nodes.label: Tau acetylation
nodes.description: SIRT1 removes tau acetylation as a deacetylase that normally limits tau aggregation, but SIRT1 activity falls under oxidative conditions, permitting acetylated, aggregation-prone tau to accumulate. This links redox state to tau post-translational control. The directionality is SIRT1 deacetylation to reduced tau aggregation. A caveat is that SIRT1 also deacetylates many other substrates, and its net effect on tau depends on cellular NAD+ availability. The NAD+-dependence of SIRT1 ties tau acetylation to cellular energetics and explains interest in NAD+-boosting strategies for tauopathies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 作為一種去乙醯酶去除了 tau acetylation，該去乙醯酶通常限制 tau 聚集，但 SIRT1 活性在氧化條件下下降，從而允許乙醯化、易於聚集的 tau 累積。這將氧化還原狀態與 tau 翻譯後控制聯繫起來。方向性是SIRT1去乙醯化以減少tau聚集。需要注意的是，SIRT1 也會使許多其他底物去乙醯基，其對 tau 的淨效應取決於細胞 NAD+ 的可用性。 SIRT1 的 NAD+ 依賴性將 tau acetylation 與細胞能量學聯繫起來，並解釋了人們對 tauopathies 的 NAD+ 增強策略的興趣。

nodes.label: rDNA
nodes.description: SIRT1 stabilizes ribosomal DNA by maintaining the silencing of rDNA repeats, essentially performing in human cells the same function that the yeast sirtuin Sir2 performs at the rDNA locus. Through its deacetylase activity and recruitment of DNMT1, SIRT1 preserves rDNA methylation and prevents the recombination events that generate toxic extrachromosomal rDNA circles during aging. This conserved function links rDNA stability to genome integrity, cellular senescence, and lifespan control across species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過維持 rDNA 重複序列的沉默來穩定核醣體 DNA，本質上在人類細胞中執行與酵母 Sirtuin Sir2 在 rDNA 基因座上執行的相同功能。透過其去乙醯化酶活性和 DNMT1 的募集，SIRT1 保留了 rDNA 甲基化，並防止在老化過程中產生有毒染色體外 rDNA 環的重組事件。這種保守的功能將 rDNA 的穩定性與基因組完整性、細胞老化和跨物種壽命控制聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Intestinal Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: SIRT1 suppresses intestinal epithelial ROS accumulation and apoptosis after ischemia-reperfusion, and resveratrol protects through the SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO pathway. SIRT3 alleviates mitochondrial oxidative damage and apoptosis via peroxiredoxin 3 deacetylation, while SIRT6 downregulation by miR-351-5p aggravates intestinal IRI injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 抑制缺血—再灌流後的腸上皮 ROS 累積與凋亡，且 resveratrol 透過 SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO 路徑保護。SIRT3 經由 peroxiredoxin 3 去乙醯化減輕粒線體氧化損傷與凋亡，而 SIRT6 經由 miR-351-5p 下調加劇腸 IRI 損傷。

nodes.label: Tamoxifen
nodes.description: SIRT1 causes tamoxifen resistance in ER-alpha-positive breast cancer by upregulating multidrug resistance protein 2 (MRP2) through FoxO1 deacetylation. SIRT1 inhibition therefore augments paclitaxel and doxorubicin cytotoxicity, while SIRT4 enhances tamoxifen sensitivity via STAT3 inhibition. This makes SIRT1 status a determinant of endocrine-therapy response in breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 ER-alpha 陽性乳癌中透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化上調多重抗藥性蛋白 2（MRP2），造成 tamoxifen 抗性。因此 SIRT1 抑制增強 paclitaxel 與 doxorubicin 細胞毒性，而 SIRT4 透過 STAT3 抑制增強 tamoxifen 敏感性。這使 SIRT1 狀態成為乳癌內分泌治療反應的決定因子。

nodes.label: T helper type 1 cells development
nodes.description: Dendritic-cell SIRT1 knockout drives T helper 1 (Th1) cell development and promotes inflammation, indicating SIRT1 normally restrains Th1 polarization. Directionally, DC SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed Th1 differentiation. This tempers cell-mediated inflammatory responses and promotes regulatory T-cell generation, shaping the balance between immunity and tolerance. It demonstrates SIRT1's immunoregulatory role in antigen presentation and is relevant to autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, where excessive Th1 responses drive pathology. The effect likely reflects SIRT1-dependent control of cytokine and costimulatory molecule expression in dendritic cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 樹突細胞 SIRT1 敲除驅動輔助性 T 1（Th1）細胞發展並促進發炎，表明 SIRT1 通常限制 Th1 偏向。在方向性上，DC SIRT1 位於被抑制的 Th1 分化的上游。這調節細胞介導的發炎反應並促進調節性 T 細胞生成，塑造免疫和耐受之間的平衡。它展示了 SIRT1 在抗原呈遞中的免疫調節角色，與自體免疫和發炎性疾病相關，在這些疾病中過度的 Th1 反應驅動病理。此效應可能反映了 SIRT1 依賴性控制樹突細胞中細胞因子和共刺激分子表達。

nodes.label: endothelial cell senescence
nodes.description: Downregulation of SIRT1 was found to be important in the senescence of different types of endothelial cells. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of cellular senescence in the vascular endothelium. Because SIRT1 normally promotes stress resistance and genomic stability, its decline in endothelial cells is linked to the senescent phenotype. This positions SIRT1 as a potential target for preserving endothelial function and preventing vascular ageing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的下調在不同類型內皮細胞的衰老中被發現具有重要意義。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於血管內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT1通常促進壓力抗性和基因組穩定性，其在內皮細胞中的下降與衰老表型相關。這將SIRT1確定為維持內皮功能和預防血管老化的潛在靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: DNA double-strand breaks (RCM)
nodes.description: During DNA repair, SIRT1 relocalizes to double-strand breaks where it deacetylates repair factors, a central mechanism of the Information Theory of Aging (RCM) framework. Directionally, DNA damage sits upstream of SIRT1 relocalization. This consumes NAD+ and redistributes chromatin modifiers, proposed to drive epigenetic drift, and it is a key node in Sinclair's model of aging. By moving to sites of damage, SIRT1 is thought to abandon its normal genomic loci, causing loss of epigenetic information. This redistribution model is the basis for the ICE-Mouse experiments linking DNA repair to epigenetic aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 DNA 修復期間，SIRT1 重新定位到雙鏈斷裂處，在那裡去乙醯化修復因子，這是衰老資訊理論（RCM）框架的核心機制。在方向性上，DNA 損傷位於 SIRT1 重新定位的上游。這消耗 NAD+ 並重新分配染色質修飾因子，被提出驅動表觀遺傳漂變，是 Sinclair 衰老模型中的關鍵節點。透過移動到損傷位點，SIRT1 被認為放棄其正常的基因組位點，導致表觀遺傳資訊的喪失。這種重新分配模型是 ICE 小鼠實驗將 DNA 修復與表觀遺傳衰老聯繫起來的基礎。

nodes.label: CRC radioresistance via β-catenin
nodes.description: FoxQ1-mediated SIRT1 upregulation augments the expression and nuclear translocation of β-catenin and benefits CRC-related intestinal pathological bacteria, thereby enhancing the radioresistance of colorectal cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulation sits upstream of β-catenin-driven survival and radiation resistance in CRC. By promoting β-catenin signaling, SIRT1 helps colorectal cancer cells survive ionizing radiation, which has implications for combining SIRT1 inhibition with radiotherapy to improve treatment outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FoxQ1介導的SIRT1上調增強了β-catenin的表達和核轉位，並有利於CRC相關的腸道致病菌，從而增強大腸直腸癌細胞的放射抗性。方向上，SIRT1上調位於CRC中β-catenin驅動的存活和輻射抗性的上游。透過促進β-catenin訊號，SIRT1幫助大腸直腸癌細胞在電離輻射中存活，這對於將SIRT1抑制與放療結合以改善治療結果具有意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: HIC1
nodes.description: HIC1 (hypermethylated in cancer 1) is a tumor suppressor that binds the SIRT1 promoter via its POZ domain and directly represses SIRT1 transcription. Because p53 transactivates HIC1, a negative feedback loop exists: p53 induces HIC1, which then restrains SIRT1, preventing excessive p53 deacetylation and preserving p53 tumor-suppressive capacity. The directionality is HIC1 → SIRT1 repression, upstream of SIRT1's inhibition of p53. Disruption of this loop in cancer can unleash SIRT1 to silence p53.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIC1（hypermethylated in cancer 1）是一種腫瘤抑制因子，通過其 POZ 結構域結合 SIRT1 啟動子並直接抑制 SIRT1 轉錄。由於 p53 反式活化 HIC1，存在一個負回饋迴路：p53 誘導 HIC1，HIC1 反過來限制 SIRT1，防止過度的 p53 去乙醯化並維持 p53 的腫瘤抑制能力。其方向性為 HIC1 → SIRT1 抑制，位於 SIRT1 對 p53 的抑制上游。此迴路在癌症中的中斷可以釋放 SIRT1 來沉默 p53。

nodes.label: PML-mediated premature senescence
nodes.description: In mouse embryonic fibroblasts, SIRT1 rescues cells from PML-mediated premature senescence by deacetylating and inhibiting p53, relieving the senescence program. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of senescence rescue. This requires the PML-p53-SIRT1 nuclear-body axis, and it shows SIRT1 can oppose proliferative arrest when appropriately engaged. By deacetylating p53 within PML nuclear bodies, SIRT1 dampens the p53-dependent senescence checkpoint. This dual role—promoting survival in normal cells but potentially enabling cancer-cell proliferation—illustrates the context-dependence of SIRT1's functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在小鼠胚胎成纖維細胞中，SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 p53 從 PML 誘導的過早衰老中拯救細胞，解除衰老程式。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於拯救衰老的上游。這需要 PML-p53-SIRT1 核體軸線，並表明 SIRT1 在適當啟動時可以對抗增殖停滯。透過在 PML 核體中去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 削弱 p53 依賴性的衰老檢查點。這種雙重角色——在正常細胞中促進存活但可能使癌細胞增殖——說明了 SIRT1 功能的情境依賴性。

nodes.label: White adipose tissue
nodes.description: In white adipose tissue, SIRT1 promotes lipolysis and fat mobilization by repressing adipogenic transcription factors such as PPAR-γ and aP2 and by co-ordinating catabolic gene programs. This shifts storage tissue from lipid accumulation toward fatty-acid release for oxidation in muscle and liver, supporting metabolic flexibility. Directionally, SIRT1 acts to repress adipogenesis and enhance fat mobilization. These actions contribute to the lean phenotype and metabolic health seen under caloric restriction, and reduced SIRT1 in visceral adipose stem cells from obese individuals is associated with enhanced adipogenic capacity and visceral fat expansion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在白色脂肪組織中，SIRT1 通過抑制脂肪生成轉錄因子（如 PPAR-γ 和 aP2）並協調分解代謝基因程序來促進脂肪分解和脂肪動員。這使儲存組織從脂質累積轉向脂肪酸釋放，以在肌肉和肝臟中進行氧化，支持代謝靈活性。在方向性上，SIRT1 的作用是抑制脂肪生成並增強脂肪動員。這些作用有助於在熱量限制下看到的精瘦表型和代謝健康，肥胖者內臟脂肪幹細胞中 SIRT1 的減少與增強的脂肪生成能力和內臟脂肪擴張相關。

nodes.label: NAM (nicotinamide)
nodes.description: Nicotinamide is a known potent inhibitor of several classes of ribosylase enzymes that require NAD for their activity, as well as of SIRT1, the class III NAD+-dependent histone deacetylase. NAM acts as an end-product noncompetitive inhibitor of SIRT1 by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to NAD+, thereby blocking NAD+ hydrolysis. Because NAM is generated by the sirtuin reaction itself, it provides a built-in negative feedback mechanism that can curtail SIRT1 activity when local nicotinamide accumulates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺是多種需要NAD的核糖基酶以及SIRT1（第III類NAD+依賴性組蛋白去乙醯酶）的已知強效抑制劑。NAM透過結合到與NAD+相鄰的保守口袋作為SIRT1的末端產物非競爭性抑制劑，從而阻斷NAD+水解。由於NAM是sirtuin反應本身產生的，它提供了一個內建的負反饋機制，可以在局部菸鹼醯胺積累時限制SIRT1活性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Sepsis-induced inflammatory lung injury
nodes.description: Overall SIRT1 knockout mice are highly susceptible to sepsis-induced inflammatory lung injury due to activation of the proinflammatory transcription factor NF-kappaB. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of heightened inflammatory lung damage. Because SIRT1 normally deacetylates and restrains NF-kappaB, its absence removes a key brake on inflammatory gene expression during sepsis. This unleashes an exaggerated inflammatory response that damages the lung, illustrating SIRT1's protective role in acute inflammatory injury. Restoring SIRT1 activity may therefore help dampen the excessive inflammation that complicates sepsis and contributes to acute respiratory failure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1基因敲除小鼠由於促發炎轉錄因子NF-kappaB的活化而高度易感於敗血症誘導的發炎性肺損傷。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於炎症性肺損傷加重的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化並抑制NF-kappaB，其缺失在敗血症期間移除了發炎基因表達的關鍵制動器。這釋放了過度的發炎反應損害肺部，說明了SIRT1在急性發炎性損傷中的保護作用。因此恢復SIRT1活性可能有助於抑制使敗血症複雜化並導致急性呼吸衰竭的過度發炎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: TGF-β1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis
nodes.description: Overexpression of SIRT1 abolishes TGF-β1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis and suppresses CTGF expression in mouse kidney, protecting renal tissue from TGF-β1 insult. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed TGF-β1 pathology. This renoprotective action operates via deacetylation of TGF-β pathway components, including the promotion of Smad7 degradation that tempers TGF-β signaling in glomerular cells. It supports SIRT1 activation as a strategy against kidney fibrosis, and it is consistent with SIRT1's broader antifibrotic effects in heart and lung. Preserving SIRT1 in the kidney may slow the progression of chronic kidney disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過量表達消除 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡和纖維化，並在小鼠腎臟中抑制 CTGF 表達，保護腎組織免受 TGF-β1 損傷。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 TGF-β1 病理上游。這種腎保護作用通過 TGF-β 通路組分的去乙醯化運作，包括促進 Smad7 降解以調節腎小球細胞中的 TGF-β 信號。它支持 SIRT1 活化作為對抗腎纖維化的策略，與 SIRT1 在心臟和肺中的更廣泛抗纖維化效應一致。在腎臟中保留 SIRT1 可能減緩慢性腎病的進展。

nodes.label: osteopontin-induced NF-κB p65 acetylation and EMT
nodes.description: Overexpression of SIRT1 protects non-small-cell lung cancer cells against osteopontin-induced NF-κB p65 acetylation and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, thereby attenuating osteopontin-driven cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of dampened NF-κB signaling and EMT in response to the pro-metastatic cytokine osteopontin. By deacetylating p65 and restraining EMT, SIRT1 limits the invasive and proliferative program that osteopontin triggers in NSCLC cells, supporting a tumor-suppressive role in this context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的過表達保護非小細胞肺癌細胞免受骨橋蛋白誘導的NF-κB p65乙醯化和上皮-間質轉化，從而減輕骨橋蛋白驅動的細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT1位於對促轉移細胞因子骨橋蛋白的NF-κB訊號和EMT減弱的上游。透過去乙醯化p65並抑制EMT，SIRT1限制了骨橋蛋白在NSCLC細胞中觸發的侵襲性和增殖性程序，在此環境中支持腫瘤抑制角色。
nodes.norm_label: osteopontin-induced nf-κb p65 acetylation and emt
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment
nodes.description: Pharmacological targeting or RNAi-mediated knockdown of SIRT1 inhibits cell growth and sensitizes acute myeloid leukemia cells to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of enhanced drug sensitivity in AML. By restraining SIRT1-driven survival, AML cells become more responsive to tyrosine kinase inhibitors, suggesting that combining SIRT1 inhibition with TKI therapy could improve leukemia treatment outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的藥理學靶向或RNAi介導的沉默抑制細胞生長並使急性骨髓性白血病細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於AML中藥物敏感性增強的上游。透過抑制SIRT1驅動的存活，AML細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑變得更加敏感，表明將SIRT1抑制與TKI治療結合可能改善白血病治療結果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: FOXO1/FOXO3
nodes.description: SIRT1 activates FOXO1/FOXO3 by deacetylation, coupling NAD+ sensing to stress resistance and metabolic gene programs (Brunet 2004 PMID 15066266).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化作用活化 FOXO1/FOXO3，將 NAD+ 感知與抗壓反應和代謝基因程序耦合（Brunet 2004 PMID 15066266）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Lox-1-mediated foam cell formation
nodes.description: SIRT1 activation reduces lectin-like oxidized-LDL receptor-1 (Lox-1)-mediated foam cell formation by suppressing NF-κB signaling in vascular cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of inhibited Lox-1 scavenging of oxidized LDL. This limits macrophage lipid loading, a key early step in atherosclerosis, and reduces the inflammatory cascade triggered by ox-LDL uptake. It is a vascular anti-atherogenic action of SIRT1, complementing its activation of eNOS and its regulation of TIMP3. By restraining foam-cell formation, SIRT1 slows the development of atherosclerotic plaques in the vessel wall.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 活化通過抑制血管細胞中的 NF-κB 信號來減少凝集素樣氧化低密度脂蛋白受體-1（Lox-1）介導的泡沫細胞形成。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 Lox-1 對氧化低密度脂蛋白的清道夫作用上游。這限制巨噬細胞的脂質裝載（動脈粥樣硬化的關鍵早期步驟），並減少氧化低密度脂蛋白攝入觸發的發炎級聯。這是 SIRT1 的血管抗動脈粥樣硬化作用，與其對 eNOS 的活化和對 TIMP3 的調節互補。通過限制泡沫細胞形成，SIRT1 減緩血管壁中動脈粥樣硬化斑塊的發展。

nodes.label: Osteoblasts (vs adipocytes)
nodes.description: SIRT1 activators promote osteoblast differentiation while suppressing adipocyte formation from mesenchymal progenitors, biasing lineage commitment toward bone. This effect is linked to SIRT1's repression of PPAR-γ and support of RUNX2/osteogenic programs. The directionality is SIRT1 favoring osteogenesis over adipogenesis. The association carries moderate confidence (0.75) but has therapeutic implications for osteoporosis. Importantly, it complements SIRT1's opposing action on myogenesis, underscoring context dependence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 活化因子促進骨母細胞分化，同時抑制來自間充質前體細胞的脂肪細胞形成，使譜系承諾偏向骨骼。這種效應與 SIRT1 對 PPAR-γ 的抑制和支持 RUNX2/骨生成程序相關。在方向性上，SIRT1 偏好骨生成而非脂肪生成。此關聯的信心程度為中等（0.75），但對骨質疏鬆症具有治療意義。重要的是，它與 SIRT1 對肌肉生成的對立作用互補，強調了情境依賴性。

nodes.label: colorectal cancer via glutamine metabolism and apoptosis
nodes.description: SIRT1 affects colorectal cancer in a dose-dependent manner by regulating glutamine metabolism and apoptotic pathways. Heterozygous deletion of SIRT1 induces c-Myc expression, enhancing glutamine metabolism, proliferation, autophagy, and cancer formation, whereas homozygous deletion triggers apoptosis, increases cell death, diminishes autophagy, and reduces cancer formation. Directionally, SIRT1 expression level sits upstream of opposing metabolic and survival outcomes in CRC, explaining the dual roles of SIRT1 in colorectal tumorigenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1以劑量依賴的方式透過調節穀氨醯胺代謝和凋亡途徑影響大腸直腸癌。SIRT1的雜合缺失誘導c-Myc表達，增強穀氨醯胺代謝、增殖、自噬和癌症形成，而純合缺失則觸發凋亡、增加細胞死亡、減少自噬並降低癌症形成。方向上，SIRT1表達水平位於CRC中對立的代謝和存活結果的上游，解釋了SIRT1在大腸直腸癌發生中的雙重角色。
nodes.norm_label: colorectal cancer via glutamine metabolism and apoptosis
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: pancreatic cancer cells
nodes.description: SIRT1 can facilitate chemoresistance of pancreatic cancer cells by regulating their adaptive response to chemotherapy-induced stress. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of stress adaptation and reduced drug sensitivity in pancreatic cancer. By helping tumor cells adapt to chemotherapy-induced stress, SIRT1 enables pancreatic cancer cells to survive cytotoxic treatment. This identifies SIRT1 as a potential target to overcome chemoresistance in pancreatic cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1可以透過調節胰腺癌細胞對化療誘導壓力的適應性反應來促進化療耐藥性。方向上，SIRT1位於胰腺癌中壓力適應和藥物敏感性降低的上游。透過幫助腫瘤細胞適應化療誘導的壓力，SIRT1使胰腺癌細胞能够在細胞毒治療中存活。這將SIRT1確定為克服胰腺癌化療耐藥性的潛在靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: FoxO1/MDR2 upregulation
nodes.description: SIRT1 causes tamoxifen resistance in ER-alpha-positive breast cancer cells through upregulation of multidrug resistance protein 2 (MDR2), an effect mediated by deacetylation of the transcription factor FoxO1. Inhibition of SIRT1 impairs nuclear FoxO1 accumulation and MDR2 expression and augments the cytotoxic effects of paclitaxel and doxorubicin in tamoxifen-resistant cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of FoxO1- and MDR2-mediated chemoresistance. By driving drug-efflux capacity in resistant cells, SIRT1 reduces the efficacy of endocrine therapy and other agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過上調多藥耐藥蛋白2（MDR2）導致ER-alpha陽性乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen耐藥性，此效果透過轉錄因子FoxO1的去乙醯化介導。抑制SIRT1損害核FoxO1的積累和MDR2表達，並增強紫杉醇和doxorubicin在Tamoxifen耐藥細胞中的細胞毒作用。方向上，SIRT1位於FoxO1和MDR2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過驅動耐藥細胞中的藥物外排能力，SIRT1降低了內分泌療法和其他藥物的療效。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Huntington's disease models
nodes.description: SIRT1 conferred neuroprotection in three different mouse models of Huntington's disease; overexpression attenuated mutant huntingtin neurotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在三種不同的亨廷頓氏症小鼠模型中賦予神經保護作用；過表達減弱了突變 huntingtin 的神經毒性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: PGC-1α regulation
nodes.description: SIRT1 confers neuroprotection partly through deacetylation and activation of PGC-1α, which drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant defenses in neurons. Enhanced PGC-1α activity counters the energetic and oxidative deficits underlying neurodegeneration, and PGC-1α knockout mice are markedly more sensitive to toxins such as MPTP and kainic acid. Directionally, SIRT1 activates PGC-1α to build neuronal resilience. This axis is a leading explanation for how SIRT1 activation benefits Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and other neurodegenerative models, and it connects sirtuin biology to mitochondrial health as a central determinant of neuronal survival in aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 部分通過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1α 提供神經保護，PGC-1α 驅動神經元的粒線體生物合成和抗氧化防禦。PGC-1α 活性增強對抗神經退行性疾病的能量和氧化缺陷，PGC-1α 敲除小鼠對 MPTP 和 kainic acid 等毒素顯著更敏感。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化 PGC-1α 以建立神經元的韌性。這個軸是解釋 SIRT1 活化如何有益於帕金森症、阿茲海默症和其他神經退行性疾病模型的主要假說，將 sirtuin 生物學與粒線體健康（作為衰老中神經元存活的中心決定因素）聯繫起來。

nodes.label: XPA deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT1 controls UV-induced DNA damage repair by deacetylating xeroderma pigmentosum group A (XPA), a protein that is required for the nucleotide excision repair pathway to function properly. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of XPA activity and thereby of nucleotide excision repair. This places SIRT1 in the DNA damage response network and links sirtuin function to the maintenance of genomic integrity following environmental genotoxic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化著色性乾皮症A組（XPA）蛋白來控制紫外線誘導的DNA損傷修復，XPA是核苷酸切除修復途徑正常運作所需的蛋白質。方向上，SIRT1位於XPA活性的上游，從而位於核苷酸切除修復的上游。這將SIRT1置於DNA損傷反應網路中，並將sirtuin功能與環境基因毒性壓力後基因組完整性的維護聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Adiponectin gene expression (via FOXO1-C/EBPα)
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO1 and enhances its interaction with C/EBPα, a combination that drives transcription of the adiponectin gene and raises circulating adiponectin. Adiponectin in turn improves insulin sensitivity and has anti-inflammatory effects in liver and muscle. Directionally, SIRT1 acts through FOXO1 and C/EBPα to promote adiponectin expression. This links SIRT1 to beneficial adipokine secretion and metabolic health, and forms part of a positive circuit in which SIRT1-mediated adiponectin induction reinforces systemic insulin sensitivity, consistent with the insulin-sensitizing phenotype associated with SIRT1 activation and caloric restriction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO1 並增強其與 C/EBPα 的相互作用，這組合驅動脂聯素基因的轉錄並提高循環脂聯素水平。脂聯素反過來改善胰島素敏感性並在肝臟和肌肉中具有抗發炎效應。在方向性上，SIRT1 通過 FOXO1 和 C/EBPα 促進脂聯素表達。這將 SIRT1 與有益的脂肪因子分泌和代謝健康聯繫起來，並形成一個正向電路的一部分：SIRT1 介導的脂聯素誘導增強全身胰島素敏感性，與 SIRT1 活化和熱量限制相關的胰島素增敏表型一致。

nodes.label: Histone H2A.Z (Lys115, Lys121)
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates Lys115 and Lys121 of the histone variant H2A.Z, a mark that licenses H2A.Z for ubiquitination and proteasome-dependent degradation. Removing these acetyl groups thus destabilizes H2A.Z at chromatin and reduces its occupancy at target promoters. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically modifies H2A.Z upstream of its clearance from chromatin. Because H2A.Z promotes pathological gene programs, including those driving maladaptive cardiac hypertrophy, its removal by SIRT1 is protective in the heart, and this mechanism illustrates how a sirtuin can shape transcription by controlling the stability of a histone variant rather than only its acetylation state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化組蛋白變體 H2A.Z 的 Lys115 和 Lys121，這種修飾允許 H2A.Z 被泛素化和蛋白酶體依賴性降解。因此移除這些乙醯基使 H2A.Z 在染色質上不穩定，並降低其在靶標啟動子處的佔有率。在方向性上，SIRT1 在酶學上修飾 H2A.Z，位於其從染色質清除的上游。由於 H2A.Z 促進病理性基因程序（包括驅動適應不良心臟肥大的程序），其被 SIRT1 移除在心臟中具有保護作用，此機制說明了 sirtuin 如何通過控制組蛋白變體的穩定性而非僅僅其乙醯化狀態來塑造轉錄。

nodes.label: H3K14
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates Lys14 of histone H3 (H3K14ac), a mark associated with active transcription, thereby contributing to gene silencing at targeted promoters. Loss of H3K14ac reduces promoter accessibility and cooperates with other repressive modifications to restrain transcription, making this a mechanism of chromatin-level control. Directionally, SIRT1 acts enzymatically to remove the acetyl mark and shift chromatin toward repression. This histone-targeting activity complements SIRT1 deacetylation of non-histone substrates and helps explain how a single sirtuin coordinates broad transcriptional programs across the genome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的 Lys14（H3K14ac），這是一個與活躍轉錄相關的標記，因此有助於在靶標啟動子處的基因沉默。H3K14ac 的缺失降低了啟動子可及性，並與其他抑制性修飾協同限制轉錄，使其成為染色質水平控制的一種機制。在方向性上，SIRT1 在酶學上移除乙醯標記，使染色質向抑制方向轉變。這種組蛋白靶向活性與 SIRT1 對非組蛋白受質的去乙醯化互補，有助於解釋單一 sirtuin 如何在全基因組範圍內協調廣泛的轉錄程序。

nodes.label: Tat (HIV-1 protein)
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates Lys50 of the HIV-1 transactivator Tat, a modification that increases Tat's affinity for the viral LTR and its ability to recruit the transcription machinery. This enzymatic action therefore activates, rather than suppresses, the viral protein, promoting robust expression of viral genes from the proviral genome. Directionally, SIRT1 modifies Tat and thereby enhances viral transcription, revealing an unexpected pro-viral role for the otherwise cytoprotective SIRT1. Because deacetylated Tat is a more potent transactivator, the interaction represents a host factor that HIV exploits, making SIRT1–Tat a candidate target for antiviral strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 HIV-1 轉錄活化因子 Tat 的 Lys50，這種修飾增加 Tat 對病毒 LTR 的親和力及其招募轉錄機制的能力。因此這種酶學作用是活化而非抑制病毒蛋白，促進病毒基因在前病毒基因組上的強力表達。在方向性上，SIRT1 修飾 Tat 從而增強病毒轉錄，揭示了通常具有細胞保護作用的 SIRT1 的一個意想不到的促病毒角色。由於去乙醯化的 Tat 是更強的轉錄活化因子，這種相互作用代表了 HIV 利用的宿主因子，使 SIRT1–Tat 成為抗病毒策略的候選靶點。

nodes.label: NAMPT/NAD+ cycle
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates PGC-1alpha and amplifies expression of the circadian transcription factors BMAL1 and CLOCK. A key target of the BMAL1-CLOCK complex is NAMPT, establishing a circadian NAD+ biosynthesis cycle that rhythmically activates and deactivates SIRT1 in alignment with the daily cycle. Directionally, the NAMPT-NAD+ cycle sits upstream of rhythmic SIRT1 activity. Because SIRT1 feeds back to regulate clock components, this forms a stable oscillator coupling metabolism to circadian time. Disruption of this loop, as seen with aging and shift work, impairs both circadian function and metabolic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化PGC-1alpha並放大晝夜節律轉錄因子BMAL1和CLOCK的表達。BMAL1-CLOCK複合物的一個關鍵靶標是NAMPT，建立了晝夜節律NAD+生物合成循環，有節奏地活化和失活SIRT1以與每日週期對齊。方向上，NAMPT-NAD+循環位於節律性SIRT1活性的上游。因為SIRT1反饋調節時鐘成分，這形成了一個穩定的振盪器，將代謝與晝夜節律時間耦合。此迴路的中斷，如老化和輪班工作中所見，會損害晝夜節律功能和代謝健康。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md

nodes.label: WAT browning
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates PPARgamma at lysine residues K268 and K293, and this modification promotes exchange of cofactors within the PPARgamma transcriptional complex. The resulting change in cofactor recruitment enhances browning of white adipose tissue, increasing thermogenesis, mitochondrial biogenesis, and PGC-1alpha-dependent oxidative programs. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic modification of PPARgamma sits upstream of beige adipocyte induction. Because PPARgamma is a master regulator of adipocyte biology, its deacetylation by SIRT1 can shift adipose tissue from a fat-storing toward a fat-burning phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1在賴氨酸殘基K268和K293位點去乙醯化PPARgamma，此修飾促進PPARgamma轉錄複合物中輔因子的交換。輔因子徵集的變化增強了白色脂肪組織的褐化，增加生熱作用、粒線體生成和PGC-1alpha依賴性的氧化程序。方向上，SIRT1對PPARgamma的酵素修飾位於米色脂肪細胞誘導的上游。由於PPARgamma是脂肪細胞生物學的主控調節因子，其被SIRT1去乙醯化可以將脂肪組織從儲脂表型轉向燃脂表型。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: RNA Polymerase I transcription (via TAFI68 deacetylation)
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates TAFI68, a subunit of the RNA polymerase I transcription factor complex, decreasing its DNA-binding activity and thereby repressing rRNA transcription. This contrasts with SIRT7, which activates Pol I, illustrating divergent sirtuin control of ribosome biogenesis within the same family. Directionally, SIRT1 acts on TAFI68 to repress Pol I output. By limiting ribosome production, SIRT1 can restrain growth and oppose the biosynthetic programs favored in cancer and pathological hypertrophy, positioning the SIRT1/SIRT7 balance as a rheostat that determines whether cells commit to growth-oriented or maintenance-oriented metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 TAFI68，這是 RNA 聚合酶 I 轉錄因子複合體的一個亞基，降低其 DNA 結合活性，從而抑制 rRNA 轉錄。這與活化 Pol I 的 SIRT7 形成對比，說明同一 sirtuin 家族內對核糖體生物合成的分歧性控制。在方向性上，SIRT1 作用於 TAFI68 以抑制 Pol I 輸出。通過限制核糖體產生，SIRT1 可以抑制生長並對抗癌症和病理性肥大中偏好的生物合成程序，使 SIRT1/SIRT7 平衡成為一個決定細胞是投入生長導向還是維護導向代謝的調節器。
nodes.norm_label: rna polymerase i transcription (via tafi68 deacetylation)

nodes.label: AceCS1
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates acetyl-CoA synthetase 1 (AceCS1) in the cytoplasm, analogous to SIRT3's activation of the mitochondrial AceCS2, permitting acetate utilization outside the mitochondrion. Activated AceCS1 supplies cytosolic acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification, fatty-acid synthesis, and other biosynthetic reactions. Directionally, SIRT1 activates AceCS1 to feed cytosolic acetyl-CoA metabolism. Together with SIRT3, this shows sirtuins broadly license acetate salvage across compartments, coupling nutrient availability and redox state to acetyl-CoA pools that influence both bioenergetics and the epigenetic regulation of gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化細胞質中的乙醯-CoA 合酶 1（AceCS1），類似於 SIRT3 對粒線體 AceCS2 的活化，允許在粒線體外利用乙酸。活化的 AceCS1 提供細胞質乙醯-CoA 用於染色質修飾、脂肪酸合成和其他生物合成反應。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化 AceCS1 以支持細胞質乙醯-CoA 代謝。與 SIRT3 一起，這表明 sirtuin 在不同區室中廣泛授權乙酸的回收利用，將營養可利用性和氧化還原狀態與影響生物能量學和表觀遺傳基因表達調節的乙醯-CoA 池偶聯起來。

nodes.label: p53 at Lys379
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates p53 specifically at Lys379, inhibiting p53-dependent apoptosis and promoting cell survival under genotoxic stress. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically inactivates p53 at this site. This is one of several lysines, including Lys317 and Lys370, targeted by SIRT1, and the net effect is cytoprotection that can be oncogenic in established tumors. By dampening p53-mediated apoptosis, SIRT1 biases cells toward repair and survival after DNA damage. The p53-SIRT1 axis is thus a double-edged sword, protecting normal tissues but also potentially shielding cancer cells from death signals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 特別在 Lys379 位點去乙醯化 p53，抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡並在基因毒性壓力下促進細胞存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式在此位點使 p53 失活。這是 SIRT1 靶向的多個賴氨酸位點之一（包括 Lys317 和 Lys370），淨效應是細胞保護，這在已確立的腫瘤中可能具有致瘤性。透過抑制 p53 介導的凋亡，SIRT1 使細胞在 DNA 損傷後傾向於修復和存活。p53-SIRT1 軸線因此是一把雙刃劍，在保護正常組織的同時也可能保護癌細胞免於死亡訊號。

nodes.label: H3K16ac
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the histone mark H3K16ac, promoting chromatin compaction / transcriptional repression at target loci as part of its NAD+-dependent deacetylase program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化組蛋白標記 H3K16ac，促進靶位點的染色質凝縮/轉錄抑制，作為其 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶程序的一部分。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: H3K26ac
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the histone mark H3K26ac, promoting chromatin compaction / transcriptional repression at target loci as part of its NAD+-dependent deacetylase program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化組蛋白標記 H3K26ac，促進靶位點的染色質凝縮/轉錄抑制，作為其 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶程序的一部分。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: LXR (Liver X Receptor)
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the liver X receptor (LXR), a nuclear receptor that regulates cholesterol metabolism and efflux. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically modulates LXR. This influences reverse cholesterol transport and lipid homeostasis, expanding SIRT1's role in cardiovascular and metabolic regulation. By deacetylating LXR, SIRT1 can alter the expression of cholesterol-efflux genes, connecting sirtuin activity to lipid handling. This regulation is relevant to atherosclerosis and metabolic disease, where cholesterol homeostasis is central, and it complements SIRT1's actions on PPARs and other nuclear receptors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化肝臟 X 受體（LXR）——一種調控膽固醇代謝和外排的核受體。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式調節 LXR。這影響逆向膽固醇運輸和脂質恆定性，擴展了 SIRT1 在心血管和代謝調節中的角色。透過去乙醯化 LXR，SIRT1 可以改變膽固醇外排基因的表達，將 sirtuin 活性與脂質處理聯繫起來。此調控與動脈粥樣硬化和代謝疾病相關，在這些疾病中膽固醇恆定性至關重要，並與 SIRT1 對 PPAR 和其他核受體的作用互補。

nodes.label: ROCK1 (neurons)
nodes.description: SIRT1 downregulates ROCK1 expression in neurons, which induces α-secretase (ADAM10) activity relevant to amyloid precursor processing and Alzheimer's prevention under caloric restriction. Directionally, SIRT1 suppresses ROCK1, which induces α-secretase. This shifts APP cleavage away from the amyloidogenic β-secretase pathway, reducing β-amyloid production. By promoting the non-amyloidogenic processing of APP through ADAM10, SIRT1 protects against amyloid pathology in Alzheimer's models. This mechanism is induced by caloric restriction and links sirtuin activity to the prevention of Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在神經元中下調 ROCK1 表達，後者誘導 α-分泌酶（ADAM10）活性，與澱粉樣前體蛋白加工和限制熱量預防阿茲海默症相關。在方向性上，SIRT1 抑制 ROCK1，後者誘導 α-分泌酶。這將 APP 切割從 β-分泌酶的澱粉樣生成途徑轉移，減少 β-澱粉樣蛋白的產生。透過透過 ADAM10 促進 APP 的非澱粉樣生成加工，SIRT1 在阿茲海默症模型中保護免受澱粉樣病理。此機制由限制熱量誘導，將 sirtuin 活性與預防阿茲海默症聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Angiotensin II type 1 receptor expression
nodes.description: SIRT1 downregulates angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) expression in vascular smooth-muscle cells, reducing angiotensin-II signaling. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of AT1R suppression. Lower AT1R diminishes vasoconstriction and hypertensive signaling, contributing to SIRT1's antihypertensive actions. This is consistent with the observation that resveratrol-driven SIRT1 elevation reduces angiotensin-II-induced hypertension in vivo. By dampening the renin-angiotensin system's most important receptor, SIRT1 provides vascular protection that parallels the effects of AT1R blockers, positioning sirtuin activation as a complementary approach to blood-pressure control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在血管平滑肌細胞中下調血管張力素 II 1 型受體（AT1R）的表達，減少血管張力素 II 的訊號傳導。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 AT1R 抑制的上游。較低的 AT1R 減少血管收縮和高血壓訊號，有助於 SIRT1 的降血壓作用。這與 resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調在體內減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓的觀察一致。透過抑制腎素-血管張力素系統最重要的受體，SIRT1 提供了類似 AT1R 阻斷劑效果的血管保護，將 sirtuin 活化定位為血壓控制的互補方法。

nodes.label: AIM2 inflammasome-mediated immunity
nodes.description: SIRT1 enables HPV-infected cervical cancer cells to continue growing by nullifying absent in melanoma 2 inflammasome-mediated immunity. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed inflammasome signaling and immune clearance in cervical cancer. By inactivating the AIM2 inflammasome, SIRT1 helps HPV-infected cervical cancer cells evade innate immune surveillance, supporting their continued growth. This positions the SIRT1-AIM2 axis as a potential immunotherapeutic target in HPV-driven cervical cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1使HPV感染的子宮頸癌細胞能够透過消除黑色素瘤缺失2（AIM2）發炎小體介導的免疫來繼續生長。方向上，SIRT1位於子宮頸癌中發炎小體訊號和免疫清除抑制的上游。透過使AIM2發炎小體失活，SIRT1幫助HPV感染的子宮頸癌細胞逃避先天免疫監視，支持其持續生長。這將SIRT1-AIM2軸確定為HPV驅動的子宮頸癌中的潛在免疫治療靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: HMGB1 suppression
nodes.description: SIRT1 expression suppresses the expression and acetylation of high-mobility group box 1 protein, thereby inhibiting migration, invasion, and angiogenesis of ovarian cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of reduced HMGB1-driven metastatic and angiogenic programs. By dampening HMGB1, SIRT1 limits the invasive and blood-supply-supporting behaviors of ovarian cancer cells, supporting a tumor-suppressive role and identifying the SIRT1-HMGB1 axis as a candidate therapeutic target in ovarian cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的表達抑制高遷移率族盒1蛋白（HMGB1）的表達和乙醯化，從而抑制卵巢癌細胞的遷移、侵襲和血管新生。方向上，SIRT1位於HMGB1驅動的轉移和血管新生程序減少的上游。透過抑制HMGB1，SIRT1限制了卵巢癌細胞的侵襲性和血液供應支持行為，支持腫瘤抑制角色，並將SIRT1-HMGB1軸確定為卵巢癌中的候選治療靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: 40 substrates
nodes.description: SIRT1 functions as a deacetylase that modulates more than forty known substrates involved in inflammation, stress resistance, mitochondrial biogenesis, fatty acid metabolism, insulin secretion, glucose production, and lipid homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic activity sits upstream of a broad network of cellular processes. This extraordinary substrate diversity explains why SIRT1 participates in metabolism, stress resistance, inflammation, and longevity across many tissues. The wide substrate range also means SIRT1's effects are highly context-dependent, with outcomes shaped by the tissue, the nutrient state, and the specific substrates engaged.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1作為去乙醯酶發揮作用，調節超過四十種已知底物，涉及發炎、壓力抗性、粒線體生成、脂肪酸代謝、胰島素分泌、葡萄糖生成和脂質恆定。方向上，SIRT1酵素活性位於廣泛細胞過程網絡的上游。這種非凡的底物多樣性解釋了為何SIRT1在多種組織中參與代謝、壓力抗性、發炎和長壽。廣泛的底物範圍也意味著SIRT1的效果高度依賴環境，結果由組織、營養狀態和參與的特定底物所決定。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md

nodes.label: oxidative stress and age-related NAD+ decline
nodes.description: SIRT1 has a significant role in oxidative stress response. Increased SIRT1 protein levels counteract oxidative stress and the ageing-related decline in NAD+ levels. In elderly humans SIRT1 protein expression shows a remarkable age-related increase against oxidative stress. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of cellular defence against oxidative damage, and its induction appears to be a compensatory anti-ageing response that mitigates the consequences of declining NAD+ availability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1在氧化壓力反應中具有重要作用。增加的SIRT1蛋白水平對抗氧化壓力和與年齡相關的NAD+水平下降。在老年人中，SIRT1蛋白表達顯示出對抗氧化壓力的顯著與年齡相關的增加。方向上，SIRT1位於對氧化損傷的細胞防禦的上游，其誘導似乎是一種補償性的抗老化反應，減輕了NAD+可用性下降的後果。
nodes.norm_label: oxidative stress and age-related nad+ decline
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Muscle cells (myogenesis)
nodes.description: SIRT1 inhibits myogenesis by deacetylating histones H3K9 and H3K14 at the promoters of myogenin and myosin heavy chain, repressing muscle-gene expression. This keeps myoblasts in a less differentiated state under certain conditions, opposing the myogenic program driven by MyoD and MEF2. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed muscle differentiation. However, SIRT1 can also support muscle maintenance under stress, so context matters: SIRT1 also deacetylates PCAF and MyoD themselves to restrain differentiation, yet in aging or metabolic stress it protects muscle from damage, illustrating that SIRT1's net effect on muscle depends on the balance of these opposing actions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 通過去乙醯化肌生成素和肌球蛋白重鏈啟動子處的組蛋白 H3K9 和 H3K14 來抑制肌肉生成，在某些條件下抑制肌肉基因表達，保持肌母細胞處於較不分化的狀態，對抗由 MyoD 和 MEF2 驅動的肌生成程序。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於抑制肌肉分化的上游。然而，SIRT1 在壓力下也可以支持肌肉維護，因此情境很重要：SIRT1 也去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 本身以限制分化，但在衰老或代謝壓力中保護肌肉免受損傷，說明 SIRT1 對肌肉的淨效應取決於這些對立作用的平衡。

nodes.label: Metabolic switch in cardiac hypertrophy
nodes.description: SIRT1 interacts with and activates PPARalpha to prevent the metabolic switch from fatty acid oxidation to glycolysis that occurs in cardiac hypertrophy. By promoting fatty acid oxidation gene expression and inactivating NF-kappaB, SIRT1 preserves the adult heart's preferred fuel preference. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of PPARalpha-dependent metabolic preservation. Maintaining fatty acid oxidation prevents the maladaptive glycolytic shift that accompanies hypertrophic growth and heart failure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1與PPARalpha相互作用並活化它，以防止心臟肥大中從脂肪酸氧化到糖解作用的代謝轉換。透過促進脂肪酸氧化基因表達並使NF-kappaB失活，SIRT1維持成年心臟首選的燃料偏好。方向上，SIRT1位於PPARalpha依賴性代謝維持的上游。維持脂肪酸氧化可防止伴隨肥大性生長和心力衰竭的不適應性糖解轉換。

nodes.label: Vasculature
nodes.description: SIRT1 is highly expressed in the vasculature, including endothelial and smooth-muscle cells, positioning it as a central regulator of vascular homeostasis. Directionally, constitutive vascular abundance enables rapid SIRT1 responses to metabolic and shear stress. This expression pattern underlies its roles in vasodilation, inflammation, and atherosclerosis, and loss of vascular SIRT1 promotes endothelial dysfunction. Because the endothelium is constantly exposed to hemodynamic and metabolic signals, SIRT1's abundance in this tissue allows it to integrate nutrient status with vascular function, making it a key determinant of blood-vessel health and disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在血管系統中高度表達，包括內皮細胞和平滑肌細胞，使其成為血管恆定性的核心調節因子。在方向性上，組成性的血管豐度使 SIRT1 能夠快速回應代謝和剪切壓力。這種表達模式奠定了其在血管舒張、發炎和動脈粥樣硬化中的角色，而血管 SIRT1 的缺失促進內皮功能障礙。由於內皮持續暴露於血液動力學和代謝訊號，SIRT1 在此組織中的豐度使其能將營養狀態與血管功能整合，成為血管健康和疾病的關鍵決定因素。

nodes.label: Angiogenic activity during vascular remodeling
nodes.description: SIRT1 modulates angiogenic activity during vascular remodeling and growth, influencing endothelial sprouting and vessel stability in a context-dependent manner. Directionally, SIRT1 tunes angiogenic signaling. It can either promote or restrain angiogenesis depending on oxygen and metabolic cues, reflecting SIRT1's integration of stress and metabolic inputs in the vessel wall. In some settings SIRT1 supports the neovascularization needed for tissue repair, while in others it limits the pathological angiogenesis that feeds tumors. This context-dependence makes SIRT1 a nuanced regulator of vessel growth, with implications for both regenerative medicine and oncology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在血管重塑和生長過程中調節血管生成活性，以情境依賴的方式影響內皮萌芽和血管穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT1 調節血管生成訊號。根據氧氣和代謝訊號的不同，SIRT1 可以促進或限制血管生成，反映了 SIRT1 在血管壁中整合壓力和代謝輸入的能力。在某些情況下，SIRT1 支持組織修復所需的新血管生成，而在其他情況下則限制餵養腫瘤的病理性血管生成。這種情境依賴性使 SIRT1 成為血管生長的精細調節因子，對再生醫學和腫瘤學都有影響。

nodes.label: obesity-associated metabolic derangement
nodes.description: SIRT1 overexpression protects against obesity-associated metabolic derangement via deacetylation of metabolic transcription factors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達透過去乙醯化代謝轉錄因子來保護免受肥胖相關的代謝紊亂。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: α-synuclein aggregates (Parkinson's disease)
nodes.description: SIRT1 overexpression reduces α-synuclein aggregates, supporting a role in Parkinson's protection (via FOXO/autophagy pathways).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達減少 α-synuclein 聚集體，支持其在帕金森氏症保護中的作用（透過 FOXO/自噬通路）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: VEGF-A elevation
nodes.description: SIRT1 promotes cisplatin resistance in non-small-cell lung cancer cells by elevating expression of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A). SIRT1 is upregulated in cisplatin-resistant tumor tissues and cells compared with cisplatin-sensitive groups, correlating with the resistant phenotype. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of VEGF-A-mediated chemoresistance. By enhancing VEGF-A, SIRT1 may support tumor survival and adaptive responses that blunt the cytotoxic effects of cisplatin. This identifies SIRT1 as a potential target for overcoming chemotherapy resistance in lung cancer, since inhibiting SIRT1 could lower VEGF-A and re-sensitize resistant tumors to platinum-based treatment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過升高血管內皮生長因子A（VEGF-A）的表達促進非小細胞肺癌細胞的順鉑耐藥性。與順鉑敏感組相比，SIRT1在順鉑耐藥的腫瘤組織和細胞中上調，與耐藥表型相關。方向上，SIRT1位於VEGF-A介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過增強VEGF-A，SIRT1可能支持腫瘤存活和適應性反應，削弱順鉑的細胞毒作用。這將SIRT1確定為克服肺癌化療耐藥的潛在靶點，因為抑制SIRT1可以降低VEGF-A並使耐藥腫瘤對鉑基治療重新敏感。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: endometrial cancer growth and cisplatin resistance
nodes.description: SIRT1 promotes the growth and cisplatin resistance of endometrial cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of increased tumor-cell survival and reduced sensitivity to cisplatin in endometrial cancer. By supporting proliferative and survival programs, SIRT1 enables endometrial cancer cells to grow and to withstand platinum-based chemotherapy. This identifies SIRT1 as a potential therapeutic target for improving endometrial cancer treatment outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1促進子宮內膜癌細胞的生長和順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT1位於子宮內膜癌中腫瘤細胞存活增加和順鉑敏感性降低的上游。透過支持增殖性和存活程序，SIRT1使子宮內膜癌細胞能够生長並承受鉑基化療。這將SIRT1確定為改善子宮內膜癌治療結果的潛在治療靶點。
nodes.norm_label: endometrial cancer growth and cisplatin resistance
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: p27/CDK2 deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT1 promotes the progression of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia by regulating the phosphorylation and degradation of the cell-cycle inhibitor p27 through deacetylation of cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2). Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of CDK2-dependent cell-cycle progression in leukemia. By licensing CDK2 activity, SIRT1 promotes the degradation of p27 and thereby removes a brake on cell-cycle entry, fueling leukemic proliferation. This makes SIRT1 a promoter of T-ALL progression and identifies SIRT1 inhibition as a potential therapeutic strategy to restore p27-mediated cell-cycle control and suppress leukemic growth.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化週期蛋白依賴性激酶2（CDK2）來調節細胞週期抑制因子p27的磷酸化和降解，從而促進T細胞急性淋巴性白血病的進展。方向上，SIRT1位於白血病中CDK2依賴性細胞週期進展的上游。透過許可CDK2活性，SIRT1促進p27的降解，從而移除細胞週期進入的制動器，為白血病增殖提供燃料。這使SIRT1成為T-ALL進展的促進因子，並將SIRT1抑制確定為恢復p27介導的細胞週期控制並抑制白血病生長的潛在治療策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: NLRP3 inflammasome (via AMPKα/XBP1)
nodes.description: SIRT1 protects against inflammation by deacetylating and attenuating NLRP3 activity via the AMPKα/XBP1 pathway in macrophages. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically suppresses NLRP3 through XBP1s. This couples endoplasmic-reticulum stress responses to innate immune regulation, and it is a refined mechanistic view of SIRT1's anti-inflammasome action. By deacetylating XBP1s downstream of AMPK, SIRT1 prevents NLRP3 assembly and the subsequent maturation of IL-1β. This pathway is relevant to atherosclerotic and metabolic disease, where inflammasome-driven inflammation contributes to tissue damage and insulin resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過在巨噬細胞中透過 AMPKα/XBP1 途徑去乙醯化並減弱 NLRP3 活性來保護免受發炎。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式透過 XBP1s 抑制 NLRP3。這將內質網壓力反應與先天免疫調控偶聯，是 SIRT1 抗炎性體效應的精細機制觀點。透過在 AMPK 下游去乙醯化 XBP1s，SIRT1 防止 NLRP3 組裝和隨後的 IL-1β 成熟。此通路與動脈粥樣硬化和代謝疾病相關，在這些疾病中炎性體驅動的發炎導致組織損傷和胰島素阻抗。

nodes.label: β-amyloid toxicity
nodes.description: SIRT1 protects neurons from β-amyloid-induced toxicity, in part by inhibiting NF-κB signaling in microglia and reducing neuroinflammation, and by supporting neuronal stress-resistance pathways. This limits the inflammatory and oxidative damage that accompany amyloid pathology and preserves synaptic function. Directionally, SIRT1 activity sits upstream of reduced neuronal injury. The effect dovetails with observations that caloric restriction, which raises SIRT1, protects against Alzheimer's-like neuropathology in mouse models, and that SIRT1 promotes non-amyloidogenic processing of APP through the α-secretase ADAM10, reducing production of the toxic β-amyloid peptide itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 保護神經元免受 β-amyloid 誘導的毒性，部分通過抑制小膠質細胞中的 NF-κB 信號並減少神經發炎，以及支持神經元的壓力抗性通路。這限制了伴隨澱粉樣病變的發炎和氧化損傷，並保留突觸功能。在方向性上，SIRT1 活性位於減少神經元損傷的上游。此效應與以下觀察一致：熱量限制（提高 SIRT1）在小鼠模型中保護對抗阿茲海默症樣的神經病理變化，且 SIRT1 通過 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 促進 APP 的非澱粉樣生成處理，減少有毒 β-amyloid 肽的產生。

nodes.label: vascular protection
nodes.description: SIRT1 protects the vasculature by deacetylating and activating eNOS to boost nitric oxide, downregulating AT1R and NF-kB, maintaining TIMP3, and suppressing foam-cell formation via Lox-1; endothelial SIRT1 depletion is associated with cardiovascular disease, and SIRT1 activation opposes atherosclerosis and vascular aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 eNOS 來增強一氧化氮生成，下調 AT1R 和 NF-kB，維持 TIMP3，並透過 Lox-1 抑制泡沫細胞形成，從而保護血管；內皮 SIRT1 缺乏與心血管疾病相關，而 SIRT1 活化可對抗動脈粥狀硬化和血管衰老。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Histone H1 (Lys9, Lys26)
nodes.description: SIRT1 removes acetyl groups from Lys9 and Lys26 of linker histone H1, a modification that influences higher-order chromatin compaction and gene accessibility. Deacetylated H1 is generally associated with a more condensed, transcriptionally repressed chromatin state at SIRT1-target loci. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts enzymatically on H1 to remodel chromatin and silence specific programs. Because H1 links nucleosomes, this action helps SIRT1 enforce long-range repression independently of core histone modifications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 從連接組蛋白 H1 的 Lys9 和 Lys26 上移除乙醯基，這種修飾影響高階染色質凝縮和基因可及性。去乙醯化的 H1 通常與 SIRT1 靶標基因座上更凝縮、轉錄抑制的染色質狀態相關。其方向性為：SIRT1 在酶學上作用於 H1，重塑染色質並沉默特定程序。由於 H1 連接核小體，此作用幫助 SIRT1 獨立於核心組蛋白修飾來實施遠距離抑制。

nodes.label: PPAR-γ (adipogenesis)
nodes.description: SIRT1 represses PPAR-γ, the master regulator of adipogenesis, by deacetylating it and interfering with its co-activator interactions, thereby inhibiting differentiation of preadipocytes into fat cells. Pharmacological SIRT1 activation or overexpression recapitulates this repression and blocks adipogenesis, while SIRT1 knockdown promotes adipogenic differentiation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of PPAR-γ suppression, limiting fat-cell formation. By restraining adipogenesis, SIRT1 prevents excessive white-fat accumulation and contributes to the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction, although its role in mature adipocytes and lipid mobilization is more complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 通過去乙醯化 PPAR-γ（脂肪生成的主要調節因子）並干擾其共活化因子相互作用來抑制它，從而抑制前脂肪細胞分化為脂肪細胞。藥理性 SIRT1 活化或過量表達重現此抑制並阻斷脂肪生成，而 SIRT1 敲低促進脂肪生成分化。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 PPAR-γ 抑制的上游，限制脂肪細胞形成。通過約束脂肪生成，SIRT1 防止過度白色脂肪累積並有助於熱量限制的代謝益處，儘管其在成熟脂肪細胞和脂質動員中的作用更為複雜。

nodes.label: p53/miR-22 axis
nodes.description: SIRT1 targets the p53/miR-22 axis to suppress inflammation, lowering expression of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS). Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of repressed p53/miR-22-inflammatory output. This intersects SIRT1's control of p53 with microRNA-mediated gene silencing, broadening SIRT1's anti-inflammatory repertoire beyond NF-κB. By dampening p53-dependent inflammatory signaling, SIRT1 reduces prostaglandin and nitric-oxide production, and this pathway is relevant to inflammatory disease and cancer, where COX-2 and iNOS drive tissue damage and tumor promotion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 靶向 p53/miR-22 軸以抑制發炎，降低環氧合酶-2（COX-2）和誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）的表達。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 p53/miR-22-發炎輸出的上游。這將 SIRT1 對 p53 的控制與微小 RNA 介導的基因沉默交匯，擴展了 SIRT1 超越 NF-κB 的抗發炎能力。通過抑制 p53 依賴性發炎信號，SIRT1 減少前列腺素和一氧化氮的產生，此通路與發炎性疾病和癌症相關，在這些疾病中 COX-2 和 iNOS 驅動組織損傷和腫瘤促進。

nodes.label: Telomeric chromatin
nodes.description: SIRT1's histone deacetylase activity is directly associated with regulation of telomeric chromatin, gene expression, and the dynamic association of DNA repair factors with chromatin. Telomere shortening occurs over the lifespan and has been linked to the concomitant decrease in SIRT1 expression with age. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of telomeric chromatin maintenance. By preserving the integrity of telomere-associated chromatin and facilitating repair factor access, SIRT1 helps stabilize the chromosome ends whose erosion is a hallmark of aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的組蛋白去乙醯酶活性直接與端粒染色質調節、基因表達以及DNA修復因子與染色質的動態關聯相關。端粒縮短在整個壽命期間發生，並與SIRT1表達隨年齡減少的現象相關。方向上，SIRT1位於端粒染色質維護的上游。透過維護端粒相關染色質的完整性並促進修復因子的進入，SIRT1幫助穩定其磨損是衰老標誌的染色體末端。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md

nodes.label: Wnt/β-catenin signaling in lung adenocarcinoma
nodes.description: SIRT1, upregulated by circ_0001946, promotes cell growth in lung adenocarcinoma by activating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of β-catenin-driven proliferation in this lung cancer subtype. This oncogenic SIRT1 function contrasts with the tumor-suppressive anti-proliferative effect SIRT1 exerts in non-small-cell lung cancer when induced by SNHG10, demonstrating that SIRT1's role in lung cancer depends on the tumor subtype and the signaling context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1被circ_0001946上調，透過活化Wnt/β-catenin訊號通路促進肺腺癌中的細胞生長。方向上，SIRT1位於此肺癌亞型中β-catenin驅動的增殖的上游。此致癌的SIRT1功能與SIRT1在非小細胞肺癌中被SNHG10誘導時所發揮的腫瘤抑制性抗增殖效果形成對比，證明了SIRT1在肺癌中的作用取決於腫瘤亞型和訊號環境。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: NSCLC cell proliferation
nodes.description: SIRT1, when upregulated by the long noncoding RNA SNHG10, suppresses proliferation of non-small-cell lung cancer cells, acting as a tumor suppressor in this context. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of restrained NSCLC growth. This tumor-suppressive role of SIRT1 in lung cancer contrasts with the oncogenic functions SIRT1 displays in other settings, underscoring the strong context dependence of sirtuin biology. The finding implicates SIRT1 as a mediator of SNHG10's anti-proliferative effects and suggests that sustaining SIRT1 expression may limit NSCLC cell expansion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1在被長鏈非編碼RNA SNHG10上調時，抑制非小細胞肺癌細胞的增殖，在此環境中作為腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT1位於NSCLC生長抑制的上游。SIRT1在肺癌中的此腫瘤抑制角色與SIRT1在其他環境中表現的致癌功能形成對比，強化了sirtuin生物學的強烈環境依賴性。此發現將SIRT1確定為SNHG10抗增殖效果的介導因子，並表明維持SIRT1表達可能限制NSCLC細胞擴增。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Developmental defects
nodes.description: SIRT1-null mice are markedly smaller, grow slowly, and show defects in eye morphogenesis and cardiac septation, revealing SIRT1's role in normal development. These phenotypes indicate that SIRT1 is not merely a stress-response protein but is required for organogenesis and systemic growth. Directionally, SIRT1 deficiency causes structural developmental abnormalities. The perinatal lethality of many SIRT1 knockout strains limited study of the complete phenotype, prompting the development of tissue-specific conditional models that have since clarified SIRT1's contributions to metabolism, circadian rhythm, fertility, and stress resistance in the adult organism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 缺失小鼠明顯較小、生長緩慢，並顯示眼睛形態發生和心臟間隔缺損，揭示了 SIRT1 在正常發育中的作用。這些表型表明 SIRT1 不僅是壓力反應蛋白，而是器官發生和全身生長所必需的。在方向性上，SIRT1 缺乏導致結構性發育異常。許多 SIRT1 敲除品系的圍產期致死性限制了對完整表型的研究，促使開發組織特異性條件模型，此後這些模型闡明了 SIRT1 對成人代謝、晝夜節律、生育能力和壓力抗性的貢獻。

nodes.label: cisplatin sensitivity via autophagy suppression
nodes.description: Silencing of SIRT1 enhances the cisplatin sensitivity of H1299/cisplatin non-small-cell lung cancer cells by suppressing autophagy. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of reduced autophagic survival signaling and increased susceptibility to cisplatin. Because autophagy can protect cancer cells from chemotherapy-induced damage, its suppression re-sensitizes resistant NSCLC cells to cisplatin. This identifies SIRT1 inhibition as a potential strategy to overcome platinum resistance in lung cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 沉默SIRT1透過抑制自噬來增強H1299/順鉑非小細胞肺癌細胞的順鉑敏感性。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於自噬性存活訊號減少和順鉑敏感性增加的上游。由於自噬可以保護癌細胞免受化療誘導的損傷，其抑制使耐藥NSCLC細胞對順鉑重新敏感。這將SIRT1抑制確定為克服肺癌鉑耐藥的潛在策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Sterility
nodes.description: Surviving SIRT1 knockout mice of both sexes are sterile: males have low sperm counts and females fail to ovulate, implicating SIRT1 in gametogenesis and reproductive endocrine control. The defect reflects failed differentiation and stress responses in gonadal tissues, where SIRT1 normally supports germ-cell survival and maturation. Directionally, SIRT1 loss leads to reproductive failure. This shows SIRT1 is essential for germ-cell development and fertility, and it is consistent with SIRT1's broader role in integrating nutrient status with reproductive function—a link relevant to the well-known dependence of fertility on metabolic state in mammals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 存活的 SIRT1 敲除小鼠（雌雄均有）是不育的：雄性精子數量低，雌性無法排卵，表明 SIRT1 參與配子發生和生殖內分泌控制。此缺陷反映了性腺組織中分化和壓力反應的失敗，SIRT1 正常情況下支持生殖細胞的存活和成熟。在方向性上，SIRT1 的缺失導致生殖失敗。這表明 SIRT1 對生殖細胞發育和生育能力至關重要，與 SIRT1 在整合營養狀態與生殖功能方面的更廣泛作用一致——這一聯繫與哺乳動物中生育能力對代謝狀態的眾所周知的依賴性相關。

nodes.label: circ_0001946
nodes.description: The circular RNA circ_0001946 upregulates SIRT1, and the resulting SIRT1 activity promotes cell growth in lung adenocarcinoma by activating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway. Directionally, circ_0001946 sits upstream of SIRT1 upregulation, which in turn drives oncogenic Wnt signaling. This represents a tumor-promoting axis in lung adenocarcinoma that is opposite to the tumor-suppressive SIRT1 effect mediated by SNHG10 in NSCLC, illustrating how different noncoding RNAs can direct SIRT1 toward opposing outcomes in the same tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 環狀RNA circ_0001946上調SIRT1，由此產生的SIRT1活性透過活化Wnt/β-catenin訊號通路促進肺腺癌中的細胞生長。方向上，circ_0001946位於SIRT1上調的上游，後者反過來驅動致癌性Wnt訊號。這代表了肺腺癌中的一個促腫瘤軸，與SNHG10在NSCLC中介導的腫瘤抑制性SIRT1效果相反，說明了不同的非編碼RNA如何能將SIRT1引導至同一組織中的對立結果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: SNHG10
nodes.description: The long noncoding RNA SNHG10 upregulates the tumor-suppressive sirtuin SIRT1 in non-small-cell lung cancer by sponging miR-543, relieving microRNA-mediated repression of SIRT1 expression. Directionally, SNHG10 acts upstream of SIRT1 abundance in the NSCLC ceRNA network. By sequestering miR-543, SNHG10 raises SIRT1 levels, and this upregulation underlies the lncRNA's tumor-suppressive activity in lung cancer. The finding highlights how noncoding RNAs can tune sirtuin expression and thereby influence the balance between tumor suppression and tumor promotion in specific cancer contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 長鏈非編碼RNA SNHG10在非小細胞肺癌中透過海綿吸附miR-543來上調腫瘤抑制性sirtuin SIRT1，解除microRNA對SIRT1表達的抑制。方向上，SNHG10在NSCLC ceRNA網路中位於SIRT1豐度的上游。透過隔離miR-543，SNHG10提高SIRT1水平，此上調構成了該lncRNA在肺癌中腫瘤抑制活性的基礎。此發現突顯了非編碼RNA如何能調節sirtuin表達，從而影響特定癌症環境中腫瘤抑制與腫瘤促進之間的平衡。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: PCAF/GCN5
nodes.description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

nodes.label: mTOR/S6K pathway
nodes.description: mTORC1/S6K1 signaling opposes SIRT1-promoted catabolic and stress-resistance programs (while SIRT1/SIRT2 deacetylate S6K1 to license its activity, making regulation bidirectional and nutrient-dependent); rapamycin-mediated mTOR inhibition raises NAD+ and benefits from SIRT1 coupling, as reflected in Table 3's classification of the mTOR/S6K pathway as a SIRT1 negative regulator.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC1/S6K1 信號拮抗 SIRT1 促進的分解代謝和抗壓程序（同時 SIRT1/SIRT2 去乙醯化 S6K1 以允許其活性，使調節具有雙向性和營養依賴性）；雷帕霉素介導的 mTOR 抑制提高 NAD+ 並受益於 SIRT1 耦合，正如表 3 將 mTOR/S6K 通路歸類為 SIRT1 負向調節因子所反映的。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: cleaved SIRT1
nodes.description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

nodes.label: Dominant-negative Caspase-9
nodes.description: Co-expression of dominant-negative Caspase-9 or Bcl-xL blocked the cleavage and nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization of Sir2alpha (SIRT1) during TNF-alpha-induced apoptosis. This established the translocation as downstream of apoptosome activation and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 共表達顯性失活型 Caspase-9 或 Bcl-xL 阻斷了 TNF-α 誘導凋亡期間 Sir2α（SIRT1）的裂解和從細胞核到細胞質的重新定位。這確立了此轉位位於凋亡小體活化和粒線體外膜通透化的下游。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

nodes.label: Cellular Senescence markers
nodes.description: Moderate Sirt1 overexpression lowered the INK4/ARF family proteins p15INK4b, p19ARF, and p53 in the aging heart, while raising the anti-apoptotic molecules Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL. This anti-senescence effect contributes to retarding age-dependent cardiac decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 中度的 Sirt1 過表達降低了衰老心臟中的 INK4/ARF 家族蛋白 p15INK4b、p19ARF 和 p53，同時提高抗凋亡分子 Bcl-2 和 Bcl-xL。此抗衰老作用有助於延緩年齡相關的心臟衰退。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md

nodes.label: Glucose-6-phosphate
nodes.description: Pentose phosphate pathway flux toward NADPH/G6P promotes SIRT1 activity toward 14-3-3-zeta; G6P supplementation in Xenopus egg extract enhanced 14-3-3-zeta-directed sirtuin activity and caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta binding. Declining PPP activity leads to 14-3-3-zeta acetylation, its release, and caspase-2 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸戊糖途徑朝向 NADPH/G6P 的通量促進 SIRT1 對 14-3-3ζ 的活性；在非洲爪蟾卵提取物中補充 G6P 增強了針對 14-3-3ζ 的 sirtuin 活性以及 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合。PPP 活性下降導致 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化、其釋放和 caspase-2 活化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

nodes.label: Tumor suppressor inactivation
nodes.description: SIRT1 can also act as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting beta-catenin and NF-kB signaling, in contrast to its oncogenic role of deacetylating and inactivating p53. This context-dependent duality is why SIRT1 is described as a molecular 'shapeshifter' whose actions demand biomarker-guided strategies for clinical translation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 也可透過抑制 β-catenin 和 NF-kB 信號作為腫瘤抑制因子，與其去乙醯化並使 p53 失活的致癌角色形成對比。這種依賴情境的雙重性，是 SIRT1 被描述為分子「變形者」、其作用需要生物標記引導策略才能臨床轉化的原因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md

nodes.label: RelA/p65
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the RelA/p65 subunit of NF-kB, inhibiting NF-kB-dependent pro-inflammatory gene expression. Higher SIRT1 in caloric-restricted animals may explain their reduced inflammatory responses, and this action is both anti-inflammatory and tumor-suppressive.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 NF-kB 的 RelA/p65 亞基，抑制依賴 NF-kB 的促發炎基因表達。熱量限制動物中較高的 SIRT1 可能解釋其減少的發炎反應，此作用既抗發炎又具腫瘤抑制性。

nodes.label: Hes1
nodes.description: SIRT1 directly regulates BDNF transcription by deacetylating and repressing Hes1, a transcriptional repressor of BDNF, thereby relieving inhibition and promoting neuronal survival and neurogenesis. This is a key SIRT1-dependent mechanism linking metabolism to neurotrophic support.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 Hes1（BDNF 的轉錄抑制因子）直接調節 BDNF 轉錄，從而解除抑制並促進神經元存活和神經新生。這是將代謝與神經滋養支持聯繫起來的關鍵 SIRT1 依賴性機制。

nodes.label: DNA-damage-induced cell death
nodes.description: SIRT1 protects against damage-induced death on the ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 axis: the SIRT1 activator resveratrol attenuated etoposide/camptothecin-induced death, while the inhibitor EX-527 enhanced it. In TRIM28-knockout cells, SIRT1 knockdown increased etoposide death, proving TRIM28-mediated degradation is what kills.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 ATM–TRIM28–SIRT1 軸上保護免受損傷誘導的死亡：SIRT1 活化劑白藜蘆醇減輕依托泊苷/喜樹鹼誘導的死亡，而抑制劑 EX-527 則增強之。在 TRIM28 敲除細胞中，SIRT1 敲低增加依托泊苷死亡，證明 TRIM28 介導的降解才是致死原因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

nodes.label: Paraquat-induced oxidative stress
nodes.description: Tg-Sirt1 line 40 (moderate 7.5-fold SIRT1) was protected against paraquat-induced oxidative stress: paraquat-induced apoptosis, 8-OHdG staining, and malondialdehyde content rises were abolished, while paraquat-induced catalase induction was greater. High-dose (12.5-fold) line 53 showed elevated oxidative stress even at baseline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tg-Sirt1 系 40（中度 7.5 倍 SIRT1）免受百草枯誘導的氧化壓力：百草枯誘導的凋亡、8-OHdG 染色和丙二醛含量升高被消除，而百草枯誘導的過氧化氫酶誘導更強。高劑量（12.5 倍）系 53 即使在基線也顯示氧化壓力升高。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md

nodes.label: DEPDVP motif
nodes.description: Under severe DNA damage, SIRT1 undergoes C-terminal cleavage by caspases at the DEPDVP(704-709) motif; the D707A mutant is cleavage-resistant and the DeltaC703 truncation reproduces the natural cleaved band. This cleavage is redundant and mediated by multiple caspases, as only pan-caspase inhibition blocks it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，SIRT1 在 DEPDVP(704–709) 基序被 caspase 進行 C 端裂解；D707A 突變體具有抗裂解性，而 ΔC703 截短可再現天然的裂解條帶。此裂解由多種 caspase 冗餘介導，只有廣譜 caspase 抑制才能阻斷它。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

nodes.label: Sclerostin
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates sclerostin (SOST) to activate Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and increase bone anabolism. SIRT1 knockout mice have a low bone-mass phenotype, and SIRT1 overexpression increases osteoblast osteogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化硬骨素（sclerostin/SOST）以活化 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號並增加骨合成代謝。SIRT1 剔除小鼠具有低骨量表現型，SIRT1 過度表現增加成骨細胞成骨。

nodes.label: NBS1
nodes.description: SIRT1 interacts directly with NBS1 and maintains it in a hypoacetylated state, permitting NBS1 Ser343 phosphorylation required for an efficient DNA damage repair response. This couples sirtuin-dependent chromatin control to high-fidelity double-strand break repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 直接與 NBS1 交互作用並維持其低乙醯化狀態，允許高效 DNA 損傷修復反應所需的 NBS1 Ser343 磷酸化。這將 sirtuin 依賴的染色質控制與高保真雙股斷裂修復相耦合。

nodes.label: Coronary Artery Disease
nodes.description: SIRT1 is protective in coronary artery disease: genetic polymorphisms are associated with CAD risk, and expression is reduced in CAD patients. SIRT1 restoration is a candidate strategy for attenuating vascular remodeling and plaque progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對冠狀動脈疾病具有保護作用：基因多型性與 CAD 風險相關，且在 CAD 患者中表現降低。恢復 SIRT1 是減輕血管重塑與斑塊進展的候選策略。

nodes.label: Histone H2A.Z
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the H2A histone variant Histone H2A.Z at Lys115 and Lys121. Acetylation at these lysines normally protects H2A.Z from ubiquitin-mediated destruction, so SIRT1 removes that protection and accelerates proteasome-dependent turnover, resetting promoter nucleosome composition and gene expression programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會在 H2A 組蛋白變異體 Histone H2A.Z 的第 115 與第 121 號離胺酸上進行去乙醯化。這些離胺酸的乙醯化原本可保護 H2A.Z 免於泛素媒介的降解，因此 SIRT1 移除了此保護並加速蛋白酶體依賴性的汰換，藉此重設啟動子的核小體組成與基因表現程式。

nodes.label: p50
nodes.description: NF-kappaB exists in multiple forms, of which the p65/p50 heterodimer (p65, RelA, paired with the NFKB1-encoded p50 subunit) is the most prevalent species. p50 is thus a core constitutive partner of p65 in canonical NF-kappaB heterodimers, which the sirtuins inhibit in their anti-inflammatory effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NF-κB 存在多種形式，其中 p65/p50 異源二聚體（p65，即 RelA，與由 NFKB1 編碼的 p50 次單元配對）是最普遍的型態。因此 p50 是典型 NF-κB 異源二聚體中 p65 的核心構成型伴隨者，而 sirtuin 正是藉由抑制 NFKB 路徑發揮抗發炎作用。

nodes.label: lncRNA DACH1
nodes.description: A long noncoding RNA at the DACH1 locus interacts with SIRT3 to regulate mitochondrial oxidative damage and cell death in heart failure, representing a noncoding-RNA arm of SIRT3's cardioprotective network that couples nuclear gene regulation to mitochondrial integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 位於 DACH1 位點的一種長非編碼 RNA 與 SIRT3 互動以調節心臟衰竭中的粒線體氧化損傷和細胞死亡，代表了 SIRT3 心臟保護網絡中的非編碼 RNA 臂，將核基因調節與粒線體完整性偶聯。

nodes.label: Histone Crotonylation eraser activity
nodes.description: Beyond canonical deacetylase activity, SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates. This dynamic regulation of histone crotonylation adds a new dimension to SIRT3's epigenetic repertoire, modulating gene expression plasticity under both homeostatic and stress conditions. The review positions this decrotonylase activity alongside SIRT3's roles in heterochromatin maintenance and double-strand break repair as a nuclear epigenetic function of the mitochondrial deacetylase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了典型的去乙醯酶活性外，SIRT3 還具有相當的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化能力，選擇性地從特定組蛋白受質上去除巴豆醯基。這種組蛋白巴豆醯基化的動態調節為 SIRT3 的表觀遺傳 repertoire 增添了新的維度，在恆定和壓力條件下調節基因表現可塑性。該綜述將此去巴豆醯基化活性與 SIRT3 在異染色質維護和雙股斷裂修復中的角色並列，作為粒線體去乙醯酶的核表觀遺傳功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Alpha-synuclein aggregates
nodes.description: Beyond mitochondrial homeostasis, SIRT3 contributes to the clearance of misfolded alpha-synuclein aggregates, a pathological hallmark of Parkinson's disease, and mitigates neuroinflammation by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation. These converging actions highlight the translational potential of targeting SIRT3 in PD therapy, though whether SIRT3 alterations precede dopaminergic neurodegeneration remains unclear.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了粒線體恆定外，SIRT3 還有助於清除錯誤摺疊的 α-synuclein 聚集體（巴金森氏症的病理特徵），並透過抑制 NLRP3 炎症小體活化減輕神經發炎。這些匯聚的作用凸顯了靶向 SIRT3 在 PD 治療中的轉化潛力，但 SIRT3 改變是否先於多巴胺ergic 神經退化仍不清楚。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Obese mouse BAT
nodes.description: Brown adipose tissue of obese mice shows reduced SIRT3 protein and decreased mitochondrial protein expression, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity. Directionally, obesity sits upstream of lower SIRT3. This blunts cold-induced and basal mitochondrial function, and it connects metabolic disease to sirtuin attenuation. By reducing SIRT3, obesity impairs the mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative capacity required for thermogenesis. This observation supports the concept that restoring SIRT3, through fasting or pharmacological activation, could improve the metabolic and thermogenic dysfunction associated with obesity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肥胖小鼠的棕色脂肪組織顯示 SIRT3 蛋白減少和粒線體蛋白表達降低，將肥胖與熱能能力受損聯繫起來。在方向性上，肥胖位於較低 SIRT3 的上游。這削弱了冷誘導和基礎粒線體功能，將代謝疾病與 sirtuin 減弱聯繫起來。透過減少 SIRT3，肥胖損害了熱能所需的粒線體生物合成和氧化能力。此觀察支持了恢復 SIRT3（透過禁食或藥理學活化）可能改善與肥胖相關的代謝和熱能功能障礙的概念。

nodes.label: COL1A1
nodes.description: COL1A1 encodes the alpha-1 chain of type I collagen, the principal ECM fibrillar collagen in myocardium. SIRT3 suppresses myocardial fibrosis through deacetylation of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1 and TGF-beta1, reducing ECM deposition in pressure-overloaded cardiomyocytes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: COL1A1 編碼 I 型膠原蛋白的 α-1 鏈，是心肌中的主要 ECM 纖維性膠原蛋白。SIRT3 透過去乙醯化促纖維化基因（包括 COL1A1 和 TGF-beta1），在壓力超負荷的心肌細胞中抑制心肌纖維化，減少 ECM 沉積。

nodes.label: caloric restriction protection in cochlea
nodes.description: Caloric restriction alleviates age-related hearing loss by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protective effect is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, highlighting SIRT3's indispensable role in CR-induced auditory resilience. Mechanistically, SIRT3 enhances IDH2 activity under CR, boosting mitochondrial NADPH production and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity and delaying hearing loss progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷來緩解年齡相關性聽力損失，但此保護作用在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，凸顯 SIRT3 在 CR 誘導的聽覺韌性中不可或缺的角色。機制上 SIRT3 在 CR 下增強 IDH2 活性，促進粒線體 NADPH 產生和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性並延緩聽力損失進展。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex
nodes.description: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 overexpression mitigates neuronal injury by inhibiting the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, thereby reducing mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) formation and protecting neurons from metabolic stress-induced apoptosis in diabetic encephalopathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 的過量表現透過抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物減輕神經元損傷，從而減少粒線體相關內質網膜（MAM）形成，保護神經元免受代謝壓力誘導的凋亡，在糖尿病腦病變中發揮保護作用。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Cold exposure (brown adipose tissue)
nodes.description: Cold exposure induces SIRT3 in brown adipose tissue, where it promotes expression of mitochondrial genes and supports thermogenic programs. The induction enhances oxidative metabolism and uncoupled respiration needed for heat production, with SIRT3 acting upstream of UCP1-dependent thermogenesis. Directionally, a cold stimulus triggers SIRT3 upregulation, which in turn drives thermogenic mitochondrial biogenesis. This ties SIRT3 to adaptive thermogenesis and the metabolic benefits of cold exposure, and conversely SIRT3 is reduced in brown adipose tissue of obese mice, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity and blunted cold-induced mitochondrial function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 冷暴露在棕色脂肪組織中誘導 SIRT3，促進粒線體基因表達並支持產熱程序。這種誘導增強了產生熱量所需的氧化代謝和解偶聯呼吸，SIRT3 在 UCP1 依賴性產熱的上游作用。在方向性上，冷刺激觸發 SIRT3 上調，進而驅動產熱性粒線體生物合成。這將 SIRT3 與適應性產熱和冷暴露的代謝益處聯繫起來，相反，肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪組織中 SIRT3 減少，將肥胖與受損的產熱能力和遲鈍的冷誘導粒線體功能聯繫起來。

nodes.label: LCAD (fatty acid β-oxidation)
nodes.description: Fasting induces SIRT3 activation, which in turn enhances fatty acid oxidation through deacetylation and activation of long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), a key enzyme of mitochondrial beta-oxidation. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatic activation of LCAD sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. This promotes the harvest of energy from fat stores during fasting and caloric restriction, when glucose is scarce. By supporting efficient beta-oxidation, SIRT3 helps maintain ATP production while limiting the accumulation of damaging lipid intermediates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 禁食誘導SIRT3活化，後者透過去乙醯化和活化長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）——粒線體β-氧化的關鍵酶——來增強脂肪酸氧化。方向上，SIRT3對LCAD的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。這促進了在禁食和熱量限制期間（葡萄糖稀缺時）從脂肪儲存中獲取能量。透過支持高效的β-氧化，SIRT3在限制有害脂質中間體積累的同時幫助維持ATP的產生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: Histone Crotonylation
nodes.description: Histone crotonylation (Kcr) is deposited from crotonyl-CoA and generally marks active transcription. SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates, and decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as ETS1 to constrain neoplastic dissemination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 組蛋白巴豆醯基化（Kcr）由巴豆醯-CoA 沉積，通常標記活躍的轉錄。SIRT3 具有相當的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化能力，選擇性地從特定組蛋白受質上去除巴豆醯基，並降低轉移相關位點如 ETS1 的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化以限制腫瘤擴散。

nodes.label: Honokiol effects
nodes.description: Honokiol (HKL), a bisphenolic lignan from Magnolia officinalis, upregulates SIRT3 while augmenting its enzymatic activity, and shRNA-induced SIRT3 knockdown significantly attenuates HKL's cytoprotective effects on mitochondrial biogenesis, OXPHOS capacity, and bioenergetic output. HKL protects the brain from ischemia-reperfusion injury, ameliorates intracerebral hemorrhage-induced apoptosis and mitochondrial fission, and inhibits ferroptosis, all via SIRT3 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Honokiol（HKL）是來自厚朴的雙酚木脂素，上調 SIRT3 並增強其酵素活性，而 shRNA 誘導的 SIRT3 敲減顯著削弱 HKL 對粒線體生成、氧化磷酸化能力和生物能輸出的細胞保護作用。HKL 保護大腦免受缺血再灌注損傷，改善腦出血誘導的凋亡和粒線體分裂，並抑制鐵死亡，所有這些都透過 SIRT3 活化實現。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: OSCP
nodes.description: Honokiol-activated SIRT3 deacetylates OSCP, a subunit of the mitochondrial F1Fo-ATP synthase, optimizing coupling of proton flux to ATP synthesis. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically tunes ATP synthase function. Improved coupling boosts cellular energy output while limiting proton-leak-associated ROS, enhancing mitochondrial efficiency. This contributes to honokiol's metabolic and cardioprotective actions, and it shows that SIRT3 regulates not only antioxidant enzymes but also the core machinery of ATP production. By improving the efficiency and integrity of oxidative phosphorylation, SIRT3 supports the bioenergetic capacity that declines with age and metabolic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 被厚朴酚活化的 SIRT3 去乙醯化 OSCP（粒線體 F1Fo-ATP 合酶的一個亞基），優化質子流與 ATP 合成的偶聯。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上調節 ATP 合酶功能。改善的偶聯在限制質子洩漏相關 ROS 的同時提升細胞能量輸出，增強粒線體效率。這有助於厚朴酚的代謝和心臟保護作用，並表明 SIRT3 不僅調節抗氧化酶，還調節 ATP 產生的核心機制。通過改善氧化磷酸化的效率和完整性，SIRT3 支持隨年齡和代謝疾病下降的生物能量能力。

nodes.label: p53 at Lys320
nodes.description: In Alzheimer's disease, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial bioenergetics disrupted by amyloid-beta toxicity, partially through deacetylation of mitochondrial p53 at Lys320, a modification crucial for maintaining energy homeostasis and neuronal survival. SIRT3 mRNA expression declines progressively in AD clinical specimens and rodent models, and SIRT3 levels inversely associate with tau protein deposition, supporting SIRT3 as a mitochondrial checkpoint and candidate biomarker in AD.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症中，SIRT3 增強被澱粉樣蛋白-beta 毒性破壞的粒線體生物能學，部分透過在 Lys320 處去乙醯化粒線體 p53，此修飾對於維持能量恆定和神經元存活至關重要。SIRT3 mRNA 表現在 AD 臨床標本和囓齒動物模型中進行性下降，且 SIRT3 水平與 tau 蛋白沉積呈負相關，支持 SIRT3 作為 AD 中的粒線體檢查點和候選生物標記。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: DRP1/Fis1 mitochondrial fission
nodes.description: In Huntington's disease, SIRT3 maintains mitochondrial dynamics by suppressing fission regulators such as Fis1 and Drp1, preserving mitochondrial morphology and promoting efficient axonal transport. In Drosophila HD models, transgenic expression of the SIRT3 ortholog dSirt2 significantly attenuates neuropil degeneration and prolongs organismal longevity, reinforcing conserved neuroprotective functions of SIRT3 across species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在亨丁頓氏症中，SIRT3 透過抑制分裂調節因子如 Fis1 和 Drp1 維護粒線體動態，保持粒線體形態並促進有效的軸突運輸。在果蠅 HD 模型中，SIRT3 直系同源物 dSirt2 的轉基因表達顯著減輕神經 neuropil 退化並延長生物體壽命，增強了 SIRT3 跨物種的保守性神經保護功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: FOS/AP-1 and STAT3/NFATc2 signaling
nodes.description: In cardiomyocytes, SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis by inhibiting the FOS/AP-1 and STAT3/NFATc2 signaling pathways, complementing its GSK3beta Lys15 deacetylation that blocks Smad3 complexes. Together these transcriptional suppressions reduce ECM gene expression and pathological cardiac remodeling, establishing SIRT3 as a master anti-fibrotic node acting on multiple pro-fibrotic pathways simultaneously.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在心肌細胞中，SIRT3 透過抑制 FOS/AP-1 和 STAT3/NFATc2 訊號途徑減輕纖維化，與其阻斷 Smad3 複合物的 GSK3beta Lys15 去乙醯化互補。這些轉錄抑制共同減少 ECM 基因表達和病理性心臟重塑，確立 SIRT3 作為同時作用於多個促纖維化途徑的主要抗纖維化節點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: chemoresistance in CLL
nodes.description: In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance via ROS buffering. This tumor-supportive role contrasts with SIRT3's tumor-suppressive actions in other contexts (Warburg suppression via HIF-1alpha destabilization, OGG1-mediated DNA repair, H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity), exemplifying the dualistic, context-dependent behavior of SIRT3 in cancer biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在慢性淋巴性白血病中，SIRT3 實現代謝適應，透過活性氧緩衝賦予化療抗性。此腫瘤支持角色與 SIRT3 在其他情境中的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比（透過 HIF-1alpha 不穩定化抑制 Warburg 效應、OGG1 介導的 DNA 修復、H3K56 去乙醯化維持 NHEJ 精準度），體現了 SIRT3 在癌症生物學中的雙重性、情境依賴行為。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration
nodes.description: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。
