nodes.norm_label: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: AGO2/cytochrome b axis
nodes.description: In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress primarily through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway, uncoupling excessive glucose levels from electron transport chain dysfunction. SIRT3 downregulation leads to breakdown of this axis, resulting in impaired ETC activity and accelerated DCM progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化主要透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並抑制氧化壓力，將過高的血糖水平與電子傳遞鏈功能障礙解偶聯。SIRT3 的下調導致此軸線的崩解，造成 ETC 活性受損和 DCM 進展加速。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Irisin osteoprotection
nodes.description: In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects that are strictly dependent on SIRT3: lentivirus-mediated SIRT3 silencing abolishes irisin's osteoprotective efficacy against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction. SIRT3 is therefore the obligatory signaling node for irisin-mediated redox homeostasis and bone preservation in the diabetic periodontium.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用嚴格依賴 SIRT3：慢病毒介導的 SIRT3 沉默消除 Irisin 對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的骨保護效果。因此 SIRT3 是 Irisin 介導的氧化還原恆定和糖尿病牙周組織骨保護的必要訊號節點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Withaferin A anti-fibrotic effect
nodes.description: In hepatic fibrosis models, SIRT3 has been implicated in mediating the anti-fibrotic effects of withaferin A, an effect that is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice. This finding reinforces SIRT3's role as an indispensable molecular effector of pharmacological anti-fibrotic agents, consistent with its central suppressive function across hepatic, pulmonary, cardiac, and renal fibrosis models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肝纖維化模型中，SIRT3 被認為參與介導 withaferin A 的抗纖維化作用，此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除。此發現增強了 SIRT3 作為藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器的角色，與其在肝、肺、心和腎纖維化模型中的核心抑制功能一致。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Cell transformation
nodes.description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: MAPK/ERK
nodes.description: MAPK/ERK signaling can oppose SIRT3-dependent metabolic and antioxidant outputs (e.g., ERK-driven proliferative/fibrotic signaling coupling with SIRT3 decrease); Table 3 lists MAPK/ERK among negative regulators of the SIRT3 pathway in aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MAPK/ERK 信號可以拮抗 SIRT3 依賴性的代謝和抗氧化輸出（例如 ERK 驅動的增殖/纖維化信號與 SIRT3 下降耦合）；表 3 將 MAPK/ERK 列為衰老中 SIRT3 通路的負向調節因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: TFAM at Lys154
nodes.description: Melatonin's orchestration of sequential mitophagy processes depends on SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154, the pivotal molecular switch promoting mitophagic flux. In vascular calcification, SIRT3 also deacetylates proteins within the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Melatonin 對連續粒線體自噬過程的編排依賴 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化，這是促進粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。在血管鈣化中，SIRT3 還去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白，促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α
nodes.description: Pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α (PDH E1α) becomes hyperacetylated at Lys385 in tubular epithelial cells after TGF-β1 stimulation and is deacetylated by SIRT3, modulating pyruvate entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates PDH. This links mitochondrial metabolism to TGF-β1-driven kidney injury, and loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and pyruvate/lactate accumulation. It shows SIRT3 buffering metabolic dysfunction during fibrosis, and connects the metabolic phenotype of injured kidneys to sirtuin-dependent control of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1α（PDH E1α）在 TGF-β1 刺激後在腎小管上皮細胞中 Lys385 處被超乙醯化，並被 SIRT3 去乙醯化，調節丙酮酸進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 PDH。這將粒線體代謝與 TGF-β1 驅動的腎損傷聯繫起來，SIRT3 的缺失導致 PDH 超乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少和丙酮酸/乳酸累積。它表明 SIRT3 在纖維化期間緩衝代謝功能障礙，並將受損腎臟的代謝表型與丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體的 sirtuin 依賴性控制聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Centenarian-linked SNPs
nodes.description: SIRT3 G477T and other SNPs are associated with human longevity/healthy aging; the G477T variant (V208I/V184I alleles) improves SIRT3 function or expression and is enriched in centenarian populations in some cohorts (source review; Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 reports).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 G477T 和其他 SNP 與人類長壽/健康衰老相關；G477T 變異（V208I/V184I 等位基因）改善 SIRT3 功能或表達，在某些族群中在百歲老人中富集（文獻綜述；Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 報導）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: GDH (gluconeogenesis from amino acids)
nodes.description: SIRT3 activates GDH to support gluconeogenesis from amino acids via deacetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 GDH 以支持氨基酸的糖質新生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: ALS motor neuron metabolic abnormalities
nodes.description: SIRT3 activation prevents amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons from developing metabolic abnormalities. ALS motor neurons exhibit hallmark metabolic defects including decreased mitochondrial respiration and increased glycolysis, which arise from systemic NAD+ depletion. SIRT3 activation and/or NAD+ supplementation has been discovered as a treatment for disease phenotypes in both sporadic and familial ALS, restoring normal mitochondrial metabolism and rescuing motor neuron viability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3活化防止肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）運動神經元出現代謝異常。ALS運動神經元表現出標誌性的代謝缺陷，包括粒線體呼吸降低和糖解作用增加，這些源於全身性NAD+耗竭。SIRT3活化和/或NAD+補充已被發現可治療散發性和家族性ALS的疾病表型，恢復正常的粒線體代謝並挽救運動神經元存活能力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: OPA1 deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT3 contributes to maintaining mitochondrial morphology through optic atrophy 1 (OPA1) deacetylation, maintaining cristae structure and preventing inflammasome activation in cardiac fibroblasts. Matrine engages protective effects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway, combining antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms to preserve renal function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過視神經萎縮蛋白 1（OPA1）去乙醯化有助於維護粒線體形態，維持嵴結構並防止心臟纖維母細胞中的炎症小體活化。Matrine 透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態，對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，結合抗氧化和抗發炎機制以維護腎功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: ACC1 upregulation-driven de novo lipogenesis
nodes.description: SIRT3 contributes to the reprogramming of fatty acid synthesis by upregulating acetyl-coA carboxylase 1 to promote de novo lipogenesis through SIRT3 deacetylation, thereby promoting the invasion and metastasis of cervical cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of ACC1-driven de novo lipogenesis and metastatic behavior in cervical cancer. By enhancing lipid synthesis, SIRT3 supports the invasive and metastatic capabilities of cervical cancer cells, identifying SIRT3-ACC1 lipogenesis as a potential therapeutic target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過上調乙醯CoA羧化酶1（ACC1）來重編程脂肪酸合成，透過SIRT3去乙醯化促進從頭脂肪生成，從而促進子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移。方向上，SIRT3位於子宮頸癌中ACC1驅動的從頭脂肪生成和轉移行為的上游。透過增強脂質合成，SIRT3支持子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移能力，將SIRT3-ACC1脂肪生成確定為潛在的治療靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: H4K14ac
nodes.description: SIRT3 deacetylates H4K14ac, part of its mitochondrial/cytonuclear deacetylase program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 H4K14ac，這是其粒線體/核質去乙醯酶程序的一部分。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: complex I/III
nodes.description: SIRT3 deacetylates subunits of respiratory-chain complexes I and III, maintaining basal ATP levels and electron-transport efficiency (Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 的次單元，維持基礎 ATP 水平和電子傳輸效率（Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: H3K27 crotonylation at ETS1 loci
nodes.description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as the ETS1 promoter, effectively constraining neoplastic dissemination. Mechanistically, the long noncoding RNA LINC00922 can decoy SIRT3 away from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating local H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis. This places SIRT3's lysine decrotonylase activity at the interface of histone acylation state and oncogenic transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低轉移相關位點如 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，有效限制腫瘤擴散。機制上，長非編碼 RNA LINC00922 可以將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調局部 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移。這將 SIRT3 的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化活性置於組蛋白醯基化狀態和致癌性轉錄的交界處。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Lung fibrosis via TGF-β1
nodes.description: SIRT3 deficiency in the aging murine lung promotes a fibrotic response mediated by TGF-beta1 and augments mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Conversely, SIRT3 overexpression can ameliorate asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Directionally, SIRT3 deficiency sits upstream of enhanced TGF-beta1-driven fibrosis, because by weakening mitochondrial antioxidant defenses it renders alveolar epithelial cells vulnerable to the damage that fuels the fibrotic program. Restoring SIRT3 could therefore protect against pulmonary fibrosis, making mitochondrial sirtuin activity an important determinant of lung resilience to environmental and aging-related fibrotic injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 老化小鼠肺部的SIRT3缺乏促進由TGF-beta1介導的纖維化反應，並增強肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體DNA損傷和凋亡。相反，SIRT3過表達可以改善石棉誘導的肺纖維化。方向上，SIRT3缺乏位於TGF-beta1驅動的纖維化增強的上游，因為透過削弱粒線體抗氧化防禦，它使肺泡上皮細胞容易受到推動纖維化程序的損傷。因此恢復SIRT3可能保護免受肺纖維化，使粒線體sirtuin活性成為肺部對環境和與年齡相關纖維化損傷韌性的重要決定因素。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs
nodes.description: SIRT3 governs mitochondrial biogenesis by activating PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs, which maintain mitochondrial DNA integrity in Parkinson's disease models, and promotes PGC-1alpha-dependent transcription to sustain redox homeostasis and neuronal energy metabolism in Huntington's disease. In diabetic nephropathy, the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis activated by meteorin-like protein stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過活化 PGC-1alpha 轉錄程序掌控粒線體生成，在巴金森氏症模型中維護粒線體 DNA 完整性，並促進 PGC-1alpha 依賴的轉錄以維持亨丁頓氏症中的氧化還原恆定和神經元能量代謝。在糖尿病腎病變中，由 meteorin-like 蛋白活化的 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，維護粒線體超微結構完整性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: HIF1α (inhibits glycolysis)
nodes.description: SIRT3 indirectly destabilizes HIF1α and subsequently inhibits glycolysis and glucose oxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 間接不穩定化 HIF1α，隨後抑制糖酵解和葡萄糖氧化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Human aging (longevity)
nodes.description: SIRT3 is associated with Human aging (longevity); mitochondrial sirtuin activity and SIRT3 variants are linked to human longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 與人類衰老（長壽）相關；粒線體 sirtuin 活性和 SIRT3 變異與人類長壽相關。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: mitochondrial enzyme deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT3 is the principal mitochondrial deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from the majority of the mitochondrial acetylome - including respiratory-chain (Complex I/III), TCA-cycle (IDH2, SDH), beta-oxidation (LCAD), and antioxidant (MnSOD) enzymes - to tune bioenergetics; its activity is NAD+-dependent and rises with caloric restriction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，從粒線體乙醯化組的大部分蛋白質上移除乙醯基團——包括呼吸鏈（複合體 I/III）、TCA 循環（IDH2、SDH）、β-氧化（LCAD）和抗氧化（MnSOD）酶——以調節生物能量學；其活性依賴 NAD+ 並在熱量限制時升高。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Reactive oxygen species production
nodes.description: SIRT3 lowers mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating antioxidant enzymes such as MnSOD and components of the electron-transport chain, while also reducing mitochondrial membrane potential in a manner that limits superoxide leak. Higher SIRT3 activity therefore shifts the mitochondrial redox balance toward less oxidative damage. The directionality is SIRT3 activity upstream of reduced ROS. This antioxidant function is a major basis for SIRT3's protective roles in heart, liver, and aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 通過去乙醯化並活化抗氧化酶（如 MnSOD 和電子傳遞鏈的組分）來降低粒線體 ROS，同時以限制超氧自由基洩漏的方式降低粒線體膜電位。因此更高的 SIRT3 活性使粒線體氧化還原平衡向更少的氧化損傷傾斜。其方向性為 SIRT3 活性在減少 ROS 的上游。這種抗氧化功能是 SIRT3 在心臟、肝臟和衰老中保護作用的主要基礎。

nodes.label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase (PDH)
nodes.description: SIRT3 maintains the activity of pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) by preventing its hyperacetylation, thereby coupling glycolysis-derived carbon to mitochondrial oxidation. Loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and accumulation of pyruvate and lactate, impairing metabolic flexibility in skeletal muscle. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of PDH-dependent glucose oxidation. By protecting PDH, SIRT3 ensures that glucose can be oxidized in mitochondria rather than being diverted to lactate, preserving energy efficiency during exercise and metabolic stress. This function is central to SIRT3's role in supporting muscle performance and whole-body glucose handling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過防止丙酮酸脫氫酶（PDH）過度乙醯化來維持其活性，從而將糖解衍生的碳與粒線體氧化耦合。SIRT3的缺失導致PDH過度乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少以及丙酮酸和乳酸的積累，損害骨骼肌的代謝靈活性。方向上，SIRT3位於PDH依賴性葡萄糖氧化的上游。透過保護PDH，SIRT3確保葡萄糖可以在粒線體中氧化而非被分流到乳酸，在運動和代謝壓力期間維持能量效率。此功能是SIRT3支持肌肉表現和全身葡萄糖處理角色的核心。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: ROS management
nodes.description: SIRT3 manages mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating MnSOD and IDH2, boosting NADPH/glutathione antioxidant defense; this lowers mitochondrial superoxide and oxidative damage, protecting against cardiovascular, metabolic, and age-related injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD 和 IDH2 來管理粒線體 ROS，增強 NADPH/穀胱甘肽抗氧化防禦；這降低了粒線體超氧化物和氧化損傷，保護免受心血管、代謝和年齡相關的損傷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: GSK3beta at Lys15
nodes.description: SIRT3 mediates its anti-fibrotic effect through targeted deacetylation of glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3beta) at Lys15, effectively preventing Smad3 transcriptional complex formation and subsequent fibrogenic programming. Genetic deletion of SIRT3 increases GSK3beta acetylation and hyperactivates TGF-beta signaling, culminating in enhanced transcription of ECM-related genes. This mechanism operates across peritoneal, cardiac, pulmonary, and hepatic fibrosis models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 Lys15 處靶向去乙醯化糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3beta），有效阻止 Smad3 轉錄複合物的形成及隨後的纖維化程序，從而發揮抗纖維化作用。SIRT3 的基因缺失增加 GSK3beta 乙醯化並過度活化 TGF-beta 訊號，最終增強 ECM 相關基因的轉錄。此機制在腹膜、心臟、肺部和肝纖維化模型中均運作。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Twist downregulation
nodes.description: SIRT3 overexpression dramatically suppresses the metastatic capability of ovarian cancer cells by inhibiting epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition through downregulation of Twist, a key EMT transcription factor. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Twist suppression and maintenance of an epithelial phenotype. By reducing Twist, SIRT3 blocks the switch that confers migratory and invasive behavior on tumor cells. This restrains the metastatic spread that is the main cause of ovarian cancer mortality. The finding positions SIRT3 as a suppressor of ovarian cancer metastasis and suggests that maintaining SIRT3 activity could help limit disease dissemination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3過表達透過下調Twist（一種關鍵的EMT轉錄因子）抑制上皮-間質轉化，從而顯著抑制卵巢癌細胞的轉移能力。方向上，SIRT3位於Twist抑制和上皮表型維持的上游。透過降低Twist，SIRT3阻斷了賦予腫瘤細胞遷移和侵襲行為的轉換。這限制了作為卵巢癌死亡主要原因的轉移性擴散。此發現將SIRT3定位為卵巢癌轉移的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT3活性可能有助於限制疾病擴散。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: tamoxifen sensitivity in MTR-3 breast cancer cells
nodes.description: SIRT3 overexpression in the breast cancer cell line MTR-3 reduces the sensitivity of the resistant cells to tamoxifen. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of diminished responsiveness to endocrine therapy in breast cancer cells. By lowering tamoxifen sensitivity, SIRT3 may contribute to anti-estrogen resistance, complicating endocrine treatment of breast cancer. This is counterbalanced by SIRT4, which enhances tamoxifen sensitivity, highlighting opposing sirtuin functions in endocrine-resistant breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3在乳腺癌細胞系MTR-3中的過表達降低了耐藥細胞對Tamoxifen的敏感性。方向上，SIRT3位於乳腺癌細胞中內分泌療法反應性降低的上游。透過降低Tamoxifen敏感性，SIRT3可能促成抗雌激素耐藥性，使乳腺癌的內分泌治療變得複雜。這與增強Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT4相平衡，突顯了內分泌耐藥性乳腺癌中sirtuin的對立功能。
nodes.norm_label: tamoxifen sensitivity in mtr-3 breast cancer cells
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: cardiac hypertrophy during ageing
nodes.description: SIRT3 prevents cardiac hypertrophy during ageing; its deacetylase activity protects against age-related cardiac hypertrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在衰老過程中預防心臟肥大；其去乙醯酶活性保護免受年齡相關的心臟肥大。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: ATM-Chk2 DNA damage repair
nodes.description: SIRT3 promotes DNA damage repair and radioresistance through the ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM)-Chk2 pathway in non-small-cell lung cancer cells. By supporting this DNA-damage-response branch, SIRT3 enables cancer cells to survive ionizing radiation more effectively. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of enhanced DNA repair and radiation resistance. This has therapeutic implications, because combining SIRT3 inhibition with radiotherapy could impair the repair of radiation-induced damage and thereby improve treatment efficacy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過ataxia telangiectasia mutated（ATM）-Chk2通路在非小細胞肺癌細胞中促進DNA損傷修復和放射抗性。透過支持此DNA損傷反應分支，SIRT3使癌細胞能更有效地在電離輻射中存活。方向上，SIRT3位於DNA修復增強和輻射抗性的上游。這具有治療意義，因為將SIRT3抑制與放療結合可能損害輻射誘導損傷的修復，從而提高治療效果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: PINK1/Parkin mitophagy
nodes.description: SIRT3 promotes PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy, which reduces mitochondrial ROS and restores hematopoietic stem cell repopulation efficiency through lysosomal clearance of damaged mitochondria. In the aging brain, the PINK1/Parkin pathway clears damaged mitochondria in Alzheimer's disease models, mitigating amyloidogenesis and tau pathology, and in osteoarthritis models SIRT3 promotes mitophagy to maintain chondrocyte health. Mitophagy is thus a core mitochondrial quality-control arm of SIRT3's cytoprotective program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 促進 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬，後者降低粒線體活性氧並透過溶酶體清除受損粒線體恢造血幹細胞重建效率。在老化的大腦中，PINK1/Parkin 途徑在阿茲海默症模型中清除受損粒線體，減輕澱粉樣蛋白生成和 tau 病理變化；在骨關節炎模型中 SIRT3 促進粒線體自噬以維護軟骨細胞健康。因此粒線體自噬是 SIRT3 細胞保護程序的核心粒線體品質控制臂。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: fatty acid oxidation (FAO)
nodes.description: SIRT3 promotes fatty-acid oxidation by deacetylating metabolic enzymes of β-oxidation and the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化 β-氧化和 TCA 循環的代謝酶來促進脂肪酸氧化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury
nodes.description: SIRT3 promotes the expression of manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD), and this regulation is crucial for the protective effect of SIRT3 on hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of MnSOD-dependent lung protection. By maintaining MnSOD, SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense against the oxidative stress generated by high oxygen exposure. This shields lung tissue from the reactive oxygen species that drive injury during hyperoxia. The finding highlights SIRT3 as a mitochondrial antioxidant guardian in the lung and suggests that strategies to enhance SIRT3 or MnSOD could protect against oxygen-induced lung damage in clinical settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3促進錳超氧化物歧化酶（MnSOD）的表達，此調節對SIRT3保護高氧誘導的急性肺損傷的效果至關重要。方向上，SIRT3位於MnSOD依賴性肺保護的上游。透過維持MnSOD，SIRT3支持粒線體抗氧化防禦，對抗高氧暴露產生的氧化壓力。這保護肺組織免受在高氧期間驅動損傷的活性氧。此發現突顯SIRT3作為肺部的粒線體抗氧化守護者，並表明增強SIRT3或MnSOD的策略可能在臨床環境中保護免受氧誘導的肺損傷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: cisplatin resistance in lung cancer
nodes.description: SIRT3 reduces cisplatin resistance in lung cancer by modulating the FoxO3/Cdc10-dependent transcript 1 protein axis. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in drug-resistant lung cancer cells. By acting through the FoxO3/CDT1 pathway, SIRT3 counteracts the survival adaptations that underlie cisplatin resistance, making SIRT3 activation a candidate strategy to re-sensitize resistant lung tumors to platinum-based chemotherapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過調節FoxO3/Cdc10-dependent transcript 1（CDT1）蛋白軸來降低肺癌中的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT3位於藥物耐藥肺癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過透過FoxO3/CDT1通路发挥作用，SIRT3對抗構成順鉑耐藥基礎的存活適應，使SIRT3活化成為使耐藥肺癌腫瘤對鉑基化療重新敏感的候選策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: AMPK/mTOR autophagy axis
nodes.description: SIRT3 regulates autophagic flux through the AMPK/mTOR and FOXO3a pathways, facilitating mitochondrial quality control via AMPK/ULK1 phosphorylation while antagonizing mTOR-mediated autophagic repression. Genetic ablation of SIRT3 impairs autophagic signaling with paradoxical activation of glutathione peroxidase 4 activity that suppresses autophagy initiation. A positive feedback loop exists in which autophagy induces SIRT3 via FOXO3a, restoring hematopoietic stem cell repopulation through enhanced clearance of damaged mitochondria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 AMPK/mTOR 和 FOXO3a 途徑調節自噬通量，透過 AMPK/ULK1 磷酸化促進粒線體品質控制，同時拮抗 mTOR 介導的自噬抑制。SIRT3 的基因敲除損害自噬訊號，伴隨穀胱甘肽過氧化酶 4 活性的矛盾活化，後者抑制自噬啟動。存在一個正回饋迴路，其中自噬透過 FOXO3a 誘導 SIRT3，透過增強受損粒線體的清除恢造血幹細胞重建能力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: cell death regulation
nodes.description: SIRT3 regulates cell death in a context-dependent manner: it is predominantly anti-apoptotic under stress (via MnSOD activation, Bcl-2 deacetylation, and cyclophilin D modulation) yet pro-apoptotic in some malignancies; it also governs ferroptosis susceptibility through mitochondrial ROS and lipid-peroxidation control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 以環境依賴的方式調節細胞死亡：在壓力下主要為抗凋亡作用（透過 MnSOD 活化、Bcl-2 去乙醯化和親環素 D 調節），但在某些惡性腫瘤中為促凋亡作用；它還透過粒線體 ROS 和脂質過氧化控制來調節鐵死亡敏感性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: PDH E1alpha
nodes.description: SIRT3 regulates pyruvate dehydrogenase E1alpha deacetylation, bridging glycolysis and the TCA cycle in tubular epithelial cells during the progression of renal fibrosis. Honokiol-activated SIRT3 upregulates mitochondrial GPX4 and decreases its acetylation, inhibiting neuronal ferroptosis and mitigating perioperative neurocognitive disorders, illustrating SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control across glycolysis-TCA coupling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1alpha 去乙醯化，在腎纖維化進展期間連接腎小管上皮細胞中的糖酵解和 TCA 循環。Honokiol 活化的 SIRT3 上調粒線體 GPX4 並降低其乙醯化，抑制神經元鐵死亡並減輕圍術期神經認知障礙，說明了 SIRT3 在糖酵解-TCA 偶聯中的代謝酵素控制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Ku70-Bax
nodes.description: SIRT3 stabilizes the interaction between Ku70 and Bax to enhance the viability of glioma cells, representing an oncogenic function in this cancer type that contrasts with its tumor-suppressive roles elsewhere. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of enhanced glioma cell survival. By keeping Bax sequestered by Ku70, SIRT3 prevents the pro-apoptotic protein from triggering mitochondrial cell death, allowing glioma cells to evade apoptosis. This oncogenic facet complicates the picture of SIRT3 as a universal tumor suppressor and underscores that its net effect depends on cellular context. In gliomas, SIRT3 inhibition might be a strategy to promote tumor cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3穩定Ku70和Bax之間的相互作用以增強膠質瘤細胞的存活能力，代表了在此癌症類型中與其在其他地方的腫瘤抑制角色形成對比的致癌功能。方向上，SIRT3位於膠質瘤細胞存活增強的上游。透過保持Bax被Ku70隔離，SIRT3防止促凋亡蛋白觸發粒線體細胞死亡，使膠質瘤細胞能夠逃避凋亡。這種致癌面向使SIRT3作為普遍腫瘤抑制因子的圖像變得複雜，並強調其淨效果取決於細胞環境。在膠質瘤中，SIRT3抑制可能是促進腫瘤細胞死亡的策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: HIF-1α inhibition and ROS suppression
nodes.description: SIRT3 stops mitochondrial reactive oxygen species generation, which inhibits HIF-1α and tumour growth. When SIRT3 is overexpressed, it resists the growth of established cancer cell lines. SIRT3 also prevents cancer cell metabolic reprogramming by destabilising HIF1α. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced mitochondrial ROS and HIF-1α stabilisation, thereby opposing the hypoxic and metabolic adaptations that support tumour growth.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3阻止粒線體活性氧的產生，這抑制HIF-1α和腫瘤生長。當SIRT3過表達時，它抵抗已建立癌細胞系的生長。SIRT3也透過使HIF1α不穩定化來防止癌細胞代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT3位於粒線體ROS降低和HIF-1α穩定化抑制的上游，從而對抗支持腫瘤生長的缺氧和代謝適應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: ATP production
nodes.description: SIRT3 supports ATP production by deacetylating respiratory-chain complexes I and III and OSCP of the ATP synthase, optimizing electron transport and coupling proton flux to ATP synthesis; loss of SIRT3 impairs oxidative phosphorylation and lowers ATP output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 以及 ATP 合酶的 OSCP 來支持 ATP 產生，優化電子傳輸並將質子流與 ATP 合成耦合；SIRT3 的缺失損害氧化磷酸化並降低 ATP 產量。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: COVID-19 clinical outcome
nodes.description: Serum SIRT3 levels are markedly lower in severe COVID-19 patients compared with those with mild or moderate disease, indicating a positive role of SIRT3 in alleviating COVID-19. Directionally, SIRT3 levels sit upstream of clinical outcome and prognosis. Because SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense and dampens inflammation, its reduction in severe cases may permit greater oxidative stress and inflammatory damage. SIRT3 levels therefore serve as an indicator of disease severity and associate with prognosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與輕度或中度疾病患者相比，重症COVID-19患者的血清SIRT3水平顯著較低，表明SIRT3在緩解COVID-19中具有正面作用。方向上，SIRT3水平位於臨床結局和預後的上游。因為SIRT3支持粒線體抗氧化防禦並抑制發炎，其在重症中的降低可能允許更大的氧化壓力和發炎損傷。因此SIRT3水平作為疾病嚴重程度的指標，並與預後相關。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: healthspan outcomes
nodes.description: The conclusion of the review positions SIRT3 as a pleiotropic regulatory hub in cellular senescence and geropathology, a critical determinant across cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative conditions, metabolic syndrome, cancer, kidney diseases, COPD, and degenerative spine and joint diseases. It highlights SIRT3's regulation of the mitochondrial acetylome and its profound effect on chromatin remodeling and genome stability, making SIRT3 agonism a promising translational strategy in geroscience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 該綜述的結論將 SIRT3 定位為細胞衰老和老年病理學中的多效性調控中樞，是心血管疾病、神經退化性疾病、代謝症候群、癌症、腎臟疾病、COPD 以及退化性脊柱和關節疾病的關鍵決定因子。它凸顯了 SIRT3 對粒線體乙醯酶組的調節及其對染色質重塑和基因組穩定性的深遠影響，使 SIRT3 激動成為老年科學中一個有前景的轉化策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: N-terminal 101 residues by mitochondrial processing peptidase
nodes.description: The full-length SIRT3 protein is enzymatically inactive and contains a mitochondrial targeting domain at its N-terminus. Mitochondrial matrix processing peptidase cleaves the N-terminal 101 residues, which then activates the enzyme. Directionally, proteolytic processing sits upstream of SIRT3 catalytic activity within the mitochondrial matrix. This maturation step ensures that SIRT3 functions only after import into mitochondria, where it deacetylates metabolic enzymes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 全長SIRT3蛋白在酵素上是不活性的，其N端包含一個粒線體靶向結構域。粒線體基質加工肽酶切除N端101個殘基，從而活化該酶。方向上，蛋白水解加工位於粒線體基質中SIRT3催化活性的上游。此成熟步驟確保SIRT3僅在輸入粒線體後才發揮功能，在那裡它去乙醯化代謝酶。
nodes.norm_label: n-terminal 101 residues by mitochondrial processing peptidase
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: p53 pathway
nodes.description: Through the p53 pathway, SIRT3 prevents dysfunction and senescence caused by high glucose levels in endothelial cells by partially abrogating p53 activity. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of dampened p53 signalling and thereby of protection against glucose-induced endothelial senescence. This links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to vascular health and identifies SIRT3 as a potential target for preventing diabetic endothelial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過p53通路，SIRT3透過部分消除p53活性來預防高葡萄糖水平在內皮細胞中引起的功能障礙和衰老。方向上，SIRT3位於p53訊號減弱的上游，從而保護免受葡萄糖誘導的內皮衰老。這將粒線體sirtuin活性與血管健康聯繫起來，並將SIRT3確定為預防糖尿病內皮功能障礙的潛在靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
nodes.description: Upregulation of SIRT3 in breast cancer cells suppresses glycolysis and proliferation, offering a metabolic pathway for tumour suppression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced glycolytic metabolism and growth in breast cancer cells. By suppressing glycolysis, SIRT3 limits the Warburg-like metabolic program that supports breast cancer proliferation, identifying SIRT3 activation as a potential tumour-suppressive strategy in breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在乳腺癌細胞中的上調可抑制糖酵解和細胞增殖，為腫瘤抑制提供了一條代謝途徑。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 位於降低乳腺癌細胞糖酵解代謝和生長的上游。透過抑制糖酵解，SIRT3 限制了支持乳腺癌增殖的類沃伯格（Warburg）代謝程序，從而確立 SIRT3 活化作為乳腺癌中潛在的腫瘤抑制策略。
nodes.norm_label: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: 2-APQC
nodes.description: 2-APQC is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis; efficacy is lost in SIRT3-knockout models and attenuated by nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary target, via suppression of AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 2-APQC 是一種新型 SIRT3 藥理學激動劑，緩解異丙腎上腺素誘導的病理性心臟肥厚和纖維化；在 SIRT3 基因敲除模型中療效喪失，並被尼可醯胺削弱，確認 SIRT3 為其主要靶標，透過抑制 AKT/mTOR/p70S6K 和 JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 訊號實現。

nodes.label: Ac2-26
nodes.description: Ac2-26, the annexin A1-derived tripeptide mimetic, transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, concurrently reducing oxidative damage while promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy, augmenting mitochondrial function to limit ischemic kidney injury (Suliman et al., Front Physiol 2021).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ac2-26 是 annexin A1 衍生的三胜肽類似物，在轉錄水平上調 SIRT3，同時減少氧化損傷並促進粒線體生成和粒線體自噬，增強粒線體功能以限制缺血性腎損傷（Suliman et al., Front Physiol 2021）。

nodes.label: miR-494-3p
nodes.description: Oxidative stress-induced miR-494-3p downregulates SIRT3, establishing a senescence-exacerbating feedback loop; in COPD it directly targets SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells, increasing p27 expression and accelerating cellular senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氧化壓力誘導的 miR-494-3p 下調 SIRT3，建立一個加劇衰老的回饋迴路；在 COPD 中它直接靶向小氣道上皮細胞中的 SIRT3，增加 p27 表現並加速細胞衰老。

nodes.label: Poricoic acid A
nodes.description: Poricoic acid A is a lanostane triterpenoid from Poria cocos. It upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro, a candidate disease-modifying agent for tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Poricoic acid A 是來自茯苓的羊毛甾烷三萜類化合物。它上調 SIRT3 並促進 β-catenin K49 去乙醯化，減輕腎臟纖維母細胞活化和腎間質纖維化（體內和體外），是腎小管間質纖維化的候選疾病修飾劑。

nodes.label: MIP-2
nodes.description: SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and MIP-2 (CXCL2), as well as diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in various preclinical models. These anti-inflammatory effects are sustained even after discontinuation of dietary interventions, indicating durable transcriptional reprogramming via NF-kappaB and STAT3 suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化與促發炎細胞因子如 TNF-alpha、IL-6 和 MIP-2（CXCL2）的表達減少以及各種臨床前模型中多形核白血球浸潤的減少一致相關。這些抗發炎效果在停止飲食介入後仍持續存在，表明透過 NF-kappaB 和 STAT3 抑制實現了持久的轉錄重編程。

nodes.label: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化主要透過 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並在 DCM 中抑制氧化壓力。SIRT3 下調打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展；melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 和上調 SIRT3 發揮保護作用。

nodes.label: Lys143 (suppressing ROS-mediated mutagenesis)
nodes.description: By deacetylating IDH2 at K143, SIRT3 suppresses ROS-mediated mutagenesis and tumorigenesis. Distinct from the caloric-restriction-linked K413 activation that drives NADPH antioxidant regeneration, the K143 modification couples mitochondrial redox control directly to genomic protection. Directionally, SIRT3-IDH2 crosstalk sits upstream of reduced oxidative DNA damage in transformed cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 K143 處去乙醯 IDH2 來抑制 ROS 介導的突變和腫瘤發生。與驅動 NADPH 抗氧化劑再生的熱量限制相關的 K413 活化不同，K143 修飾將粒線體氧化還原控制直接與基因組保護結合。從方向上看，SIRT3-IDH2 串擾位於轉化細胞中減少氧化 DNA 損傷的上游。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Intracellular acetyl-CoA and NAD+ levels
nodes.description: Emerging evidence indicates that SIRT3 acts as a key metabolic regulator that senses intracellular acetyl-coenzyme A (CoA) and NAD+ levels by transducing these cues through deacetylation of mitochondrial proteins. Directionally, acetyl-CoA and NAD+ abundance sits upstream of SIRT3 activity. This nutrient-sensing role lets SIRT3 tune mitochondrial enzymatic efficiency under fasting and caloric restriction, positioning it as the mitochondrial arm of cellular energy sensing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 新出現的證據表明，SIRT3 是一種關鍵的代謝調節因子，可透過粒線體蛋白的去乙醯化轉導這些訊號來感知細胞內乙醯輔酶 A (CoA) 和 NAD+ 水平。從方向來看，乙醯輔酶A和NAD+豐度位於SIRT3活性的上游。這種營養感應作用讓 SIRT3 在禁食和熱量限制下調節粒線體酶效率，將其定位為細胞能量感應的粒線體臂。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: ox-LDL-induced foam cell formation (via AMPK and UCP1 modulation)
nodes.description: In atherosclerosis, SIRT3 promotes AMPK activation and modulates the activity of uncoupling protein-1 (UCP1), thereby suppressing oxidized-LDL-induced foam cell formation. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced macrophage lipid loading. Gut microbiota-derived metabolites further influence the SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a axis that antagonizes lipogenic programming governed by the SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 cascade, indicating functional linkage between SIRT3 activity and host-microbiome interactions in vascular disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在動脈粥狀硬化中，SIRT3 促進 AMPK 活化並調節解偶聯蛋白 1 (UCP1) 的活性，從而抑制氧化 LDL 誘導的泡沫細胞形成。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於巨噬細胞脂質負荷減少的上游。腸道微生物群衍生的代謝物進一步影響 SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a 軸，該軸拮抗由 SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 級聯控制的脂肪生成程序，顯示血管疾病中 SIRT3 活性與宿主微生物組相互作用之間的功能連結。
nodes.norm_label: ox-ldl-induced foam cell formation (via ampk and ucp1 modulation)
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: SHMT2 at Lys95 (serine metabolism)
nodes.description: In colorectal malignancies, SIRT3 optimizes serine metabolism via serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2) deacetylation at Lys95, enhancing tumor aggressiveness. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated SHMT2 activation sits upstream of intensified one-carbon metabolism supporting colorectal cancer cell proliferation and survival.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在結直腸惡性腫瘤中，SIRT3 透過絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2 (SHMT2) 在 Lys95 處去乙醯化來優化絲胺酸代謝，從而增強腫瘤侵襲性。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 SHMT2 活化位於強化一碳代謝的上游，支持大腸直腸癌細胞增殖和存活。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: GLDC at Lys514 (nucleotide biosynthesis)
nodes.description: In glioblastoma models, SIRT3 promotes nucleotide biosynthesis by deacetylating glycine decarboxylase (GLDC) at Lys514. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated GLDC activation sits upstream of expanded nucleotide pools fueling glioblastoma proliferation. Together with PYCR1 and SHMT2 regulation, this underscores how SIRT3's control of amino-acid metabolism can be co-opted to support aggressive tumor growth in specific contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在膠質母細胞瘤模型中，SIRT3 透過在 Lys514 處去乙醯甘氨酸脫羧酶 (GLDC) 來促進核苷酸生物合成。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的 GLDC 活化位於擴大的核苷酸庫的上游，促進膠質母細胞瘤增殖。與 PYCR1 和 SHMT2 調節一起，這強調了 SIRT3 對氨基酸代謝的控制如何能夠在特定情況下支持侵襲性腫瘤生長。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Src kinase oxidation (mammary carcinoma metastasis)
nodes.description: In mammary carcinoma, SIRT3 inhibits Src kinase oxidation to suppress metastatic dissemination. Directionally, SIRT3-controlled redox state sits upstream of restrained Src-driven migratory signaling. This illustrates a tumor-suppressive facet of SIRT3's ROS management, whereby maintenance of mitochondrial redox homeostasis prevents oxidative activation of pro-metastatic kinases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在乳癌中，SIRT3 抑制 Src 激酶氧化以抑制轉移擴散。從方向上看，SIRT3 控制的氧化還原狀態位於受抑制的 Src 驅動的遷移訊號的上游。這說明了 SIRT3 ROS 管理的腫瘤抑制方面，即維持粒線體氧化還原穩態可防止促轉移激酶的氧化活化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Histone methyltransferase complexes
nodes.description: In the context of viral infection, SIRT3 dynamically modulates the transcriptional output and replicative capacity of viral genomes by guiding histone methyltransferase complexes to viral episomes. Exogenous SIRT3 overexpression significantly attenuates viral gene expression, whereas deletion potentiates viral replication efficiency. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated chromatin targeting of episomal DNA sits upstream of suppressed viral transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在病毒感染的情況下，SIRT3 透過將組蛋白甲基轉移酶複合物引導至病毒附加體來動態調節病毒基因組的轉錄輸出和複製能力。外源SIRT3過度表達會顯著減弱病毒基因表達，而缺失會增強病毒複製效率。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的附加型 DNA 染色質靶向位於受抑制的病毒轉錄的上游。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: PYCR1 at Lys228 (proline biosynthesis)
nodes.description: SIRT3 catalyzes Lys228 deacetylation on pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 (PYCR1), facilitating proline biosynthesis, a critical process for tumor cell proliferation. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatic modification of PYCR1 sits upstream of enhanced proline-dependent anabolic support for tumor growth. This exemplifies the oncogenic facet of SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control in certain genetic or microenvironmental contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 催化吡咯啉 5 羧酸還原酶 1 (PYCR1) 上的 Lys228 去乙醯化，促進脯胺酸生物合成，這是腫瘤細胞增殖的關鍵過程。從方向上看，PYCR1 的 SIRT3 酶促修飾位於增強的脯氨酸依賴性合成代謝支持腫瘤生長的上游。這例證了 SIRT3 在某些遺傳或微環境背景下代謝酵素控制的致癌方面。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: PACAP (pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide)
nodes.description: SIRT3 modulates neuropeptide signaling pathways: its interaction with pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP) enhances neuroprotective effects by alleviating amyloid-beta toxicity. Directionally, the SIRT3-PACAP interaction sits upstream of reduced Aβ-mediated neuronal injury. This indicates that SIRT3 can bridge neurotrophic and metabolic signaling in the aging brain, extending its neuroprotective repertoire beyond mitochondrial homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節神經肽訊號通路：它與垂體腺苷酸環化酶激活多肽 (PACAP) 的相互作用可透過減輕澱粉樣蛋白 - β 的毒性來增強神經保護作用。從方向上看，SIRT3-PACAP 相互作用位於減少 Aβ 介導的神經元損傷的上游。這表明 SIRT3 可以在老化大腦中橋接神經營養和代謝信號傳導，將其神經保護功能擴展到粒線體穩態之外。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: p53/p21 axis (senescence initiation)
nodes.description: SIRT3 regulates canonical senescence markers such as SA-beta-gal and inhibits the p53/p21 axis, thereby delaying senescence initiation. Directionally, SIRT3 activity sits upstream of suppressed p53-p21 checkpoint engagement. By restraining this axis alongside its antioxidant and metabolic programs, SIRT3 minimizes DNA damage accumulation and postpones entry into the senescent state during aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節經典老化標記物（例如 SA-β-gal）並抑制 p53/p21 軸，從而延遲老化起始。從方向上看，SIRT3 活性位於受抑制的 p53-p21 檢查點參與的上游。透過抑制此軸及其抗氧化和代謝程序，SIRT3 最大限度地減少 DNA 損傷積累，並在老化過程中推遲進入衰老狀態。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: miR-297 and miR-421
nodes.description: The microRNAs miR-297 and miR-421 act as upstream modulators of SIRT3, repressing its expression and consequently influencing apoptosis-related pathways. Directionally, these microRNAs sit upstream of diminished SIRT3 output. Their dysregulation shifts the apoptotic balance in stressed cells and adds a noncoding-RNA regulatory layer to SIRT3's control of cell fate decisions in aging and malignancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: microRNA miR-297 和 miR-421 作为 SIRT3 的上游调节剂，抑制其表达，从而影响细胞凋亡相关途径。从方向上看，这些 microRNA 位于 SIRT3 输出减少的上游。它們的失調改變了壓力細胞中的凋亡平衡，並為 SIRT3 對老化和惡性腫瘤中細胞命運決定的控制添加了非編碼 RNA 調節層。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: ATP5O
nodes.description: In healthy mitochondria a pool of SIRT3 is sequestered by ATP synthase via the ATP5O (OSCP) subunit. When matrix pH drops upon depolarization, SIRT3 dissociates from ATP5O (requiring H135 of ATP5O) and redistributes to matrix substrates, enabling rapid deacetylation of metabolic enzymes and recovery of membrane potential within minutes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，一部分 SIRT3 被 ATP 合成酶透過 ATP5O（OSCP）亞基封存。當去極化導致基質 pH 下降時，SIRT3 從 ATP5O 解離（需要 ATP5O 的 H135），並重新分佈到基質受質上，實現對代謝酶的快速去乙醯化並在數分鐘內恢復膜電位。

nodes.label: Kidney Stones
nodes.description: SIRT3 is downregulated in patients with kidney stones and is protective via the Nrf2/heme oxygenase-1 pathway. SIRT3-dependent antioxidant defense protects tubular epithelium from crystal-induced injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在腎結石患者中表現降低，並經由 Nrf2/血基質加氧酶-1 途徑具有保護作用。SIRT3 依賴的抗氧化防禦保護腎小管上皮免受晶體誘導的損傷。

nodes.label: CypD
nodes.description: SIRT3 deacetylates cyclophilin D, preventing mitochondrial permeability-transition pore opening. This anti-apoptotic arm complements SIRT3's pro-autophagy roles in its context-dependent duality.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 cyclophilin D，防止粒線體通透轉換孔開啟。此抗凋亡臂補充 SIRT3 在其情境依賴雙重性中的促自噬角色。

nodes.label: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
nodes.description: In Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance through ROS buffering. By boosting mitochondrial antioxidant capacity — via MnSOD deacetylation and IDH2-driven NADPH production — SIRT3 protects leukemic cells from the oxidative damage imposed by cytotoxic chemotherapy, a tumour-supportive role that contrasts with its tumour-suppressive action elsewhere.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia 中，SIRT3 透過 ROS 緩衝促成代謝適應並賦予化療抗藥性。SIRT3 藉由提升粒線體抗氧化能力——經由 MnSOD 去乙醯化與 IDH2 驅動的 NADPH 生成——保護白血病細胞免受細胞毒性化療所造成的氧化傷害，這種促腫瘤作用與其在其他情境下的抑腫作用形成對比。

nodes.label: SENP1
nodes.description: In tumor-associated macrophages, the SUMO protease SENP1 deSUMOylates the mitochondrial sirtuin SIRT3; SIRT3 SUMOylation deficiency enhances cholesterol synthesis, raises mitochondrial acetyl-CoA, and drives M2 polarization. This SENP1-SIRT3-cholesterol axis shows that mitochondrial sirtuin activity in immune host cells gates the anti-tumor cytotoxic response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Tumor-Associated Macrophage 中，SUMO 蛋白酶 SENP1 將粒線體 sirtuin SIRT3 去 SUMO 化；SIRT3 的 SUMO 化缺失會提升膽固醇合成、提高粒線體 acetyl-CoA，並驅動 M2 極化。此 SENP1-SIRT3-膽固醇軸顯示免疫宿主細胞中的粒線體 sirtuin 活性可調控抗腫瘤細胞毒性反應。

nodes.label: UBX1325
nodes.description: UBX1325 is a Bcl-xL-inhibitor senolytic with randomized phase-2 data in diabetic macular edema (Klier 2025). It extends the navitoclax-class SCAP strategy to an ophthalmic indication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UBX1325 是具糖尿病黃斑水腫隨機二期數據（Klier 2025）的 Bcl-xL 抑制劑 senolytic。它將 navitoclax 類 SCAP 策略擴展至眼科適應症。

nodes.label: CK1
nodes.description: CK1 phosphorylates Bid at Thr58/Ser61/64, blocking caspase-8 cleavage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CK1 在 Thr58/Ser61/64 磷酸化 Bid，阻斷 caspase-8 切割。

nodes.label: PAK4
nodes.description: PAK4 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating the BH3-only protein.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAK4 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，使 BH3-only 蛋白失活。

nodes.label: PAK5
nodes.description: PAK5 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, paralleling the PAK4 edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAK5 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，與 PAK4 邊平行。

nodes.label: DUB
nodes.description: USP9X is a deubiquitinase reversing substrate ubiquitination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: USP9X 是逆轉受質泛素化的去泛素酶。

nodes.label: BAI1
nodes.description: Pharmacologic BAX inhibitors BAI1 and eltrombopag block BAX translocation and oligomerization, reducing cytosolic mtDNA/mtRNA and SASP secretion in senescent fibroblasts; in aged mice BAI1 lowers circulating SASP factors and improves bone strength and frailty without altering p16/p21 arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藥理學 BAX 抑制劑 BAI1 與 eltrombopag 阻斷 BAX 轉位與寡聚，減少衰老纖維母細胞的胞質 mtDNA/mtRNA 與 SASP 分泌；在老齡小鼠中 BAI1 降低循環 SASP 因子並改善骨強度與衰弱，且不改變 p16/p21 停滯。

nodes.label: TNFR
nodes.description: TNFR1 is the death-domain-containing member of the TNF receptor family and the canonical necroptosis entry point; other TNFR-superfamily members lack the same direct necrosome coupling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNFR1 為 TNF 受體家族中具死亡結構域的成員，是 necroptosis 的經典入口；其他 TNFR 超家族成員無相同的直接 necrosome 偶聯。

nodes.label: Calpain-2
nodes.description: Calpain-2 (m-calpain; CAPN2 with CAPNS1) is a millimolar-Ca2+-dependent cytosolic cysteine protease that acts as the motility effector of the pro-survival Caspase-8 state. Src-family-phosphorylated Caspase-8 scaffolds FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K complexes at focal adhesions, where localized Calpain-2 cleaves talin, vinculin and FAK itself, accelerating adhesion disassembly/reassembly cycles that power mesenchymal migration. Adhesion turnover feeds PI3K/AKT and ERK signaling, creating a feed-forward migration–survival loop in colon cancer and glioblastoma; the same pY-Caspase-8 switch therefore makes Calpain-2 a downstream target of Src inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Calpain-2（m-calpain；CAPN2 搭配 CAPNS1）是毫莫耳 Ca2+ 依賴的胞質半胱胺酸蛋白酶，作為促存活型 Caspase-8 狀態的運動效應器。被 Src 家族磷酸化的 Caspase-8 在焦點黏附處支架化 FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K 複合體，局部化的 Calpain-2 切割 talin、vinculin 與 FAK 本身，加速黏附解體／重組循環以驅動間質細胞遷移。黏附周轉再回饋 PI3K/AKT 與 ERK 訊號，在大腸癌與膠質母細胞瘤中形成遷移—存活的正饋迴路；因此同一個 pY-Caspase-8 轉換使 Calpain-2 成為 Src 抑制的下游標的。

nodes.label: TFEB at Ser142
nodes.description: CDK4/6 phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142, driving CRM1-dependent nuclear export and cytoplasmic sequestration during cell-cycle progression. This modification aligns TFEB repression with the biosynthetic demands of dividing cells, when autophagy is downregulated. Pharmacologic CDK4/6 inhibitors relieve this constraint, permitting TFEB nuclear accumulation and enhancing lysosome biogenesis and autophagic flux. The axis thereby couples cell-cycle machinery to the metabolic state of the cell.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK4/6 在 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，驅動 CRM1 依賴的核輸出以及在細胞週期進展期間的細胞質隔離。此修飾將 TFEB 抑制與分裂細胞的生物合成需求對齊，此時自噬被下調。藥理 CDK4/6 抑制劑解除此約束，允許 TFEB 核累積並增強溶酶體生物發生與自噬流。該軸因而將細胞週期機制與細胞的代謝狀態耦合。

nodes.label: Early SASP
nodes.description: p21 supports an early secretory phenotype -- including factors such as CXCL14 and IGFBP3 -- that places stressed cells under immunosurveillance prior to full senescence. This early p21-associated secretome differs from the later NF-kB-dominated SASP, and it may help communicate cellular stress and recruit immune clearance. The relationship suggests p21 contributes to both arrest and the initial communicative state of stressed cells. It is more nuanced than simple arrest enforcement, giving moderate confidence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p21 支持早期分泌表型——包括如 CXCL14 與 IGFBP3 等因子——使受壓細胞在完全衰老前處於免疫監視下。此早期 p21 相關分泌組不同於後期 NF-κB 主導的 SASP，且可能有助溝通細胞壓力並招募免疫清除。此關係顯示 p21 同時貢獻停滯與受壓細胞的初始溝通狀態。它比簡單的停滯執行更細微，信度中等。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md

nodes.label: Nucleus Pulposus
nodes.description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

nodes.label: Thymidylate Synthase
nodes.description: Thymidylate synthase is the principal target of 5-fluorouracil: its active metabolite FdUMP forms a lethal ternary complex with the enzyme and folate, depleting thymidine pools, triggering DNA repair stress and apoptosis in dividing cells. Fenbendazole overcomes 5-FU-resistant colorectal cells by interfering with glycolysis rather than inhibiting thymidylate synthase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thymidylate synthase 是 5-Fluorouracil 的主要標的：其活性代謝物 FdUMP 與酵素及葉酸形成致死的三元複合體，耗竭胸腺嘧啶核苷池，在分裂細胞中引發 DNA 修復壓力與細胞凋亡。Fenbendazole 對抗 5-FU 抗藥性的結直腸癌細胞，是藉由干擾糖解作用而非抑制 thymidylate synthase。

nodes.label: glycated serum albumin
nodes.description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: serum AGE levels
nodes.description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Circulation
nodes.description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Intestinal Absorption
nodes.description: Orlistat, a lipase inhibitor, reduced serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal in 21 women with polycystic ovary disease compared with 15 women without PCOS, by decreasing AGE absorption. A six-month study evaluating the effect of calorie restriction and orlistat found serum AGE reductions in both PCOS and obese groups, independent of changes in body mass index. By interfering with lipid absorption, orlistat also reduces the absorption of fat-associated dietary AGEs, since foods rich in protein and fat have the highest AGE content. Orlistat therefore illustrates how modulating intestinal absorption can lower postprandial glycation load.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Orlistat 是一種脂解酶抑制劑（lipase inhibitor），在 21 名多囊性卵巢疾病女性與 15 名無 PCOS 女性相比，於高 AGE 餐後降低了血清 AGE，方式是減少 AGE 吸收。一項評估熱量限制與 orlistat 效果為期六個月的研究發現，PCOS 與肥胖組的血清 AGE 均下降，且獨立於身體質量指數的變化。透過干擾脂質吸收，orlistat 也減少與脂肪相關的飲食性 AGE 吸收，因為富含蛋白質與脂肪的食物 AGE 含量最高。因此，orlistat 說明了調節腸道吸收如何能降低餐後糖化負載。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: High dietary AGE intake
nodes.description: Sebekova and colleagues found that long-term consumption of advanced glycation end products in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. High long-term consumption of AGEs has also been associated with higher levels of fasting glucose, insulin, and serum AGEs, as well as increased AGE localization and RAGE staining in the ovarian tissue of rats. These results show that chronic dietary AGE excess can reproduce in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sebekova 及其同事發現，大鼠長期攝取晚期糖化終產物會導致蛋白尿呈劑量依賴性增加，隨時間可能誘發腎損傷。長期高量攝取 AGE 也與較高的空腹血糖、胰島素與血清 AGE 濃度，以及大鼠卵巢組織中 AGE 定位與 RAGE 染色增加有關。這些結果顯示，慢性飲食性 AGE 過量能在動物中重現老化與糖尿病中見到的部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食的毒性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Plasma AGEs
nodes.description: Uribarri and colleagues estimated dietary AGE intake from three-day food records in 90 healthy subjects using a database of the AGE content of foods and found a significant correlation between ingested AGEs and plasma levels; a subgroup exposed to dietary restriction of AGEs showed decreased plasma levels as well. Similar results were reported in patients with diabetes and renal failure. These findings support the view that the intake of dietary AGEs is an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and that reducing dietary AGE intake lowers circulating AGE concentrations even in healthy individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Uribarri 及其同事利用食物 AGE 含量資料庫，從 90 名健康受試者的三日飲食記錄估計飲食 AGE 攝取量，發現攝入 AGE 與血漿濃度之間有顯著相關；一組接受飲食 AGE 限制的亞組也顯示血漿濃度下降。糖尿病與腎衰竭患者中也報告了類似結果。這些發現支持飲食 AGE 攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且減少飲食 AGE 攝取可降低循環 AGE 濃度，即使在健康個體中亦然。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: End Stage Renal Disease
nodes.description: In End Stage Renal Disease the relationship with Advanced Glycation End Products runs both ways: elevated levels of AGEs such as CML predict renal function decline, while reduced renal clearance raises circulating AGE burden. The same tissue AGE accumulation that drives micro- and macrovascular damage in diabetes is therefore also linked to renal disease progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 End Stage Renal Disease 中，與 Advanced Glycation End Products 的關係是雙向的：CML 等 AGE 濃度升高可預測腎功能衰退，而腎臟清除能力下降又會提高循環中的 AGE 負荷。因此，在糖尿病中驅動微血管與大血管損傷的組織 AGE 累積，同樣也與腎病進展相關。

nodes.label: AGO2
nodes.description: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGO2（Argonaute 2）是 RISC 的催化核心，執行 microRNA 引導的基因沉默。在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力；SIRT3 缺失打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Metabolism
nodes.description: miR-378 modulates mitochondrial energy metabolism through targets including ERRgamma (ESRRG), GABPA, and CRAT/MED13. It counterbalances PGC-1beta activity and is co-transcribed with its host gene PPARGC1B, tying its expression to mitochondrial biogenesis programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: miR-378 透過包括 ERRgamma（ESRRG）、GABPA 和 CRAT/MED13 在內的靶標調節粒線體能量代謝。它平衡 PGC-1beta 的活性，並與宿主基因 PPARGC1B 共同轉錄，將其表現與粒線體生合成程式連結起來。

nodes.label: PGC-1beta
nodes.description: miR-378a is encoded within the first intron of the PPARGC1B gene (PGC-1beta) on chromosome 5q32. Because it sits inside the metabolic master regulator locus, its dysregulation couples mitochondrial metabolic decline with the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: miR-378a 編碼在染色體 5q32 的 PPARGC1B 基因（PGC-1beta）第一個內含子中。由於它位於代謝主調控基因座內，其失調將粒線體代謝衰退與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸耦合起來。

nodes.label: Exportin-5
nodes.description: Exportin-5 is a RanGTP-dependent nuclear export receptor that transports precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) hairpins from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. There the pre-miRNA is matured by Dicer and loaded onto Argonaute in the RISC.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Exportin-5 是 RanGTP 依賴的核輸出受體，將 microRNA 前驅物（pre-miRNA）髮夾從細胞核運送至細胞質。在那裡 pre-miRNA 由 Dicer 成熟並裝載到 RISC 中的 Argonaute。

nodes.label: Ribonuclease III
nodes.description: Ribonuclease III (RNase III) is a family of enzymes that specifically cleave double-stranded RNA, including Drosha and Dicer that initiate and mature microRNA biogenesis. These RNase III enzymes process microRNA precursors into functional guides.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核糖核酸酶 III（RNase III）是特異性剪切雙股 RNA 的酶家族，包括起始與成熟 microRNA 生合成的 Drosha 與 Dicer。這些 RNase III 酶將 microRNA 前驅物加工為功能性引導。

nodes.label: RISC
nodes.description: The RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC) is the effector machinery of small-RNA silencing, centered on an Argonaute protein loaded with a guide microRNA or siRNA. RISC directs sequence-specific translational repression or cleavage of target mRNAs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA 誘導靜默複合體（RISC）是小 RNA 靜默的效應機制，以裝載引導 microRNA 或 siRNA 的 Argonaute 蛋白為中心。RISC 對目標 mRNA 進行序列特異的轉譯抑制或剪切。

nodes.label: Double-stranded RNA-binding domain
nodes.description: The double-stranded RNA-binding domain (dsRBD) binds double-stranded RNA in a structure-specific manner and positions RNA substrates for processing enzymes. DGCR8 and Dicer use tandem dsRBDs to recognize and process microRNA precursors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雙股 RNA 結合結構域（dsRBD）以結構特異方式結合雙股 RNA，並將 RNA 受質定位給加工酶。DGCR8 與 Dicer 利用串聯 dsRBD 來辨識與加工 microRNA 前驅物。

nodes.label: Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
nodes.description: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is a chronic lung disease of premature infants in which dysregulated mitochondrial fission and fusion contribute to lung cell injury. Impaired mitochondrial dynamics and mitophagy are implicated in the arrested alveolar and vascular development of BPD.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 支氣管肺發育不良（BPD）是早產兒的慢性肺病，其中失調的粒線體分裂與融合造成肺細胞損傷。粒線體動態與 mitophagy 受損與 BPD 中肺泡與血管發育停滯有關。

nodes.label: Caspase-2 Ser135
nodes.description: 14-3-3-zeta binds caspase-2 in a phosphorylation-dependent manner, protecting Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta disengages this shield, allowing dephosphorylation and activation of caspase-2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 以依賴磷酸化的方式結合 caspase-2，保護 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）免受去磷酸化。14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化會解除此保護盾，允許去磷酸化和 caspase-2 活化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

nodes.label: Acetylated 14-3-3
nodes.description: Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta triggers its dissociation from the initiator caspase-2, allowing caspase-2 activation. In contrast, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of 14-3-3-zeta at K49 maintains its binding and keeps caspase-2 suppressed, so 14-3-3-zeta acetylation state controls apoptotic sensitivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化觸發其與起始型 caspase-2 的解離，允許 caspase-2 活化。相反，SIRT1 在 K49 介導的 14-3-3ζ 去乙醯化維持其結合並使 caspase-2 保持受抑制，因此 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化狀態控制凋亡敏感性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

nodes.label: Glial cells
nodes.description: Glial cells and Neuroinflammation are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Glial cells and Neuroinflammation may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glial cells 和 Neuroinflammation 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Glial cells 和 Neuroinflammation 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Cytosolic DNA crosstalk
nodes.description: Cytosolic mtDNA, cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and LINE-1 cDNA crosstalk to amplify cGAS-STING signaling in senescence; removing any single DNA source often suppresses SASP, and blocking the mitochondrial source preserves acute immune responses better than direct cGAS or STING blockade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胞質 mtDNA、細胞質染色質片段與 LINE-1 cDNA 交互作用以放大衰老中的 cGAS-STING 訊號；去除任一 DNA 來源常可抑制 SASP，而阻斷粒線體來源比直接抑制 cGAS 或 STING 更能保留急性免疫反應。

nodes.label: Cerebrospinal Fluid
nodes.description: Cerebrospinal Fluid, the clear fluid bathing the CNS ventricles and subarachnoid space, acts as a conduit for cGAS-STING activation: both cGAMP, the second messenger synthesized by cGAS, and downstream inflammatory cytokines partition into CSF, letting activation signals spread beyond the local site of nucleic acid sensing. CSF cGAMP and cytokine levels are therefore candidate biomarkers of pathway activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cerebrospinal Fluid（腦脊髓液）是浸潤 CNS 腦室與蛛網膜下腔的清澈液體，作為 cGAS-STING Pathway 活化的傳導管道：cGAS 合成的第二訊使 cGAMP 與下游發炎性細胞激素皆可分配進入 CSF，使活化訊號得以超越核酸感測的局部位置擴散。因此 CSF 中的 cGAMP 與細胞激素濃度可作為該路徑活化的候選生物標記。

nodes.label: Protein Degradation
nodes.description: A ubiquitin ligase (E3) recognizes a specific protein substrate and catalyzes transfer of ubiquitin from an E2 enzyme, tagging proteins for proteasomal degradation, altered localization, or non-proteolytic signaling. With over 600 E3 ligases in humans, the E3 step confers substrate specificity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 泛素連接酶（E3）識別特定蛋白質受質，並催化泛素從 E2 酶轉移，將蛋白質標記以進行蛋白酶體降解、改變定位或非蛋白水解訊號。人類有超過 600 種 E3 連接酶，E3 步驟賦予受質特異性。

nodes.label: ARF
nodes.description: ARF binds HUWE1, stabilizing p53 against ubiquitination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARF 結合 HUWE1，使 p53 免於泛素化而穩定。

nodes.label: Chromosomal Instability
nodes.description: Persistent APC/C defects drive continuous chromosomal instability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 持續的 APC/C 缺陷驅動連續的染色體不穩定。

nodes.label: Spindle Assembly Checkpoint
nodes.description: The APC/C is the ultimate effector restrained by the spindle assembly checkpoint via Mad2/BubR1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APC/C 是經 Mad2/BubR1 受紡錘體組裝檢查點約束的最終效應器。

nodes.label: 26S Proteasome
nodes.description: Ubiquitinated APC/C substrates are degraded by the 26S proteasome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 泛素化的 APC/C 受質被 26S 蛋白酶體降解。

nodes.label: Intracellular and extracellular signals
nodes.description: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway integrates a wide array of intracellular and extracellular cues—including growth factors, insulin, amino acids, oxygen, and energy status—to coordinate cell growth, metabolism, proliferation, and survival. Through its two complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, it translates these inputs into decisions about biosynthesis versus catabolism, notably by inhibiting autophagy when resources are abundant. This central integrator role makes mTOR a nodal control point for physiology and a target for cancer, aging, and metabolic disease. Its dysregulation is implicated in nearly every major chronic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素機械性標靶（mTOR）途徑整合了廣泛的細胞內與細胞外線索——包括生長因子、胰島素、胺基酸、氧氣和能量狀態——以協調細胞生長、代謝、增殖與存活。透過其兩個複合物 mTORC1 和 mTORC2，它將這些輸入轉化為關於生物合成與分解代謝的決策，特別是在資源充裕時抑制自噬。這種核心整合者角色使 mTOR 成為生理學的節點控制點，以及癌症、老化和代謝疾病的標靶。其失調與幾乎每一種主要慢性疾病都有關聯。

nodes.label: mTOR, Rictor, mSIN1, Protor-1, mLST8, Deptor
nodes.description: mTOR complex 2 (mTORC2) comprises six core proteins: mTOR, Rictor (its defining scaffold), mSIN1 (required for mTORC2 integrity and Akt phosphorylation), Protor-1, mLST8, and the negative regulator Deptor. mTORC2 is best known for phosphorylating and activating Akt at Ser473 and for regulating cytoskeletal organization and cell survival. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2 is not acutely rapamycin-sensitive and is not directly recruited to lysosomes by Rag GTPases. Its distinct composition underlies its separate physiological roles in metabolism and actin dynamics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 2（mTORC2）包含六個核心蛋白：mTOR、Rictor（其定義性支架）、mSIN1（mTORC2 完整性與 Akt 磷酸化所需）、Protor-1、mLST8，以及負向調節者 Deptor。mTORC2 最為人所知的是在 Ser473 磷酸化並活化 Akt，以及調節細胞骨架組織和細胞存活。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 不會被雷帕黴素急性抑制，也不會被 Rag GTPases 直接招募至溶酶體。其獨特組成奠定了其在代謝和肌動蛋白動力學中各自獨立的生理角色。
nodes.norm_label: mtor, rictor, msin1, protor-1, mlst8, deptor

nodes.label: Akt at Ser473
nodes.description: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

nodes.label: Cytoskeletal organization
nodes.description: mTORC2 regulates actin cytoskeleton organization and cell migration through phosphorylation of PKCα and via effects on paxillin, RhoA, and Rac1 signaling. These outputs control cell polarity, stress-fiber formation, and the ability of cells to remodel their architecture during growth and movement. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2's roles are more closely tied to spatial organization and survival than to bulk nutrient sensing. Dysregulation of mTORC2-dependent cytoskeletal control contributes to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC2 透過磷酸化 PKCα 以及經由對 paxillin、RhoA 和 Rac1 信號的效應，調節肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織和細胞遷移。這些輸出控制了細胞極性、應力纖維形成，以及細胞在生長和移動期間重塑其架構的能力。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 的角色更密切地與空間組織和存活相關，而非大規模的營養感知。mTORC2 依賴的細胞骨架控制失調促成癌細胞侵襲和轉移。

nodes.label: Pneumonitis
nodes.description: A rare side effect of rapamycin is noninfectious interstitial pneumonitis, which is not reliably reversible with continued dosing and mandates stopping therapy. It is listed among the serious adverse events of mTOR inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 的罕見副作用是非感染性間質性肺炎，繼續給藥未必可逆，必須停藥。它被列為 mTOR 抑制劑的嚴重不良事件之一。

nodes.label: ACE Inhibitors
nodes.description: ACE inhibitors are proposed as components of a combined anti-aging formulation alongside rapamycin, metformin, aspirin, and PDE5 inhibitors. In this framework agents that address multiple age-related diseases are combined with mTOR inhibition so that they complement one another and mitigate respective side effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ACE 抑制劑被提出作為與 rapamycin、metformin、aspirin 及 PDE5 抑制劑並用的聯合抗衰老配方組成。在此框架下，針對多種老化相關疾病的藥物與 mTOR 抑制合併使用，以互補並減輕各自的副作用。

nodes.label: Anemia
nodes.description: Anemia is one of the hematological cytopenias that can accompany chronic mTOR inhibitor therapy. Rapamycin and rapalogs reduce blood cell counts by inhibiting cell proliferation, with mild reversible anemia among the common hematological side effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 貧血是慢性 mTOR 抑制劑治療可能伴隨的血液細胞減少症之一。Rapamycin 與 rapalog 透過抑制細胞增殖降低血球數量，輕度可逆的貧血是常見的血液學副作用之一。

nodes.label: Leukopenia
nodes.description: Leukopenia is a decrease in circulating white blood cells and one of the hematological cytopenias linked to chronic mTOR inhibitor use. Chronic high-dose rapamycin lowers blood cell counts, and mild reversible leukopenia is a common side effect.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 白血球減少症是循環白血球減少，是與慢性 mTOR 抑制劑使用相關的血液細胞減少症之一。慢性高劑量 rapamycin 降低血球數量，輕度可逆的白血球減少是常見副作用。

nodes.label: PDE5 Inhibitors
nodes.description: PDE5 inhibitors block phosphodiesterase type 5 and are cited as conventional agents that prevent or treat more than one disease, qualifying as somewhat anti-aging drugs. They are proposed components of a combined anti-aging formulation with rapamycin, metformin, aspirin, and ACE inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PDE5 抑制劑阻斷第五型磷酸二酯酶，被引用為可預防或治療多種疾病的傳統藥物，具備某種抗衰老藥物資格。它們被提出作為與 rapamycin、metformin、aspirin 及 ACE 抑制劑並用的聯合抗衰老配方成分。

nodes.label: Fatty acid
nodes.description: Excess fatty acids drive cellular dysfunction termed lipotoxicity. Causation covers the overload pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過量脂肪酸驅動稱為脂毒性的細胞功能障礙。因果涵蓋超載病理。

nodes.label: Protor-1
nodes.description: Protor-1 (PRR5) is a component of mTORC2 that binds mSIN1 and stabilizes the complex, and it interacts with Rictor. Within mTORC2, Protor-1 regulates substrate specificity toward SGK1 and PKC, though its precise physiological function remains to be fully elucidated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Protor-1（PRR5）是 mTORC2 的組成成分，會結合 mSIN1 並穩定該複合體，且與 Rictor 互作。在 mTORC2 中，Protor-1 調控其對 SGK1 與 PKC 的受質專一性，但其確切生理功能尚未完全釐清。

nodes.label: RhoA
nodes.description: mTORC2 controls the actin cytoskeleton by promoting PKCα phosphorylation, phosphorylation and relocalization of paxillin to focal adhesions, and the GTP loading of RhoA (and Rac1) — indicating that RhoA is a downstream effector of mTORC2 signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC2 藉由促進 PKCα 磷酸化、paxillin 的磷酸化並轉位至 focal adhesion，以及 RhoA（與 Rac1）的 GTP 裝載來控制 actin cytoskeleton —— 顯示 RhoA 是 mTORC2 訊號的下游效應因子。

nodes.label: TRIAD
nodes.description: TRIAD (Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs) is a parallel-group, double-masked, randomized, placebo-controlled, multicenter clinical trial testing whether intermittent low-dose Rapamycin extends lifespan and healthspan in healthy middle-aged companion dogs. It is the first rigorous pharmacologic geroscience trial with lifespan endpoints outside the laboratory, in any species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRIAD (Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs) 是一項平行對照、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照、多中心的臨床試驗，測試間歇性低劑量 Rapamycin 是否能延長健康中年伴侶犬的壽命與健康壽齡。它是第一個在實驗室之外、以任何物種進行且具壽命終點的嚴謹藥理 geroscience 試驗。

nodes.label: cGMP
nodes.description: Atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) binds natriuretic peptide receptor-A, a membrane guanylyl cyclase, raising intracellular cGMP to drive natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation. cGMP is the second messenger mediating ANP's counter-regulatory cardiovascular actions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 心房利鈉肽（ANP）結合利鈉肽受體-A（一種膜鳥苷酸環化酶），提高細胞內 cGMP 以驅動利鈉、利尿與血管舒張。cGMP 是介導 ANP 反向調節心血管作用的第二信使。

nodes.label: BNP
nodes.description: B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) is conceptually related to atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP), with which it shares structure and function as cardiac natriuretic peptide hormones. Both counter-regulate the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and are cardiovascular biomarkers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B 型利鈉肽（BNP）與心房利鈉肽（ANP）在概念上相關，兩者作為心臟利鈉肽激素，共享結構與功能。兩者皆反向調節腎素-血管緊張素-醛固酮系統，並作為心血管生物標記。

nodes.label: Troponin
nodes.description: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

nodes.label: Alpha-catenin
nodes.description: Alpha-catenin mechanosensitively links the cadherin complex to actin filaments. Protein-level orphan edge, documented mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-catenin 以機械敏感方式將 cadherin 複合體連結到肌動蛋白絲。蛋白層級孤兒邊，機制有記載。

nodes.label: Cofilin
nodes.description: Cofilin severs filaments to promote depolymerization and turnover. Disruption is the remodeling input.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cofilin 切斷絲以促進去聚合與更新。破壞是重塑輸入。

nodes.label: L-lactate
nodes.description: L-lactate is the physiological enantiomer of lactate and is produced predominantly by glycolysis and anaerobic metabolism. Once dismissed as a mere waste product, it is now recognized as a signaling metabolite, an energy substrate shuttled between cells via the Cori cycle and monocarboxylate transporters, and an epigenetic modulator through histone lactylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: L-lactate 是 lactate 的生理性對映異構體，主要由 glycolysis 與無氧代謝產生。它過去被視為單純的廢物，如今則被認為是訊號代謝物、經由 Cori cycle 與單羧酸運輸蛋白在細胞間運送的能量底物，以及透過組蛋白 lactylation 作用的表觀遺傳調節者。

nodes.label: Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate
nodes.description: Glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate is oxidized and phosphorylated to 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate by GAPDH, consuming NAD+ to produce NADH. This is the primary glycolytic step generating reducing equivalents and couples carbon oxidation to cytosolic NAD+ consumption, so a falling NAD+/NADH ratio constrains glycolytic flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate 由 GAPDH 氧化並磷酸化為 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate，同時消耗 NAD+ 產生 NADH。這是 glycolysis 中產生還原等價物的主要步驟，將碳氧化與細胞質 NAD+ 消耗耦合，因此 NAD+/NADH 比值下降會限制 glycolysis 通量。

nodes.label: NAD+ Depletion
nodes.description: NAD+ depletion was observed during the aging process in multiple animals, including humans, and is considered the major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD). Neurodegenerative disorders such as AD are associated with DNA damage and oxidative stress, which accumulate with age and lead to impaired mitochondrial function, while excitotoxicity-driven axonal degeneration causes strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. When administered in AD mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) displays beneficial effects on both oxidative stress and DNA repair by increasing NAD+ levels, and it improves pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在多種動物（包括人類）的老化過程中觀察到 NAD+ 耗竭，且被視為阿茲海默症（AD）的主要風險因子。諸如 AD 之類的神經退化性疾病與 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力相關，這些隨年齡累積並導致粒線體功能受損，而興奮毒性驅動的軸突退化則在神經元中造成強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。在 AD 小鼠模型中給予 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）時，NR 透過提升 NAD+ 水平對氧化壓力與 DNA 修復均展現有益效果，並改善 pTau、amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: MAP2
nodes.description: MAP2 (microtubule-associated protein 2) is a high-molecular-weight protein abundant in neuronal dendrites that binds and stabilizes microtubules. MAP2 immunostaining is widely used as a dendritic marker to assess neuronal integrity and preservation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MAP2（微管相關蛋白 2）是豐富存在於神經元樹突的高分子量蛋白，結合並穩定微管。MAP2 免疫染色被廣泛用作樹突標記，以評估神經元完整性與保存。

nodes.label: Zinc Supplementation
nodes.description: Dietary zinc (10 ppm) worsened spatial memory in CRND8/E4 late-onset AD mice carrying ApoE epsilon4, increasing soluble and insoluble Abeta via altered metal-amyloid interactions and zinc transporter expression. This genotype-dependent harm contrasts with zinc's canonical antioxidant role in SOD and membrane stabilization. It shows antioxidant efficacy depends on ApoE genotype, baseline redox status, and disease biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 飲食鋅 (10 ppm) 在攜帶 ApoE epsilon4 的 CRND8/E4 晚發型 AD 小鼠中惡化空間記憶，經由改變的金屬-類澱粉交互作用與鋅轉運體表現增加可溶性與不可溶性 Abeta。此基因型依賴性傷害與鋅在 SOD 與膜穩定中的典型抗氧化角色形成對比。顯示抗氧化療效取決於 ApoE 基因型、基礎氧化還原狀態與疾病生物學。

nodes.label: Redox-Active Metals
nodes.description: Amyloid-beta binds redox-active metals (Cu2+ and Fe3+), forming complexes that generate superoxide and H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal site. This positions Abeta as a localized source of ROS in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal binding to radical generation. A caveat is that metal-free Abeta aggregation also drives pathology, so redox activity is one of several toxic functions. Abeta is proposed to act as a redox-active metal chaperone, and metal chelators have been tested as candidate therapies to limit this pro-oxidant activity.
