nodes.description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白與 redox-active metals（Cu2+ 和 Fe3+）結合，形成複合物，透過金屬位點上的類芬頓化學反應生成超氧化物和 H2O2。這使得 Abeta 成為阿茲海默症大腦中 ROS 的局部來源。方向性是金属与自由基生成的结合。需要注意的是，不含金屬的 Abeta 聚集也會引發病理學，因此氧化還原活性是多種毒性功能之一。 Abeta 被提议充当氧化还原活性金属伴侣，金属螯合剂已作为限制这种促氧化活性的候选疗法进行了测试。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Complex IV
nodes.description: Amyloid-beta impairs mitochondrial Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) after accumulating in mitochondria, depressing respiration and increasing electron leak. This links protein misfolding to bioenergetic failure and ROS. The directionality is Abeta mitochondrial localization to respiratory inhibition. A caveat is that Complex IV inhibition can be both a cause and consequence of oxidative damage in a feed-forward loop. The resulting energetic deficit may precede overt neurodegeneration and contributes to synaptic failure in Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白在 mitochondria 中累積後會損害 mitochondrial Complex IV（細胞色素 C 氧化酶），抑制呼吸並增加電子洩漏。這將蛋白質錯誤折疊與生物能量衰竭和 ROS 聯繫起來。方向性是Abeta mitochondria1定位於呼吸抑制。需要注意的是，複合物 IV 抑制既可能是前饋迴路中氧化損傷的原因，也可能是其結果。由此產生的能量缺乏可能先於明顯的 neurodegeneration 發生，並導致阿茲海默症的突觸衰竭。

nodes.label: Lecanemab
nodes.description: Lecanemab (Leqembi) is an FDA-approved anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid; it clears parenchymal Aβ protofibrils and slows cognitive decline by roughly 25–35% while carrying ARIA (edema/microhemorrhage) risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lecanemab（Leqembi）是獲 FDA 核准的抗類澱粉單株抗體，用於經確證類澱粉的早期症狀性阿茲海默症；它清除實質 Aβ 原纖維並減緩認知衰退約 25–35%，但帶有 ARIA（水腫／微出血）風險。

nodes.label: LDL receptor
nodes.description: Apolipoprotein B is the primary apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and LDL particles and serves as the ligand for the LDL receptor, making it essential for lipoprotein assembly and metabolism. LDL oxidation alters the apoB protein moiety through fragmentation and cross-linking of reactive aldehydes and oxysterols; resveratrol reduces this radical-induced alteration and chelates copper bound to apoB. Elevated apoB-containing lipoproteins drive plaque formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein B 是乳糜微粒與 LDL 顆粒的主要載脂蛋白，並作為 LDL receptor 的配體，因此對脂蛋白組裝與代謝至關重要。LDL 氧化會透過活性醛與氧化膽固醇的斷裂與交聯改變 apoB 蛋白部分；resveratrol 可減少此自由基誘發的變化並螯合結合於 apoB 的銅。含 apoB 的脂蛋白濃度升高會驅動斑塊形成。

nodes.label: BACE1
nodes.description: BACE1, the beta-secretase that initiates amyloidogenic processing of APP, is an aspartyl protease optimally active at acidic pH (~4.5-5.5), which is why amyloidogenic processing occurs predominantly in late endosomes and lysosomes. Cleavage at the Asp671 site releases sAPPβ and generates CTFβ, the substrate for Gamma-Secretase. The Swedish KM670/671NL familial mutation lies adjacent to this site and increases beta-secretase cleavage 6- to 8-fold, elevating total Aβ production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BACE1 是啟動 APP 類澱粉樣處理的 beta-secretase，屬於天門冬胺酸蛋白酶，在酸性 pH（約 4.5-5.5）下活性最佳，因此類澱粉樣處理主要發生於晚內體與溶酶體。在 Asp671 位點切割會釋出 sAPPβ 並產生 CTFβ，作為 Gamma-Secretase 的受質。家族性瑞典突變 KM670/671NL 正好位於此位點附近，使 beta-secretase 切割增加 6 至 8 倍，抬高總 Aβ 生成量。

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB
nodes.description: By deacetylating NF-κB, SIRT1 reduces transcription of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, dampening the inflammatory transcriptome. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB leads to lower cytokine output. This is mechanistically important in atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration, and metabolic inflammation, where sustained cytokine signaling drives tissue damage. Resveratrol leverages this axis to curb chronic low-grade inflammation, and SIRT6, SIRT2, and SIRT7 also restrain NF-κB through distinct mechanisms, making suppression of NF-κB-dependent cytokine production one of the most consistent anti-inflammatory actions across the sirtuin family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 NF-κB，SIRT1 降低 TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 的轉錄，抑制發炎轉錄組。在方向性上，SIRT1 對 NF-κB 的去乙醯化導致較低的細胞因子輸出。這在動脈粥樣硬化、神經退行性疾病和代謝性發炎中具有機制重要性，在這些疾病中持續的細胞因子信號驅動組織損傷。白藜蘆醇利用此軸來抑制慢性低度發炎，SIRT6、SIRT2 和 SIRT7 也通過不同機制限制 NF-κB，使抑制 NF-κB 依賴性細胞因子產生成為 sirtuin 家族中最一致的抗發炎作用之一。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Phosphatase
nodes.description: Phosphatases remove phosphate groups, reversing kinase action.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸酶移除磷酸基團，逆轉激酶作用。

nodes.label: SASP Enhancers
nodes.description: H3K27ac marks senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression, identifying the enhancer landscape licensed during the senescent response. These acetylated, transcriptionally active enhancers recruit BRD4 and transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kB to SASP loci, enabling robust and sustained secretome transcription. The mark thus charts the chromatin basis of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and distinguishes active SASP enhancers from repressed loci. Targeting these enhancers with BET inhibitors such as JQ1 suppresses SASP expression, revealing the enhancer landscape as a therapeutic vulnerability in senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3K27ac 標記驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子，辨識衰老反應中許可的增強子景觀。這些乙醯化、轉錄活化的增強子招募 BRD4 與 AP-1、NF-κB 等轉錄因子至 SASP 基因座，促成強健且持續的分泌組轉錄。此標記因此描繪衰老相關分泌表型的染色質基礎，並區分活化的 SASP 增強子與受抑制基因座。以 BET 抑制劑如 JQ1 標靶這些增強子抑制 SASP 表現，揭示增強子景觀作為衰老中治療脆弱性。

nodes.label: MEF2D
nodes.description: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

nodes.label: Glycolic acid
nodes.description: PARK7 (encoding DJ-1) acts as a Glutathione-independent glyoxalase inside cells, detoxifying the reactive precursor Glyoxal into Glycolic acid. Because this reaction does not consume GSH, it remains functional under Oxidative Stress when GSH is depleted — making DJ-1 a last line of defense against dicarbonyl stress and preventing Glyoxal from forming irreversible Advanced Glycation End Products. DJ-1 also converts Methylglyoxal to L-lactate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARK7（編碼 DJ-1）在細胞內作為不依賴 Glutathione 的 glyoxalase 作用，將活性前驅物 Glyoxal 解毒轉為 Glycolic acid。由於此反應不消耗 GSH，因此在 GSH 被耗竭的 Oxidative Stress 下仍可運作，使 DJ-1 成為對抗 dicarbonyl stress 的最後一道防線，並避免 Glyoxal 形成不可逆的 Advanced Glycation End Products。DJ-1 也將 Methylglyoxal 轉為 L-lactate。

nodes.label: protein function
nodes.description: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids that leads to loss of protein function and impaired elasticity of tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons. The process is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, implicating it in diabetic complications and aging. Intracellular AGE modification of signaling molecules can impair cellular functions and gene expression, and glycation of antioxidant enzymes such as catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase reduces their activity, further increasing cellular oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glycation 是 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應，會導致蛋白質功能喪失以及 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等組織彈性受損。此過程在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，使其涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。細胞內 signaling molecules 的 intracellular AGE modification 會損害細胞功能與 gene expression，而 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 等 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 會降低其活性，進一步增加細胞 oxidative stress。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Collagen IV
nodes.description: Collagen IV forms the network scaffold of basal lamina sheets. Containment records the scaffold.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Collagen IV 形成基底膜片的網絡支架。包含記錄支架。

nodes.label: Receptor Tyrosine Kinase
nodes.description: c-Met is definitionally a receptor tyrosine kinase. Classification is textbook.
nodes.description_zh_TW: c-Met 定義上是受體酪胺酸激酶。歸類為教科書等級。

nodes.label: Complex I and Complex IV
nodes.description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

nodes.label: VCAM-1/VLA-4 Interaction
nodes.description: Natalizumab (Tysabri) blocks the VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction by antagonizing alpha4 integrin, reducing T-cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier in multiple sclerosis. This dampens CNS inflammation but leaves patients susceptible to progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. The directionality is integrin blockade to reduced leukocyte entry. A caveat is that broad alpha4 inhibition also affects gut homing, causing PML and other risks that limit use. The drug's efficacy in MS validates the VCAM-1/VLA-4 pathway as a driver of neuroinflammation, though its safety profile demands careful monitoring.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Natalizumab (Tysabri) 透過拮抗 α4 整合素來阻斷 VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction，從而減少 ros 中 multiple sclerosis 中血腦障壁的 T 細胞運輸。這可以抑制中樞神經系統炎症，但使患者容易患上進行性多灶性白質腦病變。方向性是整合素阻斷以減少白血球進入。需要注意的是，廣泛的 alpha4 抑制也會影響腸道歸巢，導致 PML 和其他限制使用的風險。該藥物對多發性硬化症的療效證實了 VCAM-1/VLA-4 路徑作為神經發炎的驅動因素，但其安全性需要仔細監測。

nodes.label: Premature cellular senescence
nodes.description: PML-IV overexpression is sufficient to induce p53-dependent premature senescence, and loss of PML accelerates tumorigenesis, establishing PML as a tumor suppressor. Directionally, PML sits upstream of senescence. This process engages SIRT1 and p53 at PML nuclear bodies, and it contextualizes SIRT1's role in proliferation arrest. By activating p53-dependent senescence, PML restricts uncontrolled proliferation and prevents tumor formation. The PML-SIRT1-p53 axis illustrates how a nuclear body can coordinate the decision between senescence, apoptosis, and proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PML-IV 過度表達足以誘導 p53 依賴性過早衰老，而 PML 的缺失加速腫瘤發生，確立 PML 為腫瘤抑制因子。在方向性上，PML 位於衰老的上游。此過程在 PML 核體中涉及 SIRT1 和 p53，並將 SIRT1 在增殖停滯中的角色置於背景中。透過活化 p53 依賴性衰老，PML 限制不受控制的增殖並防止腫瘤形成。PML-SIRT1-p53 軸線說明了核體如何協調衰老、凋亡和增殖之間的決定。

nodes.label: Topoisomerase II
nodes.description: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

nodes.label: Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
nodes.description: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

nodes.label: Clustered DNA Damage
nodes.description: Ionizing radiation causes clustered DNA damage, defined as two or more lesions within one or two helical turns, a signature pattern that overwhelms repair and drives lethal or mutagenic breaks. This clustering distinguishes radiation from many chemical genotoxins. The directionality is radiation to locally concentrated lesions. A caveat is that clustering severity depends on radiation quality (LET) and oxygen enhancement, so not all exposures produce identical patterns. Clustered lesions are a hallmark of high-LET radiation and are repaired inefficiently, increasing the probability of mutation and cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 導致 clustered DNA damage，定義為一兩個螺旋圈內的兩個或多個病變，這是一種壓倒修復並導致致命或誘變斷裂的特徵模式。这种聚类将辐射与许多化学基因毒素区分开来。方向性是局部集中病灶的輻射。需要注意的是，聚集的严重程度取决于辐射质量 (LET) 和氧气增强，因此并非所有暴露都会产生相同的模式。聚集性病变是高 LET 辐射的一个标志，修复效率低下，增加了突变和细胞死亡的可能性。

nodes.label: Network Motif
nodes.description: The study screened 5346 possible three-node network topologies of a coarse-grained signaling cascade model using a high-throughput computational approach, with 5000 parameter sets and 30 inhibitor concentrations per topology. More than 500 topologies show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average, with the highest fraction of hormetic parameter sets in a topology composed of four repressing interactions. The probability of hormesis increases as the network becomes more complex, indicating it depends on the density and complexity of the network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 該研究以高通量計算方法篩檢了粗略顆粒化訊息傳導級聯模型的 5346 種可能三節點網路拓撲，每種拓撲使用 5000 組參數與 30 種抑制劑濃度。超過 500 種拓撲展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更受青睞，其中由四條抑制性交互作用組成的拓撲擁有最高比例的荷爾米希參數組。荷爾米希的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升，顯示其取決於網路的密度與複雜度。

nodes.label: Adenosine-binding site with SIRT2
nodes.description: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Environmental Oxygen Threshold
nodes.description: A species- and tissue-dependent oxygen concentration threshold determines whether POS is triggered; severe hypoxia induces GCL and GPX in Neohelice granulata while milder exposures do not. This threshold behavior parallels hormetic dose-response requirements.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 是否觸發 Preparation for Oxidative Stress 取決於物種與組織特異的氧氣濃度閾值；嚴重缺氧可在 Neohelice granulata 中誘導 GCL 與 GPX，而較輕微的暴露則無此效應。這種閾值行為與 hormesis 的劑量反應要求相呼應。

nodes.label: Retinal Cell Viability
nodes.description: At 10 uM, Brosimine B raised mixed chicken-embryo retinal cell viability to 145.0% of control after 24 h in normoxia. Neither 1 uM nor 5 uM produced a significant increase. The effect defines the stimulatory peak of its hormetic window.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 10 uM 的 Brosimine B 在常氧下經 24 小時將混合雞胚視網膜細胞存活率提升至對照組的 145.0%。1 uM 與 5 uM 均無顯著增加。此效應界定了其 hormetic window 的刺激峰值。

nodes.label: Antioxidant Capacity
nodes.description: At 25 mM NaCl, total antioxidant activity rose 38.1%, DPPH-scavenging 6.0%, total phenols 8.8%, ascorbic acid 37.5%, and carotenoids 11.5% in sunflower microgreens. Moderate and severe salt levels had opposite (suppressive) effects. Salt eustress thus functions as a cost-effective elicitor of antioxidant quality.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 25 mM NaCl 使向日葵苗菜總抗氧化活性上升 38.1%、DPPH 清除率 6.0%、總酚 8.8%、抗壞血酸 37.5%、類胡蘿蔔素 11.5%。中重度鹽濃度則有相反（抑制）效應。因此鹽 eustress 可作為提升抗氧化品質的簡便低成本誘導手段。

nodes.label: Lipid Peroxidation Products
nodes.description: Beyond oxygen-derived reactive species, aldehyde products of lipid peroxidation are proposed as primary mediators of the hormetic POS signal. They help link mild macromolecular oxidation during hypoxia to upregulation of redox defenses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了氧衍生自由基之外，脂質過氧化的醛類產物被認為是 hormesis 型 POS 訊號的主要媒介。它們將缺氧期間的輕度大分子氧化與氧化還原防禦的上調連結起來。

nodes.label: Brosimum acutifolium
nodes.description: Brosimine B (4,7-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan) was isolated from ethanolic bark extract of Brosimum acutifolium (Murure, Moraceae) collected in Para, Brazil. The species bark is traditionally used for analgesic and anti-inflammatory purposes. This botanical origin links Brosimine B to the antioxidant-rich Moraceae family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brosimine B（4,7-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan）分離自巴西 Para 地區 Brosimum acutifolium（Murure，桑科）樹皮乙醇萃取物。該樹種樹皮傳統上用於鎮痛與抗發炎。此植物來源將 Brosimine B 連結至富含抗氧化物的 Moraceae 家族。

nodes.label: Cytotoxicity
nodes.description: Concentrations above 10 uM (25, 50, and 100 uM) drastically reduced retinal cell viability, demonstrating the descending toxic limb of the hormetic curve. This toxicity threshold mirrors related Moraceae compounds such as moracin P and mulberrofuran Q. It establishes a narrow therapeutic window for Brosimine B.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高於 10 uM 的濃度（25、50、100 uM）大幅降低視網膜細胞存活率，呈現 hormetic 曲線的下降毒性支。此毒性閾值與 Moraceae 家族相關化合物如 moracin P 和 mulberrofuran Q 相似。這確立了 Brosimine B 狹窄的治療窗。

nodes.label: Nutritional Quality
nodes.description: Eustress at 25 mM NaCl increased total carbohydrates by 27.2%, total proteins by 27.6%, plus Ca, Mg, Mn, Zn (11.9-14.3%) and linoleic acid (5.0%) in sunflower microgreens. These gains co-occurred with yield increases rather than trading off against them. The authors conclude low-dose salt improves both yield and nutritional value.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 25 mM NaCl 的 eustress 使向日葵苗菜總碳水化合物增加 27.2%、總蛋白增加 27.6%，另有 Ca、Mg、Mn、Zn（11.9-14.3%）與亞麻油酸（5.0%）提升。這些增益與產量增加同時發生而非相互取捨。作者結論為低劑量鹽同時改善產量與營養價值。

nodes.label: Cytoprotective Proteins
nodes.description: Hormesis activates NF-kB, MAPK, AMPK, mTOR, and PI3K/Akt signaling, upregulating phase 2 enzymes, antioxidant enzymes, heat-shock proteins, growth factors, and energy-metabolism proteins. This diminishes oxidative stress and inflammation, mitigates cellular senescence, and enables tissue repair and restored homeostasis. The effect prevents or reduces damage from subsequent higher-dose stimuli across the lifespan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hormesis 可活化 NF-kB、MAPK、AMPK、mTOR 與 PI3K/Akt 訊號，上調 phase 2 enzymes、抗氧化酶、heat-shock proteins、生長因子與能量代謝蛋白。此作用降低氧化壓力與發炎、減緩細胞衰老，並促進組織修復與恆定重建。該效應可預防或減輕後續高劑量刺激造成的損傷，並貫穿整個生命週期。

nodes.label: Maillard Reaction Products
nodes.description: Low doses of Maillard reaction products from cooking show antioxidant, antimicrobial, and prebiotic properties with potential benefits for cancer, glucose metabolism, and cardiovascular risk. High levels are detrimental, so the benefit is confined to a low-dose hormetic window.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 烹調產生的低劑量 Maillard Reaction Products 具有抗氧化、抗菌與益生元特性，對癌症、葡萄糖代謝與心血管風險可能有益。高劑量則有害，因此其效益侷限於低劑量的 hormesis 窗口。

nodes.label: Distress
nodes.description: Moderate and severe salt levels of 75 and 100 mM NaCl significantly reduced sunflower microgreen growth parameters. Higher salt levels also induced marked oxidative stress, opposite to the 25 mM eustress response. This marks the toxic limb of the salt dose-response curve.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 75 與 100 mM 的中重度鹽濃度顯著降低向日葵苗菜生長參數。較高鹽濃度亦引起明顯氧化壓力，與 25 mM eustress 反應相反。這標誌著鹽劑量反應曲線的毒性支。

nodes.label: Reoxygenation Injury
nodes.description: POS was originally framed as upregulating antioxidants during hypoxia specifically to cope with heightened oxidant formation during reoxygenation. Evidence from mussels, fish, frogs, and snails shows antioxidant induction during low oxygen followed by normalization after oxygen restoration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: POS 最初被描述為在缺氧期間上調抗氧化物，專門用以應對再氧合期間增加的氧化物生成。來自貽貝、魚類、蛙類與蝸牛的證據顯示，抗氧化物在低氧期間被誘導，並在氧氣恢復後回到正常值。

nodes.label: Quantitative Dose-Response Criteria
nodes.description: A POS response only qualifies as hormesis if it meets quantitative Calabrese-Blain criteria: at least a 10% increase forming an inverted U-shaped curve or a 3% reduction forming a J-shaped curve, followed by a return toward baseline as a function of exposure time or concentration. These thresholds separate true biphasic hormetic regulation, such as scallop SOD rising 15-50% then falling 40-60%, from noise or monotonic stress responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: POS 反應僅在符合 Calabrese-Blain 定量標準時才算 Hormesis：隨暴露時間或濃度變化，至少增加 10% 形成倒 U 形曲線，或降低 3% 形成 J 形曲線，之後回到基線。這些閾值將真正的雙相 hormetic 調控（如扇貝 SOD 上升 15-50% 後下降 40-60%）與雜訊或單調壓力反應區分開來。

nodes.label: Multiple Animal Phyla
nodes.description: POS has been documented as an adaptive physiological mechanism in 83 animal species from 8 different phyla under low-oxygen stress and estivation, with 60-70% of analyzed species POS-positive. Antioxidant enzymes rise during hypoxia and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal, showing POS is a widespread cross-phylum conditioning strategy rather than a species-specific quirk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Preparation for Oxidative Stress 已被記錄為 8 個不同門共 83 種動物在低氧壓力與夏眠下的適應性生理機制，受分析物種中約 60-70% 為 POS-positive。抗氧化酶在缺氧期間上升，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線，顯示 POS 是跨門的 conditioning 策略，而非物種特異的偶發現象。

nodes.label: Antidotum Mithridaticum
nodes.description: Antidotum Mithridaticum, the ancient 'universal antidote' attributed to King Mithridates VI of Pontus, embodies mithridatism: the daily ingestion of sub-lethal poison doses to build tolerance. This is an early intuition of hormesis, that low-dose exposure to a stressor induces adaptive protective responses raising resistance to higher doses. Mithridatism prefigures modern preconditioning and mitohormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antidotum Mithridaticum 是傳統上歸於本都國王 Mithridates VI 的古代「萬能解毒劑」，體現了 mithridatism：每日攝取亞致死劑量的毒物以建立耐受性。這正是 hormesis 的早期直覺——低劑量暴露於壓力源可誘發適應性保護反應，提高對更高劑量的抵抗力。Mithridatism 可視為現代 preconditioning 與 mitohormesis 的先驅。

nodes.label: Hormesis in Non-Mitochondrial Systems
nodes.description: Beyond mitohormesis, the same biphasic dose-response pattern — radiation, oxygen deprivation, mechanical load, heat, cold, infection, psychological challenge, caloric deficit, phytochemicals — constitutes non-mitochondrial Hormesis. These domains are underrecognized largely because of semantic fragmentation: each field uses its own vocabulary ('adaptive response', 'preconditioning', 'eustress') without sharing the underlying biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 mitohormesis 之外，相同的雙相劑量-反應型態——輻射、缺氧、機械負荷、高溫、低溫、感染、心理挑戰、熱量缺乏、植物化學物質——構成了非粒線體的 Hormesis。這些領域之所以被低估，主要歸因於語意碎片化：每個領域各自使用自己的詞彙（「適應反應」、「預備」、「良性壓力」），卻未共享同一套生物學基礎。

nodes.label: Redox Vaccination
nodes.description: The Redox Vaccination hypothesis proposes that sub-toxic adrenochrome exposure upregulates SIRT3 via a retrograde ROS→AMPK→PGC-1α→SIRT3 cascade, effectively widening the Hormetic Window for subsequent challenges. It is the mechanistic analogue of ischemic preconditioning or mithridatism: repeated sub-lethal exposures expand adaptive capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Redox Vaccination 假說提出，次毒性的腎上腺醌暴露可經由 ROS→AMPK→PGC-1α→SIRT3 的逆行級聯提升 SIRT3，因而實質上擴大後續挑戰的 Hormetic Window。它在機制上等同於缺血預備作用或 mithridatism：反覆的次致死暴露可擴張適應容量。

nodes.label: Signaling Molecules
nodes.description: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a signaling molecule, functioning as a second messenger in insulin signaling, growth-factor pathways, and immune responses. Its relatively long half-life and membrane permeability allow it to diffuse and oxidize specific targets reversibly. The directionality is H2O2 from enzyme or leak to signal propagation. A caveat is that the same molecule is toxic at higher concentrations, so concentration and compartmentalization determine whether H2O2 signals or damages. Reversible oxidation of target cysteines, such as those in PTP1B and PTEN, allows H2O2 to propagate kinase-dependent responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 作為訊號分子，在胰島素訊號、生長因子途徑和免疫反應中充當第二信使。其相對較長的半衰期和膜滲透性使其能夠可逆地擴散和氧化特定標靶。方向性是 H2O2 從酵素或洩漏到訊號傳播。需要注意的是，相同的分子在較高濃度下是有毒的，因此濃度和區室化決定了 H2O2 是否發出訊號或造成損害。目標半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B 和 PTEN 中的半胱氨酸）的可逆氧化使 H2O2 能夠傳播激酶依賴性反應。

nodes.label: Cysteine Thiols
nodes.description: Hydrogen peroxide oxidizes cysteine thiols, transducing signals through reversible oxidation to sulfenic acid, disulfide, or higher oxides that alter protein activity. This post-translational modification is a core mechanism by which oxidants regulate phosphatases, kinases, and transcription factors. The directionality is oxidant to thiol modification to functional change. A caveat is that excessive or irreversible over-oxidation (sulfinic/sulfonic acid) leads to loss of function and damage rather than signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 氧化 cysteine thiols，透過可逆氧化將訊號轉化成次磺酸、二硫化物或改變蛋白質活性的高級氧化物。這種翻譯後修飾是氧化劑調節磷酸酶、激酶和轉錄因子的核心機制。方向性是氧化劑到硫醇修飾到功能變化。需要注意的是，過度或不可逆的過度氧化（亞磺酸/磺酸）會導致功能喪失和損傷，而不是訊號傳導。

nodes.label: Gingivitis
nodes.description: Necrotizing gingivitis and periodontal destruction are the classic presentation of acatalasemia from undegraded oral peroxide. Association records the mucosal hallmark.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 壞死性齦炎與牙周破壞是未降解口腔過氧化物導致 acatalasemia 的典型表現。關聯記錄黏膜標誌。

nodes.label: HemF-like
nodes.description: HemF-like (coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like) enzymes are biocatalysts identified by functional metagenomics in soil bacteria that can use synthetic Glucosepane as a nutrient source. The human homolog of HemF, together with homologous bacterial proteins in the human microbiome such as Escherichia and Pseudomonas, catalyzes cleavage of the glucosepane ring in vitro, releasing Citrulline as a byproduct — the only known route for enzymatically reversing this AGE crosslink.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HemF-like（coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like）酵素是由功能性 metagenomics 在土壤細菌中發現的生物催化劑，能以合成的 Glucosepane 作為養分來源。HemF 的人類同源蛋白，以及人體微生物組中如 Escherichia 與 Pseudomonas 的同源蛋白，能在體外催化 glucosepane 環的切斷，並釋出 Citrulline 作為副產物——這是已知唯一能以酵素方式逆轉此 AGE 交聯的途徑。

nodes.label: QueE-like
nodes.description: QueE-like enzymes are radical S-adenosylmethionine proteins discovered by metagenomic screening that cleave glucosepane, the exceptionally stable lysine-arginine imidazolium AGE crosslink; they can grow on synthetic glucosepane as sole nutrient and degrade it in vitro.
nodes.description_zh_TW: QueE-like 酵素是經由 metagenomic 篩選發現的 radical S-adenosylmethionine 蛋白，可切割 [[Glucosepane]]——一種極穩定的離胺酸-精胺酸 imidazolium AGE 交聯；它們能以合成 glucosepane 為唯一營養源生長，並在體外降解之。

nodes.label: 5-FU
nodes.description: 5-FU (fluorouracil) is the infusional fluoropyrimidine backbone of rectal cancer chemoradiation, delivered as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation. It is standard for locally advanced rectal cancer. 5-FU is therefore central to the nCRT regimen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5-FU（氟尿嘧啶）是直腸癌化放療的輸注型氟嘧啶主幹，在新輔助化放療中作為放射增敏劑給藥。它是局部晚期直腸癌的標準治療。因此 5-FU 對 nCRT 方案至關重要。

nodes.label: Capecitabine
nodes.description: Capecitabine is an oral fluoropyrimidine prodrug used as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation for rectal cancer. It is an alternative to infusional 5-FU in the nCRT regimen. Capecitabine is therefore central to rectal cancer chemoradiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Capecitabine 是口服氟嘧啶前驅藥，用作直腸癌新輔助化放療中的放射增敏劑。它是 nCRT 方案中輸注 5-FU 的替代品。因此 Capecitabine 對直腸癌化放療至關重要。

nodes.label: Flushing
nodes.description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day, and several preclinical studies have confirmed that both NA and nicotinamide (NAM) can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NA shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels and is used to treat dyslipidemia, but this flushing side effect limits its tolerability. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR) elevates NAD+ levels without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, and was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關，且數項臨床前研究已確認 NA 與 nicotinamide（NAM）皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。NA 展現降低血脂水平的效果並被用於治療血脂異常，但此潮紅副作用限制了其耐受性。相對地，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）提升 NAD+ 水平而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），並在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Serum Cholesterol
nodes.description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Alcoholism
nodes.description: With Abram Hoffer, Humphry Osmond conducted some of the first controlled trials of LSD as a treatment for Alcoholism at Saskatchewan Hospital in the 1950s and early 1960s. Their studies reported that a single high-dose LSD session combined with psychotherapy produced significant reductions in relapse rates among chronic alcoholics — findings that have seen major renewed interest in the current renaissance of psychedelic-assisted therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Humphry Osmond 與 Abram Hoffer 在 1950 至 1960 年代初於 Saskatchewan Hospital 進行了最早一批以 LSD 治療 Alcoholism 的對照試驗之一。其研究報告指出，單次高劑量 LSD 給藥合併心理治療，可使慢性酒精成癮者的復發率顯著下降——這些發現隨著迷幻藥輔助治療的復興而重新受到重視。

nodes.label: calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase
nodes.description: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

nodes.label: memory formation
nodes.description: CaMKIIalpha is essential for memory formation, as its autophosphorylation and persistent activity maintain the synaptic changes underlying learning across hippocampal and cortical circuits. Pharmacological or genetic disruption of CaMKIIalpha impairs spatial and associative memory, while its activation supports memory encoding. Because CaMKIIalpha is enriched in forebrain structures, its promoter is widely used to drive transgene expression in cognitive circuits. Its role makes it a frequent target in studies of cognitive enhancement and neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 memory formation 至關重要，因為其自身磷酸化和持續活性維持了海馬和皮質迴路學習的突觸變化。 CaMKIIalpha 的藥理或遺傳破壞會損害空間記憶和聯想記憶，而其活化則支持記憶編碼。由於 CaMKIIalpha 富含前腦結構，因此其啟動子被廣泛用於驅動認知迴路中的轉基因表現。它的作用使其成為認知增強和神經退化性疾病研究的常見目標。

nodes.label: COMT-OE mouse models
nodes.description: The CaMKIIalpha promoter is used in COMT-OE mouse models to drive transgenic COMT overexpression selectively in forebrain, cortical and hippocampal neurons, mimicking the brain-specific isoform distribution of endogenous COMT. This restricts the genetic manipulation to regions relevant to cognition while sparing the periphery and cerebellum, which retain normal COMT activity. The approach yields a clean model for studying prefrontal and striatal COMT effects on learning and impulse control. Cerebellar function remains intact and serves as an internal control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: COMT-OE mouse models 中使用 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子選擇性地驅動轉基因 COMT 在前腦、皮質和海馬神經元中過度表達，模仿內源性 COMT 的 brain 特異性亞型分佈。這將基因操作限制在與認知相關的區域，同時保留了保留正常 COMT activity 的周邊和小腦。此方法產生了一個乾淨的模型，用於研究前額葉和紋狀體 COMT 對學習和衝動控制的影響。小腦功能保持完整併作為內部控制。

nodes.label: motor coordination
nodes.description: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

nodes.label: negative control in COMT-OE studies
nodes.description: The cerebellum serves as a negative control in COMT-OE studies because CaMKIIalpha-promoter-driven transgene expression is forebrain-restricted, leaving cerebellar structure and function intact. Demonstrating preserved cerebellar-dependent performance, such as motor coordination and balance, confirms that observed cognitive or motor effects arise from forebrain COMT overexpression rather than generalized toxicity. This control strengthens causal interpretation of the model's behavioral outcomes. It exemplifies the value of region-specific promoters in behavioral neuroscience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小腦充當 negative control in COMT-OE studies，因為 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子驅動的轉基因表達受到前腦限制，從而保持小腦結構和功能完整。證明保留的小腦依賴性性能，例如 motor coordination 和平衡，證實觀察到的認知或運動效應是由前腦 COMT 過度表達而不是普遍毒性引起的。這種控制加強了對模型行為結果的因果解釋。它例證了區域特異性啟動子在行為神經科學中的價值。

nodes.label: Deep cerebellar nuclei
nodes.description: Cerebellar cortical output passes through the deep nuclei (dentate, interposed, fastigial) to shape motor commands. Containment records the output nuclei embedded within the cerebellum.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小腦皮質輸出經深部核（齒狀、間位、頂核）以塑造運動指令。包含記錄嵌於小腦內的輸出核。

nodes.label: Ataxia
nodes.description: Gait and limb ataxia is the cardinal manifestation of olivopontocerebellar atrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 步態與肢體共濟失調是橄欖橋腦小腦萎縮的主要表現。

nodes.label: Murine embryonic fibroblast
nodes.description: Murine embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) are primary fibroblasts commonly used as feeder layers that secrete factors including LIF to support embryonic stem cell culture. MEF feeder contamination can confound miRNA analyses of ES cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞（MEF）是常用的飼養層初代纖維母細胞，分泌包括 LIF 在內的因子以支持胚胎幹細胞培養。MEF 飼養層污染可能干擾 ES 細胞的 miRNA 分析。

nodes.label: Podocyte
nodes.description: Charge-based anti-adhesion maintains foot-process architecture.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 電荷型抗黏附維持足突架構。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial DNA Mutations
nodes.description: Mitochondrial fusion dilutes mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations by mixing the contents of healthy and damaged mitochondria, thereby enabling functional complementation between individual mitochondrial genomes. By exchanging mitochondrial DNA, proteins, lipids, and metabolites across a connected network, fusion allows a damaged genome to be complemented by the products of an intact genome. This content mixing is a principal functional rationale for the existence of the mitochondrial network and is experimentally demonstrated by the finding that fusion between a wild-type and a mutant mitochondrion restores oxidative phosphorylation function in heteroplasmic cells. Loss of fusion therefore accelerates the phenotypic manifestation of mtDNA mutations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合透過混合健康和受損粒線體的內容物，稀釋粒線體 DNA（mtDNA）突變，從而實現個別粒線體基因體之間的功能互補。透過在互連網路中交換粒線體 DNA、蛋白質、脂質和代謝物，融合使得受損的基因體可由完整基因體的產物進行互補。這種內容混合是粒線體網路存在的主要功能原理，並透過實驗發現異質性細胞中野生型與突變粒線體的融合可恢復氧化磷酸化功能而得到證實。因此，融合的喪失會加速 mtDNA 突變的表型表現。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

nodes.label: OPA1-mediated Fusion
nodes.description: Cardiolipin is required for OPA1-mediated inner-membrane fusion in liposome reconstitutions, dual to its pro-fission DRP1 stimulation. One lipid gates both fusion and fission.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 在脂質體重構中為 OPA1 介導的內膜融合所必需，與其促分裂的 DRP1 刺激成雙。一種脂質門控融合與分裂兩者。

nodes.label: Alu element transcripts
nodes.description: Alu elements are short interspersed nuclear elements that, when derepressed, produce transcripts that contribute to genomic instability. In aging and stressed cells, loss of epigenetic silencing permits Alu transcription, and the resulting double-stranded RNA and retrotransposition intermediates challenge genome integrity by promoting insertions and activating innate immune DNA and RNA sensing pathways. Aberrant Alu activity is therefore both a consequence and a driver of the accumulating genomic instability recognized as a hallmark of aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alu 元件是短散佈的核元件，當去抑制時，會產生導致基因組不穩定的轉錄物。在老化和壓力的細胞中，表觀遺傳沉默的喪失允許 Alu 轉錄，由此產生的雙股 RNA 和逆轉錄轉座中間體透過促進插入和激活先天免疫 DNA 和 RNA 感測途徑來挑戰基因組完整性。因此，異常的 Alu 活性既是基因組不穩定性累積的結果，也是其驅動因素，而基因組不穩定性被認為是老化的標誌。

nodes.label: TMG
nodes.description: TMG (trimethylglycine/betaine) is a methyl donor that, via betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase, converts homocysteine to methionine. By supporting remethylation it helps maintain a high SAM:SAH ratio, reducing SAH accumulation and preserving methylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TMG（三甲基甘氨酸/betaine）是甲基供體，經由甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶將同型半胱氨酸轉化為甲硫氨酸。透過支持再甲基化，它有助於維持高 SAM:SAH 比例，減少 SAH 累積並保存甲基化能力。

nodes.label: Histone Deacetylases
nodes.description: Sulforaphane from broccoli acts as a well-characterized inhibitor of histone deacetylase enzymes. By altering histone acetylation and chromatin structure, it durably reprograms expression of genes involved in stress resistance, inflammation, and longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 來自青花菜的 Sulforaphane 是明確的 Histone Deacetylases 抑制劑。透過改變組蛋白乙醯化與染色質結構，它能持久重編與壓力抗性、發炎及長壽相關基因的表現。

nodes.label: Tetraploidy
nodes.description: Fusion-generated tetraploid genomes trigger arrest as CFIS. Whole-genome doubling is the causal insult.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 融合產生的四倍體基因組觸發停滯成為 CFIS。全基因組加倍是因果傷害。

nodes.label: Barr Body
nodes.description: The compacted silent X chromosome is the Barr body.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 緻密沉默的 X 染色體即 Barr body。

nodes.label: Dosage Compensation
nodes.description: X inactivation equalizes X-linked gene dosage between the sexes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: X 失活平衡兩性間 X 連鎖基因劑量。

nodes.label: Immunomodulation
nodes.description: Immunomodulation is central to MSC therapeutic action on inflammation. Regulation is the immunological output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 免疫調節是 MSC 對發炎治療作用的核心。調節是其免疫學輸出。

nodes.label: dopaminergic neurotransmission
nodes.description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

nodes.label: NKX2-1
nodes.description: NKX2-1 (Nk2 homeobox 1) is deacetylated by SIRT1 in hypothalamic DMH/LH neurons; deacetylated NKX2-1 activates transcription of OX2R, the orexin receptor whose increased signaling recapitulates calorie restriction and extends lifespan in BRASTO mice. Thus NKX2-1 is the direct transcriptional relay between SIRT1 and OX2R. By linking SIRT1 activity to orexin-receptor expression, NKX2-1 connects sirtuin signaling to the neural circuits controlling arousal, activity, and energy expenditure. This pathway illustrates how a single transcription factor can mediate the longevity effects of sirtuin activation in the brain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NKX2-1（Nk2 homeobox 1）在下丘腦DMH/LH神經元中被SIRT1去乙醯化；去乙醯化的NKX2-1啟動OX2R的轉錄，OX2R是食慾素受體，其訊號增強模擬了熱量限制並在BRASTO小鼠中延長壽命。因此NKX2-1是SIRT1和OX2R之間的直接轉錄中繼。透過將SIRT1活性與食慾素受體表達聯繫起來，NKX2-1將sirtuin訊號與控制覺醒、活動和能量消耗的神經迴路連接。此通路說明了單一轉錄因子如何能介導sirtuin活化在大腦中的長壽效應。

nodes.label: cognitive enhancer
nodes.description: A nootropic is by definition a cognitive-enhancing agent targeting alertness, attention or executive function. Classification covers prescription repurposing like modafinil as well as supplements.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nootropic 依定義是針對警覺、注意或執行功能的認知增強劑。歸類涵蓋如 modafinil 的處方再利用與補充劑。

nodes.label: sleep disorder
nodes.description: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological sleep disorder of excessive daytime sleepiness with disrupted nocturnal sleep. Classification anchors it in sleep medicine rather than psychiatry.
nodes.description_zh_TW: narcolepsy 是以日間過度嗜睡與夜間睡眠中斷為特徵的慢性神經性睡眠疾患。歸類將它錨定於睡眠醫學而非精神科。

nodes.label: MHC class I
nodes.description: Epidrugs synergize with immunotherapy via MHC-I/PD-L1 upregulation. Upregulation is the immune-visibility mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 表觀藥物經由 MHC-I/PD-L1 上調與免疫治療協同。上調是免疫可見性機制。

nodes.label: ADM
nodes.description: DNA methylation surrogates of ADM are components of the DNAmGrimAge clock alongside Cystatin C, B2M, GDF15 and PAI-1, translating circulating adrenomedullin levels into an accelerated-aging signal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ADM 的 DNA 甲基化替代指標是 DNAmGrimAge 時鐘的組成成分，與 Cystatin C、B2M、GDF15 及 PAI-1 並列，將循環中的腎上腺髓質素濃度轉譯為加速老化訊號。

nodes.label: α-synuclein-mediated toxicity
nodes.description: AGK2-mediated SIRT2 inhibition prevents deacetylation of α-tubulin and microtubule elements, suppressing aggregation and protecting dopaminergic neuron viability in Parkinson's models. Directionally, AGK2/SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of neuronal rescue. This targets the microtubule instability underlying synuclein toxicity, and it is a leading SIRT2-inhibition neurodegenerative strategy. By maintaining the acetylated, stable state of tubulin, AGK2 helps neurons withstand α-synuclein aggregates. These results provided some of the strongest evidence that SIRT2 inhibition, rather than activation, is neuroprotective.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGK2 介導的 SIRT2 抑制防止 α-微管蛋白和微管元件的去乙醯化，抑制聚集並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺能神經元活性。在方向性上，AGK2/SIRT2 抑制位於神經元拯救的上游。這靶向突觸核蛋白毒性底層的微管不穩定性，是領先的 SIRT2 抑制神經退行性策略。透過維護微管蛋白的乙醯化穩定狀態，AGK2 幫助神經元抵抗 α-突觸核蛋白聚集。這些結果提供了最強的證據之一，表明 SIRT2 抑制（而非活化）具有神經保護作用。

nodes.label: phospho-JNK
nodes.description: Administration of AGK2 confers significant neuroprotection under ischemic and hypoxic conditions by suppressing the apoptotic cascade, downregulating phosphorylated JNK (phospho-JNK) and FOXO3a, the direct downstream target of SIRT2. This ultimately prevents Bim activation and subsequent caspase-3 cleavage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在缺血和缺氧條件下，給予 AGK2 透過抑制凋亡級聯、下調磷酸化 JNK（phospho-JNK）和 FOXO3a（SIRT2 的直接下游靶標）來提供顯著的神經保護。這最終阻止 Bim 活化和隨後的 caspase-3 裂解。

nodes.label: Fluorescent substrate artifacts
nodes.description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Polyphenol STAC
nodes.description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: SIRT1 KM for substrates
nodes.description: Sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) such as resveratrol lower the Km of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates, amplifying deacetylation efficiency. Directionally, STAC binding sits upstream of enhanced catalytic rate. This allosteric effect is the defining action of a STAC, and it underlies the metabolic and longevity benefits attributed to these molecules. By increasing substrate affinity, STACs allow SIRT1 to deacetylate targets even at low NAD+ concentrations. This mechanism distinguishes true STACs from indirect NAD+-raising compounds, and it is central to STAC pharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）如 resveratrol 降低 SIRT1 對其肽和 NAD+ 底物的 Km 值，放大去乙醯化效率。在方向性上，STAC 結合位於增強催化速率的上游。這種變構效應是 STAC 的定義性作用，構成了歸因於這些分子的代謝和長壽益處的基礎。透過增加底物親和力，STAC 使 SIRT1 即使在低 NAD+ 濃度下也能去乙醯化靶標。此機制區分了真正的 STAC 與間接提高 NAD+ 的化合物，是 STAC 藥理學的核心。

nodes.label: K-type allosteric activation (lowers Km)
nodes.description: STACs (sirtuin-activating compounds) activate sirtuins through a K-type allosteric mechanism that lowers the Michaelis constant (Km) for both NAD+ and the acetylated substrate peptide, raising catalytic efficiency without changing Vmax. This is the canonical mechanism encoded for the dozen chemical classes of STACs, distinct from the NAD+-boosting strategy (NMN/NR/CD38 inhibition) that restores co-substrate availability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STACs（sirtuin 活化化合物）透過 K 型別構機制活化 sirtuins，降低 NAD+ 與乙醯化受質胜肽的米氏常數（Km），在不改變 Vmax 的情況下提升催化效率。這是一打化學類別 STACs 的典型機制，不同於 NAD+ 提升策略（NMN/NR/CD38 抑制）——後者是恢復輔受質的可及性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: SNP
nodes.description: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a variation at a single nucleotide position in the genome, the most common type of genetic variation, occurring roughly every few hundred bases. SNPs such as COMT Val158Met (rs4680) can alter protein function, gene expression, or drug response, making them the primary markers used in pharmacogenetic and behavioral genetics studies. Most SNPs are neutral, but functional variants can have substantial biological effects. They are the foundation of modern association studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 單核苷酸多態性 (SNP) 是基因組中單一核苷酸位置的變異，是最常見的遺傳變異類型，大約每幾百個鹼基就會發生一次。 SNPs（例如 COMT Val158Met (rs4680)）可以改變蛋白質功能，gene expression 或 drug response，使它們成為藥物遺傳學和行為遺傳學研究中使用的主要標記。大多數 SNPs 是中性的，但功能變異可以產生顯著的生物效應。它們是現代聯想研究的基礎。

nodes.label: mRNA
nodes.description: Messenger RNA provides the decoded template for protein synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 信使 RNA 提供蛋白合成的解碼模板。

nodes.label: Ribosome
nodes.description: Ribosomes synthesize proteins by decoding messenger RNA.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核醣體經由解碼信使 RNA 合成蛋白。

nodes.label: Eosinophilia
nodes.description: Peripheral blood eosinophilia is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia 是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

nodes.label: antioxidant enzyme expression
nodes.description: Moderate physical exercise induces the expression of antioxidant enzymes, leading to the reduction of oxidative stress. Exercise effectively inhibits ROS generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes, and because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is attributed mainly to exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Physical exercise also decreases oxidative stress in rodent models and is reported to improve systemic antioxidant activity in humans. These antioxidant effects link exercise to reduced AGE accumulation and healthier aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 適度的身體運動會誘導抗氧化酵素的表現，進而降低氧化壓力。運動能有效抑制 ROS 的生成並提升抗氧化酵素的活性，而由於蛋白質糖化反應是由 ROS 驅動並加速的，規律運動對 AGE 形成的抑制主要歸因於運動相關的抗氧化活性。身體運動也能降低囓齒類動物模式中的氧化壓力，且據報導能改善人類的全身性抗氧化活性。這些抗氧化效應將運動與減少的 AGE 堆積及更健康的老化連結起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Appetite
nodes.description: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

nodes.label: Athletes
nodes.description: Athletes in heavy training display elevated resting metabolic rates compared with untrained individuals, largely because their higher fat free mass increases the metabolic load of lean tissues. Speakman notes that RMR measured in endurance athletes can be elevated by about 5-10 percent beyond the prediction for their body composition alone, an effect attributed to increased protein turnover, elevated sympathetic tone, and continued recovery processes in muscle. However, the review stresses that the majority of the difference in total daily energy expenditure between athletes and non-athletes arises from the energy cost of training itself, not from chronic elevation of RMR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 進行高強度訓練的運動員與未訓練者相比表現出更高的靜息代謝率，主要是因為他們較高的去脂體重增加了瘦組織的代謝負擔。Speakman指出，在耐力運動員中測量的RMR可能比僅根據其身體成分預測的值高出約5-10%，這一效應歸因於蛋白質周轉增加、交感神經張力升高和肌肉中持續的恢復過程。然而，該綜述強調，運動員和非運動員之間每日總能量消耗的大部分差異來自訓練本身的能量成本，而不是來自RMR的長期升高。

nodes.label: Post-exercise Energy Expenditure
nodes.description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

nodes.label: Daily Energy Expenditure
nodes.description: Physical activity and exercise are the components of daily energy expenditure that are most amenable to voluntary modification, in contrast to resting metabolic rate and thermic effect of food which are largely fixed by body size and composition. Speakman reviews doubly labelled water studies of total daily energy expenditure in adults to argue that although activity levels vary widely between individuals, the day-to-day variability of total daily energy expenditure is surprisingly small, around 2-3 percent. This suggests energy intake is tightly matched to expenditure over the long term, and that exercise-induced elevations in expenditure are generally not fully compensated by reductions elsewhere in the daily energy budget.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 體力活動和運動是每日能量支出中最容易自願修改的成分，而靜息代謝率和食物熱效應 largely 由身體大小和成分固定。Speakman回顧了成人每日總能量支出的雙標記水研究，認為儘管活動水平因人而異，但每日總能量支出的每日變異性驚人地小，約2-3%。這表明能量攝入在長期內與支出緊密匹配，且運動引起的支出增加通常不會完全被日常能量預算中其他地方的減少所補償。

nodes.label: Sedentary Behaviour
nodes.description: Total physical activity during the day can be limited by sedentary behaviour, and in some doubly labelled water studies the elevated energy expenditure from a structured exercise session was partly offset by a reduction in non-exercise physical activity elsewhere in the day. Speakman notes that the extent of this compensation varies between individuals, so the net effect of a training program on total daily energy expenditure is the sum of the exercise cost, the excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, and any changes in spontaneous activity and appetite. This interaction helps explain why measured increases in total daily energy expenditure with training are often smaller than the energy cost of the training sessions themselves.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 白天的總體力活動可能因久坐行為而受限，在一些雙標記水研究中，結構化運動課程增加的能量消耗部分被一天中其他時間非運動體力活動的減少所抵消。Speakman指出這種補償程度因人而異，因此訓練課程對每日總能量支出的淨效應是運動成本、運動後過量氧消耗以及自發活動和食慾變化的總和。這種相互作用有助於解釋為什麼訓練期間測量的每日總能量支出增加通常小於訓練課程本身的能量成本。

nodes.label: BDNF and NAD+ levels
nodes.description: Exercise raises both BDNF and NAD+ levels, and SIRT1 may mediate exercise-induced BDNF upregulation in the hippocampus. Directionally, exercise sits upstream of BDNF and NAD+ elevation. Higher NAD+ fuels SIRT1, which then supports BDNF, and this provides a mechanistic bridge between physical activity, sirtuins, and brain health. By raising NAD+, exercise engages the sirtuin pathway that promotes BDNF expression and mitochondrial function. This axis is central to the well-established cognitive benefits of exercise and to the geroscience concept of exercise as medicine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運動同時提高 BDNF 和 NAD+ 水平，SIRT1 可能中介運動誘導的海馬 BDNF 上調。在方向性上，運動位於 BDNF 和 NAD+ 提升的上游。較高的 NAD+ 為 SIRT1 提供燃料，後者隨後支持 BDNF，這提供了身體活動、sirtuin 和大腦健康之間的機制橋樑。透過提高 NAD+，運動啟動促進 BDNF 表達和粒線體功能的 sirtuin 途徑。此軸線是運動公認的認知益處和老年科學中運動即藥物概念的核心。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: SIRT1 allele variants
nodes.description: Several single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the human SIRT1 gene are significantly associated with systemic energy expenditure in Finnish cohorts, suggesting that SIRT1 variation influences metabolic rate. These variants may alter SIRT1 expression or activity, shifting how individuals burn fuel at rest and during activity. Directionally, genetic SIRT1 variation is linked to an energy-expenditure phenotype. As with most genetic-association findings, effect sizes are modest and context-dependent, and replication in other populations is needed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT1 基因中的幾個單核苷酸多態性與芬蘭研究組的全身能量消耗顯著相關，表明 SIRT1 變異影響代謝率。這些變異可能改變 SIRT1 的表達或活性，改變個體在靜息和活動狀態下的燃料燃燒方式。在方向性上，遺傳性 SIRT1 變異與能量消耗表型相關。與大多數遺傳關聯研究一樣，效應量 modest 且取決於情境，需要在其他人群中進行複製驗證。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: MG53
nodes.description: In a d-galactose plus AlCl3 sporadic AD rat model with suppressed AMPK-SIRT1-PGC-1alpha signaling and elevated plasma tau, chronic treadmill exercise restored the AMPK-SIRT1-PGC-1alpha axis and significantly elevated MG53 expression at gene and protein levels across brain, muscle, and circulation. Restored MG53 links systemic cellular repair to improved behavior and tau normalization, defining a novel central-peripheral neuroprotective mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 AMPK-SIRT1-PGC-1alpha 訊號受抑制且血漿 tau 升高的 d-galactose 合併 AlCl3 散發型 AD 大鼠模型中，長期跑步機運動恢復 AMPK-SIRT1-PGC-1alpha 軸，並在腦、肌肉與循環中顯著提升 MG53 的基因與蛋白表現。恢復的 MG53 將全身性細胞修復與行為改善及 tau 正常化連結起來，構成嶄新的中樞-周邊神經保護機制。

nodes.label: γ-H2A.X
nodes.description: gamma-H2A.X, the phosphorylated form of the histone variant H2A.X at serine 139, serves as a beacon that recruits DNA repair proteins to sites of double-strand DNA breaks. Phosphorylation of H2A.X spreads over large chromatin domains around the break, providing a platform for the assembly of DNA repair complexes and the amplification of damage signaling. Beyond its role in repair, gamma-H2A.X induces p53 expression and activates senescence signaling, and it accumulates with aging as a result of persistent DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: γ-H2A.X 是組蛋白變體 H2A.X 在絲氨酸 139 的磷酸化形式，可作為將 DNA 修復蛋白招募到雙股 DNA 斷裂位點的信標。 H2A.X 的磷酸化遍布斷裂周圍的大染色質結構域，為 DNA 修復複合物的組裝和損傷訊號的放大提供了平台。除了修復作用之外，gamma-H2A.X 還誘導 p53 表達並激活衰老信號傳導，並且由於持續的 DNA 損傷，它會隨著衰老而累積。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of FOXO4
nodes.description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

nodes.label: Global Hypomethylation
nodes.description: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

nodes.label: epigenetic information
nodes.description: Partial reprogramming (e.g., via Yamanaka factors) can reset epigenetic information, supporting the idea that aging is reversible at the information level. This connection to cellular reprogramming complements the RCM hypothesis, which frames aging as an epigenetic software problem rather than purely hardware (mutation) damage. Because epigenetic changes can potentially be reset, unlike permanent mutations, reprogramming-based approaches offer a route to restoring youthful gene expression patterns.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 部分重編程（例如透過 Yamanaka 因子）可以重置表觀遺傳資訊，支持了衰老在資訊層面可逆的觀點。這種與細胞重編程的關聯補充了 RCM 假說，該假說將衰老定位為表觀遺傳軟體問題，而非單純的硬體（突變）損傷。由於表觀遺傳變化不像永久性突變那樣無法逆轉，基於重編程的方法提供了恢復年輕基因表達模式的途徑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

nodes.label: High-dose SIRT1
nodes.description: High (12.5-fold) cardiac SIRT1 overexpression induced cardiomyopathy with increased apoptosis, hypertrophy, and oxidative stress, reduced ATP, citrate synthase, and mitochondrial biogenesis (about 50% PGC-1alpha loss), and possible NAD+ depletion. This is the canonical example of a hormetic dose window for cardiac SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高（12.5 倍）心臟 SIRT1 過表達誘導心肌病，伴隨凋亡、肥大和氧化壓力增加，ATP、檸檬酸合成酶和粒線體生物合成減少（PGC-1α 損失約 50%），並可能消耗 NAD+。這是心臟 SIRT1 毒物興奮效應劑量窗口的典型例子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md

nodes.label: CTCF
nodes.description: Cohesin cooperates with CTCF in loop-extruded TAD boundary formation. Interaction organizes three-dimensional genome architecture.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cohesin 與 CTCF 在環擠出 TAD 邊界形成協作。交互作用組織三維基因組架構。

nodes.label: Separase
nodes.description: Separase cleaves RAD21 to release cohesin at anaphase onset. Removal triggers sister separation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Separase 切割 RAD21 在後期開始釋放 cohesin。移除觸發姐妹分離。

nodes.label: NIPBL
nodes.description: The NIPBL loader deposits cohesin; NIPBL mutation causes Cornelia de Lange syndrome. Regulation is the loading control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NIPBL 裝載器沉積 cohesin；NIPBL 突變導致 Cornelia de Lange 症候群。調節是裝載控制。

nodes.label: Protease
nodes.description: HIV-1 Pol also encodes the viral protease, which during maturation cleaves the Gag and Gag-Pol polyproteins into functional subunits to produce infectious mature virions. Protease is the target of PI-class antiretroviral drugs such as darunavir and atazanavir, which are typically boosted with ritonavir or cobicistat.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 的 Pol 同樣編碼病毒 protease，它在成熟階段將 Gag 與 Gag-Pol 多蛋白切割成具功能的次單元，以產生具感染力的成熟病毒顆粒。Protease 是 darunavir、atazanavir 等 PI 類抗反轉錄病毒藥物的標的，這些藥物通常以 ritonavir 或 cobicistat 加以增幅。

nodes.label: AIDS
nodes.description: HIV-1 is the causative agent of the global AIDS pandemic. Infection leads to progressive CD4+ T cell depletion through direct viral killing, bystander apoptosis, pyroptosis of abortively infected cells and chronic immune activation; once CD4 counts fall below 200 cells/µL the host becomes susceptible to opportunistic infections such as Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, tuberculosis and toxoplasmosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 是全球 AIDS 大流行的致病因子。感染會透過直接病毒殺傷、旁觀細胞 apoptosis、abortively infected 細胞的 pyroptosis 與慢性免疫活化，造成 CD4+ T 細胞逐步耗竭；當 CD4 數低於 200 cells/µL，宿主便容易出現 Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia、tuberculosis 與 toxoplasmosis 等伺機性感染。

nodes.label: Integrase
nodes.description: The HIV-1 Pol polyprotein encodes the viral enzymes reverse transcriptase, integrase and protease. Integrase catalyzes insertion of proviral DNA into the host genome during nuclear import, and is the target of the INSTI class of antiretroviral drugs (dolutegravir, bictegravir, raltegravir, cabotegravir).
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 的 Pol 多蛋白會編碼病毒酵素 reverse transcriptase、integrase 與 protease。Integrase 在前整合複合體進入細胞核後，催化前病毒 DNA 插入宿主基因組，並是 INSTI 類抗反轉錄病毒藥物（dolutegravir、bictegravir、raltegravir、cabotegravir）的標的。

nodes.label: Pericytes
nodes.description: Pericytes are contractile perivascular cells that ensheathe the endothelial lining of capillaries and post-capillary venules while embedded in the basement membrane. Together with Endothelial Cells and astrocytic end-feet they form the neurovascular unit that maintains the Blood-Brain Barrier, and their loss or dysfunction is implicated in neurodegeneration and small-vessel disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pericytes 是可收縮的血管周細胞，嵌於基底膜中並包覆微血管與微靜脈後小靜脈的內皮襯裡。它們與 Endothelial Cells 及星狀細胞終足共同構成維持 Blood-Brain Barrier 的 neurovascular unit；其流失或功能異常與 neurodegeneration 及腦小血管病變有關。

nodes.label: Glaucoma
nodes.description: Glaucoma and other optic neuropathies cause progressive degeneration of Retinal Ganglion Cells; as CNS projection neurons whose axons form the optic nerve, Retinal Ganglion Cells are particularly vulnerable to axonal injury and chronic mitochondrial stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glaucoma 及其他視神經病變造成 Retinal Ganglion Cells 的進行性退化；Retinal Ganglion Cells 是軸突構成視神經的中樞神經系統投射神經元，因此特別容易受到軸突損傷與慢性粒線體壓力的傷害。

nodes.label: NAD+/NADH redox imbalance
nodes.description: The hallmark hyperglycemia of diabetes mellitus causes a redox imbalance between NAD+ and NADH that can lead to oxidative stress and a variety of metabolic syndromes. In cells whose glucose uptake is not insulin-dependent, glucose oversupply leads to NADH overproduction by both the conventional glucose combustion pathways (glycolysis and the Krebs cycle) and the polyol pathway. This NAD+/NADH imbalance, also known as pseudohypoxia, initially causes reductive stress and mitochondrial overload and dysfunction, which lead to oxidative stress and oxidative damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins. Additionally, PARP overactivation depletes NAD+, and this redox imbalance is a major factor contributing to the development of diabetic complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 糖尿病的標誌性高血糖造成 NAD+ 與 NADH 之間的氧化還原失衡，可能導致氧化壓力與多種代謝症候群。在葡萄糖攝取不依賴胰島素的細胞中，葡萄糖過量供給透過傳統的葡萄糖燃燒路徑（糖解作用與克氏循環）以及多元醇路徑導致 NADH 過度生成。這種 NAD+/NADH 失衡，亦稱為假性缺氧，最初造成還原壓力與粒線體超載及功能障礙，進而導致氧化壓力以及對 DNA、脂質與蛋白質的氧化損傷。此外，PARP 過度活化耗竭 NAD+，而此氧化還原失衡是促成糖尿病併發症發展的主要因素。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: RUNX1-KMT2A Epigenetic Program
nodes.description: Transient hyperglycemia exacerbates immune training and alone induces low-level TRIM with glycolysis-gene transcription; inhibition of KMT2A histone writers curbs TNF training. Diabetic training is centrally imprinted and adoptively transferable through RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming, promoting atherosclerosis. It underlies the concept of hyperglycemic memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 短暫 Hyperglycemia 可加劇 immune training，單獨即可誘導低程度 TRIM 並轉錄 glycolysis 基因；抑制 KMT2A histone writers 可減弱 TNF 訓練。糖尿病訓練是 centrally imprinted，可經由 RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming 被 adoptively transfer，並促進 atherosclerosis。這是 hyperglycemic memory 概念的基礎。

nodes.label: Peroxisome membrane assembly
nodes.description: PEX1 is an ATPase essential for peroxisome membrane assembly and matrix protein import, operating as part of the peroxisomal AAA (ATPases associated with diverse cellular activities) machinery. Loss of PEX1 causes a complete lack of functional peroxisomes, as import and biogenesis cannot proceed. This essential role makes PEX1 mutations among the most common causes of peroxisome biogenesis disorders. The gene thus sits at the foundation of peroxisome formation and metabolic competence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX1 是一種對過氧化體膜組裝和基質蛋白輸入至關必要的 ATPase，作為過氧化體 AAA（與多樣細胞活動相關的 ATPase）機械的一部分運作。PEX1 的缺失導致功能性過氧化體完全缺乏，因為輸入和生物發生無法進行。此必要角色使 PEX1 突變成為過氧化體生物發生障礙最常見的原因。因此該基因位居過氧化體形成和代謝能力的基礎。

nodes.label: PEX gene mutations
nodes.description: Zellweger syndrome, the most severe form of the Zellweger spectrum of peroxisome biogenesis disorders, is caused by mutations in PEX genes required for peroxisome assembly and matrix protein import. Affected individuals lack functional peroxisomes, leading to accumulation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid intermediates, and pipecolic acid, with profound neurologic, hepatic, and skeletal abnormalities. The spectrum's severity correlates with the degree of residual peroxisomal function. These disorders highlight the non-redundant essentiality of peroxisomes in human development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Zellweger 症候群是 Zellweger 譜系過氧化體生物發生障礙中最嚴重的形式，由組裝過氧化體和基質蛋白輸入所需的 PEX 基因突變所引起。患者缺乏功能性過氧化體，導致極長鏈脂肪酸、膽汁酸中間物和哌可酸（pipecolic acid）累積，伴隨嚴重的神經、肝臟和骨骼異常。此譜系的嚴重程度與殘餘過氧化體功能程度相關。這些障礙凸顯了過氧化體在人類發育中非冗余的必要性。

nodes.label: PEX1 mutation
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

nodes.label: Infantile Refsum Disease
nodes.description: Neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy (NALD) is an intermediate form of Zellweger spectrum disorders, less severe than Zellweger syndrome but more severe than infantile Refsum disease. All arise from autosomal recessive mutations in PEX genes essential for peroxisome biogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 新生兒腎上腺腦白質失養症（NALD）是 Zellweger 譜系障礙的中間形式，比 Zellweger 症候群輕微但比嬰兒型 Refsum 病嚴重。兩者皆源於對過氧化體生合成必需的 PEX 基因自體隱性突變。

nodes.label: Parasiticidal effect
nodes.description: Activation of GluCls in nematodes and arthropods drives Cl- influx, membrane hyperpolarization, flaccid paralysis and death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 線蟲和節肢動物中 GluCl 的活化會導致 Cl 流入、膜超極化、弛緩性麻痺和死亡。

nodes.label: GABA-gated chloride channels
nodes.description: Avermectins also potentiate invertebrate GABA-gated chloride channels; vertebrate GABA_A receptors require roughly 100-fold higher concentrations, underpinning selective safety.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Avermectins 也能增強無脊椎動物 GABA-gated chloride channels；脊椎動物 GABA_A 受體需要約高出 100 倍的濃度，以確保選擇性安全。

nodes.label: Anti-androgen
nodes.description: Enzalutamide is a nonsteroidal anti-androgen used in endocrine therapy of prostate cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 是一種非甾體抗雄激素，用於前列腺癌的內分泌治療。

nodes.label: Humans
nodes.description: Humans and other vertebrates lack glutamate-gated chloride channels, which underpins the selective safety of avermectin/ivermectin at therapeutic doses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Humans和其他脊椎動物缺乏穀氨酸門控氯離子通道，這支撐了阿維菌素/伊維菌素在治療劑量下的選擇性安全性。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Membrane
nodes.description: Ivermectin directly depolarizes mitochondrial membranes, raising Bax, lowering Bcl-2 and releasing cytochrome c. Distinct from fenbendazole's HK2-VDAC detachment route.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 直接去極化粒線體膜，升高 Bax、降低 Bcl-2 並釋放 cytochrome c。不同於 fenbendazole 的 HK2-VDAC 脫離路徑。

nodes.label: Brugia timori
nodes.description: Brugia timori is a filarial nematode, one of the three principal causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, geographically restricted to the Lesser Sunda Islands of eastern Indonesia. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels releasing microfilariae into the blood, and chronic infection causes lymphangiitis, hydrocele and elephantiasis; like other filariae it depends on Wolbachia endosymbionts for development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brugia timori 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia malayi 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大主要致病原之一，地理分布侷限於印尼東部的小巽他群島。成蟲寄生於淋巴管並將微絲蟲釋放至血液，慢性感染造成淋巴管炎、陰囊積液與象皮病；與其他絲蟲一樣，其發育仰賴 Wolbachia 內共生菌。

nodes.label: Miltefosine
nodes.description: Miltefosine is the only oral agent used against leishmaniasis; it is effective in the Indian subcontinent for visceral disease and is also used systemically for multiple, large or chronic cutaneous lesions and for mucocutaneous disease. Its use is limited by teratogenicity and by rising resistance, so systemic miltefosine and pentamidine serve as alternatives where amphotericin B is unsuitable.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Miltefosine 是唯一用於 leishmaniasis 的口服藥物；在印度次大陸對內臟型有效，也以全身性治療用於多發、大或慢性的皮膚病灶及黏膜皮膚型。其使用受限於致畸性與日益上升的抗藥性，因此在 amphotericin B 不適用時，miltefosine 與 pentamidine 可作為替代方案。

nodes.label: Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis
nodes.description: The Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis (GPELF) was launched by the World Health Organization in 2000 as one of the largest public-health drug-distribution efforts in history. WHO convenes and coordinates the programme, coordinating donated drug supply with endemic-country health ministries and non-governmental implementation partners, and its MDA strategy aims to suppress the microfilarial reservoir below the transmission threshold after 4–6 years of annual treatment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis (GPELF) 由 World Health Organization 於 2000 年發起，是史上最大规模的公共衛生藥物分發行動之一。WHO 負責召集與協調此計畫，連繫捐贈藥品供應、流行國衛生部門與非政府執行夥伴；其 MDA 策略目標是在連續每年治療 4–6 年後，將微絲蟲儲備量抑制到傳播門檻以下。
nodes.norm_label: global programme to eliminate lymphatic filariasis
nodes.source_file: Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis.md

nodes.label: Arginase
nodes.description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

nodes.label: Hemoglobin A1c
nodes.description: Hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized early glycation product, an Amadori product formed when glucose attaches non-enzymatically to the amino terminus of hemoglobin in red blood cells. It is used clinically as an indicator of blood glucose management in people with diabetes because its level reflects average glycemia over the preceding weeks. As an Amadori product, hemoglobin A1c is a reversible early intermediate on the pathway to irreversible advanced glycation end products. Its clinical utility demonstrates that even early, reversible glycation products are valuable biomarkers of glycation burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 糖化血色素 A1c（Hemoglobin A1c）是最廣為人知的早期糖化產物，是一種當葡萄糖非酵素性地附著於紅血球中血紅素的胺基端時所形成的阿馬多里產物（Amadori product）。它在臨床上用作糖尿病患者血糖控制的指標，因為其濃度反映前幾週的平均血糖狀態。作為一種阿馬多里產物，糖化血色素 A1c 是通往不可逆晚期糖化終產物路徑上的一個可逆早期中間產物。其臨床效用證明，即使是早期、可逆的糖化產物也是糖化負擔的有價值生物標記。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Fructosamine-3-phosphate
nodes.description: Fructosamine-3-phosphate is a highly unstable intermediate metabolite of the enzymatic deglycation pathway. It arises when Fructosamine-3-kinase phosphorylates Amadori products on glycated proteins, and because of its chemical instability it spontaneously decomposes to regenerate the original undamaged amino acid while releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. Its fleeting existence is what makes this deglycation route reversible.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fructosamine-3-phosphate 是酵素性去糖化途徑中高度不穩定的中間代謝物。它由 Fructosamine-3-kinase 磷酸化糖化蛋白上的 Amadori products 而生成，並因化學不穩定而自發分解，恢復原本未受損的胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，後者隨即被去毒酵素中和。其短暫的存在正是此去糖化途徑得以逆轉的關鍵。

nodes.label: Apoptotic and autophagic cell death (MCF-7)
nodes.description: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

nodes.label: Senescence-like growth arrest
nodes.description: Sirtinol induces senescence-like growth arrest in human lung cancer H1299 cells, consistent with sirtuin inhibition engaging tumor-suppressive programs. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of growth arrest. This phenotype mirrors aspects of SIRT1 loss and suggests that sirtuin blockers can blunt proliferation. The senescence-like arrest likely reflects reactivation of p53 and other tumor suppressors that sirtuins normally restrain. By demonstrating that sirtuin inhibition can induce growth arrest, sirtinol provided early evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 在人類肺癌 H1299 細胞中誘導衰老樣生長停滯，與 sirtuin 抑制啟動腫瘤抑制程式一致。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於生長停滯的上游。此表型反映了 SIRT1 缺失的某些方面，表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可以削弱增殖。衰老樣停滯可能反映了 p53 和其他 sirtuin 通常抑制的腫瘤抑制因子的重新活化。透過證明 sirtuin 抑制可以誘導生長停滯，Sirtinol 為 sirtuin 阻斷劑的抗癌潛力提供了早期證據。

nodes.label: Breast, lung, prostate and leukemia cancer cells
nodes.description: Sirtinol, a hydroxynaphthaldehyde derivative discovered in a phenotypic screen, is active against multiple sirtuin isoforms and has cytotoxic activity against cancer cells of different origins, including breast, lung, prostate, and leukemia cell lines. This broad anticancer activity made sirtinol the founding member of the beta-naphthol inhibitor family and seeded structure-activity programs that produced salermide, cambinol, and splitomicin. Directionally, sirtinol-mediated inhibition of sirtuin activity sits upstream of its cytotoxic effects on malignant cells, though its full target spectrum extends beyond sirtuins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 是一種在表型篩選中發現的羥基萘醛衍生物，對多種 sirtuin 同工型具有活性，並對不同來源的癌細胞具有細胞毒活性，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、前列腺癌和白血病細胞系。這種廣泛的抗癌活性使 Sirtinol 成為 β-萘酚抑制劑家族的創始成員，並啟動了產生 salermide、cambinol 和 splitomicin 的構效關係研究。方向性上 Sirtinol 介導的 sirtuin 活性抑制位於其對惡性細胞細胞毒作用的上游，儘管其完整的作用靶標範圍超越了 sirtuin。
nodes.norm_label: breast, lung, prostate and leukemia cancer cells
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: SIRT5 pockets B, C and substrate-binding site
