nodes.description: Co-crystallization of suramin with human SIRT5 revealed that suramin binds by occupying the nicotinamide ribose pocket (B-pocket), the nicotinamide pocket (C-pocket), and part of the substrate-binding site. This structural insight explains suramin's broad, high-affinity inhibition of multiple sirtuins and informed the design of more selective derivatives such as NF675. Directionally, suramin is the ligand and the SIRT5 catalytic cleft the receptor. The structure also illustrates general principles governing small-molecule engagement of the sirtuin NAD+/substrate channel.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Suramin 與人類 SIRT5 的共晶體結構揭示 Suramin 透過占据尼可醯胺核糖口袋（B 口袋）、尼可醯胺口袋（C 口袋）和部分受質結合位點進行結合。此結構見解解釋了 Suramin 對多種 sirtuin 的廣泛高親和力抑制作用，並為設計更具選擇性的衍生物如 NF675 提供了依據。方向性上 Suramin 是配體，SIRT5 催化溝槽是受體。此結構也闡明了小分子與 sirtuin NAD+/受質通道結合的一般原則。
nodes.norm_label: sirt5 pockets b, c and substrate-binding site
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: SIRT1-selective inhibitor
nodes.description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5
nodes.description: Suramin is a potent inhibitor of many sirtuins like SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5. The majority of known sirtuin inhibitors exclusively inhibit SIRT1 and/or SIRT2, however some also inhibit SIRT3 and SIRT5 with reduced affinity. Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines, and Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53, with both inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蘇拉明（Suramin）是多種 sirtuins 的強效抑制劑，包括 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT5。大多數已知的 sirtuin 抑制劑僅抑制 SIRT1 和/或 SIRT2，但也有部分抑制劑以較低親和力抑制 SIRT3 和 SIRT5。Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用，而 Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡，兩者均可抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Skin
nodes.description: Pentosidine is a cross-linking advanced glycation end product that accumulates in skin with age, together with argpyrimidine. It is also found to increase with age in the lamina cribrosa, lung collagen, patellar tendon, vitreous body, oocytes, intervertebral disk, and cartilage. Pentosidine is formed from the reaction of sugars with lysine and arginine residues and functions as a fluorescent AGE marker of cumulative glycation. Its age-dependent accumulation in skin and other connective tissues reflects the progressive cross-linking and stiffening of the extracellular matrix during aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pentosidine 是一種 cross-linking advanced glycation end product，會隨年齡與 argpyrimidine 一起堆積於 skin 中。它也發現會隨年齡在 lamina cribrosa、lung collagen、patellar tendon、vitreous body、oocytes、intervertebral disk 與 cartilage 中增加。Pentosidine 由 sugars 與 lysine 和 arginine residues 反應形成，並作為 cumulative glycation 的 fluorescent AGE marker。其在 skin 與其他 connective tissues 中隨年齡的 accumulation 反映了 aging 過程中 extracellular matrix 的漸進 cross-linking 與 stiffening。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Cancer cells to chemotherapy
nodes.description: Cambinol combination with chemotherapeutic agents dramatically sensitizes cancer cells to chemotherapy-induced apoptosis. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of enhanced chemosensitivity. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, it removes survival signals that protect tumor cells from drug-induced death, and this supports sirtuin inhibition as a chemosensitization strategy. The effect is particularly relevant in p53-wild-type tumors, where sirtuin inhibition reactivates p53-dependent apoptosis. Combination regimens of sirtuin inhibitors with conventional chemotherapy are therefore of significant clinical interest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cambinol 與化療藥物的組合顯著增敏癌細胞對化療誘導的凋亡。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於增強化療敏感性的上游。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，它移除保護腫瘤細胞免於藥物誘導死亡的存活訊號，支持 sirtuin 抑制作為化療增敏策略。此效應在 p53 野生型腫瘤中特別相關，因為 sirtuin 抑制可重新活化 p53 依賴性凋亡。因此 sirtuin 抑制劑與常規化療的組合方案具有重要的臨床意義。

nodes.label: Burkitt lymphoma cell lines
nodes.description: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Cancer cell migration and invasion
nodes.description: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

nodes.label: Cancer cell lines (MOLT4, MDA-MB-231, RKO)
nodes.description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

nodes.label: Proapoptotic genes (via H4K16ac)
nodes.description: Salermide inhibits SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of H4K16, leading to epigenetic reactivation of proapoptotic genes aberrantly repressed in cancer cells. Directionally, Salermide promotes H4K16 hyperacetylation, which drives apoptosis gene expression. This removes a chromatin-based survival brake and is a mechanistic rationale for sirtuin-inhibitor cancer therapy. By restoring H4K16ac at the promoters of pro-apoptotic genes, Salermide reverses the epigenetic silencing imposed by SIRT1. This illustrates how sirtuin inhibitors can act as epigenetic modulators to restore tumor-suppressive transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制 SIRT1 介導的 H4K16 去乙醯化，導致在癌細胞中異常被抑制的促凋亡基因的表觀遺傳重新活化。在方向性上，Salermide 促進 H4K16 超乙醯化，驅動凋亡基因表達。這移除了基於染色質的存活制動器，是 sirtuin 抑制劑癌症治療的機制性理由。透過在促凋亡基因啟動子上恢復 H4K16ac，Salermide 逆轉了 SIRT1 施加的表觀遺傳沉默。這說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑如何作為表觀遺傳調節因子來恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。

nodes.label: Colorectal cancer stem cells
nodes.description: Salermide inhibits colorectal carcinoma cancer-stem-cell self-renewal and reduces tumorigenesis, targeting the resilient stem-cell fraction. Directionally, Salermide sits upstream of stem-cell suppression. This is important because cancer stem cells drive relapse and resistance, and extending sirtuin-inhibitor effects to the tumor-initiation compartment has therapeutic significance. By suppressing self-renewal, Salermide reduces the population of cells capable of regenerating tumors. These findings suggest that sirtuin inhibitors may be effective against the most refractory cancer cell populations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制結腸直腸癌癌幹細胞的自我更新並減少腫瘤發生，靶向頑固的幹細胞群體。在方向性上，Salermide 位於抑制幹細胞的上游。這很重要，因為癌幹細胞驅動復發和抗藥性，將 sirtuin 抑制劑的效應延伸到腫瘤起始區室具有治療意義。透過抑制自我更新，Salermide 減少能夠再生腫瘤的細胞群。這些發現表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可能對最頑固的癌細胞群體有效。

nodes.label: D-lactate
nodes.description: D-lactate is a D-enantiomer of lactate generated as the terminal end product of the Glyoxalase System. Within that system GLO2 hydrolyzes the intermediate S-D-lactoylglutathione, releasing D-lactate while simultaneously regenerating the cellular antioxidant Glutathione, so the D-isomer marks the point at which methylglyoxal/glyoxal dicarbonyl stress has been resolved.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D-lactate 是乳酸的 D-對映異構物，為 Glyoxalase System 的最終產物。在該系統中，GLO2 水解中間產物 S-D-lactoylglutathione，釋出 D-lactate 的同時再生細胞抗氧化劑 Glutathione，因此 D-型標記著 methylglyoxal/glyoxal 二碳醣基壓力已被處理的終點。

nodes.label: G→T transversions
nodes.description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine causes G to T transversions because the oxidized base pairs promiscuously with adenine during replication, so a G:C pair becomes an A:T pair after a round of replication and repair. These transversions are signature mutations in many cancers. The directionality is miscoding lesion to mutagenic outcome. A caveat is that accurate repair by OGG1 before replication averts most mutations, so only unrepaired lesions are mutagenic. G to T transversions are among the most frequent mutations found in oncogenes and tumor suppressors in human cancers, underscoring the relevance of this lesion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 會導致 G 到 T 顛換，因為複製過程中氧化鹼基與腺嘌呤混雜配對，因此 G:C 對經過一輪複製和修復後變成 A:T 對。這些顛換是許多 cancer 的特徵突變。方向性是將病變錯誤編碼為誘變結果。需要注意的是，複製前透過 OGG1 進行的精確修復可以避免大多數突變，因此只有未修復的損傷才具有突變性。 G 至 T 顛換是人類 cancer 癌基因和腫瘤抑制基因中最常見的突變之一，強調了這種病變的相關性。

nodes.label: Pro-oxidants
nodes.description: Flavonoids can act as pro-oxidants at high concentrations because, in the presence of transition metals, they undergo autoxidation that generates semiquinone radicals and subsequently superoxide and H2O2. This biphasic behavior underlies their hormetic profile. The directionality is high-dose flavonoid to radical generation. A caveat is that pro-oxidant effects are favored by metal abundance and high dose, whereas low doses are generally antioxidant. This pro-oxidant behavior is implicated in their anticancer effects, where selective ROS generation can drive apoptosis in malignant cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 在高濃度下可以充當 pro-oxidants，因為在過渡金屬存在的情況下，它們會發生 autoxidation，生成半醌自由基，隨後生成超氧化物和 H2O2。这种双相行为是其毒物兴奋效应的基础。方向性是大剂量黄酮类物质向自由基生成。需要注意的是，金属丰度和高剂量有利于促氧化作用，而低剂量通常具有抗氧化作用。这种促氧化行为与它们的抗 cancer 作用有关，其中选择性 ROS 生成可以在恶性细胞中驱动 apoptosis。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide bioavailability
nodes.description: Genistein enhances nitric oxide bioavailability by upregulating eNOS expression and scavenging superoxide that would otherwise consume NO. The combined effect improves endothelial NO signaling. The directionality is isoflavone to increased bioavailable NO. A caveat is that genistein can also bind estrogen receptors, so part of its vascular benefit may be receptor-mediated rather than purely redox-based. Clinical studies report improved flow-mediated dilation after soy isoflavone intake, consistent with enhanced NO-dependent vasorelaxation in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Genistein 透過上調 eNOS 表現並清除超氧化物來增強 nitric oxide bioavailability，否則超氧化物會消耗 NO。綜合作用可改善內皮 NO 訊號傳導。異黃酮的方向性是增加生物可利用的一氧化氮。需要注意的是，genistein 還可以結合雌激素受體，因此其部分血管益處可能是受體介導的，而不是純粹基於氧化還原的。臨床研究報告稱，攝取大豆異黃酮後血流介導的擴張得到改善，這與體內 NO 依賴性血管舒張作用的增強一致。

nodes.label: Nucleic Acids
nodes.description: Nucleic acids are prone to damage by reactive oxygen species, particularly hydroxyl radicals, which attack both the sugar-phosphate backbone and nucleobases. Guanine is the most readily oxidized base, yielding 8-oxo-dG and strand lesions. The directionality is ROS to nucleic-acid modification. A caveat is that DNA is partly protected by histones, repair enzymes, and metal sequestration, so damage is non-uniform across the genome. Oxidative lesions accumulate with age and in numerous diseases, and their levels are widely used as biomarkers of oxidative exposure and damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nucleic acids 很容易被 reactive oxygen species，特別是 hydroxyl radicals 損壞，hydroxyl radicals 會攻擊糖磷酸主鏈和核鹼基。鳥嘌呤是最容易被氧化的鹼基，產生 8-oxo-dG 和鏈損傷。方向性是ROS到核酸修飾。需要注意的是，DNA 部分受到組蛋白、修復酵素和金屬隔離的保護，因此基因組中的損傷是不均勻的。氧化損傷隨著年齡的增長和在許多疾病中積累，其水平被廣泛用作氧化暴露和損傷的生物標記。

nodes.label: GSK-3beta
nodes.description: Oxidative stress activates GSK-3beta among other kinases, and the resulting hyperphosphorylation of tau promotes its dissociation from microtubules and aggregation. GSK-3beta is normally restrained by Akt but is released under oxidative and inflammatory conditions. The directionality is oxidant to kinase activation to tau modification. A caveat is that GSK-3beta has many substrates beyond tau, and its activity is regulated by phosphorylation independent of ROS. Because GSK-3beta is a central node in tau pathology, redox-driven kinase activation is considered an early event in Alzheimer's disease progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化其他激酶中的 GSK-3beta，由此產生的 tau 過度磷酸化促進其從微管解離和聚集。 GSK-3beta 通常受 Akt 抑制，但在氧化和發炎條件下釋放。方向性是氧化劑對激酶活化對tau修飾。需要注意的是，GSK-3beta 除了 tau 之外還有許多底物，且其活性受到磷酸化的調節，與 ROS 無關。由於 GSK-3beta 是 tau 病理學的中心節點，氧化還原驅動的激酶活化被認為是阿茲海默症進展的早期事件。

nodes.label: NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription
nodes.description: Oxidative stress activates NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription, as ROS activate the transcription factor to bind kappaB response elements in the VCAM-1 promoter. Elevated VCAM-1 then promotes leukocyte adhesion to endothelium. The directionality is oxidant to NF-kappaB to adhesion-molecule expression. A caveat is that many cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta) also induce VCAM-1, so ROS is one of several upstream activators. VCAM-1 upregulation is a key early step in atherogenesis, and its redox-sensitive induction links oxidative stress to leukocyte infiltration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化 NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription，因為 ROS 活化轉錄因子以結合 VCAM-1 啟動子中的 kappaB 反應元件。升高的 VCAM-1 會促進白血球與內皮細胞的黏附。 NF-κB 的方向性對黏附分子的表達具有氧化作用。需要注意的是，許多細胞激素（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta）也會誘導 VCAM-1，因此 ROS 是幾個上游活化劑之一。 VCAM-1 上調是動脈粥狀硬化形成的關鍵早期步驟，其氧化還原敏感誘導將 oxidative stress 與白血球浸潤聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Asthma severity
nodes.description: Oxidative stress correlates with asthma severity, with greater oxidant burden tracking with worse symptoms and higher exacerbation frequency. Biomarkers of lipid and protein oxidation rise during acute attacks. The directionality is oxidant load to clinical severity. A caveat is that correlation does not establish direction; severe asthma may also generate more ROS via eosinophil and NOX activity. These observations support the use of redox biomarkers in monitoring asthma control and evaluating antioxidant-based therapies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 與 asthma severity 相關，氧化負荷追蹤更大，症狀更嚴重，惡化頻率更高。在急性發作期間，脂質和蛋白質氧化的生物標記會升高。方向性是氧化負荷與臨床嚴重程度的關係。需要注意的是，相關性並不能確定方向；嚴重的asthma也可能透過嗜酸性粒細胞和NOX活性產生更多的ROS。這些觀察結果支持使用氧化還原生物標記物來監測 asthma 控制和評估基於抗氧化劑的療法。

nodes.label: Redox Imbalance
nodes.description: Oxidative stress is a redox imbalance in which reactive oxygen (and nitrogen) species production exceeds the capacity to detoxify them or repair the resulting damage. This definition frames oxidative stress as a dynamic disequilibrium rather than a single molecule. The directionality is imbalance between oxidants and defenses. A caveat is that transient oxidative shifts are physiological signaling events, so 'stress' specifically denotes sustained or excessive imbalance. This framing emphasizes that redox biology is bidirectional and that the severity of stress is determined by the balance of generation, defense, and repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 是一種 redox imbalance，其中活性氧（和氮）物質的產生超過了其解毒或修復所造成損害的能力。這個定義將 oxidative stress 視為動態不平衡而不是單一分子。方向性是氧化劑和防禦之間的不平衡。需要注意的是，短暫的氧化轉變是生理訊號事件，因此「壓力」特別指持續或過度的不平衡。這個框架強調氧化還原生物學是雙向的，壓力的嚴重程度由生成、防禦和修復的平衡決定。

nodes.label: 350 to 450 mg per 100g
nodes.description: Black elderberries provide roughly 350-450 mg cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit, with about 70-85 g reaching a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, berry content sits upstream of anthocyanin intake. Cyanidin is a powerful natural SIRT6 activator, and this positions elderberry as a dietary SIRT6-modulating food. The high anthocyanin content makes elderberry one of the richest natural sources of cyanidin, and its traditional use for immune support is consistent with the bioactivity of these compounds. Understanding the dose achievable from food is essential for interpreting dietary studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 黑接骨木莓每 100 克新鮮果實含有約 350-450 mg 花青素-3-葡萄糖苷，約 70-85 克即可達到 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，莓果含量位於花青素攝入量的上游。花青素是強效的天然 SIRT6 活化劑，這使接骨木莓成為飲食中的 SIRT6 調節食物。高花青素含量使接骨木莓成為花青素最豐富的天然來源之一，其傳統用於免疫支持與這些化合物的生物活性一致。理解從食物可達的劑量對於詮釋飲食研究至關重要。

nodes.label: Quinone
nodes.description: Quinones are organic compounds with a conjugated cyclic dione structure. The formation of a quinone moiety is the first step in the oxidation of catecholamines to aminochromes, where catechol hydroxyls are oxidized to carbonyl groups.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 醌（quinone）是具有共軛環狀二酮結構的有機化合物。醌部分的形成是兒茶酚胺氧化為 aminochrome 的第一步，其中兒茶酚羥基被氧化為羰基。

nodes.label: Renal Failure
nodes.description: Oxidative Stress is involved in a plethora of renal diseases including glomerulo- and tubule-interstitial nephritis, Renal Failure, Proteinuria and Uremia, linking redox imbalance to loss of kidney function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 涉及多種腎臟疾病，包括腎小球與腎小管間質性腎炎、Renal Failure、Proteinuria 與 Uremia，將氧化還原失衡與腎功能喪失連結起來。

nodes.label: premature ageing
nodes.description: Global SIRT7 depletion contributes to premature ageing, especially in the backbone, white adipose tissue, and the heart.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 的全身性缺乏促成早衰，尤其是在脊柱、白色脂肪組織和心臟中。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: DNA repair and chromatin compaction
nodes.description: SIRT7 depletion decreases DNA repair and compaction of chromatin, rendering cells more susceptible to genotoxic stressors. SIRT7 is a histone desuccinylase that functionally links to chromatin compaction and genome stability. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of reduced genomic stability and increased sensitivity to DNA damage, making SIRT7 important for protecting cells against genotoxic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭降低DNA修復和染色質壓縮，使細胞更容易受到基因毒性壓力源的影響。SIRT7是一種組蛋白去琥珀醯化酶，在功能上與染色質壓縮和基因組穩定性相關。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於基因組穩定性降低和DNA損傷敏感性增加的上游，使SIRT7對保護細胞免受基因毒性壓力至關重要。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: p38/MAPK signaling activation
nodes.description: SIRT7 depletion inhibits tumor growth by activating p38/MAPK signaling in breast cancer. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of p38/MAPK pathway activation, which suppresses tumor-cell expansion. Because SIRT7 normally restrains this growth-limiting signaling, its depletion unleashes p38/MAPK activity and curbs tumor growth. This positions SIRT7 as a tumor-promoting factor in breast cancer and identifies the p38/MAPK pathway as a downstream mediator.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭透過活化p38/MAPK訊號通路在乳腺癌中抑制腫瘤生長。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於p38/MAPK通路活化的上游，後者抑制腫瘤細胞擴增。因為SIRT7通常限制此生長限制性訊號，其耗竭釋放p38/MAPK活性並抑制腫瘤生長。這將SIRT7定位為乳腺癌中的促腫瘤因子，並將p38/MAPK通路確定為下游介導因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: GERD
nodes.description: Chronic reflux is the primary etiological driver of Barrett's-to-adenocarcinoma progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性逆流是 Barrett 至腺癌進展的主要病因驅動。

nodes.label: Barrett's Esophagus
nodes.description: The metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma cascade from Barrett's esophagus to adenocarcinoma is textbook.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Barrett 食道至腺癌的化生—異生—癌級聯是教科書等級。

nodes.label: hypomania and depression
nodes.description: Bipolar II Disorder is characterized by the occurrence of at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode, with hypomania representing a less severe form of mania that does not cause marked functional impairment or psychosis and does not require hospitalization. The depressive phases typically predominate in duration and disability, making depression the major source of impairment. Genetic variants including COMT and MTHFR have been explored as contributors to susceptibility through effects on catecholamine and methyl metabolism, though the associations are modest. The disorder is distinguished from Bipolar I by the absence of full manic episodes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bipolar II Disorder的特徵是發生至少一次輕躁症發作和至少一次重度憂鬱發作，輕躁症代表一種不太嚴重的躁狂形式，不會引起明顯的功能障礙或精神病，並且不需要住院治療。憂鬱階段通常在持續時間和殘疾方面占主導地位，這使得憂鬱症成為損害的主要來源。包括 COMT 和 MTHFR 在內的遺傳變異已被探索為透過影響兒茶酚胺和甲基代謝而導致易感性的因素，儘管這種關聯性不大。此疾病與 I 型雙極性情感疾患的差異在於不存在完全的躁症發作。

nodes.label: Lamotrigine
nodes.description: Lamotrigine is a first-line mood stabilizer for bipolar depression maintenance, delaying depressive relapse in Bipolar II. Its indication covers the predominant depressive pole of the disorder.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lamotrigine 是雙極憂鬱維持治療的第一線情緒穩定劑，延緩第二型雙極的憂鬱復發。其適應症涵蓋疾病主要的憂鬱極。

nodes.label: Lipid profile (raises HDL, reduces LDL oxidation)
nodes.description: The Mediterranean Diet raises HDL while reducing LDL oxidation through its polyphenol-rich components, improving the overall lipid profile. Directionally, the diet sits upstream of favorable lipid changes. This contributes to its cardiovascular protection, and resveratrol and other polyphenols are putative SIRT1-engaging contributors. By combining healthy fats with antioxidant polyphenols, the diet improves both the quantity and quality of circulating lipoproteins. These lipid effects are part of the broader cardiovascular benefit demonstrated in clinical trials of the Mediterranean diet.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 地中海飲食透過其富含多酚的成分提高 HDL 同時減少 LDL 氧化，改善整體血脂特徵。在方向性上，飲食位於有利脂質變化的上游。這有助於其心血管保護作用，resveratrol 和其他多酚是假定的 SIRT1 介入貢獻者。透過結合健康脂肪和抗氧化多酚，飲食同時改善了循環脂蛋白的數量和品質。這些脂質效應是地中海飲食臨床試驗中展示的更廣泛心血管益處的一部分。
nodes.norm_label: lipid profile (raises hdl, reduces ldl oxidation)

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Disease risk
nodes.description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

nodes.label: SIRT1 and RelA/p65
nodes.description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Complement System
nodes.description: Complement defects are central to Systemic Lupus Erythematosus pathogenesis: inherited C1q, C2 and C4 deficiency impairs clearance of apoptotic debris, while ongoing immune complex deposition in disease consumes C3 and C4, so low complement is both a genetic risk and a biomarker of active disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 補體系統缺陷是 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus 致病機制的核心：遺傳性的 C1q、C2、C4 缺乏會妨礙凋亡殘骸的清除，而疾病中持續的免疫複合體沉積又會消耗 C3 與 C4。因此補體偏低既是遺傳風險，也是疾病活動的生物標記。

nodes.label: MTHFD1 variants
nodes.description: Several MTHFD1 polymorphisms, such as the G1958A/R653Q missense variant, have been associated with altered enzyme kinetics and biomarkers of impaired folate metabolism. These variants are linked to elevated homocysteine and modified risk for neural tube defects and certain cancers. As with MTHFR, they can reduce the efficiency of methyl-group provision.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 若干 MTHFD1 多態性，例如 G1958A/R653Q 錯義變異，已與改變的酶動力學和葉酸代謝受損的生物標記相關。這些變異與 elevated homocysteine 以及神經管缺陷和某些癌症的風險改變有關。與 MTHFR 一樣，它們會降低甲基供給的效率。

nodes.label: MTRR A66G polymorphism
nodes.description: The common MTRR A66G (Ile22Met) polymorphism reduces reductase efficiency and is associated with elevated homocysteine, particularly when compounded by MTHFR or MethylB12 insufficiency. Genotyping MTRR helps identify individuals who benefit from active B12 forms. Such individuals may be vulnerable to methylation deficits that exacerbate slow-COMT sensitivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 常見的 MTRR A66G (Ile22Met) 多態性會降低還原酶效率，並與 elevated homocysteine 相關，尤其是在 MTHFR 或 MethylB12 不足同時存在時。MTRR 基因分型有助於識別受益於活性 B12 形式的個體。這類個體可能容易受到加重緩慢-COMT 敏感性的甲基化缺陷影響。

nodes.label: Immunoglobulin G
nodes.description: Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Indole
nodes.description: Indole and 5,6-indolequinone are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Indole and 5,6-indolequinone may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

nodes.label: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
nodes.description: Magnetic Resonance Imaging detects Neuromelanin using physical or chemical contrast properties specific to the pigment. Mechanistically, the technique reads signal generated by iron content, paramagnetism, or tracer binding to the pigment. This is significant because it enables non-invasive assessment of pigmented neuron integrity in health and Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that the signal is influenced by field strength, sequence, and confounders such as iron, requiring careful quantification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Magnetic Resonance Imaging 使用顏料特有的物理或化學對比特性來檢測 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，該技術讀取由 iron 內容、順磁性或與顏料結合的示踪劑產生的訊號。這很重要，因為它可以對健康和 Parkinson's disease 中的色素神經元完整性進行非侵入性評估。需要注意的是，訊號受到場強、序列和 iron 等混雜因素的影響，需要仔細量化。

nodes.label: Medulla Oblongata
nodes.description: Medulla Oblongata and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Medulla Oblongata and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Nicotine and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nicotine 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Nicotine 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Pons
nodes.description: Pons and Locus Coeruleus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Pons and Locus Coeruleus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

nodes.label: Flortaucipir
nodes.description: Flortaucipir binds to Neuromelanin through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Flortaucipir acts as the ligand or matrix and Neuromelanin as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flortaucipir 透過物理化學親和力與 Neuromelanin 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Flortaucipir 作為配體或基質，Neuromelanin 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

nodes.label: Leukoaminochrome
nodes.description: Leukoaminochrome condenses into polymeric neuromelanin pigment. Conversion records the generic leuco-aminochrome to pigment route.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 無色胺色素縮合為聚合的神經黑素色素。轉換記錄通用無色胺色素到色素路徑。

nodes.label: Dolichol
nodes.description: Dolichol resides within neuromelanin pigment granules of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Presence records the isoprenoid component of granule matrix.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dolichol 存在於黑質緻密部 neuromelanin 色素顆粒內。存在記錄顆粒基質的異戊二烯成分。

nodes.label: SIRT6 deficiency (macrophages)
nodes.description: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

nodes.label: SYK Kinase Signaling
nodes.description: Heme triggers a characteristic TRIM response with H3K27ac remodeling through SYK-dependent ROS generation rather than oxidative chemistry alone. Unlike oxLDL or HMGB1 training, heme training is mTOR-independent: rapamycin has no effect, while SYK inhibition with R406 blocks training. It defines an alternative DAMP-to-chromatin route.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Heme 透過 SYK-dependent ROS generation 而非僅靠氧化化學性質，觸發帶有 H3K27ac 重塑的典型 TRIM 反應。與 Oxidized LDL 或 HMGB1 訓練不同，Heme 訓練是 mTOR-independent：rapamycin 無效，而以 R406 抑制 SYK 可阻斷訓練。它定義了一條替代性的 DAMP-to-chromatin 路徑。

nodes.label: Hematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells
nodes.description: Systemic heme reaches the bone marrow and activates hematopoietic stem cells, increasing myeloid-lineage frequency and imprinting TRIM-related epigenetic changes. Adoptive progeny show in vivo resistance to bacterial sepsis. This is a central-training mechanism linking hemolysis/tissue damage to durable innate memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 全身性 Heme 可達骨髓並活化 hematopoietic stem cells，增加 myeloid-lineage 比例並印記 TRIM-related epigenetic changes。其子代細胞在 in vivo 對 bacterial sepsis 具抵抗力。這是將溶血／組織損傷與持久性先天記憶連結起來的 central-training 機制。

nodes.label: Ischemic preconditioning cardioprotection
nodes.description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

nodes.label: Sir2 in S. cerevisiae (weakly inhibits human SIRT1)
nodes.description: Splitomicin inhibits Sir2 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, but showed weaker inhibition on human SIRT1. Yeast Sir2 and human SIRT2 are inhibited by sirtinol. Directionally, these small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors (STICs) sit upstream of reduced sirtuin catalytic activity, with species- and isoform-selective potencies. Sirtuin inhibitors have also been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, in addition to cancer therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Splitomicin 抑制釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的 Sir2，但對人類 SIRT1 的抑制作用較弱。酵母 Sir2 和人類 SIRT2 均可被 sirtinol 抑制。從作用方向而言，這些小分子 sirtuin 抑制劑（STICs）位於降低 sirtuin 催化活性的上游，具有物種和亞型選擇性效能。除了癌症治療之外，sirtuin 抑制劑也被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療。
nodes.norm_label: sir2 in s. cerevisiae (weakly inhibits human sirt1)
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: LMO2 deacetylation
nodes.description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Resistance to microtubule inhibitors
nodes.description: SIRT2 inhibition or downregulation appears counterproductive in certain cancer contexts, particularly when combined with microtubule inhibitors, because loss of SIRT2 prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and makes cancer cells resistant to these agents. The enzyme normally helps cells exit mitosis cleanly; without it, cells linger in a prolonged arrested state that selects for survival. Directionally, low SIRT2 activity sits upstream of this resistance phenotype. This caveat limits the general anticancer rationale for SIRT2 inhibition and argues for careful context- and regimen-specific use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制或下調在某些癌症情境中看似適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合併使用時，因為 SIRT2 的缺失延長了慢性有絲分裂停滯，使癌細胞對這些藥物產生抗性。該酵素正常情況下幫助細胞順利退出有絲分裂；沒有它時，細胞會停留在延長的停滯狀態中，有利於存活。方向性上低 SIRT2 活性位於此抗性表型的上游。這一注意事項限制了 SIRT2 抑制的通用抗癌依據，並主張在使用時需謹慎考慮具體情境和治療方案。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: 14-3-3 protein
nodes.description: Once TFEB is phosphorylated at serine 211 by mTORC1, 14-3-3 proteins bind the phosphorylated motif and mask the transcription factor's nuclear localization signal. This cytosolic sequestration prevents TFEB from accessing CLEAR elements in the nucleus, thereby suppressing expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The 14-3-3 interaction thereby converts a single phosphorylation event into a durable spatial exclusion of TFEB. Disruption of this complex is a key step in starvation- and drug-induced TFEB activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一旦 TFEB 被 mTORC1 在 serine 211 磷酸化，14-3-3 蛋白即結合該磷酸化基序並遮蔽轉錄因子的核定位信號。這種細胞質隔離阻止 TFEB 接近核內的 CLEAR 元件，從而抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。14-3-3 的交互作用因此將單一磷酸化事件轉化為對 TFEB 的持久空間排除。此複合體的破壞是飢餓和藥物誘導 TFEB 活化中的關鍵步驟。

nodes.label: 20% of human cancers
nodes.description: The human SIRT3 gene is deleted in up to 20% of all human cancers analyzed overall, and in up to 40% of breast and ovarian cancers. This frequent deletion establishes SIRT3 as a tumor suppressor that acts through reactive oxygen species suppression and metabolic regulation. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of increased tumorigenesis susceptibility. By removing mitochondrial antioxidant protection, deletion of SIRT3 raises oxidative stress that can drive oncogenic signaling and genomic damage. The high deletion frequency, especially in breast and ovarian cancer, suggests SIRT3 status is an important determinant of cancer risk and may have prognostic value.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類SIRT3基因在所分析的所有人類癌症中高達20%被刪除，在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中高達40%被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除確立了SIRT3作為透過活性氧抑制和代謝調節發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT3缺失位於腫瘤發生易感性增加的上游。透過移除粒線體抗氧化保護，SIRT3的刪除增加了可驅動致癌訊號和基因組損傷的氧化壓力。高頻率的刪除，特別是在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中，表明SIRT3狀態是癌症風險的重要決定因素，可能具有預後價值。

nodes.label: 20S Proteasome
nodes.description: Carbonylated proteins are degraded by the 20S proteasome, which recognizes their unfolded, oxidized structure and degrades them independently of ubiquitin. This removes damaged proteins before they aggregate or lose function. The directionality is oxidized protein to proteasomal clearance. A caveat is that severe oxidation can form cross-links that resist degradation and instead promote aggregates, especially in aging and neurodegeneration. Because 20S degradation is ATP- and ubiquitin-independent, it provides a rapid, energy-sparing route for clearing mildly oxidized proteins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Carbonylated proteins 被 20S proteasome 降解，20S proteasome 識別其未折疊的氧化結構並獨立於泛素進行降解。這可以在損壞的 proteins 聚集或失去功能之前將其刪除。方向性是氧化蛋白到蛋白酶體清除。需要注意的是，嚴重氧化會形成 cross 連接，從而抵抗降解並促進聚集，特別是在 aging 和 neurodegeneration 中。由於 20S 降解不依賴 ATP 和泛素，因此它提供了一個快速、節能的途徑來清除輕度氧化的 proteins。

nodes.description: Ubiquitous overexpression of the Drosophila Sir2 ortholog (dSir2) extends female lifespan by about 29%, with a more modest or absent effect in males. The sexually dimorphic response reflects differences in nutrient sensing and reproductive physiology between the sexes, and it mirrors the pattern seen in worm and yeast models. Directionally, increased dSir2 acts upstream to produce the longevity phenotype, consistent with a conserved sirtuin-caloric-restriction axis. As in C. elegans and S. cerevisiae, the effect depends on genetic background, dietary conditions, and the level of expression achieved.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 果蠅 Sir2 直系同源物（dSir2）的全表達過量表達可延長雌性壽命約 29%，對雄性則效果較為溫和或無效。這種性別二態性反應反映了兩性之間營養感知和生殖生理學的差異，並且與線蟲和酵母模型中看到的模式相呼應。在方向性上，dSir2 增加在上游作用產生長壽表型，與保守的 sirtuin-熱量限制軸一致。與在 C. elegans 和 S. cerevisiae 中一樣，該效應取決於遺傳背景、飲食條件和所達到的表達水平。

nodes.description: Integration of an extra SIR2 copy in yeast increases replicative lifespan by up to about 30%, implicating Sir2 dosage directly in longevity. The mechanism involves reinforced silencing at rDNA repeats, which reduces spurious recombination and the accumulation of extrachromosomal rDNA circles that drive aging. This is a gain-of-function, directional relationship: more Sir2 yields longer lifespan, though the effect saturates and very high doses can be detrimental. The finding established the foundational idea that boosting sirtuin activity can extend lifespan in a simple eukaryote.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在酵母中整合額外的 SIR2 拷貝可使複製性壽命延長約 30%，直接將 Sir2 劑量與長壽聯繫起來。其機制涉及加強 rDNA 重複序列的沉默，減少異常重複組合和推動衰老的染色體外 rDNA 環的累積。這是一種功能增強的、方向性的關係：更多的 Sir2 產生更長的壽命，但這種效應會飽和，過高劑量可能有害。這一發現確立了增強 sirtuin 活性可以在簡單真核生物中延長壽命的基本理念。

nodes.label: 40% of methyl groups
nodes.description: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

nodes.label: Creatine synthesis
nodes.description: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

nodes.label: induced pluripotency
nodes.description: By targeting glycolytic enzymes, SIRT2 controls metabolic reprogramming during induced pluripotency. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of the metabolic switch from oxidative to glycolytic metabolism that accompanies reprogramming of somatic cells toward pluripotency. This metabolic control is essential for the establishment and function of primed human pluripotent stem cells, linking sirtuin activity to cell fate determination and stem cell biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過靶向糖解酶來控制誘導多能性期間的代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT2位於伴隨體細胞向多能性重編程的從氧化代謝到糖解代謝的代謝轉換的上游。這種代謝控制對於已啟動的人類多能幹細胞的建立和功能至關重要，將sirtuin活性與細胞命運決定和幹細胞生物學聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: SIRT2 overactivity
nodes.description: Direct SIRT2 activation is generally avoided therapeutically because overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, where excessive deacetylation may impair microtubule and protein-homeostasis defenses. Directionally, SIRT2 overactivity is associated with neuronal damage. Consequently, SIRT2 inhibitors are pursued for Parkinsons and Huntingtons disease, where preserving α-tubulin acetylation protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. This therapeutic direction contrasts with SIRT2s tumor-suppressive functions in other tissues, illustrating how the same enzyme can be targeted in opposite directions depending on disease context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 直接活化 SIRT2 通常在治療上被避免，因為其過度活性與神經退行性疾病背景下的神經毒性相關，過度去乙醯化可能損害微管和蛋白質穩態防禦。在方向性上，SIRT2 過度活性與神經元損傷相關。因此，SIRT2 抑制劑正在帕金森症和亨丁頓症的研究中被追求，保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化可以保護神經元免受聚集毒性。這種治療方向與 SIRT2 在其他組織中的腫瘤抑制功能形成對比，說明同一酶如何根據疾病情境被朝相反方向靶向。

nodes.label: TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation
nodes.description: Genetic knockdown and chemical inhibition of SIRT2 attenuate TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation and MDM2 expression, reducing fibrogenic responses. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition leads to less TGF-β1 fibroblast activation. This is unusual because it implies SIRT2 can promote, rather than suppress, fibrosis in this context, unlike the antifibrotic SIRT1, SIRT3, and SIRT6. It underscores the context-dependence of sirtuin-fibrosis relationships and suggests that SIRT2 inhibition might be antifibrotic in specific settings. The MDM2 connection links SIRT2 to p53 regulation during fibroblast activation, adding mechanistic depth to the observation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基因敲低和化學抑制 SIRT2 減弱 TGF-β1 誘導的纖維母細胞活化和 MDM2 表達，減少纖維化反應。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制導致較少的 TGF-β1 纖維母細胞活化。這是不尋常的，因為它暗示 SIRT2 在此情境下可以促進而非抑制纖維化，不同於抗纖維化的 SIRT1、SIRT3 和 SIRT6。它強調了 sirtuin-纖維化關係的情境依賴性，並提示 SIRT2 抑制可能在特定環境中具有抗纖維化作用。MDM2 的聯繫將 SIRT2 與纖維母細胞活化期間的 p53 調節聯繫起來，為觀察結果增加了機制深度。

nodes.label: IDH1 (repressing CRC migration)
nodes.description: In human colorectal cancer, SIRT2-dependent deacetylation of the metabolic enzyme IDH1 represses cancer cell migration and invasion both in vitro and in vivo. This regulation of IDH1 influences cellular metabolism and inhibits the formation of liver metastases. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of IDH1 sits upstream of suppressed colorectal cancer metastasis. By modulating IDH1 and the metabolic state of the tumor cell, SIRT2 limits the invasive capacity that drives metastatic spread. This positions SIRT2 as a suppressor of colorectal cancer progression and indicates that preserving SIRT2 activity, or mimicking its effects, could restrain metastasis in this malignancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在人類大腸直腸癌中，SIRT2依賴性的代謝酶IDH1去乙醯化在體外和體內抑制癌細胞遷移和侵襲。此IDH1的調節影響細胞代謝並抑制肝臟轉移瘤的形成。方向上，SIRT2對IDH1的酵素修飾位於大腸直腸癌轉移抑制的上游。透過調節IDH1和腫瘤細胞的代謝狀態，SIRT2限制了驅動轉移性擴散的侵襲能力。這將SIRT2定位為大腸直腸癌進展的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT2活性或模擬其效果可能限制此惡性腫瘤的轉移。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer cells
nodes.description: Overexpression of SIRT2 significantly enhances the sensitivity of cisplatin-resistant counterpart ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells. By increasing the vulnerability of these cells to cisplatin, SIRT2 may help overcome platinum resistance, a major obstacle in ovarian cancer treatment. This suggests that strategies to augment SIRT2 activity could improve the efficacy of cisplatin-based therapy in resistant disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2的過表達顯著增強順鉑耐藥性對應卵巢癌細胞對順鉑的敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於耐藥卵巢癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過增加這些細胞對順鉑的脆弱性，SIRT2可能有助於克服鉑耐藥性，這是卵巢癌治療中的主要障礙。這表明增強SIRT2活性的策略可能提高耐藥性疾病中順鉑基治療的效果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: FOXOs
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates FOXO1 and FOXO3a, promoting their nuclear accumulation and target-gene activation (e.g., stress resistance, gluconeogenesis, and cell survival) in a manner analogous to SIRT1-FOXO coupling, making FOXOs downstream effectors and listed positive regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 FOXO1 和 FOXO3a，促進它們的核積累和靶基因活化（例如抗壓、糖質新生和細胞存活），類似於 SIRT1-FOXO 的耦合方式，使 FOXOs 成為 SIRT2 通路的下游效應因子和被列出的正向調節因子（Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: PPP
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates G6PD in the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP) at Lys403, activating it to promote NADPH production and antioxidant defense; the PPP thus serves as a downstream effector of SIRT2 and is listed among its positive pathway regulators (Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在磷酸戊糖途徑（PPP）中去乙醯化 G6PD 的 Lys403，活化它以促進 NADPH 產生和抗氧化防禦；因此 PPP 作為 SIRT2 的下游效應因子被列為其正向通路調節因子（Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: AKR1C1
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates aldo-keto reductase family 1 member C1 (AKR1C1), and this modification inhibits transactivation of STAT3 target genes, suppressing migration of non-small-cell lung cancer cells both in vitro and in xenograft models. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of AKR1C1 sits upstream of reduced STAT3-driven metastasis. By restraining STAT3 transcriptional activity, SIRT2 limits the invasive and migratory phenotype that contributes to lung cancer progression. This tumor-suppressive axis contrasts with SIRT2's pro-tumorigenic stabilization of Myc in other settings, reinforcing the context-dependence of sirtuin biology in oncology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2去乙醯化醛酮還原酶家族1成員C1（AKR1C1），此修飾抑制STAT3靶基因的轉活化，在體外和異種移植模型中抑制非小細胞肺癌細胞的遷移。方向上，SIRT2對AKR1C1的酵素修飾位於STAT3驅動的轉移減少的上游。透過抑制STAT3轉錄活性，SIRT2限制了促進肺癌進展的侵襲和遷移表型。此腫瘤抑制軸與SIRT2在其他環境中對Myc的促腫瘤穩定化形成對比，強化了sirtuin生物學在腫瘤學中的環境依賴性。

nodes.label: H4K16ac
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates histone H4 Lys16 during the G2/M transition, promoting mitotic chromatin condensation (Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期間去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 Lys16，促進有絲分裂染色質凝縮（Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: transcription factor deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates transcription factors including NF-kB/p65, p53, FOXO1, and FOXO3a, generally restraining their pro-inflammatory/apoptotic output while shaping metabolic and stress programs; this cytoplasmic transcription-factor control complements SIRT2's tubulin and mitotic functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化包括 NF-kB/p65、p53、FOXO1 和 FOXO3a 在內的轉錄因子，通常抑制其促發炎/凋亡輸出，同時塑造代謝和壓力反應程序；這種細胞質轉錄因子的控制補充了 SIRT2 的 tubulin 和有絲分裂功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
nodes.description: SIRT2 downregulation or chemical inhibition induces anticancer effects that include p53 accumulation, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis, mirroring the tumor-suppressive functions of the enzyme. Loss of SIRT2 permits mitotic regulators such as Aurora-A/Aurora-B to accumulate, destabilizing division and forcing checkpoint engagement. The relationship is directional: reduced SIRT2 activity leads to p53 stabilization and arrest. A caveat is that SIRT2 inhibition can be counterproductive in some contexts, notably alongside microtubule inhibitors where it prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and confers resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 下調或化學抑制會產生抗癌效果，包括 p53 累積、細胞週期停滯和凋亡，反映了該酵素的腫瘤抑制功能。SIRT2 的缺失允許有絲分裂調節因子如 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 累積，使細胞分裂不穩定並強迫檢查點啟動。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 活性降低導致 p53 穩定化和停滯。但需要注意的是，SIRT2 抑制在某些情境下可能適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合用時，會延長慢性有絲分裂停滯並賦予抗藥性。
nodes.norm_label: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Th2 responses and macrophage polarization
nodes.description: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation by upregulating T-helper type 2 responses and macrophage polarization. Pharmacologic ablation of SIRT2 attenuates, while genetic SIRT2 overexpression exaggerates, the allergic asthmatic phenotype. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Th2-driven allergic inflammation. By promoting the type 2 immune response characteristic of asthma, SIRT2 amplifies airway inflammation and the associated pathology. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a candidate therapeutic approach for allergic asthma, since reducing SIRT2 activity could dampen Th2 responses and macrophage-mediated inflammation, providing a potential strategy to modulate the severity of the disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過上調T輔助細胞第2型反應和巨噬細胞極化來增強過敏性氣喘發炎。藥理學消除SIRT2可減輕，而基因SIRT2過表達則加重過敏性氣喘表型。方向上，SIRT2位於Th2驅動的過敏性發炎的上游。透過促進氣喘特徵性的第2型免疫反應，SIRT2放大氣道發炎和相關病理。這使SIRT2抑制成為過敏性氣喘的候選治療方法，因為降低SIRT2活性可能抑制Th2反應和巨噬細胞介導的發炎，提供調節疾病嚴重程度的潛在策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: N-Myc and c-Myc
nodes.description: SIRT2 enhances the protein stability of the oncogenic transcription factors N-Myc and c-Myc, promoting cancer cell proliferation. This represents an oncogenic function of SIRT2 that is distinct from its tumor-suppressive roles in other cellular contexts. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Myc stabilization and enhanced proliferation. By protecting these potent oncogenes from degradation, SIRT2 can support the growth of Myc-driven tumors, complicating the simple view of sirtuins as universal tumor suppressors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2增強致癌轉錄因子N-Myc和c-Myc的蛋白穩定性，促進癌細胞增殖。這代表了SIRT2的一個致癌功能，與其在其他細胞環境中的腫瘤抑制作用不同。方向上，SIRT2位於Myc穩定化和增殖增強的上游。透過保護這些強效癌基因免受降解，SIRT2可以支持Myc驅動的腫瘤生長，使sirtuin作為普遍腫瘤抑制因子的簡單觀點變得複雜。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Cervical cancer progression
nodes.description: SIRT2 expression is decreased in cervical cancer tissue versus adjacent normal tissue, and higher SIRT2 predicts favorable survival, indicating it suppresses cervical cancer progression. Directionally, SIRT2 loss is associated with, and putatively enables, tumor advancement. Its deacetylase actions on metabolic and mitotic substrates likely enforce differentiation and genome stability, restraining the aggressive features of cervical cancer. This adds to the context-dependent tumor-suppressor face of SIRT2, which can also promote tumors by stabilizing oncogenes such as c-Myc in other settings, underscoring the tissue- and context-specificity of SIRT2's role in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在宮頸癌組織中與鄰近正常組織相比表達降低，較高的 SIRT2 預測良好的生存率，表明其抑制宮頸癌進展。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失與腫瘤進展相關，並推定為促進因素。其對代謝和有絲分裂受質的去乙醯酶作用可能實施分化和基因組穩定性，限制宮頸癌的侵襲性特徵。這增加了 SIRT2 情境依賴性腫瘤抑制的一面，SIRT2 也可以通過在其他情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因來促進腫瘤，突顯 SIRT6 在癌症中作用的組織和情境特異性。

nodes.label: BubR1 progeroid mice
nodes.description: SIRT2 extends lifespan in BubR1 progeroid mice, as reported in the longevity/aging literature, supporting a role in cell-cycle and proteostatic regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 BubR1 早衰小鼠中延長壽命，這在長壽/衰老文獻中已有報導，支持其在細胞週期和蛋白質恆定調節中的角色。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: oxidative damage
nodes.description: SIRT2 has a role in neurodegeneration and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of neuronal resilience against oxidative stress. Although SIRT2 is overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders such as Parkinson's disease, its ability to shield neurons from oxidative injury suggests a protective function in specific contexts, and SIRT2 remains a candidate target for neuroprotective strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2在神經退行性疾病中具有作用，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。方向上，SIRT2位於神經元對氧化壓力的韌性的上游。儘管SIRT2在帕金森氏症等神經退行性疾病中過表達，但它保護神經元免受氧化損傷的能力表明在特定環境中的保護功能，SIRT2仍然是神經保護策略的候選靶點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Cell cycle regulation
nodes.description: SIRT2 is a cytoplasmic/mitotic deacetylase that regulates cytokinesis and the G2/M transition, supporting genomic stability and mitotic fidelity; age-related SIRT2 decline impairs these cell-cycle checkpoints (source review; North & Verdin review of SIRT2 mitotic roles).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種細胞質/有絲分裂去乙醯酶，調節細胞質分裂和 G2/M 轉換，支持基因組穩定性和有絲分裂忠實度；與年齡相關的 SIRT2 下降損害這些細胞週期檢查點（文獻綜述；North & Verdin 關於 SIRT2 有絲分裂角色的綜述）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells
nodes.description: SIRT2 is expressed in oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells, the myelin-forming glia of the CNS and PNS respectively, where it deacetylates α-tubulin and regulates microtubule stability. Its presence in myelinating cells ties SIRT2 to axonal support, myelin integrity, and the cytoskeletal dynamics required for glial process extension. Directionally, SIRT2 acts within glia to control cytoskeletal organization. Dysregulation of SIRT2 is implicated in demyelinating and neurodegenerative conditions, and because α-tubulin acetylation is protective in axons, the balance of SIRT2 activity in myelinating glia is thought to influence both myelination and axonal health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在寡突膠質細胞和雪旺細胞（分別為中樞和周圍神經系統的髓鞘形成膠質細胞）中表達，在此處去乙醯化 α-tubulin 並調節微管穩定性。其在髓鞘形成細胞中的存在將 SIRT2 與軸突支持、髓鞘完整性和膠質突起延伸所需的細胞骨架動態聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT2 在膠質細胞內控制細胞骨架組織。SIRT2 的失調與脫髓鞘和神經退行性疾病有關，且由於 α-tubulin 乙醯化在軸突中具有保護作用，髓鞘形成膠質中 SIRT2 活性的平衡被認為影響髓鞘形成和軸突健康。

nodes.label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffolds
nodes.description: SIRT2 is inhibited by kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against the enzyme on the rationale that sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. The bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, alongside the general Kinase enzyme family that shares the adenosine pocket. Directionally, the shared adenosine-binding site of SIRT2 and protein kinases underlies this cross-inhibition. Because these scaffolds retain kinase activity, their cellular effects reflect a combination of kinase and sirtuin blockade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 被激酶抑制劑骨架抑制，這些骨架透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對該酵素的活性而被鑑定，其原理是 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與共享腺嘌呤口袋的激酶酶家族並列。方向性上 SIRT2 和蛋白激酶共享的腺嘌呤結合位點奠定了這種交叉抑制的基礎。由於這些骨架保留了激酶活性，其細胞效應反映了激酶和 sirtuin 阻斷的組合。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: tubulin deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT2 is the first identified tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule stability and dynamics; this underlies SIRT2's mitotic roles and explains why SIRT2 inhibitors, by preserving tubulin acetylation, protect neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's disease models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是第一個被發現的 tubulin 去乙醯酶，它移除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基團以調節微管穩定性和動態性；這構成了 SIRT2 有絲分裂功能的基礎，也解釋了為什麼 SIRT2 抑制劑透過保留 tubulin 乙醯化，在帕金森氏症和亨廷頓氏症模型中保護神經元。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Tubulin deacetylase
nodes.description: SIRT2 is the predominantly cytoplasmic sirtuin that functions as a tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule dynamics and mitotic fidelity. Because it deacetylates tubulin and other mitotic regulators, SIRT2 loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora-A and Aurora-B in check during division, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Directionally, SIRT2's tubulin deacetylase activity is an upstream determinant of normal chromosome segregation, linking sirtuin biology to mitotic stability and tumor suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要位於細胞質的 sirtuin，作為微管蛋白去乙醯酶功能，去除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基以調節微管動態和有絲分裂精準度。由於其去乙醯化 tubulin 和其他有絲分裂調節因子，SIRT2 缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的機制，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。方向性上 SIRT2 的微管蛋白去乙醯酶活性是正常染色體分離的上游決定因素，將 sirtuin 生物學與有絲分裂穩定性和腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: cell-cycle control
nodes.description: SIRT2 peaks at the G2/M transition and deacetylates H4K16, alpha-tubulin, and mitotic regulators, promoting chromatin condensation and mitotic fidelity; its loss raises Aurora-A/B and causes aneuploidy, linking SIRT2 to cell-cycle control and genomic stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，並去乙醯化 H4K16、α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子，促進染色質凝縮和有絲分裂忠實度；其缺失會增加 Aurora-A/B 水平並導致非整倍體，將 SIRT2 與細胞週期控制和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: BRCA1 deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT2 promotes BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimerization through deacetylation of BRCA1, facilitating assembly of the repair complex required for homologous recombination. This supports genome maintenance and tumor suppression by enabling high-fidelity repair of DNA double-strand breaks. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic licensing of BRCA1 sits upstream of repair complex formation. By promoting homologous recombination, SIRT2 helps cells repair potentially oncogenic DNA damage accurately rather than through error-prone pathways. This links SIRT2 to DNA repair fidelity and explains part of its tumor-suppressive activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化BRCA1促進BRCA1-BARD1異源二聚化，促進同源重組所需的修復複合物組裝。這透過實現DNA雙鏈斷裂的高保真修復來支持基因組維護和腫瘤抑制。方向上，SIRT2對BRCA1的酵素許可位於修復複合物形成的上游。透過促進同源重組，SIRT2幫助細胞準確修復潛在致癌的DNA損傷，而非透過易錯途徑。這將SIRT2與DNA修復保真度聯繫起來，並解釋了其部分腫瘤抑制活性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: endometrial cancer stemness and chemoresistance via MEK/ERK
nodes.description: SIRT2 promotes cell stemness and activates the MEK/ERK signaling pathway while repressing chemosensitivity in endometrial cancer. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stem-like phenotypes and MEK/ERK-dependent survival in endometrial cancer cells. By enhancing stemness and ERK signaling, SIRT2 supports tumor self-renewal and reduces responsiveness to chemotherapy. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a potential strategy to sensitize endometrial cancer to treatment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2促進細胞幹性並活化MEK/ERK訊號通路，同時抑制子宮內膜癌的化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於子宮內膜癌細胞中幹細胞樣表型和MEK/ERK依賴性存活的上游。透過增強幹性和ERK訊號，SIRT2支持腫瘤自我更新並降低對化療的反應性。這使SIRT2抑制成為使子宮內膜癌對治療敏感的潛在策略。
nodes.norm_label: endometrial cancer stemness and chemoresistance via mek/erk
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: HIF-1 activity
nodes.description: SIRT2 regulates HIF-1 activity, which is important for tumour hypoxia responses. HIF-1 protein stability and transcriptional activity are both negatively influenced by SIRT2, with SIRT2-mediated deacetylation necessary for HIF-1α destabilisation and the tumour cell hypoxia response. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of reduced HIF-1α abundance and activity, thereby restraining hypoxia-driven transcriptional programs in tumour cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2調節HIF-1活性，這對腫瘤缺氧反應很重要。HIF-1蛋白穩定性和轉錄活性都受到SIRT2的負向影響，SIRT2介導的去乙醯化對於HIF-1α不穩定化和腫瘤細胞缺氧反應是必要的。方向上，SIRT2位於HIF-1α豐度和活性降低的上游，從而抑制腫瘤細胞中的缺氧驅動的轉錄程序。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Glioma tumour formation
nodes.description: SIRT2 resides in a genomic region frequently deleted in human gliomas, and re-expression of SIRT2 markedly reduces colony formation by glioma cells, indicating tumor-suppressor function. Its activity deacetylates substrates such as α-tubulin and HNF4α that govern mitotic fidelity and metabolism, helping to preserve genomic stability during division. Directionally, SIRT2 loss permits gliomagenesis while SIRT2 restoration suppresses it. A caveat is that SIRT2 can act as either a tumor suppressor or a promoter depending on tissue and context—stabilizing oncogenes like c-Myc in some settings—so its role in cancer is highly context-dependent and cell-type-specific.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 位於人類膠質瘤中頻繁缺失的基因組區域，SIRT2 的重新表達顯著減少膠質瘤細胞的集落形成，表明其具有腫瘤抑制功能。其活性去乙醯化 α-tubulin 和 HNF4α 等受質，調節有絲分裂忠實度和代謝，有助於在細胞分裂期間維持基因組穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失允許膠質瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的恢復則抑制它。需要注意的是，SIRT2 可以根據組織和情境充當腫瘤抑制因子或促進因子——在某些情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因——因此其在癌症中的作用高度取決於情境和細胞類型。

nodes.label: FoxO1 deacetylation
nodes.description: SIRT2 suppresses adipocyte differentiation through deacetylation of the transcription factor FoxO1, which reinforces FoxO1-mediated repression of PPARgamma. Consistent with this, reduced SIRT1 and SIRT2 expression in visceral adipose stem cells from obese individuals correlates with enhanced adipogenic capacity and visceral fat expansion. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of FoxO1-dependent anti-adipogenic programs. By keeping FoxO1 active in repressing PPARgamma, SIRT2 restrains the conversion of precursor cells into mature adipocytes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化轉錄因子FoxO1來抑制脂肪細胞分化，這加強了FoxO1對PPARgamma的抑制。與此一致，肥胖者內臟脂肪幹細胞中SIRT1和SIRT2表達的降低與脂肪生成能力的增強和內臟脂肪擴張相關。方向上，SIRT2位於FoxO1依賴性抗脂肪生成程序的上游。透過保持FoxO1在抑制PPARgamma方面的活性，SIRT2限制了前體細胞向成熟脂肪細胞的轉化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: SirReal2
nodes.description: SirReal2 is a potent SIRT2 inhibitor, with an IC50 of 0.14 μM and minimal effects on SIRT1 and SIRT3, exploiting a SIRT2-specific binding pocket. Directionally, SirReal2 blocks SIRT2 deacetylase activity. It is a key chemical probe for SIRT2 biology in neurodegeneration and cancer, and its selectivity makes it valuable for isolating SIRT2-specific effects from the broader sirtuin family. Because SIRT2 inhibition protects neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's models, SirReal2's selectivity positions it as a candidate scaffold for therapeutic development in neurodegenerative disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SirReal2 是一種強效的 SIRT2 抑制劑，IC50 為 0.14 μM，對 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 影響極小，利用 SIRT2 特異性結合口袋。在方向性上，SirReal2 阻斷 SIRT2 去乙醯酶活性。它是神經退行性疾病和癌症中 SIRT2 生物學的關鍵化學探針，其選擇性使其在區分 SIRT2 特異性效應與更廣泛 sirtuin 家族時具有價值。由於 SIRT2 抑制在帕金森症和亨丁頓症模型中保護神經元，SirReal2 的選擇性使其定位為神經退行性疾病治療開發的候選骨架。

nodes.label: NSCLC cell lines and metastatic melanoma
nodes.description: The level of SIRT2 is upregulated in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines and in metastatic human melanoma tissues compared to healthy cells and tissues. Directionally, SIRT2 expression is increased in these aggressive cancer contexts. In metastatic melanoma, SIRT2 levels are increased compared to tumours of early stage, suggesting involvement of SIRT2 in the advancement of metastatic disease. SIRT2 therefore represents a potential biomarker and drug target in NSCLC and metastatic melanoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2在非小細胞肺癌細胞系和轉移性人類黑色素瘤組織中與健康細胞和組織相比表現為上調。方向上，SIRT2表達在這些侵襲性癌症環境中增加。在轉移性黑色素瘤中，SIRT2水平與早期腫瘤相比增加，表明SIRT2參與了轉移性疾病的進展。因此SIRT2在NSCLC和轉移性黑色素瘤中代表了潛在的生物標誌物和藥物靶點。
nodes.norm_label: nsclc cell lines and metastatic melanoma
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: CDC14B
nodes.description: The phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2, triggering its ubiquitination and 26S proteasomal degradation, which promotes exit from mitosis. Directionally, CDC14B sits upstream of SIRT2 destabilization. This couples SIRT2 turnover to cell-cycle progression, and it ensures SIRT2 levels fall as cells complete division. By dephosphorylating SIRT2 at mitotic exit, CDC14B inactivates and degrades the enzyme that was active during G2/M. This regulatory circuit links SIRT2 abundance to the cell cycle and explains the oscillation of SIRT2 levels during division.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2，觸發其泛素化和 26S 蛋白酶體降解，促進有絲分裂退出。在方向性上，CDC14B 位於 SIRT6 不穩定化的上游。這將 SIRT6 周轉與細胞週期進程偶聯，並確保 SIRT6 水平在細胞完成分裂時下降。透過在有絲分裂退出時去磷酸化 SIRT6，CDC14B 使在 G2/M 期間活化的酶失活並降解。此調控迴路將 SIRT6 豐度與細胞週期聯繫起來，並解釋了 SIRT6 水平在分裂過程中的振盪。

nodes.label: cisplatin sensitivity in NSCLC
nodes.description: Upregulation of SIRT2 in non-small-cell lung cancer cells increases their sensitivity to cisplatin treatment, while the opposite modulation reduces responsiveness. Directionally, SIRT2 levels sit upstream of platinum chemosensitivity in NSCLC. Higher SIRT2 expression renders tumor cells more vulnerable to cisplatin-induced killing, suggesting that SIRT2 activity could be exploited to improve the efficacy of platinum-based therapy in lung cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非小細胞肺癌細胞中SIRT2的上調增加了它們對順鉑治療的敏感性，而相反的調節則降低反應性。方向上，SIRT2水平位於NSCLC鉑化療敏感性的上游。較高的SIRT2表達使腫瘤細胞更容易受到順鉑誘導的殺傷，表明SIRT2活性可以被利用來提高肺癌中鉑基治療的效果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: NFATc2
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates NFATc2, attenuating agonist-induced cardiac hypertrophy. Loss of SIRT2 reduces AMPK, promoting aging-related and angiotensin II-induced hypertrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 NFATc2，減輕促效劑誘導的心臟肥大。SIRT2 缺失降低 AMPK，促成老化相關與血管緊張素 II 誘導的肥大。

nodes.label: GKRP
nodes.description: SIRT2 promotes glucose-dependent hepatic glucose uptake by deacetylating GKRP at K126. GKRP is an inhibitory binding partner of glucokinase, and its acetylation state modulates the threshold for hepatic glucose phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過在 K126 去乙醯化 GKRP 來促進葡萄糖依賴的肝臟葡萄糖攝取。GKRP 是葡萄糖激酶的抑制性結合夥伴，其乙醯化狀態調控肝臟葡萄糖磷酸化的門檻。

nodes.description: A chromosomal duplication that increases sir-2.1 dosage in C. elegans extends lifespan by up to approximately 50%, paralleling the yeast finding in a multicellular organism. The longevity effect depends on intact insulin/IGF-1-like signaling, because sir-2.1 acts downstream of the DAF-2 pathway to promote stress resistance. The relationship is directional: elevated sir-2.1 produces the lifespan gain. A key caveat is that the requirement for DAF-16 (FOXO) ties sirtuin longevity to the conserved FOXO transcription-factor network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在秀丽隱桿線蟲（C. elegans）中，增加 sir-2.1 劑量的染色體複製可延長壽命約 50%，在多細胞生物中與酵母的發現相呼應。這種長壽效應依賴於完整的胰島素/IGF-1 類似信號通路，因為 sir-2.1 在 DAF-2 通路下游作用以促進壓力抗性。其方向性為：sir-2.1 升高產生壽命延長。一個關鍵的注意事項是，對 DAF-16（FOXO）的需求將 sirtuin 長壽與保守的 FOXO 轉錄因子網絡聯繫起來。

nodes.description: A chromosomal duplication that increases sir-2.1 dosage in C. elegans extends lifespan by up to approximately 50%, paralleling the yeast finding in a multicellular organism. nodes.label: 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation
nodes.description: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

nodes.label: AAV-CentSIRT6
nodes.description: AAV-mediated delivery of centenarian SIRT6 reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in HGPS patient-derived fibroblasts, validating the variant's silencing function in progeria. Directionally, CentSIRT6 expression sits upstream of LINE-1 reduction. This is a proof-of-concept gene-therapy approach to laminopathy, and it extends the SIRT6/LINE-1 axis to a treatable model. By restoring SIRT6 function in progeria cells through gene delivery, the approach reproduces the LINE-1-suppressing effect of the centenarian variant. These results support the feasibility of SIRT6-based gene therapy for progeroid syndromes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AAV 介導的百歲人瑞 SIRT6 遞送在 HGPS 患者來源的成纖維細胞中降低 LINE-1 ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白水平，驗證了該變異體在早衰症中的沉默功能。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 表達位於 LINE-1 減少的上游。這是針對核纖層蛋白病的概念驗證基因治療方法，並將 SIRT6/LINE-1 軸線延伸到可治療的模型。透過基因遞送恢復早衰症細胞中的 SIRT6 功能，該方法重現了百歲人瑞變異體的 LINE-1 抑制效應。這些結果支持基於 SIRT6 的基因治療用於早衰症候群的可行性。

nodes.label: LINE-1 in HGPS fibroblasts
nodes.description: AAV-mediated delivery of centenarian SIRT6 reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in HGPS patient-derived fibroblasts, validating the variant's silencing function in progeria. nodes.label: Acetylated alpha-tubulin
nodes.description: The cell-based ELISA-type assay, adapted from histone acetyltransferase inhibitor assays, confirms SIRT2 inhibitors such as 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones: cells seeded in 96-well plates are treated with compounds, fixed, permeabilized, and probed with antibody against acetylated alpha-tubulin, with fluorescence measured after enhancement solution addition. This format is well suited for high-throughput screenings. Directionally, the acetylated tubulin signal directly reflects SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition in cells. It complements Western blot with quantitative, plate-based throughput.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基於細胞的 ELISA 型測定改編自組蛋白乙醯轉移酶抑制劑測定，用於確認 SIRT2 抑制劑如 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮：將細胞接種於 96 孔板中，經化合物處理、固定、透化後，使用抗乙醯化 α-tubulin 的抗體探測，在加入增強溶液後測量螢光。此格式非常適合高通量篩選。方向性上乙醯化 tubulin 訊號直接反映細胞中的 SIRT2 去乙醯酶抑制。它以定量、微孔板兼容的通量補充了西方墨點法。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Cell-based ELISA assay
nodes.description: The cell-based ELISA-type assay, adapted from histone acetyltransferase inhibitor assays, confirms SIRT2 inhibitors such as 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones: cells seeded in 96-well plates are treated with compounds, fixed, permeabilized, and probed with antibody against acetylated alpha-tubulin, with fluorescence measured after enhancement solution addition. This format is well suited for high-throughput screenings. Directionally, the acetylated tubulin signal directly reflects SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition in cells. It complements Western blot with quantitative, plate-based throughput.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基於細胞的 ELISA 型測定改編自組蛋白乙醯轉移酶抑制劑測定，用於確認 SIRT2 抑制劑如 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮：將細胞接種於 96 孔板中，經化合物處理、固定、透化後，使用抗乙醯化 α-tubulin 的抗體探測，在加入增強溶液後測量螢光。此格式非常適合高通量篩選。方向性上乙醯化 tubulin 訊號直接反映細胞中的 SIRT2 去乙醯酶抑制。它以定量、微孔板兼容的通量補充了西方墨點法。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Acetylated p53, histone 3 and gamma-tubulin
nodes.description: Western blot is the most commonly used cell-based analysis to evaluate sirtuin inhibition: cells are exposed to putative inhibitors, lysed, and probed with antibodies against acetylated lysine on known sirtuin substrates, typically p53, histone 3, or gamma-tubulin. Increased acetylation indicates reduced sirtuin activity. Directionally, the acetylation state of these substrates reports the functional outcome of inhibitor treatment in intact cells. Because it measures endogenous substrates rather than artificial fluorophores, it is a key confirmatory readout after fluorescent screening.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 西方墨點法是最常用的基於細胞的分析方法，用於評估 sirtuin 抑制：將細胞暴露於推定的抑制劑後裂解，並使用抗已知 sirtuin 受質上乙醯化離胺酸的抗體進行探測，通常為 p53、組蛋白 H3 或 γ-tubulin。乙醯化增加表示 sirtuin 活性降低。方向性上這些受質的乙醯化狀態報告了抑制劑在完整細胞中的功能結果。由於其測量的是內源性受質而非人工螢光基團，它是螢光篩選後的關鍵確認性讀取。

nodes.label: Adenine, nicotinamide-ribose and nicotinamide pockets
nodes.description: The sirtuin NAD+ binding site is divisible into an adenine binding pocket (pocket A), a nicotinamide ribose pocket (pocket B), and a nicotinamide binding pocket (pocket C), formed by the large Rossmann domain and the cofactor binding loop. NAD+ enters a non-productive conformation outside the C pocket until an acetyl-lysine substrate is present, at which point a productive arrangement engages the C pocket. Directionally, this topology defines how inhibitors such as nicotinamide (pocket C) and suramin (pockets B, C, and substrate site) act, and frames structure-based design of sirtuin modulators.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin NAD+ 結合位點可分為腺嘌呤結合口袋（口袋 A）、尼可醯胺核糖口袋（口袋 B）和尼可醯胺結合口袋（口袋 C），由大型 Rossmann 結構域和輔因子結合環形成。在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在時，NAD+ 以非生產性構象進入 C 口袋以外的區域；當受質存在時，產生性構象才會與 C 口袋結合。方向性上此拓撲結構定義了抑制劑如尼可醯胺（口袋 C）和 Suramin（口袋 B、C 和受質位點）的作用方式，並為 sirtuin 調節劑的結構導向設計提供了框架。
