nodes.label: Dimethyl fumarate
nodes.description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸活化 NRF2 pathway in MS therapy，誘導 HO-1、NQO1 和 GPx，以增強神經膠質和神經元的抗氧化防禦。這是一種針對復發性多發性硬化症的註冊疾病緩解治療方法。方向性為富馬酸鹽至 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護。需要注意的是，富馬酸二甲酯也會改變淋巴細胞亞群，並可能引起潮紅和胃腸道效應，因此 NRF2 活化是多種機制之一。臨床試驗顯示，儘管 NRF2 與其他富馬酸鹽藥物相比，其確切貢獻仍有爭議，但復發和殘疾進展有所減少。

nodes.label: TFEB at S122/S109/S114
nodes.description: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: SIRT2 disruption
nodes.description: Disruption of SIRT2 in the mouse raises the levels of the mitotic regulators Aurora-A and Aurora-B, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Because SIRT2 is a tubulin deacetylase and a guardian of mitotic fidelity, its loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora kinase abundance in check during division. The directionality is that SIRT2 sits upstream: reduced SIRT2 permits Aurora kinase accumulation, which then destabilizes mitosis. This pathway connects sirtuin biology to chromosome segregation and genomic instability in tumorigenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在小鼠中破壞 SIRT2 會提高有絲分裂調節因子 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的水平，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。由於 SIRT2 是微管蛋白去乙醯酶且是有絲分裂精準度的守護者，其缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora 激酶豐度的機制。方向性上 SIRT2 位於上游：SIRT2 減少允許 Aurora 激酶累積，進而使有絲分裂不穩定。此途徑將 sirtuin 生物學與染色體分離和基因組不穩定性在腫瘤發生中的作用聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: HIC1 transcription
nodes.description: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Neuroendocrine
nodes.description: Small-cell lung cancer is classified as a high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma expressing neuroendocrine markers including Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A, and CD56. These markers are used in SCLC diagnosis. The neuroendocrine phenotype defines SCLC biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Small-cell lung cancer 被歸類為高惡性度神經內分泌癌，表現包括 Synaptophysin、Chromogranin A 和 CD56 在內的神經內分泌標記。這些標記用於 SCLC 診斷。神經內分泌表型定義了 SCLC 的生物學。

nodes.label: BCG
nodes.description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

nodes.label: cervical cancer
nodes.description: Cisplatin is the standard chemotherapy backbone for cervical cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是子宮頸癌標準化療主幹。

nodes.label: Decoy Receptor
nodes.description: B18R is a soluble interferon-sequestering decoy receptor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B18R 是可溶性干擾素隔離誘餌受體。

nodes.label: Vaccinia Virus
nodes.description: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

nodes.label: drug response
nodes.description: SNPs can predict individual drug response by altering the structure or expression of drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, or drug targets, as exemplified by COMT Val158Met predicting aspirin and modafinil responses. Pharmacogenetic testing leverages such variants to personalize dosing and choice of therapy, improving efficacy and reducing adverse effects. The predictive power varies with the size and direction of each variant's effect and with gene-environment interactions. This approach is central to precision medicine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SNPs 可以透過改變藥物代謝酶、轉運蛋白或藥物標靶的結構或表現來預測個別 drug response，例如 COMT Val158Met 預測阿斯匹靈和莫達非尼反應。藥物基因學測試利用這些變異來個人化劑量和治療選擇，提高療效並減少不良反應。預測能力隨每個變異效應的大小和方向以及基因-環境交互作用而變化。這種方法是精準醫學的核心。

nodes.label: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
nodes.description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 SIRT3/ATG5 軸保持粒線體完整性，從而降低 ROS 水平並維持一氧化氮生物利用度，從而在維持內皮細胞功能中發揮關鍵作用。從方向上看，該軸位於維持的內皮 NO 訊號傳導的上游。相反，EC特異性敲除模型中SIRT3的缺失會導致NLRP3發炎小體過度活化和內皮功能障礙，進而形成促發炎、促動脈粥狀硬化的表型。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Energy homeostasis and autophagy
nodes.description: SIRT1 and AMPK form a reciprocal regulatory loop in which each can activate the other, jointly promoting energy homeostasis and autophagic flux. Directionally, the interaction is bidirectional: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates LKB1 and PGC-1α while AMPK phosphorylates and activates SIRT1. This creates a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit, and it is a central node integrating nutrient sensing and clearance. By activating each other, SIRT1 and AMPK amplify catabolic and protective programs, including mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy. This loop is a key target for interventions that aim to restore metabolic health in aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 AMPK 形成雙向調控迴路，兩者可以互相活化，共同促進能量恆定性和自噬通量。在方向性上，此相互作用是雙向的：SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 LKB1 和 PGC-1α，而 AMPK 磷酸化並活化 SIRT1。這創造了一個自強化的代謝迴路，是整合營養感知和清除的核心節點。透過互相活化，SIRT1 和 AMPK 放大分解代謝和保護程式，包括粒線體生物合成和自噬。此迴路是旨在恢復衰老代謝健康的干預措施的關鍵靶標。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Enzyme-coupled nicotinamide assay
nodes.description: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

nodes.label: ETS1
nodes.description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

nodes.label: SIRT3 via H3K27 crotonylation
nodes.description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).

nodes.label: Extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

nodes.label: FGF21 signaling
nodes.description: Restoring SIRT3 expression via lifestyle interventions or fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF21) signaling improves mitochondrial integrity and myocardial function in diabetes. Directionally, FGF21 sits upstream of recovered SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This points to metabolic reprogramming as a promising avenue for diabetic patients, coupling endocrine FGF21 biology to the mitochondrial deacetylase axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過生活方式介入或纖維母細胞生長因子 21 (FGF21) 訊號恢復 SIRT3 表現可改善糖尿病患者的粒線體完整性和心肌功能。從方向上看，FGF21 位於恢復的 SIRT3 依賴性粒線體品質控制的上游。這表明代謝重編程對於糖尿病患者來說是一條有前途的途徑，將內分泌 FGF21 生物學與粒線體去乙醯化酶軸結合起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: Fisetin Bioavailability
nodes.description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Fisetin Dissolution
nodes.description: Solid dispersions of fisetin are prepared by dispersing the drug in a hydrophilic polymer matrix such as polyvinylpyrrolidone or hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, converting crystalline fisetin into an amorphous form that dissolves much faster. The review describes how fisetin solid dispersions markedly increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility relative to the free drug, leading to improved oral absorption and higher plasma concentrations in pharmacokinetic studies. Because dissolution is the limiting step in fisetin absorption, solid dispersion technology is one of the most straightforward and widely explored macro- to micro-scale strategies for improving its bioavailability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的固體分散體通過將藥物分散在親水性聚合物基質（如聚乙烯吡咯烷酮或羥丙甲纖維素）中製備，將結晶非瑟酮轉化為溶解快得多的無定形形式。該綜述描述了非瑟酮固體分散體如何與游離藥物相比顯著增加溶出速率和表觀溶解度，從而在藥物動力學研究中改善口服吸收和更高的血漿濃度。由於溶出是非瑟酮吸收的限速步驟，固體分散體技術是改善其生物利用度的最直接和最廣泛探索的宏觀到微觀策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB
nodes.description: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB shifts signaling to necroptosis, as loss of NF-kappaB-dependent survival genes leaves RIPK1 free to engage RIPK3 and MLKL in lytic, pro-inflammatory cell death. This explains toxicity when NF-kappaB is inhibited in TNF-exposed cells. The directionality is NF-kappaB blockade to necroptotic switch. A caveat is that caspase-8 can still divert cells to apoptosis, so the outcome depends on the full death-receptor complex composition. Necroptosis is highly inflammatory because lysed cells release damage-associated molecular patterns, amplifying tissue injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB 將訊號傳導轉移至 necroptosis，因為 NF-kappaB 依賴性存活基因的缺失使 RIPK1 可以自由地與 RIPK3 和 MLKL 結合，參與裂解性促發炎細胞死亡。这解释了 TNF 暴露细胞中 NF-κB 受到抑制时的毒性。方向性是 NF-kappaB 阻断坏死性凋亡开关。需要注意的是，caspase-8 仍然可以將細胞轉移到 apoptosis，因此結果取決於完整的死亡受體複合物組成。 Necroptosis 具有高度發炎性，因為裂解的細胞會釋放與損傷相關的分子模式，從而放大組織損傷。

nodes.label: Necroptosis-associated inflammation
nodes.description: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.

nodes.label: CYLD
nodes.description: Cylindromatosis (CYLD) modulates the ubiquitination status of RIPK1, gating neuroinflammation and hyperinflammatory syndromes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 圓柱瘤蛋白（CYLD）調控RIPK1的泛素化狀態，掌控神經發炎與全身性高發炎症候群。

nodes.label: DAPK
nodes.description: DAPK (death-associated protein kinase 1, DAPK1) inhibits RIPK1 activity by directly phosphorylating the RIPK1 protein, restraining tumors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DAPK（死亡相關蛋白激酶1，DAPK1）透過直接磷酸化RIPK1蛋白來抑制RIPK1活性，進而抑制腫瘤。

nodes.label: OTULIN
nodes.description: Phosphorylation of OTULIN at Tyr-56 regulates RIPK1 ubiquitination and drives necroptotic cell death in inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OTULIN在Tyr-56的磷酸化可調控RIPK1泛素化，並在發炎中驅動necroptosis細胞死亡。

nodes.label: Antitumor Immunity
nodes.description: Necroptotic tumor cells release damage-associated molecular patterns that can promote immunogenic cell death and activate antitumor immunity; sustained necroptotic signaling may instead contribute to therapy resistance, giving necroptosis a dual, context-dependent role in cancer (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: necroptotic 腫瘤細胞釋放損傷相關分子模式，可促進免疫原性細胞死亡並活化抗腫瘤免疫；但持續的 necroptotic 訊號反而可能促成治療抗性，使 necroptosis 在癌症中具雙重且依情境而定的角色（Niu et al. 2026）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Regulatory complexity and therapeutic targeting of the necroptosis network.md

nodes.label: HG-9-91-01
nodes.description: HG-9-91-01 is a salt-inducible kinase inhibitor that suppresses necroptosis by disrupting the RIPK3/MLKL interaction, demonstrating that the terminal necroptosis execution step is pharmacologically targetable independently of RIPK1 (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: HG-9-91-01 是 salt-inducible kinase 抑制劑，透過破壞 RIPK3/MLKL 交互作用而抑制 necroptosis，證明 necroptosis 的終端執行步驟可在不依賴 RIPK1 的情況下被藥理靶向（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: Apelin
nodes.description: In streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats, apelin treatment reversed hippocampal necroptosis (RIPK3/MLKL axis), alleviated cognitive impairment, and preserved neuronal viability, evidence that endogenous peptides can restrain necroptosis in metabolic/neurological injury (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在鏈脲佐菌素誘導的糖尿病大鼠中，apelin 治療逆轉海馬 necroptosis（RIPK3/MLKL 軸）、改善認知障礙並維持神經元存活，證明內源性胜肽可在代謝/神經損傷中抑制 necroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: TRPM7
nodes.description: TRPM7 is a Mg2+/Ca2+-permeable cation channel proposed to mediate indirect/MLKL-independent membrane compromise during necroptosis; the review highlights such ion-channel routes as evidence that the terminal execution phase is more heterogeneous than a single pore mechanism (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRPM7 是可通透 Mg2+/Ca2+ 的陽離子通道，被提出在 necroptosis 中媒介間接/不依賴 MLKL 的膜損傷；該綜述以此類離子通道途徑說明終端執行階段比單一孔道機制更具異質性（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: Acid Sphingomyelinase
nodes.description: Acid sphingomyelinase was listed among proposed regulators of necroptosis in the 2014 review, pending definitive confirmation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸性鞘磷脂酶在 2014 年綜述中被列為 necroptosis 之候選調節者，尚待明確證實。

nodes.label: Food Matrix
nodes.description: The food matrix, the intricate assembly of nutrients, fiber, and other constituents in whole foods, significantly modulates the bioavailability, metabolism, and ultimate bioactivity of hormetins. Health effects of a diet rich in hormetic foods may therefore exceed and differ qualitatively from the sum of isolated compounds such as resveratrol or curcumin tested in controlled laboratory settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Food Matrix 即全食物中營養素、纖維與其他成分交織而成的複雜基質，可顯著調控 Hormetins 的生物可利用率、代謝與最終生物活性。因此富含 hormetic 食物的飲食，其健康效應可能超越並在性質上有別於受控實驗室條件下測試的單一分離化合物（如 resveratrol 或 curcumin）效應之總和。

nodes.label: French Paradox
nodes.description: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

nodes.label: Fumarate
nodes.description: In beta-glucan-trained monocytes, glutaminolysis drives fumarate accumulation, which inhibits KDM5 demethylases and preserves activating histone methylation. Exogenous fumarate alone can imprint a trained phenotype, while blocking glutaminolysis impairs training. It directly couples TCA-cycle remodeling to chromatin memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 beta-glucan 訓練的單核球中，glutaminolysis 驅動 Fumarate 累積，進而抑制 KDM5 Histone Demethylases 並保留活化型組蛋白甲基化。單獨給予外源性 Fumarate 即可印記 trained phenotype，而阻斷 glutaminolysis 則損害訓練。它直接將 TCA-cycle remodeling 與 chromatin memory 耦合。

nodes.label: gastric cancer progression via STAT3/MMP-13
nodes.description: SIRT1 depletion promotes gastric cancer progression through activation of the STAT3/MMP-13 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of STAT3- and MMP-13-driven tumor progression in gastric cancer. Because SIRT1 normally restrains this pathway, its depletion unleashes STAT3 activation and MMP-13 expression, accelerating GC growth and invasion. This positions SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer and identifies STAT3/MMP-13 signaling as a downstream mediator of SIRT1's protective effect.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1的耗竭透過活化STAT3/MMP-13訊號通路促進胃癌的進展。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於胃癌中STAT3和MMP-13驅動的腫瘤進展的上游。因為SIRT1通常抑制此通路，其耗竭釋放STAT3活化和MMP-13表達，加速胃癌生長和侵襲。這將SIRT1定位為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，並將STAT3/MMP-13訊號確定為SIRT1保護效果的下游介導因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Gender-specific tumorigenesis
nodes.description: SIRT2-deficient mice develop gender-specific tumors, with females acquiring mammary tumors and males developing hepatocellular carcinoma, matching the mitotic instability produced by elevated Aurora-A/Aurora-B. Consistent with a tumor-suppressor role, human breast cancers and hepatocellular carcinomas often show reduced SIRT2 relative to normal tissue. The relationship is directional: loss of SIRT2 predisposes to these malignancies, whereas SIRT2 expression restrains them. This positions SIRT2 among the sirtuins that act as tumor suppressors in genetic mouse models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 缺陷小鼠發展出性別特異性的腫瘤，雌性獲得多發性乳腺腫瘤，雄性則發展為肝細胞癌，這與 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 升高所產生的有絲分裂不穩定性相符。與腫瘤抑制角色一致的是，人類乳癌和肝細胞癌相較於正常組織常表現出 SIRT2 降低。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 的缺失促使這些惡性腫瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的表現則抑制它們。這將 SIRT2 定位為在基因工程小鼠模型中具有腫瘤抑制功能的 sirtuin 之一。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

The relationship is directional: loss of SIRT2 predisposes to these malignancies, whereas SIRT2 expression restrains them. This positions SIRT2 among the sirtuins that act as tumor suppressors in genetic mouse models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 缺陷小鼠發展出性別特異性的腫瘤，雌性獲得多發性乳腺腫瘤，雄性則發展為肝細胞癌，這與 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 升高所產生的有絲分裂不穩定性相符。與腫瘤抑制角色一致的是，人類乳癌和肝細胞癌相較於正常組織常表現出 SIRT2 降低。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 的缺失促使這些惡性腫瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的表現則抑制它們。這將 SIRT2 定位為在基因工程小鼠模型中具有腫瘤抑制功能的 sirtuin 之一。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Glioblastoma growth
nodes.description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of p21-activated kinase 1 (PAK1) at lysine 420 hinders autophagy and glioblastoma growth, establishing SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in this context. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic inhibition of PAK1 sits upstream of suppressed glioblastoma progression. By restraining PAK1 activity, SIRT1 limits the autophagy that glioblastoma cells rely on to survive under metabolic stress. This impairs tumor growth and positions SIRT1 as a brake on an aggressive brain malignancy. The finding illustrates that the same sirtuin can exert opposite effects in different cancers, and it suggests SIRT1 activation as a therapeutic direction for glioblastoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1介導的p21活化激酶1（PAK1）第420位賴氨酸去乙醯化阻碍自噬和膠質母細胞瘤生長，確立SIRT1在此環境中作為腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT1對PAK1的酵素抑制位於膠質母細胞瘤進展抑制的上游。透過限制PAK1活性，SIRT1限制了膠質母細胞瘤細胞在代謝壓力下存活所依賴的自噬。這損害了腫瘤生長，並將SIRT1定位為對侵略性腦部惡性腫瘤的制動器。此發現說明了同一sirtuin可以在不同癌症中產生相反效果，並建議SIRT1活化作為膠質母細胞瘤的治療方向。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion
nodes.description: Repression of UCP2 by SIRT1 preserves mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis in pancreatic β-cells, which raises the ATP/ADP ratio and closes KATP channels to trigger insulin release. Mice overexpressing SIRT1 in β-cells show enhanced glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, while SIRT1 loss elevates UCP2 and impairs the response. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated UCP2 downregulation leads to stronger insulin secretion. This links SIRT1 to improved glucose homeostasis and protection against diabetes, and it is consistent with the observation that caloric restriction, which raises SIRT1, preserves β-cell function and insulin sensitivity in aging organisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 UCP2 的抑制維持了胰腺 β 細胞的粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成，從而提高 ATP/ADP 比值並關閉 KATP 通道以觸發胰島素釋放。在 β 細胞中過量表達 SIRT1 的小鼠表現出增強的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，而 SIRT1 的缺失升高 UCP2 並損害此反應。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 UCP2 下調導致更強的胰島素分泌。這將 SIRT1 與改善的葡萄糖穩態和對糖尿病的保護聯繫起來，與熱量限制（提高 SIRT1）在衰老機體中保留 β 細胞功能和胰島素敏感性的觀察一致。

nodes.label: GRP75
nodes.description: GRP75 (mortalin/HSPA9) links the ER IP3R to the mitochondrial VDAC1 channel at mitochondria-associated ER membranes, gating calcium transfer. SIRT3 overexpression inhibits the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, reducing MAM formation and protecting hippocampal neurons from hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial calcium overload and apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GRP75（mortalin/HSPA9）在粒線體相關內質網膜上將內質網 IP3R 與粒線體 VDAC1 通道連接，調控鈣離子傳遞。SIRT3 的過量表現抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物，減少 MAM 形成，保護海馬神經元免受高血糖誘導的粒線體鈣超載和凋亡。

nodes.label: Hair Cells
nodes.description: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 耳蝸毛細胞是機械感測受體，一旦喪失無法再生。在熱量限制下，SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2 活化促進粒線體 NADPH 和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性——這種保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中完全喪失。

nodes.label: Head and neck cancer
nodes.description: Oral SCC belongs to the anatomical head-and-neck cancer parent class.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 口腔鱗癌屬於解剖學頭頸癌母類。

nodes.label: LIPL-3
nodes.description: LIPL-3 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that, like LIPL-1, co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2 and contributes to intralysosomal lipid hydrolysis. It is transcriptionally induced by HLH-30 under fasting conditions, enabling the breakdown of lipid droplets delivered via lipophagy. Together with other lipl family members, LIPL-3 is required for efficient energy mobilization during starvation. Its lysosomal localization anchors it within the autophagy-lysosomal degradative system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIPL-3 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，如同 LIPL-1，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，並有助於溶酶體內的脂質水解。它在禁食條件下受 HLH-30 轉錄誘發，使得經由脂噬遞送的脂滴得以分解。與其他 lipl 家族成員一起，LIPL-3 是飢餓期間有效能量動員所必需的。其溶酶體定位將它錨定於自噬—溶酶體降解系統中。

nodes.label: SLC-36.1
nodes.description: SLC-36.1 (a solute carrier) forms a complex with the PPK-3/PIKfyve kinase module to regulate phagocytic lysosome reformation (PLR), the process by which phagolysosomes regenerate new lysosomes after phagocytosis. By influencing PI(3,5)P2 generation and membrane dynamics, this complex ensures restoration of the lysosomal pool following immune or clearance challenges. Defects in PLR impair the ability of phagocytes to sustain repeated rounds of degradation. The pathway connects solute transport and phosphoinositide metabolism to innate immune function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC-36.1（一種溶質載體）與 PPK-3/PIKfyve 激酶模組形成複合物，以調節吞噬性溶酶體重組（PLR）——即吞噬溶酶體在吞噬作用後再生新溶酶體的過程。透過影響 PI(3,5)P2 生成和膜動力學，此複合物確保在免疫或清除挑戰後溶酶體庫的恢復。PLR 的缺陷會損害吞噬細胞持續多輪降解的能力。此途徑將溶質運輸和磷酸肌醇代謝連結到先天免疫功能。

nodes.label: Ca2+ from lysosomes
nodes.description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

nodes.label: Lysosomal Ca2+ efflux
nodes.description: TRPML1 is the principal lysosomal Ca2+ release channel, activated by PI(3,5)P2 and other cues to efflux Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol. The released Ca2+ activates calcineurin, driving TFEB/TFE3 nuclear translocation and thereby coupling ion flux to transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis. TRPML1 also participates in lysosomal trafficking and autophagosome-lysosome fusion. Loss of TRPML1 causes mucolipidosis type IV, a lysosomal storage disorder, confirming its essential role in degradative homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRPML1 是主要的溶酶體 Ca2+ 釋放通道，由 PI(3,5)P2 及其他線索活化，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔流出至細胞質。釋出的 Ca2+ 活化 calcineurin，驅動 TFEB/TFE3 核轉運，從而將離子流與溶酶體生物發生的轉錄活化耦合起來。TRPML1 亦參與溶酶體運輸以及自噬體—溶酶體融合。TRPML1 的缺失導致黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV），一種溶酶體儲存障礙，確認了其在降解恆定性中的必要角色。

nodes.label: Degradation center and signaling hub
nodes.description: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

nodes.label: LRO
nodes.description: PGP-2 is a C. elegans ABC (ATP-binding cassette) transporter localized to lysosome-related organelle (LRO) membranes that is essential for their biogenesis; these LROs — the gut granules — serve as fat storage sites. Its absence results in loss of gut granules and altered lipid storage, and it co-localizes with the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PGP-2 是 C. elegans 的 ABC（ATP 結合盒）轉運蛋白，定位於溶酶體相關胞器（LRO）膜上，對其生成不可或缺；這些 LRO（即腸顆粒）是脂肪儲存場所。PGP-2 缺失會造成腸顆粒消失與脂質儲存改變，且它與溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 共定位。

nodes.label: heart hypertrophy, fibrosis, inflammatory cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: SIRT7 deletion leads to heart hypertrophy, fibrosis, lipofuscin accumulation, and inflammatory cardiomyopathy that worsens with age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺失導致心臟肥大、纖維化、脂褐素積累和發炎性心肌病，且隨年齡加重。

nodes.label: Herbicides
nodes.description: Herbicides and paraquat were among the earliest artificial chemical stressors found to induce hormesis in plants, stimulating growth or defense at low doses while causing phytotoxicity at high doses. This biphasic logic is now applied to develop novel herbicides, optimize insecticide dosing via sublethal effects, and eradicate cancer cells by exploiting the high-dose inhibitory limb.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Herbicides 與 paraquat 是最早被發現可在植物中誘發 Hormesis 的人工化學壓力源之一，低劑量刺激生長或防禦，高劑量則產生植物毒性。此雙相邏輯現已應用於開發新型除草劑、經由亞致死效應優化殺蟲劑劑量，以及利用高劑量抑制支來清除癌細胞。

nodes.description: Herbicides and paraquat were among the earliest artificial chemical stressors found to induce hormesis in plants, stimulating growth or defense at low doses while causing phytotoxicity at high doses. This biphasic logic is now applied to develop novel herbicides, optimize insecticide dosing via sublethal effects, and eradicate cancer cells by exploiting the high-dose inhibitory limb.

nodes.label: HIV-1 viral transcription
nodes.description: Because deacetylated Tat is a more potent transactivator, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation at Lys50 boosts HIV-1 transcription from the proviral LTR. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts on Tat to amplify viral gene expression and reactivate latent proviruses. This positions host SIRT1 as a cofactor that HIV exploits, a caveat to the generally beneficial reputation of SIRT1 activation. Targeting this interaction is of interest for antiviral strategies, particularly for the shock-and-kill approach to HIV latency, where compounds that modulate the SIRT1–Tat axis could either silence or purge the latent reservoir depending on the therapeutic goal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於去乙醯化的 Tat 是更強的轉錄活化因子，SIRT1 介導的 Lys50 去乙醯化增強了 HIV-1 從前病毒 LTR 的轉錄。其方向性為：SIRT1 作用於 Tat 以放大病毒基因表達並重新活化潛伏的前病毒。這將宿主 SIRT1 定位為 HIV 利用的輔因子，是 SIRT1 活化普遍有益聲譽的一個注意事項。靶向此相互作用對抗病毒策略具有意義，特別是針對 HIV 潜伏的「震驚與清除」方法，調節 SIRT1–Tat 軸的化合物可以根據治療目標沉默或清除潛伏儲存庫。

nodes.label: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
nodes.community_name: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
nodes.description: SIRT1 and SIRT6 deacetylate the RNA-binding protein hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in hepatocellular carcinoma. Directionally, SIRT1 and SIRT6 sit upstream of hnRNP A1 deacetylation, which curtails glycolytic gene expression and tumor growth. By restraining the glycolytic program through hnRNP A1, these nuclear sirtuins act as metabolic tumor suppressors in HCC, opposing the aerobic glycolysis that supports cancer cell proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1和SIRT6去乙醯化RNA結合蛋白hnRNP A1以抑制肝細胞癌中的糖解作用和生長。方向上，SIRT1和SIRT6位於hnRNP A1去乙醯化的上游，後者限制糖解基因表達和腫瘤生長。透過透過hnRNP A1抑制糖解程序，這些核sirtuin在HCC中作為代謝腫瘤抑制因子，對抗支持癌細胞增殖的有氧糖解。

nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1和SIRT6去乙醯化RNA結合蛋白hnRNP A1以抑制肝細胞癌中的糖解作用和生長。方向上，SIRT1和SIRT6位於hnRNP A1去乙醯化的上游，後者限制糖解基因表達和腫瘤生長。透過透過hnRNP A1抑制糖解程序，這些核sirtuin在HCC中作為代謝腫瘤抑制因子，對抗支持癌細胞增殖的有氧糖解。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay
nodes.description: The homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay, which uses the fluorescent acetyl-lysine substrate ZMAL and NAD+ followed by trypsin treatment to release the AMC fluorophore, was used to screen several compound families as sirtuin inhibitors, including adenosine mimetics, inhibitors of kinases or phosphatases, suramin analogs, splitomicin derivatives, thiobarbiturates, and 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones. Directionally, the assay's ZMAL-ZML trypsin-coupled readout provides a plate-compatible screen for sirtuin inhibition. Its utility explains the breadth of scaffolds identified across independent discovery programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 均質螢光去乙醯酶測定使用螢光乙醯-離胺酸受質 ZMAL 和 NAD+，隨後經胰蛋白酶處理釋放 AMC 螢光基團，被用於篩選多個化合物家族作為 sirtuin 抑制劑，包括腺嘌呤類似物、激酶或磷酸酶抑制劑、Suramin 類似物、splitomicin 衍生物、硫代巴比妥酸鹽和 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮。方向性上該測定的 ZMAL-ZML 胰蛋白酶偶聯讀取提供了適用於微孔板的 sirtuin 抑制篩選方法。其實用性解釋了在獨立發現計畫中鑑定出多種骨架結構的廣度。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Hormetic Zone
nodes.description: The hormetic stimulatory zone typically spans 0.1 to 10 times the No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL), with large-scale analyses indicating approximately 40% of chemical substances exhibit hormetic characteristics. This low-dose stimulation window is evolutionarily conserved from bacteria to mammals and defines where mild stressors build resilience rather than cause inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hormetic Zone 的刺激窗通常橫跨 No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) 的 0.1 至 10 倍，大規模分析顯示約 40% 化學物質具有 hormetic 特徵。此低劑量刺激窗從細菌到哺乳類高度保守，界定了輕度壓力源建立韌性而非造成抑制的範圍。

nodes.description: The hormetic stimulatory zone typically spans 0.1 to 10 times the No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL), with large-scale analyses indicating approximately 40% of chemical substances exhibit hormetic characteristics. nodes.label: Hyperactivation of autophagy
nodes.description: Deacetylation of LDHB by SIRT5 hyperactivates autophagy, accelerating cellular self-digestion and influencing tumor cell survival and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5-mediated LDHB deacetylation sits upstream of autophagic hyperactivation. This can support tumor-cell fitness under stress by recycling nutrients, but it may also provoke cell-death programs when excessive. It exemplifies SIRT5's role at the autophagy-metabolism interface, where the same enzyme coordinates both fuel utilization and the clearance of cellular components. Understanding this axis is relevant to cancer therapy, where modulating autophagy can either sensitize or protect tumor cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化使自噬過度活化，加速細胞自我消化並影響腫瘤細胞的存活和代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化位於自噬過度活化的上游。這可以透過回收營養物質在壓力下支持腫瘤細胞的適應性，但當過度活化時也可能引發細胞死亡程式。這體現了 SIRT5 在自噬—代謝交界處的角色，同一種酶同時協調燃料利用和細胞組件的清除。理解這一軸線與癌症治療相關，因為調控自噬可以增敏或保護腫瘤細胞。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Hypoxia-reoxygenation
nodes.description: Hypoxia-reoxygenation produces a ROS burst in rheumatoid arthritis synovium analogous to ischemia-reperfusion, as restored oxygen fuels mitochondrial and enzymatic ROS after hypoxic epochs. This oxidant surge perpetuates synovial inflammation and joint damage. The directionality is reoxygenation to ROS burst in joint tissue. A caveat is that RA synovium is also hypoxic because of high metabolic and infiltrating-cell demand, so the cycle is sustained rather than episodic. This mechanism may explain the vulnerability of the inflamed joint to intermittent blood flow and oxidative injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypoxia-reoxygenation 在類風濕性關節炎滑膜中產生 ROS 爆發，類似於缺血再灌注，因為缺氧時期後恢復的氧氣為 mitochondria1 和酶促 ROS 提供燃料。這種氧化劑激增會導致滑膜發炎和關節損傷持續存在。方向性是關節組織中ROS爆發的再氧合。需要注意的是，由於高代謝和浸潤細胞的需求，RA 滑膜也會缺氧，因此循環是持續的而不是間歇性的。這種機制可以解釋發炎關節對間歇性血流和氧化損傷的脆弱性。

nodes.label: IGF1R-mTOR Signaling
nodes.description: Cholesterol-biosynthesis-derived mevalonate activates IGF1R and downstream PI3K-mTOR, promoting histone modifications at inflammatory loci. Statins prevent trained immunity induction, whereas mevalonate kinase deficiency yields a constitutively trained state. oxLDL engages this mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop via HIF-1alpha.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 源自 cholesterol-biosynthesis 的 Mevalonate 活化 IGF1R 及下游 PI3K-mTOR，促進發炎基因座的 histone modifications。Statins 可阻止 trained immunity 的誘導，而 mevalonate kinase deficiency 則產生組成型 trained state。Oxidized LDL 經由 HIF-1alpha 接合此 mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop。

nodes.label: insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes
nodes.description: SIRT1 and its activators prevent/reverse insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes by enhancing deacetylation of metabolic regulators (e.g., PGC-1α, FOXO; Rodgers 2005 PMID 15931387).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 及其活化劑透過增強代謝調節因子（例如 PGC-1α、FOXO）的去乙醯化來預防/逆轉胰島素抵抗和第二型糖尿病（Rodgers 2005 PMID 15931387）。

nodes.label: Soluble VCAM-1
nodes.description: Soluble VCAM-1 is a biomarker for endothelial dysfunction, being elevated in cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatoid arthritis as a shed fragment of the adhesion molecule. Its level reflects chronic endothelial activation. The directionality is endothelial activation to soluble marker release. A caveat is that soluble VCAM-1 lacks the membrane anchor and its biological activity differs from full-length VCAM-1, so it is an index rather than a direct effector. Serum sVCAM-1 is now used in risk stratification and to monitor endothelial health in research cohorts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Soluble VCAM-1 是 endothelial dysfunction 的生物標記物，在 cardiovascular disease、糖尿病、高血壓和類風濕性關節炎中作為黏附分子的脫落片段而升高。其水平反映了慢性內皮活化。方向性是內皮活化至可溶性標記物釋放。需要注意的是，soluble VCAM-1 缺乏膜錨，其生物活性與全長 VCAM-1 不同，因此它是一個指標而不是直接效應子。血清 sVCAM-1 現在用於風險分層和監測研究隊列中的內皮健康。

nodes.label: Senolytic Agent
nodes.description: Fisetin belongs to the pharmacological class of senolytics, agents that selectively kill senescent cells. Senolytics, exemplified by fisetin and dasatinib plus quercetin, exploit the reliance of senescent cells on anti-apoptotic survival networks. Fisetin's senolytic profile was identified in screening studies and validated in mouse models where it cleared senescent cells in adipose tissue, bone marrow, and other organs and extended healthspan. Because senescent cell accumulation drives tissue dysfunction and age-related disease, fisetin is now being evaluated in human trials, and its classification as a senolytic frames the therapeutic rationale for improving its bioavailability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin屬於senolytic（衰老細胞清除劑）藥理學類別，即選擇性殺死衰老細胞的藥物。以fisetin及dasatinib加quercetin為代表的senolytic，利用衰老細胞對抗凋亡存活網絡的依賴。Fisetin的senolytic特性在篩選研究中被識別，並在小鼠模型中獲得驗證：它清除脂肪組織、骨髓及其他器官中的衰老細胞，並延長健康壽命。由於衰老細胞累積驅動組織功能失調與年齡相關疾病，fisetin目前正在人體試驗中評估，而其作為senolytic的分類也為改善其生體可用率的治療學理提供框架。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Neuroprotective Activity
nodes.description: Fisetin exerts neuroprotective effects that are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and direct signaling actions in neurons. It protects cultured neurons from oxidative and excitotoxic insults, and in animal models of ischemia and Parkinson's disease it reduces neuronal loss and improves motor function. Fisetin also acts as a cognitive enhancer, improving learning and memory in healthy rodents through modulation of ERK-CREB signaling and by promoting synaptic plasticity, and it has been proposed as a candidate for Alzheimer's disease based on its ability to reduce beta-amyloid aggregation and tau pathology. These effects motivate delivery strategies aimed at improving brain exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin發揮的神經保護效應歸因於其在神經元中的抗氧化、抗發炎與直接訊號傳導作用。它能保護培養神經元免受氧化與興奮性毒性傷害，且在缺血與帕金森氏症動物模型中減少神經元損失並改善運動功能。Fisetin也作為認知增強劑，透過調節ERK-CREB訊號並促進突觸可塑性，改善健康囓齒類的學習與記憶；基於其減少β-類澱粉蛋白聚集與tau病理的能力，也被提出作為阿茲海默症的候選藥物。這些效應推動了旨在提高腦部暴露量的給藥策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Low Water Solubility
nodes.description: Fisetin has extremely low water solubility, reported in the range of a few micrograms per milliliter, which classifies it as a Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) class II or IV drug. The low solubility, combined with poor permeability in some assessments and extensive intestinal and hepatic first-pass metabolism, results in low and erratic oral bioavailability. Because dissolution is the rate-limiting step for oral absorption, much of the formulation research described in the review aims to increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility of fisetin, using approaches such as solid dispersions, cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, and nanocrystals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin的水溶性極低，報告值約為每毫升數微克，使其被歸類為生物藥劑學分類系統（BCS）第II類或第IV類藥物。低溶解度加上部分評估中較差的通透性，以及廣泛的腸道與肝臟首次通過代謝，導致低且不穩定的口服生體可用率。由於溶離是口服吸收的速率決定步驟，該綜述所述的大部分配方研究旨在提高fisetin的溶離速率與表觀溶解度，使用固體分散、環糊精包合物與奈米晶體等方法。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Anti-diabetic Activity
nodes.description: Fisetin improves glucose homeostasis in experimental diabetes by enhancing insulin sensitivity and reducing hepatic glucose output. In diabetic rodents it lowers fasting blood glucose and glycated hemoglobin, reduces insulin resistance, and protects pancreatic beta cells, in part through its antioxidant activity and activation of AMPK signaling in liver and muscle. The review notes these metabolic benefits depend on adequate systemic exposure, which the oral delivery of unformulated fisetin may not achieve, further emphasizing the need for bioavailability-improving formulations to realize its therapeutic potential in humans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin透過提高胰島素敏感性與減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出，改善實驗性糖尿病的葡萄糖恆定。在糖尿病囓齒類中，它降低空腹血糖與糖化血色素、減少胰島素阻抗，並保護胰臟β細胞，部分透過其抗氧化活性與活化肝臟及肌肉中的AMPK訊號。該綜述指出，這些代謝益處取決於足夠的全身暴露量，而未經配方處理的fisetin口服給藥可能無法達成，進一步強調需要能改善生體可用率的配方，才能實現其於人體的治療潛力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Anti-oxidative Activity
nodes.description: Fisetin is a potent antioxidant that scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species and stimulates endogenous antioxidant defenses including Nrf2-dependent expression of heme oxygenase-1, catalase, and superoxide dismutase. Its multiple hydroxyl groups allow it to donate electrons to quench free radicals and chelate metal ions that catalyze oxidative damage. The anti-oxidative action of fisetin underpins its protective effects in neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, and renal models of oxidative stress, and is considered a core mechanism shared with other polyphenols in its protective pharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin是一種強效抗氧化劑，可清除活性氧物種（ROS）與活性氮物種，並刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，包括Nrf2依賴性的血基質氧化酶-1（heme oxygenase-1）、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶表現。其多個羥基使其能捐贈電子以淬滅自由基，並螯合催化氧化損傷的金屬離子。fisetin的抗氧化作用是其於神經、心臟、肝臟與腎臟氧化壓力模型中保護效應的基礎，並被認為是其保護性藥理學中與其他多酚類共有的核心機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Limited Oral Absorption
nodes.description: Fisetin is incompletely and variably absorbed after oral administration due to its low water solubility and rapid first-pass metabolism by intestinal and hepatic conjugating enzymes. Bioavailability studies report low and highly variable plasma fisetin concentrations after oral dosing, with most of the absorbed compound present as glucuronide and sulfate conjugates rather than the parent aglycone. The review identifies this limited oral absorption as the principal barrier to clinical translation of fisetin's broad preclinical pharmacology, and the majority of the formulation strategies it discusses are specifically aimed at increasing the fraction of the orally administered dose that reaches the systemic circulation unchanged.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin口服給藥後的吸收不完全且變異大，原因在於其低水溶性，以及腸道與肝臟接合酶快速的首次通過代謝。生體可用率研究報告指出，口服給藥後血漿fisetin濃度低且高度變異，大部分被吸收的化合物以葡萄糖醛酸（glucuronide）與硫酸（sulfate）接合物形式存在，而非母體苷元（aglycone）。該綜述將此有限的口服吸收認定為fisetin廣泛臨床前藥理學轉譯的主要障礙，而其討論的大部分配方策略均專門針對提高口服劑量中未經改變即到達全身循環的比例。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Anti-cancer Activity
nodes.description: Fisetin shows broad anti-cancer activity against cell lines derived from lung, colon, breast, prostate, liver, melanoma, bladder, and leukemia. It inhibits cancer cell proliferation by arresting the cell cycle at G1 or G2/M phase, induces apoptosis through the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway with activation of caspases and modulation of Bcl-2 family proteins, and suppresses invasion and metastasis by inhibiting matrix metalloproteinases and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Fisetin also sensitizes tumor cells to conventional chemotherapeutics. Its anti-cancer efficacy in animal models, however, has been limited by the low concentrations achieved after oral dosing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin對源自肺、結腸、乳、前列腺、肝、黑色素瘤、膀胱與白血病的細胞株展現廣泛的抗癌活性。它透過將細胞週期阻斷於G1或G2/M期來抑制癌細胞增殖，經由內在粒線體途徑誘發凋亡（伴隨caspase活化與Bcl-2家族蛋白調節），並透過抑制基質金屬蛋白酶與上皮-間質轉換來抑制侵襲與轉移。Fisetin也會使腫瘤細胞對傳統化療藥物敏感化。然而，其動物模型中的抗癌效力受到口服給藥後僅達低濃度所限制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: PI3K/Akt pathway
nodes.description: Senescent cells resist apoptosis by upregulating Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs). Like Quercetin, Fisetin targets SCAP members including the PI3K/Akt pro-survival axis, inducing selective death of some senescent cell types — e.g., caspase3/7-mediated apoptosis in senescent HUVECs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞透過上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs）抵抗凋亡。Fisetin 如同 Quercetin，會攻擊包括 PI3K/Akt 存活軸在內的 SCAP 成員，選擇性地殺死部分衰老細胞類型——例如在衰老的 HUVECs 中誘發 caspase3/7 介導的細胞凋亡。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan.md

nodes.label: Cyclodextrins
nodes.description: Cyclodextrins are cyclic oligosaccharides of six to eight alpha-D-glucopyranose units with a hydrophobic cavity and hydrophilic exterior. They form inclusion complexes with lipophilic guests, raising their aqueous solubility and bioavailability; fisetin complexed with alpha-, beta- and gamma-CD and derivatives gained 1.6- to 161.9-fold in solubility, though the resulting bioactivity was inconsistent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclodextrins 是由六至八個 alpha-D-glucopyranose 單元組成、具有疏水性空腔與親水性外殼的環狀寡糖。它們與親脂性客体形成包埋複合物，提高其水溶性與 Bioavailability；fisetin 與 alpha-、beta-、gamma-CD 及其衍生物形成的複合物溶解度提升 1.6 至 161.9 倍，但產生的生物活性並不一致。

nodes.label: insulin sensitivity / glucose intolerance
nodes.description: SIRT7 knockout mice are resistant to glucose intolerance and show improved insulin sensitivity on a high-fat diet.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 敲除小鼠對葡萄糖不耐受具有抵抗力，並在高脂飲食上顯示改善的胰島素敏感性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: SIRT7 knockout
nodes.description: SIRT7 knockout mice are resistant to glucose intolerance and show improved insulin sensitivity on a high-fat diet.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7 敲除小鼠對葡萄糖不耐受具有抵抗力，並在高脂飲食上顯示改善的胰島素敏感性。

nodes.label: mitochondrial bioenergetics
nodes.description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

nodes.label: intracellular cAMP
nodes.description: Inhibiting PDE4 prevents cAMP degradation, so intracellular cAMP accumulates after resveratrol exposure. Directionally, PDE4 inhibition leads to elevated cAMP. Elevated cAMP then activates the exchange protein Epac1, propagating a calcium and AMPK signal that ultimately boosts NAD+ and SIRT1. This pathway explains how resveratrol can activate SIRT1 even through non-allosteric means, and it connects resveratrol's pharmacology to the broader cAMP signaling network. Because PDE4 is a validated therapeutic target, this arm also links resveratrol's metabolic and anti-inflammatory effects to a well-characterized drug target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抑制 PDE4 阻止 cAMP 降解，因此在白藜蘆醇暴露後細胞內 cAMP 累積。在方向性上，PDE4 抑制導致 cAMP 升高。升高的 cAMP 然後活化交換蛋白 Epac1，傳播鈣離子和 AMPK 信號，最終提升 NAD+ 和 SIRT1。此通路解釋了白藜蘆醇如何能通過非變構方式活化 SIRT1，將白藜蘆醇的藥理學與更廣泛的 cAMP 信號網絡聯繫起來。由於 PDE4 是一個已驗證的治療靶點，這個臂也將白藜蘆醇的代謝和抗發炎效應與一個特徵明確的藥物靶點聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Irisin via SIRT3
nodes.description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease of tooth-supporting tissues driven by dysbiotic biofilm and host responses, with diabetes as a major risk modifier. In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin's SIRT3-dependent osteoprotection prevents alveolar bone resorption, identifying SIRT3 as a host-modulatory target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 牙周炎是由失調的生物膜和宿主反應驅動的牙齒支持組織慢性發炎疾病，糖尿病是主要的風險修飾因子。在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 的 SIRT3 依賴性骨保護防止牙槽骨吸收，將 SIRT3 識別為宿主調節靶標。

nodes.label: K122
nodes.description: K122 is shorthand notation for lysine 122 of mitochondrial MnSOD (SOD2), the same residue described in full in the Lys122 note. Acetyl-K122 / Lys68 western blotting serves as a SIRT3 target-engagement endpoint in the sirtuin recommendation analyses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: K122 是粒線體 MnSOD（SOD2）第 122 號離胺酸的簡寫，與 Lys122 筆記中所描述者為同一殘基。在 sirtuin 建議分析中，acetyl-K122／Lys68 西方墨點被用作 SIRT3 標的結合率的檢測終點。

nodes.label: Keap1-NRF2-ARE Pathway
nodes.description: In mitohormesis, elevated ROS activates the Keap1/NRF2/ARE pathway, driving transcription of cytoprotective vitagenes. This increases antioxidant enzymes, Hsp70, heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), neurotrophic factors, plus sirtuin and glutathione redox systems. The resulting adaptive stress response has longer-lasting protection than conventional antioxidants, especially in neurons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 mitohormesis 中，升高的 ROS 會活化 Keap1/NRF2/ARE Pathway，驅動細胞保護性 Vitagenes 的轉錄。此過程增加抗氧化酶、Hsp70、heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)、神經營養因子，以及 sirtuin 與穀胱甘肽氧化還原系統。所產生的適應性壓力反應比傳統抗氧化劑具有更持久的保護作用，尤其在神經元中。

nodes.label: SIRT3 via Nrf2
nodes.description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

nodes.label: lung cancer patients from healthy individuals
nodes.community_name: lung cancer patients from healthy individuals
nodes.description: Serum SIRT3 distinguishes lung cancer patients from healthy individuals with an area under the curve of 0.918, an optimal cutoff value of 3.12, a sensitivity of 86.4%, and a specificity of 94%. Directionally, serum SIRT3 levels serve as a diagnostic biomarker for lung cancer. The high accuracy of SIRT3 in discriminating cancer patients supports its use as a blood-based marker for lung cancer screening or early detection, complementing SIRT expression differences observed between tumor and non-tumor lung tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 血清SIRT3以0.918的曲線下面積、3.12的最佳截斷值、86.4%的靈敏度和94%的特異度區分肺癌患者與健康個體。方向上，血清SIRT3水平作為肺癌的診斷生物標誌物。SIRT3在區分癌症患者方面的高準確度支持其作為肺癌篩檢或早期偵測的血液標誌物的用途，補充了在腫瘤和非腫瘤肺組織之間觀察到的SIRT表達差異。

nodes.label: LXR Activation
nodes.description: Liver X receptor activation augments oxLDL-induced trained immunity, while LXR inhibition reduces the trained IL-6 and TNF-alpha cytokine response and H3K4me3-H3K27ac enrichment at inflammatory promoters. LXR thus acts as a nuclear-receptor amplifier of the CD36-TLR4 to mTOR-HIF-1alpha training circuit, linking sterol sensing to innate memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liver X receptor 活化可增強 oxLDL 誘發的 trained immunity，而抑制 LXR 則降低訓練後的 IL-6 與 TNF-alpha 細胞激素反應及發炎啟動子上的 H3K4me3-H3K27ac 富集。因此 LXR 作為 CD36-TLR4 至 mTOR-HIF-1alpha 訓練迴路的核受體放大器，將固醇感測與先天記憶連結起來。

nodes.label: oxLDL-Induced Trained Immunity
nodes.description: Liver X receptor activation augments oxLDL-induced trained immunity, while LXR inhibition reduces the trained IL-6 and TNF-alpha cytokine response and H3K4me3-H3K27ac enrichment at inflammatory promoters. LXR thus acts as a nuclear-receptor amplifier of the CD36-TLR4 to mTOR-HIF-1alpha training circuit, linking sterol sensing to innate memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liver X receptor 活化可增強 oxLDL 誘發的 trained immunity，而抑制 LXR 則降低訓練後的 IL-6 與 TNF-alpha 細胞激素反應及發炎啟動子上的 H3K4me3-H3K27ac 富集。因此 LXR 作為 CD36-TLR4 至 mTOR-HIF-1alpha 訓練迴路的核受體放大器，將固醇感測與先天記憶連結起來。

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
nodes.description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

nodes.label: Ferroptosis Susceptibility
nodes.description: Vulnerable senescent cells are able to pass their ferroptosis vulnerability on to neighboring cells, helping explain why only a few senescent cells can turn into more and ultimately impact a larger tissue over time. This paracrine transmission of ferroptosis sensitivity means that a small number of senescent cells can spread susceptibility to ferroptotic death across a tissue, and it represents one mechanism by which the Salk team found ferroptosis and senescence to be connected during aging. The researchers describe the target as eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy for longer, and the finding underpins the therapeutic rationale for targeting acid ceramidase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 脆弱的衰老細胞能將其鐵依賴性細胞死亡的脆弱性傳遞給鄰近細胞，這有助於解釋為何少數衰老細胞能轉變為更多衰老細胞，並最終隨時間影響更大的組織。這種鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感性的旁分泌傳遞，意味著少數衰老細胞就能將對鐵依賴性細胞死亡的易感性擴散至整個組織；Salk團隊發現這是鐵依賴性細胞死亡與衰老在老化過程中相互關聯的機制之一。研究人員將目標描述為清除衰老細胞，同時讓鄰近細胞更長久地保持健康；此發現支持了以酸性神經醯胺酶為標靶的治療學理。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: Dasatinib plus Quercetin
nodes.description: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan.md

nodes.label: Alveolar Macrophages
nodes.description: Alveolar macrophages are tissue-resident lung macrophages that clear particulates and are key sources of inflammatory mediators. Their persistent activation contributes to chronic low-grade lung inflammation that feeds into systemic inflammaging with age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肺泡巨噬細胞是肺組織駐留的巨噬細胞，負責清除微粒並是發炎介質的重要來源。其持續活化促成慢性低度肺部發炎，隨年齡增長助長全身性的發炎老化（inflammaging）。

nodes.label: Argonaute
nodes.description: Argonaute proteins are the effector subunits of small-RNA silencing pathways. In the context of immune-aging literature they are linked to microRNA regulation that influences inflammatory programs, connecting RNA-silencing machinery to chronic inflammaging states.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Argonaute 蛋白是小 RNA 靜默途徑的效應亞基。在免疫老化文獻脈絡中，它們與調控發炎程式的 microRNA 調節相關，將 RNA 靜默機制與慢性的發炎老化狀態相連結。

nodes.label: Herpes Zoster
nodes.description: Herpes zoster arises from reactivation of latent varicella zoster virus, and recurrent viral reactivation is a source of chronic antigenic and inflammatory stress. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹源於潛伏的水痘帶狀皰疹病毒再活化，而反覆的病毒再活化是慢性抗原與發炎壓力的來源。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

nodes.label: Postherpetic Neuralgia
nodes.description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

nodes.label: Health and Retirement Study
nodes.description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

nodes.label: Transcriptomic Aging
nodes.description: Transcriptomic aging describes the progressive remodeling of the transcriptome with age, reflecting dysregulated inflammatory and stress-response pathways. Slower transcriptomic aging implies dampened expression of inflammaging-associated gene programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉錄組老化描述轉錄組隨年齡的進行性重塑，反映失調的發炎與壓力反應途徑。較慢的轉錄組老化意味著發炎老化相關基因程式的表現被削弱。

nodes.label: Varicella Zoster Virus
nodes.description: Varicella zoster virus establishes lifelong latency and can reactivate, and recurrent subclinical reactivation contributes to chronic immune activation. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 水痘帶狀皰疹病毒建立終身潛伏並可再活化，反覆的亞臨床再活化促成慢性免疫活化。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

nodes.label: Senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction
nodes.description: MiDAS is the senescence programme initiated by mitochondrial dysfunction itself, whereas SAMD describes the mitochondrial deterioration that occurs within already-senescent cells and fuels the canonical pro-inflammatory SASP via ROS, minority MOMP and mtDNA release through cGAS-STING. Together they form a feedback loop coupling mitochondrial decline to low-grade inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MiDAS 是由粒線體功能障礙本身啟動的衰老程式，而 SAMD 描述的是已在衰老細胞內發生的粒線體劣化，並藉 ROS、minority MOMP 與經 cGAS-STING 釋出的 mtDNA 助長典型促發炎 SASP。兩者共同形成回饋迴路，將粒線體衰退與低度發炎耦合。

nodes.label: Lys68-acetylated MnSOD
nodes.description: Acetylation of MnSOD at Lys68 destabilizes the homotetramer, shifting it to a monomeric form that gains roughly 40-fold increased peroxidase activity instead of dismutase activity. This Lys68-acetylation switch converts MnSOD from a superoxide scavenger into a pro-oxidant that generates H2O2 via peroxidase chemistry, driving HIF2-alpha stabilization and cancer stemness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MnSOD 在 Lys68 的乙醯化會破壞同源四聚體，使其轉變為單體形式，獲得約 40 倍的過氧化酶活性而非歧化酶活性。此 Lys68 乙醯化開關將 MnSOD 從超氧陰離子清除劑轉變為透過過氧化酶化學生成 H2O2 的促氧化劑，驅動 HIF2-alpha 穩定化和癌症幹性。

nodes.label: Peroxidase activity
nodes.description: Acetylation of MnSOD at Lys68 destabilizes the homotetramer, shifting it to a monomeric form that gains roughly 40-fold increased peroxidase activity instead of dismutase activity. This Lys68-acetylation switch converts MnSOD from a superoxide scavenger into a pro-oxidant that generates H2O2 via peroxidase chemistry, driving HIF2-alpha stabilization and cancer stemness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MnSOD 在 Lys68 的乙醯化會破壞同源四聚體，使其轉變為單體形式，獲得約 40 倍的過氧化酶活性而非歧化酶活性。此 Lys68 乙醯化開關將 MnSOD 從超氧陰離子清除劑轉變為透過過氧化酶化學生成 H2O2 的促氧化劑，驅動 HIF2-alpha 穩定化和癌症幹性。

nodes.label: Lysosomal and autophagy genes
nodes.description: ZKSCAN3 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that represses the expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes, acting in opposition to TFEB/TFE3. Under basal conditions it limits autophagic and lysosomal capacity, and its inhibition or loss enhances cellular clearance. ZKSCAN3 thereby functions as a transcriptional brake on the degradative network, complementary to the post-translational repression by mTORC1. Targeting ZKSCAN3 has been proposed as a strategy to boost autophagy in disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ZKSCAN3 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現，作用與 TFEB/TFE3 相反。在基礎條件下它限制自噬和溶酶體能力，其抑制或缺失則增強細胞清除。因此 ZKSCAN3 作為降解網絡的轉錄性制動，補充了 mTORC1 的轉譯後抑制。標靶 ZKSCAN3 已被提議作為在疾病中提升自噬的策略。

nodes.label: Male longevity beyond 90 years
nodes.description: A polymorphism in an intron-5 enhancer of the SIRT3 gene is associated with exceptional longevity, specifically survival beyond 90 years in men. The variant is thought to alter SIRT3 expression or regulation, conferring enhanced mitochondrial stress resistance and antioxidant capacity. Directionally, the genetic variation is associated with, and putatively causal of, prolonged lifespan. As a correlation it supports—but does not prove—that higher SIRT3 activity promotes human longevity, and it is consistent with separate findings linking SIRT3 single-nucleotide polymorphisms to longevity in other cohorts, including the TRELONG study, reinforcing SIRT3 as a candidate human longevity gene.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 基因內含子 5 增強子中的一個多態性與非凡長壽相關，具體為男性存活超過 90 年。該變異被認為改變 SIRT3 的表達或調節，賦予增強的粒線體壓力抗性和抗氧化能力。在方向性上，這種遺傳變異與延長的壽命相關，並推定為因果關係。作為相關性，它支持但並未證明更高的 SIRT3 活性促進人類長壽，與其他研究組（包括 TRELONG 研究）將 SIRT3 單核苷酸多態性與長壽聯繫起來的發現一致，強化了 SIRT3 作為人類長壽候選基因的地位。

nodes.label: Manganese
nodes.description: Manganese is an essential trace metal required for enzymes such as MnSOD, but chronic overexposure is neurotoxic and produces a Parkinsonian-like disorder called manganism. Manganese preferentially accumulates in mitochondria and inhibits complex II.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 錳是 MnSOD 等酶所需的必需微量元素，但慢性過度暴露具有神經毒性，會產生稱為錳中毒（manganism）的帕金森樣疾病。錳優先累積於粒線體並抑制 complex II。

nodes.label: MAP4K3
nodes.description: MAP4K3 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 3, an N-terminal modification that primes TFEB for subsequent phosphorylation at S211 by mTORC1. This hierarchical phosphorylation reveals that TFEB regulation involves ordered, multi-site modification in which upstream kinases license downstream ones. By enabling the mTORC1 repressive mark, MAP4K3 integrates amino-acid and growth-factor inputs into TFEB control. The finding adds a further layer of complexity to the kinase network governing lysosomal gene transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MAP4K3 於 serine 3 磷酸化 TFEB，這是一種使 TFEB 為後續 mTORC1 在 S211 的磷酸化做準備的 N 端修飾。這種階層性磷酸化顯示 TFEB 調節涉及有序的多位點修飾，其中上游激酶許可下游激酶。透過啟用 mTORC1 抑制性標記，MAP4K3 將胺基酸和生長因子輸入整合進 TFEB 控制中。此發現為控制溶酶體基因轉錄的激酶網絡增添了進一步的複雜層次。

nodes.label: Matrine
nodes.description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

nodes.label: PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis
nodes.description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

nodes.label: MHY2245
nodes.description: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Microfluidic mobility shift assay
nodes.description: The microfluidic mobility shift assay separates SIRT1 substrate and product peptides by differences in electrophoretic mobility caused by charge and mass changes upon lysine deacetylation, quantitating fluorescence of both peaks. The assay effectively separates neutral-acetylated substrate peptides from deacetylated products bearing an additional positive charge. Although it could support high-throughput screening, it is more suitable for hit confirmation and mechanistic studies. Directionally, it provides a label-based yet artifact-minimized readout of SIRT1 activity distinct from fluorophore-release assays.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 微流體遷移率位移測定透過離胺酸去乙醯化引起的電荷和質量變化所導致的電泳遷移率差異來分離 SIRT1 受質和產物胜肽，量化兩個峰的螢光。該測定有效地將中性乙醯化受質胜肽與帶有額外正電荷的去乙醯化產物分開。儘管它可用於高通量篩選，但更適合用於命中確認和機制研究。方向性上它提供了一種基於標記但假象最小化的 SIRT1 活性讀取方式，與螢光基團釋放測定不同。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: 6-hydroxydopamine
nodes.description: 6-hydroxydopamine causes Parkinson's Disease by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 6-hydroxydopamine 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Parkinson's Disease，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

nodes.label: Ambroxol
nodes.description: Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Bradykinesia
nodes.description: Bradykinesia and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Bradykinesia and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

nodes.label: reward learning
nodes.description: The Striatum controls reward learning by encoding prediction errors and reinforcing stimulus-reward associations via dopaminergic signaling to medium spiny neurons of the ventral striatum, including the nucleus accumbens. Dopamine release timed to rewards strengthens these circuits, a process sensitive to COMT-dependent dopamine tone and DAT-mediated clearance. This underlies both adaptive motivation and substance use disorders. It is a central node in the brain's reward and reinforcement system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Striatum 透過編碼預測誤差來控制 reward learning，並透過多巴胺能訊號傳導至腹側紋狀體（包括伏隔核）的中型多棘神經元來加強刺激-reward 關聯。 Dopamine 的釋放定時獎勵增強了這些迴路，這是一個對 COMT 依賴的多巴胺音和 DAT 介導的清除敏感的過程。這是適應性動機和物質使用疾患的基礎。它是brain的reward和加強系統中的中心節點。

nodes.label: habit formation
nodes.description: The striatum controls habit formation through its role in procedural learning, where repeated stimulus-response associations are encoded in dorsolateral striatal circuits under dopaminergic modulation. Dopamine availability, partly set by COMT and governed mainly by DAT, determines the efficiency of habit acquisition and automatization. Dysregulation contributes to compulsive and addictive behaviors, where habits become maladaptive. The striatum is thus central to both adaptive skill learning and pathological behaviors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紋狀體透過其在程序性學習中的作用來控制 habit formation，其中重複的刺激-反應關聯在多巴胺能調節下被編碼在背外側紋狀體迴路中。 Dopamine 的可用性部分由 COMT 設置，主要由 DAT 控制，決定了習慣習得和自動化的效率。失調會導致強迫性和成癮行為，使習慣變得不適應。因此，紋狀體對於適應性技能學習和病理行為都至關重要。

nodes.label: motor control
nodes.description: The striatum controls motor control as the major input nucleus of the basal ganglia, integrating dopaminergic, cortical, and thalamic signals to select and execute movements. Dopamine acting on striatal medium spiny neurons, via D1 direct and D2 indirect pathways, fine-tunes motor output and movement initiation. COMT and DAT jointly shape the striatal dopamine that governs this function, though DAT dominates. Dysfunction of the striatum is central to Parkinson's disease and other movement disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紋狀體控制 motor control 作為 basal ganglia 的主要輸入核，整合多巴胺能、皮質和丘腦訊號來選擇和執行運動。 Dopamine 透過 D1 直接和 D2 間接途徑作用於紋狀體中型多棘神經元，微調運動輸出和 movement 啟動。 COMT 和 DAT 共同塑造控制此功能的紋狀體多巴胺，儘管 DAT 占主導地位。紋狀體功能障礙是帕金森氏症和其他 movement 疾病的核心。

nodes.label: Dopamine Quinones
nodes.description: Dopamine autoxidizes via iron/MAO routes to quinones plus 6-OHDA, forming alpha-synuclein adducts. This catecholamine-oxidation chemistry bridges dopamine handling to Parkinson pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine 經由鐵/MAO 路徑自氧化為 quinones 及 6-OHDA，形成 alpha-synuclein 加合物。此兒茶酚胺氧化化學將多巴胺處理連結到帕金森病理。

nodes.label: Levodopa
nodes.description: Levodopa is the standard dopamine-replacement therapy for Parkinson disease. Treatment is the clinical indication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Levodopa 是帕金森病的標準多巴胺替代治療。治療是臨床適應症。

nodes.label: Tardive Dyskinesia
nodes.description: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

nodes.label: DAT
nodes.description: The dopamine transporter DAT is highly abundant in dopaminergic terminals, where it mediates rapid uptake of dopamine from the synaptic cleft. Cleared dopamine is either packaged into storage vesicles or degraded by monoamine oxidase, so DAT sets both the amplitude and the duration of dopaminergic signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine transporter DAT 在 dopaminergic terminal 中高度表現，負責將 dopamine 由突觸間隙快速攝回。被清除的 dopamine 要么被包裝進儲存囊泡，要么由 monoamine oxidase 代謝，因此 DAT 同時決定了 dopaminergic 訊號的強度與持續時間。

nodes.label: PARK2
nodes.description: PARK2 encodes Parkin; mutations in this gene are the most common cause of autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson's Disease, accounting for up to 50% of familial cases and roughly 15% of sporadic early-onset cases. Loss of Parkin function impairs mitophagy, allowing dysfunctional mitochondria to accumulate and raising oxidative stress, with selective vulnerability of Substantia Nigra dopaminergic neurons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARK2 編碼 Parkin；此基因的突變是體染色體隱性早發型 Parkinson's Disease 最常見的病因，約佔家族性病例的 50%，以及散發性早發型病例的約 15%。Parkin 功能喪失會損害 mitophagy，使失能的粒線體累積並提高氧化壓力，導致 Substantia Nigra 多巴胺神經元特別易受傷害。

nodes.label: Model System
nodes.description: Sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.) microgreens are presented both as nutritious superfoods and as model systems for studying plant stress responses. The ten-day hydroponic root-dipping assay across 0-100 mM NaCl enabled parallel measurement of growth, stress biomarkers, and nutritional traits. This dual food-model role motivates salt eustress as an agronomic elicitor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 向日葵（Helianthus annuus L.）苗菜同時被視為營養超級食物與研究植物壓力反應的 Model System。為期十天、0-100 mM NaCl 的水耕浸根試驗可平行量測生長、壓力生物標誌與營養性狀。這種食用與模式雙重角色使鹽 eustress 成為具吸引力的農藝誘導手段。

nodes.label: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
nodes.community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
nodes.description: Mice lacking PGC-1α are markedly more sensitive to neuronal loss induced by MPTP, a dopaminergic toxin, and kainic acid, an excitotoxin, revealing PGC-1αs role in neuronal stress resistance. Because SIRT1 activates PGC-1α by deacetylation, this sensitivity indirectly implicates the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis in neuroprotection. Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。
nodes.norm_label: mptp and kainic acid neuronal damage
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: mTORC1 under hypoxia
nodes.description: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

nodes.label: NAD+ bioluminescence assay
nodes.description: The NAD+ bioluminescence assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying remaining NAD+ after a deacetylation reaction, coupling NAD+ consumption to bacterial luciferase-catalyzed oxidation of decanal via a NAD+/NADH reduction step. It uses a label-free peptide substrate and is applicable to sirtuins with any peptide substrate. Directionally, NAD+ depletion tracks sirtuin catalytic turnover. Its label-free nature and high amenability to high-throughput screening make it a useful complement to fluorescent substrate-based assays, whose artifacts affect STAC measurements.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物發光測定透過量化去乙醯化反應後剩餘的 NAD+ 來測量 sirtuin 活性，將 NAD+ 消耗與細菌螢光素酶催化的癸醛氧化偶聯，透過 NAD+/NADH 還原步驟。它使用無標記的胜肽受質，適用於任何胜肽受質的 sirtuin。方向性上 NAD+ 耗竭追蹤 sirtuin 催化轉化。其無標記特性和高通量篩選的良好適應性使其成為螢光受質基測定的有用補充，後者的假象影響了 STAC 測量。

nodes.label: NAMPT targeting in AML
nodes.description: SIRT6 knockdown-induced DNA repair deficiencies are potently synergistic with NAMPT targeting in acute myeloid leukemia treatment, showing promising in vivo efficacy compared with monotherapy. Directionally, SIRT6 loss-driven DNA repair defects and NAMPT inhibition cooperate to kill AML cells. This dual strategy exploits two vulnerabilities, offering a rationale for combination-based treatments that outperform single-agent therapy in acute myeloid leukemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6敲低誘導的DNA修復缺陷在急性骨髓性白血病治療中與NAMPT靶向具有強大的協同作用，與單一療法相比顯示出有前景的體內療效。方向上，SIRT6缺失驅動的DNA修復缺陷和NAMPT抑制協同殺傷AML細胞。這種雙重策略利用兩個脆弱性，為在急性骨髓性白血病中優於單一藥物治療的組合治療提供了理論基礎。
