nodes.label: NF-κB pro-inflammatory signalling
nodes.description: Deacetylation of RelA/p65 by SIRT1 lowers NF-κB transactivation, thereby reducing expression of cytokines, chemokines, and adhesion molecules that propagate inflammation. This directly opposes the pro-inflammatory program and underlies many of SIRT1's protective effects in metabolic, cardiovascular, and neurodegenerative contexts. The directionality is SIRT1 deacetylation → suppressed NF-κB signaling. A caveat is that excessive NF-κB suppression could impair host defense, so the effect is beneficial within physiological ranges.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 RelA/p65 的去乙醯化降低 NF-κB 的轉錄活化，從而減少促進發炎的細胞因子、趨化因子和黏附分子的表達。這直接對抗促發炎程序，是 SIRT1 在代謝、心血管和神經退行性疾病背景下許多保護效應的基礎。其方向性為 SIRT1 去乙醯化 → 抑制 NF-κB 信號。需要注意的是，過度抑制 NF-κB 可能損害宿主防禦，因此其效應在生理範圍內是有益的。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Nicotinamide released by sirtuins
nodes.description: The radiochemical assay measures sirtuin deacetylase activity using an acetylated peptide substrate and [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+, detecting the release of 14C-nicotinamide. Unreacted NAD+ is captured by a boronic acid resin, and the unbound fraction containing released nicotinamide is counted in a scintillation counter, in a format compatible with 96-well high-throughput screening. Directionally, radiolabeled nicotinamide release directly quantifies catalytic rounds. This assay confirmed the identification of indoles as sirtuin inhibitors, although radioactive waste and safety considerations limit routine screening use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 放射化學測定使用乙醯化胜肽受質和 [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+ 測量 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性，偵測 14C-尼可醯胺的釋放。未反應的 NAD+ 被硼酸樹脂捕獲，含有釋放的尼可醯胺的非結合部分在液體閃爍計數器中計數，格式相容於 96 孔高通量篩選。方向性上放射性標記尼可醯胺的釋放直接量化催化輪次。此測定確認了吲哚類作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的鑑定，儘管放射性廢物和安全考量限制了其在常規篩選中的使用。

nodes.label: Radiochemical nicotinamide release assay
nodes.description: The radiochemical assay measures sirtuin deacetylase activity using an acetylated peptide substrate and [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+, detecting the release of 14C-nicotinamide. Unreacted NAD+ is captured by a boronic acid resin, and the unbound fraction containing released nicotinamide is counted in a scintillation counter, in a format compatible with 96-well high-throughput screening. Directionally, radiolabeled nicotinamide release directly quantifies catalytic rounds. This assay confirmed the identification of indoles as sirtuin inhibitors, although radioactive waste and safety considerations limit routine screening use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 放射化學測定使用乙醯化胜肽受質和 [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+ 測量 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性，偵測 14C-尼可醯胺的釋放。未反應的 NAD+ 被硼酸樹脂捕獲，含有釋放的尼可醯胺的非結合部分在液體閃爍計數器中計數，格式相容於 96 孔高通量篩選。方向性上放射性標記尼可醯胺的釋放直接量化催化輪次。此測定確認了吲哚類作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的鑑定，儘管放射性廢物和安全考量限制了其在常規篩選中的使用。

nodes.label: NLRP3-Dependent Trained Immunity
nodes.description: Short-term Western diet triggers NLRP3-dependent trained immunity with myelopoietic skewing in vivo, and it fails to induce training in Nlrp3-deficient mice. Transient Western diet exposure can imprint durable innate memory that reshapes subsequent inflammatory responses such as DSS colitis, framing diet as a sterile DAMP-like trainer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 短期 Western Diet 可在 in vivo 觸發 NLRP3-dependent trained immunity 並造成 myelopoietic skewing，在 Nlrp3 缺陷小鼠則無法誘發訓練。短暫的西式飲食暴露可印記持久的先天記憶，重塑後續發炎反應如 DSS colitis，將飲食定位為類似無菌 DAMP 的訓練因子。

nodes.label: Nox4-derived H2O2
nodes.description: Nox4-derived H2O2 is required for TGF-beta-induced EMT, as Nox4 knockout blocks mesenchymal marker expression and cell migration during epithelial-mesenchymal transition. The oxidant thus serves as a necessary signal rather than mere byproduct. The directionality is Nox4 H2O2 to EMT execution. A caveat is that complete EMT also needs Smad and transcription-factor reprogramming, so H2O2 is necessary but not sufficient alone. Nox4 inhibitors are being evaluated as anti-fibrotic agents, underscoring the therapeutic relevance of this redox pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nox4-derived H2O2 是 TGF-beta-induced EMT 所必需的，因為 Nox4 敲除會阻斷上皮-間質轉化過程中的間質標記表達和細胞遷移。因此，氧化劑充當必要的信號而不僅僅是副產物。方向性是Nox4 H2O2到EMT執行。需要注意的是，完整的 EMT 還需要 Smad 和轉錄因子重編程，因此 H2O2 是必要的，但單獨使用還不夠。 Nox4 抑制劑正在作為抗纖維化藥物進行評估，強調了此氧化還原途徑的治療相關性。

nodes.label: Nuclear SIRT1 (enhanced by resveratrol)
nodes.description: Nuclear SIRT1, enhanced by resveratrol, induces superoxide dismutase in cardiomyocytes, an antioxidant enzyme that suppresses cell death under stress. Directionally, nuclear SIRT1 sits upstream of SOD induction. This is a cardiomyoprotective output of resveratrol's SIRT1 activation, reducing oxidative damage and preserving cardiac cell viability during injury. It complements SIRT1's other cardiac actions, including SERCA2a deacetylation and PPARα activation, and it illustrates how resveratrol engages nuclear sirtuin activity to boost endogenous antioxidant defense. The SOD induction is part of the broader FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program driven by SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核 SIRT1 在 resveratrol 增強下誘導心肌細胞中的超氧化物歧化酶，一種在壓力下抑制細胞死亡的抗氧化酶。在方向性上，核 SIRT1 位於 SOD 誘導的上游。這是 resveratrol SIRT1 活化的心肌保護輸出，在損傷期間減少氧化損傷並維護心臟細胞活性。這與 SIRT1 的其他心臟作用互補，包括 SERCA2a 去乙醯化和 PPARα 活化，並說明 resveratrol 如何利用核 sirtuin 活性來增強內源性抗氧化防禦。SOD 誘導是 SIRT1 驅動的更廣泛 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程式的一部分。

nodes.label: CVD in fast COMT
nodes.description: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk specifically in individuals carrying the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, a pharmacogenetic interaction identified in prospective studies. The mechanism is thought to involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter aspirin's effects on vascular homeostasis. This contrasts sharply with slow COMT individuals, in whom aspirin is protective, underscoring the importance of COMT genotyping in cardiovascular prevention strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aspirin 可能會增加心血管疾病的風險，特別是在攜帶快速 COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型的個體中，這是前瞻性研究中發現的一種藥物遺傳學交互作用。此機制被認為涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，從而改變阿斯匹靈對血管穩態的影響。這與緩慢的 COMT 個體形成鮮明對比，阿斯匹靈對這些個體具有保護作用，並強調了 COMT 基因分型在心血管預防策略中的重要性。

nodes.label: VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes
nodes.description: VCAM-1 binds VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes, mediating firm adhesion and transendothelial migration during inflammation. This interaction is central to leukocyte trafficking into tissue. The directionality is endothelial ligand to leukocyte engagement. A caveat is that VCAM-1 also binds alpha4beta7 and other integrins, and competing ligands (e.g., fibronectin) modulate the interaction. This adhesion pathway is a validated drug target, with natalizumab blocking VLA-4 to reduce CNS inflammation in multiple sclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VCAM-1 結合 VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes，在發炎過程中介導牢固黏附和跨內皮遷移。這種相互作用對於白血球運輸到組織中至關重要。方向性是內皮配體與白血球的結合。需要注意的是，VCAM-1 還結合 alpha4beta7 和其他整合素，並且競爭性配體（例如纖維連接蛋白）調節相互作用。這種黏附途徑是經過驗證的藥物標靶，那他珠單抗可阻斷 VLA-4，從而減少 multiple sclerosis 的中樞神經系統發炎。

nodes.label: cancer in fast COMT
nodes.description: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) increases cancer risk in fast COMT (Val/Val) individuals, as reported in subgroup analyses of supplementation trials where rapid COMT metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates was associated with adverse outcomes. The mechanism may involve altered handling of catecholestrogens or oxidative metabolites that differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction cautions against blanket vitamin E recommendation in fast genotypes. It underscores the importance of genotype-aware antioxidant guidance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin E（α-生育醇）會增加快速 COMT（Val/Val）個體的癌症風險，正如補充試驗的亞組分析所報告的那樣，其中維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的快速 COMT 代謝與不良後果相關。該機制可能涉及改變兒茶酚雌激素或氧化代謝物的處理方式，這些代謝物因酶活性而異。這種基因-營養素交互作用提醒我們不要在快速基因型中全面推薦維生素 E。它強調了基因型感知抗氧化指導的重要性。

nodes.label: cancer risk in slow COMT
nodes.description: Vitamin E reduces cancer risk in slow COMT individuals, with the protective effect concentrated in Met/Met genotypes in stratified trial data, likely reflecting more favorable metabolism of vitamin E and associated catechols when COMT activity is low. This contrasts with the increased risk observed in fast COMT genotypes, demonstrating a bidirectional gene-nutrient interaction. The mechanism is thought to involve COMT-dependent handling of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and catecholestrogens. Genotype-stratified analysis is therefore essential for interpreting antioxidant trials.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin E 減少了 cancer risk in slow COMT 個體，分層試驗數據中的保護作用集中在 Met/Met 基因型上，這可能反映出當 COMT activity 較低時維生素 E 和相關兒茶酚的代謝更有利。這與快速 COMT 基因型中觀察到的風險增加形成鮮明對比，證明了基因與營養的雙向交互作用。此機制被認為涉及 COMT 依賴的維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體和兒茶酚雌激素的處理。因此，基因型分層分析對於解釋抗氧化試驗至關重要。

nodes.label: Cell Signaling
nodes.description: Cell Membranes are essential for cell signaling because their receptor proteins initiate signaling cascades at the cell surface, and they also underlie ion transport, endocytosis, exocytosis, and cell adhesion. Membrane potential and ion gradients are maintained by channels and transporters embedded in the bilayer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cell Membranes 對 cell signaling 至关重要，因為其受體蛋白在細胞表面啟動訊息級聯；膜同時也是離子運輸、endocytosis、exocytosis 與 cell adhesion 的基礎。膜電位與離子梯度則由嵌於雙層中的通道與運輸蛋白維持。

nodes.label: Oleic acid accumulation
nodes.description: PERO1 functions as a sensor of oleic acid accumulation on damaged peroxisomes, triggering autophagic removal of these defective organelles. By detecting lipid imbalance indicative of peroxisomal dysfunction, PERO1 initiates quality-control degradation that prevents the propagation of impaired organelles. This lipid-sensing mechanism links metabolic state to organelle surveillance. The pathway exemplifies how selective autophagy integrates metabolic cues to maintain peroxisome integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PERO1 作為受損過氧化體上油酸累積的感測器，觸發對這些缺陷胞器的自噬性移除。透過偵測指示過氧化體功能障礙的脂質失衡，PERO1 啟動品質控制降解，防止受損胞器的傳播。此脂質感測機制將代謝狀態與胞器監控連結起來。此途徑具體體現了選擇性自噬如何整合代謝線索以維持過氧化體完整性。

nodes.label: p33ING1b
nodes.description: In hepatocarcinoma, p33ING1b binds SIRT1 and blocks its ability to deacetylate p53, thereby preserving p53's transcriptional activity, including repression of α-fetoprotein (AFP). This relieves SIRT1-mediated inhibition of p53 tumor suppression, restoring the p53-dependent checkpoint in liver cancer cells. Directionally, p33ING1b antagonizes SIRT1 at the p53 node. The interaction reveals a tissue-specific brake on SIRT1's pro-survival, potentially oncogenic action, and is consistent with p33ING1b's function as a tumor suppressor that cooperates with p53, highlighting how accessory proteins can redirect sirtuin activity toward anti-tumor outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肝癌中，p33ING1b 結合 SIRT1 並阻斷其去乙醯化 p53 的能力，從而保留 p53 的轉錄活性，包括對 α-胎兒蛋白（AFP）的抑制。這解除了 SIRT1 介導的對 p53 腫瘤抑制的抑制，恢復肝癌細胞中 p53 依賴性的檢查點。在方向性上，p33ING1b 在 p53 節點上拮抗 SIRT1。這種相互作用揭示了對 SIRT1 的促存活、潛在致癌作用的組織特異性制動，與 p33ING1b 作為與 p53 協同的腫瘤抑制因子的功能一致，突顯了輔助蛋白如何將 sirtuin 活性重新導向抗腫瘤結果。

nodes.label: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
nodes.community_name: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
nodes.description: Upon oncogenic stress, the PML-IV isoform recruits both p53 and SIRT1 into PML nuclear bodies, assembling a stress-responsive regulatory hub. Directionally, PML-IV sits upstream of p53/SIRT1 compartmentalization. Within these bodies, SIRT1 deacetylates p53 to shape the senescence/apoptosis decision, and it connects PML bodies to sirtuin-mediated tumor suppression. By concentrating p53 and SIRT1 at nuclear bodies, PML-IV ensures that stress responses are locally integrated. This compartmentalization is central to the tumor-suppressive functions of the PML pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在致癌壓力下，PML-IV 同型異構體將 p53 和 SIRT1 兩者招募到 PML 核體中，組裝壓力反應性調控樞紐。在方向性上，PML-IV 位於 p53/SIRT6 區室化的上游。在這些核體內，SIRT1 去乙醯化 p53 以塑造衰老/凋亡決定，並將 PML 核體與 sirtuin 介導的腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。透過在核體中濃縮 p53 和 SIRT1，PML-IV 確保壓力反應被局部整合。這種區室化對 PML 通路的腫瘤抑制功能至關重要。

nodes.label: Parkinson's and Huntington's disease
nodes.description: Selective SIRT2 inhibitors such as AGK2, AK-7, and SirReal2 are investigated in neurodegenerative disease models because blocking SIRT2 preserves α-tubulin acetylation and protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition promotes microtubule stability and neuroprotection. These agents rescue dopaminergic neurons from α-synuclein toxicity, reduce huntingtin aggregation in models of Huntington's disease, and confer protection in ischemic stroke. The approach exploits the inverse therapeutic logic of SIRT2 versus other sirtuins: while most sirtuin biology supports activation for healthspan, SIRT2 inhibition appears beneficial in specific neurodegenerative contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 選擇性 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AGK2、AK-7 和 SirReal2）正在神經退行性疾病模型中進行研究，因為阻斷 SIRT2 保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化並保護神經元免受聚集毒性。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制促進微管穩定性和神經保護。這些藥劑從 α-synuclein 毒性中拯救多巴胺能神經元，在亨丁頓症模型中減少 huntingtin 聚集，並在缺血性中風中賦予保護。此方法利用了 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的反向治療邏輯：雖然大多數 sirtuin 生物學支持活化以促進健康壽命，SIRT2 抑制在特定神經退行性疾病背景下似乎是有益的。

These agents rescue dopaminergic neurons from α-synuclein toxicity, reduce huntingtin aggregation in models of Huntington's disease, and confer protection in ischemic stroke. The approach exploits the inverse therapeutic logic of SIRT2 versus other sirtuins: while most sirtuin biology supports activation for healthspan, SIRT2 inhibition appears beneficial in specific neurodegenerative contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 選擇性 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AGK2、AK-7 和 SirReal2）正在神經退行性疾病模型中進行研究，因為阻斷 SIRT2 保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化並保護神經元免受聚集毒性。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制促進微管穩定性和神經保護。這些藥劑從 α-synuclein 毒性中拯救多巴胺能神經元，在亨丁頓症模型中減少 huntingtin 聚集，並在缺血性中風中賦予保護。此方法利用了 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的反向治療邏輯：雖然大多數 sirtuin 生物學支持活化以促進健康壽命，SIRT2 抑制在特定神經退行性疾病背景下似乎是有益的。

nodes.label: Parkinson's disease motor symptoms
nodes.description: Striatum dysfunction causes the motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease because degeneration of nigrostriatal dopamine input deprives striatal medium spiny neurons of dopaminergic tone, disrupting the basal ganglia motor loop. The resulting imbalance between the D1-mediated direct and D2-mediated indirect pathways produces bradykinesia, rigidity, and tremor. COMT inhibitors indirectly help by preserving peripheral levodopa for central conversion to dopamine. This dopaminergic model underpins the standard treatment of Parkinson's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Striatum dysfunction 會導致巴金森氏症的運動症狀，因為黑質紋狀體多巴胺輸入的退化剝奪了紋狀體中型多巴胺能神經元的多巴胺能張力，從而破壞了 basal ganglia 運動迴路。由此產生的 D1 介導的直接通路和 D2 介導的間接通路之間的不平衡會導致運動遲緩、僵硬和震顫。 COMT 抑制劑透過保留週邊左旋多巴以促進中樞轉化為多巴胺間接提供幫助。這種多巴胺能模型是帕金森氏症標準治療的基礎。

nodes.label: peripheral tissues
nodes.description: S-COMT (soluble COMT) predominates in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, where it handles the bulk of systemic catechol and catechol-drug metabolism. Unlike MB-COMT, it lacks a membrane anchor and is freely cytosolic, with lower affinity but higher capacity for catechol substrates. Its peripheral dominance means COMT genotype strongly affects systemic catechol disposition and drug responses, such as levodopa metabolism. This isoform distribution underpins the peripheral effects of COMT inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S-COMT（可溶性 COMT）在 peripheral tissues 中占主導地位，例如肝臟、腎臟和紅血球，它處理大量的全身兒茶酚和兒茶酚藥物代謝。與 MB-COMT 不同，它缺乏膜錨並自由地存在於胞質中，對兒茶酚底物的親和力較低，但容量較高。其周邊優勢意味著 COMT genotype 強烈影響全身兒茶酚處置和藥物反應，例如左旋多巴代謝。這種異構體分佈支撐了 COMT 抑制劑的周邊作用。

nodes.label: PKCβ
nodes.description: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

nodes.label: Premature aging phenotype
nodes.description: Mice lacking SIRT6 develop a striking premature-aging syndrome with reduced size, loss of subcutaneous fat, lymphopenia, colitis, and spinal curvature, dying early in life. The phenotype reflects defective base-excision repair, genomic instability, and metabolic and inflammatory dysregulation, demonstrating that SIRT6 is essential for maintaining genome integrity and metabolic homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT6 deficiency produces multisystem premature aging. This makes SIRT6 one of the clearest single-gene links between sirtuins and mammalian longevity, and it positions SIRT6 among the strongest candidates for translating sirtuin biology into interventions that delay age-related decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 缺乏 SIRT6 的小鼠發展出顯著的早衰症候群，表現為體型縮小、皮下脂肪減少、淋巴細胞減少症、結腸炎和脊柱彎曲，並在生命早期死亡。該表型反映了鹼基切除修復缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及代謝和發炎調節失常，證明 SIRT6 對維持基因組完整性及代謝穩態至關重要。在方向性上，SIRT6 缺乏導致多系統早衰。這使 SIRT6 成為 sirtuin 與哺乳動物長壽之間最明確的單基因聯繫之一，並將 SIRT6 定位為將 sirtuin 生物學轉化為延緩衰老相關退化干預措施的最有力候選者之一。

nodes.label: Red wine matrix
nodes.description: Resveratrol achieves efficacious levels only when ingested within the red-wine matrix, which contains co-constituents that slow its metabolism and improve exposure. Directionally, matrix components sit upstream of better resveratrol bioavailability. This helps resolve discrepancies between in vitro potency and in vivo human trials, and it supports whole-food approaches over isolated-compound supplementation. Quercetin and ethanol in particular may inhibit resveratrol's catabolic enzymes, prolonging its presence. The matrix effect is a key consideration for designing resveratrol formulations and for interpreting epidemiological associations between wine consumption and health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 只有在紅酒基質中攝入時才能達到有效水平，該基質含有共同成分可減緩其代謝並改善暴露量。在方向性上，基質成分位於改善 resveratrol 生物利用度的上游。這有助於解決體外效力和體內人體試驗之間的差異，並支持全食物方法而非單獨化合物補充。特別是槲皮素和乙醇可能抑制 resveratrol 的分解代謝酶，延長其存在時間。基質效應是設計 resveratrol 製劑和詮釋葡萄酒消費與健康之間流行病學關聯的關鍵考量。

nodes.label: Ferric Iron
nodes.description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutations in globin genes (alpha, beta, or gamma chains) that stabilize the ferric (Fe3+) state of heme iron. Patients with hemoglobin M disease often have lifelong cyanosis but are otherwise asymptomatic or mildly affected, because the stabilized ferric methemoglobin cannot carry oxygen yet the body compensates. This congenital cause of methemoglobinemia is distinct from the enzyme-deficiency form arising from cytochrome b5 reductase mutations, and both congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutations in globin genes (alpha, beta, or gamma chains) that stabilize the ferric (Fe3+) state of heme iron。Patients with hemoglobin M disease often have lifelong cyanosis but are otherwise asymptomatic or mildly affected, because the stabilized ferric methemoglobin cannot carry oxygen yet the body compensates。This congenital cause of methemoglobinemia is distinct from the enzyme-deficiency form arising from cytochrome b5 reductase mutations, and both congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia。

nodes.label: Oxygen
nodes.description: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state. In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal. When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues. This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state。In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal。When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues。This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia。

nodes.label: Antioxidant Enzymes
nodes.description: Hypoxia and related states such as estivation transiently upregulate endogenous antioxidant enzymes including Superoxide Dismutase, Catalase, Glutathione S-Transferase, and Glutathione Peroxidase. These activities rise by tens of percent during low-oxygen exposure and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypoxia 及相關狀態（如夏眠）會短暫上調內源性 Antioxidant Enzymes，包括 Superoxide Dismutase、Catalase、Glutathione S-Transferase 和 Glutathione Peroxidase。這些酵素活性在低氧暴露期間上升數十個百分點，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線。

nodes.label: NOAEL
nodes.description: The No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) is the dose where the hormetic curve intersects the control-response line. Doses left of NOAEL induce adaptive low-dose responses that maintain homeostasis and improve tolerance, while doses right of NOAEL cause toxicity, irreversible damage, or death. NOAEL therefore marks the boundary between the hormetic zone and toxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) 是 hormetic 曲線與對照反應線相交的劑量。位於 NOAEL 左側的劑量誘發適應性低劑量反應，可維持恆定並提升耐受性，而右側劑量則導致毒性、不可逆損傷或死亡。因此 NOAEL 標誌著 hormetic zone 與毒性之間的界線。

nodes.label: Exchange transfusion
nodes.description: Exchange transfusion replaces a patient's blood with donor blood and serves as a treatment of last resort for severe or refractory Methemoglobinemia, used when Methylene blue has failed or is contraindicated. Ascorbic acid is another alternative or adjunct, and hyperbaric oxygen may be used in severe or refractory cases, so the procedure sits at the end of the treatment hierarchy rather than first line.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Exchange transfusion 以捐贈者的血液置換病人血液，是重度或難治性 Methemoglobinemia 的最後手段治療，用於 Methylene blue 失敗或屬禁忌時。Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）為其他替代或輔助選項，嚴重或難治病例亦可使用高壓氧，因此此程序位於治療階層末端而非第一線。

nodes.label: Severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis
nodes.community_name: Severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis
nodes.description: SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis when challenged with a hypertrophic stimulus, revealing SIRT3's protective role in the heart. Directionally, SIRT3 loss leads to pathological cardiac remodeling. This is driven by elevated ROS and impaired mitochondrial function, which fuel the hypertrophic and fibrotic response. It mirrors the resistance seen when SIRT3 is overexpressed, confirming a causal protective role. The phenotype highlights the importance of mitochondrial sirtuin activity for cardiac health and supports SIRT3 activation as a therapeutic strategy to prevent maladaptive remodeling in heart disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺陷小鼠在受到肥大性刺激時會發展出嚴重的心臟肥大和間質纖維化，揭示了 SIRT3 在心臟中的保護角色。在方向性上，SIRT3 的缺失導致病理性心臟重塑。這由 ROS 升高和粒線體功能障礙所驅動，它們為肥大性和纖維化反應提供動力。這反映了 SIRT3 過度表達時所見的抗性，確認了因果保護角色。此表型突顯了粒線體 sirtuin 活性對心臟健康的重要性，並支持 SIRT3 活化作為預防心臟病中不良重塑的治療策略。

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of Smad7
nodes.description: By promoting degradation of Smad7, SIRT1 deacetylation tempers TGF-β signaling in glomerular mesangial cells and protects them from TGF-β-dependent apoptosis. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts on Smad7 to relieve a pro-apoptotic TGF-β output in the kidney. This renoprotective mechanism is relevant to diabetic nephropathy and other glomerulopathies, where excessive TGF-β drives mesangial injury and fibrosis. It illustrates how sirtuin control of a single substrate can determine cell fate during injury, and it complements SIRT1's broader antifibrotic actions that suppress TGF-β1-induced apoptosis, fibrosis, and CTGF expression in renal tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過促進 Smad7 降解，SIRT1 去乙醯化調節腎小球系膜細胞中的 TGF-β 信號，保護它們免受 TGF-β 依賴性凋亡。其方向性為：SIRT1 作用於 Smad7 以減輕腎臟中促凋亡的 TGF-β 輸出。這種腎保護機制與糖尿病腎病和其他腎小球病變相關，其中過度的 TGF-β 驅動系膜損傷和纖維化。它說明了 sirtuin 對單一受質的控制如何在損傷期間決定細胞命運，並與 SIRT1 在腎組織中抑制 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡、纖維化和 CTGF 表達的更廣泛抗纖維化作用互補。

nodes.label: SIRT3 deacetylase activity
nodes.description: The deacetylase activity of SIRT3 is required for viral suppression, and during infection SIRT3 keeps membrane potential and mitochondrial pH stable. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of mitochondrial homeostasis during viral infection, supporting antiviral defence. By maintaining mitochondrial function under infection-induced stress, SIRT3 protects cells from viral damage and restricts viral replication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3的去乙醯酶活性對病毒抑制是必需的，在感染期間SIRT3保持膜電位和粒線體pH的穩定。方向上，SIRT3位於病毒感染期間粒線體恆定的上游，支持抗病毒防禦。透過在感染誘導的壓力下維持粒線體功能，SIRT3保護細胞免受病毒損傷並限制病毒複製。

nodes.description: The deacetylase activity of SIRT3 is required for viral suppression, and during infection SIRT3 keeps membrane potential and mitochondrial pH stable. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of mitochondrial homeostasis during viral infection, supporting antiviral defence. By maintaining mitochondrial function under infection-induced stress, SIRT3 protects cells from viral damage and restricts viral replication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3的去乙醯酶活性對病毒抑制是必需的，在感染期間SIRT3保持膜電位和粒線體pH的穩定。方向上，SIRT3位於病毒感染期間粒線體恆定的上游，支持抗病毒防禦。透過在感染誘導的壓力下維持粒線體功能，SIRT3保護細胞免受病毒損傷並限制病毒複製。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: SIRT3 for anti-fibrotic effect
nodes.description: Withaferin A, a withanolide from Withania somnifera, mediates anti-fibrotic effects in hepatic fibrosis models through SIRT3; this effect is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice, positioning SIRT3 as the indispensable molecular effector of this pharmacological anti-fibrotic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Withaferin A 是來自南非醉茄的 withanolide，在肝纖維化模型中介導抗纖維化作用；此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除，將 SIRT3 定位為此藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器。

nodes.label: SIRT3-overexpressing mice
nodes.description: Transgenic mice overexpressing SIRT3 are significantly resistant to stimuli-induced cardiac hypertrophy, the inverse of the SIRT3-null phenotype. Directionally, SIRT3 gain leads to hypertrophy resistance. This protection arises from better mitochondrial ROS control, antioxidant enzyme expression, and metabolic flexibility, which together blunt the growth signals that drive pathological remodeling. It validates SIRT3 as a cardiac therapeutic target and is consistent with SIRT3's regulation of MnSOD, catalase, and mitochondrial Complex I. The complementary loss- and gain-of-function phenotypes firmly establish SIRT3 as a central cardiac protector.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過度表達 SIRT3 的轉基因小鼠對刺激誘導的心臟肥大具有顯著抗性，與 SIRT3 缺失表型相反。在方向性上，SIRT3 功能增強導致肥大抗性。這種保護源於更好的粒線體 ROS 控制、抗氧化酶表達和代謝靈活性，共同削弱驅動病理性重塑的生長訊號。它驗證了 SIRT3 作為心臟治療靶標，並與 SIRT3 對 MnSOD、過氧化氫酶和粒線體 Complex I 的調控一致。互補的功能缺失和功能增強表型確立了 SIRT3 作為核心心臟保護因子的地位。

nodes.description: Transgenic mice overexpressing SIRT3 are significantly resistant to stimuli-induced cardiac hypertrophy, the inverse of the SIRT3-null phenotype. Directionally, SIRT3 gain leads to hypertrophy resistance. nodes.label: SIRT3 proteolytic degradation
nodes.description: Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH/EPHX2) hydrolyzes epoxy-fatty acids and modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation. sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impedes renal vascular calcification progression, linking lipid-epoxide biology to SIRT3 stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH/EPHX2）水解環氧化脂肪酸並透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 周轉。sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化進展，將脂質環氧化物生物學與 SIRT3 穩定性聯繫起來。

nodes.label: SIRT6 centenarian variants (N308K/A313S)
nodes.description: Centenarian-associated SIRT6 variants (N308K/A313S) elevate endogenous SIRT6 protein through a weakened interaction with vimentin, independent of mRNA changes. Directionally, the variant reduces vimentin binding, which raises SIRT6. This suggests protein stability, not expression, drives the longevity phenotype, and it links a human genetic finding to SIRT6 abundance. By escaping vimentin-mediated degradation, variant SIRT6 accumulates to higher levels in cells. This mechanism explains how a subtle coding change can increase SIRT6 output and is consistent with the variants' association with exceptional longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與百歲人瑞相關的 SIRT6 變異體（N308K/A313S）透過與 vimentin 的弱化相互作用（獨立於 mRNA 變化）提高內源性 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，變異體減少 vimentin 結合，從而提高 SIRT6。這表明蛋白穩定性（而非表達）驅動長壽表型，並將人類遺傳學發現與 SIRT6 豐度聯繫起來。透過逃避 vimentin 介導的降解，變異體 SIRT6 在細胞中積累到更高水平。此機制解釋了微妙的編碼變化如何能增加 SIRT6 產出，與該變異體和非凡長壽的關聯一致。

nodes.label: SIRT6 protein levels
nodes.description: Centenarian-associated SIRT6 variants (N308K/A313S) elevate endogenous SIRT6 protein through a weakened interaction with vimentin, independent of mRNA changes. Directionally, the variant reduces vimentin binding, which raises SIRT6. nodes.label: TFEB at S467
nodes.description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

nodes.label: Elevated 8-oxodG
nodes.description: Elevated 8-oxodG is associated with cancer, being increased in lung, breast, bladder, and colorectal cancers where it marks heightened oxidative DNA damage and genomic instability. Persistent oxidative lesions increase mutation burden that can drive oncogenesis. The directionality is oxidative damage to cancer risk or marker. A caveat is that elevated 8-oxodG may be a consequence of the tumor's metabolic and inflammatory state as much as a cause. Urinary and tissue 8-oxodG are frequently elevated in cancer patients and have been proposed as markers of exposure and disease burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Elevated 8-oxodG 與 cancer 相關，在肺、乳腺、膀胱和結直腸 cancer 中增加，標誌著氧化 DNA damage 和基因組不穩定性的增強。持續的氧化損傷會增加突變負擔，從而促進腫瘤發生。方向性是對cancer風險或標記的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，elevated 8-oxodG 可能是腫瘤代謝和發炎狀態的結果，也可能是原因。 cancer 患者的尿液和組織中 8-oxodG 經常升高，並已被提議作為暴露和疾病負擔的標記。

nodes.label: Cell Membrane
nodes.description: melittin disrupts Cell Membrane. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The cell membrane is the lipid bilayer whose integrity and receptor composition govern signaling, transport, and survival of tumor cells. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Cell Membrane rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: melittin 擾亂 Cell Membrane。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Cell Membrane 是脂質雙層，其完整性和受體組成控制腫瘤細胞的訊號傳導、運輸和存活。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Cell Membrane 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

nodes.label: Transcription factor family
nodes.description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Thr172
nodes.description: LKB1 is the primary upstream kinase phosphorylating AMPK at Thr172 in the activation loop, increasing AMPK activity over a hundred-fold. Directionally, LKB1 sits upstream of AMPK activation. This couples energy sensing to metabolic reprogramming, since activated AMPK promotes catabolism and inhibits anabolism. Sirtuins feed into this node via LKB1 deacetylation and AMPK-dependent NAD+ elevation, creating a self-reinforcing circuit. The LKB1-AMPK pathway is a central regulator of cellular energy homeostasis, and its dysregulation contributes to metabolic disease and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LKB1 是磷酸化 AMPK 啟動迴路中 Thr172 位點的主要上游激酶，將 AMPK 活性提高百倍以上。在方向性上，LKB1 位於 AMPK 活化的上游。這將能量感知與代謝重編程偶聯，因為活化的 AMPK 促進分解代謝並抑制合成代謝。Sirtuin 透過 LKB1 去乙醯化和 AMPK 依賴性的 NAD+ 提升回饋到此節點，創造自強化的迴路。LKB1-AMPK 途徑是細胞能量恆定性的核心調節因子，其失調導致代謝疾病和癌症。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: STRAD and MO25 for activity
nodes.description: LKB1 requires binding to STRAD and MO25 to exit the nucleus and gain full kinase activity; without this scaffold it remains inactive. Directionally, STRAD and MO25 sit upstream of LKB1 activation. This gating is essential for LKB1's role as the master upstream AMPK kinase, and SIRT1 and AMPK deacetylate and phosphorylate LKB1 to modulate its localization. The STRAD/MO25 scaffold both stabilizes LKB1 and directs it to the cytoplasm where it can activate AMPK. Mutations in LKB1, as in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, disrupt this pathway and predispose to cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LKB1 需要與 STRAD 和 MO25 結合才能離開細胞核並獲得完整的激酶活性；沒有這個支架它保持不活化。在方向性上，STRAD 和 MO25 位於 LKB1 活化的上游。這種門控機制對 LKB1 作為核心上游 AMPK 激酶的角色至關重要，SIRT1 和 AMPK 去乙醯化和磷酸化 LKB1 以調控其定位。STRAD/MO25 支架既穩定 LKB1 又將其導向細胞質，在那裡它可以活化 AMPK。LKB1 的突變，如 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，會破壞此途徑並增加癌症易感性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Neuroblastoma
nodes.description: Neuroblastoma is an embryonal malignancy arising from neural crest cells of the sympathetic nervous system and the most common extracranial solid tumor in children. Its aggressive forms exhibit excessive mitochondrial fission and high metabolic demands.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 神經母細胞瘤是源自交感神經系統神經嵴細胞的胚胎性惡性腫瘤，是兒童最常見的顱外實體腫瘤。其侵襲性形式表現過度的粒線體分裂與高代謝需求。

nodes.label: Antibody
nodes.description: Trastuzumab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody.
nodes.description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 是人源化 IgG1 單株抗體。

nodes.label: ApiTox
nodes.description: ApiTox is a standardized preparation of Apis mellifera venom used in apitherapy research; its major bioactive components are melittin (40-60% of dry weight), Phospholipase A2, apamin, mast cell degranulating peptide and adolapin. Melittin is the principal toxin of ApiTox, a 26-amino acid amphipathic peptide that disrupts cell membranes, activates Phospholipase A2 and induces Apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ApiTox 是 Apis mellifera 蜂毒標準化製劑，用於蜂療研究；其主要活性成分包括 melittin（占乾重 40–60%）、Phospholipase A2、apamin、肥大細胞脫顆粒胜肽與 adolapin。Melittin 是 ApiTox 的主要毒素，為 26 個胺基酸的兩親性胜肽，可破壞細胞膜、活化 Phospholipase A2 並誘發 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）。

nodes.label: bioluminescence resonance energy transfer
nodes.description: BRET transfers energy non-radiatively from a luminescent donor such as NanoLuc to a fluorescent acceptor when the two lie within about 10 nm, so it reports protein proximity without external excitation light. Fusing NanoLuc to EGFR and challenging it with TAMRA-EGF or FITC-melittin showed that melittin approaches EGFR without occupying the EGF-binding site.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRET 將能量以非輻射方式由發光供體（如 NanoLuc）傳遞給螢光受體，前提是兩者相距約 10 nm 內，因此無需外部激發光即可報讀蛋白質鄰近性。將 NanoLuc 接上 EGFR，再以 TAMRA-EGF 或 FITC-melittin 競爭，顯示 melittin 能接近 EGFR 但不會占據 EGF 結合位。

nodes.label: HeLa
nodes.description: HeLa cells carry integrated human papillomavirus 18 E6 and E7 oncoproteins that inactivate the p53 and Rb tumor suppressors, which is what allows this cervical adenocarcinoma-derived line to proliferate without control. HeLa therefore serves both as a cancer model and as a foundational tool for cancer biology, and its transformed genotype limits physiological fidelity in experiments.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞帶有整合的 human papillomavirus 18 E6 與 E7 致癌蛋白，它們使 p53 與 Rb 腫瘤抑制因子失去功能，正是這讓這株源自子宮頸腺癌的細胞系得以不受控制地增殖。HeLa 因此既是癌症模型，也是癌症生物學的基礎研究工具，但其轉型化的基因型限制了實驗的生理忠實度。

nodes.label: c-KIT
nodes.description: Imatinib is the prototype tyrosine-kinase inhibitor targeting BCR-ABL, c-KIT and PDGFR. Its inhibition of c-KIT is the basis of its activity in KIT-mutant gastrointestinal stromal tumors, and it is the classic single-target KIT inhibitor against which multi-targeted agents such as pazopanib are contrasted.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Imatinib 是標靶 BCR-ABL、c-KIT 與 PDGFR 的原型酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。其對 c-KIT 的抑制是它在 KIT 突變型胃腸道間質腫瘤中的活性基礎，也是與 pazopanib 等多標的藥物對照時的典型單一標的 KIT 抑制劑。

nodes.label: PDK1
nodes.description: Full activation of Akt requires phosphorylation at two sites: Ser308 by PDK1 and Ser473 by mTORC2 (Sarbassov et al. 2005). PDK1 is therefore the PI3K-downstream kinase that primes Akt at Ser308, converting partial phosphorylation into the fully activated kinase necessary for survival and growth signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akt 的完全活化需要兩個位點的磷酸化：Ser308 由 PDK1 磷酸化，Ser473 則由 mTORC2 磷酸化（Sarbassov 等，2005）。因此 PDK1 是 PI3K 下游的激酶，在 Ser308 為 Akt 預備磷酸化，將部分磷酸化轉為存活與生長訊號所必需的完全活化型激酶。

nodes.label: Parsley
nodes.description: Apigenin is a major dietary flavone enriched in a range of fruits and vegetables, with parsley being the richest documented source. Dried parsley was reported to contain up to 45,035 ug/g apigenin, far exceeding dried chamomile flowers (3,000-5,000 ug/g), celery seeds (786.5 ug/g), vine spinach (622 ug/g), and Chinese celery (240.2 ug/g). It is also found in chamomile tea, red wine, and beer, and is a signature component of the Mediterranean diet, whose intake has been associated epidemiologically with lower rates of several human diseases including cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是主要的膳食黃酮，富含於多種蔬果中，其中以歐芹（parsley）為文獻記載含量最豐富的來源。據報導，乾燥歐芹的芹菜素含量高達45,035 ug/g，遠超過乾燥洋甘菊花（3,000–5,000 ug/g）、芹菜籽（786.5 ug/g）、落葵（vine spinach，622 ug/g）與中國芹菜（240.2 ug/g）。它也存在於洋甘菊茶、紅酒與啤酒中，是地中海飲食的代表性成分；流行病學研究顯示，地中海飲食的攝取與包括癌症在內的多種人類疾病發生率較低有關。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: UGT1A1
nodes.description: In the intestine and liver, apigenin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 (UGT1A1), the key enzyme converting it into glucuronide and sulfate derivatives that are more readily transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, and apigenin itself induces UGT1A1 transcription in colon cells. Combined treatment with sulforaphane synergistically increased UGT1A1 mRNA induction, although apigenin did not induce GSTA1. This phase II metabolism underlies apigenin's rapid clearance and low plasma bioavailability after oral dosing, while its slow systemic elimination may allow peripheral tissue accumulation that supports chemopreventive efficacy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在腸道與肝臟中，芹菜素會被UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶1A1（UGT1A1）廣泛結合，此關鍵酵素將其轉化為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸衍生物，這些衍生物更易於在血液中運輸並經由膽汁或尿液排出；而芹菜素本身也會在結腸細胞中誘導UGT1A1的轉錄。與蘿蔔硫素（sulforaphane）合併處理可協同增強UGT1A1 mRNA的誘導，不過芹菜素不會誘導GSTA1。此第二相反應代謝是芹菜素口服後快速清除與低血漿生體可用率的原因，而其緩慢的全身性排除則可能使周邊組織累積，進而支持其化學預防功效。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Mother cell
nodes.description: Sir2p maintains cellular polarity so that oxidized proteins, misfolded aggregates, and dysfunctional mitochondria are retained in the mother cell, allowing daughter cells to begin life undamaged; this asymmetric segregation extends daughter-cell lifespan at the mother's expense. Directionally, Sir2p promotes asymmetric segregation of damage to the mother cell. By ensuring that daughters are born free of damage, this mechanism supports the longevity of the lineage. It illustrates how sirtuins contribute to cellular rejuvenation, a concept that has influenced thinking about asymmetric cell division and aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sir2p維持細胞極性，使氧化蛋白、錯誤折疊的聚集物和功能障礙的粒線體保留在母細胞中，讓子細胞在無損傷的狀態下開始生命；這種不對稱分配以母細胞為代價延長子細胞的壽命。方向上，Sir2p促進損傷向母細胞的不對稱分配。透過確保子細胞出生時無損傷，此機制支持了譜系的長壽。它說明了sirtuin如何有助於細胞回春，這一概念影響了關於不對稱細胞分裂和衰老的思考。

nodes.label: Extrachromosomal rDNA Circles (ERCs)
nodes.description: Sir2p protects yeast from toxic accumulation of self-replicating extrachromosomal rDNA circles (ERCs); deletion of the replication-fork-blocking protein Fob1p rescues the short lifespan of sir2 mutants, establishing ERC suppression as the first mechanistic explanation for Sir2's longevity effect. Directionally, Sir2p suppresses ERC accumulation to extend lifespan. By preventing the toxic buildup of these circular DNA molecules, Sir2 preserves genome stability and replicative capacity. This was the first molecular mechanism linking Sir2 to longevity and remains a foundational finding in sirtuin research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sir2p保護酵母免受自我複製的染色體外rDNA環（ERC）毒性積累的損害；刪除複製叉阻斷蛋白Fob1p可挽救sir2突變體的短壽命，確立ERC抑制是Sir2長壽效應的第一個機制性解釋。方向上，Sir2p抑制ERC積累以延長壽命。透過防止這些環狀DNA分子的毒性積累，Sir2維持基因組穩定性和複製能力。這是第一個將Sir2與長壽聯繫的分子機制，至今仍是sirtuin研究的基礎性發現。

nodes.label: Cancer Chemoprevention
nodes.description: Cancer chemoprevention aims to reduce cancer incidence by administering agents that prevent or reverse carcinogenesis, with dietary flavonoids such as apigenin as leading candidates. Apigenin exemplifies a multimodal chemopreventive flavone active across many human malignancies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 癌症化學預防旨在透過給予可預防或逆轉致癌作用的藥物來降低癌症發生率，其中以 apigenin 等膳食黃酮類為主要候選。Apigenin 是橫跨多種人類惡性腫瘤的多模式化學預防黃酮典範。

nodes.label: Chrysin
nodes.description: Chrysin shares the flavone scaffold with apigenin and, when combined with apigenin, synergistically induces apoptosis and inhibits migration in breast and liver cancer cells by downregulating MMP-2 and MMP-9. Both are plant flavones with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chrysin 與 apigenin 共享黃酮骨架，與 apigenin 合併使用時可透過下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9，協同誘導乳癌與肝癌細胞凋亡並抑制其遷移。兩者皆為機制重疊的植物黃酮。

nodes.label: NAC
nodes.description: N-acetylcysteine (NAC) is a cysteine prodrug and antioxidant that acts as a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of peroxiredoxin 6 (PRDX6). NAC markedly reduced PRDX6's H2O2-clearing peroxidase activity, in contrast to apigenin which targets its iPLA2 activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱氨酸（NAC）是半胱氨酸前藥與抗氧化劑，作為過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）過氧化酶活性的選擇性抑制劑。NAC 顯著降低 PRDX6 清除 H2O2 的過氧化酶活性，與靶向其 iPLA2 活性的 apigenin 形成對比。

nodes.label: TXNDC5
nodes.description: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

nodes.label: NSAIDs
nodes.description: NSAIDs pharmacologically block prostaglandin E2 synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NSAID 藥理阻斷前列腺素 E2 合成。

nodes.label: LAMP-2A
nodes.description: LAMP-2A (lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A) is the lysosomal receptor that makes Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy possible: the Hsc70-bound substrate docks on LAMP-2A, which translocates the protein into the lysosome for degradation. Without LAMP-2A the substrate never crosses the membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LAMP-2A（lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A）是使 Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 得以進行的 lysosome 受體：由 Hsc70 結合的受質停靠在 LAMP-2A 上，後者將蛋白質轉位進 lysosome 進行分解。缺乏 LAMP-2A 時受質無法跨越膜。

nodes.label: CHK1
nodes.description: ATR (Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related) is a serine/threonine kinase that senses replication stress and single-stranded DNA lesions. RPA-coated ssDNA recruits ATR through its obligate partner ATRIP, with TopBP1 and ETAA1 providing additional cofactors. ATR phosphorylates substrates on SQ/TQ motifs, acting on CHK1 at Ser317 and Ser345; active CHK1 then phosphorylates CDC25 phosphatases, causing their degradation or cytoplasmic sequestration and thereby inhibiting CDK activation to halt cell cycle progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATR（Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related）是感測複製壓力與單股 DNA 損傷的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶。由 RPA 覆蓋的 ssDNA 透過其必需伴護蛋白 ATRIP 招募 ATR，TopBP1 與 ETAA1 提供額外輔因子。ATR 以 SQ/TQ 為基序磷酸化受質，作用於 CHK1 的 Ser317 與 Ser345；活化的 CHK1 接著磷酸化 CDC25 磷酸酶，使其降解或被滯留於細胞質，因而抑制 CDK 活化並使細胞週期進程停止。

nodes.label: MDC1
nodes.description: Phosphorylated H2AX does not itself repair DNA; it creates a high-affinity binding platform that nucleates repair foci. The mediator MDC1 binds gamma-H2AX directly via its BRCT domain, then recruits the ubiquitin ligase RNF168, which ubiquitinates H2A and H2AX to generate binding sites for 53BP1 and BRCA1 — the factors that direct repair pathway choice between non-homologous end joining and homologous recombination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸化的 H2AX 本身並不修復 DNA；它建立高親和力的結合平台以成核修復焦點。介導蛋白 MDC1 透過其 BRCT 結構域直接結合 γ-H2AX，接著招募泛素連接酶 RNF168，由後者泛素化 H2A 與 H2AX 以產生 53BP1 與 BRCA1 的結合位點——這兩個因子決定非同源末端接合與同源重組之間的修復路徑選擇。

nodes.label: Cystine
nodes.description: SLC7A11 (xCT), the substrate subunit of System Xc-, imports cystine in exchange for glutamate; intracellular cysteine is then used for glutathione biosynthesis, sustaining GPX4-mediated protection against ferroptosis. p53 represses SLC7A11 transcription to promote ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC7A11（xCT）是 System Xc- 的受質次單元，以谷氨酸交換進口胱氨酸；胞內半胱氨酸隨後用於 glutathione 生合成，維持 GPX4 介導的鐵死亡保護。p53 抑制 SLC7A11 轉錄以促進鐵死亡。

nodes.label: Liproxstatin-1
nodes.description: Liproxstatin-1 is a spiroquinoxalinamine small molecule that inhibits ferroptosis by suppressing lipid peroxidation as a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant. It has demonstrated in vivo efficacy in mouse models of ferroptosis-driven pathologies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liproxstatin-1 是螺喹噁啉胺小分子，作為親脂自由基捕捉抗氧化劑抑制脂質過氧化來阻斷 ferroptosis。它在ferroptosis 驅動病理的小鼠模型中展現體內療效。

nodes.label: Ferritinophagy
nodes.description: NCOA4 mediates ferritinophagy, turning over ferritin to feed redox-active Fe2+ into Fenton chemistry. This iron-supply mechanism complements the lipid-substrate arm of ACSL4.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導 ferritinophagy，周轉 ferritin 以供應具氧化還原活性 Fe2+ 進入 Fenton 化學。此鐵供應機制補充 ACSL4 的脂質受質臂。

nodes.label: Deferoxamine
nodes.description: Deferoxamine chelates labile iron, starving the Fenton reaction of Fe2+ and blocking the lipid-peroxide amplification that executes ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Deferoxamine 螯合不穩定鐵，使 Fenton 反應缺乏 Fe2+，阻斷執行 ferroptosis 的脂質過氧化物放大。

nodes.label: Transferrin receptor 1
nodes.description: Transferrin receptor 1 brings ferric iron into the endosome as part of the transferrin cycle, delivering the substrate that STEAP3 then reduces and DMT1 then exports. It is the entry point of the chain that enlarges the labile iron pool and thereby sets the threshold for Fenton-driven lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Transferrin receptor 1 在 transferrin cycle 中將三價鐵帶入內體，提供 STEAP3 還原、DMT1 輸出的受質。它是擴大 labile iron pool 這條運送鏈的入口，因而決定了 Fenton 驅動的脂質過氧化與 ferroptosis 的閾值。

nodes.label: -CH3
nodes.description: A methyl group is a covalent substituent consisting of one carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms (-CH3), the smallest alkyl group and the universal currency of biological methylation. It is transferred by methyltransferases such as COMT from donors like SAMe to acceptors including DNA, proteins, phospholipids, and catechol rings. Methyl group flux is central to epigenetic regulation, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. Its availability is governed by the folate and methionine cycles, linking diet to methylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 甲基是一種共價取代基，由一個碳原子與三個氫原子鍵結 (-CH3) 組成，是最小的烷基，也是生物甲基化的通用貨幣。它透過甲基轉移酶（例如 COMT）從 SAMe 等供體轉移到包括 DNA、蛋白質、磷脂質和兒茶酚環在內的受體。甲基通量對於表觀遺傳調節、神經傳導物質失活和解毒至關重要。其可用性受 folate 和蛋氨酸循環控制，將飲食與甲基化能力聯繫起來。

nodes.label: alternative to methylfolate
nodes.description: Folinic acid is an alternative to methylfolate, particularly for slow COMT individuals, because it delivers folate cofactors without directly adding the methyl burden that methylfolate contributes to the methylation cycle. It supports nucleotide synthesis and, indirectly, methylation without acutely raising SAMe as aggressively as methyl donors do. This makes it a gentler option in methyl-sensitive genotypes, where methylfolate can provoke irritability or anxiety. It provides a route to one-carbon support that is better tolerated in this population.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 是 alternative to methylfolate，特別是對於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它提供 folate 輔因子，而不直接添加甲基葉酸對 methylation cycle 貢獻的甲基負擔。它支持核苷酸合成，並間接支持甲基化，而不會像甲基供體那樣急劇升高 SAMe。這使得它成為甲基敏感基因型的更溫和的選擇，因為甲基葉酸會引起煩躁或焦慮。它提供了一種在該人群中更容易耐受的單碳支持途徑。

nodes.label: cofactor for COMT
nodes.description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

nodes.label: serotonin to melatonin
nodes.description: Methylation converts the neurotransmitter serotonin into the hormone melatonin via N-acetyltransferase- and methyltransferase (ASMT/HIOMT)-catalyzed steps in the pineal gland, with the methyl group donated by SAMe. This reaction is the final biosynthetic step producing melatonin, which regulates circadian rhythm and sleep. The process exemplifies SAMe-dependent methylation outside the catechol system and links methyl donor status to sleep-wake physiology. It highlights the broad metabolic reach of the methylation cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過松果體中的 N-乙醯轉移酶和甲基轉移酶 (ASMT/HIOMT) 催化步驟將神經傳導物質血清素轉化為褪黑激素，甲基基團由 SAMe 提供。此反應是產生褪黑激素的最後生物合成步驟，褪黑激素調節晝夜節律和睡眠。此過程例證了兒茶酚系統外 SAMe 依賴性甲基化，並將 methyl donor 狀態與睡眠-覺醒生理學連結起來。它凸顯了 methylation cycle 廣泛的代謝範圍。

nodes.label: Catechols via COMT
nodes.description: Methylation neutralizes catechols via COMT by transferring a methyl group from SAMe to the catechol hydroxyls, converting reactive catecholamines and xenobiotics into stable, less active O-methylated metabolites for excretion. This detoxification limits oxidative catechol quinone formation and protects tissues from catechol-derived damage. COMT is thus the central catalyst of this neutralizing methylation, and its activity determines the efficiency of catechol clearance. The reaction consumes one SAMe per catechol, linking detoxification to methyl budget.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過 COMT 中和兒茶酚，將甲基從 SAMe 轉移到兒茶酚羥基，將反應性 catecholamines 和異生物質轉化為穩定的、活性較低的 O-甲基化代謝物進行排泄。這種解毒作用限制了氧化兒茶酚醌的形成，並保護組織免受兒茶酚衍生的傷害。因此，COMT 是這種中和甲基化的中心催化劑，其活性決定了兒茶酚清除的效率。該反應每種兒茶酚消耗一個 SAMe，將解毒與甲基預算聯繫起來。

nodes.label: mood side effects in slow COMT
nodes.description: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。
nodes.norm_label: mood side effects in slow comt

nodes.label: active B12 form
nodes.description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

nodes.label: active folate form
nodes.description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

nodes.label: anxiety in slow COMT
nodes.description: Methylfolate can cause anxiety in slow COMT individuals for the same reason it can cause irritability: it raises methyl donor availability that slow COMT genotypes clear and utilize less efficiently, potentially over-methylating mood-relevant pathways. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific, and may be compounded when combined with other methyl donors such as methylB12 or TMG. Clinicians often titrate methylfolate cautiously or choose non-methylated alternatives such as folinic acid in this group. Monitoring mood symptoms during supplementation is advised.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 可能會導致 anxiety in slow COMT 個體，原因與它可能導致煩躁的原因相同：它提高了 methyl donor 的可用性，從而減緩了 COMT 基因型的清除並降低了效率，可能導致情緒相關通路過度甲基化。此作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性，並且與其他甲基供體（例如甲基B12 或TMG）聯合使用時可能會加劇。臨床醫生經常謹慎滴定甲基葉酸或選擇非甲基化替代品，例如該組中的亞葉酸。建議在補充期間監測情緒症狀。

nodes.label: methylation cycle component
nodes.description: Methylfolate is a critical component of the methylation cycle, providing the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine to form methionine, the precursor of SAMe. Its availability therefore gates the entire downstream methyl donor supply, including that consumed by COMT for catechol O-methylation. Deficiencies or polymorphisms affecting methylfolate generation constrain COMT activity and can elevate homocysteine. It is the primary folate species linking dietary intake to methylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 是 methylation cycle 的關鍵組件，提供甲基，蛋氨酸合成酶將甲基轉移至高半胱氨酸，形成蛋氨酸（SAMe 的前體）。因此，它的可用性控制了整個下游 methyl donor 的供應，包括 COMT 用於兒茶酚 O-甲基化的消耗。影響甲基葉酸生成的缺陷或多態性會限制 COMT activity 並可能升高同型半胱氨酸。它是將飲食攝取量與甲基化能力聯繫起來的主要 folate 物種。

nodes.label: Methylfolate production
nodes.description: By channeling one-carbon units toward 5-methyl-THF via MTHFR, MTHFD1 indirectly supports the methylation cycle and methylfolate production. Because methylfolate feeds SAMe production for COMT, MTHFD1 activity influences the availability of methyl donors consumed by COMT. Inefficient MTHFD1 therefore potentially compounds slow-COMT phenotypes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過將一碳單元經 MTHFR 導向 5-甲基-THF，MTHFD1 間接支援 methylation cycle 和 methylfolate 產生。由於 methylfolate 供應 COMT 所消耗的 SAMe 產生，MTHFD1 活性影響 COMT 消耗的 methyl donor 可用性。因此低效的 MTHFD1 可能加重緩慢-COMT 表型。

nodes.label: leucovorin
nodes.description: Folinic acid is also known as leucovorin, a chemically reduced and stable folate derivative that differs fundamentally from folic acid. It does not require the dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) step needed by folic acid. It is clinically established as an antidote to folic-acid antagonist toxicity such as from methotrexate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 也稱為 leucovorin，是一種化學還原且穩定的葉酸衍生物，與葉酸有根本上的不同。它不需要葉酸所需的二氫葉酸還原酶（DHFR）步驟。它在臨床上確立為葉酸拮抗劑（如 methotrexate）毒性的解毒劑。

nodes.label: abrupt methyl load in slow COMT
nodes.description: For slow COMT individuals, high-dose methylfolate can sharply increase methyl-group availability, precipitating anxiety, irritability, or insomnia. Folinic acid avoids this abrupt methyl load by letting the body titrate methyl donation. It is therefore often preferred as a gentler alternative for supporting methylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對於緩慢的 COMT 個體，高劑量的 methylfolate 會急劇增加甲基群可用性，引發焦慮、煩躁或失眠。Folinic acid 透過讓人體調整甲基供給來避免這種突然的甲基負荷。因此它常被視為支持甲基化能力的較溫和替代方案而受到偏好。
nodes.norm_label: abrupt methyl load in slow comt

nodes.label: 10-formyl-THF
nodes.description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

nodes.label: purine synthesis
nodes.description: MTHFD1 produces 10-formyl-THF, which supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation, and the methylene form feeds thymidylate synthase for DNA replication. Thus MTHFD1 links nucleotide biosynthesis with the methyl-donor economy. This dual role makes it important for cell proliferation and DNA synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 產生 10-formyl-THF，後者為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳，而亞甲基形式則為 DNA 複製提供胸苷酸合成酶。因此 MTHFD1 將核苷酸生物合成與甲基供體經濟連結起來。這種雙重角色使其對細胞增殖和 DNA 合成很重要。

nodes.label: Vitamin B12 cofactor
nodes.description: MTRR maintains the Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) cofactor of methionine synthase in its active reduced state, preventing the futile cycling that would halt methyl transfer. Every catalytic cycle of MTR carries a risk of oxidative inactivation of the B12 cofactor. MTRR preserves methylation flux by reducing the cobalt center.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTRR 將 methionine synthase 的 Vitamin B12（鈷胺素）輔因子維持在活性的還原狀態，防止會停止甲基轉移的無效循環。MTR 的每個催化循環都有 B12 輔因子氧化失活的風險。MTRR 透過還原鈷中心來維持甲基化通量。

nodes.label: oxidized cobalamin cofactor
nodes.description: MTRR uses FAD and NADPH to reduce the oxidized (Co2+/Co3+) form of methionine synthase's methylcobalamin cofactor back to its active Co1+ state. This allows the enzyme to accept a methyl group from methylfolate and transfer it to homocysteine. MTRR rescues the enzyme from oxidative inactivation after each catalytic cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTRR 使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將 methionine synthase 的甲基鈷胺素輔因子氧化（Co2+/Co3+）形式還原回其活性的 Co1+ 狀態。這使酶能從 methylfolate 接受甲基並將其轉移至同型半胱氨酸。MTRR 在每個催化循環後將酶從氧化失活中救回。

nodes.label: cofactor for Methionine Synthase
nodes.description: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) functions as the prosthetic group of methionine synthase (MTR), which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using the methyl group supplied by methylfolate. The cobalt-carbon bond is labile, enabling direct transfer of the methyl group to homocysteine. This reaction simultaneously regenerates tetrahydrofolate for nucleotide synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲鈷胺）充當 methionine synthase (MTR) 的輔助基團，後者使用 methylfolate 提供的甲基將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸。鈷-碳鍵不穩定，能直接將甲基轉移至同型半胱氨酸。此反應同時再生四氫葉酸以供核苷酸合成。

nodes.label: methyl groups to Homocysteine
nodes.description: Methylfolate (5-methyl-THF) donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, using MethylB12 as cofactor, producing methionine and regenerating tetrahydrofolate. Methionine is then converted to SAMe, the universal methyl donor for COMT. Thus methylfolate sits upstream of the methyl-group pool that COMT consumes to inactivate catecholamines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基-THF）透過 methionine synthase 將其甲基捐贈給同型半胱氨酸，使用 MethylB12 作為輔因子，產生蛋氨酸並再生四氫葉酸。蛋氨酸隨後轉化為 SAMe，即 COMT 的通用 methyl donor。因此 methylfolate 位於 COMT 滅活兒茶酚胺所消耗的甲基群池上游。

nodes.label: 900 mg per day
nodes.description: A sub-chronic 90-day toxicity study in rats established that repeated oral administration of synthetic NMN at doses up to 1500 mg/kg/day appears safe and did not promote toxic effects on body weight, food and water consumption, feed conversion efficiency, or biochemical and blood parameters, although higher doses increased kidney, liver, and adrenal gland weights and elevated hepatic enzymes such as alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, and aspartate aminotransferase. Based on these findings, the established upper intake level of NMN for a 60 kg individual was set at 900 mg per day. Human studies at 100-500 mg single doses and 250-300 mg/day over weeks to months reported no adverse effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一項大鼠亞慢性 90 天毒性研究確立，重複口服高達 1500 mg/kg/天的合成 NMN 似乎安全，且未對體重、食物與水分攝取、飼料轉換效率或生化與血液參數產生毒性效應，儘管較高劑量增加了腎臟、肝臟與腎上腺重量，並提升了鹼性磷酸酶、丙胺酸轉胺酶與天門冬胺酸轉胺酶等肝酶。基於這些發現，60 kg 個體的 NMN 既定上限攝取量設定為每天 900 mg。人體研究中，100-500 mg 單次劑量以及 250-300 mg/天持續數週至數月均未報告不良反應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Combined Metabolic Activators
nodes.description: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Glucose Tolerance
nodes.description: In mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) increases NAD+ metabolism and thereby improves glucose tolerance, reduces weight gain, and exhibits neuroprotective effects against diabetic neuropathy and liver steatosis. NR also restores the significantly decreased hepatic NADP+ and NADPH levels seen in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice, both of which are important for resistance to oxidative stress. These benefits are mediated in part through activation of SIRT1, which promotes glucose-stimulated insulin secretion from pancreatic beta-cells and protects against insulin resistance in peripheral tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在小鼠模型中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可提升 NAD+ 代謝，進而改善葡萄糖耐受性、減少體重增加，並對糖尿病神經病變與肝臟脂肪變性展現神經保護作用。NR 亦能恢復糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中顯著下降的肝臟 NADP+ 與 NADPH 濃度，兩者皆對抵抗氧化壓力至關重要。這些益處部分透過活化 SIRT1 所介導，SIRT1 可促進胰島 beta 細胞的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，並保護周邊組織免於胰島素抗性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Hepatocyte Replication
nodes.description: In the regenerating liver, nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to a faster regaining of liver weight in mice. This hepatoprotective and regenerative effect is tied to NAD+ biosynthesis, which supports the energy-producing and biosynthetic demands of liver regeneration. In addition, dietary NR supplementation restored NAD+ levels that were depressed by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma, preventing both DNA damage and tumorigenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在再生肝臟中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，使小鼠更快恢復肝臟重量。這種肝保護與再生作用與 NAD+ 生物合成有關，後者支持肝臟再生所需的能量產生與生物合成需求。此外，飲食補充 NR 恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，在肝細胞癌小鼠模型中同時防止了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Edamame
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is found in a range of foods including edamame beans, avocado, broccoli, cucumber, cabbage, and tomato, according to the first evidence published by Mills et al. (2016). Among the investigated sources, the highest NMN content was found in edamame at 0.47-1.88 mg/100 g and avocado at 0.36-1.60 mg/100 g, with smaller amounts in seafood and raw meats (0.06-0.42 mg/100 g). Milk also contains NMN, with human milk the richest source at 2.1-9.8 uM. These natural occurrences support the idea that a normal diet can contribute to NAD+ precursor intake, though optimal sources remain to be established.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 根據 Mills 等人（2016）發表的首批證據，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）存在於一系列食物中，包括毛豆、酪梨、花椰菜、小黃瓜、高麗菜和番茄。在受調查的來源中，NMN 含量最高的是毛豆（0.47-1.88 mg/100 g）和酪梨（0.36-1.60 mg/100 g），海鮮與生肉中含量較少（0.06-0.42 mg/100 g）。牛奶也含有 NMN，其中人乳是最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。這些天然存在支持正常飲食可貢獻 NAD+ 前驅物攝取的概念，儘管最佳來源仍有待確立。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: GPR109A
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) administration can elevate NAD+ levels in mammalian cells and tissues without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, which is why NR is not associated with the painful flushing side effect seen with niacin. Although nicotinic acid (NA) and nicotinamide (NAM) can enter the NAD+ salvage pathway, several preclinical studies have confirmed that both can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NR, in contrast, was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects reported.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）給藥能提升哺乳動物細胞與組織中的 NAD+ 水平，而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），這就是為何 NR 與 niacin（菸鹼酸）所見的疼痛性潮紅副作用無關。儘管 nicotinic acid（NA）與 nicotinamide（NAM）能進入 NAD+ 回收路徑，數項臨床前研究已確認兩者皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。相對地，NR 在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用的報告。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: NAD+ Precursor
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is one of the most studied nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) precursors, and it is the third NAD+ precursor discovered, naturally occurring in milk and already commercially available as a nutraceutical. Alongside nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), NR feeds into NAD+ biosynthetic salvage pathways and is regarded as a favorable precursor because it lacks the serious side effects and flushing attributed to other NAD+ precursors, and because its chloride salt has been granted GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）是研究最廣泛的菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）前驅物之一，也是被發現的第三種 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品商業化供應。與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）以及菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）並列，NR 進入 NAD+ 生物合成補救途徑，被視為一種理想的前驅物，因為它沒有歸因於其他 NAD+ 前驅物的嚴重副作用與潮紅反應，且其氯化物鹽已被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe）地位。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Milk
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is the third discovered NAD+ precursor and naturally occurs in milk, and it is already available as a nutraceutical, with its chloride salt given GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status. NAD+ intermediates such as NR are found in a wide variety of foods, including meat, eggs, dairy, certain vegetables, and whole wheat, and high availability of NR has been observed in the normal human diet. Oral supplementation with NR has been shown to increase NAD+ levels in multiple tissues along with increased sirtuin activity, improved mitochondrial function, and regenerative potential of stem cells, making NR a leading candidate among NAD+ precursors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）是第三個被發現的 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品可供使用，其氯化鹽被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe，一般認為安全）地位。諸如 NR 之類的 NAD+ 中間產物存在於多種食物中，包括肉類、蛋、乳製品、某些蔬菜與全麥，且在正常人類飲食中觀察到 NR 的高可用性。口服 NR 補充已被證實能提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 水平，同時伴隨 sirtuin 活性增加、粒線體功能改善與幹細胞的再生潛力，使 NR 成為 NAD+ 前驅物中的領先候選者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Cardiac Remodeling
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation exhibits protective effects in adverse cardiac remodeling and prevents the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure. NR normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio, and long-term supplementation increases nucleocytoplasmic protein acetylation by stimulating citrate and acetyl-CoA metabolism and antioxidant gene expression. NAD+ precursor supplementation also protects against adverse cardiac remodeling by activating sirtuins and maintaining Ca2+ homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充在不良心臟重塑中展現保護作用，並在導致心衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中預防心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。NR 使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，而長期補充透過刺激檸檬酸與 acetyl-CoA 代謝以及抗氧化基因表現，增加核質蛋白乙醯化。NAD+ 前驅物補充亦透過活化 sirtuins 與維持 Ca2+ 恆定，保護免受不良心臟重塑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Bovine Milk
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Macrophage Infiltration
nodes.description: Preclinical studies have reported that nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces macrophage infiltration in damaged muscles and attenuates plasma TNF-alpha in models of fatty liver disease. These anti-inflammatory effects contribute to the improvement of metabolism and the decrease in chronic inflammation, a hallmark of aging, that underlie the life-prolonging benefits attributed to NR supplementation. Macrophage infiltration into injured tissue promotes inflammation and fibrosis, and its reduction by NR supports the management of muscular dystrophy and age-related tissue degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究報導，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）減少受損肌肉中的巨噬細胞浸潤，並在脂肪肝疾病模型中減弱血漿 TNF-alpha。這些抗發炎效果有助於代謝改善與慢性發炎（老化的標記）的降低，而後者構成了歸因於 NR 補充的延壽益處的基礎。巨噬細胞浸潤受傷組織會促進發炎與纖維化，而 NR 對其的減少支持了肌肉營養不良與年齡相關組織退化的管理。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: SLC12A8
nodes.description: SLC12A8 is a transporter encoded by the gene SLC12A8 that has been proposed to mediate cellular uptake of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), in addition to the CD73-mediated dephosphorylation route in which NMN is converted extracellularly to nicotinamide riboside for uptake. The expression of a gut transporter reinforces that NMN could be made bioavailable through oral delivery, and the presence of such a transporter in the intestine supports the idea that dietary NMN can enter the circulation. These uptake mechanisms complement each other and explain how orally administered NMN is rapidly absorbed from the intestine into the bloodstream and converted to NAD+ in tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC12A8 是由基因 SLC12A8 編碼的轉運蛋白，被認為除了 CD73 介導的去磷酸化途徑（NMN 在細胞外轉化為菸鹼醯胺核糖以供吸收）之外，還介導菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）的細胞攝取。腸道轉運蛋白的表現強化了 NMN 可透過口服遞送達成生物可利用性的觀點，而此類轉運蛋白在腸道中的存在支持膳食性 NMN 能進入循環的構想。這些攝取機制互補，並解釋了口服給予的 NMN 如何從腸道快速吸收進入血流並在組織中轉化為 NAD+。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Alcohol-Induced Depression
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors in mice by altering gut microbiota composition. Dietary supplementation with NR for 10 weeks at 400 mg/kg daily reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels, inhibited microglial activation, and provided protection against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors. The effect was attributed to NR's ability to upregulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) through microbiota changes: brain BDNF levels correlated positively with bacteria enriched in the NR group such as Barnesiella, Alloprevotella, Prevotella, Alistipes, and Mucispirillum. Fecal microbiota transplantation from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective features in germ-free recipients, demonstrating a gut-microbiota-gut-brain axis mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成，保護小鼠免於酒精誘發的類憂鬱行為。以每天 400 mg/kg NR 飲食補充 10 週，降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素水平，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並提供對酒精誘發類憂鬱行為的保護。此效應歸因於 NR 透過菌叢改變上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）的能力：腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 組中富集的細菌如 Barnesiella、Alloprevotella、Prevotella、Alistipes 和 Mucispirillum 呈正相關。來自 NR 處理供體的糞便微生物移植在無菌受體中重現了保護特徵，證明了腸道菌叢—腸—腦軸機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Creatine Kinase (CK)
nodes.description: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

nodes.label: Sirtuin activity (SIRT1, SIRT3)
nodes.description: 78c indirectly boosts SIRT1 and SIRT3 by maintaining NAD+ co-substrate availability, restoring their deacetylase function in aged tissue. Directionally, NAD+ preservation sits upstream of sirtuin reactivation. This is an indirect pan-sirtuin approach distinct from direct STACs, and it links CD38 pharmacology to longevity pathways. By preventing NAD+ consumption, 78c ensures that sirtuins have the co-substrate they require, effectively restoring the NAD+-dependent regulation that declines with age. This strategy is complementary to NAD+ precursor supplementation, and the two approaches are often combined.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 78c 透過維護 NAD+ 共同底物的可用性間接增強 SIRT1 和 SIRT3，恢復其在老年組織中的去乙醯酶功能。在方向性上，NAD+ 保存位於 sirtuin 重新活化的上游。這是與直接 STAC 不同的間接全 sirtuin 方法，將 CD38 藥理學與長壽途徑聯繫起來。透過防止 NAD+ 消耗，78c 確保 sirtuin 擁有所需的共同底物，有效恢復隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 依賴性調控。此策略與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補，兩種方法經常結合使用。

nodes.description: Administration of 78c to naturally aged male mice yields about a 14% lifespan extension, demonstrating in vivo geroprotective efficacy. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of prolonged lifespan. This effect is attributed to restored NAD+ and sirtuin function, and it validates CD38 as a longevity drug target. The lifespan benefit in naturally aged animals, rather than in accelerated-aging models, provides particularly strong evidence for translational relevance. 78c's efficacy, combined with its NAD+-sparing mechanism, established CD38 inhibition as a leading pharmacological strategy in geroscience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對自然衰老雄性小鼠施用 78c 可獲得約 14% 的壽命延長，展示了體內抗衰老療效。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於延長壽命的上游。此效應歸因於恢復的 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 功能，驗證了 CD38 作為長壽藥物靶標。在自然衰老動物（而非加速衰老模型）中的壽命益處提供了特別強的轉化相關性證據。78c 的療效結合其 NAD+ 節省機制，確立了 CD38 抑制作為老年科學中領先的藥理學策略。

nodes.label: SIRT1 activation (resveratrol)
nodes.description: Through the AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway, resveratrol reduces hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity models by enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function while limiting lipogenesis. Directionally, SIRT1 activation sits upstream of reduced liver fat accumulation. This demonstrates a translational metabolic benefit of sirtuin activation and is consistent with SIRT1s repression of lipogenic transcription factors such as SREBP-1c and PPAR-γ in the liver. By both increasing lipid catabolism and suppressing de novo lipogenesis, the pathway corrects the imbalance that drives non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過 AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α 通路，白藜蘆醇在飲食誘導肥胖模型中通過增強脂肪酸氧化和粒線體功能同時限制脂肪生成來減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化位於減少肝臟脂肪堆積的上游。這展示了 sirtuin 活化的轉化代謝益處，與 SIRT1 在肝臟中抑制 SREBP-1c 和 PPAR-γ 等脂肪生成轉錄因子一致。通過同時增加脂質分解代謝並抑制新生脂肪合成，該通路糾正了驅動非酒精性脂肪肝病的不平衡。

nodes.label: NAD+ Metabolism
nodes.description: The combined layer carries the single typed edge 'sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism', which pulls the virus into the CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging attribute space; severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion confirmed in 2020–21 literature (Heer et al., JBC 2020) — a mechanistic corridor the triples layer still lacks.
