Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md

nodes.label: SIRT7 inactivation
nodes.description: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Energy Homeostasis
nodes.description: Autophagic recycling of nutrients during fasting supports energy homeostasis. Support is the clearance-to-balance output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 禁食期間自噬回收營養支持能量恆定。支持是清除到平衡的輸出。

nodes.label: 3-Methyladenine
nodes.description: 3-Methyladenine inhibits class-III PI3K (Vps34) in the Beclin1 nucleation complex, preventing phagophore formation and blocking canonical autophagy at initiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 3-Methyladenine 抑制 Beclin1 啟動複合體中的 class-III PI3K（Vps34），阻止 phagophore 形成，在起始步驟阻斷典型自噬。

nodes.label: Chloroquine
nodes.description: Chloroquine raises lysosomal pH and blocks autophagosome-lysosome fusion, arresting autophagic flux at the degradation step; it is the standard late-stage autophagy inhibitor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chloroquine 提高溶酶體 pH 並阻斷自噬體-溶酶體融合，在降解步驟中止自噬流；是標準的晚期自噬抑制劑。

nodes.label: Mortality
nodes.description: In the prospective Bruneck cohort (n=829, 20-year follow-up), higher dietary spermidine intake was independently associated with reduced all-cause mortality (40.5 to 15.1 deaths/1000 person-years across tertiles), replicated in the Salzburg cohort; observational, residual confounding possible.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 前瞻性 Bruneck 世代（n=829，追蹤 20 年）顯示，較高飲食 spermidine 攝取與較低全因死亡率獨立相關（三分位由 40.5 降至 15.1 deaths/1000 person-years），Salzburg 世代亦複驗；屬觀察性研究，仍有殘餘干擾可能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Autophagy Inhibitor
nodes.description: An autophagy inhibitor is a compound that blocks autophagic flux. Classes include lysosomotropic agents (Chloroquine, Hydroxychloroquine, Bafilomycin A1), PI3K inhibitors, ULK1 inhibitors (SBI-0206965, MRT68921), and ATG4 inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬抑制劑是阻斷自噬流的化合物。其類別包括溶酶體親和性藥物（Chloroquine、Hydroxychloroquine、Bafilomycin A1）、PI3K 抑制劑、ULK1 抑制劑（SBI-0206965、MRT68921）以及 ATG4 抑制劑。

nodes.label: C. elegans
nodes.description: C. elegans is a transparent nematode used as a premier model organism in genetics and ageing research, with autophagy, insulin signaling (DAF-2) and nutrient sensing (mTOR) highly conserved with humans. It has provided critical insight into nutrient regulation of autophagy via HLH-30 and MXL-3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C. elegans 是透明的線蟲，為遺傳學與老化研究的首要模式生物，其 Autophagy、胰島素訊號（DAF-2）與營養感測（mTOR）與人類高度保守。它透過 HLH-30 與 MXL-3 提供了營養調控自噬的重要洞見。

nodes.label: Nuclear Export
nodes.description: Nuclear export of TFEB suppresses Autophagy: nutrient-rich conditions activate mTORC1 at the lysosome and ERK2, which phosphorylate TFEB at S142 (priming S138), creating a nuclear export signal that recruits CRM1 and traps TFEB in 14-3-3-bound cytosolic complexes. Under starvation, mTORC1 inhibition dephosphorylates TFEB, allowing nuclear accumulation and activation of CLEAR-network genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 的核輸出會抑制 Autophagy：營養充足時，溶酶體上的 mTORC1 與 ERK2 被活化，磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），產生可招募 CRM1 的核輸出訊號，將 TFEB 困在與 14-3-3 結合的細胞質複合體中。禁食時 mTORC1 抑制使 TFEB 去磷酸化，因而在核內累積並活化 CLEAR network 基因。

nodes.label: HepG2
nodes.description: HepG2 is a human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line widely used to model human liver metabolism, protein synthesis and Autophagy. It supports siRNA-mediated knockdown of TFEB and nutrient-deprivation protocols, making it a convenient human system for lysosomal-autophagy studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HepG2 是人類肝細胞癌細胞系，廣泛用於模擬人類肝臟代謝、蛋白質合成與 Autophagy。它支援 TFEB 的 siRNA 敲低與營養剝奪實驗流程，是研究 lysosome-自噬的便利人類系統。

nodes.label: Carnosine
nodes.description: Carnosine (beta-alanyl-L-histidine) is a dipeptide concentrated in muscle and brain with antioxidant, pH-buffering and anti-glycation activity. In the Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield strategy it acts as a synergist for metal chelation and AGE inhibition, stabilizing the proteostatic environment against oxidative damage to the extracellular matrix, alongside aminoguanidine and the autophagy inducer spermidine — the GOPS protocol pairing a carnosine-stabilized adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine hybrid with spermidine-driven autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Carnosine（beta-alanyl-L-histidine）是高度濃縮於肌肉與腦部的二胜肽，具有抗氧化、pH 緩衝與抗糖化活性。在 Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield 策略中，它作為金屬螯合與 AGE 抑制的協同劑，與 aminoguanidine 及自噬誘導物 spermidine 一同穩定蛋白質穩態環境、對抗細胞外基質的氧化損傷——GOPS 方案 以 carnosine 穩定的 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 雜交分子搭配 spermidine 驅動的自噬。

nodes.label: Chemotherapy sensitivity
nodes.description: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

nodes.label: Caloric Restriction Mimetics
nodes.description: Caloric restriction mimetics are pharmacological agents that reproduce the metabolic and autophagic benefits of caloric restriction without sustained food reduction. Representatives such as 2-deoxyglucose, metformin, and spermidine activate AMPK and/or inhibit mTORC1, recapitulating the low-energy signaling state that drives autophagy. By mimicking nutrient scarcity at the signaling level, these compounds induce lysosomal and autophagic gene programs similar to those engaged during DR. They are attractive translationally because they avoid the practical and compliance limitations of long-term dietary restriction in humans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱量限制擬似物是能再現熱量限制的代謝和自噬益處而無需持續減少食物的藥理劑。代表物如2-deoxyglucose、metformin和spermidine活化AMPK和／或抑制mTORC1，重現驅動自噬的低能量訊號狀態。透過在訊號層面模擬營養匱乏，這些化合物誘導與DR期間相似的溶酶體和自噬基因程序。它們在轉譯上具吸引力，因為它們避免了人類長期飲食限制的實際和依從性限制。

nodes.label: Adaptive autophagy
nodes.description: Moderate caloric restriction induces adaptive autophagy—a beneficial, hormetic form of the pathway that enhances cellular clearance and resilience without causing damage. This adaptive response, driven by AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition, contributes substantially to the lifespan and healthspan extension observed with CR. Unlike pathological autophagy, adaptive autophagy is precisely regulated and supports rather than threatens cell survival. It represents the mechanistic core of CR's pro-longevity effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 適度的熱量限制誘發適應性自噬——一種有益的、激效型（hormetic）的途徑形式，在不造成損傷的情況下增強細胞清除和韌性。此由 AMPK 活化和 mTORC1 抑制驅動的適應性反應，對熱量限制所觀察到的壽命和健康壽命延長貢獻良多。不同於病理性自噬，適應性自噬受到精確調節，支持而非威脅細胞存活。它代表了熱量限制促長壽效應的機制核心。

nodes.label: Excessive autophagy
nodes.description: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

nodes.label: High-AGE diet
nodes.description: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: AGE inhibition
nodes.description: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Glucose Homeostasis
nodes.description: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

nodes.label: NAD+/nicotinamide ratio (brain)
nodes.description: Caloric restriction elevates the brain NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which both supplies more co-substrate for sirtuins and relieves nicotinamide-mediated feedback inhibition of SIRT1. The resulting gain in sirtuin activity supports neuronal stress resistance, mitochondrial function, and suppression of neuroinflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional: CR shifts the ratio upward, which then potentiates sirtuin-dependent protective programs. This mechanism is frequently invoked to explain CR's protective effects against age-related cognitive decline and neurodegenerative pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高大腦的 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值，這既為 sirtuin 提供了更多共同受質，又解除了菸鹼醯胺介導的 SIRT1 回饋抑制。由此產生的 sirtuin 活性增強支持神經元的壓力抗性、粒線體功能和抑制神經發炎信號。這種關係是方向性的：CR 使比值上升，然後增強 sirtuin 依賴性的保護程序。這種機制經常被用來解釋 CR 對抗年齡相關認知退化和神經退行性病變的保護效應。

nodes.label: Drosophila melanogaster
nodes.description: Dietary restriction in Drosophila extends lifespan and, as in yeast, this benefit requires the dSir2 (Sir2) gene, indicating evolutionary conservation of the sirtuin-mediated CR pathway. The effect is thought to operate through improved protein homeostasis, stress resistance, and metabolic efficiency rather than simple calorie shortage. Directionally, reduced nutrient signaling upstream engages dSir2 to produce the longevity phenotype. Caveats include that the magnitude and requirement vary with sex, genetic background, and the precise restriction paradigm used.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在果蠅中，飲食限制延長壽命，且與酵母中一樣，這種益處需要 dSir2（Sir2）基因，表明 sirtuin 介導的 CR 通路具有演化保守性。該效應被認為是通過改善蛋白質穩態、壓力抗性和代謝效率，而非簡單的熱量不足來運作。在方向性上，減少的營養信號在上游啟動 dSir2，從而產生長壽表型。需要注意的是，該效應的強度和需求因性別、遺傳背景和所使用的具體限制方案而異。

nodes.label: β-amyloid neuropathology (Alzheimer's mouse model)
nodes.description: In mouse models engineered to develop Alzheimer's-like pathology, caloric restriction prevents accumulation of β-amyloid neuropathology, an effect consistent with SIRT1-driven reductions in neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. CR also preserves cognitive function and synaptic integrity in these models. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of reduced amyloid burden. This supports the hypothesis that CR protects the brain through sirtuin-mediated resilience, and is consistent with SIRT1's promotion of the non-amyloidogenic α-secretase ADAM10. Human translation remains uncertain, but the findings motivate lifestyle interventions and NAD+-boosting strategies in neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在被設計發展出阿茲海默症樣病變的小鼠模型中，熱量限制防止 β-amyloid 神經病理學的累積，這種效應與 SIRT1 驅動的神經發炎和氧化壓力減少一致。CR 還在這些模型中保留認知功能和突觸完整性。在方向性上，熱量限制位於減少澱粉樣蛋白負擔的上游。這支持了 CR 通過 sirtuin 介導的韌性保護大腦的假說，與 SIRT1 促進非澱粉樣生成的 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 一致。人類轉化仍然不確定，但這些發現為神經退行性疾病中的生活方式干預和 NAD+ 提升策略提供了動力。

nodes.label: Autophagic Cell Death
nodes.description: Prolonged calorie restriction is not uniformly protective: when the autophagic response becomes excessive, the resulting type II autophagic cell death becomes harmful, making the dose and duration of dietary restriction a determinant of whether autophagy supports or destroys the cell.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 長期熱量限制並非一律有益：當自噬反應過度時，所引發的第二型自噬性細胞死亡反而有害，因此飲食限制的劑量與持續時間決定了自噬究竟支持還是摧毀細胞。

nodes.label: Methemoglobin Restriction
nodes.description: placeholder
nodes.description_zh_TW: placeholder

nodes.label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
nodes.description: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。
nodes.norm_label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
nodes.description: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。
nodes.norm_label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of H2A.Z
nodes.description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation and degradation of H2A.Z helps protect the heart from failure by removing a histone variant that drives maladaptive cardiac hypertrophic gene programs. Deacetylated H2A.Z is targeted for proteasomal degradation, reducing its presence at promoters that would otherwise sustain pathological remodeling. Directionally, SIRT1 promotes H2A.Z loss, which attenuates hypertrophy. This is a mechanistically plausible explanation for why SIRT1 activation is cardioprotective, though the in vivo evidence carries moderate confidence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 H2A.Z 去乙醯化和降解通過移除驅動適應不良心臟肥大基因程序的組蛋白變體，幫助保護心臟免於衰竭。去乙醯化的 H2A.Z 被標記進行蛋白酶體降解，減少其在否則會維持病理性重塑的啟動子處的存在。在方向性上，SIRT1 促進 H2A.Z 的缺失，從而減弱肥大。這是 SIRT1 活化具有心臟保護作用的一個機制上合理的解釋，儘管體內證據的信心程度為中等。

nodes.label: PDH (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase)
nodes.description: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Tumour suppressor (glutamine metabolism)
nodes.description: SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting GDH and restricting glutamine-derived anaplerosis into the TCA cycle, starving cancer cells of carbon for proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine metabolism. This limits the glutamine addiction of tumors, which rely on glutamine for both energy and biosynthesis, and it is a context where SIRT4 opposes rather than promotes growth. By restraining glutamine utilization, SIRT4 reduces the metabolic support for rapid proliferation, and its loss in some cancers relieves this brake. SIRT4's tumor-suppressive role is thus tied to its regulation of mitochondrial metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 並限制穀氨醯胺衍生的回補作用進入 TCA 循環來發揮腫瘤抑制因子的作用，使癌細胞缺乏增殖所需的碳源。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制穀氨醯胺代謝的上游。這限制了腫瘤對穀氨醯胺的成癮性——腫瘤依賴穀氨醯胺同時提供能量和生物合成原料——在這個情境下 SIRT4 對抗而非促進生長。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用，SIRT4 減少了快速增殖的代謝支持，其在某些癌症中的缺失解除了此制動。SIRT4 的腫瘤抑制角色因此與其對粒線體代謝的調控相關。

nodes.label: AMPK retrograde signaling
nodes.description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: ATP homeostasis
nodes.description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: breast cancer cells
nodes.description: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle
nodes.description: SIRT4 increases the sensitivity of colorectal cancer cells to the chemotherapeutic drug 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest, which primes CRC cells for 5-fluorouracil-induced killing. By restraining proliferation, SIRT4 enhances the cytotoxic effect of the drug, suggesting that SIRT4 expression status could predict or improve responses to 5-fluorouracil-based therapy in colorectal cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制細胞週期來增加大腸直腸癌細胞對化療藥物5-氟尿嘧啶的敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯的上游，使CRC細胞為5-氟尿嘧啶誘導的殺傷做好準備。透過抑制增殖，SIRT4增強了藥物的細胞毒作用，表明SIRT4表達狀態可能預測或改善大腸直腸癌中5-氟尿嘧啶基治療的反應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Glutamate dehydrogenase
nodes.description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamate dehydrogenase by mono-ADP-ribosylation, reducing conversion of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and limiting anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically suppresses GDH activity within mitochondria. This restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion and mitochondrial ATP generation, marking SIRT4 as a metabolic brake in the organelle. Because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly opposes the oxidative, catabolic programs that SIRT3 promotes, and the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance is emerging as an important determinant of mitochondrial health and metabolic resilience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 通過單 ADP-核糖基化抑制穀氨酸脫氫酶，減少穀氨酸轉化為 α-酮戊二酸，限制回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制粒線體內的 GDH 活性。這限制了胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌和粒線體 ATP 產生，將 SIRT4 標記為該細胞器中的代謝制動器。由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它廣泛對抗 SIRT3 促進的氧化、分解代謝程序，拮抗性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡正在成為粒線體健康和代謝韌性的重要決定因素。

nodes.label: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
nodes.description: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。
nodes.norm_label: nsclc, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Phylogenetic Class II (evolutionarily ancient)
nodes.description: SIRT4 is classified in phylogenetic Class II, which includes sirtuins from bacteria, insects, nematodes, mould, and protozoa—among the most ancient sirtuin lineages. Directionally, this is an evolutionary placement rather than a causal pathway. This antiquity implies conserved mitochondrial metabolic roles, and it situates SIRT4 early in sirtuin evolution. Because Class II sirtuins predate the divergence of major eukaryotic lineages, SIRT4's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function likely represents an ancestral enzymatic activity. Understanding SIRT4's phylogenetic position helps contextualize its metabolic-brake functions relative to the more derived deacetylases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被分類為系統發育 II 類，包括來自細菌、昆蟲、線蟲、黴菌和原生動物的 sirtuin——是最古老的 sirtuin 譜系之一。在方向性上，這是演化定位而非因果途徑。這種古老性暗示保守的粒線體代謝角色，並將 SIRT4 置於 sirtuin 演化的早期。由於 II 類 sirtuin 先於主要真核生物譜系的分化，SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶活性。理解 SIRT4 的系統發育位置有助於將其代謝制動功能置於更衍生的去乙醯酶的背景中。

nodes.label: mitotic cell division regulation
nodes.description: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: E-cadherin promotion
nodes.description: SIRT4 suppresses epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by promoting expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin in gastric cancer cells. This maintains an epithelial phenotype and inhibits cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of maintained epithelial phenotype and suppressed metastasis. By preventing the loss of E-cadherin that characterizes EMT, SIRT4 blocks a key step in the acquisition of invasive and migratory behavior. This supports SIRT4's role as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer, where its downregulation may allow tumors to progress toward metastatic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過促進上皮標記E-cadherin在胃癌細胞中的表達來抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT）。這維持了上皮表型並抑制癌細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT4位於上皮表型維持和轉移抑制的上游。透過阻止EMT特徵性的E-cadherin喪失，SIRT4阻斷了獲得侵襲和遷移行為的關鍵步驟。這支持SIRT4作為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其下調可能使腫瘤向轉移性疾病進展。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: MTPα (fatty acid oxidation)
nodes.description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake that conserves lipids when nutrients are abundant. The inhibition of MTPα and of PPARα signaling shifts metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward lipid storage. SIRT4's opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為在營養豐富時保存脂質的粒線體合成代謝制動器。對 MTPα 和 PPARα 訊號的抑制使代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向脂質儲存。SIRT4 對氧化代謝的對抗是拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

nodes.label: MTPα (mitochondrial trifunctional protein α)
nodes.description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake. By inhibiting MTPα, SIRT4 conserves fatty acids for storage when nutrients are abundant. This opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance that determines mitochondrial metabolic state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為粒線體合成代謝制動器。透過抑制 MTPα，SIRT4 在營養豐富時保存脂肪酸以供儲存。這種對氧化代謝的對抗是決定粒線體代謝狀態的拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

nodes.label: p16 and p21
nodes.description: SIRT4 upregulates expression of the cell-cycle inhibitor genes p16 and p21, while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, and this cell-cycle blockade induces apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction. By enforcing these checkpoints, SIRT4 functions as a tumor suppressor in liver cancer, limiting proliferation and promoting death of transformed cells. The coordinated upregulation of p16 and p21 with suppression of cell-cycle drivers reflects SIRT4's broad influence on the machinery that governs entry into mitosis. This supports interest in SIRT4 as a therapeutic target for hepatocellular carcinoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4上調細胞週期抑制因子p16和p21的表達，同時抑制CyclinB1/Cdc2和Cdc25c，這種細胞週期阻斷誘導肝細胞癌細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯和凋亡誘導的上游。透過強制執行這些檢查點，SIRT4在肝癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子發揮作用，限制增殖並促進轉化細胞的死亡。p16和p21的協調上調與細胞週期驅動因子的抑制反映了SIRT4對控制有絲分裂進入機制的廣泛影響。這支持了SIRT4作為肝細胞癌治療靶點的興趣。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: GABAergic inhibitory cells
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons, the principal output cells of the striatum that integrate cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic inputs. Their inhibitory nature means dopamine modulation via D1/D2 receptors reshapes striatal output to basal ganglia circuits, controlling movement, habit, and reward. As the main targets of nigrostriatal dopamine, they are central to COMT's striatal effects and to dopamine-regulated behavior. They comprise about 95% of striatal neurons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，是整合皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的紋狀體的主要輸出細胞。它們的抑制性質意味著透過 D1/D2 受體的多巴胺調節來重塑 basal ganglia 電路的紋狀體輸出，控制 movement、習慣和 reward。作為黑質紋狀體多巴胺的主要標靶，它們是 COMT 紋狀體效應和多巴胺調節行為的核心。它們大約包括95% of striatal neurons。

nodes.label: 95% of striatal neurons
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons comprise approximately 95% of the neuronal population in the striatum, making them the dominant cell type through which dorsal and ventral striatal circuits operate. Their density underscores why striatal dopamine signaling, and its modulation by COMT and DAT, exerts such broad control over movement, habit, and reward behavior. The remaining 5% consist of interneurons that shape MSN activity. This cellular composition defines the functional architecture of the striatum and of the basal ganglia input stage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約佔紋狀體神經元群的 95%，使其成為背側和腹側紋狀體迴路運作的主要細胞類型。它們的密度強調了為什麼紋狀體多巴胺訊號傳導及其由 COMT 和 DAT 的調節對 movement、習慣和 reward 行為發揮如此廣泛的控制。剩下的 5% 由塑造 MSN 活動的中間神經元組成。這種細胞組成定義了紋狀體和 basal ganglia 輸入級的功能架構。

nodes.label: nigrostriatal projection
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons receive dopamine from the nigrostriatal projection originating in the substantia nigra pars compacta, making them the principal postsynaptic targets of striatal dopamine. The dopamine they receive is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake but also shaped by COMT in regions of lower DAT density. This dopaminergic input is essential for the motor and reward functions medium spiny neurons mediate, and its degeneration underlies Parkinson's disease. It is the central interface between dopamine neurons and striatal output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 從源自黑質緻密部的 nigrostriatal projection 接收多巴胺，使它們成為紋狀體多巴胺的主要突觸後目標。他們接收到的多巴胺主要透過 DAT 再攝取而終止，但在 DAT 密度較低的區域也受到 COMT 的影響。這種多巴胺能輸入對於中等棘神經元介導的運動和 reward 功能至關重要，其退化是帕金森氏症的基礎。它是多巴胺神經元和紋狀體輸出之間的中央介面。

nodes.label: catecholamine balance in Prefrontal Cortex
nodes.description: NET is critical for catecholamine balance in the prefrontal cortex because, in the relative absence of DAT, it is a major mechanism clearing both norepinephrine and dopamine, while COMT handles O-methylation. Disruption of NET, whether genetic or pharmacological, markedly alters prefrontal catechol tone and thus attention, arousal, working memory, and stress responses. Its role makes it a target for antidepressants and attention-deficit treatments. It functions in concert with COMT to maintain prefrontal dopamine homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NET 對於前額葉皮質中的兒茶酚胺平衡至關重要，因為在相對缺乏 DAT 的情況下，它是清除 norepinephrine 和多巴胺的主要機制，而 COMT 則處理 O-甲基化。 NET 的破壞，無論是遺傳的還是藥理學的，都會顯著改變前額葉兒茶酚的張力，從而改變注意力、喚醒、工作記憶和壓力反應。它的作用使其成為抗憂鬱藥物和注意力缺陷治療的目標。它與 COMT 協同作用，維持前額多巴胺穩態。

nodes.label: inhibitory dopamine receptor
nodes.description: The D2 receptor is an inhibitory (Gi/o-coupled) dopamine receptor whose activation reduces cAMP and opens GIRK potassium channels, hyperpolarizing neurons in the central nervous system. It is a major mediator of dopamine's modulatory effects on movement, reward, motivation, and cognition, and is highly expressed on striatal medium spiny neurons. Its inhibition of cAMP signaling contrasts with the excitatory D1 receptor, enabling bidirectional dopaminergic tuning of basal ganglia output. It is also the principal target of antipsychotic medications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 是一種抑制性（Gi/o 偶聯）多巴胺受體，活化可降低 cAMP 並打開 GIRK 鉀通道，使中樞神經系統中的神經元超極化。它是多巴胺對 movement、reward、動機和認知的調節作用的主要介質，並且在紋狀體中型多棘神經元上高度表達。它對 cAMP 訊號傳導的抑制與興奮性 D1 receptor 形成對比，從而實現 basal ganglia 輸出的雙向多巴胺能調節。這也是antipsychotic medications的主要目標。

nodes.label: antipsychotic medications
nodes.description: The D2 receptor is the principal target of antipsychotic medications, especially typical (first-generation) antipsychotics, which exert therapeutic effect by blocking D2 signaling to reduce psychotic symptoms. Occupancy of striatal D2 receptors correlates with both clinical efficacy and the development of extrapyramidal side effects such as parkinsonism and tardive dyskinesia. This targeting links dopaminergic tone, shaped partly by COMT, to psychiatric treatment response. D2 blockade remains the common mechanism across most antipsychotic drug classes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D2 receptor是antipsychotic medications的主要靶點，尤其是典型的（第一代）抗精神病藥，它透過阻斷D2訊號傳導以減輕精神病症狀來發揮治療作用。紋狀體 D2 受體的佔據與臨床療效和錐體外系副作用（如帕金森氏症和遲發性運動障礙）的發生有關。這種標靶將多巴胺能音調（部分由 COMT 塑造）與精神治療反應聯繫起來。 D2 阻斷仍然是大多數抗精神病藥物類別的共同機制。

nodes.label: reward
nodes.description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

nodes.label: dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
nodes.description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) also reuptakes dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, because DAT is sparse there and NET, with modest affinity for dopamine, clears a meaningful fraction of extracellular dopamine. This dual substrate specificity means prefrontal dopamine clearance is shared between NET and COMT, with both contributing to setting dopamine tone. The arrangement explains why noradrenergic drugs, such as NET inhibitors used as antidepressants and attention treatments, can influence prefrontal dopamine levels. It is a key feature of prefrontal catecholamine regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: norepinephrine 轉運蛋白 (NET) 也在前額葉皮質中重新攝取多巴胺，因為那裡的 DAT 很稀疏，而 NET 對多巴胺具有適度的親和力，可以清除相當一部分細胞外多巴胺。這種雙重底物特異性意味著 NET 和 COMT 共享前額多巴胺清除率，兩者都有助於設定多巴胺基調。這種安排解釋了為什麼去甲腎上腺素能藥物，例如用作抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的 NET 抑制劑，可以影響前額葉多巴胺水平。這是前額葉兒茶酚胺調節的關鍵特徵。

nodes.label: DAT expression
nodes.description: The prefrontal cortex has limited dopamine transporter expression compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine persists longer in the extracellular space and is inactivated mainly by diffusion, NET uptake, and COMT O-methylation. This anatomical constraint is the reason COMT genotype exerts its strongest cognitive effects in prefrontal-dependent tasks. It contrasts sharply with the DAT-dominated striatum, where reuptake is fast. This regional difference is foundational to understanding dopamine regulation and COMT's cognitive role.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質的多巴胺轉運蛋白表達有限，這意味著多巴胺在細胞外空間中持續時間更長，並且主要透過擴散、NET 攝取和 COMT O-甲基化而失去活性。這種解剖學限制是 COMT genotype 在前額葉依賴性任務中發揮最強認知作用的原因。它與 DAT 主導的紋狀體形成鮮明對比，後者的再攝取速度很快。這種區域差異是理解多巴胺調節和 COMT 認知作用的基礎。

nodes.label: primary brain region for Working Memory
nodes.description: The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region for working memory, as demonstrated by lesion, neuroimaging, and single-neuron recording studies showing its necessity for holding and manipulating information online. Its dopamine-dependent networks are exquisitely sensitive to COMT activity, since DAT is sparse and COMT dominates dopamine clearance there. This regional specialization makes it the focal point of COMT-cognition research and of the inverted-U dopamine model. Working memory is among the functions most strongly influenced by COMT genotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 病變、神經影像學和單神經元記錄研究表明，前額葉皮質是工作記憶的主要 brain 區域，表明其在線保存和操作資訊的必要性。它的多巴胺依賴性網絡對 COMT activity 非常敏感，因為 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 在那裡主導多巴胺清除。這種區域專業化使其成為 COMT 認知研究和倒 U 型多巴胺模型的焦點。工作記憶是受 COMT genotype 影響最強烈的功能之一。
nodes.norm_label: primary brain region for working memory

nodes.label: balanced dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
nodes.description: Working memory depends on balanced dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, where too little (fast COMT) or too much (slow COMT) dopamine degrades performance according to the inverted-U principle, with D1 receptor signaling particularly critical. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set this dopamine level, making working memory exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Optimal working memory therefore requires COMT activity within a narrow functional window. This is the core of the inverted-U model of dopamine and cognition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 工作記憶取決於前額葉皮質中多巴胺的平衡，根據倒 U 原理，多巴胺太少（快 COMT）或太多（慢 COMT）都會降低性能，其中 D1 receptor 訊號尤其重要。由于前额叶 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 设置了这种多巴胺水平，使工作记忆对 COMT genotype 极其敏感。因此，最佳工作记忆需要 COMT activity 在狭窄的功能窗口内。這是多巴胺和認知倒U模型的核心。

nodes.label: limited-capacity cognitive system
nodes.description: Working memory is a limited-capacity cognitive system that temporarily holds and manipulates information for use in reasoning, comprehension, and planning, distinct from long-term storage. Its capacity is constrained by prefrontal resources and modulated by dopamine, which sets the efficiency of maintenance and manipulation. COMT genotype influences the dopamine tuning that determines an individual's working memory efficiency. It is a core component of executive function and a major focus of cognitive neuroscience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 工作記憶是一種暫時保存和操作資訊以用於推理、理解和計劃的 limited-capacity cognitive system，與長期儲存不同。它的能力受到前額葉資源的限制，並受到多巴胺的調節，多巴胺決定了維護和操縱的效率。 COMT genotype 影響決定個人工作記憶效率的多巴胺調節。它是executive function的核心組件，也是認知神經科學的主要焦點。

nodes.label: COMT for dopamine clearance
nodes.description: Because the dopamine transporter is scarce in the prefrontal cortex, the region relies principally on COMT to methylate dopamine and norepinephrine at the synapse, making it the dominant clearance route. This dependence means genetic variation in COMT strongly influences PFC dopamine tone. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher dopamine while the Val (fast) allele lowers it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白在前額葉皮質稀缺，該區域主要依賴 COMT 在突觸甲基化 dopamine 和 norepinephrine，使其成為主要的清除途徑。這種依賴意味著 COMT 的遺傳變異強烈影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。Met（慢）等位基因保留較高的多巴胺，而 Val（快）等位基因則降低它。

nodes.label: sparse Dopamine Transporter in Prefrontal Cortex
nodes.description: In the prefrontal cortex, where the dopamine transporter is sparsely expressed, NET assumes an outsized role by clearing a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine in addition to norepinephrine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes. The complementary actions of NET and COMT define prefrontal dopamine dynamics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在前額葉皮質，多巴胺轉運蛋白表達稀疏，NET 除了清除 norepinephrine 外還清除大量細胞外 dopamine，因此承擔了超乎尋常的角色。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。NET 和 COMT 的互補作用定義了前額葉多巴胺動力學。
nodes.norm_label: sparse dopamine transporter in prefrontal cortex

nodes.label: spiny dendritic arbors
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons are named for their medium-sized somata and densely spiny dendritic arbors, which receive massive glutamatergic input from the cortex and thalamus. They require convergent excitatory input to transition from a resting down-state to an up-state depolarization that triggers action potentials. This morphology supports their role as integrators of diverse inputs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 因其中等大小的胞體和密集的棘狀樹突樹而得名，後者接收來自皮質和丘腦的大量穀氨酸能輸入。它們需要匯聚的興奮性輸入才能從靜止的 down-state 過渡到觸發動作電位的 up-state 去極化。這種形態支持它們作為多種輸入整合者的角色。

nodes.label: atomoxetine
nodes.description: NET can be inhibited by drugs such as atomoxetine and methylphenidate, which raise both norepinephrine and dopamine in the prefrontal cortex. These NET inhibitors enhance attention and executive function, relevant to ADHD and the cognitive effects of Modafinil. Amphetamine-like compounds reverse NET transport, causing catecholamine efflux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NET 可被 atomoxetine 和 methylphenidate 等藥物抑制，這些藥物會升高前額葉皮質中的 norepinephrine 和 dopamine。這些 NET 抑制劑增強注意力和 executive function，與 ADHD 和 Modafinil 的認知效應相關。安非他命類化合物會逆轉 NET 運輸，導致兒茶酚胺外流。

nodes.label: methyl donor availability
nodes.description: Prefrontal cortex function sits at the intersection of genetics and nutrition because COMT activity is itself modulated by methyl-donor availability such as Methylfolate, MethylB12, and SAMe. By supplying the methyl groups COMT consumes, methyl-donor status influences PFC dopamine tone. This links dietary and supplement choices to prefrontal cognition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質功能位於遺傳和營養的交匯點，因為 COMT activity 本身會受到 Methylfolate、MethylB12 和 SAMe 等甲基供體可用性的調節。透過供應 COMT 消耗的甲基，甲基供體狀態影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。這將飲食和補充劑選擇與前額葉認知連結起來。

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.description: Prefrontal dopamine dysregulation is central to ADHD, where deficits in executive function and attention arise from suboptimal PFC dopamine tone. Interventions such as NET-inhibiting drugs raise PFC dopamine and norepinephrine to improve attention. The PFC therefore sits at the intersection of genetics, cognition, and ADHD treatment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 前額葉多巴胺失調是 ADHD 的核心，執行功能和注意力的缺陷源於次佳化的 PFC 多巴胺張力。抑制 NET 的藥物等介入措施會提高 PFC 的 dopamine 和 norepinephrine 以改善注意力。因此 PFC 位於遺傳、認知和 ADHD 治療的交匯點。

nodes.label: SLC6A2 sodium-dependent symporter
nodes.description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) is a sodium- and chloride-dependent symporter of the SLC6 family encoded by SLC6A2. It couples the inward transport of one norepinephrine molecule with the co-transport of one Na+ and one Cl-. NET is the target of many antidepressants such as reboxetine and of psychostimulants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter (NET) 是 SLC6 家族的鈉和氯依賴性共同轉運體，由 SLC6A2 編碼。它將一個 norepinephrine 分子的向內運輸與一個 Na+ 和一個 Cl- 的共同運輸耦合。NET 是許多抗憂鬱藥（如 reboxetine）和精神興奮劑的靶點。

nodes.label: Norepinephrine transporter for dopamine clearance
nodes.description: The prefrontal cortex relies on the norepinephrine transporter (NET) to clear dopamine in this region because the dopamine transporter (DAT) is sparse. NET takes up both norepinephrine and a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 稀疏，前額葉皮質依賴 norepinephrine transporter (NET) 清除該區域的 dopamine。NET 同時攝取 norepinephrine 和大量細胞外 dopamine。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。

nodes.label: excitatory dopamine receptor
nodes.description: D1 is a Gs-coupled excitatory dopamine receptor driving direct-pathway facilitation, the mirror of Gi-coupled inhibitory D2. This excitatory character explains its pro-movement and reward signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D1 是 Gs 耦合的興奮性多巴胺受體，驅動直接路徑的促進，與 Gi 耦合的抑制性 D2 互為鏡像。此興奮特性解釋其促運動與獎賞訊號。

nodes.label: A53T
nodes.description: Alpha-synuclein and A53T are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and A53T may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Pale Bodies
nodes.description: Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: TOM20
nodes.description: In Parkinson's disease, toxic α-synuclein (α-Syn) binds to the TOM20 receptor on the outer mitochondrial membrane. This binding blocks protein import into Mitochondria by 50%–60%, triggering ROS production and the accumulation of damaged mitochondria, thereby contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired Mitophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，有毒的 α-synuclein (α-Syn) 會結合外層粒線體膜上的 TOM20 受體。此結合使進入 Mitochondria 的蛋白質輸入被阻斷 50%–60%，觸發 ROS 產生與受損粒線體累積，進而促成粒線體功能失調與受損的 Mitophagy。

nodes.label: TFEB at S466/S467/S469
nodes.description: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB on a cluster of serine residues (S466, S467, S469) located in its C-terminal regulatory region in response to energy stress. These phosphorylations enhance TFEB transcriptional activity and promote its nuclear accumulation, synergizing with the relief of mTORC1 repression. The modification thereby directly couples low cellular energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This AMPK-TFEB axis provides a transcription-level reinforcement of the rapid post-translational induction of autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AMPK 在能量壓力下，於其 C 端調節區的絲胺酸殘基簇（S466、S467、S469）磷酸化 TFEB。這些磷酸化增強 TFEB 轉錄活性並促進其核累積，與 mTORC1 抑制的解除產生協同。此修飾因此直接將低細胞能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序的活化。此 AMPK-TFEB 軸提供了對自噬快速轉譯後誘導的轉錄層次強化。

nodes.label: SIRT1 activity in triple-negative breast cancer
nodes.description: AMPK activation reduces the expression of the oncogenic protein metadherin through enhanced SIRT1 activity, acting independently of GSK-3β in triple-negative breast cancer. Directionally, AMPK activation sits upstream of SIRT1-driven repression of metadherin. Because metadherin promotes cancer progression, metastasis, and chemoresistance, its downregulation via the AMPK-SIRT1 axis represents a tumor-suppressive mechanism in triple-negative breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AMPK活化透過增強SIRT1活性來降低致癌蛋白metadherin的表達，在三陰性乳腺癌中不依賴GSK-3β。方向上，AMPK活化位於SIRT1驅動的metadherin抑制的上游。由於metadherin促進癌症進展、轉移和化療耐藥性，其透過AMPK-SIRT1軸的下調代表了三陰性乳腺癌中的一種腫瘤抑制機制。
nodes.norm_label: sirt1 activity in triple-negative breast cancer
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Ca2+ release (ER → cytoplasm)
nodes.description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

nodes.label: Vine Tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata)
nodes.description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

nodes.label: Peroxisome Biogenesis
nodes.description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

nodes.label: PQQ
nodes.description: Pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ) is a small redox-active compound that acts as a potent promoter of mitochondrial biogenesis and stimulant of mitochondrial function. It modulates cellular redox state and activates PGC-1alpha-associated pathways that increase mitochondrial number.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吡咯喹啉醌（PQQ）是小型氧化還原活性化合物，是粒線體生合成的強效促進劑與粒線體功能刺激劑。它調控細胞氧化還原狀態並活化增加粒線體數量的 PGC-1α 相關途徑。

nodes.label: Heat Stress
nodes.description: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

nodes.label: Calmodulin
nodes.description: Calmodulin is the primary Ca2+ sensor in the cytosol, and Ca2+–calmodulin binding induces a conformational change that activates CaMKKβ, which then phosphorylates AMPK. This creates a feed-forward loop linking cytosolic Ca2+ to the AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 axis, connecting calcium signalling to insulin sensitivity and exercise adaptation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Calmodulin 是細胞質中主要的 Ca2+ 感測器，Ca2+ 與 calmodulin 結合後誘導構形改變而活化 CaMKKβ，後者再磷酸化 AMPK。這形成一個前饋迴路，把細胞質 Ca2+ 與 AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 軸連結起來，將鈣離子訊號與胰島素敏感性及運動適應相連。

nodes.label: Compound C
nodes.description: Compound C (Dorsomorphin, BML-275) is a potent, selective and cell-permeable reversible ATP-competitive inhibitor of AMPK (Ki ≈ 109 nM), binding the kinase domain of the catalytic α subunit and preventing phosphorylation of targets such as ACC and TSC2. It is the most widely used pharmacological tool for establishing whether a phenotype requires AMPK activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Compound C（Dorsomorphin、BML-275）是強效、具選擇性且可穿透細胞的可逆性 AMPK ATP 競爭性抑制劑（Ki ≈ 109 nM），結合催化 α 次單元的激酶區並阻止 ACC 與 TSC2 等標的的磷酸化。它是判定某一表型是否需要 AMPK 活性時最廣泛使用的藥理工具。

nodes.label: CD206
nodes.description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

nodes.label: S100A4
nodes.description: In a multi-DAMP TRIM screen including HMGB1, fibrinogen, and HSP90, only oligomeric S100A4 reached beta-glucan-level trained responses via TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling. It upregulates IL-1/IL-6 programs and bypasses tolerance to subsequent LPS. Whether this reflects classical TRIM or prolonged priming remains unresolved.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在包含 HMGB1、fibrinogen 與 HSP90 的多 DAMP TRIM 篩選中，只有 oligomeric S100A4 經由 TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling 達到 beta-glucan 等級的訓練反應。它上調 IL-1/IL-6 程式並 bypass 對後續 LPS 的 tolerance。究屬 classical TRIM 或延長的 priming 仍未定論。

nodes.label: Soluble Urate
nodes.description: Soluble urate induces H3K27ac and H3K4me3 reprogramming in monocytes, and uric-acid priming followed by LPS restimulation boosts IL-1beta production. Methyltransferase inhibitors reverse this primed output. HDAC inhibition likewise modulates MSU-induced proinflammatory cytokines, tying urate training to histone control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Soluble Urate 可在單核球中誘導 H3K27ac 與 H3K4me3 重編程，且 uric-acid priming 後再以 LPS 再刺激可提升 IL-1beta 產量。Methyltransferase inhibitors 可逆轉此 primed 輸出。HDAC inhibition 同樣調節 MSU 誘導的促發炎細胞激素，將 urate training 與 histone control 連結起來。

nodes.label: PARPs
nodes.description: As the innate immune response activates to fight infection, the activation of PARPs increases due to extensive DNA damage and IFN-induced MARylation (mono-ADP-ribosylation) of target SARS-CoV-2 proteins, and this PARP response is required for inhibition of viral replication. However, this antiviral effect is reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose activity is required for virulence. These findings indicate that key events in the innate immune response to viral infections occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through NAM and NR kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當先天免疫反應活化以對抗感染時，由於廣泛的 DNA 損傷與 IFN 誘發的目標 SARS-CoV-2 蛋白 MARylation（單-ADP-核糖基化）作用，PARPs 的活化增加，而此 PARP 反應是抑制病毒複製所必需的。然而，此抗病毒效果被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 所逆轉，其活性為毒力所必需。這些發現指出，對病毒感染的先天免疫反應中的關鍵事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 NAM 與 NR 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能以支援
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Damage-associated molecular pattern
nodes.description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

nodes.label: Immunogenic cell death
nodes.description: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

nodes.label: hs-CRP
nodes.description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) is a high-sensitivity assay for C-reactive protein, an acute-phase reactant whose circulating concentration rises with systemic inflammation. It is the preferred marker for low-grade, chronic inflammation in monitoring protocols.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高敏感 C 反應蛋白（hs-CRP）是 C 反應蛋白的高敏感檢測，C 反應蛋白是循環濃度隨全身發炎升高的急性期反應物。它是監測方案中低度慢性發炎的首選標記。

nodes.label: Training Versus Tolerance
nodes.description: Acute low-dose HMGB1 via RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 favors mTOR-driven glycolysis and weak TRIM, with splenocyte priming for enhanced LPS responses. Chronic or high-dose HMGB1-RAGE signaling instead raises SIRT1/AMPK activity, suppresses mTOR and FAO programs, and enforces tolerance. HMGB1 also represses CPT1a to tune the FAO/glycolysis balance in macrophages.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 急性低劑量 HMGB1 經由 RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 偏向 mTOR-driven glycolysis 與微弱 TRIM，並使 splenocyte priming 以增強 LPS 反應。慢性或高劑量 HMGB1-RAGE signaling 反而升高 SIRT1/AMPK activity，抑制 mTOR 與 FAO 程式，並強制進入 tolerance。HMGB1 還可抑制 CPT1a，以調節巨噬細胞中的 FAO/glycolysis 平衡。

nodes.label: Immune Complex
nodes.description: An immune complex is an aggregate of immunoglobulin bound to soluble antigen. Such complexes activate complement, engage Fc receptors on phagocytes and deposit in tissues, driving type III hypersensitivity reactions such as serum sickness, rheumatoid vasculitis and glomerulonephritis. They are functionally distinct from inflammasomes, which are cytosolic multiprotein scaffolds rather than antibody-based aggregates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: immune complex 是免疫球蛋白與可溶性抗原結合形成的聚集體。此類複合體會活化 complement、與吞噬細胞上的 Fc receptor 結合並沉積於組織，驅動血清病、類風濕性血管炎與腎小球腎炎等第三型過敏反應。它們在功能上不同於 inflammasome——後者是細胞質多蛋白支架，而非抗體形成的聚集體。

nodes.label: Th17 inflammatory profile
nodes.description: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Autophagy takes it all – autophagy inducers target immune aging.md

nodes.label: Myeloid Differentiation
nodes.description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: Procyanidin C1
nodes.description: Procyanidin C1 (PCC1) is an oligomeric proanthocyanidin with selective senolytic activity, killing senescent cells and extending healthspan in mice. It served as a positive senolytic control in the screen that identified apigenin as a senomorphic.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 原花青素 C1（PCC1）是具有選擇性 senolytic（清除衰老細胞）活性的寡聚原花青素，可清除衰老細胞並延長小鼠健康壽命。它在鑑定 apigenin 為 senomorphic 的篩選中作為陽性 senolytic 對照。

nodes.label: JQ1
nodes.description: JQ1 is the prototype BET inhibitor displacing BRD4 from acetylated histones and suppressing MYC. Tool-compound edge of the BET axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JQ1 是將 BRD4 從乙醯化組蛋白移開並抑制 MYC 的原型 BET 抑制劑。BET 軸的工具化合物邊。

nodes.label: STAT
nodes.description: JAK (Janus kinase) phosphorylates latent cytoplasmic STAT transcription factors on tyrosine residues, triggering their dimerization and nuclear translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JAK（Janus 激酶）對潛伏於胞質的 STAT 轉錄因子進行酪胺酸磷酸化，促使其二聚化並轉位入核。

nodes.label: Immature Myeloid Cell
nodes.description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are the most functionally important population of immature myeloid cells: rather than representing a single lineage, their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets. They are scarce at steady state but expand dramatically under pathological stress, and are recruited into the tumor microenvironment where they suppress T-cell and NK-cell function through arginine depletion, reactive oxygen species and induction of regulatory T cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) 是 immature myeloid cells 中功能上最重要的族群：其分類反映的是一種分化停滯狀態（具有 polymorphonuclear 與 monocytic 亞群），而非單一譜系。她們在穩態下稀少，但在病理壓力下大幅擴張，並被招募進 tumor microenvironment，透過消耗 arginine、產生 reactive oxygen species 及誘導 regulatory T cells 來抑制 T 細胞與 NK 細胞功能。

nodes.label: TAME Trial
nodes.description: The TAME Trial (Targeting Aging with Metformin) is a FDA-approved clinical study testing whether Metformin delays aging-related multimorbidity. It enrolled 3000 participants aged 65 to 79 and examines whether metformin can attenuate the hallmarks of Aging and delay the onset of age-related diseases, using a framework of blood-based Biomarkers to monitor the intervention's effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TAME Trial（Targeting Aging with Metformin）是一項經 FDA 核准的臨床研究，測試 Metformin 能否延緩與老化相關的多病共存。它納入了 3000 名 65 至 79 歲的受試者，檢視 metformin 能否減弱老化的特徵並延後年齡相關疾病的發生，並以血液生物標記的框架監測介入的效應。

nodes.label: STAT1
nodes.description: Interferon-gamma receptor engagement activates the JAK kinases (JAK1, JAK2), which phosphorylate STAT1; phosphorylated STAT1 homodimers (GAF) translocate to the nucleus and bind gamma-activated sequences in the promoters of hundreds of interferon-stimulated genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Interferon-gamma 受體的接合活化 JAK 激酶（JAK1、JAK2），後者磷酸化 STAT1；被磷酸化的 STAT1 同源二聚體（GAF）轉位入核，結合數百個干擾素刺激基因啟動子上的 gamma 活化序列。

nodes.label: Pathological fibrosis
nodes.description: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: N-cadherin
nodes.description: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

nodes.label: FGF Receptor
nodes.description: N-cadherin engagement drives FGFR survival and motility signaling at the protein level; CDH2 gene used as canonical subject. Activation is the motility output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-cadherin 結合在蛋白層級驅動 FGFR 存活與遷移訊號；CDH2 基因用作典型主詞。活化是遷移輸出。

nodes.label: ABCA1 mutations
nodes.description: ABCA1 mutations cause Tangier disease, a rare disorder in which loss-of-function ABCA1 alleles lead to extremely low HDL and accumulation of cholesteryl esters in macrophages and other tissues. The defect blocks cholesterol efflux, producing enlarged orange tonsils and neuropathy. The directionality is transporter loss to lipid accumulation. A caveat is that incomplete versus complete loss of function yields a spectrum of severity, and modifier genes influence phenotype. Heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect and the clinical spectrum between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABCA1 mutations 導致 Tangier disease，這是一種罕見的疾病，其中 ABCA1 等位基因功能喪失導致 HDL 極低以及巨噬細胞和其他組織中膽固醇酯的累積。此缺陷阻礙了 cholesterol 的流出，導致橙色扁桃體增大和神經病變。方向性是轉運蛋白損失導致脂質累積。需要注意的是，不完全與完全功能喪失會產生一系列嚴重程度，且修飾基因會影響表型。雜合子表現出中等程度的 HDL 降低，說明了基因劑量效應以及 Tangier disease 和家族性 HDL 缺乏症之間的臨床光譜。

nodes.label: Cholesterol Homeostasis
nodes.description: ABCA1 regulates cholesterol homeostasis by mediating the efflux of cellular cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apolipoproteins such as apoA-I. This is the first step in reverse cholesterol transport and HDL biogenesis. The directionality is transporter activity to lipid export. A caveat is that ABCA1 also influences phospholipid trafficking and immune cell function, so its role extends beyond pure cholesterol handling. Loss of ABCA1 function underlies Tangier disease, and its deficiency in macrophages promotes foam-cell formation and accelerated atherosclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過介導細胞 cholesterol 和磷脂質向脂質貧乏的 apolipoproteins（例如 apoA-I）的流出來調節 cholesterol homeostasis。這是reverse cholesterol transport和HDL生物發生的第一步。方向性是脂質輸出的轉運蛋白活性。需要注意的是，ABCA1 也影響磷脂運輸和免疫細胞功能，因此其作用超出了純粹的 cholesterol 處理範圍。 ABCA1 功能的喪失是 Tangier disease 的基礎，巨噬細胞中的 ABCA1 功能缺失會促進泡沫細胞的形成並加速 atherosclerosis。

nodes.label: Inflammatory Gene Expression
nodes.description: LXRalpha suppresses inflammatory gene expression, as SUMOylated LXRalpha recruits corepressors such as NCoR to NF-kappaB target promoters, dampening cytokine responses. This links cholesterol sensing to immune moderation. The directionality is LXRalpha to transcriptional repression of inflammation. A caveat is that the anti-inflammatory effect is gene- and context-specific and can be overshadowed by pro-lipogenic actions at high activation. This transrepression is SUMO-dependent and independent of DNA binding, distinguishing it from classic LXR agonist responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 抑制 inflammatory gene expression，因為 SUMO 化的 LXRalpha 會將 NCoR 等輔阻遏物招募到 NF-kappaB 目標啟動子上，從而抑制細胞激素反應。這將 cholesterol 感測與免疫調節聯繫起來。 LXRα 的方向性是發炎轉錄抑制。需要注意的是，抗發炎作用是基因和環境特異性的，並且可能被高活化時的促脂肪生成作用所掩蓋。這種反式抑制是 SUMO 依賴性的並且獨立於 DNA 結合，使其與經典的 LXR 激動劑反應區分開來。

nodes.label: Oxidized Phospholipids
nodes.description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

nodes.label: Oxysterols
nodes.description: LXRalpha is activated by oxysterols such as 22(R)-, 24(S)-, and 27-hydroxycholesterol, which serve as endogenous ligands that trigger the receptor's transcriptional program. This couples cellular cholesterol status to gene regulation. The directionality is oxysterol ligand to LXRalpha activation. A caveat is that synthetic LXR agonists activate more potently but can cause undesirable lipogenesis, revealing context-dependent outcomes. Because oxysterol levels rise with cholesterol oxidation, LXRalpha links oxidative stress to protective transcriptional responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 被 22(R)-、24(S)- 和 27-羥基cholesterol 等 oxysterols 激活，它們作為觸發受體轉錄程序的內源配體。這將細胞 cholesterol 狀態與基因調控結合。方向性是氧甾醇配體對LXRα 的活化。需要注意的是，合成 LXR 激動劑的活化作用更有效，但可能會導致不良的脂肪生成，從而揭示與環境相關的結果。由於氧甾醇水平隨著 cholesterol 氧化而升高，因此 LXRalpha 將 oxidative stress 與保護性轉錄反應聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Inflammatory Gene Promoters
nodes.description: oxLDL-trained monocytes gain H3K4me3 at inflammatory promoters, similar to beta-glucan training, and methyltransferase inhibitors block the trained cytokine output. H3K4me3/H3K27ac enrichment is also seen on the TNF-alpha promoter in monocytes from symptomatic atherosclerosis patients. The mark poises promoters for enhanced transcription upon rechallenge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidized LDL 訓練後的單核球在發炎啟動子處獲得 H3K4me3，類似於 beta-glucan 訓練，且 methyltransferase inhibitors 可阻斷訓練後的細胞激素輸出。在 symptomatic atherosclerosis 患者的單核球中，也可在 TNF-alpha 啟動子上看到 H3K4me3/H3K27ac 富集。該標記使啟動子處於 poised 狀態，以便再刺激時增強轉錄。

nodes.label: Heart disease
nodes.description: Atherosclerosis is the central mechanism of most cardiovascular events through endothelial injury to plaque. Causation records the etiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 動脈粥狀硬化經由內皮損傷到斑塊是多數心血管事件的中央機制。因果記錄病因。

nodes.label: Apolipoprotein A1
nodes.description: Apolipoprotein A1 is the primary protein component of HDL and the specific acceptor for ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux: ABCA1 transfers cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apoA-1, and lipidated apoA-1 then initiates HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport. Low apoA-1 levels are associated with increased atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease risk. Resveratrol enhances apoA-1-mediated efflux by upregulating ABCA1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein A1 是 HDL 的主要蛋白質成分，也是 ABCA1 媒介膽固醇外排的特定受體：ABCA1 將膽固醇與磷脂轉移給脂質貧乏的 apoA-1，而經脂質化的 apoA-1 隨後啟動 HDL 生成與逆向膽固醇運輸。apoA-1 濃度偏低與動脈粥狀硬化及心血管疾病風險升高相關。Resveratrol 藉由上調 ABCA1 增強 apoA-1 媒介的外排。

nodes.label: Apolipoprotein E
nodes.description: Apolipoprotein E mediates cholesterol transport and clearance via LDL receptor family members, and the APOE gene has isoforms (ε2, ε3, ε4) with differential cardiovascular and neurodegenerative risk. ApoE-knockout mice spontaneously develop atherosclerosis and are a standard model; in these diabetic ApoE-KO mice, inhibiting DRP1 reduced endothelial dysfunction and lesion progression, showing excess mitochondrial fission contributes to atherogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein E 透過 LDL receptor 家族成員介導膽固醇的運輸與清除，APOE 基因具有 ε2、ε3、ε4 等型，其心血管與神經退行性風險各不相同。ApoE 剔除小鼠會自發性產生動脈粥狀硬化，是標準模型；在這些糖尿病 ApoE-KO 小鼠中，抑制 DRP1 可減少內皮功能障礙與病灶進展，顯示過度的粒線體分裂促成動脈粥狀硬化形成。

nodes.label: SARS-CoV-2 Nsp3
nodes.description: The ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3 reverses the antiviral effect of PARPs, which is required for inhibition of viral replication during infection, and the activity of nsp3 is itself required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence. By removing mono-ADP-ribose (MARylation) marks deposited on viral proteins by IFN-induced PARP activation, nsp3 counteracts the host's antiviral ADP-ribosylation response. These events occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 逆轉了 PARPs 的抗病毒效果，而後者為感染期間抑制病毒複製所必需，且 nsp3 的活性本身為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。透過移除由 IFN 誘發的 PARP 活化沉積在病毒蛋白上的 mono-ADP-ribose（MARylation，單-ADP-核糖）標記，nsp3 抵銷了宿主的抗病毒 ADP-ribosylation（ADP-核糖基化）反應。這些事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 nicotinamide riboside 與 nicotinamide 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能，以支援對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: BRCA1 mutation
nodes.description: BRCA1-deficient tumors are exquisitely sensitive to PARP inhibitors because blocking base-excision (PARP) repair in the setting of defective homologous recombination causes catastrophic, lethal DNA damage through synthetic lethality. Directionally, BRCA1 mutation sits upstream of PARP-inhibitor vulnerability. This is a cornerstone of precision oncology, targeting the specific repair defect of the tumor. It illustrates how repair-pathway context determines therapeutic selectivity, and it has transformed the treatment of BRCA-mutated breast and ovarian cancer. Sirtuins that modulate repair pathways may influence sensitivity to such agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA1 缺陷型腫瘤對 PARP 抑制劑高度敏感，因為在同源重組缺陷的情況下阻斷鹼基切除（PARP）修復會透過合成致死導致災難性的致死 DNA 損傷。在方向性上，BRCA1 突變位於 PARP 抑制劑脆弱性的上游。這是精準腫瘤學的基石，靶向腫瘤的特定修復缺陷。它說明了修復途徑情境如何決定治療選擇性，並已改變了 BRCA 突變乳腺癌和卵巢癌的治療。調控修復途徑的 sirtuin 可能影響對此類藥物的敏感性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: double-strand breaks in NHEJ
nodes.description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

nodes.label: Compensatory autophagy
nodes.description: Loss of BRCA1 triggers increased autophagy as a compensatory survival mechanism in breast and ovarian cancers, buffering the viability impact of defective homologous recombination. Directionally, BRCA1 deficiency sits upstream of autophagic upregulation. This metabolic rewiring can be co-opted by tumors to survive despite genome instability, and it connects genome-maintenance failure to lysosomal clearance pathways. Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: NAM (nicotinamide) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
nodes.description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: EREG
nodes.description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

nodes.label: WNT16B
nodes.description: WNT16B is a Wnt family ligand induced and secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP, where it promotes paracrine therapy resistance in adjacent cancer cells. Apigenin treatment reduces WNT16B expression dose-dependently.
nodes.description_zh_TW: WNT16B 是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分誘導並分泌的 Wnt 家族配體，在相鄰癌細胞中促進旁分泌治療抗藥性。Apigenin 治療以劑量依賴方式降低 WNT16B 表現。

nodes.label: AIF
nodes.description: Apoptosis-inducing factor translocates from mitochondria to the nucleus with MIF to execute large-scale DNA fragmentation in parthanatos. This caspase-independent route distinguishes parthanatos from classical apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apoptosis-inducing factor 與 MIF 從粒線體轉位至核，在 parthanatos 中執行大規模 DNA 片段化。此 caspase 非依賴途徑區分 parthanatos 與典型凋亡。

nodes.label: nNOS
nodes.description: In male ischemic neurons, nNOS-derived peroxynitrite drives the DNA damage that hyperactivates PARP1; nNOS blockade protects males by cutting off parthanatos at its source.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在雄性缺血神經元中，nNOS 衍生的 peroxynitrite 造成 DNA 損傷並使 PARP1 過度活化；阻斷 nNOS 可從源頭切斷 parthanatos，保護雄性。

nodes.label: PJ-34
nodes.description: PJ-34 is a PARP inhibitor that blocks parthanatos by preventing PARP1 hyperactivation and downstream PAR/AIF/MIF signaling; in stroke models it protects males only.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PJ-34 是 PARP 抑制劑，透過阻止 PARP1 過度活化及下游 PAR/AIF/MIF 訊號來阻斷 parthanatos；在中風模型中僅保護雄性。

nodes.label: O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
nodes.description: ARH3 hydrolyzes O-acetyl-ADP-ribose, the sirtuin deacetylation byproduct that regulates SIRT activity, TRPM2 gating and redox, using the same Mg2+-dependent alpha-anomer stereospecific mechanism as for PAR and serine-ADPr.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARH3 以與 PAR 及絲氨酸 ADPr 相同的 Mg2+ 依賴、alpha-anomer 立體專一機制，水解 sirtuin 去乙醯化副產物 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose，該分子調控 SIRT 活性、TRPM2 通道與氧化還原。

nodes.label: Cyclophilin A
nodes.description: Cyclophilin A is proposed to form an AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex in which AIF provides nuclease activity for large-scale DNA fragmentation, an alternative to the MIF/PAAN nuclease model of AIF-dependent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin A 被提出與 AIF 及組蛋白 H2AX 形成複合體，其中由 AIF 提供核酸酶活性以進行大規模 DNA 斷裂，為 AIF 依賴性 parthanatos 中 MIF/PAAN 核酸酶模型之外的替代機制（Moura et al. 2024）。

nodes.label: MMS
nodes.description: MMS is a direct-acting methylating agent whose DNA lesions (mainly N3-methyladenine and N7-methylguanine, repaired by base excision repair) activate PARP1 and can trigger PARP1-dependent parthanatos, alongside apoptosis at other doses (Moura et al. 2024).
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMS 是直接作用的甲基化劑，其 DNA 損傷（主要為 N3-methyladenine 與 N7-methylguanine，經鹼基切除修復）會活化 PARP1，並可觸發依賴 PARP1 的 parthanatos，於其他劑量下亦可引發 apoptosis（Moura et al. 2024）。

nodes.label: PARG53
nodes.description: PARG53 is a catalytically active ~53-kDa splice isoform of PARG (exons 1-8) described in 2026; its existence revises the prior PARG55/60 annotation and explains why exon 2-7 knockout clones can retain PAR-hydrolytic activity and still die, confounding knockout-versus-inhibitor comparisons (bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507).
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARG53 是 2026 年描述的 PARG 具催化活性之約 53 kDa 剪接異構體（外顯子 1-8）；其存在修正了先前的 PARG55/60 註解，並解釋為何外顯子 2-7 敲除株仍可保留 PAR 水解活性並死亡，因而混淆了敲除與抑制劑的比較（bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507）。

nodes.label: Ca2+ overload
nodes.description: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
