nodes.description_zh_TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

nodes.label: MitoQ
nodes.description: MitoQ reduces mitochondrial ROS as a mitochondria-targeted ubiquinone derivative that accumulates in the matrix and chain-breaks peroxyl radicals at their source. By concentrating antioxidant capacity inside mitochondria, it limits the downstream damage from leaked electrons. The directionality is targeted antioxidant to lowered mitochondrial oxidant burden. A caveat is that high doses of MitoQ can accumulate and potentially act as a pro-oxidant by virtue of its redox-cycling quinone structure. MitoQ has shown benefit in models of ischemia-reperfusion, neurodegeneration, and age-related vascular dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MitoQ 將 mitochondrial ROS 還原為 mitochondria 靶向泛醌衍生物，該衍生物在基質中積累，並在其源頭斷鏈過氧自由基。透過將抗氧化能力集中在 mitochondria 內部，它限制了洩漏電子對下游的損害。方向性是靶向抗氧化劑以降低mitochondria1氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，高劑量的 MitoQ 可能會積累，並可能因其氧化還原循環醌結構而充當促氧化劑。 MitoQ 在缺血再灌注、neurodegeneration 和年齡相關血管功能障礙模型中顯示出益處。

nodes.label: JNK Activation
nodes.description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation. A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

nodes.label: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling
nodes.description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling, as mtROS promote removal of this negative feedback inhibitor, permitting full Smad2/3 activation. This embeds mitochondria within the TGF-beta pathway. The directionality is mtROS to loss of SMAD7 restraint. A caveat is that SMAD7 is also regulated by ubiquitination and other mechanisms, so ROS modulates rather than exclusively controls it. This places mitochondria as regulators of TGF-beta signaling strength and explains why mitochondrial antioxidants blunt fibrosis in some models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling 需要 Mitochondrial ROS，因為 mtROS 促進去除這種負回饋抑制劑，從而允許完全活化 Smad2/3。這將 mitochondria 嵌入到 TGF-beta 路徑中。方向性是 mtROS 到 SMAD7 失去約束。需要注意的是，SMAD7 也受到泛素化和其他機制的調節，因此 ROS 調節而不是專門控制它。這使得 mitochondria 成為 TGF-beta 訊號強度的調節器，並解釋了為什麼 mitochondrial antioxidants 在某些模型中會鈍化 fibros。

nodes.label: TNFR1 signaling
nodes.description: TNFR1 signaling generates mitochondrial ROS when TRAF2 recruits TRIM21, causing electron leak at Complex I and raising mtROS. These ROS then propagate the TNFR1 pro-inflammatory and pro-death program. The directionality is receptor signaling to mitochondrial oxidant production. A caveat is that TNFR1 also engages cytosolic NOX and other ROS sources, so mitochondria are one node in the oxidative response. This mitochondrial ROS signal contributes to necroptosis and inflammatory gene induction downstream of TNF-alpha, and can be suppressed by mitochondrial-targeted antioxidants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當 TRAF2 招募 TRIM21 時，TNFR1 signaling 產生 mitochondrial ROS，導致複合物 I 處的電子洩漏併升高 mtROS。然後，這些 ROS 傳播 TNFR1 促發炎和促死亡程序。方向性是針對mitochondria1氧化劑所產生的受體訊號傳導。需要注意的是，TNFR1 也參與胞質 NOX 和其他 ROS 來源，因此 mitochondria 是氧化反應中的一個節點。此mitochondrial ROS訊號有助於necroptosis和TNF-alpha下游的發炎基因誘導，並且可以被靶向mitochondria1的antioxidants抑制。

nodes.label: Succinate
nodes.description: Succinate oxidation at Complex II drives reverse electron transport at Complex I, bursting mitochondrial ROS that stabilize HIF-1alpha and interleukin-1beta. Metabolite oxidation signals immune activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Complex II 的琥珀酸氧化驅動 Complex I 逆向電子傳遞，爆發粒線體 ROS 以穩定 HIF-1alpha 與 interleukin-1beta。代謝物氧化傳遞免疫活化訊號。

nodes.label: Angiotensin II
nodes.description: NADPH oxidase is activated by angiotensin II via the AT1 receptor, which triggers assembly of NOX isoforms (especially NOX1) in vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells. This couples the renin-angiotensin system to vascular oxidative stress and hypertension. The directionality is hormone to enzyme activation. A caveat is that AT1 signaling also activates other ROS sources and inflammatory pathways, so NOX is a major but not sole mediator of angiotensin-II effects. Angiotensin-II-driven NOX activation is a well-established mechanism in hypertension, contributing to vascular remodeling and target-organ damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase 被 angiotensin II 透過 AT1 受體激活，從而觸發血管平滑肌和內皮細胞中 NOX 同工型（尤其是 NOX1）的組裝。這將腎素-血管緊張素系統與血管 oxidative stress 和高血壓聯繫起來。方向性是荷爾蒙到酵素的活化。需要注意的是，AT1 訊號傳導也會活化其他 ROS 來源和發炎途徑，因此 NOX 是血管張力素 II 效應的主要但不是唯一的介質。血管張力素 II 驅動的 NOX 活化是高血壓的一種成熟機制，有助於血管重塑和目標器官損傷。

nodes.label: Uncoupled eNOS
nodes.description: Uncoupled eNOS produces superoxide radicals when BH4 or L-arginine becomes limiting, causing the enzyme to redirect electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. This converts the principal vascular protective enzyme into a ROS source. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling may still yield some NO, and the transition is graded rather than binary. This uncoupling is a central mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in hypertension, diabetes, and atherosclerosis, and therapies that restore BH4 or arginine aim to re-couple the enzyme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，Uncoupled eNOS 會產生 superoxide radicals，導致酵素將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。這將主要的血管保護酶轉化為 ROS 源。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍可能產生一些 NO，而且轉變是分級的而不是二元的。這種解偶聯是 endothelial dysfunction 在高血壓、糖尿病和 atherosclerosis 中的核心機制，恢復 BH4 或精氨酸的療法旨在重新偶聯該酶。

nodes.label: Innate Immune Defense
nodes.description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

nodes.label: 3-Nitrotyrosine
nodes.description: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

nodes.label: Hypotension
nodes.description: Massive nitric oxide release during septic shock, anaphylaxis, or post-cardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia causes excessive vasodilation and life-threateningly low blood pressure (hypotension). NO overproduction is driven largely by the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme during the inflammatory response. Therapeutic strategies target this cascade at different levels: aminoguanidine inhibits iNOS to block NO synthesis upstream, while methylene blue inhibits soluble guanylyl cyclase to block NO signaling downstream and restore blood pressure when vasopressors fail.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在敗血症性休克、過敏反應或心肺分流術後血管麻痺期間，大量一氧化氮釋放導致過度血管舒張和危及生命的低血壓（低血壓）。NO過度產生主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）在炎症反應期間驅動。治療策略在不同層面靶向此級聯：氨基胍抑制iNOS以在上游阻斷NO合成，而亞甲藍抑制可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶以在下游阻斷NO信號並在血管加壓素失效時恢復血壓。

nodes.label: Lipids
nodes.description: Nitrative stress nitrates unsaturated fatty acids to yield nitrated lipids such as nitrolinoleic acid and nitro-oleic acid. Unlike the destructive protein modifications, nitrated lipids act as endogenous signaling molecules that activate PPARgamma and inhibit NF-kB signaling, representing a negative feedback loop in inflammation. They also undergo Michael addition with cysteine thiols to activate the Nrf2 antioxidant program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 硝化不飽和脂肪酸，產生 nitrated lipids，例如 nitrolinoleic acid 和 nitro-oleic acid。與破壞性的蛋白質修飾不同，nitrated lipids 作為內源性 signaling molecules，活化 PPARgamma 並抑制 NF-kB 訊號，構成發炎中的負回饋迴路。它們也會與半胱胺酸硫醇進行 Michael addition，活化 Nrf2 抗氧化程序。

nodes.label: Methotrexate
nodes.description: Methotrexate, a first-line disease-modifying antirheumatic drug, increases extracellular adenosine, which suppresses NADPH Oxidase activity in neutrophils and inhibits TNF-induced ROS production in synovial fibroblasts, blunting oxidative joint damage in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methotrexate 是第一線的疾病修飾抗發炎藥物，它提高細胞外 adenosine，進而抑制 Neutrophils 中的 NADPH Oxidase 活性並阻止滑膜纖維母細胞中 TNF 誘發的 ROS 產生，減輕 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的氧化性關節損傷。

nodes.label: Yeast
nodes.description: Overexpression of the sirtuin Sir2 extends lifespan in budding yeast by suppressing the formation of toxic extrachromosomal rDNA circles. Sir2 maintains silencing at the rDNA locus, and its activity prevents the homologous recombination events that generate these circles during aging. This early discovery established sirtuins as longevity regulators and motivated extensive study of their mammalian homologs, particularly SIRT1, in aging and age-related disease, including the search for small-molecule sirtuin activators.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin Sir2 的過度表現可透過抑制有毒染色體外 rDNA 環的形成來延長芽殖酵母的壽命。 Sir2 在 rDNA 基因座上保持沉默，其活性可防止在老化過程中產生這些環的同源重組事件。這項早期發現確立了去乙醯化酶作為長壽調節劑的地位，並推動了對其哺乳動物同源物（特別是 SIRT1）在衰老和年齡相關疾病中的廣泛研究，包括尋找小分子去乙醯化酶激活劑。

nodes.label: Mono-ADP-ribosyl transferases
nodes.description: Beyond deacetylation, several sirtuins catalyze mono-ADP-ribosylation, transferring the ADP-ribose moiety of NAD+ onto target proteins without removing an acetyl group. SIRT4 and SIRT6 prominently display this mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, with SIRT6 using it to recruit heterochromatin proteins such as KAP1/HP1α. The directionality is that NAD+ is the donor and the target lysine (or other residue) is the acceptor, producing a mono-ADP-ribosylated product rather than free OAADPr. Biologically, ADP-ribosylation allows sirtuins to regulate processes—such as DNA repair and LINE-1 repression—distinct from their deacetylase functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了去乙醯化作用外，多種 sirtuin 還能催化單 ADP-核糖基化，將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖基團轉移到目標蛋白上，而不移除乙醯基。SIRT4 和 SIRT6 顯著表現出這種單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，其中 SIRT6 利用該活性招募異染色質蛋白如 KAP1/HP1α。其方向性為 NAD+ 作為供體，目標離胺酸（或其他殘基）作為受體，產生單 ADP-核糖基化的產物而非游離的 OAADPr。在生物學上，ADP-核糖基化允許 sirtuin 調節 DNA 修復和 LINE-1 抑制等過程，這些功能與其去乙醯酶功能不同。

nodes.label: p53 (via hyperacetylation)
nodes.description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

nodes.label: mTOR signaling
nodes.description: Nutrient abundance activates the mTOR pathway, which promotes anabolic processes such as protein synthesis and lipid accumulation while suppressing autophagy. Sirtuins counterbalance this anabolic state by favoring catabolic pathways that restore metabolic equilibrium. Directionally, sirtuins and mTOR act as opposed nutrient-sensing axes. This opposition is most evident during caloric restriction or fasting, when falling nutrient signals dampen mTOR while NAD+-sensitive sirtuins drive fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial maintenance, and autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 營養豐富活化mTOR通路，促進蛋白質合成和脂質積累等合成代謝過程，同時抑制自噬。Sirtuin透過有利於恢復代謝平衡的分解代謝途徑來平衡此合成代謝狀態。方向上，sirtuin和mTOR作為對立的營養感知軸。這種對抗在熱量限制或禁食時最為明顯，此時營養訊號下降抑制mTOR，而NAD+敏感的sirtuin驅動脂肪酸氧化、粒線體維護和自噬。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: PARP1 and PARP2
nodes.description: PARP1 and PARP2 are major NAD+-consuming enzymes whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function, creating competition for the same limited co-substrate. Directionally, PARP activity sits upstream of NAD+ consumption and reduced sirtuin availability. This competition is especially relevant during DNA damage, when PARP activation surges and rapidly consumes NAD+ to synthesize ADP-ribose polymers. Because both PARPs and sirtuins are essential for genome maintenance and stress responses, their shared dependence on NAD+ creates an intrinsic trade-off.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARP1和PARP2是主要的NAD+消耗酶，其活性可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能，造成對相同有限共同底物的競爭。方向上，PARP活性位於NAD+消耗和sirtuin可用性降低的上游。這種競爭在DNA損傷期間尤為重要，因為PARP活化急劇上升並迅速消耗NAD+以合成ADP-核糖聚合物。由於PARP和sirtuin都對基因組維護和壓力反應至關重要，它們對NAD+的共同依賴造成了一種內在的權衡。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: Adenosine-binding site with kinases
nodes.description: Sirtuins and protein kinases both contain an adenosine-binding pocket in their catalytic machinery, an overlap that allowed screening of known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2. This shared scaffold led to the discovery that bisindolylmaleimides such as Ro31-8220 and indolinones such as GW5074 inhibit SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. Directionally, the shared adenosine site is the molecular basis for cross-inhibition between kinase inhibitors and sirtuins, but it also means these compounds retain kinase activity, complicating the attribution of cellular effects to sirtuin inhibition alone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 和蛋白激酶在其催化機制中都包含一個腺嘌呤結合口袋，這種重疊使得已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的篩選成為可能。這種共享的骨架結構導致發現雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺如 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮如 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。方向性上共享的腺嘌呤位點是激酶抑制劑和 sirtuin 之間交叉抑制的分子基礎，但也意味著這些化合物保留了激酶活性，使將細胞效應歸因於單純 sirtuin 抑制變得複雜。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Xenograft models
nodes.description: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6 significantly delay tumor growth in human cancer mouse xenografts at single-digit micromolar concentrations. Directionally, Tenovin treatment sits upstream of reduced tumor growth. This effect is attributed to p53 reactivation and sirtuin inhibition, and it validates sirtuin inhibition as an anticancer strategy in p53-wild-type tumors. The xenograft data demonstrate that sirtuin inhibitors can exert anti-tumor efficacy in vivo, complementing the extensive in vitro evidence. These results support the continued development of sirtuin inhibitors for oncology, particularly in combination with DNA-damaging agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 和 Tenovin-6 在個位數微摩爾濃度下顯著延緩人腫瘤小鼠異種移植模型中的腫瘤生長。在方向性上，Tenovin 治療位於減少腫瘤生長的上游。此效應歸因於 p53 重新活化和 sirtuin 抑制，驗證了 sirtuin 抑制作為 p53 野生型腫瘤抗癌策略。異種移植數據表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可以在體內發揮抗腫瘤療效，與大量體外證據互補。這些結果支持繼續開發用於腫瘤學的 sirtuin 抑制劑，特別是與 DNA 損傷藥物的組合使用。

nodes.label: Rossmann fold domain
nodes.description: The conserved catalytic core of sirtuins features a large Rossmann fold domain typical of NAD+ binding proteins, together with a small zinc-binding domain and flexible loops that bring the two domains together around an extended cleft for cofactor and substrate. The Rossmann domain contains six parallel beta-strands and a Gly-X-Gly phosphate-binding motif. Directionally, this architecture is intrinsic to the sirtuin family and explains their strict NAD+ dependence. Understanding the structure underscores why NAD+ analogs and pocket C binders act as sirtuin modulators.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 的保守催化核心具有大型 Rossmann 摺疊結構域，這是 NAD+ 結合蛋白的典型特徵，還有一個小型鋅結合結構域和柔性環，將兩個結構域圍繞在一個延伸的溝槽周圍以容納輔因子和受質。Rossmann 結構域包含六條平行 beta 鏈和一個 Gly-X-Gly 磷酸鹽結合基序。方向性上這種架構是 sirtuin 家族固有的，解釋了其嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性。理解此結構凸顯了為何 NAD+ 類似物和口袋 C 結合分子可作為 sirtuin 調節劑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: NAD+-dependent enzyme
nodes.description: The sirtuin family comprises seven mammalian members (SIRT1–SIRT7) plus the ancestral yeast Sir2, all sharing an NAD+-dependent catalytic core that performs deacetylation and ADP-ribosylation. They differ in subcellular localization—nuclear (SIRT1, SIRT6, SIRT7), cytoplasmic (SIRT2), and mitochondrial (SIRT3, SIRT4, SIRT5)—which dictates their substrate portfolios. The directionality is that NAD+ is the obligate co-substrate for every family member. This unifying dependence ties sirtuin activity to the cellular energy and redox state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 家族包含七個哺乳動物成員（SIRT1–SIRT7）加上祖先型酵母 Sir2，均共享一個 NAD+ 依賴性催化核心，執行去乙醯化和 ADP-核糖基化。它們在次細胞定位上有所不同——核內（SIRT1、SIRT6、SIRT7）、細胞質（SIRT2）和粒線體（SIRT3、SIRT4、SIRT5）——這決定了它們的受質譜。其方向性為 NAD+ 是每個家族成員的必需共同受質。這種統一的依賴性將 sirtuin 活性與細胞能量和氧化還原狀態聯繫起來。

nodes.label: five classes (I-IV and U)
nodes.description: The sirtuin family has been classified into five distinct classes (I-IV and U) based on a phylogenetic study of sirtuins from a wide range of prokaryotes and eukaryotes. SIR-2.1, Drosophila melanogaster Sir2 (D.mel1), Hst1, and SIRT1 all belong to subclass Ia. Subclass Ib includes Hst2, D.mel2, and various fungi and protozoa sirtuins along with SIRT2 and SIRT3. SIRT4 and SIRT5 belong to classes II and III, respectively. SIRT6 and SIRT7 belong to Class IV, which includes only eukaryotic sirtuins. Sir2 homologues from bacteria with undifferentiated motifs constitute class U.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin家族根據對廣泛原核和真核生物sirtuin的系統發育研究被分為五個不同的類別（I-IV和U）。SIR-2.1、黑腹果蠅Sir2（D.mel1）、Hst1和SIRT1都屬於Ia亞類。Ib亞類包括Hst2、D.mel2以及各種真菌和原生動物sirtuin，連同SIRT2和SIRT3。SIRT4和SIRT5分別屬於第II和第III類。SIRT6和SIRT7屬於第IV類，僅包括真核sirtuin。具有未分化基序的細菌Sir2同源物構成U類。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Potassium ferricyanide
nodes.description: Adrenochrome has been commercially prepared by oxidizing adrenaline or its salts with potassium ferricyanide in an aqueous medium. This process is uneconomical because of the large quantities of potassium ferricyanide needed, the ensuing effluent disposal problems, and variability in product quality. The patent presents a bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process as a superior alternative that precludes these problems and yields less-colored carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅的商業製備一直是於水相介質中以鐵氰化鉀氧化腎上腺素或其鹽類。此製程不具經濟效益，因為需要大量鐵氰化鉀、隨之產生廢液處理問題，且產品品質不穩定。該專利提出一種鉍催化過硫酸鹽製程作為更優的替代方案，可避免這些問題，並產生色澤較淺的carbazochrome和腎上腺紅單胺基胍產物。

nodes.label: Acidic pH
nodes.description: Epinephrine is most stable in an acidic environment, which is why pharmaceutical adrenaline used in emergency injectors is stored in slightly acidic solution. In acidic solutions the hydroxyl groups on the catechol ring are protonated, making it much harder for oxygen to steal electrons and thereby greatly slowing the oxidation that initiates the adrenochrome pathway. pH is described as the most important factor controlling the cyclization reaction because the reaction depends on chemical oxidation and is highly sensitive to environment. This pH dependence explains both the formulation chemistry of epinephrine products and the broader principle that tissue acid-base status may modulate how readily catecholamines undergo oxidative transformation in vivo, with more alkaline conditions favoring oxidation to quinones and downstream adrenochrome formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epinephrine 在酸性環境中最為穩定，這也是為什麼急救注射器中使用的藥用 adrenaline 儲存於微酸性溶液中。在酸性溶液中，兒茶酚環上的羥基被質子化，使氧氣更難奪取電子，從而大幅減緩啟動 adrenochrome 途徑的氧化。pH 值被描述為控制環化反應最重要的因素，因為反應依賴化學氧化且對環境高度敏感。這種 pH 依賴性同時解釋了 epinephrine 產品的配方化學，以及更廣泛的原則：組織酸鹼狀態可能調節兒茶酚胺在體內發生氧化轉化的容易程度，鹼性越強的條件越有利於氧化成醌及下游 adrenochrome 的形成。

nodes.label: Liver microsomes
nodes.description: Liver microsomes are subcellular fractions of hepatic endoplasmic reticulum enriched in oxidative enzymes. In the presence of NADPH and oxygen, hepatic microsomal enzymes can oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, and the rate is modulated by high oxygen tension or inhibitors such as cyanide. This demonstrates that hepatic microsomal oxidases contribute to adrenaline oxidation alongside the well-known neutrophil and myocardial routes. The microsomal pathway represents an enzymatic or semi-enzymatic route of catecholamine oxidation that may be more relevant when oxidative stress or drug-induced enzyme activity is elevated, though it remains a minor pathway relative to COMT- and MAO-mediated metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肝微粒體是富含氧化酶的肝內質網次細胞分馏物。在 NADPH 與氧氣存在下，肝微粒體酶可將 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，且其速率受高氧張力或氰化物等抑制劑調節。這證明肝微粒體氧化酶與眾所周知的中性球與心肌途徑並行，共同促成 adrenaline 氧化。微粒體途徑代表一種兒茶酚胺氧化的酶性或半酶性途徑，在氧化壓力或藥物誘導酶活性升高時可能更為相關，儘管相對於 COMT 與 MAO 介導的代謝，它仍是次要途徑。

nodes.label: Endogenous Antioxidant Upregulation
nodes.description: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

nodes.label: Melatonin in DCM
nodes.description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

nodes.label: Nitrogen gas
nodes.description: Because leuco-adrenochrome and epinephrine intermediates are extremely oxidation-sensitive, they are stored and handled under an inert atmosphere of nitrogen gas (or argon) to prevent catecholamine autoxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 [[Leuco-adrenochrome]] 與 [[Epinephrine]] 中間產物對氧化極度敏感，它們在 [[Nitrogen gas]]（或 [[Argon]]）的惰性氣氛下儲存與操作，以防止兒茶酚胺自氧化。

nodes.label: Neffy
nodes.description: Neffy is a needle-free intranasal epinephrine spray approved for emergency treatment of anaphylaxis; its stabilized formulation reduces epinephrine autoxidation and thus limits formation of Adrenochrome and related aminochromes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neffy 是免針式鼻內 [[Epinephrine]] 噴劑，核准用於過敏性休克的緊急治療；其穩定配方減少 [[Epinephrine]] 的自氧化，因而抑制 [[Adrenochrome]] 及相關 aminochrome 的生成。

nodes.label: ALK4
nodes.description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

nodes.label: Chemokine
nodes.description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

nodes.label: CCR6
nodes.description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

nodes.label: Biological Process
nodes.description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

nodes.label: H2O2-induced cell death in cardiomyocytes
nodes.description: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: HCC growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
nodes.description: Activation of mitochondrial SIRT5 promotes the growth and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma cells via glucose metabolism reprogramming from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the glycolytic switch that fuels liver cancer progression. By favoring glycolysis, SIRT5 supplies the biosynthetic and bioenergetic demands of rapidly growing HCC cells, supporting tumor aggressiveness. This oncogenic role is opposed by SIRT5's bile-acid-metabolism-mediated suppression of HCC, underscoring the dual, context-dependent functions of SIRT5 in liver cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體SIRT5的活化透過從氧化磷酸化到糖解作用的葡萄糖代謝重編程促進肝細胞癌細胞的生長和轉移。方向上，SIRT5位於驅動肝癌進展的糖解轉換的上游。透過有利於糖解作用，SIRT5為快速生長的HCC細胞提供生物合成和生物能量需求，支持腫瘤的侵襲性。此致癌角色與SIRT5透過膽汁酸代謝介導的HCC抑制相對抗，突顯了SIRT5在肝癌中的雙重、環境依賴性功能。
nodes.norm_label: hcc growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress
nodes.description: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。
nodes.norm_label: cellular energy metabolism and ampk activity under energy stress
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: FOXO3a in lung epithelial cells
nodes.description: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA (fatty acid oxidation)
nodes.description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。
nodes.norm_label: vlcad, lcad, mcad, echa (fatty acid oxidation)
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

nodes.label: Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS suppression
nodes.description: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: IDH2 and SDHA (TCA cycle)
nodes.description: SIRT5 desuccinylates TCA-cycle enzymes IDH2 and SDHA, tuning their activity and coordinating mitochondrial energy metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically modulates TCA flux. This helps match oxidation to demand during fasting or stress, and it reinforces SIRT5's role as a central mitochondrial metabolic regulator. By adjusting the activity of key TCA-cycle enzymes, SIRT5 balances carbon entry, ATP production, and the supply of reducing equivalents. This regulation supports the metabolic flexibility that allows cells to adapt fuel utilization to nutrient availability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化 TCA 循環酶 IDH2 和 SDHA，調節其活性並協調粒線體能量代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式調節 TCA 通量。這有助於在禁食或壓力期間使氧化與需求匹配，並強化 SIRT5 作為核心粒線體代謝調節因子的角色。透過調整關鍵 TCA 循環酶的活性，SIRT5 平衡碳的進入、ATP 產生和還原當量的供應。此調控支持使細胞能根據營養可用性調整燃料利用的代謝靈活性。

nodes.label: LCAD and ACADS (fatty acid β-oxidation)
nodes.description: SIRT5 desuccinylates multiple fatty-acid β-oxidation enzymes including LCAD and ACADS, coordinating mitochondrial lipid catabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates these acyl-CoA dehydrogenases. This supports energy harvest from fat, and it exemplifies SIRT5's broad desuccinylase control of metabolism. By activating the enzymes of β-oxidation, SIRT5 promotes the use of fatty acids as fuel, particularly during fasting. This catabolic role aligns SIRT5 with SIRT3 in supporting lipid oxidation, in contrast to SIRT4's inhibition of the same pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化多種脂肪酸 β-氧化酶，包括 LCAD 和 ACADS，協調粒線體脂質分解代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化這些醯基-CoA 脫氫酶。這支持從脂肪獲取能量，並體現了 SIRT5 對代謝的廣泛去琥醯化酶控制。透過活化 β-氧化酶，SIRT5 促進脂肪酸作為燃料的使用，特別是在禁食期間。這種分解代謝角色使 SIRT5 與 SIRT3 在支持脂質氧化方面一致，與 SIRT4 對相同途徑的抑制形成對比。

nodes.label: GOT1 acetylation
nodes.description: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5表達與胰腺癌的良好預後直接相關，因為SIRT5缺失促進穀草轉氨酶1（GOT1）乙醯化，從而透過增強穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝促進細胞增殖。方向上，SIRT5位於抑制胰腺癌生長的GOT1去乙醯化的上游。當SIRT5缺失時，GOT1乙醯化升高，促進穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝以驅動增殖。這將SIRT5確定為胰腺癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其水平可能為預後提供資訊。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: GLS (glutaminase)
nodes.description: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Preadipocyte differentiation
nodes.description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

nodes.label: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells
nodes.description: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。
nodes.norm_label: breast tumor, hcc, and nsclc cells
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Phylogenetic Class III (prokaryotic origin)
nodes.description: SIRT5 is the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III, a group distributed widely across prokaryotes, marking it as one of the most ancient mammalian sirtuins. Directionally, this is an evolutionary classification. Its prokaryotic origin aligns with SIRT5's fundamental mitochondrial metabolic functions, and this situates SIRT5 at the root of sirtuin biology. Because Class III sirtuins predate the eukaryotic sirtuins, SIRT5's desuccinylase activity may represent an ancestral enzymatic function retained through evolution. SIRT5's phylogenetic position helps explain its resistance to nicotinamide inhibition and its distinct substrate preferences.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 是系統發育 III 類唯一的哺乳動物成員，該類群廣泛分布於原核生物中，標誌著它是最古老的哺乳動物 sirtuin 之一。在方向性上，這是演化分類。其原核生物起源與 SIRT5 基本的粒線體代謝功能一致，並將 SIRT5 置於 sirtuin 生物學的根源。由於 III 類 sirtuin 先於真核 sirtuin，SIRT5 的去琥珀醯酶活性可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶功能。SIRT5 的系統發育位置有助於解釋其對菸鹼醯胺抑制的抗性和其獨特的底物偏好。

nodes.label: SHMT2 desuccinylation
nodes.description: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: ammonia detoxification
nodes.description: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: intracellular signaling
nodes.description: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: bile acid metabolism orchestration
nodes.description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway (ovarian cancer)
nodes.description: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner through regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of Nrf2-mediated chemoresistance. By activating this antioxidant program, SIRT5 helps cancer cells neutralize the reactive oxygen species that contribute to cisplatin-induced DNA damage. This reduces the genotoxic burden of the drug and blunts its cytotoxicity, allowing tumor cells to survive treatment. Inhibiting SIRT5, therefore, could re-sensitize ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin by dismantling their antioxidant defenses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷，從而促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於Nrf2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過活化此抗氧化程序，SIRT5幫助癌細胞中和促成順鉑誘導的DNA損傷的活性氧。這降低了藥物的基因毒性負荷並削弱其細胞毒性，使腫瘤細胞能够在治療中存活。因此抑制SIRT5可能透過瓦解其抗氧化防禦來使卵巢癌細胞對順鉑重新敏感。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: ATP synthesis regulation
nodes.description: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Tofersen
nodes.description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

nodes.label: muscle fatigue
nodes.description: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: Glycated proteins
nodes.description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Nitrated lipids
nodes.description: Nitrated lipids activate PPARgamma, as electrophilic nitrated fatty acids such as nitrolinoleic acid act as ligands that promote the receptor's transcriptional program. This redirects metabolism and induces anti-inflammatory and antioxidant genes. The directionality is lipid nitration product to nuclear receptor activation. A caveat is that nitrated lipids can also signal through PPARalpha and other targets, so PPARgamma is a major but not exclusive node. This pathway represents a feedback mechanism in which nitrative stress generates endogenous ligands that dampen inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nitrated lipids 活化 PPARgamma，因為硝基亞麻油酸等親電子硝化脂肪酸充當配體，促進受體的轉錄程序。這會改變新陳代謝並誘導抗炎和抗氧化基因。方向性是脂質硝化產物對核受體的活化。需要注意的是，nitrated lipids 還可以透過 PPARalpha 和其他目標發出訊號，因此 PPARgamma 是一個主要但不是唯一的節點。該通路代表了一種反饋機制，其中 nitrative stress 生成抑制發炎的內源性配體。

nodes.label: Pomegranate
nodes.description: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: muscle protein degradation
nodes.description: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: TLR3/TRIF signaling
nodes.description: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: ATP synthesis
nodes.description: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: Bax/Bcl-2 ratio
nodes.description: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: E3 Ubiquitin Ligase
nodes.description: MuRF1 (Muscle RING Finger 1, also known as TRIM63) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression rises during muscle wasting and atrophy; it tags sarcomeric proteins so they can be degraded through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MuRF1（Muscle RING Finger 1，又稱 TRIM63）是一種肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，在肌肉消耗與萎縮時表現上升；它標記肌節蛋白，使其經由泛素-蛋白酶體系統被降解。

nodes.label: ATLAS
nodes.description: The ATLAS trial (Singh et al., 2022, NCT03464500) is a randomized controlled test of Urolithin A at 500 or 1000 mg/day versus placebo over 4 months in 88 middle-aged adults. It produced roughly a 12% hamstring-strength increase at 500 mg/day, improved peak VO2 and 6-minute walk distance, and reduced plasma acylcarnitines and C-reactive protein, providing core human functional evidence for the compound.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATLAS 試驗（Singh 等，2022，NCT03464500）是一項隨機對照試驗，在 88 名中年成人中以 Urolithin A 每日 500 或 1000 mg 對比安慰劑、持續 4 個月。結果顯示 500 mg/日組腿後肌力量增加約 12%，尖峰 VO2 與 6 分鐘步行距離改善，血漿 acylcarnitines 與 C 反應性蛋白下降，為該化合物提供了核心的人體功能性證據。

nodes.label: adipogenesis
nodes.description: Adipogenesis is the differentiation program by which mesenchymal cells commit to the adipocyte lineage. Early commitment is driven by C/EBPβ and C/EBPδ and by the master regulator PPARγ, whose induction alone is sufficient to convert fibroblasts into fat cells. PPARγ heterodimerizes with RXR to activate adipocyte genes including aP2/FABP4 and GLUT4, and a later phase orchestrated by C/EBPα stabilizes the differentiated state in cooperation with PPARγ.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adipogenesis 是間質細胞朝向脂肪細胞譜系 commitments 的分化程式。早期 commitment 由 C/EBPβ 與 C/EBPδ 以及主調節因子 PPARγ 驅動，單獨誘導 PPARγ 即足以將纖維母細胞轉化為脂肪細胞。PPARγ 與 RXR 形成異二聚體，活化包括 aP2/FABP4 與 GLUT4 在內的脂肪細胞基因；後期則由 C/EBPα 統籌，與 PPARγ 合作穩定已分化狀態。

nodes.label: Lymphangiogenesis
nodes.description: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

nodes.label: Anti-CD38 mAbs
nodes.description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies eliminate CD38+ Tregs and MDSCs and reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression, restoring T- and NK-cell function in the tumor microenvironment. Directionally, anti-CD38 therapy sits upstream of tumor-microenvironment reprogramming. This is both an anticancer action and a means to spare NAD+ for sirtuins, and it illustrates the dual therapeutic logic of CD38 targeting. By depleting immunosuppressive cells and reducing adenosine, these antibodies restore effector immune responses. The resulting reshaping of the tumor microenvironment contributes to the efficacy of anti-CD38 antibodies in multiple myeloma and other cancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體消除 CD38+ 調節性 T 細胞和 MDSC，並減少腺苷介導的免疫抑制，恢復腫瘤微環境中 T 細胞和 NK 細胞的功能。在方向性上，抗 CD38 治療位於腫瘤微環境重編程的上游。這既是抗癌作用也是為 sirtuin 節省 NAD+ 的手段，說明了 CD38 靶向的雙重治療邏輯。透過清除免疫抑制細胞和減少腺苷，這些抗體恢復效應免疫反應。由此產生的腫瘤微環境重塑有助於抗 CD38 抗體在多發性骨髓瘤和其他癌症中的療效。

nodes.label: CendR motif
nodes.description: CendR-receptor binding triggers transcytosis and tissue penetration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CendR-受體結合觸發胞吞轉運與組織穿透。

nodes.label: VEGFR3
nodes.description: VEGF-C is the primary ligand defining the VEGFR3 lymphatic axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是定義 VEGFR3 淋巴軸的主要配體。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Fission Sites
nodes.description: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

nodes.label: Kinesin
nodes.description: Kinesin is a family of microtubule-based motor proteins that transport cargo including mitochondria along axons. The outer mitochondrial membrane protein Miro, together with the adaptor Milton, forms a complex bridging MFN2 to kinesin motors, enabling processive mitochondrial movement to distal neuronal compartments. This Miro/Milton/kinesin axis ensures local ATP delivery and axonal mitochondrial integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Kinesin 是一類以微管為軌道、沿軸突運送貨物的馬達蛋白，可運送包括粒線體在內的物質。粒線體外膜蛋白 Miro 與轉接蛋白 Milton 形成的複合體將 MFN2 與 kinesin 馬達相連，使粒線體能持續運送至神經元遠端區室。此 Miro/Milton/kinesin 軸確保局部 ATP 供應與軸突粒線體完整性。

nodes.label: Oxidized Methionine
nodes.description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

nodes.label: Tau protein
nodes.description: Peroxynitrite nitrates tau protein at tyrosine residues, impairing tau-microtubule interaction and enhancing formation of paired helical filaments. Nitration adds to the spectrum of oxidative modifications that destabilize tau. The directionality is nitrative modification to tau dysfunction. A caveat is that tau is targeted by many oxidative and kinase modifications, so nitration is one of several converging insults. Elevated nitrotyrosine is detected on tau in neurofibrillary tangles, supporting nitration as a contributor to tau pathology in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在 tyrosine 殘基處硝酸鹽 tau protein，損害 tau-微管相互作用並增強成對螺旋絲的形成。硝化增加了氧化修飾的範圍，從而破壞了 tau 的穩定性。方向性是tau功能障礙的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，tau 是許多氧化和激酶修飾的目標，因此硝化是幾種聚合損傷之一。在神經纖維纏結中的 tau 上檢測到升高的硝基rosine，支持硝化是體內 tau 病理學的貢獻者。

nodes.label: Tetrahydrobiopterin
nodes.description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of FOXO3a
nodes.description: Deacetylated FOXO3a transcriptionally upregulates endogenous antioxidant enzymes, prominently mitochondrial MnSOD and catalase, bolstering ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a to drive increased antioxidant capacity. This reduces oxidative damage in resveratrol-treated cells and animals, and it is a central mechanism for sirtuin-mediated protection against aging and metabolic disease. The same FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program is engaged by SIRT3 in mitochondria and is complemented by FOXO1- and FOXO4-mediated stress responses, establishing the sirtuin-FOXO axis as a primary node coupling nutrient sensing to cellular redox defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 在轉錄水平上調內源性抗氧化酶，特別是粒線體 MnSOD 和 catalase，增強 ROS 清除能力。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO3a 以驅動增加的抗氧化能力。這減少白藜蘆醇處理的細胞和動物中的氧化損傷，是 sirtuin 介導的抗衰老和代謝疾病保護的核心機制。同樣的 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程序在粒線體中被 SIRT3 啟動，並與 FOXO1 和 FOXO4 介導的壓力反應互補，確立 sirtuin-FOXO 軸作為將營養感知與細胞氧化還原防禦偶聯的主要節點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: DNA-binding domain
nodes.description: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

nodes.label: Cytochrome c Oxidase
nodes.description: Peroxynitrite inactivates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV of the respiratory chain) through tyrosine nitration, contributing to bioenergetic failure. Among the 20-50 proteins preferentially nitrated in vivo are MnSOD, cytochrome c oxidase, aconitase, and glutamine synthetase. Tyrosine nitration typically inactivates these enzymes, causing loss of function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過酪氨酸硝化使 cytochrome c oxidase（呼吸鏈的 Complex IV）失活，促成生物能量衰竭。在體內優先被硝化的 20-50 種蛋白質中，包括 MnSOD、cytochrome c oxidase、aconitase 與 glutamine synthetase。酪氨酸硝化通常使這些酵素失活，造成功能喪失。

nodes.label: Locked Nucleic Acid
nodes.description: Locked nucleic acid (LNA) is a synthetic RNA analog that can be incorporated into antisense oligonucleotides and siRNAs to hybridize to target messenger RNA. Hybridizing an LNA raises melting temperature and protects against nucleases for potent silencing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 鎖核酸（LNA）是合成 RNA 類似物，可整合入反義寡核苷酸與 siRNA 以雜交至目標信使 RNA。雜交 LNA 可提高熔解溫度並抵抗核酸酶，實現強效靜默。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Catalase
nodes.description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

nodes.label: TFEB at K91/K103/K116/K430
nodes.description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

nodes.label: TFEB at K274/K279
nodes.description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

nodes.label: MALAT1 in renal carcinoma
nodes.description: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Oxidation at C212
nodes.description: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: TFEB independent of mTOR
nodes.description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

nodes.label: S-sulfhydration at C212
nodes.description: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Phosphorylated TFEB
nodes.description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

nodes.label: PGC1-alpha
nodes.description: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Autophagy-lysosomal pathway
nodes.description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 是自噬—溶酶體途徑的主轉錄調控因子，協調自噬體形成、貨物辨識、溶酶體生物發生和受質降解所需基因的表現。其活化同時提升自噬體的供應和溶酶體的降解能力，確保協調的流而非不平衡的起始。TFEB 因此將自噬的兩半——隔離和降解——耦合為單一協調程序。此軸的失調促成溶酶體儲存障礙、神經退化和癌症。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial stress
nodes.description: TFEB is activated in response to mitochondrial stress, a process requiring mitophagy machinery including PINK1, Parkin, Atg9A, and Atg5 to signal and enable TFEB nuclear translocation. As damaged mitochondria are selected for autophagic removal, TFEB coordinates a compensatory lysosomal and autophagic response that restores organelle quality. This coupling ensures that mitochondrial turnover is matched by degradative capacity. The axis links mitochondrial quality control to the broader autophagy-lysosomal network and to metabolic homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在回應粒線體壓力時被活化，此過程需要包括 PINK1、Parkin、Atg9A 和 Atg5 在內的粒線體自噬機械來傳遞信號並促成 TFEB 核轉位。當受損粒線體被選擇進行自噬移除時，TFEB 協調一個代償性的溶酶體和自噬反應，以恢復胞器品質。此耦合確保粒線體週轉由降解能力所匹配。該軸將粒線體品質控制連結到更廣泛的自噬—溶酶體網絡以及代謝恆定性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Immune response
nodes.description: TFEB regulates innate and adaptive immune responses, becoming activated during dendritic cell maturation to enhance antigen processing and presentation via expanded lysosomal and MHC-related machinery. By boosting degradative capacity, TFEB improves the efficiency of antigen degradation and epitope loading, strengthening T cell priming. TFEB activity also influences macrophage polarization and immune cell metabolism. These roles position the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator as an important modulator of immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 調節先天和適應性免疫反應，在樹突細胞成熟過程中被活化，透過擴增的溶酶體和 MHC 相關機械來增強抗原處理與呈現。透過提升降解能力，TFEB 改善了抗原降解和表位加載的效率，強化了 T 細胞啟動。TFEB 活性也影響巨噬細胞極化和免疫細胞代謝。這些角色將自噬—溶酶體主調節者定位為免疫的重要調節者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: Lipid Catabolism
nodes.description: TFEB regulates lipid catabolism by upregulating genes involved in fatty acid import, beta-oxidation, lysosomal acid lipase (LAL)-mediated lipophagy, and the transcriptional coactivators PGC-1α and PPAR-α. Through these targets, TFEB coordinates the mobilization and oxidation of stored lipids during fasting and stress. This lipid-catabolic program complements TFEB's role in protein and organelle turnover, rendering it a comprehensive metabolic regulator. Enhanced TFEB activity improves lipid handling and protects against hepatic steatosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過上調參與脂肪酸輸入、β 氧化、溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）介導的脂噬，以及轉錄共活化因子 PGC-1α 和 PPAR-α 的基因，來調節脂質分解代謝。透過這些標的，TFEB 在禁食和壓力期間協調儲存脂質的動員和氧化。此脂質分解代謝程序補充了 TFEB 在蛋白質和胞器週轉中的角色，使它成為全面的代謝調節者。增強的 TFEB 活性改善脂質處理並保護對抗肝臟脂肪變性。

nodes.label: K316
nodes.description: TFEB undergoes SUMOylation at lysine 316, a small ubiquitin-like modifier conjugation that attenuates its transcriptional activity. SUMOylation typically modulates protein-protein interactions and subnuclear compartmentalization, and at K316 it dampens TFEB-driven expression of lysosomal genes. This modification adds another layer to the post-translational code governing TFEB, acting in opposition to activatory marks such as deacetylation. The reversibility of SUMOylation by SENPs allows dynamic tuning of the degradative program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 lysine 316 發生 SUMOylation，這是一種削弱其轉錄活性的小型泛素樣修飾物共軛。SUMOylation 通常調節蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用和亞核區室化，在 K316 處它抑制 TFEB 驅動的溶酶體基因表現。此修飾為控制 TFEB 的轉譯後密碼增添了另一層次，作用與去乙醯化等活化標記相反。SUMOylation 可被 SENPs 逆轉，允許對降解程序進行動態微調。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: TNKS1
nodes.description: Tankyrase 1 (TNKS1) poly-ADP-ribosylates (PARsylates) TFEB, a modification that promotes its nuclear translocation and activation of target genes. PARsylation addsADP-ribose polymers that alter TFEB interactions and trafficking, providing a non-phosphorylation route to TFEB activation. This modification broadens the enzymatic toolkit—alongside kinases, phosphatases, acetylases, and ubiquitin ligases—that regulates the autophagy-lysosomal master switch. The TNKS1-TFEB relationship suggests potential crosstalk with Wnt/β-catenin and other PARsylation-dependent pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tankyrase 1（TNKS1）對 TFEB 進行聚 ADP-核糖基化（PARsylation），此修飾促進其核轉運和標的基因的活化。PARsylation 添加 ADP-核糖聚合物，改變 TFEB 交互作用和運輸，提供一條非磷酸化的 TFEB 活化路線。此修飾拓寬了調節自噬—溶酶體主開關的酵素工具箱——與激酶、磷酸酶、乙醯酶和泛素連接酶並列。TNKS1-TFEB 關係暗示了與 Wnt/β-catenin 和其他依賴 PARsylation 途徑的潛在串擾。

nodes.label: Rag GTPases
nodes.description: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Aneuploid cells
nodes.description: TFEB is activated in aneuploid cells as a cellular response to lysosomal stress following lysosomal accumulation of undegraded autophagic cargo. This activation occurs through an mTORC1-independent mechanism involving TFEB nuclear translocation and upregulation of its downstream targets. The response appears wired to stimulate autophagosomal rather than lysosomal biogenesis in these cells. It represents an adaptive mechanism by which aneuploid cells cope with proteotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在非整倍體細胞中被活化，作為對溶酶體累積未降解自噬貨物後之溶酶體壓力的細胞反應。此活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的機制發生，涉及 TFEB 核轉位及其下游標靶的上調。此反應似乎被設計為刺激這些細胞的自噬體而非溶酶體生物發生。它代表非整倍體細胞應對蛋白毒性的適應機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

nodes.label: Osteoclast function
nodes.description: TFEB is required for osteoclast function in vivo, as its depletion results in decreased expression of lysosomal genes, reduced lysosome number, and defective bone matrix resorption. RANK treatment promotes TFEB phosphorylation via PKCbeta kinase, leading to TFEB nuclear translocation and induction of lysosomal biogenesis. Nuclear TFEB facilitates secretion of lysosomal hydrolases at the site of bone resorption. This establishes TFEB as essential for skeletal homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 在活體中為破骨細胞功能所必需，因為其缺失導致溶酶體基因表現下降、溶酶體數量減少和骨基質吸收缺陷。RANK 處理經由 PKCbeta 激酶促進 TFEB 磷酸化，導致 TFEB 核轉位和溶酶體生物發生誘導。核 TFEB 促進溶酶體水解酶在骨吸收部位分泌。這確立了 TFEB 對骨骼恆定性的必要性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

nodes.label: Lysosomal Exocytosis
nodes.description: TFEB induces lysosomal exocytosis by increasing the number of lysosomes ready to dock and fuse with the plasma membrane and by eliciting intracellular calcium release through activation of its target gene TRPML1 (MCOLN1). This process promotes cellular clearance in several lysosomal storage disease cell models, including Sanfilippo syndrome, multiple sulfatase deficiency, and Batten disease. TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis plays important roles in bone remodeling and copper homeostasis. Overexpression of TFEB or TFE3 is sufficient to induce lysosome fusion with the plasma membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過增加準備停靠並與質膜融合的溶酶體數量，並經由活化其標的基因 TRPML1（MCOLN1）誘發細胞內鈣釋放，來誘導溶酶體胞吐。此過程在數種溶酶體儲存疾病細胞模型中促進細胞清除，包括 Sanfilippo 症候群、多重硫酸酯酶缺乏症和 Batten 病。TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐在骨重塑和銅恆定性中發揮重要作用。TFEB 或 TFE3 的過度表現足以誘導溶酶體與質膜融合。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

nodes.label: bHLH-LZ Transcription Factors
nodes.description: The MiT/TFE subfamily including TFEB belongs to the bHLH-LZ factor class. Classification nests the subfamily.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 包括 TFEB 的 MiT/TFE 亞家族屬於 bHLH-LZ 因子類。歸類嵌套亞家族。

nodes.label: Eltrombopag
nodes.description: Eltrombopag is a direct inhibitor of TFEB: it disrupts TFEB's interaction with DNA, preventing induction of autophagy genes and thereby blocking autophagic flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Eltrombopag 是 TFEB 的直接抑制劑：它破壞 TFEB 與 DNA 的交互作用，阻斷自噬基因的誘導，因而阻斷自噬流。

nodes.label: MiT Family Translocation RCC
nodes.description: MiT family translocation renal cell carcinoma is a kidney cancer subtype defined by chromosomal translocations fusing TFE3 or TFEB to partner genes, causing constitutive nuclear localization of these MiTF/TFE factors. TFEB overexpression is the driver in t(6;11) disease, where MALAT1 is the fusion partner.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MiT 家族轉位腎細胞癌是一種腎癌亞型，由將 TFE3 或 TFEB 與夥伴基因融合的染色體轉位所定義，造成這些 MiTF/TFE 因子的組成性核內定位。在 t(6;11) 型中 TFEB 過度表現為驅動力，其融合夥伴為 MALAT1。

nodes.label: PARsylation
