nodes.description: PARsylation (poly-ADP-ribosylation) is a reversible post-translational modification in which poly(ADP-ribose) chains are added to target proteins by PARP family enzymes (TNKS1, PARP1, PARP2) using NAD+ as substrate. It regulates TFEB nuclear localization via Tankyrases and also acts on ULK1 and mTORC1 components to control Autophagy; PARP inhibitors such as Olaparib induce autophagy in cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARsylation（poly-ADP-ribosylation）是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，由 PARP 家族酵素（TNKS1、PARP1、PARP2）以 NAD+ 為受體將 poly(ADP-ribose) 鏈加到目標蛋白上。它透過 Tankyrases 調控 TFEB 的核內定位，也作用於 ULK1 與 mTORC1 組件以控制 Autophagy；PARP 抑制劑如 Olaparib 可在癌細胞中誘發自噬。

nodes.label: Glucosylation
nodes.description: Glucosylation is one of the post-translational modifications that set TFEB activity and subcellular localization, alongside phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, PARylation, SUMOylation, oxidation and S-sulfhydration. SetA-mediated glucosylation of TFEB shifts it to the nucleus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glucosylation 是決定 TFEB 活性與細胞內定位的轉譯後修飾之一，與磷酸化、乙醯化、泛素化、PAR 化、SUMO 化、氧化及 S-硫氫化並列。SetA 媒介的 TFEB glucosylation 會使其轉移至細胞核。

nodes.label: dopamine in Striatum
nodes.description: Stimulus-response learning depends on dopamine signaling in the striatum, particularly within corticostriatal circuits where dopamine modulates the synaptic plasticity underlying habit formation. Both excessive and insufficient striatal dopamine, shaped by DAT, COMT, and receptor tone, disrupt S-R acquisition and procedural learning. COMT overexpression models demonstrate that altered dopamine clearance impairs this learning. This makes striatal dopamine a key determinant of habit and skill learning efficiency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 依賴紋狀體中的多巴胺訊號傳導，特別是在皮質紋狀體迴路中，其中多巴胺調節 habit formation 底層的 synaptic plasticity。由 DAT、COMT 和受體音調形成的紋狀體多巴胺過多和不足都會擾亂 S-R 獲取和程序性學習。 COMT 過度表現模型顯示多巴胺清除率的改變會損害這種學習。這使得紋狀體多巴胺成為習慣和技能學習效率的關鍵決定因素。

nodes.label: better Working Memory performance
nodes.description: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with better performance on complex working memory tasks, attributed to the elevated prefrontal dopamine tone produced by reduced enzyme activity. Under non-stressful conditions, this higher dopamine level falls near the peak of the inverted-U curve for cognition, favoring stability, accuracy, and maintenance of information. The association is robust at the group level but moderate in effect size and sensitive to task demands, sex, and environmental context such as stress. It is among the most replicated gene-cognition associations in humans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 與複雜工作記憶任務的較佳表現有關，這歸因於酵素活性降低產生的前額葉多巴胺張力升高。在無壓力的情況下，這種較高的多巴胺水平落在認知倒 U 曲線的峰值附近，有利於訊息的穩定性、準確性和維護。這種關聯在群體層面上很強，但效應大小適中，並且對任務要求、性別和壓力等環境背景敏感。它是人類複製最多的基因認知關聯之一。

nodes.label: higher anxiety
nodes.description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher anxiety traits, consistent with the worrier phenotype in which elevated prefrontal dopamine and norepinephrine promote heightened vigilance and emotional reactivity. Multiple studies report increased anxiety sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, though effect sizes are modest and context-dependent. The association follows from altered catecholamine tone rather than a direct anxietogenic mutation. It is frequently discussed in gene-environment and stress reactivity research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與 higher anxiety 性狀相關，與擔憂者表型一致，其中前額葉多巴胺升高和 norepinephrine 促進提高警覺性和情緒反應性。多項研究報告稱，慢速 COMT 個體的焦慮敏感性有所增加，但效果大小適中且取決於具體情況。這種關聯源自於兒茶酚胺音調的改變，而不是直接的焦慮突變。它在基因環境和壓力反應研究中經常被討論。

nodes.label: higher baseline dopamine
nodes.description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher baseline extracellular dopamine, because reduced COMT activity diminishes the primary route of cortical dopamine inactivation. This elevated tonic dopamine especially affects the prefrontal cortex, where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates clearance. The resulting dopamine surplus shapes cognition, anxiety, and reward sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, consistent with the worrier phenotype. It is the mechanistic link between COMT genotype and its behavioral correlates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與較高的基線細胞外多巴胺相關，因為減少的 COMT activity 減少了皮質多巴胺失活的主要途徑。這種升高的強直性多巴胺尤其影響前額葉皮質，該處 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 主導清除。由此產生的多巴胺過剩影響了慢速 COMT 個體的認知、焦慮和 reward 敏感性，與憂慮者表型一致。它是 COMT genotype 與其行為相關物之間的機制連結。

nodes.label: Worrier phenotype
nodes.description: The Met/Met genotype is called the Worrier phenotype, a popularized label reflecting the tendency toward heightened anxiety, vigilance, and careful, deliberative cognitive processing linked to elevated catecholamine tone. The term contrasts with the Warrior label for fast (Val/Val) genotypes, who are described as stress-resilient and rapid processors. While useful heuristically, the phenotype oversimplifies a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型被稱為 Worrier phenotype，這是一個流行的標籤，反映了與兒茶酚胺張力升高相關的焦慮、警覺性和仔細、深思熟慮的認知處理傾向。該術語與快速（Val/Val）基因型的戰士標籤形成鮮明對比，後者被描述為具有抗壓能力和快速處理能力。雖然啟發式有用，但表型過度簡化了受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴背景的特徵。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

nodes.label: low COMT activity
nodes.description: The Met/Met genotype produces low COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold below Val/Val levels, due to the thermolabile methionine-containing protein that is degraded more readily at body temperature. This reduced activity slows elimination of catecholamines and catechol drugs, prolonging their action and raising extracellular dopamine, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It is the defining biochemical feature of the slow COMT end of the spectrum. This biochemical phenotype underpins the associated cognitive, mood, and drug-response differences.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型產生較低的 COMT 酶活性，大約比 Val/Val 水平低三到四倍，這是因為含有不耐熱蛋氨酸的蛋白質在體溫下更容易降解。這種活性的降低減緩了 catecholamines 和兒茶酚藥物的消除，延長了它們的作用並提高了細胞外多巴胺，特別是在前額葉皮質。這是光譜中緩慢的 COMT 端的決定性生化特徵。這種生化表型是相關認知、情緒和藥物反應差異的基礎。

nodes.label: poorer Working Memory under stress
nodes.description: The Val/Val (fast) COMT genotype is associated with poorer working memory performance, especially under stress, because rapid dopamine clearance lowers prefrontal dopamine below the optimal range of the inverted-U curve. Stress-induced dopamine release is more quickly inactivated in fast genotypes, worsening cognitive efficiency precisely when performance matters most. This effect is most evident on demanding, load-bearing working memory tasks and under challenging conditions. The interaction between genotype and environmental stress is a hallmark finding in COMT research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val/Val（快速）COMT genotype 與較差的工作記憶表現相關，尤其是在壓力下，因為快速多巴胺清除會將前額葉多巴胺降低到倒 U 曲線的最佳範圍以下。在快速基因型中，壓力引起的多巴胺釋放會更快失活，從而在表現最重要的時候使認知效率惡化。這種效應在要求高、承載工作記憶任務和具有挑戰性的條件下最為明顯。基因型與環境壓力之間的相互作用是 COMT 研究的一個標誌性發現。

nodes.label: lower prefrontal dopamine
nodes.description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with lower prefrontal dopamine because rapid COMT-mediated clearance depletes the extracellular catecholamine pool in a region where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates inactivation. This reduced dopamine tone shifts working memory and executive function away from the inverted-U optimum, producing poorer performance on stability-dependent and load-heavy tasks. The relationship is a primary mechanism linking COMT genotype to cognition and behavior. It underlies the fast COMT cognitive phenotype and its stress-related trade-offs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 lower prefrontal dopamine 相關，因為 COMT 介導的快速清除會耗盡 DAT 稀疏且 COMT 失活占主導地位的區域中的細胞外兒茶酚胺庫。這種減少的多巴胺色調使工作記憶和 executive function 偏離倒 U 形最佳狀態，從而在依賴穩定性和負載繁重的任務中產生較差的性能。這種關係是將 COMT genotype 與認知和行為連結起來的主要機制。它是 COMT 快速認知表型及其與壓力相關的權衡的基礎。

nodes.label: stress resilience
nodes.description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with stress resilience, the Warrior phenotype, because fast COMT rapidly clears stress-evoked catecholamines, preventing excessive dopaminergic and noradrenergic buildup that could impair performance under pressure. This contrasts with slow COMT, which is linked to anxiety and the worrier phenotype. The label is heuristic, and effects depend on context and task, with the advantage most evident under demanding conditions. It is a widely cited example of gene-environment interaction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 stress resilience、Warrior phenotype 相關，因為快速 COMT 可以快速清除壓力誘發的 catecholamines，防止多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能過度積聚，從而損害壓力下的表現。這與緩慢的 COMT 形成鮮明對比，COMT 與焦慮和擔憂表型有關。這個標籤是啟發式的，效果取決於上下文和任務，在苛刻的條件下優勢最為明顯。這是基因與環境相互作用的一個被廣泛引用的例子。

nodes.label: Warrior phenotype
nodes.description: The Val/Val genotype is called the Warrior phenotype, a popularized descriptor for the putative advantage in stress resilience and rapid processing conferred by fast COMT and lower baseline dopamine. It contrasts with the Worrier Met/Met label, which is associated with anxiety and careful, deliberative processing. While memorable and useful heuristically, the phenotype is an oversimplification of a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型被稱為 Warrior phenotype，這是 stress resilience 的假定優勢以及快速 COMT 和較低基線多巴胺賦予的快速處理的流行描述符。它與“Worrier Met/Met”標籤形成鮮明對比，後者與焦慮和仔細、深思熟慮的處理有關。雖然令人難忘且啟發式地有用，但表型是受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴於背景的特徵的過度簡化。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

nodes.label: psychiatric disorder risk
nodes.description: Val158Met impacts risk for psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, with the Val allele associated with modestly increased risk through prefrontal dopaminergic dysregulation, though effects are modified by environment and other genes. The association is replicated but small in absolute terms, reflecting the polygenic architecture of psychiatric disorders. It illustrates how a single functional polymorphism can contribute to complex neuropsychiatric vulnerability. COMT remains a candidate gene of sustained interest in psychiatric genetics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響精神分裂症等精神疾病的風險，Val 等位基因透過前額葉多巴胺能失調與適度增加的風險相關，儘管影響會受到環境和其他基因的影響。這種關聯是重複的，但絕對值很小，反映了精神疾病的多基因結構。它說明了單一功能多態性如何導致複雜的神經精神脆弱性。 COMT 仍然是精神遺傳學領域持續關注的候選基因。

nodes.label: response to methyl donor supplements
nodes.description: Val158Met impacts the response to methyl donor supplements because COMT activity determines how quickly an individual processes the added methyl load; slow (Met) carriers are more prone to mood side effects from methylfolate or methylB12, while fast (Val) carriers tolerate them better. This makes genotype relevant to personalizing methylation supplements, with slow individuals advised to use lower doses or non-methylated forms. The directionality is consistent with COMT's role in methyl clearance. It is a practical pharmacogenetic consideration in supplementation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響 response to methyl donor supplements，因為 COMT activity 決定個體處理添加的甲基負載的速度；慢速（Met）攜帶者更容易受到甲基葉酸或甲基B12的情緒副作用的影響，而快速（Val）攜帶者則能更好地耐受它們。這使得基因型與個人化甲基化補充劑有關，建議慢速個體使用較低劑量或非甲基化形式。方向性與COMT在甲基清除中的作用一致。這是補充劑中實用的藥物基因考慮因素。

nodes.label: Valine to Methionine substitution
nodes.description: Val158Met involves a valine-to-methionine amino acid substitution at codon 158 of the COMT enzyme, replacing a hydrophobic residue with a polar one that destabilizes the protein and reduces its catalytic activity in the Met form. This single missense change is the molecular basis of the fast-slow COMT dichotomy and of the three- to four-fold differences in enzyme activity among genotypes. It is the defining feature of the rs4680 polymorphism. The substitution alters protein thermostability rather than substrate binding directly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 涉及 COMT 酶密碼子 158 處的纈氨酸至甲硫氨酸氨基酸取代，以極性殘基取代疏水性殘基，從而使蛋白質不穩定並降低其 Met 形式的催化活性。這種單一的錯義變化是快慢 COMT 二分法以及基因型之間酵素活性三到四倍差異的分子基礎。這是 rs4680 多態性的定義特性。這種取代改變了蛋白質的熱穩定性，而不是直接改變底物結合。

nodes.label: SNP in COMT
nodes.description: Val158Met is a SNP in the COMT gene, specifically a missense variant that alters enzyme function rather than merely regulatory sequence, making it a functional polymorphism. Its location within the COMT coding region directly changes protein thermostability and activity, producing the fast-slow enzyme dichotomy. It is therefore both a marker and a mechanistic driver of COMT-related traits, including cognition, mood, and drug response. It exemplifies how a single coding variant can have broad biological consequences.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 是 COMT 基因中的 SNP，特別是一種錯義變異體，它改變酵素功能而不僅僅是調節序列，使其成為功能性多態性。它在 COMT 編碼區內的位置直接改變蛋白質的熱穩定性和活性，產生快慢酶二分法。因此，它既是 COMT 相關特徵（包括認知、情緒和 drug response）的標記，也是機械驅動因素。它舉例說明了單一編碼變體如何產生廣泛的生物學後果。

nodes.label: rs4680
nodes.description: Val158Met is also known as rs4680, the dbSNP reference identifier for the G-to-A single nucleotide change at this locus that produces the Val/Met amino acid polymorphism. This designation is used in genome-wide and candidate-gene studies to tag COMT function and to standardize reporting of COMT genotype across research. The rs4680 annotation allows results to be compared across studies and populations. It is one of the most frequently genotyped SNPs in neuropsychiatric and pharmacogenetic research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 也稱為 rs4680，是產生 Val/Met 氨基酸多態性的該基因座上 G 至 A 單核苷酸變化的 dbSNP 參考標識符。此名稱用於全基因組和候選基因研究，以標記 COMT 功能並標準化整個研究中 COMT genotype 的報告。 rs4680 註釋允許跨研究和人群比較結果。它是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學研究中最常見的基因分型 SNPs 之一。

nodes.label: vitamin E cancer prevention
nodes.description: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

nodes.label: Aspirin response
nodes.description: Val158Met modulates the response to aspirin, determining whether cardiovascular outcomes are protective, as in slow/Met individuals, or neutral or harmful, as in fast/Val individuals, through genotype-dependent alterations in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's vascular effects. This interaction positions COMT as a biomarker for aspirin chemoprevention and cardiovascular risk stratification. The directionality is among the better-studied COMT-drug effects. It exemplifies pharmacogenetics in cardiovascular medicine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對阿斯匹靈的反應，透過兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性改變改變阿斯匹靈的血管效應，確定心血管結果是否具有保護性（如慢速/Met 個體）或中性或有害（如快速/Val 個體）。這種相互作用使 COMT 成為阿斯匹靈化學預防和心血管風險分層的生物標記。方向性是 COMT 藥物作用中研究得最好的之一。它體現了心血管醫學中的藥物遺傳學。

nodes.label: Modafinil response
nodes.description: Val158Met modulates the response to modafinil, with faster (Val) genotypes showing greater cognitive and wake-promoting benefit because modafinil's DAT inhibition raises dopamine from a lower COMT-set baseline, whereas slow (Met) carriers are nearer the optimum and gain less or may be over-stimulated. This pharmacogenetic interaction guides personalized stimulant use and has been demonstrated in cognitive and clinical studies. It is one of several COMT-dependent drug responses. Genotype-aware prescribing could optimize modafinil outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對莫達非尼的反應，較快 (Val) 基因型顯示出更大的認知和喚醒促進益處，因為莫達非尼的 DAT 抑制使多巴胺從較低的 COMT 設定基線升高，而較慢 (Met) 基因型更接近最佳狀態，增益較少或可能被過度刺激。這種藥物基因交互作用指導個人化興奮劑的使用，並已在認知和臨床研究中得到證實。它是幾種 COMT 依賴性藥物反應之一。基因型感知處方可以優化莫達非尼的療效。

nodes.label: Methyl donor supplements
nodes.description: People with slow COMT enzyme variants may find that supplements affecting the methylation cycle can affect their neurotransmitter levels. A sudden influx of methyl groups from high doses of methyl donor supplements can cause irritability, anger, or anxiety. Clinicians often recommend against taking methyl donor supplements for slow COMT (rs4680 A/A).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 具有緩慢 COMT 酶變異的人可能發現，影響 methylation cycle 的補充劑會影響其神經傳導物質水平。高劑量甲基供體補充劑帶來的甲基群突然湧入可能導致煩躁、憤怒或焦慮。臨床醫師常建議緩慢 COMT (rs4680 A/A) 者不要服用甲基供體補充劑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

nodes.label: habit learning
nodes.description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning is a form of procedural/habit learning in which a specific stimulus comes to automatically trigger a stereotyped behavioral response, independent of outcome valuation. It contrasts with goal-directed action and is the basis of habits, skills, and conditioned motor routines. It underlies both adaptive expertise and maladaptive habits such as addiction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 是程序性/習慣學習的一種形式，其中特定刺激會自動觸發刻板的行為反應，與結果評價無關。它與目標導向行動形成對比，是習慣、技能和條件化運動常規的基礎。它既構成適應性專長，也構成成癮等適應不良習慣的基礎。

nodes.label: nootropic response
nodes.description: Val158Met stratifies nootropic benefit because COMT-set cortical dopamine determines how much modafinil-class dopaminergic enhancement can help. Fast genotypes gain more from the same dose.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val158Met 分層 nootropic 效益，因 COMT 設定的皮質多巴胺決定多巴胺增強能幫多少。快速基因型從相同劑量獲益更多。

nodes.label: cADP-Ribose
nodes.description: CD38 is the primary NADase in mammals, an ectoenzyme that uses NAD+ to produce and hydrolyze cADP-ribose, a Ca2+-mobilizing second messenger. Because CD38 also degrades the NAD+ intermediates nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), its activity further decreases the content of NAD+. CD38 content increases with age, contributing to the age-related decline in NAD+ and mitochondrial dysfunction. In CD38-deficient mice, NAD+ levels remain high, preserving mitochondrial respiration and metabolic function with age, and pharmacological inhibition of CD38 can increase NAD+ levels and improve glucose and lipid metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD38 是哺乳動物中主要的 NADase，為一種胞外酶，利用 NAD+ 產生並水解 cADP-ribose，後者是一種可動員 Ca2+ 的第二信使。由於 CD38 也會降解 NAD+ 中間代謝物 nicotinamide riboside（NR）與 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN），其活性進一步降低 NAD+ 含量。CD38 含量隨年齡增加而上升，促成與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降與粒線體功能障礙。在 CD38 缺陷小鼠中，NAD+ 水平維持高值，隨年齡保留粒線體呼吸與代謝功能，而 CD38 的藥理抑制可提升 NAD+ 水平並改善葡萄糖與脂質代謝。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Viral Translation
nodes.description: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain
nodes.description: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Purine Nucleoside Phosphorylase
nodes.description: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。

nodes.label: NAD+ in tumor microenvironment
nodes.description: CD38 enzymatic activity depletes NAD+ in the tumor microenvironment and generates adenosine, suppressing anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses. Directionally, CD38 sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and immunosuppression. This links CD38 to cancer immune evasion, and anti-CD38 antibodies both target myeloma and reshape the tumor microenvironment. By consuming NAD+ and producing immunosuppressive adenosine, CD38 on tumor and immune cells dampens anti-tumor immunity. This dual role makes CD38 both a therapeutic target and a mechanism of immune escape in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD38 酶活性在腫瘤微環境中耗竭 NAD+ 並產生腺苷，抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。在方向性上，CD38 位於 NAD+ 耗竭和免疫抑制的上游。這將 CD38 與癌症免疫逃逸聯繫起來，抗 CD38 抗體既能靶向骨髓瘤也能重塑腫瘤微環境。透過消耗 NAD+ 和產生免疫抑制性腺苷，腫瘤和免疫細胞上的 CD38 削弱抗腫瘤免疫。這種雙重角色使 CD38 成為癌症中的治療靶標和免疫逃逸機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins (overview, CD38 KO risks, cancer therapies).md

nodes.label: Axonal/Wallerian degeneration (via SIRT1)
nodes.description: Nmnat, the NAD+-biosynthetic enzyme, protects axons from Wallerian degeneration largely by raising NAD+ and thereby activating SIRT1, which supports axonal survival after injury. The protection is upstream of SIRT1-dependent maintenance of mitochondrial and chromatin function in neurons, preserving axon integrity when the soma is damaged. Directionally, Nmnat increases NAD+, which activates SIRT1 to provide axonal protection. This established a key NAD+/sirtuin axis in neuronal resilience, informed subsequent studies of SARM1-mediated NAD+ depletion in axonal degeneration, and helped motivate the use of NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR to protect neurons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物合成酶 Nmnat 主要通過提高 NAD+ 並從而活化 SIRT1 來保護軸突免於 Wallerian 變性，SIRT1 支持損傷後的軸突存活。這種保護位於 SIRT1 依賴性維持神經元粒線體和染色質功能的上游，在胞體受損時保留軸突完整性。在方向性上，Nmnat 增加 NAD+，進而活化 SIRT1 以提供軸突保護。這確立了神經元韌性中一個關鍵的 NAD+/sirtuin 軸，為後續 SARM1 介導的軸突變性中 NAD+ 耗竭的研究提供了資訊，並推動了使用 NAD+ 前體（如 NMN 和 NR）來保護神經元的研究。

nodes.label: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
nodes.description: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN) is a dose-limiting toxicity of taxane and platinum agents. These drugs downregulate NMNAT2 in sensory neurons, raising the NMN/NAD+ ratio and activating SARM1, whose NAD+-depletion activity drives axonal degeneration; SARM1 knockout protects against CIPN in preclinical models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy（CIPN）是 taxane 與白金類藥物的劑量限制性毒性。這些藥物在感覺神經元中下调 NMNAT2，使 NMN／NAD+ 比值上升並活化 SARM1；SARM1 的 NAD+ 耗竭活性驅動軸突退化，且 SARM1 敲除在臨床前模型中可防止 CIPN。

nodes.label: Isatuximab
nodes.description: Isatuximab is the second approved anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody (2020), binding a CD38 epitope distinct from daratumumab's and showing stronger direct induction of apoptosis; it is standard of care in Multiple Myeloma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Isatuximab 是第二個獲核准的 anti-CD38 單株抗體（2020 年），其結合的 CD38 表位與 Daratumumab 不同，且直接誘發凋亡的作用更強；它是 Multiple Myeloma 的標準治療。

nodes.label: Coenzyme
nodes.description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is an essential coenzyme that plays central roles in cellular oxidation-reduction reactions, including most catabolic and anabolic processes such as glycolysis, fatty acid beta-oxidation, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and the synthesis of fatty acids, cholesterol, and steroids. Beyond its redox function, NAD+ is consumed by enzymes including sirtuins, poly-ADP-ribose polymerases (PARPs), CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes, and mono-ADP-ribose transferases, whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ content.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAD+（nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide）是一種必需的輔酶，在細胞氧化還原反應中扮演核心角色，包括大多數分解代謝與合成代謝過程，如 glycolysis、fatty acid beta-oxidation、tricarboxylic acid cycle，以及脂肪酸、膽固醇與類固醇的合成。除了其氧化還原功能外，NAD+ 會被包括 sirtuins、poly-ADP-ribose polymerases（PARPs）、CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes，以及 mono-ADP-ribose transferases 在內的酵素所消耗，這些酵素的活性可能耗竭細胞內的 NAD+ 含量。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: CD38 inhibitors (apigenin, quercetin)
nodes.description: CD38 consumes NAD+; inhibiting it (apigenin, quercetin) boosts NAD+ availability, the obligate co-substrate for all sirtuins (and thus for SIRT1-SIRT7 activity).
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+；抑制它（芹菜素、槲皮素）可增強 NAD+ 的可用性，NAD+ 是所有 sirtuins 的必需共底物（因此影響 SIRT1-SIRT7 的活性）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: DNA Topoisomerase I
nodes.description: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

nodes.label: SIRT1 as CR mediator
nodes.description: David Sinclair identified SIRT1 as a mediator of caloric-restriction benefits and, in a landmark 2003 study, discovered resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound (STAC). Directionally, the discovery establishes SIRT1/STAC centrality to longevity research. This launched the modern sirtuin field, and it connects basic yeast findings to mammalian therapeutics. By showing that resveratrol extends yeast lifespan through Sir2, Sinclair bridged the caloric-restriction and sirtuin fields. This work catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development and made SIRT1 a central target in geroscience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: David Sinclair 鑑定 SIRT1 為限制熱量益處的介導因子，並在 2003 年的里程碑研究中發現 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）。在方向性上，此發現確立了 SIRT1/STAC 在長壽研究中的核心地位。這啟動了現代 sirtuin 領域，並將基礎酵母發現與哺乳動物治療學聯繫起來。透過展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，Sinclair 架起了限制熱量和 sirtuin 領域之間的橋樑。此工作催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，使 SIRT1 成為老年科學的核心靶標。

nodes.label: Sequence-specific double-strand breaks
nodes.description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

nodes.label: Resveratrol as STAC
nodes.description: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 2003 年，Sinclair 展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，後來在高等生物中展示了類似效應，將其發現為第一個 STAC。在方向性上，此發現位於 STAC 概念的上游。這催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，至今仍是老年科學的開創性發現。透過鑑定一種活化 sirtuin 的天然化合物，Sinclair 為藥理學地介入長壽途徑提供了原型。STAC 概念自那以後推動了尋找更強效和更具選擇性的 sirtuin 活化劑用於治療。

nodes.label: RCM-driven epigenetic aging
nodes.description: Induction of double-strand breaks in the ICE Mouse, followed by repair, produces accelerated epigenetic aging and physiological decline without mutagenesis, supporting the RCM hypothesis. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of epigenetic aging. This argues that aging can arise from information loss rather than just genetic damage, and it is a cornerstone experiment for the Information Theory of Aging. Because the phenotype occurs without mutations, it is attributed to loss of epigenetic information during repair. These results reframe aging as a software problem and motivate NAD+/sirtuin-based interventions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中雙鏈斷裂的誘導及隨後的修復產生加速的表觀遺傳衰老和生理退化，不伴隨突變，支持 RCM 假說。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於表觀遺傳衰老的上游。這主張衰老可以源於資訊喪失而非僅僅基因損傷，是衰老資訊理論的基礎實驗。由於表型在沒有突變的情況下發生，被歸因於修復期間表觀遺傳資訊的喪失。這些結果將衰老重新定義為軟體問題，並推動基於 NAD+/sirtuin 的干預措施。

nodes.label: RCM (Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers)
nodes.description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

nodes.label: I-PpoI endonuclease
nodes.description: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

nodes.label: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
nodes.description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。
nodes.norm_label: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
nodes.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

nodes.label: ICE Mouse model
nodes.description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

nodes.label: Chromatin Modifiers
nodes.description: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

nodes.label: Mutations
nodes.description: In the Information Theory of Aging, mutations represent irreversible 'hardware' damage distinct from the 'software' (epigenetic) information loss the theory emphasizes as the primary driver of aging. The RCM hypothesis and ICE mouse model induce double-strand breaks without mutations to isolate epigenetic consequences.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在老化資訊理論中，突變代表不可逆的「硬體」損傷，有別於理論強調為老化主要驅動者的「軟體」（表觀遺傳）資訊喪失。RCM 假說與 ICE 小鼠模型在無突變下誘導雙股斷裂，以隔離表觀遺傳後果。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Landscape
nodes.description: The epigenetic landscape denotes the ensemble of chromatin states that establish cellular identity. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated recruitment of chromatin modifiers to DNA repair sites causes gradual erosion of this landscape, leading to loss of cellular identity and aging phenotypes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳景觀指建立細胞身分的染色質狀態總和。在 RCM 假說中，染色質修飾因子被反覆招募至 DNA 修復位點會造成此景觀的逐漸侵蝕，導致細胞身分喪失與衰老表現型。

nodes.label: Osteoclast development
nodes.description: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

nodes.label: Pycnodysostosis
nodes.description: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

nodes.label: Odanacatib
nodes.description: Odanacatib is the selective cathepsin K inhibitor reaching Phase III for osteoporosis. Inhibition is the pharmacological edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Odanacatib 是進入骨質疏鬆 III 期選擇性組織蛋白酶 K 抑制劑。抑制是藥理邊。

nodes.label: Caspase-11
nodes.description: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

nodes.label: Bone marrow-derived macrophages
nodes.description: Bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) are a standard model for studying inflammasome signaling, including AIM2. In these cells DROSHA deficiency suppresses AIM2-dependent caspase-1 activation and IL-1beta/IL-18 release, linking Microprocessor activity to AIM2 inflammasome function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 骨髓衍生巨噬細胞（BMDM）是研究發炎體訊號（包括 AIM2）的標準模型。在此類細胞中，DROSHA 缺乏會抑制 AIM2 依賴的 caspase-1 活化與 IL-1β/IL-18 釋放，將 Microprocessor 活性與 AIM2 發炎體功能相連結。

nodes.label: Embryoid Bodies
nodes.description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

nodes.label: HeLa Cells
nodes.description: HeLa cells are routinely used in RNAi and reporter assays to study microRNA biogenesis. Knockdown of DGCR8 or Drosha in HeLa S3 reduced pre-miR-16 and mature miR-16 with pri-miRNA accumulation, confirming DGCR8 requirement for microRNA maturation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞常被用於 RNAi 與報導基因分析以研究 microRNA 生合成。在 HeLa S3 中敲低 DGCR8 或 Drosha 會降低 pre-miR-16 與成熟 miR-16 並累積 pri-miRNA，證實 DGCR8 為 microRNA 成熟所需。

nodes.label: DiGeorge Syndrome
nodes.description: The DGCR8 gene lies in the DiGeorge critical region. Association records the genomic disease link.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DGCR8 基因位於 DiGeorge 關鍵區域。關聯記錄基因組疾病連結。

nodes.label: ASC
nodes.description: ASC polymerizes into specks that recruit pro-Caspase-1 via CARD interactions, enabling proximity-induced activation that cleaves Gasdermin D and pro-IL-1β/IL-18.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ASC 聚合成 specks，透過 CARD 相互作用招募 pro-Caspase-1，促成鄰近誘導活化，進而切割 Gasdermin D 與 pro-IL-1β/IL-18。

nodes.label: primary form of vitamin E
nodes.description: Alpha-tocopherol is the primary, most biologically active form of vitamin E retained and utilized by the human body, owing to its selective binding by the hepatic alpha-tocopherol transfer protein while other tocopherols are preferentially metabolized and excreted. It functions as a lipid-soluble chain-breaking antioxidant protecting polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes, and it also modulates cell signaling and immune function. Its metabolism involves catecholic intermediates that are substrates for COMT. Its cancer-prevention outcomes with supplementation differ by COMT genotype, protective in slow and potentially harmful in fast COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-tocopherol 是人體保留和利用的維生素 E 的主要、最俱生物活性的形式，因為它與肝臟 α-生育酚轉移蛋白選擇性結合，而其他生育酚則優先代謝和排泄。它作為脂溶性斷鍊抗氧化劑，保護細胞膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸，也調節細胞訊號傳導和免疫功能。其代謝涉及作為 COMT 底物的兒茶酚中間體。 COMT genotype 的補充劑預防癌症的效果有所不同，對緩慢的 COMT 個體具有保護作用，但對快速的 COMT 個體可能有害。

nodes.label: Blue-gray pigmentation of skin, eyes and mucous membranes
nodes.description: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。
nodes.norm_label: blue-gray pigmentation of skin, eyes and mucous membranes

nodes.label: DNA, RNA and proteins
nodes.description: Once absorbed, silver binds to amino or carboxyl groups in RNA, DNA, and proteins, which is the molecular basis of both its antimicrobial action and its toxicity. By coordinating thiol, amino, and carboxyl moieties, silver can disrupt enzyme active sites, nucleic acid structure, and protein folding. This promiscuous binding explains the broad-spectrum antibacterial effects of silver compounds as well as the tissue deposition, glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase inhibition, and genotoxic effects observed with chronic or high-level silver exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收，銀與RNA、DNA和蛋白質中的氨基或羧基結合，這是其抗菌作用和毒性的分子基礎。通過配位硫醇、氨基和羧基部分，銀可破壞酶活性位點、核酸結構和蛋白質折疊。這種多效結合解釋了銀化合物的廣譜抗菌效果，以及慢性或高劑量銀暴露觀察到的組織沉積、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶和Na+,K+-ATPase抑制和基因毒性效應。

nodes.label: Inhalation, oral and dermal routes
nodes.description: Silver and its compounds can be absorbed via inhalation, while silver compounds can also be absorbed orally and dermally. Once absorbed, silver distributes throughout the body in the blood, particularly to the liver, and is eliminated primarily in the faeces. The multiple absorption routes mean that occupational and consumer exposures, from airborne dusts, drinking water, and topical products, can all raise the body silver burden. In large doses this absorbed silver becomes deposited in various tissues, producing the blue-gray pigmentation of argyria and the enzyme inhibition described in silver toxicity summaries.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀及其化合物可通過吸入吸收，而銀化合物也可通過口服和皮膚吸收。一旦吸收，銀通過血液分布至全身，特別是肝臟，主要通過糞便排出。多種吸收途徑意味著職業和消費者暴露，來自空氣中的粉塵、飲用水和局部產品，都會增加體內銀負荷。大劑量吸收的銀會沉積在各種組織中，導致argyria的藍灰色色素沉著和銀毒性摘要中描述的酶抑制。

nodes.label: Selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions
nodes.description: Silver ion is reported to disrupt selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions by inhibiting glutathione peroxidase, a selenium-dependent enzyme. Because selenium is a cofactor in antioxidant redox systems, silver's interference with selenoenzymes tilts cellular redox balance toward oxidation. This mechanism helps explain how silver, despite being relatively inert as a bulk metal, exerts biological effects through disruption of thiol redox circuits in both microbial and mammalian cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 報導稱銀離子通過抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（一種硒依賴性酶）來干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應。由於硒是抗氧化氧化還原系統中的輔因子，銀對硒酶的干擾使細胞氧化還原平衡向氧化傾斜。此機制有助於解釋銀如何作為塊狀金屬相對惰性，卻通過干擾微生物和哺乳動物細胞中的硫醇氧化還原電路發揮生物效應。

nodes.label: Metallic element
nodes.description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

nodes.label: Argentite and chlorargyrite minerals
nodes.description: Silver occurs naturally in minerals such as argentite (silver sulfide) and chlorargyrite (silver chloride), which are among the primary silver ores. These mineral forms connect silver's environmental chemistry to its biology: insoluble silver salts absorbed into the body are transformed into soluble silver sulfide albuminates that bind to biomolecules. The sulfide chemistry of argentite mirrors the silver sulfide albuminates formed when silver is absorbed and distributed through the bloodstream to the liver.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀自然存在於如argentite（硫化銀）和chlorargyrite（氯化銀）等礦物中，這些是主要的銀礦石。這些礦物形式將銀的環境化學與其生物學聯繫起來：吸收體內的不溶性銀鹽被轉化為可溶性硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽，與生物分子結合。argentite的硫化物化學反映了銀吸收後通過血流分布至肝臟時形成的硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽。

nodes.label: 1027 mg/kg
nodes.description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

nodes.label: Silver oxide battery
nodes.description: Silver(I) oxide is used in the silver oxide battery, where the oxide serves as the cathode material. Silver oxide batteries deliver high energy density in compact zinc-silver(oxide) cells and are widely used in small devices such as watches, hearing aids, and cameras. The electrochemical application exploits the reduction of Ag(I) to metallic silver, linking the compound's utility directly to the redox chemistry of silver that also underlies its antimicrobial action and its tissue-staining properties.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)用於銀氧化物電池，其中氧化物作為正極材料。銀氧化物電池在緊湊的鋅-銀(氧化物)電池中提供高能量密度，廣泛用於手錶、助聽器和相機等小型設備。該電化學應用利用Ag(I)還原為金屬銀，將化合物的實用性直接與銀的氧化還原化學聯繫起來，這也奠定了其抗菌作用和組織染色特性。

nodes.label: Gold
nodes.description: Gold occurs naturally in native alloys with Silver — electrum — representing the metallic state of both noble metals outside conventional ores. That shared chemistry is the main reason the metal appears in the vault: the same oxidation, transport, and re-reduction cycle that drives metallic deposition and toxicity for Silver applies to gold nanoparticles used in nanomedicine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gold 天然存在於與 Silver 的天然合金（electrum）中，代表兩種貴金屬在常規礦石之外的金属態。這也是 Gold 之所以出現在本資料庫的主要原因：驅動 Silver 金屬沉積與毒性的氧化、運輸與再還原循環，同樣適用於奈米醫學中使用的 gold nanoparticle。

nodes.label: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol
nodes.description: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol is a selective inhibitor of TAK1 (MAP3K7) used to probe the ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis that orchestrates SASP development after DNA damage. By restraining TAK1 activity it suppresses downstream p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement that supports persistent SASP signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol 是 TAK1（MAP3K7）的選擇性抑制劑，用於探討 DNA 損傷後調控 SASP 發展的 ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸。透過抑制 TAK1 活性，它可壓制支撐持續 SASP 訊號的下游 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與。

nodes.label: Zscan4
nodes.description: Zscan4 is a transcription factor implicated in feedforward regulatory mechanisms that potentiate the SASP during senescence. The SASP is potentiated by dual feedforward mechanisms involving Zscan4 and TAK1, which apigenin intercepts at the downstream ASAP-to-SASP transition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Zscan4 是參與衰老期間強化 SASP 之前饋調控機制的轉錄因子。SASP 由涉及 Zscan4 與 TAK1 的雙重前饋機制強化，apigenin 在下游 ASAP→SASP 轉變處攔截之。

nodes.label: CSNK1G2
nodes.description: Casein kinase 1G2 binds RIPK3 to inhibit its kinase activity and necroptosis signaling in male reproductive aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶1G2結合RIPK3以抑制其激酶活性與下游necroptosis訊號，見於雄性生殖老化。

nodes.label: TAM Kinases
nodes.description: During phagocytosis, TAM kinases (Tyro3, Axl, Mer) activated by phosphatidylserine directly phosphorylate MLKL in inflammatory disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吞噬作用期間，經磷脂醯絲胺酸活化的TAM激酶（Tyro3、Axl、Mer）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎相關疾病。

nodes.label: HSP90
nodes.description: Heat shock protein 90 binds MLKL, preventing proteasomal degradation and promoting MLKL activation and membrane translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白90結合MLKL，防止其經蛋白酶體降解，並促進MLKL活化與膜轉位。

nodes.label: RSK3
nodes.description: RSK3 acts upstream of RIPK3 phosphorylation, promoting necroptosis in ischemic retinal injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RSK3作為RIPK3磷酸化的上游調控因子，促進necroptosis活化，見於缺血性視網膜損傷。

nodes.label: GSK872
nodes.description: GSK872 (GSK'872) is a selective RIPK3 kinase inhibitor used alongside RIPK1 (Necrostatin-1) and MLKL (necrosulfonamide) inhibitors to dissect and block necroptosis in preclinical models (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: GSK872（GSK'872）是選擇性 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，常與 RIPK1（Necrostatin-1）及 MLKL（necrosulfonamide）抑制劑併用，以剖析並阻斷臨床前模型中的 necroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: GSK840
nodes.description: GSK840 (GSK'840) is an ATP-competitive RIPK3 kinase inhibitor used alongside GSK872 as a necroptosis-blocking tool; like other RIPK3 inhibitors, its rescue must be interpreted with kinase-dead-rerouting-to-apoptosis controls (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: GSK840（GSK'840）是 ATP 競爭性 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，與 GSK872 併用作為阻斷 necroptosis 的工具；如同其他 RIPK3 抑制劑，其救援效果須以「激酶死亡型重導向凋亡」對照來解讀（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: Zharp-99
nodes.description: Zharp-99 is a small-molecule RIPK3 kinase inhibitor in the same direct-inhibitor class as GSK872 and GSK840, blocking necrosome output by preventing MLKL phosphorylation (Niu et al. 2026).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Zharp-99 是與 GSK872、GSK840 同屬直接抑制劑類別的小分子 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，透過阻止 MLKL 磷酸化而阻斷 necrosome 輸出（Niu et al. 2026）。

nodes.label: Damaged peroxisomes
nodes.description: Selective autophagy targets damaged peroxisomes for degradation through a process termed pexophagy, in which ubiquitin tagging of peroxisomal proteins and recruitment of ESCRT (endosomal sorting complex required for transport) machinery mark the organelle for autophagic engulfment. This cargo-specific pathway contrasts with bulk autophagy by requiring receptor proteins that bridge the peroxisome to the autophagosomal membrane. Pexophagy protects cells from the oxidative and metabolic damage caused by defective peroxisomes. Its failure leads to accumulation of aberrant organelles and disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 選擇性自噬透過稱為 pexophagy 的過程，標靶受損過氧化體進行降解，其中過氧化體蛋白的泛素標記和 ESCRT（運輸所需內體分選複合物）機制的招募，將該胞器標定為自噬吞噬。此貨物特異性途徑不同於整體自噬之處，在於它需要受體蛋白將過氧化體橋接到自噬體膜。Pexophagy 保護細胞免於缺陷過氧化體造成的氧化和代謝損傷。其失敗導致異常胞器與疾病的累積。

nodes.label: ABCD1 mutation
nodes.description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

nodes.label: Very Long Chain Fatty Acids
nodes.description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

nodes.label: Fenofibrate
nodes.description: Fenofibrate fibrate agonism activates PPAR-alpha. Activation is the pharmacological input.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fenofibrate 貝特促效活化 PPAR-alpha。活化是藥理輸入。

nodes.label: PEX Genes
nodes.description: At least 14 known PEX genes in humans encode peroxins required for Peroxisome biogenesis, assembly, and function. They execute three core processes: PTS1/PTS2 receptor cycling for matrix protein import, membrane assembly and de novo peroxisome formation from the Endoplasmic Reticulum via PEX3, PEX16, and PEX19, and proliferation through PEX11-mediated fission.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類至少有 14 個已知的 PEX 基因，其編碼的 peroxin 是 Peroxisome 生物生成、組裝與功能所必需。它們執行三項核心過程：PTS1/PTS2 受體循環以進行基質蛋白輸入、經由 PEX3、PEX16 與 PEX19 自 Endoplasmic Reticulum 進行膜組裝與新生過氧化體形成，以及透過 PEX11 介導的分裂進行增殖。

nodes.label: Plasmalogen
nodes.description: PEX7 imports alkyl-DHAP synthase, an enzyme required for plasmalogen (ether phospholipid) biosynthesis that is essential for myelin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX7 輸入烷基-DHAP 合成酶，該酵素是神經鞘所必需的 plasmalogen（醚磷脂）生合成所需。

nodes.label: Phytanic acid
nodes.description: PEX7 imports phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase (PHYH), which catalyzes alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid; loss of PEX7 therefore causes phytanic acid accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX7 輸入植烷醯輔酶 A 羥化酶（PHYH），該酵素催化植烷酸的 α-氧化；因此 PEX7 喪失會造成植烷酸累積。

nodes.label: Gene Bodies
nodes.description: DNMT3a exhibits a preference for methylating gene bodies and intergenic regions, in contrast to DNMT3b, which preferentially targets repetitive elements and pericentromeric satellite DNA. Gene body methylation is associated with transcriptional regulation, alternative splicing, and suppression of spurious transcription initiation within genes. This differential targeting between the de novo methyltransferases helps shape the distinct compartmentalization of the methylome and influences patterns of gene expression, heterochromatin formation, and genomic stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 表現出對基因體和基因間區域甲基化的偏好，而 DNMT3b 則優先針對重複元件和著絲粒周圍衛星 DNA。基因體甲基化與基因內的轉錄調控、選擇性剪接和抑制虛假轉錄起始有關。從頭甲基轉移酶之間的這種差異靶向有助於形成甲基化組的獨特區室化，並影響 gene expression 的模式、異染色質形成和基因組穩定性。

nodes.label: DSB repair and RCM
nodes.description: DSB repair and RCM may advance epigenetic clocks by affecting DNA methylation machinery (e.g., TET enzymes and DNMTs). Because the response to DNA damage follows conserved mechanisms, aging becomes somewhat predictable despite random damage, leading to consistent epigenetic drift. Directionally, DNA damage repair and the consequent relocalization of chromatin modifiers sit upstream of clock-measured epigenetic age acceleration, linking RCM to quantitative measures of biological aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂（DSB）修復和 RCM 可能透過影響 DNA 甲基化機制（例如 TET 酶和 DNMTs）來推進表觀遺傳時鐘。由於 DNA 損傷反應遵循保守的機制，衰老因此具有一定的可預測性，儘管損傷是隨機的，導致一致的表觀遺傳漂移。從作用方向而言，DNA 損傷修復及隨後的染色質修飾因子再定位位於時鐘測量的表觀遺傳年齡加速的上游，將 RCM 與生物衰老的量化測量聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

nodes.label: DLK1-DIO3 locus
nodes.description: In humans, miR-543 maps to the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 locus on chromosome 14q32, one of the largest mammalian miRNA megaclusters. Its expression is controlled by parent-of-origin DNA methylation, making it both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在人類中，miR-543 定位於染色體 14q32 的基因銘印 DLK1-DIO3 基因座，這是哺乳動物最大的 miRNA 巨簇之一。其表現受親源 DNA 甲基化控制，使其既是表觀基因組的效應器也是感測器。

nodes.label: PML-RARA
nodes.description: The PML-RARA fusion oncoprotein defines acute promyelocytic leukaemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PML-RARA 融合致癌蛋白定義急性前骨髓球白血病。

nodes.label: CpG Island
nodes.description: CpG islands are genomic regions enriched in CpG dinucleotides, usually in gene promoters. Methylation of these islands typically silences the associated gene, and age-associated hypermethylation of specific CpG islands is used to build DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks that estimate biological age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CpG Island 是富含 CpG 二核苷酸（通常位於基因啟動子）的基因體區域。這些 island 的甲基化通常會使相關基因沉默，而特定 CpG Island 隨年齡增加的過甲基化則被用於建立以 DNA 甲基化為基礎、估算生理年齡的 Epigenetic Clock。

nodes.label: TFEB at S401
nodes.description: In contrast to its S211 effect, p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 401 in a manner that promotes nuclear translocation in specific cell types such as monocytes. This site-specific divergence illustrates that p38 can either retain or activate TFEB depending on cell context and the constellation of concurrent modifications. Such opposing outcomes highlight the combinatorial code by which multiple phosphorylations determine TFEB localization. The monocyte-specific response implicates TFEB in immune cell activation and inflammatory programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 相對於其 S211 效應，p38 MAPK 以促進核轉運的方式於 serine 401 磷酸化 TFEB，此作用發生在特定細胞類型如單核細胞中。這種位點特異性分歧說明 p38 可根據細胞背景和同時存在的修飾組合，保留或活化 TFEB。這種相反結果凸顯了多種磷酸化決定 TFEB 定位的組合密碼。單核細胞特異性反應將 TFEB 牽涉進免疫細胞活化和發炎程序。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

nodes.label: 7-Ketocholesterol
nodes.description: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

nodes.label: SIRT1 deacetylation of p53
nodes.description: By deacetylating p53, SIRT1 lowers p53's transcriptional activation of BH3-only proteins and other apoptotic effectors, suppressing programmed cell death after oxidative or genotoxic stress. This creates a survival bias that helps cells tolerate damage but can also protect incipient cancer cells from elimination. The directionality is that SIRT1 activity on p53 is upstream of reduced apoptosis. A caveat is that chronic suppression of p53-dependent apoptosis is a double-edged sword: protective in normal tissue but potentially tumor-promoting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 降低 p53 對 BH3-only 蛋白和其他凋亡效應因子的轉錄活化，在氧化或基因毒性壓力後抑制程序性細胞死亡。這創造了一種存活偏向，幫助細胞耐受損傷，但也可能保護早期癌細胞免於被清除。其方向性為 SIRT1 對 p53 的活性在減少凋亡的上游。需要注意的是，長期抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡是一把雙刃劍：在正常組織中具有保護作用，但可能促進腫瘤。

nodes.label: Cytoplasmic SIRT1
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is pro-apoptotic (caspase-dependent, deacetylase-independent), flipping SIRT1 from a survival factor into a death promoter once it is cleaved and relocalized. In vivo, cells with cytoplasmic Sir2alpha were overwhelmingly dying, with over 130 of 150 such cells having pyknotic nuclei.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞質 SIRT1 是促凋亡的（依賴 caspase、不依賴去乙醯化），一旦被裂解和重新定位，便將 SIRT1 從存活因子翻轉為死亡促進者。在體內，具有細胞質 Sir2α 的細胞絕大多數正在死亡，150 個此類細胞中超過 130 個具有固縮核。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

nodes.label: SB203580
nodes.description: SB203580 is a selective inhibitor of p38 MAPK (MAPK14), blocking its phosphorylation and activation. It was used as a pharmacological tool to verify p38 MAPK's contribution to SASP expression in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SB203580 是 p38 MAPK（MAPK14）的選擇性抑制劑，阻斷其磷酸化與活化。它被用作藥理學工具，驗證 p38 MAPK 對衰老細胞中 SASP 表現的貢獻。

nodes.label: Protein Kinase C
nodes.description: PKCζ is an atypical protein kinase C isoform.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PKCζ 是非典型蛋白激酶 C 亞型。

nodes.label: PKCδ
nodes.description: Caspase-3 cleavage generates a pro-apoptotic PKCδ fragment, amplifying death by feedback.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 切割產生促凋亡 PKCδ 片段，以回饋放大死亡。

nodes.label: Caspase-Activated DNase
nodes.description: ICAD binds and holds the Caspase-Activated DNase inactive until cleavage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ICAD 結合並使 Caspase 活化 DNase 維持失活直到切割。

nodes.label: Type I vs Type II Cells
nodes.description: The type I / type II distinction (Scaffidi et al. 1998) classifies cells by how much mitochondrial amplification death-receptor apoptosis needs. Type I cells execute Caspase-8 → Caspase-3 directly and are not protected by Bcl-2; type II cells require the Caspase-8 → Bid → BAX/BAK → MOMP → Caspase-9 → Caspase-3 relay, which Bcl-2 overexpression can block.
nodes.description_zh_TW: type I / type II 的區分（Scaffidi et al. 1998）依死亡受體 Apoptosis 需要多少粒線體放大來分類細胞。type I cell 直接執行 Caspase-8 → Caspase-3，且不受 Bcl-2 保護；type II cell 則需要 Caspase-8 → Bid → BAX/BAK → MOMP → Caspase-9 → Caspase-3 的中繼傳遞，此途徑可被 Bcl-2 過量表現阻斷。
nodes.norm_label: type i vs type ii cells
nodes.source_file: Type I vs Type II Cells.md

nodes.label: One-carbon compound
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) is a one-carbon compound formally classified as a member of the guanidines. Its compact scaffold, which can be viewed as a derivative of hydrazine, guanidine, or formamide, gives it both nucleophilic and carbonyl-reactive chemistry. One-carbon compounds serve as minimal scaffolds in drug design, and here the nitrogen-dense core endows the molecule with the enzyme-inhibitory and advanced glycation end product-blocking activities for which aminoguanidine, also known as pimagedine, is studied in diabetic complications research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) 是一種一碳化合物，正式歸類為胍類化合物的一員。其緊湊的骨架可被視為肼、胍或甲醯胺的衍生物，賦予其親核性和羰基反應性化學特性。一碳化合物在藥物設計中充當最小骨架，此處富含氮的核心賦予該分子酶抑制和晚期糖基化終產物阻斷活性，因此 aminoguanidine（亦稱為 pimagedine）在糖尿病併發症研究中受到關注。

nodes.label: CH6N4
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine has the molecular formula CH6N4, a one-carbon core with four nitrogen atoms and six hydrogens, giving a molecular weight of 74.09 g/mol and an exact mass of 74.059246 Da. The nitrogen-dense structure is responsible for the compound's basicity and nucleophilicity, enabling its hydrazine- and guanidine-like reactivity toward carbonyls and enzyme active sites. As one of the smallest enzyme inhibitors known, this compact scaffold underlies aminoguanidine's broad, non-selective interactions with proteins and reactive carbonyl species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine的分子式為CH6N4，具有一個含四個氮原子和六個氫原子的單碳核心，分子量為74.09 g/mol，精確質量為74.059246 Da。其富氮結構負責該化合物的鹼性與親核性，使其對羰基和酶活性位點具有肼和胍樣反應性。作為已知最小的酶抑制劑之一，此緊湊支架奠定了aminoguanidine與蛋白質及活性羰基物種的廣泛非選擇性相互作用。

nodes.label: Enzyme Inhibitors
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine is classified under the MeSH pharmacological class of enzyme inhibitors, defined as compounds or agents that combine with an enzyme in such a manner as to prevent the normal substrate-enzyme combination and the catalytic reaction. Aminoguanidine fits this class through multiple activities: it inhibits monoamine oxidase, nitric oxide synthase, diamine oxidase, and aldose reductase. The enzyme-inhibitor classification captures the mechanism by which this small hydrazine derivative exerts both its therapeutic AGE-modulating effects and its broader off-target pharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 被歸類於 MeSH 藥理學類別中的酵素抑制劑（enzyme inhibitors），其定義為與酵素結合以阻止正常底物-酵素結合及催化反應的化合物或試劑。Aminoguanidine 透過多種活性符合此分類：它可抑制 monoamine oxidase、nitric oxide synthase、diamine oxidase 及 aldose reductase。此酵素抑制劑分類捕捉了這類小型 hydrazine 衍生物發揮其治療性 AGE 調節效應及其更廣泛的脫靶藥理學的機制。

nodes.label: Synvista Therapeutics
nodes.description: Pimagedine, the international nonproprietary name for aminoguanidine, was developed by Synvista Therapeutics, Inc. for the treatment of diabetic kidney disease. Synvista was the company that advanced aminoguanidine into clinical testing as an advanced glycation end product inhibitor. The development trajectory of this simple one-carbon molecule illustrates how basic carbonyl-trapping chemistry was translated into a candidate therapy for diabetic complications, although the compound ultimately did not progress beyond Phase 2 clinical trials.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pimagedine是aminoguanidine的國際非專利名稱，由Synvista Therapeutics, Inc.開發用於治療糖尿病腎病。Synvista是將aminoguanidine作為晚期糖化終產物抑制劑推向臨床試驗的公司。這種簡樸的一碳分子的開發歷程，展示了基礎的羰基捕獲化學如何被轉化為糖尿病併發症的候選療法，但該化合物最終未能通過第二階段臨床試驗。

nodes.label: Phase 2
nodes.description: The drug development summary for aminoguanidine (pimagedine) lists a maximum clinical phase of Phase 2, meaning the compound advanced into controlled efficacy testing but did not progress to late-stage or marketed status. Clinical evaluation focused on diabetic kidney disease and other diabetic complications, where AGE inhibition was hypothesized to be renoprotective. Reaching Phase 2 established proof-of-mechanism interest in AGE inhibitors as therapeutics, even though aminoguanidine itself was not ultimately approved for clinical use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藥物開發摘要中，aminoguanidine（pimagedine）列出的最高臨床階段為第二階段，意指該化合物已進入控制性療效測試，但未進展至晚期或上市狀態。臨床評估著重於糖尿病腎病變及其他糖尿病併發症，其中AGE抑制被假定具有腎臟保護作用。達到第二階段確立了AGE抑制劑作為治療藥物的作用機制驗證興趣，即使aminoguanidine最終未獲批准用於臨床。

nodes.label: Guanylhydrazone
nodes.description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM), historically known as S-Adchnon or adrenochrome guanylhydrazone, is formed by reacting adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine containing an indoline-5,6-dione core, with aminoguanidine, a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative. The reaction forms a stable guanylhydrazone linkage at one of the carbonyl groups of the dione structure. AMM therefore combines a redox-active indoline core with an established anti-glycation agent, providing a dual-action glyco-oxidative modulator designed to simultaneously target oxidative stress and protein crosslinking by advanced glycation end products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM），歷史上稱為 S-Adchnon 或 adrenochrome guanylhydrazone，是由含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物 adrenochrome，與親核性肼衍生物 aminoguanidine 反應形成。該反應在二酮結構的其中一個羰基上形成穩定的 guanylhydrazone 連結。因此，AMM 將具氧化還原活性的 indoline 核心與既有的抗糖化劑結合，提供一種雙重作用的糖氧化調節劑，旨在同時標靶氧化壓力與晚期糖化終產物所引發的蛋白質交聯。

nodes.label: Survival
nodes.description: A number of different studies with diabetic rats indicate that aminoguanidine-administered rats have significantly superior survival rates than untreated animals. Aminoguanidine prolongs survival in azotemic-induced diabetic rats, and it prevents age-related arterial stiffening and cardiac hypertrophy in animals. Human trials indicate aminoguanidine has very low toxicity and appears safe to use at normal dosages, with side effects limited to nausea and headache, although there is still relatively little human data and clinical trials, and broad anti-aging claims rest largely on animal and early human data rather than definitive clinical outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 多項針對糖尿病大鼠的研究表明，給予氨基胍的鼠，與未經處理的動物相比，存活率顯著優異。氨基胍延長了在氮質性糖尿病大鼠中的存活時間，並能預防在動物中出現與年齡相關的動脈僵硬和心肌肥大。人類臨床試驗表明，氨基胍毒性極低，在正常劑量下使用時似乎安全，副作用主要為噁心和頭痛，儘管人類數據和臨床試驗仍然相對有限，而且廣泛的抗衰老聲稱主要依賴動物和早期人類數據，而非明確的臨床結果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Guanidine
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine is a guanidine derivative by parent-to-derivative classification. Derivation records the chemical lineage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 依母體到衍生物歸類是 guanidine 衍生物。衍生記錄化學譜系。

nodes.label: Formamide
nodes.description: Chemistry databases formally classify Aminoguanidine as a derivative of Formamide, reflecting the single-carbon backbone that links its nitrogenous substituents. The classification is structural rather than behavioral — functionally the drug behaves as a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative — but it highlights why Aminoguanidine is one of the smallest enzyme-inhibitory drugs (MW 74.09 g/mol, zero rotatable bonds).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 化學資料庫在形式上將 Aminoguanidine 分類為 Formamide 的衍生物，反映出其含氮取代基所共用的單一碳骨架。此分類屬結構性而非行為性——就功能而言，該藥表現為親核性的 hydrazine 衍生物——但它說明了 Aminoguanidine 為何是最小的酵素抑制藥物之一（分子量 74.09 g/mol、可旋轉鍵數為零）。

nodes.label: Guanidines
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine belongs to the Guanidines chemical family through its guanidine-type nitrogenous core, related to but distinct from free Guanidine. That basic, nitrogen-rich core is what supplies the nucleophilicity used for dicarbonyl scavenging and enzyme inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 透過其 guanidine 類的含氮核心屬於 Guanidines 化學家族，與游離的 Guanidine 相關但並不相同。這個鹼性、富氮的核心正是其進行二羰基清除與酵素抑制時所需的親核性來源。

nodes.label: Histamine
nodes.description: Diamine Oxidase (DAO), also called histaminase, is the primary enzyme that breaks down Histamine from ingested food and is expressed mainly in the intestinal mucosa. Adequate DAO activity therefore protects against dietary histamine load.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diamine Oxidase（DAO，又稱 histaminase）是分解食物中 Histamine 的主要酵素，主要表現於腸道黏膜。足夠的 DAO 活性因此能防止飲食性 histamine 負荷造成不適。

nodes.label: Four distinct class III PI3K complexes
nodes.description: Beclin1 scaffolds four class III PI3K complexes (I/Atg14L, II/UVRAG, III/UVRAG+Rubicon, IV/Bif-1) that regulate autophagy at initiation, nucleation, and maturation stages. Directionally, Beclin1 sits upstream of autophagosome machinery assembly. SIRT1 deacetylates Beclin1 to enhance Vps34 activity, making Beclin1 a hub integrating sirtuin signals into autophagy. The distinct complexes direct autophagosome nucleation, membrane expansion, and fusion with lysosomes, and their composition determines whether autophagy proceeds or is restrained. Beclin1's central scaffolding role makes it a critical control point for autophagic flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Beclin1 支架四個 III 型 PI3K 複合物（I/Atg14L、II/UVRAG、III/UVRAG+Rubicon、IV/Bif-1），在自噬的啟動、成核和成熟階段進行調控。在方向性上，Beclin1 位於自噬體機器組裝的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化 Beclin1 以增強 Vps34 活性，使 Beclin1 成為將 sirtuin 訊號整合到自噬中的樞紐。不同的複合物指導自噬體的成核、膜擴張和與溶酶體的融合，其組成決定了自噬是進行還是被抑制。Beclin1 的核心支架作用使其成為自噬通量的關鍵控制點。
nodes.norm_label: four distinct class iii pi3k complexes
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: ULK1, ATG13, FIP200, ATG101
nodes.description: ULK1 functions within a stable initiation complex containing ATG13, FIP200 (RB1CC1), and ATG101, which nucleates autophagosome formation in response to nutrient status. Directionally, the complex sits upstream of autophagy initiation. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates ULK1 within this complex, positioning sirtuins at the top of the autophagic machinery. The ULK1 complex integrates signals from AMPK and mTORC1, which either activate or inhibit it depending on energy and nutrient state. This makes the initiation complex the central decision point for whether autophagy proceeds.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ULK1 在一個包含 ATG13、FIP200（RB1CC1）和 ATG101 的穩定啟動複合物中發揮功能，該複合物在回應營養狀態時 nucleate 自噬體形成。在方向性上，該複合物位於自噬啟動的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化此複合物中的 ULK1，將 sirtuin 置於自噬機制的頂端。ULK1 複合物整合來自 AMPK 和 mTORC1 的訊號，根據能量和營養狀態啟動或抑制自噬。這使啟動複合物成為自噬是否進行的決策核心。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Atg18
nodes.description: PtdIns3P is the defining lipid landmark of the autophagy initiation machinery: on the phagophore it serves as a docking platform for PX/FYVE-domain effectors, most notably the WIPI family and Atg18, which recruit downstream ATG proteins required for phagophore expansion and autophagosome growth.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PtdIns3P 是自噬起始機器的定義性脂質標記：在 phagophore 上，它作為 PX/FYVE 結構域效應蛋白的停靠平台，尤其是 WIPI 家族與 Atg18，它們會招募 phagophore 擴張與 autophagosome 生長所需的下游 ATG 蛋白。

nodes.label: Deoxycytidine kinase
nodes.description: Gemcitabine requires intracellular phosphorylation by deoxycytidine kinase (dCK) to generate its active diphosphate and triphosphate metabolites. Reduced dCK activity is a documented mechanism of resistance to the drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 需要由 deoxycytidine kinase（dCK）進行細胞內磷酸化，才能產生有活性的二磷酸和三磷酸代謝物。dCK 活性降低是已記錄的藥物抗藥性機制。

nodes.label: Polycythemia Vera
nodes.description: Hydroxyurea is a first-line therapy for managing erythrocytosis in polycythemia vera. By inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase in erythroid progenitors it reduces total red blood cell mass and prevents thrombotic complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 是控制真性紅血球增多症紅血球增多症的一線治療。透過抑制紅血球前驅細胞中的 ribonucleotide reductase，它減少總紅血球質量並預防血栓併發症。

nodes.label: Sickle Cell Disease
nodes.description: Hydroxyurea is used to improve the clinical course of sickle cell disease by raising HbF levels. It reduces the frequency of vaso-occlusive crises and is a standard disease-modifying therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 藉由提高 HbF 水平改善鐮刀型細胞疾病的臨床病程。它可減少血管阻塞性危象的發生頻率，是標準的疾病調整治療。

nodes.label: Fetal Hemoglobin
nodes.description: Hydroxyurea stimulates production of fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in red blood cells of sickle cell disease patients. Increased HbF interferes with polymerization of hemoglobin S, reducing vaso-occlusive crises.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 刺激鐮刀型細胞疾病患者的紅血球產生胎兒血紅蛋白（HbF）。HbF 增加會干擾血紅蛋白 S 的聚合，減少血管阻塞性危象。

nodes.label: DP
nodes.description: E2F/DP heterodimers constitute the functional DNA-binding transcription factor. DP partnership is obligatory for E2F target recognition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: E2F/DP 異二聚體構成具功能的 DNA 結合轉錄因子。DP 夥伴關係對 E2F 標的辨識必要。

nodes.label: Neuronal Death
nodes.description: While honokiol is neuroprotective at low doses, it increases neuronal death in vitro at higher concentrations: 100 uM applied directly to fetal cortical neurons is toxic. This dose-dependent biphasic behavior underscores the need to define human pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic parameters before clinical administration. The potential neurotoxicity at supraphysiological concentrations, combined with honokiol's antithrombotic activity, highlights the importance of careful dosing and patient selection for any therapeutic use.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚在低劑量下具有神經保護作用，但在較高濃度下會增加體外神經元死亡：100 uM 直接施加於胎兒皮質神經元即具毒性。這種劑量依賴的雙相行為凸顯了在臨床投藥前須先確立人體藥動學與藥效學參數。超生理濃度下的潛在神經毒性，加上厚朴酚的抗血栓活性，強調了任何治療用途都需謹慎給藥並審慎選擇病患。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Water
nodes.description: Honokiol is highly lipophilic with very poor water solubility, so hot-water tea extraction is inefficient and ethanol tinctures or supercritical CO2 extracts are needed for therapeutic dosing. Directionally, the physicochemical property sits upstream of formulation requirement. Its lipophilicity also aids cell and mitochondrial membrane penetration, supporting SIRT3 engagement and explaining its potency despite poor aqueous solubility. This is a practical caveat for honokiol use, since the delivery vehicle determines both absorption and bioavailability. Nanoparticle and other advanced formulations are being explored to improve honokiol's pharmacokinetics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 和厚朴酚（Honokiol）具有高度親脂性和極差的水溶性，因此熱水茶提取效率低，需要乙醇酊劑或超臨界 CO2 萃取物才能達到治療劑量。在方向性上，此物理化學性質位於製劑需求的上游。其親脂性也有助於細胞和粒線體膜穿透，支持 SIRT3 的結合並解釋了其儘管水溶性差仍具有高效力的原因。這是和厚朴酚使用的實際注意事項，因為遞送載體決定了吸收和生物利用度。正在探索奈米粒子和其他先進製劑以改善和厚朴酚的藥動學。

nodes.label: Renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis
nodes.description: Honokiol suppresses renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis by activating SIRT3, which inhibits the NF-κB/TGF-β1 pathway and limits fibrogenic signaling in kidney tubules. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to drive antifibrotic transcription. This reduces collagen deposition and inflammatory infiltrate, protecting renal architecture during injury. It illustrates SIRT3's broad tissue-protective role beyond the heart, and it is consistent with the general antifibrotic action of mitochondrial sirtuins. Given that tubulointerstitial fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic kidney disease, SIRT3 activation represents a promising strategy to slow renal decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚通過活化 SIRT3 抑制腎小管間質纖維化，SIRT3 抑制 NF-κB/TGF-β1 通路並限制腎小管中的纖維化信號。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以驅動抗纖維化轉錄。這減少膠原蛋白沉積和發炎浸潤，在損傷期間保護腎臟結構。它說明了 SIRT3 超越心臟的廣泛組織保護作用，與粒線體 sirtuin 的一般抗纖維化作用一致。鑑於小管間質纖維化是慢性腎病的共同最終通路，SIRT3 活化代表了一種延緩腎臟退化的有前景策略。

nodes.label: Thrombosis
nodes.description: Honokiol inhibits arterial thrombosis via endothelial protection and stimulation of prostacyclin. Because of this potent antithrombotic action, it should be avoided in coagulopathic patients, hemorrhagic stroke, or those on anticoagulants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Honokiol 透過內皮保護和刺激前列環素來抑制動脈血栓形成。由於這種強效的抗血栓作用，凝血病變患者、出血性中風或服用抗凝血劑者應避免使用。

nodes.label: CYP2D6
nodes.description: Dextromethorphan (DXM) is extensively metabolized by CYP2D6, and to a lesser extent CYP3A4, into dextrorphan. Poor and ultra-rapid CYP2D6 metabolizers therefore show marked inter-individual variability in exposure, and concomitant CYP2D6 inhibitors raise DXM levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dextromethorphan (DXM) 主要由 CYP2D6 代謝（次要為 CYP3A4）成為 dextrorphan。因此 CYP2D6 的低活性與超高活性代謝者之間的血中濃度差異極大，且併用 CYP2D6 抑制劑會提高 DXM 的血中濃度。

nodes.label: Shinya Yamanaka
nodes.description: Shinya Yamanaka and colleagues discovered induced pluripotent stem cells in 2006, showing that somatic fibroblasts could be reprogrammed to pluripotency by the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This landmark work, for which Yamanaka received the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012, demonstrated that cell identity is not fixed and could be reset by defined factors. iPSC technology opened new avenues for disease modeling, drug discovery, and patient-specific regenerative medicine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Shinya Yamanaka 及其同事於 2006 年發現了誘導多能幹細胞，顯示體細胞纖維母細胞可以透過四種轉錄因子 Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc 重新編程為多能性。山中伸彌憑藉這項具有里程碑意義的工作獲得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎，它證明細胞身份不是固定的，可以透過確定的因素進行重置。 iPSC 技術為疾病建模、藥物發現和患者特異性再生醫學開闢了新途徑。

nodes.label: Immune Rejection
nodes.description: Major histocompatibility complex mismatch is the principal transplant-rejection determinant.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 主要組織相容複合體錯配是主要的移植排斥決定因子。

nodes.label: Kazutoshi Takahashi
nodes.description: Takahashi is first author of the 2006 Cell paper demonstrating four-factor fibroblast reprogramming.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Takahashi 是 2006 Cell 論文證明四因子纖維母細胞重編程的第一作者。

nodes.label: Dioxygenase
nodes.description: IDO1 belongs to the family of heme-dependent dioxygenases (EC 1.13.11.52), distinct from but functionally related to tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase (TDO, mainly hepatic) and IDO2 (a less active paralog). It is a monomeric cytosolic protein of about 45 kDa encoded by the IDO1 gene on human chromosome 8p11.21. Crystal structures (e.g., PDB 2D0T, 5EK2) reveal a large domain with a deep heme-binding pocket and a smaller domain, and the active site shows plasticity that allows inhibitor and substrate binding. This structural information underpins the design of IDO1 inhibitors for immuno-oncology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IDO1 屬於依賴血基質的雙加氧酶家族（EC 1.13.11.52），與色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶（TDO，主要位於肝臟）及 IDO2（活性較低的旁系同源物）有別但功能相關。它是由人類第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 上的 IDO1 基因編碼、約 45 kDa 的單體胞質蛋白。晶體結構（例如 PDB 2D0T、5EK2）顯示一個帶有深血基質結合口袋的大結構域與一個較小結構域，且活性位點展現容許抑制劑與受質結合的可塑性。此結構資訊支撐了用於免疫腫瘤學的 IDO1 抑制劑設計。

nodes.label: Microbial Exposure
nodes.description: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

nodes.label: Clostridium sporogenes
