nodes.description: Clostridium sporogenes is an anaerobic, spore-forming gut commensal and the best-characterized producer of Indole-3-propionic acid, reducing Tryptophan through indole-pyruvate to indole-3-lactate and then IPA. IPA is a circulating radical-scavenging metabolite acting on host Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Pregnane X Receptor signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Clostridium sporogenes 是厭氧、能形成芽孢的腸道共生菌，也是 Indole-3-propionic acid 最具表征的產生菌，經由 indole-pyruvate 將 Tryptophan 還原為 indole-3-lactate 再生成 IPA。IPA 是循環中的自由基清除代謝物，作用於宿主 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 與 Pregnane X Receptor 的訊息傳遞。

nodes.label: IDO2
nodes.description: IDO2 is a heme-containing paralog of IDO1 that performs the same Tryptophan-to-N-Formylkynurenine reaction roughly 100-fold less efficiently and is thought to act primarily as a negative regulator of IDO1 — by competing for heme availability, forming heteromeric complexes that modulate IDO1 activity, or mediating non-enzymatic signaling. IDO2 also contributes to resistance against IDO1-targeted cancer therapy and is expressed in kidney, liver and antigen-presenting cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IDO2 是 IDO1 的含血基質旁系同源蛋白，執行相同的 Tryptophan→N-Formylkynurenine 反應但催化效率低約 100 倍，主要被認為是 IDO1 的負向調控者——藉由競爭血基質可用性、形成調節 IDO1 活性的異源多聚體，或介導非酵素性訊號。IDO2 也促成對 IDO1 標靶癌症療法的抗藥性，並表現於腎、肝與抗原呈現細胞。

nodes.label: TFEB for CLEAR element
nodes.description: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

nodes.label: Environment
nodes.description: Unlike the largely static genome, the epigenome is dynamic and responsive to diet, stress, exercise, toxins, and social environment. Environmental signals modify DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNA expression, shaping gene expression over the lifespan and influencing the pace of biological aging. This responsiveness links lifestyle and environmental exposures to long-term health outcomes and provides a mechanistic basis for the effects of behavior and environment on aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與基本上靜態的基因組不同，表觀基因組是動態的，並對飲食、壓力、運動、毒素和社會環境做出反應。環境訊號會改變 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白修飾和非編碼 RNA 表達，在整個生命週期中塑造 gene expression 並影響生物老化的速度。這種反應性將生活方式和環境暴露與長期健康結果聯繫起來，並為行為和環境對老化的影響提供了機制基礎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic alterations—The silent indicator for early aging and age‐associated health‐risks.md

nodes.label: Salmonella enterica
nodes.description: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Sirt4 knockout
nodes.description: Deletion of the Sirt4 gene in mice leads to hyper-activation of GDH in pancreatic islets, abnormally elevated insulin levels, and upregulation of amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, particularly in response to glutamine. These mice are protected from diet-induced obesity, linking the SIRT4-GDH axis to systemic energy balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在小鼠中刪除 Sirt4 基因會導致胰腺胰島中 GDH 過度活化、胰島素水平異常升高，並上調胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌，尤其是對穀氨醯胺的反應。這些小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，將 SIRT4–GDH 軸與全身能量平衡聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Hyperinsulinemic Hypoglycemia
nodes.description: Loss-of-function and activating mutations in the GLUD1 gene cause hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia (hyperinsulinism/hyperammonemia syndrome), illustrating the clinical impact of deregulated GDH. This underscores the importance of the SIRT4-GDH regulatory axis in whole-body glucose handling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GLUD1 基因的功能喪失性和活化性突變會導致高胰島素性低血糖（高胰島素血症/高氨血症症候群），顯示 GDH 調節異常的臨床影響。這凸顯了 SIRT4–GDH 調節軸在全身葡萄糖處理中的重要性。

nodes.label: OXPHOS
nodes.description: MYC induces elevated respiration, coupling oncogenic transcription to oxidative metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MYC 誘發升高的呼吸，將致癌轉錄耦合到氧化代謝。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression
nodes.description: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression extends lifespan, as demonstrated by MCAT (mitochondrial catalase transgenic) mice showing roughly 20 percent increased median lifespan and delayed age-related pathology. By concentrating catalase in the mitochondrial matrix, H2O2 from Complex I or III leak is removed before it propagates damage. The directionality is targeted detoxification promoting longevity. A caveat is that lifespan extension is modest and tissue-specific, and overexpression does not abolish all aging phenotypes, indicating multiple parallel aging mechanisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression延長了壽命，正如MCAT（mitochondria1catalase轉基因）小鼠所證明的那樣，其顯示中位壽命延長了約20％並延遲了與年齡相關的病理。透過將catalase濃縮在mitochondria1基質中，來自複合物I或III洩漏的H 2 O 2 在其傳播損害之前被除去。方向性是針對性排毒延年益壽。需要注意的是，壽命延長是適度的且具有組織特異性，且過度表現並不能消除所有 aging 表型，表明存在多個並行的 aging 機制。

nodes.label: Declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4
nodes.description: Aging is associated with declining SIRT3 activity and rising SIRT4, which narrows the hormetic window and increases vulnerability to mitochondrial stressors. Directionally, aging sits upstream of the altered ratio. This shift favors oxidant stress and metabolic inflexibility, and restoring the ratio, for example via caloric restriction or NAD+ precursors, is a proposed anti-aging strategy. By reducing the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 balance, aging impairs mitochondrial quality control and stress adaptation. This association links mitochondrial sirtuin biology to the functional decline of aging tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老與 SIRT3 活性下降和 SIRT4 上升相關，這縮窄了激效窗口並增加對粒線體壓力源的脆弱性。在方向性上，衰老位於改變比率的上游。這種變化有利於氧化壓力和代謝不靈活性，恢復比率（例如透過限制熱量或 NAD+ 前驅物）是一種擬議的抗衰老策略。透過降低保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡，衰老損害粒線體品質控制和壓力適應。此關聯將粒線體 sirtuin 生物學與衰老組織的功能退化聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: endostatin
nodes.description: Endostatin is a 20 kDa collagen XVIII-derived fragment that acts as a potent endogenous inhibitor of angiogenesis, restraining tumor growth and metastasis. Its regulation and matrix-derived abundance change with tissue remodeling in aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Endostatin 是 20 kDa 的 XVIII 型膠原蛋白衍生片段，是抑制血管生成、約束腫瘤生長與轉移的強效內源性抑制劑。其調控與基質衍生豐度隨衰老的組織重塑而改變。

nodes.label: Insulin/IGF-1 Signaling
nodes.description: The conserved worm-to-mammal longevity axis dissected in model organisms. Regulation is the endocrine aging input.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在模式生物解剖的保守蠕蟲到哺乳類長壽軸。調節是內分泌老化輸入。

nodes.label: Biomarkers
nodes.description: Geroscience relies on accurate biomarkers to quantify biological age and the rate of decline, and to judge whether an intervention is truly slowing biological aging rather than merely altering a surrogate. Tools such as the epigenetic clock, including DNAmGrimAge based on DNA methylation, are central to this measurement problem.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀髮科學高度依賴精確的生物標記來量化生物學年齡與衰退速率，並判斷某項介入是否真的減緩了生物學老化，而非僅改變某個替代指標。表觀遺傳時鐘（epigenetic clock）等工具——例如以 DNA 甲基化為基礎的 DNAmGrimAge——正是此測量問題的核心。

nodes.label: RHIM
nodes.description: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.

nodes.label: Extracellular neuromelanin
nodes.description: Extracellular neuromelanin activates Microglia, serving as a trigger that switches the target cell or process into an active state. Mechanistically, the entity engages receptors or danger signals that provoke proliferation, phagocytosis, or cytokine release. This is significant because activation of glial or immune effectors can both clear debris and, when chronic, perpetuate neuronal injury. A caveat is that activation has a protective-to-harmful transition, so the consequence depends on whether the response resolves or becomes sustained.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Extracellular neuromelanin 啟動 Microglia，作為將目標單元或進程切換到活動狀態的觸發器。從機制上講，該實體與受體或危險信號結合，引發增殖、吞噬或細胞激素釋放。這很重要，因為神經膠質或免疫效應器的活化既可以清除碎片，並且在慢性時，可以使神經元損傷永久化。需要注意的是，活化有一個保護性到有害性的轉變，因此結果取決於 response 是否解決或持續。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md

nodes.label: Neuronophagia
nodes.description: Neuronophagia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuronophagia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Iba1
nodes.description: Iba1 is the standard immunohistochemical marker for microglia in the central nervous system. Its expression increases with microglial activation, and Iba1 immunostaining reveals microgliosis in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Iba1 是中樞神經系統微膠質細胞的標準免疫組織化學標記。其表現隨微膠質活化而增加，Iba1 免疫染色揭示神經退化與神經發炎中的微膠質增生。

nodes.label: Urolithin A metabolism
nodes.description: Rifampicin is a hepatic enzyme inducer that can increase the activity of certain metabolic enzymes in the liver, potentially accelerating the metabolism of urolithin A and reducing its half-life in the body. This illustrates the broader principle that drugs interacting with cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver can competitively inhibit or induce these enzymes, thereby disrupting the metabolism and clearance of urolithin A and altering its systemic exposure. Common antibiotics, antifungal drugs, and anticancer drugs have been reported to interact with CYP450 enzymes in this way.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rifampicin 是一種肝臟酶誘導劑，可提升肝臟中某些代謝酶的活性，可能加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期。這說明了更廣泛的原則：與肝臟中 cytochrome P450 酶交互作用的藥物，可競爭性抑制或誘導這些酶，從而干擾 urolithin A 的代謝與清除，並改變其全身暴露量。常見的抗生素、抗真菌藥物與抗癌藥物皆曾被報導以這種方式與 CYP450 酶交互作用。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: Hematopoietic stem cells
nodes.description: Leukemic clones derive from transformed hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 白血病克隆源自於轉化的造血幹細胞或祖細胞。

nodes.label: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS
nodes.description: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。
nodes.norm_label: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ros
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Colchicine
nodes.description: Colchicine is a plant alkaloid that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. It is used for gout and familial Mediterranean fever and serves as a comparator microtubule-disrupting agent in fenbendazole-related anticancer research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Colchicine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的植物生物鹼。它用於痛風與家族性地中海熱，並作為 fenbendazole 相關抗癌研究中的比較性微管破壞藥物。

nodes.label: Dimethyl Sulfoxide
nodes.description: Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) is a pharmaceutical vehicle that enhances fenbendazole delivery by improving solubility and inhibiting CYP2C19/CYP3A4 metabolism. DMSO-mediated inhibition prolongs fenbendazole systemic exposure, enhancing its cytotoxicity even in paclitaxel-resistant cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 二甲基亞碸（DMSO）是藥品載體，透過改善溶解度並抑制 CYP2C19/CYP3A4 代謝來增進 fenbendazole 遞送。DMSO 介導的抑制延長 fenbendazole 的全身暴露，即使在 paclitaxel 抗藥細胞中也能增強其細胞毒性。

nodes.label: Flubendazole
nodes.description: Flubendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic structurally related to fenbendazole. It inhibits microtubule function through a mechanism distinct from vinca alkaloids and displays preclinical activity in leukemia and myeloma models, with reported synergism with microtubule-targeting agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flubendazole 是與 fenbendazole 結構相關的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥。它透過不同於長春花生物鹼的機制抑制微管功能，在白血病與骨髓瘤模型中表現臨床前活性，並有與微管靶向藥物協同的報導。

nodes.label: Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin
nodes.description: Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin (MbetaCD) forms inclusion complexes with hydrophobic drugs, dramatically increasing their aqueous solubility. Complexing fenbendazole with MbetaCD raises water solubility about 60,000-fold and boosts drug release, overcoming its poor bioavailability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 甲基-β-環糊精（MβCD）與疏水性藥物形成包合物，大幅提高其水溶性。將 fenbendazole 與 MβCD 複合可將水溶性提高約 60,000 倍並增進藥物釋放，克服其不良生物可用性。

nodes.label: Nitroimidazole
nodes.description: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

nodes.label: Podophyllotoxin
nodes.description: Podophyllotoxin is a lignan that binds tubulin at the colchicine site and inhibits microtubule polymerization. It is listed among agents whose tubulin-microtubule effects could theoretically synergize with or be antagonized by fenbendazole.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 鬼臼毒素（podophyllotoxin）是結合 tubulin 秋水仙素位點並抑制微管聚合的木脂素。它被列為其微管效應理論上可能與 fenbendazole 協同或拮抗的藥物之一。

nodes.label: Salicylic acid
nodes.description: Salicylic acid is explored as a crystal-engineering vehicle in the fenbendazole literature. Fenbendazole-salicylic acid cocrystals achieved 100% drug release within one hour and improved solubility, serving as a leading strategy to overcome fenbendazole's poor release rate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 水楊酸在 fenbendazole 文獻中被探索作為晶體工程載體。Fenbendazole-水楊酸共晶在一小時內達到 100% 藥物釋放並改善溶解度，是克服 fenbendazole 不良釋放速率的領先策略。

nodes.label: Soluplus
nodes.description: Soluplus is an amphiphilic graft copolymer used to formulate polymeric micelles that encapsulate poorly soluble drugs. Fenbendazole-loaded Soluplus micelles showed lower total clearance and volume of distribution, supporting improved delivery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Soluplus 是兩親性接枝共聚物，用於配製包封難溶性藥物的聚合物微胞。裝載 fenbendazole 的 Soluplus 微胞表現較低的總清除率與分布體積，支持改善的遞送。

nodes.label: DNA Helicase
nodes.description: Some bis-benzimidazole compounds bind the minor groove of DNA at specific sequences and inhibit DNA helicase activity, thereby blocking cell proliferation. This mechanism is relevant to fenbendazole-family benzimidazoles as potential anticancer agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 某些雙苯並咪唑化合物結合 DNA 小溝的特定序列並抑制 DNA 解旋酶活性，從而阻斷細胞增殖。此機制與 fenbendazole 家族苯並咪唑作為潛在抗癌藥有關。

nodes.label: Vinblastine
nodes.description: Vinblastine is a vinca-alkaloid microtubule-targeting agent that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. Both vinblastine and fenbendazole are microtubule-depolymerizing agents that arrest cells in metaphase and induce apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vinblastine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的長春花生物鹼微管靶向藥物。Vinblastine 與 fenbendazole 皆是使細胞停滯在中期並誘導凋亡的微管去聚合藥物。

nodes.label: Rituximab
nodes.description: Anti-CD20 rituximab is the backbone of B-cell NHL regimens.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抗 CD20 rituximab 是 B 細胞 NHL 方案主幹。

nodes.label: cytarabine
nodes.description: Cytarabine is the nucleoside-analog backbone of leukemia therapy, synergizing with ivermectin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cytarabine 是白血病治療的核苷類似物主幹，與 ivermectin 協同。

nodes.label: Daunorubicin
nodes.description: Daunorubicin is the anthracycline of the 7+3 leukemia backbone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Daunorubicin 是白血病 7+3 主幹的蒽環類藥。

nodes.label: Fenbendazole sulfone
nodes.description: Fenbendazole sulfone is a downstream oxidized metabolite of Fenbendazole, formed by presystemic and systemic metabolism; it predominates in plasma after administration. It is essentially the inactive end product of the pathway, since the sulfoxide Oxfendazole, not the sulfone, is the primary metabolite responsible for Fenbendazole's anthelmintic and putative anticancer activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole sulfone 是 Fenbendazole 的下游氧化代謝物，由預系統性與系統性代謝產生，並在給藥後於血漿中占優勢。它基本上是該代謝途徑的惰性終產物，因為負責 Fenbendazole 驅蟲與潛在抗癌活性的主要代謝物是硫氧化物 Oxfendazole，而非硫酮。

nodes.label: GlaxoSmithKline
nodes.description: GlaxoSmithKline is a founding donor to the Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis, supplying albendazole free of charge for mass drug administration. Together with ivermectin donated by Merck & Co. Inc, this donation has enabled distribution of billions of doses, interrupting transmission of Wuchereria bancrofti and related filarial parasites, and illustrates the public–private model of pharmaceutical support for global health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GlaxoSmithKline 是 Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis 的創始捐贈者，免費提供 albendazole 供 mass drug administration 使用。與 Merck & Co. Inc 捐贈的 ivermectin 一起，此捐贈使數十億劑得以分發，中斷 Wuchereria bancrofti 及相關絲蟲的傳播，並展現了製藥企業支持全球衛生的公私協作模式。

nodes.label: Cyclodextrin
nodes.description: Cyclodextrins encapsulate poorly water-soluble hydrophobic drugs, and methyl-beta-cyclodextrin complexed 1:1 with fenbendazole reached 20.21 mg/ml water solubility with 75% release in 15 minutes, meeting thresholds for systemic anticancer use. Cyclodextrin derivatives are therefore common pharmaceutical solubilizers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclodextrin 會包埋水溶性差的疏水性藥物，Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin 與 fenbendazole 以 1:1 形成的複合物達到 20.21 mg/ml 的水溶性並在 15 分鐘內釋放 75%，符合全身性抗癌使用的門檻。因此 cyclodextrin 衍生物是常見的藥物增溶劑。

nodes.label: Flavin-containing Monooxygenase
nodes.description: The FMO family are FAD-dependent monooxygenases catalysing NADPH- and O2-dependent oxidation of soft nucleophiles such as sulfur, nitrogen and phosphorus centres. Together with CYP3A4, FMO mediates the rapid hepatic sulfoxidation of fenbendazole to oxfendazole (fenbendazole sulfoxide); this first-pass sulfoxidation is the gateway to fenbendazole's pharmacologically active metabolite, with FMO3 the dominant hepatic form in adults.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FMO 家族是依賴 FAD 的單加氧酶，催化 NADPH 與 O2 相依的軟親核體（如硫、氮、磷中心）氧化。FMO 與 CYP3A4 共同介導 fenbendazole 在肝臟中快速硫氧化為 oxfendazole（fenbendazole sulfoxide）；這個首過硫氧化是形成 fenbendazole 藥理活性代謝物的關口，成人肝臟以 FMO3 為主。

nodes.label: HIRA/ASF1a
nodes.description: SAHF are assembled by the HIRA-ASF1a histone chaperone complex, which deposits macroH2A and core histones to establish H3K9me3-marked heterochromatin at the foci. This chaperone-driven deposition is required for the formation of the DAPI-dense nuclear bodies that characterize senescent cells, and it is coordinated with hypophosphorylated Rb. The process links histone dynamics directly to senescence-specific chromatin reorganization. HIRA/ASF1a thus provide the assembly machinery for the repressive structures that lock in the arrested state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAHF 由 HIRA-ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體組裝，該複合體沉積 macroH2A 與核心組蛋白以在焦點建立 H3K9me3 標記的異染色質。此伴護蛋白驅動的沉積對形成定義衰老細胞的 DAPI 緻密核體為必要，且與低磷酸化 Rb 協調。此過程將組蛋白動態直接連結到衰老特異性染色質重組。HIRA/ASF1a 因此提供將停滯狀態鎖入的抑制性結構的組裝機器。

nodes.label: Pinometostat
nodes.description: Pinometostat inhibits DOT1L targeting H3K79 methylation in MLL leukemias. Drug-target edge of the methyltransferase axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pinometostat 抑制 DOT1L，標靶 MLL 白血病的 H3K79 甲基化。甲基轉移酶軸的藥物—標的邊。

nodes.label: Acute Inflammation
nodes.description: Exercise-induced muscle damage signals via TNF-alpha/IL-6 to proliferate satellite cells; NSAIDs block the adaptation (Mikkelsen 2009). Acute inflammatory signaling as repair trigger.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運動誘發的肌肉損傷經由 TNF-alpha/IL-6 訊號增生衛星細胞；NSAID 阻斷此適應（Mikkelsen 2009）。急性發炎訊號作為修復觸發。

nodes.label: Osteogenesis
nodes.description: BMP2/4/7 drive osteoblast differentiation as the defining skeletal function of the pathway. Loss of signaling causes skeletal dysplasia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BMP2/4/7 驅動造骨細胞分化，作為此路徑定義性的骨骼功能。訊號缺失導致骨骼發育不良。

nodes.label: Cell Sorting
nodes.description: Differential cadherin adhesion drives developmental cell sorting. Driving records the morphogenetic output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 差異 cadherin 黏附驅動發育細胞分選。驅動記錄形態發生輸出。

nodes.label: Noggin
nodes.description: Noggin binds and sequesters BMP2/4/7 extracellularly to block signaling. This antagonism patterns embryonic and skeletal development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Noggin 在胞外結合並隔離 BMP2/4/7 以阻斷訊號。此拮抗塑造胚胎與骨骼發育。

nodes.label: YAP
nodes.description: LATS1 and LATS2 phosphorylation excludes and degrades YAP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LATS1 與 LATS2 磷酸化排除並降解 YAP。

nodes.label: Organ Size
nodes.description: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

nodes.label: Antiangiogenic therapy
nodes.description: RCC is treated with VEGF-pathway inhibitors (e.g., sunitinib) and mTOR inhibitors; chemotherapy is largely ineffective.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RCC 使用 VEGF 途徑抑制劑（例如 sunitinib）和 mTOR 抑制劑治療；化療基本上無效。

nodes.label: Intermittent Hypoxia
nodes.description: Controlled, intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha, the 'hormetic amplifier': in C. elegans mild hypoxia → transient mitochondrial ROS → HIF-1 → positive ROS feedback → AMPK negative feedback → net ROS homeostasis with lifespan extension and enhanced immunity (Li et al., 2024); in mammals it drives erythropoietin, antioxidant and BDNF programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 受控的間歇性輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，即「荷爾蒙放大器」：在 C. elegans 中輕度缺氧 → 短暫粒線體 ROS → HIF-1 → 正回饋 ROS → AMPK 負回饋 → 淨 ROS 恆定並延壽與增強免疫力（Li et al., 2024）；在哺乳類中驅動紅血球生成素、抗氧化與 BDNF 程式。

nodes.label: ARNT
nodes.description: ARNT (HIF-1β) is the obligate heterodimerization partner of HIF-1α; together they form the active HIF-1 transcription factor complex that mediates the cellular response to hypoxia. ARNT provides the bHLH and PAS domains that pair with HIF-1α to drive hypoxic gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARNT（HIF-1β）是 HIF-1α 的必需異源二聚化夥伴；兩者共同組成介導細胞低氧反應的活性 HIF-1 轉錄因子複合體。ARNT 提供與 HIF-1α 配對以驅動低氧基因表現的 bHLH 與 PAS 結構域。

nodes.label: CTP Synthetase
nodes.description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

nodes.label: Antimetabolite
nodes.description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine is a type of Antimetabolite: this synthetic cytidine nucleoside analog acts as a metabolic antagonist that depletes pyrimidine nucleotides, chiefly by inhibiting CTP synthetase, which underlies its candidate use in cancer chemotherapy and antiviral research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於 Antimetabolite（抗代謝物）的一種：此合成胞苷核苷類似物扮演代謝拮抗劑，主要透過抑制 CTP synthetase 耗竭嘧啶核苷酸，這是其在癌症化療與抗病毒研究中作為候選藥物的基礎。

nodes.label: Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome
nodes.description: CDKN1C mutation or loss of imprinting causes Beckwith-Wiedemann overgrowth syndrome. The genotype-phenotype link makes CDKN1C a developmental disease gene.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDKN1C 突變或銘印喪失導致 Beckwith-Wiedemann 過度生長症候群。此基因型—表型連結使 CDKN1C 成為發育疾病基因。

nodes.label: Carmofur
nodes.description: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

nodes.label: ARN14794
nodes.description: ARN14794 has IC50 ~100 nM against acid ceramidase and was specifically used in the Soriano-Castell 2026 ferroptosis study to reduce membrane PL-PUFA content.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARN14794 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 約為 100 nM，並在 Soriano-Castell 2026 年的鐵蛋白死亡研究中被專門用於降低膜磷脂中 PL-PUFA 的含量。

nodes.label: PUFA
nodes.description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) over-expression increases the polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content of membrane phospholipids, promoting a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile. Mechanistically, ACase-mediated ceramide breakdown releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that, via the Lands cycle, are exchanged into sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACase knockdown in senescent cells decreased the most abundant PL-PUFA species (including PC-AA, PG-DHA, PG-DPA), thereby reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool and conferring ferroptosis resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 過表達增加了膜磷脂中的不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 含量，促進了促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態。從機制上講，ACase 介導的絲胺類分解釋放了自由飽和和一元飽和脂肪酸，透過 Lands 循環轉化為 sn-2 PUFA 含有磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 這是脂質過氧化反應的底物。在老化的細胞中，ACase 下調降低了最豐富的 PL-PUFA 物種（包括 PC-AA、PG-DHA、PG-DPA），從而降低了脂質過氧化反應底物池，並賦予了焦蛋白死亡的抵抗力。

nodes.label: Senolytic Drug Target
nodes.description: Acid ceramidase is a druggable, near-term, testable senotherapeutic target for clearing senescent cells. Experimental drugs targeting acid ceramidase have already been developed for other therapeutic purposes, demonstrating that the enzyme is targetable and lighting the way toward future innovation that could extend healthspans. Because elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis, inhibitors of the enzyme could selectively eliminate senescent 'zombie' cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. The Salk team calls this a big milestone in the public health effort to support healthy aging, with the next steps being pathway completion, animal translation, and clinical trials.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶是一種可藥物標靶、近期且可測試的衰老細胞治療目標，用於清除衰老細胞。針對酸甘油酯酶的實驗性藥物已經針對其他治療目的而開發，證明該酶可標靶，為未來的創新開闢了道路，可能延長壽命。由於酸甘油酯酶升高會使衰老細胞更容易受到焦慮素突變的影響，因此抑制該酶可能能夠選擇性地消除衰老「殭屍」細胞，同時保持周圍細胞健康。沙鹿團隊將這歸結為公共衛生努力支持健康老齡化的重要里程碑，接下來的步驟包括通路完成、動物翻譯和臨床試驗。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: Phospholipid-PUFA
nodes.description: ACSL4 loads polyunsaturated fatty acids into membrane phospholipids, the obligate peroxidation substrate of ferroptosis (Doll 2017). Without ACSL4 enrichment membranes resist iron-driven peroxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ACSL4 將多元不飽和脂肪酸裝載入膜磷脂，即鐵死亡必要的過氧化受質（Doll 2017）。缺乏 ACSL4 富集，膜即抵抗鐵驅動的過氧化。

nodes.label: ARN14974
nodes.description: ARN14974 (Compound 17a) is a potent benzoxazolone carboxamide inhibitor of intracellular Acid ceramidase with an IC50 of 79 nM against recombinant human ACase, developed by Pizzirani et al. (2015) as a systemically active, brain-penetrant tool. It is active by both i.p. and i.v. routes, reduces ACase activity in brain, liver, heart, lungs and kidney, and shows Cmax 1768 ng/mL with t1/2 458 min at 10 mg/kg i.p. in mice. Carmofur is a clinically approved ACase inhibitor with BBB penetration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARN14974（Compound 17a）是細胞內 Acid ceramidase 的強效苯并噁唑啉酮甲醯胺類抑制劑，對重組人類 ACase 的 IC50 為 79 nM，由 Pizzirani 等人於 2015 年開發為可全身給藥、可穿透血腦障壁的工具化合物。它可經 i.p. 與 i.v. 途徑給藥，在腦、肝、心、肺與腎降低 ACase 活性，小鼠 10 mg/kg i.p. 時 Cmax 為 1768 ng/mL、半衰期 458 分鐘。Carmofur 則是另一個可穿透血腦障壁的已核准 ACase 抑制劑。

nodes.label: Ferroptosis Suppressor
nodes.description: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

nodes.label: Myristoylation
nodes.description: Myristoylation is the covalent attachment of a myristoyl group to FSP1's N-terminal glycine, anchoring the flavoprotein to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane. This plasma-membrane localization places FSP1's ubiquinone-reductase activity where the ubiquinol radical trap is needed to suppress ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肉荳蔻醯化是將肉荳蔻醯基共價連接至 FSP1 的 N 端甘氨酸，將黃素蛋白錨定在質膜內葉。此質膜定位使 FSP1 的泛醌還原酶活性位於需要泛醇自由基捕捉以抑制 ferroptosis 之處。

nodes.label: DHODH
nodes.description: Mitochondrial DHODH reduces CoQ10 in parallel to plasma-membrane FSP1 (Mao 2021), constituting the organellar arm of ubiquinol regeneration. The two enzymes divide ferroptosis defense by compartment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體 DHODH 與質膜 FSP1 平行還原 CoQ10（Mao 2021），構成 ubiquinol 再生的胞器臂。兩酶按區室分工鐵死亡防禦。

nodes.label: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
nodes.description: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma is a subtype of Renal Cell Carcinoma whose reprogrammed redox metabolism makes it exquisitely dependent on Glutathione and the GPX4 antioxidant axis to prevent Lipid Peroxidation and death. Inhibiting Glutathione synthesis collapses this defence and induces Ferroptosis with tumour growth suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma 是 Renal Cell Carcinoma 的一個亞型，其重編程的氧化還原代謝使它極度依賴 Glutathione 與 GPX4 抗氧化軸來防止 Lipid Peroxidation 與細胞死亡。抑制 Glutamine 合成會瓦解此防禦並誘發 Ferroptosis，同時抑制腫瘤生長。

nodes.label: Mitotane
nodes.description: Mitotane (o,p'-DDD; Lysodren) is the adrenolytic agent used in Adrenocortical carcinomas as adjuvant therapy after resection and for advanced disease; it accumulates in adrenocortical tissue, damaging mitochondria, inhibiting steroidogenesis via CYP11A1/CYP11B1 and killing tumour cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitotane（o,p'-DDD；Lysodren）是治療 Adrenocortical carcinomas 的腎上腺皮質溶解劑，作為切除後的輔助療法與晚期疾病用藥；它累積於腎上腺皮質組織，損傷粒線體、經 CYP11A1/CYP11B1 抑制類固醇生成並殺傷腫瘤細胞。

nodes.label: Stem Cell Exhaustion
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues. mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability, reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output. Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues。mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability，reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output。Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial enzyme
nodes.description: Glutaminase (GLS) is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the committed first step of glutaminolysis. Both major isoforms (GLS1 and GLS2) require oligomerization for catalytic activity and are localized to the mitochondria. By linking amino acid catabolism to the TCA cycle and redox balance, glutaminase sits at the hub of cellular metabolism. Its mitochondrial localization is central to its role in fueling proliferating cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminase（GLS）是一種粒線體基質酵素，催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，是麩醯胺分解的代謝第一步。兩種主要同型異構物（GLS1 和 GLS2）都需要寡聚化才具有催化活性，並定位於粒線體。透過將胺基酸分解代謝與 TCA 循環和氧化還原平衡連結，glutaminase 位居細胞代謝的核心。其粒線體定位對其供給增殖細胞的角色至關重要。

nodes.label: Glutamine deamidation
nodes.description: Glutaminase catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the rate-limiting first step of glutaminolysis. The glutamate produced is further transaminated to alpha-ketoglutarate, replenishing TCA-cycle intermediates (anaplerosis). This reaction is essential for glutamine-dependent cancers, which rely on glutamine as a major carbon and nitrogen source. The enzyme's activity is allosterically activated by inorganic phosphate and by its product glutamate at high concentrations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，這是麩醯胺分解的限速第一步。所產生的麩胺酸進一步轉胺為 alpha-ketoglutarate，補充 TCA 循環中間物（anaplerosis）。此反應對依賴麩醯胺的癌症至關重要，因為它們以麩醯胺作為主要碳源和氮源。此酵素活性受無機磷酸以及高濃度產物麩胺酸的異位性活化。

nodes.label: Oxidative Stress buffering
nodes.description: Glutaminase-derived glutamate can be converted to glutathione, a key antioxidant that buffers reactive oxygen species and supports redox balance. Through this route, glutaminolysis ties into oxidative stress defense and cellular resilience. The glutamate also feeds NADPH production via malic enzyme, contributing to redox homeostasis. This antioxidant dimension links glutamine metabolism to protection against oxidative damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 衍生的麩胺酸可轉化為麩胱甘肽，一種緩衝活性氧並支持氧化還原平衡的關鍵抗氧化劑。透過此途徑，麩醯胺分解與氧化壓力防禦和細胞韌性相連。麩胺酸也經由蘋果酸酶供應 NADPH 生產，貢獻於氧化還原恆定性。此抗氧化面向將麩醯胺代謝與對抗氧化損傷的保護連結起來。

nodes.label: Ammonium
nodes.description: The deamination of glutamine by glutaminase releases ammonium, which raises cytosolic pH and acts as a signaling molecule. This ammonia signal induces cytoprotective autophagy as a response to nutrient and therapeutic stress. The ammonia-autophagy axis highlights glutaminase as a bridge between nutrient sensing and cellular resilience. Ammonium production thereby couples glutamine catabolism to the stress-response program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 對麩醯胺酸的去胺化釋放銨，它提高細胞質 pH 並作為訊號分子。此氨訊號誘導保護性自噬，作為對營養和治療壓力的反應。氨—自噬軸凸顯 glutaminase 作為營養感知與細胞韌性之間的橋樑。因此銨的產生將麩醯胺分解代謝耦合到壓力反應程序。

nodes.label: GLS1 and GLS2
nodes.description: Two major glutaminase isoforms exist: kidney-type GLS1 (encoded by GLS, with alternatively spliced variants KGA and GAC) and liver-type GLS2 (encoded by GLS2). GLS1 is the predominant isoform in most proliferating cells and is allosterically activated by phosphate and glutamate. The tumor suppressor p53 transcriptionally induces GLS2. Both isoforms are mitochondrial matrix enzymes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 存在兩種主要的 glutaminase 同型異構物：腎型 GLS1（由 GLS 編碼，具選擇性剪接變異 KGA 和 GAC）和肝型 GLS2（由 GLS2 編碼）。GLS1 是大多數增殖細胞中的主要同型異構物，受磷酸和麩胺酸異位性活化。腫瘤抑制因子 p53 轉錄誘導 GLS2。兩種同型異構物都是粒線體基質酵素。

nodes.label: Haloperidol
nodes.description: Haloperidol is metabolically converted into the pyridinium neurotoxin HPP+, a charged MPP+ analog taken up by dopaminergic neurons where it inhibits mitochondrial complex I. This conversion underlies haloperidol-associated parkinsonism, which mimics but is distinct from Parkinson's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Haloperidol 在代謝上轉化為吡啶鎓神經毒素 HPP+，一種帶電荷的 MPP+ 類似物，被多巴胺神經元攝取並抑制粒線體複合體 I。此轉化是 haloperidol 相關帕金森症的基礎，其模仿但不同於 Parkinson's Disease。

nodes.label: SIRT3 for osteoprotection
nodes.description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

nodes.label: SIRT1/PGC-1α
nodes.description: SIRT1 activates PGC-1α, which co-activates the BDNF promoter, linking mitochondrial biogenesis to neurotrophic support. Directionally, SIRT1/PGC-1α sits upstream of BDNF transcription. This couples energy metabolism to neuronal growth-factor expression, and it reinforces the metabolic-neurotrophic axis of SIRT1. By coordinating the activation of PGC-1α and the expression of BDNF, SIRT1 links mitochondrial function to neuronal survival and plasticity. This connection helps explain how sirtuin activation and caloric restriction benefit brain health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 活化 PGC-1α，後者共同活化 BDNF 啟動子，將粒線體生物合成與神經營養支持聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT1/PGC-1α 位於 BDNF 轉錄的上游。這將能量代謝與神經元生長因子表達偶聯，強化了 SIRT1 的代謝-神經營養軸線。透過協調 PGC-1α 的活化和 BDNF 的表達，SIRT1 將粒線體功能與神經元存活和可塑性聯繫起來。此聯繫有助於解釋 sirtuin 活化和限制熱量如何有益於大腦健康。

nodes.label: TrkB
nodes.description: BDNF signals primarily through the receptor tyrosine kinase TrkB, triggering phosphorylation cascades including MAPK/ERK, PI3K-Akt, and PLCgamma. These pathways converge on transcription factors such as CREB, strengthening excitatory synapses, facilitating long-term potentiation, and supporting adult hippocampal neurogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BDNF 主要透過受體酪胺酸激酶 TrkB 傳遞信號，觸發包括 MAPK/ERK、PI3K–Akt 和 PLCγ 的磷酸化級聯。這些途徑匯聚於 CREB 等轉錄因子，強化興奮性突觸、促進長期增強，並支持成體海馬神經新生。

nodes.label: AMT-130
nodes.description: AMT-130 is a one-time AAV5-microRNA gene therapy delivered by MRI-guided convection-enhanced infusion into the striatum to silence mutant huntingtin (HTT); its pivotal Phase I/II result showed 75% slowing of cUHDRS decline at 36 months (p=0.003) — the first disease-slowing HD therapy (uniQure, Sep 2025).
nodes.description_zh_TW: AMT-130 是單次 AAV5-microRNA 基因治療，經 MRI 引導對流增強灌注注入紋狀體以沉默突變 huntingtin（HTT）；其關鍵 Phase I/II 結果在 36 個月時顯示 cUHDRS 衰退速度減緩 75%（p=0.003）——第一個減緩 HD 病程的療法（uniQure, Sep 2025）。

nodes.label: PKA-CREB-BDNF Signaling
nodes.description: In Abeta-induced AD rats with impaired hippocampal PKA-CREB-BDNF signaling, both intermittent fasting and exercise raised circulating beta-hydroxybutyrate, with the largest elevation in the combined fasted-exercise group. The beta-hydroxybutyrate surge paralleled the strongest rescue of PKA-CREB-BDNF activity and cognition, framing metabolic-neurotrophic coupling as a mediator of fasting-plus-exercise synergy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在海馬 PKA-CREB-BDNF 訊號受損的 Abeta 誘發 AD 大鼠中，間歇性禁食與運動均提升循環 Beta-hydroxybutyrate，其中禁食合併運動組升幅最大。此 βHB 上升與 PKA-CREB-BDNF 活性及認知的最強挽救平行，顯示代謝-神經營養耦合是禁食加運動協同效應的媒介。

nodes.label: High-Intensity Exercise
nodes.description: In dose-response comparisons across low, moderate, and high exercise intensities, all intensities improved cognition and motor outcomes, but high-intensity exercise produced the greatest BDNF upregulation alongside the strongest behavioral gains. This intensity-dependent neurotrophic response supports prescribing higher-intensity modalities such as HIIT when tolerated to maximize BDNF-TrkB signaling in neurodegenerative models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在低、中、高運動強度的劑量反應比較中，所有強度均改善認知與運動結果，但 High-Intensity Exercise 產生最大的 BDNF 上調並伴隨最強的行為改善。此強度依賴的神經營養反應支持在可耐受時優先採用 HIIT 等高強度模式，以最大化神經退化模型中的 BDNF-TrkB 訊號。

nodes.label: SIRT7 at target gene promoters
nodes.description: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: RAF1
nodes.description: Active Ras-recruited RAF1 phosphorylates MEK1/2, relaying Ras signals through the MAPK/ERK cascade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 被 Ras 招募激活的 RAF1 磷酸化 MEK1/2，經 MAPK/ERK 級聯傳遞 Ras 訊號。

nodes.label: TAFI68
nodes.description: SIRT1 can localize to the nucleolus and modulate Pol I transcription through deacetylation of TAFI68 (TAF1B), a Pol I-specific transcription factor. Counterintuitively, SIRT1 deacetylation of TAFI68 reduces its rDNA binding and represses Pol I — a restraint against unrestrained growth, opposing SIRT7.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 可定位至核仁，透過去乙醯化 Pol I 專一性轉錄因子 TAFI68（TAF1B）來調節 Pol I 轉錄。出人意料地，SIRT1 對 TAFI68 的去乙醯化會降低其與 rDNA 的結合並抑制 Pol I，形成對不受限制生長的牽制，與 SIRT7 作用相反。

nodes.label: XPA
nodes.description: XPA is a central factor of the nucleotide excision repair pathway: it recognizes and verifies bulky DNA lesions such as UV-induced photoproducts, nucleates assembly of the repair complex, and is required for both global-genome and transcription-coupled repair; XPA mutations cause xeroderma pigmentosum.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XPA 是核苷酸切除修復途徑的核心因子：它辨識並驗證 UV 誘發光產物等 bulky DNA 損傷，啟動修復複合體的組裝，且為全基因組修復與轉錄耦聯修復所必需；XPA 突變會造成著色性乾皮症。

nodes.label: Ku70
nodes.description: SIRT3 activates Ku70 via deacetylation, enhancing mitochondrial oxidative metabolism, ROS management, and ATP production (Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 Ku70，增強粒線體氧化代謝、ROS 管理和 ATP 產生（Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531）。

nodes.label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration
nodes.description: SIRT3 expression is significantly reduced in degenerated intervertebral discs, and its knockdown further exacerbates deterioration of nucleus pulposus cells under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis, while SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo, and hydrogel microspheres upregulating both SIRT3 and SOD2 maintain NPC viability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 表現在退化的椎間盤中顯著降低，其進一步敲減在氧化壓力下加劇髓核細胞的退化。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，而 SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度，同時上調 SIRT3 和 SOD2 的水凝膠微球維護 NPC 存活率。

nodes.label: NADP+
nodes.description: The Pentose Phosphate Pathway reduces NADP+ to NADPH. This oxidative branch is the main source of cellular reducing power; NADPH then regenerates reduced Glutathione and drives reductive biosynthesis, so the pathway sits upstream of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pentose Phosphate Pathway 將 NADP+ 還原成 NADPH。這條氧化支路是細胞還原力的主要來源；所產生的 NADPH 接著再生還原態的 Glutathione 並驅動還原性生合成，因此該路徑位於穀胱甘肽依賴型抗氧化防禦的上游。

nodes.label: Pyrraline
nodes.description: Pyrraline is an advanced glycation end product formed by reaction of glucose with lysine residues in proteins; it is abundant in heat-processed foods such as pretzel sticks and is absorbed in the intestine via transporters such as hPEPT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pyrraline 是由 [[Glucose]] 與蛋白質中 [[Lysine]] 殘基反應形成的晚期糖基化終產物；它富含於烘焙加工食品（如 pretzel sticks），並經由 [[hPEPT1]] 等轉運蛋白在小腸被吸收。

nodes.label: Lipase inhibitor
nodes.description: Lipase inhibitors suppress pancreatic and gastric lipases that hydrolyze dietary triglycerides, blocking fat digestion and lowering caloric uptake. Because lipophilic advanced glycation end products and their precursors co-travel with dietary fat, inhibiting lipase limits their micellar solubilization and intestinal uptake, lowering systemic AGE burden - a mechanistic link between fat digestion and the glycation axis of vascular and metabolic aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lipase inhibitor 抑制分解飲食三酸甘油酯的胰臟與胃脂肪酶，阻斷脂肪消化並降低熱量攝取。由於親脂性的 advanced glycation end products 及其前驅物與飲食脂肪共運送，抑制脂肪酶會限制其微膠粒溶解與腸道吸收，降低全身 AGE 負載——這是脂肪消化與血管及代謝性老化之醣化軸之間的機轉連結。

nodes.label: hPEPT1
nodes.description: Because hPEPT1 carries certain advanced glycation end products as well as ordinary peptides, intestinal uptake of dietary AGEs is partly carrier-mediated. The absorption mechanism for the full range of AGEs remains incompletely characterized, making this transporter a focus for studies of dietary AGE burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 hPEPT1 除了運送一般胜肽外也運送某些 Advanced Glycation End Products，飲食性 AGE 的腸道吸收部分是載體介導的。各種 AGE 的吸收機制目前仍未完全釐清，因此此轉運蛋白是研究飲食 AGE 負擔的焦點。

nodes.label: Antagomirs
nodes.description: Antagomirs are chemically engineered oligonucleotides that silence endogenous microRNAs. They bind complementary mature microRNA sequences, forming a duplex that sequesters the microRNA from its native mRNA targets and prevents RISC loading, thereby derepressing translation of the microRNA's target genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antagomirs 是經化學工程設計、能沉默內源性 microRNA 的寡核苷酸。它們與互補的成熟 microRNA 序列結合形成雙股體，將該 microRNA 從其原生 mRNA 受質中隔離，並阻止 RISC 装载，進而解除對該 microRNA 標的基因轉譯的抑制。

nodes.label: MICU2
nodes.description: By stabilizing the closed state of the uniporter, MICU2 protects the matrix from Ca2+ overload that would otherwise promote mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, ROS amplification, and apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過穩定單向轉運體的關閉狀態，MICU2 保護基質免受會促成粒線體通透性轉換孔道開啟、ROS 放大與細胞凋亡的 Ca2+ 超載。

nodes.label: Ryanodine Receptor
nodes.description: Chronic ryanodine receptor leak elevates cytosolic Ca2+ and can drive mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. RyR thus sits upstream of mitochondrial calcium and redox balance linking to MPTP-mediated cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性 ryanodine 受體滲漏升高細胞質 Ca2+，可驅動粒線體 Ca2+ 超載與粒線體通透性轉換孔道開啟。因此 RyR 位於粒線體鈣與氧化還原平衡的上游，與 MPTP 介導的細胞死亡相連結。

nodes.label: Cytokines
nodes.description: In the parkinsonian brain, activated microglia release pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 that exacerbate oxidative stress and alpha-synuclein aggregation. Cytokine networks integrate the immune axis with oxidative, lysosomal, and proteostatic hypotheses of parkinsonism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在帕金森腦中，活化的微膠質細胞釋放 TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，加劇氧化壓力與 alpha-synuclein 聚集。細胞激素網路將免疫軸與帕金森症的氧化、溶酶體及蛋白質恆定假說整合。

nodes.label: Adaptive Immune System
nodes.description: B Cells are bone marrow–derived adaptive immune lymphocytes that differentiate into antibody-secreting plasma cells on antigen encounter, forming the humoral arm of the Adaptive Immune System alongside T Lymphocyte-mediated cellular immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B Cells 是源自骨髓的適應性免疫淋巴球，在遇到抗原後分化為分泌抗體的漿細胞，與 T Lymphocyte 所介導的細胞免疫共同構成 Adaptive Immune System 的體液免疫臂。

nodes.label: Dorsal Root Ganglion
nodes.description: The Dorsal Root Ganglion (DRG) is a collection of sensory neuron cell bodies along the spinal dorsal roots. Its neurons, including Nociceptors, transmit somatosensory and pain information from the periphery to the central nervous system and are a primary site of pathological change in peripheral neuropathies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dorsal Root Ganglion（DRG）是沿脊神經背根排列的感覺神經元細胞體集合體。其神經元（包含 Nociceptor）將體感與痛覺資訊由周邊傳至中樞神經系統，也是周邊神經病變中主要的病理變化部位。

nodes.label: sjTREC
nodes.description: The single joint T cell receptor excision circle is generated during TCR alpha-chain gene rearrangement, when the TCR delta locus is excised and the discarded DNA forms a stable episomal circle. It is therefore a direct molecular readout of T Cell Receptor rearrangement taking place in the Thymus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 單一接合型 T 細胞受體切除環（sjTREC）是在 TCR α 鏈基因重組過程中產生的：TCR δ 座被切除後，被捨去的 DNA 形成穩定的附著體環狀分子。因此它是 Thymus 中進行 T Cell Receptor 重組的直接分子讀值。

nodes.label: MAD2
nodes.description: Mad2 inhibits APC/C-CDC20 at unattached kinetochores until biorientation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mad2 在未附著動點抑制 APC/C-CDC20 直到雙定向。

nodes.label: muscle protein synthesis
nodes.description: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

nodes.label: Rictor
nodes.description: mSIN1 binds Rictor, and this interaction stabilizes the mTORC2 assembly that defines the complex. Because the Rictor-mSIN1 module is unique to mTORC2 and absent from mTORC1, this binding is what allows the two complexes to signal to different substrates despite sharing mTOR itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mSIN1 與 Rictor 結合，此交互作用穩定了定義 mTORC2 的組裝。由於 Rictor-mSIN1 模組為 mTORC2 專有、mTORC1 所無，這個結合讓兩種複合體得以在共用 mTOR 的情況下向不同受體傳遞訊號。

nodes.label: mSIN1
nodes.description: mSIN1 (MAPKAP1) is an essential component of mTORC2, one of six proteins in the complex, and it maintains complex integrity so that mTORC2 can function as a kinase rather than dissociate. mTORC2 also contains mTOR, Rictor, Protor-1, mLST8 and Deptor, several of which are shared with mTORC1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mSIN1（MAPKAP1）是 mTORC2 的必需成分，該複合體共含六種蛋白質；它維持複合體完整性，使 mTORC2 得以作為激酶發揮功能而不解離。mTORC2 還包含 mTOR、Rictor、Protor-1、mLST8 與 Deptor，其中數個也與 mTORC1 共用。

nodes.label: AGER1
nodes.description: AGER1 is a cell surface receptor that facilitates uptake and degradation of advanced glycation end products. Together with glyoxalase I, glyoxalase II and carbonyl reductase, it forms part of a detoxification and counterregulation system against the pro-oxidant effects of glycation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGER1 是細胞表面受體，促進 Advanced Glycation End Products 的攝取與降解。它與 glyoxalase I、glyoxalase II 及 carbonyl reductase 一起，構成對抗 glycation 促氧化效應的解毒與反向調節系統。

nodes.label: Hyperfunction Theory of Aging
nodes.description: The hyperfunction theory of Aging (Blagosklonny) proposes that aging is the quasi-programmed, maladaptive continuation of developmental growth programs, with the nutrient/growth-sensing mTOR pathway as the master driver. When the cell cycle is blocked, mTOR-driven signals are re-routed into hypertrophic, hypersecretory 'twisted growth' (geroconversion) such as the SASP — the cellular substrate of aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高功能老化理論（Blagosklonny）主張，老化是發育生長程式的準程序性、适应不良性延續，而營養／生長感知的 mTOR 訊號路徑是主要驅動因子。當細胞週期被阻斷時，mTOR 驅動的訊號被改道至肥大、過度分泌的「扭曲生長」（geroconversion），例如 SASP，即為老化的細胞層次基礎。

nodes.label: Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease
nodes.description: Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease (MMVD) is characterized by a senescent phenotype in activated valve interstitial cells. Senescent aVICs show impaired autophagic flux with immature autophagosomes, and the resulting CDKN2A/p16 and CDKN1A/p21 burden drives SASP secretion, so targeting the senescence axis is a disease-modifying strategy rather than mere cytprotection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease (MMVD) 的特徵是活化的瓣膜間質細胞呈現 senescent 表型。senescent aVIC 的 autophagic flux 受損並出現未成熟 autophagosome，隨後 CDKN2A/p16 與 CDKN1A/p21 的累積驅動 SASP 分泌，因此以 senescence 軸為標的是一種疾病修正策略，而不只是細胞保護。

nodes.label: Vascular Dementia
nodes.description: Vascular dementia describes impaired reasoning, planning, judgment, and memory caused by brain damage from reduced cerebral blood flow. It is associated with the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products, which contribute to microvascular and macrovascular damage, arterial stiffening, and vascular stiffening characteristic of the condition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vascular Dementia 描述因腦血流受損而造成推理、計畫、判斷與記憶等思考過程障礙。它與 Advanced Glycation End Products 的累積相關聯，後者促成該疾病特徵性的微血管與大血管損傷、主動脈僵硬與血管硬化。

nodes.label: H3K4me1
nodes.description: H3K4me1 decorates de novo activated enhancers and super-enhancers that drive SASP expression in senescence. These H3K4me1-marked enhancers engage SASP promoters through enhancer-promoter looping within TADs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3K4me1 裝飾在衰老中驅動 SASP 表現的新活化增強子與超級增強子。這些 H3K4me1 標記的增強子透過 TAD 內的增強子-啟動子環化與 SASP 啟動子接合。

nodes.label: H4K5ac
nodes.description: H4K5ac is an early-acetylated H4 tail residue associated with active chromatin and is one of the acetyl marks enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. It contributes to the open enhancer state that activates SASP promoters via enhancer-promoter looping.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H4K5ac 是與活性染色質相關的 H4 尾部早期乙醯化殘基，是衰老活化超級增強子富集的乙醯標記之一。它促成透過增強子-啟動子環化活化 SASP 啟動子的開放增強子狀態。

nodes.label: Diabetic Neuropathy
nodes.description: Diabetic neuropathy (DN) is the most prevalent complication of diabetes, affecting at least half of diabetics over time. It is a progressive disorder of peripheral nerves caused by chronic hyperglycemia, with sensory loss, neuropathic pain, and autonomic dysfunction, and it involves hyperglycemia-driven metabolic dysregulation, Oxidative Stress, advanced glycation, impaired neurotrophin signalling, and neuronal mitochondrial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diabetic neuropathy（DN）是糖尿病最常見的併發症，長期下來影響至少半數糖尿病患。它是由慢性高血糖引起的進行性周邊神經疾病，表現為感覺喪失、神經病痛與自主神經功能障礙，並涉及高血糖驅動的代謝失調、Oxidative Stress、advanced glycation、神經營養因子訊號受損與神經元粒線體功能障礙。

nodes.label: IC50
nodes.description: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

nodes.label: Ischemic Preconditioning
nodes.description: Preconditioning and postconditioning are described as clinical manifestations of hormesis, where a low-dose homologous or heterologous stimulus builds a biological protective barrier. Ischemic preconditioning reduces myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, and cerebral preconditioning or transient ischemic attacks induce tolerance that lessens subsequent stroke severity. Postconditioning applies a low-dose stimulus after a high-dose insult within a time window.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Preconditioning 與 postconditioning 被描述為 Hormesis 的臨床表現形式，即以低劑量同源或異源刺激建立生物保護屏障。Ischemic Preconditioning 可減輕心肌缺血再灌流損傷，而腦部 preconditioning 或短暫性腦缺血發作可誘發耐受性並減輕後續中風嚴重度。Postconditioning 則是在高劑量損傷後的時間窗內施加低劑量刺激。

nodes.label: Mithridates VI
nodes.description: Mithridates VI of Pontus reportedly ingested gradually increasing sub-lethal doses of toxins (Mithridatism) to render himself immune to lethal poisons. The practice is the archetypal historical anecdote behind hormesis — that low doses of a stressor induce adaptive protective responses whereas high doses are harmful — and modern mitohormesis formalises the same intuition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 本都斯國的 Mithridates VI 據稱以漸增的次致死性毒物劑量（Mithridatism）攝入，使自己對致死毒物免疫。此一做法是 hormesis（低劑量壓力可誘發適應性保護反應，而高劑量有害）的歷史典範，現代 mitohormesis 則將同一 直覺加以形式化。

nodes.label: Mithridatism
nodes.description: Mithridatism, the practice of progressive poison exposure named after Mithridates VI, seeded enduring concepts in toxicology, tolerance and preconditioning. His fabled universal antidote, the Antidotum Mithridaticum, blended dozens of botanical and animal substances and influenced antidotal medicine for centuries, though his actual immunity remains debated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 以 Mithridates VI 命名的漸進毒物暴露做法 Mithridatism，為毒理學、耐受與預置化奠下長久概念。他傳說中的通用解毒劑 Antidotum Mithridaticum 混合了數十種植物與動物成分，數世紀來影響了解毒醫學，但其真實的耐毒能力仍有爭議。

nodes.label: UGA codon
nodes.description: SECISBP2 (SBP2) is the RNA-binding protein that recognizes the SECIS stem-loop in the 3′UTR of selenoprotein mRNAs. Upon ribosome encounter of an in-frame UGA, SECISBP2 binds the SECIS element and contacts 40S protein RPS27A/eS31 to prevent premature termination, then recruits the Sec-specific elongation factor eEFSec with tRNA[Ser]Sec and GTP to deliver selenocysteine to the ribosomal A site. It thereby reassigns UGA from a stop codon to a Sec codon.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SECISBP2（SBP2）是辨識 selenoprotein mRNA 3′UTR 中 SECIS 莖環結構的 RNA 結合蛋白。當核糖體遇到同讀框的 UGA 時，SECISBP2 結合 SECIS 元素並與 40S 蛋白 RPS27A／eS31 接觸以避免提早終止，隨後招募 Sec 專一性延長因子 eEFSec 與 tRNA[Ser]Sec 及 GTP，將 selenocysteine 送入核糖體 A 位。SECISBP2 因此將 UGA 由終止密碼子重新指定為 Sec 密碼子。

nodes.label: Um34
nodes.description: FTSJ1 is the methyltransferase that installs the Um34 2′-O-methyluridine modification on tRNA[Ser]Sec. Loss of Um34 causes ribosomal stalling at the recoded UGA codon and reduced selenocysteine insertion, selectively impairing antioxidant selenoproteins — and, per the melanoma metastasis work, Um34 is necessary for metastatic colonization.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FTSJ1 是將 Um34（2′-O-甲基尿苷）修飾安裝到 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上的甲基轉移酶。Um34 缺失會造成核糖體在 recoded UGA codon 停滯、Selenocysteine 掺入減少，選擇性損害具抗氧化功能的 selenoprotein——而依黑色素瘤轉移研究，Um34 對轉移性定殖是必要的。

nodes.label: Eosinophil Peroxidase
nodes.description: Eosinophil Peroxidase is the phagocyte enzyme that generates Hypobromous Acid: a cationic heme peroxidase of eosinophil specific granules that uses bromide together with Hydrogen Peroxide as co-substrate to oxidize halides into reactive brominating oxidants. The HOBr it produces brominates protein tyrosine residues, yielding bromotyrosine adducts that serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage in allergic airway disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Eosinophil Peroxidase 是產生 Hypobromous Acid 的吞噬細胞酵素：它是嗜酸性球特異顆粒中的陽離性含血基質過氧化酵素，以 bromide 與 Hydrogen Peroxide 為共同受質，將鹵離子氧化成具反應性的溴化氧化劑。其產生的 HOBr 會溴化蛋白質的 tyrosine 殘基，形成 bromotyrosine 加合物，可作為過敏性氣道疾病中嗜酸性球介導氧化損傷的特異性標記。

nodes.label: AGE-modified proteins
nodes.description: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

nodes.label: Sanglifehrin A
nodes.description: Sanglifehrin A (SfA) blocks MPT; combination of Nec-1 + SfA gave significantly stronger protection in ischemia-reperfusion injury than either monotherapy, confirming MPT and necroptosis as independent programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sanglifehrin A（SfA）阻斷 MPT；在缺血–再灌注損傷中 Nec-1 與 SfA 併用較任何單一療法提供顯著更強之保護，證實 MPT 與 necroptosis 為獨立程序。

nodes.label: oncosis
nodes.description: ATP-starved failure of the Sodium-Potassium ATPase pump is the initiating step of the necrotic cascade in ischemia: oncotic swelling is followed by Ca2+ overload, mPTP opening and membrane rupture.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATP 飢餓導致鈉鉀幫浦失效，是缺血壞死級聯的起始步驟：膨脹性腫脹之後依序發生 Ca2+ 超載、mPTP 開啟與細胞膜破裂。

nodes.label: Dopamine hypothesis
nodes.description: Although it stimulated significant research into catecholamine metabolism, the Adrenochrome Hypothesis was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia, which implicated hyperactive dopaminergic transmission in mesolimbic pathways and later accumulated robust empirical support.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 儘管它激發了大量 Catecholamines 代謝研究，Adrenochrome Hypothesis 仍大致被 Schizophrenia 的 Dopamine hypothesis 取代；後者指出 mesolimbic 路徑的過度多巴胺胺能傳遞，並獲得穩固的實證支持。

nodes.label: Abram Hoffer
nodes.description: Canadian psychiatrist and biochemist Abram Hoffer, with Humphry Osmond, co-proposed the Adrenochrome Hypothesis in a series of papers beginning in the 1950s. Hoffer's own niacin trials in schizophrenia followed from the hypothesis and were later not confirmed by independent multicenter replication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 加拿大精神科醫師與生化學家 Abram Hoffer 與 Humphry Osmond 自 1950 年代起在一系列論文中共同提出 Adrenochrome Hypothesis。Hoffer 針對 Schizophrenia 所做的 niacin 試驗源自此假說，但後續獨立多中心重複研究未能確認其結果。

nodes.label: HDAC6
nodes.description: By deacetylating MFN1, HDAC6 promotes mitochondrial fusion under glucose deprivation, coupling metabolic state to organelle morphology. This illustrates how post-translational modification of fusion factors integrates starvation stress signals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC6 藉由將 MFN1 去乙醯化，在葡萄糖缺乏時促進 mitochondrial fusion，將代謝狀態與胞器形態耦合。這說明 fusion 因子的 post-translational modification 如何整合飢餓壓力訊號。

nodes.label: Mgm1
nodes.description: Mgm1 is essential for mitochondrial fusion, acting at the inner mitochondrial membrane to mediate inner-membrane fusion and maintain cristae architecture; the Mgm1-OPA1 axis is conserved from yeast to humans, reflecting the ancient endosymbiotic origin of mitochondria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mgm1 對粒線體融合不可或缺，它作用於粒線體內膜以促成內膜融合並維持 cristae 結構；Mgm1-OPA1 軸從酵母到人類皆高度保守，反映粒線體古老的 endosymbiosis 起源。

nodes.label: YME1L
nodes.description: Loss of YME1L shifts OPA1 toward long forms and disrupts fusion, compromising mitochondrial integrity and linking protease activity directly to optic neuropathies such as Dominant Optic Atrophy. Because inner-membrane fusion requires the S-OPA1/L-OPA1 cooperative pair, YME1L is a proteolytic gatekeeper of the mitochondrial fusion balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: YME1L 喪失會使 OPA1 偏向長型並破壞融合，危及 mitochondrial integrity，並將蛋白酶活性直接與 Dominant Optic Atrophy 等視神經病變相連結。由於粒線體內膜融合需要 S-OPA1 與 L-OPA1 的協同配對，YME1L 是粒線體融合平衡的蛋白水解守門者。

nodes.label: GTP
nodes.description: GTP is a direct nucleotidyltransferase substrate of cGAS: upon binding dsDNA, cGAS condenses one ATP and one GTP into 2'3'-cGAMP through a GTP-derived GMP moiety ligated to an ATP-derived AMP moiety. Because both nucleotides are consumed stoichiometrically, local GTP concentrations gate the rate of cGAMP production and therefore the magnitude of cGAS-STING signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GTP 是 cGAS 的直接核苷酸轉移酶受質：cGAS 結合 dsDNA 後，會將一分子 ATP 與一分子 GTP 縮合形成 2'3'-cGAMP，其中 GMP 部分源自 GTP，AMP 部分源自 ATP。由於兩種核苷酸都以化學計量方式被消耗，局部 GTP 濃度會限制 cGAMP 的生成速率，進而決定 cGAS-STING 訊號的強度。

nodes.label: CD94
nodes.description: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer on NK and CD8 T cells, contacting both subunits with NKG2A conferring specificity. Engagement delivers an inhibitory signal that blunts cytotoxic clearance of senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是 NK 與 CD8 T 細胞上抑制性 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體，接觸兩個次單元並由 NKG2A 賦予特異性。結合傳遞抑制訊號，減弱對衰老細胞的細胞毒性清除。

nodes.label: MHC Class Ib
nodes.description: HLA-E is the canonical non-classical MHC class Ib molecule. Unlike the highly polymorphic classical class Ia molecules HLA-A, -B and -C, class Ib molecules such as HLA-E, -F and -G are oligomorphic, present a restricted set of peptides - often leader peptides derived from other MHC class I molecules - and engage innate lymphoid receptors rather than conventional αβ T-cell receptors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是典型的非典型 MHC class Ib 分子。與高度多型性的典型 class Ia 分子 HLA-A、-B、-C 不同，class Ib 分子（如 HLA-E、-F、-G）為寡型性，呈現受限的胜肽集合（常為來自其他 MHC class I 分子的 leader peptide），並與先天淋巴球受體而非典型 αβ T 細胞受體作用。

nodes.label: Microautophagy
nodes.description: Microautophagy is a type of Autophagy in which cytoplasmic components are directly engulfed by the lysosomal or vacuolar membrane via membrane invagination, without autophagosome formation. Unlike Macroautophagy it is generally considered nonselective, though selective forms exist, and it maintains organelle size and membrane homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Microautophagy 是 Autophagy 的一種類型，細胞質成分透過膜內陷直接被溶酶體或液泡膜吞入，不經由 autophagosome 形成。與 Macroautophagy 不同，它一般被視為非選擇性（但也有選擇性形式），並參與維持胞器大小與膜恆定。

nodes.label: Glycemic Control
nodes.description: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。

nodes.label: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
nodes.description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

nodes.label: Fat-Free Mass
nodes.description: Across and within individuals, resting metabolic rate (RMR) is most strongly predicted by fat free mass (FFM), which typically accounts for roughly 60-80 percent of the variance in RMR. Larger organs such as liver, brain, heart, and kidneys are metabolically expensive, so differences in lean mass drive most of the between-individual variation in RMR. Within a single individual, day-to-day variability of RMR is small, and the residual variability not explained by FFM includes fat mass, age, thyroid status, and ambient temperature. Because lean tissue is the primary metabolic driver, changes in muscle mass through training can modestly raise RMR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在個體之間和內部，靜息代謝率（RMR）最強烈地由去脂體重（FFM）預測，FFM通常佔RMR變異的大約60-80%。較大的器官如肝臟、大腦、心臟和腎臟在代謝上成本高昂，因此瘦體重的差異驅動了個體之間RMR的大部分變化。在單個個體內部，RMR的日常變異性很小，FFM未解釋的殘餘變異性包括脂肪質量、年齡、甲狀腺狀態和環境溫度。由於瘦組織是主要的代謝驅動因素，通過訓練改變肌肉質量可以適度提高RMR。

nodes.label: CtIP
nodes.description: CtIP is the nuclear factor required for 5'-3' end resection of DNA double-strand breaks, the rate-limiting step that commits a cell to homologous recombination repair. Through this resection activity CtIP supports DNA repair and suppresses chromosomal instability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CtIP 是 DNA 雙股斷裂 5'-3' 端切除所需的核因子，此步驟是將細胞導向同源重組修復的限速步驟。透過此切除活性，CtIP 支持 DNA Repair 並抑制染色體不穩定。

nodes.label: Synthetic Lethality
nodes.description: The classical application of Synthetic Lethality is BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation combined with PARP1 inhibition: BRCA-mutant cancers are defective in homologous recombination repair and become dependent on the backup pathway, so PARP inhibitors such as olaparib and niraparib selectively kill them. Normal cells retaining both pathways survive the single inhibition, providing the therapeutic window that makes Synthetic Lethality a cornerstone of precision cancer therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Synthetic Lethality 的典型應用是 BRCA1/BRCA2 突變搭配 PARP1 抑制：BRCA 突變癌症的 homologous recombination 修復有缺陷，因而依賴備援路徑，使 olaparib、niraparib 等 PARP 抑制劑能選擇性殺傷它們。同時保有兩條路徑的正常細胞可在單一抑制下存活，這個治療窗使 Synthetic Lethality 成為 precision cancer therapy 的基石。

nodes.label: MBOAT2
nodes.description: Androgen receptor signaling drives MBOAT2 transcription, the male counterpart of the ER-to-MBOAT1 gate, conferring ferroptosis resistance through the same PE-MUFA remodeling logic.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Androgen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT2 轉錄，即 ER 至 MBOAT1 閘門的雄性對應物，透過相同的 PE-MUFA 重塑邏輯賦予 ferroptosis 抗性。

nodes.label: Brugia malayi
nodes.description: Brugia malayi is a filarial nematode and one of the three causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, alongside Wuchereria bancrofti and Brugia timori. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels and lymph nodes, viviparous females release sheathed microfilariae with nocturnal periodicity into the bloodstream, and chronic infection produces lymphangitis, lymphedema, elephantiasis and tropical pulmonary eosinophilia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brugia malayi 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia timori 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大致病原之一。成蟲寄生於淋巴管與淋巴結，胎生的雌蟲釋出具鞘微絲蟲並呈夜間週期性出現在血流中；慢性感染會造成淋巴管炎、淋巴水腫、象皮病與熱帶肺嗜酸性粒細胞症。

nodes.label: Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre
nodes.description: The Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre (OCRC) in Ghana operates under the Ghana Health Service and in collaboration with the World Health Organization TDR programme, conducting Phase I–IV trials of anti-filarial drugs. TDR also influences study protocol design and supports applied research at the centre, contributing to the global shift from onchocerciasis control toward elimination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 迦納的 Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre (OCRC) 隸屬 Ghana Health Service，並與 World Health Organization 的 TDR 計畫合作，進行抗絲蟲藥物的 Phase I–IV 試驗。TDR 亦影響試驗方案設計並支持該中心的應用研究，促成全球由 onchocerciasis 控制轉向根除的轉變。

nodes.label: Milbemycin Oxime
nodes.description: Milbemycin oxime is the ivermectin-equivalent backbone of monthly canine and feline heartworm preventives (Interceptor, Sentinel). Like ivermectin it potentiates invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels to cause sustained Cl- influx and flaccid paralysis of nematodes, and it is a P-gp substrate whose safety margin is set by efflux plus its lower potency at mammalian channels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Milbemycin oxime 是每月犬隻與貓 heartworm 預防藥（Interceptor、Sentinel）中與 ivermectin 等價的骨架成分。與 ivermectin 相同，它增強無脊椎動物的 glutamate-gated chloride channel，造成持續 Cl⁻ 流入與線蟲弛緩性麻痺；它也是 P-gp 底物，其安全邊際取決於 efflux 以及在哺乳類通道上較低的效價。

nodes.label: Rtg1
nodes.description: Rtg1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor of S. cerevisiae and, with its bHLH/leucine-zipper partner Rtg3, forms the DNA-binding engine of the yeast Retrograde Response. Under basal conditions the heterodimer is phosphorylated and sequestered in the cytoplasm by 14-3-3 proteins Bmh1/2 and the inhibitory protein Mks1p; mitochondrial dysfunction releases the retention signal so the dimer enters the nucleus and drives citrate–isocitrate shuttle genes (CIT2, ACO1, IDH1/2).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rtg1 是 *S. cerevisiae* 的 basic helix-loop-helix 轉錄因子，與其 bHLH／leucine-zipper 搭檔 Rtg3 共同構成酵母 Retrograde Response 的 DNA 結合引擎。在基礎狀態下，該異二聚體被磷酸化並由 14-3-3 蛋白 Bmh1/2 與抑制蛋白 Mks1p 扣留在細胞質；粒線體功能障礙會解除滞留訊號，使二聚體進入細胞核並啟動檸檬酸－異檸檬酸穿梭基因（CIT2、ACO1、IDH1/2）。

nodes.label: CpG Islands
nodes.description: Mitochondrial DNA retains unmethylated CpG islands that resemble bacterial DNA sequences. Because of this, mtDNA released into the cytosol or endosomes is read as a pathogen-associated molecular pattern, activating TLR9 and p38 MAPK/NF-κB signaling, and cGAS-STING to produce type I interferons and the SASP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體 DNA 保留了類似細菌 DNA 的未甲基化 CpG Islands。因此釋放至細胞質或內體的 mtDNA 會被視為病原相關分子模式，啟動 TLR9 與 p38 MAPK/NF-κB 訊號，以及 cGAS-STING 以產生第一型干擾素與 SASP。

nodes.label: JGB1741
nodes.description: JGB1741 is a small-molecule SIRT1 inhibitor developed on the sirtinol scaffold and identified through sirtuin fluorimetric activity (Fluor de Lys-style) screening. As a sirtinol analogue it is expected to block SIRT1 deacetylase activity, part of a modulator class that also includes salermide and cambinol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JGB1741 是以 sirtinol 骨架開發的小分子 SIRT1 抑制劑，透過 sirtuin 螢光活性（Fluor de Lys 型）篩檢所識別。作為 sirtinol 類似物，它預期可阻斷 SIRT1 的去乙醯化活性，屬於同一類修飾劑，成員還包括 salermide 與 cambinol。

nodes.label: Busulfan
nodes.description: Bifunctional busulfan forms guanine-N7 interstrand crosslinks triggering DDR. Damage is the upstream lesion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雙功能 busulfan 形成鳥嘌呤 N7 鏈間交聯觸發 DDR。損傷是上游病變。

nodes.label: Monoamine oxidase B
nodes.description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Quinones and Oxidative Stress may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

nodes.label: FHL2
nodes.description: In prostate cancer cells the LIM-only scaffolding protein FHL2 binds directly to FoxO1 and to SIRT1, forming a ternary complex. Within that complex FHL2 acts as a molecular matchmaker that dramatically enhances the SIRT1–FoxO1 interaction, driving SIRT1-dependent deacetylation of FoxO1 and suppressing its pro-apoptotic transactivation, which shields tumor cells from apoptotic triggers during aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在前列腺癌細胞中，LIM-only 支架蛋白 FHL2 直接結合 FoxO1 與 SIRT1，形成三元複合體。在該複合體內，FHL2 扮演分子媒合者角色，顯著增強 SIRT1 與 FoxO1 的交互作用，促進 SIRT1 依賴性的 FoxO1 去乙醯化並抑制其促凋亡的轉錄活化，使腫瘤細胞在老化期間免於凋亡誘發。

nodes.label: Nutrient Availability
nodes.description: Nutrient levels dictate metabolic priorities and autophagic activity with scarcity activating clearance. Regulation is the supply-to-degradation coupling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 營養水平決定代謝優先與自噬活性，匱乏活化清除。調節是供應到降解的耦合。

nodes.label: CASTOR1
nodes.description: CASTOR1 is a cytosolic arginine sensor that negatively regulates mTORC1. Without arginine it binds GATOR2, preventing GATOR2 from inhibiting GATOR1, which keeps Rag GTPases inactive and suppresses mTORC1; arginine binding releases GATOR2 to activate Rag GTPases and lysosomal recruitment of mTORC1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CASTOR1 是細胞質中的 Arginine 感測器，對 mTORC1 進行負向調節。缺乏 Arginine 時它結合 GATOR2，使 GATOR2 無法抑制 GATOR1，因而讓 Rag GTPase 維持不活化並抑制 mTORC1；Arginine 結合則釋放 GATOR2，進而活化 Rag GTPase 並促使 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體。

nodes.label: SREBP1
nodes.description: SREBP1 is a master transcription factor for lipid and cholesterol homeostasis whose activity is positively regulated by mTORC1. mTORC1 activates SREBP1 via S6K1 and LIPIN1, so that when nutrients are abundant the lipogenic program is switched on together with growth signalling and autophagy is held in check.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SREBP1 是脂質與膽固醇恆定的主要轉錄因子，其活性受 mTORC1 正向調節。mTORC1 透過 S6K1 與 LIPIN1 活化 SREBP1，因此當營養充足時，脂質生成程序與生長訊號一同被開啟，而自噬受到抑制。

nodes.label: FNIP1
nodes.description: FNIP1 forms a ternary complex with Folliculin and FNIP2 that acts as a GTPase-activating protein for Rag GTPases, converting RagC/D from GTP- to GDP-bound state so that mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosome upon amino acid stimulation. FNIP1 deletion impairs mTORC1 activation and causes constitutive nuclear translocation of TFE3 and TFEB.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FNIP1 與 Folliculin 及 FNIP2 組成三元複合體，作為 Rag GTPases 的 GTPase-activating protein，將 RagC/D 由 GTP 結合態轉為 GDP 結合態，使 mTORC1 在胺基酸刺激下被招募至 lysosome。FNIP1 缺失會損害 mTORC1 活化並造成 TFE3 與 TFEB 的組成性核轉位。

nodes.label: MiT
nodes.description: The MiT (Microphthalmia/TFE) family comprises the basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors MITF, TFEB, TFE3 and TFEC. These factors bind CLEAR elements in target promoters to drive transcription of lysosomal biogenesis, autophagy, pigmentation and metabolic genes, with TFEB acting as a master regulator of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MiT（Microphthalmia/TFE）家族由 basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper 轉錄因子 MITF、TFEB、TFE3 與 TFEC 組成。這些因子結合目標基因啟動子上的 CLEAR 元素，驅動 lysosomal biogenesis、autophagy、pigmentation 與代謝相關基因的轉錄，其中 TFEB 是 lysosome biogenesis 與 autophagy 的主要調控者。

nodes.label: MDL-801
nodes.description: MDL-801 is a potent, cell-permeable synthetic allosteric activator of SIRT6 that binds the hydrophobic pocket and stimulates its deacetylase activity with an EC50 of approximately 10.3 μM. Directionally, MDL-801 sits upstream of SIRT6 activation. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, and it mitigates kidney fibrosis while suppressing glycolytic, tumor-promoting metabolism. Its improved properties make it a valuable tool for studying SIRT6-dependent pathways in vivo, and it supports the broader thesis that pharmacologic SIRT6 activation can reproduce the metabolic and genome-protective benefits of SIRT6 overexpression.
