nodes.description_zh_TW: MDL-801 是一種強效的、細胞可滲透的合成 SIRT6 變構活化因子，結合疏水口袋並以約 10.3 μM 的 EC50 刺激其去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-801 位於 SIRT6 活化的上游。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在抑制糖解、促腫瘤代謝的同時減輕腎纖維化。其改善的特性使其成為在體內研究 SIRT6 依賴性通路的有價值工具，並支持藥理性 SIRT6 活化可以重現 SIRT6 過量表達的代謝和基因組保護益處的更廣泛論點。

nodes.label: Lifespan extension
nodes.description: SIRT1 is a central mediator of healthspan and longevity: its activity declines with age as NAD+ falls, and genetic/pharmacologic (resveratrol, NAD+ precursors) activation extends lifespan in model organisms; SIRT1-dependent deacetylation of p53, FOXOs, and NF-κB underpins these effects (Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 brain-specific SIRT1-overexpression lifespan extension, PMID 24011076).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是健康跨度和長壽的核心中介因子：隨著 NAD+ 下降，其活性隨年齡增長而降低，而基因/藥物（白藜蘆醇、NAD+ 前體）活化可在模式生物中延長壽命；SIRT1 依賴性的 p53、FOXOs 和 NF-κB 去乙醯化構成了這些效應的基礎（Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 大腦特異性 SIRT1 過表達延長壽命，PMID 24011076）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: stress responses
nodes.description: SIRT1 is a central stress-response integrator that deacetylates p53, FOXO, NF-kB, and HIF to bias cells toward repair and survival, activates Nrf2 and antioxidant enzymes, and relocalizes to DNA-damage sites to support repair; these actions underpin SIRT1's stress resistance and longevity functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是一個核心的壓力反應整合因子，它去乙醯化 p53、FOXO、NF-kB 和 HIF，使細胞偏向修復和存活方向；活化 Nrf2 和抗氧化酶；並再定位至 DNA 損傷位點以支持修復；這些作用構成了 SIRT1 抗壓能力和長壽功能的基礎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Nkx3.2
nodes.description: SIRT6 deacetylates histone H3K9 at the promoters of Nkx3.2 and related genes, thereby inhibiting Nkx3.2 transcription. Because Nkx3.2 is itself a repressor of GATA5, this double-negative cascade derepresses GATA5 to prevent endothelial injury and balances vascular protective gene programs. SIRT6 also regulates downstream targets including ERK1/2 through similar H3K9 deacetylation at their promoters, acting as a locus-specific transcriptional regulator. By removing the H3K9ac mark at these loci, SIRT6 silences genes that would otherwise promote pathological programs, a chromatin-based mechanism central to SIRT6's control of endothelial and cardiovascular homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 Nkx3.2 及相關基因啟動子上的組蛋白 H3K9，從而抑制 Nkx3.2 的轉錄。由於 Nkx3.2 本身是 GATA5 的抑制因子，此雙重否定級聯反應解除對 GATA5 的抑制，以防止內皮損傷並平衡血管保護性基因程式。SIRT6 也透過在 ERK1/2 等下游靶基因啟動子上類似的 H3K9 去乙醯化作用來調控其表達，作為位點特異性的轉錄調節因子。透過在這些基因座上去除 H3K9ac 標記，SIRT6 沉默了原本會促進病理程式的基因，這是一種基於染色質的機制，對 SIRT6 控制內皮和心血管恆定性至關重要。

nodes.label: H3K56
nodes.description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K56 (Yang et al., 2009), a mark also touched by SIRT1; the node analysis flagged the missing direct SIRT6→H3K56 edge as a curation gap to fill in the next triples pass.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H3K56（Yang et al., 2009），此標記亦受 SIRT1 作用；節點分析將缺失的 SIRT6→H3K56 直接邊標記為應補回的策展缺口。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: ChREBP
nodes.description: SIRT6 deacetylates ChREBP (alongside SREBP-1c) to maintain hepatic lipid homeostasis and oppose fatty liver disease. Loss of SIRT6 elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice in part through loss of ChREBP/SREBP-1c control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 ChREBP（與 SREBP-1c 並行）以維持肝臟脂質恆定並對抗脂肪肝。在 NASH 小鼠中 SIRT6 缺失會部分因失去 ChREBP/SREBP-1c 控制而加重纖維化與氧化壓力。

nodes.label: H3K9ac
nodes.description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at the promoters of NF-κB target genes, repressing inflammatory transcription, and at the Nkx3.2 promoter, relieving repression of GATA5. H3K9 deacetylation also facilitates recruitment of DSB-repair factors such as 53BP1 and BRCA1 to chromatin flanking damage, so SIRT6 loss causes telomeric H3K9 hyperacetylation and senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 NF-κB 標的基因的啟動子上去乙醯化 H3K9，以抑制發炎性轉錄；在 Nkx3.2 啟動子上則解除對 GATA5 的壓制。H3K9 去乙醯化亦促進 53BP1、BRCA1 等雙股斷裂修復因子被招募至損傷側翼染色質，因此 SIRT6 缺失會造成端粒 H3K9 過度乙醯化與細胞衰老。

nodes.label: RELA
nodes.description: SIRT6 represses RELA (p65) transcriptional activity via chromatin deacetylation. By deacetylating histones at NF-κB target loci (and/or the RELA protein itself), SIRT6 reduces recruitment and transactivation of pro-inflammatory genes, a key mechanism restraining chronic inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過染色質去乙醯化抑制 RELA（p65）的轉錄活性。藉由在 NF-κB 標的位點（或 RELA 蛋白本身）去乙醯化組蛋白，SIRT6 降低發炎基因的招募與轉活化，是抑制慢性發炎的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: SHP2
nodes.description: SHP2 (PTPN11) is a protein tyrosine phosphatase with two SH2 domains and a catalytic PTP domain that transduces signals from receptor tyrosine kinases and cytokine receptors. In the Parkin context, SHP2 dephosphorylates Parkin at Tyr143, relieving autoinhibition and unlocking Parkin's E3 ubiquitin ligase activity — an activation step required for Parkin-mediated mitophagy. SHP2 thus provides a phosphorylation-state regulatory node on the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SHP2（PTPN11）為含有兩個 SH2 結構域與一個催化 PTP 結構域的蛋白酪胺酸磷酸酶，可傳遞受體酪胺酸激酶與細胞激素受體的訊號。在 Parkin 的脈絡中，SHP2 將 Parkin 的 Tyr143 去磷酸化，解除其自抑制並解開 Parkin 的 E3 泛素連接酶活性——這是 Parkin 介導自噬所必需的活化步驟。因此 SHP2 在 PINK1／Parkin 自噬軸上提供了一個依賴磷酸化狀態的調控節點。

nodes.label: ACSS2
nodes.description: ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase 2) is a nuclear-cytosolic enzyme that ligates acetate to coenzyme A to form acetyl-CoA, providing a mitochondrial-independent route of acetyl-CoA production that supports histone acetylation and gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ACSS2（acetyl-CoA synthetase 2）是一種核-胞質酵素，將乙酸（acetate）與輔酶 A 連接形成 acetyl-CoA，提供一條不依賴粒線體的 acetyl-CoA 生成路徑，以支持組蛋白乙醯化與基因表現。

nodes.label: AUF1
nodes.description: AUF1 (AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1, hnRNP D) is a post-transcriptional brake on the SASP. Its four isoforms (p37, p40, p42, p45) each carry two RNA-recognition motifs that bind AUUUA-type AU-rich elements in the 3' UTR; once bound, AUF1 recruits the exonuclease XRN1 and the deadenylase PARN and collaborates with the exosome to drive rapid transcript decay, including decay of transcripts for pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines such as IL-6 and IL-8.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AUF1（AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1，hnRNP D）是 SASP 的轉錄後煞車。其四個異型（p37、p40、p42、p45）各帶兩個 RNA 辨識基序，結合 3' UTR 中 AUUUA 型的 AU-rich element；結合後 AUF1 招募外切核酸酶 XRN1 與去腺苷化酶 PARN，並與 exosome 協同驅動快速的轉錄本降解，包含 IL-6、IL-8 等促發炎細胞激素與趨化因子轉錄本的降解。

nodes.label: ZFP36L1
nodes.description: ZFP36L1 (also BRF1) is a member of the tristetraprolin (TTP/TIS11) family of RNA-binding proteins. It binds AU-rich elements in the 3' UTRs of labile mRNAs via two C3H1 zinc fingers and recruits the CCR4-NOT and PARN deadenylases and the exosome to trigger decay. Under basal conditions this keeps SASP cytokine transcripts such as IL-1α, IL-6, IL-8, and GM-CSF short-lived, making ZFP36L1 a negative regulator of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ZFP36L1（又稱 BRF1）是 tristetraprolin（TTP/TIS11）家族的 RNA 結合蛋白成員。它透過兩個 C3H1 鋅指結合不穩定 mRNA 3' UTR 中的富含 AU 區域，並招募 CCR4–NOT 與 PARN 去腺苷化酶複合體及外切體以觸發降解。在基礎狀態下，這使 IL-1α、IL-6、IL-8 與 GM-CSF 等 SASP 細胞激素轉錄本維持短半衰期，因此 ZFP36L1 是 senescence-associated secretory phenotype 的負向調節因子。

nodes.label: UK5099
nodes.description: In senescent cells, MPC inhibition with UK5099 suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion across multiple senescence models without affecting p16/p21 cell-cycle arrest or DNA damage foci. This places mitochondrial pyruvate entry at the citrate-acetyl-CoA axis that sustains H3K27ac at SASP loci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 senescent cell 中，以 UK5099 抑制 MPC 可在多個 senescence 模型中抑制 SASP 基因表現與分泌，且不影響 p16/p21 細胞週期停滯或 DNA damage foci。這將粒線體丙酮酸入口定位在維持 SASP 位點 H3K27ac 的 citrate-acetyl-CoA 軸上。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - RIP3 targets pyruvate dehydrogenase complex to increase aerobic respiration in TNF-induced necroptosis.md

nodes.label: miR-34a
nodes.description: The 3'UTR of the SIRT1 transcript contains a miR-34a-responsive element; active miR-34a represses SIRT1 translation. Directionally, miR-34a sits upstream to lower SIRT1 protein. Because SIRT1 deacetylates and inhibits p53, this repression is part of a negative feedback loop that helps explain the drop in SIRT1 observed during senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 轉錄本的 3'UTR 包含一個 miR-34a 響應元件；活性 miR-34a 抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。方向性上 miR-34a 位於上游以降低 SIRT1 蛋白水平。由於 SIRT1 去乙醯化並抑制 p53，這種抑制是負回饋迴路的一部分，有助於解釋在衰老過程中觀察到的 SIRT1 下降。

nodes.label: Bleomycin
nodes.description: Bleomycin is a glycopeptide antibiotic that causes DNA double-strand breaks and is a standard tool for generating therapy-induced senescence (TIS) in vitro. Sub-lethal bleomycin treatment produces a canonical senescence phenotype with elevated SA-beta-gal and DNA-damage-response foci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bleomycin 是一種糖肽抗生素，會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，是體外誘發治療誘導性衰老（TIS）的標準工具。次致死劑量的 bleomycin 處理會產生典型的衰老表現型，包括升高的 SA-β-gal 與 DNA 損傷反應焦點。

nodes.label: p73
nodes.description: SIRT1 physically associates with p73 and deacetylates it, primarily at C-terminal lysines; acetylation is required for optimal p73 DNA binding and transactivation, so SIRT1-mediated deacetylation reverses this and suppresses p73 transcriptional activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 與 p73 物理結合並對其去乙醯化，主要發生在 C 端離胺酸；乙醯化是 p73 最佳 DNA 結合與轉錄活化所必需，因此 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化會逆轉此作用並抑制 p73 的轉錄活性。

nodes.label: A20
nodes.description: A20 terminates NF-kappaB signaling by removing K63-linked ubiquitin chains from RIP1 and TRAF6, thereby shutting down IKK activation and the downstream cascade. As a feedback inhibitor, A20 limits excessive inflammation and tissue damage. The directionality is deubiquitination to signal termination. A caveat is that A20 mutations or insufficiency are linked to chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, showing its role is non-redundant in some tissues. Mice lacking A20 in specific tissues develop severe spontaneous inflammation, confirming its role as an essential inflammatory brake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: A20 透過從 RIP1 和 TRAF6 中移除 K63 連接的泛素鏈來終止 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導，從而關閉 IKK 活化和下游級聯。作為反饋抑制劑，A20 可以限制過度發炎和組織損傷。方向性是去泛素化到訊號終止。需要注意的是，A20 突變或不足與慢性發炎和自體免疫疾病有關，這表明​​它的作用在某些組織中是非冗餘的。特定組織中缺乏 A20 的小鼠會出現嚴重的自發性炎症，證實了其作為重要發炎制動劑的作用。

nodes.label: TLR3
nodes.description: TLR3 is an endosomal toll-like receptor that recognizes double-stranded RNA and signals exclusively through the TRIF adaptor. Urolithin A, a gut-microbiome metabolite with anti-inflammatory activity, is studied for modulation of TLR signaling including the TLR3 pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TLR3 是辨識雙股 RNA 並僅透過 TRIF 銜接蛋白訊號的內體 toll 樣受體。Urolithin A 是具有抗發炎活性的腸道微生物代謝物，被研究對包括 TLR3 途徑在內之 TLR 訊號的調控。

nodes.label: Z-VAD-FMK
nodes.description: Z-VAD-FMK is a pan-caspase inhibitor that blocks caspase-dependent apoptosis; persistence of death under Z-VAD-FMK argues for necroptosis, ferroptosis, or parthanatos instead.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Z-VAD-FMK 是泛 caspase 抑制劑，可阻斷 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis；在 Z-VAD-FMK 下仍發生的死亡指向 necroptosis、ferroptosis 或 parthanatos。

nodes.label: Necrostatin-1s
nodes.description: Necrostatin-1s (Nec-1s) is the second-generation allosteric RIPK1 inhibitor: the same mechanism as Necrostatin-1 with improved metabolic stability and kinase selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1s（Nec-1s）為第二代 RIPK1 異位抑制劑：機制與 Nec-1 相同，但代謝穩定性與激酶選擇性更佳。

nodes.label: SHARPIN
nodes.description: SHARPIN is one of the three components of the linear ubiquitin chain assembly complex (LUBAC), with HOIL-1 and HOIP — the only E3 ligase complex that generates M1-linked linear polyubiquitin chains. Linear ubiquitination of RIPK1 and NEMO is required for full NF-κB pro-survival signaling downstream of TNFR1, so SHARPIN loss destabilizes the ubiquitination code that keeps RIPK1 in its pro-survival mode.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SHARPIN 是線性泛素鏈組裝複合體（LUBAC）的三個組件之一，與 HOIL-1、HOIP 共同構成唯一能產生 M1 連結線性多泛素鏈的 E3 泛素連接酶複合體。RIPK1 與 NEMO 的線性泛素化是 TNFR1 下游完整 NF-κB 促存活訊息所必需，因此 SHARPIN 缺失會破壞使 RIPK1 維持促存活模式的泛素化密碼。

nodes.label: Phagophore Assembly Site
nodes.description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

nodes.label: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA
nodes.description: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA (Sanfilippo syndrome type A) is caused by deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme sulfamidase (SGSH), required for heparan sulfate degradation. Heparan sulfate accumulation in lysosomes triggers secondary storage of GM2 gangliosides, cholesterol and autophagic substrates, and Autophagic Flux is impaired, contributing to severe neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA（Sanfilippo 症候群 A 型）由溶酶體酵素硫酸化酶（SGSH）缺乏所致，該酵素為肝素硫酸分解所必需。肝素硫酸在溶酶體內累積會引發 GM2 神經節苷脂、膽固醇與自噬受質的次級儲積，並使 Autophagic Flux 受損，加劇嚴重的神經退化。

nodes.label: Multiple Sulfatase Deficiency
nodes.description: Multiple sulfatase deficiency (MSD) is a rare lysosomal storage disease caused by mutations in SUMF1, which encodes the formylglycine-generating enzyme that activates all sulfatases, producing a combined deficiency of all 17 known human sulfatases. Arylsulfatase deficiency gives features resembling metachromatic leukodystrophy, while sulfamidase deficiency gives MPS-like features.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Multiple sulfatase deficiency（MSD）是由 SUMF1 突變造成的罕見溶酶體儲積症，SUMF1 編碼啟動所有硫酸化酶的 formylglycine 生成酶（FGE），其突變導致全部 17 種已知人類硫酸化酶合併缺乏。芳香基硫酸化酶缺乏產生類似 metachromatic leukodystrophy 的特徵，硫酸化酶缺乏則產生 MPS 樣特徵。

nodes.label: Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
nodes.description: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (Batten disease) is a group of inherited neurodegenerative disorders caused by mutations in at least 13 genes, most encoding lysosomal enzymes or transmembrane proteins involved in lysosomal function. Defective lysosomal degradation leads to accumulation of autofluorescent ceroid and lipofuscin composed of subunit c of mitochondrial ATP synthase and saposins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis（Batten 病）是一群遺傳性神經退化疾病，由至少 13 個基因突變引起，多數編碼溶酶體酵素或參與溶酶體功能的跨膜蛋白。溶酶體降解缺陷導致由粒線體 ATP 合成酶 c 次單元與 saposin 構成的自發光 ceroid 與 lipofuscin 累積。

nodes.label: Acid Hydrolases
nodes.description: Acid hydrolases are a superfamily of about 60 hydrolytic enzymes that carry out the catabolic machinery of the Lysosome at the acidic pH 4.5-5.0 maintained there, cleaving proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, nucleic acids and phosphates. Each cleaves a specific bond type, and deficiency of any single enzyme produces a characteristic lysosomal storage disease in which the undigested substrate accumulates. Delivered by the mannose-6-phosphate pathway via GNPTAB tagging in the Golgi Apparatus, they also degrade autophagosomal cargo, so impaired activity causes autophagic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acid hydrolases 是約 60 種水解酵素的超家族，在 Lysosome 內維持的酸性 pH 4.5-5.0 條件下執行溶體的分解工作，分解蛋白質、脂質、醣類、核酸與磷酸基團。每一種切割特定化學鍵，缺少其中任一酵素即造成特定的 lysosomal storage disease，使未消化受質累積。它們經由 mannose-6-phosphate 路徑運送（由 Golgi Apparatus 中的 GNPTAB 加上標記），也分解自噬體貨載，因此活性受損會造成自噬壓力。

nodes.label: CXCR4
nodes.description: CXCR4 (CD184) is the primary GPCR for CXCL12 (SDF-1) and governs hematopoietic stem cell homing, angiogenesis, metastasis and immune cell trafficking. CellChat analysis of senescent endothelial cells showed CXCR4 mRNA rising with aging while functional Cxcl12-Cxcr4 interaction strength fell, shifting the balance toward ACKR3 signaling; this defective intercellular communication may contribute to age-related endothelial dysfunction. Fisetin restored both signaling patterns to young-like levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCR4（CD184）是 CXCL12（SDF-1）的主要 GPCR，調控造血幹細胞歸巢、血管生成、轉移與免疫細胞運輸。對衰老內皮細胞的 CellChat 分析顯示，隨老化 CXCR4 mRNA 上升，但功能性 Cxcl12-Cxcr4 交互作用強度下降，使訊號平衡轉向 ACKR3；這種細胞間溝通缺陷可能促成與年齡相關的內皮功能失調。Fisetin 將兩種訊號模式皆恢復至近似年輕的狀態。

nodes.label: LIT-927
nodes.description: LIT-927 is a CXCL12 neutraligand that rescues endothelial function, restoring NO production and suppressing senescence markers in human aortic endothelial cells. Blocking CXCL12 with LIT-927 also reversed the senescence-induced increase in p21/Cdkn1a and p16INK4a/Cdkn2a and reduced mitochondrial superoxide, making CXCL12 neutralization a candidate senomorphic strategy against cardiovascular aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIT-927 是 CXCL12 的中和配體，可挽救內皮功能，在人類主動脈內皮細胞中回復 NO 產生並抑制衰老標記。以 LIT-927 阻斷 CXCL12 也能逆轉衰老所造成的 p21/Cdkn1a 與 p16INK4a/Cdkn2a 上升並降低粒線體超氧陰離子，使 CXCL12 中和成為對抗心血管老化的候選 senomorphic 策略。

nodes.label: Chemokines
nodes.description: Chemokines — small 8–14 kDa secreted cytokines that direct immune cell chemotaxis — are core components of the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype. Members such as IL-8 (CXCL8), CCL2, CXCL1, and CXCL10 contribute to immune surveillance of senescent cells and, when chronically secreted, to inflammaging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chemokines（趨化因子）——引導免疫細胞趨化的小型（8–14 kDa）分泌型細胞激素——是 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的核心成分。IL-8（CXCL8）、CCL2、CXCL1 與 CXCL10 等成員有助於衰老細胞的免疫監控；當持續分泌時則促成 inflammaging。

nodes.label: MPEG-PCL
nodes.description: Monomethyl poly(ethylene glycol)-poly(ε-caprolactone) (MPEG-PCL) is an amphiphilic block copolymer that self-assembles into ~22 nm polymeric micelles with ~98.5% encapsulation efficiency, making it a carrier for poorly soluble hydrophobic drugs such as the senolytic fisetin. Fisetin-loaded MPEG-PCL micelles show enhanced cytotoxicity against CT26 colon and SKOV3 ovarian cancer cells and prolonged survival in mice.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MPEG-PCL（單甲基聚乙二醇-聚 ε-己內酯）是兩親性嵌段共聚物，可自組裝成約 22 nm 的聚合物微膠粒，封裝效率約 98.5%，因此適合作為 fisetin 這類難溶疏水性藥物的載體。裝載 fisetin 的 MPEG-PCL 微膠粒對 CT26 大腸癌與 SKOV3 卵巢癌細胞呈現更強的細胞毒性，並在小鼠中延長存活時間。

nodes.label: PLA
nodes.description: Fisetin-loaded PLA nanoparticles increased fisetin AUC 2.32-fold and reduced tumor volume to 64.7% in a 4T1 breast cancer model by sustaining and targeting release of the poorly soluble drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 載有 fisetin 的 PLA 奈米顆粒使 fisetin 的 AUC 提高 2.32 倍，並在 4T1 乳癌模型中將腫瘤體積降至 64.7%，藉由持續性與標靶性釋放難溶藥物。

nodes.label: PLGA
nodes.description: PLGA is a biodegradable copolymer of lactic acid (and its PLA) with glycolic acid, formed by copolymerization; glycolide content tunes degradation kinetics and drug release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PLGA 是乳酸（及其 PLA）與乙醇酸的可生物降解共聚物，藉由共聚形成；乙醇酸含量可調控降解動力學與藥物釋放。

nodes.label: PVP
nodes.description: PVP's hydrophilic amorphous matrix keeps crystalline actives in a high-energy dispersed state and increases effective surface area, accelerating dissolution and raising the bioavailability of poorly water-soluble drugs such as fisetin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PVP 的親水性非晶基質使結晶態活性成分維持高能分散狀態並增加有效表面積，加速溶解並提升 fisetin 等難溶藥物的生體可用率。

nodes.label: Solid Lipid Nanoparticles
nodes.description: Solid lipid nanoparticles (a lipophilic matrix solid at body temperature) can encapsulate Fisetin, giving controlled/sustained release, protection of the labile active and improved bioavailability without organic solvents; fisetin co-loaded with the photosensitizer IR-780 into SLNs reduced LoVo colon adenocarcinoma viability by ~50% at 24 h.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Solid lipid nanoparticles（由在體溫下呈固態的親脂性基質構成）可將 Fisetin 包埋，提供受控／持續釋放、對易分解活性成分的保護，以及無需有機溶劑的生體可用度提升；將 fisetin 與光敏劑 IR-780 共載於 SLN 中，可使 LoVo 結腸腺癌細胞在 24 小時的存活率降低約 50%。

nodes.label: Geroscience
nodes.description: Geroscience is an interdisciplinary field studying the biological relationship between aging and age-related disease on the hypothesis that, because aging is the single greatest risk factor for most chronic diseases, slowing the fundamental processes of aging will delay the onset of multiple diseases simultaneously. It focuses on interconnected aging drivers including epigenetic alterations, genomic instability, senescence, and loss of proteostasis involving autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀髮科學是一門跨領域學科，其研究老化與年齡相關疾病之間的生物關聯，核心假設是：既然老化是多數慢性疾病最大的單一風險因子，減緩老化的根本過程就會同時延後多種疾病的發生。它聚焦於相互連結的老化驅動因子，包括表觀遺傳改變、基因體不穩定、細胞衰老，以及涉及自噬的蛋白質穩態喪失。

nodes.label: Immune Surveillance
nodes.description: Immune surveillance is the continuous monitoring of tissues by the immune system to detect and eliminate pathogens, malignant cells and senescent cells. Senescent cells are normally cleared by natural killer cells and macrophages recognizing surface ligands such as NKG2D ligands and SASP components.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 免疫監視是指免疫系統持續監控組織，以偵測並清除病原體、惡性細胞與衰老細胞。衰老細胞正常情況下會被辨識到細胞表面配體（如 NKG2D 配體與 SASP 成分）的自然殺手細胞與巨噬細胞清除。

nodes.label: SH-SY5Y
nodes.description: SH-SY5Y is a human neuroblastoma cell line subcloned from the SK-N-SH parental line. On exposure to retinoic acid, phorbol esters or brain-derived neurotrophic factor it adopts a neuronal phenotype with neurite outgrowth and acquires biochemical features of sympathetic dopaminergic neurons, retaining catecholaminergic markers such as tyrosine hydroxylase and dopa decarboxylase and synthesizing and storing dopamine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SH-SY5Y 是由 SK-N-SH 親代細胞系再篩選而成的人類神經母細胞瘤細胞系。在視黃酸、佛波酯或腦源性神經生長因子作用下，SH-SY5Y 會出現神經元表型與神經突生長，並獲得交感神經型多巴胺神經元的生化特徵，保留酪胺酸羥化酶與多巴羧化酶等兒茶酚胺標記，合成並儲存多巴胺。

nodes.label: Leukotrienes
nodes.description: 5-HETE is the committed precursor of the leukotriene cascade: LTA4 synthase acts on it to generate LTA4, which is then converted to leukotriene B4 and the cysteinyl leukotrienes. 5-HETE is also a neutrophil chemoattractant and is elevated in asthma, Atherosclerosis and psoriasis, which is why 5-lipoxygenase inhibitors such as zileuton and leukotriene receptor antagonists target this axis for bronchoconstriction and eosinophil recruitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5-HETE 是 leukotriane 級聯反應的承诺前驅物：LTA4 synthase 作用於它生成 LTA4，後者再被轉為 leukotriene B4 與半胱氨酰 leukotrienes。5-HETE 同時是嗜中性球的趨化因子，並在氣喘、Atherosclerosis 與牛皮癬中升高，因此 5-lipoxygenase 抑制劑如 zileuton 以及 leukotriene 受體拮抗劑會針對此軸處理支氣管收縮與嗜酸性球招募。

nodes.label: Conjugated Dienes
nodes.description: Conjugated dienes are the early products of lipid peroxidation: they form when polyunsaturated fatty acids in lipoproteins such as LDL and HDL are oxidized by copper or free radicals. Their appearance at 234 nm absorbance (extinction coefficient 27,000 M-1/cm) is the standard way to quantify the extent of lipoprotein oxidation, with a kinetic profile of lag phase, propagation phase, and decomposition phase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Conjugated Dienes 是 Lipid Peroxidation 的早期產物：當 LDL、HDL 等脂蛋白中的多不飽和脂肪酸被銅或自由基氧化時便會形成。以 234 nm 吸光度（消光係數 27,000 M-1/cm）測量是量化脂蛋白氧化程度的標準方法，其動力學曲線包含 lag phase、propagation phase 與 decomposition phase。

nodes.label: TBARS
nodes.description: Because thiobarbituric acid reacts not only with malondialdehyde but also with 4-hydroxynonenal, acrolein, glyoxal, carbohydrates and amino acids, TBARS is sensitive but not specific and tends to overestimate lipid peroxidation. LC-MS/MS quantification of F2-Isoprostanes is preferred for rigorous measurement, and TBARS is best used for rapid low-cost screening and for validating ferroptosis in culture.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於硫代巴比妥酸不只與 malondialdehyde 反應，也會與 4-hydroxynonenal、acrolein、glyoxal、醣類與胺基酸反應，TBARS 靈敏但不具專一性，容易高估脂質過氧化。嚴格定量以 F2-Isoprostanes 的 LC-MS/MS 為佳；TBARS 適合快速低成本的篩檢，以及在細胞培養中驗證 ferroptosis。

nodes.label: ABG
nodes.description: ABG with co-oximetry is the definitive diagnostic test for methemoglobinemia: a normal PaO2 with low measured oxyhemoglobin and an elevated methemoglobin fraction — the 'saturation gap' — confirms the diagnosis, and ABG also guides methylene blue therapy or exchange transfusion when levels exceed 30%.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 搭配 co-oximetry 的 ABG 是 Methemoglobinemia 的權威診斷檢查：PaO2 正常但實測 oxyhemoglobin 偏低且 Methemoglobin 比例升高（即「saturation gap」）即可確診；當濃度超過 30% 時，ABG 也用於指導 Methylene blue 治療或 Exchange transfusion。

nodes.label: Aniline dyes
nodes.description: Aniline and its metabolites oxidize the ferroprotoporphyrin IX (Fe²⁺) of hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe³⁺) state, producing methemoglobin that cannot bind oxygen and shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve leftward. Acquired methemoglobinemia therefore presents with cyanosis, chocolate-colored blood and, at high levels, hypoxia and dyspnea.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aniline 及其代謝物將 Hemoglobin 的 ferroprotoporphyrin IX（Fe²⁺）氧化為 ferric（Fe³⁺）態，產生無法攜氧並使氧解離曲線左移的 Methemoglobin。因此後天型 Methemoglobinemia 表現為 Cyanosis、巧克力色血液，濃度高時出現 Hypoxia 與呼吸困難。

nodes.label: Blue baby syndrome
nodes.description: Blue baby syndrome is infantile methemoglobinemia occurring in infants who ingest nitrates, typically from contaminated well water. The nitrates are converted to nitrites in the gut, and the nitrites then oxidize hemoglobin iron to the ferric state, producing methemoglobin that cannot carry oxygen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Blue baby syndrome 是發生於攝入硝酸鹽（常來自受污染的井水）嬰兒的嬰兒型 Methemoglobinemia。硝酸鹽在腸道中被轉為亞硝酸鹽，亞硝酸鹽再將 Hemoglobin 的鐵氧化為三價，生成無法攜氧的 Methemoglobin。

nodes.label: Nitrobenzene
nodes.description: Nitrobenzene is industrially reduced to aniline, the precursor of aniline dyes; the shared reductive metabolism explains why nitrobenzene and aniline dyes produce the same methemoglobinemia profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nitrobenzene 在工業上被還原為 aniline，後者是 aniline 染體的前驅物；共同的還原代謝解釋了 nitrobenzene 與 aniline 染體為何具有相同的 methemoglobinemia 毒性特徵。

nodes.label: Prilocaine
nodes.description: Prilocaine is an amino-amide local anesthetic with a well-characterized dose-dependent capacity to induce acquired methemoglobinemia: hydrolysis to o-toluidine and related aromatic amines oxidizes hemoglobin Fe2+ to Fe3+, with onset delayed relative to direct oxidants such as benzocaine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prilocaine 是胺基-醯胺類局部麻醉劑，具有已知的劑量依賴性後天性 [[Methemoglobinemia]] 誘發能力：水解產生的 o-toluidine 等芳香胺將 [[Hemoglobin]] 的 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，其起效時間較 [[Benzocaine]] 等直接氧化劑延後。

nodes.label: Oxygen-dissociation curve
nodes.description: The oxygen-dissociation curve relates the partial pressure of oxygen to hemoglobin oxygen saturation; in methemoglobinemia ferric subunits cannot carry oxygen and cause a left shift in the curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, impairing oxygen release to tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxygen-dissociation curve 描述氧分壓與 [[Hemoglobin]] 血氧飽和度的關係；在 [[Methemoglobinemia]] 中，鐵(III) 次單元無法攜氧，並使殘餘正常 [[Hemoglobin]] 的曲線左移，妨礙氧釋放至組織。

nodes.label: Lidocaine
nodes.description: Lidocaine, an amide-type local anesthetic and Class IB antiarrhythmic that blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, is a recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, particularly with high-dose infusion, topical mucosal application, or use in infants. The pathogenesis is metabolic: lidocaine and its aromatic amine metabolites oxidize ferroheme (Fe2+) of hemoglobin to ferriheme (Fe3+), shifting the oxygen-dissociation curve leftward and producing cyanosis refractory to oxygen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lidocaine 是一種阻斷電壓門控鈉離子通道的醯胺類局部麻醉藥與 IB 類抗心律不整藥，被認為是後天性 methemoglobinemia 的已知病因，尤其見於高劑量輸注、黏膜局部使用或嬰兒族群。其致病機轉為代謝性：lidocaine 及其芳香胺代謝物將血基質由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+），使氧解離曲線左移，產生對氧氣無反應的發紺。

nodes.label: PRAS40
nodes.description: Akt phosphorylation relieves PRAS40-mediated mTORC1 inhibition. Phosphorylation is the canonical release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化解除 PRAS40 介導的 mTORC1 抑制。磷酸化是典型釋放。

nodes.label: Sotorasib
nodes.description: Sotorasib is approved for KRAS G12C non-small-cell lung cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sotorasib 核准用於 KRAS G12C 非小細胞肺癌。

nodes.label: Topoisomerase I
nodes.description: FL118 is a second-generation camptothecin analog that traps the covalent TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of single-strand breaks. Collision of the trapped complex with replicating DNA polymerases converts these breaks into lethal double-strand breaks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FL118 是第二代喜樹鹼類似物，會捕獲共價的 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，阻止單股斷裂的重新連結。被捕獲複合體與複製中的 DNA 聚合酶碰撞，會將這些斷裂轉化為致命的雙股斷裂。

nodes.label: Ferrostatin-1
nodes.description: Ferrostatin-1 is the defining ferroptosis inhibitor: a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that halts lipid peroxidation propagation; rescue by Fer-1 is a diagnostic criterion for ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ferrostatin-1 是代表性的 ferroptosis 抑制劑：親脂性自由基捕捉抗氧化劑，可中止脂質過氧化鏈式反應；Fer-1 救援是 ferroptosis 的診斷標準。

nodes.label: CDO1
nodes.description: CDO1 and System Xc- compete for cysteine: CDO1 diverts it to catabolism, while System Xc- (SLC7A11) import supports glutathione synthesis. High CDO1 therefore lowers the GSH set-point and sensitizes gastric cancer cells to erastin, making CDO1 expression a candidate biomarker of ferroptosis sensitivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDO1 與 System Xc- 競爭半胱胺酸：CDO1 將其分流至分解代謝，而 System Xc-（SLC7A11）的輸入則支持 glutathione 合成。因此 CDO1 偏高會降低 GSH 設定點並使胃癌細胞對 erastin 敏感，也讓 CDO1 表現成為 ferroptosis 敏感性的候選生物標記。

nodes.label: CISD2
nodes.description: CISD2 (NAF-1) is a CDGSH-domain [2Fe-2S] protein localized to the mitochondrial outer membrane and ER that acts as a conserved mitochondrial ferroptosis brake. Intact CISD2 limits mitochondrial Fe2+ availability for the Fenton reaction; inhibiting the CISD2 gene in head and neck cancer cells increases mitochondrial iron and lipid ROS, promoting ferroptotic death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CISD2 (NAF-1) 是含 CDGSH domain 的 [2Fe-2S] 蛋白，位於粒線體外膜與內質網，作為保守的粒線體鐵死亡煞車。完整的 CISD2 限制可供 Fenton 反應使用的粒線體 Fe2+；在頭頸癌細胞中抑制 CISD2 基因會提高粒線體鐵與脂質 ROS，促進鐵死亡。

nodes.label: Hepatitis B Virus
nodes.description: Chronic hepatitis B virus infection, which affects over 250 million people and causes more than 800,000 deaths annually, is a major long-term complication pathway to hepatocellular carcinoma, mediated by cirrhosis and by the stable nuclear cccDNA minichromosome that allows the virus to persist.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性 hepatitis B virus 感染影響超過 2.5 億人，每年造成逾 80 萬人死亡，是通往 hepatocellular carcinoma 的主要長期併發途徑，其媒介為肝硬化，以及使病毒得以持續存在的穩定核內 cccDNA 小染色體。

nodes.label: Transferrin
nodes.description: Transferrin is the principal iron-binding glycoprotein of blood and extracellular fluid. It binds two Fe³⁺ ions and delivers them to cells via receptor-mediated endocytosis through Transferrin receptor 1; its iron-loaded (holo) form docks at the TFR1 surface and iron is released in the acidic endosome, after which apotransferrin and TFR1 recycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Transferrin 是血液與細胞外液中的主要鐵結合醣蛋白。它結合兩個 Fe³⁺ 離子，並藉由 Transferrin receptor 1 進行受體媒介的胞吞作用將鐵送入細胞；其載鐵（holo）型態在 TFR1 表面結合，鐵在酸性內體中釋放，之後 apo-transferrin 與 TFR1 循環回收。

nodes.label: Methionine Synthase
nodes.description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

nodes.label: Blood
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is unstable in blood, degrading very rapidly even at -80 degrees Celsius. In the first clinical trial of single oral NMN doses (100-500 mg) in healthy subjects, NMN was not detected in plasma, most likely because sample freezing before extraction caused NMN degradation. This rapid degradation complicates accurate measurement of circulating NMN and may explain why plasma NMN levels are kept low and constant, presumably due to balanced NMN distribution from plasma to tissues. In mice, orally administered NMN was quickly absorbed from the intestine, eliminated from circulation within 15 minutes, and rapidly converted into NAD+ in tissues such as the liver and soleus muscle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）在血液中不穩定，即使在 -80 攝氏度下也會極快速地降解。在首項健康受試者單次口服 NMN 劑量（100-500 mg）的臨床試驗中，血漿中未檢出 NMN，最可能的原因是萃取前樣本冷凍導致 NMN 降解。這種快速降解使循環 NMN 的準確測量變得複雜，並可能解釋為何血漿 NMN 水平維持在低且恆定的狀態，推測是由於 NMN 從血漿到組織的平衡分佈。在小鼠中，口服給予的 NMN 迅速從腸道吸收，在 15 分鐘內從循環中清除，並在肝臟與比目魚肌等組織中快速轉化為 NAD+。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator
nodes.description: NMN is a direct NAD+ precursor that, once converted to NAD+, serves as a universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator by supplying the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins. Directionally, NMN is converted to NAD+, which activates sirtuins. It raises NAD+ levels that decline with age, restoring sirtuin function systemically, and NMN repletion in mice reverses mitochondrial dysfunction and features of cellular senescence. NMN, together with NR, is a leading nutraceutical strategy to counteract age-related sirtuin attenuation, and its efficacy is enhanced when combined with agents that prevent NAD+ consumption, such as CD38 inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMN 是一種直接的 NAD+ 前體，一旦轉化為 NAD+，便通過為所有七種 sirtuin 提供必需的共同受質而充當通用的間接泛 sirtuin 活化因子。在方向性上，NMN 被轉化為 NAD+，NAD+ 活化 sirtuin。它提高隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 水平，恢復全身的 sirtuin 功能，小鼠中的 NMN 補充逆轉粒線體功能障礙和細胞衰老的特徵。NMN 與 NR 一起是對抗與年齡相關的 sirtuin 衰減的主要營養保健品策略，當與防止 NAD+ 消耗的藥劑（如 CD38 抑制劑）結合時，其功效增強。

nodes.label: Liraglutide
nodes.description: Liraglutide's cardioprotection reduces major adverse cardiovascular events and cardiac fibrosis by modulating TGF-β signalling and extracellular matrix remodelling, together with lowered myocardial inflammation and reduced cardiomyocyte death — making Mitophagy promotion its key mechanism of cardiac benefit.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liraglutide 的心臟保護可降低主要不良心血管事件與心臟纖維化，機制包含調節 TGF-β 訊號與細胞外基質重塑，並伴隨心肌發炎降低與心肌細胞死亡減少——因此促進 Mitophagy 是其心臟效益的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: Complex II
nodes.description: Complex II is embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane and is the only enzyme that participates in both the TCA cycle and the electron transport chain. It links carbon metabolism to mitochondrial redox signaling and oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Complex II 嵌入粒線體內膜，是唯一同時參與 TCA 循環與電子傳遞鏈的酶。它將碳代謝與粒線體氧化還原訊號及氧化壓力相連結。

nodes.label: ATF5
nodes.description: ATF5 is the mammalian transcription factor that mediates the mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Like C. elegans ATFS-1, ATF5 partitions between the nucleus and mitochondria, and under mitochondrial stress it localizes to the nucleus to induce chaperones and proteases that restore mitochondrial proteostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATF5 是介導 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的哺乳類轉錄因子。與 C. elegans 的 ATFS-1 相同，ATF5 在細胞核與粒線體之間分配；在粒線體壓力下它定位至細胞核，誘導 chaperone 與 protease 以恢復粒線體蛋白恆定。

nodes.label: DVE-1
nodes.description: UBL-5 uses its ubiquitin-like fold as a binding interface to interact physically with the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1 — it does not conjugate to targets like ubiquitin. This interaction stabilizes the UPRmt transcriptional complex, enabling DVE-1's proper nuclear accumulation and DNA-binding activity; without UBL-5 the UPRmt is nonfunctional even when ATFS-1 is activated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UBL-5 以其類泛素摺疊作為結合介面，與同源盒轉錄因子 DVE-1 發生物理交互作用——它不像泛素那樣與標的共價結合。此交互作用穩定 UPRmt 轉錄複合體，使 DVE-1 得以正常在細胞核內累積並結合 DNA；缺乏 UBL-5 時，即使 ATFS-1 被活化，UPRmt 仍無法運作。

nodes.label: Denham Harman
nodes.description: Denham Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, postulating that reactive oxygen species produced during aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage that drives aging. This theory made ROS the central agents of aging for the field and redirected ageing research toward antioxidant biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Denham Harman 於 1955 年提出 free radical theory of aging，主張 aerobic respiration 過程中產生的 reactive oxygen species 會造成累積性氧化損傷並驅動老化。此理論使 ROS 成為老化研究領域的核心因子，並將老化研究重新導向抗氧化生物學。

nodes.label: Free Radical Theory of Aging
nodes.description: Denham Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, postulating that reactive oxygen species produced during aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage that drives aging. This theory made ROS the central agents of aging for the field and redirected ageing research toward antioxidant biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Denham Harman 於 1955 年提出 free radical theory of aging，主張 aerobic respiration 過程中產生的 reactive oxygen species 會造成累積性氧化損傷並驅動老化。此理論使 ROS 成為老化研究領域的核心因子，並將老化研究重新導向抗氧化生物學。

nodes.label: HEK293
nodes.description: HEK293 is the workhorse human cell line for transient and stable recombinant protein production, lentiviral packaging, and CRISPR screens, and is heavily used in mitochondria-related and signaling studies. Its high transfectability makes it ideal for reporter assays probing mTOR, apoptosis, and stress pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HEK293 是從事暫時性與穩定性重組蛋白生產、lentiviral packaging 與 CRISPR screen 的主力人類細胞株，並廣泛用於粒線體相關與訊號研究。其高轉染效率使其成為偵測 mTOR、apoptosis 與壓力途徑的 reporter assay 理想模型。

nodes.label: Rheumatoid synovial fluid
nodes.description: Extracellular myeloperoxidase activity is detectable in rheumatoid synovial fluid as in plaque and ischemic myocardium. Localization records the inflammatory exudate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞外髓過氧化物酶活性可在類風濕滑液測得，如同斑塊與缺血心肌。定位記錄發炎滲出。

nodes.label: CXCL2
nodes.description: CXCL2 (GRObeta/MIP-2alpha) is an ELR+ C-X-C chemokine that engages CXCR2 with high affinity and CXCR1 weakly. Ligand-receptor coupling activates Galphai, stimulating PLCbeta/IP3/Ca2+, PI3K/Akt and p38 MAPK/ERK pathways, and CXCL2 recruits and activates neutrophils to induce chemotaxis, degranulation and ROS release that propagate inflammatory signalling to neighbouring cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL2（GROβ/MIP-2α）是 ELR+ 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，以高親和力結合 CXCR2，並微弱作用於 CXCR1。配體–受體耦合活化 Gαi，刺激 PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+、PI3K/Akt 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 路徑；CXCL2 募集並活化中性球，誘發趨化、脫顆粒與 ROS 釋放，將發炎訊號傳遞給鄰近細胞。

nodes.label: Cl-amidine
nodes.description: Cl-amidine is a covalent pan-peptidylarginine deiminase inhibitor with a chloro-acetamidine warhead that blocks citrullination by PAD4 and related deiminases. In NETosis assays it suppresses histone citrullination (cit-H3) and NET extrusion, making it — with DNase digestion and NE/MPO inhibition — the standard blockade panel proving PAD-dependent NET formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cl-amidine 是具有 chloro-acetamidine 親電子基團的共價廣譜 peptidylarginine deiminase 抑制劑，可阻斷 PAD4 及相關 deiminase 的 citrullination 作用。在 NETosis 分析中，它抑制 histone citrullination（cit-H3）與 NET 挤出，因此與 DNase 消化及 NE/MPO 抑制並列，構成證明 PAD 依賴性 NET 形成的標準阻斷組合。

nodes.label: Detoxification
nodes.description: The electrophilic o-quinone aminochromes generated by catecholamine oxidation (Adrenaline-quinone, Dopaminochrome, Adrenochrome) are detoxified by glutathione S-transferases, which conjugate them at ring positions such as C2 and C5 to form stable thioethers. This directly prevents the quinone from cyclizing to adrenochrome or arylating protein thiols, spares Glutathione consumed as mercapturate, and suppresses redox cycling and secondary ROS production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 兒茶酚胺氧化產生的親電子 o-quinone aminochrome（Adrenaline-quinone、Dopaminochrome、Adrenochrome）由 glutathione S-transferase 去毒，後者於 quinone 環上如 C2 與 C5 位置接合形成穩定硫醚。這直接阻止 quinone 環化生成 adrenochrome 或對蛋白質 thiol 進行芳基化，節省以 mercapturate 形式排出的 Glutathione，並抑制 redox cycling 與次級 ROS 產生。

nodes.label: Pycnogenol
nodes.description: Pycnogenol exerts anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting NF-κB signalling and adhesion-molecule expression. Combined with its enhancement of eNOS activity and NO bioavailability, this makes the extract clinically positioned against chronic venous insufficiency, edema, and retinal/capillary microcirculation defects, and against the vascular dysfunction of cardiovascular disease and diabetes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pycnogenol 藉由抑制 NF-κB 訊息傳遞與黏附分子表現發揮抗發炎作用。加上它增強 eNOS 活性與 NO 生體可用性的效果，使這種萃取物在臨床上被定位於對抗慢性靜脈功能不足、水腫與視網膜／微循環缺陷，以及心血管疾病與糖尿病的血管功能異常。

nodes.label: Muscle Mass
nodes.description: Creatine supplementation increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine stores and, particularly when combined with resistance training, promotes gains in lean tissue mass and strength. Randomized trials in older adults show greater gains in muscle mass and isometric strength with creatine plus heavy resistance training compared to training alone, and meta-analyses confirm larger gains in muscle mass and upper-body strength in older individuals supplementing creatine during resistance exercise. Creatine also decreases protein breakdown and can preserve muscle mass during energy-restricted weight loss, making it a broadly useful strategy for maintaining muscle across the lifespan and in clinical rehabilitation populations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸可增加肌肉肌酸與磷酸肌酸儲備，尤其是與阻力訓練結合時，能促進去脂組織質量與肌力的增長。在老年人中的隨機試驗顯示，與單獨訓練相比，肌酸加上重度阻力訓練可帶來更大的肌肉質量與等長肌力增長，統合分析也證實，在阻力運動期間補充肌酸的老年人，其肌肉質量與上半身肌力增長更大。肌酸還能減少蛋白質分解，並在限制能量的減重過程中保留肌肉質量，使其成為在整個生命歷程及臨床復健族群中維持肌肉的廣泛實用策略。

nodes.label: ADP
nodes.description: A transient rise in ADP (and AMP) during exercise or fasting signals a cellular energy deficit, activating AMPK, which then stimulates PGC-1α and mitochondrial biogenesis as part of mitohormetic adaptation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運動或禁食期間 ADP（與 AMP）的暫時上升代表細胞能量赤字，會活化 AMPK，後者再刺激 PGC-1α 與粒線體生合成，構成 mitohormetic 適應的一部分。

nodes.label: Atg15
nodes.description: Mammalian LIPA is the counterpart of yeast Atg15; deficiency causes Wolman disease and CESD. Homology maps vacuolar lipase to lysosomal lipase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物 LIPA 是酵母 Atg15 的對應物；缺乏導致 Wolman 病與 CESD。同源將液泡脂肪酶對應到溶酶體脂肪酶。

nodes.label: Lipid Droplet
nodes.description: ATGL (adipose triglyceride lipase, PNPLA2) is the first and rate-limiting enzyme of catabolic lipolysis. It localizes to the surface of Lipid Droplet and hydrolyzes triacylglycerol into diacylglycerol and free fatty acids, providing substrate for Lipophagy and fatty acid oxidation. Its activity determines the rate of free fatty acid release from adipose tissue and therefore systemic lipid mobilization, and it is activated during Starvation and Fasting to mobilize energy reserves.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATGL（adipose triglyceride lipase，PNPLA2）是分解性脂解的第一個也是速率限制酵素。它定位於 Lipid Droplet 表面，將三酸甘油酯水解為二酸甘油酯與游離脂肪酸，為 Lipophagy 與脂肪酸氧化提供受質。其活性決定 adipose 組織釋放游離脂肪酸的速率，因而決定全身脂質動員；並在 Starvation 與 Fasting 期間被活化以動員能量儲備。

nodes.label: HSL
nodes.description: HSL is the upstream diacylglycerol lipase that generates the monoacylglycerol substrate Monoacylglycerol Lipase then hydrolyses; together with ATGL it governs lipid mobilization from adipose tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HSL 是上游的 diglyceride 脂肪酶，產生 Monoacylglycerol Lipase 隨後水解的 monoacylglycerol 基質；它與 ATGL 共同調控脂肪組織的脂質動員。

nodes.label: Reference standard
nodes.description: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control. Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use. Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air, manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products, and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control。Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use。Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air，manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products，and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies。

nodes.label: indoline-5,6-dione
nodes.description: Adrenochrome is chemically an indoline-5,6-dione, formally 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione. The molecule features a fused bicyclic system in which a six-membered benzene ring (oxidized to a quinone at positions 5 and 6) is fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring bearing a hydroxy substituent and an N-methyl group. This structure arises when oxidized epinephrine undergoes intramolecular cyclization, in which the side-chain nitrogen attacks the electrophilic o-quinone ring (a Michael addition), closing the second ring. The quinone moiety and its o-quinone character account for much of adrenochrome's reactivity, including its ability to undergo redox cycling and one-electron reduction to the semiquinone radical.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在化學上是 indoline-5,6-dione，正式名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione。該分子具有融合雙環系統，其中一個六元苯環（於第 5 與第 6 位氧化為醌）與一個帶有羥基取代基與 N-甲基的五元含氮環融合。此結構源於氧化後的 epinephrine 發生分子內環化，其中側鏈氮攻擊親電性的 o-quinone 環（一種 Michael 加成），閉合第二個環。醌部分及其 o-quinone 特性解釋了 adrenochrome 大部分的反應性，包括其進行氧化還原循環與單電子還原為半醌自由基的能力。

nodes.label: Semicarbazide
nodes.description: Semicarbazide reacts with the o-quinone structure of Adrenochrome to form Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone). The semicarbazone adduct is markedly more stable than the parent quinone, and carbazochrome has medical applications as a hemostatic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Semicarbazide 與 Adrenochrome 的 o-quinone 結構反應生成 Carbazochrome（adrenochrome monosemicarbazone）。此 semicarbazone 加合物比母體醌顯著穩定，而 carbazochrome 在醫學上具有止血劑的應用。

nodes.label: NUMTs
nodes.description: NUMTs (nuclear insertions of mitochondrial origin) are copies of mtDNA that integrated into the nuclear genome during evolution; roughly 755 such insertions are dispersed through the human nuclear genome, mostly under 500 bp, with a mean sequence identity to mtDNA of 79.2%. They are generally considered pseudogenes and molecular fossils of the endosymbiotic transfer of genetic material from mitochondria to the nucleus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NUMTs（nuclear insertions of mitochondrial origin）是演化過程中整合進核基因體的 mtDNA 拷貝；人類核基因體中估計散布著 755 個此類插入片段，多數小於 500 bp，與 mtDNA 的平均序列一致性為 79.2%。它們一般被視為偽基因，也是粒線體向細胞核內共生轉移遺傳物質的分子化石。

nodes.label: IKKalpha
nodes.description: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

nodes.label: Opioids
nodes.description: Although most opioids act predominantly through μ, κ and δ opioid receptors, several — tramadol, meperidine, methadone and dextromethorphan — inhibit serotonin reuptake or release, raising synaptic Serotonin. When combined with SSRIs or Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors such as Methylene blue, this serotonergic activity can precipitate Serotonin Syndrome, a potentially life-threatening toxidrome of hyperthermia, autonomic instability and neuromuscular hyperactivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雖然多數類鴉片藥物主要透過 μ、κ、δ 類鴉片受體作用，但其中數種——tramadol、meperidine、methadone 與 dextromethorphan——會抑制血清素（Serotonin）的再攝取或釋放，提高突觸內 Serotonin 濃度。若與 SSRI 或諸如 Methylene blue 的單胺氧化酶抑制劑（Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor）併用，這種血清素活性可能誘發血清素症候群（Serotonin Syndrome），一種以高體溫、自主神經不穩定與神經肌肉過度興奮構成、可致命的毒理症候群。

nodes.label: Tricyclic Antidepressant
nodes.description: Methylene blue acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, so combining it with a Tricyclic Antidepressant — which blocks monoamine reuptake including serotonin and norepinephrine — risks serotonin syndrome, as does combination with SSRIs. This interaction explains why methylene blue dosing guidance warns against co-administration with tricyclics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue 具有 monoamine oxidase inhibitor 的作用，因此與阻斷包括 serotonin 與 norepinephrine 在內的單胺再攝取的 Tricyclic Antidepressant 併用會有 serotonin syndrome 風險，與 SSRI 併用亦然。這項交互作用即是 methylene blue 劑量指引警告不可與三環類抗憂鬱藥共用的原因。

nodes.label: Glucose metabolism
nodes.description: Resveratrol improves glucose metabolism and reduces LDL while elevating HDL, improving the lipid profile in metabolic models. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of better glycemic and lipoprotein control. These effects are largely SIRT1/AMPK-dependent, reflecting improved insulin sensitivity, reduced hepatic lipogenesis, and enhanced lipid oxidation. Human outcomes, however, are limited by resveratrol's poor bioavailability and short half-life, so translating these metabolic benefits to patients requires formulations that achieve effective plasma concentrations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 改善葡萄糖代謝並降低 LDL 同時升高 HDL，改善代謝模型中的血脂特徵。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善血糖和脂蛋白控制的上游。這些效應主要依賴 SIRT1/AMPK，反映胰島素敏感性改善、肝臟脂肪生成減少和脂質氧化增強。然而，由於 resveratrol 生物利用度低且半衰期短，人體結果有限，因此要將這些代謝益處轉化為患者需要能達到有效血漿濃度的製劑。

nodes.label: SERCA2a
nodes.description: SIRT1 modulates Ca2+ signaling by deacetylating Ca2+-handling proteins including IP3 receptors and SERCA2a. Deacetylation of IP3 receptors tunes endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ leak, while SERCA2a deacetylation influences diastolic Ca2+ handling in cardiomyocytes, linking sirtuin activity to cardiac hypertrophy and neurodegeneration phenotypes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由將包括 IP3 受體與 SERCA2a 在內的 Ca2+ 處理蛋白去乙醯化來調節 Ca2+ 訊號。IP3 受體的去乙醯化可調整內質網的 Ca2+ 滲漏，而 SERCA2a 的去乙醯化影響心肌細胞舒張期的 Ca2+ 處理，將 sirtuin 活性與心臟肥大及神經退化表型連結起來。

nodes.label: Piceatannol
nodes.description: Piceatannol (3,3',4,5'-tetrahydroxystilbene) is a hydroxylated stilbenoid analogue of Resveratrol and a broad-spectrum sirtuin-activating compound. Table 6 of Zhao et al. (2020) lists it as an activator of SIRT1, SIRT3 and SIRT5, making it one of the few natural compounds reported to stimulate several mammalian sirtuins simultaneously.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Piceatannol（3,3',4,5'-tetrahydroxystilbene）是 Resveratrol 的羥基化 stilbenoid 類似物，屬廣效型的 sirtuin 活化化合物。Zhao 等人（2020）的表 6 將其列為 SIRT1、SIRT3 與 SIRT5 的活化劑，使其成為少數同時能刺激多種哺乳類 sirtuin 的天然化合物之一。

nodes.label: Parasympathetic Nervous System
nodes.description: The parasympathetic nervous system is the rest, digest, and repair branch of the autonomic nervous system, controlled heavily by the vagus nerve. When active, it signals the body to calm down, digest food, and repair cells, allowing for more fluctuation between heartbeats and thereby raising HRV. A high HRV indicates strong vagal tone, meaning the parasympathetic system can quickly hit the brakes on stress. HRV reflects the tug-of-war between the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems, and recovery after stressors allows the parasympathetic branch to rebound and push HRV back to or above baseline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 副交感神經系統是自主神經系統的休息、消化和修復分支，主要受迷走神經控制。活躍時，它向身體發出信號以平靜下來、消化食物和修復細胞，允許心跳之間有更多波動，從而提高心率變異性（HRV）。高HRV表示迷走神經張力強，意味著副交感系統能快速對壓力踩剎車。HRV反映了交感和副交感系統之間的拉鋸戰，壓力後的恢復允許副交感分支反彈並將HRV推回或高於基線。

nodes.label: Arterial Aging
nodes.description: Autophagy prevents arterial aging by removing damaged mitochondria, misfolded proteins, and lipid aggregates that would otherwise promote endothelial dysfunction, inflammation, and vascular stiffening. Impaired autophagic flux in aged vessels permits oxidative stress and senescence to accumulate, driving the loss of nitric-oxide-mediated relaxation. Enhancing autophagy—pharmacologically or by caloric restriction—rescues the vascular phenotype and restores endothelial function in preclinical models. The pathway is thus a central defender of vascular youth.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬透過移除受損粒線體、錯誤折疊蛋白和脂質聚集物來防止動脈老化，這些物質否則會促進內皮功能障礙、發炎和血管僵硬化。老化血管中自噬流受損會讓氧化壓力和衰老累積，驅動一氧化氮介導舒張能力的喪失。增強自噬——藥理學上或透過熱量限制——在臨床前模型中拯救血管表型並恢復內皮功能。因此此途徑是血管年輕的主要守護者。

nodes.label: HAT
nodes.description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

nodes.label: Adaptive Immune Response
nodes.description: Autophagy facilitates adaptive immune cell activation and differentiation, and regulates antigen presentation, lymphocyte survival, and immune memory. Autophagy inducers such as Spermidine can rejuvenate B cell responses and enhance production of virus-specific memory CD8+ T cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Autophagy 促進適應性免疫細胞的活化與分化，並調控抗原呈現、淋巴球存活與免疫記憶。Spermidine 等 Autophagy inducer 可活化 B 細胞反應，並增強病毒特異性記憶型 CD8+ T cell 的產生。

nodes.label: Bafilomycin A1
nodes.description: Bafilomycin A1 is a V-ATPase inhibitor that blocks the proton translocation step of the pump. By preventing lysosomal acidification it halts the activity of acid hydrolases, so autophagic cargo that has been sequestered and delivered normally accumulates undegraded inside autolysosomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bafilomycin A1 是 V-ATPase 抑制劑，會阻斷該幫浦的質子轉運步驟。它藉由阻止溶酶體酸化而使酸性水解酶停止作用，因此正常被隔離並運送的自噬貨物會在自噬溶酶體內累積而無法降解。

nodes.label: Ketogenic Diet
nodes.description: Ketogenesis is triggered by a Ketogenic Diet as well as by Caloric Restriction and Intermittent Fasting, because all three lower glucose availability and raise fatty acid delivery to the liver. Promoting Ketogenesis this way is investigated for Neurodegenerative Disease and for enhancing the tumoricidal properties of treatments in some Cancer contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ketogenesis 可由 Ketogenic Diet 觸發，與 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 相同，因為三者都降低葡萄糖可得性並提高脂肪酸送抵肝臟。以此方式促進 Ketogenesis 正在被研究用於 Neurodegenerative Disease，以及在某些 Cancer 情境下增強治療的腫瘤殺傷特性。

nodes.label: Hesperetin
nodes.description: Hesperetin, a citrus flavanone polyphenol (the aglycone of hesperidin), exerts antifibrotic and senomorphic activity by restoring autophagic flux, reducing reactive oxygen species, and suppressing SASP-mediated fibroblast activation. It is therefore grouped with other polyphenol senotherapeutics that counteract the mitochondrial dysfunction/ROS/SASP axis sustaining fibrotic remodeling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hesperetin 是一種柑橘類黃烷酮多酚（hesperidin 的苷元），透過恢復自噬通量、降低活性氧並抑制 SASP 介導的纖維母細胞活化，發揮抗纖維化與 senomorphic 活性。因此它與其他對抗維持纖維化重塑之粒線體功能障礙／ROS／SASP 軸的多酚類 senotherapeutics 歸為同一群。

nodes.label: Pompe Disease
nodes.description: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II) is a lysosomal storage disease caused by deficiency of acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA), leading to massive glycogen accumulation in lysosomes, particularly in cardiac and skeletal muscle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 龐貝氏症（第二型肝醣儲積症）屬於溶小體儲積症，由酸性 α-葡萄糖苷酶（GAA）缺乏所致，造成溶小體（尤其在心肌與骨骼肌）大量肝醣累積。

nodes.label: PI3K-Akt Signaling
nodes.description: PTEN is a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates PIP3, thereby antagonizing PI3K/Akt signalling; its opposition to PI3K forms one branch of the incoherent bivalent motif centred on mTORC1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTEN 是脂質磷酸酶，可將 PIP3 去磷酸化，因而拮抗 PI3K/Akt 訊號；其與 PI3K 的對抗構成以 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價 motif 的一個分支。

nodes.label: TASCC
nodes.description: The TASCC is defined by spatial colocalization of active mTORC1 with autophagosomes and autolysosomes on the trans-Golgi network in senescent cells. Autophagy-derived amino acids feed mTORC1, which in turn directs cap-dependent translation - a feed-forward loop that resolves the paradox of high autophagy coexisting with vigorous secretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TASCC 的定義是衰老細胞中活化的 mTORC1 與自噬體、自噬溶體在高基氏體網絡上的空間共定位。自噬回收的胺基酸餵養 mTORC1，後者再引導帽依賴性轉譯——這個前饋迴圈化解了高自噬與旺盛分泌並存的悖論。

nodes.label: Pterostilbene
nodes.description: Pterostilbene is a calorie-restriction mimetic that directly activates SIRT1 and upstream energy sensors such as AMPK. It recapitulates the molecular signature of nutrient scarcity, enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and antioxidant defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紫檀芪是熱量限制模擬劑，直接活化 SIRT1 與 AMPK 等上游能量感應器。它重現營養稀缺的分子特徵，增強脂肪酸氧化與抗氧化防禦。

nodes.label: mTOR Inhibitor
nodes.description: Suppressed mTOR relieves inhibition of autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis via TFEB, promoting cellular cleanup. mTOR inhibition is thus a canonical inducer of autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抑制的 mTOR 解除對自噬與溶酶體生合成的抑制（經由 TFEB），促進細胞清理。因此 mTOR 抑制是自噬的典型誘導者。

nodes.label: Malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
nodes.description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

nodes.label: fatty-acid metabolism
nodes.description: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2. This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: GDH (Glutamate Dehydrogenase)
nodes.description: SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylates glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH), inhibiting its oxidative deamination of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and thereby slowing anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. This restrains amino-acid-derived ATP production and insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells, limiting nutrient-driven hormonal output. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically inhibits GDH, acting as a mitochondrial brake on amino-acid catabolism. This opposes anabolic fueling of secretion, and because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly curbs mitochondrial oxidative capacity while promoting lipid conservation under nutrient-replete conditions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 對穀氨酸脫氫酶（GDH）進行單 ADP-核糖基化，抑制其將穀氨酸氧化脫氨為 α-酮戊二酸，從而減緩回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。這限制了胰腺 β 細胞中胺基酸衍生的 ATP 產生和胰島素分泌，抑制營養物驅動的荷爾蒙輸出。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制 GDH，充時代謝的制動器限制胺基酸分解代謝。這對抗了分泌的合成代謝燃料供應，且由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它在營養充足條件下廣泛抑制粒線體氧化能力同時促進脂質保存。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α
nodes.description: SIRT4 destabilizes Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α (MTPα, HADHB) in hepatocytes, shifting metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward anabolic lipid conservation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在肝細胞中使 Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α（MTPα，HADHB）去穩定，使代謝由粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成型脂質保存。

nodes.label: Executive Function
nodes.description: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

nodes.label: ACC1
nodes.description: SIRT3 deacetylates ACC1 at multiple lysine residues and thereby increases its enzymatic activity, driving de novo lipogenesis. Because ACC1 is the rate-limiting enzyme of fatty acid synthesis, SIRT3-dependent activation is a pro-tumorigenic metabolic switch that supplies the lipid building blocks needed for membrane biogenesis, signalling and energy storage in rapidly proliferating tumour cells, and it operates orthogonally to the AMPK phosphorylation checkpoint.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 會在多個離胺酸殘基上將 ACC1 去乙醯化，進而提升其酵素活性並促進從頭脂質生成。由於 ACC1 是脂肪酸合成的限速酵素，SIRT3 依賴性的 ACC1 活化是一個促腫瘤的代謝轉換，為快速增殖的腫瘤細胞提供膜生成、訊號傳遞與能量儲存所需的脂質建構單元；此軸與 AMPK 磷酸化檢查點正交運作。

nodes.label: aak-2
nodes.description: aak-2 is the principal catalytic (alpha) subunit of the Caenorhabditis elegans AMP-activated protein kinase complex, the conserved energy sensor that monitors the AMP/ATP ratio. As the catalytic core, aak-2 transduces bioenergetic stress — raised AMP from low glucose, exercise, or mitochondrial dysfunction — into phosphorylation of anabolic and catabolic targets.
nodes.description_zh_TW: aak-2 是 Caenorhabditis elegans AMP 活化蛋白激酶複合體的主要催化（α）次單元，該複合體是監測 AMP/ATP 比例的保守能量感測器。作為催化核心，aak-2 將低葡萄糖、運動或粒線體功能障礙造成的 AMP 上升等生物能量壓力，轉換為對同化與分解代謝標的的磷酸化。

nodes.label: CANTOS Trial
nodes.description: CANTOS is cited as proof that reducing IL-1beta autoinflammatory signaling decreases cardiovascular events, validating autoinflammation as a treatable mechanism of atherosclerosis alongside the IL-1 blockade context established by anakinra.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CANTOS 被引用為降低 IL-1β 自發性發炎訊號可減少心血管事件的證據，驗證了 autoinflammation 為可治療的動脈粥狀硬化機制，並與 anakinra 所建立的 IL-1 阻斷脈絡相互呼應。

nodes.label: Senescent Cell Accumulation
nodes.description: Aging causes senescent-cell accumulation as telomere shortening, cumulative DNA damage, and stem-cell stress increase senescent-cell formation, while declining immune clearance reduces their removal. The burden rises across multiple tissues, often described as exponential with age, and is a cardinal hallmark linking cellular senescence to organismal aging. The causal direction is reinforced by experiments showing that clearing these cells alleviates age-related dysfunction. Senescent-cell accumulation is therefore both a marker and a driver of the aging process.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 老化造成衰老細胞累積，因端粒縮短、累積 DNA 損傷與幹細胞壓力增加衰老細胞形成，而下降的免疫清除減少其移除。此負擔在多種組織上升，常被描述為隨年齡指數增加，且是連結細胞衰老與個體老化的關鍵特徵。因果方向被清除這些細胞可緩解年齡相關功能障礙的實驗強化。衰老細胞累積因此既是老化過程的標記也是驅動者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md

nodes.label: Hannum Clock
nodes.description: The Hannum clock is a blood-based epigenetic age estimator whose blood-specific training makes it sensitive to immunosenescence and inflammatory states. Its age-acceleration correlates with aging and epigenetic alterations in the immune compartment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hannum 時鐘是基於血液的表觀遺傳年齡估算器，其血液特異訓練使其對免疫衰老與發炎狀態敏感。其年齡加速與免疫區室的衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

nodes.label: Connective Tissue Growth Factor
nodes.description: CTGF (CCN2), a ~36-38 kDa matricellular protein of the CCN family, is a major secreted component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Senescent cells release it in response to DNA damage, and CTGF secreted by senescent fibroblasts in the tumor microenvironment promotes paracrine tumor progression and fibrosis (Coppé et al., 2010).
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTGF（CCN2）是 CCN 家族中約 36-38 kDa 的 matricellular 蛋白，也是 SASP 的主要分泌組成。衰老細胞在 DNA 損傷時會釋放 CTGF，而腫瘤微環境中衰老纖維母細胞分泌的 CTGF 會促進旁分泌型腫瘤進展與 Fibrosis（Coppé et al., 2010）。

nodes.label: PCSK9
nodes.description: SIRT6 deficiency accelerates Atherosclerosis through dysregulation of PCSK9 and consequent LDL accumulation, indicating that SIRT6 normally constrains PCSK9-driven plasma LDL elevation and vascular disease. PCSK9 itself is a secreted protease that drives LDL receptor degradation, so SIRT6 acts upstream to limit the atherogenic node.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 缺失會透過 PCSK9 的失調與隨之而來的 LDL 累積而加速 Atherosclerosis，表示 SIRT6 正常情況下會約束 PCSK9 驅動的血漿 LDL 升高與血管疾病。PCSK9 本身是促進 LDL 受體降解的分泌型蛋白酶，因此 SIRT6 在上游作用以限制這個致粥樣硬化節點。

nodes.label: Trimethylamine N-oxide
nodes.description: Trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) is a metabolite generated from dietary choline, phosphatidylcholine and L-carnitine: gut microbiota produce the trimethylamine precursor, which host hepatic flavin monooxygenase FMO3 oxidises to TMAO. TMAO is a recognised promoter of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Trimethylamine N-oxide（TMAO）是由膳食膽鹼、磷脂醯膽鹼與 L-carnitine 生成的代謝物：腸道菌群產生三甲胺前驅物，再由宿主肝臟的黃素單加氧酶 FMO3 氧化為 TMAO。TMAO 是公認會促進 atherosclerosis 與心血管風險的因子。

nodes.label: MNNG
nodes.description: MNNG is a methylating alkylating agent that generates a high load of DNA strand breaks, hyperactivating PARP1 and driving the parthanatos cascade; PARP inhibitors (DPQ, PJ-34) but not z-VAD block MNNG-induced death (Moura et al. 2024).
nodes.description_zh_TW: MNNG 是產生大量 DNA 斷裂的甲基化烷化劑，會過度活化 PARP1 並驅動 parthanatos 級聯；PARP 抑制劑（DPQ、PJ-34）而非 z-VAD 能阻斷 MNNG 誘導的死亡（Moura et al. 2024）。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

nodes.label: PAANIB-1
nodes.description: PAANIB-1 is a brain-penetrant, selective inhibitor of the PD-D/E(X)K nuclease activity of MIF (PAAN, parthanatos-associated AIF nuclease). It spares MIF's tautomerase and cytokine functions and does not broadly inhibit other nucleases such as APE1, separating the parthanatotic nuclease arm from MIF's inflammatory roles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAANIB-1 是可穿透腦部、具選擇性的抑制劑，針對 MIF（PAAN，parthanatos 相關 AIF 核酸酶）的 PD-D/E(X)K 核酸酶活性。它保留 MIF 的互變異構酶與細胞激素功能，也不廣泛抑制 APE1 等其他核酸酶，將 parthanatotic 核酸酶臂與 MIF 的發炎功能區分開來。

nodes.label: PARP2
nodes.description: PARP2 lowers SIRT1 activity by two mechanisms: substrate competition, since both enzymes consume NAD+, and direct transcriptional repression via binding to the Sirt1 promoter. This places PARP2 at the intersection of genomic instability, NAD+ metabolism and the metabolic/longevity functions of SIRT1, and motivates NAD+-boosting strategies in aging research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARP2 透過兩種機制降低 SIRT1 活性：其一是受質競爭（兩種酵素都消耗 NAD+），其二是直接結合 Sirt1 啟動子進行轉錄抑制。這使 PARP2 處於基因體不穩定、NAD+ 代謝與 SIRT1 代謝／延壽功能的交會點，並為老化研究中的 NAD+ 補充策略提供理由。

nodes.label: TUNEL
nodes.description: TUNEL (terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling) enzymatically tags free 3′-OH DNA ends with labeled dUTP, visualizing the internucleosomal fragmentation of Apoptosis in tissue sections and fixed cells. It is the canonical histological counterpart to the DNA ladder on gels and cleaved Caspase-3 immunostaining.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TUNEL (terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling) 以酵素方式將游離的 3′-OH DNA 末端加上標記的 dUTP，使組織切片與固定細胞中 Apoptosis 的核小體間 DNA 片段化得以可視化。它是凝膠上 DNA ladder 與裂解型 Caspase-3 免疫染色的標準組織學對應物。

nodes.label: Allopurinol
nodes.description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

nodes.label: Amurensin G
nodes.description: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer natural product reported among compounds that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations and endowed with anticancer activity. It belongs to a series that includes aristoforin, polyphenols, and tanikolide identified through general screens of structurally diverse natural products. Directionally, amurensin G suppresses sirtuin deacetylase activity. Its isoform selectivity and mechanism are incompletely characterized, and its anticancer effect may involve both sirtuin inhibition and additional natural-product bioactivities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amurensin G 是一種白藜蘆醇四聚體天然產物，據報導屬於在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的化合物，並具有抗癌活性。它屬於包括 aristoforin、多酚類和 tanikolide 在內的系列，透過對結構多樣化天然產物的廣泛篩選而鑑定。方向性上 amurensin G 抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。其同工型選擇性和作用機制尚未完全表徵，其抗癌效果可能同時涉及 sirtuin 抑制和天然產物的其他生物活性。

nodes.label: Sirtuin Fluorimetric Activity
nodes.description: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., the Fluor de Lys system) are the most commonly used methods to screen molecules as sirtuin inhibitors. Deacetylation of a fluorophore-decoupled substrate sensitizes it to a developer that releases a measurable fluorophore, and percent inhibition is calculated from fluorescence. These assays identified indoles (EX-527), tenovins, JGB1741, sirtinol analogues, and cambinol analogues. A key caveat is that the aminomethylcoumarin moiety of the fluorogenic substrates can affect binding of other small molecules to the enzyme, so confirmation with orthogonal assays is recommended.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 螢光活性測定（例如 Fluor de Lys 系統）是篩選分子作為 sirtuin 抑制劑最常用的方法。去乙醯化的螢光基團解偶聯受質經顯色劑處理後釋放出可量化的螢光基團，從螢光訊號計算抑制百分比。這些測定鑑定了吲哚類（EX-527）、tenovin、JGB1741、sirtinol 類似物和 cambinol 類似物。一個關鍵注意事項是螢光受質的氨基甲基香豆素部分可能影響其他小分子與酵素的結合，因此建議使用正交測定進行確認。

nodes.label: Rossmann fold
nodes.description: The Rossmann fold is a highly conserved structural motif found in many nucleotide-binding proteins, particularly those that bind NAD+/NADH. In the sirtuin family this large domain is the primary binding site for the NAD+ cofactor required for enzymatic activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rossmann fold 是許多核苷酸結合蛋白中高度保守的結構模體，特別常見於結合 NAD+/NADH 的蛋白。在 sirtuin 家族中，這一大型結構域是酵素活性所需 NAD+ 輔因子的主要結合位。

nodes.label: Transition Metals
nodes.description: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) is a chelating agent that binds transition metal ions such as iron and copper, making them inert and drastically slowing the autoxidation of epinephrine. Because these metals catalyze electron transfer from the catechol ring to oxygen, their removal suppresses the formation of the o-quinone intermediate that leads to adrenochrome. The strategy of metal chelation is therefore a key chemical defense against the oxidative conversion of adrenaline into its reactive oxidation product. EDTA exemplifies the broader class of chelating agents used to stabilize catecholamines in pharmaceutical and analytical settings, and it highlights the general principle that transition metal availability controls the rate at which the adrenochrome pathway can proceed in solution.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EDTA（乙二胺四乙酸）是一種螯合劑，可結合鐵、銅等過渡金屬離子，使其失去活性並大幅減緩 epinephrine 的自氧化。由於這些金屬催化電子從兒茶酚環轉移至氧氣，移除它們會抑制導致 adrenochrome 的鄰苯醌中間體的形成。因此，金屬螯合策略是對抗 adrenaline 氧化轉化為其反應性氧化產物的一項關鍵化學防線。EDTA 是藥用與分析環境中用於穩定兒茶酚胺的更廣泛螯合劑類的典型代表，並凸顯了過渡金屬可得性控制 adrenochrome 途徑在溶液中進行的速率這一普遍原則。

nodes.label: Adrenochrome sulfonate
nodes.description: Adrenochrome sulfonate is a degradation product formed when adrenochrome reacts with bisulfite antioxidants in the presence of light. Its formation reflects the photochemical instability of the adrenochrome chromophore.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome sulfonate 是 Adrenochrome 在光照下與 Bisulfite 抗氧化劑反應所形成的降解產物。其形成反映了 Adrenochrome 色基的光化學不穩定性。

nodes.label: EpiPen
nodes.description: Symjepi competes with the pen-style auto-injector and the nasal spray as an epinephrine delivery platform. Its formulation design is explicitly focused on oxidation stability against light, oxygen, and trace metals, so that adrenochrome and polymeric pigment accumulation — and the associated loss of potency — are minimized.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Symjepi 在 Epinephrine 給藥平台上與筆式自動注射器及鼻用噴劑競爭。其配方設計明確聚焦於對光、氧氣與微量金屬的氧化穩定性，使 adrenochrome 與聚合色素的累積（以及伴隨的效力喪失）降至最低。

nodes.label: Anaphylaxis
nodes.description: Symjepi is indicated for the emergency treatment of Anaphylaxis in adults and older children. Because epinephrine is a catecholamine highly susceptible to autoxidation in aqueous solution, container and formulation are engineered to preserve the reduced catechol, giving a 1-2 year room-temperature shelf life and ensuring potency during allergic emergencies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Symjepi 的適應症為成人與較年長兒童的 Anaphylaxis 緊急治療。由於 Epinephrine 是水溶液中極易自氧化的兒茶酚胺，其容器與配方經工程設計以維持還原態的兒茶酚，因而具有 1–2 年的室溫保存期，確保過敏急症時的效力。

nodes.label: Stemness
nodes.description: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK-STAT signaling and STAT3. Because IL-6 is a major Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype component, the senescent secretome can actively reprogram neighboring cells toward a stem-like state - a dual-edged consequence linking senescence to tissue repair and to cancer stemness and therapy resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-6 是體內朝多能性與 stemness 重編程的核心驅動因子，透過 JAK-STAT Signaling 與 STAT3 作用。由於 IL-6 是 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的主要成分，衰老分泌組能主動將鄰近細胞重編程為幹樣狀態——這是連結衰老與組織修復、以及與 cancer stemness 和治療抗性之間的雙刃結果。

nodes.label: CEBPα
nodes.description: C/EBPα is a bZIP transcription factor that, upon senescence entry, is induced and relocalizes to chromatin, occupying senescence-activated enhancers with C/EBPβ and NF-κB (p65/p50). This enhanceosome integrates p38 MAPK phosphorylation signals with NF-κB to drive robust, sustained transcription of IL-6, IL-8 and other SASP components.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C/EBPα 是 bZIP 轉錄因子，在進入衰老時被誘導並重新定位至染色體，與 C/EBPβ 及 NF-κB（p65/p50）共同占據衰老活化增強子。這個 enhanceosome 將 p38 MAPK 磷酸化訊號與 NF-κB 整合，驅動 IL-6、IL-8 與其他 SASP 成分強而持續的轉錄。

nodes.label: IFITM3
nodes.description: IFITM3 is an interferon-inducible endolysosomal membrane protein that restricts enveloped virus fusion by stiffening cholesterol-rich membranes. In aging it is packaged into circulating plasma exosomes/extracellular vesicles; upon uptake by neighboring cells this exosomal IFITM3 triggers senescence programs in the recipients, expanding the senescent cell burden beyond locally damaged tissue and establishing a systemic, IFN-linked senescence-spreading axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IFITM3 是可被干擾素誘導的內體溶酶體膜蛋白，藉由使富含膽固醇的膜僵硬化來限制有外套膜病毒的融合。在老化狀態下它被包裝進循環血漿的外泌體／細胞外囊泡；鄰近細胞攝入後，這些外泌體 IFITM3 會在受體細胞中啟動衰老程式，使衰老細胞負擔超出局部受損組織，形成全身性、與 IFN 相連的衰老傳播軸。

nodes.label: CPS1
nodes.description: CPS1 catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step of the urea cycle, combining ammonium, bicarbonate and two ATP molecules in the mitochondrial matrix to form carbamoyl phosphate, which then condenses with ornithine to form citrulline. By converting a highly toxic amino acid catabolite into urea, CPS1 makes ammonia clearance essential to cellular and systemic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CPS1 催化尿素循環的第一步也是限速步驟，在粒線體基質中將銨離子、碳酸氫根與兩個 ATP 分子結合形成 carbamoyl phosphate，後者再與 ornithine 縮合形成 citrulline。藉由把高度有毒的胺基酸分解副產物轉為尿素，CPS1 使氨的清除成為細胞與全身健康所必需。

nodes.label: Glutathione S-Transferase
nodes.description: NRF2, acting through the Antioxidant Response Element, upregulates the expression of glutathione S-transferases (GSTs), which are pivotal detoxifying enzymes intricately related to antioxidant capacity. This transcriptional program, stimulated in the setting of urolithin A treatment, enhances cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. GSTs are therefore downstream effectors of NRF2 signaling that help protect cells against oxidative and electrophilic stress and that support the removal and turnover of damaged mitochondria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NRF2 透過 Antioxidant Response Element 作用，上調 glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) 的表現，而 GSTs 是與抗氧化能力密切相關的關鍵解毒酶。此轉錄程序在 urolithin A 處理下被刺激，進而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。因此，GSTs 是 NRF2 訊號的下游效應分子，協助保護細胞對抗氧化與親電子壓力，並支持受損粒線體的移除與更新。

nodes.label: Ellagitannins
nodes.description: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

nodes.label: Cilengitide
nodes.description: Cilengitide is a cyclic RGD pentapeptide derivative.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cilengitide 是環狀 RGD 五肽衍生物。

nodes.label: VEGF Family
nodes.description: The VEGF family canonically drives blood-vessel formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VEGF 家族典型驅動血管形成。

nodes.label: Vitronectin
nodes.description: Vitronectin is an abundant plasma and extracellular matrix glycoprotein whose central RGD (Arg-Gly-Asp) motif is the principal integrin-binding site, engaging αvβ3, αvβ5, αvβ6 and α5β1 integrins. Presenting RGD to αv-family integrins nucleates focal adhesions and activates FAK/Src signaling that drives motility and survival.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitronectin 是血浆與細胞外基質中含量豐富的醣蛋白，其中央的 RGD（Arg-Gly-Asp）序列為主要的 integrin 結合位點，可結合 αvβ3、αvβ5、αvβ6 與 α5β1 等 Integrins。向 αv 家族 integrins 呈現 RGD 會成核形成黏著斑，並啟動 FAK／Src 訊號以驅動運動與存活。

nodes.label: Galectin-9
nodes.description: Galectin-9 is a secreted beta-galactoside-binding lectin with two tandem carbohydrate recognition domains that is a component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. It was first reported as a SASP factor secreted by senescent melanoma cells, and its presence contributes to the immunosuppressive arm of the senescent secretome, potentially facilitating tumor immune evasion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Galectin-9 是一種分泌型、具有兩個串聯醣類辨識結構域的 β-半乳糖苷結合凝集素，也是細胞衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的組成成分。它最早被報告為衰老黑色素瘤細胞分泌的 SASP 因子，其存在促成了衰老分泌組的免疫抑制面向，可能協助腫瘤的免疫逃脫。

nodes.label: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
nodes.description: Pulmonary arterial hypertension involves excessive mitochondrial fission mediated by DRP1, contributing to pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation and vascular remodeling. DRP1-mediated fission has been implicated in PAH pathogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肺動脈高壓涉及由 DRP1 介導的過度粒線體分裂，促成肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖與血管重塑。DRP1 介導的分裂被認為與 PAH 致病機轉有關。

nodes.label: Lys68
nodes.description: SIRT3 directly deacetylates Lys68 of MnSOD/SOD2; deacetylated MnSOD shows dramatically enhanced dismutation of superoxide to hydrogen peroxide, reducing mitochondrial oxidative stress. This site is potentiated by SIRT3 activators such as honokiol and dihydromyricetin and serves as a canonical indicator of SIRT3 function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 直接去乙醯化 MnSOD/SOD2 的 Lys68；去乙醯化後 MnSOD 將超氧化陰離子轉為過氧化氫的能力顯著提升，降低粒線體氧化壓力。此位點可被 honokiol 與 dihydromyricetin 等 SIRT3 活化劑增強，並作為 SIRT3 功能的典型指標。

nodes.label: CLEAR Element
