nodes.description: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

nodes.label: Trehalose
nodes.description: Trehalose acts as an autophagy inducer. Induction is mTORC1-independent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 海藻糖作為自噬誘發因子。誘發不依賴 mTORC1。

nodes.label: MiT-TFE family
nodes.description: The microphthalmia (MiT/TFE) family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors comprises TFEB, TFE3, MITF and TFEC. These factors regulate autophagy and lysosomal genes by binding CLEAR elements, and their translocation or nuclear trapping activates the autophagic-lysosomal transcriptional program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 微眼畸形（MiT/TFE）家族的基本螺旋環螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子包含 TFEB、TFE3、MITF 與 TFEC。這些因子藉由結合 CLEAR elements 來調控自噬與溶酶體基因，其轉位或核內滯留可活化自噬－溶酶體轉錄程序。

nodes.label: Steatohepatitis
nodes.description: Autophagy protects against steatohepatitis by clearing lipid droplets (Lipophagy), damaged mitochondria (Mitophagy) and protein aggregates. Steatohepatitis — nonalcoholic steatohepatitis characterized by hepatic steatosis, lobular inflammation and hepatocyte ballooning — progresses to fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma when this clearance fails.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬藉由清除脂質滴（Lipophagy）、受損粒線體（Mitophagy）與蛋白聚集體來防止脂肪性肝炎。非酒精性脂肪性肝炎以肝脂肪變性、 小葉發炎與肝細胞氣球樣變為特徵，當這種清除失效時，疾病會進展為纖維化、肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

nodes.label: S-sulfhydration
nodes.description: S-sulfhydration (persulfidation) is the post-translational modification of cysteine thiols to persulfides (-SSH) by hydrogen sulfide. TFEB undergoes S-sulfhydration at C212, and the modification enhances TFEB activity by promoting its nuclear translocation, the switch that turns on lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S-硫氫化（persulfidation）是硫化氫將半胱胺酸硫醇修飾為過硫化物（-SSH）的轉譯後修飾。TFEB 在 C212 發生 S-硫氫化，該修飾藉由促進其核轉位而增強 TFEB 活性，也就是打開溶酶體生成與自噬基因的開關。

nodes.label: TNKS2
nodes.description: TNKS2 (tankyrase 2, PARP5B) is one of two tankyrase isozymes that catalyze poly-ADP-ribosylation of substrate proteins. Its ankyrin repeat domain binds substrates such as axin, TRF1 and TFEB, and PARsylation of TFEB promotes its destabilisation and restricts its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNKS2（tankyrase 2，PARP5B）是兩種 tankyrase 異構酶之一，催化受體蛋白的 poly-ADP-核糖基化。其 ankyrin repeat 結構域結合 axin、TRF1 與 TFEB 等受體，而 TFEB 的 PARsylation 會促進其去穩定化並限制其溶酶體與自噬基因的轉錄程序。

nodes.label: Tankyrases
nodes.description: Tankyrases (TNKS1 and TNKS2) are PARP5 poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases that interact with and parsylate TFEB, modulating its stability and nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. The PARP domain transfers ADP-ribose units from NAD+ onto glutamate, aspartate or lysine residues, building branched PAR chains that typically tag substrates for proteasomal degradation or altered localisation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tankyrases（TNKS1 與 TNKS2）是 PARP5 類的 poly(ADP-核糖)聚合酶，會與 TFEB 交互作用並對其進行 PARsylation，調節其穩定性與核－細胞質穿梭。其 PARP 結構域將 ADP-核糖單元從 NAD+ 轉移到麩胺酸、天門冬胺酸或離胺酸殘基上，形成分支的 PAR 鏈，通常將受體標記以供蛋白酶體降解或改變定位。

nodes.label: Dopamine Neuron
nodes.description: TFEB-mediated autophagy protects Dopamine Neuron from Alpha-synuclein toxicity. Dopamine neurons of the Substantia Nigra pars compacta are selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease, and deleting TFEB (or Atg7) in mice triggers their degeneration together with protein aggregation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 TFEB 介導的自噬可保護 Dopamine Neuron 免受 Alpha-synuclein 毒性傷害。Substantia Nigra pars compacta 的多巴胺神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中具有選擇易感性，在小鼠中剔除 TFEB（或 Atg7）會誘發其退化與蛋白聚集。

nodes.label: UPRE
nodes.description: XBP1, a member of the CEB/P family of transcription factors, binds the UPRE (unfolded protein response element) in the promoters of its target genes. During ER Stress this direct promoter occupancy switches on the unfolded protein response program, and the same XBP1-UPRE axis also contributes to transcriptional regulation of TFEB.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XBP1 是 CEB/P 轉錄因子家族的成員，它會與目標基因啟動子上的 UPRE（unfolded protein response element）結合。在 ER Stress 期間，這種直接的啟動子佔位會啟動非折疊蛋白反應程式；同一條 XBP1-UPRE 軸也參與 TFEB 的轉錄調控。

nodes.label: MAPK Signaling
nodes.description: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

nodes.label: Cognitive Performance
nodes.description: COMT modulates cognitive performance through an inverted-U (or tonic-phasic) relationship in which intermediate dopamine levels in the prefrontal cortex optimize executive function, while both excessively high (slow COMT) and low (fast COMT) activity shift performance away from the optimum. Met-bearing (slow) genotypes favor stability and working memory under calm conditions, whereas Val-bearing (fast) genotypes favor rapid processing under stress. Thus COMT genotype is a major determinant of individual differences in cognition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: COMT 透過倒 U（或強直相位）關係調節 cognitive performance，其中前額葉皮質中的中間多巴胺水平優化 executive function，而過高（慢 COMT）和低（快 COMT）活動會使性能偏離最佳狀態。含有 Met 的（慢速）基因型有利於平靜條件下的穩定性和工作記憶，而含有 Val 的（快速）基因型則有利於在壓力下快速處理。因此，COMT genotype 是認知個體差異的主要決定因素。

nodes.label: high COMT activity
nodes.description: The Val/Val genotype produces high COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold above Met/Met, due to the thermostable valine-containing enzyme with greater catalytic efficiency. This accelerates inactivation of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, lowering their extracellular signaling duration, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It defines the fast end of the COMT activity spectrum with broad cognitive and physiological consequences. It underlies the rapid catechol clearance seen in Val/Val carriers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型產生高 COMT 酶活性，大約是 Met/Met 的三到四倍，因為熱穩定的含纈氨酸酶具有更高的催化效率。這加速了多巴胺、norepinephrine 和腎上腺素的失活，降低了它們的細胞外訊號傳導持續時間，特別是在前額葉皮質。它定義了 COMT activity 系列的快速端，具有廣泛的認知和生理後果。它是 Val/Val 攜帶者中兒茶酚快速清除的基礎。

nodes.label: Daratumumab
nodes.description: Daratumumab is a frontline anti-CD38 antibody therapy for multiple myeloma, where CD38 is highly expressed on malignant plasma cells. Its clinical efficacy stems from direct and immune-mediated elimination of these cells, including complement-dependent cytotoxicity, antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, and antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis. Directionally, daratumumab sits upstream of myeloma cell clearance. Beyond oncology, its CD38 inhibition has the secondary effect of sparing NAD+ pools that sirtuins depend on, and it depletes CD38+ regulatory immune cells, reshaping the tumor microenvironment to restore anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Daratumumab 是多發性骨髓瘤的一線抗 CD38 抗體療法，其中 CD38 在惡性漿細胞上高度表達。其臨床療效源於直接和免疫介導的這些細胞的消除，包括補體依賴性細胞毒性、抗體依賴性細胞毒性和抗體依賴性細胞吞噬作用。在方向性上，Daratumumab 位於骨髓瘤細胞清除的上游。除了腫瘤學之外，其 CD38 抑制的次級效應是節省 sirtuin 依賴的 NAD+ 池，並耗竭 CD38+ 調節性免疫細胞，重塑腫瘤微環境以恢復抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。

nodes.label: CZ-48
nodes.description: CZ-48 (sulfo-ara-F-NMN) is a cell-permeant NMN analog that acts as an NMN mimetic binding the SARM1 ARM domain, relieving autoinhibition and driving NADase activation. Activated SARM1 produces cyclic ADP-ribose, depletes NAD+ and ATP, and induces non-apoptotic cell death. CZ-48 is the only known molecule with opposite effects on the two principal NAD+ glycohydrolases: it activates SARM1 while inhibiting CD38, pharmacologically separating two enzymes that share substrate and products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CZ-48（sulfo-ara-F-NMN）是可穿透細胞膜的 NMN 類似物，作為 NMN 擬態結合 SARM1 的 ARM 結構域，解除其自體抑制並驅動 NADase 活化。活化的 SARM1 會產生環腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR），耗竭 NAD+ 與 ATP，並誘發非凋亡性細胞死亡。CZ-48 是已知唯一對兩種主要 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶作用相反的分子：它活化 SARM1 卻抑制 CD38， pharmacological 上將這兩個共享底物與產物的酵素區分開來。

nodes.label: GSK-428
nodes.description: GSK-428 is a quinazoline-scaffold small molecule that binds orthosterically within the TIR-domain NADase pocket of SARM1 with nanomolar IC50 potency, blocking NAD+ cleavage and preventing the axonal NAD+ catastrophe that drives Wallerian-type axon degeneration. It belongs to the next-generation non-covalent SARM1 inhibitor class alongside DSRM-3716, offering a higher selectivity and potency profile than the repurposed covalent inhibitor disulfiram, and is aimed at axon-degeneration indications such as chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy and traumatic brain injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GSK-428 是一個喹唑啉骨架的小分子，可正交結合於 SARM1 的 TIR 結構域 NADase 活性位點，IC50 達奈莫耳級，阻斷 NAD+ 切割並防止驅動華勒氏樣軸突退化的軸突 NAD+ 災難。它與 DSRM-3716 同屬新一代非共價 SARM1 抑制劑類別，相較於被重新定位的共價抑制劑 disulfiram 具有更高的選擇性與效力，目標適應症包含化療引起的神經病變與創傷性腦損傷。

nodes.label: NMNH
nodes.description: Adenosine kinase phosphorylates NRH to NMNH, and the resulting NMNH feeds the NAD+ salvage machinery, ultimately replenishing NAD+ through NMNAT and downstream adenylation steps. This makes the enzyme an alternative entry point into NAD+ Biosynthesis that is independent of NMRK1-dependent activation of NR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adenosine Kinase 將 NRH 磷酸化為 NMNH，所產生的 NMNH 送入 NAD+ 補救機制，最後經由 NMNAT 與後續腺苷化步驟補充 NAD+。這使該酵素成為 NAD+ 生合成的替代入口，且獨立於 NMRK1 依賴性的 NR 活化。

nodes.label: Adenosine Kinase
nodes.description: Beyond its classical role of phosphorylating adenosine to AMP in purine salvage, Adenosine kinase acts as an NRH kinase, phosphorylating the reduced nucleoside NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) to generate NMNH. Because NRH is more stable than Nicotinamide Riboside and more potently raises cellular NAD+, this reaction explains why NRH outcompetes NR as a precursor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了在嘌呤補救途徑中將腺苷磷酸化為 AMP 的經典角色之外，Adenosine Kinase 還作為 NRH 激酶作用，將還原核苷 NRH（dihydronicotinamide riboside）磷酸化生成 NMNH。由於 NRH 比 Nicotinamide Riboside 更穩定、且更有效提升細胞 NAD+，此反應解釋了 NRH 作為前驅物為何優於 NR。

nodes.label: 1-Methylnicotinamide
nodes.description: NNMT is the enzyme that methylates Nicotinamide using S-adenosylmethionine to form 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA). Because 1-MNA is the terminal, largely non-recyclable sink of nicotinamide, NNMT activity sets how much nicotinamide remains available for NAD+ resynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NNMT 是以 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸將 Nicotinamide 甲基化形成 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA) 的酵素。由於 1-MNA 是菸醯胺終末且大致不可回收的匯，NNMT 活性決定了仍可供 NAD+ 再合成的菸醯胺量。

nodes.label: CLOCK
nodes.description: BMAL1 and CLOCK form the heterodimer at the centre of the Circadian Rhythm transcriptional-translational feedback loop. The pair drives clock-controlled genes including NAMPT, and their acetylation state set by SIRT1 links the ~24-hour oscillator to cellular energy state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BMAL1 與 CLOCK 組成異二聚體，位於 Circadian Rhythm 轉錄—轉譯回饋迴路的核心。該二聚體驅動包括 NAMPT 在內的時鐘受控基因，而其由 SIRT1 設定的乙醯化狀態則將約 24 小時的振盪器與細胞能量狀態相連結。

nodes.label: RANKL
nodes.description: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is the cell-surface receptor whose ligand is RANKL. Ligand engagement of RANK recruits NF-kB and MAPK signalling machinery, driving osteoclast differentiation from monocyte/macrophage precursors and, downstream, MAPK-dependent phosphorylation and activation of TFE3 (Hershey & Fisher 2004).
nodes.description_zh_TW: RANK (TNFRSF11A) 是細胞表面受體，其配體為 RANKL。RANKL 結合 RANK 後招募 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊息傳遞機制，驅動單核／巨噬細胞前驅細胞分化為 Osteoclast，並在下游經由 MAPK 依賴性的磷酸化活化 TFE3（Hershey & Fisher 2004）。

nodes.label: FLICA
nodes.description: FLICA (fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases) probes such as FAM-YVAD-FMK are cell-permeant, fluorescently tagged caspase inhibitors that covalently bind the active site of cleaved caspases. Because they report enzymatic activity rather than mere protein presence, caspase-1 FLICA is the standard live-cell readout of inflammasome-driven Caspase-1 activation, typically paired with Gasdermin D-N staining and IL-1β or LDH release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FLICA（fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases）探針，例如 FAM-YVAD-FMK，是可穿透細胞膜的螢光標記 caspase 抑制劑，能共價結合已被切割之 caspase 的活性位。由於它反映的是酵素活性而非單純的蛋白表現量，caspase-1 FLICA 是偵測發炎小體驅動之 Caspase-1 活化之標準活細胞讀值方法，通常搭配 Gasdermin D-N 染色以及 IL-1β 或 LDH 釋放量測定。

nodes.label: S100A13
nodes.description: S100A13 is an EF-hand S100 family calcium/copper-binding protein required for the copper- and calcium-dependent nuclear translocation of cleaved IL-1α. Once in the nucleus, IL-1α acts as a transcriptional coactivator for NF-κB target genes, so S100A13 sits upstream of IL-1α rather than acting as a downstream effector.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S100A13 是 EF-hand 型 S100 家族的鈣／銅結合蛋白，負責切割後 IL-1α 依賴銅與鈣的核轉位。IL-1α 進入細胞核後作為 NF-κB 目標基因的轉錄輔激活因子，因此 S100A13 位於 IL-1α 上游而非下游效應端。

nodes.label: Metallic silver
nodes.description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

nodes.label: DAI
nodes.description: DAI (DNA-dependent activator of IRFs) is the original name of ZBP1 (Z-DNA binding protein 1); the molecules are identical, with ZBP1 now the canonical gene name.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DAI（IRF 的 DNA 依賴活化因子）為 ZBP1（Z-DNA 結合蛋白 1）的原名；兩者為同一分子，ZBP1 為現行規範基因名。

nodes.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
nodes.description: Conditional deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD in intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis and IBD-like pathology, but crossing these mice onto a RIPK3-deficient background completely prevents the disease, demonstrating that the epithelial cell death underlying the phenotype is RIPK3-dependent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在腸道上皮中條件性刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引發自發性壞死性凋亡與類 IBD 的病理，但將這些小鼠交配到缺乏 RIPK3 的背景上可完全阻止該病徵，證明其上皮細胞死亡依賴 RIPK3。

nodes.label: PEX12
nodes.description: Biallelic PEX12 loss produces Zellweger spectrum disorders with essentially absent peroxisomal import. PEX12 is the third RING-finger subunit of the importomer, completing the PEX2/PEX10 RING complex; without it the PEX5 receptor cannot be recycled by ubiquitination, so peroxisomal matrix enzymes fail to reach the organelle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX12 的雙等位基因缺失會造成 Zellweger 譜系疾病，過氧化體輸入幾乎完全消失。PEX12 是 importomer 的第三個 RING 指狀次單元，補足 PEX2/PEX10 RING 複合體；缺少它，PEX5 受體便無法藉由泛素化回收，過氧化體基質酵素因而無法送達胞器。

nodes.label: PEX10
nodes.description: Biallelic PEX10 variants cause Zellweger spectrum disorders. PEX10 supplies the RING-finger ubiquitin-ligase activity of the peroxisomal importomer that recycles the PEX5 receptor after cargo import; loss of this activity collapses peroxisomal matrix protein import and yields the severe Zellweger phenotype or milder variants depending on residual function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX10 的雙等位基因變異會造成 Zellweger 譜系疾病。PEX10 提供過氧化體 importomer 的 RING 指狀泛素連接酶活性，負責在貨運輸入後回收 PEX5 受體；此活性喪失會使過氧化體基質蛋白輸入崩潰，依殘餘功能產生嚴重的 Zellweger 表型或較輕的變異。

nodes.label: PEX2
nodes.description: PEX2 encodes a RING-finger ubiquitin ligase of the peroxisomal importomer that, with PEX10 and PEX12, ubiquitinates the PEX5 import receptor to recycle it after cargo delivery. Biallelic loss of PEX2 abolishes this receptor-recycling step and produces the Zellweger spectrum disorder phenotype with defective peroxisomal matrix protein import; milder variants retain residual import capacity and present as infantile Refsum or Heimler syndrome. Zellweger spectrum disorders are autosomal-recessive peroxisome-biogenesis disorders caused by biallelic loss of PEX genes, and PEX2 is one of these causative genes. Its loss abolishes peroxisomal import, producing the severe Zellweger syndrome end of the spectrum (hypotonia, seizures, liver dysfunction, early lethality) or milder infantile Refsum and Heimler phenotypes when residual import function remains.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX2 編碼過氧化體體（importomer）的 RING 指狀泛素連接酶，與 PEX10、PEX12 共同將 PEX5 輸入受體泛素化，以便在貨運送達後回收受體。PEX2 的雙等位基因缺失會使此受體回收步驟失效，造成過氧化體基質蛋白輸入缺陷，並產生 Zellweger 譜系疾病的表型；較輕的變異仍保有部分輸入功能，表現為嬰兒型 Refsum 症候群或 Heimler 症候群。 Zellweger 譜系疾病是一類由 PEX 基因雙等位基因缺失造成的體染色體隱性過氧化體生物合成疾病，PEX2 正是其中的致病基因之一。其缺失會使過氧化體輸入喪失，造成譜系中嚴重端的 Zellweger 症候群（肌張力低下、抽搐、肝功能異常、早期死亡）；若仍保有部分輸入功能，則呈現較輕的嬰兒型 Refsum 與 Heimler 表型。

nodes.label: PEX13
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX13 cause PEX13-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder, roughly 2-5% of cases; missense variants in the SH3-like domain partially impair PEX14 interaction and yield milder phenotypes, while truncating mutations abolish import and cause lethal disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX13 突變會造成 PEX13 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群，約佔所有病例的 2–5%；SH3 樣結構域的錯義變異會部分損害與 PEX14 的交互作用而表型較輕，截短突變則完全消除輸入功能並造成致死性疾病。

nodes.label: Clonal Hematopoiesis
nodes.description: Somatic mutations in the DNMT3A gene are among the most common drivers of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP), a premalignant state in which a single hematopoietic stem cell clone expands in the blood. These mutations impair the enzyme's catalytic activity, altering DNA methylation at loci that regulate self-renewal and differentiation. Because DNMT3A-mutant clones persist and accumulate with age, they confer an elevated risk of hematologic malignancies such as acute myeloid leukemia, as well as cardiovascular disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNMT3A 基因的體細胞突變是不確定潛能克隆造血 (CHIP) 的最常見驅動因素之一，這是一種單一造血幹細胞克隆在血液中擴增的癌前狀態。這些突變損害了酵素的催化活性，改變了調節自我更新和分化的位點的 DNA 甲基化。由於 DNMT3A 突變克隆會隨著年齡的增長而持續存在和積累，因此它們會增加急性髓性白血病等血液系統惡性腫瘤以及心血管疾病的風險。

nodes.label: Biological Age
nodes.description: An epigenetic clock is a statistical estimator of biological age built from DNA methylation measurements at a defined set of CpG sites across the genome. Trained on large cohorts, these clocks compute an epigenetic age that correlates with chronological age but can also deviate from it, reflecting accelerated or decelerated biological aging. Clock acceleration is associated with disease and mortality risk, making epigenetic clocks valuable biomarkers for aging research and for evaluating anti-aging interventions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的統計估計器，是根據基因組中一組定義的 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化測量而建構的。這些時鐘經過對大群體的訓練，計算出與實際年齡相關的表觀遺傳年齡，但也可能偏離實際年齡，反映生物老化的加速或減慢。時鐘加速與疾病和死亡風險有關，這使得表觀遺傳時鐘成為老化研究和評估抗衰老幹預措施的寶貴生物標記。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Inheritance
nodes.description: DNA methylation is the primary carrier of mitotically heritable epigenetic states. Mechanism edge parallels the Epigenetics parent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化是有絲分裂可遺傳表觀遺傳狀態的主要載體。機制邊與 Epigenetics 母項平行。

nodes.label: UHRF1
nodes.description: UHRF1 directs maintenance fidelity of methylation through division. Maintenance mirrors the DNMT1 edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UHRF1 在分裂中指導甲基化的維持保真度。維持呼應 DNMT1 邊。

nodes.label: Common Pathway
nodes.description: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Lysosomal Membrane Permeabilization
nodes.description: Mild lysosomal membrane permeabilization releases cathepsins that cleave Bid and other apical caspases, engaging apoptosis. Extensive LMP floods the cytosol with hydrolases, causing necrosis-like death, while moderate LMP bridges to the apoptotic program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 輕度溶酶體膜通透化釋放組織蛋白酶，剪切 Bid 與其他頂端 caspase 以啟動細胞凋亡。重度 LMP 以水解酶淹沒細胞質造成類壞死死亡，中度 LMP 則橋接至細胞凋亡程式。

nodes.label: Livin
nodes.description: Livin (BIRC7/ML-IAP), a member of the inhibitor of apoptosis family, contains a baculoviral IAP repeat (BIR) domain that directly binds and inhibits the effector caspases caspase-3, -7 and -9, plus a C-terminal RING finger conferring E3 ubiquitin-ligase activity that targets apoptotic proteins for proteasomal degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Livin（BIRC7/ML-IAP）是細胞凋亡抑制蛋白（IAP）家族的成員，含 baculoviral IAP repeat（BIR）結構域，可直接結合並抑制效應型 Caspases（caspase-3、-7、-9）；其 C 端 RING finger 則賦予 E3 泛素連接酶活性，將凋亡相關蛋白標記送往 Proteasome 降解。

nodes.label: Flippase
nodes.description: Flippases maintain the resting asymmetry with phosphatidylserine inward, and scramblases reverse it. Scramblase and flippase are therefore functionally opposed executors of the same membrane decision: rising calcium switches scramblase on and flippase off, collapsing phosphatidylserine asymmetry within minutes to expose the eat-me signal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flippase 藉由將 phosphatidylserine 維持在內側來維持靜止時的不對稱性，而 scramblase 則將其反轉。因此 scramblase 與 flippase 是同一個膜決策的功能性對立執行者：鈣濃度上升會開啟 scramblase 並關閉 flippase，在數分鐘內使 phosphatidylserine 不對稱性崩解而暴露 eat-me 訊號。

nodes.label: diabetic complications
nodes.description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Histamine Intolerance
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the enzyme that breaks down histamine in the gut. By blocking intestinal DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods - aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods - may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This is a major safety consideration for oral aminoguanidine use in supplement or experimental settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二胺氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，該酶在腸道中分解組胺。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可顯著增加對膳食組胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組胺食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這對於口服氨基胍在補充劑或實驗設定中使用來說是一個主要安全考量。

nodes.label: Hydrazines
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine is the principal nitrogen-nitrogen bond derivative used for adrenochrome stabilization. Membership marks the hydrazine pharmacophore.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是用於 adrenochrome 穩定的主要氮氮鍵衍生物。成員關係標記肼藥效團。

nodes.label: Prodrug
nodes.description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) may act as a Prodrug: although its hydrazine group is locked in a Guanylhydrazone bond and thus non-nucleophilic, the conjugate is stable enough for clinical use while remaining plausibly hydrolysable in vivo to release free Aminoguanidine slowly. That would make AMM a controlled-release form whose anti-glycation activity is indirect. Whether this prodrug model holds is unresolved; the alternatives are retained nucleophilicity through the remaining guanidine nitrogens or chelation of the transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）可能作為 Prodrug 發揮作用：雖然其 hydrazine 官能基被鎖在 Guanylhydrazone 鍵中而缺乏親核性，該共軛物仍穩定到足以供臨床使用，卻又可能於體內緩慢水解釋出游離的 Aminoguanidine。這將使 AMM 成為間接發揮抗糖化活性的控釋形式。此 prodrug 模型是否成立尚未定論；其他可能性是由殘餘 guanidine 氮保留親核性，或螯合催化 glycoxidation 的過渡金屬。

nodes.label: Hydrazine
nodes.description: Adrenochrome is very unstable because of its o-quinone, so it is conventionally stabilized by derivatization with hydrazine compounds such as Aminoguanidine, Semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. The resulting stable adducts include Carbazochrome and Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, the hemostatic drugs of the adrenochrome family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 因具 o-quinone 而非常不穩定，因此傳統上以 hydrazine 類化合物（如 Aminoguanidine、Semicarbazide、phenylhydrazine、o-nitrophenylhydrazine、p-nitrophenylhydrazine 與 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine）進行衍生化以穩定之。所得的穩定加合物包括 Carbazochrome 與 Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine，即 adrenochrome 系列的止血藥。

nodes.label: ALKBH5
nodes.description: ALKBH5 is one of the erasers that remove m6A Modification from RNA, acting as a Fe(II)- and 2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase, together with FTO. By demethylating autophagy transcripts such as ULK1, Beclin1 and TFEB mRNA, ALKBH5 raises their stability and translation and therefore increases autophagy output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ALKBH5 是移除 m6A Modification 的 eraser 之一，與 FTO 一同作為依賴 Fe(II) 與 2-酮戊二酸的雙加氧酶作用。它藉由對 ULK1、Beclin1 與 TFEB mRNA 等自噬轉錄本去甲基化，提高其穩定性與轉譯，因而提升自噬產出。

nodes.label: Inflammatory Pain
nodes.description: Honokiol attenuates inflammatory pain, reducing formalin-induced paw-licking behavior in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice. It blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA, glutamate, substance P, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), and decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in superficial laminae (I-II) of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses and hyperalgesia. Its analgesic effects are multifactorial, involving both the inflammatory cascade and glutamatergic/NMDA receptor pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可減輕發炎性疼痛，降低福馬林誘發之發炎期的舔足行為及小鼠的熱痛覺過敏。它能阻斷由 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及前列腺素 E2（PGE2）引發的傷害性訊號傳遞，並降低福馬林誘發的 c-Fos 蛋白在 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的表現。與和厚朴酚相比，厚朴酚對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應與痛覺過敏更具選擇性。其鎮痛作用是多重因素共同造成的，同時涉及發炎級聯反應及麩胺酸能/NMDA 受體路徑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Frontotemporal Dementia
nodes.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

nodes.label: Retinal Pigment Epithelium
nodes.description: The retinal pigment epithelium is a target for cell therapy using iPSC-derived RPE, which is being tested in clinical trials for age-related macular degeneration and Stargardt disease. iPSC-derived RPE cells are transplanted subretinally to replace dysfunctional RPE, restoring phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments, the visual cycle, and the blood-retina barrier. Key release criteria for such grafts include polarized monolayer formation, phagocytic competence, and RPE65 expression, though immune rejection and graft integration remain challenges.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮是使用 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 進行細胞治療的目標，該細胞療法正在針對老年黃斑部病變和 Stargardt 病的臨床試驗中進行測試。 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 細胞被移植到視網膜下以取代功能失調的 RPE，恢復感光器外節的吞噬作用、視覺週期和血液視網膜屏障。此類移植物的關鍵釋放標準包括極化單層形成、吞噬能力和 RPE65 表達，儘管免疫排斥和移植物整合仍然是挑戰。

nodes.label: Lipofuscin
nodes.description: Autophagy is the within-lifetime quality control that partially substitutes for turnover. By clearing damaged organelles, aggregates, and misfolded proteins it limits the build-up of lipofuscin and other aging junk inside long-lived cells. When turnover drops, that quality control is no longer backed by cell replacement and the junk simply piles up.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬是單一細胞生命期內的品質管制，可部分替代細胞更新。它藉由清除受損胞器、聚集物與錯誤折疊蛋白，限制長壽命細胞內脂褐素等老化垃圾的堆積。當更新率下降時，這套品質管制便失去了細胞汰換的支援，垃圾便開始堆積。

nodes.label: BRG1
nodes.description: BRG1 is the catalytic ATPase subunit of the mammalian SWI/SNF (BAF) remodeling complexes, providing the energy that slides and evicts nucleosomes. The related BRM ATPase can substitute in specific complex variants, so BRG1 supplies the hydrolysis step that lets SWI-SNF reshape chromatin and expose regulatory DNA.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRG1 是哺乳類 SWI/SNF（BAF）重塑複合體的催化 ATPase 次單元，提供滑動與驅逐核小體所需的能量。相關的 BRM ATPase 可在特定複合體變體中取代其角色，因此 BRG1 提供了讓 SWI-SNF 重塑染色質、暴露調控性 DNA 的水解步驟。

nodes.label: Alpha Diversity
nodes.description: Alpha Diversity measures the richness and evenness of species within a single community or sample, describing the internal diversity of the Gut Microbiome. It is the within-sample complement of Beta Diversity, which compares turnover between communities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha Diversity 衡量單一群落或樣本內物種的豐富度與均勻度，用來描述 Gut Microbiome 的內部多樣性。它是樣本內的度量，與比較群落間更替的 Beta Diversity 互補。

nodes.label: Disease-Associated Microglia
nodes.description: Disease-Associated Microglia (DAM) denotes a stereotyped transcriptional and functional microglial activation state that emerges in Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation. DAM microglia show altered expression of homeostatic markers and engage phagocytic and lipid-metabolism programmes, representing the brain's attempt to contain proteotoxic burden; the signature is regulated by cues such as TREM2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Disease-Associated Microglia（DAM）指在 Neurodegenerative Disease 與 Neuroinflammation 中出現的一種刻板化轉錄與功能性的微膠細胞活化狀態。DAM 微膠細胞的穩態標記表現改變，並啟動吞噬與脂質代謝程式，代表腦部試圖圍堵蛋白毒性負荷；其特徵受 TREM2 等訊號調控。

nodes.label: Micronuclei
nodes.description: Micronuclei are aberrant nuclear bodies that arise when chromosomes fail to segregate during mitosis and become enclosed in their own nuclear envelope — a visible manifestation of genomic instability. Because their envelope is often defective, micronuclei rupture and expose dsDNA to the cytoplasm, where cGAS localises to sense the DNA.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Micronuclei 是有絲分裂時染色體分離失敗並被獨立核膜包覆所形成的異常核體，是 genomic instability 的可見表現。由於其核膜常有缺陷，micronuclei 會破裂並將雙股 DNA 暴露於細胞質，使 cGAS 定位其中感知 DNA。

nodes.label: Spliceosome
nodes.description: Noncanonical nuclear cGAS recruits the spliceosome through its intrinsically disordered region, which mediates liquid-liquid phase separation with chromatin and RNA-processing machinery. Because cGAS binds spliceosome components directly, phase-separated cGAS condensates concentrate splicing factors and can influence alternative splicing decisions independently of canonical cGAS-STING Pathway interferon output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非典型核內 cGAS 透過其 intrinsically disordered region 招募 spliceosome，該區域藉由與染色質及 RNA 加工機器的 liquid-liquid phase separation 達成此作用。由於 cGAS 直接結合 spliceosome 組分，相分離形成的 cGAS 凝聚體可濃縮剪接因子並影響 alternative splicing 決定，且獨立於典型 cGAS-STING Pathway 的干擾素輸出。

nodes.label: EMT6
nodes.description: EMT6 serves as a model for Radiation Therapy research: it is a cloned BALB/c-derived mouse mammary tumor cell line used as monolayer cultures in vitro and as intradermal solid tumors in BALB/cRw mice in vivo, and it has been extensively characterized for radiation responses. In that model fenbendazole failed to sensitize tumors to radiation, altering neither tumor growth, radiation response nor metastatic pattern, which is why EMT6 is cited as a negative-result model in fenbendazole reviews.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EMT6 是 Radiation Therapy（放射治療）研究的模型：它是源自 BALB/c 小鼠的乳癌細胞株，體外以單層培養、體內以 BALB/cRw 小鼠皮內實體腫瘤兩種形式使用，並已被廣泛用於放射反應的表徵。在該模型中 fenbendazole 未能使腫瘤對輻射增敏，既未改變腫瘤生長、放射反應，也未改變轉移模式，因此 EMT6 在 fenbendazole 的文獻回顧中被引用為陰性結果模型。

nodes.label: Radiation Therapy
nodes.description: Despite structural resemblance to known radiosensitizers, fenbendazole did not alter the radiation dose-response curves of aerobic or hypoxic EMT6 cells, did not radiosensitize EMT6 tumors in vivo, and did not increase the number of lung metastases. It also failed to interact with docetaxel, producing strictly additive rather than synergistic toxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雖然結構類似已知 radiosensitizer，Fenbendazole 並未改變有氧或缺氧 EMT6 細胞的輻射劑量反應曲線，在體內也未使 EMT6 腫瘤增敏，且未增加肺轉移數目。它與 docetaxel 亦無交互作用，毒性僅為相加而非協同。

nodes.label: Cyclin B
nodes.description: Cyclin B is the G2/M cyclin whose binding activates CDK1, forming the Cyclin B-CDK1 (formerly MPF) complex that phosphorylates substrates required for nuclear envelope breakdown, chromosome condensation, and spindle assembly. Its abrupt APC/C-mediated destruction at anaphase enforces the G2/M checkpoint.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin B 是 G2/M cyclin，其結合可活化 CDK1，形成 Cyclin B-CDK1（舊稱 MPF）複合體，磷酸化核膜崩解、染色質濃縮與紡錘體組裝所需的受質。Cyclin B 在後期被 APC/C 迅速降解，使 G2/M 檢查點得以維持。

nodes.label: ASF1a
nodes.description: ASF1a is a core member of the HIRA chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). By delivering newly synthesized H3–H4 dimers to HIRA/UBN1, ASF1a supports the heterochromatic compaction that accompanies permanent growth arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需之 HIRA 伴護蛋白複合體的核心成員。透過將新合成的 H3–H4 二聚體交給 HIRA/UBN1，ASF1a 支持伴隨永久生長停滯的異染色質壓縮。

nodes.label: H2A.X
nodes.description: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

nodes.label: UBN1
nodes.description: UBN1 is a dedicated subunit of the HIRA complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It confers specificity to the HIRA complex for H3.3 deposition during senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 複合體的專屬亞基，為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需。它賦予 HIRA 複合體在衰老期間沉積 H3.3 的特異性。

nodes.label: Tazemetostat
nodes.description: Tazemetostat (EPZ-6438; trade name Tazverik) is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable, selective SAM-competitive inhibitor that binds the catalytic SET domain of EZH2, the enzymatic subunit of Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2). It is approved by the FDA in 2020 for epithelioid sarcoma and EZH2-mutant follicular lymphoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tazemetostat（EPZ-6438；商品名 Tazverik）是同類首創、口服生物可利用的選擇性 SAM 競爭性抑制劑，結合 Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2) 的酵素次單元 EZH2 的催化 SET 結構域。它於 2020 年獲 FDA 核准用於上皮樣肉瘤與 EZH2 突變型濾泡性淋巴瘤。

nodes.label: Hepatocyte
nodes.description: Mature quiescent hepatocytes are the dominant regenerative source after hepatectomy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 成熟靜止肝細胞是肝切除後的主要再生來源。

nodes.label: Farber disease
nodes.description: Farber disease is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ASAH1, leaving less than 5% residual acid ceramidase activity. Ceramide then accumulates in lysosomes of macrophages, joints, skin and CNS, producing the classic triad of painful joint deformities, subcutaneous lipomatous nodules and vocal hoarseness; severity inversely correlates with residual enzyme activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Farber disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性溶小體儲積症，由 ASAH1 的功能喪失突變造成，使 acid ceramidase 殘餘活性低於 5%。因此 ceramide 在巨噬細胞、關節、皮膚與中樞神經的溶小體中累積，形成疼痛性關節變形、皮下脂肪瘤樣結節與聲音嘶啞的典型三聯徵；嚴重度與殘餘酵素活性成反比。

nodes.label: Lands cycle
nodes.description: The Lands cycle (deacylation-reacylation cycle) is a phospholipid remodeling pathway in which free fatty acids are exchanged into the sn-2 position of membrane Phospholipid, thereby changing the fatty acid composition of the membrane pool.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lands cycle（去醯化—再醯化循環）是一條磷脂重塑路徑，將游離脂肪酸交換進膜上 Phospholipid 的 sn-2 位置，藉此改變膜脂池的脂肪酸組成。

nodes.label: Phospholipid
nodes.description: The Lands cycle (deacylation-reacylation cycle) is a phospholipid remodeling pathway in which free fatty acids are exchanged into the sn-2 position of membrane Phospholipid, thereby changing the fatty acid composition of the membrane pool.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lands cycle（去醯化—再醯化循環）是一條磷脂重塑路徑，將游離脂肪酸交換進膜上 Phospholipid 的 sn-2 位置，藉此改變膜脂池的脂肪酸組成。

nodes.label: Sphingolipid Metabolism
nodes.description: Sphingolipid metabolism acts upstream of ferroptosis: the ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P rheostat sets cell fate, and free fatty acids released by acid ceramidase feed phospholipid PUFA enrichment (Lands cycle), creating a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sphingolipid metabolism 作用於 ferroptosis 的上游：ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P 的調節平衡決定細胞命運，而 acid ceramidase 釋出的游離脂肪酸會餵入 phospholipid 的 PUFA  enrich（Lands cycle），形成促 ferroptosis 的脂質組型。

nodes.label: Saposin-D
nodes.description: Saposin-D (SapD) is a small lysosomal saposin that extracts ceramide from the lysosomal membrane and presents it to the active site of acid ceramidase. In its open V-shaped conformation SapD binds and solubilizes the membrane ceramide, solving the substrate-access problem that the crystal structure of acid ceramidase revealed as a hydrophobic membrane-attachment surface around the substrate channel.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Saposin-D（SapD）是溶酶體中的小型 saposin，能自溶酶體膜萃取 ceramide 並呈現給 acid ceramidase 的活性位點。在其開放的 V 形構形下，SapD 會結合並溶解膜上的 ceramide，解決 acid ceramidase 晶體結構所揭示的受質可及性問題——其受質通道周圍具有疏水性的膜附著表面。

nodes.label: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy
nodes.description: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy is caused by hypomorphic mutations in ASAH1 that retain roughly 5–30% residual Acid ceramidase activity. Because the gene retains substantial function, the disorder is milder than the null phenotype; the recurrent c.125C>T (p.Thr42Met) hotspot is a recognized mutation in ASAH1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy 由 ASAH1 的低效突變引起，該突變仍保留約 5–30% 的殘餘 Acid ceramidase 活性。由於此基因保有相當功能，此疾病較同基因 null 表型溫和；反覆出現的 c.125C>T (p.Thr42Met) 熱點突變是 ASAH1 的已知突變。
nodes.norm_label: spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy

nodes.label: iFSP1
nodes.description: Because many therapy-resistant cancers rely on FSP1 for ferroptosis resistance, iFSP1 is being explored to sensitize tumors (e.g., hepatocellular carcinoma) to ferroptosis-based therapy, often in combination with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibitors rather than as monotherapy, reflecting the two-pillar ferroptosis-defense model.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於許多治療抗性腫瘤依賴 FSP1 來抵抗鐵死亡，iFSP1 被探索用於使腫瘤（例如肝細胞癌）對鐵死亡療法增敏，通常與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併使用而非單藥，這反映鐵死亡的雙支柱防禦模型。

nodes.label: Ifosfamide-induced Encephalopathy
nodes.description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label for the treatment of ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, the neurotoxicity associated with ifosfamide administration. For this indication, methylene blue is typically administered intravenously at a dosage of 50 mg every 4 hours until symptom resolution. This regimen is supported by case series and institutional experience, though dosing is individualized based on clinical response, with symptom resolution often occurring within 10 minutes to 24 hours.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療異環磷醯胺誘導的腦病變，即與異環磷醯胺給藥相關的神經毒性。對於此適應症，亞甲基藍通常以 50 mg 劑量靜脈注射，每 4 小時一次，直至症狀緩解。此方案由案例系列和機構經驗支持，但劑量根據臨床反應個體化，症狀緩解通常在 10 分鐘至 24 小時內發生。

nodes.label: Long COVID
nodes.description: Long COVID (post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection) is a chronic multisystem condition with persistent fatigue, cognitive disturbance, dyspnoea and autonomic dysfunction. Mitochondrial and energy-metabolism impairment is among the leading hypothesised mechanisms, which is why some clinicians trial Methylene blue for mitochondrial support.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Long COVID（SARS-CoV-2 感染後的後續症狀）是慢性的多系統疾病，表現為持續疲勞、認知障礙、呼吸困難與自主神經功能異常。粒線體與能量代謝障礙是最主要的假說機制之一，因此部分臨床醫師嘗試以 Methylene blue 作為粒線體支持。

nodes.label: CK2
nodes.description: Casein kinase 2 (CK2) normally restrains NF-κB activation. CK2 phosphorylates the NF-κB inhibitor IκBα (e.g. Ser283), protecting it from stimulus-induced degradation, and also primes IKK and supports NEMO function, so that total CK2 activity sets the threshold for inflammatory transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶 2 (CK2) 平常會抑制 NF-κB 的活化。CK2 會磷酸化 NF-κB 抑制蛋白 IκBα（例如 Ser283），保護它不被刺激誘導的降解；同時也活化 IKK 並支持 NEMO 功能，因此 CK2 的總活性決定了發炎轉錄的起始門檻。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress
nodes.description: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Enhancer-Promoter Looping
nodes.description: Enhancer-promoter looping is regulated within topologically associating domains, the megabase-scale compartments in which DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside. Because TADs confine enhancer-promoter contacts, genes are typically regulated by enhancers located within the same domain, and three-dimensional looping brings these regulatory elements into proximity with their target promoters. This organization allows the SASP to be driven by hyper-connected enhancer-promoter networks whose interactions are restructured during senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環在拓撲關聯域（兆鹼基級的區室）內受到調節，其中DNA序列彼此之間的相互作用比與外部序列之間的相互作用更頻繁。由於 TAD 限制了增強子-啟動子接觸，因此基因通常受到位於同一結構域內的增強子的調節，並且三維環使這些調節元件與其目標啟動子接近。這種組織允許 SASP 由超連接的增強子-啟動子網路驅動，其相互作用在老化過程中被重組。

nodes.label: Scramblase
nodes.description: Elevated cytosolic calcium is the activating signal for scramblases: Ca2+ flips the membrane asymmetry balance — scramblase on, flippase off — and the activation is ATP-independent and bidirectional. Thus calcium signaling is the upstream trigger that scramblase translates into the eat-me signal read out by Annexin V.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣濃度升高是 scramblase 的活化訊號：Ca2+ 會翻轉膜不對稱性的平衡——scramblase 開啟、flippase 關閉——且此活化不依賴 ATP 且為雙向性。因此 calcium signaling 是上游觸發因子，而 scramblase 將其轉譯為由 Annexin V 讀出的 eat-me 訊號。

nodes.label: Drosha
nodes.description: The Microprocessor is the nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex that initiates canonical microRNA biogenesis. One Drosha molecule associates with two DGCR8 molecules, DGCR8 recognizing the pri-miRNA hairpin junction as a molecular ruler and positioning Drosha's RNase III catalytic centre ~11 bp from the basal junction so Drosha makes a staggered cut yielding a 2-nt 3' overhang.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Microprocessor 是啟動典型 microRNA 生合成的核內核糖核蛋白複合體。一個 Drosha 分子與兩個 DGCR8 分子結合，DGCR8 以「分子尺」方式辨識 pri-miRNA 髮夾接合處，將 Drosha 的 RNase III 催化中心定位於距離基底接合處約 11 bp，使 Drosha 進行交錯切割並產生 2-nt 的 3' 突出端。

nodes.label: Chemical memory
nodes.description: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Biomarker
nodes.description: Ki-67 is the standard immunohistochemical proliferation biomarker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ki-67 是標準的免疫組織化學增殖生物標記。

nodes.label: BCA3
nodes.description: BCA3 was originally discovered as a cytosolic binding partner of protein kinase A. It interacts with the catalytic subunit of PKA, facilitating PKA nuclear translocation and its activity toward substrates such as CREB, while the same protein shuttles between cytoplasm and nucleus to modulate inflammatory signalling and cell death in neoplastic tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BCA3 最初是作為 protein kinase A 的細胞質結合伴護蛋白而被發現。它與 PKA 的催化次單元交互作用，促進 PKA 的核轉位及其對 CREB 等受質的活性；同時此蛋白在細胞質與細胞核之間穿梭，在腫瘤組織中調節發炎訊號與細胞死亡。

nodes.label: CHD4
nodes.description: CHD4 is the essential ATPase remodeling subunit of NuRD. Containment records the complex composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CHD4 是 NuRD 必要的 ATPase 重塑次單元。包含記錄複合體組成。

nodes.label: Hypobromous Acid
nodes.description: Eosinophil Peroxidase is the phagocyte enzyme that generates Hypobromous Acid: a cationic heme peroxidase of eosinophil specific granules that uses bromide together with Hydrogen Peroxide as co-substrate to oxidize halides into reactive brominating oxidants. The HOBr it produces brominates protein tyrosine residues, yielding bromotyrosine adducts that serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage in allergic airway disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Eosinophil Peroxidase 是產生 Hypobromous Acid 的吞噬細胞酵素：它是嗜酸性球特異顆粒中的陽離性含血基質過氧化酵素，以 bromide 與 Hydrogen Peroxide 為共同受質，將鹵離子氧化成具反應性的溴化氧化劑。其產生的 HOBr 會溴化蛋白質的 tyrosine 殘基，形成 bromotyrosine 加合物，可作為過敏性氣道疾病中嗜酸性球介導氧化損傷的特異性標記。

nodes.label: FSCV
nodes.description: Fast-scan cyclic voltammetry (FSCV) is an electrochemical technique that measures rapid, real-time changes in neurotransmitter concentration in living brain tissue. Using a carbon-fiber microelectrode and a fast triangular voltage ramp (typically 400 V/s, −0.4 to +1.3 V), FSCV oxidizes dopamine at a characteristic potential to produce a Faradaic current proportional to its concentration, resolving sub-second dopamine release in awake, behaving rodents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 快掃描循環伏安法（FSCV）是一項電化學技術，可在活體腦組織中量測神經傳遞物質濃度的快速即時變化。FSCV 使用碳纖維微電極與快速的三角電壓掃描（典型為 400 V/s，−0.4 至 +1.3 V），在特征電位氧化 dopamine，產生與其濃度成正比的法拉第電流，可解析清醒行為大鼠中次秒級的 dopamine 釋放。

nodes.label: Multidrug Resistance
nodes.description: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: PtdIns(3,5)P2
nodes.description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

nodes.label: GATA4
nodes.description: NF-kB is activated by GATA4, which promotes the pro-inflammatory SASP via TRAF3IP2 (Act1) and by inhibiting autophagy that would otherwise limit damage signals. GATA4 accumulation in senescent cells makes it a specific upstream driver of NF-kB in the arrested state, coupling defective organelle turnover to inflammatory transcription. Unlike DNA-damage-induced activation, this route is selective for the senescence program. The GATA4-NF-kB link is a senescence-selective regulatory pathway that reinforces the inflammatory secretome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NF-κB 被 GATA4 活化，GATA4 透過 TRAF3IP2（Act1）並抑制本可限制損傷訊號的自噬，促進促發炎性 SASP。GATA4 在衰老細胞中的累積使其成為停滯狀態中 NF-κB 的特異上游驅動者，將缺陷胞器更新耦合到發炎轉錄。不同於 DNA 損傷誘發的活化，此途徑對衰老程序具選擇性。GATA4-NF-κB 連結是衰老選擇性的調節路徑，強化發炎性分泌組。

nodes.label: Lysosomal Biogenesis
nodes.description: TFEB, together with TFE3 and MITF, binds CLEAR-box motifs in the promoters of lysosomal genes and is the master transcriptional regulator of lysosomal biogenesis; mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at S211 to retain it in the cytosol, while starvation triggers calcineurin-mediated dephosphorylation and nuclear translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 與 TFE3、MITF 共同結合溶小體基因啟動子上的 CLEAR-box motif，是溶小體生成的主轉錄調控因子；mTORC1 在 S211 位點磷酸化 TFEB 使其滯留於細胞質，而飢餓則引發 calcineurin 媒介的去磷酸化與核轉位。

nodes.label: Melanins
nodes.description: Melanins arise from polymerization of the pigment intermediates dopaquinone and its downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole species, which couple spontaneously to form the brown-black polymers. The same quinone-driven polymerization underlies neuromelanin deposition and adrenochrome conversion to melanin-like products, linking all three pigment routes through shared electrophilic catechol-quinone chemistry.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Melanins 由色素中間體 dopaquinone 及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 物種聚合而成，這些物種會自發偶聯形成棕黑色聚合物。同樣的醌類驅動聚合機轉 underlie 神經黑素的沉積與 adrenochrome 轉為類黑色素產物，將三條色素途徑以共享的親電性兒茶酚—醌化學連結起來。

nodes.label: TREX1
nodes.description: TREX1's C-terminal transmembrane domain anchors it to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane, where it co-localizes with cGAS and STING. The ER-targeting C-terminal domain is essential for TREX1 function in vivo, as forced cytoplasmic mislocalization impairs its ability to prevent innate immune activation. TREX1 forms homodimers via a hydrophobic interface, with back-to-back active sites enabling processive degradation of cytosolic DNA.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TREX1 的 C 端穿膜結構域將其錨定在內質網（ER）膜上，並在該處與 cGAS 及 STING 共定位。ER 定位的 C 端結構域對 TREX1 的體內功能至關重要，因為強迫其錯位至細胞質會損害其抑制先天免疫活化的能力。TREX1 透過疏水介面形成同源二聚體，其背靠背的活性位點可進行細胞質 DNA 的持續性降解。

nodes.label: Wnt-beta-catenin
nodes.description: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling stabilizes β-catenin: Wnt ligand binding Frizzled/LRP receptors inhibits the β-catenin destruction complex, allowing β-catenin to accumulate and translocate to the nucleus, where TCF/LEF transcription factors turn it into a transcriptional activator. This stabilization sustains stemness, proliferation, and fate decisions in the responding cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 典型 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號可穩定 β-catenin：Wnt 配體結合 Frizzled/LRP 受體後抑制 β-catenin 破壞複合體，使 β-catenin 得以累積並轉位進入細胞核，由 TCF/LEF 轉錄因子將其轉化為轉錄活化因子。這種穩定化維持了受應細胞的幹性、增殖與命運決定。

nodes.label: Th2
nodes.description: Type 2 helper T cells (Th2) are a specialized subset of CD4+ T Cells that orchestrate humoral immunity, anti-helminth defense, and allergic inflammatory responses. Th2 cells are defined by their signature production of IL-4, IL-5, and IL-13, which collectively drive IgE production, eosinophil recruitment, and mucus hypersecretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 第二型輔助型 T 細胞 (Th2) 是 CD4+ T Cells 的一個特化亞群，負責協調體液免疫、抗蠕蟲防禦與過敏性發炎反應。Th2 細胞的定義特徵是產生 IL-4、IL-5 與 IL-13，這些細胞激素共同驅動 IgE 生成、嗜酸性球募集與黏液分泌過多。

nodes.label: Gastrulation
nodes.description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

nodes.label: Nanoemulsions
nodes.description: Fisetin-SNEDDS nanoemulsions showed neuroprotection in rotenone-induced Parkinson's Disease rats, reducing TNFα and IL-6 while raising Glutathione, Superoxide Dismutase and Catalase. By delivering the poorly soluble fisetin efficiently, the nanoemulsion converts an oral antioxidant into a bioavailable neuroprotective agent that restores antioxidant capacity in the injured brain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin-SNEDDS nanoemulsions 在 rotenone 誘發的 Parkinson's Disease 大鼠中展現神經保護，降低 TNFα 與 IL-6，同時提升 Glutathione、Superoxide Dismutase 與 Catalase。藉由有效遞送難溶的 fisetin，nanoemulsion 把一種口服抗氧化劑轉化為具生體可用性的神經保護藥物，恢復受損腦部的抗氧化能力。

nodes.label: Sulfiredoxin
nodes.description: Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) is an ATP-dependent repair enzyme that reverses the over-oxidation of typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxins, most notably peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) in mitochondria. It reduces the sulfinic acid (Cys-SO2H) state back to the sulfenic/sulfhydryl state, recycling the peroxiredoxin and restoring peroxide-detoxifying capacity. Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reversibly inactivated when its peroxidatic cysteine is hyperoxidized to sulfinic acid during oxidative bursts. Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) repairs this hyperoxidation in an ATP-dependent reaction, restoring PRDX3's peroxide-scavenging activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴的修復酵素，可逆轉典型 2-Cys 過氧化還原酶（尤其是粒線體中的過氧化還原酶 3，PRDX3）的過度氧化。它將亞磺酸（Cys-SO2H）狀態還原回亞磺烯基/硫氫基狀態，回收過氧化還原酶並恢復過氧化物解毒能力。 在氧化爆發期間，過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）的過氧化半胱氨酸被過度氧化為亞磺酸時會可逆地失活。Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）以 ATP 依賴的反應修復此過度氧化，恢復 PRDX3 的過氧化氫清除活性。

nodes.label: DNA Methyltransferase
nodes.description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

nodes.label: eIF5A
nodes.description: Translation Initiation involves eIF5A in addition to the eIF4F subunits. eIF5A undergoes hypusination, a post-translational modification dependent on spermidine, and the modified form supports peptide bond formation at difficult motifs; it is also implicated in TFEB regulation, linking polyamine metabolism to autophagy control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 除了 eIF4F 次單元外還涉及 eIF5A。eIF5A 會進行 hypusination（一種依賴 spermidine 的轉譯後修飾），修飾後的形式可在困難的序列基序處支援肽鍵形成；它也參與 TFEB 的調控，將多胺代謝連結至自噬調控。

nodes.label: PGAM5
nodes.description: Upstream of the necroptotic program, RIPK3 upregulates PGAM5, which enhances Cyclophilin D phosphorylation, prolongs mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, and drives endothelial necroptosis in cardiac microvascular ischemia-reperfusion. This makes CypD-mPTP the mitochondrial execution arm of necroptosis, complementary to the MLKL plasma-membrane pore arm.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 necroptosis 計畫的上游，RIPK3 上調 PGAM5，後者促進 Cyclophilin D 磷酸化、延長 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟時間，並在心肌微血管缺血再灌流中驅動內皮 necroptosis。這使 CypD-mPTP 成為 necroptosis 的粒線體執行臂，與 MLKL 質膜孔道臂互補。

nodes.label: Ifosfamide
nodes.description: Ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy — confusion, hallucination and coma — is attributed to its chloroacetaldehyde metabolite and is effectively reversed by intravenous methylene blue (50 mg every 4-6 h), which restores the mitochondrial electron transport that the toxic metabolite inhibits. Prophylactic dosing is used in high-risk patients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ifosfamide 引發的腦病變——意識混亂、幻覺與昏迷——歸因於其代謝物 chloroacetaldehyde，並可被靜脈注射 methylene blue（每 4–6 小時 50 mg）有效逆轉；methylene blue 可恢復被該毒性代謝物抑制的粒線體電子傳遞。高風險患者會使用預防性給藥。

nodes.label: Gut-Brain Axis
nodes.description: The gut-brain axis is a bidirectional communication network connecting the central nervous system with the gastrointestinal tract and its resident gut microbiome. The vagus nerve provides rapid afferent and efferent signaling, while microbial metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids, cytokines, and the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis relay hormonal and immune information.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gut-brain axis 是連結中樞神經系統與 gastrointestinal tract 及其 resident gut microbiome 的雙向通訊網絡。Vagus nerve 提供快速的 afferent 與 efferent 訊號，微生物代謝物（如 short-chain fatty acids）、cytokines 與 hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis 則傳遞荷爾蒙與免疫訊息。

nodes.label: SLC19A1
nodes.description: SLC19A1 amplifies the cGAS-STING Pathway in a paracrine manner by importing extracellular cGAMP, allowing STING activation signals to be transferred between cells. Expression of SLC19A1 may therefore predict response to STING agonists, since import is the rate-limiting step in signal spread.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC19A1 藉由攝入細胞外 cGAMP，以旁分泌方式放大 cGAS-STING Pathway，使 STING 活化訊號能在細胞之間傳遞。因此 SLC19A1 的表現可能預測對 STING 致效劑的反應，因為攝入是訊號擴散的限速步驟。

nodes.label: CD86
nodes.description: CTLA-4 (CD152) is an inhibitory receptor upregulated after T-cell activation that outcompetes CD28 for CD80/CD86 binding, delivering off-signals that terminate T-cell responses. Germline haploinsufficiency of CTLA-4 causes autoimmunity, and its higher surface affinity for the shared ligands is what makes blockade effective immunotherapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 (CD152) 是 T 細胞活化後上調的抑制性受體，會在 CD80/CD86 結合上與 CD28 競爭，傳遞終止 T 細胞反應的抑制訊號。CTLA-4 的胚單倍型不足會造成自體免疫，而它對共用配體較高的表面親和力，正是阻斷 CTLA-4 能成為有效免疫療法的關鍵。

nodes.label: Interferon-gamma
nodes.description: IDO1 transcription is strongly induced by the pro-inflammatory cytokine Interferon-gamma through the JAK/STAT1 pathway, with TNF-α, IL-1β, LPS and glucocorticoids able to synergize in certain cellular contexts. Because IFNγ is a hallmark of the antitumor immune response, IFNγ-driven IDO1 induction in tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes helps suppress antitumor immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IDO1 的轉錄會被發炎性細胞激素 Interferon-gamma 透過 JAK/STAT1 路徑強烈誘導，在某些細胞情境下 TNF-α、IL-1β、LPS 與類固醇可協同作用。由於 IFNγ 是抗腫瘤免疫反應的標誌，腫瘤與腫瘤引流淋巴結中由 IFNγ 驅動的 IDO1 誘導有助於壓抑抗腫瘤免疫。

nodes.label: Polo kinase 3
nodes.description: Polo kinase 3 phosphorylates the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL at Ser49 during cell cycle progression and at checkpoint states, altering Bcl-xL's capacity to restrain Apoptosis and tipping damaged cells toward mitochondrial death. The site is distinct from the Ser62 targeted by PLK1, marking Plk3 as a stress-coupled rather than mitotic-execution kinase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Polo kinase 3 在細胞週期推進與檢查點狀態下於 Ser49 磷酸化抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-xL，改變 Bcl-xL 抑制 Apoptosis 的能力，使受損細胞倒向線粒體死亡。此位點與 PLK1 所標的的 Ser62 不同，標示出 Plk3 是與壓力偶聯的激酶，而非執行有絲分裂者。

nodes.label: Homer1
nodes.description: Homer1 serves as a marker of excitatory synapse maturity and of Synaptic plasticity more broadly, because its abundance tracks spine density and the capacity for long-term potentiation. Interventions that raise PINK1–DRP1 signaling therefore improve synaptic plasticity by restoring Homer1-positive synapses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Homer1 可作為興奮性突觸成熟度以及更廣義 Synaptic plasticity 的標記，因為其豐富程度與樹突棘密度及長期增強能力相符。因此提升 PINK1–DRP1 訊號的介入措施，可藉由恢復 Homer1 陽性突觸而改善突觸可塑性。

nodes.label: CRISPR
nodes.description: CRISPR-based genome editing is used in cellular reprogramming to delete or modify genes that limit the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells. In the classic example, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout of the transcription factor Oct4 in reprogramming studies demonstrates how targeted gene disruption can probe the requirements of pluripotency. Beyond knockouts, CRISPRi and CRISPRa allow transient modulation of reprogramming factors and pathways, enabling more efficient and controllable iPSC generation and lineage conversion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基於 CRISPR 的基因組編輯用於細胞重編程，以刪除或修改限制誘導多能幹細胞生成的基因。在經典範例中，重編程研究中 CRISPR-Cas9 介導的轉錄因子 Oct4 敲除證明了標靶基因破壞如何能夠偵測多能性的要求。除了敲除之外，CRISPRi 和 CRISPRa 還可以瞬時調節重編程因子和途徑，從而實現更有效率、更可控的 iPSC 生成和譜系轉換。

nodes.label: UBL-5
nodes.description: UBL-5 is a ubiquitin-like protein in Caenorhabditis elegans that functions as an essential transcriptional cofactor for the mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Loss of ubl-5 function abolishes the UPRmt, causing accumulation of misfolded mitochondrial proteins, shortened lifespan, and hypersensitivity to mitochondrial toxins such as ethidium bromide.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UBL-5 是 Caenorhabditis elegans 中的類泛素蛋白，作為 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 不可或缺的轉錄輔因子。ubl-5 功能喪失會使 UPRmt 失效，造成錯誤摺疊粒線體蛋白累積、壽命縮短，以及對 ethidium bromide 等粒線體毒物的高度敏感。

nodes.label: Dicarbonyls
nodes.description: Besides the Maillard reaction, advanced glycation end products can be formed through alternative pathways. The autoxidation of glucose and the lipid peroxidation of lipids into dicarbonyl derivatives, driven by increases in oxidative stress, are well-studied routes. These dicarbonyl derivatives, known as alpha-oxaldehydes, include glyoxal, methylglyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which can interact with amino groups on macromolecules and form AGEs. This connection between lipid oxidation, oxidative stress, and protein glycation illustrates how glycation and oxidation damage are intertwined and why AGEs often coexist with markers of oxidative damage in aging tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Besides the Maillard reaction，advanced glycation end products可through alternative pathways形成。由increases in oxidative stress所driven的glucose autoxidation，以及lipid peroxidation of lipids into dicarbonyl derivatives，是well-studied routes。這些known as alpha-oxaldehydes的dicarbonyl derivatives包括glyoxal、methylglyoxal與3-deoxyglucosone，它們可interact with amino groups on macromolecules並form AGEs。此connection between lipid oxidation、oxidative stress與protein glycation illustrates how glycation與oxidation damage are intertwined，以及為何AGEs常coexist with markers of oxidative damage in aging tissues。

nodes.label: Deacetylation
nodes.description: Sirtuin deacetylation consumes one NAD+ per event, hydrolyzing it to nicotinamide and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. Because of this stoichiometry, deacetylation is activated by fasting, exercise and Caloric Restriction when NAD+ rises, and inhibited when the NAD+/NADH ratio is high and NAD+ is limiting — so declining NAD+ with age directly limits deacetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: sirtuin 去乙醯化每個事件消耗一個 NAD+，將其水解為 nicotinamide 與 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose。由於此化學計量，去乙醯化會在禁食、運動與熱量限制使 NAD+ 上升時被活化，並在 NAD+/NADH 比值高、NAD+ 受限時被抑制——因此隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 會直接限制去乙醯化。

nodes.label: Thymopoiesis
nodes.description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

nodes.label: Kaempferol
nodes.description: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

nodes.label: Hemolysis
nodes.description: Hemolysis may occur during the treatment of methemoglobinemia with methylene blue, mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties which can overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, particularly in susceptible individuals. Laboratory findings can include Heinz bodies, elevated indirect bilirubin, decreased haptoglobin, and a negative direct antiglobulin test, with anemia developing one or more days after administration. The American Heart Association emphasizes that patients with G6PD deficiency are at markedly increased risk, as impaired NADPH generation limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis and worsening anemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在治療methemoglobinemia時使用methylene blue可能發生溶血，這在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性可能壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，特別是在易感個體中。實驗室結果可能包括Heinz小體、間接膽紅素升高、結合珠蛋白降低和直接抗球蛋白試驗陰性，貧血在給藥後一天或更長時間後發生。美國心臟協會強調，G6PD缺乏症患者的風險顯著增加，因為NADPH生成受損限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，從而易於快速溶血和貧血惡化。

nodes.label: Crown-like Structures
nodes.description: Crown-like structures (CLS) are histological formations in obese adipose tissue in which macrophages, predominantly of the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, form a ring around a single dead or dying adipocyte. CLS form after adipocyte hypertrophy and death, and their density in biopsies reports the inflammatory status of the tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Crown-like Structures（CLS）是肥胖脂肪組織中的組織學構造，巨噬細胞（以促發炎 M1 表型為主）環繞單一死亡或瀕死 adipocyte 形成環狀排列。CLS 在 adipocyte肥大與死亡後形成，其在活檢中的密度可反映組織的發炎狀態。

nodes.label: Valine
nodes.description: Valine is one of the three Branched-Chain Amino Acids and, unlike leucine and isoleucine, is fully glucogenic: its carbon skeleton is routed exclusively to succinyl-CoA, which enters the TCA cycle to make ATP and support hepatic gluconeogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Valine 是三大 Branched-Chain Amino Acids 之一，且與 leucine、isoleucine 不同，屬完全生糖性：其碳骨架專一地流向 succinyl-CoA，後者進入 TCA cycle 產生 ATP 並支持肝臟的 gluconeogenesis。

nodes.label: cADPR
nodes.description: cADPR (cyclic ADP-ribose) is a cyclic nucleotide second messenger synthesized from NAD+ by ADP-ribosyl cyclases, representing roughly 2-3% of the total NAD+ consumed by CD38, the dominant mammalian enzyme responsible.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cADPR（環狀 ADP-核糖）是由 ADP-核糖基環化酶從 NAD+ 合成的環狀核苷酸第二訊使，約佔哺乳動物主要負責酵素 CD38 總 NAD+ 消耗量的 2-3%。

nodes.label: Diethylcarbamazine
nodes.description: Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) is a piperazine-derived synthetic antifilarial whose primary approved indication is Lymphatic Filariasis, where it is typically given as annual single-dose mass treatment with Ivermectin or Albendazole. DEC rapidly kills both microfilariae and adult worms, potentiating eosinophil- and macrophage-mediated killing while altering parasite membrane permeability and motility.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diethylcarbamazine（DEC）是哌嗪衍生的合成抗絲蟲藥，主要核准適應症為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病），通常與 Ivermectin 或 Albendazole 一起以每年單次劑量進行大規模投藥。DEC 能迅速殺死微絲蟲與成蟲，並藉增強嗜酸性球與巨噬細胞介導的殺傷、改变寄生蟲膜通透性與運動性而作用。

nodes.label: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis
nodes.description: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (NEAT) is the energy spent on fidgeting, posture maintenance, standing, and walking rather than deliberate exercise; together with exercise costs it forms the activity component of daily Energy Expenditure and is its most variable component between individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (NEAT) 是坐立不安、姿勢維持、站立與步行等非刻意運動所消耗的能量；它與刻意運動的消耗共同構成每日 Energy Expenditure 的活動部分，也是個體間變異最大的組成。

nodes.label: Sirtuin-Caspase Crosstalk
nodes.description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

nodes.label: Atrogin-1
nodes.description: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression is transcriptionally controlled by FoxO family factors. FoxO activation, which occurs under fasting, denervation and other atrophic stimuli, drives Atrogin-1 transcription and thereby initiates the ubiquitin-proteasome program for myofibrillar protein disposal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) 是肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，其表現受 FoxO 家族轉錄因子調控。在禁食、失去神經支配及其他萎縮刺激下，FoxO 被活化並驅動 Atrogin-1 的轉錄，進而啟動肌原纖維蛋白的泛素－蛋白酶體分解程序。

nodes.label: MacroD2
nodes.description: MacroD2 is a ~47 kDa MacroD-type macrodomain ADP-ribosylation eraser in cytosol and nucleus. Using a substrate-assisted mechanism — the ADP-ribose alpha-phosphate activates a positioned catalytic water for nucleophilic attack at ribose C1'' — it hydrolyses mono-ADP-ribose linked to aspartate/glutamate, e.g. PARP10/PARP1 mono-marks, and deacetylates O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. It is inactive toward poly-ADP-ribose, acting only after PARG.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MacroD2 是約 47 kDa 的 MacroD 型巨結構域 ADP-核糖基化「擦除者」，位於細胞質與細胞核。它採用受質輔助的機制——ADP-核糖的 α-磷酸活化一個定位好的催化水分子，親核進攻核糖 C1''——水解與天門冬胺酸／麩胺酸酯鍵結的單一 ADP-核糖（例如 PARP10/PARP1 的單一標記），並去乙醯化 O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。它對 poly-ADP-核糖無活性，只在 PARG 之後作用。

nodes.label: Palbociclib
nodes.description: Palbociclib (125 mg/day, 21 days on / 7 days off) is standard first-line therapy for HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer, where it induces G1/S arrest by preventing Rb phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Palbociclib（125 mg/日，連用 21 天、停 7 天）是 HR+/HER2- 轉移性乳癌的標準一線治療，藉由阻止 Rb 磷酸化誘導 G1/S 期停滯。

nodes.label: Erastin
nodes.description: Erastin binds and inhibits the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter, specifically its SLC7A11 light chain, blocking cystine import. The resulting cysteine shortage throttles glutathione synthesis, leaving GPX4 unable to reduce phospholipid hydroperoxides and allowing ROS-mediated lipid peroxidation to propagate — the core execution axis of ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Erastin 結合並抑制 system Xc- 半胱胺酸／麩胺酸對向運輸體，特別是其 SLC7A11 輕鏈，阻斷半胱胺酸輸入。隨之而來的半胱胺酸短缺抑制 glutathione 合成，使 GPX4 無法還原磷脂質過氧化物，讓 ROS 介導的脂質過氧化持續擴散——這正是 ferroptosis 的核心執行軸。

nodes.label: Pembrolizumab
nodes.description: Blocking antibodies against PD-1 such as nivolumab and pembrolizumab, and against PD-L1 such as atezolizumab and avelumab, reinvigorate exhausted CD8+ T Cell effectors and are approved across many malignancies. Response is strongest in tumors with neo-antigen burden and PD-L1 expression, and is limited by primary resistance and immune-related adverse events from loss of tolerance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 針對 PD-1 的阻斷抗體如 nivolumab 與 pembrolizumab，以及針對 PD-L1 的 atezolizumab 與 avelumab，可重新活化耗竭的 CD8+ T Cell 效應細胞，並已於多種腫瘤獲得核准。反應在具有新抗原負載且表現 PD-L1 的腫瘤中最強，並受原發抗藥性與失去耐受性所致的免疫相關不良事件所限。

nodes.label: mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment
nodes.description: Ragulator is required for the mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment: loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. That double consequence makes Ragulator the lynchpin of lysosomal nutrient coupling, since it is needed both to switch mTORC1 off at the membrane and to prevent constitutive autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ragulator 對 mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment 而言是必需的：Ragulator 缺失會破壞營養依賴性的 mTORC1 訊號並解除對自噬的抑制。這種雙重後果使 Ragulator 成為溶酶體營養耦合的關鍵，因為它既是關閉膜上 mTORC1 所必需，也是防止自噬持續活化所必需。

nodes.label: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
nodes.description: Healthy Mitochondria isolated from human umbilical cord–derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells, when transplanted into replicatively senescent cells, reverse mitochondrial dysfunction and reduce the senescence markers p16 and p21 along with SASP factors TNFα and IL-8. This mitochondrial transplantation is offered as strong causal evidence that mitochondrial dysfunction is a significant driver of Senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自人臍帶來源 Mesenchymal Stem Cells 取得的健康 Mitochondria，移植至複製性衰老細胞後，可逆轉粒線體功能障礙，並降低衰老標記 p16 與 p21 以及 SASP 因子 TNFα 與 IL-8。這項粒線體移植提供了強力的因果證據，顯示粒線體功能障礙是 Senescence 的重要驅動因子。

nodes.label: METTL14
nodes.description: METTL14 is the scaffolding partner of METTL3 in the writer complex for N6-methyladenosine, stabilising the methyltransferase and shaping which adenosines are modified. In senescence the METTL3–METTL14 complex also redistributes genome-wide and accumulates at enhancers of SASP genes, an activity-independent structural role.
nodes.description_zh_TW: METTL14 是 N6-methyladenosine writer 複合體中 METTL3 的支架夥伴，負責穩定甲基轉移酶並決定哪些腺苷被修飾。在 senescence 中，METTL3–METTL14 複合體還會全基因組重新分布並累積於 SASP 基因的增強子，屬於不依賴催化活性的結構性角色。

nodes.label: insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
nodes.description: Insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE, insulysin) is a zinc metalloprotease best known for cleaving insulin and other small peptides and thereby regulating insulin clearance, limiting hyperinsulinaemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Insulin-degrading enzyme（IDE，insulysin）是一種鋅金屬蛋白酶，最著名的是切割胰島素與其他小胜肽，藉此調節胰島素清除、限制高胰島素血症。

nodes.label: Triiodothyronine
nodes.description: Triiodothyronine (T3) is the principal active thyroid hormone, produced largely by peripheral 5'-deiodination of thyroxine in liver, kidney and skeletal muscle. It binds nuclear thyroid-hormone receptors to regulate transcription of metabolic genes, and is a major endocrine determinant of basal metabolic rate: hypothyroidism lowers resting metabolic rate while hyperthyroidism raises it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Triiodothyronine（T3）是主要的活性甲狀腺荷爾蒙，主要由肝臟、腎臟與骨骼肌的周邊 5'-去碘化作用將 thyroxine 轉換而來。它結合核內甲狀腺荷爾蒙受體以調控代謝相關基因的轉錄，是基礎代謝率的主要內分泌決定因子：甲狀腺功能低下會降低 Resting Metabolic Rate，功能亢進則使其上升。

nodes.label: Human Endogenous Retrovirus
nodes.description: The human subset of endogenous retroviruses is termed HERV. Present across vertebrates, HERVs are normally epigenetically silenced by DNA methylation and repressive histone marks and constitute about 8% of the human genome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒在人類的子群稱為 HERV。ERV 存在於所有脊椎動物中，平時受 DNA 甲基化與抑制性組蛋白標記的表觀遺傳沉默，約占人類基因體的 8%。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: Melanocyte
nodes.description: The distant Metastatic colonization step that melanocyte-derived Melanoma must achieve is limited by Oxidative Stress in the metastatic niche. This is why melanoma cells co-opt Selenocysteine-dependent translation: sustaining antioxidant selenoproteins is what allows them to survive the oxidative burden of a distant site.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 Melanocyte 衍生出的 Melanoma 必須完成的遠端 Metastatic colonization 步驟，受到轉移微環境中 Oxidative Stress 的限制。這也是黑色素瘤細胞為何會挪用 Selenocysteine 依賴性的轉譯：維持抗氧化性的 selenoprotein，正是讓它們得以在遠端微環境的氧化負荷下存活的原因。

nodes.label: Ribosome Biogenesis
nodes.description: RNA polymerase I transcribes the 18S, 5.8S and 28S rRNA genes in the nucleolus, and each ribosome requires a single 45S precursor rRNA transcript. Pol I output is therefore the rate-limiting step of ribosome biogenesis and sets the ceiling on protein synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA 聚合酶 I 在核仁中轉錄 18S、5.8S 與 28S rRNA 基因，而每個核糖體都需要一條 45S 前驅 rRNA 轉錄本。因此 Pol I 的產出是核糖體生成的限速步驟，並為蛋白質合成設定上限。

nodes.label: Hallmarks of Cancer
nodes.description: Resisting cell death, and apoptosis in particular, is enumerated as one of the original hallmarks of cancer. By disabling the apoptotic machinery, tumor cells tolerate genomic instability and survive therapies that depend on death execution. The relationship is directional: loss of apoptosis enables cancer rather than cancer instructing the loss. Most cytotoxic and targeted agents ultimately require restoration of apoptosis to succeed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抵抗細胞死亡，特別是細胞凋亡，被列為原始Hallmarks of Cancer之一。透過禁用凋亡機制，腫瘤細胞可以耐受基因組不穩定性並在依賴死亡執行的治療中存活下來。這種關係是方向性的：細胞凋亡的喪失會引發癌症，而不是癌症導致細胞凋亡。大多數細胞毒性藥物和標靶藥物最終需要恢復細胞凋亡才能成功。

nodes.label: Neutrophil Elastase
nodes.description: Neutrophil Elastase (ELANE) is an azurophil-granule serine protease released during neutrophil activation that translocates to the nucleus in NETosis, clips histones to aid chromatin decondensation via a PAD4-independent route, and decorates extruded NETs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neutrophil Elastase (ELANE) 是嗜天青顆粒中的絲胺酸蛋白酶，在中性球活化時釋放，並於 NETosis 過程中轉位至細胞核、切割組蛋白以經由 PAD4 非依賴途徑促進染色質去凝縮，同時裝飾被擠出的 NETs。

nodes.label: KDM6A
nodes.description: Unlike most X-linked genes, KDM6A escapes X-chromosome inactivation, so both X alleles in females are transcribed and roughly twice the protein of males is produced (the degree of escape varies by tissue and individual). This biallelic dosage advantage means females require two loss-of-function hits for complete inactivation while a single mutation suffices in males, a key reason for the female advantage in the EXITS tumor suppressor framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與多數 X 連鎖基因不同，KDM6A 可逃脫 X 染色體失活，因此雌性的兩條 X 等位基因皆會被轉錄，產生的蛋白質約為雄性的兩倍（逃脫程度依組織與個體而異）。這種雙等位基因劑量優勢意味著雌性需要兩次功能喪失「擊中」才能完全失活，而雄性單次突變即足夠，這是 EXITS 腫瘤抑制因子框架中雌性優勢的重要原因。

nodes.label: OMA1
nodes.description: OMA1 is constitutively present but normally restrained; its activity is sharply upregulated in response to mitochondrial stress signals, particularly loss of Mitochondrial Membrane Potential (ΔΨm), perturbed protein import, or accumulation of unfolded proteins. Excess or prolonged OMA1 activation collapses cristae, sensitizes cells to apoptosis and cooperates with the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OMA1 平時持續存在但受到抑制；其活性會在粒線體壓力訊號出現時顯著上升，尤其是粒線體膜電位（Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, ΔΨm）喪失、蛋白輸入受擾或未折疊蛋白堆積時。過度或持續的 OMA1 活化會使嵴崩解、使細胞對凋亡敏感，並與 PINK1/Parkin 的 mitophagy 機制協同作用。

nodes.label: Sympathetic nerve endings
