nodes.description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

nodes.label: Connective Tissue
nodes.description: Fascia is the body's continuous sheet-like connective-tissue continuum — a three-dimensional web of collagen, elastin and hydrated ground substance — that wraps, separates and connects muscles, bones, vessels, nerves and organs. Classified by the Fascia Nomenclature Committee into subcutaneous, deep, visceral and parietal layers, it forms a single tensegrity network rather than isolated sheets.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fascia 是人體連續片狀的 connective tissue 連續體——由 collagen、elastin 與含水基質構成的三維網絡——包裹、分隔並連接肌肉、骨骼、血管、神經與器官。依 Fascia Nomenclature Committee 分為淺層、深層、臟器層與壁層，它構成的是單一的張力整體網絡而非彼此孤立的膜片。

nodes.label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
nodes.description: DLD is the E3 flavoprotein subunit shared by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase. It reoxidizes the dihydrolipoyl groups generated during decarboxylation, regenerating the lipoamide cofactor and transferring electrons to NAD+, so DLD activity is required for the complexes that feed carbon into the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DLD 是 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase、α-酮戊二酸去氫酶與支鏈酮酸去氫酶共用的 E3 黃素蛋白次單元。它將脫羧過程產生的 dihydrolipoyl 基團再氧化，重新生成 lipoamide 輔基並將電子轉移給 NAD+，因此 DLD 活性是將碳送入 TCA 循環的這些複合體所必需。

nodes.label: Tissue Plasminogen Activator
nodes.description: Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) is a serine protease that cleaves plasminogen at Arg561-Val562 to generate plasmin, the active protease that degrades cross-linked fibrin. Plasmin in turn cleaves single-chain tPA to the more active two-chain form, creating a positive feedback loop that amplifies fibrinolysis at the clot surface.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tissue plasminogen activator（tPA）是一種絲胺酸蛋白酶，於 Arg561-Val562 處切割 plasminogen 生成 plasmin；plasmin 進而切割單鏈 tPA 生成活性更高的雙鏈形式，形成在血塊表面放大 fibrinolysis 的正回饋迴路。

nodes.label: Biphasic Dose-Response Curve
nodes.description: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

nodes.label: E2F1
nodes.description: Retinoblastoma Protein inhibits proliferation by binding to and inactivating E2F1, a key transcriptional activator of cell cycle and cell division genes. E2F1 itself plays a dual role, acting as a master regulator of cell cycle progression at the G1/S transition and as a potent driver of apoptosis in response to severe DNA damage or oncogenic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoblastoma Protein 藉由結合並使 E2F1 失活來抑制增殖；E2F1 是 cell cycle 與細胞分裂基因的關鍵轉錄活化因子。E2F1 本身具有雙重角色：既是 G1/S transition 的 cell cycle 進展主導調節因子，也是嚴重 DNA 損傷或致癌壓力下的強效凋亡驅動者。

nodes.label: Lipopolysaccharide
nodes.description: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS), the principal endotoxin of Gram-negative bacteria, is a glycolipid anchored in the bacterial outer membrane. On release by cell lysis or gut leak it is a potent danger signal that engages TLR4 on immune and epithelial cells and initiates Inflammation via MyD88 and TRIF adapters.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lipopolysaccharide（LPS）是革蘭氏陰性菌的主要內毒素，為錨定於細菌外膜的糖脂質。在菌體裂解或腸道滲漏釋出後，LPS 是強烈的危險訊號，與免疫及上皮細胞上的 TLR4 結合，經由 MyD88 與 TRIF 轉接因子啟動 Inflammation。

nodes.label: ATFS-1
nodes.description: Under mitochondrial proteotoxic stress HAF-1, an inner-membrane ABC transporter, exports peptides generated by mitochondrial proteases from the matrix into the cytosol. These peptides act as retrograde signals that activate the transcription factor ATFS-1 and thus the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下，內膜 ABC transporter HAF-1 將粒線體蛋白酶產生的胜肽由 matrix 輸出至細胞質。這些胜肽作為 retrograde 訊號活化轉錄因子 ATFS-1，進而啟動 mitochondrial unfolded protein response。

nodes.label: Necrostatin-1
nodes.description: Necrostatin-1 (Nec-1) is a selective small-molecule inhibitor that allosterically blocks RIPK1 kinase activity, preventing phosphorylation and translocation of RIPK1 and therefore the formation of the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necrosome. It is the most widely used tool compound for dissecting necroptosis from other forms of regulated cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1（Nec-1）是選擇性小分子抑制劑，以異位（allosteric）方式阻斷 RIPK1 激酶活性，阻止 RIPK1 的磷酸化與轉位，因而無法形成 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL 壞死小體。它是區分 necroptosis 與其他受調控細胞死亡形式最廣泛使用的工具化合物。

nodes.label: TRF2
nodes.description: Progressive telomere attrition with cell division (the end-replication problem) causes loss of the protective TRF2-occupied shelterin cap, activating persistent DDR signaling that triggers Replicative Senescence. Deletion or dysfunction of TRF2 leads to telomere end-to-end fusions and genomic instability, counteracting Telomere Attrition-driven aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 隨細胞分裂而逐步發生的端粒耗損（末端複製問題）會造成具保護作用的 TRF2-占据 shelterin 帽流失，啟動持續的 DNA 損傷反應訊號，進而觸發 Replicative Senescence。TRF2 的缺失或功能失常會導致端粒端對端融合與基因體不穩定，對抗 Telomere Attrition 驅動的老化。

nodes.label: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptor
nodes.description: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors (RLRs) detect unique RNA structures generated during viral infection and then activate MAVS on the outer mitochondrial membrane. MAVS acts as the signaling platform that converts that detection event into prion-like aggregate formation and downstream interferon production, making the organelle an internal sensor of external danger.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors（RLRs）偵測病毒感染過程中產生的特殊 RNA 結構，隨後在粒線體外膜上活化 MAVS。MAVS 作為訊號平台，將此偵測事件轉換為類普里昂聚集體形成與下游 interferon 生成，使胞器成為對外來危險的內部感測器。

nodes.label: NAPRT
nodes.description: NAPRT is the first committed enzyme of the Preiss-Handler Pathway. It catalyses the rate-limiting conversion of nicotinic acid to nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN), the key step in using dietary Niacin (vitamin B3) for NAD+ production; NMNAT then converts NaMN to NaAD, and NAD+ synthase closes the route to NAD+.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAPRT 是 Preiss-Handler Pathway 的第一個承諾酵素。它催化限速的 nicotinic acid 轉為 nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) 反應，是利用膳食 Niacin（vitamin B3）製造 NAD+ 的關鍵步驟；之後由 NMNAT 將 NaMN 轉為 NaAD，再由 NAD+ synthase 將途徑收斂到 NAD+。

nodes.label: Cell Migration
nodes.description: Non-muscle myosin II generates the contractile forces needed for Cell Migration: it drives protrusion retraction, rear-end detachment, and adhesion turnover at the trailing edge, all on Cytoskeleton-resident Actin tracks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非肌肉型 myosin II 產生 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）所需的收縮力：驅動前緣的伸縮、尾端分離，以及後緣的黏附周轉—all 皆在 Cytoskeleton（細胞骨架）中的 Actin 軌道上進行。

nodes.label: Tryptophan
nodes.description: The kynurenine pathway is the major catabolic route for tryptophan, accounting for about 95% of tryptophan metabolism outside protein synthesis and serotonin production. IDO1 or TDO catalyses the rate-limiting first step, oxidative cleavage of the indole ring to produce N-formylkynurenine, which kynurenine formamidase deacylates to kynurenine. Three branch points then generate kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine/quinolinic acid, or anthranilic acid.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Kynurenine 路徑是色胺酸（Tryptophan）的主要分解代謝途徑，約佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成之外色胺酸代謝的 95%。IDO1 或 TDO 催化限速的第一步驟，切割吲哚環產生 N-formylkynurenine，再由 kynurenine formamidase 去醯化生成 kynurenine。之後三個分支點分別產生 kynurenic acid、3-hydroxykynurenine／quinolinic acid，或 anthranilic acid。

nodes.label: DNASE2
nodes.description: In senescent cells, DNASE2 is transcriptionally downregulated together with the cytosolic exonuclease TREX1. Persistent DNA damage therefore no longer resolves, the resulting cytosolic DNA activates cGAS-STING, and a type-I interferon plus NF-kB response emerges that is a major engine of the SASP - making DNASE2 loss a senescence-intrinsic mechanism rather than an extrinsic trigger.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 senescent cells 中，DNASE2 與細胞質外切核酸酶 TREX1 一同被轉錄性下調。因此持續存在的 DNA 損傷不再被解決，產生的細胞質 DNA 活化 cGAS-STING，並引發 type-I interferon 與 NF-κB 反應，成為 SASP 的主要動力來源；這使 DNASE2 的喪失成為一種 senescent 內在機制而非外在觸發因素。

nodes.label: Tyrosine
nodes.description: Tyrosine Hydroxylase is the rate-limiting enzyme of catecholamine biosynthesis, catalysing the hydroxylation of the amino acid Tyrosine to L-DOPA, the precursor of dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine. Its expression is the standard histological marker for dopaminergic neurons, and neurons lose TH expression before they die in Parkinson's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tyrosine Hydroxylase 是 Catecholamine 生合成的速率限制酵素，催化胺基酸 Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA，而 L-DOPA 是 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的前驅物。其表現是 dopaminergic neuron 的標準組織學標記，且在 Parkinson's Disease 中神經元會在死亡前先失去 TH 表現。

nodes.label: Allosteric Activator
nodes.description: An allosteric activator is a molecule that binds a protein site topographically distinct from the orthosteric active site, inducing a conformational change that increases the protein's catalytic or functional activity. Unlike orthosteric agonists, it does not compete with the endogenous substrate, which confers higher selectivity and a saturable ceiling effect that limits overactivation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 異位活化劑是結合在蛋白上與正位活性位在拓撲上相異之位置的分子，誘導構形改變以提升該蛋白的催化或功能活性。與正位激動劑不同，它不與內源性受質競爭，因此具有較高選擇性，並具可飽和的天花板效應，可限制過度活化。

nodes.label: Energy Balance
nodes.description: Because stored fat is the difference between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, chronic positive energy balance produces weight gain and drives the obesity epidemic, whereas negative balance produces weight loss. If Western food intake has been stable or declining, reduced physical activity (PAL ~1.66) must have tipped the budget positive.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於儲存的脂肪即代謝可利用能量攝取與能量消耗之間的差值，慢性正能量平衡會造成體重增加並驅動肥胖流行；負平衡則造成體重減輕。若西方飲食攝取量穩定或下降，則身體活動量降低（PAL 約 1.66）必然使能量預算轉正。

nodes.label: Extracellular Acidification Rate
nodes.description: Extracellular Acidification Rate is a real-time readout of proton efflux from living cells, detected by a pH-sensitive biosensor such as the Seahorse XF Analyzer. Because Glycolysis converts glucose to lactate with net proton production, ECAR serves as a proxy for glycolytic flux and lactate export, complementing the Oxygen Consumption Rate measurement of mitochondrial respiration. The ECAR/OCR ratio classifies cells as glycolytic or oxidative-phosphorylation-dependent, and mild respiratory-chain stress such as that engaged by Mitohormesis raises ECAR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Extracellular Acidification Rate 是活細胞釋放質子的即時讀值，由 Seahorse XF Analyzer 等 pH 敏感生物感測器偵測。由於 Glycolysis 將葡萄糖轉為乳酸並淨產生質子，ECAR 可作為糖解通量與乳酸輸出的代理指標，與量測粒線體呼吸的 Oxygen Consumption Rate 互補。ECAR/OCR 比值可區分細胞屬糖酵解型或氧化磷酸化依賴型，而 Mitohormesis 所涉及的輕度呼吸鏈壓力會使 ECAR 上升。

nodes.label: Calcium Signaling
nodes.description: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) act as regulatory hubs for calcium signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis can produce either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+ (blunting ATP production) or pathological Ca2+ overload (sensitizing to permeability transition), both amplifying ROS and destabilizing membrane integrity. MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic and redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay, promoting chronic UPRER activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) 作為 calcium signaling、lipid exchange、mitochondrial dynamics 和 stress adaptation 的 regulatory hubs。Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis 可導致 either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+（blunting ATP production）或 pathological Ca2+ overload（sensitizing to permeability transition），兩者都 amplifying ROS 和 destabilizing membrane integrity。MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic 和 redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay，promoting chronic UPRER activation。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: Nitrotyrosine
nodes.description: Tyrosine nitration yields nitrotyrosine as a stable end-product biomarker, making nitrated protein accumulation a useful sentinel of combined oxidative and nitrosative injury in cardiovascular and neurodegenerative contexts — exactly where adrenochrome and neuromelanin oxidative pathways are active.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tyrosine Nitration 會產生 Nitrotyrosine 作為穩定的終產物生物標記，使硝化蛋白的累積成為心血管與神經退行性情境下合併性氧化與亞硝基損傷的實用哨兵——而這些正是 adrenochrome 與 neuromelanin 氧化途徑活躍之處。

nodes.label: eIF4E
nodes.description: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

nodes.label: Acute Kidney Injury
nodes.description: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是腎臟生物能學的關鍵協調者，維護粒線體恆定、增強抗氧化防禦並調節 ECM 動態；其表現在腎病變中降低，且與組織學損傷嚴重程度呈負相關。SIRT3 的過量表現在多個臨床前模型中緩解 AKI 和 CKD 進展，透過 Nrf2 途徑上調、NF-kappaB 抑制（經由 IkappaBalpha 穩定化）和 NLRP3 炎症小體活化的抑制。

nodes.label: Bortezomib
nodes.description: Bortezomib blocks NF-kappaB by inhibiting the proteasome, preventing degradation of IkappaB and thus trapping NF-kappaB in the cytoplasm. This therapeutic strategy exploits the dependence of many cancers on NF-kappaB survival signaling. The directionality is proteasome inhibition to transcriptional blockade. A caveat is that bortezomib also inhibits degradation of many other proteins, causing toxicity such as peripheral neuropathy. The drug is used in multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma, where its NF-kappaB blockade and proteotoxic stress together induce myeloma cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bortezomib 透過抑制蛋白酶體來阻斷 NF-kappaB，防止 IkappaB 降解，從而將 NF-kappaB 捕獲在細胞質中。這種治療策略利用了許多 cancer 對 NF-kappaB 生存訊號的依賴。方向性是蛋白酶體抑制轉錄阻斷。需要注意的是，bortezomib 也會抑制許多其他 proteins 的降解，進而導致周邊神經病變等毒性。該藥物用於治療多發性骨髓瘤和套細胞淋巴瘤，其 NF-kappaB 阻斷和蛋白毒性壓力共同誘導骨髓瘤細胞死亡。

nodes.label: ERK2
nodes.description: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

nodes.label: Ki-67
nodes.description: Ki-67 is expressed in all active phases of the cell cycle and absent in quiescent cells, making it a robust immunohistochemical readout of proliferation. A high Ki-67 labeling index correlates with aggressive biology and, in some tumors, informs adjuvant therapy decisions. The relationship is directional as a biomarker: proliferation evidences the tumor's growth fraction rather than causing it. It is particularly integrated into grading of breast and neuroendocrine neoplasms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ki-67 在細胞週期的所有活躍階段表達，但在靜止細胞中不存在，使其成為增殖的可靠免疫組織化學讀數。高 Ki-67 標記指數與侵襲性生物學相關，並且在某些腫瘤中可以為輔助治療決策提供資訊。作為生物標記，這種關係是有方向性的：增殖證明瞭腫瘤的生長分數，而不是導致腫瘤生長的原因。它特別被納入乳腺和神經內分泌腫瘤的分級。

nodes.label: Cardiac arrest
nodes.description: Epinephrine 1 mg IV/IO every 3-5 minutes is standard therapy in cardiac arrest resuscitation. Its alpha-adrenergic vasoconstrictor effect augments aortic diastolic pressure and improves coronary and cerebral perfusion during chest compressions, raising ROSC rates — but despite this, no controlled trial has demonstrated improved survival with favourable neurological outcome, and beta-adrenergic effects may worsen myocardial stunning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cardiac arrest 復甦中，每 3–5 分鐘靜脈或骨內給予 Epinephrine 1 mg 是標準治療。其 α-腎上腺素性血管收縮作用提高主動脈舒張壓，在胸外按壓期間改善冠狀動脈與腦部灌流，提升 ROSC 率——但儘管如此，沒有任何對照試驗證明可改善具良好神經結局的存活率，且 β-腎上腺素作用可能加重心肌 stunning。

nodes.label: Proton Leak
nodes.description: Mitochondrial proton leak, the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane that bypasses ATP synthase, is a significant component of resting metabolic rate and of the energy expenditure of skeletal muscle. Because proton leak uncouples oxygen consumption from ATP production, it dissipates a portion of the proton gradient as heat and is estimated to account for roughly 20 percent of resting oxygen consumption in mammals. Speakman discusses how variations in proton leak, partly set by the expression of uncoupling proteins such as UCP3 in muscle, contribute to inter-individual differences in metabolic rate and, potentially, to differences in exercise-induced energy expenditure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體質子漏，即質子被動返回穿過粒線體內膜並繞過ATP合成酶，是靜息代謝率和骨骼肌能量消耗的重要組成部分。由於質子漏將氧氣消耗與ATP產生解偶聯，它將一部分質子梯度以熱的形式消散，估計佔哺乳動物靜息氧氣消耗的約20%。Speakman討論了質子漏的變化如何部分由肌肉中解偶聯蛋白如UCP3的表達設定，導致代謝率個體間差異，以及可能導致運動誘導能量消耗的差異。

nodes.label: Vitamin A
nodes.description: Retinoic Acid is the active metabolite of Vitamin A and a potent inducer of cellular differentiation. In embryonic stem cell research it is applied to monolayer cultures without LIF to drive mesenchymal differentiation and test the silencing of pluripotency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 是 Vitamin A 的活性代謝物，也是強效的細胞分化誘導劑。在胚胎幹細胞研究中，它在不含 LIF 的單層培養中被施加以驅動間質分化並檢測多能性的沉默。

nodes.label: Beta-Oxidation
nodes.description: While mitochondria handle the bulk of beta-oxidation for short and medium-chain fatty acids, the Peroxisome is the primary site for the preliminary beta-oxidation of very long-chain fatty acids, shortening these large lipids before they can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雖然短鏈與中鏈脂肪酸的 beta-oxidation 主要由粒線體處理，但 Peroxisome 是 very long-chain fatty acids 初步 beta-oxidation 的主要場所，先將這些大型脂質縮短，之後才能進入粒線體進行完全氧化。

nodes.label: Cholesterol Metabolism
nodes.description: Cholesterol Metabolism comprises biosynthesis via the Mevalonate pathway, uptake via the LDL Receptor, esterification by ACAT1, and efflux through ABCA1 and ABCG1. ACAT1 also acts outside lipid handling, regulating TFEB activity through acetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 包含經由 Mevalonate pathway 的生合成、經 LDL Receptor 的攝取、由 ACAT1 催化的酯化，以及經 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的外排。ACAT1 也參與脂質處理以外的調節，透過乙醯化調控 TFEB 活性。

nodes.label: Lipid peroxyl radical
nodes.description: Lipid peroxyl radical hydrogen abstraction from polyunsaturated fatty acids yields lipid hydroperoxide plus a new lipid radical; the rate-determining propagation step. Abstraction sustains the peroxidation chain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基從多元不飽和脂肪酸提取氫，產生脂質氫過氧化物加新脂質自由基；是速率決定傳播步驟。提取維持過氧化鏈。

nodes.label: Decitabine
nodes.description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

nodes.label: Prostacyclin
nodes.description: Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2 are made from the same Prostaglandin H2 pool and act on opposing receptors - IP (Gs-coupled, raising cAMP, inhibiting platelet activation and relaxing smooth muscle) versus TP (promoting aggregation and vasoconstriction). The PGI2/TXA2 ratio at the vessel wall is therefore the key determinant of thrombotic tendency. In pulmonary arterial hypertension prostacyclin deficiency is central to pathogenesis, which is why prostacyclin analogues are mainstay therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2 由同一個 Prostaglandin H2 池生成，卻作用於相反的受體——IP（Gs 偶聯、升高 cAMP、抑制血小板活化並放鬆平滑肌）對上 TP（促進聚集與血管收縮）。因此血管壁的 PGI2/TXA2 比值是血栓傾向的關鍵決定因素。在肺動脈高壓中，prostacyclin 缺乏是致病機制的核心，因此 prostacyclin 類似物為主線治療。

nodes.label: Pancreatitis
nodes.description: Acute Pancreatitis is the sudden, severe form of Pancreatitis in which premature activation of digestive enzymes triggers acinar autodigestion, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage and a systemic inflammatory response. Severity ranges from mild self-limiting disease to necrotizing pancreatitis with multi-organ failure, and gallstones and alcohol are the most common triggers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acute Pancreatitis（急性胰臟炎）是 Pancreatitis（胰臟炎）中最驟急嚴重的形式，消化酵素過早活化造成腺泡細胞自我消化，導致粒線體功能障礙、氧化性傷害與全身性發炎反應。嚴重程度可由輕微自限性疾病到壞死性胰臟炎伴隨多重器官衰竭，以膽結石與酒精為最常見誘因。

nodes.label: Progeria
nodes.description: Progeria (Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome) is caused by a mutation in the LMNA Gene that produces progerin, a toxic lamin A variant. Progerin accumulation drives premature aging features including cardiovascular disease, osteoporosis and frailty, making progeria a model of natural aging mechanisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Progeria（Hutchinson-Gilford 早老症）由 LMNA Gene 的突變所造成，該突變產生 progerin——一種具毒性的 lamin A 變體。Progerin 累積驅動提早老化表徵，包括心血管疾病、骨質疏鬆與虛弱，使 progeria 成為研究天然老化機制的模型。

nodes.label: Mebendazole
nodes.description: Mebendazole exerts preclinical antileukemic effects through tubulin depolymerization and mitotic arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mebendazole 透過微管蛋白解聚和有絲分裂停滯發揮臨牀前抗白血病作用。

nodes.label: NMNAT2
nodes.description: NMNAT2 is a protective NAD+ synthase whose loss from the distal axon after injury is the proximal event that triggers Axon Degeneration; because SARM1 consumes the NAD+ that NMNAT2 supplies, SARM1 inhibitors such as Disulfiram block the execution step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMNAT2 是具保護性的 NAD+ 合成酵素，損傷後自遠端軸突喪失是觸發 Axon Degeneration 的近端事件；由於 SARM1 消耗的正是 NMNAT2 供應的 NAD+，因此如 Disulfiram 等 SARM1 抑制劑可阻斷此執行步驟。

nodes.label: BOK
nodes.description: BOK (BCL-2-related ovarian killer protein) is a pro-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family that has emerged as a key regulator of mitophagy flux. Unlike the classical effectors, its death signaling is closely tied to mitochondrial quality control, particularly in Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BOK（BCL-2-related ovarian killer protein）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡成員，已成為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵調控者。與典型的效應蛋白不同，其死亡訊號與粒線體品質管制密不可分，在 Alzheimer's disease 中尤其如此。

nodes.label: Ammonium Persulfate
nodes.description: Ammonium persulfate is used as a convenient two-electron chemical oxidant to convert epinephrine to adrenochrome in vitro, proceeding through the o-quinone intermediate adrenaline-quinone followed by intramolecular Michael-type cyclization; the reaction is monitored by the 480 nm absorbance maximum of the adrenochrome chromophore.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ammonium Persulfate 被用作便利的雙電子化學氧化劑，在體外將 Epinephrine 轉為 Adrenochrome，反應經由 o-quinone 中間體 Adrenaline-quinone 再進行分子內 Michael 型環化；可藉 Adrenochrome 色基在 480 nm 的吸收極大來監測。

nodes.label: Propionate
nodes.description: Propionate is the three-carbon (C3) member of the Short-chain Fatty Acids, generated when gut bacteria ferment dietary fiber and resistant starch. Unlike acetate and butyrate it is produced largely by Bacteroidetes via succinate and acrylate pathways, and is absorbed into the portal vein for extensive first-pass hepatic extraction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Propionate 是 Short-chain Fatty Acids 中三碳（C3）的成員，由腸道細菌發酵膳食纖維與抗性澱粉產生。與 acetate 和 butyrate 不同，它主要由 Bacteroidetes 經 succinate 與 acrylate 路徑產生，並被吸收入門脈靜脈，經肝臟大量首過萃取。

nodes.label: Hamartoma
nodes.description: Benign tumors are dual-natured: OIS-type arrested lesions (nevi) are longevity-positive cancer barriers, whereas growth-signal-driven benign growths such as TSC1/TSC2-loss mTORC1 hamartomas are themselves disease (Tuberous Sclerosis, angiomyolipoma, epilepsy). Arrested growth is good; ongoing growth is bad.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 良性腫瘤具有雙重本質：OIS 型停滯病灶（痣）是長壽正向的癌症屏障，而由生長訊號驅動的良性生長（如 TSC1/TSC2 缺失 mTORC1 錯構瘤）本身即是疾病（結節性硬化症、血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇）。停滯的生長是好的；持續的生長是壞的。

nodes.label: TIMP3
nodes.description: TIMP3 is an endogenous ~24 kDa secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases; its N-terminal inhibitory domain inserts into the catalytic cleft of targets such as MMP-9 and MMP-2 in a 1:1 complex, and unlike TIMP1/2/4 it stays tethered to the extracellular matrix via heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TIMP3 是內生性約 24 kDa 的分泌型基質金屬蛋白酶抑制劑；其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 複合體插入 MMP-9、MMP-2 等標的酵素的催化裂縫，且與 TIMP1/2/4 不同，它透過硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣固定在細胞外基質上。

nodes.label: Brain
nodes.description: In creatine synthesis or transport deficiency, tissue creatine and phosphocreatine fall, most severely in the brain. Because the creatine phosphate shuttle underpins neuronal energy buffering, the cerebral deficit manifests as intellectual disability, speech and language delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and movement disorders with myopathic weakness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 creatine 合成或運輸缺陷中，組織的 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 下降，以 Brain 最為嚴重。由於 Creatine Phosphate Shuttle 是神經元能量緩衝的基礎，腦部缺陷表現為智能障礙、語言發育延遲、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵，以及伴隨肌無力的動作障礙。

nodes.label: Inner Mitochondrial Membrane
nodes.description: Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane that greatly increase its surface area and provide the confined compartment housing the respiratory chain complexes I-IV, ATP synthase, and TCA-cycle intermediates. They are the primary site of ATP synthesis and also contribute to calcium sequestration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cristae 是粒線體內膜的內褶，極大增加其表面積，並提供容納呼吸鏈複合體 I-IV、ATP synthase 與 TCA 循環中間產物的受限空間。它們是 ATP 合成的主要場所，也參與鈣的封存。

nodes.label: Fatty Acid Synthase
nodes.description: CMS121 is a fatty-acid-synthase (FASN) inhibitor developed by Pamela Maher's lab, discovered through the same phenotypic ferroptosis-based screening platform that yielded its sister compound J147. By inhibiting FASN it reduces pathological lipid accumulation and oxidative stress in neurons, and both compounds completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CMS121 是 Pamela Maher 實驗室開發的脂肪酸合成酶（FASN）抑制劑，與其姊妹化合物 J147 同樣來自以鐵死亡為基礎的表型篩選平台。藉由抑制 FASN，它減少神經元中病理性脂質堆積與氧化壓力，兩者皆已完成阿茲海默病的第一期臨床試驗。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Assembloids
nodes.description: Assembloids recapitulate migration, circuits and tumor-immune pathophysiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Assembloid 重現遷移、迴路與腫瘤免疫病理生理。

nodes.label: NPC1
nodes.description: NPC1 acts as a checkpoint that restrains cGAS-STING signaling under homeostatic conditions. NPC1 deficiency disrupts endolysosomal trafficking, impairs STING degradation and prolongs signaling at the ER and nuclear envelope, producing constitutive STING overactivation and sustained Type I Interferon production — a cGAS-independent route by which organelle stress alone can drive interferon signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NPC1 是在穩態下抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號的檢查點。NPC1 缺失會破壞內體溶酶體運輸、損害 STING 降解並延長其在 ER 與核膜的訊號傳遞，造成 STING 過度活化與持續的 Type I Interferon 生成——這是一條不依賴 cGAS、單靠胞器壓力即可驅動干擾素訊號的途徑。

nodes.label: MLH1
nodes.description: MLH1 is a tumor suppressor of the repair-pathway class: germline loss causes Lynch syndrome, while somatic MLH1 promoter methylation produces microsatellite instability in sporadic colorectal and endometrial cancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MLH1 屬於修復途徑類的腫瘤抑制基因：生殖系突變流失會造成 Lynch 症候群（遺傳性非息肉病大腸癌），而體細胞性 MLH1 啟動子甲基化則在散發性大腸癌與子宮內膜癌中產生微衛星不穩定。

nodes.label: Protein Turnover
nodes.description: Protein Turnover is the dynamic steady state between protein synthesis and degradation that maintains Proteostasis across the body. Because each peptide bond consumes ATP equivalents, the aggregate rate of whole-body protein turnover is a meaningful component of resting energy metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Protein Turnover 是蛋白合成與分解之間的動態平衡，維持全身的 Proteostasis。由於每個肽鍵都消耗 ATP 當量，全體蛋白周轉的總速率是靜止能量代謝中一個有意義的組成部分。

nodes.label: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol
nodes.description: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) is the brain's principal cholesterol-clearance oxysterol and an endogenous ligand of the liver X receptors, driving reverse-cholesterol-transport genes such as ABCA1, ABCG1 and ApoE across the blood–brain barrier.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) 是腦部主要的膽固醇清除 oxysterol，也是肝 X 受體的內源性配體，可誘發 ABCA1、ABCG1 與 ApoE 等逆向膽固醇運輸基因，作用可跨越血腦障壁。

nodes.label: Axon Degeneration
nodes.description: Axon Degeneration runs through a SARM1-dependent execution pathway: axonal injury causes NMNAT2 loss, the NMN/NAD+ ratio rises, SARM1 activates, NAD+ is catastrophically depleted, and energy failure produces fragmentation. Non-SARM1 routes such as Apoptosis or Autophagy-mediated pruning contribute in developmental and disease contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Axon Degeneration 主要透過依賴 SARM1 的執行途徑進行：軸突損傷導致 NMNAT2 喪失，NMN／NAD+ 比值上升，SARM1 活化造成 NAD+ 災難性耗竭，導致能量衰竭與片段化。Apoptosis 或 Autophagy 介導的修剪等非 SARM1 途徑，則在發育與疾病情境中有所貢獻。

nodes.label: Chlorpromazine
nodes.description: Chlorpromazine, the first antipsychotic phenothiazine, acts primarily as a D2 receptor antagonist, blocking central dopamine D2 signaling; at higher receptor occupancy it also blocks histamine H1, muscarinic, and alpha-adrenergic receptors, producing antipsychotic, sedating, and antiemetic effects plus mild MAO inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chlorpromazine（首個抗精神病藥 phenothiazine）主要作為 D2 receptor 拮抗劑，阻斷中樞 dopamine D2 訊號；在較高受體佔有率下亦阻斷 histamine H1、muscarinic 與 alpha-腎上腺素受體，產生抗精神病、鎮靜、止吐作用及輕微的 MAO 抑制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: CCL2
nodes.description: MMP-12 processes the CC chemokines CCL2, CCL7, CCL8 and CCL13 into CCR antagonists, which dampens monocyte recruitment and makes this chemokine-processing activity central to MMP-12's role in resolving inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-12 將 CC 趨化因子 CCL2、CCL7、CCL8 與 CCL13 加工成 CCR 拮抗劑，因而抑制單核細胞招募，使此趨化因子加工活性成為 MMP-12 在發炎消退中角色的核心。

nodes.label: BubR1
nodes.description: BUBR1 KEN-box sequesters CDC20 in the mitotic checkpoint complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BUBR1 KEN-box 在有絲分裂檢查點複合體隔離 CDC20。

nodes.label: JAK-STAT Signaling
nodes.description: SOCS3 is a classic negative-feedback regulator of cytokine signaling. It is itself induced downstream of JAK/STAT3 activity and then feeds back to inhibit JAK/STAT signaling, including potent attenuation of interferon-gamma and IL-6 responses, acting through its central SH2 domain on phosphorylated receptor tyrosines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SOCS3 是細胞激素訊息傳遞的典型負回饋調節因子。它本身由 JAK/STAT3 活性下游誘導，接著回頭抑制 JAK/STAT 訊息傳遞，包括對 interferon-gamma 與 IL-6 反應的強烈削弱；其作用經由中央 SH2 結構域辨識受體上的磷酸化酪胺酸殘基。

nodes.label: Metabolic Flexibility
nodes.description: SIRT1 is the primary driver of Metabolic Flexibility: it deacetylates PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative capacity, promotes fatty acid oxidation via PGC-1α and PPARα, and suppresses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c. During energy deprivation this shifts cells from glucose utilization toward increased fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial respiration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是推動 Metabolic Flexibility 的主要因子：它使 PGC-1α 去乙醯化以驅動粒線體生成與氧化能力，經由 PGC-1α 與 PPARα 促進脂肪酸氧化，並透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成。在能量不足時，這會使細胞由利用葡萄糖轉向提高脂肪酸氧化與粒線體呼吸。

nodes.label: Taurine
nodes.description: Taurine directly scavenges Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl), forming the more stable taurine chloramine — a relatively long-lived mediator that modulates macrophage function and limits oxidative tissue damage during Inflammation. It also buffers hypochlorous acid generated by Myeloperoxidase in the Respiratory Burst, protecting proteins, lipids, and DNA.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Taurine 可直接清除 Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl)，形成較穩定的 taurine chloramine——一種相對長壽命的介導物，可調節巨噬細胞功能並在 Inflammation 期間限制氧化性組織損傷。它也能緩衝 Myeloperoxidase 在 Respiratory Burst 中生成的次氯酸，保護蛋白質、脂質與 DNA。

nodes.label: Insulin Secretion
nodes.description: In pancreatic beta-cells, GDH activity is a central regulator of amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, providing an amino-acid-sensing branch independent of glucose. Its inhibition by SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation suppresses this insulin output, linking mitochondrial sirtuin signaling to glucose handling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在胰腺 β 細胞中，GDH 活性是胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌的核心調節者，提供獨立於葡萄糖的胺基酸感應分支。SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基化對其的抑制會抑制此胰島素輸出，將粒線體 sirtuin 信號與葡萄糖處理聯繫起來。

nodes.label: ELK1
nodes.description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

nodes.label: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence
nodes.description: SIPS is the acute stress-triggered subtype of senescence. Classification separates it from telomere-driven replicative senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIPS 是急性壓力觸發的衰老亞型。歸類將它與端粒驅動的複製性衰老分開。

nodes.label: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor
nodes.description: The Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) is a bHLH-PAS ligand-activated transcription factor that acts as a cytosolic sensor; Kynurenine, the Tryptophan metabolite generated by IDO1 and TDO, is its principal endogenous ligand. Ligand binding releases AhR from its HSP90/p23/XAP2 complex, drives nuclear translocation and heterodimerization with ARNT, and activates xenobiotic response element (XRE) transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) 是一種配體活化的 bHLH-PAS 轉錄因子，作為細胞質內的感測器；Kynurenine 是由 IDO1 與 TDO 產生的 Tryptophan 代謝物，也是其主要的內源性配體。配體結合使 AhR 從 HSP90/p23/XAP2 複合體釋放，驱动核轉位並與 ARNT 形成異二聚體，進而活化 XRE 相關的轉錄。

nodes.label: PDGFR
nodes.description: Alongside VEGFR and c-KIT, Sunitinib targets PDGFR as part of its multi-kinase profile. This breadth is what distinguishes it from single-target agents and underlies its use in GIST, where the driving mutation (typically KIT or PDGFRA) varies between tumours and a single-receptor inhibitor would leave many patients untreated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與 VEGFR 和 c-KIT 並列，Sunitinib 將 PDGFR 納入其多激酶標靶範圍。這種廣度正是它有別於單標靶藥物的特徵，也支撐其在 GIST 的用途——GIST 的驅動突變（通常為 KIT 或 PDGFRA）在腫瘤間各異，單一受體抑制劑將讓許多患者無藥可治。

nodes.label: OCP
nodes.description: The OCP was launched in 1974 by four United Nations agencies including the World Bank and was commanded by the World Health Organization. Its decades of safety and pharmacokinetic experience, together with successor programmes APOC and ONCHO, underpin contemporary investigations of ivermectin as an anti-cancer agent, and it demonstrated that community-directed treatment with ivermectin is logistically and economically viable.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OCP 於 1974 年由包括 World Bank 在內的四個聯合國機構發起，並由 World Health Organization 指揮。其數十年累積的安全與藥代動力學經驗，加上後繼的 APOC 與 ONCHO 計畫，構成了當代將 ivermectin 作為抗癌藥物研究的基礎；該計畫也證明了以 ivermectin 進行 community-directed treatment 在物流與經濟上可行。

nodes.label: Sepsis
nodes.description: SIRS criteria define the systemic inflammatory state that, when accompanied by infection, constitutes sepsis; sterile necroptotic DAMP release produces the same clinical syndrome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRS 標準定義全身性發炎狀態，若伴隨感染即構成敗血症（sepsis）；無菌性 necroptotic DAMP 釋放可產生相同臨床症候群。

nodes.label: ribonucleotide reductase
nodes.description: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis. dNTPs (dATP, dGTP, dCTP, dTTP) are the four deoxyribose building blocks of DNA, produced de novo by ribonucleotide reductase via reduction of NDPs to dNDPs followed by phosphorylation. RNR is the rate-limiting, allosterically committed step of this synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。 dNTP（dATP、dGTP、dCTP、dTTP）是 DNA 的四種去氧核糖建構單元，由核醣核苷酸還原酶將 NDP 還原為 dNDP 再經磷酸化而 de novo 合成。RNR 是此合成中速率限制、別構承諾的步驟。

nodes.label: Neurogenesis
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) enhances neurogenesis while reducing neurodegenerative pathology in Alzheimer's disease models. NR treatment increased neurogenesis by almost 20% and simultaneously reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage. These effects protect cognitive function, synaptic plasticity, learning, memory, and motor function in animal models. The mechanisms are attributed to NR raising NAD+ levels, which sustains sirtuin activity and mitochondrial gene expression, and reducing the beta-amyloid burden. This positions NR as a promising NAD+ precursor for counteracting the neuronal loss and cognitive decline associated with aging and Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在阿茲海默症模型中促進神經發生，同時減少神經退化性病理變化。NR 治療使神經發生增加近 20%，並同時減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 以及 DNA 損傷。這些效應在動物模型中保護認知功能、突觸可塑性、學習、記憶與運動功能。其機制歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 濃度，進而維持 sirtuin 活性與粒線體基因表現，並減少 beta-amyloid 負擔。這使 NR 成為一種具潛力的 NAD+ 前體，可用於對抗與老化及阿茲海默症相關的神經元喪失與認知衰退。

nodes.label: HIF-2α
nodes.description: HIF-2α is deacetylated by SIRT1, which modulates the oxygen-regulated transcription factor's output under hypoxia. Alongside HIF-1α, HIF-2α (EPAS1) controls hypoxic gene programs, and its SIRT1-dependent deacetylation extends the sirtuin network's transcriptional reach beyond the better-characterized HIF-1α axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIF-2α 被 SIRT1 去乙醯化，進而調節這個受氧調控的轉錄因子在缺氧下的輸出。HIF-2α（EPAS1）與 HIF-1α 一同控制缺氧基因程式，其依賴 SIRT1 的去乙醯化使 sirtuin 網路的轉錄調控範圍超越較被深入研究的 HIF-1α 軸。

nodes.label: Arterial Stiffness
nodes.description: Arterial stiffness is the loss of elastic compliance in large conduit arteries, chiefly the aorta and carotid, and is a hallmark of vascular aging: aortic pulse wave velocity roughly doubles between ages 20 and 70, with acceleration after 50-60. It is an independent predictor of cardiovascular events, all-cause mortality and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, and increased pulsatile microvascular stress contributes to cognitive decline, kidney disease and hypertension.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Arterial stiffness 是大型導管動脈（主要是主動脈與頸動脈）彈性顺应性的喪失，是血管老化的特徵：主動脈脈搏波速度在 20 至 70 歲之間約增加一倍，並在 50–60 歲後加速。它是心血管事件、全因死亡與保留射血分數心衰竭的獨立預測因子，而微血管脈衝壓力增加則促成認知衰退、腎臟疾病與高血壓。

nodes.label: Platelet aggregation
nodes.description: Resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing thrombotic risk and complementing its vascular benefits. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed platelet activation. This also creates a bleeding-risk caveat when combined with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin, since the anti-platelet effect adds to the anticoagulant's action. It is one of several anti-atherothrombotic actions of the compound, alongside its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects. Clinicians therefore advise caution in anticoagulated patients, and the platelet effect is considered when assessing resveratrol's overall cardiovascular profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，降低血栓形成風險並補充其血管益處。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制血小板活化的上游。這在與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑合用時也產生出血風險的警告，因為抗血小板效應會增添抗凝血劑的作用。這是該化合物的多種抗動脈粥樣硬化血栓作用之一，與其血管舒張和抗發炎效應並存。因此，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用，在評估 resveratrol 整體心血管特徵時會考慮血小板效應。

nodes.label: TDR
nodes.description: TDR is a component_of the World Health Organization system: it was established in 1975 and is co-sponsored by WHO together with UNICEF, UNDP, the World Bank and formerly the Rockefeller Foundation, with the mandate of building an evidence base for control, elimination and eradication of neglected tropical diseases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TDR 是 World Health Organization 體系的一環：它成立於 1975 年，由 WHO 與 UNICEF、UNDP、世界銀行及（前）洛克菲勒基金會共同資助，使命是為熱帶疾病的控制、消除與根除建立證據基礎。

nodes.label: Sodium Potassium ATPase
nodes.description: The Na+/K+ pump hydrolyzes one ATP per cycle to transport three Na+ out and two K+ into the cell, maintaining the electrochemical gradient across the plasma membrane that underlies resting membrane potential, action potential propagation and secondary active transport.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Na+/K+ 幫浦每個循環水解一個 ATP，將三個 Na+ 運出細胞、兩個 K+ 運入細胞，藉此維持細胞膜上的電化學梯度，而此梯度正是靜止膜電位、動作電位傳導與次級主動運輸的基礎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Bcl-w
nodes.description: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

nodes.label: SA-beta-gal
nodes.description: Lysosomal beta-galactosidase at pH 6.0 is the standard biomarker reporting replicative senescent burden. Characterization, not causation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: pH 6.0 的溶酶體 beta-galactosidase 是報告複製性衰老負擔的標準生物標記。是特徵描述而非因果。

nodes.label: Iduna
nodes.description: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

nodes.label: mitoZFNs
nodes.description: mitoZFNs (mitochondria-targeted zinc finger nucleases) were the first mtDNA-editing platform demonstrated in mammalian cells. Each monomer fuses tandem Cys2-His2 zinc fingers (recognizing 3-6 bp each) with the FokI cleavage domain, giving single-nucleotide discrimination: pathogenic mutations create allele-specific recognition sites so the mutant molecule is preferentially cleaved and degraded while wild-type mtDNA survives and repopulates the organelle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mitoZFNs（粒線體定位的鋅指核酸酶）是首個在哺乳類細胞中證明的 mtDNA 編輯平台。每個單體將串聯的 Cys2-His2 鋅指（每個辨識 3–6 bp）與 FokI 切割域融合，達成單一核苷酸的鑑別：致病突變會創造等位專一的辨識位點，使突變分子被偏好切割與降解，而野生型 mtDNA 則存活並重新填充胞器。

nodes.label: Superoxide
nodes.description: High-output nitric oxide from iNOS reacts with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. This is a functional trade-off of innate immune defense: the same NO burst that kills intracellular pathogens also generates a reactive secondary species that injures host tissue when NO output is excessive.
nodes.description_zh_TW: iNOS 產生的高產量 nitric oxide 會與 superoxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite，造成附帶的硝基化組織損傷。這是先天免疫防禦的功能性代價：殺死細胞內病原體的同一 NO 爆發，在 NO 輸出過量時也會產生傷害宿主組織的活性次級產物。

nodes.label: Multiple Myeloma
nodes.description: Multiple Myeloma is a malignancy of terminally differentiated B lymphocytes (plasma cells) that accumulate in the bone marrow, produce a monoclonal immunoglobulin M-protein and cause end-organ damage (CRAB criteria), making it the second most common hematologic malignancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Multiple Myeloma 是終末分化 B 淋巴球（漿細胞）的惡性腫瘤，腫瘤細胞在骨髓累積、產生單株免疫球蛋白（M-protein）並造成 CRAB 標準所列的臟器損傷，是第二常見的血液腫瘤。

nodes.label: Polyol Pathway
nodes.description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Secondary Necrosis
nodes.description: Secondary Necrosis is a variant of Necrosis in which the plasma membrane ruptures only after the apoptotic program has already run to completion, in cells or Apoptotic Bodies that were never cleared by phagocytic efferocytosis — the standard outcome in cell culture lacking phagocytes. Because the resulting DAMP release and sterile inflammation are indistinguishable from primary necrosis, late timepoints of a 'apoptosis' assay frequently report secondary necrosis rather than the intended outcome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Secondary Necrosis 是 Necrosis 的一種變體：細胞凋亡程序已經完成後，未被吞噬清除的細胞或 Apoptotic Bodies 才喪失細胞膜完整性——這是在缺乏吞噬細胞的細胞培養中的標準結果。由於其釋放 DAMP 與引發無菌性發炎的表現與原發性壞死無法區分，凋亡實驗的晚期時間點經常測到的是 secondary necrosis 而非預期結果。

nodes.label: Histone Modification
nodes.description: Histone Methylation is a Histone Modification in which methyl groups are added to lysine or arginine residues on histone tails. Unlike acetylation it does not change histone charge; instead it creates docking sites for 'reader' proteins, and its transcriptional consequence depends on the residue and the number of methyl groups (mono-, di-, tri-methylation).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone Methylation 是一類 Histone Modification，將甲基加到組蛋白尾端的離胺酸或精胺酸殘基上。與乙醯化不同，它不改變組蛋白的電荷，而是創造讓「讀取者」蛋白質停靠的位點；其對轉錄的影響取決於殘基種類與甲基數目（單甲基、二甲基、三甲基）。

nodes.label: Prostaglandins
nodes.description: Prostaglandins are 20-carbon lipid autacoids derived from Arachidonic acid released from membrane phospholipids by cytosolic phospholipase A2, then oxidized in two steps by COX-1 or COX-2 to Prostaglandin G2 and the reduced endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2. PGH2 is the common precursor converted by terminal synthases into PGE2, PGD2, PGF2alpha, Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2, giving the family its roles in pain, fever, vascular tone, gastric protection and platelet function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prostaglandins 是 20 碳脂質 autacoids，源自由 cytosolic phospholipase A2 從膜磷脂釋出的 Arachidonic acid，再由 COX-1 或 COX-2 兩步氧化成 Prostaglandin G2 與還原後的 endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2。PGH2 是共同前驅物，經末端合成酶轉為 PGE2、PGD2、PGF2alpha、Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2，使這一族在疼痛、發燒、血管張力、胃黏膜保護與血小板功能中扮演角色。

nodes.label: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome
nodes.description: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome is caused by a sporadic de novo mutation in the LMNA gene, which alters the protein Lamin A to produce progerin. Progerin remains permanently attached to the nuclear membrane, causing the nucleus to become misshapen and disorganized — the primary driver of the disease's accelerated-aging phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 由 LMNA 基因的偶發性新生突變引起，該突變使蛋白 Lamin A 改變而產生 progerin。Progerin 永久附著於核膜，使細胞核變形且構造混亂——這是此病加速衰老表型的主要驅動因素。

nodes.label: DNA Damage Response
nodes.description: Senescence in adult tissues can be triggered by a persistent DNA damage response (DDR) induced by various internal and external factors, including oncogenic activation, oxidative and genotoxic stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, irradiation, and chemotherapy. A sustained DDR enforces a permanent proliferation arrest and drives the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. This link between DNA damage signaling and senescence makes the DDR a central mechanism by which genotoxic stress contributes to aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 成人組織中的 Senescence 可由各種內部和外部因素誘導的持續 DNA 損傷反應 (DDR) 觸發，包括致癌活化、氧化和基因毒性壓力、粒線體功能障礙、輻射和化療。持續的 DDR 會強制永久抑制增殖並驅動老化相關的分泌表型。 DNA 損傷訊號傳導與老化之間的這種連結使 DDR 成為基因毒性壓力導致老化的核心機制。

nodes.label: KDM5C
nodes.description: KDM5C (JARID1C) is an X-linked JmjC-domain histone demethylase whose catalytic domain removes the trimethyl and dimethyl marks on histone H3 lysine 4, converting H3K4me3 to H3K4me2 to H3K4me1. By erasing this activating mark at target promoters it represses transcription, and its PHD3 zinc finger reads H3K4me3 to create an auto-inhibitory feedback loop. Loss of KDM5C causes aberrant H3K4me3 accumulation at oncogene and developmental gene promoters.
nodes.description_zh_TW: KDM5C（JARID1C）是一種 X 連鎖的 JmjC 結構域組蛋白去甲基化酶，其催化結構域可移除組蛋白 H3 離胺酸 4 上的三甲基與二甲基標記，將 H3K4me3 轉為 H3K4me2 再轉為 H3K4me1。透過擦除目標啟動子上的活化性標記，它抑制轉錄；其 PHD3 鋅指可讀取 H3K4me3，形成自我抑制的回饋迴路。KDM5C 缺失會造成致癌基因與發育相關基因啟動子上 H3K4me3 異常累積。

nodes.label: UCP2
nodes.description: UCP2 is a ~33 kDa inner mitochondrial membrane carrier that transports protons back into the matrix, dissipating the electrochemical gradient; by lowering the proton-motive force it reduces electron leakage and ROS production at complex I and III, at the cost of reduced ATP yield.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UCP2 是約 33 kDa 的粒線體內膜載體，將質子運回基質並消散電化學梯度；藉由降低質子動力勢，它減少 complex I 與 III 的電子洩漏與 ROS 產生，代價則是 ATP 產量下降。

nodes.label: α-tubulin
nodes.description: SIRT2 is the predominantly cytoplasmic sirtuin and the major deacetylase of alpha-tubulin. By removing acetyl groups it tunes microtubule dynamics, cytoskeleton organization and mitotic fidelity, with activity peaking at the G2/M transition to support chromosome condensation and segregation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要位於細胞質的 sirtuin，也是 α-tubulin 的主要去乙醯化酶。藉由移除乙醯基，它調節微管動態、細胞骨架組織與有絲分裂的準確性，其活性在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，以支持染色質濃縮與正確分離。

nodes.label: Antigen Presentation
nodes.description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Racemization
nodes.description: Because Lens Crystallins are effectively permanent, their residues spontaneously racemize over decades. This non-enzymatic Racemization is a pure chemical clock on protein age that is independent of any enzymatic turnover.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 Lens Crystallins（水晶蛋白）實質上是永久性的，其殘基會在數十年內自發地發生外消旋。這種非酵素性的 Racemization（外消旋）是獨立於任何酵素周轉的純化學蛋白年齡時鐘。

nodes.label: Actin
nodes.description: Caspase-3 cleaves actin networks during Apoptosis, dismantling the cytoskeleton and contributing to the characteristic morphological collapse of the dying cell. Actin fragmentation by caspase-3 is a late but central execution step of apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在 Apoptosis 過程中切割 actin 網絡，拆解細胞骨架並促成死亡細胞特有的形態崩解。actin 遭 caspase-3 碎裂是凋亡後期但關鍵的執行步驟。

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Pathway
nodes.description: COMT inhibition promotes the adrenochrome pathway by allowing epinephrine (and its oxidation product adrenochrome) to accumulate when O-methylation is impaired, shifting catecholamine disposition away from metanephrine formation. Adrenochrome is an auto-oxidation and cyclization product of epinephrine that has been speculated to contribute to psychoactive and neurotoxic effects, though human relevance remains debated. The association is plausible mechanistically but less well established than the rise in epinephrine itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當 O-甲基化受損時，COMT 抑製作用允許腎上腺素（及其氧化產物腎上腺素紅）積累，從而促進腎上腺素紅途徑，從而使兒茶酚胺的配置遠離變腎上腺素的形成。 Adrenochrome 是腎上腺素的自動氧化和環化產物，據推測會導致精神活性和神經毒性作用，但與人類的相關性仍存在爭議。這種關聯在機制上是合理的，但不如腎上腺素本身的增加那麼明確。

nodes.label: Cytochrome P450
nodes.description: Hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to resveratrol catabolism, alongside phase-II conjugation, determining its metabolic fate. Directionally, CYP enzymes sit upstream of resveratrol clearance. This hepatic handling caps bioavailability, and it is relevant to drug-drug interactions and dosing, since resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity. The combination of rapid conjugation and CYP-mediated oxidation explains resveratrol's short half-life. Because resveratrol can both be metabolized by and inhibit CYP enzymes, co-administered drugs may see altered clearance, a clinically important consideration for supplementation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肝臟細胞色素 P450 酶參與 resveratrol 的分解代謝，與第二相結合作用共同決定其代謝命運。在方向性上，CYP 酶位於 resveratrol 清除的上游。這種肝臟處理限制了生物利用度，與藥物-藥物相互作用和劑量相關，因為 resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性。快速結合作用與 CYP 介導的氧化的結合解釋了 resveratrol 的短半衰期。由於 resveratrol 可以既被 CYP 酶代謝又抑制其活性，合併用藥可能看到清除率改變，這是補充劑使用中臨床重要的考量。

nodes.label: CEBPβ
nodes.description: C/EBPbeta is one of the two principal transcription factors driving the inflammatory SASP, cooperating with NF-kB to activate CXCR2-ligand genes including IL-8. Loss of C/EBPbeta together with NF-kB reduces IL-8 and other chemokine receptor ligands and also impairs the growth arrest that defines oncogene-induced senescence, indicating that this transcription factor sits at the intersection of the arrest and secretory programmes. In the SASP-induction scheme C/EBPbeta occupies the transcription-factor tier alongside NF-kB, STAT and GATA4, and it is the target through which Notch modulates the late SASP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C/EBPbeta 是驅動發炎型 SASP 的兩大主要轉錄因子之一，與 NF-kB 協同活化包括 IL-8 在內的 CXCR2 配體基因。C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB 同時缺失會降低 IL-8 及其他趨化激素受體配體，並損害定義癌基因誘導衰老的生長停滯，顯示此轉錄因子位於停滯與分泌程序的交會處。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB、STAT、GATA4 同處轉錄因子層，也是 Notch 調節晚期 SASP 的作用靶點。

nodes.label: Luteoloside
nodes.description: Luteoloside lowers oxidative stress by reducing ROS, opposing the mitochondrial dysfunction/ROS/SASP axis implicated in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Luteoloside 藉由降低 ROS 減少氧化壓力，從而對抗參與特發性肺纖維化的粒線體功能失調／ROS／SASP 軸。

nodes.label: IL-12
nodes.description: IL-12 is the primary cytokine driving Th1 differentiation: it activates STAT4 in naive CD4+ T cells, induces the master Th1 transcription factor T-bet, and simultaneously suppresses Th2 and Th17 polarization.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-12 是驅動 Th1 分化最主要的細胞激素：它在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中活化 STAT4、誘導 Th1 譜系的主轉錄因子 T-bet，並同時抑制 Th2 與 Th17 極化。

nodes.label: RANK
nodes.description: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is the cell-surface receptor whose ligand is RANKL. Ligand engagement of RANK recruits NF-kB and MAPK signalling machinery, driving osteoclast differentiation from monocyte/macrophage precursors and, downstream, MAPK-dependent phosphorylation and activation of TFE3 (Hershey & Fisher 2004).
nodes.description_zh_TW: RANK (TNFRSF11A) 是細胞表面受體，其配體為 RANKL。RANKL 結合 RANK 後招募 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊息傳遞機制，驅動單核／巨噬細胞前驅細胞分化為 Osteoclast，並在下游經由 MAPK 依賴性的磷酸化活化 TFE3（Hershey & Fisher 2004）。

nodes.label: Osteoporosis
nodes.description: In bone, senescent cells secrete Interleukin-11 to activate STAT3 in osteoblasts, suppressing bone formation and shifting the osteoblast/osteoclast balance toward resorption — the senescence-associated osteokine loop that drives age-related bone loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在骨骼中，衰老細胞分泌 Interleukin-11 以活化骨母細胞中的 STAT3，抑制骨形成並將骨母細胞／破骨細胞平衡轉向骨吸收，即造成年齡相關骨流失的衰老相關骨細胞激素迴路。

nodes.label: Camptothecin
nodes.description: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

nodes.label: Free Radicals
nodes.description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

nodes.label: NOX2
nodes.description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

nodes.label: FTSJ1
nodes.description: FTSJ1 installs the Um34 modification on tRNA[Ser]Sec, and this modification is necessary and sufficient for Metastatic colonization of Melanoma in vivo. By enabling efficient Selenocysteine insertion it sustains antioxidant selenoproteins such as GPX4 and thioredoxin reductase that buffer Reactive Oxygen Species, which identifies FTSJ1/Um34 as a metastasis-selective therapeutic target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FTSJ1 在 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上加上 Um34 修飾，而此修飾在體內對 Melanoma 的 Metastatic colonization 而言既充分又必要。透過促進高效的 Selenocysteine 插入，它維持 GPX4 與 thioredoxin reductase 等抗氧化 selenoprotein 以緩衝 Reactive Oxygen Species，因此 FTSJ1/Um34 被視為轉移選擇性的治療標的。

nodes.label: Dysbiosis
nodes.description: In the human Gut Microbiome, Proteobacteria normally occupy a minor niche, but their relative abundance expands during Dysbiosis — a state linked to antibiotic use, inflammation and metabolic disruption. Centenarians and healthy-aging cohorts instead show lower Proteobacteria loads and richer beneficial taxa, making the phylum a useful dysbiosis marker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在人類 Gut Microbiome 中，Proteobacteria 正常情況下佔minor生態位，但其相對豐度會在 Dysbiosis 期間擴增——此狀態與抗生素使用、發炎及代謝失衡相關。相對地，百歲老人與健康老化群體呈現較低的 Proteobacteria 負荷與較豐富的有益菌群，使該菌門成為有用的失調指標。

nodes.label: LPS
nodes.description: LPS activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, which processes pro-IL-1beta into its mature form via caspase-1 cleavage, adding a second layer of innate immune activation critical to the hyperinflammatory state of sepsis. Together with MyD88-dependent and TRIF-dependent TLR4 signalling to NF-κB and IRF3, this drives release of TNFα, IL-1beta, IL-6 and inducible COX-2 and iNOS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LPS 會活化 NLRP3 inflammasome，透過 caspase-1 切割將 pro-IL-1β 加工為成熟形式，提供了對敗血症高發炎狀態至關重要的第二層先天免疫活化。此作用與經 MyD88 依賴性及 TRIF 依賴性 TLR4 訊號傳至 NF-κB 與 IRF3 共同驅動 TNFα、IL-1β、IL-6 以及誘導型 COX-2 與 iNOS 的釋放。

nodes.label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway
nodes.description: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: p43-FLIP
nodes.description: p43-FLIP is the 43 kDa N-terminal fragment generated when caspase-8 cleaves FLIP_L at Asp376 (Asp377 in mouse) during the first, interdimer processing step at the DISC. It retains both DEDs plus the large pseudo-caspase subunit but lacks any catalytic cysteine, so it cannot cut procaspase-8's DED2-p18 linker - which is why the heterodimer never completes intradimer processing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p43-FLIP 是在 DISC 上第一個分子間加工步驟中，caspase-8 切割 FLIP_L 於 Asp376（小鼠為 Asp377）時產生的 43 kDa N 端片段。它保留兩個 DED 加上大型偽 caspase 次單元，但缺乏任何催化性半胱胺酸，因此無法切割 procaspase-8 的 DED2–p18 連接段——這正是該異源二聚體永遠無法完成分子內加工的原因。

nodes.label: Peroxiredoxin
nodes.description: Peroxiredoxins are thiol-dependent peroxidases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide, peroxynitrite, and a range of organic hydroperoxides, reducing them to water. They are among the most abundant antioxidant proteins in the cell and act as primary H2O2 sinks and refined regulators of redox signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶是依賴硫醇的過氧化酶，可將過氧化氫、過氧亞硝酸鹽及多種有機氫過氧化物解毒並還原為水。它們是細胞中最豐富的抗氧化蛋白之一，既是主要的 H2O2 匯集處，也是氧化還原訊息傳遞的精細調節者。

nodes.label: Sister Chromatids
nodes.description: The cohesin ring complex holds sister chromatids together from replication to anaphase. Maintenance is the canonical ring function; canonical filename used.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cohesin 環複合體從複製到後期將姐妹染色單體繫在一起。維持是典型的環功能；使用典型檔名。

nodes.label: NMRK2
nodes.description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

nodes.label: GLUT4
nodes.description: Impaired GLUT4 translocation or expression — driven by obesity, ectopic lipid accumulation and inflammation — produces insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes, making GLUT4 trafficking a cornerstone target of metabolic therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GLUT4 轉位或表現受損——由肥胖、異位脂肪累積與發炎所驅動——會造成 insulin resistance 與第二型糖尿病，因此 GLUT4 的運輸是代謝治療的核心標的。

nodes.label: Myddosome
nodes.description: Through IRAK1/TRAF6/TAK1 and IKK, the myddosome drives NF-kB nuclear translocation and SASP gene transcription. This output links IL-1α sensing to the inflammatory secretome in senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 經由 IRAK1/TRAF6/TAK1 與 IKK，myddosome 驅動 NF-κB 核轉位與 SASP 基因轉錄。此輸出將 IL-1α 感知連結到衰老中的發炎分泌組。

nodes.label: Isoleucine
nodes.description: Isoleucine is one of the three branched-chain amino acids and an essential amino acid that must be obtained from the diet; its catabolism yields acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA, which enter the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Isoleucine 是三種支鏈胺基酸之一，也是必須由飲食取得的必需胺基酸；其分解代謝產生 acetyl-CoA 與 succinyl-CoA，進入 TCA cycle。

nodes.label: T Cell Receptor
nodes.description: The T Cell Receptor recognizes antigenic peptides only in the context of MHC molecules: TCR complementarity-determining regions engage peptide-MHC, Lck then phosphorylates CD3 ITAMs, and ZAP-70 with NF-AT, AP-1 and NF-κB downstream drive proliferation, cytokine production and effector differentiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: T Cell Receptor 只能在 MHC 分子的脈絡中辨識抗原胜肽：TCR 的互補決定區與胜肽-MHC 結合後，Lck 磷酸化 CD3 的 ITAM，接著 ZAP-70 與下游的 NF-AT、AP-1、NF-κB 驅動增殖、細胞激素生成與效應分化。

nodes.label: Torin1
nodes.description: Torin1 is a potent, ATP-competitive and selective inhibitor of mTORC1 and mTORC2 used as a research tool for studying mTOR signaling. By blocking mTORC1 kinase activity it relieves the mTORC1-dependent suppression of autophagy, which is why Torin1 is widely used to probe mTOR-dependent autophagy and the CLEAR network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Torin1 是一種強效、具 ATP 競爭性且選擇性的 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 抑制劑，作為研究 mTOR 訊號的工具藥。藉由阻斷 mTORC1 的激酶活性，它解除 mTORC1 對自噬的抑制，因此 Torin1 被廣泛用於研究 mTOR 依賴性自噬與 CLEAR 網絡。

nodes.label: Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
nodes.description: Beyond the primary traumatic or ischemic insult, Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) triggers a secondary injury cascade in which oxidative stress, inflammation and neuronal/glial apoptosis act together below the lesion. This secondary wave of damage, rather than the initial trauma, drives much of the progressive functional loss seen after Spinal Cord Injury (SCI).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了原發的創傷或缺血傷害之外，Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) 還會觸發續發性損傷級聯反應，在病灶以下由 oxidative stress、inflammation 與神經元/膠細胞 apoptosis 共同作用。造成 Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) 後大部分進行性功能喪失的，正是這波續發性損傷，而非初始創傷。

nodes.label: MEF
nodes.description: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) are derived from knockout embryos and serve as an in vitro validation platform for knockout mouse phenotypes. Cultured from the same embryos, MEFs permit mechanistic follow-up of in vivo findings — for example testing whether a knocked-out gene's role in mitochondrial stress response or apoptosis is cell-autonomous.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞（MEF）由敲除鼠胚胎取得，可作為敲除小鼠表型的體外驗證平台。由於與活體實驗取自相同胚胎，MEF 可對體內發現進行機制後續驗證，例如測試被敲除基因在粒線體壓力反應或凋亡中的角色是否為細胞自主性。

nodes.label: Starvation
nodes.description: NHR-49 is critical for the metabolic adaptation of C. elegans to starvation, driving the transcriptional program for fatty acid oxidation that supplies energy when nutrient intake ceases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NHR-49 對 C. elegans 對 Starvation 的代謝適應至關重要，它驅動脂肪酸氧化的轉錄程序，在營養攝取停止時供應能量。

nodes.label: Brown Adipose Tissue
nodes.description: SIRT6 supports thermogenesis in brown and beige adipose tissue, which is induced under cold exposure, thereby contributing to energy expenditure and protection from obesity. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of thermogenic gene programs in brown adipose tissue. This pro-thermogenic role opposes SIRT7, which suppresses brown-adipose function, illustrating opposing actions within the sirtuin family on energy expenditure. By maintaining the capacity of brown and beige fat to burn calories, SIRT6 helps the body dissipate energy as heat rather than store it. Supporting SIRT6 activity is therefore considered a potential approach for counteracting weight gain and metabolic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6支持棕色和米色脂肪組織中的生熱作用，該作用在冷暴露下被誘導，從而有助於能量消耗和對抗肥胖。方向上，SIRT6位於棕色脂肪組織中生熱基因程序的上游。此促生熱作用與抑制棕色脂肪功能的SIRT7相對抗，說明了sirtuin家族在能量消耗方面的對立作用。透過維持棕色和米色脂肪燃燒卡路里的能力，SIRT6幫助身體將能量以熱量形式散失而非儲存。因此支持SIRT6活性被認為是對抗體重增加和代謝疾病的潛在方法。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Alterations
nodes.description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

nodes.label: Onchocerciasis
nodes.description: Onchocerca volvulus is the filarial nematode that causes onchocerciasis (river blindness), infecting about 21 million people with 99% of cases in 31 African countries. Adults coil in subcutaneous nodules (onchocercomata) while the first-stage larvae migrate through skin and eye tissues, and the parasite depends on obligate Wolbachia endosymbionts for survival, embryogenesis and fecundity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Onchocerca volvulus 是造成 onchocerciasis（river blindness）的絲蟲線形蟲，全球約有 2100 萬人感染，其中 99% 集中於 31 個非洲國家。成蟲捲曲於皮下結節（onchocercoma）中，第一期幼蟲則在皮膚與眼部組織移行；此外此寄生蟲仰賴專性 Wolbachia 內共生菌才能存活、胚胎發育與繁殖。

nodes.label: CXCL11
nodes.description: CXCL11 (I-TAC) is an ELR- C-X-C chemokine and the most potent agonist of CXCR3, also binding CXCR7 as an atypical scavenger/decoy receptor. CXCR3 coupling to Galphai activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ signalling to drive chemotaxis of Th1/CD8+ T cells and NK cells, with expression induced via JAK/STAT1 downstream of interferons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL11（I-TAC）是 ELR− 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，也是 CXCR3 最強效的致效劑，並以非典型清除／誘餌受體的方式結合 CXCR7。CXCR3 耦合 Gαi 後活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ 訊號以驅動 Th1/CD8+ T 細胞與 NK 細胞的趨化，其表現則由干擾素下游的 JAK/STAT1 誘導。

nodes.label: Aminooxyacetate
nodes.description: Aminooxyacetate is an inhibitor of aminotransferases (notably aspartate aminotransferase, GOT1/GOT2) that blocks the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, the principal system transferring glycolytic NADH into mitochondria. By inhibiting the transamination steps of the shuttle it prevents cytosolic NADH oxidation via mitochondrial Oxidative Phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminooxyacetate 是胺基轉移酶（尤其 aspartate aminotransferase、GOT1／GOT2）的抑制劑，可阻斷 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle——將糖解產生的 NADH 轉送入粒線體的主要系統。藉由抑制該穿梭的轉胺步驟，它阻止細胞質 NADH 經由粒線體 Oxidative Phosphorylation 被氧化。

nodes.label: c-Jun N-terminal kinase
nodes.description: c-Jun N-terminal kinase is a MAPK family member activated by the MAP kinase kinases MKK4 and MKK7 in response to cytokines, UV, osmotic shock, and — most relevant here — oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction. Once active, it phosphorylates c-Jun and other substrates on Ser/Thr residues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: c-Jun N-terminal kinase 是 MAPK 家族的成員，會被 MAP 激酶激酶 MKK4 與 MKK7 活化，以回應細胞激素、UV、滲透壓衝擊，以及——在此最相關的——Oxidative Stress 與粒線體功能障礙。活化後它在絲胺酸／蘇胺酸殘基上磷酸化 c-Jun 及其他標的。

nodes.label: BRAF
nodes.description: BRAF, particularly the oncogenic BRAF V600E mutant, induces oncogene-induced senescence when expressed at high levels in normal cells. Hyperactive BRAF signaling drives aberrant proliferation and DNA damage, which activates the DNA damage response and p53, triggering a permanent growth arrest that protects against malignant transformation. Cells in BRAF-induced senescence display the full senescence phenotype, including senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and the SASP, making this a key experimental model.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRAF，特別是致癌 BRAF V600E 突變體，當在正常細胞中高水平表達時，會誘導癌基因誘導的衰老。過度活躍的 BRAF 訊號傳導會驅動異常增殖和 DNA 損傷，進而活化 DNA 損傷反應和 p53，引發永久性生長停滯，從而防止惡性轉化。 BRAF 誘導的衰老細胞表現出完整的衰老表型，包括衰老相關的異染色質灶和 SASP，使其成為關鍵的實驗模型。

nodes.label: Fat Oxidation
nodes.description: Fat oxidation is the breakdown of fatty acids to acetyl-CoA via beta-oxidation in the mitochondrial matrix, with acetyl-CoA entering the TCA cycle and mitochondrial electron transport chain to generate ATP. It is the dominant fuel during low-intensity prolonged exercise and in the post-absorptive state, with low-to-moderate intensity favouring fat oxidation and high intensity shifting toward carbohydrate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fat oxidation 是脂肪酸經粒線體基質中的 beta-oxidation 分解為 acetyl-CoA，acetyl-CoA 再進入 TCA cycle 與粒線體電子傳遞鏈以生成 ATP。它是低強度長時間運動與消化後狀態下的主要燃料；低至中等強度有利於 fat oxidation，而高強度則轉向碳水化合物氧化。

nodes.label: Rilonacept
nodes.description: Rilonacept (Arcalyst) is a soluble decoy receptor fusion protein — an IL-1 trap — built from the extracellular domains of IL-1R1 and IL-1RAcP fused to the human IgG1 Fc region. It captures IL-1β in the extracellular space with high affinity, preventing the cytokine from engaging the cell-surface IL-1 Receptor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rilonacept（Arcalyst）是一種可溶性誘餌受體融合蛋白 —— 即 IL-1 trap —— 由 IL-1R1 與 IL-1RAcP 的胞外區融合至人類 IgG1 Fc 區而成。它在細胞外以高親和力捕捉 IL-1β，阻止該細胞激素與細胞表面的 IL-1 Receptor 結合。

nodes.label: CDK1
nodes.description: Cyclin B is the G2/M cyclin whose binding activates CDK1, forming the Cyclin B-CDK1 (formerly MPF) complex that phosphorylates substrates required for nuclear envelope breakdown, chromosome condensation, and spindle assembly. Its abrupt APC/C-mediated destruction at anaphase enforces the G2/M checkpoint.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin B 是 G2/M cyclin，其結合可活化 CDK1，形成 Cyclin B-CDK1（舊稱 MPF）複合體，磷酸化核膜崩解、染色質濃縮與紡錘體組裝所需的受質。Cyclin B 在後期被 APC/C 迅速降解，使 G2/M 檢查點得以維持。

nodes.label: p16
nodes.description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md

nodes.label: Creatine Supplementation
nodes.description: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

nodes.label: Opicapone
nodes.description: Opicapone is an approved once-daily adjunct to levodopa for Parkinson's disease that reduces motor fluctuations and off time. Peripheral COMT blockade prolongs levodopa availability without central inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Opicapone 是帕金森氏症核准的每日一次左旋多巴輔助藥物，減少運動波動與關閉期。周邊 COMT 阻斷延長左旋多巴可用性而不中樞抑制。

nodes.label: Tolcapone
nodes.description: Tolcapone is used as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa in Parkinson's disease. Its clinical value is offset by a black-box warning for hepatotoxicity — rare but fatal acute liver failure — which necessitates regular liver function monitoring and limits its use relative to entacapone and opicapone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tolcapone 作為 levodopa/carbidopa 的輔助用於 Parkinson's disease。其臨床價值受到肝毒性黑框警告的限制——罕見但致命的急性肝衰竭——因此必須定期檢測肝功能，且相較 entacapone 與 opicapone 的使用受限。

nodes.label: Resolvins
nodes.description: Docosahexaenoic acid is the parent lipid of the D-series resolvins (RvD1-RvD6) and of the structurally related protectins/neuroprotectins and maresins, which are often grouped with resolvins under the specialized pro-resolving mediator umbrella. The D-series arise through 17S-HDHA and 5/12-lipoxygenase, and neuroprotectin D1 is specifically reduced in Alzheimer's Disease brain, where it protects retinal and neural tissue against oxidative injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid 是 D 系列 resolvins（RvD1-RvD6）以及結構相關的 protectins/neuroprotectins 與 maresins 的母體脂質，後者常與 resolvins 一同歸入 specialized pro-resolving mediator 的傘下。D 系列經由 17S-HDHA 與 5/12-lipoxygenase 生成；而 neuroprotectin D1 在 Alzheimer's Disease 腦中特別減少，在該處它保護視網膜與神經組織免受氧化傷害。

nodes.label: Scabies
nodes.description: Ivermectin treats Scabies orally at 200 micrograms/kg repeated after 7-14 days, and is the cornerstone of crusted (Norwegian) scabies, where combination therapy uses ivermectin on days 1, 2, 8, 9 and 15 together with topical permethrin and keratolytics to strip hyperkeratotic crusts and reduce mite burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 以每公斤 200 微克口服、7 至 14 天後重複的方式治療 Scabies，並是結痂型（Norwegian）scabies 的核心用藥；此型以聯合療法處理，在第 1、2、8、9、15 天給予 ivermectin，並搭配外用 permethrin 與角質溶解劑以去除角化過度結痂、降低蟎數。

nodes.label: Protein Carbonylation
nodes.description: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

nodes.label: Aminochrome
nodes.description: Aminochrome binds to Alpha-synuclein through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Aminochrome acts as the ligand or matrix and Alpha-synuclein as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
