nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminochrome 透過物理化學親和力與 Alpha-synuclein 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Aminochrome 作為配體或基質，Alpha-synuclein 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

nodes.label: Atg
nodes.description: Single-cell omics maps which ATG Genes are required in specific contexts: perturbation atlases combining CRISPR screens with scRNA-seq identify the autophagy machinery genes needed in a given cell state, while lineage tracing coupled to scRNA-seq reveals how Mitophagy and Selective Autophagy programs shift during differentiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Single-cell omics 可繪出在特定情境下哪些 Atg 基因為必要：結合 CRISPR 篩選與 scRNA-seq 的擾動圖譜能鑑定特定細胞狀態所需的自噬機制基因，而與 scRNA-seq 結合的細胞譜系追蹤則揭示 Mitophagy 與 Selective Autophagy 程序在分化過程中如何變化。

nodes.label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
nodes.description: Alpha-lipoic acid improves endothelial dysfunction, as confirmed in meta-analyses showing improved flow-mediated dilation and markers of oxidative stress in diabetic and metabolic patients. By restoring GSH and reducing NF-kappaB, it ameliorates NO bioavailability. The directionality is antioxidant supplementation to vascular benefit. A caveat is that trial results are heterogeneous and benefits are most consistent in established endothelial dysfunction rather than primary prevention. Lipoic acid also chelates redox-active metals, which may reduce the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals in the vascular wall.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 統合分析證實，Alpha-lipoic acid 改善了 endothelial dysfunction，顯示糖尿病和代謝患者中血流介導的擴張和 oxidative stress 標記得到改善。透過恢復 GSH 和減少 NF-κB，它可以改善 NO 的生物利用度。方向性是補充抗氧化劑對血管有益。需要注意的是，試驗結果有差異，在已建立的 endothelial dysfunction 而非一級預防中，效果最一致。硫辛酸也螯合 redox-active metals，這可能會減少血管壁中金屬催化的 hydroxyl radicals 的生成。

nodes.label: Smac DIABLO
nodes.description: Smac DIABLO is a pro-apoptotic mitochondrial protein whose principal function is to neutralize Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol during apoptosis, it binds the BIR3 domain of XIAP, cIAP1 and cIAP2 through its exposed N-terminal AVPI IAP-binding motif, displacing Caspase-9 and Caspase-3/Caspase-7 from IAP inhibition and allowing the caspase cascade to run to completion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smac DIABLO 是一個促凋亡的粒線體蛋白，其主要功能是中和 Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins。凋亡時它由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，透過暴露的 N 端 AVPI IAP-binding motif 結合 XIAP、cIAP1 與 cIAP2 的 BIR3 結構域，將 Caspase-9 與 Caspase-3/Caspase-7 從 IAP 抑制中置換出來，使 caspase 级聯得以完整進行。

nodes.label: PAD4
nodes.description: PAD4 (peptidylarginine deiminase 4) deiminates arginine residues on histone H3, generating citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3, H3Cit). Loss of the positive charge unravels chromatin structure, which is required for the chromatin decondensation and extrusion underlying NET formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAD4（肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 4）將組蛋白 H3 上的精胺酸殘基去亞胺化，生成瓜胺酸化的組蛋白 H3（cit-H3，H3Cit）。正電荷的流失使染色質鬆解，而這正是 NET 形成過程中染色質去凝縮與外排所需的條件。

nodes.label: Oncogene Activation
nodes.description: Activated oncogenes such as RAS, BRAF, and MYC drive hyperproliferation and replication stress, which in turn elicit oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) as an intrinsic tumor-suppressive failsafe. The unscheduled S-phase entry generates DNA replication stress and DNA damage that stabilize p53 and derepress the CDKN2A/p16INK4a locus, locking cells in arrest. OIS is observed in benign lesions such as melanocytic nevi and is a major barrier to tumor progression. The paradox is that OIS cells secrete a SASP that, while recruiting immune clearance, can also promote tumorigenesis in neighboring cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 活化的致癌基因如 RAS、BRAF 與 MYC 驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，進而引發致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS），作為一種內在的腫瘤抑制失效安全機制。非預期的 S 期進入產生 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷，穩定 p53 並去抑制 CDKN2A/p16INK4a 位點，將細胞鎖定於停滯。OIS 見於如黑色素細胞痣等良性病灶，是腫瘤進展的主要屏障。其矛盾之處在於，OIS 細胞分泌 SASP，雖能招募免疫清除，也可能促進鄰近細胞的腫瘤發生。

nodes.label: CDKN1A
nodes.description: CDKN1A-encoded p21 inhibits cyclin-CDK enzymes, notably CDK2, enforcing G1/S blockade. This direct inhibition is shared with the Cip/Kip family mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDKN1A 編碼的 p21 抑制 cyclin-CDK 酶（特別是 CDK2），執行 G1/S 封鎖。此直接抑制與 Cip/Kip 家族機制共享。

nodes.label: COPD
nodes.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion. Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells, and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells. Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury, making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion。Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells，and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells。Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury，making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Benzothiazine
nodes.description: Benzothiazine rings are more redox-labile and more prone to generate Oxidative Stress than the indolic units of eumelanin. Pheomelanin-type structures are poorer antioxidants and can, under UV or oxidative challenge, produce damaging radicals. This pro-oxidant behavior is relevant to both skin and brain pigment biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與 eumelanin 的吲哚類單元相比，benzothiazine 環更易發生氧化還原不穩定，且更容易產生 Oxidative Stress。Pheomelanin 型結構是較差的抗氧化劑，在 UV 或氧化挑戰下可能產生有害自由基。這種促氧化行為與皮膚和大腦的色素生物學都相關。

nodes.label: B2M
nodes.description: B2M is the invariant light chain that forms all MHC class I molecules and, in particular, stabilizes HLA-E surface expression; HLA-E/B2M on senescent and tumor cells engages NKG2A/CD94 on Natural Killer Cells and CD8 T cells, blunting cytotoxic killing and enabling Immune Evasion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B2M 是構成所有 MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈，特別能穩定 HLA-E 的表面表現；衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞上的 HLA-E/B2M 會接合 Natural Killer Cells 與 CD8 T cells 上的 NKG2A/CD94，削弱細胞毒殺殺傷並促成 Immune Evasion。

nodes.label: Olaparib
nodes.description: Pancreatic cancer is one of olaparib's approved indications, alongside BRCA-mutated breast, ovarian, and prostate cancers, on the basis of olaparib's exploitation of synthetic lethality in homologous-recombination-deficient tumors. ATM-deficient tumors are selectively vulnerable to PARP inhibitors including olaparib, and show heightened vulnerability when PARP inhibition is combined with ATR inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胰臟癌是 olaparib 的核准適應症之一，與 BRCA 突變的乳癌、卵巢癌及攝護腺癌並列，其依據是 olaparib 對同源重組缺陷腫瘤之合成致命性的利用。ATM 缺失的腫瘤對包括 olaparib 在內的 PARP 抑制劑具有選擇性脆弱性，且在 PARP 抑制合併 ATR 抑制時更為明顯。

nodes.label: Mubritinib
nodes.description: Mubritinib (TAK-165) is a ubiquinone-binding-site (Q-site) dependent inhibitor of mitochondrial Complex I, with an aromatic ring chain topology critical for Q-site binding. Originally developed as a receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor, it blocks electron transfer from NADH to ubiquinone, which inhibits NAD+ regeneration from NADH, raises the NADH:NAD+ ratio and deplete ATP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mubritinib（TAK-165）是粒線體 Complex I 的 ubiquinone 結合位點（Q-site）依賴型抑制劑，其芳香環鏈拓撲對 Q-site 結合至關重要。它最初是作為受體酪胺酸激酶抑制劑開發，而會阻斷 NADH 到 ubiquinone 的電子傳遞，抑制 NADH 再生為 NAD+、提高 NADH:NAD+ 比值並耗竭 ATP。

nodes.label: Crohn's Disease
nodes.description: The T300A variant of Atg16L1 is a risk factor for Crohn's Disease, linking impaired Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1-dependent LC3 lipidation to intestinal inflammatory disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg16L1 的 T300A 變異是 Crohn's Disease 的風險因子，將 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 依賴的 LC3 脂化受損與腸道發炎性疾病連結起來。

nodes.label: ACLY
nodes.description: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: PEX19
nodes.description: All reported PEX19 mutations cause severe Zellweger syndrome (<1% of ZSD cases); biallelic knockout in mice is embryonic lethal with no detectable peroxisomes in any tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 所有已報導的 PEX19 突變皆造成嚴重的 Zellweger 症候群（佔 ZSD 病例 <1%）；小鼠雙等位基因敲除在胚胎期即致死，任何組織皆檢測不到過氧化體。

nodes.label: Liver X Receptor
nodes.description: Liver X receptors (LXRα/NR1H3 and LXRβ/NR1H2) are nuclear receptors that regulate cholesterol, fatty acid and lipid homeostasis. SIRT1 modulates over 40 known substrates including LXR, deacetylating and regulating its activity, thereby coupling sirtuin activity to cholesterol and lipid metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liver X Receptor（LXRα/NR1H3 與 LXRβ/NR1H2）是調節膽固醇、脂肪酸與脂質恆定的核受體。SIRT1 可調節超過 40 種已知受質（包含 LXR），藉由去乙醯化並調節其活性，將 sirtuin 活性與膽固醇及脂質代謝連結起來。

nodes.label: Lens Crystallins
nodes.description: Lens Crystallins have negligible turnover, so glycation adducts accumulate over decades. This makes them one of the canonical long-lived proteins carrying old AGE modifications, and the resulting opacity reads out whole-body long-lived-protein aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lens Crystallins（水晶蛋白）的周轉率極低，因此糖化加合物會在數十年內累積。這使它們成為帶有陳年 AGE 修飾的典型長壽蛋白，其 resulting 混濁可作為全身長壽蛋白老化的讀值。

nodes.label: erlotinib
nodes.description: Lung Cancer is treated by erlotinib. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Erlotinib is a first-generation EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor used in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. The directionality runs from erlotinib toward Lung Cancer, so erlotinib is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 用 erlotinib 處理。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。厄洛替尼是第一代EGFR酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，用於EGFR突變的非小細胞Lung Cancer。方向性從 erlotinib 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 erlotinib 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

nodes.label: Astrocytes
nodes.description: Astrocytes are the most abundant glial cell type of the Central Nervous System, providing metabolic, structural and homeostatic support to Neuron and contributing to formation and maintenance of the Blood-Brain Barrier.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Astrocytes 是 Central Nervous System 中最豐富的神經膠細胞類型，為 Neuron 提供代謝、結構與恆定維持上的支持，並參與 Blood-Brain Barrier 的形成與維持。

nodes.label: XBP1
nodes.description: XBP1s is the spliced, transcriptionally competent isoform of XBP1, produced by IRE1-mediated splicing during the unfolded protein response; it directs endoplasmic reticulum stress adaptation by upregulating ER chaperones and folding machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XBP1s 是 XBP1 經剪接後具轉錄活性的異構體，由未摺疊蛋白反應期間的 IRE1 媒介剪接產生；它藉由上調內質網分子伴護蛋白與摺疊機制來主導內質網壓力的適應。

nodes.label: Epithelial cells
nodes.description: Alveolar Type II Cells are the surfactant-producing epithelial cells of the distal lung alveolus and serve as the facultative progenitor population that regenerates the flattened alveolar type I Epithelial cells after injury. They synthesize and secrete pulmonary surfactant via lamellar bodies and participate in ion and water transport to maintain airspace stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alveolar Type II Cells 是遠端肺泡產生表面活性物質的上皮細胞，並作為兼性前驅細胞群，在損傷後再生扁平化的第一型肺泡 Epithelial cells。它們藉由 lamellar body 合成並分泌肺表面活性物質，並參與離子與水分運輸以維持氣腔穩定。

nodes.label: LAMP1
nodes.description: LAMP1 is the most abundant protein on the lysosomal membrane and serves as the standard marker for Lysosome and Autolysosome. Heavily glycosylated, it protects the membrane from luminal hydrolases and maintains lysosomal stability and integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LAMP1 是 lysosome 膜上最豐富的蛋白質，也是 Lysosome 與 Autolysosome 的標準標記。高度醣基化的 LAMP1 保護膜免受腔內水解酶作用，並維持 lysosome 的穩定性與完整性。

nodes.label: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (stress cardiomyopathy, broken-heart syndrome) is an acute, reversible left ventricular systolic dysfunction that mimics acute myocardial infarction but occurs in the absence of obstructive coronary artery disease. It is classically triggered by intense emotional or physical stress and is driven by a surge of Catecholamines — particularly Epinephrine and Norepinephrine — that directly injures the myocardium.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy（壓力性心肌病變、碎心症候群）是急性、可逆的左心室收縮功能障礙，會模仿急性心肌梗塞卻不伴隨阻塞性冠狀動脈疾病。它典型地由強烈的情緒或生理壓力觸發，並由 Catecholamines——尤其是 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine——的驟升所驅動，直接損傷心肌。

nodes.label: Dasatinib
nodes.description: Senolytic therapy uses dasatinib as part of the foundational D+Q combination (Zhu et al., Nat Med 2015) for clearing senescent cells. Dasatinib's kinase-inhibitory activity lowers the apoptotic threshold of senescent cells and synergizes with quercetin, and its established clinical safety profile in leukemia facilitates repurposing in senolytic trials. The combination has shown efficacy across multiple senescent cell types and in vivo models, and D+Q has been tested in pilot clinical trials for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and diabetic kidney disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法使用 dasatinib，作為清除衰老細胞的基礎 D+Q 組合（Zhu 等人，Nat Med 2015）的一部分。Dasatinib 的激酶抑制活性降低衰老細胞的凋亡閾值並與 quercetin 協同，其在白血病中既有的臨床安全特性有助於在 senolytic 試驗中重新定位。此組合已在多種衰老細胞類型與體內模型展現療效，且 D+Q 已在特發性肺纖維化與糖尿病腎病的試驗性臨床試驗中測試。

nodes.label: Peroxiredoxin 3
nodes.description: Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reduced back to its active form by thioredoxin-2 (Trx2), which donates electrons to re-reduce the disulfide formed at its peroxidatic cysteine. Trx2 is in turn regenerated by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, sustaining the matrix peroxide-removal cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）由硫氧還蛋白-2 (Trx2) 還原回其活化形式，Trx2 提供電子以重新還原其過氧化半胱氨酸處形成的雙硫鍵。Trx2 再由粒線體硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，以維持基質過氧化氫清除循環。

nodes.label: Dicer
nodes.description: Besides MicroRNA, Dicer processes long double-stranded RNA into siRNA duplexes, so Dicer-null cells lack siRNAs as well as mature miRNAs. Unlike a DGCR8/Drosha knockout, this produces a more severe, partly miRNA-independent block to differentiation, which is why DGCR8 knockout is the cleaner tool for studying miRNA-specific function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了 MicroRNA 之外，Dicer 也將長雙股 RNA 加工成 siRNA 雙股，因此 Dicer 缺失的細胞同時缺乏 siRNA 與成熟 miRNA。相較於 DGCR8/Drosha 的 knockout，這會造成更嚴重且部分不依賴 miRNA 的分化阻斷，因此研究 miRNA 專一功能時，DGCR8 knockout 是更乾淨的工具。

nodes.label: Human Growth Hormone
nodes.description: Human Growth Hormone signaling activates the mTOR pathway downstream of IGF-1/AKT, promoting anabolic growth. Because chronically elevated GH/IGF-1 signaling is associated with increased cancer risk and shortened lifespan, exogenous HGH is regarded as a pro-aging rather than anti-aging intervention — the opposite of Rapamycin-mediated mTOR inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Human Growth Hormone 的訊號經由 IGF-1/AKT 下游活化 mTOR 途徑，促進合成性生長。由於 GH/IGF-1 訊號長期偏高與癌症風險上升及壽命縮短相關，外源性 HGH 被視為促衰老而非抗衰老的介入手段——恰與 Rapamycin 介導的 mTOR 抑制相反。

nodes.label: Ghrelin
nodes.description: Ghrelin is a 28-amino acid peptide produced primarily by the stomach that acts through the growth hormone secretagogue receptor GHS-R1a, with octanoylation at Ser3 required for biological activity. It stimulates growth hormone release from the pituitary, regulates food intake via hypothalamic feeding centers, and rises during fasting; its receptor is expressed in stomach, hypothalamus, and immune cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ghrelin 是主要由胃部產生的 28 胺基酸胜肽，透過生長激素促泌素受體 GHS-R1a 作用，且 Ser3 的辛醯化修飾為其生物活性所必需。它刺激腦下垂體釋放生長激素，經由下視丘攝食中樞調節食物攝取，並在禁食期間上升；其受體表現在胃、下視丘與免疫細胞。

nodes.label: NNMT
nodes.description: NNMT is the enzyme that methylates Nicotinamide using S-adenosylmethionine to form 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA). Because 1-MNA is the terminal, largely non-recyclable sink of nicotinamide, NNMT activity sets how much nicotinamide remains available for NAD+ resynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NNMT 是以 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸將 Nicotinamide 甲基化形成 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA) 的酵素。由於 1-MNA 是菸醯胺終末且大致不可回收的匯，NNMT 活性決定了仍可供 NAD+ 再合成的菸醯胺量。

nodes.label: M₁dG
nodes.description: M₁dG is the best-characterized DNA lesion of Lipid Peroxidation and serves as its biomarker: it records cumulative oxidative lipid damage in the genome, and steady-state levels in human leukocyte DNA typically run 1–50 adducts per 10⁸ nucleotides, rising with smoking, inflammation, and diets rich in oxidized lipid. Accumulation of the adduct with age also parallels the decline in repair capacity, making it a molecular clock of oxidative lipid exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: M₁dG 是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具代表性的 DNA 損傷，並作為其生物標記：它記錄了基因組中累積的氧化性脂質損傷，人類白血球 DNA 的穩態含量通常為每 10⁸ 個核苷酸 1–50 個加合物，並隨抽菸、發炎與富含氧化脂質的飲食而升高。該加合物隨年齡的累積也與修復能力下降平行，因此可視為氧化性脂質暴露的分子時鐘。

nodes.label: Mdivi-1
nodes.description: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: TDP-43
nodes.description: TDP-43 is the canonical example of a mislocalized RNA-binding protein. Under stress it redistributes out of the nucleus into cytoplasmic aggregates and stress granules, losing nuclear function and gaining toxicity in ALS and frontotemporal dementia; more generally, RBP mislocalization or aggregation, including sequestration by tau or polyQ condensates, drives neurodegeneration by disrupting RNA metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TDP-43 是錯定位 RNA-binding protein 的典型例子。在壓力下它從細胞核重新分布到細胞質聚集体與壓力顆粒，失去核內功能並在 ALS 與額顳葉失智症中獲得毒性；更一般地說，RBP 的錯定位或聚集（包括被 tau 或 polyQ 凝聚體隔離）會破壞 RNA 代謝而驅動神經退化。

nodes.label: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer
nodes.description: Oocyte cytoplasm reprograms donor nuclei in SCNT. Enablement is the maternal-factor mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞質在 SCNT 重編程供體核。賦能是母系因子機制。

nodes.label: EP300
nodes.description: EP300 (E1A binding protein p300) is a histone acetyltransferase and transcriptional coactivator encoded by the EP300 gene. It acetylates H3K9ac-marked chromatin and is recruited by p53, NF-kB, and nuclear receptors to activate transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EP300（E1A 結合蛋白 p300）是由 EP300 基因編碼的 Histone Acetyltransferase（組蛋白乙醯化轉移酶）與轉錄共同活化因子。它乙醯化帶有 H3K9ac 標記的染色質，並由 p53、NF-kB 與核受體招募以活化轉錄。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: FOXO Transcription Factors
nodes.description: Akt phosphorylates FOXO, excluding it from the nucleus and silencing Bim/Puma transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化 FOXO 將其排除於核外，沉默 Bim/Puma 轉錄。

nodes.label: CREB
nodes.description: Ca2+ and cAMP signaling intersect to regulate CREB-dependent transcription: Ca2+ activates CaMKIV, while cAMP activates PKA, and both phosphorylate CREB at Ser133. Ca2+-permeable channels such as TRPM2, activated by ADP-ribose and OAADPr, further couple NAD+ metabolism to Ca2+ influx, so calcium signalling and sirtuin energy sensing converge on the same transcription factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ca2+ 與 cAMP 訊號在調控 CREB 依賴的轉錄上交會：Ca2+ 活化 CaMKIV，cAMP 活化 PKA，兩者皆在 Ser133 磷酸化 CREB。TRPM2 等 Ca2+ 可通透通道可被 ADP-ribose 與 OAADPr 活化，進一步把 NAD+ 代謝與 Ca2+ 內流偶聯起來，使鈣離子訊號與 sirtuin 能量感測匯流於同一轉錄因子。

nodes.label: TLR2
nodes.description: TLR2 is the primary pattern recognition receptor for lipoteichoic acid, functioning as a complex with TLR6 and the co-receptor CD36. Binding of LTA to the TLR2/TLR6/CD36 complex activates MyD88-dependent NF-κB and MAPK signalling, inducing TNF-α, IL-6, IL-8 and IL-1β production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TLR2 是 lipoteichoic acid 的主要模式辨識受體，與 TLR6 及共同受體 CD36 形成複合體。LTA 與 TLR2/TLR6/CD36 複合體結合後，會活化 MyD88 相關的 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號，誘導 TNF-α、IL-6、IL-8 與 IL-1β 的產生。

nodes.label: Isourolithin A
nodes.description: Isourolithin A, the gut-microbial isomer of urolithin A, can stimulate mitophagy, the selective clearance of damaged mitochondria. By improving mitochondrial quality control it is of interest for muscle health and healthspan, though its potency is generally somewhat lower than that of urolithin A.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Isourolithin A 是 urolithin A 的腸道菌叢異構體，可刺激 Mitophagy，即可選擇性清除受損粒線體。藉由改善粒線體品質管制，它對肌肉健康與 healthspan 具意義，但效價通常略低於 urolithin A。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: FOXO3
nodes.description: FOXO3 is a longevity-associated forkhead transcription factor regulated by acetylation. Note-canonical spelling kept; cross-file FOXO3a variance noted.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FOXO3 是受乙醯化調節的長壽相關叉頭轉錄因子。保留筆記典型拼寫；跨檔案 FOXO3a 差異已註記。

nodes.label: Autoimmune Disease
nodes.description: Loss of the negative immune regulators that hold T Cell in a quiescent state makes T cells hypersensitive to activation signals, decreasing self-tolerance and thereby increasing Autoimmune Disease; quiescence is thus an active brake on autoimmunity rather than passive inactivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 喪失使 T Cell 維持在靜止狀態的負向免疫調節因子，會讓 T 細胞對活化訊號過度敏感，降低自身耐受性並因而增加 Autoimmune Disease；因此靜止狀態是抑制自體免疫的主動煞車，而非被動的不活動。

nodes.label: Caspase-10
nodes.description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: MMP-2
nodes.description: MMP-2 (gelatinase A) was among the first matrix-degrading enzymes catalogued in the senescence secretome. It is a secreted component of the SASP that remodels the extracellular matrix around senescent cells, releasing matrix-sequestered growth factors and by degrading basement membranes and activating latent TGF-β, amplifying paracrine senescence and fibrogenic signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-2（gelatinase A）是最早被列入衰老分泌組的基質降解酶之一。它是 SASP 的分泌成分，會重塑衰老細胞周圍的細胞外基質，釋放被基質囚禁的生長因子；並藉由降解基底膜與活化潛伏的 TGF-β，放大旁分泌衰老與促纖維化訊號。

nodes.label: p22phox
nodes.description: Loss-of-function mutations in CYBA cause an autosomal form of Chronic Granulomatous Disease. The mechanism is loss of oxidase activity rather than loss of an antioxidant: without a stable cytochrome b558, the phagocyte respiratory burst fails and catalase-positive organisms survive, so the disease is a state of deficient antimicrobial Oxidative Stress generation. It is functionally indistinguishable from the p47phox form, which is why CGD is diagnosed by respiratory-burst assay rather than by subunit.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CYBA 的無效突變會造成體染色體型的 Chronic Granulomatous Disease。其機制是氧化酶活性喪失而非抗氧劑喪失：缺少穩定的 cytochrome b558，吞噬細胞的呼吸爆發便告失敗，過氧化氫酶陽性微生物得以存活，因此此疾病是抗微生物 Oxidative Stress 生成不足的狀態。它與 p47phox 型在功能上無法區分，這也是 CGD 靠呼吸爆發檢驗而非靠次單元來診斷的原因。

nodes.label: COX-2
nodes.description: Apigenin suppresses cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), the enzyme that converts arachidonic acid into prostaglandins and whose overexpression drives carcinogenesis. It inhibits UVB-induced increases in COX-2 protein and mRNA in mouse and human keratinocytes, reduces COX-2 expression in colon and gastric cancer models, and downregulates inducible COX-2 in HCEC colon cells more potently than quercetin or tricin. In non-melanoma skin cancer models, COX-2 inhibition by apigenin prevents tumor development, and apigenin also suppresses UVB-induced cutaneous angiogenesis by maintaining endogenous TSP1 levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制環氧合酶-2 (COX-2)，該酶將 arachidonic 酸轉化為前列腺素，且其過表達促進癌變。它抑制了在小鼠和人類表皮細胞中 UVB 誘導的 COX-2 蛋白和 mRNA 升高，在結直腸癌和胃癌模型中降低 COX-2 表現，並且比槲皮苷或槲青素更強效地 downregulation  inducible COX-2 在 HCEC 結直腸細胞中，在非黑色素瘤皮膚癌模型中，阿皮ゲ寧通過抑制 COX-2 預防腫瘤發育，阿皮ゲ寧還通過維持內源性 TSP1 水平抑制 UVB 誘導的表皮血管生成。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Ubiquitination
nodes.description: Ubiquitination is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 泛素化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

nodes.label: Thermogenesis
nodes.description: Heat production during Thermogenesis depends on Mitochondrial Uncoupling: proton leak and the uncoupling proteins UCP1, UCP2 and UCP3 dissipate the proton-motive force as heat, uncoupling oxygen consumption from ATP synthesis. This is the dominant mechanism of non-shivering Thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thermogenesis 中的產熱仰賴 Mitochondrial Uncoupling：質子漏與解偶聯蛋白 UCP1、UCP2、UCP3 將質子動力勢以熱的形式耗散，使氧消耗與 ATP 合成脫鉤。這是棕色脂肪組織中非顫抖性 Thermogenesis 的主要機制。

nodes.label: Glutamine
nodes.description: Alpha-ketoglutarate is generated from Glutamine via Glutaminase and subsequent glutamate conversion, making it the primary entry point for glutamine-derived carbon into the TCA cycle. Metabolic 13C tracing shows that in MYC-high cancer cells glutamine is the primary carbon source for alpha-ketoglutarate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: α-酮戊二酸由 Glutamine 經 Glutaminase 及後續的麩胺酸轉換而生成，因此它是麩醯胺胺衍生碳進入 TCA cycle 的主要入口。代謝性 ¹³C 追蹤顯示，在 MYC 高表現的癌細胞中，Glutamine 是 α-酮戊二酸的主要碳來源。

nodes.label: Elastokines
nodes.description: Elastokine signalling through the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor activates ERK1/2 and p38 MAPK and NF-kappaB, upregulating transcription of MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12. This creates the positive feedback loop elastin degradation to elastokine generation to EBP signalling to MMP upregulation to further elastin degradation, which accelerates tissue deterioration in ageing, COPD, atherosclerosis and photoageing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Elastokine 經由彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體的訊號會活化 ERK1/2、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB，並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 的轉錄。這形成彈性蛋白降解→elastokine 生成→EBP 訊號→MMP 上調→更多彈性蛋白降解的正向迴路，在老化、COPD、動脈粥狀硬化與光老化中加速組織劣化。

nodes.label: RAF
nodes.description: RAF is a family of serine/threonine kinases (ARAF, BRAF, CRAF/RAF1) that transmit signals from RAS to MEK in the canonical RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade. RAF kinases are recruited to the membrane upon RAS-GTP activation, where they phosphorylate MEK1/2, which activates ERK1/2 and drives proliferation and survival; BRAF V600E is a common oncogenic mutation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RAF 是一族絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶 (ARAF、BRAF、CRAF/RAF1)，在典型的 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK MAPK 級聯中將訊號由 RAS 傳至 MEK。當 RAS-GTP 活化時，RAF 激酶被招募至膜上並磷酸化 MEK1/2，後者活化 ERK1/2 以驅動增殖與存活；BRAF V600E 是常見的致癌突變。

nodes.label: TRIM2
nodes.description: TRIM2 ubiquitinates the pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein Bim: its RING domain recruits an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme while coiled-coil and NHL repeat domains confer substrate specificity, attaching ubiquitin chains to Bim lysines that mark it for 26S proteasome destruction. This degradative route is a post-translational safeguard against Apoptosis, distinct from ERK/RSK-mediated transcriptional suppression of Bim.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRIM2 會對促凋亡的 BH3-only 蛋白 Bim 進行泛素化：其 RING 結構域招募 E2 泛素連接酵素，coiled-coil 與 NHL repeat 結構域賦予受質專一性，把泛素鏈接到 Bim 的離胺酸上，使其被標記並由 26S 蛋白酶體分解。這條降解途徑是對抗 Apoptosis 的轉譯後防線，與 ERK/RSK 對 Bim 的轉錄抑制不同。

nodes.label: Glucocorticoids
nodes.description: Glucocorticoids bind the intracellular glucocorticoid receptor, and the hormone-receptor complex translocates to the nucleus where it transactivates anti-inflammatory genes and transrepresses pro-inflammatory transcription: it recruits histone deacetylases, competes with NF-κB and AP-1 for coactivators, and directly inhibits NF-κB transcriptional activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glucocorticoids 與細胞內的糖皮質激素受體結合，荷爾蒙－受體複合體轉位至細胞核，在其中進行抗發炎基因的轉活化與促發炎轉錄的轉抑制：它招募組蛋白去乙醯化酶、與 NF-κB 及 AP-1 競爭共同活化因子，並直接抑制 NF-κB 的轉錄活性。

nodes.label: Estrogen Receptor
nodes.description: Estrogen receptor drives luminal breast cancer and its expression guides endocrine therapy. Flavonoids such as apigenin show biphasic estrogenic/anti-estrogenic activity via ER-binding-dependent and -independent mechanisms, with apigenin exerting anti-estrogenic effects in breast cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雌激素受體驅動管腔型乳癌，其表現指引內分泌治療。諸如 apigenin 等黃酮類透過 ER 結合依賴與非依賴機制表現雙相雌激素/抗雌激素活性，apigenin 在乳癌細胞中發揮抗雌激素作用。

nodes.label: Major histocompatibility complex class I
nodes.description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Microtubule
nodes.description: Tubulin is the target of microtubule-interfering agents including benzimidazoles, taxanes and vinca alkaloids.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 微管蛋白是微管干擾藥物的靶標，包括苯並咪唑、紫杉烷和長春花生物鹼。

nodes.label: 3-Hydroxykynurenine
nodes.description: 3-Hydroxykynurenine (3-HK) is generated from Kynurenine by the enzyme kynurenine 3-monooxygenase (KMO) within the Kynurenine Pathway, and is further metabolized to Quinolinic Acid via 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 3-Hydroxykynurenine (3-HK) 在 Kynurenine Pathway 中由酵素 kynurenine 3-monooxygenase (KMO) 以 Kynurenine 為前驅物生成，並經 3-羥基鄰氨基苯甲酸進一步代謝為 Quinolinic Acid。

nodes.label: BET inhibitors
nodes.description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Hydroxychloroquine
nodes.description: Hydroxychloroquine is a 4-aminoquinoline derivative of chloroquine used clinically for malaria prophylaxis and treatment, for systemic lupus erythematosus, and as a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug in Rheumatoid Arthritis. Its immunomodulation works partly by interfering with antigen processing and endosomal Toll-like Receptor (TLR7/9) signaling. Chronic high-dose use risks irreversible retinopathy and rarely Cardiomyopathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 chloroquine 的 4-胺基quinoline 衍生物，臨床上用於瘧疾的預防與治療、Systemic Lupus Erythematosus，以及作為 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的抗發炎性修飾藥物。其免疫調節作用部分來自干擾抗原處理與內體 Toll-like Receptor（TLR7/9）訊號。長期高劑量使用可能造成不可逆的視網膜病變，罕見情況下會引起 Cardiomyopathy。

nodes.label: Vasoplegic Shock
nodes.description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label as adjunctive therapy for refractory vasoplegic shock, including septic and anaphylactic shock, to increase systemic vascular resistance in cases refractory to standard vasopressors, particularly in the setting of cardiac surgery such as coronary artery bypass grafting. It is commonly administered as a single intravenous bolus of 2 mg/kg over 20 to 30 minutes, with some protocols incorporating a bolus followed by continuous infusion. Evidence supporting routine preoperative or postoperative prophylactic use to reduce mortality remains limited, and this practice is not considered standard of care.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療 refractory 血管舒張性休克，包括敗血性和過敏性休克，以增加系統性血管阻力，適用於對標準血管加壓素 refractory 的病例，特別是在心臟手術如冠狀動脈繞道移植術中。通常以 2 mg/kg 劑量靜脈注射推注，持續 20 至 30 分鐘，有些方案包括推注後持續輸注。支持常規術前或術後預防性使用以降低死亡率的證據仍然有限，此實踐不被視為 standard of care。

nodes.label: APC-C
nodes.description: APC-C degrades CYCLIN B1 post-metaphase, the canonical mitotic-exit step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APC-C 在中期後降解 CYCLIN B1，是典型的有絲分裂退出步驟。

nodes.label: Triapine
nodes.description: Triapine (3-AP) is an investigational alpha-N-heterocyclic thiosemicarbazone iron chelator that inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by chelating the iron of the RRM2/RRM2B small subunits. This strips the tyrosyl-radical cofactor, inactivating RNR and collapsing de novo dNTP synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Triapine（3-AP）是研究性的 alpha-N-雜環硫代半卡巴腙鐵螯合劑，透過螯合 RRM2/RRM2B 小次單元的鐵來抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶。這剝離酪胺醯自由基輔因子，使 RNR 失活並使 de novo dNTP 合成崩潰。

nodes.label: Diazepam
nodes.description: Diazepam increases GABA-A chloride-channel opening frequency, potentiating fast inhibitory neurotransmission. Modulation is the allosteric enhancement relationship.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diazepam 提高 GABA-A 氯通道開放頻率，增強快速抑制性神經傳導。調節是變構增強關係。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain
nodes.description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain pumps protons across the inner membrane, building the electrochemical gradient ΔΨm that defines the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential and drives ATP synthesis; its collapse is an early event in oxidative neuronal injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain 將質子泵送過內膜，建立定義 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 的電化學梯度 ΔΨm 並驅動 ATP 合成；其崩解是氧化性神經損傷的早期事件。

nodes.label: MPC
nodes.description: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) is a heterodimeric MPC1/MPC2 complex in the inner mitochondrial membrane that imports cytosolic pyruvate, derived from glycolysis, into the matrix. There pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, so MPC links glycolysis to mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and is the rate-limiting entry point for glucose-derived carbon into the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）是由 MPC1/MPC2 組成的異二聚體複合體，位於粒線體內膜，將源自糖解作用的細胞質丙酮酸輸入基質。在基質中，丙酮酸由丙酮酸去氫酶複合體轉為乙醯輔酶 A，因此 MPC 連結了糖解作用與粒線體氧化代謝，是葡萄糖來源碳進入 TCA 循環的限速入口。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: Melanocytes
nodes.description: Melanocytes and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Melanocytes and Cutaneous Melanoma may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Melanocytes 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Melanocytes 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Andy Crump
nodes.description: Andy Crump is a scientist and science communicator who has documented the discovery and global health impact of Ivermectin, authoring books and heavily cited historical accounts that trace the drug from the soil bacterium Streptomyces avermectinius to a Nobel-recognized therapy. His writing situates Ivermectin within the broader history of Avermectin research and the Merck & Co. Inc donation programme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Andy Crump 是記錄 Ivermectin 發現史與全球健康影響的科學家與科學傳播者，他撰寫專書與大量引用文獻，將此藥從土壤細菌 Streptomyces avermectinius 追溯到獲諾貝爾認可的治療。他的著作將 Ivermectin 置於更廣泛的 Avermectin 研究史與 Merck & Co. Inc 捐贈計畫的脈絡中。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Matrix
nodes.description: The Mitochondrial Matrix is the site of the Citric Acid Cycle, where acetyl-CoA is oxidized to generate the NADH and FADH2 that feed the mitochondrial electron transport chain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Matrix 是 Citric Acid Cycle 進行的場所，acetyl-CoA 在此被氧化，產生供應粒線體電子傳遞鏈的 NADH 與 FADH2。

nodes.label: translational-level regulation
nodes.description: Autophagy is controlled by translational-level regulation through four distinct mechanisms: eIF2α phosphorylation, 4E-BP1/eIF4E control, PDCD4/eIF4A inhibition and m6A Modification of autophagy gene mRNAs. Having several independent handles means the cell can tune autophagic machinery output without changing the transcription of the genes themselves.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Autophagy 透過四種不同機制受到 translational-level regulation 調控：eIF2α 磷酸化、4E-BP1/eIF4E 調控、PDCD4/eIF4A 抑制，以及自噬基因 mRNA 的 m6A Modification。擁有多個彼此獨立的著力點，代表細胞可在不改變基因轉錄的情況下調整自噬機組的產出。

nodes.label: NRH
nodes.description: Beyond its classical role of phosphorylating adenosine to AMP in purine salvage, Adenosine kinase acts as an NRH kinase, phosphorylating the reduced nucleoside NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) to generate NMNH. Because NRH is more stable than Nicotinamide Riboside and more potently raises cellular NAD+, this reaction explains why NRH outcompetes NR as a precursor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了在嘌呤補救途徑中將腺苷磷酸化為 AMP 的經典角色之外，Adenosine Kinase 還作為 NRH 激酶作用，將還原核苷 NRH（dihydronicotinamide riboside）磷酸化生成 NMNH。由於 NRH 比 Nicotinamide Riboside 更穩定、且更有效提升細胞 NAD+，此反應解釋了 NRH 作為前驅物為何優於 NR。

nodes.label: Mitomycin C
nodes.description: Mitomycin C is a prototypical intra- plus interstrand crosslinker. Classification defines the drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitomycin C 是原型的鏈內加鏈間交聯劑。歸類定義藥物。

nodes.label: AP2
nodes.description: AP2 is recruited to autolysosomal microdomains enriched in PtdIns(4,5)P2 during Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, where it nucleates clathrin coats that drive the membrane tubulation producing proto-lysosomes. Depletion of AP2 subunits impairs tubule formation and lysosome reformation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 過程中，AP2 會被招募到富含 PtdIns(4,5)P2 的自噬溶酶體微區，並在該處成核形成 clathrin 衣被以驅動產生 proto-lysosome 的膜管形成。AP2 次單元耗竭會損害膜管形成與溶酶體再形成。

nodes.label: Beta-Adrenergic Receptor
nodes.description: Beta-adrenergic receptors are G protein-coupled receptors activated by the catecholamines norepinephrine and epinephrine; the beta1 subtype predominates in the heart and beta2 in smooth and skeletal muscle, mediating sympathetic control of heart rate, contractility and metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Beta-adrenergic receptor 是由兒茶酚胺 norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 活化的 G 蛋白偶聯受體；beta1 亞型主要存在於心臟，beta2 存在於平滑肌與骨骼肌，介導交感神經對心率、收縮力與代謝的調控。

nodes.label: Astrocyte Senescence
nodes.description: Sustained cGAS-STING Pathway activation downstream of proteotoxic and mitochondrial stress drives Astrocyte Senescence, a stable growth-arrested, pro-inflammatory state with a SASP secretome that amplifies Neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在蛋白毒性與粒線體壓力之下持續活化的 cGAS-STING Pathway 會驅動 Astrocyte Senescence——一種穩定停滯生長、促發炎且具有 SASP 分泌表型的狀態，進而放大 Neuroinflammation 與神經退化。

nodes.label: Silver sulfide albuminates
nodes.description: Silver sulfide albuminates are the circulating transport form that delivers Silver from the blood to peripheral tissues. This protein-bound sulfide is the mechanistic bridge between systemic silver exposure and the tissue granules responsible for the pigmentation seen in Argyria, because it keeps silver soluble in plasma until it reaches and precipitates in the dermis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Silver sulfide albuminates 是將 Silver 由血液運送至周邊組織的循環運輸形式。這種蛋白結合態的硫化物是全身性 silver 曝露與造成 Argyria 色素沉著之組織顆粒之間的機制橋樑：它讓 silver 在血漿中保持可溶狀態，直到抵達真皮並沉澱為顆粒。

nodes.label: Dopaminochrome
nodes.description: Multiple lines of evidence implicate Dopaminochrome in the selective vulnerability of substantia nigra pars compacta neurons in Parkinson's Disease: postmortem PD brains show 3–5-fold elevations of dopamine oxidation products, PARK2 (Parkin) mutations impair mitophagy and enhance dopaminochrome accumulation, PARK7 (DJ-1) deficiency reduces buffering against dopamine quinones, and Dopaminochrome modification accelerates SNCA alpha-synuclein crosslinking and aggregation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 多項證據指出 Dopaminochrome 參與 substantia nigra pars compacta 神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中的選擇性脆弱性：屍檢 PD 腦中的 dopamine 氧化產物升高 3–5 倍，PARK2（Parkin）突變損害 mitophagy 並加劇 dopaminochrome 累積，PARK7（DJ-1）缺乏降低對 dopamine quinone 的緩衝能力，而 Dopaminochrome 修飾會加速 SNCA alpha-synuclein 的交聯與聚集。

nodes.label: NRK2
nodes.description: NRK2 (Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp) is a muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme that phosphorylates nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), the rate-limiting entry step of the salvage pathway: NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+. It provides a stress-responsive supplementary route alongside NAMPT and becomes critical during muscle regeneration and metabolic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NRK2（Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp）是肌肉專一性的 NAD+ 生合成酵素，可將 nicotinamide riboside (NR) 磷酸化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN)，此為 salvage pathway 的限速入口步驟：NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+。它與 NAMPT 並行提供一條壓力反應的補充途徑，在肌肉再生與代謝壓力期間變得關鍵。

nodes.label: Immune System
nodes.description: Cancer evades Immune System. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The immune system surveys and eliminates nascent malignancies, a process tumors must subvert to establish and progress. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Immune System rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer 迴避 Immune System。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Immune System 研究並消除新生的惡性腫瘤，這是腫瘤形成和發展必須顛覆的過程。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Immune System 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

nodes.label: IDH2
nodes.description: SIRT5 activates IDH2 through desuccinylation, enhancing its NADPH-producing activity and thereby supporting glutathione reduction and ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of IDH2-dependent redox buffering. This complements SOD1 activation in antioxidant defense, and it shows SIRT5's desuccinylation broadly strengthens reductive capacity. By boosting NADPH production, SIRT5 ensures sufficient reducing equivalents for glutathione and thioredoxin systems. This regulation links SIRT5 to both energy metabolism and redox homeostasis, particularly during fasting when oxidative stress rises.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化 IDH2，增強其 NADPH 產生活性，從而支持穀胱甘肽還原和 ROS 清除。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於 IDH2 依賴性紅氧緩衝的上游。這與 SOD1 活化在抗氧化防禦中互補，並表明 SIRT5 的去琥珀醯化廣泛增強還原能力。透過增強 NADPH 產生，SIRT5 確保穀胱甘肽和硫氧還蛋白系統有足夠的還原當量。此調控將 SIRT5 與能量代謝和紅氧恆定性聯繫起來，特別是在禁食期間氧化壓力升高時。

nodes.label: PD-L1
nodes.description: PD-1, a type I transmembrane inhibitory receptor of the CD28 family with ITIM and ITSM motifs, is engaged by PD-L1 (B7-H1/CD274) and PD-L2. Ligand engagement recruits the SHP-1 and SHP-2 phosphatases to the ITSM, dephosphorylating downstream CD28/PI3K/AKT and RAS-MEK-ERK components and suppressing T-cell proliferation, cytokine production, and cytotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PD-1 是 CD28 家族具 ITIM 與 ITSM 模體的 I 型跨膜抑制性受體，由 PD-L1（B7-H1/CD274）與 PD-L2 結合。配體結合會將 SHP-1 與 SHP-2 磷酸酶招募至 ITSM，使下游 CD28/PI3K/AKT 與 RAS-MEK-ERK 成分去磷酸化，抑制 T 細胞增殖、細胞激素生成與細胞毒性。

nodes.label: SAHA
nodes.description: SAHA (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid, INN vorinostat) is the prototypical hydroxamic-acid pan-HDAC inhibitor: its zinc-chelating hydroxamate group occupies the catalytic pocket of Zn2+-dependent HDACs, blocking class I and class II deacetylases. It became the first HDAC inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2006, for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAHA（suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid，INN 名 vorinostat）是羥肟酸類廣效 HDAC 抑制劑的原型：其螯鋅羥肟酸基團占據 Zn2+ 依賴型 HDAC 的催化口袋，阻斷第一類與第二類去乙醯化酶。2006 年 SAHA 成為首個獲 FDA 核准的 HDAC 抑制劑，用於皮膚型 T 細胞淋巴瘤。

nodes.label: Myosin
nodes.description: Non-muscle myosin II generates the contractile forces needed for Cell Migration: it drives protrusion retraction, rear-end detachment, and adhesion turnover at the trailing edge, all on Cytoskeleton-resident Actin tracks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非肌肉型 myosin II 產生 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）所需的收縮力：驅動前緣的伸縮、尾端分離，以及後緣的黏附周轉—all 皆在 Cytoskeleton（細胞骨架）中的 Actin 軌道上進行。

nodes.label: HMGA1
nodes.description: HMGA1 is a non-histone chromatin architectural protein induced during senescence, where it cooperates with the RB1 pathway to promote formation of repressive heterochromatin at E2F target genes and at senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF).
nodes.description_zh_TW: HMGA1 是在衰老期間被誘導的非組蛋白染色質架構蛋白，與 RB1 途徑合作，在 E2F 目標基因及衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）處促進抑制性異染色質的形成。

nodes.label: Tocopherols
nodes.description: Tocopherols are the four naturally occurring forms of Vitamin E - alpha, beta, gamma and delta - sharing the chroman-6-ol core but carrying a saturated 16-carbon phytyl tail, and differing only in chromanol ring methylation. Along with the unsaturated Tocotrienols they make up the eight vitamers of vitamin E. The phenolic hydroxyl is the hydrogen donor that terminates Lipid Peroxidation, while the lipophilic tail anchors the molecule in the lipid bilayer or lipoprotein core.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tocopherols 是 Vitamin E 的四種天然存在形式——alpha、beta、gamma 與 delta——共用 chroman-6-ol 核心，但帶有飽和的 16 碳 phytyl 尾，差異僅在 chromanol 環的甲基化。它們與不飽和的 Tocotrienols 合計構成 vitamin E 的八種 vitamer。酚羥基是終止 Lipid Peroxidation 的氫原子提供者，而親脂性尾部則把分子錨定在脂質雙層或脂蛋白核心中。

nodes.label: eIF4A
nodes.description: Translation Initiation depends on eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase that unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so the ribosome can scan to the AUG start codon. eIF4A acts within the eIF4F complex together with eIF4E and eIF4G, and its activity on TFEB mRNA is a node at which autophagy gene expression can be controlled.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 依賴 eIF4A，即 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶；它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使核糖體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。eIF4A 與 eIF4E、eIF4G 一起在 eIF4F 複合體中作用，其對 TFEB mRNA 的活性是調控自噬基因表現的關節點。

nodes.label: Lipid Synthesis
nodes.description: SREBP-1c is the master transcriptional regulator of de novo lipogenesis. Synthesized as an inactive precursor anchored to the endoplasmic reticulum, it is processed and released by S1P/S2P proteases after SCAP-mediated transport to the Golgi at low sterol, and the active N-terminal domain translocates to the nucleus to drive fatty acid and triglyceride biosynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SREBP-1c 是 de novo lipogenesis（從新生脂質合成）的核心轉錄調節因子。它先以失活前驅物形式錨定於 endoplasmic reticulum，在低固醇時經 SCAP 運送至 Golgi apparatus 後由 S1P/S2P 蛋白酶切割，其活性 N 端區段轉位至細胞核，驅動脂肪酸與三酸甘油酯的生合成。

nodes.label: Intrinsic Pathway
nodes.description: Doxorubicin (Adriamycin), an anthracycline chemotherapy drug, exerts anticancer effects by intercalating between DNA base pairs, inhibiting topoisomerase II-mediated DNA repair, and generating free radicals that induce Oxidative Stress. These actions collectively trigger the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin（Adriamycin）是一種 anthracycline 類化療藥物，其抗癌作用來自插入 DNA 鹼基對之間、抑制 topoisomerase II 媒介的 DNA 修補，以及產生自由基而誘發 Oxidative Stress。這些作用共同啟動 Apoptosis 的 Intrinsic Pathway。

nodes.label: Atg14L
nodes.description: Atg14L promotes the fusion of mature autophagosomes with the lysosome by binding the tethering factor Syntaxin 17, completing autophagic flux. This positions Atg14L not only in initiation but also in the lysosomal degradation step of autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg14L 透過結合繫鏈因子 Syntaxin 17 促進成熟自噬體與溶酶體的融合，完成自噬流。這使 Atg14L 不僅參與起始，也參與自噬的溶酶體降解步驟。

nodes.label: ECM
nodes.description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

nodes.label: Sirtuin Activators
nodes.description: Sirtuin activators are compounds and interventions that increase the catalytic efficiency or expression of sirtuins; the best-studied class are the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) exemplified by resveratrol, which lower the KM of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 活化劑是提高 sirtuin 催化效率或表現量的化合物與介入手段；研究最充分的一類是以 resveratrol 為代表的 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs），它們降低 SIRT1 對其胜肽與 NAD+ 受質的 KM。

nodes.label: ovarian cancer
nodes.description: BRCA predisposes to ovarian cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. High-grade serous ovarian cancer is characterized by frequent BRCA1/2 dysfunction and exquisite sensitivity to platinum and PARP inhibition. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon ovarian cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA 傾向於ovarian cancer。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。高等級漿液性ovarian cancer的特徵是頻繁的BRCA1/2功能障礙以及對鉑和PARP抑制的高度敏感性。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 ovarian cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種關係強調了遺傳或內在因素如何影響癌症易感性，並為風險分層篩檢和預防提供資訊。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: p27
nodes.description: The CDK inhibitor p27 is co-induced with p21 to enforce cell cycle arrest. p27 inhibits G1 cyclin-CDK complexes, maintaining cells in a non-proliferative state. Together with p21 it represents a key effector of growth arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27 與 p21 共同被誘導以強制實施細胞週期停滯。p27 抑制 G1 cyclin–CDK 複合體，使細胞維持在非增殖狀態。它與 p21 共同構成生長停滯的關鍵效應因子。

nodes.label: AceCS2
nodes.description: AceCS2 is the mitochondrial matrix acetyl-CoA synthetase that catalyzes the ATP-dependent two-step adenylation of acetate and CoA into acetyl-CoA, via an acetyl-AMP intermediate. By reclaiming acetate — often viewed as a waste product — as usable carbon, it feeds acetyl-CoA into the TCA cycle for ATP generation and buffers supply when pyruvate-derived acetyl-CoA is limiting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AceCS2 是粒線體基質的乙醯輔酶 A 合成酶，經由乙醯 AMP 中間物，催化醋酸與 CoA 依賴 ATP 的兩步腺苷酸化反應生成 acetyl-CoA。它回收常被視為廢物的醋酸作為可用碳源，將 acetyl-CoA 送入 TCA 循環以產生 ATP，並在丙酮酸衍生的 acetyl-CoA 不足時提供緩衝。

nodes.label: Cell Division
nodes.description: Cell Division, in which a parent cell yields two or more daughter cells, is tightly governed by the Cell Cycle, with checkpoints ensuring accuracy of DNA replication and chromosome segregation. Key regulators include cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb/E2F, p53, and checkpoint kinases; dysregulated division is a hallmark of cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cell Division（細胞分裂，親代細胞產生兩個或更多子細胞）受到 Cell Cycle 的嚴密調控，並由檢查點確保 DNA 複製與染色體分離的正確性。主要調控因子包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb/E2F、p53 與檢查點激酶；失調的細胞分裂是 cancer 的特徵之一。

nodes.label: Ellagic acid
nodes.description: Dietary ellagitannins hydrolyze to Ellagic Acid, which colonic Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens convert through urolithin M6/C to terminal Urolithin A; only Metabotype A individuals (25-55%) convert efficiently, so direct UA supplementation bypasses microbiome dependency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 飲食 ellagitannins 水解為 Ellagic Acid，再由結腸 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 與 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 經 urolithin M6/C 轉為終端 Urolithin A；僅 Metabotype A 個體（25–55%）能有效轉換，故直接補充 UA 可繞過菌相依賴。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: GLO1
nodes.description: GLO1 (glyoxalase 1, lactoylglutathione lyase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the cellular Glyoxalase System. It catalyzes conversion of hemithioacetals, which form spontaneously between the reactive dicarbonyl Methylglyoxal and Glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione, committing the dicarbonyl to detoxification rather than further reaction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase 1，lactoylglutathione lyase）是細胞 Glyoxalase System 的限速酵素。它催化將反應性二碳醣基 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 自發形成的 hemithioacetal 轉為 S-D-lactoylglutathione，使該二碳醣基被導向去毒途徑而非進一步反應。

nodes.label: Xanthine Oxidase
nodes.description: Uric acid (UA) is the terminal end-product of human purine catabolism. Xanthine Oxidase catalyzes the final two oxidations of the pathway, converting hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to urate, which is why inhibiting this enzyme with allopurinol is the standard way to lower uric acid in gout.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Uric acid (UA) 是人類嘌呤分解代謝的最終產物。Xanthine Oxidase 催化途徑中最後兩次氧化，將 hypoxanthine 氧化為 xanthine，再將 xanthine 氧化為 urate；因此以 allopurinol 抑制此酵素是降低 gout 中 uric acid 的標準作法。

nodes.label: Histone Methyltransferase
nodes.description: Histone Methyltransferase enzymes are the 'writers' of Histone Methylation, using S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) as the universal methyl donor. Lysine methyltransferases such as SUV39H1, EZH2 and DOT1L, and arginine PRMTs, show high residue specificity, which is what allows repressive and activating marks to occupy distinct sites.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone Methyltransferase 酵素是 Histone Methylation 的「寫入者」，以 S-adenosylmethionine（SAM）作為通用的甲基供體。SUV39H1、EZH2、DOT1L 等離胺酸甲基轉移酶，以及精胺酸 PRMT，對殘基具有高度專一性，正因如此抑制性與活化性標記才能占據不同位點。

nodes.label: MELAS
nodes.description: MELAS is a maternally inherited mitochondrial disorder caused most commonly by the A3243G mutation in the mitochondrial DNA tRNA-Leu(UUR) gene, which disrupts translation of the 13 protein-coding genes and leads to energy failure in high-demand tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MELAS 是母系遺傳的粒線體疾病，最常由粒線體 DNA 的 tRNA-Leu(UUR) 基因 A3243G 突變引起，該突變破壞 13 個蛋白質編碼基因的轉譯，導致高需求組織發生能量衰竭。

nodes.label: H3K18ac
nodes.description: H3K18ac is an acetylation associated with active enhancers and is one of the acetyl marks enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. It contributes to the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers and cooperates with the AP-1 pioneer factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3K18ac 是與活性增強子相關的乙醯化，是衰老活化超級增強子富集的乙醯標記之一。它促成 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態，並與 AP-1 先驅因子合作。

nodes.label: Human Serum Albumin
nodes.description: Human Serum Albumin is the most abundant plasma protein (35–50 g/L; 66.5 kDa, 585 residues) and the body's major transport protein for fatty acids, Bilirubin, hormones, metal ions and a wide range of drugs. It also maintains plasma colloid oncotic pressure and buffers pH, and its free Cys34 thiol scavenges Reactive Oxygen Species and nitrogen species extracellularly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是血漿中最豐富的蛋白質（35–50 g/L；66.5 kDa、585 個殘基），也是脂肪酸、Bilirubin、荷爾蒙、金屬離子與廣泛藥物的全身主要運輸蛋白。它同時維持血漿膠體滲透壓並緩衝 pH，其游離的 Cys34 硫醇還能在細胞外清除 Reactive Oxygen Species 與含氮物種。

nodes.label: SRT1460
nodes.description: SRT1460 belongs to the imidazothiazole class of synthetic sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), structurally unrelated to the polyphenolic first-generation STAC resveratrol, and is discussed alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as second-generation activators found by high-throughput screening of SIRT1 activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SRT1460 屬於咪唑並噻唑類的合成 sirtuin 活化劑（STAC），與多酚類第一代 STAC resveratrol 結構無關；它與 SRT1720、SRT2183 一同被視為透過 SIRT1 活性高 throughput 篩檢發現的第二代活化劑。

nodes.label: Myostatin
nodes.description: Myostatin is the principal negative regulator of Muscle Hypertrophy. Binding activin type IIB receptors and recruiting ALK4/5 to phosphorylate SMAD2/3, it represses myogenic genes, blocks myoblast proliferation and differentiation, and antagonizes Akt/mTORC1 anabolic signalling — the brake that loss-of-function 'double-muscling' mutations remove.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myostatin 是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的主要負向調節因子。它結合 activin type IIB 受體並招募 ALK4/5 去磷酸化 SMAD2/3，抑制肌源性基因、阻斷 myoblast 的增殖與分化，並拮抗 Akt/mTORC1 的合成代謝訊號——這正是功能喪失型「double-muscling」突變所解除的煞車。

nodes.label: Ubiquitin
nodes.description: Ubiquitin is a conserved 76-amino-acid protein that, through an E1/E2/E3 cascade, is covalently attached to lysines of target proteins. The resulting K48-linked chains are the canonical degradation signal recognized by the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System, while K63-linked chains instead mediate signaling, endocytosis and DNA repair, and deubiquitinases reverse the mark.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin 是一種高度保守的 76 胺基酸蛋白質，經由 E1/E2/E3 級聯反應共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基。所形成的 K48 鏈是 26S proteasome 辨識的典型降解訊號，而 K63 鏈則參與訊號傳遞、胞吞與 DNA 修復，去泛素化酵素則可逆轉此標記。

nodes.label: Cysteinyldopa
nodes.description: Because cysteinyldopa formation diverts dopaquinone away from redox polymerization toward a stable thioether adduct, it mitigates quinone-driven ROS generation. It therefore represents the thiol-capture arm of the same ortho-quinone management problem that the adrenochrome/aminochrome pathway illustrates in the adrenergic setting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 Cysteinyldopa 的形成把 Dopaquinone 從 redox 聚合導向穩定的硫醚加合物，它減輕了醌類所驅動的 ROS 生成。因此它代表著與 adrenochrome/aminochrome 路徑在腎上腺素能情境中所闡明者，同一鄰醌管理問題的硫醇捕捉一環。

nodes.label: Rag proteins
nodes.description: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where its activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation and positions mTORC1 for activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rag GTP 酶（RagA/B 與 RagC/D）以異二聚體形式結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重定位到溶酶體表面，也就是其活化因子 Rheb 所在之處。胺基酸充足會偏向 Rag 的活化構形，使 mTORC1 就位以接受活化。

nodes.label: Apaf-1
nodes.description: Following mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), often mediated by Bax and Bak, Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytoplasm, where it binds Apaf-1 and pro-Caspase-9 in the presence of dATP/ATP. This nucleates Apoptosome assembly, which activates the initiator Caspase-9 in the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在粒線體外膜通透化（MOMP）之後（常由 Bax 與 Bak 介導），Cytochrome c（細胞色素 c）由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，並在 dATP／ATP 存在下結合 Apaf-1 與 pro-Caspase-9，啟動 Apoptosome（凋亡小體）的組裝，進而活化起始型 Caspase-9，完成 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）內在途徑的啟動。

nodes.label: Muscle
nodes.description: Myosin motors walk along Actin filaments and convert ATP hydrolysis into mechanical force. Sarcomeric myosin II drives Muscle contraction in Cardiomyocytes, and myosin light-chain phosphorylation tunes contractility in smooth muscle and endothelium.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myosin 馬達蛋白沿著 Actin（肌動蛋白）絲移動，將 ATP 水解轉換為機械力。肌節型 myosin II 驅動 Cardiomyocytes（心肌細胞）中的 Muscle（肌肉）收縮，而 myosin 輕鏈磷酸化則調節平滑肌與內皮細胞的收縮力。

nodes.label: Cataract
nodes.description: Cataract is the opacification of the eye's crystalline lens, and its formation is driven by cumulative oxidative damage: thiol oxidation, protein carbonylation, and AGE-mediated glycation unfold and cross-link Lens Crystallins, which then aggregate and scatter light. Because the lens has minimal protein turnover, the damage accumulates irreversibly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cataract（白內障）是眼睛晶狀體的混濁，其形成由累積的氧化性傷害驅動：硫醇氧化、protein carbonylation（蛋白質羰基化）與 AGE 介導的糖化使 Lens Crystallins（晶狀體晶 crystallin 蛋白）展開並交聯，隨後聚集並散射光線。由於晶狀體的蛋白質周轉率極低，傷害會不可逆地累積。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Sodium hydrogencarbonate
nodes.description: Sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO3) serves as the preferred buffer during the oxidation of Epinephrine, maintaining the reaction medium within the pH 4-8 range required for adrenochrome formation. It is one of several buffer options (sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, sodium acetate) in industrial adrenochrome processes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sodium hydrogencarbonate（NaHCO3）在 Epinephrine 的 Oxidation 過程中作為首選緩衝液，將反應介質維持在形成 Adrenochrome 所需的 pH 4–8 範圍內。它是工業 Adrenochrome 製程中數種緩衝選項之一（磷酸二氫鈉、磷酸氫二鈉、醋酸鉀、醋酸鈉）。

nodes.label: NF-kB signaling
nodes.description: Luteolin exerts anti-inflammatory effects primarily through inhibition of pro-inflammatory signaling cascades, including NF-kB activation, MAPK phosphorylation, and the NLRP3 inflammasome. This broad suppression of inflammatory signaling underlies its benefits in atopic diseases and neuroinflammation. It is a key mechanism distinct from its COMT interactions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Luteolin 主要透過抑制促發炎訊號級聯（包括 NF-kB 活化、MAPK 磷酸化和 NLRP3 發炎小體）來發揮抗發炎作用。這種對發炎訊號的廣泛抑制是其對異位性疾病和神經發炎益處的基礎。這是與其 COMT 交互作用不同的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: Polyunsaturated fatty acids
nodes.description: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6(n-3)) is an omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid with six cis double bonds, making it one of the most oxidatively labile lipids in biology. It is the major n-3 PUFA (against Arachidonic acid as the major n-6 PUFA) and is highly enriched in neuronal membranes, retinal photoreceptors, and spermatozoa.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid（DHA，22:6(n-3)）是具有六個 cis 雙鍵的 omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid，使其成為生物學上最易被氧化的脂質之一。它是主要的 n-3 PUFA（相對地，Arachidonic acid 為主要的 n-6 PUFA），並高度富集於神經元膜、視網膜光受器與精子中。

nodes.label: Methionine
nodes.description: Dietary Methionine restriction extends the lifespan of many species and recapitulates many benefits of Protein Restriction. The response is partially dependent on FGF21 and also inhibits mTORC1; most methionine restriction studies additionally require Cysteine depletion, since cysteine can be synthesized from methionine via transsulfuration. Methionine is therefore one of the primary drivers of protein restriction benefits alongside the branched-chain amino acids.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 飲食性的 Methionine restriction 可延長多種動物的壽命，並重現 Protein Restriction 的多項效益。此反應部分依賴 FGF21，也會抑制 mTORC1；多數甲硫胺酸限制研究另需搭配 Cysteine 耗竭，因為半胱胺酸可經轉硫作用由甲硫胺酸合成。因此 Methionine 是蛋白質限制效益的主要驅動者之一，與支鏈胺基酸並列。

nodes.label: MacroD1
nodes.description: MacroD1 (LRP16) is a MacroD-type macrodomain ADP-ribosylation eraser, predominantly in the mitochondrial matrix with nuclear splice forms. It hydrolyses mono-ADP-ribose ester-linked to aspartate/glutamate to counteract writers such as PARP10/PARP7, and after PARG pre-trimming it also counteracts PARP1 mono-modification. It is inactive toward PAR polymers, which are left to PARG/ARH3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MacroD1（LRP16）是 MacroD 型巨結構域的 ADP-核糖基化「擦除者」，主要位於粒線體基質，並有核內剪接 isoform。它水解與天門冬胺酸／麩胺酸酯鍵結的單一 ADP-核糖，以抵銷 PARP10/PARP7 等「寫入者」；在 PARG 預先修剪鏈之後，它也能抵銷 PARP1 的單一修飾。它對 PAR 聚合物無活性，後者交由 PARG/ARH3 處理。

nodes.label: GATOR2
nodes.description: CASTOR1 acts as a GATOR2-interacting inhibitor of mTORC1 signaling: in the absence of arginine it sequesters GATOR2, and arginine binding dissociates CASTOR1 from GATOR2, releasing GATOR2 to inhibit GATOR1 and activate Rag GTPases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CASTOR1 是與 GATOR2 交互作用、抑制 mTORC1 訊號的蛋白：缺乏 Arginine 時它隔離 GATOR2；Arginine 結合則使 CASTOR1 與 GATOR2 解離，釋放 GATOR2 去抑制 GATOR1 並活化 Rag GTPase。

nodes.label: Wnt4
nodes.description: BMP and Wnt4 synergize in osteoblast differentiation and neural crest programs. Crosstalk integrates two morphogen axes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BMP 與 Wnt4 在造骨細胞分化與神經脊程序協同。交互作用整合兩個形態發生素軸。

nodes.label: DNA Replication Stress
nodes.description: Gemcitabine induces DNA replication stress through two converging mechanisms: masked chain termination after incorporation of the triphosphate into nascent DNA, and dNTP pool depletion via ribonucleotide reductase inhibition. Together these stall replication forks and destabilize ongoing DNA synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 透過兩個匯聚機制誘導 DNA 複製壓力：三磷酸嵌入新生 DNA 後的隱蔽式鏈終止，以及透過抑制 ribonucleotide reductase 造成的 dNTP 池耗竭。這兩者共同使複製叉停滯並破壞正在進行的 DNA 合成。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
nodes.description: Displacement of BAK's anti-apoptotic restraints by BH3-only activators (Bim, Bid, Puma, Noxa) liberates BAK to assemble large beta-barrel pores in the outer mitochondrial membrane. This permeabilization releases cytochrome c and Smac DIABLO, initiates the caspase cascade, amplifies reactive oxygen species and can trigger Parkin-dependent mitophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當 BH3-only 活化蛋白（Bim、Bid、Puma、Noxa）排除 BAK 的抗凋亡制約後，BAK 便在粒線體外膜組裝大型 β-桶狀孔洞。這次通透化釋放 cytochrome c 與 Smac DIABLO，啟動 caspase 級聯、放大活性氧，並可觸發 Parkin 依賴性的粒線體自噬。

nodes.label: MPP+
nodes.description: MPP+ causes Mitochondrial Dysfunction by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MPP+ 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Mitochondrial Dysfunction，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

nodes.label: RB1
nodes.description: RB1 is the Knudson two-hit archetype tumor suppressor. Classification is historical and textbook.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RB1 是 Knudson 二擊原型腫瘤抑制基因。歸類具歷史與教科書地位。

nodes.label: Dietary Restriction
nodes.description: Dietary restriction (DR) and its variants are among the most potent physiological activators of autophagy, engaging the pathway in most cultured cells and across many organs in vivo. By lowering circulating nutrients and insulin while raising AMP/ATP ratios, DR relieves mTORC1 inhibition and activates AMPK, thereby de-repressing the ULK1 complex and TFEB-dependent lysosomal programs. In model organisms such as C. elegans, DR induces autophagy through coordinated transcriptional changes mediated by orthologs like HLH-30/TFEB. The health- and lifespan-extending effects of DR are widely attributed in substantial part to this induction of adaptive autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 飲食限制（DR）及其變體是最強效的自噬生理活化因子之一，在大多數培養細胞和體內許多器官中啟動該途徑。透過降低循環營養素和胰島素，同時提高AMP/ATP比值，DR解除mTORC1的抑制並活化AMPK，從而解除對ULK1複合體和TFEB依賴性溶酶體程序的抑制。在如C. elegans等模式生物中，DR透過HLH-30/TFEB等同源蛋白介導的協調轉錄變化誘導自噬。DR促進健康和延長壽命的效應，在很大程度上被歸因於此適應性自噬的誘導。

nodes.label: DNA Replication
nodes.description: dNTPs are consumed stoichiometrically by DNA polymerases during DNA replication and repair, and their supply is rate-limiting. Balanced dNTP pools are essential for high-fidelity replication; both depletion and imbalance drive replication stress, mutagenesis, and genomic instability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: dNTP 在 DNA 複製與修復期間被 DNA 聚合酶以化學計量方式消耗，其供應具有速率限制。平衡的 dNTP 池對高保真複製至關重要；耗竭與失衡皆會驅動複製壓力、突變與基因體不穩定性。

nodes.label: MLL1
nodes.description: MLL1, also known as KMT2A or mixed-lineage leukemia 1, is a histone-lysine N-methyltransferase whose catalytic SET domain transfers methyl groups from SAM to histone H3 lysine 4. It acts in multiprotein complexes (WDR5, RBBP5, ASH2L, DPY30) that are required for full catalytic activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MLL1 又稱 KMT2A 或 mixed-lineage leukemia 1，是一個組蛋白離胺酸 N-甲基轉移酶，其催化性的 SET 結構域將 SAM 的甲基轉移到組蛋白 H3 的離胺酸 4 上。它以多蛋白複合體（WDR5、RBBP5、ASH2L、DPY30）形式作用，這些複合體對完整的催化活性是必要的。

nodes.label: ALS
nodes.description: OPTN mutations have been identified as pathogenic in ALS, and because mitophagy critically depends on OPTN and its kinase TBK1, loss of OPTN function impairs both mitochondrial clearance and axonal transport. Loss of function in this pathway therefore couples defective selective autophagy to motor neuron degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OPTN 突變已被確認在 ALS（肌萎縮性側索硬化症）中具有致病性；由於 mitophagy 高度依賴 OPTN 及其激酶 TBK1，OPTN 功能喪失會同時損害粒線體清除與軸突運輸。因此此路徑的功能喪失會把選擇性自噬缺陷與運動神經元退化連結起來。

nodes.label: SUV39H1
nodes.description: SUV39H1 deposits H3K9me3 as a family member enzyme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SUV39H1 作為家族成員酶沉積 H3K9me3。

nodes.label: PANoptosis
nodes.description: Reperfusion injury combines a ROS burst with mtDNA release and calcium overload, and the resulting death is mixed rather than assignable to one executor, so PANoptosis is the default assumption. The confirmatory test is PANoptosome assembly (ASC, Caspase-8, and RIPK3 colocalization) rather than any single marker, because blocking one arm fails to stop the process. In the flowchart, TAK1 loss additionally drives RIPK1 kinase death independently of Caspase-8, which is the canonical route into this composite modality.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 再灌流傷害同時結合 ROS 爆發、mtDNA 釋放與鈣離子過載，其後的死亡是混合型而無法歸給單一執行者，因此以 PANoptosis 為預設假設。確認測試是 PANoptosome 的組裝（ASC、Caspase-8 與 RIPK3 共定位），而非任何單一標記，因為阻斷單一臂無法終止此過程。在流程圖中，TAK1 喪失亦可獨立於 Caspase-8 驅動 RIPK1 kinase death，這是進入此複合 modality 的典型路徑。

nodes.label: Clofarabine
nodes.description: Clofarabine's diphosphate inhibits ribonucleotide reductase (IC50 about 65 nM), depleting dNTP pools and further starving DNA synthesis. This direct RNR inhibition is complemented by DNA polymerase inhibition and chain termination by the incorporated triphosphate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Clofarabine 的二磷酸形式抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶（IC50 約 65 nM），耗竭 dNTP 池並進一步使 DNA 合成匱乏。此直接的 RNR 抑制與嵌入的三磷酸所造成的 DNA 聚合酶抑制及鏈終止相互補。

nodes.label: Hepatocyte Growth Factor
nodes.description: HGF is the sole high-affinity ligand activating the c-Met receptor. Ligand-receptor exclusivity defines the module.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HGF 是活化 c-Met 受體的唯一高親和力配體。配體—受體專一性定義模組。

nodes.label: Atg13
nodes.description: FIP200 scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex: without the FIP200 scaffold the Atg13 and Atg101 subunits cannot assemble productively with ULK1, and Autophagosome formation fails. mTORC1 controls Autophagy chiefly through this ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FIP200 作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體：沒有 FIP200 支架，Atg13 與 Atg101 次單元便無法與 ULK1 有效組裝，Autophagosome 形成隨之失敗。mTORC1 主要透過此 ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 複合體調控 Autophagy。

nodes.label: Alu element
nodes.description: Alu elements are approximately 300-bp short interspersed nuclear elements (SINEs) derived from the 7SL RNA gene. With about 1.1 million copies they make up roughly 11% of the human genome, making them the most abundant Transposable Elements family; they are transcribed by RNA polymerase III and mobilize in copy-and-paste fashion through a LINE-1 ORF2 RNA intermediate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alu element 是約 300 bp、源自 7SL RNA 基因的短散在核元件（SINE）。約有 110 萬份拷貝，約占人類基因組的 11%，是數量最多的 Transposable Elements 家族；它們由 RNA polymerase III 轉錄，並透過 LINE-1 ORF2 蛋白的 RNA 中間物以「複製貼上」方式移動。

nodes.label: METTL3
nodes.description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the writer complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine on mRNA co-transcriptionally, working with METTL14 and accessory proteins such as WTAP and VIRMA. It methylates roughly 0.1–0.4% of adenosines, preferentially in the DRACH consensus motif near stop codons, 3′ UTRs and long internal exons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: METTL3 是催化次單元，與 METTL14 及 WTAP、VIRMA 等輔助蛋白共同組成 writer 複合體，於轉錄時在 mRNA 上沉積 N6-methyladenosine。它甲基化約 0.1–0.4% 的腺苷，偏好位於終止密碼子、3′ UTR 與長內含子附近的 DRACH 共識序列。

nodes.label: Ragulator
nodes.description: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

nodes.label: uPA
nodes.description: PAI-1 is the principal physiological inhibitor of the plasminogen activators uPA and tissue-type plasminogen activator, blocking plasmin generation and therefore fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix remodelling. By suppressing plasmin it also modulates integrin and latent-growth-factor activation, feeding fibrotic and proliferative loops.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 uPA 與組織型纖維蛋白溶解酶原活化素的主要生理抑制劑，阻斷 plasmin 生成，因而抑制纖維蛋白溶解與細胞外基質重塑。透過抑制 plasmin，它也調節 integrin 與潛在生長因子的活化，feeding 纖維化與增殖性回饋迴圈。

nodes.label: Bismuth
nodes.description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

nodes.label: Reverse Cholesterol Transport
nodes.description: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: cells, especially Macrophages, export excess free Cholesterol to extracellular lipid acceptors such as Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL. Because the process is the rate-limiting gateway of the whole reverse transport cascade, its impairment promotes foam cell formation and Atherosclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步且為速率限制步驟：細胞（尤其是 Macrophages）將過量的游離 Cholesterol 輸出至細胞外脂質受體，例如 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL。由於此步驟是整個逆向運輸級聯反應的速率限制關口，其功能受損會促進泡沫細胞形成與 Atherosclerosis。

nodes.label: Auranofin
nodes.description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

nodes.label: Traumatic Brain Injury
nodes.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is acquired brain injury from external mechanical force, and its primary insult is followed by a secondary cascade of energy failure and ATP depletion, glutamate-driven excitotoxicity, oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction and edema. The metabolic crisis outlasts the mechanical event, leaving the brain vulnerable for hours to days after impact.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Traumatic brain injury（TBI）是由外部機械力造成的後天腦損傷，其原發傷害之後會接續次級級聯：能量衰竭與 ATP 耗竭、glutamate 驅動的 excitotoxicity、oxidative stress、inflammation、mitochondrial dysfunction 與水腫。這場代謝危機比機械性事件持續更久，使腦部在受撞後數小時至數日內仍處於脆弱狀態。

nodes.label: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors
nodes.description: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
