nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

nodes.label: BRCA
nodes.description: BRCA predisposes to Breast Cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA 傾向於Breast Cancer。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種關係強調了遺傳或內在因素如何影響癌症易感性，並為風險分層篩檢和預防提供資訊。

nodes.label: GCN2
nodes.description: GCN2 (EIF2AK4) is one of four mammalian eIF2alpha kinases, activated by uncharged tRNA accumulating during amino acid starvation. It phosphorylates eIF2alpha at Ser51, which attenuates global protein synthesis while promoting translation of stress-responsive mRNAs such as ATF4, mounting the integrated stress response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GCN2（EIF2AK4）是哺乳動物四種 eIF2α kinase 之一，由胺基酸飢餓期間累積的未攜帶胺基酸的 tRNA 活化。它在 Ser51 位點磷酸化 eIF2α，使全域蛋白質合成降低，同時促進 ATF4 等壓力反應 mRNA 的轉譯，啟動 integrated stress response。

nodes.label: SetA
nodes.description: SetA is an effector protein from Legionella pneumophila that glucosylates TFEB at multiple sites, leading to its nuclear enrichment by interfering with 14-3-3 protein binding. Because 14-3-3 binding normally retains TFEB in the cytosol, the glucosylation event hijacks the host's own regulatory mechanism to drive TFEB into the nucleus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SetA 是來自嗜肺性退伍軍人菌的效應蛋白，會在多個位點對 TFEB 進行葡萄糖基化，藉由干擾 14-3-3 protein 的結合而使 TFEB 在核內富集。由於與 14-3-3 的結合通常將 TFEB 侷限於細胞質，這個葡萄糖基化事件劫持了宿主自身的調控機制，把 TFEB 驅入細胞核。

nodes.label: 5-Azacytidine
nodes.description: 5-Azacytidine inhibits DNMT1, the maintenance DNA methyltransferase that copies methylation patterns onto daughter strands during DNA replication. As a cytidine analog, 5-azacytidine is incorporated into DNA, where it covalently traps DNMT1 and depletes the enzyme, causing passive loss of methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates silenced genes, including tumor suppressors, and underlies its clinical use in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia. It is also studied for its capacity to modulate senescence and reactivate silenced developmental programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 抑制 DNMT1，這是一種維持 DNA 甲基轉移酶，在 DNA 複製過程中將甲基化模式複製到子鏈上。作為胞苷類似物，5-氮雜胞苷摻入 DNA 中，共價捕獲 DNMT1 並耗盡該酶，導致新合成鏈上的甲基化被動喪失。这种去甲基化重新激活了沉默的基因，包括肿瘤抑制基因，这是其在骨髓增生异常综合征和急性髓系白血病中的临床应用的基础。人們也研究了它調節衰老和重新激活沉默的發育程序的能力。

nodes.label: Progerin
nodes.description: Progerin is a toxic, truncated isoform of Lamin A produced when a silent point mutation in the LMNA gene (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site. Because it retains a permanently farnesylated C-terminus it cannot be de-farnesylated, and it accumulates at the nuclear membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Progerin 是 Lamin A 的毒性截短型異構物，由 LMNA gene 上的一個沉默點突變（c.1824C>T）活化隱藏剪接位點而產生。由於其保留永久性的法尼基化 C 端而無法被去法尼基化，它會在核膜處累積。

nodes.label: MEF2C
nodes.description: Chronic microglial cGAS-STING signalling restrains the protective MEF2C neuronal gene program in a non-cell-autonomous manner: microglial cGAS deletion reverses neuronal MEF2C downregulation in tauopathy (Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023), making the cGAS axis a therapeutic target for preserving neuronal resilience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性的小膠質細胞 cGAS–STING 訊號以非細胞自體的方式抑制具保護性的 MEF2C 神經元基因程式：小膠質細胞 cGAS 缺失可逆轉 tauopathy 中神經元 MEF2C 的下调（Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023），使 cGAS 軸成為維持神經元韌性的治療標的。

nodes.label: Lactobacillus
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These bacteria are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune support. NR also modulates gut microbiota in ways protective against high-fat diet-induced weight gain: mice fed 60% HFD with 0.4% NR for 168 days had nearly 16% less weight gain and lower fasting blood glucose, and fecal transfer from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective effect with a microbiota enriched in butyrate-producing Firmicutes. NR thus reshapes the microbiome to favor metabolically beneficial bacteria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些細菌與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及免疫支持。NR 也以對抗高脂飲食誘發體重增加的方式調節腸道菌叢：以含 0.4% NR 的 60% HFD 餵食 168 天的小鼠，體重增加減少近 16% 且空腹血糖較低，而來自 NR 處理供體的糞便移植重現了此保護效應，其菌叢富含產丁酸的 Firmicutes。NR 因此重塑微生物組以偏好代謝有益的細菌。

nodes.label: Ribociclib
nodes.description: Ribociclib is a selective CDK4/6 inhibitor blocking G1 progression. Same pharmacological class logic as palbociclib.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ribociclib 是阻斷 G1 進展的選擇性 CDK4/6 抑制劑。與 palbociclib 相同的藥理類別邏輯。

nodes.label: CYP2J2
nodes.description: CYP2J2 epoxidizes Arachidonic acid at carbons 8, 9, 11 and 14 to form the corresponding epoxyeicosatrienoic acids (8,9-, 11,12-, 14,15-EET). These EETs activate soluble epoxide hydrolase-regulated signalling that promotes vasodilation, inhibits Inflammation, modulates ion channels and endothelial function, and in cancer models has been reported to suppress proliferation and limit Oxidative Stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CYP2J2 將 Arachidonic acid（花生四烯酸）在第 8、9、11、14 號碳位環氧化，形成相應的 epoxyeicosatrienoic acids（EET，環氧二十碳三烯酸）。這些 EET 活化可溶性環氧乙烷水解酶調節的訊號，促進血管擴張、抑制 Inflammation（發炎）、調節離子通道與內皮功能；在癌症模型中據報可抑制增殖並限制 Oxidative Stress（氧化壓力）。

nodes.label: Snail
nodes.description: Snail (SNAI1) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Driving is the defining transcription program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Snail（SNAI1）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。驅動是定義性轉錄程序。

nodes.label: Checkpoint Inhibitor
nodes.description: Checkpoint Inhibitors are the core modality of Immunotherapy: they release CTLA-4 and PD-1/PD-L1 brake signaling that suppresses antitumor T-cell activity, converting a chronically inflamed but immune-excluded tumor into one the immune system can clear.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Checkpoint Inhibitor（檢查點抑制劑）是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）的核心手段：它們解除抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞活性的 CTLA-4 與 PD-1/PD-L1 煞車訊號，使長期發炎但免疫排斥的腫瘤轉為免疫系統可清除的腫瘤。

nodes.label: Lymphocyte
nodes.description: T-lineage activation requires major histocompatibility complex presentation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: T 譜系活化需要主要組織相容複合體呈現。

nodes.label: Immune Evasion
nodes.description: PD-L1 enables Immune Evasion. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Immune evasion is a recognized hallmark whereby tumors disarm or exclude cytotoxic lymphocytes through checkpoints and immunosuppressive microenvironments. The relationship is directional, with PD-L1 acting as the operative agent upon Immune Evasion rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PD-L1 啟用 Immune Evasion。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 Immune Evasion是一個公認的標誌，腫瘤透過檢查點和免疫抑制微環境解除或排除細胞毒性淋巴細胞。這種關係是有方向的，PD-L1 充當 Immune Evasion 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Onchocerca volvulus
nodes.description: Onchocerca volvulus is the filarial nematode that causes onchocerciasis (river blindness), infecting about 21 million people with 99% of cases in 31 African countries. Adults coil in subcutaneous nodules (onchocercomata) while the first-stage larvae migrate through skin and eye tissues, and the parasite depends on obligate Wolbachia endosymbionts for survival, embryogenesis and fecundity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Onchocerca volvulus 是造成 onchocerciasis（river blindness）的絲蟲線形蟲，全球約有 2100 萬人感染，其中 99% 集中於 31 個非洲國家。成蟲捲曲於皮下結節（onchocercoma）中，第一期幼蟲則在皮膚與眼部組織移行；此外此寄生蟲仰賴專性 Wolbachia 內共生菌才能存活、胚胎發育與繁殖。

nodes.label: Selenium
nodes.description: Selenium is an essential constituent of glutathione peroxidases and thioredoxin reductases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides. Zinc complements this by stabilizing membranes, inhibiting NADPH oxidase, and serving as a structural element of superoxide dismutase (SOD). Dysregulation of these trace elements in Parkinson's disease exacerbates oxidative stress and neuronal injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Selenium 是穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶與硫氧還蛋白還原酶的必要組成，負責解毒過氧化氫與脂質過氧化物。Zinc 則透過穩定細胞膜、抑制 NADPH oxidase，並作為超氧化物歧化酶 (SOD) 的結構元素來 допол此防禦。在 Parkinson's disease 中，這些微量元素的失調會加劇氧化壓力與神經損傷。

nodes.label: CYP3A4
nodes.description: Piperine raises the Bioavailability of co-administered compounds by inhibiting intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein, and phase-II conjugation by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The classic demonstration is a roughly 20-fold increase in Curcumin bioavailability, with similar enhancement explored for Fisetin and other poorly absorbed polyphenols.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Piperine 藉由抑制腸道與肝臟的 CYP3A4 及其他 cytochrome P450 酵素、外排轉運蛋白 P-glycoprotein，以及 UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 的第二期結合反應，提高併用化合物的 Bioavailability。經典例子是使 Curcumin 的生體可用度提升約 20 倍；類似的增強效果也在 Fisetin 與其他吸收不良的 polyphenols 上被研究。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

nodes.label: MC1R
nodes.description: MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: IRF3
nodes.description: In the nucleus IRF3 cooperates with NF-κB and AP-1 at promoter enhancers such as the IFN-β enhanceosome, inducing type I interferons and interferon-stimulated genes. IRF3 is thus the terminal effector of cytosolic DNA/RNA sensing and a key arm of sterile inflammatory responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在細胞核內，IRF3 於 IFN-β enhanceosome 等啟動子增強元件上與 NF-κB 及 AP-1 協作，誘導第一型干擾素與干擾素刺激基因的表現。因此 IRF3 是細胞質 DNA/RNA 感知的末端效應因子，也是無菌性發炎反應的重要支臂。

nodes.label: Erythrocytes
nodes.description: Erythrocytes are the principal oxygen-delivering blood cells and are unusually exposed to Oxidative Stress, being subject both to autoxidation of Hemoglobin and to circulating catecholamine metabolites such as Adrenochrome. Because mature red cells lack nuclei and mitochondria they cannot repair oxidized protein, so this oxidative burden drives Hemolysis and Methemoglobinemia, with the latter evident as cyanosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Erythrocytes 是主要的運送氧氣的血球，特別暴露於 Oxidative Stress：既承受 Hemoglobin 的自氧化，也接觸 Adrenochrome 等循環中的兒茶酚胺代謝物。由於成熟紅血球缺乏細胞核與粒線體，無法修復被氧化的蛋白質，這份氧化負擔會導致 Hemolysis 與 Methemoglobinemia，後者表現為發紺。

nodes.label: UVRAG
nodes.description: Vps34 binds UVRAG in an alternative complex that acts on endosomes instead of autophagosomes. Because the same catalytic subunit is shared between an autophagy complex with Atg14 and an endocytic complex with UVRAG, Vps34 is a branch point where the cell decides between degradative fates for a given membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vps34 會與 UVRAG 結合形成作用於內體而非自噬體的另一個複合體。由於同一催化次單元被含 Atg14 的自噬複合體與含 UVRAG 的胞吞複合體共用，Vps34 構成分支點，由細胞決定某段膜的降解命運。

nodes.label: H4K16
nodes.description: Sas2p acetylates histone H4 at lysine 16, opening telomeric chromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sas2p 乙醯化組蛋白 H4 離胺酸 16，打開端粒染色質。

nodes.label: Metabotypes
nodes.description: Urolithin A is only produced by individuals carrying the metabotype-A gut microbial signature (Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens), roughly 12-40% of people depending on cohort. Metabotype-B carriers make isourolithin A instead and metabotype-0 carriers make no detectable urolithin, so dietary ellagitannins silently do nothing for them while direct Urolithin A supplementation is required.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 只有在帶有 metabotype-A 腸道菌群特徵（Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens）的人才會生成，依族群不同約占 12–40%。metabotype-B 帶因者生成的是 isourolithin A，metabotype-0 帶因者則測不到任何 urolithin，因此對這兩類人而言膳食型 ellagitannin 完全無效，必須直接補充 Urolithin A。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: MCU
nodes.description: MCU-mediated calcium uptake is driven by the negative mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm); in senescence the resulting loss of ΔΨm also elevates ROS production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MCU 介導的鈣離子攝入由負的粒線體膜電位（ΔΨm）驅動；在衰老時由此造成的 ΔΨm 下降也會提高 ROS 產生。

nodes.label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
nodes.description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

nodes.label: Th1
nodes.description: IL-12 is the primary cytokine driving Th1 differentiation: it activates STAT4 in naive CD4+ T cells, induces the master Th1 transcription factor T-bet, and simultaneously suppresses Th2 and Th17 polarization.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-12 是驅動 Th1 分化最主要的細胞激素：它在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中活化 STAT4、誘導 Th1 譜系的主轉錄因子 T-bet，並同時抑制 Th2 與 Th17 極化。

nodes.label: HMGB2
nodes.description: HMGB2 is a chromatin architectural factor whose loss triggers a shift in heterochromatin organization in senescence. It is progressively depleted in senescent cells, influencing the formation and stability of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HMGB2 是染色質架構因子，其喪失會在衰老中觸發異染色質組織的轉變。它在衰老細胞中逐漸耗竭，影響衰老相關異染色質焦點的形成與穩定。

nodes.label: PAMP
nodes.description: PAMP are conserved microbial motifs absent from host cells; their engagement of pattern recognition receptors such as TLRs, NOD-like receptors and RLRs is what activates the Innate Immune System and triggers an inflammatory response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAMP 是微生物特有、宿主細胞不具的保守分子基序；它們與 TLR、NOD-like receptors、RLR 等模式辨識受體結合，正是啟動 Innate Immune System 並引發發炎反應的原因。

nodes.label: Hypothalamus
nodes.description: Orexin (hypocretin) is produced by a small cluster of neurons in the lateral and perifornical Hypothalamus, where prepro-orexin is cleaved into orexin-A and orexin-B and the neurons project widely to cortex, brainstem and limbic system. These glucose-sensing neurons promote arousal-associated energy expenditure and physical activity, linking sleep–wake regulation to metabolic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Orexin（hypocretin）由外側與圍室核下視丘（Hypothalamus）的一小群神經元產生，這些神經元將前驅 orexin 切割成 orexin-A 與 orexin-B，並廣泛投射至皮質、腦幹與邊緣系統。這些具葡萄糖感測能力的神經元促進覺醒相關的能量消耗與身體活動，把睡眠—清醒調節與代謝健康連結起來。

nodes.label: Cardiotoxicity
nodes.description: Cardiotoxicity is a key safety endpoint alongside drug-induced liver injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 心臟毒性是與藥物性肝損傷並列的關鍵安全終點。

nodes.label: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network
nodes.description: PEX3 encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein required for correct folding and transport of many other peroxins into the peroxisome membrane, acting as an essential building block of the Peroxisome Biogenesis Network. Loss of function leaves misfolded proteins that accumulate and disrupt membrane integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX3 編碼過氧化體膜蛋白，負責許多其他 peroxin 正確摺疊並運送至過氧化體膜，是 Peroxisome Biogenesis Network 的必要組成。功能喪失會留下累積的錯誤摺疊蛋白，破壞膜完整性。

nodes.label: PERK
nodes.description: PERK (EIF2AK3) is a type I transmembrane ER-resident kinase that senses unfolded proteins via its luminal domain. Upon ER stress it dimerizes and autophosphorylates, then phosphorylates eIF2alpha at Ser51, attenuating global translation while selectively upregulating ATF4 translation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PERK（EIF2AK3）是 I 型跨膜內質網駐留激酶，透過其腔內區域感知未折疊蛋白。當 ER stress 發生時，PERK 二聚化並自體磷酸化，接著在 Ser51 位點磷酸化 eIF2α，抑制全域轉譯的同時選擇性提升 ATF4 的轉譯。

nodes.label: PAK2
nodes.description: PAK2 directly binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at three residues. Ser30 phosphorylation in the prodomain blocks interaction with Caspase-9 and prevents activation, Thr173 favors an inhibitory conformation, and Ser239 near the active site sterically hinders substrate binding — a two-pronged strategy that neutralizes both pro-caspase-7 and already-active enzyme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAK2 直接結合並在三個殘基上磷酸化 Caspase-7。prodomain 上的 Ser30 磷酸化阻斷與 Caspase-9 的交互作用而阻止活化，Thr173 促成抑制性構形，而活性位點附近的 Ser239 則以立體障礙妨礙受質結合——這是一種雙管齊下的策略，同時中和前驅物 Caspase-7 與已活化的酵素。

nodes.label: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns
nodes.description: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Quality Control
nodes.description: Mitophagy, the autophagic degradation of damaged mitochondria, is a core arm of Mitochondrial Quality Control; it is driven by the PINK1/Parkin/p62 axis and is reduced in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitophagy（受損粒線體的自噬降解）是 Mitochondrial Quality Control 的核心環節，由 PINK1/Parkin/p62 軸驅動，並在衰老細胞中減少。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

nodes.label: Lamin A
nodes.description: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome is caused by a sporadic de novo mutation in the LMNA gene, which alters the protein Lamin A to produce progerin. Progerin remains permanently attached to the nuclear membrane, causing the nucleus to become misshapen and disorganized — the primary driver of the disease's accelerated-aging phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 由 LMNA 基因的偶發性新生突變引起，該突變使蛋白 Lamin A 改變而產生 progerin。Progerin 永久附著於核膜，使細胞核變形且構造混亂——這是此病加速衰老表型的主要驅動因素。

nodes.label: AMP
nodes.description: Nudix Hydrolases cleave free ADP-ribose into AMP plus ribose-5-phosphate, an AMP/salvage arm of the parthanatos cascade. AMP can inhibit the mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocator and activate AMPK–mTORC1 signalling, and ribose-5-phosphate feeds NAD+ salvage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nudix Hydrolases 將游離 ADP-ribose 切割成 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸，構成 parthanatos 級聯中的 AMP/回收分支。AMP 可抑制粒線體腺嘌呤核苷轉位酶並活化 AMPK–mTORC1 訊號，核糖-5-磷酸則供應 NAD+ 回收途徑。

nodes.label: Gasdermin D
nodes.description: Caspase-4 is a human inflammatory (non-canonical) caspase that senses cytosolic Gram-negative bacterial LPS through its CARD, inducing oligomerization and auto-cleavage. Once active it cleaves Gasdermin D at the linker, freeing the N-terminal pore-forming domain that oligomerizes in the plasma membrane to form pyroptotic pores.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-4 是人類發炎性（非典型）caspase，透過其 CARD 感測細胞質中的革蘭氏陰性菌 LPS，誘發寡聚化與自我切割。一旦活化即在連接區切割 Gasdermin D，釋出 N 端成孔區，該區在細胞膜上寡聚形成 pyroptosis 孔洞。

nodes.label: Base Excision Repair
nodes.description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

nodes.label: Pyruvate
nodes.description: Pyruvate is converted to Acetyl-CoA by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase in the rate-limiting, committed step that links glycolysis to aerobic respiration. Because acetyl-CoA is what fuels the TCA cycle, blocking this step removes the reducing equivalents whose downstream leak produces the mitochondrial ROS that RIPK3 needs in order to reinforce necrosome assembly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pyruvate 經由 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase 轉變為 Acetyl-CoA，這是連結糖解作用與有氧呼吸的限速且不可逆步驟。由於 acetyl-CoA 是 TCA cycle 的燃料，阻斷此步驟便移除了產生還原力的來源，而其下游滲漏正是形成粒線體 ROS 的途徑——而 RIPK3 需要這些 ROS 才能強化 necrosome 組裝。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: Genome stability
nodes.description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 on telomeric chromatin and suppresses LINE-1 retrotransposon activity, maintaining genome stability and telomere function; SIRT6-deficient cells show genomic instability, telomere defects, and cellular senescence (Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化端粒染色質上的 H3K9，並抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄轉座子活性，維持基因組穩定性和端粒功能；SIRT6 缺乏的細胞表現出基因組不穩定、端粒缺陷及細胞衰老（Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014）。

nodes.label: ZBP1
nodes.description: ZBP1 (also known as DAI) is the prototypical Z-nucleic-acid sensor: it detects the left-handed Z-DNA and Z-RNA structures that form transiently at alternating purine-pyrimidine repeats and at sites of active transcription or topological stress, triggering cell death programs including PANoptosis, frequently in coordination with STING and MAVS. In viral encephalitis such as HSV-1 infection, ZBP1-mediated sensing drives RIPK3-dependent cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ZBP1（又稱 DAI）是典型的 Z 核酸感測器：它偵測在交替嘌呤–嘧啶重複序列以及活躍轉錄或拓撲壓力位點瞬間形成的左手 Z-DNA 與 Z-RNA 結構，觸發包括 PANoptosis 在內的細胞死亡程式，且常與 STING 及 MAVS 協同。在 HSV-1 等病毒性腦炎中，ZBP1 介導的感測驅動 RIPK3 依賴性的細胞死亡。

nodes.label: Ripoptosome
nodes.description: By removing cIAPs, Smac mimetics license Ripoptosome assembly. With cIAPs gone, cytosolic RIPK1 accumulates, exposes its death domain, recruits FADD and Caspase-8, and nucleates the ~2 MDa ripoptosome. This is precisely the experimental paradigm (IAP antagonist plus poly I:C/TLR3 stimulation, Feoktistova et al. 2011) in which the complex was originally defined.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藉由移除 cIAPs，Smac mimetics 為 Ripoptosome 的組裝解除抑制。當 cIAPs 消失後，細胞質中的 RIPK1 累積、暴露其 death domain、招募 FADD 與 Caspase-8，並成核形成約 2 MDa 的 ripoptosome。這正是最初定義此複合體的實驗範式（IAP 拮抗劑加上 poly I:C/TLR3 刺激，Feoktistova et al. 2011）。

nodes.label: Keshan disease
nodes.description: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Selenium deficiency 會導致 Keshan disease，這是一種在 selenium 貧乏地區發現的地方性心肌病變，其原因是心臟 glutathione peroxidase 活性不足以及隨之而來的心肌氧化損傷。受影響的心臟顯示 necrosis 和 fibrosis 的抗病毒和抗氧化防禦能力降低。方向性是營養缺乏、酵素衰竭、組織損傷。需要注意的是，柯薩奇病毒感染與缺乏症相互作用，因此 Keshan disease 並不純粹是 selenium 缺乏症。

nodes.label: Redox Battery
nodes.description: The Redox Battery is a conceptual construct in the adrenochrome handling protocol representing the reservable store of cellular reducing equivalents that absorbs the oxidative load generated during catecholamine autoxidation. Adrenochrome and its quinone derivatives (Aminochrome, o-quinone) discharge the battery by draining electrons through redox cycling; a collapsed battery converts transient oxidation into persistent oxidative damage, protein alkylation, NLRP3 Inflammasome activation, and Senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Redox Battery 是 Adrenochrome 處理.protocol 中的概念性建構，代表細胞還原等量物的儲備池，用以吸收兒茶酚胺自氧化產生的氧化負荷。Adrenochrome 及其醌衍生物（Aminochrome、o-quinone）透過氧化還原循環抽走電子而「放電」；電池崩潰會把短暫的氧化轉為持續性氧化損傷、蛋白質烷基化、NLRP3 Inflammasome 活化與 Senescence。

nodes.label: HER2
nodes.description: HER2 drives Breast Cancer. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with HER2 acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HER2 驅動 Breast Cancer。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，HER2 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: NPAT
nodes.description: NPAT is gated by cell-cycle kinases: cyclin E/CDK2 phosphorylation at the G1/S transition licenses NPAT to drive replication-dependent histone gene transcription. In quiescence or senescence cyclin E/CDK2 activity falls, NPAT is dephosphorylated, and the replication-dependent histone genes are silenced — which is why NPAT disengagement is a principal cause of the canonical histone collapse seen in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NPAT 受細胞週期激酶調控：在 G1/S 轉換時 cyclin E/CDK2 的磷酸化授權 NPAT 驅動複製依賴型組蛋白基因的轉錄。在靜止或衰老時 cyclin E/CDK2 活性下降，NPAT 被去磷酸化，複製依賴型組蛋白基因因而沉默——這正是 NPAT 失去作用成為衰老細胞典型組蛋白崩潰主因的原因。

nodes.label: Magnolol
nodes.description: Magnolol shares honokiol's positive allosteric modulation of GABA_A receptors, generally slightly less potent, and is used as a neolignan modulator of inhibitory neurotransmission alongside honokiol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Magnolol 與 honokiol 共享對 GABA_A receptor 的正向別構調節作用，效力通常略低，並與 honokiol 一同作為抑制性神經傳遞的 neolignan 調節劑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Exercise Hormesis
nodes.description: Exercise Hormesis is the canonical whole-organism hormetic stressor: transient exercise ROS, calcium, AMP/ATP and lactate pulses act as the stress input that elicits the adaptive response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Exercise Hormesis 是全身層級典型的 hormetic 壓力源：運動期間短暫的 ROS、鈣離子、AMP/ATP 與乳酸脈衝即為誘發適應反應的壓力輸入。

nodes.label: Yamanaka Factors
nodes.description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

nodes.label: Wnt signaling
nodes.description: Beta-catenin orchestrates the canonical Wnt signaling pathway as a transcriptional coactivator of TCF/LEF factors. Without Wnt ligands a destruction complex (APC, Axin, GSK-3beta, CK1) phosphorylates it for proteasomal degradation; Wnt binding stabilizes beta-catenin, which translocates to the nucleus and activates proliferation-driving target genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: β-Catenin 作為 TCF/LEF 因子的轉錄共活化因子，主導標準型 Wnt signaling 途徑。缺乏 Wnt 配體時，降解複合體（APC、Axin、GSK-3β、CK1）會將其磷酸化並標記供蛋白酶體降解；Wnt 結合則穩定 β-catenin，使其轉位入核並活化驅動增殖的目標基因。

nodes.label: Roscovitine
nodes.description: Roscovitine is a pan-CDK pharmacological inhibitor. Broad-spectrum CDK blockade is its defining action.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Roscovitine 是泛 CDK 藥理抑制劑。廣譜 CDK 封鎖是其定義性作用。

nodes.label: Cyclin D1
nodes.description: Cyclin D1 belongs to the D-type cyclin family governing G1 CDK4/6 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin D1 屬於掌管 G1 CDK4/6 活化的 D 型 cyclin 家族。

nodes.label: CXCL10
nodes.description: The cGAS-STING DNA-sensing pathway is an upstream driver of CXCL10 release, connecting genotoxic stress to the interferon-responsive branch of the SASP. Because CXCL10 recruits NK and T cells, its upregulation helps resolve senescence acutely, while persistent expression in aged tissue sustains inflammaging and autoimmune pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cGAS–STING DNA 感知路徑是 CXCL10 釋放的上游驅動因子，將基因毒性壓力連結到 SASP 的干擾素反應分支。由於 CXCL10 會募集 NK 與 T 細胞，其上調有助於急性解決衰老；但在老化組織中持續表現則會維持 inflammaging 與自體免疫病態。

nodes.label: Acetate
nodes.description: Acetate is the two-carbon short-chain fatty acid (CH3COO-) and the most abundant SCFA produced by gut fermentation, generated by anaerobic bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Bacteroides and by acetogens from dietary fiber. It is absorbed into portal blood and distributed systemically, crossing membranes as the protonated acid or via monocarboxylate transporters to reach the liver, brain and periphery. SCFA profiles including acetate are altered in aging and are modulated by diet, Caloric Restriction and NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acetate 是二碳短鏈脂肪酸（CH3COO-），也是腸道發酵產量最豐富的 SCFA，由 Bifidobacterium、Bacteroides 等厭氧菌與產乙酸菌從膳食纖維產生。它被吸收進入門脈血液並分布全身，以質子化酸形式或經單羧酸運輸蛋白跨越細胞膜，抵達肝臟、腦與周邊組織。包含 acetate 在內的 SCFA 譜會隨老化改變，並受飲食、Caloric Restriction 與 Nicotinamide Riboside 等 NAD+ 前驅物調控。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: Smoking
nodes.description: Cigarette, cigar, and wood smoke contain enormous amounts of free radicals and oxidants (cigarette smoke alone carries on the order of 10^17 oxidant molecules per puff). These external oxidants directly increase reactive oxygen species, deplete antioxidants such as vitamin C and glutathione, and cause systemic oxidative stress. Smoke also activates sympathetic nervous system responses and inflammation, further raising endogenous ROS production. This oxidative environment promotes the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome and supports the redox cycle by which adrenochrome generates more superoxide, linking smoking to increased catecholamine oxidation and oxidative damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 香菸、雪茄與木柴煙霧含有大量自由基與氧化劑（單是香菸煙霧每口就帶有約 10^17 個氧化劑分子）。這些外部氧化劑直接增加活性氧物種、耗竭維生素 C 與麩胱甘肽等抗氧化劑，並造成全身性氧化壓力。煙霧也活化交感神經系統反應與發炎，進一步升高內源性 ROS 生成。此氧化環境促進 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，並支持 adrenochrome 藉以產生更多超氧陰離子的氧化還原循環，將吸菸與增加的兒茶酚胺氧化及氧化損傷連結起來。

nodes.label: Dopamine Transporter
nodes.description: The Dopamine Transporter (DAT) is a membrane protein responsible for reuptake of Dopamine from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic neuron, terminating the dopaminergic signal and recycling the neurotransmitter. DAT is highly abundant in the Sirtuins, where rapid uptake into dopaminergic terminals is the primary way dopamine signalling ends.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine Transporter（DAT）是一種膜蛋白，負責將 Dopamine 從突觸間隙回收至突觸前神經元，終止多巴胺訊號並回收神經傳遞物質。DAT 在 Sirtuins 中高度豐富，在該區快速攝入多巴胺神經末梢是 dopamine 訊號終止的主要方式。

nodes.label: Down Syndrome
nodes.description: Down Syndrome is trisomy 21, a numerical chromosomal abnormality produced when meiotic nondisjunction adds a third copy of Chromosome 21. The extra gene dosage, not any point mutation, underlies the phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是三染色體 21，一種數目性的染色體異常，由減數分裂時的不分離（nondisjunction）加入第三份 Chromosome（染色體）21 所造成。其表型基礎是基因劑量增加，而非任何點突變。

nodes.label: Navitoclax
nodes.description: Senescent Cells resist apoptosis through upregulated senescent-cell anti-apoptotic pathways (SCAPs), notably BCL-xL; inhibiting BCL-xL with Navitoclax therefore selectively kills many senescent cells and reduces the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senescent Cells 會透過上升的衰老細胞抗凋亡路徑（SCAPs，尤其是 BCL-xL）抵抗凋亡；因此以 Navitoclax 抑制 BCL-xL 可選擇性殺死許多衰老細胞並降低 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype。

nodes.label: Axonal Degeneration
nodes.description: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Muscle Atrophy
nodes.description: Myostatin promotes Muscle Atrophy. In addition to repressing myogenic transcription, it drives protein catabolism and antagonizes Akt/mTORC1 signalling, so the net effect of myostatin signalling is loss of contractile mass — the reason it is a therapeutic target in Sarcopenia, Cachexia and muscular dystrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myostatin 會促進 Muscle Atrophy。除了抑制肌源性轉錄外，它還促進蛋白質分解代謝並拮抗 Akt/mTORC1 訊號，因此 myostatin 訊號的淨效應就是收縮性肌量的流失——這也是它在 Sarcopenia、Cachexia 與肌營養不良症中成為治療標的原因。

nodes.label: Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation
nodes.description: Intrinsically disordered regions lack a fixed three-dimensional fold yet drive liquid–liquid phase separation, forming membraneless organelles and condensates, and they are enriched in sites for phosphorylation, acetylation and other post-translational modifications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內在無序區缺乏固定的三維摺疊，卻能驅動液–液相分離，形成無膜胞器與凝聚體；它們也富含磷酸化、乙醯化等轉譯後修飾位點。

nodes.label: Fibroblasts
nodes.description: Fibroblasts are the principal ECM-producing cells depositing collagens and matrix. Canonical plural filename used. Production is their tissue function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fibroblasts 是沉積膠原與基質的主要 ECM 產生細胞。使用典型複數檔名。產生是其組織功能。

nodes.label: LeucoMB
nodes.description: LeucoMB is the reduced (leuco) form of the tricyclic phenothiazine Methylene blue. In MB's catalytic redox cycle the dye accepts electrons from complex I of the mitochondrion to become LeucoMB, so LeucoMB is the reduced intermediate of that electron-shuttling cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LeucoMB 是三環吩噻嗪類 Methylene blue 的還原型（leuco 型）。在 MB 的催化氧化還原循環中，染料自粒線體複合體 I 接受電子而成為 LeucoMB，因此 LeucoMB 是該電子穿梭循環中的還原中間體。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Rtg3
nodes.description: Rtg3 carries the bHLH/ZIP DNA-binding domain and, together with Rtg1, drives the Retrograde Response in S. cerevisiae. In healthy cells it is phosphorylated via the Mks1–Ptc1 axis and held in the cytoplasm bound to 14-3-3 proteins; when mitochondrial respiration is impaired the retention signal is lost and the Rtg1–Rtg3 heterodimer enters the nucleus to activate nuclear-encoded genes, prominently the citrate–isocitrate shuttle enzymes CIT2, ACO1, and IDH1/IDH2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rtg3 帶有 bHLH/ZIP DNA 結合區域，並與 Rtg1 一起驅動 *S. cerevisiae* 的 Retrograde Response。在健康細胞中它經由 Mks1–Ptc1 軸被磷酸化，並與 14-3-3 蛋白結合而留在細胞質；當粒線體呼吸受損時滞留訊號喪失，Rtg1–Rtg3 異二聚體進入細胞核，活化核編碼基因，尤以檸檬酸－異檸檬酸穿梭酵素 CIT2、ACO1 與 IDH1/IDH2 為主。

nodes.label: Zeb1
nodes.description: Zeb1 is a core E-box-binding driver of EMT. Driving defines its transition role.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Zeb1 是 EMT 的核心 E-box 結合驅動者。驅動定義其轉換角色。

nodes.label: CXCR2
nodes.description: IL-8 (CXCL8) signals through CXCR1/CXCR2 to expand cancer stem-cell pools and promote tumoursphere formation. CXCR2 blockade abrogates this stemness effect, establishing the receptor axis of SASP-driven reprogramming.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-8（CXCL8）經 CXCR1/CXCR2 訊號擴張癌症幹細胞池並促進腫瘤球形成。阻斷 CXCR2 消除此幹性效應，確立 SASP 驅動重編程的受體軸。

nodes.label: Vasopressin
nodes.description: Vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone, AVP) is a posterior-pituitary nonapeptide that acts on Gq-coupled V1a receptors to mobilize calcium and activate MAPK and PKC, producing vasoconstriction; via Gs-coupled V2 receptors it instead raises cAMP and inserts aquaporins to conserve water.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vasopressin（antidiuretic hormone，AVP）是腦下垂體後葉的九胜肽，透過 Gq-coupled V1a 受體動員 calcium 並活化 MAPK 與 PKC 而產生 vasoconstriction；經 Gs-coupled V2 受體則提高 cAMP 並插入 aquaporin 以保存水分。

nodes.label: MTHFD2
nodes.description: MTHFD2 sits immediately downstream of SHMT2, which converts serine to glycine plus 5,10-methylene-THF in the mitochondrial folate cycle — the dominant source of one-carbon units and mitochondrial NADPH in proliferating and cancer cells. Because it generates NADPH while feeding folate/one-carbon flux into 10-formyl-THF for purine and nucleotide synthesis, MTHFD2 is a junction where carbon metabolism and redox defence converge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTHFD2 位於 SHMT2 的下游；SHMT2 在粒線體葉酸循環中將 serine 轉為 glycine 與 5,10-亞甲基 THF，而此循環是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳單位與粒線體 NADPH 的主要來源。由於 MTHFD2 一方面產生 NADPH，另一方面將葉酸／一碳通量送入 10-甲醯 THF 以供嘌呤與核苷酸合成，它是碳代謝與氧化還原防禦交會的節點。

nodes.label: Calcium
nodes.description: The mitochondrial calcium uniporter is a highly selective pore-forming channel of the inner mitochondrial membrane, the central subunit of a holocomplex including MCUb, EMRE and the calcium-sensing gatekeepers MICU1 and MICU2. Under basal cytosolic calcium MICU1/2 keep the pore closed; when local calcium rises at endoplasmic-reticulum-mitochondria contact sites they relieve inhibition, permitting cooperative high-capacity influx that shapes cytosolic calcium transients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter 是粒線體內膜上高度選擇性的成孔通道，為包含 MCUb、EMRE 與鈣感受性守門者 MICU1、MICU2 的整體複合體之核心次單元。在基礎細胞質鈣濃度下 MICU1/2 使孔道關閉；當內質網—粒線體接觸處局部鈣上升時，它們解除抑制，允許協同的高容量內流，藉以塑形細胞質鈣的暫態變化。

nodes.label: Gene Silencing
nodes.description: High levels of DNA methylation in promoter regions, often concentrated in CpG islands, are strongly associated with gene silencing. Methylated promoters recruit methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins and inhibit the binding of transcription factors, converting active promoters into transcriptionally inert chromatin. This repressive mechanism is used physiologically for imprinting and for silencing transposable elements, and its aberrant targeting of tumor suppressor gene promoters is a hallmark of cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 啟動子區域的高水平 DNA 甲基化（通常集中在 CpG 島）與基因沉默密切相關。甲基化啟動子招募甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白並抑制轉錄因子的結合，將活性啟動子轉化為轉錄惰性染色質。這種抑制機制在生理學上用於印記和沈默轉座元件，其對腫瘤抑制基因啟動子的異常靶向性是癌症的標誌。

nodes.label: Exosomes
nodes.description: Exosomal vesicle communication shapes TME composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 外泌體囊泡通訊塑造 TME 組成。

nodes.label: GAPDH
nodes.description: GAPDH catalyzes the NAD+-dependent conversion of Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate to the high-energy glycolytic intermediate 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, generating NADH in the process. Because the step consumes NAD+, senescent cells with a lowered NAD+/NADH ratio form less 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, which curtails glycolytic ATP production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GAPDH 以 NAD+ 依賴的方式將 Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate 轉換成高能糖解中間產物 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate，並同時生成 NADH。由於此步驟需要 NAD+，NAD+/NADH 比值下降的衰老細胞生成的 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 較少，因而抑制糖解產 ATP。

nodes.label: TRIF
nodes.description: TRIF is a cytoplasmic adaptor central to toll-like receptor signaling, serving as the exclusive adaptor for TLR3. Urolithin A, with its anti-inflammatory activity, is studied for modulation of the TRIF-dependent TLR signaling branch.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRIF 是 toll 樣受體訊號中心的細胞質銜接蛋白，是 TLR3 的專屬銜接蛋白。Urolithin A 具有抗發炎活性，被研究對 TRIF 依賴 TLR 訊號分支的調控。

nodes.label: GABA
nodes.description: Glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) catalyzes the decarboxylation of glutamate to synthesize GABA, the principal inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. It exists as two isoforms, GAD65 and GAD67; GAD67 is constitutively active and maintains basal GABA levels, whereas GAD65 supplies GABA for regulated release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase（GAD）催化 glutamate 的去羧化反應以合成 GABA——腦部主要的抑制性神經傳遞物質。GAD 有兩種同功型 GAD65 與 GAD67；GAD67 為組成性活性、維持基礎 GABA 濃度，GAD65 則供應受調控釋放所需的 GABA。

nodes.label: MMP-9
nodes.description: TIMP3 is an endogenous ~24 kDa secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases; its N-terminal inhibitory domain inserts into the catalytic cleft of targets such as MMP-9 and MMP-2 in a 1:1 complex, and unlike TIMP1/2/4 it stays tethered to the extracellular matrix via heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TIMP3 是內生性約 24 kDa 的分泌型基質金屬蛋白酶抑制劑；其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 複合體插入 MMP-9、MMP-2 等標的酵素的催化裂縫，且與 TIMP1/2/4 不同，它透過硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣固定在細胞外基質上。

nodes.label: SRT2183
nodes.description: SRT2183 belongs to the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), the concrete chemical entities that enhance sirtuin activity; it was reported together with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as part of the potent second-generation synthetic STAC series developed after the polyphenolic activators.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SRT2183 屬於 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs），即能增強 sirtuin 活性的具體化學實體；它與 SRT1720、SRT1460 一起被報導為多酚類活化劑之後開發的強效第二代合成 STAC 系列。

nodes.label: HO-1
nodes.description: HO-1 is among the most highly inducible antioxidant enzymes because NRF2 binds the antioxidant response element (ARE) in its promoter. NRF2-dependent HO-1 induction is engaged by SIRT1-activating resveratrol and by pharmacological NRF2 activators such as sulforaphane, and it protects cells against oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HO-1 是可誘導性最高的抗氧化酵素之一，因為 NRF2 會結合其啟動子上的抗氧化反應元件（ARE）。由 SIRT1 活化的 resveratrol 與 sulforaphane 等藥理型 NRF2 活化劑可誘發 NRF2 相依的 HO-1 表現，進而保護細胞免受氧化壓力、細胞凋亡與發炎傷害。

nodes.label: alpha-1 Antitrypsin
nodes.description: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

nodes.label: Purkinje cell
nodes.description: Purkinje cells are the principal output neurons of the cerebellar cortex integrating sensory-motor input to deep nuclei. Containment records the defining cellular composition of the cerebellum.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Purkinje 細胞是小腦皮質的主要輸出神經元，整合感覺運動輸入至深部核。包含記錄小腦的定義性細胞組成。

nodes.label: Vps15
nodes.description: Vps34 (PIK3C3), the class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase, requires Vps15 (PIK3R4) as its p150 regulatory subunit. Vps15 recruits Vps34 to membranes and stabilizes its active site, so loss of Vps15 cripples the production of PtdIns3P and everything downstream of it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vps34（PIK3C3）這項第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶，需要 Vps15（PIK3R4）作為其 p150 調節次單元。Vps15 將 Vps34 招募至膜上並穩定其活性位點，因此 Vps15 缺失會使 PtdIns3P 的產生及其下游所有事件癱瘓。

nodes.label: Kitasato Institute
nodes.description: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

nodes.label: CD4+ T Cells
nodes.description: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are a CD4+ T-lymphocyte subset that suppresses excessive immune activation and maintains self-tolerance, countering chronic inflammation and autoimmunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Regulatory T cells（Tregs）是 CD4+ T 淋巴球的一個次群，可抑制過度的免疫活化並維持自身耐受性，對抗慢性發炎與自體免疫。

nodes.label: Singlet Oxygen
nodes.description: Carotenoids quench singlet oxygen by physical energy transfer from the triplet state of the sensitizer, a capacity that requires at least nine conjugated double bonds - which excludes phytoene and phytofluene. This is a non-radical antioxidant route distinct from radical trapping: carotenoids do not donate hydrogen to lipid peroxyl radicals the way tocopherols do, they physically deactivate an excited sensitizer. Within membrane lipid domains, beta-carotene, alpha-carotene and lycopene in the orange pericarp of Queen Palm and the mesocarp of Red Palm Oil act as direct singlet-oxygen quenchers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Carotenoids 透過從敏化劑三重態進行物理能量轉移來 quench Singlet Oxygen，此能力需要至少九個共軛雙鍵，因此 phytoene 與 phytofluene 不具此能力。這是一條與自由基捕捉不同的非自由基抗氧路徑：類胡蘿蔔素不像 tocopherols 那樣把氫原子 donate 給脂質過氧自由基，而是物理性地去活化一個受激的敏化劑。在膜脂質區域中，Queen Palm 的橙色果皮與 Red Palm Oil 的中果皮所含的 beta-carotene、alpha-carotene 與 lycopene 都是直接的 singlet-oxygen quenchers。

nodes.label: VEGF
nodes.description: VEGF is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward VEGF, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VEGF 是 Hallmarks of Cancer 的標誌。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 向 VEGF，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: Enterocloster
nodes.description: Enterocloster is a genus of anaerobic gut bacteria and thus a member of the Gut Microbiome. Which species are present determines which ellagitannin-to-urolithin conversion steps can occur, underpinning metabotype A, B, and 0 variability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Enterocloster 是厭氧腸道菌的一個屬，因此是 Gut Microbiome（腸道菌群）的成員。存在哪些菌種決定了哪些 ellagitannin 轉為 urolithin 的步驟能夠發生，構成 metabotype A、B 與 0 變異的基礎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Macrophage Polarization
nodes.description: SIRT2 decreases atherosclerotic plaque formation in LDL receptor-deficient mice by regulating macrophage polarization. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of anti-atherogenic macrophage phenotypes. By steering macrophages toward less inflammatory states, SIRT2 reduces the foam-cell accumulation and chronic inflammation that drive plaque development. This links SIRT2 to innate immune modulation in vascular disease, complementing the anti-inflammatory actions of other sirtuins. Because macrophages are central to atherosclerosis, interventions that preserve SIRT2 activity in these cells could help limit plaque burden and stabilize existing lesions, reducing the risk of cardiovascular events.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2在LDL受體缺陷小鼠中透過調節巨噬細胞極化來減少動脈粥樣硬化斑塊的形成。方向上，SIRT2位於抗動脈粥樣硬化的巨噬細胞表型的上游。透過將巨噬細胞引導至較不發炎的狀態，SIRT2減少了驅動斑塊發展的泡沫細胞積累和慢性發炎。這將SIRT2與血管疾病中的先天免疫調節聯繫起來，補充了其他sirtuin的抗發炎作用。由於巨噬細胞是動脈粥樣硬化的核心，維持這些細胞中SIRT2活性的介入措施可能有助於限制斑塊負荷並穩定現有病變，降低心血管事件的風險。

nodes.label: O-GlcNAcylation
nodes.description: O-GlcNAcylation of DRP1 increases its fission activity: O-GlcNAc transferase drives DRP1 translocation from the Cytosol to the mitochondria, enhancing Mitochondrial Fission in parallel with the stimulatory effect of S-nitrosylation on the same GTPase. Because excessive fission is associated with aging and mitochondrial dysfunction, DRP1 O-GlcNAcylation links dietary glucose load to mitochondrial fragmentation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DRP1 的 O-GlcNA 醣基化（O-GlcNAcylation）會提高其分裂活性：O-GlcNAc 轉移酶驅動 DRP1 由細胞質（Cytosol）轉位至粒線體，增強粒線體分裂（Mitochondrial Fission），與 S-硝基化對同一 GTPase 的刺激作用平行。因過度分裂與老化及粒線體功能障礙相關，DRP1 的 O-GlcNAcylation 將飲食葡萄糖負荷與粒線體碎裂連結起來。

nodes.label: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor
nodes.description: Methylene blue acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), and this activity underlies its mood effects. MAO enzymes break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, so inhibiting them leaves more of these neurotransmitters in the synapse - the same mechanism used by antidepressants like phenelzine. Because MAOI activity is potent, methylene blue carries real drug-interaction risks: combining it with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic medications can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern and a key contraindication for self-dosing with methylene blue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑（MAOI）發揮作用，這種活性是其情緒效應的基礎。MAO酶分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素，因此抑制它們會使更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中——這與phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用機制相同。由於MAOI活性很強，methylene blue帶有真正的藥物相互作用風險：將其與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，也是自行服用methylene blue的關鍵禁忌症。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

nodes.label: mitoTALENs
nodes.description: mitoTALENs (mitochondria-targeted transcription activator-like effector nucleases) are engineered nucleases that selectively cleave mutant mtDNA inside mitochondria. A TALE repeat array programmed to span the pathogenic mutation discriminates mutant from wild-type mtDNA at the single-nucleotide level, and the obligately dimeric FokI nuclease requires two monomers bound at adjacent half-sites, enhancing specificity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mitoTALENs（粒線體定位的轉錄活化因子樣效應器核酸酶）是經工程設計的核酸酶，可在粒線體內選擇性切割突變型 mtDNA。跨越致病突變點設計的 TALE repeat 陣列可在單一核苷酸層級區分突變型與野生型 mtDNA；而二聚化屬絕對必要的 FokI 核酸酶域要求兩個單體結合於相鄰半位點，進一步提升專一性。

nodes.label: NADH
nodes.description: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Integrity
nodes.description: Fusion complements damaged mitochondrial components by mixing mtDNA, proteins, and metabolites between organelles and equalizes membrane potential across the network, thereby maintaining Mitochondrial Integrity alongside fission-mediated quality control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 融合藉由在胞器間混合 mtDNA、蛋白質與代謝物來補償受損的粒線體成分，並使網絡內的膜電位趨於一致，因而與分裂介導的品質管制共同維持 Mitochondrial Integrity。

nodes.label: Retrograde Response
nodes.description: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a key effector of the mammalian Retrograde Response. Mitochondrial stress — electron transport chain impairment, Mitochondrial ROS accumulation, loss of membrane potential — converges on RXRα via calcium-dependent calcineurin, which dephosphorylates and activates the receptor, promoting nuclear translocation and transcription of metabolic adaptation, antioxidant defense, Mitochondrial Biogenesis, and Mitochondrial Dynamics genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoid X receptor α（RXRA、NR2B1）是哺乳類 Retrograde Response 的關鍵效應者。粒線體壓力——電子傳遞鏈受損、Mitochondrial ROS 累積、膜電位喪失——經由鈣離子依賴的 calcineurin 匯聚於 RXRα；calcineurin 使其去磷酸化並活化，促進核轉位與代謝適應、抗氧化防禦、Mitochondrial Biogenesis 與 Mitochondrial Dynamics 等基因的轉錄。

nodes.label: SLC25A51
nodes.description: SLC25A51 (MCART1) is a six-transmembrane-helix SLC25 carrier in the mitochondrial inner membrane that mediates uptake of intact NAD+ into the matrix, driven in part by membrane potential. Mitochondria cannot synthesize NAD+ de novo and the inner membrane is impermeable to pyridine nucleotides, so this importer supplies the matrix pool; the near-identical paralog SLC25A52 can substitute when overexpressed but is barely expressed in most tissues, leaving SLC25A51 as the dominant physiological route.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC25A51（MCART1）是位於粒線體內膜、具六次跨膜螺旋的 SLC25 載體，在膜電位的部分驅動下介導完整 NAD+ 進入基質的攝取。粒線體無法從頭合成 NAD+，且內膜對吡啶核苷酸不通透，因此必須由此進口蛋白供應基質 NAD+ 池；近乎相同的旁系同源物 SLC25A52 在過量表現時可替代，但在多數組織中幾乎不表現，使 SLC25A51 成為主要的生理途徑。

nodes.label: Reprogramming
nodes.description: Transient OSKM expression erases cell identity and yields induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). iPSCs enable patient-specific disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative applications, including the first iPSC clinical trial for macular degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 短暫的 OSKM 表現會抹除細胞身分並產生誘導多能幹細胞（iPSC）。iPSC 促成患者特異性的疾病建模、藥物發現和再生應用，包括第一個黃斑部退化 iPSC 臨床試驗。

nodes.label: DNMT3b
nodes.description: DNMT3b works alongside DNMT3a as a de novo methyltransferase to establish new DNA methylation patterns during early development. It preferentially methylates repetitive elements, including pericentromeric satellite repeats, where its activity is essential for heterochromatin formation and genomic stability. Loss-of-function mutations in DNMT3B cause ICF syndrome, characterized by immunodeficiency, centromeric instability, and facial anomalies, while its overexpression is common in cancers, where it contributes to aberrant hypermethylation and tumor suppressor silencing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNMT3b 與 DNMT3a 一起作為從頭甲基轉移酶，在早期開發過程中建立新的 DNA 甲基化模式。它優先甲基化重複元件，包括著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列，其活性對於異染色質形成和基因組穩定性至關重要。 DNMT3B 的功能缺失突變會導致 ICF 綜合徵，其特徵是免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和麵部異常，而其過度表達在癌症中很常見，會導致異常高甲基化和腫瘤抑制基因沉默。

nodes.label: SLC25A1
nodes.description: In senescent cells, SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels across multiple senescence contexts — irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative. The upregulation sustains the cytosolic acetyl-CoA supply needed for histone H3K27 acetylation at SASP gene loci, linking mitochondrial carbon flux to the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，SLC25A1 的 mRNA 與蛋白質表現在多種衰老情境——輻射誘發、阿霉素誘發與複製性衰老——皆顯著上升。此上調維持了 SASP 基因位點上組蛋白 H3K27 乙醯化所需的細胞質乙醯輔酶 A 供應，將粒線體碳流與衰老相關分泌表型連結起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: Ketogenesis
nodes.description: Ketogenesis is induced whenever glucose availability falls, as under Caloric Restriction, Intermittent Fasting or a Ketogenic Diet. During fasting the inhibition of mTORC1 (rising AMP/ATP) promotes Ketogenesis while inhibiting glycolysis and glutaminolysis in tumor cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 只要葡萄糖可得性下降就會誘導 Ketogenesis，例如在 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 或 Ketogenic Diet 之下。禁食期間 mTORC1 的抑制（AMP/ATP 上升）會促進 Ketogenesis，同時在腫瘤細胞中抑制糖解與麩醯胺分解。

nodes.label: Cyclin-Dependent Kinase
nodes.description: CDKN1A-encoded p21 inhibits cyclin-CDK enzymes, notably CDK2, enforcing G1/S blockade. This direct inhibition is shared with the Cip/Kip family mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDKN1A 編碼的 p21 抑制 cyclin-CDK 酶（特別是 CDK2），執行 G1/S 封鎖。此直接抑制與 Cip/Kip 家族機制共享。

nodes.label: CD157
nodes.description: CD157, also called bone marrow stromal cell antigen 1 (BST1), is a glycohydrolase that participates in NAD+ precursor metabolism. It hydrolyzes nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which is then further metabolized by gut microbiota into nicotinic acid and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway to NAD+. In addition, CD157 displays base-exchange activity against both NR and niacin riboside (NAR), interconverting amidated and deamidated precursor pathways. This dual activity means CD157 not only diverts NR toward the deamidated route but also links the two branches of NAD+ biosynthesis, providing alternative substrates that maintain intracellular NAD+ levels depending on tissue and dietary context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD157，又稱骨髓基質細胞抗原1（BST1），是一種參與NAD+前體代謝的糖水解酶。它將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）水解為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），隨後由腸道微生物群進一步代謝為菸鹼酸，並經由Preiss-Handler途徑進入NAD+。此外，CD157對NR與菸鹼酸核糖苷（NAR）均展現鹼基交換活性，使醯胺化與去醯胺化的前體途徑相互轉換。這種雙重活性意味著CD157不僅將NR導向去醯胺化路線，也連結NAD+生合成的兩個分支，提供替代受質，依組織與飲食背景維持細胞內NAD+水平。

nodes.label: JNK
nodes.description: JNK-mediated Bcl-2 phosphorylation releases Beclin1 for VPS34 nucleation. Phosphorylation is the stress-release mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JNK 介導的 Bcl-2 磷酸化釋放 Beclin1 以供 VPS34 成核。磷酸化是壓力釋放機制。

nodes.label: Quinolinic Acid
nodes.description: The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. Because the pathway accounts for approximately 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, its flux through IDO1 and TDO substantially shapes systemic NAD+ levels and neuroactive metabolite balance. KP dysregulation is implicated in neurodegeneration, depression, chronic inflammation, and infections (e.g., HIV modulates IDO1), in part because of the neuroactive and excitotoxic properties of kynurenine and quinolinic acid. This links IDO1 activity to both metabolic and neurological outcomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸途徑產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。由於該途徑佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，其經由 IDO1 與 TDO 的流量大幅塑造全身 NAD+ 濃度與神經活性代謝物平衡。KP 失調被認為與神經退化、憂鬱症、慢性發炎及感染（例如 HIV 調節 IDO1）有關，部分原因是犬尿胺酸與喹啉酸的神經活性與興奮毒性特性。這將 IDO1 活性同時連結至代謝與神經學結果。

nodes.label: VEGFR
nodes.description: The VEGFR family (VEGFR-1/2/3) comprises receptor tyrosine kinases activated by VEGF ligands. Among them VEGFR-2 is the principal driver of tumor Angiogenesis, which is why the pathway is a standard antiangiogenic target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VEGFR 家族（VEGFR-1/2/3）為由 VEGF ligand 活化的受體酪胺酸激酶。其中 VEGFR-2 是腫瘤 Angiogenesis 的主要驅動因子，因此此途徑是標準的抗血管新生標的。

nodes.label: Osteoclast
nodes.description: V-ATPase acidifies the resorption lacuna near pH 4.5 for matrix degradation. Requirement is the acidification dependency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 酸化吸收陷窩至約 pH 4.5 以降解基質。必要性是酸化依賴。

nodes.label: Homeostasis
nodes.description: Apoptosis is the dominant homeostatic execution mode whose rate largely sets how fast a tissue turns over. Whole-body figures of roughly 150 x 10^9 apoptotic cells per day imply a full cellular churn of about 248 days (~8 months). Tissues then diverge over orders of magnitude, from gut epithelium renewing every 3-5 days to neurons lasting a lifetime.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞凋亡是主導性的恆定態執行模式，其速率在很大程度上決定組織的更新速度。全身每天約 150 x 10^9 個細胞凋亡，對應整體細胞更替週期約 248 天（約 8 個月）。之後各組織的更新速率相差數個數量級，從腸上皮每 3-5 天更新一次，到神經元可延續終身。

nodes.label: SUMOylation
nodes.description: SUMOylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier proteins are covalently attached to lysine residues of target proteins. SUMOylation of TFEB at K316 attenuates its transcriptional activity, dampening expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes; like ubiquitylation it proceeds through an E1 activating enzyme (SAE1/SAE2), the E2 UBC9 and E3 ligases, but it modulates protein interactions, localization and stability rather than directing degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SUMOylation 是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，Sumo 類泛素修飾蛋白被共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基上。TFEB 在 K316 的 SUMOylation 會削弱其轉錄活性，壓低溶酶體與自噬基因的表現；與泛素化相同，它經由 E1 活化酶（SAE1/SAE2）、E2 UBC9 與 E3 連接酶進行，但它調節的是蛋白質交互作用、定位與穩定性，而非導向降解。

nodes.label: Warburg Effect
nodes.description: Metabolic Reprogramming includes Warburg Effect. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. The relationship is directional, with Metabolic Reprogramming acting as the operative agent upon Warburg Effect rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 包括Warburg Effect。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。這種關係是有方向的，Metabolic Reprogramming 充當Warburg Effect 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: Akkermansia
nodes.description: Akkermansia muciniphila is the principal gut-dwelling species of the genus Akkermansia (phylum Verrucomicrobia). It colonizes the intestinal mucus layer and degrades host mucin glycoproteins, and is consistently associated with gut barrier integrity and metabolic homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akkermansia muciniphila 是 Akkermansia 屬（Verrucomicrobia 門）主要的腸道物種。它定殖於腸道黏液層並分解宿主黏蛋白醣蛋白，且與腸道屏障完整性及代謝恆定穩定相關。

nodes.label: PAR
nodes.description: In Parthanatos, free PAR chains bind Hexokinase-1 through its PAR-binding motif and inhibit catalysis, driving VDAC dissociation and cytosolic translocation with loss of activity. Purified PAR directly inhibits hexokinase in neuronal and glioblastoma lysates whereas PARG-predigested PAR does not, and PBM-mutant HK1 resists PAR inhibition — decisive evidence for a direct binding model.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Parthanatos 中，游離的 PAR 鏈透過 PAR 結合基序與 Hexokinase-1 結合並抑制其催化活性，導致 VDAC 解離、轉位至細胞質並伴隨活性喪失。純化的 PAR 可直接抑制神經元與膠質母細胞瘤裂解液中的己糖激酶，而經 PARG 預消解的 PAR 則無此效果；帶有 PBM 突變的 HK1 能抵抗 PAR 抑制——這是直接結合模型最具決定性的證據。

nodes.label: cAMP
nodes.description: High intracellular cAMP activates Epac1 (Exchange Protein directly Activated by cAMP), a guanine-nucleotide-exchange factor that triggers downstream signaling independent of PKA. Directionally, cAMP sits upstream of Epac1 activation. Epac1 then stimulates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum, linking cAMP to Ca2+-dependent kinases and propagating a metabolic signal. This step is pivotal in resveratrol's indirect SIRT1-activation cascade, bridging the PDE4/cAMP arm to AMPK and NAD+ metabolism. The pathway illustrates how a polyphenol can activate sirtuins through classical second-messenger signaling rather than direct enzyme binding alone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高濃度的細胞內 cAMP 活化 Epac1（直接被 cAMP 活化的交換蛋白），這是一種鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子，觸發不依賴 PKA 的下游信號。在方向性上，cAMP 位於 Epac1 活化的上游。Epac1 然後刺激內質網的鈣離子釋放，將 cAMP 與 Ca2+ 依賴性激酶聯繫起來並傳播代謝信號。這一步是白藜蘆醇間接 SIRT1 活化級聯中的關鍵樞紐，將 PDE4/cAMP 臂橋接到 AMPK 和 NAD+ 代謝。此通路說明了一種多酚如何通過經典的第二信使信號而非僅靠直接酶結合來活化 sirtuin。

nodes.label: PAI-1
nodes.description: PAI-1 is the principal physiological inhibitor of the plasminogen activators uPA and tissue-type plasminogen activator, blocking plasmin generation and therefore fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix remodelling. By suppressing plasmin it also modulates integrin and latent-growth-factor activation, feeding fibrotic and proliferative loops.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 uPA 與組織型纖維蛋白溶解酶原活化素的主要生理抑制劑，阻斷 plasmin 生成，因而抑制纖維蛋白溶解與細胞外基質重塑。透過抑制 plasmin，它也調節 integrin 與潛在生長因子的活化，feeding 纖維化與增殖性回饋迴圈。

nodes.label: TLR9
nodes.description: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) is an endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG-rich DNA within the lumen of endosomes and lysosomes. Unlike the cytosolic DNA sensor cGAS, TLR9 is confined to the endolysosomal compartment, where it detects pathogen-derived DNA and, in some contexts, endogenous self-DNA delivered to these vesicles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) 是一種內體型 Toll 樣受體，在內體與溶酶體腔內偵測未甲基化的 CpG 富含 DNA。與細胞質 DNA 感測器 cGAS 不同，TLR9 受限於內溶體區室，在該處辨識病原體來源的 DNA，並在某些情境下辨識被運送至此囊泡的內源性自體 DNA。

nodes.label: CDK Inhibitor
nodes.description: CDK inhibitors as a class block cyclin-dependent kinase activity to gate cell-cycle transitions. This definitional class-target edge covers INK4 and Cip/Kip members plus drugs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制因子作為一類阻斷週期蛋白依賴激酶活性以守衛細胞週期轉換。此定義性類別—標的邊涵蓋 INK4 與 Cip/Kip 成員及藥物。

nodes.label: NASH
nodes.description: NASH is the inflammatory, potentially progressive form of Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Where simple steatosis is fat accumulation alone, NASH adds hepatocyte injury, Inflammation and variable fibrosis, and it can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NASH 是 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 中具發炎性且可能進展的形式。單純脂肪肝僅有脂肪堆積，而 NASH 額外加上肝細胞損傷、Inflammation 與程度不一的纖維化，並可進展為肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

nodes.label: Kynurenine Pathway
nodes.description: IDO1 catalyzes the first, rate-limiting step in tryptophan catabolism, inserting both oxygen atoms of O2 into the indole ring to yield N-formylkynurenine and thereby initiating the Kynurenine Pathway. Downstream metabolism produces Quinolinic Acid and ultimately NAD+, so IDO1 activity links tryptophan availability to the cellular NAD+ pool as well as to T-cell immunity and tumor immune tolerance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IDO1 催化色胺酸分解代謝的第一步也是限速步驟，將 O2 的兩個氧原子插入 indole 環以生成 N-formylkynurenine，據此啟動 Kynurenine Pathway。下游代謝產生 Quinolinic Acid 並最終生成 NAD+，因此 IDO1 活性同時連結色胺酸可得性與細胞 NAD+ 池，以及 T 細胞免疫與腫瘤免疫耐受。

nodes.label: Muscle Stem Cell
nodes.description: Satellite cells are the tissue-resident muscle stem cells of skeletal muscle, located between the basal lamina and the sarcolemma of mature muscle fibers. They are essential for postnatal muscle growth, regeneration after injury, and maintenance of muscle mass throughout life, and they are held in a quiescent G0 state marked by Pax7 until activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Satellite cell 是 skeletal muscle 的組織常駐 muscle stem cell，位於成熟肌纖維的 basal lamina 與 sarcolemma 之間。它們對出生後的肌肉生長、受傷後的再生，以及終生的肌肉量維持不可或缺，並在以 Pax7 為標記的 G0 靜止狀態中維持，直到被活化為止。

nodes.label: Bim
nodes.description: Bcl-2 family includes Bim. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bim rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bim。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Bim 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: miR-217
nodes.description: miR-217 is a senescence-associated microRNA whose canonical validated target is SIRT1. It binds the SIRT1 3'-UTR and suppresses translation, reducing NAD+-dependent deacetylase activity (Menghini et al., Circulation 2009; PMID 19188522).
nodes.description_zh_TW: miR-217 是一種與衰老相關的微 RNA，其經實驗驗證的經典靶標是 SIRT1。它結合 SIRT1 的 3'-UTR 並抑制轉譯，降低 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯化酶活性（Menghini 等人，Circulation 2009；PMID 19188522）。

nodes.label: HDACs
nodes.description: Trichostatin A is a hydroxamate HDAC inhibitor used alongside SAHA to demonstrate that deacetylation restrains autophagy. Its inhibition of HDACs de-represses TFEB and FOXO targets, raising Autophagy activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是羥胺酸類的 HDAC 抑制劑，常與 SAHA 併用以證明去乙醯化會壓抑自噬。其對 HDACs 的抑制會解除 TFEB 與 FOXO 標的基因的壓抑，提高 Autophagy 活性。

nodes.label: Cyclophosphamide
nodes.description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

nodes.label: Thioredoxin reductase
nodes.description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

nodes.label: GW5074
nodes.description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

nodes.label: Ro31-8220
nodes.description: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor; its adenosine-binding scaffold allowed it to be repurposed as an inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. It belongs to the kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins, sharing this property with the indolinone GW5074. Directionally, Ro31-8220's identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold underlies its cross-reactivity with sirtuins through the shared adenosine-binding site. Because it retains potent kinase activity, cellular effects cannot be attributed solely to sirtuin inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 是一種最初作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺化合物；其腺嘌呤結合骨架使其被重新定位為低微摩爾範圍內的 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 抑制劑。它屬於透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 活性而鑑定的激酶抑制劑骨架，與吲哚啉酮 GW5074 共享此特性。方向性上 Ro31-8220 作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份奠定了其透過共享腺嘌呤結合位點對 sirtuin 的交叉反應性。由於其保留強效激酶活性，細胞效應不能僅歸因於 sirtuin 抑制。

nodes.label: PhenoAge
nodes.description: The Horvath clock is the pan-tissue reference against which later clocks including PhenoAge are compared. PhenoAge complements the Horvath clock by tracking mortality-linked phenotypic age rather than chronological age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘是後續時鐘（包括 PhenoAge）進行比較的跨組織參考。PhenoAge 透過追蹤與死亡率相關的表現型年齡而非時間年齡，與 Horvath 時鐘互補。

nodes.label: TH17
nodes.description: IL-22, a member of the IL-10 gene family, is produced mainly by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets. It mediates mucosal barrier maintenance through antimicrobial peptides and epithelial proliferation after tissue injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-22 屬於 IL-10 基因家族，主要由輔助型 T 細胞 17（TH17）與先天淋巴細胞亞群產生。它透過抗菌胜肽與上皮細胞增殖，在組織受損後維持黏膜屏障並促進修復。

nodes.label: PAK1
nodes.description: Cancer Stem Cells are regulated by PAK1. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. The directionality runs from PAK1 toward Cancer Stem Cells, so PAK1 is the active agent and Cancer Stem Cells the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 受 PAK1 調節。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 PAK1 朝向 Cancer Stem Cells，因此 PAK1 是主動主體，Cancer Stem Cells 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

nodes.label: Metabolic Reprogramming
nodes.description: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Immunotherapy
nodes.description: Checkpoint Inhibitors are the core modality of Immunotherapy: they release CTLA-4 and PD-1/PD-L1 brake signaling that suppresses antitumor T-cell activity, converting a chronically inflamed but immune-excluded tumor into one the immune system can clear.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Checkpoint Inhibitor（檢查點抑制劑）是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）的核心手段：它們解除抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞活性的 CTLA-4 與 PD-1/PD-L1 煞車訊號，使長期發炎但免疫排斥的腫瘤轉為免疫系統可清除的腫瘤。

nodes.label: Age-Related Diseases
nodes.description: Aging is the sum of all age-related diseases, pre-diseases and pre-pre-diseases, which limit lifespan, and since humans die from age-related diseases rather than from healthy aging, a drug indicated for all age-related diseases must be an anti-aging drug in that it targets the common driver of these diseases, namely aging itself. Standard medicine extends lifespan mostly by preventing death from overt diseases, extending the unhealthy phase of life, whereas anti-aging medicine increases both healthspan and lifespan and is most effective at the stage of pre-diseases before complications and organ damage occur.
nodes.description_zh_TW:
衰老是所有與年齡相關的疾病、亞疾病和前亞疾病的總和，這些疾病限制壽命。由於人類通常死於與年齡相關的疾病，而不是健康衰老，因此針對所有與年齡相關疾病的藥物必須是一種抗衰老藥物，因為它標靶這些疾病的共同驅動因素，即衰老本身。標準醫學主要通過預防明顯疾病來延長壽命，延長不健康的生活階段，而抗衰老醫學則同時增加健康壽命和壽命，並在亞疾病階段（在出現併發症和器官損傷之前）最有效。”} 자바스크립트에서 실행할 수 있는 코드를 생성하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 다음 코드는 간단한 웹 페이지를 생성합니다. My First Heading

My First Heading

This is my first paragraph.

이 코드를 실행하면 제목이

nodes.label: Rab7
nodes.description: Lysosomal positioning and perinuclear clustering are regulated by Rab7 effectors, with FYCO1-type machinery driving plus-end transport and the RILP-ORP1L dynein adaptor driving minus-end movement. Perinuclear lysosomal clustering in turn facilitates Autophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 溶酶體的定位與核周聚集由 Rab7 效應蛋白調控，其中 FYCO1 類機器驅動向正端運輸，RILP-ORP1L 動力蛋白銜接蛋白驅动向負端移動。而核周溶酶體聚集反過來有助於 Autophagy。

nodes.label: Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: SIRT1 protects against Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury. Cardiac-specific SIRT1 knockout enlarges infarct size, whereas overexpression upregulates the FoxO1/MnSOD antioxidant pathway and downregulates the pro-apoptotic caspase-3/Bax axis. Upstream, miR-132 inhibition and lncRNA Oip5-as1 converge on a SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1α module.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 可保護心臟免受 Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury。心肌特異性 SIRT1 剔除會擴大梗死面積，而過量表現則會上調 FoxO1/MnSOD 抗氧化路徑並下調促凋亡的 caspase-3/Bax 軸。上游方面，miR-132 抑制與 lncRNA Oip5-as1 都收斂到 SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1α 模組。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential
nodes.description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain pumps protons across the inner membrane, building the electrochemical gradient ΔΨm that defines the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential and drives ATP synthesis; its collapse is an early event in oxidative neuronal injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain 將質子泵送過內膜，建立定義 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 的電化學梯度 ΔΨm 並驅動 ATP 合成；其崩解是氧化性神經損傷的早期事件。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Muscle Hypertrophy
nodes.description: mTORC1 is the central anabolic driver of Muscle Hypertrophy. Mechanical tension and metabolic stress during resistance exercise activate the PI3K/Akt pathway and leucine sensing upstream of mTORC1, which raises translation initiation and boosts myofibrillar protein accretion. Sustained mTORC1 signalling is what makes a muscle grow rather than merely adapt.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC1 是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的核心合成代謝驅動因子。阻力運動期間的機械張力與代謝壓力會經由 PI3K/Akt 路徑與 leucine 感測在 mTORC1 上游活化它，進而提升轉譯起始並促進肌原纖維蛋白的累積。持續的 mTORC1 訊號正是肌肉生長而非僅止於適應的關鍵。

nodes.label: SMAD2
nodes.description: TGFBR1 phosphorylates receptor-SMAD SMAD2 as the primary transducer. Body text confirms this canonical activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGFBR1 磷酸化受體 SMAD SMAD2 作為主要傳導器。內文確認此典型活化。

nodes.label: Acute Lung Injury
nodes.description: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome is the more severe end of the acute lung injury spectrum: a syndrome of acute diffuse lung injury producing increased pulmonary vascular permeability, edema, and refractory hypoxemic respiratory failure, triggered by insults such as sepsis, pneumonia, aspiration, trauma, pancreatitis, and severe COVID-19 rather than a single disease entity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome 是急性肺損傷光譜中較嚴重的一端：一種急性瀰漫性肺損傷症候群，造成肺血管通透性增加、水腫與難以緩解的低血氧呼吸衰竭，可由敗血症、肺炎、誤吸、創傷、胰臟炎與嚴重 COVID-19 等誘因引起，並非單一疾病。

nodes.label: H3K27me3
nodes.description: By blocking EZH2-mediated trimethylation of histone H3 at lysine 27, Tazemetostat reduces the repressive H3K27me3 mark. Loss of aberrant H3K27me3 derepresses silenced tumor-suppressor genes, restoring differentiation and cell-cycle control in cancers addicted to EZH2 activity, and exemplifies targeting the 'writer' enzymes of the epigenome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藉由阻斷 EZH2 對組蛋白 H3 第 27 號離胺酸的三甲基化，Tazemetostat 可降低抑制性的 H3K27me3 標記。異常 H3K27me3 的流失會解除被沉默的腫瘤抑制基因之抑制，在對 EZH2 活性成癮的癌症中恢復分化與細胞週期控制，並 exemplifies 針對表觀基因組「寫入者」酵素的策略。

nodes.label: IgE
