nodes.description: IL-4 is indispensable for IgE class switching in B cells; IL-4-deficient mice fail to produce IgE and have impaired anti-helminth immunity. This is why dupilumab, an anti-IL-4Rα antibody blocking both IL-4 and IL-13, is approved for type 2 inflammatory disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-4 對 B 細胞的 IgE 類別轉換不可或缺；IL-4 缺乏小鼠無法產生 IgE，且抗蠕蟲免疫受損。這也是為何阻斷 IL-4 與 IL-13 的抗 IL-4Rα 抗體 dupilumab 獲准用於第二型發炎性疾病。

nodes.label: Macromolecular Crowding
nodes.description: Neuromelanin and Macromolecular Crowding are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Macromolecular Crowding may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Macromolecular Crowding 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Macromolecular Crowding 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: TRAF2
nodes.description: TRAF2 is a key component of the signaling complex recruited by TNFR1, where it helps activate the NF-κB pathway to promote cell survival. In TNFR1 complex I, TRAF2 recruits cIAPs to ubiquitinate RIPK1 (survival mode), and is itself a CYLD deubiquitination substrate at the complex I → complex II handoff. Because of this survival signaling, TRAF2 overactivity can contribute to tumor growth and resistance to apoptosis-inducing therapies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAF2 是 TNFR1 所招募訊號複合體的關鍵成分，在其中協助活化 NF-κB 途徑以促進細胞存活。在 TNFR1 complex I 中，TRAF2 招募 cIAPs 對 RIPK1 進行泛素化（存活模式），其本身在 complex I → complex II 的交接處是 CYLD 去泛素化的受質。由於此存活訊號作用，TRAF2 的過度活化可能促成腫瘤生長與對誘導凋亡療法的抗性。

nodes.label: N-Myc
nodes.description: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

nodes.label: Extrinsic Pathway
nodes.description: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: CXCL12
nodes.description: CXCL12 was identified as the most highly upregulated SASP factor in endothelial cells with aging, and add-back of CXCL12 to old fisetin plasma recapitulated age-related endothelial dysfunction (-22% peak endothelium-dependent dilation), while CXCL12 neutralization with LIT-927 rescued function. CXCL12 also impairs NO production, raises mitochondrial superoxide and drives endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, establishing it as a causal circulating driver of vascular aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL12 被確認為內皮細胞隨老化上調最多的 SASP 因子；將 CXCL12 加回老年小鼠經 fisetin 處理的血漿可重現與年齡相關的內皮功能障礙（內皮依賴性擴張峰值下降 22%），而以 LIT-927 中和 CXCL12 則可挽救功能。CXCL12 還會損害 NO 產生、提高粒線體超氧陰離子並促進內皮間質轉化，確立它是血管老化的因果性循環因子。

nodes.label: GlyNAC
nodes.description: The NAC component of GlyNAC is deacetylated to cysteine, supplying the rate-limiting amino acid for glutathione synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GlyNAC 中的 NAC 成分會去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，提供穀胱甘肽合成中限速的胺基酸來源。

nodes.label: Cathepsin B
nodes.description: Silica-induced lysosomal membrane permeabilization spills lysosomal proteases including Cathepsin B into the cytosol; cytosolic Cathepsin B acts as a danger signal that triggers NLRP3 activation and downstream IL-1β maturation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Silica 造成的溶酶體膜通透化會使包括 Cathepsin B 在內的溶酶體蛋白酶外漏至細胞質；細胞質中的 Cathepsin B 作為危險訊號，誘發 NLRP3 活化與下游 IL-1β 成熟。

nodes.label: Testosterone
nodes.description: Androgen-receptor binding promotes protein synthesis, resistance to Muscle Atrophy, and prevention of Osteoporosis. Testosterone deficiency associates with sarcopenia, adiposity, and inflammaging, whereas balanced androgen tone within a Mitohormesis-like optimum favors Healthspan; supraphysiological dosing instead raises redox and thrombotic risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雄性素受體的結合促進蛋白質合成、提高對 Muscle Atrophy 的抵抗力並預防 Osteoporosis。Testosterone 缺乏與肌少症、脂肪堆積及 inflammaging 相關；而在類似 Mitohormesis 的最佳範圍內維持平衡的雄性素張力則有利於 Healthspan；超生理劑量的給藥反而會提高氧化還原與血栓風險。

nodes.label: Malate-Aspartate Shuttle
nodes.description: Aminooxyacetate is an inhibitor of aminotransferases (notably aspartate aminotransferase, GOT1/GOT2) that blocks the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, the principal system transferring glycolytic NADH into mitochondria. By inhibiting the transamination steps of the shuttle it prevents cytosolic NADH oxidation via mitochondrial Oxidative Phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminooxyacetate 是胺基轉移酶（尤其 aspartate aminotransferase、GOT1／GOT2）的抑制劑，可阻斷 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle——將糖解產生的 NADH 轉送入粒線體的主要系統。藉由抑制該穿梭的轉胺步驟，它阻止細胞質 NADH 經由粒線體 Oxidative Phosphorylation 被氧化。

nodes.label: Bifidobacterium
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These genera are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune system support. NAD+ precursors modulate gut microbiota by providing an energy source for beneficial bacteria, activating sirtuins, and improving gut barrier function. NMN and NR thereby reverse gut dysbiosis and promote beneficial effects at both intestinal and extraintestinal levels, linking dietary NAD+ precursor intake to a healthier gut microbial community.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些屬與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及支持免疫系統。NAD+ 前驅物透過提供有益細菌的能量來源、活化去乙醯酶以及改善腸道屏障功能來調節腸道菌叢。NMN 和 NR 因此逆轉腸道失調，並在腸內與腸外層面促進有益效應，將膳食性 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與更健康的腸道微生物群落連結起來。

nodes.label: TBK1
nodes.description: TRAF3 binds and activates the TBK1–IKKε kinase complex that phosphorylates IRF3, driving IFN-β transcription and type I interferon production. This makes TRAF3 a central relay of antiviral innate immunity; dysregulated TRAF3 affects antiviral defense, autoimmunity, and lymphomagenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAF3 結合並活化 TBK1–IKKε 激酶複合體，後者磷酸化 IRF3，驅動 IFN-β 的轉錄與第一型干擾素的產生。這使 TRAF3 成為抗病毒先天免疫的中繼站；TRAF3 的失調會影響抗病毒防禦、自體免疫與淋巴瘤生成。

nodes.label: Immune Checkpoint
nodes.description: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: ASK1
nodes.description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

nodes.label: Chromaffin cells
nodes.description: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome. This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants. Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome。This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants。Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues。

nodes.label: Nanoparticles
nodes.description: Human Serum Albumin is an ideal nanocarrier because it is endogenous, non-immunogenic, biodegradable and binds hydrophobic drugs, improving Bioavailability of poorly soluble compounds. Albumin-bound nanoparticle technology is clinically validated (e.g. nab-paclitaxel) and exploits gp60/SPARC albumin uptake pathways enriched in tumors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是理想的奈米載體，因為它是內源性、非免疫原性、可生物降解且能結合疏水性藥物，可改善難溶化合物的 Bioavailability。白蛋白結合型奈米粒子技術已獲臨床驗證（如 nab-paclitaxel），並利用在腫瘤中富集的 gp60/SPARC 白蛋白攝取途徑。

nodes.label: IκBα
nodes.description: The IKK complex is the core signaling component of canonical NF-κB activation. IKKβ phosphorylates IkappaBalpha at Ser32/Ser36, creating a phosphodegron recognized by the SCF/β-TrCP E3 ligase and causing K48-linked ubiquitination and rapid proteasomal degradation. Freed NF-κB then translocates to the nucleus and activates target genes; NEMO is essential for signal-dependent assembly and activation of the complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IKK complex 是典型 NF-κB 活化的核心訊號元件。IKKβ 在 Ser32/Ser36 磷酸化 IkappaBalpha，形成由 SCF/β-TrCP E3 連接酶辨識的磷酸降解子，造成 K48 連結泛素化與快速的蛋白酶體降解。獲得自由的 NF-κB 隨後轉位入核並活化標的基因；NEMO 對此複合體的訊號依賴性組裝與活化是必要的。

nodes.label: MDH1
nodes.description: Cytosolic MDH1 catalyzes the reversible conversion of malate to oxaloacetate coupled to NAD+ reduction to NADH; together with mitochondrial MDH2 it forms the cytosolic arm of the malate-aspartate shuttle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞質的 MDH1 催化蘋果酸可逆轉為草醯乙酸，並將 NAD⁺ 還原為 NADH；它與粒線體的 MDH2 共同構成蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭的細胞質一側。

nodes.label: N-Acetylcysteine
nodes.description: N-Acetylcysteine raises intracellular Glutathione. Cysteine is the rate-limiting residue of GSH synthesis, and NAC supplies bioavailable cysteine after deacetylation; replenishing the GSH pool is the principal mechanism behind NAC's reduction of Oxidative Stress and its clinical use in acetaminophen poisoning, where it restores hepatic GSH and prevents NAPQI adduction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-Acetylcysteine 會提升細胞內 Glutathione。Cysteine 是 GSH 合成的限速殘基，而 NAC 在去乙醯化後供應可利用的 cysteine；補充 GSH 池正是 NAC 降低 Oxidative Stress 的主要機制，也是其在乙醯胺酚中毒的臨床用途——恢復肝臟 GSH 並阻止 NAPQI 加合。

nodes.label: Lipid Metabolism
nodes.description: Lipid metabolism is a major output of SIRT1 deacetylase activity, which modulates transcription factors such as PGC-1alpha, LXR, FOXO, and CREB to govern lipid handling. SIRT1 deficiency is linked to metabolic and lipid disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 脂質代謝是 SIRT1 去乙醯化酶活性的主要輸出，SIRT1 調控 PGC-1α、LXR、FOXO 與 CREB 等轉錄因子以掌握脂質處理。SIRT1 缺乏與代謝及脂質疾病相關。

nodes.label: Wnt
nodes.description: Wnt/Frizzled inhibits the destruction complex so beta-catenin accumulates; core canonical mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Wnt/Frizzled 抑制破壞複合體使 β-catenin 累積；核心典型機制。

nodes.label: Transposable Elements
nodes.description: Alu elements are approximately 300-bp short interspersed nuclear elements (SINEs) derived from the 7SL RNA gene. With about 1.1 million copies they make up roughly 11% of the human genome, making them the most abundant Transposable Elements family; they are transcribed by RNA polymerase III and mobilize in copy-and-paste fashion through a LINE-1 ORF2 RNA intermediate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alu element 是約 300 bp、源自 7SL RNA 基因的短散在核元件（SINE）。約有 110 萬份拷貝，約占人類基因組的 11%，是數量最多的 Transposable Elements 家族；它們由 RNA polymerase III 轉錄，並透過 LINE-1 ORF2 蛋白的 RNA 中間物以「複製貼上」方式移動。

nodes.label: MOMP
nodes.description: BH3 mimetics relates to MOMP through the relation induce. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 透過關係式與 MOMP 相關。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

nodes.label: FL118
nodes.description: FL118 is a second-generation camptothecin analog that traps the covalent TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of single-strand breaks. Collision of the trapped complex with replicating DNA polymerases converts these breaks into lethal double-strand breaks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FL118 是第二代喜樹鹼類似物，會捕獲共價的 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，阻止單股斷裂的重新連結。被捕獲複合體與複製中的 DNA 聚合酶碰撞，會將這些斷裂轉化為致命的雙股斷裂。

nodes.label: GDF15
nodes.description: GDF15 is a TGFbeta-family SASP ligand whose blockade with antibodies partially rescues paracrine arrest in Acosta 2013. It acts alongside Activin A and TGF-beta1 as a non-redundant arrest-transmitting signal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GDF15 是 TGFbeta 家族 SASP 配體，Acosta 2013 中抗體阻斷部分拯救旁分泌停滯。它與 Activin A 和 TGF-beta1 並列，作為非冗餘的停滯傳遞訊號。

nodes.label: SHMT2
nodes.description: 5-Fluorouracil-resistant colorectal cancer cells show strong serine dependency, upregulating SHMT2 to compartmentalize one-carbon metabolism in mitochondria, supporting purine biosynthesis and DNA damage repair. SHMT2-driven mitochondrial one-carbon metabolism is therefore both a driver of CRC progression and a mechanism of chemoresistance to 5-FU; targeting serine availability or SHMT2 activity can revert 5-FU resistance in preclinical models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對 5-氟尿嘧啶抗藥的大腸直腸癌細胞呈現強烈的絲胺酸依賴性，並上調 SHMT2 以將一碳代謝區隔於粒線體中，藉此支援嘌呤生合成與 DNA 損傷修復。因此 SHMT2 驅動的粒線體一碳代謝既是大腸直腸癌進展的驅動因子，也是對 5-FU 的抗藥性機制；在前臨床模型中，抑制絲胺酸供應或 SHMT2 活性可逆轉 5-FU 抗藥性。

nodes.label: L-DOPA
nodes.description: Dopamine is a catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesized from tyrosine in two steps: Tyrosine Hydroxylase catalyzes tyrosine to L-DOPA, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts L-DOPA to dopamine. In the substantia nigra pars compacta the dopamine is then packaged into synaptic vesicles by Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine 是由酪胺素合成的兒茶酚胺神經傳遞物質，分兩步：Tyrosine Hydroxylase 催化酪胺素生成 L-DOPA，再由芳香族 L-胺基酸脫羧酶將 L-DOPA 轉為 dopamine。在 substantia nigra pars compacta 中，dopamine 隨後由 Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2 包裝進突觸小泡。

nodes.label: Alternative Splicing
nodes.description: PTBP1 is a principal repressor of alternative pre-mRNA splicing: binding polypyrimidine-rich sequences near splice sites occludes U2AF65 recruitment, biases exon skipping, and looping the pre-mRNA can hide the splice site; its effects are position- and context-dependent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTBP1 是前驅 mRNA 選擇性剪接的主要抑制因子：結合剪接位點附近的聚嘧啶豐富序列會阻擋 U2AF65 的招募、偏向外顯子跳過，並可藉由環化前驅 mRNA 隱藏剪接位點；其效果依位置與脈絡而定。

nodes.label: Statins
nodes.description: Statins are pharmacological inhibitors of HMG-CoA reductase; lowering cholesterol through this target is their primary therapeutic action in cardiovascular disease. The same inhibition is exploited experimentally to sensitize cells and tumors to ferroptosis in combination with GPX4 inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Statins 是 HMG-CoA reductase 的藥理抑制劑；經由此標的降低膽固醇是它在心血管疾病中的主要治療作用。同一種抑制作用也被實驗性地用來與 GPX4 抑制劑併用，使細胞與腫瘤對 ferroptosis 更加敏感。

nodes.label: Uric Acid
nodes.description: Gout is an inflammatory arthritis driven by persistent hyperuricemia, which supersaturates urate and promotes crystallization of monosodium urate in joints, cartilage, and soft tissue. Hyperuricemia arises from increased purine turnover, overproduction via Xanthine Oxidase, or reduced renal excretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gout 是由持續性高尿酸血症驅動的發炎性關節炎，尿酸過飽和促使 monosodium urate 在關節、軟骨與軟組織結晶。高尿酸血症來自 purine turnover 增加、經 Xanthine Oxidase 的生成過多，或腎臟排泄減少。

nodes.label: Atg5
nodes.description: Atg5 is essential for T Cell survival and proliferation. Atg5-deficient T cells are incapable of autophagy initiation, which abrogates the differentiation towards a regulatory Foxp3+ phenotype induced by Spermidine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg5 對 T Cell 的存活與增殖不可或缺。缺乏 Atg5 的 T cell 無法起始自噬，因而阻斷 Spermidine 誘導的調控型 Foxp3+ 表現型分化。

nodes.label: NAD+ Salvage Pathway
nodes.description: The NAD+ Salvage Pathway produces NAD+ as the dominant biosynthetic route in most mammalian tissues. It recycles nicotinamide released by NAD+-consuming enzymes back into NAD+ in two steps: NAMPT generates NMN, then NMNAT converts NMN to NAD+, so salvage efficiency sets the co-substrate supply for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAD+ Salvage Pathway 產生 NAD+，是大多數哺乳動物組織中的主導生合成途徑。它以兩步把 NAD+ 消耗酵素所釋出的 nicotinamide 回收成 NAD+：先由 NAMPT 生成 NMN，再由 NMNAT 將 NMN 轉為 NAD+；因此 salvage 效率決定了 sirtuins、PARPs 與 CD38 的共同受質供應。

nodes.label: EX-527
nodes.description: EX-527 (selisistat) is an indole-derived, cell-permeable small molecule that blocks SIRT1 with high selectivity (IC50 ~0.098 μM versus ~20 μM for SIRT2 and ~50 μM for SIRT3). It occupies the nicotinamide-binding pocket as a nicotinamide analog, halting NAD+-dependent deacetylation and making it a standard probe of SIRT1 function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EX-527（selisistat）是吲哚衍生、可穿透細胞的小分子化合物，能高度選擇性地抑制 SIRT1（IC50 約 0.098 μM，相較 SIRT2 約 20 μM、SIRT3 約 50 μM）。它以菸醯胺類似物身分占據菸醯胺結合位，阻斷 NAD+ 依賴性的去乙醯化，是研究 SIRT1 功能的標準工具。

nodes.label: APE1
nodes.description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

nodes.label: Toll-like Receptor
nodes.description: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) is an endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG-rich DNA within the lumen of endosomes and lysosomes. Unlike the cytosolic DNA sensor cGAS, TLR9 is confined to the endolysosomal compartment, where it detects pathogen-derived DNA and, in some contexts, endogenous self-DNA delivered to these vesicles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) 是一種內體型 Toll 樣受體，在內體與溶酶體腔內偵測未甲基化的 CpG 富含 DNA。與細胞質 DNA 感測器 cGAS 不同，TLR9 受限於內溶體區室，在該處辨識病原體來源的 DNA，並在某些情境下辨識被運送至此囊泡的內源性自體 DNA。

nodes.label: macroH2A
nodes.description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci contain macroH2A, along with HP1, H3K9me3, and HMGA proteins, which together form compacted chromatin domains in the nuclei of senescent cells. The accumulation of macroH2A in these foci promotes transcriptional silencing of proliferation-associated genes and helps stabilize the senescent state. Although not essential for growth arrest, the incorporation of macroH2A into SAHFs is a hallmark of senescence-associated chromatin reorganization. The enrichment of macroH2A distinguishes SAHFs from ordinary heterochromatin domains.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關的異染色質灶包含 macroH2A 以及 HP1、H3K9me3 和 HMGA 蛋白，它們一起在老化細胞的細胞核中形成壓縮的染色質結構域。 macroH2A 在這些病灶中的累積促進了增殖相關基因的轉錄沉默，並有助於穩定老化狀態。儘管 macroH2A 摻入 SAHF 對生長停滯不是必需的，但它是衰老相關染色質重組的標誌。 macroH2A 的富集將 SAHF 與普通異染色質結構域區分開來。

nodes.label: Immunosenescence
nodes.description: Immunosenescence impairs T-cell immunity, featuring perturbed memory responses, thymic involution, reduced naive T-cell generation, and accumulation of differentiated, often dysfunctional memory and effector subsets such as EMRA CD8+ T cells. This limits responses to infection and vaccination in the elderly and weakens T-cell-mediated immune surveillance, including the clearance of senescent and premalignant cells. The impairment is a hallmark of adaptive immune aging. It directly contributes to the decline in senescence surveillance with age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 免疫衰老損害 T 細胞免疫，特徵為記憶反應紊亂、胸腺退化、初始 T 細胞生成減少，以及分化、常功能障礙的記憶與效應子集（如 EMRA CD8+ T 細胞）累積。這限制老年人對感染與疫苗的回應，並削弱 T 細胞介導的免疫監視，包括清除衰老與癌前細胞。此損害是適應性免疫老化的特徵，直接促成隨年齡的衰老監視下降。

nodes.label: TOM1
nodes.description: TOM1 acts as a negative regulator of innate immune signaling. TOM1 recruitment to ubiquitinated Toll-like Receptor 4 and IL-1 receptor complexes accelerates their clearance, damping pro-inflammatory NF-κB and cytokine output; TOM1 knockdown enhances TLR- and IL-1β-driven inflammation. By routing ubiquitinated receptors to lysosomes, TOM1 limits receptor half-life and keeps inflammatory signaling balanced.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TOM1 作為先天免疫訊號的負向調節因子。TOM1 被招募至泛素化的 Toll-like Receptor 4 與 IL-1 受體複合體後加速其清除，抑制促發炎的 NF-κB 與細胞激素輸出；TOM1 敲低會增強 TLR 與 IL-1β 驅動的發炎反應。藉由將泛素化受體運送至 lysosome，TOM1 限制受體半衰期，使發炎訊號維持平衡。

nodes.label: Lysosome Biogenesis
nodes.description: The CLEAR network is a master transcriptional program orchestrated by the MiT/TFE factors TFEB and TFE3, which bind CLEAR elements (GTCACGTGAC) in promoters of lysosomal hydrolases, v-ATPase and autophagic genes. CLEAR therefore drives Lysosome Biogenesis so that lysosomal capacity scales with autophagic demand; diminished TFEB/CLEAR activity with age contributes to lysosomal storage and aggregation disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網絡是由 MiT/TFE 因子（主要為 TFEB 與 TFE3）統籌的主控轉錄程式，這些因子結合於溶小體水解酵素、v-ATPase 與自噬基因啟動子上的 CLEAR 元素（GTCACGTGAC）。因此 CLEAR 驅動 Lysosome Biogenesis，使溶小體容量隨自噬需求擴張；隨年齡下降的 TFEB/CLEAR 活性則促成溶小體儲積與聚集疾病。

nodes.label: ADAM10
nodes.description: ADAM10 activity attenuates Amyloid Beta production by cleaving APP non-amyloidogenically; inhibiting or losing this α-secretase shifts APP toward BACE1 and increases plaque burden, which is why ADAM10 is framed as an anti-amyloid gatekeeper.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ADAM10 的活性透過非類澱粉樣方式切斷 APP 而降低 Amyloid Beta 生成；抑制或喪失此 α-secretase 會使 APP 轉向 BACE1 並增加斑塊負擔，因此 ADAM10 被視為抗類澱粉樣的關卡守門者。

nodes.label: cIAPs
nodes.description: Smac mimetics deplete cIAPs by forcing them into their own destruction. Bivalent compounds such as birinapant dimerize the cIAP RING domains, triggering K48 auto-ubiquitination and proteasomal self-destruction within minutes; monovalent compounds such as LCL161 and xevinapant/AT-406 act more gradually but reach the same endpoint, the loss of RIPK1 ubiquitination in TNFR1 complex I.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smac mimetics 藉由迫使 cIAPs 自我毀滅而使其耗竭。雙價化合物如 birinapant 會使 cIAP 的 RING 結構域二聚化，在數分鐘內觸發 K48 自我泛素化與蛋白酶體自體毀滅；單價化合物如 LCL161 與 xevinapant/AT-406 作用較慢，但達到相同終點——TNFR1 complex I 中 RIPK1 泛素化的喪失。

nodes.label: DJ-1
nodes.description: Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Hypertension
nodes.description: Hypertension is the persistent elevation of arterial blood pressure (≥140/90 mmHg), affecting roughly 1.39 billion people and standing as a major risk factor for Cardiovascular Disease, Stroke, Chronic Kidney Disease and Heart Failure. It both causes and results from Endothelial Dysfunction, and chronic pressure overload drives cardiac remodeling toward heart failure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypertension 是動脈血壓持續升高（≥140/90 mmHg）的狀態，影響約 13.9 億人，是 Cardiovascular Disease、Stroke、Chronic Kidney Disease 與 Heart Failure 的主要危險因子。它既是 Endothelial Dysfunction 的成因也是結果，長期壓力過載會驅動心臟重塑而走向心衰竭。

nodes.label: XIAP
nodes.description: Intrinsic Pathway is inhibited by XIAP. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Intrinsic Pathway, so XIAP is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 被XIAP 抑制。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Intrinsic Pathway，因此 XIAP 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

nodes.label: c-Myc
nodes.description: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors used to reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include the oncogene c-Myc. c-Myc opens chromatin by binding methylated regions and promotes the proliferation and metabolic changes that accompany reprogramming initiation. However, c-Myc is a potent oncogene that increases the risk of tumorigenesis in iPSC-derived cells, motivating efforts to exclude or replace it with safer alternatives. Its dual role as reprogramming enhancer and oncogene highlights the safety concerns of iPSC therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 山中因子是用於將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子，其中包括癌基因 c-Myc。 c-Myc 透過結合甲基化區域打開染色質，並促進伴隨重編程啟動的增殖和代謝變化。然而，c-Myc 是一種強效致癌基因，會增加 iPSC 衍生細胞發生腫瘤的風險，促使人們努力排除它或用更安全的替代品取代它。它作為重編程增強子和癌基因的雙重作用凸顯了 iPSC 治療的安全性問題。

nodes.label: Cathepsin D
nodes.description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

nodes.label: DDX3X
nodes.description: DDX3X activates Wnt signaling by promoting the nuclear accumulation of beta-catenin. Because nuclear beta-catenin is the transcriptional effector of the canonical Wnt pathway, DDX3X sits upstream of beta-catenin-dependent transcription, linking an RNA helicase to proliferative and developmental gene programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DDX3X 藉由促進 beta-catenin 在細胞核內累積而活化 Wnt 訊號。由於核內的 beta-catenin 是典型 Wnt 路徑的轉錄效應因子，DDX3X 位於 beta-catenin 依賴性轉錄的上游，將一個 RNA helicase 與增殖及發育相關的基因程式連結起來。

nodes.label: HLA Haplobank
nodes.description: A haplobank curates HLA-homozygous induced pluripotent stem cell master lines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 單倍庫策展 HLA 純合誘導多能幹細胞主系。

nodes.label: P300
nodes.description: Transactivation domains recruit P300/CBP coactivator complexes, documented for p53-P300. Recruitment couples TFs to acetylation machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉活化結構域招募 P300/CBP 協同活化複合體，p53-P300 已記載。招募將轉錄因子耦合到乙醯化機器。

nodes.label: CD8+ T Cell
nodes.description: CD8+ T Cells (cytotoxic T lymphocytes) are a subset of T cells that play a critical role in the Adaptive Immune Response by killing infected or cancerous cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD8+ T Cell（細胞毒性 T 淋巴球）是 T Cell 的一個次群，藉由殺死受感染或癌化的細胞，在 Adaptive Immune Response 中扮演關鍵角色。

nodes.label: Mectizan
nodes.description: Established in 1987, the Mectizan Donation Program manages Merck & Co. Inc's donation of Mectizan (brand-name ivermectin) free of charge, handling logistics, distribution and pharmacovigilance with endemic-country ministries of health, the World Health Organization and non-governmental partners. It became the template for large-scale philanthropic drug donation and a cornerstone of neglected-tropical-disease elimination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mectizan Donation Program 成立於 1987 年，負責管理 Merck & Co. Inc 免費捐贈的 Mectizan（ivermectin 的商品名），並與流行國衛生部門、World Health Organization 及非政府夥伴共同處理後勤、分發與藥物警戒。它成為大規模慈善藥品捐贈的典範，也是 neglected tropical disease 根除計畫的基石。

nodes.label: mitoTAD
nodes.description: mitoTAD operates on the mitochondrial import translocons themselves: when a mitochondrial precursor protein stalls during passage through the TOM/TIM complexes, mitoTAD mediates its extraction from the channel and subsequent proteasomal degradation, clearing the gate so that import can resume. It therefore acts constitutively, whereas the broader mitoCPR is a stress-inducible response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mitoTAD 作用的對象正是粒線體輸入轉位子本身：當粒線體前驅蛋白在通過 TOM/TIM 複合體時卡滯，mitoTAD 媒介其自通道抽出與隨後的蛋白酶體降解，清理通道使輸入得以恢復。因此它是構成性作用，而較廣義的 mitoCPR 則是壓力誘發的反應。

nodes.label: Acrolein
nodes.description: Acrolein (CH2=CH-CHO, 2-propenal) is the simplest alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde and one of the most electrophilic products of Lipid Peroxidation. It arises from beta-scission of PUFA hydroperoxides, notably omega-3 species such as Docosahexaenoic acid, whose chain length and double-bond placement favor release of a three-carbon fragment. Because its vinyl group flanks a carbonyl, it is a potent Michael acceptor that modifies protein cysteine, histidine and lysine residues and forms DNA adducts at concentrations well below those required for Malondialdehyde or 4-Hydroxynonenal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acrolein（CH2=CH-CHO，2-propenal）是最簡單的 α,β-不飽和醛，也是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具親電性的產物之一。它來自 PUFA 過氧化物的 β-scission，尤其是 Docosahexaenoic acid 等 omega-3 脂肪酸，其鏈長與雙鍵位置有利於釋出三碳片段。由於其乙烯基緊鄰羰基，它是強效的 Michael 受體，可在遠低於 Malondialdehyde 或 4-Hydroxynonenal 所需的濃度下修飾蛋白質的 cysteine、histidine 與 lysine 殘基並形成 DNA 加合物。

nodes.label: Cytosol
nodes.description: Stress granules are membrane-less organelles that assemble within the cytosol. The cytosol is a crowded, structured medium rather than a static fluid, and liquid-liquid phase separation in it drives the formation of stress granules and processing bodies that sequester untranslated mRNAs during stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stress granules 是在 cytosol 中組裝形成的無膜胞器。Cytosol 並非靜態流體，而是擁擠且具結構的介質，其中的 liquid-liquid phase separation 驅動 stress granules 與 processing bodies 的形成，在壓力下隔離未轉譯的 mRNA。

nodes.label: SLC6A8
nodes.description: The creatine transporter gene SLC6A8 is markedly upregulated in tumor-infiltrating immune cells, and creatine uptake through it is required for effective CD8 T cell antitumor function (Di Biase et al., 2019). This links the creatine transport system to cancer immunotherapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: creatine transporter 基因 SLC6A8 在腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中顯著上调，透過它攝取 creatine 對 CD8 T cells 有效的抗腫瘤功能是必要的（Di Biase et al., 2019）。這將 creatine 運輸系統與癌症免疫治療連結起來。

nodes.label: Eryptosis
nodes.description: Eryptosis is triggered by convergence on cytosolic calcium elevation from oxidative stress, osmotic shock, energy depletion that impairs calcium extrusion, and ceramide accumulation. Calcium then activates calpain proteases and phospholipid scramblases while inhibiting flippases, externalizing phosphatidylserine as the Annexin V-positive eat-me signal, with cell shrinkage and membrane blebbing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Eryptosis 的誘發因子包括 oxidative stress、滲透壓衝擊、耗損 ATP 導致鈣外排能力下降，以及 Ceramide 累積，它們都匯聚於細胞質鈣離子上升。鈣離子接著活化 calpain 蛋白酶與 phospholipid scramblase 並抑制 flipase，將 phosphatidylserine 外翻形成 Annexin V 陽性的 eat-me 訊號，並伴隨細胞縮小與膜起泡。

nodes.label: Retinoic Acid
nodes.description: Retinoic Acid is the active metabolite of Vitamin A and a potent inducer of cellular differentiation. In embryonic stem cell research it is applied to monolayer cultures without LIF to drive mesenchymal differentiation and test the silencing of pluripotency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 是 Vitamin A 的活性代謝物，也是強效的細胞分化誘導劑。在胚胎幹細胞研究中，它在不含 LIF 的單層培養中被施加以驅動間質分化並檢測多能性的沉默。

nodes.label: Glutaredoxin
nodes.description: Glutaredoxin donates electrons to ribonucleotide reductase (RNR), providing a glutathione-routed backup to thioredoxin for de novo dNTP synthesis. Glutaredoxin was discovered through its ability to reduce RNR, and both systems can sustain ribonucleotide reduction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 提供電子給核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR），為 de novo dNTP 合成提供一條經由麩胱甘肽路線、與硫氧還蛋白並行的備援途徑。Glutaredoxin 正是因其還原 RNR 的能力而被發現，兩者皆能維持核醣核苷酸還原作用。

nodes.label: Lamin B1
nodes.description: Downregulation of the nuclear lamina protein Lamin B1 is one of the most conserved, cell-autonomous markers of Senescence, holding across replicative, oncogene-induced and therapy-induced senescence in human and mouse cells. Because the loss is cell-autonomous, LMNB1 negativity is used to quantify senescent-cell burden in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核纖層蛋白 Lamin B1 的下調是最保守且細胞自主的 Senescence 標誌之一，在複製性、致癌基因誘導與治療誘導的衰老中皆成立，且適用於人與小鼠細胞。由於這種流失是細胞自主的，LMNB1 陰性可用於在體內量化衰老細胞負荷。

nodes.label: Type I Interferon
nodes.description: Interferon-stimulated genes are the aggregated transcriptional output of type I interferon signaling: IFN-I binding IFNAR1 activates JAK-STAT pathways that induce hundreds of ISGs whose products establish an antiviral and inflammatory cellular state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 干擾素刺激基因是第一型干擾素訊息傳遞的聚合轉錄輸出：IFN-I 結合 IFNAR1 後活化 JAK-STAT 途徑，誘導數百個 ISG，其蛋白產物建立抗病毒與發炎性的細胞狀態。

nodes.label: Fibroblast
nodes.description: TGF-β signalling through SMAD2/3 drives fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation and extracellular matrix deposition. Activated myofibroblasts are contractile, α-smooth-muscle-actin-positive cells that close wounds but, when persistently activated, drive fibrosis — which is why fibroblast-targeted therapies such as TGF-β or lysyl oxidase inhibition aim to limit pathological scarring.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-β 經由 SMAD2/3 的訊號傳遞驅動 fibroblast 向 myofibroblast 分化與 extracellular matrix 沉積。被活化的 myofibroblast 是具收縮性、α-smooth-muscle-actin 陽性的細胞，可閉合傷口，但持續活化時會驅動 fibrosis——因此針對 fibroblast 的治療（如抑制 TGF-β 或 lysyl oxidase）旨在限制病理性瘢痕。

nodes.label: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation
nodes.description: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) is an ATP-dependent pathway that rebuilds Lysosome from endolysosomes after endocytic cargo has been degraded. It is distinct from Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, which regenerates lysosomes from autolysosomes after autophagic turnover.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) 是一條 ATP 依賴途徑，在內吞負載物被分解後由 endolysosome 重建 Lysosome。它與 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 不同，後者是在自噬周轉之後由 autolysosome 再生 lysosome。

nodes.label: Lysosomal Acid Lipase
nodes.description: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

nodes.label: MDA-LDL
nodes.description: MDA-LDL is one of the two major immunologically defined forms of oxidatively modified LDL, the other being Oxidized LDL, but it is the narrower entity. Oxidized LDL denotes the full spectrum of oxidatively modified particles - lipid peroxides, oxidized phospholipids, fragmented apoB - detected by antibodies against oxidized phospholipid epitopes such as E06, whereas MDA-LDL reports only the aldehyde-adducted fraction. The two correlate but are not interchangeable, and their relative abundance shifts with the type of oxidative insult.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MDA-LDL 是氧化修飾 LDL 的兩大免疫學定義形式之一，另一者是 Oxidized LDL，但 MDA-LDL 範圍更窄。Oxidized LDL 指的是所有氧化修飾顆粒的完整光譜——脂質過氧化物、氧化磷脂、碎裂的 apoB——以針對氧化磷脂表位（如 E06）的抗體偵測；MDA-LDL 則僅回報醛類加合的部分。兩者相關但不可互換，且其相對比例會隨氧化傷害的類型而改變。

nodes.label: MFN1
nodes.description: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: T Cell
nodes.description: CD8+ T Cells (cytotoxic T lymphocytes) are a subset of T cells that play a critical role in the Adaptive Immune Response by killing infected or cancerous cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD8+ T Cell（細胞毒性 T 淋巴球）是 T Cell 的一個次群，藉由殺死受感染或癌化的細胞，在 Adaptive Immune Response 中扮演關鍵角色。

nodes.label: Substantia Nigra
nodes.description: The striatum receives dopamine from the substantia nigra pars compacta via the nigrostriatal pathway, the loss of which characterizes Parkinson's disease. This dopaminergic input is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake and shaped by COMT, especially in lower-DAT compartments, and is essential for normal striatal and motor function. The integrity of this projection is required for coordinated movement and reward processing. Its degeneration produces the cardinal motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紋狀體透過黑質紋狀體途徑從黑質緻密部接收多巴胺，多巴胺的喪失是帕金森氏症的特徵。這種多巴胺能輸入主要由 DAT 再攝取終止，並由 COMT 塑造，特別是在低 DAT 區室中，對於正常紋狀體和運動功能至關重要。協調 movement 和 reward 處理需要此投影的完整性。它的退化產生了帕金森氏症的主要運動症狀。

nodes.label: p62
nodes.description: p62 (SQSTM1) also directly degrades p21, the second CDK inhibitor cleared in Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease. Because both p16 and p21 impose the senescence arrest, their combined p62-mediated removal explains how restoring Autophagy flux can reverse the senescent phenotype in aVICs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p62 (SQSTM1) 也直接降解 p21，即在 Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease 中被清除的第二個 CDK 抑制因子。由於 p16 與 p21 共同造成 senescence 停滯，兩者經 p62 媒介的清除，便解釋了恢復 Autophagy flux 為何能逆轉 aVIC 的 senescent 表型。

nodes.label: ATF4
nodes.description: Phosphorylation of eIF2α at Ser51 attenuates global cap-dependent translation while paradoxically promoting translation of selected stress-responsive mRNAs such as ATF4. Phosphorylated eIF2α sequesters the guanine nucleotide exchange factor eIF2B, preventing eIF2 complex recycling; ATF4 then drives transcription of adaptive genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eIF2α 在 Ser51 的磷酸化會抑制整體帽依賴性轉譯，卻反而促進 ATF4 等選擇性壓力反應 mRNA 的轉譯。磷酸化的 eIF2α 隔離鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子 eIF2B，阻斷 eIF2 複合體的再循環；ATF4 隨後驅動適應性基因的轉錄。

nodes.label: CDC20
nodes.description: APC/C bound to CDC20 drives the metaphase-to-anaphase transition with defined specificity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與 CDC20 結合的 APC/C 以既定特異性驅動中期到後期轉換。

nodes.label: Mass Spectrometry
nodes.description: The Metabolome — the complete set of small-molecule chemicals present in a sample, cell, or organism at a given moment — is profiled by untargeted or targeted metabolomics using Mass Spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance. The resulting fingerprints are highly dynamic, shifting over seconds to hours with feeding, exercise, circadian rhythm, and stress, and serve as sensitive Biomarkers of physiological state and disease risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolome——在特定時刻存在於樣本、細胞或生物體中的全部小分子化學物集合——是透過以 Mass Spectrometry 與核磁共振進行的非標定或標定式代謝組學來描繪的。所得的指紋變動極快，會隨進食、運動、晝夜節律與壓力在數秒至數小時間尺度上改變，並可作為生理狀態與疾病風險的敏感 Biomarkers。

nodes.label: Entacapone
nodes.description: Entacapone belongs to the COMT inhibitor drug class, alongside tolcapone and opicapone. Its clinical role is as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa therapy in Parkinson's disease, where prolonging levodopa half-life reduces off time.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Entacapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑這一藥物類別，與 tolcapone、opicapone 同類。其臨床角色是作為 Parkinson's disease 中 levodopa/carbidopa 治療的輔助用藥，藉由延長 levodopa 半衰期減少 off time。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Respiration
nodes.description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain (Complexes I–IV) receives electrons from NADH and FADH2 generated by the TCA cycle; the resulting proton pumping builds the gradient whose dissipation through ATP Synthase defines Mitochondrial Respiration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain（Complexes I–IV）接受 TCA cycle 產生的 NADH 與 FADH2 的電子；由此驅動的質子泵送建立梯度，其經 ATP Synthase 的消散即定義了 Mitochondrial Respiration。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Endothelial Cells
nodes.description: EndoMT is the transdifferentiation of endothelial cells, which lose their characteristic endothelial markers and acquire mesenchymal, contractile and matrix-producing properties. It is a key mechanism in cardiovascular pathology, vascular ageing and fibrosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EndoMT 是內皮細胞的轉分化：其失去特有的內皮標記並獲得間質性、收縮性與基質生成特性。它是心血管病理、血管老化與纖維化中的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: Atg16L1
nodes.description: The T300A variant of Atg16L1 is a risk factor for Crohn's Disease, linking impaired Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1-dependent LC3 lipidation to intestinal inflammatory disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg16L1 的 T300A 變異是 Crohn's Disease 的風險因子，將 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 依賴的 LC3 脂化受損與腸道發炎性疾病連結起來。

nodes.label: RGD peptide
nodes.description: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

nodes.label: Hematopoiesis
nodes.description: All blood cell lineages are generated by hematopoiesis, a lifelong process carried out in the bone marrow by hematopoietic stem cells that self-renew and differentiate along myeloid and lymphoid paths under transcription factors, cytokines, and epigenetic control, plus metabolic tuning by mTOR and AMPK nutrient sensing. Hematopoiesis thereby sustains oxygen carriage, immunity, and hemostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 所有血球譜系都由 hematopoiesis 產生；這是一生持續進行、發生於骨髓的過程，由能自我更新並在轉錄因子、細胞激素與表觀遺傳調控下分化成髓系與淋巴系路徑的造血幹細胞執行，並受到 mTOR 與 AMPK 營養感知的代謝調節。Hematopoiesis 藉此維持氧氣運送、免疫與止血功能。

nodes.label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
nodes.description: Budding yeast is a premier eukaryotic model organism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 芽殖酵母是首屈一指的真核模式生物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine
nodes.description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a well-characterized and abundant member of the Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) class, formed by oxidative degradation of Amadori products or by reaction of glyoxal with lysine residues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是被充分刻畫且含量豐富的晚期糖基化終產物（AGEs）類成員，由 Amadori 產物的氧化降解或乙二醛與離胺酸殘基反應而形成。

nodes.label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
nodes.description: Respiratory Chain Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is the first and largest enzyme of the mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain, an L-shaped ~45-subunit assembly embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane that oxidizes NADH at an FMN site and passes electrons through iron–sulfur clusters to reduce ubiquinone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Respiratory Chain Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）是粒線體 Electron Transport Chain 中第一個也是最大的酵素，為嵌於內膜、約 45 次單元的 L 型組裝體，於 FMN 位點氧化 NADH，並經由鐵硫簇傳遞電子以還原 ubiquinone。

nodes.label: Zellweger Spectrum Disorders
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX13 cause PEX13-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder, roughly 2-5% of cases; missense variants in the SH3-like domain partially impair PEX14 interaction and yield milder phenotypes, while truncating mutations abolish import and cause lethal disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX13 突變會造成 PEX13 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群，約佔所有病例的 2–5%；SH3 樣結構域的錯義變異會部分損害與 PEX14 的交互作用而表型較輕，截短突變則完全消除輸入功能並造成致死性疾病。

nodes.label: Cholesterol Efflux
nodes.description: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: cells, especially Macrophages, export excess free Cholesterol to extracellular lipid acceptors such as Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL. Because the process is the rate-limiting gateway of the whole reverse transport cascade, its impairment promotes foam cell formation and Atherosclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步且為速率限制步驟：細胞（尤其是 Macrophages）將過量的游離 Cholesterol 輸出至細胞外脂質受體，例如 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL。由於此步驟是整個逆向運輸級聯反應的速率限制關口，其功能受損會促進泡沫細胞形成與 Atherosclerosis。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition
nodes.description: MPT is an independent regulated-necrosis program: cyclophilin D-dependent opening of the permeability transition pore; cyclophilin D-deficient mice are partially protected from organ ischemia-reperfusion injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MPT 是獨立的 regulated necrosis 程序：由 Cyclophilin D 依賴性之通透性轉換孔開啟所介導；Cyclophilin D 缺失小鼠在器官缺血–再灌注損傷中獲得部分保護。

nodes.label: 3-deoxyglucosone
nodes.description: 3-deoxyglucosone is a highly reactive dicarbonyl (α-oxaldehyde) intermediate generated endogenously by non-enzymatic sugar degradation and lipid peroxidation. It reacts with amino groups to form advanced glycation end products, making it a potent glycation precursor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 3-deoxyglucosone 是高度反應性的二羰基（α-oxaldehyde）中間體，由非酵素性糖降解與 Lipid Peroxidation 內源性生成。它與胺基反應形成 Advanced Glycation End Products，因此是強效的 glycation 前驅物。

nodes.label: SAM
nodes.description: SAM is the universal methyl donor for DNMT1-mediated 5mC synthesis. Classification defines its metabolic role.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAM 是 DNMT1 介導 5mC 合成的通用甲基供體。歸類定義其代謝角色。

nodes.label: Integrated Stress Response
nodes.description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

nodes.label: docetaxel
nodes.description: Docetaxel is a backbone TNBC regimen with melittin-combo data.
nodes.description_zh_TW: docetaxel 是 TNBC 主幹方案，具 melittin 合併數據。

nodes.label: RIG-I
nodes.description: RIG-I (DDX58) is a cytosolic DExH-box RNA helicase pattern-recognition receptor that detects short double-stranded RNA with a 5'-triphosphate or 5'-diphosphate end. Ligand binding plus K63-linked polyubiquitination releases its N-terminal CARDs, which nucleate filaments that drive MAVS (IPS-1) oligomerisation on the mitochondrial outer membrane, MAMs and peroxisomes, converting RIG-I recognition into downstream signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RIG-I (DDX58) 是細胞質的 DExH-box RNA 解旋酶型模式辨識受體，可偵測帶 5′-三磷酸或 5′-二磷酸末端 的短雙股 RNA。配體結合加上 K63 連結的泛素化會釋出其 N 端 CARD，CARD 核化成絲狀體並驅動 MAVS (IPS-1) 在粒線體外膜、MAM 與過氧化體上聚集，將 RIG-I 的辨識轉為下游訊息傳遞。

nodes.label: Cell Proliferation
nodes.description: mTORC2 is the downstream readout of the rapamycin model since it drives cell cycle progression and survival via AKT, and also regulates mitochondrial physiology, metabolism and integrity. mTORC2 activity has been shown to increase with age, and its elimination has been shown to alleviate aging progression. In the simulations, the typical dose-response curve shows a clear decrease in mTORC2 activity at intermediate rapamycin concentrations, followed by reduced sensitivity at higher doses, while short-term rapamycin exposure increases mTORC2 activity and long-term exposure obstructs its assembly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC2是雷帕霉素模型的下游讀出，因為它透過AKT驅動細胞週期進展和存活，同時也調節粒線體生理、代謝和完整性。mTORC2活性已被證明隨年齡增長而增加，且其消除可減緩衰老進展。在模擬中，典型的劑量反應曲線顯示在中等雷帕霉素濃度下mTORC2活性明顯降低，隨後在更高劑量下敏感性降低，而短期雷帕霉素暴露增加mTORC2活性，長期暴露則阻碍其組裝。

nodes.label: Superoxide Dismutase
nodes.description: Superoxide Dismutase catalyses the dismutation of the superoxide radical (O2•−) into ordinary molecular oxygen (O2) and Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2). As a core enzymatic component of the antioxidant defence system, it protects cells from ROS-induced damage by clearing superoxide before it can oxidise other substrates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Superoxide Dismutase 催化 superoxide radical（O2•−）的歧化反應，生成一般分子氧（O2）與 Hydrogen Peroxide（H2O2）。作為抗氧化防禦系統的核心酵素組分，它在 superoxide 能氧化其他受質之前將其清除，藉此保護細胞免受 ROS 造成的損傷。

nodes.label: KDM4
nodes.description: Genetic or pharmacological inhibition of KDM4 lowers IL-6, IL-8 and MMP secretion without necessarily abolishing growth arrest, marking KDM4 as a senomorphic target; loss of H3K9me3 at SASP loci reduces linker-histone compaction and permits NF-κB and BRD4 access.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對 KDM4 的遺傳或藥理學抑制可降低 IL-6、IL-8 與 MMP 的分泌而不必然廢除生長停滯，使 KDM4 成為 senomorphic 標的；SASP 位點上 H3K9me3 的流失減少連接組蛋白介導的壓縮，讓 NF-κB 與 BRD4 能接觸染色質。

nodes.label: FasL
nodes.description: FasL binding to Fas recruits FADD and Caspase-8 to the DISC, triggering Caspase-8 auto-activation; active Caspase-8 then cleaves executioner caspases (Caspase-3, Caspase-7) or Bid for mitochondrial amplification. FasL is thus a primary initiator of the extrinsic apoptotic pathway and, with TRAIL, one of the two best-characterized death ligands.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FasL 與 Fas 結合會將 FADD 與 Caspase-8 招募至 DISC，觸發 Caspase-8 自我活化；活化的 Caspase-8 接著切割執行者 caspase（Caspase-3、Caspase-7）或 Bid 以進行粒線體放大。因此 FasL 是外在性凋亡路徑的主要起始者，並與 TRAIL 並列為兩個最深入的死亡配體。

nodes.label: XIST
nodes.description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md

nodes.label: Curcumin
nodes.description: Curcumin modulates inflammatory pathways by inhibiting NF-kB signaling. Because turmeric contains only about 3% curcumin with low bioavailability, its in vivo efficacy often requires high doses or formulation strategies such as co-administration with piperine from black pepper.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Curcumin 透過抑制 NF-kB 訊號調控發炎路徑。由於薑黃僅含約 3% 的 Curcumin 且生物可利用率低，其在體內的功效常需高劑量或配方策略，例如與黑胡椒中的 piperine 併用。

nodes.label: Knockout mouse
nodes.description: C57BL/6 ("B6") is the dominant inbred background for engineered mouse lines: because background strongly influences phenotype, most engineered alleles are backcrossed onto this strain to control confounders, and its >20 generations of brother-sister mating give high reproducibility.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C57BL/6（「B6」）是基因改造小鼠品系最主要的近交背景：由於背景品系會強烈影響表型，多數改造等位基因都會回交到本品系以控制混雜因子；其超過 20 代的兄弟姊妹交配也帶來高度可重複性。

nodes.label: TCA cycle
nodes.description: Glutaminolysis feeds the TCA cycle with anaplerotic carbon at the alpha-ketoglutarate node. It is the dominant anaplerotic route in rapidly proliferating cancer cells, and blocking it together with Complex I collapses the glutamine-fueled cycle in MYC-high breast cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminolysis 在 alpha-ketoglutarate 節點以 anaplerotic 碳供應 TCA cycle。在快速增殖的癌細胞中它是主要的 anaplerotic 途徑；在 MYC-high 乳癌細胞中，與 Complex I 一起阻斷即可瓦解 glutamine 驅動的 cycle。

nodes.label: Redox Homeostasis
nodes.description: SIRT3 buffers mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating MnSOD and IDH2, letting SIRT3-rich tumor-associated macrophages tolerate the oxidative metabolism that supports their M2 program. This ties mitochondrial sirtuin redox control directly to immune polarization and to the redox homeostasis of the Tumor Microenvironment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由去乙醯化 MnSOD 與 IDH2 緩衝粒線體 ROS，使 SIRT3 豐富的 Tumor-Associated Macrophage 能耐受支持其 M2 程序的氧化代謝。這將粒線體 sirtuin 的氧化還原調控直接連結到免疫極化，以及 Tumor Microenvironment 的 Redox Homeostasis。

nodes.label: Fructosamine
nodes.description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme that initiates protein deglycation by phosphorylating fructosamine, the Amadori residues on glycated proteins, converting them into fructosamine-3-phosphate. This phosphorylated compound is highly unstable and spontaneously decomposes, regenerating the original, undamaged amino acid and releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. By repairing early glycation intermediates before they progress to irreversible AGEs, FN3K provides the repair arm of the enzymatic defense against AGE accumulation, complementary to prevention by dicarbonyl detoxification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（Fructosamine-3-kinase, FN3K）是一種細胞內酵素，透過磷酸化果糖胺（即糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里殘基）來啟動蛋白質去糖化，將其轉化為果糖胺-3-磷酸（fructosamine-3-phosphate）。此磷酸化化合物高度不穩定並自發分解，再生原始的未受損胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，隨後被解毒酵素中和。透過在不可逆 AGE 形成之前修復早期糖化中間產物，FN3K 提供了對抗 AGE 堆積之酵素防禦的修復臂，補充二羰基解毒的預防作用。

nodes.label: DELE1
nodes.description: DELE1 couples detection of mitochondrial dysfunction at the inner membrane to activation of the cytosolic integrated stress response. Depending on the intensity and duration of stress, the outcome of this OMA1-DELE1-HRI signaling ranges from adaptive recovery to induction of apoptosis, and the pathway is implicated in neurodegeneration, cardiomyopathy and metabolic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DELE1 將內膜對粒線體功能失調的偵測與細胞質 integrated stress response 的活化耦合起來。此 OMA1-DELE1-HRI 訊號的結果依壓力的強度與持續時間而定，可從適應性恢復一路延伸至 apoptosis 的誘導；該途徑與神經退化、心肌病變及代謝疾病皆有關聯。

nodes.label: Caenorhabditis elegans
nodes.description: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

nodes.label: William C. Campbell
nodes.description: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

nodes.label: MyoD
nodes.description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

nodes.label: TRIM28
nodes.description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

nodes.label: Ferroptosis in IDD
nodes.description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

nodes.label: Epicatechin
nodes.description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

nodes.label: Apolipoprotein B
nodes.description: Apolipoprotein B is the primary apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and LDL particles and serves as the ligand for the LDL receptor, making it essential for lipoprotein assembly and metabolism. LDL oxidation alters the apoB protein moiety through fragmentation and cross-linking of reactive aldehydes and oxysterols; resveratrol reduces this radical-induced alteration and chelates copper bound to apoB. Elevated apoB-containing lipoproteins drive plaque formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein B 是乳糜微粒與 LDL 顆粒的主要載脂蛋白，並作為 LDL receptor 的配體，因此對脂蛋白組裝與代謝至關重要。LDL 氧化會透過活性醛與氧化膽固醇的斷裂與交聯改變 apoB 蛋白部分；resveratrol 可減少此自由基誘發的變化並螯合結合於 apoB 的銅。含 apoB 的脂蛋白濃度升高會驅動斑塊形成。

nodes.label: nootropic
nodes.description: A nootropic is by definition a cognitive-enhancing agent targeting alertness, attention or executive function. Classification covers prescription repurposing like modafinil as well as supplements.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nootropic 依定義是針對警覺、注意或執行功能的認知增強劑。歸類涵蓋如 modafinil 的處方再利用與補充劑。

nodes.label: Retinal Ganglion Cells
nodes.description: Neuronal STING activity is activated within Retinal Ganglion Cells and the adjacent retinal pigment epithelium during disease, driving Retinal Ganglion Cell death and vision loss in glaucoma; because STING activation is deleterious, pharmacological inhibition of the cGAS-STING axis is being investigated to preserve Retinal Ganglion Cell viability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在疾病過程中，Retinal Ganglion Cells 與鄰近的視網膜色素上皮內神經元 STING 活性被活化，驅動 Retinal Ganglion Cells 死亡並造成青光眼的視力喪失；由於 STING 活化具有損害性，藥理抑制 cGAS-STING 軸正被研究以保存 Retinal Ganglion Cells 的存活。

nodes.label: 5,6-indolequinone
nodes.description: 5,6-indolequinone is biochemically converted into Neuromelanin through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, 5,6-indolequinone acts as the substrate and Neuromelanin as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，5,6-indolequinone 作為底物，Neuromelanin 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

nodes.label: Neurotoxicity
nodes.description: Direct SIRT2 activation is generally avoided therapeutically because overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, where excessive deacetylation may impair microtubule and protein-homeostasis defenses. Directionally, SIRT2 overactivity is associated with neuronal damage. Consequently, SIRT2 inhibitors are pursued for Parkinsons and Huntingtons disease, where preserving α-tubulin acetylation protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. This therapeutic direction contrasts with SIRT2s tumor-suppressive functions in other tissues, illustrating how the same enzyme can be targeted in opposite directions depending on disease context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 直接活化 SIRT2 通常在治療上被避免，因為其過度活性與神經退行性疾病背景下的神經毒性相關，過度去乙醯化可能損害微管和蛋白質穩態防禦。在方向性上，SIRT2 過度活性與神經元損傷相關。因此，SIRT2 抑制劑正在帕金森症和亨丁頓症的研究中被追求，保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化可以保護神經元免受聚集毒性。這種治療方向與 SIRT2 在其他組織中的腫瘤抑制功能形成對比，說明同一酶如何根據疾病情境被朝相反方向靶向。

nodes.label: Stanniocalcin-1
nodes.description: Stanniocalcin-1, a glycoprotein hormone, orchestrates a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis, and inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway to ameliorate renal injury in diabetic murine models. The hormetic description reflects STC1's pattern of effect: mild mitochondrial stress engages AMPK, supporting SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種糖蛋白激素，編排了一個激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡，並透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現以改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。激效性描述反映了 STC1 的作用模式：輕度粒線體壓力啟動 AMPK，支持 SIRT3 依賴的粒線體品質控制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: LIR Motif
nodes.description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

nodes.label: Oral squamous cell carcinoma
nodes.description: In oral squamous cell carcinomas, SIRT3 is overexpressed, and its downregulation has antiproliferative activity and sensitizes carcinoma cells to radiation and to cisplatin. This contrasts with SIRT3's broader tumor-suppressive role in mouse models, showing that sirtuin function is context-dependent. Directionally, elevated SIRT3 supports tumor growth and therapy resistance in this cancer type, while SIRT3 loss restores sensitivity. The finding highlights that a single sirtuin can be either protective or oncogenic depending on tumor type and molecular background.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在口腔鱗狀細胞癌中，SIRT3 過量表現，其下調具有抗增殖活性並使癌細胞對放射治療和 Cisplatin 敏感。這與 SIRT3 在小鼠模型中更廣泛的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比，顯示 sirtuin 功能具有情境依賴性。方向性上，SIRT3 升高在此癌種中支持腫瘤生長和治療抗性，而 SIRT3 缺失恢復敏感性。此發現凸顯了單一 sirtuin 根據腫瘤類型和分子背景可能具有保護性或致癌性。

nodes.label: Intermedin
nodes.description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

nodes.label: Liquiritigenin
nodes.description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

nodes.label: Shingles Vaccine
nodes.description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

nodes.label: Biological Aging
nodes.description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

nodes.label: Meteorin-like protein
nodes.description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

nodes.label: Dyskinesia
nodes.description: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

nodes.label: Hemoglobin M
nodes.description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is a rare congenital form of Methemoglobinemia caused by autosomal dominant mutations in the globin genes (α, β or γ chains). These mutations stabilize the iron in the ferric Fe³⁺ state within Hemoglobin, so the affected heme groups cannot bind oxygen, producing lifelong Cyanosis; patients are otherwise typically asymptomatic or only mildly affected.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin M（HbM）疾病是 Methemoglobinemia 的一種罕見先天型態，由 globin 基因（α、β 或 γ 鏈）的體染色體顯性突變造成。這些突變使 Hemoglobin 中的鐵穩定於 ferric Fe³⁺ 態，使受影響的 heme 無法結合氧氣，造成終身 Cyanosis；患者通常無其他症狀或僅有輕微表現。

nodes.label: soluble epoxide hydrolase
nodes.description: A regulatory axis exists in which soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation, with sEH deficiency preserving SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impede renal vascular calcification progression. sEH inhibition or deficiency therefore acts as an indirect SIRT3-stabilizing strategy in advanced CKD-associated vascular calcification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 存在一個調控軸線，其中可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH）透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 的周轉，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化的進展。因此 sEH 抑制或缺乏作為進階 CKD 相關血管鈣化中間接穩定 SIRT3 的策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

nodes.label: ETS
nodes.description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。

nodes.label: Imatinib
nodes.description: Imatinib is the prototype tyrosine-kinase inhibitor targeting BCR-ABL, c-KIT and PDGFR. Its inhibition of c-KIT is the basis of its activity in KIT-mutant gastrointestinal stromal tumors, and it is the classic single-target KIT inhibitor against which multi-targeted agents such as pazopanib are contrasted.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Imatinib 是標靶 BCR-ABL、c-KIT 與 PDGFR 的原型酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。其對 c-KIT 的抑制是它在 KIT 突變型胃腸道間質腫瘤中的活性基礎，也是與 pazopanib 等多標的藥物對照時的典型單一標的 KIT 抑制劑。

nodes.label: NCOA4
nodes.description: NCOA4 mediates ferritinophagy, turning over ferritin to feed redox-active Fe2+ into Fenton chemistry. This iron-supply mechanism complements the lipid-substrate arm of ACSL4.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導 ferritinophagy，周轉 ferritin 以供應具氧化還原活性 Fe2+ 進入 Fenton 化學。此鐵供應機制補充 ACSL4 的脂質受質臂。

nodes.label: Iron Regulatory Protein 1
nodes.description: Apo-aconitase is Iron Regulatory Protein 1, which binds the ferritin iron-responsive element repressing translation. Cluster loss switches enzyme to RNA regulator.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 脫輔基 aconitase 即 Iron Regulatory Protein 1，結合 ferritin 鐵反應元件抑制轉譯。簇缺失將酶切換為 RNA 調節因子。

nodes.label: Betaine
nodes.description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

nodes.label: Heparin
nodes.description: Heparin is a glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant that binds antithrombin III and induces a conformational change that accelerates antithrombin-mediated inactivation of thrombin (factor IIa) and factor Xa by roughly 1000-fold. Unfractionated heparin inhibits both thrombin and Xa, whereas low molecular weight heparin such as enoxaparin and dalteparin primarily targets Xa.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Heparin 是一種醣胺聚醣類抗凝血劑，可與 antithrombin III 結合並誘導構形改變，使 antithrombin 對 thrombin（factor IIa）與 factor Xa 的抑制加速約 1000 倍。未分級肝素同時抑制 thrombin 與 Xa，而 enoxaparin、dalteparin 等低分子量肝素則主要作用於 Xa。

nodes.label: Christensenellaceae
nodes.description: Christensenellaceae are saccharolytic anaerobic bacteria of the Firmicutes whose fermentation yields Short-chain Fatty Acids, particularly acetate and butyrate. These metabolites fuel colonocytes and support an anti-inflammatory tone, giving the family a direct metabolic role in host energy balance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Christensenellaceae 是屬於 Firmicutes 的產糖厭氧菌，其發酵產生 Short-chain Fatty Acids，尤其是乙酸與丁酸。這些代謝物為結腸細胞供能並維持抗發炎基調，使此菌科在宿主能量平衡中具有直接代謝作用。

nodes.label: PON1
nodes.description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

nodes.label: DNA Ligase IV
nodes.description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

nodes.label: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction
nodes.description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Mst1
nodes.description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

nodes.label: SOD1
nodes.description: SIRT5 activates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) through desuccinylation, enhancing NADPH production and glutathione recycling for ROS detoxification. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This bolsters cytosolic antioxidant capacity, and it extends SIRT5's protective actions beyond the mitochondria's own enzymes. By promoting NADPH generation and glutathione recycling, SOD1 activation supports the detoxification of superoxide and the maintenance of redox balance. This antioxidant function complements SIRT5's metabolic roles and contributes to cellular protection against oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增強 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收以進行 ROS 解毒。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 SOD1。這增強了細胞質抗氧化能力，並將 SIRT5 的保護作用延伸到粒線體自身酶之外。透過促進 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收，SOD1 活化支持超氧陰離子的解毒和紅氧平衡的維護。這種抗氧化功能與 SIRT5 的代謝角色互補，並有助於細胞對抗氧化壓力的保護。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

nodes.label: MuRF1
nodes.description: MuRF1 (Muscle RING Finger 1, also known as TRIM63) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression rises during muscle wasting and atrophy; it tags sarcomeric proteins so they can be degraded through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MuRF1（Muscle RING Finger 1，又稱 TRIM63）是一種肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，在肌肉消耗與萎縮時表現上升；它標記肌節蛋白，使其經由泛素-蛋白酶體系統被降解。

nodes.label: STUB1
nodes.description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

nodes.label: ACAT1
nodes.description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

nodes.label: I-PpoI
nodes.description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

nodes.label: Antagonistic Pleiotropy
