nodes.description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

nodes.label: SIRT1 inhibition
nodes.description: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Radiosensitizer
nodes.description: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

nodes.label: Beta-hydroxybutyrate
nodes.description: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

nodes.label: p65
nodes.description: p65 (RELA) is one of the two subunits of the most prevalent NF-kappaB species, the p65/p50 heterodimer. Its transcriptional activity is acetylation-sensitive: increased SIRT1 protein expression reduces acetylation of the NF-kappaB p65 subunit, which suppresses TNF-alpha-induced NF-kappaB transcriptional activation and reduces TNF-alpha secretion in a SIRT1-dependent manner.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p65（RELA）是最普遍的 NF-κB 型態——p65/p50 異源二聚體——的兩個次單元之一。其轉錄活性對乙醯化敏感：SIRT1 蛋白表現增加會降低 NF-κB p65 次單元的乙醯化程度，進而以 SIRT1 依賴的方式抑制 TNFα 誘發的 NF-κB 轉錄活化並減少 TNFα 分泌。

nodes.label: Orlistat
nodes.description: Beyond inhibiting fat absorption, orlistat decreases intestinal absorption of dietary Advanced Glycation End Products; in women with PCOS it lowered postprandial serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal compared with controls.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了抑制脂肪吸收外，[[Orlistat]] 還能減少飲食性 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 的腸道吸收；在 PCOS 女性中，相較對照組可降低高 AGE 餐後的血清 AGE 濃度。

nodes.label: Acatalasemia
nodes.description: Glutathione peroxidase and peroxiredoxin redundancy compensates catalase loss, explaining asymptomatic acatalasemia cases through alternative peroxide detoxification. Backup enzymes mask the deficiency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 與過氧化還原蛋白冗餘補償 catalase 缺失，經由替代過氧化物解毒解釋無症狀 acatalasemia 病例。備援酶掩蓋缺陷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

nodes.label: Humphry Osmond
nodes.description: Hoffer met Osmond at Saskatchewan Hospital in Weyburn in 1950, and the two systematically studied catecholamines and their oxidized metabolites in psychiatric patients, ran controlled LSD trials, and co-authored the monographs that elaborated the adrenochrome model.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hoffer 於 1950 年在 Weyburn 的 Saskatchewan Hospital 認識 Osmond，兩人系統性研究精神科病人的 Catecholamines 及其氧化代謝物、進行受控的 LSD 試驗，並共同撰寫闡述 adrenochrome 模型的專著。

nodes.label: Butein
nodes.description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。

nodes.label: L-arginine
nodes.description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

nodes.label: NF675
nodes.description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

nodes.label: Lys122
nodes.description: SIRT3, the major mitochondrial deacetylase, directly removes the acetyl group from Lys122 of MnSOD/SOD2; deacetylated MnSOD shows dramatically increased dismutation activity, lowering mitochondrial oxidative stress. Lys122 is thus a canonical readout of SIRT3 function, and its acetylation status is used as a surrogate marker of SIRT3 activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3（主要的粒線體去乙醯化酶）會直接移除 MnSOD/SOD2 上 Lys122 的乙醯基；去乙醯化後的 MnSOD 歧化活性顯著提升，降低粒線體氧化壓力。因此 Lys122 是 SIRT3 功能的典型讀出指標，其乙醯化狀態也被用作 SIRT3 活性的替代標記。

nodes.label: ZCCHC11
nodes.description: ZCCHC11 uridylates pre-let-7 downstream of Lin28 recruitment, destabilizing it. Consolidated inhibits form; downregulates variant dropped.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 在 Lin28 招募下游使 pre-let-7 尿苷化使其不穩定。合併的 inhibits 形式；downregulates 變體捨棄。

nodes.label: Dihydromyricetin
nodes.description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

nodes.label: Paracrine Reprogramming
nodes.description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

nodes.label: Cadherin
nodes.description: Differential cadherin adhesion drives developmental cell sorting. Driving records the morphogenetic output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 差異 cadherin 黏附驅動發育細胞分選。驅動記錄形態發生輸出。

nodes.label: Adrenocortical carcinomas
nodes.description: Mitotane (o,p'-DDD; Lysodren) is the adrenolytic agent used in Adrenocortical carcinomas as adjuvant therapy after resection and for advanced disease; it accumulates in adrenocortical tissue, damaging mitochondria, inhibiting steroidogenesis via CYP11A1/CYP11B1 and killing tumour cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitotane（o,p'-DDD；Lysodren）是治療 Adrenocortical carcinomas 的腎上腺皮質溶解劑，作為切除後的輔助療法與晚期疾病用藥；它累積於腎上腺皮質組織，損傷粒線體、經 CYP11A1/CYP11B1 抑制類固醇生成並殺傷腫瘤細胞。

nodes.label: HPP+
nodes.description: Haloperidol is metabolically converted into the pyridinium neurotoxin HPP+, a charged MPP+ analog taken up by dopaminergic neurons where it inhibits mitochondrial complex I. This conversion underlies haloperidol-associated parkinsonism, which mimics but is distinct from Parkinson's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Haloperidol 在代謝上轉化為吡啶鎓神經毒素 HPP+，一種帶電荷的 MPP+ 類似物，被多巴胺神經元攝取並抑制粒線體複合體 I。此轉化是 haloperidol 相關帕金森症的基礎，其模仿但不同於 Parkinson's Disease。

nodes.label: Microgliosis
nodes.description: Microglia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Microglia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Microglia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Microglia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: SADS
nodes.description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

nodes.label: GATOR1
nodes.description: The DEPDC5-containing GATOR1 complex is the GAP converting RagA/B-GTP to GDP. Inhibition is the amino-acid-off switch.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 含 DEPDC5 的 GATOR1 複合體是將 RagA/B-GTP 轉 GDP 的 GAP。抑制是胺基酸關閉開關。

nodes.label: World Health Organization
nodes.description: The African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control was coordinated by the World Health Organization, which partnered with endemic African countries and with Merck & Co. Inc as donor of Ivermectin. The community-directed treatment with ivermectin (CDTI) model it pioneered became the global template for neglected tropical disease control and is now proposed for equitable cancer prevention in low-resource settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control 由 World Health Organization 協調，與非洲流行國家及 Ivermectin 捐贈者 Merck & Co. Inc 合作。該計畫開創的社區導向 ivermectin 治療（CDTI）模式成為被忽略熱帶疾病防治的全球範本，現今也被提出用於低資源地區的癌症防治公平性。

nodes.label: Macrophage
nodes.description: Interferon-gamma is the classical M1 macrophage activator, inducing respiratory burst, MHC class II expression, and production of reactive oxygen species and nitric oxide in macrophages.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Interferon-gamma 是典型的 M1 macrophage 活化因子，誘導呼吸爆發、MHC 第二類分子表現，以及巨噬細胞產生活性氧與一氧化氮。

nodes.label: Epac1
nodes.description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

nodes.label: MDL-800
nodes.description: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

nodes.label: Pulmonary Fibrosis
nodes.description: Pirfenidone is approved for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, acting as an antifibrotic and anti-inflammatory agent. Despite this indication it showed no significant senolytic activity at 5 uM in the fisetin screen, so it is a senotherapeutic candidate rather than an established senolytic.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pirfenidone 獲核准用於治療 Pulmonary Fibrosis，作為抗纖維化與抗發炎藥物。儘管有此適應症，它在 fisetin 篩選試驗中於 5 µM 並未顯示顯著 senolytic 活性，因此屬於 senotherapeutic 候選，而非已確立的 senolytic。

nodes.label: PKCζ
nodes.description: PKCζ is an atypical protein kinase C isoform.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PKCζ 是非典型蛋白激酶 C 亞型。

nodes.label: Atg12
nodes.description: Atg12 is conjugated to Atg5 by Atg7, with Atg10 acting as the E2-like enzyme, and the resulting Atg5-Atg12 conjugate interacts noncovalently with Atg16. The Atg5-Atg12-Atg16 complex associates with phagophores but dissociates from completed autophagosomes, which is why Atg5-Atg12 is used as a specific marker of the autophagosome-precursor stage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg12 由 Atg7 接合到 Atg5，Atg10 扮演 E2 類酵素，所形成的 Atg5-Atg12 接合物再以非共價方式與 Atg16 交互作用。Atg5-Atg12-Atg16 複合體與吞噬膜相結合，卻從已完成的自噬體上解離，因此 Atg5-Atg12 被用作自噬體前驅階段的特異標記。

nodes.label: Fructosamine-3-kinase
nodes.description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) phosphorylates fructosamine/Amadori residues on proteins to Fructosamine-3-phosphate, which spontaneously decomposes — in the process releasing 3-deoxyglucosone — to regenerate undamaged protein and reverse early glycation intracellularly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fructosamine-3-kinase（FN3K）將蛋白上的 fructosamine／Amadori 殘基磷酸化為 Fructosamine-3-phosphate，後者自發分解（過程中釋出 3-deoxyglucosone），再生未受損的蛋白，在細胞內逆轉早期 glycation。

nodes.label: HP1alpha
nodes.description: SIRT6-mediated mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 recruits HP1α to package LINE-1 retrotransposons into heterochromatin, silencing their expression. Directionally, SIRT6/KAP1 sits upstream of HP1α tethering. This protects genome stability by containing mobile elements, and it explains how SIRT6 loss derepresses LINE-1. By maintaining heterochromatic silencing of retrotransposons, SIRT6 prevents the insertional mutations and genomic instability caused by active LINE-1 elements. The KAP1-HP1α axis is thus a critical effector of SIRT6's genome-protective function, and its disruption contributes to the instability seen in SIRT6-deficient cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 介導的 KAP1 單 ADP-核糖基化招募 HP1α 將 LINE-1 逆轉座子包裝成異染色質，沉默其表達。在方向性上，SIRT6/KAP1 位於 HP1α 拴繫的上游。這透過限制可動元件保護基因組穩定性，並解釋了 SIRT6 缺失如何解除 LINE-1 的抑制。透過維護逆轉座子的異染色質沉默，SIRT6 防止了活性 LINE-1 元件引起的插入突變和基因組不穩定性。KAP1-HP1α 軸線因此是 SIRT6 基因組保護功能的關鍵效應器，其破壞導致 SIRT6 缺陷細胞中所見的不穩定性。

nodes.label: Diamine Oxidase
nodes.description: Diamine Oxidase (DAO), also called histaminase, is the primary enzyme that breaks down Histamine from ingested food and is expressed mainly in the intestinal mucosa. Adequate DAO activity therefore protects against dietary histamine load.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diamine Oxidase（DAO，又稱 histaminase）是分解食物中 Histamine 的主要酵素，主要表現於腸道黏膜。足夠的 DAO 活性因此能防止飲食性 histamine 負荷造成不適。

nodes.label: USP9X
nodes.description: USP9X removes Mcl-1 polyubiquitin chains, blocking proteasomal degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: USP9X 移除 Mcl-1 多泛素鏈，阻斷蛋白酶體降解。

nodes.label: SAH
nodes.description: SAH (S-adenosylhomocysteine) is the hydrolysis product formed when SAM donates its methyl group, and it is a potent competitive inhibitor of nearly all methyltransferases. Accumulation of SAH globally suppresses methylation, including histone methylation, perturbing epigenetic homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAH（S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸）是 SAM 捐出甲基時形成的水解產物，是幾乎所有甲基轉移酶的強效競爭性抑制劑。SAH 累積會全面抑制甲基化（包括組蛋白甲基化），擾亂表觀遺傳恆定。

nodes.label: Chronic Kidney Disease
nodes.description: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD, diabetic nephropathy) is a progressive complication of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and a leading cause of Chronic Kidney Disease. It is characterized by glomerular and tubular injury driven by chronic hyperglycemia, inflammation and extracellular matrix remodeling, culminating in loss of renal function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diabetic Kidney Disease（DKD，糖尿病腎病）是 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 的進行性併發症，也是 Chronic Kidney Disease 的主要成因之一。其特徵為慢性 hyperglycemia、inflammation 與細胞外基質重塑所驅動的腎小球與腎小管損傷，最終導致腎功能喪失。

nodes.label: HTT
nodes.description: Huntington's disease is caused by expansion of a CAG repeat to 36 or more repeats in exon 1 of HTT, which inserts a polyglutamine tract into huntingtin's N-terminus. The resulting mutant protein misfolds and aggregates, and the disease is therefore defined by a single gene's repeat expansion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Huntington's disease 是由 HTT 外顯子 1 的 CAG 重複擴增至 36 次以上所造成，該擴增會在 huntingtin 的 N 端插入一段多麩醯胺酸序列。由此產生的突變蛋白錯誤摺疊並聚集，因此此疾病由單一基因的重複擴增所定義。

nodes.label: CxxC Motif
nodes.description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) contains the CxxC active-site motif (Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys, residues Cys32-Cys35), which forms the catalytic core of its oxidoreductase activity. The N-terminal Cys32 attacks substrate disulfides while Cys35 resolves the mixed disulfide.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 含有 CxxC 活性位點基序（Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys，殘基 Cys32-Cys35），構成其氧化還原酶活性的催化核心。N 端的 Cys32 攻擊受質雙硫鍵，而 Cys35 則解析混合雙硫鍵。

nodes.label: ATR
nodes.description: RPA-coated single-stranded DNA at stalled forks activates the ATR-CHK1 checkpoint. This is the canonical replication-stress sensor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 停滯叉上 RPA 包被的單股 DNA 活化 ATR-CHK1 檢查點。這是典型的複製壓力感受器。

nodes.label: MAVS
nodes.description: RIG-I (DDX58) is a cytosolic DExH-box RNA helicase pattern-recognition receptor that detects short double-stranded RNA with a 5'-triphosphate or 5'-diphosphate end. Ligand binding plus K63-linked polyubiquitination releases its N-terminal CARDs, which nucleate filaments that drive MAVS (IPS-1) oligomerisation on the mitochondrial outer membrane, MAMs and peroxisomes, converting RIG-I recognition into downstream signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RIG-I (DDX58) 是細胞質的 DExH-box RNA 解旋酶型模式辨識受體，可偵測帶 5′-三磷酸或 5′-二磷酸末端 的短雙股 RNA。配體結合加上 K63 連結的泛素化會釋出其 N 端 CARD，CARD 核化成絲狀體並驅動 MAVS (IPS-1) 在粒線體外膜、MAM 與過氧化體上聚集，將 RIG-I 的辨識轉為下游訊息傳遞。

nodes.label: GADD45
nodes.description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

nodes.label: necrosome
nodes.description: TNF-α binding to TNFR1 assembles complex I (RIPK1, TRADD, TRAF2, LUBAC, cIAP1, CYLD, NEMO). When NF-κB activation is suppressed, RIPK1 deubiquitinates and assembles complex IIa (ripoptosome) with FADD, TRADD, and pro-caspase-8 for apoptosis; with cIAP1 inhibited, complex IIb forms. Only when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited does RIPK1 recruit RIPK3 and MLKL into the necrosome — making TNF signaling a three-way fate decision in which the necrosome is the final, caspase-suppressed branch.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNF-α 與 TNFR1 結合會組裝 complex I（RIPK1、TRADD、TRAF2、LUBAC、cIAP1、CYLD、NEMO）。當 NF-κB 活化受抑制時，RIPK1 去泛素化並與 FADD、TRADD 及 pro-Caspase-8 組裝出 complex IIa（ripoptosome）以進行細胞凋亡；當 cIAP1 受抑制時則形成 complex IIb。只有當 caspase-8 缺席或受抑制時，RIPK1 才會招募 RIPK3 與 MLKL 組成 necrosome——使 TNF 訊號成為三向的命運決定，而 necrosome 是 caspase 受壓制後的最終分支。

nodes.label: 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate
nodes.description: GAPDH catalyzes the NAD+-dependent conversion of Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate to the high-energy glycolytic intermediate 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, generating NADH in the process. Because the step consumes NAD+, senescent cells with a lowered NAD+/NADH ratio form less 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, which curtails glycolytic ATP production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GAPDH 以 NAD+ 依賴的方式將 Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate 轉換成高能糖解中間產物 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate，並同時生成 NADH。由於此步驟需要 NAD+，NAD+/NADH 比值下降的衰老細胞生成的 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 較少，因而抑制糖解產 ATP。

nodes.label: KPNB1
nodes.description: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

nodes.label: DNAmGrimAge
nodes.description: DNAmGrimAge is a second-generation epigenetic clock trained to predict morbidity, mortality, and physiological decline rather than simply chronological age. It incorporates DNA methylation surrogates for plasma proteins and smoking exposure, producing a DNAm-based age estimate that is a robust predictor of lifespan and healthspan. As a stronger predictor of time-to-death than first-generation clocks such as the Horvath and Hannum clocks, GrimAge is widely used as an endpoint in aging and rejuvenation studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNAmGrimAge 是第二代表觀遺傳時鐘，經過訓練可以預測發病率、死亡率和生理衰退，而不僅僅是實際年齡。它結合了血漿蛋白和吸煙暴露的 DNA 甲基化替代物，產生基於 DNAm 的年齡估計，這是壽命和健康壽命的強大預測因子。作為比第一代時鐘（例如 Horvath 和 Hannum 時鐘）更強大的死亡時間預測器，GrimAge 被廣泛用作衰老和復興研究的終點。

nodes.label: Phosphorylation
nodes.description: Phosphorylation is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

nodes.label: Respiratory Burst
nodes.description: The Respiratory Burst is the rapid, coordinated release of Reactive Oxygen Species — superoxide and Hydrogen Peroxide — by cells such as Neutrophils and macrophages as part of the innate immune response, and it is one of the major endogenous sources of Reactive Oxygen Species during inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Respiratory Burst 是 Neutrophils 與巨噬細胞等細胞在先天免疫反應中快速大量釋放 Reactive Oxygen Species（超氧陰離子與 Hydrogen Peroxide）的過程，也是發炎時 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要內源性來源之一。

nodes.label: Viral Replication
nodes.description: PARP-mediated MARylation of viral proteins is required for inhibition of viral replication. As the innate immune response activates during infection, extensive DNA Damage and IFN-induced mono-ADP-ribosylation activate PARPs; the antiviral effect is then reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose de-MARylation activity is required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藉由 PARP 媒介對病毒蛋白的 MARylation 是抑制 viral replication 所必需的。感染期間先天免疫反應活化時，廣泛的 DNA Damage 與 IFN 誘發的單 ADP 核糖基化活化 PARP；隨後此抗病毒效應會被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-核糖基水解酶 macrodomain 反轉，其去 MARylation 活性為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。

nodes.label: MEK
nodes.description: RAF kinases phosphorylate MEK1/2 once recruited to the membrane by RAS-GTP, and MEK in turn activates ERK1/2. RAF/MEK is also the axis behind RAS-RAF-MEK-dependent oxidative cell death described by Yagoda et al. involving VDAC, the iron-dependent death that preceded the formal naming of ferroptosis, and Raf/MEK is a ferroptosis-modulating route in hepatocellular carcinoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RAF 激酶在被 RAS-GTP 招募至膜上後磷酸化 MEK1/2，MEK 再活化 ERK1/2。RAF/MEK 也是 Yagoda 等人所描述的 RAS-RAF-MEK 依賴性氧化細胞死亡（涉及 VDAC）的軸線，那種鐵依賴性死亡早於 ferroptosis 的正式命名；而在肝細胞癌中，Raf/MEK 是調節 ferroptosis 的路徑。

nodes.label: CDKN1C
nodes.description: CDKN1C (p57) is expressed from the maternal allele only under KvDMR1 imprinting control. This parent-of-origin regulation links cell-cycle control to epigenetic inheritance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDKN1C（p57）僅在 KvDMR1 銘印控制下從母系等位基因表現。此親源調節將細胞週期控制連結到表觀遺傳繼承。

nodes.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
nodes.description: Hydroxychloroquine is first-line systemic therapy for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: it reduces flare frequency and disease activity, and mechanistically it interferes with TLR7/9-dependent nucleic acid sensing that drives the type I interferon loop of the disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus 的一線全身性治療：可降低發作頻率與疾病活性，機制上則是干擾 TLR7/9 依賴的核酸辨識，而此路徑正是該病第一型干擾素迴圈的驅動力。

nodes.label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
nodes.description: Alpha-synuclein is biochemically converted into Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Alpha-synuclein acts as the substrate and Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation。從機制上講，Alpha-synuclein 作為底物，Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

nodes.label: Skeletal Muscle
nodes.description: Approximately 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, where it exists partly as free creatine and partly as creatine phosphate. The muscle creatine pool is maintained by both endogenous synthesis and dietary intake, and it is depleted by high-intensity activity and resynthesized during recovery. Muscle total creatine concentrations can be increased by supplementation, typically by 10-20 percent, and this elevated store extends the time for which high-intensity exercise can be sustained. The predominance of skeletal muscle as a creatine depot explains why most creatine research has focused on muscle function, strength, and performance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中一部分以游離肌酸形式存在，一部分以磷酸肌酸形式存在。肌肉肌酸池由內源性合成與飲食攝取共同維持，會因高強度活動而耗竭，並在恢復期間重新合成。補充可使肌肉總肌酸濃度增加，通常為 10–20%，而提高的儲備可延長高強度運動得以持續的時間。骨骼肌作為肌酸儲存庫的主導地位，說明了為何大多數肌酸研究都聚焦於肌肉功能、肌力與運動表現。

nodes.label: ICAD
nodes.description: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. ICAD is the inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase that, upon caspase-3 cleavage, releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 分裂 ICAD。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 ICAD 是 caspase 活化的 DNase 抑制劑，在 caspase-3 裂解時，釋放 CAD 以片段化核 DNA。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 ICAD 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

nodes.label: SARS-CoV-2
nodes.description: SARS-CoV-2 is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus of the Coronaviridae family (genus Betacoronavirus) and the causative agent of COVID-19, a respiratory disease that emerged as a global pandemic in 2020. It enters cells when its club-shaped spike protein binds the host angiotensin-converting enzyme 2, with spike priming by host proteases; after membrane fusion the viral RNA is released into the cytosol, translated and replicated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 是冠狀病毒科（Betacoronavirus 屬）的正股單股 RNA 病毒，也是 COVID-19 的致病因子——一種於 2020 年成為全球大流行的呼吸道疾病。當其棒狀的棘蛋白與宿主的血管張力素轉換酶 2 結合時病毒進入細胞，棘蛋白需先經宿主蛋白酶切割加工；膜融合後病毒 RNA 釋放至細胞質並被轉譯、複製。

nodes.label: TGF-β Signaling
nodes.description: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。

nodes.label: Cell Cycle
nodes.description: Cell Division, in which a parent cell yields two or more daughter cells, is tightly governed by the Cell Cycle, with checkpoints ensuring accuracy of DNA replication and chromosome segregation. Key regulators include cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb/E2F, p53, and checkpoint kinases; dysregulated division is a hallmark of cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cell Division（細胞分裂，親代細胞產生兩個或更多子細胞）受到 Cell Cycle 的嚴密調控，並由檢查點確保 DNA 複製與染色體分離的正確性。主要調控因子包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb/E2F、p53 與檢查點激酶；失調的細胞分裂是 cancer 的特徵之一。

nodes.label: PML
nodes.description: PML-IV overexpression is sufficient to induce p53-dependent premature senescence, and loss of PML accelerates tumorigenesis, establishing PML as a tumor suppressor. Directionally, PML sits upstream of senescence. This process engages SIRT1 and p53 at PML nuclear bodies, and it contextualizes SIRT1's role in proliferation arrest. By activating p53-dependent senescence, PML restricts uncontrolled proliferation and prevents tumor formation. The PML-SIRT1-p53 axis illustrates how a nuclear body can coordinate the decision between senescence, apoptosis, and proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PML-IV 過度表達足以誘導 p53 依賴性過早衰老，而 PML 的缺失加速腫瘤發生，確立 PML 為腫瘤抑制因子。在方向性上，PML 位於衰老的上游。此過程在 PML 核體中涉及 SIRT1 和 p53，並將 SIRT1 在增殖停滯中的角色置於背景中。透過活化 p53 依賴性衰老，PML 限制不受控制的增殖並防止腫瘤形成。PML-SIRT1-p53 軸線說明了核體如何協調衰老、凋亡和增殖之間的決定。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Function
nodes.description: Mitochondrial function is the integrated physiological capacity of mitochondria to perform oxidative phosphorylation (ATP production via the electron transport chain), metabolite and ion homeostasis, redox balance, dynamics, quality control and stress signalling. Respiratory capacity is the primary readout of that function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial function 是粒線體執行 oxidative phosphorylation（經電子傳遞鏈產生 ATP）、代謝物與離子恆定、氧化還原平衡、動態、品質管制與壓力訊號的整合生理能力。呼吸能力是衡量此功能的 主要讀值。

nodes.label: Dextromethorphan
nodes.description: The most important safety concern for dextromethorphan is its interaction with serotonergic drugs. Combined use with a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (such as Methylene blue, phenelzine, or selegiline) can precipitate serotonin syndrome — a life-threatening condition of hyperthermia, clonus, agitation, and autonomic instability — so the combination is contraindicated.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dextromethorphan 最重要的安全問題是與血清素活化藥物的交互作用。與 Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor（如 Methylene blue、phenelzine、selegiline）併用可能誘發 serotonin syndrome — 一種高熱、陣攣、焦躁與自律神經不穩定的致命狀況，因此此組合屬禁忌。

nodes.label: NMNAT
nodes.description: NMNAT (nicotinamide mononucleotide adenylyltransferase) catalyzes the final committed step in NAD+ biosynthesis, transferring an AMP moiety from ATP onto NMN (or NaMN) to yield NAD+ (or NAAD). All three mammalian NAD+ routes — de novo from Tryptophan, the NAMPT-driven salvage pathway, and the Preiss-Handler pathway — converge on this single NMNAT-catalyzed step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMNAT（nicotinamide mononucleotide adenylyltransferase）催化 NAD+ 生合成的最後定案步驟，將 ATP 的 AMP 基團轉移至 NMN（或 NaMN）上以生成 NAD+（或 NAAD）。哺乳類三條 NAD+ 途徑——由 Tryptophan 起始的 de novo 合成、NAMPT 驅動的 salvage pathway，以及 Preiss-Handler pathway——全都收斂於這一個 NMNAT 催化的步驟。

nodes.label: Mice
nodes.description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

nodes.label: Heat Shock Proteins
nodes.description: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

nodes.label: narcolepsy
nodes.description: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological sleep disorder of excessive daytime sleepiness with disrupted nocturnal sleep. Classification anchors it in sleep medicine rather than psychiatry.
nodes.description_zh_TW: narcolepsy 是以日間過度嗜睡與夜間睡眠中斷為特徵的慢性神經性睡眠疾患。歸類將它錨定於睡眠醫學而非精神科。

nodes.label: LipA
nodes.description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

nodes.label: PGP-2
nodes.description: PGP-2 is a C. elegans ABC (ATP-binding cassette) transporter localized to lysosome-related organelle (LRO) membranes that is essential for their biogenesis; these LROs — the gut granules — serve as fat storage sites. Its absence results in loss of gut granules and altered lipid storage, and it co-localizes with the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PGP-2 是 C. elegans 的 ABC（ATP 結合盒）轉運蛋白，定位於溶酶體相關胞器（LRO）膜上，對其生成不可或缺；這些 LRO（即腸顆粒）是脂肪儲存場所。PGP-2 缺失會造成腸顆粒消失與脂質儲存改變，且它與溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 共定位。

nodes.label: Vasoconstriction
nodes.description: Basal endothelial Nitric Oxide (NO) opposes vasoconstriction via the NO → Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase → cGMP relaxation pathway. When this cascade is blocked — as with methylene blue in vasoplegia — net vasoconstriction and a rise in blood pressure result.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基礎狀態下的內皮 Nitric Oxide（NO）經由 NO → Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase → cGMP 的放鬆途徑對抗 vasoconstriction。當此級聯被阻斷（例如 vasoplegia 中使用 methylene blue），便會造成淨 vasoconstriction 與血壓上升。

nodes.label: Messenger RNA
nodes.description: Messenger RNA is a single-stranded RNA molecule transcribed from DNA by RNA polymerase II that carries the coding sequence for a protein, serving as the template for translation at the ribosome. In this way mRNA is the central effector that links genotype to phenotype and is the final substrate on which gene expression acts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Messenger RNA 是由 RNA 聚合酶 II 從 DNA 轉錄出的單股 RNA 分子，攜帶蛋白質的編碼序列，並作為核糖體上轉譯的模板。mRNA 因此是連接基因型與表型的核心效應分子，也是基因表現最終作用其上的作用對象。

nodes.label: 5-Fluorouracil
nodes.description: Thymidylate synthase is the principal target of 5-fluorouracil: its active metabolite FdUMP forms a lethal ternary complex with the enzyme and folate, depleting thymidine pools, triggering DNA repair stress and apoptosis in dividing cells. Fenbendazole overcomes 5-FU-resistant colorectal cells by interfering with glycolysis rather than inhibiting thymidylate synthase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thymidylate synthase 是 5-Fluorouracil 的主要標的：其活性代謝物 FdUMP 與酵素及葉酸形成致死的三元複合體，耗竭胸腺嘧啶核苷池，在分裂細胞中引發 DNA 修復壓力與細胞凋亡。Fenbendazole 對抗 5-FU 抗藥性的結直腸癌細胞，是藉由干擾糖解作用而非抑制 thymidylate synthase。

nodes.label: Pro-inflammatory Cytokines
nodes.description: By deacetylating NF-κB, SIRT1 reduces transcription of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, dampening the inflammatory transcriptome. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB leads to lower cytokine output. This is mechanistically important in atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration, and metabolic inflammation, where sustained cytokine signaling drives tissue damage. Resveratrol leverages this axis to curb chronic low-grade inflammation, and SIRT6, SIRT2, and SIRT7 also restrain NF-κB through distinct mechanisms, making suppression of NF-κB-dependent cytokine production one of the most consistent anti-inflammatory actions across the sirtuin family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 NF-κB，SIRT1 降低 TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 的轉錄，抑制發炎轉錄組。在方向性上，SIRT1 對 NF-κB 的去乙醯化導致較低的細胞因子輸出。這在動脈粥樣硬化、神經退行性疾病和代謝性發炎中具有機制重要性，在這些疾病中持續的細胞因子信號驅動組織損傷。白藜蘆醇利用此軸來抑制慢性低度發炎，SIRT6、SIRT2 和 SIRT7 也通過不同機制限制 NF-κB，使抑制 NF-κB 依賴性細胞因子產生成為 sirtuin 家族中最一致的抗發炎作用之一。

nodes.label: CeTOR
nodes.description: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

nodes.label: Proteinuria
nodes.description: Long-term consumption of dietary advanced glycation end products (AGEs) in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. Chronic dietary AGE excess reproduces in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet to the kidney.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 大鼠長期攝取膳食 advanced glycation end products（AGEs）會造成劑量依賴性的 proteinuria 增加，長期下來可能誘發腎臟損傷。慢性膳食 AGE 過量在動物身上重現了 aging 與 diabetes 中部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食對腎臟的毒性。

nodes.label: Vincristine
nodes.description: Vincristine is the microtubule-targeting constituent of R-CHOP, a vinca alkaloid that disrupts the mitotic spindle in dividing cells. Its inclusion links the regimen to the same microtubule-disrupting logic exploited by microtubule-targeted repurposing candidates such as Fenbendazole.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vincristine 是 R-CHOP 中作用於微管的成分，屬於 vinca alkaloid 類，能破壞分裂細胞的有絲分裂紡錘體。其納入使該方案與 Fenbendazole 等作用於微管再定位候選藥所利用的同一套微管破壞邏輯相連結。

nodes.label: PtdIns3P
nodes.description: PIKfyve phosphorylates PtdIns3P at the 5-position to produce PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes. This conversion is essential for endosomal maturation and for resolving autophagic cargo into the lysosome, and the early-endosome switch from Rab5/PtdIns3P to Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2 defines the early-to-late endosome transition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 將 PtdIns3P 在 5 位磷酸化，生成內溶體膜上的 PtdIns(3,5)P2。此轉換對內體成熟與將自噬貨物送往溶酶體至關重要，而早期內體由 Rab5/PtdIns3P 轉換為 Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2，正定義了早到晚期內體的轉變。

nodes.label: Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
nodes.description: MSCs contribute to repair via trophic and differentiation effects. Contribution covers paracrine plus lineage mechanisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MSC 經由營養與分化效應貢獻修復。貢獻涵蓋旁分泌加譜系機制。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Modifiers
nodes.description: 5-Azacytidine is classified as an epigenetic modifier, specifically a DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor, and it is among the first epigenetic drugs used in the clinic. As a cytidine analog, it is incorporated into DNA during replication, where it covalently traps DNMT enzymes and causes passive loss of DNA methylation, reactivating silenced genes such as tumor suppressors. This mechanism underlies its use in myelodysplastic syndromes and leukemia and its application in research on gene silencing, development, and aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine被歸類為表觀遺傳修飾劑，特別是DNA甲基轉移酶（DNMT）抑制劑，是第一批應用於臨床的表觀遺傳藥物之一。作為胞苷類似物，它在複製過程中摻入 DNA，共價捕獲 DNMT 酶並導致 DNA 甲基化被動丟失，從而重新激活腫瘤抑制基因等沉默基因。這種機制是其在骨髓增生異常綜合症和白血病中的應用及其在基因沉默、發育和老化研究中的應用的基礎。

nodes.label: CobB
nodes.description: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

nodes.label: Ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome
nodes.description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

nodes.label: Genomic Imprinting
nodes.description: DNMT1 is the maintenance methyltransferase that copies parental-origin methylation at imprinting control regions through mitosis, preserving Genomic Imprinting marks in every daughter cell.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNMT1 是維持型甲基轉移酶，透過有絲分裂複製親代來源在 imprinting 控制區（ICR）的甲基化，在每個子細胞中保存 Genomic Imprinting（基因組印記）標記。

nodes.label: Kidney Fibrosis
nodes.description: Kidney fibrosis — pathological extracellular matrix accumulation in the renal tubulointerstitium and glomeruli with myofibroblast activation driven by TGF-beta, oxidative stress and metabolic dysfunction — is the final common pathway of nearly all progressive kidney diseases and the key determinant of progression to end-stage kidney disease. Fibrosis replaces functional nephrons with scar tissue, progressively losing filtration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腎臟纖維化——腎小管間質與腎小球中細胞外基質的病理性累積，伴隨由 TGF-beta、氧化壓力與代謝失調所驅動的肌成纖維細胞活化——是幾乎所有進展性腎病的最終共同途徑，也是進展至末期腎病的關鍵決定因子。纖維化以疤痕組織取代具功能的腎元，使濾過功能逐步喪失。

nodes.label: Ionizing Radiation
nodes.description: Ionizing radiation activates ATM kinase by causing DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM, which then phosphorylates Chk2, p53, and BRCA1 to coordinate the damage response. This initiates cell-cycle arrest and repair. The directionality is DNA break to kinase signaling cascade. A caveat is that ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. ATM is considered the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response to double-strand breaks, integrating cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis decisions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過引起 DNA 雙股斷裂來活化 ATM kinase，從而募集 ATM 並使其自磷酸化，然後 ATM 磷酸化 Chk2、p53 和 BRCA1 以協調損傷反應。這啟動了細胞週期停滯和修復。方向性是 DNA 斷裂至激酶訊號級聯。需要注意的是，ATM 也會對 oxidative stress 和複製壓力做出反應，因此它的活化並不是唯一由輻射驅動的。 ATM 被認為是對雙股斷裂的 DNA 損傷反應的主協調員，整合了細胞週期停滯、修復和 apoptosis 決策。

nodes.label: slow COMT
nodes.description: In slow COMT variants, catechol clearance is reduced so endogenous catecholamines may accumulate, enhancing stress reactivity. Exogenous catechols can further inhibit the already sluggish enzyme and add methyl-group demand on the methylation cycle. This underlies the stress sensitivity and supplement intolerance often reported by slow COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在緩慢的 COMT 變異中，兒茶酚清除減少，因此內源性 catecholamines 可能累積，增強壓力反應性。外源性兒茶酚可進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶，並增加對 methylation cycle 的甲基需求。這正是緩慢 COMT 個體常回報的壓力敏感性和補充劑不耐受的基礎。

nodes.label: Cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: Keshan disease is an endemic nutritional cardiomyopathy by definition. Classification places the selenium-deficiency disorder among myocardial diseases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Keshan disease 依定義是地方性營養性心肌病。歸類將硒缺乏症置於心肌疾病之中。

nodes.label: Tangier disease
nodes.description: Tangier disease is a rare autosomal-recessive disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ABCA1, the cholesterol transporter central to cholesterol efflux. The resulting block of cholesterol transfer to apolipoprotein A-I produces the hallmark extremely low HDL and tissue cholesteryl ester accumulation, with enlarged orange tonsils and peripheral neuropathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tangier disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 cholesterol efflux 核心運輸蛋白 ABCA1 的失功能突變所造成。Cholesterol 無法轉移給 apolipoprotein A-I，因而產生典型的 HDL 極低與組織膽固醇酯堆積，並出現扁桃體橘黃色增大與周邊神經病變。

nodes.label: ADP-ribose
nodes.description: Free ADP-ribose released by PARG/ARH3 hydrolysis of PAR binds the NUDT9-homology domain of TRPM2 and opens the channel to Ca2+, linking PARP1 hyperactivation in Parthanatos to calcium influx and downstream Calpain and mitochondrial permeability transition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 PARG/ARH3 水解 PAR 釋出的游離 ADP-ribose 會結合 TRPM2 的 NUDT9 同源結構域並開啟通道讓 Ca2+ 通過，將 Parthanatos 中的 PARP1 過度活化連結到鈣離子流入及下游的 Calpain 與粒線體通透性轉換。

nodes.label: Indole-3-propionic acid
nodes.description: Clostridium sporogenes is an anaerobic, spore-forming gut commensal and the best-characterized producer of Indole-3-propionic acid, reducing Tryptophan through indole-pyruvate to indole-3-lactate and then IPA. IPA is a circulating radical-scavenging metabolite acting on host Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Pregnane X Receptor signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Clostridium sporogenes 是厭氧、能形成芽孢的腸道共生菌，也是 Indole-3-propionic acid 最具表征的產生菌，經由 indole-pyruvate 將 Tryptophan 還原為 indole-3-lactate 再生成 IPA。IPA 是循環中的自由基清除代謝物，作用於宿主 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 與 Pregnane X Receptor 的訊息傳遞。

nodes.label: Rifampicin
nodes.description: Rifampicin activates the pregnane X receptor (PXR) in the liver, upregulating cytochrome P450 enzymes including CYP3A4 together with conjugating and transporting enzymes. Increased activity of these metabolic enzymes shortens the half-life and systemic exposure of co-administered drugs, making rifampicin a model perpetrator of drug-drug interactions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rifampicin 在肝臟活化 pregnane X receptor（PXR），上调細胞色素 P450 酵素（包含 CYP3A4）以及接合與運輸酵素。這些代謝酵素活性上升會縮短併用藥物的半衰期並降低全身暴露量，使 rifampicin 成為典型的藥物交互作用元凶。

nodes.label: acute promyelocytic leukaemia
nodes.description: APL is the M3 subtype of acute myeloid leukemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APL 是急性骨髓性白血病的 M3 亞型。

nodes.label: Adenosine Triphosphate
nodes.description: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

nodes.label: Warfarin
nodes.description: Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant that inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), blocking the recycling of oxidized vitamin K to its reduced form and thereby preventing the gamma-carboxylation and activation of clotting factors II, VII, IX and X along with the regulatory proteins protein C and protein S.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Warfarin 是一种口服抗凝血劑，抑制維生素 K 環氧化物還原酶（VKORC1），阻斷氧化態維生素 K 還原為其還原態，因而阻止凝血因子 II、VII、IX、X 以及調節性蛋白質 protein C 與 protein S 的 γ-羧化與活化。

nodes.label: Enzalutamide
nodes.description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

nodes.label: Biphasic Dose Response
nodes.description: Varying hypoxia intensity or duration produces inverted-U or J-shaped responses in antioxidant enzymes, e.g. scallop SOD rising 15-50% at 12 h then falling 40-60% over days. Pacific white shrimp SOD and GPX show similar inverted-U curves, meeting quantitative hormesis criteria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 改變 Hypoxia 強度或持續時間會在抗氧化酵素中產生倒 U 形或 J 形反應，例如扇貝 SOD 在 12 小時上升 15-50%，數天後下降 40-60%。太平洋白蝦的 SOD 與 GPX 也呈現類似倒 U 形曲線，符合定量的 hormesis 標準。

nodes.label: Thymidine
nodes.description: Excess thymidine induces potent replication stress via dNTP pool imbalance. Imbalance stalls forks as effectively as polymerase inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過量 thymidine 經由 dNTP 池失衡誘發強效複製壓力。失衡使複製叉停滯，效力等同聚合酶抑制。

nodes.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
nodes.description: Emphysema is a subtype of COPD defined by permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles with destruction of their walls and no obvious fibrosis. Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor, with occupational dusts, air pollution and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency also predisposing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肺氣腫是 COPD 的一個型態，其定義為終末細支氣管遠端氣腔永久性擴大且其壁被破壞，並無明顯纖維化。吸菸是主要危險因子，職業粉塵、空氣污染與 alpha-1 antitrypsin 缺乏亦為易感因素。

nodes.label: Lymphatic Filariasis
nodes.description: Brugia malayi is a filarial nematode and one of the three causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, alongside Wuchereria bancrofti and Brugia timori. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels and lymph nodes, viviparous females release sheathed microfilariae with nocturnal periodicity into the bloodstream, and chronic infection produces lymphangitis, lymphedema, elephantiasis and tropical pulmonary eosinophilia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brugia malayi 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia timori 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大致病原之一。成蟲寄生於淋巴管與淋巴結，胎生的雌蟲釋出具鞘微絲蟲並呈夜間週期性出現在血流中；慢性感染會造成淋巴管炎、淋巴水腫、象皮病與熱帶肺嗜酸性粒細胞症。

nodes.label: Liver
nodes.description: The urea cycle is a liver mitochondrial and cytosolic pathway that converts toxic ammonia from amino-acid catabolism into urea for excretion via five enzymes, notably carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1, ornithine transcarbamylase, argininosuccinate synthetase, argininosuccinate lyase and arginase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 尿素循環是肝臟中粒線體與胞質的途徑，由五種酵素（尤其是 carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1、ornithine transcarbamylase、argininosuccinate synthetase、argininosuccinate lyase 與 arginase）將胺基酸分解產生的有毒氨轉為尿素以排出體外。

nodes.label: Cell-to-Cell Fusion-Induced Senescence
nodes.description: CFIS produces a stable senescent phenotype withdrawn from the cycle. Classification places fusion arrest in the senescence family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CFIS 產生退出週期的穩定衰老表型。歸類將融合停滯置於衰老家族。

nodes.label: Vitamin B6
nodes.description: Its active form, pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP), is a cofactor for over 140 enzymatic reactions. As cofactor of Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase it enables synthesis of Dopamine, Serotonin and Norepinephrine; it is also required for homocysteine metabolism via cystathionine beta-synthase and serves as a cofactor for serine hydroxymethyltransferase in the methylation cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 其活性形式 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate（PLP）是超過 140 種酵素反應的輔因子。作為 Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的輔因子，它使 Dopamine、Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine 的合成得以進行；同時也透過 cystathionine beta-synthase 參與 homocysteine 代謝，並在 methylation 循環中作為 serine hydroxymethyltransferase 的輔因子。

nodes.label: Macular Degeneration
nodes.description: Age is the dominant risk factor for macular degenerative blindness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 年齡是黃斑部退化失明的主要危險因子。

nodes.label: Calpain
nodes.description: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

nodes.label: Caspase-7
nodes.description: Caspase-7 (CMH-1, ICE-LAP3) is an executioner (effector) protease, synthesized as an inactive procaspase-7 with p20 and p10 catalytic subunits. It is functionally redundant with Caspase-3 but has distinct substrate preferences and upstream regulation, playing a non-redundant role in endoplasmic reticulum stress and certain tissue contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-7（CMH-1、ICE-LAP3）是執行者（效應）蛋白酶，以含 p20 與 p10 催化次單元的不活化 procaspase-7 形式合成。它與 Caspase-3 功能冗餘，但具有不同的受質偏好與上游調控，並在內質網壓力與特定組織情境中扮演不可替代的角色。

nodes.label: Lipotoxicity
nodes.description: Lipotoxicity is cellular and tissue injury arising when lipid intermediates accumulate ectopically in non-adipose tissues. Excess fatty-acid delivery or incomplete oxidation produces diacylglycerol, ceramides and long-chain acyl-CoAs that activate protein kinase C and mTOR and inhibit insulin signalling, making lipotoxicity a key mechanism linking obesity and ectopic fat to insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lipotoxicity 是脂質中間產物在非脂肪組織異位累積所造成的細胞與組織損傷。過量脂肪酸輸送或氧化不完全會產生 diacylglycerol、ceramides 與長鏈 acyl-CoA，活化 protein kinase C 與 mTOR 並抑制胰島素訊號，因此 lipotoxicity 是連結肥胖、異位脂肪與胰島素阻抗及第二型糖尿病的關鍵機制。

nodes.label: APP
nodes.description: APP is a type I transmembrane glycoprotein whose sequential proteolysis generates the Amyloid Beta Peptide. In the amyloidogenic pathway, Beta-Secretase 1 cleaves full-length APP at Asp671 on endosomal luminal surfaces to release sAPPβ and the membrane-tethered CTFβ/C99, which the Gamma-Secretase complex then cleaves intramembranously to liberate Aβ40 or the more aggregation-prone Aβ42. The Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio is a critical determinant of Amyloid Plaque formation in Alzheimer's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APP 是第一型跨膜醣蛋白，其依序的蛋白水解會產生 Amyloid Beta Peptide。在類澱粉樣路徑中，Beta-Secretase 1 在內體腔面切割 Asp671 位置的完整長度 APP，釋出 sAPPβ 與膜錨定的 CTFβ/C99，隨後由 Gamma-Secretase 複合體在膜內切割，釋放 Aβ40 或更易聚集的 Aβ42。Aβ42/Aβ40 比例是 Alzheimer's Disease 中 Amyloid Plaque 形成的關鍵決定因素。

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide Synthase
nodes.description: L-arginine is converted by nitric oxide synthase in a two-step monooxygenase reaction requiring NADPH, FAD, FMN, tetrahydrobiopterin, and heme. The enzyme first forms N-hydroxyarginine and then releases NO and citrulline. The directionality is enzyme-catalyzed oxidation of arginine to NO. A caveat is that uncoupled NOS, lacking BH4 or arginine, diverts the reaction to superoxide instead of NO. When BH4 or L-arginine is limiting, NOS becomes uncoupled and produces superoxide instead of NO, so substrate availability also shapes the enzyme's redox output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: L-arginine 在需要 NADPH、FAD、FMN、tetrahydrobiopterin 和血紅素的兩步驟單加氧酶反應中由 nitric oxide synthase 轉化。此酵素首先形成 N-羥基精氨酸，然後釋放 NO 和瓜氨酸。方向性是酵素催化精胺酸氧化成NO。需要注意的是，未偶聯的 NOS，缺乏 BH4 或精氨酸，會將反應轉向超氧化物而不是 NO。當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，NOS 會解偶聯並產生超氧化物而不是 NO，因此底物可用性也會影響酵素的氧化還原輸出。

nodes.label: Major Histocompatibility Complex
nodes.description: The T Cell Receptor recognizes antigenic peptides only in the context of MHC molecules: TCR complementarity-determining regions engage peptide-MHC, Lck then phosphorylates CD3 ITAMs, and ZAP-70 with NF-AT, AP-1 and NF-κB downstream drive proliferation, cytokine production and effector differentiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: T Cell Receptor 只能在 MHC 分子的脈絡中辨識抗原胜肽：TCR 的互補決定區與胜肽-MHC 結合後，Lck 磷酸化 CD3 的 ITAM，接著 ZAP-70 與下游的 NF-AT、AP-1、NF-κB 驅動增殖、細胞激素生成與效應分化。

nodes.label: Satellite Cells
nodes.description: Muscle stem cells and satellite cells name the same Pax7+ population positionally. Single alias pair kept; mirror dropped on dedup.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌肉幹細胞與衛星細胞按位置命名同一 Pax7+ 群體。僅保留單一別名對；鏡像在去重中捨棄。

nodes.label: GM-CSF
nodes.description: GM-CSF activates the ERK2 pathway, which phosphorylates BAX at Thr167. This creates a recognition motif for Pin1, which locks BAX in an inactive state, preventing its mitochondrial translocation and protecting cells such as eosinophils from apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 活化 ERK2 路徑，使 BAX 在 Thr167 被磷酸化。這形成 Pin1 的辨識基序，讓 Pin1 將 BAX 鎖定在不活化狀態，阻止其轉位至粒線體，保護嗜酸性球等細胞免於 apoptosis。

nodes.label: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption
nodes.description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

nodes.label: PARP inhibitors
nodes.description: PARP inhibitors exploit synthetic lethality: in cells deficient in BRCA1 or BRCA2 the loss of PARP1-mediated repair eliminates the last major break-fixing pathway, so olaparib, rucaparib, niraparib and talazoparib cause lethal double-strand break accumulation selectively in BRCA-mutant tumors. Talazoparib's potent PARP-trapping activity adds cytotoxicity but also a distinct toxicity profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARP 抑制劑利用合成致死：在 BRCA1 或 BRCA2 缺陷的細胞中，失去 PARP1 介導的修復會剝除最後一條主要的斷裂修復途徑，因此 olaparib、rucaparib、niraparib 與 talazoparib 會選擇性地在 BRCA 突變腫瘤中造成致命的雙股斷裂累積。Talazoparib 強大的 PARP 捕捉活性增加了細胞毒性，也帶來不同的毒性輪廓。

nodes.label: TNFR1
nodes.description: TNFα binding to TNFR1 nucleates Complex I (TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK) for NF-κB survival signaling; when NF-κB output is blocked and caspase-8 inhibited the same receptor licenses the necrosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNFα 結合 TNFR1 組裝 Complex I（TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK）啟動 NF-κB 生存訊號；當 NF-κB 受阻且 caspase-8 被抑制時，同一受體轉而准許 necrosome 形成。

nodes.label: Cytochrome b5 reductase
nodes.description: Cytochrome b5 reductase, also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, is the enzyme that returns spontaneously formed methemoglobin (normally under 1-2% of total hemoglobin) to its functional ferrous Fe2+ state. By keeping hemoglobin in the ferrous state, this enzyme is what makes hemoglobin able to carry oxygen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase（又稱 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase）是將自發形成的 methemoglobin（正常情況下佔總 hemoglobin 的 1–2% 以下）還原回具功能的 Fe2+ 狀態的酵素。藉由讓 hemoglobin 維持於 ferrous 狀態，此酵素使 hemoglobin 能夠攜帶氧氣。

nodes.label: Alpha-tocopherol
nodes.description: Alpha-tocopherol is the 5,7,8-trimethyl vitamer of Tocopherols and the reference form for vitamin E activity, supplying about 90% of plasma vitamin E. Its selective retention is kinetic rather than nutritional: alpha-tocopherol transfer protein binds the alpha form and resecretes it in VLDL while other vitamers are preferentially omega-hydroxylated by CYP4F2 and excreted in bile. Because the more highly methylated ring raises electron density on the phenolic oxygen and speeds H-atom transfer to a lipid peroxyl radical, alpha-tocopherol is both the most potent radical trap and the best alpha-TTP ligand.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-tocopherol 是 Tocopherols 中 5,7,8-三甲基的 vitamer，也是 vitamin E 活性的參考形式，約供應血漿中 90% 的 vitamin E。其選擇性保留是動力學而非營養學現象：alpha-tocopherol transfer protein 專一結合 alpha 型並以 VLDL 重新分泌，其他 vitamer 則主要被 CYP4F2 ω-羥化後經膽汁排出。由於環上甲基化程度越高，酚羥基氧的電子密度越大、對脂質過氧自由基的氫原子轉移越快，alpha-tocopherol 既是最強的自由基捕捉者，也是最好的 alpha-TTP 配體。

nodes.label: FUNDC1
nodes.description: Activating FUNDC1-mediated autophagy clears damaged mitochondria, significantly reducing neuronal apoptosis and infarct volume after ischemia/hypoxia-reperfusion injury. The converse is also true: FUNDC1 knockout significantly worsens neural damage, making the hypoxia-inducible FUNDC1 axis a neuroprotective target in stroke and reperfusion injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 活化 FUNDC1 介導的自噬可清除受損粒線體，在缺血／缺氧再灌 injury 後顯著降低神經元 apoptosis 與梗死體積。反之亦然：FUNDC1 敲除會顯著加重神經損傷，使缺氧誘導的 FUNDC1 軸成為中風與再灌損傷中的神經保護標的。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Histone Methylation
nodes.description: Histone Methylation is a Histone Modification in which methyl groups are added to lysine or arginine residues on histone tails. Unlike acetylation it does not change histone charge; instead it creates docking sites for 'reader' proteins, and its transcriptional consequence depends on the residue and the number of methyl groups (mono-, di-, tri-methylation).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone Methylation 是一類 Histone Modification，將甲基加到組蛋白尾端的離胺酸或精胺酸殘基上。與乙醯化不同，它不改變組蛋白的電荷，而是創造讓「讀取者」蛋白質停靠的位點；其對轉錄的影響取決於殘基種類與甲基數目（單甲基、二甲基、三甲基）。

nodes.label: Basal Lamina
nodes.description: Basal lamina is a specialized sheet form of extracellular matrix. Classification nests it in ECM.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基底膜是細胞外基質的特化片狀形式。歸類將它嵌套於 ECM。

nodes.label: Glyoxalase System
nodes.description: The Glyoxalase System is the primary cellular defense pathway against dicarbonyl stress and the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products. It detoxifies reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during Glycolysis and Lipid Peroxidation by sequentially acting GLO1 and GLO2 enzymes, and maintaining its activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and mitigating diabetic complications. Because the pathway requires Glutathione as a co-substrate, it becomes compromised under Oxidative Stress when GSH is depleted.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glyoxalase System 是細胞對抗 dicarbonyl stress 與 Advanced Glycation End Products 累積的主要防禦途徑。它透過依序作用的 GLO1 與 GLO2 酵素，分解在 Glycolysis 與 Lipid Peroxidation 過程中產生的活性 dicarbonyl 中間體；維持此途徑活性是降低內源性 AGE 累積、減輕糖尿病併發症的主要著力點。由於該途徑需以 Glutathione 為共同受質，因此在 GSH 被耗竭的 Oxidative Stress 狀態下功能會受損。

nodes.label: TRAIL
nodes.description: Extrinsic Pathway is initiated by TRAIL. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Extrinsic Pathway, so TRAIL is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 TRAIL 發起。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 TRAIL 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: Type I vs Type II Cells.md

nodes.label: Hesperidin
nodes.description: Hesperidin contributes antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity as a citrus flavanone, consistent with the flavonoid class pattern. Its COMT neutrality makes it usable where catechol flavonoids are not.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 作為柑橘黃烷酮貢獻抗氧化與抗發炎活性，符合類黃酮類別模式。其 COMT 中性使其在兒茶酚類黃酮不適用處可用。

nodes.label: KAP1
nodes.description: KAP1 (TRIM28/TIF1beta) is the universal corepressor for KRAB-zinc-finger transcription factors, recruiting SETDB1, HDACs and HP1alpha to build H3K9me3-dominated silent chromatin; SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation promotes KAP1–HP1alpha interaction to package LINE-1 elements into repressive heterochromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: KAP1（TRIM28/TIF1β）是 KRAB 鋅指轉錄因子的通用共抑制因子，招募 SETDB1、HDAC 與 HP1α 建立以 H3K9me3 為主的沉默染色質；SIRT6 的單 ADP 核糖基化促進 KAP1–HP1α 交互作用，將 LINE-1 元素包裝進抑制性異染色質。

nodes.label: Eustress
nodes.description: Low-dose NaCl at 25 mM acts as eustress in hydroponically grown sunflower microgreens, stimulating rather than suppressing growth. Shoot fresh yield rose 58.7%, leaf area 81.4%, and root length 25.7% versus control. This stimulatory low-dose effect is the defining feature of eustress/hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 25 mM 低劑量 NaCl 在水耕向日葵苗菜中發揮 Eustress 作用，促進而非抑制生長。地上部鮮重增加 58.7%、葉面積增加 81.4%、根長增加 25.7%。這種低劑量刺激效應正是 eustress／hormesis 的定義特徵。

nodes.label: Senolytic Therapy
nodes.description: Tumor Microenvironment is targeted by Senolytic Therapy. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Senolytic therapy selectively eliminates senescent cells to remove their SASP and has been explored to blunt therapy-induced relapse. The directionality runs from Senolytic Therapy toward Tumor Microenvironment, so Senolytic Therapy is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tumor Microenvironment 的目標是 Senolytic Therapy。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Senolytic 療法選擇性地消除衰老細胞以消除其SASP，並已被探索用於抑制治療引起的復發。方向性從 Senolytic Therapy 朝向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 Senolytic Therapy 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

nodes.label: Information Theory of Aging
nodes.description: Sinclair proposed the information-theory-of-aging framework, positing that aging results from loss of epigenetic information (the software) rather than mere damage accumulation. Directionally, the theory explains aging as reversible information loss. Sirtuins such as SIRT1 are central because they relocalize during repair, driving epigenetic drift, and it is a unifying hypothesis motivating NAD+/sirtuin restoration. By framing aging as a software failure, the theory suggests that restoring youthful epigenetic states could reverse age-related decline. This framework has driven considerable research into epigenetic clocks, NAD+ biology, and cellular reprogramming.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sinclair 提出衰老資訊理論框架，假定衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊（軟體）的喪失而非僅僅損傷的積累。在方向性上，該理論將衰老解釋為可逆的資訊喪失。Sirtuin 如 SIRT1 至關重要，因為它們在修復期間重新定位，驅動表觀遺傳漂變，是一個統一的假說，推動 NAD+/sirtuin 恢復。透過將衰老框架定義為軟體故障，該理論表明恢復年輕的表觀遺傳狀態可能逆轉年齡相關退化。此框架推動了大量關於表觀遺傳時鐘、NAD+ 生物學和細胞重編程的研究。

nodes.label: Adrenal gland
nodes.description: The Adrenal gland is a paired endocrine organ whose inner Adrenal medulla, composed of Chromaffin cells, synthesizes the Catecholamines Epinephrine (about 80%) and Norepinephrine (about 20%). Synthesis runs Tyrosine to L-DOPA via Tyrosine Hydroxylase, then dopamine, Norepinephrine, and finally Epinephrine via PNMT.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenal gland 是一對內分泌器官，其內層由 Chromaffin cells 組成的 Adrenal medulla 合成 Catecholamines，即約 80% 的 Epinephrine 與約 20% 的 Norepinephrine。合成途徑由 Tyrosine 經 Tyrosine Hydroxylase 轉為 L-DOPA，再經 dopamine、Norepinephrine，最後由 PNMT 催化生成 Epinephrine。

nodes.label: Proteostasis
nodes.description: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

nodes.label: single nucleotide variation
nodes.description: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a variation at a single nucleotide position in the genome, the most common type of genetic variation, occurring roughly every few hundred bases. SNPs such as COMT Val158Met (rs4680) can alter protein function, gene expression, or drug response, making them the primary markers used in pharmacogenetic and behavioral genetics studies. Most SNPs are neutral, but functional variants can have substantial biological effects. They are the foundation of modern association studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 單核苷酸多態性 (SNP) 是基因組中單一核苷酸位置的變異，是最常見的遺傳變異類型，大約每幾百個鹼基就會發生一次。 SNPs（例如 COMT Val158Met (rs4680)）可以改變蛋白質功能，gene expression 或 drug response，使它們成為藥物遺傳學和行為遺傳學研究中使用的主要標記。大多數 SNPs 是中性的，但功能變異可以產生顯著的生物效應。它們是現代聯想研究的基礎。

nodes.label: Methionine sulfoxide reductases
nodes.description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

nodes.label: Atg4B
nodes.description: SIRT2, a cytosolic NAD+-dependent deacetylase, deacetylates ATG4B in response to starvation, modulating the activity of this cysteine protease that processes and delipidates the autophagosome marker LC3/GABARAP. Deacetylation of ATG4B influences the dynamics of LC3 conjugation and autophagosome maturation, fine-tuning autophagic flux. Because SIRT2 activity rises when NAD+ is elevated during CR and exercise, this modification links energy status to autophagosome biogenesis. The SIRT2-ATG4B axis adds an acetylation layer to core autophagy machinery regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種胞質 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯酶，在回應飢餓時去乙醯化 ATG4B——該半胱氨酸蛋白酶負責處理並去脂化自噬體標記 LC3/GABARAP。ATG4B 的去乙醯化影響 LC3 共軛和自噬體成熟的動力學，精細調諧自噬流。由於 SIRT2 活性在熱量限制和運動期間 NAD+ 升高時上升，此修飾將能量狀態與自噬體生物發生連結起來。SIRT2-ATG4B 軸為核心自噬機械的調節增添了乙醯化層次。

nodes.label: Autoxidation
nodes.description: Chelators such as EDTA suppress epinephrine autoxidation by sequestering the catalytic transition metals, chiefly Fe2+ and Cu+, that drive Fenton-type hydroperoxide decomposition. Blocking these metal ions removes the most efficient initiators of the radical chain, and chelators such as these are therefore standard additives in epinephrine formulations alongside antioxidants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EDTA 等螯合劑藉由隔離主要催化鏈反應的過渡金屬（尤其是 Fe2+ 與 Cu+）來抑制 Epinephrine 的 autoxidation；這些金屬以 Fenton 型化學分解過氧化氫物。阻斷這些金屬離子即移除了自由基鏈最有效的起始機制，因此這類螯合劑與抗氧化劑同為 Epinephrine 處方中的標準添加物。

nodes.label: Senomorphic Therapy
nodes.description: Ruxolitinib is a prototypic Senomorphic Therapy: rather than eliminating senescent cells it suppresses their inflammatory output via JAK–STAT blockade, abrogating secretion of IL-6 and IL-8 and blunting the pro-fibrotic secretome without killing the cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 是典型的 Senomorphic Therapy：它並不清除衰老細胞，而是透過阻斷 JAK–STAT 抑制其發炎輸出，在不殺死細胞的情況下取消 IL-6 與 IL-8 的分泌，並削弱促纖維化分泌體。

nodes.label: Gluconeogenesis
nodes.description: In hepatocytes propionate is activated to propionyl-CoA, carboxylated, epimerized and rearranged to succinyl-CoA by the Vitamin B12-dependent enzyme methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, feeding the gluconeogenic and TCA cycles — making propionate a meaningful precursor for endogenous glucose production during fasting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，propionate 被活化為 propionyl-CoA，經羧化、差向異構後，由 Vitamin B12 依賴的酵素 methylmalonyl-CoA mutase 重排為 succinyl-CoA，供應糖質新生與 TCA 循環——使 propionate 成为禁食期間內源性葡萄糖生成的重要前驅物。

nodes.label: Malondialdehyde
nodes.description: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

nodes.label: Hepatic Steatosis
nodes.description: Through the AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway, resveratrol reduces hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity models by enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function while limiting lipogenesis. Directionally, SIRT1 activation sits upstream of reduced liver fat accumulation. This demonstrates a translational metabolic benefit of sirtuin activation and is consistent with SIRT1s repression of lipogenic transcription factors such as SREBP-1c and PPAR-γ in the liver. By both increasing lipid catabolism and suppressing de novo lipogenesis, the pathway corrects the imbalance that drives non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過 AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α 通路，白藜蘆醇在飲食誘導肥胖模型中通過增強脂肪酸氧化和粒線體功能同時限制脂肪生成來減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化位於減少肝臟脂肪堆積的上游。這展示了 sirtuin 活化的轉化代謝益處，與 SIRT1 在肝臟中抑制 SREBP-1c 和 PPAR-γ 等脂肪生成轉錄因子一致。通過同時增加脂質分解代謝並抑制新生脂肪合成，該通路糾正了驅動非酒精性脂肪肝病的不平衡。

nodes.label: Arginine
nodes.description: Protein citrullination is definitionally arginine deimination to citrulline residues. Substrate identity anchors the modification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化定義上即精胺酸脫亞胺為瓜氨酸殘基。底物身份錨定修飾。

nodes.label: Genistein
nodes.description: Genistein inhibits NADPH oxidase, reducing superoxide production in endothelial cells by interfering with NOX assembly and signaling. This contributes to its vasculoprotective profile. The directionality is isoflavone to lowered NOX-derived ROS. A caveat is that genistein's effects on NOX are cell-type specific and can be modulated by its estrogen-receptor activity. By limiting superoxide, genistein also spares nitric oxide from rapid inactivation, improving endothelial function and vascular tone. These effects, combined with suppression of adhesion-molecule expression, underpin its atheroprotective properties in experimental and epidemiological studies.
