nodes.description_zh_TW: Genistein 抑制 NADPH oxidase，透過幹擾 NOX 組裝和訊號傳導來減少內皮細胞中超氧化物的產生。這有助於其血管保護作用。方向性是異黃酮至降低NOX衍生的ROS。需要注意的是，genistein 對 NOX 的影響是細胞類型特異性的，並且可以透過其雌激素受體活性進行調節。透過限制超氧化物，genistein 還可以防止 nitric oxide 快速失活，從而改善內皮功能和血管張力。這些作用與黏附分子表現的抑制相結合，在實驗和流行病學研究中鞏固了其動脈粥狀硬化保護特性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: Cytoplasmic Chromatin Fragments
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments are the primary endogenous ligand that activates cGAS-STING signaling in senescent cells. cGAS binds the fragments in a sequence-independent manner, recognizing DNA longer than 20 bp, and synthesizes 2'3'-cGAMP, which activates STING and the downstream TBK1-IRF3-NF-kB cascade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 是 senescent cells 中活化 cGAS-STING 訊號的主要內源性配體。cGAS 以不依賴序列的方式結合這些片段，辨識長度超過 20 bp 的 DNA，並合成 2'3'-cGAMP，進而活化 STING 與下游的 TBK1-IRF3-NF-κB 級聯反應。

nodes.label: Hallmarks of Aging
nodes.description: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

nodes.label: IKK
nodes.description: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Lewy Bodies
nodes.description: Lewy bodies and pale bodies in Parkinson's Disease are immunopositive for ubiquitin, marking a failure of Proteostasis: the neuron has attempted, and failed, to clear aggregated alpha-synuclein and oxidized substrates through the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System. Neuromelanin burden in the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta compounds this proteostatic stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Parkinson's Disease 中的 Lewy Bodies 與 Pale Bodies 對 ubiquitin 呈免疫陽性，標記出 Proteostasis 的失效：該神經元曾試圖、卻未能經由 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 清除聚集的 alpha-synuclein 與氧化受質。Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 中的 neuromelanin 負擔進一步加重此蛋白穩態壓力。

nodes.label: irinotecan
nodes.description: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

nodes.label: Prostaglandin E2
nodes.description: Prostaglandin E2 is one of the inflammatory mediators that sensitize nociceptor terminals at sites of tissue injury, together with bradykinin and cytokines. Sensitized nociceptors fire spontaneously and respond to normally innocuous stimuli, producing spontaneous pain, hyperalgesia and allodynia that together define inflammatory pain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prostaglandin E2 是使 nociceptor 末梢在組織損傷處敏感化的發炎介質之一，與 bradykinin 及細胞激素共同作用。敏感化的 nociceptor 會自發性放電並對原本無害的刺激產生反應，造成自發性疼痛、痛覺過敏與異痛症，三者共同構成 inflammatory pain。

nodes.label: Survivin
nodes.description: Smac-DIABLO antagonizes Survivin. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon Survivin rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smac-DIABLO 對抗 Survivin。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 Survivin 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

nodes.label: PKC
nodes.description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

nodes.label: Phagocytic Lysosome Reformation
nodes.description: Phosphoinositide signaling drives phagocytic lysosome reformation membrane remodeling. Regulation parallels the ALR edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸肌醇訊號驅動吞噬性溶酶體重組膜重塑。調節與 ALR 邊平行。

nodes.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
nodes.description: Auranofin (Ridaura) was FDA-approved in 1985 for adult rheumatoid arthritis as a second-line gold DMARD after NSAID failure, at an oral dose of 6 mg/day. Its mechanism in RA is incompletely understood but involves suppression of phagocytosis and inflammatory mediator release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Auranofin（Ridaura）於 1985 年獲 FDA 核准用於成人類風濕性關節炎，作為 NSAID 治療失敗後的二線金製劑 DMARD，口服劑量為每日 6 mg。其在 RA 中的機制尚未完全明瞭，但涉及抑制吞噬作用與發炎介質釋放。

nodes.label: Leishmaniasis
nodes.description: In leishmaniasis, metacyclic promastigotes injected by the sandfly are rapidly phagocytosed by resident macrophages, inside which they transform into round, non-flagellated amastigotes within a parasitophorous vacuole. Amastigotes then multiply by binary fission until the host cell ruptures and infects neighbouring macrophages, making the macrophage the primary host cell and replicative niche of the parasite.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 leishmaniasis 中，沙蠅注入的 metacyclic promastigote 會迅速被 resident macrophages 吞噬，並在 parasitophorous vacuole 內轉變為圓形、無鞭毛的 amastigote。Amastigote 接著以二分裂增殖，直到宿主細胞破裂並感染鄰近的 macrophages，因此 macrophage 是此寄生蟲的主要宿主細胞與增殖棲位。

nodes.label: Cholesterol
nodes.description: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

nodes.label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome System
nodes.description: Ubiquitin is a conserved 76-amino-acid protein that, through an E1/E2/E3 cascade, is covalently attached to lysines of target proteins. The resulting K48-linked chains are the canonical degradation signal recognized by the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System, while K63-linked chains instead mediate signaling, endocytosis and DNA repair, and deubiquitinases reverse the mark.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin 是一種高度保守的 76 胺基酸蛋白質，經由 E1/E2/E3 級聯反應共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基。所形成的 K48 鏈是 26S proteasome 辨識的典型降解訊號，而 K63 鏈則參與訊號傳遞、胞吞與 DNA 修復，去泛素化酵素則可逆轉此標記。

nodes.label: Aurora Kinase
nodes.description: Aurora Kinase isozymes — Aurora-A, Aurora-B and Aurora-C — coordinate mitotic spindle assembly, chromosome alignment and segregation, and cytokinesis; Aurora-A acts at centrosomes and spindle poles, while Aurora-B is a chromosomal passenger complex component regulating kinetochore-microtubule attachments and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aurora Kinase 異構酶——Aurora-A、Aurora-B 與 Aurora-C——共同協調有絲分裂紡錘體的組裝、染色體的對齊與分離，以及胞質分裂；Aurora-A 作用於中心體與紡錘體極，Aurora-B 則是染色體乘客複合體成分，調控動粒—微管附著與紡錘體組裝檢查點。

nodes.label: Histone Acetyltransferase
nodes.description: Sas2p is a MYST-family histone acetyltransferase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sas2p 是 MYST 家族組蛋白乙醯轉移酶。

nodes.label: Pentosidine
nodes.description: Pentosidine is a well-known fluorescent cross-link of the Advanced Glycation End Products family, formed by reaction of ribose, glucose or other sugars with lysine and arginine residues, and used to measure the extent of protein glycation and cross-linking in tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pentosidine 是 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 家族中著名的螢光性交聯產物，由核糖、葡萄糖等糖類與 [[Lysine]]、[[Arginine]] 殘基反應形成，用於衡量組織中蛋白質的糖化與交聯程度。

nodes.label: GLO2
nodes.description: D-lactate is a D-enantiomer of lactate generated as the terminal end product of the Glyoxalase System. Within that system GLO2 hydrolyzes the intermediate S-D-lactoylglutathione, releasing D-lactate while simultaneously regenerating the cellular antioxidant Glutathione, so the D-isomer marks the point at which methylglyoxal/glyoxal dicarbonyl stress has been resolved.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D-lactate 是乳酸的 D-對映異構物，為 Glyoxalase System 的最終產物。在該系統中，GLO2 水解中間產物 S-D-lactoylglutathione，釋出 D-lactate 的同時再生細胞抗氧化劑 Glutathione，因此 D-型標記著 methylglyoxal/glyoxal 二碳醣基壓力已被處理的終點。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction-Associated Senescence
nodes.description: MiDAS is a distinct form of cellular senescence triggered by mitochondrial perturbation rather than canonical genotoxic stressors, first characterised by Wiley et al. (2016). Unlike replicative or stress-induced senescence, it engages cell-cycle arrest through AMPK and p53 without the classic DNA damage response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MiDAS 是一種由粒線體擾動而非典型基因毒性壓力觸發的獨特 cellular senescence 形式，由 Wiley 等人（2016）首先描述。與 replicative 或 stress-induced senescence 不同，它透過 AMPK 與 p53 引發細胞週期停滯，而不涉及典型的 DNA damage 反應。

nodes.label: Oxfendazole
nodes.description: The FMO family are FAD-dependent monooxygenases catalysing NADPH- and O2-dependent oxidation of soft nucleophiles such as sulfur, nitrogen and phosphorus centres. Together with CYP3A4, FMO mediates the rapid hepatic sulfoxidation of fenbendazole to oxfendazole (fenbendazole sulfoxide); this first-pass sulfoxidation is the gateway to fenbendazole's pharmacologically active metabolite, with FMO3 the dominant hepatic form in adults.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FMO 家族是依賴 FAD 的單加氧酶，催化 NADPH 與 O2 相依的軟親核體（如硫、氮、磷中心）氧化。FMO 與 CYP3A4 共同介導 fenbendazole 在肝臟中快速硫氧化為 oxfendazole（fenbendazole sulfoxide）；這個首過硫氧化是形成 fenbendazole 藥理活性代謝物的關口，成人肝臟以 FMO3 為主。

nodes.label: VTA
nodes.description: VTA dopaminergic neurons project to the Nucleus Accumbens via the mesolimbic pathway, where they mediate reward, motivation and reinforcement. This projection is the principal route by which phasic VTA dopamine encodes reward prediction error.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VTA 的多巴胺神經元經 mesolimbic 途徑投射至 Nucleus Accumbens，在該處中介 reward、motivation 與 reinforcement。這條投射是 phasic VTA dopamine 編碼 reward prediction error 的主要路徑。

nodes.label: Depression
nodes.description: Dysfunction of the Nucleus Accumbens reward circuitry contributes to Depression, manifesting as anhedonia and reduced motivation. Because the same hub links emotion, cognition and movement, it is a target for interventions ranging from deep-brain stimulation to pharmacotherapy in affective disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 伏隔核（Nucleus Accumbens）獎賞迴路的功能失常會促成憂鬱症（Depression），表現為快感缺失與動機降低。由於同一個樞紐連結情緒、認知與運動，它也是情感疾病中從深部腦刺激到藥物治療的介入標的。

nodes.label: Magnesium
nodes.description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。

nodes.label: iNOS
nodes.description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

nodes.label: Argyria
nodes.description: Silver compounds are the source materials whose ingested or inhaled silver is absorbed into the circulation and ultimately deposited as elemental silver or silver sulfide granules in tissue, producing the irreversible blue-gray discoloration of Argyria. Insoluble Silver salts are converted along the way into soluble, protein-bound species that can cross into tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Silver compounds 是被吸收 silver 的來源材料，經攝入或吸入後進入循環系統，最後以金屬 silver 或 silver sulfide 顆粒沉積於組織，造成 Argyria 不可逆的青灰色色素沉著。過程中不溶性的 Silver salts 會轉變為可溶的蛋白結合態物種後進入組織。

nodes.label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
nodes.description: Metabolic Syndrome is a cluster of interconnected abnormalities — central obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension, and dyslipidemia — that collectively increase the risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Cardiovascular Disease, and Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. It arises from visceral adiposity and dysregulated lipid and glucose metabolism, creating systemic low-grade Inflammation and Oxidative Stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolic Syndrome 是一群互相關聯的異常——中央型肥胖、胰島素阻抗、高血壓與血脂異常——的集合，會共同提高 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus、Cardiovascular Disease 與 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 的風險。它源自內臟脂肪堆積與脂質、葡萄糖代謝失調，形成全身性低度發炎與 Oxidative Stress。

nodes.label: Trained Immunity
nodes.description: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling installs the aerobic-glycolysis (Warburg) program with increased glucose uptake and lactate that supports heightened cytokine output on rechallenge. Genetic or pharmacologic blockade of AKT, mTOR, or HIF-1alpha abrogates both the metabolic shift and trained cytokines in vitro and in vivo. BCG vaccination data corroborate elevated glycolytic flux under mTOR control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling 建立 aerobic-glycolysis（Warburg）程式，增加 glucose uptake 與 lactate，以支持再刺激時增強的細胞激素輸出。在 in vitro 與 in vivo 以基因或藥物阻斷 AKT、mTOR 或 HIF-1alpha，均可消除代謝轉換與訓練後的細胞激素。BCG vaccination 數據也證實在 mTOR 控制下 glycolytic flux 升高。

nodes.label: Methionine Restriction
nodes.description: The metabolic response to Methionine restriction is partially dependent on FGF21, consistent with MR acting through the same endocrine axis as Protein Restriction; in humans, sulfur amino acid restriction increased FGF21, reduced leptin, and reduced body weight. MR also inhibits mTORC1 signaling, coupling amino acid scarcity to reduced anabolic signaling, and most MR studies require cysteine depletion for the benefits to appear.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methionine restriction 的代謝反應部分仰賴 FGF21，這與 MR 經由和 Protein Restriction 相同的內分泌軸作用一致；在人類中，限制含硫胺基酸會提高 FGF21、降低瘦素並減少體重。MR 也會抑制 mTORC1 訊號，將胺基酸匱乏與合成訊號降低連結起來，且多數 MR 研究都需搭配半胱胺酸耗竭才能觀察到效益。

nodes.label: trastuzumab
nodes.description: Trastuzumab is the standard anti-HER2 antibody for this subtype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 是此亞型的標準抗 HER2 抗體。

nodes.label: TSC2
nodes.description: Germline TSC2 loss causes the TSC hamartoma syndrome. Causation is the genetic etiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 生殖系 TSC2 缺失導致 TSC 錯構瘤症候群。因果是遺傳病因。

nodes.label: Fenton Reaction
nodes.description: The Fenton reaction produces hydroxyl radicals according to Fe2+ + H2O2 to Fe3+ + OH* + OH-, a one-electron reduction of hydrogen peroxide by ferrous iron. This reaction is the principal mechanism by which relatively inert H2O2 is converted into the supremely reactive hydroxyl radical at sites of free iron. The directionality is metal-catalyzed conversion of a diffusible oxidant into a locally devastating radical. A caveat is that the ferric product can be recycled back to Fe2+ by reductants, sustaining chain production of hydroxyl radicals as long as iron and peroxide coexist.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fenton reaction 根據 Fe2+ + H2O2 產生 hydroxyl radicals 至 Fe3+ + OH* + OH-，這是亞鐵 iron 對 hydrogen peroxide 的單電子還原。此反應是相對惰性的 H2O2 在 free iron 位點轉化為活性極高的羥基自由基的主要機制。方向性是擴散氧化劑在金屬催化下轉化為局部破壞性自由基。需要注意的是，只要 iron 和過氧化物共存，三價鐵產品就可以透過還原劑回收 Fe2+，從而維持 hydroxyl radicals 的鍊式生產。

nodes.label: DOT1L
nodes.description: DOT1L (KMT4), the sole H3K79 methyltransferase, is required for SASP emergence: knockdown prevents the senescence-associated secretory phenotype while leaving the senescence growth arrest intact. H3K79 methylation is thought to keep chromatin at SASP loci open and permissive, so DOT1L is a senomorphic target rather than a senolytic one.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DOT1L (KMT4) 是唯一的 H3K79 methyltransferase，為 SASP 的出現所必需：其 knockdown 可阻止 senescence-associated secretory phenotype，卻不影響 senescence 的生長停滯。H3K79 甲基化被認為能使 SASP 位點的染色質維持開放且具轉錄允許性，因此 DOT1L 是 senomorphic 而非 senolytic 標的。

nodes.label: H3K56ac
nodes.description: Pharmacological SIRT6 activation with UBCS039, MDL-800, MDL-801, or Cyanidin rapidly lowers both H3K9ac and H3K56ac, compacting chromatin and facilitating DNA double-strand break repair. MDL-800-induced reduction of H3K9ac/H3K56ac has been reported in tumor cell lines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 以 UBCS039、MDL-800、MDL-801 或 Cyanidin 進行藥理性的 SIRT6 活化，可迅速降低 H3K9ac 與 H3K56ac，使染色質凝聚並促進 DNA 雙股斷裂修復。MDL-800 降低 H3K9ac／H3K56ac 的效果已在腫瘤細胞系中被報導。

nodes.label: GCN5
nodes.description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

nodes.label: Muscular Dystrophies (MD)
nodes.description: Dystrophin defects are the classic cause of Muscular Dystrophies (MD). Loss of functional dystrophin breaks the sarcolemmal linkage to the cytoskeleton, so contractions tear the muscle membrane and drive repeated fibre necrosis — the lesion underlying Duchenne and Becker dystrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dystrophin 缺陷是 Muscular Dystrophies (MD) 的典型病因。功能性 dystrophin 流失會破壞肌膜與細胞骨架的連結，使收縮時撕裂肌膜並引發反覆的肌纖維壞死——這正是 Duchenne 與 Becker 肌營養不良症的病灶基礎。

nodes.label: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
nodes.description: IPF is a paradigm of senescence-driven pathology. Aged lung fibroblasts accumulate senescence markers and secrete a pro-fibrotic SASP including IL-11, leukotrienes and TGFβ, which recruits immune cells and sustains a fibrogenic loop that resists normal repair. SIRT1 downregulation in IPF de-represses IL-11 transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IPF 是衰老驅動病理的典範。老化的肺纖維母細胞累積衰老標記並分泌促纖維化的 SASP（包含 IL-11、白三烯與 TGFβ），招募免疫細胞並維持抗拒正常修復的纖維生成迴路。IPF 中 SIRT1 的下调使 IL-11 轉錄去抑制。

nodes.label: DNA Polymerase
nodes.description: BrdU is a thymidine analog that competes with endogenous thymidine for incorporation by DNA Polymerase during replicative synthesis. Because it is only incorporated into actively dividing cells, it is the basis of proliferation labeling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BrdU 是胸腺嘧啶核苷類似物，在複製合成過程中與內源性胸腺嘧啶核苷競爭 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）的Incorporation（摻入）。由於它只會被摻入正在分裂的細胞，因此成為細胞增殖標定的基礎。

nodes.label: HDAC4
nodes.description: HDAC4 buffers AP-1 activity in young cells and is degraded on senescence entry, licensing AP-1-driven SASP. Loss of the brake explains senescence-specific AP-1 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC4 在年輕細胞緩衝 AP-1 活性，並在衰老進入時降解，許可 AP-1 驅動的 SASP。煞車喪失解釋衰老特異的 AP-1 活化。

nodes.label: Contact Inhibition
nodes.description: Mechanical density cues act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 機械密度線索經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ。

nodes.label: Bcl-2 family
nodes.description: BAK (Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer, gene BCL2L7) is a pro-apoptotic effector of the Bcl-2 family. Unlike the mostly cytosolic BAX, BAK is constitutively embedded in the outer mitochondrial membrane of healthy cells, holding BH1–BH3 domains that are restrained by anti-apoptotic partners such as Bcl-2 and Mcl-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BAK（Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer，基因 BCL2L7）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡效應蛋白。與主要存在於細胞質的 BAX 不同，BAK 在健康細胞中組成型地嵌入粒線體外膜，具有 BH1–BH3 結構域，並受 Bcl-2、Mcl-1 等抗凋亡蛋白制約。

nodes.label: Benzimidazole
nodes.description: Some bis-benzimidazole compounds bind the minor groove of DNA at specific sequences and inhibit DNA helicase activity, thereby blocking cell proliferation. This mechanism is relevant to fenbendazole-family benzimidazoles as potential anticancer agents.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 某些雙苯並咪唑化合物結合 DNA 小溝的特定序列並抑制 DNA 解旋酶活性，從而阻斷細胞增殖。此機制與 fenbendazole 家族苯並咪唑作為潛在抗癌藥有關。

nodes.label: Phytochemicals
nodes.description: Phytochemicals directly inhibit histone methyltransferase activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 植物化學物直接抑制組蛋白甲基轉移酶活性。

nodes.label: Interferon
nodes.description: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.

nodes.label: Senescence Surveillance
nodes.description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senescence Surveillance. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescence surveillance is the immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells orchestrated by their SASP chemokine and cytokine output. The directionality runs from Senescence Surveillance toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence Surveillance is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Senescence Surveillance 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。監視是由衰老細胞的趨化因子和細胞激素輸出協調的免疫介導的清除。方向性從 Senescence Surveillance 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence Surveillance 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Metabolic Syndrome
nodes.description: Metabolic Syndrome is a cluster of interconnected abnormalities — central obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension, and dyslipidemia — that collectively increase the risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Cardiovascular Disease, and Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. It arises from visceral adiposity and dysregulated lipid and glucose metabolism, creating systemic low-grade Inflammation and Oxidative Stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolic Syndrome 是一群互相關聯的異常——中央型肥胖、胰島素阻抗、高血壓與血脂異常——的集合，會共同提高 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus、Cardiovascular Disease 與 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 的風險。它源自內臟脂肪堆積與脂質、葡萄糖代謝失調，形成全身性低度發炎與 Oxidative Stress。

nodes.label: HAF-1
nodes.description: Under mitochondrial proteotoxic stress HAF-1, an inner-membrane ABC transporter, exports peptides generated by mitochondrial proteases from the matrix into the cytosol. These peptides act as retrograde signals that activate the transcription factor ATFS-1 and thus the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下，內膜 ABC transporter HAF-1 將粒線體蛋白酶產生的胜肽由 matrix 輸出至細胞質。這些胜肽作為 retrograde 訊號活化轉錄因子 ATFS-1，進而啟動 mitochondrial unfolded protein response。

nodes.label: Cyanidin-3-glucoside
nodes.description: Black elderberries provide roughly 350-450 mg cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit, with about 70-85 g reaching a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, berry content sits upstream of anthocyanin intake. Cyanidin is a powerful natural SIRT6 activator, and this positions elderberry as a dietary SIRT6-modulating food. The high anthocyanin content makes elderberry one of the richest natural sources of cyanidin, and its traditional use for immune support is consistent with the bioactivity of these compounds. Understanding the dose achievable from food is essential for interpreting dietary studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 黑接骨木莓每 100 克新鮮果實含有約 350-450 mg 花青素-3-葡萄糖苷，約 70-85 克即可達到 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，莓果含量位於花青素攝入量的上游。花青素是強效的天然 SIRT6 活化劑，這使接骨木莓成為飲食中的 SIRT6 調節食物。高花青素含量使接骨木莓成為花青素最豐富的天然來源之一，其傳統用於免疫支持與這些化合物的生物活性一致。理解從食物可達的劑量對於詮釋飲食研究至關重要。

nodes.label: Locus Coeruleus
nodes.description: Locus Coeruleus degenerates in Parkinson's Disease, reflecting the selective loss of these neurons as the disease progresses. Mechanistically, degeneration follows the spread of alpha-synuclein pathology and the failure of protective systems in vulnerable circuits. This is significant because the lost population underlies the non-motor and motor features attributed to the affected region. A caveat is that the same neurons also decline in normal aging and other disorders, so magnitude and pattern must be interpreted in full context.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Locus Coeruleus 在 Parkinson's Disease 中退化，反映出隨著疾病的進展這些神經元選擇性缺失。從機制上講，退化是隨著 alpha-synuclein 病理學的傳播和脆弱電路中保護系統的失效而發生的。這很重要，因為人口的流失是受影響地區非運動和運動特徵的基礎。需要注意的是，在正常 aging 和其他疾病中，相同的神經元也會下降，因此必須在完整的背景下解釋幅度和模式。

nodes.label: H3K9me3
nodes.description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHFs) are characterized by increased binding of HP1, H3K9me3 marks, macroH2A, and HMGA proteins. These foci are large domains of condensed heterochromatin that form in the nuclei of senescent cells and are believed to contribute to silencing of proliferation-associated genes. SAHF formation requires chromatin regulators including HIRA, ASF1a, and UBN1, and although not essential for growth arrest, their disruption correlates with reduced SASP expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關異染色質灶 (SAHF) 的特徵是 HP1、H3K9me3 標記、macroH2A 和 HMGA 蛋白的結合增加。這些病灶是在老化細胞的細胞核中形成的濃縮異染色質的大結構域，被認為有助於增殖相關基因的沉默。 SAHF 的形成需要染色質調節因子，包括 HIRA、ASF1a 和 UBN1，雖然對於生長停滯不是必需的，但它們的破壞與 SASP 表達的減少有關。

nodes.label: OPTN
nodes.description: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) is a mitochondrial transport adaptor protein that forms a complex with Optineurin (OPTN) and KIF5B for proper anterograde axonal mitochondrial transport. OPTN directly interacts with TRAK1 and KIF5B in a C-terminal-dependent manner to stabilize them, and the OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B complex is critical for axonal mitochondrial distribution.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) 是粒線體運輸轉接蛋白，與 Optineurin (OPTN) 及 KIF5B 形成複合體，以進行正確的軸突順向粒線體運輸。OPTN 以依賴 C 端的方式直接與 TRAK1 及 KIF5B 互動並使其穩定，而 OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B 複合體對軸突粒線體分布至關重要。

nodes.label: Cardiolipin
nodes.description: Cardiolipin is an obligate cofactor for inner-membrane fusion: L-OPA1 binds cardiolipin on liposomes and GTP hydrolysis by OPA1 drives fusion, and removing cardiolipin abolishes fusion even when L-OPA1 is present on both membranes. Cardiolipin also interacts with DRP1 to stimulate its oligomerization and GTPase activity, promoting fission, so the same lipid bidirectionally regulates mitochondrial dynamics. It is additionally required for mitophagy receptor recruitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 是內膜融合的必需輔因子：L-OPA1 在脂質體上結合 cardiolipin，OPA1 的 GTP 水解驅動融合；即使兩側膜上都有 L-OPA1，只要移除 cardiolipin 融合即被廢除。Cardiolipin 也與 DRP1 互動以促進其寡聚化與 GTPase 活性而促進分裂，因此同一種脂質對粒線體動態學具有雙向調控作用。它同時也是 mitophagy 受體招募所必需。

nodes.label: Aminoguanidine HCL
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride is the prototype therapeutic AGE inhibitor: as a nucleophilic carbonyl trap it reacts rapidly with reactive alpha,beta-dicarbonyl intermediates (Methylglyoxal, Glyoxal, 3-deoxyglucosone) to form stable, non-toxic 3-amino-1,2,4-triazine adducts, intercepting them before they cross-link proteins and thus preventing the AGE accumulation that drives vascular stiffening, basement membrane thickening, and tissue damage in Aging and Diabetes Mellitus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride 是原型的 AGE 抑制療效藥：作為親核性羰基捕集劑，它能快速與活性 α,β-二羰基中間物（Methylglyoxal、Glyoxal、3-deoxyglucosone）反應，形成穩定且無毒的 3-amino-1,2,4-triazine 加合物，在其與蛋白質交聯前先行攔截，因而避免造成血管僵硬、基底膜增厚與 Aging 及 Diabetes Mellitus 中組織損傷的 AGE 累積。

nodes.label: Doxorubicin
nodes.description: Doxorubicin (Adriamycin), an anthracycline chemotherapy drug, exerts anticancer effects by intercalating between DNA base pairs, inhibiting topoisomerase II-mediated DNA repair, and generating free radicals that induce Oxidative Stress. These actions collectively trigger the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin（Adriamycin）是一種 anthracycline 類化療藥物，其抗癌作用來自插入 DNA 鹼基對之間、抑制 topoisomerase II 媒介的 DNA 修補，以及產生自由基而誘發 Oxidative Stress。這些作用共同啟動 Apoptosis 的 Intrinsic Pathway。

nodes.label: Emphysema
nodes.description: Emphysema is a subtype of COPD defined by permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles with destruction of their walls and no obvious fibrosis. Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor, with occupational dusts, air pollution and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency also predisposing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肺氣腫是 COPD 的一個型態，其定義為終末細支氣管遠端氣腔永久性擴大且其壁被破壞，並無明顯纖維化。吸菸是主要危險因子，職業粉塵、空氣污染與 alpha-1 antitrypsin 缺乏亦為易感因素。

nodes.label: HSPA8
nodes.description: HSPA8 (HSC70) is the constitutive HSP70-family chaperone that delivers KFERQ-motif client proteins to LAMP-2A at the lysosome in chaperone-mediated autophagy. Because deficient CMA degradation compromises proteostasis and activates signaling that culminates in cellular senescence, HSPA8 is central to both proteostasis and senescence control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是恆定表現的 HSP70 家族伴護蛋白，負責在伴護素媒介自噬中將帶有 KFERQ 序列的受質蛋白運送至溶酶體的 LAMP-2A。由於 CMA 降解不足會破壞蛋白恆定性並啟動最終導致細胞衰老的訊號傳遞，HSPA8 同時是蛋白恆定與衰老調控的核心。

nodes.label: Strongyloidiasis
nodes.description: CTLA-4 checkpoint blockade, including anti-PD-1 combinations, is a recognized trigger of disseminated Strongyloidiasis in carriers of latent infection. The mechanism is the same as for steroids: relief of the Th2/eosinophil brake allows autoinfective larvae to amplify, so steroid-refractory or atypical presentations should raise suspicion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 檢查點阻斷（含與 anti-PD-1 的聯合）是潛伏感染者發生播散性 Strongyloidiasis 的公認誘發因素。其機轉與糖皮質激素相同：解除 Th2／嗜酸性球煞車後，自傳染性幼蟲得以大量增殖，因此對類固醇無反應或表現不典型時應提高懷疑。

nodes.label: Maillard Reaction
nodes.description: Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) are a heterogeneous, complex group of compounds formed mainly via the Maillard reaction, in which a reducing sugar reacts non-enzymatically with amino groups in proteins, lipids, or DNA. The Maillard reaction has long been exploited by the food industry for the color and taste it imparts, but its products have gained attention in biomedicine because AGEs are associated with chronic diseases of aging such as diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, and Alzheimer's disease. AGEs form in three phases, and the final brownish, often fluorescent products are very stable and accumulate in tissues, where they interfere with protein function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products（AGEs）是一群heterogeneous、complex的compounds，主要經由Maillard reaction形成，其中a reducing sugar與proteins、lipids或DNA中的amino groups進行non-enzymatic reaction。Maillard reaction長期以來被food industry利用以imparts color與taste，但其products在biomedicine中受到attention，因為AGEs與diabetes mellitus、cardiovascular disease及Alzheimer's disease等aging chronic diseases相關。AGEs form in three phases，最終的brownish、often fluorescent products非常stable並accumulate in tissues，干擾protein function。

nodes.label: Ubiquinone
nodes.description: Ubiquinone/CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Because FSP1 depends on this ubiquinone supply, interventions that suppress mevalonate flux toward cholesterol (statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) deplete the CoQ10 pool and converge on FSP1, predicting ferroptosis sensitivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 泛醌/CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物。由於 FSP1 依賴此泛醌供應，抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的介入（statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會耗竭 CoQ10 池並在 FSP1 處交會，預示鐵死亡敏感性。

nodes.label: Oxygen Consumption Rate
nodes.description: Oxygen Consumption Rate is measured in real time with a Seahorse XF Analyzer, whose transient micro-chamber clamps track O2 flux while titrating oligomycin, FCCP and rotenone/antimycin A to resolve basal, ATP-linked, proton-leak and spare respiratory capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxygen Consumption Rate 以 [[Seahorse XF Analyzer]] 即時測定；儀器利用瞬間微腔夾制追蹤 O₂ 通量，並以 [[Oligomycin]]、[[FCCP]] 與 rotenone/antimycin A 滴定，解析基礎呼吸、ATP 連結呼吸、質子漏與呼吸剩餘容量。

nodes.label: Fatty acid oxidation
nodes.description: PPARα is a nuclear receptor transcription factor whose activation induces fatty acid oxidation, ketogenesis and lipid metabolism programs, lowering triglycerides and improving the lipid profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PPARα 是核受體轉錄因子，其活化會誘導脂肪酸氧化、生酮與脂質代謝程式，降低三酸甘油酯並改善脂質剖面。

nodes.label: GSK3β
nodes.description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

nodes.label: MHC type II
nodes.description: The alpha2 and beta2 membrane-proximal Ig-like domains of MHC class II form the docking site for the CD4 co-receptor on T helper cells, which is how peptide-MHC II complexes engage CD4+ T cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MHC 第二類分子的 α2 與 β2 膜近端類免疫球結構域構成輔助受體 CD4 在 T 幫助細胞上的停靠位點，peptide–MHC II 複合體正是藉此接合 CD4+ T 細胞。

nodes.label: Silver nanoparticles
nodes.description: Silver nanoparticles are a definitional nanoscale subtype of silver compounds. Classification nests the particulate form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀奈米顆粒是銀化合物的定義性奈米亞型。歸類嵌套顆粒形式。

nodes.label: Sarcopenia
nodes.description: Sarcopenia, the progressive and generalized loss of skeletal muscle mass and strength, is a serious problem among older populations and is associated with increased Oxidative Stress and Inflammation. It may be exacerbated by the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products in muscle tissue, linking it to dietary and endogenous AGE exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sarcopenia（骨骼肌量與肌力逐漸普遍性的流失）是老年族群中的嚴重問題，並與升高的 Oxidative Stress 及 Inflammation 相關；肌肉組織中 Advanced Glycation End Products 的累積可能使其惡化，將它與飲食性及內源性 AGE 暴露連結起來。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Complex I
nodes.description: NDUFA10 is a structural subunit of Mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), the first and largest complex of the oxidative phosphorylation electron transport chain. Complex I transfers electrons from NADH to ubiquinone while pumping protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane to build the gradient that drives ATP synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NDUFA10 是 Mitochondrial Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）的結構次單元，而 Complex I 是 oxidative phosphorylation 電子傳遞鏈中第一且最大的複合體。Complex I 將電子由 NADH 傳遞給 ubiquinone，同時在粒線體內膜泵出質子以建立驅動 ATP 合成的電化學梯度。

nodes.label: Intrinsically Disordered Region
nodes.description: Intrinsically disordered regions lack a fixed three-dimensional fold yet drive liquid–liquid phase separation, forming membraneless organelles and condensates, and they are enriched in sites for phosphorylation, acetylation and other post-translational modifications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內在無序區缺乏固定的三維摺疊，卻能驅動液–液相分離，形成無膜胞器與凝聚體；它們也富含磷酸化、乙醯化等轉譯後修飾位點。

nodes.label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
nodes.description: Serum creatinine is freely filtered by the glomeruli and is the cornerstone of routine renal function assessment, used to estimate GFR via Cockcroft-Gault, MDRD, and CKD-EPI equations. Its main limitation is dependence on muscle mass, protein intake, and drugs such as cimetidine or trimethoprim that inhibit tubular secretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serum creatinine 由腎小球自由濾過，是常規腎功能評估的基石，用於透過 Cockcroft-Gault、MDRD 與 CKD-EPI 公式估算 GFR。其主要限制是受肌肉量、蛋白質攝取，以及 cimetidine 或 trimethoprim 等抑制腎小管分泌的藥物影響。

nodes.label: Histone Acetylation
nodes.description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: Arterial Stiffening
nodes.description: In preclinical and early clinical studies, alagebrium improved arterial compliance, reduced arterial stiffening and enhanced left-ventricular diastolic function, effects attributed to reversal of AGE-mediated matrix rigidification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在臨床前與早期臨床研究中，Alagebrium 改善動脈順應性、降低 Arterial Stiffening 並提升左心室舒張功能，這些效果歸因於逆轉 AGE 所致基質僵硬。

nodes.label: Histone H3
nodes.description: Histone H3 is one of the core histones that form the Nucleosome: together with Histone H4 it makes an (H3-H4)2 tetramer that organizes the central 120–130 bp of DNA wrapped around the particle. H3 is among the most highly conserved proteins across eukaryotes and carries a dense array of post-translational modifications on its ~40-residue N-terminal tail.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone H3 是構成 Nucleosome 的核心組蛋白之一：它與 Histone H4 共同形成 (H3-H4)2 四聚體，組織纏繞在核小體上的中央 120–130 bp DNA。H3 是真核生物中序列最保守的蛋白質之一，其約 40 個殘基的 N 端尾帶上帶有密集的轉譯後修飾。

nodes.label: Intermittent Fasting
nodes.description: Intermittent fasting (IF) is a dietary intervention that periodically restricts caloric intake, producing the nutrient deprivation signals that robustly induce autophagy in many tissues. In preclinical cancer models, cycles of IF combined with chemotherapy have been shown to slow tumor growth and improve therapeutic index by exploiting the differential stress resistance of normal versus malignant cells. The protective effect of autophagy during fasting helps normal cells tolerate chemotherapy, while many tumors remain reliant on constitutive autophagy for survival. These findings position IF as a translational strategy to modulate autophagic tone for anti-cancer and pro-longevity benefits.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食（IF）是一種週期性限制熱量攝取的飲食介入，產生營養剝奪訊號，在許多組織中強力誘導自噬。在臨床前癌症模型中，IF週期與化療相結合已被證明可減緩腫瘤生長並改善治療指數，這是透過利用正常細胞與惡性細胞的差異性壓力抵抗。斷食期間自噬的保護作用幫助正常細胞耐受化療，而許多腫瘤仍依賴組成型自噬以存活。這些發現將IF定位為一種轉譯策略，用於調節自噬張力以獲得抗癌和促長壽的益處。

nodes.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
nodes.description: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

nodes.label: One-Carbon Metabolism
nodes.description: MTHFD2 sits immediately downstream of SHMT2, which converts serine to glycine plus 5,10-methylene-THF in the mitochondrial folate cycle — the dominant source of one-carbon units and mitochondrial NADPH in proliferating and cancer cells. Because it generates NADPH while feeding folate/one-carbon flux into 10-formyl-THF for purine and nucleotide synthesis, MTHFD2 is a junction where carbon metabolism and redox defence converge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTHFD2 位於 SHMT2 的下游；SHMT2 在粒線體葉酸循環中將 serine 轉為 glycine 與 5,10-亞甲基 THF，而此循環是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳單位與粒線體 NADPH 的主要來源。由於 MTHFD2 一方面產生 NADPH，另一方面將葉酸／一碳通量送入 10-甲醯 THF 以供嘌呤與核苷酸合成，它是碳代謝與氧化還原防禦交會的節點。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Remodeling
nodes.description: Cellular reprogramming is fundamentally an epigenetic remodeling process that erases somatic memory and installs a new cellular identity. Reprogramming requires global erasure of somatic DNA methylation, reconfiguration of histone marks, and resetting of the chromatin landscape at pluripotency loci, driven by pioneer factors and chromatin remodelers. The process proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, and culminates in the establishment of a stable pluripotent state in induced pluripotent stem cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程從根本上來說是一種表觀遺傳重塑過程，它會消除體細胞記憶並安裝新的細胞身份。重編程需要在先鋒因子和染色質重塑因子的驅動下，全面消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化、重新配置組蛋白標記以及重置多能性位點的染色質景觀。這個過程經歷確定的階段，包括間質到上皮的轉變，並最終在誘導多能幹細胞中建立穩定的多能狀態。

nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the scaffold protein 14-3-3ζ (lysine 49), identified by a biotin-switch proteomics screen for cytoplasmic SIRT1 substrates. Deacetylated 14-3-3ζ maintains its phosphorylation-dependent binding to caspase-2, shielding caspase-2 Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. When SIRT1 activity drops, 14-3-3ζ becomes acetylated and dissociates from caspase-2, allowing the apical caspase to activate. This is the first demonstration of cytoplasmic 14-3-3 acetylation as a death-regulatory modification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化支架蛋白 14-3-3ζ（離胺酸 49），此為針對細胞質 SIRT1 受質之 biotin-switch 蛋白質體學篩選的發現。去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 維持其與 caspase-2 之磷酸化依賴性結合，保護 Caspase-2 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）不被去磷酸化。當 SIRT1 活性下降時，14-3-3ζ 被乙醯化並與 caspase-2 解離，使這個頂端 caspase 得以活化。這是首次證明細胞質 14-3-3 乙醯化具有死亡調控功能。

nodes.label: RAS
nodes.description: Activated RAS (e.g., HRASG12V) is a prototypical OIS-inducing oncogene, driving hyperproliferation and replication stress that triggers senescence as a tumor-suppressive failsafe. RAS signaling pushes cells into S-phase at excessive frequency, generating DNA damage that stabilizes p53 and derepresses p16, enforcing durable arrest. The relationship is a foundational model of OIS, first described by Serrano in 1997, and is extensively validated across cell and animal systems. It underlies the concept of oncogene-induced tumor-suppressive barriers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 活化的 RAS（如 HRASG12V）是典型 OIS 誘發致癌基因，驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，觸發衰老作為腫瘤抑制失效安全。RAS 訊號以過高頻率將細胞推入 S 期，產生 DNA 損傷並激活 DDR 以強制停滯。此誘發是致癌基因誘發衰老的原型，並將癌基因活化直接耦合到生長停止。它是理解 OIS 作為腫瘤抑制屏障的基礎。

nodes.label: Bladder Cancer
nodes.description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

nodes.label: Hexokinase 2
nodes.description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Hexokinase 2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Hexokinase 2 is the glycolytic first-step enzyme most strongly induced in cancer, where it often tethers to mitochondria to couple glycolysis to survival. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 Hexokinase 2 與 Hexokinase 2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hexokinase 2 是癌症中最強烈誘導的糖解第一步酶，它經常與粒線體結合，將糖解與生存結合。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

nodes.label: Vps34
nodes.description: BEC-1 is part of the Class III PI3K complex containing Vps34, through which it acts as a key regulator of Autophagy and is essential for nucleation of the Autophagosome in C. elegans.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BEC-1 是含有 Vps34 的 Class III PI3K 複合體的組成，藉此作為 Autophagy 的關鍵調節因子，並對 C. elegans 中 Autophagosome 的成核不可或缺。

nodes.label: BAK
nodes.description: BAK (Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer, gene BCL2L7) is a pro-apoptotic effector of the Bcl-2 family. Unlike the mostly cytosolic BAX, BAK is constitutively embedded in the outer mitochondrial membrane of healthy cells, holding BH1–BH3 domains that are restrained by anti-apoptotic partners such as Bcl-2 and Mcl-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BAK（Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer，基因 BCL2L7）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡效應蛋白。與主要存在於細胞質的 BAX 不同，BAK 在健康細胞中組成型地嵌入粒線體外膜，具有 BH1–BH3 結構域，並受 Bcl-2、Mcl-1 等抗凋亡蛋白制約。

nodes.label: Slug
nodes.description: Slug (SNAI2) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Parallel driver to Snail.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Slug（SNAI2）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。與 Snail 平行的驅動者。

nodes.label: Niacin
nodes.description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。

nodes.label: Ascaris
nodes.description: Trichuris is classified together with Ascaris and hookworms as a soil-transmitted helminth, and long-term ivermectin treatment for onchocerciasis is associated with reduced prevalence of co-infections by these soil-transmitted helminths, which together infect over one billion people.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Trichuris 與 Ascaris 及鉤蟲同屬土壤傳播蠕蟲；以 Ivermectin 長期治療河盲症，也與這些土壤傳播蠕蟲共同感染的盛行率下降相關，而它們合計感染逾十億人。

nodes.label: Irisin
nodes.description: Skeletal muscle acts as a major endocrine organ, releasing myokines — most studied is Irisin, the cleaved ectodomain of FNDC5 — that travel via circulation to adipose tissue, bone, brain and vasculature, linking physical activity to systemic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 骨骼肌扮演主要內分泌器官的角色，釋放 myokine；其中研究最深入的是 Irisin，也就是 FNDC5 被切割後的外域片段。它經血液循環作用於脂肪組織、骨骼、腦與血管，將身體活動與全身健康連結起來。

nodes.label: PDGFAA
nodes.description: Senescent Cells transiently accumulate at the wound edge during cutaneous injury and secrete PDGFAA alongside osteopontin. The secreted growth factor is what recruits and differentiates fibroblasts into myofibroblasts, so the senescent cell is not merely a bystander but a required temporary signal source for optimal tissue repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在皮膚損傷期間，Senescent Cells 會於傷口邊緣短暫累積，並與 osteopontin 一同分泌 PDGFAA。所分泌的這個生長因子正是招募並分化纖維細胞為肌成纖維細胞的訊號，因此衰老細胞並非單純旁觀者，而是最佳組織修復所必需的暫時訊號來源。

nodes.label: Tumor Suppressor
nodes.description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

nodes.label: Natural Killer Cells
nodes.description: Natural Killer Cells are a major source of Interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma), which activates macrophages, upregulates MHC expression, and promotes Th1 responses; IFN-gamma production declines with age as part of immunosenescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Natural Killer Cells 是 Interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) 的主要來源，該細胞激素可活化巨噬細胞、上調 MHC 表現並促進 Th1 反應；隨年齡增長，IFN-γ 的產量會因免疫老化而下降。

nodes.label: Protein Synthesis
nodes.description: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

nodes.label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
nodes.description: Through SIRT3 activation, honokiol reverses pathological cardiac hypertrophy and protects against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in preclinical models. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to engage antihypertrophic and antioxidant programs. By activating mitochondrial defenses, it counters the oxidative and energetic deficits of failing myocardium and suppresses the ROS-driven signaling that sustains hypertrophic growth. This positions SIRT3 as a therapeutic node in heart failure, consistent with the observations that SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe hypertrophy and fibrosis while SIRT3-overexpressing mice are resistant to hypertrophy-inducing stimuli.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 通過 SIRT3 活化，厚朴酚在臨床前模型中逆轉病理性心臟肥大並保護對抗 doxorubicin 誘導的心臟毒性。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以啟動抗肥大和抗氧化程序。通過活化粒線體防禦，它對抗衰竭心肌的氧化和能量缺陷，並抑制維持肥大生長的 ROS 驅動信號。這將 SIRT3 定位為心臟衰竭的治療節點，與 SIRT3 缺乏小鼠發展嚴重肥大和纖維化而 SIRT3 過量表達小鼠對肥大誘導刺激具有抗性的觀察一致。

nodes.label: Myelin
nodes.description: Multiple Sclerosis impairs Myelin through an autoimmune, T cell-mediated attack on myelin antigens such as MBP, PLP and MOG. Stripping the sheath in the central nervous system disrupts saltatory conduction and removes the trophic signals myelin provides to axons, so demyelination converts an inflammatory lesion into irreversible axonal degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Multiple Sclerosis 透過針對 MBP、PLP 與 MOG 等髓鞘抗原的自體免疫性 T 細胞攻擊損害 Myelin。在中樞神經系統剝除髓鞘會破壞跳躍式傳導，並移除髓鞘提供給軸突的營養訊號，因此脫髓鞘會把發炎性病灶轉為不可逆的軸突變性。

nodes.label: Asthma
nodes.description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

nodes.label: Propolis
nodes.description: Propolis inhibits NF-κB, with its caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE) acting as a potent inhibitor of NF-κB and of COX-2. This transcription-factor suppression is the shared mechanistic basis for both the anti-inflammatory and the anti-cancer activity attributed to propolis extracts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Propolis 抑制 NF-κB，其中咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）是 NF-κB 與 COX-2 的強效抑制劑。這種轉錄因子抑制，是 propolis 萃取物同時具有抗發炎與抗癌活性的共同機轉基礎。

nodes.label: Dopachrome tautomerase
nodes.description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

nodes.label: Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells
nodes.description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are the most functionally important population of immature myeloid cells: rather than representing a single lineage, their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets. They are scarce at steady state but expand dramatically under pathological stress, and are recruited into the tumor microenvironment where they suppress T-cell and NK-cell function through arginine depletion, reactive oxygen species and induction of regulatory T cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) 是 immature myeloid cells 中功能上最重要的族群：其分類反映的是一種分化停滯狀態（具有 polymorphonuclear 與 monocytic 亞群），而非單一譜系。她們在穩態下稀少，但在病理壓力下大幅擴張，並被招募進 tumor microenvironment，透過消耗 arginine、產生 reactive oxygen species 及誘導 regulatory T cells 來抑制 T 細胞與 NK 細胞功能。

nodes.label: Mitoxantrone
nodes.description: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

nodes.label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
nodes.description: Human caspase-4 is a cytosolic-LPS sensor and noncanonical effector alongside caspase-5, paralleling murine caspase-11. It cleaves gasdermin D and IL-1α to drive SASP and pyroptotic signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類 caspase-4 是胞質 LPS 感受器與非典型效應因子，與 caspase-5 並列，對應小鼠 caspase-11。它切割 gasdermin D 與 IL-1α 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptotic 訊號。

nodes.label: PTEN
nodes.description: PTEN is a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates PIP3, thereby antagonizing PI3K/Akt signalling; its opposition to PI3K forms one branch of the incoherent bivalent motif centred on mTORC1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTEN 是脂質磷酸酶，可將 PIP3 去磷酸化，因而拮抗 PI3K/Akt 訊號；其與 PI3K 的對抗構成以 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價 motif 的一個分支。

nodes.label: Telomere
nodes.description: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

nodes.label: E2F
nodes.description: Hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors in G1. This suppression withholds S-phase genes until CDK phosphorylation releases them.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 低磷酸化 RB1 在 G1 結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子。此抑制扣留 S 期基因，直到 CDK 磷酸化釋放它們。

nodes.label: Nicotinic acid
nodes.description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) enters the Preiss-Handler Pathway, where NAPRT forms NaMN, NMNAT adenylates it to NaAD, and NAD+ synthetase amidates NaAD to NAD+. This route bypasses NAMPT, the rate-limiting and NAD+-sensitive step of the salvage pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: [[Nicotinic acid]]（niacin）經由 Preiss-Handler Pathway 進入 [[NAD+]] 合成：NAPRT 形成 NaMN，[[NMNAT]] 將其腺苷酸化為 NaAD，再由 NAD+ 合成酶醯胺化生成 [[NAD+]]。此途徑繞過補救途徑中的限速步驟 [[NAMPT]]。

nodes.label: Autophagic Flux
nodes.description: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

nodes.label: IGF1
nodes.description: Intermittent fasting lowers circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), a potent mitogenic and pro-survival hormone whose signaling converges on the PI3K-Akt-mTOR axis to inhibit autophagy. In a breast cancer model, a 48-hour fasting period reduced IGF-1 levels by approximately 70%, dampening pro-tumorigenic IGF-1 receptor signaling. The resulting reduction in mTORC1 activity contributes to the fasting-induced activation of autophagy and the enhanced stress resistance of normal tissues. Lower IGF-1 during fasting is therefore a key endocrine mechanism linking IF to both tumor suppression and longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食降低循環的類胰島素生長因子1（IGF-1），這是一種強效的促有絲分裂和促存活激素，其訊號匯聚於PI3K-Akt-mTOR軸以抑制自噬。在乳腺癌模型中，48小時斷食使IGF-1水平降低約70%，減弱促腫瘤生成的IGF-1受體訊號。由此產生的mTORC1活性降低有助於斷食誘導的自噬活化和正常組織增強的壓力抵抗。因此，斷食期間較低的IGF-1是將IF與腫瘤抑制和長壽連結的關鍵內分泌機制。

nodes.label: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus
nodes.description: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。
nodes.norm_label: dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus
nodes.source_file: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md

nodes.label: Orexin
nodes.description: Narcolepsy type 1 is driven by loss of orexin-producing hypothalamic neurons destabilizing sleep-wake boundaries. The association is the causal core of the disorder's pathophysiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 第一型 narcolepsy 由喪失下視丘食慾素神經元、破壞睡眠覺醒邊界所驅動。此關聯是疾病病理生理的因果核心。

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites
nodes.description: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites (SADS) is the striking decompaction of constitutive pericentromeric/pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin that occurs in many senescent cell models. Unlike the facultative heterochromatin of SAHF, SADS affects constitutive heterochromatin and occurs regardless of SAHF presence, reflecting a global loosening of repressive chromatin in senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites（SADS）是許多衰老細胞模型中構成性 pericentromeric/pericentrosomal 衛星異染色質的顯著解壓縮。與 SAHF 的兼性異染色質不同，SADS 影響的是構成性異染色質且不論是否形成 SAHF 都會發生，反映衰老中抑制性染色質的整體鬆動。

nodes.label: GSK3
nodes.description: GSK3 builds the S155/S159/T163 phosphodegron routing Mcl-1 to SCF degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GSK3 建立 S155/S159/T163 磷酸降解子，將 Mcl-1 送往 SCF 降解。

nodes.label: Hydroxyl Radicals
nodes.description: Amifostine (WR-2721) is a phosphorothioate prodrug dephosphorylated at the cell membrane by alkaline phosphatase to the free-thiol metabolite WR-1065, which accumulates selectively in normal tissues. WR-1065 donates hydrogen atoms to neutralize hydroxyl radicals (HO•) generated by ionizing radiation, protecting DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amifostine（WR-2721）是磷硫代前藥，在細胞膜上被鹼性磷酸酶去磷酸化為游離硫醇代謝物 WR-1065，並選擇性地累積於正常組織。WR-1065 提供氫原子以中和電離輻射產生的氫自由基（HO•），保護 DNA 與蛋白質免受輻射誘發的損傷。

nodes.label: Cigarette Smoke
nodes.description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

nodes.label: MERCS
nodes.description: MERCS localize fusion/fission machinery such as DRP1, so their altered abundance in senescence or neurodegeneration reshapes mitochondrial morphology; in the R6/1 Huntington's disease model, increased DRP1-mediated fission reduces MERCS and impairs mitochondrial calcium handling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MERCS 會定位融合／分裂機制（如 DRP1），因此在衰老或神經退化時其數量改變會重塑粒線體形態；在 R6/1 亨丁頓症模型中，DRP1 媒介的分裂增加會減少 MERCS 並損害粒線體的鈣離子處理。

nodes.label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine
nodes.description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is the most abundant oxidative lesion in DNA, with roughly 10^3 to 10^6 lesions per cell per day arising from normal metabolism and extrinsic insults. Its prevalence reflects both high formation rate and efficient but imperfect repair. The directionality is oxidation of guanine to the dominant adduct. A caveat is that the steady-state level integrates formation and repair, so it is an indirect rather than instantaneous measure of ROS flux. The steady-state 8-oxodG level is influenced by both the rate of oxidation and the efficiency of OGG1-mediated repair, so it reflects the balance between insult and defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 DNA 中最豐富的氧化損傷，每個細胞每天約有 10^3 至 10^6 個損傷，這些損傷是由正常代謝和外在損傷引起的。它的流行反映了高形成率和有效但不完善的修復。方向性是鳥嘌呤氧化成主要加合物。需要注意的是，穩態水平整合了形成和修復，因此它是 ROS 通量的間接而非瞬時測量。穩態8-oxodG水平受到氧化速率和OGG1介導的修復效率的影響，因此它反映了損傷和防禦之間的平衡。

nodes.label: Pentose Phosphate Pathway
nodes.description: The Pentose Phosphate Pathway reduces NADP+ to NADPH. This oxidative branch is the main source of cellular reducing power; NADPH then regenerates reduced Glutathione and drives reductive biosynthesis, so the pathway sits upstream of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pentose Phosphate Pathway 將 NADP+ 還原成 NADPH。這條氧化支路是細胞還原力的主要來源；所產生的 NADPH 接著再生還原態的 Glutathione 並驅動還原性生合成，因此該路徑位於穀胱甘肽依賴型抗氧化防禦的上游。

nodes.label: E-cadherin
nodes.description: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

nodes.label: IL-8
nodes.description: IL-8 (CXCL8) is a prototypical SASP chemokine secreted by senescent cells, essential for neutrophil recruitment and, in tumors, cancer stemness via CXCR2 signaling. It is co-induced with IL-6 downstream of NF-kB and IL-1a and is frequently measured alongside IL-6 as a SASP readout. IL-8's roles in both inflammation and tumor promotion underscore the dual nature of the secretome, supporting wound-healing neutrophil influx acutely while contributing to chronic inflammation and therapy resistance. It is a canonical component of the senescent secretome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 介白素-8（IL-8）與 IL-6 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。IL-8 由衰老細胞分泌，重塑局部組織微環境並對鄰近細胞發揮旁分泌效應。在本研究中，重組 IL-8（以 1:2 比例與 IL-6 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現，此現象可由衰老細胞共培養重現，導致脂質過氧化升高並使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

nodes.label: Sox2
nodes.description: Sox2 maintains neural stem cells by preserving their self-renewal and multipotency, the ability to generate neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. Sox2 is expressed in neural stem cells of the developing and adult brain, where it is a central determinant of neural identity and is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for direct neural conversion. In reprogramming to induced neural stem cells, forced expression of Sox2 remodels the somatic epigenome toward a neural fate. Sox2 is thus a linchpin connecting pluripotency regulation to neurogenesis and neural repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sox2 透過保留神經幹細胞的自我更新和多能性、生成神經元、星狀膠質細胞和少突膠質細胞的能力來維持神經幹細胞。 Sox2 在發育中和成年 brain 的神經幹細胞中表達，它是神經身份的核心決定因素，對於直接神經轉換通常是必要的，有時是充分的。在對誘導神經幹細胞進行重編程時，Sox2 的強製表達將體細胞表觀基因組重塑為神經命運。因此，Sox2 是將多能性調節與神經生成和神經修復聯繫起來的關鍵。

nodes.label: CDK2
nodes.description: Cyclin A is an S/G2-phase cyclin whose complex with CDK2 initiates and executes S phase, with Cyclin A-CDK1 later contributing to mitotic entry. Cyclin A is then degraded via the APC/C at the metaphase-anaphase transition, enforcing irreversible cell-cycle progression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin A 是 S/G2 期的 cyclin，與 CDK2 形成的複合體啟動並執行 S 期，之後 Cyclin A-CDK1 參與有絲分裂進入。Cyclin A 隨後在中期-後期轉換時經 APC/C 降解，使細胞週期進展不可逆。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md

nodes.label: TNF-alpha
nodes.description: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) is a cell signaling protein (cytokine) involved in systemic Inflammation and one of the cytokines that make up the acute phase reaction. It is a potent activator of the NF-κB pathway, and low-level ROS promote the phosphorylation and degradation of IkappaBalpha by the IKK complex, allowing p65/p50 nuclear translocation. NF-κB then transcriptionally upregulates antioxidant genes (MnSOD, FTH1, HMOX1, glutathione peroxidases, catalase) that form a negative feedback loop limiting TNF-alpha-induced tissue damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腫瘤壞死因子 alpha (TNF-alpha) 是參與全身性 Inflammation 的細胞訊號蛋白（細胞激素），也是構成急性期反應的細胞激素之一。它是 NF-κB 途徑的強效活化劑；低濃度的 ROS 促進 IKK 複合體對 IkappaBalpha 的磷酸化與降解，使 p65/p50 得以轉位入核。NF-κB 隨後在轉錄層面上調抗氧化基因（MnSOD、FTH1、HMOX1、穀胱甘肽過氧化酶、catalase），形成限制 TNF-alpha 所致組織損傷的負回饋迴路。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA
nodes.description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: DNMT3a
nodes.description: Recurrent mutations in DNMT3A, notably the R882H hotspot mutation, are found in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cases. These mutations reduce the methyltransferase activity of DNMT3a, disrupting DNA methylation at regulatory regions that control hematopoietic stem cell behavior. The resulting epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis, and DNMT3A-mutant clones are frequently detectable in preleukemic states, linking age-associated clonal hematopoiesis to overt AML.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在約 20% 的急性髓性白血病 (AML) 病例中發現了 DNMT3A 的複發突變，尤其是 R882H 熱點突變。這些突變降低了 DNMT3a 的甲基轉移酶活性，破壞了控製造血幹細胞行為的調節區域的 DNA 甲基化。由此產生的表觀遺傳失調與其他突變共同驅動白血病發生，並且在白血病前期狀態中經常可以檢測到 DNMT3A 突變克隆，將年齡相關的克隆造血與明顯的 AML 聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
nodes.description: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) is one of the three canonical types of Autophagy (alongside Macroautophagy and Microautophagy). Unlike the other routes it does not require vesicle formation: cytosolic proteins carrying a KFERQ-like motif are delivered directly into the lysosome for enzymatic degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) 是 Autophagy 的三種典型類型之一（與 Macroautophagy、Microautophagy 並列）。與其他途徑不同，它不需要囊泡形成：帶有 KFERQ 類基序的細胞質蛋白質直接被運送進 lysosome 進行酵素分解。

nodes.label: ARH3
nodes.description: ARH3 is the only known hydrolase that removes serine-linked mono-ADP-ribose written by the PARP1/HPF1 complex, completing the ADP-ribosylation cycle after PARG removes bulk polymer. ARH3-KO cells accumulate serine-MAR while HPF1-KO cells lose it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARH3 是目前已知唯一可移除由 PARP1/HPF1 複合體寫入的絲氨酸單 ADP-核糖修飾的水解酶，在 PARG 移除大量聚合物後完成 ADP-ribosylation 循環。ARH3-KO 細胞堆積 serine-MAR，而 HPF1-KO 細胞則減少。

nodes.label: Replicative Senescence
nodes.description: WI-38 is a diploid human fetal lung fibroblast cell line derived by Leonard Hayflick in 1962. It has a finite replicative lifespan and enters replicative senescence after roughly 50 population doublings (reaching PDL55-60 by serial passage), which makes it a classical model system for cellular aging research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: WI-38 是 Leonard Hayflick 於 1962 年建立的二倍體人類胎兒肺纖維母細胞株。它具有有限的複製壽命，在約 50 次族群倍增後進入 replicative senescence（連續傳代約於 PDL55–60 達到），因此是細胞老化研究的經典模型系統。

nodes.label: ADP-ribosylation
nodes.description: ARH3 is the only known hydrolase that removes serine-linked mono-ADP-ribose written by the PARP1/HPF1 complex, completing the ADP-ribosylation cycle after PARG removes bulk polymer. ARH3-KO cells accumulate serine-MAR while HPF1-KO cells lose it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARH3 是目前已知唯一可移除由 PARP1/HPF1 複合體寫入的絲氨酸單 ADP-核糖修飾的水解酶，在 PARG 移除大量聚合物後完成 ADP-ribosylation 循環。ARH3-KO 細胞堆積 serine-MAR，而 HPF1-KO 細胞則減少。

nodes.label: ACSL4
nodes.description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) inhibition reduces PL-PUFA levels and lipid peroxidation without altering expression of ACSL4, the acyl-CoA synthetase that canonically drives PUFA incorporation into phospholipids during ferroptosis. After ACase knockdown, ACSL4 protein remained high, indicating that the decrease in PL-PUFAs is driven by reduced supply of saturated/monounsaturated fatty acids for Lands-cycle exchange (due to decreased ceramide lipolysis) rather than by changes in ACSL4. Both ACase and ACSL4 knockdown protect senescent cells against RSL3, but through supply-side versus incorporation-side mechanisms respectively.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸性膽鹼酯酶 (ACase) 抑制降低 PL-PUFA 水平和脂質過氧化而不改變 ACSL4 的表達，ACSᒪ4 是一種 canonically 驅動 PUFA 整合到磷脂中的 acyl-CoA  합성 효소。在 ACase 下調後，ACSL4 蛋白仍然很高，表明 PL-PUFAs 的減少是由飽和/單不飽和脂肪酸的供應減少（由於肌醇酯水解減少）所驅動，而不是由 ACSᒪ4 的變化所引起。ACase 和 ACSᒪ4 下調均能保護衰老細胞免受 RSL3 的影響，但分別通過供應側和整合側機制。

nodes.label: Neuropilin-1
nodes.description: Cleaved CendR engages Neuropilin-1 for tumor penetration as step two.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 切割的 CendR 接合 Neuropilin-1 以腫瘤穿透作為第二步。

nodes.label: Hemoglobin
nodes.description: Amyl nitrite intentionally oxidizes hemoglobin iron from Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, creating methemoglobin that scavenges cyanide as cyanmethemoglobin and spares mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase — the mechanism behind its historical use in cyanide poisoning. The same oxidation causes methemoglobinemia, cyanosis and hypoxia on overuse.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amyl nitrite 會將 Hemoglobin 的鐵由 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，形成 Methemoglobin，以 cyanmethemoglobin 形式螯合氰化物並保護粒線體 cytochrome oxidase——這是其在氰化物中毒中歷史性用途的機制。相同的氧化在過量使用時會造成 Methemoglobinemia、Cyanosis 與 Hypoxia。

nodes.label: G1 Phase
nodes.description: The G1 Phase (Gap 1) is the first gap phase of the cell cycle in eukaryotic cell division, following mitosis or exit from quiescence and preceding S phase. During G1 the cell grows, synthesizes RNAs and proteins, and monitors its environment before committing to DNA replication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G1 期（第一間隙期）是真核細胞分裂中細胞週期的第一個間隙期，緊接有絲分裂或退出靜止期，並先於 S 期。在 G1 期，細胞生長、合成 RNA 和蛋白質，並在決定進行 DNA 複製前監測其環境。

nodes.label: Incoherent Bivalent Motif
nodes.description: Atypical dose-response curves where a drug's effect does not follow a monotonic shape are referred to as hormetic or biphasic. This computational study shows that all hormetic networks share a similar core structure: an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of the drug, in which the two interactions emanating from the target have net opposite (direct or indirect) effects over the downstream output. Around 18% of all three-node network topologies contain this motif, and topologies with an incoherent bivalent motif show a roughly five-fold increased probability of exhibiting hormesis compared with all topologies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藥物效應不呈單調形狀的非典型劑量反應曲線稱為荷爾米希（hormetic）或雙相反應。這項計算研究顯示，所有荷爾米希網路共享相似的核心結構：以藥物靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體（incoherent bivalent network motif），其中由靶點發出的兩條交互作用對下游輸出具有淨相反（直接或間接）的效應。約 18% 的三節點網路拓撲含有此模體，而含有不一致雙價模體的拓撲展現荷爾米希反應的機率約為所有拓撲的五倍。

nodes.label: PP2A
nodes.description: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。

nodes.label: Ceramide
nodes.description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile. Acid ceramidase breaks down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition. In senescent cells, progressively higher expression of this enzyme drives a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids - the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Salk Institute researchers studying human lung cells discovered that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis and that removal of the enzyme protects both young and old cells from ferroptosis-induced death. Because acid ceramidase inhibitors already exist for other therapeutic purposes, the enzyme represents a druggable target for clearing senescent cells and supporting healthy aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。 酸陶瓷酶將絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，重塑膜脂類組成。在老化的細胞中，這種酶的表達水平隨著時間推移而升高，導致富含不飽和脂肪酸的促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。沙鹿研究所研究員在研究人類肺細胞時發現，升高後的酸陶瓷酶使老化的細胞更容易受到焦蛋白死亡的影響，並且去除這種酶可以保護年輕和年老的細胞免受焦蛋白誘導的死亡。因為酸陶瓷酶抑制劑已經存在於其他治療用途中，因此這種酶是一個可藥物標靶的目標，可以用於清除老化的細胞並支持健康老齡化。

nodes.label: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids
nodes.description: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids are monohydroxylated metabolites of Arachidonic acid, formed by addition of a single hydroxyl group at defined positions along the carbon chain. They are the hydroxy counterparts of the hydroperoxy intermediates (HPETEs) generated during Lipid Peroxidation and by lipoxygenase catalysis. Of the family, 5-HETE is the committed precursor of Leukotrienes, 15-HETE feeds lipoxin A4, and 20-HETE is a CYP4A/CYP4F product that constricts renal and cerebral arterioles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids 是 Arachidonic acid 的單羥化代謝物，由在碳鏈上特定位置加上一個羥基而形成。它們是 Lipid Peroxidation 與 lipoxygenase 催化過程中所產生過氧中間物（HPETEs）的羥基對應物。在這一族中，5-HETE 是 Leukotrienes 的承诺前驅物，15-HETE 通往 lipoxin A4，而 20-HETE 則為 CYP4A/CYP4F 產物，可收縮腎臟與腦動脈小動脈。

nodes.label: SMAD3
nodes.description: SMAD3 is the co-primary R-SMAD complexing with SMAD4 for nuclear action. Parallel edge to the SMAD2 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SMAD3 是與 SMAD4 形成複合體入核作用的共同主要 R-SMAD。與 SMAD2 活化平行的邊。

nodes.label: 4-Hydroxynonenal
nodes.description: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers.
