As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Vimentin
nodes.description: The N308K substitution selectively reduces SIRT6-vimentin interaction, which normally promotes SIRT6 degradation, thereby increasing SIRT6 protein levels. Directionally, N308K sits upstream of weakened vimentin binding. This stabilizes SIRT6 and enhances its functional output, and it is the molecular explanation for the centenarian variant phenotype. Because vimentin normally targets SIRT6 for proteasomal degradation, the N308K variant escapes this turnover. This post-translational stabilization, rather than transcriptional upregulation, underlies the increased SIRT6 abundance seen in carriers of the longevity-associated variant.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N308K 取代選擇性地減少 SIRT6-vimentin 的相互作用——後者通常促進 SIRT6 降解——從而增加 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，N308K 位於 vimentin 結合弱化的上游。這穩定 SIRT6 並增強其功能輸出，是百歲人瑞變異體表型的分子解釋。由於 vimentin 通常靶向 SIRT6 進行蛋白酶體降解，N308K 變異體逃避了這種周轉。這種轉錄後穩定化（而非轉錄上調）構成了長壽相關變異體攜帶者中 SIRT6 豐度增加的基礎。

nodes.label: Diabetic nephropathy
nodes.description: Albuminuria is the abnormal excretion of plasma albumin into the urine, marking increased glomerular permeability. It is among the earliest detectable manifestations of Diabetic nephropathy, tracks with worsening glomerular injury, and predicts progression to end-stage renal disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Albuminuria 是血漿白蛋白異常排入尿液的情形，標記腎小球通透性增加。它是 Diabetic nephropathy 最早可偵測的表現之一，與腎小球損傷惡化相關，並可預測疾病進展至末期腎病。

nodes.label: Serotonin Syndrome
nodes.description: Serotonin syndrome has been reported following administration of methylene blue, particularly when used concomitantly with medications that increase serotonergic activity, including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, and monoamine oxidase inhibitors, certain opioids, and dextromethorphan. The FDA labeling carries a boxed warning that methylene blue may cause serious or fatal serotonin syndrome when combined with serotonergic drugs and opioids, and recommends avoiding concomitant use entirely. Clinical manifestations include altered mental status, autonomic instability, neuromuscular abnormalities, seizures, and gastrointestinal symptoms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在施用methylene blue後已有血清素症候群的報告，特別是當與增加血清素能活性的藥物同時使用時，包括選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑和單胺氧化酶抑制劑、某些鴉片類藥物和dextromethorphan。FDA標籤帶有方框警告，指出methylene blue與血清素能藥物和鴉片類藥物結合使用可能導致嚴重或致命的血清素症候群，並建議完全避免同時使用。臨床表現包括精神狀態改變、自主神經不穩定、神經肌肉異常、癲癇發作和胃腸道症狀。

nodes.label: HIRA
nodes.description: H3.3 is a replication-independent histone variant deposited by dedicated chaperones, principally HIRA at gene bodies and enhancers. Because senescent cells have exited the cell cycle, H3.3 deposition becomes increasingly reliant on the HIRA complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3.3 是非複製依賴的組蛋白變異體，由專屬伴護蛋白（主要是在基因體與增強子處的 HIRA）沉積。由於衰老細胞已退出細胞週期，H3.3 沉積日益依賴 HIRA 複合體。

nodes.label: Cysteine
nodes.description: N-acetylcysteine is deacetylated to cysteine, whose availability governs the activity of glutamate-cysteine ligase, the rate-limiting enzyme of glutathione synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱胺酸去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，其可用性決定穀胱甘肽合成限速酶麩胺酸-半胱胺酸連接酶的活性。

nodes.label: Gene Expression
nodes.description: RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) is a high-throughput sequencing method that profiles the complete set of RNA transcripts in a biological sample and quantifies gene expression. The workflow runs RNA extraction, poly-A selection or ribosomal RNA depletion, reverse transcription to cDNA, adapter ligation and PCR library preparation, sequencing, then bioinformatics read alignment and quantification with tools such as DESeq2 for differential expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA-seq（RNA 定序）是一種高通量定序方法，可剖析生物樣本中完整的 RNA 轉錄本集合並量化基因表現。工作流程包含 RNA 萃取、poly-A 篩選或核糖體 RNA 去除、逆转錄成 cDNA、接头連接與 PCR 文庫製備、定序，最後以 DESeq2 等工具進行讀段比對與差異表現量化。

nodes.label: BH3 mimetics
nodes.description: Apoptosis is restored by BH3 mimetics. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Apoptosis, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: BRCA1
nodes.description: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

nodes.label: Embryonic Stem Cells
nodes.description: Leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) is an IL-6-family cytokine that maintains Embryonic Stem Cells in pluripotency and self-renewal via STAT3 signalling. In differentiation assays LIF is withheld, or cells are plated without feeders, so lineage commitment can proceed and embryoid bodies form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Leukemia inhibitory factor（LIF）是 IL-6 家族細胞激素，透過 STAT3 訊號維持 Embryonic Stem Cells 的多能性與自我更新。在分化實驗中會撤除 LIF（或將細胞以無飼養層方式培養），以允許譜系決定並形成類胚體。

nodes.label: Glioblastoma
nodes.description: Glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs) drive therapy resistance and recurrence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤幹細胞樣細胞 (GSCs) 驅動治療抵抗和復發。

nodes.label: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta
nodes.description: The Striatum receives dopaminergic input from the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta via the Nigrostriatal System, and degeneration of this pathway is the central pathological event in Parkinson's Disease — dopamine depletion in the putamen produces bradykinesia, rigidity and tremor. The Striatum also receives Prefrontal Cortex input forming cortico-basal ganglia loops essential for executive control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Striatum 經由 Nigrostriatal System 接收來自 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 的 dopaminergic 輸入，而此路徑的退化正是 Parkinson's Disease 的核心病理事件——putamen 的 dopamine 耗竭造成 bradykinesia、rigidity 與 tremor。Striatum 亦接收 Prefrontal Cortex 輸入，形成執行控制所必需的皮質-basal ganglia 迴路。

nodes.label: PARK7
nodes.description: PARK7 mutations (L166P, M26I) cause early-onset autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease. DJ-1-deficient neurons show fragmented mitochondria, Complex I impairment, and accelerated α-synuclein aggregation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARK7 突變（L166P、M26I）造成早發性體染色體隱性遺傳帕金森氏症。DJ-1 缺失的神經元呈現粒線體碎片化、Complex I 功能受損與 α-synuclein 聚集加速。

nodes.label: Integrins
nodes.description: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

nodes.label: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
nodes.description: NASH is the inflammatory, potentially progressive form of Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Where simple steatosis is fat accumulation alone, NASH adds hepatocyte injury, Inflammation and variable fibrosis, and it can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NASH 是 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 中具發炎性且可能進展的形式。單純脂肪肝僅有脂肪堆積，而 NASH 額外加上肝細胞損傷、Inflammation 與程度不一的纖維化，並可進展為肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

nodes.label: Central Nervous System
nodes.description: Astrocytes are the most abundant glial cell type of the Central Nervous System, providing metabolic, structural and homeostatic support to Neuron and contributing to formation and maintenance of the Blood-Brain Barrier.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Astrocytes 是 Central Nervous System 中最豐富的神經膠細胞類型，為 Neuron 提供代謝、結構與恆定維持上的支持，並參與 Blood-Brain Barrier 的形成與維持。

nodes.label: MPTP
nodes.description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Regulatory T Cell
nodes.description: TGF-beta1 is the canonical inducer of FoxP3+ regulatory T cell differentiation. In combination with IL-2 it drives the TGF-beta1 pathway's Smad/FoxP3 program toward a suppressive phenotype, which is why regulatory T cells are classed with TGF-beta1 as central to maintaining self-tolerance — and why tumors and senescent niches actively recruit them to evade immune attack.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-beta1 是 FoxP3+ 調節性 T 細胞分化的標準誘導因子。它與 IL-2 協同推動 TGF-beta1 途徑的 Smad/FoxP3 程式走向抑制性表型，因此調節性 T 細胞與 TGF-beta1 同為維持自身耐受的核心；這也是腫瘤與老化 niche 會主動招募它們以逃避免疫攻擊的原因。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Dynamics
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

nodes.label: BRD4
nodes.description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Cytochrome c
nodes.description: Methylene blue (MB) accepts electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I and transfers them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing respiratory chain Complexes I-III. In isolated-mitochondria complex I-III assays with NADH as electron donor, MB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction, while the negative-control antimycin A (a complex III inhibitor) blocked it. This electron shunt underlies MB's ability to maintain oxidative phosphorylation and ATP production when upstream complexes are inhibited, and it is the mechanistic basis for MB's enhancement of cellular oxygen consumption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過線粒體複合體 I 接受來自 NADH 的電子，並直接轉移到細胞色素 c，有效地繞過呼吸鏈複合體 I-III。在以 NADH 為電子供體的分離線粒體複合體 I-III 檢測中，MB 顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，而陰性對照抗黴素 A（一種複合體 III 抑制劑）則阻斷了它。這種電子旁路是 MB 在當上游複合體被抑制時仍能維持氧化磷酸化和 ATP 產生的基礎，也是 MB 增強細胞氧氣消耗的機制基礎。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Cyclophilin D
nodes.description: Cyclophilin D (PPIF) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase and the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. It binds the pore and promotes its opening in response to matrix calcium overload and reactive oxygen species, thereby gating cytochrome c release upstream of the caspase cascade and making CypD a senolytic target in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin D（PPIF）是粒線體基質的 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase，也是 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 的主要正向調節者。它結合孔道並在基質鈣過載與 Reactive Oxygen Species 作用下促進孔道開啟，藉此在 caspase 级聯上游控制 Cytochrome c 釋放，並使 CypD 成為衰老細胞的 senolytic 標的。

nodes.label: Metabolic Syndromes
nodes.description: HNF4α is an orphan nuclear receptor and master transcriptional regulator of hepatocyte differentiation, liver metabolism, and lipid homeostasis, governing gluconeogenesis, fatty acid oxidation, lipoprotein assembly, and bile acid synthesis. HNF4A mutations cause MODY1, underscoring its role in glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and hepatic glucose homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HNF4α 是孤兒核受體，也是肝細胞分化、肝臟代謝與脂質恆定的主控轉錄調節因子，掌控糖質新生、脂肪酸氧化、脂蛋白組裝與膽汁酸合成。HNF4A 突變會造成 MODY1，凸顯其在葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌與肝臟葡萄糖恆定中的角色。

nodes.label: CDH1
nodes.description: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

nodes.label: SAHF
nodes.description: SAHF are assembled by the HIRA-ASF1a histone chaperone complex, which deposits macroH2A and core histones to establish H3K9me3-marked heterochromatin at the foci. This chaperone-driven deposition is required for the formation of the DAPI-dense nuclear bodies that characterize senescent cells, and it is coordinated with hypophosphorylated Rb. The process links histone dynamics directly to senescence-specific chromatin reorganization. HIRA/ASF1a thus provide the assembly machinery for the repressive structures that lock in the arrested state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAHF 由 HIRA-ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體組裝，該複合體沉積 macroH2A 與核心組蛋白以在焦點建立 H3K9me3 標記的異染色質。此伴護蛋白驅動的沉積對形成定義衰老細胞的 DAPI 緻密核體為必要，且與低磷酸化 Rb 協調。此過程將組蛋白動態直接連結到衰老特異性染色質重組。HIRA/ASF1a 因此提供將停滯狀態鎖入的抑制性結構的組裝機器。

nodes.label: Cell Membranes
nodes.description: Aquaporins are a conserved family of integral membrane proteins forming selective channels for rapid passive water movement across biological membranes down osmotic gradients. Each monomer has six transmembrane helices around a narrow central pore and channels assemble as tetramers; NPA motifs and an ar/R constriction form the selectivity filter that permits single-file water transport while excluding protons and ions. Aquaglyceroporins (AQP3, AQP7, AQP9) also conduct glycerol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aquaporin 是一群保守的整合膜蛋白，形成選擇性通道，使水分沿滲透梯度快速被動通過生物膜。每個單體具有圍繞狹窄中央孔道的六段跨膜螺旋，通道以四聚體組裝；NPA 序列與 ar/R 收縮構成選擇性濾器，允許單列水分子通過並排除質子與離子。Aquaglyceroporin（AQP3、AQP7、AQP9）亦可運送 glycerol。

nodes.label: Oxidation
nodes.description: Oxidation in biological systems — both enzymatic and non-enzymatic — is a major source of Reactive Oxygen Species. Non-enzymatic autoxidation of catechols reduces molecular oxygen to Superoxide, which dismutates to Hydrogen Peroxide and perpetuates oxidative chain reactions, coupling oxidation chemistry directly to oxidative damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 生物體內的氧化（酵素性與非酵素性皆是）都是 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要來源。非酵素性兒茶酚自氧化會將分子氧還原為 Superoxide，後者歧化為 Hydrogen Peroxide 並延續氧化鏈反應，將氧化化學直接連結至氧化傷害。

nodes.label: Serotonin
nodes.description: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors block the serotonin transporter (and the norepinephrine transporter), raising synaptic Serotonin and Norepinephrine; this dual action is exploited in depression, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors 阻斷 serotonin 轉運蛋白（以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白），提高突觸內的 Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine；此雙重作用被應用於憂鬱症、廣泛性焦慮症、糖尿病神經病變疼痛與纖維肌痛。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

nodes.label: D1 receptor
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons express D1 receptors on the direct pathway, where D1 activation promotes movement facilitation by disinhibiting thalamocortical output. The D1/D2 dichotomy partitions striatal output into direct and indirect pathways with opposing effects on motor control, providing the framework for understanding dopamine action in the basal ganglia. Dopamine's action at D1 receptors is thus a key node modulated by the dopamine tone that COMT helps set in regions of lower DAT density. D1 signaling is also implicated in reward and incentive learning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 在直接途徑上表達 D1 受體，其中 D1 活化透過去抑制丘腦皮質輸出來促進 movement 的促進。 D1/D2 二分法將紋狀體輸出分為直接和間接途徑，對 motor control 有相反的影響，為理解 basal ganglia 中的多巴胺作用提供了框架。因此，Dopamine 對 D1 受體的作用是受多巴胺音調調節的關鍵節點，COMT 有助於在 DAT 密度較低的區域中設定多巴胺音調。 D1 訊號傳導也與 reward 和激勵學習有關。

nodes.label: mPOS
nodes.description: mPOS (mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress) arises when mitochondrial precursor proteins accumulate in the cytosol beyond the capacity of quality control pathways. Because roughly 1000 mitochondrial proteins are synthesized on cytosolic ribosomes before import, any impairment of the TOM/TIM translocons, loss of membrane potential, or saturation of the import machinery causes cytosolic accumulation. The accumulated precursors aggregate and sequester chaperones, disturbing proteostasis and triggering proteotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當粒線體前驅蛋白在細胞質中累積、超出品質管制路徑的處理能力時，即形成 mPOS（粒線體前驅蛋白過度累積壓力）。由於約 1000 種粒線體蛋白在細胞質核糖體上合成後才輸入，TOM/TIM 轉位子受損、膜電位喪失或輸入機制飽和都會造成細胞質累積。這些累積的前驅蛋白會聚集並滯留分子伴護蛋白，破壞蛋白恆定並引發蛋白毒性。

nodes.label: Natalizumab (Tysabri)
nodes.description: Natalizumab (Tysabri) blocks the VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction by antagonizing alpha4 integrin, reducing T-cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier in multiple sclerosis. This dampens CNS inflammation but leaves patients susceptible to progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. The directionality is integrin blockade to reduced leukocyte entry. A caveat is that broad alpha4 inhibition also affects gut homing, causing PML and other risks that limit use. The drug's efficacy in MS validates the VCAM-1/VLA-4 pathway as a driver of neuroinflammation, though its safety profile demands careful monitoring.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Natalizumab (Tysabri) 透過拮抗 α4 整合素來阻斷 VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction，從而減少 ros 中 multiple sclerosis 中血腦障壁的 T 細胞運輸。這可以抑制中樞神經系統炎症，但使患者容易患上進行性多灶性白質腦病變。方向性是整合素阻斷以減少白血球進入。需要注意的是，廣泛的 alpha4 抑制也會影響腸道歸巢，導致 PML 和其他限制使用的風險。該藥物對多發性硬化症的療效證實了 VCAM-1/VLA-4 路徑作為神經發炎的驅動因素，但其安全性需要仔細監測。

nodes.label: Frailty
nodes.description: The clinical frailty index operationalizes frailty as a continuous score over accumulated health deficits; the Whitehead index scores 31 parameters spanning body condition, locomotion and integumentary signs in mice and correlates with biological age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 臨床 frailty index 將 frailty 操作化為累積健康缺損的連續分數；Whitehead 指數在小鼠中評分涵蓋身體狀況、運動與皮膚徵象的 31 項參數，並與生物學年齡相關。

nodes.label: Females
nodes.description: Women have higher NAD+/NADH redox ratios (1.33 vs 1.09) that narrow with biological age, and women's NAD+ levels fluctuate without the monotonic age decline seen in men. Estrogen stabilizes PARP-1 to spare NAD+, protecting sirtuin (SIRT1/SIRT3) activity into midlife; post-menopausal women face a 'double decline' as hormonal shifts compound age-related NAD+ changes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 女性具較高的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原比值（1.33 對 1.09），且隨生物年齡增寬而縮小；女性 NAD+ 水平波動，無男性那樣的單調年齡下降。雌激素使 PARP-1 穩定以節省 NAD+，將 sirtuin（SIRT1/SIRT3）活性保護至中年；停經後女性則面臨荷爾蒙變化與年齡相關 NAD+ 改變疊加的「雙重下降」。

nodes.label: PPARα
nodes.description: PPARα is a nuclear receptor transcription factor whose activation induces fatty acid oxidation, ketogenesis and lipid metabolism programs, lowering triglycerides and improving the lipid profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PPARα 是核受體轉錄因子，其活化會誘導脂肪酸氧化、生酮與脂質代謝程式，降低三酸甘油酯並改善脂質剖面。

nodes.label: Insulin Sensitivity
nodes.description: SIRT1 enhances insulin sensitivity by deacetylating and repressing PTP1B, a negative regulator of insulin signaling, and by activating PGC-1α-driven mitochondrial biogenesis. Because PTP1B removal relieves inhibition of the insulin receptor/IRS/PI3K/Akt cascade, GLUT4 translocation and glucose uptake rise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由去乙醯化並抑制胰島素訊號的負向調節因子 PTP1B，以及活化 PGC-1α 驅動的 Mitochondrial Biogenesis，來提升 Insulin Sensitivity。由於 PTP1B 被去除可解除對胰島素受體／IRS／PI3K/Akt 級聯的抑制，GLUT4 轉位與葡萄糖攝取因而上升。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: Tyrosinase
nodes.description: Tyrosinase and Neuromelanin Synthesis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Tyrosinase and Neuromelanin Synthesis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 和 Neuromelanin Synthesis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Tyrosinase 和 Neuromelanin Synthesis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: SLC7A11
nodes.description: SLC7A11 (xCT) is a 12-pass transmembrane SLC7 protein encoding the catalytic light chain of the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter. It contains the substrate-binding pocket for cystine and glutamate and is covalently linked by a conserved disulfide bond to the heavy chain SLC3A2 (4F2hc/CD98); the SLC7A11–SLC3A2 heterodimer is the functional unit, and SLC7A11 alone is retained in the ER and cannot reach the plasma membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC7A11（xCT）是 12 次跨膜的 SLC7 蛋白，編碼 system Xc- 胱胺／麩胺酸反向運輸體的催化輕鏈。它含有辨識胱胺與麩胺酸的受質結合口袋，並透過保守的二硫鍵與重鏈 SLC3A2（4F2hc／CD98）共價連結；SLC7A11–SLC3A2 異二聚體才是功能單元，单独的 SLC7A11 會滯留於內質網而無法到達質膜。

nodes.label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence
nodes.description: The senolytic paradox arises because oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) arrests BRAF/RAS/MYC-driven cells in a benign lesion as a cell-autonomous fail-safe enforced by p53, p16INK4A and RB1. Clearing those OIS cells removes a cancer barrier rather than a risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senolytic paradox 之所以出現，是因為 oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) 以 p53、p16INK4A 與 RB1 為基礎，細胞自主地將帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 驅動突變的細胞阻滯在良性病灶中。清除這些 OIS 細胞等於移除一道癌症屏障，而非移除風險。

nodes.label: Cathepsins
nodes.description: Cathepsins B, L and S are frequently upregulated in malignant tumours, where they degrade extracellular matrix components to facilitate invasion and metastasis. Their secretion by cancer cells and tumour-associated macrophages creates pericellular proteolytic hotspots that drive tissue invasion and also promote angiogenesis and modulate immune surveillance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cathepsins B、L 與 S 在惡性腫瘤中常見表現上調，藉由降解 Extracellular Matrix 成分來促進侵犯與轉移。癌細胞與腫瘤相關巨噬細胞分泌這些蛋白酶，製造細胞周圍的蛋白水解熱點以驅動組織侵犯，並同時促進血管新生與調節免疫監視。

nodes.label: Transcription Factor
nodes.description: Transcription factors bind promoter/enhancer DNA to control gene output. Definitional regulator-to-process edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子結合啟動子/增強子 DNA 以控制基因輸出。定義性調節者到過程邊。

nodes.label: SAMD
nodes.description: SAMD (senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction) is a specific form of mitochondrial dysfunction that is a hallmark of senescent cells, encompassing reduced oxidative phosphorylation, altered mitochondrial dynamics, and elevated ROS production. It is distinct from generalized mitochondrial disease in being a programmed, senescence-associated feature that both results from and feeds back into the arrested state. SAMD drives the SASP through ROS and mtDNA release, coupling metabolic derangement to inflammation. Its classification as mitochondrial dysfunction situates it within the metabolic hallmarks of aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAMD（senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction，衰老相關粒線體功能障礙）是粒線體功能障礙的一種特定形式，是衰老細胞的特徵，涵蓋氧化磷酸化降低、粒線體動態改變與 ROS 產生升高。它不同於一般性粒線體疾病之處，在於其為一種程序性、衰老相關的特徵，既由停滯狀態產生又回饋至停滯狀態。SAMD 透過 ROS 與 mtDNA 釋放驅動 SASP，將代謝失調耦合到發炎。其歸類為粒線體功能障礙，使其定位於老化的代謝特徵之中。

nodes.label: Lipophagy
nodes.description: MXL-3 represses lipophagy when food is available. As a Max-like bHLH-LZ transcription factor it occupies the CACGTG sites in the promoters of the lysosomal lipase genes lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3 and lipl-5, keeping the lipolytic program off; fasting drops mxl-3 mRNA and MXL-3 rapidly leaves the intestinal nuclei, relieving that repression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在食物可得時，MXL-3 抑制 lipophagy。這個 Max-like bHLH-LZ 轉錄因子佔據溶酶體脂肪酶基因 lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3 與 lipl-5 啟動子上的 CACGTG 位點，使脂肪分解程式維持關閉；禁食時 mxl-3 mRNA 下降，MXL-3 迅速離開腸道細胞核，因而解除此抑制。

nodes.label: mtDNA
nodes.description: mtDNA released by minority MOMP activates cGAS-STING, driving type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP without causing full cell death. The cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern recognized by cGAS, linking mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD) directly to innate immune activation. This activation is a pivotal bridge between metabolism and senescence inflammation and also enhances immune surveillance of the arrested cell. It is a well-validated mechanism in multiple senescence models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 少數 MOMP 釋放的 mtDNA 活化 cGAS-STING，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 而不引起完全細胞死亡。胞質 mtDNA 作為 cGAS 辨識的損傷相關分子模式，將粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）直接連結到先天免疫活化。此活化是代謝與衰老發炎間的關鍵橋樑，也增強對停滯細胞的免疫監視。它在多種衰老模型中為良好驗證的機制。

nodes.label: Nucleosome Remodeling
nodes.description: Nucleosome remodeling capacity decreases with age, accompanied by the loss of core histones and nucleosome occupancy. In aging yeast, nucleosome occupancy decreases by up to 50 percent and half the core histone proteins are lost, and similar chromatin decompaction occurs in worms and human cells. Reduced histone abundance and nucleosome loss decompact chromatin, increasing DNA accessibility and transcriptional noise while contributing to genomic instability in aging cells. These findings support the view that chromatin decompaction is a fundamental driver of age-related dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nucleosome 重塑能力隨著年齡的增長而降低，伴隨著核心組蛋白和核小體佔據的損失。在老化的酵母菌中，核小體佔有率下降高達 50%，一半的核心組蛋白流失，蠕蟲和人類細胞中也會發生類似的染色質解壓縮。組蛋白豐度的減少和核小體的流失會使染色質解壓縮，增加 DNA 的可及性和轉錄噪音，同時導致老化細胞的基因組不穩定。這些發現支持這樣的觀點：染色質解壓縮是與年齡相關的功能障礙的根本驅動因素。

nodes.label: ATM Kinase
nodes.description: Ionizing radiation activates ATM kinase by causing DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM, which then phosphorylates Chk2, p53, and BRCA1 to coordinate the damage response. This initiates cell-cycle arrest and repair. The directionality is DNA break to kinase signaling cascade. A caveat is that ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. ATM is considered the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response to double-strand breaks, integrating cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis decisions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過引起 DNA 雙股斷裂來活化 ATM kinase，從而募集 ATM 並使其自磷酸化，然後 ATM 磷酸化 Chk2、p53 和 BRCA1 以協調損傷反應。這啟動了細胞週期停滯和修復。方向性是 DNA 斷裂至激酶訊號級聯。需要注意的是，ATM 也會對 oxidative stress 和複製壓力做出反應，因此它的活化並不是唯一由輻射驅動的。 ATM 被認為是對雙股斷裂的 DNA 損傷反應的主協調員，整合了細胞週期停滯、修復和 apoptosis 決策。

nodes.label: Epstein-Barr virus
nodes.description: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

nodes.label: N-Formylkynurenine
nodes.description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

nodes.label: TGF-beta1
nodes.description: TGF-beta receptors are the prototypical receptors for the TGF-beta1 ligand. This ligand-receptor pairing defines the signaling module.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 受體是 TGF-beta1 配體的典型受體。此配體—受體配對定義訊號模組。

nodes.label: CD36
nodes.description: Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1, THBS1) is a large matricellular glycoprotein secreted by platelets, endothelial cells and Macrophages that binds CD36. Binding of this ligand to the receptor is what initiates TSP-1 signalling, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake to adhesion, survival and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thrombospondin-1（TSP-1、THBS1）是由血小板、內皮細胞與 Macrophages 分泌的大型基質細胞糖蛋白，可與 CD36 結合。正是這種配體與受體的結合啟動了 TSP-1 訊號，將 CD36 的角色從脂質攝取擴展到黏附、存活與發炎。

nodes.label: UCP1
nodes.description: UCP1 is a mitochondrial inner-membrane carrier expressed almost exclusively in brown adipose tissue. It transports protons from the intermembrane space back into the matrix, short-circuiting the proton gradient set up by the Electron Transport Chain so that energy is released as heat rather than captured as ATP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UCP1 是幾乎專一表現於 Brown Adipose Tissue 的粒線體內膜載體。它將質子由膜間腔運回基質，使 Electron Transport Chain 建立的質子梯度短路，能量因此以熱的形式釋放，而非被捕捉成 ATP。

nodes.label: Thymic Epithelial Cells
nodes.description: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) are the stromal cells of the thymus that form the three-dimensional network required for Thymopoiesis. Cortical TECs support early thymocyte development, present self-peptide/MHC for positive selection and provide chemokine gradients, while medullary TECs express tissue-restricted antigens via AIRE and mediate negative selection, establishing central self-tolerance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thymic epithelial cells（TECs）是胸腺的基質細胞，形成 Thymopoiesis 所必需的三維網絡。皮質 TECs 支持早期胸腺細胞發育、呈現自身胜肽/MHC 以進行正向選擇並提供趨化激素梯度；髓質 TECs 則透過 AIRE 表達組織限定抗原並介導負向選擇，建立中樞自我耐受。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Uncoupling
nodes.description: Mitochondrial Uncoupling dissipates the proton motive force across the inner membrane without ATP synthesis, releasing the energy as heat and therefore lowering the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Uncoupling 讓內膜兩側的質子動力勢在未合成 ATP 的情況下消散，能量以熱的形式釋放，因而降低 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential。

nodes.label: PYCR1
nodes.description: PYCR1 requires NADH or NADPH as its obligate reducing cofactor (P5C + NAD(P)H + H+ → L-proline + NAD(P)+), and its consumption of mitochondrial NADH can shift the NAD+/NADH ratio and alter mitochondrial metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PYCR1 需要 NADH 或 NADPH 作為其必需的還原輔因子（P5C + NAD(P)H + H⁺ → L-脯胺酸 + NAD(P)⁺），其消耗粒線體 NADH 可改變 NAD+/NADH 比例並擾動粒線體代謝。

nodes.label: ELK4
nodes.description: ELK4 (SAP-1) belongs to the ETS-domain ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of transcription factors, defined by a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain. Within sirtuin biology, ELK4 is notable for interacting with SIRT7 and stabilizing the deacetylase at target gene promoters, where SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 and represses tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, ELK4's identity as an ETS factor underlies its promoter-targeting function. This links the ETS transcription factor family to the pro-oncogenic SIRT7-H3K18ac axis in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ELK4（SAP-1）屬於 ETS 結構域三元複合物因子（TCF）轉錄因子亞家族，其特徵是保守的 ETS DNA 結合結構域。在 sirtuin 生物學中，ELK4 因與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處而引人注目，在那裡 SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。方向性上 ELK4 作為 ETS 因子的身份奠定了其啟動子靶向功能。這將 ETS 轉錄因子家族與癌症中的促致癌 SIRT7-H3K18ac 軸線聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma
nodes.description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

nodes.label: Senolytic
nodes.description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senolytic. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senolytics are agents that preferentially kill senescent cells, often by disabling their anti-apoptotic SCAP survival networks. The directionality runs from Senolytic toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senolytic is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 用 Senolytic 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它們是優先殺死衰老細胞的藥物，通常是透過禁用其抗凋亡 SCAP 生存網絡來實現的。方向性從 Senolytic 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senolytic 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Silver compounds
nodes.description: Silver compounds are the source materials whose ingested or inhaled silver is absorbed into the circulation and ultimately deposited as elemental silver or silver sulfide granules in tissue, producing the irreversible blue-gray discoloration of Argyria. Insoluble Silver salts are converted along the way into soluble, protein-bound species that can cross into tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Silver compounds 是被吸收 silver 的來源材料，經攝入或吸入後進入循環系統，最後以金屬 silver 或 silver sulfide 顆粒沉積於組織，造成 Argyria 不可逆的青灰色色素沉著。過程中不溶性的 Silver salts 會轉變為可溶的蛋白結合態物種後進入組織。

nodes.label: Metabolome
nodes.description: The Metabolome — the complete set of small-molecule chemicals present in a sample, cell, or organism at a given moment — is profiled by untargeted or targeted metabolomics using Mass Spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance. The resulting fingerprints are highly dynamic, shifting over seconds to hours with feeding, exercise, circadian rhythm, and stress, and serve as sensitive Biomarkers of physiological state and disease risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolome——在特定時刻存在於樣本、細胞或生物體中的全部小分子化學物集合——是透過以 Mass Spectrometry 與核磁共振進行的非標定或標定式代謝組學來描繪的。所得的指紋變動極快，會隨進食、運動、晝夜節律與壓力在數秒至數小時間尺度上改變，並可作為生理狀態與疾病風險的敏感 Biomarkers。

nodes.label: Caspases
nodes.description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: Superoxide anion
nodes.description: Superoxide anion is the upstream precursor of Hydrogen Peroxide: the enzyme Superoxide Dismutase dismutates superoxide into H2O2, and other enzymes such as NADPH Oxidase, Xanthine Oxidase and MAO generate H2O2 directly. In mitochondria MnSOD (SOD2) performs the same dismutation, feeding the peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin water arm.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Superoxide anion 是 Hydrogen Peroxide 的上游前驅物：酵素 Superoxide Dismutase 將超氧陰離子歧化為 H2O2，而 NADPH Oxidase、Xanthine Oxidase 與 MAO 等酵素則直接產生 H2O2。在粒線體中，MnSOD（SOD2）執行同樣的歧化反應，供應 peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin 水臂使用。

nodes.label: Glutathione Peroxidase
nodes.description: Glutathione peroxidase reduces free hydrogen peroxide to water and organic hydroperoxides to their corresponding alcohols, using reduced glutathione as a cofactor. It is one of the main enzymatic components of the cellular antioxidant defense against ROS-induced damage, and its activity is impaired by glycation, raising oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 以還原型 glutathione 為輔因子，將游離 hydrogen peroxide 還原為水，並將有機 hydroperoxide 還原為相應的醇。它是細胞對抗 ROS 損傷的抗氧化防禦主要酵素組件之一，其活性會因 glycation 而下降，導致 oxidative stress 上升。

nodes.label: Small-cell lung cancer
nodes.description: Small-cell lung cancer is treated with Chemotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment: concurrent platinum plus etoposide with thoracic radiotherapy for limited-stage disease, and platinum-based chemotherapy combined with a PD-L1 inhibitor for extensive-stage disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小細胞肺癌（Small-cell lung cancer）以化療（Chemotherapy）治療。含鉑化療是 SCLC 治療的骨幹：侷限期以含鉑加 etoposide 並合併胸部放射治療，廣泛期則以含鉑化療合併 PD-L1 抑制劑治療。

nodes.label: Atg1
nodes.description: Atg1 is a conserved serine/threonine kinase that plays a central role in the initiation of Autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation. It is ULK1 in mammals and nucleates the Autophagosome once mTORC1 dissociates during starvation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg1 是保守的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，在營養缺乏時於 Autophagy 的起始扮演核心角色。它在哺乳類即為 ULK1，並在飢餓時 mTORC1 解離後成核形成 Autophagosome。

nodes.label: Epigenome
nodes.description: The epigenome comprises layers of information that switch genes on or off without changing the DNA sequence: chemical tags on DNA (chiefly DNA methylation), DNA-associated proteins such as histones and their histone modifications that alter chromatin structure, and regulatory RNAs such as non-coding RNA. Unlike the genome, it varies between cell types and changes across the life course.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epigenome 由多層資訊構成，可在不改變 DNA 序列的情況下開關基因：DNA 上的化學標記（主要為 DNA methylation）、與 DNA 結合的蛋白質如 histone 及其改變 chromatin 結構的 histone modification，以及 non-coding RNA 等調控性 RNA。與 genome 不同，它在細胞型態間有差異，並隨生命歷程改變。

nodes.label: V-ATPase
nodes.description: The V-ATPase is a multi-subunit proton pump with V0 membrane and V1 cytosolic domains that maintains the acidic lysosomal lumen at about pH 4.5-5.5. This low pH is what activates more than 50 intralysosomal hydrolases, so V-ATPase is the enzyme that makes lysosomal degradation chemistry possible.
nodes.description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 是由 V0 膜區與 V1 細胞質區構成的多次單元質子幫浦，負責將溶酶體腔維持在約 pH 4.5–5.5 的酸性環境。這個低 pH 正是活化超過 50 種溶酶體內水解酶的條件，因此 V-ATPase 是使溶酶體降解化學反應得以進行的酵素。

nodes.label: Huntington's Disease
nodes.description: Huntington's disease is caused by expansion of a CAG repeat to 36 or more repeats in exon 1 of HTT, which inserts a polyglutamine tract into huntingtin's N-terminus. The resulting mutant protein misfolds and aggregates, and the disease is therefore defined by a single gene's repeat expansion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Huntington's disease 是由 HTT 外顯子 1 的 CAG 重複擴增至 36 次以上所造成，該擴增會在 huntingtin 的 N 端插入一段多麩醯胺酸序列。由此產生的突變蛋白錯誤摺疊並聚集，因此此疾病由單一基因的重複擴增所定義。

nodes.label: Nigrostriatal System
nodes.description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Inflammasome
nodes.description: Canonical inflammasomes activate caspase-1, which processes pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into their mature secreted forms and cleaves gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. This activation is the central effector step of the inflammasome pathway and requires assembly of sensor, ASC, and procaspase-1. In senescence, caspase-1 activity also feeds the SASP, particularly during oncogene-induced senescence where the canonical inflammasome is engaged. The relationship is a foundational inflammasome mechanism with direct relevance to senescence-associated inflammation and sterile immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 典型發炎體活化 caspase-1，caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 與 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟、分泌形式，驅動發炎。此切割是衰老細胞中促發炎性 IL-1beta 釋放的核心步驟，且構成 SASP 的 IL-1 臂。不同於 IL-1alpha（細胞內並經 calpain 切割），IL-1beta 嚴格依賴 caspase-1 活化，使發炎體成為 SASP 中此細胞激素的必要閘門。此活化連結 DAMP 感知到分泌組的發炎輸出。

nodes.label: HSP70
nodes.description: Hsp70 is the major transcriptional target of phenylbutyrate mediating cytoprotection and refolding. Upregulation is the chaperone output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hsp70 是 phenylbutyrate 介導細胞保護與重折疊的主要轉錄標的。上調是伴侶輸出。

nodes.label: Innate Immune System
nodes.description: PAMP are conserved microbial motifs absent from host cells; their engagement of pattern recognition receptors such as TLRs, NOD-like receptors and RLRs is what activates the Innate Immune System and triggers an inflammatory response.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAMP 是微生物特有、宿主細胞不具的保守分子基序；它們與 TLR、NOD-like receptors、RLR 等模式辨識受體結合，正是啟動 Innate Immune System 並引發發炎反應的原因。

nodes.label: NAMPT
nodes.description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ Salvage Pathway. It catalyses the condensation of nicotinamide with PRPP to form NMN, and because its expression declines with age, loss of this single step is sufficient to produce the age-related NAD+ decline that impairs sirtuin activity and DNA repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ Salvage Pathway 的限速酵素。它催化 nicotinamide 與 PRPP 縮合生成 NMN；由於其表現隨年齡衰退，單這一步的流失就足以造成與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降，進而損害 sirtuin 活性與 DNA 修復。

nodes.label: TRAF6
nodes.description: TRAF6 builds Lys63-linked and linear ubiquitin chains via its RING domain with the Ubc13/Uev1A E2 complex; these chains act as scaffolds recruiting TAK1 and the IKK and TBK1 kinases, which activate NF-κB and MAP kinases. The resulting program drives inflammation, interferon responses, and osteoclastogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAF6 透過其 RING 區域與 Ubc13/Uev1A E2 複合體建立 Lys63 連接與線型泛素鏈；這些鏈作為支架招募 TAK1 與 IKK、TBK1 激酶，進而活化 NF-κB 與 MAP 激酶。由此啟動的程式驅動發炎、干擾素反應與破骨細胞生成。

nodes.label: BIG1
nodes.description: BIG1 is a protein that regulates the trafficking of proteins and lipids to and from the Plasma Membrane, and it is thought to help move vesicles between organelles such as the Golgi apparatus and the Plasma Membrane. Because BIG1 controls which surface receptors and lipids reach the Plasma Membrane, this trafficking determines the membrane's composition, supports cell-cell communication, and shapes how strongly and for how long a cell responds to extracellular signals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BIG1 是一種調控蛋白質與脂質在細胞內運送（trafficking）往返於 Plasma Membrane 的蛋白質，並被認為參與囊泡在 Golgi apparatus 與 Plasma Membrane 等胞器之間的移動。由於 BIG1 決定哪些表面受體與脂質能被運送至 Plasma Membrane，這項運送調控了膜的組成、支撐細胞間的溝通，並塑造細胞對細胞外訊號反應的強度與持續時間。

nodes.label: EMT
nodes.description: EMT promotes Chemotherapy Resistance. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with EMT acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EMT 促進 Chemotherapy Resistance。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，EMT 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Cell Cycle Arrest
nodes.description: Cellular senescence is fundamentally defined as a state of stable, essentially irreversible cell-cycle arrest in which cells remain metabolically active but lose the capacity to proliferate, distinguishing it from quiescence and terminal differentiation. The arrest is actively enforced by tumor-suppressor networks -- the p53/p21 and p16/Rb axes -- that impose a durable G1-phase block and remain engaged even under strong mitogenic stimulation. Because the arrest is permanent, senescent cells can persist for the lifetime of the organism, accumulating in tissues with age. Importantly, senescence is not mere growth arrest but a comprehensive reprogramming entailing chromatin reorganization, metabolic shifts, and a distinctive secretory phenotype (SASP).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老在根本上被定義為一種穩定、本質上不可逆的細胞週期停滯狀態，細胞在此狀態下仍維持代謝活性，但喪失增殖能力，從而有別於靜止（quiescence）與終末分化。此停滯由腫瘤抑制網絡主動執行——即 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 軸——它們施加持久的 G1 期阻斷，即便在強力促有絲分裂刺激下仍持續作用。由於停滯是永久性的，衰老細胞可在個體終生存留並隨年齡在組織中累積。重要的是，衰老不只是單純的生長停滯，而是一種包含染色質重組、代謝轉變以及獨特分泌表型（SASP）的全面重編程。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
nodes.description: Adult stem cells such as hematopoietic stem cells spend most of their lives in quiescence to protect the genome and preserve self-renewal capacity. By remaining in a low-activity state, these cells limit DNA replication-associated damage and metabolic stress, maintaining their regenerative potential over a lifetime and resisting stem cell exhaustion. Quiescence therefore serves as a protective mechanism that balances stem cell maintenance with the need to respond rapidly to hematopoietic demand.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 成體幹細胞（例如造血幹細胞）一生的大部分時間都處於靜止狀態，以保護基因組並保持自我更新能力。透過維持低活性狀態，這些細胞限制了 DNA 複製相關的損傷和代謝應激，在一生中保持其再生潛力並抵抗幹細胞衰竭。因此，Quiescence 作為一種保護機制，平衡幹細胞維持與快速反應造血需求的需要。

nodes.label: cGAMP
nodes.description: The Meningeal Lymphatic System acts as a conduit for cGAS-STING–derived products such as cGAMP and cytokines, carrying them from the brain to peripheral lymphoid tissue. By exporting these danger signals it shapes both innate and Adaptive Immune System responses to neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Meningeal Lymphatic System 扮演 cGAS-STING 衍生物（例如 cGAMP 與細胞激素）的傳送管道，將它們由腦部運送至周邊淋巴組織。藉由輸出這些危險訊號，它同時形塑了先天免疫與 Adaptive Immune System 對神經退行性病變的反應。

nodes.label: Integrin
nodes.description: Integrins are heterodimeric transmembrane receptors that mediate cell-ECM adhesion by binding matrix ligands such as fibronectin (alpha5beta1), vitronectin (alphavbeta3) and collagens. Ligand engagement induces conformational extension, clustering, and recruitment of focal adhesion machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Integrin 是異二聚體跨膜受體，透過結合纖連蛋白（alpha5beta1）、玻連蛋白（alphavbeta3）和膠原蛋白等基質配體，介導細胞-ECM 黏附。配體接合誘導構形伸展、聚集和黏著斑機器的招募。

nodes.label: HUWE1
nodes.description: HUWE1 is the primary E3 ubiquitin ligase for Mcl-1 turnover.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 Mcl-1 週轉的主要 E3 泛素連接酶。

nodes.label: Bid
nodes.description: Bid (BH3 interacting-domain death agonist) is a pro-apoptotic BH3-only member of the Bcl-2 family and a 22 kDa protein that exists in an inactive cytosolic conformation. It serves as the critical link between the extrinsic death-receptor and intrinsic mitochondrial pathways of apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bid（BH3 interacting-domain death agonist）是 Bcl-2 家族促凋亡的 BH3-only 成員，為 22 kDa 蛋白，以不活化的細胞質構形存在。它是凋亡中外在性死亡受體路徑與內在性粒線體路徑之間的關鍵橋樑。

nodes.label: PRDX6
nodes.description: Phospholipase A2 enzymes hydrolyze phospholipids to release arachidonic acid and lysophospholipids. Peroxiredoxin 6 uniquely carries an iPLA2 (calcium-independent PLA2) activity whose suppression underlies apigenin's senomorphic SASP suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷脂酶 A2（PLA2）水解磷脂以釋放花生四烯酸與溶血磷脂。過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）獨特地帶有 iPLA2（鈣非依賴 PLA2）活性，其抑制是 apigenin 的 senomorphic SASP 壓制基礎。

nodes.label: Activin A
nodes.description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

nodes.label: Wound Healing
nodes.description: High levels of Advanced Glycation End Products impair wound healing by promoting inflammation, reducing nitric oxide activity, and causing vascular and neurological modifications. Because the effect operates through several mechanisms at once, AGE burden is a modifiable therapeutic target in diabetic and elderly patients with chronic wounds.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高濃度的 Advanced Glycation End Products 會藉由促進發炎、降低一氧化氮活性，以及造成血管與神經修飾來損害傷口癒合。由於此作用同時透過多重機制進行，AGE 負擔是糖尿病與老年慢性傷口患者可調節的治療標的。

nodes.label: c-Met
nodes.description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

nodes.label: Adrenochrome formation
nodes.description: Oxidative stress drives adrenochrome formation because high levels of superoxide and H2O2 favor oxidation and cyclization of adrenaline to the neurotoxic quinone adrenochrome. This pathway has been implicated in psychosis models and redox-linked neuronal injury. The directionality is catecholamine oxidation to adrenochrome. A caveat is that adrenochrome formation in vivo is contested, and adrenochrome can also be detoxified or further metabolized, so its pathological relevance remains debated. The pathway is also relevant to catecholamine-driven cardiotoxicity during stress and to hypotheses linking redox state to neuropsychiatric phenomena.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 驅動 adrenochrome formation，因為高水平的超氧化物和 H2O2 有利於腎上腺素氧化和環化為神經毒性醌腎上腺素紅。此途徑與精神病模型和氧化還原相關的神經元損傷有關。方向性是兒茶酚胺氧化成腎上腺素紅。需要注意的是，体内的 adrenochrome formation 存在争议，并且肾上腺素红也可以被解毒或进一步代谢，因此其病理相关性仍然存在争议。该通路还与应激期间儿茶酚胺驱动的心脏毒性以及将氧化还原状态与神经精神现象联系起来的假设有关。

nodes.label: NMN
nodes.description: NMN is an endogenous nucleotide derived from vitamin B3 and the direct biosynthetic precursor of NAD+. It is converted to NAD+ by NMNAT in the salvage pathway, so raising NMN availability raises cellular NAD+ and, because every mammalian sirtuin requires NAD+ as an obligate co-substrate, potentiates the whole sirtuin family without NMN binding any sirtuin directly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMN 是源自維生素 B3 的內源性核苷酸，也是 NAD+ 的直接生合成前驅物。它在 salvage pathway 中由 NMNAT 轉換為 NAD+，因此提高 NMN 的可得性便會提高細胞 NAD+，而由於所有哺乳類 sirtuin 都以 NAD+ 為必要共同受質，這會在不直接結合任何 sirtuin 的情況下增強整個 sirtuin 家族的活性。

nodes.label: Autophagic Lysosome Reformation
nodes.description: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

nodes.label: Amadori products
nodes.description: Amadori products are stable early-stage intermediates of glycation that form when the initial unstable Schiff base between a reducing sugar and a protein amino group undergoes chemical rearrangement over days. They are therefore reversible targets before they become irreversible crosslinks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amadori products 是 glycation 早期階段的穩定中間體，由還原糖與蛋白胺基之間最初不穩定的 Schiff base 經數日的化學重排形成。因此在成為不可逆交聯之前，它們是可逆的處置標的。

nodes.label: Kinase
nodes.description: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。

nodes.label: NETosis
nodes.description: Citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3) is the PAD4-generated immunodetection signature of NETosis, marking neutrophil extracellular trap formation. Together with extracellular DNA (Sytox Green) and MPO-DNA complexes it forms the diagnostic triad that distinguishes NETs from generic necrotic DNA release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 瓜胺酸化組蛋白 H3（cit-H3）是 NETosis 的 PAD4 生成式免疫檢測標記，用以標示中性球細胞外捕捉網（NET）的形成。它與細胞外 DNA（Sytox Green）以及 MPO–DNA 複合體共同構成診斷三聯體，用以區分 NET 與一般壞死造成的 DNA 釋放。

nodes.label: Homologous Recombination
nodes.description: BRCA2 is the Tumor Suppressor protein that loads RAD51 onto single-stranded DNA at resected Double-Strand Breaks, enabling strand exchange during Homologous Recombination; with BRCA1 and PALB2 it forms a complex essential for genome maintenance through DNA Repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA2 是將 RAD51 載 onto 切除後的 Double-Strand Breaks 所產生的單股 DNA 上的 Tumor Suppressor 蛋白，使 Homologous Recombination 過程中的股交換得以進行；它與 BRCA1 及 PALB2 共同形成對透過 DNA Repair 維持基因體完整性所必需的複合體。

nodes.label: LINE-1
nodes.description: KAP1 (TRIM28/TIF1beta) is the universal corepressor for KRAB-zinc-finger transcription factors, recruiting SETDB1, HDACs and HP1alpha to build H3K9me3-dominated silent chromatin; SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation promotes KAP1–HP1alpha interaction to package LINE-1 elements into repressive heterochromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: KAP1（TRIM28/TIF1β）是 KRAB 鋅指轉錄因子的通用共抑制因子，招募 SETDB1、HDAC 與 HP1α 建立以 H3K9me3 為主的沉默染色質；SIRT6 的單 ADP 核糖基化促進 KAP1–HP1α 交互作用，將 LINE-1 元素包裝進抑制性異染色質。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: CDK4 6
nodes.description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

nodes.label: Sulforaphane
nodes.description: Sulforaphane from broccoli acts as a well-characterized inhibitor of histone deacetylase enzymes. By altering histone acetylation and chromatin structure, it durably reprograms expression of genes involved in stress resistance, inflammation, and longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 來自青花菜的 Sulforaphane 是明確的 Histone Deacetylases 抑制劑。透過改變組蛋白乙醯化與染色質結構，它能持久重編與壓力抗性、發炎及長壽相關基因的表現。

nodes.label: Gnathostomiasis
nodes.description: Peripheral blood eosinophilia — an expansion of circulating eosinophils — is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia（循環中 eosinophils 的擴增）是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

nodes.label: Adrenoleukodystrophy
nodes.description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

nodes.label: Lymphoma
nodes.description: DLBCL is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DLBCL 是侵襲性 B 細胞非何杰金淋巴瘤亞型。

nodes.label: Regulatory T cells
nodes.description: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are a CD4+ T-lymphocyte subset that suppresses excessive immune activation and maintains self-tolerance, countering chronic inflammation and autoimmunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Regulatory T cells（Tregs）是 CD4+ T 淋巴球的一個次群，可抑制過度的免疫活化並維持自身耐受性，對抗慢性發炎與自體免疫。

nodes.label: Lactylation
nodes.description: Lysine lactylation is a lactate-derived post-translational modification coupling metabolic state to protein function. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation, promoting ferroptosis and accelerating nucleus pulposus cell decline in intervertebral disc degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 離胺酸乳醯化是一種乳酸衍生的翻譯後修飾，將代謝狀態與蛋白功能偶聯。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化，促進椎間盤退化中髓核細胞的鐵死亡和功能衰退。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging
nodes.description: In 1972 Denham Harman refined his free radical theory into the mitochondrial free radical theory of aging, specifically implicating mitochondria as the primary source and the primary target of reactive oxygen species. This localisation sharpened the earlier theory by assigning both origin and damage site to one organelle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 1972 年，Denham Harman 將其 free radical theory 精煉為 mitochondrial free radical theory of aging，明確指出 mitochondria 是 reactive oxygen species 的主要來源與主要標的。此項定位為較早的理論增加了精確度，把起源與損傷部位同時指派給同一胞器。
nodes.norm_label: mitochondrial free radical theory of aging

nodes.label: ASAH1
nodes.description: Farber disease is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ASAH1, leaving less than 5% residual acid ceramidase activity. Ceramide then accumulates in lysosomes of macrophages, joints, skin and CNS, producing the classic triad of painful joint deformities, subcutaneous lipomatous nodules and vocal hoarseness; severity inversely correlates with residual enzyme activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Farber disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性溶小體儲積症，由 ASAH1 的功能喪失突變造成，使 acid ceramidase 殘餘活性低於 5%。因此 ceramide 在巨噬細胞、關節、皮膚與中樞神經的溶小體中累積，形成疼痛性關節變形、皮下脂肪瘤樣結節與聲音嘶啞的典型三聯徵；嚴重度與殘餘酵素活性成反比。

nodes.label: Atrial natriuretic peptide
nodes.description: Heart releases Atrial natriuretic peptide when atrial cardiomyocytes are stretched. ANP acts through cGMP signaling to unload volume, providing a hormonal counterweight to the sympathetic drive on the Heart.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當心房心肌細胞受到牽張時，Heart（心臟）會釋放 Atrial natriuretic peptide（心房利鈉胜肽）。ANP 透過 cGMP 訊號卸除體液量，對心臟的交感神經驅動形成荷爾蒙層面的對沖。

nodes.label: Mediterranean Diet
nodes.description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

nodes.label: Fucoidan
nodes.description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

nodes.label: B18R
nodes.description: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

nodes.label: Tenovins
nodes.description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

nodes.label: Cathepsin K
nodes.description: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

nodes.label: CD38 inhibitor 78c
nodes.description: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 78c 是一種高效力、高選擇性、口服可利用的 CD38 NAD+ 糖水解酶活性小分子抑制劑。在方向性上，78c 位於 CD38 阻斷的上游。透過阻止 NAD+ 消耗，它節省了 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶的共同底物，是領先的衰老逆轉 NAD+ 保存策略。78c 的效力和口服可利用性使其適用於長期體內研究，其對老年小鼠的施用恢復了 NAD+ 水平和 sirtuin 活性。這些特性使 78c 成為驗證 CD38 作為長壽靶標的關鍵藥理學工具。

nodes.label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
nodes.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

nodes.label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
nodes.description: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

nodes.label: BMP Signaling Pathway
nodes.description: BMP2/4/7 drive osteoblast differentiation as the defining skeletal function of the pathway. Loss of signaling causes skeletal dysplasia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BMP2/4/7 驅動造骨細胞分化，作為此路徑定義性的骨骼功能。訊號缺失導致骨骼發育不良。

nodes.label: Endothelial Nitric Oxide Synthase
nodes.description: eNOS (NOS3) is the constitutive isoform of nitric oxide synthase expressed in vascular endothelium, continuously producing low-level nitric oxide for basal vascular tone and opposing vasoconstriction. It dimerizes to catalyze the NADPH-dependent oxidation of L-arginine to citrulline and NO, requiring the cofactors tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), FAD and FMN.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eNOS（NOS3）是表現於血管內皮的一氧化氮合成酶組成型亞型，持續產生低量一氧化氮以維持基礎血管張力並對抗血管收縮。它以二聚體形式催化 NADPH 依賴的 L-精胺酸氧化生成瓜胺酸與 NO，需輔因子四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）、FAD 與 FMN。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Drift
nodes.description: Aging involves epigenetic drift, the progressive divergence of DNA methylation and chromatin marks from the youthful state that erodes the fidelity of gene expression. Drift occurs stochastically, increasing variation both between individuals and between cells of the same tissue, and it contributes to cellular dysfunction and age-related disease. Polycomb group protein target genes are particularly susceptible to age-associated methylation changes, linking drift to the loss of cellular identity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aging 涉及表觀遺傳漂移、DNA 甲基化和染色質標記與年輕狀態的逐漸分歧，從而侵蝕了 gene expression 的保真度。漂移是隨機發生的，增加了個體之間和同一組織細胞之間的變異，並導致細胞功能障礙和與年齡相關的疾病。多梳蛋白標靶基因特別容易受到與年齡相關的甲基化變化的影響，將漂移與細胞身份的喪失聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Dietary Hormesis
nodes.description: Dietary hormesis is framed as the cumulative, potentially synergistic adaptive response to a complex array of hormetins within whole-food matrices. This is distinguished from biphasic dose-responses of isolated compounds like resveratrol or curcumin studied in controlled laboratory settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dietary Hormesis 被定義為對全食物基質中複雜 Hormetins 陣列產生的累積性、可能具協同作用的適應反應。這與在受控實驗室條件下研究的單一分離化合物（如 resveratrol 或 curcumin）的雙相劑量反應有所區別。

nodes.label: Glutamate
nodes.description: Methylene blue (MB) provides potent neuroprotection against glutamate-induced oxidative toxicity in HT-22 hippocampal neurons, a model in which glutamate blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter and depletes cellular glutathione. MB was protective in both MTT and Calcein AM viability assays with an EC50 of 17.81 nM and without altering total glutathione levels. This protection correlated with attenuation of glutamate-induced ROS production and mitochondrial membrane potential depolarization, establishing MB's action as upstream of ROS generation rather than as a direct antioxidant.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在HT-22海馬神經元中提供對谷氨酸誘導的氧化毒性的強大神經保護作用，這是一種谷氨酸阻斷胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向轉運蛋白並耗盡細胞谷胱甘肽的模型。MB在MTT和Calcein AM活力測定中具有保護作用，EC50為17.81 nM，並且不改變總谷胱甘肽水平。這種保護作用與谷氨酸誘導的ROS產生和粒線體膜電位去極化的減弱相關，確立了MB的作用是在ROS產生的上游而不是作為直接抗氧化劑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Neuron
nodes.description: Both glutamic acid decarboxylase isoforms are highly expressed in GABAergic neurons, which depend on the enzyme to maintain basal GABA levels and thus inhibitory tone. Reduced GAD activity is associated with epilepsy and anxiety disorders, and anti-GAD antibodies are diagnostic markers in stiff-person syndrome and type 1 diabetes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase 的兩種同功型皆在 GABAergic 的 neuron 中高度表現，這些神經元仰賴該酵素維持基礎 GABA 濃度與抑制性張力。GAD 活性降低與 epilepsy 及焦慮疾患相關，而 anti-GAD 抗體則是 stiff-person syndrome 與 type 1 diabetes 的診斷標記。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: ERK
nodes.description: ERK phosphorylation of Mcl-1 at T163 blocks the GSK3 phosphodegron cascade, stabilizing the protein.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ERK 在 T163 磷酸化 Mcl-1 阻斷 GSK3 磷酸降解決聯，穩定蛋白。

nodes.label: CCL20
nodes.description: CCL20 expression is driven by NF-kB and induced by IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, placing it downstream of the apical SASP amplifiers. This positions CCL20 within the IL-1alpha-centered feed-forward loop of senescence inflammation, in which a single upstream cytokine orchestrates a broad chemokine response. Its induction integrates the master inflammatory cytokines with chemokine output, ensuring immune recruitment is coordinated with secretome activation. The relationship is mechanistically coherent and well documented across senescence and inflammatory models. IL-1β acts through the same IL-1R-NF-kB route as a parallel inducer in fibroblasts and epithelial cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CCL20 表現由 NF-κB 驅動，並被 IL-1alpha、IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 誘發，將其置於頂層 SASP 放大器的下游。這將 CCL20 定位於 IL-1alpha 中心的衰老發炎正向迴圈中，其中單一上游細胞激素協調廣泛趨化因子反應。其誘發整合主發炎細胞激素與趨化因子輸出，確保免疫招募與分泌組活化協調。此關係在機制上連貫，並跨衰老與發炎模型良好記載。 IL-1β 在纖維母細胞與上皮細胞經由相同的 IL-1R-NF-κB 途徑作為平行誘發因子。

nodes.label: PEX7
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX7 cause PEX7-related Zellweger Spectrum Disorder (~5-10% of cases), classically rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 1; the founder allele c.727G>A partially impairs PTS2 binding.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX7 突變會造成 PEX7 相關的 Zellweger 光譜症候群（約佔 5–10% 病例），典型表現為肢端軟骨點樣變化症第一型；創始等位基因 c.727G>A 會部分損害 PTS2 結合。

nodes.label: Oct4
nodes.description: During cellular reprogramming, Oct4 initiates the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET), a required early step in which fibroblast-like cells adopt an epithelial morphology. By suppressing mesenchymal genes and promoting epithelial ones, Oct4 helps reorganize the cytoskeleton and cell-adhesion program toward the epithelial identity characteristic of pluripotent cells. This MET is followed by erasure of somatic marks and establishment of the pluripotency network, and it is reinforced by the cooperation of Klf4.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在細胞重編程過程中，Oct4 啟動間質到上皮的轉變 (MET)，這是纖維母細胞樣細胞採用上皮形態所需的早期步驟。透過抑制間質基因並促進上皮基因，Oct4 有助於重組細胞骨架和細胞黏附程序，以實現多能細胞的上皮身份特徵。該 MET 隨後是體細胞標記的擦除和多能性網絡的建立，並透過 Klf4 的合作得到加強。

nodes.label: Gemcitabine
nodes.description: Gemcitabine's diphosphate (dFdCDP) irreversibly inactivates the RRM1 subunit of ribonucleotide reductase and depletes dNTP pools, especially dCTP, self-potentiating its own incorporation into DNA. This makes RNR a central target of gemcitabine's anticancer action.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 的二磷酸形式（dFdCDP）會不可逆地使核醣核苷酸還原酶的 RRM1 次單元失活，並耗竭 dNTP 池（尤其是 dCTP），自我增強其嵌入 DNA。這使 RNR 成為 Gemcitabine 抗癌作用的中心靶點。

nodes.label: Atg8
nodes.description: GATE-16 (GABARAPL2) is a Golgi-associated member of the Atg8 protein family, involved in intra-Golgi transport as well as Autophagy. It is conjugated to autophagosomal membranes similarly to LC3 and GABARAP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GATE-16（GABARAPL2）是 Atg8 蛋白家族中與 Golgi 關聯的成員，參與 Golgi 內運輸以及 Autophagy。它與 LC3 及 GABARAP 類似地被接附到 autophagosome 膜上。

nodes.label: γ-H2AX
nodes.description: 53BP1 is recruited to DNA double-strand break sites through cooperative recognition of the histone marks H4K20me2 and H2AK15ub, a localization step that is stabilized by interaction with γ-H2AX via the MDC1 mediator. This makes 53BP1 a downstream chromatin scaffold that converts the γ-H2AX damage signal into a repair-pathway commitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 53BP1 透過協同辨識組蛋白標記 H4K20me2 與 H2AK15ub 被招募到 DNA 雙股斷裂（DSB）位點，此定位步驟再由 MDC1 媒介與 γ-H2AX 的交互作用加以穩定。這使 53BP1 成為下游的染色質支架，把 γ-H2AX 的損傷訊號轉為修復途徑的選擇。

nodes.label: TRPM2
nodes.description: Free ADP-ribose released by PARG/ARH3 hydrolysis of PAR binds the NUDT9-homology domain of TRPM2 and opens the channel to Ca2+, linking PARP1 hyperactivation in Parthanatos to calcium influx and downstream Calpain and mitochondrial permeability transition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 PARG/ARH3 水解 PAR 釋出的游離 ADP-ribose 會結合 TRPM2 的 NUDT9 同源結構域並開啟通道讓 Ca2+ 通過，將 Parthanatos 中的 PARP1 過度活化連結到鈣離子流入及下游的 Calpain 與粒線體通透性轉換。

nodes.label: FoxO1
nodes.description: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

nodes.label: PODXL
nodes.description: PODXL is a canonical undifferentiated-state surface marker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PODXL 是典型的未分化狀態表面標記。

nodes.label: EXITS
nodes.description: The EXITS framework (Dunford et al., Nature Genetics 2017) identifies X-chromosome tumor suppressor genes that escape X-inactivation and are therefore biallelically expressed in females, protecting them from single-hit loss. Across >4,100 cancers of 21 tumour types, exactly six of 783 non-pseudoautosomal X genes — ATRX, CNKSR2, DDX3X, KDM5C, KDM6A, MAGEC3 — showed significantly more male-biased loss-of-function mutation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EXITS 架構（Dunford 等，Nature Genetics 2017）辨識出逃脫 X 染色體失活、在女性中呈雙等位表現的 X 染色體腫瘤抑制基因，使其免於單次突變的衝擊。在 21 種腫瘤逾 4,100 例癌症中，783 個非偽自動區 X 基因中恰有六個呈現顯著偏向男性的功能喪失突變：ATRX、CNKSR2、DDX3X、KDM5C、KDM6A、MAGEC3。

nodes.label: Peroxisome
nodes.description: At least 14 known PEX genes in humans encode peroxins required for Peroxisome biogenesis, assembly, and function. They execute three core processes: PTS1/PTS2 receptor cycling for matrix protein import, membrane assembly and de novo peroxisome formation from the Endoplasmic Reticulum via PEX3, PEX16, and PEX19, and proliferation through PEX11-mediated fission.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類至少有 14 個已知的 PEX 基因，其編碼的 peroxin 是 Peroxisome 生物生成、組裝與功能所必需。它們執行三項核心過程：PTS1/PTS2 受體循環以進行基質蛋白輸入、經由 PEX3、PEX16 與 PEX19 自 Endoplasmic Reticulum 進行膜組裝與新生過氧化體形成，以及透過 PEX11 介導的分裂進行增殖。

nodes.label: CDH2
nodes.description: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

nodes.label: ICE Mouse
nodes.description: Double-strand-break induction in the ICE Mouse shifts the epigenetic (DNA-methylation) clock, consistent with chromatin modifiers such as SIRT1 relocalizing away from native sites during repair. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of clock acceleration. This provides a quantitative readout of epigenetic drift, and it links the RCM model to measurable aging biomarkers. By demonstrating that DNA damage alone can advance the epigenetic clock, the ICE Mouse connects the loss of epigenetic information to the rate of aging. This finding supports the use of DNA-methylation clocks as indicators of biological age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中的雙鏈斷裂誘導改變了表觀遺傳（DNA 甲基化）時鐘，與染色質修飾因子如 SIRT1 在修復期間從原始位點重新定位一致。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於時鐘加速的上游。這提供了表觀遺傳漂變的量化讀數，並將 RCM 模型與可測量的衰老生物標誌物聯繫起來。透過證明僅 DNA 損傷就能推進表觀遺傳時鐘，ICE 小鼠將表觀遺傳資訊的喪失與衰老速率聯繫起來。此發現支持使用 DNA 甲基化時鐘作為生物年齡的指標。

nodes.label: Rectal Cancer
nodes.description: Rectal cancer is often grouped with colon cancer as colorectal cancer, but is managed distinctly due to pelvic anatomical constraints and differing treatment paradigms.
