nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

nodes.label: Cerebellum
nodes.description: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

nodes.label: Caspase-2
nodes.description: The CDK1-CYCLIN B1 complex phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, a site that blocks caspase-2 maturation and thereby couples mitotic entry to apoptotic restraint: actively dividing cells keep Caspase-2 off, while loss of CYCLIN B1 at mitotic exit or under genotoxic arrest relieves the inhibition and permits Caspase-2-driven death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK1–CYCLIN B1 複合體在 Ser308 位點磷酸化 Caspase-2，該位點可阻斷 caspase-2 的成熟，因而把進入有絲分裂與凋亡抑制相偶聯：正在分裂的細胞使 Caspase-2 保持關閉，而在有絲分裂退出或基因毒性停滯時 CYCLIN B1 流失會解除此抑制，允許 Caspase-2 驅動的死亡發生。

nodes.label: Stimulus-response learning
nodes.description: Stimulus-response learning depends on dopamine signaling in the striatum, particularly within corticostriatal circuits where dopamine modulates the synaptic plasticity underlying habit formation. Both excessive and insufficient striatal dopamine, shaped by DAT, COMT, and receptor tone, disrupt S-R acquisition and procedural learning. COMT overexpression models demonstrate that altered dopamine clearance impairs this learning. This makes striatal dopamine a key determinant of habit and skill learning efficiency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 依賴紋狀體中的多巴胺訊號傳導，特別是在皮質紋狀體迴路中，其中多巴胺調節 habit formation 底層的 synaptic plasticity。由 DAT、COMT 和受體音調形成的紋狀體多巴胺過多和不足都會擾亂 S-R 獲取和程序性學習。 COMT 過度表現模型顯示多巴胺清除率的改變會損害這種學習。這使得紋狀體多巴胺成為習慣和技能學習效率的關鍵決定因素。

nodes.label: KRAS
nodes.description: Lung Cancer is driven by KRAS. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. The directionality runs from KRAS toward Lung Cancer, so KRAS is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 由KRAS 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。方向性從 KRAS 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 KRAS 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: PPARγ
nodes.description: SIRT1 represses PPARγ-mediated transcription, inhibiting adipogenesis; SIRT1 overexpression or pharmacological activation by resveratrol therefore promotes fat mobilization by repressing PPARγ and aP2 genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 抑制 PPARγ 媒介的轉錄，因而抑制脂肪生成；SIRT1 过量表現或經 resveratrol 藥理活化後，藉由抑制 PPARγ 與 aP2 基因促進脂肪動員。

nodes.label: Rutin
nodes.description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

nodes.label: Cambinol
nodes.description: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

nodes.label: Salermide
nodes.description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

nodes.label: Sirtinol
nodes.description: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

nodes.label: Ubiquitin Ligase
nodes.description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

nodes.label: Double-Strand Break
nodes.description: Double-strand breaks are the principal trigger for the recruitment of chromatin modifiers away from their native genomic loci to damage sites. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated cycles of DSB-induced relocalization are proposed to erode the epigenetic landscape over time.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂是染色質修飾因子被招募離開原生基因座至損傷位點的主要觸發因素。在 RCM 假說中，反覆的 DSB 誘導易位被認為會隨時間侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

nodes.label: Methylglyoxal
nodes.description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

nodes.label: p21 CIP1
nodes.description: DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 binds and inhibits cyclin-CDK complexes, notably CDK2, enforcing a G1/S arrest. This p53-to-p21 axis is a primary, rapid enforcement mechanism of senescence and quiescence, and the induction is dose-dependent and reversible in the short term but locks the arrest when sustained. It exemplifies tumor-suppressive cell-cycle control and is a core target of the DNA damage response. p21 also supports an early secretory phenotype during stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷穩定 p53，p53 轉錄誘發 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 結合並抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體，特別是 CDK2，強制 G1/S 停滯。此 p53-to-p21 軸是衰老與靜止的主要、快速執行機制，且此誘發在短期內依劑量且可逆，但在持續時鎖定停滯。它例示腫瘤抑制性細胞週期控制，是 DNA 損傷反應的核心標靶。p21 也在壓力期間支持早期分泌表型。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: MTHFD1
nodes.description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

nodes.label: Caspase-9
nodes.description: During apoptosis the initiator caspase-9 directly cleaves SIRT1 (Sir2α), the NAD+-dependent deacetylase that normally restrains p53- and FOXO-driven death programs. Cleavage is caspase-dependent: dominant-negative caspase-9 blocks both the lower-molecular-weight SIRT1 band and its nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization in TNF-α-treated HeLa cells. Because caspase-9 sits at the top of the intrinsic cascade, SIRT1 dismantling begins early in the apoptotic process rather than as a late cleanup event. This is the founding observation of the caspase-to-sirtuin feedback direction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在細胞凋亡過程中，起始半胱天冬酶-9（Caspase-9）會直接切割 SIRT1（Sir2α）——這個通常抑制 p53 與 FOXO 死亡程序的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶。切割是 caspase 依賴性的：顯性負向 Caspase-9 同時阻斷了 TNF-α 處理的 HeLa 細胞中較低分子量的 SIRT1 條帶及其由細胞核向細胞質的重新定位。由於 Caspase-9 位於內在級聯的頂端，SIRT1 的瓦解在細胞凋亡早期即已開始，而非晚期的清理事件。這是 caspase 至 sirtuin 回饋方向的奠基性觀察。

nodes.label: Extracellular Matrix
nodes.description: Integrins are heterodimeric transmembrane receptors that mediate cell-ECM adhesion by binding matrix ligands such as fibronectin (alpha5beta1), vitronectin (alphavbeta3) and collagens. Ligand engagement induces conformational extension, clustering, and recruitment of focal adhesion machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Integrin 是異二聚體跨膜受體，透過結合纖連蛋白（alpha5beta1）、玻連蛋白（alphavbeta3）和膠原蛋白等基質配體，介導細胞-ECM 黏附。配體接合誘導構形伸展、聚集和黏著斑機器的招募。

nodes.label: AP-1
nodes.description: The transcription factor AP-1 acts as a pioneering factor that binds to enhancers associated with SASP and other senescence-related genes, initiating the opening of closed chromatin. By pioneering open chromatin at these enhancers, AP-1 enables subsequent recruitment of transcriptional machinery, the histone acetyltransferase p300, and activation of SASP gene expression. Depletion of the AP-1 family member c-Jun alone can partially reverse senescence-associated cell cycle arrest, underscoring AP-1's central regulatory role.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 AP-1 作為先鋒因子，與 SASP 和其他老化相關基因相關的增強子結合，啟動封閉染色質的打開。透過在這些增強子上率先開放染色質，AP-1 能夠隨後招募轉錄機制、組蛋白乙醯轉移酶 p300，並活化 SASP gene expression。單獨消耗 AP-1 家族成員 c-Jun 可以部分逆轉老化相關的細胞週期停滯，強調了 AP-1 的核心調節作用。

nodes.label: Nitrative Stress
nodes.description: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

nodes.label: Heart Rate Variability
nodes.description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

nodes.label: PARP
nodes.description: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases (PARPs) are NAD+-consuming enzymes that transfer ADP-ribose units onto proteins and nucleic acids, playing critical roles in DNA repair and antiviral immunity. During aging, accumulated DNA damage activates PARPs, which depletes NAD+ and reduces SIRT1 activity. In SARS-CoV-2 infection, PARPs inhibit viral transcript translation through ADP-ribosylation, but viral macrodomain proteins hydrolyze these ADPR units, and the compensatory hyperactivation of PARPs consumes NAD+; restoring NAD+ may therefore support the antiviral functions of PARPs. PARPs also consume NAD+ during diabetes-associated DNA repair, contributing to the NAD+/NADH redox imbalance that drives diabetic complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 聚(ADP-核糖)聚合酶（PARPs）是消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，可將 ADP-ribose 單元轉移至蛋白質與核酸上，在 DNA 修復與抗病毒免疫中扮演關鍵角色。老化過程中，累積的 DNA 損傷會活化 PARPs，進而耗竭 NAD+ 並降低 SIRT1 活性。在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中，PARPs 透過 ADP-ribosylation 抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，但病毒的 macrodomain 蛋白會水解這些 ADPR 單元，而 PARPs 的代償性過度活化會消耗 NAD+；因此補充 NAD+ 可能有助於支持 PARPs 的抗病毒功能。PARPs 在糖尿病相關的 DNA 修復過程中也會消耗 NAD+，促成驅動糖尿病併發症的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原失衡。

nodes.label: Translation
nodes.description: Translation is the final protein-synthesis step of gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉譯是基因表現最後的蛋白合成步驟。

nodes.label: Brosimine B
nodes.description: Brosimine B (2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-prenylflavan, C20H22O3) is a prenylated flavan from Brosimum acutifolium bark and a textbook Hormetin: low-dose stimulation with high-dose inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brosimine B（2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-prenylflavan，C20H22O3）取自 Brosimum acutifolium 樹皮的異戊烯化黃烷，是典型的 Hormetin：低劑量刺激、高劑量抑制。

nodes.label: ME2
nodes.description: SIRT3 acts as a delactylase for malic enzyme 2, removing the K352 lactyl mark and thereby inhibiting ME2 activity. Lactylation at K352 normally enhances ME2 activity, NADPH production and mitochondrial respiration, so SIRT3-mediated delactylation is tumor-suppressive in colorectal cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 作為蘋果酸酶 2 的去乳醯化酶，移除 K352 的乳醯化標記，因而抑制 ME2 活性。K352 的乳醯化原本會提升 ME2 活性、NADPH 生成與粒線體呼吸，因此 SIRT3 媒介的去乳醯化在結直腸癌中具有抑制腫瘤的作用。

nodes.label: Proteasome
nodes.description: Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: HLA-E
nodes.description: B2M is the invariant light chain that forms all MHC class I molecules and, in particular, stabilizes HLA-E surface expression; HLA-E/B2M on senescent and tumor cells engages NKG2A/CD94 on Natural Killer Cells and CD8 T cells, blunting cytotoxic killing and enabling Immune Evasion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B2M 是構成所有 MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈，特別能穩定 HLA-E 的表面表現；衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞上的 HLA-E/B2M 會接合 Natural Killer Cells 與 CD8 T cells 上的 NKG2A/CD94，削弱細胞毒殺殺傷並促成 Immune Evasion。

nodes.label: Beclin1
nodes.description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

nodes.label: SREBP-1c
nodes.description: SREBP-1c is the master transcriptional regulator of de novo lipogenesis. Synthesized as an inactive precursor anchored to the endoplasmic reticulum, it is processed and released by S1P/S2P proteases after SCAP-mediated transport to the Golgi at low sterol, and the active N-terminal domain translocates to the nucleus to drive fatty acid and triglyceride biosynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SREBP-1c 是 de novo lipogenesis（從新生脂質合成）的核心轉錄調節因子。它先以失活前驅物形式錨定於 endoplasmic reticulum，在低固醇時經 SCAP 運送至 Golgi apparatus 後由 S1P/S2P 蛋白酶切割，其活性 N 端區段轉位至細胞核，驅動脂肪酸與三酸甘油酯的生合成。

nodes.label: FGF21
nodes.description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

nodes.label: OPA1
nodes.description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Selective Autophagy
nodes.description: Mitophagy is a specialized, evolutionarily conserved form of selective autophagy dedicated to the degradation of damaged or dysfunctional mitochondria. Under stress such as excessive ROS, nutrient deficiency, or cellular aging, mitochondria undergo depolarization and are selectively engulfed and eliminated. The process proceeds through recognition of damaged mitochondria, recruitment of adaptors or receptors, autophagosome formation, and fusion with lysosomes. This ensures mitochondrial quality control and cellular homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 是選擇性自噬的一種特化、演化上保守的形式，專門降解受損或功能失常的粒線體。在過量 ROS、營養缺乏或細胞老化等壓力下，粒線體發生去極化並被選擇性吞噬和清除。此過程歷經辨識受損粒線體、招募接合蛋白或受體、自噬體形成，以及與溶酶體融合。這確保了粒線體品質控制和細胞恆定性。

nodes.label: IDO1
nodes.description: IDO1 catalyzes the first, rate-limiting step in tryptophan catabolism, inserting both oxygen atoms of O2 into the indole ring to yield N-formylkynurenine and thereby initiating the Kynurenine Pathway. Downstream metabolism produces Quinolinic Acid and ultimately NAD+, so IDO1 activity links tryptophan availability to the cellular NAD+ pool as well as to T-cell immunity and tumor immune tolerance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IDO1 催化色胺酸分解代謝的第一步也是限速步驟，將 O2 的兩個氧原子插入 indole 環以生成 N-formylkynurenine，據此啟動 Kynurenine Pathway。下游代謝產生 Quinolinic Acid 並最終生成 NAD+，因此 IDO1 活性同時連結色胺酸可得性與細胞 NAD+ 池，以及 T 細胞免疫與腫瘤免疫耐受。

nodes.label: TRPML1
nodes.description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

nodes.label: Autophagosome
nodes.description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

nodes.label: Melatonin
nodes.description: Melatonin acts as a potent antioxidant, protecting the body from Oxidative Stress and free-radical damage. This antioxidant capacity, beyond its sleep–wake signalling role, is why melatonin has been profiled as a therapeutic in sepsis, contrast-induced acute kidney injury, and diabetic cardiomyopathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Melatonin 具備強效的抗氧化作用，能保護身體免受 Oxidative Stress 與自由基傷害。這項抗氧化能力（超越其睡眠—覺醒訊號的角色），正是褪黑激素曾被評估為敗血症、對比劑誘發急性腎損傷與糖尿病心肌病治療手段的原因。

nodes.label: Hypochlorous Acid
nodes.description: Hypochlorous acid chlorinates tyrosine to form 3-chlorotyrosine, a stable adduct that is a specific biomarker of myeloperoxidase activity in vivo. Its presence marks HOCl exposure in inflamed tissues. The directionality is HOCl to chlorinated protein residue. A caveat is that 3-chlorotyrosine reflects historical MPO activity and can be turned over with protein degradation, so it is an integrative rather than instantaneous marker. 3-chlorotyrosine levels rise in atherosclerotic plaques, pneumonia, and other inflammatory conditions, supporting its use as a clinical research biomarker.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 氯化 tyrosine 形成 3-chlorotyrosine，這是一種穩定的加合物，是體內 myeloperoxidase 活性的特定生物標記。它的存在標誌著發炎組織中的次氯酸暴露。方向性是 HOCl 到氯化蛋白質殘基。需要注意的是，3-chlorotyrosine 反映了歷史 MPO 活性，並且可以隨著蛋白質降解而翻轉，因此它是一個綜合標記，而不是瞬時標記。 3-chlorotyrosine 水平在 atheros 硬化斑塊、肺炎和其他發炎性疾病中升高，支持其用作臨床研究生物標記。

nodes.label: MyD88
nodes.description: MyD88 is the archetypal adaptor protein: a non-enzymatic cytoplasmic scaffold that couples receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Homotypic TIR-TIR interactions recruit it to activated Toll-like Receptor and IL-1 Receptor, and death-domain interactions then bring IRAK4 and IRAK1 into proximity for trans-autophosphorylation. Because MyD88 has no catalytic activity, its function is entirely architectural.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MyD88 是典型的 adaptor protein：一個無酵素活性的細胞質支架，將受體活化與下游激酶級聯反應連結起來。經由 TIR-TIR 同型交互作用，它被招募至活化的 Toll-like Receptor 與 IL-1 Receptor，再透過 death domain 交互作用將 IRAK4 與 IRAK1 拉近以進行交互磷酸化。由於 MyD88 不具催化活性，其功能完全是架構性的。

nodes.label: Complex I
nodes.description: BAY 87-2243 is a ubiquinone-binding site (Q-site) dependent inhibitor of mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), originally developed as a HIF-1 pathway inhibitor. It blocks electron transfer from NADH to ubiquinone, producing an increased NADH:NAD+ ratio, NAD+ and ATP depletion, AMPK activation and collapse of the TCA cycle in glutamine-dependent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BAY 87-2243 是粒線體 Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone 氧化還原酶）的泛醌結合位點（Q-site）依賴型抑制劑，最初作為 HIF-1 途徑抑制劑開發。它阻斷 NADH 將電子傳遞給泛醌，造成 NADH:NAD+ 比值上升、NAD+ 與 ATP 耗竭、AMPK 活化，並使依賴麩醯胺酸的細胞 TCA cycle 崩潰。

nodes.label: Cognition
nodes.description: The Prefrontal Cortex mediates executive function and working memory, underpinning planning, inhibitory control, cognitive flexibility and abstract reasoning. It operates within an inverted-U dose-response curve for Dopamine signalling, so both excess and deficiency impair performance, and its volume declines with normal aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prefrontal Cortex 中介執行功能與工作記憶，是計畫、抑制控制、認知彈性與抽象推理的基礎。其運作遵循 Dopamine 訊號的倒 U 型劑量反應曲線，過多與過少皆會損害表現，且其體積會隨正常老化而減少。

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Hypothesis
nodes.description: Canadian psychiatrist and biochemist Abram Hoffer, with Humphry Osmond, co-proposed the Adrenochrome Hypothesis in a series of papers beginning in the 1950s. Hoffer's own niacin trials in schizophrenia followed from the hypothesis and were later not confirmed by independent multicenter replication.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 加拿大精神科醫師與生化學家 Abram Hoffer 與 Humphry Osmond 自 1950 年代起在一系列論文中共同提出 Adrenochrome Hypothesis。Hoffer 針對 Schizophrenia 所做的 niacin 試驗源自此假說，但後續獨立多中心重複研究未能確認其結果。

nodes.label: ATGL
nodes.description: ATGL (adipose triglyceride lipase, PNPLA2) is the first and rate-limiting enzyme of catabolic lipolysis. It localizes to the surface of Lipid Droplet and hydrolyzes triacylglycerol into diacylglycerol and free fatty acids, providing substrate for Lipophagy and fatty acid oxidation. Its activity determines the rate of free fatty acid release from adipose tissue and therefore systemic lipid mobilization, and it is activated during Starvation and Fasting to mobilize energy reserves.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATGL（adipose triglyceride lipase，PNPLA2）是分解性脂解的第一個也是速率限制酵素。它定位於 Lipid Droplet 表面，將三酸甘油酯水解為二酸甘油酯與游離脂肪酸，為 Lipophagy 與脂肪酸氧化提供受質。其活性決定 adipose 組織釋放游離脂肪酸的速率，因而決定全身脂質動員；並在 Starvation 與 Fasting 期間被活化以動員能量儲備。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
nodes.description: Cyclophilin D (PPIF) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase and the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. It binds the pore and promotes its opening in response to matrix calcium overload and reactive oxygen species, thereby gating cytochrome c release upstream of the caspase cascade and making CypD a senolytic target in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin D（PPIF）是粒線體基質的 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase，也是 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 的主要正向調節者。它結合孔道並在基質鈣過載與 Reactive Oxygen Species 作用下促進孔道開啟，藉此在 caspase 级聯上游控制 Cytochrome c 釋放，並使 CypD 成為衰老細胞的 senolytic 標的。

nodes.label: Oleacein
nodes.description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

nodes.label: NADPH
nodes.description: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase is the rate-limiting enzyme of the pentose phosphate pathway, oxidizing glucose-6-phosphate to 6-phosphoglucono-delta-lactone while reducing NADP+ to NADPH. The NADPH produced is the principal driver of reduced glutathione regeneration, which neutralizes reactive oxygen species and is what erythrocytes depend on.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase 是磷酸戊糖途徑的限速酵素，將葡萄糖-6-磷酸氧化為 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸-δ-內酯，同時把 NADP+ 還原為 NADPH。所產生的 NADPH 是還原型麩胱甘肽再生的主要動力，可中和活性氧，而這正是紅血球所依賴的機制。

nodes.label: Neuroprotection
nodes.description: Neuroprotection and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuroprotection and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuroprotection 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuroprotection 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Parkin
nodes.description: Parkin is a multidomain E3 ubiquitin ligase whose N-terminal Ubiquitin-like domain engages RING0 in the autoinhibited state, folding the enzyme closed so that RING2 is occluded. Displacement of the UBL — by PINK1-mediated phosphorylation and ubiquitin-dependent relief of repression — releases active Parkin, which then ubiquitinates mitochondrial substrates during Mitophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Parkin 是多結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 N 端 Ubiquitin-like domain 在自抑制狀態下與 RING0 結合，使酵素摺疊成封閉構形而遮蔽 RING2。UBL 的位移——由 PINK1 媒介的磷酸化與泛素依賴性的去抑制促成——會釋出活性 Parkin，後者在 Mitophagy 期間泛素化粒線體受質。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Striatum
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

nodes.label: FSP1
nodes.description: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

nodes.label: Coenzyme Q10
nodes.description: Ubiquinone (CoQ10, oxidized) is the direct electron acceptor for FSP1, a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NAD(P)H to reduce CoQ10 to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains and suppresses ferroptosis. This FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis is glutathione-independent and acts in parallel to GPX4. Because CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway, statin-mediated depletion starves FSP1 of substrate and sensitizes cells to ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 泛醌（CoQ10，氧化態）是 FSP1 的直接電子受體；FSP1 是一種質膜黃素蛋白，利用 NAD(P)H 將 CoQ10 還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），後者是脂溶性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑，能終止磷脂過氧自由基鏈並抑制鐵死亡。這條 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸不依賴谷胱甘肽，並與 GPX4 平行運作。由於 CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物，statin 介導的耗竭會使 FSP1 缺乏受質並使細胞對鐵死亡增敏。

nodes.label: Modafinil
nodes.description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

nodes.label: DGCR8
nodes.description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

nodes.label: Obesity
nodes.description: Because stored fat is the difference between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, chronic positive energy balance produces weight gain and drives the obesity epidemic, whereas negative balance produces weight loss. If Western food intake has been stable or declining, reduced physical activity (PAL ~1.66) must have tipped the budget positive.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於儲存的脂肪即代謝可利用能量攝取與能量消耗之間的差值，慢性正能量平衡會造成體重增加並驅動肥胖流行；負平衡則造成體重減輕。若西方飲食攝取量穩定或下降，則身體活動量降低（PAL 約 1.66）必然使能量預算轉正。

nodes.label: Cohesin
nodes.description: The cohesin ring complex holds sister chromatids together from replication to anaphase. Maintenance is the canonical ring function; canonical filename used.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cohesin 環複合體從複製到後期將姐妹染色單體繫在一起。維持是典型的環功能；使用典型檔名。

nodes.label: leukemia
nodes.description: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

nodes.label: MethylB12
nodes.description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

nodes.label: Hydroxyurea
nodes.description: Hydroxyurea quenches the tyrosyl radical in the RRM2 small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, inactivating the enzyme. It is used clinically in myeloproliferative neoplasms and is a canonical inducer of DNA replication stress and senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 會淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶 RRM2 小次單元中的酪胺醯自由基，使酵素失活。它在臨床上用於骨髓增生性腫瘤，並是 DNA 複製壓力與衰老的典型誘導劑。

nodes.label: MXL-3
nodes.description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

nodes.label: Oocyte
nodes.description: Oocyte cytoplasm reprograms donor nuclei in SCNT. Enablement is the maternal-factor mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞質在 SCNT 重編程供體核。賦能是母系因子機制。

nodes.label: Aspirin
nodes.description: Low-dose aspirin irreversibly acetylates COX-1 in platelets, suppressing Thromboxane A2 for the platelet's roughly 10-day lifespan. Endothelial Prostacyclin is largely spared because endothelium is nucleate and can resynthesize COX, and because low dose preferentially hits the platelet enzyme pool. This selectivity is the mechanistic basis of prophylaxis, and its loss with nonselective NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors is why those agents carry cardiovascular risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 低劑量 aspirin 不可逆地乙醯化血小板中的 COX-1，在血小板約 10 天的生命期中抑制 Thromboxane A2。內皮的 Prostacyclin 則大致被保留，因為內皮具有細胞核、可重新合成 COX，且低劑量優先作用於血小板的酵素儲備池。此選擇性是預防作用的機制基礎；而非選擇性 NSAID 與 COX-2 抑制劑喪失了這種選擇性，正是它們帶有心血管風險的原因。

nodes.label: Bcl-xL
nodes.description: Bcl-xL (B-cell lymphoma-extra large, BCL2L1) is a potent anti-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family, one of the four-BH-domain proteins (with Bcl-2, Bcl-w, A1-Bfl-1, Mcl-1) that counteract apoptosis by sequestering pro-apoptotic family members. It is a major regulator of the intrinsic mitochondrial apoptotic pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bcl-xL（B-cell lymphoma-extra large，BCL2L1）是 Bcl-2 家族作用強大的抗凋亡成員，屬於含四個 BH 結構域的蛋白群（與 Bcl-2、Bcl-w、A1-Bfl-1、Mcl-1 並列），藉由隔離促凋亡家族成員來抵銷凋亡。它是內在性粒線體凋亡路徑的主要調控者。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Luteolin
nodes.description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

nodes.label: MITF
nodes.description: MITF is the master bHLH-Zip transcription factor of melanocyte development and pigment production, driving expression of the melanin synthesis machinery including tyrosinase, TRP1 and DCT. These enzymes convert tyrosine into dopaquinone and downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole intermediates that polymerize into melanins; because melanogenesis is redox-intensive and generates ortho-quinones and ROS, MITF indirectly governs the cell's capacity to buffer oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MITF 是黑色素細胞發育與色素產生的關鍵 bHLH-Zip 轉錄因子，驅動 tyrosinase、TRP1 與 DCT 等黑色素合成機制基因的表現。這些酵素將 tyrosine 轉為 dopaquinone，及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 中間體，再聚合為 melanins；由於黑色素生成屬氧化還原密集且會產生鄰醌與 ROS，MITF 間接支配細胞緩衝 oxidative stress 的能力。

nodes.label: Huntingtin
nodes.description: Huntington's Disease is an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder caused by CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion in the HTT gene. Repeats of 36 or more produce full penetrance at ≥40 CAGs and juvenile-onset disease at ≥60, because the expanded polyglutamine tract makes mutant Huntingtin misfold and aggregate into amyloid-like fibrils whose N-terminal fragments are the most cytotoxic species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Huntington's Disease 是一種由 HTT 基因 CAG 三核苷酸重複擴增所致的體染色體顯性神經退化疾病。重複數達 36 以上，≥40 CAG 為完全外顯率，≥60 則為幼年型，因為擴張的多麩醯胺酸束會使突變型 Huntingtin 錯誤折疊並聚集為類澱粉纖維，其中 N 端片段毒性最高。

nodes.label: Bioavailability
nodes.description: Loading the senolytic flavonoid Fisetin into Human Serum Albumin nanoparticles (220 ± 8 nm, ~84% encapsulation, ~75% released over 72 h) overcomes the flavonoid's poor solubility and rapid clearance, and produced greater cytotoxicity against MCF-7 Breast Cancer cells than free Fisetin. Albumin encapsulation is thus a general strategy for delivering poorly bioavailable compounds.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 將衰老細胞毒殺類黃酮 Fisetin 裝載於 Human Serum Albumin 奈米粒子中（220 ± 8 nm、封裝率約 84%、72 小時釋放約 75%），可克服該類黃酮溶解度差與清除快的限制，對 MCF-7 Breast Cancer 細胞的毒性高於游離 Fisetin。因此白蛋白包封是提升難溶性化合物 Bioavailability 的一般策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: ROS
nodes.description: OGD markedly increased intracellular superoxide/ROS production, peaking at 453% of control at 6 h. Brosimine B at 10 uM significantly lowered ROS only at the 3 h time point, with no effect at 6 or 24 h. The transient antioxidant effect parallels its early-window protection of viability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OGD 顯著增加細胞內超氧陰離子／ROS 生成，在 6 小時達到對照組的 453%。10 uM Brosimine B 僅在缺氧後 3 小時顯著降低 ROS，6 小時與 24 小時無效。此短暫抗氧化效應與其早期存活率保護窗一致。

nodes.label: MYC
nodes.description: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

nodes.label: HMGB1
nodes.description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Disease
nodes.description: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy. In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1. Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy。In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1。Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
nodes.description: Sinclair co-founded Sirtris Pharmaceuticals (later acquired by GlaxoSmithKline) to develop STACs such as SRT1720 and SRT2104 as therapeutics. Directionally, the academic discovery was translated into a company. This drove clinical translation of sirtuin activators, and it illustrates the bench-to-bedside path of sirtuin research. By commercializing STACs, Sirtris aimed to develop drugs that reproduce the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction. Although clinical outcomes were mixed, the company's formation validated sirtuins as a druggable target class and stimulated industrial interest in longevity biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sinclair 共同創辦了 Sirtris Pharmaceuticals（後被葛蘭素史克收購）以開發 SRT1720 和 SRT2104 等 STAC 作為治療藥物。在方向性上，學術發現被轉化為一家公司。這推動了 sirtuin 活化劑的臨床轉化，並說明了 sirtuin 研究從實驗室到床邊的路徑。透過商業化 STAC，Sirtris 旨在開發再現限制熱量代謝益處的藥物。儘管臨床結果不一，該公司的成立驗證了 sirtuin 作為可藥靶標類別的地位，並刺激了工業界對長壽生物學的興趣。

nodes.label: Pancreatic Cancer
nodes.description: PDA (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) accounts for approximately 85% of all pancreatic malignancies, arising from the ductal epithelium of the exocrine pancreas. It is among the most lethal cancers, with roughly 12% five-year survival across stages, and is projected to become the second leading cause of cancer death by 2030.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PDA（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma）約佔所有胰臟惡性腫瘤的 85%，源自外分泌胰臟的導管上皮。它是最致命的癌症之一，各期合計五年存活率約 12%，並預計於 2030 年成為癌症死亡第二大原因。

nodes.label: D2 receptor
nodes.description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

nodes.label: Caspase-1
nodes.description: ASC polymerizes into specks that recruit pro-Caspase-1 via CARD interactions, enabling proximity-induced activation that cleaves Gasdermin D and pro-IL-1β/IL-18.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ASC 聚合成 specks，透過 CARD 相互作用招募 pro-Caspase-1，促成鄰近誘導活化，進而切割 Gasdermin D 與 pro-IL-1β/IL-18。

nodes.label: RAGE
nodes.description: Advanced glycation end products exert their biological effects through two mechanisms: a receptor-independent pathway involving direct protein damage and extracellular matrix disruption, and a receptor-mediated pathway engaging RAGE, the receptor for advanced glycation end products. Interaction of AGEs with RAGE triggers activation of the MAPK and PI3K pathways, leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB. Both endogenous and dietary AGEs act as RAGE ligands, and activation of RAGE signaling by dietary AGEs has been demonstrated in vitro, linking exogenous glycation load to pro-inflammatory intracellular signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products exert their biological effects through two mechanisms：一為涉及direct protein damage與extracellular matrix disruption的receptor-independent pathway，另一為engaging RAGE（receptor for advanced glycation end products）的receptor-mediated pathway。AGEs與RAGE的interaction triggers activation of the MAPK與PI3K pathways，leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB。Both endogenous與dietary AGEs act as RAGE ligands，且dietary AGEs對RAGE signaling的activation已在in vitro被demonstrated，linking exogenous glycation load to pro-inflammatory intracellular signaling。

nodes.label: Microglia
nodes.description: Disease-Associated Microglia (DAM) denotes a stereotyped transcriptional and functional microglial activation state that emerges in Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation. DAM microglia show altered expression of homeostatic markers and engage phagocytic and lipid-metabolism programmes, representing the brain's attempt to contain proteotoxic burden; the signature is regulated by cues such as TREM2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Disease-Associated Microglia（DAM）指在 Neurodegenerative Disease 與 Neuroinflammation 中出現的一種刻板化轉錄與功能性的微膠細胞活化狀態。DAM 微膠細胞的穩態標記表現改變，並啟動吞噬與脂質代謝程式，代表腦部試圖圍堵蛋白毒性負荷；其特徵受 TREM2 等訊號調控。

nodes.label: Norepinephrine
nodes.description: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

nodes.label: Cellular Reprogramming
nodes.description: Cellular reprogramming erases somatic DNA methylation and other epigenetic marks to reset the cell to a pluripotent state. During iPSC generation, the Yamanaka factors promote active and passive demethylation of pluripotency gene promoters while somatic gene methylation is lost, and this global epigenetic reset is required for establishing the pluripotency gene network. The erasure of DNA methylation is a defining feature of the stochastic and deterministic phases of reprogramming. This epigenetic reset is what enables a differentiated cell to regain full developmental potential.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程會消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化和其他表觀遺傳標記，從而將細胞重置為多能狀態。在 iPSC 生成過程中，山中因子促進多能性基因啟動子主動和被動去甲基化，同時體細胞基因甲基化丟失，這種全局表觀遺傳重置是建立多能性基因網絡所必需的。 DNA 甲基化的消除是重編程隨機階段和確定性階段的決定性特徵。這種表觀遺傳重置使分化細胞能夠重新獲得全部發育潛力。

nodes.label: Colon Cancer
nodes.description: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

nodes.label: eNOS
nodes.description: eNOS (endothelial nitric oxide synthase, NOS3) is the constitutively expressed, calcium/calmodulin-dependent isoform of nitric oxide synthase in the vascular endothelium. It catalyses the conversion of L-arginine to low, pulsatile fluxes of nitric oxide, which diffuse to vascular smooth muscle and raise cGMP via soluble guanylyl cyclase to produce vasodilation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eNOS（內皮型一氧化氮合成酶，NOS3）是血管內皮中構成性表現、依賴鈣離子/鈣調蛋白的 nitric oxide synthase 異構型。它催化 L-精胺酸轉化為低量脈動式的 nitric oxide；後者擴散至血管平滑肌，經可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶提高 cGMP，產生血管舒張。

nodes.label: Anaphase Promoting Complex-Cyclosome
nodes.description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

nodes.label: EGCG
nodes.description: Green tea is the primary dietary source of EGCG, the dominant polyphenol of the beverage. EGCG is abundant in green tea, while its concentration is much lower in fermented teas such as black tea.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 綠茶是 EGCG 的主要膳食來源，EGCG 為綠茶中含量最高的多酚；在黑茶等發酵茶中，其濃度則大幅降低。

nodes.label: Caspase-8
nodes.description: Bid is activated by proteolytic cleavage, with caspase-8 the primary activating protease downstream of death-receptor engagement (caspase-2 and caspase-10 can also do so). Cleavage converts full-length Bid to tBid, which translocates to mitochondria; CK1/CK2 phosphorylation at Thr58/Ser61/Ser64 blocks the event.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bid 經由蛋白水解切割而活化，其中 caspase-8 是死亡受體啟動後的主要活化酵素（caspase-2 與 caspase-10 亦可參與）。切割將全长 Bid 轉為 tBid，後者轉位至粒線體；CK1/CK2 在 Thr58/Ser61/Ser64 的磷酸化則阻斷此步驟。

nodes.label: SARM1
nodes.description: Axon Degeneration runs through a SARM1-dependent execution pathway: axonal injury causes NMNAT2 loss, the NMN/NAD+ ratio rises, SARM1 activates, NAD+ is catastrophically depleted, and energy failure produces fragmentation. Non-SARM1 routes such as Apoptosis or Autophagy-mediated pruning contribute in developmental and disease contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Axon Degeneration 主要透過依賴 SARM1 的執行途徑進行：軸突損傷導致 NMNAT2 喪失，NMN／NAD+ 比值上升，SARM1 活化造成 NAD+ 災難性耗竭，導致能量衰竭與片段化。Apoptosis 或 Autophagy 介導的修剪等非 SARM1 途徑，則在發育與疾病情境中有所貢獻。

nodes.label: Cancer Stem Cells
nodes.description: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: GPX4
nodes.description: GPX4 is the only enzyme that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides inside the membrane, using its catalytic selenocysteine and two glutathione to convert LOOH to the inert lipid alcohol before the chain branches. Substituting cysteine for selenocysteine costs about 100-fold activity, and dietary Selenium loss removes the catalytic residue entirely, which is why selenium deficiency sensitizes tissue to ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GPX4 是唯一能在膜內還原磷脂質過氧化物的酵素，利用其催化的 selenocysteine 與兩個 glutathione 將 LOOH 轉為惰性的脂質醇，在鏈式反應分支之前完成。將 selenocysteine 換成 cysteine 會使活性下降約 100 倍，而飲食中 Selenium 流失則完全移除催化殘基，這也是 selenium 缺乏會讓組織易感鐵死亡的原因。

nodes.label: Cardiomyocytes
nodes.description: CPT2 is expressed at high levels in tissues with robust oxidative capacity - skeletal muscle, heart (cardiomyocytes), liver and kidney. Because the outer-membrane enzyme CPT1 is allosterically inhibited by malonyl-CoA while CPT2 is not, the CPT2 step of the carnitine shuttle is the rate-limiting entry point for long-chain fatty acid oxidation, supplying the matrix with acyl-CoA for beta-oxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CPT2 在氧化能力強的組織中高度表現，包括骨骼肌、心臟（心肌細胞）、肝臟與腎臟。由於外膜酵素 CPT1 會被 malonyl-CoA 別構抑制，而 CPT2 不受此調控，肉鹼穿梭的第二步 CPT2 便是長鏈脂肪酸氧化的限速入口，負責在基質中提供 acyl-CoA 供 β-氧化使用。

nodes.label: Genomic Instability
nodes.description: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

nodes.label: Heart
nodes.description: Heart releases Atrial natriuretic peptide when atrial cardiomyocytes are stretched. ANP acts through cGMP signaling to unload volume, providing a hormonal counterweight to the sympathetic drive on the Heart.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當心房心肌細胞受到牽張時，Heart（心臟）會釋放 Atrial natriuretic peptide（心房利鈉胜肽）。ANP 透過 cGMP 訊號卸除體液量，對心臟的交感神經驅動形成荷爾蒙層面的對沖。

nodes.label: Neutrophils
nodes.description: Neutrophils are white blood cells that generate large quantities of reactive oxygen species, primarily superoxide anion and hydroxyl radicals, during the respiratory burst that accompanies infection and inflammation. This burst is the basis of their microbicidal activity but also mediates non-specific oxidation reactions, including the conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome both intracellularly and extracellularly. Neutrophil-derived oxidants also include hydrogen peroxide and products of myeloperoxidase. In the lungs and other tissues flooded by neutrophils during conditions such as pneumonia, ARDS, COPD exacerbations, and acute lung injury, this ROS production makes epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation a prominent local reaction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 中性球是在感染與發炎伴隨的呼吸爆發期間產生大量活性氧物種（主要為超氧陰離子與羥基自由基）的白血球。此爆發是其殺微生物活性的基礎，但也介導非特異性氧化反應，包括在細胞內與細胞外將 epinephrine 轉化為 adrenochrome。中性球衍生的氧化劑也包括過氧化氫與 myeloperoxidase 的產物。在肺炎、ARDS、COPD 急性惡化與急性肺損傷等情況下被中性球淹沒的肺部與其他組織中，此 ROS 產生使 epinephrine 至 adrenochrome 的氧化成為顯著的局部反應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: EZH2
nodes.description: EZH2 is the catalytic PRC2 subunit within the histone methyltransferase family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EZH2 是組蛋白甲基轉移酶家族中的催化 PRC2 次單元。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
nodes.description: In the AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway, energy stress raises AMPK activity, AMPK phosphorylates PGC-1α, and the coactivator partners with transcription factors such as NRFs and ERRα to induce nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, elevating mitochondrial number, capacity, ATP output and stress resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway 中，能量壓力提升 AMPK 活性，AMPK 磷酸化 PGC-1α，後者再與 NRF、ERRα 等轉錄因子合作誘導核編碼的粒線體基因，提升粒線體數量、容量、ATP 產出與抗逆境能力。

nodes.label: Preparation for Oxidative Stress
nodes.description: Oliveira et al. propose that Preparation for Oxidative Stress (POS) is an example of physiological conditioning hormesis. Mild hypoxia-driven oxidant production preconditions animals so they tolerate a stronger reoxygenation redox challenge, matching the biphasic preconditioning pattern of hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oliveira 等人提出 Preparation for Oxidative Stress (POS) 是生理性制約 hormesis 的一個例子。輕度缺氧引發的氧化物產生可預先調節動物，使其耐受隨後更強的再氧合氧化還原挑戰，符合 hormesis 的雙相預處理模式。

nodes.label: STACs
nodes.description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

nodes.label: Stroke
nodes.description: Stroke is a medical emergency caused by interruption of blood supply to the brain, with ~87% of cases ischemic from thrombus or embolus. Its pathophysiology runs through the Ischemia-reperfusion Injury cascade, in which Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, Excitotoxicity and Apoptosis act together to produce tissue damage and neurological deficits.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stroke 是腦部血流中斷所造成的醫療急症，約 87% 屬血栓或栓塞造成的 ischemic stroke。其病理生理經由 Ischemia-reperfusion Injury 級聯反應，過程中 Oxidative Stress、Inflammation、Excitotoxicity 與 Apoptosis 共同作用，造成組織損傷與神經功能缺損。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Antioxidant
nodes.description: Antioxidants inhibit or delay oxidative stress by neutralizing or scavenging reactive oxygen species and free radicals. Endogenous systems include superoxide dismutase (dismutates superoxide to hydrogen peroxide), catalase (converts hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen), glutathione peroxidase and glutathione, while vitamin C and vitamin E act as exogenous lipid- and water-soluble scavengers. Loss of this capacity contributes to atherosclerosis, aging and neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antioxidant 藉由中和或清除活性氧與自由基來抑制或延緩氧化壓力。內源性系統包括 superoxide dismutase（將超氧陰離子歧化為過氧化氫）、catalase（將過氧化氫轉為水與氧）、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione，而 vitamin C 與 vitamin E 則作為外源性的脂溶性與水溶性清除劑。此防禦能力的喪失與動脈粥狀硬化、老化及神經退行性疾病有關。

nodes.label: Energy Expenditure
nodes.description: Doubly-labelled water (DLW), the criterion field method, tracks total daily CO2 production from isotopically labelled water (2H and 18O) over 1-3 weeks, giving a measure of free-living daily energy expenditure. Indirect calorimetry instead measures O2 consumption and CO2 production to compute expenditure during RMR measurement or exercise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 雙標水（DLW）為公認的現場標準方法，以同位素標記水（2H 與 18O）在 1 至 3 週內追蹤每日總 CO2 產生量，得到自由生活狀態下的每日能量消耗。間接測熱法則測量 O2 消耗與 CO2 產生，以計算休息代謝率測定或運動期間的能量消耗。

nodes.label: Sirtuin Inhibitors
nodes.description: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., the Fluor de Lys system) are the most commonly used methods to screen molecules as sirtuin inhibitors. Deacetylation of a fluorophore-decoupled substrate sensitizes it to a developer that releases a measurable fluorophore, and percent inhibition is calculated from fluorescence. These assays identified indoles (EX-527), tenovins, JGB1741, sirtinol analogues, and cambinol analogues. A key caveat is that the aminomethylcoumarin moiety of the fluorogenic substrates can affect binding of other small molecules to the enzyme, so confirmation with orthogonal assays is recommended.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 螢光活性測定（例如 Fluor de Lys 系統）是篩選分子作為 sirtuin 抑制劑最常用的方法。去乙醯化的螢光基團解偶聯受質經顯色劑處理後釋放出可量化的螢光基團，從螢光訊號計算抑制百分比。這些測定鑑定了吲哚類（EX-527）、tenovin、JGB1741、sirtinol 類似物和 cambinol 類似物。一個關鍵注意事項是螢光受質的氨基甲基香豆素部分可能影響其他小分子與酵素的結合，因此建議使用正交測定進行確認。

nodes.label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
nodes.description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) is a stabilized hybrid derivative formed by reaction of adrenochrome with aminoguanidine. It is more stable and less colored than the parent molecule, whose o-quinone structure is unstable, and like carbazochrome it is used as a hemostatic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）是 Adrenochrome 與 Aminoguanidine 反應形成的穩定化雜交衍生物。它比母體（具有不穩定的 o-quinone 結構）更穩定、顏色更淺，且與 Carbazochrome 同樣用作止血劑。

nodes.label: Senolytics
nodes.description: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。

nodes.label: Polyphenols
nodes.description: At low doses polyphenols stimulate endogenous antioxidant defenses, but at high concentrations such as concentrated supplements they act as potent pro-oxidants causing oxidative damage. Examples include liver damage from high-dose green tea catechins, illustrating the biphasic benefit-to-harm transition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 低劑量 Polyphenols 可刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，但在高濃度（如濃縮補充劑）下則成為強效促氧化劑並造成氧化損傷。例如高劑量綠茶兒茶素可能導致肝損傷，說明了從有益到有害的雙相轉換。

nodes.label: Tumor Suppressor Gene
nodes.description: p53 is the definitional tumor suppressor gene of cancer biology. Classification is textbook.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p53 是癌症生物學定義性的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類為教科書等級。

nodes.label: PINK1
nodes.description: More than 50 pathogenic PINK1 mutations cause autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson's disease, the second most common genetic cause after PRKN; mutations cluster in the kinase domain and impair catalytic activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 超過 50 個致病性 PINK1 突變會造成體染色體隱性早發型帕金森氏症，是僅次於 PRKN 的第二常見遺傳原因；突變集中於激酶結構域並損害催化活性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: TGFβ
nodes.description: BMP is a large subfamily of secreted growth factors within the TGFβ superfamily; synthesized as precursors and cleaved to mature C-terminal dimers stabilized by an intramolecular cystine knot, BMPs signal through type I/II serine-threonine kinase receptors to form morphogen gradients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BMP 是 TGFβ 超家族中一大分泌型生長因子亞家族；它們先以前驅物合成，再被切割釋出由分子內 cystine knot 穩定的 C 端成熟二聚體，並透過第一型／第二型絲胺酸－蘇胺酸激酶受體傳訊，形成形態發生的濃度梯度。

nodes.label: Heart Failure
nodes.description: Levels of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) are significantly decreased in cardiomyocytes from individuals with advanced heart failure, along with MnSOD and Bcl-xL. This loss of the protective thioredoxin system is thought to reduce cardiac resistance to pathologic insults in end-stage disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在晚期心臟衰竭患者的心肌細胞中，Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的濃度會顯著下降，MnSOD 與 Bcl-xL 亦然。此保護性硫氧還蛋白系統的喪失被認為會降低末期疾病中心臟對病理傷害的抵抗能力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Iron
nodes.description: Iron causes Oxidative Stress by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Iron 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Oxidative Stress，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

nodes.label: Androgen Receptor
nodes.description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

nodes.label: Amyloid Beta
nodes.description: Amyloid plaque pathology is central to Alzheimer disease. Involvement records the defining lesion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 類澱粉斑塊病理是阿茲海默病的核心。涉及記錄定義性病灶。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: EGFR
nodes.description: Lung Cancer is driven by EGFR. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Lung Cancer, so EGFR is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 由EGFR 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從EGFR向Lung Cancer延伸，因此EGFR是活性劑，Lung Cancer是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: HIV-1
nodes.description: HIV-1 is the causative agent of the global AIDS pandemic. Infection leads to progressive CD4+ T cell depletion through direct viral killing, bystander apoptosis, pyroptosis of abortively infected cells and chronic immune activation; once CD4 counts fall below 200 cells/µL the host becomes susceptible to opportunistic infections such as Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, tuberculosis and toxoplasmosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 是全球 AIDS 大流行的致病因子。感染會透過直接病毒殺傷、旁觀細胞 apoptosis、abortively infected 細胞的 pyroptosis 與慢性免疫活化，造成 CD4+ T 細胞逐步耗竭；當 CD4 數低於 200 cells/µL，宿主便容易出現 Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia、tuberculosis 與 toxoplasmosis 等伺機性感染。

nodes.label: IL-6
nodes.description: IL-6 is a prototypical SASP cytokine and one of the most consistently secreted factors in senescent cells, acting as an essential mediator of paracrine senescence and immune modulation. It signals through JAK/STAT3 to promote inflammation and, in some contexts, stemness, and it is widely used as a biomarker of the senescent secretome and of aging. IL-6 also contributes to the feed-forward loop sustaining the SASP and to inflammaging. Its prominence and reliability make it a canonical reference SASP component, frequently measured with IL-8.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 介白素-6（IL-6）與 IL-8 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。衰老細胞分泌 IL-6，重塑局部組織微環境並發揮旁分泌效應，甚至將衰老表型傳播給健康細胞。在本研究中，重組 IL-6（以 2:1 比例與 IL-8 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現並提高脂質過氧化，使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感，並放大組織功能障礙。

nodes.label: Paracrine Senescence
nodes.description: Notch is essential for establishing Paracrine Senescence: senescent cells stimulate Notch signaling in neighboring cells, propagating the arrested, SASP-producing state, though the SASP of these secondary senescent cells is weaker and may limit runaway spread.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Notch 對建立 Paracrine Senescence 至關重要：衰老細胞會刺激鄰近細胞的 Notch 訊號，傳播停滯且產生 SASP 的狀態；不過次級衰老細胞的 SASP 較弱，可限制失控擴散。

nodes.label: Nucleus
nodes.description: In C. elegans, mitochondrial dysfunction caused by protein misfolding alters the subcellular localization of the transcription factor ATFS-1. In healthy mitochondria, ATFS-1 is imported into the organelle and degraded by the Lon protease. During stress, ATFS-1 instead traffics to the nucleus to drive transcription of genes involved in the coordinated UPRmt response. This import-versus-nuclear-translocation decision makes protein import a readout of mitochondrial health, a paradigm the review argues is extended in mammals by mechanisms involving DELE1 processing and PINK1 accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在線蟲中，蛋白質錯誤摺疊引起的粒線體功能障礙會改變轉錄因子ATFS-1的亞細胞定位。在健康的粒線體中，ATFS-1被輸入胞器內並由Lon蛋白酶降解。在壓力期間，ATFS-1則改而運輸至細胞核，驅動協調性UPRmt反應相關基因的轉錄。這種「輸入粒線體」與「轉位至細胞核」的抉擇，使蛋白質輸入成為粒線體健康狀態的讀數；該綜述主張此範式在哺乳類中經由涉及DELE1加工與PINK1累積的機制獲得延伸。

nodes.label: MAPK
nodes.description: RAS/MAPK is a canonical c-Met effector arm for proliferation. Activation covers the mitogenic output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RAS/MAPK 是 c-Met 增殖的典型效應臂。活化涵蓋促有絲分裂輸出。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Hippocampus
nodes.description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

nodes.label: Methylfolate
nodes.description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

nodes.label: MLKL
nodes.description: During phagocytosis, TAM kinases (Tyro3, Axl, Mer) activated by phosphatidylserine directly phosphorylate MLKL in inflammatory disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吞噬作用期間，經磷脂醯絲胺酸活化的TAM激酶（Tyro3、Axl、Mer）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎相關疾病。

nodes.label: Insulin Resistance
nodes.description: When it is over-activated by nutrients and insulin, mTOR acts via S6K1 to inhibit insulin signaling, thereby causing insulin resistance. Acute treatment with rapamycin abrogates insulin resistance in cells and animals including humans, and one study shows chronic treatment with rapamycin may also prevent insulin resistance. However, in some rodent models chronic rapamycin treatment can cause glucose intolerance and insulin resistance, which is interpreted as a benevolent starvation pseudo-diabetes (SPD), a reversible condition that does not lead to complications and resembles the metabolic state of prolonged fasting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當被營養素和胰島素過度活化時，mTOR透過S6K1抑制胰島素信號，從而導致胰島素抵抗。急性雷帕霉素治療可消除細胞和動物（包括人類）的胰島素抵抗，一項研究顯示慢性雷帕霉素治療也可能預防胰島素抵抗。然而，在某些囓齒類模型中，慢性雷帕霉素治療可能導致葡萄糖不耐受和胰島素抵抗，這被解釋為一種良性飢餓假性糖尿病（SPD），一種可逆且不會導致併發症的狀態，類似於長期禁食的代謝狀態。

nodes.label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
nodes.description: Alzheimer disease is the most common dementia and neurodegenerative disorder. Classification nests it in the disease family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 阿茲海默病是最常見的失智與神經退化疾病。歸類將它嵌套於疾病家族。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: Schizophrenia
nodes.description: The Dopamine hypothesis models the symptoms of Schizophrenia as arising from disturbed, hyperactive dopaminergic signal transduction, with emphasis on neurotransmitter receptor activity. It superseded the earlier Adrenochrome Hypothesis, which had attributed schizophrenia to oxidative catecholamine metabolites such as adrenochrome, and thereby redirected research toward Dopamine receptor pharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine hypothesis 將 Schizophrenia 的症狀歸因於受干擾且過度活躍的多巴胺訊息傳遞，強調神經傳遞受體的活性。它取代了較早將精神分裂症歸因於 adrenochrome 等兒茶酚胺氧化代謝物的 Adrenochrome Hypothesis，將研究重心轉向 Dopamine 受體藥理學。

nodes.label: Methylation Cycle
nodes.description: Folinic acid supports the methylation cycle by contributing one-carbon units that enable remethylation of homocysteine to methionine and production of SAMe. Because it is not delivered as the fully methylated end product, it provides folate capacity without an immediate methyl hit. This makes it a gentler option than methylfolate for slow COMT individuals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 透過提供一碳單位來支援 methylation cycle，這些一碳單位使同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸並產生 SAMe。由於它並非以完全甲基化的終產物形式提供，因此能在沒有立即甲基衝擊的情況下提供葉酸能力。這使其成為緩慢 COMT 個體比 methylfolate 更溫和的選擇。

nodes.label: Hydroxocobalamin
nodes.description: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

nodes.label: Protein Restriction
nodes.description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

nodes.label: Norepinephrine transporter
nodes.description: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

nodes.label: DNMT1
