nodes.description: DNMT1 is the maintenance methyltransferase that copies parental-origin methylation at imprinting control regions through mitosis, preserving Genomic Imprinting marks in every daughter cell.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNMT1 是維持型甲基轉移酶，透過有絲分裂複製親代來源在 imprinting 控制區（ICR）的甲基化，在每個子細胞中保存 Genomic Imprinting（基因組印記）標記。

nodes.label: IL-1β
nodes.description: Anakinra competitively blocks the binding of both IL-1α and IL-1β to IL-1R1, shutting off IL-1-mediated inflammatory signalling. By blocking IL-1β signalling it reduces senescence-associated secretory phenotype output from senescent cells and lowers the paracrine inflammatory burden that drives inflammaging, making it a prototype senomorphic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Anakinra 競爭性阻斷 IL-1α 與 IL-1β 與 IL-1R1 的結合，關閉 IL-1 介導的發炎訊息傳遞。藉由阻斷 IL-1β 訊號，它可減少衰老細胞的衰老相關分泌表型輸出，降低驅動 inflammaging 的旁分泌發炎負擔，因此是典型的 senomorphic 藥物。

nodes.label: Heterochromatin
nodes.description: Heterochromatin keeps Transposable Elements such as LINE-1 transcriptionally silent, preventing them from being transcribed and reinserted elsewhere in the genome. When heterochromatin is lost or 'relaxes' toward Euchromatin, these elements become inappropriately activated, contributing to Genomic Instability and age-related cellular decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Heterochromatin 會使 LINE-1 等 Transposable Elements 維持轉錄靜默，阻止它們被轉錄並重新插入基因組其他位置。當異染色質流失、朝 Euchromatin「鬆弛」時，這些元件會被不適當地活化，促成 Genomic Instability 與年齡相關的細胞衰退。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Fusion
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through fusion and fission, two opposing yet coordinated processes that determine mitochondrial number, shape and function. Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network, enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide, and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity; it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion. Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane, and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fusion and fission 兩個 opposing yet coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，determining mitochondrial number, shape and function。Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network，enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide，and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity；it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion。Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane，and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: TNFα
nodes.description: NF-kB is the primary downstream transcription factor of TNF receptor signaling. Activation is distinct from the TNF-Signaling convergence edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 TNF 受體訊號的主要下游轉錄因子。活化不同於 TNF 訊號匯聚邊。

nodes.label: Blood-Brain Barrier
nodes.description: Honokiol, a lipid-soluble lignan extracted from Magnolia species, readily crosses the blood-brain barrier to exert its effects in the central nervous system, including anti-tumorigenic and neuroprotective actions. Its lipid solubility allows it to pass lipid bilayers and act at multiple intracellular and membrane sites, a property shared with the structurally related anesthetic propofol and the analog magnolol. BBB penetration is a prerequisite for honokiol's anxiolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-seizure activities in the brain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是從木蘭屬（Magnolia）植物中提取的脂溶性木脂素，能輕易穿越血腦屏障，在中樞神經系統中發揮作用，包括抗腫瘤生成與神經保護作用。其脂溶性使其能穿過脂質雙層，作用於多個細胞內與膜上的位點，此特性與結構相關的麻醉劑丙泊酚及類似物和厚朴酚共通。穿透血腦屏障是厚朴酚在大腦中發揮抗焦慮、鎮痛、抗發炎與抗癲癇活性的先決條件。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Chemotherapy
nodes.description: BH3 mimetics synergizes with Chemotherapy. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic agents to kill rapidly dividing cells, and its efficacy is limited by innate and acquired resistance mechanisms. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 與 Chemotherapy 具有協同作用。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 Chemotherapy 使用細胞毒性劑殺死快速分裂的細胞，其功效受到先天和後天抗藥性機制的限制。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當Chemotherapy 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Chromatin
nodes.description: Histone acetylation opens chromatin by neutralizing the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, weakening their electrostatic interaction with the negatively charged DNA backbone. This relaxes nucleosome compaction and increases the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and other regulatory proteins, promoting gene expression. Acetylation is dynamically deposited by histone acetyltransferases and removed by histone deacetylases, and the balance between these activities tunes chromatin structure across the genome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化透過中和組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來打開染色質，削弱它們與帶負電的 DNA 主鏈的靜電相互作用。這放鬆了核小體的壓縮並增加了 DNA 與轉錄因子和其他調節蛋白的可及性，從而促進了 gene expression。乙醯化由組蛋白乙醯轉移酶動態沉積並由組蛋白去乙醯酶去除，這些活性之間的平衡調節整個基因組的染色質結構。

nodes.label: NLRP3
nodes.description: Uric Acid Crystals activate NLRP3 in joints, making gout the prototypical acquired autoinflammatory disease; the same inflammasome is triggered by other endogenous danger signals such as Silica, oxidized Cardiolipin and mitochondrial DNA in sterile inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Uric Acid Crystals 會在關節中活化 NLRP3，使痛風成為典型的後天性自體發炎疾病；相同的發炎小體也可被其他內源性危險訊號（例如 Silica、氧化態的 Cardiolipin 與粒線體 DNA）在無菌發炎中觸發。

nodes.label: PI3K
nodes.description: Growth factors bind receptor tyrosine kinases or G protein-coupled receptors and activate RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK and PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 as well as JAK/STAT cascades. These cascades increase cyclin levels or reduce CDK inhibitor abundance to drive cell proliferation; dysregulated growth factor signaling is a hallmark of cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Growth factors 結合 receptor tyrosine kinases 或 G protein-coupled receptors，活化 RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 以及 JAK/STAT cascade。這些 cascade 增加 cyclin 濃度或降低 CDK inhibitor 豐度以驅動 cell proliferation；growth factor 訊號失調是 cancer 的特徵之一。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Partial Reprogramming
nodes.description: Signs of aging can be reversed by partial reprogramming, in which the Yamanaka factors are expressed transiently and cyclically rather than continuously. This approach restored youthful gene expression and extended lifespan in progeroid mice without the tumor formation seen with full reprogramming to pluripotency. By resetting age-related epigenetic marks, including DNA methylation and chromatin state, partial reprogramming demonstrates that aspects of biological aging are reversible. This has established partial reprogramming as a leading candidate rejuvenation strategy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 老化跡象可以透過部分重編程來逆轉，其中山中因子短暫且週期性地表達，而不是連續表達。這種方法恢復了 gene expression 的年輕狀態，並延長了早衰小鼠的壽命，並且在完全重編程為多能性時沒有腫瘤形成。透過重置與年齡相關的表觀遺傳標記，包括 DNA 甲基化和染色質狀態，部分重編程表明生物老化的各個方面是可逆的。這使得部分重編程成為主要的候選者復興策略。

nodes.label: Leuco-adrenochrome
nodes.description: Leuco-adrenochrome, the reduced leuco-form of the aminochrome system, is further oxidized to form adrenochrome, a distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound whose color arises from its extended conjugated system. Adrenochrome is the classic oxidation product of epinephrine studied since the 19th century. Because leuco-adrenochrome is highly unstable in the presence of oxygen and acts as a ready electron donor, this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily, which is why leuco-adrenochrome is difficult to isolate outside controlled laboratory environments and why pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations is a recognized stability problem.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome，aminochrome system 的 reduced leuco-form，is further oxidized to form adrenochrome，一種 distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound，其 color arises from its extended conjugated system。Adrenochrome 是 classic oxidation product of epinephrine，自 19th century 以來被研究。由於 leuco-adrenochrome 在 oxygen presence 下 highly unstable 且 acts as a ready electron donor，this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily，這就是為什麼 leuco-adrenochrome 在 controlled laboratory environments 外 difficult to isolate，以及 pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations 是 recognized stability problem。

nodes.label: Silver
nodes.description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

nodes.label: Pyroptosis
nodes.description: Gasdermin D pore formation is the execution step of pyroptotic cell death: the released N-terminal fragment oligomerizes and inserts into membranes to form ~10-20 nm pores, causing cellular swelling, loss of membrane integrity and lytic death. This pore-forming action is what makes pyroptosis inherently inflammatory, in contrast to the immunologically silent dismantling of apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gasdermin D 成孔是 pyroptosis 細胞死亡的執行步驟：釋出的 N 端片段寡聚並插入膜形成約 10–20 nm 的孔洞，造成細胞腫脹、膜完整性喪失與裂解性死亡。正是這種成孔作用使 pyroptosis 本質上具有發炎性，與免疫學上無聲的凋亡拆解形成對比。

nodes.label: Endothelial Dysfunction
nodes.description: CXCL12 was identified as the most highly upregulated SASP factor in endothelial cells with aging, and add-back of CXCL12 to old fisetin plasma recapitulated age-related endothelial dysfunction (-22% peak endothelium-dependent dilation), while CXCL12 neutralization with LIT-927 rescued function. CXCL12 also impairs NO production, raises mitochondrial superoxide and drives endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, establishing it as a causal circulating driver of vascular aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL12 被確認為內皮細胞隨老化上調最多的 SASP 因子；將 CXCL12 加回老年小鼠經 fisetin 處理的血漿可重現與年齡相關的內皮功能障礙（內皮依賴性擴張峰值下降 22%），而以 LIT-927 中和 CXCL12 則可挽救功能。CXCL12 還會損害 NO 產生、提高粒線體超氧陰離子並促進內皮間質轉化，確立它是血管老化的因果性循環因子。

nodes.label: Estrogen
nodes.description: Estrogen binding activates Erβ, which then dimerizes and regulates target gene transcription, mediating many physiological actions of estrogen in the brain, vasculature, and metabolic tissues. Erβ is expressed in the hippocampus, cortex, vascular endothelium, and reproductive tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Estrogen 的結合會活化 Erβ，後者隨即二聚化並調控標的基因轉錄，介導 estrogen 在腦部、血管與代謝組織中的多項生理作用。Erβ 表現於 hippocampus、cortex、血管內皮與生殖組織。

nodes.label: Gut Microbiome
nodes.description: The gut microbiome ferments dietary fiber into short-chain fatty acids, notably butyrate, which act on enteroendocrine cells and the enteric nervous system. These anti-inflammatory microbial products also maintain barrier integrity and train the immune system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 將 dietary fiber 發酵成 short-chain fatty acids，尤其是 butyrate，並作用於 enteroendocrine cells 與 enteric nervous system。這些抗發炎微生物產物也維持 barrier integrity 並訓練 immune system。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Glycation
nodes.description: Glycation is the product of the reaction between a sugar and the free amino group of proteins, referred to as cross-linking, and the accumulation of these glycation byproducts results in large, cross-linked molecules that inhibit the ability of the cell to function normally. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) accumulate with age in tissues, contributing to arterial stiffening and cardiac enlargement. Levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of non-diabetics, and AGEs are believed to play an important role in the development of diabetic complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 糖化（glycation）是糖與蛋白質游離胺基之間反應的產物，又稱交叉連結（cross-linking），而這些糖化副產物的累積會形成大型、交叉連結的分子，抑制細胞正常運作的能力。晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）隨年齡在組織中累積，促成動脈硬化與心臟肥大。糖尿病患者的交叉連結產物水平是非糖尿病患者的兩到三倍，且AGEs被認為在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Myeloperoxidase
nodes.description: Hypochlorous acid is generated by myeloperoxidase, which uses H2O2 and chloride to produce HOCl in activated neutrophils and monocytes. This reaction concentrates a potent oxidant at infection and inflammatory sites. The directionality is MPO catalysis to HOCl formation. A caveat is that MPO can also use bromide and other halides, so related hypohalous acids are produced alongside HOCl. Because HOCl is produced only in proximity to MPO, the appearance of its chlorinated products such as 3-chlorotyrosine is a highly specific footprint of MPO activity in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 由 myeloperoxidase 生成，myeloperoxidase 使用 H2O2 和氯化物在活化的嗜中性球和單核球產生 HOCl。此反應在感染和發炎部位濃縮了強效氧化劑。方向性是 MPO 催化 HOCl 的形成。要注意的是，MPO 還可以使用溴化物和其他鹵化物，因此相關的次鹵酸會與 HOCl 一起產生。由於 HOCl 僅在 MPO 附近產生，因此其氯化產物（例如 3-chlorotyrosine）的出現是 MPO 體內活性的高度特異性足跡。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Clock
nodes.description: Epigenetic clocks are built from DNA methylation measurements at defined sets of CpG sites whose methylation levels change predictably with chronological age. These statistical models convert methylome data into an estimate of biological age, and deviations between predicted and chronological age indicate accelerated or decelerated aging. Because methylation at these sites responds to interventions such as caloric restriction and partial reprogramming, clocks are used to track the effectiveness of rejuvenation strategies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是根據一組定義的 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化測量構建的，這些位點的甲基化水平可預測地隨著實際年齡的變化而變化。這些統計模型將甲基化組數據轉換為生物年齡的估計值，預測年齡和實際年齡之間的偏差表示老化加速或減慢。由於這些位點的甲基化會對熱量限制和部分重編程等乾預措施做出反應，因此時鐘被用來追蹤恢復活力策略的有效性。

nodes.label: Tau
nodes.description: Neurofibrillary tangles are intraneuronal paired helical filament aggregates of hyperphosphorylated Tau protein, a defining pathological feature of Alzheimer's Disease and other tauopathies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neurofibrillary tangles 是過度磷酸化 Tau 蛋白在神經細胞內形成的配對螺旋纖維聚集體，為 Alzheimer's Disease 與其他 tauopathy 的定義性病理特徵。

nodes.label: Tubulin
nodes.description: Alpha-tubulin is one of the two subunits, with beta-tubulin, that form the alpha-beta tubulin heterodimer, the building block of microtubules and the mitotic spindle. Acetylation of alpha-tubulin, classically at Lys40, is a well-established mark of stabilized, long-lived microtubules.
nodes.description_zh_TW: α-tubulin 與 β-tubulin 共同組成 αβ 型的 Tubulin 異二聚體，該異二聚體是微管與有絲分裂紡錘體的組成單位。α-tubulin 的乙醯化（典型位於 Lys40）是穩定且長壽命微管的公認標記。

nodes.label: ULK1
nodes.description: ULK1 functions within a stable initiation complex containing ATG13, FIP200 (RB1CC1), and ATG101, which nucleates autophagosome formation in response to nutrient status. Directionally, the complex sits upstream of autophagy initiation. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates ULK1 within this complex, positioning sirtuins at the top of the autophagic machinery. The ULK1 complex integrates signals from AMPK and mTORC1, which either activate or inhibit it depending on energy and nutrient state. This makes the initiation complex the central decision point for whether autophagy proceeds.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ULK1 在一個包含 ATG13、FIP200（RB1CC1）和 ATG101 的穩定啟動複合物中發揮功能，該複合物在回應營養狀態時 nucleate 自噬體形成。在方向性上，該複合物位於自噬啟動的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化此複合物中的 ULK1，將 sirtuin 置於自噬機制的頂端。ULK1 複合物整合來自 AMPK 和 mTORC1 的訊號，根據能量和營養狀態啟動或抑制自噬。這使啟動複合物成為自噬是否進行的決策核心。

nodes.label: p38 MAPK
nodes.description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates MK2 (MAPKAPK2) at Thr222 in humans, activating the kinase and relieving an intramolecular inhibitory interaction, making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls labile inflammatory mRNA stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在人類磷酸化 MK2（MAPKAPK2）的 Thr222 位點，活化該激酶並解除其分子內抑制性交互作用，使 MK2 成為 p38 調控不穩定發炎 mRNA 穩定性的主要執行者。

nodes.label: STAT3
nodes.description: IL-6 to JAK to STAT3 forms the autocrine amplification loop of SASP signaling. Activation sustains chronic inflammatory transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-6 到 JAK 到 STAT3 形成 SASP 訊號的自分泌放大迴圈。活化維持慢性發炎轉錄。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Glutaminase
nodes.description: Two major glutaminase isoforms exist: kidney-type GLS1 (encoded by GLS, with alternatively spliced variants KGA and GAC) and liver-type GLS2 (encoded by GLS2). GLS1 is the predominant isoform in most proliferating cells and is allosterically activated by phosphate and glutamate. The tumor suppressor p53 transcriptionally induces GLS2. Both isoforms are mitochondrial matrix enzymes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 存在兩種主要的 glutaminase 同型異構物：腎型 GLS1（由 GLS 編碼，具選擇性剪接變異 KGA 和 GAC）和肝型 GLS2（由 GLS2 編碼）。GLS1 是大多數增殖細胞中的主要同型異構物，受磷酸和麩胺酸異位性活化。腫瘤抑制因子 p53 轉錄誘導 GLS2。兩種同型異構物都是粒線體基質酵素。

nodes.label: Berberine
nodes.description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: ATP
nodes.description: Complex V synthesizes ATP using the proton motive force at roughly 32 to 34 ATP per glucose. Synthesis is the oxidative-phosphorylation output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 複合體 V 利用質子動力以每葡萄糖約 32 至 34 ATP 合成 ATP。合成是氧化磷酸化輸出。

nodes.label: Thymic Involution
nodes.description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

nodes.label: DNA Repair
nodes.description: MLH1 pairs with PMS2 as the MutLα mismatch-repair complex, excising base mismatches and insertion/deletion loops left by DNA Polymerase during replication. Its loss disables the DNA Repair branch that corrects these errors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MLH1 與 PMS2 組成 MutLα 錯配修復複合體，切除複製過程中由 DNA Polymerase 留下的鹼基錯配與插入／缺失環。MLH1 流失會使負責修正這些錯誤的 DNA Repair 分支失效。

nodes.label: Necrosis
nodes.description: Secondary Necrosis is a variant of Necrosis in which the plasma membrane ruptures only after the apoptotic program has already run to completion, in cells or Apoptotic Bodies that were never cleared by phagocytic efferocytosis — the standard outcome in cell culture lacking phagocytes. Because the resulting DAMP release and sterile inflammation are indistinguishable from primary necrosis, late timepoints of a 'apoptosis' assay frequently report secondary necrosis rather than the intended outcome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Secondary Necrosis 是 Necrosis 的一種變體：細胞凋亡程序已經完成後，未被吞噬清除的細胞或 Apoptotic Bodies 才喪失細胞膜完整性——這是在缺乏吞噬細胞的細胞培養中的標準結果。由於其釋放 DAMP 與引發無菌性發炎的表現與原發性壞死無法區分，凋亡實驗的晚期時間點經常測到的是 secondary necrosis 而非預期結果。

nodes.label: Mitosis
nodes.description: Aurora Kinase isozymes — Aurora-A, Aurora-B and Aurora-C — coordinate mitotic spindle assembly, chromosome alignment and segregation, and cytokinesis; Aurora-A acts at centrosomes and spindle poles, while Aurora-B is a chromosomal passenger complex component regulating kinetochore-microtubule attachments and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aurora Kinase 異構酶——Aurora-A、Aurora-B 與 Aurora-C——共同協調有絲分裂紡錘體的組裝、染色體的對齊與分離，以及胞質分裂；Aurora-A 作用於中心體與紡錘體極，Aurora-B 則是染色體乘客複合體成分，調控動粒—微管附著與紡錘體組裝檢查點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Mcl-1
nodes.description: Resistance to ABT-737 is commonly driven by Mcl-1, a pro-survival Bcl-2 family protein that ABT-737 does not inhibit. Because Mcl-1 remains available to bind and sequester pro-apoptotic effectors, MOMP is not fully engaged. The relationship is directional and defines a specific, targetable vulnerability rather than a general failure. Co-targeting Mcl-1 restores the apoptotic commitment that ABT-737 alone cannot achieve.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對 ABT-737 的抗性通常由 Mcl-1 驅動，這是 ABT-737 不抑制的一種促生存 Bcl-2 family 蛋白。由於 Mcl-1 仍可結合和隔離促凋亡效應子，因此 MOMP 並未完全發揮作用。這種關係是定向的，定義了特定的、可針對的漏洞，而不是一般的故障。共同靶向 Mcl-1 恢復了單獨 ABT-737 無法實現的凋亡承諾。

nodes.label: Lifespan
nodes.description: AGE-1 is the C. elegans class-I PI3K catalytic subunit downstream of the DAF-2 insulin/IGF-1 receptor; reduced AGE-1 signalling derepresses DAF-16/FOXO and extends Lifespan. The age-1(hx546) mutant was among the first single-gene longevity mutants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGE-1 是 C. elegans 的第一類 PI3K 催化次單元，位於 DAF-2 胰島素/IGF-1 受體下游；AGE-1 訊號下降會解除對 DAF-16/FOXO 的抑制並延長 Lifespan。age-1(hx546) 突變株是最早的單基因長壽突變株之一。

nodes.label: Diabetes Mellitus
nodes.description: Diabetes Mellitus is a group of metabolic diseases characterized by chronic hyperglycemia. Chronic hyperglycemia increases Reactive Oxygen Species production in the Mitochondria, producing systemic Oxidative Stress together with micro- and macrovascular complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diabetes Mellitus 是一群以長期高血糖為特徵的代謝疾病。慢性高血糖使 Mitochondria 產生更多 Reactive Oxygen Species，造成全身性的 Oxidative Stress，並伴隨微血管與大血管併發症。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Cisplatin
nodes.description: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

nodes.label: CamKIIα
nodes.description: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

nodes.label: RIPK1
nodes.description: Necrostatin-1 (Nec-1) is a selective small-molecule inhibitor that allosterically blocks RIPK1 kinase activity, preventing phosphorylation and translocation of RIPK1 and therefore the formation of the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necrosome. It is the most widely used tool compound for dissecting necroptosis from other forms of regulated cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1（Nec-1）是選擇性小分子抑制劑，以異位（allosteric）方式阻斷 RIPK1 激酶活性，阻止 RIPK1 的磷酸化與轉位，因而無法形成 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL 壞死小體。它是區分 necroptosis 與其他受調控細胞死亡形式最廣泛使用的工具化合物。

nodes.label: STING
nodes.description: STING inhibitors (H151, SN-011, amlexanox, c-176) are experimental small molecules that block signaling downstream of the cGAS-STING pathway by interfering with STING activation, trafficking, or downstream kinase recruitment. Targeting STING itself interrupts both canonical cGAS-dependent and noncanonical, cGAS-independent activation such as that triggered by NPC1 deficiency or C9orf72 loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STING inhibitors（H151、SN-011、amlexanox、c-176）是實驗性小分子，透過干擾 STING 的活化、運輸或下游激酶招募，阻斷 cGAS-STING Pathway 下游的訊息傳遞。由於直接針對 STING，因此可同時阻斷典型的 cGAS 依賴性與非典型 cGAS 非依賴性活化，例如由 NPC1 缺乏或 C9orf72 喪失所觸發者。

nodes.label: HIF-1α
nodes.description: Under hypoxic or ischemic stress, HIF-1α transcriptionally activates BNIP3 in neurons; BNIP3 then inserts into the mitochondrial membrane, causing loss of mitochondrial membrane potential and opening of the Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore, producing delayed neuronal death that BNIP3 knockout rescues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在缺氧或缺血壓力下，HIF-1α 於神經元中轉錄活化 BNIP3；BNIP3 隨後嵌入粒線體膜，造成粒線體膜電位喪失與 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟，引發延遲性神經元死亡，而 BNIP3 敲除可挽救此現象。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: PGC-1α
nodes.description: PGC-1α acts as the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis, co-activating NRF1, NRF2, PPARα, PPARγ, ERRalpha and YY1 to control expression of over 1,000 nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes via the NRF1/NRF2 → TFAM axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PGC-1α 是粒線體生成的總調控因子，藉由共同活化 NRF1、NRF2、PPARα、PPARγ、ERRalpha 與 YY1，經 NRF1/NRF2 → TFAM 路徑調控超過一千個核編碼粒線體基因的表現。

nodes.label: Flavonoids
nodes.description: Flavonoids inhibit NADPH oxidase by blocking p47phox translocation to the membrane, reducing superoxide production in endothelial and phagocytic cells. This interrupts a major enzymatic ROS source. The directionality is flavonoid to NOX assembly inhibition. A caveat is that different flavonoids preferentially target different NOX isoforms, and effects vary with structure and bioavailability. This inhibition is shared by many dietary flavonoids and contributes to their vasculo- and cardioprotective effects, addressing the source rather than only the products of oxidant generation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 透過阻斷 p47phox 易位至膜來抑制 NADPH oxidase，從而減少內皮細胞和吞噬細胞中超氧化物的產生。這會中斷 ROS 的主要酵素源。方向性是類黃酮對 NOX 組裝的抑制。需要注意的是，不同的 flavonoids 優先針對不同的 NOX 同工型，且效果因結構和生物利用度而異。許多飲食中的 flavonoids 都具有這種抑製作用，有助於其血管和心臟保護作用，解決氧化劑生成的根源而不僅僅是產物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: Synaptic plasticity
nodes.description: CaMKIIalpha is essential for synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD), by phosphorylating AMPA receptor subunits and structural proteins that consolidate changes in synaptic efficacy. Inhibition or knockout of CaMKIIalpha abolishes LTP at many synapses, confirming its necessity. Its autophosphorylation at threonine 286 generates calcium-independent activity that maintains potentiated transmission over time. It thus serves as a molecular switch converting transient calcium signals into lasting synaptic memory.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 synaptic plasticity 至關重要，包括長時程增強 (LTP) 和長時程抑制 (LTD)，透過磷酸化 AMPA 受體亞基和結構蛋白來鞏固突觸功效的變化。抑製或敲除 CaMKIIalpha 可消除許多突觸的 LTP，證實了其必要性。其蘇氨酸 286 處的自磷酸化產生不依賴鈣的活性，可隨著時間的推移維持增強的傳輸。因此，它充當分子開關，將瞬態鈣訊號轉換為持久的突觸記憶。

nodes.label: melittin
nodes.description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

nodes.label: Differentiation
nodes.description: Retinoic Acid induces differentiation in monolayer cultures of embryonic stem cells cultured without Leukemia inhibitory factor, providing a standard in vitro model for testing lineage commitment and self-renewal silencing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 在未添加 Leukemia inhibitory factor 的胚胎幹細胞單層培養中誘導 Differentiation，提供了測試譜系命定與自我更新沉默的標準體外模型。

nodes.label: Selenocysteine
nodes.description: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD) is a selenoprotein whose catalytic activity depends on a C-terminal selenocysteine (Sec) residue encoded by a recoded UGA codon. This selenium dependence makes TXNRD exquisitely sensitive to electrophilic inhibitors that react with selenols, including auranofin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD）是一種硒蛋白，其催化活性依賴由重編碼 UGA 密碼子編碼的 C 端硒半胱氨酸（Sec）殘基。此硒依賴性使 TXNRD 對能與硒醇反應的親電子抑制劑（包括 auranofin）極為敏感。

nodes.label: Medium spiny neurons
nodes.description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

nodes.label: PEX14
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX14 cause PEX14-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder (~1-2% of cases); missense variants in the acidic docking domain partially impair PEX5 binding and give milder disease, while truncating mutations are lethal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX14 突變會造成 PEX14 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群（約佔 1–2% 病例）；酸性對接結構域的錯義變異會部分損害 PEX5 結合而疾病較輕，截短突變則致死。

nodes.label: Catecholamines
nodes.description: The Adrenal gland is a paired endocrine organ whose inner Adrenal medulla, composed of Chromaffin cells, synthesizes the Catecholamines Epinephrine (about 80%) and Norepinephrine (about 20%). Synthesis runs Tyrosine to L-DOPA via Tyrosine Hydroxylase, then dopamine, Norepinephrine, and finally Epinephrine via PNMT.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenal gland 是一對內分泌器官，其內層由 Chromaffin cells 組成的 Adrenal medulla 合成 Catecholamines，即約 80% 的 Epinephrine 與約 20% 的 Norepinephrine。合成途徑由 Tyrosine 經 Tyrosine Hydroxylase 轉為 L-DOPA，再經 dopamine、Norepinephrine，最後由 PNMT 催化生成 Epinephrine。

nodes.label: Hormetic Window
nodes.description: Methylene blue follows a hormetic dose-response curve: the same mechanism that is beneficial at low doses works against the organism at high ones. The therapeutic window is real and narrow - 1-4 mg is where the benefits are, and above 7-10 mg the risks start - while doses above approximately 2 mg/kg can flip the redox-cycling mechanism from antioxidant to pro-oxidant, generating oxidative stress instead of reducing it. Too little and you do not get the benefits; too much and the redox cycling starts producing oxidative stress. This hormetic behavior explains why more is not better for methylene blue and why micro-to-low-physiological dosing (0.5-4 mg) is the evidence-supported sweet spot for wellness applications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue遵循hormetic劑量反應曲線：在低劑量有益的機制在高劑量下對生物體有害。治療窗口是真實且狹窄的——1-4毫克是益處所在，超過7-10毫克風險開始——而劑量超過約2 mg/kg可能使氧化還原循環機制從抗氧化劑轉變為促氧化劑，產生氧化應激而不是減少它。太少你得不到益處；太多氧化還原循環開始產生氧化應激。這種hormetic行為解釋了為什麼對methylene blue來說越多越好不成立，以及為什麼微至低生理劑量（0.5-4毫克）是健康應用的證據支持最佳範圍。

nodes.label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: Reperfusion introduces molecular oxygen into metabolically compromised tissue and triggers a burst of reactive oxygen species from xanthine oxidase, the mitochondrial electron transport chain, NADPH oxidase and activated neutrophils, causing lipid peroxidation, protein oxidation and DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 再灌流將分子氧帶入代謝受損的組織，觸發來自黃嘌呤氧化酶、粒線體電子傳遞鏈、NADPH oxidase 與活化嗜中性球的活性氧爆發，造成脂質過氧化、蛋白質氧化與 DNA 損傷。

nodes.label: RIPK3
nodes.description: Conditional deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD in intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis and IBD-like pathology, but crossing these mice onto a RIPK3-deficient background completely prevents the disease, demonstrating that the epithelial cell death underlying the phenotype is RIPK3-dependent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在腸道上皮中條件性刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引發自發性壞死性凋亡與類 IBD 的病理，但將這些小鼠交配到缺乏 RIPK3 的背景上可完全阻止該病徵，證明其上皮細胞死亡依賴 RIPK3。

nodes.label: BDNF
nodes.description: In dose-response comparisons across low, moderate, and high exercise intensities, all intensities improved cognition and motor outcomes, but high-intensity exercise produced the greatest BDNF upregulation alongside the strongest behavioral gains. This intensity-dependent neurotrophic response supports prescribing higher-intensity modalities such as HIIT when tolerated to maximize BDNF-TrkB signaling in neurodegenerative models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在低、中、高運動強度的劑量反應比較中，所有強度均改善認知與運動結果，但 High-Intensity Exercise 產生最大的 BDNF 上調並伴隨最強的行為改善。此強度依賴的神經營養反應支持在可耐受時優先採用 HIIT 等高強度模式，以最大化神經退化模型中的 BDNF-TrkB 訊號。

nodes.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
nodes.description: Sorafenib is an orally active multi-kinase inhibitor targeting RAF, VEGFR and PDGFR, approved as first-line therapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (and certain renal and thyroid cancers) where it dampens RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling and angiogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sorafenib 是可口服的多激酶抑制劑，標的為 RAF、VEGFR 與 PDGFR，獲准作為晚期 hepatocellular carcinoma（以及部分腎癌與甲狀腺癌）的第一線治療，用以抑制 RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK 訊號與血管新生。

nodes.label: Angiogenesis
nodes.description: The tumour microenvironment is a heterogeneous ecosystem of malignant cells, cancer-associated fibroblasts, immune and endothelial cells, extracellular matrix and a cytokine soup of growth factors including VEGF and EGF. Tumors secrete VEGF to recruit new blood vessels, ensuring a steady supply of nutrients and oxygen, and hypoxia, low pH and raised interstitial pressure drive drug resistance and immune evasion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腫瘤微環境（tumour microenvironment）是由惡性細胞、癌相關纖維母細胞、免疫與內皮細胞、細胞外基質，以及含 VEGF、EGF 等生長因子的「細胞激素湯」所構成的異質性生態系。腫瘤分泌 VEGF 以招募新血管，確保營養與氧氣的穩定供應；而低氧、低 pH 與升高的間質壓力則促成藥物抗性與免疫逃脫。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial DNA
nodes.description: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: Longevity
nodes.description: Dietary protein restriction (PR) is a robust geroprotective regimen that extends lifespan in yeast, flies, and rodents and improves healthspan. Rodent studies demonstrate lifespan extension across many strains (for example, 34.9% in male C57BL/6J mice on a 21% vs 7% protein diet, and large extensions in flies), while restriction of specific essential amino acids - particularly methionine, isoleucine, and valine - recapitulates many of PR's benefits. FGF21-null mice do not live longer on PR, identifying FGF21 as essential for the longevity benefits. The Okinawan population's ~9% protein diet is cited as a human parallel to PR's lifespan effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 飲食蛋白質限制（PR）是一種強健的抗老化方案，在酵母、果蠅和囓齒動物中延長壽命並改善健康span。囓齒動物研究顯示多種品系的壽命延長（例如，21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性C57BL/6J小鼠延長34.9%，果蠅中也有大幅延長），而特定必需胺基酸——特別是甲硫氨酸、異亮氨酸和纈氨酸——的限制重現了PR的許多益處。FGF21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長，確定了FGF21對壽命益處的必要性。沖繩人口約9%蛋白質飲食被引用為人類中與PR壽命效應平行的例子。

nodes.label: NADPH Oxidase
nodes.description: p47phox (NCF1) is the cytosolic organizer of the NOX2 NADPH Oxidase: upon phosphorylation it translocates to the membrane together with p67phox and p40phox to join cytochrome b558 (p22phox/gp91phox), triggering the respiratory burst. Its role is organizational rather than catalytic - p47phox is a scaffold that brings the cytosolic subunits into contact with the membrane catalytic subunit, which is why its loss abolishes oxidase activation and why NCF1 mutations are the commonest autosomal-recessive cause of Chronic Granulomatous Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p47phox（NCF1）是 NOX2 NADPH Oxidase 的細胞質組織次單元：磷酸化後，它與 p67phox 及 p40phox 一同轉位至膜，與 cytochrome b558（p22phox/gp91phox）結合，觸發呼吸爆發。其角色是組織性而非催化性——p47phox 是將細胞質次單元帶到膜上催化次單元附近的支架，因此其喪失會使氧化酶活化消失，而 NCF1 突變是 Chronic Granulomatous Disease 最常見的體染色體隱性病因。

nodes.label: Tumor Microenvironment
nodes.description: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: mTORC2
nodes.description: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

nodes.label: Metastasis
nodes.description: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition underlies carcinoma invasion and metastasis and contributes to resistance to chemotherapy and targeted therapy. SASP factors from senescent fibroblasts and epithelial cells enhance invasiveness, stemness and therapy resistance in adjacent tumor cells, so even a small senescent-cell burden can promote pre-neoplastic progression and dissemination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition 是 carcinoma 侵襲與 metastasis 的基礎，也促成對化學治療與標靶治療的抗藥性。來自衰老纖維母細胞與上皮細胞的 SASP 因子會增強鄰近腫瘤細胞的侵襲性、幹性與治療抗藥性，因此即使衰老細胞數量很少也能促進癌前進展與散布。

nodes.label: Peroxynitrite
nodes.description: Peroxynitrite (ONOO-) is the most powerful oxidant driving tyrosine nitration, converting a tyrosine residue to 3-nitrotyrosine either directly or via intermediate radicals (tyrosyl radical plus nitrogen dioxide). Peroxynitrite itself forms where nitric oxide and superoxide coincide, so nitration marks sites of combined nitric oxide and superoxide generation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite（ONOO-）是推動 Tyrosine Nitration 最強的氧化劑，可直接或經由中間自由基（tyrosyl radical 加 nitrogen dioxide）將酪胺酸殘基轉換為 3-nitrotyrosine。Peroxynitrite 本身在一氧化氮與超氧陰離子交會處形成，因此硝化標記出的是一氧化氮與超氧陰離子共同生成的位點。

nodes.label: Prefrontal Cortex
nodes.description: COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase) dominates dopamine clearance in the prefrontal cortex because this brain region is sparsely populated with the dopamine transporter (DAT), forcing reliance on extracellular enzymatic degradation rather than rapid reuptake. By methylating dopamine into inactive 3-methoxytyramine using SAMe as cofactor, COMT sets the extracellular dopamine tone that governs prefrontal cognition, working memory, and executive control. The norepinephrine transporter contributes secondarily to this clearance. Because the Val158Met polymorphism changes COMT activity three- to four-fold, genetic variation in COMT has an outsized impact on prefrontal dopamine signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）主導前額葉皮質中的多巴胺清除，因為該 brain 區域稀疏地分佈有多巴胺轉運蛋白（DAT），迫使其依賴細胞外酶促降解而不是快速再攝取。透過使用 SAMe 作為輔因子將多巴胺甲基化為不活躍的 3-methoxytyramine，COMT 設定了控制前額認知、工作記憶和執行控制的細胞外多巴胺基調。 norepinephrine 運輸車對這項清除起到了次要的作用。由於 Val158Met 多態性使 COMT activity 發生三到四倍的變化，COMT 的遺傳變異對前額葉多巴胺訊號傳導產生巨大影響。

nodes.label: Neuroinflammation
nodes.description: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation causes Neuroinflammation by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Neuroinflammation，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

nodes.label: Vitamin E
nodes.description: Red palm oil delivers 717-863 ppm of Vitamin E, roughly 10 mg per tablespoon, which is the same order as the 15 mg adult RDA. Unlike fully bleached and deodorized palm olein, low-temperature molecular distillation preserves about 80% of the crude oil's carotenoids and vitamin E. Heavy refining destroys 50-80% of the tocopherols and essentially all carotenoids, so minimally refined red palm oil is the nutritionally meaningful form and refined palm olein is not a comparable source.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Red palm oil 提供 717-863 ppm 的 Vitamin E，每一大匙約 10 mg，與成人 RDA 15 mg 屬同一量級。與完全漂白、脫臭的 palm olein 不同，低溫分子蒸餾可保留原油中約 80% 的類胡蘿蔔素與 vitamin E。重度精煉會破壞 50-80% 的 tocopherols，並幾乎摧毁所有類胡蘿蔔素，因此 minimally refined 的 red palm oil 才是有營養意義的形式，refined palm olein 並非等效來源。

nodes.label: Caspase-3
nodes.description: The executioner caspase-3 also directly cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis. Because both the initiator caspase-9 and executioner caspase-3 process Sir2α, cleavage and the accompanying nuclear-to-cytoplasmic dislocation occur throughout the apoptotic process, not at a single checkpoint. In Ara-C-treated embryonic mouse brain, over 130 of 150 cells with cytoplasmic Sir2α had pyknotic nuclei, confirming in vivo that the caspase-3-era SIRT1 fragments mark terminally dying cells. Cleavage therefore converts an anti-apoptotic survival factor into processed fragments precisely when the death program becomes irreversible.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 執行者半胱天冬酶-3（Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間同樣會直接切割 SIRT1。由於起始 Caspase-9 與執行者 Caspase-3 都會處理 Sir2α，切割與伴隨的核質易位發生在整個細胞凋亡過程中，而非單一檢查點。在 Ara-C 處理的胚胎小鼠腦中，150 個細胞質型 Sir2α 細胞裡有超過 130 個呈現核固縮，證實在體內帶 caspase-3 特徵的 SIRT1 片段標記著走向終末的死亡細胞。當死亡程序變得不可逆時，切割便將抗凋亡的存活因子轉化為處理後的片段。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Hydrogen Peroxide
nodes.description: Peroxiredoxins are thiol-dependent peroxidases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide, peroxynitrite, and a range of organic hydroperoxides, reducing them to water. They are among the most abundant antioxidant proteins in the cell and act as primary H2O2 sinks and refined regulators of redox signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶是依賴硫醇的過氧化酶，可將過氧化氫、過氧亞硝酸鹽及多種有機氫過氧化物解毒並還原為水。它們是細胞中最豐富的抗氧化蛋白之一，既是主要的 H2O2 匯集處，也是氧化還原訊息傳遞的精細調節者。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response
nodes.description: ATF5 is the mammalian transcription factor that mediates the mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Like C. elegans ATFS-1, ATF5 partitions between the nucleus and mitochondria, and under mitochondrial stress it localizes to the nucleus to induce chaperones and proteases that restore mitochondrial proteostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATF5 是介導 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的哺乳類轉錄因子。與 C. elegans 的 ATFS-1 相同，ATF5 在細胞核與粒線體之間分配；在粒線體壓力下它定位至細胞核，誘導 chaperone 與 protease 以恢復粒線體蛋白恆定。

nodes.label: Hypoxia
nodes.description: Ischemic stroke is acute brain injury from focal arterial occlusion in which hypoxia collapses oxidative phosphorylation, producing an irreversibly necrotic core surrounded by a hypoperfused but salvageable penumbra that is the target of reperfusion therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 缺血性中風是局部動脈阻塞造成的急性腦損傷，缺氧使氧化磷酸化崩潰，形成不可逆壞死的核心，外圍則是低灌流但可挽救的半暗帶，為再灌流治療的目標。

nodes.label: Macrophages
nodes.description: Crown-like structures (CLS) are histological formations in obese adipose tissue in which macrophages, predominantly of the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, form a ring around a single dead or dying adipocyte. CLS form after adipocyte hypertrophy and death, and their density in biopsies reports the inflammatory status of the tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Crown-like Structures（CLS）是肥胖脂肪組織中的組織學構造，巨噬細胞（以促發炎 M1 表型為主）環繞單一死亡或瀕死 adipocyte 形成環狀排列。CLS 在 adipocyte肥大與死亡後形成，其在活檢中的密度可反映組織的發炎狀態。

nodes.label: MFN2
nodes.description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Fibrosis
nodes.description: TGF-beta drives organ fibrosis through collagen synthesis and MMP suppression. It is the dominant profibrotic cascade in lung, liver and kidney.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 經由膠原合成與 MMP 抑制驅動器官纖維化。它是肺、肝與腎的主要促纖維化級聯。

nodes.label: PARP1
nodes.description: PARP1 is one of four major NAD+-consuming enzyme families — with CD38, SARM1 and the sirtuins — that compete for a shared intracellular pool. PARP1 polymerizes ADP-ribose from NAD+ onto target proteins for DNA repair signaling, and hyperactivation can exhaust the pool, which is why combined CD38 plus PARP1 inhibition fully rescues NAD+ where single agents fail.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PARP1 是四大 NAD+ 消耗酵素家族之一——與 CD38、SARM1 及 sirtuins 競爭同一細胞內池。PARP1 將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖聚合到受質蛋白上以傳遞 DNA 修復訊號，而過度活化可能耗盡此池；這也是 CD38 與 PARP1 合併抑制能完全救援 NAD+、單一藥物卻做不到的原因。

nodes.label: BAX
nodes.description: BH3-only proteins activate BAX and dislodge BAK from anti-apoptotic restraint, allowing BAX/BAK oligomerization into lipidic pores; full synchronized pore formation is the pivotal commitment event of intrinsic apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BH3-only 蛋白會活化 BAX 並將 BAK 從抗凋亡的抑制中釋放，使 BAX/BAK 寡聚化形成脂質孔道；全面同步的成孔即為內在性凋亡的關鍵承諾事件。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: Methemoglobin
nodes.description: Cytochrome b5 reductase, also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, is the enzyme that returns spontaneously formed methemoglobin (normally under 1-2% of total hemoglobin) to its functional ferrous Fe2+ state. By keeping hemoglobin in the ferrous state, this enzyme is what makes hemoglobin able to carry oxygen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase（又稱 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase）是將自發形成的 methemoglobin（正常情況下佔總 hemoglobin 的 1–2% 以下）還原回具功能的 Fe2+ 狀態的酵素。藉由讓 hemoglobin 維持於 ferrous 狀態，此酵素使 hemoglobin 能夠攜帶氧氣。

nodes.label: DRP1
nodes.description: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family. Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes. DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts).
nodes.description_zh_TW: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family。Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes。DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts)。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide
nodes.description: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) is the direct biosynthetic precursor of NAD+, a key intermediate that can be adenylylated by NMNAT to generate the coenzyme; as an NAD+ booster it enables activation of PGC-1a and sirtuin-mediated pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) 是 NAD+ 的直接生合成前驅物，屬關鍵中間產物，可經 NMNAT 腺苷酸化生成該輔酶；作為 NAD+ 促進劑，NMN 能使 PGC-1α 與 sirtuin 媒介的路徑得以活化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: Parthanatos
nodes.description: Parthanatos is a regulated cell death program defined by PARP1 hyperactivation, PAR signaling, and AIF/MIF-dependent large-scale DNA fragmentation, distinct from caspase-dependent apoptosis and accidental necrosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Parthanatos 是一種受調控的細胞死亡程序，由 PARP1 過度活化、PAR 訊號傳遞以及 AIF/MIF 依賴的大尺度 DNA 片段化所定義，不同於 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis 與意外的 necrosis。

nodes.label: Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis
nodes.description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide
nodes.description: Volatile, lipophilic amyl nitrite releases nitric oxide and nitrite in vivo; liberated nitric oxide activates soluble guanylyl cyclase, raising cGMP and relaxing vascular smooth muscle — the basis of its anti-anginal and vasodilator effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 揮發性、亲脂性的 Amyl nitrite 在體內釋放 Nitric Oxide 與 nitrite；釋出的 Nitric Oxide 活化 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase，使 cGMP 上升並放鬆血管平滑肌，這是其抗心絞痛與血管擴張作用的基礎。

nodes.label: Metformin
nodes.description: The TAME Trial (Targeting Aging with Metformin) is a FDA-approved clinical study testing whether Metformin delays aging-related multimorbidity. It enrolled 3000 participants aged 65 to 79 and examines whether metformin can attenuate the hallmarks of Aging and delay the onset of age-related diseases, using a framework of blood-based Biomarkers to monitor the intervention's effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TAME Trial（Targeting Aging with Metformin）是一項經 FDA 核准的臨床研究，測試 Metformin 能否延緩與老化相關的多病共存。它納入了 3000 名 65 至 79 歲的受試者，檢視 metformin 能否減弱老化的特徵並延後年齡相關疾病的發生，並以血液生物標記的框架監測介入的效應。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: Spermidine
nodes.description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Fission
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: LC3
nodes.description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

nodes.label: CD38
nodes.description: Malignant plasma cells in Multiple Myeloma express extremely high levels of CD38, which makes CD38 the premier therapeutic target in the disease; loss of CD38 from the surface by trogocytosis is a key resistance mechanism to anti-CD38 antibodies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Multiple Myeloma 的惡性漿細胞極度高表達 CD38，使 CD38 成為該疾病最主要的治療標的；而透過 trogocytosis 自細胞表面剝除 CD38 則是對抗 anti-CD38 抗體的關鍵抗藥機制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: cGAS
nodes.description: cGAS synthesizes the endogenous cyclic dinucleotide messenger 2'3'-cGAMP from ATP and GTP upon sensing cytosolic DNA. cGAMP then binds STING in the endoplasmic reticulum, triggering STING translocation to the ERGIC and recruitment of TBK1 and IRF3 to drive type I interferon and ISG expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cGAS 在偵測到細胞質 DNA 後，以 ATP 與 GTP 合成內源性 Cyclic Dinucleotide 訊息傳遞者 2'3'-cGAMP。cGAMP 接著在內質網中結合 STING，促使 STING 易位至 ERGIC 並招募 TBK1 與 IRF3，進而驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 的表現。

nodes.label: NLRP3 Inflammasome
nodes.description: ASC-speck proximity induces caspase-1 activation as the canonical inflammasome output. Activation executes pyroptotic and cytokine processing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ASC 斑點鄰近誘發 caspase-1 活化作為典型發炎體輸出。活化執行焦亡與細胞激素處理。

nodes.label: MnSOD
nodes.description: The dismutation of superoxide by MnSOD yields hydrogen peroxide as its enzymatic product, which is then detoxified by catalase and peroxiredoxins/glutathione peroxidases. This product feeds the mitochondrial peroxide-relay, linking MnSOD to the thioredoxin/peroxiredoxin water-evolving arm of the redox system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MnSOD 對超氧陰離子的歧化作用產生過氧化氫作為其酶產物，隨後由過氧化氫酶和過氧化還原酶/麩胱甘肽過氧化酶加以解毒。此產物供應粒線體過氧化物傳遞鏈，將 MnSOD 與硫氧還蛋白/過氧化還原酶的水生成還原分支聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Humanin
nodes.description: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition
nodes.description: The Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype of senescent cells can induce epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in neighbouring cancer cells, coupling chronic senescence to tumor aggressiveness. SASP factors act through several channels: TGF-beta directly activates EMT transcription factors, IL-6 and IL-8 engage STAT3 and NF-kappaB, and MMPs such as MMP-2 and MMP-9 cleave junctional and basement-membrane proteins to liberate latent TGF-beta and growth factors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞的 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 可在鄰近癌細胞中誘發 epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition，將慢性衰老與腫瘤侵襲性連結起來。SASP 因子透過數個管道作用：TGF-beta 直接活化 EMT 轉錄因子，IL-6 與 IL-8 啟動 STAT3 與 NF-kappaB，而 MMP-2、MMP-9 等 MMP 則切割連接蛋白與 basement membrane 蛋白，釋出潛伏的 TGF-beta 與生長因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial ROS
nodes.description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation. A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

nodes.label: Acid ceramidase
nodes.description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile. Acid ceramidase breaks down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition. In senescent cells, progressively higher expression of this enzyme drives a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids - the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Salk Institute researchers studying human lung cells discovered that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis and that removal of the enzyme protects both young and old cells from ferroptosis-induced death. Because acid ceramidase inhibitors already exist for other therapeutic purposes, the enzyme represents a druggable target for clearing senescent cells and supporting healthy aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。 酸陶瓷酶將絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，重塑膜脂類組成。在老化的細胞中，這種酶的表達水平隨著時間推移而升高，導致富含不飽和脂肪酸的促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。沙鹿研究所研究員在研究人類肺細胞時發現，升高後的酸陶瓷酶使老化的細胞更容易受到焦蛋白死亡的影響，並且去除這種酶可以保護年輕和年老的細胞免受焦蛋白誘導的死亡。因為酸陶瓷酶抑制劑已經存在於其他治療用途中，因此這種酶是一個可藥物標靶的目標，可以用於清除老化的細胞並支持健康老齡化。

nodes.label: Senescent Cells
nodes.description: Senescent cells are the producers of the SASP, the ensemble of secreted factors that mediates most of their non-cell-autonomous effects on neighboring cells and the systemic milieu. The SASP is actively synthesized and released by the arrested cell rather than leaking passively, and its composition reflects the upstream inducing pathway and tissue context. This production enables paracrine senescence, immune recruitment, and inflammaging, converting a single arrested cell into a source of broad tissue influence. The senescent cell is thus the source and the SASP its principal effector output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞是 SASP 的產生者，SASP 是介導其對鄰近細胞與全身微環境大多數非細胞自主性效應的分泌因子集合。SASP 由停滯細胞主動合成與釋放，而非被動滲漏，其組成反映上游誘發路徑與組織脈絡。此產生促成旁分泌衰老、免疫招募與 inflammaging，將單一停滯細胞轉化為廣泛組織影響的來源。因此衰老細胞是來源，而 SASP 是其主要指效輸出。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
nodes.description: Mitohormesis is triggered by mild mitochondrial stress, which can arise from a variety of insults including genetic or pharmacological disruption of the electron transport chain, incorrect folding of mitochondrial matrix proteins, or stalling of mitochondrial ribosomes. These perturbations are relayed from the mitochondria to the cytosol and nucleus through retrograde signaling mechanisms, including mitochondrial ROS release and peptide export. Rather than being harmful, this coordinated response induces cytoprotective programs that reduce subsequent stress susceptibility.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應由輕度粒線體壓力觸發，這種壓力可能源自多種損傷，包括電子傳遞鏈的基因或藥物破壞、粒線體基質蛋白的錯誤折疊，或粒線體核糖體的停滯。這些擾動透過逆行訊號機制從粒線體傳遞到細胞質和細胞核，包括粒線體 ROS 釋放和肽段輸出。這種協調反應並非有害，而是誘導細胞保護程式，降低後續的壓力易感性。

nodes.label: Quiescence
nodes.description: Quiescence is a state of reversible proliferative arrest in which cells exit the cell cycle but retain the capacity to re-enter upon appropriate stimuli. It is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks S-phase gene expression until mitogenic signals release the block. Unlike senescence, quiescence is reversible and lacks a senescence-associated secretory phenotype, and it is a key protective state for adult stem cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Quiescence 是一種可逆的增殖停滯狀態，其中細胞退出細胞週期，但保留在適當刺激下重新進入細胞週期的能力。它在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期 gene expression，直到有絲分裂信號釋放阻斷。與老化不同，靜止是可逆的，並且缺乏與老化相關的分泌表型，它是成體幹細胞的關鍵保護狀態。

nodes.label: HLH-30
nodes.description: HLH-30 prevents aging and extends lifespan in C. elegans; hlh-30 mutants are short-lived, and loss of hlh-30 suppresses the longevity conferred by mxl-3 deletion. By driving autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity embodies the conserved mechanism by which enhanced clearance promotes longevity across species. The epistasis with mxl-3 places HLH-30 downstream as the effector of the pro-longevity program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中防止老化並延長壽命；hlh-30 突變體壽命短，且 hlh-30 的缺失抑制了 mxl-3 缺失所賦予的長壽。透過驅動自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性體現了增強清除能跨越物種促進長壽的保守機制。與 mxl-3 的遺傳上位性將 HLH-30 置於下游，作為促長壽程序的效應物。

nodes.label: Vitamin C
nodes.description: Ascorbate is the water-phase reductant that regenerates the α-tocopheroxyl radical at the membrane-water interface, which is why one tocopherol molecule can trap many peroxyl radicals before it is lost. Vitamin E is therefore catalytic rather than stoichiometric, and its functional reserve is set by the ascorbate, glutathione and NADPH pool rather than by tocopherol concentration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ascorbate 是水相還原劑，在膜－水介面上將 α-tocopheroxyl 自由基再生，因此單一 tocopherol 分子在被消耗前可捕捉許多過氧自由基。Vitamin E 因此是催化性而非化學計量性的，其功能儲備由 ascorbate、glutathione 與 NADPH 的儲備決定，而非由 tocopherol 濃度決定。

nodes.label: Methemoglobinemia
nodes.description: Methylene blue is an established treatment for methemoglobinemia, a condition in which red blood cells cannot carry oxygen properly. It has been a first-line treatment for this indication since the early 20th century and remains on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines. The clinical treatment dose for methemoglobinemia is 0.5-4 mg/kg (roughly 35-280 mg for a 70 kg adult), which is well above the micro-doses used in longevity and cognitive protocols. This medical use is distinct from wellness applications; at the very high doses used in medical settings methylene blue can paradoxically induce methemoglobin formation in some contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍是治療高鐵血紅蛋白血症的 established 方法，這是一種紅血球無法正常攜帶氧氣的疾病。自 20 世紀初以來，它一直是此適應症的一線治療，並仍在世界衛生組織基本藥物清單上。高鐵血紅蛋白血症的臨床治療劑量為 0.5-4 mg/kg（約 35-280 mg，適用於 70 kg 成人），遠高於 longevity 和認知方案中使用的 micro-doses。這種醫療用途與 wellness 應用不同；在醫療環境中使用的非常高劑量下，亞甲基藍在某些情況下可能 paradoxically 誘導高鐵血紅蛋白形成。

nodes.label: Bcl-2
nodes.description: ABT-263 inhibits Bcl-2. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABT-263 抑制 Bcl-2。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

nodes.label: Glycolysis
nodes.description: 2-deoxy-D-glucose is phosphorylated by hexokinase to 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, which accumulates and competitively inhibits hexokinase and phosphoglucose isomerase, blocking the glycolytic flux. Its blockade of glycolysis produces a transient ATP drop that mimics caloric restriction and shifts cells toward mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 2-deoxy-D-glucose 經 hexokinase 磷酸化為 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate 後累積，並競爭性抑制 hexokinase 與 phosphoglucose isomerase，因而阻斷 glycolysis。其對 glycolysis 的阻斷造成暫時性 ATP 下降，模擬 Caloric Restriction，並使細胞轉向粒線體的 Oxidative Phosphorylation。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Melanoma
nodes.description: Individuals with Oculocutaneous Albinism are exquisitely sensitive to UV radiation and have a substantially elevated lifetime risk of Melanoma and non-melanoma skin cancer. Chronic sun damage leads to solar elastosis, lentigines, and actinic keratoses. Lifelong dermatologic surveillance is required.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 患有 Oculocutaneous Albinism 的人對 UV 輻射極為敏感，一生中發生 Melanoma 和非黑色素瘤皮膚癌的風險大幅升高。慢性日曬損傷會導致日光性彈性變性、雀斑樣痣和光化性角化病。需要終生的皮膚科監測。

nodes.label: Akt
nodes.description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

nodes.label: Quercetin
nodes.description: Quercetin is a catechol flavonoid, a flavonol whose B-ring bears two adjacent hydroxyl groups, classifying it as a dietary catechol and a COMT substrate. Its catechol structure also enables competitive COMT inhibition at higher doses, influencing both its own pharmacokinetics and those of co-ingested catechols like EGCG. It is among the most abundant flavonoids in the human diet, found in onions, apples, and tea, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Its metabolism by COMT links dietary intake to genotype-dependent disposition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Quercetin 是 catechol flavonoid 的黃酮醇，其 B 環帶有兩個相鄰的羥基，將其歸類為膳食兒茶酚和 COMT 底物。其兒茶酚結構也能夠在較高劑量下實現競爭性 COMT 抑制，從而影響其自身的藥物動力學以及共同攝入的兒茶酚（如 EGCG）的藥物動力學。它是人類飲食中最豐富的類黃酮之一，存在於洋蔥、蘋果和茶中，有助於抗氧化和 anti-inflammatory effects。 COMT 的代謝將飲食攝取與基因型依賴性處置聯繫起來。

nodes.label: MicroRNA
nodes.description: MicroRNAs bind Messenger RNA to control its stability, localization, and translation, together with other RNA-binding proteins and non-coding RNAs. Locked Nucleic Acid–based inhibitors exploit the same axis to repress mRNA translation or promote its degradation, which is why nucleic-acid senolytic and antisense strategies treat mRNA as their substrate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MicroRNA 會與 Messenger RNA 結合，控制其穩定性、定位與轉譯，並與其他 RNA 結合蛋白及非編碼 RNA 協同作用。以 Locked Nucleic Acid 為基礎的抑制劑利用同一條軸線來抑制 mRNA 轉譯或促進其降解，因此核酸類 senolytic 與反義策略都把 mRNA 當作作用受質。

nodes.label: Catalase
nodes.description: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

nodes.label: Oxidative Phosphorylation
nodes.description: Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP) is the universal energy currency of the cell, coupling exergonic and endergonic reactions through phosphate-bond hydrolysis. It is produced mainly by Oxidative Phosphorylation at the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane, with glycolysis contributing under anaerobic conditions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adenosine Triphosphate（ATP）是細胞的通用能量貨幣，透過磷酸鍵水解連結放能與吸能反應。它主要由 Inner Mitochondrial Membrane 上的 Oxidative Phosphorylation 產生，無氧條件下則有糖解作用參與貢獻。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

nodes.label: Lipid Peroxidation
nodes.description: Acrolein (CH2=CH-CHO, 2-propenal) is the simplest alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde and one of the most electrophilic products of Lipid Peroxidation. It arises from beta-scission of PUFA hydroperoxides, notably omega-3 species such as Docosahexaenoic acid, whose chain length and double-bond placement favor release of a three-carbon fragment. Because its vinyl group flanks a carbonyl, it is a potent Michael acceptor that modifies protein cysteine, histidine and lysine residues and forms DNA adducts at concentrations well below those required for Malondialdehyde or 4-Hydroxynonenal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acrolein（CH2=CH-CHO，2-propenal）是最簡單的 α,β-不飽和醛，也是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具親電性的產物之一。它來自 PUFA 過氧化物的 β-scission，尤其是 Docosahexaenoic acid 等 omega-3 脂肪酸，其鏈長與雙鍵位置有利於釋出三碳片段。由於其乙烯基緊鄰羰基，它是強效的 Michael 受體，可在遠低於 Malondialdehyde 或 4-Hydroxynonenal 所需的濃度下修飾蛋白質的 cysteine、histidine 與 lysine 殘基並形成 DNA 加合物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
nodes.description: Disease modeling uses induced pluripotent stem cells to recreate genetic diseases in vitro by reprogramming patient somatic cells and differentiating them into the affected cell types. iPSC-derived models recapitulate disease phenotypes, such as TDP-43 mislocalization in frontotemporal dementia neurons, enabling mechanistic dissection of pathology and identification of therapeutic targets. Because the cells carry the patient's actual genome, they also support drug screening and personalized medicine approaches.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 疾病建模使用誘導多能幹細胞，透過對患者體細胞進行重新編程並將其分化為受影響的細胞類型，在體外重現遺傳疾病。 iPSC 衍生模型概括了疾病表型，例如額顳葉失智症神經元中的 TDP-43 錯誤定位，從而能夠對病理進行機械剖析並識別治療標靶。由於細胞攜帶患者的實際基因組，因此它們也支持藥物篩選和個人化醫療方法。

nodes.label: Honokiol
nodes.description: Honokiol, a lipid-soluble lignan extracted from Magnolia species, readily crosses the blood-brain barrier to exert its effects in the central nervous system, including anti-tumorigenic and neuroprotective actions. Its lipid solubility allows it to pass lipid bilayers and act at multiple intracellular and membrane sites, a property shared with the structurally related anesthetic propofol and the analog magnolol. BBB penetration is a prerequisite for honokiol's anxiolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-seizure activities in the brain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是從木蘭屬（Magnolia）植物中提取的脂溶性木脂素，能輕易穿越血腦屏障，在中樞神經系統中發揮作用，包括抗腫瘤生成與神經保護作用。其脂溶性使其能穿過脂質雙層，作用於多個細胞內與膜上的位點，此特性與結構相關的麻醉劑丙泊酚及類似物和厚朴酚共通。穿透血腦屏障是厚朴酚在大腦中發揮抗焦慮、鎮痛、抗發炎與抗癲癇活性的先決條件。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: DNA Damage
nodes.description: DNA damage, particularly persistent double-strand breaks, is a potent inducer of senescence through activation of the DNA damage response (DDR). The ATM/ATR kinases phosphorylate and stabilize the transcription factor p53, which transcribes p21CIP1 to inhibit cyclin-CDK complexes and enforce arrest. Damage-induced senescence acts as a barrier to malignant transformation by halting proliferation of genomically unstable cells. A caveat is that the same DDR can also drive a pro-inflammatory SASP, so DNA damage both suppresses and, chronically, may promote pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷，特別是持續性的雙股斷裂，透過活化 DNA 損傷反應（DDR）而成為強效的衰老誘發因子。ATM/ATR 激酶磷酸化並穩定轉錄因子 p53，後者轉錄 p21CIP1 以抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體並強制停滯。損傷誘發的衰老透過阻斷基因組不穩定細胞的增殖，作為惡性轉化的屏障。但需注意，同一 DDR 也能驅動促發炎的 SASP，因此 DNA 損傷一方面抑制、在慢性情況下卻也可能促進病理。

nodes.label: Aminoguanidine
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine, also developed as pimagedine by Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics, is the first identified inhibitor of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). By trapping reactive carbonyl species, it prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins that is proposed to drive many features of aging. Most anti-aging research has been carried out using a hydrochloride (HCL) derivative, which is more soluble and less irritating than the bicarbonate form, and aminoguanidine has a half-life of only 4 hours, so dosages of 150-300 mg per day are best administered in split doses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Aminoguanidine)，也由 Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics 开发为皮马地宁 (pimagadidine)，是先进糖基化终产物 (AGEs) 的首个抑制剂。通过捕获反应性羰基物种，它能阻止组织蛋白的交联，这被认为是导致衰老许多特征的原因。大部分抗衰老研究都使用盐酸盐 (HCL) 衍生物进行，该衍生物比碳酸氢盐形式更可溶且刺激性更小，而氨基胍丁的半衰期仅为 4 小时，因此，每日 150-300 毫克分剂量给药效果最佳。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Apigenin
nodes.description: Apigenin halts cell cycle progression in cancer cells at either the G1 or G2/M phase depending on the cell type.
