nodes.description: Centromeres are epigenetically specified by CENP-A chromatin rather than by DNA sequence in most eukaryotes. The centromere is the specialized chromosome region where the kinetochore assembles and spindle microtubules attach during mitosis and meiosis, flanked by pericentric heterochromatin enriched in H3K9me3; its dysfunction causes aneuploidy and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在多數真核生物中，centromere 是由 CENP-A 染色質而非 DNA 序列表觀指定的。它是染色體上 kinetochore 組裝且紡錘絲微管在有絲分裂與減數分裂時附著的特化區域，兩側為富含 H3K9me3 的著絲粒周邊異染色質；其功能障礙會導致 aneuploidy 與 cancer。

nodes.label: Amifostine
nodes.description: Amifostine (WR-2721) is a phosphorothioate prodrug dephosphorylated at the cell membrane by alkaline phosphatase to the free-thiol metabolite WR-1065, which accumulates selectively in normal tissues. WR-1065 donates hydrogen atoms to neutralize hydroxyl radicals (HO•) generated by ionizing radiation, protecting DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amifostine（WR-2721）是磷硫代前藥，在細胞膜上被鹼性磷酸酶去磷酸化為游離硫醇代謝物 WR-1065，並選擇性地累積於正常組織。WR-1065 提供氫原子以中和電離輻射產生的氫自由基（HO•），保護 DNA 與蛋白質免受輻射誘發的損傷。

nodes.label: Thermic Effect of Food
nodes.description: The Thermic Effect of Food (TEF, diet-induced thermogenesis) is the post-ingestive rise in energy expenditure above Resting Metabolic Rate that reflects the energetic cost of digesting, absorbing, transporting and storing nutrients. Together with resting metabolism and physical activity, TEF is one of the three canonical components of the daily energy budget, and its magnitude is proportional to the size and protein content of the meal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 食物熱效應（TEF，飲食誘導產熱）是進食後能量消耗高於 Resting Metabolic Rate 的增幅，反映消化、吸收、運輸與儲存營養素所需的能量代價。TEF 與休息代謝及身體活動並列為每日能量預算的三大組成部分，其大小與餐食份量及蛋白質含量成正比。

nodes.label: MMP
nodes.description: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: CMS121
nodes.description: CMS121 is a fatty-acid-synthase (FASN) inhibitor developed by Pamela Maher's lab, discovered through the same phenotypic ferroptosis-based screening platform that yielded its sister compound J147. By inhibiting FASN it reduces pathological lipid accumulation and oxidative stress in neurons, and both compounds completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CMS121 是 Pamela Maher 實驗室開發的脂肪酸合成酶（FASN）抑制劑，與其姊妹化合物 J147 同樣來自以鐵死亡為基礎的表型篩選平台。藉由抑制 FASN，它減少神經元中病理性脂質堆積與氧化壓力，兩者皆已完成阿茲海默病的第一期臨床試驗。

nodes.label: Citrulline
nodes.description: Nitric oxide radical is synthesised by nitric oxide synthase through the oxidation of arginine to citrulline, making citrulline the obligatory by-product of NO generation. This places citrulline at two distinct fates: an enzymatic by-product of NO signalling and a chemical by-product of glucosepane breakdown.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一氧化氮自由基由 Nitric Oxide Synthase 經由 Arginine 氧化為 Citrulline 而合成，使 Citrulline 成為 NO 生成不可避免的副產物。這使 Citrulline 具有兩種不同的命運：作為 NO 訊號的酵素副產物，以及作為 Glucosepane 降解的化學副產物。

nodes.label: CD4
nodes.description: HIV-1 enters cells when the envelope glycoprotein gp120 binds the CD4 receptor together with a CCR5 or CXCR4 coreceptor, with gp41 then mediating membrane fusion. CD4+ T cell depletion driven by this entry step is the immunological basis of HIV-1 immunodeficiency, and it is also exploited therapeutically by post-attachment CD4-directed antibodies such as ibalizumab.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 入侵細胞時，envelope 醣蛋白 gp120 會與 CD4 受體及 CCR5 或 CXCR4 共同受體結合，接著由 gp41 介導膜融合。由這個入侵步驟造成的 CD4+ T 細胞耗竭，是 HIV-1 免疫缺陷的免疫學基礎；治療上也被 ibalizumab 等 post-attachment CD4 導向抗體所利用。

nodes.label: DAF-7
nodes.description: DAF-7 is the C. elegans TGFβ ortholog, expressed mainly in sensory neurons. Unlike the insulin/insulin-receptor pathway, DAF-7 responds to environmental cues such as food availability and pheromones and acts on a different transcriptional output, notably not through the metabolic repressor MXL-3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DAF-7 是 C. elegans 的 TGFβ 直系同源物，主要在感覺神經元表現。與 insulin/insulin receptor 路徑不同，DAF-7 會對食物可得性與費洛蒙等環境線索作出反應，且作用於不同的轉錄輸出，尤其並非透過代謝抑制因子 MXL-3。

nodes.label: Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate
nodes.description: Guanylate cyclase enzymes convert GTP to the second messenger cGMP, which activates protein kinase G and regulates smooth-muscle tone, platelet aggregation, and neuronal signaling. The soluble isoform is the principal receptor for nitric oxide, while particulate isoforms respond to natriuretic peptides.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Guanylate cyclase 將 GTP 轉換為第二信使 cGMP，後者活化 protein kinase G 並調節平滑肌張力、血小板聚集與神經訊號。可溶性型是 nitric oxide 的主要受體，顆粒型則對 natriuretic peptide 反應。

nodes.label: Pan-sirtuin Activator
nodes.description: Caloric restriction is the canonical endogenous pan-sirtuin activator: it raises the NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, relieving nicotinamide feedback inhibition and boosting sirtuin activity across the family. In yeast the CR lifespan benefit requires SIR2, the genetic template later extrapolated to mammalian SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熱量限制是典型的內源性廣泛 sirtuin 活化劑：它提高 NAD+/菸醯胺比值，解除菸醯胺的負回饋抑制，整體提升 sirtuin 活性。在酵母中，熱量限制的壽命效益需要 SIR2，這是後來外推至哺乳類 SIRT1 的遺傳範本。

nodes.label: Myricetin
nodes.description: Myricetin is a Flavonol within the wider Flavonoids class, a polyphenol found across many fruits, vegetables and medicinal herbs. Its reported antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity follows the general structure-activity pattern of flavonols, and it was screened alongside Fisetin, Quercetin and Luteolin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myricetin 是更廣泛 Flavonoids 類別中的 Flavonol，為存在於多種水果、蔬菜與藥草的多酚。其已知的抗氧化與抗發炎活性符合 flavonol 一般的結構—活性型態，並與 Fisetin、Quercetin、Luteolin 一同接受篩選。

nodes.label: IGFBP5
nodes.description: IGFBP5 binds circulating and tissue IGF1 with high affinity through conserved cysteine-rich N- and C-terminal domains, regulating IGF access to IGF1R. By sequestering IGFs it can dampen pro-survival PI3K/Akt signaling, reinforcing senescence-associated growth arrest, and it also acts in autocrine/paracrine fashion to promote and propagate the senescent state during development and in adult tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IGFBP5 透過保守的富含半胱胺酸 N 端與 C 端結構域，以高親和力結合循環與組織中的 IGF1，調控 IGF 與 IGF1R 接觸的機會。藉由封存 IGF，它可減弱促存活的 PI3K/Akt 訊號，強化與衰老相關的生長停滯；並以自分泌／旁分泌方式在胚胎發育與成人組織中促進並傳播衰老狀態。

nodes.label: Senescence-Messaging Secretome
nodes.description: The Senescence-Messaging Secretome is an alternative name for the SASP that frames it as a sophisticated intercellular communication network rather than a mere collection of secreted factors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senescence-Messaging Secretome 是 SASP 的另一種名稱，強調它並非只是一群分泌因子，而是一套精密的細胞間通訊網路。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: SNEDDS
nodes.description: Self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery systems are anhydrous preconcentrates of drug, oil, surfactant and co-surfactant that spontaneously form an oil-in-water nanoemulsion upon aqueous dilution, as occurs in the stomach. The nanometer droplets drastically increase surface area for absorption; the fisetin-SNEDDS formulation reported 154 nm droplets with 100% drug loading.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自奈米乳化藥物傳遞系統（SNEDDS）是由藥物、油、界面活性劑與助表面活性劑組成的無水預濃縮物，遇水稀釋（如在胃中）時會自發形成水包油型奈米乳液。奈米尺度的液滴可大幅增加吸收表面積；文獻報導的 fisetin-SNEDDS 配方液滴大小為 154 nm，藥物負載率達 100%。

nodes.label: ATAC-seq
nodes.description: ATAC-seq (Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing) maps Chromatin Accessibility genome-wide by using hyperactive Tn5 Transposase to fragment and tag open chromatin with sequencing adapters, followed by high-throughput sequencing on DNA Sequencing platforms. Tn5 preferentially integrates into nucleosome-depleted regions such as Enhancers and Transcription Factor Binding Sites, so aligned tag fragments identify accessible loci. It also reports Nucleosome Positioning from fragment length distribution and Transcription Factor footprinting from insertion patterns.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATAC-seq（Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing）以超活性 Tn5 Transposase 對開放染色質進行片段化並加上加上定序接子，再以 DNA Sequencing 平台進行高通量定序，藉此在全基因體尺度測量 Chromatin Accessibility。Tn5 偏好整合進 Promoter、Enhancer 與 Transcription Factor Binding Sites 等核小體缺失區域，因此比對上的 tag 片段即可界定可及位點。ATAC-seq 亦可由片段長度分布判讀 Nucleosome Positioning，並由插入模式推斷 Transcription Factor 的 footprint。

nodes.label: Addiction
nodes.description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase
nodes.description: Cytochrome b5 reductase and NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase are two names for the same NADH- cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase. Mutations in the CYB5R gene therefore reduce the activity of this same enzyme and cause congenital methemoglobinemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase 與 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 是同一個 NADH-cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase 的兩種名稱。因此 CYB5R 基因突變會降低此同一酵素的活性，並造成先天性 methemoglobinemia。

nodes.label: DYRK1A
nodes.description: DYRK1A phosphorylates caspase-9 at Thr125, inhibiting the initiator.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DYRK1A 在 Thr125 磷酸化 caspase-9，抑制起始者。

nodes.label: LGG-1
nodes.description: LGG-1, one of the LC3 homologues, is required for Lipophagy: post-developmental dual inactivation of lgg-1 and lgg-2 leads to increased fat accumulation. That lipophagy depends on core autophagy genes indicates it is a conserved mechanism across metazoans rather than a lysosome-specific process, and that the lysosomal lipases act within the same pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LGG-1（LC3 同源基因之一）對 Lipophagy 而言是必需的：發育後同時使 lgg-1 與 lgg-2 失活會導致脂肪累積增加。lipophagy 依賴核心自噬基因，顯示它是跨後生動物保守的機制而非溶酶體專有過程，也表示溶酶體脂肪酶是在同一路徑內作用。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

nodes.label: c-CBL
nodes.description: c-CBL is a RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligase and negative regulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling. Its TKB domain recognizes doubly phosphorylated tyrosines on activated receptors such as EGFR, c-KIT and the PDGF receptor, and it attaches ubiquitin chains that sort the receptor into multivesicular bodies for lysosomal or proteasomal degradation, terminating proliferative and survival signals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: c-CBL 是 RING 型 E3 泛素連接酶，也是受體酪胺酸激酶訊號的負向調控者。其 TKB 結構域辨識 EGFR、c-KIT 與 PDGF 受體等已活化受體上雙重磷酸化的酪胺酸，並接上泛素鏈使受體被分選進入多囊泡體，進行溶酶體或蛋白酶體降解，終止增殖與存活訊號。

nodes.label: miRNA
nodes.description: Paracrine miRNA traffic instigates paracrine senescence and shapes the tissue microenvironment: senescent cells export miRNAs in extracellular vesicles that reprogramme neighbours. This is why circulating senescence-associated miRNAs serve as non-invasive biomarkers of biological age and inflammaging, and why exosomal miRNAs are explored as engineered senomorphic delivery vehicles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 旁分泌的 miRNA 運輸會啟動 paracrine senescence 並塑造組織微環境：senescent cells 將 miRNA 以細胞外囊泡形式輸出，重新設定鄰近細胞。這也是為何循環中的 senescence 相關 miRNA 可作為生物年齡與 inflammaging 的非侵入性生物標記，以及為何 exosomal miRNA 被探索作為工程化的 senomorphic 遞送載體。

nodes.label: Albuminuria
nodes.description: Albuminuria is the abnormal excretion of plasma albumin into the urine, marking increased glomerular permeability. It is among the earliest detectable manifestations of Diabetic nephropathy, tracks with worsening glomerular injury, and predicts progression to end-stage renal disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Albuminuria 是血漿白蛋白異常排入尿液的情形，標記腎小球通透性增加。它是 Diabetic nephropathy 最早可偵測的表現之一，與腎小球損傷惡化相關，並可預測疾病進展至末期腎病。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: LYN
nodes.description: LYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LYN 是 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

nodes.label: Autonomic Nervous System
nodes.description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

nodes.label: SepSecS
nodes.description: SepSecS is the final selenium-incorporating step of selenocysteine biosynthesis; its loss abolishes Selenoprotein synthesis and is lethal in mice.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SepSecS 是 selenocysteine 生物合成中最後一個納入硒的步驟；其缺失會完全中止 Selenoprotein 的合成，並在老鼠中造成致命。

nodes.label: HIV
nodes.description: HIV-1 is the pandemic form of HIV: it is a lentivirus of the Retroviridae family and, with Group M subtypes A–K and circulating recombinant forms, accounts for more than 95% of infections worldwide. HIV-2, in contrast, is largely confined to West Africa, is less transmissible and progresses to AIDS more slowly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HIV-1 是 HIV 的 pandemic 型態：屬 Retroviridae 科的 lentivirus，以 Group M 的 A–K 亞型與循環重組型（CRF）佔全球感染逾 95%。相對地，HIV-2 主要侷限於西非，傳播力較低且進展為 AIDS 的速度較慢。

nodes.label: IP3R2
nodes.description: ITPR2 is the gene encoding inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 2 (IP3R2), an isoform of the IP3 receptor family that mediates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytosol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ITPR2 是編碼肌醇 1,4,5-三磷酸受體第 2 型（IP3R2）的基因，屬於 IP3 受體家族的異構型，負責將鈣離子由內質網釋放至細胞質。

nodes.label: Redox Potential
nodes.description: Toluidine Blue O has the most negative redox potential (E1/2 = −0.012 V vs NHE) of the methylene blue derivatives studied, and this negative Redox Potential enables electron shuttling that enhances cellular oxygen consumption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Toluidine Blue O 在受測的 Methylene blue 衍生物中具有最負的還原電位（E1/2 = −0.012 V vs NHE），這種負的 Redox Potential 使其能作為電子載體穿梭，進而提升細胞的耗氧量。

nodes.label: Oligomycin
nodes.description: Oligomycin is a macrolide antibiotic that inhibits the F_O subunit of mitochondrial ATP synthase (Complex V), blocking Oxidative Phosphorylation and causing a characteristic drop in oxygen consumption with a compensatory rise in glycolysis. It is injected before FCCP in Seahorse assays to isolate ATP-synthase-linked respiration from maximal electron-transport capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oligomycin 是一種巨環抗生素，抑制粒線體 ATP 合成酶（Complex V）的 F_O 次單元，使氧化磷酸化（Oxidative Phosphorylation）受阻，造成耗氧量典型性下降與糖解代償性上升。在 Seahorse 試驗中，它會在 FCCP 之前注入，以將 ATP 合成酶連結的呼吸與最大電子傳遞容量區分開來。

nodes.label: Silver salts
nodes.description: Insoluble silver salts transform into soluble protein-bound transport species, the gateway step of systemic handling. Transformation enables circulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 不溶性銀鹽轉化為可溶性蛋白結合運輸物種，是全身處理的門戶步驟。轉化促成循環。

nodes.label: Saturated Enzymatic Regime
nodes.description: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

nodes.label: Guanidinoacetate (GAA)
nodes.description: Guanidinoacetate (glycocyamine) is the direct precursor of creatine, formed in the kidney from arginine and glycine by AGAT and then methylated by GAMT using S-adenosylmethionine to yield creatine in the liver. In GAMT deficiency GAA accumulates to toxic levels and causes neurological damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Guanidinoacetate（glycocyamine）是 creatine 的直接前驅物，在腎臟由 arginine 與 glycine 經 AGAT 形成，再由 GAMT 以 S-adenosylmethionine 為甲基供體在肝臟甲基化為 creatine。GAMT 缺乏時 GAA 累積至毒性濃度並造成神經損傷。

nodes.label: Thioredoxin
nodes.description: Thioredoxin proteins are recycled to their active reduced state by thioredoxin reductase in an NADPH-consuming cycle. Together with the glutathione system, thioredoxin and thioredoxin reductase constitute the bulk of cellular antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白透過硫氧還蛋白還原酶在耗用 NADPH 的循環中被回收至活化的還原態。與麩胱甘肽系統一起，硫氧還蛋白與硫氧還蛋白還原酶構成了細胞抗氧化能力的主要部分。

nodes.label: Kynurenic Acid
nodes.description: Kynurenic acid (KynA) is a neuroactive metabolite of the kynurenine pathway produced from kynurenine by kynurenine aminotransferases. It is an endogenous broad-spectrum antagonist acting at the glycine co-agonist site of the NMDA receptor, which makes it neuroprotective against glutamate-mediated excitotoxicity. It also antagonizes alpha-7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, modulating cognition and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Kynurenic acid（KynA）是犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）路徑的神經活性代謝物，由 kynurenine aminotransferase 自 kynurenine 產生。它是作用於 NMDA 受體甘胺酸共同作用位點的內生性廣效拮抗劑，因此能對抗麩胺酸介導的興奮毒性而具神經保護作用。它亦拮抗 α7 尼古丁型乙醯膽鹼受體，調節認知與發炎。

nodes.label: 2-Chlorophenothiazine
nodes.description: 2-Chlorophenothiazine is a chlorinated phenothiazine nucleus: it keeps the free 10-nitrogen and position-5 sulfur of the Phenothiazine scaffold but has no amine side chains at positions 3 and 7, which is why it lacks the electron-carrier activity of Methylene blue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 2-Chlorophenothiazine 是氯化的 phenothiazine 核：保留 Phenothiazine 骨架的自由 10-氮與第 5 號硫，但在 3 與 7 位置沒有胺基側鏈，因此缺乏 Methylene blue 的電子載體活性。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Branched-Chain Amino Acids
nodes.description: Isoleucine is one of the three branched-chain amino acids and an essential amino acid that must be obtained from the diet; its catabolism yields acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA, which enter the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Isoleucine 是三種支鏈胺基酸之一，也是必須由飲食取得的必需胺基酸；其分解代謝產生 acetyl-CoA 與 succinyl-CoA，進入 TCA cycle。

nodes.label: PDE
nodes.description: Phosphodiesterases (PDE1-PDE11) are metallophosphohydrolases that degrade the second messengers cAMP and cGMP to inactive 5′-nucleoside monophosphates. By terminating cyclic-nucleotide signals they set the amplitude, duration and localization of PKA/PKG activation, thereby influencing metabolism, cardiovascular tone and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸二酯酶（PDE1–PDE11）是一類金屬磷酸酶，將第二訊使 cAMP 與 cGMP 水解為不具活性的 5′-核苷單磷酸。藉由終止環核苷酸訊號，它們決定 PKA/PKG 活化的幅度、持續時間與定位，進而影響代謝、血管張力與發炎。

nodes.label: Cyclooxygenase
nodes.description: Prostaglandin G₂ (PGG₂) is the 15-hydroperoxy endoperoxide produced by the bis-dioxygenation of arachidonic acid at the cyclooxygenase site of COX-1/COX-2 — two O₂ additions forming the bicyclic endoperoxide — making it the first committed intermediate of the prostanoid pathway and the site of aspirin's irreversible Ser530 acetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prostaglandin G₂（PGG₂）是在 COX-1/COX-2 的環氧化酶位點由花生四烯酸雙加氧而產生的 15-過氧基內過氧化物——兩次 O₂ 加成形成雙環內過氧化物——使其成為前列腺素路徑的第一個承諾中間產物，也是 aspirin 不可逆乙醯化 Ser530 的作用位點。

nodes.label: Phosphocreatine (PCr)
nodes.description: Creatine kinase reversibly phosphorylates creatine with ATP to produce phosphocreatine, the muscle phosphagen store. This reaction is the mechanistic hub of the creatine-PCr energy buffer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Creatine kinase 以 ATP 可逆磷酸化肌酸以產生磷酸肌酸，即肌肉磷酸原儲庫。此反應是肌酸-PCr 能量緩衝的機制樞紐。

nodes.label: Vagus Nerve
nodes.description: Vagus Nerve and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Vagus Nerve and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vagus Nerve 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Vagus Nerve 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: DNA-PK
nodes.description: DNA-PK, together with ATM and ATR, phosphorylates histone H2AX to form gamma-H2AX foci at DNA double-strand breaks. Gamma-H2AX is therefore the experimental readout of DNA-PK kinase activity and of double-strand break damage, which is why gamma-H2AX elevation after fenbendazole treatment in A375 cells is interpreted as evidence of induced DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DNA-PK 與 ATM、ATR 一起磷酸化 histone H2AX，在 DNA 雙股斷裂處形成 gamma-H2AX 焦點。因此 gamma-H2AX 是 DNA-PK kinase 活性與雙股斷裂損傷的實驗判讀指標；這也是 A375 細胞在 fenbendazole 處理後 gamma-H2AX 升高會被解讀為 DNA 損傷被誘發的證據的原因。

nodes.label: ABT-737
nodes.description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

nodes.label: FKBP12
nodes.description: Rapalogs inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. FKBP12 is therefore the essential cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage and suppress mTORC1 signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rapalog 透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面來抑制 mTORC1。因此 FKBP12 是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與並抑制 mTORC1 訊號所需的必需輔因子。

nodes.label: NMRK1
nodes.description: NMRK1 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 1), together with its isoform NMRK2, directly phosphorylates nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), bypassing the rate-limiting enzyme NAMPT. This route also circumvents the requirement for energetically costly PRPP (phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate) and the feedback inhibition by NAD+. NMRK1 is expressed ubiquitously across tissues, whereas NMRK2 expression is concentrated in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which helps explain why these tissues respond well to NR supplementation. NR is an orally available NAD+ precursor that increases NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity in multiple tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NMRK1（nicotinamide ribose kinase 1）與其同工型 NMRK2 直接將 nicotinamide riboside（NR）磷酸化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN），繞過限速酶 NAMPT。此途徑亦規避了對耗能的 PRPP（phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate）之需求，以及 NAD+ 的回饋抑制。NMRK1 於各組織中廣泛表現，而 NMRK2 的表現則集中於心臟與骨骼肌，這有助於解釋這些組織為何對 NR 補充反應良好。NR 是一種口服可用的 NAD+ 前驅物，可提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 濃度與 sirtuin 活性。

nodes.label: PIDDosome
nodes.description: PIDDosome activates Caspase-2. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDDosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PIDDosome 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDDosome 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: TSC
nodes.description: Tuberous sclerosis complex is the prototypical mTORopathy, caused by loss of TSC1/TSC2, and it is defined by hamartomas such as cortical tubers, angiomyolipoma and SEGA. Phospho-ribosomal protein S6 serves as a pharmacodynamic biomarker of pathway activation in these patients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 結節性硬化症（TSC）是最典型的 mTORopathy，由 TSC1/TSC2 缺失造成，並以 hamartoma（如皮質結節、血管平滑肌脂肪瘤與 SEGA）為其定義特徵。磷酸化 ribosomal protein S6 在這些病人中可作為路徑活化的藥效學生物標記。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

nodes.label: ETS transcription factor
nodes.description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat
nodes.description: TNFR1 complex II is governed by the Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat. Because complex I upregulates FLIP_L transcriptionally, the strength and duration of the initial survival signal set the apoptotic threshold of the complex that follows — the rheostat's transcriptional arm. FLIP_L heterodimers cleave RIPK1 locally and disarm the complex (survival), procaspase-8 homodimers execute apoptosis, and FLIP_S heterodimers leave RIPK1 intact for necroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNFR1 complex II 受 Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat 調控。由於 complex I 會在轉錄層面上調 FLIP_L，初始存活訊號的強度與持續時間便設定了後續複合體的凋亡門檻——這就是 rheostat 的轉錄臂。FLIP_L 異二聚體在局部切割 RIPK1 並解除複合體武裝（存活），procaspase-8 同二聚體執行凋亡，而 FLIP_S 異二聚體則讓 RIPK1 保持完整以供壞死性凋亡使用。

nodes.label: Amiodarone
nodes.description: Amiodarone is a class III antiarrhythmic (with additional class I, II and IV activity) that blocks potassium, sodium and calcium channels as well as beta-adrenergic receptors. It is used for refractory ventricular arrhythmias and is positioned in advanced life-support resuscitation protocols for cardiac arrest. Its large iodine load and lipophilicity produce chronic thyroid dysfunction, pulmonary fibrosis, corneal deposits and hepatotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amiodarone 是第三類抗心律不整藥（兼具第一、二、四類活性），可阻斷鉀離子、鈉離子與鈣離子通道以及 β-腎上腺素受體。它用於難治性心室心律不整，並被納入心臟驟停進階生命支持急救方案。其高碘負荷與脂溶性導致慢性甲狀腺功能異常、肺纖維化、角膜沉積與肝毒性。

nodes.label: HIIT
nodes.description: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is a cornerstone mitohormetic stimulus: brief maximal efforts generate an acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation that trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）刺激：短暫的最大努力產生急性 ROS 峰值與乳酸累積，觸發粒線體生合成的總管 PGC-1α。

nodes.label: CTLA-4
nodes.description: CTLA-4 is one of the two checkpoint targets used by Immunotherapy. Antibody blockade of CTLA-4 removes inhibitory signaling from activated T cells at priming, and alongside PD-1/PD-L1 blockade it defines current checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）所使用的兩個檢查點標的之一。以抗體阻斷 CTLA-4 可移除活化的 T 細胞在活化階段的抑制訊號，並與 PD-1/PD-L1 阻斷共同構成現行檢查點抑制劑療法的基礎。

nodes.label: Zellweger syndrome
nodes.description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

nodes.label: Pheochromocytoma
nodes.description: Pheochromocytoma is a Catecholamines-secreting tumor arising from Chromaffin cells of the Adrenal medulla, producing paroxysmal hypertension, palpitations, headache, and diaphoresis. About 10% are extra-adrenal paragangliomas, 10% bilateral, 10% malignant, and 10% hereditary (MEN2, VHL disease, NF1).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pheochromocytoma 是源自 Adrenal medulla 之 Chromaffin cells 的 Catecholamines 分泌腫瘤，會造成陣發性高血壓、心悸、頭痛與大量出汗。約 10% 為腎上腺外 paraganglioma、10% 為雙側、10% 為惡性、10% 為遺傳性（與 MEN2、VHL disease、NF1 相關）。

nodes.label: Notch
nodes.description: Notch is essential for establishing Paracrine Senescence: senescent cells stimulate Notch signaling in neighboring cells, propagating the arrested, SASP-producing state, though the SASP of these secondary senescent cells is weaker and may limit runaway spread.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Notch 對建立 Paracrine Senescence 至關重要：衰老細胞會刺激鄰近細胞的 Notch 訊號，傳播停滯且產生 SASP 的狀態；不過次級衰老細胞的 SASP 較弱，可限制失控擴散。

nodes.label: Single-cell Omics
nodes.description: Single-cell omics comprises technologies such as scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, single-cell proteomics and spatial transcriptomics that profile individual cells, circumventing the averaging inherent in bulk measurements. In Autophagy research these methods reveal pronounced cell-to-cell heterogeneity in autophagic flux, lysosomal capacity and nutrient sensing, showing how mTORC1 and TFEB programs differ between cells within the same tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Single-cell omics 包含 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、單細胞蛋白組學與空間轉錄組等技術，可分析個別細胞，避開大量測量的平均化缺陷。在自噬研究中，這些方法揭示了自噬流、溶酶體容量與營養感測的顯著細胞間異質性，顯示同一組織內不同細胞的 mTORC1 與 TFEB 程序如何有所差異。

nodes.label: Dyspnea
nodes.description: In symptomatic methemoglobinemia, Methylene blue reduces methemoglobin back to functional Hemoglobin, relieving Dyspnea and Cyanosis; management otherwise targets the underlying cause. Dyspnea can also be acute (pulmonary embolism, asthma, pneumonia, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome) or chronic (COPD, heart failure).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在有症狀的 methemoglobinemia 中，Methylene blue 將 methemoglobin 還原為具功能的 Hemoglobin，緩解 Dyspnea 與 Cyanosis；其他處置則針對潛在病因。Dyspnea 可為急性（肺栓塞、氣喘、肺炎、Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome）或慢性（COPD、心衰竭）。

nodes.label: L-Tyrosine
nodes.description: L-Tyrosine is biochemically converted into L-DOPA through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, L-Tyrosine acts as the substrate and L-DOPA as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: L-Tyrosine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 L-DOPA。從機制上講，L-Tyrosine 作為底物，L-DOPA 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

nodes.label: Erythropoietin
nodes.description: Erythropoietin is the kidney-derived cytokine induced by hypoxia-inducible factors that drives red cell production via the EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 axis. In chronic kidney disease, EPO deficiency and accelerated eryptosis coincide, producing anaemia; sepsis alters EPO responsiveness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Erythropoietin 是由 hypoxia-inducible factors 誘導、腎臟來源的細胞激素，透過 EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 軸驅動紅血球生成。在 chronic kidney disease 中，EPO 缺乏與加速的 eryptosis 同時出現而造成貧血；sepsis 則會改變 EPO 的反應性。

nodes.label: Myocardium
nodes.description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

nodes.label: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
nodes.description: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy, the thickening or enlargement of the left ventricular wall in response to pressure overload, is accompanied by increased expression of the fission protein DRP1 and reduced levels of the fusion protein MFN2, so mitochondrial dynamics themselves are a biomarker of cardiac remodelling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy 是壓力超負荷引起的左心室壁增厚或擴大，常伴隨分裂蛋白 DRP1 上升與融合蛋白 MFN2 下降，因此粒線體動態本身即為心臟重塑的生物標誌。

nodes.label: Basal Ganglia
nodes.description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

nodes.label: TIMP2
nodes.description: TIMP2 binds the catalytic site of MMP-2 (gelatinase A) in a 1:1 complex to inhibit it, but at low concentrations it also acts as a facilitator rather than an inhibitor: TIMP2 bridges MT1-MMP and pro-MMP-2 on the cell surface into a ternary complex, letting adjacent uninhibited MT1-MMP cleave the pro-peptide and generate active 62 kDa MMP-2. This makes TIMP2 a concentration-dependent molecular switch.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TIMP2 以 1:1 複合體結合 MMP-2（gelatinase A）的催化位而抑制它；但在低濃度下它反而是促進因子：TIMP2 在細胞表面把 MT1-MMP 與 pro-MMP-2 架橋成三元複合體，使鄰近且未被抑制的 MT1-MMP 剪除前驅物胜肽，生成具活性的 62 kDa MMP-2。這使 TIMP2 成為濃度依賴的分子開關。

nodes.label: OSKM
nodes.description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

nodes.label: PQBP1
nodes.description: Activating cGAS via the tau-PQBP1 axis triggers cGAS-STING signalling, driving type I interferon and ISG programmes, microglial inflammatory states and neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過 tau–PQBP1 軸活化 cGAS 會啟動 cGAS-STING 訊號，驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 程式、小膠細胞發炎狀態與神經退化。

nodes.label: Dopaminergic Neurons
nodes.description: Dopaminergic Neurons are the primary source of Dopamine in the mammalian central nervous system, controlling metabolic processes, executive functions, and motor control. They are abundant in the Substantia Nigra (pars compacta) and are essential for motor control, reward-motivated behaviour, and executive function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopaminergic Neurons 是哺乳類中樞神經系統內 Dopamine 的主要來源，控制代謝過程、執行功能與運動控制。它們在 Substantia Nigra（pars compacta）豐富分布，對運動控制、獎賞驅動行為與執行功能至關重要。

nodes.label: TAT
nodes.description: TAT (Transactivator of transcription) is encoded by the tat gene of HIV-1. In virology it is essential for replication, binding the TAR RNA element in nascent transcripts and recruiting host P-TEFb to boost transcription elongation; the 11-residue basic domain YGRKKRRQRRR is what makes it useful as a cell-penetrating peptide.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TAT（transactivator of transcription）由 HIV-1 的 tat 基因編碼。在病毒學上它對複製不可或缺，會結合新生轉錄本中的 TAR RNA 元素並招募宿主 P-TEFb 以促進轉錄延長；正是這 11 殘基的鹼性區 YGRKKRRQRRR 使它可作為穿透細胞的胜肽使用。

nodes.label: H3K4me3
nodes.description: Trained Immunity is marked by H3K4me3 at promoters together with H3K4me1/H3K27ac at enhancers and latent enhancers, plus the lncRNA UMLILO; G9a inhibition augments training, and miR-9-5p opposes it while miR-146a supports tolerance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Trained Immunity 在啟動子帶有 H3K4me3，並在 enhancer 與 latent enhancer 帶有 H3K4me1/H3K27ac，同時涉及 lncRNA UMLILO；抑制 G9a 可增強 training，miR-9-5p 與之相抗而 miR-146a 則支持 tolerance。

nodes.label: Kidney
nodes.description: Urolithin A and its metabolites can be excreted from the body through the kidneys and intestines. Renal function can influence the rate of urolithin A elimination, since a portion of the compound and its conjugated forms is cleared in the urine, while additional urolithin A is further metabolized into other compounds within the intestines before being eliminated through feces. Renal function, intestinal permeability, and individual characteristics are therefore among the physiological factors that shape the bioavailability, metabolism, and distribution of urolithin A.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 及其代謝物可經由腎臟與腸道排出體外。腎功能會影響 urolithin A 的排除速率，因為部分化合物及其結合形式經尿液清除，而另有部分 urolithin A 在腸道內進一步代謝為其他化合物後再經糞便排出。因此，腎功能、腸道通透性與個體特徵，是形塑 urolithin A 生體可用率、代謝與分布的生理因素之一。

nodes.label: Ribosomal Protein S6
nodes.description: S6K1, itself activated by mTORC1, phosphorylates Ribosomal Protein S6 (rpS6) at multiple serine residues; because of this, phosphorylated S6 is widely used as the canonical surrogate readout of mTORC1 activity in resected tissues and preclinical models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S6K1（本身由 mTORC1 活化）在多個絲胺酸殘基上磷酸化 Ribosomal Protein S6（rpS6）；因此磷酸化 S6 被廣泛用作切檢組織與前臨床模型中 mTORC1 活性的標準替代性讀值。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

nodes.label: MALAT1
nodes.description: MALAT1 modulates Autophagy by sponging miR-101, which upregulates STUB1 expression, and by interacting with TFEB to influence lysosomal gene transcription and by regulating mTORC1 signaling under hypoxic stress. The same mechanism has been reported to upregulate SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MALAT1 透過「海綿」miR-101 來調節 Autophagy，進而提升 STUB1 的表達；它也與 TFEB 互動以影響溶酶體基因轉錄，並在缺氧壓力下調節 mTORC1 訊號。同一機制亦被報導可上調 SIRT1。

nodes.label: Lactate
nodes.description: Warburg Effect produces Lactate. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. Lactate is the end product of aerobic glycolysis whose export acidifies the tumor microenvironment and fosters invasion and immune suppression. The relationship is directional, with Warburg Effect acting as the operative agent upon Lactate rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Warburg Effect 產生 Lactate。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 Lactate 是有氧糖解的最終產物，其輸出酸化 Tumor Microenvironment 並促進入侵和免疫抑制。這種關係是有方向的，Warburg Effect 充當 Lactate 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Plasminogen
nodes.description: Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) is a serine protease that cleaves plasminogen at Arg561-Val562 to generate plasmin, the active protease that degrades cross-linked fibrin. Plasmin in turn cleaves single-chain tPA to the more active two-chain form, creating a positive feedback loop that amplifies fibrinolysis at the clot surface.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tissue plasminogen activator（tPA）是一種絲胺酸蛋白酶，於 Arg561-Val562 處切割 plasminogen 生成 plasmin；plasmin 進而切割單鏈 tPA 生成活性更高的雙鏈形式，形成在血塊表面放大 fibrinolysis 的正回饋迴路。

nodes.label: TDO
nodes.description: TDO also produces N-Formylkynurenine, but in a tissue-restricted way: hepatic tryptophan dioxygenase runs the same oxidative deamination. Having IDO1 and TDO generate the identical intermediate means tryptophan catabolism can be targeted at either entry point, and that N-Formylkynurenine is not a marker of one specific enzyme's activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TDO 也會產生 N-Formylkynurenine，但侷限於特定組織：肝臟的 tryptophan dioxygenase 執行相同的氧化脫胺反應。由於 IDO1 與 TDO 生成相同的中間產物，表示 tryptophan 分解可在任一入口被標定，也表示 N-Formylkynurenine 並非某一特定酵素活性的專一標記。

nodes.label: Actinobacteria
nodes.description: Bifidobacterium is a genus of Gram-positive, non-motile, often Y- or V-shaped branched anaerobic bacteria belonging to the phylum Actinobacteria; it is among the first colonizers of the infant gut and remains prevalent in the adult gut microbiome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bifidobacterium 是屬於 Actinobacteria 門的革蘭氏陽性、不具運動性、常呈 Y 形或 V 形分枝的厭氧菌屬；它是嬰兒腸道最早的定殖菌之一，並在成人 gut microbiome 中持續普遍存在。

nodes.label: Rejuvenation
nodes.description: Rejuvenation can be achieved by cellular reprogramming, which resets age-related epigenetic changes to restore a youthful state. Full reprogramming to pluripotency erases somatic epigenetic marks and restores youthful gene expression, and partial reprogramming achieves rejuvenation without full dedifferentiation. Because aging is associated with reversible epigenetic alterations, resetting DNA methylation and chromatin marks through reprogramming can restore cellular and organismal function. The field now aims to translate these resetting effects into therapies that slow human aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rejuvenation可以透過細胞重編程來實現，細胞重編程會重置與年齡相關的表觀遺傳學變化，以恢復年輕狀態。完全重編程為多能性會消除體細胞表觀遺傳標記並恢復年輕的gene expression，而部分重編程則無需完全去分化即可實現返老還童。由於老化與可逆的表觀遺傳改變有關，因此透過重編程重置 DNA 甲基化和染色質標記可以恢復細胞和有機體功能。該領域現在的目標是將這些重置效應轉化為減緩人類老化的療法。

nodes.label: Sunitinib
nodes.description: Sunitinib is a multi-targeted receptor tyrosine-kinase inhibitor of VEGFR, PDGFR and c-KIT, approved for renal cell carcinoma, GIST and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours. As a representative VEGFR-targeted antiangiogenic TKI it is cited alongside Pazopanib, blocking the VEGF signalling that tumour endothelium depends on for growth.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sunitinib 是 VEGFR、PDGFR 與 c-KIT 的多標靶受體酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，已核准用於 renal cell carcinoma、GIST 與 pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour。作為具代表性的 VEGFR 標靶抗血管生成 TKI，它與 Pazopanib 並列被引用，藉阻斷腫瘤內皮生長所依賴的 VEGF 訊息而作用。

nodes.label: Aldose reductase
nodes.description: Aldose reductase catalyzes the first rate-limiting glucose to sorbitol step opening the pathway. Initiation gates all downstream flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aldose reductase 催化首個速率限制的葡萄糖到山梨醇步驟，開啟路徑。啟動守衛所有下游通量。

nodes.label: Cytoskeleton
nodes.description: Ambra-1 links autophagy to the Cytoskeleton via interactions with dynein and myosin, and it is phosphorylated by ULK1 during starvation, which releases it from the dynein complex to enable Beclin1 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ambra-1 透過與 dynein、myosin 的交互作用把自噬與 Cytoskeleton 連結起來；在飢餓時它受 ULK1 磷酸化，因而從 dynein 複合體釋放，使 Beclin1得以活化。

nodes.label: E3 ligase
nodes.description: HUWE1 is a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 HECT 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶。

nodes.label: Sodium Metabisulfite
nodes.description: Sodium metabisulfite is a reducing agent commonly added to pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions as a sacrificial antioxidant. Because epinephrine slowly oxidizes in the presence of air, the sulfite compound donates electrons to any quinone intermediate that forms, converting it back to stable epinephrine and preventing the pink-red adrenochrome discoloration that indicates oxidation. This is why many injectable epinephrine formulations used in emergency devices such as autoinjectors contain sodium metabisulfite: it extends the shelf life of the catecholamine by intercepting the very first oxidation step of the adrenochrome pathway. The practice illustrates how chemical formulation, not just biology, exploits the catechol-quinone redox equilibrium to suppress adrenochrome formation and preserve drug potency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sodium metabisulfite 是一種還原劑，常被加入腎上腺素（epinephrine）藥劑中作為犧牲性抗氧化劑。因為腎上腺素在空氣中會緩慢氧化，sulfite 化合物會向形成的任何醌類中間體提供電子，將其轉回穩定的腎上腺素，並防止呈粉紅紅色的 adrenochrome 變色，這是氧化的指標。因此，許多用於自動注射器等緊急裝置的注射型腎上腺素製劑都含有 sodium metabisulfite：它透過攔截 adrenochrome 途徑的第一個氧化步驟，延長了兒茶酚胺的保存期限。此做法說明了化學配方（而不僅是生物學）如何利用兒茶酚-醌氧化還原平衡來抑制 adrenochrome 的形成並保持藥效。

nodes.label: UPRam
nodes.description: UPRam (unfolded protein response activated by mistargeting of proteins) is a stress pathway triggered when Mitochondria-directed precursor proteins are misdirected to other organelles or accumulate in the cytosol because import is impaired. The cell responds by upregulating chaperones and proteasomal components, with HSF1 and NRF1 coordinating the response and RPN4 a key downstream effector in yeast.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UPRam（unfolded protein response activated by mistargeting of proteins）是在粒線體前驅蛋白因輸入受損而被誤送至其他胞器、或於細胞質累積時觸發的壓力途徑。細胞藉由上調 chaperone 與 proteasome 元件因應，由 HSF1 與 NRF1 協調，RPN4 則是酵母中的關鍵下游效應器。

nodes.label: apitherapy
nodes.description: Apitherapy is a branch of complementary and alternative medicine that uses products derived from honeybees — honey, pollen, propolis, royal jelly and bee venom (apitoxin) — for therapeutic purposes. In oncology it is studied chiefly for the antitumor properties of venom and its major peptide melittin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apitherapy 是 Complementary and alternative medicine 的一支，使用源自 Honeybee 的產品——蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠、蜂王漿與蜂毒（apitoxin）——作為治療用途。在腫瘤學上，其研究重點為蜂毒及其主要胜肽 melittin 的抗腫瘤性質。

nodes.label: Cerulein-Induced Pancreatitis
nodes.description: Acinar necrosis in cerulein-induced pancreatitis is driven in large part by necroptosis: supramaximal cerulein hyperstimulation activates RIPK3, whose phosphorylation of MLKL ruptures acinar membranes; RIPK3 or MLKL deletion attenuates severity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cerulein 誘導胰臟炎的腺泡壞死主要由 necroptosis 驅動：超最大量 cerulein 過度刺激活化 RIPK3，其磷酸化 MLKL 使腺泡膜破裂；RIPK3 或 MLKL 缺失可減輕嚴重度。

nodes.label: ESCRT
nodes.description: ESCRT machinery (complexes 0-III) performs the membrane scission that lets Selective Autophagy capture damaged organelles. After a defective peroxisome is tagged with ubiquitin and sensed by PERO1, ESCRT is recruited and engages LC3 to initiate engulfment into an autophagosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ESCRT 機制（0-III 複合體）執行膜切割，使 Selective Autophagy 能夠包圍受損胞器。當缺陷的 peroxisome 被泛素標記並由 PERO1 辨識後，ESCRT 被招募並與 LC3 互動，啟動包裹進 autophagosome 的過程。

nodes.label: INF2
nodes.description: INF2 is an endoplasmic-reticulum-bound inverted formin that acts at ER-mitochondria contact sites, coupling cytoskeletal remodeling at membrane contact sites to organelle division and thereby underpinning mitochondrial integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: INF2 是結合於內質網的 inverted formin，在內質網—粒線體接觸位點作用，將膜接觸位點的細胞骨架重塑與胞器分裂耦合，進而支撐粒線體完整性。

nodes.label: H3K36me3
nodes.description: H3K36me3 occupies the perichromatin space of facultative heterochromatin structures such as senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It marks the transcriptionally active surfaces flanking senescent heterochromatin, distinct from the repressive interior.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 佔據衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）等兼性異染色質結構的染色質外周空間。它標記衰老異染色質旁側的轉錄活性表面，與抑制性的內部相區別。

nodes.label: CCN1
nodes.description: CCN1 (CYR61) binds integrin α6β1 and heparan sulfate proteoglycans, and engagement triggers ROS accumulation that activates p53 and the p16/RB pathways, inducing senescence in activated myofibroblasts (Jun & Lau 2010). CCN1 thus acts as a feedback brake that limits fibrosis during wound healing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CCN1（CYR61）結合 integrin α6β1 與硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣，其結合會引發 ROS 累積並活化 p53 與 p16/RB 路徑，誘導活化的肌成纖維細胞進入衰老（Jun & Lau 2010）。因此 CCN1 扮演回饋煞車，在傷口癒合期間限制纖維化。

nodes.label: HMG-CoA reductase
nodes.description: Statins are pharmacological inhibitors of HMG-CoA reductase; lowering cholesterol through this target is their primary therapeutic action in cardiovascular disease. The same inhibition is exploited experimentally to sensitize cells and tumors to ferroptosis in combination with GPX4 inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Statins 是 HMG-CoA reductase 的藥理抑制劑；經由此標的降低膽固醇是它在心血管疾病中的主要治療作用。同一種抑制作用也被實驗性地用來與 GPX4 抑制劑併用，使細胞與腫瘤對 ferroptosis 更加敏感。

nodes.label: Hydroxyfenbendazole
nodes.description: Hydroxyfenbendazole is a phase-I hydroxylated metabolite of fenbendazole generated by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP2J2 (with CYP2C19). After intravenous dosing in cattle more than 50% of the fenbendazole dose was recovered as hydroxyfenbendazole in excreta, making it the major excretory metabolite of the parent drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hydroxyfenbendazole 是 fenbendazole 的 phase-I 羥基化代謝物，由細胞色素 P450 酵素 CYP2J2（與 CYP2C19）生成。在牛靜脈給藥後，超過 50% 的 fenbendazole 劑量以 hydroxyfenbendazole 形式由排泄物回收，使其成為母藥的主要排泄代謝物。

nodes.label: c-FLIP
nodes.description: p22-FLIP is the 22 kDa N-terminal fragment produced when caspase-8 cleaves c-FLIP (FLIP_L or FLIP_S) at Asp198 (Asp196 in some isoforms) in cytosolic, FADD-independent heterodimers. Retaining only DED1-DED2, it is generated off the DISC, unlike Asp376 processing, and its production is human-specific.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p22-FLIP 是在細胞質中、不依賴 FADD 的異源二聚體裡，caspase-8 切割 c-FLIP（FLIP_L 或 FLIP_S）於 Asp198（部分異構型為 Asp196）時產生的 22 kDa N 端片段。它僅保留 DED1–DED2，於 DISC 之外生成（不同於 Asp376 的加工），且其生成為人類專一。

nodes.label: RNA-seq
nodes.description: RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) is a high-throughput sequencing method that profiles the complete set of RNA transcripts in a biological sample and quantifies gene expression. The workflow runs RNA extraction, poly-A selection or ribosomal RNA depletion, reverse transcription to cDNA, adapter ligation and PCR library preparation, sequencing, then bioinformatics read alignment and quantification with tools such as DESeq2 for differential expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA-seq（RNA 定序）是一種高通量定序方法，可剖析生物樣本中完整的 RNA 轉錄本集合並量化基因表現。工作流程包含 RNA 萃取、poly-A 篩選或核糖體 RNA 去除、逆转錄成 cDNA、接头連接與 PCR 文庫製備、定序，最後以 DESeq2 等工具進行讀段比對與差異表現量化。

nodes.label: SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio
nodes.description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio determines the hormetic window: a high ratio (SIRT3-dominant) favors the adaptive branch, while a low ratio tilts toward the toxic branch of mitohormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 比例決定激素性窗口：比例高（SIRT3 主導）傾向適應分支，比例低則傾向粒線體激素性的毒性分支。

nodes.label: Drug Repositioning
nodes.description: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

nodes.label: JNK1
nodes.description: JNK1 phosphorylates Bcl-2 at Thr69/Ser70/Ser87, inactivating the guardian.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JNK1 在 Thr69/Ser70/Ser87 磷酸化 Bcl-2，使守護者失活。

nodes.label: SCF Complex
nodes.description: FBW7 confers substrate specificity on the SCF ubiquitin ligase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FBW7 賦予 SCF 泛素連接酶受質特異性。

nodes.label: Malate
nodes.description: Malate dehydrogenase (MDH) catalyzes the reversible, NAD+-dependent interconversion of oxaloacetate and malate (oxaloacetate + NADH + H+ ⇌ malate + NAD+). Cytosolic MDH1 reduces oxaloacetate to malate using cytosolic NADH, feeding the malate-aspartate shuttle, while mitochondrial MDH2 oxidizes malate back to oxaloacetate, regenerating NADH in the matrix for OXPHOS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Malate dehydrogenase（MDH）催化草醯乙酸與蘋果酸之間可逆的、依賴 NAD+ 的相互轉換（草醯乙酸 + NADH + H+ ⇌ 蘋果酸 + NAD+）。細胞質中的 MDH1 利用細胞質 NADH 將草醯乙酸還原為蘋果酸以餵入蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭，而粒線體中的 MDH2 則將蘋果酸氧化回草醯乙酸，在基質中為 OXPHOS 再生 NADH。

nodes.label: Indirect Calorimetry
nodes.description: Indirect calorimetry estimates energy expenditure from respiratory gas exchange — the rate of O2 consumption and CO2 production — converted to energy via the respiratory quotient. Under standardized post-absorptive, rest-supine, thermoneutral conditions it is the standard method for resting metabolic rate, with typical precision around 3%.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 間接量熱法藉由呼吸氣體交換（O2 消耗與 CO2 產生速率）並以呼吸商換算為能量，來估算能量消耗。在標準化的事後吸收狀態、靜臥與熱中性條件下，它是測量靜止代謝率的標準方法，典型精度約為 3%。

nodes.label: HDAC inhibitors
nodes.description: SAHA (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid, INN vorinostat) is the prototypical hydroxamic-acid pan-HDAC inhibitor: its zinc-chelating hydroxamate group occupies the catalytic pocket of Zn2+-dependent HDACs, blocking class I and class II deacetylases. It became the first HDAC inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2006, for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAHA（suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid，INN 名 vorinostat）是羥肟酸類廣效 HDAC 抑制劑的原型：其螯鋅羥肟酸基團占據 Zn2+ 依賴型 HDAC 的催化口袋，阻斷第一類與第二類去乙醯化酶。2006 年 SAHA 成為首個獲 FDA 核准的 HDAC 抑制劑，用於皮膚型 T 細胞淋巴瘤。

nodes.label: cap-dependent translation
nodes.description: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

nodes.label: Translocase of the Outer Mitochondrial Membrane
nodes.description: The TOM complex is the principal entry gate for nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins: it recognises mitochondrial targeting sequences and conducts precursors across the outer mitochondrial membrane into the intermembrane space, then hands them to the Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane for further import into the matrix.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TOM 複合體是核編碼粒線體蛋白的主要入口：它辨識粒線體定位序列，將前驅蛋白質導引通過粒線體外膜進入膜間腔，再交由 Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane 進一步輸入基質。
nodes.norm_label: translocase of the outer mitochondrial membrane
nodes.source_file: Translocase of the Outer Mitochondrial Membrane.md

nodes.label: HRI
nodes.description: eIF2α is a key regulatory hub of the integrated stress response, phosphorylated at Ser51 by four stress-activated kinases. HRI (EIF2AK1) is the mitochondrial stress-responsive kinase, activated by DELE1 and heme deficiency, alongside PERK (ER stress), GCN2 (amino acid starvation), and PKR (double-stranded RNA).
nodes.description_zh_TW: eIF2α 是整合性壓力反應的關鍵調節樞紐，在 Ser51 上被四種壓力活化激酶磷酸化。HRI（EIF2AK1）是粒線體壓力反應的激酶，由 DELE1 與血基質缺乏活化，其他三者分別為 PERK（ER 壓力）、GCN2（胺基酸缺乏）與 PKR（雙股 RNA）。

nodes.label: NKG2A
nodes.description: NKG2A is an inhibitory C-type lectin-like receptor encoded by KLRC1 that pairs with CD94 on NK cells and a subset of CD8+ T cells to recognize HLA-E, the non-classical MHC class Ib molecule presenting leader peptides from classical HLA-A/B/C. Because HLA-E is stabilized by peptides from other HLA molecules, its surface level reports the overall HLA-I expression of a target cell, so missing-self cells escape NKG2A inhibition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NKG2A 是由 KLRC1 編碼的抑制性 C 型凝集素類受體，與 CD94 形成異源二聚體表現在 NK 細胞與部分 CD8+ T 細胞上，負責辨識 HLA-E——即呈現源自典型 HLA-A/B/C leader peptide 的非典型 MHC class Ib 分子。由於 HLA-E 由其他 HLA 分子的 peptide 穩定，其表面量等同於回報標的細胞的整體 HLA-I 表現，因此「missing-self」的細胞便能逃過 NKG2A 的抑制。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence
nodes.description: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase is the matrix-localized metalloprotease that removes N-terminal Mitochondrial Targeting Sequences from newly imported nuclear-encoded proteins shortly after they traverse the inner membrane, enabling proper folding and function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase 是位於基質的金屬蛋白酶，在新輸入的核基因編碼蛋白穿過內膜後不久，即切除其 N 端 Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence，使其得以正確摺疊並發揮功能。

nodes.label: anti-inflammatory properties
nodes.description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

nodes.label: IkappaB
nodes.description: IκB proteins are a family of cytoplasmic inhibitors that sequester NF-κB dimers in the cytosol via their ankyrin-repeat binding of the nuclear localization signal, preventing nuclear import. IκBα is the primary member for canonical signalling; IκBζ is nuclear and regulates IL-6 transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IκB 蛋白是一系列細胞質抑制蛋白，透過其 ankyrin repeat 結構結合 NF-κB 二聚體的核定位訊號，將其隔離在細胞質中，阻止核輸入。IκBα 是典型訊號傳遞的主要成員；IκBζ 位於細胞核內並調控 IL-6 的轉錄。

nodes.label: Somatic Cells
nodes.description: The Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc, abbreviated OSKM) are a set of four transcription factors used to induce pluripotency in differentiated somatic cells. When introduced into fibroblasts or other somatic cells, they initiate a cascade of transcriptional and epigenetic changes that reset the cell toward an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, erasing somatic memory and installing the pluripotency network. This demonstration, pioneered by Shinya Yamanaka in 2006, established that cellular identity is not fixed but can be reprogrammed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 山中因子（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc，縮寫為 OSKM）是一組四個轉錄因子，用於誘導分化體細胞的多能性。當引入成纖維細胞或其他體細胞時，它們會啟動一系列轉錄和表觀遺傳學變化，將細胞重置為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，消除體細胞記憶並安裝多能性網路。此演示由 Shinya Yamanaka 於 2006 年首創，證實細胞身份不是固定的，而是可以重新編程的。

nodes.label: Apis mellifera
nodes.description: Apis mellifera, the Western or European honeybee, is a hymenopteran insect of major ecological and economic importance as a pollinator. Within this knowledge base it is included principally as the natural source of venom and its principal cytotoxic peptide melittin, both studied for anticancer activity, alongside honey, pollen, propolis and royal jelly as the basis of apitherapy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apis mellifera（西方蜜蜂／歐洲蜜蜂）是膜翅目昆蟲，作為授粉者具有極大的生態與經濟重要性。在本知識庫中，收錄它的主要原因是它是蜂毒及其主要細胞毒性胜肽 melittin 的天然來源，兩者都被研究用於抗癌活性，並與蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠與蜂王漿共同構成 apitherapy（蜂療）的基礎。

nodes.label: HERV
nodes.description: Human endogenous retroviruses activate the cGAS-STING pathway when their expression is derepressed during aging and senescence. Age-related loss of DNA methylation and heterochromatin permits HERV transcription, and the resulting HERV RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA that is sensed by cGAS, triggering STING-dependent upregulation of type I interferons and SASP factors. HERV-driven innate immune signaling contributes to inflammaging and the paracrine spread of senescence. Suppressing HERV expression or reverse transcription therefore reduces this senescence-driving inflammatory signal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當人類內源性逆轉錄病毒的表達在老化和老化過程中被抑制時，它們會活化 cGAS-STING 路徑。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化和異染色質缺失允許 HERV 轉錄，並且所得的 HERV RNA 被逆轉錄為 cGAS 感知的 cDNA，觸發 I 型乾擾素和 SASP 因子的 STING 依賴性上調。 HERV 驅動的先天免疫訊號傳導有助於發炎和老化的旁分泌擴散。因此，抑制 HERV 表達或逆轉錄可以減少這種老化驅動的發炎訊號。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: Endogenous Retrovirus
nodes.description: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

nodes.label: STAT6
nodes.description: IL-13 binds the IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 receptor complex, activating JAK1 and TYK2, which phosphorylate STAT6. Dimerized STAT6 translocates to the nucleus and drives transcription of mucus, tissue-remodeling and alternatively-activated macrophage genes. IL-13 shares both the IL-4Rα subunit and STAT6 signaling with IL-4.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-13 與 IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 受體複合體結合後活化 JAK1 與 TYK2，進而使 STAT6 磷酸化。二聚化的 STAT6 轉位至細胞核，驅動黏液、組織重塑以及 alternative 活化巨噬細胞相關基因的轉錄。IL-13 與 IL-4 共用 IL-4Rα 次單元與 STAT6 訊號傳遞。

nodes.label: Bilirubin
nodes.description: Human Serum Albumin is the most abundant plasma protein (35–50 g/L; 66.5 kDa, 585 residues) and the body's major transport protein for fatty acids, Bilirubin, hormones, metal ions and a wide range of drugs. It also maintains plasma colloid oncotic pressure and buffers pH, and its free Cys34 thiol scavenges Reactive Oxygen Species and nitrogen species extracellularly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是血漿中最豐富的蛋白質（35–50 g/L；66.5 kDa、585 個殘基），也是脂肪酸、Bilirubin、荷爾蒙、金屬離子與廣泛藥物的全身主要運輸蛋白。它同時維持血漿膠體滲透壓並緩衝 pH，其游離的 Cys34 硫醇還能在細胞外清除 Reactive Oxygen Species 與含氮物種。

nodes.label: Piperine
nodes.description: Piperine raises the Bioavailability of co-administered compounds by inhibiting intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein, and phase-II conjugation by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The classic demonstration is a roughly 20-fold increase in Curcumin bioavailability, with similar enhancement explored for Fisetin and other poorly absorbed polyphenols.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Piperine 藉由抑制腸道與肝臟的 CYP3A4 及其他 cytochrome P450 酵素、外排轉運蛋白 P-glycoprotein，以及 UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 的第二期結合反應，提高併用化合物的 Bioavailability。經典例子是使 Curcumin 的生體可用度提升約 20 倍；類似的增強效果也在 Fisetin 與其他吸收不良的 polyphenols 上被研究。

nodes.label: C11-BODIPY
nodes.description: C11-BODIPY is a fluorescent fatty acid analogue that inserts into membranes and shifts emission from red (~590 nm) to green (~510 nm) when oxidized by lipid peroxyl radicals; the green/red ratio gives a ratiometric readout of lipid peroxidation independent of probe loading and cell number.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C11-BODIPY 是一種螢光脂肪酸類似物，可嵌入細胞膜，並在被 lipid peroxyl radical 氧化時使發光由紅光（約 590 nm）移至綠光（約 510 nm）；綠／紅比值可提供不受探針載量與細胞數影響的 lipid peroxidation 比率型讀值。

nodes.label: Hepatic Stellate Cells
nodes.description: Roughly 50-80% of the body's vitamin A sits in hepatic stellate cells as retinyl esters, which is why loss of these cells in hepatic injury can precipitate deficiency. The liver monitors supply, converting retinol to retinyl esters via lecithin:retinol acyltransferase when supply is ample and mobilizing them when needed. Because retinoids do not circulate appreciably in free form - retinol travels bound to retinol-binding protein 4 with transthyretin - tissue delivery is tightly buffered rather than responsive to acute intake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 體內約 50-80% 的 vitamin A 以 retinyl esters 形式儲存在 Hepatic Stellate Cells，這也是肝臟損傷造成這些細胞喪失時可能引發缺乏的原因。肝臟負責監測供應，供應充足時經 lecithin:retinol acyltransferase 將 retinol 轉為 retinyl esters，需要時再動員。由於類維生素 A 在游離型態下循環量極低——retinol 與 retinol-binding protein 4 及 transthyretin 結合運送——組織供應是受到嚴格緩衝，而非對急性攝取迅速反應。

nodes.label: DNA-PKcs
nodes.description: SIRT6 promotes DNA-PKcs mobilization/stability at DSBs, enhancing repair (McCord 2009 PMID 20157594).
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 促進 DNA-PKcs 在雙股斷裂處的動員/穩定性，增強修復（McCord 2009 PMID 20157594）。

nodes.label: Serum
nodes.description: Serum is the most widely used sample type in clinical laboratory medicine, chosen over plasma for chemistry panels because it is prepared simply by allowing blood to clot and centrifuging. Key analytes include Glucose (fasting, postprandial, HbA1c) for diagnosing Diabetes Mellitus, Creatinine and urea for renal function, and transaminases for hepatocellular injury.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serum 是臨床實驗醫學中最常用的樣本類型，因為製備簡單——只需讓血液凝固後離心——故在化學檢驗套組中優於血漿。主要檢測包括用於診斷 Diabetes Mellitus 的 Glucose（空腹、餐後、HbA1c）、評估腎功能的 Creatinine 與尿素，以及評估肝細胞損傷的轉氨酶。

nodes.label: Oxaloacetate
nodes.description: Within the Citric Acid Cycle, Malate Dehydrogenase catalyses the reversible conversion of Oxaloacetate to Malate, interconverting NAD+ and NADH as it does so. This malate–oxaloacetate node also feeds the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, coupling cytosolic and mitochondrial redox state.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Citric Acid Cycle 內，Malate Dehydrogenase 催化 Oxaloacetate 與 Malate 之間的可逆轉換，並在此過程中轉換 NAD+ 與 NADH。這個 malate–oxaloacetate 節點同時供應 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle，將細胞質與粒線體的氧化還原狀態偶聯起來。

nodes.label: Alkylating agent
nodes.description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

nodes.label: ROCK1
nodes.description: Caspase-3 removes the inhibitory C-terminal fragment of ROCK1, activating it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 移除 ROCK1 抑制性 C 端片段以活化之。

nodes.label: Optineurin
nodes.description: Beyond cargo recognition, Optineurin acts as a negative regulator of inflammatory signalling: it negatively regulates NF-κB signaling by interacting with RIP1 and other pathway components. As a cytoplasmic selective autophagy receptor that also participates in Mitophagy alongside NBR1, NDP52 and p62, Optineurin therefore links aggregate and mitochondria clearance to control of inflammatory tone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了辨識受質之外，Optineurin 還是發炎訊號的負向調節者：它藉由與 RIP1 及其他途徑成分交互作用，負向調節 NF-κB 訊號傳遞。Optineurin 作為細胞質選擇性自噬受體，與 NBR1、NDP52、p62 一同參與 Mitophagy，因此把聚合物與粒線體的清除連結到發炎張力的調控。

nodes.label: ERRalpha
nodes.description: ERRalpha transcriptionally activates mitochondrial biogenesis genes, coactivated by PGC-1alpha, and regulates NRF1, NRF2 (GABPA) and TFAM to drive mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription. Metabolic stress such as exercise, caloric restriction and cold exposure upregulates ERRalpha via PGC-1alpha.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ERRalpha 在 PGC-1α 共活化下轉錄活化粒線體生物發生相關基因，並調控 NRF1、NRF2（GABPA）與 TFAM，以驅動粒線體 DNA 的複製與轉錄。運動、熱量限制與寒冷暴露等代謝壓力可經由 PGC-1α 上調 ERRalpha。

nodes.label: Guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase
nodes.description: GAMT is the terminal methyltransferase of creatine biosynthesis, irreversibly methylating guanidinoacetate to form creatine using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor and producing SAH. It is expressed mainly in liver, kidney, and pancreas, so most guanidinoacetate made in the kidney travels to the liver for methylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GAMT 是 creatine 生合成的末端 methyltransferase，以 S-adenosylmethionine 為甲基供體、生成 SAH，不可逆地將 guanidinoacetate 甲基化為 creatine。它主要表現於肝臟、腎臟與胰臟，因此腎臟產生的大部分 guanidinoacetate 會運送至肝臟進行甲基化。

nodes.label: Urolithins
nodes.description: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

nodes.label: Docosahexaenoic acid
nodes.description: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6(n-3)) is an omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid with six cis double bonds, making it one of the most oxidatively labile lipids in biology. It is the major n-3 PUFA (against Arachidonic acid as the major n-6 PUFA) and is highly enriched in neuronal membranes, retinal photoreceptors, and spermatozoa.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid（DHA，22:6(n-3)）是具有六個 cis 雙鍵的 omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid，使其成為生物學上最易被氧化的脂質之一。它是主要的 n-3 PUFA（相對地，Arachidonic acid 為主要的 n-6 PUFA），並高度富集於神經元膜、視網膜光受器與精子中。

nodes.label: LIPL-2
nodes.description: HLH-30 induces LIPL-2 during fasting, while MXL-3 represses it under well-fed conditions. The reciprocal transcriptional switch is the mechanism by which C. elegans couples nutrient status to Lipophagy, matching the ~12-fold rise in lipl-2 mRNA after six hours of fasting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在禁食期間誘導 LIPL-2，而 MXL-3 在營養充足條件下抑制它。這種互補的轉錄開關是 C. elegans 將營養狀態與 Lipophagy 耦合的機制，對應禁食六小時後 lipl-2 mRNA 約 12 倍的上升。

nodes.label: Epigenetic Aging
nodes.description: Down Syndrome is a natural model of segmental progeria: alongside early Senescence and immune dysregulation, epigenetic age acceleration is well documented, driven by the same Aβ burden that produces its Alzheimer pathology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是節段性早老症（segmental progeria）的天然模型：除了提早出現 Senescence（細胞衰老）與免疫失調之外，其表觀遺傳年齡加速亦已有充分文獻支持，並由與其阿茲海默病理相同的 Aβ 負擔所驅動。

nodes.label: Synaptic Vesicles
nodes.description: Dopamine is located in Synaptic Vesicles, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Synaptic Vesicles 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

nodes.label: TGFβ Superfamily
nodes.description: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

nodes.label: LC-MS
nodes.description: LC-MS combines the physical separation of liquid chromatography with mass analysis to identify catecholamine metabolites and impurities such as leuco-adrenochrome with high sensitivity and specificity. Adrenochrome analytics rely on it both to verify the purity of commercial epinephrine against a reference standard and to quantify trace degradation products in biological or pharmaceutical samples.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LC-MS 結合液相層析的物理分離能力與質譜分析能力，可高專一性地鑑別兒茶酚胺代謝物與 leuco-adrenochrome 等雜質。Adrenochrome 的分析同時倚賴它，藉以比對商業 epinephrine 樣品與參考標準以確認純度，並定量生物或藥物樣品中的微量降解產物。

nodes.label: DAXX
nodes.description: As the H3.3-specific chaperone of the ATRX-DAXX complex, DAXX deposits the histone variant H3.3 at telomeres, pericentric heterochromatin and endogenous retroviruses. This targeted deposition is how the complex establishes and maintains heterochromatin at those repeat-rich loci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 作為 ATRX-DAXX 複合體中專一於 H3.3 的 chaperone，DAXX 將 histone variant H3.3 沉積到 telomere、pericentric heterochromatin 與內源性反轉錄病毒上。這種標的性沉積正是該複合體在這些重複序列豐富的位點建立並維持異染色質的方式。

nodes.label: Red Palm Oil
nodes.description: Red Palm Oil is the richest common food matrix for lipophilic carotenoids, carrying roughly 600-750 ppm total (about 665 ppm average), of which ~41% is beta-carotene and ~41% alpha-carotene plus lycopene, phytoene and phytofluene. One tablespoon (~13 g) delivers ~8.7 mg total carotenoids, roughly 400-500 ug RAE of provitamin A. The oil's lipid vehicle solubilizes the carotenoids into mixed micelles, which is why carotenoid absorption from red palm oil far exceeds that from fat-free vegetables, and the serum-retinol response saturates at <=8 g/day.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Red Palm Oil 是脂溶性類胡蘿蔔素最豐富的常見食物基質，總含量約 600-750 ppm（平均約 665 ppm），其中約 41% 為 β-carotene、約 41% 為 α-carotene，並含有 lycopene、phytoene 與 phytofluene。一大匙（約 13 g）可提供約 8.7 mg 總類胡蘿蔔素，約合 400-500 ug RAE 的 provitamin A。油脂載體可將類胡蘿蔔素溶入混合微膠粒，因此其吸收率遠高於無脂蔬菜；而血清 retinol 反應在每日 ≤8 g 時即達飽和。

nodes.label: Necrosulfonamide
nodes.description: NSA also blocks Gasdermin D pore formation, so NSA rescue alone cannot separate necroptosis from pyroptosis. This off-target activity is the canonical example of the selectivity problem in the necroptosis drug field, and the reason NSA must be paired with Necrostatin-1/GSK872 versus caspase-1/NLRP3 inhibitors in a death-dissection panel.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NSA 也會阻斷 Gasdermin D 成孔，因此單靠 NSA 救援無法區分 necroptosis 與 pyroptosis。這項離靶活性是 necroptosis 藥物領域選擇性問題的典型例證，也是 NSA 必須在死亡機制鑑別組合中與 Necrostatin-1／GSK872 以及 caspase-1／NLRP3 抑制劑配對使用的原因。

nodes.label: HDAC
nodes.description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

nodes.label: Monoacylglycerol Lipase
nodes.description: Monoacylglycerol Lipase hydrolyses monoacylglycerol to glycerol and free fatty acid, completing adipose triglyceride catabolism and therefore acting as the final-step lipase of Lipid Metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Monoacylglycerol Lipase 將 monoacylglycerol 水解為 glycerol 與游離脂肪酸，完成脂肪組織三酸甘油酯的分解，因此是 Lipid Metabolism 的最後一步脂肪酶。

nodes.label: IL-22
nodes.description: IL-22 signals through IL-22R on thymic epithelial cells to drive their proliferation and survival, raising thymic cellularity after total body irradiation (Dudakov et al., 2012). IL-22-deficient mice show impaired immune recovery, and loss of CD4/CD8 double-positive thymocytes triggers IL-23-driven ILC production of IL-22 that feeds back into thymic regeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-22 透過胸腺上皮細胞上的 IL-22R 訊號促進其增殖與存活，在全身輻射後提高胸腺細胞數（Dudakov et al., 2012）。IL-22 缺乏小鼠的免疫恢復受損；CD4/CD8 雙陽性胸腺細胞的流失會觸發 IL-23 驅動的 ILC 產生 IL-22，再回頭促進胸腺再生。

nodes.label: Angiostatin
nodes.description: MMP-12 is the most potent matrix metalloproteinase for generating angiostatin from plasminogen, positioning it as a dual-function enzyme: pro-inflammatory via chemokine processing yet anti-angiogenic via angiostatin generation. MMP-3, MMP-7 and MMP-9 can also generate angiostatin, and TIMP1/TIMP3 restrain its production. The pro- versus anti-angiogenic balance of MMP-12 is context-dependent in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-12 是由 plasminogen 生成 angiostatin 最具效力的基質金屬蛋白酶，使其成為雙功能酵素：經由趨化素加工具促發炎作用，經由 angiostatin 生成則具抗血管新生作用。MMP-3、MMP-7 與 MMP-9 亦能生成 angiostatin，而 TIMP1/TIMP3 會抑制其生成。MMP-12 促血管新生與抗血管新生的平衡在癌症中具情境依賴性。

nodes.label: Translation Initiation
nodes.description: Translation Initiation depends on eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase that unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so the ribosome can scan to the AUG start codon. eIF4A acts within the eIF4F complex together with eIF4E and eIF4G, and its activity on TFEB mRNA is a node at which autophagy gene expression can be controlled.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 依賴 eIF4A，即 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶；它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使核糖體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。eIF4A 與 eIF4E、eIF4G 一起在 eIF4F 複合體中作用，其對 TFEB mRNA 的活性是調控自噬基因表現的關節點。

nodes.label: CCR2
nodes.description: CCL2 (MCP-1) signals chiefly through CCR2, a Gαi-coupled GPCR, with minor activity at CCR4. Engagement activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ flux to drive chemotaxis and adhesion of monocytes, making the CCL2–CCR2 axis the principal monocyte and macrophage recruitment route in the SASP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CCL2（MCP-1）主要透過 CCR2（屬 Gαi 偶聯的 GPCR）傳遞訊號，並在 CCR4 有較弱的活性。其結合會活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ 通量，驅動單核球趨化與黏附，使 CCL2–CCR2 軸成為 SASP 中招募單核球與巨噬細胞的主要途徑。

nodes.label: Omi-HtrA2
nodes.description: Omi/HtrA2 promotes Apoptosis. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse.
