This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Omi/HtrA2 促進 Apoptosis。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Thymus
nodes.description: The thymus exhibits profound age-associated involution, a striking paradoxical feature of this critical lymphoid tissue. Thymic function begins to decrease from the first year of life; the lymphoid component of the thymic epithelial space involutes roughly 3% per year through middle age (35-45 years) and about 1% per year thereafter, while the perivascular space expands with adipocytes and peripheral lymphocytes. By age 70, the TES falls below 10% of total thymus tissue. Although thymic decline is of minimal consequence to healthy individuals, the reduced efficacy of the aging immune system has direct etiological links with opportunistic infections, autoimmunity, and cancer burden.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胸腺表現出顯著的年齡相關退化，這是這一關鍵淋巴組織的一個突出矛盾特徵。胸腺功能從生命第一年開始下降；胸腺上皮空間的淋巴成分以每年約 3% 的速度退化至中年（35-45 歲），此後每年約 1%，而血管周圍空間隨脂肪細胞和外周淋巴細胞擴增。到 70 歲時，TES 降至總胸腺組織的 10% 以下。儘管胸腺衰退對健康個體影響極小，但老化免疫系統效力降低與機會性感染、自身免疫和癌症負擔有直接的病因學聯繫。

nodes.label: Non-coding RNA
nodes.description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

nodes.label: Methemoglobin Reductase
nodes.description: In the treatment of methemoglobinemia, methylene blue is reduced by NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase to leucomethylene blue, which then reduces Fe3+ in methemoglobin back to the ferrous state Fe2+, restoring normal hemoglobin function. This nonenzymatic redox conversion is the primary mechanism by which methylene blue reverses methemoglobinemia. Because the pathway depends on NADPH, patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, who have impaired NADPH generation, are at markedly increased risk of hemolysis and the drug is contraindicated in this population.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在治療methemoglobinemia時，methylene blue被NADPH依賴性methemoglobin還原酶還原為leucomethylene blue，後者然後將methemoglobin中的Fe3+還原回亞鐵狀態Fe2+，恢復正常的血紅蛋白功能。這種非酶促氧化還原轉化是methylene blue逆轉methemoglobin的主要機制。由於該途徑依賴於NADPH，NADPH生成受損的葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者溶血風險顯著增加，該藥物在該人群中是禁忌的。

nodes.label: Flavones
nodes.description: Flavones are one of the subclasses of flavonoids, characterized by a 2-phenylchromen-4-one backbone without a 3-hydroxyl group and shared by the dietary flavones apigenin, luteolin and chrysin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flavones 是 flavonoids 的亞類之一，其特徵為具有 2-苯基色烯-4-酮骨架且不含 3-羥基，飲食中的 apigenin、luteolin 與 chrysin 均屬此類。

nodes.label: MAPKAPK2
nodes.description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates MK2 (MAPKAPK2) at Thr222 in humans, activating the kinase and relieving an intramolecular inhibitory interaction, making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls labile inflammatory mRNA stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在人類磷酸化 MK2（MAPKAPK2）的 Thr222 位點，活化該激酶並解除其分子內抑制性交互作用，使 MK2 成為 p38 調控不穩定發炎 mRNA 穩定性的主要執行者。

nodes.label: IRS1
nodes.description: IRS1 is a signaling adaptor in insulin signaling whose phosphorylation by S6K provides negative feedback that dampens PI3K-Akt signaling. In the incoherent bivalent motif network model, such negative-feedback nodes underlie hormetic dose responses of pathway inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IRS1 是胰島素訊號中的訊號銜接蛋白，其被 S6K 磷酸化提供抑制 PI3K-Akt 訊號的負回饋。在不一致雙價模體（incoherent bivalent motif）網路模型中，此類負回饋節點是途徑抑制劑毒物興奮劑量反應的基礎。

nodes.label: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor
nodes.description: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor signalling through PDGF receptor tyrosine kinases activates vascular smooth muscle cells and is associated with decreased MFN2 levels and increased mitochondrial fragmentation. Inhibition of fission with Mdivi-1 counteracts PDGF-induced fragmentation and reduces VSMC proliferation, so PDGF shifts the mitochondrial network toward fission to support pathological vascular remodelling in Atherosclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor 經由 PDGF 受體酪胺酸激酶作用，活化血管平滑肌細胞，並與 MFN2 濃度下降及粒線體碎裂增加相關。以 Mdivi-1 抑制分裂可抵銷 PDGF 引起的碎裂並降低 VSMC 增殖，顯示 PDGF 將粒線體網絡推向分裂，以支持 Atherosclerosis 中的病理性血管重塑。

nodes.label: Nanotechnology
nodes.description: Nanoparticles are the core engineered carrier class within pharmaceutical nanotechnology, alongside liposomes, nanoemulsions, nanocrystals, and cyclodextrin inclusion complexes used to overcome poor solubility and rapid metabolism of bioactive compounds such as Fisetin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 奈米顆粒是藥物奈米科技中的核心工程載體類別，與微脂體、奈米乳化液、奈米晶體及環糊精包含複合體並列，用以克服 Fisetin 等活性成分的水溶性差與快速代謝問題。

nodes.label: MiTF TFE family
nodes.description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

nodes.label: Bmf
nodes.description: Bmf is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bmf, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bmf the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bmf 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bmf，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bmf 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: Arachidonic acid
nodes.description: Prostaglandins are 20-carbon lipid autacoids derived from Arachidonic acid released from membrane phospholipids by cytosolic phospholipase A2, then oxidized in two steps by COX-1 or COX-2 to Prostaglandin G2 and the reduced endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2. PGH2 is the common precursor converted by terminal synthases into PGE2, PGD2, PGF2alpha, Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2, giving the family its roles in pain, fever, vascular tone, gastric protection and platelet function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Prostaglandins 是 20 碳脂質 autacoids，源自由 cytosolic phospholipase A2 從膜磷脂釋出的 Arachidonic acid，再由 COX-1 或 COX-2 兩步氧化成 Prostaglandin G2 與還原後的 endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2。PGH2 是共同前驅物，經末端合成酶轉為 PGE2、PGD2、PGF2alpha、Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2，使這一族在疼痛、發燒、血管張力、胃黏膜保護與血小板功能中扮演角色。

nodes.label: SN011
nodes.description: SN011 is used to interrogate the relationship between cGAS–STING signaling and the SASP. Because blocking STING with SN011 neither blocks H3K27ac loss nor SASP suppression driven by SLC25A1, the two axes are mechanistically independent: the mitochondrial citrate–acetyl-CoA route to SASP does not require the mtDNA–cGAS–STING arm.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SN011 被用來釐清 cGAS–STING 訊息傳遞與 SASP 之間的關係。由於以 SN011 阻斷 STING 既無法阻止 H3K27ac 的下降，也無法阻止 SLC25A1 所驅動的 SASP 抑制，兩條軸在機制上是彼此獨立的：粒線體的 citrate–acetyl-CoA 途徑並不需要 mtDNA–cGAS–STING 這一支。

nodes.label: FYN
nodes.description: FYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase alongside SRC and LYN.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FYN 是與 SRC 和 LYN 並列的 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

nodes.label: Streptomyces avermectinius
nodes.description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

nodes.label: Retrotransposon
nodes.description: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

nodes.label: C57BL-6
nodes.description: C57BL/6 ("B6") is the dominant inbred background for engineered mouse lines: because background strongly influences phenotype, most engineered alleles are backcrossed onto this strain to control confounders, and its >20 generations of brother-sister mating give high reproducibility.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C57BL/6（「B6」）是基因改造小鼠品系最主要的近交背景：由於背景品系會強烈影響表型，多數改造等位基因都會回交到本品系以控制混雜因子；其超過 20 代的兄弟姊妹交配也帶來高度可重複性。

nodes.label: LPCAT3
nodes.description: LPCAT3 is an ER and nuclear-envelope MBOAT-family enzyme that remodels phospholipids by acylating lysophospholipid acceptors with polyunsaturated fatty acids, especially arachidonate and adrenate, at the sn-2 position. It thereby builds the oxidizable PUFA-containing phosphatidylethanolamine (PE) pool that lipoxygenases and Fenton-reaction radicals peroxidize. Knockdown of LPCAT3 or ACSL4 reduces PUFA-PE and protects cells from ferroptosis; overexpression sensitizes them.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LPCAT3 是位於內質網與核膜的 MBOAT 家族酵素，透過在 sn-2 位置以多不飽和脂肪酸（尤其是花生四烯酸與腎上腺酸）醯化溶血磷脂受質來重塑磷脂。它藉此建立起可被脂氧合酶與 Fenton reaction 自由基過氧化的、含 PUFA 的磷脂醯乙醇胺（PE）池。LPCAT3 或 ACSL4 的敲除會減少 PUFA-PE 並保護細胞免於 ferroptosis；其過表現則使細胞更敏感。

nodes.label: cit-H3
nodes.description: PAD4 (peptidylarginine deiminase 4) deiminates arginine residues on histone H3, generating citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3, H3Cit). Loss of the positive charge unravels chromatin structure, which is required for the chromatin decondensation and extrusion underlying NET formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PAD4（肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 4）將組蛋白 H3 上的精胺酸殘基去亞胺化，生成瓜胺酸化的組蛋白 H3（cit-H3，H3Cit）。正電荷的流失使染色質鬆解，而這正是 NET 形成過程中染色質去凝縮與外排所需的條件。

nodes.label: Adiponectin
nodes.description: Adipocytes within Adipose Tissue secrete Adiponectin, an insulin-sensitizing hormone that enhances insulin sensitivity and fatty-acid oxidation. Its production falls in obesity and insulin resistance, linking adipose secretory failure to metabolic disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adipose Tissue 內的脂肪細胞分泌 Adiponectin，一種增進胰島素敏感性与脂肪酸氧化的促胰島素作用激素。其分泌量在肥胖與胰島素阻抗時下降，將脂肪分泌功能失調與代謝疾病連結起來。

nodes.label: Chromosome
nodes.description: Cell Division checkpoints verify DNA Replication and Chromosome alignment before anaphase, with control through Cyclin/CDK, Rb/E2F and p53. When this surveillance fails, mis-segregation produces aneuploidy such as Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) via meiotic nondisjunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cell Division 的檢查點在後期之前驗證 DNA Replication 與 Chromosome 對位，並透過 Cyclin/CDK、Rb/E2F 與 p53 加以控制。當此監控失效時，分離錯誤會透過減數分裂不分離產生非整倍體，例如 Trisomy 21（Down Syndrome）。

nodes.label: Kinase Inhibitor
nodes.description: Kinases constitute the largest enzyme superfamily in eukaryotes, catalysing transfer of the gamma-phosphate of ATP to protein, lipid or sugar substrates and thereby regulating proliferation, differentiation, metabolism, apoptosis and the cell cycle. Because deregulated kinase activity (mutation, amplification, translocation) drives many cancers, kinase inhibitors are among the most successful targeted cancer therapeutics and remain a major drug class.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 激酶是真核生物中最大的酵素超家族，催化 ATP 的 γ-磷酸基轉移至蛋白質、脂質或糖受質上，藉此調控增殖、分化、代謝、凋亡與細胞週期。由於激酶活性失調（突變、擴增、轉位）會驅動多種癌症，激酶抑制劑已成為最成功的標靶癌症治療手段之一，仍是主要藥物類別。

nodes.label: NBR1
nodes.description: NBR1 mediates Mitophagy as a cytoplasmic selective autophagy receptor. Its ubiquitin-binding domains recognize ubiquitinated damaged mitochondria, and its LIR Motif binds LC3 on the autophagosomal membrane, tethering cargo for delivery into the autophagosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NBR1 作為細胞質內的選擇性自噬受體，媒介 Mitophagy。它的泛素結合區辨識被泛素化的受損粒線體，並透過 LIR Motif 與 autophagosome 膜上的 LC3 結合，將貨物質拴住並送入 autophagosome。

nodes.label: Glyoxal
nodes.description: Glyoxal is a highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediate generated during cellular metabolism, Glycolysis and Lipid Peroxidation. It is a potent inducer of dicarbonyl stress, reacting non-enzymatically with cellular macromolecules to form Advanced Glycation End Products. It is detoxified by enzymatic defense networks including the Glyoxalase System and PARK7 (DJ-1), which catalyzes its glutathione-independent conversion to Glycolic acid and thereby protects cellular proteins from covalent modification.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glyoxal 是在細胞代謝、Glycolysis 與 Lipid Peroxidation 過程中產生的高反應性 dicarbonyl 中間體。它是 dicarbonyl stress 的強效誘發因子，會與細胞大分子進行非酵素性反應形成 Advanced Glycation End Products。它可被包括 Glyoxalase System 與 PARK7（DJ-1）在內的酵素防禦網絡解毒；PARK7 催化其不依賴 glutathione 的轉化為 Glycolic acid，藉此保護細胞蛋白免於共價修飾。

nodes.label: Retinal Photoreceptors
nodes.description: SIRT3 and SIRT5 are both critical for the health of retinal photoreceptors, and SIRT3 activity is sensitive to the reduction of NAD+ content detected in multiple disorders with retinal degeneration, including age-associated dysfunction, diabetic retinopathy, and light-induced degeneration in mice. SIRT3 is a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase that supports ATP homeostasis, ROS detoxification, and neuroprotection, and increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 is one proposed mechanism of nicotinamide riboside's neuroprotective effects. This suggests a potential therapeutic treatment with NR for a variety of disorders that include photoreceptor degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT5 對視網膜感光細胞的健康均至關重要，且 SIRT3 活性對多種伴隨視網膜退化的疾病中所偵測到的 NAD+ 含量降低相當敏感，包括年齡相關功能障礙、diabetic retinopathy（糖尿病視網膜病變）與小鼠中的光誘發退化。SIRT3 是一種粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，支持 ATP 恆定、ROS（活性氧）解毒與神經保護，而提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3 是 nicotinamide riboside 神經保護效應的其中一種被提出的機制。這暗示了以 NR 治療包含感光細胞退化在內的各種疾病的潛在療法。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Atg101
nodes.description: Atg101 binds the Atg13 N-terminus and protects it against proteasomal turnover. Regulation is the stabilization mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg101 結合 Atg13 N 端並保護其免於蛋白酶體更新。調節是穩定機制。

nodes.label: Fascia
nodes.description: Fascia is the body's continuous sheet-like connective-tissue continuum — a three-dimensional web of collagen, elastin and hydrated ground substance — that wraps, separates and connects muscles, bones, vessels, nerves and organs. Classified by the Fascia Nomenclature Committee into subcutaneous, deep, visceral and parietal layers, it forms a single tensegrity network rather than isolated sheets.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fascia 是人體連續片狀的 connective tissue 連續體——由 collagen、elastin 與含水基質構成的三維網絡——包裹、分隔並連接肌肉、骨骼、血管、神經與器官。依 Fascia Nomenclature Committee 分為淺層、深層、臟器層與壁層，它構成的是單一的張力整體網絡而非彼此孤立的膜片。

nodes.label: Melanogenesis
nodes.description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

nodes.label: FNDC5
nodes.description: FNDC5 transcription is transcriptionally driven by PGC-1α, with co-activation through ERRalpha and PPARγ. Exercise, cold exposure, AMPK activation and p38 MAPK signalling all raise FNDC5 expression through this axis, so the PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin cascade links mechanical and metabolic stress to secretion of the myokine irisin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FNDC5 的轉錄由 PGC-1α 驅動，並透過 ERRalpha 與 PPARγ 的共活化增強。運動、寒冷暴露、AMPK 活化與 p38 MAPK 訊號都經由此軸提升 FNDC5 表現，因此 PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin 級聯將機械與代謝壓力連結至 myokine irisin 的分泌。

nodes.label: MAML1
nodes.description: As the obligatory co-activator of the Notch-CSL complex, MAML1 is the effector through which Notch signalling establishes paracrine senescence in neighbouring cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 作為 Notch–CSL 複合體不可或缺的共同活化因子，MAML1 是 Notch 訊號在鄰近細胞中建立旁分泌性衰老（paracrine senescence）的執行者。

nodes.label: Honeybee venom
nodes.description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

nodes.label: Lamins
nodes.description: Caspase-3 cleaves Lamins. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Lamins are the intermediate-filament proteins of the nuclear lamina whose cleavage by caspases drives nuclear collapse during apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 劈開 Lamins。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Lamins 是核纖層的中間絲蛋白，在細胞凋亡過程中被半胱天冬酶裂解驅動核塌陷。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 Lamins 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

nodes.label: BIRC2
nodes.description: Smac mimetics bind the BIR2/BIR3 domains of cIAP1, dimerize RING domains and flip ligase activity onto cIAP1 itself, collapsing its half-life from hours to minutes; cIAP1 degradation is the proximal pharmacodynamic readout in every Smac-mimetic trial and licenses Ripoptosome assembly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smac mimetics 結合 cIAP1 的 BIR2/BIR3 結構域、使 RING 結構域二聚化，並將連接酶活性轉 onto cIAP1 自身，使其半衰期由數小時縮短至數分鐘；cIAP1 降解是所有 Smac-mimetic 試驗最接近的藥效學讀值，並使 Ripoptosome 得以組裝。

nodes.label: ARH1
nodes.description: ARH1 (ADPRH) is the founding ARH-family eraser of ADP-ribosylation: a ~39 kDa, binuclear Mg2+-dependent hydrolase that cleaves alpha-anomeric ADP-ribose-arginine bonds written by cholera-toxin-like ARTs such as mammalian ARTC1. It is the Arg-specific counterpart to ARH3 (Ser) and MacroD1/MacroD2/TARG1 (Asp/Glu), shows less than 1% of ARH3 PAR activity, and restoring Arg residues for a new MARylation cycle explains why Arh1-knockout mice are hypersensitive to cholera toxin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARH1（ADPRH）是 ADP-ribosylation 的 ARH 家族首個「擦除者」：一個約 39 kDa、具雙核 Mg2+ 依賴性的水解酶，可切斷由霍亂毒素樣 ART（例如哺乳類 ARTC1）寫入的 alpha-異構 ADP-ribose-精胺酸鍵。它是 ARH3（Ser）與 MacroD1/MacroD2/TARG1（Asp/Glu）的精胺酸專一對應物，對 PAR 的活性不到 ARH3 的 1%；它將精胺酸殘基還原以進入新的 MARylation 循環，也解釋了 Arh1 敲除小鼠對霍亂毒素的高度敏感。

nodes.label: ERGIC
nodes.description: The ER-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) is a tubulovesicular membrane system situated between the endoplasmic reticulum and the Golgi apparatus, serving as a sorting and trafficking hub for newly synthesized secretory and membrane proteins. Because it originates from the ER, it also sits at the interface of ER stress and autophagic clearance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內質網—高基氏體中間區室（ERGIC）是位於內質網與高基氏體之間的管囊狀膜系統，作為新生分泌蛋白與膜蛋白的分選與運輸樞紐；由於源自內質網，它也位於 ER 壓力與自噬清除的交界面上。

nodes.label: HMGCS2
nodes.description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates HMGCS2 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2), the rate-limiting enzyme of ketone-body synthesis, supporting energy production during fasting. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates HMGCS2. This promotes ketogenesis when carbohydrate is scarce, and it is a fasting-adaptive function of SIRT5. By enabling ketone-body production from acetyl-CoA, SIRT5 supports the brain and other tissues during prolonged fasting. This regulation complements SIRT5's activation of urea-cycle and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化 HMGCS2（3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯-CoA 合酶 2）——酮體合成的限速酶——在禁食期間支持能量產生。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 HMGCS2。這在碳水化合物稀缺時促進酮體生成，是 SIRT5 的禁食適應性功能。透過使酮體能從乙醯-CoA 產生，SIRT5 在長期禁食期間支持大腦和其他組織。此調控與 SIRT5 對尿素循環和脂肪酸氧化酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為分解代謝的協調者。

nodes.label: Anaplerosis
nodes.description: Anaplerosis comprises the biochemical reactions that refill TCA cycle intermediates withdrawn for biosynthesis. In rapidly proliferating cells, intermediates are diverted into amino acid, fatty acid, sterol and nucleotide synthesis, so anaplerotic input becomes essential for continued cycle flux. Glutamine is the dominant anaplerotic substrate in cancer cells, converted to glutamate by glutaminase and then to α-ketoglutarate, which re-enters the cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Anaplerosis 指的是補回因生物合成而被抽用的 TCA cycle 中間產物的生化反應。在快速增殖細胞中，中間產物被分流至胺基酸、脂肪酸、固醇與核苷酸合成，因此補充性輸入對維持循環流量至關重要。在癌細胞中，glutamine 是主要的補充性受質，經 glutaminase 轉為 glutamate，再轉為 α-Ketoglutarate 重新進入循環。

nodes.label: Proto-lysosomal Tubules
nodes.description: Proto-lysosomal tubules are dynamic membrane extensions arising from endolysosomes during lysosome reformation. They represent an intermediate stage in recycling lysosomal membrane and content, ultimately giving rise to new proto-lysosomes that mature into functional lysosomes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 原溶酶體小管（proto-lysosomal tubules）是溶酶體再形成期間由內吞溶酶體產生的動態膜延伸。它們是回收溶酶體膜與內容物的中間階段，最終產生成熟為功能性溶酶體的新原溶酶體。

nodes.label: CLEAR Network
nodes.description: The CLEAR network drives a coordinated lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program that expands lysosomal capacity and autophagic throughput during stress. By upregulating lysosomal hydrolases and biogenesis genes it supports proteostasis and clearance of damaged organelles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網路驅動協調的溶酶體-自噬轉錄程式，在壓力期間擴增溶酶體容量與自噬通量。透過上調溶酶體水解酶與生合成基因，它支持蛋白質恆定與受損胞器的清除。

nodes.label: IGF-Akt Signaling
nodes.description: SIRT6 blocks IGF-Akt signaling and thereby cardiac hypertrophy development by targeting c-Jun, interrupting a pro-hypertrophic survival pathway. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of IGF-Akt repression. This protects the heart from maladaptive growth, and SIRT6 knockout mice develop cardiac hypertrophy that is abrogated when IGF signaling is inhibited in vivo. It complements SIRT6's anti-fibrotic actions in cardiovascular tissue and illustrates the importance of restraining growth-factor signaling in the heart. SIRT6's co-repression of c-Jun-dependent transcription at the chromatin level links epigenetic control to cardiac remodeling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過靶向 c-Jun 阻斷 IGF-Akt 信號從而阻止心臟肥大的發展，中斷一個促肥大的存活通路。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 IGF-Akt 抑制的上游。這保護心臟免受適應不良生長，SIRT6 敲除小鼠發展心臟肥大，在體內抑制 IGF 信號時被消除。它與 SIRT6 在心血管組織中的抗纖維化作用互補，說明了限制心臟中生長因子信號的重要性。SIRT6 在染色質水平對 c-Jun 依賴性轉錄的共抑制將表觀遺傳控制與心臟重塑聯繫起來。

nodes.label: CD36 Receptor
nodes.description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

nodes.label: Gap Junction
nodes.description: Gap junctions are clusters of connexin-formed intercellular channels that pass ions and small molecules below roughly 1 kDa. This size limit accommodates cGAMP, so cGAMP made by cGAS in one cell can diffuse directly into a neighboring cell through channels such as CX36 and engage STING there without that cell having sensed DNA itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 間隙連接是由連接蛋白（connexin）構成的細胞間通道群，允許離子與分子量約 1 kDa 以下的小分子通過。此大小上限足以容納 cGAMP，因此某一細胞中由 cGAS 製造的 cGAMP 可經由 CX36 等通道直接擴散至鄰近細胞並在該處活化 STING，而無須該細胞自身感知到 DNA。

nodes.label: Bmi-1
nodes.description: Bmi-1 is essential for the self-renewal and maintenance of Cancer Stem Cells, a stemness function that helps explain its oncogenic role: as a core Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 component it silences genes, and its overexpression in breast cancer, lung cancer and leukemia is well documented. Targeting Bmi-1 is therefore a route to deplete the stem-cell compartment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bmi-1 對 Cancer Stem Cells（癌幹細胞）的自我更新與維持至關重要，此幹性功能有助解釋其致癌角色：作為 Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 的核心成分，它負責沉默基因，而它在乳癌、肺癌與白血病中的過度表現已有充分記錄。因此標定 Bmi-1 是清除幹細胞群的一条途徑。

nodes.label: Embryonic Development
nodes.description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

nodes.label: PIKfyve
nodes.description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

nodes.label: Cardiovascular System
nodes.description: In a study of 24 middle-aged companion dogs, echocardiography showed improvements in both diastolic and systolic measures of age-related cardiac function (E/A ratio, fractional shortening, and ejection fraction) in dogs treated with rapamycin. Rapamycin also stimulates the breakdown of damaged cytoplasmic elements, reduces oxidative stress, and supports tissue regeneration in cardiac tissue, and induces production of growth factors IGF1 and VEGF while reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha to support cardiac regeneration after infarction. Cardiovascular diseases are the main cause of death in the elderly, making mTOR inhibitors a promising direction for cardioprotective research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在一項24隻中年伴侶犬的研究中，心臟超音波顯示rapamycin治療的犬隻在年齡相關心臟功能的舒張和收縮指標（E/A比、短縮分數和射血分數）方面有所改善。Rapamycin還刺激受損細胞質成分的分解，減少氧化壓力，並支持心臟組織的組織再生，並誘導生長因子IGF1和VEGF的產生，同時減少IL-1beta和TNF-alpha以支持梗塞後的心臟再生。心血管疾病是老年人的主要死因，使得mTOR抑制劑成為心臟保護研究的一個有前途的方向。

nodes.label: FBXO7
nodes.description: Loss of FBXO7 function reduces Parkin recruitment efficiency, leading to accumulation of damaged mitochondria and increased susceptibility to oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurons. Mutations in PARK15, the gene encoding FBXO7, cause autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson's disease, directly linking FBXO7 dysfunction to impaired mitophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FBXO7 功能喪失會降低 Parkin 的招募效率，造成受損粒線體累積，並使多巴胺神經元更易受到 oxidative stress 影響。編碼 FBXO7 的 PARK15 基因突變會造成體染色體隱性遺傳的早發型 Parkinson's disease，直接將 FBXO7 功能障礙與受損的 mitophagy 連結起來。

nodes.label: flavanone
nodes.description: Flavanone is the saturated C-ring flavonoid subclass lacking the catechol motif. Classification nests it in the flavonoid family.
nodes.description_zh_TW: flavanone 是飽和 C 環的類黃酮亞類，缺乏兒茶酚基序。歸類將其嵌套於類黃酮家族。

nodes.label: SEPHS2
nodes.description: SEPHS2 (selenophosphate synthetase 2) is the entry point of selenium into the amino acid: it converts selenide, derived from dietary selenium, plus ATP into monoselenophosphate, the activated selenium donor used by SepSecS to convert O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec into Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec. SEPHS2 sits upstream of PSTK and SepSecS, and its output gates the whole selenoprotein family — so selenium availability tunes selenoproteome capacity, a link relevant to aging and redox decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SEPHS2（selenophosphate synthetase 2）是硒進入胺基酸的入口：它將源自飲食硒的 selenide 與 ATP 轉為單硒磷酸（monoselenophosphate），即 SepSecS 將 O-磷酸絲胺醯-tRNA[Ser]Sec 轉成 Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec 時所用的活化硒供體。SEPHS2 位於 PSTK 與 SepSecS 上游，其產物控管整個 selenoprotein 家族，因此硒的可利用性可調整 selenoproteome 容量，這與老化及氧化還原衰退相關。

nodes.label: Ruxolitinib
nodes.description: Ruxolitinib is a prototypic Senomorphic Therapy: rather than eliminating senescent cells it suppresses their inflammatory output via JAK–STAT blockade, abrogating secretion of IL-6 and IL-8 and blunting the pro-fibrotic secretome without killing the cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 是典型的 Senomorphic Therapy：它並不清除衰老細胞，而是透過阻斷 JAK–STAT 抑制其發炎輸出，在不殺死細胞的情況下取消 IL-6 與 IL-8 的分泌，並削弱促纖維化分泌體。

nodes.label: LRRK2
nodes.description: Mutations in LRRK2, particularly G2019S, are among the most common genetic causes of familial Parkinson's disease. LRRK2 is a large multi-domain kinase that regulates mitophagy, lysosomal function and vesicle sorting, and pathogenic LRRK2 activity impairs mitophagy — the LRRK2 kinase inhibitor GSK3357679A restores mitophagy defects in LRRK2 G2019S mice, showing that targeting LRRK2 can rescue mitophagy damage in vivo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LRRK2 的突異（尤其是 G2019S）是家族性 Parkinson's disease 最常見的遺傳病因之一。LRRK2 是一種大型多結構域激酶，調節 mitophagy、溶小體功能與囊泡分選，而致病型 LRRK2 活性會損害 mitophagy——LRRK2 激酶抑制劑 GSK3357679A 可在 LRRK2 G2019S 小鼠中恢復 mitophagy 缺損，顯示針對 LRRK2 的標靶可在體內救援 mitophagy 損傷。

nodes.label: PTPN family
nodes.description: PTPN2 (TC-PTP) is a ubiquitously expressed non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase belonging to the PTPN family, distinguished by an N-terminal catalytic domain with the conserved HCxxR motif and a C-terminal tail that directs nuclear/cytoplasmic localization and substrate engagement.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTPN2（TC-PTP）是廣泛表現的非受體型蛋白酪胺酸磷酸酶，屬於 PTPN family，其特徵為帶有保守 HCxxR 基序的 N 端催化區，以及負責核質定位與受質招募的 C 端尾部。

nodes.label: Adherens Junction
nodes.description: E-cadherin is the primary epithelial transmembrane protein of adherens junctions. Containment records the junction composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: E-cadherin 是黏附連接的主要上皮跨膜蛋白。包含記錄連接組成。

nodes.label: ITPR2
nodes.description: The ER calcium release channel ITPR2 is localized at MERCS, where it supplies the calcium that MCU takes up; enhanced ITPR2-mediated release during senescence drives matrix calcium accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 內質網鈣離子釋放通道 ITPR2 定位於 MERCS，在該處供應 MCU 所攝取的鈣離子；衰老期間 ITPR2 媒介的釋放增強，驅動基質鈣累積。

nodes.label: Photobiomodulation
nodes.description: Photobiomodulation uses red and near-infrared light (roughly 600-1000 nm) whose photons are absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria. This accelerates electron transfer and the proton gradient, boosting ATP production and transiently modulating ROS signalling in a hormetic direction, which is why PBM is listed among environmental mitohormetic exposures alongside cold, heat and exercise.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Photobiomodulation 使用紅光與近紅外光（約 600–1000 nm），其光子由粒線體中的 cytochrome c oxidase（Complex IV）吸收。這會加速電子傳遞與質子梯度，提升 ATP 產生，並以 hormesis 方向短暫調節 ROS 訊號；因此 PBM 與寒冷、高溫、運動並列為環境性的 mitohormetic 曝露。

nodes.label: Autolysosome
nodes.description: After degradation, autolysosomes undergo Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, a process that regenerates functional lysosomes from the hybrid organelle. ALR depends on AMPK, mTORC1 reactivation, and clathrin-mediated budding.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 降解完成後，autolysosome 會進行 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation，由該混合胞器再生出可運作的溶酶體。ALR 依賴 AMPK、mTORC1 再活化與 clathrin 媒介的出芽。

nodes.label: Toren Finkel
nodes.description: Toren Finkel is best known for co-developing the mitohormesis concept with Jeanho Yun, published as a landmark 2014 Cell Metabolism review. The work established that low-level mitochondrial perturbation triggers compensatory transcriptional and metabolic programs operating through the mitochondrial unfolded protein response and SKN-1/NRF2 signaling, shifting the paradigm from viewing mitochondrial dysfunction solely as pathogenic.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Toren Finkel 最廣為人知的是與 Jeanho Yun 共同提出 mitohormesis 概念，成果發表為 2014 年《Cell Metabolism》的里程碑式回顧論文。該研究確立低程度的粒線體擾動會經由 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 與 SKN-1/NRF2 訊號啟動代償性轉錄與代謝程式，扭轉了將粒線體功能障礙僅視為致病因素的典範。

nodes.label: Nudix Hydrolases
nodes.description: Nudix Hydrolases (NUDT family, e.g. NUDT5/NUDT9-type ADPR pyrophosphatases) cleave the phosphodiester bond of free ADP-ribose, producing AMP and ribose-5-phosphate (R5P). In Parthanatos they sit downstream of PARG and ARH3, converting the PAR-catabolism product ADP-ribose into both a metabolic signal (AMP) and salvage substrates (R5P).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nudix 水解酶（Nudix Hydrolases，NUDT 家族，例如 NUDT5/NUDT9 型 ADPR 焦磷酸酶）切割游離 ADP-ribose 的磷酸二酯鍵，產生 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸（R5P）。在 parthanatos 中，它們位於 PARG 與 ARH3 下游，將 PAR 分解產物 ADP-ribose 同時轉成代謝訊號（AMP）與補救合成受質（R5P）。

nodes.label: Lamivudine
nodes.description: Lamivudine (3TC) is a cytidine nucleoside analogue that, after phosphorylation to its triphosphate form, competes with dCTP and terminates cDNA chain elongation. The same inhibitory principle applies to the endogenous reverse transcriptase encoded by autonomous LINE-1 retroelements, which is why lamivudine acts as a senomorphic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lamivudine（3TC）是胞苷核苷類似物，磷酸化為三磷酸型後與 dCTP 競爭並終止 cDNA 鏈延長。相同的抑制原理也適用於自主性 LINE-1 反轉錄子所編碼的內源性反轉錄酶，因此 lamivudine 可作為 senomorphic 藥物。

nodes.label: Tauopathy
nodes.description: Pathogenic tau activates microglial NF-κB signaling, inducing a transcriptional program that alters tau handling and promotes release of seed-competent tau species. Genetic inhibition of microglial NF-κB traps tau intracellularly and markedly reduces extracellular tau seeding and in vivo propagation, establishing NF-κB as a key regulator of microglial tau export.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 致病性 tau 會活化微膠細胞的 NF-κB 訊號，誘導一套轉錄程式，改變 tau 的處理方式並促進具播種能力的 tau 物種釋放。對微膠細胞 NF-κB 的遺傳性抑制會將 tau 困在細胞內，顯著降低細胞外 tau 的播種與體內傳播，確立 NF-κB 為微膠細胞 tau 輸出的關鍵調節因子。

nodes.label: Dietary AGE Restriction
nodes.description: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
nodes.description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。
nodes.norm_label: nobel prize in physiology or medicine

nodes.label: Fas
nodes.description: FasL (Fas ligand, CD95L/CD178, TNFSF6) is a type II transmembrane protein of the TNF superfamily that binds the Fas receptor (CD95/APO-1). Trimerization upon receptor binding clusters Fas and recruits the adaptor FADD and procaspase-8 to form the DISC.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FasL（Fas ligand，CD95L／CD178，TNFSF6）是 TNF 超家族的第二型跨膜蛋白，與 Fas 受體（CD95／APO-1）結合。受體結合後 FasL 三聚化使 Fas 聚集，並招募轉接蛋白 FADD 與 procaspase-8 形成 DISC。

nodes.label: NRTI
nodes.description: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, developed as antiretroviral drugs for HIV, also inhibit LINE-1 retrotransposition. NRTIs act as chain-terminating nucleoside analogs that are incorporated into nascent DNA by reverse transcriptase, halting the synthesis of the L1 cDNA copies that would otherwise be generated from L1 RNA in the cytoplasm. By blocking LINE-1 reverse transcription, NRTIs reduce the cGAS-STING-dependent inflammation and SASP that arise from retrotransposon derepression during aging, and they are being explored as anti-aging interventions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑是作為 HIV 抗逆轉錄病毒藥物而開發的，也能抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座。 NRTI 充當鏈終止核苷類似物，透過逆轉錄酶將其摻入新生 DNA 中，從而停止 L1 cDNA 副本的合成，否則這些副本將由細胞質中的 L1 RNA 產生。透過阻斷 LINE-1 逆轉錄，NRTI 可以減少 cGAS-STING 依賴性發炎和老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子去抑制引起的 SASP，並且它們正在被探索作為抗衰老幹預措施。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

nodes.label: Esophageal Cancer
nodes.description: The metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma cascade from Barrett's esophagus to adenocarcinoma is textbook.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Barrett 食道至腺癌的化生—異生—癌級聯是教科書等級。

nodes.label: Bipolar II Disorder
nodes.description: Bipolar II Disorder is characterized by the occurrence of at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode, with hypomania representing a less severe form of mania that does not cause marked functional impairment or psychosis and does not require hospitalization. The depressive phases typically predominate in duration and disability, making depression the major source of impairment. Genetic variants including COMT and MTHFR have been explored as contributors to susceptibility through effects on catecholamine and methyl metabolism, though the associations are modest. The disorder is distinguished from Bipolar I by the absence of full manic episodes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bipolar II Disorder的特徵是發生至少一次輕躁症發作和至少一次重度憂鬱發作，輕躁症代表一種不太嚴重的躁狂形式，不會引起明顯的功能障礙或精神病，並且不需要住院治療。憂鬱階段通常在持續時間和殘疾方面占主導地位，這使得憂鬱症成為損害的主要來源。包括 COMT 和 MTHFR 在內的遺傳變異已被探索為透過影響兒茶酚胺和甲基代謝而導致易感性的因素，儘管這種關聯性不大。此疾病與 I 型雙極性情感疾患的差異在於不存在完全的躁症發作。

nodes.label: elevated homocysteine
nodes.description: Several MTHFD1 polymorphisms, such as the G1958A/R653Q missense variant, have been associated with altered enzyme kinetics and biomarkers of impaired folate metabolism. These variants are linked to elevated homocysteine and modified risk for neural tube defects and certain cancers. As with MTHFR, they can reduce the efficiency of methyl-group provision.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 若干 MTHFD1 多態性，例如 G1958A/R653Q 錯義變異，已與改變的酶動力學和葉酸代謝受損的生物標記相關。這些變異與 elevated homocysteine 以及神經管缺陷和某些癌症的風險改變有關。與 MTHFR 一樣，它們會降低甲基供給的效率。

nodes.label: Heme
nodes.description: Heme triggers a characteristic TRIM response with H3K27ac remodeling through SYK-dependent ROS generation rather than oxidative chemistry alone. Unlike oxLDL or HMGB1 training, heme training is mTOR-independent: rapamycin has no effect, while SYK inhibition with R406 blocks training. It defines an alternative DAMP-to-chromatin route.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Heme 透過 SYK-dependent ROS generation 而非僅靠氧化化學性質，觸發帶有 H3K27ac 重塑的典型 TRIM 反應。與 Oxidized LDL 或 HMGB1 訓練不同，Heme 訓練是 mTOR-independent：rapamycin 無效，而以 R406 抑制 SYK 可阻斷訓練。它定義了一條替代性的 DAMP-to-chromatin 路徑。

nodes.label: SIRT2 inhibition
nodes.description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

nodes.label: Trichuris
nodes.description: Trichuriasis (whipworm infection) is a soil-transmitted helminth infection of the large intestine caused by the nematode Trichuris trichiura. Adult worms anchor their thin anterior ends in the colonic mucosa, and heavy burdens in children produce Trichuris dysentery syndrome with bloody diarrhea, growth stunting and rectal prolapse.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 鞭蟲病（ whipworm infection ）是由線蟲 Trichuris trichiura 所引起的大腸土壤傳播蠕蟲感染。成蟲以細長的前端固定於結腸黏膜，重度感染（多見於兒童）會造成鞭蟲痢疾症候群，表現為血性腹瀉、生長遲緩與直腸脫垂。

nodes.label: Milton
nodes.description: Disruption of the MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin axis, as occurs with MFN2 mutations causing Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, impairs axonal mitochondrial transport and underlies the resulting peripheral neuropathy and axonal degeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MFN2 突變造成 Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A 時，MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin 軸受破壞，軸突粒線體運輸受損，並構成周邊神經病變與軸突退化的基礎。

nodes.label: isp-1
nodes.description: isp-1 (Iron-Sulfur Protein 1) is a Caenorhabditis elegans gene encoding a subunit of mitochondrial complex III (ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase), the iron-sulfur containing core of the electron transport chain. Its reduction of mitochondrial respiration is the initiating lesion behind the gene's lifespan phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: isp-1（Iron-Sulfur Protein 1）是 Caenorhabditis elegans 的一個基因，編碼粒線體 Complex III（ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase）的次單元，該複合體是電子傳遞鏈含鐵硫的核心。其對粒線體呼吸的抑制是該基因壽命表型背後的起始病變。

nodes.label: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors
nodes.description: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors block the serotonin transporter (and the norepinephrine transporter), raising synaptic Serotonin and Norepinephrine; this dual action is exploited in depression, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors 阻斷 serotonin 轉運蛋白（以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白），提高突觸內的 Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine；此雙重作用被應用於憂鬱症、廣泛性焦慮症、糖尿病神經病變疼痛與纖維肌痛。

nodes.label: HSP90β
nodes.description: HSP90β functions as an Apaf-1 inhibitor: it binds Apaf-1 and suppresses its nucleotide-dependent oligomerization, holding Apaf-1 in an inactive monomeric state. In BCR-ABL-driven tyrosine kinase leukemias this anti-death role restrains apoptosome formation, and it explains why HSP90 inhibition can unleash mitochondrial apoptosis selectively in malignant cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HSP90β 扮演 Apaf-1 抑制劑的角色：它與 Apaf-1 結合並抑制其依核苷酸的寡聚化，使 Apaf-1 維持在不活化的單體狀態。在 BCR-ABL 驅動的 tyrosine kinase 白血病中，這種抗死亡作用限制了 apoptosome 的形成，也解釋了為何 HSP90 抑制能選擇性地在惡性細胞中釋放粒線體 apoptosis。

nodes.label: Sodium nitrite
nodes.description: Sodium nitrite is the proximal methemoglobin-forming agent in the nitrate/nitrite family, oxidizing the ferrous (Fe2+) heme iron of Hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. Ingested nitrate is first reduced by oral and gut microbiota to nitrite, which is then absorbed and delivers the oxidative hit to the heme carrier.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite 是硝酸鹽／亞硝酸鹽家族中最直接造成methemoglobin形成的物質，將 Hemoglobin 血基質中的亞鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。摄入的硝酸鹽先經口腔與腸道菌群還原為亞硝酸鹽，後者被吸收後對血基質載體造成氧化傷害。

nodes.label: Focal Adhesion
nodes.description: Integrins are the transmembrane ECM receptors of focal adhesions. Containment records the adhesion composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Integrin 是黏著斑的跨膜 ECM 受體。包含記錄黏附組成。

nodes.label: SWI-SNF
nodes.description: SWI/SNF (mammalian BAF) complexes perform ATP-dependent nucleosome remodeling using their BRG1/BRM ATPase subunits. The ATPase hydrolyzes energy to slide, reposition, or evict nucleosomes, opening promoters and enhancers to control access of transcriptional machinery — making SWI-SNF the catalytic engine of nucleosome remodeling rather than merely a structural component.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SWI/SNF（哺乳類 BAF）複合體以其 BRG1/BRM ATPase 次單元執行 ATP 依賴性的核小體重塑。ATPase 水解能量以滑動、重新定位或驅逐核小體，開放 promoter 與 enhancer，控制轉錄機器的可及性——因此 SWI-SNF 是核小體重塑的催化引擎，而不只是結構性成分。

nodes.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
nodes.description: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combining the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, Vincristine and prednisone. It serves as the conventional comparator against which alternative or repurposed approaches are framed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: R-CHOP 是 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 的標準一線治療方案，將抗 CD20 抗體 rituximab 與 cyclophosphamide、doxorubicin、Vincristine 及 prednisone 合併。它也是評估替代或再定位療法時的常規對照基準。

nodes.label: TRADD
nodes.description: TRADD nucleates FADD/Complex II assembly leading to caspase-8 activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRADD 使 FADD/Complex II 組裝成核，導致 caspase-8 活化。

nodes.label: MTHFR
nodes.description: Folinic acid (5-formyltetrahydrofolate) bypasses the MTHFR enzyme because it enters folate metabolism downstream of the MTHFR-catalyzed reduction step, requiring conversion by other enzymes to 5-methyl-THF without direct MTHFR dependence. This makes it useful for individuals with MTHFR variants who cannot efficiently generate methylfolate from folic acid or 5,10-methylene-THF. It provides methyl groups for the cycle without relying on the impaired enzymatic step. It is a common alternative in personalized methylation support protocols.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Folinic acid（5-甲醯四氫葉酸）繞過 MTHFR 酶，因為它進入 MTHFR 催化還原步驟下游的 folate 代謝，需要其他酶轉化為 5-甲基-THF，而不直接依賴 MTHFR。這使得它對於患有 MTHFR variants 且無法有效地從葉酸或 5,10-亞甲基-THF 生成甲基葉酸的個體非常有用。它為循環提供 methyl groups，而不依賴受損的酶促步驟。它是個人化甲基化支持方案中的常見替代方案。

nodes.label: Benzocaine
nodes.description: Benzocaine is an ester-type local anaesthetic used in over-the-counter teething gels, topical sprays and sunburn remedies, and it is a well-recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia. Even modest systemic absorption — especially in infants, with mucosal application or at high doses — can produce cyanosis, chocolate-coloured blood and hypoxia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Benzocaine 是非處方牙膠、外用噴劑與防曬製劑中常用的酯類局部麻醉藥，也是後天性 Methemoglobinemia 的公認病因。即使只有有限的全身吸收——在嬰兒、黏膜給藥或高劑量時尤其明顯——也可能造成發紺、巧克力色血液與低血氧。

nodes.label: Isobutyl nitrite
nodes.description: Isobutyl nitrite is a volatile alkyl nitrite ('poppers') whose nitrite species oxidize the ferrous (Fe2+) iron of hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. The resulting methemoglobin cannot bind or transport oxygen, so nitrite-driven one-electron oxidation of heme iron is the shared chemical basis for isobutyl nitrite toxicity and, in parallel, for the redox/autoxidation chemistry of catecholamine quinones.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Isobutyl nitrite 是一種易揮發的烷基亞硝酸酯（「poppers」），其亞硝酸鹽物種可將血基質的鐵由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。所形成的 methemoglobin 無法結合或運送氧氣，因此亞硝酸鹽驅動的單電子血基質氧化，正是 isobutyl nitrite 毒性的化學基礎，也與兒茶酚胺醌類的氧化／自氧化化學平行。

nodes.label: Amyl nitrite
nodes.description: Amyl nitrite intentionally oxidizes hemoglobin iron from Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, creating methemoglobin that scavenges cyanide as cyanmethemoglobin and spares mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase — the mechanism behind its historical use in cyanide poisoning. The same oxidation causes methemoglobinemia, cyanosis and hypoxia on overuse.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amyl nitrite 會將 Hemoglobin 的鐵由 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，形成 Methemoglobin，以 cyanmethemoglobin 形式螯合氰化物並保護粒線體 cytochrome oxidase——這是其在氰化物中毒中歷史性用途的機制。相同的氧化在過量使用時會造成 Methemoglobinemia、Cyanosis 與 Hypoxia。

nodes.label: Beta-TrCP
nodes.description: Beta-TrCP ubiquitinates IkappaBalpha, whose destruction activates NF-kB.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Beta-TrCP 泛素化 IkappaBalpha，其破壞活化 NF-κB。

nodes.label: miR-29b
nodes.description: miR-29b directly targets pro-survival Mcl-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: miR-29b 直接標靶促存活 Mcl-1。

nodes.label: Redox Optimization
nodes.description: Redox Optimization is the active maintenance side of the Redox Battery concept: the deliberate upkeep of cellular reducing potential while processing redox-active indolequinones. It targets the NAD+/NADH and Glutathione (GSH/GSSG) buffering capacity, monitoring the GSH/GSSG ratio and NAD+/NADH balance and adjusting them as catecholamine load and quinone flux change, keeping the reservable reducing-equivalent reserve charged.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Redox Optimization 是 Redox Battery 概念中「維持」的一面：在處理氧化還原活性 indolequinone 時主動維持細胞還原勢能。它以 NAD+/NADH 與 Glutathione（GSH/GSSG）的緩衝容量為目標，依兒茶酚胺負荷與醌通量的變化監測 GSH/GSSG 比值與 NAD+/NADH 平衡，使可儲備的還原等量物儲備維持在「充電」狀態。

nodes.label: catechol flavonoid
nodes.description: Fisetin is a catechol-containing flavonoid, a flavonol found in fruits and vegetables such as strawberries and apples, and its catechol ring makes it both a substrate for and a potential inhibitor of COMT. As a dietary catechol, it is O-methylated by COMT during metabolism, linking its pharmacokinetics to COMT genotype. At high supplemental doses it can compete with endogenous catechols for the enzyme, though physiological dietary intake is generally modest. It is studied for its antioxidant, senolytic, and neuroprotective properties.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種含兒茶酚的黃酮類化合物，是一種存在於草莓和蘋果等水果和蔬菜中的黃酮醇，其兒茶酚環使其既是 COMT 的底物，又是 COMT 的潛在抑制劑。作為一種膳食兒茶酚，它在代謝過程中被 COMT O-甲基化，從而將其藥物動力學與 COMT genotype 聯繫起來。在高補充劑量下，它可以與內源性兒茶酚競爭酶，儘管生理飲食攝取量通常是適度的。人們對其抗氧化劑、senolytic 和 neuroprotective properties 進行了研究。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

nodes.label: Glucose Oxidase
nodes.description: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Translation
nodes.description: Human mtDNA encodes 13 Oxidative Phosphorylation subunits among 22 tRNAs and 2 rRNAs; because these subunits are needed to assemble the respiratory chain, organelle-autonomous Mitochondrial Translation is a rate-limiting step for bioenergetic function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 人類 mtDNA 在 22 個 tRNA 與 2 個 rRNA 之外還編碼 13 個 Oxidative Phosphorylation 次單元；由於這些次單元是組裝呼吸鏈所必需，胞器自主的 Mitochondrial Translation 是生物能量功能的速率限制步驟。

nodes.label: MitoStores
nodes.description: MitoStores are cytosolic granules that act as temporary storage depots for mitochondrial precursor proteins when import into mitochondria is impaired or saturated, part of the triage system for mPOS (mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress). Chaperone-bound precursors are held in an import-competent state, preventing their aggregation and cytosolic proteotoxicity until import capacity is restored.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MitoStores 是細胞質顆粒，在粒線體 precursor protein 的輸入受損或飽和時作為暫時儲存庫，屬於 mPOS（粒線體 precursor 過度累積壓力）的分流系統。Chaperone 結合的 precursor 以可輸入狀態被保存，避免聚集與細胞質 proteotoxicity，待輸入能力恢復後再釋放至粒線體。

nodes.label: Drug Resistance
nodes.description: Drug Resistance in oncology describes diminished efficacy of cytotoxic or targeted agents over time, driven by efflux pumps, DNA-repair upregulation, metabolic reprogramming, and microenvironmental factors. A key contributor is the acidic, lactate-rich Tumor Microenvironment produced by Glycolysis, which promotes resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腫瘤學中的 Drug Resistance 指細胞毒性或標靶藥物效能在時間推移下降低，由幫浦外排、DNA 修補上調、代謝重編程與微環境因素共同驅動。關鍵促成因子是由 Glycolysis 產生的酸性、乳酸-rich 的 Tumor Microenvironment，它會促進抗藥性。

nodes.label: Nuclear Pore Complex
nodes.description: Lamin A, together with lamin C and the B-type lamins, forms the nuclear lamina meshwork underlying the inner nuclear membrane. By anchoring the Nuclear Pore Complex it provides mechanical support to the nucleus and helps organize Chromatin into lamina-associated domains.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lamin A 與 lamin C 及 B 型 lamin 共同構成內核膜下的核纖層網狀結構。它藉由錨定 Nuclear Pore Complex 為細胞核提供機械支撐，並將 Chromatin 組織成核纖層相關結構域（LADs）。

nodes.label: GLUT1
nodes.description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to GLUT1 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. GLUT1 is a high-capacity glucose transporter markedly upregulated on the tumor-cell surface to feed the glycolytic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 GLUT1 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 GLUT1 是一種高容量葡萄糖轉運蛋白，在腫瘤細胞表面顯著上調以供給糖解表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

nodes.label: JNK2
nodes.description: JNK2 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, inactivating it during G2 arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL，在 G2 停滯使其失活。

nodes.label: PTPN23
nodes.description: PTPN23 (HD-PTP) is a PTPN family member distinguished from other members by an N-terminal Bro1 domain that links it to CHMP proteins of the ESCRT-III complex and to ubiquitinated cargo, allowing the phosphatase domain to couple death signalling to endosomal sorting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTPN23（HD-PTP）是 PTPN family 的成員，與其他成員不同的是它帶有 N 端 Bro1 結構域，可連結 ESCRT-III 複合體的 CHMP 蛋白與泛素化貨載，使磷酸酶區域能把死亡訊號與內體分選串接起來。

nodes.label: ABCD1
nodes.description: Genetic defects in the transporter ABCD1 impair peroxisomal beta-oxidation, leading to toxic accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids and severe metabolic diseases such as Zellweger syndrome and Adrenoleukodystrophy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 運輸蛋白 ABCD1 的基因缺陷會損害過氧化體的 beta-oxidation，導致 very long-chain fatty acids 毒性累積，並造成 Zellweger syndrome 與 Adrenoleukodystrophy 等嚴重代謝疾病。

nodes.label: Interleukin 1β
nodes.description: Caspase-1 is the effector protease of the inflammasome pathway: when activated by the NLRP3 inflammasome (or by the AIM2 inflammasome via ASC specks), it proteolytically cleaves Interleukin 1β from its inactive precursor into its mature, secreted, active form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-1 是發炎小體路徑的效應蛋白酶：當它被 NLRP3 Inflammasome（或經由 ASC 斑塊的 AIM2 Inflammasome）活化時，會將 Interleukin 1β 由不活性前驅物蛋白水解切割成成熟、可分泌的活性形式。

nodes.label: Type 2 Diabetes
nodes.description: SIRT3 is consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, with deficiency correlating with insulin resistance and disturbed systemic energy homeostasis. In skeletal muscle, SIRT3 deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance and contributing to type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗和全身能量代謝失調相關。在骨骼肌中，SIRT3 缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重周邊胰島素阻抗並促進第 2 型糖尿病的病理生理學。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: PEX3
nodes.description: PEX3 encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein required for correct folding and transport of many other peroxins into the peroxisome membrane, acting as an essential building block of the Peroxisome Biogenesis Network. Loss of function leaves misfolded proteins that accumulate and disrupt membrane integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX3 編碼過氧化體膜蛋白，負責許多其他 peroxin 正確摺疊並運送至過氧化體膜，是 Peroxisome Biogenesis Network 的必要組成。功能喪失會留下累積的錯誤摺疊蛋白，破壞膜完整性。

nodes.label: 53BP1
nodes.description: 53BP1 is recruited to DNA double-strand break sites through cooperative recognition of the histone marks H4K20me2 and H2AK15ub, a localization step that is stabilized by interaction with γ-H2AX via the MDC1 mediator. This makes 53BP1 a downstream chromatin scaffold that converts the γ-H2AX damage signal into a repair-pathway commitment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 53BP1 透過協同辨識組蛋白標記 H4K20me2 與 H2AK15ub 被招募到 DNA 雙股斷裂（DSB）位點，此定位步驟再由 MDC1 媒介與 γ-H2AX 的交互作用加以穩定。這使 53BP1 成為下游的染色質支架，把 γ-H2AX 的損傷訊號轉為修復途徑的選擇。

nodes.label: TRIM21
nodes.description: TRIM21 directly interacts with RIPK1 and ubiquitinates it through its RING domain, regulating antiviral immunity and autoimmunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRIM21直接與RIPK1交互作用，並透過其RING結構域泛素化RIPK1，調控抗病毒免疫與自體免疫。

nodes.label: Circadian Rhythm
nodes.description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting NAD+ salvage enzyme and a transcriptional target of BMAL1/CLOCK. By generating rhythmic NAD+ oscillations it closes the SIRT1 circadian loop, gating SIRT1 activity and thereby setting the timing of downstream clock-controlled output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ salvage 途徑的速率限制酵素，同時是 BMAL1/CLOCK 的轉錄標的。藉由產生節律性的 NAD+ 振盪，它閉合了 SIRT1 的晝夜迴路，門控 SIRT1 活性並因而設定下游時鐘受控輸出的時序。

nodes.label: Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation
nodes.description: The CLEAR network is a master transcriptional program orchestrated by the MiT/TFE factors TFEB and TFE3, which bind CLEAR elements (GTCACGTGAC) in promoters of lysosomal hydrolases, v-ATPase and autophagic genes. CLEAR therefore drives Lysosome Biogenesis so that lysosomal capacity scales with autophagic demand; diminished TFEB/CLEAR activity with age contributes to lysosomal storage and aggregation disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網絡是由 MiT/TFE 因子（主要為 TFEB 與 TFE3）統籌的主控轉錄程式，這些因子結合於溶小體水解酵素、v-ATPase 與自噬基因啟動子上的 CLEAR 元素（GTCACGTGAC）。因此 CLEAR 驅動 Lysosome Biogenesis，使溶小體容量隨自噬需求擴張；隨年齡下降的 TFEB/CLEAR 活性則促成溶小體儲積與聚集疾病。

nodes.label: Puma
nodes.description: Bcl-2 family includes Puma. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Puma。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: PP1α
nodes.description: PP1α is the alpha catalytic isoform of PP1, encoded by PPP1CA. Like all PP1 isoforms it carries the conserved PP1 catalytic fold with a beta12-alphaC loop binding two Mn2+/Fe2+ ions, but its substrate specificity comes from associated regulatory proteins recognizing RVxF motifs rather than from the catalytic core itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PP1α 是 PP1 的 alpha 催化異型，由 PPP1CA 編碼。與所有 PP1 異型相同，它帶有保守的 PP1 催化摺疊，其 beta12-alphaC 迴圈結合兩個 Mn2+/Fe2+ 離子；但其受質專一性來自辨識 RVxF 基序的結合調節蛋白，而非催化核心本身。

nodes.label: Oxyhemoglobin
nodes.description: Oxyhemoglobin is one of the hemoglobin fractions directly resolved by multiwavelength co-oximetry. Because specimens should be analysed promptly or kept cold and protected from air, artifactual changes in the oxy/methemoglobin ratio can otherwise confound the reported result.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin 是多波長 Co-oximetry 直接解析的 Hemoglobin 分部之一。由於檢體應儘速分析或冷藏並避免接觸空氣，否則 oxy／methemoglobin 比例的人為變化會混淆報告結果。

nodes.label: RAW264.7
nodes.description: RAW264.7 is an immortalized mouse macrophage cell line derived from an ascitic tumor induced by Abelson murine leukemia virus in a male BALB/c mouse, established in 1978. It carries v-Abl transformant sequences and retains many primary macrophage functions, including Fc receptor-mediated phagocytosis, cytokine secretion and nitric oxide production upon LPS/IFN-gamma stimulation, and can be polarized toward M1 or M2 phenotypes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RAW264.7 是源自雄性 BALB/c 小鼠中 Abelson 鼠白血病病毒誘發的腹水腫瘤之永生化小鼠巨噬細胞株，建立於 1978 年。它帶有 v-Abl 轉位序列，並保留許多原代巨噬細胞功能，包括 Fc 受體媒介的吞噬作用、細胞激素分泌，以及在 LPS／IFN-γ 刺激下的一氧化氮生成，且可被極化為 M1 或 M2 表型。

nodes.label: SKN-1
nodes.description: SKN-1 is the Caenorhabditis elegans ortholog of mammalian NRF2, a cap'n'collar basic leucine zipper transcription factor governing the conserved antioxidant and detoxification response. Under basal conditions SKN-1 is retained in the cytoplasm by the BTB–Kelch repressor WDR-23, the homolog of Keap1; upon oxidative or electrophilic insult the repressor is inactivated and SKN-1 translocates to the nucleus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SKN-1 是哺乳類 NRF2 在 *Caenorhabditis elegans* 的直系同源物，屬於 cap'n'collar 型基本白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，調控保守的抗氧化與解毒反應。在基礎狀態下 SKN-1 受 BTB–Kelch 抑制蛋白 WDR-23（Keap1 的同源物）扣留於細胞質；遭遇氧化或親電性攻擊時抑制蛋白失活，SKN-1 轉位至細胞核。

nodes.label: UTY
nodes.description: UTY (KDM6C) is the Y-chromosome homolog of the X-linked H3K27 demethylase KDM6A (UTX). Unlike KDM6A it has no catalytic H3K27 demethylase activity, yet retains non-catalytic tumor-suppressor function and partially compensates for KDM6A loss in males — males with KDM6A LOF plus mosaic chrY loss lose that backup.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UTY（KDM6C）是 X 聯結的 H3K27 去甲基化酵素 KDM6A（UTX）的 Y 染色體同源物。與 KDM6A 不同，UTY 不具催化性 H3K27 去甲基化活性，但保有非催化性的腫瘤抑制功能，並在男性中部分補償 KDM6A 缺失——KDM6A 功能喪失合併嵌合性 Y 染色體流失的男性即失去此備援。

nodes.label: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1
nodes.description: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1, encoded by BANF1) is a small, highly conserved chromatin-associated protein that binds DNA, histones and components of the nuclear envelope, helping maintain nuclear architecture and envelope integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1（BAF1，由 BANF1 編碼）是一種小型且高度保守的染色質相關蛋白，可結合 DNA、組蛋白與核膜的組成成分，協助維持核架構與核膜完整性。

nodes.label: Glutathione Reductase
nodes.description: Glutathione reductase regenerates the reduced glutathione pool by reducing GSSG to two GSH at the expense of NADPH, coupling glutathione peroxidase activity to the pentose phosphate pathway. Without it the GPx/GSSG cycle cannot be sustained, and glycation impairs its function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutathione reductase 以 NADPH 為代價將 GSSG 還原為兩個 GSH，再生還原型 glutathione 庫，將 glutathione peroxidase 活性與 pentose phosphate pathway 耦合。若缺乏此酵素，GPx/GSSG cycle 無法持續，且 glycation 會損害其功能。

nodes.label: S6K1/2
nodes.description: S6K1/2 are primary downstream effectors of mTORC1, and rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 suppresses S6K1/2 activity. This places S6K1/2 on the rapamycin-sensitive axis regulating protein synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S6K1/2 是 mTORC1 的主要下游效應器，rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會壓制 S6K1/2 活性。這使 S6K1/2 位於調控蛋白質合成的 rapamycin 敏感軸上。

nodes.label: Eosinophils
nodes.description: Peripheral blood eosinophilia — an expansion of circulating eosinophils — is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia（循環中 eosinophils 的擴增）是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

nodes.label: Aerobic Capacity
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

nodes.label: Topologically Associating Domain
nodes.description: Enhancer-promoter looping is regulated within topologically associating domains, the megabase-scale compartments in which DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside. Because TADs confine enhancer-promoter contacts, genes are typically regulated by enhancers located within the same domain, and three-dimensional looping brings these regulatory elements into proximity with their target promoters. This organization allows the SASP to be driven by hyper-connected enhancer-promoter networks whose interactions are restructured during senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環在拓撲關聯域（兆鹼基級的區室）內受到調節，其中DNA序列彼此之間的相互作用比與外部序列之間的相互作用更頻繁。由於 TAD 限制了增強子-啟動子接觸，因此基因通常受到位於同一結構域內的增強子的調節，並且三維環使這些調節元件與其目標啟動子接近。這種組織允許 SASP 由超連接的增強子-啟動子網路驅動，其相互作用在老化過程中被重組。

nodes.label: CDKN1B
nodes.description: The CDK inhibitor p27 (CDKN1B) binds and inhibits Cyclin E-CDK2 to enforce G1 arrest and quiescence, preventing premature firing of replication origins. Cyclin E activity is otherwise induced downstream of Cyclin D-CDK4/6 signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27（CDKN1B）結合並抑制 Cyclin E-CDK2，以維持 G1 停滯與 quiescence，防止複製起始點被提早啟動。Cyclin E 的活性則在 Cyclin D-CDK4/6 訊號下游被誘導。

nodes.label: SOCS3
nodes.description: SOCS3 is a classic negative-feedback regulator of cytokine signaling. It is itself induced downstream of JAK/STAT3 activity and then feeds back to inhibit JAK/STAT signaling, including potent attenuation of interferon-gamma and IL-6 responses, acting through its central SH2 domain on phosphorylated receptor tyrosines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SOCS3 是細胞激素訊息傳遞的典型負回饋調節因子。它本身由 JAK/STAT3 活性下游誘導，接著回頭抑制 JAK/STAT 訊息傳遞，包括對 interferon-gamma 與 IL-6 反應的強烈削弱；其作用經由中央 SH2 結構域辨識受體上的磷酸化酪胺酸殘基。

nodes.label: BAFF
nodes.description: BAFF binds three TNF-receptor superfamily members — BAFF-R, BCMA and TACI — with distinct affinities; BAFF-R engages TRAF3→NIK to activate the non-canonical NF-κB pathway plus canonical NF-κB, MAPK and PI3K/Akt, promoting B-cell survival, maturation and immunoglobulin class-switching.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BAFF 會以不同親和力結合三個 TNF 受體超家族成員——BAFF-R、BCMA 與 TACI；BAFF-R 透過 TRAF3→NIK 活化非典型 NF-κB 途徑，並同時涉及典型 NF-κB、MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt，促進 B 細胞存活、成熟與免疫球蛋白類別轉換。

nodes.label: Cyclin E
nodes.description: Cyclin E binds CDK2 to drive the G1-to-S transition: Cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates retinoblastoma protein, completes E2F release, and fires replication origins. Cyclin E is degraded after S-phase entry by SCF-Fbw7 ubiquitination, and impaired turnover causes replication stress and genomic instability; CCNE1 amplification in ovarian, endometrial and triple-negative breast cancer confers CDK2 dependence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin E 與 CDK2 結合以驅動 G1 到 S 的轉換：Cyclin E-CDK2 磷酸化 Retinoblastoma Protein、完成 E2F 釋放並啟動複製起始點。Cyclin E 在 S 期進入後由 SCF-Fbw7 泛素化降解，降解受阻會造成複製壓力與基因體不穩定；CCNE1 在卵巢癌、子宮內膜癌與三陰性乳癌中的放大使腫瘤依賴 CDK2。

nodes.label: G3BP1
nodes.description: G3BP1 is the principal stress-granule scaffold and acts as a cofactor for cGAS: in senescent cells it binds DNA-coated cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and promotes cGAS oligomerization and stable engagement with double-stranded DNA, lowering the activation threshold for cGAS-STING signaling and hence the type-I interferon and NF-kB arms of the SASP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G3BP1 是主要的 stress granule 支架蛋白，並作為 cGAS 的輔因子：在衰老細胞中，它結合被 DNA 包覆的細胞質染色質碎片，促進 cGAS 寡聚化並與雙股 DNA 穩定結合，降低 cGAS-STING 訊號的活化門檻，進而影響 SASP 的第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 分支。

nodes.label: SK61_2
nodes.description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

nodes.label: Epacadostat
nodes.description: By blocking IDO1-mediated tryptophan catabolism, epacadostat suppresses kynurenine production and relieves IDO1-driven immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment. Compensatory upregulation of TDO and IDO2 can drive resistance to this blockade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Epacadostat 藉由阻斷 IDO1 介導的 tryptophan 分解代謝，抑制 kynurenine 生成並解除 tumor microenvironment 中由 IDO1 造成的免疫抑制。TDO 與 IDO2 的代償性上升則可能造成對此阻斷的抗藥性。

nodes.label: FOLFIRI
nodes.description: FOLFIRI is a primary systemic regimen for colorectal cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FOLFIRI 是結直腸癌主要全身性方案。

nodes.label: LGG-2
nodes.description: LGG-2 is one of the C. elegans orthologues of the yeast Atg8 and mammalian LC3/GABARAP proteins. As the Atg8 family ortholog of GABARAP, LGG-2 performs the membrane-tethering role that mammalian GABARAP plays in autophagosome formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LGG-2 是酵母 Atg8 與哺乳類 LC3/GABARAP 在 C. elegans 中的直系同源物之一。作為 GABARAP 的 Atg8 家族直系同源物，LGG-2 執行哺乳類 GABARAP 在 autophagosome 形成中所扮演的膜繫留角色。

nodes.label: Senolytic Paradox
nodes.description: The senolytic paradox arises because oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) arrests BRAF/RAS/MYC-driven cells in a benign lesion as a cell-autonomous fail-safe enforced by p53, p16INK4A and RB1. Clearing those OIS cells removes a cancer barrier rather than a risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Senolytic paradox 之所以出現，是因為 oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) 以 p53、p16INK4A 與 RB1 為基礎，細胞自主地將帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 驅動突變的細胞阻滯在良性病灶中。清除這些 OIS 細胞等於移除一道癌症屏障，而非移除風險。

nodes.label: BH3 profiling
nodes.description: BH3 profiling reports dependence on specific anti-apoptotic proteins, with the Noxa BH3 peptide selectively binding Mcl-1 so that a strong Noxa response identifies Mcl-1 dependence. That dependency readout is used to select candidates for Mcl-1 inhibitors such as AMG 176 and S63845, and high Mcl-1 expression is a major mechanism of venetoclax resistance that this assay can detect.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BH3 profiling 會讀出細胞對特定抗凋亡蛋白的依賴性，其中 Noxa BH3 胜肽選擇性結合 Mcl-1，因此 Noxa 訊號強烈反應即判定為 Mcl-1 依賴。此依賴性讀值用於篩選 AMG 176、S63845 等 Mcl-1 抑制劑的候選腫瘤，而 Mcl-1 高表現也是 venetoclax 抗藥性的主要機轉，可由此檢測偵測。

nodes.label: ATRX
nodes.description: ATRX is a ~280 kDa ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler of the SWI/SNF superfamily that cooperates with the histone chaperone DAXX to assemble the histone variant H3.3 into chromatin at telomeres, pericentric and centromeric heterochromatin, endogenous retroviruses and other repetitive elements, and imprinted loci. Its ADD domain binds H3 tails specifically when H3 is unmethylated at Lys9 (H3K4me0), linking ATRX activity to transcriptional silencing, while an HP1-interacting region anchors it at heterochromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ATRX 是 SWI/SNF 超家族中約 280 kDa 的 ATP 依賴性染色質重塑蛋白，與組蛋白伴護蛋白 DAXX 協同將組蛋白變異體 H3.3 組裝進端粒、周中節與著絲點異染色質、內源性反轉錄病毒與其他重複元素，以及印跡基因座的染色質。其 ADD 區域在 H3 的 Lys9 未甲基化（H3K4me0）時專一性結合 H3 尾端，將 ATRX 活性與轉錄沉默連結起來；HP1 交互作用區則將其錨定於異染色質。

nodes.label: Nucleoside Reverse Transcriptase Inhibitor
nodes.description: Blocking ERV (and LINE-1) reverse transcription with nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors reduces interferon inflammation in vivo and SASP in cells, supporting repurposing of NRTIs such as emtricitabine as senomorphics targeting the retrotransposon axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 以核苷類反轉錄酶抑制劑阻斷 ERV（與 LINE-1）的反轉錄，可在體內降低干擾素發炎並在細胞中降低 SASP，支持將 emtricitabine 等 NRTI 重新定位為針對散轉子軸的 senomorphic 藥物。

nodes.label: PDCD4
nodes.description: PDCD4 is a Tumor Suppressor that also functions as a general brake on protein synthesis. Its tumor-suppressive activity follows at least in part from repressing translation of growth- and survival-promoting transcripts, and from lowering TFEB protein levels, which curtails autophagy-lysosomal support of tumors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PDCD4 既是 Tumor Suppressor，也是一般性的蛋白質合成煞車。其腫瘤抑制活性至少部分來自抑制促進生長與存活之轉錄本的轉譯，以及降低 TFEB 蛋白量，進而削弱自噬－溶酶體對腫瘤的支持。

nodes.label: P66shc
nodes.description: P66shc knockout mice live about 30% longer than wild-type controls and show enhanced resistance to oxidative stress and age-related pathologies, indicating P66shc is a negative regulator of longevity. Directionally, loss of P66shc extends lifespan. This makes P66shc an attractive node, with SIRT1 as an upstream suppressor, for longevity interventions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: P66shc 基因敲除小鼠比野生型對照多活約 30%，並表現出對氧化壓力和年齡相關病變的增強抵抗力，表明 P66shc 是壽命的負向調節因子。方向性上 P66shc 的缺失延長壽命。這使 P66shc 成為一個有吸引力的節點，以 SIRT1 作為上游抑制因子，用於長壽介入措施。

nodes.label: Glycotoxins
nodes.description: Cigarette smoking is an exogenous source of glycation compounds. The curing of tobacco leaves has been proposed as the source of compounds that can readily increase in vivo AGEs; Cerami and colleagues found that glycotoxins from cigarettes are inhaled into the alveoli, then transported to the bloodstream or to lung cells where they interact with other glycation products and contribute to AGE formation. Smoking thus adds to the body's AGE burden beyond diet and endogenous production. This exogenous route of AGE generation helps explain the accelerated tissue aging and cardiovascular risk observed in smokers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 吸菸是糖化化合物的外源性來源。菸葉的烘烤被認為是能輕易增加體內 AGE 之化合物的來源；Cerami 及其同事發現，來自香菸的糖毒素（glycotoxins）被吸入肺泡，隨後被運送至血液或肺細胞，在那裡與其他糖化產物交互作用並促成 AGE 形成。因此，吸菸在飲食與內生性產生之外，額外增加了身體的 AGE 負擔。這種外源性的 AGE 生成途徑有助於解釋吸菸者中觀察到的加速組織老化與心血管風險。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: Disulfiram
nodes.description: The TIR dimer NAD+-binding pocket is the site of action for SARM1 inhibitors. Disulfiram covalently modifies a TIR cysteine, while DSRM-3716 and GSK-428 occupy the pocket non-covalently; the CD38 inhibitor 78c shares the conserved adduct-forming uncompetitive mechanism, which is why CD38 and SARM1 are paired as parallel NADases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TIR 二聚體的 NAD+ 結合口袋是 SARM1 抑制劑的作用位點。Disulfiram 以共價方式修飾 TIR 的半胱胺酸殘基，DSRM-3716 與 GSK-428 則以非共價方式占據該口袋；CD38 抑制劑 78c 共享同樣的加成物形成型不競爭機制，因此 CD38 與 SARM1 常被並列為平行的 NADase。

nodes.label: BCL2L13
nodes.description: BCL2L13 (Bcl-2-like protein 13, Bcl-Rambo) is the mammalian functional homolog of the yeast Atg32 mitophagy receptor. It provides a Parkin-independent route of mitochondrial clearance, which matters in Parkinson's disease where Parkin function is itself impaired.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BCL2L13（Bcl-2-like protein 13，Bcl-Rambo）是酵母 Atg32 粒線體自噬受體在哺乳類的功能同源物。它提供不依賴 Parkin 的粒線體清除途徑，這在 Parkin 功能本身受損的 Parkinson's disease 中格外重要。

nodes.label: ADMA
nodes.description: Asymmetric dimethylarginine (ADMA) accumulates in oxidative stress states because ROS inhibit DDAH, the enzyme that degrades ADMA, via oxidation and S-nitrosylation of its active-site Cys-249. Elevated ADMA competitively inhibits eNOS, promoting uncoupling; plasma ADMA is a robust independent predictor of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality in atherosclerotic, diabetic and chronic kidney disease patients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 非對稱二甲基精胺（ADMA）在氧化壓力狀態下會累積，因為 ROS 會抑制分解 ADMA 的酵素 DDAH（經由其活性位點 Cys-249 的氧化與 S-硝基化）。升高的 ADMA 競爭性抑制 eNOS 並促進其解偶聯；血漿 ADMA 是動脈粥狀硬化、糖尿病與慢性腎病患者心血管事件與全因死亡的穩健獨立預測因子。

nodes.label: R-CHOP
nodes.description: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combining the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, Vincristine and prednisone. It serves as the conventional comparator against which alternative or repurposed approaches are framed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: R-CHOP 是 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 的標準一線治療方案，將抗 CD20 抗體 rituximab 與 cyclophosphamide、doxorubicin、Vincristine 及 prednisone 合併。它也是評估替代或再定位療法時的常規對照基準。

nodes.label: Lymphopenia
nodes.description: Lymphopenia, an abnormally low circulating lymphocyte count, is a characteristic feature of severe SARS-CoV-2 infection. During the adaptive immune response, CD4+ and CD8+ T cell numbers decline dramatically while exaggerated pro-inflammatory cytokine production drives a pulmonary cytokine storm, making lymphopenia part of a maladaptive immune response rather than an isolated finding.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lymphopenia（循環淋巴細胞數異常偏低）是嚴重 SARS-CoV-2 感染的特徵性表現。在適應性免疫反應期間，CD4+ 與 CD8+ T Cell 數量大幅下降，而過度產生的促發炎細胞激素驅動肺部細胞激素風暴，使 lymphopenia 成為適應不良免疫反應的一部分而非孤立現象。

nodes.label: Peroxisomes
nodes.description: Peroxisomes are a major site of cellular oxygen consumption and H2O2 production, and they concentrate Catalase to about 15% of total peroxisomal protein. Catalase decomposes the H2O2 generated in the same organelle by peroxisomal oxidases such as acyl-CoA oxidases, D-amino acid oxidase and polyamine oxidase — a classic case of metabolic compartmentalization that keeps peroxide confined and detoxified.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxisomes 是細胞耗氧與產生 H2O2 的主要場所之一，並將 Catalase 濃縮至約佔過氧化體總蛋白的 15%。Catalase 分解同一胞器內由 acyl-CoA oxidase、D-amino acid oxidase 與 polyamine oxidase 等過氧化體氧化酶產生的 H2O2 —— 這是代謝區室化的典型例子，使過氧化物被限制並解毒。

nodes.label: Very Low Density Lipoprotein
nodes.description: Studies conducted at the University of Milan over 25 years showed that aminoguanidine reduces the ability of very low density lipoprotein (VLDL), the bad form of cholesterol, to bind itself to blood vessel walls, in tests on animals. In turn, blood platelets are less likely to coagulate and form dangerous clots. Aminoguanidine's role in reducing VLDL cholesterol and its ability to stabilize glucose metabolism indicate it has a wide-reaching ability to help prevent and treat a number of aging disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 米蘭大學二十五年來的研究表明，氨基胍降低非常低密度脂蛋白 (VLDL)，即壞膽固醇的形式，與血管壁結合的能力，在動物實驗中有效。 此外，血小板更不活躍，也更不容易形成危險血栓。 氨基胍在降低 VLDL 膽固醇和穩定葡萄糖代謝方面的作用，以及其穩定代謝的能力，表明它具有廣泛的抗衰老和治療多種衰老疾病的能力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: VCP
nodes.description: VCP accumulation is a characteristic feature of Huntington's Disease: as an AAA ATPase it binds mutant huntingtin and, together with BNIP3L/NIX, pushes mitophagy past the protective range into a lethal regime, contributing to neuronal death in the striatum.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VCP 的累積是 Huntington's Disease 的特徵之一：此 AAA ATPase 與突變型 huntingtin 結合，並與 BNIP3L/NIX 一起將 mitophagy 推過保護範圍而進入致死區間，促成 striatum 的神經元死亡。

nodes.label: Squalene synthase
