nodes.description: Squalene synthase, encoded by FDFT1, catalyzes the first committed step of sterol biosynthesis in the Mevalonate pathway by condensing two farnesyl diphosphate molecules into squalene. As the ER-membrane node where mevalonate-derived isoprenoid flux commits to the sterol branch, it sits at a metabolic branch point rather than a terminal step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Squalene synthase（由 FDFT1 編碼）催化 Mevalonate pathway 中類固醇生合成的第一步反應，將兩個 farnesyl diphosphate 分子縮合成 squalene。作為內質網膜上使 mevalonate 衍生異戊二烯oid通量投入類固醇支的節點，它位於代謝分支點而非末端步驟。

nodes.label: PDA
nodes.description: PDA (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) accounts for approximately 85% of all pancreatic malignancies, arising from the ductal epithelium of the exocrine pancreas. It is among the most lethal cancers, with roughly 12% five-year survival across stages, and is projected to become the second leading cause of cancer death by 2030.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PDA（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma）約佔所有胰臟惡性腫瘤的 85%，源自外分泌胰臟的導管上皮。它是最致命的癌症之一，各期合計五年存活率約 12%，並預計於 2030 年成為癌症死亡第二大原因。

nodes.label: NUCKS1
nodes.description: NUCKS1 sustains proliferative chromatin programs, so its depletion in cancer cell lines triggers Cellular Senescence and apoptosis through the p53/p21 pathway. This makes NUCKS1 loss both a growth-arrest trigger and a therapeutic vulnerability: NUCKS1 is overexpressed in breast, hepatocellular, gastric, colorectal and lung malignancies, where high expression correlates with proliferation, metastasis and poor prognosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NUCKS1 維持增殖性的染色質程序，因此在癌症細胞株中敲低 NUCKS1 會透過 p53/p21 路徑誘發 Cellular Senescence 與凋亡。這使 NUCKS1 流失既是生長停滞的觸發因子，也是治療弱點：NUCKS1 在乳癌、肝細胞癌、胃癌、大腸癌與肺癌中過度表現，高表現與增殖、轉移及不良預後相關。

nodes.label: TIMP1
nodes.description: Endogenous inhibition of MMP-12 is provided by tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases, principally TIMP1 and TIMP2. The balance between MMP-12 and TIMP levels determines the net elastinolytic activity in tissues; when MMP-12 activity overwhelms alpha-1 antitrypsin capacity, alveolar elastin is degraded and airspace enlargement develops.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-12 的內生性抑制由基質金屬蛋白酶組織抑制劑提供，主要是 TIMP1 與 TIMP2。組織中淨彈性蛋白水解活性取決於 MMP-12 與 TIMP 的平衡；當 MMP-12 活性超越 alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶的緩衝能力時，肺泡彈性蛋白被降解並出現氣腔擴大。

nodes.label: Cardiomyocyte
nodes.description: Taurine modulates calcium flux across membranes, stabilizing Cardiomyocyte function and skeletal muscle contractility. Taurine deficiency (e.g., in taurine-depleted diets, in cats) causes retinal degeneration, cardiomyopathy, and immune dysfunction, and taurine supplementation is therapeutic in these settings.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Taurine 調節跨膜的鈣離子通量，穩定 Cardiomyocyte 功能與骨骼肌收縮性。Taurine 缺乏（例如缺乏 taurine 的飲食、貓的情況）會造成視網膜退化、心肌病變與免疫功能失常，而補充 taurine 在這些情況下具有治療作用。

nodes.label: RHEB-1
nodes.description: RHEB-1 is the C. elegans orthologue of the small GTPase Rheb and a key activator of mTOR (CeTOR) in response to nutrient signals. RHEB-1 activates Autophagy under dietary restriction and regulates dauer formation, and is required for the lifespan extension seen in certain intermittent fasting models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RHEB-1 是小 GTP 酶 Rheb 在 C. elegans 中的同源物，也是營養訊號下 mTOR（CeTOR）的關鍵活化因子。RHEB-1 在飲食限制下活化 Autophagy 並調控 dauer 形成，且為某些間歇性禁食模型中壽命延展所必需。

nodes.label: Guanylate Cyclase
nodes.description: Guanylate cyclase enzymes convert GTP to the second messenger cGMP, which activates protein kinase G and regulates smooth-muscle tone, platelet aggregation, and neuronal signaling. The soluble isoform is the principal receptor for nitric oxide, while particulate isoforms respond to natriuretic peptides.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Guanylate cyclase 將 GTP 轉換為第二信使 cGMP，後者活化 protein kinase G 並調節平滑肌張力、血小板聚集與神經訊號。可溶性型是 nitric oxide 的主要受體，顆粒型則對 natriuretic peptide 反應。

nodes.label: Amelparib
nodes.description: Amelparib belongs to the PARP inhibitor class but is pharmacologically distinct from the oncology agents olaparib, veliparib, rucaparib, niraparib and talazoparib: it is designed for acute CNS use with parenteral dosing and targets parthanatos rather than homologous-recombination-deficient tumors. Notably, its Phase 1 and Phase 2a ran without sex stratification despite male-biased PARP/AIF neuroprotection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amelparib 屬於 PARP 抑制劑類別，但與腫瘤用藥 olaparib、veliparib、rucaparib、niraparib、talazoparib 在藥理上不同：它為急性中樞神經系統使用而設計，採靜脈給藥，標的不是同源重組缺陷腫瘤。值得注意的是，其第一期與第二期 a 期試驗未進行性別分層，儘管 PARP/AIF 神經保護具有男性偏向性。

nodes.label: UCP3
nodes.description: UCP3 is a member of the SLC25 mitochondrial carrier family of uncoupling proteins expressed most highly in skeletal muscle and, to a lesser extent, in brown adipose tissue and heart. It localises to the inner mitochondrial membrane and may mediate mild proton leak and fatty-acid handling in muscle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UCP3 是 SLC25 粒線體載體家族的解偶聯蛋白成員，在 Skeletal Muscle 表現最高，在 Brown Adipose Tissue 與心肌次之。它定位於粒線體內膜，可能在肌肉中介導輕微的質子漏與脂肪酸處理。

nodes.label: chromatin condensation
nodes.description: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: HOXA10
nodes.description: SIRT2 interacts with HOXA10, a conserved homeobox transcription factor critical for embryonic cell-type determination and adult tissue homeostasis, including reproductive and hematopoietic development. The interaction suggests SIRT2 influences HOXA10-dependent transcriptional programs, though the precise deacetylation outcome is less well characterized than for other SIRT2 substrates. Directionally, SIRT2 engages HOXA10 as a partner and potential substrate. This connection links SIRT2 to developmental regulation and possibly to differentiation defects in disease, and is consistent with SIRT2's broader roles in controlling transcription-factor activity and cell-fate decisions across tissues.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 與 HOXA10 相互作用，HOXA10 是一種保守的同源框轉錄因子，對胚胎細胞類型決定和成人組織穩態（包括生殖和造血發育）至關重要。這種相互作用表明 SIRT2 影響 HOXA10 依賴性的轉錄程序，儘管其確切的去乙醯化結果不如其他 SIRT2 受質那樣有充分描述。在方向性上，SIRT2 與 HOXA10 作為夥伴和潛在受質相互作用。這種聯繫將 SIRT2 與發育調節以及可能的疾病分化缺陷聯繫起來，與 SIRT2 在控制跨組織轉錄因子活性和細胞命運決定方面的更廣泛作用一致。

nodes.label: Pyridoxamine
nodes.description: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。

nodes.label: Doxycycline
nodes.description: Doxycycline, a tetracycline-class antibiotic, at concentrations above its antimicrobial IC50 binds the mitochondrial 39S ribosomal subunit and blocks aminoacyl-tRNA accommodation, selectively depleting the 13 mtDNA-encoded respiratory-chain subunits. The resulting respiratory deficiency is a classic trigger of the Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response: in C. elegans it activates the ATFS-1 transcriptional program, induces mitochondrial chaperones and proteases, and extends Lifespan, which is why it is a standard pharmacological probe of mitohormesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Doxycycline 屬四環黴素類抗生素，在高於抗菌 IC50 的濃度下結合粒線體 39S 核糖體次單元並阻斷氨醯-tRNA 接受，選擇性耗竭 13 個 mtDNA 編碼的呼吸鏈次單元。由此造成的呼吸不足是 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的典型觸發因素：在 *C. elegans* 中它啟動 ATFS-1 轉錄程式、誘導粒線體伴護蛋白與蛋白酶並延長 Lifespan，因此被用作研究 mitohormesis 的標準藥理探針。

nodes.label: Immunometabolism
nodes.description: Immunometabolism is closely tied to Immune Aging, which involves transcriptional and metabolic reprogramming in individual immune cells. Pharmacological metabolic reprogramming is one strategy: Metformin improves memory immune responses by metabolically reprogramming memory CD8+ T cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Immunometabolism 與 Immune Aging 密切相關，後者涉及個別免疫細胞的轉錄與代謝重編程。藥理性的代謝重編程是策略之一：Metformin 透過代謝重編程記憶 CD8+ T cells，改善記憶性免疫反應。

nodes.label: Caspase-5
nodes.description: Caspase-5 is a human inflammatory caspase that oligomerizes and auto-cleaves in response to cytosolic danger signals such as microbial products. Active caspase-5 cleaves Gasdermin D at its linker, releasing the N-terminal pore-forming domain which oligomerizes in the plasma membrane to form lytic pores.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-5 是人類發炎性 caspase，會因細胞質危險訊號（如微生物產物）而寡聚化並自我切割。活化的 caspase-5 在連接區切割 Gasdermin D，釋出 N 端成孔區，該區在細胞膜上寡聚形成裂解性孔洞。

nodes.label: Serotonin Receptor
nodes.description: Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine) signals through Serotonin Receptor, a family of seven GPCR subfamilies (5-HT1-5-HT7) with the exception of 5-HT3, which is a ligand-gated cation channel; 5-HT1 couples to Gi/o, 5-HT2 to Gq, and 5-HT4/6/7 to Gs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serotonin（5-hydroxytryptamine）透過 Serotonin Receptor 傳遞訊號；此家族包含七個 GPCR 亞群（5-HT1–5-HT7），但 5-HT3 為配體門控陽離子通道。5-HT1 偶聯 Gi/o，5-HT2 偶聯 Gq，5-HT4/6/7 則偶聯 Gs。

nodes.label: Stilbene
nodes.description: Stilbenes are a class of polyphenolic organic compounds built on a 1,2-diphenylethylene core (a central ethene bridge connecting two aromatic rings) and existing as cis and trans isomers, with the trans configuration being the more biologically active form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stilbene 是一類以 1,2-二苯乙烯骨架（連接兩個芳香環的中心烯橋）為基礎的多酚類有機化合物，存在順式與反式異構物，其中反式為生物活性較高的形式。

nodes.label: Glu230
nodes.description: Glu230 (E230) is a conserved negatively charged residue in the N-terminal domain of SIRT1. It is a critical determinant of the allosteric binding site engaged by small-molecule activators, and mutagenesis of Glu230 abolishes the activating effect of resveratrol on SIRT1 catalytic activity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glu230（E230）是 SIRT1 N 端區域中保守帶負電的殘基，為小分子活化劑結合之異位（allosteric）位點的關鍵決定因子；將 Glu230 突變後，resveratrol 對 SIRT1 催化活性的活化作用即消失。

nodes.label: Microfilariae
nodes.description: Adult female Wuchereria bancrofti residing in lymphatic vessels release up to about 1000 microfilariae a day for 10–14 years. These sheathed microfilariae enter the circulation with pronounced nocturnal periodicity matching mosquito feeding, and are taken up by biting mosquitoes to continue development, making them both the disseminating stage within the host and the transmission stage to the environment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 棲息於淋巴管中的 Wuchereria bancrofti 雌性成蟲每天可釋出多達約 1000 條微絲蟲，長達 10–14 年。這些有鞘微絲蟲帶有與蚊媒吸血時間吻合的明顯夜間週期性而進入循環，並被叮咬的蚊子攝入以繼續發育，因此它們既是宿主體內的擴散階段，也是對環境的傳播階段。

nodes.label: Werner Syndrome
nodes.description: Werner syndrome is a progeroid disorder caused by mutations in the WRN gene, which encodes a protein with both helicase and exonuclease activities essential for DNA repair and genome stability. The WRN protein functions in pathways including homologous recombination, base excision repair, and resolution of replication stress, and its loss leads to accelerated genomic instability and premature aging. Werner syndrome patients prematurely develop age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, diabetes, and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Werner 症候群是一種由 WRN 基因突變引起的早衰症，該基因編碼的蛋白質具有解旋酶和核酸外切酶活性，對於 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性至關重要。 WRN 蛋白在同源重組、鹼基切除修復和複製壓力解決等途徑中發揮作用，其缺失會導致基因組不穩定加速和過早老化。沃納症候群患者過早地患有與年齡相關的疾病，如動脈粥狀硬化、糖尿病和癌症。

nodes.label: Outer Mitochondrial Membrane
nodes.description: MFN1 is a large dynamin-related GTPase resident in the Outer Mitochondrial Membrane, where it tethers adjacent mitochondria through its heptad-repeat (HR2) domains. Redox-dependent disulfide bond formation between MFN HR2 domains drives oligomerization and merger of the outer membranes, so MFN1 is a direct executor of outer membrane fusion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MFN1 是駐紮於 Outer Mitochondrial Membrane 的大型 dynamin 相關 GTPase，透過其 heptad-repeat（HR2）結構域將相鄰粒線體錨定在一起。MFN 的 HR2 結構域之間形成依賴氧化還原的雙硫鍵，驅動寡聚化與外膜融合，因此 MFN1 是外膜融合的直接執行者。

nodes.label: CISD1
nodes.description: CISD1 (mitoNEET) buffers mitochondrial labile iron, which restrains the outputs of ROS-driven lipid peroxidation. Loss or inhibition of CISD1 raises mitochondrial iron and lipid ROS, sensitizing cells to ferroptosis; CISD1 is listed alongside NRF2, metallothionein-1G and p53 as a negative regulator of ferroptosis in liver cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CISD1 (mitoNEET) 會緩衝粒線體中的活性鐵，因而抑制 ROS 驅動脂質過氧化的產物。CISD1 缺失或受抑制時，粒線體鐵與脂質 ROS 上升，使細胞對鐵死亡更加敏感；在肝癌細胞中，CISD1 與 NRF2、metallothionein-1G 及 p53 同列為鐵死亡的負向調節因子。

nodes.label: AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway
nodes.description: In the AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway, energy stress raises AMPK activity, AMPK phosphorylates PGC-1α, and the coactivator partners with transcription factors such as NRFs and ERRα to induce nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, elevating mitochondrial number, capacity, ATP output and stress resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway 中，能量壓力提升 AMPK 活性，AMPK 磷酸化 PGC-1α，後者再與 NRF、ERRα 等轉錄因子合作誘導核編碼的粒線體基因，提升粒線體數量、容量、ATP 產出與抗逆境能力。

nodes.label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
nodes.description: Nitrative stress is caused by reactive nitrogen species when RNS production exceeds the capacity of detoxifying and repair systems to neutralize them. The condition reflects an imbalance between nitrating oxidants and endogenous defenses. The directionality is RNS excess to nitrative damage. A caveat is that transient, localized RNS signaling is physiological, so pathology depends on chronic overload or miscompartmentalization. The transition from beneficial to pathological RNS activity hinges on concentration, duration, and the tissue's antioxidant and repair capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 是由 reactive nitrogen species 當 RNS 產生超過解毒和修復系統中和它們的能力時引起的。這種情況反映了硝化氧化劑和內源性防禦之間的不平衡。方向性是RNS過量對硝化損傷的影響。需要注意的是，短暫的、局部的 RNS 訊號傳導是生理性的，因此病理學取決於慢性超負荷或錯室化。 RNS 活性從有益到病理的轉變取決於濃度、持續時間以及組織的抗氧化和修復能力。

nodes.label: Atg9
nodes.description: Atg9 is the only transmembrane ATG protein and a carrier for membrane delivery to the expanding Autophagosome during biogenesis. It cycles between the Golgi, endosomes, and the phagophore assembly site, and is essential for both Macroautophagy and selective autophagy pathways.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg9 是唯一的跨膜 ATG 蛋白，在自噬體生成過程中負責將膜運送至擴張中的 Autophagosome。它在 Golgi、內體與吞噬泡組裝位點之間循環，且對 Macroautophagy 與選擇性自噬途徑皆不可或缺。

nodes.label: DLD (dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase)
nodes.description: DLD is the E3 flavoprotein subunit shared by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase. It reoxidizes the dihydrolipoyl groups generated during decarboxylation, regenerating the lipoamide cofactor and transferring electrons to NAD+, so DLD activity is required for the complexes that feed carbon into the TCA cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DLD 是 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase、α-酮戊二酸去氫酶與支鏈酮酸去氫酶共用的 E3 黃素蛋白次單元。它將脫羧過程產生的 dihydrolipoyl 基團再氧化，重新生成 lipoamide 輔基並將電子轉移給 NAD+，因此 DLD 活性是將碳送入 TCA 循環的這些複合體所必需。

nodes.label: USP30
nodes.description: Loss of USP30 in knockout mice prevents behavioural deficits, increases mitophagy, and reduces both phosphorylated S129 alpha-synuclein and dopaminergic neuron loss; the brain-penetrant inhibitor MTX115325 shows similar efficacy in Parkinson's Disease models. USP30 knockdown also cuts lipid ROS by about 40% and reduces ferroptotic neuronal death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 knockout mouse 中移除 USP30 可預防行為缺陷、增加 mitophagy，並降低磷酸化 S129 的 alpha-synuclein 與 dopaminergic neuron 喪失；可穿過血腦障礙的抑制劑 MTX115325 在 Parkinson's Disease 模型中展現類似效力。USP30 knockdown 還可減少約 40% 的脂質 ROS 並降低 ferroptosis 性的神經元死亡。

nodes.label: IBRDC2
nodes.description: By driving Bax oligomerization and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, IBRDC2 commits the cell to apoptosis and thereby triggers the release of cytochrome c from mitochondria. The released cytochrome c then feeds the apoptosome cascade, so IBRDC2 sits at the hinge between the p53 damage response and committed mitochondrial death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IBRDC2 藉由驅動 Bax 寡聚化與粒線體外膜通透化，使細胞注定走向 apoptosis，並因此觸發 cytochrome c 自粒線體釋放。釋出的 cytochrome c 隨後推動 apoptosome 級聯反應，使 IBRDC2 處於 p53 損傷反應與已決定的粒線體死亡之間的樞紐位置。

nodes.label: Dopachrome
nodes.description: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole (DHI) is the reducing indole monomer released by spontaneous decarboxylation and reduction of Dopachrome during melanogenesis; its carboxylic acid analog DHICA arises via dopachrome tautomerase. DHI is the prototypical eumelanin monomer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole（DHI）是在 melanogenesis 過程中 Dopachrome 自發脫羧與還原所釋出的還原性 indole 單體；其羧酸類似物 DHICA 則由 dopachrome tautomerase 產生。DHI 是 eumelanin 的典型單體。

nodes.label: Lipoteichoic Acid
nodes.description: Lipoteichoic acid (LTA) is a major constituent of the Gram-positive bacterial cell wall and functions as a canonical PAMP detected by the innate immune system. It is a polymer of glycerolphosphate or ribitolphosphate subunits linked by phosphodiester bonds, anchored to the bacterial membrane by a glycolipid moiety, with D-alanine and N-acetylglucosamine substitutions that modulate its immunogenicity. It is the Gram-positive counterpart of LPS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lipoteichoic acid (LTA) 是革蘭氏陽性菌 cell wall 的主要成分，作為典型 PAMP 被 innate immune system 辨識。它是由 glycerolphosphate 或 ribitolphosphate 次單元以 phosphodiester 鍵連接的聚合物，藉 glycolipid 部分錨定於細菌膜上，其 D-alanine 與 N-acetylglucosamine 取代程度會調節免疫原性。它是 LPS 的革蘭氏陽性菌對應物。

nodes.label: SR-BI
nodes.description: SR-BI is one of three known pathways for free cholesterol efflux from macrophages. Unlike ABCA1, it does not preferentially lipidate lipid-poor apoA-1; instead it mediates bidirectional, ATP-independent cholesterol flux across the plasma membrane, with net movement set by the cholesterol gradient between cell and acceptor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SR-BI 是巨噬細胞遊離 cholesterol 外流的三條已知途徑之一。與 ABCA1 不同，它不會優先將脂質載入脂蛋白缺乏的 apoA-1；相反地，它以雙向且不依賴 ATP 的方式促進胆固醇跨越細胞膜流動，淨移動方向由細胞與接受體之間的胆固醇梯度決定。

nodes.label: Phosphatidylethanolamine
nodes.description: Phosphatidylethanolamine esterified with arachidonic or adrenic acid at the sn-2 position is the key peroxidation substrate on which Ferroptosis is executed. Lipoxygenases such as ALOX15 directly oxygenate PUFA-PE, and the resulting PE-OOH is the proximal lethal species whose accumulation disrupts membrane integrity; its peroxidation is more lethal than that of phosphatidylcholine.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 sn-2 位置以 arachidonic acid 或 adrenic acid 酯化的 Phosphatidylethanolamine 是 Ferroptosis 執行的關鍵過氧化底物。ALOX15 等 Lipoxygenase 可直接氧化 PUFA-PE，產生的 PE-OOH 是造成細胞死亡的近端致死物種，其累積會破壞膜完整性；PE 的過氧化致死性高於 phosphatidylcholine。

nodes.label: Ornithine Aminotransferase (OAT) Deficiency
nodes.description: Gyrate atrophy is a rare autosomal recessive chorioretinal degeneration caused by mutations in the OAT gene encoding ornithine aminotransferase. The deficiency produces sharply demarcated circular atrophic lesions in the mid-peripheral retina that enlarge, coalesce, and lead to tunnel vision and legal blindness by age 40-50.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gyrate atrophy 是一罕見的體染色體隱性脈絡視網膜退化症，由編碼 ornithine aminotransferase 的 OAT 基因突變造成。缺乏使中周邊視網膜出現邊界清楚的圓形萎縮病灶，逐漸擴大融合，導致管狀視野並在 40 至 50 歲達法定失明。

nodes.label: Fructosyl-Amino Acid Oxidases
nodes.description: Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases (FAOD) oxidatively cleave Amadori products back to the original free amino acid, providing an exogenous or bacterial route to reverse glycation before irreversible AGE crosslinks form.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fructosyl-Amino Acid Oxidases（FAOD）將 Amadori products 氧化裂解回游離的原始胺基酸，提供外源性或細菌性的 deglycation 途徑，在不可逆 AGE 交聯形成之前逆轉 glycation。

nodes.label: MAX
nodes.description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

nodes.label: Intestinal Barrier
nodes.description: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid from microbial fermentation of dietary fiber, serves as a primary colonocyte energy source. It enhances barrier integrity by increasing expression of tight junction proteins like occludin, preventing systemic inflammation in a dose-sensitive hormetic manner.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Butyrate 是膳食纖維經微生物發酵產生的短鏈脂肪酸，也是結腸細胞的主要能量來源。它透過增加 tight junction 蛋白（如 occludin）的表現來強化屏障完整性，以劑量敏感的 hormesis 方式預防全身性發炎。

nodes.label: Low-Density Lipoprotein
nodes.description: Low-density lipoprotein is the principal cholesterol-transporting lipoprotein, carrying ApoB-100 with a core of cholesteryl esters and triglycerides. The unmodified particle is relatively inert; pathogenicity emerges once LDL is retained in the arterial intima and chemically modified by oxidation or glycation, after which scavenger-receptor uptake by macrophages seeds foam cells and fatty streaks. Small, dense LDL subspecies are especially prone to both modifications, so particle number and quality matter beyond total cholesterol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Low-Density Lipoprotein 是運送膽固醇的主要脂蛋白，攜帶 ApoB-100 及膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯核心。未經修飾的顆粒相對惰性；致病性出現在 LDL 滯留於動脈內膜並受到氧化或醣化修飾之後，此時經由清道夫受體被巨噬細胞攝取，形成泡沫細胞與脂肪斑塊。體積小而密的 LDL 次族群特別容易被這兩種修飾，因此顆粒數量與品質比總膽固醇更關鍵。

nodes.label: p70S6 kinase
nodes.description: mTORC1 is the upstream activator of p70S6 kinase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC1 是 p70S6 kinase 的上游活化因子。

nodes.label: Inulin
nodes.description: Enzymatically synthesized inulin nanoparticles (95.9–238.5 nm) encapsulate fisetin, increasing its solubility 3.6-fold over the free compound and showing higher DPPH antioxidant activity, with improved thermal stability at 70 °C.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 以酵素法合成的 inulin 奈米顆粒（95.9–238.5 nm）可包埋 fisetin，使其溶解度較游離型提升 3.6 倍，DPPH 抗氧化活性更高，且在 70 °C 下熱穩定性更佳。

nodes.label: Glucose uptake
nodes.description: Fenbendazole reduces glucose uptake in cancer cells, lowering lactate production and reversing drug resistance. It activates p53, driving mitochondrial p53-p21 signaling that suppresses GLUT transporter expression, and additionally impedes hexokinase 2. Because cancer cells already sharply increase glucose uptake to fuel glycolysis and biomass production, starving them of glucose is the central anticancer mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 降低癌細胞的葡萄糖攝取，減少乳酸生成並逆轉藥物抗性。它活化 p53，透過粒線體 p53-p21 訊號抑制 GLUT 轉運蛋白的表現，並另外阻礙 hexokinase 2。由於癌細胞本已大幅提高葡萄糖攝取以供應糖解作用與生物量生產，因此使其缺糖是核心抗癌機制。

nodes.label: HER2-enriched breast cancer
nodes.description: HER2-enriched cancer is a molecular subtype of breast cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HER2 富集癌是乳癌的分子亞型。

nodes.label: DR4
nodes.description: TRAIL binding induces DR4 trimerization and DISC recruitment, initiating extrinsic apoptosis with tumor selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAIL 結合誘發 DR4 三聚化與 DISC 招募，啟動具腫瘤選擇性的外源性凋亡。

nodes.label: JAK-STAT3
nodes.description: The JAK-STAT3 signaling axis promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR and by transducing cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory and tumor-promoting facets of the secretome. JAK1/2 inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib) reduce SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8, validating the axis as a senomorphic target. The pathway is especially important for the feed-forward, self-reinforcing inflammation characteristic of chronic senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號軸透過與 p38 MAPK 和 mTOR 交互作用，以及轉導來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化促成年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向。JAK1/2 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8，證實此軸作為 senomorphic 標靶。該路徑對慢性衰老特有的正向、自我強化發炎尤為重要。

nodes.label: TGF-β3
nodes.description: TGF-beta3 is a ligand isoform of the TGF-beta superfamily.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-β3 是 TGF-β 超家族的配體亞型。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Honeybee venom and melittin suppress growth factor receptor activation in HER2-enriched and triple-negative breast cancer - npj Precision Oncology.md

nodes.label: Pulse Wave Velocity
nodes.description: Pulse wave velocity (PWV) is the speed at which the pressure wave generated by left ventricular ejection travels along the arterial tree, and is the gold standard clinical measure of arterial stiffness. It is computed as arterial distance between two recording sites divided by pulse transit time (D/Δt), with carotid-femoral PWV (cfPWV) the most validated variant. Because pressure waves travel faster through rigid vessels than compliant ones, higher PWV values indicate stiffer arteries.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 脈搏波傳導速度 (PWV) 是左心室射血所產生的壓力波沿動脈樹傳播的速度，被視為衡量動脈僵硬度（arterial stiffness）的黃金標準臨床指標。它以兩個量測部位間的動脈距離除以脈搏傳導時間計算（D/Δt），其中頸動脈－股動脈 PWV (cfPWV) 為驗證最充分、應用最廣的版本。由於壓力波在僵硬血管中傳播比在彈性血管中快，PWV 值越高代表動脈越僵硬。

nodes.label: MFF
nodes.description: MFF (mitochondrial fission factor) is an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondria to initiate fission. Its role is relatively simple: MFF overexpression enhances mitochondrial fragmentation, whereas low MFF expression inhibits DRP1 anchoring to the mitochondria and results in elongated mitochondria. MFF physically interacts with the MID proteins within a DRP1 complex, and MFF appears uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission, whereas FIS1 is involved in asymmetrical fission. MFF is upregulated in heart failure and pulmonary diseases where excessive fission predominates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MFF（線粒體分裂因子）是一種外線粒體膜接頭蛋白，可招募 DRP1 到線粒體以啟動分裂。其作用相對簡單：MFF 過表達增強線粒體 fragment，而低 MFF 表達抑制 DRP1 錨定到線粒體，導致線粒體 elongated。MFF 與 DRP1 複合體中的 MID 蛋白 physically interacts，且 MFF 似乎 uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission，而 FIS1 參與 asymmetrical fission。MFF 在 heart failure 和 pulmonary diseases 中 upregulated，其中 excessive fission predominates。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

nodes.label: LHRH
nodes.description: Luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation and are a clinically tolerable alternative to surgical castration. Agents such as Lupron (leuprolide) act on the pituitary gland, desensitizing LHRH receptors and thereby decreasing luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone, leading to reduced estrogen and testosterone production. Human studies with LHRH analogues have resulted in increased thymic weight and reversal of age-related thymic structural defects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 黃體生成激素釋放激素（LHRH）類似物可達成藥理性性類固醇消融，是外科去勢的臨床上可耐受之替代方案。諸如 Lupron（leuprolide）等藥物作用於腦下垂體，使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，從而減少黃體生成激素與濾泡刺激激素，導致雌激素與睪固酮生成減少。使用 LHRH 類似物的人類研究已導致胸腺重量增加及年齡相關胸腺結構缺陷的逆轉。

nodes.label: S-Nitrosylation
nodes.description: S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (GSNOR, also ADH5) catalyzes the reduction and denitrosylation of S-nitrosoglutathione (GSNO), thereby controlling the size of the GSNO pool available for protein S-nitrosylation. Losing GSNOR activity lets S-nitrosylation of substrate proteins persist and intensify, so GSNOR is the principal brake on cellular protein S-nitrosylation levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S-亞硝基麩胱甘肽還原酶（GSNOR，又稱 ADH5）催化 S-亞硝基麩胱甘肽（GSNO）的還原與去亞硝基化，藉此控制可供蛋白質 S-亞硝基化使用的 GSNO 池大小。GSNOR 活性喪失會使受質蛋白的 S-亞硝基化持續並加劇，因此 GSNOR 是細胞蛋白 S-亞硝基化程度的主要煞車。

nodes.label: CDH5
nodes.description: CDH5 (VE-cadherin, CD144) is a classical cadherin expressed exclusively in endothelial cells. With five extracellular cadherin domains and a cytoplasmic tail bound to p120-catenin, β-catenin and α-catenin, it forms Ca2+-dependent homophilic interactions at adherens junctions and links to the actin cytoskeleton, maintaining vascular barrier integrity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDH5（VE-cadherin，CD144）是專一表現在內皮細胞的典型鈣黏著蛋白。它具有五個胞外鈣黏著蛋白結構域，胞質尾與 p120-catenin、β-catenin 及 α-catenin 結合，在黏著帶形成鈣離子依賴的同型性交互作用並連結到肌動蛋白骨架，維持血管屏障完整性。

nodes.label: H3K122ac
nodes.description: H3K122ac is a core-domain acetylation that destabilizes the nucleosome and is enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Alongside H3K27ac and H3K18ac, it marks the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H3K122ac 是使核小體不穩定的核心結構域乙醯化，富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。與 H3K27ac 及 H3K18ac 並列，它標記 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態。

nodes.label: Atg14
nodes.description: Vps34 binds Atg14 to form the autophagy-specific class III PI3K complex, in which Atg14 stimulates Vps34 kinase activity. Vps34 also forms a distinct complex with UVRAG that supports endocytosis rather than autophagy, so partner choice determines which membrane-trafficking outcome the kinase serves.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vps34 與 Atg14 結合形成自噬專一性的第三類 PI3K 複合體，其中 Atg14 會刺激 Vps34 的激酶活性。Vps34 亦與 UVRAG 形成支援胞吞而非自噬的不同複合體，因此選擇何種伴護蛋白決定了該激酶服務哪一種膜運輸結果。

nodes.label: Nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase
nodes.description: C57BL/6J substrains carry a naturally hypomorphic Nnt (nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase) allele, which can affect glucose metabolism and mitochondrial redox — a caveat when interpreting metabolic phenotypes in this strain.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C57BL/6J 亞系帶有一個天然低功能的 Nnt（nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase）等位基因，會影響葡萄糖代謝與粒線體氧化還原——這是在此品系解讀代謝表型時的注意事項。

nodes.label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome
nodes.description: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

nodes.label: Proteins
nodes.description: Protein carbonylation is an irreversible modification of proteins introduced by metal-catalyzed oxidation or by adduction of lipid-peroxidation products to susceptible residues. It marks severe, often non-repairable oxidative damage and is used as a biomarker. The directionality is oxidative insult to stable carbonyl formation. A caveat is that carbonylation can also arise from glycation and other non-ROS processes, so it is not exclusively an oxidative-stress marker. Carbonyls can be measured in plasma, tissues, and cell lysates, and their accumulation is a hallmark of aging and age-related disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Protein carbonylation 是 proteins 的不可逆修飾，透過金屬催化氧化或透過脂質過氧化產物與敏感殘基的加合引入。它標誌著嚴重的、通常不可修復的氧化損傷，並被用作生物標記。方向性是對穩定羰基形成的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，羰基化也可能由糖化和其他非 ROS 過程引起，因此它不僅僅是氧化壓力標記。可以在血漿、組織和細胞裂解物中測量羰基，它們的累積是 aging 和年齡相關疾病的標誌。

nodes.label: Rubicon
nodes.description: Rubicon and UVRAG reciprocally regulate the Vps34 complex: Rubicon restrains Vps34 lipid kinase activity and endosomal maturation, while UVRAG promotes them. They compete within overlapping complexes to modulate autophagy and endocytic trafficking.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rubicon 與 UVRAG 對 Vps34 複合體進行相互調控：Rubicon 抑制 Vps34 脂質激酶活性與內體成熟，UVRAG 則促進之。它們在重疊複合體中競爭以調控自噬與內吞運輸。

nodes.label: Doramectin
nodes.description: Doramectin is a P-glycoprotein (P-gp/ABCB1) substrate, and mammalian CNS selectivity of avermectins depends on P-gp efflux at the intact blood-brain barrier. Dogs carrying the ABCB1-1delta (MDR1) deletion, such as collies, Australian shepherds and Shelties, are therefore at risk of neurotoxicity (mydriasis, ataxia, tremors, coma) even at modest doses, and its long persistence makes this especially hazardous.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Doramectin 是 P 醣蛋白（P-gp／ABCB1）的受質，而 avermectin 類對哺乳類中樞神經的選擇性仰賴 P-gp 在完整血腦障壁的排出。因此帶有 ABCB1-1Δ（MDR1）缺失的犬隻（如牧羊犬、澳洲牧羊犬與雪特犬）即使在中等劑量下也有神經毒性風險（瞳孔放大、共濟失調、顫抖、昏迷），而其長效滯留使此風險格外危險。

nodes.label: Selamectin
nodes.description: Selamectin is a P-gp (MDR1/ABCB1) substrate, and the transporter-mediated restriction is what keeps its brain concentrations low. Substantially lower CNS penetration than Ivermectin, demonstrated even in P-glycoprotein-deficient Mdr1a/b and Bcrp knockout mice, gives Selamectin a wider safety margin in collie-type dogs homozygous for the ABCB1-1delta deletion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Selamectin 是 P-gp（MDR1/ABCB1）的受質，正是這種運輸蛋白介導的限制使其腦中濃度維持低檔。與 Ivermectin 相比更低的腦部穿透，即使在缺乏 P 醣蛋白的 Mdr1a/b 與 Bcrp 剔除小鼠中也已證實，使 Selamectin 對帶有 ABCB1-1Δ 缺失同型合子的柯利牧羊犬有更寬的安全餘裕。

nodes.label: HNF4α
nodes.description: SIRT2 deacetylates HNF4α at multiple lysines in its hinge and ligand-binding domains, enhancing its protein stability and transcriptional output. The deacetylated nuclear receptor then drives expression of genes controlling fatty acid beta-oxidation; loss of SIRT2 or hyperacetylation of HNF4α leads to lipid droplet accumulation and a metabolic shift toward lipotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 會在 HNF4α 的鉸鏈區與配體結合區多個離胺酸上進行去乙醯化，提升其蛋白穩定性與轉錄輸出。去乙醯化後的核受體進而驅動調控脂肪酸 β-氧化基因的表現；SIRT2 缺失或 HNF4α 過度乙醯化會導致脂滴堆積與朝 lipotoxicity 轉移的代謝變化。

nodes.label: Metabolic Plasticity
nodes.description: SIRT3 sits at the centre of the glycolysis–OXPHOS switch because its deacetylase activity tunes metabolic flux and the redox setpoint simultaneously. It deacetylates and activates TCA-cycle and ETC enzymes and PGC-1α to drive OXPHOS and mitochondrial biogenesis, destabilizes HIF-1α to curb the glycolytic program, and lowers ROS via MnSOD, IDH2, MTHFD2, and catalase. The net effect is context-dependent: tumor-suppressive in glycolytic cancers, oncogenic in OXPHOS-addicted ones.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 位於糖解–OXPHOS 切換的核心，因為其去乙醯酶活性可同時調整代謝通量與氧化還原設定點。它使 TCA 循環與電子傳遞鏈酵素及 PGC-1α 去乙醯化並活化，以驅動 OXPHOS 與粒線體生成；使 HIF-1α 去穩定化以抑制糖解基因程序；並透過 MnSOD、IDH2、MTHFD2 與 catalase 降低 ROS。最終效應取決於情境：在糖解型癌症中具抑腫作用，在 OXPHOS 成癮型癌症中則為致癌因子。

nodes.label: ACTH
nodes.description: The Adrenal cortex receives minimal direct innervation and is regulated primarily by humoral signals. ACTH released from the anterior pituitary under HPA Axis drive upregulates cortical steroidogenesis, while Cortisol exerts negative feedback at pituitary and hypothalamic levels; Angiotensin II and plasma Potassium are the dominant inputs for aldosterone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenal cortex 幾乎沒有直接神經支配，主要受體液訊號調節。在 HPA Axis 驅動下由腦下垂體前葉釋放的 ACTH 會上调皮質類固醇生成，而 Cortisol 則在腦下垂體與下視丘層級進行負回饋；Angiotensin II 與血漿 Potassium 則是 aldosterone 分泌的主要輸入訊號。

nodes.label: IL-18
nodes.description: IL-18 is synthesized as an inactive pro-IL-18 precursor and matures only when caspase-1, recruited by the NLRP3 inflammasome, cleaves it in macrophages and other innate immune cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-18 先以無活性的 pro-IL-18 前驅物形式合成，必須由 NLRP3 發炎小體招募的 caspase-1 在巨噬細胞及其他先天免疫細胞中切割後才成熟。

nodes.label: Gastrointestinal Tract
nodes.description: The gastrointestinal tract is the ecological niche that cultivates the gut microbiome, the largest microbial aggregate associated with the body. The microbiome ferments dietary fiber into short-chain fatty acids that nourish colonocytes and modulate inflammation, and age-related changes in motility, absorptive capacity, and microbial composition shift this ecosystem, making GIT function a contributing factor to frailty and neurodegenerative risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胃腸道是培養腸道菌群的生態棲位，該菌群是與人體相關的最大微生物聚集體。菌群將膳食纖維發酵為短鏈脂肪酸，這些代謝物供養結腸上皮細胞並調節發炎；而隨年齡出現的蠕動減慢、吸收能力下降與菌群組成改變會擾動此生態系，使胃腸道功能成為虛弱與神經退化風險的促成因素。

nodes.label: Synovial Fluid
nodes.description: In chronic joint disease, especially Rheumatoid Arthritis, persistent inflammation and the turnover of long-lived matrix proteins favor the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products within cartilage and the synovial milieu. This local AGE burden parallels the carbonyl and aminochrome chemistry seen systemically, making synovial fluid a window onto systemic glycative-oxidative aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在慢性關節疾病（尤其是 Rheumatoid Arthritis）中，持續的發炎與長壽命基質蛋白的汰換會促使 Advanced Glycation End Products 在軟骨與關節腔環境中累積。這項局部 AGE 負擔與全身可見的羰基與 aminochrome 化學平行，使滑液成為全身糖化—氧化老化的觀察窗口。

nodes.label: TGF-beta Receptor
nodes.description: TGF-beta receptors are the prototypical receptors for the TGF-beta1 ligand. This ligand-receptor pairing defines the signaling module.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 受體是 TGF-beta1 配體的典型受體。此配體—受體配對定義訊號模組。

nodes.label: gp130
nodes.description: IL-6 engages the IL-6R/gp130 co-receptor to activate JAK-STAT3, sustaining stemness factors OCT4, NANOG and SOX2. This canonical axis underlies SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming and cancer stemness.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-6 接合 IL-6R/gp130 共受體以活化 JAK-STAT3，維持幹性因子 OCT4、NANOG 與 SOX2。此典型軸構成 SASP 驅動的旁分泌重編程與癌症幹性的基礎。

nodes.label: Seahorse XF Analyzer
nodes.description: Oxygen Consumption Rate is measured in real time with a Seahorse XF Analyzer, whose transient micro-chamber clamps track O2 flux while titrating oligomycin, FCCP and rotenone/antimycin A to resolve basal, ATP-linked, proton-leak and spare respiratory capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oxygen Consumption Rate 以 [[Seahorse XF Analyzer]] 即時測定；儀器利用瞬間微腔夾制追蹤 O₂ 通量，並以 [[Oligomycin]]、[[FCCP]] 與 rotenone/antimycin A 滴定，解析基礎呼吸、ATP 連結呼吸、質子漏與呼吸剩餘容量。

nodes.label: Horvath Clock
nodes.description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

nodes.label: Creatine Kinase
nodes.description: Creatine kinase reversibly phosphorylates creatine with ATP to produce phosphocreatine, the muscle phosphagen store. This reaction is the mechanistic hub of the creatine-PCr energy buffer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Creatine kinase 以 ATP 可逆磷酸化肌酸以產生磷酸肌酸，即肌肉磷酸原儲庫。此反應是肌酸-PCr 能量緩衝的機制樞紐。

nodes.label: CXCL14
nodes.description: CXCL14 (BRAK) is a constitutively expressed C-X-C chemokine that, unlike most CXC ligands, lacks the ELR motif and does not signal through classical CXCR1/2/3 receptors. Its expression is supported by the p53 tumor suppressor and the p21-Rb axis, placing it in the early p53/p21/Rb-dependent SASP program rather than the later NF-kB-driven inflammatory wave; it is thus often lost in p53-mutant cancers, removing an immune-surveillance cue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL14 (BRAK) 是持續表現的 C-X-C 趨化因子，與多數 CXC 配體不同，它缺少 ELR motif，也不經由典型的 CXCR1/2/3 受體傳遞訊號。其表現由腫瘤抑制蛋白 p53 與 p21–Rb 軸支撐，因此屬於早期 p53/p21/Rb 相依的 SASP 程式，而非後續 NF-κB 驅動的發炎波；它也常在 p53 突變的癌症中缺失，使免疫監視訊號消失。

nodes.label: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS)
nodes.description: Fibromyalgia is a chronic disorder of unknown etiology characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, non-restorative sleep and cognitive dysfunction. It is frequently comorbid with chronic fatigue syndrome, irritable bowel syndrome, migraine, temporomandibular joint disorder and mood disorders, and both fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue syndrome are thought to involve impaired energy metabolism, supporting a shared bioenergetic mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fibromyalgia 是一種病因未明的慢性疾病，特徵為廣泛性肌肉骨骼疼痛、疲勞、非恢復性睡眠與認知功能障礙。它常與 chronic fatigue syndrome、irritable bowel syndrome、migraine、顳顎關節障礙及情緒障礙共病，而 fibromyalgia 與 chronic fatigue syndrome 皆被認為涉及能量代謝受損，支持兩者共有的生物能量學機制。

nodes.label: Cristae
nodes.description: Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane that greatly increase its surface area and provide the confined compartment housing the respiratory chain complexes I-IV, ATP synthase, and TCA-cycle intermediates. They are the primary site of ATP synthesis and also contribute to calcium sequestration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cristae 是粒線體內膜的內褶，極大增加其表面積，並提供容納呼吸鏈複合體 I-IV、ATP synthase 與 TCA 循環中間產物的受限空間。它們是 ATP 合成的主要場所，也參與鈣的封存。

nodes.label: Creatinine
nodes.description: Serum creatinine is freely filtered by the glomeruli and is the cornerstone of routine renal function assessment, used to estimate GFR via Cockcroft-Gault, MDRD, and CKD-EPI equations. Its main limitation is dependence on muscle mass, protein intake, and drugs such as cimetidine or trimethoprim that inhibit tubular secretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serum creatinine 由腎小球自由濾過，是常規腎功能評估的基石，用於透過 Cockcroft-Gault、MDRD 與 CKD-EPI 公式估算 GFR。其主要限制是受肌肉量、蛋白質攝取，以及 cimetidine 或 trimethoprim 等抑制腎小管分泌的藥物影響。

nodes.label: p22-FLIP
nodes.description: p22-FLIP is the 22 kDa N-terminal fragment produced when caspase-8 cleaves c-FLIP (FLIP_L or FLIP_S) at Asp198 (Asp196 in some isoforms) in cytosolic, FADD-independent heterodimers. Retaining only DED1-DED2, it is generated off the DISC, unlike Asp376 processing, and its production is human-specific.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p22-FLIP 是在細胞質中、不依賴 FADD 的異源二聚體裡，caspase-8 切割 c-FLIP（FLIP_L 或 FLIP_S）於 Asp198（部分異構型為 Asp196）時產生的 22 kDa N 端片段。它僅保留 DED1–DED2，於 DISC 之外生成（不同於 Asp376 的加工），且其生成為人類專一。

nodes.label: Pancreatic Beta Cells
nodes.description: Pancreatic Beta Cells are the endocrine cells of the islets of Langerhans that synthesize and secrete Insulin in response to glucose. Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion couples glycolytic flux to granule exocytosis and requires intact mitochondrial function plus coordinated ERK and STAT3 signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pancreatic Beta Cells 是 Langerhans 島中負責合成並分泌 Insulin 的內分泌細胞。葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌將糖解通量與顆粒胞吐耦合，並需要完整的粒線體功能以及協調的 ERK 與 STAT3 訊號。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

nodes.label: EF24
nodes.description: EF24 is a synthetic, enone-containing analog of Curcumin engineered for greater chemical stability and cellular uptake. In senescence and fibrosis research it is profiled as a senomorphic, polyphenol-derived agent that counteracts stress-induced cellular aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EF24 是 Curcumin 的合成 enone 類衍生物，經設計以獲得更佳的化學穩定性與細胞攝取能力。在衰老與纖維化研究中，它被歸類為 senomorphic、多酚衍生的藥物，可對抗壓力誘發的細胞老化。

nodes.label: Synaptophysin
nodes.description: Synaptophysin (SYP) is a 38 kDa transmembrane glycoprotein of synaptic vesicles and among the most abundant proteins of the presynaptic terminal. It forms a channel-like complex with other vesicular proteins and participates in synaptic vesicle biogenesis, trafficking, exocytosis and membrane fusion during neurotransmitter release, making it a structural component of Synapse.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Synaptophysin（SYP）是突觸小泡的 38 kDa 跨膜醣蛋白，也是突觸前末端最豐富的蛋白質之一。它與其他囊泡蛋白形成通道狀複合體，參與突觸小泡生成、運輸、exocytosis 與神經傳遞物質釋放時的膜融合，因此是 Synapse 的結構組分。

nodes.label: DMT1
nodes.description: DMT1 expands the labile iron pool by importing STEAP3-reduced Fe2+ into the cytosol, and it is this labile iron that powers the Fenton reaction. DMT1 is therefore the downstream effector of the transferrin cycle for cytosolic iron delivery; blocking DMT1 or upstream TFR1/STEAP3 starves the Fenton reaction and protects against erastin-induced ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DMT1 藉由將 STEAP3 還原後的 Fe2+ 送入細胞質而擴大 labile iron pool，而正是這些 labile iron 驅動 Fenton reaction。因此 DMT1 是 transferrin cycle 在細胞質鐵供應上的下游效應因子；阻斷 DMT4 或上游的 TFR1/STEAP3 會使 Fenton reaction 缺乏鐵源，並防止 erastin 誘發的 ferroptosis。

nodes.label: Tyrosinase-related protein-1
nodes.description: Tyrosinase-related protein-1 and Tyrosinase are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Tyrosinase-related protein-1 and Tyrosinase may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase-related protein-1 和 Tyrosinase 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Tyrosinase-related protein-1 和 Tyrosinase 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: Pioneer Factor
nodes.description: A pioneer factor can bind its motif within closed, nucleosome-occupied chromatin and initiate local chromatin opening. In senescence, pioneer factors such as AP-1 are the initial drivers that open enhancers at SASP and senescence genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 先驅因子能在封閉、核小體佔據的染色質內結合其模體並啟動局部染色質開啟。在衰老中，諸如 AP-1 等先驅因子是開啟 SASP 與衰老基因增強子的初始驅動者。

nodes.label: Leptomycin B
nodes.description: Leptomycin B causes nuclear accumulation of the transcription factors TFEB, TFE3 and FOXO, which in turn enhances Autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis. Because CRM1 export is a key control layer over the autophagic transcriptional program, its blockade is a mechanistic probe of TFEB activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Leptomycin B 造成轉錄因子 TFEB、TFE3 與 FOXO 在細胞核內累積，進而增強 Autophagy 與溶酶體生成。由於 CRM1 依賴的核輸出是自噬轉錄程序的關鍵調控層，阻斷 CRM1 是探討 TFEB 活化機制的工具。

nodes.label: Benign Tumor
nodes.description: Benign tumors are dual-natured: OIS-type arrested lesions (nevi) are longevity-positive cancer barriers, whereas growth-signal-driven benign growths such as TSC1/TSC2-loss mTORC1 hamartomas are themselves disease (Tuberous Sclerosis, angiomyolipoma, epilepsy). Arrested growth is good; ongoing growth is bad.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 良性腫瘤具有雙重本質：OIS 型停滯病灶（痣）是長壽正向的癌症屏障，而由生長訊號驅動的良性生長（如 TSC1/TSC2 缺失 mTORC1 錯構瘤）本身即是疾病（結節性硬化症、血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇）。停滯的生長是好的；持續的生長是壞的。

nodes.label: Adrenal medulla
nodes.description: The Adrenal medulla is the inner parenchyma of the Adrenal gland, a neural-crest-derived neuroendocrine tissue that functions as a modified sympathetic ganglion. It is composed of large rounded Chromaffin cells that store catecholamines in dense-core vesicles alongside ATP, dopamine beta-hydroxylase, and chromogranins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenal medulla 是 Adrenal gland 的內層實質，屬神經嵴來源的神经內分泌組織，功能上等同於修飾過的交感神經節。它由大型圓形 Chromaffin cells 組成，這些細胞在緻密核心囊泡中與 ATP、dopamine beta-hydroxylase 及 chromogranins 一同儲存兒茶酚胺。

nodes.label: B Cells
nodes.description: B Cells are bone marrow–derived adaptive immune lymphocytes that differentiate into antibody-secreting plasma cells on antigen encounter, forming the humoral arm of the Adaptive Immune System alongside T Lymphocyte-mediated cellular immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: B Cells 是源自骨髓的適應性免疫淋巴球，在遇到抗原後分化為分泌抗體的漿細胞，與 T Lymphocyte 所介導的細胞免疫共同構成 Adaptive Immune System 的體液免疫臂。

nodes.label: TARG1
nodes.description: As a macrodomain ADP-ribose hydrolase, TARG1 hydrolyzes mono-ADP-ribose linked to aspartate and glutamate, cleaves the terminal protein-proximal residue of PAR chains, and converts O-acetyl/O-propionyl/O-butyryl-ADP-ribose - the by-products of sirtuin activity - into ADP-ribose plus free short-chain fatty acid.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 作為巨結構域 ADP-核糖水解酶，TARG1 會水解連結於天門冬胺酸與麩胺酸上的單 ADP-核糖，剪除 PAR 鏈末端最靠近蛋白質的殘基，並將 sirtuin 活性產生的 O-乙醯基／O-丙醯基／O-丁醯基-ADP-核糖轉為 ADP-核糖與游離短鏈脂肪酸。

nodes.label: Vitamin B3
nodes.description: Vitamin B3 (niacin) — nicotinic acid and nicotinamide — is the primary substrate for NAD+ biosynthesis via the Preiss-Handler and salvage pathways. Nicotinamide Riboside and Nicotinamide Mononucleotide are more bioavailable NAD+ precursors. Because NAD+ levels decline with age, adequate B3 intake supports the NAD+-dependent activity of SIRT1 and mitochondrial function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin B3（niacin，含 nicotinic acid 與 nicotinamide）是 NAD+ 經 Preiss-Handler 與 salvage 途徑生合成的主要受質。Nicotinamide Riboside 與 Nicotinamide Mononucleotide 則是生物利用度更高的 NAD+ 前驅物。由於 NAD+ 水平隨老化下降，充足的 B3 攝取可支持 SIRT1 的 NAD+ 相依活性與粒線體功能。

nodes.label: NAAD
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation substantially increases NAAD (nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide) levels, indicating flux through the deamidated Preiss-Handler pathway. Oral NR raised NAAD by 4.5-fold alongside more than twofold increases in NAD+ and 1.4-fold increases in NMN. Martens et al. reported about a fivefold increase in NAAD in blood of healthy middle-aged adults supplemented with 1 g/day NR for 6 weeks, and single doses of 100-1000 mg NR produced a roughly 2,900% increase in NAAD from undetectable baseline. NAAD is therefore a product and biomarker of NR metabolism that confirms the predominance of the deamidated route after NR intake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）大幅提升 NAAD（菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）水平，顯示流經去醯胺化 Preiss-Handler 路徑。口服 NR 使 NAAD 提升 4.5 倍，同時 NAD+ 增加超過兩倍、NMN 增加 1.4 倍。Martens 等人報告，每天補充 1 g NR 達 6 週的健康中年人血液中 NAAD 增加約五倍，而 100-1000 mg 單次 NR 劑量使 NAAD 從無法檢出的基線增加約 2,900%。因此，NAAD 是 NR 代謝的產物與生物標記，證實了 NR 攝取後去醯胺化途徑的優勢地位。

nodes.label: Peptide deformylase
nodes.description: Actinonin is a hydroxamate antibiotic and potent inhibitor of peptide deformylase, the enzyme that removes the N-terminal formyl group from nascent polypeptides in bacteria and mitochondria. Blocking it halts formyl-peptide processing in mitochondria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Actinonin 是含羥肟酸的抗生素，也是 Peptide deformylase 的強效抑制劑；該酵素負責移除細菌與粒線體新生多肽的 N 端甲醯基。抑制它會阻斷粒線體中的 formyl-peptide 加工。

nodes.label: Antioxidant Supplementation Paradox
nodes.description: The Antioxidant Supplementation Paradox — that high-dose antioxidant supplements can increase mortality, impair exercise adaptation and disrupt homeostasis — dissolves under hormetic thinking. ROS are not merely damaging byproducts but essential signalling molecules, and the biphasic dose-response means moderate ROS is beneficial while high ROS is harmful. Linear 'more antioxidant = better' logic ignores the hormetic zone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Antioxidant Supplementation Paradox（高劑量抗氧化補充可能增加死亡、損害運動適應與破壞恆定）在 hormesis 思維下得以化解。ROS 不只是損傷性副產物，更是必要的訊號分子；雙相劑量反應意味著中等 ROS 有益而高濃度 ROS 有害。線性的「抗氧化越多越健康」邏輯忽略了 hormetic zone。

nodes.label: SHP1
nodes.description: Extrinsic Pathway is restored by SHP1. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. SHP1 is a protein tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and reactivates caspase-8, restoring death-receptor-induced apoptosis. The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Extrinsic Pathway, so SHP1 is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 SHP1 恢復。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 SHP1 是一種蛋白質酪胺酸磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並重新活化 caspase-8，恢復死亡受體誘導的細胞凋亡。方向性從 SHP1 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 SHP1 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: RSL3
nodes.description: Inactivating GPX4 removes the cell's ability to reduce phospholipid hydroperoxides, so RSL3 treatment leads to accumulation of iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and hence ferroptosis. Glutathione depletion synergizes with RSL3 because GSH is the GPX4 cofactor, and adrenochrome is hypothesized to share a similar GPX4-inhibition mechanism via o-quinone electrophilic arylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 使 GPX4 失活會剝奪細胞還原磷脂過氧化物的能力，因此 RSL3 處理會導致鐵依賴性的 lipid peroxidation 累積，進而引發 ferroptosis。glutathione 耗竭與 RSL3 具有協同作用，因為 GSH 是 GPX4 的輔因子；而 adrenochrome 被假設透過鄰醌類的親電芳香化作用共享類似的 GPX4 抑制機制。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter
nodes.description: The mitochondrial calcium uniporter is a highly selective pore-forming channel of the inner mitochondrial membrane, the central subunit of a holocomplex including MCUb, EMRE and the calcium-sensing gatekeepers MICU1 and MICU2. Under basal cytosolic calcium MICU1/2 keep the pore closed; when local calcium rises at endoplasmic-reticulum-mitochondria contact sites they relieve inhibition, permitting cooperative high-capacity influx that shapes cytosolic calcium transients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter 是粒線體內膜上高度選擇性的成孔通道，為包含 MCUb、EMRE 與鈣感受性守門者 MICU1、MICU2 的整體複合體之核心次單元。在基礎細胞質鈣濃度下 MICU1/2 使孔道關閉；當內質網—粒線體接觸處局部鈣上升時，它們解除抑制，允許協同的高容量內流，藉以塑形細胞質鈣的暫態變化。

nodes.label: urea cycle
nodes.description: CPS1 catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step of the urea cycle, combining ammonium, bicarbonate and two ATP molecules in the mitochondrial matrix to form carbamoyl phosphate, which then condenses with ornithine to form citrulline. By converting a highly toxic amino acid catabolite into urea, CPS1 makes ammonia clearance essential to cellular and systemic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CPS1 催化尿素循環的第一步也是限速步驟，在粒線體基質中將銨離子、碳酸氫根與兩個 ATP 分子結合形成 carbamoyl phosphate，後者再與 ornithine 縮合形成 citrulline。藉由把高度有毒的胺基酸分解副產物轉為尿素，CPS1 使氨的清除成為細胞與全身健康所必需。

nodes.label: Rab5
nodes.description: Rab7 activation occurs as endosomes mature: the early endosome-specific GTPase Rab5, together with PtdIns3P, is replaced by late endosome-specific Rab7 and PtdIns(3,5)P2, with the Mon1–Ccz1 complex acting as Rab7's major GEF. Rab7 dysfunction thus reflects failure of the Rab5-to-Rab7 handoff during endolysosomal maturation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rab7 的活化發生在內體成熟過程中：內體特異的 GTP 酶 Rab5 與 PtdIns3P 被晚內體特異的 Rab7 與 PtdIns(3,5)P2 取代，其中 Mon1–Ccz1 複合體是 Rab7 的主要 GEF。因此 Rab7 的功能失調反映了內體成熟過程中 Rab5 到 Rab7 交接的失敗。

nodes.label: Loss of Y Chromosome
nodes.description: Mosaic loss of the Y chromosome (mLOY) is the most common somatic mutation in men — detectable in 40% of 70-year-olds and 57% of 93-year-olds. Y-deficient cells show T-cell exhaustion with PD-1 sensitivity that enables bladder-cancer growth, and roughly 500 autosomal genes are dysregulated in LOY leukocytes. Smoking is a reversible dose-dependent risk factor and inflammation amplifies LOY cardiovascular harm.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Y 染色體的嵌合性流失（mLOY）是男性最常見的體細胞突變，70 歲者有 40%、93 歲者有 57% 可檢出。Y 缺陷細胞出現對 PD-1 敏感的 T 細胞耗竭，使膀胱癌得以生長，且 LOY 白血球中約 500 個體染色體基因異常調控。吸菸是可逆的劑量依賴性風險因子，而 Inflammation 會放大 LOY 的心血管危害。

nodes.label: PTPN5
nodes.description: PTPN5 (STEP) removes the inhibitory phosphate from BAK at Tyr108, which licenses BAK for conformational activation and is a critical control point in mitochondrial apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTPN5（STEP）移除 BAK 在 Tyr108 上的抑制性磷酸基，賦予 BAK 構形活化的許可，是粒線體凋亡的關鍵控制點。

nodes.label: Target of rapamycin
nodes.description: Rapamycin inhibits Target of rapamycin, a central regulator of cell growth and metabolism whose pathway governs muscle protein synthesis and cell growth. Inhibition of this axis can extend lifespan through mechanisms that include adaptive mitochondrial ROS signaling, making it a major pharmacological target for longevity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 抑制 Target of rapamycin，一個調控細胞生長與代謝的中樞調節因子，其路徑掌控肌肉蛋白合成與細胞生長。抑制此軸可透過包括適應性粒線體 ROS 訊號在內的機制延長壽命，因此它是長壽研究的重要藥理標的。

nodes.label: Inflammatory Diseases
nodes.description: Inflammatory Diseases such as Rheumatoid Arthritis, Inflammatory Bowel Disease, psoriasis, and Atherosclerosis arise when unresolved Inflammation persists — that is, when NF-κB-driven cytokine circuits fail to terminate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 像 Rheumatoid Arthritis（類風濕性關節炎）、Inflammatory Bowel Disease（發炎性腸道疾病）、psoriasis（銀屑病）與 Atherosclerosis（動脈粥狀硬化）等 Inflammatory Diseases（發炎性疾病），都是當未解炎的 Inflammation（發炎）持續存在時產生——也就是當 NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素迴路無法終止時。

nodes.label: PSTK
nodes.description: SepSecS (selenocysteine synthase) acts on the O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec intermediate generated by the upstream kinase PSTK, replacing its phosphoseryl group with selenocysteine using monoselenophosphate as the selenium donor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SepSecS（selenocysteine synthase）作用於上游激酶 PSTK 所產生的 O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec 中間產物，以 monoselenophosphate 作為硒供體，將其 phosphoseryl 群換成 selenocysteine。

nodes.label: Iodoacetic Acid
nodes.description: Iodoacetic acid irreversibly inhibits glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase by alkylating its catalytic cysteine thiol, blocking glycolysis, depleting ATP, and — through disrupted disulfide handling and impaired NADH reoxidation — raising reactive oxygen species and promoting lipid peroxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 碘乙酸藉由烷基化甘油醛-3-磷酸去氫酶的催化性半胱胺酸硫醇，不可逆地抑制該酵素，阻斷糖解作用、耗竭 ATP，並透過破壞雙硫鍵處理與損害 NADH 再氧化而升高活性氧並促進脂質過氧化。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: PCAF
nodes.description: PCAF (p300/CBP-associated factor; KAT2B) is a histone acetyltransferase that acetylates histones and transcription factors, generally activating gene expression. It partners with the coactivators p300 and CBP in regulating muscle-gene transcription during myogenesis, and its acetylation promotes muscle-specific genes through coactivation with MyoD.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PCAF（p300/CBP 相關因子；KAT2B）是組蛋白乙醯化轉移酶，可乙醯化組蛋白與轉錄因子，通常活化基因表現。它在肌生成中與共活化因子 p300、CBP 合作調控肌肉基因轉錄，並透過與 MyoD 共活化促進肌肉特異性基因表現。

nodes.label: Michaelis-Menten Kinetics
nodes.description: The kinetic equations of the model are defined as three coupled ODEs where interactions between Input, Target and Output nodes are computed following a Michaelis-Menten approach of activation-deactivation. The Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from the Target to the Input node is the key parameter that distinguishes hormetic from monotonic responses, acting as an effective non-linear threshold that buffers the indirect pathway. The main limitation of this approach is that it implicitly assumes enzyme-substrate complex dissociation is basically instantaneous, which may not apply to all steps of a signaling pathway.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 模型的 kinetic equations 定義為三個 coupled ODEs，其中 Input、Target 和 Output 節點之間的交互作用按照 Michaelis-Menten 方法計算 activation-deactivation。Michaelis-Menten 常數 K21 是從 Target 到 Input 節點 backward interaction 的 key parameter，區分 hormetic 和 monotonic responses，作為 effective non-linear threshold 緩衝 indirect pathway。此方法的 main limitation 是它隱含假設 enzyme-substrate complex dissociation 基本上是 instantaneous，這可能不適用於 signaling pathway 的所有步驟。

nodes.label: Acetyl-L-Carnitine
nodes.description: Acetyl-L-Carnitine (ALC) is the acetylated form of L-Carnitine, the naturally occurring L-enantiomer. It facilitates the transport of long-chain fatty acids into Mitochondria for beta-oxidation and supplies an acetyl group for energy metabolism and acetylcholine synthesis, so it inherits the mitochondrial transport function of its parent compound. It is also grouped with Carnosine and Aminoguanidine as a compound shown to help prevent Cross-linking associated with aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acetyl-L-Carnitine（ALC）是天然存在的 L-映型 L-Carnitine 的乙醯化形式。它促進長鏈脂肪酸進入 Mitochondria 以進行 β-氧化，並供應乙醯基供能量代謝與乙醯膽鹼合成，因此承襲其母體化合物的粒線體運輸功能。它也與 Carnosine、Aminoguanidine 並列，被列為有助於預防老化相關 Cross-linking 的化合物。

nodes.label: Rad53p
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dysfunction — loss of respiratory complex subunits or cofactors — elevates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production at complexes III and I. The resulting ROS are sensed by a Tel1p-dependent signaling module that phosphorylates Rad53p, which then translocates to the nucleus and interfaces with chromatin-modifying complexes, illustrating how a core DNA damage signaling module is co-opted as a redox-responsive longevity regulator.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體功能障礙——呼吸鏈次單元或輔因子的喪失——會在複合體 III 與 I 處升高超氧陰離子與過氧化氫的生成。由此產生的活性氧被 Tel1p 相依的訊號模組感知並磷酸化 Rad53p，後者轉位至細胞核與染色質修飾複合體作用，說明核心 DNA 損傷訊號模組如何被徵用為氧化還原反應性的延壽調控者。

nodes.label: TRAF3
nodes.description: Beyond driving interferon induction, TRAF3 also negatively regulates NF-κB and MAPK pathways in certain contexts, balancing inflammatory output. This dual role positions TRAF3 as a node that couples antiviral type I interferon signaling to restraint of inflammatory transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了驅動干擾素誘導之外，TRAF3 在某些情境下也會負向調節 NF-κB 與 MAPK 途徑，以平衡發炎輸出。這種雙重角色使 TRAF3 成為將抗病毒的第一型干擾素訊號與發炎性轉錄的抑制連結在一起的節點。

nodes.label: DPPH
nodes.description: Vitamin E scavenges DPPH radicals as effectively as resveratrol at identical concentrations, with more than 50% of activity within the first 30 minutes. This head-to-head equivalence is what supports interpreting both compounds as comparably potent chain-breaking or hydrogen-donating antioxidants under assay conditions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin E 在相同濃度下清除 DPPH 自由基的效果與 resveratrol 相當，超過 50% 的活性出現在前 30 分鐘內。這項一對一的等效性，支持將兩者皆解讀為在 assay 條件下效力相當的鏈斷裂型或供氫型抗氧化劑。

nodes.label: Nucleotide Excision Repair
nodes.description: XPA is a central factor of the nucleotide excision repair pathway: it recognizes and verifies bulky DNA lesions such as UV-induced photoproducts, nucleates assembly of the repair complex, and is required for both global-genome and transcription-coupled repair; XPA mutations cause xeroderma pigmentosum.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XPA 是核苷酸切除修復途徑的核心因子：它辨識並驗證 UV 誘發光產物等 bulky DNA 損傷，啟動修復複合體的組裝，且為全基因組修復與轉錄耦聯修復所必需；XPA 突變會造成著色性乾皮症。

nodes.label: Silica
nodes.description: Silica-induced lysosomal membrane permeabilization spills lysosomal proteases including Cathepsin B into the cytosol; cytosolic Cathepsin B acts as a danger signal that triggers NLRP3 activation and downstream IL-1β maturation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Silica 造成的溶酶體膜通透化會使包括 Cathepsin B 在內的溶酶體蛋白酶外漏至細胞質；細胞質中的 Cathepsin B 作為危險訊號，誘發 NLRP3 活化與下游 IL-1β 成熟。

nodes.label: Vitamin D
nodes.description: Vitamin D is a group of fat-soluble secosteroids (vitamin D2 ergocalciferol and vitamin D3 cholecalciferol) responsible for increasing intestinal absorption of calcium, magnesium and phosphate, thereby regulating calcium and phosphate homeostasis. In humans it is a vitamin because the skin cannot synthesize it without UV exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin D 是一組脂溶性 secosteroid（vitamin D2 ergocalciferol 與 vitamin D3 cholecalciferol），負責增加腸道對 calcium、magnesium 與 phosphate 的吸收，藉此調節 calcium 與 phosphate 的恆定。在人類而言它之所以是維生素，是因為皮膚若無 UV 曝曬便無法自行合成。

nodes.label: Tunneling Nanotubes
nodes.description: Tunneling Nanotubes are thin, actin-rich membrane protrusions that establish direct cytoplasmic continuity between distant cells, allowing cGAMP and mtDNA to pass from a stressed sender to a naive receiver. Alongside extracellular vesicles, they are the two recognized routes of contact-dependent cGAS-STING spread.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tunneling Nanotube 是細長富含 actin 的膜突出構造，可讓相距很遠的細胞之間建立細胞質連續性，使 cGAMP 與 mtDNA 從受壓的發送細胞傳至未受刺激的接收細胞。與 extracellular vesicles 並列，它們是接觸依賴型 cGAS-STING 傳播的兩條已知途徑。

nodes.label: Sorafenib
nodes.description: Sorafenib is an orally active multi-kinase inhibitor targeting RAF, VEGFR and PDGFR, approved as first-line therapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (and certain renal and thyroid cancers) where it dampens RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling and angiogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sorafenib 是可口服的多激酶抑制劑，標的為 RAF、VEGFR 與 PDGFR，獲准作為晚期 hepatocellular carcinoma（以及部分腎癌與甲狀腺癌）的第一線治療，用以抑制 RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK 訊號與血管新生。

nodes.label: GABARAP
nodes.description: LGG-2 is one of the C. elegans orthologues of the yeast Atg8 and mammalian LC3/GABARAP proteins. As the Atg8 family ortholog of GABARAP, LGG-2 performs the membrane-tethering role that mammalian GABARAP plays in autophagosome formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LGG-2 是酵母 Atg8 與哺乳類 LC3/GABARAP 在 C. elegans 中的直系同源物之一。作為 GABARAP 的 Atg8 家族直系同源物，LGG-2 執行哺乳類 GABARAP 在 autophagosome 形成中所扮演的膜繫留角色。

nodes.label: AIFM2
nodes.description: AIFM2 carries parthanatic death by binding MIF through its E22 region, and the resulting AIF-MIF (PAAN) complex acts as the lead nuclease executioner, cutting DNA into 20-50 kb large-scale fragments. Nuclease-dead MIF or the inhibitor PAANIB-1 protects in alpha-synuclein fibril, MPTP, stroke and EAE models while sparing apoptosis and necroptosis, making parthanatic DNA cleavage pharmacologically separable.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AIFM2 透過 E22 區域結合 MIF 來執行 parthanatos 死亡，形成的 AIF-MIF（PAAN）複合體是目前最有力的核酸酶執行者，可把 DNA 切成 20–50 kb 的大片段。核酸酶失活的 MIF 或抑制劑 PAANIB-1 可在 alpha-synuclein 纖維、MPTP、中風與 EAE 模型中提供保護，且不影響 apoptosis 與 necroptosis，使 parthanatic 的 DNA 切割在藥理上可被區隔。

nodes.label: AC93253
nodes.description: AC93253 belongs to the compound class of sirtuin inhibitors, whose members block sirtuin deacetylase activity to probe sirtuin function in disease. Its micromolar potency and anticancer activity illustrate the rationale for SIRT2 inhibition as an anticancer strategy, tempered by the caution that SIRT2 inhibition may be counterproductive when combined with microtubule inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AC93253 屬於 sirtuin 抑制劑這一化合物類別，該類成員藉由阻斷 sirtuin 去乙醯化活性來探測 sirtuin 在疾病中的功能。它的微莫耳效力與抗癌活性說明了將 SIRT2 抑制作為抗癌策略的理由，但也須留意：與微管抑制劑併用時，SIRT2 抑制可能適得其反。

nodes.label: TALE
nodes.description: TALE proteins are the alternative programmable DNA-binding module, with a simpler one-to-one base-to-residue recognition code. Zinc finger recognition instead depends on neighbouring residues, making engineering more context-sensitive and requiring empirical validation; large repetitive arrays are also hard to deliver and can bind off-target, reducing wild-type mtDNA copy number.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TALE 蛋白是另一種可程式化 DNA 結合模組，具有較簡單的鹼基對殘基一對一辨識密碼。鋅指的辨識則依賴鄰近殘基，因此工程化更為情境敏感、需要實證驗證；此外，大型重複陣列難以遞送，也可能結合非標的位點，導致野生型 mtDNA 拷貝數下降。

nodes.label: Hes1 and Hey2
nodes.description: SIRT1 physically interacts with the bHLH transcriptional repressors Hes1 and Hey2 both in vitro and in vivo, modulating their ability to repress target promoters. Deacetylation by SIRT1 can alter the DNA-binding or co-repressor recruitment of these factors, tuning the strength of Notch-and-Hes-coupled gene silencing. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically modulates Hes1/Hey2 repression. This intersects with Notch and VEGF signaling and with SIRT1's neuroprotective regulation of BDNF, since Hes1 is a repressor of the BDNF promoter and SIRT1 relieves that repression through Hes1 deacetylation, linking this interaction to neuronal survival and cognitive function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在體外和體內與 bHLH 轉錄抑制因子 Hes1 和 Hey2 物理相互作用，調節它們抑制靶標啟動子的能力。SIRT1 的去乙醯化可以改變這些因子的 DNA 結合或共抑制因子招募，調節 Notch-Hes 偶聯的基因沉默強度。在方向性上，SIRT1 在酶學上調節 Hes1/Hey2 的抑制作用。這與 Notch 和 VEGF 信號以及 SIRT1 對 BDNF 的神經保護調節交匯，因為 Hes1 是 BDNF 啟動子的抑制因子，SIRT1 通過 Hes1 去乙醯化解除此抑制，將此相互作用與神經元存活和認知功能聯繫起來。

nodes.label: PROTAC
nodes.description: A PROTAC is a bifunctional molecule in which a target-binding warhead is linked to an E3 ubiquitin ligase recruiter, inducing proximity-dependent ubiquitination and degradation of the target via the ubiquitin proteasome system.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PROTAC 是一種雙功能分子，將標的結合 warhead 與 E3 泛素連接酶招募器相連，誘導鄰近依賴性泛素化，並經泛素-蛋白酶體系統降解標的。

nodes.label: VDAC
nodes.description: Hexokinase-1 anchors to the outer mitochondrial membrane through VDAC via an N-terminal hydrophobic helix, and VDAC-bound HK1 preferentially consumes mitochondrial ATP while stabilizing membrane potential. In Parthanatos, release of this anchor translocates HK1 to the cytosol, lowering its activity and membrane potential and sensitizing neurons to TNF/BAX-mediated death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hexokinase-1 透過 N 端疏水性螺旋與 VDAC 結合而錨定於粒線體外膜；與 VDAC 結合的 HK1 會優先使用粒線體 ATP 並穩定膜電位。在 Parthanatos 中，錨定解除會使 HK1 轉位至細胞質，降低其活性與膜電位，並讓神經元對 TNF/BAX 介導的死亡更加敏感。

nodes.label: Tyrosine Hydroxylase
nodes.description: Tyrosine Hydroxylase is the rate-limiting enzyme of catecholamine biosynthesis, catalysing the hydroxylation of the amino acid Tyrosine to L-DOPA, the precursor of dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine. Its expression is the standard histological marker for dopaminergic neurons, and neurons lose TH expression before they die in Parkinson's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tyrosine Hydroxylase 是 Catecholamine 生合成的速率限制酵素，催化胺基酸 Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA，而 L-DOPA 是 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的前驅物。其表現是 dopaminergic neuron 的標準組織學標記，且在 Parkinson's Disease 中神經元會在死亡前先失去 TH 表現。

nodes.label: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6
nodes.description: Tenovin-1 and tenovin-6 are small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors identified in a phenotypic screen for p53-activating compounds; they target SIRT1 and SIRT2, blocking their deacetylation of p53, with tenovin-6 showing improved cellular potency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 與 tenovin-6 是在 p53 活化化合物表型篩檢中鑑定出的小分子 sirtuin 抑制劑；它們以 SIRT1 與 SIRT2 為標的，阻斷兩者對 p53 的去乙醯化，其中 tenovin-6 具有更好的細胞效力。

nodes.label: GABARAPL1
nodes.description: GABARAPL1, an ATG8-family ubiquitin-like protein, is processed by the E1 Atg7, E2 Atg3, and E3 Atg12–Atg5–Atg16L1 machinery and then conjugated to phosphatidylethanolamine on nascent phagophores. This lipidation anchors it to autophagosome membranes and drives elongation, cargo recruitment, and lysosomal fusion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GABARAPL1 屬 ATG8 家族的泛素樣蛋白，經由 E1 Atg7、E2 Atg3 與 E3 Atg12–Atg5–Atg16L1 複合體加工後，與磷脂乙醇胺偶聯於新生吞噬膜上。此脂質化將其錨定在自噬體膜上，並促進膜的延長、貨物的招募與溶小體融合。

nodes.label: Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine (Pimagedine) is primarily known as a selective inhibitor of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), the enzyme responsible for producing high levels of nitric oxide during inflammation. By blocking iNOS, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of nitric oxide from the start of the inflammatory cascade, acting upstream of NO signaling. Because it selectively targets the inducible form rather than the healthy endothelial form (eNOS), it is considered a way to halt the inflammatory cascade without completely shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Pimagedine) 主要已知作為 inducible 硝酸 synthase (iNOS) 的選擇性抑制劑，該酶負責在發炎期間產生高濃度的硝酸鹽。通過阻斷 iNOS，氨基胍丁可以從發炎遞濫的開始處阻止硝酸鹽的過度產生，在 NO 訊號之前起作用。因為它選擇性地針對 inducible 形式而非健康內皮細胞形式 (eNOS)，因此被認為是停止發炎遞濫的方法，而無需完全關閉正常的血壓調節。

nodes.label: IκBζ
nodes.description: IκBζ (Inhibitor of NF-κB zeta) is a selective co-activator of NF-κB for a subset of target genes, including IL6 and IL8; by linking NF-κB signaling to specific secretome composition it acts as a master regulator of SASP interleukins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IκBζ（Inhibitor of NF-κB zeta）是 NF-κB 針對部分標的基因（含 IL6 與 IL8）的選擇性共同活化因子；藉由將 NF-κB 訊息連結到特定的分泌組成分，它成為 SASP interleukin 的主要調節因子。

nodes.label: iRGD peptide
nodes.description: iRGD homes to alphav tumor vasculature via its RGD motif as step one.
nodes.description_zh_TW: iRGD 經 RGD 基序歸巢 αv 腫瘤血管作為第一步。

nodes.label: Ornithine transcarbamylase
nodes.description: Misfolded or aggregation-prone ornithine transcarbamylase variants imported into the matrix expose hydrophobic regions that activate the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, shifting transcription toward chaperones, matrix proteases and antioxidant defenses while slowing general protein translation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 錯誤摺疊或易聚集的 [[Ornithine transcarbamylase]] 變異體進入粒線體基質後暴露疏水區域，活化 [[Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response]]，使轉錄轉向 chaperone、基質蛋白酶與抗氧化防禦，並暫時降低一般蛋白質轉譯。

nodes.label: Dapsone
nodes.description: Dapsone is one of the most common causes of drug-induced methemoglobinemia, particularly with chronic dosing, because its hydroxylamine metabolite oxidizes hemoglobin iron to methemoglobin. It also drives oxidative hemolysis, markedly worse in Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase deficiency; severe cases are treated with Methylene blue, which restores NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase-dependent reduction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dapsone 是藥物誘發性 methemoglobinemia 最常見的原因之一，尤其在長期給藥時，因為其羥胺代謝物會將 hemoglobin 的鐵氧化為 methemoglobin。它也會造成氧化性溶血，在 Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase 缺乏時更為嚴重；嚴重病例以 Methylene blue 治療，恢復 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 途徑的還原能力。

nodes.label: Rasburicase
nodes.description: Patients with G6PD deficiency cannot adequately regenerate reduced Glutathione to detoxify the peroxides generated by rasburicase, so they are at markedly increased risk of rasburicase-induced Methemoglobinemia and Hemolysis. Rasburicase is therefore contraindicated in G6PD-deficient individuals, and alternatives such as febuxostat or allopurinol are preferred.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G6PD 缺乏患者無法充分再生還原型 Glutathione 以解毒 rasburicase 產生的過氧化物，因此對 rasburicase 所致的 Methemoglobinemia 與 Hemolysis 的易感性顯著升高。故 G6PD 缺乏者禁用 rasburicase，並優先改用 febuxostat 或 allopurinol 等替代藥物。

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase
nodes.description: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase is the matrix-localized metalloprotease that removes N-terminal Mitochondrial Targeting Sequences from newly imported nuclear-encoded proteins shortly after they traverse the inner membrane, enabling proper folding and function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase 是位於基質的金屬蛋白酶，在新輸入的核基因編碼蛋白穿過內膜後不久，即切除其 N 端 Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence，使其得以正確摺疊並發揮功能。

nodes.label: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide
nodes.description: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a potent oxidant tool compound for stress studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是壓力研究的強效氧化劑工具化合物。

nodes.label: Autophagy Inducer
nodes.description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

nodes.label: Males
nodes.description: SIRT6 overexpression extends median lifespan of male mice by 14.5% and 9.9% with no significant effect in females (Kanfi et al., Nature 2012); the male-specific benefit tracks reduced serum IGF-1 and IIS. In the inbred C57BL/6JOlaHsd background (Roichman et al., Nat Commun 2021) it extends lifespan in both sexes, but the effect remains strongest in males (~27% vs ~15%), gated by baseline IGF-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表現使雄性小鼠中位壽命延長 14.5% 與 9.9%，對雌性無顯著效果（Kanfi 等，Nature 2012）；雄性特異獲益追蹤於血清 IGF-1 與 IIS 的降低。在近交 C57BL/6JOlaHsd 背景（Roichman 等，Nat Commun 2021）中於兩性皆延長壽命，但效應仍以雄性最強（約 27% 對 15%），受基礎 IGF-1 所調控。

nodes.label: c-Jun
nodes.description: SIRT6 functions as a negative regulator of cardiac hypertrophy by co-repressing c-Jun-dependent transcription at the chromatin level, thereby inhibiting downstream IGF-AKT signaling. In vivo inhibition of IGF signaling in SIRT6 knockout mice abrogates the hypertrophic response. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed c-Jun transcription and IGF-AKT signaling. By restraining this growth-promoting axis, SIRT6 limits the pathological growth signals that drive cardiac hypertrophy. The observation that blocking IGF signaling rescues the hypertrophic phenotype confirms that this pathway mediates the effect.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6作為心臟肥大的負向調節因子，透過在染色質水平共同抑制c-Jun依賴性的轉錄，從而抑制下游IGF-AKT訊號。在SIRT6基因敲除小鼠中體內抑制IGF訊號可消除肥大反應。方向上，SIRT6位於c-Jun轉錄抑制和IGF-AKT訊號抑制的上游。透過抑制此促生長軸，SIRT6限制了驅動心臟肥大的病理性生長訊號。阻斷IGF訊號可挽救肥大表型的觀察證實了此通路介導了該效應。

nodes.label: SNAPIN
nodes.description: Defective SNAPIN-dependent retrograde transport contributes to synaptic mitochondrial pathology in Alzheimer's disease. In AD models, mitophagy initiation is increased but transport is impaired, so partially degraded mitochondria accumulate within synapses; restoring SNAPIN transport clears these organelles and rescues synaptic function, linking SNAPIN failure to neurodegeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SNAPIN 依賴性逆向運輸的缺陷會促成 Alzheimer's disease 中的突觸粒線體病變。在 AD 模型中，mitophagy 的啟動增加但運輸受阻，導致部分降解的粒線體在突觸內堆積；恢復 SNAPIN 的運輸功能可清除這些胞器並挽救突觶功能，將 SNAPIN 失效與神經退化連結起來。

nodes.label: Acute Pancreatitis
nodes.description: Acute Pancreatitis is the sudden, severe form of Pancreatitis in which premature activation of digestive enzymes triggers acinar autodigestion, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage and a systemic inflammatory response. Severity ranges from mild self-limiting disease to necrotizing pancreatitis with multi-organ failure, and gallstones and alcohol are the most common triggers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acute Pancreatitis（急性胰臟炎）是 Pancreatitis（胰臟炎）中最驟急嚴重的形式，消化酵素過早活化造成腺泡細胞自我消化，導致粒線體功能障礙、氧化性傷害與全身性發炎反應。嚴重程度可由輕微自限性疾病到壞死性胰臟炎伴隨多重器官衰竭，以膽結石與酒精為最常見誘因。

nodes.label: miR-7
nodes.description: EGFR is the principal directly-repressed RTK target restraining proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EGFR 是主要的直接抑制 RTK 標的以約束增殖。

nodes.label: PEPCK
nodes.description: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase catalyzes the committed step of gluconeogenesis, converting oxaloacetate to phosphoenolpyruvate. It is a key control point for hepatic glucose output during fasting and for glyceroneogenesis in adipose tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷酸烯醇丙酮酸羧激酶催化糖質新生的關鍵步驟，將草醯乙酸轉為磷酸烯醇丙酮酸。它是禁食時肝臟葡萄糖輸出與脂肪組織甘油新生（glyceroneogenesis）的核心調控點。

nodes.label: Carbazochrome
nodes.description: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid is a highly water-soluble sulfonate derivative of carbazochrome. The sulfonation greatly improves aqueous solubility and is what makes carbazochrome clinically usable as an injectable haemostatic agent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid 是 Carbazochrome 的高水溶性磺酸衍生物。此磺化大幅提升水溶性，也正是使 Carbazochrome 能作為可注射止血藥物在臨床上使用的原因。

nodes.label: G0 Phase
nodes.description: G0 quiescence is reversible arrest while senescence is irreversible and inflammatory. The distinction separates protective stem-cell dormancy from pathological accumulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G0 靜止是可逆停滯，而衰老不可逆且發炎。此區別將保護性幹細胞休眠與病理性累積分開。

nodes.label: IRE1
nodes.description: IRE1 is activated by ER Stress: accumulation of unfolded proteins in the lumen triggers its kinase/RNase activity, launching the unfolded protein response branch that restores proteostasis. IRE1α, PERK, and ATF6 branches are also engaged as hormetic proteostasis responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IRE1 由 ER Stress（內質網壓力）活化：腔內未摺疊蛋白累積會觸發其激酶／RNase 活性，啟動恢復蛋白質穩定性的未摺疊蛋白反應分支。IRE1α、PERK 與 ATF6 分支也會作為 hormetic 蛋白穩定性反應而被啟動。

nodes.label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A
nodes.description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
