nodes.description_zh_TW: CPT2 對骨骼肌的長鏈脂肪酸氧化是必需的，而骨骼肌也是 CPT2 高度表現的主要部位；它讓肌肉與心臟得以氧化長鏈脂肪酸並將葡萄糖留給腦，同時在禁食期間支持肝臟糖質生成。CPT2 活性喪失會造成 CPT2 缺乏症中最輕且最常見的肌病型表型，表現為運動誘發的肌痛、無力與反覆發生伴肌紅蛋白尿的橫紋肌溶解，通常由長時間運動、禁食、寒冷或感染誘發；常見的始祖等位基因為 p.Ser113Leu。

nodes.label: HDAC3
nodes.description: Through its N-terminal domain HDAC4 recruits the catalytically active class I deacetylase HDAC3, linking acetyl-lysine reader function to real deacetylase activity. The HDAC4-HDAC3 complex integrates the H3K27ac landscape with control of SASP gene expression at AP-1-regulated enhancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC4 透過其 N 端結構域招募具有催化活性的 class I 去乙醯化酶 HDAC3，將 acetyl-lysine reader 功能與真正的去乙醯化活性連結。HDAC4-HDAC3 complex 將 H3K27ac 圖景與 AP-1 調控 enhancer 上的 SASP 基因表現控制整合起來。

nodes.label: α-Ketoglutarate
nodes.description: Alpha-ketoglutarate is generated from Glutamine via Glutaminase and subsequent glutamate conversion, making it the primary entry point for glutamine-derived carbon into the TCA cycle. Metabolic 13C tracing shows that in MYC-high cancer cells glutamine is the primary carbon source for alpha-ketoglutarate.
nodes.description_zh_TW: α-酮戊二酸由 Glutamine 經 Glutaminase 及後續的麩胺酸轉換而生成，因此它是麩醯胺胺衍生碳進入 TCA cycle 的主要入口。代謝性 ¹³C 追蹤顯示，在 MYC 高表現的癌細胞中，Glutamine 是 α-酮戊二酸的主要碳來源。

nodes.label: carbohydrate metabolism
nodes.description: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

nodes.label: Tenovin-6
nodes.description: Tenovin-6 inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 10 μM, making SIRT2 its more potent sirtuin target compared with SIRT1. Directionally, Tenovin-6 blocks SIRT2 catalysis. By inhibiting SIRT2 deacetylation, it can protect neurons and reactivate p53, and it also inhibits SIRT3 with an IC50 of 67 μM, so its effects span multiple sirtuins. It is a chemical probe distinguishing SIRT2 from other sirtuins, and its p53-reactivation activity underlies its anticancer phenotype. The moderate potency and limited selectivity require careful interpretation of Tenovin-6 studies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tenovin-6 以 IC50 10 μM 抑制 SIRT2，使其成為相較於 SIRT1 更強效的 sirtuin 靶標。在方向性上，Tenovin-6 阻斷 SIRT2 催化作用。透過抑制 SIRT2 去乙醯化，它可以保護神經元並重新活化 p53，同時也以 IC50 67 μM 抑制 SIRT3，因此其效應跨越多個 sirtuin。它是區分 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的化學探針，其 p53 重新活化活性構成了其抗癌表型的基礎。中等效力和有限的選擇性需要謹慎詮釋 Tenovin-6 的研究。

nodes.label: Liver Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: SIRT3 is protective in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout of Takeda G protein-coupled receptor 5 suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. The protective SIRT1/SIRT3 axis is a targetable balance for organ protection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 對肝臟缺血再灌注損傷具有保護作用：敲除 Takeda G 蛋白偶聯受體 5 會抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞並加重損傷。保護性的 SIRT1/SIRT3 軸是器官保護的可靶向平衡。

nodes.label: CDK5
nodes.description: CDK5 is activated by oxidative stress, linking redox status to its kinase activity. Separately, CDK5 phosphorylation of Noxa at Ser13 inactivates Noxa in metabolically regulated leukemia, so CDK5 sits at the intersection of stress signalling and apoptotic control.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDK5 會被氧化壓力活化，將氧化還原狀態與其激酶活性連結起來。另一方面，在代謝受調控的白血病中，CDK5 在 Ser13 磷酸化 Noxa 使其失活，因此 CDK5 處於壓力訊號與凋亡調控的交會處。

nodes.label: Flavonol
nodes.description: Myricetin is a Flavonol within the wider Flavonoids class, a polyphenol found across many fruits, vegetables and medicinal herbs. Its reported antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity follows the general structure-activity pattern of flavonols, and it was screened alongside Fisetin, Quercetin and Luteolin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Myricetin 是更廣泛 Flavonoids 類別中的 Flavonol，為存在於多種水果、蔬菜與藥草的多酚。其已知的抗氧化與抗發炎活性符合 flavonol 一般的結構—活性型態，並與 Fisetin、Quercetin、Luteolin 一同接受篩選。

nodes.label: NQO1
nodes.description: NQO1 (NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1, also called DT-diaphorase) performs a safe two-electron reduction of quinones to stable hydroquinones, bypassing the dangerous semiquinone intermediate. Healthy cells use this enzyme, together with GSTM2, to defend against aminochrome-induced toxicity. Because two-electron reduction prevents formation of reactive semiquinone radicals, NQO1 is a critical gatekeeper determining whether a quinone such as adrenochrome becomes a benign hydroquinone or a source of oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NQO1（NAD(P)H:醌氧化還原酶1，也稱DT-心肌黃酶）執行對醌的安全雙電子還原為穩定的氫醌，繞過危險的半醌中間體。健康細胞使用此酶，連同GSTM2，來防禦氨基色素誘導的毒性。由於雙電子還原防止活性半醌自由基的形成，NQO1是決定醌如腎上腺素色素成為良性氫醌還是氧化應激來源的關鍵守門員。

nodes.label: Butyrate
nodes.description: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid from microbial fermentation of dietary fiber, serves as a primary colonocyte energy source. It enhances barrier integrity by increasing expression of tight junction proteins like occludin, preventing systemic inflammation in a dose-sensitive hormetic manner.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Butyrate 是膳食纖維經微生物發酵產生的短鏈脂肪酸，也是結腸細胞的主要能量來源。它透過增加 tight junction 蛋白（如 occludin）的表現來強化屏障完整性，以劑量敏感的 hormesis 方式預防全身性發炎。

nodes.label: Senomorphics
nodes.description: Senescent cells are modulated by senomorphics, agents that suppress their deleterious SASP without eliminating the cell itself, leaving the growth arrest intact while dampening paracrine inflammation, fibrosis, and immune dysfunction. Senomorphics act on upstream SASP regulators -- including mTOR, NF-kB, JAK-STAT, p38 MAPK, and the BRD4/KDM4 chromatin axis -- within the senescent cell, and many also enhance autophagy. The approach is complementary to senolysis and preserves potentially beneficial acute-senescence functions such as wound healing and tumor suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞受 senomorphics 調控，senomorphics 是抑制其有害 SASP 而不消除細胞本身的藥劑，在保留生長停滯的同時減弱旁分泌發炎、纖維化與免疫失調。Senomorphics 作用於衰老細胞內上游 SASP 調節者——包括 mTOR、NF-κB、JAK-STAT、p38 MAPK 與 BRD4/KDM4 染色質軸——且多數也增強自噬。此途徑與 senolysis 互補，並保留潛在有益的急性衰老功能如傷口癒合與腫瘤抑制。

nodes.label: NB-4746
nodes.description: NB-4746 inhibits the NAD+-hydrolysing TIR domain of SARM1, preventing the axonal NAD+ catastrophe that drives Wallerian degeneration. Its brain-penetrant profile distinguishes it from earlier peripherally-restricted candidates and enables central nervous system indications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NB-4746 抑制 SARM1 水解 NAD+ 的 TIR 結構域，阻止驅動 Wallerian 變性的軸突 NAD+ 災難。其可穿過血腦障礙的特性使它有別於早期僅限周邊的候選藥物，並得以開展中樞神經系統的適應症。

nodes.label: SRT2104
nodes.description: SRT2104 is commonly classified as a Sirtuin Activating Compound (STAC) and is highly selective for SIRT1 over SIRT2 and SIRT3. A related STAC, SRT2104's relative SRT1720, and other agents such as MDL-801 with improved specificity reflect successive attempts to obtain isoform-precise sirtuin activators.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SRT2104 通常被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），且相對 SIRT2 與 SIRT3 對 SIRT1 具有高選擇性。同系列的 STAC（如 SRT1720）以及 MDL-801 等選擇性更佳的藥物，反映出取得異型專一性 sirtuin 活化劑的連續嘗試。

nodes.label: Protein Kinase A
nodes.description: Protein Kinase A phosphorylates the fission GTPase DRP1 at Ser637, a cAMP-dependent serine/threonine modification that retains DRP1 in the cytosol and prevents its recruitment to the outer mitochondrial membrane. PKA therefore negatively regulates mitochondrial fission, in contrast to pro-fission kinases such as ERK (Ser616) and CDK1 (Ser585).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Protein Kinase A 會在 Ser637 磷酸化裂解 GTP 酶 DRP1；這個 cAMP 依賴的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸修飾使 DRP1 留在 cytosol，阻止其被招募至 outer mitochondrial membrane。因此 PKA 負向調控粒線體分裂，與 ERK（Ser616）、CDK1（Ser585）等促分裂激酶相反。

nodes.label: leucine zipper transcription Factors
nodes.description: XBP1 is a member of the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors, which contain a basic region for DNA binding and a leucine zipper for dimerization. As a member of this class XBP1 can act as an activating or a repressing heterodimer partner depending on its splice variant, and it occupies the UPRE during ER Stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: XBP1 是 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子家族的成員，該家族含有負責結合 DNA 的鹼性區域與用於二聚化的亮胺酸拉鍊。作為此類成員，XBP1 依其剪接變體可作為活化型或抑制型的異二聚體夥伴，並在 ER Stress 期間佔據 UPRE。

nodes.label: PKA
nodes.description: PKA phosphorylates the initiator Caspase-9 at Ser99, Ser183 and Ser195, modulating its stability and activity so as to dampen the intrinsic apoptotic program. This survival-toned phosphorylation can protect normal cells under stress but also supports Cancer cell survival and resistance to cell death.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PKA 會在 Ser99、Ser183 與 Ser195 磷酸化起始型 Caspase-9，調節其穩定性與活性，從而抑制內在性凋亡程式。這種偏向存活的磷酸化可保護受壓的正常細胞，但也能支持 Cancer 細胞存活與對細胞死亡的抵抗。

nodes.label: Thrombocytopenia
nodes.description: ABT-263 causes Thrombocytopenia. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Thrombocytopenia is an abnormally low platelet count that, when caused by Bcl-xL inhibition, reflects the dependence of platelets on that survival protein. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Thrombocytopenia rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABT-263 導致Thrombocytopenia。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Thrombocytopenia 是異常低的血小板計數，當由 Bcl-xL 抑制引起時，反映了血小板對此存活蛋白的依賴性。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Thrombocytopenia 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Pin1
nodes.description: Pin1 isomerizes and stabilizes many oncoproteins such as cyclin D1, c-Myc and beta-catenin, while inactivating tumour suppressors including p53 and p27. Pin1 is overexpressed in many cancers and considered an oncogene, with overexpression correlating with poor prognosis in breast, lung and prostate cancer and its inhibition triggering apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pin1 異構化並穩定多種致癌蛋白，如 cyclin D1、c-Myc 與 beta-catenin，同時使包括 p53 與 p27 在內的腫瘤抑制因子失活。Pin1 在多種癌症中過度表現並被視為致癌基因，其過度表現與乳癌、肺癌與攝護腺癌的不良預後相關，而抑制 Pin1 會誘發癌細胞凋亡。

nodes.label: Menadione
nodes.description: Menadione (vitamin K3) is a synthetic naphthoquinone whose principal activity is redox cycling: it is one-electron reduced by NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase or mitochondrial NADH dehydrogenase to a semiquinone radical, which rapidly transfers the electron to molecular oxygen, regenerating the parent quinone while generating superoxide anion and downstream hydrogen peroxide. The result is a sustained burst of oxidative stress; at high doses menadione depletes glutathione, oxidizes thiols and triggers necrotic or apoptotic death, which is why it is no longer used clinically as a vitamin K source.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Menadione（vitamin K3）是合成萘醌，主要活性來自 redox cycling：它被 NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase 或粒線體 NADH dehydrogenase 單電子還原成半醌自由基，後者迅速將電子轉移給分子氧，在再生母體醌的同時產生 superoxide anion 與下游 hydrogen peroxide。結果是持續的 oxidative stress；高劑量下 menadione 會耗盡 glutathione、氧化硫醇並引發壞死或凋亡，因此已不再作為 vitamin K 補充品臨床使用。

nodes.label: o-quinone
nodes.description: Under conditions of Oxidative Stress, the catechol ring of Epinephrine loses electrons to generate an o-quinone (ortho-quinone). This is a highly reactive intermediate of epinephrine oxidation, the step that precedes adrenochrome formation, and it serves as a marker of oxidative decay in catecholamines.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Oxidative Stress 條件下，Epinephrine 的兒茶酚環失去電子而生成 o-quinone（鄰醌）。它是腎上腺素氧化過程中高度反應性的中間產物，位於形成 Adrenochrome 之前的那一步，並可作為兒茶酚胺氧化劣化的指標。

nodes.label: PANoptosome
nodes.description: The PANoptosome is the supramolecular complex that co-assembles the pyroptotic, apoptotic, and necroptotic arms so they fire simultaneously as PANoptosis. Because the three lethal pathways share one platform, blocking any single pathway does not prevent death, which is the complex's defining non-redundancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PANoptosome 是使發炎性裂解凋亡、凋亡與壞死凋亡三條臂同時組裝並以 PANoptosis 形式共同發作的超分子複合體。由於三條致死途徑共用同一平台，阻斷任一途徑都無法阻止死亡，這正是該複合體定義性的非冗餘性。

nodes.label: Smad7
nodes.description: Smad7 is an inhibitory SMAD that antagonizes TGF-beta signalling: lacking the SSXS phosphorylation motif of R-SMADs, it competitively binds the activated TGF-beta type I receptor (ALK5), blocking R-SMAD phosphorylation, recruiting Smurf1 to degrade the receptor and terminating the signal.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smad7 是抑制性 SMAD，可拮抗 TGF-beta 訊號：由於缺少 R-SMAD 的 SSXS 磷酸化序列，它會競爭性結合活化的 TGF-beta 第一型受體（ALK5），阻斷 R-SMAD 磷酸化、招募 Smurf1 降解受體並終止訊號。

nodes.label: Malate Dehydrogenase
nodes.description: Malate dehydrogenase (MDH) catalyzes the reversible, NAD+-dependent interconversion of oxaloacetate and malate (oxaloacetate + NADH + H+ ⇌ malate + NAD+). Cytosolic MDH1 reduces oxaloacetate to malate using cytosolic NADH, feeding the malate-aspartate shuttle, while mitochondrial MDH2 oxidizes malate back to oxaloacetate, regenerating NADH in the matrix for OXPHOS.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Malate dehydrogenase（MDH）催化草醯乙酸與蘋果酸之間可逆的、依賴 NAD+ 的相互轉換（草醯乙酸 + NADH + H+ ⇌ 蘋果酸 + NAD+）。細胞質中的 MDH1 利用細胞質 NADH 將草醯乙酸還原為蘋果酸以餵入蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭，而粒線體中的 MDH2 則將蘋果酸氧化回草醯乙酸，在基質中為 OXPHOS 再生 NADH。

nodes.label: Keratinocyte Growth Factor
nodes.description: Keratinocyte growth factor (KGF, FGF7) signals through the epithelial receptor FGFR2IIIb to stimulate proliferation and differentiation of thymic epithelial cells (TECs). It is critical for fetal thymus organogenesis and initial TEC expansion, and in aged animals it increases thymic size, thymocyte production, and output of naive CD4 T cells while restoring defined cortical and medullary compartments.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 角蛋白細胞生長因子（KGF，FGF7）透過上皮細胞特異的受體 FGFR2IIIb 傳遞訊號，刺激胸腺上皮細胞（TECs）的增殖與分化。它對胎兒期胸腺器官生成與 TEC 初始擴增至關重要；在老化動物中，它可增加胸腺大小、胸腺細胞產量與初始型 CD4 T 細胞的輸出，並恢復界線明確的皮質與髓質分區。

nodes.label: Akkermansia muciniphila
nodes.description: Akkermansia muciniphila is the principal gut-dwelling species of the genus Akkermansia (phylum Verrucomicrobia). It colonizes the intestinal mucus layer and degrades host mucin glycoproteins, and is consistently associated with gut barrier integrity and metabolic homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Akkermansia muciniphila 是 Akkermansia 屬（Verrucomicrobia 門）主要的腸道物種。它定殖於腸道黏液層並分解宿主黏蛋白醣蛋白，且與腸道屏障完整性及代謝恆定穩定相關。

nodes.label: S Phase
nodes.description: S Phase is the phase of the Cell Cycle in which DNA Replication occurs, producing two copies of the genome; it follows G1 Phase and precedes G2 Phase, and the pre-replication complex (ORC, CDC6, CDT1, MCM helicase) is assembled to license the process.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S Phase 是 Cell Cycle 中進行 DNA Replication 的階段，會產生兩份基因組拷貝；它緊接 G1 Phase 並在 G2 Phase 之前，且前複製複合體（ORC、CDC6、CDT1、MCM 解旋酶）會先行組裝以授權此過程。

nodes.label: Bacteroidetes
nodes.description: Gut Bacteroidetes ferment dietary fiber, resistant starch and host glycans that host enzymes cannot digest into Short-chain Fatty Acids — principally acetate and propionate — plus succinate; these metabolites nourish colonocytes, modulate hepatic lipid metabolism, and engage enteroendocrine and immune cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腸道 Bacteroidetes 會將宿主酵素無法消化的膳食纖維、抗性澱粉與宿主聚醣發酵成 Short-chain Fatty Acids（主要是乙酸與丙酸）以及琥珀酸；這些代謝物滋養結腸細胞、調節肝臟脂質代謝，並與腸泌神經細胞及免疫細胞互動。

nodes.label: TRAK1
nodes.description: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) is a mitochondrial transport adaptor protein that forms a complex with Optineurin (OPTN) and KIF5B for proper anterograde axonal mitochondrial transport. OPTN directly interacts with TRAK1 and KIF5B in a C-terminal-dependent manner to stabilize them, and the OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B complex is critical for axonal mitochondrial distribution.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) 是粒線體運輸轉接蛋白，與 Optineurin (OPTN) 及 KIF5B 形成複合體，以進行正確的軸突順向粒線體運輸。OPTN 以依賴 C 端的方式直接與 TRAK1 及 KIF5B 互動並使其穩定，而 OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B 複合體對軸突粒線體分布至關重要。

nodes.label: Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase
nodes.description: Due to the risk of hemolysis and worsening anemia, methylene blue is contraindicated in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency. The hemolysis associated with methylene blue is mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties that overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, and G6PD-deficient individuals have impaired NADPH generation that limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis. Methylene blue is also contraindicated in individuals with a known history of anaphylaxis or severe hypersensitivity to methylene blue or related thiazine dye products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於溶血和貧血惡化的風險，methylene blue在葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者中是禁忌的。與methylene blue相關的溶血在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，而G6PD缺乏個體的NADPH生成受損，限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，易於快速溶血。Methylene blue在已知有對methylene blue或相關噻嗪染料產品過敏或嚴重超敏反應病史的個體中也是禁忌的。

nodes.label: A1-Bfl-1
nodes.description: A1-Bfl-1 is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member.
nodes.description_zh_TW: A1-Bfl-1 是抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員。

nodes.label: Noxa
nodes.description: Noxa selectively binds Mcl-1 and promotes its degradation, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Noxa 選擇性結合 Mcl-1 並促進其降解，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感化。

nodes.label: Oxygen-Glucose Deprivation
nodes.description: OGD reduced retinal cell viability at 3, 6, and 24 h, modeling ischemia-induced oxidative stress. Co-treatment with 10 uM Brosimine B restored viability at 3 h (107%) and partially at 6 h, but not at 24 h. The protection is therefore time-limited to early hypoxia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OGD 在 3、6、24 小時均降低視網膜細胞存活率，模擬缺血引起的氧化壓力。10 uM Brosimine B 共處理在 3 小時恢復存活率（107%），6 小時部分恢復，24 小時則無效。因此其保護作用僅限於早期缺氧階段。

nodes.label: Cortisol
nodes.description: Chronically elevated cortisol, from stacked stressors or poor recovery, suppresses heart-rate variability (HRV) and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis. Acute cortisol release supports the fight-or-flight response, but sustained elevation undermines parasympathetic recovery and HRV rebound.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 長期升高的 cortisol（源自疊加壓力或恢復不足）會抑制心率變異度（HRV）並損害粒線體生合成。急性 cortisol 釋放支持戰或逃反應，但持續升高會破壞副交感恢復與 HRV 反彈。

nodes.label: SWI-SNF Complex
nodes.description: The SWI-SNF complex (called BAF in mammals) is an ATP-dependent chromatin-remodeling machine with catalytic subunits SNF2H and SNF2L that slides, evicts or restructures nucleosomes to regulate DNA accessibility and transcription. Because it controls nucleosome positioning, its coordination with cGAS may also influence DNA damage repair, replication and genome stability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SWI-SNF Complex（在哺乳類稱為 BAF）是 ATP 依賴性的染色質重塑機器，其催化次單元 SNF2H 與 SNF2L 可滑動、驅逐或重塑核小體，以調控 DNA 可及性與轉錄。由於它控制核小體定位，其與 cGAS 的協同作用也可能影響 DNA damage 修復、複製與基因體穩定性。

nodes.label: Deiodinase
nodes.description: Deiodinases gatekeep thyroid hormone action at the tissue level by controlling local triiodothyronine availability independently of systemic thyroid status. DIO2 converts thyroxine (T4) to active T3, DIO3 inactivates T4 and T3 to reverse T3, and DIO1 contributes to both activation and inactivation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Deiodinase 在組織層級守護 thyroid hormone 的作用，獨立於全身甲狀腺狀態地調控局部 triiodothyronine 的可用量。DIO2 將 thyroxine (T4) 轉換為活性 T3，DIO3 將 T4 與 T3 去活化為 reverse T3，而 DIO1 則同時參與活化與去活化。

nodes.label: Kynurenine
nodes.description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

nodes.label: Artesunate
nodes.description: Artesunate is safe and approved for malaria, and repurposing it for ferroptosis-driven oncology is under active study. In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, ART specifically induced ROS production and activated ferroptosis, with combinations such as piperlongumine, Cotylenin A and sulfasalazine amplifying ferroptotic killing. Its action can be potentiated by raising labile iron or combining with GPX4 inhibitors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Artesunate 安全且已核准用於瘧疾，將其重新定位用於 ferroptosis 驅動的腫瘤學正在研究中。在胰管腺癌中，ART 可特定誘發 ROS 生成並活化 ferroptosis，與 piperlongumine、Cotylenin A 或 sulfasalazine 併用可放大鐵死亡殺傷。其作用可藉提高 labile iron 或與 GPX4 抑制劑併用而增強。

nodes.label: NFS1
nodes.description: NFS1 is abundantly expressed in highly differentiated lung adenocarcinomas, where it maintains iron-sulfur cluster homeostasis. This high expression marks the tumor as dependent on desulfurase activity for cluster supply, and it is why NFS1 has been proposed as a combinatorial therapeutic target in lung adenocarcinoma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NFS1 在高度分化的肺腺癌中高度表現，藉此維持鐵硫簇恆定。這樣的高度表現標示出腫瘤依賴 desulfurase 活性來供應鐵硫簇，也是 NFS1 被提出作為肺腺癌合併治療標的的原因。

nodes.label: CHOP
nodes.description: CHOP is a member of the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors, sharing the basic region plus leucine zipper architecture with ATF4, XBP1, CREB, FOS and JUN. This family is relevant to autophagy because its members are activated by stress signals such as ER Stress and nutrient deprivation, where they rewire transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CHOP 是 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子家族的成員，與 ATF4、XBP1、CREB、FOS、JUN 共用「鹼性區域加亮胺酸拉鍊」的架構。此家族與自噬相關，因為其成員會被 ER Stress 與營養剝奪等壓力訊號活化，並在其中改寫轉錄程式。

nodes.label: JAK2
nodes.description: Ruxolitinib inhibits JAK2, the second of its two primary kinase targets; it was the first JAK inhibitor approved by the FDA (2011 for myelofibrosis, 2014 for polycythemia vera) and is also used in steroid-refractory acute graft-versus-host disease and, as a topical cream, in atopic dermatitis and vitiligo.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 抑制 JAK2，這是它兩個主要激酶標的中的第二個；它是首個獲 FDA 核准的 JAK 抑制劑（2011 年用於骨髓纖維化、2014 年用於真性紅血球增多症），並用於類固醇無效的急性移植物抗宿主病，外用乳膏則用於異位性皮膚炎與白斑症。

nodes.label: Citrate Synthase
nodes.description: Citrate Synthase is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyses the first committed step of the TCA cycle, condensing Acetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate to form Citrate. Its activity is also used as a standard biochemical marker of mitochondrial density and tissue oxidative capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Citrate Synthase 是粒線體基質酵素，催化 TCA cycle 的第一個committed步驟，將 Acetyl-CoA 與 oxaloacetate 縮合形成 Citrate。其活性同時被用作粒線體密度與組織氧化能力的標準生化指標。

nodes.label: Gyrate Atrophy
nodes.description: Gyrate atrophy is a rare autosomal recessive chorioretinal degeneration caused by mutations in the OAT gene encoding ornithine aminotransferase. The deficiency produces sharply demarcated circular atrophic lesions in the mid-peripheral retina that enlarge, coalesce, and lead to tunnel vision and legal blindness by age 40-50.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gyrate atrophy 是一罕見的體染色體隱性脈絡視網膜退化症，由編碼 ornithine aminotransferase 的 OAT 基因突變造成。缺乏使中周邊視網膜出現邊界清楚的圓形萎縮病灶，逐漸擴大融合，導致管狀視野並在 40 至 50 歲達法定失明。

nodes.label: Adiposity
nodes.description: Protein restriction reduces adiposity while increasing energy expenditure, an effect that occurs despite increased food intake. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body fat, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose homeostasis, with effects most pronounced in males but also present in females, and it remains effective when initiated late in life (18-20 months). These metabolic benefits are largely mediated by FGF21, which promotes energy expenditure through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue and increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue, shifting brain signaling toward protein appetite. Randomized controlled trials confirm low-protein diets reduce body weight and fat mass in humans despite increased caloric intake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制減少脂肪量同時增加能量消耗，這種效應在食物攝入增加的情況下發生。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體脂肪，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖恆定性，效應在雄性中最明顯，但在雌性中也存在，並且在生命晚期開始（18-20個月）仍然有效。這些代謝益處主要由FGF21介導，FGF21透過UCP1依賴的白色脂肪組織產熱米色化促進能量消耗，並增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱，將腦訊號轉向蛋白質食慾。隨機對照試驗證實，儘管熱量攝入增加，低蛋白飲食減少人類的體重和脂肪量。

nodes.label: FRAT2
nodes.description: FRAT2 binds GSK3β competing with Axin to disrupt the destruction complex. Inhibition releases beta-catenin signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FRAT2 結合 GSK3β 與 Axin 競爭以破壞降解複合體。抑制釋放 beta-catenin 訊號。

nodes.label: JMJD3
nodes.description: In senescence, JMJD3 overexpression specifically reduces H3K27me3 levels at the IL-6 and IL-8 promoters, elevating their expression along with other SASP factors; because NF-κB can recruit H3K27 demethylases to inflammatory loci, JMJD3 cooperates with NF-κB signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在衰老過程中，JMJD3 的過量表現會專一性地降低 IL-6 與 IL-8 啟動子上的 H3K27me3 濃度，升高其表現及其他 SASP 因子；由於 NF-κB 可招募 H3K27 去甲基化酶至發炎位點，JMJD3 與 NF-κB 訊息相互協作。

nodes.label: Metabolites
nodes.description: Metabolites are the small molecules (typically <1.5 kDa) that participate in or are produced by Metabolism; they are the substrates, intermediates, and end products of enzyme-catalyzed biochemical networks. Their collective profile constitutes the Metabolome and shifts with age and microbiome composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metabolites 是參與或由 Metabolism 產生的small molecules（通常 <1.5 kDa），也是酵素催化的生化網路中的受質、中間產物與終產物。它们的集合即構成 Metabolome，並隨年齡與微生物組組成而改變。

nodes.label: CYP2C19
nodes.description: CYP2C19 is a member of the Cytochrome P450 superfamily: a membrane-bound hemoprotein in the endoplasmic reticulum that uses NADPH and molecular oxygen to insert an oxygen atom into substrates via a high-valent iron-oxo species, favouring lipophilic, weakly basic drugs. It contributes both to detoxification and to the activation of prodrugs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CYP2C19 是 Cytochrome P450（細胞色素 P450）超家族的成員：為位於內質網的膜結合血基質蛋白，利用 NADPH 與分子氧經由高價鐵—氧中間物將氧原子插入受質，偏好親脂性、弱鹼性藥物。它同時參與解毒與前驅藥的活化。

nodes.label: IFNAR1
nodes.description: IFNAR1 is a transmembrane receptor subunit that partners with IFNAR2 to form the heterodimeric receptor for Type I Interferon (IFN-α/IFN-β). Within the CNS it is the critical conduit that links microglial Type I Interferon release to neuronal dysfunction: sustained IFN-I from activated Microglia engages neuronal IFNAR1, initiating JAK-STAT signaling that suppresses the MEF2C resilience program in tauopathy models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IFNAR1 是跨膜受體次單元，與 IFNAR2 組成異源二聚體受體以接受 Type I Interferon（IFN-α/IFN-β）。在中樞神經系統中，它是將 Microglia 釋放的 Type I Interferon 連結至神經元功能障礙的關鍵通道：活化 Microglia 持續分泌 IFN-I 作用於神經元 IFNAR1，啟動 JAK-STAT 訊號，在 tauopathy 模型中抑制 MEF2C 抗逆境基因程式。

nodes.label: Epilepsy
nodes.description: Loss-of-function mutations in SLC6A8 cause creatine transporter deficiency (CTD, OMIM #300352), an X-linked recessive disorder accounting for about 2% of intellectual disability in males. Features include global developmental delay, epilepsy, speech/language delay, autistic-like behaviors and movement disorders; diagnosis rests on elevated urinary creatine:creatinine ratio and reduced brain creatine on MRS. Unlike AGAT/GAMT deficiencies, oral creatine supplementation is less effective because the transporter defect blocks cellular uptake.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC6A8 的失功能突變會造成肌酸轉運蛋白缺乏症（CTD，OMIM #300352），一種 X 聯隱性遺傳疾病，約占男性智障的 2%。其特徵包括整體發育遲緩、癲癇、語言發育遲緩類自閉症狀與運動障礙；診斷依據為尿中肌酸／肌酸酐比值升高及 MRS 上腦肌酸降低。與 AGAT／GAMT 缺乏不同，口服肌酸補充效果較差，因為轉運蛋白缺陷阻斷了細胞攝取。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Ascariasis
nodes.description: Ascaris is a genus of large parasitic roundworms whose principal human species, Ascaris lumbricoides, causes Ascariasis. The infective embryonated eggs are ingested, larvae hatch in the small intestine and migrate through the portal circulation, liver, heart and lungs before being swallowed back into the intestine, where they mature into 15-30 cm adults; the prepatent period is roughly 60-75 days.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ascaris 是大型寄生圓蟲的一屬，其主要人體寄生物種 Ascaris lumbricoides 會引起 Ascariasis（蛔蟲病）。感染途徑為攝入帶胚胎的蟲卵，幼蟲在小腸孵化後穿過腸壁，經門脈循環、肝臟、心臟與肺臟移行，再被咳吞回小腸成熟為 15–30 公分的成蟲；潛伏期（感染至產卵）約為 60–75 天。

nodes.label: Nucleus Accumbens
nodes.description: Nucleus Accumbens is the ventral striatal region that forms the heart of the brain's reward circuitry, and it is subdivided into a core and a shell with distinct inputs and outputs. As a limbic–motor interface it integrates motivational, emotional and cognitive signals to direct goal-directed and habitual behaviour, making it a key target for reward, addiction and affective disease research.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 伏隔核（Nucleus Accumbens）是腹側紋狀體（Striatum）的區域，構成腦部獎賞迴路的核心，並可分為核心部與殼部，各自具有不同的輸入與輸出。作為邊緣—運動的介面，它整合動機、情緒與認知訊號以引導目標導向與習慣性行為，因此是研究獎賞、成癮與情感疾病的重要標的。

nodes.label: Unfolded Protein Response
nodes.description: The Unfolded Protein Response is the conserved ER Stress pathway activated when misfolded proteins accumulate in the ER lumen, and it is the central mechanism maintaining ER proteostasis. IRE1, PERK and ATF6 act as three parallel sensor branches, all held inactive by the chaperone BiP (GRP78) until it is titrated away.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Unfolded Protein Response 是在錯誤折疊蛋白累積於內質網腔時活化的保守性 ER Stress 途徑，也是維持 ER proteostasis 的核心機制。IRE1、PERK 與 ATF6 為三條平行感測分支，在被伴護蛋白 BiP（GRP78）結合而維持不活化，直到 BiP 被抽調去協助折疊。

nodes.label: Miro
nodes.description: Miro serves as the mitochondrial docking site for the Milton adaptor, which in turn recruits kinesin motors. Together Miro-Milton-kinesin forms the transport machinery that moves mitochondria along axons, and mutations in MFN2 that disrupt this linkage cause Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A with axonal mitochondrial depletion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Miro 作為 Milton adaptor 的粒線體停靠位點，而 Milton 再招募 kinesin 馬達。Miro-Milton-kinesin 共同構成沿軸突運送粒線體的運輸機器；破壞此連結的 MFN2 突變會造成 Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A，伴隨軸突粒線體耗竭。

nodes.label: Rb
nodes.description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is enforced by Rb. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Retinoblastoma protein is a tumor suppressor that, when hypophosphorylated, binds E2F to block S-phase entry and underpins senescence arrest. The directionality runs from Rb toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Rb is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Rb 強制執行。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白是一種蛋白質，當低磷酸化時，它會與 E2F 結合，阻止進入 S 期並支持老化停滯。方向性從 Rb 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Rb 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md

nodes.label: H2A.J
nodes.description: The histone variant H2A.J is enriched at the promoters of SASP genes, where it facilitates changes in chromatin accessibility that induce SASP expression. H2A.J accumulates in human senescent fibroblasts, in aged human skin, and in mouse tissues, particularly in response to persistent DNA damage. This DNA damage-associated incorporation of H2A.J at inflammatory gene loci links the DNA damage response to the activation of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. This enrichment distinguishes H2A.J from canonical histones and marks the switch toward inflammatory gene expression in senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 組蛋白變異體 H2A.J 在 SASP 基因的啟動子處富集，它促進染色質可及性的變化，從而誘導 SASP 表達。 H2A.J 在人類老化成纖維細胞、衰老人類皮膚和小鼠組織中積累，特別是在對持續 DNA 損傷的反應中。這種與 DNA 損傷相關的 H2A.J 在發炎基因位點的摻入將 DNA 損傷反應與老化相關分泌表型的活化聯繫起來。這種富集將 H2A.J 與典型組蛋白區分開來，並標誌著衰老細胞中向發炎 gene expression 的轉變。

nodes.label: T Lymphocyte
nodes.description: Thymopoiesis is the process by which T cell development, maturation and induction of self-tolerance occur in the thymic epithelial space. Lymphoid progenitors enter the thymus at the cortico-medullary junction, migrate to the outer cortex for early development and TCR gene rearrangement and positive selection, then return to the medulla for negative selection before export to the periphery. Reduction of functional thymopoiesis with aging results in loss of TCR gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胸腺生成是 T 細胞發育、成熟和自身耐受誘導在胸腺上皮空間中發生的過程。淋巴祖細胞在皮髓交界處進入胸腺，遷移至外皮質進行早期發育和 TCR 基因重排及陽性選擇，然後返回髓質進行陰性選擇，最後輸出至外周。隨著年齡增長，功能性胸腺生成的減弱導致 TCR 基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。

nodes.label: Ischemia
nodes.description: Reduced perfusion from constriction directly causes ischemia. Causation is the flow to injury step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 收縮減少灌流直接導致缺血。因果是血流到損傷步驟。

nodes.label: Stress-Induced Senescence
nodes.description: Stress-Induced Senescence is a form of Senescence triggered by acute cellular stressors rather than replicative exhaustion. Inducers include genotoxic agents, oxidative stress, oncogene activation, mitochondrial dysfunction (MiDAS), epigenetic disruption and proteotoxic stress, and it engages the p53-p21 and p16-RB tumour suppressor pathways to produce stable cell cycle arrest and SASP activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stress-Induced Senescence 是由急性細胞壓力而非複製性耗竭觸發的 Senescence 形式。誘發因子包含 genotoxic agent、oxidative stress、oncogene 活化、mitochondrial dysfunction（MiDAS）、epigenetic 失調與 proteotoxic stress，並啟動 p53-p21 與 p16-RB 腫瘤抑制路徑以造成穩定的細胞週期停滯與 SASP 活化。

nodes.label: TREM2
nodes.description: TREM2 tone bidirectionally shapes both microglial and astrocytic responses: TREM2 haploinsufficiency intensifies Astrocyte Senescence, indicating that loss of TREM2 function accelerates glial senescence. Because TREM2 both gates inflammatory signaling and supports microglial homeostasis, it is a prime target for immunomodulatory strategies that dampen maladaptive IFN-I programs without abolishing protective microglial functions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TREM2 的作用量能雙向塑造微膠細胞與星狀膠細胞的反應：TREM2 單倍體功能不足會加劇 Astrocyte Senescence，顯示 TREM2 功能喪失會加速膠細胞的 Senescence。由於 TREM2 既能閘控發炎訊號又能支持微膠細胞恆定，它是免疫調節策略的绝佳標的，可在不犧牲保護性微膠細胞功能的前提下抑制失適應性的 IFN-I 程式。

nodes.label: Pirfenidone
nodes.description: Pirfenidone is a synthetic anti-inflammatory and antifibrotic drug approved for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis that inhibits TGF-beta signaling and reduces oxidative stress. In the fisetin senolytic screen (Yousefzadeh et al., 2018) it was included in the 10-compound flavonoid panel at 5 uM and showed no significant reduction in senescent cell burden in Ercc1-/- MEFs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pirfenidone 是合成的小分子抗發炎與抗纖維化藥物，已核准用於 Pulmonary Fibrosis，可抑制 TGFβ 訊號並降低 oxidative stress。在 fisetin senolytic 篩選試驗（Yousefzadeh 等，2018）中，它以 5 µM 納入 10 種化合物組成的 panel，且在 Ercc1-/- MEF 中未顯著降低 senescent cell 數量。

nodes.label: Amphiregulin
nodes.description: Amphiregulin (AREG) is an epidermal growth factor family ligand that binds the EGFR (ERBB1) receptor, triggering receptor dimerization and autophosphorylation. Downstream signalling engages the MAPK/ERK, PI3K/Akt and STAT pathways to stimulate proliferation, survival and migration. AREG is shed from the cell surface as a transmembrane precursor by ADAM17 (TACE) to yield the soluble mature factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amphiregulin（AREG）是表皮生長因子家族的配體，與 EGFR（ERBB1）受體結合後引發受體二聚化與自體磷酸化。下游訊息傳遞啟動 MAPK/ERK、PI3K/Akt 與 STAT 路徑，促進增殖、存活與遷移。AREG 先以跨膜前驅物形式存在，再由 ADAM17（TACE）從細胞表面剪切釋出可溶性成熟因子。

nodes.label: Cathepsin L1
nodes.description: Cathepsin L1 (CTSL), a lysosomal cysteine protease, cleaves the N-terminal tail of the replication-independent histone variant H3.3 during chromatin remodeling and DNA-damage responses. This tail clipping erases post-translational modifications that control cell-cycle regulators, altering the chromatin landscape at senescence loci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cathepsin L1（CTSL）為溶酶體半胱胺酸蛋白酶，會在染色質重塑與 DNA 傷害反應期間切割複製非依賴型組蛋白變異體 H3.3 的 N 端尾部。此尾部切割會抹除調控細胞週期相關因子的轉譯後修飾，改變衰老基因座周圍的染色質景觀。

nodes.label: Keap1
nodes.description: Keap1's homolog WDR-23 restrains SKN-1 by tethering it in the cytoplasm under basal conditions. Oxidative or electrophilic stress inactivates the BTB–Kelch repressor, releasing SKN-1 so it can accumulate in the nucleus and induce phase-II enzymes, xenobiotic transporters, and proteostasis genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Keap1 的同源物 WDR-23 在基礎狀態下將 SKN-1 繫留於細胞質而抑制它。氧化或親電性壓力使 BTB–Kelch 抑制蛋白失活，釋放 SKN-1 使其得以在細胞核累積，並誘導第二期解毒酵素、異生物轉運蛋白與蛋白質恆定基因。

nodes.label: Arginine Glycine Amidinotransferase
nodes.description: Arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT, GATM) catalyzes the first committed step of endogenous creatine synthesis: arginine + glycine → guanidinoacetate (GAA), mainly in the kidney, with the pathway completed by GAMT methylation in the liver. AGAT deficiency causes cerebral creatine deficiency with intellectual disability, treatable by creatine supplementation, and AGAT plus GAMT together supply roughly half the body creatine pool.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Arginine:glycine amidinotransferase（AGAT、GATM）催化內生性 creatine 合成的第一個committed步驟：arginine + glycine → guanidinoacetate（GAA），主要在腎臟進行，再由肝臟的 GAMT 甲基化完成途徑。AGAT 缺乏會造成伴隨智能障礙的腦型 creatine 缺乏症，可藉 creatine 補充治療；AGAT 與 GAMT 合計供應約身體 creatine 池的一半。

nodes.label: SREBP2
nodes.description: SIRT6 restrains the lipogenic transcription factors SREBP1 and SREBP2 by multiple mechanisms, coupling sirtuin activity to control of lipogenesis and cholesterol synthesis. Loss of hepatic SIRT6 accordingly derepresses the lipogenic program, producing liver steatosis, reduced fatty acid oxidation and elevated lipogenic gene expression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 以多種機制抑制脂肪生成轉錄因子 SREBP1 與 SREBP2，將 sirtuin 活性與脂肪生成及胆固醇合成的調控連結起來。因此肝臟 SIRT6 的喪失會解除對脂肪生成程式的抑制，造成肝脂肪變性、脂肪酸氧化下降以及脂肪生成基因表現升高。

nodes.label: Immune Aging
nodes.description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

nodes.label: Glucocerebrosidase
nodes.description: Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: VEGFR2
nodes.description: Neuropilin-1 potentiates VEGFR2 signaling as co-receptor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuropilin-1 作為共受體增強 VEGFR2 訊號。

nodes.label: Rapalogs
nodes.description: Rapalogs are analogs of rapamycin that inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. They share rapamycin's core pharmacology, including mTORC1 inhibition, autophagy induction, and lifespan effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 rapamycin 的類似物，透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面抑制 mTORC1。它們共享 rapamycin 的核心藥理學，包括 mTORC1 抑制、自噬誘導與壽命效應。

nodes.label: Ezetimibe
nodes.description: Ezetimibe targets Cholesterol Metabolism at the intestine: it blocks the NPC1L1 cholesterol transporter at the brush border, cutting dietary and biliary cholesterol absorption by roughly half and lowering LDL-C, especially in combination with Statins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ezetimibe 在腸道層面針對 Cholesterol Metabolism：阻斷刷狀緣的 NPC1L1 膽固醇轉運蛋白，使飲食與膽汁中的膽固醇吸收減少約一半，並降低 LDL-C，與 Statins 併用時效果尤其明顯。

nodes.label: Ephrin Type A Receptor 2
nodes.description: EPHA2 is a receptor tyrosine kinase that relays the pro-tumorigenic effects of the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype at a distance. Exosomes released by senescent fibroblasts and epithelial cells carry ephrin ligands and growth factors that activate EPHA2 on recipient cancer cells, circumventing the contact-dependence of canonical ephrin-A1 binding and driving ligand-independent mitogenic signaling through PI3K-AKT, Src-FAK and MAPK.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EPHA2 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，能在遠距離傳遞 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的促腫瘤效應。衰老纖維母細胞與上皮細胞釋出的外泌體攜帶 ephrin 配體與生長因子，活化受體癌細胞上的 EPHA2，繞過典型 ephrin-A1 結合的接觸依賴性，並透過 PI3K-AKT、Src-FAK 與 MAPK 驅動配體非依賴性的致分裂訊號。

nodes.label: Protein Kinase D
nodes.description: Once active, Protein Kinase D phosphorylates and activates the IKK complex — phosphorylating IKKβ and the regulatory machinery — which stimulates IκBα degradation and nuclear NF-κB translocation. PKD also modulates NF-κB at the chromatin level (e.g., phosphorylation of histone H3 at Ser10) and influences AP-1 and CREB transcriptional programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Protein Kinase D 一旦活化便磷酸化並活化 IKK complex——磷酸化 IKKbeta 與其調節機制——從而促進 IκBα 降解與 NF-κB 的核內轉位。PKD 也在染色質層級調節 NF-κB（例如磷酸化組蛋白 H3 的 Ser10），並影響 AP-1 與 CREB 轉錄程式。

nodes.label: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases
nodes.description: Oxidants reversibly oxidize and inhibit protein tyrosine phosphatases such as PTP1B and PTEN during POS-related redox imbalance. Phosphatase inhibition shifts signaling toward a higher phosphorylated state, promoting kinase cascades and redox-sensitive transcription factor activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 POS 相關的氧化還原失衡期間，氧化物可逆地氧化並抑制 Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases，如 PTP1B 和 PTEN。磷酸酶抑制使訊號傳導偏向高度磷酸化狀態，促進激酶級聯反應與氧化還原敏感轉錄因子的活化。

nodes.label: Cognitive Decline
nodes.description: Apigenin improved cognitive and affective outcomes in prematurely aged mice following whole-body irradiation: Y-maze spontaneous alternation tests showed basic recovery of short-term working memory in apigenin-treated aged animals, and open-field assays showed prolonged exploration of the central zone, indicating reduced anxiety-like behavior. These findings suggest that SASP suppression by apigenin can counteract neurobehavioral deficits associated with premature aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紫神素改善了 prematurely 老化的老鼠在全身照射後的神經認知和情感結果：Y-maze 自轉 alternation 測試顯示，在紫神素治療的衰老動物中，短期工作記憶出現了基本恢復，而開放場測驗顯示對中央區域的探索時間延長，表明出現了減少焦慮狀行為的跡象。這些發現表明，紫神素抑制 SASP 可以抵消與 prematurely 老化相關的神經行為缺陷。

nodes.label: Merck & Co. Inc
nodes.description: Merck & Co. Inc (known as MSD outside the US and Canada) played a key role in the development and donation of Ivermectin. In the early 1970s Satoshi Ōmura's Antibiotics Research Group at the Kitasato Institute formed the Public Sector–Private Sector partnership with Merck that led to ivermectin's discovery, and Merck then sustained long-running donation programs for the drug.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Merck & Co. Inc（在美國與加拿大以外稱為 MSD）在 Ivermectin 的開發與捐贈上扮演了關鍵角色。1970 年代初，Kitasato Institute 的 Satoshi Ōmura 抗生素研究小組與 Merck 建立了公私夥伴關係，促成 ivermectin 的發現，而 Merck 之後更長期推動該藥物的捐贈計畫。
nodes.source_file: Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis.md

nodes.label: Noise-Induced Hearing Loss
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) has been shown to prevent noise-induced hearing loss and neurite retraction from hair cells in the inner ear through a SIRT3-dependent mechanism, in which the NR-induced increase in NAD+ supports the activity of the mitochondrial deacetylase SIRT3. This illustrates the broader neuroprotective and therapeutic potential of NR, which also protects neurons from excitotoxicity-induced axonal degeneration and preserves axonal NAD+ content. SIRT3 activity is sensitive to the reduction of NAD+ content detected in multiple disorders with retinal degeneration, and NR may therefore have therapeutic applications for a variety of sensory and neurodegenerative conditions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）已被證實透過 SIRT3 依賴性機制預防噪音誘發的聽力喪失與內耳毛細胞的 neurite retraction（神經突退縮），其中 NR 誘發的 NAD+ 提升支持了粒線體去乙醯酶 SIRT3 的活性。這說明了 NR 更廣泛的神經保護與治療潛力，其亦保護神經元免於興奮毒性誘發的軸突退化並保留軸突 NAD+ 含量。SIRT3 活性對多種伴隨視網膜退化的疾病中所偵測到的 NAD+ 含量降低相當敏感，因此 NR 可能對各種感覺與神經退化性疾病具有治療應用價值。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

nodes.label: Reactive Oxygen Species generation
nodes.description: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

nodes.label: RRM1
nodes.description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM1 provides the large catalytic (alpha) subunit carrying the active site and the allosteric specificity/activity sites. RRM1 assembles with either the RRM2 or RRM2B small subunit to form the active holoenzyme. RRM1 encodes the large (alpha) catalytic subunit of human ribonucleotide reductase, which assembles with the RRM2 or RRM2B small subunit to form the active alpha2beta2 holoenzyme. It carries the active site, the allosteric specificity and activity sites, and the redox-active disulfide reduced each cycle by thioredoxin-1 or glutaredoxin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM1 提供大型催化（alpha）次單元，帶有活性位點以及別構特異性/活性位點。RRM1 與 RRM2 或 RRM2B 小次單元組裝形成活性全酶。 RRM1 編碼人類核醣核苷酸還原酶的大型（alpha）催化次單元，與 RRM2 或 RRM2B 小次單元組裝形成活性 alpha2beta2 全酶。它帶有活性位點、別構特異性與活性位點，以及每個循環由硫氧還蛋白-1 或 glutaredoxin 還原的氧化還原活性雙硫鍵。

nodes.label: Chromatin Remodeling
nodes.description: Methylated DNA is recognized by methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins that recruit chromatin remodeling factors and histone deacetylases to the site. These recruited complexes remove acetyl groups and deposit repressive histone modifications, promoting condensation of the chromatin into a transcriptionally inactive state. This cross-talk between DNA methylation and histone modification establishes a self-reinforcing repressive loop that maintains stable gene silencing across cell divisions, and it is a major route by which promoter methylation converts active genes into silenced heterochromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 甲基化 DNA 被甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白識別，將染色質重塑因子和組蛋白去乙醯化酶募集到該位點。這些招募的複合物去除乙醯基並沉積抑制性組蛋白修飾，促進染色質凝結成轉錄失活狀態。 DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾之間的這種串擾建立了一個自我強化的抑制環，在細胞分裂過程中維持穩定的基因沉默，並且它是啟動子甲基化將活性基因轉化為沉默的異染色質的主要途徑。

nodes.label: Succinate Dehydrogenase
nodes.description: SIRT3 regulates succinate dehydrogenase (SDH, complex II), described as a critical acetylation node within the mitochondrial matrix that mediates crosstalk between metabolic flux control and mitochondrial energy transduction systems. Through modulation of SDH enzymatic activity, SIRT3 fine-tunes substrate utilization efficiency while maintaining electron transfer chain synchronization, preserving metabolic homeostasis across the TCA cycle and oxidative phosphorylation interface.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節琥珀酸脫氫酶（SDH，複合物 II），被描述為粒線體基質中代謝通量控制和粒線體能量傳導系統之間串擾的關鍵乙醯化節點。透過調節 SDH 酵素活性，SIRT3 微調受質利用效率，同時維持電子傳遞鏈同步化，在 TCA 循環和氧化磷酸化界面間維持代謝恆定。

nodes.label: CXCL3
nodes.description: CXCL3 (GROγ/MIP-2β) is the third member of the ELR+ growth-regulated oncogene cluster and signals through CXCR2 at high affinity, with CXCR1 engaged only weakly. Receptor engagement activates Gαi → PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+, PI3K/Akt and p38 MAPK/ERK cascades, and CXCL3 is a conserved component of the SASP, completing the core ELR+ CXC chemokine cluster with CXCL1 and CXCL2. Because senescent cells secrete CXCL3 and bystander cells express CXCR2, this axis forms a feed-forward loop that reinforces senescence and spreads the phenotype paracrine through tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL3（GROγ/MIP-2β）是 ELR+ growth-regulated oncogene 群聚的第三個成員，以高親和力結合 CXCR2，而對 CXCR1 的親和力較弱。受體活化後啟動 Gαi → PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+、PI3K/Akt 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 級聯反應；CXCL3 亦是 SASP 的保守成分，與 CXCL1、CXCL2 共同構成核心 ELR+ CXC 趨化因子群。由於衰老細胞會分泌 CXCL3，而旁觀細胞表現 CXCR2，此軸形成前饋迴路，強化衰老並以旁分泌方式在組織中擴散該表型。

nodes.label: UPRmt
nodes.description: In C. elegans, proteotoxic stress blocks import of the transcription factor ATFS-1; the protein is excluded from mitochondria, traffics to the nucleus and, with DVE-1 and UBL-5, induces chaperones (HSP-6/mtHSP70) and proteases such as LONP. The same nuclear output in mammals is driven by the ATF4/ATF5/CHOP integrated stress response axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，蛋白毒性壓力阻斷轉錄因子 ATFS-1 的輸入；該蛋白被排除於粒線體之外而運送至細胞核，並與 DVE-1、UBL-5 共同誘導 chaperone（HSP-6/mtHSP70）與 LONP 等蛋白酶。在哺乳類中，相同的核內輸出由 ATF4/ATF5/CHOP 的 integrated stress response 軸驅動。

nodes.label: Setanaxib
nodes.description: Setanaxib (GKT137831) is a first-in-class orally active pyrazolopyridine dione that selectively inhibits the NOX1 and NOX4 isoforms of the NADPH oxidase family, blunting pathological NOX-derived reactive oxygen species rather than scavenging them indiscriminately.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Setanaxib（GKT137831）是首創、口服活性的 pyrazolopyridine dione，可選擇性抑制 NADPH oxidase 家族的 NOX1 與 NOX4 亞型；它抑制的是病理性 NOX 來源的活性氧，而非籠統地清除活性氧。

nodes.label: RAIDD
nodes.description: RAIDD activates Caspase-2. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RAIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: ATG-16.2
nodes.description: The Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 complex is required for LGG-1/LGG-2 lipidation and autophagosome formation. Requirement is the conjugation dependency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 複合體為 LGG-1/LGG-2 脂化與自噬體形成所需。必要性是接合依賴。

nodes.label: Microbiome
nodes.description: The microbiota interfaces with the gut-brain axis, influencing cognition and neurodegeneration, and is therefore a tractable lever for healthspan; caloric restriction, exercise and nicotinamide riboside reshape microbial composition toward longevity phenotypes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菌群與 gut-brain axis 相互介面，影響認知與神經退化，因此是可操作的 healthspan 槓桿；caloric restriction、運動與 nicotinamide riboside 會將菌群組成重塑為長壽表型。

nodes.label: Rotenone
nodes.description: Rotenone is the classic Complex I inhibitor: it binds the ubiquinone-reduction site of Respiratory Chain Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) and blocks electron transfer from the iron–sulfur clusters to ubiquinone, impairing oxidative phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Rotenone 是典型的 Complex I 抑制劑：它結合 Respiratory Chain Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）的 ubiquinone 還原位點，阻斷電子由鐵硫簇向 ubiquinone 的轉移，使氧化磷酸化受損。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: FNIP2
nodes.description: Missense mutations in FNIP2 are associated with Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome-like phenotypes such as fibrofolliculomas and renal cell carcinoma, and FNIP2 has been identified as a susceptibility locus in genome-wide association studies for chronic kidney disease, linking it to Folliculin-pathway tumor suppressor biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FNIP2 的錯義突變與 Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome 類表型（例如纖毛濾泡瘤與腎細胞癌）相關，且 FNIP2 在慢性腎病的全基因體關聯研究中被鑑定為易感位點，將其與 Folliculin 路徑的腫瘤抑制功能連結。

nodes.label: Etoposide
nodes.description: Etoposide is a chemotherapeutic DNA-damaging agent that induces therapy-induced senescence by triggering a robust DNA damage response. As a topoisomerase II inhibitor, etoposide causes DNA double-strand breaks that activate p53 and the DNA damage response, leading to a permanent cell cycle arrest with the hallmarks of cellular senescence. In research, etoposide is a standard experimental tool for generating therapy-induced senescence in human fibroblasts to study SASP expression and epigenetic remodeling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Etoposide 是一種化療性 DNA 損傷劑，透過觸發強烈的 DNA 損傷反應來誘導治療引起的衰老。作為拓樸異構酶 II 抑制劑，依托泊苷會引起 DNA 雙股斷裂，進而活化 p53 和 DNA 損傷反應，進而導致具有細胞老化標誌的永久性細胞週期停滯。在研究中，依托泊苷是一種標準實驗工具，可在人類纖維母細胞中產生治療誘導的衰老，以研究 SASP 表達和表觀遺傳重塑。

nodes.label: 4E-BP1
nodes.description: mTORC1 promotes protein synthesis by phosphorylating 4E-BP1 and S6K1. The phosphorylation of 4E-BP1 prevents its binding to eIF4E, enabling eIF4E to promote cap-dependent translation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTORC1 藉由磷酸化 4E-BP1 與 S6K1 來促進蛋白質合成。4E-BP1 的磷酸化阻止其結合 eIF4E，使 eIF4E 能促進帽依賴性轉譯。

nodes.label: PREMOTE
nodes.description: In PREMOTE the gut microbiome mediates the observed metabolic benefit: berberine's roughly 1% HbA1c reduction tracked with compositional and metabolite changes, and the enriched taxa included Akkermansia muciniphila, Bifidobacterium, and SCFA-producing Lactobacillus. This supports berberine's high-intraluminal-exposure model, in which activity resides in the gut lumen independently of systemic absorption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 PREMOTE 試驗中，腸道微生物群是所觀察到代謝效益的介導者：Berberine 約 1% 的 HbA1c 下降與微生物組成及代謝物的改變相對應，被富集的類群包括 Akkermansia muciniphila、Bifidobacterium 以及產 SCFA 的 Lactobacillus。這支持 Berberine 的高腸腔暴露模型——其活性存在於腸道管腔內，獨立於全身吸收而作用。

nodes.label: FIN56
nodes.description: FIN56 binds to and activates squalene synthase, pushing mevalonate pathway flux toward sterol and cholesterol biosynthesis and away from CoQ10/ubiquinone synthesis. The resulting ubiquinone depletion converges on FSP1, whose radical-trapping defence collapses because its substrate is no longer regenerated as ubiquinol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FIN56 結合並活化 squalene synthase，使 mevalonate pathway 的流量轉向 sterol 與 cholesterol 合成，而遠離 CoQ10/ubiquinone 合成。由此造成的 ubiquinone 耗損匯聚到 FSP1：由於其受質無法再被還原成 ubiquinol，FSP1 的自由基捕捉防禦因而崩潰。

nodes.label: Extracellular Vesicles
nodes.description: Extracellular vesicles, including exosomes and microvesicles, are lipid-bilayer particles released by cells to mediate intercellular communication. They can be loaded with cGAMP and mtDNA, transferring cGAS-STING activation from a sender cell to a naive receiver: neurons stressed by activity-induced DNA damage or proteotoxic insult package nucleic acid cargo that activates microglial cGAS-STING, and microglia broadcast signals back to neurons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Extracellular vesicles（包含 exosome 與 microvesicle）是細胞釋放以進行細胞間溝通的脂質雙層顆粒。它們可裝載 cGAMP 與 mtDNA，把 cGAS-STING 的活化由發訊細胞傳遞給未受刺激的受訊細胞：因活動誘發的 DNA Damage 或蛋白質毒性壓力而受損的神經元會包裝核酸貨物以活化小膠細胞的 cGAS-STING，而小膠細胞也會將訊號回傳給神經元。

nodes.label: Sodium Persulfate
nodes.description: Sodium Persulfate (Na2S2O8) is used in vitro as a two-electron oxidizing agent that converts the catechol ring of Epinephrine to the corresponding o-quinone intermediate, adrenaline-quinone, which then cyclizes to adrenochrome. Because the persulfate anion is water-soluble, it offers formulation advantages over the potassium analog for aqueous adrenaline oxidation assays.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sodium Persulfate（Na2S2O8）在體外作為雙電子氧化劑，將 Epinephrine 的兒茶酚環氧化成對應的鄰醌中間體（adrenaline-quinone），後者再環化生成 adrenochrome。由於過硫酸根陰離子水溶性良好，在水性腎上腺素氧化檢測中比鉀鹽類更方便。

nodes.label: CDK
nodes.description: The Cell Cycle — the ordered series of events leading to DNA replication and cell division — is tightly regulated by cyclins, cyclin-dependent kinases (CDK), and CDK inhibitors. Quiescent cells retain the capacity to re-enter the Cell Cycle upon an appropriate stimulus, whereas senescence is a stable arrest of it.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cell Cycle（細胞週期）——導向 DNA 複製與細胞分裂的有序事件序列——受到 cyclin、cyclin-dependent kinase（CDK）與 CDK inhibitor 的嚴格調控。Quiescence（靜止）細胞保有在適當刺激下重新進入 Cell Cycle 的能力，而 senescence（衰老）則是其穩定停止。

nodes.label: CTPI2
nodes.description: Targeting mitochondrial citrate metabolism suppresses inflammation across tissues and improves tissue function and healthspan during ageing without detectable changes in p16 or p21 expression, consistent with SASP modulation rather than senolytic clearance of senescent cells. In aged muscle, senescent-like nuclei defined by the CoreScence gene signature are present at similar abundance and distribution across conditions despite reduced SASP-associated transcription and chromatin accessibility at loci such as Ccl2 and Igfbp4. In the liver, the abundance of p16-positive and/or p21-positive cells remains unchanged while their nuclear histone acetylation is reduced by CTPI2 treatment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 靶向線粒體枸櫞酸代謝抑制多個組織中的炎症，並在老化過程中改善組織功能和健康壽命，而p16或p21表達沒有可檢測到的變化，這與SASP調節而非衰老細胞的senolytic清除一致。在老年肌肉中，由CoreScence基因特徵定義的衰老樣細胞核在不同條件下以相似的豐度和分佈存在，儘管SASP相關轉錄和染色質可及性在Ccl2和Igfbp4等位點降低。在肝臟中，p16陽性和/或p21陽性細胞的豐度保持不變，而它們的細胞核組蛋白乙酰化被CTPI2治療降低。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

nodes.label: SLC36A1-4
nodes.description: SLC36A1-4 (PAT1–PAT4) are proton-coupled amino acid transporters; the lysosomal isoforms PAT1/SLC36A1 and PAT4/SLC36A4 face the lumen and release neutral amino acids such as glycine, alanine and proline to the cytosol, using the inward proton gradient maintained by the V-ATPase. They are secondary-active symporters coupling amino acid efflux to proton influx.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC36A1-4（PAT1–PAT4）是質子偶聯胺基酸轉運蛋白；溶酶體型的 PAT1/SLC36A1 與 PAT4/SLC36A4 朝向腔內，利用由 V-ATPase 維持的向內質子梯度，將甘胺酸、丙胺酸、脯胺酸等中性胺基酸釋放至細胞質。它們是將胺基酸外流與質子內流偶聯的次級主動同向轉運蛋白。

nodes.label: Acute Stress-Associated Phenotype
nodes.description: Apigenin blocks the transition of the ASAP toward the SASP by disrupting ATM-HSPA8 and HSPA8-p38 MAPK crosstalk, preventing maturation of the secretome. As a flavonoid it also binds PRDX6 to inhibit its iPLA2 activity, further gatekeeping the transition between acute stress response and chronic secretion. This early intervention contrasts with agents that only suppress the established SASP, positioning apigenin as a candidate preventive senomorphic that acts at the ASAP stage. The mechanism highlights HSPA8 and PRDX6 as druggable nodes in senescence initiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Apigenin 透過破壞 ATM-HSPA8 與 HSPA8-p38 MAPK 交互作用阻斷 ASAP 朝向 SASP 的轉變，防止分泌組成熟。作為類黃酮它也結合 PRDX6 抑制其 iPLA2 活性，進一步守門急性壓力反應與慢性分泌間的轉變。此早期介入不同於僅抑制已建立 SASP 的藥劑，將 apigenin 定位為作用於 ASAP 階段的候選預防性 senomorphic。此機制凸顯 HSPA8 與 PRDX6 作為衰老起始中可藥物化的節點。

nodes.label: Nutlins
nodes.description: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

nodes.label: Ventral Tegmental Area
nodes.description: Ventral Tegmental Area is spared in Parkinson's Disease, contrasting with the pronounced loss of other dopaminergic populations. Mechanistically, relative sparing reflects differences in pigment load, connectivity, and vulnerability factors between nuclei. This is significant because the differential involvement helps define the anatomical selectivity of the disease. A caveat is that 'spared' is relative; these neurons may show milder or later changes rather than complete immunity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ventral Tegmental Area 在 Parkinson's Disease 中倖免於難，與其他 dopaminergic 族群的明顯損失形成鮮明對比。從機制上講，相對保留反映了細胞核之間色素負載、連接性和脆弱性因素的差異。這很重要，因為不同的受累情況有助於確定疾病的解剖選擇性。需要注意的是，「倖免」是相對的。這些神經元可能會表現出較輕微或較晚的變化，而不是完全免疫。

nodes.label: Raptor
nodes.description: Regulatory-associated protein of mTOR (Raptor) is an essential scaffold component of mTORC1. As the structural backbone of the five-subunit complex, Raptor regulates mTORC1 assembly and activity and is the subunit through which nutrient-loaded Rag GTPases recruit the complex to the lysosomal surface in nutrient-rich conditions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: mTOR 的調節相關蛋白 Raptor 是 mTORC1 不可或缺的支架成分。作為這五次單元複合體的結構骨架，Raptor 調控 mTORC1 的組裝與活性，也是富含營養時攜帶營養的 Rag GTP 酶把複合體招募到溶酶體表面的次單元。

nodes.label: FIP200
nodes.description: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is a core component of the ULK1 complex and the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17; it is essential for Macroautophagy initiation. It scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex so that the autophagy-initiation signal is transmitted to nascent Autophagosome nucleation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是 ULK1 複合體的核心成員，也是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物，對 Macroautophagy 的起始不可或缺。它作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體，使自噬起始訊號得以傳遞至新生 Autophagosome 的成核。

nodes.label: Vitamin B12
nodes.description: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) is a critical cofactor in the methylation cycle: as Methylcobalamin it serves as cofactor for methionine synthase, converting Homocysteine to Methionine, and MTRR is required to regenerate the active methylcobalamin form. Deficiency elevates homocysteine and impairs SAMe production, with knock-on effects for COMT-dependent dopamine and estrogen metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Vitamin B12（cobalamin）是 methylation 循環的關鍵輔因子：以 Methylcobalamin 形式作為 methionine synthase 的輔因子，將 Homocysteine 轉為 Methionine；並需 MTRR 再生活性 methylcobalamin 形式。缺乏會使 homocysteine 上升並損害 SAMe 生成，進而影響 COMT 相依的 dopamine 與 estrogen 代謝。

nodes.label: Fibronectin
nodes.description: The ECM (Extracellular Matrix) is a complex network of extracellular proteins and carbohydrates — including collagen and glycoproteins such as Fibronectin and Vitronectin — that provides structural and biochemical support to surrounding cells. It also forms part of the niche together with surrounding cells and blood vessels, contacting quiescent cells by soluble factors or direct contact.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ECM（Extracellular Matrix）是由細胞外蛋白質與醣類組成的複雜網路 — 包含 collagen 以及 Fibronectin、Vitronectin 等醣蛋白 — 提供周圍細胞結構性與生化性支持。它也與周圍細胞及血管共同構成 niche，透過可溶性因子或直接接觸與靜止細胞互動。

nodes.label: Genotype
nodes.description: Acquired mutations and genomic instability, defined as the accumulation of DNA damage and chromosomal aberrations, progressively distort the genotype over the lifetime and drive aging and cancer. Unlike reversible epigenetic change, this is a permanent alteration of the constitutional sequence itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 後天獲得的突變與基因體不穩定（定義為 DNA 損傷與染色體異常的累積）會在一生中逐步扭曲基因型，並推動老化與癌症。與可逆的表觀遺傳改變不同，這是對體質性序列本身的永久性改變。

nodes.label: Selenoprotein P
nodes.description: Selenoprotein P is the major plasma selenium transport protein, delivering selenium from the liver to peripheral tissues and serving as the principal vehicle that moves dietary selenium into the body's selenoproteome. Because it is itself a selenoprotein, it acts as the node linking dietary selenium intake to the rest of the selenoprotein family and prioritizes essential selenoproteins under low selenium.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Selenoprotein P 是血漿中主要的 selenium 運輸蛋白，負責將 selenium 由肝臟運送至周邊組織，並是把飲食中的 selenium 帶入體內 selenoproteome 的主要載體。由於它本身也是 selenoprotein，它便成為連結飲食硒攝取與其餘 selenoprotein 家族的節點，並在缺硒時優先維持必需的 selenoprotein。

nodes.label: CNKSR2
nodes.description: CNKSR2 acts as a RAS-pathway tumor suppressor and is one of six EXITS (Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors) genes. Across 21 tumor types these X-linked genes harbor loss-of-function mutations significantly more often in males, because females are biallelically buffered by escape from X-inactivation while males are hemizygous and vulnerable to single-hit inactivation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CNKSR2 作為 RAS 路徑的腫瘤抑制基因，是六個 EXITS（Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors）基因之一。在 21 種腫瘤類型中，這些 X 聯鎖基因的功能缺失突變在男性顯著更常見，因為女性因逃脫 X 染色體失活而具有雙等位緩衝，男性則為半合子，單次打擊即失去功能。

nodes.label: SNARE proteins
nodes.description: SNARE proteins (STX17, SNAP29, VAMP8) mediate fusion of the Autophagosome outer membrane with a Lysosome to produce an Autolysosome; modifications that reduce SNAP29 interaction with Stx17 and VAMP8 inhibit SNARE complex assembly and Autolysosome formation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SNARE proteins（STX17、SNAP29、VAMP8）媒介 Autophagosome 外膜與 Lysosome 融合以形成 Autolysosome；降低 SNAP29 與 Stx17、VAMP8 交互作用的修飾會抑制 SNARE 複合體組裝與 Autolysosome 形成。

nodes.label: MUC1
nodes.description: The cytoplasmic tail fragment MUC1-C of the transmembrane mucin MUC1 is an oncogenic signalling protein highly expressed in triple-negative breast cancer. Analogous to SLC7A11 (xCT), the light chain of system Xc-, MUC1-C forms a complex with xCT and CD44v that controls glutathione levels, making it a ferroptosis-resistance node in TNBC.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 跨膜黏蛋白 MUC1 的細胞質尾端片段 MUC1-C 是一種致癌訊號蛋白，在三陰性乳癌中高度表現。與 system Xc- 的輕鏈 SLC7A11（xCT）類似，MUC1-C 與 xCT 及 CD44v 形成複合體以調控 glutathione 水準，使其成為三陰性乳癌中的鐵死亡抗性節點。

nodes.label: Protein Kinase R
nodes.description: Interferon signaling transcriptionally upregulates PKR (EIF2AK2), which in turn is required for IFN-induced RIPK1/RIPK3 necroptosis in addition to its classical eIF2α translational block (Thapa et al. 2016).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 干擾素訊號轉錄性上調 PKR（EIF2AK2）；PKR 除經典的 eIF2α 轉譯阻斷外，亦為 IFN 誘導 RIPK1/RIPK3 necroptosis 所必需（Thapa et al. 2016）。

nodes.label: DSRM-3716
nodes.description: DSRM-3716 is a second-generation SARM1 inhibitor, a non-covalent small molecule that blocks SARM1 NADase activity at low nanomolar IC50 with greater potency and selectivity than the covalent inhibitor disulfiram. By inhibiting SARM1 it protects axons from Wallerian degeneration, targeting chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, traumatic brain injury and chronic peripheral neuropathy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DSRM-3716 是第二代的 SARM1 抑制劑，為非共價小分子，以低奈莫耳 IC50 阻斷 SARM1 的 NADase 活性，效力與選擇性皆優於共價抑制劑 disulfiram。透過抑制 SARM1，它可保護軸突免於 Wallerian degeneration，適應症涵蓋化療引發的周邊神經病變、traumatic brain injury 與慢性周邊神經病變。

nodes.label: Cyclin D
nodes.description: Cyclin D is the regulatory partner of CDK4/6, and the Cyclin D-CDK4/6 complex drives G1 phase progression by phosphorylating retinoblastoma protein, releasing E2F to permit S-phase gene expression. High levels of Cyclin D/E with CDK4/6 therefore increase proliferation by driving passage through G1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cyclin D 是 CDK4/6 的調節性搭檔，Cyclin D-CDK4/6 複合體透過磷酸化 Retinoblastoma Protein 釋放 E2F，驅動 G1 Phase 进展並允許 S 期基因表現。因此 Cyclin D/E 與 CDK4/6 濃度高會藉由通過 G1 而增加增殖。

nodes.label: BluB-like
nodes.description: BluB-like enzymes are bacterial proteins homologous to BluB, the radical SAM enzyme that builds the lower ligand of vitamin B12. Metagenomic and structural studies identified such biocatalysts in soil and gut-associated microbes that bind and hydrolyse glucosepane, the most abundant and chemically stable advanced glycation cross-link in aged human tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BluB-like 酵素是與 BluB（合成維生素 B12 下軸配體的 radical SAM 酵素）同源的細菌蛋白。宏基因組與結構研究在土壤及腸道相關微生物中鑑定出這類生物催化劑，它們能結合並水解 glucosepane——老化人體組織中最豐富且化學上最穩定的 advanced glycation 交聯。

nodes.label: African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control
nodes.description: The African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control (APOC) was a WHO-coordinated partnership launched in 1995 whose explicit goal was to eliminate Onchocerciasis (river blindness) as a public health problem across endemic African countries. It broke transmission by annual mass drug administration delivered through trained community volunteers rather than fixed health facilities, and by 2015 had delivered over one billion treatments before being succeeded by ESPEN.
nodes.description_zh_TW: African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control（APOC，非洲蟲尾絲蟲病防治計畫）是 1995 年啟動、由 World Health Organization 協調的合作計畫，其明確目標是在非洲流行國家將 Onchocerciasis（河盲症）從公共衛生問題中消除。它透過每年一次的大規模投藥（由受訓的社區志工而非固定醫療設施發放）阻斷傳播，至 2015 年結案時已提供逾十億人次治療，之後由 ESPEN 接續。

nodes.label: RNA Polymerase I
nodes.description: RNA polymerase I transcribes the 18S, 5.8S and 28S rRNA genes in the nucleolus, and each ribosome requires a single 45S precursor rRNA transcript. Pol I output is therefore the rate-limiting step of ribosome biogenesis and sets the ceiling on protein synthesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA 聚合酶 I 在核仁中轉錄 18S、5.8S 與 28S rRNA 基因，而每個核糖體都需要一條 45S 前驅 rRNA 轉錄本。因此 Pol I 的產出是核糖體生成的限速步驟，並為蛋白質合成設定上限。

nodes.label: MTFP1
nodes.description: MTFP1 (MTP18) is an inner mitochondrial membrane protein required for the completion of mitochondrial fission after DRP1-mediated outer membrane constriction. Unlike the outer membrane fission machinery (DRP1, MFF, MID49, MID51), MTFP1 operates at the inner membrane level, coordinating inner membrane remodelling with the outer membrane machinery to ensure complete organelle division.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MTFP1（MTP18）是粒線體內膜蛋白，在 DRP1 介導的外膜收縮之後，為粒線體分裂的完成所必需。不同於外膜的分裂機制（DRP1、MFF、MID49、MID51），MTFP1 在內膜層面作用，協調內膜重塑與外膜機制，以確保胞器完全分裂。

nodes.label: Nucleosome
nodes.description: Histone H3 is one of the core histones that form the Nucleosome: together with Histone H4 it makes an (H3-H4)2 tetramer that organizes the central 120–130 bp of DNA wrapped around the particle. H3 is among the most highly conserved proteins across eukaryotes and carries a dense array of post-translational modifications on its ~40-residue N-terminal tail.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone H3 是構成 Nucleosome 的核心組蛋白之一：它與 Histone H4 共同形成 (H3-H4)2 四聚體，組織纏繞在核小體上的中央 120–130 bp DNA。H3 是真核生物中序列最保守的蛋白質之一，其約 40 個殘基的 N 端尾帶上帶有密集的轉譯後修飾。

nodes.label: PTBP1
nodes.description: PTBP1 is a principal repressor of alternative pre-mRNA splicing: binding polypyrimidine-rich sequences near splice sites occludes U2AF65 recruitment, biases exon skipping, and looping the pre-mRNA can hide the splice site; its effects are position- and context-dependent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTBP1 是前驅 mRNA 選擇性剪接的主要抑制因子：結合剪接位點附近的聚嘧啶豐富序列會阻擋 U2AF65 的招募、偏向外顯子跳過，並可藉由環化前驅 mRNA 隱藏剪接位點；其效果依位置與脈絡而定。

nodes.label: Antioxidant Properties
nodes.description: Oleacein has antioxidant properties, scavenging reactive oxygen species and upregulating endogenous antioxidant defenses such as Nrf2-target genes, typical of olive phenolic compounds. This activity supports vascular and neuronal protection and underlies part of the Mediterranean diet's health benefits. Its catechol-like structure also makes it a COMT-interacting compound, serving as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is among the most abundant phenolic secoiridoids in extra virgin olive oil.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Oleacein 具有 antioxidant properties，清除活性氧並上調內源性抗氧化防禦，例如 Nrf2 目標基因（典型的橄欖酚類化合物）。這種活性支持血管和神經元保護，是地中海飲食健康益處的一部分。其茶酚樣結構也使其成為 COMT 相互作用化合物，既可作為底物又可作為競爭性抑制劑。它是 extra virgin olive oil 中最豐富的酚類環環烯醚萜化合物之一。

nodes.label: J147
nodes.description: Because lipid peroxidation is the execution step of ferroptosis, J147's blockade of lipid peroxidation explains its rescue of RSL3-killed cells and its protection of neurons from oxidative and metabolic stress; it also improves cognitive function in aged Alzheimer's-disease mice.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於脂質過氧化是 ferroptosis 的執行步驟，J147 阻斷脂質過氧化解釋了它為何能救回被 RSL3 殺死的細胞，以及保護神經元免受氧化與代謝壓力；它也改善了老化阿茲海默症小鼠的認知功能。

nodes.label: System Xc-
nodes.description: System Xc- (SLC7A11/SLC3A2 cystine/glutamate antiporter) imports cystine in exchange for glutamate; intracellular cystine is reduced to cysteine, the rate-limiting precursor for Glutathione synthesis. Its inhibition (e.g., by erastin) depletes GSH and is the classic trigger of GPX4-dependent ferroptosis, defining the upstream node of the parallel GPX4 axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11/SLC3A2 胱氨酸/麩氨酸逆向轉運體）以麩氨酸交換導入胱氨酸；細胞內胱氨酸被還原為半胱氨酸，即 Glutathione 合成的速率限制前驅物。其抑制（例如被 erastin）會耗竭 GSH，是 GPX4 依賴性鐵死亡的典型觸發因子，界定了平行 GPX4 軸的上游節點。

nodes.label: Eumelanin
nodes.description: Dopachrome tautomerase activity diverts the melanin pathway toward DHICA-rich eumelanin, which is more stable and a better antioxidant than the alternative indole route. By catalyzing the tautomerization of dopachrome to 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid, the enzyme promotes eumelanin formation. This enzymatic step is critical for protective dark pigment production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase 活性將黑色素途徑轉向富含 DHICA 的 eumelanin，與替代的吲哚途徑相比，後者更穩定且是更好的抗氧化劑。透過催化 dopachrome 異構化為 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid，該酶促進 eumelanin 的形成。此酶促步驟對於保護性深色色素的產生至關重要。

nodes.label: Transcription
nodes.description: Histone Modification on histone tails constitutes a central part of the epigenetic code that dictates whether the underlying DNA is accessible for Transcription or remains tightly packed. The specific combination of marks — the 'histone code' — is read by specialized proteins that recruit factors to either open or close the chromatin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone Modification 發生在組蛋白尾端，是表觀遺傳密碼的核心組成，決定其下的 DNA 是否可供 Transcription 存取或維持緊密包裝。這些標記的特定組合——即「組蛋白密碼」——由專門蛋白質讀取，再招募因子以開啟或關閉染色質。

nodes.label: NHR-49
nodes.description: NHR-49 (nuclear hormone receptor 49) is the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian PPARα and a key transcriptional regulator of fat metabolism. It regulates genes for fatty acid beta-oxidation, transport and desaturation, and is critical for metabolic adaptation to starvation and for lifespan extension downstream of LIPL-4.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NHR-49（核受體 49）是哺乳類 PPARα 在 C. elegans 中的同源物，也是脂肪代謝的關鍵轉錄調控因子。它調控脂肪酸 β-氧化、運輸與去飽和相關基因，且對禁食的代謝適應以及 LIPL-4 下游的壽命延展至關重要。

nodes.label: Meningeal Lymphatic System
nodes.description: The Meningeal Lymphatic System comprises dural lymphatic vessels that line the meninges and provide a dedicated route for CNS interstitial fluid, antigens, and immune mediators to reach the cervical lymph nodes. Once considered absent, these vessels are now recognized as essential for brain immune surveillance and for clearing protein aggregates and inflammatory signals from the neuroparenchyma.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Meningeal Lymphatic System 由沿著腦膜分布的硬膜淋巴管構成，提供中樞神經系統間質液、抗原與免疫介質通往頸部淋巴結的專門引流途徑。這些血管過去曾被認為不存在，如今則被認定對腦部的免疫監控，以及清除神經實質中的蛋白聚集物與發炎訊號具有必要性。

nodes.label: Diabetes
nodes.description: Chronic hyperglycemia in Diabetes drives non-enzymatic glycation of proteins, lipids and nucleic acids, accelerating formation and tissue accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products. Hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial superoxide overproduction raises dicarbonyl flux (Methylglyoxal, glyoxal); the resulting AGEs cross-link matrix proteins such as Collagen and engage RAGE, sustaining Inflammation and Oxidative Stress that underlie micro- and macrovascular complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diabetes 中的慢性高血糖驅動蛋白質、脂質與核酸的非酵素性糖化，加速 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成與在組織中的累積。高血糖引起的粒線體 superoxide 過量產生提高二碳醣基通量（Methylglyoxal、glyoxal）；生成的 AGE 交聯 Collagen 等基質蛋白並結合 RAGE，維持 Inflammation 與 Oxidative Stress，成為微血管與大血管併發症的基礎。

nodes.label: TNFR1 complex II
nodes.description: TNFR1 complex I is the obligate precursor of TNFR1 complex II: its dissolution is what births the death-competent successor. CYLD deubiquitination of RIPK1 dissolves the membrane scaffold, after which the TRADD–RIPK1 heterodimer internalizes and recruits FADD, procaspase-8 and c-FLIP. Block ubiquitination instead (e.g. by Smac mimetics) and complex I collapses straight into ripoptosome-like death signaling without ever accumulating as a free death complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNFR1 complex I 是 TNFR1 complex II 不可或缺的先驅：其溶解才是催生這個具死亡能力的後繼複合體的關鍵。CYLD 對 RIPK1 的去泛素化溶解了膜支架，之後 TRADD–RIPK1 異二聚體內化並招募 FADD、procaspase-8 與 c-FLIP。若改為阻斷泛素化（例如以 Smac mimetics），complex I 便直接崩解為類似 ripoptosome 的死亡訊號，甚至不會累積成游離的死亡複合體。

nodes.label: Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome
nodes.description: SIRS criteria define the systemic inflammatory state that, when accompanied by infection, constitutes sepsis; sterile necroptotic DAMP release produces the same clinical syndrome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRS 標準定義全身性發炎狀態，若伴隨感染即構成敗血症（sepsis）；無菌性 necroptotic DAMP 釋放可產生相同臨床症候群。

nodes.label: GATA5
nodes.description: Nkx3.2 (Bapx1) acts as a transcriptional repressor of GATA5 in endothelial cells. Because SIRT6 silences Nkx3.2, GATA5 is derepressed and endothelial injury is prevented — placing developmental homeobox factors inside the adult vascular-maintenance SIRT6 network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nkx3.2（Bapx1）在內皮細胞中作為 GATA5 的轉錄抑制因子。由於 SIRT6 沉默 Nkx3.2，GATA5 被解除抑制，內皮損傷得以避免——顯示發育相關的同源域轉錄因子也被納入成人血管維持的 SIRT6 網絡。

nodes.label: miR-101
nodes.description: MALAT1 modulates Autophagy by sponging miR-101, which upregulates STUB1 expression, and by interacting with TFEB to influence lysosomal gene transcription and by regulating mTORC1 signaling under hypoxic stress. The same mechanism has been reported to upregulate SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MALAT1 透過「海綿」miR-101 來調節 Autophagy，進而提升 STUB1 的表達；它也與 TFEB 互動以影響溶酶體基因轉錄，並在缺氧壓力下調節 mTORC1 訊號。同一機制亦被報導可上調 SIRT1。

nodes.label: Platelets
nodes.description: Platelet aggregation is the process whereby activated platelets bind to one another through fibrinogen bridging the integrin receptor, forming the terminal common pathway of primary hemostasis. Activated platelets aggregate to form thrombi and support coagulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 血小板凝集是活化的血小板透過纖維蛋白原橋接整合素受體而彼此結合的過程，是初級止血的終末共同途徑。活化的血小板凝集成血栓並支持凝血。

nodes.label: Adrenolutin
nodes.description: The adrenochrome pathway produces two major catabolites from the oxidation of adrenaline, and adrenolutin is one of them, alongside adrenochrome. Adrenolutin arises as a rearrangement product downstream of adrenochrome and represents the further transformation of the indoline quinone scaffold. The detection of these catabolites is central to the pathway's study: a compound with the same retention time as adrenochrome on HPLC was detected in a biological fluid rich in neutrophils, supporting the view that the pathway can operate in vivo. Adrenolutin, like adrenochrome, belongs to the family of oxidative adrenaline metabolites whose formation is driven by oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils, and its presence signals activation of the oxidative catecholamine metabolism implicated in stress-induced heart disease.
