nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 途徑從 adrenaline 的氧化產生兩種主要分解代謝物，adrenolutin 是其中之一，與 adrenochrome 並列。Adrenolutin 是 adrenochrome 下游的重排產物，代表了 indoline 醌骨架的進一步轉化。這些分解代謝物的檢測是該途徑研究的核心：在富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中，檢測到一個與 adrenochrome 在 HPLC 上滯留時間相同的化合物，支持了該途徑可在體內運作的觀點。Adrenolutin 如同 adrenochrome，屬於由受刺激中性粒細胞產生的氧自由基所驅動形成的氧化性 adrenaline 代謝物家族，其存在標誌著與壓力誘發心臟病相關的氧化性兒茶酚胺代謝的活化。

nodes.label: Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cells
nodes.description: Extracellular TFAM bound to mtDNA is pro-inflammatory: the TFAM-mtDNA complex engages RAGE on the plasmacytoid dendritic cell surface, allowing mtDNA to be internalized. Once internal, the CpG-containing mtDNA is recognized by endosomal TLR9, which initiates signaling that drives expression of inflammatory factors and makes pDCs the major producers of type I interferon.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 細胞外的 TFAM 與 mtDNA 結合後具促發炎性：TFAM–mtDNA 複合體與 plasmacytoid dendritic cell 表面上的 RAGE 結合，使 mtDNA 被內吞。進入細胞後，含 CpG 的 mtDNA 由內體膜上的 TLR9 辨識，啟動訊號傳遞並促進發炎因子的表現，也使 pDC 成為 type I interferon 的主要製造者。

nodes.label: PtdIns(4,5)P2
nodes.description: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

nodes.label: WHAMM
nodes.description: WHAMM is required for Autophagic Lysosome Reformation (ALR): during ALR it drives Arp2/3-dependent, actin-based tubulation of autolysosomes that scission proto-lysosomal tubules and rebuild the lysosomal pool after autophagic degradation. Loss of WHAMM disrupts lysosomal reformation and causes autolysosomal swelling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: WHAMM 對 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation（ALR）而言是必需的：在 ALR 過程中，它驅動依賴 Arp2/3 的、以肌動蛋白為基礎的自噬溶酶體管狀化，剪切出前溶酶體管並在自噬降解後重建溶酶體池。WHAMM 缺失會破壞溶酶體再形成並造成自噬溶酶體腫脹。

nodes.label: Trim17
nodes.description: TRIM17 is a TRIM-family E3 ubiquitin ligase whose SPRY domain directs substrate specificity toward the pro-survival BCL-2 family member Mcl-1. Catalyzing polyubiquitin attachment on Mcl-1 targets it for 26S proteasomal degradation, lowering the threshold for mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization and caspase activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TRIM17 是 TRIM 家族的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 SPRY 結構域將受質專一性導向促存活性的 BCL-2 家族成員 Mcl-1。TRIM17 催化在 Mcl-1 上接上多泛素鏈，使其被 26S 蛋白酶體辨識並降解，進而降低粒線體外膜通透化與 caspase 啟動的閾值。

nodes.label: NPM1
nodes.description: NPM1 binds both ATM and p38 MAPK in senescent cells, making it a shared interactor of the two SASP-relevant stress kinases. This dual engagement is apigenin-insensitive, which is what distinguishes NPM1 from HSPA8 as the apigenin-sensitive node responsible for SASP suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NPM1 在衰老細胞中同時結合 ATM 與 p38 MAPK，因此是這兩個與 SASP 相關壓力激酶的共同交互蛋白。這種雙重結合不受 apigenin 影響，正是 NPM1 與 HSPA8 的差別——後者才是負責 SASP 抑制的 apigenin 敏感節點。

nodes.label: AP4
nodes.description: AP4 is required for Autophagic Lysosome Reformation: it delivers lysosomal membrane proteins such as LAMP1 and LAMP2 from the trans-Golgi network to the reforming autolysosomal tubules, maintaining membrane identity and hydrolase competence. Loss of AP4 produces ALR defects, enlarged vacuoles, and reduced Autophagic Flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AP4 對 Autophagic Lysosome Formation 而言是必要的：它將 LAMP1、LAMP2 等溶酶體膜蛋白從 trans-Golgi network 運送至再形成的自噬溶酶體膜管，維持膜身分與水解酵素能力。AP4 缺失會造成 ALR 缺陷、液泡腫大與 Autophagic Flux 下降。

nodes.label: FKBP8
nodes.description: FKBP8 provides an alternative pathway for mitochondrial clearance when the canonical PINK1/Parkin pathway is impaired, which is directly relevant to Parkinson's disease, where Parkin function is compromised. By maintaining mitochondrial quality control in the absence of Parkin, FKBP8-mediated mitophagy may slow neurodegeneration driven by damaged mitochondria.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當典型的 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時，FKBP8 提供另一條清除受損粒線體的途徑，這與 Parkin 功能缺損的 Parkinson's disease 直接相關。在沒有 Parkin 的情況下，FKBP8 介導的 mitophagy 可維持粒線體品質管制，因而可能減緩受損粒線體所驅動的神經退化。

nodes.label: PLK1
nodes.description: Polo kinase 3 is distinct from PLK1 despite family membership: PLK1 is the oncogenic mitotic execution kinase that phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, whereas Plk3 is a tumor-suppressive stress sensor acting at Ser49. Care is needed not to conflate the two when interpreting polo-kinase biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Polo kinase 3 雖同屬家族，卻與 PLK1 明顯不同：PLK1 是致癌的有絲分裂執行激酶，作用於 Bcl-xL 的 Ser62；而 Plk3 則是作用於 Ser49 的腫瘤抑制性壓力感測器。解讀 polo 激酶生物學時須注意不可將兩者混為一談。

nodes.label: Sympathetic Nervous System
nodes.description: The Sympathetic Nervous System releases Epinephrine and Norepinephrine from the adrenal medulla and postganglionic terminals, alongside Cortisol from the adrenal cortex, to mobilise the body for action. Its cardiovascular signature is increased heart rate and rhythmicity, which lowers Heart Rate Variability — making HRV the readout by which sympathetic tone is tracked during stress and recovery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sympathetic Nervous System 由腎上腺髓質與節後神經末梢釋放 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine，並連同腎上腺皮質的 Cortisol，使身體動員備戰。其心血管特徵是心率與規律性上升，因而降低 Heart Rate Variability——這使 HRV 成為追蹤壓力與恢復期間交感張力的讀值。

nodes.label: CDKN2A
nodes.description: CDKN2A (p16INK4a locus) is an archetypal tumor suppressor. Classification groups it with p53/RB1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CDKN2A（p16INK4a 基因座）是典型的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類將它與 p53/RB1 並列。

nodes.label: SLC38A9
nodes.description: SLC38A9 is a lysosomal sodium-coupled amino acid transporter that also acts as a lysosomal arginine sensor. When luminal arginine is present SLC38A9 engages the Ragulator–Rag proteins complex to promote GTP-loading of RagA/B, recruiting mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface where it is activated by Rheb; autophagy is consequently suppressed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC38A9 是溶酶體的鈉偶聯胺基酸轉運蛋白，同時也是溶酶體精胺酸感測器。當腔內存在精胺酸時，SLC38A9 與 Ragulator–Rag proteins 複合體結合以促進 RagA/B 的 GTP 載入，把 mTORC1 招募到溶酶體表面並由 Rheb 活化，結果是自噬受到抑制。

nodes.label: SmgGDS
nodes.description: Estradiol induces SmgGDS (RAP1GDS1) in the female heart, where it restrains ferritinophagy-mediated ferroptosis and contributes to cardiac protection.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Estradiol 在雌性心臟誘導 SmgGDS（RAP1GDS1），抑制 ferritinophagy 介導的 ferroptosis，參與心臟保護。

nodes.label: Tissue Engineering
nodes.description: Engineered constructs augment endogenous healing of damaged tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 工程化構建體增強受損組織的內源癒合。

nodes.label: PEX1
nodes.description: PEX1 is an ATPase essential for peroxisome membrane assembly and matrix protein import, operating as part of the peroxisomal AAA (ATPases associated with diverse cellular activities) machinery. Loss of PEX1 causes a complete lack of functional peroxisomes, as import and biogenesis cannot proceed. This essential role makes PEX1 mutations among the most common causes of peroxisome biogenesis disorders. The gene thus sits at the foundation of peroxisome formation and metabolic competence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PEX1 是一種對過氧化體膜組裝和基質蛋白輸入至關必要的 ATPase，作為過氧化體 AAA（與多樣細胞活動相關的 ATPase）機械的一部分運作。PEX1 的缺失導致功能性過氧化體完全缺乏，因為輸入和生物發生無法進行。此必要角色使 PEX1 突變成為過氧化體生物發生障礙最常見的原因。因此該基因位居過氧化體形成和代謝能力的基礎。

nodes.label: Neonatal Adrenoleukodystrophy
nodes.description: Neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy (NALD) is an intermediate form of Zellweger spectrum disorders, less severe than Zellweger syndrome but more severe than infantile Refsum disease. All arise from autosomal recessive mutations in PEX genes essential for peroxisome biogenesis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 新生兒腎上腺腦白質失養症（NALD）是 Zellweger 譜系障礙的中間形式，比 Zellweger 症候群輕微但比嬰兒型 Refsum 病嚴重。兩者皆源於對過氧化體生合成必需的 PEX 基因自體隱性突變。

nodes.label: Foxp3
nodes.description: Foxp3 (Forkhead Box P3) is the forkhead transcription factor that specifies the Regulatory T Cell (Treg) lineage, making it the master regulator of Treg identity. Spermidine can promote differentiation of CD4+ T cells toward this Foxp3+ phenotype with an anti-inflammatory profile.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Foxp3（Forkhead Box P3）是指定 Regulatory T Cell（Treg）譜系的 forkhead 轉錄因子，是 Treg 身分的總調控因子。Spermidine 可促進 CD4+ T cells 向此 Foxp3+、具抗發炎特徵的表型分化。

nodes.label: Nuclear Envelope
nodes.description: cGAS is tethered at the Nuclear Envelope through Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1), which dynamically outcompetes cGAS for DNA binding and restricts its activity; NPC1 at the envelope further modulates cGAS, so envelope integrity determines whether cGAS stays quiescent or engaged.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cGAS 透過 Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1) 錨定於 Nuclear Envelope；BAF1 會動態地與 cGAS 競爭 DNA 結合並限制其活性，而位於核膜的 NPC1 進一步調節 cGAS，因此核膜完整性決定 cGAS 是保持靜默或被活化。

nodes.label: Glutamine Metabolism
nodes.description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamine metabolism in colorectal cancer cells—for example by restraining GDH-dependent anaplerosis—acting as a tumor suppressor that limits nutrient fueling of proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine catabolism. This constrains the glutamine addiction of many tumors, which rely on glutamine as a carbon and nitrogen source. It illustrates SIRT4's context-dependent tumor-suppressive role, contrasting with its metabolic-brake functions in normal tissue. Because glutamine metabolism supports both bioenergetics and nucleotide synthesis in cancer, SIRT4-mediated suppression of anaplerosis represents a potential therapeutic strategy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在大腸癌細胞中抑制穀氨酰胺代謝——例如通過限制 GDH 依賴性的回補反應——充時代謝抑制因子，限制增殖的營養燃料供應。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制的穀氨酰胺分解代謝上游。這限制了許多腫瘤對穀氨酰胺的成癮依賴性，這些腫瘤依賴穀氨酰胺作為碳和氮源。它說明了 SIRT4 情境依賴性的腫瘤抑制角色，與其在正常組織中的代謝制動功能形成對比。由於穀氨酰胺代謝在癌症中支持生物能量學和核苷酸合成，SIRT4 介導的回補反應抑制代表了一種潛在的治療策略。

nodes.label: Adrenochromatization
nodes.description: Adrenochromatization is a redox event in which epinephrine is oxidized to adrenochrome, its semiquinone radical and downstream adrenolutin, generating reactive oxygen species and depleting reducing equivalents such as glutathione and ascorbate. The process is self-amplifying through redox cycling of the semiquinone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochromatization 是一個氧化還原事件：Epinephrine 被氧化為 Adrenochrome、其 semiquinone 自由基與下游的 Adrenolutin，產生 Reactive Oxygen Species 並耗竭 glutathione、ascorbate 等還原當量。此過程藉由 semiquinone 的 Redox Cycling 自我放大。

nodes.label: Acetylation
nodes.description: Acetylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which an acetyl group is transferred from Acetyl-CoA to a substrate, catalysed by HATs and removed by HDACs and Sirtuins. Because the donor is Acetyl-CoA, acetylation status directly links Metabolism to Epigenetics: Histone lysine acetylation such as H3K9ac, H3K27ac and H4K16ac regulates Chromatin structure and Gene Expression, while non-histone acetylation modulates the activity, stability and localization of p53, NF-κB, STAT3, α-Tubulin and PGC-1α.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Acetylation 是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，將乙醯基由 Acetyl-CoA 轉移至受質，由 HAT 催化，並由 HDAC 與 Sirtuins 移除。由於供體是 Acetyl-CoA，乙醯化狀態直接將 Metabolism 與 Epigenetics 連結：H3K9ac、H3K27ac、H4K16ac 等組蛋白離胺酸乙醯化調控 Chromatin 結構與 Gene Expression，而非組蛋白乙醯化則調節 p53、NF-κB、STAT3、α-Tubulin 與 PGC-1α 的活性、穩定性與定位。

nodes.label: Terminal Differentiation
nodes.description: Terminal identity opposes the undifferentiated pluripotent ground state. Opposition separates endpoints from origins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 終末身份對立未分化的多能性基態。對立將終點與起源分開。

nodes.label: Phospholipase A2
nodes.description: Phospholipase A2 enzymes hydrolyze phospholipids to release arachidonic acid and lysophospholipids. Peroxiredoxin 6 uniquely carries an iPLA2 (calcium-independent PLA2) activity whose suppression underlies apigenin's senomorphic SASP suppression.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 磷脂酶 A2（PLA2）水解磷脂以釋放花生四烯酸與溶血磷脂。過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）獨特地帶有 iPLA2（鈣非依賴 PLA2）活性，其抑制是 apigenin 的 senomorphic SASP 壓制基礎。

nodes.label: c-ABL
nodes.description: BCR-ABL is the constitutively active tyrosine kinase produced by the t(9;22) Philadelphia translocation, which fuses BCR to the c-ABL kinase moiety; this fusion deregulates c-ABL and drives leukemia via RAS/MAPK, PI3K/AKT and STAT5 survival signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BCR-ABL 是由 t(9;22) 費城染色體轉位所產生的持續活化酪胺酸激酶，該轉位將 BCR 與 c-ABL 激酶片段融合；此融合使 c-ABL 去調控，並透過 RAS/MAPK、PI3K/AKT 與 STAT5 存活訊號驅動白血病。

nodes.label: TGF-beta
nodes.description: TGF-beta induces NOX4 expression, increasing a steady source of H2O2 that acts as a second messenger for TGF-beta's pro-fibrotic program. This couples the cytokine to redox signaling in fibroblasts and epithelium. The directionality is TGF-beta to NOX4 upregulation to H2O2. A caveat is that TGF-beta also signals through Smad and MAPK pathways, so NOX4-derived H2O2 is a contributor, not the sole mediator. NOX4-derived H2O2 is required for TGF-beta-induced epithelial-mesenchymal transition and contributes to fibrosis in kidney, lung, and heart.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 誘導 NOX4 表達，增加 H2O2 的穩定來源，作為 TGF-beta 促纖維化程序的第二信使。這將細胞激素與纖維母細胞和上皮細胞中的氧化還原訊號偶聯。方向性是 TGF-beta 到 NOX4 上調到 H2O2。需要注意的是，TGF-beta 也透過 Smad 和 MAPK 途徑發出訊號，因此 NOX4-derived H2O2 是貢獻者，而不是唯一的中介者。 NOX4-derived H2O2 是 TGF-beta 誘導的上皮間質轉化所必需的，並有助於腎臟、肺部和心臟中的 fibrosis。

nodes.label: Sodium Butyrate
nodes.description: Sodium butyrate (HDAC inhibitor) induces senescence-like state via p21 upregulation, which can be both p53-dependent and independent.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sodium butyrate（HDAC 抑制劑）透過 p21 上調誘發類衰老狀態，可為 p53 依賴或非依賴。

nodes.label: Glioma
nodes.description: Glioblastoma is the most common and most malignant primary CNS tumor in adults, classified as a grade IV astrocytoma and representing the most malignant end of the glioma spectrum. Despite surgical resection, radiotherapy, temozolomide chemotherapy, and tumor-treating fields, median survival remains under 15 months, which is why glioma-directed mechanisms such as sirtuin modulation are studied intensively in this entity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腦膜瘤是成人中最常見且最具惡性的原發性中樞神經系統腫瘤，被歸類為第 4 級星狀膠細胞瘤，代表 gliome 譜系中最惡性的端點。儘管已有手術切除、放射治療、temozolomide 化學治療與腫瘤電場治療，中位存活期仍低於 15 個月；這也是 sirtuin 調節等 gliome 相關機制在此疾病中被密集研究的原因。

nodes.label: Flavonoid
nodes.description: Brosimine B is described as a prenylated flavan flavonoid (2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan, C20H22O3). Like other neuroprotective flavonoids such as hesperidin, it combines antioxidant and biphasic dose-response properties. Its flavonoid chemistry underpins the proposed ROS-scavenging and enzyme-modulating actions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Brosimine B 被描述為異戊烯基黃烷類 Flavonoid（2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan，C20H22O3）。與 hesperidin 等神經保護類黃酮一樣，兼具抗氧化與雙相劑量反應特性。其黃酮化學結構是所提 ROS 清除與酶調節作用的基礎。

nodes.label: Wallerian Degeneration
nodes.description: SARM1 is the central non-redundant executor of Wallerian degeneration: SARM1 knockout mice are profoundly resistant to Wallerian degeneration across peripheral nerves, dorsal root ganglia and optic nerve, and axotomized SARM1-null axons stay structurally intact for days to weeks. SARM1 inhibition also improves functional recovery in rodent sciatic nerve crush and transection models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SARM1 是華勒氏退行性變（axon degeneration 後程式性退行）的核心且不可替代的執行者：SARM1 敲除小鼠在周邊神經、背根神經節與視神經中皆高度抵抗華勒氏退行性變，軸切後的 SARM1 缺失軸突可維持結構完整數天至數週。抑制 SARM1 亦可在小鼠坐骨神經壓傷與離斷模型中改善功能恢復。

nodes.label: S. cerevisiae
nodes.description: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (baker's yeast) is the preeminent eukaryotic model organism for dissecting aging, metabolism, and redox homeostasis. Its short replicative lifespan is highly tractable genetically, and conserved longevity pathways first mapped in yeast — TOR/Sch9, Sir2, AMPK/Snf1, and the mitochondrial Retrograde Response — translate directly to mammalian biology.
nodes.description_zh_TW: *Saccharomyces cerevisiae*（烘焙酵母）是剖析老化、代謝與氧化還原恆定的首選真核 Model Organisms。其短複製壽命在遺傳上高度可操作，而在酵母首先被繪製的保守延壽路徑——TOR/Sch9、Sir2、AMPK/Snf1 以及粒線體 Retrograde Response——可直接轉譯到哺乳類生物學。

nodes.label: Proteobacteria
nodes.description: Proteobacteria is one of the largest and most physiologically diverse phyla of Gram-Negative Bacteria, spanning Alpha-, Beta-, Gamma-, Delta- and Epsilonproteobacteria and including familiar genera such as Escherichia, Salmonella, Pseudomonas, Helicobacter and Campylobacter, plus a substantial fraction of known pathogens.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Proteobacteria 是 Gram-Negative Bacteria 中最大且生理多樣性最高的菌門之一，涵蓋 Alpha-、Beta-、Gamma-、Delta- 與 Epsilonproteobacteria，並包含 Escherichia、Salmonella、Pseudomonas、Helicobacter、Campylobacter 等常見菌屬，以及相當比例的已知病原體。

nodes.label: Tyrosine Nitration
nodes.description: Peroxynitrite (ONOO-) is the most powerful oxidant driving tyrosine nitration, converting a tyrosine residue to 3-nitrotyrosine either directly or via intermediate radicals (tyrosyl radical plus nitrogen dioxide). Peroxynitrite itself forms where nitric oxide and superoxide coincide, so nitration marks sites of combined nitric oxide and superoxide generation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite（ONOO-）是推動 Tyrosine Nitration 最強的氧化劑，可直接或經由中間自由基（tyrosyl radical 加 nitrogen dioxide）將酪胺酸殘基轉換為 3-nitrotyrosine。Peroxynitrite 本身在一氧化氮與超氧陰離子交會處形成，因此硝化標記出的是一氧化氮與超氧陰離子共同生成的位點。

nodes.label: PD-1
nodes.description: PD-1, a type I transmembrane inhibitory receptor of the CD28 family with ITIM and ITSM motifs, is engaged by PD-L1 (B7-H1/CD274) and PD-L2. Ligand engagement recruits the SHP-1 and SHP-2 phosphatases to the ITSM, dephosphorylating downstream CD28/PI3K/AKT and RAS-MEK-ERK components and suppressing T-cell proliferation, cytokine production, and cytotoxicity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PD-1 是 CD28 家族具 ITIM 與 ITSM 模體的 I 型跨膜抑制性受體，由 PD-L1（B7-H1/CD274）與 PD-L2 結合。配體結合會將 SHP-1 與 SHP-2 磷酸酶招募至 ITSM，使下游 CD28/PI3K/AKT 與 RAS-MEK-ERK 成分去磷酸化，抑制 T 細胞增殖、細胞激素生成與細胞毒性。

nodes.label: Bone Marrow
nodes.description: Bone marrow, a semi-solid tissue in the trabecular portions of bone, is the primary site of hematopoiesis in adult mammals, producing on the order of 500 billion blood cells per day across erythrocyte, platelet, granulocyte, monocyte and lymphocyte lineages.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bone marrow 是位於骨小樑狀骨內的半固體組織，是成年哺乳類主要的 hematopoiesis 場所，每天產生約五千億個血球，涵蓋紅血球、血小板、顆粒球、單核球與淋巴球等系列。

nodes.label: SLC3A2
nodes.description: SLC3A2 (4F2hc/CD98) is the heavy-chain subunit of several heterodimeric amino acid transporters, most relevantly the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter. SLC3A2 does not itself bind cystine but is essential for the proper folding, disulfide-linked assembly and plasma-membrane localization of its catalytic light-chain partner SLC7A11 (xCT); the SLC7A11–SLC3A2 heterodimer is the functional unit, and SLC7A11 alone is retained in the ER.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SLC3A2（4F2hc／CD98）是數個異二聚體胺基酸轉運蛋白的重鏈次單元，其中最重要的是 system Xc- 胱胺／麩胺酸反向運輸體。SLC3A2 本身不結合胱胺，但它對其催化輕鏈 partner SLC7A11（xCT）的正確摺疊、二硫鍵連結組裝與質膜定位不可或缺；SLC7A11–SLC3A2 異二聚體才是功能單元，单独的 SLC7A11 會滯留於內質網。

nodes.label: DPP4
nodes.description: Plasma-membrane-associated DPP4 is the proximal cause of lipid peroxidation in colorectal cancer: p53 loss blocks DPP4 nuclear accumulation, redistributing the protease to the plasma membrane where its activity generates the peroxidation that executes ferroptosis. DPP4 is thus a druggable node, already validated in diabetes by gliptins, for tuning ferroptotic therapy responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 colorectal cancer 中，plasma-membrane-associated 的 DPP4 是脂質過氧化的近端成因：p53 喪失阻斷 DPP4 的核內累積，使此蛋白酶重新分配至質膜，並由其活性產生導致 ferroptosis 的過氧化作用。因此 DPP4 是一個可成藥的節點（已由 gliptins 在糖尿病中驗證），可用於調節鐵死亡治療的反應。

nodes.label: Deacetylases
nodes.description: Deacetylases remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histones and other proteins, opposing acetyltransferases and thereby shaping the cellular acetylation landscape. Deacetylation of Histone H3 and Histone H4 generally condenses Chromatin and represses transcription, while deacetylation of non-histone targets such as FOXO and p53 modulates transcription factor activity, DNA repair and metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 去乙醯化酶移除組蛋白與其他蛋白上離胺酸殘基的乙醯基，與乙醯轉移酶作用相反，因而塑造細胞的乙醯化景觀。Histone H3 與 Histone H4 的去乙醯化一般會使 Chromatin 濃縮並抑制轉錄；而 FOXO 與 p53 等非組蛋白標的的去乙醯化則調節轉錄因子活性、DNA 修復與代謝。

nodes.label: Mrps5
nodes.description: Mrps5 encodes a small subunit of the mammalian mitoribosome, whose knockdown reduces mitochondrial translation capacity and produces a mild respiratory deficiency that is sensed as proteotoxic stress. This activates the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, in which ATF5/ATFS-1 relocalizes to the nucleus and induces mitochondrial chaperones, proteases and antioxidant defenses; sublethal inhibition of Mrps5 phenocopies pharmacological translation blockers such as doxycycline and actinonin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mrps5 編碼哺乳類粒線體核糖體的小次單元，其敲低會降低粒線體轉譯能力，產生被感知為蛋白毒性壓力的輕度呼吸缺陷。這會活化粒線體未折疊蛋白反應：ATF5/ATFS-1 轉位入核並誘導粒線體伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與抗氧化防禦；Mrps5 的亞致死抑制可 phenocopy doxycycline 與 actinonin 等藥理學轉譯抑制劑。

nodes.label: CKII
nodes.description: CKII phosphorylates and thereby stabilizes the anti-apoptotic protein Mcl-1, one of more than 300 CKII substrates spanning transcription factors, tumour suppressors such as p53 and PTEN, cell-cycle regulators and apoptotic proteins. Stabilized Mcl-1 buffers the apoptotic threshold, letting CKII drive proliferation while disabling cell-death checkpoints.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CKII 磷酸化並因此穩定抗凋亡蛋白 Mcl-1；Mcl-1 只是 CKII 三百多個受質之一，另有轉錄因子、p53 與 PTEN 等腫瘤抑制基因、細胞週期調節因子及凋亡相關蛋白。穩定化的 Mcl-1 緩衝了凋亡門檻，使 CKII 得以一方面驅動增殖、另一方面關閉細胞死亡檢查點。

nodes.label: FBW7
nodes.description: FBW7 recognizes the GSK3-primed S155/S159 phosphodegron on Mcl-1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FBW7 辨識 Mcl-1 上經 GSK3 啟動的 S155/S159 磷酸降解子。

nodes.label: MET gene
nodes.description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

nodes.label: Satellite Cell
nodes.description: Satellite cells are the tissue-resident muscle stem cells of skeletal muscle, located between the basal lamina and the sarcolemma of mature muscle fibers. They are essential for postnatal muscle growth, regeneration after injury, and maintenance of muscle mass throughout life, and they are held in a quiescent G0 state marked by Pax7 until activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Satellite cell 是 skeletal muscle 的組織常駐 muscle stem cell，位於成熟肌纖維的 basal lamina 與 sarcolemma 之間。它們對出生後的肌肉生長、受傷後的再生，以及終生的肌肉量維持不可或缺，並在以 Pax7 為標記的 G0 靜止狀態中維持，直到被活化為止。

nodes.label: T-bet
nodes.description: IL-12 signaling through STAT4 induces T-bet (TBX21) in naive CD4+ T cells, committing them to the Th1 lineage. T-bet then drives interferon-gamma production while suppressing the competing Th2 (GATA3) and Th17 fates, so IL-12 upstream sets the balance between defense against intracellular pathogens and allergic responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-12 透過 STAT4 的訊號會在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中誘導 T-bet（TBX21），使其承諾走向 Th1 譜系。之後 T-bet 驅動 interferon-gamma 的產生，同時抑制競爭性的 Th2（GATA3）與 Th17 命運，因此上游的 IL-12 決定了對抗細胞內病原體與過敏反應之間的平衡。

nodes.label: BrdU
nodes.description: BrdU is a thymidine analog that competes with endogenous thymidine for incorporation by DNA Polymerase during replicative synthesis. Because it is only incorporated into actively dividing cells, it is the basis of proliferation labeling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BrdU 是胸腺嘧啶核苷類似物，在複製合成過程中與內源性胸腺嘧啶核苷競爭 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）的Incorporation（摻入）。由於它只會被摻入正在分裂的細胞，因此成為細胞增殖標定的基礎。

nodes.label: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases
nodes.description: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases are endoplasmic reticulum resident phase-two conjugation enzymes. Localization places the superfamily at the detoxification membrane.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases 是內質網駐留的二相結合酶。定位將此超家族置於解毒膜。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

nodes.label: CXCR3
nodes.description: CXCL10 (IP-10) is an ELR- C-X-C chemokine and principal ligand of CXCR3 (also CXCR3B). Unlike ELR+ CXC chemokines it is not angiogenic or neutrophil-directed; instead CXCR3 activation couples to Galphai, PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ flux to drive polarized migration of Th1/CD8+ T cells, NK cells and monocytes, supporting immune surveillance of senescent cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CXCL10（IP-10）是 ELR− 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，也是 CXCR3（以及 CXCR3B）的主要配體。與 ELR+ CXC 趨化因子不同，它不具血管生成或中性球趨化作用；相反地，CXCR3 活化後耦合 Gαi、PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ flux，驅動 Th1/CD8+ T 細胞、NK 細胞與單核球的極化移行，支持對衰老細胞的免疫監視。

nodes.label: Xenohormesis
nodes.description: The Hormesis Vocabulary Bridge includes Xenohormesis among the nutrition-side synonyms for hormesis, alongside dietary hormesis and hormetins delivered in whole foods.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hormesis Vocabulary Bridge 將 Xenohormesis 列為營養領域的 hormesis 同義詞之一，與 dietary hormesis 及以全食物攝取的 hormetin 並列。

nodes.label: NuRD complex
nodes.description: CHD4 is the essential ATPase remodeling subunit of NuRD. Containment records the complex composition.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CHD4 是 NuRD 必要的 ATPase 重塑次單元。包含記錄複合體組成。

nodes.label: Creatine Phosphate Shuttle
nodes.description: The creatine phosphate (phosphocreatine/creatine kinase) shuttle is built on compartmentalized creatine kinase isoforms: mitochondrial CK sits on the outer mitochondrial membrane near the adenine nucleotide translocator and uses exported matrix ATP to phosphorylate creatine, while cytosolic, sarcomeric, and brain-type CK isoforms regenerate ATP from phosphocreatine plus ADP at the sites of ATP consumption.
nodes.description_zh_TW: creatine phosphate（phosphocreatine/creatine kinase）shuttle 建立在分區化的 creatine kinase 異型酶之上：粒線體型 CK 定位於外膜、靠近 adenine nucleotide translocator，利用外排的基質 ATP 磷酸化 creatine；而細胞質型、sarcomeric 與腦型 CK 異型酶則在 ATP 消耗位點以 phosphocreatine 加上 ADP 重新生成 ATP。

nodes.label: Leucine
nodes.description: Leucine is one of the three Branched-Chain Amino Acids, alongside isoleucine and valine. It is the most potent amino-acid activator of mTORC1, and dietary leucine restriction alone recapitulates many hallmarks of protein restriction such as suppressed mTORC1 signalling, reduced hepatic steatosis and improved metabolic health.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Leucine 是三大 Branched-Chain Amino Acids 之一，與 isoleucine、valine 並列。它是 mTORC1 最強的胺基酸活化劑；單獨限制飲食中的 leucine 即可重現蛋白限制的許多特徵，例如 mTORC1 訊號被抑制、肝臟脂肪變性減少以及代謝健康改善。

nodes.label: Vitamin K
nodes.description: Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant that inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), blocking the recycling of oxidized vitamin K to its reduced form and thereby preventing the gamma-carboxylation and activation of clotting factors II, VII, IX and X along with the regulatory proteins protein C and protein S.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Warfarin 是一种口服抗凝血劑，抑制維生素 K 環氧化物還原酶（VKORC1），阻斷氧化態維生素 K 還原為其還原態，因而阻止凝血因子 II、VII、IX、X 以及調節性蛋白質 protein C 與 protein S 的 γ-羧化與活化。

nodes.label: Certificate of Analysis
nodes.description: For research chemicals such as leuco-adrenochrome, a Certificate of Analysis issued by Quality Assurance documents the purity, identity and storage conditions of a batch, with identity typically verified by H-NMR or mass spectrometry. This is important because synthetic batches of quinone intermediates can easily degrade if handled improperly, making batch-specific documentation necessary.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 對 Leuco-adrenochrome 等研究用化學品而言，由品質保證部門發出的 Certificate of Analysis 記載了該批次的純度、鑑別與儲存條件，鑑別通常以 H-NMR 或 Mass Spectrometry 驗證。這點很重要，因為醌類中間物的合成批次在處理不當時極易降解，因此必須有批次專屬的文件。

nodes.label: CRM1
nodes.description: CRM1 inhibitors such as Leptomycin B and Selinexor (KPT-330) cause nuclear accumulation of TFEB and thereby induce autophagy. Selinexor is FDA-approved for multiple myeloma, making CRM1 a therapeutically tractable node in autophagy regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CRM1 抑制劑如 Leptomycin B 與 Selinexor（KPT-330）會造成 TFEB 在核內累積，進而誘導 Autophagy。Selinexor 已獲 FDA 核准用於多發性骨髓瘤，使 CRM1 成為可治療的自噬調控節點。

nodes.label: Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy
nodes.description: Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy is acute or subacute myocardial injury and systolic dysfunction driven by sustained supraphysiologic excess of Catecholamines, particularly norepinephrine. It presents classically as stress (Takotsubo) cardiomyopathy or as pheochromocytoma-associated cardiomyopathy, and histologically shows contraction-band necrosis without dominant coronary occlusion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy（兒茶酚胺誘發性心肌病變）是由持續過高的 Catecholamines（尤其是 norepinephrine）所驅動的急性或亞急性心肌損傷與收縮功能障礙。典型表現為壓力性（Takotsubo）心肌病變或 pheochromocytoma 相關心肌病變，組織學上呈現收縮帶壞死而無主要冠狀動脈阻塞。

nodes.label: SLC1A5
nodes.description: miR-137 directly targets SLC1A5, the glutamine transporter that feeds GSH and TCA/anabolic pathways supporting antioxidant defence. This post-transcriptional control means small RNAs tune the glutamine-GSH axis that sets the GPX4 defence threshold in melanoma, making miR-137 and SLC1A5 candidate biomarkers and therapeutic nodes for sensitising resistant melanoma to ferroptosis inducers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: miR-137 直接標定 SLC1A5；此麩醯胺酸轉運蛋白供應 GSH 以及支撐抗氧化防禦的 TCA／合成代謝路徑。這種轉錄後調控意味著小 RNA 可微調設定 melanoma 中 GPX4 防禦閾值的麩醯胺酸–GSH 軸，使 miR-137 與 SLC1A5 成為使抗藥性 melanoma 對 ferroptosis 誘導物敏感的候選生物標記與治療節點。

nodes.label: Prostaglandin H₂
nodes.description: Prostaglandin H₂ (PGH₂) is produced when the peroxidase site of the same cyclooxygenase reduces the C15 hydroperoxide of PGG₂ to a C15 hydroxyl, converting the hydroperoxide intermediate into the common precursor of all prostanoids — prostaglandins, thromboxane A₂ and prostacyclin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 當同一環氧化酶的過氧化酶位點將 PGG₂ 的 C15 過氧基還原為 C15 羥基時，產生 Prostaglandin H₂（PGH₂），使此過氧化中間產物轉為所有前列腺素類——前列腺素、thromboxane A₂ 與 prostacyclin——的共同前驅物。

nodes.label: Mectizan Donation Program
nodes.description: Established in 1987, the Mectizan Donation Program manages Merck & Co. Inc's donation of Mectizan (brand-name ivermectin) free of charge, handling logistics, distribution and pharmacovigilance with endemic-country ministries of health, the World Health Organization and non-governmental partners. It became the template for large-scale philanthropic drug donation and a cornerstone of neglected-tropical-disease elimination.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mectizan Donation Program 成立於 1987 年，負責管理 Merck & Co. Inc 免費捐贈的 Mectizan（ivermectin 的商品名），並與流行國衛生部門、World Health Organization 及非政府夥伴共同處理後勤、分發與藥物警戒。它成為大規模慈善藥品捐贈的典範，也是 neglected tropical disease 根除計畫的基石。

nodes.label: Frailty Index
nodes.description: The clinical frailty index operationalizes frailty as a continuous score over accumulated health deficits; the Whitehead index scores 31 parameters spanning body condition, locomotion and integumentary signs in mice and correlates with biological age.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 臨床 frailty index 將 frailty 操作化為累積健康缺損的連續分數；Whitehead 指數在小鼠中評分涵蓋身體狀況、運動與皮膚徵象的 31 項參數，並與生物學年齡相關。

nodes.label: FACT complex
nodes.description: The FACT complex (SSRP1/SUPT16H) is a histone chaperone that binds TFEB and thereby facilitates expression of lysosomal and antioxidant genes. SUMOylation of TFEB at K316 attenuates its transcriptional activity by reducing its binding to FACT complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FACT complex（SSRP1/SUPT16H）是 histone chaperone，可與 TFEB 結合，藉此促進 lysosome 與抗氧化基因的表現。TFEB 在 K316 的 SUMO 化會減少其與 FACT complex 的結合，因而削弱其轉錄活性。

nodes.label: Cross-link Breakers
nodes.description: Cross-link breakers are pharmacological agents that cleave or destabilize pre-existing covalent cross-links — especially advanced glycation end-product bridges such as glucosepane and pentosidine — that accumulate in long-lived proteins during aging and diabetes. Unlike AGE inhibitors, breakers actively reverse already-formed cross-links, potentially restoring tissue elasticity and protein turnover.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cross-link Breakers 是切斷或破壞既有共價交聯的藥理作用劑——尤其是 Aging 與糖尿病期間在長壽命蛋白質中累積的 Advanced Glycation End Products 交聯橋，如 Glucosepane 與 Pentosidine。與 AGE 抑制劑不同，breaker 主動逆轉已形成的交聯，有望恢復組織彈性與蛋白質周轉。

nodes.label: Hypusination
nodes.description: Hypusination converts lysine K50 of eIF5A to hypusine through the sequential action of DHPS and DOHH. This unique post-translational modification is required for eIF5A to function in translation elongation, and it is the reason Spermidine can raise the synthesis of proteins such as TFEB.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hypusination 透過 DHPS 與 DOHH 的連續作用，將 eIF5A 的 K50 離胺酸轉換為 hypusine。此獨特的轉譯後修飾是 eIF5A 執行轉譯延伸功能的必要條件，也是 Spermidine 能提高 TFEB 等蛋白質合成的原因。

nodes.label: Tumor Antigen
nodes.description: Tumor antigens are the molecular signatures by which the immune system distinguishes malignant cells, presented on MHC to cytotoxic T cells. Loss or down-regulation of antigen/MHC is a key route to immune evasion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抗原是免疫系統用以區分惡性細胞的分子特徵，在 MHC 上呈遞給細胞毒性 T 細胞。抗原/MHC 的喪失或下調是免疫逃逸的關鍵途徑。

nodes.label: Nanocrystals
nodes.description: Nanocrystals are pure, carrier-free drug particles below 1 µm dispersed with a stabilizer into a nanosuspension. Because they contain no matrix material — only active compound — reducing particle size into the nanorange increases surface area and dissolution velocity (Noyes–Whitney), improving gastrointestinal absorption and Bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs such as Fisetin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nanocrystals 是純粹的無載體藥物顆粒，粒徑小於 1 µm，並與穩定劑一起分散成 nanosuspension。由於不含任何基質材料——只有活性成分——將顆粒縮小至奈米尺度會增加表面積與溶解速率（Noyes–Whitney），從而改善 Fisetin 等難溶性藥物的腸胃吸收與 Bioavailability。

nodes.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function. In mouse models this reduction was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis, and it complements established antihypertensive therapies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Nicotinamide riboside 補充可降低 systolic blood pressure 與主動脈僵硬，這兩者是心血管功能的重要臨床風險指標。在小鼠模型中，此降低效果與 NAD+ 恆定的改善同時出現，並可作為既有降血壓治療的補充。

nodes.label: SERT
nodes.description: SERT is the primary target of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) and of tricyclic antidepressants; blocking reuptake raises synaptic serotonin and relieves mood disorders, while combining serotonergic agents risks serotonin syndrome. Serotonin tone is also shaped by monoamine oxidase catabolism and by serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, and SLC6A4 polymorphisms modulate stress resilience and psychiatric disorder risk.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SERT 是選擇性血清素再攝取抑制劑（SSRIs）與三環類抗憂鬱劑的主要標的；阻斷再攝取會提高突觸內血清素、緩解情緒障礙，但合併使用血清素類藥物有造成血清素症候群的風險。血清素張力亦受單胺氧化酶分解與血清素－正腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑影響，而 SLC6A4 多型性可調節壓力韌性與精神疾病風險。

nodes.label: Physical Activity Level
nodes.description: Physical activity level (PAL) is the DEE:RMR ratio from doubly-labelled water data: ~1.66 in contemporary Western adults (n=574), meaning about 60% of energy is spent at rest, versus ~2.6x RMR in free-living wild mammals (range 1.4-7.5), which spend only ~32% of their daily budget at rest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 體力活動量（PAL）為雙標水資料所得的 DEE:RMR 比值：當代西方成年人約 1.66（n=574），代表約 60% 的能量花在休息；自由生活的野生哺乳類則平均約 2.6 倍 RMR（範圍 1.4–7.5），僅約 32% 的每日預算用於休息。

nodes.label: N6-methyladenosine
nodes.description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the writer complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine on mRNA co-transcriptionally, working with METTL14 and accessory proteins such as WTAP and VIRMA. It methylates roughly 0.1–0.4% of adenosines, preferentially in the DRACH consensus motif near stop codons, 3′ UTRs and long internal exons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: METTL3 是催化次單元，與 METTL14 及 WTAP、VIRMA 等輔助蛋白共同組成 writer 複合體，於轉錄時在 mRNA 上沉積 N6-methyladenosine。它甲基化約 0.1–0.4% 的腺苷，偏好位於終止密碼子、3′ UTR 與長內含子附近的 DRACH 共識序列。

nodes.label: Abemaciclib
nodes.description: Abemaciclib (LY2835219) is a selective CDK4/CDK6 inhibitor with pharmacology distinct from Palbociclib: higher potency, a continuous dosing schedule, and the ability to cross the blood-brain barrier.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Abemaciclib（LY2835219）是選擇性的 CDK4/CDK6 抑制劑，其藥理特性與 Palbociclib 不同：效力較高、採連續給藥，且能通過血腦障蔽。

nodes.label: FGF
nodes.description: FGF is one of the major growth factor families (with EGF, PDGF, VEGF, IGF, HGF, TGFβ). Its 22 members signal through FGFR tyrosine kinases to activate RAS/MAPK cascades driving proliferation, Cell Migration, and tissue repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FGF（纖維母細胞生長因子）是主要生長因子家族之一（與 EGF、PDGF、VEGF、IGF、HGF、TGFβ 並列）。其 22 個成員透過 FGFR 酪胺酸激酶傳遞訊號，啟動 RAS/MAPK 級聯以驅動增殖、Cell Migration（細胞遷移）與組織修復。

nodes.label: Pazopanib
nodes.description: Pazopanib is a multi-targeted tyrosine-kinase inhibitor that blocks VEGFR signaling (alongside PDGFR and c-KIT) and is used as antiangiogenic therapy. It is cited as the VEGFR-directed agent in fenbendazole cancer case-report contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Pazopanib 是多標的酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，可阻斷 VEGFR 訊號（並同時作用於 PDGFR 與 c-KIT），用作抗血管新生治療。在 fenbendazole 癌症個案報告的脈絡中，它是所引用的 VEGFR 標的藥物。

nodes.label: ABCG1
nodes.description: ABCG1 transcription is strongly induced by the liver X receptors (LXRα/β) in response to accumulating oxysterols, coupling intracellular sterol load to efflux capacity. In macrophage foam cells ABCG1-driven cholesterol export to HDL protects against Atherosclerosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABCG1 的轉錄會在 oxysterol 累積時受到肝 X 受體 (LXRα/β) 強烈誘導，將細胞內類固醇負載與外排能力相連結。在巨噬細胞泡沫細胞中，ABCG1 驅動的膽固醇外排至 HDL 可防止 Atherosclerosis。

nodes.label: metabolic disorders
nodes.description: Metabolic disorders are associated with Autophagy dysfunction, which is a common feature across the class rather than a feature of any single disease. This makes autophagic-lysosomal capacity a therapeutic target of unusually broad reach, and also explains why TFEB activation improves several metabolically distinct conditions at once.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 代謝疾病與 Autophagy 功能異常相關，而這是整類疾病共有的特徵，而非任一單一疾病的特徵。這使自噬－溶酶體容量成為觸及面極廣的治療標的，也解釋了為何 TFEB 活化能同時改善多種代謝機制不同的疾病。

nodes.label: Lipid hydroperoxide
nodes.description: GPX4 is the only enzyme that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides inside the membrane, using its catalytic selenocysteine and two glutathione to convert LOOH to the inert lipid alcohol before the chain branches. Substituting cysteine for selenocysteine costs about 100-fold activity, and dietary Selenium loss removes the catalytic residue entirely, which is why selenium deficiency sensitizes tissue to ferroptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GPX4 是唯一能在膜內還原磷脂質過氧化物的酵素，利用其催化的 selenocysteine 與兩個 glutathione 將 LOOH 轉為惰性的脂質醇，在鏈式反應分支之前完成。將 selenocysteine 換成 cysteine 會使活性下降約 100 倍，而飲食中 Selenium 流失則完全移除催化殘基，這也是 selenium 缺乏會讓組織易感鐵死亡的原因。

nodes.label: Model Organisms
nodes.description: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。

nodes.label: MJ33
nodes.description: MJ33 is a selective inhibitor of the acidic calcium-independent phospholipase A2 (iPLA2) activity of peroxiredoxin 6, the direct molecular target of the senomorphic apigenin; inhibiting PRDX6 iPLA2 is sufficient to produce a senomorphic effect.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MJ33 是過氧化還原蛋白 6（PRDX6）酸性鈣非依賴型磷脂酶 A2（iPLA2）活性的選擇性抑制劑，也是 senomorphic 化合物 apigenin 的直接分子標的；抑制 PRDX6 的 iPLA2 即足以產生 senomorphic 效應。

nodes.label: Glycine
nodes.description: In mitochondria SHMT2 converts Serine to glycine plus a one-carbon unit; this is the dominant entry point of one-carbon metabolism in proliferating and cancer cells, supplying nucleotides, NADPH and methylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在線粒體中 SHMT2 將 Serine 轉換為 glycine 與一個一碳單位；這是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳代謝的主要入口，供應核苷酸、NADPH 與甲基化能力。

nodes.label: Hrk
nodes.description: Hrk (Harakiri, BCL2 interacting protein) is a pro-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family, listed alongside Bax, Bak, Bad, Bcl-Xs, Bid, Bik and Bim in opposition to the anti-apoptotic members Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Bcl-w, A1-Bfl-1 and Mcl-1. Its altered expression or mutation is associated with cancer, neurodegenerative disease and developmental disorders.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hrk（Harakiri，BCL2 interacting protein）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡成員，與 Bax、Bak、Bad、Bcl-Xs、Bid、Bik、Bim 一同被列為對抗抗凋亡成員 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Bcl-w、A1-Bfl-1 與 Mcl-1 的一群。其表現改變或突變與癌症、神經退化性疾病及發育異常相關。

nodes.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
nodes.description: Immune Checkpoint is targeted by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Immune checkpoint inhibitors are antibodies that release the brakes on T cells by blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4 interactions. The directionality runs from Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors toward Immune Checkpoint, so Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 是 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 的目標。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是透過阻斷 PD-1/PD-L1 或 CTLA-4 交互作用來釋放 T 細胞煞車作用的抗體。方向性從 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 向 Immune Checkpoint 延伸，因此 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

nodes.label: PLK3
nodes.description: PLK3 phosphorylates BCL-XL at Ser49, causing cell cycle G2 arrest in lymphoma cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PLK3 在 Ser49 磷酸化 BCL-XL，在淋巴瘤細胞中造成細胞週期 G2 停滯。

nodes.label: Strongyloides
nodes.description: Strongyloides, principally S. stercoralis, causes Strongyloidiasis. It is exceptional among parasitic nematodes in completing both a host-dependent and a free-living cycle and in producing autoinfective filariform larvae within the host, allowing chronic infection to persist for decades without exogenous re-exposure.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Strongyloides（以 S. stercoralis 為主）造成 Strongyloidiasis。它在寄生線蟲中相當特殊，既能完成宿主依賴型與自由生活型兩種生活史，又能在宿主體內產生自傳染性的絲狀幼蟲，使慢性感染在無外源性再暴露的情況下仍可持續數十年。

nodes.label: Intestinal Stem Cell
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), an NAD+ precursor, restores NAD+ in intestinal stem cells and reverses mtDNA-mutation-driven dysfunction via UPRmt, linking the NAD+ fuel line to stem-cell resilience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）作為 NAD+ 前體，可恢復腸道幹細胞的 NAD+，並經 UPRmt 逆轉 mtDNA 突變驅動的功能障礙，將 NAD+ 燃料線與幹細胞韌性連結。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: IL-1 Receptor
nodes.description: Anakinra is recombinant human IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1Ra). It binds IL-1R1 with high affinity but does not recruit the accessory protein IL-1RAcP, making it a competitive antagonist that prevents MyD88-dependent signalling and thereby blocks NF-κB and MAPK activation, reducing transcription of pro-inflammatory genes including IL1B, TNFα, IL-6 and COX-2.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Anakinra 是重組的人類 IL-1 受體拮抗劑（IL-1Ra）。它以高親和力結合 IL-1R1，但不會招募輔助蛋白 IL-1RAcP，因此作為競爭性拮抗劑阻斷 MyD88 相依訊息傳遞，進而阻斷 NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化，減少 IL1B、TNFα、IL-6 與 COX-2 等促發炎基因的轉錄。

nodes.label: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens
nodes.description: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens is a human intestinal bacterium of the Eggerthellaceae family that metabolizes dietary Ellagic acid into Isourolithin A, an isomer of Urolithin A. Together with Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens it accounts for the conversion of ellagic acid into the urolithin metabolite class in the colon, determining which urolithin species is produced.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 是 Eggerthellaceae 科的人類腸道菌，能將膳食中的 Ellagic acid 代謝為 Isourolithin A（Urolithin A 的異構物）。它與 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 共同負責在結腸中將 ellagic acid 轉為 urolithin 類代謝物，決定所產生的 urolithin 物種。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Preiss-Handler Pathway
nodes.description: The Preiss-Handler pathway is the de novo biosynthesis route to NAD+, converting tryptophan or niacin into NAD+ through a sequence culminating in the ATP-dependent condensation of quinolinate with phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate. It provides the essential redox and signaling cofactor NAD+.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Preiss-Handler 途徑是到 NAD+ 的從頭生合成途徑，將色胺酸或菸鹼酸經由以喹啉酸與磷酸核糖焦磷酸之 ATP 依賴縮合告終的序列轉化為 NAD+。它提供必需的氧化還原與訊號輔因子 NAD+。

nodes.label: H1.2
nodes.description: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
nodes.description_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

nodes.label: MICU1
nodes.description: MICU1 gates mitochondrial Ca2+ entry and is essential for preventing pathological matrix Ca2+ overload that can trigger mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening and apoptosis. Loss of MICU1 causes uncontrolled Ca2+ uptake and mitochondrial swelling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MICU1 門控粒線體 Ca2+ 進入，對防止可能觸發粒線體通透性轉換孔道開啟與細胞凋亡的病理性基質 Ca2+ 超載至關重要。MICU1 喪失導致失控的 Ca2+ 攝取與粒線體腫脹。

nodes.label: IL-7
nodes.description: Interleukin 7 is a 25 kDa glycoprotein produced by stromal cells in the thymus and bone marrow that promotes both survival and differentiation of immature triple-negative and mature single-positive thymocytes. IL-7 binds the IL-7 receptor expressed on lymphoid precursors (CD3-CD4-CD8-), double-positive CD4+CD8+ thymocytes, and single-positive CD4 or CD8 T cells. Schluns et al. demonstrated that IL-7 administration to non-lymphopenic mice expands naive and memory peripheral CD4 and CD8 T cells, and treatment with IL-7 restores thymopoiesis in IL-7-deficient mice. Recombinant human IL-7 (CYT 99 007) showed low toxicity and dose-dependent expansion of naive and memory T cells in patients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 介白素 7 是 25 kDa 的醣蛋白，由胸腺與骨髓中的基質細胞產生，促進未成熟三陰性與成熟單陽性胸腺細胞的存活與分化。IL-7 結合表現於淋巴前驅細胞（CD3-CD4-CD8-）、雙陽性 CD4+CD8+ 胸腺細胞與單陽性 CD4 或 CD8 T 細胞上的 IL-7 受體。Schluns 等人證明，對非淋巴球減少小鼠施用 IL-7 可擴增周邊初始與記憶 CD4 及 CD8 T 細胞，且 IL-7 治療可恢復 IL-7 缺陷小鼠的胸腺生成。重組人類 IL-7（CYT 99 007）在患者中顯示低毒性及劑量依賴性的初始與記憶 T 細胞擴增。

nodes.label: Mucositis
nodes.description: At high or chronic doses Rapamycin and its rapalogs cause stomatitis and mucositis — ulceration of the oral and digestive tract mucosa; in off-label longevity surveys mouth ulcers were the only side effect significantly more common in rapamycin users, and were mild, reversible on discontinuation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在高劑量或長期使用下，Rapamycin 及其 rapalogs 會造成 stomatitis 與 Mucositis（口腔與消化道黏膜潰瘍）；在非標籤長壽調查中，口腔潰瘍是 rapamycin 使用者中唯一顯著較常見的副作用，且多為輕度、停藥後可逆。

nodes.label: S6K1
nodes.description: S6K1, itself activated by mTORC1, phosphorylates Ribosomal Protein S6 (rpS6) at multiple serine residues; because of this, phosphorylated S6 is widely used as the canonical surrogate readout of mTORC1 activity in resected tissues and preclinical models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S6K1（本身由 mTORC1 活化）在多個絲胺酸殘基上磷酸化 Ribosomal Protein S6（rpS6）；因此磷酸化 S6 被廣泛用作切檢組織與前臨床模型中 mTORC1 活性的標準替代性讀值。

nodes.label: Symjepi
nodes.description: Symjepi is a brand-name pre-filled syringe delivering a fixed dose of Epinephrine by manual, needle-based intramuscular injection into the anterolateral thigh. It is a compact, single-use alternative to the pen-style auto-injector and to the nasal spray, designed for emergency self-administration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Symjepi 是品牌名稱的預填充注射器，以手動針劑方式將固定劑量的 Epinephrine 肌肉注射到大腿前外側。它是筆式自動注射器與鼻用噴劑的精簡、單次使用替代方案，設計用於緊急自行給藥。

nodes.label: MID51
nodes.description: MID51 (MIEF1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondrial surface and participates in fission complex assembly, functioning both as a facilitator and a modulator of DRP1-mediated fission.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MID51（MIEF1）是粒線體外膜蛋白，會將 DRP1 招募到粒線體表面並參與分裂複合體的組裝，同時作為 DRP1 媒介分裂的促進者與調節者。

nodes.label: Sphingosine-1-phosphate
nodes.description: Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) is a phosphorylated derivative of sphingosine: sphingosine kinases add a phosphate to the amino alcohol backbone, converting Sphingosine into S1P. The note places Sphingosine as the immediate metabolic precursor of S1P, and S1P as the bioactive endpoint of the sphingosine arm of the ceramide/sphingosine/S1P rheostat.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) 是 sphingosine 的磷酸化衍生物：sphingosine kinase 將磷酸基加到該胺基醇骨架上，把 Sphingosine 轉換為 S1P。此筆記將 Sphingosine 列為 S1P 的直接代謝前驅物，而 S1P 則是 ceramide/sphingosine/S1P 恆定器中 sphingosine 支的生物活性終點。

nodes.label: Thyroid Hormones
nodes.description: Thyroid hormones — chiefly triiodothyronine (T3) and thyroxine (T4) — are the principal endocrine regulators of metabolic rate and modulate resting metabolic rate (RMR). Hypothyroid states lower RMR while hyperthyroid states raise it, and even within the euthyroid range thyroid hormone levels explain part of the inter-individual variance in RMR.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thyroid hormones（主要是 triiodothyronine（T3）與 thyroxine（T4））是代謝率的主要內分泌調節因子，並可調節 resting metabolic rate（RMR）。甲狀腺功能低下會降低 RMR，亢進則會提高 RMR；即使在甲狀腺功能正常範圍內，thyroid hormone 濃度也可解釋個體間 RMR 變異的一部分。

nodes.label: HGF
nodes.description: Upon muscle injury or exercise, satellite cells exit quiescence through a nitric oxide–HGF–c-Met signaling axis, then proliferate as myogenic precursor cells and differentiate into myoblasts that fuse to repair or form new myofibers, while a subset self-renews. HGF is thus the immediate trigger that couples an injury or exercise signal to the myogenic transcription factor cascade beginning with Pax7 and MyoD.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在肌肉受傷或運動後，satellite cell 經由 nitric oxide–HGF–c-Met 訊息軸退出靜止狀態，接著以肌肉前驅細胞形式增殖並分化為 myoblast，融合以修復或形成新的肌纖維，其中一部分則自我更新。因此 HGF 是將損傷或運動訊號與由 Pax7、MyoD 起始的肌肉轉錄因子級聯直接連結的觸發因子。

nodes.label: Folate
nodes.description: One-Carbon Metabolism requires Folate, whose reduced form tetrahydrofolate is the cofactor that carries single-carbon units (formyl, methenyl, methylene, methyl, formimino) between metabolites. Because folate deficiency truncates the pathway, the network is a direct interface between diet, nucleotide biosynthesis, epigenetic methylation and redox balance, and folate deficiency is linked to neural tube defects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 一碳代謝（One-Carbon Metabolism）需要 Folate（葉酸），其還原型四氫葉酸是攜帶單碳單位（甲醯、甲烯基、亞甲基、甲基、甲醯胺基）於代謝物之間轉移的輔因子。由於葉酸缺乏會使此途徑受阻，此代謝網是飲食、核苷酸生合成、表觀遺傳甲基化與氧化還原平衡之間的直接介面，而葉酸缺乏與神經管缺陷相關。

nodes.label: TGF-beta Signaling Pathway
nodes.description: TGFBR1 phosphorylates receptor-SMAD SMAD2 as the primary transducer. Body text confirms this canonical activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TGFBR1 磷酸化受體 SMAD SMAD2 作為主要傳導器。內文確認此典型活化。

nodes.label: LIPL-5
nodes.description: LIPL-5 is a C. elegans triglyceride lipase that is modestly (about 2-fold) upregulated after 6 hours of fasting in adult worms. Its transcription is repressed by MXL-3 in well-fed animals and induced by HLH-30 during fasting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LIPL-5 是 C. elegans 的三酸甘油酯脂肪酶，在成蟲禁食 6 小時後會中度（約 2 倍）上調。其轉錄在營養充足時受 MXL-3 抑制，並在禁食期間由 HLH-30 誘導。

nodes.label: 2-deoxy-D-glucose
nodes.description: 2-deoxy-D-glucose is phosphorylated by hexokinase to 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, which accumulates and competitively inhibits hexokinase and phosphoglucose isomerase, blocking the glycolytic flux. Its blockade of glycolysis produces a transient ATP drop that mimics caloric restriction and shifts cells toward mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 2-deoxy-D-glucose 經 hexokinase 磷酸化為 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate 後累積，並競爭性抑制 hexokinase 與 phosphoglucose isomerase，因而阻斷 glycolysis。其對 glycolysis 的阻斷造成暫時性 ATP 下降，模擬 Caloric Restriction，並使細胞轉向粒線體的 Oxidative Phosphorylation。

nodes.label: ARIH1
nodes.description: ARIH1 (Ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1, TRIAD1) is an E3 Ubiquitin ligase that promotes Mitophagy in cancer cells. As an E3 ligase it catalyses transfer of ubiquitin onto substrate proteins, marking them for recognition by autophagy receptors; this ubiquitin-dependent pathway enhances clearance of damaged mitochondria. By eliminating mitochondria that would otherwise trigger cell death, ARIH1 maintains normal mitochondrial quality control and shapes cellular responses to mitochondrial stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ARIH1（Ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1，TRIAD1）是促進癌細胞 Mitophagy 的 E3 Ubiquitin 連接酶。作為 E3 連接酶，它催化將 ubiquitin 轉移到受質蛋白上，標記其供自噬受體辨識；這條泛素依賴路徑增強了受損粒線體的清除。藉由清除原本會誘發細胞死亡的粒線體，ARIH1 維持正常的粒線體品質管制，並塑造細胞對粒線體壓力的反應。

nodes.label: LDHB
nodes.description: SIRT5 deacetylates LDHB at specific lysine residues, hyperactivating the enzyme beyond normal physiological levels. LDHB is among SIRT5's reported substrates whose succinylation state influences activity, consistent with SIRT5 also acting as a lysine desuccinylase and demalonylase.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT5 會在特定離胺酸上對 LDHB 去乙醯化，使該酵素活性超出正常生理水準。LDHB 是 SIRT5 已報導受質之一，其琥珀醯化狀態會影響活性，這與 SIRT5 同時具離胺酸去琥珀醯化酶與去丙二醯化酶活性的情形一致。

nodes.label: Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
nodes.description: VEGF is targeted by Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Tyrosine-kinase inhibitors block receptor or cytoplasmic kinases and include the anti-VEGF and anti-EGFR agents used in solid tumors. The directionality runs from Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors toward VEGF, so Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: VEGF 的目標是 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。酪胺酸激酶抑制劑阻斷受體或細胞質激酶，包括用於實體腫瘤的抗-和抗-藥物。方向性從 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 向 VEGF，因此 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

nodes.label: Ligand-conjugated Nanoparticles
nodes.description: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles are nanoparticle cores decorated with ligands that bind specific cell-surface markers, concentrating the particle and its payload at the desired site while sparing non-target tissue. Applied to senescence, this ligand-receptor interaction directs senolytics or senomorphics selectively to senescent cells, potentially improving their therapeutic index over untargeted formulations.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles 是以可結合特定細胞表面標記的配體修飾的奈米顆粒核心，能將顆粒與其負載物集中於目標部位，同時減少非標靶組織的暴露。應用於衰老領域時，這種配體—受體作用可將 senolytics 或 senomorphics 選擇性導向 senescent cells，相較未標靶配方有潛力提升治療指數。

nodes.label: ERMIT
nodes.description: Mitochondria retained in enucleated erythrocytes would generate damaging reactive oxygen species in the circulation, so their developmental elimination by ERMIT protects red cells from oxidative injury. Defective ERMIT instead causes incomplete mitochondrial retention and premature hemolysis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 若去核紅血球中殘留粒線體，便會在循環中產生具損傷性的活性氧物種；因此 ERMIT 的發育性清除可保護紅血球免受氧化傷害。ERMIT 缺失則會造成粒線體殘留與過早溶血。

nodes.label: CB-839
nodes.description: CB-839 (telaglenastat) selectively inhibits glutaminase GLS1, blocking the conversion of glutamine to glutamate and cutting off the anaplerotic glutamine flux into the TCA cycle. As monotherapy it shows limited efficacy in unselected triple-negative breast cancer; but in MYC-high tumors — which rewire the TCA cycle to glutamine-derived carbon — CB-839 combined with Complex I inhibitors (mubritinib, metformin) collapses both anaplerosis and NAD+ regeneration, creating a synthetic-lethal vulnerability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CB-839（telaglenastat）選擇性抑制麩胺酸酶 GLS1，阻斷麩胺醯胺轉換為麩胺酸，並切斷進入 TCA 循環的回補性麩胺醯胺通量。作為單一藥物，其在未經選擇的三陰性乳腺癌中療效有限；但在 MYC-high 腫瘤——其 TCA 循環已重接為麩胺醯胺碳源——CB-839 與 Complex I 抑制劑（mubritinib、metformin）併用會同時瓦解回補作用與 NAD+ 再生，形成合成致死的脆弱性。

nodes.label: APC
nodes.description: APC (adenomatous polyposis coli) scaffolds the Axin/GSK3β destruction complex that phosphorylates β-Catenin for degradation, thereby restraining Wnt signaling. As a gatekeeper tumor suppressor, truncating APC mutations lift this brake and initiate most colorectal cancers through constitutive β-catenin activity, while germline APC mutation causes familial adenomatous polyposis. FRAT2 antagonizes the destruction complex to amplify Wnt signaling upstream of APC.
nodes.description_zh_TW: APC（adenomatous polyposis coli）作為支架蛋白組織 Axin/GSK3β 降解複合體，使 β-Catenin 被磷酸化後降解，因而抑制 Wnt signaling。APC 是守門員式的腫瘤抑制基因，其截斷型突變解除此煞車，透過組成性 β-catenin 活性引發多數大腸直腸癌；生殖系 APC 突變則導致家族性腺瘤性息肉症。FRAT2 會拮抗降解複合體，在 APC 上游放大 Wnt signaling。

nodes.label: Bardoxolone methyl
nodes.description: Bardoxolone methyl (CDDO-Me, RTA 402) is a synthetic triterpenoid and an NRF2 activator: it drives expression of antioxidant genes through the Antioxidant Response Element (ARE), which is why it is being developed against chronic kidney disease and other oxidative/inflammatory indications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bardoxolone methyl（CDDO-Me、RTA 402）是一種合成三萜類化合物，也是 NRF2 活化劑：它透過抗氧化反應元件（ARE）促進抗氧化基因表現，因此被用於慢性腎臟疾病等氧化與發炎相關疾病的開發。

nodes.label: CD73
nodes.description: CD73 (ecto-5'-nucleotidase, NT5E) is a cell-surface ectoenzyme with two relevant activities: it can degrade NMN into Nicotinamide Riboside, thereby sustaining NAD+ synthesis, and it converts extracellular AMP to adenosine, regulating purinergic signaling and immunometabolism. The first role makes CD73 relevant to NAD+ precursor availability.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD73（ecto-5'-nucleotidase，NT5E）是細胞表面的胞外酵素，具有兩項相關活性：它可將 NMN 降解為 Nicotinamide Riboside，藉此維持 NAD+ 合成；並將細胞外 AMP 轉換為 adenosine，調節嘌呤能訊號與 Immunometabolism。前者使 CD73 與 NAD+ 前驅物的可利用性相關。

nodes.label: Proanthocyanidins
nodes.description: Beyond SIRT1 and NRF2 engagement, Proanthocyanidins also activate AMPK, inhibit NF-κB inflammatory signaling, and modulate glycation and advanced glycation end-product formation — a multi-target profile underpinning their vascular, metabolic and neuroprotective signatures.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了作用於 SIRT1 與 NRF2 之外，Proanthocyanidins 也會活化 AMPK、抑制 NF-κB 發炎訊號，並調節 glycation 與晚期糖基化終產物的形成——這種多標的特徵構成其血管、代謝與神經保護效應的基礎。

nodes.label: SIRT1 and SIRT2
nodes.description: GW5074, an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor, was tested with other kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 because sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. It showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, placing it alongside the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 as a kinase-scaffold sirtuin inhibitor. Directionally, GW5074's scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, underscoring the value of structure-based follow-up for selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GW5074 最初是作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物，與其他激酶抑制劑一起被測試對 SIRT2 的活性，因為 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。它在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 一起被歸類為激酶骨架 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 GW5074 的骨架結構使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了針對選擇性進行結構導向後續研究的價值。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

nodes.label: Geraldol
nodes.description: COMT generates geraldol (3'-O-methylfisetin) by O-methylating fisetin at its 3'-hydroxyl position, as demonstrated directly by Poor et al. (2016, Biomed Pharmacother 83:998-1005). The process is concentration-dependent: at low fisetin concentrations COMT acts on the substrate and methylates it, whereas at higher concentrations fisetin occupies the COMT active site without being efficiently methylated, showing inhibitor-like behavior.
nodes.description_zh_TW: COMT 藉由在 fisetin 的 3'-羥基位置進行 O-甲基化而生成 geraldol（3'-O-甲基非瑟酮），此點由 Poor et al.（2016, Biomed Pharmacother 83:998–1005）直接證實。此過程具濃度依賴性：在 fisetin 濃度低時，COMT 以受質方式作用並將其甲基化；而濃度較高時，fisetin 占據 COMT 活性位卻未被有效甲基化，呈現類似抑制劑的行為。

nodes.label: Toluidine Blue O
nodes.description: Toluidine blue O (TB), the 3,7-dimethyl analog of methylene blue, is the most potent of the tested phenothiazine derivatives, with EC50s of 1.75 nM for viability, 0.11 nM for ROS reduction, and 1.54 nM for preserving mitochondrial membrane potential in the HT-22 glutamate assay. Like MB, TB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction in the complex I-III assay with NADH as electron donor, enhanced cellular oxygen consumption, and decreased lactate production, sharing MB's alternative electron-transfer-carrier function but with greater potency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 甲苯胺藍 O（TB）是甲烯藍的 3,7-二甲基類似物，是已測試的吩噻嗪衍生物中最有效的，在 HT-22 谷氨酸測定中，其 EC50 分別為 viability 1.75 nM、ROS 減少 0.11 nM、保護線粒體膜電位 1.54 nM。與 MB 一樣，TB 在以 NADH 為電子供體的 complex I-III 測定中顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，增強了細胞氧消耗，降低了乳酸產生，共享 MB 的替代電子轉載體功能但效力更強。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: Vasodilation
nodes.description: Under normal conditions nitric oxide is a crucial signaling molecule that relaxes vascular smooth muscle via activation of soluble guanylyl cyclase and cGMP production. However, during severe inflammation, injury, or shock, overproduction of NO - primarily by inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) - leads to excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage. This is the pathway targeted by both aminoguanidine, which blocks NO synthesis at iNOS (upstream), and methylene blue, which blocks NO action at sGC (downstream).
nodes.description_zh_TW: 正常情況下，一氧化氮是通過激活可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶和cGMP產生來放鬆血管平滑肌的關鍵信號分子。然而，在嚴重炎症、損傷或休克期間，NO的過度產生（主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）產生）導致過度血管舒張、血管滲漏和組織損傷。這正是氨基胍（在iNOS水平阻斷NO合成，上游）和亞甲藍（在sGC水平阻斷NO作用，下游）共同靶向的通路。

nodes.label: Caspase-4
nodes.description: Caspase-4 is a human inflammatory (non-canonical) caspase that senses cytosolic Gram-negative bacterial LPS through its CARD, inducing oligomerization and auto-cleavage. Once active it cleaves Gasdermin D at the linker, freeing the N-terminal pore-forming domain that oligomerizes in the plasma membrane to form pyroptotic pores.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-4 是人類發炎性（非典型）caspase，透過其 CARD 感測細胞質中的革蘭氏陰性菌 LPS，誘發寡聚化與自我切割。一旦活化即在連接區切割 Gasdermin D，釋出 N 端成孔區，該區在細胞膜上寡聚形成 pyroptosis 孔洞。

nodes.label: Cyclin
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinases require cyclin regulatory subunits for activity; monomeric CDKs are inactive. Cyclin binding provides the obligatory activation step.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 週期蛋白依賴激酶需要 cyclin 調節次單元才有活性；單體 CDK 無活性。Cyclin 結合提供必要的活化步驟。

nodes.label: Blastocyst
nodes.description: Embryonic stem cells derive from the blastocyst inner cell mass. Product relation roots ESCs in preimplantation development.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 胚胎幹細胞源自囊胚內細胞團。產物關係將 ESC 根植於著床前發育。

nodes.label: Chemotherapy Resistance
nodes.description: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: Securin
nodes.description: At anaphase onset the anaphase promoting complex-cyclosome, activated by CDC20, ubiquitinates securin and targets it for proteasomal destruction. Degrading securin frees the protease separase, which then cleaves cohesin to allow sister chromatid separation; a non-degradable securin mutant blocks anaphase entirely, showing that securin turnover is the licensing step for chromosome segregation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在後期起始時，由 CDC20 活化的後期促進複合體會將 securin 泛素化並標記其進行蛋白酶體降解。Securin 被降解後釋出蛋白酶 separase，後者再切割 cohesin，使姐妹染色分體得以分離；不可降解的 securin 突變會完全阻斷後期，顯示 securin 的周轉是染色體分離的許可步驟。

nodes.label: Coronary artery constriction
nodes.description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, and one of its documented cardiovascular effects is constriction of the coronary arteries. Along with cell necrosis and arrhythmias, coronary artery constriction links adrenochrome to impaired blood supply to the heart muscle and thereby to the pathology of stress-induced heart disease. The vasoconstrictive action of this adrenaline oxidation product is consistent with the broader biology of catecholamine oxidation, where reactive quinone species exert direct effects on vascular smooth muscle. These findings are significant in the context of the adrenochrome pathway because oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome, potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 已知 Adrenochrome 具有心臟毒性，其已記錄的心血管作用之一是冠狀動脈收縮。除了細胞壞死和心律不整外，冠狀動脈收縮將 Adrenochrome 與心肌血液供應受損連結起來，進而與壓力性心臟疾病的病理相關。這種 adrenaline 氧化產物的血管收縮作用與 catecholamine 氧化的更廣泛生物學一致，其中活性醌類物種對血管平滑肌產生直接作用。這些發現在 Adrenochrome 途徑的背景下具有重要意義，因為浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性白血球產生的氧自由基可驅動 adrenaline 氧化為 Adrenochrome， potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.

nodes.label: PTPN2
nodes.description: PTPN2 (TC-PTP) is a ubiquitously expressed non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase belonging to the PTPN family, distinguished by an N-terminal catalytic domain with the conserved HCxxR motif and a C-terminal tail that directs nuclear/cytoplasmic localization and substrate engagement.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PTPN2（TC-PTP）是廣泛表現的非受體型蛋白酪胺酸磷酸酶，屬於 PTPN family，其特徵為帶有保守 HCxxR 基序的 N 端催化區，以及負責核質定位與受質招募的 C 端尾部。

nodes.label: TLR2/6
nodes.description: CD36 receptor acts as a co-receptor for TLR2/6, enabling recognition of oxidized LDL, amyloid-beta, and microbial products to trigger sterile and innate inflammatory signaling. This bridges lipid sensing to innate immunity. The directionality is co-receptor to inflammasome and NF-kappaB activation. A caveat is that CD36 is not the sole TLR2/6 partner, and its contribution varies by ligand and cell type. This cooperation allows CD36 to bridge lipid sensing and innate immunity, promoting inflammatory responses to oxidized self-ligands.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 作為 TLR2/6 的共同受體，能夠辨識 oxidized LDL、β 澱粉樣蛋白和微生物產物，從而觸發無菌和先天發炎訊號傳導。這將脂質感測與先天免疫聯繫起來。方向性是發炎小體和 NF-κB 活化的共同受體。需要注意的是，CD36 並不是唯一的 TLR2/6 夥伴，其貢獻因配體和細胞類型而異。這種合作使得 CD36 能夠橋接脂質感應和先天免疫，促進對氧化自身配體的發炎反應。

nodes.label: B Cell
nodes.description: IgE is the antibody isotype that B Cell produce after IL-4/IL-13-driven class switching; this irreversible switch commits the B cell line to allergy-mediating antibody output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IgE 是 B Cell（B 細胞）在 IL-4/IL-13 驅動類別轉換後所產生的抗體同型；這個不可逆的轉換使該 B 細胞系專職製造媒介過敏的抗體。

nodes.label: UCHL1
nodes.description: UCHL1 (also known as PGP9.5) is highly enriched in neurons and is encoded by the PARK5 gene; PARK5 mutations have been linked to Parkinson's Disease, placing it in the same PD gene-product convergence on ubiquitin-dependent quality control as PINK1 and Parkin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: UCHL1（又稱 PGP9.5）在神經元中高度富集，由 PARK5 基因編碼；PARK5 突變已被連結到 Parkinson's Disease，使其與 PINK1、Parkin 一同落在以泛素依賴性蛋白質品質管制為核心的 PD 基因產物匯聚軸上。

nodes.label: STING Inhibitors
nodes.description: STING inhibitors (H151, SN-011, amlexanox, c-176) are experimental small molecules that block signaling downstream of the cGAS-STING pathway by interfering with STING activation, trafficking, or downstream kinase recruitment. Targeting STING itself interrupts both canonical cGAS-dependent and noncanonical, cGAS-independent activation such as that triggered by NPC1 deficiency or C9orf72 loss.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STING inhibitors（H151、SN-011、amlexanox、c-176）是實驗性小分子，透過干擾 STING 的活化、運輸或下游激酶招募，阻斷 cGAS-STING Pathway 下游的訊息傳遞。由於直接針對 STING，因此可同時阻斷典型的 cGAS 依賴性與非典型 cGAS 非依賴性活化，例如由 NPC1 缺乏或 C9orf72 喪失所觸發者。

nodes.label: Fibromyalgia
nodes.description: Fibromyalgia is a chronic disorder of unknown etiology characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, non-restorative sleep and cognitive dysfunction. It is frequently comorbid with chronic fatigue syndrome, irritable bowel syndrome, migraine, temporomandibular joint disorder and mood disorders, and both fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue syndrome are thought to involve impaired energy metabolism, supporting a shared bioenergetic mechanism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fibromyalgia 是一種病因未明的慢性疾病，特徵為廣泛性肌肉骨骼疼痛、疲勞、非恢復性睡眠與認知功能障礙。它常與 chronic fatigue syndrome、irritable bowel syndrome、migraine、顳顎關節障礙及情緒障礙共病，而 fibromyalgia 與 chronic fatigue syndrome 皆被認為涉及能量代謝受損，支持兩者共有的生物能量學機制。

nodes.label: Positron Emission Tomography
nodes.description: Neuromelanin and Positron Emission Tomography are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Positron Emission Tomography may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Positron Emission Tomography 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Positron Emission Tomography 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: HDAC1
nodes.description: HDAC1 is one of the chromatin modifiers, alongside SIRT1, SIRT6, and PARP1, that relocalize to DNA damage sites during repair. Within the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis, repeated recruitment away from native loci with imperfect return is proposed to erode the epigenetic landscape and de-repress retrotransposons.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HDAC1 是與 SIRT1、SIRT6、PARP1 並列、在修復過程中會重新定位至 DNA 損傷位點的染色質修飾因子之一。在「Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis」中，反覆被招募離開原生位點卻未能完全回歸，被認為會侵蝕表觀遺傳 Landscape 並解除對 retrotransposon 的抑制。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

nodes.label: Serine
nodes.description: Serine donates its carbon skeleton to Cysteine biosynthesis, and serine-derived cysteine is the rate-limiting precursor for Glutathione synthesis, linking one-carbon metabolism to antioxidant defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Serine 提供其碳骨架用於 Cysteine 的生合成，而源自 serine 的 cysteine 是 Glutathione 合成的速率限制前驅物，將一碳代謝與抗氧化防禦連結起來。

nodes.label: Oblimersen sodium
nodes.description: The antisense Oblimersen lowers Bcl-2 protein via RNase-H mRNA cleavage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 反義 Oblimersen 經 RNase-H mRNA 切割降低 Bcl-2 蛋白。

nodes.label: Everolimus
nodes.description: Two randomized placebo-controlled clinical trials tested rapalogs among the elderly for immunomodulation. Treatment with everolimus monotherapy or everolimus in combination with RTB101 for six weeks resulted in a better response to influenza vaccine and fewer infections over the next year compared to placebo. The proposed mechanism is an increase in autophagy through inhibition of mTOR along with increased expression of antiviral proteins. The observation that immune function improves after a single six-week period of mTORC1 inhibition has important clinical implications, since elderly patients are particularly at risk of dying from influenza.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 兩項隨機、安慰劑對照的臨床試驗在老年族群中測試了rapalog的免疫調節作用。與安慰劑相比，單用everolimus或以everolimus合併RTB101治療六週，可獲得較佳的流感疫苗反應，並在接下來一年內減少感染次數。其提出的機制是透過抑制mTOR來增加自噬（autophagy），同時增加抗病毒蛋白的表現。僅單次六週的mTORC1抑制即可改善免疫功能，此觀察具有重要的臨床意義，因為老年患者特別容易因流感而死亡。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

nodes.label: Mitochondria-Associated Membranes
nodes.description: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) act as regulatory hubs for calcium signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis can produce either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+ (blunting ATP production) or pathological Ca2+ overload (sensitizing to permeability transition), both amplifying ROS and destabilizing membrane integrity. MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic and redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay, promoting chronic UPRER activation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) 作為 calcium signaling、lipid exchange、mitochondrial dynamics 和 stress adaptation 的 regulatory hubs。Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis 可導致 either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+（blunting ATP production）或 pathological Ca2+ overload（sensitizing to permeability transition），兩者都 amplifying ROS 和 destabilizing membrane integrity。MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic 和 redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay，promoting chronic UPRER activation。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

nodes.label: KIF5B
nodes.description: KIF5B motors extend reformation tubules during ALR. Regulation is the motility input.
nodes.description_zh_TW: KIF5B 馬達在 ALR 延伸重組小管。調節是運動輸入。

nodes.label: Thrombospondin-1
nodes.description: Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1, THBS1) is a large matricellular glycoprotein secreted by platelets, endothelial cells and Macrophages that binds CD36. Binding of this ligand to the receptor is what initiates TSP-1 signalling, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake to adhesion, survival and inflammation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thrombospondin-1（TSP-1、THBS1）是由血小板、內皮細胞與 Macrophages 分泌的大型基質細胞糖蛋白，可與 CD36 結合。正是這種配體與受體的結合啟動了 TSP-1 訊號，將 CD36 的角色從脂質攝取擴展到黏附、存活與發炎。

nodes.label: Centromere
nodes.description: Centromeres are epigenetically specified by CENP-A chromatin rather than by DNA sequence in most eukaryotes. The centromere is the specialized chromosome region where the kinetochore assembles and spindle microtubules attach during mitosis and meiosis, flanked by pericentric heterochromatin enriched in H3K9me3; its dysfunction causes aneuploidy and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在多數真核生物中，centromere 是由 CENP-A 染色質而非 DNA 序列表觀指定的。它是染色體上 kinetochore 組裝且紡錘絲微管在有絲分裂與減數分裂時附著的特化區域，兩側為富含 H3K9me3 的著絲粒周邊異染色質；其功能障礙會導致 aneuploidy 與 cancer。

nodes.label: Growth Factor
nodes.description: FGF is one of the major growth factor families (with EGF, PDGF, VEGF, IGF, HGF, TGFβ). Its 22 members signal through FGFR tyrosine kinases to activate RAS/MAPK cascades driving proliferation, Cell Migration, and tissue repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FGF（纖維母細胞生長因子）是主要生長因子家族之一（與 EGF、PDGF、VEGF、IGF、HGF、TGFβ 並列）。其 22 個成員透過 FGFR 酪胺酸激酶傳遞訊號，啟動 RAS/MAPK 級聯以驅動增殖、Cell Migration（細胞遷移）與組織修復。

nodes.label: mitoRQC
nodes.description: By eliminating faulty nascent chains, mitoRQC protects mitochondrial proteostasis alongside UPRmt, mitophagy and import-surveillance pathways (mitoCPR, mitoTAD). Failure of this network underlies adaptive mitohormesis, and its breakdown contributes to mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress and age-related decline.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 藉由清除 有缺陷的新生鏈，mitoRQC 與 UPRmt、mitophagy 及輸入監控路徑（mitoCPR、mitoTAD）共同保護粒線體蛋白恆定。此網絡構成適應性 mitohormesis 的基礎，而其失效會促成 mitochondrial dysfunction、oxidative stress 與年齡相關衰退。

nodes.label: BCR-ABL
nodes.description: BCR-ABL is the constitutively active tyrosine kinase produced by the t(9;22) Philadelphia translocation, which fuses BCR to the c-ABL kinase moiety; this fusion deregulates c-ABL and drives leukemia via RAS/MAPK, PI3K/AKT and STAT5 survival signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BCR-ABL 是由 t(9;22) 費城染色體轉位所產生的持續活化酪胺酸激酶，該轉位將 BCR 與 c-ABL 激酶片段融合；此融合使 c-ABL 去調控，並透過 RAS/MAPK、PI3K/AKT 與 STAT5 存活訊號驅動白血病。

nodes.label: Nociceptor
nodes.description: The Dorsal Root Ganglion (DRG) is a collection of sensory neuron cell bodies along the spinal dorsal roots. Its neurons, including Nociceptors, transmit somatosensory and pain information from the periphery to the central nervous system and are a primary site of pathological change in peripheral neuropathies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Dorsal Root Ganglion（DRG）是沿脊神經背根排列的感覺神經元細胞體集合體。其神經元（包含 Nociceptor）將體感與痛覺資訊由周邊傳至中樞神經系統，也是周邊神經病變中主要的病理變化部位。

nodes.label: Gout
nodes.description: Gout is an inflammatory arthritis driven by persistent hyperuricemia, which supersaturates urate and promotes crystallization of monosodium urate in joints, cartilage, and soft tissue. Hyperuricemia arises from increased purine turnover, overproduction via Xanthine Oxidase, or reduced renal excretion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gout 是由持續性高尿酸血症驅動的發炎性關節炎，尿酸過飽和促使 monosodium urate 在關節、軟骨與軟組織結晶。高尿酸血症來自 purine turnover 增加、經 Xanthine Oxidase 的生成過多，或腎臟排泄減少。

nodes.label: Telomerase
nodes.description: SIRT6 overexpression increases the survival of transverse aortic constriction-induced heart failure mice, which might be associated with upregulation of Telomerase reverse transcriptase and telomere repeat binding factor 1/2. Telomerase activity is therefore linked to telomere maintenance and the cytoprotective transcriptional response to moderate SIRT1/SIRT6 elevation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 的過度表現可提高橫向主動脈縮窄所誘發心衰竭小鼠的存活率，這可能與端粒反轉錄酶以及端粒重複結合因子 1/2 的上调有關。因此 Telomerase 活性與端粒維持，以及對中度 SIRT1/SIRT6 上升的細胞保護性轉錄反應相互連結。

nodes.label: Cross-linking
nodes.description: Aminoguanidine prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins by trapping reactive carbonyl species and by binding to sugars, thus preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins. Glucose can react with protein amino groups in a process called glycation to form glucose/protein combinations that eventually cause active cross-links, and this continuous cross-linking may be prevented by glycation inhibitors whose primary use is to stabilize glucose metabolism. Aminoguanidine joins up with substances that cause links and stops cross-links from developing, protecting the proteins that make up the body from aging damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 氨基胍可以通過捕獲反應性羰基物種並與糖結合來防止組織蛋白之間的交叉連接，從而阻止它們與蛋白的精氨酸基團結合。葡萄糖可以通過稱為糖化反應的過程與蛋白氨基反應，形成葡萄糖/蛋白組合，最終導致活躍的交叉連接，而這種持續的交叉連接可能被糖化抑制劑所阻止，其主要用途是穩定葡萄糖代謝。氨基胍與引起鏈接的物質結合，阻止交叉連接的發展，從而保護身體組成的蛋白免受衰老損傷。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

nodes.label: Neural Stem Cell
nodes.description: Sox2 maintains neural stem cells by preserving their self-renewal and multipotency, the ability to generate neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. Sox2 is expressed in neural stem cells of the developing and adult brain, where it is a central determinant of neural identity and is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for direct neural conversion. In reprogramming to induced neural stem cells, forced expression of Sox2 remodels the somatic epigenome toward a neural fate. Sox2 is thus a linchpin connecting pluripotency regulation to neurogenesis and neural repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sox2 透過保留神經幹細胞的自我更新和多能性、生成神經元、星狀膠質細胞和少突膠質細胞的能力來維持神經幹細胞。 Sox2 在發育中和成年 brain 的神經幹細胞中表達，它是神經身份的核心決定因素，對於直接神經轉換通常是必要的，有時是充分的。在對誘導神經幹細胞進行重編程時，Sox2 的強製表達將體細胞表觀基因組重塑為神經命運。因此，Sox2 是將多能性調節與神經生成和神經修復聯繫起來的關鍵。

nodes.label: Mesenchymal-to-Epithelial Transition
