nodes.label: PIDD
nodes.description: PIDD activates Caspase-2. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

nodes.label: UV Light
nodes.description: Ultraviolet light generates reactive oxygen species (ROS) that drive the oxidation of catecholamines such as epinephrine. Because ROS can steal electrons from the catechol hydroxyls, producing the o-quinone intermediate, light exposure accelerates the pathway that converts adrenaline into adrenochrome. This photochemical sensitivity is why pharmaceutical epinephrine is stored in amber vials away from light: preventing light-induced ROS formation slows the oxidation and cyclization reactions that degrade the drug. The same principle applies more broadly to catecholamine biochemistry, where photo-oxidation can convert adrenaline solutions pink. Temperature and light, as factors governing kinetic energy and radical generation, are therefore environmental controls that determine whether epinephrine remains stable or proceeds toward adrenochrome and its toxic downstream chemistry.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 紫外線產生活性氧（ROS），驅動兒茶酚胺如腎上腺素的氧化。因為ROS可以從兒茶酚羥基中夺取電子，產生鄰醌中間體，光照暴露加速了將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺素紅的途徑。這種光化學敏感性是為什麼藥用腎上腺素儲存在避光的琥珀色玻璃瓶中：防止光照誘導的ROS形成可以減緩降解藥物的氧化和環化反應。相同原理更廣泛地應用於兒茶酚胺生物化學，其中光氧化可以使腎上腺素溶液變粉紅。溫度和光照作為控制動能和自由基生成的因素，因此是決定腎上腺素是保持穩定還是走向腎上腺素紅及其有毒下游化學的環境控制。

nodes.label: Telomere Attrition
nodes.description: Progressive telomere shortening with each cell division eventually exposes chromosome ends that are recognized as DNA double-strand breaks, triggering replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. Critically short or dysfunctional telomeres activate the ATM/p53 and ATR/p21 DDR cascades, halting proliferation to prevent chromosomal instability. This mechanism is the canonical explanation for the finite replicative capacity of primary human cells in culture. The directionality is one-way in normal cells, though telomerase reactivation can bypass the arrest -- a hallmark of cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 每一次細胞分裂伴隨的漸進性端粒縮短，最終會暴露出被辨識為 DNA 雙股斷裂的染色體端點，在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。過短或功能異常的端粒會活化 ATM/p53 與 ATR/p21 的 DDR 級聯，停止增殖以預防染色體不穩定。此機制是原代人類細胞在培養中有限複製能力的標準解釋。在正常細胞中此方向是單向的，但端粒酶再活化可繞過停滯——這是癌症的特徵。

nodes.label: Stomatitis
nodes.description: Stomatitis is a characteristic, often dose-limiting adverse event of mTOR inhibitor therapy, and therefore an mTORC1-dependent class effect shared by Rapamycin and rapalogs alike. This makes oral and gastrointestinal mucosal ulceration one of the main practical brakes on escalating mTOR inhibition for anti-aging purposes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Stomatitis 是 mTOR 抑制劑療法具代表性且常為劑量限制性的不良事件，因此屬於 Rapamycin 與 rapalogs 共同具備的 mTORC1 相關類效應。這使口腔與胃腸道黏膜潰瘍成為提升 mTOR 抑制強度以用於抗老化時，主要的實務限制。

nodes.label: Deoxycholic Acid
nodes.description: Deoxycholic acid induces senescence in hepatic stellate cells by causing DNA damage through reactive oxygen species generation, direct genotoxic effects on nuclear DNA and activation of the DNA damage response. The resulting persistent damage signalling produces p16 and p21 upregulation, SA-beta-gal activity and SASP secretion, the hallmark features of senescence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Deoxycholic acid 藉由產生 reactive oxygen species、對核 DNA 施加直接基因毒性作用並活化 DNA damage response 而在 hepatic stellate cell 中誘發 senescence。隨後持續的損傷訊號造成 p16 與 p21 上調、SA-β-gal 活性及 SASP 分泌，即 senescent 的典型特徵。

nodes.label: Gram-Negative Bacteria
nodes.description: Bacteroidetes is a major phylum of Gram-Negative Bacteria — typically non-spore-forming rods that are obligate or facultative anaerobes — distinguished from Firmicutes by cell-wall architecture and a lipopolysaccharide-rich outer membrane; Bacteroides and Prevotella dominate the human Gut Microbiome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bacteroidetes 是 Gram-Negative Bacteria 的一個主要門類——典型為不形成芽孢的桿菌，專性或兼性厭氧——並在細胞壁架構與富含脂多醣的外膜上與 Firmicutes 區隔；Bacteroides 與 Prevotella 在人類 Gut Microbiome 中佔優勢。

nodes.label: Cell Adhesion
nodes.description: Laminin mediates cell adhesion as a stated adhesive process. Promotion is the adhesive output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Laminin 介導細胞黏附作為既定的黏附過程。促進是黏附輸出。

nodes.label: eIF2α
nodes.description: eIF2α is a key regulatory hub of the integrated stress response, phosphorylated at Ser51 by four stress-activated kinases. HRI (EIF2AK1) is the mitochondrial stress-responsive kinase, activated by DELE1 and heme deficiency, alongside PERK (ER stress), GCN2 (amino acid starvation), and PKR (double-stranded RNA).
nodes.description_zh_TW: eIF2α 是整合性壓力反應的關鍵調節樞紐，在 Ser51 上被四種壓力活化激酶磷酸化。HRI（EIF2AK1）是粒線體壓力反應的激酶，由 DELE1 與血基質缺乏活化，其他三者分別為 PERK（ER 壓力）、GCN2（胺基酸缺乏）與 PKR（雙股 RNA）。

nodes.label: Neurofibrillary tangles
nodes.description: Neurofibrillary tangles are intraneuronal paired helical filament aggregates of hyperphosphorylated Tau protein, a defining pathological feature of Alzheimer's Disease and other tauopathies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neurofibrillary tangles 是過度磷酸化 Tau 蛋白在神經細胞內形成的配對螺旋纖維聚集體，為 Alzheimer's Disease 與其他 tauopathy 的定義性病理特徵。

nodes.label: Zinc Finger
nodes.description: A zinc finger is a conserved structural motif in which zinc ions are coordinated by cysteine and histidine residues, folding the polypeptide into a compact domain that binds DNA, RNA, or protein. The canonical Cys2-His2 (C2H2) finger comprises about 30 amino acids folded into a beta-hairpin and an alpha-helix; the alpha-helix inserts into the DNA major groove, with residues at positions -1, 2, 3, and 6 making base-specific contacts. Because individual fingers recognize roughly 3 bp, tandem arrays of 3-6 fingers extend specificity to about 9-18 bp.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 鋅指是一種保守的結構模體，由鋅離子與半胱胺酸及組胺酸殘基配位，使多肽鏈摺疊成能結合 DNA、RNA 或蛋白質的緊密結構域。典型的 Cys2-His2（C2H2）鋅指約含 30 個胺基酸，摺疊成 β-髮夾與 α 螺旋；α 螺旋插入 DNA 大溝，位於 −1、2、3 與 6 位置的殘基與鹼基做專一性接觸。由於單一鋅指約辨識 3 bp，3–6 個鋅指的串聯陣列可將專一性延伸至約 9–18 bp。

nodes.label: Propidium Iodide
nodes.description: Propidium Iodide is paired with Annexin V in the standard viability panel: PI is a membrane-impermeant intercalating dye excluded by intact membranes, so Annexin V+/PI− defines early apoptosis while Annexin V+/PI+ marks lytic programs (parthanatos, necrosis, necroptosis, pyroptosis) and late secondary necrosis of uncleared apoptotic bodies.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Propidium Iodide 在標準細胞存活面板中與 Annexin V 搭配使用：PI 為膜不通透的嵌入型染劑，完整細胞膜會將其排除，因此 Annexin V+/PI− 定義早期 apoptosis，而 Annexin V+/PI+ 則標記裂解型程序（parthanatos、necrosis、necroptosis、pyroptosis）以及未被清除凋亡小體的晚期次級壞死。

nodes.label: Vasopressors
nodes.description: In Vasoplegic Shock, standard vasopressors may fail because low systemic vascular resistance plus nitric-oxide–mediated vascular hyporesponsivity leaves vessels unresponsive even to high-dose catecholamines. Rescue strategies target the NO axis instead, e.g. methylene blue inhibiting soluble guanylyl cyclase to restore vascular tone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 Vasoplegic Shock 中，標準 Vasopressors 可能失效，因為全身血管阻力偏低加上 nitric-oxide 介導的血管低反應性，使血管即使面對高劑量 catecholamines 也無反應。救援策略因此轉向 NO 軸，例如 methylene blue 抑制 soluble guanylyl cyclase 以恢復血管張力。

nodes.label: cco-1
nodes.description: cco-1 encodes the Caenorhabditis elegans ortholog of cytochrome c oxidase subunit V (COX5, complex IV), a structural and regulatory subunit of the mitochondrial electron transport chain. Because complex IV sits at the terminal step of the redox chain, cco-1 is required for the final reduction of oxygen to water and for efficient mitochondrial respiration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: cco-1 編碼 Caenorhabditis elegans 的細胞色素 c 氧化酶次單元 V（COX5，複合體 IV）直系同源物，該次單元是粒線體電子傳遞鏈的結構與調節組成。由於複合體 IV 位於氧化還原鏈的末端步驟，cco-1 對氧最終還原成水與有效粒線體呼吸作用不可或缺。

nodes.label: Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis
nodes.description: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) spans a spectrum from simple hepatic steatosis to Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH), fibrosis, and cirrhosis in the absence of significant alcohol consumption, driven by de novo lipogenesis, insulin resistance, and mitochondrial dysfunction.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) 在無顯著酒精攝取的情況下，從單純肝臟脂肪變性進展為 Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH)、纖維化與肝硬化，驅動因子包括新生脂肪合成、胰島素阻抗與粒線體功能異常。

nodes.label: Geminin
nodes.description: Geminin is a cell cycle regulator that blocks MCM helicase loading onto chromatin, thereby preventing re-replication (Xouri et al., 2004). It accumulates during S phase and G2 and is degraded at mitotic exit, so its transient presence licenses DNA replication exactly once per cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Geminin 是細胞週期調節因子，會阻斷 MCM 解旋酶在染色質上的裝載，因而防止 DNA 再度複製（Xouri et al., 2004）。它在 S 期與 G2 期累積，並於有絲分裂退出時被降解，因此其短暫存在使 DNA 複製在每個週期中恰好發生一次。

nodes.label: Aquaporins
nodes.description: Aquaporins are a conserved family of integral membrane proteins forming selective channels for rapid passive water movement across biological membranes down osmotic gradients. Each monomer has six transmembrane helices around a narrow central pore and channels assemble as tetramers; NPA motifs and an ar/R constriction form the selectivity filter that permits single-file water transport while excluding protons and ions. Aquaglyceroporins (AQP3, AQP7, AQP9) also conduct glycerol.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Aquaporin 是一群保守的整合膜蛋白，形成選擇性通道，使水分沿滲透梯度快速被動通過生物膜。每個單體具有圍繞狹窄中央孔道的六段跨膜螺旋，通道以四聚體組裝；NPA 序列與 ar/R 收縮構成選擇性濾器，允許單列水分子通過並排除質子與離子。Aquaglyceroporin（AQP3、AQP7、AQP9）亦可運送 glycerol。

nodes.label: Redox Cycling
nodes.description: Adrenochrome is not merely a passive end-product of adrenaline oxidation; it actively participates in redox cycling that amplifies oxidative stress. It accepts one electron from reducing agents or enzymes to form the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, which then donates its unpaired electron to molecular oxygen, regenerating adrenochrome and producing superoxide anion. Because newly generated superoxide can oxidize more adrenaline to adrenochrome, the cycle repeats without net consumption of adrenochrome, which acts catalytically. This cycling also consumes oxygen and produces hydrogen peroxide, and it has been directly demonstrated in submitochondrial particles using ESR spectroscopy and pulse radiolysis, explaining part of adrenochrome's cardiotoxic and neurodegenerative potential.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不僅是 adrenaline 氧化的被動終產物；它主動參與放大氧化壓力的氧化還原循環。它從還原劑或酶接受一個電子形成 adrenochrome 半醌自由基，隨後將其未配對電子捐給分子氧，再生 adrenochrome 並產生超氧陰離子。由於新生成的超氧陰離子可氧化更多 adrenaline 為 adrenochrome，此循環在無 adrenochrome 淨消耗下重複，發揮催化作用。此循環也消耗氧氣並產生過氧化氫，且已在亞粒線體顆粒中透過 ESR 光譜與脈衝輻解直接證實，解釋了 adrenochrome 部分的心臟毒性與神經退化潛力。

nodes.label: Nucleolus
nodes.description: The nucleolus is the largest structure within the cell nucleus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 核仁是細胞核內最大的結構。

nodes.label: Diabetic Kidney Disease
nodes.description: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD, diabetic nephropathy) is a progressive complication of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and a leading cause of Chronic Kidney Disease. It is characterized by glomerular and tubular injury driven by chronic hyperglycemia, inflammation and extracellular matrix remodeling, culminating in loss of renal function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diabetic Kidney Disease（DKD，糖尿病腎病）是 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 的進行性併發症，也是 Chronic Kidney Disease 的主要成因之一。其特徵為慢性 hyperglycemia、inflammation 與細胞外基質重塑所驅動的腎小球與腎小管損傷，最終導致腎功能喪失。

nodes.label: Carotenoids
nodes.description: Red Palm Oil is the richest common food matrix for lipophilic carotenoids, carrying roughly 600-750 ppm total (about 665 ppm average), of which ~41% is beta-carotene and ~41% alpha-carotene plus lycopene, phytoene and phytofluene. One tablespoon (~13 g) delivers ~8.7 mg total carotenoids, roughly 400-500 ug RAE of provitamin A. The oil's lipid vehicle solubilizes the carotenoids into mixed micelles, which is why carotenoid absorption from red palm oil far exceeds that from fat-free vegetables, and the serum-retinol response saturates at <=8 g/day.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Red Palm Oil 是脂溶性類胡蘿蔔素最豐富的常見食物基質，總含量約 600-750 ppm（平均約 665 ppm），其中約 41% 為 β-carotene、約 41% 為 α-carotene，並含有 lycopene、phytoene 與 phytofluene。一大匙（約 13 g）可提供約 8.7 mg 總類胡蘿蔔素，約合 400-500 ug RAE 的 provitamin A。油脂載體可將類胡蘿蔔素溶入混合微膠粒，因此其吸收率遠高於無脂蔬菜；而血清 retinol 反應在每日 ≤8 g 時即達飽和。

nodes.label: HNRNPD
nodes.description: HNRNPD (AUF1) binds AU-rich elements in target mRNAs and, when the transcript carries m6A installed by METTL3, destabilizes TFEB pre-mRNA, lowering TFEB protein and attenuating lysosomal-autophagy transcription. Reader proteins such as YTHDF2 contribute to the m6A-dependent targeting.
nodes.description_zh_TW: HNRNPD（AUF1）會結合目標 mRNA 的 AU-rich 元素；當轉錄本帶有 METTL3 安裝的 m6A 標記時，它會使 TFEB 前驅 mRNA 去穩定，降低 TFEB 蛋白並削弱 lysosome-自噬轉錄。诸如 YTHDF2 等 reader 蛋白參與此 m6A 依賴的標定。

nodes.label: Neurodegenerative Disease
nodes.description: Pathological protein aggregates such as Tau and polyglutamine-expanded huntingtin nucleate phase-separated droplets that mature into stable aggregates, sequestering RNA-Binding Proteins and disrupting RNA processing. Such condensates compete with and corrupt normal phase-separated assemblies, linking LLPS biophysics to Neuroinflammation and neuronal dysfunction in diseases such as Alzheimer's Disease and Huntington's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Tau 與多麩醯胺酸擴張的 huntingtin 等病理性蛋白聚集體會成核形成相分離液滴，並成熟為穩定聚集體，扣留 RNA-Binding Proteins 並破壞 RNA 加工。這類凝聚體會與正常相分離組裝競爭並使其受損，把 LLPS 的生物物理學與 Neuroinflammation 及神經元功能障礙連結起來。

nodes.label: Myocardial infarction
nodes.description: Patients with takotsubo present with chest pain, dyspnea, and ST-segment elevation or deep T-wave inversion on ECG — indistinguishable from ST-elevation Myocardial infarction. Modestly elevated Troponin is often discordant with the degree of wall-motion abnormality, and coronary angiography shows normal or non-obstructive coronaries, with characteristic apical ballooning on ventriculography or echocardiography.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Takotsubo 患者會出現胸痛、呼吸困難，以及 ECG 上的 ST 段上升或深 T 波倒置——與 ST 上升型 Myocardial infarction 難以區分。輕度升高的 Troponin 常與室壁運動異常的程度不一致，且冠狀動脈攝影顯示正常或非阻塞性冠狀動脈，心室造影或超音波則可見典型的頂端氣球狀（apical ballooning）變化。

nodes.label: p47phox
nodes.description: p47phox (NCF1) is the cytosolic organizer of the NOX2 NADPH Oxidase: upon phosphorylation it translocates to the membrane together with p67phox and p40phox to join cytochrome b558 (p22phox/gp91phox), triggering the respiratory burst. Its role is organizational rather than catalytic - p47phox is a scaffold that brings the cytosolic subunits into contact with the membrane catalytic subunit, which is why its loss abolishes oxidase activation and why NCF1 mutations are the commonest autosomal-recessive cause of Chronic Granulomatous Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p47phox（NCF1）是 NOX2 NADPH Oxidase 的細胞質組織次單元：磷酸化後，它與 p67phox 及 p40phox 一同轉位至膜，與 cytochrome b558（p22phox/gp91phox）結合，觸發呼吸爆發。其角色是組織性而非催化性——p47phox 是將細胞質次單元帶到膜上催化次單元附近的支架，因此其喪失會使氧化酶活化消失，而 NCF1 突變是 Chronic Granulomatous Disease 最常見的體染色體隱性病因。

nodes.label: Anti-inflammatory
nodes.description: Anti-inflammatory denotes substances, interventions or mechanisms that reduce inflammation. It encompasses pharmacological agents (NSAIDs, corticosteroids, DMARDs, biologics), dietary compounds (curcumin, resveratrol, omega-3 fatty acids, polyphenols) and lifestyle interventions (exercise, caloric restriction, fasting). Mechanisms include inhibition of NF-κB, cyclooxygenase and lipoxygenase, cytokine signalling and ROS production.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Anti-inflammatory 泛指可減少發炎的物質、介入或機制，涵蓋藥理藥物（NSAIDs、Corticosteroids、DMARDs、Biologics）、膳食化合物（curcumin、resveratrol、Omega-3 Fatty Acids、Polyphenols）以及生活型態介入（Exercise、Caloric Restriction、Fasting）。其機制包括抑制 NF-κB、環氧化酶與脂氧化酶、細胞激素訊號與 ROS 生成。

nodes.label: Executioner Caspase
nodes.description: Caspase-7 (CMH-1, ICE-LAP3) is an executioner (effector) protease, synthesized as an inactive procaspase-7 with p20 and p10 catalytic subunits. It is functionally redundant with Caspase-3 but has distinct substrate preferences and upstream regulation, playing a non-redundant role in endoplasmic reticulum stress and certain tissue contexts.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-7（CMH-1、ICE-LAP3）是執行者（效應）蛋白酶，以含 p20 與 p10 催化次單元的不活化 procaspase-7 形式合成。它與 Caspase-3 功能冗餘，但具有不同的受質偏好與上游調控，並在內質網壓力與特定組織情境中扮演不可替代的角色。

nodes.label: IKKepsilon
nodes.description: IKKepsilon, together with TBK1, phosphorylates XIAP at Ser430 within its RING finger domain, triggering Lys48-linked autoubiquitination at Lys322 and Lys328 and rapid proteasomal degradation. This functional link between innate immune activation (e.g., viral infection) and apoptotic sensitization means cells that have recently fought viral infection upregulate IKKε and lower their apoptotic threshold as a safeguard against viral persistence.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與 TBK1 一起在 XIAP 的 RING finger 區域磷酸化 Ser430，觸發 Lys322 與 Lys328 位置的 Lys48 連結自泛素化與快速的蛋白酶體降解。這條連結先天免疫活化（如病毒感染）與凋亡致敏的功能路徑意味著：剛經歷過抗病毒戰鬥的細胞會上調 IKKε、降低凋亡門檻，作為防止病毒持續存在的防線。

nodes.label: Phenotype
nodes.description: In geroscience, the 'aging phenotype' is a composite decline in physiological reserve, increased vulnerability to disease and loss of homeostasis. Geroscience reframes aging as a unifying phenotype driven by the Hallmarks of Aging, which motivates interventions aimed at the overall aging phenotype rather than at single diseases.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 geroscience 中，「老化 phenotype」指生理儲備的綜合性下降、疾病易感性增加與恆定性喪失。Geroscience 將老化重新詮釋為由 Hallmarks of Aging 驅動的統一 phenotype，這促使干預措施以整體老化 phenotype 為目標，而非針對單一疾病。

nodes.label: Euchromatin
nodes.description: Histone acetylation promotes the formation of euchromatin, the open, transcriptionally permissive form of chromatin. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, reducing their affinity for the negatively charged DNA backbone and loosening the nucleosome structure. This relaxed conformation allows transcription factors and RNA polymerase to access regulatory sequences, and acetylated lysines also serve as docking sites for bromodomain-containing reader proteins that further stimulate transcription.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化促進常染色質的形成，常染色質是開放的、轉錄允許的染色質形式。乙醯化會中和組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的正電荷，降低其與帶負電荷的 DNA 主鏈的親和力，並鬆開核小體結構。這種鬆弛的構象允許轉錄因子和 RNA 聚合酶存取調控序列，乙醯化離胺酸也可作為含溴結構域讀取蛋白的對接位點，進一步刺激轉錄。

nodes.label: GSIS
nodes.description: Impairment of glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, driven by insulin resistance, lipotoxicity and oxidative stress, produces glucose intolerance and type 2 diabetes. AMPK and mTOR tune beta-cell mass and secretory capacity, while sirtuins and NAD+ influence insulin secretion and beta-cell survival.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由 insulin resistance、lipotoxicity 與氧化壓力造成的 glucose-stimulated insulin secretion 損傷，會導致 glucose intolerance 與第二型糖尿病。AMPK 與 mTOR 調節 β 細胞的量與分泌能力，而 sirtuins 與 NAD+ 則影響 insulin 分泌與 β 細胞存活。

nodes.label: Glucokinase
nodes.description: Glucokinase (GCK, hexokinase IV) phosphorylates glucose to glucose-6-phosphate in liver and pancreatic beta cells, and it acts as the glucose sensor that gates insulin release. Its product feeds glycolysis, so the enzyme links ambient glucose concentration to both hormone secretion and downstream fuel flux.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glucokinase（GCK，即 hexokinase IV）在肝臟與胰臟 β 細胞中將葡萄糖磷酸化為葡萄糖-6-磷酸，並作為感測葡萄糖、控制胰島素釋放的感測器。其產物供應糖解作用，因此此酵素將環境葡萄糖濃度同時連結到荷爾蒙分泌與下游的燃料通量。

nodes.label: Queen Palm
nodes.description: Queen Palm (Syagrus romanzoffiana, jeriva) fruit carries beta-carotene and alpha-carotene as the dominant pigments of the orange pericarp, both provitamin A species that quench Singlet Oxygen, plus lutein and zeaxanthin as membrane-integrated photoprotectants. Pulp oil extracts reach about 1,200 ug/g total carotenoids, a load comparable to jelly palm and acai and below Tier-1 record-holders such as buriti at 5-10 times the carotenoid load. The combination of carotenoids and a lipid vehicle in one fruit is what makes it a useful food-source test case for structural protection against Lipid Peroxidation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Queen Palm（Syagrus romanzoffiana，jerivá）果實以 beta-carotene 與 alpha-carotene 為橙色果皮中的主要色素，兩者皆為 provitamin A 物種且能 quench Singlet Oxygen，並含 lutein 與 zeaxanthin 作為整合於膜的光保護物。果肉油萃取物可達約 1,200 ug/g 的總類胡蘿蔔素，其量級與 jelly palm、acai 相當，則低於 Tier-1 紀錄保持者 buriti（其類胡蘿蔔素量為 5-10 倍）。同一果實中同時具備類胡蘿蔔素與脂質載體，使其成為結構性防禦 Lipid Peroxidation 的食物來源測試案例。

nodes.label: HFE
nodes.description: Progressive iron overload in hereditary hemochromatosis is associated with substantially elevated Hepatocellular Carcinoma risk once fibrosis or cirrhosis is established, making iron a clear co-carcinogen rather than an inert trace element. This is a genotype-level exception to the usual 'iron is not a carcinogen' framing. Cardiac involvement is likewise a leading cause of death in iron overload, with iron deposition in cardiomyocytes driving dilated cardiomyopathy and Arrhythmias independent of any other risk factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 遺傳性血鐵質沉著症中的進行性鐵負荷，在纖維化或肝硬化確立之後，與顯著升高的 Hepatocellular Carcinoma 風險相關，使鐵成為明確的共同致癌因子而非惰性微量元素。這是基因型層次上對「鐵不是致癌物」的一般論述的例外。鐵負荷中的心臟侵犯同樣是主要死因，心肌細胞的鐵沉積可在不依賴其他危險因子的情况下造成擴張型心肌病變與 Arrhythmias。

nodes.label: Homologous recombination repair
nodes.description: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

nodes.label: TOP1
nodes.description: TOP1 (Topoisomerase 1) relieves DNA supercoiling by creating transient single-strand breaks. Its trapped cleavage complexes (TOP1cc) assist cGAS recognition of and binding to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCFs), which is essential for downstream SASP regulation: TOP1 on these fragments licenses cGAS binding by exposing appropriate DNA topology and co-localizing with the sensor, cooperating with G3BP1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TOP1 (Topoisomerase 1) 藉由製造暫時性單股斷裂來解除 DNA 超螺旋。其被捕捉的裂解複合體 (TOP1cc) 協助 cGAS 辨識並結合細胞質染色質片段 (CCFs)，這對下游 SASP 的調控至关重要：TOP1 藉由呈現適當的 DNA 拓撲並與感測器共定位，使 cGAS 得以結合，並與 G3BP1 協同作用。

nodes.label: Cachexia
nodes.description: Cachexia is a metabolic syndrome of involuntary skeletal muscle and adipose loss that nutritional support cannot fully reverse, driven by catabolic inflammation (TNF-α, IL-6) through NF-κB/STAT signaling with impaired mTORC1. NAD+ deficiency is implicated in both cancer- and chemotherapy-induced cachexia, with repletion (e.g. niacin) therapeutic in both settings; Nrk2 downregulation alongside skeletal muscle NAD+ loss is an early robust signature, with cisplatin producing the most severe phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Cachexia 是一種無法單靠營養支持完全逆轉的代謝症候群，表現為骨骼肌與脂肪的非自願性流失，由促分解的發炎（TNF-α、IL-6）經 NF-κB/STAT 訊號並伴隨 mTORC1 受损所驅動。NAD+ 缺乏同時涉入癌症引發與化療引發的 cachexia，補充 NAD+（如菸酸）在兩種情境中都具治療效果；Nrk2 下調並伴隨骨骼肌 NAD+ 流失是早期且穩健的特徵，其中 cisplatin 造成最嚴重的表型。

nodes.label: SIR-2.1
nodes.description: Worm SIR-2.1 NAD-dependent deacetylase regulates lifespan and stress resistance. Regulation is the aging output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 線蟲 SIR-2.1 NAD 依賴去乙醯酶調節壽命與壓力抗性。調節是老化輸出。

nodes.label: FOXO4
nodes.description: Hydrogen peroxide-induced acetylation inhibits FOXO4 transactivation, and SIRT1 deacetylation reverses this, restoring FOXO4 activity and enhancing GADD45 alpha expression and resistance to oxidative stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過氧化氫誘發的乙醯化會抑制 FOXO4 的轉錄活化，而 SIRT1 的去乙醯化可逆轉此現象，恢復 FOXO4 活性並增強 GADD45 alpha 表現與對氧化壓力的抵抗力。

nodes.label: FAK
nodes.description: Fibronectin engages integrins to trigger outside-in signalling that activates FAK, Src, PI3K/Akt and the MAPK/ERK pathways. Force-dependent fibronectin fibrillogenesis exposes cryptic binding sites and stiffens the matrix in a positive feedback loop, and this mechanical signalling is a key driver of EMT and invasion in cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Fibronectin 與整合素結合後觸發由外向內的訊號，活化 FAK、Src、PI3K／Akt 與 MAPK／ERK 途徑。Fibronectin 的纖維化本身依賴機械力：細胞收縮力暴露隱藏的結合位點並使基質硬化，形成正回饋迴路，而這種機械訊號是癌症中 EMT 與侵襲的關鍵驅動因素。

nodes.label: Src
nodes.description: Src is the primary kinase that phosphorylates Caspase-8 at Tyr380 (Tyr397/Tyr465 depending on isoform), together with related SFKs such as Lyn. This phosphorylation blocks proteolytic cleavage and maturation of Caspase-8, shutting down the extrinsic apoptotic pathway and converting Caspase-8 into a scaffolding protein that recruits FAK, calpain-2 and PI3K to drive migration and survival signalling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Src 是磷酸化 Caspase-8 於 Tyr380（依 isoform 為 Tyr397/Tyr465）的主要激酶，Lyn 等相關 SFK 亦同。此磷酸化阻斷 Caspase-8 的蛋白水解切割與成熟，關閉外在凋亡路徑，並將 Caspase-8 轉為支架蛋白，招募 FAK、calpain-2 與 PI3K 以驅動遷移與存活訊息。

nodes.label: Restriction Point
nodes.description: The restriction point (R point) is the commitment point late in G1 after which CDK activity becomes self-sustaining and largely independent of external growth cues. Passage through it commits the cell to a complete round of division.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 限制點（R 點）是 G1 後期的承諾點，通過後 CDK 活性變成自我維持，並在很大程度上不依賴外部生長訊號。通過它使細胞承諾完成一整輪分裂。

nodes.label: Chondrocytes
nodes.description: In osteoarthritis, SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial integrity by deacetylating cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4 isoform 2, and its deletion correlates with OA exacerbation in animal and human models. SIRT3 promotes mitophagy via the PINK1/Parkin axis, maintains mitochondrial health by regulating FOXO3a hyperacetylation, inhibits chondrocyte apoptosis through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, facilitates mitochondrial fusion for mtDNA complementation, and enhances cartilage resilience.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在骨關節炎中，SIRT3 透過去乙醯化細胞色素 c 氧化酶亞基 4 異型 2 維護粒線體完整性，其缺失與動物和人類模型中的 OA 加劇相關。SIRT3 透過 PINK1/Parkin 軸線促進粒線體自噬，透過調節 FOXO3a 超乙醯化維護粒線體健康，透過 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 訊號抑制軟骨細胞凋亡，促進粒線體融合以進行 mtDNA 補償，並增強軟骨韌性。

nodes.label: Transcriptome
nodes.description: A transcriptome is the complete set of RNA transcripts — including mRNA, rRNA, tRNA, and non-coding RNA — produced by the genome at a specific time or under a specific condition. Transcriptomic analysis such as RNA-seq measures expression of thousands of genes simultaneously, making the transcriptome the readout that Transcription ultimately generates.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 轉錄組（transcriptome）是基因組在特定時間或特定條件下產生的全部 RNA 轉錄本集合，包含 mRNA、rRNA、tRNA 與非編碼 RNA。RNA-seq 等轉錄組分析可同時測量數千個基因的表現，使 transcriptome 成為 Transcription 最終產生的讀值。

nodes.label: Lox-1
nodes.description: SIRT1 activation suppresses Lox-1 expression in endothelial cells and macrophages by deacetylating RelA/p65 and blocking NF-κB transactivation of the OLR1 promoter. Reduced Lox-1 diminishes macrophage oxLDL uptake and foam cell formation, a seminal event in atherosclerotic plaque development, so sirtuin activators such as resveratrol and SRT1720 are atheroprotective in preclinical models.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 的活化藉由去乙醯化 RelA/p65 並阻斷 NF-κB 對 OLR1 啟動子的轉錄活化，抑制內皮細胞與巨噬細胞中的 Lox-1 表現。Lox-1 降低會減少巨噬細胞對 oxLDL 的攝取與 Foam Cells 的形成——此為動脈粥狀硬化斑塊發育的關鍵事件——因此 resveratrol、SRT1720 等 sirtuin 活化劑在前臨床模型中具有抗動脈粥狀硬化作用。

nodes.label: mTOR-HIF-1alpha Axis
nodes.description: Brief oxLDL exposure trains human monocytes so that TLR2/TLR4 restimulation elicits amplified TNF-alpha and IL-6. This training depends on Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling, since Torin1 or Raptor/Rictor silencing abolishes the trained cytokine response. It exemplifies DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring shared with beta-glucan training.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 短暫的 Oxidized LDL 暴露可訓練人類單核球，使 TLR2/TLR4 再刺激時產生放大的 TNF-alpha 與 IL-6。此訓練依賴 Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling，因為 Torin1 或 Raptor/Rictor 沉默可消除訓練後的細胞激素反應。這是與 beta-glucan 訓練共用的 DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring 範例。

nodes.label: PHB2
nodes.description: PHB2 contains an LIR motif (Y-V-L-P at residues 121-124) that binds cytosolic LC3 once PHB2 is exposed, recruiting the autophagy machinery.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PHB2 含有一段 LIR motif（位於殘基 121–124 的 Y-V-L-P），在 PHB2 暴露後可結合細胞質中的 LC3，藉以募集自噬機制。

nodes.label: Mevalonate pathway
nodes.description: The substrate for FSP1 — ubiquinone/CoQ10 — is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Perturbations that suppress mevalonate output toward cholesterol (e.g., statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) starve FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate, collapsing the FSP1 axis and predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. This makes the mevalonate pathway intersect ferroptosis at two nodes: selenocysteine-tRNA maturation for GPX4 and CoQ10 supply for FSP1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FSP1 的受質——泛醌/CoQ10——是甲羥戊酸（mevalonate）路徑的非固醇產物。抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的擾動（例如 statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會使 FSP1 缺乏泛醌受質，瓦解 FSP1 軸並預示鐵死亡敏感性。這使甲羥戊酸路徑在兩個節點與鐵死亡交會：GPX4 所需的硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟，以及 FSP1 所需的 CoQ10 供應。

nodes.label: Polyamine
nodes.description: Proline is the major nitrogen donor for polyamine synthesis, including spermidine, which is itself implicated in autophagy induction and longevity. Proline's cyclic structure additionally constrains protein backbone conformation and stabilizes collagen.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Proline 是多胺（包括 spermidine）合成的主要氮供應者，而 spermidine 本身即與自噬誘導及長壽相關。Proline 的環狀結構另外可限制蛋白主鏈構形並穩定 collagen。

nodes.label: SRT1720
nodes.description: SRT1720 improves insulin sensitivity, reduces hepatic steatosis and enhances mitochondrial biogenesis in diet-induced obese mouse models, and extends lifespan in mice fed a high-fat diet but not in chow-fed mice — suggesting context-dependent efficacy that benefits metabolically stressed animals more than healthy ones.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SRT1720 在飲食誘導的肥胖小鼠模型中改善胰島素敏感度、減少肝脂肪變性並增強粒線體生生成；它可延長高脂飲食小鼠的壽命，但對正常飼料小鼠無效，顯示其效力具情境依賴性，對代謝受壓的動物益處較大。

nodes.label: Bik
nodes.description: Bik is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bik, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bik 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從Bcl-2 family 向Bik 延伸，因此Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bik 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: Body Mass Index
nodes.description: Body Mass Index is the standard population-level screening index for weight status (BMI >= 30 defines obesity), and it correlates strongly with adiposity and cardiometabolic risk at the population level, though it does not distinguish fat from lean mass.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Body Mass Index 是族群層級體重狀態的標準篩檢指標（BMI >= 30 定義為肥胖），在族群層面與體脂及心血管代謝風險高度相關，但它無法區分脂肪與瘦體組織。

nodes.label: PALB2
nodes.description: The PALB2-BRCA1-BRCA2-RAD51 axis mediates strand exchange at resected DNA breaks, which is what homologous recombination repair depends on to restore broken chromosomes accurately. PALB2 therefore sits inside the DNA repair pathway as an enabling scaffold: its loss produces both Fanconi anemia phenotype and the PARP-inhibitor sensitivity characteristic of BRCA deficiency.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PALB2-BRCA1-BRCA2-RAD51 軸在經切除的 DNA 斷端上執行股交換，而同源重組修復正是依靠此機制準確修復受損染色體。因此 PALB2 位於 DNA 修復途徑之內，作為一個必要的支架：其缺失同時造成 Fanconi 貧血表型，以及 BRCA 缺失所特有的 PARP 抑制劑敏感性。

nodes.label: Histone H1
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates the linker histone Histone H1 at Lys9 and Lys26. Because H1 acetylation neutralizes positive charges and weakens linker-DNA binding, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation restores tighter linker-DNA association and a repressive, more compact chromatin environment.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會在連接組蛋白 Histone H1 的第 9 與第 26 號離胺酸上進行去乙醯化。由於 H1 的乙醯化會中和正電荷並削弱其與連接 DNA 的結合，SIRT1 媒介的去乙醯化可恢復較緊密的連接 DNA 結合與具抑制性的高度凝聚染色質環境。

nodes.label: RRM2B
nodes.description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2B (p53R2) provides a p53-inducible small (beta-prime) subunit that partners with RRM1 to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis. RRM2B mutations cause mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes. RRM2B encodes p53R2, the p53-inducible small (beta-prime) subunit of human ribonucleotide reductase, which assembles with the RRM1 alpha subunit to form an active enzyme. It contains the same radical-bearing di-iron/tyrosyl cofactor as RRM2 with a Phe-for-Tyr substitution.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2B（p53R2）提供受 p53 誘導的（beta-prime）小次單元，與 RRM1 配對以供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。RRM2B 突變會導致粒線體 DNA 耗竭症候群。 RRM2B 編碼 p53R2，即人類核醣核苷酸還原酶受 p53 誘導的（beta-prime）小次單元，與 RRM1 alpha 次單元組裝形成活性酵素。它含有與 RRM2 相同的攜帶自由基的雙鐵/酪胺醯輔因子，但有一個 Phe 取代 Tyr。

nodes.label: membrane blebbing
nodes.description: Active ROCK1 drives MLC phosphorylation and actomyosin contraction producing blebs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 活化的 ROCK1 驅動 MLC 磷酸化與肌動球蛋白收縮產生泡。

nodes.label: MUL1
nodes.description: Because MUL1 operates independently of PINK1, it offers redundancy in the mitophagy system when PINK1/Parkin signalling fails as it does in familial Parkinson's disease. MUL1 expression then compensates for Parkin deficiency, offering redundancy that may partly explain why PINK1/Parkin mutations do not always produce overt mitochondrial accumulation in patients.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 MUL1 的作用不依賴 PINK1，當 PINK1/Parkin 訊號失效（如家族性帕金森氏症）時，它在粒線體自噬系統中提供了冗餘性。此時 MUL1 的表現可代償 Parkin 缺失，這種冗餘或可部分解釋為何 PINK1/Parkin 突變在患者身上不一定造成明顯的粒線體累積。

nodes.label: triple-negative breast cancer
nodes.description: TNBC is a breast cancer subtype defined by absent ER/PR/HER2 receptors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNBC 是以 ER/PR/HER2 受體缺失定義的乳癌亞型。

nodes.label: clk-1
nodes.description: clk-1 (Clock-1) is a Caenorhabditis elegans gene encoding a mitochondrial hydroxylase involved in the biosynthesis of ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q). Because ubiquinone is the mobile electron carrier of the respiratory chain, reduced clk-1 activity impairs electron transport and produces the mild mitochondrial stress that underlies the gene's longevity phenotype.
nodes.description_zh_TW: clk-1（Clock-1）是 Caenorhabditis elegans 的一個基因，編碼參與 Ubiquinone（Coenzyme Q）生合成的粒線體羥化酶。由於 ubiquinone 是呼吸鏈的可移動電子載體，clk-1 活性下降會損害電子傳遞，並造成該基因長壽表型所依據的輕度粒線體壓力。

nodes.label: transcriptional regulation
nodes.description: Autophagy gene transcription is under transcriptional regulation by TFEB, TFE3, FOXO, ATF4, XBP1, PPARα, SREBP1 and ZKSCAN3, which respond to nutrients and stress. Because the components of the autophagy machinery are themselves transcriptionally controlled, transcriptional regulation is the level at which the cell decides how much degradative capacity to build.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 自噬基因的轉錄受到 TFEB、TFE3、FOXO、ATF4、XBP1、PPARα、SREBP1 與 ZKSCAN3 等因子對營養與壓力的 transcriptional regulation 調控。由於自噬機組本身的成分即受轉錄調控，transcriptional regulation 正是細胞決定要建構多少降解容量的層級。

nodes.label: Lin28
nodes.description: Lin28 blocks pri/pre-let-7 maturation, forming a bistable stemness switch with let-7. Inhibition derepresses pluripotency factors.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lin28 阻斷 pri/pre-let-7 成熟，與 let-7 形成雙穩態幹性開關。抑制去抑制多能性因子。

nodes.label: Chronic Granulomatous Disease
nodes.description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

nodes.label: Schiff base
nodes.description: Amadori products are stable early-stage intermediates of glycation that form when the initial unstable Schiff base between a reducing sugar and a protein amino group undergoes chemical rearrangement over days. They are therefore reversible targets before they become irreversible crosslinks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Amadori products 是 glycation 早期階段的穩定中間體，由還原糖與蛋白胺基之間最初不穩定的 Schiff base 經數日的化學重排形成。因此在成為不可逆交聯之前，它們是可逆的處置標的。

nodes.label: SAT1
nodes.description: SAT1 generates N1-acetylspermidine/spermine, which are exported and oxidized by polyamine oxidase, producing H2O2 and downstream reactive oxygen species. SAT1 is tightly regulated at the level of mRNA stability and protein degradation, making it a rapid-response node to stress signals rather than a slow metabolic enzyme.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SAT1 生成 N1-乙醯 spermidine／spermine，後者被輸出並由多胺氧化酶氧化，產生 H2O2 與下游活性氧物種。SAT1 在 mRNA 穩定性與蛋白質降解層級受到嚴密調控，因此它是對壓力訊號快速反應的節點，而非緩慢的代謝酵素。

nodes.label: Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators
nodes.description: Selective androgen receptor modulators are non-steroidal ligands that bind the ligand-binding domain of the androgen receptor and recruit coactivators driving transcription of anabolic genes, but do so in a tissue-selective manner. Anabolic effects in skeletal muscle and bone are retained while activity in androgenic tissues (prostate, skin, hair) is weaker, which accounts for the improved side-effect profile versus exogenous testosterone.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators 是非類固醇配體，可結合 androgen receptor 的配體結合區並招募輔活化因子以驅動合成代謝基因的轉錄，但以組織選擇性的方式進行。skeletal muscle 與骨骼的合成代謝效應被保留，而在雄性激素組織（前列腺、皮膚、毛髮）中的作用較弱，這正是其相較於外源性 testosterone 較佳副作用特徵的原因。

nodes.label: Nucleoside Analog
nodes.description: Bromodeoxyuridine is a thymidine analog in the nucleoside-analog class with Gemcitabine and CPEC. Same antimetabolite family, tracer application.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bromodeoxyuridine 是與 Gemcitabine 和 CPEC 同屬核苷類似物類別的胸苷類似物。相同抗代謝家族，追蹤應用。

nodes.label: Lithium
nodes.description: Lithium is administered clinically as Li+ salts and its best-characterised target is inhibition of GSK3 (both alpha and beta isoforms), mimicking Wnt/beta-catenin signalling and influencing neuroplasticity. This contributes to its mood-stabilising action and reduced suicide risk, as well as proposed neuroprotection in Alzheimer's Disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lithium 臨床上以 Li+ 鹽類給予，其最明確的標的是抑制 GSK3（α 與 β 兩種異型），模擬 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號並影響神經可塑性。這既構成其情緒穩定作用與降低自殺風險的機制，也是其在 Alzheimer's Disease 中被提出之神經保護作用的依據。

nodes.label: Neurotransmission
nodes.description: Neurotransmission and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neurotransmission and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Neurotransmission 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neurotransmission 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

nodes.label: PP1
nodes.description: PP1α is the alpha catalytic isoform of PP1, encoded by PPP1CA. Like all PP1 isoforms it carries the conserved PP1 catalytic fold with a beta12-alphaC loop binding two Mn2+/Fe2+ ions, but its substrate specificity comes from associated regulatory proteins recognizing RVxF motifs rather than from the catalytic core itself.
nodes.description_zh_TW: PP1α 是 PP1 的 alpha 催化異型，由 PPP1CA 編碼。與所有 PP1 異型相同，它帶有保守的 PP1 催化摺疊，其 beta12-alphaC 迴圈結合兩個 Mn2+/Fe2+ 離子；但其受質專一性來自辨識 RVxF 基序的結合調節蛋白，而非催化核心本身。

nodes.label: Plasma Membrane
nodes.description: FSP1 carries an N-terminal N-myristoylation motif that recruits it to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, positioning the enzyme precisely where phospholipid peroxidation is initiated and propagated. Membrane association is essential for its ferroptosis-suppressive function.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FSP1 帶有 N 端 N-肉豆蔻酰化（myristoylation）基序，將其招募至質膜內葉，使酵素精確定位在磷脂過氧化起始與傳播的位置。膜結合對其抑制鐵死亡的功能不可或缺。

nodes.label: NDP52
nodes.description: NDP52 (CALCOCO2) is a primary autophagy receptor of the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy pathway. Through its LC3-interacting region (LIR) motif it binds LC3 proteins on the expanding phagophore, guiding the isolation membrane to enwrap ubiquitin-coated damaged mitochondria. NDP52 therefore bridges ubiquitin-tagged mitochondrial cargo to the autophagosome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: NDP52（CALCOCO2）是 PINK1/Parkin 介導的 mitophagy 主要自噬受體。NDP52 透過其 LIR motif 與 phagophore 上的 LC3 蛋白結合，引導分離膜包覆被泛素標記的受損粒線體。NDP52 因此將泛素標記的粒線體貨載與自噬體連結起來。

nodes.label: Bromodeoxyuridine
nodes.description: Bromodeoxyuridine is a thymidine analog in the nucleoside-analog class with Gemcitabine and CPEC. Same antimetabolite family, tracer application.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bromodeoxyuridine 是與 Gemcitabine 和 CPEC 同屬核苷類似物類別的胸苷類似物。相同抗代謝家族，追蹤應用。

nodes.label: Retinoid X receptor α
nodes.description: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a key effector of the mammalian Retrograde Response. Mitochondrial stress — electron transport chain impairment, Mitochondrial ROS accumulation, loss of membrane potential — converges on RXRα via calcium-dependent calcineurin, which dephosphorylates and activates the receptor, promoting nuclear translocation and transcription of metabolic adaptation, antioxidant defense, Mitochondrial Biogenesis, and Mitochondrial Dynamics genes.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Retinoid X receptor α（RXRA、NR2B1）是哺乳類 Retrograde Response 的關鍵效應者。粒線體壓力——電子傳遞鏈受損、Mitochondrial ROS 累積、膜電位喪失——經由鈣離子依賴的 calcineurin 匯聚於 RXRα；calcineurin 使其去磷酸化並活化，促進核轉位與代謝適應、抗氧化防禦、Mitochondrial Biogenesis 與 Mitochondrial Dynamics 等基因的轉錄。

nodes.label: FXR
nodes.description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation modulates the transcriptional output of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), adjusting bile-acid signaling in response to cellular NAD+ and energy status. This couples nutrient sensing to hepatic lipid, glucose, and cholesterol handling, since fasting-induced NAD+ rises retune FXR-dependent metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 媒介的去乙醯化可調節 farnesoid X receptor（FXR）的轉錄輸出，使膽汁酸訊號隨細胞 NAD+ 與能量狀態而調整。由於禁食造成的 NAD+ 上升會重新校準 FXR 依賴性的代謝，此機制將營養感知與肝臟脂質、葡萄糖及膽固醇處理相連結。

nodes.label: Reactive Species
nodes.description: Contrary to intuition, hypoxia shifts the mitochondrial electron transport system toward a reduced state, increasing electron availability and favoring superoxide formation. This hypoxic oxidant burst provides the redox signal that activates defenses before the larger reoxygenation insult.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 與直覺相反，Hypoxia 使粒線體電子傳遞系統偏向還原態，增加電子可利用性並促進超氧物生成。這波缺氧期間的氧化物爆發提供了氧化還原訊號，在更大的再氧合損傷之前活化防禦機制。

nodes.label: EDTA
nodes.description: EDTA is the prototypical polyaminocarboxylate chelator: a hexadentate molecule whose four carboxylate oxygens and two amine nitrogens coordinate a broad range of di- and trivalent metal ions. Experimentally it is the reference tool for blocking metal-dependent adrenochrome synthesis by sequestering the catalytic Fe2+ and Cu+.
nodes.description_zh_TW: EDTA 是典型的聚胺羧酸類螯合劑：以四個羧酸根氧與兩個胺基氮配位廣泛二價與三價金屬離子的六齒分子。實驗上，它是藉由隔離具催化作用的 Fe2+ 與 Cu+ 來阻斷金屬依賴性 Adrenochrome 合成的參考工具。

nodes.label: Centenarians
nodes.description: Two linked missense variants in SIRT6 (N308K/A313S) are enriched in Ashkenazi Jewish centenarians; the variants elevate SIRT6 protein level, enhance its mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, delay senescence, and suppress LINE1 derepression. They also protect against progerin-induced stress and frame gerotherapeutic strategies to extend healthspan.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT6 的兩個連鎖錯義變異（N308K/A313S）在阿什肯納茲猶太 centenarians（百歲人瑞）中富集；這些變異提高 SIRT6 蛋白量、增強其單 ADP-核糖基化活性、延緩衰老並抑制 LINE1 去抑制。它們也能對抗 progerin 造成的壓力，並為延長 healthspan 的 gerotherapeutic 策略提供框架。

nodes.label: Catechin
nodes.description: Catechin is a flavan-3-ol member of the Flavonoids, abundant in green tea, cocoa, and fruits, with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. It is also a monomeric building block of the polymeric proanthocyanidins and belongs to the natural-polyphenol STAC family that activates SIRT1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Catechin 是 Flavonoids（黃酮類）中 flavan-3-ol 家族的成員，富含於綠茶、可可與水果，具有抗氧化與抗發炎活性。它也是聚合 proanthocyanidins 的單體構成單元，並屬於可活化 SIRT1 的天然多酚 STAC 家族。

nodes.label: Glutathione S-transferase π1
nodes.description: SIRT3 downregulates both the mRNA and protein levels of glutathione S-transferase pi 1 (GSTP1), a phase II detoxification enzyme involved in the metabolism of chemotherapeutic agents. SIRT3 overexpression promotes sorafenib-induced apoptosis and thereby enhances the drug sensitivity of hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced GSTP1 and enhanced drug responsiveness. By lowering the capacity of cancer cells to detoxify sorafenib, SIRT3 restores sensitivity to this agent. This suggests that SIRT3 expression status could predict sorafenib response in liver cancer, and that boosting SIRT3 may help overcome drug resistance in this malignancy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT3下調穀胱甘肽S-轉移酶pi 1（GSTP1）的mRNA和蛋白水平，GSTP1是參與化療藥物代謝的II期解毒酶。SIRT3過表達促進Sorafenib誘導的凋亡，從而增強肝細胞癌細胞的藥物敏感性。方向上，SIRT3位於GSTP1降低和藥物反應性增強的上游。透過降低癌細胞解毒Sorafenib的能力，SIRT3恢復了對此藥物的敏感性。這表明SIRT3表達狀態可能預測肝癌中的Sorafenib反應，而增強SIRT3可能有助於克服此惡性腫瘤的藥物耐藥性。

nodes.label: F2-Isoprostanes
nodes.description: F2-isoprostanes are the gold-standard biomarker for oxidative stress, formed non-enzymatically by free-radical peroxidation of arachidonic acid into prostaglandin-like compounds. They are measured in urine and plasma and are remarkably stable. The directionality is lipid peroxidation to isoprostane formation. A caveat is that isoprostanes can also arise from cyclooxygenase-independent enzymatic routes in rare cases, and levels are influenced by diet and renal function. Their measurement has become the reference standard for evaluating antioxidant efficacy in human intervention trials.
nodes.description_zh_TW: F2-isoprostanes 是 oxidative stress 的黃金標準生物標記物，由花生四烯酸自由基過氧化成 prostaglandin 樣化合物，以非酵素方式形成。它們在尿液和血漿中進行測量，並且非常穩定。方向性是lipid peroxidation至isoprostane形成。需要注意的是，在極少數情況下，isoprostanes 也可能由不依賴環氧合酶的酵素途徑產生，且其水平受到飲食和腎功能的影響。他們的測量結果已成為評估人類幹預試驗中抗氧化功效的參考標準。

nodes.label: Lovastatin
nodes.description: Lovastatin, a statin, acts as an SHP2 agonist: it promotes SHP2 dephosphorylation of Parkin at Tyr143, thereby enhancing Parkin E3 ligase activation and downstream mitophagy. This links statin pharmacology to the phosphorylation-dependent control of the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Lovastatin 屬 statin 類藥物，作為 SHP2 促效劑：促進 SHP2 將 Parkin 的 Tyr143 去磷酸化，藉此增強 Parkin E3 泛素連接酶的活化與下游自噬。這將 statin 類藥理與 PINK1／Parkin 自噬軸的磷酸化依賴性調控連結起來。

nodes.label: Autophagosome-lysosome fusion
nodes.description: TFEB is a master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy that plays a critical role in autophagosome-lysosome fusion and clearance of cargo. Directionally, TFEB sits upstream of autophagic-lysosomal execution. Because SIRT2 stabilizes TFEB mRNA and SIRT1 deacetylates TFEB to promote its nuclear translocation, sirtuins influence TFEB function through multiple mechanisms. This links sirtuins to the terminal degradative step of autophagy, and TFEB's transcriptional program, known as CLEAR, coordinates the lysosomal and autophagic machinery that clears damaged proteins and organelles during stress.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物合成和自噬的主控轉錄因子，在自噬溶酶體融合和清除負載物中扮演關鍵角色。在方向性上，TFEB 位於自噬溶酶體執行步驟的上游。由於 SIRT2 穩定 TFEB mRNA，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 TFEB 以促進其核轉位，sirtuin 透過多種機制影響 TFEB 功能。這將 sirtuin 與自噬的終末降解步驟聯繫起來，而 TFEB 的轉錄程式——稱為 CLEAR——協調溶酶體和自噬機制，以在壓力期間清除受損蛋白質和細胞器。

nodes.label: spliced X-box binding protein 1
nodes.description: SIRT1 deacetylates spliced X-box-binding protein 1 (XBP1s) downstream of an AMPKα-dependent pathway in macrophages, and deacetylated XBP1s then inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome assembly. Directionally, SIRT1 modifies XBP1s, which in turn suppresses NLRP3. This couples endoplasmic-reticulum stress responses to sirtuin control of inflammation, integrating two stress pathways at the intersection of metabolism and immunity. It is a key mechanism in atherosclerotic and metabolic disease, where chronic ER stress and inflammasome activation drive pathology, and it illustrates how SIRT1 coordinates multiple inputs to restrain inflammatory signaling.
nodes.description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在巨噬細胞中 AMPKα 依賴性通路的下游去乙醯化剪接的 X 結合蛋白 1（XBP1s），去乙醯化的 XBP1s 然後抑制 NLRP3 炎症小體組裝。在方向性上，SIRT1 修飾 XBP1s，XBP1s 再抑制 NLRP3。這將內質網壓力反應與 sirtuin 的發炎控制偶聯起來，在代謝和免疫的交匯處整合兩個壓力通路。這是動脈粥樣硬化和代謝疾病中的關鍵機制，在這些疾病中慢性內質網壓力和炎症小體活化驅動病理，說明 SIRT1 如何協調多個輸入來抑制發炎信號。

nodes.label: Diaphorase
nodes.description: The names Diaphorase, NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase and Cytochrome b5 reductase denote the same flavoprotein enzyme of red blood cells, with only the last used for the genetically defined deficiency state. Congenital deficiency of cytochrome b5 reductase causes hereditary Methemoglobinemia with chronic Cyanosis, whereas acute oxidant-induced methemoglobinemia is treated with Methylene blue, which is reduced by NADPH and then bypasses the diaphorase route entirely.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Diaphorase、NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 與 Cytochrome b5 reductase 指的是紅血球中的同一個黃素蛋白酵素，其中只有 Cytochrome b5 reductase 用於描述遺傳性缺乏狀態。Cytochrome b5 reductase 的先天缺乏造成伴隨慢性 Cyanosis 的遺傳性 Methemoglobinemia；急性氧化性 methemoglobinemia 則以 Methylene blue 治療，該藥被 NADPH 還原後完全繞過 diaphorase 途徑。

nodes.label: Ca2+
nodes.description: Ca2+ and cAMP signaling intersect to regulate CREB-dependent transcription: Ca2+ activates CaMKIV, while cAMP activates PKA, and both phosphorylate CREB at Ser133. Ca2+-permeable channels such as TRPM2, activated by ADP-ribose and OAADPr, further couple NAD+ metabolism to Ca2+ influx, so calcium signalling and sirtuin energy sensing converge on the same transcription factor.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ca2+ 與 cAMP 訊號在調控 CREB 依賴的轉錄上交會：Ca2+ 活化 CaMKIV，cAMP 活化 PKA，兩者皆在 Ser133 磷酸化 CREB。TRPM2 等 Ca2+ 可通透通道可被 ADP-ribose 與 OAADPr 活化，進一步把 NAD+ 代謝與 Ca2+ 內流偶聯起來，使鈣離子訊號與 sirtuin 能量感測匯流於同一轉錄因子。

nodes.label: Melanoidins
nodes.description: Terminal high molecular weight brown pigments of cooked foods are Maillard melanoidins. Polymerization ends the browning cascade.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 熟食的終末高分子量棕色色素即 Maillard melanoidins。聚合終止褐變級聯。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: adrenochrome synthesis
nodes.description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

nodes.label: Cellular Homeostasis
nodes.description: Mitochondrial dynamics refers to the continuous processes of fusion and fission that regulate mitochondrial morphology, number, and function. These processes maintain cellular homeostasis by exchanging components, diluting damage, and enabling mitophagy.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 粒線體動態指調控粒線體形態、數量與功能的持續融合與分裂過程。這些過程透過交換成分、稀釋損傷與促成 mitophagy 來維持細胞恆定。

nodes.label: CASTOR2
nodes.description: Arginine-free CASTOR1-CASTOR2 heterodimer binds and represses GATOR2. Parallel inhibition to the CASTOR1 edge.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 無精胺酸 CASTOR1-CASTOR2 異二聚體結合並抑制 GATOR2。與 CASTOR1 邊平行的抑制。

nodes.label: Elastin
nodes.description: MMP-12 (macrophage elastase) is the most potent elastinolytic MMP and the only one that can effectively degrade insoluble elastin at physiological concentrations, making it the principal elastase in macrophage-mediated tissue remodelling. MMP-12-deficient mice are protected from cigarette smoke-induced emphysema, and MMP-12-mediated elastin degradation is a central mechanism of both intrinsic and extrinsic skin ageing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-12（巨噬細胞彈性蛋白酶）是最強的彈性蛋白溶解 MMP，也是唯一能在生理濃度下有效降解不溶性彈性蛋白的 MMP，因此是巨噬細胞介導組織重塑中的主要彈性蛋白酶。MMP-12 缺失小鼠可免於菸草煙誘發的肺氣腫，而 MMP-12 介導的彈性蛋白降解也是內在與外在皮膚老化的核心機制。

nodes.label: DR5
nodes.description: DR5 is the primary TRAIL receptor; ligand binding nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DR5 是主要的 TRAIL 受體；配體結合使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性凋亡。

nodes.label: Trichuriasis
nodes.description: Trichuriasis (whipworm infection) is a soil-transmitted helminth infection of the large intestine caused by the nematode Trichuris trichiura. Adult worms anchor their thin anterior ends in the colonic mucosa, and heavy burdens in children produce Trichuris dysentery syndrome with bloody diarrhea, growth stunting and rectal prolapse.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 鞭蟲病（ whipworm infection ）是由線蟲 Trichuris trichiura 所引起的大腸土壤傳播蠕蟲感染。成蟲以細長的前端固定於結腸黏膜，重度感染（多見於兒童）會造成鞭蟲痢疾症候群，表現為血性腹瀉、生長遲緩與直腸脫垂。

nodes.label: Ambra-1
nodes.description: Ambra-1 is a scaffold protein that bridges Beclin1 to the ULK1 complex, coordinating autophagosome nucleation as a positive regulator of the PI3K III complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Ambra-1 是支架蛋白，將 Beclin1 與 ULK1 複合體連結起來，作為 PI3K III 複合體的正向調節因子來協調自噬體成核。

nodes.label: Complex III
nodes.description: Methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional Complex III in the mitochondrial electron transport chain, rerouting electron flow to maintain ATP production when normal respiratory chain pathways are impaired. Together with its ability to bypass Complex I, this makes methylene blue a molecular shunt that sustains oxidative phosphorylation and ATP output in compromised mitochondria. This effect is demonstrated in cellular and animal studies at sub-1 mg/kg doses (roughly 1-4 mg per dose in adults). The mitochondrial longevity data are largely from cells and mice, so human translation is not guaranteed, and most mechanistic evidence remains preclinical.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylene blue可以繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的複合物III，在正常呼吸鏈路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP產生。與其繞過複合物I的能力結合，這使得methylene blue成為一種分子分流器，在受損的粒線體中維持氧化磷酸化和ATP輸出。這種效果在細胞和動物研究中以低於1 mg/kg的劑量（成人大約每次1-4毫克）得到證實。粒線體長壽數據主要來自細胞和小鼠，因此不能保證在人體中的轉化，大多數機制證據仍處於臨床前階段。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

nodes.label: IL-6R
nodes.description: IL-6R (CD126) is the ligand-binding subunit of the IL-6 receptor complex and has no intrinsic enzymatic activity. IL-6 binds IL-6R at site I, the binary complex then recruits gp130 at site II to form a 2:2:2 hexamer, and gp130 dimerization brings JAK1, JAK2 and TYK2 together to phosphorylate STAT3.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-6R（CD126）是 IL-6 受體複合體的配體結合次單元，本身不具酵素活性。IL-6 先在 site I 與 IL-6R 結合，該二元複合體再於 site II 招募 gp130 形成 2:2:2 六聚體，gp130 二聚化使 JAK1、JAK2 與 TYK2 聚集並使 STAT3 磷酸化。

nodes.label: UV-induced photoaging
nodes.description: Singlet oxygen mediates UV-induced photoaging because UVA radiation excites endogenous photosensitizers (e.g., porphyrins, flavins) in skin, producing 1O2 that induces matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression. MMPs degrade collagen and elastin, producing wrinkles, laxity, and solar elastosis. The directionality is photon to radical to enzyme to matrix destruction. A caveat is that UVA also generates other ROS and activates signaling pathways independently, so singlet oxygen is one contributor among several in photoaging.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Singlet oxygen 介導 UV-induced photoaging，因為 UVA 輻射會激發皮膚中的內源性光敏劑（例如卟啉、黃素），產生 1O2，誘導基質金屬蛋白酶 (MMP) 表現。 MMP 會降解膠原蛋白和彈性蛋白，產生皺紋、鬆弛和日光性彈性組織變性。方向性是光子到自由基到酵素到基質破壞。需要注意的是，UVA 也會產生其他 ROS 並獨立活化訊號通路，因此 singlet oxygen 是 photoaging 中的幾個貢獻者之一。

nodes.label: Prostate Cancer
nodes.description: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

nodes.label: Liposomes
nodes.description: Liposomes are one of the principal nanoplatforms of pharmaceutical nanotechnology, used alongside polymeric nanoparticles, nanoemulsions (including SNEDDS), nanocrystals, and cyclodextrin inclusion complexes to improve delivery of poorly soluble compounds.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 微脂體是藥物奈米科技的主要奈米平台之一，與聚合物奈米顆粒、奈米乳化液（含 SNEDDS）、奈米晶體及環糊精包含複合體並用，以改善難溶性化合物的輸送。

nodes.label: p15INK4b
nodes.description: p15INK4b specifically binds and inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, preventing cyclin D-CDK complex formation and Rb phosphorylation. This enforces a G1 cell-cycle block that is central to paracrine and oncogene-induced senescence, and its action parallels p16INK4a, providing redundant CDK inhibition. The inhibition is direct and is a canonical mechanism of the INK4 family of CDK inhibitors. By maintaining hypophosphorylated Rb, p15 keeps E2F transcription factors sequestered and silences S-phase genes, ensuring durable arrest.
nodes.description_zh_TW: p15INK4b 特異結合並抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，防止 cyclin D-CDK 複合體形成與 Rb 磷酸化。這強制對旁分泌與致癌基因誘發衰老至為核心的 G1 細胞週期封鎖，且其作用與 p16INK4a 平行，提供冗餘 CDK 抑制。此抑制直接，且是 INK4 家族 CDK 抑制因子的典型機制。透過維持低磷酸化 Rb，p15 使 E2F 轉錄因子隔離並靜默 S 期基因，確保持久停滯。

nodes.label: IL-4
nodes.description: IL-4 binding to IL-4Rα activates JAK1 and JAK3, which phosphorylate STAT6; STAT6 then drives GATA3, CCL17, CCL22 and MUC5AC transcription, defining the type 2 immune program. IL-13 uses the same IL-4Rα subunit and STAT6 axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IL-4 與 IL-4Rα 結合後活化 JAK1 與 JAK3，進而使 STAT6 磷酸化；STAT6 隨後驅動 GATA3、CCL17、CCL22 與 MUC5AC 的轉錄，定義第二型免疫程式。IL-13 使用相同的 IL-4Rα 次單元與 STAT6 軸。

nodes.label: MEK1_2
nodes.description: MEK1/2 are critical mediators of cell proliferation, differentiation and survival downstream of receptor tyrosine kinases, which makes them validated therapeutic targets in BRAF-mutant melanoma and neurofibromatosis type 1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MEK1/2 是受體酪胺酸激酶下游調節細胞增殖、分化與存活的重要中介，因此它們是 BRAF 突變黑色素瘤與第一型神經纖維瘤病中已獲驗證的治療標的。

nodes.label: Induced Neural Stem Cells
nodes.description: Direct lineage reprogramming converts somatic cells into induced neural stem cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 直接譜系重編程將體細胞轉化為誘導神經幹細胞。

nodes.label: Sestrin2
nodes.description: Sestrin2 is a stress-inducible leucine sensor and oxidoreductase that inhibits mTORC1 by binding GATOR2 in the absence of leucine. Because GATOR2 is part of the GATOR1 complex that relays amino acid availability to Rag GTPases, Sestrin2 acts as the low-leucine signal that releases the brake on mTORC1.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sestrin2 是可被壓力誘發的亮胺酸感測蛋白與氧化還原酶，在缺乏亮胺酸時藉由結合 GATOR2 抑制 mTORC1。由於 GATOR2 是將胺基酸可用性傳遞給 Rag GTP 酶之 GATOR1 複合體的一部分，Sestrin2 便扮演低亮胺酸訊號，解除對 mTORC1 的煞車。

nodes.label: S-Nitrosoglutathione Reductase
nodes.description: S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (GSNOR, also ADH5) catalyzes the reduction and denitrosylation of S-nitrosoglutathione (GSNO), thereby controlling the size of the GSNO pool available for protein S-nitrosylation. Losing GSNOR activity lets S-nitrosylation of substrate proteins persist and intensify, so GSNOR is the principal brake on cellular protein S-nitrosylation levels.
nodes.description_zh_TW: S-亞硝基麩胱甘肽還原酶（GSNOR，又稱 ADH5）催化 S-亞硝基麩胱甘肽（GSNO）的還原與去亞硝基化，藉此控制可供蛋白質 S-亞硝基化使用的 GSNO 池大小。GSNOR 活性喪失會使受質蛋白的 S-亞硝基化持續並加劇，因此 GSNOR 是細胞蛋白 S-亞硝基化程度的主要煞車。

nodes.label: Klotho
nodes.description: Klotho is a transmembrane protein with a shed, hormone-like extracellular domain that acts as an anti-aging factor: loss-of-function accelerates aging, while elevated Klotho extends lifespan in mice. It regulates mTOR/insulin-IGF signalling and phosphate and vitamin D metabolism, placing it on a shared axis with mTORC1 control and stem-cell homeostasis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Klotho 是一種跨膜蛋白，具有可被剪切釋放、具有荷爾蒙樣特性的胞外結構域，作為抗衰老因子發揮作用：功能喪失會加速衰老，而 Klotho 水平升高則可延長小鼠壽命。它調節 mTOR／胰島素-IGF 訊號以及磷與維生素 D 代謝，因而位於與 mTORC1 調控和幹細胞恆定共享的同一條軸上。

nodes.label: DNA Hypomethylation
nodes.description: LINE-1 retrotransposons are derepressed by DNA hypomethylation, since methylation of L1 promoters normally keeps these elements transcriptionally silent. Age-related global loss of DNA methylation, especially at repetitive elements, relieves this silencing and allows LINE-1 transcription and retrotransposition. The resulting L1 cDNA accumulates in the cytoplasm, where it activates the cGAS-STING pathway and contributes to the chronic inflammation and SASP that characterize aging. Restoring methylation at L1 promoters re-silences these elements, confirming the causal role of hypomethylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座子因 DNA 低甲基化而被去抑制，因為 L1 啟動子的甲基化通常會使這些元件保持轉錄沉默。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化整體喪失，尤其是重複元件，可以緩解這種沉默並允許 LINE-1 轉錄和逆轉錄轉座。由此產生的 L1 cDNA 在細胞質中積累，激活 cGAS-STING 通路並導致慢性發炎和表徵衰老的 SASP。恢復 L1 啟動子的甲基化會使這些元件重新沉默，證實了低甲基化的因果作用。

nodes.label: Senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways
nodes.description: Senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis because they upregulate Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs), including Bcl-2 family pro-survival proteins and the PI3K/Akt axis. Different senescent cell types rely on different SCAPs, which is why no single senolytic clears all senescent cells — and why SCAP-targeting drugs such as Fisetin, D+Q, and Navitoclax show cell-type selectivity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞因上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs，包括 Bcl-2 家族促存活蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 軸）而抵抗細胞凋亡。不同衰老細胞類型依賴不同的 SCAPs，因此沒有任何單一 senolytic 能清除所有衰老細胞——這也是為何攻擊 SCAPs 的藥物如 Fisetin、D+Q 與 Navitoclax 呈現細胞類型選擇性的原因。

nodes.label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
nodes.description: Germline loss-of-function mutations in STK11 (LKB1) cause Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, characterized by hamartomatous polyps and elevated cancer risk. Directionally, LKB1 deficiency sits upstream of this cancer predisposition. This highlights LKB1 as a critical tumor suppressor and metabolic regulator, and its connection to AMPK and sirtuin axes explains the metabolic features of the syndrome. Because LKB1 loss compromises AMPK activation, cells fail to properly sense energy stress, promoting growth and genomic instability. The syndrome illustrates the clinical importance of the LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin network.
nodes.description_zh_TW: STK11（LKB1）的生殖系功能缺失突變導致 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，其特徵為錯構瘤性息肉和癌症風險增加。在方向性上，LKB1 缺陷位於此癌症易感性的上游。這突顯了 LKB1 作為關鍵腫瘤抑制因子和代謝調節因子的地位，其與 AMPK 和 sirtuin 軸線的聯繫解釋了該綜合症的代謝特徵。由於 LKB1 的缺失損害 AMPK 活化，細胞無法正確感知能量壓力，促進生長和基因組不穩定。該綜合症說明了 LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin 網絡的臨床重要性。

nodes.label: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens
nodes.description: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens, an Eggerthellaceae gut anaerobe, metabolizes dietary Ellagic Acid as the principal upstream converter in the urolithin pathway, generating intermediate urolithins (M5/D/C) that downstream consortium members finish to Urolithin A; its carriage underpins metabotype A converter status.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 為 Eggerthellaceae 腸道厭氧菌，是 urolithin 途徑的主要上游轉換者，代謝飲食 Ellagic Acid 產生中間 urolithins（M5/D/C），再由下游菌叢完成為 Urolithin A；其攜帶與否決定 metabotype A 轉換者身分。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

nodes.label: Cyanosis
nodes.description: Because the ferric hemoglobin produced in blue baby syndrome cannot bind oxygen, affected infants develop cyanosis — the characteristic blue discolouration of skin and mucous membranes that gives the syndrome its name.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 由於 Blue baby syndrome 中生成的三價 Hemoglobin 無法結合氧氣，受影響的嬰兒會出現 Cyanosis——也就是皮膚與黏膜特有的發藍變色，此即此症候群名稱的由來。

nodes.label: AGE-1
nodes.description: AGE-1 is the C. elegans class-I PI3K catalytic subunit downstream of the DAF-2 insulin/IGF-1 receptor; reduced AGE-1 signalling derepresses DAF-16/FOXO and extends Lifespan. The age-1(hx546) mutant was among the first single-gene longevity mutants.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AGE-1 是 C. elegans 的第一類 PI3K 催化次單元，位於 DAF-2 胰島素/IGF-1 受體下游；AGE-1 訊號下降會解除對 DAF-16/FOXO 的抑制並延長 Lifespan。age-1(hx546) 突變株是最早的單基因長壽突變株之一。

nodes.label: Metastatic colonization
nodes.description: Metastatic colonization — the survival, persistence, and proliferation of disseminated cancer cells into macroscopic lesions at a distant organ — is the final, least efficient, most rate-limiting phase of Metastasis. Disseminated tumor cells can remain quiescent in tissues for up to 20 years before re-entering the cell cycle to initiate colonization when conditions favor proliferation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Metastatic colonization——即播散的癌細胞於遠端器官存活、持續並增殖形成巨觀病灶——是 Metastasis 的最後一步，也是效率最低、速率限制最強的階段。播散腫瘤細胞可在組織中維持靜止最長達 20 年，直到條件有利於增殖時才重新進入細胞週期並啟動定殖。

nodes.label: DdCBE
nodes.description: DddA-derived cytosine base editors target mitochondrial DNA, catalysing C-to-T conversions without introducing double-strand breaks. A split DddA cytidine deaminase, each half fused to a TALE array targeting opposite strands, reassembles its active site on adjacent target sites and so confines editing to the chosen mitochondrial locus.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DddA-derived cytosine base editors 以 mitochondrial DNA 為標的，在不產生雙股斷裂的情況下催化 C 轉 T。被切開的 DddA cytidine deaminase 兩半各自融合針對相反股鏈的 TALE 陣列，在相鄰標的位點重新組裝出活性位點，因而將編輯限制在所選定的粒線體位點。

nodes.label: Matrix Metalloproteinase
nodes.description: MMP-12 (matrix metalloproteinase-12, also called macrophage metalloelastase or MME) is a zinc-dependent endopeptidase of the matrix metalloproteinase family, secreted predominantly by tissue macrophages. It is synthesised as an inactive zymogen and activated extracellularly by serine proteases such as plasmin or by other MMPs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MMP-12（基質金屬蛋白酶-12，又稱巨噬細胞金屬彈性蛋白酶或 MME）是基質金屬蛋白酶家族的鋅依賴性內肽酶，主要由組織巨噬細胞分泌。它先以無活性的酶原形式合成，再由胞外的血清蛋白酶（如 plasmin）或其他 MMP 活化。

nodes.label: Dominant Optic Atrophy
nodes.description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

nodes.label: cDNA
nodes.description: RNA-seq libraries are built by reverse transcription of RNA into complementary DNA (cDNA) before adapter ligation and PCR amplification. cDNA synthesis is therefore the required intermediate that converts RNA abundance into a sequenceable, amplifiable library for high-throughput sequencing.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNA-seq 文庫是先把 RNA 逆轉錄為互補 DNA (cDNA)，再進行接頭連接與 PCR 擴增而建立。因此 cDNA 合成是必要的中間步驟，將 RNA 豐度轉為可定序、可擴增的文庫，以供高通量定序。

nodes.label: Glucose Intolerance
nodes.description: Chronic rapamycin treatment is associated with metabolic disturbances including glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia in both mice and humans administered rapamycin for prevention of immunosenescence. Mechanistically these effects are attributed not only to mTORC1 inhibition but also to unintended suppression of mTORC2, which induces insulin resistance - a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. Houde et al. showed chronic rapamycin causes glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia by upregulating hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairing lipid deposition in adipose tissue.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin治療與代謝紊亂相關，包括在rapamycin給藥以預防免疫老化的兩者小鼠和人類中的葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。從機制上講，這些效應不僅歸因於mTORC1抑制，還歸因於意外抑制mTORC2，這會誘發胰島素阻抗——這是代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。Houde等人顯示慢性rapamycin透過上調肝臟糖質新生和損害脂肪組織中的脂質沉積來引起葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

nodes.label: G6PD deficiency
nodes.description: G6PD deficiency is an inherited loss of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase that compromises the ability of Erythrocytes to handle Oxidative Stress, so affected individuals hemolyze on exposure to oxidant triggers including Methylene blue and dapsone hydroxylamine. Methylene blue is therefore contraindicated or must be used with caution in G6PD-deficient patients being treated for Methemoglobinemia, and ascorbic acid is often preferred as the safer alternative.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G6PD deficiency 是 glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase 的遺傳性缺失，使 Erythrocytes 無法有效應付 Oxidative Stress，因此患者在接觸 Methylene blue 與 dapsone hydroxylamine 等氧化性觸發物時會發生溶血。因此在治療 Methemoglobinemia 時，Methylene blue 對 G6PD 缺乏者屬禁忌或需謹慎使用，而 ascorbic acid 常被作為較安全的替代方案。

nodes.label: G6PD
nodes.description: G6PD occupies the rate-limiting position in the pentose phosphate pathway, the oxidative branch that generates NADPH for reductive biosynthesis and glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense.
nodes.description_zh_TW: G6PD 在 pentose phosphate pathway 中占據限速位置；該途徑的氧化分支產生 NADPH，供還原性生合成與 glutathione 依賴的抗氧化防禦使用。

nodes.label: FADD
nodes.description: TNFR1 complex II contains FADD, which is recruited after CYLD-mediated deubiquitination of RIPK1 releases the TRADD–RIPK1 heterodimer from the membrane. Together with procaspase-8/Caspase-10 and c-FLIP isoforms, FADD builds a soluble DISC-like platform through DED–DED interactions exactly as in the death-inducing signaling complex, making complex II its cytosolic architectural cousin.
nodes.description_zh_TW: TNFR1 complex II 含有 FADD；它在 CYLD 媒介的 RIPK1 去泛素化使 TRADD–RIPK1 異二聚體自膜釋放之後被招募。FADD 與 procaspase-8/Caspase-10 及 c-FLIP 各異構體一起，透過 DED–DED 交互作用建構出可溶性的類 DISC 平台，其架構與死亡誘導訊號複合體完全相同，使 complex II 成為後者的細胞質架構近親。

nodes.label: Canakinumab
nodes.description: Canakinumab (Ilaris) is a human monoclonal antibody that binds free IL-1β with high affinity and prevents it from engaging the IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP complex, without affecting IL-1α or other IL-1 family members — making it more selective than anakinra, which blocks both ligands. By neutralizing extracellular IL-1β it inhibits MyD88-dependent signaling, reducing NF-κB activation and transcription of IL-6, TNFα and COX-2. The long-acting antibody (half-life ~26 days) is dosed subcutaneously and is degraded proteolytically without CYP-mediated metabolism.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Canakinumab（Ilaris）是一種人類單株抗體，以高親和力結合游離 IL-1β，阻止其與 IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP 受體複合體接合，且不影響 IL-1α 或其他 IL-1 家族成員——因此比同時阻斷兩者的 anakinra 更具選擇性。藉由中和胞外 IL-1β，它抑制 MyD88 依賴的訊號，減少 NF-κB 活化以及 IL-6、TNFα、COX-2 的轉錄。此長效抗體（半衰期約 26 天）以皮下注射給藥，經蛋白水解分解代謝，不經 CYP 代謝。

nodes.label: Hexokinase-1
nodes.description: Hexokinase-1 (HK1) catalyzes the first regulatory step of Glycolysis: ATP-dependent phosphorylation of glucose to glucose-6-phosphate. It docks to outer-mitochondrial VDAC, coupling cytosolic glycolysis to Oxidative Phosphorylation, and the glucose-6-phosphate it generates also feeds the pentose phosphate pathway to supply NADPH and glutathione.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Hexokinase-1（HK1）催化 Glycolysis 的第一個調控步驟：以 ATP 依賴方式將葡萄糖磷酸化為葡萄糖-6-磷酸。它停靠於粒線體外膜的 VDAC，把細胞質的糖解作用與 Oxidative Phosphorylation 耦聯，而所產生的葡萄糖-6-磷酸同時供應磷酸戊糖途徑以產生 NADPH 與穀胱甘肽。

nodes.label: Complex IV
nodes.description: Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) is the terminal enzyme of the mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain, receiving electrons from reduced Cytochrome c and reducing molecular oxygen to water. It is the ultimate electron sink of aerobic respiration and a major determinant of Oxidative Phosphorylation capacity.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Complex IV（cytochrome c oxidase）是粒線體 Electron Transport Chain 的末端酵素，接受還原態 Cytochrome c 的電子並將分子氧還原成水。它是有氧呼吸的最終電子受體，也是決定 Oxidative Phosphorylation 能力的主要因素。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

nodes.label: AICAR
nodes.description: AICAR-driven AMPK activation promotes Mitochondrial Biogenesis partly through PGC-1α, upregulating catabolic pathways such as Fatty acid oxidation and GLUT4 translocation. This has made AICAR a widely used 'exercise mimetic'.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AICAR 引發的 AMPK 活化會部分透過 PGC-1α 促進 Mitochondrial Biogenesis，並上調脂肪酸氧化與 GLUT4 轉位等分解代謝途徑。這使 AICAR 成為廣泛使用的「運動模擬劑」。

nodes.label: vFLIP
nodes.description: KSHV vFLIP occupies the same NEMO binding site as p22-FLIP, hard-wiring infected cells to constitutive NF-kappaB survival. This viral mimicry explains the functional interchangeability of the two and shows how a viral protein can hijack the FADD-independent FLIP fragment axis.
nodes.description_zh_TW: KSHV 的 vFLIP 佔據與 p22-FLIP 相同的 NEMO 結合位點，將受感染細胞硬接成構成性的 NF-κB 存活狀態。這種病毒擬態解釋了兩者的功能可互換性，也顯示病毒蛋白如何劫持不依賴 FADD 的 FLIP 片段軸。

nodes.label: Topoisomerase
nodes.description: Topoisomerases normally manage DNA supercoiling and topological stress during replication, transcription and repair by transiently cleaving one (topoisomerase I) or both (topoisomerase II) DNA strands, passing another strand through the break, and religating. Inhibiting them with fisetin or quercetin prevents religation and converts the enzyme from a guardian into a source of DNA damage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Topoisomerase 正常情況下藉由暫時切割一股（topoisomerase I）或兩股（topoisomerase II）DNA、讓另一股穿越斷口再重新接合，來處理複製、轉錄與修復過程中的 DNA 超捲曲與拓撲壓力。以 fisetin 或 quercetin 抑制它們會阻斷再接合，使酵素由守護者轉為 DNA 損傷的來源。

nodes.label: MID49
nodes.description: MID49 regulates fission in a bidirectional, dose-dependent way: low MID49 levels enhance fission by allowing efficient DRP1 recruitment, whereas overexpression paradoxically elongates mitochondria by sequestering inactive DRP1 in a non-productive complex.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MID49 以雙向、劑量依賴的方式調控分裂：MID49 濃度低時可促進 DRP1 有效招募而增強分裂；過量表現反而會以非生產性複合體困住失活的 DRP1，使粒線體延長。

nodes.label: Sphingosine
nodes.description: Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) is a phosphorylated derivative of sphingosine: sphingosine kinases add a phosphate to the amino alcohol backbone, converting Sphingosine into S1P. The note places Sphingosine as the immediate metabolic precursor of S1P, and S1P as the bioactive endpoint of the sphingosine arm of the ceramide/sphingosine/S1P rheostat.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) 是 sphingosine 的磷酸化衍生物：sphingosine kinase 將磷酸基加到該胺基醇骨架上，把 Sphingosine 轉換為 S1P。此筆記將 Sphingosine 列為 S1P 的直接代謝前驅物，而 S1P 則是 ceramide/sphingosine/S1P 恆定器中 sphingosine 支的生物活性終點。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

nodes.label: FIS1
nodes.description: FIS1 overexpression increases mitochondrial fragmentation, leading to dysfunction and increased autophagosome formation, whereas OPA1 and MFN1 promote fusion and functionally oppose FIS1. Mammalian cells lacking FIS1 show little or no fission defect, so its role is far less significant in mammalian cells than in yeast.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FIS1 過度表現會增加粒線體碎裂，造成功能障礙與 autophagosome 形成增加；相對地，OPA1 與 MFN1 促進融合，功能上與 FIS1 相反。缺乏 FIS1 的哺乳類細胞幾乎沒有 fission 缺陷，因此 FIS1 在哺乳類細胞中的重要性遠低於酵母。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

nodes.label: OGG1
nodes.description: OGG1 repairs 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine as a bifunctional DNA glycosylase that excises the damaged base and cleaves the backbone, initiating base-excision repair that liberates free 8-oxodG. This prevents the lesion from mispairing with adenine during replication. The directionality is lesion to repair pathway. A caveat is that OGG1's role in processing 8-oxodG is most critical in nuclear DNA, while mitochondrial isoforms handle mtDNA damage with somewhat different kinetics. OGG1 also releases the free 8-oxodG into urine, which is why urinary levels of the lesion report both damage and active repair.
nodes.description_zh_TW: OGG1 作為雙功能 DNA 糖基化酶修復 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine，切除受損鹼基並切割主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復，釋放遊離 8-oxodG。這可以防止複製過程中病變與腺嘌呤錯配。方向性是損傷修復途徑。需要注意的是，OGG1 在核子 DNA 中處理 8-oxodG 的作用最為關鍵，而 mitochondria1 亞型以有些不同的動力學處理 mtDNA damage。 OGG1 也將遊離的 8-oxodG 釋放到尿液中，這就是為什麼病變的尿液水平報告損傷和主動修復的原因。

nodes.label: CXCL5
nodes.description: AP-1 transactivates CXCL5 (a SASP chemokine), which feeds inflammaging. Caloric restriction suppresses inflammaging and activates autophagy via mTOR/AMPK.
nodes.description_zh_TW: AP-1 轉活化 CXCL5（一種 SASP 趨化因子），促成發炎性老化（inflammaging）。熱量限制可抑制發炎性老化，並透過 mTOR/AMPK 活化自噬。

nodes.label: Glutaminolysis
nodes.description: Glutaminolysis feeds the TCA cycle with anaplerotic carbon at the alpha-ketoglutarate node. It is the dominant anaplerotic route in rapidly proliferating cancer cells, and blocking it together with Complex I collapses the glutamine-fueled cycle in MYC-high breast cancer cells.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutaminolysis 在 alpha-ketoglutarate 節點以 anaplerotic 碳供應 TCA cycle。在快速增殖的癌細胞中它是主要的 anaplerotic 途徑；在 MYC-high 乳癌細胞中，與 Complex I 一起阻斷即可瓦解 glutamine 驅動的 cycle。

nodes.label: GATE-16
nodes.description: GATE-16 (GABARAPL2) is a Golgi-associated member of the Atg8 protein family, involved in intra-Golgi transport as well as Autophagy. It is conjugated to autophagosomal membranes similarly to LC3 and GABARAP.
nodes.description_zh_TW: GATE-16（GABARAPL2）是 Atg8 蛋白家族中與 Golgi 關聯的成員，參與 Golgi 內運輸以及 Autophagy。它與 LC3 及 GABARAP 類似地被接附到 autophagosome 膜上。

nodes.label: MCPIP1
nodes.description: MCPIP1 (Regnase-1/ZC3H12A) alleviates inflammatory responses by promoting SIRT1 expression through modulation of miR-9. MCPIP1 sits upstream of increased SIRT1, and the higher SIRT1 then suppresses NF-κB-driven inflammation, creating an anti-inflammatory circuit centred on SIRT1 induction — a non-enzymatic route to modulating NAD+-dependent deacetylation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: MCPIP1（Regnase-1/ZC3H12A）透過調節 miR-9 促進 SIRT1 表現，進而緩解發炎反應。MCPIP1 位於 SIRT1 上升的上游，而較高的 SIRT1 會抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 inflammation，形成以 SIRT1 誘導為中心的抗發炎迴路——這是一條調控 NAD+ 相關去乙醯化的非酵素途徑。

nodes.label: Caspase-6
nodes.description: Caspase-6 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase particularly important for cleavage of nuclear lamins and the structural collapse of the nucleus. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death.
