The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-6, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-6 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-6 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-6 是一種劊子手半胱天冬酶，對於核纖層蛋白的裂解和細胞核的結構崩潰特別重要。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-6，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-6 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

nodes.label: IRAK1
nodes.description: IRAK1 is a serine/threonine kinase downstream of IL-1R and TLR receptors that propagates MyD88-dependent signaling to NF-kB and MAPKs. Apigenin suppresses the SASP partly by inhibiting IL-1alpha signaling via IRAK1, IRAK4, p38 MAPK, and NF-kB.
nodes.description_zh_TW: IRAK1 是 IL-1R 與 TLR 受體下游的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，傳播 MyD88 依賴訊號至 NF-κB 與 MAPK。Apigenin 部分透過經 IRAK1、IRAK4、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB 抑制 IL-1α 訊號來壓制 SASP。

nodes.label: Proteotoxicity
nodes.description: Proteotoxicity — proteotoxic stress from misfolded and aggregated proteins — accumulates as neurodegenerative disease progresses, with rising levels of misfolded proteins and peptides. The process is regulated by nutrient sensors, stress pathways and hormonal signals, and its impairment is linked to metabolic disease, neurodegeneration and cancer.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Proteotoxicity（由錯誤摺疊與聚集蛋白造成的蛋白毒性壓力）會隨著 neurodegenerative disease 進展而累積，錯誤摺疊蛋白與胜肽的量持續上升。此過程受營養感測器、壓力路徑與荷爾蒙訊號調控，其失調則與代謝疾病、神經退化與癌症相關。

nodes.label: Matrix Metalloproteinases
nodes.description: Matrix metalloproteinases are calcium-dependent, zinc-containing endopeptidases responsible for degradation and remodeling of extracellular matrix components. MMP-1 and MMP-2 act on collagen that has been stiffened and crosslinked by advanced glycation end products, and under high-AGE conditions MMP expression and activity become dysregulated, contributing to pathological remodeling and vascular complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Matrix Metalloproteinases 是鈣依賴性、含鋅的內肽酶，負責細胞外基質成分的降解與重塑。MMP-1 與 MMP-2 作用於已被 advanced glycation end products 硬化並交聯的 collagen；在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 的表現與活性會失調，造成病理性重塑與血管併發症。

nodes.label: BNIP3L
nodes.description: BNIP3L expression is transcriptionally upregulated under hypoxia through HIF-1α stabilization, linking oxygen sensing to mitophagy induction; the same induction occurs in erythroid precursors, where BNIP3L drives programmed mitochondrial elimination during erythroblast maturation, and NIX knockout mice develop anemia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: BNIP3L 的表現在缺氧下經由 HIF-1α 穩定化而轉錄上調，將氧氣感測連結到自噬誘導；同樣的誘導也發生在紅血球前驅細胞，BNIP3L 在此驅動紅血球母細胞成熟時的程式性粒線體消除，而 NIX 敲除小鼠會出現貧血。

nodes.label: Methylglyoxal (MG)
nodes.description: Methylglyoxal is a highly reactive α-oxoaldehyde generated mainly as a side product of glycolysis from triose phosphates; unchecked, it glycates proteins, lipids and DNA to form advanced glycation end-products, contributing to oxidative stress and diabetic complications.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Methylglyoxal 是高度反應性的 α-氧醛，主要由糖解作用中的三碳糖磷酸副產物生成；若未受控制，它會對蛋白質、脂質與 DNA 進行糖化，形成 advanced glycation end-products，促成氧化壓力與糖尿病併發症。

nodes.label: Flavan-3-ols
nodes.description: Flavan-3-ols (flavanols) are a subclass of flavonoids with a 2-phenyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-3-ol skeleton and a hydroxyl at C3. Unlike most flavonoids they are non-glycosylated and lack a C2=C3 double bond in the C-ring, and they exist as monomers (catechins, epicatechins and their gallates such as EGCG) that polymerize via B-type and A-type bonds into proanthocyanidins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Flavan-3-ols（flavanols）是 flavonoids 的次類，具有 2-phenyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-3-ol 骨架且 C3 帶有羥基。與多數 flavonoid 不同，它們不經糖基化且 C 環缺少 C2=C3 雙鍵，並以單體（catechins、epicatechins 及其 gallate 酯如 EGCG）形式存在，再經 B 型與 A 型鍵聚合成 proanthocyanidins。

nodes.label: Thioredoxin-2
nodes.description: Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reduced back to its active form by thioredoxin-2 (Trx2), which donates electrons to re-reduce the disulfide formed at its peroxidatic cysteine. Trx2 is in turn regenerated by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, sustaining the matrix peroxide-removal cycle.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）由硫氧還蛋白-2 (Trx2) 還原回其活化形式，Trx2 提供電子以重新還原其過氧化半胱氨酸處形成的雙硫鍵。Trx2 再由粒線體硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，以維持基質過氧化氫清除循環。

nodes.label: Adipose Tissue
nodes.description: Adipose Tissue is a major endocrine organ, and its adipocytes secrete Leptin to signal satiety and energy stores to the brain, alongside Adiponectin, free fatty acids, and numerous cytokines. Leptin secretion rises with fat mass and is a key feedback signal in energy-balance regulation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Adipose Tissue 是重要的內分泌器官，其脂肪細胞分泌 Leptin 向腦部傳遞飽足感與能量儲存的訊號，並同時分泌 Adiponectin、游離脂肪酸與多種細胞激素。Leptin 的分泌隨脂肪量上升，是能量平衡調節中的關鍵回饋訊號。

nodes.label: H-NMR
nodes.description: H-NMR (proton nuclear magnetic resonance) determines the structure of organic molecules and is the primary method, alongside Mass Spectrometry, for verifying the molecular structure and purity of synthesized intermediates such as Leuco-adrenochrome. The Certificate of Analysis supplied with purchased material usually specifies the purity and the verification method used, since synthetic batches can readily degrade if handled improperly.
nodes.description_zh_TW: H-NMR（proton 核磁共振）用於判定有機分子的結構，是與 Mass Spectrometry 並列、驗證 Leuco-adrenochrome 等合成中間體分子結構與純度的主要方法。購買材料時隨附的 Certificate of Analysis 通常會註明純度與所用的驗證方法，因為合成批次若處理不當很容易降解。

nodes.label: Quality Control
nodes.description: A Certificate of Analysis is the document by which Quality Assurance confirms that a regulated product meets its product specification. In a research setting it plays the same role for chemical reagents that batch-release testing plays for pharmaceuticals.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Certificate of Analysis 是品質保證部門確認受規管產品符合產品規格的文件。在研究情境中，它對化學試劑所扮演的角色，與批次放行測試對藥品所扮演的角色相同。

nodes.label: CaMKII
nodes.description: CaMKII phosphorylates caspase-2 on Ser135 — distinct from the Ser164 site regulated by CaMKII in the metabolic context — rendering the apical caspase inactive. This phosphorylation is itself shielded by 14-3-3ζ binding, and the shield's integrity depends on the acetylation state of 14-3-3ζ, which SIRT1 controls. The system layers a phospho-switch (CaMKII/Ser135) on top of an acetyl-switch (SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49), so nutrient-driven PPP flux ultimately decides whether caspase-2 stays suppressed.
nodes.description_zh_TW: CaMKII 會將 caspase-2 的 Ser135 磷酸化——與其在代謝脈絡中調控的 Ser164 位點不同——使頂端 caspase 處於不活化狀態。此磷酸化本身又被 14-3-3ζ 的結合所保護，而保護罩的完整性取決於 SIRT1 所控制的 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化狀態。整個系統在乙醯開關（SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49）之上再疊加磷酸開關（CaMKII/Ser135），因此養分驅動的 PPP 通量最終決定 caspase-2 是否維持被抑制。

nodes.label: ABT-263
nodes.description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
nodes.description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

nodes.label: C9orf72
nodes.description: C9orf72 repeat expansions are the most common genetic cause of familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, producing loss of function, repeat-associated non-AUG translation of dipeptide-repeat proteins, and nuclear RNA foci.
nodes.description_zh_TW: C9orf72 的重複擴增是家族性 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 與 fronto-temporal dementia 最常見的遺傳病因，會造成功能喪失、重複相關的非 AUG 轉譯產生二胜肽重複蛋白，以及核內 RNA  foci。

nodes.label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
nodes.description: Smac DIABLO is a pro-apoptotic mitochondrial protein whose principal function is to neutralize Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol during apoptosis, it binds the BIR3 domain of XIAP, cIAP1 and cIAP2 through its exposed N-terminal AVPI IAP-binding motif, displacing Caspase-9 and Caspase-3/Caspase-7 from IAP inhibition and allowing the caspase cascade to run to completion.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Smac DIABLO 是一個促凋亡的粒線體蛋白，其主要功能是中和 Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins。凋亡時它由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，透過暴露的 N 端 AVPI IAP-binding motif 結合 XIAP、cIAP1 與 cIAP2 的 BIR3 結構域，將 Caspase-9 與 Caspase-3/Caspase-7 從 IAP 抑制中置換出來，使 caspase 级聯得以完整進行。

nodes.label: Thioglycerol
nodes.description: Thioglycerol is a sulfite-free alternative to the conventional sulfite preservative Sodium Metabisulfite in epinephrine formulations. Replacing sulfites with thiol stabilizers reduces allergenicity while preserving catecholamine stability, since sulfites can provoke hypersensitivity and complicate stability profiles.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Thioglycerol 是 Epinephrine 製劑中傳統亞硫酸鹽防腐劑 Sodium Metabisulfite 的無亞硫酸鹽替代方案。以硫醇類穩定劑取代亞硫酸鹽可在維持兒茶酚胺穩定性的同時降低過敏原性，因為亞硫酸鹽可能引發過敏反應並使穩定性資料更複雜。

nodes.label: Retrograde Signaling
nodes.description: Mitochondria communicate stress to the nucleus through retrograde signaling pathways. In yeast this involves the Rtg1/Rtg3 transcription factors, whose activation extends replicative lifespan; in mammals the retrograde response involves calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation and may include the Retinoid X receptor alpha, PGC-1alpha, JNK, and ROS generation. Mitochondrial perturbations such as mtDNA deletion, respiratory chain inhibition, misfolded matrix proteins, or stalled ribosomes all elicit coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression that reconfigure metabolism and induce cytoprotective programs.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 通過 retrograde signaling pathways 與細胞核溝通壓力。在 yeast 中，這涉及 Rtg1/Rtg3 轉錄因子，其激活可延長 replicative lifespan；在 mammals 中，retrograde response 涉及 calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation 且可能包括 Retinoid X receptor alpha、PGC-1alpha、JNK 和 ROS 生成。Mitochondrial perturbations 如 mtDNA deletion、respiratory chain inhibition、misfolded matrix proteins 或 stalled ribosomes 都會引發 coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression，重新配置代謝並誘導 cytoprotective programs。

nodes.label: 5xFAD
nodes.description: 5xFAD is a transgenic mouse model that co-expresses five familial Alzheimer's Disease mutations in APP and PSEN1, driving aggressive, early-onset Amyloid Beta plaque deposition. It reproduces amyloid pathology faithfully but with accelerated phenotypes relative to late-onset human disease.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 5xFAD 是轉殖小鼠模型，共表達 APP 與 PSEN1 上五個家族性 Alzheimer's Disease 突變，造成侵襲性、早發的 Amyloid Beta 斑塊沉積。它能忠實重現類澱粉樣病變，但表型相較於晚發型人類疾病更為加速。

nodes.label: Glutamic Acid Decarboxylase
nodes.description: Glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) catalyzes the decarboxylation of glutamate to synthesize GABA, the principal inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. It exists as two isoforms, GAD65 and GAD67; GAD67 is constitutively active and maintains basal GABA levels, whereas GAD65 supplies GABA for regulated release.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase（GAD）催化 glutamate 的去羧化反應以合成 GABA——腦部主要的抑制性神經傳遞物質。GAD 有兩種同功型 GAD65 與 GAD67；GAD67 為組成性活性、維持基礎 GABA 濃度，GAD65 則供應受調控釋放所需的 GABA。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: Fructose
nodes.description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

nodes.label: miR-137
nodes.description: In melanoma, miR-137 negatively regulates ferroptosis by directly targeting the glutamine transporter SLC1A5: knockdown of miR-137 promotes ferroptosis, whereas its presence protects melanoma cells from iron-dependent death. Because SLC1A5 is itself ferroptosis-protective in this context, loss of miR-137 raises glutamine import, GSH supply and antioxidant defence, increasing ferroptotic resistance.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 在 melanoma 中，miR-137 藉由直接標定麩醯胺酸轉運蛋白 SLC1A5 而負向調節 ferroptosis：miR-137 的敲除會促進 ferroptosis，而其存在則保護 melanoma 細胞免於鐵依賴性死亡。由於 SLC1A5 在此脈絡下本身具有保護作用，miR-137 流失會提高麩醯胺酸輸入、GSH 供應與抗氧化防禦，進而增加對 ferroptosis 的抗性。

nodes.label: Stilbenoid
nodes.description: Beyond sirtuin activation, stilbenoids counteract oxidative stress and inflammation by scavenging radicals and dampening NF-κB signalling; certain derivatives also show estrogenic and senolytic activities.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 除了 sirtuin 活化之外，stilbenoid 藉由清除自由基與抑制 NF-κB 訊號來對抗氧化壓力與發炎；某些衍生物另展現雌激素作用與 senolytic 活性。

nodes.label: FoxM1
nodes.description: FoxM1 is overexpressed in a broad range of carcinomas and correlates with proliferation, chemoresistance and poor prognosis; it also promotes senescence bypass and EMT, making it an oncology target complicated by its physiological indispensability in tissue regeneration.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FoxM1 在廣泛的 carcinomas 中過度表現，並與增殖、化療抗藥性與不良預後相關；它也促進衰老逃逸與 EMT，因此成為腫瘤學標靶，但其參與組織再生的生理必要性使抑制策略更為複雜。

nodes.label: RNF185
nodes.description: RNF185 is a mitochondrial ubiquitin E3 ligase that forms part of the non-Parkin E3 ligase network providing backup mitophagy capacity. Together with parallel ligases such as MUL1 and Ambra-1/HUWE1, it maintains mitochondrial quality control when the primary PINK1/Parkin pathway is impaired, so cells can still clear damaged mitochondria when the canonical pathway is compromised.
nodes.description_zh_TW: RNF185 是粒線體泛素 E3 連接酶，屬於提供備援 mitophagy 能力的非 Parkin E3 連接酶網路。它與 MUL1 及 Ambra-1/HUWE1 等平行連接酶一起，在主要 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時維持粒線體品質管制，使細胞在典型途徑失效時仍能清除受損粒線體。

nodes.label: Follistatin
nodes.description: Follistatin binds and neutralizes Activin A extracellularly, acting as a soluble antagonist that can block its paracrine senescence-inducing activity. This provides a natural brake on Activin A signaling and a potential therapeutic route to limit SASP-mediated arrest spread in tissue. The follistatin-Activin A axis is a classic antagonistic ligand-binding pair, and neutralization experiments confirm its functional relevance in paracrine senescence models. Because follistatin also regulates other TGFbeta-family ligands, it represents an endogenous checkpoint on the arrest-inducing arm of the senescent secretome.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Follistatin 在胞外結合並中和 Activin A，作為可阻斷其旁分泌衰老誘發活性的可溶性拮抗劑。這提供對 Activin A 訊號的自然制動，以及限制組織中 SASP 介導停滯擴散的潛在治療途徑。follistatin-Activin A 軸是經典的拮抗性配體—結合對，且中和實驗確認其在旁分泌衰老模型中的功能相關性。由於 follistatin 也調節其他 TGFbeta 家族配體，它代表衰老分泌組停滯誘發臂的內源性檢查點。

nodes.label: Bisulfite
nodes.description: Bisulfite (sodium bisulfite or metabisulfite) is a reducing agent added to pharmaceutical epinephrine injections to prevent oxidation of the catechol and thereby inhibit adrenochrome formation. By scavenging oxygen and reactive oxygen species and reducing oxidized intermediates, bisulfite keeps adrenaline solutions stable and usable for extended periods, preventing the pink-to-red discoloration that signals adrenochrome accumulation. This practical application reflects the general principle that the epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation can be slowed by antioxidants, acidic pH, low temperature, and protection from light. Without such stabilizers, adrenaline auto-oxidizes visibly within days to weeks.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Bisulfite（sodium bisulfite 或 metabisulfite）是一種 reducing agent，添加於藥用 epinephrine 注射劑中，以防止 catechol 氧化從而抑制 adrenochrome 形成。透過清除氧氣與 reactive oxygen species 並還原氧化的中間產物，bisulfite 使 adrenaline 溶液保持穩定且可長期使用，防止標示 adrenochrome 堆積的粉紅至紅色變色。此實際應用反映了一般原則：epinephrine-to-adrenochrome 氧化可透過 antioxidants、酸性 pH、低溫與避光而減緩。若無此類 stabilizers，adrenaline 會在數天至數週內明顯 auto-oxidizes。

nodes.label: Genotoxic Stress
nodes.description: Genotoxic insults directly produce DNA lesions as their defining consequence. Causation is definitional for the stress class.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 基因毒性傷害直接產生 DNA 病變作為其定義性後果。因果對此壓力類別是定義性的。

nodes.label: 89-kDa PARP1 Fragment
nodes.description: Caspase-3 (with caspase-7) cleaves full-length 116-kDa PARP1 at Asp214/Gly215, separating the DNA-binding from the catalytic domain and releasing the 89-kDa C-terminal p89 fragment. This cleavage was classically read as simple inactivation of PARP1 to conserve apoptotic energy, but p89 is now recognized as a signalling-competent product rather than a passive one.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Caspase-3（連同 caspase-7）在 Asp214/Gly215 切割全长 116 kDa 的 PARP1，將 DNA 結合區與催化區分開，釋出 89 kDa 的 C 端 p89 片段。此切割過去僅被視為單純抑制 PARP1 以節省凋亡能量，如今則認為 p89 是具備訊號活性的產物，而非被動碎片。

nodes.label: eEFSec
nodes.description: By delivering selenocysteine in response to a recoded UGA codon in the SECIS-dependent context, eEFSec converts a nominal stop signal into a sense codon. This recoding is tuned by the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec installed by FTSJ1, which sets the efficiency of Sec insertion for a subset of antioxidant selenoproteins.
nodes.description_zh_TW: eEFSec 在 SECIS 依賴的脈絡下，針對再編碼的 UGA 密碼子遞送硒半胱胺酸，將原本的終止訊號轉為有義密碼子。這項再編碼的效率由 FTSJ1 安裝於 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾調整，決定部分抗氧化硒蛋白的 Sec 插入效率。

nodes.label: c-Fos
nodes.description: c-Fos is an immediate-early response gene encoding Fos, a core subunit of the AP-1 transcription factor heterodimer. It is rapidly induced by mitogenic signalling and promotes cell-cycle progression and proliferation, and as a proto-oncogene it is linked to oncogene-induced transformation. Fos-Jun heterodimers bind AP-1 sites to regulate genes controlling proliferation, differentiation, and stress responses.
nodes.description_zh_TW: c-Fos 是即刻早期反應基因，編碼 Fos——AP-1 轉錄因子異二聚體的核心次單元。它受促分裂訊號迅速誘導，促進細胞週期進程與增殖；作為原致癌基因，它也與致癌基因誘導的轉型相關。Fos–Jun 異二聚體結合 AP-1 位點，調控控制增殖、分化與壓力反應的基因。
nodes.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

nodes.label: DAF-2
nodes.description: Reduced insulin/IGF-1 signaling through dietary restriction, intermittent fasting, or genetic reduction of DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor, derepresses autophagy and doubles lifespan via DAF-16/FOXO, making it one of the most robust lifespan-extending interventions.
nodes.description_zh_TW: 透過飲食限制、間歇性禁食，或在 C. elegans 中遺傳性降低胰島素/IGF-1 受體 DAF-2 來減少胰島素訊息傳遞，可解除對自噬的抑制並經由 DAF-16/FOXO 使壽命加倍，是最穩健的延壽介入之一。

nodes.label: DDX3Y
nodes.description: DDX3Y is the Y-chromosome homolog of DDX3X. The two share ATP-dependent RNA unwinding and translation initiation, stress granule and Wnt functions, but the overlap is not identical: X-X female compensation is stronger than X-Y male compensation (36% chrX loss vs 8.2% chrY loss among mutated tumors, P=0.0022), leaving a net female advantage.
nodes.description_zh_TW: DDX3Y 是 DDX3X 的 Y 染色體同源基因。兩者共享 ATP 依賴性 RNA 解旋、轉譯起始、stress granule 與 Wnt 功能，但重疊並非完全一致：女性 X-X 補償強於男性 X-Y 補償（在突變腫瘤中 chrX 喪失 36% 對 chrY 喪失 8.2%，P=0.0022），因而保留了淨的女性優勢。

nodes.label: Phenelzine
nodes.description: Phenelzine is a classical irreversible Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor antidepressant, the pharmacological prototype of the class that raises synaptic monoamines to produce antidepressant and anxiolytic effects.
nodes.description_zh_TW: Phenelzine 是經典的不可逆 Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor 抗憂鬱藥，是該類提高突觸單胺以產生抗憂鬱與抗焦慮作用的藥理原型。

nodes.label: Atg17
nodes.description: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17. As the Atg17 scaffold, FIP200 holds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex together and is required for Autophagosome formation during Macroautophagy initiation.
nodes.description_zh_TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物。作為 Atg17 支架，FIP200 將 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體維持在一起，並為 Macroautophagy 起始時的 Autophagosome 形成所必需。

links.context: CCF may emerge from heterochromatinized or SAHF regions in senescent cells, as the compacted chromatin of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci can be shed into the cytosol and trigger cGAS-STING signaling. This speculative link connects the structural reorganization of chromatin that accompanies senescence to innate immune activation, providing a potential route by which silenced genomic regions become inflammatory ligands. The evidence is suggestive but less direct than the DNA-SCARS-to-CCF pathway, and the contribution of SAHF-derived fragments remains an open question. Confidence is accordingly low, reflecting the preliminary nature of the association.
links.context_zh_TW: CCF 可能來自衰老細胞中異染色質化或 SAHF 區域，因衰老相關異染色質焦點的緻密染色質可脫落至胞質並觸發 cGAS-STING 訊號。此推測性連結將伴隨衰老的染色質結構重組連結到先天免疫活化，提供靜默基因組區域成為發炎配體的潛在途徑。證據具提示性但較 DNA-SCARS-to-CCF 路徑不直接，且 SAHF 衍生片段的貢獻仍為開放問題。信度因而低，反映此關聯的初步性質。
links.source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and senescence‐associated secretory phenotype via the cGAS_STING signaling pathway in cancer.md

links.context: Graph node-analysis (15 Aug 2026): SIRT3 reaches Adrenochrome through TWO independent shortest paths (via Oxidative Stress and NF-κB), versus SIRT1/SIRT2's single NF-κB bridge — i.e. SIRT3 is wired INTO Adrenochrome's stress zone with route redundancy/robustness.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析（2026-08-15）：SIRT3 經由兩條獨立最短路徑（透過 Oxidative Stress 與 NF-κB）到達 Adrenochrome，相對於 SIRT1/SIRT2 單一 NF-κB 橋樑——即 SIRT3 以路徑冗餘/穩健性被編入 Adrenochrome 的壓力區。

links.context: Graph node-analysis (networkx/scipy, 15 Aug 2026): COMT sits 1 hop from both Dopamine and Epinephrine with the highest Adamic-Adar latent pull (0.51–0.72) and #3 personalized-PageRank rank for both — the direct enzymatic gateway/hub of catecholamine handling, versus MAO which is peripheral. Graph node-analysis (combined sirtuin/catecholamine drill): COMT is the actual enzymatic gateway to Dopamine (1-hop adjacency, #3 PageRank seed at Dopamine, highest Adamic-Adar), while the sirtuins' dopamine relevance is an aging/neurodegeneration-context phenomenon.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析（networkx/scipy，2026-08-15）：COMT 距 Dopamine 與 Epinephrine 皆 1 跳，具最高的 Adamic-Adar 潛在連結拉力（0.51–0.72）與兩者皆 #3 的個人化 PageRank 排名——是兒茶酚胺處理的直接酵素樞紐/閘門，相對於周邊的 MAO。 圖譜節點分析（sirtuin/兒茶酚胺合併演練）：COMT 是通往 Dopamine 的真正酵素閘門（1 跳相鄰、Dopamine 種子 #3 PageRank、最高 Adamic-Adar），而 sirtuins 的多巴胺相關性是老化/神經退化脈絡現象。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: COMT links directly to Epinephrine (1 hop) and carries the strongest latent link pull (Adamic-Adar 0.721) of any source–target pair, placing it as the systemic catecholamine-metabolism hub in the wiki graph.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：COMT 直接連結 Epinephrine（1 跳）並帶有所有來源–標的對中最強的潛在連結拉力（Adamic-Adar 0.721），在 wiki 圖譜中居於系統性兒茶酚胺代謝樞紐。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: MAO (degree 2, k-core 2) reaches Dopamine only through Epinephrine (no direct edge), with ~3–4× larger commute distance and near-null resistance z (Dopamine z = −0.70) — a peripheral metabolic spoke versus COMT's hub status.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：MAO（degree 2、k-core 2）僅能透過 Epinephrine 到達 Dopamine（無直接邊），通勤距離約大 3–4 倍且阻力 z 近於零（Dopamine z = −0.70）——相對於 COMT 的樞紐地位，它是周邊的代謝輻條。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: SIRT1 depends on a single bridge (NF-κB) to reach Adrenochrome, a single point of failure, whereas SIRT3 has two independent routes. By flow metrics (PPR #63, lowest effective resistance 0.094) SIRT1 is nevertheless the closest sirtuin to Adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT1 依賴單一橋樑（NF-κB）到達 Adrenochrome，為單點失效；而 SIRT3 有兩條獨立路徑。然而依流量指標（PPR #63、最低有效電阻 0.094）SIRT1 仍是距 Adrenochrome 最近的 sirtuin。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: SIRT1→Dopamine is the single most route-rich relationship in the sirtuin×catecholamine set (7 distinct shortest paths via Aging, Parkinson's Disease, Senescence, Tau, Resveratrol) — the dopamine link is indirect and aging/neurodegeneration-contextual, not enzymatic.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT1→Dopamine 是 sirtuin×兒茶酚酚胺組中路徑最豐富的關係（7 條經由 Aging、Parkinson's Disease、Senescence、Tau、Resveratrol 的不同最短路徑）——其多巴胺連結是間接且老化/神經退化脈絡性的，而非酵素性的。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: SIRT3 shows the strongest latent (missing-edge) link pull toward Adrenochrome (Adamic-Adar 0.556 vs SIRT1 0.268), consistent with its two-path redundancy — the sirtuin the graph encodes as 'belonging' in the adrenochrome neighborhood.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT3 對 Adrenochrome 展現最強的潛在（缺失邊）連結拉力（Adamic-Adar 0.556，對 SIRT1 的 0.268），與其雙路徑冗餘一致——圖譜將此 sirtuin 編碼為「屬於」adrenochrome 鄰域。

links.context: Graph node-analysis: SIRT3→Dopamine has exactly one route, through Oxidative Stress — the only latent redox edge any sirtuin holds to a catecholamine — making SIRT3 the sirtuin with a genuine redox/genotoxic link to dopamine.
links.context_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT3→Dopamine 僅有一條路徑，經由 Oxidative Stress——任何 sirtuin 對兒茶酚胺持有的唯一潛在氧化還原邊——使 SIRT3 成為與多巴胺具真正氧化還原/基因毒性連結的 sirtuin。

links.context: Calpain-dependent cleavage of AIF is proposed only for the inner-membrane AIF pool, generating a 57 kDa truncated AIF that no longer anchors to the inner membrane and can exit. The route requires a second hit beyond PAR binding and is model-dependent rather than a general feature of parthanatos. Evidence against it includes the release of uncleaved 62 kDa AIF in canonical MNNG and NMDA paradigms, so whether calpain cleavage is required remains unresolved.
links.context_zh_TW: Calpain 依賴性的 AIF 切割僅被提出適用於粒線體內膜的 AIF 池，產生不再錨定於內膜、可外出的 57 kDa 截短型 AIF。此途徑需要 PAR 結合之外的第二個打擊，且屬模型依賴而非 parthanatos 的一般特徵。反對證據包括在典型 MNNG 與 NMDA 範式中釋放的是未切割的 62 kDa AIF，因此 calpain 切割是否為必要步驟仍未定論。

links.context: A case study of 10 critically ill COVID-19 patients over 50 years old reported that an NMN cocktail (83 mL of NMN mixed with 400 mL of water, consumed before breakfast and dinner) was strongly associated with resolution of COVID-19 symptoms. Before treatment, patients had low oxygen saturation, pulmonary infiltrates, and inflammation; post-treatment there was rapid improvement in bilateral pulmonary infiltrates, fever resolution, and lower inflammation biomarkers. One patient who stopped treatment after 3 days experienced relapse with fever and pulmonary infiltrates 8 days later. The rapid clinical improvement suggests NMN may help reverse the potentially fatal cytokine storm triggered by SARS-CoV-2, though larger controlled studies are needed.
links.context_zh_TW: 一項針對 10 名 50 歲以上重症 COVID-19 患者的病例研究報告，NMN 雞尾酒（83 mL NMN 混合 400 mL 水，於早餐與晚餐前飲用）與 COVID-19 症狀的緩解強烈相關。治療前，患者血氧飽和度低、有肺部浸潤與發炎；治療後雙側肺部浸潤迅速改善、退燒，且發炎生物標記下降。一名患者在 3 天後停止治療，8 天後出現發燒與肺部浸潤的復發。快速的臨床改善顯示 NMN 可能有助於逆轉 SARS-CoV-2 觸發的潛在致命細胞激素風暴，儘管仍需要更大規模的對照研究。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: COMT detoxifies catechol substrates, including reactive catechol estrogen quinones and catechol carcinogens, which is one mechanistic candidate for its role as a response gate. COMT haploinsufficiency at 22q11.2 carries a cancer predisposition, and competition from catechol-bearing dietary polyphenols such as Quercetin and Fisetin means fast COMT clears these faster, potentially reshaping the whole catechol/antioxidant milieu.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 負責解毒兒茶酚類基質，包括反應性的兒茶酚雌激素醌與兒茶酚致癌物，這是它作為反應閘門的機制候選之一。22q11.2 區段的 COMT 單倍體不足帶有癌症易感傾向；而來自 Quercetin、Fisetin 等含兒茶酚膳食多酚的競爭意味著快型 COMT 清除它們得更快，可能重塑整體的兒茶酚／抗氧化 milieu。

links.context: In the SASP-remodeling aminochrome complex (SRAC) strategy, GlyNAC supplies the reductive glutathione buffer while carbazochrome (a stabilized adrenochrome derivative) supplies the mitohormetic trigger, expanding the safety margin of the hormetic pulse. This is a protocol-design hypothesis (combo-therapy/SRAC documents), NOT directly established in primary biomedical literature; it rests on the separately grounded edges GlyNAC -> Glutathione and Carbazochrome -> Adrenochrom (is_derivative_of).
links.context_zh_TW: 在 SASP 重塑胺基色體複合物（SRAC）策略中，GlyNAC 提供穀胱甘肽還原緩衝，而卡巴可羅（穩定化的腎上腺素紅衍生物）提供粒線體激素性觸發，擴大激素性脈衝的安全邊際。這是一項協定設計假說（combo-therapy／SRAC 文件），並非直接由基礎醫學文獻確立；其依據來自各自獨立佐證的 GlyNAC → 穀胱甘肽 與 卡巴可羅 → 腎上腺素紅（is_derivative_of）邊。

links.context: In the calpain-cleavage model of AIF release, calcium entry through TRPM2 activates calpain I, which cleaves the 62 kDa AIF to a 57 kDa truncated form that detaches from the inner mitochondrial membrane; calpeptin and cyclosporin A block this step. Bid/Bax alone releases cytochrome c but not AIF, so the two release routes are separable. The model is contested: canonical MNNG/NMDA parthanatos releases uncleaved 62 kDa AIF and calpastatin knockout fails to block it.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 AIF 釋放的 calpain 切割模型中，經由 TRPM2 進入的鈣離子活化 calpain I，將 62 kDa 的 AIF 切割為脫離粒線體內膜的 57 kDa 截短型；calpeptin 與 cyclosporin A 可阻斷此步驟。Bid/Bax 單獨可釋放 cytochrome c 但不釋放 AIF，顯示兩條釋放途徑可分離。此模型仍有爭議：典型的 MNNG/NMDA parthanatos 釋放的是未切割的 62 kDa AIF，且 calpastatin 剔除無法阻斷之。

links.context: PINK1 promotes fission via DRP1 S616 phosphorylation but also supports fusion (stabilizing OPA1, modulating MFN2). Its effects are species/cell-type dependent. [HYPOTHESIS: context-dependent paradox]
links.context_zh_TW: PINK1 透過 DRP1 S616 磷酸化促進分裂，但也支持融合（穩定 OPA1、調節 MFN2）。其效應依物種／細胞類型而異。[HYPOTHESIS: 情境依賴的矛盾]

links.context: Prolonged calorie restriction is not uniformly protective: when the autophagic response becomes excessive, the resulting type II autophagic cell death becomes harmful, making the dose and duration of dietary restriction a determinant of whether autophagy supports or destroys the cell.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期熱量限制並非一律有益：當自噬反應過度時，所引發的第二型自噬性細胞死亡反而有害，因此飲食限制的劑量與持續時間決定了自噬究竟支持還是摧毀細胞。

links.context: AMPK-mTORC1 signaling downstream of AMP accumulation has been proposed to induce an autophagic response in parthanatos, but whether AMPK activation and autophagy contribute to death execution or are protective is currently unclear (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: AMP 蓄積下游的 AMPK-mTORC1 訊號被認為在 parthanatos 中誘導自噬反應，但 AMPK 活化與自噬究竟促成死亡執行或具保護作用目前仍不清楚（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: ARH3 acts as a protective rather than an executionary PAR hydrolase in parthanatos. ARH3-deficient patients and mice are hypersensitive to ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2-induced parthanatos, yet ARH3 knockout has no effect on MNNG-induced death in RPE1 cells, and an alternative epigenetic explanation involving histone mono-ADP-ribosylation scars remains open.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 parthanatos 中，ARH3 是具有保護作用而非執行作用的 PAR 水解酶。ARH3 缺陷的患者與小鼠對缺血再灌流及 H2O2 誘發的 parthanatos 高度敏感，然而在 RPE1 細胞中 ARH3 敲除對 MNNG 誘發的死亡毫無影響；此外，涉及組蛋白單 ADP-ribosylation 疤痕的另一種表觀遺傳學解釋仍未排除。

links.context: ARH3, the exo-PARase and serine-ADP-ribosylhydrolase partner of PARG, is dispensable for PARP1-dependent death in an RPE1/MNNG model, so its protective role is cell-type and insult dependent and contrasts with its sensitivity in ischemia and H2O2 systems (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: ARH3（PARG 的外切 PAR 酶與絲胺酸 ADP-ribosyl 水解酶夥伴）在 RPE1/MNNG 模型中對 PARP1 依賴性死亡並非必需，其保護作用取決於細胞類型與刺激，並與其在缺血與 H2O2 系統中的敏感性形成對比（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: Adrenochrome is hypothesized to act as a dual ferroptosis inducer, simultaneously generating lipid-peroxidation-initiating ROS via redox cycling and potentially inhibiting GPX4 through o-quinone electrophilic arylation of its selenocysteine. This mechanism is analogous to the classical ferroptosis inducer RSL3. The hypothesis awaits experimental validation with ferroptosis rescue panels.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 被假設作為雙重 ferroptosis 誘導劑，一方面透過 redox cycling 產生啟動 lipid peroxidation 的 ROS，另一方面可能透過對其 selenocysteine 的 o-quinone 親電子芳基化來抑制 GPX4。此機制類似於經典的 ferroptosis 誘導劑 RSL3。此假設有待以 ferroptosis 救援組合進行實驗驗證。

links.context: Adrenochrome is hypothesized to inhibit GPX4 through o-quinone electrophilic arylation of its catalytic selenocysteine, analogous to the ferroptosis inducer RSL3. Combined with redox-cycling generation of lipid-peroxidation-initiating ROS, this would make adrenochrome a dual ferroptosis inducer. This hypothesis may explain cardiomyocyte death in catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy and dopaminergic neuron vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 被假設透過 o-quinone 對其催化性 selenocysteine 進行親電子芳基化來抑制 GPX4，類似於 ferroptosis 誘導劑 RSL3。結合 redox cycling 產生啟動 lipid peroxidation 的 ROS，這將使 adrenochrome 成為雙重 ferroptosis 誘導劑。此假設或可解釋 catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 中的心肌細胞死亡，以及 Parkinson's disease 中多巴胺能神經元的易感性。

links.context: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) may act as a Prodrug: although its hydrazine group is locked in a Guanylhydrazone bond and thus non-nucleophilic, the conjugate is stable enough for clinical use while remaining plausibly hydrolysable in vivo to release free Aminoguanidine slowly. That would make AMM a controlled-release form whose anti-glycation activity is indirect. Whether this prodrug model holds is unresolved; the alternatives are retained nucleophilicity through the remaining guanidine nitrogens or chelation of the transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）可能作為 Prodrug 發揮作用：雖然其 hydrazine 官能基被鎖在 Guanylhydrazone 鍵中而缺乏親核性，該共軛物仍穩定到足以供臨床使用，卻又可能於體內緩慢水解釋出游離的 Aminoguanidine。這將使 AMM 成為間接發揮抗糖化活性的控釋形式。此 prodrug 模型是否成立尚未定論；其他可能性是由殘餘 guanidine 氮保留親核性，或螯合催化 glycoxidation 的過渡金屬。

links.context: Although Neuromelanin is distinct from cutaneous melanin, albinism links to broader pigment biology in the central nervous system. Both cutaneous and neural pigment share melanogenic and catechol-oxidation chemistry. This connects OCA to the wider pigment system and its pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管 Neuromelanin 有別於皮膚黑色素，白化症仍與中樞神經系統中更廣泛的色素生物學相關。皮膚和神經色素都共享黑色素生成和兒茶酚氧化化學特性。這將 OCA 與更廣泛的色素系統及其病理連結起來。

links.context: Although the corpus keeps an activates edge from resveratrol to SIRT1, the direct-activation claim is challenged by the Fluor de Lys substrate artifact and by in vivo work showing resveratrol acts only at concentrations far above physiological levels. Its in vivo effects appear to run through an indirect cAMP/PDE4/Epac1/AMPK/NAD+ cascade instead. A qualified counter-edge was added rather than lowering confidence, because resveratrol is a high-degree hub.
links.context_zh_TW: 雖然語料仍保留 resveratrol 對 SIRT1 的 activates 邊，但直接活化的說法受到 Fluor de Lys 受質假象的挑戰，體內研究也顯示 resveratrol 只在遠高於生理濃度時才有作用。其體內效應似乎是透過間接的 cAMP/PDE4/Epac1/AMPK/NAD+ 級聯產生。因此新增了一條帶限定的反向邊，而不是降低信度，因為 resveratrol 是高節點度的樞紐。

links.context: Because its reported autophagy-inhibiting activity can compromise mitophagic clearance, carbazochrome sulfonic acid is a potential liability for protocols that rely on selective mitophagy to remove dysfunctional mitochondria — a caution flagged in the context of mitohormesis-based therapeutics.
links.context_zh_TW: 由於其被報告的自噬抑制活性可能損害線粒體自噬的清除作用，Carbazochrome sulfonic acid 對依賴選擇性 Mitophagy 移除失能粒線體的方案而言是潛在的干擾因子——這是在基於 mitohormesis 的治療語境中所標記的警示。

links.context: Calpain I, a Ca2+-dependent protease, can cleave and release AIF from mitochondria (62 to 57 kDa) and cleaves BID to route Ca2+ signals through BAX, providing a candidate Ca2+-calpain-AIF route in parthanatos. However calpain inhibition or knockout does not prevent AIF release in some models, so its role is context dependent (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: 鈣依賴蛋白酶 calpain I 可切割並自粒線體釋放 AIF（62 至 57 kDa），並切割 BID 使 Ca2+ 訊號經 BAX 傳遞，為 parthanatos 中 Ca2+-calpain-AIF 的候選路徑。然而部分模型中 calpain 抑制或敲除無法阻止 AIF 釋放，故其角色取決於情境（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: Glutaminolysis is the catabolic pathway in which glutamine is sequentially converted to glutamate by glutaminase and then to alpha-ketoglutarate, feeding carbon into the TCA cycle. Glutamine is the committed substrate of the pathway, and in MYC-high cancer cells this glutamine-derived alpha-ketoglutarate replaces glucose-derived carbon as the cycle's primary fuel.
links.context_zh_TW: Glutaminolysis 是 catabolic 途徑：glutamine 先經 glutaminase 轉為 glutamate，再轉為 alpha-ketoglutarate 以供應 TCA cycle 的碳。在 MYC-high 癌細胞中，此 glutamine 衍生的 alpha-ketoglutarate 取代 glucose 衍生碳成為 cycle 的主要燃料。

links.context: MAGE family members can interact with p53 and modulate its transcriptional activity, and MAGEC3 may contribute to p53-dependent tumor suppression - though MAGEC3 itself is among the least mechanistically characterized of the six EXITS genes.
links.context_zh_TW: MAGE 家族成員可與 p53 互動並調節其轉錄活性，MAGEC3 可能參與 p53 依賴的腫瘤抑制；不過 MAGEC3 本身是六個 EXITS 基因中機制最不清楚者之一。

links.context: Opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore allows non-selective solute diffusion, mitochondrial swelling and rupture, and is a candidate route for AIF release during parthanatos alongside direct PAR binding and calpain proteolysis (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟使溶質非選擇性擴散、粒線體腫脹與破裂，為 parthanatos 中 AIF 釋放的候選途徑之一，與直接 PAR 結合及 calpain 蛋白酶解並列（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: Proteotoxicity — proteotoxic stress from misfolded and aggregated proteins — accumulates as neurodegenerative disease progresses, with rising levels of misfolded proteins and peptides. The process is regulated by nutrient sensors, stress pathways and hormonal signals, and its impairment is linked to metabolic disease, neurodegeneration and cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteotoxicity（由錯誤摺疊與聚集蛋白造成的蛋白毒性壓力）會隨著 neurodegenerative disease 進展而累積，錯誤摺疊蛋白與胜肽的量持續上升。此過程受營養感測器、壓力路徑與荷爾蒙訊號調控，其失調則與代謝疾病、神經退化與癌症相關。

links.context: Proximity-guided graph learning can recover tumour-associated antigens without targeting them directly. Anchoring on EGFR and ranking non-adjacent candidates by their co-varying proximity profiles across many experiments surfaces tumour-associated proximity antigens, and the resulting pairs are cross-validated against curated interaction databases, coessentiality data and clinical proteomics. EGFR is used as the anchor node for co-target ranking in proximity-guided antigen discovery, with graph attention and variational graph autoencoder architectures trained to rank EGFR-associated co-targets. Feature ablation shows that dropping either measured proximity or protein expression reduces precision, so proximity carries signal that is not redundant with known connectivity and abundance alone.
links.context_zh_TW: 以鄰近性引導的圖學習可以在不直接標定標的情況下找回腫瘤相關抗原。以 EGFR 為錨點、依各蛋白在多種實驗中共變的鄰近性剖面對非相鄰候選排序，即可浮現腫瘤相關的鄰近抗原，並以策展的交互作用資料庫、共必需性資料與臨床蛋白組學交叉驗證這些配對。 在鄰近性引導的抗原發現中，EGFR 被當作共同標的排序的錨點節點，並以圖注意力網路與變分圖自編碼器訓練來排序 EGFR 相關的共同標的。特徵消融實驗顯示，無論移除測得的鄰近性或蛋白質表現，準確率都會下降，表示鄰近性攜帶的訊號並非已知連結度與豐度所能取代。

links.context: Ribonucleotide reductase is the archetypal thioredoxin-1 client. After each catalytic cycle its active-site cysteines are oxidized to a disulfide, and reduced Thioredoxin-1 — regenerated by Thioredoxin reductase plus NADPH — re-reduces the enzyme. Glutaredoxin provides a parallel donor routed through reduced Glutathione, and both pathways converge on NADPH.
links.context_zh_TW: 核糖核苷酸還原酶是 thioredoxin-1 最典型的客戶蛋白。每一次催化循環後，其活性位點的半胱胺酸會被氧化成雙硫鍵，再由還原態的 Thioredoxin-1（其本身由 Thioredoxin reductase 加上 NADPH 再生）重新還原酵素。Glutaredoxin 則透過還原態的 Glutathione 提供平行電子供體，兩條途徑皆最終匯入 NADPH。

links.context: SIRT6 overexpression increases the survival of transverse aortic constriction-induced heart failure mice, which might be associated with upregulation of Telomerase reverse transcriptase and telomere repeat binding factor 1/2. Telomerase activity is therefore linked to telomere maintenance and the cytoprotective transcriptional response to moderate SIRT1/SIRT6 elevation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 的過度表現可提高橫向主動脈縮窄所誘發心衰竭小鼠的存活率，這可能與端粒反轉錄酶以及端粒重複結合因子 1/2 的上调有關。因此 Telomerase 活性與端粒維持，以及對中度 SIRT1/SIRT6 上升的細胞保護性轉錄反應相互連結。

links.context: SRT2183 mimics many of the transcriptional effects attributed to resveratrol, including deacetylation of SIRT1 substrates such as p53; given its metabolic similarity to resveratrol, it may act in vivo partly through indirect pathways such as the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK axis rather than direct SIRT1 binding.
links.context_zh_TW: SRT2183 模仿 resveratrol 的多項轉錄效應，包括對 SIRT1 作用標的（如 p53）的去乙醯化；由於與 resveratrol 的代謝相似性，它在體內可能部分是透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 等間接途徑而非直接結合 SIRT1 作用。

links.context: The Substantia Nigra is a critical Basal Ganglia structure located in the midbrain, Latin for 'black substance' after the dark colour provided by high Neuromelanin concentrations in its neurons. It divides into the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta, rich in dopaminergic neurons and projecting onward to the striatum, and the Substantia Nigra Pars Reticulata, composed mainly of GABAergic neurons and serving as a primary Basal Ganglia output nucleus.
links.context_zh_TW: Substantia Nigra 是位於 midbrain 的關鍵 Basal Ganglia 結構，其拉丁名「black substance」源自其神經元中高濃度 Neuromelanin 所賦予的深色。它分為富含 dopaminergic neuron、並進一步投射至 striatum 的 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta，以及主要由 GABAergic neuron 組成、作為 Basal Ganglia 主要輸出核的 Substantia Nigra Pars Reticulata。

links.context: The role of PARG in parthanatos is conflicting: overexpression or knockdown of PARG can protect (Andrabi 2006; Yu 2006), yet PARG inhibition also protects in brain ischaemia (Lu 2003) and PARG silencing protects against H2O2 but not MNNG (Blenn 2006). The review treats whether PARG promotes or inhibits execution as an open question, plausibly dose- and context-dependent (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 在 parthanatos 中的角色相互矛盾：過度表現或敲低 PARG 皆可保護（Andrabi 2006；Yu 2006），但 PARG 抑制在腦缺血中亦具保護作用（Lu 2003），且 PARG 沉默對 H2O2 有保護但對 MNNG 無效（Blenn 2006）。該綜述將 PARG 促成或抑制執行視為未解問題，可能取決於劑量與情境（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: The role of necroptosis in sepsis remains open: cecal-ligation-and-puncture (CLP) studies conflict (Nec-1 protective in one report, accelerating in others) and RIPK3-/MLKL-deficient mice show no benefit.
links.context_zh_TW: Necroptosis 在敗血症之角色仍未有定論：盲腸結紮穿刺（CLP）模式之研究結果相互矛盾（一篇報告 Nec-1 具保護作用，其他則顯示加速），而 RIPK3/MLKL 缺失小鼠未見獲益。

links.context: Under the autophagy-senescence threshold model, Spermidine-induced autophagic flux suppresses entry into Senescence while cellular damage stays below a critical threshold; once damage exceeds it, autophagy is reprogrammed to support senescent-cell survival and senolytics such as Fisetin are required, making spermidine and fisetin sequential non-redundant partners on the same continuum.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 autophagy–senescence 閾值模型下，Spermidine 誘導的自噬通量可在細胞損傷低於臨界閾值時抑制進入 Senescence；損傷超越閾值後，自噬被重編程以支持衰老細胞存活，此時需 Fisetin 等 senolytics 清除，使兩者在同一連續體上成為先後有序、非冗餘的搭檔。
links.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

links.context: Abnormal expression levels of BIG1 have been investigated for a possible role in Cancer progression. Since BIG1 regulates growth-related signaling and membrane protein trafficking, it may influence the signaling of oncogenic receptors, which in turn could contribute to uncontrolled cell proliferation and metastasis.
links.context_zh_TW: BIG1 表現量異常已被研究，以探討其在 Cancer 進展中可能扮演的角色。由於 BIG1 調控與生長相關的訊號傳遞以及膜蛋白運輸，它可能影響致癌受體的訊號作用，進而促成細胞不受控制的增殖與轉移。

links.context: Aristoforin is a plant-derived natural product reported among compounds with diverse structural cores that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations. Grouped with Amurensin G, polyphenols and Tanikolide in natural-product sirtuin inhibitor series, its target selectivity and mechanism are less characterized than those of synthetic inhibitors, and effects may extend to additional cellular targets.
links.context_zh_TW: Aristoforin 是植物來源的天然產物，與其他結構核心多樣的化合物一同被報導能在微莫耳濃度下抑制 sirtuin。它在天然產物 sirtuin 抑制劑系列中與 Amurensin G、多酚類及 Tanikolide 並列，但其標的選擇性與機制的解析度不如合成抑制劑，作用也可能延伸至其他細胞標的。

links.context: Chronic generation of Malondialdehyde and 4-Hydroxynonenal from ongoing lipid peroxidation degrades mitohormetic capacity, so preventing that generation is not the same as blunting the hormetic signal. The distinction resolves the apparent conflict between membrane protection and hormesis: lipid-peroxidation control preserves the adaptive response rather than suppressing it.
links.context_zh_TW: 持續脂質過氧化所產生的 Malondialdehyde 與 4-Hydroxynonenal 會侵蝕 mitohormetic 容量，因此阻止其生成與削弱 hormetic 訊號並不相同。這項區分化解了膜保護與 hormesis 之間的表面衝突：控制脂質過氧化是保存而非壓抑適應反應。

links.context: Cyclophilin A is proposed to form an AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex in which AIF provides nuclease activity for large-scale DNA fragmentation, an alternative to the MIF/PAAN nuclease model of AIF-dependent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclophilin A 被提出與 AIF 及組蛋白 H2AX 形成複合體，其中由 AIF 提供核酸酶活性以進行大規模 DNA 斷裂，為 AIF 依賴性 parthanatos 中 MIF/PAAN 核酸酶模型之外的替代機制（Moura et al. 2024）。

links.context: Dysregulation of BIG1 has been linked to the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative conditions such as Alzheimer's Disease. Because BIG1 governs membrane trafficking and receptor signaling, defective BIG1 function is hypothesized to contribute to the accumulation of misfolded protein aggregates and to disrupted neuronal connectivity — both hallmark features of Alzheimer's Disease. This link is emerging and remains largely hypothetical.
links.context_zh_TW: BIG1 的失調已被認為與神經退行性疾病（例如 Alzheimer's Disease）的致病過程相關。由於 BIG1 主導膜運輸與受體訊號傳遞，BIG1 功能缺陷被假設可能促成錯誤摺疊蛋白聚集物的累積以及神經元連結的破壞——這兩者皆是 Alzheimer's Disease 的典型特徵。此關聯仍屬新興且多為假設性。

links.context: Erythropoietin is listed as protective against eryptosis, plausibly by supporting red cell energy and redox homeostasis and opposing calcium overload. The cited studies do not establish a direct anti-eryptotic mechanism, so the relationship is inferred from cross-program biology rather than demonstrated.
links.context_zh_TW: Erythropoietin 被列為對 eryptosis 具有保護作用，可能透過支持紅血球的能量與氧化還原恆定並抵銷鈣離子過載。所引用的研究並未確立直接的抗 eryptosis 機制，因此此關係是由跨程式生物學推論而來，而非已證實。

links.context: Fenbendazole is under preclinical investigation for cholangiocarcinoma as part of the repurposed anthelmintic anticancer cluster.
links.context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 正在對膽管癌進行臨牀前研究，作為重新利用的驅蟲抗癌藥物簇的一部分。

links.context: In the prodrug model for adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, Prodrug behavior means in vivo hydrolysis of the Guanylhydrazone linkage releases free Aminoguanidine over time. The strategy trades immediate potency for stability and tolerability, since the inactive parent conjugate is chemically robust in storage while the active Aminoguanidine is delivered gradually to inhibit Advanced Glycation End Products formation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 的 prodrug 模型中，Prodrug 行為指的是體內水解 Guanylhydrazone 連結鍵，隨時間釋出游離的 Aminoguanidine。此策略以即效性換取穩定性與耐受性：無活性的母體共軛物在儲存時化學穩健，而活性的 Aminoguanidine 則逐步釋放以抑制 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成。

links.context: Mebendazole shows preclinical antiproliferative activity in cholangiocarcinoma via microtubule interference.
links.context_zh_TW: Mebendazole 顯示透過微管幹擾對膽管癌具有臨牀前抗增殖活性。

links.context: N6-methyladenosine is a target for Senomorphic strategies. Since senomorphics aim to dampen SASP without killing senescent cells, the enhancer-looping function of the m6A writer complex is a plausible lever: METTL3 inhibitors such as STM2457 and FTO inhibitors are being pursued, and rewiring m6A could blunt the secretome while preserving the arrested cell.
links.context_zh_TW: N6-methyladenosine 是 Senomorphic 策略的標的。由於 senomorphics 旨在抑制 SASP 而不殺死 senescent 細胞，m6A writer 複合體的增強子環化功能便成為合理的著力點：METTL3 抑制劑如 STM2457 與 FTO 抑制劑正被開發，而重新布署 m6A 訊號可在保留停滯細胞的同時削弱分泌組。

links.context: Select Enterocloster gut species contribute to the multi-step consortium conversion of Ellagic Acid toward Urolithin A alongside the principal converters Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens; as a minor contributor its presence modulates but does not alone determine urolithin metabotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 特定 Enterocloster 腸道菌種與主要轉換者 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 及 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 共同參與 Ellagic Acid 往 Urolithin A 的多步菌叢轉換；作為次要貢獻者，其存在可調節但不足以單獨決定 urolithin metabotype。
links.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

links.context: Immunosenescence can be partially reversed by spermidine, a natural polyamine that induces autophagy and has been shown to improve immune function and healthspan in model organisms. By promoting autophagic clearance, spermidine mitigates age-related immune decline and reduces the accumulation of dysfunctional cells. The evidence is promising but largely preclinical, giving moderate confidence in its translational potential. Its favorable safety profile supports further exploration in aging research.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫衰老可被 spermidine 部分逆轉，spermidine 是一種誘導自噬並已顯示改善模式生物免疫功能與健康壽命的天然多胺。透過促進自噬清除，spermidine 減輕年齡相關免疫衰退並減少功能障礙細胞的累積。證據具前景但多屬臨床前，對其轉譯潛力給予中等信度。其良好的安全特性支持在老化研究中進一步探索。

links.context: Immunosenescence may be partially reversed by metformin, an AMPK-activating autophagy inducer with anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects in aged individuals. Preclinical and some clinical data suggest improved immune parameters, including reduced chronic inflammation and enhanced metabolic fitness of immune cells. The reversal is modest and mechanistically tied to metabolic reprogramming rather than direct immune restoration. Confidence is moderate given the heterogeneity of study outcomes.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫衰老可能部分被 metformin 逆轉，metformin 是一種活化 AMPK、具抗發炎與免疫調節效應的老化個體中的自噬誘導劑。臨床前與部分臨床資料顯示免疫參數改善，包括減少慢性發炎與增強免疫細胞的代謝適能。此逆轉溫和且機制上連結到代謝重編程而非直接免疫恢復。考量研究結果的異質性，信度中等。

links.context: In established tumors, paracrine senescence from therapy-induced senescent (TIS) cells can promote cancer progression via a tumor-supportive SASP rich in growth factors and EMT inducers. The spread of senescence-associated remodeling can enhance stemness, invasiveness, and therapy resistance in neighboring malignant cells, and chronic SASP (IL-6, IL-8 via JAK/STAT3) expands cancer stem-cell traits. This duality mirrors senescence's overall Janus-faced relationship with cancer. The promoting effect depends on SASP composition and immune context.
links.context_zh_TW: 在已建立腫瘤中，來自治療誘發衰老（TIS）細胞的旁分泌衰老可透過富含生長因子與 EMT 誘發因子的促腫瘤 SASP 促進癌症進展。衰老相關重塑的擴散可增強鄰近惡性細胞的幹性、侵襲性與治療抗藥性，且慢性 SASP（IL-6、IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3）擴大癌症幹細胞特徵。此雙重性反映衰老與癌症整體的兩面關係。促進效應取決於 SASP 組成與免疫脈絡。

links.context: Resveratrol suppresses SAMD by acting as an antioxidant that quenches ROS from dysfunctional mitochondria and by activating SIRT1, which supports mitochondrial biogenesis and function. This reduces the mitochondrial-derived inflammatory drive of the SASP, and SIRT1 activation also limits NF-kB-driven cytokine expression. Preclinical evidence is supportive, but in vivo translation is limited by the compound's poor bioavailability. The senomorphic relevance is mechanistically sound, giving moderate confidence for its effect on mitochondrial dysfunction in senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 作為抗氧化劑淬滅來自功能障礙粒線體的 ROS，並透過活化 SIRT1 抑制 SAMD，SIRT1 支持粒線體生成與功能。這減少 SASP 的粒線體衍生發炎驅動，且 SIRT1 活化也限制 NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素表現。臨床前證據支持，但體內轉譯受限於該化合物不佳的生體可用率。其 senomorphic 相關性在機制上健全，對其在衰老中粒線體功能障礙的效應給予中等信度。

links.context: SCAPs are engaged and reinforced by senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD), as senescent cells deploy mitochondrial and metabolic adaptations within their pro-survival network to survive despite mitochondrial stress. SAMD-generated signals (ROS, mtDNA) can both threaten and, via SCAP buffering (e.g., restraint of minority MOMP), protect the cell. The relationship reflects the coexistence of mitochondrial insult with anti-death safeguards. Confidence is moderate given the complexity and context-dependence of mitochondrial-survival crosstalk.
links.context_zh_TW: SCAPs 被衰老相關粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）參與並強化，因衰老細胞在其促存活網絡中部署粒線體與代謝適應以在粒線體壓力下存活。SAMD 產生的訊號（ROS、mtDNA）既能威脅細胞，也能經由 SCAP 緩衝（如抑制少數 MOMP）保護細胞。此關係反映粒線體損害與抗死亡防護的共存。考量粒線體—存活交互作用的複雜性與依脈絡性，信度中等。

links.context: Senomorphics may target KDM4 histone demethylases, whose inhibition blocks SASP factor expression by preserving repressive H3K9me3 and H3K36me3 marks at SASP loci. This is a candidate rather than established clinical strategy, as KDM4 inhibitors are still under characterization, but the mechanistic logic is sound given KDM4's role in licensing the secretome by removing repressive chromatin. The epigenetic opposition to EZH2-mediated silencing shapes net SASP output. Confidence is therefore moderate pending in vivo validation of KDM4-directed senomorphics.
links.context_zh_TW: Senomorphics 可能標靶 KDM4 組蛋白去甲基酶，其抑制透過保留 SASP 基因座處抑制性的 H3K9me3 與 H3K36me3 標記阻斷 SASP 因子表現。這是候選而非已確立的臨床策略，因 KDM4 抑制劑仍在表徵中，但其機制邏輯健全，考慮到 KDM4 經由移除抑制性染色質來許可分泌組的角色。其對 EZH2 介導靜默的表觀遺傳對立塑造淨 SASP 輸出。因此信度中等，有待 KDM4 標靶 senomorphics 的體內驗證。

links.context: Therapy-induced senescence may be modulated by senomorphics -- epigenetic inhibitors (BET, KDM4, DOT1L) under oncology investigation could be repurposed to tame TIS-associated inflammation without reversing the beneficial arrest. By suppressing the SASP, these agents could mitigate therapy toxicity and relapse promotion while preserving tumor-suppressive growth arrest. The concept is mechanistically attractive but largely preclinical, with BET inhibitors the most advanced candidates. Confidence is moderate pending clinical validation.
links.context_zh_TW: 治療誘發衰老可能被 senomorphics 調節——腫瘤學研究中探索的表觀遺傳抑制劑（BET、KDM4、DOT1L）可被重新定位以馴服 TIS 相關發炎而不逆轉有益的停滯。透過抑制 SASP，這些藥劑可減輕治療毒性與復發促進，同時保留腫瘤抑制性生長停滯。此概念在機制上吸引人但多屬臨床前，BET 抑制劑是最先進候選。信度中等，有待臨床驗證。

links.context: AMPK is drawn as an upstream input to p38 MAPK in the SASP-induction scheme, coupling metabolic state to secretome output. The accompanying text of the source review describes the metabolic arm slightly differently, emphasising altered NAD+/NADH ratios influencing the SASP via AMPK-mediated activation of p53 and NAMPT salvage promoting a high pro-inflammatory SASP; NAMPT and the NAD+/NADH pool are shown feeding this arm. The shared implication is that bioenergetic and redox status set the gain on SASP signalling rather than merely permitting it.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，AMPK 被畫為 p38 MAPK 的上游輸入，將代謝狀態耦合至 secretome 輸出。原回顧的正文對此代謝臂的描述略有不同，強調 NAD+/NADH 比值改變經 AMPK 介導的 p53 活化影響 SASP，以及 NAMPT 回收促進高促炎 SASP；圖中顯示 NAMPT 與 NAD+/NADH 池供應此臂。共同含義是生物能量與氧化還原狀態設定 SASP 訊號的增益，而不僅是允許其發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: Aberrant or ectopic tyrosinase-family activity in the brain may contribute to Oxidative Stress in dopaminergic neurons. Shifts in melanogenic enzyme activity affect the redox behavior of neuromelanin. The enzyme therefore connects pigment composition to oxidative vulnerability.
links.context_zh_TW: 大腦中異常或異位的 tyrosinase 家族活性可能導致多巴胺神經元中的 Oxidative Stress。黑色素生成酶活性的變化影響 neuromelanin 的氧化還原行為。因此該酶將色素組成與氧化脆弱性聯繫起來。

links.context: Acid sphingomyelinase was listed among proposed regulators of necroptosis in the 2014 review, pending definitive confirmation.
links.context_zh_TW: 酸性鞘磷脂酶在 2014 年綜述中被列為 necroptosis 之候選調節者，尚待明確證實。

links.context: Adrenolutin is a metabolite of adrenochrome, formed as adrenochrome is further rearranged and oxidized. In hypotheses about stress-induced heart problems, adrenochrome or its metabolites such as adrenolutin have been proposed as mediators of catecholamine toxicity in inflammatory cardiac conditions, and one study suggested the neutrophil-driven adrenaline-to-adrenochrome route could be a catabolic pathway relevant in inflammatory diseases with possible links to cardiac effects. The adrenochrome-to-adrenolutin conversion is part of the broader oxidation chemistry of catecholamines.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenolutin是adrenochrome的metabolite，於adrenochrome進一步rearranged與oxidized時形成。在hypotheses about stress-induced heart problems中，adrenochrome或其如adrenolutin等metabolites被proposed as mediators of catecholamine toxicity in inflammatory cardiac conditions，且有一項study suggested嗜中性球驅動的adrenaline-to-adrenochrome route可能是inflammatory diseases中relevant的catabolic pathway，並possible links to cardiac effects。Adrenochrome-to-adrenolutin conversion是catecholamines更廣泛oxidation chemistry的一部分。

links.context: All-trans retinoic acid drives Drp1 induction and mitochondrial fission, a transcriptional arm that opposes retinol's non-genomic role as a cofactor for mitochondrial PKCdelta in the pyruvate dehydrogenase and oxidative-phosphorylation axis. Retinol deficiency lowers complex I activity and raises mitochondrial ROS, whereas excess retinoid produces mitochondrial swelling, permeability transition and ROS-driven lipid peroxidation. Membrane-phase vitamin E holds this fission response in check, which is the core of the 'too much retinoid is pro-oxidant' caveat.
links.context_zh_TW: All-trans retinoic acid 會誘導 Drp1 與粒線體分裂，這是一條轉錄性途徑，與 retinol 作為粒線體 PKCdelta 共因子、參與 pyruvate dehydrogenase 與氧化磷酸化軸的非基因體角色相互對抗。Retinol 缺乏會降低 complex I 活性並提高粒線體 ROS；相反地，類維生素 A 過量會造成粒線體膨脹、permeability transition 與 ROS 驅動的脂質過氧化。膜相的 vitamin E 會抑制此分裂反應，這正是「類維生素 A 過量具 pro-oxidant 作用」此一警示的核心。

links.context: Androgen Receptor signalling raises Ferroptosis susceptibility in male tissue, with MBOAT2 identified as a direct AR target in contrast to the ER-regulated MBOAT1. Testosterone is therefore a dominant susceptibility factor for Ferroptosis in settings such as renal ischemia, which mirrors the estrogen-driven antioxidant program retained in females.
links.context_zh_TW: Androgen Receptor 訊息會提高雄性組織對 Ferroptosis 的易感性，其中 MBOAT2 被確認為 AR 的直接標的，與受 ER 調控的 MBOAT1 形成對比。因此在腎臟缺血等情境下，Testosterone 是 Ferroptosis 的主要易感因子，這與雌性保留的雌激素驅動抗氧化程式形成鏡像對照。

links.context: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is a physiological reductant capable of reducing silver ions to metallic silver, alongside catecholamines which act similarly. This reduction is one route by which absorbed silver is transformed within tissues. Because ascorbate and catecholamines are ubiquitous reducing agents, the reductive formation of elemental silver in vivo is thought to contribute to the pigmented tissue deposits seen in argyria, and the same chemistry is exploited in laboratory synthesis of silver nanoparticles.
links.context_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸（維生素C）是一種生理還原劑，能夠將銀離子還原為金屬銀，兒茶酚胺也具有類似作用。此還原是吸收的銀在組織內轉化的一種途徑。由於抗壞血酸鹽和兒茶酚胺是普遍存在的還原劑，體內元素銀的還原形成被認為有助於argyria中見到的色素組織沉積，相同的化學也應用於實驗室合成銀奈米粒子。

links.context: Ascorbic acid reduces protein-bound silver to metallic deposits in transport. Reduction precipitates the carried load.
links.context_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸在運輸中將蛋白結合銀還原為金屬沉積。還原沉澱攜帶負荷。

links.context: At lower exposure, fisetin exhibits senomorphic effects, suppressing the SASP and NF-kB/IL-6 signaling without necessarily killing senescent cells. This dose-dependent duality means fisetin can be tuned toward clearance or modulation, and the senomorphic facet is supported by multiple studies. It is, however, best characterized as secondary to fisetin's more prominent senolytic action, which dominates at higher doses. Confidence in the senomorphic component is moderate, with the senolytic activity better established.
links.context_zh_TW: 在較低暴露下，fisetin 展現 senomorphic 效應，抑制 SASP 與 NF-κB/IL-6 訊號而不必然殺死衰老細胞。此依劑量的雙重性意味 fisetin 可調向清除或調節，且 senomorphic 面向獲多項研究支持。然而，它最佳特徵為次於 fisetin 更突出的 senolytic 作用，後者在較高劑量占主導。senomorphic 組成的信度中等，senolytic 活性較確立。

links.context: Avermectin's derivative ivermectin is under active preclinical investigation for anticancer repositioning (Wnt/beta-catenin, AKT/mTOR and PAK1 inhibition; apoptosis; multidrug-resistance reversal).
links.context_zh_TW: Avermectin 的衍生物伊維菌素正在積極進行抗癌重新定位的臨牀前研究（Wnt/β-連環蛋白、AKT/mTOR 和 PAK1 抑制；細胞凋亡；逆轉多重抗藥性）。

links.context: BIG1 may engage the Actin Cytoskeleton, and possibly microtubule networks, as tracks for directed transport of intracellular cargo. By coupling vesicle movement to the Actin Cytoskeleton, BIG1 helps deliver proteins to defined cellular locations, which is what allows cells to mount rapid and spatially precise responses to environmental change.
links.context_zh_TW: BIG1 可能與 Actin Cytoskeleton（可能也包括微管網路）結合，將其作為細胞內貨物的定向運輸軌道。BIG1 透過把囊泡移動與 Actin Cytoskeleton 耦合，協助將蛋白質運送至特定胞內位置；這正是細胞能對環境變化做出迅速且空間精確反應的原因。

links.context: Base Excision Repair is essential for development, tissue maintenance and stress adaptation, and its dysregulation or impairment contributes to aging as well as to metabolic disease, neurodegeneration and cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Base Excision Repair 對發育、組織維持與壓力適應不可或缺；其失調或功能受損會促成老化，以及代謝疾病、神經退化與癌症。

links.context: Bax-knockout fibroblasts resist PARP-1-dependent death with compromised AIF release, but Bcl-2 overexpression only delays rather than blocks death and the 12-h window leaves delay-vs-rescue unresolved, so BAX as obligatory AIF-release pore downstream of PAR remains a candidate (Andrabi 2008; David 2009).
links.context_zh_TW: Bax 敲除成纤维细胞抵抗 PARP-1 依赖死亡且 AIF 释放受损，但 Bcl-2 过表达仅延迟不阻断，12 小时窗口无法区分延迟与挽救，故 BAX 作为 PAR 下游 AIF 释放孔仍为候选。

links.context: Benzimidazole anthelmintics including fenbendazole show preclinical anticancer activity across leukemic models via microtubule disruption.
links.context_zh_TW: Benzimidazole 包括芬苯達唑在內的驅蟲藥物透過微管破壞在白血病模型中顯示出臨牀前抗癌活性。

links.context: Beyond its antiarrhythmic action, amiodarone has a recognised inflammatory toxicity axis: chronic use is associated with pulmonary fibrosis and interstitial pneumonitis driven by inflammatory and fibrotic mechanisms in the lung. This is why its long-term use requires monitoring of pulmonary and thyroid function.
links.context_zh_TW: 除了抗心律不整作用外，Amiodarone 另有明確的發炎毒性軸：長期使用與肺部發炎及纖維化機制所驅動的肺纖維化與間質性肺炎相關。這也是長期用藥需監測肺功能與甲狀腺功能的原因。

links.context: Beyond its haemostatic indication, conflicting reports indicate that carbazochrome sulfonic acid can inhibit autophagy in some cellular contexts. This matters for mitohormetic redox-relay strategies in which therapeutic benefit depends on mitophagic clearance of damaged mitochondria.
links.context_zh_TW: 在止血適應症之外，有互相衝突的報告指出 Carbazochrome sulfonic acid 在某些細胞情境下可能抑制 Autophagy。這對以線粒體自噬清除受損粒線體來獲益的 mitohormetic redox-relay 策略而言具有重要性。

links.context: Beyond neuronal inhibition, GABA and its receptors exert tumor-modulatory effects: GABA_B receptor signaling can suppress cAMP/ERK-driven proliferation in some carcinomas, and GABA release by glioblastoma cells shapes the peritumoral excitatory/inhibitory balance and seizure propensity. GABA receptors are therefore being explored as modifiers of the tumor microenvironment and the neuro-immune axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 除了神經元抑制作用之外，GABA 及其受體還具有調節腫瘤的效果：GABA_B 受體訊號可在某些 carcinoma 中抑制 cAMP/ERK 驅動的增殖，而 glioblastoma 細胞釋放 GABA 會塑造腫瘤周圍的興奮/抑制平衡與癲癇傾向。因此 GABA 受體正被探索作為 tumor microenvironment 與神經免疫軸的調節因子。

links.context: By carrying PAR into the cytoplasm and engaging AIF, p89 links the parthanatos executioner machinery to the apoptotic cleavage cascade. It remains open whether p89-PAR preferentially engages MIF or CypA/H2AX nuclease complexes, and what the stoichiometry of p89-bound versus free PAR is in signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 藉由將 PAR 帶入細胞質並招募 AIF，p89 把 parthanatos 的執行機制與凋亡切割級聯連結起來。仍未釐清的是 p89-PAR 究竟偏好作用於 MIF 還是 CypA/H2AX 核酸酶複合體，以及在訊號傳遞中 p89 結合型與游離型 PAR 的莫耳比。

links.context: Cardiotoxicity is a key safety endpoint alongside drug-induced liver injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 心臟毒性是與藥物性肝損傷並列的關鍵安全終點。

links.context: Cholangiocarcinoma harbors cancer stem-like cells that drive recurrence and chemoresistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 含有促進復發和化療抗藥性的癌症幹細胞樣細胞。

links.context: Chronic SASP from therapy-induced senescent cells may promote therapy resistance, fibrosis, and aging phenotypes, and in established tumors it can enhance cancer stemness and relapse. The secreted factors, particularly IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, create a permissive, pro-tumorigenic microenvironment despite the initial anti-tumor arrest. This Janus-faced role complicates the net benefit of therapies that induce senescence. The promoting effect is context-dependent, giving moderate confidence, and motivates senomorphic adjuncts to chemotherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 治療誘發衰老細胞的慢性 SASP 可能促進治療抗藥性、纖維化與老化表型，且在已建立腫瘤中可增強癌症幹性與復發。儘管最初有抗腫瘤停滯，分泌因子（特別是經 JAK/STAT3 的 IL-6 與 IL-8）創造允許、促腫瘤的微環境。此兩面角色使誘發衰老的療法淨益處複雜化。促進效應依脈絡而定，信度中等，並促使以 senomorphic 作為化療輔助。

links.context: Chronic ultraviolet exposure impairs NRF2 nuclear translocation and antioxidant response transcription. Suppression weakens the inducible defense of photoaged skin.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性紫外線暴露損害 NRF2 核轉位與抗氧化反應轉錄。抑制削弱光老化皮膚的誘導防禦。

links.context: Creatine Supplementation, and alternatively Guanidinoacetate (GAA) supplementation, improved functional capacity, pain, depression, sleep and quality of life in small open-label studies of Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) and fibromyalgia. The benefits waned after supplementation stopped, and the evidence remains preliminary pending larger trials.
links.context_zh_TW: Creatine Supplementation（或替代的 Guanidinoacetate (GAA) 補充）在針對 Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) 與 fibromyalgia 的小型開放性研究中，改善了功能容量、疼痛、憂鬱、睡眠與生活品質。停止補充後效益減退，且在更大型試驗前證據仍屬初步性質。

links.context: Creatine augments the anticancer efficacy of the metabolite methylglyoxal (MG). Creatine content and energy availability are low in several types of malignant cells and in the T cells that mediate immune responses against cancer, and the creatine transporter SLC6A8 is markedly increased in tumor-infiltrating immune cells. Patra et al. reported that MG efficacy is significantly augmented in the presence of creatine, and combined administration of creatine, methylglyoxal, and ascorbic acid provided greater efficacy and eliminated visible signs of tumor growth. Creatine and creatine kinase, very low in sarcoma tissue, were significantly elevated with concomitant regression of tumor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 肌酸可增強代謝物甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal，MG）的抗癌療效。多種惡性細胞以及介導抗癌免疫反應的T細胞中，肌酸含量與能量可用性均偏低；而腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中的肌酸轉運蛋白SLC6A8則顯著增加。Patra等人報告，在肌酸存在下MG的療效顯著增強；合併投予肌酸、甲基乙二醛與抗壞血酸（ascorbic acid）可提供更大的療效，並消除可見的腫瘤生長跡象。肉瘤組織中原本極低的肌酸與肌酸激酶顯著升高，伴隨腫瘤細胞的消退。

links.context: Cyclic-nucleotide tone set by phosphodiesterases modulates AMPK and sirtuin outputs: cAMP/CREB and PGC-1α networks overlap with SIRT1-dependent mitochondrial programs, and PDE inhibition can shift cells toward oxidative metabolism. Some pleiotropic effects of resveratrol and related sirtuin activators involve this cyclic-nucleotide cross-talk.
links.context_zh_TW: 由磷酸二酯酶設定的環核苷酸張力會調節 AMPK 與 sirtuin 的輸出：cAMP/CREB 與 PGC-1α 網絡與 SIRT1 依賴的粒線體程式重疊，PDE 抑制可將細胞推向氧化代謝。白藜蘆醇等 sirtuin 活化劑的部分多效性也涉及這種環核苷酸交互作用。

links.context: Cysteine adduction by adrenochrome functionally impairs Complex I beyond redox cycling at the site. Inhibition is single-source and kept at 0.70.
links.context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素半胱胺酸加成在位點氧化還原循環之外功能性損害複合體 I。抑制為單一來源，維持 0.70。

links.context: Cytosolic DNA sensing feeds AP-1 activation downstream; the file's Path Traces asserted the reverse, but Mechanism Summary establishes cGAS-STING as upstream sensor. Corrected direction recorded here.
links.context_zh_TW: 胞質 DNA 感知在下游供養 AP-1 活化；檔案的 Path Traces 主張相反，但 Mechanism Summary 確立 cGAS-STING 為上游感受器。此記錄修正後的方向。

links.context: Defects in the Apoptosis signaling pathways that normally eliminate damaged or potentially malignant cells allow malignant transformation and, ultimately, tumour Metastasis and resistance to anticancer drugs. Apoptosis therefore acts as a gatekeeper whose failure licenses the metastatic program rather than being a late consequence of it.
links.context_zh_TW: 正常情況下負責清除受損或潛在惡性細胞的 Apoptosis 訊號路徑一旦失靈，就會容許惡性轉化，並最終促成腫瘤的 Metastasis 與對抗癌藥物的抗藥性。因此 Apoptosis 是一座守門機制，其失效等於放行轉移程序，而非轉移的晚期後果。

links.context: Demethylation by 5-Azacytidine reactivates silenced CDH1; inference from drug listing, capped. Reactivation is the epidrug mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 去甲基化重新活化沉默的 CDH1；自藥物列表的推斷，設上限。重新活化是表觀藥物機制。

links.context: Diabetic retinopathy degeneration is linked to retinal NAD+ loss in photoreceptors. Association records the metabolic retinopathy connection.
links.context_zh_TW: 糖尿病視網膜病變退化與感光細胞視網膜 NAD+ 缺失相關。關聯記錄代謝性視網膜病變連結。

links.context: Dietary protein elicits a larger Thermic Effect of Food than carbohydrate or fat, so the heat increment of feeding tracks dietary protein intake and its post-absorptive cost. Because this component of the energy budget is tied to food intake rather than to activity, Speakman and Selman argue it cannot account for the obesity epidemic — a fall in expenditure through this route would require a matching fall in intake, which has not occurred.
links.context_zh_TW: 膳食蛋白質引起的 Thermic Effect of Food 高於碳水化合物或脂肪，因此進食熱增量會隨飲食蛋白質攝取量及其吸收後的代謝代價而變動。由於此一能量預算組成與食物攝取量而非活動量相關，Speakman 與 Selman 認為它無法解釋肥胖流行——透過此途徑的消耗下降需要攝取量同步下降，而實際上並未發生。

links.context: Early axonal pathology accompanies Alzheimer's Disease progression. Association records shared axonopathy across neurodegenerations.
links.context_zh_TW: 早期軸突病理伴隨 Alzheimer's Disease 進展。關聯記錄神經退化間共享的軸突病變。

links.context: Enhanced expression and phosphorylation of SIRT7 has been reported to promote cardiac fibrosis via activation of SMAD2 and ERK signaling pathways, while SIRT7 knockout in mice has paradoxically also been reported to result in cardiac fibrosis. The relationship is therefore bidirectional or context-dependent, with SMAD2 serving as a downstream effector of SIRT7's non-deacetylase signaling in the fibrotic program.
links.context_zh_TW: 有報告指出 SIRT7 的表現與磷酸化增強會透過活化 SMAD2 與 ERK 訊息途徑促進心肌纖維化，但也有報告指出小鼠 SIRT7 敲除同樣造成心肌纖維化。因此此關係是雙向或依情境而定的，SMAD2 則作為 SIRT7 非去乙醯化訊息在纖維化程式中的下游效應者。

links.context: Epigenetic target classes including histone methyltransferases are screened for H3K27me3 modulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 含組蛋白甲基轉移酶的表觀遺傳標的類被篩選以調節 H3K27me3。

links.context: Erythropoietin is the kidney-derived cytokine induced by hypoxia-inducible factors that drives red cell production via the EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 axis. In chronic kidney disease, EPO deficiency and accelerated eryptosis coincide, producing anaemia; sepsis alters EPO responsiveness.
links.context_zh_TW: Erythropoietin 是由 hypoxia-inducible factors 誘導、腎臟來源的細胞激素，透過 EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 軸驅動紅血球生成。在 chronic kidney disease 中，EPO 缺乏與加速的 eryptosis 同時出現而造成貧血；sepsis 則會改變 EPO 的反應性。

links.context: Estrogen signaling engages HDAC3 to repress STING transcription, dampening cGAS-STING output; loss of this axis derepresses innate DNA-sensing inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Estrogen 訊號透過 HDAC3 抑制 STING 轉錄，降低 cGAS-STING 輸出；此軸喪失將解除先天 DNA 感測發炎的抑制。

links.context_zh_TW: CDH2/N-cadherin 下游 FGFR 介導的遷移促進移動。設上限的促進邊。

links.context_zh_TW: 禁食營養剝奪訊號經由 mTORC1 抑制解除起始抑制。抑制是禁食關閉開關。
