links.context_zh_TW: Carnosine（beta-alanyl-L-histidine）是高度濃縮於肌肉與腦部的二胜肽，具有抗氧化、pH 緩衝與抗糖化活性。在 Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield 策略中，它作為金屬螯合與 AGE 抑制的協同劑，與 aminoguanidine 及自噬誘導物 spermidine 一同穩定蛋白質穩態環境、對抗細胞外基質的氧化損傷——GOPS 方案 以 carnosine 穩定的 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 雜交分子搭配 spermidine 驅動的自噬。

links.context: Caspase-1 cleaves Gasdermin D, whose N-terminal fragment forms pores in the plasma membrane, executing pyroptosis. Pore formation leads to cell swelling and rupture with release of proinflammatory cytokines. Gasdermin D is thus the executioner of pyroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-1 裂解 Gasdermin D，其 N 端片段在質膜上形成孔洞，執行細胞焦亡。孔洞形成導致細胞腫脹與破裂，並釋放促發炎細胞因子。因此 Gasdermin D 是細胞焦亡的執行者。

links.context: Caspase-3 is activated early in oncogene-induced senescence and exerts non-apoptotic, senescence-reinforcing functions (Tang et al. 2012, PMID 22863278) — it is the only caspase with non-trivial PPR flow into Senescence/SASP/Autophagy, connecting the death machinery to the aging program.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在致癌基因誘導衰老早期被活化，並施展非凋亡、強化衰老的功能（Tang et al. 2012, PMID 22863278）——它是唯一對 Senescence/SASP/Autophagy 有顯著 PPR 流量的 caspase，把死亡機械與老化程式連結。

links.context: Caspase-3 removes the inhibitory C-terminal fragment of ROCK1, activating it.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 移除 ROCK1 抑制性 C 端片段以活化之。

links.context: Caspases are the executioner proteases of the female-preferred (XX) death arm: female cells show higher and earlier caspase-3 (Liu et al., Stroke 2009) and ~3x greater, uniquely nuclear-translocating caspase-8 (Sharma et al., ASN Neuro 2011) after ischemia, and pan-caspase inhibition protects females but not males in experimental stroke.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspases 是女性偏好（XX）死亡分支的執行蛋白酶：缺血後女性細胞的 caspase-3 較高且更早（Liu 等，Stroke 2009），caspase-8 約 3 倍且具 XX 特有的核轉位（Sharma 等，ASN Neuro 2011），而廣效 caspase 抑制在實驗性中風中僅保護雌性而對雄性無效。

links.context: Caspases are the female-preferred death effectors in the XX-caspase / XY-PARP-1-AIF framework. Caspase-3/8 activation is higher and earlier in female (XX) cells and neurons after ischemia, and pan-caspase inhibition protects females but not males in experimental stroke.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspases 是 XX-caspase / XY-PARP-1-AIF 架構中女性偏好的死亡效應因子。缺血後女性（XX）細胞與神經元的 caspase-3/8 活化較高且較早，而廣效 caspase 抑制在實驗性中風中僅保護雌性。

links.context: Cataract — opacification of the lens — is the most thoroughly characterized pathology of racemization. Human lens γ-crystallins accumulate D-aspartic acid at defined positions (Asp-58, Asp-151) with age, and the extent of racemization correlates directly with cataract severity because D-Asp promotes protein unfolding, aggregation, and light scattering.
links.context_zh_TW: Cataract（水晶體混濁）是外消旋化最被充分描述的病理表現。人類水晶體 γ-crystallin 隨年齡在特定位置（Asp-58、Asp-151）累積 D-天門冬胺酸，且外消旋化程度與白內障嚴重度直接相關，因 D-Asp 促進蛋白質解摺、聚集與光散射。

links.context: Catechol toxicity is mediated predominantly by its oxidation product o-benzoquinone, a strongly electrophilic species that rapidly arylates protein cysteine residues and glutathione. This quinone-driven depletion of intracellular glutathione and oxidative injury triggers apoptosis in susceptible cell types and produces mitochondrial dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechol 的毒性主要由其氧化產物 o-benzoquinone 介導；此強親電子物種會迅速與蛋白質半胱胺酸殘基及 glutathione 發生芳基化反應。這種 quinone 驅動的細胞內 glutathione 耗竭與氧化傷害，會在易感細胞中誘發 apoptosis 並造成粒線體功能障礙。

links.context: Catecholamine polymerization proceeds by oxidative coupling of quinoid intermediates through semiquinone radical chain propagation, yielding the dark brown neuromelanin that accumulates with age in catecholaminergic neurons of the Substantia Nigra and Locus Coeruleus.
links.context_zh_TW: 兒茶酚胺的聚合經由 quinoid 中間體的氧化偶聯、以 semiquinone 自由基作為鏈傳播物進行，最終生成深褐色 [[Neuromelanin]]，在人一生中累積於 [[Substantia Nigra]] 與 [[Locus Coeruleus]] 的兒茶酚胺神經元。

links.context: Catecholamines act as reducing agents for Silver, donating electrons that convert oxidized silver ions back to the zero-valent elemental state within tissues. This re-reduction is one of two routes (the other being ascorbic acid) by which silver becomes the insoluble metallic deposit that accumulates in skin and underlies Argyria.
links.context_zh_TW: Catecholamines 是 Silver 的還原劑，提供電子將氧化態的 silver ion 還原為零價金屬態。這條再還原途徑（另一條為 ascorbic acid）是 silver 轉變為不溶性金屬沉積、累積於皮膚並造成 Argyria 的兩種機制之一。

links.context: Catechols are inactivated by COMT-mediated O-methylation, a reaction that consumes one methyl group (transferred from SAMe) per catechol molecule. When exogenous catechols such as high-dose Quercetin, Fisetin, Luteolin, or green-tea EGCG are introduced in slow-COMT individuals, the added substrate load raises methyl-group demand on the Methylation Cycle, the pathway that regenerates SAMe from homocysteine remethylation. Sustained catechol load can therefore tax methylation capacity, linking catechol exposure to methyl-donor burden and explaining why catechol-rich supplements are often poorly tolerated in slow COMT carriers.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechols 藉由 COMT 催化的 O-甲基化反應被去活化，每個 catechol 分子消耗一個由 SAMe 轉移的甲基。當慢速 COMT 個體攝入外源性 catechols（如高劑量 Quercetin、Fisetin、Luteolin 或綠茶 EGCG）時，增加的受質負荷會提高 Methylation Cycle 的甲基需求，而 Methylation Cycle 是藉由 homocysteine 再甲基化再生 SAMe 的路徑。持續的 catechol 負荷因此可能耗損甲基化能力，將 catechol 暴露與甲基供體負擔連結起來，也解釋了為何富含 catechol 的補充劑在慢速 COMT 帶原者中常不易耐受。

links.context: Cathepsin D is an aspartic lysosomal protease and, together with cathepsin B, a major driver of the proteolytic degradation of intracellular proteins modified by advanced glycation end products such as N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine, which are targeted to the lysosome for clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsin D 是一種天門冬胺酸型溶小體蛋白酶，與 Cathepsin B 一起，是降解被 Advanced Glycation End Products（如 N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine）修飾之細胞內蛋白質的主要驅動力；這些蛋白質會被導向 Lysosome 加以清除。

links.context: Cathepsin K, abundantly expressed in osteoclasts, is the principal protease responsible for degrading type I collagen during bone resorption, and its activity is essential for normal skeletal remodelling and calcium homeostasis. Excessive cathepsin K activity in osteoclasts instead contributes to pathological bone loss in osteoporosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Osteoclasts 中高度表現的 Cathepsin K，是骨吸收過程中降解第一型 Collagen 的主要蛋白酶，其活性對正常骨骼重塑與鈣恆定不可或缺。相對地，Osteoclasts 中過度的 Cathepsin K 活性會促成 Osteoporosis 中的病理性骨質流失。

links.context: Cathepsin L1-mediated H3.3 clipping produces the truncated fragment H3.3cs1, which accumulates in senescent cells and can itself induce senescence. When BRD4 protection fails, clipping increases chromatin accessibility and activating marks (H3K27ac, H3K122ac, H3K4me3), enhancing transcription of SASP factor genes — placing cathepsin L1 at the intersection of histone-variant metabolism and SASP induction.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsin L1 介導的 H3.3 切割會產生截短片段 H3.3cs1，該片段在衰老細胞中累積並可自行誘發衰老。當 BRD4 的保護作用失效時，切割會提高染色質可近性與活化標記（H3K27ac、H3K122ac、H3K4me3），增強 SASP 因子基因的轉錄——使 cathepsin L1 位於組蛋白變異體代謝與 SASP 誘導的交會點。

links.context: Cathepsins B, L and S are frequently upregulated in malignant tumours, where they degrade extracellular matrix components to facilitate invasion and metastasis. Their secretion by cancer cells and tumour-associated macrophages creates pericellular proteolytic hotspots that drive tissue invasion and also promote angiogenesis and modulate immune surveillance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsins B、L 與 S 在惡性腫瘤中常見表現上調，藉由降解 Extracellular Matrix 成分來促進侵犯與轉移。癌細胞與腫瘤相關巨噬細胞分泌這些蛋白酶，製造細胞周圍的蛋白水解熱點以驅動組織侵犯，並同時促進血管新生與調節免疫監視。

links.context: CeTOR represses hlh-30 transcription: inactivation of CeTOR by RNAi induces hlh-30 expression, showing that mTOR controls the C. elegans TFEB orthologue at the transcriptional level. This is a reciprocal arrangement to the mammalian one, where mTOR instead acts on TFEB protein through phosphorylation, and it helps explain why CeTOR inhibition alone is insufficient to fully activate the fat-mobilization program.
links.context_zh_TW: CeTOR 抑制 hlh-30 的轉錄：以 RNAi 使 CeTOR 失活會誘導 hlh-30 表現，顯示 mTOR 在轉錄層級調控 C. elegans 的 TFEB 直系同源基因。這與哺乳類的安排相反，哺乳類中 mTOR 反而透過磷酸化作用於 TFEB 蛋白；這也有助於解釋為何單純抑制 CeTOR 不足以完全啟動脂肪動員程式。
links.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

links.context: Celastrol extends lifespan in obese mice and improves metabolic health by activating AMPK and SIRT1. It acts as a caloric restriction mimetic and has anti-inflammatory activity via NF-kB inhibition.
links.context_zh_TW: Celastrol 延長肥胖小鼠的壽命，並藉由活化 AMPK 與 SIRT1 改善代謝健康。它作為 caloric restriction mimetic，並透過 NF-κB 抑制產生抗發炎作用。

links.context: Celastrol, a pentacyclic triterpenoid, activates the HSF1 stress response and the NRF2 antioxidant pathway, linking proteotoxic stress handling to its autophagy-inducing and longevity effects.
links.context_zh_TW: Celastrol 作為五環三萜類化合物，可活化 HSF1 壓力反應與 NRF2 抗氧化途徑，將蛋白毒性壓力的處理與其誘導自噬及延長壽命的效果連結起來。

links.context: Cell Membranes are essential for cell signaling because their receptor proteins initiate signaling cascades at the cell surface, and they also underlie ion transport, endocytosis, exocytosis, and cell adhesion. Membrane potential and ion gradients are maintained by channels and transporters embedded in the bilayer.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Membranes 對 cell signaling 至关重要，因為其受體蛋白在細胞表面啟動訊息級聯；膜同時也是離子運輸、endocytosis、exocytosis 與 cell adhesion 的基礎。膜電位與離子梯度則由嵌於雙層中的通道與運輸蛋白維持。

links.context: Cell migration is driven by cytoskeletal dynamics: actin polymerization at the leading edge generates protrusion, myosin motors on actin tracks produce contractility, and focal-adhesion turnover couples the cytoskeleton to matrix. FAK signaling transduces adhesion and stiffness cues into these cytoskeletal remodeling programs.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell migration 由 cytoskeleton 的動態變化驅動：前緣的 actin 聚合產生突出，actin 上的 myosin 马達產生收縮力，而 focal adhesion 的更替則把 cytoskeleton 與基質耦合。FAK signaling 將黏附與硬度訊號轉譯為這些 cytoskeleton 重塑程式。

links.context: Cellular Senescence is a root cause of multiple Age-Related Diseases: senolytic interventions such as Fisetin or the Dasatinib plus Quercetin combination clear senescent cells and thereby alleviate frailty, atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, and renal dysfunction in preclinical models, reducing pathology across several disease categories in aged mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞 Senescence 是多項 Age-Related Diseases 的根本成因：Fisetin 或 Dasatinib 加 Quercetin 等 senolytic 介入可清除衰老細胞，在前臨床模型中緩解虛弱、動脈粥狀硬化、骨關節炎與腎功能障礙，並在老化小鼠中降低多類疾病的病理變化。

links.context: Cellular methylglyoxal is cleared by the glyoxalase system (GLO1/GLO2), which uses glutathione as the cofactor for conversion to less reactive species; the drain on glutathione and the resulting glycation burden are the basis of MG's toxicity when detoxification is overwhelmed.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞內的 methylglyoxal 由 glyoxalase system（GLO1/GLO2）清除，該系統以 glutathione 為輔因子將其轉為反應性較低的物種；glutathione 的消耗與隨之而來的糖化負擔，構成解毒被壓垮時 MG 毒性的基礎。

links.context: Cerebrospinal Fluid, the clear fluid bathing the CNS ventricles and subarachnoid space, acts as a conduit for cGAS-STING activation: both cGAMP, the second messenger synthesized by cGAS, and downstream inflammatory cytokines partition into CSF, letting activation signals spread beyond the local site of nucleic acid sensing. CSF cGAMP and cytokine levels are therefore candidate biomarkers of pathway activation.
links.context_zh_TW: Cerebrospinal Fluid（腦脊髓液）是浸潤 CNS 腦室與蛛網膜下腔的清澈液體，作為 cGAS-STING Pathway 活化的傳導管道：cGAS 合成的第二訊使 cGAMP 與下游發炎性細胞激素皆可分配進入 CSF，使活化訊號得以超越核酸感測的局部位置擴散。因此 CSF 中的 cGAMP 與細胞激素濃度可作為該路徑活化的候選生物標記。

links.context: Certain Advanced Glycation End Products of dietary origin, notably Pyrraline, are taken up from the intestinal lumen into the blood or lymph by specific transporters such as hPEPT1. This makes intestinal absorption a route by which ingested AGEs enter systemic circulation and can exert their biological effects at distant tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 某些飲食來源的 Advanced Glycation End Products，尤其是 Pyrraline，會透過 hPEPT1 等特定轉運蛋白由腸腔被吸收進入血液或淋巴。這使腸道吸收成為攝入性 AGEs 進入全身循環、並在遠端組織發揮生物效應的途徑。

links.context: Chelators such as EDTA suppress epinephrine autoxidation by sequestering the catalytic transition metals, chiefly Fe2+ and Cu+, that drive Fenton-type hydroperoxide decomposition. Blocking these metal ions removes the most efficient initiators of the radical chain, and chelators such as these are therefore standard additives in epinephrine formulations alongside antioxidants.
links.context_zh_TW: EDTA 等螯合劑藉由隔離主要催化鏈反應的過渡金屬（尤其是 Fe2+ 與 Cu+）來抑制 Epinephrine 的 autoxidation；這些金屬以 Fenton 型化學分解過氧化氫物。阻斷這些金屬離子即移除了自由基鏈最有效的起始機制，因此這類螯合劑與抗氧化劑同為 Epinephrine 處方中的標準添加物。

links.context: Chlorpromazine's bulky 10-nitrogen side chain blocks the free heterocyclic nitrogen required for alternative electron transfer, so it shows no methylene-blue-like neuroprotection: no increase in cytochrome c reduction or oxygen consumption rate, no Complex I→III electron shunt, ~1000-fold weaker potency than methylene blue against glutamate insult, and — uniquely — a pro-oxidative signature in cell-free lysate assays. It was the only compound tested that failed to protect against rotenone neurotoxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: Chlorpromazine bulky 的 10-氮側鏈阻斷了替代性電子傳遞所需的游離雜環氮，因此不具 methylene blue 式的神經保護：未增加 cytochrome c 還原量或氧消耗率、無 Complex I→III 電子分流、對 glutamate 傷害的效力比 methylene blue 弱約 1000 倍，且獨具在無細胞溶血產物試驗中的促氧化特徵。它是受測化合物中唯一無法防止 rotenone 神經毒性的物質。

links.context: Cholesterol Metabolism and Autophagy are linked in both directions: Autophagy delivers cholesterol from lipid droplets to lysosomes for hydrolysis by Lysosomal Acid Lipase, while accumulated cholesterol impairs autophagic flux. Conversely, adequate autophagic capacity supports cholesterol efflux and prevents lipotoxic accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 與 Autophagy 呈雙向關聯：Autophagy 將胆固醇從脂滴運送至 lysosome，由 Lysosomal Acid Lipase 水解；反之，胆固醇堆積會損害自噬流。足夠的自噬能力則支持胆固醇外排，避免脂毒性累積。

links.context: Cholesterol is a major structural component of Cell Membranes, where it modulates membrane fluidity and contributes to formation of cholesterol- and sphingolipid-enriched signaling microdomains in which membrane proteins diffuse laterally under the fluid mosaic model.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol（膽固醇）是 Cell Membranes 的主要結構成分，可調節膜流動性，並促成富含膽固醇與鞘脂的訊息微區形成；在流體鑲嵌模型中，膜蛋白於其中可側向擴散。

links.context: Chromaffin cells are neuroendocrine cells that form the principal secretory population of the Adrenal medulla, with extra-adrenal populations in the paraganglia and sympathetic ganglia of the Autonomic Nervous System. Embryologically neural crest-derived, they are modified postganglionic sympathetic neurons that lost their axons and release hormones directly into the circulation.
links.context_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells 是神經內分泌細胞，構成 Adrenal medulla 的主要分泌細胞群，並在 Autonomic Nervous System 的副神經節與交感神經節中存在腎上腺外族群。其胚胎來源為神經脊，實質上是失去軸突的交感節後神經元修飾型，直接將激素釋放至循環中。

links.context: Chromaffin cells synthesize and store Catecholamines, principally Epinephrine and Norepinephrine, in dense-core granules. When Epinephrine released from these cells is oxidized by oxidants or metal-catalyzed reactions, it can form Adrenochrome, an aminochrome product that links chromaffin cell biology to the oxidative-stress chemistry of the adrenochrome hypothesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells 在緻密核心顆粒中合成並儲存 Catecholamines，主要為 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine。當由這些細胞釋放的 Epinephrine 被氧化劑或金屬催化反應氧化時，可形成 Adrenochrome——一種 aminochrome 產物，將嗜鉻細胞生物學與腎上腺紅素假說中的氧化應化學相連。

links.context: Chromatin reorganization underlies establishment of the pluripotent state. Requirement gates pluripotency on plasticity.
links.context_zh_TW: 染色質重組構成多能性狀態建立的基礎。必要性將多能性門控於可塑性。

links.context: Chromosome segregation during mitosis and meiosis is mediated by microtubule attachment at the centromere, making the centromere a required structural landmark for accurate division.
links.context_zh_TW: 有絲分裂與減數分裂期間的染色體分離，是藉由微管在 centromere 處的附著而完成，因此 centromere 是準確分裂所必需的結構性地標。

links.context: Chronic ER stress and dysregulated autophagy underpin neurodegeneration (Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's), type 2 diabetes beta-cell failure, cancer and ischaemia-reperfusion injury. Chemical chaperones such as TUDCA and 4-PBA and UPR modulators such as ISRIB are in preclinical development to relieve it.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 ER 壓力與失調的自噬是神經退行性疾病（阿茲海默、帕金森、亨廷頓）、第二型糖尿病 β 細胞衰竭、癌症與缺血再灌流損傷的基礎；以 TUDCA、4-PBA 等化學伴護分子與 ISRIB 等 UPR 調節劑緩解 ER 壓力，目前處於臨床前開發階段。

links.context: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

links.context: Chronic exposure to high glucose or fatty acids in Metabolic Syndromes leaves 'epigenetic scars' — altered DNA Methylation and Epigenetic Alterations such as loss of Heterochromatin — that persist even after the metabolic factors are normalized. The resulting Inflammation is both cause and consequence of these changes, which is why metabolic syndrome is read as a marker of early aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Metabolic Syndromes 中，長期暴露於高血糖或脂肪酸會留下「表觀遺傳疤痕」——改變的 DNA Methylation 以及如異染色質流失等 Epigenetic Alterations——即使代謝因素恢復正常後仍持續存在。由此引發的 Inflammation 既是這些改變的原因也是其後果，因此代謝症候群被視為早期老化的指標。

links.context: Chronic hepatitis B and C virus infection and steatohepatitis drive persistent inflammation that promotes cirrhosis and a pro-tumorigenic niche in hepatocellular carcinoma. SASP-driven chronic inflammation is a key mechanism in obesity-associated HCC. Inflammation is therefore central to HCC pathogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 B 型和 C 型肝炎病毒感染以及脂肪性肝炎驅動持續發炎，促進肝硬化與肝細胞癌的促腫瘤微環境。SASP 驅動的慢性發炎是肥胖相關 HCC 的關鍵機制。因此發炎對 HCC 的發病機制至關重要。

links.context: Chronic immune activation sustains fibrogenic programs. Promotion is the inflammatory feed into scarring.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性免疫活化維持纖維化生成程序。促進是發炎對疤痕的供養。

links.context: Chronic kidney disease is both a cause and a consequence of elevated AGE levels in the blood: reduced renal clearance raises circulating AGEs, and elevated AGEs in turn drive renal injury. Consistently, elevated plasma CML was found to be independently associated with CKD and with estimated glomerular filtration rate at baseline and after three to six years of follow-up.
links.context_zh_TW: Chronic Kidney Disease 既是血液中 AGE 濃度升高的原因，也是其結果：腎臟清除力下降使循環中的 AGEs 升高，而升高的 AGEs 反過來損傷腎臟。相應地，研究發現血漿 CML 濃度升高與 CKD 及估算腎小球過濾率在基線以及三至六年追蹤後皆呈獨立關聯。

links.context: Cigarette smoke compounds the protease-antiprotease imbalance by oxidising the Met358 residue in AAT's reactive centre loop, reducing its inhibitory activity roughly 2,000-fold, while also recruiting neutrophils to the lung to increase elastase release and generating ROS that directly damage elastin. PiZZ smokers therefore develop emphysema 10-20 years earlier than PiZZ non-smokers, which is why smoking cessation is the most impactful intervention.
links.context_zh_TW: 香菸菸霧會加劇蛋白酶／抗蛋白酶失衡：它氧化 AAT 反應中心環中的 Met358 殘基，使其抑制活性下降約 2,000 倍，同時招募嗜中性球到肺部增加彈性蛋白酶釋放，並產生直接損傷 elastin 的 ROS。因此 PiZZ 吸菸者較 PiZZ 不吸菸者提早 10–20 年發病肺氣腫，戒菸也因此成為最有效的介入措施。

links.context: Cigarette smoking is an exogenous source of glycation compounds. The curing of tobacco leaves has been proposed as the source of compounds that can readily increase in vivo AGEs; Cerami and colleagues found that glycotoxins from cigarettes are inhaled into the alveoli, then transported to the bloodstream or to lung cells where they interact with other glycation products and contribute to AGE formation. Smoking thus adds to the body's AGE burden beyond diet and endogenous production. This exogenous route of AGE generation helps explain the accelerated tissue aging and cardiovascular risk observed in smokers.
links.context_zh_TW: 吸菸是糖化化合物的外源性來源。菸葉的烘烤被認為是能輕易增加體內 AGE 之化合物的來源；Cerami 及其同事發現，來自香菸的糖毒素（glycotoxins）被吸入肺泡，隨後被運送至血液或肺細胞，在那裡與其他糖化產物交互作用並促成 AGE 形成。因此，吸菸在飲食與內生性產生之外，額外增加了身體的 AGE 負擔。這種外源性的 AGE 生成途徑有助於解釋吸菸者中觀察到的加速組織老化與心血管風險。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Circadian Rhythm regulates the NAD+ Salvage Pathway: NAMPT expression oscillates with the clock, generating daily oscillations in NAD+ that feed back to gate SIRT1 activity and clock-controlled gene expression. The result is a ~24-hour NAD+ cycle, whose disruption by shift work or jet lag is a proposed metabolic lesion.
links.context_zh_TW: Circadian Rhythm 會調節 NAD+ Salvage Pathway：NAMPT 的表現隨生理時鐘振盪，產生每日 NAD+ 振盪，再回饋以調節 SIRT1 活性與時鐘控制的基因表現。結果是約 24 小時的 NAD+ 週期，而輪班工作或時差造成的週期破壞即被視為一種代謝病灶。

links.context: Cisplatin depletes muscle NAD+ by 14 percent with NADH/NADPH declines.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 耗竭肌肉 NAD+ 14% 併 NADH/NADPH 下降。

links.context: Cisplatin induces the most severe cachexia phenotype among tested regimens, with roughly 14% muscle NAD+ loss and 93% downregulation of NRK2, recapitulating the metabolic signature of cancer cachexia. Chemotherapy more broadly activates pro-atrophic signaling, suppresses anabolism, and induces mitochondrial dysfunction and metabolic derangement.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 在受測方案中誘發最嚴重的 cachexia 表型，肌肉 NAD+ 流失約 14%、NRK2 下調約 93%，重現 cancer cachexia 的代謝特徵。更廣義地說，化療會活化促萎縮訊號、抑制合成代謝，並造成粒線體功能障礙與代謝失衡。

links.context: Cisplatin is a platinum agent used in limited-stage small-cell lung cancer, delivered concurrently with etoposide and thoracic radiotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment. Cisplatin is therefore central to LS-SCLC therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是用於局限性 Small-cell lung cancer 的鉑類藥物，與 etoposide 及胸部放療同時給藥。鉑類化療是 SCLC 治療的主幹。因此 Cisplatin 對 LS-SCLC 的治療至關重要。

links.context: Cisplatin is central to neoadjuvant and first-line metastatic bladder cancer treatment as a DNA cross-linking agent that activates intrinsic apoptotic pathways. Neoadjuvant cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy followed by radical cystectomy is the standard of care for localized muscle-invasive disease. Cisplatin thus plays a central role in bladder cancer therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是膀胱癌新輔助與一線轉移治療的核心藥物，作為 DNA 交聯劑激活內源性細胞凋亡途徑。以順鉑為基礎的新輔助聯合化療後接續根除性膀胱切除術是局限性肌層浸潤疾病的標準治療。因此 Cisplatin 在膀胱癌治療中扮演核心角色。

links.context: Cisplatin is the standard chemotherapy backbone for cervical cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是子宮頸癌標準化療主幹。

links.context: Class-I PI3K-Akt signaling inhibits autophagy via mTORC1 activation and TFEB-S467 retention, distinct from pro-autophagy class-III PI3K. Inhibition is the fed-state brake.
links.context_zh_TW: I 類 PI3K-Akt 經由 mTORC1 活化與 TFEB-S467 滯留抑制自噬，不同於促自噬的 III 類 PI3K。抑制是進食煞車。

links.context: Co-encapsulation of a liposomal cargo with Cisplatin showed additive cytotoxicity in glioblastoma (U-87 MG) cells, illustrating liposomes as a platform for combination therapy. Fisetin binary ethosomes additionally reduced UVB-induced skin cancer incidence to 49% versus 96% in UV-only mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 將藥物與 Cisplatin 共同包埋於 liposome 中，在膠質母細胞瘤（U-87 MG）細胞中呈現加成性的細胞毒性，說明 liposomes 可作為聯合療法的平台。Fisetin binary ethosome 更將 UVB 誘發的皮膚癌發生率由僅 UV 組的 96% 降至 49%。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 is regenerated from its oxidized ubiquinone to the reduced ubiquinol form by NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) and by the thioredoxin/glutaredoxin systems. This recycling maintains the antioxidant capacity of ubiquinol after it quenches lipid radicals. It links CoQ10 function to the broader glutathione and thioredoxin antioxidant networks.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 由 NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1（NQO1）以及 thioredoxin/glutaredoxin 系統從其氧化態 ubiquinone 再生成還原態 ubiquinol。這種回收在 ubiquinol 淬滅脂質自由基後維持其抗氧化能力。它將 CoQ10 的功能與更廣泛的 glutathione 和 thioredoxin 抗氧化網絡連結起來。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 levels decline with aging across multiple tissues, most notably in the heart, brain, and skeletal muscle. This decline results from decreased gene expression of biosynthetic enzymes and increased oxidative consumption. Reduced CoQ10 availability with age is thought to contribute to mitochondrial dysfunction and age-related pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 水平隨 aging 在多種組織中下降，尤其是在心臟、腦和骨骼肌中最為明顯。此下降源於生物合成酶基因表現降低以及氧化消耗增加。隨年齡而減少的 CoQ10 可用性被認為會促成 mitochondrial dysfunction 與年齡相關的病理。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10, in its reduced ubiquinol form, is a central suppressor of ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of lipid-peroxidation-driven cell death. Through the FSP1 pathway, the plasma-membrane flavoprotein FSP1 uses NADPH to reduce ubiquinone to ubiquinol, maintaining the radical trap that counteracts lipid peroxidation independently of GPX4. Because CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway, its availability links mevalonate output to FSP1 function, and depletion via statins can predict ferroptosis sensitivity.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 以其還原態 ubiquinol 形式，是 ferroptosis（一種鐵依賴、由脂質過氧化驅動的細胞死亡）的核心抑制因子。透過 FSP1 途徑，細胞膜黃素蛋白 FSP1 利用 NADPH 將 ubiquinone 還原為 ubiquinol，維持獨立於 GPX4 的、對抗 lipid peroxidation 的自由基陷阱。由於 CoQ10 是 mevalonate pathway 的非固醇產物，其可用性將 mevalonate 輸出與 FSP1 功能連結起來，經由 statins 造成的耗竭可預測 ferroptosis 敏感性。

links.context: Cold exposure activates brown adipose tissue and induces UCP1, increasing mitochondrial density and non-shivering thermogenesis. This controlled cold stress is a classic hormetic stimulus: with a recovery period it enhances mitochondrial quality and metabolic flexibility, making UCP1 induction a marker of Mitohormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 冷暴露會活化 Brown Adipose Tissue 並誘導 UCP1，提高粒線體密度與非顫抖性產熱。這種受控的冷壓力是典型的 hormetic 刺激：在搭配恢復期時可提升粒線體品質與代謝彈性，因此 UCP1 誘導可作為 Mitohormesis 的標記。

links.context: Collagen is the primary overproduced ECM protein of fibrotic scars. Accumulation defines the lesion.
links.context_zh_TW: 膠原是纖維化疤痕主要過度產生的 ECM 蛋白。累積定義病灶。

links.context: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
links.context_zh_TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Complex I dysfunction generates reactive oxygen species driving senescence signaling. Production is the basal leak direction.
links.context_zh_TW: 複合體 I 功能障礙產生驅動衰老訊號的活性氧。產生是基礎洩漏方向。

links.context: Complex IV pumps four protons from the matrix to the intermembrane space per O2 reduced, contributing to the proton-motive force that drives ATP Synthase. This makes Complex IV indirectly responsible for ATP production through oxidative phosphorylation, and its impairment elevates Mitochondrial ROS.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex IV 每還原一個 O2 便從基質向膜間腔泵出四個質子，協助建立驅動 ATP Synthase 的質子動力勢。這使 Complex IV 透過氧化磷酸化間接負責 ATP 生成，而其功能受損會升高 Mitochondrial ROS。

links.context: Constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, driven by APC loss, is activated in the majority of sporadic colon cancers. Aberrant Wnt signaling from inactivating APC mutation is the initiating event in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. The Wnt pathway is therefore central to colon cancer initiation.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 APC 缺失驅動的持續性 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號傳導在多數散發性結腸癌中被激活。源自 APC 失活突變的異常 Wnt 訊號傳導是腺瘤–癌序列的起始事件。因此 Wnt 途徑對結腸癌的起始至關重要。

links.context: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

links.context: Controlled, intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha, the 'hormetic amplifier': in C. elegans mild hypoxia → transient mitochondrial ROS → HIF-1 → positive ROS feedback → AMPK negative feedback → net ROS homeostasis with lifespan extension and enhanced immunity (Li et al., 2024); in mammals it drives erythropoietin, antioxidant and BDNF programs.
links.context_zh_TW: 受控的間歇性輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，即「荷爾蒙放大器」：在 C. elegans 中輕度缺氧 → 短暫粒線體 ROS → HIF-1 → 正回饋 ROS → AMPK 負回饋 → 淨 ROS 恆定並延壽與增強免疫力（Li et al., 2024）；在哺乳類中驅動紅血球生成素、抗氧化與 BDNF 程式。

links.context: CpG islands are genomic regions enriched in CpG dinucleotides, usually in gene promoters. Methylation of these islands typically silences the associated gene, and age-associated hypermethylation of specific CpG islands is used to build DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks that estimate biological age.
links.context_zh_TW: CpG Island 是富含 CpG 二核苷酸（通常位於基因啟動子）的基因體區域。這些 island 的甲基化通常會使相關基因沉默，而特定 CpG Island 隨年齡增加的過甲基化則被用於建立以 DNA 甲基化為基礎、估算生理年齡的 Epigenetic Clock。

links.context: Creatine supplementation influences glucose handling in skeletal muscle, in part by upregulating the GLUT4 glucose transporter. Creatine prevents declines in GLUT4 during immobilization and increases GLUT4 by about 40% during rehabilitation after atrophy, and co-ingestion with carbohydrate and protein enhances creatine uptake and muscle glycogen. In type 2 diabetic patients, 12 weeks of creatine supplementation during training improved glucose tolerance, increased GLUT4 translocation, and significantly reduced HbA1c, with changes in AMPK signaling related to GLUT4 translocation and HbA1c. These findings indicate creatine enhances glucose uptake and supports glucose management, especially when combined with exercise.
links.context_zh_TW: 補充肌酸會影響骨骼肌的葡萄糖處理，部分機制是透過上調 GLUT4 葡萄糖轉運蛋白。肌酸可防止固定不動期間 GLUT4 的下降，並在萎縮後的復健期間使 GLUT4 增加約 40%，而與碳水化合物和蛋白質併服可增強肌酸攝取與肌肉肝醣。在第二型糖尿病患者中，訓練期間補充肌酸 12 週可改善葡萄糖耐受度、增加 GLUT4 轉位，並顯著降低 HbA1c，其中 AMPK 訊息傳導的變化與 GLUT4 轉位及 HbA1c 相關。這些發現顯示肌酸能增強葡萄糖攝取並支持血糖管理，尤其是與運動結合時。

links.context: Creatine supplementation is a first-line, evidence-based adjunct for Muscle Hypertrophy. By expanding the intramuscular phosphocreatine pool it raises training capacity and the anabolic response to resistance loading, letting heavier sets add more contractile protein over time.
links.context_zh_TW: Creatine 補充是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的一線、具實證根據的輔助手段。藉由擴增肌肉內的磷酸肌酸庫，它能提升訓練能力與阻力負荷下的合成代謝反應，讓更重的組數隨時間累積更多收縮蛋白。

links.context: Cristae remodeling during apoptotic mitochondrial permeabilization liberates cytochrome c from the intermembrane space into the cytosol, where it activates the apoptosome and the caspase cascade. Cristae are therefore the structural compartment whose remodeling couples cristae integrity to cell death signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 凋亡性粒線體通透化過程中的 cristae 重塑會將 cytochrome c 從膜間腔釋放至細胞質，在該處活化 apoptosome 與 caspase 级聯。因此 cristae 是將其結構完整性與細胞死亡訊號連結起來的功能區室。

links.context: Critically shortened Telomeres in Alveolar Type II Cells, driven by Telomere Attrition and Telomerase mutations, trigger sustained p53 activation and replicative senescence, thereby reducing regenerative capacity after injury and allowing senescent AT2 cells to drive fibrosis through their SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 Telomere Attrition 與 telomerase 突變造成 Alveolar Type II Cells 的 Telomere 嚴重縮短，會觸發持續的 p53 活化與複製性衰老，進而降低損傷後的再生能力，並使衰老 AT2 細胞透過其 SASP 推動纖維化。

links.context: Culturing SCNT blastocysts yields nuclear-transfer ESC lines.
links.context_zh_TW: 培養 SCNT 囊胚產生核轉移 ESC 系。

links.context: Curcumin and its synthetic analog EF24 have been shown to suppress oxidative stress–induced epithelial senescence and modulate PTEN-related signalling pathways, countering the pro-survival, pro-fibrotic axis that sustains senescent cells. EF24 was listed among natural/synthetic compounds with senolytic or SASP-modulating properties in preclinical pulmonary fibrosis settings.
links.context_zh_TW: Curcumin 及其合成類似物 EF24 已被證實能抑制氧化壓力誘發的上皮 senescence，並調節 PTEN 相關的訊號路徑，以對抗維持 senescent cells 的促存活、促纖維化軸。EF24 被列入在臨床前肺纖維化情境中具有 senolytic 或 SASP 調節特性的天然／合成化合物清單。

links.context: Cyanidin-3-glucoside is a natural SIRT6 activator, the most distinctive vault feature of the compound. Activation links anthocyanin to sirtuin biology.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyanidin-3-glucoside 是天然 SIRT6 活化劑，為此化合物最獨特的 vault 特徵。活化將花青素與 sirtuin 生物學連結。

links.context: Cyclin B is essential for mitotic entry and progression. Without B-type cyclins cells cannot execute M phase.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclin B 對有絲分裂進入與進展必要。缺乏 B 型 cyclin 細胞無法執行 M 期。

links.context: Cyclopentenyl cytosine belongs to the nucleoside analog class of antimetabolites, replacing the ribose of cytidine with a cyclopentene ring. The structural change permits phosphorylation to the active triphosphate but prevents productive incorporation into nucleic acids.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於核苷類似物類別的抗代謝物，以環戊烯環取代胞苷的核糖。此結構改變允許其磷酸化為活性三磷酸，但防止其被有效地嵌入核酸。

links.context: Cystine import through system Xc- sustains GSH supply that brakes ferroptosis. Protection is the reverse of the Erastin inhibition edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 經由 system Xc- 的胱胺酸輸入維持 GSH 供應以煞車鐵死亡。保護是 Erastin 抑制邊的反向。

links.context: Cytoplasmic DNA species — chromatin fragments (CCFs) released by Lamin B1 loss and nuclear envelope blebbing, mitochondrial DNA from dysfunctional mitochondria, and DNA from ruptured micronuclei — accumulate as a hallmark of senescence and activate the cGAS-STING Pathway, driving the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞質中的 DNA 種類——由 Lamin B1 流失與核膜出芽釋出的染色質碎片（CCFs）、來自功能失調粒線體的粒線體 DNA，以及破裂微核釋出的 DNA——會作為 Senescence 的特徵性表現而累積，並活化 cGAS-STING Pathway，驅動 SASP。

links.context: Cytoplasmic LINE-1 cDNA triggers interferon signaling through cGAS-STING, reinforcing the SASP in deep senescence when retroelements are derepressed. LINE-1 reverse-transcription products provide cytosolic nucleic-acid ligands for cGAS, and this activation is restrained by RB1 and SIRT6, whose decline permits L1 mobilization. The mechanism connects transposon activation to innate immune-driven inflammation and represents a late, amplifying loop in established senescence. It is increasingly recognized as a driver of age-related sterile inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 胞質 LINE-1 cDNA 透過 cGAS-STING 觸發干擾素訊號，在逆轉錄元件去抑制的深層衰老中強化 SASP。LINE-1 逆轉錄產物提供 cGAS 的胞質核酸配體，此活化受 RB1 與 SIRT6 抑制，兩者下降允許 L1 移動。此機制將轉座子活化連結到先天免疫驅動的發炎，並代表已確立衰老中晚期、放大的迴圈。它日益被認識為年齡相關無菌發炎的驅動者。
links.source_file: _document_ - JCI -Expanding roles of cGAS-STING signaling in neuroinflammation.md

links.context: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments appear specifically in senescent cells, where downregulation of Lamin B1 destabilizes the nuclear lamina, allowing the nuclear envelope to herniate and 1-10 kb genomic fragments enriched for LINE-1 repeats and pericentromeric satellite DNA to be extruded into the cytosol. Their burden is therefore a hallmark of the senescent state and correlates with inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 專門出現於 senescent cells：此時 Lamin B1 下調使核纖層失穩，核膜因而向外疝出，並將富含 LINE-1 重複序列與周 centromeric 衛星 DNA 的 1–10 kb 基因組片段排入細胞質。因此其累積量是 senescent state 的特徵，並與 inflammaging 相關。

links.context: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments are normally cleared from the cytosol by the DNases DNASE2 and TREX1. In senescent cells both enzymes are transcriptionally downregulated via the E2F complex, so the fragments persist, accumulate and remain available to stimulate cGAS-STING and hence the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 正常情況下由 DNase DNASE2 與 TREX1 從細胞質中清除。在 senescent cells 中這兩種酵素皆經 E2F 複合體被轉錄性下調，因此這些片段持續存在、逐漸累積，並得以持續刺激 cGAS-STING 進而促進 SASP。

links.context: Cytosolic and circulating mtDNA are major drivers of sterile inflammaging and of age-related disease such as atherosclerosis, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and neurodegeneration. Beyond innate immunity, mtDNA stress engages mitochondrial retrograde signalling (ATF4/CHOP, AMPK) that remodels nuclear gene expression, contributing to the senescent metabolic state; elevated cell-free mtDNA in plasma is a candidate biomarker of senescent burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞質與循環中的 mtDNA 是無菌性 inflammaging 及年齡相關疾病（如動脈粥狀硬化、idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis 與神經退化）的主要驅動因子。除了先天免疫之外，mtDNA 壓力還會啟動粒線體逆行訊號（ATF4/CHOP、AMPK），重塑核基因表現，促成 senescent 的代謝狀態；血漿中升高的游離 mtDNA 則是 senescent 負荷的候選生物標記。

links.context: D1-mediated dopamine signaling gates working memory maintenance, paralleling the D2 working-memory edge. Prefrontal D1 occupancy depends on COMT-set dopamine tone where DAT is sparse.
links.context_zh_TW: D1 介導的多巴胺訊號守衛工作記憶維持，與 D2 工作記憶邊平行。前額葉 D1 佔據在 DAT 稀疏處依賴 COMT 設定的多巴胺張力。

links.context: DAMPs such as uric acid and extracellular ATP activate the Inflammasome: uric acid released from damaged cells activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, while ATP activates P2X7 purinergic receptors. This is the microbial-independent counterpart to PAMP signalling, and its chronic versus acute release determines whether the outcome in Cancer is pro-tumorigenic Inflammation or immunogenic cell death and antitumor immunity.
links.context_zh_TW: DAMP 如尿酸與細胞外 ATP 可活化 Inflammasome（發炎小體）：受損細胞釋放的尿酸活化 NLRP3 發炎小體，ATP 則活化 P2X7 嘌呤能受體。這是與 PAMP 訊號相對應、不依賴微生物的途徑；在 Cancer（癌症）中，其慢性或急性釋放決定結果是促腫瘤的 Inflammation（發炎）還是免疫原性細胞死亡與抗腫瘤免疫。

links.context: DJ-1 detoxifies glyoxal to glycolic acid GSH-independently, parallel to methylglyoxal-to-L-lactate conversion. Second substrate leg of the DJ-1 glyoxalase program.
links.context_zh_TW: DJ-1 不依賴 GSH 將 glyoxal 解毒為 glycolic acid，與 methylglyoxal 到 L-lactate 轉換平行。DJ-1 乙二醛酶程序的第二受質分支。

links.context: DNA Methylation governs the expression of miR-543 through the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 cluster on chromosome 14q32 that hosts the microRNA; parent-of-origin methylation controls the locus, making miR-543 both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome and linking epigenetic drift to the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
links.context_zh_TW: DNA Methylation 透過位於染色體 14q32 上、帶有親源印記的 DLK1-DIO3 基因叢調控 miR-543 的表現；該基因座由親源甲基化控制，使 miR-543 既是表觀基因組的效應分子也是感應分子，並將表觀遺傳漂變與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸相連。

links.context: DNASE2 normally restrains the cGAS-STING pathway by degrading the DNA that cGAS would otherwise sense. When DNASE2 is lost, DNA persists as micronuclei and cytosolic chromatin, is detected by cGAS, and activates STING, IRF3 and NF-kB - so the normal action of DNASE2 is suppression of this innate immune pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: DNASE2 正常情況下藉由降解否則會被 cGAS 感知的 DNA，抑制 cGAS-STING pathway。當 DNASE2 喪失時，DNA 以 micronuclei 與細胞質染色質的形式持續存在，被 cGAS 偵測並活化 STING、IRF3 與 NF-κB；因此 DNASE2 的正常作用就是抑制這條先天免疫路徑。

links.context: DNM2 acts at the outer mitochondrial membrane, the site where DRP1 initiates constriction and where the division furrow must ultimately be severed. Its localization to this surface is what allows a cytosolic dynamin-like GTPase to participate in completing organelle division.
links.context_zh_TW: DNM2 作用於 outer mitochondrial membrane，此處是 DRP1 啟動收縮、以及分裂溝最終必須被切斷的部位。DNM2 定位於此表面，正是讓一個位於細胞質的 dynamin-like GTPase 能參與完成胞器分裂的關鍵。

links.context: DNMT1 propagates methylation states through cell division as maintenance methyltransferase. Maintenance is the inheritance mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: DNMT1 作為維持甲基轉移酶在細胞分裂中傳播甲基化狀態。維持是繼承機制。

links.context: DSRM-3716 exists to overcome the promiscuity of disulfiram, the repurposed covalent inhibitor of SARM1. Because disulfiram reacts nonspecifically with protein thiols, DSRM-3716 was developed as a non-covalent, high-selectivity alternative occupying the same TIR NAD+ pocket without off-target adduct formation.
links.context_zh_TW: DSRM-3716 的存在是為了克服 disulfiram 這項被重新定位使用的 SARM1 共價抑制劑的選擇性不足問題。由於 disulfiram 會與蛋白質 thiol 非專一性地反應，DSRM-3716 因此被開發為非共價、高選擇性的替代物，佔據相同的 TIR NAD+ pocket 而不產生離靶加合物。

links.context: DVE-1 executes the transcriptional output of the Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response. When mitochondrial proteotoxic stress is sensed, cytosolic ATFS-1 fails to import into stressed mitochondria and enters the nucleus instead, and DVE-1 is then recruited to UPRmt target promoters, linking calibrated mitochondrial stress to adaptive gene expression and Lifespan extension.
links.context_zh_TW: DVE-1 執行 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的轉錄輸出。當粒線體蛋白毒性壓力被感知時，細胞質中的 ATFS-1 無法被輸入受損粒線體而改為進入細胞核，接著 DVE-1 被招募至 UPRmt 標的啟動子，將校準過的粒線體壓力連結至適應性基因表現與 Lifespan 延長。

links.context: DYRK1A (dual-specificity tyrosine phosphorylation-regulated kinase 1A) is upregulated in Down syndrome and phosphorylates Tau at multiple AD-relevant sites, adding to the kinase load that drives Tau hyperphosphorylation and neurofibrillary pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: DYRK1A (dual-specificity tyrosine phosphorylation-regulated kinase 1A) 在 Down syndrome 中會上调，並在多個與 AD 相關的位點磷酸化 Tau，增加推動 Tau 過度磷酸化與神經纖維病變的激酶負荷。

links.context: Dasatinib is a component of senolytic therapy: in the dasatinib plus quercetin combination it clears senescent cells through inhibition of BCL-2/PI3K-AKT-dependent anti-apoptotic survival signalling. As a tool compound it is also used to probe biological mechanisms beyond senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Dasatinib 是 senolytic 療法的組成成分：在 dasatinib 加 quercetin 的組合中，它藉由抑制 BCL-2/PI3K-AKT 依賴的抗凋亡存活訊號來清除 senescent cells。作為工具化合物，它也被用於探討 senescence 之外的生物機制。

links.context: Decades-long prophase-I arrest is a specialized quiescence program. Involvement frames meiotic arrest as dormancy.
links.context_zh_TW: 數十年的前期 I 停滯是特化的靜止程序。涉及將減數分裂停滯框定為休眠。

links.context: Deleting Caspase-8 or FADD from intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis with pathology morphologically similar to inflammatory bowel disease, and RIPK3 deletion completely prevents it.
links.context_zh_TW: 從腸道上皮刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引起自發性 necroptosis，其病理形態類似發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），而 RIPK3 缺失可完全預防之。

links.context: Depending on the severity and duration of replication stress, hydroxyurea can drive permanent cell cycle arrest. This senescence outcome is exploited in chemotherapy and in senescence research as a tool compound.
links.context_zh_TW: 依複製壓力的嚴重程度和持續時間，Hydroxyurea 可驅使細胞永久停滯於細胞週期。這種衰老結果被用於化療，並作為工具化合物用於衰老研究。

links.context: Despite RIPK3- and MLKL-deficiency protecting in the cerulein pancreatitis model, Nec-1 administration worsened histological damage and raised serum lipase/amylase — attributed by the authors to Nec-1's short half-life rather than genuine pathway agonism.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管在雨蛙素（cerulein）胰臟炎模型中 RIPK3 與 MLKL 缺失具保護作用，Nec-1 給藥卻惡化組織學損傷並升高血清脂肪酶/澱粉酶——作者歸因於 Nec-1 半衰期過短，而非真正促進該路徑。

links.context: Despite being pro-aging overall, exogenous Human Growth Hormone allows regeneration of the aged or damaged Thymus and enhances hematopoiesis after bone marrow transplantation (Tian et al., 1998; Murphy & Longo, 2000). The effect runs through IGF-1 acting on thymic stromal cells to raise IL-7, which drives intrathymic T cell survival — a context-dependent benefit that coexists with long-term aging concerns.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管整體上是促衰老的，外源性 Human Growth Hormone 仍可讓老化或受損的 Thymus 再生，並在骨髓移植後增強造血（Tian et al., 1998；Murphy & Longo, 2000）。其作用經由 IGF-1 作用於胸腺基質細胞以提升 IL-7，進而推動胸腺內 T 細胞存活——這是一種與長期衰老疑慮並存的、依情境而定的好處。

links.context: Despite the in-vitro prominence of TNFR1 in necroptosis induction, TNFR1-deficient or TNFR1/2-double-deficient mice are not protected in renal ischemia-reperfusion injury — evidence that additional inducers matter in vivo.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管 TNFR1 在體外 necroptosis 誘導中地位顯著，TNFR1 缺失或 TNFR1/2 雙缺失小鼠在腎缺血–再灌注損傷中並未受到保護——證明體內尚有其他誘導物扮演角色。

links.context: Dextromethorphan's primary metabolite, dextrorphan, is an NMDA receptor antagonist, which gives DXM downstream NMDA-antagonist and dissociative properties at high doses. DXM itself also inhibits serotonin reuptake and has activity at sigma-1 receptors, contributing serotonergic effects.
links.context_zh_TW: Dextromethorphan 的主要代謝物 dextrorphan 是 NMDA receptor 拮抗劑，使 DXM 在高劑量下具有下游的 NMDA 拮抗與解離作用。DXM 本身也抑制血清素回收，並對 sigma-1 receptors 有活性，產生血清素作用。

links.context: Diabetes shares many hallmarks with Aging. Elevated glucose promotes the accumulation of senescent cells, particularly in the vasculature and kidneys, and epigenetic-clock studies show type 2 diabetes individuals often carry a higher biological age than their chronological age.
links.context_zh_TW: Diabetes 與 Aging 共享多項生物標誌。血糖升高會促進 senescent cells 的累積，尤其在血管與腎臟；表觀遺傳時鐘研究亦顯示第二型 diabetes 患者的生物年齡常高於實際年齡。

links.context: Diaziquone is an aziridinylbenzoquinone crosslinker in the alkylator class. Classification by mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: Diaziquone 是烷化劑類別中的 aziridinylbenzoquinone 交聯劑。依機制歸類。

links.context: Dicer and its downstream miRNAs regulate inflammatory responses and are implicated in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis, cancer, and Senescence. Reduced mature miRNA output can derepress pro-inflammatory and senescence gene programmes, which contributes to Inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: Dicer 及其下游的 miRNA 調節發炎反應，並與 Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis、癌症與 Senescence 相關。成熟 miRNA 產量下降會解除對促發炎與衰老基因程式的抑制，進而促成 Inflammaging。

links.context: Dietary isoleucine correlates with body mass index in humans, and increased circulating isoleucine is associated with increased mortality risk. In Western diet-fed mice, increasing dietary isoleucine promotes weight gain, fat accretion, glucose intolerance, and insulin resistance. In contrast, isoleucine restriction consistently improves metabolic health across dietary contexts and age groups, extends lifespan of both Drosophila and mice, reduces frailty and increases healthspan, rejuvenates aged mice at the molecular level, induces substantial epigenetic changes, and improves Alzheimer's disease outcomes in male mice. Isoleucine is described as an exceptionally powerful modifier of the hallmarks of protein restriction.
links.context_zh_TW: 飲食中的異白胺酸與人類身體質量指數相關，且循環異白胺酸升高與死亡風險增加有關。在西方飲食餵養的小鼠中，增加飲食異白胺酸會促進體重增加、脂肪累積、葡萄糖不耐受與胰島素抗性。相反地，限制異白胺酸在各種飲食情境與年齡層中一致地改善代謝健康、延長果蠅與小鼠的壽命、減少衰弱並延長健康壽命、在分子層面使老年小鼠年輕化、誘導顯著的表觀遺傳變化，並改善雄性小鼠的阿茲海默症結果。異白胺酸被描述為蛋白質限制標誌特徵的異常強大修飾因子。

links.context: Dietary supplementation of nicotinamide riboside (NR) restored NAD+ levels caused by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma and thereby prevented both DNA damage and tumorigenesis. NAD+ is required by sirtuins and PARPs that mediate DNA repair, and its depletion, driven by DNA damage and stress, is a feature of aging and age-associated pathology. By maintaining NAD+ availability for DNA repair enzymes and improving oxidative stress responses, NR displays beneficial effects on DNA repair in Alzheimer's disease mouse models as well. These findings support NR as a protective agent against genotoxic stress and tumorigenesis in the liver.
links.context_zh_TW: 飲食補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，此現象見於肝細胞癌小鼠模型，並因此同時預防了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。NAD+ 是介導 DNA 修復的 sirtuins 與 PARPs 所必需的，而其耗竭由 DNA 損傷與壓力所驅動，是老化及老化相關病理的一項特徵。透過維持 NAD+ 供應給 DNA 修復酶並改善氧化壓力反應，NR 在阿茲海默症小鼠模型中亦展現對 DNA 修復的有益效果。這些發現支持 NR 作為對抗肝臟基因毒性壓力與腫瘤發生的保護性物質。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Diethylcarbamazine kills circulating microfilariae in lymphatic filariasis and is therefore a second-line microfilaricide alongside ivermectin. Its use is restricted in regions co-endemic for onchocerciasis because rapid microfilarial killing there can trigger severe inflammatory Mazzotti reactions.
links.context_zh_TW: Diethylcarbamazine 會殺死 lymphatic filariasis 中循環的微絲蟲，因此是與 ivermectin 並列的第二線殺微絲蟲藥。在 onchocerciasis 共生的地區其使用受到限制，因為快速殺死微絲蟲可能引發嚴重的發炎性 Mazzotti 反應。

links.context: Differentiation and Yamanaka reprogramming run opposite trajectories. Opposition frames the two programs as inverses.
links.context_zh_TW: 分化與山中重編程運行相反軌跡。對立將兩個程序框定為互逆。

links.context: Disruption of the MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin axis, as occurs with MFN2 mutations causing Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, impairs axonal mitochondrial transport and underlies the resulting peripheral neuropathy and axonal degeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: MFN2 突變造成 Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A 時，MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin 軸受破壞，軸突粒線體運輸受損，並構成周邊神經病變與軸突退化的基礎。

links.context: Disruption of the gut-brain axis is linked to inflammation, aging, and neurodegeneration, notably Parkinson's Disease, where alpha-synuclein pathology may originate in the gut, and Alzheimer's Disease. Supporting a healthy microbiome through diet, fasting, and exercise is being explored to preserve brain health.
links.context_zh_TW: Gut-brain axis 的失調與 inflammation、aging 及 neurodegeneration 相關，尤其是 Parkinson's Disease（其 alpha-synuclein 病變可能起源於腸道）與 Alzheimer's Disease。透過飲食、fasting 與運動維持健康菌叢以保護腦健康正在被探索。

links.context: Diverse somatic cell types are produced by developmental differentiation programs. Product relation roots somatic identity in lineage commitment.
links.context_zh_TW: 多樣體細胞類型由發育分化程序產生。產物關係將體細胞身份根植於譜系承諾。

links.context: Docetaxel is a backbone TNBC regimen with melittin-combo data.
links.context_zh_TW: docetaxel 是 TNBC 主幹方案，具 melittin 合併數據。

links.context: Dolichol resides within neuromelanin pigment granules of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Presence records the isoprenoid component of granule matrix.
links.context_zh_TW: Dolichol 存在於黑質緻密部 neuromelanin 色素顆粒內。存在記錄顆粒基質的異戊二烯成分。

links.context: Dopamine Neuron survival depends on basal Autophagy: impairment of autophagy machinery causes dopamine neuron degeneration and protein aggregation. The reverse framing is equally important — basal autophagy is a prerequisite for maintaining these neurons, whose loss is a hallmark of Parkinson's Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopamine Neuron 的存活依賴基礎的 Autophagy：自噬機制受損會造成多巴胺神經元退化與蛋白聚集。反過來說同樣重要——基礎自噬是維持這些神經元的前提，而其流失正是 Parkinson's Disease 的標誌。

links.context: Dopamine autoxidizes via iron/MAO routes to quinones plus 6-OHDA, forming alpha-synuclein adducts. This catecholamine-oxidation chemistry bridges dopamine handling to Parkinson pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopamine 經由鐵/MAO 路徑自氧化為 quinones 及 6-OHDA，形成 alpha-synuclein 加合物。此兒茶酚胺氧化化學將多巴胺處理連結到帕金森病理。

links.context: Dopamine governs striatal synaptic plasticity as a neuromodulator of strength changes. Regulation is the modulatory control relationship.
links.context_zh_TW: 多巴胺作為強度變化的神經調節劑掌管紋狀體突觸可塑性。調節是調節性控制關係。

links.context: Dopamine, like epinephrine, undergoes oxidation to an aminochrome: dopamine is converted through an o-quinone intermediate to dopaminochrome, the dopamine analog of adrenochrome. These aminochromes are unstable reactive intermediates that can polymerize into melanins, including neuromelanin in dopaminergic neurons. This oxidation pathway is relevant to the brain, where oxidative metabolism of catecholamines into quinone-like compounds contributes to the age-dependent buildup of neuromelanin pigments in the substantia nigra. The reactivity of dopaminochrome and related aminochromes underlies their potential neurotoxicity and their sequestration by neuromelanin.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopamine 與 epinephrine 類似，會氧化成 aminochrome：dopamine 經由 o-quinone 中間產物轉化為 dopaminochrome，即 adrenochrome 的 dopamine 類似物。這些 aminochromes 是不穩定的反應性中間產物，可聚合成 melanins，包括多巴胺能神經元中的 neuromelanin。此氧化途徑與大腦相關，其中兒茶酚胺氧化代謝成類 quinone 化合物，促成了 substantia nigra 中 neuromelanin 色素隨年齡的堆積。Dopaminochrome 及相關 aminochromes 的反應性，是其潛在神經毒性以及被 neuromelanin 隔離的基礎。

links.context: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process. Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration. This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process。Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration。This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions。

links.context: Dopaminochrome carries the alpha,beta-unsaturated indoline-5,6-dione Michael-acceptor motif shared with adrenochrome. Classification groups the quinoid electrophiles.
links.context_zh_TW: 多巴胺色素帶有與腎上腺素共享的 α,β-不飽和吲哚醌 Michael 受體基序。歸類統合醌型親電子劑。

links.context: Doramectin shares its mechanism and endectocide spectrum with Ivermectin: like ivermectin it agonizes invertebrate glutamate- and GABA-gated chloride channels to produce sustained Cl- influx and parasite paralysis, but its cyclohexyl group extends the elimination half-life to days in cattle, enabling long-acting single-dose control. Unlike Ivermectin it is a livestock-only label, making Milbemycin Oxime or Selamectin preferable in MDR1-affected dogs.
links.context_zh_TW: Doramectin 與 Ivermectin 共享其機轉與內外寄生蟲兼殺範圍：與 ivermectin 相同，它激动無脊椎動物的麩胺酸與 GABA 門控氯離子通道以產生持續 Cl⁻ 內流並使寄生蟲麻痺，但其環己基使牛體內排除半衰期延長至數日，可實現長效單次劑量控制。與 Ivermectin 不同的是它僅標示為家畜用藥，因此在 MDR1 異常犬隻中應優先選用 Milbemycin Oxime 或 Selamectin。

links.context: Down Syndrome is a natural model of segmental progeria: alongside early Senescence and immune dysregulation, epigenetic age acceleration is well documented, driven by the same Aβ burden that produces its Alzheimer pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是節段性早老症（segmental progeria）的天然模型：除了提早出現 Senescence（細胞衰老）與免疫失調之外，其表觀遺傳年齡加速亦已有充分文獻支持，並由與其阿茲海默病理相同的 Aβ 負擔所驅動。

links.context: Down Syndrome tissues display premature Senescence alongside immune dysregulation and early aging phenotypes, so the disorder is used as a human model of accelerated aging rather than merely of neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）的組織會出現早發的 Senescence（細胞衰老），並伴隨免疫失調與提早老化表型，因此此疾病被當作加速老化的人類模型，而不只是神經退化的模型。

links.context: Doxycycline (100–200 mg daily for 4–6 weeks) targets the obligate Wolbachia endosymbionts of Onchocerca volvulus rather than the worm itself. Sterilizing adult females and producing a gradual decline in microfilarial production gives sustained therapeutic benefit, an indirect chemotherapeutic strategy particularly useful in co-endemic settings where elimination is feasible.
links.context_zh_TW: Doxycycline（每日 100–200 mg，連續 4–6 週）作用於 Onchocerca volvulus 的專性 Wolbachia 內共生菌，而非寄生蟲本身。使成蟲雌性不孕並使微絲蟲產量逐步下降，可提供持續的治療效益；這是一種間接化療策略，在可進行根除的共生流行區特別有用。

links.context: During accidental necrotic rupture IL-1alpha leaks passively as a sterile-inflammation driver alongside HMGB1. Calpain-processed forms add a regulated-release route in some myeloid settings.
links.context_zh_TW: 在意外發生的壞死性膜破裂中，IL-1alpha 與 HMGB1 一同以被動方式外漏，成為無菌性發炎的驅動因子。在某些髓系細胞情境下，calpain 切割後的形式則提供了一條受調控的釋放途徑。

links.context: During apoptosis the same BAX/BAK macropores that release mitochondrial DNA in senescent cells are accompanied by active caspases that silence the inflammatory response. Senescent cells lack that caspase suppression, so an identical pore event becomes a chronic inflammatory engine driving the SASP rather than remaining immunologically quiet.
links.context_zh_TW: 在凋亡過程中，與衰老細胞釋放粒線體 DNA 相同的 BAX/BAK 大孔洞事件，伴隨活性 caspase 抑制發炎反應。衰老細胞缺乏這種 caspase 抑制，因此相同的孔洞事件反而成為驅動 SASP 的慢性發炎引擎，而不會保持免疫學上的沉默。

links.context: During apoptosis, caspase cleavage inactivates the flippase ATP11C while XKR scramblase becomes active, so externalization of the phosphatidylserine eat-me signal depends on shutting the flippase arm down.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 apoptosis 過程中，caspase 切割使 flippase ATP11C 失活，同時 XKR scramblase 被活化，因此磷脂醯絲胺酸這個 eat-me 訊號的外顯，取決於 flippase 一臂的關閉。

links.context: During caloric restriction intracellular nicotinamide concentrations fall, relieving feedback inhibition of sirtuins and contributing to sirtuin activation and the associated stress-resistance and longevity effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 在熱量限制期間，細胞內 [[Nicotinamide]] 濃度下降，解除對 sirtuin 的回饋抑制，促成 sirtuin 活化及其相關的抗逆境與延壽效應。

links.context: During latent infection the EBV protein LMP1 constitutively activates NF-kappaB, JNK and PI3K-Akt signalling in infected B cells, driving proliferation and contributing to EBV-associated malignancy. Its signalling behaviour is that of a constitutively active CD40 receptor, and it is an active therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: 在潛伏感染期間，EBV 蛋白 LMP1 於受感染的 B 細胞中持續活化 NF-kappaB、JNK 與 PI3K-Akt 訊號，驅動增殖並促成 EBV 相關的惡性腫瘤。其訊號行為等同於持續活化的 CD40 receptor，也是活躍的治療標的。

links.context: During prolonged mitotic arrest CDC20-directed APC-C degrades CDK1-Thr92-primed Mcl-1.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期有絲分裂停滯期間 CDC20 指導的 APC-C 降解經 CDK1-Thr92 啟動的 Mcl-1。

links.context: During senescence reduced electron-transport-chain efficiency and lowered NAD+ levels depress the NAD+/NADH ratio generated by the Citric Acid Cycle, lowering ATP and raising AMP/ATP to activate AMPK. Restoring the ratio, via NAMPT upregulation or Methylene blue redox cycling, modulates senescence and the SASP, placing the cycle upstream of the senescence program.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老過程中，電子傳遞鏈效率下降與 NAD+ 水平降低會壓低由 Citric Acid Cycle 產生的 NAD+/NADH 比值，使 ATP 下降、AMP/ATP 上升並活化 AMPK。藉由 NAMPT 上調或 Methylene blue 氧化還原循環恢復該比值，可調節衰老與 SASP，顯示此循環位於衰老程式之上游。

links.context: During starvation ULK1 phosphorylates Ambra-1, releasing it from the dynein complex so that Beclin1 can be activated and autophagosome nucleation can proceed.
links.context_zh_TW: 在飢餓期間，ULK1 磷酸化 Ambra-1，使其從 dynein 複合體釋放，讓 Beclin1 能被活化並進行自噬體成核。

links.context: During the oxidation of adrenaline, the reaction mixture is tinged with purplish red due to the production of adrenochrome, and its color becomes deeper with increasing adrenochrome content. The reaction is continued until the absorbance at a wavelength of 495 nm, measured by sampling the reaction mixture at an appropriate time, reaches a maximum, at which point further oxidation of the product is minimized and adrenochrome is obtained in maximum yield. The reaction time required for maximum yield varies from 30 to 45 minutes depending on the temperature of the reaction mixture and the level of catalyst employed.
links.context_zh_TW: 在腎上腺素氧化過程中，反應混合物因腎上腺紅的生成而呈紫紅色，且隨腎上腺紅含量增加而顏色加深。反應持續進行，直到於適當時間取樣反應混合物所測得的495 nm波長吸光度達到最大值，此時產物的進一步氧化降至最低，並以最大產率獲得腎上腺紅。達到最大產率所需的反應時間為30至45分鐘不等，取決於反應混合物的溫度和所用催化劑的量。

links.context: Dysfunction of Atg proteins is linked to Neurodegeneration, Cancer, Metabolic Disease and Aging; nearly sixteen Atg proteins and two distinct ubiquitin-like conjugation systems are required to promote autophagosome formation during caloric restriction and fasting.
links.context_zh_TW: Atg 蛋白質的功能失調與 Neurodegeneration、Cancer、Metabolic Disease 及 Aging 皆有關；在熱量限制與禁食期間，促進自噬體形成需要近十六個 Atg 蛋白質與兩套不同的類泛素結合系統。

links.context: Dysregulated IL-18 signaling is implicated in chronic inflammation, autoimmune disease, metabolic syndrome and age-related inflammaging, which makes the NLRP3/caspase-1 axis that matures IL-18 a target of inflammasome-inhibitor drug development.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-18 訊號失調與慢性發炎、自體免疫疾病、代謝症候群及與年齡相關的 inflammaging 有關，因此使成熟 IL-18 的 NLRP3/caspase-1 軸成為發炎小體抑制劑藥物開發的標的。

links.context: Dysregulated Mitochondrial Dynamics — excessive mitochondrial fission and impaired mitophagy — contributes to alveolar epithelial cell death and fibrotic remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis. Alongside epithelial apoptosis, fibroblast proliferation into myofibroblasts and excessive collagen deposition define this dysregulated wound-healing response to repetitive alveolar injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 失調的 Mitochondrial Dynamics——過度的粒線體分裂與受損的 mitophagy——促成肺泡上皮細胞死亡與 pulmonary fibrosis 的纖維化重塑。與上皮細胞凋亡、纖維母細胞增殖為肌成纖維細胞及過量膠原沉積一起，構成對反覆肺泡損傷的失調傷口癒合反應。

links.context: Dysregulated Post-translational Modification is a hallmark of cancer: hyperactive phosphorylation cascades (MAPK, JAK/STAT, PI3K/AKT), aberrant ubiquitination that removes tumor suppressors such as p53 via MDM2, and altered acetylation/methylation that reshape the epigenetic landscape all promote tumor initiation and progression.
links.context_zh_TW: Post-translational Modification 失調是癌症的特徵之一：過度活化的磷酸化級聯（MAPK、JAK/STAT、PI3K/AKT）、透過 MDM2 移除 p53 等腫瘤抑制蛋白的異常 ubiquitination，以及改變的乙醯化／甲基化重塑表觀遺傳景觀，皆促進腫瘤的起始與進展。

links.context: Dysregulated cyclic dinucleotide accumulation, whether from excessive cGAS activity or impaired CDN degradation, drives chronic inflammation and neuroinflammation. Sensing of CDNs is therefore a double-edged target, valuable for antiviral and antitumor therapy but harmful when chronically active.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclic Dinucleotide 的失調累積——無論源自 cGAS 過度活化或 CDN 降解受阻——都會驅動慢性發炎與 Neuroinflammation。因此對 CDN 的感知是一個雙刃的標的：對抗病毒與抗腫瘤療法有價值，但慢性活化時則有害。

links.context: Dysregulated glutamatergic signalling contributes to ischemic stroke, traumatic brain injury, status epilepticus and chronic neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and Huntington's disease. It represents the failure of the regulation that normally makes glutamate essential for learning, memory and synaptic plasticity.
links.context_zh_TW: 失调的 glutamatergic 訊號參與 ischemic stroke、traumatic brain injury、status epilepticus，以及 Alzheimer's disease、Parkinson's disease、amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 與 Huntington's disease 等慢性神經退化疾病。它代表正常情況下使 glutamate 對學習、記憶與突觸可塑性不可或缺的調控機制失效。

links.context: Dysregulated valine catabolism is linked to systemic metabolic dysfunction: the incomplete-oxidation intermediate 3-hydroxyisobutyrate (3-HIB), produced mainly in skeletal muscle, promotes muscle insulin resistance in diabetic rats, linking high valine intake to impaired glucose handling.
links.context_zh_TW: Valine 分解代謝失調與全身代謝功能障礙相關：不完全氧化中間產物 3-hydroxyisobutyrate（3-HIB，主要在骨骼肌生成）在糖尿病大鼠中促進肌肉 insulin resistance，將高 valine 攝取與葡萄糖處理受損連結起來。

links.context: E-cadherin clustering at adherens junctions initiates inhibitory signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 黏附連接的 E-cadherin 聚集啟動抑制訊號。

links.context: E3 ligase dysfunction underlies cancer through MDM2 amplification, VHL loss in renal cancer, and RB1 pathway perturbations. The E3 substrate-recognition interface is exploited therapeutically by PROTACs and molecular glues that recruit neo-substrates to ligases such as CRBN or VHL.
links.context_zh_TW: E3 連接酶功能障礙透過 MDM2 擴增、腎癌中的 VHL 缺失和 RB1 途徑擾動構成癌症的基礎。治療上利用 E3 受質識別界面開發 PROTAC 和分子膠，將新受質招募到 CRBN 或 VHL 等連接酶。

links.context: ECM ligands engage and activate integrin receptors, completing the ECM-Integrin-FAK chain. Activation is the outside-in trigger.
links.context_zh_TW: ECM 配體接合併活化 integrin 受體，完成 ECM-Integrin-FAK 鏈。活化是由外而內的觸發。

links.context: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) is a chelating agent that binds metal ions such as iron and copper. Because those metals catalyse the oxidation of Epinephrine, EDTA binding renders them inert and dramatically slows Epinephrine autoxidation, thereby indirectly limiting Adrenochrome production.
links.context_zh_TW: EDTA（ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid）是一種螯合劑，可結合鐵、銅等金屬離子。由於這些金屬會催化 Epinephrine 的氧化，EDTA 與其結合後使其失活，大幅減緩 Epinephrine 的自發氧化，進而間接限制 Adrenochrome 的生成。

links.context: EF24's primary signalling nodes are the PTEN/PI3K axis and Reactive Oxygen Species, with a mechanism described as anti-senescence and SASP modulation. Within the IPF senescence network it is grouped with Procyanidin C1, Resveratrol, and Quercetin as a polyphenol-class modulator able to attenuate the SASP and epithelial senescence that drive fibroblast activation and extracellular matrix deposition.
links.context_zh_TW: EF24 的主要訊號節點為 PTEN/PI3K 軸與 Reactive Oxygen Species，其機制被描述為抗衰老與 SASP 調節。在 IPF 衰老網絡中，它與 Procyanidin C1、Resveratrol、Quercetin 同屬多酚類調節劑，可減弱驅動 fibroblast 活化與細胞外基質沉積的 SASP 與上皮 senescence。

links.context: EGFR is the principal directly-repressed RTK target restraining proliferation.
links.context_zh_TW: EGFR 是主要的直接抑制 RTK 標的以約束增殖。

links.context: EGFR mutation is a major driver and therapeutic target in NSCLC.
links.context_zh_TW: EGFR 突變是 NSCLC 主要驅動與治療標靶。

links.context: EMT6 serves as a model for Radiation Therapy research: it is a cloned BALB/c-derived mouse mammary tumor cell line used as monolayer cultures in vitro and as intradermal solid tumors in BALB/cRw mice in vivo, and it has been extensively characterized for radiation responses. In that model fenbendazole failed to sensitize tumors to radiation, altering neither tumor growth, radiation response nor metastatic pattern, which is why EMT6 is cited as a negative-result model in fenbendazole reviews.
links.context_zh_TW: EMT6 是 Radiation Therapy（放射治療）研究的模型：它是源自 BALB/c 小鼠的乳癌細胞株，體外以單層培養、體內以 BALB/cRw 小鼠皮內實體腫瘤兩種形式使用，並已被廣泛用於放射反應的表徵。在該模型中 fenbendazole 未能使腫瘤對輻射增敏，既未改變腫瘤生長、放射反應，也未改變轉移模式，因此 EMT6 在 fenbendazole 的文獻回顧中被引用為陰性結果模型。

links.context: EP300 functionally opposes SIRT1 at shared promoters (AR, BRCA1, EZH2 loci), where EP300 writes acetyl marks and SIRT1 removes them. The acetylation state of those loci therefore integrates nutrient and NAD+ status with transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: EP300 在共享的啟動子（AR、BRCA1、EZH2 位點）上與 SIRT1 功能上相互對抗：EP300 寫入乙醯化標記，SIRT1 則將其移除。這些位點的乙醯化狀態因此整合了營養與 NAD+ 狀態與轉錄調控。

links.context: EPHA2 cross-talks with TGF-beta and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition programs that enhance invasiveness, which is why EPHA2 inhibitors are being developed in combination with TGF-beta or EMT-pathway blockers. The connection runs both ways: EMT programs and senescent-cell exosomes converge on EPHA2 signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: EPHA2 與 TGF-beta 及 epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition 程式互相串連以增強侵襲性，因此 EPHA2 抑制劑正與 TGF-beta 或 EMT 路徑阻斷劑併用開發。此關係是雙向的：EMT 程式與衰老細胞外泌體皆匯入 EPHA2 訊號。

links.context: ER stress and the unfolded protein response are key inducers of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and of cellular senescence programmes generally, making ER proteostasis a lever for modulating the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: ER 壓力與未摺疊蛋白反應是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）以及一般細胞衰老程序的主要誘導因子，使內質網蛋白穩定性成為調節 SASP 的槓桿。

links.context: ER stress is a cellular condition in which the folding capacity of the endoplasmic reticulum is overwhelmed. In Parkinson's disease pathogenesis, reactive oxygen species and neuromelanin's toxic precursor aminochrome can trigger it; aminochrome adducts with alpha-synuclein generate neurotoxic oligomers that also trigger mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: ER 壓力是內質網摺疊能力被超越的細胞狀態。在帕金森氏症的致病過程中，活性氧物種與神經黑質的毒性前驅物 aminochrome 可誘發 ER 壓力；aminochrome 與 α-突觸核蛋白形成的加合物會產生具神經毒性的寡聚體，並可觸發粒線體功能失調與氧化壓力。

links.context: ERK phosphorylation of Mcl-1 at T163 blocks the GSK3 phosphodegron cascade, stabilizing the protein.
links.context_zh_TW: ERK 在 T163 磷酸化 Mcl-1 阻斷 GSK3 磷酸降解決聯，穩定蛋白。

links.context: ERRalpha (estrogen-related receptor alpha, encoded by ESRRA) is an orphan nuclear receptor closely related to estrogen receptor alpha and beta, but unlike them it is not activated by estrogen. It is constitutively active once expressed and is controlled by PGC-1alpha coactivation and interaction with corepressors such as NRIP1/RIP140.
links.context_zh_TW: ERRalpha（estrogen-related receptor alpha，由 ESRRA 編碼）是孤立的核受體，與雌激素受體 alpha 及 beta 高度相關，但與其不同的是它不會被雌激素活化。它一旦表現即具組成型活性，並受 PGC-1α 共活化與 NRIP1/RIP140 等共抑制因子調控。

links.context: ERRalpha drives bioenergetic reprogramming in basal-like and triple-negative breast cancer and other high-energy-demand tumours; it is overexpressed in basal-like breast cancer and ERRalpha inhibition reduces tumour growth and metastasis. ERRalpha also mediates insulin sensitivity and hepatic gluconeogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: ERRalpha 驅動基底樣與三陰性乳癌以及其他高能量需求腫瘤的生物能量重編程；在基底樣乳癌中 ERRalpha 過度表現，而抑制 ERRalpha 可減少腫瘤生長與轉移。ERRalpha 亦介導胰島素敏感度與肝糖質新生。

links.context: ETC dysfunction — including mutations in individual complexes — is implicated in mitochondrial disease, neurodegeneration and age-related decline, since complexes I and III are the dominant mitochondrial ROS sources whose leakage drives oxidative damage over time.
links.context_zh_TW: 電子傳遞鏈功能失調——包含個別複合體的突變——與粒線體疾病、神經退化及與年齡相關的衰退有關，因為複合體 I 與 III 是粒線體 ROS 的主要來源，其漏溢會隨時間造成氧化傷害。

links.context: ETS transcription factors are frequently deregulated in cancer by overexpression, chromosomal translocation, or as downstream effectors of MAPK/RAS signaling. ETS gene fusions such as TMPRSS2-ERG in prostate cancer and EWS-ETS fusions in Ewing sarcoma are diagnostic and therapeutic biomarkers.
links.context_zh_TW: ETS 轉錄因子在癌症中常因過度表現、染色體轉位，或作為 MAPK/RAS 訊號的下游效應器而失去調控。前列腺癌的 TMPRSS2-ERG 融合與 Ewing 肉瘤的 EWS-ETS 融合基因，即為診斷與治療的生物標記。

links.context: EV signalling amplifies network inflammation, with microglia acting as both receiver and sender of EV-borne alarm signals. In pulmonary fibrosis, stem-cell-derived extracellular vesicles are proposed to work in the opposite direction, attenuating oxidative stress, modulating the SASP and reducing fibroblast activation, which makes them an emerging senescence-targeted therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: EV 訊號會放大網絡層級的發炎，小膠細胞既是 EV 所攜帶警報訊號的受訊者也是發訊者。在肺纖維化中，幹細胞衍生的 extracellular vesicles 則被提出具有相反作用，可減輕 oxidative stress、調節 SASP 並減少纖維母細胞活化，使其成為新興的衰老細胞標靶治療。

links.context: EX-527 reverses chemoresistance in several tumor types: it sensitizes endometrial cancer cells carrying mutated or non-functional p53, as well as non-small cell lung cancer cells, to cisplatin and other chemotherapeutic agents in xenograft models.
links.context_zh_TW: EX-527 可逆轉多種腫瘤的化療抗藥性：在異種移植模型中，它使帶有突變或無功能 p53 的子宮內膜癌細胞，以及非小細胞肺癌細胞，對 cisplatin 與其他化療藥物重新敏感。

links.context: EZH2, the catalytic subunit of the polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), represses pro-inflammatory SASP factors including CCL2, CXCL9, and CXCL10 by depositing the H3K27me3 repressive mark at their loci. Loss or inhibition of EZH2 derepresses these chemokines and augments the SASP, placing polycomb-mediated silencing as a counterbalance to the activating transcription factors of the secretome. The relationship is fairly well established in specific contexts but represents one of several layers of SASP control rather than a master switch, and it contrasts with the activating roles of KDM4 and BRD4 at the same loci.
links.context_zh_TW: EZH2 是 polycomb 抑制複合體 2（PRC2）的催化次單元，透過在 CCL2、CXCL9 與 CXCL10 等促發炎性 SASP 因子基因座沉積 H3K27me3 抑制性標記，抑制這些因子。EZH2 缺失或抑制會去抑制這些趨化因子並放大 SASP，使 polycomb 介導的靜默成為分泌組活化轉錄因子的平衡力量。此關係在特定脈絡中相當確立，但代表 SASP 控制的其中一層而非主開關，且與 KDM4 和 BRD4 在同一基因座的活化角色形成對比。

links.context: Efficient UGA recoding selectively supports translation of selenoproteins that buffer reactive oxygen species, notably the GPX4 and Thioredoxin reductase families, which are essential for controlling lipid peroxidation and preventing ferroptosis. Um34 loss collapses antioxidant selenoprotein translation and thereby increases oxidative-stress sensitivity; separately, ribosome stalling during selenoprotein translation has been shown to expose a ferroptosis vulnerability (Li et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2022), linking recoding fidelity to cell-death fate.
links.context_zh_TW: 高效的 UGA 再編碼會選擇性支持那些緩衝活性氧的 selenoprotein 的轉譯，尤其是 GPX4 與 Thioredoxin reductase 家族，它們對控制脂質過氧化與防止 ferroptosis 至關重要。Um34 缺失會崩潰抗氧化 selenoprotein 的轉譯，進而提高氧化壓力敏感性；另一方面，selenoprotein 轉譯過程中的核糖體停滯已被證實會暴露 ferroptosis 脆弱性（Li 等，Nat. Chem. Biol. 2022），將再編碼保真度與細胞命運相連。
links.source_file: _document_ - Selenocysteine tRNA methylation promotes oxidative stress resistance in melanoma metastasis.md

links.context: Elastin is among the longest-lived proteins in the human body, with an arterial half-life of 70+ years, so it is exceptionally vulnerable to cumulative damage from glycation, oxidation and proteolysis with no efficient repair. AGE crosslinks stiffen elastin fibres, reduce elasticity and make elastin resistant to normal remodelling.
links.context_zh_TW: 彈性蛋白是人體最長壽的蛋白質之一，在動脈中的半衰期超過 70 年，因此對糖化、氧化與蛋白水解所造成的累積傷害特別脆弱，且缺乏有效修復。AGE 交聯會使彈性蛋白纖維變硬、降低彈性，並使其抵抗正常重塑。

links.context: Elastokines promote developmental angiogenesis, where controlled elastin remodelling is required for vascular maturation, and in cancer they drive tumour angiogenesis via EBP-mediated VEGF upregulation while also enabling migration and invasion through degraded elastic barriers.
links.context_zh_TW: Elastokines 促進發育性血管新生（此時需受控的彈性蛋白重塑以完成血管成熟）；在癌症中，它們藉由 EBP 介導的 VEGF 上調驅動腫瘤血管新生，並透過降解的彈性屏障促進遷移與侵犯。

links.context: Elastokines promote paracrine senescence in neighbouring dermal fibroblasts, and their serum and urinary levels — particularly VGVAPG-containing peptides — serve as biomarkers of elastin degradation in COPD, atherosclerosis, skin ageing and rheumatoid arthritis.
links.context_zh_TW: Elastokines 會在鄰近的真皮纖維母細胞中誘發旁分泌性衰老；其血清與尿液濃度（尤其是含 VGVAPG 的胜肽）可作為 COPD、動脈粥狀硬化、皮膚老化與類風濕性關節炎中彈性蛋白降解的生物標記。

links.context: Elevated HSP27 correlates with resistance to chemotherapy (e.g., docetaxel) in prostate and other cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP27 升高與前列腺癌及其他癌症對化療（如 docetaxel）的抗性相關。

links.context: Elevated MDSC frequencies rise with age and contribute to immunosenescence by suppressing T-cell and NK responses and promoting a tolerogenic environment. Their expansion is both a marker and a driver of age-related immune decline, and it correlates with chronic inflammation. The relationship embeds MDSCs within the broader aging immune dysfunction and links the SASP to adaptive immune deterioration. Reducing MDSC burden is proposed as a strategy to rejuvenate aged immune responses, and markers of MDSC accumulation are being tested as biomarkers of immune aging.
links.context_zh_TW: MDSCs 貢獻免疫衰老，透過其免疫抑制功能與擴張加劇年齡相關免疫功能衰退。在衰老中，MDSC 蓄積削弱對感染、疫苗與癌前病變的適應性免疫反應，加劇免疫老化表型。此貢獻與慢性發炎（inflammaging）協作，其中 SASP 驅動的骨髓生成維持抑制性細胞池。將 MDSCs 連結到免疫衰老將其置於老化免疫衰退的核心。

links.context: Elevated Proteobacteria abundance and reduced overall microbial diversity are recurrent features of aging and age-related disease, contributing to Inflammaging. Because Proteobacteria bear lipopolysaccharide (endotoxin) on their outer membrane, increased burden raises circulating LPS, activates innate immunity and promotes low-grade inflammation via TLR4 signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteobacteria 豐度升高與整體微生物多樣性下降是老化與年齡相關疾病的反覆特徵，並促成 inflammaging。由於 Proteobacteria 的外膜帶有 lipopolysaccharide（內毒素），其負荷增加會提高循環 LPS、活化先天免疫並透過 TLR4 訊號促進低度發炎。

links.context: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens is a principal urolithin A converter whose steps complement those supplied by Enterocloster species; together their activity determines the rate at which Ellagic acid becomes Urolithin A.
links.context_zh_TW: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 是主要的尿脂素 A 轉換菌，其步驟與 Enterocloster 菌種提供的步驟互補；兩者的活性共同決定 Ellagic acid 轉為 Urolithin A 的速率。

links.context: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens, an Eggerthellaceae gut bacterium, is specifically characterized by producing Isourolithin A, the structural isomer of Urolithin A, from dietary Ellagic Acid; its activity defines urolithin metabotype B (urolithin B plus isourolithin A producers) as distinct from Urolithin A-predominant metabotype A.
links.context_zh_TW: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 為 Eggerthellaceae 腸道菌，其特徵是能由飲食 Ellagic Acid 產生 Isourolithin A（Urolithin A 的結構異構物）；其活性定義了 urolithin metabotype B（產 urolithin B 與 isourolithin A 者），有別於以 Urolithin A 為主的 metabotype A。
links.source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md

links.context: Encapsulation of the flavonoid Fisetin in nanoparticles bypasses its poor aqueous solubility and rapid phase II metabolism, protecting it in the GI tract, slowing release, and increasing intestinal permeability up to 4.9x in the duodenum for PLGA/PVA particles.
links.context_zh_TW: 將類黃酮 Fisetin 封裝於奈米顆粒中可繞過其水溶性差與快速的 phase II 代謝，保護藥物免受胃腸道破壞、減緩釋放，並使 PLGA/PVA 顆粒在十二指腸的腸通透性提高至多 4.9 倍。

links.context: Endogenous defences against excitotoxic injury include astrocytic glutamate uptake, antioxidant buffering, and autophagy that clears damaged organelles. Because this clearance pathway is protective, boosting autophagy and NAD+-dependent sirtuin activity is explored as a neuroprotective strategy against excitotoxic and age-related neuronal injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 對抗 excitotoxic 損傷的內在防禦包括星狀膠細胞的 glutamate 回收、抗氧化緩衝，以及清除受損胞器的 autophagy。由於這條清除路徑具有保護作用，強化 autophagy 與 NAD+ 相關的 sirtuin 活性便被探索作為對抗 excitotoxic 與老化相關神經元損傷的神經保護策略。

links.context: Endothelial dysfunction is a systemic pathological state of the vascular endothelium with reduced nitric oxide bioavailability, impaired vasodilation, increased inflammatory adhesion molecule expression and a pro-thrombotic phenotype. It is an early hallmark of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease, and the initiating step in atherogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 內皮功能失調是血管內皮的全身性病理狀態，特徵為一氧化氮生物可用度下降、血管舒張功能受損、發炎性黏附分子表現增加與促血栓表型。它是動脈粥狀硬化與心血管疾病的早期標記，也是致粥樣硬化的起始步驟。

links.context: Energy-stress AMPK phosphorylates the TSC complex at S1387 to activate it. Phosphorylation is the energy-on switch.
links.context_zh_TW: 能量壓力 AMPK 在 S1387 磷酸化 TSC 複合體以活化它。磷酸化是能量開啟開關。

links.context: Enhanced SIRT6 activity abrogates the neurotoxicity of ALS-linked mutant SOD1 astrocytes, making SIRT6 a therapeutic target in ALS. SIRT1 is increased in SOD1-G93A mice and SIRT3 is increased in ALS spinal cord, with functional implications still unclear, while SIRT6 upregulation also alleviates inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis after spinal cord injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 增強的 SIRT6 活性消除 ALS 連結突變 SOD1 星狀細胞的神經毒性，使 SIRT6 成為 ALS 的治療標的。SIRT1 在 SOD1-G93A 小鼠中增加，SIRT3 在 ALS 脊髓中增加，功能意義仍不明，而 SIRT6 上調亦減輕脊髓損傷後的發炎、氧化壓力與凋亡。

links.context: Enhancing TFEB activity transcriptionally upregulates lysosomal enzymes and autophagic receptors, accelerating tau degradation. Small molecules such as Celastrol and related TFEB activators, as well as mTORC1 inhibitors (rapalogues), stimulate autophagic flux and reduce tau burden in models, while Selective Autophagy receptors (p62, NBR1) recognise ubiquitinated tau for delivery to phagophores.
links.context_zh_TW: 提升 TFEB 活性會在轉錄層面上調溶酶體酵素與自噬受體，加速 tau 的降解。小分子如 Celastrol 及相關的 TFEB 活化劑，以及 mTORC1 抑制劑（rapalog 類），能刺激自噬流並在模型中降低 tau 負擔；而選擇性自噬受體（p62、NBR1）則辨識泛素化的 tau 並將其運送至吞噬膜。

links.context: Entacapone serves as the reference COMT inhibitor against which fisetin is compared. Entacapone is roughly 10-50x more potent (IC50 ~0.23 uM versus 2.6-5.8 uM), but fisetin is a mixed competitive/noncompetitive inhibitor, is itself a COMT substrate yielding the active metabolite geraldol, and adds senolytic, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity that entacapone lacks.
links.context_zh_TW: Entacapone 是評估 fisetin 的 COMT 抑制能力時的對照藥。Entacapone 效價約高 10-50 倍（IC50 ~0.23 uM 對 2.6-5.8 uM），但 fisetin 為混合型（競爭加非競爭）抑制劑，本身也是 COMT 受質並生成活性代謝物 geraldol，且另具 senolytic、抗發炎與抗氧化活性，為 entacapone 所無。

links.context: Epacadostat was tested in combination with checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab and nivolumab across Phase I-III trials in melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer and bladder cancer. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic scaffolding signaling that catalytic inhibition does not block, complicating combination use.
links.context_zh_TW: Epacadostat 曾與 pembrolizumab、nivolumab 等 checkpoint inhibitor 併用於黑色素瘤、非小細胞肺癌與膀胱癌的第一至三期臨床試驗。IDO1 亦可參與非酵素性的支架訊號，而催化抑制無法阻斷此作用，使併用更為複雜。

links.context: Epidemiologic and case-control studies support an inverse relationship between apigenin-containing flavonoid intake and the risk of several cancers, including ovarian cancer.
