links.context: Mebendazole, a benzimidazole active against filarial worms including onchocerciasis, shares its microtubule-disrupting mechanism with anti-mitotic chemotherapy. This mechanistic overlap is why onchocerciasis drug development informs oncology repurposing: the same destabilization of microtubules that immobilizes parasites blocks spindle dynamics in dividing tumour cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Mebendazole 是一種對包括 onchocerciasis 在內的絲蟲有效的 benzimidazole，與抗有絲分裂化療共享 destabilize microtubule 的機制。這種機制重疊正是 onchocerciasis 藥物開發能回饋腫瘤學再定位的原因：使寄生蟲癱瘓的同一種 microtubule 去穩定化，同樣會阻斷分裂中腫瘤細胞的紡錘體動力學。

links.context: Mechanical density cues act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ.
links.context_zh_TW: 機械密度線索經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ。

links.context: Meiosis-two sister-chromatid nondisjunction produces trisomic gametes.
links.context_zh_TW: 減數分裂二姐妹染色單體不分離產生三體配子。

links.context: Meiotic chromosome segregation depends on the cohesin complex, with REC8 acting as the meiotic kleisin that holds Sister Chromatids together from prophase I until anaphase I. By maintaining sister cohesion specifically until the first division, cohesin allows Meiosis to separate homologous chromosomes in Meiosis I while still permitting sister chromatid separation in Meiosis II.
links.context_zh_TW: 減數分裂的染色體分離仰賴 cohesin 複合體，其中 REC8 作為減數分裂專屬的 kleisin，自前期 I 一直維持姐妹染色分體的黏連至後期 I。藉由只在第一次分裂前維持姐妹染色分體黏連，cohesin 使 Meiosis 得以在第一次分裂中分離同源染色體，同時仍允許第二次分裂中分離姐妹染色分體。

links.context: Melanoma cells co-opt the tRNA[Ser]Sec Um34 axis to sustain an antioxidant shield: by maintaining Um34-modified tRNA[Ser]Sec they keep antioxidant selenoprotein translation high, which permits survival under the high oxidative stress of the metastatic niche. Um34 modification is necessary and sufficient for metastasis in melanoma xenograft models, and micrometastatic cells upregulate selenocysteine biosynthesis, consistent with prior work showing oxidative stress limits distant metastasis. The axis is therefore a potential therapeutic target specific to metastatic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤細胞會劫持 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 軸以維持抗氧化屏障：藉由保有帶 Um34 修飾的 tRNA[Ser]Sec，使抗氧化 selenoprotein 的轉譯維持高檔，讓細胞得以在轉移灶的高氧化壓力環境中存活。在黑色素瘤異種移植模型中，Um34 修飾對轉移既是必要也是充分條件，且微轉移細胞會上調 selenocysteine 生合成，與先前顯示氧化壓力限制遠端轉移的研究一致。因此此軸是轉移性疾病特有的潛在治療標的。
links.source_file: _document_ - Selenocysteine tRNA methylation promotes oxidative stress resistance in melanoma metastasis.md

links.context: Melanoma derived from Melanocyte exploits Selenocysteine translation through the FTSJ1/Um34 axis to maintain antioxidant selenoproteins. This Selenocysteine-based antioxidant shield is what allows metastatic cells to survive the oxidative stress of the metastatic niche.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 Melanocyte 衍生的 Melanoma 會利用 FTSJ1/Um34 軸進行 Selenocysteine 的轉譯，以維持抗氧化性的 selenoprotein。正是這套以 Selenocysteine 為基礎的抗氧化防護shield，讓轉移細胞得以在轉移微環境的氧化壓力下存活。

links.context: Melanoma has a high propensity for early metastasis and accounts for the majority of skin-cancer deaths through metastatic spread. Metastatic colonization is an oxidative-stress-sensitive process dependent on FTSJ1/Um34-driven selenoprotein translation. Oxidative stress inhibits the ability of melanoma cells to colonize distant sites.
links.context_zh_TW: Melanoma 具有早期轉移的高度傾向，並透過轉移擴散造成大多數皮膚癌死亡。轉移性定殖是一個對氧化壓力敏感的過程，依賴 FTSJ1/Um34 驅動的硒蛋白轉譯。氧化壓力會抑制黑色素瘤細胞定殖遠處部位的能力。

links.context: Melanoma is promoted by SASP. Senescent melanocytes in nevi are held in check by oncogene-induced senescence driven by BRAF V600E, but the SASP they produce—particularly IL-8 and GROα—can stimulate the proliferation of rare premalignant cells that escaped senescence, potentially driving melanoma development.
links.context_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤（Melanoma）受 SASP 促進。痣中的衰老黑色素細胞受 BRAF V600E 驅動的致癌基因誘導衰老（OIS）所抑制，但它們所產生的 SASP——尤其是 IL-8 與 GROα——可刺激已逃脫衰老的罕見癌前細胞增殖，可能驅動黑色素瘤的發展。

links.context: Melittin induces Apoptosis in melanoma, breast cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma and lung cancer cells and synergizes with conventional Chemotherapy agents. Because systemic use is limited by hemolytic toxicity, nanoparticle formulations of melittin are being developed to improve delivery, and Annexin V/propidium iodide staining is used to characterise the dose-dependent shift between apoptotic and necrotic fates.
links.context_zh_TW: Melittin 可在黑色素瘤、乳癌、肝細胞癌與肺癌細胞中誘發 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡），並與傳統 Chemotherapy（化學治療）藥物產生協同作用。由於全身使用受血溶性毒性限制，melittin 的奈米顆粒製劑正在開發以改善遞送；研究者並以 Annexin V／碘化丙啶染色來判定細胞在凋亡與壞死命運間隨劑量改變的位移。

links.context: Melittin, the principal toxin of ApiTox, activates Phospholipase A2 as well as disrupting cell membranes. Phospholipase A2 hydrolyzes membrane phospholipids to release arachidonic acid for prostaglandin and leukotriene synthesis, so melittin links membrane damage to eicosanoid production and the resulting inflammatory and apoptotic signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: Melittin 是 ApiTox 的主要毒素，除破壞細胞膜外亦會活化 Phospholipase A2。Phospholipase A2 水解膜磷脂以釋放 arachidonic acid（花生四烯酸）供前列腺素與白三烯合成，因此 melittin 把膜損傷與類二十碳四烯酸產生連結，引發後續發炎與凋亡訊號。

links.context: Mesenchymal and stromal cells synthesize pro-HGF for niche signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 間質與基質細胞合成 pro-HGF 以供微環境訊號。

links.context: Metabolic disorders are associated with Autophagy dysfunction, which is a common feature across the class rather than a feature of any single disease. This makes autophagic-lysosomal capacity a therapeutic target of unusually broad reach, and also explains why TFEB activation improves several metabolically distinct conditions at once.
links.context_zh_TW: 代謝疾病與 Autophagy 功能異常相關，而這是整類疾病共有的特徵，而非任一單一疾病的特徵。這使自噬－溶酶體容量成為觸及面極廣的治療標的，也解釋了為何 TFEB 活化能同時改善多種代謝機制不同的疾病。

links.context: Metabotypes refine risk stratification beyond body-mass-index or single Biomarkers in Metabolic Syndrome and cardiometabolic disease, predicting who will benefit from specific diets, exercise, or pharmacotherapy. This biomarker-guided stratification in clinical trials also offers a mechanistic explanation for inter-individual variability in drug response and adverse effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Metabolic Syndrome 與心血管代謝疾病中，Metabotypes 能在身體質量指數或單一 Biomarker 之外細化風險分層，預測誰能從特定飲食、運動或藥物治療中獲益。這種以生物標記為導引的臨床試驗分層，也為藥物反應與不良反應的個體間變異提供了機制性解釋。

links.context: Metformin has been shown to decrease circulating advanced glycation end products in patients with diabetes, as well as to decrease the activity of NF-kB. In a study of 22 women with polycystic ovary disease, six months of metformin therapy resulted in a reduction of serum AGEs. As a widely used anti-diabetic drug, metformin's ability to lower circulating AGEs offers an additional explanation for some of its beneficial metabolic and vascular effects beyond glycemic control. These observations position metformin among pharmacological agents studied as blockers of AGE formation or action.
links.context_zh_TW: Metformin 已被證實能降低糖尿病患者的循環晚期糖化終產物，並降低 NF-kB 的活性。在一項針對 22 名多囊性卵巢疾病（polycystic ovary disease）女性的研究中，六個月的 metformin 治療導致血清 AGE 下降。作為廣泛使用的抗糖尿病藥物，metformin 降低循環 AGE 的能力為其部分有益的代謝與血管效應提供了超越血糖控制之外的額外解釋。這些觀察將 metformin 定位於被研究作為 AGE 形成或作用阻斷劑的藥理藥物之中。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Metformin induces autophagy as an AMPK-dependent autophagy inducer. Induction couples energy sensing to clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: Metformin 作為 AMPK 依賴的自噬誘發因子誘發自噬。誘發將能量感知耦合到清除。

links.context: Metformin inhibits mTORC1 via AMPK and lysosomal Rag-GTPase convergence. Inhibition is distinct from direct rapamycin binding.
links.context_zh_TW: Metformin 經由 AMPK 與溶酶體 Rag-GTPase 匯聚抑制 mTORC1。抑制不同於 rapamycin 直接結合。

links.context: Metformin is believed to exert its anti-diabetic effects through inhibition of complex I of the mitochondrial respiratory chain, a mild perturbation of mitochondrial function that may generate a hormetic (mitohormetic) signal. In mice and lower organisms, metformin treatment induces increased oxidant defenses and extends lifespan, suggesting that gentle inhibition of mitochondrial function can trigger beneficial adaptive stress responses. This positions metformin as a potential prototype for drugs that exploit mitohormesis to treat age-related disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Metformin被認為通過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈的複合物I來發揮其抗糖尿病作用，這是對粒線體功能的輕微干擾，可能產生hormetic（mitohormetic）信號。在小鼠和低等生物中，metformin治療誘導氧化防禦增加並延長壽命，表明輕度抑制粒線體功能可以觸發有益的適應性壓力反應。這使得metformin成為利用mitohormesis治療與年齡相關疾病的藥物潛在原型。

links.context: Metformin, a widely used antidiabetic drug and repurposable agent, reduces the SASP without causing substantial cytotoxicity to senescent cells, holding potential as a senomorphic agent. In this study, metformin-involving assays phenocopied those derived from apigenin: metformin lowered cancer cell malignancy by downregulating the activity of senescent stromal cell conditioned medium, indicating a common pattern shared by both agents. This supports the broader concept that pharmacologically targeting SASP development with senomorphic agents can deprive cancer cells of stroma-conferred gain-of-function phenotypes, specifically chemoresistance, and suggests strategies to improve the...
links.context_zh_TW: Metformin是一種廣泛使用的抗糖尿病藥物和可重新利用的藥物，它減少SASP而不對衰老細胞造成實質性細胞毒性，具有作為senomorphic藥物的潛力。在本研究中，涉及metformin的測定複製了從apigenin得出的表型：metformin通過下調衰老基質細胞條件培養基的活性來降低癌細胞惡性度，表明兩種藥物共享一種共同模式。這支持了更廣泛的概念，即通過senomorphic藥物在藥理學上靶向SASP發展可以剝奪癌細胞由基質賦予的功能獲得性表型，特別是化療抗性，並提出了改善...的策略

links.context: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues. Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin. Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated.
links.context_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues。Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin。Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated。

links.context: Methionine Synthase catalyzes the methylation of homocysteine to methionine, coupling the folate-dependent one-carbon pool to methionine recycling and thereby to the availability of S-adenosylmethionine as the universal methyl donor. Dysregulation of its activity is implicated in metabolic disorders, oxidative stress-related pathologies, and cancer, and pharmacological modulation of this enzyme is a therapeutic strategy for diseases involving its pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: Methionine Synthase 催化同型半胱胺酸再甲基化為 methionine，將依賴 folate 的單碳池與甲硫胺酸回收相連結，進而連結到 S-adenosylmethionine 作為通用甲基供體的可用性。其活性失調與代謝疾病、氧化壓力相關病理及癌症有關，而對此酵素進行藥理調節是涉及其途徑之疾病的治療策略。

links.context: Methotrexate, a first-line disease-modifying antirheumatic drug, increases extracellular adenosine, which suppresses NADPH Oxidase activity in neutrophils and inhibits TNF-induced ROS production in synovial fibroblasts, blunting oxidative joint damage in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
links.context_zh_TW: Methotrexate 是第一線的疾病修飾抗發炎藥物，它提高細胞外 adenosine，進而抑制 Neutrophils 中的 NADPH Oxidase 活性並阻止滑膜纖維母細胞中 TNF 誘發的 ROS 產生，減輕 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的氧化性關節損傷。

links.context: Methyl groups, the one-carbon units transferred by methylation reactions, are regenerated by the Methylation Cycle: after SAMe donates a methyl group (e.g., to COMT for catechol inactivation), the resulting homocysteine is remethylated back to methionine using Methylfolate and MethylB12, so the methyl-donor pool is continuously replenished. The Methylation Cycle is therefore the metabolic engine that sustains methyl-group supply for COMT and other methyltransferases.
links.context_zh_TW: Methyl groups 是甲基化反應所轉移的一碳單元，由 Methylation Cycle 再生：SAMe 捐出甲基（例如給 COMT 用於 catechol 去活化）後，產生的 homocysteine 會藉由 Methylfolate 與 MethylB12 再甲基化回 methionine，使甲基供體池持續補充。因此 Methylation Cycle 是維持 COMT 及其他甲基轉移酶甲基供應的代謝引擎。

links.context: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) supports the Methylation Cycle as the methyl-group carrier for methionine synthase: it provides the methyl group that remethylates homocysteine to methionine, regenerating the SAMe pool that the cycle distributes to methyltransferases such as COMT. Together with Methylfolate, methylB12 is one of the two B-vitamin cofactors that keep homocysteine remethylation, and therefore SAMe-dependent catecholamine clearance, running efficiently.
links.context_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲基鈷胺）作為 methionine synthase 的甲基載體支持 Methylation Cycle：它提供將 homocysteine 再甲基化為 methionine 所需的甲基，再生該循環分配給 COMT 等甲基轉移酶的 SAMe 池。與 Methylfolate 一樣，methylB12 是維持 homocysteine 再甲基化（以及依賴 SAMe 的兒茶酚胺清除）順暢運作的兩種 B 群維生素輔因子之一。

links.context: Methylene Blue acts as an electron cycler that can bypass proximal Electron Transport Chain blocks downstream of Complex IV, restoring redox tone. Complex IV activity also integrates with Mitohormesis, where mild respiratory inhibition triggers adaptive stress responses, and inherited COX deficiencies contribute to neurodegenerative disease and aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene Blue 作為電子循環劑，可繞過 Complex IV 上游的 Electron Transport Chain 阻斷，恢復氧化還原張力。Complex IV 活性亦與 Mitohormesis 相互整合——輕度呼吸抑制可誘發適應性壓力反應——而遺傳性 COX 缺乏則促成神經退化疾病與老化。

links.context: Methylene blue (MB) is neuroprotective in rodent models of stroke, reducing infarct volume and preserving neurological function. MB enhances cellular oxygen consumption in vivo and provides protection against hypoxia-induced injury, including in primary hepatocyte cultures. Its mechanism is distinct from conventional antioxidants: by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III and by upregulating complex IV activity and expression, MB sustains mitochondrial bioenergetics in ischemic tissue where electron transport is compromised.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在中風的囓齒類模型中具有神經保護作用，減少梗塞體積並保留神經功能。MB在體內增強細胞氧氣消耗，並提供對缺氧誘導損傷的保護，包括在原代肝細胞培養中。其機制與傳統抗氧化劑不同：通過作為繞過複合物I-III的替代電子轉運載體，並通過上調複合物IV活性和表達，MB在電子傳輸受損的缺血組織中維持粒線體生物能量學。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Methylene blue can act as an alternative electron carrier that reroutes electrons around a defective Complex I, preserving mitochondrial respiration and partially rescuing the toxicity of Complex I blockade by rotenone.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue 可作為替代性電子載體，將電子繞過失效的 Complex I 傳遞，因而維持粒線體呼吸並可部分救援 rotenone 阻斷 Complex I 所造成的毒性。

links.context: Methylene blue carries a negative Redox Potential (E1/2 = −0.108 V vs NHE) that lets it act as an electron shuttle within the mitochondrial respiratory chain, which is why it enhances the Oxygen Consumption Rate of treated cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue 具有負的 Redox Potential（E1/2 = −0.108 V vs NHE），可在粒線體呼吸鏈中作為電子載體穿梭，這也是它能提升處理細胞 Oxygen Consumption Rate 的原因。

links.context: Methylene blue increases synaptic serotonin by inhibiting monoamine oxidase enzymes, which normally break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. Inhibiting these enzymes means more of these neurotransmitters remain in the synapse, which is how antidepressants like phenelzine work. This mechanism provides methylene blue's mild mood-lifting and anxiolytic effects at 0.5-2 mg doses, but it is also the source of its most serious safety concern: combining methylene blue with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome - a documented case-report-level interaction requiring physician involvement.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過抑制單胺氧化酶酶來增加突觸血清素，這些酶通常分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素。抑制這些酶意味著更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中，這就是phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用方式。這種機制在0.5-2毫克劑量下提供methylene blue的輕度情緒提升和抗焦慮作用，但這也是其最嚴重安全問題的來源：將methylene blue與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群——這是一種已記錄的病例報告級別的相互作用，需要醫師參與。
links.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

links.context: Methylene blue maintains ATP production by acting as a redox cycling agent in mitochondria, donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running efficiently. It can bypass dysfunctional Complex I and Complex III, rerouting electron flow to sustain ATP synthesis when normal pathways are impaired - essentially a backup generator for cellular energy production. The dose range that shows this effect in cellular and animal studies is consistently in the sub-1 mg/kg range (1-4 mg per dose for most adults). These mitochondrial effects are the mechanistic basis for proposed cognitive and energy benefits, though most supporting evidence comes from cell cultures and rodents rather than human trials.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用來維持ATP產生，捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈有效運行。它可以繞過功能障礙的複合物I和III，在正常路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP合成——本質上是細胞能量產生的備用發電機。在細胞和動物研究中顯示這種效果的劑量範圍始終在低於1 mg/kg的範圍內（大多數成人每次1-4毫克）。這些粒線體效應是提出的認知和能量益處的機制基礎，儘管大多數支持證據來自細胞培養和囓齒類動物而不是人體試驗。
links.source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md

links.context: Methylglyoxal is paradoxically selectively cytotoxic to cancer cells, which have elevated glycolysis and impaired detoxification. Patra et al. and Pal et al. showed that creatine — with ascorbic acid — markedly augments MG's antitumour effect, eliminating visible tumour growth in sarcoma models by depleting cellular ATP and disrupting cancer metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylglyoxal 對癌症細胞具有選擇性細胞毒性（癌症細胞糖解作用旺盛且解毒能力受損）。Patra 與 Pal 等人顯示 creatine（搭配 Ascorbic Acid）可大幅增強 MG 的抗腫瘤效果，藉由耗竭細胞 ATP 並擾動癌症代謝，在 sarcoma 模型中消除可見的腫瘤生長。

links.context: Methylglyoxal modifies lysine to carboxyethyllysine and crosslinks. Modification is the second major AGE route.
links.context_zh_TW: 甲基乙二醛修飾離胺酸形成羧乙基離胺酸與交聯。修飾是第二主要 AGE 路徑。

links.context: Methylglyoxal, a reactive dicarbonyl, glycates threonine residues (alongside arginine and lysine) in long-lived proteins. Such methylglyoxal-derived adducts accumulate in aging tissues, so threonine residues serve as a chemically labile site where dicarbonyl stress leaves a covalent footprint on protein structure and function.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylglyoxal 是一種反應性二羰基，會在長壽命蛋白質中使 threonine 殘基（以及 arginine 與 lysine 殘基）糖基化。此類 Methylglyoxal 衍生的加合物在老化組織中累積，因此 threonine 殘基成為二羰基壓力在蛋白質結構與功能上留下共價印記的化學脆弱點。

links.context: MiDAS is the senescence programme initiated by mitochondrial dysfunction itself, whereas SAMD describes the mitochondrial deterioration that occurs within already-senescent cells and fuels the canonical pro-inflammatory SASP via ROS, minority MOMP and mtDNA release through cGAS-STING. Together they form a feedback loop coupling mitochondrial decline to low-grade inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: MiDAS 是由粒線體功能障礙本身啟動的衰老程式，而 SAMD 描述的是已在衰老細胞內發生的粒線體劣化，並藉 ROS、minority MOMP 與經 cGAS-STING 釋出的 mtDNA 助長典型促發炎 SASP。兩者共同形成回饋迴路，將粒線體衰退與低度發炎耦合。

links.context: MicroRNAs are 21-25 nt small non-coding RNAs that post-transcriptionally regulate gene expression by binding target mRNAs, causing their degradation or inhibiting translation. They form a major layer of epigenetic control and are themselves often regulated by DNA methylation and histone modification.
links.context_zh_TW: MicroRNA 是 21-25 個核苷酸的小型非編碼 RNA，藉由結合目標 mRNA 使其降解或抑制其轉譯，以轉錄後方式調控基因表現。miRNA 是表觀遺傳調控的重要一層，本身也常受 DNA 甲基化與 histone modification 調節。

links.context: Microglial STING helps preserve blood-brain barrier integrity during aging, so STING inhibition is context dependent: some inhibitors may compromise this barrier-protective function even as they reduce parenchymal inflammation. This protective role is the reason cell-type-selective delivery is needed if STING inhibitors are to be used in neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 微膠細胞的 STING 在老化過程中有助於維持 blood-brain barrier 的完整性，因此 STING 抑制的效應與情境相關：某些抑制劑可能在降低實質內發炎的同時，損害這項保護屏障的功能。正是這項保護性角色，使得若要在神經退化中使用 STING inhibitors，必須採取細胞類型選擇性的遞送方式。

links.context: Microglial STING signaling is protective at the blood-brain barrier: it preserves hippocampal barrier integrity during aging, such that STING deficiency paradoxically accelerates cognitive and motor decline even though it reduces senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 微膠細胞的 STING 訊號對血腦屏障具有保護作用：它能在老化期間維持海馬的屏障完整性，因此 STING 缺乏反而會加速認知與運動能力的衰退，儘管它也減少了 senescence。

links.context: Milbemycins share the 16-membered macrocyclic lactone scaffold of the avermectins but differ by lacking the oleandrose disaccharide and by their Streptomyces hygroscopicus origin; the 5-oxime modification markedly improves oral absorption, making once-monthly oral dosing feasible.
links.context_zh_TW: Milbemycin 與 avermectin 共用 16 員環的 macrocyclic lactone 骨架，但缺少 oleandrose 双醣且源自 Streptomyces hygroscopicus；其 5-oxime 修飾大幅提升口服吸收，使每月一次口服給藥得以實行。

links.context: Minority MOMP is the mechanistic link between apoptosis and senescence: by keeping cells alive but inflammatory through mtDNA-driven cGAS-STING signaling, it lets stressed cells broadcast the SASP instead of dying. Interrupting miMOMP-cGAS-STING signaling is therefore a senomorphic strategy that blunts the senescence phenotype without killing the cell.
links.context_zh_TW: Minority MOMP 是 apoptosis 與 senescence 之間的機制性環節：它藉由 mtDNA 驅動的 cGAS-STING 訊號讓受壓細胞維持存活但帶有發炎性，藉 SASP 廣播狀態而非死亡。因此阻斷 miMOMP-cGAS-STING 訊號是可在不殺死細胞的前提下削弱衰老表型的 senomorphic 策略。

links.context: Miro (Miro1/RHOT1) is the outer mitochondrial membrane receptor for the Milton-kinesin transport complex, anchoring mitochondria to microtubule motors so they can be distributed to distal neuronal compartments. Parkin-mediated ubiquitination of Miro1 is the step that segregates impaired mitochondria for autophagic clearance by mitophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: Miro（Miro1/RHOT1）是粒線體外膜上 Milton-kinesin 運輸複合體的受體，將粒線體錨定於微管馬達，使其能分配至遠端神經元區室。Parkin 對 Miro1 的泛素化是將受損粒線體隔離、供 mitophagy 進行自噬清除的關鍵步驟。

links.context: Mithridates VI of Pontus reportedly ingested gradually increasing sub-lethal doses of toxins (Mithridatism) to render himself immune to lethal poisons. The practice is the archetypal historical anecdote behind hormesis — that low doses of a stressor induce adaptive protective responses whereas high doses are harmful — and modern mitohormesis formalises the same intuition.
links.context_zh_TW: 本都斯國的 Mithridates VI 據稱以漸增的次致死性毒物劑量（Mithridatism）攝入，使自己對致死毒物免疫。此一做法是 hormesis（低劑量壓力可誘發適應性保護反應，而高劑量有害）的歷史典範，現代 mitohormesis 則將同一 直覺加以形式化。

links.context: Mithridatism, the practice of protecting oneself against a poison by gradually self-administering non-lethal amounts and popularized by Mithridates VI of Pontus with the Antidotum Mithridaticum, is the historical precursor to the scientific concept of hormesis. It illustrates the same underlying principle - that low-dose exposure to a stressor can induce an adaptive, protective response - which mitohormesis extends to mild mitochondrial perturbation.
links.context_zh_TW: Mithridatism 指透過逐步自行攝取非致死劑量來保護自己免於毒害的做法，因龐特國王 Mithridates VI 與 Antidotum Mithridaticum 而聞名，是科學上 hormesis 概念的前身。它呈現了相同的底層原理——低劑量接觸壓力源可誘發適應性保護反應——而 mitohormesis 將此原理延伸至輕度粒線體擾動。

links.context: MitoStores are cytosolic granules that act as temporary storage depots for mitochondrial precursor proteins when import into mitochondria is impaired or saturated, part of the triage system for mPOS (mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress). Chaperone-bound precursors are held in an import-competent state, preventing their aggregation and cytosolic proteotoxicity until import capacity is restored.
links.context_zh_TW: MitoStores 是細胞質顆粒，在粒線體 precursor protein 的輸入受損或飽和時作為暫時儲存庫，屬於 mPOS（粒線體 precursor 過度累積壓力）的分流系統。Chaperone 結合的 precursor 以可輸入狀態被保存，避免聚集與細胞質 proteotoxicity，待輸入能力恢復後再釋放至粒線體。

links.context: Mitochondria are identified as the primary source of ROS in the mitochondrial free radical theory of aging, and longer-lived species generally produce less superoxide and H2O2. Validation attempts have yielded mixed results, and the field now views oxidative damage as one of several interconnected hallmarks of aging, with ROS also serving signaling functions.
links.context_zh_TW: 在粒線體自由基老化理論中，mitochondria 被認定為 ROS 的主要來源，且壽命較長的物種通常產生較少的 superoxide 與 H2O2。相關驗證結果參差不一，現今領域已將氧化傷害視為數個相互連結的 aging hallmarks 之一，且 ROS 同時具有訊號功能。

links.context: Mitochondria govern stem cell fate through energy production, ROS signalling, mtDNA integrity, metabolite-mediated epigenetic regulation and dynamic segregation during division. Quiescent stem cells rely on glycolysis and shift toward oxidative phosphorylation on activation, while selective retention of aged mitochondria in intestinal stem cells promotes TET-dependent epigenetic remodelling via α-ketoglutarate.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體透過能量產生、ROS 訊號、mtDNA 完整性、代謝物介導的表觀遺傳調控與分裂時的動態分配來決定幹細胞命運。靜止的幹細胞依賴糖解作用，活化時則轉向 oxidative phosphorylation；而腸道幹細胞選擇性保留老化粒線體，會經由 α-ketoglutarate 促進 TET 相關的表觀遺傳重塑。

links.context: Mitochondria occupy up to 30-40% of ventricular cardiomyocyte volume, arranged in ordered chains between myofibrils and beneath the sarcolemma. This high density reflects the enormous ATP demand of continuous contraction; 60-90% of ATP normally derives from fatty acid oxidation, with the remainder from glucose and lactate, making the healthy heart substrate-flexible but critically oxidative-phosphorylation-dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondria 佔心室型 Cardiomyocytes 細胞體積的 30–40%，排列在肌原纖維之間與肌漿膜下的規則鏈狀結構中。如此高的密度反映持續收縮的巨大 ATP 需求；正常情況下 60–90% 的 ATP 來自脂肪酸氧化，其餘來自 Glucose 與 Lactate，使健康心臟具有受質彈性，卻也極度依賴氧化磷酸化。

links.context: Mitochondria retained in enucleated erythrocytes would generate damaging reactive oxygen species in the circulation, so their developmental elimination by ERMIT protects red cells from oxidative injury. Defective ERMIT instead causes incomplete mitochondrial retention and premature hemolysis.
links.context_zh_TW: 若去核紅血球中殘留粒線體，便會在循環中產生具損傷性的活性氧物種；因此 ERMIT 的發育性清除可保護紅血球免受氧化傷害。ERMIT 缺失則會造成粒線體殘留與過早溶血。

links.context: Mitochondrial DNA as a circular genome, together with the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes, bacterial-style ribosomes and replication, is among the strongest molecular evidence for endosymbiotic origin of the mitochondrion.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體 DNA 呈環狀，加上粒線體的內外膜、細菌式的核糖體與複製方式，是粒線體內共生起源最強的分子證據之一。

links.context: Mitochondrial ROS production is an early and obligatory event in TNFR1 signaling: TRAF2 recruits the E3 ligase TRIM21, which ubiquitinates p65 (NDUFS1) of Respiratory Chain Complex I, causing electron leak and Superoxide Radicals generation. The resulting mitochondrial ROS is required for sustained JNK activation and IL-1β production, coupling TNF-alpha receptor signaling to oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體 ROS 的產生是 TNFR1 訊號傳遞中早期且必要的事件：TRAF2 招募 E3 連接酶 TRIM21，後者將 Respiratory Complex I 的 p65 (NDUFS1) 泛素化，造成電子漏出與 Superoxide Radicals 的生成。由此產生的粒線體 ROS 是維持 JNK 活化與 IL-1β 產生所必需，將 TNF-alpha 受體訊號與氧化壓力連結起來。

links.context: Mitochondrial ROS, together with the high replication rate of mtDNA and its relatively limited repair capacity, drives the somatic mtDNA mutations that generate Heteroplasmy. Because new mutant genomes arise throughout life, heteroplasmy levels drift and become mosaic across cells and tissues as an organism ages.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 加上 mtDNA 高複製率與相對有限的修復能力，會促成體細胞性 mtDNA 突變的產生，而這些突變正是形成 Heteroplasmy 的來源。由於新的突變基因組在一生中持續出現，heteroplasmy 程度會隨個體老化而漂移，並在細胞與組織間形成鑲嵌分布。

links.context: Mitochondrial TXNRD2 inhibition by auranofin compromises redox defense and bioenergetics, promoting ferroptosis in sensitive cells. Ferroptosis is one of the cell-death modalities engaged in auranofin-sensitive cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: Auranofin 對粒線體 TXNRD2 的抑制會損害氧化還原防禦與能量代謝，並在敏感細胞中促成鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）。Ferroptosis 是 Auranofin 敏感癌症中所引發的細胞死亡模式之一。

links.context: Mitochondrial clearance through mitophagy maintains quiescence; its loss in HSCs causes aberrant cell-cycle re-entry.
links.context_zh_TW: 經由 mitophagy 的粒線體清除維持靜止；其在 HSC 缺失導致異常細胞週期重入。
links.source_file: _document_ - Cellular Mechanisms and Regulation of Quiescence.md

links.context: Mitochondrial dysfunction — loss of respiratory complex subunits or cofactors — elevates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production at complexes III and I. The resulting ROS are sensed by a Tel1p-dependent signaling module that phosphorylates Rad53p, which then translocates to the nucleus and interfaces with chromatin-modifying complexes, illustrating how a core DNA damage signaling module is co-opted as a redox-responsive longevity regulator.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體功能障礙——呼吸鏈次單元或輔因子的喪失——會在複合體 III 與 I 處升高超氧陰離子與過氧化氫的生成。由此產生的活性氧被 Tel1p 相依的訊號模組感知並磷酸化 Rad53p，後者轉位至細胞核與染色質修飾複合體作用，說明核心 DNA 損傷訊號模組如何被徵用為氧化還原反應性的延壽調控者。

links.context: Mitochondrial function declines with age through accumulation of mtDNA mutations (rising heteroplasmy), erosion of quality control, and NAD+ depletion — a metabolic bottleneck that compromises sirtuin (SIRT1, SIRT3) and AMPK-dependent resilience. Loss of function drives MiDAS, stem cell exhaustion and inflammaging, and underlies insulin resistance, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration and heart failure.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體功能隨年齡衰退，原因是 mtDNA 突變累積（heteroplasmy 上升）、品質管制侵蝕與 NAD+ 耗竭——後者是一項代謝瓶頸，削弱 sirtuin（SIRT1、SIRT3）與 AMPK 相依賴的韌性。功能喪失會驅動 MiDAS、幹細胞耗竭與 inflammaging，並構成胰島素阻抗、肌少症、神經退化與心衰竭的基礎。

links.context: Mitochondrial oxidants participate in numerous signaling pathways, including the activation of macroautophagy. Reactive oxygen species are essential for autophagy and specifically regulate the activity of Atg4, a protease that processes the autophagy protein Atg8/LC3. Beyond autophagy, mitochondrial ROS also modulate hypoxic signaling and regulate cytosolic stress kinases, and they serve as central signaling mediators in mitohormesis, where a controlled increase in mitochondrial oxidant production triggers adaptive cytoprotective programs that extend lifespan.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體氧化劑參與多種訊號傳導途徑，包括巨自噬的活化。活性氧類（ROS）對自噬至關重要，並特異性調節 Atg4 的活性，Atg4 是一種加工自噬蛋白 Atg8/LC3 的蛋白酶。除了自噬外，粒線體 ROS 也調節缺氧訊號並調節細胞質壓力激酶，它們在粒線體促效應（mitohormesis）中作為核心訊號介體，其中粒線體氧化劑產出的控制性增加會觸發適應性細胞保護程式，從而延長壽命。

links.context: Mitochondrial oxidation of glucose in beta cells generates the ATP signal that drives KATP channel closure and depolarization, making mitochondria the energetic trigger of glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: β 細胞中葡萄糖的粒線體氧化所產生的 ATP 訊號，驅動 KATP 通道關閉與膜去極化，因此 mitochondria 是 glucose-stimulated insulin secretion 的能量觸發點。

links.context: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide expression is induced by mitochondrial stress and oxidative stress, and the peptides in turn preserve redox homeostasis and stress resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide 的表現會被粒線體壓力與氧化壓力誘導，而這些胜肽反過來維持氧化還原恆定與抗壓能力。

links.context: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptides mediate Retrograde Signaling: mitochondria communicate to the nucleus and cytoplasm through ROS, calcium, cytochrome c, nitric oxide, mtDNA and MDPs such as Humanin, thereby regulating stress resistance, energy metabolism and cell fate.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptides 媒介 Retrograde Signaling：粒線體透過 ROS、鈣離子、cytochrome c、一氧化氮、mtDNA 以及 Humanin 等 MDP 向細胞核與細胞質傳遞訊息，進而調控抗壓能力、能量代謝與細胞命運。

links.context: Mitohormesis reduces susceptibility to disease and age-related pathology. By inducing a broad cytoprotective state - augmented antioxidant defenses, chaperone expression, xenobiotic detoxification, and metabolic reconfiguration - the hormetic response protects organisms from subsequent larger stresses. Individual variation in the mitohormesis response has been proposed to explain why only some obese individuals develop clinically apparent diabetes despite increased nutrient-driven mitochondrial ROS, and a fuller understanding may provide a unifying hypothesis for why we age.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應降低了對疾病和與年齡相關的病理學的易感性。透過誘導廣泛的細胞保護狀態——增強的抗氧化防禦、分子伴護表達、異生物质解毒和代謝重構——促效應反應保護生物體免受後續較大壓力的影響。粒線體促效應反應的個體差異已被提出用於解釋為何只有某些肥胖個體在營養驅動的粒線體 ROS 增加的情況下發展出臨床明顯的糖尿病，更全面的理解可能提供為何我們會衰老的統一假說。

links.context: Mitohormetic benefit exists only within the Hormetic Window: sublethal mitochondrial stress extends Lifespan, whereas stress beyond the NOAEL kills the cell. Because the window is narrow in brain and pancreatic β-cells but wide in liver and skeletal Muscle, the same mitohormetic dose can be therapeutic in one tissue and pathological in another.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitohormesis 的效益只存在於 Hormetic Window 之內：次致死性粒線體壓力可延長 Lifespan，超過 NOAEL 的壓力則會殺死細胞。由於視窗在腦與胰島 β 細胞較窄、在肝臟與骨骼 Muscle 較寬，同一劑量的 mitohormetic 刺激在一個組織可能是治療性的，在另一個組織則是致病的。

links.context: Mitophagy is the specific arm of autophagy that protects against ischemic injury by selectively removing damaged mitochondria, the main source of the reactive oxygen species and apoptotic mediators that kill cells on reperfusion. Loss of this selective quality control converts a reversible ischemic insult into irreversible injury.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitophagy 是自噬中特別負責對抗缺血性損傷的分支，它選擇性清除受損粒線體，而受損粒線體正是在再灌注時造成細胞死亡的活性氧與凋亡介質的主要來源。這項選擇性品質管制的喪失，會把可逆的缺血傷害轉為不可逆損傷。

links.context: MnSOD (manganese superoxide dismutase) is the mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme that eliminates superoxide generated during respiration. Its activity is regulated by acetylation, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation increasing MnSOD activity. When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, MnSOD acetylation decreases, mitochondrial MnSOD activity rises, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels fall. This reduced mitochondrial ROS burden lessens oxidative damage and supports mitochondrial quality control, contributing to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, inflammasome activation, and age-related mitochondrial dysfunction in tissues such as the myocardium, skeletal muscle, and neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: MnSOD（錳超氧化物歧化酶）是在呼吸過程中消除所產生的超氧化物的粒線體抗氧化酶。其活性受乙醯化調控，其中 SIRT3 介導的去乙醯化會增加 MnSOD 活性。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，MnSOD 乙醯化下降，粒線體 MnSOD 活性上升，粒線體活性氧物種水平降低。這種減少的粒線體 ROS 負擔減輕了氧化損傷並支持粒線體品質控制，有助於 NR 對氧化壓力、發炎體活化以及心肌、骨骼肌和神經元等組織中與年齡相關的粒線體功能障礙的保護作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: MnSOD and mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) are functionally coupled within the shared matrix peroxide-relay: MnSOD converts superoxide to H2O2, which peroxiredoxin 3 scavenges, and Trx2 regenerates peroxiredoxin 3 to keep that arm running. Their coupling is metabolic (through the peroxide stream) rather than a direct protein-protein interaction. Together they buffer mitochondrial ROS and determine whether MnSOD-derived H2O2 is detoxified to water or released as a hormetic signal.
links.context_zh_TW: MnSOD 與粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）在共享的基質過氧化物接力中功能性地耦合：MnSOD 將超氧化物轉化為 H2O2，後者由 peroxiredoxin 3 清除，而 Trx2 再生 peroxiredoxin 3 以維持該分支運作。此耦合是代謝性的（透過過氧化物流），而非直接的蛋白質-蛋白質交互作用。兩者共同緩衝粒線體 ROS，並決定 MnSOD 衍生的 H2O2 是被解毒為水，還是被釋放為激效訊號。

links.context: MnSOD produces hydrogen peroxide that Peroxiredoxin 3, the principal matrix H2O2 scavenger, consumes. MnSOD and peroxiredoxin 3 form the two coupled halves of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay.
links.context_zh_TW: MnSOD 產生過氧化氫，由基質中主要的 H2O2 清除者 Peroxiredoxin 3 加以消耗。MnSOD 與 peroxiredoxin 3 構成粒線體過氧化物接力反應的兩端。

links.context: Monocyte/macrophage lineage derives into osteoclasts under RANKL plus M-CSF. Induction is the differentiation drive.
links.context_zh_TW: 單核/巨噬細胞譜系在 RANKL 加 M-CSF 下分化為蝕骨細胞。誘發是分化驅動。

links.context: Mosaic loss of the Y chromosome (mLOY) is the most common somatic mutation in men — detectable in 40% of 70-year-olds and 57% of 93-year-olds. LOY impairs senescent-cell clearance, contributing to renal disease, and drives TGFβ1/galectin-3 signalling in cardiac macrophages that promotes fibrosis and heart failure.
links.context_zh_TW: Y 染色體的嵌合性流失（mLOY）是男性最常見的體細胞突變，70 歲者有 40%、93 歲者有 57% 可檢出。LOY 會損害衰老細胞的清除而促成腎病，並活化心臟巨噬細胞中的 TGFβ1/galectin-3 訊號以促進纖維化與心衰竭。

links.context: Mosaic loss of the Y chromosome (mLOY) is the most common somatic mutation in men — detectable in 40% of 70-year-olds and 57% of 93-year-olds. Y-deficient cells show T-cell exhaustion with PD-1 sensitivity that enables bladder-cancer growth, and roughly 500 autosomal genes are dysregulated in LOY leukocytes. Smoking is a reversible dose-dependent risk factor and inflammation amplifies LOY cardiovascular harm.
links.context_zh_TW: Y 染色體的嵌合性流失（mLOY）是男性最常見的體細胞突變，70 歲者有 40%、93 歲者有 57% 可檢出。Y 缺陷細胞出現對 PD-1 敏感的 T 細胞耗竭，使膀胱癌得以生長，且 LOY 白血球中約 500 個體染色體基因異常調控。吸菸是可逆的劑量依賴性風險因子，而 Inflammation 會放大 LOY 的心血管危害。

links.context: Mosaic loss of the Y chromosome in blood-forming cells is causally linked to fibrosis: bone-marrow LOY mice show shortened lifespan and cardiac, pulmonary and renal fibrosis, with LOY macrophages producing TGFβ1 and galectin-3 to activate fibroblasts, and TGFβ1 blockade rescuing the phenotype. In men this pathogenic clonal gain expands exponentially after age 60, forming a structural mirror of the estrogen cliff.
links.context_zh_TW: 造血細胞中的嵌合型 Y 染色體缺失與纖維化有因果關係：骨髓 LOY 小鼠出現壽命縮短與心、肺、腎纖維化，LOY 巨噬細胞透過 TGFβ1 與 galectin-3 活化纖維母細胞，而阻斷 TGFβ1 可拯救此表型。在男性身上，這種致病性克隆在 60 歲後呈指數擴張，形成雌激素斷崖的結構性鏡像。

links.context: Mounting evidence indicates that mitophagy, the selective degradation of damaged or excessive mitochondria, is an especially crucial regulator of innate immune system function, linking organelle quality control to inflammatory and antimicrobial responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 愈來愈多證據顯示，mitophagy（選擇性清除受損或過量粒線體）是先天免疫系統功能特別重要的調節因子，將胞器品質管制與發炎及抗微生物反應連結起來。

links.context: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) are derived from knockout embryos and serve as an in vitro validation platform for knockout mouse phenotypes. Cultured from the same embryos, MEFs permit mechanistic follow-up of in vivo findings — for example testing whether a knocked-out gene's role in mitochondrial stress response or apoptosis is cell-autonomous.
links.context_zh_TW: 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞（MEF）由敲除鼠胚胎取得，可作為敲除小鼠表型的體外驗證平台。由於與活體實驗取自相同胚胎，MEF 可對體內發現進行機制後續驗證，例如測試被敲除基因在粒線體壓力反應或凋亡中的角色是否為細胞自主性。

links.context: Moxidectin is a P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) substrate, and P-gp efflux normally restricts its CNS accumulation. Dogs homozygous for the MDR1 (ABCB1-1Δ) deletion clear macrocyclic lactones poorly, so moxidectin's long persistence amplifies toxicity risk — especially with the non-withdrawable injectable ProHeart 6, which is why milbemycin oxime is preferred for collie-type dogs.
links.context_zh_TW: Moxidectin 是 P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) 的受質，而 P-gp 的外排作用通常限制其在中樞神經系統的累積。帶有 MDR1（ABCB1-1Δ）缺失同型合子的犬類清除 macrocyclic lactones 的能力較差，因此 moxidectin 的長效持久性會放大中毒風險——對無法撤除的 ProHeart 6 注射劑尤其如此，這也是 collie 類犬隻較偏好 milbemycin oxime 的原因。

links.context: Mrps5 belongs to a class of mitohormetic longevity genes - including cco-1, isp-1 and clk-1 - whose calibrated impairment prolongs healthspan. Because the induced UPRmt program raises chaperone, protease and antioxidant capacity, reduced mitoribosomal function yields a longevity phenotype rather than simply a defect, underscoring the dosage sensitivity of mitoribosome function also seen in human MRPS5 mitochondrial disorders.
links.context_zh_TW: Mrps5 屬於 mitohormetic 長壽基因一類——包括 cco-1、isp-1 與 clk-1——其經校準的損傷可延長 healthspan。由於被誘發的 UPRmt 程式提升伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與抗氧化能力，粒線體核糖體功能降低反而產生延壽表型而非單純缺陷，這也呼應人類 MRPS5 粒線體疾病所顯現的劑量敏感性。

links.context: Muscular Dystrophies (MD) generate a chronic Inflammation secondary to the primary genetic lesion. Repeated fibre necrosis releases contents that recruit immune cells, and the resulting fibro-fatty replacement progressively reduces viable contractile tissue and force production.
links.context_zh_TW: Muscular Dystrophies (MD) 會因初級遺傳病變而引發繼發的慢性 Inflammation。反覆的肌纖維壞死釋出細胞內容物並招募免疫細胞，隨後的纖維脂肪替換使可收縮的組織與力量產生逐步下降。

links.context: Mutations in human OPA1, the mammalian counterpart of yeast Mgm1, cause dominant optic atrophy, linking inner-membrane fusion failure to neurodegeneration in the retina and optic nerve.
links.context_zh_TW: 人類 OPA1（酵母 Mgm1 的哺乳類對應物）突變會造成 dominant optic atrophy，將內膜融合失效與視網膜及視神經的神經退化連結起來。

links.context: Mutations in nuo-6 impair mitochondrial function and reduce respiration, which — like mutations in isp-1 and clk-1 — extends lifespan. The resulting longevity depends on activation of adaptive stress responses, with Mitohormesis being one of them, so reduced nuo-6 activity acts as a mitohormetic trigger.
links.context_zh_TW: nuo-6 的突變會損害粒線體功能並降低呼吸作用，與 isp-1、clk-1 的突變相似地延長壽命。這種長壽依賴於適應性壓力反應的活化，而 Mitohormesis 正是其中之一，因此 nuo-6 活性下降可作為啟動 mitohormesis 的誘因。

links.context: Myddosome-dependent IL-1R signaling is required for SASP establishment and maintenance; MyD88 or IRAK1 depletion suppresses secretome output. The scaffold thus licenses the IL-1α-to-NF-kB inflammatory program.
links.context_zh_TW: Myddosome 依賴的 IL-1R 訊號對 SASP 建立與維持必要；耗竭 MyD88 或 IRAK1 抑制分泌組輸出。此支架因此許可 IL-1α 到 NF-κB 的發炎程序。

links.context: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells exert potent immunosuppressive activity on the immune system, blunting T-cell and NK-cell function through arginine depletion, reactive oxygen species and induction of regulatory T cells. Because immature myeloid cells are blocked from terminal maturation, they represent a cell type that bridges aging, inflammation and cancer by suppressing immune clearance of damaged and transformed cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells 對免疫系統具有強大的免疫抑制活性，透過消耗 arginine、產生 reactive oxygen species 與誘導 regulatory T cells 來削弱 T 細胞與 NK 細胞功能。由於 immature myeloid cells 被阻斷而無法終末成熟，她們成為連結老化、發炎與癌症的細胞類型，藉由抑制免疫系統清除受損與轉化細胞。

links.context: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) is a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, and to a lesser extent in monocytes and macrophages. It plays a central role in the oxidative burst during innate immune responses, producing hypochlorous acid and other oxidants that kill pathogens in phagosomes. On release during inflammation, MPO can also oxidize host biomolecules and catecholamines such as epinephrine, and its products contribute to both antimicrobial defense and, in excess, to tissue damage and cardiovascular pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中、較少量存在於monocytes與macrophages的heme-containing enzyme。它在innate immune responses的oxidative burst中扮演central role，產生hypochlorous acid及其他oxidants以kill pathogens in phagosomes。在inflammation期間released時，MPO亦能oxidize host biomolecules及如epinephrine等catecholamines，其products既contribute to antimicrobial defense，在excess時也會導致tissue damage與cardiovascular pathology。

links.context: Myeloperoxidase (MPO), a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, uses hydrogen peroxide (H2O2, generated by NADPH oxidase) as its substrate. In its halogenation cycle, MPO catalyzes the two-electron oxidation of chloride to hypochlorous acid, and in its peroxidase cycle it performs one-electron oxidations of organic substrates such as catecholamines, tyrosine, urate, ascorbate, and nitrite. The hydrogen peroxide substrate thus links NADPH oxidase activity to MPO-driven oxidation, and both contribute to the conversion of adrenaline to adrenochrome in activated neutrophils.
links.context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中的heme-containing enzyme，以hydrogen peroxide（H2O2，由NADPH oxidase生成）作為其substrate。在其halogenation cycle中，MPO催化chloride的two-electron oxidation生成hypochlorous acid；在其peroxidase cycle中，它對catecholamines、tyrosine、urate、ascorbate及nitrite等有機substrates進行one-electron oxidations。因此，hydrogen peroxide substrate將NADPH oxidase activity與MPO-driven oxidation連結起來，兩者皆contribute to activated neutrophils中adrenaline轉化為adrenochrome。

links.context: Myeloperoxidase generates Hypochlorous Acid, a potent two-electron oxidant, during the respiratory burst of myeloid cells. Hypochlorous Acid rapidly oxidizes Epinephrine and Adrenochrome is generated as a product, making Myeloperoxidase the enzymatic source of the adrenochrome intermediate.
links.context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 在髓系細胞的呼吸爆發中生成強效的雙電子氧化劑 Hypochlorous Acid。Hypochlorous Acid 可快速氧化 Epinephrine 而生成 Adrenochrome，因此 Myeloperoxidase 是腎上腺紅色素中間產物的酵素來源。

links.context: Myeloperoxidase oxidizes Epinephrine to Adrenochrome. This reaction is favoured by the highly oxidative environment of the neutrophil respiratory burst, which is why adrenochrome and related aminochromes accumulate wherever MPO is released — oxidative stress, and notably in the adrenal and cardiac tissue hit in the context of Adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 會將 Epinephrine 氧化為 Adrenochrome。此反應受 neutrophil 呼吸爆發所營造的高度氧化環境促進，因此 MPO 釋放處就會累積 adrenochrome 與相關的 aminochrome——在氧化壓力情境中皆然，Adrenochrome 相關情境下的腎上腺與心肌組織尤其明顯。

links.context: Myeloperoxidase released by activated Neutrophils produces Hypochlorous Acid, which oxidizes and chlorinates proteoglycans and collagen in articular cartilage and inactivates protease inhibitors such as alpha1-antitrypsin; MPO levels correlate with disease activity and 3-chlorotyrosine is elevated as a biomarker of joint damage.
links.context_zh_TW: 由活化 Neutrophils 釋放的 Myeloperoxidase 產生 Hypochlorous Acid，氧化並氯化關節軟骨中的蛋白聚醣與膠原蛋白，並使 alpha1-antitrypsin 等蛋白酶抑制劑失活；MPO 濃度與疾病活動度相關，3-Chlorotyrosine 則作為關節損傷的生物標記而升高。

links.context: Myosin motors interact with actin filaments in stress fibers and contractility. Interaction is the motor-filament pairing.
links.context_zh_TW: Myosin 馬達在應力纖維與收縮中與肌動蛋白絲交互作用。交互作用是馬達—絲配對。

links.context: Myricetin showed weak senotherapeutic activity in the ten-flavonoid screen reported by Yousefzadeh et al. (2018). Tested at 5 μM in Ercc1-null MEFs, it was clearly inferior to Fisetin, which is why myricetin is not regarded as a leading Senolytic despite sharing the flavonol scaffold.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Yousefzadeh 等（2018）報告的十種 flavonoid 篩選中，Myricetin 的 senotherapeutic 活性偏弱。它在 Ercc1 缺失的 MEF 中以 5 μM 測試，表現明顯不如 Fisetin；因此儘管共享 flavonol 骨架，myricetin 並不被視為領先的 Senolytic。

links.context: M₁dG levels are elevated in colon, breast, and liver tumors as well as in surrounding tissue, supporting the lipid-peroxidation route to carcinogenesis. The lesion is pro-mutagenic — causing G→T and G→A transversions and frameshifts in bacterial and mammalian polymerase assays — so an adduct load raised by oxidative lipid damage, compounded by impaired repair capacity, plausibly drives mutation accumulation in aging tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: M₁dG 濃度在結直腸癌、乳癌與肝癌腫瘤及其周圍組織中升高，支持脂質過氧化途徑參致癌化。該損傷具促突變性——在細菌與哺乳類聚合酶檢測中造成 G→T 與 G→A 顛換以及移碼突變——因此氧化性脂質損傷提高的加合物負荷，若再合併修復能力受損，很可能推動老化組織中的突變累積。

links.context: N-Myc obligately heterodimerizes with MAX for DNA binding.
links.context_zh_TW: N-Myc 與 MAX 專性異二聚化以結合 DNA。

links.context: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), a predominant advanced glycation end product, can serve as a predictor of cardiovascular mortality. Semba and colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years, during which 22% died, 43.9% from cardiovascular disease; women in the highest quartiles of CML had the highest risk of dying from cardiovascular disease. CML, the most abundant AGE both in vivo and in foods, is therefore used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden and an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations.
links.context_zh_TW: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）是一種predominant advanced glycation end product，可作為cardiovascular mortality的predictor。Semba及其colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years，期間22% died，43.9% from cardiovascular disease；CML處於highest quartiles的女性died from cardiovascular disease的risk最高。CML是in vivo與in foods中最abundant的AGE，因此被used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden與an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: NAAD is the adenylated intermediate of the deamidated Preiss-Handler route and is amidated to NAD+ in the final step. Because NAAD is elevated only when this branch is active, its measurement distinguishes the deamidated route from the direct amidated NAD+ salvage pathway (NAMPT/NMNAT).
links.context_zh_TW: NAAD 是去醯胺的 Preiss-Handler 路徑中的腺苷化中間產物，最後一步被醯胺化為 NAD+。由於只有此支線活化時 NAAD 才會升高，測量 NAAD 可區分去醯胺路徑與直接的醯胺型 NAD+ 回收路徑（NAMPT/NMNAT）。

links.context: NAD+ depletion alone cannot explain parthanatos: energy-replete cells die from delivered PAR, anti-PAR/PARG rescue without restoring bulk energetics, mitochondrial NAD+ stays physiological during genotoxic stress, and Bax/calpain KOs survive MNNG despite massive NAD+ drops (David 2009 review of Berger suicide hypothesis).
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+ 耗竭不足以解释 parthanatos：能量充足细胞仍死于外源 PAR，抗 PAR/PARG 挽救不依赖整体能量恢复，基因毒应激时线粒体 NAD+ 维持生理水平，Bax/calpain KO  massive NAD+ 下降仍存活。

links.context: NAD+ is the primary reducing-equivalent couple of the Redox Battery. Recharge of the battery depends on NADPH-generating metabolism and precursor availability (e.g., Nicotinamide), so protocol design monitors battery state and replenishes NAD+/NADH capacity in step with the adrenochrome load it must absorb.
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+ 是 Redox Battery 的主要還原等量物偶對。電池的「充電」仰賴 NADPH 生成的代謝與前驅物供應（例如 Nicotinamide），因此 protocol 設計會監測電池狀態，並依其必須吸收的 adrenochrome 負荷同步補充 NAD+/NADH 容量。

links.context: NAD+ supply and decay rate sets SIRT3 reaction velocity without any sirtuin binding, so cofactor flux is a distinct pace-setting route alongside direct kinetic modulators. Steady-state SIRT3 activators such as compounds 5329973 and 5689785 exploit this by mechanism-based activation that roughly doubles catalytic efficiency with respect to NAD+, restoring full activity at 50% NAD+, the aged-state concentration.
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+ 的供應與消耗速率在不與任何 sirtuin 結合的情況下就決定了 SIRT3 的反應速率，因此輔因子通量是與直接動力學調節者並列的另一條設定節奏路徑。像化合物 5329973 與 5689785 這類穩態 SIRT3 活化劑正是利用這一點，透過機制式活化使對 NAD+ 的催化效率約增加一倍，在 NAD+ 降至 50%（老化濃度）時仍能恢復完整活性。

links.context: NADPH oxidase is the enzyme system in activated neutrophils that generates superoxide radicals, the primary oxidants driving adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome. The superoxide and derived reactive oxygen species produced by this system account for over 80% of adrenaline oxidation in the presence of stimulated neutrophils at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, making it the major catabolic route for adrenaline under these inflammatory conditions. Hydrogen peroxide generated by NADPH oxidase also serves as the substrate for myeloperoxidase, which can further contribute to catecholamine oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase是activated neutrophils中生成superoxide radicals的enzyme system，而superoxide radicals是驅動adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome的主要oxidants。在低micromolar adrenaline concentrations下，此system產生的superoxide及其derived reactive oxygen species佔stimulated neutrophils存在時adrenaline oxidation的80%以上，使其成為這些inflammatory conditions下adrenaline的主要catabolic route。NADPH oxidase生成的hydrogen peroxide亦作為myeloperoxidase的substrate，可進一步促進catecholamine oxidation。

links.context: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase performs the one-electron reduction of aminochrome ortho-quinones such as adrenochrome, generating highly unstable semiquinone radicals. These radicals rapidly transfer their electron to molecular oxygen, producing superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone in a redox cycle. This enzyme-initiated reduction is the entry point for aminochrome-driven oxidative stress that is hypothesized to selectively push already-ROS-elevated senescent cells into apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶執行氨基色素鄰醌如腎上腺素色素的單電子還原，產生高度不穩定的半醌自由基。這些自由基迅速將其電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並在氧化還原循環中再生母體醌。此酶啟動的還原是氨基色素驅動的氧化應激的入口點，假定選擇性地將已ROS升高的衰老細胞推入凋亡。

links.context: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, and a 2025 report shows it also acts as an AMP/ATP energy-stress switch. Because NAD+ resynthesis costs high-energy phosphates, NAMPT activity ties cellular energy state to sirtuin velocity, which is why tool compounds such as P7C3 and FK866 are studied as supply-side pace-setters rather than as sirtuin binders.
links.context_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ 補救合成路徑的限速酵素，2025 年的一份報告顯示它同時也是 AMP／ATP 能量壓力開關。由於 NAD+ 重新合成需消耗高能磷酸基，NAMPT 活性把細胞能量狀態與 sirtuin 的反應速率連結起來，因此像 P7C3 與 FK866 這類工具化合物是以供給端設定節奏來研究，而不是作為 sirtuin 結合劑。

links.context: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, and the NAD+ it produces drives circadian SIRT3 activity rhythms. Temporal NAD+ biosynthesis by NAMPT thus activates SIRT3.
links.context_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收途徑的速率限制酶，其所產生的 NAD+ 驅動 SIRT3 活性的晝夜節律。因此 NAMPT 的時序性 NAD+ 生物合成會活化 SIRT3。

links.context: NAPRT is a key enzyme of NAD+ Biosynthesis, specifically the Preiss-Handler branch. It is highly expressed in liver, kidney and small intestine — tissues with high NAD+ turnover — so niacin utilization and thus NAD+ availability for sirtuins is uneven across the body.
links.context_zh_TW: NAPRT 是 NAD+ Biosynthesis 的關鍵酵素，專屬於 Preiss-Handler 分支。它在肝臟、腎臟與小腸高度表現——這些正是 NAD+ 周轉率高的組織——因此 niacin 的利用效率、進而供應 sirtuins 的 NAD+ 可得性，在全身各處並不均勻。

links.context: NAPRT is inhibited by NAD+ and by NADH, classic feedback inhibition. The product (and the reduced pool) therefore throttles its own synthesis route, which is a general principle of NAD+ metabolism: when the pool is sufficient, biosynthetic enzymes are held back and degradation dominates.
links.context_zh_TW: NAPRT 受 NAD+ 與 NADH 抑制，屬於典型的回饋抑制。因此產物（以及其還原態的池）會限制自身的生合成途徑，這是 NAD+ 代謝的一般原則：當池量充足時，生合成酵素受到抑制，分解代謝便居主導。

links.context: NB-4746 protects NAD+ from hydrolysis. By blocking SARM1, the drug preserves the axonal NAD+ pool during the acute injury window, halting axonal degeneration before it becomes irreversible and permitting regeneration and functional recovery.
links.context_zh_TW: NB-4746 保護 NAD+ 免於被水解。藉由阻斷 SARM1，該藥物在急性損傷期保住軸突的 NAD+ 池，在軸突變性變得不可逆之前將其停止，讓再生與功能恢復得以進行。

links.context: NB-4746 targets acute injury indications including Traumatic Brain Injury and chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy. It completed Phase 1 in healthy volunteers in 2024 with targeted plasma and CSF exposure and no serious adverse events, and advanced to Phase 1b/2 in 2025.
links.context_zh_TW: NB-4746 的標的是包括 Traumatic Brain Injury 與化療引發的周邊神經病變等急性損傷適應症。它於 2024 年在健康志願者完成第一期試驗，達到目標血漿與 CSF 暴露且無嚴重不良事件，並於 2025 年推進至第一 b/二期試驗。

links.context: NBR1 cooperates with NDP52 and Optineurin as well as p62. NDP52 is involved in xenophagy and mitophagy, while Optineurin links autophagy dysfunction to glaucoma and ALS; together the receptor set lets redundant recognition cover mitophagy, xenophagy and aggregate clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: NBR1 除與 p62 外，也與 NDP52 及 Optineurin 合作。NDP52 參與 xenophagy 與 mitophagy，Optineurin 則把自噬功能障礙與青光眼及 ALS 連結起來；這組受體讓冗餘辨識得以涵蓋 mitophagy、xenophagy 與聚集物清除。

links.context: NCOA4 mediates ferritinophagy, turning over ferritin to feed redox-active Fe2+ into Fenton chemistry. This iron-supply mechanism complements the lipid-substrate arm of ACSL4.
links.context_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導 ferritinophagy，周轉 ferritin 以供應具氧化還原活性 Fe2+ 進入 Fenton 化學。此鐵供應機制補充 ACSL4 的脂質受質臂。

links.context: NDP52 and OPTN act redundantly as the two primary autophagy receptors of the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy pathway. Both are phosphorylated by TBK1 and both bind ubiquitin chains on damaged mitochondria, so functional loss of one receptor is buffered by the other and mitophagic clearance remains robust.
links.context_zh_TW: NDP52 與 OPTN 以功能冗餘的方式作為 PINK1/Parkin mitophagy 路徑的兩大主要自噬受體。兩者皆由 TBK1 磷酸化，也都會結合受損粒線體上的泛素鏈，因此其中一個受體功能喪失時可由另一個補償，使 mitophagy 清除仍維持穩健。

links.context: NETosis is the major pathological neutrophil death program in sepsis, where the resulting NET burden tracks immunothrombosis. Because NETs present decondensed chromatin, histones, neutrophil elastase and Myeloperoxidase, they amplify microvascular clotting and tissue injury — which is why PAD4 inhibition and DNase digestion of NETs are explored as therapeutic interventions in septic patients.
links.context_zh_TW: NETosis 是 sepsis 中主要的病理性嗜中性球死亡程序，其釋出的 NET 負荷與 immunothrombosis 同步變化。由於 NET 呈現去凝聚染色質、組蛋白、neutrophil elastase 與 Myeloperoxidase，會放大微血管栓塞與組織損傷——因此 PAD4 抑制劑與 NET 的 DNase 消化被探索作為敗血患者的治療介入。

links.context: NF-kB Signal-1 priming transcribes NLRP3, pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18. Upregulation is the priming arm.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 訊號一起始轉錄 NLRP3、pro-IL-1β 與 pro-IL-18。上調是致敏臂。

links.context: NF-kB can decrease SIRT1 activity by modulating miR-34a expression, mirroring the p53-miR-34a-SIRT1 loop. Directionally, NF-kB engagement of the miR-34a arm suppresses SIRT1 translation. This provides a route by which chronic inflammatory signaling blunts sirtuin activity during ageing.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 可以透過調節 miR-34a 的表現來降低 SIRT1 活性，反映了 p53-miR-34a-SIRT1 迴路。方向性上 NF-κB 透過 miR-34a 臂抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。這提供了慢性發炎訊號在老化過程中削弱 sirtuin 活性的路徑。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: NF-kB is inhibited by nutlin 3a indirectly: nutlin 3a stabilizes p53 by inhibiting MDM2, and p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven pro-inflammatory SASP. This leverages the tumor-suppressor rheostat to dampen inflammation rather than broadly blocking the pathway, and it is consistent with the finding that p53 loss dramatically amplifies the secretome. The effect is mechanistically sound but nutlin 3a is primarily a research compound with limited clinical development. Its action illustrates the p53-NF-kB counterbalance in SASP control.
links.context_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 間接抑制 NF-κB：nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2 穩定 p53，而 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的促發炎性 SASP。這利用腫瘤抑制變阻器減弱發炎而非廣泛阻斷路徑，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組的發現一致。此效應在機制上健全，但 nutlin 3a 主要是研究化合物、臨床開發有限。其作用說明 SASP 控制中 p53-NF-κB 的平衡。

links.context: NF-kB is the major transcriptional inducer of A1-Bfl-1.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 A1-Bfl-1 的主要轉錄誘發因子。

links.context: NF-kB is the master transcriptional regulator of SASP genes with activity rising with age. Active-voice driver edge complementing the regulated_by reverse.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 SASP 基因的主要轉錄調節因子，活性隨年齡上升。主動語態驅動邊補充 regulated_by 反向。

links.context: NF-κB is the master transcription factor of the inflammatory response and a principal target of anti-inflammatory strategies. Blocking NF-κB activation reduces transcription of pro-inflammatory cytokines and enzymes such as COX-2, which is how agents like anakinra, corticosteroids and curcumin exert part of their effect.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是發炎反應的主導轉錄因子，也是抗發炎策略的主要標的。阻斷 NF-κB 活化可減少 COX-2 等發炎性細胞激素與酵素的轉錄，anakinra、Corticosteroids 與 curcumin 等藥物的作用部分即源於此。

links.context: NF675 was obtained by optimization of the suramin scaffold. Suramin occupies the nicotinamide ribose (B), nicotinamide (C) and part of the substrate-binding pockets of sirtuins; NF675 presumably shares this binding mode while improving SIRT1 selectivity.
links.context_zh_TW: NF675 由 suramin 骨架最佳化而得。Suramin 佔據 sirtuin 的菸醯胺核糖口袋（B）、菸醯胺口袋（C）與部分受質結合位；NF675 推測沿用此結合模式，同時提升對 SIRT1 的選擇性。

links.context: NFS1 acts as a ferroptosis modifier rather than a trigger: suppressing NFS1 alone does not induce ferroptosis, but the resulting iron starvation sensitizes cells so that pre-existing ROS tip them into lipid-peroxidation-driven ferroptotic death. This places NFS1 at the intersection of iron metabolism and oxidative stress, and explains why pairing NFS1 inhibition with ROS inducers or GPX4 inhibitors could selectively kill lung adenocarcinoma.
links.context_zh_TW: NFS1 的作用是 ferroptosis 修飾因子而非觸發因子：單獨抑制 NFS1 並不會誘發 ferroptosis，但由此造成的 iron starvation 會使細胞敏感化，讓既有的 ROS 將其推向以脂質過氧化為特徵的 ferroptosis 死亡。這使 NFS1 處於鐵代謝與氧化壓力的交會處，也解釋了為何將 NFS1 抑制與 ROS 誘導劑或 GPX4 抑制劑併用，可能選擇性地殺死肺腺癌。

links.context: NHR-49 is critical for the metabolic adaptation of C. elegans to starvation, driving the transcriptional program for fatty acid oxidation that supplies energy when nutrient intake ceases.
links.context_zh_TW: NHR-49 對 C. elegans 對 Starvation 的代謝適應至關重要，它驅動脂肪酸氧化的轉錄程序，在營養攝取停止時供應能量。

links.context: NHR-49 regulates Lipophagy, beta-oxidation and lifespan extension downstream of LIPL-4 in C. elegans. The transcriptional regulation of lysosomal lipolysis mediated by MXL-3 and HLH-30, by contrast, has been reported to function independently of NHR-49.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，NHR-49 調控 LIPL-4 下游的 Lipophagy、β-氧化與壽命延展。相對地，由 MXL-3 與 HLH-30 介導的溶酶體脂解轉錄調控則被報導可獨立於 NHR-49 運作。

links.context: NIX cooperates with the outer mitochondrial membrane receptor FUNDC1 to coordinate hypoxia-induced mitophagy. Both receptors are BH3-domain-bearing OMM proteins whose hypoxia-stabilized expression couples mitophagy capacity to oxygen availability, allowing cells to clear damaged mitochondria when oxidative phosphorylation is compromised.
links.context_zh_TW: NIX 與粒線體外膜受體 FUNDC1 協同協調缺氧誘發的 mitophagy。兩者都是帶有 BH3 domain 的 OMM 蛋白，其在缺氧下穩定的表現使 mitophagy 容量與氧氣可得性耦合，讓細胞能在 oxidative phosphorylation 受損時清除受損粒線體。

links.context: NKG2A and PD-1 are independent inhibitory circuits that can be co-expressed on exhausted CD8+ T cells. Because they act through separate receptors yet converge on the same suppression of T-cell effector function, combinatorial anti-NKG2A plus anti-PD-1 blockade produces synergistic reinvigoration of exhausted T cells in preclinical models.
links.context_zh_TW: NKG2A 與 PD-1 是彼此獨立的抑制迴路，可在耗竭的 CD8+ T 細胞上共同表現。由於兩者經由不同的受體作用，卻收斂到對 T 細胞效應功能的相同抑制，因此 anti-NKG2A 加上 anti-PD-1 的合併阻斷在臨床前模型中對耗竭 T 細胞產生協同的再活化效果。

links.context: NMN does not directly bind or activate any individual sirtuin; it acts as a universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator by raising cellular NAD+ concentrations. Because SIRT1 through SIRT7 all require NAD+ as an obligate co-substrate for their deacetylase and deacylase activities, NMN supplementation potentiates the entire family, reproducing many of the NAD+-dependent benefits of Caloric Restriction including improved insulin sensitivity, mitochondrial function and vascular function in aged models.
links.context_zh_TW: NMN 並不直接結合或活化任何單一 sirtuin；它是藉由提高細胞 NAD+ 濃度而作為普遍、間接的 pan-sirtuin 活化劑。由於 SIRT1 到 SIRT7 的 deacetylase 與 deacylase 活性全都以 NAD+ 為必要共同受質，補充 NMN 便可增強整個家族，並重現 Caloric Restriction 許多依賴 NAD+ 的效益，包括在老化模型中改善胰島素敏感性、粒線體功能與血管功能。

links.context: NMN protects against acute pancreatitis injury in experimental models: it raises NAD+, activates the SIRT3-PRDX5 axis and reduces pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress and inflammation. This positions microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors as mediators of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and the gut-pancreas axis as a dietary or microbiota-targeted avenue of intervention.
links.context_zh_TW: NMN 在實驗模型中可對抗急性胰臟炎的損傷：它提升 NAD+、活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 軸，並降低胰臟的粒線體功能障礙、氧化壓力與發炎。這使腸道菌群產生的 NAD+ 前驅物成為糞便菌群移植保護作用的介導因子，也使腸道—胰臟軸成為飲食或菌群導向的介入途徑。

links.context: NMN raises NAD+ through supply-side kinetics rather than by binding a sirtuin, and a 2026 head-to-head study found NMN produced roughly double the whole-blood NAD+ of nicotinamide riboside at 14 days, apparently via gut microbiota conversion to nicotinamide, while NAM gave only a transient rise. Clinical derivatives such as HK-660S and MIB-626 exploit the same route to engage SIRT1 and SIRT3. NMN appears in the combined graph as part of the mechanistic/process vocabulary (NMN/NAD+) that the wiki corpus added and the triples extraction had under-represented, ranking among the top wiki-only nodes by degree and by PageRank. Mechanistically it sits on the NAD+ biosynthesis side, so the pair is treated as a precursor relationship rather than a flat association. Its k-core of 19 places it deep inside the union's core rather than in the periphery.
links.context_zh_TW: NMN 透過供給端動力學而不是結合 sirtuin 來提高 NAD+，2026 年一項頭對頭研究發現 14 天時 NMN 造成的全血 NAD+ 約為 Nicotinamide Riboside 的兩倍，機制似乎是經腸道菌群轉換為 nicotinamide，而 NAM 只造成短暫上升。像 HK-660S 與 MIB-626 等臨床衍生物走的也是同一路徑，藉以接合 SIRT1 與 SIRT3。 NMN 在合併圖中屬於 wiki 語料新增、而 triples 擷取先前低估的機制／過程詞彙（NMN/NAD+），並在 wiki-only 節點中同時以節點度與 PageRank 排名前列。從機制上看，它位於 NAD+ 生合成的上游，因此這對節點被視為前驅物關係，而非單純的關聯。其 k-core 為 19，顯示它深陷聯集核心而非位於外圍。

links.context: NMN raises Short-chain Fatty Acids indirectly: by remodeling the gut microbiota toward butyrate-producing taxa, NMN increases production of microbial metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids. These metabolites reinforce mucosal barrier integrity, so the microbiota-remodeling effect of NMN converges with its direct effects on tight junctions and mucus secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: NMN 間接提升 Short-chain Fatty Acids：藉由將 gut microbiota 重塑為以丁酸產生菌為主的組成，NMN 增加短鏈脂肪酸等微生物代謝物的產生。這些代謝物可強化黏膜屏障完整性，因此 NMN 的菌群重塑作用與其對緊密連接與黏液分泌的直接作用相互匯聚。

links.context: NMN restores NAD+ co-substrate availability for sirtuins, distinct from allosteric STAC activation. Standard precursor biology paired with the existing NR-sirtuin edge.
links.context_zh_TW: NMN 恢復 sirtuins 的 NAD+ 輔受質可及性，不同於別構 STAC 活化。標準前驅物生物學，與既有的 NR-sirtuin 邊配對。

links.context: NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide) is the reduced form of NMN and promotes NAD+ synthesis. Its reduced pyridine ring is converted to NAD+ through salvage machinery via adenylylation steps, bypassing some rate-limiting steps of the amidated routes and offering an alternative substrate for NAD+ replenishment.
links.context_zh_TW: NMNH（二氫菸醯胺單核苷酸）是 NMN 的還原型，可促進 NAD+ 合成。其還原吡啶環經回收機制透過腺苷化步驟轉為 NAD+，繞過醯胺路徑中部分限速步驟，提供補充 NAD+ 的替代受質。

links.context: NMRK2 (NRK2) is expressed predominantly in cardiac and skeletal muscle. In the failing heart, where NAD+ levels fall, NMRK2-dependent conversion of Nicotinamide Riboside to NMN acts as an adaptive rescue pathway that restores NAD+ availability to support contractile bioenergetics.
links.context_zh_TW: NMRK2（NRK2）主要表現在心肌與骨骼肌中。在 NAD+ 濃度下降的衰竭心臟裡，NMRK2 依賴的 Nicotinamide Riboside → NMN 轉換扮演適應性的救援途徑，恢復 NAD+ 的可得性以支撐收縮功能的生物能代謝。

links.context: NOX4 supplies the H2O2 that acts as the dominant oxidative senescence trigger in lung, kidney and vasculature, driving p53/p21 and p16/Rb arrest. In skin the same NOX4/ROS axis operates downstream of UV, and in colon it contributes a TGFβ and PGC-1alpha pro-oxidant tilt rather than acting as the primary sensor.
links.context_zh_TW: NOX4 供應 H2O2，是肺、腎與血管中占主導地位的氧化性衰老觸發因子，驅動 p53／p21 與 p16／Rb 停滯。在皮膚，同一條 NOX4／ROS 軸位於 UV 下游作用；在結腸，它則提供 TGFβ 與 PGC-1alpha 的促氧化傾斜，而非作為主要感測器。

links.context: NPAT is gated by cell-cycle kinases: cyclin E/CDK2 phosphorylation at the G1/S transition licenses NPAT to drive replication-dependent histone gene transcription. In quiescence or senescence cyclin E/CDK2 activity falls, NPAT is dephosphorylated, and the replication-dependent histone genes are silenced — which is why NPAT disengagement is a principal cause of the canonical histone collapse seen in senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: NPAT 受細胞週期激酶調控：在 G1/S 轉換時 cyclin E/CDK2 的磷酸化授權 NPAT 驅動複製依賴型組蛋白基因的轉錄。在靜止或衰老時 cyclin E/CDK2 活性下降，NPAT 被去磷酸化，複製依賴型組蛋白基因因而沉默——這正是 NPAT 失去作用成為衰老細胞典型組蛋白崩潰主因的原因。

links.context: NPC1 acts as a checkpoint that restrains cGAS-STING signaling under homeostatic conditions. NPC1 deficiency disrupts endolysosomal trafficking, impairs STING degradation and prolongs signaling at the ER and nuclear envelope, producing constitutive STING overactivation and sustained Type I Interferon production — a cGAS-independent route by which organelle stress alone can drive interferon signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: NPC1 是在穩態下抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號的檢查點。NPC1 缺失會破壞內體溶酶體運輸、損害 STING 降解並延長其在 ER 與核膜的訊號傳遞，造成 STING 過度活化與持續的 Type I Interferon 生成——這是一條不依賴 cGAS、單靠胞器壓力即可驅動干擾素訊號的途徑。

links.context: NQO1 performs obligatory two-electron quinone to hydroquinone reduction, bypassing the semiquinone and blocking redox cycling. NQO1 is DT-diaphorase, the classic aminochrome reductase.
links.context_zh_TW: NQO1 執行必要的雙電子醌到氫醌還原，繞過半醌並阻斷氧化還原循環。NQO1 即 DT-diaphorase，典型的胺色素還原酶。

links.context: NRF2 (nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor) is a leucine zipper transcription factor that is clearly activated by oxidative stress and participates in the hormetic induction of increased stress resistance. It regulates the expression of a host of gene products that help mediate resistance to oxidative stress. Its worm homolog SKN-1 directly binds mitochondria and is required to mediate the longevity benefits associated with mitochondrial oxidant release, establishing NRF2/SKN-1 as a key effector of the mitochondrial ROS-driven hormetic response.
links.context_zh_TW: NRF2（紅細胞核因子2相關因子）是一種亮氨酸拉鏈轉錄因子，明顯被氧化應激激活，並參與壓力抗性增強的興奮性誘導。它調節一系列有助於介導氧化抗性的基因產物的表達。其線蟲同源物SKN-1直接結合粒線體，是介導與粒線體氧化劑釋放相關的長壽益處所必需的，確立NRF2/SKN-1為粒線體ROS驅動興奮反應的關鍵效應器。

links.context: NRF2 acting through Antioxidant Response Elements coordinates upregulation of the detoxification network that buffers catecholamine oxidation products. Key Nrf2 targets include NQO1, which two-electron-reduces o-quinones to hydroquinones and blocks redox cycling, HO-1, which cleaves pro-oxidant heme into biliverdin, carbon monoxide and sequestered iron, and the glutamate-cysteine ligase subunits that raise Glutathione synthetic capacity. Pharmacological NRF2 activators such as Dimethyl fumarate therefore enhance Phase II/III clearance of aminochromes.
links.context_zh_TW: NRF2 透過 Antioxidant Response Element 協調上調可緩衝兒茶酚胺氧化產物的去毒網絡。重要的 Nrf2 標的包括以雙電子將 o-quinone 還原為 hydroquinone、阻斷 redox cycling 的 NQO1；將促氧化 heme 裂解為 biliverdin、一氧化碳與被隔離的鐵的 HO-1；以及提升 Glutathione 合成能力的 glutamate-cysteine ligase 次單元。因此 NRF2 的藥理活化劑如 Dimethyl fumarate 可強化 aminochrome 的 Phase II/III 清除。

links.context: NRF2 induces ferritin together with glutathione-linked defences, and NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy then liberates stored iron back into the labile pool. This cell-autonomous inducible sequestration is the counterpart of the systemic HFE defect: a genetically iron-loaded individual must mount this adaptive response lifelong, since the same labile iron pool that HFE loss enlarges is the substrate for Fenton Reaction chemistry. Ferritin abundance therefore controls how much iron is immediately available for radical generation.
links.context_zh_TW: NRF2 會誘導 Ferritin 與 glutathione 連結的防禦系統，而 NCOA4 介導的 ferritinophagy 隨後將儲存的鐵釋放回 labile pool。這種細胞自主、可誘發的隔離作用正是全身性 HFE 缺陷的對應面：遺傳性鐵負荷個體必須終生啟動此適應反應，因為 HFE 喪失所擴大的正是同一個 labile iron pool，也是 Fenton Reaction 化學的受質。因此 Ferritin 的含量決定了多少鐵可立即用於自由基生成。

links.context: NRF2 is the master cytoprotective regulator engaged by hormetic stress, mirroring the mitohormesis mediation. Mediation is the effector arm.
links.context_zh_TW: NRF2 是激效壓力接合的主要細胞保護調節器，呼應 mitohormesis 媒介。媒介是效應臂。

links.context: NRF2 with ARE is the Tier I program of the hierarchical oxidative-stress model formalised for hormesis, occupying the low-dose adaptive zone with antioxidant and phase II enzyme induction and glutathione restoration. Tier II adds NF-κB-driven inflammation and cell-cycle arrest, and Tier III executes apoptosis and necrosis, so the tiers are the same control network at increasing saturation.
links.context_zh_TW: NRF2 搭配 ARE 是分層氧化壓力模型中的第一層程式，並在為 hormesis 形式化後佔據低劑量適應區，伴隨抗氧化與第二相酵素誘導以及 glutathione 的恢復。第二層加入 NF-κB 驅動的發炎與細胞週期阻滯，第三層則執行凋亡與壞死，因此各層其實是同一控制網絡在飽和度遞增下的表現。

links.context: NRK2 is the consistent earliest responder suppressed across chemo models.
links.context_zh_TW: NRK2 是化療模型一致最早反應的被抑制者。

links.context: NRK2 is the muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme.
links.context_zh_TW: NRK2 是肌肉特異的 NAD+ 生合成酶。

links.context: NUCKS1 carries acetylation sites whose state is reversed by SIRT7 deacetylase activity, and that balance modulates how much NUCKS1 occupies chromatin. The SIRT7–NUCKS1 axis has been implicated in senescence-associated chromatin reorganization and SASP regulation, including at rDNA loci where the two partners meet in nucleolus-associated regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: NUCKS1 帶有可被 SIRT7 去乙醯化酵素活性逆轉的乙醯化位點，而該平衡決定 NUCKS1 佔據染色質的程度。SIRT7–NUCKS1 軸已被認為參與衰老相關的染色質重組與 SASP 調控，包括在這兩個搭檔於核仁相關調控中相遇的 rDNA 基因座上。

links.context: NUCKS1 is recruited to sites of DNA Damage and has been implicated in homologous-recombination repair through interaction with repair proteins such as BRCA1. By supporting double-strand-break repair, NUCKS1 protects proliferating cells from genomic instability, and it also associates with chromatin bearing the repressive H3K9me3 mark to modulate proliferation- and metabolism-associated gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: NUCKS1 會被招募至 DNA Damage 位點，並透過與 BRCA1 等修復蛋白的交互作用參與同源重組修復。藉由支援雙股斷裂修復，NUCKS1 保護增殖細胞免於 genomic instability；它也會與帶有抑制性 H3K9me3 標記的染色質結合，以調節增殖與代謝相關基因的表現。

links.context: NUCKS1 sustains proliferative chromatin programs, so its depletion in cancer cell lines triggers Cellular Senescence and apoptosis through the p53/p21 pathway. This makes NUCKS1 loss both a growth-arrest trigger and a therapeutic vulnerability: NUCKS1 is overexpressed in breast, hepatocellular, gastric, colorectal and lung malignancies, where high expression correlates with proliferation, metastasis and poor prognosis.
links.context_zh_TW: NUCKS1 維持增殖性的染色質程序，因此在癌症細胞株中敲低 NUCKS1 會透過 p53/p21 路徑誘發 Cellular Senescence 與凋亡。這使 NUCKS1 流失既是生長停滞的觸發因子，也是治療弱點：NUCKS1 在乳癌、肝細胞癌、胃癌、大腸癌與肺癌中過度表現，高表現與增殖、轉移及不良預後相關。

links.context: Naive lymphocytes rest metabolically restrained in quiescence until antigen activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 初始淋巴細胞在抗原活化前以代謝受限靜止休憩。

links.context: Naked mole rats display remarkable resistance to cancer alongside extraordinary longevity, which is what makes them a premier comparative model for Senescence, genomic stability and innate immunity. Their muted neuroinflammation despite genomic instability suggests that longevity in this species is not bought by avoiding DNA damage but by tolerating it without destructive inflammatory output.
links.context_zh_TW: 裸鼢鼠在極長壽命的同時展現出非凡的癌症抵抗性，使其成為研究 Senescence、genomic stability 與先天免疫的首要比較模型。它們在 genomic instability 下仍抑制 neuroinflammation，表示該物種的長壽並非靠避免 DNA damage 取得，而是靠容忍 DNA damage 而不產生破壞性的發炎輸出。

links.context: Naked mole rats maintain high genomic instability yet keep cGAS-STING Pathway output muted. Unlike human cGAS, which is anchored to nucleosomes and restrained to prevent aberrant activation, naked mole rat cGAS exhibits prolonged retention on chromatin and enhances DNA Repair — an evolutionary rewiring in which nuclear cGAS is co-opted toward genome maintenance rather than inflammatory signaling, damping Type I Interferon and inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 裸鼢鼠保有高度的 genomic instability，卻使 cGAS-STING Pathway 的輸出維持低弱。與錨定於 nucleosome 並受抑制以避免異常活化的人類 cGAS 不同，裸鼢鼠 cGAS 在 chromatin 上保留時間更長且強化 DNA Repair——這是一種演化上的重新佈線，使核內 cGAS 轉向基因體維護而非發炎訊號，因而抑制 Type I Interferon 與 inflammation。

links.context: Nanoformulation of fisetin in MPEG-PCL polymeric micelles addresses the low bioavailability of the parent compound: encapsulation is near quantitative, tumor growth inhibition is 1.3-fold stronger than free fisetin, and survival is prolonged by 17 days in murine models. The same strategy generalises to other hydrophobic phytochemicals such as honokiol and magnolol.
links.context_zh_TW: 將 fisetin 以 MPEG-PCL 聚合物微膠粒做奈米製劑化，可解決母體化合物生體利用率低的問題：封裝率接近完全，腫瘤生長抑制比游離 fisetin 強 1.3 倍，並在小鼠模型中延長存活 17 天。相同策略也可推廣至 honokiol 與 magnolol 等其他疏水性植物化合物。

links.context: Nanog sustains indefinite stem-cell proliferation without differentiation. Maintenance separates renewal from lineage exit.
links.context_zh_TW: Nanog 在不分化下維持幹細胞無限增殖。維持將更新與譜系退出分開。

links.context: Nec-1s was developed as the second-generation successor to Necrostatin-1, retaining the RIPK1-targeting scaffold while eliminating the indoleamine-2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) off-target activity of the first-generation compound.
links.context_zh_TW: Nec-1s 為 Nec-1 的第二代後繼化合物，保留靶向 RIPK1 的骨架，同時消除第一代化合物的 IDO 非靶標活性。

links.context: Negative regulators of ferroptosis in HCC — NRF2, metallothionein-1G, CISD1 and p53 — confer resistance to sorafenib's ferroptotic effect, so high activity of these markers predicts ferroptosis-resistant disease and is a target for resensitization.
links.context_zh_TW: HCC 中 ferroptosis 的負向調節因子——NRF2、metallothionein-1G、CISD1 與 p53——會賦予對 sorafenib ferroptosis 作用的抗藥性；因此這些標記活性偏高可預測 ferroptosis 抗藥的病程，也是重新敏感化的治療目標。

links.context: Neural stem cells sustain developmental and adult neurogenesis. Promotion is their defining tissue function.
links.context_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞維持發育與成年神經生成。促進是其定義性組織功能。

links.context: Neural stem cells yield radial-glial and intermediate progenitors. Generation is the lineage output of the stem pool.
links.context_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞產生放射狀膠質與中間祖細胞。產生是幹細胞池的譜系輸出。

links.context: Neuroinflammation mediated by microglia and astrocytes amplifies and propagates oxidative neuronal damage: activated microglia undergo a NADPH Oxidase respiratory burst producing superoxide and nitric oxide-derived peroxynitrite, and reactive A1 astrocytes lose glutathione export and iron sequestration.
links.context_zh_TW: 由小膠細胞與星狀膠細胞介導的 Neuroinflammation 會放大並傳播神經元氧化損傷：活化的小膠細胞經 NADPH Oxidase 呼吸爆發產生超氧陰離子與一氧化氮衍生的過氧亞硝酸鹽，而反應性 A1 星狀膠細胞則喪失麩胱甘肽輸出與鐵隔離能力。

links.context: Neuromelanin in the Substantia Nigra is built from DHI/DHICA units and catechol-derived quinones. Because uncontrolled 5,6-Dihydroxyindole oxidation amplifies local oxidative load, it contributes to the same protein cross-linking and oxidative damage implicated in Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Substantia Nigra 中的 Neuromelanin 由 DHI/DHICA 單元與兒茶酚衍生的 quinone 構成。由於 5,6-Dihydroxyindole 的氧化失控會放大局部氧化負載，它參與了與 Parkinson's Disease 相關的蛋白交聯與氧化損傷。

links.context: Neuropilin-1 amplifies VEGF-driven vessel formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Neuropilin-1 放大 VEGF 驅動的血管形成。

links.context: Neutral Red increases cellular oxygen consumption rate in Seahorse assays, placing it with Methylene blue and Toluidine Blue O among OCR-enhancing compounds; however, it does not increase Cytochrome c reduction between Complex I and Complex III, so it is not an alternative electron carrier.
links.context_zh_TW: Neutral Red 在 Seahorse 檢測中可提高細胞耗氧率，與 Methylene blue、Toluidine Blue O 同屬增強 OCR 的化合物；然而它並未增加 Complex I 至 Complex III 之間的 Cytochrome c 還原，因此不具替代性電子載體功能。

links.context: Neutrophil Elastase acts with Myeloperoxidase as a co-decorating granule enzyme on extruded neutrophil extracellular traps; inhibiting NE/MPO is part of the standard NETosis blockade panel, with PAD4 representing the parallel citrullination arm.
links.context_zh_TW: Neutrophil Elastase 與 Myeloperoxidase 共同作為外擲中性球胞外誘捕網的顆粒酵素；抑制 NE/MPO 是標準 NETosis 阻斷組合的一部分，而 PAD4 則代表平行的瓜胺酸化分支。

links.context: Neutrophil Elastase clips chromatin histones and, together with the co-decorating granule enzyme Myeloperoxidase and the citrullinated histone marker cit-H3, forms the DNA-histone-protease web that traps pathogens and pathologically drives immunothrombosis in Sepsis.
links.context_zh_TW: Neutrophil Elastase 切割染色質組蛋白，並與共同裝飾的顆粒酵素 Myeloperoxidase 及瓜胺酸化組蛋白標記 cit-H3 一起形成捕捉病原體的 DNA–組蛋白–蛋白酶網，在 Sepsis 中病理性地促成免疫性血栓形成。

links.context: Neutrophils, as part of the innate immune response, generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) including superoxide radicals through their NADPH oxidase system, with myeloperoxidase contributing additional oxidants such as hypochlorous acid. These ROS serve a key antimicrobial function, but they also oxidize nearby biomolecules, including catecholamines such as epinephrine, converting them to oxidation products like adrenochrome. This ROS-driven chemistry is most prominent locally at sites of inflammation, infection, or tissue damage where neutrophils accumulate, and it links immune activation to oxidative stress and catecholamine metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Neutrophils, as part of the innate immune response, generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) including superoxide radicals through their NADPH oxidase system, with myeloperoxidase contributing additional oxidants such as hypochlorous acid。These ROS serve a key antimicrobial function, but they also oxidize nearby biomolecules, including catecholamines such as epinephrine, converting them to oxidation products like adrenochrome。This ROS-driven chemistry is most prominent locally at sites of inflammation, infection, or tissue damage where neutrophils accumulate, and it links immune activation to oxidative stress and catecholamine metabolism。
