links.context: Nicotinamide Riboside enters NAD+ metabolism through phosphorylation to NMN by the two nicotinamide riboside kinases NMRK1 and NMRK2. This direct route bypasses the NAMPT requirement of the conventional salvage pathway, which is why NMRK1/NMRK2 are described as bypassing that step on the way to NAD+.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotinamide Riboside 經由兩種 nicotinamide riboside kinase——NMRK1 與 NMRK2——磷酸化為 NMN 而進入 NAD+ 代謝。這條直接途徑繞過了傳統 salvage pathway 對 NAMPT 的需求，因此 NMRK1/NMRK2 被描述為在通往 NAD+ 的路上繞過該步驟。

links.context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) derived from the gut microbiota ameliorates acute pancreatitis injury. In acute pancreatitis mouse models, NMN increased NAD+ levels and activated the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner. Acute pancreatitis is exacerbated by gut microbiota dysbiosis, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher serum NMN levels, enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. This makes NMN an important mediator of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and highlights the role of gut microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors in pathological outcomes of the host.
links.context_zh_TW: 源自腸道菌叢的菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善急性胰臟炎損傷。在急性胰臟炎小鼠模型中，NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑，以部分依賴 SIRT3 的方式減輕胰臟粒線體功能障礙、氧化損傷與發炎。急性胰臟炎會因腸道菌叢失調而惡化，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。這使 NMN 成為糞便微生物移植保護效應的重要介導者，並凸顯腸道菌叢產生的 NAD+ 前驅物在宿主病理結果中的作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves features of Alzheimer's disease by raising NAD+ levels and supporting sirtuin activity. It protects neuronal cells from oxidative stress, prevents beta-amyloid oligomer-induced cognitive impairment and neuronal death, and inhibits JNK activation to reverse Alzheimer's disease pathology in experimental models. NMN is proposed as a nutraceutical to prevent age-related physiological decline and has demonstrated cardio- and vasoprotective actions as well. Alongside nicotinamide riboside, which reduces neuroinflammation, phosphorylated Tau, DNA damage, and hippocampal neuron apoptosis while increasing neurogenesis, NMN represents a dietary NAD+ precursor strategy against neurodegenerative and age-related diseases.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN）透過提升 NAD+ 濃度並支持 sirtuin 活性，改善 Alzheimer's disease 的特徵。它能保護神經元細胞免受氧化壓力，防止 beta-amyloid 寡聚體誘發的認知障礙與神經元死亡，並抑制 JNK 活化以逆轉實驗模型中 Alzheimer's disease 的病理變化。NMN 被提議作為一種營養保健品，以預防與年齡相關的生理衰退，並且也已展現出心臟與血管保護作用。與 nicotinamide riboside 並用，後者能減少神經發炎、磷酸化 Tau、DNA 損傷與海馬神經元凋亡，同時增加神經生成，NMN 代表一種針對神經退化性與年齡相關疾病的飲食性 NAD+ 前驅物策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves intestinal barrier function, which is important for preventing translocation of harmful bacteria and toxins from the gut into the bloodstream. In colitis models, NMN increased the expression of tight-junction proteins and improved mucus secretion, attenuating intestinal mucosal permeability. Long-term NMN treatment also increased the number of goblet cells, mucus thickness, and tight junction protein expression, maintaining the integrity of the intestinal epithelium. NMN and NR share this gut-protective property alongside selective stimulation of beneficial bacteria, and NAD+-precursor-activated sirtuins also protect intestinal endothelial cells against oxidative injury, collectively reinforcing the gut barrier.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善腸道屏障功能，這對於防止有害細菌與毒素從腸道移位至血流中相當重要。在結腸炎模型中，NMN 增加緊密連接蛋白的表現並改善黏液分泌，減輕腸黏膜通透性。長期 NMN 處理也增加杯狀細胞數量、黏液厚度與緊密連接蛋白表現，維持腸上皮的完整性。NMN 和 NR 共享此腸道保護特性，加上對有益細菌的選擇性刺激，且 NAD+ 前驅物活化的去乙醯酶也保護腸道內皮細胞免受氧化損傷，共同強化腸道屏障。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suppresses NF-kB signaling as part of its anti-inflammatory mechanism. In LPS-activated macrophages, proteomics analysis identified that NMN downregulated COX-2 expression and suppressed inflammation-related pathways including prostanoid biosynthesis, LPS/IL-1-mediated inhibition of RXR function, and IL-6 and NF-kB signaling. This downregulation of NF-kB and related pathways decreased extracellular secretion of IL-6 and IL-1beta and lowered prostaglandin E2 levels, alleviating LPS-induced inflammation and oxidative stress. These effects complement the sirtuin-mediated suppression of NF-kB, positioning NMN as a dietary agent that restrains the master pro-inflammatory transcription factor.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）抑制 NF-kB 訊息傳導，作為其抗發炎機制的一部分。在 LPS 活化的巨噬細胞中，蛋白質體學分析發現 NMN 下調 COX-2 表現並抑制與發炎相關的路徑，包括類前列腺素生合成、LPS/IL-1 介導的 RXR 功能抑制，以及 IL-6 和 NF-kB 訊息傳導。此 NF-kB 及相關路徑的下調降低了 IL-6 和 IL-1beta 的細胞外分泌並降低前列腺素 E2 水平，緩解 LPS 誘發的發炎與氧化壓力。這些效應補充了去乙醯酶介導的 NF-kB 抑制，使 NMN 成為一種能抑制主要促發炎轉錄因子的膳食性物質。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) delays axon degeneration and demyelination in a facial nerve axotomy model. Intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice, mimicking the protective effect of CD38 knockdown. Because the age-related increase in CD38 activity degrades NMN and NAD+ and alters precursor pharmacokinetics, NR-mediated NAD+ replenishment helps maintain axonal integrity after injury, supporting NR as a candidate intervention for neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在面神經軸突切斷模型中延遲軸突退化與脫髓鞘。在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射、持續 1 週，延遲了軸突退化與脫髓鞘，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 濃度，模擬了 CD38 敲低的保護作用。由於隨年齡增加的 CD38 活性會降解 NMN 與 NAD+，並改變前驅物的藥物動力學，NR 介導的 NAD+ 補充有助於在受傷後維持軸突完整性，支持 NR 作為神經退化性疾病的候選介入手段。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) promotes mitochondrial fusion, particularly in the diabetic heart. Daily oral gavage of NR at 400 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks alleviated diabetes-induced cardiomyopathy and improved cardiac function in diabetic mice by elevating myocardium NAD+ content and promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion. This action occurs via the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway and suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. By restoring balanced mitochondrial dynamics in a disease state characterized by mitochondrial fragmentation and dysfunction, NR supports cardiomyocyte survival and cardiac bioenergetics.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）促進粒線體融合，特別是在糖尿病心臟中。每天以 400 mg/kg/天 NR 口服灌胃 4 週，透過提升心肌 NAD+ 含量並促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，減輕糖尿病誘發的心肌病並改善糖尿病小鼠的心臟功能。此作用透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑發生，並抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。透過在粒線體碎裂與功能障礙為特徵的疾病狀態中恢復平衡的粒線體動態，NR 支持心肌細胞存活與心臟生物能量學。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors in mice by altering gut microbiota composition. Dietary supplementation with NR for 10 weeks at 400 mg/kg daily reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels, inhibited microglial activation, and provided protection against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors. The effect was attributed to NR's ability to upregulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) through microbiota changes: brain BDNF levels correlated positively with bacteria enriched in the NR group such as Barnesiella, Alloprevotella, Prevotella, Alistipes, and Mucispirillum. Fecal microbiota transplantation from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective features in germ-free recipients, demonstrating a gut-microbiota-gut-brain axis mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成，保護小鼠免於酒精誘發的類憂鬱行為。以每天 400 mg/kg NR 飲食補充 10 週，降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素水平，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並提供對酒精誘發類憂鬱行為的保護。此效應歸因於 NR 透過菌叢改變上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）的能力：腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 組中富集的細菌如 Barnesiella、Alloprevotella、Prevotella、Alistipes 和 Mucispirillum 呈正相關。來自 NR 處理供體的糞便微生物移植在無菌受體中重現了保護特徵，證明了腸道菌叢—腸—腦軸機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces fat accumulation in the liver through a mechanism that involves induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), which is elicited by NAD+ repletion and reverses fatty liver disease in mice. Through this pathway, as well as through activation of SIRT1 and factors associated with cholesterol homeostasis, NR can reduce cholesterol levels and improve liver health. In regenerating liver, NR reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to faster recovery of liver weight.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過涉及誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的機制減少肝臟中的脂肪堆積，此反應由 NAD+ 補充所引發，並在小鼠中逆轉脂肪肝疾病。透過此路徑，以及透過活化 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定相關的因子，NR 能降低膽固醇水平並改善肝臟健康。在再生肝臟中，NR 減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，導致肝臟重量更快恢復。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation and liver steatosis in mouse models, effects that are mediated through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response and through SIRT1 activation, which promotes fatty acid oxidation and inhibits lipogenesis, protecting the liver from steatosis. NR also restores hepatic NADP+ and NADPH in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice and reduces cholesterol levels via SIRT1 and cholesterol-homeostasis factors. Sirtuins are downregulated in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, so raising NAD+ with NR
links.context_zh_TW: 煙酰胺核糖（NR）在小鼠模型中減少脂質堆積與肝臟脂肪變性，這些效應是透過誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應以及透過 SIRT1 活化所介導，後者促進脂肪酸氧化並抑制脂肪生成，保護肝臟免於脂肪變性。NR 也會在糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中恢復肝臟的 NADP+ 與 NADPH，並透過 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定因子降低膽固醇水平。Sirtuins 在非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）患者中表現下調，NAFLD 是與第二型糖尿病、肥胖和胰島素抵抗相關的代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因此以 NR 提升 NAD+
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces aortic stiffness and systolic blood pressure, both clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These NR-induced effects may occur via nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, because NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which maintains healthy vascular function and promotes endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation through endothelial nitric oxide synthase. Arterial stiffness reduction aligns with the broader cardiovascular benefits of NR, which normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio and preserves cardiac function in models of heart failure and dilated cardiomyopathy, supporting the
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低主動脈僵硬與收縮壓，兩者皆為心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些由 NR 誘發的效應可能透過核內與胞質 SIRT1 活化而產生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 可維持健康血管功能並透過 endothelial nitric oxide synthase 促進內皮依賴性血管舒張。動脈僵硬的降低與 NR 更廣泛的心血管益處一致，NR 可將心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，並在心力衰竭與擴張型心肌病模型中維持心臟功能，支持
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) upregulates brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) by altering gut microbiota composition. In a mouse model of alcohol-induced depression, 10 weeks of NR supplementation reduced pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines, inhibited microglial activation, and protected against depression-like behaviors, with the protective effect attributed to NR-driven increases in BDNF. Brain BDNF levels were positively correlated with bacteria abundant in NR-treated mice, such as Barnesiella and Alloprevotella, whereas brain inflammatory cytokines correlated with bacteria enriched in the depression model group. This BDNF upregulation via microbiota remodeling links NR intake to improved emotional behavior and neural plasticity.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠模型中，10 週 NR 補充降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並保護免於類憂鬱行為，其保護效應歸因於 NR 驅動的 BDNF 增加。腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 處理小鼠中豐富的細菌如 Barnesiella 和 Alloprevotella 呈正相關，而腦部發炎細胞激素則與憂鬱模型組中富集的細菌相關。這種透過菌叢重塑的 BDNF 上調將 NR 攝取與改善情緒行為及神經可塑性連結起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD) and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. DMD is characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration, and decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression are also observed in this condition. By improving muscular strength, rejuvenating senescent muscle stem cells, and reducing levels of inflammation and fibrosis, NR could be effective in managing the progression of muscular dystrophy and degeneration. These findings support the use of NR for the human condition of DMD.
links.context_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）被發現能改善 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。DMD 的特徵為 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化，且在此疾病中亦觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低。透過改善肌肉力量、使衰老的肌肉幹細胞年輕化，以及降低發炎與纖維化程度，NR 可能有效管理肌肉營養不良與退化的進程。這些發現支持將 NR 用於人類 DMD 病症。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside protects neurons from excitotoxicity-induced axon loss by restoring axonal NAD+. Precursor repletion counters SARM1-driven depletion.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotinamide riboside 經由恢復軸突 NAD+ 保護神經元免於興奮毒性誘發的軸突缺失。前體補充對抗 SARM1 驅動的耗竭。

links.context: Nicotine and the physiological stress of smoking trigger release of adrenaline from the adrenal glands, raising circulating Epinephrine levels. Because Epinephrine is the parent catecholamine substrate for aminochrome formation, this surge in substrate directly increases the rate at which Adrenochrome can be generated.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotine 與吸菸造成的生理壓力會觸發腎上腺釋放 adrenaline，使循環中的 Epinephrine 濃度上升。由於 Epinephrine 是 aminochrome 生成的母體兒茶酚胺受質，這一波受質增加會直接提高 Adrenochrome 的生成速率。

links.context: Nitrative stress damages DNA primarily through the formation of 8-nitroguanine from the reaction of reactive nitrogen species with guanine residues. Unlike the stable oxidative lesion 8-oxo-dG, 8-nitroguanine is chemically unstable and spontaneously depurinates to form apurinic/apyrimidinic sites, causing mutations and strand breaks. It can also adduct to histone lysines to generate DNA-protein crosslinks that disrupt chromatin structure.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 主要透過 reactive nitrogen species 與鳥嘌呤殘基反應形成 8-nitroguanine 來損傷 DNA。與穩定的氧化損傷 8-oxo-dG 不同，8-nitroguanine 化學性質不穩定，會自發性去嘌呤形成無嘌呤/無嘧啶位點，造成突變與鏈斷裂。它也能加成至組蛋白離胺酸，產生破壞染色質結構的 DNA-蛋白質交聯。

links.context: Nitrative stress impairs mitochondria because they are both sources and targets of reactive nitrogen and oxygen species. Peroxynitrite formed in the mitochondrial matrix inactivates MnSOD and aconitase and nitrates Complex I subunits, impairing both the TCA cycle and antioxidant defenses. Opening of the permeability transition pore in response to this damage triggers cytochrome c release and apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 損害 mitochondria，因為粒線體既是 reactive nitrogen 與 oxygen species 的來源也是標靶。在粒線體基質中形成的 peroxynitrite 會使 MnSOD 與 aconitase 失活並硝化 Complex I 次單元，同時損害 TCA 循環與抗氧化防禦。針對此損傷而開啟的 permeability transition pore 會觸發 cytochrome c 釋放與 apoptosis。

links.context: Nitrative stress is a primary mediator of ischemia-reperfusion injury, where the abrupt reintroduction of oxygen generates a burst of both ROS and RNS that overwhelms matrix defenses. Mitochondrial nitrative stress cascades trigger permeability transition, cytochrome c release, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis during early reperfusion. This makes nitrative stress a central mechanism in reperfusion damage across organs.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 是 ischemia-reperfusion injury 的主要介導者，在此過程中，氧氣的突然重新導入會產生 ROS 與 RNS 的爆發，壓垮基質防禦。粒線體的 nitrative stress 級聯在再灌注早期觸發 permeability transition、cytochrome c 釋放與心肌細胞 apoptosis。這使 nitrative stress 成為跨器官再灌注損傷的核心機制。

links.context: Nitrative stress promotes apoptosis through peroxynitrite-induced protein nitration and lipid peroxidation that open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. This leads to cytochrome c release and activation of the intrinsic apoptotic cascade. In cytochrome c itself, nitration of Tyr-74 inhibits electron transfer and promotes apoptosome formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 透過 peroxynitrite 誘導的蛋白質硝化與脂質過氧化開啟粒線體 permeability transition pore，從而促進 apoptosis。這導致 cytochrome c 釋放並活化內源性凋亡級聯。在 cytochrome c 本身，Tyr-74 的硝化會抑制電子傳遞並促進凋亡體形成。

links.context: Nitric Oxide acts as a vasodilator that relaxes vascular smooth muscle to regulate blood flow and pressure; declining NO bioavailability with age is a major mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in Cardiovascular Disease and arterial aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitric Oxide 作為血管擴張劑，可舒張血管平滑肌以調節血流與血壓；隨年齡增長 NO 生體可用性下降，是 Cardiovascular Disease 與動脈老化中內皮功能異常的重要機制。

links.context: Nitrobenzene, certain local anesthetics and ingested nitrates/nitrites share the ferrihemoglobin-inducing mechanism with aniline dyes, oxidizing heme iron to the Fe³⁺ state. Management follows the general methemoglobinemia paradigm of co-oximetry confirmation and methylene blue reduction.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrobenzene、某些局部麻醉藥與攝入的硝酸鹽／亞硝酸鹽與 Aniline dyes 具有相同的 ferrihemoglobin 誘導機制，將血基質鐵氧化為 Fe³⁺ 態。處置遵循 Methemoglobinemia 的一般準則：以 Co-oximetry 確認並以 Methylene blue 還原。

links.context: Nkx3.2 (Bapx1) acts as a transcriptional repressor of GATA5 in endothelial cells. Because SIRT6 silences Nkx3.2, GATA5 is derepressed and endothelial injury is prevented — placing developmental homeobox factors inside the adult vascular-maintenance SIRT6 network.
links.context_zh_TW: Nkx3.2（Bapx1）在內皮細胞中作為 GATA5 的轉錄抑制因子。由於 SIRT6 沉默 Nkx3.2，GATA5 被解除抑制，內皮損傷得以避免——顯示發育相關的同源域轉錄因子也被納入成人血管維持的 SIRT6 網絡。

links.context: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis is quantified by subtracting Resting Metabolic Rate, Thermic Effect of Food, and deliberate-exercise costs from total daily energy expenditure measured with Doubly-Labelled Water, often combined with accelerometry or respiratory chambers.
links.context_zh_TW: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis 的量化方式，是從以 Doubly-Labelled Water 測得的每日總能量消耗中，扣除 Resting Metabolic Rate、Thermic Effect of Food 與刻意運動消耗，並常搭配加速度計或呼吸室量測。

links.context: Non-enzymatic peroxidation of arachidonic acid yields 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha, the gold-standard oxidative stress biomarker. Isoprostane formation marks membrane peroxidation burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 花生四烯酸的非酶促過氧化產生 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha，即黃金標準 oxidative stress 生物標記。異前列腺素形成標記膜過氧化負荷。

links.context: None of the methylene blue-related compounds (methylene blue, toluidine blue O, phenothiazine, 2-chlorophenothiazine, chlorpromazine, promethazine, neutral red) protected HT-22 cells from the glucose oxidase H2O2 insult, whereas pyruvate as a positive antioxidant control did. This establishes that methylene blue neuroprotection is not classical chain-breaking antioxidant activity but operates upstream on mitochondrial electron flow.
links.context_zh_TW: 所有 methylene blue 相關化合物（methylene blue、toluidine blue O、phenothiazine、2-chlorophenothiazine、chlorpromazine、promethazine、neutral red）都無法保護 HT-22 細胞免受 glucose oxidase 所產生的 H2O2 傷害，而作為抗氧化陽性對照的 pyruvate 則可以。這確立了 methylene blue 的神經保護並非典型的鏈斷式抗氧化作用，而是作用於粒線體電子傳遞的上游。

links.context: Not all benign growth is protective: loss of TSC1/TSC2 causes tuberous sclerosis, a disorder marked by numerous benign hamartomas driven by mTORC1 hyperactivation. Here the benign growth itself is the disease, with no anti-cancer benefit.
links.context_zh_TW: 並非所有良性生長都有保護作用：TSC1/TSC2 喪失會造成結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis），其特徵為大量由 mTORC1 過度活化驅動的良性 hamartoma。此時良性生長本身就是疾病，並無抗癌效益。

links.context: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
links.context_zh_TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

links.context: Notch signalling restrains inflammasome-dependent IL-1beta production. In the SASP-induction scheme the released Notch1 intracellular domain (N1ICD) is drawn as a cytoplasmic inhibitor of the inflammasome, in addition to its nuclear role with MAML1. The consequence is that loss of NOTCH1 signalling de-represses IL-1beta maturation, and because IL-1beta is itself a potent SASP amplifier, Notch acts as a brake whose removal increases the inflammatory output of senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Notch 訊號抑制依賴發炎體的 IL-1beta 產生。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，受切割釋出的 Notch1 胞內結構域（N1ICD）除了與 MAML1 的細胞核角色外，也被畫為發炎體的細胞質抑制者。結果是 NOTCH1 訊號喪失會解除對 IL-1beta 成熟的抑制，而由於 IL-1beta 本身是強效的 SASP 放大器，Notch 因而扮演煞車角色，其移除會提高衰老細胞的發炎輸出。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: Nucleosome carries Histone Modification marks on its histone tails — acetylation, methylation and related chemical tags — which serve as signals read by cellular machinery to activate or repress gene expression. Because the octamer inside each nucleosome can be modified at multiple residues, nucleosome-centred histone marks constitute a primary layer of epigenetic regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 核小體（Nucleosome）的組蛋白尾部帶有組蛋白修飾（Histone Modification）標記——乙醯化、甲基化等——作為細胞機制讀取的訊號，用以活化或抑制基因表現。由於每個核小體的核心八聚體可在多個殘基被修飾，以核小體為中心的組蛋白標記構成了表觀遺傳調控的主要層次。

links.context: O-GlcNAcylation of Tau Protein is reduced in Alzheimer's Disease brain, with reciprocal phosphorylation at adjacent sites increased, promoting neurofibrillary tangle formation and tau pathology. SIRT1 reduces tau O-GlcNAcylation by regulating OGT, and total tau O-GlcNAcylation modulates its aggregation propensity (Lu et al., 2020), making O-GlcNAc cycling a metabolic handle on tauopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默病（Alzheimer's Disease）腦中，Tau Protein 的 O-GlcNA 醣基化（O-GlcNAcylation）減少，而相鄰位點的磷酸化增加，促進神經纖維纏結形成與 tau 病變。SIRT1 透過調控 OGT 降低 tau 的 O-GlcNAcylation，而 tau 的總 O-GlcNAcylation 量可調節其聚集傾向（Lu 等人，2020），使 O-GlcNAc 循環成為處理 tau 病變的代謝著力點。

links.context: O-GlcNAcylation of the hepatic transcription factor HNF4α shapes its conformational state and interaction with coactivators/corepressors, influencing transcriptional output of metabolic programmes such as gluconeogenesis and lipid handling. Because O-GlcNAcylation of metabolic regulators responds to diet via the hexosamine biosynthesis pathway, it acts as a molecular bridge between nutrition and gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: 肝臟轉錄因子 HNF4α 的 O-GlcNA 醣基化（O-GlcNAcylation）會改變其構形狀態與輔激活／輔抑制因子的交互作用，影響糖新生與脂質處理等代謝程式的轉錄輸出。由於代謝調節蛋白的 O-GlcNAcylation 會透過己糖胺生合成路徑對飲食作出反應，它可作為營養與基因表現之間的分子橋樑。

links.context: OIS arrests via the p53/p21 axis; p53 loss is the canonical bypass to malignancy in the OIS-p53-cancer path. Requirement, not mere association.
links.context_zh_TW: OIS 經由 p53/p21 軸停滯；p53 缺失是 OIS-p53-癌症路徑中典型的惡性繞行。是必要性而非單純關聯。

links.context: OIS cells in benign/premalignant lesions are vulnerable to Navitoclax-class senolytics. Eliminating them may paradoxically promote tumor growth by removing a cell-autonomous cancer barrier — the senolytic paradox — so retaining certain benign tumors is functionally protective against cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: 良性／癌前病灶中的 OIS 細胞易受 Navitoclax 類去衰老藥物攻擊。清除它們可能矛盾地透過移除細胞自主的癌症屏障而促進腫瘤生長——即去衰老悖論——因此保留某些良性腫瘤在功能上對抗癌症具保護性。

links.context: OMA1 is a conserved zinc-dependent metalloprotease anchored in the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane. This localization places it at the intersection of mitochondrial dynamics, quality control and cell-death priming, and it helps execute UPRmt-associated remodeling in neurodegeneration and metabolic disease where mitochondrial turnover is perturbed.
links.context_zh_TW: OMA1 是錨定於粒線體內膜（Inner Mitochondrial Membrane）的保守鋅依賴金屬蛋白酶。此定位使它位於粒線體動態、品質管制與細胞死亡啟動的交會處，並協助執行 UPRmt 相關的重塑；在粒線體周轉受擾的神經退化與代謝疾病中尤其重要。

links.context: OPA1 is the mammalian ortholog of the yeast protein Mgm1, a dynamin-related GTPase whose fusion activity requires cardiolipin in both systems. Conservation of the Mgm1/OPA1 architecture makes yeast a standard model for dissecting OPA1 processing, the L/S ratio and cardiolipin-dependent fusion mechanics.
links.context_zh_TW: OPA1 是酵母蛋白 Mgm1 的哺乳類同源物；兩者都是類 dynamin 的 GTPase，其融合活性皆需要心磷脂。Mgm1/OPA1 架構的高度保守性，使酵母成為研究 OPA1 加工、L/S 比例與心磷脂依賴性融合機制的標準模型。

links.context: OSKM expression resets somatic epigenomes to pluripotency. Reset records the rejuvenation-direction edge.
links.context_zh_TW: OSKM 表現將體細胞表觀基因組重置為多能性。重置記錄回春方向的邊。

links.context: OX2R expression is concentrated in the Hypothalamus, specifically the dorsomedial and lateral nuclei (DMH/LH) where the BRASTO lifespan phenotype originates, and in the tuberomammillary nucleus. Mice on a calorie-restricted diet show the same hypothalamic SIRT1/OX2R signature, so OX2R marks a hypothalamic hub through which sirtuin activity and calorie restriction converge on activity, thermoregulation and muscle mitochondrial phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: OX2R 的表現集中於下視丘（Hypothalamus），具體位於產生 BRASTO 壽命表型的背內側核與外側核（DMH/LH），以及乳頭核。熱量限制飲食的小鼠也呈現相同的下視丘 SIRT1/OX2R 訊號，因此 OX2R 標記出一個下視丘樞紐，sirtuin 活性與熱量限制皆經由它匯聚到活動量、體溫調節與肌肉粒線體表型。

links.context: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 3 (OCA3), also called rufous or red albinism, is due to mutations in TYRP1 (9p23) encoding Tyrosinase-related protein-1. This melanosomal enzyme is involved in eumelanin synthesis. It is most common in individuals of African or Puerto Rican descent.
links.context_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 3 型（OCA3），也稱為紅褐色或紅色白化症，由編碼 Tyrosinase-related protein-1 的 TYRP1（9p23）突變引起。這種 melanosomal 酶參與 eumelanin 合成。它在非洲或波多黎各裔人群中最常見。

links.context: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 6 (OCA6) results from mutations in DCT (13q32.2), encoding Dopachrome tautomerase (TYRP2). This melanosomal enzyme is involved in melanin synthesis. Defects in DCT produce hypopigmentation within the OCA spectrum.
links.context_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 6 型（OCA6）由 DCT（13q32.2）突變引起，該基因編碼 Dopachrome tautomerase（TYRP2）。這種 melanosomal 酶參與黑色素合成。DCT 的缺陷會在 OCA 譜系內產生色素減退。

links.context: On ligand binding, BMP receptors phosphorylate receptor-regulated SMAD1/5/8, which complex with SMAD4 and translocate to the nucleus to regulate transcription — the canonical BMP pathway; BMP also signals non-canonically through MAPK (p38, ERK) and is antagonized extracellularly by noggin, chordin and gremlin.
links.context_zh_TW: 配體結合後，BMP 受體會磷酸化受體調節型 SMAD1/5/8，後者與 SMAD4 形成複合體並轉位入核調控轉錄，即典型 BMP 途徑；BMP 亦透過 MAPK（p38、ERK）進行非典型訊號傳遞，並受 noggin、chordin 與 gremlin 在細胞外拮抗。

links.context: Once iron-loaded transferrin is endocytosed, STEAP3 reduces endosomal Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺, after which DMT1 exports the ferrous iron into the cytosol labile iron pool. Ceruloplasmin performs the complementary extracellular oxidation of Fe²⁺ to the TF-bindable Fe³⁺, closing the cycle of transferrin-mediated iron uptake.
links.context_zh_TW: 載鐵 transferrin 被胞吞後，STEAP3 在內體中將 Fe³⁺ 還原為 Fe²⁺，隨後 DMT1 將亞鐵離子輸出至細胞質的 labile iron pool。Ceruloplasmin 則在細胞外執行互補的 Fe²⁺ 氧化為可與 TF 結合的 Fe³⁺，完成 transferrin 介導鐵攝入的循環。

links.context: One form of cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome arises from mutations in arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), the enzyme that catalyzes the first committed step of creatine synthesis, producing guanidinoacetate. The resulting cerebral creatine and phosphocreatine depletion produces intellectual disability, speech delay, epilepsy, and myopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 腦型 creatine 缺乏症候群的一種形式源自 arginine:glycine amidinotransferase（AGAT）突變，該酵素催化 creatine 合成第一個committed步驟以產生 guanidinoacetate。由此造成的腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 缺乏會導致智能障礙、語言延遲、epilepsy 與肌病變。

links.context: One of the mechanisms by which Advanced Glycation End Products impair wound healing is the reduction of nitric oxide activity. Loss of NO-mediated vasodilation limits blood flow to injured tissue and contributes to the vascular modification component of the AGE phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced Glycation End Products 損害傷口癒合的機制之一，是降低一氧化氮活性。NO 介導的血管擴張作用喪失會限制受傷組織的血流，並構成 AGE 表型中血管修飾的一部分。

links.context: One of the three platforms where the rheostat reads out is the ripoptosome, a death-receptor-independent 2 MDa RIPK1-FADD-caspase-8-c-FLIP assembly that forms spontaneously when cIAPs are depleted (genotoxic stress, Smac mimetics). Caspase-8/FLIP_L disassembles it via RIPK1 cleavage while c-FLIP_S stabilizes it and diverts to necroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 棘輪讀取的三個平台之一是 ripoptosome：在 cIAP 被耗竭（基因毒壓力、Smac 擬態劑）時自發形成的、與死亡受體無關的 2 MDa RIPK1-FADD-caspase-8-c-FLIP 組裝體。Caspase-8／FLIP_L 藉由切割 RIPK1 將其拆解，而 c-FLIP_S 則穩定它並使細胞轉向 necroptosis。

links.context: One-Carbon Metabolism requires Folate, whose reduced form tetrahydrofolate is the cofactor that carries single-carbon units (formyl, methenyl, methylene, methyl, formimino) between metabolites. Because folate deficiency truncates the pathway, the network is a direct interface between diet, nucleotide biosynthesis, epigenetic methylation and redox balance, and folate deficiency is linked to neural tube defects.
links.context_zh_TW: 一碳代謝（One-Carbon Metabolism）需要 Folate（葉酸），其還原型四氫葉酸是攜帶單碳單位（甲醯、甲烯基、亞甲基、甲基、甲醯胺基）於代謝物之間轉移的輔因子。由於葉酸缺乏會使此途徑受阻，此代謝網是飲食、核苷酸生合成、表觀遺傳甲基化與氧化還原平衡之間的直接介面，而葉酸缺乏與神經管缺陷相關。

links.context: One-Carbon Metabolism uses tetrahydrofolate as the central one-carbon carrier to regenerate Methionine from Homocysteine, feeding the SAM-dependent methylation of DNA, RNA, histones and lipids. Because SAM supply depends on this cycle, one-carbon flux sets the methylation capacity of the epigenome and the SAM/SAH ratio, and the Homocysteine it produces links the network to cardiovascular and cognitive risk when clearance is impaired.
links.context_zh_TW: 一碳代謝（One-Carbon Metabolism）以四氫葉酸作為一碳載體，將同型半胱氨酸（Homocysteine）再生成為蛋胺酸（MetMethionine），供應 DNA、RNA、組蛋白與脂質的 SAM 依賴性甲基化。由於 SAM 供應取決於此循環，一碳通量決定了表觀基因體的甲基化能力與 SAM/SAH 比值，而其產生的 Homocysteine 在清除受損時也將此網路與心血管及認知風險相連。

links.context: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

links.context: Oral magnolol (10 mg/kg) with honokiol prevents age-related memory and learning deficits in SAMP8 mice by preserving cholinergic neurons and enhancing Akt activity. Magnolol with honokiol also significantly decreases amyloid-beta-induced neuronal death in PC12 cells, attributed to reduced reactive oxygen species, suppressed intracellular calcium and inhibited caspase-3.
links.context_zh_TW: 口服 magnolol（10 mg/kg）搭配 honokiol 可在 SAMP8 小鼠中預防與年齡相關的記憶與學習缺陷，方式是保留膽鹼能神經元並增強 Akt 活性。Magnolol 搭配 honokiol 也可顯著減少 PC12 細胞中 amyloid-beta 誘發的神經元死亡，其機制歸因於活性氧減少、細胞內 calcium 被抑制以及 caspase-3 被抑制。

links.context: Orally administered NMN is rapidly degraded in the gut by the enzyme CD38 (and by intestinal alkaline phosphatase), which is why oral bioavailability is low. Strategies that raise effective NMN exposure include enteric-coated formulations, liposomal encapsulation and co-administration with CD38 inhibitors, all of which preserve the precursor long enough to enter the NAD+ pool.
links.context_zh_TW: 口服 NMN 會在腸道中被酵素 CD38（以及腸道鹼性磷酸酶）迅速降解，因此口服生體可用性偏低。提高 NMN 有效暴露量的策略包括腸衣製劑、脂雙層包封，以及與 CD38 抑制劑併用，這些方法都能讓前驅物存活夠久以進入 NAD+ 庫。

links.context: Orlistat, a lipase inhibitor, reduced serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal in 21 women with polycystic ovary disease compared with 15 women without PCOS, by decreasing AGE absorption. A six-month study evaluating the effect of calorie restriction and orlistat found serum AGE reductions in both PCOS and obese groups, independent of changes in body mass index. By interfering with lipid absorption, orlistat also reduces the absorption of fat-associated dietary AGEs, since foods rich in protein and fat have the highest AGE content. Orlistat therefore illustrates how modulating intestinal absorption can lower postprandial glycation load.
links.context_zh_TW: Orlistat 是一種脂解酶抑制劑（lipase inhibitor），在 21 名多囊性卵巢疾病女性與 15 名無 PCOS 女性相比，於高 AGE 餐後降低了血清 AGE，方式是減少 AGE 吸收。一項評估熱量限制與 orlistat 效果為期六個月的研究發現，PCOS 與肥胖組的血清 AGE 均下降，且獨立於身體質量指數的變化。透過干擾脂質吸收，orlistat 也減少與脂肪相關的飲食性 AGE 吸收，因為富含蛋白質與脂肪的食物 AGE 含量最高。因此，orlistat 說明了調節腸道吸收如何能降低餐後糖化負載。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Orlistat, derived from Streptomyces toxytricini, is the prototypical lipase inhibitor: an irreversible inhibitor of gastric and pancreatic lipase used for weight management. Its mechanism extends beyond caloric restriction, since blocking fat digestion also reduces uptake of dietary advanced glycation end products; chronic use nonetheless requires fat-soluble vitamin monitoring because of malabsorption.
links.context_zh_TW: Orlistat 源自 Streptomyces toxytricini，是脂肪酶抑制劑的原型：不可逆地抑制胃與胰臟脂肪酶，用於體重管理。其機轉不侷限於熱量限制，因為阻斷脂肪消化也會減少飲食性 advanced glycation end products 的攝取；但長期使用仍須監測脂溶性維生素以防吸收不良。

links.context: Osteoarthritis is treated by senolytics in clinical trials (e.g., NCT04210986) aimed at reducing joint pain and improving function by clearing senescent chondrocytes and synovial cells that accumulate in degenerating joints. Preclinical studies show senolytics alleviate osteoarthritis pathology and improve cartilage integrity by reducing SASP-driven cartilage degradation and inflammation. Because senescent cells in joint tissue secrete proteases and inflammatory cytokines that erode cartilage, their elimination is considered a leading musculoskeletal application of senolytic therapy. Results have been promising enough to support continued clinical investigation in osteoarthritis.
links.context_zh_TW: 骨關節炎在臨床試驗中被 senolytics 治療（如 NCT04210986），旨在透過清除退化關節中累積的衰老軟骨細胞與滑膜細胞減輕關節疼痛並改善功能。臨床前研究顯示 senolytics 減輕骨關節炎病理並透過減少 SASP 驅動的軟骨降解與發炎改善軟骨完整性。由於關節組織中衰老細胞分泌侵蝕軟骨的蛋白酶與發炎細胞激素，其消除被視為 senolytic 療法領先的肌肉骨骼應用。結果已足夠前景以支持骨關節炎的持續臨床研究。

links.context: Ovarian cancer is characterized by late presentation with widespread peritoneal metastasis, which defines advanced disease. Peritoneal spread and acquired resistance to platinum-taxane chemotherapy drive poor long-term survival. Metastasis is therefore central to ovarian cancer lethality.
links.context_zh_TW: 卵巢癌以晚期表現並伴有廣泛腹膜轉移為特徵，這定義了晚期疾病。腹膜擴散與對鉑類–紫杉烷化療的後天抗性導致長期存活率不佳。因此轉移對卵巢癌的致死性至關重要。

links.context: Over-expression of Acid ceramidase in senescent cells breaks down Ceramide, releasing free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids. These liberated fatty acids enter the Lands cycle and are exchanged into the sn-2 position of membrane Phospholipid, the mechanistic link between ceramide catabolism and the ferroptosis-prone membrane lipid profile.
links.context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞中 Acid ceramidase 過度表現會分解 Ceramide，釋出游離的飽和脂肪酸（SFA）與單不飽和脂肪酸（MUFA）。這些被釋出的脂肪酸進入 Lands cycle 並被交換進膜上 Phospholipid 的 sn-2 位置，構成 ceramide 分解代謝與促 Ferroptosis 膜脂譜之間的機制連結。

links.context: Over-expression of Acid ceramidase in senescent cells raises the sphingosine pool, and sphingosine kinases phosphorylate that pool into Sphingosine-1-phosphate. The resulting rise in Sphingosine-1-phosphate supports senescent-cell survival and blocks apoptosis, even though the same Acid ceramidase activity simultaneously creates a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile by releasing free fatty acids for membrane phospholipid PUFA enrichment.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent cells 中過量表現 Acid ceramidase 會提高 sphingosine 池，而 sphingosine kinase 將該池磷酸化為 Sphingosine-1-phosphate。Sphingosine-1-phosphate 隨之上升，支撐 senescent cell 存活並阻斷 apoptosis；然而同一 Acid ceramidase 活性也會釋出游離脂肪酸供膜上 phospholipid 的 PUFA 富集，同時製造出促 ferroptosis 的脂質輪廓。

links.context: Overexpression of SLC25A51 promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression by driving aerobic glycolysis through SIRT5 activation (Bai et al., Free Radic Biol Med 2022): the same NAD+ supply that protects normal liver from respiratory decline can be co-opted for tumor metabolic plasticity. Because SLC25A51 controls the mitochondrial NAD+ fraction specifically, modulating import offers a compartment-targeted alternative to systemic NAD+ repletion by precursors such as nicotinamide riboside or NMN.
links.context_zh_TW: SLC25A51 過量表現會透過活化 SIRT5 驅動有氧糖解，促進肝細胞癌進展（Bai et al., Free Radic Biol Med 2022）：原本保護正常肝臟免於呼吸功能衰退的 NAD+ 供應，可被癌細胞挪用以獲得腫瘤代謝可塑性。由於 SLC25A51 專一調控粒線體的 NAD+ 分量，調整其輸入可作為相對於菸鹼醯胺核糖或 NMN 等前驅物全身性 NAD+ 補充的區室導向替代方案。

links.context: Overexpression or amplification of Aurora-A/Aurora-B is a hallmark of many solid tumors and predicts poor prognosis in breast, lung and pancreatic cancers; excess Aurora mitotic regulator activity in the setting of SIRT2 loss drives Aneuploidy and mitotic catastrophe.
links.context_zh_TW: Aurora-A／Aurora-B 的過度表現或擴增是許多實體腫瘤的特徵，並預測乳癌、肺癌與胰臟癌的不良預後；在 SIRT2 喪失的情境下，過量的 Aurora 有絲分裂調節因子活性會驅動 Aneuploidy 與有絲分裂災難。

links.context: Oxidative lesions engage the ATM/ATR-CHK-p53-p21 cascade in SIPS. This signaling leg is shared with genotoxic senescence programs.
links.context_zh_TW: 氧化損傷在 SIPS 接合 ATM/ATR-CHK-p53-p21 級聯。此訊號分支與基因毒性衰老程序共享。

links.context: P66shc inhibits the activity of the FOXO3a transcription factor, blunting a key stress-resistance and antioxidant program. Directionally, P66shc suppresses FOXO3a output. Because SIRT1 represses P66shc, sirtuin activity indirectly unleashes FOXO3a-dependent defense pathways.
links.context_zh_TW: P66shc 抑制 FOXO3a 轉錄因子的活性，削弱了關鍵的抗壓力和抗氧化程序。方向性上 P66shc 抑制 FOXO3a 的輸出。由於 SIRT1 抑制 P66shc，sirtuin 活性間接釋放了 FOXO3a 依賴的防禦途徑。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: PAK1 facilitates NF-kB nuclear activation; ivermectin's PAK1 degradation therefore dampens NF-kB signaling. Because NF-kB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, this overlaps with the senomorphic strategy — targeting SASP production without killing senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK1 促進 NF-kB 核活化；ivermectin 的 PAK1 降解因此減弱 NF-kB 訊號。由於 NF-kB 是 SASP 的主控轉錄調節因子，這與 senomorphic 策略——標靶 SASP 產生而不殺死衰老細胞——重疊。

links.context: PANoptosis simultaneously engages apoptosis, pyroptosis, and necroptosis machinery through PANoptosome complexes assembled on ZBP1, AIM2, RIPK1, NLRP12, or NLRP3 sensors. Crucially it persists when individual pathway molecules are deleted, which is why it is now argued to be a distinct pathway rather than simple crosstalk. This persistence also destroys any attempt to assign a per-modality percentage, since a single death event activates three modalities at once.
links.context_zh_TW: PANoptosis 透過組裝於 ZBP1、AIM2、RIPK1、NLRP12 或 NLRP3 感測器上的 PANoptosome 複合體，同時啟動 apoptosis、pyroptosis 與 necroptosis 的機制。關鍵在於，當個別路徑分子被刪除時它依然持續存在，因此如今論證它是獨立路徑而非單純的交互作用。這種持續性也使任何「按 modality 分配百分比」的嘗試失效，因為單一死亡事件會同時啟動三種 modality。

links.context: PARG is a dose-dependent hinge for parthanatos execution. Full pharmacological PARG inhibition prevents MNNG-induced death as effectively as a PARP inhibitor, while 1-3 uM residual activity still allows killing, and full blockade prevents ATP depletion without preventing NAD+ depletion, formally uncoupling the two readouts. A newly described PARG53 splice isoform explains why exon-3/7 knockout clones retaining activity still die.
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 是 parthanatos 執行的劑量依賴性樞紐。完全的 PARG 藥理抑制可像 PARP 抑制劑一樣阻止 MNNG 誘發的細胞死亡，但殘留 1–3 uM 活性仍會致死；完全阻斷可防止 ATP 耗竭卻無法阻止 NAD+ 耗竭，兩者因此被正式拆解為彼此獨立的讀值。新發現的 PARG53 剪接異型則解釋了為何仍保有活性的 exon-3/7 敲除株依然會死亡。

links.context: PARG is the bulk poly-ADP-ribose glycohydrolase that removes PAR chains, and MacroD1 acts only on the mono-ADP-ribose residues left after chain removal. This division of labour means MacroD1 cannot substitute for PARG: poly(ADP-ribose) polymers, in which MacroD1 is inactive, are handled upstream by PARG and ARH3.
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 是移除 PAR 鏈的聚合物ADP-核糖糖苷水解酶，而 MacroD1 只作用於鏈被移除後留下的單一 ADP-核糖殘基。這種分工表示 MacroD1 無法取代 PARG：MacroD1 對其無活性的 poly(ADP-ribose) 聚合物，是由上游的 PARG 與 ARH3 處理。

links.context: PARK7 (DJ-1) functions as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase that detoxifies free methylglyoxal and glyoxal directly into L-lactate and glycolic acid, thereby preventing these reactive dicarbonyl species from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. Because dicarbonyls are generated continuously during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, PARK7 activity helps keep AGE formation in check. Mutations or loss of PARK7 lead to significant tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs. PARK7 therefore complements the glyoxalase system as a second line of defense against endogenous glycation.
links.context_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）作為一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶，將游離甲基乙二醛與乙二醛直接解毒為 L-乳酸與乙醇酸，從而防止這些反應性二羰基物種在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。由於二羰基物在糖解與脂質過氧化過程中持續生成，PARK7 活性有助於控制 AGE 形成。PARK7 的突變或缺失會導致顯著的組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積。因此，PARK7 補充乙二醛酶系統，作為對抗內生性糖化的第二道防線。

links.context: PARK7 (DJ-1), historically characterized as a protein deglycase, is now understood from biochemical evidence to function primarily as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase. It stereospecifically detoxifies free methylglyoxal and glyoxal directly into L-lactate and glycolic acid, preventing these reactive species from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. Mutations or loss of PARK7 lead to significant tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs. PARK7 therefore provides a second, glutathione-independent layer of protection against dicarbonyl stress in addition to the classical glyoxalase system.
links.context_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）歷來被表徵為一種蛋白質去糖化酶（protein deglycase），但現在根據生化證據被理解為主要作為一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶。它立體特異性地將游離甲基乙二醛與乙二醛直接解毒為 L-乳酸（L-lactate）與乙醇酸（glycolic acid），防止這些反應性物種在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。PARK7 的突變或缺失會導致顯著的組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積。因此，PARK7 除了經典的乙二醛酶系統外，提供了第二層不依賴麩胱甘肽的二羰基壓力保護。

links.context: PARL cleaves PINK1 after import, working with Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase to gate the PINK1 import-and-degrade pathway; when membrane potential is lost, import fails and PINK1 accumulates on the outer membrane to recruit Parkin.
links.context_zh_TW: PARL 在 PINK1 輸入後將其切割，與 Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase 共同把關 PINK1 的輸入與降解途徑；當膜電位喪失時輸入受阻，PINK1 便累積於外膜並招募 Parkin。

links.context: PARP inhibitors prevent PAR accumulation and H2O2-induced death in ARH3-deficient cells, and are proposed as therapy for ARH3-dependent neurodegeneration; ARH3 inhibition is conversely explored to potentiate PARG inhibitors against short PAR oligomers.
links.context_zh_TW: PARP 抑制劑可阻止 ARH3 缺陷細胞的 PAR 堆積與 H2O2 誘發死亡，被提議用於 ARH3 相關神經退化的治療；反之，抑制 ARH3 被探索用於增強 PARG 抑制劑對短 PAR 寡聚體的效果。

links.context: PARP-1 is the male-preferred death effector: XY cells die via PARP-1/AIF-dependent necrosis rather than caspases. PARP-1 knockout protects males from ischemic brain injury but exacerbates damage in females, and loss of PARP-1 abrogates estradiol's neuroprotective potential — the mirror image of the XX-caspase arm.
links.context_zh_TW: PARP-1 是男性偏好的死亡效應因子：XY 細胞經 PARP-1/AIF 依賴的壞死而非 caspases 死亡。PARP-1 基因剔除保護雄性免於缺血性腦損傷，但在雌性卻加重損傷，且失去 PARP-1 會取消雌二醇的神經保護潛能——此為 XX-caspase 分支的鏡像。

links.context: PARP-1 overactivation depletes NAD+: in the male (XY) death arm, PARP-1 hyperactivation consumes NAD+ leading to energetic collapse and AIF-mediated necrosis; male skin shows PARP activity that increases with age (inversely correlated with NAD+, r=-0.639), whereas female skin does not. Estrogen stabilizes PARP-1 on DNA, sparing NAD+ in females.
links.context_zh_TW: PARP-1 過度活化會耗竭 NAD+：在男性（XY）死亡分支中，PARP-1 過度活化消耗 NAD+ 導致能量崩潰與 AIF 媒介壞死；男性皮膚的 PARP 活性隨年齡增加（與 NAD+ 負相關，r=-0.639），女性皮膚則否。雌激素使 PARP-1 穩定結合於 DNA，為女性節省 NAD+。

links.context: PARP1 inhibition is male-leaning in stroke, because PARP-1 knockout males infarct far less than wild type while ovariectomized females are worsened and caspase inhibition protects females only. The only PARP inhibitor to reach the clinic, amelparib, has been tested in unstratified stroke populations and stalled, so the actionable change is trial design stratifying by sex and hormone status using PAR or nuclear AIF versus cleaved caspase-3/-8 as readouts.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Stroke 中，PARP1 抑制的效果偏向雄性，因為 PARP-1 敲除雄性的梗死遠小於野生型，而卵巢切除的雌性反而惡化，且 caspase 抑制只保護雌性。唯一進入臨床的 PARP 抑制劑 amelparib 曾在未分層的 Stroke 族群中試驗並停滯，因此真正可採取的改變是試驗設計：以性別與荷爾蒙狀態分層，並以 PAR 或核內 AIF 對比切割型 caspase-3／-8 作為讀值。

links.context: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
links.context_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: PEX14 acts as a signaling scaffold at the peroxisomal surface, interacting with AMPK and mTORC1 to couple peroxisomal metabolism to nutrient-sensing pathways.
links.context_zh_TW: PEX14 在過氧化體表面作為訊號支架，與 AMPK 及 mTORC1 交互作用，將過氧化體代謝與營養感知路徑耦合。

links.context: PEX14 translocates to the nucleus under certain conditions and interacts with the transcription factor TFEB, linking peroxisome biogenesis to lysosomal and peroxisomal gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: 在某些條件下 PEX14 會轉位至細胞核並與轉錄因子 TFEB 交互作用，將過氧化體生成與溶小體、過氧化體基因表現連結起來。

links.context: PGAM1 converts 3-phosphoglycerate to 2-phosphoglycerate in glycolysis and regulates the pentose phosphate pathway by controlling 3-phosphoglycerate levels, a key inhibitor of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase. SIRT2-dependent PGAM1 activation therefore favours NADPH and ribose production that support proliferation.
links.context_zh_TW: PGAM1 在糖解作用中將 3-磷酸甘油酸轉為 2-磷酸甘油酸，並藉由調控 3-磷酸甘油酸（葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶的關鍵抑制劑）水平來調節磷酸戊糖途徑。因此 SIRT2 依賴的 PGAM1 活化有利於支持細胞增生的 NADPH 與核糖生成。

links.context: PGAM5 activates the GTP-binding fission protein Drp1, which translocates to mitochondria to drive the fission that both segregates damaged mitochondria for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy and, under severe RIPK3 activation, contributes to necroptotic mitochondrial rupture. The RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 route is thus a shared conduit: mild damage routes it to mitophagy, severe damage to necroptosis. Some studies contest the importance of PGAM5 in Drp1 activation, so the exact mechanism remains under investigation.
links.context_zh_TW: PGAM5 會活化 GTP 結合的分裂蛋白 Drp1，使其轉位至粒線體驅動分裂——此過程既能隔離受損粒線體供 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬之用，在強烈 RIPK3 活化下也促成程序性壞死的粒線體破裂。RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 路徑因此是共享通道：輕度損傷導向粒線體自噬，嚴重損傷導向程序性壞死。部分研究質疑 PGAM5 在 Drp1 活化中的重要性，其確切機制仍在研究中。

links.context: PINK1 mediates phosphorylation reactions on dysfunctional mitochondria that activate the E3 ligase Parkin, which then ubiquitinates mitochondrial membrane proteins for autophagic removal. Loss of PINK1 produces a selective mitochondrial defect in complexes I and II in the striatum, and its functions in mitophagy and in the interferon-gamma-inducible knockout phenotype position it as a mitophagy gatekeeper.
links.context_zh_TW: PINK1 在功能失常的粒線體上媒介磷酸化反應，活化 E3 泛素連接酶 Parkin，後者再泛素化粒線體膜蛋白以利自噬移除。PINK1 缺失會在紋狀體造成選擇性粒線體缺陷（複合體 I 與 II），而它在 mitophagy 中的功能及其在干擾素 γ 可誘導型敲除表型中的作用，使它被定位為 mitophagy 的守門者。

links.context: PLK1 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62 together with CDK1/JNK2.
links.context_zh_TW: PLK1 與 CDK1/JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL。

links.context: PP1 opposes CaMKII by dephosphorylating caspase-2 at Ser164.
links.context_zh_TW: PP1 在 Ser164 去磷酸化 caspase-2，對抗 CaMKII。

links.context: PP2A is modeled as the main phosphatase counteracting mTORC1, dephosphorylating and opposing the mTORC1-driven activation of S6K1/2 in the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: PP2A 被視為對抗 mTORC1 的主要磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並對抗 mTORC1 驅動的 S6K1/2 活化，位於rapamycin hormesis 背後的不一致雙價 motif 中。

links.context: PPAR-alpha is the master regulator of lipid beta-oxidation metabolism. Regulation is the lipid-program control.
links.context_zh_TW: PPAR-alpha 是脂質 β 氧化代謝的主調控者。調節是脂質程序控制。

links.context: PPARα cooperates with SIRT1 and AMPK to coordinate metabolic adaptation during fasting, linking energy status to the fasting-induced upregulation of fatty acid oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: PPARα 與 SIRT1 及 AMPK 協同，在禁食期間協調代謝適應，將能量狀態與禁食誘導的脂肪酸氧化上調連結起來。

links.context: PPARγ is a transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism, among other processes. Urolithin A increases PPARγ expression and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. PPARγ signaling thus contributes to the metabolic regulatory effects attributed to urolithin A, complementing its activation of the AMPK pathway in supporting muscle energy metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: PPARγ 是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝等過程的轉錄因子。Urolithin A 提升 PPARγ 表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。因此，PPARγ 訊號有助於歸因於 urolithin A 的代謝調節效應，補足其對 AMPK 路徑的活化以支援肌肉能量代謝。
links.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

links.context: PROTAC technology has been proposed as an emerging strategy to degrade cGAS therapeutically, durably dampening cGAS-STING signalling rather than merely blocking enzymatic activity.
links.context_zh_TW: PROTAC 技術被提出作為新興策略，以治療性降解 cGAS，進而持久抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號，而非僅僅阻斷酵素活性。

links.context: PVP acts as a complexing agent that keeps lipophilic compounds such as fisetin in an amorphous dispersed state, preventing precipitation and overcoming their poor aqueous solubility.
links.context_zh_TW: PVP 扮演錯合劑，將 fisetin 等親脂性化合物維持在非晶分散狀態，防止析出並克服其不良的水溶性。

links.context: Paclitaxel is a listed systemic indication for breast cancer beyond ovarian use.
links.context_zh_TW: paclitaxel 是乳癌列載的全身性適應症，超出卵巢用途。

links.context: Paclitaxel is a taxane used in the platinum/taxane first-line chemotherapy for ovarian cancer. Ivermectin enhances the efficacy of paclitaxel in ovarian cancer models. Paclitaxel is therefore central to ovarian cancer treatment.
links.context_zh_TW: Paclitaxel 是用於卵巢癌鉑類/紫杉烷一線化療的紫杉烷類藥物。Ivermectin 在卵巢癌模型中增強 paclitaxel 的療效。因此 Paclitaxel 對卵巢癌治療至關重要。

links.context: Pancreatic iron deposition is the endocrine lesion behind the classical 'bronze diabetes' of hereditary hemochromatosis, together with skin hyperpigmentation and hypogonadism; all three are late-disease findings. Earlier and more common presentations are fatigue, arthralgia of the 2nd and 3rd metacarpophalangeal joints, and elevated ALT. Because iron is deposited in islets as well as liver, glucose handling degrades alongside hepatic architecture, which is why the endocrine phenotype is inseparable from the hepatic one.
links.context_zh_TW: 胰臟的鐵沉積是遺傳性血鐵質沉著症「 bronzed diabetes（bronze diabetes）」的內分泌病灶，與皮膚色素沉著、性腺功能低下並列，但三者皆屬晚期表現。更早且更常見的表現為疲勞、第 2 與第 3 掌指關節的關節痛，以及 ALT 升高。由於鐵同時沉積於胰島與肝臟，葡萄糖處理能力會隨肝臟結構退化而惡化，這也是為何內分泌表型與肝臟表型無法分離。

links.context: Paracrine Senescence explains how a senescent burden far below one percent of cells can produce organism-wide dysfunction and chronic Inflammaging. Injecting senescent preadipocytes or transplanting an old heart into a young recipient reproduces senescence markers, frailty and cognitive deficits at distant sites, and 2024 work adds bone-marrow macrophage-derived extracellular vesicles carrying miRNA that act on the PPARα axis in liver, muscle, fat and brain.
links.context_zh_TW: Paracrine Senescence 說明了為何不到百分之一的衰老細胞就能造成全身性功能失調與慢性 Inflammaging。注入衰老前脂肪細胞或把老心臟移植給年輕受體，都能在遠隔部位重現衰老標記、虛弱與認知缺損；2024 年的研究更指出，骨髓巨噬細胞釋出的細胞外囊泡可攜帶 miRNA，透過 PPARα 軸作用於肝臟、肌肉、脂肪與腦部。

links.context: Parkin is recruited by PINK1 to ubiquitinate depolarized mitochondria for autophagosomal engulfment in the canonical mitophagy axis. This complements the existing PINK1-initiates-Mitophagy triple with the effector arm.
links.context_zh_TW: Parkin 被 PINK1 招募以泛素化去極化粒線體，供自噬體包吞，構成典型 mitophagy 軸。此以效應臂補充既有的 PINK1 起始 Mitophagy triple。

links.context: Parthanatos can preclude apoptosis: prolonged NAD+/ATP depletion after severe DNA damage blocks apoptotic execution, whereas lower damage allows a transient dip and apoptosis; conversely apoptotic caspases cleave PARP1 to prevent parthanatos. Whether the crosstalk extends beyond mutual antagonism is an open question (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: Parthanatos 可排除 apoptosis：嚴重 DNA 損傷後持續的 NAD+/ATP 耗竭阻斷凋亡執行，而較輕損傷僅造成短暫下降並容許凋亡；反之凋亡 caspase 切割 PARP1 以阻止 parthanatos。此交互作用是否不僅止於相互拮抗仍是未解問題（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: Parthanatos, like Necrosis, Necroptosis and Pyroptosis, is a lytic death program that ruptures the plasma membrane and therefore stains Propidium Iodide positive; the Annexin V+/PI+ combination is the diagnostic signature used to separate it from non-lytic apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Parthanatos 與 Necrosis、Necroptosis、Pyroptosis 同屬會破壞細胞膜的裂解型死亡程序，因此呈 Propidium Iodide 陽性；Annexin V+/PI+ 的組合即是將其與非裂解型 apoptosis 區分的診斷特徵。

links.context: Pathological ECM over-deposition defines fibrotic scarring. Accumulation is the disease criterion.
links.context_zh_TW: 病理性 ECM 過度沉積定義纖維化疤痕。累積是疾病判準。

links.context: Pathological overactivation of the NMDA receptor produces excitotoxicity, the Ca2+-dependent neuronal death that underlies ischemic injury in stroke, traumatic brain injury and the seizure propagation of epilepsy. Antagonists such as memantine are therefore used in neurodegeneration, while honokiol represents a multitarget natural-product modulator with both antiseizure and neuroprotective profiles.
links.context_zh_TW: NMDA receptor 的病理性過度活化會造成 excitotoxicity，即依賴 Ca2+ 的神經元死亡，也是 stroke、traumatic brain injury 的缺血性損傷與 epilepsy 的 seizure 傳播之基礎。因此 memantine 等拮抗劑被用於神經退化疾病治療，而 Honokiol 則是兼具抗發作與神經保護的多標的天然產物調節劑。

links.context: Patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cells serve as the cell source.
links.context_zh_TW: 患者特異誘導多能幹細胞充當細胞來源。

links.context: Pazopanib is a multi-targeted tyrosine-kinase inhibitor that blocks VEGFR signaling (alongside PDGFR and c-KIT) and is used as antiangiogenic therapy. It is cited as the VEGFR-directed agent in fenbendazole cancer case-report contexts.
links.context_zh_TW: Pazopanib 是多標的酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，可阻斷 VEGFR 訊號（並同時作用於 PDGFR 與 c-KIT），用作抗血管新生治療。在 fenbendazole 癌症個案報告的脈絡中，它是所引用的 VEGFR 標的藥物。

links.context: Pediculosis carries a substantial infectious-disease burden because body lice transmit Rickettsia prowazekii (epidemic typhus), Bartonella quintana (trench fever) and Borrelia recurrentis (relapsing fever). These louse-borne diseases flourish under war, disaster, displacement and homelessness, making epidemic typhus a re-emerging threat.
links.context_zh_TW: Pediculosis 帶有相當的傳染病負擔，因為體蝨會傳播 Rickettsia prowazekii（流行性斑疹傷寒）、Bartonella quintana（戰壕熱）與 Borrelia recurrentis（回歸熱）。這些蝨媒疾病在戰爭、災害、流離失所與無家可歸情境下盛行，使流行性斑疹傷寒成為重新興起的威脅。

links.context: Pediculosis is driven by a hypersensitivity reaction to louse saliva, and the intense pruritus that follows causes persistent scratching, excoriations and secondary bacterial impetiginization with cervical or occipital lymphadenopathy. These lesions reflect local Inflammation around the feeding sites.
links.context_zh_TW: Pediculosis 由對蝨唾液的過敏反應驅動，隨後的劇烈搔癢造成持續抓破、擦傷與繼發性細菌膿皰病，並可伴隨頸部或枕部淋巴結腫大。這些病灶反映了叮咬處的局部 Inflammation。

links.context: Pentose phosphate pathway flux toward NADPH/G6P promotes SIRT1 activity toward 14-3-3-zeta; G6P supplementation in Xenopus egg extract enhanced 14-3-3-zeta-directed sirtuin activity and caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta binding. Declining PPP activity leads to 14-3-3-zeta acetylation, its release, and caspase-2 activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸戊糖途徑朝向 NADPH/G6P 的通量促進 SIRT1 對 14-3-3ζ 的活性；在非洲爪蟾卵提取物中補充 G6P 增強了針對 14-3-3ζ 的 sirtuin 活性以及 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合。PPP 活性下降導致 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化、其釋放和 caspase-2 活化。
links.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

links.context: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
links.context_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

links.context: Pericytes are contractile perivascular cells that ensheathe the endothelial lining of capillaries and post-capillary venules while embedded in the basement membrane. Together with Endothelial Cells and astrocytic end-feet they form the neurovascular unit that maintains the Blood-Brain Barrier, and their loss or dysfunction is implicated in neurodegeneration and small-vessel disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Pericytes 是可收縮的血管周細胞，嵌於基底膜中並包覆微血管與微靜脈後小靜脈的內皮襯裡。它們與 Endothelial Cells 及星狀細胞終足共同構成維持 Blood-Brain Barrier 的 neurovascular unit；其流失或功能異常與 neurodegeneration 及腦小血管病變有關。

links.context: Peripheral blood eosinophilia is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia 是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

links.context: Peripheral blood eosinophilia — an expansion of circulating eosinophils — is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia（循環中 eosinophils 的擴增）是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

links.context: Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) expression is induced by the transcription factor NRF2 and is frequently up-regulated in cancer and stressed tissues as part of an antioxidant program. Its selective mitochondrial localization makes it a central node linking redox homeostasis to mitochondrial quality control and longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）的表現由轉錄因子 NRF2 誘導，並在癌症與受壓力的組織中作為抗氧化計畫的一部分而常被上調。其選擇性的粒線體定位使其成為連結氧化還原恆定與粒線體品質控制及長壽的關鍵節點。

links.context: Peroxisomes perform beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid synthesis, ether phospholipid (plasmalogen) synthesis critical for myelin, alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid and glyoxylate detoxification. Peroxisomal disorders such as Zellweger Syndrome and X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy illustrate how peroxisomal dysfunction raises oxidative stress and contributes to neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxisomes 負責超長鏈脂肪酸的 beta-氧化、膽汁酸合成、對髓鞘關鍵的醚磷脂（plasmalogen）合成、植烷酸的 alpha-氧化以及乙醛酸解毒。Zellweger Syndrome 與 X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy 等過氧化體疾病顯示，過氧化體功能異常會升高氧化壓力並促成 neurodegeneration。

links.context: Peroxynitrite contributes to atherosclerosis by depleting nitric oxide and impairing endothelium-dependent vasodilation, a hallmark of endothelial dysfunction. 3-Nitrotyrosine is elevated in human atherosclerotic plaques, and plasma nitrotyrosine levels independently predict cardiovascular events. This positions peroxynitrite as a central player in the earliest stage of atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過耗竭 nitric oxide 並損害內皮依賴性血管舒張（endothelial dysfunction 的特徵）來促成 atherosclerosis。3-Nitrotyrosine 在人體動脈粥狀硬化斑塊中升高，且血漿 nitrotyrosine 水平可獨立預測心血管事件。這使 peroxynitrite 成為 atherosclerosis 最早階段的核心角色。

links.context: Peroxynitrite damages DNA mainly through guanine oxidation and the formation of 8-nitroguanine, a specific nitrative lesion that rapidly depurinates to generate abasic sites. 8-nitroguanine is also mutagenic, inducing G-to-T transversions, and has been detected in infected gastric epithelium and cholangiocarcinoma tissues. This links peroxynitrite to infection-associated carcinogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 主要透過鳥嘌呤氧化與形成 8-nitroguanine 來損傷 DNA，後者是一種特異性的硝化損傷，會迅速去嘌呤產生無嘌呤位點。8-nitroguanine 也具有致突變性，誘導 G 至 T 的顛換，並已在受感染的胃上皮與 cholangiocarcinoma 組織中檢測到。這將 peroxynitrite 與感染相關的致癌作用連結起來。

links.context: Peroxynitrite induces apoptosis by oxidizing mitochondrial components including thioredoxin 2 and the permeability transition pore, triggering mitochondrial swelling and cytochrome c release. The resultant opening of the permeability transition pore commits the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. This is prominent in ischemia-reperfusion injury and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過氧化粒線體成分（包括 thioredoxin 2 與 permeability transition pore）誘導 apoptosis，觸發粒線體腫脹與 cytochrome c 釋放。由此造成的 permeability transition pore 開啟使細胞走向內源性凋亡。這在 ischemia-reperfusion injury 與神經退化中尤為明顯。

links.context: Peroxynitrite initiates lipid peroxidation by abstracting hydrogen atoms from polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes. The resulting lipid peroxyl radicals propagate chain reactions that generate malondialdehyde and 4-hydroxynonenal. This membrane damage is a key mechanism of peroxynitrite toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過從細胞膜中的 polyunsaturated fatty acids 提取氫原子來啟動 lipid peroxidation。由此產生的脂質過氧化自由基傳播連鎖反應，生成 malondialdehyde 與 4-hydroxynonenal。這種膜損傷是 peroxynitrite 毒性的關鍵機制。

links.context: Peroxynitrite oxidizes and inactivates Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) along with mitochondrial permeability transition pore components. This oxidation contributes to mitochondrial swelling and apoptosis, linking nitrative stress to mitochondrial dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: 過氧亞硝酸鹽會與粒線體通透性轉換孔組成一起氧化並使 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 失活。此氧化作用會促成粒線體腫脹與細胞凋亡，將硝化壓力與粒線體功能障礙連結起來。

links.context: Peroxynitrite oxidizes glutathione (GSH), which is the dominant cellular defense against this oxidant. The reaction converts GSH to sulfenic and sulfinic derivatives and glutathione disulfide, with a rate constant that makes GSH a kinetically relevant scavenger at millimolar concentrations. Depleting glutathione therefore increases susceptibility to peroxynitrite damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 氧化 glutathione（GSH），後者是對抗此氧化劑的主要細胞防禦。此反應將 GSH 轉化為亞磺酸/次磺酸衍生物及 glutathione 二硫化物，其速率常數使 GSH 在毫莫耳濃度下成為動力學上相關的清除劑。因此耗竭 glutathione 會增加對 peroxynitrite 損傷的易感性。

links.context: Persistent SASP from senescent epithelial, stellate and fibroblast pools is now framed as the canonical maladaptive-repair route into Fibrosis, with TGFβ and MMPs driving fibroblast activation, collagen deposition and architecture loss across lung, kidney, liver and muscle. Transient SASP instead promotes progenitor proliferation and immune clearance, so highly regenerative organs fibrose only when the secretory phenotype persists. SASP factors released by accumulated senescent cells promote fibrosis in the surrounding tissue. The same secreted program also propagates senescence to bystander cells, so the fibrotic effect and the pro-senescence effect travel together. It is a downstream cost of letting turnover fall too low.
links.context_zh_TW: 持續的 SASP 來自衰老的上皮、stellate 與纖維母細胞池，如今被視為通往 Fibrosis 的典型不良修復路徑，由 TGFβ 與 MMP 驅動纖維母細胞活化、膠原沉積與結構破壞，涵蓋肺、腎、肝與肌肉。短暫的 SASP 反而促進前驅細胞增殖與免疫清除，因此高再生器官只有在分泌表型持續時才會纖維化。 累積的衰老細胞釋出的 SASP 因子會促進周圍組織的纖維化。同一套分泌程序也會把衰老傳播給旁觀細胞，因此促纖維化效應與促衰老效應是一起傳遞的。這是更新率過低時所產生的下游代價。

links.context: Persistent fibroblast activation transitions to myofibroblasts driving scar formation.
links.context_zh_TW: 持續的纖維母細胞活化轉為肌纖維母細胞驅動疤痕形成。

links.context: Pharmacological cGAS inhibition selectively suppresses neurotoxic inflammatory programs while preserving beneficial microglial functions such as phagocytosis and recruitment to pathological aggregates. In tauopathy models it phenocopies the protective APOE3 Christchurch (R136S) resilience allele, validating that suppression of cGAS-STING signaling is sufficient to recapitulate genetic protection against tau toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: 藥理性 cGAS 抑制可選擇性抑制具神經毒性的發炎程式，同時保留小膠細胞的吞噬作用與向病理聚集物招募等有益功能。在 tau 病變模型中，它表型模擬具保護性的 APOE3 Christchurch（R136S）抗性等位基因，驗證了抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號足以重現對 tau 毒性的遺傳性保護。

links.context: Pharmacological inhibition of Acid ceramidase with the benzoxazolone carboxamide inhibitors ARN14794 and ARN14974 protects Senescent Cells and proliferative cells from RSL3-induced Ferroptosis. The protection is independent of GPX4, GSH and iron: instead, inhibiting ACase lowers membrane PL-PUFA content and thereby Lipid Peroxidation, the ferroptotic driver. This makes ACase inhibition a candidate senomorphic/senolytic strategy for age-related disease and reframes ceramide lipid remodeling as a ferroptosis control point.
links.context_zh_TW: 以苯并噁唑啉酮甲醯胺類抑制劑 ARN14794 與 ARN14974 藥理抑制 Acid ceramidase，可保護 Senescent Cells 與增生細胞免於 RSL3 誘發的 Ferroptosis。此保護作用獨立於 GPX4、GSH 與鐵：抑制 ACase 是藉由降低膜上 PL-PUFA 含量，進而減少推動 Ferroptosis 的 Lipid Peroxidation。這使 ACase 抑制成為面向老年相關疾病的候選 senomorphic/senolytic 策略，並把神經醯胺脂質重塑重新定位為 Ferroptosis 的調控節點。

links.context: Phenothiazine and its 10-N-substituted relatives (2-Chlorophenothiazine, Chlorpromazine, Promethazine) have strongly positive Redox Potential values and consequently show no enhancement of cellular oxygen consumption, having lost the electron-shunt phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Phenothiazine 及其 10-N-取代衍生物（2-Chlorophenothiazine、Chlorpromazine、Promethazine）具有明顯為正的 Redox Potential，因此不顯示任何細胞耗氧提升效果，已失去電子分流表型。

links.context: Phenylbutyrate inhibits class I/IIA HDACs at stress-response promoters. Same inhibitor class as butyrate and valproate.
links.context_zh_TW: Phenylbutyrate 在壓力反應啟動子抑制 I/IIA 類 HDAC。與 butyrate 和 valproate 相同的抑制劑類別。

links.context: Phospho-ribosomal protein S6 is the candidate pharmacodynamic biomarker for mTOR pathway activation, where etiology is clear - as in monogenic mTORopathies. The success of rapamycin in these genetically stratified conditions contrasts with the inconsistent aging data, highlighting the need for validated biomarkers in longevity trials.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸化 ribosomal protein S6 是 mTOR 路徑活化的候選藥效學生物標記，在病因明確的單基因 mTORopathies 中尤其如此。Rapamycin 在這些經遺傳分層的狀況中的成功，與其在老化上的不一致數據形成對比，凸顯長壽試驗對已驗證生物標記的需求。

links.context: Phosphodegron phosphorylation directs SCF ubiquitin degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸降解子磷酸化指導 SCF 泛素降解。

links.context: Phosphorylated SMAD2/3 obligatorily complex with the co-SMAD SMAD4 to regulate target-gene transcription downstream of Activin A-ALK4. This SMAD4-dependent step couples ligand binding to induction of cell-cycle inhibitors in recipient cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸化 SMAD2/3 必須與共 SMAD SMAD4 形成複合體，才能調節 Activin A-ALK4 下游的標的基因轉錄。此 SMAD4 依賴步驟將配體結合耦合到受體細胞中細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。

links.context: Phosphorylation of Huntingtin at Ser421 recruits the autophagy initiation complex components Beclin-1 and ULK1 to the cargo, so wild-type Huntingtin functions as a selective autophagy receptor that clears aggregation-prone proteins. Loss of this cargo-recruitment function with polyQ expansion contributes to the accumulation of misfolded protein aggregates.
links.context_zh_TW: Huntingtin 在 Ser421 被磷酸化後會招募自噬起始複合體的 Beclin-1 與 ULK1 至待降解物，因此野生型 Huntingtin 扮演選擇性自噬受體的角色，清除易聚集蛋白。多麩醯胺酸擴張造成這項受體功能喪失，促成錯誤折疊蛋白聚集體的累積。

links.context: Plasma-membrane-associated DPP4 is the proximal cause of lipid peroxidation in colorectal cancer: p53 loss blocks DPP4 nuclear accumulation, redistributing the protease to the plasma membrane where its activity generates the peroxidation that executes ferroptosis. DPP4 is thus a druggable node, already validated in diabetes by gliptins, for tuning ferroptotic therapy responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 colorectal cancer 中，plasma-membrane-associated 的 DPP4 是脂質過氧化的近端成因：p53 喪失阻斷 DPP4 的核內累積，使此蛋白酶重新分配至質膜，並由其活性產生導致 ferroptosis 的過氧化作用。因此 DPP4 是一個可成藥的節點（已由 gliptins 在糖尿病中驗證），可用於調節鐵死亡治療的反應。

links.context: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor drives the mitochondrial network toward Mitochondrial Fission in vascular smooth muscle cells by lowering the fusion protein MFN2. This fission-dependent remodelling supports pathological vascular changes in Atherosclerosis, making the mitochondrial network a mechanistic link between growth factor signalling and vascular disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor 藉由降低融合蛋白 MFN2，驅使血管平滑肌細胞的粒線體網絡朝 Mitochondrial Fission 方向移動。這種依賴分裂的重塑支持 Atherosclerosis 中的病理性血管變化，使粒線體網絡成為連結生長因子訊號與血管疾病的機制環節。

links.context: Polyamines such as spermidine are autophagy inducers. Polyamine-rich foods boost longevity in various model organisms, polyamine levels fall in aged somatic and immune cells, and restoring polyamines protects against age-induced memory impairment and rejuvenates B cell responses in an Autophagy-dependent manner.
links.context_zh_TW: 像 spermidine 這樣的多胺是自噬誘導物。富含多胺的食物在多種模式生物中提升壽命，多胺濃度在老化的體細胞與免疫細胞中下降，而補充多胺可保護免受年齡相關的記憶損傷，並以 Autophagy 依賴的方式恢復 B 細胞反應。

links.context: Polycomb repressive complexes 1/2 deposit H3K27me3 to repress CDKN2A in young proliferating cells. Loss of this repression licenses p16 accumulation during senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Polycomb 抑制複合體 1/2 沉積 H3K27me3，在年輕增殖細胞抑制 CDKN2A。此抑制的喪失許可衰老期間 p16 累積。

links.context: Polymerase inhibition stalls forks, phenocopying the Gemcitabine/Hydroxyurea stress pattern. Same inducer class, same evidence grade.
links.context_zh_TW: 聚合酶抑制使複製叉停滯，表型複製 Gemcitabine/Hydroxyurea 壓力模式。相同誘發類別，相同證據等級。

links.context: Polyphenols chelate Fe2+/Fe3+ and Cu+/Cu2+ through catechol and galloyl groups, and this metal chelation prevents the Fenton Reaction by suppressing hydroxyl radical generation and inhibits Lipid Peroxidation by removing catalytic iron from membranes. The same chemistry underpins their inhibition of pro-oxidant enzymes and their reduction of non-heme iron absorption.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 透過 catechol 與 galloyl 基團螯合 Fe2+/Fe3+ 與 Cu+/Cu2+，這種金屬螯合可防止 Fenton Reaction（抑制 hydroxyl radical 生成），並藉由從膜上移除催化性鐵而抑制 Lipid Peroxidation。相同的化學機制也是它們抑制促氧化酵素與降低非血基鐵吸收的基礎。

links.context: Polyphenols possess high antioxidant capacity and are effective inhibitors of glycation and Advanced Glycation End Products formation. By neutralising Reactive Oxygen Species and trapping reactive carbonyls, they help prevent age-related organ dysfunction induced by glycotoxins, and they are a major subclass within which flavonoids, stilbenes such as Resveratrol, and phenolic acids are classified.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 具有高抗氧化能力，並能有效抑制 glycation 與 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成。藉由中和 Reactive Oxygen Species 並捕捉反應性羰基，它們有助於預防 glycotoxin 引起的年齡相關器官功能障礙；其下分類包括 Flavonoids、Resveratrol 等 stilbenes，以及 phenolic acids。

links.context: Pompe Disease is mechanistically tied to Autophagy failure: undegraded glycogen in membrane-bound lysosomes causes progressive lysosomal swelling and rupture, while autophagic vacuoles fill the cytoplasm. Diaphragmatic and intercostal involvement produces restrictive respiratory failure, the main cause of morbidity in late-onset patients.
links.context_zh_TW: Pompe Disease 在機制上與 Autophagy 失效相連：未被分解的醣原在膜包覆的溶小體中堆積，造成溶小體逐漸膨脹與破裂，同時自噬空泡佔滿細胞質。橫膈膜與肋間肌受累造成限制性呼吸衰竭，是晚發型患者主要的致病原因。

links.context: Predictable age-related shifts in DNA methylation — global hypomethylation of repeats such as LINE-1 and Alu, promoter hypermethylation of tumour suppressors, and site-specific drift — are exploited by epigenetic clocks such as DNAmGrimAge to estimate biological age.
links.context_zh_TW: 與年齡相關、可預測的 DNA 甲基化變化（LINE-1、Alu 等重複序列的全面低甲基化、腫瘤抑制基因啟動子高甲基化及位點特異性漂移）被 DNAmGrimAge 等表觀遺傳時鐘用來推估生物年齡。

links.context: Pregnane X Receptor activation suppresses NF-κB inflammatory signaling in epithelium and endothelium, maintaining mucin expression and inhibiting CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 responses. PXR thus translates microbial chemistry into host transcriptional programs with anti-inflammatory output.
links.context_zh_TW: Pregnane X Receptor 活化會在上皮與內皮中抑制 NF-κB 發炎訊號，維持黏蛋白表現並抑制 CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 反應。PXR 因此能將微生物的化學訊號轉譯為具抗發炎輸出的宿主轉錄程式。

links.context: Proanthocyanidins are exceptionally potent radical scavengers — often rated above vitamin C/E in ORAC/TEAC assays via catechol/galloyl H-donation and metal chelation — and they activate the NRF2/KEAP1 antioxidant transcriptional program, countering age-associated oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Proanthocyanidins 是極強的自由基清除劑——在 ORAC/TEAC 測定中常優於維生素 C/E，機制包含兒茶酚／沒食子醯基的氫供應與金屬螯合——並可活化 NRF2/KEAP1 抗氧化轉錄程式，以對抗與年齡相關的氧化壓力。

links.context: Progenitor cells are formed from stem cells through differentiation commitment. Product relation roots them downstream of stemness.
links.context_zh_TW: 祖細胞經由分化承諾從幹細胞形成。產物關係將它們根植於幹性下游。

links.context: Progerin accumulation causes nuclear blebbing, genomic instability (disrupted chromatin organization and DNA repair), and premature senescence with SASP induction — the molecular basis of Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome and its accelerated aging phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Progerin 累積會造成核起泡、基因體不穩定（染色質組織與 DNA 修復受損），以及提早誘發衰老與 SASP——這正是 Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 及其加速老化表型的分子基礎。

links.context: Progressive Muscle Atrophy is a defining feature of Muscular Dystrophies (MD). Because the primary damaged tissue is muscle itself, rather than the neuron as in most neurodegenerative disease, the loss of functional mass remains partly reversible with interventions that support anabolism and energy supply.
links.context_zh_TW: 漸進性的 Muscle Atrophy 是 Muscular Dystrophies (MD) 的定義性特徵。由於受損的主要組織是肌肉本身，而非多數神經退化疾病中的神經元，功能性肌量的流失仍可透過支持合成代謝與能量供應的介入部分逆轉。

links.context: Proliferative and remodeling phases of wound healing constitute repair.
links.context_zh_TW: 傷口癒合的增殖與重塑期構成修復。

links.context: Promethazine is a phenothiazine derivative in which the position-10 nitrogen carries a 2-(dimethylamino)propyl side chain. This substitution blocks the free heterocyclic nitrogen required for alternative electron transfer, yields a strongly positive redox potential (E1/2 ≈ 1.069 V vs NHE), and abolishes the methylene blue-like mitochondrial electron-shunt phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Promethazine 是 phenothiazine 的衍生物，其 10 位氮上接有 2-(dimethylamino)propyl 側鏈。此取代阻斷了替代性電子傳遞所需的游離雜環氮，產生極正還原電位（E1/2 ≈ 1.069 V vs NHE），並消除 methylene blue 式的粒線體電子分流表型。

links.context: Promoter hypermethylation silences tumor suppressor genes in cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: 啟動子高甲基化在癌症沉默腫瘤抑制基因。

links.context: Prophylactic dietary creatine for five days before traumatic brain injury reduced cortical damage by 36% in rats and 50% in mice in the preclinical evidence reviewed, an effect attributed to improved energy availability and to sustaining the creatine phosphate shuttle and phosphocreatine buffering during ischaemia-like secondary injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 在所審閱的前臨床證據中，於 traumatic brain injury 前連續五天給予膳食 creatine 可使皮質損傷在大鼠減少 36%、小鼠減少 50%，此效果歸因於能量可利用性的改善，以及在類缺血次級傷害期間維持 creatine phosphate shuttle 與 phosphocreatine 緩衝。

links.context: Propionate signals through FFAR2 and FFAR3 on enteroendocrine and immune cells, reinforcing intestinal barrier integrity and exerting anti-inflammatory actions: it can suppress NF-κB activation, promote regulatory T-cell differentiation and lower systemic inflammation, linking propionate to improved metabolic control.
links.context_zh_TW: Propionate 透過腸泌素細胞與免疫細胞上的 FFAR2 與 FFAR3 傳遞訊號，強化腸道屏障完整性並發揮抗發炎作用：可抑制 NF-κB 活化、促進調節型 T 細胞分化並降低全身性 inflammation，將 propionate 與改善的代謝控制連結起來。

links.context: Propolis induces Apoptosis in tumor models, with its phenolic component CAPE directly inducing apoptosis and inhibiting NF-κB. Combined with cell cycle arrest and modulation of PI3K/Akt and Wnt/beta-catenin signalling, this underlies the observed antiproliferative activity in Breast Cancer, Prostate Cancer, Colorectal Cancer, Melanoma and Glioblastoma cell lines.
links.context_zh_TW: Propolis 在腫瘤模型中誘發 Apoptosis，其酚類成分 CAPE 可直接誘發凋亡並抑制 NF-κB。搭配細胞週期停滯以及 PI3K/Akt 與 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號的調節，這構成了其在 Breast Cancer、Prostate Cancer、Colorectal Cancer、Melanoma 與 Glioblastoma 細胞株中所觀察到的抗增殖活性基礎。

links.context: Propolis reduces Inflammation by lowering IL-6, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta production in activated macrophages and through its antioxidant activity. This anti-inflammatory arm runs parallel to the antiproliferative arm in the traditional-medicine use of bee glue.
links.context_zh_TW: Propolis 藉由降低活化巨噬細胞中 IL-6、TNF-α 與 IL-1β 的產生，並透過其抗氧化活性來減少 Inflammation。這條抗發炎路徑與傳統醫學使用蜂膠時的抗增殖路徑並行。

links.context: Prostaglandin G₂ is a genuine lipid hydroperoxide — the only one produced enzymatically in bulk — and the ferryl-oxo protoporphyrin radical cation generated at the COX peroxidase site can leak and oxidize nearby lipids and proteins. Under glutathione depletion this couples prostanoid synthesis to local Lipid Peroxidation, linking inflammation with oxidative membrane damage and oxidized LDL formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin G₂ 是真正的脂質過氧化氫——唯一大量以酵素方式產生的成員——而 COX 過氧化酶位點生成的高鐵醯基原血紅素自由基陽離子會外漏並氧化鄰近脂質與蛋白質。在穀胱甘肽耗竭下，此現象將前列腺素合成與局部 Lipid Peroxidation 耦合，連結發炎與氧化性膜損傷及氧化 LDL 的形成。
