links.context: Prostate cancer and breast cancer are the two poles of a single vault-wide principle: sex-hormone-receptor signaling (AR in males, ER in females) is the master determinant of hormone-driven tumor biology, and the same hormones drive the sex differences seen throughout Apoptosis, mTORC1, NF-κB, and Senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 攝護腺癌與乳癌是單一全域原則的兩極：性荷爾蒙受體訊號（雄性為 AR，雌性為 ER）是荷爾蒙驅動腫瘤生物學的主要決定因素，且相同荷爾蒙驅動 Apoptosis、mTORC1、NF-κB 與 Senescence 中所見的性別差異。

links.context: Prostate cancer is the clearest male-specific malignancy driven by androgen-receptor signaling — the male-androgen mirror of the estrogen-driven paradigm in Breast Cancer. Androgen-AR signaling couples to mTORC1 activation in male cancers (Gökduman 2023), and AR and the PI3K/AKT/mTOR network show reciprocal negative feedback. ADT (androgen deprivation) is the archetypal male sex-hormone-targeted therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 攝護腺癌是由雄激素受體訊號驅動的最明確男性特異惡性腫瘤——乳癌雌激素驅動典範的男性—雄激素鏡像。雄激素-AR 訊號在男性癌症中與 mTORC1 活化相耦合（Gökduman 2023），且 AR 與 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 網絡呈互惠性負回饋。ADT（雄激素剝奪）是典型的男性性荷爾蒙標靶療法。

links.context: Protein Kinase D activates NF-κB through the IKK complex, promoting IκBα degradation and nuclear translocation. This redox-sensitive PKD–NF-κB link is what allows mitochondrial oxidative stress to shape inflammatory gene expression in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Kinase D 透過 IKK complex 活化 NF-κB，促進 IκBα 降解與核內轉位。這條對氧化還原敏感的 PKD–NF-κB 連結，正是粒線體氧化壓力能在老化中塑造發炎性基因表現的原因。

links.context: Protein Kinase D drives NF-κB-dependent transcription of SASP components such as IL-6 and IL-8 in senescent cells, so it determines both the magnitude and the qualitative profile of the senescent secretome. Targeting PKD offers a senomorphic route to limit chronic SASP-driven inflammaging and tissue dysfunction in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Kinase D 在衰老細胞中驅動 IL-6 與 IL-8 等 SASP 組成物的 NF-κB 依賴性轉錄，因此可決定衰老分泌組的量級與質地特徵。以 PKD 為標的提供了一條 senomorphic 途徑，可限制老化中慢性 SASP 驅動的 inflammaging 與組織功能障礙。

links.context: Protein Kinase D is a major sensor of oxidative and genotoxic stress and is directly engaged by reactive oxygen species: in senescent cells accumulated mitochondrial ROS promote PKD autophosphorylation (Ser744/Ser748 in PKD1) and membrane/cytoskeletal translocation, positioning PKD as a translator of cellular redox state into inflammatory gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Kinase D 是氧化與基因毒性壓力的主要感測器，並可直接被活性氧engage：在衰老細胞中累積的粒線體 ROS 會促進 PKD 自體磷酸化（PKD1 的 Ser744/Ser748）與膜／細胞骨架轉位，使 PKD 成為將細胞氧化還原狀態轉譯為發炎性基因表現的節點。

links.context: Protein kinase A phosphorylates DRP1 at Ser637, retaining it in the cytosol and inhibiting fission during nutrient deprivation; calcineurin dephosphorylates Ser637, permitting DRP1 translocation and fission. In contrast, CDK1/Cyclin B phosphorylates Ser585 during mitosis and ERK2 phosphorylates Ser616 to activate fission, with Parkin ubiquitination targeting DRP1 for proteasomal degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein kinase A 磷酸化 DRP1 的 Ser637，使其滯留細胞質並在養分缺乏時抑制 fission；反之，去磷酸化的 calcineurin 可移除 Ser637 上的磷酸，允許 DRP1 轉位至粒線體並進行 fission。相對地，CDK1/Cyclin B 在有絲分裂時磷酸化 Ser585，ERK2 則磷酸化 Ser616 以活化 fission，而 Parkin 的泛素化則使 DRP1 被蛋白酶體降解。

links.context: Protein kinase C beta (PKCbeta) phosphorylates TFEB at S466 and the cluster S461/S462 and S468, promoting its stability (PMID 23599343). Phosphorylation at S466 is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same site to enhance transcriptional activity, while PKCbeta-mediated phosphorylation stabilizes the TFEB protein. By stabilizing TFEB, PKCbeta signaling can raise the cellular pool of the transcription factor available for nuclear translocation when other activating signals arrive. This illustrates how post-translational phosphorylation by multiple kinases converges on TFEB to control its abundance, localization, and activity, integrating diverse cellular signaling inputs into the regulation of lysosomal and autophagic gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCbeta）在 S466 以及 S461/S462 和 S468 群簇上磷酸化 TFEB，促進其穩定性（PMID 23599343）。S466 的磷酸化與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一部位以增強轉錄活性，而 PKCbeta 介導的磷酸化穩定 TFEB 蛋白。通過穩定 TFEB，PKCbeta 信號可以增加細胞中可用於核轉位的轉錄因子池，當其他啟動信號到達時。這說明多重激酶的翻譯後磷酸化如何匯聚在 TFEB 上，控制其豐度、定位和活性，將多樣的細胞信號輸入整合到溶酶體和自噬基因表達的調節中。

links.context: Protein restriction blunts age-associated increases in frailty, a state of vulnerability increasing risk of dependency, falls, hospitalization, and mortality. In mice, PR reduced frailty while extending lifespan (34.9% increase in males on a 21% vs 7% protein diet), and isoleucine and valine restriction likewise reduce frailty and extend healthspan. The relationship between protein and frailty is complex: some observational studies associate higher protein intake with reduced frailty risk, but a British twin study showed more protein is associated with increased sarcopenia risk, while a low-protein Mediterranean diet was associated with increased muscle mass and strength, and plant but not animal protein is associated with reduced frailty risk. Exercise can largely offset lean mass loss on low-protein diets.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制減弱與年齡相關的虛弱增加，虛弱是增加依賴、跌倒、住院和死亡風險的脆弱狀態。在小鼠中，PR在延長壽命的同時減少虛弱（21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性小鼠壽命增加34.9%），異亮氨酸和纈氨酸限制同樣減少虛弱並延長健康span。蛋白質和虛弱的關係很複雜：一些觀察性研究將較高的蛋白質攝入與降低的虛弱風險相關聯，但一項英國雙胞胎研究顯示較多蛋白質與增加的肌肉減少症風險相關，而低蛋白地中海飲食與增加的肌肉質量和力量相關，植物蛋白而非動物蛋白與降低的虛弱風險相關。運動可以 largely offset 低蛋白飲食中的瘦體組織損失。

links.context: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

links.context: Protein restriction reduces cellular senescence, one of its six defined hallmarks. High-protein diets increase hepatic senescence and SASP, increase inflammation and senescence in white adipose tissue (reduced by PR through an FGF21-dependent mechanism), and promote senescent cell accumulation in the kidney, whereas PR reduces these burdens. FGF21 itself suppresses senescence in cultured cells, reducing drug-induced senescence and pro-inflammatory SASP markers. Isoleucine and valine restriction likewise reduce hepatic senescence and SASP. Because senescent cells drive tissue dysfunction and accelerate aging, PR's suppression of senescence represents a core mechanism linking dietary protein intake to healthspan.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制減少細胞衰老，這是其六個定義標誌之一。高蛋白飲食增加肝臟衰老和SASP，增加白色脂肪組織的發炎和衰老（透過FGF21依賴的機制被PR減少），並促進腎臟中衰老細胞的累積，而PR減少這些負擔。FGF21本身抑制培養細胞的衰老，減少藥物誘導的衰老和促發炎SASP標誌物。異亮氨酸和纈氨酸限制同樣減少肝臟衰老和SASP。由於衰老細胞驅動組織功能障礙並加速老化，PR對衰老的抑制代表了一個核心機制，將飲食蛋白質攝入與健康span聯繫起來。

links.context: Proteinuria is a cardinal sign of glomerular disease, often accompanies reduced glomerular filtration rate, and is a central feature of diabetic nephropathy. It is a prognostic biomarker that guides therapy in diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy, where interventions such as ACE inhibitors target its reduction.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteinuria 是腎絲球疾病的核心徵象，常伴隨 glomerular filtration rate 下降，也是 diabetic nephropathy 的重要特徵。它是引導 diabetic 與 hypertensive nephropathy 治療的預後生物標記，ACE inhibitors 等介入措施即以降低其濃度為目標。

links.context: Proton leak dissipates the mitochondrial gradient as heat, the mechanistic basis of brown-fat thermogenesis. Uncoupling converts respiratory energy to warmth.
links.context_zh_TW: 質子漏以熱耗散粒線體梯度，是棕色脂肪產熱的機制基礎。去偶聯將呼吸能量轉為熱。

links.context: Proton leak is the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane, bypassing ATP synthase. Localization defines the chemiosmotic short-circuit.
links.context_zh_TW: 質子漏是質子跨內粒線體膜的被動回流，繞過 ATP 合酶。定位定義化學滲透短路。

links.context: PtdIns(4,5)P2 is a plasma-membrane-enriched phosphoinositide that also acts as a direct regulator of Autophagy: at the initiation stage its enrichment at forming phagophores supports vesicle curvature and recruits actin regulators that facilitate autophagosome closure, in addition to its role in autophagic lysosome reformation.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns(4,5)P2 是富含於質膜的磷脂訊號分子，也直接調控 Autophagy：在起始階段，它在形成的 phagophore 上富集以支持囊泡曲率，並招募促進 autophagosome 閉合的肌動蛋白調控因子；此外它還參與 autophagic lysosome reformation。

links.context: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP/PNP) cleaves the glycosidic bond of nucleosides, converting nicotinamide riboside to nicotinamide, which is then recycled to NAD+ via NAMPT and NMNAT. This gut cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR and explains its low, interindividually variable oral bioavailability.
links.context_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP/PNP）切割核苷的糖苷鍵，將菸醯胺核苷轉為菸醯胺，後者再經 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 回收為 NAD+。此腸道內的切割被認為是降解 NR 的可變步驟，解釋了 NR 偏低且個體間差異大的口服生體可用率。

links.context: Pycnogenol exerts anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting NF-κB signalling and adhesion-molecule expression. Combined with its enhancement of eNOS activity and NO bioavailability, this makes the extract clinically positioned against chronic venous insufficiency, edema, and retinal/capillary microcirculation defects, and against the vascular dysfunction of cardiovascular disease and diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Pycnogenol 藉由抑制 NF-κB 訊息傳遞與黏附分子表現發揮抗發炎作用。加上它增強 eNOS 活性與 NO 生體可用性的效果，使這種萃取物在臨床上被定位於對抗慢性靜脈功能不足、水腫與視網膜／微循環缺陷，以及心血管疾病與糖尿病的血管功能異常。

links.context: Pycnogenol is a potent direct radical scavenger and metal chelator, and it upregulates endogenous antioxidant defences via the NRF2/KEAP1 pathway while sparing vitamin C and glutathione. It also inhibits NF-κB signalling and adhesion-molecule expression, giving it combined antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity against age-associated oxidative stress and inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Pycnogenol 是強效的直接自由基清除劑與金屬螯合劑，透過 NRF2/KEAP1 路徑上调內源性抗氧化防禦，同時節省 vitamin C 與 glutathione。它也抑制 NF-κB 訊息傳遞與黏附分子表現，賦予其對抗老化相關氧化壓力與發炎的抗氧化及抗發炎活性。

links.context: Pyridoxamine exhibits both carbonyl-trapping and modest cross-link-breaking activity, placing it in the breaker category even though its primary action is scavenging reactive carbonyl intermediates. Its dual action makes it an attractive dual-purpose agent against glyco-oxidative proteostasis failure.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 同時具有羰基捕捉與溫和的交聯切斷活性，因此雖其主要作用是清除活性羰基中間物，仍歸入 breaker 類別。其雙重作用使它成為對抗醣氧化蛋白穩態失調的具吸引力雙效藥物。

links.context: Pyrimidine starvation induced by Cyclopentenyl cytosine activates DNA damage responses that include p53-associated checkpoints. Stabilization of p53 couples the metabolic perturbation to cell cycle arrest and the senescent phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 誘導的嘧啶缺乏會活化包含 p53 相關檢查點的 DNA 損傷反應。p53 的穩定化將代謝擾動與細胞週期停滯及衰老表型連結起來。

links.context: Pyroptosis is initiated by the assembly of inflammasomes containing a pattern recognition receptor, ASC, and pro-caspase-1, which activates Caspase-1. Active Caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into mature forms and cleaves Gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. Caspase-1 is therefore the central executor protease of pyroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyroptosis 由含有模式識別受體、ASC 和 pro-caspase-1 的發炎小體組裝所啟動，並激活 Caspase-1。活化的 Caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 和 pro-IL-18 裂解為成熟形式，並裂解 Gasdermin D 以執行細胞焦亡。因此 Caspase-1 是細胞焦亡的核心執行蛋白酶。

links.context: Pyrraline is an advanced glycation end product formed by reaction of glucose with lysine residues in proteins; it is abundant in heat-processed foods such as pretzel sticks and is absorbed in the intestine via transporters such as hPEPT1.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyrraline 是由 [[Glucose]] 與蛋白質中 [[Lysine]] 殘基反應形成的晚期糖基化終產物；它富含於烘焙加工食品（如 pretzel sticks），並經由 [[hPEPT1]] 等轉運蛋白在小腸被吸收。

links.context: Quercetin is a flavonoid polyphenol with reported anti-glycation properties. Along with kaempferol, genistein, and quercitrin, quercetin inhibits the glycation process in vitro, and the anti-glycation activities of several polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than the reference inhibitor aminoguanidine. These flavonoids act partly through high antioxidant capacity, which counteracts the ROS that accelerate glycation. Because naturally occurring phytochemicals are relatively safe and available in oral forms, flavonoid-rich herbs are promising agents for the prevention of glycation and AGE formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是一種據報導具有抗糖化特性的類黃酮多酚。與 kaempferol、genistein 和 quercitrin 一起，quercetin 在體外抑制糖化過程，且數種多酚的抗糖化活性類似於或甚至強於參考抑制劑 aminoguanidine。這些類黃酮部分透過高抗氧化能力作用，抵消加速糖化的 ROS。由於天然存在的植物化學物質相對安全且可供口服形式，富含類黃酮的草藥是用於預防糖化與 AGE 形成的極具潛力物質。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: RAD51 is central to genome maintenance as the core recombinase of the DNA repair machinery. Its activity is central to repairing DNA interstrand crosslinks and to the broader DNA repair network, making it a hub node in maintaining genomic integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: RAD51 作為 DNA 修復機制核心的 recombinase，在基因體維持中居於關鍵地位。其活性對修復 DNA 股間交聯與更廣泛的 DNA 修復網路至關重要，使它成為維持基因體完整性的樞紐節點。

links.context: RAGE activates mTOR through the PI3K/Akt pathway upon ligand engagement, which in turn inhibits autophagy and promotes inflammatory gene expression. This places RAGE upstream of a major metabolic and pro-inflammatory signaling node. The PI3K/Akt-mTOR arm is one of several RAGE-triggered cascades, alongside NF-kB, MAPK, and JAK/STAT signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 在配體結合時透過 PI3K/Akt 途徑活化 mTOR，後者進而抑制 autophagy 並促進發炎基因表現。這使 RAGE 位於主要代謝與促發炎訊號節點的上游。PI3K/Akt-mTOR 臂是 RAGE 觸發的幾個級聯之一，此外還有 NF-kB、MAPK 與 JAK/STAT 訊號。

links.context: RAGE contributes to atherosclerosis through AGE-driven inflammatory signaling and its role in diabetic vasculopathy. RAGE activation upregulates NF-kB target genes including COX-2 and iNOS, amplifying oxidative stress and vascular injury. Recombinant sRAGE attenuates disease progression in preclinical models of atherosclerosis and diabetic vasculopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 透過 AGE 驅動的發炎訊號及其在糖尿病血管病變中的角色，促成 atherosclerosis。RAGE 活化會上調包括 COX-2 與 iNOS 在內的 NF-kB 標靶基因，放大氧化壓力與血管損傷。重組 sRAGE 在 atherosclerosis 與糖尿病血管病變的臨床前模型中能減緩疾病進展。

links.context: RAGE inhibits autophagy through activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway and mTOR, shifting cells from autophagic clearance toward sustained inflammatory signaling. This inhibition may impair clearance of aminochrome-damaged mitochondria in the adrenochrome pathway. Prolonged RAGE activation thereby promotes a pro-inflammatory and pro-fibrotic state.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 透過活化 PI3K/Akt 途徑與 mTOR 抑制 autophagy，使細胞從自噬清除轉向持續的發炎訊號。此抑制作用可能損害 adrenochrome 途徑中受 aminochrome 損傷粒線體的清除。因此，長期 RAGE 活化會促進促發炎與促纖維化狀態。

links.context: RAGE is cleaved by the metalloprotease ADAM10 (and by MMP9), generating soluble RAGE (sRAGE) that lacks the transmembrane and intracellular domains. sRAGE functions as a decoy receptor, sequestering RAGE ligands and preventing membrane-bound RAGE activation. Low serum sRAGE levels are a biomarker for increased disease risk.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 會被金屬蛋白酶 ADAM10（以及 MMP9）裂解，產生缺乏跨膜與胞內結構域的 soluble RAGE（sRAGE）。sRAGE 作為誘餌受體，隔離 RAGE 配體並阻止膜結合 RAGE 的活化。低血清 sRAGE 水平是疾病風險增加的生物標記。

links.context: RAGE promotes insulin resistance in diabetes, where chronic hyperglycemia drives AGE formation that engages RAGE. RAGE signaling contributes to endothelial dysfunction, podocyte injury, and atherosclerosis underlying diabetic complications. This makes RAGE a key mediator linking chronic hyperglycemia to metabolic and vascular pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 在 diabetes 中促進 insulin resistance，其中慢性高血糖驅動 AGE 形成並啟動 RAGE。RAGE 訊號促成 endothelial dysfunction、足細胞損傷與 atherosclerosis，這些是糖尿病併發症的基礎。這使 RAGE 成為連結慢性高血糖與代謝及血管病理的關鍵介導者。

links.context: RAS is one of the most frequently point-mutated drivers of Oncogene Activation, with hotspot mutations such as G12V converting the RAS proto-oncogene product into a constitutively active GTPase. Because RAS sits at the head of MAPK and PI3K-Akt Signaling, RAS mutations_cause Oncogene Activation that propagates proliferative and survival signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: RAS 是致癌基因活化（Oncogene Activation）最常見的點突變驅動因子之一，其 G12V 等熱點突變會將 RAS 原致癌基因產物轉為持續活化的 GTPase。由於 RAS 位於 MAPK 與 PI3K-Akt Signaling 的上游，RAS 突變所造成的致癌基因活化會向下傳遞增殖與存活訊號。

links.context: RAS is the upstream oncogene that drives the RAS/MAPK/ERK cascade, terminating in ELK1 activation. Deregulated ELK1 activity downstream of constitutive MAPK signalling contributes to oncogenic transcription programmes in cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: RAS 是上游致癌基因，驅動 RAS/MAPK/ERK 級聯反應並最終活化 ELK1。在組成性 MAPK 訊號之下失調的 ELK1 活性，會促成癌症中的致癌轉錄程序。

links.context: RAS/MAPK is a canonical c-Met effector arm for proliferation. Activation covers the mitogenic output.
links.context_zh_TW: RAS/MAPK 是 c-Met 增殖的典型效應臂。活化涵蓋促有絲分裂輸出。

links.context: RAW264.7 is a standard experimental model for inflammation, Toll-like receptor signalling, the oxidative burst and macrophage polarization studies. It is widely used to screen anti-inflammatory and senomorphic compounds, and because macrophages are central to inflammaging and the senescence-messaging secretome, the line helps dissect how senolytics and immunomodulators shift macrophage phenotype with implications for the cancer microenvironment and tissue repair.
links.context_zh_TW: RAW264.7 是研究發炎、Toll-like receptor 訊息傳遞、氧化爆發與巨噬細胞極化的標準實驗模型。它被廣泛用於篩選抗發炎與 senomorphic 化合物；由於巨噬細胞在 inflammaging 與衰老訊息分泌體中居核心地位，此細胞株有助於解析 senolytics 與免疫調節劑如何改變巨噬細胞表型，並牽涉癌症微環境與組織修復。

links.context: RGD peptide contributes to Metastasis in reverse: integrin signalling through RGD sites on extracellular matrix proteins such as Fibronectin, Vitronectin and Fibrinogen enables sustained survival, Angiogenesis and invasion, supporting the Hallmarks of Cancer. Blocking the motif therefore reduces dissemination.
links.context_zh_TW: RGD peptide 在反方向上促成 Metastasis：透過 Fibronectin、Vitronectin 與 Fibrinogen 等細胞外基質蛋白上的 RGD 位點所進行的 integrin 訊號，能提供持續存活、Angiogenesis 與侵襲，支撐 Hallmarks of Cancer。因此封鎖此基序可減少散布。

links.context: RGD-containing peptides are pro-apoptotic: competitive blockade of integrin-mediated adhesion by RGD mimetics induces anoikis, the detachment-induced Apoptosis of endothelial and tumor cells. Some of these peptides are additionally able to induce auto-activation of proCaspase-3 directly.
links.context_zh_TW: 含 RGD 的胜肽具有促凋亡作用：RGD 模擬物競爭性阻斷 integrin 介導的黏附，會誘發失巢凋亡，即內皮與腫瘤細胞脫落誘發的 Apoptosis。部分此類胜肽更能直接誘導 proCaspase-3 的自我活化。

links.context: RIG-I senses cytosolic RNA and promotes the senescence-associated inflammatory programme. Its RNA ligands include retroelement-derived transcripts, which are de-repressed during senescence and deep senescence, and mitochondrial double-stranded RNA released when mitochondrial dynamics or quality control are impaired. RIG-I signals through MAVS to TBK1 and IRF3 as well as NF-kB, so its output overlaps the type I interferon and inflammatory arms of the SASP. In the SASP-induction scheme RIG-I occupies the RNA-sensing position, parallel to DNA sensing by cGAS.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I 感測胞質 RNA 並促進衰老相關發炎程序。其 RNA 配體包括在衰老與深度衰老中解除抑制的反轉錄元件來源轉錄本，以及粒線體動態或品質管制受損時釋出的粒線體雙股 RNA。RIG-I 經 MAVS 傳訊至 TBK1、IRF3 以及 NF-kB，因此其輸出與 SASP 的第一型干擾素臂及發炎臂重疊。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，RIG-I 佔據 RNA 感測位置，與 cGAS 的 DNA 感測平行。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: RIPK3 activation is dominated by RHIM-mediated engagement from RIPK1, ZBP1 or TRIF, but is supplemented by context-specific regulators: RSK3 phosphorylates RIPK3 to promote death in ischemic retinal injury, whereas CSNK1G2 binds and inhibits RIPK3. Some pathogens bypass RHIM entirely — severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus NSs binds the RIPK3 kinase domain to promote autophosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 的活化主要由 RIPK1、ZBP1 或 TRIF 經 RHIM 介導的接合所主導，但另有情境特異性的調控者補充：RSK3 磷酸化 RIPK3 以促進缺血性視網膜損傷中的死亡，而 CSNK1G2 則結合並抑制 RIPK3。某些病原體完全繞過 RHIM——發熱伴血小板減少症候群病毒（SFTSV）的 NSs 會結合 RIPK3 激酶區以促進自體磷酸化。

links.context: RIPK3 deletion attenuates acinar necrosis, edema, and serum amylase in cerulein-induced pancreatitis, supporting a causal necroptotic component.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 缺失減輕 cerulein 誘導胰臟炎的腺泡壞死、水腫與血清澱粉酶，支持 necroptosis 的因果角色。

links.context: RLR signaling bifurcates after MAVS filament formation: IRF3/IRF7 activation drives type-I interferon production while NF-κB activation drives pro-inflammatory cytokines. Viral infection and the ensuing interferon/cytokine storm amplify oxidative burden, with activated immune cells generating ROS, Nitric Oxide, and peroxynitrite that accelerate catecholamine autoxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: MAVS 纖維形成後 RLR 訊號分岔：IRF3/IRF7 活化驅動第一型干擾素的產生，而 NF-κB 活化則驅動促發炎細胞激素。病毒感染及其後的干擾素／細胞激素風暴會放大氧化負荷，活化的免疫細胞產生 ROS、Nitric Oxide 與過氧亞硝酸鹽，加速兒茶酚胺自氧化。

links.context: RNA Polymerase I transcription is repressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of TAFI68, which lowers TAFI68 promoter occupancy; this restraint may protect cells from oncogenic overgrowth, while loss of the opposing activator SIRT7 recapitulates a senescent, low-rRNA phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA 聚合酶 I 的轉錄會被 SIRT1 介導的 TAFI68 去乙醯化所抑制，後者降低 TAFI68 對啟動子的占據；這種克制可能保護細胞免於致癌性過度生長，而相反的活化者 SIRT7 缺失則重現衰老型低 rRNA 表型。

links.context: RNF185 acts alongside MUL1 and Ambra-1/HUWE1 as part of a redundant non-Parkin E3 ligase network. This redundancy is the point: even when the primary PINK1/Parkin mitophagy pathway is impaired, these ligases preserve mitochondrial quality control and ensure damaged mitochondria can still be cleared.
links.context_zh_TW: RNF185 與 MUL1、Ambra-1/HUWE1 一起作用，是冗餘的非 Parkin E3 連接酶網路的一環。關鍵在於這種冗餘性：即使主要的 PINK1/Parkin mitophagy 途徑受損，這些連接酶仍能維持粒線體品質管制，確保受損粒線體得以清除。

links.context: ROS signals through JNK/p38 to activate AP-1 in the senescence stress cascade. This stress-input edge precedes AP-1 pioneer opening of SASP enhancers.
links.context_zh_TW: ROS 經由 JNK/p38 在衰老壓力級聯活化 AP-1。此壓力輸入邊先於 AP-1 先鋒開啟 SASP 增強子。

links.context: RRM2 is overexpressed in many tumor types and correlates with poor prognosis and chemoresistance. Because normal quiescent tissues have low RRM2, blocking it preferentially hurts proliferating tumor and leukemic cells.
links.context_zh_TW: RRM2 在許多腫瘤類型中被過度表現，並與不良預後及化學抗藥性相關。由於正常靜止組織的 RRM2 濃度低，阻斷 RRM2 會優先傷害增殖中的腫瘤與白血病細胞。

links.context: RSK phosphorylates the Bim S93/S94/S98 degron primed by ERK Ser69, feeding SCF-Beta-TrCP turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: RSK 磷酸化經 ERK Ser69 啟動的 Bim S93/S94/S98 降解子，供養 SCF-Beta-TrCP 週轉。

links.context: RSK-primed phospho-Bim is recognized by SCF-Beta-TrCP for proteasomal degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: RSK 啟動的磷酸化 Bim 被 SCF-Beta-TrCP 辨識以蛋白酶體降解。

links.context: RSL3 is a ferroptosis inducer proposed as an alternative to mitotane in adrenocortical carcinoma, exploiting the tumour's GPX4-high phenotype to achieve equivalent or better efficacy with less systemic toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: RSL3 是 feroptosis 誘導劑，利用腫瘤 GPX4 高表型的特性，被提出作為腎上腺皮質癌中 mitotane 的替代方案，以更低的全身毒性取得相當或更佳的療效。

links.context: Racemization of L-epinephrine to the D-isomer, promoted by heat and pH changes during storage, is a pharmaceutical stability problem: the D-isomer is significantly less biologically active, so racemization reduces the therapeutic potency of epinephrine products and is a monitored quality-control parameter.
links.context_zh_TW: L-型 Epinephrine 在儲存過程中受熱與 pH 變化而發生外消旋化轉為 D 型，是藥物穩定性問題：D 型異構物的生物活性顯著較低，因此外消旋化會降低 Epinephrine 製劑的治療效力，並成為受監測的品質管制參數。

links.context: Rapamycin blunts the TASCC-dependent SASP by inhibiting mTORC1, so mTOR inhibition lowers cap-dependent translation of SASP mRNAs and the secreted cytokine load. Senescence and the cell-cycle arrest persist, which is what makes rapamycin a senomorphic rather than a senolytic agent.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 透過抑制 mTORC1 削弱 TASCC 依賴的 SASP，使 mTOR 抑制降低 SASP mRNA 的帽依賴性轉譯與分泌的細胞激素量。衰老與細胞週期停滯依然存在，因此 rapamycin 是 senomorphic 而非 senolytic 藥物。

links.context: Rapamycin reverses the senescent valve-cell phenotype of Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease. As an mTOR inhibitor it de-represses mTORC1-dependent autophagy, restoring autophagic flux in aVICs and lowering CDKN2A/p16, CDKN1A/p21 and SASP output; ATG7/ATG3 overexpression reproduces the effect, while ATG deficiency induces it.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 可逆轉 Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease 的 senescent 瓣膜細胞表型。作為 mTOR 抑制劑，它解除對 mTORC1 依賴性自噬的壓制，恢復 aVIC 的 autophagic flux，並降低 CDKN2A/p16、CDKN1A/p21 與 SASP 輸出；ATG7/ATG3 的過量表現可重現此效應，而 ATG 缺乏則誘發之。

links.context: Rapamycin serves as proof-of-concept for the hyperfunction theory: because mTOR is claimed to be the driver of continued growth execution, its inhibitor extends lifespan across model organisms by slowing geroconversion rather than by treating any single disease. The theory accordingly frames longevity interventions as terminating growth signaling (with Caloric Restriction and Metformin), and distinguishes growth-arrested benign lesions (protective) from growth-driven hamartomas (disease).
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 是高功能老化理論的實證：既然 mTOR 被主張為持續執行生長的驅動因子，其抑制劑便能於模式生物中延長壽命，機制是減緩 geroconversion 而非治療單一疾病。該理論因此將長壽介入設定為終止生長訊號（搭配 Caloric Restriction 與 Metformin），並區分生長已停止的良性病灶（保護性）與持續生長驅動的 Hamartoma（疾病）。

links.context: Rapamycin's geroprotective effects are often attributed to autophagy induction, yet autophagy has dual, context-dependent roles in cancer: while it may suppress tumor initiation by clearing damaged cellular components, it can also support the survival and growth of established tumors by providing substrates for metabolism and clearing damage that would otherwise be lethal. Thus enhancing autophagy in aging populations with elevated cancer risks and an unknown genetic background may inadvertently promote oncogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素的老年保護（geroprotective）效果常歸因於自噬的誘導，然而自噬在癌症中具有雙重且依賴情境的角色：一方面，它可透過清除受損的細胞成分來抑制腫瘤起始；另一方面，它也能透過提供代謝受質、清除否則將致死的損傷，來支持已形成腫瘤的存活與生長。因此，在癌症風險升高且遺傳背景未知的衰老族群中增強自噬，可能無意間促進腫瘤發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: Raptor interacts with RagA/B GTP–RagC/D GDP heterodimers to tether mTORC1 to the lysosome in nutrient-abundant conditions, where the lysosomal surface functions as the platform for mTORC1 activation by Rheb. Without this Raptor-mediated recruitment the complex cannot be positioned where its kinase action is coupled to luminal nutrient levels.
links.context_zh_TW: Raptor 與 RagA/B GTP–RagC/D GDP 異二聚體結合，在營養充足時把 mTORC1 錨定到溶酶體表面；該處正是 Rheb 活化 mTORC1 的平台。若缺乏 Raptor 介導的招募，複合體便無法被定位到其激酶作用與腔內營養濃度相耦合的位置。

links.context: Rather than killing senescent cells, Lamivudine is repurposed as a senomorphic agent that dampens the SASP. Its inhibition of cGAS-STING signalling is indirect: lamivudine does not bind cGAS or STING directly but removes their upstream trigger, retroelement-derived cDNA.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamivudine 並非殺死衰老細胞，而是被重新定位為 senomorphic 藥物以抑制 SASP。它對 cGAS-STING 訊號的抑制是間接的：lamivudine 並不直接結合 cGAS 或 STING，而是移除其上游觸發因子——反轉錄子來源的 cDNA。

links.context: Re-synthesizing NAD+ by the salvage pathway after PARP1 turnover is expensive: the complete cycle costs four high-energy phosphates per ADP-ribose unit. With NAD(H) around 0.3 mM versus ATP around 3-4 mM, full NAD+ turnover could itself contribute substantially to ATP depletion during parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: PARP1 周轉後經救援路徑重新合成 NAD+ 成本高昂：完整循環每單位 ADP-ribose 耗費四個高能磷酸鍵。NAD(H) 約 0.3 mM、ATP 約 3-4 mM，故 NAD+ 完全周轉本身即可顯著促成 parthanatos 中的 ATP 耗竭（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: Receptor activity drives the TGF-beta EMT program in epithelia. Upstream position, same program as the pathway edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 受體活性在上皮驅動 TGF-beta EMT 程序。上游位置，與路徑邊相同程序。

links.context: Recombinant IL-6/IL-8 recapitulates trans-well paracrine ACase upregulation in bystander proliferative cells. This grounds the SASP-to-ACase axis in defined cytokines.
links.context_zh_TW: 重組 IL-6/IL-8 重現 trans-well 旁分泌 ACase 上調。此以明確的細胞激素奠定 SASP 到 ACase 軸的基礎。

links.context: Recurrent mutations in the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3a occur in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia cases, with the R882H hotspot most frequent. These mutations reduce methyltransferase activity and disrupt DNA methylation at regulatory regions controlling stem cell behavior. This epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: DNA 甲基轉移酶 DNMT3a 的反覆突變發生在約 20% 的急性骨髓性白血病病例中，其中 R882H 熱點最常見。這些突變降低甲基轉移酶活性，並擾亂控制幹細胞行為的調控區域之 DNA 甲基化。這種表觀遺傳失調與其他突變合作驅動白血病發生。

links.context: Redox Optimization is the active maintenance side of the Redox Battery concept: the deliberate upkeep of cellular reducing potential while processing redox-active indolequinones. It targets the NAD+/NADH and Glutathione (GSH/GSSG) buffering capacity, monitoring the GSH/GSSG ratio and NAD+/NADH balance and adjusting them as catecholamine load and quinone flux change, keeping the reservable reducing-equivalent reserve charged.
links.context_zh_TW: Redox Optimization 是 Redox Battery 概念中「維持」的一面：在處理氧化還原活性 indolequinone 時主動維持細胞還原勢能。它以 NAD+/NADH 與 Glutathione（GSH/GSSG）的緩衝容量為目標，依兒茶酚胺負荷與醌通量的變化監測 GSH/GSSG 比值與 NAD+/NADH 平衡，使可儲備的還原等量物儲備維持在「充電」狀態。

links.context: Reduced CK2 activity or expression in senescent cells relieves its brake on the NF-κB pathway, promoting IKK/NF-κB activation and contributing to induction of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. CK2 thus behaves as an endogenous senescence suppressor whose downregulation is one of the licensing events for the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞中 CK2 活性或表現下降，會解除它對 NF-κB 路徑的抑制，促進 IKK/NF-κB 活化，並促成衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的誘導。因此 CK2 相當於內生性的衰老抑制因子，其下调是 SASP 得以啟動的許可事件之一。

links.context: Reduced PGI2 accompanies plaque progression in Atherosclerosis, for two reasons: endothelium produces less prostacyclin as it becomes dysfunctional, and oxidized LDL plus lipid peroxides inhibit prostacyclin synthase directly. Because PGI2 is the dominant endogenous restraint on platelet aggregation in intact vessels, its loss is a pro-thrombotic shift at the vessel wall, and its release during ischaemia normally limits platelet deposition and microvascular occlusion during reperfusion.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Atherosclerosis 中，PGI2 減少會伴隨斑塊進展，原因有二：內皮功能失調後製造的 prostacyclin 變少；以及 Oxidized LDL 與脂質過氧化物直接抑制 prostacyclin synthase。由於 PGI2 是完整血管中對血小板聚集的主要內生限制因子，其喪失即代表血管壁層次的促血栓轉向；而缺血時 PGI2 的釋放通常可在再灌流期間限制血小板沉積與微血管阻塞。

links.context: Reduced SIRT6 expression contributes to COPD through insufficient autophagy and cellular senescence during cigarette-smoke exposure, while SIRT6 overexpression weakens autophagy via the IGF-Akt-mTOR axis. SIRT3 inhibits airway epithelial mitochondrial oxidative stress to attenuate COPD progression, and SIRT1 is substantially decreased in COPD and emphysema lungs.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 表現減少透過香菸煙霧暴露期間自噬不足與細胞衰老促成 COPD，而 SIRT6 過度表現經由 IGF-Akt-mTOR 軸減弱自噬。SIRT3 抑制氣道上皮粒線體氧化壓力以減緩 COPD 進展，且 SIRT1 在 COPD 與肺氣腫肺中大幅減少。

links.context: Reduced Thioredoxin-1 binds the N-terminal domain of ASK1, maintaining the kinase in an inactive monomeric state. Oxidation of Thioredoxin-1 during oxidative stress releases ASK1 from this inhibition. Thioredoxin-1 thus functions as a key redox-sensitive inhibitor of ASK1 activity.
links.context_zh_TW: 還原態的 Thioredoxin-1 與 ASK1 的 N 端結構域結合，使激酶維持在不活化的單體狀態。在氧化壓力期間，Thioredoxin-1 的氧化會使 ASK1 脫離此抑制。因此 Thioredoxin-1 是 ASK1 活性的關鍵氧化還原敏感性抑制因子。

links.context: Reduced calorie intake and Intermittent Fasting make tumor cells more susceptible to apoptosis via stimulation of CD8+ T cells, and fasting-driven metabolic reprogramming improves CD8+ T cell memory responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量攝取減少與 Intermittent Fasting 藉由刺激 CD8+ T Cell，使腫瘤細胞更易發生凋亡；禁食驅動的代謝重編程則改善 CD8+ T Cell 的記憶反應。

links.context: Regulatory T cells are a FoxP3-expressing CD4+ subset that suppress immune responses through IL-10, TGF-β, CTLA-4 and IL-2 consumption, maintaining peripheral tolerance and preventing autoimmunity. Dysregulated CD4+ T cells drive tissue damage in rheumatoid arthritis, multiple sclerosis, type 1 diabetes and systemic lupus erythematosus.
links.context_zh_TW: 表現 FoxP3 的 Treg 是 CD4+ 的一個子集，透過 IL-10、TGF-β、CTLA-4 與 IL-2 消耗來抑制免疫反應，維持周邊耐受並避免自體免疫。CD4+ T 細胞的失調則在類風濕性關節炎、多發性硬化症、第一型糖尿病與全身性紅斑性狼瘡中造成組織損傷。

links.context: Relative to ivermectin, moxidectin is roughly 100-fold more lipid-soluble, distributes widely into fat, is cleared much more slowly (an elimination half-life of several weeks in dogs) and is more potent per milligram. This potency/duration trade-off enables six-month ProHeart dosing but also means overdose cannot be quickly cleared, giving moxidectin a narrower dose margin than milbemycin oxime.
links.context_zh_TW: 相較於 ivermectin，moxidectin 的脂溶性約高 100 倍、廣泛分布於脂肪組織、清除速度慢得多（犬隻排除半衰期達數週），且每毫克效價更高。這種效價與持久性的取捨使六個月一次的 ProHeart 給藥得以實現，但過量也無法迅速清除，使 moxidectin 的劑量安全邊際比 milbemycin oxime 更窄。

links.context: Release of Cytochrome c from the mitochondrial intermembrane space is a critical mitochondrial-to-cell signal and the decisive trigger of the intrinsic apoptosis pathway, illustrating how mitochondria actively determine cell fate rather than acting as passive organelles.
links.context_zh_TW: Cytochrome c 自粒線體膜間腔釋放是關鍵的粒線體對細胞訊號，也是內源性凋亡路徑的決定性觸發因子，顯示粒線體主動決定細胞命運，而非僅是被動胞器。

links.context: Release of cathepsins from lysosomes during lysosomal membrane permeabilization switches their role from housekeeping proteases to mediators of programmed cell death. The switch is engaged by a wide range of stressors including reactive oxygen species, lipid peroxidation products and chemotherapeutic agents, so cathepsin release constitutes a general stress-response apoptotic pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: 在溶小體膜通透化期間 Cathepsins 自溶小體釋放，使其角色由維持性蛋白酶轉為程序性細胞死亡的介導者。此轉換可由多種壓力源觸發，包括 Reactive Oxygen Species、脂質過氧化產物與化學治療藥物，因此 Cathepsins 的釋放構成一條普遍的壓力反應性凋亡路徑。

links.context: Released epinephrine from the Adrenal medulla is susceptible to auto-oxidation, forming reactive aminochromes such as Adrenochrome especially in the presence of oxidants, trace metals, or alkaline pH. This links medullary catecholamine flux to redox stress and to Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy under sustained drive.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 Adrenal medulla 釋放的 epinephrine 容易自發氧化，形成 Adrenochrome 等反應性 aminochrome，在氧化劑、痕量金屬或鹼性 pH 環境下尤為明顯。這把髓質的兒茶酚胺通量與氧化還原壓力連結起來，也與持續刺激下的 Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 相關。

links.context: Remodelling of the ECM is regulated by Lysosome activity, as seen during C. elegans molting, where STA-2- and ELT-3-dependent lysosome biogenesis drives ECM remodelling. This links lysosomal function — the degradative organelle and endpoint of autophagic flux — to extracellular matrix turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: ECM 的重塑受 Lysosome 活性調控，如 C. elegans 蛻皮過程中由 STA-2 與 ELT-3 相依賴的 lysosome 生成所驅動的 ECM 重塑。這將 lysosome 功能（降解性胞器與自噬流的終點）與細胞外基質的更新連結起來。

links.context: Reprogramming is the proof that aging is substantially epigenetic: information loss (epigenetic drift) rather than pure damage accumulation. The ICE mouse experiments and reprogramming share this mechanistic frame, with aging positioned as a reversible epigenetic state.
links.context_zh_TW: Reprogramming 證明年齡在很大程度上是表觀遺傳性的：是資訊流失（表觀遺傳漂移）而非單純的損害累積。ICE 小鼠實驗和重編程共享此機制框架，將老化定位為可逆的表觀遺傳狀態。

links.context: Residual variation in resting metabolic rate — the part not explained by fat-free mass — is heritable and correlates with physiological and genetic factors, among them circulating leptin levels (Toth et al. 1999), making the leptin gene a candidate correlate of residual RMR.
links.context_zh_TW: 基礎代謝率的殘餘變異（即無法由去脂體重解釋的部分）具有遺傳性，並與生理及遺傳因子相關，其中之一是循環中的 leptin 濃度（Toth et al. 1999），因此 leptin 基因是殘餘 RMR 的候選相關因子。

links.context: Resolvins and the products of Lipid Peroxidation occupy the same chemical real estate because they share the same substrates, but their formation routes are mutually exclusive. Under tight enzymatic control DHA and EPA are oxygenated by lipoxygenase into resolvin series; under unregulated radical attack the same lipids yield cytotoxic aldehydes such as 4-Hydroxynonenal and Acrolein plus F2-Isoprostanes. The shared intermediate is the lipid hydroperoxide, and the branch point is the adequacy of the antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: Resolvins 與 Lipid Peroxidation 的產物佔據同一化學領域，因為它們共用相同的受質，但兩者的形成途徑互斥。在嚴密的酵素控制下，DHA 與 EPA 會被 lipoxygenase 氧化成各系列 resolvin；在不受調控的自由基進攻下，同樣的脂質則產生 4-Hydroxynonenal、Acrolein 等細胞毒性醛類與 F2-Isoprostanes。兩者的共同中間物是脂質過氧化氫物，分岔點則在抗氧防禦是否充足。

links.context: Restoring mitochondrial function is a major therapeutic strategy in aging research, pursued via NAD+ repletion with precursors such as nicotinamide riboside (NR) and NMN, mitophagy enhancement with urolithin A, activation of mitochondrial biogenesis, and mtDNA editing with mitoTALENs and mitoZFNs.
links.context_zh_TW: 在老化研究中，恢復粒線體功能是主要治療策略，路徑包括以 nicotinamide riboside（NR）與 NMN 等前驅物補充 NAD+、以 urolithin A 增強 mitophagy、活化粒線體生成，以及以 mitoTALENs 與 mitoZFNs 進行 mtDNA 編輯。

links.context: Restricting dietary valine alone (~66% reduction) recapitulates many benefits of Protein Restriction: reduced body weight, reduced hepatic Cellular Senescence, and ~23% lifespan extension in male C57BL/6J mice, with protective effects on Alzheimer's Disease progression in females.
links.context_zh_TW: 單獨限制膳食 valine（約減少 66%）可重現 Protein Restriction 的多項效益：體重下降、肝臟 Cellular Senescence 減少，以及雄性 C57BL/6J 小鼠約 23% 的壽命延長；對雌性小鼠的 Alzheimer's Disease 進展亦具保護作用。

links.context: Resveratrol extends lifespan across diverse organisms, including Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Caenorhabditis elegans, Drosophila melanogaster and the short-lived fish Nothobranchius furzeri; in mice on high-fat or high-calorie diets it improved metabolic health, increased mitochondrial number and lowered blood glucose and insulin.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 能在多種生物中延長壽命，包括 Saccharomyces cerevisiae、Caenorhabditis elegans、Drosophila melanogaster 以及短命魚 Nothobranchius furzeri；在高脂或高熱量飲食的小鼠中，它改善代謝健康、增加粒線體數量並降低血糖與胰島素。

links.context: Resveratrol is widely considered a caloric restriction mimetic: without reducing food intake it recapitulates many effects of Caloric Restriction — increased mitochondrial biogenesis, reduced inflammation and improved insulin sensitivity — via SIRT1→PGC-1α signalling, though whether the effects are truly SIRT1-dependent in mammals remains debated.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 被廣泛視為 caloric restriction mimetic：它在不減少攝食的情況下重現 Caloric Restriction 的多項效應 —— 粒線體新生增加、发炎減少與胰島素敏感度改善 —— 主要經由 SIRT1→PGC-1α 訊號，但在哺乳類中其效應是否真正 SIRT1 相依仍有爭議。

links.context: Retinoid X receptor α acts in obligate heterodimers with a wide array of nuclear receptors, which is how it integrates hormonal, nutritional, and metabolic signals. In the mitochondrial stress arm it partners with PGC-1α to drive antioxidant defense and mitochondrial biogenesis programs, while obligate permissive heterodimers with PPAR family members regulate lipid and glucose metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoid X receptor α 與多種核受體形成必然性異二聚體，藉此整合荷爾蒙、營養與代謝訊號。在粒線體壓力這一支，它與 PGC-1α 配對以驅動抗氧化防禦與粒線體生物合成程式；而與 PPAR 家族成員形成的必然型 permissive 異二聚體則調節脂質與葡萄糖代謝。

links.context: Rheumatoid Arthritis alters both the composition and the redox state of Synovial Fluid, promoting AGE crosslinking of collagen, stiffening of the matrix, and engagement of RAGE on synovial fibroblasts, macrophages, and chondrocytes. This amplifies inflammatory cytokine release and proteolytic cartilage degradation, forming a feed-forward loop of glycative and oxidative damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Rheumatoid Arthritis 會同時改變 Synovial Fluid 的組成與氧化還原狀態，促進膠原蛋白的 AGE 交聯、基質硬化，以及滑膜纖維母細胞、巨噬細胞與軟骨細胞上 RAGE 的活化。這會放大發炎細胞激素釋放與蛋白水解性軟骨破壞，形成糖化與氧化損傷的正回饋迴路。

links.context: Ribociclib is indicated in HR+/HER2- breast cancer (MONALEESA trials). Clinical indication edge of the CDK4/6 class.
links.context_zh_TW: Ribociclib 適用於 HR+/HER2- 乳癌（MONALEESA 試驗）。CDK4/6 類別的臨床適應症邊。

links.context: Rifampicin is a hepatic enzyme inducer that can increase the activity of certain metabolic enzymes in the liver, potentially accelerating the metabolism of urolithin A and reducing its half-life in the body. This illustrates the broader principle that drugs interacting with cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver can competitively inhibit or induce these enzymes, thereby disrupting the metabolism and clearance of urolithin A and altering its systemic exposure. Common antibiotics, antifungal drugs, and anticancer drugs have been reported to interact with CYP450 enzymes in this way.
links.context_zh_TW: Rifampicin 是一種肝臟酶誘導劑，可提升肝臟中某些代謝酶的活性，可能加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期。這說明了更廣泛的原則：與肝臟中 cytochrome P450 酶交互作用的藥物，可競爭性抑制或誘導這些酶，從而干擾 urolithin A 的代謝與清除，並改變其全身暴露量。常見的抗生素、抗真菌藥物與抗癌藥物皆曾被報導以這種方式與 CYP450 酶交互作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

links.context: Rising heteroplasmy — mutant mtDNA burden — compromises translation output, and age-related decline in translation fidelity and efficiency alongside rising heteroplasmy contributes to bioenergetic decline in stem cells and post-mitotic tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: heteroplasmy 上升（突變 mtDNA 的負擔）會削弱轉譯產出；轉譯保真度與效率的年齡相關衰退，伴隨 heteroplasmy 上升，造成幹細胞與分裂後組織的能量代謝衰退。

links.context: S1R is an ER/mitochondrial-membrane chaperone encoded by SIGMAR1 that modulates ER stress and lipid metabolism; inhibiting S1R promotes ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells, positioning it as a brake on the lipid-peroxidation cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: S1R 是由 SIGMAR1 編碼、位於內質網／粒線體接觸膜的伴護蛋白，可調節內質網壓力與脂質代謝；抑制 S1R 會在 hepatocellular carcinoma 細胞中促進 ferroptosis，使其成為脂質過氧化級聯反應的煞車。

links.context: SA-beta-gal is a lysosomal-activity reporter classed as a biomarker of senescence and aging. Classification separates reporters from effectors.
links.context_zh_TW: SA-beta-gal 是歸類為衰老與老化生物標記的溶酶體活性報導器。歸類將報導器與效應器分開。

links.context: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

links.context: SAH is the stoichiometric byproduct of SAM methyl transfer. Product relation records the reaction balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SAH 是 SAM 甲基轉移的化學計量副產物。產物關係記錄反應平衡。

links.context: SAHA (vorinostat) is an HDAC inhibitor; by blocking histone deacetylase activity it keeps TFEB acetylated and thereby enhances TFEB activity. HDAC inhibitors such as SAHA and Trichostatin A induce Autophagy through TFEB and FOXO activation.
links.context_zh_TW: SAHA（vorinostat）是 HDAC 抑制劑；藉由阻斷 histone 去乙醯化活性，它使 TFEB 維持乙醯化態，從而提升 TFEB 活性。像 SAHA 與 Trichostatin A 這類 HDAC 抑制劑會經由活化 TFEB 與 FOXO 誘導 Autophagy。

links.context: SAHF (Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci) are dense, localized Chromatin clusters that form paradoxically while global heterochromatin declines with age. By compacting these foci over cell-cycle genes, SAHF permanently silence their transcription, locking senescent cells out of the cell cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: SAHF（senescence-associated heterochromatin foci）是隨年齡全域 heterochromatin 下降而反常形成的緻密局部 Chromatin 團塊。SAHF 將這些 foci 壓實覆蓋於細胞週期基因之上，永久沉默其轉錄，使衰老細胞被鎖定於細胞週期之外。

links.context: SARM1 NADase activity executes Wallerian axon degeneration and is a druggable ALS node. NAD+ depletion links SARM1 to the sirtuin-starvation corridor.
links.context_zh_TW: SARM1 NADase 活性執行 Wallerian 軸突退化，是可藥物化的 ALS 節點。NAD+ 耗竭將 SARM1 連結到 sirtuin 飢餓走廊。

links.context: SARM1 is a NAD+-consuming enzyme, grouped with CD38 and CD157 as an NAD+ glycohydrolase that degrades the coenzyme in signaling and stress pathways. Alongside ADP-ribosyl transferases, poly-ADP polymerases, and sirtuins, SARM1 mediates essential NAD+-dependent processes such as DNA repair, apoptosis, cell survival, lifespan regulation, and metabolic adjustments. Its NAD+ consumption contributes to the constant synthesis-catabolism-recycling cycle that sustains NAD+ levels, and disturbances that shift this balance, such as aging or infection, can reduce NAD+ availability. Dietary precursors like NMN and NR counter this by replenishing the NAD+ pool consumed by these signaling enzymes.
links.context_zh_TW: SARM1 是一種消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，與 CD38 和 CD157 同屬 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶，在訊號傳導與壓力路徑中降解此輔酶。與 ADP-ribosyl transferases、poly-ADP polymerases 和 sirtuins 一起，SARM1 介導 DNA 修復、凋亡、細胞存活、壽命調控與代謝調整等必需的 NAD+ 依賴性過程。其 NAD+ 消耗作用有助於維持 NAD+ 濃度恆定的合成—分解—再循環週期，而老化或感染等使此平衡偏移的擾動，會降低 NAD+ 的可利用性。NMN 與 NR 等膳食前驅物透過補充這些訊號酵素所消耗的 NAD+ 庫存來對抗此現象。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: SASP IL-6/IL-8 signaling through JAK-STAT3 promotes dedifferentiation and stem-like states in recipient cells. This fate-modulating arm underlies both regenerative plasticity acutely and cancer stemness chronically.
links.context_zh_TW: SASP 的 IL-6/IL-8 經 JAK-STAT3 訊號促進受體細胞去分化與類幹細胞狀態。此命運調節臂構成急性期的再生可塑性與慢性期的癌症幹性。

links.context: SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 jointly upregulate HLA-E, which engages NKG2A/CD94 to suppress NK and CD8 T-cell killing. This symmetric IL-8 leg mirrors the existing IL-6 triple and completes the SASP-driven immune-evasion loop.
links.context_zh_TW: SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 共同上調 HLA-E，後者接合 NKG2A/CD94 以抑制 NK 與 CD8 T 細胞殺死。此對稱的 IL-8 路徑呼應既有 IL-6 triple，完整呈現 SASP 驅動的免疫逃脫迴圈。

links.context: SAT1 generates N1-acetylspermidine/spermine, which are exported and oxidized by polyamine oxidase, producing H2O2 and downstream reactive oxygen species. SAT1 is tightly regulated at the level of mRNA stability and protein degradation, making it a rapid-response node to stress signals rather than a slow metabolic enzyme.
links.context_zh_TW: SAT1 生成 N1-乙醯 spermidine／spermine，後者被輸出並由多胺氧化酶氧化，產生 H2O2 與下游活性氧物種。SAT1 在 mRNA 穩定性與蛋白質降解層級受到嚴密調控，因此它是對壓力訊號快速反應的節點，而非緩慢的代謝酵素。

links.context: SCNT reprograms donor nuclei to blastocyst-stage epigenomes. Generation records the cloning route.
links.context_zh_TW: SCNT 將供體核重編程至囊胚期表觀基因組。產生記錄克隆路徑。

links.context: SHMT2-driven mitochondrial one-carbon metabolism (SHMT2 → MTHFD2 → MTHFD1L) is now recognized as the dominant source of one-carbon units in cancer cells, accounting for roughly 75% of total one-carbon production in rapidly dividing cells. The resulting glycine and 5,10-methylene-THF feed downstream MTHFD2 to regenerate NADPH for reductive biosynthesis and redox defense.
links.context_zh_TW: SHMT2 驅動的粒線體一碳代謝（SHMT2 → MTHFD2 → MTHFD1L）如今被認為是癌細胞中一碳單位的主要來源，在快速分裂細胞中約占總一碳產量的 75%。所產生的甘胺酸與 5,10-亞甲基-THF 供給下游 MTHFD2，以再生用於還原性生合成與氧化還原防禦的 NADPH。

links.context: SIRS criteria define the systemic inflammatory state that, when accompanied by infection, constitutes sepsis; sterile necroptotic DAMP release produces the same clinical syndrome.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRS 標準定義全身性發炎狀態，若伴隨感染即構成敗血症（sepsis）；無菌性 necroptotic DAMP 釋放可產生相同臨床症候群。

links.context: SIRT1 activation attenuates atherosclerotic disease and counteracts TMAO inflammation. Protection is the sirtuin vascular output.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 活化減輕動脈粥狀硬化並對抗 TMAO 發炎。保護是 sirtuin 血管輸出。

links.context: SIRT1 ameliorates the autophagic degradation of alpha-synuclein by deacetylating LC3 and improves motor defects in Parkinson's disease. This connects sirtuin activity directly to clearance of the pathological protein aggregate central to PD. SIRT1's pro-autophagy action here contrasts with SIRT2, which mediates exacerbation of alpha-synuclein toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 LC3 改善 alpha-synuclein 的自噬降解，並改善帕金森氏症的運動缺陷。這將 sirtuin 活性直接連結至 PD 核心病理蛋白聚集體的清除。SIRT1 此處的促自噬作用與介導加劇 alpha-synuclein 毒性的 SIRT2 形成對比。

links.context: SIRT1 and caspases form a reciprocal crosstalk in which caspases cleave SIRT1, converting it into a pro-apoptotic death promoter. This axis runs backwards from the SIRT1-to-caspase suppression loop as a caspase-to-SIRT1 cleavage switch during apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 與 caspase 形成相互作用的串聯關係，其中 caspase 裂解 SIRT1，使其轉變為促凋亡的死亡促進者。此軸向在細胞凋亡中，從 SIRT1 抑制 caspase 的迴路反轉為 caspase 裂解 SIRT1 的開關。

links.context: SIRT1 can also act as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting beta-catenin and NF-kB signaling, in contrast to its oncogenic role of deacetylating and inactivating p53. This context-dependent duality is why SIRT1 is described as a molecular 'shapeshifter' whose actions demand biomarker-guided strategies for clinical translation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 也可透過抑制 β-catenin 和 NF-kB 信號作為腫瘤抑制因子，與其去乙醯化並使 p53 失活的致癌角色形成對比。這種依賴情境的雙重性，是 SIRT1 被描述為分子「變形者」、其作用需要生物標記引導策略才能臨床轉化的原因。
links.source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md

links.context: SIRT1 can localize to the nucleolus and modulate Pol I transcription through deacetylation of TAFI68 (TAF1B), a Pol I-specific transcription factor. Counterintuitively, SIRT1 deacetylation of TAFI68 reduces its rDNA binding and represses Pol I — a restraint against unrestrained growth, opposing SIRT7.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 可定位至核仁，透過去乙醯化 Pol I 專一性轉錄因子 TAFI68（TAF1B）來調節 Pol I 轉錄。出人意料地，SIRT1 對 TAFI68 的去乙醯化會降低其與 rDNA 的結合並抑制 Pol I，形成對不受限制生長的牽制，與 SIRT7 作用相反。

links.context: SIRT1 cleavage and ubiquitination-mediated degradation are not unique to DNA damage — they also occur during mitosis. Synchronized cells (double-thymidine block, nocodazole) lose SIRT1 as they enter M phase in an MG132-sensitive, Boc-D-FMK-sensitive, transcription-independent manner, with TRIM28-SIRT1 colocalization peaking in prometaphase/metaphase. ATM phosphorylates TRIM28 Ser824 in mitosis as well, dislodging it from heterochromatin — so the same destruction axis runs in dividing cells.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 的切割與泛素化降解並非 DNA 損傷所獨有——在有絲分裂期間也會發生。同步化細胞（雙重胸腺嘧啶阻斷、nocodazole）進入 M 期時會以 MG132 敏感、Boc-D-FMK 敏感且不依賴轉錄的方式失去 SIRT1，TRIM28-SIRT1 的共定位在前/中期達到高峰。ATM 在有絲分裂中同樣會將 TRIM28 Ser824 磷酸化，使其脫離異染色質——因此同一破壞軸也在分裂細胞中運作。
links.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

links.context: SIRT1 deacetylates Atg8/LC3 along with Atg5 and Atg7, and resveratrol induces the deacetylation of dozens of cytoplasmic proteins. Because SIRT1 acts in both nucleus and cytoplasm, and a cytoplasmic variant is as efficient as wild-type SIRT1 at inducing autophagy, cytoplasmic deacetylation targets such as the LC3 machinery appear sufficient to deliver the autophagy response.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化 Atg8/LC3 以及 Atg5 與 Atg7，而 resveratrol 會誘導數十種細胞質蛋白去乙醯化。由於 SIRT1 在細胞核與細胞質中皆作用，且細胞質變異型的自噬誘導效率與野生型 SIRT1 相當，LC3 機器這類細胞質去乙醯化標的似乎已足以引出自噬反應。

links.context: SIRT1 deacetylates NAMPT, enhancing its enzymatic activity. Because NAMPT sets the NAD+ pool and SIRT1 consumes NAD+, this post-translational modification is a second, faster feedback route — alongside transcriptional control through PGC-1α — for tying sirtuin activity to NAD+ supply.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化 NAMPT，增強其酵素活性。由於 NAMPT 決定 NAD+ 池而 SIRT1 又消耗 NAD+，這項轉譯後修飾是除了經 PGC-1α 的轉錄調控之外，第二條更快速的回饋途徑，用來把 sirtuin 活性與 NAD+ 供應綁在一起。

links.context: SIRT1 deacetylates p53, which is commonly mutated in human cancers and which can both positively and negatively regulate autophagy via the mTOR pathway. Because the transcription factors SIRT1 deacetylates (p53, HSF1, FOXO3, PGC1a) all influence SIRT1 expression in turn, deacetylation forms a feedback architecture linking SIRT1 activity to stress response and autophagy induction.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化 p53；p53 在人類癌症中常突變，且可經由 mTOR 路徑正向與負向調控自噬。由於 SIRT1 所去乙醯化的轉錄因子（p53、HSF1、FOXO3、PGC1a）反過來也影響 SIRT1 表現，去乙醯化因而構成連結 SIRT1 活性與壓力反應及自噬誘導的回饋架構。

links.context: SIRT1 deacetylates p65 Lys310 to suppress NF-kB, mirroring the existing SIRT6 edge. Suppression is the sirtuin anti-inflammatory output.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 p65 Lys310 以抑制 NF-κB，呼應既有的 SIRT6 邊。抑制是 sirtuin 抗發炎輸出。

links.context: SIRT1 exerts anti-inflammatory effects in adipose tissue by inhibiting NF-κB signaling, reducing macrophage infiltration, and promoting polarization toward the anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype; SIRT6 acts similarly by suppressing inflammatory signaling. Loss of SIRT3, in contrast, activates the NLRP3 inflammasome and enhances adipose tissue inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過抑制 NF-κB 訊號、減少巨噬細胞浸潤並促進向抗發炎 M2 表型的極化，在脂肪組織中發揮抗發炎作用；SIRT6 也藉由抑制發炎訊號產生類似效果。相反地，SIRT3 缺失會活化 NLRP3 發炎小體並加劇脂肪組織發炎。

links.context: SIRT1 forms a molecular complex with Atg5, Atg7 and Atg8, and transiently increased expression of SIRT1 is sufficient to stimulate basal rates of autophagy; SIRT1 also interacts with the Cullin 4B-Ring E3 ligase complex, which promotes autophagy of cancer cells.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 與 Atg5、Atg7、Atg8 形成分子複合體，而 SIRT1 的短暫表現增加即足以刺激基礎自噬速率；SIRT1 亦與 Cullin 4B-Ring E3 連接酶複合體交互作用，後者可促進癌細胞的自噬。

links.context: SIRT1 is an NAD+-dependent deacetylase, so its activity depends on maintaining the NAD+ pool that Vitamin B3 feeds. Age-related NAD+ decline therefore blunts SIRT1 activity, linking B3 status to the sirtuin arm of the redox and longevity axis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 是 NAD+ 相依的去乙醯化酶，因此其活性仰賴由 Vitamin B3 供應的 NAD+ 存量。老化相關的 NAD+ 下降會削弱 SIRT1 活性，將 B3 狀態與 redox 及 longevity 軸線的 sirtuin 分支連結起來。

links.context: SIRT1 is overexpressed in HPV-infected cervical cancer cells and nullifies AIM2 inflammasome-mediated immunity, correlating with poor clinical outcomes. This immunosuppressive action allows cervical cancer cells to evade inflammasome-driven clearance, positioning SIRT1 as an oncogenic factor in HPV-driven cervical cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 HPV 感染的子宮頸癌細胞中過度表現，並使 AIM2 發炎體介導的免疫失效，與不良臨床結果相關。此免疫抑制作用使子宮頸癌細胞逃避免炎體驅動的清除，將 SIRT1 定位為 HPV 驅動子宮頸癌中的致癌因子。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in acute pancreatitis via deacetylation of p53 and HSF1, dampening acinar-cell damage. In chronic pancreatitis, however, SIRT1 is upregulated and drives inflammation-induced EMT through the miR-278 axis, illustrating a context-dependent switch from protection to pathogenesis within the same organ.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在急性胰臟炎中透過 p53 與 HSF1 去乙醯化具有保護性，減弱腺泡細胞損傷。然而在慢性胰臟炎中，SIRT1 上調並透過 miR-278 軸驅動發炎誘發的 EMT，體現同一器官內從保護到致病的情境依賴轉換。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in diabetic kidney disease by deacetylating p53 and activating FoxO3a and Nrf2, and resveratrol promotes resistance to diabetic renal fibrosis via Nrf2. These antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions defend podocytes and the renal tubulointerstitium against hyperglycemic damage.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病腎臟疾病中具保護性，透過去乙醯化 p53 並活化 FoxO3a 與 Nrf2，且 resveratrol 透過 Nrf2 促進對糖尿病腎纖維化的抗性。這些抗氧化與抗凋亡作用防禦足細胞與腎小管間質免於高血糖損傷。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in most Acute Lung Injury models: knockout mice are highly susceptible to sepsis-induced lung injury via NF-kB, and resveratrol reduces injury in LPS sepsis and paraquat models through the SIRT1/NRF2 axis. The picture is context dependent, however, since the SIRT1 inhibitor EX-527 alleviates endotoxemia lung injury by suppressing mTOR.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在多數 Acute Lung Injury 模型中具有保護作用：基因敲除小鼠經由 NF-κB 而高度易感於敗血症誘發的肺損傷，resveratrol 亦透過 SIRT1／NRF2 軸減輕 LPS 敗血症與百草枯模型中的損傷。不過此效應具情境依賴性，因為 SIRT1 抑制劑 EX-527 反而藉由抑制 mTOR 緩解內毒素血症的肺損傷。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in osteoarthritis by reducing chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, reversing homocysteine-induced changes through the PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma cascade, inhibiting EGFR ubiquitination, and inhibiting chondrocyte senescence. SIRT1 therefore maintains cartilage homeostasis on multiple axes.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，經由 PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma 級聯逆轉同半胱氨酸誘發的變化，抑制 EGFR 泛素化，並抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 因此在多軸線上維持軟骨穩態。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in osteoporosis: SIRT1 knockout mice have low bone mass, SIRT1 increases osteoblast osteogenesis via FoxO3a, and it deacetylates sclerostin to promote Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Resveratrol restores alkaline phosphatase and osteocalcin via NF-kB. SIRT1 thus supports bone formation and opposes age-related bone loss.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨質疏鬆症中具保護性：SIRT1 基因敲除小鼠骨量低，SIRT1 透過 FoxO3a 增加造骨細胞成骨，且去乙醯化 sclerostin 以促進 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號。Resveratrol 透過 NF-kB 恢復鹼性磷酸酶與骨鈣素。SIRT1 因此支持骨形成並對抗年齡相關骨流失。

links.context: SIRT1 is protective in renal fibrosis: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis by suppressing CTGF, and the SIRT1 activator SRT1720 attenuates unilateral ureteral obstruction-induced fibrosis. SIRT1-induced HIF-1alpha deacetylation additionally protects against tubulointerstitial damage, while podocyte SIRT1 reduction aggravates glomerulosclerosis and albuminuria.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在腎臟纖維化中具有保護作用：SIRT1 過量表現藉由抑制 CTGF 而消除 TGF-β1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，SIRT1 活化劑 SRT1720 亦可減輕單側輸尿管阻塞誘發的纖維化。SIRT1 誘發的 HIF-1α 去乙醯化另可保護腎小管間質損傷，而 podocyte 中 SIRT1 減少則加重腎小球硬化與白蛋白尿。

links.context: SIRT1 is reduced in degenerative nucleus pulposus tissues with severity, and inhibits NF-kB transcriptional activity while suppressing c-Fos/c-Jun phosphorylation. SIRT2 reverses IL-1beta action by inhibiting the p53/p21 pathway, SIRT3 maintains nucleus pulposus cell homeostasis, and SIRT6 inhibits inflammatory responses and senescence via NF-kB in IDD.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在退行性髓核組織中隨嚴重程度減少，並抑制 NF-kB 轉錄活性同時抑制 c-Fos/c-Jun 磷酸化。SIRT2 透過抑制 p53/p21 路徑逆轉 IL-1beta 作用，SIRT3 維持髓核細胞穩態，且 SIRT6 在 IDD 中透過 NF-kB 抑制發炎反應與衰老。

links.context: SIRT1 may attenuate the atherosclerotic plaque formation driven by Trimethylamine N-oxide: in vascular smooth muscle cells, SIRT1 dampens the TMAO-induced inflammatory response and modulates SM22α expression, slowing disease progression along the TMAO–SIRT1 axis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 可能抑制由 Trimethylamine N-oxide 驅動的動脈粥樣硬化斑塊形成：在血管平滑肌細胞中，SIRT1 會緩和 TMAO 引發的發炎反應並調節 SM22α 表現，沿著 TMAO–SIRT1 軸減緩疾病進展。

links.context: SIRT1 modulates Ca2+ signaling by deacetylating Ca2+-handling proteins including IP3 receptors and SERCA2a. Deacetylation of IP3 receptors tunes endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ leak, while SERCA2a deacetylation influences diastolic Ca2+ handling in cardiomyocytes, linking sirtuin activity to cardiac hypertrophy and neurodegeneration phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由將包括 IP3 受體與 SERCA2a 在內的 Ca2+ 處理蛋白去乙醯化來調節 Ca2+ 訊號。IP3 受體的去乙醯化可調整內質網的 Ca2+ 滲漏，而 SERCA2a 的去乙醯化影響心肌細胞舒張期的 Ca2+ 處理，將 sirtuin 活性與心臟肥大及神經退化表型連結起來。

links.context: SIRT1 modulates the vascular response to Hypertension: VSMC-specific SIRT1 overexpression attenuates Ang II-induced hypertension, SIRT1 activation attenuates Klotho-deficiency arterial stiffness via AMPK/eNOS, and NAMPT-mediated SIRT1 overexpression lowers Ang II-induced ROS production. Decreased urinary SIRT1 serves as a non-invasive biomarker of early hypertensive renal damage.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 調節血管對 Hypertension 的反應：血管平滑肌細胞特異性 SIRT1 過量表現可緩解 Ang II 誘發的高血壓，SIRT1 活化經由 AMPK/eNOS 減輕 Klotho 缺乏造成的動脈僵硬，NAMPT 介導的 SIRT1 過量表現則降低 Ang II 誘發的 ROS。尿液中 SIRT1 下降可作為高血壓性腎臟早期損傷的非侵入性生物標記。

links.context: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO fibrosis, while SIRT1 represses HIF2alpha. However, SIRT1 downregulation may also inhibit fibroblast activation via EGFR/PDGFR-beta, creating therapeutic ambiguity. The dominant role is renoprotective, opposing tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現透過抑制 CTGF 廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 纖維化，而 SIRT1 抑制 HIF2alpha。然而，SIRT1 下調亦可經由 EGFR/PDGFR-beta 抑制纖維母細胞活化，造成治療上的曖昧。其優勢角色為腎保護，對抗小管間質纖維化。

links.context: SIRT1 overexpression prevents capillary cell apoptosis and degenerative capillary formation in diabetic retinopathy, reduces DM-induced retinal inflammation, and improves visual function. In diabetic cardiomyopathy SIRT1 activation inhibits ROS-induced oxidative stress and fibrosis, while SIRT3 regulates fibrosis, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress in the diabetic myocardium.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現防止糖尿病視網膜病變中的微血管細胞凋亡與退行性微血管形成，減少 DM 誘發的視網膜發炎，並改善視覺功能。在糖尿病性心肌病中，SIRT1 活化抑制 ROS 誘發的氧化壓力與纖維化，而 SIRT3 調節糖尿病心肌中的纖維化、發炎、凋亡與氧化壓力。

links.context: SIRT1 promotes T-ALL progression by deacetylating CDK2, which drives p27 phosphorylation and degradation, and SIRT1 knockdown sensitizes AML to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. SIRT2 activation by NAMPT reduces proliferation and induces apoptosis in AML blasts via the Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin axis, showing opposing leukemic roles for the two sirtuins.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2 促進 T-ALL 進展，後者驅動 p27 磷酸化與降解，且 SIRT1 敲低使 AML 對酪胺酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。SIRT2 經由 NAMPT 活化透過 Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin 軸減少增生並誘發 AML 母細胞凋亡，顯示兩個 sirtuin 相反的白血病角色。

links.context: SIRT1 promotes T-lymphocyte acute lymphoblastic leukemia progression by deacetylating CDK2, thereby regulating the phosphorylation and degradation of p27. This links a sirtuin-dependent deacetylation switch to the CDK inhibitor abundance that gates cell-cycle entry.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2，進而調控 p27 的磷酸化與降解，藉以促進 T 淋巴母細胞急性淋巴芽球性白血病（T-ALL）的進展。這將 sirtuin 依賴性的去乙醯化開關，與把關細胞週期進入的 CDK 抑制劑含量連結起來。

links.context: SIRT1 protects against NASH by deacetylating the lipogenic regulators ChREBP and SREBP-1c, maintaining hepatic lipid homeostasis, and by blocking hepatic stellate cell activation so it antagonizes liver fibrosis. Hepocyte-specific sirtuin knockout models show markedly elevated fibrosis and oxidative stress, and the protective role reverses in alcoholic liver disease.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由去乙醯化脂肪生成調節因子 ChREBP 與 SREBP-1c 以維持肝臟脂質恆定，並藉由阻斷 Hepatic Stellate Cells 的活化來對抗肝纖維化，因而保護免受 NASH。肝細胞特異性 sirtuin 剔除模型可見纖維化與氧化壓力顯著升高，且此保護角色在酒精性肝病中會反轉。

links.context: SIRT1 reduces Abeta-induced senescence and mitochondrial dysfunction, reduces tau O-GlcNAcylation via CREB, and enhances Beclin-1 deacetylation for beneficial autophagy in Alzheimer's disease. Inverse serum and saliva SIRT1 levels with AD suggest noninvasive diagnostic potential.
links.context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症中，SIRT1 可減少 β-澱粉樣蛋白誘導的衰老與粒線體功能障礙、透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAc 修飾，並增強 Beclin-1 去乙醯化以促進有益自噬。血清與唾液 SIRT1 濃度與 AD 呈反向關係，具有非侵入性診斷潛力。

links.context: SIRT1 reduces O-GlcNAcylation of tau via CREB in Alzheimer's disease, and SIRT3 plays a role in tau acetylation as a potential therapy target. SIRT2 affects tau phosphorylation and autophagic flux, and nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD where FoxO1 recruits it to Fzd1/Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在阿茲海默症中透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAcylation，且 SIRT3 在 tau 乙醯化中扮演角色，作為潛在治療標的。SIRT2 影響 tau 磷酸化與自噬流，核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，其中 FoxO1 將其招募至 Fzd1/Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac。

links.context: SIRT1 suppresses Caspase-1 (pyroptosis) via the NRF2/PGC-1alpha axis, and suppresses Caspase-3/Caspase-7 via FOXO4, establishing sirtuins as upstream brakes on both apoptotic and pyroptotic execution; SIRT2 is the exception that promotes apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 經由 NRF2/PGC-1alpha 軸抑制 Caspase-1（細胞焦亡），並經由 FOXO4 抑制 Caspase-3/Caspase-7，使 sirtuins 成為細胞凋亡與焦亡執行的上游煞車；SIRT2 是特例，會促進細胞凋亡。

links.context: SIRT1 suppresses Obesity by inhibiting adipogenesis and stimulating energy expenditure, activating AMPK and PGC-1α to increase mitochondrial respiration. In pancreatic tissue, SIRT3 deficiency conversely promotes hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity, and miRNA-dependent repression of SIRT1 mRNA via its 3′-UTR promotes adipogenesis, illustrating that SIRT1 dosage sets the adipogenesis–energy expenditure balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由抑制脂肪生成並促進能量消耗來抑制肥胖（Obesity），其方式是活化 AMPK 與 PGC-1α 以增加粒線體呼吸。反之，在胰臟中 SIRT3 缺乏會在飲食誘導的肥胖中促進肝臟脂肪變性，而透過 SIRT1 mRNA 的 3′-UTR 由 miRNA 造成的抑制則會促進脂肪生成，顯示 SIRT1 的劑量決定了脂肪生成與能量消耗的平衡。

links.context: SIRT1 suppresses intestinal epithelial ROS accumulation and apoptosis after ischemia-reperfusion, and resveratrol protects through the SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO pathway. SIRT3 alleviates mitochondrial oxidative damage and apoptosis via peroxiredoxin 3 deacetylation, while SIRT6 downregulation by miR-351-5p aggravates intestinal IRI injury.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 抑制缺血—再灌流後的腸上皮 ROS 累積與凋亡，且 resveratrol 透過 SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO 路徑保護。SIRT3 經由 peroxiredoxin 3 去乙醯化減輕粒線體氧化損傷與凋亡，而 SIRT6 經由 miR-351-5p 下調加劇腸 IRI 損傷。

links.context: SIRT1 upregulates NAMPT, creating a positive feedback loop. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates PGC-1α, which drives NAMPT transcription; the resulting NAD+ then re-enables SIRT1, so the SIRT1 → NAMPT → NAD+ → SIRT1 loop is self-reinforcing and self-limiting as NAD+ accumulates.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 上調 NAMPT，形成正回饋迴路。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1α，後者驅動 NAMPT 的轉錄；所產生的 NAD+ 又重新使 SIRT1 得以作用，因此 SIRT1 → NAMPT → NAD+ → SIRT1 這個迴路會自我強化，並隨 NAD+ 累積而自我限制。

links.context: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of TRIM28 stabilizes its interaction with 53BP1 and enhances non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) repair, prior to its role as the damage-induced E3 for SIRT1. This reciprocal relationship places SIRT1 and TRIM28 in a coordinated DNA-damage-response axis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 TRIM28 去乙醯化穩定其與 53BP1 的相互作用並增強非同源末端接合（NHEJ）修復，這發生在 TRIM28 作為損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 連接酶之前。這種互惠關係使 SIRT1 和 TRIM28 處於協調的 DNA 損傷反應軸中。
links.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

links.context: SIRT2 binds the 3'UTR of TFEB mRNA and facilitates its stability, raising TFEB expression. The extra TFEB in turn promotes autophagosome-lysosome fusion, so SIRT2 links sirtuin activity to autophagic flux via post-transcriptional control of the master transcription factor.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 會結合 TFEB mRNA 的 3'UTR 並提高其穩定性，使 TFEB 表現上升。增加的 TFEB 隨後促進 autophagosome 與 lysosome 的融合，因此 SIRT2 透過對主轉錄因子進行轉錄後調控，把 sirtuin 活性連結到自噬通量。

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates Akt and other cytoplasmic regulators, keeping the PI3K/Akt axis in an active state. Inhibition of SIRT2 with AC93253 causes Akt acetylation, de-phosphorylation and consequent inactivation, producing antileukemia effects and linking sirtuin inhibition to suppression of PI3K/Akt signaling in cancer cells.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 會將 Akt 及其他細胞質調節因子去乙醯化，使 PI3K/Akt 軸維持於活化狀態。使用 AC93253 抑制 SIRT2 會造成 Akt 乙醯化、去磷酸化並隨之失活，產生抗白血病效應，並將 sirtuin 抑制與癌細胞中 PI3K/Akt 訊號的壓抑連結起來。

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates BRCA1 to promote damage-foci localization; knockdown impairs homologous recombination. Deacetylation is the repair-licensing step.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 BRCA1 以促進損傷灶定位；敲低損害同源重組。去乙醯化是修復許可步驟。

links.context: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation: pharmacologic ablation attenuates the phenotype while genetic overexpression exaggerates it, and SIRT2 aggravates asthma through Th2 responses and macrophage polarization. Unlike the protective SIRT1 and SIRT3 in asthma, SIRT2 is harmful, exemplifying the counter-regulatory relationship between SIRT2 and the protective sirtuins in allergic airway disease.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 增強過敏性氣喘發炎：藥理去除減弱表型，而基因過度表現誇大之，且 SIRT2 透過 Th2 反應與巨噬細胞極化加劇氣喘。不同於氣喘中保護性的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3，SIRT2 是有害的，體現了過敏性氣道疾病中 SIRT2 與保護性 sirtuin 之間的相反調節關係。

links.context: SIRT2 inhibition achieves neuroprotection in cellular and invertebrate models of Huntington's Disease, and manipulating sterol biosynthesis to mimic SIRT2 inhibition diminishes mutant huntingtin toxicity. This makes SIRT2 a target distinct from SIRT1: beneficial in HD by deacetylation-dependent inhibition rather than activation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制在 Huntington's Disease 的細胞與無脊椎動物模型中達成神經保護，而操控類固醇生合成以模擬 SIRT2 抑制可降低突變型 huntingtin 的毒性。這使 SIRT2 成為與 SIRT1 不同的標靶：它是在此疾病中藉由去乙醯化依賴的抑制（而非活化）而有益。

links.context: SIRT2 is detrimental in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: it deacetylates MAPK phosphatase-1 to activate MAPK and augment inflammatory responses and cell death, whereas SIRT1 and SIRT3 are protective. SIRT1 is decreased after IRI and its high levels predict superior survival in human liver transplants via suppression of mitochondrial dysfunction through MFN2.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在肝缺血—再灌流損傷中是有害的：它去乙醯化 MAPK 磷酸酶-1 以活化 MAPK 並加劇發炎反應與細胞死亡，而 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 具保護性。SIRT1 在 IRI 後減少，且其高水平透過 MFN2 抑制粒線體功能障礙預測人類肝移植的優越存活。

links.context: SIRT2 is protective in Osteoarthritis because it inhibits extracellular matrix degradation by preventing acetylation of the p65 subunit of NF-κB. Since NF-κB-driven catabolic signalling is a core driver of cartilage matrix loss, SIRT2-mediated deacetylation of p65 reduces the catabolic arm without requiring the broader effects of SIRT1 activation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在骨關節炎（Osteoarthritis）中具有保護作用，因為它藉由阻止 NF-κB 次單元 p65 的乙醯化來抑制細胞外基質降解。由於 NF-κB 驅動的分解代謝訊號是軟骨基質流失的核心驅動因子，SIRT2 對 p65 的去乙醯化可在不需 SIRT1 廣泛效應的情況下降低分解代謝支路。

links.context: SIRT2 is protective in osteoarthritis by preventing p65 acetylation to inhibit ECM degradation, and SIRT6 inhibits chondrocyte senescence by negatively regulating NF-kB-mediated inflammatory responses. SIRT1 reduces chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin, while SIRT3 has a dual role dependent on SOD2 acetylation status.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過防止 p65 乙醯化以抑制 ECM 降解，且 SIRT6 透過負調節 NF-kB 介導的發炎反應抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，而 SIRT3 具有依賴 SOD2 乙醯化狀態的雙重角色。

links.context: SIRT2 mediates exacerbation of alpha-synuclein toxicity in Parkinson's disease, and SIRT2 deletion is protective. NAD+ metabolism alterations activate SIRT2, which decreases acetylated alpha-tubulin and contributes to cytoskeletal dysfunction. This is the rationale behind testing SIRT2 inhibitors such as AK-7 and SirReal2 for PD, although results remain preclinical.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 介導帕金森氏症中 alpha-synuclein 毒性的加劇，且 SIRT2 缺失具保護性。NAD+ 代謝改變活化 SIRT2，後者降低乙醯化 alpha-tubulin 並促成細胞骨架功能障礙。這是在 PD 中測試 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AK-7 與 SirReal2）的理據，儘管結果仍處於臨床前階段。

links.context: SIRT2 prevents NAFLD by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha, but is deleterious in hepatic fibrosis through the SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc axis. SIRT4 upregulation inhibits high-fat-diet-induced lipid accumulation, inflammation, and fibrogenesis via the SIRT4/Smad4 axis, though SIRT4 is harmful in NAFLD by destabilizing mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4 alpha 防止 NAFLD，但在肝纖維化中透過 SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc 軸是有害的。SIRT4 上調透過 SIRT4/Smad4 軸抑制高脂飲食誘發的脂質堆積、發炎與纖維生成，儘管 SIRT4 在 NAFLD 中因不穩定粒線體三功能蛋白質 alpha 而有害。

links.context: SIRT2 suppression alleviates amyloid-beta pathology and cognitive deficits in Alzheimer's disease by inhibiting beta-secretase 1 (BACE1) via reticulon 4B deacetylation. Nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD, recruited by FoxO1 to the Fzd1 and Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac, and SIRT2 inhibition recovers microtubule stabilization and autophagic flux. SIRT2 is thus a harmful, druggable target in AD, opposing protective SIRT1 and SIRT3.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制透過網狀蛋白 4B（reticulon 4B）去乙醯化抑制 beta-secretase 1（BACE1），減輕阿茲海默症的類澱粉-beta 病理與認知缺陷。核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，被 FoxO1 招募至 Fzd1 與 Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac，且 SIRT2 抑制可恢復微管穩定與自噬流。SIRT2 因此是 AD 中一個有害、可藥物化的標的，對抗保護性的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3。

links.context: SIRT3 contributes to the reprogramming of fatty acid synthesis by upregulating and deacetylating ACC1, thereby promoting de novo Lipid Synthesis; in cholangiocarcinoma this promotes tumour invasion and metastasis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過上調並去乙醯化 ACC1，參與脂肪酸合成的重編程，進而促進從頭 Lipid Synthesis；在膽管癌中此作用會促進腫瘤侵襲與轉移。

links.context: SIRT3 couples the glycolysis-to-OXPHOS switch to the redox setpoint, conferring metabolic plasticity in a tumor-type-, stage- and microenvironment-dependent manner. This makes SIRT3 a context-dependent tumor suppressor or oncogene.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 將糖解作用至氧化磷酸化的轉換與氧化還原設定點相耦合，賦予代謝可塑性，且此作用依腫瘤類型、分期與微環境而定。這使 SIRT3 成為依情境而異的腫瘤抑制子或致癌基因。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates MnSOD (SOD2); the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio therefore reflects mitochondrial ROS-buffering capacity and links the ratio node to its MnSOD substrate.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD（SOD2）；因此 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例反映粒線體 ROS 緩衝能力，並將比例節點連結至其 MnSOD 基質。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates and stabilizes the mitochondrial glutamate transporter SLC25A22 at K83, preventing its ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation and sustaining mitochondrial glutathione supply. This protects lung adenocarcinoma from ferroptosis, a microenvironment- and redox-dependent survival role.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 K83 去乙醯化並穩定粒線體穀氨酸轉運蛋白 SLC25A22，防止其泛素化和蛋白酶體降解，並維持粒線體麩胱甘肽供應。這保護肺腺癌免受鐵死亡，是一項依賴微環境和氧化還原的存活作用。

links.context: SIRT3 deficiency causes lamina-associated domain detachment, increased chromatin accessibility, and aberrant repetitive-sequence transcription leading to senescence of human MSCs. SIRT1 activation of La Ribonucleoprotein 7 dampens p53 and NF-kB p65 transcriptional activity to ameliorate cellular senescence, while SIRT6 preserves telomere integrity and deacetylates Pol-beta for DNA-damage resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺失造成板層相關域脫離、染色質可及性增加與異常重複序列轉錄，導致人類 MSC 的衰老。SIRT1 活化 La Ribonucleoprotein 7 減弱 p53 與 NF-kB p65 轉錄活性以改善細胞衰老，而 SIRT6 維持端粒完整性並去乙醯化 Pol-beta 以賦予 DNA 損傷抗性。

links.context: SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, and SIRT3 protects the heart through mitochondrial quality control and oxidative-stress defense. As the primary mitochondrial deacetylase it sustains OXPHOS and antioxidant enzymes such as SOD2, so its loss amplifies reperfusion damage. This makes SIRT3 a key mitochondrial cardioprotective factor.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺失加劇心肌缺血—再灌流損傷，且 SIRT3 透過粒線體品質控制與氧化壓力防禦保護心臟。作為主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，它維持 OXPHOS 與 SOD2 等抗氧化酵素，因此其缺失放大再灌流損傷。這使 SIRT3 成為關鍵的粒線體心臟保護因子。

links.context: SIRT3 deficiency within the aging lung promotes a fibrotic response via TGF-beta1 and via alveolar epithelial cell mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis; conversely, SIRT3 overexpression ameliorates asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. The same sirtuin therefore opposes fibrotic remodeling at the mitochondrial level.
links.context_zh_TW: 老化肺部中的 SIRT3 缺乏會透過 TGF-beta1 以及肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體 DNA 損傷與凋亡促進纖維化反應；相反地，SIRT3 過表現可改善石棉誘發的 pulmonary fibrosis。同一個 sirtuin 因而在粒線體層次對抗纖維化重塑。

links.context: SIRT3 depletion in muscle and liver impairs mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and worsens insulin resistance, linking mitochondrial dysfunction to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus pathogenesis. SIRT1-3 levels are reduced while SIRT5 and SIRT6 are elevated in diabetes patients.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在肌肉與肝臟的耗竭會損害粒線體的 Oxidative Phosphorylation 並加重 insulin resistance，將粒線體功能障礙連結到 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 的致病機制。糖尿病患者中 SIRT1-3 下降，而 SIRT5 與 SIRT6 上升。

links.context: SIRT3 is a prosurvival factor protective in ischemic stroke through HIF-1alpha/VEGF signaling in astrocytes, and it is downregulated in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury where enhancing SIRT3 with Wnt/beta-catenin is proposed as a therapeutic target. This extends SIRT3's mitochondrial protective axis to the neurovascular unit.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在缺血性腦中風中是透過星形細胞中 HIF-1alpha/VEGF 訊號的促存活保護因子，且其在腦缺血—再灌流損傷中下調，其中提議以 Wnt/beta-catenin 增強 SIRT3 作為治療標的。這將 SIRT3 的粒線體保護軸延伸至神經血管單元。

links.context: SIRT3 is required to prevent severe renal fibrosis: SIRT3 knockout mice are susceptible to severe fibrosis associated with hyperacetylation of PDH E1alpha at K385. SIRT3 is also protective in kidney stones through an Nrf2/heme oxygenase-1 dependent antioxidant axis, whereas SIRT3/SIRT1 downregulation promotes calcium oxalate crystal–cell adhesion.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 是防止嚴重腎臟纖維化所必需的：SIRT3 knockout 小鼠易發生與 PDH E1α 在 K385 處過度乙醯化相關的嚴重纖維化。SIRT3 亦透過 Nrf2／血紅素加氧酶-1 依賴的抗氧化軸在腎結石中發揮保護作用，而 SIRT3/SIRT1 下調則促進草酸鈣晶體與細胞的黏附。

links.context: SIRT3 knockout mice are susceptible to severe kidney fibrosis due to PDH E1alpha hyperacetylation at K385, and SIRT6 proximal-tubule knockout aggravates UUO fibrosis with the MDL-800 activator mitigating it. SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO-induced fibrosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠因 PDH E1alpha 在 K385 過乙醯化而易罹嚴重腎纖維化，且 SIRT6 近曲小管敲除加劇 UUO 纖維化，而 MDL-800 活化劑減輕之。SIRT1 過度表現透過 CTGF 抑制廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 誘發的纖維化。

links.context: SIRT3 overexpression activates macroautophagy via the AMPK-ULK1 axis, reducing lipid accumulation and thereby limiting Obesity. This places SIRT3 as an energy-sensing node: NAD+-dependent deacetylation of metabolic enzymes in mitochondria converts NAD+ status into control of lipophagy and adiposity, and pancreatic SIRT3 deficiency promotes hepatic steatosis via enhanced 5-hydroxytryptamine synthesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 過量表現可透過 AMPK-ULK1 軸活化巨自噬（macroautophagy），減少脂質堆積並因此限制肥胖（Obesity）。這使 SIRT3 成為一個能量感測節點：在粒線體中對代謝酵素進行 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯化，把 NAD+ 狀態轉換成對脂噬與脂肪量的調控；而胰臟 SIRT3 缺乏會透過 5-羥色胺合成增加而促進肝臟脂肪變性。

links.context: SIRT3 overexpression attenuates both Ang II-induced and DOCA-salt-induced hypertension. Conversely, diminished SIRT3 causes redox-dependent inactivation of MnSOD (SOD2), which contributes to hypertension pathogenesis; SIRT3 also alleviates hypertensive renal injury by suppressing EMT. SIRT3 thus acts as an endogenous antioxidant brake on hypertensive target-organ damage.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 過量表現可緩解 Ang II 誘發與 DOCA-salt 誘發的 Hypertension。相反地，SIRT3 減少會造成 MnSOD（SOD2）的氧化還原失活，參與高血壓的致病；SIRT3 亦藉抑制 EMT 減輕高血壓性腎損傷。SIRT3 因此是高血壓標器官損傷的內源性抗氧化煞車。

links.context: SIRT3 overexpression suppresses ovarian cancer metastasis via Twist-downregulation-driven EMT inhibition. In contrast SIRT3 promotes viability in glioma by stabilizing the Ku70-Bax interaction, and in cervical cancer it promotes invasion and metastasis by reprogramming fatty acid synthesis through ACC1 upregulation. The metastatic effect of SIRT3 is therefore tumor-type dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 過度表現透過 Twist 下調驅動的 EMT 抑制，抑制卵巢癌轉移。相對地，SIRT3 在膠質瘤中透過穩定 Ku70-Bax 交互作用促進存活，而在子宮頸癌中透過 ACC1 上調重編程脂肪酸合成來促進侵犯與轉移。因此 SIRT3 的轉移效應依腫瘤類型而異。

links.context: SIRT3 promotes MnSOD expression to protect against hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury, and SIRT3-deficient mice develop more severe ALI through NLRP3 activation in macrophages. SIRT3 therefore defends the lung epithelium against oxidative and inflammatory damage by sustaining mitochondrial antioxidant capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 促進 MnSOD 表現以對抗高氧誘發的急性肺損傷，且 SIRT3 缺失小鼠透過巨噬細胞中 NLRP3 活化發展更嚴重的 ALI。SIRT3 因此透過維持粒線體抗氧化能力，防禦肺上皮免於氧化與發炎損傷。

links.context: SIRT3 promotes expression of the autophagic proteins Beclin1 and LC3II by downregulating the Notch Signaling-1/Hes-1 pathway, linking sirtuin activity to autophagic flux induction.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由下調 Notch Signaling-1／Hes-1 路徑促進自噬相關蛋白 Beclin1 與 LC3II 的表現，將 sirtuin 活性與自噬通量誘導連結起來。

links.context: SIRT3 protects against Acute Lung Injury by promoting MnSOD expression in the lung, so that SIRT3-deficient mice develop more severe hyperoxia-induced injury, in part through NLRP3 inflammasome activation in alveolar macrophages.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由促進肺部的 MnSOD 表現而對抗 Acute Lung Injury，因此 SIRT3 缺乏小鼠在高氧誘導下會出現更嚴重的損傷，部分原因是肺泡巨噬細胞中的 NLRP3 發炎小體被活化。

links.context: SIRT3 protects against NASH by improving mitochondrial function, deacetylating mitochondrial trifunctional proteins and LCAD. Because lipid metabolic dysregulation and mitochondrial dysfunction are both drivers of NASH progression, this positions the NAD+-dependent mitochondrial deacetylase as a brake on the disease.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由改善粒線體功能、而去乙醯化粒線體三功能蛋白與 LCAD，來保護免受 NASH。由於脂質代謝失調與粒線體功能障礙都是 NASH 進展的驅動因素，這使這個 NAD+ 依賴型粒線體去乙醯化酶成為對此疾病的煞車。
