links.context: Fibromyalgia is a chronic disorder of unknown etiology characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, non-restorative sleep and cognitive dysfunction. It is frequently comorbid with chronic fatigue syndrome, irritable bowel syndrome, migraine, temporomandibular joint disorder and mood disorders, and both fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue syndrome are thought to involve impaired energy metabolism, supporting a shared bioenergetic mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: Fibromyalgia 是一種病因未明的慢性疾病，特徵為廣泛性肌肉骨骼疼痛、疲勞、非恢復性睡眠與認知功能障礙。它常與 chronic fatigue syndrome、irritable bowel syndrome、migraine、顳顎關節障礙及情緒障礙共病，而 fibromyalgia 與 chronic fatigue syndrome 皆被認為涉及能量代謝受損，支持兩者共有的生物能量學機制。

links.context: Fisetin is a poorly soluble flavonoid whose bioavailability is limited by dissolution; SNEDDS encapsulation is the remedy described in the note. In a rotenone Parkinson's disease model the fisetin-SNEDDS formulation reduced TNFα and IL-6 and raised glutathione, superoxide dismutase and catalase, showing that improved delivery translates into neuroprotection and antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種難溶性的類黃酮，其生體可用性受溶出度限制；SNEDDS 的包載即是該筆記中所述的解決方式。在 rotenone 誘發的 Parkinson's disease 模型中，fisetin-SNEDDS 配方降低了 TNFα 與 IL-6，並提升 glutathione、superoxide dismutase 與 catalase，顯示改善遞送可轉化為神經保護與抗氧化防禦。

links.context: Flippases maintain the resting asymmetry with phosphatidylserine inward, and scramblases reverse it. Scramblase and flippase are therefore functionally opposed executors of the same membrane decision: rising calcium switches scramblase on and flippase off, collapsing phosphatidylserine asymmetry within minutes to expose the eat-me signal.
links.context_zh_TW: Flippase 藉由將 phosphatidylserine 維持在內側來維持靜止時的不對稱性，而 scramblase 則將其反轉。因此 scramblase 與 flippase 是同一個膜決策的功能性對立執行者：鈣濃度上升會開啟 scramblase 並關閉 flippase，在數分鐘內使 phosphatidylserine 不對稱性崩解而暴露 eat-me 訊號。

links.context: Fructose is more reactive than glucose, so polyol flux feeds glycation and end-product accumulation. Reactivity differential drives the contribution.
links.context_zh_TW: 果糖比葡萄糖更具反應性，故多元醇通量供養糖化與終產物累積。反應性差異驅動貢獻。

links.context: G1 is the principal point of entry into quiescence (G0), a reversible arrest state occupied by differentiated tissues and stem cells. Cells can re-enter G1 from G0 in response to injury or mitogenic stimulation, and G1 length modulates stem cell self-renewal versus differentiation.
links.context_zh_TW: G1 是進入靜止期（G0）的主要入口點，靜止期是被分化組織和幹細胞佔據的可逆停滯狀態。細胞可因損傷或促有絲分裂刺激而從 G0 重新進入 G1，且 G1 長度調節幹細胞的自我更新與分化之間的平衡。

links.context: GATA4 is a transcriptional regulator that promotes the pro-inflammatory SASP by activating NF-kB, in part through TRAF3IP2 (Act1), and by inhibiting autophagy, which would otherwise clear damaging organelles and dampen inflammatory signals. Its accumulation in senescent cells makes it an upstream driver of the secretome's inflammatory arm, coupling defective organelle turnover directly to cytokine production. Unlike many SASP regulators that act on a single pathway, GATA4 integrates both transcriptional and autophagy-based control. The mechanism is well supported and positions GATA4 as a distinctive senescence-specific SASP regulator.
links.context_zh_TW: GATA4 是一種轉錄調節者，透過活化 NF-κB（部分經由 TRAF3IP2（Act1））並抑制自噬，促進促發炎性 SASP，而自噬本可清除受損胞器並減弱發炎訊號。其在衰老細胞中的累積使其成為分泌組發炎臂的上游驅動者，將缺陷的胞器更新直接耦合到細胞激素產生。不同於多數作用於單一路徑的 SASP 調節者，GATA4 整合轉錄與基於自噬的控制。此機制獲良好支持，並將 GATA4 定位為獨特的衰老特異性 SASP 調節者。

links.context: GCN2 is the amino-acid sensor that translates IDO1-mediated tryptophan depletion into regulatory T cell differentiation and T-cell anergy. Sensing reduced available amino acids, GCN2 activates a nutrient-stress response that biases T cells toward a suppressive FoxP3+ phenotype, linking tryptophan catabolism to peripheral tolerance.
links.context_zh_TW: GCN2 是將 IDO1 所致的 tryptophan 耗竭轉譯為調節性 T 細胞分化與 T 細胞無反應的胺基酸感測器。在感知可利用胺基酸減少後，GCN2 啟動營養壓力反應，使 T 細胞偏向抑制性的 FoxP3+ 表型，將 tryptophan 分解代謝與周邊耐受連結起來。

links.context: GCN2, a stress kinase activated by amino-acid scarcity, brakes global protein synthesis. Unlike a blanket shutdown, this response is selective: bulk translation is suppressed while ATF4 translation is permitted, so cells conserve energy and still mount a transcriptional stress response. PERK acts similarly under ER stress.
links.context_zh_TW: GCN2 是由胺基酸缺乏活化的壓力激酶，會抑制整體蛋白質合成。與全面停產不同，這項反應具有選擇性：大部分轉譯被壓抑，但 ATF4 的轉譯仍被允許，因此細胞在節省能量的同時仍能啟動轉錄性的壓力反應。PERK 在內質網壓力下的作用亦然。

links.context: GLO2, the second isoenzyme of the Glyoxalase System, hydrolyzes S-D-lactoylglutathione to D-lactate and in the process regenerates Glutathione, effectively recycling the cofactor consumed when glutathione adducts formed with methylglyoxal. This makes GLO2-dependent glutathione sparing a major defense against dicarbonyl and AGE accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: GLO2 作為 Glyoxalase System 的第二個同工酶，水解 S-D-lactoylglutathione 生成 D-lactate，並在過程中再生 Glutathione，等於回收了 glutathione 與 methylglyoxal 結合時消耗的輔因子。這使 GLO2 依賴的 glutathione 節省成為對抗二碳醣基與 AGE 累積的重要防禦。

links.context: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
links.context_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

links.context: Gasdermin D pore formation by the noncanonical inflammasome triggers K+ efflux, which in turn activates the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 inflammasome downstream. This creates a hierarchical cascade in which noncanonical activation licenses canonical inflammasome firing and amplifies IL-1beta production and inflammation. In senescence, the relationship connects the IL-1alpha-based senescent-cell pathway to the IL-1beta-based macrophage pathway, coordinating the dual inflammasome axis. It is a well-documented cross-talk between the two inflammasome pathways.
links.context_zh_TW: 非典型發炎體的 gasdermin D 孔洞形成觸發 K+ 外流，繼而下游活化典型 NLRP3/caspase-1 發炎體。這創造層級級聯，其中非典型活化許可典型發炎體點火並放大 IL-1beta 產生，將兩條發炎體途徑連結成單一放大的發炎輸出。在衰老中，此階層使非典型觸發轉化為強健的 IL-1beta 分泌，加強 SASP 的發炎臂。它是發炎體串聯的關鍵機制。

links.context: Gemcitabine requires intracellular phosphorylation by deoxycytidine kinase (dCK) to generate its active diphosphate and triphosphate metabolites. Reduced dCK activity is a documented mechanism of resistance to the drug.
links.context_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 需要由 deoxycytidine kinase（dCK）進行細胞內磷酸化，才能產生有活性的二磷酸和三磷酸代謝物。dCK 活性降低是已記錄的藥物抗藥性機制。

links.context: Genomic imprinting is parent-of-origin germline epigenetic inheritance. Classification nests imprinting in heritable regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 基因組銘印是親源種系表觀遺傳繼承。歸類將銘印嵌套於可遺傳調節。

links.context: Genotoxic stress in therapy-induced senescence generates persistent DNA damage foci termed DNA-SCARS (DNA segments with chromatin alterations reinforcing senescence), which are precursors to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments. These structures sustain DDR signaling and the arrested state, and their shedding into the cytosol activates cGAS-STING and the SASP. DNA-SCARS thereby mechanistically link damage to durable senescence and inflammation. They are a defining feature distinguishing TIS from transient damage responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 治療誘發衰老中的基因毒性壓力產生稱為 DNA-SCARS（具染色質改變以強化衰老的 DNA 片段）的持續 DNA 損傷灶，它們是胞質染色質片段的前驅物。這些結構維持 DDR 訊號與停滯狀態，其脫落至胞質活化 cGAS-STING 與 SASP。DNA-SCARS 因此在機制上將損傷連結到持久衰老與發炎。它們是區分 TIS 與短暫損傷反應的定義性特徵。

links.context: Genotoxic stress is a primary inducer committing damaged cells to senescent arrest. Induction covers replicative, oncogene and therapy-induced routes.
links.context_zh_TW: 基因毒性壓力是使受損細胞走向衰老停滯的主要誘發因子。誘發涵蓋複製、致癌基因與治療誘發路徑。

links.context: Ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice. In the aged thymus, ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease and correlate with functional thymic involution and generalized elevated inflammation, implying that the decline of these hormones contributes to the age-associated inflammatory milieu. In addition to suppressing inflammation, ghrelin has a stimulatory effect on thymus cellularity, increasing early thymic progenitors and recent thymic emigrants.
links.context_zh_TW: Ghrelin減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應。在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平下降，並與功能性胸腺退化及全面性發炎升高相關，顯示這些激素的衰退促成了年齡相關的發炎環境。除了抑制發炎外，ghrelin對胸腺細胞數量具有刺激作用，可增加早期胸腺前驅細胞與近期胸腺遷出細胞（recent thymic emigrants）。

links.context: Gut Dysbiosis is associated with intestinal inflammation and systemic disease, and the gut-immune axis connects dysbiosis to systemic inflammation and immunosenescence. This makes the microbiome a modifiable node in age-related inflammatory burden, since targeting dysbiosis through NAD+ precursors can dampen gut-derived inflammation in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Gut Dysbiosis 與腸道發炎及全身性疾病相關，而腸道—免疫軸把 dysbiosis 連結到全身性 inflammation 與 immunosenescence。這使 microbiome 成為老化相關發炎負荷中可被調節的節點，因為透過 NAD+ 前驅物針對 dysbiosis 可抑制老化中的腸道衍生發炎。

links.context: H4K16 acetylation by Sas2p marks open transcriptionally active chromatin.
links.context_zh_TW: Sas2p 的 H4K16 乙醯化標記開放的轉錄活性染色質。

links.context: HIF-2α is stabilized when oxygen supply falls, allowing this PAS-domain transcription factor to accumulate in the nucleus and drive hypoxic gene programs, including angiogenic responses in vascular endothelium.
links.context_zh_TW: 當氧氣供應下降時 HIF-2α 會被穩定化，使這個 PAS 結構域轉錄因子在細胞核中累積並啟動缺氧基因程式，包括血管內皮中的血管新生反應。

links.context: HPLC is the primary analytical method used to monitor the degradation of Epinephrine and to quantify the levels of Leuco-adrenochrome and Adrenochrome in pharmaceutical formulations. Chromatographic separation by HPLC is also the standard quality-control tool for detecting Impurity marker species against a Reference standard, and it was used to detect a compound with the same retention time as Adrenochrome in a biological fluid rich in Neutrophils.
links.context_zh_TW: HPLC 是監測 Epinephrine 降解、以及定量藥品製劑中 Leuco-adrenochrome 與 Adrenochrome 含量的主要分析方法。HPLC 的層析分離也是相對於 Reference standard 偵測 Impurity marker 物質的標準品質管制工具；研究者曾以 HPLC 在富含 Neutrophils 的生物液體中檢測到與 Adrenochrome 保留時間相同的化合物。

links.context: HPP+ accumulates in mitochondria via dopamine transporter uptake and inhibits complex I of the electron transport chain, mirroring MPP+ toxicity. Complex I blockade drives oxidative injury in nigral neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: HPP+ 經多巴胺轉運蛋白攝取累積於粒線體，抑制電子傳遞鏈複合體 I，呼應 MPP+ 毒性。複合體 I 阻斷驅動黑質神經元氧化損傷。

links.context: HSF1 is the heat-shock transcription factor that induces HSP70 family chaperone expression under heat shock, oxidative stress, and proteotoxic stress. Its activity is regulated by post-translational modification, and altered HSF1 expression is associated with cancer, neurodegeneration, and developmental disorders; SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of HSF1, enhanced by resveratrol, is part of its stress-protective axis.
links.context_zh_TW: HSF1 是熱休克轉錄因子，在熱休克、氧化壓力與蛋白毒性壓力下誘發 HSP70 家族伴護蛋白的表現。其活性受轉譯後修飾調控，而 HSF1 表現的改變與癌症、神經退化性疾病及發育異常相關；由 resveratrol 強化的 SIRT1 介導之 HSF1 去乙醯化，屬於其抗壓保護軸的一環。

links.context: HSPA8 (HSC70), a member of the heat shock protein 70 family, directly binds phosphorylated ATM, as shown by p-ATM-mediated co-immunoprecipitation, and this interaction is specifically attenuated by apigenin treatment. ATM is the central modulator of the DNA damage response whose activation drives a persistent SASP; the HSPA8-ATM crosstalk represents an upstream transduction step in the transition from the acute stress-associated phenotype to the full SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是熱休克蛋白 70 家族的成員，可直接結合磷酸化的 ATM（如 p-ATM 介導的共免疫沉澱所示），而此交互作用會特異性地被芹菜素處理削弱。ATM 是 DNA 損傷反應的核心調節者，其活化會驅動持續性的 SASP；HSPA8-ATM 交互對話代表從急性壓力相關表現型轉變為完整 SASP 過程中的上游傳導步驟。

links.context: HUWE1/ARF-BP1 ubiquitinates p53, a reaction blocked by ARF.
links.context_zh_TW: HUWE1/ARF-BP1 泛素化 p53，此反應被 ARF 阻斷。

links.context: Hamartomas in mTORopathies are the direct manifestation of mTORC1 hyperactivation: loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 relieve inhibition of Rheb, driving constitutive mTORC1 signaling and benign overgrowths such as cortical tubers, subependymal giant cell astrocytoma, renal angiomyolipoma, and cardiac rhabdomyoma. Unlike an oncogene-induced senescence nevus, the growth is ongoing rather than arrested.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORopathy 中的 hamartoma 是 mTORC1 過度活化的直接表現：TSC1 或 TSC2 的功能缺失突變解除了對 Rheb 的抑制，造成 mTORC1 訊號組成性活化與良性過度生長，例如皮質結節、室管膜下巨細胞星形細胞瘤、腎血管平滑肌脂肪瘤與心律橫紋肌瘤。與致癌基因誘發衰老的痣不同，這種生長是持續進行而非停滯的。

links.context: HeLa cells carry integrated human papillomavirus 18 E6 and E7 oncoproteins that inactivate the p53 and Rb tumor suppressors, which is what allows this cervical adenocarcinoma-derived line to proliferate without control. HeLa therefore serves both as a cancer model and as a foundational tool for cancer biology, and its transformed genotype limits physiological fidelity in experiments.
links.context_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞帶有整合的 human papillomavirus 18 E6 與 E7 致癌蛋白，它們使 p53 與 Rb 腫瘤抑制因子失去功能，正是這讓這株源自子宮頸腺癌的細胞系得以不受控制地增殖。HeLa 因此既是癌症模型，也是癌症生物學的基礎研究工具，但其轉型化的基因型限制了實驗的生理忠實度。

links.context: HemF-like (coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like) enzymes are biocatalysts identified by functional metagenomics in soil bacteria that can use synthetic Glucosepane as a nutrient source. The human homolog of HemF, together with homologous bacterial proteins in the human microbiome such as Escherichia and Pseudomonas, catalyzes cleavage of the glucosepane ring in vitro, releasing Citrulline as a byproduct — the only known route for enzymatically reversing this AGE crosslink.
links.context_zh_TW: HemF-like（coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like）酵素是由功能性 metagenomics 在土壤細菌中發現的生物催化劑，能以合成的 Glucosepane 作為養分來源。HemF 的人類同源蛋白，以及人體微生物組中如 Escherichia 與 Pseudomonas 的同源蛋白，能在體外催化 glucosepane 環的切斷，並釋出 Citrulline 作為副產物——這是已知唯一能以酵素方式逆轉此 AGE 交聯的途徑。

links.context: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

links.context: Higher Christensenellaceae abundance in the Gut Microbiome is consistently associated with lower Body Mass Index, lean body composition and successful aging, and the family is enriched in Centenarians. The same taxon is among the most heritable in the human Gut Microbiome, tracking host genotype more strongly than most other microbes.
links.context_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 中較高的 Christensenellaceae 豐度，與較低的 Body Mass Index、瘦體組成及 successful aging 高度相關，且此菌科在 Centenarians 中被富集。在人類 Gut Microbiome 中，它是遺傳性最高的類群之一，與宿主基因型的關聯強於多數其他微生物。

links.context: Higher open-chain keto fraction makes fructose more glycating than glucose, feeding end-product formation. Carbonyl availability drives the contribution.
links.context_zh_TW: 較高的開鏈酮比例使果糖比葡萄糖更易糖化，供養終產物形成。羰基可用性驅動貢獻。

links.context: Honokiol exerts neuroprotection in part by preserving the activity of the Na+/K+-ATPase, the membrane pump critical for maintaining neuronal resting potential and ion homeostasis. In mouse models of cerebral ischemia, honokiol treatment preserved Na+/K+-ATPase activity and enzymatic mitochondrial function, correlating with reduced neuronal damage. Together with phosphorylation of pro-survival factors, preservation of mitochondrial function, and GABA-A modulation, Na+/K+-ATPase preservation is one of at least five distinct parallel mechanisms through which honokiol protects neurons from ischemic and oxidative injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚的神經保護作用部分來自於保存 Na+/K+-ATPase 的活性，此膜幫浦對維持神經元靜止膜電位與離子恆定至關重要。在腦缺血小鼠模型中，厚朴酚治療保存了 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性與粒線體酶功能，並與神經元損傷減輕相關。加上促存活因子的磷酸化、粒線體功能的維持及 GABA-A 調節，Na+/K+-ATPase 保存是厚朴酚保護神經元免於缺血與氧化損傷的至少五種不同平行機制之一。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol inhibits nitric oxide expression in LPS-stimulated macrophages, a key anti-inflammatory effect. Nitric oxide overproduction during inflammation drives vasodilation, tissue damage, and pain; honokiol suppresses its induction by blocking PKC-alpha membrane translocation, MAPK signaling, and NF-kappaB activation. In the setting of cerebral ischemia, honokiol additionally prevents neurotoxic nitric oxide production by disrupting the PSD95-nNOS coupling at the NMDA receptor complex, thereby limiting calcium-dependent nNOS activation and downstream nitrosative neuronal injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚抑制 LPS 刺激巨噬細胞中的一氧化氮表現，此為關鍵的抗發炎效應。發炎期間一氧化氮過量產生會驅動血管擴張、組織損傷與疼痛；厚朴酚透過阻斷 PKC-alpha 膜轉位、MAPK 訊息傳導及 NF-kappaB 活化來抑制其誘導。在腦缺血的情境下，厚朴酚另外透過破壞 NMDA 受體複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯來防止神經毒性一氧化氮產生，從而限制鈣依賴的 nNOS 活化及下游的硝化性神經元損傷。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Hormetins converge on NRF2/ARE signalling by electrophilically modifying Keap1 cysteines, which is why Keap1 modification is the shared upstream node across polyphenol, isothiocyanate and prenylated-flavan hormetins.
links.context_zh_TW: Hormetin 透過以親電方式修飾 Keap1 的半胱胺酸殘基而收斂到 NRF2/ARE 訊號，因此 Keap1 的修飾是多酚類、異硫氰酸酯類與異戊烯化黃烷類 Hormetin 共用的上游節點。

links.context: Humanin is a peptide of approximately 24 amino acids believed to derive from a short, cryptic open reading frame within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA gene, and it was the first identified mammalian mitokine. Originally isolated as a protective factor against familial Alzheimer's disease, humanin circulates in plasma and exerts cytoprotective and metabolic effects in various experimental paradigms. It is considered the founding member of a class of mitochondrially-derived peptides (MDPs) causing systemic effects in mammals.
links.context_zh_TW: Humanin 是約 24 個胺基酸的胜肽，被認為源自粒線體 16S rRNA 基因內一個簡短、隱蔽的開放閱讀框架，是第一個被鑑定的哺乳類 mitokine。最初作為家族性阿茲海默症的保護因子被分離出來，humanin 循環於血漿中，並在各種實驗範式中發揮細胞保護與代謝效應。它被認為是一類粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）的創始成員，在哺乳類中造成全身性效應。

links.context: Hydroxocobalamin is the parenteral B12 form used to treat deficiency states including pernicious anemia and malabsorption. Repletion corrects the megaloblastic anemia of B12 deficiency.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是用於治療包括惡性貧血與吸收不良在內缺乏狀態的注射 B12 形式。補充矯正 B12 缺乏的巨母紅血球貧血。

links.context: Hydroxyurea stimulates production of fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in red blood cells of sickle cell disease patients. Increased HbF interferes with polymerization of hemoglobin S, reducing vaso-occlusive crises.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 刺激鐮刀型細胞疾病患者的紅血球產生胎兒血紅蛋白（HbF）。HbF 增加會干擾血紅蛋白 S 的聚合，減少血管阻塞性危象。

links.context: ICAD cleavage is a late definitive step of apoptotic DNA fragmentation.
links.context_zh_TW: ICAD 切割是凋亡 DNA 片段化的晚期確定步驟。

links.context: IL-1R transduces signals through IRAK1, the kinase recruited to the receptor complex via the adaptor MyD88. IRAK1 activation leads to NF-kB-dependent transcription and, in the SASP-induction scheme, is also drawn feeding the STING axis, a link that connects receptor-level cytokine feedback to cytosolic DNA-sensing output. This makes IRAK1 a convergence point where autocrine IL-1 signalling and damage-sensing pathways are integrated before they act on the inflammatory transcriptional programme.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1R 經 IRAK1 傳遞訊號，該激酶經銜接蛋白 MyD88 被招募至受體複合體。IRAK1 活化導致 NF-kB 依賴性轉錄，而在 SASP 誘導架構圖中亦被畫為供應 STING 軸，此連結將受體層級的細胞激素回饋接至胞質 DNA 感測輸出。這使 IRAK1 成為匯聚點，自泌 IL-1 訊號與損傷感測路徑在此整合後才作用於發炎轉錄程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: IL-1α is a key regulator not previously linked with senescence induction: ectopic IL-1α expression arrested IMR90 cells, causing senescence accompanied by increased oxidative and DNA damage and induction of p53 and p21^CIP1, while IL-1α expression could reproduce SASP activation. In a mouse model where OIS was induced in hepatocytes, IL-1R blockade reduced the percentage of senescent hepatocytes, confirming IL-1 signalling is required for senescence maintenance in vivo.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是先前未與衰老誘導連結的關鍵調節因子：異位表現 IL-1α 使 IMR90 細胞停滯，造成伴隨氧化與 DNA damage 增加以及 p53 與 p21^CIP1 誘導的衰老，而 IL-1α 表現可重現 SASP 的活化。在以肝細胞誘導 OIS 的小鼠模型中，IL-1R 阻斷減少了衰老肝細胞的比例，確認 IL-1 訊號在體內對衰老的維持是必要的。

links.context: IL-4 from Th2 cells drives M2 alternative macrophage polarization, associated with tissue repair and fibrosis, and IL-13 synergizes with IL-4 in this respect with PPARγ acting as a co-activator of the M2 gene program. Th2 cytokines also promote wound healing, fibroblast proliferation, and collagen synthesis — reparative functions that become fibrotic when chronically activated.
links.context_zh_TW: Th2 細胞分泌的 IL-4 驅動 M2 替代性巨噬細胞極化，與組織修復及纖維化相關；在此方面 IL-13 與 IL-4 協同作用，並由 PPARγ 作為 M2 基因程式的輔活化因子。Th2 細胞激素也促進傷口癒合、纖維母細胞增生與膠原合成——這些修復功能在慢性活化時會轉為纖維化。

links.context: IL-6 and other pro-inflammatory SASP cytokines promote MDSC accumulation and activation via JAK/STAT3 signalling, expanding the immunosuppressive myeloid compartment. This creates a feedback loop in which the SASP both recruits and licenses MDSCs, sustaining systemic immune suppression. The relationship links senescent-cell secretion to systemic immune dysfunction and is supported by cancer and aging immunology studies. JAK/STAT3 inhibitors can reduce MDSC expansion, positioning this axis as a therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: MDSCs 被 IL-6 擴張，IL-6 是強效的 SASP 細胞激素，促進未成熟骨髓前驅細胞的存活與增殖。此擴張在慢性發炎與衰老微環境中放大免疫抑制區室，進一步損害 T 細胞功能與衰老監視。透過 IL-6，持續衰老分泌組無意中助長其自身逃避免疫清除。此關係將 SASP 的發炎臂連結到骨髓生成調節與免疫衰老。

links.context: IL-6 is explicitly listed as a SASP cytokine activated downstream of cGAS-STING. Induction records the sensing-to-cytokine direction.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 明確列為 cGAS-STING 下游活化的 SASP 細胞激素。誘發記錄感知到細胞激素的方向。

links.context: IL-8 (CXCL-8), GROα and GROβ are core SASP components that bind CXCR2, creating a self-amplifying secretory network in which CXCR2-binding chemokines reinforce growth arrest. Malignant melanocytes express high levels of CXCR2 and can be stimulated by its ligands IL-8 and GROα, so the senescent microenvironment may stimulate proliferation of rare premalignant cells in nevi and promote melanoma development.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-8（CXCL-8）、GROα 與 GROβ 是核心 SASP 成分，可結合 CXCR2，形成 CXCR2 結合型趨化因子強化生長停滯的正回饋分泌網絡。惡性黑色素細胞高度表現 CXCR2，並可被其配體 IL-8 與 GROα 刺激，因此衰老微環境可能刺激痣中罕見的前惡性細胞增殖並促進 melanoma 形成。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype The Dark Side of Tumor Suppression.md

links.context: IL-8 signalling through CXCR2 expands the cancer stem cell (CSC) pool and promotes tumoursphere formation, linking a core SASP chemokine to stemness in malignant contexts. This enhances tumour aggressiveness and therapy resistance and drives an invasive, EMT-associated phenotype in breast and colorectal models. The relationship positions IL-8 as a stemness-driving SASP component, and it is supported by CXCR2-blockade and tumoursphere assays. Targeting the IL-8/CXCR2 axis is explored as an anti-stemness strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-8 透過 CXCR2 的訊號擴張癌症幹細胞（CSC）池並促進腫瘤球形成，將核心 SASP 趨化因子連結到惡性脈絡中的幹性。這增強腫瘤侵襲性與治療抗藥性，並在乳房與大腸癌中驅動具侵襲性、EMT 相關的表型。在衰老中，IL-8 的此作用將分泌組輸出耦合到幹細胞擴張，貢獻 SASP 的促腫瘤潛力。它是幹性—發炎軸的關鍵節點。

links.context: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is treated by senolytic therapy with the combination of dasatinib and quercetin (D+Q) in a pilot clinical trial (NCT02874989) that improved physical function in patients. The rationale is that accumulation of senescent alveolar epithelial cells and fibroblasts, together with their pro-fibrotic SASP, contributes to IPF pathogenesis and progressive scarring. Results support further evaluation of senolytics in fibrotic lung disease and suggest that clearing senescent cells can attenuate fibrosis-driven functional decline. This is among the most advanced clinical indications for senolytic therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 特發性肺纖維化在試驗性臨床試驗（NCT02874989）中以 dasatinib 與 quercetin（D+Q）組合進行 senolytic 治療，改善患者身體功能。其依據為衰老肺泡上皮細胞與纖維母細胞的累積，連同其促纖維化 SASP，促成 IPF 致病機制與進行性疤痕。結果支持在纖維化肺病進一步評估 senolytics，並提示清除衰老細胞可減弱纖維化驅動的功能衰退。這是 senolytic 療法最先進的臨床適應症之一。

links.context: In C. elegans, ATGL (encoded by atgl-1) acts in parallel to the lipophagy pathway involving the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3, rather than as a component of it. ATGL supplies lipolytic substrate for lysosomal degradation and fatty acid oxidation, so cytosolic and lysosomal routes of fat mobilization are partly redundant; this positioning of ATGL at the interface of the two pathways is why its loss is buffered in C. elegans.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，ATGL（由 atgl-1 編碼）與涉及溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 的 lipophagy 路徑平行作用，而非其組成部分。ATGL 為溶酶體降解與脂肪酸氧化提供脂解受質，因此細胞質與溶酶體兩條脂質動員途徑部分冗餘；ATGL 處於這兩條路徑交界的定位，也解釋了為何在 C. elegans 中其缺失可被緩衝。

links.context: In COVID-19 an unbalanced p53/SIRT1 axis affects lymphocyte homeostasis: because SIRT1 deacetylates p53, low SIRT1 leaves p53 persistently activated, which may contribute to the lymphopenia seen in severe disease. Increased SIRT1 may therefore alleviate pathogenesis, making SIRT1 activation a proposed therapeutic strategy for immune dysfunction in COVID-19.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 COVID-19 中，失衡的 p53/SIRT1 軸會影響淋巴球恆定：因為 SIRT1 會去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 偏低會使 p53 持續活化，可能加重重症所見的淋巴球減少。因此提升 SIRT1 可能有助於減輕致病過程，使 SIRT1 活化成為 COVID-19 免疫功能失調的治療策略。

links.context: In End Stage Renal Disease the relationship with Advanced Glycation End Products runs both ways: elevated levels of AGEs such as CML predict renal function decline, while reduced renal clearance raises circulating AGE burden. The same tissue AGE accumulation that drives micro- and macrovascular damage in diabetes is therefore also linked to renal disease progression.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 End Stage Renal Disease 中，與 Advanced Glycation End Products 的關係是雙向的：CML 等 AGE 濃度升高可預測腎功能衰退，而腎臟清除能力下降又會提高循環中的 AGE 負荷。因此，在糖尿病中驅動微血管與大血管損傷的組織 AGE 累積，同樣也與腎病進展相關。

links.context: In OXPHOS-addicted malignancies such as AML, SIRT3 is critical for leukemia stem cell survival via FAO→OXPHOS→ATP, while SIRT3 inhibition spares normal hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells — a therapeutic window. SIRT3 therefore maintains the stemness and stress resistance of Cancer Stem Cells by supporting fatty acid oxidation, OXPHOS, and ROS buffering.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 AML 等 OXPHOS 成癮型惡性腫瘤中，SIRT3 對白血病幹細胞的存活至關重要，途徑為脂肪酸氧化→OXPHOS→ATP；而抑制 SIRT3 則可 sparing 正常造血幹／前驅細胞，形成治療窗口。因此 SIRT3 透過支持脂肪酸氧化、OXPHOS 與 ROS 緩衝，維持 Cancer Stem Cells 的幹性與抗逆境能力。

links.context: In TDP-43 models, STING inhibition reduces motor neuron death, and in iPSC-derived motor neurons it rescues TDP-43-mediated toxicity. The rescue relationship between STING blockade and TDP-43 pathology is one of the strongest arguments for these compounds as neuroprotective agents, and it is balanced by the caution that genetic STING deficiency also accelerates cognitive and motor decline.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 TDP-43 模型中，抑制 STING 可減少運動神經元死亡；在 iPSC 衍生的運動神經元中，則可挽救 TDP-43 媒介的毒性。STING 阻斷與 TDP-43 病變之間的挽救關係，是支持這些化合物作為神經保護劑的最強論據之一；但也須謹慎，因為 STING 遺傳性缺乏反而會加速認知與運動功能衰退。

links.context: In aging models, mTOR inhibition by rapamycin is associated with increased autophagy, reduced cellular senescence and delayed aging. Rapamycin reduces markers of senescence in human skin in an exploratory randomized trial, and mid-life administration delays onset of age-related pathologies in mice. In contrast with its robust effects in monogenic mTORopathies where the molecular etiology is clearly defined, aging is a heterogeneous, multifactorial process without a single dominant pathway, which may explain why mTOR inhibition yields robust disease-modifying effects in epilepsy models but inconsistent outcomes in aging research.
links.context_zh_TW: 在老化模型中，rapamycin對mTOR的抑制與自噬增加、細胞衰老減少和老化延遲相關。在探索性隨機試驗中，rapamycin減少人類皮膚中的衰老標誌物，中年給藥延遲小鼠年齡相關病理的發病。與其在分子病因明確定義的單基因mTORopathies中的強健效應相比，老化是一個異質性、多因素過程，沒有單一主導途徑，這可能解釋了為何mTOR抑制在癲癇模型中產生強健的疾病修正效應，但在老化研究中結果不一致。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: In animal behavioral models, honokiol produces anxiolysis at doses as low as 0.2 mg/kg with fewer motor and cognitive side effects than the benzodiazepine diazepam. The anxiolytic effect of honokiol is blocked by flumazenil, bicuculline, CCK-4, and caffeine, whereas these agents differentially affect diazepam's anxiolysis (e.g., caffeine enhances diazepam's effect), suggesting honokiol may act through partly alternative pathways in addition to GABA-A potentiation. This favorable side-effect profile is a key rationale for developing honokiol as an anxiolytic.
links.context_zh_TW: 在動物行為模型中，厚朴酚在低至 0.2 mg/kg 的劑量下即產生抗焦慮作用，且運動與認知副作用少於苯二氮平類藥物地西泮。厚朴酚的抗焦慮作用可被氟馬西尼、荷包牡丹鹼、CCK-4 及咖啡因阻斷，而這些藥劑對地西泮抗焦慮作用的影響則各不相同（例如咖啡因會增強地西泮的效果），顯示厚朴酚除了 GABA-A 強化之外，可能部分經由替代路徑發揮作用。這種良好的副作用特性是開發厚朴酚為抗焦慮藥物的關鍵理由。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: In both oncogene-induced and replicative senescence, the Condensin SMC2-SMC4 complex shows increased binding at B-to-A compartment-switching regions, which are enriched for SASP genes and coincide with their upregulation. Condensin therefore couples compartment repositioning to SASP transcription, placing it in the 3D-genome rewiring that licenses the secretory phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 在致癌基因誘導與複製性衰老中，Condensin 的 SMC2-SMC4 複合體在 B-to-A 區室轉換區域的結合增加，而這些區域富含 SASP 基因並與其上調同步。因此 Condensin 將區室重定位與 SASP 的轉錄相偶聯，使其位於授權分泌表型的三維基因組重塑之中。

links.context: In breast tumor cell lines SIRT1 is found predominantly in the cytoplasm — very little nuclear signal — in contrast to the nuclear distribution seen in normal breast tissue. Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is the form that regulates the 14-3-3ζ-caspase-2 module, and cytoplasmic SIRT1 is also the form generated by caspase cleavage during apoptosis, where it behaves pro-apoptotically in a deacetylase-independent manner. Subcellular localization therefore flips SIRT1's functional valence: nuclear anti-apoptotic, cytoplasmic context-dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: 在乳腺癌細胞株中，SIRT1 主要分布於細胞質——核內訊號極少——與正常乳腺組織的細胞核分布形成對比。細胞質型 SIRT1 正是調控 14-3-3ζ-Caspase-2 模組的形式，也是細胞凋亡期間被 caspase 切割後產生的形式，此時它以不依賴去乙醯活性的方式促進凋亡。次細胞定位因此翻轉了 SIRT1 的功能極性：細胞核內抗凋亡，細胞質內則視情境而定。
links.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

links.context: In canine mitral valve interstitial cells from dogs with Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease, rapamycin and torin-1 reverse senescence via autophagy; in canine MSCs, rapamycin phenocopies curcumin's autophagy-mediated delay of senescence. Rapamycin also clears p16/p21 via p62-mediated selective autophagy, giving high biological plausibility for cardiac aging endpoints.
links.context_zh_TW: 在取自罹患 Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease 之犬的僧帽瓣間質細胞中，rapamycin 與 torin-1 可透過自噬逆轉 Senescence；在犬間質幹細胞中，rapamycin 可模擬薑黃素藉自噬延緩 Senescence 的效果。Rapamycin 亦透過 p62 媒介的選擇性自噬清除 p16/p21，為心臟老化終點提供高度的生物學合理性。

links.context: In clinical studies, the Val158 allele has been linked with increased risk for schizophrenia in some populations, as well as a poorer response to antipsychotic treatment. The same polymorphism influences vulnerability to environmental risk factors, such as cannabis use increasing psychosis risk selectively in Val158 homozygotes. The effect is modest relative to overall genetic architecture.
links.context_zh_TW: 在臨床研究中，Val158 等位基因已在某些人群中與精神分裂症風險增加以及對抗精神病藥物治療反應較差相關。同一多態性影響對環境風險因素的脆弱性，例如在 Val158 純合子中，青春期使用大麻會選擇性地增加精神病風險。相對於整體遺傳結構，此效應不大。
links.source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md

links.context: In female mammals the primary oocyte arrests at prophase I of Meiosis and remains quiescent there for years, whereas most other cell types enter quiescence in the G0 phase. This prophase I arrest makes the maternal Meiotic program the rate-limiting and highly error-prone step in human reproduction.
links.context_zh_TW: 在雌性哺乳動物中，初級卵母細胞會停滯於 Meiosis 的前期 I 並在其中維持數年的靜止，而其他多數細胞類型則進入 G0 期的靜止狀態。這種前期 I 停滯使母源的 Meiosis 程序成為人類生殖中速率最慢且最容易出錯的步驟。

links.context: In ischemia-reperfusion injury, caspase-1 cleaves the BH3-only protein Bid, converting pyroptotic signaling into mitochondrial apoptosis. In gasdermin-D-deficient cells, caspase-1 drives the full Bid/caspase-9/caspase-3 apoptotic cascade — sometimes followed by GSDME-dependent pyroptosis to eliminate uncleared apoptotic bodies. This demonstrates that inflammasome sensors can trigger apoptosis when the pyroptotic executor is missing, a physiologically relevant mechanism in cells with minimal GSDMD expression such as neurons and mast cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 在缺血再灌注損傷中，Caspase-1 會切割 BH3-only 蛋白 Bid，將焦亡訊號轉為粒線體凋亡。在 gasdermin-D 缺陷細胞中，Caspase-1 可驅動完整的 Bid/Caspase-9/Caspase-3 凋亡級聯——有時隨後再以 GSDME 依賴的焦亡清除未被清理的凋亡小體。這證明當焦亡執行者缺席時，發炎體感應器也能觸發細胞凋亡；此機制在 GSDMD 表達極低的細胞（如神經元與肥大細胞）中具生理相關性。

links.context: In senescent cells, surface-bound IL-1α engages IL-1 receptors and recruits MyD88, sustaining constitutive NF-κB activation and therefore the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype. MyD88 sits at the interface of innate immune signaling and senescent inflammatory output, and its loss blunts SASP amplification.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，細胞表面結合的 IL-1α 與 IL-1 受體結合並招募 MyD88，維持構成性的 NF-κB 活化，因而維持 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype。MyD88 處於先天免疫訊號與衰老細胞發炎性輸出的交界處，其缺失會削弱 SASP 的放大作用。

links.context: In the cytosol ACLY cleaves Citrate into Acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate. The acetyl-CoA thereby released supplies de novo Lipid Synthesis and histone acetylation, while pharmacological disruption of citrate export or ACLY depletes cytosolic acetyl-CoA and selectively suppresses the SASP without affecting cell viability.
links.context_zh_TW: 在細胞質中 ACLY 將 Citrate 切割為 Acetyl-CoA 與 oxaloacetate。由此釋出的 acetyl-CoA 供應 de novo Lipid Synthesis 與 histone acetylation；而以藥理方式阻斷柠檬酸輸出或 ACLY，會耗竭細胞質 acetyl-CoA 並選擇性抑制 SASP，同時不影響細胞存活。

links.context: In the intestine and liver, apigenin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 (UGT1A1), the key enzyme converting it into glucuronide and sulfate derivatives that are more readily transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, and apigenin itself induces UGT1A1 transcription in colon cells. Combined treatment with sulforaphane synergistically increased UGT1A1 mRNA induction, although apigenin did not induce GSTA1. This phase II metabolism underlies apigenin's rapid clearance and low plasma bioavailability after oral dosing, while its slow systemic elimination may allow peripheral tissue accumulation that supports chemopreventive efficacy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在腸道與肝臟中，芹菜素會被UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶1A1（UGT1A1）廣泛結合，此關鍵酵素將其轉化為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸衍生物，這些衍生物更易於在血液中運輸並經由膽汁或尿液排出；而芹菜素本身也會在結腸細胞中誘導UGT1A1的轉錄。與蘿蔔硫素（sulforaphane）合併處理可協同增強UGT1A1 mRNA的誘導，不過芹菜素不會誘導GSTA1。此第二相反應代謝是芹菜素口服後快速清除與低血漿生體可用率的原因，而其緩慢的全身性排除則可能使周邊組織累積，進而支持其化學預防功效。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: In vascular aging, senescent Endothelial Cells undergoing Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition lose endothelial traits and acquire mesenchymal, MSC-like contractile markers, so the mesenchymal gene signature is used as a readout of this transdifferentiation. The transition is driven by the SASP factor CXCL12, whose release is reversed by fisetin treatment.
links.context_zh_TW: 在血管老化過程中，發生 Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition 的衰老 Endothelial Cells 會失去內皮特徵並獲得間質幹細胞樣的收縮標記，因此間質基因簽章被用作此轉分化的讀值指標。此轉化由 SASP 因子 CXCL12 驅動，而 fisetin 治療可逆轉其釋放。

links.context: In yeast, accumulation of mitochondrial precursor proteins in the cytosol initially triggers activation of the transcription factor HSF1, an ancient regulator of chaperone expression. HSF1 subsequently activates RPN4, a short-lived protein that directly interacts with the proteasome and regulates expression of multiple proteasomal subunits, as well as the transcription factor PDR3. This mitoprotein-induced stress response increases cytosolic chaperone activity, augments the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and clears proteins clogging the mitochondrial translocase, while OXPHOS machinery repression occurs independently of the HSF1-RPN4-PDR3 axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在酵母中，粒線體前體蛋白在細胞質中的積累最初觸發轉錄因子 HSF1 的活化，HSF1 是分子伴護表達的古老調節因子。HSF1 隨後活化 RPN4，RPN4 是一種短壽命蛋白，直接與蛋白酶體相互作用並調節多個蛋白酶體亞基的表達，以及轉錄因子 PDR3。這種粒線體蛋白誘導的壓力反應增加細胞質分子伴護活性，增強泛素-蛋白酶體系統，並清除阻塞粒線體轉位酶的蛋白質，而 OXPHOS 機制的抑制獨立於 HSF1-RPN4-PDR3 軸發生。

links.context: Integrin-dependent adhesion turnover at focal adhesions drives cell migration during development, wound healing and immune trafficking. Each integrin heterodimer has defined ligand specificity that directs migration in distinct tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Integrin 依賴的黏著斑黏附更新在發育、傷口癒合和免疫運輸期間驅動細胞遷移。每個 integrin 異二聚體具有明確的配體特異性，指導不同組織中的遷移。

links.context: Integrins are the primary receptors transducing laminin signals. Binding is the signal-entry pairing.
links.context_zh_TW: Integrin 是傳導 laminin 訊號的主要受體。結合是訊號進入配對。

links.context: Intermittent Fasting and Caloric Restriction exert cardioprotective roles largely by promoting Autophagic Flux: IF reduces infarct area in mouse models of Ischemia-reperfusion Injury, and in aged models of acute Myocardial infarction it upregulates Atg5 and reduces cardiac injury markers. In ischemic conditions AMPK activation and the resulting Autophagy protect injured cells, whereas deficient Autophagy is linked to Ventricular Remodeling and Cardiomyocyte Toxicity — which is why Autophagic Flux is considered crucial for cardiomyocyte homeostasis and heart function.
links.context_zh_TW: Intermittent Fasting 與 Caloric Restriction 主要藉由促進 Autophagic Flux 發揮心臟保護作用：IF 在缺血再灌流傷害的小鼠模型中縮小梗死面積，並在老化急性 Myocardial infarction 模型中上調 Atg5、減少心臟損傷標記。在缺血條件下 AMPK 活化及其後續的 Autophagy 保護受損細胞，而 Autophagy 不足則與 Ventricular Remodeling 及 Cardiomyocyte Toxicity 相關——因此 Autophagic Flux 被視為維持心肌細胞恆定與心臟功能的關鍵。

links.context: Isogenic pairs are the gold standard for monogenic causal attribution.
links.context_zh_TW: 同基因對是單基因因果歸因的黃金標準。

links.context: JNK1 phosphorylates Bcl-2 at Thr69/Ser70/Ser87, inactivating the guardian.
links.context_zh_TW: JNK1 在 Thr69/Ser70/Ser87 磷酸化 Bcl-2，使守護者失活。

links.context: JNK2 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, inactivating it during G2 arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL，在 G2 停滯使其失活。

links.context: KDM5C modulates H3K4 methylation at promoters of p53 target genes, facilitating p53-dependent transcription of cell cycle arrest genes such as p21 CIP1. Loss-of-function KDM5C mutations therefore compromise p53-mediated arrest, and they are also linked to X-linked intellectual disability (Siderius syndrome), underscoring that KDM5C dosage matters for normal neuronal development.
links.context_zh_TW: KDM5C 會調節 p53 目標基因啟動子上的 H3K4 甲基化，促進 p53 依賴性的細胞週期停滯基因（如 p21 CIP1）轉錄。因此 KDM5C 的功能喪失突變會削弱 p53 介導的細胞週期停滯；這些突變也與 X 連鎖智能障礙（Siderius 症候群）相關，顯示 KDM5C 的劑量對正常神經元發育十分重要。

links.context: KGF promotes thymic rejuvenation by increasing thymic cellularity, thymocyte production, and humoral responses to T-dependent antigens. In aged mice a single course of KGF raised thymic cellularity for two months, with monthly maintenance restoring thymic architecture and immune function. Because KGF has targets outside the thymus and the mechanism in the postnatal thymus is still unresolved, the functional quality of the regenerated thymus remains to be established.
links.context_zh_TW: KGF 藉由增加胸腺細胞量、胸腺細胞產量以及對 T 細胞依賴性抗原的體液反應，促進胸腺年輕化。在老化小鼠中，單一療程的 KGF 即可提升胸腺細胞量達兩個月；每月維持給藥可恢復胸腺結構與免疫功能。由於 KGF 在胸腺外亦具有標的，且在出生後胸腺中的作用機制仍未釐清，再生後胸腺的功能品質仍有待確立。

links.context: KRAS is mutated in approximately 30% of lung cancers, with G12C most common in adenocarcinomas of non-small-cell lung cancer. In lung cancer, KRAS mutations often co-occur with LKB1 or KEAP1/NRF2 alterations and p53 mutations. These co-mutations shape the immune and metabolic phenotype of the tumor.
links.context_zh_TW: KRAS 在約 30% 的肺癌中發生突變，其中 G12C 在非小細胞肺癌的腺癌中最常見。在肺癌中，KRAS 突變常與 LKB1 或 KEAP1/NRF2 改變以及 p53 突變共同發生。這些共同突變塑造了腫瘤的免疫與代謝表型。

links.context: KRAS is mutated in approximately 40% of colorectal cancers, most commonly at G12V, G12D, and G13D. These hotspot mutations constitutively activate the MAPK/ERK pathway and drive proliferation of intermediate adenomas in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. KRAS mutation status also guides anti-EGFR therapy selection.
links.context_zh_TW: KRAS 在約 40% 的結直腸癌中發生突變，最常見於 G12V、G12D 和 G13D。這些熱點突變會持續激活 MAPK/ERK 途徑，並在腺瘤–癌序列中驅動中間腺瘤的增殖。KRAS 突變狀態也指導抗 EGFR 療法的選擇。

links.context: Knockout mice are used to dissect pathways such as mTOR, mitochondria-mediated stress response and apoptosis, and to test the causal roles of candidate longevity genes such as sirtuins and insulin/IGF-1 signalling components in lifespan and healthspan. Comparing knockout phenotypes with wild-type littermates infers a gene's physiological role, although strain background effects, compensatory developmental remodelling and imperfect correspondence to human physiology limit interpretation.
links.context_zh_TW: 敲除小鼠被用於剖析 mTOR、粒線體介導的壓力反應與凋亡等路徑，並測試 sirtuin 與胰島素/IGF-1 訊號成分等候選長壽基因在壽命與健康壽命中的因果角色。將敲除表型與同窩野生型比較可推論基因的生理功能，但品系背景效應、發育期代償性重塑以及與人類生理不完全對應等因素限制了詮釋。

links.context: LHRH agonists achieve sex steroid ablation pharmacologically through receptor desensitization rather than surgery, and this is being tested in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (NCT01338987) and melanoma vaccine response augmentation (NCT00254397). The reversible, non-surgical character of the approach is its main clinical advantage over orchiectomy and oophorectomy.
links.context_zh_TW: LHRH 致效劑透過受體去敏感化以藥理方式達成性類固醇去除，而非手術方式；此法正在異基因造血幹細胞移植（NCT01338987）與黑色素瘤疫苗反應增強（NCT00254397）中接受測試。這種可逆、非手術的特性，相較於睪丸切除與卵巢切除，是其主要的臨床優勢。

links.context: LHRH analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation, and removal of sex steroid inhibition restores thymic architecture: aged rats given LHRH analogue treatment regained thymic weight and cellularity (Greenstein et al., 1987), and thymic weight increased while age-related thymic structural defects reversed. Unlike surgical castration, this is a reversible pharmaceutical approach more likely to be tolerated clinically.
links.context_zh_TW: LHRH 類似物可達成藥理學上的性類固醇去除，而解除性類固醇的抑制可恢復胸腺結構：接受 LHRH 類似物治療的老年大鼠恢復了胸腺重量與細胞量（Greenstein 等，1987），胸腺重量增加且與年齡相關的胸腺結構缺損獲得逆轉。與手術去勢不同，這是可逆的藥物途徑，在臨床上較可能被耐受。

links.context: Lactobacillus is a genus of Gram-positive, facultatively anaerobic, rod-shaped, non-spore-forming bacteria that ferments carbohydrates into lactic acid, bacteriocins and hydrogen peroxide, lowering pH to inhibit pathogens and reinforcing mucosal barriers. In the gut it complements Bifidobacterium in contributing to short-chain fatty acid production and interacts with the immune system to promote tolerance; berberine enriches SCFA-producing Lactobacillus spp. via high intraluminal exposure.
links.context_zh_TW: Lactobacillus 是一屬革蘭氏陽性、兼性厭氧、桿狀、不形成芽孢的細菌，能將碳水化合物發酵成乳酸、bacteriocin 與過氧化氫，藉由降低 pH 抑制病原菌並強化黏膜屏障。在腸道中它與 Bifidobacterium 互補，協助產生短鏈脂肪酸，並與免疫系統互動以促進耐受性；berberine 則透過高腸腔暴露濃度富集產 SCFA 的 Lactobacillus spp.。

links.context: Laminin mediates cell adhesion as a stated adhesive process. Promotion is the adhesive output.
links.context_zh_TW: Laminin 介導細胞黏附作為既定的黏附過程。促進是黏附輸出。

links.context: Leucine-free Sestrin2 binds and blocks GATOR2. Inhibition is the leucine-off switch.
links.context_zh_TW: 無白胺酸 Sestrin2 結合並阻斷 GATOR2。抑制是白胺酸關閉開關。

links.context: Leuco-methylene blue reduces ferric Fe3+ in methemoglobin back to ferrous Fe2+, restoring hemoglobin function. Reduction is mechanistically exact and distinct from treats-Methemoglobinemia.
links.context_zh_TW: Leuco-methylene blue 將變性血紅素的 Fe3+ 還原回 Fe2+，恢復血紅素功能。還原在機制精確且不同於治療變性血紅素血症。

links.context: Like eukaryotic sirtuins, CobB couples deacetylation of acetyl-lysine substrates to NAD+ cleavage, producing deacetylated substrate, nicotinamide and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. In Salmonella enterica this link between NAD+ metabolism and acetylation connects nutrient availability to the activity of acetylated metabolic enzymes, and CobB's name reflects its role in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic acid catabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: 與真核 sirtuin 相同，CobB 將 acetyl-lysine 受質的去乙醯化與 NAD+ 的切割偶聯，產生去乙醯化受質、nicotinamide 與 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose。在 Salmonella enterica 中，NAD+ 代謝與乙醯化的連結把營養可利用性與乙醯化代謝酵素的活性相連，而 CobB 之名反映其在 cobalamin 生合成與 propionic acid 分解中的作用。

links.context: Loss of PTEN elevates AKT activity and reactive oxygen species, engaging a DNA-damage response and p53-dependent arrest in TLS. The p53 pathway is a primary effector enforcing the senescent state downstream of tumor-suppressor loss.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 TLS 中，PTEN 缺失會提高 AKT 活性和活性氧，啟動 DNA 損傷反應和 p53 依賴的停滯。p53 途徑是腫瘤抑制因子缺失下游執行衰老狀態的主要效應器。

links.context: Loss of tumor suppressor gene function, including p53 and RB1, is a principal driver of tumorigenicity. Intact tumor-suppressor checkpoints enforce senescence and maintain differentiation control that blocks tumor formation.
links.context_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制基因功能（包括 p53 和 RB1）的喪失是致瘤性的主要驅動因素。完整的腫瘤抑制檢查點執行衰老並維持阻止腫瘤形成所需的分化控制。

links.context: Lysosomal acid lipase is transcriptionally induced by TFEB during nutrient deprivation. Regulation extends TFEB to lipid catabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶在營養剝奪期間由 TFEB 轉錄誘發。調節將 TFEB 延伸到脂質分解。

links.context: MTHFD1 contributes to the folate-derived one-carbon pool that ultimately yields methylfolate and SAMe, the methyl donor consumed by COMT to inactivate dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. Inefficient MTHFD1 therefore constrains the methyl-group supply available to COMT. This indirectly affects catecholamine methylation throughput.
links.context_zh_TW: MTHFD1 促成最終產生 methylfolate 和 SAMe 的葉酸衍生一碳池，SAMe 是 COMT 滅活 dopamine、epinephrine 和 norepinephrine 所消耗的 methyl donor。因此低效的 MTHFD1 限制了 COMT 可用的甲基供應。這間接影響兒茶酚胺甲基化通量。

links.context: Mad2 inhibits APC/C-CDC20 at unattached kinetochores until biorientation.
links.context_zh_TW: Mad2 在未附著動點抑制 APC/C-CDC20 直到雙定向。

links.context: Matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3) is a SASP protease associated with extracellular matrix degradation, tissue remodeling, and, in tumor contexts, cancer cell invasion and metastasis. Its secretion reflects the matrix-remodeling arm of the secretome that supports wound healing acutely but pathological tissue breakdown chronically, and MMP-3 can activate other MMPs in a cascade, amplifying remodeling. This protease component distinguishes the SASP from a purely cytokine profile and contributes to fibrosis and basement-membrane disruption in aging tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶-3（MMP-3）是一種與細胞外基質降解、組織重塑以及腫瘤脈絡中癌細胞侵襲和轉移相關的 SASP 蛋白酶。其分泌反映支持急性傷口癒合但慢性病理性組織崩解的基質重塑臂，且 MMP-3 可在級聯中活化其他 MMP，放大重塑。此蛋白酶組成將 SASP 與純細胞激素輪廓區分，並貢獻老化組織中的纖維化與基底膜破壞。

links.context: Matrix metalloproteinases secreted by senescent cells regulate the activity of soluble SASP factors: MMP-1 and MMP-3 produced by senescent cells cleave MCP-1, MCP-2, MCP-4 and IL-8, and other CXCL/CCL family members constituting the SASP can be cleaved by MMP-9, MMP-2 or MMP-7. These cytokines can originate from neighboring leukocytes or tumor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞分泌的 Matrix Metalloproteinase 會調節可溶性 SASP 因子的活性：衰老細胞產生的 MMP-1 與 MMP-3 可切割 MCP-1、MCP-2、MCP-4 與 IL-8，其他構成 SASP 的 CXCL/CCL 家族成員則可被 MMP-9、MMP-2 或 MMP-7 切割。這些細胞激素可能來自鄰近的白血球或腫瘤細胞。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype The Dark Side of Tumor Suppression.md

links.context: Melatonin is described as a critical, mitochondria-targeted antioxidant whose endogenous production is maximized by ensuring complete darkness during sleep. Circadian alignment and sleep hygiene are presented as high-impact behaviors supporting the mitohormesis protocol, since deep sleep is when cellular repair and neural recovery occur. The document ties melatonin production to sleep quality, which in turn determines overnight HRV and recovery capacity, completing the loop between circadian biology, antioxidant defenses, and mitochondrial adaptation.
links.context_zh_TW: 褪黑激素被描述為一種關鍵的、以粒線體為標靶的抗氧化劑，其內源性生成可藉由確保睡眠期間完全黑暗而最大化。晝夜節律對齊與睡眠衛生被呈現為支持粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）方案的高影響力行為，因為深度睡眠是細胞修復與神經恢復發生的時刻。該文件將褪黑激素生成與睡眠品質連結，而睡眠品質又決定整夜 HRV 與恢復能力，在晝夜節律生物學、抗氧化防禦與粒線體適應之間完成迴路。

links.context: Melatonin promotes Mitophagy through a SIRT3-dependent axis: SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 drives mitophagy and preserves mitochondria and autophagy in sepsis, while the effect is abolished in SIRT3-knockout animals. Melatonin therefore requires SIRT3 to execute its mitochondrial quality-control function.
links.context_zh_TW: Melatonin 透過 SIRT3 依賴的軸促進 Mitophagy：SIRT3 介導 TFAM 在 Lys154 位置的去乙醯化可驅動粒線體自噬，並在敗血症中維持粒線體與自噬功能；此效應在 SIRT3 剔除的動物中則消失。因此，Melatonin 執行其粒線體品管功能需要 SIRT3 的參與。

links.context: Metabolic Plasticity is a concept closely related to Metabolic Flexibility but with a different axis. Metabolic Flexibility describes fuel-source switching (glucose versus fatty acids) in homeostatic tissues, whereas Metabolic Plasticity foregrounds adaptive, often reversible reprogramming between glycolysis and OXPHOS that lets malignant cells survive hostile niches, evade therapy, and colonize new sites.
links.context_zh_TW: Metabolic Plasticity 與 Metabolic Flexible 密切相關，但著眼軸線不同。Metabolic Flexibility 描述恆定組織中的燃料來源切換（葡萄糖對脂肪酸），而 Metabolic Plasticity 則強調糖解作用與 OXPHOS 之間可逆的適應性重編程，使惡性細胞得以在惡劣微環境中存活、逃逸治療並定殖新的部位。

links.context: MethylB12 can cause overmethylation symptoms such as anxiety, irritability, insomnia, or mood lability in slow COMT individuals. For those sensitive to methylated B12, non-methylated forms such as adenosylcobalamin or hydroxocobalamin are often better tolerated. These alternatives bypass the direct methyl-donor surge while still correcting B12 deficiency.
links.context_zh_TW: MethylB12 可能導致緩慢 COMT 個體出現過度甲基化症狀，例如焦慮、煩躁、失眠或情緒不穩定。對於對甲基化 B12 敏感的個體，非甲基化形式如 adenosylcobalamin 或 hydroxocobalamin 通常耐受性更好。這些替代品繞過直接的甲基供體激增，同時仍能矯正 B12 缺乏。

links.context: Methylene blue (MB) provides neuroprotection in rodent and invertebrate models of Parkinson's disease. MB retained protective activity in in vivo models of stroke, Parkinson's disease, and optic neuropathy, and phenothiazine (the parent nucleus of MB) is highly efficacious in Caenorhabditis elegans models of parkinsonism employing rotenone or MPP+. MB's efficacy in these models is attributed to its alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer shunt and regenerable antioxidant action, which counteract the mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress central to dopaminergic neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在帕金森病的囓齒類和無脊椎動物模型中提供神經保護。MB在中風、帕金森病和視神經病變的體內模型中保留了保護活性，吩噻嗪（MB的母體核）在使用rotenone或MPP+的秀丽隱桿線蟲帕金森病模型中具有高效力。MB在這些模型中的功效歸因於其替代粒線體電子分流和可再生的抗氧化作用，這些作用對抗了多巴胺能神經退行性變的核心——粒線體功能障礙和氧化應激。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Methylglyoxal preferentially targets arginine guanidinium groups to form hydroimidazolone adducts. Modification is the dominant AGE chemistry.
links.context_zh_TW: 甲基乙二醛優先標定精胺酸胍基形成氫咪唑酮加合物。修飾是主要的 AGE 化學。

links.context: Microbiota-derived short-chain fatty acids reinforce intestinal barrier integrity, so the gut microbiome and the barrier interact bidirectionally: dysbiosis impairs the barrier, while beneficial bacteria and their metabolites restore it. Disruption of the barrier produces a leaky gut that permits microbial product translocation and drives systemic inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 菌群衍生的 Short-chain Fatty Acids 可強化腸道屏障完整性，因此 gut microbiome 與屏障是雙向交互的：dysbiosis 會損害屏障，而有益菌及其代謝物則可修復屏障。屏障遭破壞會形成 leaky gut，讓微生物產物轉位並驅動全身性 inflammation。

links.context: Microglial cGAS deletion reverses the downregulation of neuronal MEF2C, a resilience transcription factor, linking innate immune signaling to loss of cognitive resilience. Pharmacological cGAS inhibition likewise preserves synapses and phenocopies the protective APOE3 Christchurch (R136S) resilience allele in tauopathy models, validating suppression of cGAS-STING signaling as a strategy to recapitulate genetic protection against tau toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: 微膠細胞 cGAS 的缺失可逆轉神經元 MEF2C（一種韌性轉錄因子）的下调，將先天免疫訊號與認知韌性的喪失連結起來。藥理性 cGAS 抑制同樣能保留突觸，並在 tauopathy 模型中模擬保護性的 APOE3 Christchurch (R136S) 韌性等位基因，驗證了抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號作為重現對 tau 毒性之遺傳性保護的策略。

links.context: Mitochondria act as platforms for orchestrating innate immune responses to external threats. The MAVS protein, an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor, binds retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) that sense viral RNA, self-propagates in a prion-like fashion, and recruits TRAF2, TRAF6, and RIPK1 to activate antiviral signaling. Additionally, mitochondrial ROS prime the NLRP3 inflammasome, whose activation leads to caspase-1 activation and proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta, linking mitochondrial stress to the inflammatory response.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondria 作為 orchestrate innate immune responses to external threats 的平台。MAVS 蛋白是一種外線粒體膜 adaptor，結合 retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) 感測 viral RNA，以 prion-like fashion 自我增殖，並招募 TRAF2、TRAF6 和 RIPK1 激活 antiviral signaling。此外，mitochondrial ROS priming NLRP3 inflammasome，其 activation 導致 caspase-1 activation 和 proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta，將 mitochondrial stress 與 inflammatory response 連結。

links.context: Mitochondrial ROS generated during SAMD activate NF-kB and stress kinases including p38 MAPK, linking metabolic dysfunction to SASP transcription. This provides a non-genotoxic route to NF-kB activation in senescence, independent of DNA damage sensors, and sustains the inflammatory secretome. The activation underscores SAMD as an upstream metabolic regulator of senescence inflammation, with p38 MAPK further stabilizing SASP transcripts. This metabolic-to-transcriptional coupling is central to how mitochondrial stress drives the secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: SAMD 期間產生的粒線體 ROS 活化 NF-κB 與包括 p38 MAPK 在內的壓力激酶，將代謝失調連結到 SASP 轉錄。這提供一條非基因毒性的 NF-κB 活化途徑，獨立於 DNA 損傷感受器，並維持發炎性分泌組。此活化強調 SAMD 作為衰老發炎的上游代謝調節者，且 p38 MAPK 進一步穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此代謝到轉錄的耦合是粒線體壓力如何驅動分泌組的核心。

links.context: Mitochondrial fission (mediated by DRP1) facilitates isolation of dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments for degradation via mitophagy, an essential step in quality control. In aging cells the fission-fusion balance is disrupted, often favoring fission, producing increased fragmentation, bioenergetic failure and apoptosis. In stem/progenitor compartments, sustained fragmentation maintains stress signaling programs that erode quiescence, bias lineage decisions, and increase vulnerability to inflammatory cues. Mitochondrial fission is a prerequisite for mitophagy, the selective autophagic degradation of damaged mitochondria. Fission produces small, fragmented mitochondrial units that can be enveloped by autophagosomes, whereas highly fused mitochondria are largely protected from autophagy. In the canonical pathway, the serine/threonine kinase PINK1 accumulates on depolarized mitochondria and recruits the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin, which ubiquitinates outer membrane proteins and marks the mitochondrion for autophagic clearance. DRP1-dependent fragmentation facilitates this process, and blocking fission, for example with the DRP1 inhibitor Mdivi-1, impairs mitophagy in many cellular models, linking the fission machinery to mitochondrial quality control.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial fission (mediated by DRP1) facilitates isolation of dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments for degradation via mitophagy，an essential step in quality control。In aging cells the fission-fusion balance is disrupted, often favoring fission, producing increased fragmentation, bioenergetic failure and apoptosis。In stem/progenitor compartments, sustained fragmentation maintains stress signaling programs that erode quiescence, bias lineage decisions, and increase vulnerability to inflammatory cues。 Mitochondrial fission is a prerequisite for mitophagy, the selective autophagic degradation of damaged mitochondria。Fission produces small, fragmented mitochondrial units that can be enveloped by autophagosomes, whereas highly fused mitochondria are largely protected from autophagy。In the canonical pathway, the serine/threonine kinase PINK1 accumulates on depolarized mitochondria and recruits the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin, which ubiquitinates outer membrane proteins and marks the mitochondrion for autophagic clearance。DRP1-dependent fragmentation facilitates this process, and blocking fission, for example with the DRP1 inhibitor Mdivi-1, impairs mitophagy in many cellular models, linking the fission machinery to mitochondrial quality control。

links.context: Mitochondrial signaling is increasingly implicated in macrophage biology, a cell type involved in processes from the inflammatory response to wound healing. LPS-stimulated macrophages show marked accumulation of the TCA cycle intermediate succinate, which stabilizes HIF-1alpha and leads to enhanced IL-1beta production; mitochondrial ROS generated by succinate oxidation is the critical signaling intermediate. Conversely, late-phase pro-resolving macrophages shift away from ROS-dependent signaling and adopt a UPRmt signature. This illustrates how the same mitochondrial stress pathways that produce hormesis also tune immune cell function.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體訊號傳導越來越與巨噬細胞生物學相關聯，巨噬細胞是參與從炎症反應到傷口癒合等過程的細胞類型。LPS 刺激的巨噬細胞顯示 TCA 循環中間體琥珀酸的顯著積累，琥珀酸穩定 HIF-1alpha 並導致 IL-1beta 產生增加；由琥珀酸氧化產生的粒線體 ROS 是關鍵的訊號中間體。相反地，後期促消退巨噬細胞轉離 ROS 依賴性訊號，並採用 UPRmt 特徵。這說明了產生促效應的相同粒線體壓力途徑如何也調節免疫細胞功能。

links.context: Mitohormesis and mitochondrial stress signaling have been linked to Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, cardiomyopathy, ferroptosis, inflammasome activation, cGAS-STING signaling, macrophage biology, chemotherapeutic resistance, and metabolic syndrome. UPRmt response genes are elevated in patients with familial or sporadic Alzheimer's disease compared to controls, and similar activation is seen in models of Parkinson's disease. Protein aggregates characteristic of AD, PD, and HD can interfere with mitochondrial protein import, tying proteostasis failure at the mitochondrial boundary to neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應和粒線體壓力訊號傳導已與阿茲海默症、帕金森症、亨廷頓症、心肌病、鐵死亡、炎症小體活化、cGAS-STING 訊號、巨噬細胞生物學、化療抗性和代謝症候群相關聯。與對照組相比，UPRmt 反應基因在家族性或散發性阿茲海默症患者中升高，在帕金森症模型中也看到類似的活化。AD、PD 和 HD 特徵的蛋白質團塊可干擾粒線體蛋白質輸入，將粒線體邊界的蛋白質體恆定性失敗與神經退化相連結。

links.context: Mitokines are soluble factors released by stressed mitochondria that communicate mitochondrial stress status to distal tissues, enabling cell-non-autonomous regulation of stress responses and lifespan. In C. elegans, knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates the UPRmt response in the intestine and extends lifespan, implying that stressed mitochondria in the nervous system release signals that modulate stress defenses elsewhere in the soma. This allows mitochondria in one tissue to act as sensors of overall metabolic status for the entire organism.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體因子是由受壓粒線體釋放的可溶性因子，將粒線體壓力狀態傳遞給遠端組織，實現壓力反應和壽命的細胞非自主性調節。在 C. elegans 中，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的敲低會在腸道活化 UPRmt 反應並延長壽命，暗示神經系統中受壓粒線體釋放的訊號在其他體細胞部位調節壓力防禦。這使得一個組織中的粒線體能夠作為整個生物體整體代謝狀態的感測器。

links.context: Mitophagy primarily restrains ferroptosis by disposing of damaged, ROS-leaking mitochondria and by regulating iron translocation (mitoferrins, Fe-S clusters) between matrix and cytoplasm. The relationship is bidirectional, however: complex I inhibition (BAY 87-2243) can drive PINK1-dependent mitophagy that raises ROS and promotes ferroptosis, FUNDC1 can deliver GPX4 to lysosomes promoting ferroptosis, and O-GlcNAc transferase inhibition couples ferritinophagy and mitophagy to ferroptosis sensitivity. Net effect is context-dependent — governed by ROS level, iron availability, and the receptor engaged.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體自噬主要透過清除滲漏 ROS 的受損粒線體、並調節基質與細胞質之間的鐵轉運（mitoferrin、Fe-S cluster）來抑制鐵死亡。然而此關係是雙向的：Complex I 抑制（BAY 87-2243）可驅動 PINK1 依賴的粒線體自噬而升高 ROS 並促進鐵死亡；FUNDC1 可將 GPX4 送入溶酶體促進鐵死亡；O-GlcNAc 轉移酶的抑制則將鐵蛋白自噬與粒線體自噬偶聯至鐵死亡敏感性。整體效應取決於 ROS 水平、鐵可用性與所動用的受體。

links.context: Monomeric catechin and polymeric proanthocyanidins belong to the natural-polyphenol STAC family that activates SIRT1 through the shared K-type allosteric mechanism, lowering the substrate K~m~ so that SIRT1 is activated even at low polyphenol concentrations. Flavan-3-ols also engage AMPK and inhibit NF-κB inflammatory signalling, and activate the NRF2/KEAP1 cytoprotective program as radical scavengers and metal chelators.
links.context_zh_TW: 單體 catechin 與聚合的 proanthocyanidins 屬於天然多酚 STAC 家族，可透過共有的 K 型異位機制活化 SIRT1，降低受質的 K~m~，使 SIRT1 在低多酚濃度下即可被活化。Flavan-3-ols 也會啟動 AMPK、抑制 NF-κB 發炎訊號，並以自由基清除劑與金屬螯合作用啟動 NRF2/KEAP1 細胞保護程式。

links.context: N-cadherin induction is the mesenchymal marker arm of the cadherin switch. Upregulation defines transition direction.
links.context_zh_TW: N-cadherin 誘發是 cadherin 轉換的間質標記臂。上調定義轉換方向。

links.context: N-terminal hexokinase 2 tethers to mitochondrial VDAC for preferential ATP access.
links.context_zh_TW: N 端 Hexokinase 2 繫於粒線體 VDAC 以優先取得 ATP。

links.context: NAD+ levels decline as C. elegans worms age, and restoration of NAD+ levels extends longevity through a pathway that requires activation of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt). Overexpression of the NAD-dependent deacetylase sir-2.1 (the worm SIRT1 homolog) likewise extends lifespan in a UPRmt-dependent fashion. Mitochondrial activity centrally determines the levels of metabolic intermediates such as NAD+/NADH and acetyl-CoA, which act as obligate cofactors for the sirtuin, PARP, and histone acetyltransferase enzyme families.
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+水平在秀丽隱桿線蟲衰老過程中下降，而恢復NAD+水平可透過需要粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）激活的通路延長壽命。NAD+依賴性去乙醯酶sir-2.1（線蟲SIRT1同源物）的過表達同樣以UPRmt依賴的方式延長壽命。粒線體活性 central 決定代謝中間體如NAD+/NADH和acetyl-CoA的水平，它們作為sirtuin、PARP和組蛋白乙醯轉移酶酶家族的必需輔因子。

links.context: NF-kB is activated by GATA4, which promotes the pro-inflammatory SASP via TRAF3IP2 (Act1) and by inhibiting autophagy that would otherwise limit damage signals. GATA4 accumulation in senescent cells makes it a specific upstream driver of NF-kB in the arrested state, coupling defective organelle turnover to inflammatory transcription. Unlike DNA-damage-induced activation, this route is selective for the senescence program. The GATA4-NF-kB link is a senescence-selective regulatory pathway that reinforces the inflammatory secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 被 GATA4 活化，GATA4 透過 TRAF3IP2（Act1）並抑制本可限制損傷訊號的自噬，促進促發炎性 SASP。GATA4 在衰老細胞中的累積使其成為停滯狀態中 NF-κB 的特異上游驅動者，將缺陷胞器更新耦合到發炎轉錄。不同於 DNA 損傷誘發的活化，此途徑對衰老程序具選擇性。GATA4-NF-κB 連結是衰老選擇性的調節路徑，強化發炎性分泌組。

links.context: NF-kB is inhibited by glucocorticoids, which block the pro-inflammatory SASP by impairing IL-1a-mediated NF-kB activity. Glucocorticoids repress NF-kB transactivation by recruiting co-repressors and interfering with its interaction with coactivators, reducing SASP cytokine output. This explains their classic anti-inflammatory action in senescence contexts and their historical use in treating inflammatory conditions. The inhibition is well established pharmacologically, though chronic use carries significant side effects.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 被糖皮質類固醇抑制，糖皮質類固醇透過損害 IL-1α 介導的 NF-κB 活性阻斷促發炎性 SASP。糖皮質類固醇經由招募協同抑制因子並干擾其與協同活化因子的交互作用，抑制 NF-κB 轉活化，降低 SASP 細胞激素輸出。這解釋其在衰老脈絡中的典型抗發炎作用，及其在治療發炎疾病的歷史用途。此抑制在藥理上確立牢固，儘管慢性使用帶有顯著副作用。

links.context: NSAIDs pharmacologically block prostaglandin E2 synthesis.
links.context_zh_TW: NSAID 藥理阻斷前列腺素 E2 合成。

links.context: Navitoclax inhibits BCL-2 and BCL-XL to push SCAP-dependent senescent cells into apoptosis. Inhibition is the senolytic mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: Navitoclax 抑制 BCL-2 與 BCL-XL 以將 SCAP 依賴的衰老細胞推入凋亡。抑制是 senolytic 機制。

links.context: Necrotic DAMP release prominently induces inflammation via TLR/RAGE/NLRP3. Induction is the pro-inflammatory outcome.
links.context_zh_TW: 壞死 DAMP 釋放經由 TLR/RAGE/NLRP3 顯著誘發發炎。誘發是促發炎結果。

links.context: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
links.context_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Niche conditions dictate the prevailing metabolic state in Tumor Microenvironment: hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1α and favours glycolysis against SIRT3-mediated destabilization, acetate/serine scavenging and glutamine utilization let SIRT3-reprogrammed cells re-source carbon, and high lactate feeds lactylation of enzymes such as ME2 that gates the glycolysis–OXPHOS balance. The microenvironment therefore sets the direction of Metabolic Plasticity.
links.context_zh_TW: 微環境條件決定了 Tumor Microenvironment 中主導的代謝狀態：缺氧會穩定 HIF-1α 而偏好糖解，與 SIRT3 介導的去穩定化作用相抗衡；乙酸／絲胺酸 scavenging 與麩醯胺利用則讓經 SIRT3 重編程的細胞能重新調整碳源；而高乳酸會促成 ME2 等酵素的乳醯化，進而閘控糖解–OXPHOS 的平衡。因此微環境決定了 Metabolic Plasticity 的方向。

links.context: Notch restrains the late pro-inflammatory SASP by repressing the transcriptional activity of C/EBPbeta. The mechanism is attributed in the source review to NOTCH1-driven inhibition, and it explains the temporal phasing of the secretome: Notch gates the transition from an early, TGFbeta-dominated secretome to a late, IL-6/IL-8-dominated inflammatory one by limiting C/EBPbeta-dependent transcription. Because C/EBPbeta cooperates with NF-kB at CXCR2-ligand and other SASP genes, its repression by Notch damps a broad subset of pro-inflammatory outputs rather than a single cytokine.
links.context_zh_TW: Notch 藉由抑制 C/EBPbeta 的轉錄活性來約束晚期促炎 SASP。原回顧將此機制歸因於 NOTCH1 驅動的抑制，這也解釋了 secretome 的時間分期：Notch 藉由限制 C/EBPbeta 依賴性轉錄，管制由早期 TGFbeta 主導的 secretome 轉換為晚期 IL-6/IL-8 主導的發炎型。由於 C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB 在 CXCR2 配體及其他 SASP 基因上協同，Notch 對其抑制會壓低一大類促炎輸出，而非僅單一細胞激素。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: Nudix Hydrolases cleave free ADP-ribose into AMP plus ribose-5-phosphate, an AMP/salvage arm of the parthanatos cascade. AMP can inhibit the mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocator and activate AMPK–mTORC1 signalling, and ribose-5-phosphate feeds NAD+ salvage.
links.context_zh_TW: Nudix Hydrolases 將游離 ADP-ribose 切割成 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸，構成 parthanatos 級聯中的 AMP/回收分支。AMP 可抑制粒線體腺嘌呤核苷轉位酶並活化 AMPK–mTORC1 訊號，核糖-5-磷酸則供應 NAD+ 回收途徑。

links.context: Nutrient levels dictate metabolic priorities and autophagic activity with scarcity activating clearance. Regulation is the supply-to-degradation coupling.
links.context_zh_TW: 營養水平決定代謝優先與自噬活性，匱乏活化清除。調節是供應到降解的耦合。

links.context: Nutrient sufficiency raises Acetyl-CoA, which can inhibit Autophagy via mTOR activation, whereas fasting lowers acetyl-CoA and promotes autophagic flux. This positions acetyl-CoA as a metabolic switch between anabolism and catabolism and links the nutrient state to autophagy output. Interventions that modulate acetyl-CoA availability, including Caloric Restriction, Nicotinamide Riboside and Mitohormesis, influence downstream acetylation and stress-resistance pathways relevant to longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: 營養充足會提高 Acetyl-CoA，進而可透過 mTOR 活化抑制 Autophagy；相反地，禁食會降低 Acetyl-CoA 並促進自噬流。這使 Acetyl-CoA 成為同化與異化之間的代謝開關，並把營養狀態與自噬輸出連結起來。調節 Acetyl-CoA 可得性的介入手段，包括 Caloric Restriction、Nicotinamide Riboside 與 Mitohormesis，會影響與長壽相關的下游乙醯化與抗壓力路徑。

links.context: Oncogenic KRAS mutation, most commonly at codon 12 or 13, constitutively activates the MAPK/ERK pathway and drives proliferation of intermediate adenomas in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. KRAS activation is a key step in the Vogelstein model of colon cancer. KRAS mutation status also guides anti-EGFR therapy selection.
links.context_zh_TW: 致癌性 KRAS 突變（最常見於密碼子 12 或 13）持續激活 MAPK/ERK 途徑，並在腺瘤–癌序列中驅動中間腺瘤的增殖。KRAS 激活是結腸癌 Vogelstein 模型中的關鍵步驟。KRAS 突變狀態也指導抗 EGFR 療法的選擇。

links.context: Organoids are a central platform for monogenic, complex-disease and infection studies.
links.context_zh_TW: 類器官是單基因、複雜疾病與感染研究的核心平台。

links.context: PAK4 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating the BH3-only protein.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK4 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，使 BH3-only 蛋白失活。

links.context: PAK5 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, paralleling the PAK4 edge.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK5 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，與 PAK4 邊平行。

links.context: PARP consumes NAD+ as it MARylates target proteins during antiviral defense, so sustained PARP activity couples innate immune restriction of viral replication to cellular NAD+ depletion. This is why boosting NAD+ content through nicotinamide and NR kinase pathways is proposed to restore antiviral PARP function and support control of viral replication during infection.
links.context_zh_TW: PARP 在對蛋白進行 MARylation 以執行抗病毒防禦時會消耗 NAD+，因此持續的 PARP 活性把先天免疫對 viral replication 的限制與細胞 NAD+ 耗竭耦合。這也是為何提出透過 nicotinamide 與 NR kinase 路徑提升 NAD+ 含量以恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能、支持感染期間對 viral replication 的控制。

links.context: PEX12 provides the RING-finger ligase activity that ubiquitinates and thereby recycles the PEX5 import receptor at the peroxisomal membrane. It acts upstream of cargo release together with the PEX13 docking component, linking docking, translocation, and receptor recycling into one ubiquitin-dependent importomer cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: PEX12 提供 RING 指狀連接酶活性，在過氧化體膜上將 PEX5 輸入受體泛素化並使其回收。它與 PEX13 對接元件共同作用於貨運釋放之前，把對接、轉位與受體回收串成同一個泛素依賴的 importomer 循環。

links.context: PKCι phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating it.
links.context_zh_TW: PKCι 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad 使其失活。

links.context: PREMOTE enrolled approximately 400 newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes mellitus patients across multiple centers, so the trial's population is defined by early-stage metabolic disease rather than long-standing, treated diabetes. That design choice makes the observed ~1% HbA1c reduction informative about berberine's effect in metabolically naive patients.
links.context_zh_TW: PREMOTE 在多個中心收納約 400 名新診斷的 type 2 diabetes mellitus 患者，因此試驗族群是由早期代謝疾病而非長期治療過的糖尿病所界定。這項設計選擇使所觀察到的約 1% HbA1c 下降，能說明 Berberine 對代謝上未受干預患者的效力。

links.context: Pancreatic cancer is one of olaparib's approved indications, alongside BRCA-mutated breast, ovarian, and prostate cancers, on the basis of olaparib's exploitation of synthetic lethality in homologous-recombination-deficient tumors. ATM-deficient tumors are selectively vulnerable to PARP inhibitors including olaparib, and show heightened vulnerability when PARP inhibition is combined with ATR inhibition.
links.context_zh_TW: 胰臟癌是 olaparib 的核准適應症之一，與 BRCA 突變的乳癌、卵巢癌及攝護腺癌並列，其依據是 olaparib 對同源重組缺陷腫瘤之合成致命性的利用。ATM 缺失的腫瘤對包括 olaparib 在內的 PARP 抑制劑具有選擇性脆弱性，且在 PARP 抑制合併 ATR 抑制時更為明顯。

links.context: Paracrine reprogramming alters the differentiation status (stemness, EMT) of recipient cells, whereas paracrine senescence induces growth arrest in them; the two are distinct non-cell-autonomous consequences of the SASP. Both can co-occur, but their endpoints differ: fate change versus cell-cycle exit. The distinction clarifies the multifarious influence of senescent cells on neighbours and matters for interpreting whether SASP exposure is regenerative or pathological. It is a conceptual but important separation within senescence biology.
links.context_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程改變受體細胞的分化狀態（幹性、EMT），而旁分泌衰老則誘發其生長停滯；兩者是 SASP 不同的非細胞自主性後果。兩者皆可能共存，但端點相反——一者重塑身分，一者強加停滯。此區別對理解衰老分泌組的多重效應至為核心，並說明相同分泌組如何同時驅動組織重塑與腫瘤抑制。它是 SASP 生物學的關鍵概念分界。

links.context: Paracrine senescence amplifies chronic inflammation by spreading senescent phenotypes through tissues, with each newly arrested cell contributing its own SASP to the milieu. This positive-feedback loop sustains the sterile, low-grade inflammation of inflammaging and compounds the inflammatory burden with age. The spread is driven by IL-1a, TGFb, and chemokines acting on neighboring cells and recruiting immune cells. Breaking the paracrine loop is a key route to reducing inflammaging and its downstream pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: 旁分泌衰老透過 SASP 因子與趨化因子作用於鄰近細胞並招募免疫細胞，擴散衰老表型以放大慢性發炎。此正向迴圈維持 inflammaging 的無菌、低程度發炎，並隨年齡加重發炎負擔。此擴散由 IL-1α、TGFb 與趨化因子驅動，並招募免疫細胞。打破旁分泌迴圈是減少 inflammaging 及其下游病理的關鍵途徑。

links.context: Paracrine senescence contributes to aging by explaining how a small fraction of senescent cells can drive disproportionate tissue dysfunction: the arrested state spreads to neighbors, amplifying the cellular senescence burden with age. This multiplicative effect accelerates functional decline beyond what the initiating cell count would suggest, and it links local senescence to systemic aging phenotypes. The spread is driven by SASP factors and can be reinforced by epigenetic and inflammatory feedback. Interrupting the spread is therefore a plausible anti-aging strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: 旁分泌衰老透過解釋少數衰老細胞如何驅動不成比例的組織功能障礙來促進老化：停滯狀態擴散至鄰近細胞，隨年齡放大細胞衰老負擔。此乘法效應加速超出起始細胞計數所暗示的功能衰退，並將局部衰老連結到全身性老化表型。此擴散由 SASP 因子驅動，並可被表觀遺傳與發炎回饋強化。中斷擴散因此是合理可行的抗老化策略。

links.context: Parkin ubiquitinates the voltage-dependent anion channel VDAC on the mitochondrial outer membrane — a modification with dual cell-fate meaning: monoubiquitination of VDAC halts apoptosis, while polyubiquitination feeds PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. Parkin also ubiquitinates MFN1 and mitochondrial Rho GTPases, and regulates Drp1 activity and degradation. VDAC is therefore the point of intersection where the same E3 ligase executing mitophagy also restrains apoptotic permeabilization.
links.context_zh_TW: Parkin 會對粒線體外膜的電壓依賴性陰離子通道 VDAC 進行泛素化——此修飾具有雙重的細胞命運意義：VDAC 的單泛素化可阻止細胞凋亡，而多泛素化則驅動 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。Parkin 也會泛素化 MFN1 與粒線體 Rho GTPase，並調控 Drp1 的活性與降解。因此 VDAC 正是同一個 E3 連接酶在執行粒線體自噬之外、同時抑制凋亡通透化的交會點。

links.context: Partial reprogramming through short, cyclic OSKM pulses in vivo reverses epigenetic age without teratoma risk or identity loss, targeting rejuvenation rather than pluripotency. It is the translational arm linking reprogramming to rejuvenation and the information theory of aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 透過體內短暫、週期性的 OSKM 脈衝進行部分重編程，可在無畸胎瘤風險或身分喪失的情況下逆轉表觀遺傳年齡，目標是回春而非多能性。這是將重編程與回春及老化資訊理論連結起來的轉譯分支。

links.context: Peroxynitrite (ONOO⁻) nitrates Tau Protein at Tyr18, Tyr29, and Tyr394, generating 3-Nitrotyrosine. Tyrosine nitration impairs tau-microtubule interaction and enhances PHF formation, so peroxynitrite is a direct oxidative post-translational route from Reactive Oxygen Species to tau aggregation.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite (ONOO⁻) 會在 Tau Protein 的 Tyr18、Tyr29 與 Tyr394 位置進行硝基化，生成 3-Nitrotyrosine。酪胺酸硝基化會損害 tau 與微管的交互作用並促進 PHF 形成，因此 peroxynitrite 是由 Reactive Oxygen Species 通往 tau 聚集的直接氧化後修飾途徑。

links.context: Persistent MyD88-dependent IL-1R signaling drives age-related chronic inflammation by sustaining NF-kB activation and SASP/cytokine production. As a hub of IL-1 family signaling, MyD88 propagates the inflammatory loop that characterizes inflammaging and links cellular senescence to systemic, sterile inflammation. Because IL-1 signaling through MyD88 operates in both senescent cells and responding immune cells, it amplifies inflammatory output across tissues. Inhibiting MyD88 or the IL-1R is therefore a plausible anti-inflammaging strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: MyD88 驅動 inflammaging，透過維持由衰老細胞 IL-1alpha 與 SASP 因子觸發的慢性先天免疫活化。作為將 DAMP 與細胞激素受體連結到 NF-κB 的中央樞紐，MyD88 持續性活化助長年齡相關無菌發炎。其驅動角色在 MyD88 缺失減輕衰老相關發炎的模型中支持，使其成為針對 inflammaging 的候選治療標靶。它將細胞衰老直接連結到全身性發炎狀態。

links.context: Persistent unrepaired damage sustains DDR signaling that locks cells into senescent arrest. Induction separates transient checkpoint delay from durable senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 持續未修復的損傷維持 DDR 訊號，將細胞鎖入衰老停滯。誘發將短暫檢查點延遲與持久衰老分開。

links.context: Pinometostat inhibits DOT1L targeting H3K79 methylation in MLL leukemias. Drug-target edge of the methyltransferase axis.
links.context_zh_TW: Pinometostat 抑制 DOT1L，標靶 MLL 白血病的 H3K79 甲基化。甲基轉移酶軸的藥物—標的邊。

links.context: Predictable age-related shifts in DNA Methylation — global hypomethylation that reactivates repetitive elements alongside focal promoter hypermethylation of tumour suppressor genes — form the basis of the Epigenetic Clock, which uses these methylation patterns to estimate biological age accurately.
links.context_zh_TW: 與年齡相關、可預測的 DNA Methylation 變化——包含重新活化重複序列的全域去甲基化，以及腫瘤抑制基因啟動子區的局部高甲基化——構成 Epigenetic Clock 的基礎，該時鐘利用這些甲基化模式準確估算生物學年齡。

links.context: Preparation for Oxidative Stress (POS) is proposed as the physiological conditioning instance of Hormesis: transient upregulation of antioxidant enzymes during hypoxia or estivation that meets the inverted-U stimulation criteria.
links.context_zh_TW: Preparation for Oxidative Stress（POS）被提出作為 Hormesis 的生理條件化實例：缺氧或夏眠期間抗氧化酵素的短暫上調，符合倒 U 型的刺激判準。

links.context: Preserving fat-free mass during weight loss — via exercise rather than diet alone — protects against the fall in resting metabolic rate that otherwise accompanies caloric restriction, which is why resistance training is emphasised for weight-loss maintenance. Training also raises metabolic output per unit of lean tissue, since the metabolic intensity of FFM components is not uniform and aerobic enzyme induction is modifiable.
links.context_zh_TW: 在減重期間透過運動（而非單靠飲食）維持 fat-free mass，可防止原本伴隨熱量限制而出現的 resting metabolic rate 下降，因此減重維持特別強調阻力訓練。訓練還能提高每單位 lean tissue 的代謝產出，因為 FFM 各成分的代謝強度並不一致，且氧化酵素的誘導是可改變的。

links.context: Processed VEGF-C engages VEGFR2 to support blood-vessel angiogenesis, contributing to the angiogenic arm of the SASP. This promotes vascularization in wound healing but also in tumor and chronic-inflammatory contexts. The relationship links a senescence-secreted growth factor to new vessel formation and explains the pro-angiogenic influence of the secretome on surrounding tissue. It is a well-characterized VEGF-C activity that complements its primary lymphangiogenic role, and it may support nutrient supply and inflammatory cell trafficking into senescent tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: 經處理的 VEGF-C 接合 VEGFR2 以支持血管生成，貢獻 SASP 的血管生成臂。這在傷口癒合中促進血管化，但也在腫瘤與慢性炎症脈絡中。此關係將衰老分泌的生長因子連結到新血管形成，擴展分泌組超越免疫調節的功能後果。在慢性脈絡中，其血管生成可支持腫瘤生長，說明 SASP 的雙重性。它是分泌組生長因子臂的典型組成。

links.context: Promoter CpG hypermethylation silences CDH1 in epithelial cancers. Silencing is the epigenetic inactivation route.
links.context_zh_TW: 啟動子 CpG 高甲基化在上皮癌沉默 CDH1。沉默是表觀遺傳失活路徑。

links.context: Protein restriction couples autophagy activation with translation suppression, an adaptive response to amino acid scarcity that preserves cellular homeostasis. Upon mTORC1 inhibition, ULK1 initiates autophagosome formation, and mice lacking hepatic autophagy activation have blunted responses to PR. Amino acid sensing is physiologically important because scarcity promotes catabolic pathways and induces autophagy, allowing recycling of cellular components during dietary restriction.
