This historical clinical use demonstrates that the guanylhydrazone conjugate is stable and tolerated in vivo, in contrast to free adrenochrome. It also indicates that systematic evaluation of AMM in modern long-term aging and glycation models is currently lacking.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 在歷史上被開發並主要於日本臨床用於作為止血性毛細血管穩定劑與放射防護劑。其止血作用反映其穩定毛細血管並減少出血的能力，而其放射防護效果被認為源於保護細胞膜與造血祖細胞免受輻射誘發的氧化損傷。此歷史臨床用途證明 guanylhydrazone 共軛物在體內穩定且可耐受，與游離 adrenochrome 形成對比。它也顯示目前缺乏在現代長期衰老與糖化模型中對 AMM 的系統性評估。

links.context: Adrenochrome sulfonate is a degradation product formed when adrenochrome reacts with bisulfite antioxidants in the presence of light. Its formation reflects the photochemical instability of the adrenochrome chromophore.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome sulfonate 是 Adrenochrome 在光照下與 Bisulfite 抗氧化劑反應所形成的降解產物。其形成反映了 Adrenochrome 色基的光化學不穩定性。

links.context: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) released from the anterior pituitary under hypothalamic CRH stimulation binds the adrenal cortex to drive cortisol synthesis and release, forming the effector arm of the HPA-axis stress response. Chronic ACTH–cortisol activation suppresses heart-rate variability and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH）在下視丘 CRH 刺激下由腦下垂體前葉釋放，作用於腎上腺皮質以驅動 cortisol 的合成與釋放，構成 HPA 軸壓力反應的效應臂。慢性的 ACTH–cortisol 活化會抑制心率變異度並損害粒線體生合成。

links.context: Adult female Onchocerca volvulus coiled in subcutaneous onchocercomata release unsheathed microfilariae approximately 250–300 µm long, which migrate through dermis, lymphatics and ocular tissues. These larvae are the pathogenic stage of onchocerciasis: living microfilariae provoke little acute inflammation, but their death — spontaneous or drug-induced — releases antigens that incite inflammation, lymphatic endothelial injury and fibrosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 捲曲於皮下 onchocercoma 結節中的 Onchocerca volvulus 雌性成蟲會釋出長約 250–300 µm 的無鞘微絲蟲，牠們在真皮、淋巴與眼部組織中移行。這些幼蟲是 onchocerciasis 的致病階段：活的微絲蟲引起的急性發炎反應輕微，但其死亡——自然或藥物誘發——會釋出抗原，激起 inflammation、淋巴內皮損傷與纖維化。

links.context: Adult female Wuchereria bancrofti residing in lymphatic vessels release up to about 1000 microfilariae a day for 10–14 years. These sheathed microfilariae enter the circulation with pronounced nocturnal periodicity matching mosquito feeding, and are taken up by biting mosquitoes to continue development, making them both the disseminating stage within the host and the transmission stage to the environment.
links.context_zh_TW: 棲息於淋巴管中的 Wuchereria bancrofti 雌性成蟲每天可釋出多達約 1000 條微絲蟲，長達 10–14 年。這些有鞘微絲蟲帶有與蚊媒吸血時間吻合的明顯夜間週期性而進入循環，並被叮咬的蚊子攝入以繼續發育，因此它們既是宿主體內的擴散階段，也是對環境的傳播階段。

links.context: Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) form covalent cross-links with arterial collagen and elastin, replacing compliant elastin with a rigid, non-extensible matrix. This AGE-mediated cross-linking is the central molecular driver of arterial stiffening: loss of compliance in large elastic arteries raises systolic and pulse pressure, increases left-ventricular afterload, and damages small vessels in brain and kidney.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) 與動脈的 collagen 與 elastin 形成共價交聯，將具彈性的 elastin 替換為僵硬、不可伸展的基質。這種由 AGE 介導的交聯是動脈硬化的核心分子驅動因素：大彈性動脈順應性的喪失會升高收縮壓與脈壓、增加左心室後負荷，並傷害腦與腎臟的小血管。

links.context: Advanced Glycation End Products crosslink long-lived proteins such as collagen, elastin and myelin, and these AGE-modified proteins activate the RAGE receptor. RAGE engagement triggers pro-inflammatory NF-κB signaling and promotes oxidative stress via receptor-dependent NADPH oxidase activation, making the glyoxalase system a critical barrier to the glycation-inflammatory axis. Glyoxalase capacity also declines with age through oxidative inactivation of GLO1, reduced Glutathione availability and transcriptional downregulation, mirroring the accumulation of AGEs.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced Glycation End Products 會交聯 collagen、elastin 與 myelin 等長壽命蛋白，這些經 AGE 修飾的蛋白會活化 RAGE 受體。RAGE 的接合引發促發炎性的 NF-κB 訊號傳遞，並透過受體依賴型的 NADPH oxidase 活化促進氧化壓力，因此 glyoxalase system 是對抗 glycation–發炎軸的關鍵屏障。隨老化，glyoxalase 能力會因 GLO1 的氧化失活、Glutathione 可用性下降與轉錄下調而衰退，與 AGE 累積同步。

links.context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues over time and are associated with atherosclerotic plaque formation. Microvascular and macrovascular damage seen in diabetes is attributed to AGE accumulation in tissues, but it is also associated with atherosclerosis in the general aging population. Mechanistically, glycation of LDL reduces its uptake by cell receptors, glycated LDL becomes more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall, and macrophage uptake of these modified lipoproteins leads to foam cell formation and atheroma development. AGEs also impair nitric oxide bioavailability, further promoting the vascular dysfunction that underlies atherogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues over time並are associated with atherosclerotic plaque formation。Diabetes中所見的microvascular與macrovascular damage歸因於tissues中AGE accumulation，但它也與general aging population的atherosclerosis相關。在mechanistically，glycation of LDL reduces其uptake by cell receptors，glycated LDL becomes more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，而macrophage uptake of these modified lipoproteins leads to foam cell formation與atheroma development。AGEs亦impair nitric oxide bioavailability，further promoting the vascular dysfunction that underlies atherogenesis。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix and cross-link elastic fibers as well as collagen. This cross-linking of extracellular proteins reduces the elasticity of connective tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons, affecting especially vascular function. Glycated modifications alter the balance between ECM synthesis and degradation, accelerating skin aging and increasing skin stiffness. AGE-elastin cross-linking is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM）內，並使 elastic fibers 與 collagen 交聯。這種 extracellular proteins 的交聯降低了 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等結締組織的彈性，尤其影響 vascular function。Glycated modifications 改變 ECM synthesis 與 degradation 之間的平衡，加速 skin aging 並增加皮膚僵硬。AGE-elastin cross-linking 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products are toxic glycated adducts that accumulate in tissues during aging and in numerous age-related degenerative diseases. Numerous publications have demonstrated acceleration of the aging process by AGEs, which injure the extracellular matrix and cells through ECM cross-linking, modification of intracellular proteins, and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling. AGE accumulation in tissues such as heart, lung collagen, skin, tendon, cartilage, and vitreous body increases with age, and inhibiting AGE formation and accumulation is proposed to increase lifespan. Exogenous dietary AGEs also trigger organ dysfunction and tissue aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 是有毒的 glycated adducts，會在 aging 以及眾多 age-related degenerative diseases 期間堆積於組織中。大量文獻已證實 AGEs 加速 aging process，其透過 ECM cross-linking、intracellular proteins 修飾與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling 來傷害 extracellular matrix 與細胞。Heart、lung collagen、skin、tendon、cartilage 與 vitreous body 等組織中的 AGE accumulation 隨年齡增加，而抑制 AGE formation 與 accumulation 被提議可 increase lifespan。Exogenous dietary AGEs 也會引發 organ dysfunction 與 tissue aging。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products can modify intracellular antioxidant enzymes and reduce their activity. Glycated modifications lower the activity of catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase, and these alterations increase cellular oxidative stress. Because catalase normally decomposes hydrogen peroxide, its inhibition by glycation weakens cellular antioxidant defense and perpetuates oxidative damage. This glycation of antioxidant enzymes exemplifies how intracellular AGE modification of proteins impairs cellular function and contributes to the oxidative stress that characterizes aging and diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 可修飾 intracellular antioxidant enzymes 並降低其活性。Glycated modifications 降低 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 的活性，這些 alterations 增加細胞 oxidative stress。由於 catalase 通常 decomposes hydrogen peroxide，其受 glycation 抑制會削弱細胞 antioxidant defense 並使 oxidative damage 持續。這種 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 說明了蛋白質的 intracellular AGE modification 如何 impairs cellular function，並促成 aging 與 diabetes 特徵性的 oxidative stress。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products damage the cardiovascular system in part by glycating low-density lipoproteins (LDL) on both the apolipoprotein B and phospholipid components of the particle. Glycated LDL is more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall than non-glycated LDL, and it is not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway, so it accumulates in the vessel wall. Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation and the development of atheroma. This glycoxidative modification of LDL is thus a direct route through which AGEs promote atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products部分透過對low-density lipoproteins（LDL）顆粒上的apolipoprotein B與phospholipid components進行glycating，來damages the cardiovascular system。Glycated LDL比non-glycated LDL更susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，且它not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway，因此accumulates in the vessel wall。Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation與atheroma的development。因此，此glycoxidative modification of LDL是AGEs promote atherosclerosis的direct route。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Advanced glycation end products reduce nitric oxide activity, a vasodilator whose biosynthesis in the endothelium counteracts mechanisms of atherosclerosis. One proposed mechanism is that AGEs reduce the half-life of endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) in the endothelium; Xu and colleagues found decreased eNOS activity after exposure to CML, and a reversible inhibition of endothelium- and NO-dependent vascular responses after 30 minutes of exposure to CML-albumin, both in vivo and in vitro. By impairing eNOS, AGEs blunt nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation, contributing to the endothelial dysfunction and elevated vascular tone that characterize aging and diabetic vasculature.
links.context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products reduce nitric oxide activity——nitric oxide是一種vasodilator，其在endothelium中的biosynthesis counteracts mechanisms of atherosclerosis。One proposed mechanism是AGEs reduce the half-life of endothelial nitric oxide synthase（eNOS）in the endothelium；Xu及其colleagues found decreased eNOS activity after exposure to CML，且exposure to CML-albumin 30 minutes後，endothelium-與NO-dependent vascular responses出現reversible inhibition，此現象in vivo與in vitro皆然。By impairing eNOS，AGEs blunt nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation，contributing to the endothelial dysfunction與elevated vascular tone that characterize aging與diabetic vasculature。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

links.context: After degradation, autolysosomes undergo Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, a process that regenerates functional lysosomes from the hybrid organelle. ALR depends on AMPK, mTORC1 reactivation, and clathrin-mediated budding.
links.context_zh_TW: 降解完成後，autolysosome 會進行 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation，由該混合胞器再生出可運作的溶酶體。ALR 依賴 AMPK、mTORC1 再活化與 clathrin 媒介的出芽。

links.context: After partial hepatic absorption, fenbendazole is rapidly metabolized by FMO and CYP3A4 enzymes into its sulfoxide derivative oxfendazole, which is the primary metabolite responsible for fenbendazole's biological activity and can be reduced back to fenbendazole. Oxfendazole's much higher solubility (44.12 μg/ml) makes its human pharmacokinetics a useful surrogate for fenbendazole, and it received FDA fast-track designation for human trichuriasis.
links.context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 經肝臟部分吸收後，由 FMO 與 CYP3A4 酵素迅速代謝為其亞砜衍生物 Oxfendazole；後者是負責 Fenbendazole 生物活性的主要代謝物，且可被還原回 Fenbendazole。Oxfendazole 的溶解度（44.12 μg/ml）遠高於 Fenbendazole，因此其人體藥動學可作為 Fenbendazole 的替代參考，並已獲 FDA 快車指定用於人類鞭蟲病。

links.context: After thioredoxins catalyze substrate reduction, their oxidized CxxC motif is regenerated by thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, while glutaredoxins are recycled by reduced glutathione. Electrons thus flow from NADPH or GSH through the CxxC motif to protein disulfide substrates.
links.context_zh_TW: 在硫氧還蛋白催化受質還原後，其被氧化的 CxxC 基序由硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，而 glutaredoxin 則由還原態麩胱甘肽回收。因此電子從 NADPH 或 GSH 經 CxxC 基序流向蛋白質雙硫受質。

links.context: After time-gated labeling, TransitID cells are lysed and proteins enriched by streptavidin pulldown, with Mass Spectrometry and specialised LC-MS/MS workflows used to identify proteins biotinylated first by TurboID in the source compartment and then captured by BirA in the destination compartment — the signature of active transit between compartments.
links.context_zh_TW: 時間閘控標記後，TransitID 會將細胞裂解、以 streptavidin pulldown 富集蛋白，再透過 Mass Spectrometry 與專用的 LC-MS/MS 流程，辨識先由來源胞器的 TurboID 標記、再被目標胞器的 BirA 捕捉的蛋白質——這正是胞器間實際轉位的訊號特徵。

links.context: Age is the dominant risk factor for macular degenerative blindness.
links.context_zh_TW: 年齡是黃斑部退化失明的主要危險因子。

links.context: Age-related decline in immune surveillance permits senescent cells to accumulate, driving tissue dysfunction and age-related pathology. Pharmacological senolytics may compensate for this failed physiological clearance mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的免疫監視衰退使衰老細胞得以累積，進而造成組織功能失調與年齡相關病理。藥物性的 senolytics 可補償這個失效的生理性清除機制。

links.context: Aged mouse oocytes show sharply reduced SIRT1 (together with SIRT2 and SIRT3); maintaining SIRT1 expression reduces postovulatory oocyte ageing in vitro and in vivo. Directionally, SIRT1 decline contributes to oocyte ageing. This positions SIRT1 among the sirtuins guarding oocyte redox state and female fertility.
links.context_zh_TW: 老化的小鼠卵母細胞表現出 SIRT1（連同 SIRT2 和 SIRT3）的急劇下降；維持 SIRT1 表現可在體外和體內減少排卵後卵母細胞老化。方向性上 SIRT1 的下降導致卵母細胞老化。這將 SIRT3 定位為保護卵母細胞氧化還原狀態和女性生育力的 sirtuin 之一。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: Agents such as urolithin A or a mitohormetic ROS pulse activate NRF2, which transactivates the antioxidant response element and drives expression of glutathione S-transferases and other phase II enzymes, priming cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control.
links.context_zh_TW: Urolithin A 等物質或 mitohormetic 的 ROS 脈衝會活化 NRF2，進而反式啟動 Antioxidant Response Element，驅動 glutathione S-transferase 等第二期酵素的表現，為細胞 Autophagy 與粒線體品質管制做好準備。

links.context: Aggregation of amyloid-beta (Aβ) peptides is the central pathogenic event in Alzheimer's Disease: Aβ is the principal component of amyloid plaques, and its accumulation also underlies cerebral amyloid angiopathy. Reducing Aβ-induced neuronal death is a common assay endpoint, for example in studies of honokiol and magnolol.
links.context_zh_TW: 類澱粉β（Aβ）胜肽的聚集是 Alzheimer's Disease 的核心致病事件：Aβ 是類澱粉斑塊的主要成分，其累積也構成腦類澱粉血管病變的基礎。降低 Aβ 誘導的神經元死亡是常見的試驗終點，例如在研究 honokiol 與 magnolol 時即採用此指標。

links.context: Aging is accompanied by a global loss of repressive H3K9me3 and H3K27me3 marks, erosion of heterochromatin, derepression of Transposable Elements and redistribution of chromatin modifiers. This epigenetic drift is a core component of the Epigenetic Alterations hallmark of aging and is documented as a reversible driver of aging phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: Aging 伴隨抑制性的 H3K9me3 與 H3K27me3 標記全面流失、異染色質侵蝕、Transposable Elements 去抑制，以及染色質修飾酶的重新分布。這種表觀遺傳漂變是 Epigenetic Alterations 這個衰老特徵的核心組成，並被記錄為可逆的衰老表型驅動因素。

links.context: Aging is the single most significant risk factor for Neurodegenerative Diseases, whose long-lived post-mitotic neurons accumulate DNA damage (Genomic Instability) and suffer Autophagy failure linked to mTOR and AMPK dysregulation, alongside global Histone Acetylation deficits.
links.context_zh_TW: Aging 是 Neurodegenerative Diseases 最重要的單一風險因子；其長壽且不再分裂的神經元會累積 DNA 損傷（Genomic Instability），並出現與 mTOR、AMPK 失調相關的 Autophagy 失效，同時伴隨整體 Histone Acetylation 不足。

links.context: Aging remodels the Metabolome: alterations in acylcarnitines, branched-chain amino acids, the Kynurenine Pathway, and NAD+ intermediates track with Inflammation, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, and Metabolic Syndrome. Comparative metabolomic studies of Centenarians and long-lived cohorts use these shifts to identify pro-longevity metabolic signatures.
links.context_zh_TW: Aging 會重塑 Metabolome：醯基肉鹼、支鏈胺基酸、Kynurenine Pathway 以及 NAD+ 中間產物的改變，與 Inflammation、Mitochondrial Dysfunction 及 Metabolic Syndrome 平行變動。針對 Centenarians 與長壽族群的比較代謝組學研究，正是利用這些變化來鑑定促進長壽的代謝簽章。

links.context: Akt activates mTORC1, the master suppressor of Autophagy, and Akt phosphorylates TSC2, relieving the tuberin-hamartin GAP complex so that Rheb can drive mTORC1. Akt is also the major mTORC2 substrate at Ser473, linking the two complexes in the PI3K/Akt/mTOR axis.
links.context_zh_TW: Akt 會活化 mTORC1（Autophagy 的主要抑制者），並磷酸化 TSC2，使 tuberin-hamartin GAP 複合體解除抑制，讓 Rheb 得以驅動 mTORC1。Akt 同時是 mTORC2 在 Ser473 的主要受質，將兩個複合體連結在 PI3K／Akt／mTOR 軸上。

links.context: Akt and PP1α act on the same Caspase-9 residue from opposite directions: Akt phosphorylates Thr125 and suppresses initiator caspase activity, whereas PP1α dephosphorylates that same site and releases the inhibition. The resulting balance determines apoptotic priming in tumor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Akt 與 PP1α 從相反方向作用於 Caspase-9 的同一殘基：Akt 磷酸化 Thr125 並抑制起始型 caspase 活性，而 PP1α 則將同一位置去磷酸化並解除抑制。兩者的平衡決定腫瘤細胞的凋亡預備狀態。

links.context: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, resulting in cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor (PMID 28165011). This places TFEB downstream of PI3K/Akt signaling, so growth factor and insulin signals can restrain TFEB's nuclear translocation and thus suppress the lysosomal/autophagic transcriptional program. The S467 site is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same residue to produce the opposite outcome - enhanced transcriptional activity - illustrating how different kinases can converge on a single phosphorylation site to generate context-dependent regulation of TFEB. Akt-mediated cytoplasmic retention keeps TFEB inactive in the cytosol until activating signals relieve the phosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: Akt 在絲氨酸 467 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留（PMID 28165011）。這使 TFEB 位於 PI3K/Akt 信號通路的下游，因此生長因子和胰島素信號可以抑制 TFEB 的核轉位，從而抑制溶酶體/自噬轉錄程序。S467 位點與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一殘基產生相反結果——增強轉錄活性——說明不同的激酶如何匯聚在同一磷酸化位點上，根據語境產生 TFEB 的差異調節。Akt 介導的胞質保留使 TFEB 在細胞質中保持非活性狀態，直到啟動信號解除其磷酸化。

links.context: Akt phosphorylation inhibits the TSC1/TSC2 complex, raising Rheb-GTP. Inhibition is the growth-factor release of the brake.
links.context_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化抑制 TSC1/TSC2 複合體，提高 Rheb-GTP。抑制是生長因子釋放煞車。

links.context: Akt signaling is associated with inhibition of SIRT2-dependent cell-cycle and stress outputs (e.g., cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates SIRT2 at Ser331 to reduce its deacetylase activity), placing AKT signaling among negative regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304).
links.context_zh_TW: Akt 信號與 SIRT2 依賴性的細胞週期和壓力輸出的抑制相關（例如 cyclin E-CDK2 在 Ser331 處磷酸化 SIRT2 以降低其去乙醯酶活性），將 AKT 信號列為 SIRT2 通路的負向調節因子（Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Albendazole 400 mg daily for three days is a first-line treatment for trichuriasis, but single-dose albendazole alone has limited efficacy against Trichuris compared with other soil-transmitted helminths. Efficacy rises substantially when albendazole is combined with ivermectin or oxantel pamoate.
links.context_zh_TW: Albendazole 每日 400 mg、連續三天是鞭蟲病的一線治療，但單次劑量的 Albendazole 對 Trichuris 的療效，相較其他土壤傳播蠕蟲較為有限。與 Ivermectin 或 Oxantel pamoate 併用時，療效顯著提升。

links.context: Albendazole is the secondary anthelmintic option for Strongyloidiasis when Ivermectin is unavailable or contraindicated. It is a benzimidazole that, like oxfendazole, acts on parasite tubulin, and its lower cure rates mean eradication should be documented serologically and parasitologically.
links.context_zh_TW: 當 Ivermectin 無法取得或禁忌時，Albendazole 是 Strongyloidiasis 的次選驅蟲藥。它屬於 benzimidazole 類，與 oxfendazole 相同作用於寄生蟲 tubulin；由於根除率較低，應以血清學與寄生蟲學方法確認根除。

links.context: Albendazole is used synergistically with ivermectin in the treatment of gnathostomiasis, given at 400 mg twice daily for 21 days to act against migrating larvae of the zoonotic nematode genus Gnathostoma, most commonly Gnathostoma spinigerum.
links.context_zh_TW: Albendazole 在 gnathostomiasis 治療中與 ivermectin 協同併用，劑量為 400 mg、每日兩次、連續 21 天，作用於人畜共通絲蟲屬 Gnathostoma（最常見為 Gnathostoma spinigerum）的移行幼蟲。

links.context: Aldehyde dehydrogenases catalyze NAD(P)+-dependent oxidation of aldehydes such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal to their corresponding, less reactive carboxylic acids, reducing the rate of advanced glycation end product formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases 催化 NAD(P)+ 依賴的醛類氧化，將 3-deoxyglucosone、Methylglyoxal 等轉為反應性較低的羧酸，降低 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成速率。

links.context: Aldo-keto reductases act as a vital line of defense against dicarbonyl stress by reducing reactive glycation precursors such as methylglyoxal into less toxic species, with carbonyl reductase serving a complementary role in the AGE detoxification system.
links.context_zh_TW: Aldo-Keto Reductases 藉由將 Methylglyoxal 等反應性 glycation 前驅物還原為毒性較低的物種，對抗二羰基壓力；carbonyl reductase 在 AGE 解毒系統中扮演互補角色。

links.context: Aldo-keto reductases are NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductases that reduce the reactive dicarbonyl 3-deoxyglucosone to the corresponding, less toxic alcohol, removing it before it can cross-link proteins.
links.context_zh_TW: Aldo-Keto Reductases 是 NAD(P)H 依賴的氧化還原酶，將反應性二羰基 3-deoxyglucosone 還原為毒性較低的醇，在其交聯蛋白之前予以清除。

links.context: All LOX isoforms can initiate enzymatic Lipid Peroxidation. 12/15-LOX activity on membrane Polyunsaturated fatty acids contributes to Ferroptosis by generating peroxidized phospholipids whenever GPX4 antioxidant defence is overwhelmed, linking LOX chemistry to ferroptotic death and oxidative injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 所有 LOX 異型皆可啟動酵素性 Lipid Peroxidation。12/15-LOX 作用於膜上的多不飽和脂肪酸，在 GPX4 抗氧化防線被壓垮時產生過氧化磷脂，促成 Ferroptosis，將 LOX 化學與鐵死亡及氧化傷害連結起來。

links.context: All three UPR arms (PERK, IRE1, ATF6) converge on autophagy induction, and autophagic clearance of aggregated proteins and damaged ER fragments resolves the stress — a bidirectional relationship in which ER stress is both a signal that induces autophagy and a state modulated by it.
links.context_zh_TW: UPR 的三條分支（PERK、IRE1、ATF6）皆收斂於自噬的誘導，而自噬對聚集蛋白與受損內質網片段的清除可解除壓力——形成雙向關係：ER 壓力既是誘導自噬的訊號，其狀態也受自噬調節。

links.context: All-trans retinoic acid, the transcriptionally active endpoint of the retinoid pathway, heterodimerizes retinoic acid receptors (RARalpha/beta/gamma) with retinoid X receptors on retinoic acid response elements and drives a redox-defense gene program. Among the induced targets are GPX4, FSP1, GCH1 (for BH4 synthesis), ACSL3, SCD1 and PPARalpha - the transcriptional anti-ferroptotic module described by Studer et al. 2024. GPX4 is the enzymatic brake that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides, so its induction raises the threshold for iron-dependent death.
links.context_zh_TW: All-trans retinoic acid 是類維生素 A 途徑中具轉錄活性的終點，它與 retinoic acid receptors（RARalpha/beta/gamma）及 retinoid X receptors 在 retinoic acid response elements 上形成異二聚體，啟動紅氧防禦基因程式。被誘導的標的包括 GPX4、FSP1、GCH1（BH4 合成）、ACSL3、SCD1 與 PPARalpha——即 Studer 等人 2024 年所述的轉錄性抗 ferroptosis 模組。GPX4 是還原磷脂過氧化氫物的酵素煞車，因此其誘導會提高鐵依賴性細胞死亡的閾值。

links.context: Alongside Interleukin 1β, caspase-1 also matures IL-18. In the DROSHA-AIM2 axis in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, DROSHA deficiency suppressed AIM2 inflammasome-dependent caspase-1 activation and consequently IL-1β/IL-18 secretion from alveolar macrophages.
links.context_zh_TW: 除了 Interleukin 1β 之外，Caspase-1 也使 IL-18 成熟。在 Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis 的 DROSHA–AIM2 軸中，DROSha 缺失會抑制 AIM2 Inflammasome 依賴性的 Caspase-1 活化，並因而抑制肺泡巨噬細胞的 IL-1β/IL-18 分泌。

links.context: Alongside JAK2 and STAT3, ERK is one of the signalling nodes whose activating phosphotyrosines PTPN2 removes, terminating proliferative and survival output. This makes PTPN2 a broad brake on oncogenic cascades rather than a pathway-specific inhibitor.
links.context_zh_TW: 與 JAK2、STAT3 並列，ERK 也是 PTPN2 移除其活化性磷酸酪胺酸以終止增殖與存活輸出的訊號節點。這使 PTPN2 成為癌化訊號級聯的廣泛煞車，而非路徑專一性抑制劑。

links.context: Alongside VEGFR and c-KIT, Sunitinib targets PDGFR as part of its multi-kinase profile. This breadth is what distinguishes it from single-target agents and underlies its use in GIST, where the driving mutation (typically KIT or PDGFRA) varies between tumours and a single-receptor inhibitor would leave many patients untreated.
links.context_zh_TW: 與 VEGFR 和 c-KIT 並列，Sunitinib 將 PDGFR 納入其多激酶標靶範圍。這種廣度正是它有別於單標靶藥物的特徵，也支撐其在 GIST 的用途——GIST 的驅動突變（通常為 KIT 或 PDGFRA）在腫瘤間各異，單一受體抑制劑將讓許多患者無藥可治。

links.context: Alpha Diversity measures the richness and evenness of species within a single community or sample, describing the internal diversity of the Gut Microbiome. It is the within-sample complement of Beta Diversity, which compares turnover between communities.
links.context_zh_TW: Alpha Diversity 衡量單一群落或樣本內物種的豐富度與均勻度，用來描述 Gut Microbiome 的內部多樣性。它是樣本內的度量，與比較群落間更替的 Beta Diversity 互補。

links.context: Alpha-ketoglutarate is an obligate co-substrate for several dioxygenase families — TET enzymes mediating DNA demethylation, JmjC-domain histone demethylases, and PHD/EGLN prolyl hydroxylases that regulate HIF-alpha — so changes in its level can influence the Epigenome and oxygen sensing.
links.context_zh_TW: α-酮戊二酸是多個雙加氧酶家族的必需輔底物——包括介導 DNA 去甲基化的 TET 酵素、JmjC 結構域組蛋白去甲基化酶，以及調控 HIF-α 的 PHD/EGLN 脯胺酸羥化酶——因此其濃度變化可影響 Epigenome 與氧感應。

links.context: Alpha-ketoglutarate is the key intermediate through which glutamine carbon enters the TCA cycle by Anaplerosis, and it serves as a precursor for amino acid, fatty acid and sterol biosynthesis. Complex I inhibition causes alpha-ketoglutarate accumulation that cannot be efficiently processed into downstream TCA intermediates, stalling the cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: α-酮戊二酸是麩醯胺胺碳藉由 Anaplerosis 進入 TCA cycle 的關鍵中間產物，同時也是胺基酸、脂肪酸與類固醇生合成的先驅物。Complex I 抑制會造成 α-酮戊二酸累積，卻無法有效被處理成後續的 TCA 中間產物，使循環停滯。

links.context: Alpha-tubulin is one of the two subunits, with beta-tubulin, that form the alpha-beta tubulin heterodimer, the building block of microtubules and the mitotic spindle. Acetylation of alpha-tubulin, classically at Lys40, is a well-established mark of stabilized, long-lived microtubules.
links.context_zh_TW: α-tubulin 與 β-tubulin 共同組成 αβ 型的 Tubulin 異二聚體，該異二聚體是微管與有絲分裂紡錘體的組成單位。α-tubulin 的乙醯化（典型位於 Lys40）是穩定且長壽命微管的公認標記。

links.context: Although cGAS is best known for cytosolic DNA sensing, a substantial pool localizes to the Nucleus, where it performs noncanonical, STING-independent functions. Nuclear cGAS is tethered to nucleosomes via histones H2A/H2B, which restrains aberrant activation while enabling roles in genome stability, RNA processing and chromatin organization.
links.context_zh_TW: 雖然 cGAS 最廣為人知的功能是細胞質 DNA 感測，但有相當一部分會定位於細胞核（Nucleus），執行非典型且不依賴 STING 的功能。核內 cGAS 透過組蛋白 H2A/H2B 錨定於核小體，在抑制異常活化的同時，使其得以參與基因體穩定、RNA 處理與染色質組織。

links.context: Although it stimulated significant research into catecholamine metabolism, the Adrenochrome Hypothesis was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia, which implicated hyperactive dopaminergic transmission in mesolimbic pathways and later accumulated robust empirical support.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管它激發了大量 Catecholamines 代謝研究，Adrenochrome Hypothesis 仍大致被 Schizophrenia 的 Dopamine hypothesis 取代；後者指出 mesolimbic 路徑的過度多巴胺胺能傳遞，並獲得穩固的實證支持。

links.context: Although most opioids act predominantly through μ, κ and δ opioid receptors, several — tramadol, meperidine, methadone and dextromethorphan — inhibit serotonin reuptake or release, raising synaptic Serotonin. When combined with SSRIs or Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors such as Methylene blue, this serotonergic activity can precipitate Serotonin Syndrome, a potentially life-threatening toxidrome of hyperthermia, autonomic instability and neuromuscular hyperactivity.
links.context_zh_TW: 雖然多數類鴉片藥物主要透過 μ、κ、δ 類鴉片受體作用，但其中數種——tramadol、meperidine、methadone 與 dextromethorphan——會抑制血清素（Serotonin）的再攝取或釋放，提高突觸內 Serotonin 濃度。若與 SSRI 或諸如 Methylene blue 的單胺氧化酶抑制劑（Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor）併用，這種血清素活性可能誘發血清素症候群（Serotonin Syndrome），一種以高體溫、自主神經不穩定與神經肌肉過度興奮構成、可致命的毒理症候群。

links.context: Although nicotinamide (NAM) effectively increases NAD+ in tissues, it also exerts an inhibitory effect on sirtuins and PARP activity, a property that distinguishes it from the other precursors NMN and NR. At high doses, NAM is methylated by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase to generate N1-methylnicotinamide for elimination in urine, which can lower the cellular methyl pool over time. This depletion could reduce DNA and protein methylation and alter gene expression patterns and protein activity, since DNA methylation in gene promoter regions is typically associated with transcriptional repression. These effects may explain why NR administration raises NAD+ levels more than NAM treatment in some studies.
links.context_zh_TW: 儘管菸鹼醯胺（NAM）能有效提升組織中的 NAD+，它同時對去乙醯酶與 PARP 活性產生抑制作用，此特性使其有別於其他前驅物 NMN 和 NR。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶甲基化，生成 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能隨時間降低細胞甲基池。此耗竭可能減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現模式與蛋白質活性，因為基因啟動子區域的 DNA 甲基化通常與轉錄抑制相關。這些效應可能解釋為何在部分研究中 NR 給藥比 NAM 處理更能提升 NAD+ 水平。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Amadori products of glucose-lysine binding are early reversible fructosamine intermediates. Binding yields the first stable adduct.
links.context_zh_TW: 葡萄糖-離胺酸結合的 Amadori 產物是早期可逆的 fructosamine 中間體。結合產生首個穩定加合物。

links.context: Ambra-1 is a scaffold protein that bridges Beclin1 to the ULK1 complex, coordinating autophagosome nucleation as a positive regulator of the PI3K III complex.
links.context_zh_TW: Ambra-1 是支架蛋白，將 Beclin1 與 ULK1 複合體連結起來，作為 PI3K III 複合體的正向調節因子來協調自噬體成核。

links.context: Amifostine reduces radiation-induced DNA damage in normal tissue and is approved to decrease moderate-to-severe xerostomia in patients undergoing post-operative radiation for head and neck cancer. Its dose-limiting toxicities, hypotension and nausea, constrain clinical use despite its status as the prototypical selective radioprotectant.
links.context_zh_TW: Amifostine 可減少正常組織中輻射誘發的 DNA Damage，並获准用於降低接受頭頸癌術後放療患者中重度口乾的發生率。其劑量限制性毒性（低血壓與噁心）限制了臨床使用，儘管它是典型的選擇性放射保護劑。

links.context: Aminochrome is the cyclized, oxidized form of dopamine that can polymerize into the protective pigment neuromelanin. It is a pivotal branch-point intermediate whose normal polymerization builds neuromelanin while aberrant reactions form neurotoxic species.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminochrome 是多巴胺環化氧化後的產物，可聚合形成具保護性的色素 neuromelanin。它是關鍵的分支中間物，正常聚合時建構 neuromelanin，異常反應時則形成神經毒性物質。

links.context: Aminochromes are strong electrophiles capable of reacting with nucleophilic sulfhydryl (cysteine) groups on cellular proteins via Michael addition. This covalent modification is the proposed senomorphic mechanism: by alkylating critical cysteine residues on regulators such as IKK and the p65 subunit of NF-κB, adrenochrome could permanently inhibit NF-κB signaling and blunt transcription of SASP factors like IL-6 and IL-8. The same thiol-reactivity underlies aminochrome toxicity through adduct formation with proteins such as alpha-synuclein.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基色素是強親電體，能通過麥克爾加成與細胞蛋白質上的親核硫氫基（半胱氨酸）反應。這種共價修飾是假定的衰老模仿機制：通過烷基化調節因子如IKK和NF-κB的p65亞基上的關鍵半胱氨酸殘基，腎上腺素色素可能永久抑制NF-κB信號並削弱IL-6和IL-8等SASP因子的轉錄。相同的硫醇反應性奠定了氨基色素通過與α-突觸核蛋白等蛋白質形成加合物的毒性。

links.context: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome undergo one-electron reduction by enzymes like NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase to form unstable semiquinone radicals, which transfer electrons to molecular oxygen, generating superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone. This catalytic redox cycling continuously fuels oxidative stress. Because the quinone is regenerated, even small amounts of aminochrome can generate large amounts of reactive oxygen, the proposed basis for selective killing of oxidatively stressed senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素經由NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶等酶進行單電子還原，形成不穩定的半醌自由基，這些自由基將電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並再生母體醌。此催化氧化還原循環持續 fuel 氧化應激。由於醌被再生，即使少量氨基色素也能產生大量活性氧，這是選擇性殺死氧化應激衰老細胞的假定基礎。

links.context: Aminochromes tend to polymerize into complex pigments such as Neuromelanin in the brain or peripheral melanins. This polymerization route explains the dark pigment that accumulates in dopaminergic neurons and whose abundance has long been assumed to be an unavoidable by-product of Aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminochromes 傾向聚合形成複雜色素，例如腦中的 Neuromelanin 或周邊黑色素。這條聚合途徑解釋了多巴胺能神經元中累積的深色色素，而其含量長期以為只是 Aging 不可避免的副產物。

links.context: Aminochromes, including adrenochrome, are ortho-quinones (o-quinones), a structural class of strong electrophiles that participate in one- and two-electron redox reactions. As an o-quinone, adrenochrome can be reduced to a semiquinone radical and can undergo Michael addition with nucleophilic thiols on proteins. The o-quinone character is the chemical basis for both the proposed senotherapeutic effects, ROS generation and NF-κB modification, and the toxic adduct formation implicated in neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基色素，包括腎上腺素色素，是鄰醌（o-quinones），一類參與單電子和雙電子氧化還原反應的強親電體結構類。作為鄰醌，腎上腺素色素可被還原為半醌自由基，並可與蛋白質上的親核硫醇進行麥克爾加成。鄰醌特性是所提出的衰老治療效應（ROS產生和NF-κB修飾）以及與神經退行性疾病相關的毒性加合物形成的化學基礎。

links.context: Aminochromes, the oxidative intermediates of catecholamine metabolism, can polymerize into neuromelanin, the dark pigment that accumulates in catecholaminergic neurons. This oxidation route becomes more prominent in high-ROS settings such as stress, smoking, or inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminochromes（兒茶酚胺氧化的中間產物）可聚合成 neuromelanin，即在兒茶酚胺能神經元中累積的深色色素。此氧化途徑在壓力、抽菸或發炎等高 ROS 情境下更為顯著。

links.context: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) is a one-carbon compound formally classified as a member of the guanidines. Its compact scaffold, which can be viewed as a derivative of hydrazine, guanidine, or formamide, gives it both nucleophilic and carbonyl-reactive chemistry. One-carbon compounds serve as minimal scaffolds in drug design, and here the nitrogen-dense core endows the molecule with the enzyme-inhibitory and advanced glycation end product-blocking activities for which aminoguanidine, also known as pimagedine, is studied in diabetic complications research.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) 是一種一碳化合物，正式歸類為胍類化合物的一員。其緊湊的骨架可被視為肼、胍或甲醯胺的衍生物，賦予其親核性和羰基反應性化學特性。一碳化合物在藥物設計中充當最小骨架，此處富含氮的核心賦予該分子酶抑制和晚期糖基化終產物阻斷活性，因此 aminoguanidine（亦稱為 pimagedine）在糖尿病併發症研究中受到關注。

links.context: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) manages diabetic nephropathy and is beneficial in treating patients with the condition, either alone or in combination with other therapies. Diabetic nephropathy is the progressive kidney damage driven by hyperglycemia, advanced glycation end product accumulation, and hemodynamic stress. By inhibiting AGE formation and, to a lesser extent, aldose reductase and nitric oxide synthase, aminoguanidine targets several pathways implicated in the renal injury of diabetes, which is why it was developed and clinically investigated for diabetic kidney disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) 用於治療糖尿病腎病變，對患有此病症的患者有益，可單獨使用或與其他療法結合使用。糖尿病腎病變是由高血糖、晚期糖化終產物積累和血液動力學壓力所導致的進行性腎損傷。通過抑制 AGE 形成，以及較少程度地抑制醛糖還原酶和一氧化氮合酶，aminoguanidine 針對多種與糖尿病腎損傷相關的通路，這就是為什麼它被開發並臨床研究用於糖尿病腎病。

links.context: Aminoguanidine blocks the synthesis of nitric oxide by selectively inhibiting the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme, acting upstream of NO signaling in the NO-cGMP vasodilation cascade. While methylene blue blocks NO action downstream at soluble guanylyl cyclase, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of NO from the start, during inflammation, injury, or shock. Because it spares the endothelial form of NOS (eNOS), it is considered a theoretical way to halt the inflammatory cascade without shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍抑制诱导型一氧化氮合酶 (iNOS) 酶的合成，在 NO 信号通路上上游作用，参与 NO-cGMP 血管舒张的级联反应。 亚硝酰青色素则在可溶性一氧化氮合酶 (sGC) 处阻断 NO 作用，而氨基胍则从一开始阻止 NO 过度产生，在炎症、损伤或休克期间。 由于它保留了内皮型 NOS (eNOS) 的活性，因此被认为是无需关闭正常血压调节即可阻止炎症级联反应的一种理论方法。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is a scavenger of alpha-dicarbonyls and showed promising results in some studies as an inhibitor of advanced glycation end product formation. In long-term animal studies, administration of aminoguanidine for 24-30 weeks prevented age-related cardiac hypertrophy and arterial stiffness, consistent with protection against AGE-driven cardiovascular remodeling. However, a clinical trial in diabetic patients was stopped due to safety concerns and lack of efficacy, with side effects including gastrointestinal disturbance, abnormal liver function tests, and flu-like symptoms. Aminoguanidine remains a reference compound for anti-glycation drug development.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍（Aminoguanidine）是α-二羰基化合物的清除劑，在部分研究中作為晚期糖化終產物形成的抑制劑展現出有希望的結果。在長期動物研究中，給予氨基胍 24-30 週可預防年齡相關的心肌肥大與動脈僵硬，與對抗 AGE 驅動的心血管重塑之保護作用一致。然而，一項針對糖尿病患者的臨床試驗因安全性疑慮與缺乏療效而中止，副作用包括胃腸道不適、肝功能檢驗異常與類流感症狀。氨基胍仍是抗糖化藥物開發的參考化合物。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the enzyme that breaks down histamine in the gut. By blocking intestinal DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods - aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods - may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This is a major safety consideration for oral aminoguanidine use in supplement or experimental settings.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二胺氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，該酶在腸道中分解組胺。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可顯著增加對膳食組胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組胺食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這對於口服氨基胍在補充劑或實驗設定中使用來說是一個主要安全考量。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine is an EC 1.4.3.4 (monoamine oxidase) inhibitor. Monoamine oxidase is the flavin-dependent mitochondrial enzyme that degrades catecholamines and other biogenic amines, and its inhibition can raise amine concentrations and alter cellular redox balance. Because aminoguanidine is a hydrazine derivative, its MAO inhibition parallels the mechanism of classic hydrazine-based MAO inhibitors, a property relevant both to its pharmacology and to off-target effects when the compound is used experimentally in catecholamine or adrenochrome research.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 EC 1.4.3.4（monoamine oxidase）抑制劑。Monoamine oxidase 是降解兒茶酚胺和其他生物胺的黃素依賴型粒線體酵素，其抑制可升高胺濃度並改變細胞氧化還原平衡。由於 aminoguanidine 是肼衍生物，其 MAO 抑制作用與經典基於肼的 MAO 抑制劑機制相似，此性質既與其藥理學相關，也與該化合物在兒茶酚胺或 adrenochrome 研究中實驗使用時的脫靶效應相關。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is classified under the MeSH pharmacological class of enzyme inhibitors, defined as compounds or agents that combine with an enzyme in such a manner as to prevent the normal substrate-enzyme combination and the catalytic reaction. Aminoguanidine fits this class through multiple activities: it inhibits monoamine oxidase, nitric oxide synthase, diamine oxidase, and aldose reductase. The enzyme-inhibitor classification captures the mechanism by which this small hydrazine derivative exerts both its therapeutic AGE-modulating effects and its broader off-target pharmacology.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 被歸類於 MeSH 藥理學類別中的酵素抑制劑（enzyme inhibitors），其定義為與酵素結合以阻止正常底物-酵素結合及催化反應的化合物或試劑。Aminoguanidine 透過多種活性符合此分類：它可抑制 monoamine oxidase、nitric oxide synthase、diamine oxidase 及 aldose reductase。此酵素抑制劑分類捕捉了這類小型 hydrazine 衍生物發揮其治療性 AGE 調節效應及其更廣泛的脫靶藥理學的機制。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is formally a member of the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group that is highly basic and forms strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine formally belongs to the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group, which is highly basic and can form strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine, the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.

links.context: Aminoguanidine is the tightest-coupled exogenous protocol agent to the adrenochrome trigger: direct chemical edge 'reacts_with' (conf 0.9, PPR #4 seeded at Adrenochrome) originating from the US4501923A adrenochrome-preparation patent document in the vault.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是與 adrenochrome 觸發器耦合最緊密的外源協定劑：直接化學邊「reacts_with」（conf 0.9，以 Adrenochrome 為種子時 PPR #4），源自庫中的 US4501923A adrenochrome 製備專利文件。

links.context: Aminoguanidine reacts with the unstable o-quinone structure of Adrenochrome to form Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a stable crystalline hemostatic derivative. This traps the reactive quinone with the hydrazine group, preserving the adrenochrome moiety's hormetic redox activity while eliminating uncontrolled reactivity.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 會與 Adrenochrome 不穩定的 o-醌結構反應，形成 Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine，一種穩定的結晶止血衍生物。此反應以 hydazine 基團捕捉反應性醌類，在保留 adrenochrome 部分的 hormetic 氧化還原活性的同時消除不受控的反應性。

links.context: Aminoguanidine was the first AGE inhibitor and has been shown in previous reports to prevent diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications through the inhibition of AGE formation. It was also shown to prevent diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking. However, aminoguanidine cannot be used clinically due to safety concerns including pro-oxidant activities and inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. Its efficacy in animal models established the concept that blocking glycation can prevent diabetic complications and validated AGEs as a therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是首個 AGE inhibitor，先前報告已證實其透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。它也被證實能預防 diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking。然而，由於包括 pro-oxidant activities 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase 在內的 safety concerns，aminoguanidine 無法臨床使用。其在 animal models 中的 efficacy 確立了 blocking glycation 可預防 diabetic complications 的概念，並 validated AGEs 作為 therapeutic target。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine's drug indication is diabetic kidney disease, and it is investigated for use and treatment in this condition. Diabetic nephropathy is a major cause of end-stage renal disease and is closely tied to hyperglycemia-driven accumulation of advanced glycation end products in the glomerulus. The investigational status reflects clinical interest in AGE inhibition as a renoprotective strategy, with aminoguanidine serving as the prototypical agent in that class despite its development not reaching an approved, marketed product.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 的藥物適應症為糖尿病腎病，目前正針對此適應症進行研究與治療探索。糖尿病腎病變是末期腎病的主要致因，與高血糖驅動的晚期糖化終產物（AGE）在腎小球中的蓄積密切相關。其研究狀態反映出臨床界對 AGE 抑制作為腎臟保護策略的興趣，Aminoguanidine 作為該類藥物的原型代表，儘管其開發尚未達到獲准上市的階段。

links.context: Aminoguanidine, the first AGE inhibitor, has a safety concern related to its inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Aminooxyacetate, an aminotransferase inhibitor that blocks the malate-aspartate shuttle, lowers the cytosolic NAD+/NADH ratio — but not the mitochondrial one — and causes senescence. Together with MDH1-knockdown data this demonstrates that the cytosolic NAD+/NADH ratio maintained by the shuttle, rather than mitochondrial NAD+ pools, governs senescence induction.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminooxyacetate 是一種抑制轉氨酶、可阻斷蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭的物質；它降低細胞質的 NAD+/NADH 比值（但不影響粒線體），並造成衰老。結合 MDH1 敲低的數據，這證明調控衰老誘發的是由該穿梭維持的細胞質 NAD+/NADH 比值，而非粒線體 NAD+ 池。

links.context: Amiodarone is a class III antiarrhythmic (with additional class I, II and IV activity) that blocks potassium, sodium and calcium channels as well as beta-adrenergic receptors. It is used for refractory ventricular arrhythmias and is positioned in advanced life-support resuscitation protocols for cardiac arrest. Its large iodine load and lipophilicity produce chronic thyroid dysfunction, pulmonary fibrosis, corneal deposits and hepatotoxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: Amiodarone 是第三類抗心律不整藥（兼具第一、二、四類活性），可阻斷鉀離子、鈉離子與鈣離子通道以及 β-腎上腺素受體。它用於難治性心室心律不整，並被納入心臟驟停進階生命支持急救方案。其高碘負荷與脂溶性導致慢性甲狀腺功能異常、肺纖維化、角膜沉積與肝毒性。

links.context: Ammonium persulfate is a powerful two-electron oxidizer with E° = 2.01 V for S₂O₈²⁻ + 2e⁻ → 2SO₄²⁻, exceeding hydrogen peroxide (1.78 V). In aqueous solution it decomposes slowly by hydrolysis to hydrogen peroxide and ammonium bisulfate, a process accelerated by heat, transition metal ions and alkaline pH.
links.context_zh_TW: Ammonium Persulfate 是強效雙電子氧化劑，S₂O₈²⁻ + 2e⁻ → 2SO₄²⁻ 的標準還原電位 E° = 2.01 V，高於 Hydrogen Peroxide（1.78 V）。在水溶液中它經水解緩慢分解產生 Hydrogen Peroxide 與 ammonium bisulfate，熱、過渡金屬離子與鹼性 pH 會加速此過程。

links.context: Among individual essential amino acids, Methionine is one of the most effective at recapitulating the benefits of Protein restriction, alongside isoleucine and valine. Because cysteine can be synthesized from methionine via transsulfuration, most methionine restriction studies also require cysteine depletion, which places MR and PR on a shared endocrine and methyl-donor axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在個別必需胺基酸之中，Methionine 是最能重現 Protein Restriction 效益者之一，與 isoleucine、valine 並列。由於半胱胺酸可經由轉硫作用由甲硫胺酸合成，因此多數甲硫胺酸限制研究也需搭配半胱胺酸耗竭，使 MR 與 PR 落在共享的內分泌與甲基供體軸線上。

links.context: Among the three precursors nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide (NAM), and nicotinamide riboside (NR), only NR could prolong survival and induce hematopoietic stem cell regeneration, as documented in a study with mice treated with irradiation. This implies advantages of the NR precursor for potential use in cancer patients undergoing chemo- or radiotherapy, and orally administered NR was also found to improve resistance to and reversal of chemotherapeutic neuropathy. NR's ability to rejuvenate stem cells appears to be a general phenomenon during treatment and has been suggested to underlie a small but significant extension of lifespan in mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 在三種前驅物 nicotinic acid（NA）、nicotinamide（NAM）與 nicotinamide riboside（NR）之中，唯有 NR 能延長存活並誘發造血幹細胞再生，此記載於一項以照射處理小鼠的研究中。這暗示了 NR 前驅物在癌症患者接受化療或放療時潛在使用的優勢，且口服 NR 亦被發現能改善對化療神經病變的抵抗力與其逆轉。NR 使幹細胞年輕化的能力似乎為治療期間的普遍現象，並被認為是小鼠中微小但顯著的壽命延長的基礎。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
links.context_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Amphiregulin is a canonical EGFR ligand within the SASP growth-factor arm that drives epithelial proliferation and reprogramming. EGFR engagement links senescent secretion to neighboring-stroma remodeling.
links.context_zh_TW: Amphiregulin 是 SASP 生長因子臂中典型的 EGFR 配體，驅動上皮增殖與重編程。EGFR 結合將衰老分泌連結到鄰近基質重塑。

links.context: Amphiregulin is a conserved growth-factor component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), secreted by senescent cells in autocrine and paracrine fashion. In acute senescence it supports wound healing and liver regeneration, while in chronic senescence sustained EGFR activation can promote tumor growth and therapy resistance — exemplifying the dual nature of SASP factors.
links.context_zh_TW: Amphiregulin 是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中保守的生長因子成分，由衰老細胞以自分泌與旁分泌方式釋放。在急性衰老情境中它促進傷口癒合與肝臟再生，而在慢性衰老情境中持續的 EGFR 活化則可能促進腫瘤生長與治療抗性，典型地體現 SASP 因子的雙重性。

links.context: Amplification of BIRC2/BIRC3 occurs in multiple carcinomas, and the resulting excess cIAP activity is a therapeutic vulnerability addressed by Smac mimetics such as birinapant, LCL161 and xevinapant in clinical trials. Efficacy tracks with RIPK3 proficiency and low FLIP_S, and the canonical resistance routes — RIPK3 silencing and c-FLIP overexpression — convert ripoptosome signaling back into survival.
links.context_zh_TW: BIRC2/BIRC3 的擴增見於多種癌症，而由此而來的 cIAP 活性過高正是臨床試驗中 birinapant、LCL161 與 xevinapant 等 Smac mimetics 所要攻擊的治療弱點。療效與 RIPK3 的功能完整性及較低的 FLIP_S 相關，而典型的抗藥途徑——RIPK3 靜默與 c-FLIP 過度表現——會把 ripoptosome 訊號重新轉回存活模式。

links.context: An EpiPen is a brand of epinephrine auto-injector used for emergency treatment of Anaphylaxis. The stability of the Epinephrine it contains is critical: formulations are designed to suppress formation of Adrenochrome and other degradants, giving a typical shelf life of 12-24 months at room temperature, which is why device formulation and quality control are core product concerns.
links.context_zh_TW: EpiPen 是 epinephrine 自動注射器的品牌名稱，用於 Anaphylaxis 的緊急治療。其中 Epinephrine 的穩定性至關重要：配方設計會抑制 Adrenochrome 與其他降解產物的形成，使室溫下典型保存期限達 12–24 個月，因此裝置配方與品質管制是產品核心考量。

links.context: An Oncogene is a gene with the potential to cause Cancer when mutated, overexpressed or constitutively activated. Major oncogenes include RAS, MYC, BRAF, EGFR, HER2, PIK3CA, Akt and BCR-ABL, and their activation promotes Cell Proliferation, Angiogenesis, Metastasis and resistance to Apoptosis, which is why they are the dominant oncogenic lesions in human tumours.
links.context_zh_TW: 致癌基因（Oncogene）是在突變、過量表現或持續活化時具有引發癌症（Cancer）潛力的基因。主要致癌基因包括 RAS、MYC、BRAF、EGFR、HER2、PIK3CA、Akt 與 BCR-ABL，其活化會促進細胞增殖（Cell Proliferation）、血管新生（Angiogenesis）、轉移（Metastasis）與對凋亡（Apoptosis）的抵抗，因此它們是人類腫瘤中主要的致癌病變。

links.context: An arterial blood gas performed with co-oximetry quantifies hemoglobin species directly, including methemoglobin, carboxyhemoglobin, oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin. Methemoglobin levels above 1.5% are abnormal, and values above 15% produce cyanosis while above 50% can cause life-threatening hypoxia and cardiac arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: 搭配 co-oximetry 執行的 ABG 可直接定量各類血紅素，包含 Methemoglobin、carboxyhemoglobin、Oxyhemoglobin 與 deoxyhemoglobin。Methemoglobin 超過 1.5% 即屬異常，超過 15% 會造成 Cyanosis，超過 50% 則可能引發致命性 Hypoxia 與 Cardiac arrest。

links.context: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
links.context_zh_TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

links.context: An o-quinone (ortho-quinone) is a type of organic compound derived from phenols, specifically catechols, and behaves as a highly reactive Electrophile: its quinone carbonyls are prone to nucleophilic attack, for example via Michael addition, which is also the mechanism of its intramolecular cyclization.
links.context_zh_TW: o-quinone（鄰醌）是由酚類、尤其是兒茶酚衍生而成的一類有機化合物，具有高度反應性的 Electrophile 性質：其醌類羰基容易受到親核性進攻，例如透過 Michael addition，而這也正是其分子內環化的機制。

links.context: Anakinra is approved for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis refractory to DMARDs, and for acute gout flares unresponsive to colchicine or NSAIDs. It has also been studied in the CANTOS Trial context as proof-of-concept for IL-1 blockade in cardiovascular disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Anakinra 已核准用於對 DMARD 無反應的中重度類風濕性關節炎，也用於對 colchicine 或 NSAIDs 無反應的急性痛風發作。它亦在 CANTOS Trial 的脈絡中作為 IL-1 阻斷於心血管疾病的理念驗證而被研究。

links.context: Anaplerosis comprises the biochemical reactions that refill TCA cycle intermediates withdrawn for biosynthesis. In rapidly proliferating cells, intermediates are diverted into amino acid, fatty acid, sterol and nucleotide synthesis, so anaplerotic input becomes essential for continued cycle flux. Glutamine is the dominant anaplerotic substrate in cancer cells, converted to glutamate by glutaminase and then to α-ketoglutarate, which re-enters the cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: Anaplerosis 指的是補回因生物合成而被抽用的 TCA cycle 中間產物的生化反應。在快速增殖細胞中，中間產物被分流至胺基酸、脂肪酸、固醇與核苷酸合成，因此補充性輸入對維持循環流量至關重要。在癌細胞中，glutamine 是主要的補充性受質，經 glutaminase 轉為 glutamate，再轉為 α-Ketoglutarate 重新進入循環。

links.context: Androgen receptor signaling drives MBOAT2 transcription, the male counterpart of the ER-to-MBOAT1 gate, conferring ferroptosis resistance through the same PE-MUFA remodeling logic.
links.context_zh_TW: Androgen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT2 轉錄，即 ER 至 MBOAT1 閘門的雄性對應物，透過相同的 PE-MUFA 重塑邏輯賦予 ferroptosis 抗性。

links.context: Androgen-receptor binding promotes protein synthesis, resistance to Muscle Atrophy, and prevention of Osteoporosis. Testosterone deficiency associates with sarcopenia, adiposity, and inflammaging, whereas balanced androgen tone within a Mitohormesis-like optimum favors Healthspan; supraphysiological dosing instead raises redox and thrombotic risk.
links.context_zh_TW: 雄性素受體的結合促進蛋白質合成、提高對 Muscle Atrophy 的抵抗力並預防 Osteoporosis。Testosterone 缺乏與肌少症、脂肪堆積及 inflammaging 相關；而在類似 Mitohormesis 的最佳範圍內維持平衡的雄性素張力則有利於 Healthspan；超生理劑量的給藥反而會提高氧化還原與血栓風險。

links.context: Aneuploidy has a paradoxical dual role in cancer. In cells with intact p53, whole-chromosome gain triggers p53-dependent growth arrest or apoptosis, acting as a tumour-suppressive barrier. Once p53 function is lost — a common early tumorigenic event — aneuploid cells can proliferate and aneuploidy instead promotes genomic instability, loss of heterozygosity and clonal evolution toward drug resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Aneuploidy 在癌症中具有矛盾的雙重角色。在 p53 完整的細胞中，整條染色體增加會觸發 p53 相依的生長停滯或凋亡，構成腫瘤抑制屏障。一旦 p53 功能喪失（腫瘤發生的早期常見事件），非整倍體細胞即可增殖，非整倍體反而促進基因體不穩定、異型合子性喪失與朝向抗藥性的克隆演化和。

links.context: Aneuploidy is a near-universal hallmark of cancer cells: about 90% of solid tumours and a substantial fraction of haematological malignancies are aneuploid. Ongoing chromosomal missegregation (chromosomal instability) drives intratumour heterogeneity, enabling loss of tumour suppressor genes, gain of oncogenes, HLA loss for immune evasion and copy-number driven drug resistance. Aneuploidy also imposes proteotoxic and metabolic stress by overloading the proteasome and shifting metabolic flux.
links.context_zh_TW: Aneuploidy 幾乎是癌細胞的普遍特徵：約 90% 的實體腫瘤與相當比例的血液惡性腫瘤具有非整倍體。持續的染色體誤分離（染色體不穩定）驅動腫瘤內異質性，使腫瘤抑制基因喪失、致癌基因增幅、HLA 喪失以利免疫逃脫，以及由拷貝數變化造成的抗藥性。非整倍體也透過使蛋白酶體過載與改變代謝流而施加蛋白毒性與代謝壓力。

links.context: Angiogenesis is the formation of new blood vessels from pre-existing vessels and is a critical process in tumor growth, wound healing and ischemia-reperfusion injury adaptation. Tumour angiogenesis is a hallmark of cancer, driven in part by HIF-1α-dependent VEGF expression, with ROS promoting angiogenic signalling. Anti-angiogenic strategies aim to starve tumours of blood supply.
links.context_zh_TW: Angiogenesis 是由既有血管形成新血管的過程，在腫瘤生長、傷口癒合與缺血再灌流損傷的適應中皆具關鍵地位。腫瘤血管新生是癌症的特徵之一，部分由 HIF-1α 依賴的 VEGF 表現驅動，並由 ROS 促進血管新生訊號。抗血管新生策略的目標是使腫瘤缺乏血液供給。

links.context: Annexin V is the canonical reagent for detecting phosphatidylserine exposure, the 'eat-me' signal externalized on the inner plasma membrane leaflet during early Apoptosis. Conjugated to fluorescent or biotin tags, Annexin V binds phosphatidylserine with nanomolar affinity in the presence of Ca2+ and labels cells without membrane permeabilization, making it the standard early-death marker in flow-cytometry apoptosis assays.
links.context_zh_TW: Annexin V 是偵測磷脂醯絲胺酸（PS）外露的標準試劑，而 PS 正是細胞在 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）早期由內膜葉翻轉到細胞外膜的「被吞噬訊號」。Annexin V 螯合螢光或生物素標記後，在 Ca²⁺ 存在下以奈莫耳級親和力結合 PS，並可在不破壞細胞膜的情況下標示細胞，因此成為流式細胞凋亡檢測中標準的早期死亡標記。

links.context: Anti-CD20 rituximab is the backbone of B-cell NHL regimens.
links.context_zh_TW: 抗 CD20 rituximab 是 B 細胞 NHL 方案主幹。

links.context: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 inhibits apoptosis, thereby opposing SIRT5's pro-survival species; in Table 3 Bcl-2 is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT5 pathway in contexts where SIRT5's effects depend on cell survival/Apoptosis signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 抗凋亡 Bcl-2 抑制凋亡，因此拮抗 SIRT5 的促存活作用；在表 3 中，Bcl-2 被列為 SIRT5 通路在 SIRT5 效果依賴於細胞存活/凋亡信號環境中的負向調節因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 sequesters BAX, blocking its mitochondrial translocation and outer-membrane permeabilization. This canonical blockade is the control point that senolytics and BH3 mimetics release.
links.context_zh_TW: 抗凋亡 Bcl-2 隔離 BAX，阻斷其粒線體轉位與外膜通透化。此典型封鎖是 senolytics 與 BH3 mimetics 釋放的控制點。

links.context: Anti-inflammatory denotes substances, interventions or mechanisms that reduce inflammation. It encompasses pharmacological agents (NSAIDs, corticosteroids, DMARDs, biologics), dietary compounds (curcumin, resveratrol, omega-3 fatty acids, polyphenols) and lifestyle interventions (exercise, caloric restriction, fasting). Mechanisms include inhibition of NF-κB, cyclooxygenase and lipoxygenase, cytokine signalling and ROS production.
links.context_zh_TW: Anti-inflammatory 泛指可減少發炎的物質、介入或機制，涵蓋藥理藥物（NSAIDs、Corticosteroids、DMARDs、Biologics）、膳食化合物（curcumin、resveratrol、Omega-3 Fatty Acids、Polyphenols）以及生活型態介入（Exercise、Caloric Restriction、Fasting）。其機制包括抑制 NF-κB、環氧化酶與脂氧化酶、細胞激素訊號與 ROS 生成。

links.context: Antioxidants protect LDL and HDL from oxidative modification and thereby oppose atherosclerosis. Oxidation of LDL produces oxidized LDL that drives foam cell formation, while oxidation of HDL impairs its cholesterol efflux capacity. Resveratrol protects lipoproteins against copper- and radical-induced oxidation and preserves LDL vitamin E content during oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Antioxidant 可保護 LDL 與 HDL 免於氧化修飾，因而抵抗動脈粥狀硬化。LDL 的氧化會產生 oxidized LDL 並驅動泡沫細胞形成，而 HDL 的氧化則損害其膽固醇外排能力。Resveratrol 可保護脂蛋白免受銅離子與自由基誘發的氧化，並在氧化壓力下維持 LDL 中的 vitamin E 含量。

links.context: Aphidicolin competitively inhibits DNA polymerases alpha/delta at the dCTP site. This defines its fork-stalling pharmacology.
links.context_zh_TW: Aphidicolin 在 dCTP 位點競爭性抑制 DNA 聚合酶 alpha/delta。此定義其複製叉停滯藥理。

links.context: ApiTox is a standardized preparation of Apis mellifera venom used in apitherapy research; its major bioactive components are melittin (40-60% of dry weight), Phospholipase A2, apamin, mast cell degranulating peptide and adolapin. Melittin is the principal toxin of ApiTox, a 26-amino acid amphipathic peptide that disrupts cell membranes, activates Phospholipase A2 and induces Apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: ApiTox 是 Apis mellifera 蜂毒標準化製劑，用於蜂療研究；其主要活性成分包括 melittin（占乾重 40–60%）、Phospholipase A2、apamin、肥大細胞脫顆粒胜肽與 adolapin。Melittin 是 ApiTox 的主要毒素，為 26 個胺基酸的兩親性胜肽，可破壞細胞膜、活化 Phospholipase A2 並誘發 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）。

links.context: Apigenin ATP-competitively inhibits CDK4, blocking cyclin association and G1 progression. Inhibition parallels the CDK6 edge.
links.context_zh_TW: Apigenin 以 ATP 競爭抑制 CDK4，阻斷 cyclin 結合與 G1 進展。抑制與 CDK6 邊平行。

links.context: Apigenin acts as a senomorphic that suppresses the SASP of senescent stroma, depriving adjacent cancer cells of the paracrine chemoresistance they had acquired; conditioned media from apigenin-treated stroma reversed the viability shift, and combining apigenin with mitoxantrone produced an additional 51.1% tumor reduction in vivo with enhanced DNA damage and apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Apigenin 作為 senomorphic 抑制衰老基質的 SASP，使鄰近癌細胞失去先前獲得的旁分泌化學抗藥性；經 apigenin 處理的基質條件培養液可逆轉存活率的位移，體內將 apigenin 與 mitoxantrone 併用則額外降低 51.1% 腫瘤體積，並增強 DNA 損傷與 apoptosis。

links.context: Apigenin blocks the transition of the ASAP toward the SASP by disrupting ATM-HSPA8 and HSPA8-p38 MAPK crosstalk, preventing maturation of the secretome. As a flavonoid it also binds PRDX6 to inhibit its iPLA2 activity, further gatekeeping the transition between acute stress response and chronic secretion. This early intervention contrasts with agents that only suppress the established SASP, positioning apigenin as a candidate preventive senomorphic that acts at the ASAP stage. The mechanism highlights HSPA8 and PRDX6 as druggable nodes in senescence initiation.
links.context_zh_TW: Apigenin 透過破壞 ATM-HSPA8 與 HSPA8-p38 MAPK 交互作用阻斷 ASAP 朝向 SASP 的轉變，防止分泌組成熟。作為類黃酮它也結合 PRDX6 抑制其 iPLA2 活性，進一步守門急性壓力反應與慢性分泌間的轉變。此早期介入不同於僅抑制已建立 SASP 的藥劑，將 apigenin 定位為作用於 ASAP 階段的候選預防性 senomorphic。此機制凸顯 HSPA8 與 PRDX6 作為衰老起始中可藥物化的節點。

links.context: Apigenin modulates the MAPK cascade, inducing dose-dependent phosphorylation of ERK and p38 while having little effect on JNK phosphorylation in colon carcinoma and keratinocyte models. It also suppresses MEKK1-driven activation of ERK, JNK, and p38 in bladder smooth-muscle cells, thereby inhibiting cell migration and actin polymerization. In thyroid cancer cells apigenin disrupted EGFR tyrosine auto-phosphorylation and downstream MAPK signaling. Its net effect on the MAPK axis contributes to its chemopreventive activity by restraining proliferation, migration, and invasion across multiple cancer types.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧調節 MAPK 級聯反應，誘導 ERK 和 p38 的劑量相關磷酸化，同時對 JNK 磷酸化影響不大，在結直腸癌和角質形成細胞模型中均有效。它還抑制 MEKK1 驅動的 ERK、JNK 和 p38 活化，從而抑制細胞遷移和焦磷酸鹽聚合。在甲狀腺癌細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧擾亂了 EGFR 酪氨酸自磷酸化和下游 MAPK 訊號傳導。它對 MAPK 軸的淨效應有助於其抗癌前列腺活性，藉由抑制多種癌症類型中的增殖、遷移和侵襲。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: Apigenin prevents progression of the acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) into the chronic, pro-inflammatory SASP. The ASAP is the immediate cellular reaction to genotoxic or environmental insult, characterized by ATM phosphorylation and nucleus-to-cytoplasm translocation, TRAF6 auto-ubiquitination and TAK1 activation, occurring before senescence markers become evident. Under bleomycin stress, TAK1 phosphorylation and subsequent p38 MAPK activation and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement normally sustain the secretory phenotype. Apigenin leaves ATM and TAK1 phosphorylation largely intact but blocks downstream transduction through HSPA8, halting the ASAP-to-SASP switch. At a minimally optimal concentration of 10 µM, apigenin dose-dependently decreases a broad set of canonical SASP factors including IL-6, IL-8/CXCL8, IL-1α, IL-1β, MMP1/MMP3, GM-CSF, TIMP1 and WNT16B, both at transcript and protein level across senescent PSC27, WI38 and IMR90 cells regardless of senescence-inducing modality (replicative, oncogene-induced, or therapy-induced) or organ origin. GSEA shows suppression of SASP and NF-κB signatures; KEGG analysis reveals inhibition of TNF and NF-κB signaling, cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction, and type I interferon pathways. Crucially, SA-β-Gal positivity and mitotic arrest remain unchanged, confirming SASP-selective senomorphic action.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧可預防急性壓力相關表型 (ASAP) 轉化為慢性、促發炎的 SASP。 ASAP 是對基因毒性或環境刺激的即時細胞反應，其特徵是 ATM 磷酸化和核到細胞質的轉位、TRAF6 自體二聚化和 TAK1 活化，在衰老標誌物出現之前發生。 在 Bleomycin 壓力下， TAK1 磷酸化和隨後的 p38 MAPK 活化和 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與，通常維持分泌表型。 阿皮ゲ寧 讓 ATM 和 TAK1 磷酸化 largely intact，但卻阻斷通過 HSPA8 的下游轉導，從而阻止 ASAP 轉化為 SASP。 在最低有效濃度10 µM下，芹菜素以劑量依賴方式降低一系列典型的SASP因子，包括IL-6、IL-8/CXCL8、IL-1α、IL-1β、MMP1/MMP3、GM-CSF、TIMP1與WNT16B，在轉錄與蛋白質層面皆然，且涵蓋衰老的PSC27、WI38與IMR90細胞，不受衰老誘導方式（複製性、致癌基因誘導或治療誘導）或器官來源影響。GSEA顯示SASP與NF-κB特徵受到抑制；KEGG分析則顯示TNF與NF-κB訊息傳導、細胞激素-細胞激素受體交互作用及第一型干擾素途徑受到抑制。關鍵的是，SA-β-Gal陽性與有絲分裂停滯保持不變，證實其為SASP選擇性的衰老形態調節作用。

links.context: Apis mellifera, the Western or European honeybee, is a hymenopteran insect of major ecological and economic importance as a pollinator. Within this knowledge base it is included principally as the natural source of venom and its principal cytotoxic peptide melittin, both studied for anticancer activity, alongside honey, pollen, propolis and royal jelly as the basis of apitherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Apis mellifera（西方蜜蜂／歐洲蜜蜂）是膜翅目昆蟲，作為授粉者具有極大的生態與經濟重要性。在本知識庫中，收錄它的主要原因是它是蜂毒及其主要細胞毒性胜肽 melittin 的天然來源，兩者都被研究用於抗癌活性，並與蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠與蜂王漿共同構成 apitherapy（蜂療）的基礎。

links.context: Apitherapy is a branch of complementary and alternative medicine that uses products derived from honeybees — honey, pollen, propolis, royal jelly and bee venom (apitoxin) — for therapeutic purposes. In oncology it is studied chiefly for the antitumor properties of venom and its major peptide melittin.
links.context_zh_TW: Apitherapy 是 Complementary and alternative medicine 的一支，使用源自 Honeybee 的產品——蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠、蜂王漿與蜂毒（apitoxin）——作為治療用途。在腫瘤學上，其研究重點為蜂毒及其主要胜肽 melittin 的抗腫瘤性質。

links.context: Apolipoprotein B is the primary apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and LDL particles and serves as the ligand for the LDL receptor, making it essential for lipoprotein assembly and metabolism. LDL oxidation alters the apoB protein moiety through fragmentation and cross-linking of reactive aldehydes and oxysterols; resveratrol reduces this radical-induced alteration and chelates copper bound to apoB. Elevated apoB-containing lipoproteins drive plaque formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein B 是乳糜微粒與 LDL 顆粒的主要載脂蛋白，並作為 LDL receptor 的配體，因此對脂蛋白組裝與代謝至關重要。LDL 氧化會透過活性醛與氧化膽固醇的斷裂與交聯改變 apoB 蛋白部分；resveratrol 可減少此自由基誘發的變化並螯合結合於 apoB 的銅。含 apoB 的脂蛋白濃度升高會驅動斑塊形成。

links.context: Apolipoprotein B is the primary apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and LDL particles, and its B100 form serves as the ligand for the LDL receptor, making it essential for lipoprotein assembly and metabolism. LDL oxidation alters the apoB protein moiety through fragmentation and cross-linking of reactive aldehydes and oxysterols; resveratrol reduces this radical-induced alteration and chelates copper bound to apoB. Elevated apoB-containing lipoproteins drive plaque formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein B 是乳糜微粒與 LDL 顆粒的主要載脂蛋白，其 B100 形式作為 LDL receptor 的配體，因此對脂蛋白組裝與代謝至關重要。LDL 氧化會透過活性醛與氧化膽固醇的斷裂與交聯改變 apoB 蛋白部分；resveratrol 可減少此自由基誘發的變化並螯合結合於 apoB 的銅。含 apoB 的脂蛋白濃度升高會驅動斑塊形成。

links.context: Apolipoprotein E mediates cholesterol transport and clearance via LDL receptor family members, and the APOE gene has isoforms (ε2, ε3, ε4) with differential cardiovascular and neurodegenerative risk. ApoE-knockout mice spontaneously develop atherosclerosis and are a standard model; in these diabetic ApoE-KO mice, inhibiting DRP1 reduced endothelial dysfunction and lesion progression, showing excess mitochondrial fission contributes to atherogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein E 透過 LDL receptor 家族成員介導膽固醇的運輸與清除，APOE 基因具有 ε2、ε3、ε4 等型，其心血管與神經退行性風險各不相同。ApoE 剔除小鼠會自發性產生動脈粥狀硬化，是標準模型；在這些糖尿病 ApoE-KO 小鼠中，抑制 DRP1 可減少內皮功能障礙與病灶進展，顯示過度的粒線體分裂促成動脈粥狀硬化形成。

links.context: Apoptosis is the classic programmed arm of regulated cell death.
links.context_zh_TW: Apoptosis 是受調控細胞死亡的典型程序臂。

links.context: Apoptosis is the dominant homeostatic execution mode whose rate largely sets how fast a tissue turns over. Whole-body figures of roughly 150 x 10^9 apoptotic cells per day imply a full cellular churn of about 248 days (~8 months). Tissues then diverge over orders of magnitude, from gut epithelium renewing every 3-5 days to neurons lasting a lifetime.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞凋亡是主導性的恆定態執行模式，其速率在很大程度上決定組織的更新速度。全身每天約 150 x 10^9 個細胞凋亡，對應整體細胞更替週期約 248 天（約 8 個月）。之後各組織的更新速率相差數個數量級，從腸上皮每 3-5 天更新一次，到神經元可延續終身。

links.context: Apoptotic caspases-3 and -7 cleave active gasdermin D (GSDMD) at the non-canonical aspartate-88 site, inactivating its pore-forming N-terminal fragment and thereby suppressing pyroptosis. Because these apoptotic caspases activate more slowly than caspase-1, this acts as a delayed negative-feedback brake: the inflammasome initiates pyroptosis, and the slower apoptotic arm damps it to prevent excessive inflammation. The nature of the death ultimately produced depends on which gasdermin substrate is available — GSDMD (inhibited by caspase-3/-7) versus GSDME (activated by caspase-3).
links.context_zh_TW: 凋亡性的 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 會在非典型天門冬胺酸-88 位點切割活化的 gasdermin D（GSDMD），使其成孔的 N 端片段失活，從而抑制焦亡。由於這些凋亡 caspases 的活化比 Caspase-1 慢，這形成延遲的負回饋剎車：發炎體啟動焦亡，而較慢的凋亡臂則抑制過度發炎。最終產生的死亡型態取決於可用的 gasdermin 受質——GSDMD（被 Caspase-3/-7 抑制）或 GSDME（被 Caspase-3 活化）。

links.context: Aquaporins are a conserved family of integral membrane proteins forming selective channels for rapid passive water movement across biological membranes down osmotic gradients. Each monomer has six transmembrane helices around a narrow central pore and channels assemble as tetramers; NPA motifs and an ar/R constriction form the selectivity filter that permits single-file water transport while excluding protons and ions. Aquaglyceroporins (AQP3, AQP7, AQP9) also conduct glycerol.
links.context_zh_TW: Aquaporin 是一群保守的整合膜蛋白，形成選擇性通道，使水分沿滲透梯度快速被動通過生物膜。每個單體具有圍繞狹窄中央孔道的六段跨膜螺旋，通道以四聚體組裝；NPA 序列與 ar/R 收縮構成選擇性濾器，允許單列水分子通過並排除質子與離子。Aquaglyceroporin（AQP3、AQP7、AQP9）亦可運送 glycerol。

links.context: Arginine residues on long-lived structural proteins such as collagen are primary targets for non-enzymatic glycation: reducing sugars or reactive dicarbonyls attach to them via a Schiff base, ultimately forming complex, irreversible advanced glycation end products.
links.context_zh_TW: Collagen 等長壽命結構蛋白上的 Arginine 殘基是非酵素性 glycation 的主要標的：還原糖或反應性二羰基經由 Schiff base 與其結合，最終形成複雜且不可逆的 Advanced Glycation End Products。

links.context: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
links.context_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。

links.context: Aristoforin belongs to the compound class of sirtuin inhibitors, natural products that suppress sirtuin deacetylase activity to interrogate sirtuin dependence in cancer models. Its micromolar potency and limited selectivity make it a research tool in sirtuin inhibition studies and natural product drug discovery rather than a clinical candidate.
links.context_zh_TW: Aristoforin 屬於 sirtuin 抑制劑這一化合物類別，即在癌症模型中用於檢驗 sirtuin 依賴性的天然產物，可抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯化活性。由於其僅具微莫耳效力且選擇性有限，它較適合作為 sirtuin 抑制研究與天然產物藥物開發的研究工具，而非臨床候選藥物。

links.context: Arterial stiffening is fundamentally an age-related loss of arterial compliance, reflected by rising pulse-wave velocity, and is a major contributor to cardiovascular aging and cognitive decline.
