links.context_zh_TW: CXCR3（CD183）是 ELR− 干擾素誘導型趨化因子 CXCL9、CXCL10（IP-10）與 CXCL11（I-TAC）的 G 蛋白偶聯受體，其中 CXCL11 的結合親和力最高。這些配體由 I 型／II 型干擾素經 JAK/STAT1 以及 NF-κB 誘導；受體接合後活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ flux，驅動極化趨化與 inside-out 型整合素活化。CXCR3 在 Th1 與 CD8+ T 細胞及 NK 細胞上持續高表現。

links.context: CYCLIN B1 inhibits Apoptosis during mitosis through its kinase activity on Caspase-2, and in Cancer it is frequently overexpressed or dysregulated, sustaining CDK1 activity, chromosomal instability and resistance to death. High CYCLIN B1 correlates with advanced stage, high grade and poor prognosis in breast, lung and cervical carcinomas, and tumors can co-opt this anti-apoptotic phosphorylation to survive therapeutic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: CYCLIN B1 透過對 Caspase-2 的激酶活性在有絲分裂期間抑制 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）；在 Cancer（癌症）中它常被過度表現或失調，維持 CDK1 活性、染色體不穩定性與死亡抗性。CYCLIN B1 高表現與乳癌、肺癌與子宮頸癌的晚期、高分級及不良預後相關，腫瘤可藉此抗凋亡磷酸化存活於治療壓力之下。

links.context: CYCLIN B1 is the activating regulatory partner of CDK1, forming the maturation-promoting factor (MPF) that governs the G2/M transition. As the activating partner it enables CDK1 to phosphorylate the substrates that execute mitosis, while CYCLIN B1 abundance peaks at mitosis and is degraded by APC/C after metaphase to allow mitotic exit; its level serves as a proliferation and prognostic biomarker in cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: CYCLIN B1 是 CDK1 的活化型調節夥伴，兩者形成成熟促進因子（MPF）以掌控 G2/M 轉換。作為活化夥伴，它使 CDK1 能磷酸化執行有絲分裂的受質；而 CYCLIN B1 的含量在有絲分裂時達峰，於中期後由 APC/C 降解以允許退出有絲分裂，其濃度在癌症中可作為增殖與預後的生物標記。

links.context: CYP2C19 acts together with CYP2J2 to metabolize fenbendazole into hydroxyfenbendazole, so both enzymes determine the hepatic phase-I disposition of the benzimidazole. Hydroxyfenbendazole sits alongside the sulfoxide oxfendazole and fenbendazole sulfone as one of several phase-I metabolites of the parent compound.
links.context_zh_TW: CYP2C19 與 CYP2J2 共同作用，將 fenbendazole 代謝為 hydroxyfenbendazole，因此兩種酵素共同決定該 benzimidazole 的肝臟 phase-I 去向。Hydroxyfenbendazole 與硫醚化物 oxfendazole、fenbendazole sulfone 並列，為母藥的數種 phase-I 代謝物之一。

links.context: CYP2C19 is a hepatic monooxygenase of the Cytochrome P450 superfamily that metabolizes at least 10% of clinical medicines, including the benzimidazole anthelmintics Albendazole and Fenbendazole. Because these benzimidazoles are of interest for repurposed anticancer activity, CYP2C19 metabolizer status -- extensive, poor (*2, *3) or ultrarapid (*17) -- affects their intratumoral exposure and toxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: CYP2C19 是 Cytochrome P450（細胞色素 P450）超家族的肝臟單加氧酶，代謝至少 10% 的臨床用藥，包括苯並咪唑類驅蟲藥 Albendazole 與 Fenbendazole。由於這些苯並咪唑類藥物具有抗癌重新定位的興趣，CYP2C19 的代謝者型態（廣泛型、代謝不良型 *2／*3、超快速型 *17）會影響其腫瘤內暴露量與毒性。

links.context: CYP2C19 is a member of the Cytochrome P450 superfamily: a membrane-bound hemoprotein in the endoplasmic reticulum that uses NADPH and molecular oxygen to insert an oxygen atom into substrates via a high-valent iron-oxo species, favouring lipophilic, weakly basic drugs. It contributes both to detoxification and to the activation of prodrugs.
links.context_zh_TW: CYP2C19 是 Cytochrome P450（細胞色素 P450）超家族的成員：為位於內質網的膜結合血基質蛋白，利用 NADPH 與分子氧經由高價鐵—氧中間物將氧原子插入受質，偏好親脂性、弱鹼性藥物。它同時參與解毒與前驅藥的活化。

links.context: CYP2C19 metabolizes the benzimidazole anthelmintic Fenbendazole, in addition to proton-pump inhibitors, anti-epileptics and the antiplatelet prodrug clopidogrel. The prominent polymorphism of CYP2C19 makes it a flagship pharmacogenomic enzyme: poor metabolizers show elevated substrate levels and toxicity, ultrarapid metabolizers are under-treated, and CPIC recommends genotyping to guide dosing.
links.context_zh_TW: 除了質子幫浦抑制劑、抗癲癇藥與抗血小板前驅藥 clopidogrel 之外，CYP2C19 也代謝苯並咪唑類驅蟲藥 Fenbendazole。CYP2C19 顯著的基因多型性使它成為藥物基因組學的代表性酵素：代謝不良者對受質的暴露與毒性升高，超快速代謝者則劑量不足，CPIC 建議以基因分型來指導給藥。

links.context: CYP3A4 acts alongside FMO in the rapid hepatic conversion of fenbendazole to its active sulfoxide metabolite oxfendazole, with CYP2J2 and CYP2C19 additionally forming hydroxyfenbendazole. Because the FMO/CYP3A4 first-pass sulfoxidation is the gateway to oxfendazole, variation in these enzymes sets the exposure to the active metabolite.
links.context_zh_TW: CYP3A4 與 FMO 共同參與 fenbendazole 在肝臟中快速轉換為其活性硫氧化代謝物 oxfendazole，另有 CYP2J2 與 CYP2C19 形成 hydroxyfenbendazole。由於 FMO/CYP3A4 的首過硫氧化是形成 oxfendazole 的關口，這些酵素的變異決定了活性代謝物的暴露量。

links.context: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
links.context_zh_TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

links.context: CaMKII phosphorylates caspase-2 on Ser135 — distinct from the Ser164 site regulated by CaMKII in the metabolic context — rendering the apical caspase inactive. This phosphorylation is itself shielded by 14-3-3ζ binding, and the shield's integrity depends on the acetylation state of 14-3-3ζ, which SIRT1 controls. The system layers a phospho-switch (CaMKII/Ser135) on top of an acetyl-switch (SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49), so nutrient-driven PPP flux ultimately decides whether caspase-2 stays suppressed.
links.context_zh_TW: CaMKII 會將 caspase-2 的 Ser135 磷酸化——與其在代謝脈絡中調控的 Ser164 位點不同——使頂端 caspase 處於不活化狀態。此磷酸化本身又被 14-3-3ζ 的結合所保護，而保護罩的完整性取決於 SIRT1 所控制的 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化狀態。整個系統在乙醯開關（SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49）之上再疊加磷酸開關（CaMKII/Ser135），因此養分驅動的 PPP 通量最終決定 caspase-2 是否維持被抑制。
links.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

links.context: CaMKKβ is activated by the Ca2+ surge triggered by Epac1-mediated release from the Endoplasmic Reticulum. Epac1, a cAMP-activated GEF, therefore sits upstream of CaMKKβ and, in the Resveratrol cascade, links PDE4 inhibition to AMPK phosphorylation, NAMPT upregulation, NAD+ elevation and ultimately SIRT1 activation independently of adenine nucleotide ratios.
links.context_zh_TW: CaMKKβ 會被 Epac1 媒介的內質網釋放所引發的 Ca2+ 激增活化。因此，作為 cAMP 活化的 GEF，Epac1 位於 CaMKKβ 上游；在 Resveratrol 的級聯中，它把 PDE4 抑制與 AMPK 磷酸化、NAMPT 上調、NAD+ 上升並最終 SIRT1 活化連結起來，且獨立於腺嘌呤核苷酸比例。

links.context: Calcium overload during excitotoxic stress drives massive reactive oxygen species generation within mitochondria, collapsing membrane potential and ATP synthesis. The oxidative crisis amplifies the excitotoxic cascade, which is why oxidative stress and excitotoxicity reinforce each other in neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Excitotoxic 壓力下的鈣離子過載會在粒線體內大量產生 reactive oxygen species，使膜電位與 ATP 合成崩潰。此氧化危機會放大 excitotoxic 級聯反應，這也是 oxidative stress 與 excitotoxicity 在神經退化病程中互相強化的原因。

links.context: Calcium signaling — the spatiotemporal regulation of intracellular calcium — influences mitochondrial dynamics most importantly at the ER–mitochondria interface (MAMs), where calcium is transferred from the endoplasmic reticulum to mitochondria. Calcium flux at MAMs and calcium-dependent inner-membrane constriction modulate the constrictive machinery executing fission, with INF2 and actin mediating ER-initiated fission. By shifting the fusion/fission equilibrium, calcium signaling integrates ER stress, bioenergetic demand and organelle morphology, and dysregulated handling at MAMs is implicated in neurodegeneration and metabolic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 鈣訊號（細胞內鈣濃度的時空調控）對粒線體動態學的影響最集中於內質網—粒線體介面（MAMs），鈣離子在此由內質網轉移至粒線體。MAMs 處的鈣flux 與依賴鈣的內膜收縮會調節執行分裂的收縮機構，其中 INF2 與肌動蛋白介導由內質網發起的分裂。藉由改變融合／分裂平衡，鈣訊號整合了內質網壓力、能量需求與胞器形態，而 MAMs 處鈣處理失調與神經退化及代謝疾病有關。

links.context: Calcium/calmodulin binding co-activates CaMKII in response to calcium fluxes.
links.context_zh_TW: 鈣/鈣調蛋白結合響應鈣流共活化 CaMKII。

links.context: Calmodulin is the primary Ca2+ sensor in the cytosol, and Ca2+–calmodulin binding induces a conformational change that activates CaMKKβ, which then phosphorylates AMPK. This creates a feed-forward loop linking cytosolic Ca2+ to the AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 axis, connecting calcium signalling to insulin sensitivity and exercise adaptation.
links.context_zh_TW: Calmodulin 是細胞質中主要的 Ca2+ 感測器，Ca2+ 與 calmodulin 結合後誘導構形改變而活化 CaMKKβ，後者再磷酸化 AMPK。這形成一個前饋迴路，把細胞質 Ca2+ 與 AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 軸連結起來，將鈣離子訊號與胰島素敏感性及運動適應相連。

links.context: Caloric Restriction elevates NAD+ levels (or the NAD+/NADH ratio), which directly enhances the deacetylase activity of SIRT1 — one of the sirtuins it upregulates, alongside SIRT3, while downregulating SIRT4. Activated SIRT1 deacetylates histones to tighten chromatin into heterochromatin, silences pro-inflammatory and pro-senescence genes including p16INK4a, suppresses NF-κB, deacetylates PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative phosphorylation, and promotes fat mobilization via the PPAR-γ/NCoR/SMRT axis. Because CR-mediated lifespan extension requires SIR2 in yeast, sirtuins are central — though not exclusive — mediators, since TOR acts as a sirtuin-independent route.
links.context_zh_TW: Caloric Restriction 會提高 NAD+ 濃度（或 NAD+/NADH 比值），直接提升 SIRT1 的去乙醯化酶活性——SIRT1 是 CR 上調的 sirtuin 之一（同時也上調 SIRT3、下調 SIRT4）。活化的 SIRT1 對組蛋白去乙醯化，使染色質緊密形成異染色質，沉默包括 p16INK4a 在內的促發炎與促衰老基因，抑制 NF-κB，並對 PGC-1α 去乙醯化以驅動粒線體生物新生與氧化磷酸化，經 PPAR-γ/NCoR/SMRT 軸促進脂肪動員。由於 CR 介導的壽命延長在酵母中需要 SIR2，sirtuin 是（但非唯一）核心介導者，因為 TOR 提供 sirtuin 非依賴的途徑。

links.context: Caloric Restriction is a potent inducer of Autophagy: it lowers ATP and raises the AMP/ATP ratio, which activates AMPK, and AMPK in turn induces autophagy to compensate for energy limitation and maintain Cellular Homeostasis. Short or moderate restriction produces beneficial adaptive autophagy, whereas prolonged or extreme restriction can push into excessive autophagy and potentially Autophagic Cell Death — the same induction that makes CR a therapeutic target in cancer and a cardioprotective strategy in Ischemia-reperfusion Injury.
links.context_zh_TW: Caloric Restriction 是 Autophagy 的強效誘導者：它降低 ATP 並提高 AMP/ATP 比值，進而活化 AMPK，而 AMPK 又誘導自噬以補償能量限制並維持 Cellular Homeostasis。短期或中等程度的限制會產生有益的適應性自噬，而長期或極端的限制則可能造成過度自噬，甚至引發 Autophagic Cell Death——正是同一種自噬誘導使 CR 成為癌症治療與缺血再灌流傷害心臟保護的策略標的。

links.context: Caloric restriction increases SIRT5 levels alongside other sirtuins (except SIRT4). Directionally, CR is upstream of elevated SIRT5. SIRT5 desuccinylates/demalonylates metabolic enzymes, so its CR induction fits the broader CR-driven remodeling of mitochondrial acylation.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高 SIRT5 水平以及其他 sirtuin（除 SIRT4 外）。方向性上 CR 位於 SIRT5 升高的上游。SIRT5 去琥珀醯基化/去丙二醯基化代謝酵素，因此其 CR 誘導符合 CR 驅動的粒線體醯基化重塑的更廣泛範圍。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: Caloric restriction increases SIRT6 levels; SIRT6 is otherwise depleted in senescent fibroblasts and vascular cells. Directionally, CR raises SIRT6, supporting its genome-stability and metabolic functions. This aligns SIRT6 with the CR- and healthspan-protective sirtuin program.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高 SIRT6 水平；SIRT6 在衰老的纖維母細胞和血管細胞中反而被耗竭。方向性上 CR 提高 SIRT6，支持其基因組穩定性和代謝功能。這將 SIRT6 與 CR 和健康壽命保護性 sirtuin 程序對齊。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: Caloric restriction increases SIRT7 levels; SIRT7 otherwise declines in senescent fibroblasts. Directionally, CR is upstream of elevated SIRT7. Given SIRT7's nucleolar/ribosomal and stress roles, its CR induction extends sirtuin-mediated adaptation to the nucleolus.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高 SIRT7 水平；SIRT7 在衰老的纖維母細胞中反而下降。方向性上 CR 位於 SIRT7 升高的上游。鑑於 SIRT7 的核仁/核糖體和壓力功能，其 CR 誘導將 sirtuin 介導的適應延伸到核仁。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: Caloric restriction is a canonical mitohormetic stressor: a transient energy deficit activates AMPK, PGC-1alpha, SIRT1, and NRF2, driving mitochondrial biogenesis, mitophagy, and endogenous antioxidant defenses. Glucose restriction and CR are among the best-established triggers of the hormetic longevity response.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制是典型粒線體促效應壓力源：短暫的能量虧損活化 AMPK、PGC-1alpha、SIRT1 與 NRF2，驅動粒線體生成、mitophagy 與內生抗氧化防禦。葡萄糖限制與 CR 是最確立的促效應長壽反應觸發因子之一。

links.context: Calorie restriction (CR) is considered the most effective approach to extend lifespan in eukaryotes, and its life-prolonging effects may partly be mediated via increased sirtuin function, which requires NAD+ as a substrate. A study in mouse models documented that a one-day fast increases NAD+ in the liver, whereas CR elevates NAD+ and reduces nicotinamide in the brain, implying that increased levels of NAD+ mediate several beneficial effects of calorie restriction. As with CR, nicotinamide riboside (NR) can increase NAD+ levels and Sir2 function, and it extends lifespan in yeast without calorie restriction, supporting the life-prolonging effects of NR supplementation.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制（CR）被視為真核生物中延長壽命最有效的方法，其延壽效果可能部分經由增加的 sirtuin 功能所介導，而後者需要 NAD+ 作為受質。一項小鼠模型研究記載，一天的禁食提升肝臟中的 NAD+，而 CR 提升 NAD+ 同時降低腦中的 nicotinamide，暗示 NAD+ 水平增加介導了熱量限制的數種有益效果。如同 CR，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）能提升 NAD+ 水平與 Sir2 功能，並在酵母中無須熱量限制即延長壽命，支持了 NR 補充的延壽效果。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Calpain-2 (m-calpain; CAPN2 with CAPNS1) is a millimolar-Ca2+-dependent cytosolic cysteine protease that acts as the motility effector of the pro-survival Caspase-8 state. Src-family-phosphorylated Caspase-8 scaffolds FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K complexes at focal adhesions, where localized Calpain-2 cleaves talin, vinculin and FAK itself, accelerating adhesion disassembly/reassembly cycles that power mesenchymal migration. Adhesion turnover feeds PI3K/AKT and ERK signaling, creating a feed-forward migration–survival loop in colon cancer and glioblastoma; the same pY-Caspase-8 switch therefore makes Calpain-2 a downstream target of Src inhibition.
links.context_zh_TW: Calpain-2（m-calpain；CAPN2 搭配 CAPNS1）是毫莫耳 Ca2+ 依賴的胞質半胱胺酸蛋白酶，作為促存活型 Caspase-8 狀態的運動效應器。被 Src 家族磷酸化的 Caspase-8 在焦點黏附處支架化 FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K 複合體，局部化的 Calpain-2 切割 talin、vinculin 與 FAK 本身，加速黏附解體／重組循環以驅動間質細胞遷移。黏附周轉再回饋 PI3K/AKT 與 ERK 訊號，在大腸癌與膠質母細胞瘤中形成遷移—存活的正饋迴路；因此同一個 pY-Caspase-8 轉換使 Calpain-2 成為 Src 抑制的下游標的。

links.context: CamKIIα is abundantly expressed in hippocampal circuits where its autophosphorylation sustains LTP and memory consolidation. Hippocampal expression extends its forebrain cognitive role beyond prefrontal cortex.
links.context_zh_TW: CamKIIα 豐富表現於海馬迴路，其自磷酸化維持 LTP 與記憶鞏固。海馬表現將其前腦認知角色延伸至前額葉之外。

links.context: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
links.context_zh_TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

links.context: Canakinumab is a monoclonal anti-IL-1beta antibody; in CANTOS it reduced cardiovascular events in post-MI patients with elevated hs-CRP without lipid lowering, giving the first clinical proof that targeting inflammation prevents atherosclerotic complications.
links.context_zh_TW: Canakinumab 是抗 IL-1β 的單株抗體；在 CANTOS 試驗中，它在 hs-CRP 升高的心肌梗塞後患者中減少了心血管事件且未伴隨血脂下降，首次從臨床證明針對發炎的治療可預防動脈粥狀硬化併發症。

links.context: Cancer cells rely on aerobic glycolysis to support rapid proliferation and biomass production, the Warburg effect, with overexpression of Hexokinase 2, Phosphofructokinase, and Pyruvate Kinase M2 and upregulation of GLUT1 glucose transporters. Anticancer strategies therefore aim to inhibit glycolysis and starve tumor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 癌細胞依賴 aerobic glycolysis 支撐快速增殖與生物量生成，即 Warburg Effect，並伴隨 Hexokinase 2、Phosphofructokinase 與 Pyruvate Kinase M2 的過度表現以及 GLUT1 glucose transporter 上调。因此抗癌策略常以抑制 glycolysis、讓腫瘤細胞缺葡萄糖為目標。

links.context: Cancer chemoprevention aims to reduce cancer incidence by administering agents that prevent or reverse carcinogenesis, with dietary flavonoids such as apigenin as leading candidates. Apigenin exemplifies a multimodal chemopreventive flavone active across many human malignancies.
links.context_zh_TW: 癌症化學預防旨在透過給予可預防或逆轉致癌作用的藥物來降低癌症發生率，其中以 apigenin 等膳食黃酮類為主要候選。Apigenin 是橫跨多種人類惡性腫瘤的多模式化學預防黃酮典範。

links.context: Canonical inflammasome activation drives the SASP: caspase-1 or IL-1R inhibitors blunt SASP expression, placing inflammasome activation upstream of the secretome during oncogene-induced senescence. By generating mature IL-1beta and amplifying NF-kB signaling, the inflammasome sustains SASP factor production. The relationship establishes the inflammasome as an intrinsic SASP regulator, not merely a responder, and is supported by pharmacological inhibition studies. This positions the canonical pathway as an amplifier of inflammation downstream of senescent-cell stress signals.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體驅動 SASP，特別是透過產生並釋放成熟 IL-1beta，其隨後可放大下游 SASP 因子。此驅動將發炎體置於分泌組的 IL-1 臂上游，並與胞質 DNA 與 mtDNA 感受器協調。透過提供頂層發炎細胞激素，發炎體強化旁分泌衰老與免疫招募。其貢獻使發炎體成為 SASP 調節與 senomorphic 標靶的關鍵組成。

links.context: Cap-dependent Translation Initiation requires eIF4E, the cap-binding component of the eIF4F complex. eIF4E recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA, which is the first step of the pathway: 43S preinitiation complex recruitment followed by scanning to the AUG start codon. Because mTORC1 controls eIF4E availability through 4E-BP1 phosphorylation, Translation Initiation is a major point through which mTOR signaling modulates protein output.
links.context_zh_TW: 依賴帽的 Translation Initiation 需要 eIF4E，也就是 eIF4F 複合體中負責結合帽的成分。eIF4E 辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，這是該路徑的第一步：接著招募 43S 起始前複合體並掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。由於 mTORC1 透過 4E-BP1 的磷酸化調控 eIF4E 的可用性，Translation Initiation 是 mTOR 訊號調節蛋白質產量的主要切入點。

links.context: Carbazochrome is a stabilized derivative of adrenochrome used in some parts of the world as a hemostatic agent that promotes blood clotting and helps manage hemorrhaging. Whereas adrenochrome itself is too unstable for practical medical use, derivatives such as carbazochrome and its sulfonate and monosemicarbazone forms are much more stable and have been developed pharmaceutically as hemostatics. Carbazochrome's hemostatic action reflects the pharmacological repurposing of the adrenochrome scaffold, in contrast to the lack of any proven medical use for adrenochrome itself as a drug.
links.context_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 的穩定化衍生物，在世界某些地區用作 hemostatic agent，可促進血液凝固並協助控制出血。相對地，adrenochrome 本身過於不穩定而無法實際醫療使用，而 carbazochrome 及其 sulfonate 與 monosemicarbazone 形式等衍生物則穩定得多，已被開發為藥用 hemostatics。Carbazochrome 的止血作用反映了 adrenochrome scaffold 的藥理再利用，與 adrenochrome 本身作為藥物缺乏任何證實的醫療用途形成對比。

links.context: Carbazochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome synthesis ('is_an_intermediate_for', conf 0.9); it is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone, produced by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to render it relatively chemically inactive.
links.context_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 合成的中間體（「is_an_intermediate_for」，conf 0.9）；它是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（monosemicarbazone），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成，使其相對化學惰性。

links.context: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid is a highly water-soluble sulfonate derivative of carbazochrome. The sulfonation greatly improves aqueous solubility and is what makes carbazochrome clinically usable as an injectable haemostatic agent.
links.context_zh_TW: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid 是 Carbazochrome 的高水溶性磺酸衍生物。此磺化大幅提升水溶性，也正是使 Carbazochrome 能作為可注射止血藥物在臨床上使用的原因。

links.context: Cardiac Fibrosis is excessive extracellular matrix (collagen) deposition in the myocardium produced by cardiac fibroblast activation and differentiation into myofibroblasts. TGF-beta is the central profibrotic cytokine, driving myofibroblast differentiation via Smad signaling in response to chronic injury — pressure overload, ischemia, inflammation and Angiotensin II. Sustained fibrosis impairs myocardial compliance and electrical conduction, progressing toward heart failure and arrhythmia. Resveratrol-mediated activation of SIRT1 and SIRT3 attenuates it by inhibiting the TGF-beta/Smad3 pathway, whereas SIRT6 knockout induces it.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiac Fibrosis 是心肌中過量的細胞外基質（膠原蛋白）沉積，由心臟纖維母細胞活化並分化為肌成纖維細胞所造成。TGF-beta 是核心促纖維化細胞激素，藉由 Smad 訊號在壓力超載、缺血、發炎與 Angiotensin II 等慢性傷害訊號下驅動肌成纖維細胞分化。持續的纖維化會損害心肌順應性與電氣傳導，進展為心衰竭與心律不整。以 resveratrol 活化 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 可透過抑制 TGF-beta/Smad3 路徑減輕纖維化，而 SIRT6 剔除則會誘發纖維化。

links.context: Cardiac glycosides such as ouabain and digoxin inhibit Sodium Potassium ATPase, and this pharmacological inhibition is exploited therapeutically in heart failure — the same pump also acting as a signalling receptor, since ouabain is an endogenous steroid.
links.context_zh_TW: Ouabain 與 digoxin 等 cardiac glycoside 會抑制 Sodium Potassium ATPase，而這種藥理抑制被用於 heart failure 的治療；同一個幫浦也扮演訊號受體的角色，因為 ouabain 本身是內源性類固醇。

links.context: Cardiac-specific overexpression of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces infarct size after ischemia-reperfusion injury and improves survival, preserving contractile reserve, mitochondrial complex activity, and membrane potential. This cardioprotection is lost in middle-aged mice due to nitrative inactivation of Trx1.
links.context_zh_TW: 心臟特異性的 Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 過度表現可減少缺血再灌流損傷後的心肌梗塞面積並改善存活，維持收縮儲備、粒線體複合物活性與膜電位。此心臟保護作用在中年小鼠中會因 Trx1 的硝化失活而喪失。

links.context: Cardiolipin binds L-OPA1 on liposomes and is absolutely required for OPA1-mediated fusion: removing cardiolipin abolishes membrane merging even with L-OPA1 present on both leaflets, and GTP hydrolysis by OPA1 is likewise essential. Disease alleles in dominant optic atrophy show defects in cardiolipin-stimulated GTP hydrolysis and membrane tubulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 心磷脂（Cardiolipin）可在脂質體上結合 L-OPA1，且對 OPA1 介導的融合是絕對必要的：移除心磷脂後，即使兩個葉層都有 L-OPA1，膜融合仍會消失，OPA1 的 GTP 水解亦不可或缺。顯性視神經萎縮的致病等位基因則在心磷脂刺激的 GTP 水解與膜管形成方面有缺陷。

links.context: Cardiolipin is a dimeric phospholipid unique to the inner mitochondrial membrane that stabilizes membrane curvature and promotes fusion and fission remodeling events of the organelle.
links.context_zh_TW: 心磷脂是粒線體內膜特有的二聚磷脂，可穩定膜曲率，並促進此胞器的融合與分裂重塑事件。

links.context: Cardiolipin, the unique mitochondrial phospholipid, is essential for cristae assembly and stability, contributing to the curvature and mechanical integrity of the inner membrane folds on which oxidative phosphorylation depends.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 是粒線體特有的磷脂，對 cristae 的組裝與穩定至關重要，並促成內膜褶皺（Oxidative Phosphorylation 依賴其上）的曲率與機械完整性。

links.context: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity is damage or dysfunction of heart muscle cells that is the major dose-limiting adverse effect of Chemotherapy, particularly the anthracyclines Doxorubicin and Daunorubicin. Doxorubicin redox-cycles at Mitochondrial Complex I, generating superoxide and hydroxyl radical that damage cardiomyocyte DNA, proteins and lipids; cardiotoxic agents also impair Oxidative Phosphorylation, open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore and deplete ATP, while TOP2B poisoning triggers p53-dependent apoptosis, disrupted SERCA and ryanodine receptor calcium handling adds calcium overload, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation adds IL-1β-mediated damage. Dexrazoxane is the FDA-approved iron-chelating cardioprotectant.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity 指心臟肌肉細胞的損傷或功能障礙，是 Chemotherapy（尤其是 anthracyclines 類的 Doxorubicin 與 Daunorubicin）最主要的劑量限制性不良反應。Doxorubicin 在 Mitochondrial Complex I 進行氧化還原循環，產生 superoxide 與 hydroxyl radical 損傷心肌細胞的 DNA、蛋白質與脂質；具心毒性的藥物也會損害 Oxidative Phosphorylation、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔並耗竭 ATP，而 TOP2B 中毒引發 p53 依賴的凋亡，SERCA 與 ryanodine 受體的鈣處理失調加上鈣過載，NLRP3 發炎小體活化再加上 IL-1β 介導的損傷。Dexrazoxane 是 FDA 核准的鐵螯合型心臟保護劑。

links.context: Cardiomyocytes are striated, terminally differentiated heart muscle cells with densely packed mitochondria occupying ~25-35% of cell volume, making them among the most energetically demanding cells in the body and largely post-mitotic in adults. Sustained ATP from oxidative phosphorylation is essential and they are exquisitely sensitive to ischemia, so mitochondrial Dysfunction, oxidative and metabolic stress and Autophagy dysregulation drive Cardiomyopathy, Cardiac Hypertrophy and ultimately Heart Failure. Gap junctions and desmosomes in intercalated discs couple cells into a functional syncytium, and calcium flux through ryanodine receptors and the sarcoplasmic reticulum underlies excitation–contraction coupling.
links.context_zh_TW: 心肌細胞是具橫紋、終末分化的心臟肌肉細胞，粒線體密集排列佔細胞體積約 25–35%，使其成為體內能量需求最高的細胞之一，且在成人期大多為終末分裂後狀態。來自氧化磷酸化的大量 ATP 不可或缺，且對缺血極為敏感，因此粒線體功能障礙、氧化與代謝壓力以及自噬失調會驅動 Cardiomyopathy、Cardiac Hypertrophy，最終導向 Heart Failure。闰盤中的間隙連結與橋粒將細胞偶聯成功能性合胞體，而經由 ryanodine 受體與肌漿網的鈣離子 flux 則構成興奮—收縮偶聯的基礎。

links.context: Cardiomyocytes are the contractile Muscle cells of the Heart, expressing sarcomeric myosin II and generating the force that propels circulation under autonomic and hormonal control.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiomyocytes（心肌細胞）是 Heart（心臟）中具收縮功能的 Muscle（肌肉）細胞，表現肌節型 myosin II，在自主神經與荷爾蒙調控下產生推動循環的力量。

links.context: Cardiomyocytes express sarcomeric myosin II, which forms the contractile filaments of the sarcomere and generates the force underlying cardiomyocyte contraction in Heart and Muscle tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiomyocytes（心肌細胞）表現肌節型 myosin II，其構成肌節的收縮絲，產生 Heart（心臟）與 Muscle（肌肉）組織中驅動心肌細胞收縮的力量。

links.context: Cardiomyocytes have extraordinarily high energy demands, consuming on the order of 30 kg of ATP daily. Because the heart has very limited glycolytic capacity and minimal glycogen stores, it depends critically on oxidative phosphorylation and is therefore exquisitely vulnerable to ischaemia.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiomyocytes 的能量需求極高，每日消耗約 30 公斤的 ATP。由於心臟糖解能力非常有限且肝醣儲備極少，它嚴重依賴氧化磷酸化，因此對 Ischemia 極為脆弱。

links.context: Cardiomyopathy is a heterogeneous group of disorders in which the myocardium becomes structurally and functionally abnormal without coronary artery disease, hypertension or valvular disease sufficient to explain it, caused by inherited sarcomere mutations, metabolic and mitochondrial defects, toxins, infection or neurohormonal overstimulation. Common pathways include Cardiomyocyte injury, contractile dysfunction and Cardiac Fibrosis driven by Oxidative Stress and inflammation; persistent adrenergic drive and reactive oxygen species drive remodeling and progression toward Heart Failure. Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy is a distinct stress-related form in which excess catecholamine causes myocyte calcium overload, contraction-band necrosis and transient ventricular dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiomyopathy 是一類異質性疾患，心肌在沒有足以解釋其變化的冠狀動脈疾病、高血壓或瓣膜病的情況下發生結構與功能異常，成因包括遺傳性肌小節蛋白突變、代謝與粒線體缺陷、毒素、感染或神經荷爾蒙過度刺激。常見途徑包含心肌細胞損傷、收縮功能障礙，以及由 Oxidative Stress 與發炎驅動的 Cardiac Fibrosis；持續的腎上腺素能張力與活性氧驅動重塑並朝 Heart Failure 進展。Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 则是壓力相關的獨特型態，過量兒茶酚胺造成肌細胞鈣過載、收縮帶壞死與暫時性心室功能障礙。

links.context: Carotenoids form the non-tocopherol radical-trapping tier in membranes, sitting beside tocopherols as the second line of bilayer defense. Their conjugated polyene chains delocalize the unpaired electron of an intercepted peroxyl radical and terminate it, and they also quench singlet oxygen, so they block the propagation step of Lipid Peroxidation from two directions. In the radical-trapping hierarchy relevant to ferroptosis, however, tocotrienols are the more potent traps, and carotenoids contribute mainly non-radical quenching plus conversion to retinol and retinal, which are themselves direct lipid-radical traps.
links.context_zh_TW: Carotenoids 構成膜中非 tocopherol 的自由基捕捉層級，與 tocopherols 並列為雙層膜防禦的第二道防線。其共軛多烯鏈可將所截獲過氧自由基的未成對電子去定域化並終止之，同時也能 quench Singlet Oxygen，因此從兩個方向阻斷 Lipid Peroxidation 的傳播步驟。不過在與 ferroptosis 相關的自由基捕捉層級中，tocotrienols 才是較強的捕捉者；類胡蘿蔔素主要貢獻非自由基的 quenching，以及轉換為同樣是直接脂質自由基捕捉者的 retinol 與 retinal。

links.context: Casein kinase 1G2 binds RIPK3 to inhibit its kinase activity and necroptosis signaling in male reproductive aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶1G2結合RIPK3以抑制其激酶活性與下游necroptosis訊號，見於雄性生殖老化。

links.context: Casein kinase 2 (CK2) normally restrains NF-κB activation. CK2 phosphorylates the NF-κB inhibitor IκBα (e.g. Ser283), protecting it from stimulus-induced degradation, and also primes IKK and supports NEMO function, so that total CK2 activity sets the threshold for inflammatory transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶 2 (CK2) 平常會抑制 NF-κB 的活化。CK2 會磷酸化 NF-κB 抑制蛋白 IκBα（例如 Ser283），保護它不被刺激誘導的降解；同時也活化 IKK 並支持 NEMO 功能，因此 CK2 的總活性決定了發炎轉錄的起始門檻。

links.context: Caspase activation, hallmark of the intrinsic apoptosis pathway, is antagonistic to SIRT4's mitochondrial anti-apoptotic function; during apoptosis caspases cleave/deregulate mitochondrial effectors, placing caspases among negative regulators of the SIRT4 pathway (Table 3).
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase 活化是內在凋亡通路的標誌，與 SIRT4 的粒線體抗凋亡功能相對抗；在凋亡期間，caspases 切割/失調粒線體效應因子，使 caspases 列為 SIRT4 通路的負向調節因子（表 3）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Caspase-1 FLICA is the standard live-cell readout used to detect the execution of pyroptosis. Because inflammasome activation and Caspase-1 cleavage occur upstream of Gasdermin D pore formation, FLICA signal is the earliest enzymatic marker that a cell has committed to pyroptotic death, and it is read alongside Gasdermin D-N staining and cytokine release.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-1 FLICA 是用來偵測 pyroptosis 執行的標準活細胞讀值方法。由於發炎小體活化與 Caspase-1 切割發生在 Gasdermin D 成孔之前，FLICA 訊號是細胞已啟動 pyroptotic 死亡最早期的酵素標記，通常與 Gasdermin D-N 染色及細胞激素釋放一起判讀。

links.context: Caspase-1 cleaves p31 pro-IL-1beta to the mature p17 cytokine. Production is the cytokine-maturation output.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-1 將 p31 pro-IL-1β 切割為成熟 p17 細胞激素。產生是細胞激素成熟輸出。

links.context: Caspase-1 is a core SASP amplifier: NLRP3 → Caspase-1 → IL-1beta → NF-kappaB → IL-6/IL-8 signaling increases with age and drives inflammaging and immunosenescence (Youm et al. 2013, PMID 23562091) — the graph currently connects it only transitively via Inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-1 是核心 SASP 放大器：NLRP3 → Caspase-1 → IL-1beta → NF-kappaB → IL-6/IL-8 訊號隨年齡增加並驅動發炎性老化與免疫衰老（Youm et al. 2013, PMID 23562091）——圖目前僅透過 Inflammaging 間接連到它。

links.context: Caspase-1/4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D; the N-terminal fragment oligomerizes to form pores in the plasma membrane, causing pyroptosis, an inflammatory lytic cell death. While senescent cells generally resist death, inflammasome-driven pyroptosis can occur in neighboring cells or under certain stimuli, releasing IL-1alpha, HMGB1, and mtDNA into the extracellular space. The relationship connects senescence-associated DAMPs to a distinct cell-death modality and broadens the cell-fate consequences of inflammasome activation. Pyroptotic debris further amplifies the local inflammatory response, creating a feed-forward loop.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體活化觸發 pyroptosis，一種促發炎的炎性細胞死亡，其裂解 gasdermin D 形成膜孔洞並釋放細胞內含物。在衰老中，發炎體驅動的 pyroptosis 可在次致死設定下發生，釋放 DAMPs 與 IL-1 家族細胞激素而不完全殺死細胞，放大 SASP。此過程將細胞死亡形態與分泌表型耦合，並可影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。其角色在衰老中仍被積極研究，信度中等。

links.context: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

links.context: Caspase-3 cleaves actin networks during Apoptosis, dismantling the cytoskeleton and contributing to the characteristic morphological collapse of the dying cell. Actin fragmentation by caspase-3 is a late but central execution step of apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在 Apoptosis 過程中切割 actin 網絡，拆解細胞骨架並促成死亡細胞特有的形態崩解。actin 遭 caspase-3 碎裂是凋亡後期但關鍵的執行步驟。

links.context: Caspase-3 is a molecular target of Q-VD-OPh, the broad-spectrum irreversible pan-caspase inhibitor. Compared with the earlier-generation Z-VAD-FMK, Q-VD-OPh offers lower toxicity while retaining in vivo efficacy, making it the preferred tool for establishing whether a phenotype depends on caspase-3/-8 activation.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 是廣效不可逆泛 caspase 抑制劑 Q-VD-OPh 的分子標的。與較早期世代的 Z-VAD-FMK 相比，Q-VD-OPh 在保有體內效力的同時毒性更低，因此是判定某一表型是否依賴 Caspase-3/-8 活化的首選工具。

links.context: Caspase-4 cleaves the alarmin IL-1α, which can transit from the cell surface to the nucleus in a copper/calcium-dependent manner and license NF-κB-dependent SASP transcription. Caspase-4, with caspase-5 and the mouse ortholog caspase-11, is therefore essential for certain IL-1α activation events within the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-4 切割警示素 IL-1α，後者能以銅／鈣依賴方式自細胞表面轉位至細胞核，啟動 NF-κB 依賴性的 SASP 轉錄。因此 Caspase-4 與 caspase-5 及小鼠同源物 caspase-11 一起，是 SASP 中某些 IL-1α 活化事件所必需的。

links.context: Caspase-4 is the human functional ortholog of mouse Caspase-11 and a paralog of human Caspase-5, the two human inflammatory caspases sharing overlapping non-canonical inflammasome duties. The duplication is why the same LPS-sensing axis is discussed under both names in human and mouse literature.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-4 是小鼠 Caspase-11 的人類功能同源物，也是人類 Caspase-5 的旁系同源物；這兩個人類發炎性 caspase 共享功能重疊的非典型發炎小體任務。正是這項複製，使同一條 LPS 感測軸在人類與小鼠文獻中以兩個名稱並行討論。

links.context: Caspase-5 (human) is the inducible noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D to drive SASP and pyroptosis. Its activation is essential for the noncanonical inflammasome's role in senescence, and its expression is induced by interferons and controlled upstream by the cGAS-STING pathway. The relationship positions caspase-5 as the enzymatic executor of the pathway in human cells. It is supported by cleavage-site and loss-of-function studies showing reduced SASP after CASP5 knockdown.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-5（人類）是可誘發的非典型效應 caspase，切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptosis。其活化對非典型發炎體在衰老中的角色必要，且其表現被干擾素誘發並受上游 cGAS-STING 控制。透過產生活性 IL-1alpha，caspase-5 許可 SASP 本身而非僅回應它，將非典型發炎體置於分泌組上游。此切割是連結先天免疫到衰老溝通的關鍵步驟。

links.context: Caspase-5 is paralogous to human Caspase-4 and orthologous to mouse Caspase-11, the trio constituting the human/mouse inflammatory caspase axis. Functional redundancy between Caspase-4 and Caspase-5 explains why blocking one alone incompletely suppresses non-canonical inflammasome output.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-5 與人類 Caspase-4 為旁系同源、與小鼠 Caspase-11 為直系同源，三者構成人類／小鼠的發炎性 caspase 軸。Caspase-4 與 Caspase-5 之間的功能冗餘，解釋了為何單獨阻斷其一無法完全抑制非典型發炎小體的輸出。

links.context: Caspase-5 is the archetypal effector of the non-canonical inflammasome: its gasdermin D cleavage generates plasma-membrane pores that drive pyroptosis and the release of inflammatory mediators, and the accompanying K+ efflux licenses Caspase-1 to mature IL-1β/IL-18. It is a candidate target in inflammatory and autoinflammatory disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-5 是非典型發炎小體的典型效應蛋白：其對 gasdermin D 的切割產生細胞膜孔洞，推動 pyroptosis 與發炎介質釋放，並伴隨的 K+ 外流啟動 Caspase-1 以成熟 IL-1β／IL-18。它是發炎與自體發炎疾病的候選標的。

links.context: Caspase-5/11 within the noncanonical inflammasome cleaves pro-IL-1α at a conserved site distinct from calpain, licensing SASP establishment. This pathway-level step complements the existing enzyme-level caspase-5 cleavage triple.
links.context_zh_TW: 非典型發炎體內的 caspase-5/11 在與 calpain 不同的保守位點切割 pro-IL-1α，許可 SASP 建立。此路徑層級步驟補充既有的酶層級 caspase-5 切割 triple。

links.context: Caspase-6 promotes the ZBP1-RIPK3 inflammatory response through interaction with RIPK3 in viral infection.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-6透過與RIPK3交互作用，促進ZBP1-RIPK3觸發的發炎反應，見於病毒感染性疾病。

links.context: Caspase-8 cleaves PARP1 at Asp214/Gly215 between the DNA-binding and catalytic domains, which inactivates PARP1 hyperactivation and thereby antagonises parthanatos. This creates the core mutual antagonism of the two programmes, and it is also mechanistically relevant to necroptosis, where active Caspase-8 normally cleaves RIPK1/RIPK3 to suppress the necrosome.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-8 會在 DNA 結合區與催化區之間的 Asp214／Gly215 位置切割 PARP1，使 PARP1 的過度活化失效，進而拮抗 parthanatos。這構成兩套程式之間核心的相互拮抗，在 necroptosis 中也具有機制相關性，因為活化的 Caspase-8 會正常地切割 RIPK1／RIPK3 以抑制 necrosome。

links.context: Caspase-8 directly cleaves executioner caspase-7 in type I cells. Activation parallels the caspase-3 edge.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-8 在 I 型細胞直接切割執行 caspase-7。活化與 caspase-3 邊平行。

links.context: Caspase-8 homodimers or caspase-8/FLIP_L heterodimers cut FLIP_L in trans at Asp376 during interdimer processing at the DISC. In quantitative models (Neumann et al.), the rate of p43-FLIP generation is the critical parameter of the life/death decision: fast p43 accumulation marks heterodimer-dominated, survival-favoring DISCs.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 DISC 的分子間加工過程中，caspase-8 同源二聚體或 caspase-8/FLIP_L 異源二聚體會以反式方式切割 FLIP_L 的 Asp376。在量化模型中（Neumann 等），p43-FLIP 的生成速率是生死決定的關鍵參數：p43 快速累積標誌著以異源二聚體為主、有利存活的 DISC。

links.context: Caspases are a conserved family of cysteine-aspartate proteases that function as central regulators of apoptosis and inflammation. Initiator caspases sense death signals while executioner caspases dismantle the cell, placing caspases at the heart of the apoptotic program.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase 是保守的半胱氨酸-天門冬氨酸蛋白酶家族，是細胞凋亡與發炎的核心調控者。起始型 caspase 感知死亡訊號，執行型 caspase 則分解細胞，使 caspase 位居細胞凋亡程式的核心。

links.context: Catalase is an antioxidant enzyme that decomposes hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen. Along with superoxide dismutase, it inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in neutrophil homogenates, demonstrating the reactive oxygen species dependence of the reaction. By removing hydrogen peroxide, catalase eliminates an oxidant that drives catechol oxidation and prevents the accumulation of hydroxyl radicals derived from it. Because hydrogen peroxide is generated both by mitochondrial respiration and during MAO-mediated deamination, catalase activity helps keep the adrenochrome pathway a minor route of adrenaline metabolism under normal oxidative conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase 是一種將過氧化氫分解為水與氧的抗氧化酶。它與 superoxide dismutase 一起，在中性球勻漿中抑制 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，證明此反應對活性氧物種的依賴。透過移除過氧化氫，catalase 消除驅動兒茶酚氧化的氧化劑，並防止其衍生的羥基自由基累積。由於過氧化氫既由粒線體呼吸產生，也在 MAO 介導的脫胺期間生成，catalase 活性有助於在正常氧化條件下使 adrenochrome 途徑維持為 adrenaline 代謝的次要路線。

links.context: Catalase is one of the primary enzymes that decomposes Hydrogen Peroxide into water and oxygen, terminating the peroxide signal. Glutathione Peroxidase performs the same detoxification using Glutathione as the electron donor, so the two enzymes together set the steady-state H2O2 concentration that governs redox signaling versus damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase 是將 Hydrogen Peroxide 分解為水與氧的主要酵素之一，可終止過氧化物訊號。Glutathione Peroxidase 則以 Glutathione 作為電子供體執行相同的解毒作用；兩者共同決定穩態的 H2O2 濃度，進而決定細胞偏向氧化還原訊號或損傷。

links.context: Catechol is the standard in vitro substrate for COMT activity assays. In mammalian biochemistry the catechol moiety is also handled by COMT and MAO, which metabolize catecholamines by methylating or oxidizing the catechol ring.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechol 是 COMT 活性體外測定的標準受質。在哺乳類生化中，catechol 結構亦由 COMT 與 MAO 處理，兩者分別藉由甲基化或氧化 catechol 環來代謝兒茶酚胺。

links.context: Catecholamines are primarily degraded by the enzymatic pathways COMT and MAO. Without COMT-mediated O-methylation, catecholamines accumulate and generate free radicals that damage DNA, so COMT protects cells including neurons from oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Catecholamines 主要透過 COMT 與 MAO 的酵素途徑分解。若缺乏 COMT 介導的 O-甲基化，兒茶酚胺會累積並產生可損傷 DNA 的自由基，因此 COMT 可保護包括神經元在內的細胞免受 oxidative stress 傷害。

links.context: Cathepsin B is a cysteine protease localized to the lysosome, where it contributes to intracellular proteolysis and cellular protein turnover as one of the principal proteases of the lysosomal degradative machinery.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsin B 是定位於 Lysosome 的半胱胺酸蛋白酶，作為溶小體降解機制的主要蛋白酶之一，參與細胞內蛋白水解與蛋白質周轉。

links.context: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

links.context: Celastrol activates TFEB via inhibiting mTORC1, reducing insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates and improving memory deficiency in Alzheimer's disease models.
links.context_zh_TW: Celastrol 透過抑制 mTORC1 活化 TFEB，減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體，並改善阿茲海默症模型中的記憶缺陷。

links.context: Celastrol is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is a potent Hsp90 inhibitor and induces Autophagy, while enhancing TFEB-mediated autophagy and mitigating Tau pathology, showing potential for Alzheimer's disease therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Celastrol 是五環三萜類化合物，是強效的 Hsp90 抑制劑並誘導 Autophagy，同時增強 TFEB 媒介的自噬並減緩 Tau 病理，對阿茲海默病治療具有潛力。

links.context: Cell Division checkpoints verify DNA Replication and Chromosome alignment before anaphase, with control through Cyclin/CDK, Rb/E2F and p53. When this surveillance fails, mis-segregation produces aneuploidy such as Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) via meiotic nondisjunction.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Division 的檢查點在後期之前驗證 DNA Replication 與 Chromosome 對位，並透過 Cyclin/CDK、Rb/E2F 與 p53 加以控制。當此監控失效時，分離錯誤會透過減數分裂不分離產生非整倍體，例如 Trisomy 21（Down Syndrome）。

links.context: Cell Membranes are phospholipid bilayers whose integrity depends on their lipid components. Membrane damage from Lipid Peroxidation is a key feature of Oxidative Stress, making the bilayer a principal target and readout of oxidative injury.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Membranes（細胞膜）為磷脂雙層，其完整性仰賴脂質成分。來自 Lipid Peroxidation（脂質過氧化）的膜損傷是 Oxidative Stress 的重要特徵，使雙層膜成為氧化傷害的主要標的與判讀指標。

links.context: Cell Migration proceeds by leading-edge actin polymerization, integrin adhesion coordinated by FAK signaling, myosin contraction, and trailing-edge release, steered by gradients of hepatocyte growth factor, FGF, and chemokines. It underlies development, wound healing, immune recruitment, and — when hijacked — cancer invasion.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Migration（細胞遷移）藉由前緣的 actin 聚合、由 FAK signaling 協調的 integrin 黏附、myosin 收縮以及後緣釋放而進行，並受 hepatocyte growth factor、FGF 與趨化因子梯度引導。它是發育、傷口癒合、免疫細胞募集的基礎——遭腫瘤劫持時則促成 cancer 侵襲。

links.context: Cell Proliferation — cells growing and dividing to produce daughter cells — is tightly regulated by growth factor signaling, Cell Cycle checkpoints, and cell division machinery, with key regulators including cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb, E2F, MYC, RAS, and PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 signaling. mTORC1 acts as a nutrient-sensitive master regulator of cell growth, promoting anabolism and limiting autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Proliferation（細胞增殖，細胞生長並分裂產生子細胞）受到 growth factor 訊號、Cell Cycle 檢查點與細胞分裂機器的嚴格調控，主要調控者包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb、E2F、MYC、RAS 與 PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 訊號。mTORC1 作為營養素敏感的細胞生長主調控者，促進合成代謝並限制 autophagy。

links.context: Cell Stress covers adverse states such as Oxidative Stress, DNA damage, and DNA replication stress. Such stress may resolve, allow adaptation, or lock into Senescence; its dysregulation contributes to aging, metabolic disease, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Stress（細胞壓力）涵蓋 Oxidative Stress、DNA 損傷與 DNA 複製壓力等不利狀態。此類壓力可能緩解、允許適應，或鎖定為 Senescence（衰老）；其失調則與老化、代謝疾病、神經退化與癌症有關。

links.context: Cell fate after DNA damage is set by p53 dynamics rather than by damage load alone. Pulsed p53 signalling selectively activates arrest and repair genes such as CDKN1A and permits recovery, whereas sustained p53 drives terminal programs including apoptosis; CDKN1A induction occurs at lower p53 thresholds than BAX. This temporal refinement explains why the same insult can yield arrest, senescence, or death.
links.context_zh_TW: DNA 損傷後細胞的命運由 p53 的動態而非損傷負載本身決定。脈衝式 p53 訊號選擇性活化 CDKN1A 等阻滯與修復基因並允許細胞恢復，而持續性 p53 則啟動包括凋亡在內的終末程序；CDKN1A 的誘導閾值低於 BAX。這項時間動態上的修正，說明為何同一種傷害可以分別導致細胞停滯、衰老或死亡。

links.context: Cells from Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome patients show a massive loss of repressive heterochromatin, particularly the H3K9me3 mark, leading to aberrant gene expression. The disorganized nucleus also produces significant DNA Damage and genomic structural abnormalities, and progerin-containing cells enter Senescence prematurely with SASP secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: 來自 Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 患者的細胞會大量流失抑制性異染色質，尤其是 H3K9me3 標記，造成異常基因表現。構造混亂的細胞核也會造成顯著 DNA Damage 與基因體結構異常，而含 progerin 的細胞會過早進入 Senescence 並分泌 SASP。

links.context: Cells lacking SIRT3 show increased ROS that can activate HIF-1alpha, linking mitochondrial sirtuin deficiency to a pseudo-hypoxic, Warburg-like metabolic state. SIRT3 thus restrains HIF-1alpha activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 缺乏 SIRT3 的細胞表現增加的 ROS，可活化 HIF-1α，將粒線體 sirtuin 缺乏與類低氧的 Warburg 樣代謝狀態相連結。因此 SIRT3 約束 HIF-1α 的活化。

links.context: Centromeres are epigenetically specified by CENP-A chromatin rather than by DNA sequence in most eukaryotes. The centromere is the specialized chromosome region where the kinetochore assembles and spindle microtubules attach during mitosis and meiosis, flanked by pericentric heterochromatin enriched in H3K9me3; its dysfunction causes aneuploidy and cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: 在多數真核生物中，centromere 是由 CENP-A 染色質而非 DNA 序列表觀指定的。它是染色體上 kinetochore 組裝且紡錘絲微管在有絲分裂與減數分裂時附著的特化區域，兩側為富含 H3K9me3 的著絲粒周邊異染色質；其功能障礙會導致 aneuploidy 與 cancer。

links.context: Ceramide accumulation is a conserved stress signal that promotes apoptosis, mitochondrial dysfunction, and inflammation. It is the central hub of sphingolipid metabolism, sitting at the branch point between synthesis and breakdown, and ceramide/sphingosine rheostat shifts are implicated in senescent-cell survival and in melanoma and prostate cancer biology.
links.context_zh_TW: Ceramide（神經醯胺）的累積是促進 apoptosis、粒線體功能障礙與發炎的保守壓力訊號。它是 sphingolipid 代謝的中樞，位於合成與分解的分支點；ceramide／sphingosine 失衡亦與衰老細胞存活以及 melanoma、prostate cancer 生物学相關。

links.context: Ceramide and Sphingosine-1-phosphate occupy opposite ends of a rheostat: high ceramide is growth-inhibitory and pro-death, whereas high Sphingosine-1-phosphate is pro-survival and anti-apoptotic. This opposition is the core organizing principle of sphingolipid signaling in the note, and the ratio between the two sets the cell's survival set-point.
links.context_zh_TW: Ceramide 與 Sphingosine-1-phosphate 位於恆定器的相反兩端：ceramide 濃度高時具生長抑制與促死亡作用，而 Sphingosine-1-phosphate 濃度高時則促存活與抗凋亡。此對抗作用是筆記中 sphingolipid 訊息傳遞的核心組織原則，兩者的比值決定細胞的存活設定點。

links.context: Cerebrovascular endothelial cells are the principal cellular constituent of the blood-brain barrier, joined by tight junctions and working with astrocytes and pericytes to restrict paracellular permeability, forming the neurovascular unit.
links.context_zh_TW: 腦血管內皮細胞是血腦屏障的主要細胞構成，藉由緊密連結相連，並與星狀膠細胞及周細胞共同限制旁細胞通透性，構成神經血管單元。

links.context: Cerebrovascular endothelial cells express cGAS and STING and are active participants in inflammation, hemostasis and immune surveillance. In endothelial cells, cGAS-STING is activated by damaged mtDNA and other cytosolic DNA triggers, inducing type I interferon signalling and pyroptotic cell death.
links.context_zh_TW: 腦血管內皮細胞表現 cGAS 與 STING，是發炎、止血與免疫監視的積極參與者。在內皮細胞中，cGAS-STING 由受損的 mtDNA 及其他細胞質 DNA 觸發物活化，誘發第一型干擾素訊號與細胞焦亡。

links.context: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy is the selective, lysosome-dependent route by which individual cytosolic proteins are degraded: the substrate-chaperone complex is delivered to the lysosomal membrane and translocated into the lysosome lumen, where lysosomal proteases destroy the cargo. Its decline during Aging correlates with toxic protein aggregate accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 是選擇性、依賴 lysosome 的途徑，藉由它分解個別細胞質蛋白質：受質—chaperone 複合體被運送至 lysosome 膜並轉位進入 lysosome 腔內，由 lysosome 蛋白酶分解負載物。其活性隨 Aging 下降，並與毒性蛋白聚集物的累積相關。

links.context: Checkpoint inhibitors block the PD-L1 ligand, restoring T-cell function.
links.context_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑阻斷 PD-L1 配體，恢復 T 細胞功能。

links.context: Chemokines — small 8–14 kDa secreted cytokines that direct immune cell chemotaxis — are core components of the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype. Members such as IL-8 (CXCL8), CCL2, CXCL1, and CXCL10 contribute to immune surveillance of senescent cells and, when chronically secreted, to inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemokines（趨化因子）——引導免疫細胞趨化的小型（8–14 kDa）分泌型細胞激素——是 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的核心成分。IL-8（CXCL8）、CCL2、CXCL1 與 CXCL10 等成員有助於衰老細胞的免疫監控；當持續分泌時則促成 inflammaging。

links.context: Chemoresistance — the ability of cancer cells to survive and proliferate despite cytotoxic chemotherapy — is substantially driven paracrinely by SASP factors secreted by therapy-damaged stromal cells. Senescent stroma induced by bleomycin or mitoxantrone releases WNT16B, amphiregulin, and EREG, shifting adjacent cancer cell dose–response curves to higher viability in the tumor microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemoresistance（腫瘤細胞在細胞毒化學治療下仍能存活與增殖的能力）主要受到治療損傷的基質細胞所分泌 SASP 因子的旁分泌驅動。由 bleomycin 或 mitoxantrone 誘發的衰老基質會釋放 WNT16B、amphiregulin 與 EREG，使鄰近癌細胞在腫瘤微環境中的劑量－反應曲線移向更高存活率。

links.context: Chemotherapy alone, independent of tumor burden, disrupts tissue NAD+ metabolism. Common regimens (cisplatin, FOLFIRI, FOLFOX) induce skeletal muscle NAD+ loss and downregulate the NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme NRK2, recapitulating the metabolic alterations previously seen in cancer cachexia; hepatic NAD+ falls 15–20% with prolonged treatment.
links.context_zh_TW: 單以 Chemotherapy 本身（與腫瘤負荷無關）即會破壞組織 NAD+ 代謝。常用方案（cisplatin、FOLFIRI、FOLFOX）會造成骨骼肌 NAD+ 流失並下调 NAD+ 生合成酵素 NRK2，重現先前在 cancer cachexia 中觀察到的代謝改變；長期治療亦使肝臟 NAD+ 下降 15–20%。

links.context: Chemotherapy treats cancer with cytotoxic or cytostatic drugs acting mainly by inducing DNA Damage, inhibiting mitosis, or blocking DNA replication, with major adverse effects including myelosuppression, cardiotoxicity, and peripheral neuropathy. Non-dividing quiescent cancer cells are correspondingly resistant to most agents.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemotherapy 以細胞毒或細胞抑制藥物治療 cancer，主要機轉為誘導 DNA Damage、抑制有絲分裂或阻斷 DNA 複製；其主要不良反應包括骨髓抑制、心臟毒性與周邊神經病變。相對地，非分裂的靜止癌細胞對多數化療藥物具有抗藥性。

links.context: Chemotherapy, long-term steroids, hematopoietic stem-cell transplant and checkpoint inhibitors such as anti-CTLA-4 or anti-PD-1 therapy for Cancer all increase susceptibility to Strongyloidiasis hyperinfection syndrome, which presents with enterocolitis, paralytic ileus, pulmonary infiltrates and gram-negative sepsis at high mortality. Screening endemic patients before immunosuppression is standard of care.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemotherapy、長期糖皮質激素、骨髓造血幹細胞移植，以及用於 Cancer 的 anti-CTLA-4 或 anti-PD-1 等檢查點抑制劑，都會提高 Strongyloidiasis 過度感染症候群的易感性；該症候群表現為腸結腸炎、麻痺性腸阻塞、肺部浸潤與高死亡率的革蘭氏陰性菌敗血症。在免疫抑制前篩檢流行地區患者屬標準照護。

links.context: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN) is a dose-limiting toxicity of taxane and platinum agents. These drugs downregulate NMNAT2 in sensory neurons, raising the NMN/NAD+ ratio and activating SARM1, whose NAD+-depletion activity drives axonal degeneration; SARM1 knockout protects against CIPN in preclinical models.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy（CIPN）是 taxane 與白金類藥物的劑量限制性毒性。這些藥物在感覺神經元中下调 NMNAT2，使 NMN／NAD+ 比值上升並活化 SARM1；SARM1 的 NAD+ 耗竭活性驅動軸突退化，且 SARM1 敲除在臨床前模型中可防止 CIPN。

links.context: Chlorpromazine is a Phenothiazine derivative defined by substitution at the 10-nitrogen with a 3-chloropropyl-dimethylaminoethyl side chain. That modification, shared with promethazine, abolishes methylene-blue-like mitochondrial electron-shunt activity and pro-oxidative liability follows.
links.context_zh_TW: Chlorpromazine 是 Phenothiazine 衍生物，其定義特徵為在 10-氮上以 3-氯丙基-二甲氨基乙基側鏈取代。此修飾（與 promethazine 共有）會消除 methylene blue 式的粒線體電子分流活性，並伴隨促氧化風險。

links.context: Chlorpromazine, a phenothiazine carrying an amine side chain on its 10-nitrogen, was the only compound among those tested that failed to protect HT-22 cells in the rotenone neurotoxicity model. The 10-N substitution causes a roughly 1000-fold loss of potency relative to methylene blue in glutamate, IAA, and rotenone assays, and abolishes the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt, oxygen consumption enhancement, and glycolysis suppression. In the lysate oxidation assay chlorpromazine increased DCF fluorescence with or without mitochondria and NADH, behaving as a pro-oxidant and explaining its weak neuroprotection.
links.context_zh_TW: 氯丙嗪（chlorpromazine）是在其10-氮上帶有胺側鏈的吩噻嗪（phenothiazine），是受測化合物中唯一無法在魚藤酮（rotenone）神經毒性模型中保護HT-22細胞的化合物。與亞甲藍（methylene blue）相比，10-N取代在麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA與魚藤酮試驗中造成約1000倍的效力損失，並消除複合體I至細胞色素c的電子分流、耗氧量增強與糖解抑制。在裂解液氧化試驗中，氯丙嗪在有或無粒線體與NADH的情況下皆增加DCF螢光，表現出促氧化劑（pro-oxidant）行為，這解釋了其微弱的神經保護作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Chlorpromazine, the first antipsychotic phenothiazine, acts primarily as a D2 receptor antagonist, blocking central dopamine D2 signaling; at higher receptor occupancy it also blocks histamine H1, muscarinic, and alpha-adrenergic receptors, producing antipsychotic, sedating, and antiemetic effects plus mild MAO inhibition.
links.context_zh_TW: Chlorpromazine（首個抗精神病藥 phenothiazine）主要作為 D2 receptor 拮抗劑，阻斷中樞 dopamine D2 訊號；在較高受體佔有率下亦阻斷 histamine H1、muscarinic 與 alpha-腎上腺素受體，產生抗精神病、鎮靜、止吐作用及輕微的 MAO 抑制。

links.context: Cholesterol Influx and Cholesterol Efflux are opposing processes whose balance determines cellular cholesterol homeostasis. Influx delivers Cholesterol to the cell, primarily Macrophages, whereas efflux exports it to Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL; only the net balance decides whether the cell remains healthy or becomes lipid-laden.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Influx 與 Cholesterol Efflux 是一對相反過程，兩者的平衡決定細胞膽固醇恆定。Influx 將 Cholesterol 送入細胞（主要為 Macrophages），而 efflux 將其輸出至 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL；唯有淨平衡決定細胞維持健康或淪為脂質堆積。

links.context: Cholesterol Metabolism comprises biosynthesis via the Mevalonate pathway, uptake via the LDL Receptor, esterification by ACAT1, and efflux through ABCA1 and ABCG1. ACAT1 also acts outside lipid handling, regulating TFEB activity through acetylation.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 包含經由 Mevalonate pathway 的生合成、經 LDL Receptor 的攝取、由 ACAT1 催化的酯化，以及經 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的外排。ACAT1 也參與脂質處理以外的調節，透過乙醯化調控 TFEB 活性。

links.context: Cholesterol efflux is the protective mechanism by which HDL removes excess cholesterol from macrophages, occurring via aqueous diffusion, SR-BI-mediated bidirectional flux, and ABCA1-mediated transfer to lipid-poor apoA-1. Oxidative stress (Fe/ascorbate) impairs ABCA1 expression and efflux, while resveratrol (0-25 µM) restores HDL3-mediated efflux in a dose-dependent manner by upregulating ABCA1.
links.context_zh_TW: 膽固醇外流是 HDL 將過多膽固醇從巨噬細胞移除的保護機制，可經由水相擴散、SR-BI 媒介的雙向通量，以及 ABCA1 媒介轉移至缺乏脂質的 apoA-1 等途徑進行。氧化壓力（Fe/ascorbate）會損害 ABCA1 表現與外流，而 resveratrol（0-25 µM）則以劑量依賴方式上調 ABCA1，恢復 HDL3 媒介的外流。

links.context: Cholesterol efflux via ABCA1 and ABCG1 exports cholesterol from macrophages; when it is insufficient, free cholesterol and cholesteryl esters accumulate and foam cells form. Resveratrol restores efflux under oxidative stress by upregulating ABCA1.
links.context_zh_TW: 經由 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的 cholesterol efflux 會將膽固醇排出 macrophages；當其不足時，游離膽固醇與膽固醇酯累積而形成 foam cells。Resveratrol 可在氧化壓力下藉由上調 ABCA1 恢復 efflux。

links.context: Cholesterol is a major lipid component of Myelin, which is roughly 70–80% lipid by dry weight. Together with Galactocerebroside-type glycolipids and Sphingomyelin, it enforces the compact, hydrophobic, high-resistance membrane that makes myelin a poor conductor and a good insulator.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol 是 Myelin 的主要脂質成分；Myelin 以乾重計約有 70–80% 為脂質。它與 Galactocerebroside 類醣脂及 Sphingomyelin 共同構成緊密、疏水、高電阻的膜，使髓鞘成為不良導體與良好絕緣體。

links.context: Chondrocytes are the sole resident cell type of cartilage and are a well-documented site of cellular senescence in osteoarthritis. Senescent chondrocytes develop a SASP that drives a catabolic, pro-inflammatory microenvironment contributing to cartilage degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: 軟骨細胞是軟骨的唯一駐留細胞類型，是骨關節炎中細胞衰老的充分記載部位。衰老軟骨細胞發展出 SASP，驅動促分解、促發炎的微環境，促成軟骨退化。

links.context: Christensenellaceae are saccharolytic anaerobic bacteria of the Firmicutes whose fermentation yields Short-chain Fatty Acids, particularly acetate and butyrate. These metabolites fuel colonocytes and support an anti-inflammatory tone, giving the family a direct metabolic role in host energy balance.
links.context_zh_TW: Christensenellaceae 是屬於 Firmicutes 的產糖厭氧菌，其發酵產生 Short-chain Fatty Acids，尤其是乙酸與丁酸。這些代謝物為結腸細胞供能並維持抗發炎基調，使此菌科在宿主能量平衡中具有直接代謝作用。

links.context: Chromaffin cells of the Adrenal medulla package Catecholamines with chromogranins and ATP into dense-core secretory granules. Preganglionic sympathetic acetylcholine release triggers calcium influx and granule exocytosis, driving the systemic fight-or-flight response of increased heart rate, bronchodilation and glycogenolysis.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenal medulla 的 Chromaffin cells 將 Catecholamines 與 chromogranin 及 ATP 一同包裝進緻密核心分泌顆粒。節前交感神經釋放乙醯膽鹼引發鈣離子內流與顆粒胞吐，驅動心跳加快、支氣管擴張與肝醣分解的全身性戰或逃反應。

links.context: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

links.context: Chronic SASP-driven inflammaging contributes to cardiovascular disease, including atherosclerosis, by promoting endothelial dysfunction, vascular inflammation, and plaque instability. The persistent inflammatory mediators accelerate vascular aging and thrombotic risk, and senescent endothelial cells contribute directly to this process. This links cellular senescence to a leading cause of age-related mortality, and senotherapeutic interventions are being explored to mitigate vascular inflammation. The contribution is supported by studies showing reduced cardiovascular risk with lower inflammatory burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 驅動的 inflammaging 透過促進內皮功能障礙、血管發炎與斑塊不穩定，貢獻包括動脈粥狀硬化在內的心血管疾病。持續發炎介質加速血管老化與血栓風險，且衰老內皮細胞直接貢獻此過程。這將細胞衰老連結到年齡相關死亡的主要原因，且 senotherapeutic 介入正被探索以減輕血管發炎。此貢獻獲較低發炎負擔伴隨心血管風險降低的研究支持。

links.context: Chronic activation of the p38 arm of the MAPK pathway is a key driver of entry into senescence, and pharmacological inhibition of p38 delays senescence in human cells; dysregulated MAPK signalling also contributes to chronic inflammation in old age.
links.context_zh_TW: MAPK 訊號傳遞中 p38 分支的慢性活化是細胞進入衰老的重要驅動力，藥理學抑制 p38 可延緩人類細胞衰老；失衡的 MAPK 訊號亦有助於老年慢性發炎。

links.context: Chronic antioxidant supplementation can inhibit the hormetic response and thereby block the cytoprotective adaptations that mitohormesis normally induces. This may explain the disappointing results of antioxidant clinical trials, where large meta-analyses generally failed to show benefit and in some cases suggested increased mortality. Supporting evidence comes from human studies showing that antioxidant supplements inhibit the salutary benefits of exercise, which is itself viewed as a mild stressor. Antioxidants presumably prevent the rise in mitochondrial ROS that is required to trigger the adaptive response.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期抗氧化補充可抑制促效應反應，從而阻斷粒線體促效應通常誘導的細胞保護適應。這可能解釋了抗氧化臨床試驗令人失望的結果，大型薈萃分析通常未能顯示益處，在某些情況下甚至顯示死亡率增加。支持性證據來自人體研究，顯示抗氧化補充劑抑制運動的有益效果，而運動本身被視為輕度壓力源。抗氧化劑可能阻止觸發適應性反應所需的粒線體 ROS 升高。

links.context: Chronic hyperglycemia is the metabolic stressor that drives Diabetic Kidney Disease, inducing premature senescence of mesangial, tubular and endothelial cells. Senescent renal cells acquire the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype and secrete pro-inflammatory cytokines and matrix-remodeling factors, propagating fibrotic signaling and renal dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 hyperglycemia 是驅動 Diabetic Kidney Disease 的代謝壓力源，會誘導係膜細胞、腎小管細胞與內皮細胞的早熟衰老。衰老腎細胞獲得 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype，分泌促發炎細胞激素與基質重塑因子，傳播纖維化訊號與腎功能障礙。

links.context: Chronic inflammasome activation by sterile stimuli, including senescent-cell DAMPs, drives persistent inflammation and age-related diseases, contributing to inflammaging. By producing IL-1beta and IL-18 and sustaining innate immune activation, inflammasomes maintain the low-grade inflammatory milieu characteristic of aging tissues. The relationship positions the inflammasome as a downstream executor of SASP-driven inflammation and links cellular senescence to systemic inflammatory states. It is a well-supported component of the aging inflammatory circuit, with NLRP3 recognized as a major contributor.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體貢獻 inflammaging，透過持續產生 IL-1beta 與釋放 DAMPs 維持慢性低程度發炎。隨年齡累積的發炎體活化源自衰老細胞與組織損傷，產生有助於年齡相關疾病特徵的無菌發炎環境。此貢獻將細胞衰老連結到全身 inflammaging，且 senomorphic 或抗發炎體策略可減輕其效應。它是 SASP—發炎體—aging 軸中的關鍵節點。

links.context: Chronic inflammation is driven by sustained NF-κB and NLRP3 inflammasome signalling; assembly of the inflammasome activates caspase-1, which cleaves pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 into active forms and can induce pyroptotic cell death. NLRP3 is uniquely sensitive to oxidative stress, so mtDNA release, ROS bursts and potassium efflux all trigger it.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性發炎由持續的 NF-κB 與 NLRP3 發炎小體訊號驅動；發炎小體組裝後活化 caspase-1，將 pro-IL-1β 與 pro-IL-18 切割成活性形式，並可誘發 pyroptosis 細胞死亡。NLRP3 對氧化壓力特別敏感，因此 mtDNA 釋放、活性氧爆發與鉀離子外流都能觸發它。

links.context: Chronic inhibition of mTORC1 by Rapamycin and its analogs (rapalogs) frequently elevates cholesterol and triglyceride levels. Mechanistically the mTOR-S6K1 axis normally promotes lipogenesis while suppressing adipose lipid storage; chronic rapamycin disrupts that balance, upregulating hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairing lipid deposition in adipose tissue, producing glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia. The effect is usually dose-dependent and reversible on discontinuation.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 及其類似物（rapalogs）長期抑制 mTORC1 時，常會升高膽固醇與三酸甘油酯。機制上，mTOR–S6K1 軸平時促進脂肪生成並抑制脂肪組織的脂質儲存；慢性 rapamycin 破壞此平衡，促進肝糖質新生並妨礙脂質在脂肪組織沉積，造成葡萄糖耐受不良與 Hyperlipidemia。此效應通常呈劑量依賴且停藥後可逆。

links.context: Chronic low-grade Autoinflammation, driven by persistent NLRP3 activation from endogenous DAMPs such as oxidized Cardiolipin, mtDNA and Uric Acid Crystals, is a major component of Inflammaging and directly links inflammasome-driven IL-1β overproduction to age-related disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 由內源性 DAMP（如氧化態 Cardiolipin、mtDNA 與 Uric Acid Crystals）持續活化 NLRP3 所造成的慢性低度 Autoinflammation，是 Inflammaging 的重要組成，並將發炎小體驅動的 IL-1β 過量生成直接連結到年齡相關疾病。

links.context: Chronic microglial cGAS-STING signalling restrains the protective MEF2C neuronal gene program in a non-cell-autonomous manner: microglial cGAS deletion reverses neuronal MEF2C downregulation in tauopathy (Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023), making the cGAS axis a therapeutic target for preserving neuronal resilience.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性的小膠質細胞 cGAS–STING 訊號以非細胞自體的方式抑制具保護性的 MEF2C 神經元基因程式：小膠質細胞 cGAS 缺失可逆轉 tauopathy 中神經元 MEF2C 的下调（Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023），使 cGAS 軸成為維持神經元韌性的治療標的。

links.context: Chronic occupational silica inhalation drives persistent NLRP3 activation, IL-1β secretion and granulomatous inflammation (silicosis), and raises the risk of rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, scleroderma, lung cancer and tuberculosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期職業性吸入 silica 會造成持續的 NLRP3 活化、IL-1β 分泌與肉芽腫性發炎（silicosis），並提高 rheumatoid arthritis、systemic lupus erythematosus、硬皮症、肺癌與結核病的風險。

links.context: Chronic rapamycin and rapalog administration can produce glucose intolerance and insulin resistance, an effect mechanistically separable from the longevity benefit of mTORC1 inhibition. In some rodent models chronic rapamycin upregulates hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairs adipose lipid deposition, yielding both glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia, although healthy elderly humans on low-dose or intermittent schedules typically show no hyperglycemia or less than placebo.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期使用 rapamycin 及其 rapalog 類藥物可造成葡萄糖耐受不良與胰島素阻抗，此效應在機制上可與 mTORC1 抑制的長壽益處區分開來。在部分鼠類模型中，慢性 rapamycin 會上调肝臟糖質新生並損害脂肪組織的脂質沉積，因而同時造成葡萄糖耐受不良與高脂血症；但健康老年人使用低劑量或間歇性給藥時，通常未見高血糖或低於安慰劑組。

links.context: Chronic ryanodine receptor leak elevates cytosolic Ca2+ and can drive mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. RyR thus sits upstream of mitochondrial calcium and redox balance linking to MPTP-mediated cell death.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 ryanodine 受體滲漏升高細胞質 Ca2+，可驅動粒線體 Ca2+ 超載與粒線體通透性轉換孔道開啟。因此 RyR 位於粒線體鈣與氧化還原平衡的上游，與 MPTP 介導的細胞死亡相連結。

links.context: Chronically elevated cortisol, from stacked stressors or poor recovery, suppresses heart-rate variability (HRV) and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis. Acute cortisol release supports the fight-or-flight response, but sustained elevation undermines parasympathetic recovery and HRV rebound.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期升高的 cortisol（源自疊加壓力或恢復不足）會抑制心率變異度（HRV）並損害粒線體生合成。急性 cortisol 釋放支持戰或逃反應，但持續升高會破壞副交感恢復與 HRV 反彈。

links.context: Chrysin shares the flavone scaffold with apigenin and, when combined with apigenin, synergistically induces apoptosis and inhibits migration in breast and liver cancer cells by downregulating MMP-2 and MMP-9. Both are plant flavones with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
links.context_zh_TW: Chrysin 與 apigenin 共享黃酮骨架，與 apigenin 合併使用時可透過下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9，協同誘導乳癌與肝癌細胞凋亡並抑制其遷移。兩者皆為機制重疊的植物黃酮。

links.context: Cigarette Smoke delivers thousands of chemicals including semiquinone, hydroxyl and nitric-oxide Free Radicals. Tar-phase semiquinones redox-cycle to generate sustained Reactive Oxygen Species long after inhalational exposure, so the oxidant burden outlasts the acute event and chronically erodes tissue antioxidant defences.
links.context_zh_TW: Cigarette Smoke 含有數千種化學物質，其中包括 semiquinone、hydroxyl 與 nitric-oxide 等 Free Radicals。焦油相的 semiquinone 可進行氧化還原循環，在吸入事件結束後仍持續產生 Reactive Oxygen Species，因此氧化負荷會超出急性暴露期，長期侵蝕組織抗氧化防禦。

links.context: Cilengitide antagonizes alphav-beta3/beta5 integrins at the ligand pocket.
links.context_zh_TW: Cilengitide 在配體口袋拮抗 αvβ3/β5 integrin。

links.context: Cilengitide is a cyclic RGD pentapeptide derivative.
links.context_zh_TW: Cilengitide 是環狀 RGD 五肽衍生物。

links.context: Circulating GM-CSF is used as a pharmacodynamic biomarker of senescent-cell burden; its levels fall after senolytic treatment in clinical studies such as diabetic kidney disease, so GM-CSF is measured alongside IL-6 and MMP-9 to assess therapeutic efficacy.
links.context_zh_TW: 循環中的 GM-CSF 被用作衰老細胞負荷的藥效學生物標記；在糖尿病腎病等臨床研究中，senolytic 治療後其濃度會下降，因此 GM-CSF 會與 IL-6、MMP-9 一同被測定以評估療效。

links.context: Circulating taurine concentrations decline with age across species, from mice and monkeys to humans. In mice, chronic taurine supplementation extended healthspan and lifespan, improving muscle, bone, immune, and metabolic function (Singh et al., 2023, Science; PMID 37561875), linking taurine status to longevity phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: 循環中的 taurine 濃度在小鼠、猴與人類等各物種中都隨年齡下降。在小鼠中，長期補充 taurine 可延長健康壽齡與壽命，改善肌肉、骨骼、免疫與代謝功能（Singh 等，2023，Science；PMID 37561875），將 taurine 狀態與長壽表型連結起來。

links.context: Cisplatin induces Autophagy in cancer cells as a resistance mechanism, so inhibiting Autophagy enhances cisplatin cytotoxicity. The drug also damages Mitochondria and triggers Mitophagy, and SIRT1-driven upregulation of VEGF-A further promotes cisplatin resistance in non-small-cell lung cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 在癌細胞中誘發 Autophagy 作為抗藥機制，因此抑制 Autophagy 可增強 cisplatin 的細胞毒性。該藥亦損傷 Mitochondria 並誘發 Mitophagy；此外 SIRT1 介導的 VEGF-A 上調會進一步促進非小細胞肺癌的 cisplatin 抗藥性。

links.context: Cl-amidine is a covalent pan-peptidylarginine deiminase inhibitor with a chloro-acetamidine warhead that blocks citrullination by PAD4 and related deiminases. In NETosis assays it suppresses histone citrullination (cit-H3) and NET extrusion, making it — with DNase digestion and NE/MPO inhibition — the standard blockade panel proving PAD-dependent NET formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Cl-amidine 是具有 chloro-acetamidine 親電子基團的共價廣譜 peptidylarginine deiminase 抑制劑，可阻斷 PAD4 及相關 deiminase 的 citrullination 作用。在 NETosis 分析中，它抑制 histone citrullination（cit-H3）與 NET 挤出，因此與 DNase 消化及 NE/MPO 抑制並列，構成證明 PAD 依賴性 NET 形成的標準阻斷組合。

links.context: Class membership, not molecule identity: adrenochrome belongs to the aminochrome class — the oxidized, colored o-quinone products formed from catecholamines (each aminochrome derives from its precursor amine: aminochrome from dopamine, adrenochrome from epinephrine). Aminochromes are examined here as candidate senotherapeutics; their chemistry, ortho-quinone electrophilicity and redox cycling determine both their potential cytostatic and senomorphic activity and their neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity.
links.context_zh_TW: 類別成員關係，而非分子身分：腎上腺素紅屬於氨基色素類——由兒茶酚胺氧化形成的有色鄰醌產物（每種氨基色素皆源自其前驅胺類：氨基色素來自多巴胺，腎上腺素紅來自腎上腺素）。氨基色素在此被研究為候選衰老治療藥物；其化學性質、鄰醌親電性與氧化還原循環決定了其潛在的細胞靜止與衰老模仿活性，以及其神經毒性與心臟毒性。

links.context: Classic pharmacological geroprotectors include the mTOR inhibitor rapamycin and its rapalogs, alongside metformin and senolytics. Many act through overlapping nutrient-sensing axes and engage autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: 經典的藥理學延緩衰老劑包括 mTOR 抑制劑 rapamycin 及其 rapalog，以及 metformin 與 senolytic。許多透過重疊的營養感知軸作用並啟動自噬。

links.context: Clear-cell RCC is driven by VHL loss, leading to HIF-1alpha/2alpha stabilization, angiogenesis and metabolic reprogramming.
links.context_zh_TW: 透明細胞 RCC 由 VHL 缺失驅動，導致 HIF-1alpha/2alpha 穩定、血管生成和代謝重編程。

links.context: Cleavage of the mutant mitochondrial genome triggers its degradation, sparing wild-type molecules which repopulate the cell. Pioneered by Bacman et al. (2013, Nature Medicine; PMID 23242366) against the m.8993 T>C mutation (NARP/MILS), this shifted heteroplasmy and restored oxidative phosphorylation in patient-derived cybrids; AAV-delivered variants later produced the same rescue in mouse models of MELAS (m.5024C>T).
links.context_zh_TW: 突變型粒線體基因組被切割後會隨即降解，野生型分子則得以保留並重新填充細胞。該策略由 Bacman 等人（2013，Nature Medicine；PMID 23242366）首度以 m.8993 T>C 突變（NARP/MILS）實現，藉由改變異質性比例在病人衍生 cybrid 中恢復了 oxidative phosphorylation；之後以 AAV 遞送的版本又在 MELAS（m.5024C>T）小鼠模型中產生相同的救援效果。

links.context: Cleaved CendR engages Neuropilin-1 for tumor penetration as step two.
links.context_zh_TW: 切割的 CendR 接合 Neuropilin-1 以腫瘤穿透作為第二步。

links.context: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
links.context_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。
links.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

links.context: Clofarabine depletes dNTP pools by inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase, starving DNA synthesis in proliferating cells. This mechanism synergizes with its incorporation into DNA to terminate chain elongation.
links.context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 透過抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶來耗竭 dNTP 池，使增殖細胞中的 DNA 合成匱乏。此機制與其嵌入 DNA 終止鏈延長相互協同。

links.context: Clofarabine poisons DNA Polymerase: the nucleoside analog incorporates into DNA and then terminates chain elongation, giving a triple threat on DNA metabolism together with ribonucleotide reductase inhibition and direct incorporation.
links.context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 會毒害 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）：此核苷類似物摻入 DNA 後即終止鏈延長，與抑制核糖核苷酸還原酶及直接摻入共同構成對 DNA 代謝的三重打擊。

links.context: Clofarabine triphosphate disrupts mitochondrial membrane integrity, releasing cytochrome c and AIF to drive apoptosis. It also inhibits DNA polymerases alpha, beta, and epsilon and is incorporated into DNA, terminating chain elongation and interfering with DNA repair.
links.context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 三磷酸會破壞粒線體膜完整性，釋放細胞色素 c 與 AIF 以驅動細胞凋亡。它也抑制 DNA 聚合酶 alpha、beta、epsilon，並嵌入 DNA 終止鏈延長、干擾 DNA 修復。

links.context: Co-expression of dominant-negative Caspase-9 or Bcl-xL blocked the cleavage and nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization of Sir2alpha (SIRT1) during TNF-alpha-induced apoptosis. This established the translocation as downstream of apoptosome activation and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization.
links.context_zh_TW: 共表達顯性失活型 Caspase-9 或 Bcl-xL 阻斷了 TNF-α 誘導凋亡期間 Sir2α（SIRT1）的裂解和從細胞核到細胞質的重新定位。這確立了此轉位位於凋亡小體活化和粒線體外膜通透化的下游。
links.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

links.context: CobB, discovered in Salmonella enterica, is the founding prokaryotic sirtuin. Its characterization showed that NAD+-dependent deacetylation is not restricted to eukaryotes but also occurs in prokaryotes, where one or two sirtuins typically regulate metabolic pathways. Its discovery placed the NAD+-dependent deacetylation mechanism evolutionarily before the seven human sirtuins.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Salmonella enterica 中發現的 CobB 是原核生物 sirtuin 的奠基者。其特性研究顯示 NAD+ 相關去乙醯化並非僅限於真核生物，在原核生物（通常有一到兩個 sirtuin 調節代謝路徑）中同樣存在。其發現將 NAD+ 相關去乙醯化機制在演化上置於人類七個 sirtuin 之前。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 is synthesized endogenously through the mevalonate pathway, the same biosynthetic route that produces cholesterol. The pathway requires at least twelve gene products (PDSS1, PDSS2, COQ2-COQ9 in humans) and uses tyrosine as the benzene-ring precursor. Because statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme of this pathway, they simultaneously lower endogenous CoQ10 synthesis alongside cholesterol, which explains the rationale for CoQ10 supplementation in statin-induced myopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 透過 mevalonate pathway 內源性合成，這與產生 cholesterol 的合成途徑相同。此途徑至少需要十二種基因產物（人類的 PDSS1、PDSS2、COQ2-COQ9），並以 tyrosine 作為苯環前驅物。由於 statins 抑制此途徑的限速酶 HMG-CoA reductase，因此會同時降低內源性 CoQ10 與 cholesterol 的合成，這解釋了在 statin-induced myopathy 中補充 CoQ10 的依據。

links.context: Cohesin cooperates with CTCF in loop-extruded TAD boundary formation. Interaction organizes three-dimensional genome architecture.
links.context_zh_TW: Cohesin 與 CTCF 在環擠出 TAD 邊界形成協作。交互作用組織三維基因組架構。

links.context: Colchicine is a plant alkaloid that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. It is used for gout and familial Mediterranean fever and serves as a comparator microtubule-disrupting agent in fenbendazole-related anticancer research.
links.context_zh_TW: Colchicine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的植物生物鹼。它用於痛風與家族性地中海熱，並作為 fenbendazole 相關抗癌研究中的比較性微管破壞藥物。

links.context: Collagen types one to three are the dominant structural fibers.
links.context_zh_TW: 第一至三型膠原是主要的結構纖維。

links.context: Community-directed distribution of Ivermectin suppresses skin Microfilariae and thereby interrupts transmission of Onchocerca volvulus, complementing larviciding of Simulium breeding rivers. Because Microfilariae are the stage picked up by the fly, lowering their skin density removes the vector's infectious source.
links.context_zh_TW: 以社區為導向的 Ivermectin 發放可抑制皮膚中的 Microfilariae，藉此阻斷 Onchocerca volvulus 的傳播，與對 Simulium 孳生河流的殺幼蟲措施互補。由於 Microfilariae 正是被黑蠅吸入的階段，降低其皮膚密度等於移除病媒的感染來源。

links.context: Compared with liposomes and polymeric nanoparticles, Solid Lipid Nanoparticles improve bioavailability of lipophilic drugs such as Fisetin while offering controlled release and avoiding organic solvents.
links.context_zh_TW: 相較於 liposomes 與高分子 polymeric nanoparticles，Solid Lipid Nanoparticles 能在提供受控釋放並避免有機溶劑的同時，提升 Fisetin 等親脂性藥物的生體可用度。

links.context: Complement defects are central to Systemic Lupus Erythematosus pathogenesis: inherited C1q, C2 and C4 deficiency impairs clearance of apoptotic debris, while ongoing immune complex deposition in disease consumes C3 and C4, so low complement is both a genetic risk and a biomarker of active disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 補體系統缺陷是 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus 致病機制的核心：遺傳性的 C1q、C2、C4 缺乏會妨礙凋亡殘骸的清除，而疾病中持續的免疫複合體沉積又會消耗 C3 與 C4。因此補體偏低既是遺傳風險，也是疾病活動的生物標記。

links.context: Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is the first enzyme of the electron transport chain, and its inhibition is a central mechanism of mitochondrial dysfunction. Loss of complex I elevates oxidative stress and depletes ATP, linking it to Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex I（NADH：泛醌氧化還原酶）是電子傳遞鏈的第一個酶，其抑制是粒線體功能障礙的核心機制。Complex I 喪失會升高氧化壓力並耗竭 ATP，與帕金森氏症相連結。

links.context: Complex I is the entry point of the electron transport chain and oxidizes NADH back to NAD+, thereby regenerating the oxidized cofactor that the TCA cycle requires. MYChigh cancer cells exploit this Complex I-dependent NAD+ regeneration to sustain a Glutamine-fueled TCA cycle supplying biosynthetic precursors.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex I 是電子傳遞鏈的入口，將 NADH 氧化回 NAD+，再生 TCA cycle 所必需的氧化態輔酶。MYChigh 癌細胞利用這種 Complex I 相依的 NAD+ 再生，以維持由 Glutamine 驅動、供應生合成前驅物的 TCA cycle。

links.context: Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) oxidizes succinate and reduces ubiquinone; its product ubiquinol is the fuel that drives reverse electron transport when the membrane is highly polarized. Succinate accumulation during ischemia makes Complex II a key upstream driver of RET-derived ROS.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex II（琥珀酸脫氫酶）氧化琥珀酸並還原泛醌；其產物泛醇是膜高度極化時驅動反向電子傳遞（RET）的燃料。缺血期間的琥珀酸累積使 Complex II 成為 RET 來源 ROS 的關鍵上游驅動者。

links.context: Complex II is embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane and is the only enzyme that participates in both the TCA cycle and the electron transport chain. It links carbon metabolism to mitochondrial redox signaling and oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex II 嵌入粒線體內膜，是唯一同時參與 TCA 循環與電子傳遞鏈的酶。它將碳代謝與粒線體氧化還原訊號及氧化壓力相連結。

links.context: Complex III (the cytochrome bc1 complex) is a major source of Reactive Oxygen Species in the inner Mitochondria membrane: electron leakage at the Qo site during the Q-cycle generates Superoxide. Its activity therefore couples electron transport from Coenzyme Q10 to Cytochrome c to both proton translocation and mitochondrial oxidant production.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex III（cytochrome bc1 複合體）是內膜 Mitochondria 中 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要來源之一：Q-cycle 過程中在 Qo 位點的電子洩漏會產生 Superoxide。因此其活性將電子由 Coenzyme Q10 傳遞至 Cytochrome c 的過程，與質子轉位及粒線體氧化產物的生成相互耦聯。

links.context: Complex III is the other principal leak site of Mitochondrial Superoxide; leak there is greatest at high Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, and the resulting superoxide is rapidly dismutated or can damage cardiolipin, proteins and mtDNA.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex III 是 Mitochondrial Superoxide 的另一個主要滲漏位點；該處的滲漏在高 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 下最大，產生的 superoxide 會被迅速歧化，否則便損傷 cardiolipin、蛋白質與 mtDNA。

links.context: Complex III is the second major site of Mitochondrial ROS generation, where electrons leak from the ubiquinol oxidation reaction to reduce molecular oxygen to superoxide.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex III 是 Mitochondrial ROS 生成的第二大場所，電子自 ubiquinol 氧化反應中滲漏，將分子氧還原為 superoxide。

links.context: Complex III is the third complex of the Electron Transport Chain in the inner Mitochondria membrane, catalysing electron transfer from Coenzyme Q10 to Cytochrome c coupled to proton translocation via the Q-cycle.
