links.context: ELK4 contains a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain recognizing purine-rich GGAA/T motifs and an SRF interaction domain, and is phosphorylated by ERK1/2 and other MAPKs at its transcriptional activation domain. This links receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to immediate-early gene transcription and explains why elevated ELK4 signalling contributes to oncogenic transcriptional programs downstream of MAPK.
links.context_zh_TW: ELK4 含有辨識富含嘌呤 GGAA/T 序列的保守 ETS DNA 結合區與一個 SRF 交互作用區，並由 ERK1/2 及其他 MAPK 在其轉錄活化區磷酸化。這把受體酪胺酸激酶訊號連結至立即早期基因的轉錄，也解釋了為何 ELK4 訊號升高會促成 MAPK 下游的致癌性轉錄程式。

links.context: ELK4, an ETS-domain transcription factor of the ternary complex factor subfamily, stabilizes SIRT7 at the promoters of its target genes. ELK4-dependent tethering is required for SIRT7 to reach chromatin and deacetylate H3K18ac, repressing genes with tumor suppressor function and thereby maintaining cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth.
links.context_zh_TW: ELK4 是三元複合體因子次家族中的 ETS 結構域轉錄因子，它在 SIRT7 標的基因的啟動子上穩定 SIRT7。ELK4 依賴性的繫留是 SIRT7 抵達染色質並去乙醯化 H3K18ac 所必需，使具腫瘤抑制功能的基因受到抑制，進而維持如非錨定生長等癌症特徵。

links.context: EMT drives cell internalization movements of gastrulation. Involvement places morphogenesis in the transition logic.
links.context_zh_TW: EMT 驅動原腸形成的細胞內移運動。涉及將形態發生置於轉換邏輯。

links.context: EP300 acetylates non-histone substrates including LC3, p53, and ATG proteins. Acetylated LC3 is functionally inactive, so LC3 hypoacetylation is the direct readout of EP300 inhibition and the proximal event that permits autophagosome formation.
links.context_zh_TW: EP300 會乙醯化包括 LC3、p53 與 ATG 蛋白在內的非組蛋白受質。乙醯化的 LC3 在功能上不活化，因此 LC3 低乙醯化是 EP300 抑制的直接讀值，也是允許自噬體形成的近端事件。

links.context: EP300 normally keeps cytoplasmic Autophagy-related proteins — ATG5, ATG7, ATG12, and LC3 — acetylated and inactive. Removing that acetyl brake (as Spermidine does) drives mTOR-independent autophagic flux.
links.context_zh_TW: EP300 正常情況下會讓細胞質中的 Autophagy（自噬）相關蛋白——ATG5、ATG7、ATG12 與 LC3——維持乙醯化而不活化。移除此乙醯化煞車（如 Spermidine 所做）即可驅動不依賴 mTOR 的自噬通量。

links.context: EPHA2 activation in recipient cancer cells stimulates proliferation, migration and a more aggressive phenotype, linking chronic senescence to tumor promotion and therapy resistance independently of the senescent cells' own cell-cycle arrest. EPHA2 is amplified, overexpressed or mislocalized in breast, lung, melanoma and glioblastoma and correlates with poor prognosis, making it a target for antibodies, kinase inhibitors and antibody-drug conjugates.
links.context_zh_TW: 受體癌細胞中 EPHA2 的活化會促進增殖、移行與更具侵襲性的表型，將慢性衰老與腫瘤促進及治療抗藥性連結起來，且獨立於衰老細胞本身的細胞週期停滯。EPHA2 在乳癌、肺癌、黑色素瘤與多形性膠質母細胞瘤中擴增、過度表現或錯位表達並與不良預後相關，因此是單株抗體、激酶抑制劑與抗體藥物複合體的治療標的。

links.context: EPHA2 is a receptor tyrosine kinase that relays the pro-tumorigenic effects of the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype at a distance. Exosomes released by senescent fibroblasts and epithelial cells carry ephrin ligands and growth factors that activate EPHA2 on recipient cancer cells, circumventing the contact-dependence of canonical ephrin-A1 binding and driving ligand-independent mitogenic signaling through PI3K-AKT, Src-FAK and MAPK.
links.context_zh_TW: EPHA2 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，能在遠距離傳遞 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的促腫瘤效應。衰老纖維母細胞與上皮細胞釋出的外泌體攜帶 ephrin 配體與生長因子，活化受體癌細胞上的 EPHA2，繞過典型 ephrin-A1 結合的接觸依賴性，並透過 PI3K-AKT、Src-FAK 與 MAPK 驅動配體非依賴性的致分裂訊號。

links.context: EPR spectroscopy is the most direct method for measuring reactive oxygen species in biological systems, quantifying ROS and antioxidant capacity in samples and detecting free radical production in mitochondria. Spin trapping with reagents such as DMPO, POBN or DEPMPO stabilizes short-lived radicals such as superoxide and hydroxyl radical for detection.
links.context_zh_TW: EPR 光譜是生物系統中測量活性氧物種最直接的方法，可定量樣品中的 ROS 與抗氧化能力，並偵測粒線體中的自由基生成；使用 DMPO、POBN 或 DEPMPO 等自旋捕捉試劑可穩定超氧陰離子與羥基自由基等短壽命自由基以便偵測。

links.context: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

links.context: ERK licenses TRIM2-mediated ubiquitylation of Bim: growth-factor signalling through the ERK/MAPK cascade activates kinases such as RSK that prime Bim, enhancing its recognition by TRIM2. Loss of TRIM2 therefore sensitizes cells to apoptosis, whereas TRIM2 activity promotes survival, especially in neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: ERK 為 TRIM2 介導的 Bim 泛素化提供許可：透過 ERK/MAPK 級聯的生長因子訊號活化 RSK 等激酶以預備 Bim，提高其被 TRIM2 辨識的效率。因此 TRIM2 喪失會使細胞對凋亡敏感，而 TRIM2 活性則促進存活，在神經元中尤其明顯。

links.context: ERK phosphorylates MFN1 in its HR1 domain, inhibiting mitochondrial fusion and promoting apoptosis - a redox- and stress-sensitive brake on mitofusin activity.
links.context_zh_TW: ERK 會磷酸化 MFN1 的 HR1 結構域，抑制粒線體融合並促進細胞凋亡，構成對 mitofusin 活性受氧化還原與壓力調控的煞車。

links.context: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

links.context: ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142, producing cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export of the transcription factor (PMID 21617040, 29992949). Phosphorylation at this site, shared with mTORC1 and CDK4/CDK6, keeps TFEB out of the nucleus and thereby represses its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes. This places TFEB under the control of mitogen/extracellular-signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling in addition to nutrient sensing, integrating growth factor cues into the control of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. Dephosphorylation of S142 by calcineurin reverses this effect and promotes TFEB translocation to the nucleus.
links.context_zh_TW: ERK2 在絲氨酸 142 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留和核輸出（PMID 21617040、29992949）。此位點的磷酸化與 mTORC1 和 CDK4/CDK6 共享，使 TFEB 保持在細胞核外，從而抑制其溶酶體和自噬基因的轉錄程序。這使 TFEB 除了營養感知外，還受到絲裂原/細胞外信號調節激酶（ERK）信號通路的控制，將生長因子線索整合到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的調節中。鈣調磷酸酶對 S142 的去磷酸化逆轉此效應，促進 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

links.context: ERRalpha transcriptionally activates mitochondrial biogenesis genes, coactivated by PGC-1alpha, and regulates NRF1, NRF2 (GABPA) and TFAM to drive mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription. Metabolic stress such as exercise, caloric restriction and cold exposure upregulates ERRalpha via PGC-1alpha.
links.context_zh_TW: ERRalpha 在 PGC-1α 共活化下轉錄活化粒線體生物發生相關基因，並調控 NRF1、NRF2（GABPA）與 TFAM，以驅動粒線體 DNA 的複製與轉錄。運動、熱量限制與寒冷暴露等代謝壓力可經由 PGC-1α 上調 ERRalpha。

links.context: ERRalpha upregulates nuclear-encoded oxidative phosphorylation genes, including electron transport chain subunits NDUFS1, COXIV and ATP5B, as part of its master regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid oxidation (MCAD, LCAD, CPT1b, PDK4).
links.context_zh_TW: ERRalpha 上調核基因編碼的氧化磷酸化基因，包括電子傳遞鏈次單元 NDUFS1、COXIV 與 ATP5B；這是其作為氧化磷酸化與脂肪酸氧化（MCAD、LCAD、CPT1b、PDK4）主控因子的一部分。

links.context: ERV RNA is reverse-transcribed into cDNA in the cytoplasm, where it is sensed by cGAS-STING (and RIG-I-like receptors), triggering type I interferon and NF-kappaB-driven SASP. In humans, the HERV subset releases retrovirus-like particles that infect neighbouring cells, spreading senescence — making ERV derepression a conserved, cross-species engine of senescence-associated inflammation and inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: ERV RNA 在細胞質中被反轉錄成 cDNA，隨即由 cGAS-STING（以及 RIG-I 類受體）感知，觸發第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP。在人類中，HERV 子群可釋放類反轉錄病毒顆粒感染鄰近細胞，傳播衰老——使 ERV 去抑制成為跨物種保守的衰老相關發炎與 inflammaging 引擎。

links.context: ERVs are normally kept silent by DNA methylation and repressive histone marks, with the corepressor KAP1 and heterochromatin factor HP1alpha (supported by SIRT6 and RB1) packaging ERV/LINE-1 loci into heterochromatin. In senescence, epigenetic erosion — global and focal DNA hypomethylation, loss of H3K9me3 via shifts in SUV39H1/KDM4 and H3K27me3 via EZH2/JMJD3, and heterochromatin decompaction (SADS) — relieves this silencing and permits ERV transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: ERV 平時受 DNA 甲基化與抑制性組蛋白標記沉默，由共抑制因子 KAP1 與異染色質因子 HP1alpha（並由 SIRT6 與 RB1 支援）將 ERV/LINE-1 基因座包裝成異染色質。在衰老時，表觀遺傳侵蝕——全域與局部的 DNA 低甲基化、經 SUV39H1/KDM4 變化造成的 H3K9me3 喪失、經 EZH2/JMJD3 造成的 H3K27me3 喪失，以及異染色質去壓縮（SADS）——會解除此沉默並允許 ERV 轉錄。

links.context: ESCRT machinery (complexes 0-III) performs the membrane scission that lets Selective Autophagy capture damaged organelles. After a defective peroxisome is tagged with ubiquitin and sensed by PERO1, ESCRT is recruited and engages LC3 to initiate engulfment into an autophagosome.
links.context_zh_TW: ESCRT 機制（0-III 複合體）執行膜切割，使 Selective Autophagy 能夠包圍受損胞器。當缺陷的 peroxisome 被泛素標記並由 PERO1 辨識後，ESCRT 被招募並與 LC3 互動，啟動包裹進 autophagosome 的過程。

links.context: ESCs maintain naive pluripotent developmental potential. Maintenance is their defining property.
links.context_zh_TW: ESC 維持初始多能性發育潛能。維持是其定義特性。

links.context: EV-borne cGAMP and mtDNA cargo propagates cGAS-STING activation between CNS cells such as neurons, microglia and astrocytes, converting localized cellular stress into network-wide neuroinflammation. This makes EV-mediated signaling a candidate target for interrupting pathological cGAS-STING spread.
links.context_zh_TW: EV 攜帶的 cGAMP 與 mtDNA 貨物會在神經元、小膠細胞與星狀膠細胞等 CNS 細胞之間傳播 cGAS-STING 活化，把局部細胞壓力轉化為全網絡性的 neuroinflammation。這使 EV 媒介的訊號成為阻斷病理性 cGAS-STING 擴散的一個候選標的。

links.context: Each bis-allylic methylene group in DHA is a target for hydrogen abstraction by the Hydroxyl radical and other radical species. With six double bonds DHA has roughly 10-fold higher oxidizability than linoleic acid (18:2) and about 3-fold higher than Arachidonic acid (20:4), so DHA is the most peroxidation-prone neuronal lipid.
links.context_zh_TW: DHA 中的每個 bis-allylic methylene 基團都是 Hydroxyl radical 及其他自由基抽取氫原子的標的。由於有六個雙鍵，DHA 的氧化性約為 linoleic acid（18:2）的 10 倍、Arachidonic acid（20:4）的 3 倍，因此 DHA 是神經組織中最易被過氧化���脂質。

links.context: Each turn of the TCA cycle oxidizes acetyl-CoA, releasing two CO2 and generating 3 NADH, 1 FADH2 and 1 GTP. The NADH and FADH2 are the reducing equivalents fed into the electron transport chain, which is how the TCA cycle powers ATP generation by oxidative phosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: TCA cycle 每轉一圈會氧化 acetyl-CoA，釋出兩個 CO2 並產生 3 NADH、1 FADH2 與 1 GTP。這些 NADH 與 FADH2 就是送入電子傳遞鏈的還原當量，也正是 TCA cycle 藉由氧化磷酸化產生 ATP 的方式。

links.context: Efficient lymphatic clearance limits the accumulation of inflammatory mediators, whereas impaired drainage permits their buildup in the cerebrospinal fluid and parenchyma. Dysfunction of the Meningeal Lymphatic System therefore exacerbates cGAS-STING–driven Neuroinflammation and worsens amyloid pathology, making support of meningeal lymphatic function a strategy to dampen chronic CNS inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 有效的淋巴清除可限制發炎介質的累積，而引流受損則容許它們在腦脊髓液與神經實質中堆積。因此 Meningeal Lymphatic System 的功能失調會加劇 cGAS-STING 驅動的 Neuroinflammation 並惡化類澱粉樣病變，使支持腦膜淋巴功能成為抑制慢性中樞神經發炎的策略。

links.context: Elastin degradation in alveolar walls by MMP-12 and neutrophil elastase is the defining pathological feature of emphysema. Loss of elastic recoil and airway collapse during expiration produce airflow limitation and air trapping, with protease-antiprotease imbalance overwhelming alpha-1 antitrypsin capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 肺泡壁中的彈性蛋白經 MMP-12 與嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶降解，是肺氣腫的定義性病理特徵。彈性回縮喪失與呼氣時氣道塌陷造成氣流受限與空氣滯留，蛋白酶與抗蛋白酶失衡超過 alpha-1 antitrypsin 的容量。

links.context: Elastin fragmentation by MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12 reduces arterial elastic recoil, contributing to systolic hypertension, left ventricular hypertrophy and cardiovascular risk. Fragmentation is one of the earliest structural changes in atherosclerotic vessel remodelling, and elastin also accumulates AGE crosslinks with age that stiffen its fibres.
links.context_zh_TW: MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 對彈性蛋白的碎裂會降低動脈的彈性回縮，促成收縮期高血壓、左心室肥厚與心血管風險。彈性蛋白碎裂是動脈粥狀硬化血管重塑最早的結構變化之一；隨老化彈性蛋白也累積 AGE 交聯，使其纖維變硬。

links.context: Elastokine signalling through the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor activates ERK1/2 and p38 MAPK and NF-kappaB, upregulating transcription of MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12. This creates the positive feedback loop elastin degradation to elastokine generation to EBP signalling to MMP upregulation to further elastin degradation, which accelerates tissue deterioration in ageing, COPD, atherosclerosis and photoageing.
links.context_zh_TW: Elastokine 經由彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體的訊號會活化 ERK1/2、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB，並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 的轉錄。這形成彈性蛋白降解→elastokine 生成→EBP 訊號→MMP 上調→更多彈性蛋白降解的正向迴路，在老化、COPD、動脈粥狀硬化與光老化中加速組織劣化。

links.context: Elastokines are chemotactic for monocytes and macrophages, promoting inflammatory cell recruitment to degraded elastic tissue and macrophage activation, which in turn raises MMP-12 output. In the lung they amplify alveolar elastin degradation and contribute to the protease-antiprotease imbalance driving airspace enlargement.
links.context_zh_TW: Elastokines 對單核球與巨噬細胞具有趨化作用，促進發炎細胞被招募至降解的彈性組織並活化巨噬細胞，後者再提高 MMP-12 的產量。在肺部，它們放大肺泡彈性蛋白降解，並促成造成氣腔擴大的蛋白酶—抗蛋白酶失衡。

links.context: Electron leak and therefore Mitochondrial ROS production is greatest under a high Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, because the back-pressure of the proton gradient drives reverse electron transport into Complex I.
links.context_zh_TW: 電子滲漏、因而 Mitochondrial ROS 的產生，在高 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 下最為顯著，因為質子梯度的反向壓力會將電子經 Complex I 驅回而形成反向電子傳遞。

links.context: Electron leak at the FMN and ubiquinone sites makes Respiratory Chain Complex I a principal source of superoxide and Mitochondrial ROS; Complex I activity declines with age, contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction and Oxidative Stress.
links.context_zh_TW: 電子在 FMN 與 ubiquinone 位點的滲漏使 Respiratory Chain Complex I 成為超氧陰離子與 Mitochondrial ROS 的主要來源；Complex I 活性隨年齡下降，促成粒線體功能障礙與 Oxidative Stress。

links.context: Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy, also called electron spin resonance (ESR), is a technique that detects species bearing unpaired electrons — paramagnetic species including free radicals, transition metal ions and reactive oxygen species. It measures resonant absorption of microwave radiation by unpaired electrons in an external magnetic field.
links.context_zh_TW: 電子順磁共振（EPR）光譜，又稱電子自旋共振（ESR），是一種偵測帶有未成對電子的物種（順磁性物種）的技術，包括自由基、過渡金屬離子與活性氧物種；其原理是測量未成對電子在外加磁場中對微波輻射的共振吸收。

links.context: Elevated cytosolic calcium is the activating signal for scramblases: Ca2+ flips the membrane asymmetry balance — scramblase on, flippase off — and the activation is ATP-independent and bidirectional. Thus calcium signaling is the upstream trigger that scramblase translates into the eat-me signal read out by Annexin V.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣濃度升高是 scramblase 的活化訊號：Ca2+ 會翻轉膜不對稱性的平衡——scramblase 開啟、flippase 關閉——且此活化不依賴 ATP 且為雙向性。因此 calcium signaling 是上游觸發因子，而 scramblase 將其轉譯為由 Annexin V 讀出的 eat-me 訊號。

links.context: Elevated deoxycholic acid in obesity and high-fat-diet contexts promotes hepatocellular carcinoma through an indirect route: dysbiosis raises DCA, DCA senesces hepatic stellate cells, and the resulting SASP-driven inflammation (IL-1beta, COX-2/PGE2) via cGAS-STING creates a pro-tumorigenic microenvironment. Serum DCA is elevated in obese individuals and correlates with HCC risk.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肥胖與高脂飲食情境中升高的 deoxycholic acid 透過一條間接途徑促進 hepatocellular carcinoma：dysbiosis 升高 DCA，DCA 使 hepatic stellate cell 進入 senescence，隨後經 cGAS-STING 產生的 SASP 驅動發炎（IL-1β、COX-2/PGE2）營造促腫瘤的微環境。肥胖者的 serum DCA 升高並與 HCC 風險相關。

links.context: Elevated interferon-stimulated genes are a shared feature of mouse models, human patient tissue and disease-stressed glial cells across neurodegenerative conditions including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, FTD and ALS, and in AD they correlate with cognitive decline.
links.context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症、巴金森氏症、額顳葉失智症與肌萎縮性側索硬化症等神經退化疾病中，升高的干擾素刺激基因是小鼠模型、人體病患組織與受疾病壓力的膠細胞所共有的特徵；在 AD 中其與認知衰退相關。

links.context: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens is a human intestinal bacterium of the Eggerthellaceae family that metabolizes dietary Ellagic acid into Isourolithin A, an isomer of Urolithin A. Together with Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens it accounts for the conversion of ellagic acid into the urolithin metabolite class in the colon, determining which urolithin species is produced.
links.context_zh_TW: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 是 Eggerthellaceae 科的人類腸道菌，能將膳食中的 Ellagic acid 代謝為 Isourolithin A（Urolithin A 的異構物）。它與 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 共同負責在結腸中將 ellagic acid 轉為 urolithin 類代謝物，決定所產生的 urolithin 物種。

links.context: Ellagic acid released from ellagitannin hydrolysis is decarboxylated by gut microbiota to give the urolithin metabolite class. The resulting compounds exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging biological activities, so ellagic acid in the diet is an upstream determinant of urolithin exposure.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 Ellagitannin 水解釋出的 Ellagic acid 會被腸道菌群脫羧，形成 urolithin 代謝物類群。所得化合物具有抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗老化等生物活性，因此飲食中的 ellagic acid 是 urolithin 暴露量的上游決定因子。

links.context: Ellagitannins are hydrolyzable tannins abundant in pomegranates, strawberries, walnuts and almonds. They act as prebiotic precursors that the gut microbiota metabolizes in the colon, releasing Ellagic acid and ultimately generating urolithins such as Urolithin A, a metabolite associated with muscle health and performance.
links.context_zh_TW: Ellagitannins 是廣泛存在於石榴、草莓、核桃與杏仁中的可水解單寧。它們作為益生元前驅物，被腸道菌群在結腸中代謝，釋出 Ellagic acid，並最終生成 urolithin 類物質如與肌肉健康及表現相關的 Urolithin A。

links.context: Eltrombopag is a direct inhibitor of TFEB: it disrupts TFEB's interaction with DNA, preventing induction of autophagy genes and thereby blocking autophagic flux.
links.context_zh_TW: Eltrombopag 是 TFEB 的直接抑制劑：它破壞 TFEB 與 DNA 的交互作用，阻斷自噬基因的誘導，因而阻斷自噬流。

links.context: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
links.context_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

links.context: Embryonic stem cells are assayed via teratoma formation as gold-standard trilineage proof.
links.context_zh_TW: 胚胎幹細胞經由畸胎瘤形成測定，作為三胚層黃金標準證據。

links.context: EndoMT is a mechanism of age-related endothelial dysfunction: senescent endothelial cells lose CDH5 and PECAM1 and gain TGFB1 and ACTA2. Fisetin plasma prevented EndoMT by restoring endothelial markers (3.1-fold CDH5, 2-fold PECAM1) and suppressing mesenchymal markers (-88% TGFB1, -89% ACTA2).
links.context_zh_TW: EndoMT 是年齡相關內皮功能失調的一項機制：衰老內皮細胞失去 CDH5 與 PECAM1，並獲得 TGFB1 與 ACTA2。Fisetin 血漿可預防 EndoMT，方式是恢復內皮標記（CDH5 上升 3.1 倍、PECAM1 上升 2 倍）並抑制間質標記（TGFB1 下降 88%、ACTA2 下降 89%）。

links.context: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) is an ATP-dependent pathway that rebuilds Lysosome from endolysosomes after endocytic cargo has been degraded. It is distinct from Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, which regenerates lysosomes from autolysosomes after autophagic turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) 是一條 ATP 依賴途徑，在內吞負載物被分解後由 endolysosome 重建 Lysosome。它與 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 不同，後者是在自噬周轉之後由 autolysosome 再生 lysosome。

links.context: Endogenous inhibition of MMP-12 is provided by tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases, principally TIMP1 and TIMP2. The balance between MMP-12 and TIMP levels determines the net elastinolytic activity in tissues; when MMP-12 activity overwhelms alpha-1 antitrypsin capacity, alveolar elastin is degraded and airspace enlargement develops.
links.context_zh_TW: MMP-12 的內生性抑制由基質金屬蛋白酶組織抑制劑提供，主要是 TIMP1 與 TIMP2。組織中淨彈性蛋白水解活性取決於 MMP-12 與 TIMP 的平衡；當 MMP-12 活性超越 alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶的緩衝能力時，肺泡彈性蛋白被降解並出現氣腔擴大。

links.context: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
links.context_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

links.context: Endosomal TLR9 recognizes unmethylated CpG motifs. In senescent cells, low-grade apoptotic stress causes minority mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, releasing mtDNA containing unmethylated CpG islands into the cytosol; these act as DAMP signals that activate TLR9-p38 MAPK-NF-κB and drive the pro-inflammatory SASP. Circulating CpG-bearing mtDNA rises with age, linking CpG sensing to inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: 內體中的 TLR9 會辨識未甲基化的 CpG motif。在衰老細胞中，低程度的凋亡壓力造成 minority MOMP，使含有未甲基化 CpG Islands 的 mtDNA 釋放至細胞質；這些作為 DAMP 訊號啟動 TLR9-p38 MAPK-NF-κB 並推動促發炎 SASP。帶有 CpG 的循環 mtDNA 隨年齡上升，將 CpG 感知與 inflammaging 連結起來。

links.context: Endosymbiotic theory holds that an ancestral eukaryotic cell engulfed an aerobic alphaproteobacterium which became a permanent inherited endosymbiont, giving rise to the mitochondrion. Supporting evidence includes circular mitochondrial DNA, the double-membrane architecture, bacterial-style ribosomes and replication, and prokaryotic metabolic pathways such as the TCA cycle retained in the matrix.
links.context_zh_TW: 內共生學說認為，祖先真核細胞吞噬了好氧 α-變形菌，使其成為永久性、可遺傳的內共生體，進而產生了粒線體。支持證據包括環狀的粒線體 DNA、雙層膜構造、細菌式的核糖體與複製方式，以及基質中保留的 TCA 循環等原核代謝途徑。

links.context: Endothelial SIRT1 depletion is associated with cardiovascular diseases, reflecting SIRT1's vascular protective (eNOS/NO, anti-inflammatory) roles.
links.context_zh_TW: 內皮 SIRT1 缺乏與心血管疾病相關，反映了 SIRT1 的血管保護（eNOS/NO、抗發炎）功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Endothelial STING activation is deleterious to the blood-brain barrier: across models of irradiation, infection and intracerebral hemorrhage, it induces IFN-I signalling and pyroptosis, leading to barrier disruption and leukocyte infiltration, while activated ECs adopt a pro-inflammatory and pro-thrombotic phenotype. By contrast, microglial STING signalling appears protective, preserving hippocampal barrier integrity during aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 內皮 STING 的活化對血腦屏障有害：在照射、感染與腦內出血等模型中，它誘發 IFN-I 訊號與細胞焦亡，造成屏障破壞與白血球浸潤，活化的內皮細胞並轉為促發炎與促血栓表型。相對地，微膠細胞的 STING 訊號似乎是保護性的，能在老化期間維持海馬的屏障完整性。

links.context: Endothelium-dependent vasodilation runs through Nitric Oxide: shear stress and agonists activate endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) to produce NO, which diffuses to smooth muscle and activates Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase, raising cGMP, lowering intracellular calcium and driving relaxation. Nitrates, PDE5 Inhibitors and calcium-channel blockers exploit this pathway therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: 內皮依賴性的 vasodilation 透過 Nitric Oxide 進行：剪力與致效劑活化內皮 nitric oxide synthase（eNOS）產生 NO，NO 擴散至平滑肌並活化 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase，使 cGMP 上升、細胞內 calcium 下降而促成放鬆。Nitrates、PDE5 Inhibitors 與 calcium-channel blockers 即以此途徑作為治療機制。

links.context: Endurance training lowers UCP3 protein expression in type I, IIa and IIx muscle fibres, though acute exercise and training may differentially affect UCP3 mRNA. Training-induced down-regulation is a candidate explanation for why resting metabolic rate can fall after intensive training despite gains in lean mass, an interpretation that remains contested.
links.context_zh_TW: 耐力訓練會降低 type I、IIa 與 IIx 肌纖維中的 UCP3 蛋白表現，儘管急性運動與訓練可能對 UCP3 mRNA 有相反影響。訓練誘導的下調是「密集訓練後即使瘦體重增加、resting metabolic rate 仍可下降」的候選解釋，但此詮釋仍有爭議。

links.context: Energy balance is the equilibrium between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, which is partitioned into resting metabolic rate, the thermic effect of food and activity energy expenditure. It is regulated by interrelated adjustments of appetite, non-exercise activity thermogenesis and resting metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: 能量平衡是代謝可利用的能量攝取與能量消耗之間的均衡，後者可分為休息代謝率、食物熱效應與活動能量消耗。它由食慾、非運動性活動產熱與休息代謝之間的相互調整來調節。

links.context: Energy failure in MELAS tissues with high metabolic demand (brain, muscle) leads to secondary mitochondrial ROS generation and oxidative stress, contributing to the syndrome's neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: MELAS 中高代謝需求組織（腦、肌肉）的能量衰竭會導致次級的粒線體 ROS 生成與氧化壓力，促成該症候群的神經退化。

links.context: Enhancer-promoter looping is the physical folding that brings distal enhancers into proximity with target promoters. Senescence-activated super-enhancers are placed in contact with key SASP genes through EP looping, making 3D contact maps informative for predicting SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環化是使遠端增強子與目標啟動子靠近的物理摺疊。衰老活化的超級增強子（super-enhancer）透過 EP 環化與關鍵 SASP 基因接觸，使三維接觸圖譜對預測 SASP 具有資訊價值。

links.context: Entacapone belongs to the COMT inhibitor drug class, alongside tolcapone and opicapone. Its clinical role is as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa therapy in Parkinson's disease, where prolonging levodopa half-life reduces off time.
links.context_zh_TW: Entacapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑這一藥物類別，與 tolcapone、opicapone 同類。其臨床角色是作為 Parkinson's disease 中 levodopa/carbidopa 治療的輔助用藥，藉由延長 levodopa 半衰期減少 off time。

links.context: Entacapone is used clinically as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease. By inhibiting peripheral COMT it prolongs levodopa's half-life and reduces off time, without the central COMT inhibition that distinguishes tolcapone.
links.context_zh_TW: Entacapone 在臨床上作為 Parkinson's disease 中 levodopa 的輔助用藥。透過抑制周邊 COMT 延長 levodopa 半衰期並減少 off time，且不像 tolcapone 那樣抑制中央 COMT。

links.context: Enterocloster is a genus of anaerobic gut bacteria and thus a member of the Gut Microbiome. Which species are present determines which ellagitannin-to-urolithin conversion steps can occur, underpinning metabotype A, B, and 0 variability.
links.context_zh_TW: Enterocloster 是厭氧腸道菌的一個屬，因此是 Gut Microbiome（腸道菌群）的成員。存在哪些菌種決定了哪些 ellagitannin 轉為 urolithin 的步驟能夠發生，構成 metabotype A、B 與 0 變異的基礎。

links.context: Enzalutamide is approved for metastatic and non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Its efficacy is limited by acquired resistance through androgen receptor amplification, splice variants such as AR-V7, and bypass signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於轉移性與非轉移性去勢抵抗性 prostate cancer。其療效受限於後天抗藥性，包括 androgen receptor 擴增、AR-V7 等剪接變異體以及旁路訊號。

links.context: Enzymatically synthesized inulin nanoparticles (95.9–238.5 nm) encapsulate fisetin, increasing its solubility 3.6-fold over the free compound and showing higher DPPH antioxidant activity, with improved thermal stability at 70 °C.
links.context_zh_TW: 以酵素法合成的 inulin 奈米顆粒（95.9–238.5 nm）可包埋 fisetin，使其溶解度較游離型提升 3.6 倍，DPPH 抗氧化活性更高，且在 70 °C 下熱穩定性更佳。

links.context: Eosinophil Peroxidase requires Hydrogen Peroxide as its obligate co-substrate. Released from eosinophil specific granules during degranulation, the enzyme couples peroxide reduction to oxidation of bromide or pseudohalides, which is why H2O2 availability from the respiratory burst sets the limit on how much Hypobromous Acid the eosinophil can generate.
links.context_zh_TW: Eosinophil Peroxidase 需要 Hydrogen Peroxide 作為其必備的共同受質。該酵素於嗜酸性球脫顆粒時由特異顆粒釋放，將過氧化物的還原與 bromide 或 pseudohalide 的氧化偶聯；因此呼吸爆發所供應的 H2O2 多寡，決定了嗜酸性球能產生多少 Hypobromous Acid。

links.context: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
links.context_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Epicatechin, a polyphenolic flavonoid of green tea and cocoa, acts as a potent breaker of Advanced Glycation End Products. Its nucleophilic carbons at C6 and C8 of the A-ring attack and cleave the side chains of AGE structures, destroying preformed protein cross-links such as those in glycated Serum albumin. It also inhibits formation of new AGEs, decreases AGE accumulation in retinal tissue, and neutralizes Reactive Oxygen Species.
links.context_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是綠茶與可可中的多酚類黃酮，是 Advanced Glycation End Products 的強效裂解劑。其 A 環 C6 與 C8 位置的親核碳會進攻並切斷 AGE 結構的側鏈，破壞如糖化 Serum albumin 中既有的蛋白質交聯。它同時抑制新 AGE 的形成、減少視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積，並中和 Reactive Oxygen Species。

links.context: Epigenetic clocks (for example the Horvath clock) use algorithms that analyze DNA Methylation at specific CpG sites to estimate an individual's biological age. When epigenetic age exceeds chronological age, termed epigenetic age acceleration, the subject carries higher risk for Cancer, Cardiovascular Disease, and Neurodegenerative Diseases.
links.context_zh_TW: Epigenetic clock（例如 Horvath clock）使用演算法分析特定 CpG 位點的 DNA Methylation，以估算個人的生物年齡。當表觀遺傳年齡高於實際年齡（即表觀遺傳年齡加速）時，個體在 Cancer、Cardiovascular Disease 與 Neurodegenerative Diseases 上的風險較高。

links.context: Epigenetic clocks are the operational estimator of biological age.
links.context_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的操作性估計器。

links.context: Epinephrine 1 mg IV/IO every 3-5 minutes is standard therapy in cardiac arrest resuscitation. Its alpha-adrenergic vasoconstrictor effect augments aortic diastolic pressure and improves coronary and cerebral perfusion during chest compressions, raising ROSC rates — but despite this, no controlled trial has demonstrated improved survival with favourable neurological outcome, and beta-adrenergic effects may worsen myocardial stunning.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiac arrest 復甦中，每 3–5 分鐘靜脈或骨內給予 Epinephrine 1 mg 是標準治療。其 α-腎上腺素性血管收縮作用提高主動脈舒張壓，在胸外按壓期間改善冠狀動脈與腦部灌流，提升 ROSC 率——但儘管如此，沒有任何對照試驗證明可改善具良好神經結局的存活率，且 β-腎上腺素作用可能加重心肌 stunning。

links.context: Epinephrine is a catecholamine and neurotransmitter produced by the adrenal glands and certain neurons, central to the fight-or-flight response: it raises heart rate and blood pressure, constricts blood vessels and dilates air passages. Norepinephrine is its precursor.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 是由腎上腺與某些神經元產生的兒茶酚胺類神經傳遞物質，是 fight-or-flight 反应的樞紐：它提高心率與血壓、收縮血管並擴張氣道。Norepinephrine 則是其前驅物。

links.context: Epinephrine is a catecholamine built from a benzene ring carrying two hydroxyl groups (a catechol) plus an amine side chain. Under oxidative stress, or simply in the presence of oxygen in a test tube, the two hydroxyl groups lose hydrogen atoms or electrons, transforming the stable catechol ring into a highly reactive o-quinone. This oxidation is the trigger of the entire adrenochrome pathway: the o-quinone intermediate is electron-poor and unstable, and it immediately seeks stabilization by cyclization. Because no enzyme is needed for the oxidation step, epinephrine can autoxidize spontaneously in vitro, and in vivo the reaction becomes significant only when antioxidant defenses are overwhelmed. The catechol-to-quinone conversion is the same chemistry that underpins the oxidation of dopamine and other catecholamines.
links.context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素是一種兒茶酚胺，由帶有兩個羥基（兒茶酚）的苯環和胺側鏈構成。在氧化應激下，或僅在試管中存在氧氣時，兩個羥基失去氫原子或電子，將穩定的兒茶酚環轉化為高反應性的鄰苯醌。這種氧化是整個 adrenochrome 途徑的觸發因素：鄰苯醌中間體缺電子且不穩定，它立即通過環化尋求穩定。由於氧化步驟不需要酶，腎上腺素可以在體外自發 autoxidize，而在體內只有當抗氧化防禦被壓倒時反應才變得顯著。兒茶酚到醌的轉化是支撐多巴胺和其他兒茶酚胺氧化的相同化學反應。

links.context: Epinephrine is a catecholamine whose levels are controlled by two main degradation routes, COMT and monoamine oxidase. Inhibiting these pathways raises epinephrine levels and shifts its metabolism toward adrenochrome formation, which is why COMT inhibitors such as fisetin raise a mechanistic concern about catecholamine excess under oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 是兒茶酚胺，其濃度主要由 COMT 與 monoamine oxidase 兩條降解路徑控制。抑制這些路徑會使 epinephrine 濃度上升，並使其代謝轉向 adrenochrome 形成；因此 fisetin 等 COMT 抑制劑在 oxidative stress 下引發兒茶酚胺過量的疑慮屬於機轉性考量。

links.context: Epinephrine is most stable in an acidic environment, which is why pharmaceutical adrenaline used in emergency injectors is stored in slightly acidic solution. In acidic solutions the hydroxyl groups on the catechol ring are protonated, making it much harder for oxygen to steal electrons and thereby greatly slowing the oxidation that initiates the adrenochrome pathway. pH is described as the most important factor controlling the cyclization reaction because the reaction depends on chemical oxidation and is highly sensitive to environment. This pH dependence explains both the formulation chemistry of epinephrine products and the broader principle that tissue acid-base status may modulate how readily catecholamines undergo oxidative transformation in vivo, with more alkaline conditions favoring oxidation to quinones and downstream adrenochrome formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 在酸性環境中最為穩定，這也是為什麼急救注射器中使用的藥用 adrenaline 儲存於微酸性溶液中。在酸性溶液中，兒茶酚環上的羥基被質子化，使氧氣更難奪取電子，從而大幅減緩啟動 adrenochrome 途徑的氧化。pH 值被描述為控制環化反應最重要的因素，因為反應依賴化學氧化且對環境高度敏感。這種 pH 依賴性同時解釋了 epinephrine 產品的配方化學，以及更廣泛的原則：組織酸鹼狀態可能調節兒茶酚胺在體內發生氧化轉化的容易程度，鹼性越強的條件越有利於氧化成醌及下游 adrenochrome 的形成。

links.context: Epinephrine solutions oxidize to adrenochrome and adrenolutin on light or heat exposure, so autoinjectors must be protected from light and heat: degraded product loses potency precisely when it is needed most, making redox stability a genuine patient-safety issue.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 溶液在光照或加熱下會氧化為 Adrenochrome 與 Adrenolutin，因此自動注射器必須避光避熱：降解產物恰好在最需要時失去效力，使氧化還原穩定性成為真正的病人安全問題。

links.context: Epinephrine, like norepinephrine, is an endogenous agonist of beta-adrenergic receptors, engaging beta3 receptors in adipose tissue to stimulate lipolysis and thermogenesis — the basis for beta3-agonist research in obesity.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 與 norepinephrine 相同，都是 beta-adrenergic receptor 的內源性致效劑，可作用於脂肪組織的 beta3 受體以刺激脂解與產熱，這也是 beta3 致效劑用於肥胖研究的基础。

links.context: Epinephrine, like other catecholamines, is unusually prone to autoxidation in open air and at physiological or alkaline pH. The free-radical chain reaction proceeds through adrenaline-quinone and leuco-adrenochrome intermediates, and the rate rises roughly ten-fold per unit increase in pH above 7.0 because the catecholate anion is far more easily oxidized.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 與其他兒茶酚胺一樣，在空氣中以及生理或鹼性 pH 下特別容易發生 autoxidation。這個自由基鏈反應經由 Adrenaline-quinone 與 Leuco-adrenochrome 中間物進行；pH 高於 7.0 時，每上升一個 pH 單位反應速率約提高十倍，因為 catecholate 陰離子更易被氧化。

links.context: Epithelial cells are joined by tight junctions, adherens junctions, desmosomes and gap junctions that seal a barrier on a basement membrane with apical-basal polarity. Acquisition of migratory, invasive behaviour through epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition is what underpins metastasis from carcinomas of epithelial origin.
links.context_zh_TW: Epithelial cells 透過 tight junction、adherens junction、desmosome 與 gap junction 相互連結，在 basement membrane 上以 apical-basal 極性形成屏障。正是經由 epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition 獲得移行與侵襲能力，使上皮來源的 carcinoma 能發生 metastasis。

links.context: Epstein-Barr virus infects more than 90% of the adult human population and establishes lifelong latency in B Cells. Entry is mediated by the glycoproteins gp350, gB and gH/gL acting on CD21 and HLA class II, and the virus maintains three latency programs expressing EBNA1, EBNA2, LMP1, LMP2A and EBERs, with LMP1 mimicking a constitutively active CD40 receptor.
links.context_zh_TW: Epstein-Barr virus 感染超過九成以上的成人族群，並在 B Cells 中建立終生性 latency。病毒以 gp350、gB 與 gH/gL 作用於 CD21 與 HLA class II 進入細胞，並維持三種 latency 程式，表現 EBNA1、EBNA2、LMP1、LMP2A 與 EBERs；其中 LMP1 的作用類似持續活化的 CD40 receptor。

links.context: Erastin and sulfasalazine (an approved drug) inhibit xCT, collapsing cystine import and setting in motion glutathione depletion, GPX4 failure and lipid peroxidation. Combining xCT blockade with GPX4 inhibition or iron loading is therefore a rational ferroptosis-inducing combination in oncology, and xCT abundance is a predictive biomarker for response to system Xc- inhibitors.
links.context_zh_TW: Erastin 與 sulfasalazine（已核准藥物）抑制 xCT，使胱胺輸入崩潰，啟動麩胱甘肽耗竭、GPX4 失效與脂質過氧化。因此將 xCT 阻斷與 GPX4 抑制或鐵負荷結合，是腫瘤學上合理的誘發鐵死亡組合，而 xCT 豐度也是預測 system Xc- 抑制劑反應的生物標記。

links.context: Erastin disables GPX4 indirectly rather than by covalent binding: cystine import blockade collapses glutathione, and without GSH as cofactor GPX4 cannot reduce phospholipid hydroperoxides. Pairing erastin with RSL3, a direct GPX4 inhibitor, is the standard way to separate the upstream and downstream nodes of the ferroptotic cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: Erastin 並非藉由共價結合，而是間接使 GPX4 失效：阻斷半胱胺酸輸入使 glutathione 崩解，缺乏 GSH 作為輔因子時 GPX4 無法還原磷脂質過氧化物。將 erastin 與直接抑制 GPX4 的 RSL3 搭配，是分離 ferroptosis 級聯上游與下游節點的標準做法。

links.context: Errors during Meiosis — most importantly nondisjunction of homologous chromosomes in Meiosis I or of Sister Chromatids in Meiosis II — produce gametes with abnormal chromosome numbers, i.e. Aneuploidy. Aneuploid gametes arising this way are the direct cause of conditions such as Down Syndrome (trisomy 21) after fertilization.
links.context_zh_TW: Meiosis 過程中的錯誤——最重要的是第一次分裂中同源染色體的不分離，或第二次分裂中 Sister Chromatids 的不分離——會產生染色體數目異常的配子，也就是 Aneuploidy。此類由減數分裂錯誤產生的非整倍體配子，是受精後造成如 Down Syndrome（三染色體 21）這類疾病的直接原因。

links.context: Eryptosis is the calcium-dependent regulated death of mature erythrocytes, involving calpain/scramblase activation, phosphatidylserine exposure, and loss of CD47-SIRPalpha, cleared silently by splenic red-pulp macrophages. It is morphologically apoptosis-like but caspase-independent, which is why it must be excluded from apoptosis counts. Since erythrocyte production and clearance runs near 200 billion cells per day, eryptosis rather than apoptosis dominates raw whole-body turnover of roughly 330 billion cells per day.
links.context_zh_TW: Eryptosis 是成熟紅血球的鈣離子依賴性受調控死亡，涉及 calpain/scramblase 活化、phosphatidylserine 暴露與 CD47–SIRPalpha 喪失，並由脾臟紅髓巨噬細胞無聲清除。它在形態上類似 apoptosis 卻不依賴 caspase，因此必須從 apoptosis 計數中排除。由於紅血球的生成與清除約達每日 2000 億個細胞，因此在每日約 3300 億個細胞的整體更新中，主導者是 eryptosis 而非 apoptosis。

links.context: Eryptosis is triggered by convergence on cytosolic calcium elevation from oxidative stress, osmotic shock, energy depletion that impairs calcium extrusion, and ceramide accumulation. Calcium then activates calpain proteases and phospholipid scramblases while inhibiting flippases, externalizing phosphatidylserine as the Annexin V-positive eat-me signal, with cell shrinkage and membrane blebbing.
links.context_zh_TW: Eryptosis 的誘發因子包括 oxidative stress、滲透壓衝擊、耗損 ATP 導致鈣外排能力下降，以及 Ceramide 累積，它們都匯聚於細胞質鈣離子上升。鈣離子接著活化 calpain 蛋白酶與 phospholipid scramblase 並抑制 flipase，將 phosphatidylserine 外翻形成 Annexin V 陽性的 eat-me 訊號，並伴隨細胞縮小與膜起泡。

links.context: Erythrocytes are the principal oxygen-delivering blood cells and are unusually exposed to Oxidative Stress, being subject both to autoxidation of Hemoglobin and to circulating catecholamine metabolites such as Adrenochrome. Because mature red cells lack nuclei and mitochondria they cannot repair oxidized protein, so this oxidative burden drives Hemolysis and Methemoglobinemia, with the latter evident as cyanosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Erythrocytes 是主要的運送氧氣的血球，特別暴露於 Oxidative Stress：既承受 Hemoglobin 的自氧化，也接觸 Adrenochrome 等循環中的兒茶酚胺代謝物。由於成熟紅血球缺乏細胞核與粒線體，無法修復被氧化的蛋白質，這份氧化負擔會導致 Hemolysis 與 Methemoglobinemia，後者表現為發紺。

links.context: Erythroid mitophagy removes mitochondria completely, leaving mature mammalian erythrocytes dependent solely on glycolysis for ATP. Physiological consequences include maximized oxygen delivery, prevention of ROS damage in the circulation, and the deformability needed to pass through narrow capillaries.
links.context_zh_TW: 紅系粒線體自噬將粒線體完全清除，使成熟哺乳類紅血球的全套 ATP 完全仰賴糖解作用。其生理後果包括最大化氧氣輸送、避免循環中的 ROS 傷害，以及通過狹窄微血管所需的變形能力。

links.context: Erβ (estrogen receptor β, encoded by ESR2) signaling upregulates SIRT1 expression and activity, coupling estrogen signaling to NAD+-dependent deacetylation, mitochondrial function, and neuroprotection. Estrogen-replacement models show increased SIRT1 levels and reduced oxidative damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Erβ（estrogen receptor β，由 ESR2 編碼）的訊號傳遞會上調 SIRT1 的表現與活性，將 estrogen 訊號與 NAD+ 依賴型的去乙醯化、粒線體功能及神經保護相連結。Estrogen 替代模型顯示 SIRT1 濃度上升與氧化傷害減少。

links.context: Erβ is one of the two nuclear estrogen receptor subtypes, along with ERα. It is a ligand-activated nuclear receptor that, upon estrogen binding, dimerizes and regulates transcription of target genes through estrogen response elements, while also engaging non-genomic signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Erβ 是兩種核內 estrogen receptor 次型之一，另一種為 ERα。它是配體活化的核受體，在結合 estrogen 後二聚化，透過 estrogen response elements 調控標的基因的轉錄，同時也參與非基因體訊號傳遞。

links.context: Established in 1987, the Mectizan Donation Program manages Merck & Co. Inc's donation of Mectizan (brand-name ivermectin) free of charge, handling logistics, distribution and pharmacovigilance with endemic-country ministries of health, the World Health Organization and non-governmental partners. It became the template for large-scale philanthropic drug donation and a cornerstone of neglected-tropical-disease elimination.
links.context_zh_TW: Mectizan Donation Program 成立於 1987 年，負責管理 Merck & Co. Inc 免費捐贈的 Mectizan（ivermectin 的商品名），並與流行國衛生部門、World Health Organization 及非政府夥伴共同處理後勤、分發與藥物警戒。它成為大規模慈善藥品捐贈的典範，也是 neglected tropical disease 根除計畫的基石。

links.context: Estrogen binding activates Erβ, which then dimerizes and regulates target gene transcription, mediating many physiological actions of estrogen in the brain, vasculature, and metabolic tissues. Erβ is expressed in the hippocampus, cortex, vascular endothelium, and reproductive tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Estrogen 的結合會活化 Erβ，後者隨即二聚化並調控標的基因轉錄，介導 estrogen 在腦部、血管與代謝組織中的多項生理作用。Erβ 表現於 hippocampus、cortex、血管內皮與生殖組織。

links.context: Estrogen receptor drives luminal breast cancer and its expression guides endocrine therapy. Flavonoids such as apigenin show biphasic estrogenic/anti-estrogenic activity via ER-binding-dependent and -independent mechanisms, with apigenin exerting anti-estrogenic effects in breast cancer cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 雌激素受體驅動管腔型乳癌，其表現指引內分泌治療。諸如 apigenin 等黃酮類透過 ER 結合依賴與非依賴機制表現雙相雌激素/抗雌激素活性，apigenin 在乳癌細胞中發揮抗雌激素作用。

links.context: Estrogen receptor signaling drives MBOAT1 transcription; MBOAT1 remodels phospholipids toward PE-MUFA, suppressing ferroptosis independently of GPX4/FSP1 — the female remodeling gate.
links.context_zh_TW: Estrogen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT1 轉錄；MBOAT1 將磷脂重塑為 PE-MUFA，以 GPX4/FSP1 非依賴方式抑制 ferroptosis——即雌性重塑閘門。

links.context: Estrogen receptor β (Erβ) signaling upregulates SIRT1 expression and activity, linking estrogens to SIRT1-mediated metabolic and neuroprotective programs; estrogen-replacement models show increased SIRT1 levels and reduced oxidative damage (source review Table 3 lists Erβ as a positive SIRT1 regulator).
links.context_zh_TW: 雌激素受體 β（Erβ）信號上調 SIRT1 的表達和活性，將雌激素與 SIRT1 介導的代謝和神經保護程序聯繫起來；雌激素替代模型顯示 SIRT1 水平增加和氧化損傷減少（文獻綜述表 3 將 Erβ 列為 SIRT1 的正向調節因子）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Etoposide (VP-16) is a topoisomerase inhibitor that forms a ternary complex with DNA and topoisomerase II, preventing re-ligation of DNA strands. The resulting accumulation of DNA double-strand breaks triggers cell cycle arrest and apoptosis, and it is classified among DNA-damaging agents that can also induce cellular senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Etoposide（VP-16）是 topoisomerase 抑制劑，與 DNA 及 topoisomerase II 形成三複合物，阻止 DNA 股的再接合。所造成的 DNA 雙股斷裂累積會引發細胞週期停滯與 apoptosis；它也被歸類為可誘發細胞 senescence 的 DNA 損傷類藥物。

links.context: Etoposide, a topoisomerase II poison causing genotoxic stress, induces therapy-induced senescence by generating DNA breaks that engage the DNA damage response and the arrest program. It is widely used experimentally to trigger TIS, and the senescence it provokes includes persistent DNA damage foci and a robust SASP. These persistent damage foci (DNA-SCARS) sustain DDR signaling and can give rise to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments that feed cGAS-STING. Its utility highlights genotoxic stress as a universal TIS trigger.
links.context_zh_TW: Etoposide 是一種引起基因毒性壓力的拓撲異構酶 II 毒劑，透過產生接合 DNA 損傷反應與停滯程序的 DNA 斷裂，誘發治療誘發衰老。它在實驗上廣泛用於觸發 TIS，其引發的衰老包含持續 DNA 損傷灶與強健 SASP。這些持續損傷灶（DNA-SCARS）維持 DDR 訊號，並可產生滋養 cGAS-STING 的胞質染色質片段。其效用凸顯基因毒性壓力是普遍的 TIS 觸發因子。

links.context: Euchromatin's open structure and acetylated histones keep DNA accessible, enabling transcription. Its formation and maintenance are regulated by histone acetyltransferases, which add acetyl groups, and histone deacetylases, which remove them.
links.context_zh_TW: Euchromatin 開放的結構與乙醯化的 histone 使 DNA 保持可接近，因而容許 transcription。其形成與維持由 histone acetyltransferase（加上乙醯基）與 histone deacetylase（移除乙醯基）調控。

links.context: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption (EPOC) is the sustained elevation of metabolic rate above resting levels after a bout of physical activity, and it is the acute route by which physical activity raises resting metabolic rate. It decays biphasically, with half-lives of roughly 1 h and 13 h, so training studies that do not let the long phase resolve can confound long-term RMR measurements.
links.context_zh_TW: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption（EPOC）是運動後代謝率持續高於休息水準的現象，也是身體活動提升 resting metabolic rate 的急性途徑。它以雙相方式衰減，半衰期約為 1 小時與 13 小時，因此未讓長時相衰減完畢的訓練研究可能混淆長期的 RMR 量測。

links.context: Excess catecholamines, whether from emotional or physiological stress, pheochromocytoma or exogenous infusion, produce well-characterised cardiotoxicity through three mechanisms: Ca2+ overload from sustained beta-adrenergic drive and RyR2-mediated SR leak, ROS generation that impairs mitochondrial respiration and triggers apoptosis and necrosis, and contraction band necrosis as the histopathological hallmark.
links.context_zh_TW: 過量的 Catecholamines——不論來自情緒或生理壓力、Pheochromocytoma 或外源性輸注——透過三種機制產生明確的 Cardiotoxicity：持續 β-腎上腺素刺激與 RyR2 介導的肌漿網漏鈣所造成的 Ca2+ 過載；損害粒線體呼吸並誘發 Apoptosis 與 Necrosis 的 ROS 生成；以及作為組織病理學特徵的收縮帶壞死。

links.context: Excess glutamate overactivates ionotropic receptors, causing sustained calcium influx; the resulting calcium overload stresses mitochondria and drives reactive oxygen species generation, activating proteases that damage neurons. This cascade is a core mechanism in Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and stroke injury, and is why NAD+-dependent resilience and sirtuins buffer downstream mitochondrial failure.
links.context_zh_TW: 過量的 glutamate 會使離子型受體過度活化，造成持續的鈣離子流入；隨之而來的鈣超載會壓迫粒線體並驅動活性氧生成，活化損傷神經元的蛋白酶。此級聯反應是巴金森氏症、阿茲海默症與腦中風損傷的核心機制，也正是 NAD+ 依賴性的復原力與 sirtuins 能緩衝下游粒線體失效的原因。

links.context: Excess or dysfunctional Adipose Tissue drives Obesity, chronic low-grade inflammation, Insulin Resistance, and Metabolic Syndrome. Hypertrophic adipocytes recruit inflammatory Macrophages and secrete pro-inflammatory adipokines, linking adiposity to Diabetes Mellitus and cardiovascular disease, while AMPK governs adipocyte lipolysis and lipogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 過量或功能失調的 Adipose Tissue 會促成 Obesity、慢性低度發炎、Insulin Resistance 與 Metabolic Syndrome。肥大的脂肪細胞會招募發炎性 Macrophages 並分泌促發炎 adipokine，將肥胖與 Diabetes Mellitus 及心血管疾病連結；同時 AMPK 調控脂肪細胞的脂解與脂新生。

links.context: Excess or miscompartmentalized iron promotes oxidative stress through Fenton chemistry, generating damaging hydroxyl radicals. Iron-driven ROS damages lipids, proteins, and DNA, contributing to neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 過量或區室化錯誤的鐵透過芬頓化學促進氧化壓力，產生破壞性的羥基自由基。鐵驅動的 ROS 損害脂質、蛋白質與 DNA，促成帕金森氏症的神經退化。

links.context: Excessive activation of the mTORC1 pathway leads to impaired proliferation and differentiation of stem cells, promoting their aging and apoptosis. Rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 can restore stem cell functionality and improve tissue regeneration, as demonstrated in animal models where it increased myogenic and chondrogenic differentiation of muscle cells and improved mesenchymal cell function in Klotho-deficient mice. The mechanism is mainly associated with activation of autophagy, which cleanses cells of damaged structures and increases their survival and resistance to stress, and rapamycin also induces growth factors such as IGF1 and VEGF.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1通路的過度激活導致幹細胞增殖和分化受損，促進其老化和凋亡。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑製可以恢復幹細胞功能並改善組織再生，這在動物模型中得到證實，其中它增加了肌肉細胞的肌源性和軟骨源性分化，並改善了Klotho缺陷小鼠的間充質細胞功能。該機制主要與自噬激活有關，自噬清除細胞中的損傷結構並增加其存活和對壓力的抵抗力，rapamycin還誘導生長因子如IGF1和VEGF。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

links.context: Excessive cytokine- and NO-driven vasodilation produces refractory hypotension in Vasoplegic Shock and Septic Shock. Inducible nitric oxide synthase generates massive Nitric Oxide, overactivating the guanylyl cyclase cascade beyond the point where vascular smooth muscle can respond.
links.context_zh_TW: 過度、由 cytokine 與 NO 驅動的 vasodilation 會在 Vasoplegic Shock 與 Septic Shock 中造成 refractory hypotension。Inducible nitric oxide synthase 製造大量 Nitric Oxide，使 guanylyl cyclase 級聯過度活化，超出血管平滑肌可回應的範圍。

links.context: Excessive mTORC1 activation impairs proliferation and differentiation of stem cells, promoting their aging and apoptosis. The effect is reversed by Rapamycin, which restores stem cell functionality by activating Autophagy, reducing Inflammation and oxidative stress, and inducing growth factors such as IGF1 and VEGF — improving myogenic/chondrogenic differentiation, mesenchymal function in Klotho-deficient mice, and survival of transplanted stem cells after myocardial infarction.
links.context_zh_TW: 過度 mTORC1 活化會損害 stem cell 的增殖與分化，促進其老化與 apoptosis。此效應可被 Rapamycin 逆轉：Rapamycin 藉活化 Autophagy、降低 Inflammation 與 oxidative stress，並誘導 IGF1、VEGF 等生長因子來恢復幹細胞功能——改善成肌/成軟骨分化、Klotho 缺乏小鼠的間質細胞功能，以及心肌梗塞後移植幹細胞的存活。

links.context: Exchange transfusion replaces a patient's blood with donor blood and serves as a treatment of last resort for severe or refractory Methemoglobinemia, used when Methylene blue has failed or is contraindicated. Ascorbic acid is another alternative or adjunct, and hyperbaric oxygen may be used in severe or refractory cases, so the procedure sits at the end of the treatment hierarchy rather than first line.
links.context_zh_TW: Exchange transfusion 以捐贈者的血液置換病人血液，是重度或難治性 Methemoglobinemia 的最後手段治療，用於 Methylene blue 失敗或屬禁忌時。Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）為其他替代或輔助選項，嚴重或難治病例亦可使用高壓氧，因此此程序位於治療階層末端而非第一線。

links.context: Excitotoxicity is neuronal injury in which overactivation of excitatory glutamate signalling on ionotropic receptors causes sustained calcium entry. Intracellular calcium overload activates calpains, phospholipases and endonucleases and drives massive reactive oxygen species production, and the resulting oxidative and energetic crisis engages apoptosis and necrotic death.
links.context_zh_TW: Excitotoxicity 是興奮性 glutamate 訊號在 ionotropic receptor 上過度活化所造成的神經元損傷，會導致持續的鈣離子流入。細胞內鈣離子過載活化 calpain、phospholipase 與 endonuclease，並大量產生 reactive oxygen species，隨後的氧化與能量危機啟動 apoptosis 與壞死性死亡。

links.context: Exercise Hormesis is driven by Mitochondrial ROS rather than by damage: the transient ROS pulse is the signal that switches on NF-kB, SIRT1, PGC-1alpha, AMPK and NRF2 and hence the adaptive program.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise Hormesis 由 Mitochondrial ROS 而非損傷驅動：短暫的 ROS 脈衝即是訊號，啟動 NF-κB、SIRT1、PGC-1α、AMPK 與 NRF2，進而啟動適應方案。

links.context: Exercise induces PGC-1α in skeletal muscle, which drives FNDC5 transcription; FNDC5 expression therefore rises with physical activity, upstream of Irisin secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: 運動會在骨骼肌中誘導 PGC-1α，進而驅動 FNDC5 的轉錄；因此 FNDC5 的表現量隨身體活動上升，並位於 Irisin 分泌的上游。

links.context: Exercise induces mitohormesis: hormetic reactive oxygen species signalling that upregulates NRF2 and superoxide dismutase. This is a central reason exercise counts as one of the most effective interventions for extending healthspan and attenuating age-related decline.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise 會誘發 mitohormesis：即 hormetic 的 reactive oxygen species 訊號，進而上調 NRF2 與 superoxide dismutase。這也是 exercise 被視為延長 healthspan 與減緩老化相關衰退最有效介入手段之一的核心原因。

links.context: Exercise promotes adult neurogenesis through BDNF upregulation, linking physical activity to cognitive health. It also improves insulin sensitivity and cardiovascular health, and regular exercise is associated with reduced all-cause mortality and extended healthspan.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise 透過 BDNF 上调促進成人 neurogenesis，將身體活動與認知健康連結起來。它也改善 insulin sensitivity 與心血管健康，而规律運動與全因死亡率下降及 healthspan 延長相關。

links.context: Exercise raises NAD+ levels and activates SIRT1, SIRT3 and SIRT6 in skeletal muscle, heart and brain. SIRT1 together with PGC-1alpha mediates exercise-induced mitochondrial biogenesis and improved insulin sensitivity, autophagy is promoted in a SIRT1-dependent manner, and BDNF induction underlying neurogenesis is partly SIRT1-dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise 提高 NAD+ 濃度並在骨骼肌、心臟與腦部活化 SIRT1、SIRT3 與 SIRT6。SIRT1 與 PGC-1alpha 共同媒介運動引發的 mitochondrial biogenesis 與 insulin sensitivity 改善；autophagy 以 SIRT1 依賴方式被促進；作為 neurogenesis 基礎的 BDNF 誘導也部分依賴 SIRT1。

links.context: Exercise raises both BDNF and NAD+ levels, and SIRT1 may mediate exercise-induced BDNF upregulation in the hippocampus. Similarly, caloric restriction and intermittent fasting elevate BDNF through SIRT1/FoxO-dependent pathways, contributing to cognitive resilience against aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 運動提高 BDNF 和 NAD+ 水平，SIRT1 可能介導運動誘導的海馬體 BDNF 上調。同樣地，熱量限制和間歇性禁食透過 SIRT1/FoxO 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF，有助於對抗衰老的認知韌性。

links.context: Exercise stimulates mitophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis via PGC-1alpha, and SIRT3 upregulation in muscle is required for the full metabolic benefits of training, including enhanced oxidative phosphorylation and reduced reactive oxygen species. Lifestyle and nutrition, especially exercise, enhance the autophagy pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise 透過 PGC-1alpha 刺激 mitophagy 與 mitochondrial biogenesis，而肌肉中 SIRT3 的上调是訓練完整代謝效益所必需，包括提升 oxidative phosphorylation 與降低 reactive oxygen species。生活方式與營養，尤其是 exercise，會強化 autophagy 路徑。

links.context: Exercise-generated ROS act as the signalling trigger for mitochondrial biogenesis through the AMPK-PGC-1α axis, with SOD, catalase and GPx induction as effectors. This is the domain's strongest hormetic case, which is why co-supplementing antioxidants around workouts blunts the mROS to AMPK to PGC-1α cascade that the adaptation depends on.
links.context_zh_TW: 運動產生的 ROS 會透過 AMPK-PGC-1α 軸作為粒線體生物發生的訊號觸發，並以 SOD、catalase 與 GPx 的誘導作為效應者。這是該領域最強的 hormetic 案例，也因此在運動前後補充抗氧化劑會削弱適應所依賴的 mROS → AMPK → PGC-1α 級聯。

links.context: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
links.context_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

links.context: Exogenous antioxidants suppress the very ROS signal that would trigger the cell's own NRF2 → antioxidant response element cascade, which induces NQO1, HO-1, glutathione S-transferase, catalase and SOD2. This endogenous system yields 10–100× more antioxidant capacity than dietary supplementation, so the supplements flatten the signal without replacing the response. Sulforaphane and curcumin work better precisely because they are mild stressors that activate NRF2 via Keap1.
links.context_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑會抑制原本能觸發細胞自身 NRF2 → 抗氧化反應元件（ARE）級聯的 ROS 訊號，而該級聯會誘導 NQO1、HO-1、glutathione S-transferase、catalase 與 SOD2。這套內源性系統可提供比膳食補充多 10–100 倍的抗氧化容量，因此補充劑只是壓平訊號而無法取代反應。Sulforaphane 與 curcumin 之所以更有效，正是因為它們是經由 Keap1 活化 NRF2 的輕度壓力源。

links.context: Exogenous nicotinamide riboside (NR) promotes Sir2-dependent repression of recombination, improves gene silencing, and extends lifespan in yeast without calorie restriction, in the same manner as calorie restriction, which increases NAD+ levels and Sir2 function. The mechanism of action of NR in yeast is completely dependent on increased net NAD+ synthesis through the Nrk1 and the Urh1/Pnp1/4 pathways. A one-day fast increases NAD+ in the liver, and calorie restriction elevates NAD+ while reducing nicotinamide in the brain, implying that increased NAD+ mediates several beneficial effects of calorie restriction.
links.context_zh_TW: 外源性 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）促進 Sir2 依賴性的重組抑制、改善基因靜默，並在酵母中無須熱量限制即延長壽命，其方式與熱量限制相同，後者會提升 NAD+ 水平與 Sir2 功能。NR 在酵母中的作用機制完全依賴於透過 Nrk1 與 Urh1/Pnp1/4 路徑增加的淨 NAD+ 合成。一天的禁食會提升肝臟中的 NAD+，而熱量限制則提升 NAD+ 同時降低腦中的 nicotinamide，暗示 NAD+ 增加介導了熱量限制的數種有益效果。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Exportin-5 is a RanGTP-dependent nuclear export receptor that transports precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) hairpins from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. There the pre-miRNA is matured by Dicer and loaded onto Argonaute in the RISC.
links.context_zh_TW: Exportin-5 是 RanGTP 依賴的核輸出受體，將 microRNA 前驅物（pre-miRNA）髮夾從細胞核運送至細胞質。在那裡 pre-miRNA 由 Dicer 成熟並裝載到 RISC 中的 Argonaute。

links.context: Exposure of PHB2 upon outer membrane rupture provides a damage-threshold sensor: it acts as a mitophagy receptor enabling Parkin-independent mitophagy when the damage is severe enough to compromise the outer membrane.
links.context_zh_TW: 外膜破裂使 PHB2 暴露，提供一個損傷閾值感測器：它作為自噬受體，在損傷嚴重到破壞外膜時促成 Parkin 非依賴性的粒線體自噬。

links.context: Expression of MPC1 and MPC2 is increased across multiple senescence models, including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Because MPC-dependent pyruvate import feeds the TCA cycle and the citrate-acetyl-CoA axis (SLC25A1, ACLY) that supplies histone acetylation at SASP loci, MPC sits upstream of the SASP programme.
links.context_zh_TW: 在多種衰老模型中（包括輻射誘發、多柔比星誘發與複製性衰老），MPC1 與 MPC2 的表現皆上升。由於 MPC 依賴的丙酮酸輸入供養 TCA 循環，以及供應 SASP 位點組蛋白乙醯化的檸檬酸—乙醯輔酶 A 軸（SLC25A1、ACLY），MPC 處於 SASP 計畫的上游。

links.context: Extracellular Acidification Rate is a real-time readout of proton efflux from living cells, detected by a pH-sensitive biosensor such as the Seahorse XF Analyzer. Because Glycolysis converts glucose to lactate with net proton production, ECAR serves as a proxy for glycolytic flux and lactate export, complementing the Oxygen Consumption Rate measurement of mitochondrial respiration. The ECAR/OCR ratio classifies cells as glycolytic or oxidative-phosphorylation-dependent, and mild respiratory-chain stress such as that engaged by Mitohormesis raises ECAR.
links.context_zh_TW: Extracellular Acidification Rate 是活細胞釋放質子的即時讀值，由 Seahorse XF Analyzer 等 pH 敏感生物感測器偵測。由於 Glycolysis 將葡萄糖轉為乳酸並淨產生質子，ECAR 可作為糖解通量與乳酸輸出的代理指標，與量測粒線體呼吸的 Oxygen Consumption Rate 互補。ECAR/OCR 比值可區分細胞屬糖酵解型或氧化磷酸化依賴型，而 Mitohormesis 所涉及的輕度呼吸鏈壓力會使 ECAR 上升。

links.context: Extracellular IL-1alpha binds IL-1R1, which recruits IL-1RAcP and MyD88 to activate NF-κB and MAPK in neighboring cells, so a lytic release event converts membrane rupture into a defined inflammatory signal.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞外的 IL-1alpha 與 IL-1R1 結合，後者招募 IL-1RAcP 與 MyD88，在鄰近細胞中活化 NF-κB 與 MAPK，因此裂解性釋放事件可將膜破裂轉化為明確的發炎訊號。

links.context: Extracellular Interleukin-33 binds the receptor ST2 (IL-1RL1), which pairs with IL-1RAcP to recruit MyD88 and activate NF-κB and MAPK; as a nuclear alarmin it is released passively on cell damage rather than by classical secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞外的 Interleukin-33 結合受體 ST2（IL-1RL1），後者與 IL-1RAcP 配對招募 MyD88 並活化 NF-κB 與 MAPK；作為核內 alarmin，它是在細胞受損時被動釋放，而非經由典型分泌路徑。

links.context: Extracellular TFAM bound to mtDNA is pro-inflammatory: the TFAM-mtDNA complex engages RAGE on the plasmacytoid dendritic cell surface, allowing mtDNA to be internalized. Once internal, the CpG-containing mtDNA is recognized by endosomal TLR9, which initiates signaling that drives expression of inflammatory factors and makes pDCs the major producers of type I interferon.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞外的 TFAM 與 mtDNA 結合後具促發炎性：TFAM–mtDNA 複合體與 plasmacytoid dendritic cell 表面上的 RAGE 結合，使 mtDNA 被內吞。進入細胞後，含 CpG 的 mtDNA 由內體膜上的 TLR9 辨識，啟動訊號傳遞並促進發炎因子的表現，也使 pDC 成為 type I interferon 的主要製造者。

links.context: Extracellular cGAMP released through PANX1 diffuses to distant cells and engages the STING-IRF3 pathway there, propagating NF-κB-associated inflammatory transcription beyond the original activation site. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of PANX1 limits this spread, marking it as a non-cell-autonomous amplifier of Neuroinflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 經 PANX1 釋放的細胞外 cGAMP 擴散至遠端細胞，在該處啟動 STING–IRF3 途徑，將 NF-κB 相關的發炎性轉錄傳播至原本的活化位點之外。對 PANX1 的藥理或遺傳抑制可限制此擴散，顯示其為 Neuroinflammation 的非細胞自體性放大器。

links.context: Extracellular vesicles, including exosomes and microvesicles, are lipid-bilayer particles released by cells to mediate intercellular communication. They can be loaded with cGAMP and mtDNA, transferring cGAS-STING activation from a sender cell to a naive receiver: neurons stressed by activity-induced DNA damage or proteotoxic insult package nucleic acid cargo that activates microglial cGAS-STING, and microglia broadcast signals back to neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: Extracellular vesicles（包含 exosome 與 microvesicle）是細胞釋放以進行細胞間溝通的脂質雙層顆粒。它們可裝載 cGAMP 與 mtDNA，把 cGAS-STING 的活化由發訊細胞傳遞給未受刺激的受訊細胞：因活動誘發的 DNA Damage 或蛋白質毒性壓力而受損的神經元會包裝核酸貨物以活化小膠細胞的 cGAS-STING，而小膠細胞也會將訊號回傳給神經元。

links.context: Ezetimibe targets Cholesterol Metabolism at the intestine: it blocks the NPC1L1 cholesterol transporter at the brush border, cutting dietary and biliary cholesterol absorption by roughly half and lowering LDL-C, especially in combination with Statins.
links.context_zh_TW: Ezetimibe 在腸道層面針對 Cholesterol Metabolism：阻斷刷狀緣的 NPC1L1 膽固醇轉運蛋白，使飲食與膽汁中的膽固醇吸收減少約一半，並降低 LDL-C，與 Statins 併用時效果尤其明顯。

links.context: F2-Isoprostanes are the marker of the radical rather than the enzymatic oxygenation route, distinguishing non-enzymatic free-radical oxidation of arachidonic acid from lipoxygenase- and cyclooxygenase-mediated synthesis. Because prostaglandin flux reports inflammatory enzymatic activity while F2-Isoprostanes report radical oxidative damage, measuring both separates inflammation from oxidative stress, and the relative abundance of 8-HETE versus 15S-HETE further resolves the radical component by stereochemistry.
links.context_zh_TW: F2-Isoprostanes 是自由基途徑而非酵素性氧化途徑的標記，用以區分 arachidonic acid 的非酵素性自由基氧化與 lipoxygenase、cyclooxygenase 介導的合成。由於 prostaglandin 通量回報發炎性的酵素活性，而 F2-Isoprostanes 回報自由基氧化傷害，兩者同時測量即可區分發炎與氧化壓力；而 8-HETE 與 15S-HETE 相對含量之比更能以立體化學進一步解析其中的自由基成分。

links.context: FADD is the adaptor within the Ripoptosome: it bridges RIPK1 to the DED chain and recruits procaspase-8, Caspase-10 and c-FLIP isoforms via DED–DED interactions, mirroring DISC assembly but in the cytosol rather than at a death receptor.
links.context_zh_TW: FADD 是 Ripoptosome 內的接合蛋白：它將 RIPK1 與 DED 鏈相連，並透過 DED–DED 交互作用招募 procaspase-8、Caspase-10 與 c-FLIP 異型體，這與 DISC 的組裝類似，但發生於細胞質而非死亡受體處。

links.context: FBW7 confers substrate specificity on the SCF ubiquitin ligase.
links.context_zh_TW: FBW7 賦予 SCF 泛素連接酶受質特異性。

links.context: FBXO7 (F-box protein 7) is a scaffolding protein that interacts with both PINK1 and Parkin, acting as a molecular bridge that markedly accelerates Parkin translocation from the cytosol to damaged mitochondria. When mitochondrial membrane potential is lost, PINK1 stabilizes on the outer membrane and recruits Parkin; FBXO7 amplifies that recruitment for rapid, robust Parkin translocation.
links.context_zh_TW: FBXO7（F-box protein 7）是同時與 PINK1 與 Parkin 作用的支架蛋白，作為分子橋樑大幅加速 Parkin 由細胞質轉位到受損粒線體。當粒線體膜電位喪失時，PINK1 會穩定在外膜上並招募 Parkin；FBXO7 則放大此招募過程，使 Parkin 能快速且有效率地轉位。

links.context: FBXO7 is a key component of the PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy pathway. It belongs to the F-box protein family, whose members typically serve as substrate-recognition subunits of SCF (SKP1-CUL1-F-box) E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes, but in mitophagy it acts instead as a scaffold rather than a substrate adaptor.
links.context_zh_TW: FBXO7 是 PINK1/Parkin 媒介的 mitophagy 路徑中的關鍵成分。它屬於 F-box protein 家族，該家族成員通常作為 SCF（SKP1-CUL1-F-box）E3 泛素連接酶複合體的受質辨識次單元，但在 mitophagy 中它扮演的是支架而非受質轉接子的角色。

links.context: FCCP (carbonyl cyanide-4-trifluoromethoxyphenylhydrazone) is a protonophore that collapses the mitochondrial proton gradient, uncoupling oxidative phosphorylation. This maximally stimulates mitochondrial electron transport chain electron flux and oxygen consumption, which is why it is injected after oligomycin in Seahorse bioenergetic assays to reveal maximal respiration.
links.context_zh_TW: FCCP（carbonyl cyanide-4-trifluoromethoxyphenylhydrazone）是質子載體，會崩解粒線體的質子梯度，使 oxidative phosphorylation 解偶聯。此作用可最大程度刺激 mitochondrial electron transport chain 的電子流與耗氧，因此在 Seahorse 生體能量分析中會在 oligomycin 之後注入，以顯示最大呼吸能力。

links.context: FGF gradients drive Cell Migration: FGFR signaling establishes polarity and traction in migratory cells, and in stem-cell niches within the Basal Lamina FGF gradients are what retain progenitors in place.
links.context_zh_TW: FGF 梯度驅動 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）：FGFR 訊號在移動細胞中建立極性與牽引力，而在 Basal Lamina（基底板）內的幹細胞 niche 中，FGF 梯度正是將前驅細胞留在原處的力量。

links.context: FGF21 is a primary stress-induced mitokine downstream of mitochondrial dysfunction. Classification places it in the inter-organ signaling family.
links.context_zh_TW: FGF21 是粒線體功能障礙下游的主要壓力誘發 mitokine。歸類將它置於器官間訊號家族。

links.context: FGF21 is essential for the longevity and many of the metabolic benefits of protein restriction. Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR, while mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30-40% lifespan extension, identifying FGF21 as the critical downstream mediator. FGF21 promotes energy expenditure in part through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, acting in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue. It also regulates lipid homeostasis, reduces circulating triglycerides, mediates PR effects on cellular senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue, and reduces hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis in obese models.
links.context_zh_TW: FGF21對於蛋白質限制的長壽效應及其許多代謝益處至關重要。Fgf21基因剔除小鼠在PR下並不會活得更久，而過度表現Fgf21的小鼠則顯示約30–40%的壽命延長，使FGF21被確認為關鍵的下游媒介者。FGF21部分透過UCP1依賴性的白色脂肪組織產熱性米色化促進能量消耗，其作用發生於腦中並經由交感神經訊號傳遞，同時也增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。它還調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯、中介PR對白色脂肪組織中細胞衰老與發炎的效應，並在肥胖模型中減少肝臟脂肪變性、發炎與纖維化。

links.context: FIN56 binds to and activates squalene synthase, pushing mevalonate pathway flux toward sterol and cholesterol biosynthesis and away from CoQ10/ubiquinone synthesis. The resulting ubiquinone depletion converges on FSP1, whose radical-trapping defence collapses because its substrate is no longer regenerated as ubiquinol.
links.context_zh_TW: FIN56 結合並活化 squalene synthase，使 mevalonate pathway 的流量轉向 sterol 與 cholesterol 合成，而遠離 CoQ10/ubiquinone 合成。由此造成的 ubiquinone 耗損匯聚到 FSP1：由於其受質無法再被還原成 ubiquinol，FSP1 的自由基捕捉防禦因而崩潰。

links.context: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17. As the Atg17 scaffold, FIP200 holds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex together and is required for Autophagosome formation during Macroautophagy initiation.
links.context_zh_TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物。作為 Atg17 支架，FIP200 將 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體維持在一起，並為 Macroautophagy 起始時的 Autophagosome 形成所必需。

links.context: FIP200 scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex: without the FIP200 scaffold the Atg13 and Atg101 subunits cannot assemble productively with ULK1, and Autophagosome formation fails. mTORC1 controls Autophagy chiefly through this ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 complex.
links.context_zh_TW: FIP200 作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體：沒有 FIP200 支架，Atg13 與 Atg101 次單元便無法與 ULK1 有效組裝，Autophagosome 形成隨之失敗。mTORC1 主要透過此 ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 複合體調控 Autophagy。

links.context: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

links.context: FIS1 overexpression increases mitochondrial fragmentation, leading to dysfunction and increased autophagosome formation, whereas OPA1 and MFN1 promote fusion and functionally oppose FIS1. Mammalian cells lacking FIS1 show little or no fission defect, so its role is far less significant in mammalian cells than in yeast.
links.context_zh_TW: FIS1 過度表現會增加粒線體碎裂，造成功能障礙與 autophagosome 形成增加；相對地，OPA1 與 MFN1 促進融合，功能上與 FIS1 相反。缺乏 FIS1 的哺乳類細胞幾乎沒有 fission 缺陷，因此 FIS1 在哺乳類細胞中的重要性遠低於酵母。

links.context: FIS1-mediated mitochondrial fission is a prerequisite for mitophagy, so reduced FIS1 impairs mitophagy. In senescent cells FIS1 expression is downregulated, contributing to an elongated, interconnected mitochondrial morphology; knockdown of FIS1 produces a senescent morphology with increased SA-beta-gal activity that is reversed by reintroducing FIS1 or by OPA1 knockdown.
links.context_zh_TW: FIS1 媒介的粒線體 fission 是 mitophagy 的前提，因此 FIS1 減少會損害 mitophagy。在衰老細胞中 FIS1 表現下調，導致粒線體呈細長且互相連通的形態；FIS1 的 knockdown 會產生 SA-beta-gal 活性升高的衰老表型，而重新導入 FIS1 或對 OPA1 作 knockdown 都能逆轉此現象。

links.context: FKBP38 triggers mitophagy through aggregation of the autophagosomal protein LC3, specifically the LC3A isoform, via its LIR motif. This direct recruitment of autophagosomal membranes to the mitochondrial surface is what allows FKBP38 to bypass Parkin recruitment and ubiquitin tagging of outer mitochondrial membrane proteins.
links.context_zh_TW: FKBP38 透過其 LIR motif 使自噬相關蛋白 LC3（尤其是 LC3A 異構體）聚集，進而啟動 mitophagy。正是這種對自噬體膜的直接招募，讓 FKBP38 能繞過 Parkin 的招募以及外膜蛋白的泛素標記。

links.context: FL118 is a small-molecule camptothecin analog derived from the SN-38 scaffold, designed to overcome the limitations of earlier camptothecins such as irinotecan and topotecan. Like other camptothecins it stabilizes the TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, but with improved potency and selectivity.
links.context_zh_TW: FL118 是衍自 SN-38 骨架的小分子喜樹鹼類似物，旨在克服早期喜樹鹼（如 irinotecan 和 topotecan）的局限。與其他喜樹鹼一樣，它穩定 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，但具有更高的效力和選擇性。

links.context: FNIP1 cooperates with Folliculin and FNIP2 in the FLCN-FNIP1/2 complex, whose RagC/D GAP activity gates Amino Acid Sensing-driven mTORC1 recruitment. FNIP1 also carries a DENN domain and AMPK phosphorylation sites, coupling the complex to energy state.
links.context_zh_TW: FNIP1 與 Folliculin 及 FNIP2 在 FLCN-FNIP1/2 複合體中协同作用，該複合體的 RagC/D GAP 活性把關 Amino Acid Sensing 驅動的 mTORC1 招募。FNIP1 另含 DENN 結構域與 AMPK 磷酸化位點，將複合體與能量狀態耦合。

links.context: FNIP1 forms a ternary complex with Folliculin and FNIP2 that acts as a GTPase-activating protein for Rag GTPases, converting RagC/D from GTP- to GDP-bound state so that mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosome upon amino acid stimulation. FNIP1 deletion impairs mTORC1 activation and causes constitutive nuclear translocation of TFE3 and TFEB.
links.context_zh_TW: FNIP1 與 Folliculin 及 FNIP2 組成三元複合體，作為 Rag GTPases 的 GTPase-activating protein，將 RagC/D 由 GTP 結合態轉為 GDP 結合態，使 mTORC1 在胺基酸刺激下被招募至 lysosome。FNIP1 缺失會損害 mTORC1 活化並造成 TFE3 與 TFEB 的組成性核轉位。

links.context: FNIP2 sits upstream of mTORC1 as a scaffold of the Folliculin-FNIP1/2 complex, whose Rag GTPase GAP activity regulates mTORC1 translocation to the lysosomal surface in response to Amino Acid Sensing. AMPK directly phosphorylates FNIP2, linking Energy Homeostasis to mTORC1 regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: FNIP2 作為 Folliculin-FNIP1/2 複合體的支架位於 mTORC1 上游，該複合體的 Rag GTPase GAP 活性依 Amino Acid Sensing 調控 mTORC1 轉位至 lysosome 表面。AMPK 直接磷酸化 FNIP2，將 Energy Homeostasis 與 mTORC1 調控連結起來。

links.context: FOLFIRI is a 5-FU/leucovorin/irinotecan chemotherapy regimen.
links.context_zh_TW: FOLFIRI 是 5-FU/亞葉酸/irinotecan 化療方案。

links.context: FOLFOX is a 5-FU/leucovorin/oxaliplatin chemotherapy regimen.
links.context_zh_TW: FOLFOX 是 5-FU/亞葉酸/oxaliplatin 化療方案。

links.context: FOXO transcription factors act as the principal brake on Muscle Hypertrophy. Activated FOXO drives expression of the ubiquitin ligases Atrogin-1 and MuRF1, routing myofibrillar protein to the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System for degradation and forcing a negative net protein balance that opposes muscle growth.
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO 轉錄因子是抑制 Muscle Hypertrophy 的主要煞車。活化的 FOXO 會促進泛素連接酶 Atrogin-1 與 MuRF1 的表現，將肌原纖維蛋白送往 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 降解，導致淨蛋白質平衡轉負，進而對抗肌肉生長。

links.context: FOXO3 and SIRT1 form a feed-forward stress-resistance loop: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3 to shunt it toward stress-resistance and metabolic genes, while FOXO3 transactivates SIRT1 expression; this mutually reinforcing pair is central to longevity-associated signalling (Brunet et al., 2004, PMID 15066266).
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3 和 SIRT1 形成前饋抗壓迴圈：SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO3 以將其導向抗壓和代謝基因，而 FOXO3 反式活化 SIRT1 表達；這種相互增強的一對是長壽相關信號的核心（Brunet et al., 2004, PMID 15066266）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: FOXO3 is a longevity-associated forkhead transcription factor regulated by acetylation. Note-canonical spelling kept; cross-file FOXO3a variance noted.
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3 是受乙醯化調節的長壽相關叉頭轉錄因子。保留筆記典型拼寫；跨檔案 FOXO3a 差異已註記。

links.context: FOXO3 is a positive regulator of the SIRT7 pathway: FOXO factors interact with SIRT7 to promote stress resistance, while SIRT7 deacetylates FOXO3 to prevent pro-apoptotic Ser574 phosphorylation, forming a mutual-activation loop (source review Table 3; SIRT7-FOXO3 cooperation).
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3 是 SIRT7 途徑的正向調節因子：FOXO 因子與 SIRT7 互動以促進抗壓力能力，而 SIRT7 去乙醯化 FOXO3 以防止促凋亡的 Ser574 磷酸化，形成相互活化的迴路（來源文獻表 3; SIRT7-FOXO3 協同作用）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: FOXO3 transactivates the SIRT1 gene, reinforcing the SIRT1–FOXO3 feed-forward loop. Together with SIRT1-dependent deacetylation this couples NAD+ availability to sustained stress-resistance transcription, one of the most robust genetic correlates of human longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3 可啟動 SIRT1 基因的轉錄，強化 SIRT1–FOXO3 前饋迴路。搭配 SIRT1 依賴性的去乙醯化，此機制將 NAD+ 可用性與持續的抗壓轉錄相連結，也是人類長壽最穩固的遺傳相關因子之一。

links.context: FOXO3a is the transcription factor that mediates SIRT1-dependent SOD2/MnSOD expression, driving mitochondrial antioxidant defense. Its activation increases MnSOD levels and oxidative-stress resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3a 是介導 SIRT1 依賴性 SOD2/MnSOD 表現的轉錄因子，驅動粒線體抗氧化防禦。其活化會提高 MnSOD 濃度並增強對氧化壓力的抵抗。

links.context: FOXO3a translocates to mitochondria where it binds the SIRT3 promoter and induces SIRT3 expression, which in turn activates MnSOD to reduce ROS, forming a FOXO3a-SIRT3-PGC-1α mitochondrial-protective loop (source review; Tseng et al., 2013; also PMC2532794).
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3a 轉位至粒線體，在那裡結合 SIRT3 啟動子並誘導 SIRT3 表達，後者反過來活化 MnSOD 以減少 ROS，形成 FOXO3a-SIRT3-PGC-1α 粒線體保護迴圈（文獻綜述；Tseng et al., 2013；另見 PMC2532794）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: FSP1 is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NADPH to reduce coenzyme Q10 to ubiquinol, supplying a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that operates entirely outside the glutathione system. Loss of either the FSP1-CoQ10 axis or the GPX4-glutathione axis is survivable, but combined loss is synergistic, which is why coenzyme Q10 status and vitamin E status both matter for membrane integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: FSP1 是利用 NADPH 將 coenzyme Q10 還原為 ubiquinol 的細胞膜黃素蛋白，提供一個完全在 glutathione 系統之外運作的親脂性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑。FSP1-CoQ10 軸或 GPX4-glutathione 軸任一失去皆可存活，但兩者同時失去則產生協同效應，因此 coenzyme Q10 狀態與 vitamin E 狀態都對膜完整性重要。

links.context: FSP1 is a warfarin-resistant vitamin K reductase: it reduces vitamin K to its hydroquinone (VKH2), sustaining a non-canonical vitamin K redox cycle that also supplies a reduced radical-trapping antioxidant — explaining its ability to overcome warfarin poisoning (Mishima et al., Nature 2022).
links.context_zh_TW: FSP1 是抗 warfarin 的維生素 K 還原酶：它把 vitamin K 還原成氫醌（VKH2），維持供應還原態自由基捕捉抗氧化劑的非典型維生素 K 氧化還原循環——解釋其克服 warfarin 中毒的能力（Mishima et al., Nature 2022）。

links.context: FSP1 uses NADPH to reduce mevalonate-derived ubiquinone (CoQ10) to radical-trapping ubiquinol, so the MVA-derived CoQ10 pool is the rate-limiting substrate of the FSP1 axis. Diverting MVA flux toward sterols (e.g. via squalene synthase engagement by FIN56) or inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase with statins depletes ubiquinone and collapses the FSP1 trap independently of GPX4.
links.context_zh_TW: FSP1 以 NADPH 將源自甲羥戊酸途徑的 ubiquinone（CoQ10）還原為可捕捉自由基的 ubiquinol，因此 MVA 提供的 CoQ10 是 FSP1 軸的限速受質。將 MVA 通量轉向 sterol（如以 squalene synthase 參與的 FIN56）或以 statins 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，都會耗竭 ubiquinone，進而獨立於 GPX4 崩潰 FSP1 的捕捉能力。

links.context: FTSJ1 is the 2'-O-ribose methyltransferase that installs the Um34 modification on the two tRNA[Ser]Sec isodecoders, and this modification is a prerequisite for efficient selenocysteine recoding at UGA codons. Selenoprotein translation and tRNA[Ser]Sec Um34 levels both rise in response to oxidative stress. Loss of Um34 causes ribosomal stalling and decreased UGA recoding, making cells more sensitive to reactive oxygen species.
links.context_zh_TW: FTSJ1 是將 Um34 修飾安裝到兩種 tRNA[Ser]Sec 等型 tRNA 上的 2′-O-核糖甲基轉移酶，而此修飾是 UGA 密碼子上 selenocysteine 高效再編碼的前提。面對氧化壓力時，selenoprotein 的轉譯與 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 含量皆會上升。Um34 缺失會造成核糖體停滯與 UGA 再編碼下降，使細胞對活性氧更為敏感。
links.source_file: _document_ - Selenocysteine tRNA methylation promotes oxidative stress resistance in melanoma metastasis.md

links.context: FTSJ1 is the 2′-O-ribose methyltransferase that installs Um34 at position 34 of tRNA[Ser]Sec, a post-transcriptional modification required for efficient UGA recoding of a subset of selenoproteins. Loss of Um34 causes ribosomal stalling and reduced recoding, collapsing antioxidant selenoprotein translation; because Sec-dependent translation also supports melanoma survival under oxidative stress, FTSJ1/Um34 becomes a metastasis-selective therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: FTSJ1 是 2′-O-核糖甲基轉移酶，負責在 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的第 34 位安裝 Um34；此轉錄後修飾是部分 selenprotein 有效進行 UGA 重新編碼所必需。Um34 的喪失會造成核糖體停滯與重新編碼減少，使抗氧化 selenoprotein 的轉譯崩潰；由於 Sec 依賴性的轉譯也支持 melanoma 在氧化壓力下的存活，FTSJ1/Um34 因此成為轉移選擇性的治療標的。

links.context: FTSJ1 is the methyltransferase that installs the Um34 2′-O-methyluridine modification on tRNA[Ser]Sec. Loss of Um34 causes ribosomal stalling at the recoded UGA codon and reduced selenocysteine insertion, selectively impairing antioxidant selenoproteins — and, per the melanoma metastasis work, Um34 is necessary for metastatic colonization.
links.context_zh_TW: FTSJ1 是將 Um34（2′-O-甲基尿苷）修飾安裝到 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上的甲基轉移酶。Um34 缺失會造成核糖體在 recoded UGA codon 停滯、Selenocysteine 掺入減少，選擇性損害具抗氧化功能的 selenoprotein——而依黑色素瘤轉移研究，Um34 對轉移性定殖是必要的。
