links.context: H3K122ac is a core-domain acetylation that destabilizes the nucleosome and is enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Alongside H3K27ac and H3K18ac, it marks the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K122ac 是使核小體不穩定的核心結構域乙醯化，富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。與 H3K27ac 及 H3K18ac 並列，它標記 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態。

links.context: H3K18ac is an acetylation associated with active enhancers and is one of the acetyl marks enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. It contributes to the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers and cooperates with the AP-1 pioneer factor.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K18ac 是與活性增強子相關的乙醯化，是衰老活化超級增強子富集的乙醯標記之一。它促成 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態，並與 AP-1 先驅因子合作。

links.context: H3K18ac is often co-deposited with other enhancer acetyl marks including H3K27ac at active regulatory elements. Both are enriched together with H3K4me1 at senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K18ac 常與包括 H3K27ac 在內的其他增強子乙醯標記在活性調控元件上共同沉積。兩者皆與 H3K4me1 一起富集於驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子。

links.context: H3K27ac is the signature active-enhancer mark whose genome-wide remodeling orchestrates SASP expression in senescence. The BET-family protein BRD4 binds H3K27ac at senescence-activated enhancers to induce NF-kB-regulated SASP genes.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K27ac 是標誌性活性增強子標記，其全基因組重塑在衰老中協調 SASP 表現。BET 家族蛋白 BRD4 結合衰老活化增強子上的 H3K27ac，以誘導 NF-κB 調控的 SASP 基因。

links.context: H3K27ac marks senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression, identifying the enhancer landscape licensed during the senescent response. These acetylated, transcriptionally active enhancers recruit BRD4 and transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kB to SASP loci, enabling robust and sustained secretome transcription. The mark thus charts the chromatin basis of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and distinguishes active SASP enhancers from repressed loci. Targeting these enhancers with BET inhibitors such as JQ1 suppresses SASP expression, revealing the enhancer landscape as a therapeutic vulnerability in senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K27ac 標記驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子，辨識衰老反應中許可的增強子景觀。這些乙醯化、轉錄活化的增強子招募 BRD4 與 AP-1、NF-κB 等轉錄因子至 SASP 基因座，促成強健且持續的分泌組轉錄。此標記因此描繪衰老相關分泌表型的染色質基礎，並區分活化的 SASP 增強子與受抑制基因座。以 BET 抑制劑如 JQ1 標靶這些增強子抑制 SASP 表現，揭示增強子景觀作為衰老中治療脆弱性。

links.context: H3K36me3 is a gene-body trimethyl mark deposited co-transcriptionally by SETD2 and removed by KDM4 (JMJD2) JmjC demethylases. Its dynamics regulate transcribed gene bodies including SASP loci.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K36me3 是由 SETD2 共轉錄沉積、由 KDM4（JMJD2）JmjC 去甲基酶移除的基因體三甲基標記。其動態調控包括 SASP 基因座在內的轉錄基因體。

links.context: H3K36me3 occupies the perichromatin space of facultative heterochromatin structures such as senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It marks the transcriptionally active surfaces flanking senescent heterochromatin, distinct from the repressive interior.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K36me3 佔據衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）等兼性異染色質結構的染色質外周空間。它標記衰老異染色質旁側的轉錄活性表面，與抑制性的內部相區別。

links.context: H3K4me1 decorates de novo activated enhancers and super-enhancers that drive SASP expression in senescence. These H3K4me1-marked enhancers engage SASP promoters through enhancer-promoter looping within TADs.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K4me1 裝飾在衰老中驅動 SASP 表現的新活化增強子與超級增強子。這些 H3K4me1 標記的增強子透過 TAD 內的增強子-啟動子環化與 SASP 啟動子接合。

links.context: H3K4me1 is the canonical enhancer mark, and active enhancers are defined by the combination of H3K4me1 with H3K27ac. In senescence, super-enhancers are enriched in both H3K4me1 and H3K27ac to drive SASP expression.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K4me1 是典型的增強子標記，活性增強子由 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 的組合定義。在衰老中，超級增強子同時富集 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 以驅動 SASP 表現。

links.context: H3K4me3 and the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence, co-localizing in 'mesas' while H3K27me3 is depleted from 'canyons'. These bivalent states define transcriptional poise.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K4me3 與抑制性 H3K27me3 在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀，在「mesas」中共定位，而 H3K27me3 在「canyons」中被耗竭。這些雙價狀態定義轉錄準備狀態。

links.context: H3K4me3 is a canonical activating mark concentrated at promoters, deposited by MLL1 (KMT2A) and other SET1-complex methyltransferases. Its dynamics with the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K4me3 是集中於啟動子的典型活化標記，由 MLL1（KMT2A）及其他 SET1 複合體甲基轉移酶沉積。它與抑制性 H3K27me3 的動態在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀。

links.context: H3K56ac denotes acetylation of lysine 56 on Histone H3. Unlike N-terminal tail marks, K56 sits in the globular alphaN domain at the core–DNA interface, where acetylation neutralizes charge and loosens chromatin. The mark decorates newly synthesized H3, coupling histone deposition to nucleosome assembly during S phase and DNA repair.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K56ac 指 Histone H3 第 56 號離胺酸的乙醯化。與 N 端尾部標記不同，K56 位於球狀 alphaN 區域的核心－DNA 介面上，其乙醯化中和電荷並使染色質鬆動。此標記修飾新合成的 H3，將組蛋白沉積與 S 期的核小體組裝及 DNA 修復相連結。

links.context: H3K79me2 is a nucleosome-core methylation deposited by the methyltransferase DOT1L, the sole H3K79 methyltransferase. H3K79 methylation marks actively transcribed gene bodies and is elevated at SASP loci.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K79me2 是由甲基轉移酶 DOT1L（唯一的 H3K79 甲基轉移酶）沉積的核小體核心甲基化。H3K79 甲基化標記活躍轉錄的基因體，並在 SASP 基因座升高。

links.context: H3K9me3 is read by chromodomain proteins HP1alpha/beta/gamma, which drive chromatin compaction and spreading of repressed domains. HP1 then helps recruit SUV39H1 to methylate neighboring nucleosomes, creating a positive-feedback loop that maintains H3K9 methylation; when senescence reduces the mark, this self-reinforcing repression is lost.
links.context_zh_TW: H3K9me3 由帶有 chromodomain 的蛋白 HP1alpha/beta/gamma 辨識，後者驅動染色質壓縮與抑制區域的擴散。HP1 再協助招募 SUV39H1 甲基化鄰近的核小體，形成維持 H3K9 甲基化的正回饋迴路；當衰老使此標記減少時，這個自我強化的抑制便告瓦解。

links.context: H4K5ac is an early-acetylated H4 tail residue associated with active chromatin and is one of the acetyl marks enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. It contributes to the open enhancer state that activates SASP promoters via enhancer-promoter looping.
links.context_zh_TW: H4K5ac 是與活性染色質相關的 H4 尾部早期乙醯化殘基，是衰老活化超級增強子富集的乙醯標記之一。它促成透過增強子-啟動子環化活化 SASP 啟動子的開放增強子狀態。

links.context: H4K5ac is often co-acetylated with other marks and is enriched together with H3K27ac at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Both acetyl marks contribute to the open enhancer landscape driving SASP expression.
links.context_zh_TW: H4K5ac 常與其他標記共同乙醯化，並與 H3K27ac 一起富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。兩種乙醯標記皆促成驅動 SASP 表現的開放增強子景觀。

links.context: HAF-1 is an inner mitochondrial membrane ABC-transporter family protein in C. elegans that exports matrix-derived peptides into the cytosol to signal mitochondrial stress. Proteins degraded by matrix proteases generate peptides that exit the mitochondria through HAF-1 (analogous to the yeast Mdl1 transporter), and this peptide release triggers a nuclear transcriptional response involving the ubiquitin-like protein UBL-5, the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1, and ATFS-1. The mechanism is reminiscent of peptide-based quorum sensing in gram-positive bacteria, where peptides exported via ABC transporters activate two-component histidine kinase sensors.
links.context_zh_TW: HAF-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）粒線體內膜上的 ABC 轉運蛋白家族蛋白，負責將基質來源的胜肽輸出至細胞質，以傳遞粒線體壓力訊號。經基質蛋白酶降解的蛋白質會產生胜肽，透過 HAF-1 離開粒線體（類似酵母菌的 Mdl1 轉運蛋白），此胜肽釋放會觸發涉及類泛素蛋白 UBL-5、同源框轉錄因子 DVE-1 及 ATFS-1 的核轉錄反應。此機制令人聯想到革蘭氏陽性菌中基於胜肽的群體感應，細菌透過 ABC 轉運蛋白輸出的胜肽會活化雙組分組織胺酸激酶感測器。

links.context: HDAC1 is a class I histone deacetylase that removes acetyl groups from lysine residues on histones and other proteins, compacting chromatin and repressing transcription. It normally occupies specific genomic loci to preserve the gene-expression programs that define cellular identity.
links.context_zh_TW: HDAC1 屬於第一類 histone deacetylase，負責移除組蛋白及其他蛋白上離胺酸的乙醯基，使染色質凝聚並抑制轉錄。它通常占據特定的基因體位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表現程式。

links.context: HDAC1/2 provide the deacetylase arm of NuRD, normalized to the existing filename. Containment records the dual enzyme machinery.
links.context_zh_TW: HDAC1/2 提供 NuRD 的去乙醯化酶臂，正規化至既有檔名。包含記錄雙酶機器。

links.context: HDAC4 buffers the AP-1-driven SASP transcriptional program by overseeing H3K27ac status at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Upon entry into senescence HDAC4 is degraded, releasing the NF-kappaB-regulated SASP program; HDAC4 depletion likewise enhances SASP expression, so stabilizing HDAC4 could be senomorphic.
links.context_zh_TW: HDAC4 藉由監控 senescence-activated super-enhancers 上的 H3K27ac 狀態，緩衝 AP-1 驅動的 SASP 轉錄程式。進入 senescence 時 HDAC4 被降解，釋放 NF-kappaB 調控的 SASP 程式；HDAC4 耗竭同樣會增強 SASP 表現，因此穩定 HDAC4 可能具 senomorphic 效果。

links.context: HDAC6 is a cytoplasmically localized deacetylase that deacetylates the fusion protein MFN1 under glucose deprivation, enhancing its fusogenic activity. Shifting the balance away from the pro-fission DRP1 axis toward fusion maintains mitochondrial integrity and bioenergetic resilience when nutrient supply is limited.
links.context_zh_TW: HDAC6 是細胞質定位的 deacetylase，在葡萄糖缺乏時將 fusion 蛋白 MFN1 去乙醯化，增強其 fusogenic 活性。將平衡由 pro-fission 的 DRP1 軸轉向 fusion，可在養分供應受限時維持 mitochondrial integrity 與 bioenergetic 韌性。

links.context: HDACs (histone deacetylases) remove acetyl groups from histones and non-histone proteins, and their action on TFEB lowers its transcriptional output. Two enzyme classes acetylate TFEB (GCN5, ACAT1) while SIRT1 and HDACs deacetylate it, making the acetylation balance a key switch for lysosomal-autophagy transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: HDACs（histone deacetylases）移除組蛋白與非組蛋白上的乙醯基，其對 TFEB 的作用會降低其轉錄輸出。GCN5 與 ACAT1 兩類酵素可使 TFEB 乙醯化，而 SIRT1 與 HDACs 則使其去乙醯化，使乙醯化平衡成為 lysosome-自噬轉錄的關鍵開關。

links.context: HDL carries the antioxidant enzyme PON1, which contributes to the particle's antioxidant capacity and protects LDL from oxidation. Oxidation of HDL reduces PON1 activity and thereby weakens the anti-atherogenic function of the lipoprotein.
links.context_zh_TW: HDL 攜帶抗氧化酵素 PON1，後者貢獻於該顆粒的抗氧化能力並保護 LDL 免於氧化。HDL 的氧化會降低 PON1 活性，因而削弱此 lipoprotein 的抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。

links.context: HDL protects LDL against oxidation, largely by carrying the antioxidant enzyme PON1. Elevated HDL is associated with reduced atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease risk, so HDL-based strategies target ABCA1, ABCG1, and PON1.
links.context_zh_TW: HDL 主要藉由攜帶抗氧化酵素 PON1 保護 LDL 免於氧化。HDL 濃度較高與較低的 atherosclerosis 及 cardiovascular disease 風險相關，因此以 HDL 為基礎的策略針對 ABCA1、ABCG1 與 PON1。

links.context: HER2 is one of the oncogenic client proteins whose folding and stability depend on HSP90β. Because HSP90β is overexpressed in aggressive leukemias and solid tumors and correlates with chemotherapy resistance, its chaperone activity indirectly sustains HER2-driven proliferative signalling in tumours.
links.context_zh_TW: HER2 是折疊與穩定性仰賴 HSP90β 的致癌客戶蛋白之一。由於 HSP90β 在侵襲性白血病與實體腫瘤中過度表現並與化療抗藥性相關，其 chaperone 活性等於間接維持腫瘤中由 HER2 驅動的增殖訊號。

links.context: HERV-derived cDNA engages the cGAS-STING Pathway to upregulate SASP factors, and retrovirus-like particles released from senescent cells — or found in the sera of older individuals — can infect healthy cells via their envelope protein and induce a senescence phenotype in those cells. Human Endogenous Retrovirus thus drives paracrine spread of senescence, amplifying SASP expression community-wide.
links.context_zh_TW: HERV 來源的 cDNA 透過 cGAS-STING Pathway 上調 SASP 因子；而從衰老細胞釋出的類反轉錄病毒顆粒（或存在於老年人血清中）可藉其包膜蛋白感染健康細胞，並在那些細胞中誘導衰老表型。因此 Human Endogenous Retrovirus 推動衰老的旁分泌擴散，在群體層面放大 SASP 表現。

links.context: HFE acts upstream of the iron-export valve Ferroportin. Normally the liver senses body iron and secretes hepcidin, which binds Ferroportin on the enterocyte and macrophage surface and triggers its internalization and degradation, closing the iron-export gate. HFE is required for that hepcidin upregulation; without it, hepcidin output stays inappropriately low and Ferroportin remains on the surface, leaving a duodenal iron valve stuck open. SLC40A1 gain-of-function inverts the phenotype, producing hepcidin-resistant, macrophage-predominant iron loading.
links.context_zh_TW: HFE 作用於鐵輸出閘門 Ferroportin 的上游。正常情況下肝臟感知體內鐵儲量並分泌 hepcidin，hepcidin 與腸細胞及巨噬細胞表面的 Ferroportin 結合，觸發其內吞與降解，關閉鐵輸出通道。HFE 是此 hepcidin 上調所必需；缺乏 HFE 時 hepcidin 輸出維持在不應有的低量，Ferroportin 仍留在細胞表面，使十二指腸的「鐵閥門」卡在開啟狀態。SLC40A1 的功能增益則顛覆此表型，造成 hepcidin 抗性、以巨噬細胞為主的鐵負荷。

links.context: HFE is a structural chaperone, not an enzyme or transporter, and its whole function is to set the right size of the body iron pool. Loss of HFE function makes the liver under-read its own iron stores, so duodenal iron absorption proceeds regardless of body stores and reticuloendothelial recycling efficiency falls. Iron then accumulates preferentially in parenchyma - liver, heart, pancreas, skin, pituitary, joints - rather than in the safer reticuloendothelial sequestration seen in secondary overload. A C282Y homozygote is effectively iron-loaded from roughly the third decade without any dietary contribution.
links.context_zh_TW: HFE 是結構性陪伴蛋白（chaperone），不是酵素或運輸蛋白，其全部功能在於設定體內鐵儲存的正確規模。HFE 功能喪失使肝臟低估自身的鐵儲量，十二指腸的鐵吸收不論體內儲量皆持續進行，且網狀內皮系統的鐵回收效率下降。鐵因而優先累積於臟器實質——肝、心、胰、皮膚、腦下垂體、關節——而非次級鐵負荷中較安全的網狀內皮隔離。C282Y 同型合子個體自約第三個十年起即已處於鐵負荷狀態，與飲食攝取無關。

links.context: HGF drives the canonical liver repair response after injury. Promotion is its eponymous regenerative function.
links.context_zh_TW: HGF 在損傷後驅動典型的肝臟修復反應。促進是其名符其實的再生功能。

links.context: HGF-MET signaling produces the invasive growth program including branching morphogenesis, migration, and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition-like scattering of epithelial cells. MET recapitulates this program through GRB2/SOS, PI3K-AKT, STAT3 and SRC-family kinase signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: HGF-MET 訊號產生侵入性生長程式，包括分支形態發生、遷移和上皮細胞的類上皮-間質轉化散射。MET 透過 GRB2/SOS、PI3K-AKT、STAT3 和 SRC 家族激酶訊號重現此程式。

links.context: HIF-2α is deacetylated by SIRT1, which modulates the oxygen-regulated transcription factor's output under hypoxia. Alongside HIF-1α, HIF-2α (EPAS1) controls hypoxic gene programs, and its SIRT1-dependent deacetylation extends the sirtuin network's transcriptional reach beyond the better-characterized HIF-1α axis.
links.context_zh_TW: HIF-2α 被 SIRT1 去乙醯化，進而調節這個受氧調控的轉錄因子在缺氧下的輸出。HIF-2α（EPAS1）與 HIF-1α 一同控制缺氧基因程式，其依賴 SIRT1 的去乙醯化使 sirtuin 網路的轉錄調控範圍超越較被深入研究的 HIF-1α 軸。

links.context: HIRA is a central coordinator of the replication-independent deposition of H3.3 and is essential for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). Along with ASF1a and UBN1, it assembles the facultative heterochromatin accompanying senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: HIRA 是 H3.3 非複製依賴沉積的核心協調者，是形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所必需。它與 ASF1a 及 UBN1 一起組裝伴隨衰老的兼性異染色質。

links.context: HIRA relocalizes to promyelocytic leukemia (PML) nuclear bodies during senescence, and preventing HIRA translocation to PML bodies blocks SAHF formation. PML nuclear bodies are thus required for HIRA-mediated heterochromatin assembly.
links.context_zh_TW: HIRA 在衰老期間易位至前髓細胞白血病（PML）核體，而阻止 HIRA 轉位至 PML 核體會阻斷 SAHF 形成。因此 PML 核體是 HIRA 介導異染色質組裝所需。

links.context: HIV-1 Pol also encodes the viral protease, which during maturation cleaves the Gag and Gag-Pol polyproteins into functional subunits to produce infectious mature virions. Protease is the target of PI-class antiretroviral drugs such as darunavir and atazanavir, which are typically boosted with ritonavir or cobicistat.
links.context_zh_TW: HIV-1 的 Pol 同樣編碼病毒 protease，它在成熟階段將 Gag 與 Gag-Pol 多蛋白切割成具功能的次單元，以產生具感染力的成熟病毒顆粒。Protease 是 darunavir、atazanavir 等 PI 類抗反轉錄病毒藥物的標的，這些藥物通常以 ritonavir 或 cobicistat 加以增幅。

links.context: HIV-1 is the pandemic form of HIV: it is a lentivirus of the Retroviridae family and, with Group M subtypes A–K and circulating recombinant forms, accounts for more than 95% of infections worldwide. HIV-2, in contrast, is largely confined to West Africa, is less transmissible and progresses to AIDS more slowly.
links.context_zh_TW: HIV-1 是 HIV 的 pandemic 型態：屬 Retroviridae 科的 lentivirus，以 Group M 的 A–K 亞型與循環重組型（CRF）佔全球感染逾 95%。相對地，HIV-2 主要侷限於西非，傳播力較低且進展為 AIDS 的速度較慢。

links.context: HLA-E upregulation mediates immune evasion, allowing senescent cells and tumor cells to escape NK- and CD8+ T-cell-mediated clearance via NKG2A/CD94 engagement. By dampening cytotoxic responses, it converts an otherwise visible arrested cell into a protected one, explaining why some senescent cells persist despite an inflammatory milieu. This immune-evasive function is a recognized senescence-surveillance subversion mechanism and mirrors the HLA-E-driven checkpoint exploited by many tumors. Blocking NKG2A can restore immune-mediated elimination of HLA-E-expressing cells.
links.context_zh_TW: HLA-E 上升介導免疫逃脫，允許衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞經由 NKG2A/CD94 參與逃避免疫 NK 與 CD8+ T 細胞介導的清除。透過減弱細胞毒性反應，它將否則可見的停滯細胞轉化為受保護的細胞，解釋為何某些衰老細胞儘管有發炎微環境仍持續。此免疫逃脫功能是公認的衰老監視顛覆機制，並反映許多腫瘤利用的 HLA-E 驅動檢查點。阻斷 NKG2A 可恢復對表達 HLA-E 細胞的免疫介導排除。

links.context: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 engagement delivers an inhibitory signal that blunts NK cell cytotoxic killing of HLA-E-expressing senescent and tumor cells. By engaging this checkpoint, senescent cells protect themselves from NKG2A-positive NK cells, undermining the innate arm of senescence surveillance. This immune-evasive upregulation reduces the probability of immune clearance and allows arrested cells to persist in tissues. The suppression is a direct ligand-receptor inhibitory mechanism, and blocking the interaction with anti-NKG2A antibodies can restore NK-mediated killing.
links.context_zh_TW: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 參與傳遞抑制訊號，減弱 NK 細胞對表達 HLA-E 的衰老與腫瘤細胞的細胞毒性殺死。透過參與此檢查點，衰老細胞保護自己對抗 NKG2A 陽性 NK 細胞，破壞衰老監視的先天臂。此免疫逃脫性上升減少免疫清除的機率，並允許停滯細胞在組織中持續。此抑制是直接配體—受體抑制機制，且以抗 NKG2A 抗體阻斷此交互作用可恢復 NK 介導的殺死。

links.context: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 engagement on CD8+ T cells suppresses their cytotoxic killing, extending the immune-evasive effect beyond NK cells to the adaptive compartment. This allows HLA-E-upregulated senescent and malignant cells to evade cytotoxic T lymphocytes, contributing to failed clearance and persistence. The suppression reinforces the dual innate and adaptive immune evasion conferred by HLA-E and mirrors the checkpoint biology exploited by tumors. Pharmacological blockade of the interaction is being explored as a strategy to restore CD8+ T-cell responses.
links.context_zh_TW: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 在 CD8+ T 細胞上的參與抑制其細胞毒性殺死，將免疫逃脫效應從 NK 細胞擴展到適應區室。這允許 HLA-E 上升的衰老與惡性細胞逃避免疫毒性 T 淋巴球，貢獻失敗清除與持續。此抑制強化 HLA-E 賦予的雙重先天與適應免疫逃脫，並反映腫瘤利用的檢查點生物學。藥理阻斷此交互作用正被探索作為恢復 CD8+ T 細胞反應的策略。

links.context: HLH-30 induces LIPL-2 during fasting, while MXL-3 represses it under well-fed conditions. The reciprocal transcriptional switch is the mechanism by which C. elegans couples nutrient status to Lipophagy, matching the ~12-fold rise in lipl-2 mRNA after six hours of fasting.
links.context_zh_TW: HLH-30 在禁食期間誘導 LIPL-2，而 MXL-3 在營養充足條件下抑制它。這種互補的轉錄開關是 C. elegans 將營養狀態與 Lipophagy 耦合的機制，對應禁食六小時後 lipl-2 mRNA 約 12 倍的上升。

links.context: HLH-30 is required for Autophagy in C. elegans: fasting hlh-30 mutants fail to activate transcription of the essential autophagy genes lgg-1, lgg-2 and atg-16.2. The same mutants die prematurely in starvation, showing that HLH-30 is needed to mount the metabolic response that supplies the cell with energy during food deprivation.
links.context_zh_TW: HLH-30 對 C. elegans 的 Autophagy 而言是必需的：禁食條件下的 hlh-30 突變個體無法活化必要自噬基因 lgg-1、lgg-2 與 atg-16.2 的轉錄。相同突變體在飢餓時會提早死亡，顯示 HLH-30 為啟動食物剝奪期間供能所需的代謝反應所必需。
links.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

links.context: HLH-30 promotes Lipophagy by inducing the lysosomal lipase genes lipl-2, lipl-3 and lipl-5 and contributing to lipl-1 induction during fasting, at least partly by autoregulating its own transcription. Following fasting HLH-30 is enriched in intestinal nuclei and occupies the lipase promoters, so it hands off from MXL-3 repression to fasting-driven lipolysis.
links.context_zh_TW: HLH-30 藉由在禁食期間誘導溶酶體脂肪酶基因 lipl-2、lipl-3 與 lipl-5，並協助 lipl-1 的誘導來促進 Lipophagy，部分是透過自我調控自身轉錄。禁食後 HLH-30 會富集於腸道細胞核並佔據脂肪酶啟動子，因此完成從 MXL-3 抑制到禁食驅動脂肪分解的交接。
links.source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md

links.context: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition by statins diverts mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, collapsing the ubiquinone pool; with no substrate to reduce, FSP1 cannot regenerate ubiquinol even with abundant NAD(P)H — so statins (like FIN56) sensitize to ferroptosis independently of GPX4 status.
links.context_zh_TW: Statins 對 HMG-CoA 還原酶的抑制使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，使 ubiquinone 池崩潰；沒有受質可還原時，即使 NAD(P)H 充足 FSP1 也無法再生成 ubiquinol——因此 statins（如 FIN56）以不依賴 GPX4 狀態的方式使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

links.context: HMGA1 cooperates with the RB1 (retinoblastoma) pathway to promote formation of repressive heterochromatin at proliferation-promoting loci. This reinforcement of the heterochromatic state helps lock cells into permanent growth arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: HMGA1 與 RB1（視網膜母細胞瘤）途徑合作，在促進增殖的基因座處促進抑制性異染色質的形成。此對異染色質狀態的強化有助於將細胞鎖入永久生長停滯。

links.context: HMGA1 is a non-histone chromatin architectural protein induced during senescence, where it cooperates with the RB1 pathway to promote formation of repressive heterochromatin at E2F target genes and at senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF).
links.context_zh_TW: HMGA1 是在衰老期間被誘導的非組蛋白染色質架構蛋白，與 RB1 途徑合作，在 E2F 目標基因及衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）處促進抑制性異染色質的形成。

links.context: HMGB1 engages the receptor for advanced glycation end products (RAGE/AGER), promoting inflammation, migration and metastasis.
links.context_zh_TW: HMGB1 結合晚期糖基化終產物受體（RAGE/AGER），促進炎症、遷移和轉移。

links.context: HMGB1 is a key Damage-Associated Molecular Pattern: a nuclear protein released during necrosis and by senescent cells that binds TLR4 and RAGE. Its release is amplified in the SASP programme of senescent cells, where HMGB1 release further amplifies inflammatory signalling alongside cytosolic DNA-driven cGAS-STING activation.
links.context_zh_TW: HMGB1 是關鍵的 DAMP（損傷相關分子模式）：它是壞死時與衰老細胞釋出的核蛋白，可結合 TLR4 與 RAGE。其釋放在衰老細胞的 SASP（衰老相關分泌表型）程式中被放大，與細胞質 DNA 驅動的 cGAS-STING 活化一同進一步放大發炎訊號。

links.context: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
links.context_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

links.context: HNRNPD (AUF1) binds AU-rich elements in target mRNAs and, when the transcript carries m6A installed by METTL3, destabilizes TFEB pre-mRNA, lowering TFEB protein and attenuating lysosomal-autophagy transcription. Reader proteins such as YTHDF2 contribute to the m6A-dependent targeting.
links.context_zh_TW: HNRNPD（AUF1）會結合目標 mRNA 的 AU-rich 元素；當轉錄本帶有 METTL3 安裝的 m6A 標記時，它會使 TFEB 前驅 mRNA 去穩定，降低 TFEB 蛋白並削弱 lysosome-自噬轉錄。诸如 YTHDF2 等 reader 蛋白參與此 m6A 依賴的標定。

links.context: HO-1 degrades heme by cleaving the porphyrin ring at the α-meso carbon, yielding biliverdin IXα, carbon monoxide, and ferrous iron; biliverdin is then reduced to the potent antioxidant bilirubin. Loss or misregulation of this axis leaves free heme and iron available for Fenton chemistry and hydroxyl-radical generation, worsening oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: HO-1 在 α-meso 碳處切開卟啉環以分解血基質，產生 biliverdin IXα、一氧化碳與亞鐵離子；biliverdin 隨後被還原成強效抗氧化劑 bilirubin。此軸功能喪失或失調會讓游離血基質與鐵質得以進行 Fenton 化學反應並生成羥基自由基，使氧化壓力惡化。

links.context: HRI is a core eIF2α kinase of the integrated stress response: it phosphorylates the alpha subunit of eukaryotic initiation factor 2, reducing ternary-complex formation and globally repressing translation so cells conserve resources and limit damaged-protein synthesis. HRI is the principal translator of heme status into translational control.
links.context_zh_TW: HRI 是整合性壓力反應中的核心 eIF2α 激酶：它磷酸化真核起始因子 2 的 α 次單元，減少三元複合體形成並全面抑制轉譯，使細胞節省資源並減少受損蛋白質的合成。HRI 是將血基質狀態轉譯為轉譯調控的主要節點。

links.context: HRI is the kinase effector of the OMA1-DELE1-HRI axis: once activated by the released DELE1 tail, HRI phosphorylates eIF2α to induce the Integrated Stress Response, including ATF4 and CHOP transcription. This axis is a backup to OMA1-dependent OPA1 cleavage and complements other mitochondrial stress outputs, illustrating how Mitochondria communicate distress to the cytosol independently of the canonical PINK1/Parkin mitophagy route.
links.context_zh_TW: HRI 是 OMA1-DELE1-HRI 軸的激酶效應器：一旦被釋出的 DELE1 尾端活化，HRI 便磷酸化 eIF2α，誘發整合性壓力反應（Integrated Stress Response），包括 ATF4 與 CHOP 的轉錄。此軸是 OMA1 依賴的 OPA1 切割之外的備援途徑，與其他粒線體壓力輸出互補，說明粒線體（Mitochondria）如何獨立於典型的 PINK1/Parkin mitophagy 路徑將窘迫訊號傳遞至細胞質。

links.context: HSL acts downstream of ATGL in sequential lipolysis: ATGL initiates triacylglycerol breakdown and HSL, the second-step adipocyte lipase, hydrolyzes the resulting diacylglycerol (and cholesteryl esters) to release fatty acids for oxidation, working together with monoacylglycerol lipase to complete triacylglycerol catabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: HSL 在連續脂解作用中位於 ATGL 下游：ATGL 先啟動三酸甘油酯分解，第二步的脂肪細胞脂肪酶 HSL 再水解所產生的二酸甘油酯（以及膽固醇酯）以釋放脂肪酸供氧化，並與單酸甘油酯脂肪酶共同完成三酸甘油酯的分解。

links.context: HSP27 is phosphorylated by the p38 MAPK/MK2 axis, regulating its chaperone and anti-apoptotic functions.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP27 被 p38 MAPK/MK2 軸磷酸化，調節其分子伴侶和抗凋亡功能。

links.context: HSP70 protects cells from apoptosis by blocking apoptosome formation, in addition to its role as a chaperone in protein folding and aggregation prevention. Its expression is induced by heat shock, oxidative stress, and proteotoxic stress through HSF1, and it is overexpressed in many cancers and protective in neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP70 藉由阻斷 apoptosome 形成來保護細胞免受細胞凋亡，除此之外它還在蛋白質摺疊與防止蛋白聚集上扮演伴護蛋白的角色。其表現由 HSF1 透過熱休克、氧化壓力與蛋白毒性壓力誘發，並在多種癌症中過度表現、於神經退化性疾病中具有保護作用。

links.context: HSP90β functions as an Apaf-1 inhibitor: it binds Apaf-1 and suppresses its nucleotide-dependent oligomerization, holding Apaf-1 in an inactive monomeric state. In BCR-ABL-driven tyrosine kinase leukemias this anti-death role restrains apoptosome formation, and it explains why HSP90 inhibition can unleash mitochondrial apoptosis selectively in malignant cells.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP90β 扮演 Apaf-1 抑制劑的角色：它與 Apaf-1 結合並抑制其依核苷酸的寡聚化，使 Apaf-1 維持在不活化的單體狀態。在 BCR-ABL 驅動的 tyrosine kinase 白血病中，這種抗死亡作用限制了 apoptosome 的形成，也解釋了為何 HSP90 抑制能選擇性地在惡性細胞中釋放粒線體 apoptosis。

links.context: HSP90β stabilizes a large cohort of labile client proteins that includes EGFR, HER2, AKT, BCR-ABL, mutant p53 and MET, maintaining oncogenic signaling and preventing client degradation by the proteasome. HSP90 inhibitors such as AUY922 and ganetespib destabilize numerous oncogenic clients simultaneously, which is attractive but limited by heat-shock feedback.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP90β 會穩定一大批不穩定的客戶蛋白，其中包含 EGFR、HER2、AKT、BCR-ABL、突變型 p53 與 MET，藉此維持致癌訊號並防止客戶蛋白被 proteasome 降解。AUY922 與 ganetespib 等 HSP90 抑制劑可同時 destabilize 大量致癌客戶蛋白，策略具吸引力，但受 heat-shock 回饋限制。

links.context: HSPA8 is a shared binding partner of the DDR kinase ATM and p38 MAPK, two kinases that transduce signals driving SASP development. Disrupting the HSPA8 interaction with p-ATM and p38 MAPK blocks the conversion of the acute stress-associated phenotype into the chronic SASP, making HSPA8 a senomorphic target that spares senescent cells themselves.
links.context_zh_TW: HSPA8 是 DNA 損傷反應激酶 ATM 與 p38 MAPK 共同的結合夥伴，這兩個激酶負責傳遞驅動 SASP 形成的訊號。破壞 HSPA8 與 p-ATM 及 p38 MAPK 的互動，可阻斷急性壓力相關表型轉化為慢性 SASP 的過程，使 HSPA8 成為可在不殺死衰老細胞的前提下作用的 senomorphic 標的。

links.context: HSPA8 physically interacts with PRDX6 in senescent cells, as shown by co-immunoprecipitation/MS. Because apigenin binds PRDX6 and inhibits its iPLA2 activity, PRDX6–HSPA8 functional interference is the proposed mechanistic basis of apigenin's senomorphic effect, and the selective HSPA8 inhibitor VER155008 phenocopies that effect.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，HSPA8 與 PRDX6 存在物理性互動（由共免疫沉澱／質譜證實）。由於 apigenin 會結合 PRDX6 並抑制其 iPLA2 活性，PRDX6–HSPA8 的功能性干擾即被提出為 apigenin  senomorphic（抗衰老作用）效果的機轉基礎，而選擇性 HSPA8 抑制劑 VER155008 可模擬此效果。

links.context: Haloperidol is metabolically converted into the pyridinium neurotoxin HPP+, a charged MPP+ analog taken up by dopaminergic neurons where it inhibits mitochondrial complex I. This conversion underlies haloperidol-associated parkinsonism, which mimics but is distinct from Parkinson's Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Haloperidol 在代謝上轉化為吡啶鎓神經毒素 HPP+，一種帶電荷的 MPP+ 類似物，被多巴胺神經元攝取並抑制粒線體複合體 I。此轉化是 haloperidol 相關帕金森症的基礎，其模仿但不同於 Parkinson's Disease。

links.context: Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, holding that ROS from aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage; it was later refined as the mitochondrial free radical theory, implicating mitochondria as the primary source and target of ROS.
links.context_zh_TW: Harman 於 1955 年提出自由基老化理論，主張有氧呼吸產生的 ROS 造成累積性氧化傷害；此理論後來被精煉為粒線體自由基理論，將 mitochondria 視為 ROS 的主要來源與作用標的。

links.context: HeLa cells are routinely used in RNAi and reporter assays to study microRNA biogenesis. Knockdown of DGCR8 or Drosha in HeLa S3 reduced pre-miR-16 and mature miR-16 with pri-miRNA accumulation, confirming DGCR8 requirement for microRNA maturation.
links.context_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞常被用於 RNAi 與報導基因分析以研究 microRNA 生合成。在 HeLa S3 中敲低 DGCR8 或 Drosha 會降低 pre-miR-16 與成熟 miR-16 並累積 pri-miRNA，證實 DGCR8 為 microRNA 成熟所需。

links.context: Heart rate variability (HRV) reflects the balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic branches of the autonomic nervous system. The parasympathetic branch, governed largely by the vagus nerve, allows greater beat-to-beat fluctuation and raises HRV.
links.context_zh_TW: 心率變異度（HRV）反映自主神經系統交感與副交感分支的平衡。主要由迷走神經（vagus nerve）主導的副交感分支允許更大的逐跳波動並提高 HRV。

links.context: Heat shock protein 90 binds MLKL, preventing proteasomal degradation and promoting MLKL activation and membrane translocation.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白90結合MLKL，防止其經蛋白酶體降解，並促進MLKL活化與膜轉位。

links.context: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

links.context: Hematopoietic output and stem-cell fitness decline with aging, a manifestation of stem cell exhaustion that skews myelopoiesis, impairs lymphopoiesis, and diminishes regenerative capacity. The consequences are immunodeficiency, anemia, and heightened myeloid malignancy risk, and the resulting inflammation intertwines hematopoiesis with inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: 隨著老化，造血輸出與幹細胞功能下降，這是幹細胞耗竭的一種表現，會使髓系生成偏移、抑制淋巴系生成並削弱再生能力。後果包括免疫缺陷、貧血與骨髓系惡性腫瘤風險升高，而由此引發的發炎也讓 hematopoiesis 與發炎性老化相互交織。

links.context: Hematopoietic stem cells depend on autophagy for maintenance, with the protein Atg7 essential for HSC fitness. Consistent with this, rapamycin treatment restores self-renewal and expansion of aged HSCs, indicating that declining autophagic flux contributes to age-related loss of HSC function and immune aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 造血幹細胞的維持仰賴自噬，其中蛋白質 Atg7 對 HSC 功能至關重要。與此一致，rapamycin 治療可恢復老化 HSC 的自我更新與擴增，顯示自噬通量下降促成 HSC 功能的年齡相關喪失與免疫老化。

links.context: Hemoglobin is a tetramer of two alpha and two beta chains found in erythrocytes, where each chain carries a heme group whose iron sits in the ferrous (Fe2+) state to reversibly bind oxygen for systemic transport. Oxidation of that iron to the ferric (Fe3+) state yields methemoglobin, which can no longer carry oxygen effectively.
links.context_zh_TW: Hemoglobin 是由兩條 α 鏈與兩條 β 鏈組成的四聚體，存在於紅血球中；每條鏈都帶有一個血基質基團，其鐵處於亞鐵（Fe2+）狀態，可逆地結合氧氣以在全身運送氧氣。當該鐵被氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）時即形成 methemoglobin，無法再有效運送氧氣。

links.context: Hemolysis is the destruction of Erythrocytes, releasing Hemoglobin into the surrounding plasma. It is a significant risk when patients with G6PD deficiency are treated with Methylene blue for Methemoglobinemia, because the oxidative dye can trigger hemolysis in susceptible individuals; management of methemoglobinemia must therefore avoid precipitating hemolysis.
links.context_zh_TW: Hemolysis 是 Erythrocytes 的破壞，使 Hemoglobin 釋放至周圍血漿中。當以 Methylene blue 治療 G6PD deficiency 患者的 Methemoglobinemia 時，這是一項重大風險，因為這種氧化性染料可能在易感個體中誘發溶血；因此 methemoglobinemia 的處置必須避免造成 Hemolysis。

links.context: Heparin is a glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant that binds antithrombin III and induces a conformational change that accelerates antithrombin-mediated inactivation of thrombin (factor IIa) and factor Xa by roughly 1000-fold. Unfractionated heparin inhibits both thrombin and Xa, whereas low molecular weight heparin such as enoxaparin and dalteparin primarily targets Xa.
links.context_zh_TW: Heparin 是一種醣胺聚醣類抗凝血劑，可與 antithrombin III 結合並誘導構形改變，使 antithrombin 對 thrombin（factor IIa）與 factor Xa 的抑制加速約 1000 倍。未分級肝素同時抑制 thrombin 與 Xa，而 enoxaparin、dalteparin 等低分子量肝素則主要作用於 Xa。

links.context: Hes1 and Hey2 are downstream effectors of Notch signaling. Hes proteins bind E-box (CACNAG) motifs and recruit Groucho/TLE corepressors and histone deacetylases to silence proneural targets, while Hey proteins are activated via the Notch intracellular domain and RBPJκ. Hes1 is expressed in oscillatory waves that pattern the nervous system, whereas Hey2 is constitutive in myocardium and vasculature.
links.context_zh_TW: Hes1 與 Hey2 是 Notch signaling 的下游效應因子。Hes 蛋白結合 E-box（CACNAG）模體，並招募 Groucho/TLE 共抑制子與 histone deacetylase 以靜默神經前驅相關標的；Hey 蛋白則經由 Notch 細胞內區域與 RBPJκ 被活化。Hes1 以振盪波形式表現以塑造神經系統，Hey2 則在心臟與血管中恆常表現。

links.context: Hesperetin, a citrus flavanone polyphenol (the aglycone of hesperidin), exerts antifibrotic and senomorphic activity by restoring autophagic flux, reducing reactive oxygen species, and suppressing SASP-mediated fibroblast activation. It is therefore grouped with other polyphenol senotherapeutics that counteract the mitochondrial dysfunction/ROS/SASP axis sustaining fibrotic remodeling.
links.context_zh_TW: Hesperetin 是一種柑橘類黃烷酮多酚（hesperidin 的苷元），透過恢復自噬通量、降低活性氧並抑制 SASP 介導的纖維母細胞活化，發揮抗纖維化與 senomorphic 活性。因此它與其他對抗維持纖維化重塑之粒線體功能障礙／ROS／SASP 軸的多酚類 senotherapeutics 歸為同一群。

links.context: Hesperidin is the prototypical flavanone glycoside of citrus. Membership anchors the dietary example.
links.context_zh_TW: Hesperidin 是柑橘典型的 flavanone 糖苷。成員關係錨定膳食範例。

links.context: Hexokinase-1 anchors to the outer mitochondrial membrane through VDAC via an N-terminal hydrophobic helix, and VDAC-bound HK1 preferentially consumes mitochondrial ATP while stabilizing membrane potential. In Parthanatos, release of this anchor translocates HK1 to the cytosol, lowering its activity and membrane potential and sensitizing neurons to TNF/BAX-mediated death.
links.context_zh_TW: Hexokinase-1 透過 N 端疏水性螺旋與 VDAC 結合而錨定於粒線體外膜；與 VDAC 結合的 HK1 會優先使用粒線體 ATP 並穩定膜電位。在 Parthanatos 中，錨定解除會使 HK1 轉位至細胞質，降低其活性與膜電位，並讓神經元對 TNF/BAX 介導的死亡更加敏感。

links.context: Hexokinase-1 inhibition is the bioenergetic hit of the cytosolic dual-hit model of Parthanatos: nuclear PARP1 hyperactivation generates free PAR, which inhibits HK1 and releases it from VDAC, blocking glycolysis and the PPP, and lowering both ATP and NADPH/GSH. HK activity falls about 15 minutes post-MNNG, before NAD+ depletion — so the hit precedes and is independent of NAD+ loss.
links.context_zh_TW: Hexokinase-1 的抑制是 Parthanatos 細胞質雙重打擊模型的生體能量核心：細胞核內 PARP1 過度活化產生游離 PAR，抑制 HK1 並使其自 VDAC 解離，阻斷糖解作用與 PPP，使 ATP 與 NADPH/GSH 同時下降。HK 活性在 MNNG 處理後約 15 分鐘即下降，早於 NAD+ 耗竭——代表此打擊先於且獨立於 NAD+ 流失。

links.context: High NADPH flux protects against Ferroptosis. Tumor cells with strong NADPH generation resist ferroptosis through both the FSP1 and GPX4 axes, whereas agents that drain NADPH sensitize them; for that reason NAD(P)H levels have been proposed as a biomarker of ferroptosis sensitivity across cancer cell lines.
links.context_zh_TW: 高的 NADPH 通量可保護免受 Ferroptosis。NADPH 生成旺盛的腫瘤細胞可同時透過 FSP1 與 GPX4 兩軸抵抗 Ferroptosis，而耗竭 NADPH 的藥劑則使其敏感化；因此 NAD(P)H 濃度已被提出作為跨癌細胞株評估 Ferroptosis 敏感性的生物標記。

links.context: High cAMP downstream of MC1R activation upregulates Tyrosinase and the eumelanogenic program. Tyrosinase is the rate-limiting enzyme whose induction produces protective dark pigment. MC1R signaling thereby drives Tyrosinase-dependent melanin synthesis.
links.context_zh_TW: MC1R 活化下游的高 cAMP 會上調 Tyrosinase 和 eumelanogenic 程序。Tyrosinase 是限速酶，其誘導會產生保護性深色色素。因此 MC1R 信號傳導驅動依賴 Tyrosinase 的黑色素合成。

links.context: High levels of Advanced Glycation End Products impair wound healing by promoting inflammation, reducing nitric oxide activity, and causing vascular and neurological modifications. Because the effect operates through several mechanisms at once, AGE burden is a modifiable therapeutic target in diabetic and elderly patients with chronic wounds.
links.context_zh_TW: 高濃度的 Advanced Glycation End Products 會藉由促進發炎、降低一氧化氮活性，以及造成血管與神經修飾來損害傷口癒合。由於此作用同時透過多重機制進行，AGE 負擔是糖尿病與老年慢性傷口患者可調節的治療標的。

links.context: High levels or prolonged exposure to Nitric Oxide lead to the formation of Methemoglobin, which can cause Methemoglobinemia; this is why inhaled nitric oxide is listed among the common culprits of methemoglobin formation alongside dapsone, benzocaine, and rasburicase.
links.context_zh_TW: 高濃度或長時間暴露於 Nitric Oxide 會形成 Methemoglobin，可能導致 Methemoglobinemia；這也是吸入性 nitric oxide 與 dapsone、benzocaine、rasburicase 並列為 methemoglobin 形成常見原因的原因。

links.context: High uPAR expression correlates with poor prognosis in Breast Cancer, where uPAR drives invasion and metastasis by localizing proteolysis to the cell surface and activating latent MMPs. It is also induced by SASP signals, promoting paracrine invasion of neighbouring cancer cells, and soluble uPAR (suPAR) serves as a serum prognostic biomarker.
links.context_zh_TW: uPAR 表現偏高與 Breast Cancer 的不良預後相關；在該情境下，uPAR 藉由將蛋白水解作用定位到細胞表面並活化潛伏 MMP 而促進侵犯與轉移。它也受 SASP 訊號誘導，促進鄰近癌細胞的旁分泌侵犯，而可溶性 uPAR（suPAR）則作為血清預後生物標記。

links.context: High-dose, long-term creatine monohydrate supplementation (0.3-0.8 g/kg/day) is the standard therapy for AGAT and GAMT deficiencies: it can normalize brain creatine and phosphocreatine and improve or stabilize neurodevelopmental outcomes, especially when started early. SLC6A8 transporter deficiency responds poorly because cellular uptake itself is blocked.
links.context_zh_TW: 高劑量、長期的 creatine monohydrate 補充（0.3-0.8 g/kg/day）是 AGAT 與 GAMT 缺乏的標準療法：可使腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 恢復正常，並改善或穩定神經發育結果，尤其在早期開始時。SLC6A8 transporter 缺乏因細胞攝取本身受阻而反應較差。

links.context: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is a cornerstone mitohormetic stimulus: brief maximal efforts generate an acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation that trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）刺激：短暫的最大努力產生急性 ROS 峰值與乳酸累積，觸發粒線體生合成的總管 PGC-1α。

links.context: High-output nitric oxide from iNOS reacts with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. This is a functional trade-off of innate immune defense: the same NO burst that kills intracellular pathogens also generates a reactive secondary species that injures host tissue when NO output is excessive.
links.context_zh_TW: iNOS 產生的高產量 nitric oxide 會與 superoxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite，造成附帶的硝基化組織損傷。這是先天免疫防禦的功能性代價：殺死細胞內病原體的同一 NO 爆發，在 NO 輸出過量時也會產生傷害宿主組織的活性次級產物。

links.context: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) is a high-sensitivity assay for C-reactive protein, an acute-phase reactant whose circulating concentration rises with systemic inflammation. It is the preferred marker for low-grade, chronic inflammation in monitoring protocols.
links.context_zh_TW: 高敏感 C 反應蛋白（hs-CRP）是 C 反應蛋白的高敏感檢測，C 反應蛋白是循環濃度隨全身發炎升高的急性期反應物。它是監測方案中低度慢性發炎的首選標記。

links.context: High-throughput screening is the primary engine of modern drug discovery campaigns.
links.context_zh_TW: 高通量篩選是現代藥物發現的主要引擎。

links.context: Histamine Intolerance arises when histamine intake or endogenous release exceeds the body's degradative capacity, typically because intestinal Diamine Oxidase activity is reduced. The accumulated Histamine then produces allergic-like symptoms — headache, flushing, urticaria, tachycardia, abdominal pain, nausea and diarrhea — often after histamine-rich foods.
links.context_zh_TW: 當組織胺的攝取或內源性釋放超過身體的分解能力時，就會出現 Histamine Intolerance，而最典型的原因是腸道 Diamine Oxidase 活性下降。累積的 Histamine 隨後產生類過敏症狀——頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹、心悸、腹痛、噁心與腹瀉——常在食用高組織胺食物後出現。

links.context: Histone Acetylation is the best-studied Histone Modification and is generally associated with gene activation and an open Chromatin structure resembling Euchromatin. Marks are added by 'writers' such as HATs and removed by 'erasers' such as HDACs, so the acetylation state of a locus is dynamic rather than fixed.
links.context_zh_TW: Histone Acetylation 是研究最深入的 Histone Modification，一般與基因活化及開放的 Chromatin 結構（類似 Euchromatin）相關。標記由 HAT 等「寫入者」加上，再由 HDAC 等「擦除者」移除，因此某位點的乙醯化狀態是動態的而非固定的。

links.context: Histone Deacetylase enzymes such as the HDACs, acting together with Histone Methyltransferase enzymes, maintain the compact state of Heterochromatin by removing acetyl groups and depositing marks such as H3K9me3 on histone tails. Without this maintenance activity heterochromatic regions decondense and lose transcriptional repression.
links.context_zh_TW: HDAC 等 Histone Deacetylase 酵素與 Histone Methyltransferase 酵素共同維持 Heterochromatin 的緊密狀態，方式是移除乙醯基並在組蛋白尾端沉積如 H3K9me3 的標記。缺乏這些維持活性時，異染色質區域會解離並失去轉錄抑制。

links.context: Histone H3 is the most extensively modified member of the core Histone proteins, carrying acetylation, methylation, phosphorylation, ubiquitination and citrullination marks on its N-terminal tail. These Histone Modification marks read by bromodomain, chromodomain and PHD Finger reader domains regulate Gene Expression, DNA Repair, DNA Replication and Chromosome Condensation.
links.context_zh_TW: Histone H3 是核心 Histone 蛋白中修飾最密集者，其 N 端尾帶上帶有乙醯化、甲基化、磷酸化、泛素化與瓜胺酸化等標記。這些由 bromodomain、chromodomain 與 PHD Finger 讀取結構域辨識的 Histone Modification 標記，調控 Gene Expression、DNA Repair、DNA Replication 與 Chromosome Condensation。

links.context: Histone Modification on histone tails constitutes a central part of the epigenetic code that dictates whether the underlying DNA is accessible for Transcription or remains tightly packed. The specific combination of marks — the 'histone code' — is read by specialized proteins that recruit factors to either open or close the chromatin.
links.context_zh_TW: Histone Modification 發生在組蛋白尾端，是表觀遺傳密碼的核心組成，決定其下的 DNA 是否可供 Transcription 存取或維持緊密包裝。這些標記的特定組合——即「組蛋白密碼」——由專門蛋白質讀取，再招募因子以開啟或關閉染色質。

links.context: Histone crotonylation (Kcr) is deposited from crotonyl-CoA and generally marks active transcription. SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates, and decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as ETS1 to constrain neoplastic dissemination.
links.context_zh_TW: 組蛋白巴豆醯基化（Kcr）由巴豆醯-CoA 沉積，通常標記活躍的轉錄。SIRT3 具有相當的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化能力，選擇性地從特定組蛋白受質上去除巴豆醯基，並降低轉移相關位點如 ETS1 的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化以限制腫瘤擴散。

links.context: Homer1 (Homer homolog 1, also known as Vesl-1) is a postsynaptic scaffold protein at excitatory synapses that links Glutamate receptors to downstream signaling pathways. Because Homer1-positive puncta mark mature excitatory synapses, reduced Homer1 expression correlates with lower spine and synapse density.
links.context_zh_TW: Homer1（Homer homolog 1，又稱 Vesl-1）是興奮性突觸的突觸後支架蛋白，把 Glutamate 受體與下游訊息傳遞路徑連結起來。由於 Homer1 陽性的斑點可標記成熟的興奮性突觸，Homer1 表現下降便與樹突棘及突觸密度降低相關。

links.context: Honokiol activates SIRT3, which in turn deacetylates MnSOD at Lys68 and Lys122, dramatically increasing its ROS-scavenging activity and reducing mitochondrial oxidative stress. This makes Honokiol an indirect enhancer of MnSOD function and a strategy to restore dynamic Lys68 cycling rather than locking the acetylation switch.
links.context_zh_TW: Honokiol 活化 SIRT3，SIRT3 再於 Lys68 和 Lys122 去乙醯化 MnSOD，大幅提升其 ROS 清除活性並減少粒線體氧化壓力。這使 Honokiol 成為 MnSOD 功能的間接增強劑，也是恢復 Lys68 動態循環而非鎖定乙醯化開關的一種策略。

links.context: Honokiol attenuates inflammatory pain, reducing formalin-induced paw-licking behavior in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice. It blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA, glutamate, substance P, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), and decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in superficial laminae (I-II) of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses and hyperalgesia. Its analgesic effects are multifactorial, involving both the inflammatory cascade and glutamatergic/NMDA receptor pathways.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可減輕發炎性疼痛，降低福馬林誘發之發炎期的舔足行為及小鼠的熱痛覺過敏。它能阻斷由 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及前列腺素 E2（PGE2）引發的傷害性訊號傳遞，並降低福馬林誘發的 c-Fos 蛋白在 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的表現。與和厚朴酚相比，厚朴酚對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應與痛覺過敏更具選擇性。其鎮痛作用是多重因素共同造成的，同時涉及發炎級聯反應及麩胺酸能/NMDA 受體路徑。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol inhibits NF-kB activation downstream of PKC and MAPK, reducing TNF-alpha, NO, and COX-2 expression in macrophages, microglia, astrocytes, and dendritic cells. It also suppresses NF-kB/TGF-beta1 signaling partly via SIRT3, limiting fibrotic and inflammatory responses.
links.context_zh_TW: Honokiol 抑制 PKC 和 MAPK 下游的 NF-kB 活化，減少巨噬細胞、微膠質細胞、星狀細胞和樹突狀細胞中的 TNF-α、NO 和 COX-2 表達。它還部分透過 SIRT3 抑制 NF-kB/TGF-β1 信號，限制纖維化和發炎反應。

links.context: Honokiol inhibits NMDA-evoked cationic influx, blocking excessive calcium entry that would otherwise drive excitotoxic neuronal injury and seizures. In rat cerebellar granule cells, honokiol inhibited repetitive firing by blocking glutamate-, NMDA-, and K+-evoked cation influx, and intraperitoneal honokiol (1 and 5 mg/kg) increased seizure thresholds in NMDA-infusion models, being more potent than magnolol. In ischemic conditions honokiol also disrupts PSD95-nNOS coupling at the NMDA receptor postsynaptic complex, preventing neurotoxic nitric oxide production downstream of NMDA receptor activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚抑制 NMDA 誘發的陽離子內流，阻斷過量的鈣離子進入，否則這些鈣離子會驅動興奮毒性神經元損傷與癲癇發作。在大鼠小腦顆粒細胞中，厚朴酚透過阻斷麩胺酸、NMDA 及 K+ 誘發的陽離子內流來抑制重複放電，且腹腔注射厚朴酚（1 及 5 mg/kg）可提高 NMDA 輸注模型中的癲癇閾值，效力優於和厚朴酚。在缺血條件下，厚朴酚還會破壞 NMDA 受體突觸後複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯，防止 NMDA 受體活化下游之神經毒性一氧化氮產生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator of synaptic and extrasynaptic GABA_A receptors, increasing muscimol binding sites about three-fold and acting at the benzodiazepine site; its effects are far greater at delta-subunit-containing receptors (900-1100% response) than at alpha-beta-gamma receptors, and are blocked by bicuculline and flumazenil.
links.context_zh_TW: Honokiol 是突觸與外突觸 GABA_A receptor 的正向別構調節劑（positive allosteric modulator），使 muscimol 結合位點數約增加三倍，並作用於 benzodiazepine site；其效應在含 delta 次單元的受體上（900–1100% 反應）遠強於 alpha-beta-gamma 受體，且可被 bicuculline 與 flumazenil 阻斷。

links.context: Honokiol promotes non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and shortens sleep latency. In mouse studies, honokiol at 10 and 20 mg/kg significantly decreased sleep latency and increased the amount of NREM sleep without affecting REM sleep or EEG power density, and it excited sleep-promoting neurons in the ventrolateral preoptic area. These effects occur through the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor. The combined sleep-promoting and anxiolytic actions suggest a potential role for honokiol as an anesthetic adjunct.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可促進非快速動眼（NREM）睡眠並縮短入睡潛伏期。在小鼠研究中，厚朴酚在 10 及 20 mg/kg 劑量下顯著縮短入睡潛伏期並增加 NREM 睡眠量，但不影響 REM 睡眠或 EEG 功率密度，且會興奮腹外側視前區的促睡眠神經元。這些效應經由 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點產生。促睡眠與抗焦慮作用的結合，顯示厚朴酚可能作為麻醉輔助劑的潛力。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol reduces TNF-alpha secretion from LPS-stimulated mouse macrophages. Using lipopolysaccharide to induce inflammation, honokiol decreased tumor necrosis factor-alpha secretion, inhibited nitric oxide expression, blocked protein kinase C-alpha membrane translocation, and suppressed NF-kappaB activation in macrophages, with similar anti-inflammatory effects translated to human monocyte-derived dendritic cells. By dampening this central pro-inflammatory cytokine, honokiol mitigates the inflammatory cascade that drives neuroinflammation and inflammatory pain, making it a candidate adjunct for inflammatory conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚減少 LPS 刺激小鼠巨噬細胞分泌 TNF-alpha。使用脂多醣誘導發炎時，厚朴酚降低了腫瘤壞死因子-alpha 的分泌、抑制一氧化氮表現、阻斷蛋白激酶 C-alpha 膜轉位，並抑制巨噬細胞中的 NF-kappaB 活化，類似的抗發炎效果也延伸至人類單核球來源的樹突狀細胞。藉由抑制此核心促發炎細胞激素，厚朴酚緩解了驅動神經發炎與發炎性疼痛的發炎級聯反應，使其成為發炎性疾病的候選輔助用藥。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol significantly decreased beta-amyloid (Abeta)-induced neuronal death in neuronal culture models of Alzheimer's disease. In screening nine compounds from Chinese herbs for anti-Alzheimer's activity, only honokiol and magnolol markedly reduced Abeta-induced cell death. The protective mechanism involves decreased ROS production, suppressed intracellular calcium elevation, and inhibition of caspase-3 activity. A honokiol-containing extract of Magnolia officinalis also prevented lipopolysaccharide-induced memory deficiency via antineuroinflammatory and antiamyloidogenic effects, supporting honokiol's therapeutic potential in Alzheimer's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症的神經元培養模型中，厚朴酚顯著降低 β-類澱粉（Aβ）誘發的神經元死亡。在篩選九種中草藥化合物的抗阿茲海默活性時，僅厚朴酚與和厚朴酚能顯著減少 Aβ 誘發的細胞死亡。其保護機制涉及 ROS 產生減少、細胞內鈣離子升高受抑制及 caspase-3 活性受抑制。含厚朴酚的厚朴（Magnolia officinalis）萃取物也能透過抗神經發炎與抗類澱粉生成作用預防脂多醣誘發的記憶缺損，支持厚朴酚在阿茲海默症中的治療潛力。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol, a biphenolic neolignan, attenuates inflammatory pain in preclinical models. It reduces formalin-induced paw-licking in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice, blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA receptor, glutamate, substance P and prostaglandin E2, and decreases c-Fos expression in laminae I-II of the L4-L5 dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses.
links.context_zh_TW: Honokiol（一種雙酚類新木脂素）在臨床前模型中可減輕 inflammatory pain。它降低小鼠 formalin 誘發發炎期的舔足行為與熱痛覺過敏，阻斷由 NMDA receptor、glutamate、substance P 與 prostaglandin E2 引發的傷害性感覺訊號，並降低 L4–L5 背角第 I–II 層的 c-Fos 表現。相較於 magnolol，honokiol 對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應更具選擇性。

links.context: Hormesis is the named form of a biphasic dose-response in which low doses stimulate and high doses inhibit, tracing to the Arndt-Schulz law of 1887 and the coined Greek term for excitation in 1943. Because the same curve shape is described in a dozen other fields under different names, restricting a search to the word hormesis misses most of the relevant literature.
links.context_zh_TW: Hormesis 是一種具名的雙相劑量反應形式：低劑量刺激、高劑量抑制，其源流可回溯至 1887 年的 Arndt-Schulz 法則，以及 1943 年創造的希臘文「興奮」一詞。由於同一條曲線形狀在十多個其他領域以不同名稱描述，僅以 hormesis 一詞檢索會遺漏大部分相關文獻。

links.context: Human Endogenous Retrovirus RNA is reverse-transcribed in the cytoplasm of senescent cells, and the resulting HERV cDNA is sensed by the cGAS-STING Pathway to induce type I interferon and SASP. This parallels the mechanism by which LINE-1 cDNA activates innate immunity, and the interferon output feeds tissue-wide Inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: Human Endogenous Retrovirus 的 RNA 在衰老細胞的細胞質中被反轉錄，產生的 HERV cDNA 由 cGAS-STING Pathway 感知，進而誘導第一型干擾素與 SASP。這與 LINE-1 cDNA 啟動先天免疫的機制平行，而干擾素的輸出則餵養組織層級的 Inflammaging。

links.context: Human Endogenous Retrovirus proviruses are normally silenced by DNA Methylation and heterochromatin compaction. In senescence, age-related DNA demethylation and heterochromatin decompaction derepress these proviruses, driving transcription of viral proteins and retrovirus-like particles — which is why HERV expression is elevated in aged human tissues and in the serum of elderly individuals.
links.context_zh_TW: Human Endogenous Retrovirus 的前病毒通常受 DNA Methylation 與異染色質凝縮所抑制。在細胞衰老時，年齡相關的 DNA 去甲基化與異染色質解離使這些前病毒去抑制，驅動病毒蛋白與類反轉錄病毒顆粒的轉錄——這也是老化組織與老年人血清中 HERV 表現升高的原因。

links.context: Human Growth Hormone is a pituitary-derived peptide hormone whose principal downstream effector is IGF1. GH stimulates IGF-1 production, and IGF-1 in turn provides anti-apoptotic signals, promotes immune cell survival, and acts on thymic epithelial cells to stimulate IL-7 production that supports T cell survival and function.
links.context_zh_TW: Human Growth Hormone 是腦下垂體分泌的胜肽激素，其主要下游效應器為 IGF1。GH 促進 IGF-1 的產生，而 IGF-1 提供抗凋亡訊號、促進免疫細胞存活，並作用於胸腺上皮細胞以刺激 IL-7 的生成，進而支持 T 細胞的存活與功能。

links.context: Human Serum Albumin is an ideal nanocarrier because it is endogenous, non-immunogenic, biodegradable and binds hydrophobic drugs, improving Bioavailability of poorly soluble compounds. Albumin-bound nanoparticle technology is clinically validated (e.g. nab-paclitaxel) and exploits gp60/SPARC albumin uptake pathways enriched in tumors.
links.context_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是理想的奈米載體，因為它是內源性、非免疫原性、可生物降解且能結合疏水性藥物，可改善難溶化合物的 Bioavailability。白蛋白結合型奈米粒子技術已獲臨床驗證（如 nab-paclitaxel），並利用在腫瘤中富集的 gp60/SPARC 白蛋白攝取途徑。

links.context: Humanin expression is elevated in the skeletal muscles of CPEO patients, mirroring findings in MELAS. Because this upregulation most likely represents a compensatory stress response to mitochondrial dysfunction, the correlation between humanin levels and disease severity suggests humanin could serve as a biomarker and potential therapeutic target for mitochondrial disease.
links.context_zh_TW: CPEO 患者的骨骼肌中，Humanin 的表現量升高，與 MELAS 的發現一致。由於這種上調很可能代表對粒線體功能失調的代償性壓力反應，humanin 濃度與疾病嚴重程度之間的相關性，顯示 humanin 可作為粒線體疾病的生物標記與潛在治療標的。

links.context: Humanin inhibits Apoptosis in beta cells, and the protective effect is transduced in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner. This links mitochondrial-derived peptide signalling to cytokine resistance, opposing the IL-1beta, TNFalpha and Interferon-gamma driven cell death triggered by infiltrating Lymphocytes and activated Macrophages in type 1 diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Humanin 在 beta 細胞中抑制 Apoptosis，且其保護作用經由 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式傳遞。這把粒線體衍生胜肽訊號與細胞激素抗性連結起來，對抗第一型糖尿病中浸潤的 Lymphocytes 與活化的 Macrophages 所釋放 IL-1β、TNFα 與 Interferon-gamma 引發的細胞死亡。

links.context: Humanin restores ATP levels in lymphocytes from MELAS patients, preventing them from falling into energy deficiency. MELAS is a mitochondrial disorder strongly associated with the A3243G mutant mitochondrial DNA, a location immediately downstream of the 16S rRNA locus, and MELAS patients have defective ATP synthesis which causes tissue damage especially in high-energy-demand tissues. Notably, humanin levels are considerably elevated in skeletal muscles of patients with MELAS and chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia, likely because the stress conferred by these pathological states induces elevated humanin levels.
links.context_zh_TW: Humanin 恢復 MELAS 患者淋巴球中的 ATP 濃度，防止其陷入能量缺乏。MELAS 是一種粒線體疾病，與 A3243G 突變粒線體 DNA 密切相關，該位置緊鄰 16S rRNA 基因座下游，且 MELAS 患者的 ATP 合成有缺陷，造成組織損傷，尤其在高能量需求組織中。值得注意的是，MELAS 與慢性進行性外眼肌麻痺患者的骨骼肌中 humanin 濃度顯著升高，可能是因為這些病理狀態造成的壓力誘導了 humanin 濃度升高。
links.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

links.context: Humans and other vertebrates lack glutamate-gated chloride channels, which underpins the selective safety of avermectin/ivermectin at therapeutic doses.
links.context_zh_TW: Humans和其他脊椎動物缺乏穀氨酸門控氯離子通道，這支撐了阿維菌素/伊維菌素在治療劑量下的選擇性安全性。

links.context: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome is the primary human model for segmented progeria: children appear healthy at birth but show dramatic, rapid Aging within the first year (hair loss, thin skin, joint stiffness), and most die of heart disease or stroke — the same leading causes of death in the elderly. It is therefore a critical system for dissecting the biology of normal aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 是分節型早老症的主要人類模型：孩子在出生時看似健康，卻在第一年內就出現戲劇性且快速的 Aging（掉髮、皮膚變薄、關節僵硬），多數死於心臟病或中風——與老年人死亡的主因相同。因此它是剖析正常老化生物學的關鍵研究系統。

links.context: Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) is a diffusible non-radical reactive oxygen species formed as a byproduct of mitochondrial respiration, MAO activity, and superoxide dismutation. Alongside superoxide anion, it is one of the key reactive oxygen species that drive the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in vivo. Because H2O2 and the radicals derived from it accelerate catechol oxidation, elevated hydrogen peroxide shifts adrenaline away from its primary COMT- and MAO-mediated metabolic routes toward the minor adrenochrome pathway. This helps explain why adrenochrome formation increases under oxidative stress and why enzymes that remove H2O2, such as catalase, inhibit the reaction in experimental settings.
links.context_zh_TW: 過氧化氫（H2O2）是一種可擴散的非自由基活性氧物種，作為粒線體呼吸、MAO 活性與超氧歧化的副產物形成。與超氧陰離子並列，它是體內驅動 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome 的關鍵活性氧物種之一。由於 H2O2 及其衍生的自由基會加速兒茶酚氧化，升高的過氧化氫會將腎上腺素從其主要的 COMT 與 MAO 介導代謝途徑，轉向次要的 adrenochrome 途徑。這有助於解釋為何在氧化壓力下 adrenochrome 形成增加，以及為何在實驗環境中移除 H2O2 的酶（如 catalase）會抑制此反應。

links.context: Hydrogen peroxide-induced acetylation inhibits FOXO4 transactivation, and SIRT1 deacetylation reverses this, restoring FOXO4 activity and enhancing GADD45 alpha expression and resistance to oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: 過氧化氫誘發的乙醯化會抑制 FOXO4 的轉錄活化，而 SIRT1 的去乙醯化可逆轉此現象，恢復 FOXO4 活性並增強 GADD45 alpha 表現與對氧化壓力的抵抗力。

links.context: Hydroxocobalamin is the antidote of choice for cyanide poisoning: its hydroxyl ligand exchanges for cyanide to form nontoxic cyanocobalamin, excreted renally. This is a distinct indication from B12 repletion.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是氰化物中毒的首選解毒劑：其羥基配體與氰化物交換形成無毒的 cyanocobalamin，經腎排出。這是與 B12 補充不同的適應症。

links.context: Hydroxychloroquine is a 4-aminoquinoline derivative of chloroquine used clinically for malaria prophylaxis and treatment, for systemic lupus erythematosus, and as a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug in Rheumatoid Arthritis. Its immunomodulation works partly by interfering with antigen processing and endosomal Toll-like Receptor (TLR7/9) signaling. Chronic high-dose use risks irreversible retinopathy and rarely Cardiomyopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 chloroquine 的 4-胺基quinoline 衍生物，臨床上用於瘧疾的預防與治療、Systemic Lupus Erythematosus，以及作為 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的抗發炎性修飾藥物。其免疫調節作用部分來自干擾抗原處理與內體 Toll-like Receptor（TLR7/9）訊號。長期高劑量使用可能造成不可逆的視網膜病變，罕見情況下會引起 Cardiomyopathy。

links.context: Hydroxychloroquine is first-line systemic therapy for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: it reduces flare frequency and disease activity, and mechanistically it interferes with TLR7/9-dependent nucleic acid sensing that drives the type I interferon loop of the disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus 的一線全身性治療：可降低發作頻率與疾病活性，機制上則是干擾 TLR7/9 依賴的核酸辨識，而此路徑正是該病第一型干擾素迴圈的驅動力。

links.context: Hydroxyfenbendazole is a phase-I hydroxylated metabolite of fenbendazole generated by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP2J2 (with CYP2C19). After intravenous dosing in cattle more than 50% of the fenbendazole dose was recovered as hydroxyfenbendazole in excreta, making it the major excretory metabolite of the parent drug.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyfenbendazole 是 fenbendazole 的 phase-I 羥基化代謝物，由細胞色素 P450 酵素 CYP2J2（與 CYP2C19）生成。在牛靜脈給藥後，超過 50% 的 fenbendazole 劑量以 hydroxyfenbendazole 形式由排泄物回收，使其成為母藥的主要排泄代謝物。

links.context: Hydroxyfenbendazole is the hydroxylated derivative of the benzimidazole anthelmintic fenbendazole, representing its main phase-I metabolic fate. Because the parent compound fenbendazole is being studied for repurposed anticancer activity, characterizing its metabolite profile is part of defining the pharmacological entity that would be carried into oncology trials.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyfenbendazole 是 benzimidazole 驅蟲藥 fenbendazole 的羥基化衍生物，代表其主要的 phase-I 代謝去向。由於母藥 fenbendazole 正被研究作為抗癌再定位用途，闡明其代謝物譜系是界定將帶入腫瘤學試驗之藥理實體的一部分。

links.context: Hydroxyurea quenches the ribonucleotide reductase tyrosyl radical, starving cells of dNTPs. The resulting dNTP depletion causes replication fork stalling, DNA replication stress, and cell-cycle arrest or senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶的酪胺醯自由基，使細胞缺乏 dNTP。由此造成的 dNTP 耗竭會導致複製叉停滯、DNA 複製壓力以及細胞週期停滯或衰老。

links.context: Hydroxyurea stalls DNA Polymerase indirectly: by inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase it depletes dNTP pools, so replicative synthesis halts at replication forks. This indirect route makes it a mechanistic probe of nucleotide supply.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea（羥基脲）以間接方式使 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）停滯：它抑制核糖核苷酸還原酶而耗盡 dNTP 池，使複製合成在複製叉處停止。這條間接途徑使其成為研究核苷酸供應的機制探針。

links.context: Hyperglycemia is an abnormally high blood glucose concentration and a primary driver of pathological Glycation. Under hyperglycemic conditions the non-enzymatic reaction between sugars and proteins is greatly accelerated, causing rapid accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products — most apparent in insulin-independent tissues such as erythrocytes, peripheral nerve, endothelium, lens and kidney cells. Consequences include acceleration of Aging, diabetic complications such as neuropathy, nephropathy and retinopathy, and increased Oxidative Stress through glucose autoxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: Hyperglycemia 是血糖濃度異常升高，也是病理性 Glycation 的主要驅動力。在高血糖條件下，糖與蛋白質之間的非酵素性反應大幅加速，造成 Advanced Glycation End Products 迅速累積——在不依賴胰島素的組織中尤其明顯，例如紅血球、周邊神經、內皮、晶狀體與腎臟細胞。其後果包括加速 Aging、造成神經病變／腎病變／視網膜病變等糖尿病併發症，以及經由葡萄糖自氧化增加 Oxidative Stress。

links.context: Hyperlipidemia is a metabolic disorder of abnormally high circulating LDL cholesterol, total cholesterol and/or triglycerides with reciprocal reduction in HDL. It is a major modifiable risk factor for Atherosclerosis and Cardiovascular Disease, usually managed with Statins. In the longevity setting it is a tolerable class effect of rapalogs, but poorly justified in healthy anti-aging users, and it often co-occurs with Glucose Intolerance and Insulin Resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Hyperlipidemia 是循環中 LDL 膽固醇、總膽固醇與／或三酸甘油酯過高、且 HDL 反而降低的代謝異常。它是 Atherosclerosis 與 Cardiovascular Disease 的主要可改變危險因子，通常以 Statins 治療。在長壽領域它是 rapalogs 可耐受的類效應，但在健康抗老化使用者身上缺乏正當理由，且常與 Glucose Intolerance、Insulin Resistance 共同出現。

links.context: Hyperphosphorylated Tau detaches from microtubules, disrupting axonal transport and aggregating into insoluble fibrils (Neurofibrillary tangles) that impair mitochondrial trafficking and function; spread of tau pathology also correlates with cognitive decline and induces senescence-like states.
links.context_zh_TW: 過度磷酸化的 Tau 會自微管脫離，破壞軸突運輸並聚合成不溶性纖維（Neurofibrillary tangles），進而損害粒線體的運輸與功能；tau 病理的擴散也與認知衰退相關，並誘發類似 Senescence 的細胞狀態。

links.context: Hypertension is the persistent elevation of arterial blood pressure (≥140/90 mmHg), affecting roughly 1.39 billion people and standing as a major risk factor for Cardiovascular Disease, Stroke, Chronic Kidney Disease and Heart Failure. It both causes and results from Endothelial Dysfunction, and chronic pressure overload drives cardiac remodeling toward heart failure.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypertension 是動脈血壓持續升高（≥140/90 mmHg）的狀態，影響約 13.9 億人，是 Cardiovascular Disease、Stroke、Chronic Kidney Disease 與 Heart Failure 的主要危險因子。它既是 Endothelial Dysfunction 的成因也是結果，長期壓力過載會驅動心臟重塑而走向心衰竭。

links.context: Hypochlorous acid rapidly converts epinephrine to its quinone via near-diffusion-limited two-electron oxidation without metal catalysis. This direct oxidation is the strongest newly documented MPO-pathway step.
links.context_zh_TW: 次氯酸以近擴散極限的雙電子氧化快速將腎上腺素轉為醌，無需金屬催化。此直接氧化是 MPO 路徑中最強的新記載步驟。

links.context: Hypusination converts lysine K50 of eIF5A to hypusine through the sequential action of DHPS and DOHH. This unique post-translational modification is required for eIF5A to function in translation elongation, and it is the reason Spermidine can raise the synthesis of proteins such as TFEB.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypusination 透過 DHPS 與 DOHH 的連續作用，將 eIF5A 的 K50 離胺酸轉換為 hypusine。此獨特的轉譯後修飾是 eIF5A 執行轉譯延伸功能的必要條件，也是 Spermidine 能提高 TFEB 等蛋白質合成的原因。

links.context: IBRDC2 (also known as p53RFP or RNF144B) is a transcriptional target of p53: upon genotoxic stress p53 induces IBRDC2, which localizes to the mitochondrial outer membrane and ubiquitinates the pro-apoptotic BCL-2 family protein Bax. IBRDC2 thus translates p53 signalling into effector-phase mitochondrial death, and its loss can blunt apoptosis and cooperate with p53 inactivation to promote tumor survival and chemotherapy resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: IBRDC2（又稱 p53RFP 或 RNF144B）是 p53 的轉錄標的：在基因毒性壓力下 p53 誘導 IBRDC2，後者定位於粒線體外膜並使促凋亡的 BCL-2 家族蛋白 Bax 被 ubiquitination 修飾。IBRDC2 因此把 p53 訊號轉譯為效應期的粒線體死亡；其流失會削弱 apoptosis，並可能與 p53 失活協同促進腫瘤存活與化療抗藥性。

links.context: IC50 assumes a monotonic dose-response, whereas hormesis produces an inverted-U curve where a drug may be most effective at an intermediate concentration. Hormetic curves therefore challenge the IC50-based framework used in drug development.
links.context_zh_TW: IC50 假設單調劑量-反應，而毒物興奮效應產生倒 U 型曲線，藥物可能在中間濃度最有效。因此毒物興奮曲線挑戰藥物開發中基於 IC50 的框架。

links.context: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
links.context_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

links.context: ICAM-1, an endothelial/leukocyte adhesion molecule elevated during inflammation and aging, is a target of SIRT6-repressed NF-κB signaling; its upregulation opposes SIRT6's vascular-protective role and it is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT6 pathway in Table 3.
links.context_zh_TW: ICAM-1 是一種內皮/白血球黏附分子，在發炎和老化期間升高，是 SIRT6 抑制的 NF-κB 訊號的下游靶標；其上調對抗 SIRT6 的血管保護作用，並被列入表 3 中 SIRT6 途徑的負向調節因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: IDO1 depletes tryptophan and diverts it into the kynurenine pathway, which induces regulatory T cell differentiation. Two downstream routes converge on the same outcome: tryptophan scarcity activates the GCN2 amino-acid sensor, while kynurenine-pathway metabolites such as kynurenine ligate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor. This makes IDO1 an upstream immunosuppressive enzyme that promotes tolerance rather than effector immunity.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 會耗竭 tryptophan 並將其導入 kynurenine 途徑，進而誘導調節性 T 細胞分化。兩條下游路徑匯聚到相同結果：tryptophan 缺乏活化 GCN2 胺基酸感測器，而 kynurenine 途徑的代謝物（如 kynurenine）則結合 aryl hydrocarbon receptor。這使 IDO1 成為促進耐受而非效應免疫的上游抑制性酵素。

links.context: IDO1 is highly expressed in the placenta, lymph nodes, lungs, small intestine, and certain immune cells including dendritic cells, macrophages and monocytes, and it is inducible in many tissues during inflammation. In antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells, IDO1 modulates T cell responses peripherally through local tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, creating an immunosuppressive environment. This expression pattern underlies IDO1's roles in maternal-fetal tolerance (high placental expression), antimicrobial defense, regulation of inflammation and autoimmunity, and tumor immune escape.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 在胎盤、淋巴結、肺、小腸以及樹突細胞、巨噬細胞與單核球等特定免疫細胞中高度表現，並可在發炎期間於許多組織中被誘導。在樹突細胞等抗原呈現細胞中，IDO1 透過局部色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸生成在外周調節 T 細胞反應，創造免疫抑制環境。此表現模式構成 IDO1 在母胎耐受（胎盤高表現）、抗菌防禦、發炎與自體免疫調節以及腫瘤免疫逃逸中所扮演角色的基礎。

links.context: IDO1-mediated tryptophan depletion activates GCN2 in effector T cells, leading to G1 cell-cycle arrest, induction of apoptotic programs, T-cell anergy and functional inactivation, and Treg differentiation. GCN2 is thus the critical effector translating tryptophan depletion into T-cell growth arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 介導的 tryptophan 耗竭會在效應 T 細胞中活化 GCN2，導致 G1 期細胞週期阻滯、凋亡程式誘導、T 細胞無能與功能失活，以及 Treg 分化。因此 GCN2 是將 tryptophan 耗竭轉譯為 T 細胞生長阻滯的關鍵效應物。

links.context: IFN-gamma upregulates MHC class II on virtually all cell types, letting non-professional APCs such as epithelial, endothelial and fibroblast cells present antigen under inflammatory conditions; exogenous IFN-gamma or IFN-alpha is used to upregulate MHC II on tumor cells and improve immunogenicity.
links.context_zh_TW: IFN-γ 幾乎在所有細胞型態上都會上調 MHC 第二類分子，使上皮、內皮與纖維母細胞等非專業 APC 在發炎條件下也能呈現抗原；外加 IFN-γ 或 IFN-α 則被用於上調腫瘤細胞的 MHC II 並提升其免疫原性。

links.context: IFNAR1 is a transmembrane receptor subunit that partners with IFNAR2 to form the heterodimeric receptor for Type I Interferon (IFN-α/IFN-β). Within the CNS it is the critical conduit that links microglial Type I Interferon release to neuronal dysfunction: sustained IFN-I from activated Microglia engages neuronal IFNAR1, initiating JAK-STAT signaling that suppresses the MEF2C resilience program in tauopathy models.
links.context_zh_TW: IFNAR1 是跨膜受體次單元，與 IFNAR2 組成異源二聚體受體以接受 Type I Interferon（IFN-α/IFN-β）。在中樞神經系統中，它是將 Microglia 釋放的 Type I Interferon 連結至神經元功能障礙的關鍵通道：活化 Microglia 持續分泌 IFN-I 作用於神經元 IFNAR1，啟動 JAK-STAT 訊號，在 tauopathy 模型中抑制 MEF2C 抗逆境基因程式。

links.context: IGF-1/AKT signaling can modulate SIRT6 activity and expression in metabolic and intestinal-fitness contexts, generally promoting SIRT6-dependent metabolic and tumor-suppressive programs; Table 3 lists IGF-1/AKT among positive regulators of the SIRT6 pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: IGF-1/AKT 訊號可在代謝和腸道適能情境中調節 SIRT6 的活性和表現，通常促進 SIRT6 依賴的代謝和腫瘤抑制程序；表 3 將 IGF-1/AKT 列為 SIRT6 途徑的正向調節因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: IGF-Akt Signaling is a conserved pro-growth, pro-survival axis: IGF-1 binding to IGF1R triggers PI3K-dependent PIP3 generation, which recruits and phosphorylates the serine/threonine kinase Akt (via PDK1/mTORC2). Akt then phosphorylates targets such as mTOR, GSK3β and FOXOs to promote growth, survival and protein synthesis; sustained activation in cardiomyocytes pushes maladaptive cardiac hypertrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: IGF-Akt Signaling 是一條保守的促生長、促存活軸：IGF-1 與 IGF1R 結合後啟動 PI3K 依賴的 PIP3 生成，進而招募並磷酸化絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶 Akt（經由 PDK1/mTORC2）。Akt 接著磷酸化 mTOR、GSK3β 與 FOXO 等標的以促進生長、存活與蛋白質合成；在心肌細胞中持續活化會推動不適應性的心臟肥大。

links.context: IGF1 is the principal downstream mediator of Human Growth Hormone signaling: GH promotes somatic growth largely through IGF1 produced in the liver. IGF1 also acts on thymic stromal/Thymic Epithelial Cells to stimulate IL-7 production, providing anti-apoptotic signals that support thymopoiesis and T Lymphocyte survival and immune reconstitution. Chronically elevated GH/IGF1 signaling is associated with increased Cancer risk and shortened lifespan.
links.context_zh_TW: IGF1 是 Human Growth Hormone 訊號的主要下游介導者：GH 促進軀體生長很大程度上透過肝臟產生的 IGF1。IGF1 也作用於胸腺基質／Thymic Epithelial Cells 以刺激 IL-7 生成，提供抗凋亡訊號以支持 thymopoiesis 與 T Lymphocyte 存活及免疫重建。GH/IGF1 訊號慢性升高則與 Cancer 風險增加及壽命縮短相關。

links.context: IGFBP3 is the major circulating binding protein for IGF1 and a direct p53 target gene, a hallmark of the p53-dependent arm of the SASP. Secreted after DNA damage and during oncogene-induced senescence, it binds IGF1/IGF-2 with high affinity, limiting their availability to IGF1R and thereby dampening pro-proliferative growth-factor signaling; by restraining IGF signaling it reinforces senescence-associated growth arrest and helps suppress neighboring-cell proliferation.
links.context_zh_TW: IGFBP3 是 IGF1 的主要循環結合蛋白，也是直接的 p53 標的基因，為 SASP 之 p53 依賴分支的特徵。DNA 損傷與癌基因誘導衰老後分泌的 IGFBP3 以高親和力結合 IGF1/IGF-2，限制它們與 IGF1R 接觸，因而抑制促增殖性的生長因子訊號；藉由 restrain IGF 訊號，它強化與衰老相關的生長停滯並抑制鄰近細胞增殖。

links.context: IKKbeta is activated by phosphorylation at Ser177/Ser181 in its activation loop by TAK1 (MAP3K7) and other MAP3Ks. Upstream chains include TNF-α via RIPK1–TRAF2–TAK1, Interleukin 1β via MyD88–IRAK–TRAF6–TAK1, and LPS via TLR4. IKKβ also inactivates TSC1 in response to pro-inflammatory cytokines, leading to mTORC1 activation (Lee et al., 2007).
links.context_zh_TW: IKKbeta 由 TAK1（MAP3K7）與其他 MAP3K 在其活化環的 Ser177/Ser181 磷酸化而活化。上游鏈包括 TNF-α 經 RIPK1–TRAF2–TAK1、Interleukin 1β 經 MyD88–IRAK–TRAF6–TAK1，以及 LPS 經 TLR4。發炎性細胞激素也可使 IKKβ 與 TSC1 作用而使其失活，導致 mTORC1 活化（Lee et al., 2007）。

links.context: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
links.context_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

links.context: IL-1 Receptor signaling is the point through which all IL-1-targeting biologics act. Anakinra is recombinant IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1Ra), an endogenous competitive antagonist that binds IL-1R1 without recruiting IL-1RAcP, thereby blocking signaling; Canakinumab is an anti-IL-1β monoclonal antibody, and Rilonacept a soluble IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP fusion that intercepts ligands before they reach the receptor.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1 Receptor 訊號是所有 IL-1 標靶生物製劑發揮作用的關口。Anakinra 是重組的 IL-1 受體拮抗劑（IL-1Ra），一種內源性競爭性拮抗劑，能結合 IL-1R1 而不招募 IL-1RAcP，因而阻斷訊號；Canakinumab 是抗 IL-1β 單株抗體，Rilonacept 則是可溶性 IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP 融合蛋白，在配體到達受體前攔截之。

links.context: IL-1 blockade is the therapeutic mainstay of Autoinflammation: Canakinumab (anti-IL-1β) and Anakinra (IL-1Ra) treat CAPS, gout and other autoinflammatory conditions, while Rilonacept acts as an IL-1 trap. The CANTOS Trial showed that reducing IL-1β autoinflammation lowers cardiovascular events.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1 阻斷是 Autoinflammation 的治療主軸：Canakinumab（抗 IL-1β 抗體）與 Anakinra（IL-1Ra）用於 CAPS、痛風及其他自體發炎疾病，Rilonacept 則作為 IL-1 陷阱分子。CANTOS Trial 顯示降低 IL-1β 造成的自體發炎可減少心血管事件。

links.context: IL-10 is a homodimeric anti-inflammatory cytokine that signals through IL-10R1/IL-10R2, activating JAK/STAT and primarily phosphorylating STAT3. Nuclear STAT3 induces SOCS3 and BCL3 transcription, which suppress pro-inflammatory cytokine production and inhibit NF-κB activity. IL-10 also reduces the macrophage oxidative burst by inhibiting NADPH oxidase and downregulates MHC type II and co-stimulatory molecules to limit antigen presentation.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-10 是一種同源二聚體抗發炎細胞激素，透過 IL-10R1/IL-10R2 訊號，活化 JAK/STAT 並主要磷酸化 STAT3。進入細胞核的 STAT3 誘導 SOCS3 與 BCL3 轉錄，進而抑制促發炎細胞激素產生並抑制 NF-κB 活性。IL-10 也藉由抑制 NADPH oxidase 降低巨噬細胞的氧化爆發，並下調 MHC type II 與共刺激分子以限制抗原呈現。

links.context: IL-10 suppresses production of the pro-inflammatory cytokines TNFα, IL-12, IL-6 and IL-1β, thereby limiting excessive immune responses and tissue damage. It is produced by Macrophages, CD4+ T Cells, regulatory T cells and B Cells, is essential for mucosal immune tolerance (IL-10-deficient mice develop spontaneous colitis), and promotes Th2 differentiation while inhibiting Th1 responses — though excessive IL-10 can impair pathogen clearance and suppress CD8+ T-cell antitumor immunity.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-10 抑制促發炎細胞激素 TNFα、IL-12、IL-6 與 IL-1β 的產生，因而限制過度的免疫反應與組織損傷。它由 Macrophages、CD4+ T Cells、調節型 T 細胞與 B Cells 產生，對黏膜免疫耐受不可或缺（缺乏 IL-10 的小鼠會自發性結腸炎），並促進 Th2 分化、抑制 Th1 反應——但過量的 IL-10 也可能妨礙病原清除並壓抑 CD8+ T 細胞的抗腫瘤免疫。

links.context: IL-12 activates natural killer cells to secrete IFN-gamma and enhance cytotoxicity, providing early innate defense before a fully developed adaptive response is available.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-12 活化自然殺手細胞，使其分泌 IFN-gamma 並增強細胞毒性，在適應性免疫完全建立前提供先天的防禦。

links.context: IL-12 is secreted mainly by activated macrophages and dendritic cells responding to intracellular pathogens; the resulting IFN-gamma then feeds back to activate macrophage killing mechanisms, forming a self-reinforcing loop between innate and adaptive immunity.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-12 主要由受到細胞內病原體刺激而活化的巨噬細胞與樹突細胞分泌；所產生的 IFN-gamma 反過來活化巨噬細胞的殺傷機制，形成先天與適應性免疫之間自我強化的迴路。

links.context: IL-13 drives alternative (M2) macrophage polarization through STAT6 together with the co-activator PPARγ. This reprograms macrophages toward tissue repair and anti-helminth effector functions rather than classical pro-inflammatory activation.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-13 透過 STAT6 與共同活化因子 PPARγ 驅動巨噬細胞的 alternative（M2）極化，將巨噬細胞重新編程為偏向組織修復與抗蠕蟲效應功能，而非典型的促發炎活化。

links.context: IL-13 is secreted predominantly by activated Th2 cells, along with mast cells and ILC2s. Together with IL-4 it defines the type 2 immune axis underlying allergic inflammation, eosinophilic disease and fibrotic remodeling.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-13 主要由活化的 Th2 細胞分泌，另有肥大細胞與 ILC2。它與 IL-4 共同定義了第二型免疫軸，是過敏性發炎、嗜酸性疾病與纖維化重塑的基礎。

links.context: IL-13 promotes IgE class switching in B Cell alongside M2 macrophage polarization, linking type-2 immune programs to both humoral allergy and tissue repair.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-13 與 M2 巨噬細胞極化並肩，促進 B Cell（細胞）進行 IgE 類別轉換，將第二型免疫程序同時連結至體液性過敏與組織修復。

links.context: IL-18 is one of the cytokine components of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), where it contributes to inflammaging. Its release links inflammasome activation in senescent cells to chronic age-related inflammatory signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-18 是細胞衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的細胞激素成分之一，參與推動 inflammaging。其釋放將衰老細胞中的發炎小體活化與慢性發炎訊號連結起來。

links.context: IL-1R is the cell-surface receptor for the pleiotropic pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and IL-1α. Ligation by IL-1β recruits the adaptor MyD88 and the kinase IRAK, ultimately activating TRAF6 and the NF-κB cascade and driving transcription of TNF-α, IL-6, and additional IL-1β in a feed-forward inflammatory loop.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1R 是多效性促發炎細胞激素 IL-1β 與 IL-1α 的細胞表面受體。IL-1β 結合後會招募接合蛋白 MyD88 與激酶 IRAK，最終活化 TRAF6 與 NF-κB 級聯反應，驅動 TNF-α、IL-6 及更多 IL-1β 的轉錄，形成前饋式發炎迴路。

links.context: IL-1R1 is the primary signaling receptor for IL-1α and IL-1β, mediating the pro-inflammatory effects of both. Ligand binding recruits IL-1RAcP, forming a 1:1:1 heterotrimer whose TIR domains recruit MyD88, which recruits IRAK4 and IRAK1, triggering a cascade that activates TRAF6 and ultimately the IKK complex — leading to NF-κB nuclear translocation and MAPK/AP-1 activation and transcription of IL-6, TNFα and other inflammatory genes.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1R1 是 IL-1α 與 IL-1β 的主要訊號受體，介導兩者的促發炎作用。配體結合後招募 IL-1RAcP，形成 1:1:1 的異源三聚體，其 TIR 區域招募 MyD88；MyD88 再招募 IRAK4 與 IRAK1，啟動活化 TRAF6 並最終活化 IKK complex 的級聯反應——導致 NF-κB 核轉位、MAPK/AP-1 活化，以及 IL-6、TNFα 等發炎基因的轉錄。

links.context: IL-1α engages IL-1R on neighboring cells to activate MyD88-NF-kB signaling and induce paracrine arrest. IL-1R blockade restrains this spread, establishing the receptor as the obligate conduit of IL-1α-mediated senescence transmission.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 接合鄰近細胞的 IL-1R 以活化 MyD88-NF-κB 訊號並誘發旁分泌停滯。阻斷 IL-1R 抑制此擴散，確立該受體為 IL-1α 介導衰老傳遞的必要通道。

links.context: IL-1α expression is controlled translationally downstream of mTOR via RNA-binding proteins such as AUF1 and ZFP36L1 that stabilize SASP mRNAs, so mTOR activity sets how much IL-1α — and therefore how much of the SASP — a cell makes.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 的表現受 mTOR 下游的轉譯層級調控，透過 AUF1、ZFP36L1 等 RNA 結合蛋白穩定 SASP mRNA，因此 mTOR 活性決定細胞製造多少 IL-1α，進而決定 SASP 的量。

links.context: IL-22, a member of the IL-10 gene family, is produced mainly by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets. It mediates mucosal barrier maintenance through antimicrobial peptides and epithelial proliferation after tissue injury.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-22 屬於 IL-10 基因家族，主要由輔助型 T 細胞 17（TH17）與先天淋巴細胞亞群產生。它透過抗菌胜肽與上皮細胞增殖，在組織受損後維持黏膜屏障並促進修復。

links.context: IL-4 acts in autocrine and paracrine fashion to promote and maintain the Th2 phenotype by inducing GATA3 and suppressing T-bet and Th1 differentiation, thereby holding Th1 and Th2 lineages in mutual antagonism.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-4 以自分泌與旁分泌方式誘導 GATA3 並抑制 T-bet 與 Th1 分化，藉以促進並維持 Th2 表型，使 Th1 與 Th2 譜系處於相互拮抗的狀態。

links.context: IL-4 drives M2 alternative macrophage activation via STAT6 and the co-activator PPARγ, favoring wound healing and anti-helminth defense. The same polarization can be exploited by tumors, where IL-4-driven M2 tumor-associated macrophages create an immunosuppressive microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-4 透過 STAT6 與共同活化因子 PPARγ 驅動 M2 alternative 巨噬細胞活化，有利於傷口癒合與抗蠕蟲防禦。腫瘤也可利用同一極化途徑，由 IL-4 驅動的 M2 腫瘤相關巨噬細胞形成免疫抑制性微環境。
