links.context: IL-4 produced by Th2 cells inhibits IL-12 production and thereby blocks Th1 differentiation, establishing the reciprocal antagonism that keeps type 1 and type 2 immune axes mutually exclusive.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 Th2 細胞產生的 IL-4 抑制 IL-12 的產生，因而阻斷 Th1 分化，建立使第一型與第二型免疫軸互斥的相互拮抗關係。

links.context: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK-STAT signaling and STAT3. Because IL-6 is a major Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype component, the senescent secretome can actively reprogram neighboring cells toward a stem-like state - a dual-edged consequence linking senescence to tissue repair and to cancer stemness and therapy resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 是體內朝多能性與 stemness 重編程的核心驅動因子，透過 JAK-STAT Signaling 與 STAT3 作用。由於 IL-6 是 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的主要成分，衰老分泌組能主動將鄰近細胞重編程為幹樣狀態——這是連結衰老與組織修復、以及與 cancer stemness 和治療抗性之間的雙刃結果。

links.context: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK/STAT3 signaling, promoting a dedifferentiated, stem-like state in recipient cells. This underlies both wound-healing plasticity and, pathologically, cancer stemness, with STAT3 transcriptionally sustaining stemness factors such as OCT4, NANOG, and SOX2. The relationship links a core SASP cytokine to cell-fate reprogramming and is supported by reprogramming and cancer-stemness studies. Blocking IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling can interrupt this reprogramming.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 是透過 JAK/STAT3 訊號驅動體內朝多能性與幹性重編程的核心驅動者，在受體細胞中促進去分化、類幹細胞狀態。這構成傷口癒合可塑性，以及病理上、由 STAT3 轉錄持續幹性基因的癌症幹性。在衰老中，SASP 的 IL-6 可重編程鄰近細胞朝向幹樣身分，有助組織修復但也可能助長腫瘤幹性。它是 SASP—幹性軸的主要效應器。

links.context: IL-6, IL-1beta, and TGFbeta together drive naive T-cell differentiation toward the TH17 lineage, linking the SASP to adaptive immune reprogramming. TH17 cells recruited to senescent niches can amplify inflammation and promote autoimmunity-like responses. The relationship connects the secretome to a distinct effector T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and is a well-established cytokine combination in TH17 biology. This illustrates how the SASP shapes not only innate but also adaptive immune responses.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6、IL-1beta 與 TGFbeta 共同驅動初始 T 細胞朝 TH17 譜系分化，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫重編程。被招募至衰老巢的 TH17 細胞可放大發炎並促進類自體免疫反應。此關係將分泌組連結到特定 T 細胞子集偏移，擴展 SASP 超越先天活化的免疫學後果。它是衰老與自體免疫樣發炎間的橋樑。

links.context: IL-6R is the receptor arm of the autocrine IL-6 loop that sustains the SASP: secreted IL-6 activates JAK-STAT3, which promotes SASP gene expression and reinforces the senescent state without killing the cell. That is why IL-6R blockade and JAK inhibitors such as ruxolitinib act as senomorphics.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6R 是維持 SASP 的自分泌 IL-6 迴路中的受體端：分泌出的 IL-6 活化 JAK-STAT3，促進 SASP 基因表現並在不下殺細胞的情況下強化衰老狀態。這正是 IL-6R 阻斷與 JAK 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）可作為 senomorphic 藥物的原因。

links.context: INF2 is an endoplasmic-reticulum-bound inverted formin that acts at ER-mitochondria contact sites, coupling cytoskeletal remodeling at membrane contact sites to organelle division and thereby underpinning mitochondrial integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: INF2 是結合於內質網的 inverted formin，在內質網—粒線體接觸位點作用，將膜接觸位點的細胞骨架重塑與胞器分裂耦合，進而支撐粒線體完整性。

links.context: IP3R2 is an ER-resident calcium channel that interacts with FUNDC1 at mitochondria-associated ER membranes. FUNDC1 helps maintain MAM structural stability; when it is absent the MAM structure breaks down, impairing mitochondrial fission and producing abnormal calcium signaling — a mechanism relevant to calcium homeostasis failure in neurodegenerative disease.
links.context_zh_TW: IP3R2 是內質網上的鈣離子通道，在粒線體—內質網相鄰膜（MAM）處與 FUNDC1 相互作用。FUNDC1 有助於維持 MAM 的結構穩定；當其缺失時，MAM 結構解體，導致粒線體分裂受損與異常的鈣離子訊號——這是神經退化疾病中鈣恆定失衡的機制之一。

links.context: IP3R2 is enriched at mitochondria-ER contact sites, where it couples to the VDAC-MCU axis to enable direct calcium transfer from the ER into the mitochondrial matrix, shaping mitochondrial calcium dynamics relevant to senescence-associated matrix calcium overload.
links.context_zh_TW: IP3R2 富含於粒線體—內質網接觸位點，在該處與 VDAC-MCU 軸耦合，使鈣離子能由內質網直接轉移至粒線體基質，塑造與衰老相關粒線體基質鈣超載有關的鈣動態。

links.context: IRAK1 is a serine/threonine kinase downstream of IL-1R and TLR receptors that propagates MyD88-dependent signaling to NF-kB and MAPKs. Apigenin suppresses the SASP partly by inhibiting IL-1alpha signaling via IRAK1, IRAK4, p38 MAPK, and NF-kB.
links.context_zh_TW: IRAK1 是 IL-1R 與 TLR 受體下游的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，傳播 MyD88 依賴訊號至 NF-κB 與 MAPK。Apigenin 部分透過經 IRAK1、IRAK4、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB 抑制 IL-1α 訊號來壓制 SASP。

links.context: IRAK4 and IRAK1 are recruited to MyD88 through death-domain interactions within the myddosome scaffold. Placing these kinases in close proximity enables their trans-autophosphorylation and downstream TRAF6-mediated signaling, so IRAK4 sits immediately downstream of the MyD88 adaptor complex in TLR and IL-1R pathways.
links.context_zh_TW: IRAK4 與 IRAK1 透過 death domain 交互作用在 myddosome 支架中被 MyD88 招募。將這些激酶置於極近距離可促成其交互磷酸化與下游 TRAF6 媒介的訊號傳遞，因此 IRAK4 位於 TLR 與 IL-1R 訊號路徑中 MyD88 適應體複合體的緊密下游。

links.context: IRAK4 is the proximal kinase of MyD88-dependent IL-1R/TLR signaling that recruits and activates IRAK1 to drive NF-kB and MAPK activation. Both are inhibited by apigenin to suppress the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: IRAK4 是 MyD88 依賴 IL-1R/TLR 訊號的近端激酶，招募並活化 IRAK1 以驅動 NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化。兩者皆被 apigenin 抑制以壓制 SASP。

links.context: IRE1 is activated by ER Stress: accumulation of unfolded proteins in the lumen triggers its kinase/RNase activity, launching the unfolded protein response branch that restores proteostasis. IRE1α, PERK, and ATF6 branches are also engaged as hormetic proteostasis responses.
links.context_zh_TW: IRE1 由 ER Stress（內質網壓力）活化：腔內未摺疊蛋白累積會觸發其激酶／RNase 活性，啟動恢復蛋白質穩定性的未摺疊蛋白反應分支。IRE1α、PERK 與 ATF6 分支也會作為 hormetic 蛋白穩定性反應而被啟動。

links.context: IRF3 drives transcription of type I interferon genes after being phosphorylated by TBK1 downstream of STING or MAVS. This is the branch of SASP regulation that produces the interferon component of the secretome and, in deep senescence, the late interferon-dependent reinforcement of the inflammatory programme. Interferon released from senescent cells can act on neighbouring cells through IFNAR-JAK-STAT signalling, reinforcing interferon-stimulated gene expression and contributing to paracrine senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: IRF3 在 STING 或 MAVS 下游被 TBK1 磷酸化後，驅動第一型干擾素基因轉錄。這是 SASP 調控中產生 secretome 干擾素成分的分支，並在深度衰老中形成晚期依賴干擾素的發炎程序強化。衰老細胞釋出的干擾素可經 IFNAR-JAK-STAT 訊號作用於鄰近細胞，強化干擾素刺激基因表現並促成旁分泌衰老。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: IRS-2 is a cytosolic adapter phosphorylated by the insulin/IGF-1 receptor that bridges receptor activation to PI3K-Akt signaling, the pathway controlling glucose homeostasis and beta-cell function. Impaired IRS-2 signaling is a contributor to insulin resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: IRS-2 是由胰島素/IGF-1 受體磷酸化的細胞質轉接蛋白，負責把受體活化橋接到控制葡萄糖恆定與 β 細胞功能的 PI3K-Akt 訊號。IRS-2 訊號受損是造成胰島素阻抗的因素之一。

links.context: ISG15 is an interferon-inducible ubiquitin-like modifier that, in senescence, is induced by p16 overexpression and marks a distinct p53-dependent SASP profile enriched for interferon-stimulated genes. Its ISGylation and secreted cytokine activities reinforce a type I interferon state and promote paracrine senescence and immune surveillance.
links.context_zh_TW: ISG15 是干擾素誘導的類泛素修飾蛋白，在細胞衰老中由 p16 過度表現所誘導，標記出一種依賴 p53、富含干擾素刺激基因的獨特 SASP 圖譜。其 ISG 化與分泌型細胞激素活性強化第一型干擾素狀態，並促進旁分泌衰老與免疫監視。

links.context: ISGs mark pro-inflammatory glial subpopulations and are co-induced with pro-inflammatory cytokines in activated microglia and astrocytes; ISG induction also characterizes an IFN-I–enriched microglial subset linked to synapse loss, distinct from the canonical disease-associated microglia program.
links.context_zh_TW: ISG 標記促發炎膠細胞次族群，並在活化的 microglia 與星狀膠細胞中與促發炎細胞激素共同被誘導；ISG 的誘導也定義了一個富含 IFN-I、與突觸喪失相關的 microglia 亞群，與典型的 disease-associated microglia 程式相區別。

links.context: Iba1 is the standard immunohistochemical marker for microglia in the central nervous system. Its expression increases with microglial activation, and Iba1 immunostaining reveals microgliosis in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Iba1 是中樞神經系統微膠質細胞的標準免疫組織化學標記。其表現隨微膠質活化而增加，Iba1 免疫染色揭示神經退化與神經發炎中的微膠質增生。

links.context: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
links.context_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

links.context: Ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy — confusion, hallucination and coma — is attributed to its chloroacetaldehyde metabolite and is effectively reversed by intravenous methylene blue (50 mg every 4-6 h), which restores the mitochondrial electron transport that the toxic metabolite inhibits. Prophylactic dosing is used in high-risk patients.
links.context_zh_TW: Ifosfamide 引發的腦病變——意識混亂、幻覺與昏迷——歸因於其代謝物 chloroacetaldehyde，並可被靜脈注射 methylene blue（每 4–6 小時 50 mg）有效逆轉；methylene blue 可恢復被該毒性代謝物抑制的粒線體電子傳遞。高風險患者會使用預防性給藥。

links.context: IgE is the antibody isotype that B Cell produce after IL-4/IL-13-driven class switching; this irreversible switch commits the B cell line to allergy-mediating antibody output.
links.context_zh_TW: IgE 是 B Cell（B 細胞）在 IL-4/IL-13 驅動類別轉換後所產生的抗體同型；這個不可逆的轉換使該 B 細胞系專職製造媒介過敏的抗體。

links.context: IgE mediates allergy and anti-parasite immunity: it arms mast cells and basophils through FcεRI, and allergen crosslinking of receptor-bound IgE triggers histamine release and the allergic inflammation cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: IgE 媒介過敏與抗寄生蟲免疫：它透過 FcεRI 為肥大細胞與嗜鹼性球武裝，而受體結合的 IgE 被過敏原交聯時，即觸發組織胺釋放與過敏性發炎級聯反應。

links.context: IkappaBalpha is the cytosolic inhibitor that sequesters NF-kB (p65/p50) in the cytoplasm. Signal-induced degradation of IkappaBalpha permits NF-kB nuclear translocation and transcription of inflammatory genes including SASP factors.
links.context_zh_TW: IκBα 是將 NF-κB（p65/p50）隔離在細胞質的細胞質抑制劑。訊號誘導的 IκBα 降解使 NF-κB 得以核轉位並轉錄包括 SASP 因子在內的發炎基因。

links.context: Imatinib revolutionized the treatment of chronic myeloid leukemia through BCR-ABL inhibition and is standard therapy for KIT-mutant GIST, alongside the co-target PDGFR. It is a foundational precision-oncology agent.
links.context_zh_TW: Imatinib 透過抑制 BCR-ABL 徹底改變了慢性骨髓性白血病的治療，並與其共同標的 PDGFR 一同成為 KIT 突變型 GIST 的標準治療。它是精準腫瘤學的奠基性藥物。

links.context: Immune evasion is a hallmark of cancer whereby cells subvert immune surveillance through checkpoint molecules and an immunosuppressive milieu. The tumor microenvironment is a constellation of elements that can exclude or tolerize cytotoxic lymphocytes, reinforcing evasion.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫逃逸是癌症的特徵，細胞透過檢查點分子與免疫抑制環境規避免疫監視。腫瘤微環境是能排除或耐受化細胞毒性淋巴球的元素集合，強化逃逸。

links.context: Immunometabolism examines how metabolic pathways such as Autophagy, Glycolysis and OxPhos regulate immune cell function and differentiation. Selective Autophagy is central to it: it modulates immunity through metabolic reprogramming and facilitates energy metabolism during effector T Cell activation.
links.context_zh_TW: Immunometabolism 研究 Autophagy、Glycolysis 與 OxPhos 等代謝途徑如何調節免疫細胞功能與分化。Selective Autophagy 是其核心：它透過代謝重編程調節免疫，並在效應型 T Cell 活化期間促進能量代謝。

links.context: Immunotherapy is routinely combined with Chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and targeted agents. Chemotherapy supplies cytolytic tumor killing and antigen release, while chemotherapy-driven NAD+ loss shifts the metabolic context that influences treatment response.
links.context_zh_TW: Immunotherapy（免疫療法）常與 Chemotherapy（化學治療）、放射治療與標靶藥物合併使用。化療提供細胞溶解性的腫瘤殺傷與抗原釋放，而化療造成的 NAD+ 流失則改變影響治療反應的代謝背景。

links.context: Impaired Mitochondrial Quality Control is a central feature of Senescence: senescent cells show reduced mitophagy, downregulated DRP1/FIS1, altered fusion dynamics, and accumulation of dysfunctional elongated mitochondria that produce excess ROS and feed the SASP via NLRP3 and JNK.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Quality Control 受損是 Senescence 的核心特徵：衰老細胞的 mitophagy 減少、DRP1/FIS1 下調、融合動態改變，並累積過度產生 ROS 的功能異常細長粒線體，經 NLRP3 與 JNK 促進 SASP。

links.context: Impairment of glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, driven by insulin resistance, lipotoxicity and oxidative stress, produces glucose intolerance and type 2 diabetes. AMPK and mTOR tune beta-cell mass and secretory capacity, while sirtuins and NAD+ influence insulin secretion and beta-cell survival.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 insulin resistance、lipotoxicity 與氧化壓力造成的 glucose-stimulated insulin secretion 損傷，會導致 glucose intolerance 與第二型糖尿病。AMPK 與 mTOR 調節 β 細胞的量與分泌能力，而 sirtuins 與 NAD+ 則影響 insulin 分泌與 β 細胞存活。

links.context: In 5xFAD mice, microglial cGAS deletion increases recruitment of Microglia to amyloid plaques and enhances Aβ clearance while suppressing IFN-I signaling — establishing that cGAS-STING inhibition can uncouple neurotoxic inflammation from beneficial phagocytosis, and making the model a testbed for cGAS and STING inhibitors.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 5xFAD 小鼠中，微膠細胞的 cGAS 剔除會增加 Microglia 被招募至類澱粉樣斑塊並提升 Aβ 清除，同時抑制 IFN-I 訊號——證明抑制 cGAS-STING 可將神經毒性發炎與有益的吞噬作用解耦，也使此模型成為測試 cGAS 與 STING 抑制劑的平台。

links.context: In C. elegans, mitochondrial dysfunction caused by protein misfolding alters the subcellular localization of the transcription factor ATFS-1. In healthy mitochondria, ATFS-1 is imported into the organelle and degraded by the Lon protease. During stress, ATFS-1 instead traffics to the nucleus to drive transcription of genes involved in the coordinated UPRmt response. This import-versus-nuclear-translocation decision makes protein import a readout of mitochondrial health, a paradigm the review argues is extended in mammals by mechanisms involving DELE1 processing and PINK1 accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在線蟲中，蛋白質錯誤摺疊引起的粒線體功能障礙會改變轉錄因子ATFS-1的亞細胞定位。在健康的粒線體中，ATFS-1被輸入胞器內並由Lon蛋白酶降解。在壓力期間，ATFS-1則改而運輸至細胞核，驅動協調性UPRmt反應相關基因的轉錄。這種「輸入粒線體」與「轉位至細胞核」的抉擇，使蛋白質輸入成為粒線體健康狀態的讀數；該綜述主張此範式在哺乳類中經由涉及DELE1加工與PINK1累積的機制獲得延伸。

links.context: In C57BL/6J mice prematurely aged by sublethal whole-body irradiation (WBI), intraperitoneal apigenin partially but significantly reversed physical dysfunction and improved exercise performance: grip strength, hanging endurance, rotarod duration and balance-beam crossing were all restored relative to vehicle. Apigenin also reversed WBI-associated graying fur and age-related expansion of pulmonary alveoli, and improved spleen white pulp architecture.
links.context_zh_TW: 在由亞甲基全身照射（WBI）導致的C57BL/6J小鼠早期衰老模型中，腹腔注射阿苯吡喃醇部分但顯著地逆轉了身體功能障礙，並改善了運動表現：握力、懸吊耐力、滾筒時間和平衡板越野均恢復至與藥物控制組相比較，阿苯吡喃醇還逆轉了WBI引起的毛髮灰白和肺泡擴大，並改善脾臟白 pulp 結構。

links.context: In Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance through ROS buffering. By boosting mitochondrial antioxidant capacity — via MnSOD deacetylation and IDH2-driven NADPH production — SIRT3 protects leukemic cells from the oxidative damage imposed by cytotoxic chemotherapy, a tumour-supportive role that contrasts with its tumour-suppressive action elsewhere.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia 中，SIRT3 透過 ROS 緩衝促成代謝適應並賦予化療抗藥性。SIRT3 藉由提升粒線體抗氧化能力——經由 MnSOD 去乙醯化與 IDH2 驅動的 NADPH 生成——保護白血病細胞免受細胞毒性化療所造成的氧化傷害，這種促腫瘤作用與其在其他情境下的抑腫作用形成對比。

links.context: In HT-22 cells assayed on the Seahorse XF24, Methylene blue increased Oxygen Consumption Rate and reduced extracellular acidification rate versus vehicle, even when respiration was clamped with Oligomycin before FCCP. This shows Methylene blue sustains electron transport and suppresses anaerobic glycolysis independently of ATP synthase; 2-Chlorophenothiazine and Chlorpromazine were inert, so the effect is specific to the phenothiazine cation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Seahorse XF24 上檢測的 HT-22 細胞中，Methylene blue 相較溶劑對照可提高耗氧量並降低細胞外酸化率，即使在 FCCP 之前已用 Oligomycin 箝制呼吸亦然。這顯示 Methylene blue 可獨立於 ATP 合成酶維持電子傳遞並抑制無氧糖解；而 2-Chlorophenothiazine 與 Chlorpromazine 則無此效應，證明該作用對吩噻嗪陽離子具有專一性。

links.context: In Huntington's disease the OPTN-Rab8 interaction is compromised by mutant huntingtin (mHtt). Because lysosomes are primarily in the cell body, failure to deliver mitochondria-containing autophagosomes there blocks autophagic flux, so mutant huntingtin produces a mitophagy defect through its disruption of Rab8-mediated transport.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Huntington's disease 中，突變的 huntingtin (mHtt) 會破壞 OPTN–Rab8 的交互作用。由於溶小體主要位於細胞體，無法將含粒線體的自噬體送達該處就會阻斷自噬通量，因此突變 huntingtin 透過破壞 Rab8 媒介的運輸而造成 mitophagy 缺陷。

links.context: In Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis, Drosha and AIM2 protein are both elevated in alveolar macrophages, and Drosha deficiency suppresses AIM2 inflammasome-dependent caspase-1 activation and IL-1β/IL-18 secretion, placing the Microprocessor complex upstream of the AIM2 inflammasome.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis 中，肺泡巨噬細胞的 Drosha 與 AIM2 蛋白皆升高；Drosa 缺失會抑制 AIM2 inflammasome 相關的 caspase-1 活化與 IL-1β/IL-18 分泌，顯示 Microprocessor complex 位於 AIM2 inflammasome 上游。

links.context: In J774, THP-1 and mouse peritoneal macrophages, Fe/ascorbate-induced oxidative stress impairs ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux. Resveratrol (0-25 µM) restores HDL3-mediated efflux under oxidative stress in a dose-dependent manner, which is part of its proposed atheroprotective action — and a direct example of redox control of macrophage lipid handling.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 J774、THP-1 與小鼠腹腔巨噬細胞中，Fe/ascorbate 誘發的氧化壓力會損害 ABCA1 媒介的膽固醇外流。Resveratrol（0-25 µM）以劑量依賴方式在氧化壓力下恢復 HDL3 媒介的外流，這是其被提出的抗動脈粥狀硬化作用的一部分——也是氧化還原調控巨噬細胞脂質處理的直接例子。

links.context: In K-RAS mutated cancers, hyperactive ERK1/2 phosphorylates and inactivates PTPN5, locking BAK in its inactive phosphorylated state and providing resistance to apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 K-RAS 突變的癌症中，過度活化的 ERK1/2 磷酸化並使 PTPN5 失活，將 BAK 鎖定於其不活化的磷酸化狀態，從而產生對凋亡的抗性。

links.context: In Klotho-deficient premature-aging mice, excessive mTORC1 activation drives exhaustion of mesenchymal stem cells and bone abnormalities; rapamycin inhibition of mTORC1 improves mesenchymal stem-cell function in these models. Because both Klotho elevation and mTORC1 inhibition are pro-longevity, rapamycin engages the same stem-cell and homeostasis axis compromised in Klotho deficiency.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Klotho 缺陷的早衰小鼠中，過度 mTORC1 活化會驅動間質幹細胞耗竭與骨骼異常；rapamycin 對 mTORC1 的抑制可在這些模型中改善間質幹細胞功能。由於 Klotho 上升與 mTORC1 抑制皆具促進長壽的作用，rapamycin 作用於 Klotho 缺陷所破壞的同一條幹細胞／恆定軸。

links.context: In MYC-high cancer cells, glutamine anaplerosis becomes the primary carbon source for the TCA cycle: MYC enhances glutaminolysis, promoting influx of glutamine-derived α-ketoglutarate into the cycle. This is essential because TCA intermediates are continuously extracted for biosynthesis, and the sustained cycle supplies both reducing equivalents for the respiratory chain and biosynthetic precursors.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 MYC 高表現的癌細胞中，glutamine anaplerosis 成為 TCA cycle 的主要碳來源：MYC 強化 glutaminolysis，促進 glutamine 衍生的 α-Ketoglutarate 流入循環。這是必要的，因為 TCA 中間產物持續被抽用於生物合成，而維持的循環同時供應呼吸鏈所需的還原型當量與生物合成前驅物。

links.context: In Ornithine Aminotransferase (OAT) Deficiency, loss of ornithine catabolism causes massive ornithine accumulation (plasma 10–20× normal), and the elevated ornithine inhibits Arginine Glycine Amidinotransferase, the first enzyme in endogenous Creatine biosynthesis. This product-inhibition mechanism explains the secondary creatine depletion that distinguishes OAT deficiency from isolated ornithine excess.
links.context_zh_TW: 在鳥胺酸轉氨酶缺乏症（Ornithine Aminotransferase (OAT) Deficiency）中，鳥胺酸分解代謝喪失造成鳥胺酸大量累積（血漿為正常的 10–20 倍），升高的鳥胺酸會抑制精胺酸甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（Arginine Glycine Amidinotransferase），即內源性肌酸（Creatine）生合成的第一個酵素。這種產物抑制機制解釋了使 OAT 缺乏症有別於單純鳥胺酸過量的次發性肌酸耗乏。

links.context: In PREMOTE the gut microbiome mediates the observed metabolic benefit: berberine's roughly 1% HbA1c reduction tracked with compositional and metabolite changes, and the enriched taxa included Akkermansia muciniphila, Bifidobacterium, and SCFA-producing Lactobacillus. This supports berberine's high-intraluminal-exposure model, in which activity resides in the gut lumen independently of systemic absorption.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 PREMOTE 試驗中，腸道微生物群是所觀察到代謝效益的介導者：Berberine 約 1% 的 HbA1c 下降與微生物組成及代謝物的改變相對應，被富集的類群包括 Akkermansia muciniphila、Bifidobacterium 以及產 SCFA 的 Lactobacillus。這支持 Berberine 的高腸腔暴露模型——其活性存在於腸道管腔內，獨立於全身吸收而作用。

links.context: In Parkinson's Disease, Neuroinflammation is anatomically restricted to neuromelanin-rich nuclei (Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta, Locus Coeruleus), implicating Neuromelanin released from dying neurons as a damage-associated molecular pattern that primes microglia and sustains the inflammatory loop.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，Neuroinflammation 在解剖上侷限於富含 neuromelanin 的核團（Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta、Locus Coeruleus），顯示由死亡神經元釋出的 Neuromelanin 是啟動小膠細胞並維持發炎迴路的損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）。

links.context: In Pérez et al. (Aging Cell 2009), systemic overexpression of MnSOD (with CuZnSOD, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) did not extend mouse lifespan. MnSOD's contribution is essentially catalytic — it must sit inside the hormetic window (the K68 'Goldilocks' acetylation dial), and its overexpression buffers ROS without unlocking new signal.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Pérez et al.（Aging Cell 2009）中，全身性 MnSOD（與 CuZnSOD、catalase、glutathione peroxidase）過度表現並未延長小鼠壽命。MnSOD 的貢獻本質上是催化性的——必須落在荷爾蒙窗口內（K68「金髮姑娘」乙醯化旋鈕），過度表現只是線性緩衝 ROS，不會開啟新訊號。

links.context: In Vasoplegic Shock and Septic Shock, pathologic NO overproduction causes refractory hypotension. Methylene blue restores vascular tone therapeutically by inhibiting both nitric oxide synthase and Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase, lowering cGMP and thereby producing vasoconstriction as rescue when catecholamine Vasopressors fail.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Vasoplegic Shock 與 Septic Shock 中，病理性 NO 過量製造造成 refractory hypotension。Methylene blue 藉由抑制 nitric oxide synthase 與 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase 降低 cGMP，恢復血管張力並產生治療性的 vasoconstriction，作為 catecholamine 類 Vasopressors 失效時的救援療法。

links.context: In Vasoplegic Shock, standard vasopressors may fail because low systemic vascular resistance plus nitric-oxide–mediated vascular hyporesponsivity leaves vessels unresponsive even to high-dose catecholamines. Rescue strategies target the NO axis instead, e.g. methylene blue inhibiting soluble guanylyl cyclase to restore vascular tone.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Vasoplegic Shock 中，標準 Vasopressors 可能失效，因為全身血管阻力偏低加上 nitric-oxide 介導的血管低反應性，使血管即使面對高劑量 catecholamines 也無反應。救援策略因此轉向 NO 軸，例如 methylene blue 抑制 soluble guanylyl cyclase 以恢復血管張力。

links.context: In Western diet-fed mice, increasing dietary isoleucine promotes weight gain, fat accretion, glucose intolerance and insulin resistance, effects that parallel the human epidemiology linking circulating isoleucine to obesity, elevated body mass index and increased mortality risk.
links.context_zh_TW: 在西方飲食餵養的小鼠中，增加膳食 isoleucine 會促進體重增加、脂肪堆積、葡萄糖耐受不良與胰島素阻抗，這些效應與人類流行病學中循環 isoleucine 連結肥胖、BMI 升高及死亡風險增加的結果相符。

links.context: In a dextran sodium sulfate colitis mouse model, NMN given by gavage (1 mg/g body weight) reversed gut dysbiosis by increasing microbial abundance and diversity and reshaping community composition. Long-term treatment enriched butyric-acid-producing bacteria such as Ruminococcaceae UCG-014, Prevotellaceae NK3B31 and Akkermansia muciniphila while decreasing potentially harmful taxa including Bilophila and Oscillibacter.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 dextran sodium sulfate 結腸炎小鼠模型中，經由灌胃給予 NMN（1 mg/g 體重）可逆轉 gut dysbiosis，增加微生物豐富度與多樣性並重塑群落組成。長期處理會富集產生丁酸的細菌（如 Ruminococcaceae UCG-014、Prevotellaceae NK3B31 與 Akkermansia muciniphila），並減少 Bilophila 與 Oscillibacter 等潛在有害類群。

links.context: In a screen of 526 oncology drugs across triple-negative breast cancer cell lines, mubritinib showed the highest MYC selectivity, with the largest drug sensitivity difference between MYChigh and MYClow groups. Even at 10 nM it induced MYC-associated cell death under glutamine-deprived conditions, supporting dose de-escalation studies in MYChigh cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 526 種腫瘤藥物對 triple-negative breast cancer 細胞系的篩選中，mubritinib 展現最高的 MYC 選擇性，MYChigh 與 MYClow 組之間的藥物敏感性差值最大。即使在 10 nM 的低濃度下，它也能在 glutamine 缺乏條件下誘發 MYC 相關的細胞死亡，支持在 MYChigh 癌症中進行劑量遞減研究。

links.context: In addition to NF-kB activation, the interaction of advanced glycation end products with RAGE activates NADPH oxidase, a complex of enzymes that produces superoxide. When this oxidase complex is upregulated, it increases intracellular oxidative stress. The sudden increase in oxidative stress generated by NADPH oxidase in response to AGE-RAGE interaction can itself activate NF-kB, reinforcing pro-inflammatory signaling. This pathway provides a direct biochemical link between glycation and oxidative stress, explaining why AGEs are considered pro-oxidant agents and why glycoxidative damage and oxidative markers frequently accumulate together in aging tissues and in diabetic vasculature.
links.context_zh_TW: In addition to NF-kB activation，advanced glycation end products與RAGE的interaction亦activates NADPH oxidase——一個produces superoxide的enzymes complex。當此oxidase complex is upregulated，它increases intracellular oxidative stress。NADPH oxidase因應AGE-RAGE interaction而generated的oxidative stress sudden increase，本身即可activate NF-kB，reinforcing pro-inflammatory signaling。此pathway provides a direct biochemical link between glycation與oxidative stress，explaining why AGEs are considered pro-oxidant agents，以及為何glycoxidative damage與oxidative markers frequently accumulate together in aging tissues與diabetic vasculature。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: In adrenochrome handling, Aminoguanidine is the hydrazine-class reagent used to stabilize the unstable o-quinone of Adrenochrome by conventional derivatization, forming Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine. That derivative is a Hemostatics agent and the central modulator of the SASP-Remodeling Aminochrome Complex.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 adrenochrome 的處理中，Aminoguanidine 是用於以傳統衍生化方式穩定 Adrenochrome 不穩定 o-醌的 hydrazine 類試劑，形成 Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine。該衍生物是一種 Hemostatics 藥劑，也是 SASP-Remodeling Aminochrome Complex 的核心調節成分。

links.context: In an Alzheimer's Disease mouse model, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of RARβ activates ADAM10 transcription, raising α-secretase activity and directing APP away from BACE1 processing to attenuate β-amyloid; brain-specific Sirt1 knockout conversely increases aggregates and worsens phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Alzheimer's Disease 小鼠模型中，SIRT1 對 RARβ 的去乙醯化會活化 ADAM10 轉錄，提升 α-secretase 活性並使 APP 遠離 BACE1 處理而減輕 β-類澱粉樣蛋白；反之，腦部特異性 Sirt1 剔除會增加聚集物並惡化表型。

links.context: In bone, senescent cells secrete Interleukin-11 to activate STAT3 in osteoblasts, suppressing bone formation and shifting the osteoblast/osteoclast balance toward resorption — the senescence-associated osteokine loop that drives age-related bone loss.
links.context_zh_TW: 在骨骼中，衰老細胞分泌 Interleukin-11 以活化骨母細胞中的 STAT3，抑制骨形成並將骨母細胞／破骨細胞平衡轉向骨吸收，即造成年齡相關骨流失的衰老相關骨細胞激素迴路。

links.context: In breast tumor cell lines where SIRT1 is primarily cytoplasmic, SIRT1 inhibition causes rapid caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta dissociation and markedly enhances paclitaxel sensitivity. This is therapeutically relevant during mitotic arrest when transcription is not ongoing.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 SIRT1 主要位於細胞質的乳腺腫瘤細胞系中，抑制 SIRT1 會導致快速的 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 解離，並顯著增強對太平洋紫杉醇（paclitaxel）的敏感性。這在有絲分裂停滯、轉錄不進行時具有治療相關性。
links.source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md

links.context: In cataract, the long-lived Lens Crystallins of the lens lose solubility, unfold, and cross-link into aggregates that scatter light. Their required decades-long solubility is why lens damage is cumulative and irreversible.
links.context_zh_TW: 在白內障中，晶狀體的長壽命 Lens Crystallins 失去溶解性、展開並交聯成聚集體，進而散射光線。這些蛋白必須維持數十年溶解性，也正是晶狀體傷害累積且不可逆的原因。

links.context: In cellular senescence, large-scale rewiring of the enhancer-promoter network is a primary mechanism by which the epigenetic landscape activates SASP genes. EP loops place senescence-activated enhancers in contact with SASP promoters to induce their secretion.
links.context_zh_TW: 在細胞衰老中，增強子-啟動子網路的大規模重組是表觀遺傳景觀活化 SASP 基因的主要機制。EP 環化使衰老活化的增強子與 SASP 啟動子接觸以誘導其分泌。

links.context: In cellular senescence, upregulation of class Ib molecules such as HLA-E becomes a mechanism of immune evasion that protects arrested cells from cytotoxic lymphocytes. By engaging the inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 receptor, senescent cells dampen NK- and T-cell-mediated elimination and thereby undermine senescence surveillance.
links.context_zh_TW: 在細胞衰老中，HLA-E 等 class Ib 分子的上調成為一種 immune evasion 機制，保護已停止分裂的細胞免受細胞毒性淋巴球攻擊。透過與抑制性 NKG2A/CD94 受體結合，衰老細胞抑制 NK 與 T 細胞介導的清除，進而破壞 senescence surveillance。

links.context: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies suggest short-term rapamycin or rapalogs may improve aspects of immune function in older adults, but these relied on serologic responses to influenza vaccination, a marker with limited predictive value for broader immunocompetence. Broader measures including T cell repertoire diversity, innate immune activity, and real-world infection resistance remain underexplored.
links.context_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: In colorectal cancer cells, p53 inhibits erastin-induced ferroptosis by blocking DPP4 activity - distinct from p53's ferroptosis-promoting role in other cancers. With p53 present, DPP4 is restrained; upon p53 loss, nuclear accumulation of DPP4 is inhibited and plasma-membrane-associated DPP4 becomes free to drive lipid peroxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 colorectal cancer 細胞中，p53 藉由阻斷 DPP4 活性而抑制 erastin 誘發的 ferroptosis，這與 p53 在其他癌症中促進 ferroptosis 的角色相反。當 p53 存在時 DPP4 受到抑制；p53 喪失後 DPP4 的核內累積受阻，plasma-membrane-associated 的 DPP4 便得以自由驅動脂質過氧化。

links.context: In copper-induced LDL oxidation, resveratrol at 0-1 µM inhibits conjugated diene formation by extending the lag phase and lowering V_max of peroxidation, without substantially changing OD_max at low concentrations. This antioxidant effect on lipoprotein oxidation underlies part of resveratrol's proposed atheroprotective action.
links.context_zh_TW: 在銅誘發的 LDL 氧化中，0-1 µM 的 Resveratrol 可抑制 Conjugated Dienes 形成，延長 lag phase 並降低過氧化作用的 V_max，而在低濃度時大致不影響 OD_max。這種對脂蛋白氧化的抗氧化作用構成 Resveratrol 被認為具有保護血管作用的部分機制。

links.context: In distributive shock — Septic Shock and Vasoplegic Shock — massive Nitric Oxide release activates soluble Guanylate Cyclase, raising cGMP and producing profound, catecholamine-refractory Vasodilation. The resulting low arterial pressure compromises organ perfusion, so refractory vasoplegia unresponsive to Vasopressors is rescued with Methylene blue, which inhibits guanylate cyclase and blocks the NO→cGMP vasodilatory cascade to restore vascular tone.
links.context_zh_TW: 在分布性休克（Septic Shock 與 Vasoplegic Shock）中大量的 Nitric Oxide 釋放會活化可溶性 Guanylate Cyclase，使 cGMP 上升並造成嚴重且對兒茶酚胺無反應的 Vasodilation，導致動脈壓過低、組織灌流不足。因此對 Vasopressors 無反應的顽固 vasoplegia 可用 Methylene blue 搶救，它抑制 guanylate cyclase、阻斷 NO→cGMP 血管擴張級聯以恢復血管張力。

links.context: In experimental models, microbiota-derived NMN is converted to NAD+ and elevates NAD+ pools, which activates the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway. Activated SIRT3 transduces the protective signal through PRDX5, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner, so the protection afforded by NMN requires SIRT3 as a downstream effector.
links.context_zh_TW: 在實驗模型中，腸道菌群來源的 NMN 會被轉換為 NAD+ 並提升 NAD+ 濃度，進而活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 途徑。被活化的 SIRT3 透過 PRDX5 傳遞保護訊號，減輕胰臟的粒線體功能障礙、氧化性傷害與發炎，且此保護作用部分依賴 SIRT3，因此 NMN 的保護效果需要 SIRT3 作為下游效應分子。

links.context: In ferroptosis models, artesunate triggers glutathione depletion together with GPX4 inactivation and accumulation of lipid peroxides. Because GPX4 uses reduced glutathione to reduce lipid hydroperoxides, loss of GSH removes the cell's principal defence against lipid peroxidation and commits the cell to ferroptotic death.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 ferroptosis 模型中，artesunate 會引發 glutathione 耗竭，並伴隨 GPX4 失活與脂質過氧化物累積。由於 GPX4 依賴還原型 glutathione 將脂質過氫化物還原，GSH 的流失等於移除了細胞對抗脂質過氧化的主要防線，使細胞走向鐵死亡。

links.context: In healthy mitochondria a pool of SIRT3 is sequestered by ATP synthase via the ATP5O (OSCP) subunit. When matrix pH drops upon depolarization, SIRT3 dissociates from ATP5O (requiring H135 of ATP5O) and redistributes to matrix substrates, enabling rapid deacetylation of metabolic enzymes and recovery of membrane potential within minutes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，一部分 SIRT3 被 ATP 合成酶透過 ATP5O（OSCP）亞基封存。當去極化導致基質 pH 下降時，SIRT3 從 ATP5O 解離（需要 ATP5O 的 H135），並重新分佈到基質受質上，實現對代謝酶的快速去乙醯化並在數分鐘內恢復膜電位。

links.context: In hepatocytes propionate is activated to propionyl-CoA, carboxylated, epimerized and rearranged to succinyl-CoA by the Vitamin B12-dependent enzyme methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, feeding the gluconeogenic and TCA cycles — making propionate a meaningful precursor for endogenous glucose production during fasting.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，propionate 被活化為 propionyl-CoA，經羧化、差向異構後，由 Vitamin B12 依賴的酵素 methylmalonyl-CoA mutase 重排為 succinyl-CoA，供應糖質新生與 TCA 循環——使 propionate 成为禁食期間內源性葡萄糖生成的重要前驅物。

links.context: In humans, miR-543 maps to the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 locus on chromosome 14q32, one of the largest mammalian miRNA megaclusters. Its expression is controlled by parent-of-origin DNA methylation, making it both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome.
links.context_zh_TW: 在人類中，miR-543 定位於染色體 14q32 的基因銘印 DLK1-DIO3 基因座，這是哺乳動物最大的 miRNA 巨簇之一。其表現受親源 DNA 甲基化控制，使其既是表觀基因組的效應器也是感測器。

links.context: In idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis alveolar macrophages show elevated Drosha and AIM2. DROSHA promotes AIM2 inflammasome activation, caspase-1 cleavage and IL-1β/IL-18 release, linking Microprocessor activity to innate immune lung inflammation and adding a macrophage inflammasome axis atop the fibroblast SASP axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在特發性肺纖維化的肺泡巨噬細胞中，Drosha 與 AIM2 表現升高。DROSHA 促進 AIM2 發炎小體活化、caspase-1 切割以及 IL-1β/IL-18 釋放，將 Microprocessor 活性與先天免疫性肺部發炎連結起來，在纖維母細胞 SASP 軸之上加上一條巨噬細胞發炎小體軸。

links.context: In immunocompetent hosts, a Th2 milieu with Eosinophils, IgE and IL-5 normally restrains Strongyloides larval burden and keeps chronic Strongyloidiasis asymptomatic. Glucocorticoids and other cancer therapies suppress this control, permitting uncontrolled larval proliferation, hyperinfection and disseminated disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在免疫健全宿主中，含有 Eosinophils、IgE 與 IL-5 的 Th2 環境通常會抑制 Strongyloides 的幼蟲負荷，使慢性 Strongyloidiasis 保持無症狀。糖皮質激素與其他癌症療法會抑制此控制作用，讓幼蟲不受限制地增殖，導致過度感染與播散性疾病。

links.context: In ischemic stroke, hypoxia-driven collapse of oxidative phosphorylation triggers excitotoxicity with glutamate-driven calcium influx, mitochondrial dysfunction and a surge of reactive oxygen species, with ischemia-reperfusion injury adding a secondary oxidative burst on restored blood flow.
links.context_zh_TW: 在缺血性中風中，缺氧驅動的氧化磷酸化崩潰會觸發谷胺酸驅動的鈣內流所形成的興奮性毒性、粒線體功能障礙與活性氧激增，而缺血再灌流損傷在血流恢復後再加上第二波氧化傷害。

links.context: In lysosomal storage diseases, deficiency of a single hydrolase, transporter, or membrane protein causes undegraded substrate to accumulate, enlarging lysosomes and thereby impairing autophagic flux, disrupting calcium homeostasis and triggering inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在溶小體儲積症中，單一水解酵素、運輸蛋白或膜蛋白的缺失會造成未分解受質累積，使溶小體腫大並進而損害自噬流、破壞鈣離子恆定並誘發發炎。

links.context: In macroautophagy, the lysosome fuses with autophagosomes to form autolysosomes, in which cargo is degraded and recycled; lysosomal dysfunction is a hallmark of aging and of metabolic and neurodegenerative disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在巨自噬過程中，溶小體與自噬體融合形成自溶小體並降解、回收其中物質；溶小體功能失調是老化以及代謝性與神經退化疾病的重要特徵。

links.context: In mammals the CBP/p300 acetyltransferases write H3K56ac (Das et al., Nature 2009), marking newly synthesized histone H3 as it is deposited during S phase. Timely removal by NAD+-dependent sirtuins such as SIRT6, SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT3 is what couples nucleosome assembly to replication and repair.
links.context_zh_TW: 在哺乳類中，CBP／p300 乙醯化轉移酶負責寫入 H3K56ac（Das et al., Nature 2009），標記 S 期中新合成的 histone H3 及其沉積。藉由 NAD+ 依賴性 sirtuin（如 SIRT6、SIRT1、SIRT2、SIRT3）的及時移除，核小體組裝得以與複製及修復相連結。

links.context: In mammals, the selective autophagy receptors p62/SQSTM1 and NBR1 recognize ubiquitinated peroxisomal membrane proteins such as PEX5 and PMP70 and bridge them to LC3 on the forming autophagosome. Stress or import failure triggers mono/poly-ubiquitination of PEX5, which is the ubiquitin signal that commits the peroxisome to pexophagosomal turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: 在哺乳動物中，選擇性自噬受體 p62/SQSTM1 與 NBR1 會辨識已被泛素化的過氧化體膜蛋白（例如 PEX5 與 PMP70），並將它們與形成中自噬體膜上的 LC3 橋接。壓力或輸入失效會引發 PEX5 等過氧化體蛋白的單/多泛素化，這個泛素訊號即是把過氧化體送入 pexophagosome 周轉的關鍵。

links.context: In melanoma, miR-137 negatively regulates ferroptosis by directly targeting the glutamine transporter SLC1A5: knockdown of miR-137 promotes ferroptosis, whereas its presence protects melanoma cells from iron-dependent death. Because SLC1A5 is itself ferroptosis-protective in this context, loss of miR-137 raises glutamine import, GSH supply and antioxidant defence, increasing ferroptotic resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 melanoma 中，miR-137 藉由直接標定麩醯胺酸轉運蛋白 SLC1A5 而負向調節 ferroptosis：miR-137 的敲除會促進 ferroptosis，而其存在則保護 melanoma 細胞免於鐵依賴性死亡。由於 SLC1A5 在此脈絡下本身具有保護作用，miR-137 流失會提高麩醯胺酸輸入、GSH 供應與抗氧化防禦，進而增加對 ferroptosis 的抗性。

links.context: In methemoglobinemia, iron in hemoglobin is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, producing methemoglobin that cannot bind oxygen and imparting a characteristic slate-gray or chocolate-brown discoloration that does not improve with supplemental oxygen. Pulse oximetry may read falsely normal, and methylene blue is the antidote for symptomatic cases.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Methemoglobinemia 中，Hemoglobin 的鐵由亞鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+），生成無法結合氧氣的 Methemoglobin，並造成特有的石板灰或巧克力棕色變色，且不因補充氧氣而改善。脈搏血氧儀可能讀數偽裝正常，Methylene blue 則是症狀性病例的解毒劑。

links.context: In most cellular contexts p53 restrains the pro-inflammatory arm of the SASP, limiting expression of cytokines and chemokines; loss or mutation of p53 dramatically amplifies SASP output. This restraint is mechanistically linked to p53's ability to suppress NF-κB-driven inflammation and to its role in DNA-damage-induced senescence. The directionality is suppressive: intact p53 yields a more contained secretome, whereas p53 deficiency yields an exaggerated, tumor-promoting SASP. This nuance explains why p53 status strongly shapes the net effect of senescence in tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 在多數細胞脈絡中，p53 抑制 SASP 的促發炎臂，限制細胞激素與趨化因子表現；p53 缺失或突變會大幅放大 SASP 輸出。此抑制在機制上連結到 p53 抑制 NF-κB 驅動發炎的能力，以及其在 DNA 損傷誘發衰老中的角色。其方向性為抑制性：完整的 p53 產生更受控的分泌組，而 p53 缺陷則產生誇張、促腫瘤的 SASP。此細微處解釋了 p53 狀態如何強烈塑造組織中衰老的淨效應。

links.context: In mouse models of high-fat-diet-induced obesity, a dietary dose of nicotinamide riboside (NR) as small as 400 mg/kg/day improved insulin sensitivity and protected mice from weight gain, while NR increased NAD+ metabolism, improved glucose tolerance, reduced weight gain, and exhibited neuroprotective effects against diabetic neuropathy and liver steatosis in diabetic mouse models. These rodent results have not yet been replicated in humans: 12-week supplementation of NR at 2000 mg/day did not improve insulin sensitivity or other metabolic parameters in insulin-resistant, obese men.
links.context_zh_TW: 在高脂飲食誘發肥胖的小鼠模型中，低至 400 mg/kg/day 的膳食菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）劑量改善了胰島素敏感性並保護小鼠免於體重增加；同時 NR 增強了 NAD+ 代謝、改善葡萄糖耐受性、減少體重增加，並在糖尿病小鼠模型中展現對糖尿病神經病變與肝臟脂肪變性的神經保護作用。這些囓齒類動物的結果尚未在人類身上複製：在胰島素阻抗的肥胖男性中，每日 2000 mg/day 補充 NR 達 12 週，並未改善胰島素敏感性或其他代謝參數。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: In mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) increases NAD+ metabolism and thereby improves glucose tolerance, reduces weight gain, and exhibits neuroprotective effects against diabetic neuropathy and liver steatosis. NR also restores the significantly decreased hepatic NADP+ and NADPH levels seen in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice, both of which are important for resistance to oxidative stress. These benefits are mediated in part through activation of SIRT1, which promotes glucose-stimulated insulin secretion from pancreatic beta-cells and protects against insulin resistance in peripheral tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 在小鼠模型中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可提升 NAD+ 代謝，進而改善葡萄糖耐受性、減少體重增加，並對糖尿病神經病變與肝臟脂肪變性展現神經保護作用。NR 亦能恢復糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中顯著下降的肝臟 NADP+ 與 NADPH 濃度，兩者皆對抵抗氧化壓力至關重要。這些益處部分透過活化 SIRT1 所介導，SIRT1 可促進胰島 beta 細胞的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，並保護周邊組織免於胰島素抗性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: In mouse oocytes aged in vivo or in vitro, expression of SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT3 is dramatically reduced; prolonged expression of these sirtuins reduces postovulatory oocyte ageing. Directionally, loss of SIRT3 (with SIRT1/2) accompanies oocyte ageing. SIRT1 and SIRT3 act as redox sensors in oocytes, implicating them in female fertility and age-related reproductive decline.
links.context_zh_TW: 在體內或體外老化的鼠卵母細胞中，SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT3 的表現顯著降低；延長這些 sirtuin 的表現可減少排卵後卵母細胞老化。方向性上 SIRT3（連同 SIRT1/2）的缺失伴隨卵母細胞老化。SIRT1 和 SIRT3 在卵母細胞中作為氧化還原感測器，將它們與女性生育力和年齡相關的生殖功能衰退聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: In neutral-to-alkaline solution catechol autoxidizes by sequential one-electron transfers through the o-semiquinone radical to o-benzoquinone, generating superoxide, hydrogen peroxide, and hydroxyl radical. This redox-cycling loop establishes a self-propagating ROS source that can deplete cellular antioxidants such as glutathione.
links.context_zh_TW: 在中性至鹼性溶液中，catechol 經由連續單電子轉移自氧化，經 o-semiquinone 自由基生成 o-benzoquinone，並產生超氧陰離子、過氧化氫與羥基自由基。此 redox cycling 迴路形成自我延續的 ROS 來源，可耗竭 glutathione 等細胞抗氧化物質。

links.context: In normally growing HeLa cells, transfected Sir2alpha (SIRT1) is nuclear, but upon apoptotic stimulation with TNF-alpha it appears in the cytoplasm of dying cells. Both dominant-negative Caspase-9 and Bcl-xL kept Sir2alpha in the nucleus, placing the translocation downstream of apoptosome activation and MOMP.
links.context_zh_TW: 在正常生長的 HeLa 細胞中，轉染的 Sir2α（SIRT1）位於細胞核，但在以 TNF-α 進行凋亡刺激後，它出現在瀕死細胞的細胞質中。顯性失活型 Caspase-9 和 Bcl-xL 都使 Sir2α 保持在細胞核中，將此轉位置於凋亡小體活化和 MOMP 的下游。
links.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

links.context: In obesity, gut-microbiota-derived deoxycholic acid induces senescence in hepatic stellate cells, and the resulting SASP output creates a pro-inflammatory, pro-tumorigenic niche that drives hepatocellular carcinoma. Senescent HSC accumulate cytoplasmic DNA because DNASE2 and TREX1 are downregulated, which activates cGAS-STING and NF-κB/IRF3-dependent SASP transcription; STING knockout in mice blunts SASP and attenuates obesity-associated HCC.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肥胖情境下，腸道菌群衍生的 deoxycholic acid 會誘發肝星狀細胞衰老，而隨後產生的 SASP 營造出促發炎、促腫瘤的微環境，進而驅動 hepatocellular carcinoma。衰老 HSC 因 DNASE2 與 TREX1 下調而累積細胞質 DNA，啟動 cGAS-STING 與 NF-κB/IRF3 相依的 SASP 轉錄；在小鼠中敲除 STING 可削弱 SASP 並減輕肥胖相關的 HCC。

links.context: In older adults, 24-week GlyNAC supplementation reduced plasma F2-isoprostanes by 40% and protein carbonyls by 35%, markers of oxidative damage.
links.context_zh_TW: 老年受試者中，24 週 GlyNAC 補充使血漿 F2-異前列腺素下降 40%、蛋白質羰基下降 35%，皆為氧化損傷指標。

links.context: In pancreatic cancer, TFEB-mediated glutaminase upregulation supports tumor metabolism by supplying the glutamine-derived carbon and nitrogen needed for growth. Glutaminolysis is a hallmark of rapidly dividing cancer cells, which depend on glutamine for survival. TFEB-driven glutaminase expression supports the metabolic flexibility that underlies therapy resistance. Pharmacological glutaminase inhibition sensitizes pancreatic tumor cells to chemotherapy and targeted agents.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰腺癌中，TFEB 介導的 glutaminase 上調透過提供生長所需的麩醯胺衍生碳和氮，支持腫瘤代謝。麩醯胺分解是快速分裂癌細胞的標誌，它們依賴麩醯胺存活。TFEB 驅動的 glutaminase 表現支持構成治療抗性基礎的代謝靈活性。藥理學抑制 glutaminase 可使胰腺腫瘤細胞對化療和標靶藥物增敏。

links.context: In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma TFEB is hyperactivated and plays a pathogenic role, controlling glutamine metabolism and acting as a critical survival factor for PDA cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰臟導管腺癌中 TFEB 過度活化並扮演致病角色，控制麩醯胺酸代謝並作為 PDA 細胞的關鍵存活因子。

links.context: In pathological conditions characterized by muscle atrophy, such as certain neuromuscular diseases or extended periods of immobility, urolithin A may offer potential benefits. It can stimulate muscle protein synthesis while inhibiting protein degradation pathways, including FoxO signaling, the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, helping to preserve muscle mass and mitigate muscle wasting. Human clinical validation of these anti-atrophic effects remains limited, but the mechanistic evidence is supportive.
links.context_zh_TW: 在以肌肉萎縮為特徵的病理狀態下，如某些神經肌肉疾病或長期不活動，urolithin A 可能提供潛在益處。它可刺激肌肉蛋白合成，同時抑制蛋白降解路徑，包括 FoxO 訊號、泛素-蛋白酶體系統，以及 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，有助於保留肌肉量並減輕肌肉消耗。這些抗萎縮效應的人體臨床驗證仍有限，但機制證據具支持性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

links.context: In preclinical and early clinical studies, alagebrium improved arterial compliance, reduced arterial stiffening and enhanced left-ventricular diastolic function, effects attributed to reversal of AGE-mediated matrix rigidification.
links.context_zh_TW: 在臨床前與早期臨床研究中，Alagebrium 改善動脈順應性、降低 Arterial Stiffening 並提升左心室舒張功能，這些效果歸因於逆轉 AGE 所致基質僵硬。

links.context: In progeroid mouse models of Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome, transient expression of the Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc; OSKM) has been used to generate Partial Reprogramming in vivo. The transient expression improves the disease phenotype and extends the lifespan of affected mice, making partial reprogramming a leading rejuvenation strategy for progeria.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 的早老小鼠模型中，暫時表現 Yamanaka factors（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4、c-Myc；OSKM）已被用於在體內產生 Partial Reprogramming。此短暫表現可改善疾病表型並延長受影響小鼠的壽命，使部分重編程成為早老症的領先返老策略。

links.context: In proliferating cells, SIRT6 and RB1 are enriched at the 5'UTR of LINE-1 loci, where SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylates KAP1, promoting its interaction with HP1alpha and heterochromatinization of L1; during senescence RB1 declines and SIRT6 is depleted from L1 loci, releasing this repression.
links.context_zh_TW: 在增殖細胞中，SIRT6 與 RB1 會聚集於 LINE-1 位點的 5'UTR，SIRT6 在該處對 KAP1 進行單 ADP 核糖基化，促進其與 HP1α 的交互作用並使 L1 異染色質化；在衰老時 RB1 下降且 SIRT6 從 L1 位點流失，解除此抑制。

links.context: In prostate cancer cells the LIM-only scaffolding protein FHL2 binds directly to FoxO1 and to SIRT1, forming a ternary complex. Within that complex FHL2 acts as a molecular matchmaker that dramatically enhances the SIRT1–FoxO1 interaction, driving SIRT1-dependent deacetylation of FoxO1 and suppressing its pro-apoptotic transactivation, which shields tumor cells from apoptotic triggers during aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 在前列腺癌細胞中，LIM-only 支架蛋白 FHL2 直接結合 FoxO1 與 SIRT1，形成三元複合體。在該複合體內，FHL2 扮演分子媒合者角色，顯著增強 SIRT1 與 FoxO1 的交互作用，促進 SIRT1 依賴性的 FoxO1 去乙醯化並抑制其促凋亡的轉錄活化，使腫瘤細胞在老化期間免於凋亡誘發。

links.context: In response to nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation, a remarkable increase (45-fold) in nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide (NAAD) was reported in a study with male human subjects and C57Bl6/J mice, indicating an additional conversion pathway of NR to NAD+. NAAD represents the most sensitive biomarker of effective NAD+ supplementation since it is undetectable in the blood prior to supplementation and its levels increase in the liver after orally administered NAD+ precursors. NR could also significantly elevate NAAD heart content, where the increase of NAD+ occurs in the absence of a steady-state NAD+ increase, and NR increased NAAD by at least 45-fold compared to baseline.
links.context_zh_TW: 在對 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充的反應中，一項針對男性人類受試者與 C57Bl6/J 小鼠的研究報導了 nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide（NAAD，菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）的顯著增加（45 倍），顯示 NR 轉化為 NAD+ 的額外路徑。NAAD 代表了有效 NAD+ 補充最敏感的生物標記，因為它在補充前於血液中無法偵測，且其水平在口服 NAD+ 前驅物後於肝臟中上升。NR 亦能顯著提升心臟中的 NAAD 含量，其中 NAD+ 的增加發生於缺乏穩態 NAD+ 增加的情況下，且 NR 相較於基線將 NAAD 提升了至少 45 倍。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: In response to survival cytokines such as GM-CSF, ERK2 phosphorylates BAX at Thr167, creating a pThr-Pro motif recognized by the peptidyl-prolyl isomerase Pin1. Pin1 binding locks BAX in an inactive state, preventing its mitochondrial translocation and oligomerization — a pro-survival switch.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 GM-CSF 等存活細胞激素刺激下，ERK2 會在 Thr167 位點磷酸化 BAX，形成可被肽脯氨醯順反異構酶 Pin1 辨識的 pThr-Pro 基序；Pin1 結合後將 BAX 鎖定於失活態，阻止其粒線體轉位與寡聚化——這是一個促存活開關。

links.context: In senescence the TCA citrate-acetyl-CoA export axis is a metabolic checkpoint for the SASP: SLC25A1 exports citrate to the cytosol where ACLY regenerates acetyl-CoA used for H3K27ac deposition at SASP loci. Inhibiting SLC25A1 with CTPI2, or blocking MPC pyruvate entry, collapses this axis and selectively suppresses SASP without killing senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老中，TCA 的 citrate–acetyl-CoA 輸出軸是 SASP 的代謝檢查點：SLC25A1 將 citrate 輸出至細胞質，由 ACLY 再生 acetyl-CoA 供 SASP 基因座上的 H3K27ac 沉積。以 CTPI2 抑制 SLC25A1 或阻斷 MPC 的丙酮酸入口，會使此軸崩潰並選擇性抑制 SASP，而不會殺死衰老細胞。

links.context: In senescent PSC27 cells, VER155008 concentration-dependently dampens canonical SASP factors and suppresses the p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR cascade triggered by genotoxic stress, phenocopying the senomorphic effect of Apigenin.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老的 PSC27 細胞中，VER155008 以濃度依賴方式抑制標準 SASP 因子，並壓低由基因毒性壓力觸發的 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 級聯反應，重現 Apigenin 的 senomorphic 效應。

links.context: In senescent cells ATM and ROS activate TAK1, which then drives both p38 MAPK and mTORC1 signaling - two pathways independently required for full SASP expression. Genetic or pharmacological TAK1 inhibition markedly suppresses IL-6, IL-8 and other SASP factors without necessarily rescuing the cell-cycle arrest, making TAK1 a genuine senomorphic node.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，ATM 與 ROS 會活化 TAK1，後者再驅動 p38 MAPK 與 mTORC1 訊號——這兩條路徑皆為完整 SASP 表現所必需。以基因或藥物方式抑制 TAK1 可顯著降低 IL-6、IL-8 等 SASP 因子分泌，卻未必能逆轉細胞週期停滯，因此 TAK1 是真正的 senomorphic 節點。

links.context: In senescent cells mTOR is hyperactive and localizes to the trans-Golgi in a TOR-autophagy spatial coupling compartment, coupling autophagy-derived amino acids to high secretory demand. mTOR promotes cap-dependent translation of IL-1α mRNA and regulates MAPKAPK2, which stabilizes SASP mRNAs. Inhibiting mTOR with rapamycin suppresses IL-1α translation, reduces NF-κB activity and attenuates SASP without reversing senescence arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中 mTOR 過度活化，並定位於 trans-Golgi 的 TOR-autophagy 空間偶聯區室，把自噬來源的胺基酸與高分泌需求耦合。mTOR 促進 IL-1α mRNA 的 cap 依賴性轉譯並調控 MAPKAPK2，後者穩定 SASP mRNA。以 rapamycin 抑制 mTOR 可抑制 IL-1α 轉譯、降低 NF-κB 活性並減弱 SASP，卻不會逆轉衰老停滯。

links.context: In senescent cells the NAD+/NADH ratio falls because of reduced TCA/ETC flux and NAD+ consumption by repair pathways. Since glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate oxidation by GAPDH requires NAD+, glycolysis and ATP production are inhibited, and the resulting rise in the AMP+ADP/ATP ratio activates AMPK.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent 細胞中，因 TCA/ETC 通量下降與修復途徑消耗 NAD+，NAD+/NADH 比值降低。由於 GAPDH 氧化 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate 需要 NAD+，glycolysis 與 ATP 生成受到抑制，隨後 AMP+ADP/ATP 比值上升並活化 AMPK。

links.context: In senescent cells the activity and protein level of cytosolic MDH1 are reduced, contributing to decreased NAD+ levels. Knockdown of MDH1, which lowers the cytosolic NAD+/NADH ratio, induces senescence, whereas knockdown of mitochondrial MDH2 — which affects mitochondrial but not cytosolic NAD+ — does not. This indicates that cytosolic, not mitochondrial, NAD+ pools govern senescence induction.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，細胞質 MDH1 的活性與蛋白量都下降，導致 NAD+ 水準降低。敲低 MDH1（使細胞質 NAD+/NADH 比值下降）會誘發衰老，而敲低粒線體 MDH2（影響的是粒線體而非細胞質 NAD+）則不會。這顯示調控衰老誘發的是細胞質而非粒線體的 NAD+ 池。

links.context: In senescent cells the mitochondrial Citrate–acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, and the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 exports Citrate to the cytosol, where ACLY regenerates the Acetyl-CoA pool used for H3K27ac deposition at SASP loci. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces citrate, isocitrate and cis-aconitate, and in vivo improves healthspan and reduces frailty in aged mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，粒線體 Citrate–acetyl-CoA 軸受到上調，粒線體柠檬酸載體 SLC25A1 將 Citrate 輸出至細胞質，在該處 ACLY 重新生成供 SASP 位點 H3K27ac 沉積所用的 Acetyl-CoA 池。抑制 SLC25A1 會降低 citrate、isocitrate 與 cis-aconitate 濃度，並在活體中改善老年小鼠的健康壽命與降低虛弱程度。

links.context: In senescent cells, MPC inhibition with UK5099 suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion across multiple senescence models without affecting p16/p21 cell-cycle arrest or DNA damage foci. This places mitochondrial pyruvate entry at the citrate-acetyl-CoA axis that sustains H3K27ac at SASP loci.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent cell 中，以 UK5099 抑制 MPC 可在多個 senescence 模型中抑制 SASP 基因表現與分泌，且不影響 p16/p21 細胞週期停滯或 DNA damage foci。這將粒線體丙酮酸入口定位在維持 SASP 位點 H3K27ac 的 citrate-acetyl-CoA 軸上。

links.context: In senescent cells, SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels across multiple senescence contexts — irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative. The upregulation sustains the cytosolic acetyl-CoA supply needed for histone H3K27 acetylation at SASP gene loci, linking mitochondrial carbon flux to the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，SLC25A1 的 mRNA 與蛋白質表現在多種衰老情境——輻射誘發、阿霉素誘發與複製性衰老——皆顯著上升。此上調維持了 SASP 基因位點上組蛋白 H3K27 乙醯化所需的細胞質乙醯輔酶 A 供應，將粒線體碳流與衰老相關分泌表型連結起來。

links.context: In senescent cells, cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and/or mitochondrial DNA accumulate in the cytosol and activate cGAS to produce cGAMP. This drives STING-dependent SASP expression, linking cellular senescence to immune surveillance. The same cGAMP-STING-TBK1-IRF3 axis also drives type I interferon production, making cGAMP central to the cGAS-STING pathway in senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，細胞質染色質碎片與／或粒線體 DNA 累積於細胞質，活化 cGAS 以產生 cGAMP。這驅動 STING 依賴性的 SASP 表現，將細胞衰老與免疫監視相連結。同一條 cGAMP–STING–TBK1–IRF3 軸也驅動第一型干擾素的產生，使 cGAMP 在衰老細胞的 cGAS-STING pathway 中居於核心地位。

links.context: In senescent cells, persistent p38 signalling keeps MK2 active, which stabilizes IL-6, IL-8, CXCL1/2 and MCP-1 transcripts and maintains the inflammatory secretome even after transcriptional initiation wanes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent cell 中，p38 訊號持續使 MK2 保持活化，穩定 IL-6、IL-8、CXCL1/2 與 MCP-1 的轉錄本，即使轉錄起始已減弱仍維持發炎性分泌型。

links.context: In senescent hepatic stellate cells, Interleukin-33 expression is induced downstream of Interleukin-1β signaling, establishing an IL-1β → IL-33 axis in which IL-33 amplifies the upstream SASP-initiator loop rather than acting alone.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老肝星狀細胞中，Interleukin-33 的表現由 Interleukin-1β 訊息下游誘導，建立 IL-1β → IL-33 軸，使 IL-33 放大上游的 SASP 啟動迴路而非單獨作用。

links.context: In senescent tumour cells CXCL10 expression is restrained by the Polycomb methyltransferase EZH2, which represses its promoter, whereas type I/II interferons induce it through JAK/STAT1 and NF-kB. Upstream of its release lie the cGAS-STING DNA-sensing pathway, linking genotoxic stress to the interferon-responsive SASP branch.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老腫瘤細胞中，CXCL10 的表現受到多梳組蛋白甲基轉移酶 EZH2 抑制，後者壓制其啟動子；而第一型與第二型干擾素則經由 JAK/STAT1 與 NF-κB 誘導它。其釋放的上游為 cGAS–STING DNA 感知路徑，將基因毒性壓力連結到干擾素反應型的 SASP 分支。

links.context: In several models of cardiac injuries, including heart failure (HF), the NAMPT enzyme is repressed while Nmrk2 expression is robustly upregulated, and a similar shift was observed in human failing hearts in models of cardiomyopathy. Activation of the NMRK2 pathway therefore represents a common adaptive mechanism in the failing heart, where NAD+ levels are low, and the Nmrk2 gene can be activated in response to NAMPT inhibition. This shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis is an energy-sparing mechanism, since NMN synthesis from NR by NMRK enzymes requires a single ATP while synthesis from NAM by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents.
links.context_zh_TW: 在包括心臟衰竭（HF）在內的數種心臟損傷模型中，NAMPT 酵素受到抑制，而 Nmrk2 表現則顯著上調，且在心肌病變模型的人類衰竭心臟中也觀察到類似的轉變。因此，NMRK2 路徑的活化代表衰竭心臟中一種常見的適應性機制，此時 NAD+ 濃度偏低，且 Nmrk2 基因可因應 NAMPT 抑制而被活化。這種從 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 以進行 NAD+ 合成，是一種節省能量的機制，因為 NMRK 酵素將 NR 合成為 NMN 僅需一個 ATP，而 NAMPT 將 NAM 合成則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: In skeletal muscle, Pompe Disease severely impairs the Autophagy pathway. Autophagosomes and autophagic debris accumulate massively in myofibers, displacing the contractile apparatus; this autophagic buildup — not merely lysosomal glycogen storage — is now recognized as a major driver of muscle pathology and a key factor limiting the efficacy of enzyme replacement therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在骨骼肌中，Pompe Disease 會嚴重損害 Autophagy 路徑。自噬體與自噬殘餘物在肌纖維中大量堆積、排擠收縮裝置；這種自噬堆積（而非僅僅溶小體醣原儲存）如今被視為肌肉病變的主要驅動因素，也是限制酵素替代療法療效的關鍵因子。

links.context: In slow COMT variants, catechol clearance is reduced so endogenous catecholamines may accumulate, enhancing stress reactivity. Exogenous catechols can further inhibit the already sluggish enzyme and add methyl-group demand on the methylation cycle. This underlies the stress sensitivity and supplement intolerance often reported by slow COMT individuals.
links.context_zh_TW: 在緩慢的 COMT 變異中，兒茶酚清除減少，因此內源性 catecholamines 可能累積，增強壓力反應性。外源性兒茶酚可進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶，並增加對 methylation cycle 的甲基需求。這正是緩慢 COMT 個體常回報的壓力敏感性和補充劑不耐受的基礎。

links.context: In spinal models Suramin protects against intervertebral disc degeneration by directly inhibiting the inflammatory NF-κB signalling pathway. Separately, it perturbs mitochondrial membrane potential and significantly reduces ATP in rapidly dividing leukaemia and solid tumour cells, suppressing their bioenergetic survival independently of its sirtuin effect.
links.context_zh_TW: 在脊椎模型中，Suramin 藉由直接抑制發炎性 NF-κB 訊息傳遞路徑而防護椎間盤退化。另在機制上獨立於其 sirtuin 作用，它擾動粒線體膜電位並顯著降低快速分裂的 leukemia 與實體腫瘤細胞之 ATP，抑制其生物能量存活。

links.context: In stem-cell research, tumorigenicity is the principal safety risk of iPSCs: residual undifferentiated pluripotent cells can generate teratomas or, more rarely, malignant tumors. Rigorous purification and release testing are required before clinical use.
links.context_zh_TW: 在幹細胞研究中，致瘤性是 iPSC 的主要安全風險：殘留的未分化多能細胞可產生畸胎瘤，或更罕見地產生惡性腫瘤。臨床使用前需要嚴格的純化和放行檢測。

links.context: In symptomatic methemoglobinemia, Methylene blue reduces methemoglobin back to functional Hemoglobin, relieving Dyspnea and Cyanosis; management otherwise targets the underlying cause. Dyspnea can also be acute (pulmonary embolism, asthma, pneumonia, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome) or chronic (COPD, heart failure).
links.context_zh_TW: 在有症狀的 methemoglobinemia 中，Methylene blue 將 methemoglobin 還原為具功能的 Hemoglobin，緩解 Dyspnea 與 Cyanosis；其他處置則針對潛在病因。Dyspnea 可為急性（肺栓塞、氣喘、肺炎、Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome）或慢性（COPD、心衰竭）。

links.context: In takotsubo pathophysiology, high catecholamine concentrations drive their oxidation to Adrenochrome and related Aminochromes, generating Superoxide and Hydrogen Peroxide via one-electron reduction of O₂ by the semiquinone radical intermediate. Adrenochrome then redox-cycles with NADPH and depletes Glutathione, impairing membrane repair and sustaining Lipid Peroxidation beyond what stoichiometric catecholamine oxidation would produce.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 takotsubo 的病理生理中，高濃度兒茶酚胺會被氧化為 Adrenochrome 與相關的 Aminochromes，經由半醌自由基中間體對 O₂ 的單電子還原產生 Superoxide 與 Hydrogen Peroxide。Adrenochrome 隨後與 NADPH 進行氧化還原循環並耗盡 Glutathione，損害膜修復，使 Lipid Peroxidation 持續進行，其程度超出化學計量式兒茶酚胺氧化所能造成的範圍。

links.context: In tauopathy models, activation of cGAS within pericytes destabilizes the neurovascular unit and compromises Blood-Brain Barrier integrity, allowing immune infiltration and exacerbating neuroinflammation. This parallels the endothelial cGAS-STING axis, and chronic pericyte cGAS activation — potentially triggered by mtDNA leakage or DNA damage — makes the vascular compartment a key site where the DNA-sensing pathway drives barrier failure.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 tauopathy 模型中，Pericytes 內 cGAS 的活化會破壞 neurovascular unit 的穩定性並損害 Blood-Brain Barrier 的完整性，使免疫細胞得以浸潤並加劇 neuroinflammation。這與內皮細胞的 cGAS-STING 軸相互呼應；Pericyte 的 cGAS 慢性活化（可能由 mtDNA 外漏或 DNA damage 觸發）使血管區成為 DNA 感測路徑造成屏障失敗的關鍵部位。

links.context: In the Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway, TRAF2 is normally bound to pro-caspase-12, keeping the protease inactive. Upon ER stress, TRAF2 dissociates from pro-caspase-12, allowing activation of Caspase-12 and committing the cell to ER-stress-induced Apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 中，TRAF2 正常情況下與 pro-caspase-12 結合，使該蛋白酶維持不活化。當內質網壓力發生時，TRAF2 從 pro-caspase-12 解離，使 Caspase-12 得以活化，並將細胞推向內質網壓力誘發的 Apoptosis。

links.context: In the absence of TREX1, cytosolic DNA accumulates and engages the cGAS sensor, leading to 2'3'-cGAMP production and STING activation; this triggers signaling through TBK1 and IRF3, resulting in type I Interferon (IFN-α/β) production and chronic interferon signaling that drives autoimmunity. TREX1 mutations cause Aicardi-Goutières syndrome type 1, the most common genetic cause of this type I interferonopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在缺乏 TREX1 的情況下，細胞質 DNA 累積並活化 cGAS 感測器，導致 2'3'-cGAMP 生成與 STING 活化；這會透過 TBK1 與 IRF3 啟動訊號，造成第一型 Interferon (IFN-α/β) 產生與慢性干擾素訊號，進而驅動自體免疫。TREX1 突變造成 Aicardi-Goutières 症候群第一型，是此類第一型干擾素病最常見的遺傳原因。

links.context: In the central nervous system IL-1β is produced mainly by microglia and astrocytes in response to amyloid beta plaques, alpha-synuclein aggregates and ATP released from damaged neurons. Elevated IL-1β in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease drives synaptic dysfunction, glutamate excitotoxicity and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 在中樞神經系統中，IL-1β 主要由小膠細胞與星狀膠細胞產生，誘發因子包括類澱粉 β 斑塊、α-突觸核蛋白聚集物以及受損神經元釋放的 ATP。Alzheimer's 與 Parkinson's disease 中升高的 IL-1β 驅動突觸功能障礙、麩胺酸興奮性毒性與神經退化。

links.context: In the current topology model, MFN1's C-terminal HR2 heptad-repeat domain faces the Mitochondrial Intermembrane Space, where it engages in trans interactions with the HR2 domain of a neighbouring mitofusin to tether the two outer membranes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在目前的拓撲模型中，MFN1 的 C 端 HR2 七重重複結構域朝向 Mitochondrial Intermembrane Space，並在此與相鄰 mitofusin 的 HR2 域進行反式交互作用，將兩層外膜繫結。

links.context: In the industrial synthesis of Adrenochrome from Epinephrine, Sodium hydrogencarbonate is the preferred buffering agent, supplying the mildly alkaline pH environment that permits oxidation of the catechol to proceed through the o-quinone intermediate to the indoline-5,6-dione chromophore.
links.context_zh_TW: 在以 Epinephrine 工業合成 Adrenochrome 的過程中，Sodium hydrogencarbonate 是首選緩衝劑，提供溫和鹼性的 pH 環境，使兒茶酚得以經由鄰醌中間體氧化成 indoline-5,6-dione 發色團。

links.context: In the islet, IL-1β released by infiltrating Lymphocytes and activated Macrophages induces Apoptosis in Pancreatic Beta Cells, alongside TNFalpha and Interferon-gamma. Progressive lymphocyte accumulation and beta-cell destruction are the central lesions of type 1 diabetes, and Humanin counteracts this cytokine-driven death.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰島中，浸潤的 Lymphocytes 與活化的 Macrophages 釋放的 IL-1β 與 TNFα、Interferon-gamma 一同誘發 Pancreatic Beta Cells 的 Apoptosis。淋巴球逐漸累積與 beta 細胞破壞是第一型糖尿病的核心病灶，而 Humanin 可對抗這種細胞激素驅動的死亡。

links.context: In the liver, absorbed acetate is activated to Acetyl-CoA and incorporated into lipids, cholesterol and ketone bodies, linking the Gut Microbiome to host Lipid Metabolism. Acetate also supplies the acetyl group pool used in Acetylation, including Histone Acetylation, and in the brain can be used by astrocytes for acetyl-CoA and neurotransmitter synthesis. Exogenous acetate can also bypass an SLC25A1 block via ACSS2, restoring acetylation in senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝臟中，吸收的 acetate 被活化為 Acetyl-CoA，並納入脂質、膽固醇與酮體，將 Gut Microbiome 與宿主 Lipid Metabolism 連結起來。Acetate 同時供應 Acetylation（含 Histone Acetylation）所需的乙醯基群池；在腦中可由星狀膠細胞用於 Acetyl-CoA 與神經傳遞物質合成。外源性 acetate 也能透過 ACSS2 繞過 SLC25A1 阻斷，恢復衰老細胞中的乙醯化。

links.context: In the malate-aspartate shuttle, cytosolic malate transports glycolytic reducing equivalents into mitochondria, linking glycolysis to OXPHOS. Because the malate/oxaloacetate couple sits at the centre of the cytosolic NAD+/NADH balance that governs senescence, malate's interconversion with oxaloacetate is mechanistically tied to whether cells maintain a youthful, non-senescent redox state.
links.context_zh_TW: 在蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭中，細胞質蘋果酸將糖解作用產生的還原當量運送進粒線體，連結糖解作用與 OXPHOS。由於蘋果酸／草醯乙酸偶聯位於調控衰老的細胞質 NAD+/NADH 平衡中心，蘋果酸與草醯乙酸的相互轉換在機制上與細胞能否維持年輕、非衰老的氧化還原狀態直接相關。

links.context: In the mammalian retrograde response, mitochondrial stress (ROS, calcium, bioenergetic crisis) activates c-Jun N-terminal kinase, which phosphorylates and modulates transcription factors including AP-1, FOXO, and p53 to reprogram nuclear gene expression toward antioxidant defense and mitochondrial biogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在哺乳類 Retrograde Response 中，粒線體壓力（ROS、鈣離子、生物能量危機）會活化 c-Jun N-terminal kinase，後者磷酸化並調節 AP-1、FOXO 與 p53 等轉錄因子，將核基因表現重編程為朝向抗氧化防禦與粒線體生合成。

links.context: In the nucleus IRF3 cooperates with NF-κB and AP-1 at promoter enhancers such as the IFN-β enhanceosome, inducing type I interferons and interferon-stimulated genes. IRF3 is thus the terminal effector of cytosolic DNA/RNA sensing and a key arm of sterile inflammatory responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 在細胞核內，IRF3 於 IFN-β enhanceosome 等啟動子增強元件上與 NF-κB 及 AP-1 協作，誘導第一型干擾素與干擾素刺激基因的表現。因此 IRF3 是細胞質 DNA/RNA 感知的末端效應因子，也是無菌性發炎反應的重要支臂。

links.context: In the p53 pathway, SAT1 is a p53 transcriptional target whose induction drives ALOX15-dependent lipid peroxidation, so SAT1 sits upstream of the lipoxygenase that executes ferroptotic death (PMID: 25799957).
links.context_zh_TW: 在 p53 途徑中，SAT1 是 p53 的轉錄標的，其誘導會推動 ALOX15 依賴的脂質過氧化，因此 SAT1 位於執行鐵死亡死亡的脂氧酶上游 (PMID: 25799957)。

links.context: In the parkinsonian brain, activated microglia release pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 that exacerbate oxidative stress and alpha-synuclein aggregation. Cytokine networks integrate the immune axis with oxidative, lysosomal, and proteostatic hypotheses of parkinsonism.
links.context_zh_TW: 在帕金森腦中，活化的微膠質細胞釋放 TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，加劇氧化壓力與 alpha-synuclein 聚集。細胞激素網路將免疫軸與帕金森症的氧化、溶酶體及蛋白質恆定假說整合。

links.context: In the regenerating liver, nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to a faster regaining of liver weight in mice. This hepatoprotective and regenerative effect is tied to NAD+ biosynthesis, which supports the energy-producing and biosynthetic demands of liver regeneration. In addition, dietary NR supplementation restored NAD+ levels that were depressed by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma, preventing both DNA damage and tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在再生肝臟中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，使小鼠更快恢復肝臟重量。這種肝保護與再生作用與 NAD+ 生物合成有關，後者支持肝臟再生所需的能量產生與生物合成需求。此外，飲食補充 NR 恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，在肝細胞癌小鼠模型中同時防止了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: In the vasculature, eNOS/NO signaling and SIRT6 cooperate in endothelial protection and vasodilation (analogous to the SIRT1-eNOS loop), so eNOS is listed as a positive regulator of the SIRT6 pathway in Table 3.
links.context_zh_TW: 在血管中，eNOS/NO 訊號與 SIRT6 協同合作，共同參與內皮保護和血管舒張（類似於 SIRT1-eNOS 迴路），因此 eNOS 被列為表 3 中 SIRT6 途徑的正向調節因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: In therapy-treated or aged animals and patients, systemic senescent cells secrete low-grade SASP factors such as IL-6, IL-1α, IL-1β, IL-8, CXCL1, CCL2 and TNF to maintain a chronic inflammatory status. Persistent low-grade secretion sustains inflammaging, linking senescent-cell burden to cardiovascular disease, osteoarthritis and frailty.
links.context_zh_TW: 在接受治療或老化的動物與病人中，全身性衰老細胞分泌低度量的 SASP 因子（如 IL-6、IL-1α、IL-1β、IL-8、CXCL1、CCL2 與 TNF）以維持慢性發炎狀態。持續的低度量分泌維持 inflammaging，把衰老細胞負荷連結到 Cardiovascular Disease、Osteoarthritis 與 frailty。

links.context: In trichuriasis, adding ivermectin to albendazole achieves significantly higher cure and egg-reduction rates than either drug alone (OR 2.65 for cure in meta-analyses), which is why ivermectin is added for heavy or treatment-refractory infections.
links.context_zh_TW: 在鞭蟲病中，Ivermectin 與 Albendazole 併用所達成的治癒率與蟲卵減少率，顯著高於任一藥物單獨使用（統合分析的治癒率 OR 為 2.65），因此重度感染或治療無效的病例會加上 Ivermectin。

links.context: In tumor-associated macrophages, the SUMO protease SENP1 deSUMOylates the mitochondrial sirtuin SIRT3; SIRT3 SUMOylation deficiency enhances cholesterol synthesis, raises mitochondrial acetyl-CoA, and drives M2 polarization. This SENP1-SIRT3-cholesterol axis shows that mitochondrial sirtuin activity in immune host cells gates the anti-tumor cytotoxic response.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Tumor-Associated Macrophage 中，SUMO 蛋白酶 SENP1 將粒線體 sirtuin SIRT3 去 SUMO 化；SIRT3 的 SUMO 化缺失會提升膽固醇合成、提高粒線體 acetyl-CoA，並驅動 M2 極化。此 SENP1-SIRT3-膽固醇軸顯示免疫宿主細胞中的粒線體 sirtuin 活性可調控抗腫瘤細胞毒性反應。

links.context: In vivo activation of SIRT1 protects against cardiac hypertrophy, metabolic dysregulation, and cardiac inflammation in a mouse model of cardiac hypertrophy, and exhibits protective effects in other models of cardiac dysfunction. SIRT1 is an NAD+-dependent deacetylase that mediates much of the cardioprotective benefit of NAD+ precursor supplementation, and NAD+ is an obligate substrate for its activity. In the failing heart, protein hyperacetylation driven by decreasing NAD+-dependent deacetylation increases both in mouse models of hypertrophy and in human patients with ischemic heart failure or dilated cardiomyopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 體內激活 SIRT1 可於心肌肥大小鼠模型中對抗心臟肥大、代謝失調與心臟發炎，並在其他心臟功能障礙模型中展現保護效應。SIRT1 是一種 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，介導了 NAD+ 前驅物補充所帶來的大部分心臟保護效益，而 NAD+ 是其活性不可或缺的受質。在衰竭心臟中，由 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯作用下降所驅動的蛋白質過度乙醯化，在小鼠肥大模型以及患有缺血性心衰竭或擴張型心肌病的人類患者中皆會增加。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Inactivating APC mutation is the initiating event of the adenoma-carcinoma sequence, driving constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in most sporadic colon cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: APC 失活突變是腺瘤–癌序列的起始事件，在多數散發性結腸癌中驅動持續性 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號。

links.context: Inactivating GPX4 removes the cell's ability to reduce phospholipid hydroperoxides, so RSL3 treatment leads to accumulation of iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and hence ferroptosis. Glutathione depletion synergizes with RSL3 because GSH is the GPX4 cofactor, and adrenochrome is hypothesized to share a similar GPX4-inhibition mechanism via o-quinone electrophilic arylation.
links.context_zh_TW: 使 GPX4 失活會剝奪細胞還原磷脂過氧化物的能力，因此 RSL3 處理會導致鐵依賴性的 lipid peroxidation 累積，進而引發 ferroptosis。glutathione 耗竭與 RSL3 具有協同作用，因為 GSH 是 GPX4 的輔因子；而 adrenochrome 被假設透過鄰醌類的親電芳香化作用共享類似的 GPX4 抑制機制。

links.context: Increased PARylation is a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, and it could be decreased in AD mice with nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation. Increased PARylation has also been detected in several other neurodegenerative disorders that involve DNA repair defects, including Cockayne syndrome, xeroderma pigmentosum, and ataxia-telangiectasia, where PARP-mediated NAD+ depletion plays a major role in pathogenesis. Despite the underlying DNA repair deficiencies, NR dramatically improved the phenotype of each of these conditions in mouse models, prolonging survival by more than three times in ataxic mice.
links.context_zh_TW: PARylation（聚 ADP-核糖基化）增加是阿茲海默症的標記，且可透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充在 AD 小鼠中降低。PARylation 增加亦在數種涉及 DNA 修復缺陷的其他神經退化性疾病中被偵測到，包括 Cockayne 症候群、xeroderma pigmentosum（著色性乾皮症）與 ataxia-telangiectasia（共濟失調毛細血管擴張症），其中 PARP 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭在致病機轉中扮演主要角色。儘管存在潛在的 DNA 修復缺陷，NR 在小鼠模型中顯著改善了這些疾病的每一種表型，在共濟失調小鼠中將存活期延長超過三倍。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Increasing TFEB function via PGC-1α rescues the proteotoxicity of Huntington's Disease: PGC-1α promotes huntingtin turnover and clearance of protein aggregates by activating TFEB, the master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. This links mitochondrial biogenesis signalling directly to lysosomal clearance of protein aggregates.
links.context_zh_TW: 透過 PGC-1α 提升 TFEB 功能可救援 Huntington's Disease 的蛋白毒性：PGC-1α 藉由活化溶小體生成與自噬的主控轉錄因子 TFEB，促進 huntingtin 周轉與蛋白聚集體的清除。這把粒線體生成的訊號直接連結到蛋白聚集體的溶小體清除。

links.context: Individuals with Oculocutaneous Albinism are exquisitely sensitive to UV radiation and have a substantially elevated lifetime risk of Melanoma and non-melanoma skin cancer. Chronic sun damage leads to solar elastosis, lentigines, and actinic keratoses. Lifelong dermatologic surveillance is required.
links.context_zh_TW: 患有 Oculocutaneous Albinism 的人對 UV 輻射極為敏感，一生中發生 Melanoma 和非黑色素瘤皮膚癌的風險大幅升高。慢性日曬損傷會導致日光性彈性變性、雀斑樣痣和光化性角化病。需要終生的皮膚科監測。

links.context: Indole-3-propionic acid (IPA), the principal microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite, activates the Pregnane X Receptor (PXR/NR1I2). PXR activation upregulates the barrier gene B3galt5, reinforces mucus and tight-junction defenses, inhibits NF-κB, and suppresses CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 responses, making IPA–PXR signaling relevant to inflammatory bowel disease and barrier integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: Indole-3-propionic acid（IPA，主要的菌群衍生色胺酸代謝物）會活化 Pregnane X Receptor（PXR/NR1I2）。PXR 活化會上調屏障基因 B3galt5、強化黏液與緊密連結防禦、抑制 NF-κB，並抑制 CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 反應，使 IPA–PXR 訊號與發炎性腸病及屏障完整性相關。

links.context: Indole-3-propionic acid is a gut microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite. It potentiates SIRT3 to enhance myocardial bioenergetics and improve diastolic function in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, representing a microbiota-mitochondria axis with translational potential.
links.context_zh_TW: Indole-3-propionic acid 是一種腸道微生物群衍生的色氨酸代謝物。它增強 SIRT3 以改善心肌生物能學並改善射血分數保留性心臟衰竭的舒張功能，代表了一個具有轉化潛力的微生物群-粒線體軸線。

links.context: Indoline — a benzene ring fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring, the partially hydrogenated form of indole — forms the structural core of Aminochromes such as Adrenochrome and Dopaminochrome. During Oxidation of Catecholamines the catechol ring is converted to a Quinone while the side-chain nitrogen cyclizes to close the five-membered indoline ring.
links.context_zh_TW: Indoline——由苯環與五員含氮環稠合而成、為 indole 部分氫化型態——構成 Aminochromes（如 Adrenochrome 與 Dopaminochrome）的結構核心。在 Catecholamines 的 Oxidation 過程中，catechol 環被轉換為 Quinone，同時側鏈氮原子環化閉合形成五員 indoline 環。

links.context: Indoline-5,6-dione is formed from Epinephrine through internal cyclization of an o-quinone intermediate: the catechol is first oxidized to the ortho-quinone, then an intramolecular Michael addition closes the indoline ring. The unstable intermediates make this step a control point in adrenochrome chemistry.
links.context_zh_TW: Indoline-5,6-dione 是由 Epinephrine 經由鄰醌中間體的內部環化形成：兒茶酚先被氧化為鄰醌，再經分子內 Michael 加成閉合形成 indoline 環。由於其中間體不穩定，此步驟成為 Adrenochrome 化學反應的調控點。

links.context: Indoline-5,6-dione is the chemical structure corresponding to Adrenochrome, consisting of an indoline ring system with two ketone groups at the 5 and 6 positions. Its formation marks a side pathway of catecholamine oxidation and is often taken as a marker for failed homeostasis or extreme oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Indoline-5,6-dione 是 Adrenochrome 對應的化學結構，由 5 與 6 位置具有兩個酮基的 indoline 環系構成。其形成標記了兒茶酚胺氧化的一條側途徑，常被視為穩態崩解（failed homeostasis）或極端 Oxidative Stress 的指標。

links.context: Inflammaging is reduced by senomorphics, which suppress the SASP-driven chronic inflammation without eliminating senescent cells. By damping IL-6, IL-1a, and other cytokines, senomorphics lower the sterile inflammatory milieu of aging while preserving potentially beneficial acute senescence. This approach is a key clinical strategy where cell clearance may be undesirable or unsafe, such as in frail populations. It complements senolysis by targeting the inflammatory output rather than the cellular source.
links.context_zh_TW: Inflammaging 被 senomorphics 減少，senomorphics 在不消除衰老細胞下抑制 SASP 驅動的慢性發炎。透過減弱 IL-6、IL-1α 與其他細胞激素，senomorphics 降低老化的無菌發炎微環境，同時保留潛在有益的急性衰老。此途徑在細胞清除可能不合宜或不安全（如衰弱族群）時是關鍵臨床策略。它補充 senolysis，標靶發炎輸出而非細胞來源。

links.context: Inflammasome activation is a cause rather than an effect of the SASP during oncogene-induced senescence: cells undergoing OIS secreted processed mature IL-1α and IL-1β and exhibited Caspase-1 activity, and inflammasome component protein levels rose without mRNA change. Caspase-1 or IL-1R inhibitors blunted SASP component expression during OIS, whereas TGFBR1 inhibitors did not.
links.context_zh_TW: 在致癌基因誘發衰老期間，inflammasome 活化是 SASP 的原因而非結果：進行 OIS 的細胞分泌經加工的成熟 IL-1α 與 IL-1β，並呈現 Caspase-1 活性；inflammasome 成分的蛋白質水平上升而 mRNA 未變。Caspase-1 或 IL-1R 抑制劑可削弱 OIS 期間的 SASP 成分表現，而 TGFBR1 抑制劑則無此效果。

links.context: Inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves Parkin, the E3 ligase essential for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, halting the mitophagy pathway. Caspase-1 simultaneously enhances mitochondrial ROS production, permeabilization, and fragmentation, pushing damage beyond mitophagy's repair capacity. This is the pyroptosis-to-mitophagy inhibitory arm: lytic inflammatory death not only runs ahead of mitochondrial cleanup but actively dismantles it — although ambient ozone exposure studies show ROS can also activate PINK1-Parkin mitophagy upstream of NLRP3 pyroptosis, so the relationship is bidirectional and context-dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體活化的 Caspase-1 會切割 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬所必需的 E3 連接酶 Parkin，使粒線體自噬路徑中止。Caspase-1 同時加劇粒線體 ROS 的產生、通透化與片段化，使損傷超出粒線體自噬的修復能力。這是焦亡至粒線體自噬的抑制臂：發炎性裂解死亡不只跑在粒線體清理之前，還主動拆解它——不過臭氧暴露研究顯示 ROS 也可在 NLRP3 焦亡的上游活化 PINK1-Parkin 粒線體自噬，因此兩者關係是雙向且取決於情境的。

links.context: Inflammasome-processed IL-1alpha is the master upstream regulator of the SASP program. Drive records the apical cytokine position.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體處理的 IL-1α 是 SASP 程序的上游主調控者。驅動記錄頂端細胞激素位置。

links.context: Inflammation creates a permissive oxidative environment for epinephrine oxidation to adrenochrome: recruited neutrophils and activated macrophages release myeloperoxidase and NADPH oxidase, generating hypochlorous acid and superoxide. Adrenochrome in turn activates NF-κB, closing a positive feedback loop between inflammation and catecholamine oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎為腎上腺素氧化成 adrenochrome 創造了容許性的氧化環境：被招募的中性球與活化的巨噬細胞釋放 myeloperoxidase 與 NADPH oxidase，生成次氯酸與超氧陰離子。而 adrenochrome 反過來活化 NF-κB，形成發炎與兒茶酚胺氧化之間的正向回饋迴路。

links.context: Inflammation is the direct downstream consequence of PAMP recognition: PRR signalling sets in motion NF-κB-driven cytokine release, and chronic infection-driven inflammation sustained by PAMP signalling is a documented contributor to Tumorigenesis in H. pylori-associated gastric cancer, HPV-associated cervical cancer and HBV/HCV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
links.context_zh_TW: Inflammation 是 PAMP 辨識後的直接下游結果：PRR 訊號啟動 NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素釋放，而由 PAMP 訊號維持的慢性感染發炎，則是 H. pylori 相關胃癌、HPV 相關子宮頸癌與 HBV/HCV 相關肝細胞癌中已被記錄的 Tumorigenesis 促成因素。
