links.context: Inflammatory Diseases such as Rheumatoid Arthritis, Inflammatory Bowel Disease, psoriasis, and Atherosclerosis arise when unresolved Inflammation persists — that is, when NF-κB-driven cytokine circuits fail to terminate.
links.context_zh_TW: 像 Rheumatoid Arthritis（類風濕性關節炎）、Inflammatory Bowel Disease（發炎性腸道疾病）、psoriasis（銀屑病）與 Atherosclerosis（動脈粥狀硬化）等 Inflammatory Diseases（發炎性疾病），都是當未解炎的 Inflammation（發炎）持續存在時產生——也就是當 NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素迴路無法終止時。

links.context: Inhalation of isobutyl nitrite can trigger severe acquired methemoglobinemia, presenting with cyanosis, hypoxia and characteristic chocolate-brown blood. Because the underlying defect is oxidatively impaired hemoglobin, antidotes must restore the ferrous heme state rather than improve oxygen delivery capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 吸入 isobutyl nitrite 可誘發嚴重的後天性 methemoglobinemia，表現為發紺、缺氧以及特有的巧克力色血液。由於其缺陷在於血基質被氧化而無法正常運氧，解毒劑必須還原鐵離子狀態，而非單純改善氧氣運送。

links.context: Inhibition of mTOR by rapamycin improves the NAD+/NADH redox balance, supports oxidative phosphorylation, relieves mTOR-hyperactivity pseudohypoxia linked to HIF-1α accumulation, and promotes mitochondrial biogenesis via PGC-1α and TFAM, renewing mitochondrial populations and improving fatty-acid metabolism in senescent tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 抑制 mTOR 可改善 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原平衡、支持 oxidative phosphorylation、解除與 HIF-1α 累積相關的 mTOR 過度活化假性缺氧，並透過 PGC-1α 與 TFAM 促進粒線體生成，更新粒線體族群並改善衰老組織中的脂肪酸代謝。

links.context: Inhibition of mTOR by rapamycin raises TFAM together with PGC-1alpha, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis, renewal of the mitochondrial population and improved fatty-acid metabolism in senescent tissues such as myocardium and brown adipose tissue. Rapamycin additionally boosts TFAM via cap-independent translation and ATF4/H2S-mediated stress resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 抑制 mTOR 會使 TFAM 與 PGC-1alpha 一起上升，促進 mitochondrial biogenesis、粒線體族群的更新，以及心肌與褐色脂肪等衰老組織中的脂肪酸代謝改善。Rapamycin 也透過帽非依賴性轉譯與 ATF4/H2S 媒介的壓力抗性進一步提升 TFAM。

links.context: Inhibition of ribonucleotide reductase produces dNTP insufficiency, which stalls replication forks and activates ATR/ATM checkpoint signaling; the resulting dNTP-catastrophe axis is precisely how agents such as hydroxyurea impose cell-cycle arrest and can lead to Apoptosis or Senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 抑制核糖核苷酸還原酶會造成 dNTP 不足，進而使複製叉停滯並活化 ATR/ATM 檢查點訊號；由此形成的「dNTP 災難」軸線，正是 hydroxyurea 等藥物造成細胞週期停滯、並可能導致 Apoptosis 或 Senescence 的機制。

links.context: Insulin Resistance is a pathological condition in which cells fail to respond normally to insulin, and it is a hallmark of type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. It has also been linked to the intake and accumulation of dietary Advanced Glycation End Products, which may promote systemic Inflammation and Oxidative Stress and thereby worsen insulin responsiveness.
links.context_zh_TW: Insulin Resistance 是細胞對胰島素反應正常的病理狀態，也是 type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 的特徵。它也與膳食 Advanced Glycation End Products 的攝取與累積有關，後者可能促進全身性 Inflammation 與 Oxidative Stress，進而惡化胰島素反應性。

links.context: Insulin signaling drives glucose uptake by recruiting the GLUT4 glucose transporter to the cell membrane via the insulin receptor → IRS1 → PI3K → AKT cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: 胰島素訊息傳遞經由胰島素受體 → IRS1 → PI3K → AKT 的級聯，將葡萄糖轉運蛋白 GLUT4 招募到細胞膜以促進葡萄糖攝取。

links.context: Insulin-driven Akt signaling phosphorylates FOXO3 and sequesters it in the cytoplasm, opposing FOXO3's nuclear stress-resistance activity. This links nutrient and insulin sensing directly to FOXO3-dependent gene expression.
links.context_zh_TW: 胰島素驅動的 Akt 訊號會磷酸化 FOXO3 並將其滯留於細胞質中，對抗 FOXO3 的核內抗壓活性。這使營養與胰島素感知得以直接連結至 FOXO3 依賴性的基因表現。

links.context: Interferon binding to its receptor activates JAK kinases, which phosphorylate STAT transcription factors — the canonical JAK-STAT cascade that primes necroptosis machinery.
links.context_zh_TW: 干擾素結合其受體活化 JAK 激酶，JAK 磷酸化 STAT 轉錄因子——此為啟動 necroptosis 機器的經典 JAK-STAT 級聯。

links.context: Interferon-gamma-induced IDO1 diverts tryptophan into the kynurenine pathway, and the IFN-gamma–IDO1–kynurenine–aryl hydrocarbon receptor axis is a major immunosuppressive pathway in the tumor microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: Interferon-gamma 誘導的 IDO1 將色胺酸分流至犬尿胺酸途徑，而 IFN-gamma–IDO1–犬尿胺酸–芳香烴受體軸是腫瘤微環境中主要的免疫抑制途徑。

links.context: Interleukin-11 binds IL-11Ralpha, which complexes with the shared subunit gp130 to activate JAK (primarily JAK1/TYK2) and STAT3, plus MAPK and PI3K/Akt cascades; IL-11 also engages MAPK and PI3K/Akt signaling to drive fibroblast activation and matrix deposition.
links.context_zh_TW: Interleukin-11 結合 IL-11Rα，後者與共用次單元 gp130 複合以活化 JAK（主要為 JAK1/TYK2）與 STAT3，並同時啟動 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt 級聯；IL-11 亦經由 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt 訊息促成纖維母細胞活化與基質沉積。

links.context: Interleukin-11 is a distinctive senescence-associated secretory phenotype factor with tissue-restricted, mostly deleterious consequences: senescent cells secrete it to activate STAT3 in osteoblasts and amplify pro-fibrotic signaling in lung and heart.
links.context_zh_TW: Interleukin-11 是具組織限制性且多為有害的 SASP 因子：衰老細胞分泌 IL-11 以活化骨母細胞中的 STAT3，並在肺與心臟放大促纖維化訊息。

links.context: Interleukin-33 released from senescent hepatic stellate cells activates group 2 innate lymphoid cells, eosinophils and regulatory T cells, reshaping the tumor microenvironment toward immune suppression and promoting hepatocellular carcinoma development.
links.context_zh_TW: 由衰老肝星狀細胞釋放的 Interleukin-33 活化第 2 型先天淋巴球細胞（ILC2s）、嗜伊紅性球與調節型 T 細胞，使腫瘤微環境轉向免疫抑制並促進肝細胞癌的發展。

links.context: Intermittent fasting and time-restricted feeding compress the eating window to 8-10 hours to allow a 14-16 hour daily fasting period, described as the simplest and most effective way to activate AMPK and mitophagy. Constant snacking and chronic overeating abolish the fasting-induced AMPK signal necessary for mitophagy. Fasting-induced mitochondrial recycling is a core mitohormetic mechanism, and stopping food intake at least 3-4 hours before sleep is highlighted as a key variable that instantly improves overnight HRV by allowing the body to focus entirely on cellular repair during sleep.
links.context_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食與限時進食將進食窗口壓縮至8–10小時，以達到每天14–16小時的禁食期，被描述為活化AMPK與粒線體自噬最簡單且最有效的方法。持續零嘴進食與慢性暴食會消除禁食誘發、粒線體自噬所需的AMPK訊號。禁食誘導的粒線體回收是核心的粒線體毒物興奮機制，而至少在睡前3–4小時停止進食被強調為關鍵變因，可讓身體在睡眠期間完全專注於細胞修復，立即改善夜間HRV。

links.context: Intestinal stem cells are LGR5+ crypt base columnar cells that drive continuous epithelial renewal and are particularly vulnerable to mtDNA mutations: a high burden of mitochondrial DNA mutations reduces LGR5+ cell function and organoid-forming capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 腸道幹細胞是位於腸 crypt 基底的 LGR5+ 柱狀細胞，負責持續的上皮更新，並特別容易受到粒線體 DNA 突變影響：粒線體 DNA 突變負荷高會降低 LGR5+ 細胞功能與類器官形成能力。

links.context: Intestinal stem cells are LGR5+ stem cells located at the base of intestinal crypts, among the most rapidly dividing stem cell populations in the body, whose fate is partitioned by mitochondrial age and quality rather than mtDNA mutation load alone.
links.context_zh_TW: 腸道幹細胞是位於腸 crypt 基底的 LGR5+ 幹細胞，是體內分裂最快的幹細胞族群之一，其命運受粒線體年齡與品質而非僅 mtDNA 突變負荷所區分。

links.context: Intracellular AGE modification of proteins reduces the activity of several antioxidant enzymes, including glutathione peroxidase, catalase, and glutathione reductase. Glutathione peroxidase normally reduces hydrogen peroxide and lipid peroxides using glutathione, and its inhibition by glycation increases cellular oxidative stress. These alterations of antioxidant enzyme activities contribute to the pro-oxidant state seen in aging and diabetic tissues, and represent one mechanism by which glycation impairs cellular function. This is distinct from the extracellular cross-linking and RAGE-mediated effects of AGEs.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質的 intracellular AGE modification 降低多種 antioxidant enzymes 的活性，包括 glutathione peroxidase、catalase 與 glutathione reductase。Glutathione peroxidase 通常使用 glutathione 來 reduce hydrogen peroxide 與 lipid peroxides，其受 glycation 抑制會增加細胞 oxidative stress。這些 antioxidant enzyme activities 的 alterations 促成 aging 與 diabetic tissues 中可見的 pro-oxidant state，並代表 glycation impairs cellular function 的一種機制。這不同於 AGEs 的 extracellular cross-linking 與 RAGE-mediated effects。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Ionizing radiation causes DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM at the site of damage, converting it to an active monomer. This makes ionizing radiation a primary exogenous trigger for ATM activation. Activated ATM then coordinates cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 游離輻射會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，在損傷處招募並使 ATM 自體磷酸化，將其轉化為活化的單體。這使游離輻射成為 ATM 激活的主要外源性觸發因子。激活的 ATM 隨後協調細胞週期停滯、修復與細胞凋亡。

links.context: Irinotecan is a cytotoxic camptothecin-analog chemotherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: irinotecan 是細胞毒性喜樹鹼類似物化療藥。

links.context: Irinotecan is a flagship colorectal cancer therapeutic.
links.context_zh_TW: irinotecan 是結直腸癌旗艦治療藥。

links.context: Irinotecan is the topoisomerase-I component of FOLFIRI.
links.context_zh_TW: irinotecan 是 FOLFIRI 的拓樸異構酶 I 成分。

links.context: Irisin, a myokine secreted by skeletal muscle during exercise, is a potent activator of UCP1 in white adipose tissue. The PGC-1α-FNDC5-Irisin axis drives browning of subcutaneous white fat, converting energy-storing white adipocytes into energy-dissipating beige adipocytes and raising thermogenesis and energy expenditure.
links.context_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動時由骨骼肌分泌的 myokine，是白色脂肪組織中 UCP1 的強力活化因子。PGC-1α-FNDC5-Irisin 軸驅動皮下白脂肪「棕化」，將儲能的白色脂肪細胞轉為散熱的 beige 脂肪細胞，提升產熱與能量消耗。

links.context: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
links.context_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

links.context: Iron is an essential transition metal that in the brain is bound by neuromelanin within dopaminergic neurons. Neuromelanin granules bind substantial nigral iron, acting as a neuronal metal reservoir that detoxifies reactive free iron.
links.context_zh_TW: 鐵是必需的過渡金屬，在腦中由多巴胺神經元內的 neuromelanin 結合。Neuromelanin 顆粒結合大量黑質鐵，作為解毒反應性游離鐵的神經元金屬儲庫。

links.context: Isatin (indole-2,3-dione) is an endogenous indole alkaloid and a reversible, selective Monoamine oxidase inhibitor, particularly toward MAO-B. By limiting MAO-driven oxidative deamination of Dopamine and adrenaline, isatin modulates catecholamine flux and reduces the upstream substrate available for autoxidation into Adrenochrome. It also shows pro-oxidant and electrophilic behavior akin to indolequinones, engaging thiols such as Glutathione, and has been implicated in anxiety- and depression-like behaviour (the tribulin hypothesis) and seizure modulation.
links.context_zh_TW: Isatin（indole-2,3-dione）是內源性吲哚生物鹼，也是可逆且具選擇性的 Monoamine oxidase 抑制劑，尤其偏向 MAO-B。藉由限制 Monoamine oxidase 對 Dopamine 與 adrenaline 的氧化脫氨，Isatin 可調節兒茶酚胺通量並減少可供自氧化生成 Adrenochrome 的上游受質。它同時具有類似 indolequinone 的促氧化與親電子特性，可與 Glutathione 等硫醇反應，並與焦慮及類憂鬱行為（tribulin 假說）和癲癇調節相關。

links.context: Ischemia-reperfusion injury engages multiple regulated cell death programs: RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis, GPX4/Glutathione-regulated ferroptosis from lipid peroxidation, NLRP3-driven pyroptosis, and PARP1 hyperactivation causing parthanatos.
links.context_zh_TW: 缺血再灌流損傷會啟動多種受調控的細胞死亡程式：RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL 介導的 necroptosis、由脂質過氧化與 GPX4／Glutathione 調控的 ferroptosis、NLRP3 驅動的 pyroptosis，以及 PARP1 過度活化造成的 parthanatos。

links.context: Isobutyl nitrite is a volatile alkyl nitrite ('poppers') whose nitrite species oxidize the ferrous (Fe2+) iron of hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. The resulting methemoglobin cannot bind or transport oxygen, so nitrite-driven one-electron oxidation of heme iron is the shared chemical basis for isobutyl nitrite toxicity and, in parallel, for the redox/autoxidation chemistry of catecholamine quinones.
links.context_zh_TW: Isobutyl nitrite 是一種易揮發的烷基亞硝酸酯（「poppers」），其亞硝酸鹽物種可將血基質的鐵由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。所形成的 methemoglobin 無法結合或運送氧氣，因此亞硝酸鹽驅動的單電子血基質氧化，正是 isobutyl nitrite 毒性的化學基礎，也與兒茶酚胺醌類的氧化／自氧化化學平行。

links.context: Isoleucine is catabolized primarily in skeletal muscle and contributes to the amino-acid pool that activates mTORC1, although it is a weaker mTORC1 activator than leucine and exerts distinct metabolic effects.
links.context_zh_TW: Isoleucine 主要在骨骼肌中被分解代謝，並 contributes 至活化 mTORC1 的胺基酸池；然而它比 leucine 活化 mTORC1 的效力更弱，且具有不同的代謝效應。

links.context: Isourolithin A, the gut-microbial isomer of urolithin A, can stimulate mitophagy, the selective clearance of damaged mitochondria. By improving mitochondrial quality control it is of interest for muscle health and healthspan, though its potency is generally somewhat lower than that of urolithin A.
links.context_zh_TW: Isourolithin A 是 urolithin A 的腸道菌叢異構體，可刺激 Mitophagy，即可選擇性清除受損粒線體。藉由改善粒線體品質管制，它對肌肉健康與 healthspan 具意義，但效價通常略低於 urolithin A。

links.context: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Its active form, pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP), is a cofactor for over 140 enzymatic reactions. As cofactor of Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase it enables synthesis of Dopamine, Serotonin and Norepinephrine; it is also required for homocysteine metabolism via cystathionine beta-synthase and serves as a cofactor for serine hydroxymethyltransferase in the methylation cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: 其活性形式 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate（PLP）是超過 140 種酵素反應的輔因子。作為 Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的輔因子，它使 Dopamine、Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine 的合成得以進行；同時也透過 cystathionine beta-synthase 參與 homocysteine 代謝，並在 methylation 循環中作為 serine hydroxymethyltransferase 的輔因子。

links.context: Ivermectin (150 µg/kg orally every 6–12 months) is the cornerstone of onchocerciasis mass drug administration: it rapidly kills Onchocerca volvulus microfilariae, reducing skin and eye burden, but has limited activity against adult worms, so repeated dosing is required. Rapid microfilarial killing can also trigger a Mazzotti reaction requiring clinical attention.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin（150 µg/kg口服，每 6–12 個月一次）是 onchocerciasis mass drug administration 的支柱：它能迅速殺死 Onchocerca volvulus 微絲蟲，減少皮膚與眼部負擔，但對成蟲活性有限，因此需要反覆給藥。快速殺死微絲蟲也可能引發需要臨床處理的 Mazzotti reaction。

links.context: Ivermectin increases autophagic flux and the expression of LC3, Beclin-1 and Atg5 in breast cancer cell lines MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231, inducing autophagy by inhibiting Akt and mTOR phosphorylation through the PAK1/Akt/mTOR axis. Autophagy inhibitors chloroquine and wortmannin, or siRNA against Beclin-1 and Atg5, significantly reduce ivermectin's anticancer activity.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 在 MCF-7 與 MDA-MB-231 乳癌細胞中提高自噬流與 LC3、Beclin-1、Atg5 等關鍵自噬蛋白的表現，經由 PAK1／Akt／mTOR 軸抑制 Akt 與 mTOR 磷酸化而誘發 Autophagy。使用自噬抑制劑 chloroquine、wortmannin，或以 siRNA  knockdown Beclin-1 與 Atg5，都會顯著降低 Ivermectin 的抗癌活性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

links.context: Ivermectin induces apoptosis mainly through the mitochondrial pathway: it reduces mitochondrial membrane potential, releases cytochrome c, upregulates Bax and downregulates the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, thereby activating caspase-9/-3 and PARP to trigger apoptosis. In HeLa cells, cell-cycle arrest at G1/S accompanies the morphological hallmarks of apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 主要經粒線體途徑誘發 Apoptosis：降低粒線體膜電位、釋放 cytochrome c、上調 Bax 並下調抗凋亡的 Bcl-2，進而活化 caspase-9／-3 與 PARP 以觸發凋亡。在 HeLa 細胞中，G1／S 期細胞週期阻滯亦伴隨凋亡的形態學特徵。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

links.context: Ivermectin inhibits expression of Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 in cancer stem cells via the PAK1-STAT3 axis. Because Oct4 and Sox2 are core Yamanaka factors, this lowers reprogramming capacity and opposes partial reprogramming, while being therapeutically desirable against CSCs.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 經由 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制癌幹細胞中 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 的表現。由於 Oct4 與 Sox2 是核心 Yamanaka 因子，這降低重編程能力並對抗部分重編程，同時在治療上對抗 CSC 是理想的。

links.context: Ivermectin inhibits proliferation of Colorectal Cancer cell lines including DLD1 and LS174T and promotes Apoptosis by blocking the Wnt signalling pathway, reducing downstream genes such as AXIN2, LGR5 and ASCL2. It also reverses multidrug resistance to vincristine by repressing P-gp via the EGFR/ERK/Akt/NF-κB pathway and enhances anti-EGFR agents such as cetuximab.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 抑制 Colorectal Cancer 細胞株（含 DLD1 與 LS174T）的增殖，並藉由阻斷 Wnt 訊息路徑促進 Apoptosis，使下游基因如 AXIN2、LGR5 與 ASCL2 下降。它亦透過 EGFR/ERK/Akt/NF-κB 路徑抑制 P-gp 以逆轉對 vincristine 的多藥抗藥性，並增強 cetuximab 等抗 EGFR 藥物的作用。

links.context: Ivermectin is a 22,23-dihydroavermectin-B1a/B1b macrolide derived from avermectin, a compound class isolated by Satoshi Ōmura's group at the Kitasato Institute from a single Japanese soil sample and developed with Merck. It activates glutamate-gated chloride channels in parasites, causing chloride influx and neuronal hyperpolarization, GABA release and somatic muscle paralysis.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是 22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a／B1b 大環內酯，為 Avermectin 的衍生物；Avermectin 由大村智 Sato 團隊在北里研究所從一份日本土壤樣本中分離，並與 Merck 共同開發。它活化寄生蟲的麩胺酸門控氯離子通道，造成氯離子內流與神經元超極化、GABA 釋放與體肌麻痺。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

links.context: Ivermectin is a PAK1 inhibitor across most tumor types. It suppresses PAK1 protein without affecting PAK1 mRNA, and the proteasome inhibitor MG132 reverses this suppression, indicating degradation of PAK1 via the ubiquitination-proteasome pathway; knocking down PAK1 with siRNA correspondingly reduces ivermectin's anticancer activity.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 在多數腫瘤中是 PAK1 的抑制劑。它抑制 PAK1 蛋白卻不影響 PAK1 mRNA，且蛋白酶體抑制劑 MG132 可逆轉此抑制作用，表示 PAK1 是經由泛素化—蛋白酶體途徑被降解；以 siRNA 下調 PAK1 也相應降低 Ivermectin 的抗癌活性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

links.context: Ivermectin is a macrocyclic lactone used in mass drug administration against Brugia malayi, where annual single-dose combinations with Albendazole (in onchocerciasis co-endemic areas) or Diethylcarbamazine interrupt transmission by killing microfilariae. Diethylcarbamazine remains the cornerstone drug because it kills both microfilariae and adult worms.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是巨環內酯類藥物，用於對 Brugia malayi 的大規模投藥：在與蟲尾絲蟲病共同流行區與 Albendazole 合併、或與 Diethylcarbamazine 合併的每年單次劑量可藉殺滅微絲蟲阻斷傳播。Diethylcarbamazine 仍是核心藥物，因為它能同時殺死微絲蟲與成蟲。

links.context: Ivermectin preferentially targets and inhibits cancer stem cells, suppressing Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 expression through the PAK1-STAT3 axis. This kills CSCs therapeutically in breast cancer but simultaneously lowers the reprogramming factors needed for Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 優先標靶並抑制癌幹細胞，透過 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 表現。這在乳癌中治療性地殺死 CSC，但同時降低 Yamanaka 因子回春所需的重編程因子。

links.context: Ivermectin reverses tumor multidrug resistance by inhibiting P-glycoprotein and MDR-associated proteins. It reversed vincristine resistance in HCT-8 colorectal cells, doxorubicin resistance in MCF-7 breast cells and resistance in K562 CML, by inhibiting EGFR activation and the downstream ERK/Akt/NF-kappa B pathway to downregulate P-gp expression.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 藉由抑制 P-gp 與 MDR 相關蛋白而逆轉腫瘤的 Multidrug Resistance。它可逆轉 HCT-8 大腸癌的 vincristine 抗藥性、MCF-7 乳癌的 doxorubicin 抗藥性，以及 K562 CML 的抗藥性，機制是抑制 EGFR 活化與下游 ERK／Akt／NF-κB 路徑以降低 P-gp 表現。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md

links.context: Ivermectin treats Pediculosis: topical 0.5% lotion or oral ivermectin at 200 micrograms/kg repeated in 7-10 days are used for pubic lice, and the drug is an alternative when permethrin resistance or poor compliance complicates head-lice treatment.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 可治療 Pediculosis：0.5% 外用洗劑或每公斤 200 微克、7 至 10 天後重複的口服 ivermectin 可用於陰蝨，而當 permethrin 抗藥性或依從性不佳使頭蝨治療複雜化時，此藥為替代選擇。

links.context: Ivermectin was long hypothesized to act on GABA-gated chloride channels, but its primary invertebrate target is now established to be the glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls). Vertebrate GABA_A receptors are far less sensitive to avermectins, and this distinction is what provides ivermectin's selective safety margin — and clarifies that its anticancer activity in mammals is mediated by other targets such as PAK1, YAP1 and Akt/mTOR rather than by GABAergic blockade.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 過去曾被認為作用於 GABA-gated chloride channels，但其主要的無脊椎動物標的現已確定為 glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls)。脊椎動物的 GABA_A 受體對 avermectin 的敏感度遠低於此，這一區別正是 ivermectin 具有選擇性安全邊際的原因，也說明其在哺乳類中的抗癌活性是由 PAK1、YAP1 與 Akt/mTOR 等其他標的所介導，而非 GABAergic 阻斷。

links.context: Ivermectin, marketed as Mectizan, rapidly clears skin microfilariae of onchocerciasis by paralyzing the larvae and enhancing host clearance. Measuring microfilarial burden by blood smear, skin snip or antigen assays before and after treatment gauges the success of mass-drug-administration programmes such as the Mectizan Donation Program, which makes microfilarial density the therapeutic endpoint of filarial control.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin（商品名 Mectizan）藉由使微絲蟲麻痺並增強宿主清除，快速清除 onchocerciasis 的皮膚微絲蟲。治療前後以 blood smear、skin snip 或抗原檢測測量微絲蟲負荷，可評估 Mectizan Donation Program 等 mass drug administration 計畫的成效，使微絲蟲密度成為絲蟲控制的治療終點。

links.context: IκBζ is essential for the expression of the SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8; genetic or pharmacological targeting of IκBζ is therefore a route to modulate senescence-associated inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: IκBζ 對 SASP 细胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 的表現是必要的；因此對 IκBζ 進行遺傳或藥理學上的標定，是調節衰老相關發炎的可行途徑。

links.context: IκBζ is required for IL-8 expression as part of the NF-κB-dependent SASP arm, making it a selective handle on pro-inflammatory secretome components rather than a global inflammation regulator.
links.context_zh_TW: IκBζ 作為 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 分支的一部分，是 IL-8 表現所必需的；這使它成為對促發炎性分泌成分具有選擇性作用的著力點，而非全面性的發炎調節因子。

links.context: J147 is a disease-modifying small molecule developed in the Maher lab that has completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease and improves cognition in aged AD models.
links.context_zh_TW: J147 是由 Maher 實驗室開發的疾病修飾小分子，已完成阿茲海默症的臨床一期試驗，並在老化 AD 模型中改善認知功能。

links.context: JAK-STAT3 is inhibited by ruxolitinib, a JAK1/2 inhibitor that reduces SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 in senescent fibroblasts. By blocking JAK-STAT3 signaling downstream of SASP cytokines, it interrupts the inflammatory feed-forward loop that sustains the secretome, and its established clinical use in myelofibrosis supports its translational potential as a senomorphic. The inhibition is direct, well validated, and among the most clinically translatable senomorphic mechanisms. It positions ruxolitinib as a leading candidate for dampening senescence-associated inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 被 ruxolitinib 抑制，ruxolitinib 是一種降低衰老纖維母細胞中 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 的 JAK1/2 抑制劑。透過阻斷 SASP 細胞激素下游的 JAK-STAT3 訊號，它中斷維持分泌組的發炎正向迴圈，且其於骨髓纖維化既有的臨床使用支持其作為 senomorphic 的轉譯潛力。此抑制直接、良好驗證，且是臨床上最易轉譯的 senomorphic 機制之一。它使 ruxolitinib 成為減弱衰老相關發炎的領先候選。

links.context: JAK-STAT3 promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by integrating cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6 and interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR to amplify factor expression. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory, tumor-promoting facets of the secretome, including cancer stemness. JAK1/2 inhibition (ruxolitinib) reduces SASP cytokines, confirming the axis as a functional regulator. It is a key feed-forward loop sustaining chronic senescence-associated inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 透過整合來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，並與 p38 MAPK 與 mTOR 交互作用放大因子表現，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化貢獻年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向，包括癌症幹性。JAK1/2 抑制（ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素，確認此軸為功能性調節者。它是維持慢性衰老相關發炎的主要正向迴圈。

links.context: JAK2 trans-phosphorylates downstream STAT factors, notably STAT3, coupling cytokine receptors to proliferation/survival transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: JAK2 反式磷酸化下游 STAT 因子（特別是 STAT3），將細胞激素受體與增殖/存活轉錄偶聯。

links.context: JMJD3 (KDM6B) is the KDM6-subfamily paralog of KDM6A/UTX and acts antagonistically to EZH2, the PRC2 H3K27me3 methyltransferase; selective KDM6B inhibition is a plausible senomorphic approach but specificity versus KDM6A must be managed.
links.context_zh_TW: JMJD3（KDM6B）是 KDM6 亞家族的成員，與 KDM6A/UTX 平行，並與 PRC2 的 H3K27me3 甲基轉移酶 EZH2 作用相反；選擇性抑制 KDM6B 是合理的 senomorphic 策略，但必須處理與 KDM6A 之間的專一性問題。

links.context: JMJD3 provides a focal mechanism for senescence-associated inflammation: direct removal of the Polycomb H3K27me3 mark from the two prototypical pro-inflammatory SASP genes IL-6 and IL-8, coupling chromatin demethylation to the inflammatory secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: JMJD3 為衰老相關發炎提供了聚焦的機制：直接從兩個典型的促發炎 SASP 基因 IL-6 與 IL-8 移除 Polycomb 標記 H3K27me3，將染色質去甲基化與發炎性分泌組連結起來。

links.context: JQ1 is the prototype BET inhibitor displacing BRD4 from acetylated histones and suppressing MYC. Tool-compound edge of the BET axis.
links.context_zh_TW: JQ1 是將 BRD4 從乙醯化組蛋白移開並抑制 MYC 的原型 BET 抑制劑。BET 軸的工具化合物邊。

links.context: Jeanho Yun co-authored the 2014 landmark 'Mitohormesis' paper in Cell Metabolism with Toren Finkel. That study showed that mild mitochondrial stress in Caenorhabditis elegans extends lifespan through an adaptive response dependent on the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, providing the mechanistic framework for the mitohormesis concept.
links.context_zh_TW: Jeanho Yun 與 Toren Finkel 共同作者了 2014 年《Cell Metabolism》的里程碑論文「Mitohormesis」。該研究顯示，Caenorhabditis elegans 中輕度的粒線體壓力可透過依賴粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的適應反應延長壽命，為 mitohormesis 概念提供了機轉框架。

links.context: K122 is shorthand notation for lysine 122 of mitochondrial MnSOD (SOD2), the same residue described in full in the Lys122 note. Acetyl-K122 / Lys68 western blotting serves as a SIRT3 target-engagement endpoint in the sirtuin recommendation analyses.
links.context_zh_TW: K122 是粒線體 MnSOD（SOD2）第 122 號離胺酸的簡寫，與 Lys122 筆記中所描述者為同一殘基。在 sirtuin 建議分析中，acetyl-K122／Lys68 西方墨點被用作 SIRT3 標的結合率的檢測終點。

links.context: KAP1 bridges heterochromatin machinery to HP1alpha: SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 promotes its interaction with HP1alpha, which then nucleates heterochromatin spreading at LINE-1 promoters. Because recruitment of HP1alpha is gated by KAP1 ribosylation, HP1alpha's silencing activity is tied directly to SIRT6 abundance.
links.context_zh_TW: KAP1 將異染色質機制與 HP1alpha 連結起來：SIRT6 對 KAP1 的單 ADP-核糖基化促進其與 HP1alpha 互動，HP1alpha 隨後在 LINE-1 啟動子處起始異染色質擴散。由於 HP1alpha 的招募受 KAP1 核糖基化調控，其沉默活性直接與 SIRT6 的含量掛鈎。

links.context: KAP1 contains a central HP1-binding motif and a PHD finger and builds facultative/repetitive heterochromatin in collaboration with SETDB1; its repressive activity is dynamically regulated by SUMOylation and SIRT6-dependent mono-ADP-ribosylation, which enhance its heterochromatinizing function.
links.context_zh_TW: KAP1 含有中央 HP1 結合基序與 PHD finger，並與 SETDB1 合作建立兼性／重複序列異染色質；其抑制活性受到 SUMO 化與 SIRT6 依賴的單 ADP 核糖基化動態調控，兩者皆增強其異染色質化功能。

links.context: KDM4 (JMJD2) family JmjC demethylases use Fe(II) and alpha-ketoglutarate to remove H3K9me3/me2 and H3K36 methyl marks; by erasing repressive H3K9me3 at lamina-associated heterochromatin they open chromatin at SASP loci and promote secreted factor expression in senescent stromal cells.
links.context_zh_TW: KDM4（JMJD2）家族的 JmjC 去甲基化酶利用 Fe(II) 與 alpha-酮戊二酸移除 H3K9me3/me2 與 H3K36 甲基標記；它們藉由清除層狀相關異染色質上的抑制性 H3K9me3，在 SASP 位點開放染色質並促進衰老基質細胞分泌因子表現。

links.context: KDM4 is an established epigenetic driver of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype, and its overexpression is pronounced in senescent stromal and pre-malignant cells, making inhibitors such as JIB-04, ML324 and QC6352 candidate senomorphics and anticancer agents.
links.context_zh_TW: KDM4 是衰老相關分泌表型已確立的表觀遺傳驅動因子，且在衰老基質細胞與癌前細胞中過度表現明顯，使 JIB-04、ML324、QC6352 等抑制劑成為候選 senomorphic 與抗癌藥物。

links.context: KDM4A/KDM4B are induced downstream of p38 MAPK and pro-inflammatory signaling in senescence and relocalize away from constitutive heterochromatin toward SASP gene regulatory elements, so KDM4 links metabolic/oxidative state (alpha-KG/succinate ratio) to SASP intensity.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老過程中，KDM4A/KDM4B 由 p38 MAPK 與促發炎訊息下游誘導，並從組成性異染色質重新定位到 SASP 基因的調控元件，因此 KDM4 將代謝／氧化狀態（alpha-KG／succinate 比值）連結到 SASP 強度。

links.context: KDM5C and KDM6A are opposing X-linked EXITS demethylases: KDM5C erases the activating H3K4me3 mark while KDM6A erases the repressive H3K27me3 mark, jointly balancing active and repressive chromatin. Both escape X-inactivation and cooperate at the onset of X-chromosome inactivation to remove repressive chromatin at the XIST promoter and permit Xist upregulation.
links.context_zh_TW: KDM5C 與 KDM6A 是一對作用相反的 X 連鎖 EXITS 去甲基化酶：KDM5C 擦除活化性的 H3K4me3 標記，而 KDM6A 擦除抑制性的 H3K27me3 標記，兩者共同平衡活化與抑制性染色質。兩者皆可逃脫 X 染色體失活，並在 X 染色體失活起始時協同作用，移除 XIST 啟動子上的抑制性染色質，使 Xist 得以 上調。

links.context: KDM6A belongs to the KDM6 family of histone demethylases, whose JmjC domain uses Fe(II) and alpha-ketoglutarate as cofactors. It is the autosomal-paralog counterpart to JMJD3 (KDM6B), sharing catalytic H3K27me3 demethylase activity but differing in regulatory role: KDM6A is X-linked, escapes inactivation, and drives developmental gene regulation, whereas JMJD3 is autosomal and is a key driver of stress and inflammatory SASP signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: KDM6A 屬於 KDM6 家族的組蛋白去甲基化酶，其 JmjC 結構域以 Fe(II) 與 α-酮戊二酸作為輔因子。它是 JMJD3（KDM6B）的常染色體旁系同源對應物，兩者共享 H3K27me3 去甲基化活性但調控角色不同：KDM6A 為 X 連鎖、可逃脫失活，主要驅動發育基因的調控；JMJD3 則位於常染色體，是壓力與發炎性 SASP 訊號的關鍵驅動因子。

links.context: KIF5B motors extend reformation tubules during ALR. Regulation is the motility input.
links.context_zh_TW: KIF5B 馬達在 ALR 延伸重組小管。調節是運動輸入。

links.context: KRAS is mutated in approximately 90% of pancreatic cancers, with G12D the most common alteration. These mutations impair GTPase activity and lock KRAS in the active GTP-bound state. KRAS mutation is a defining driver of pancreatic tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: KRAS 在約 90% 的胰臟癌中發生突變，其中 G12D 是最常見的改變。這些突變會損害 GTPase 活性，並使 KRAS 鎖定在活化的 GTP 結合狀態。KRAS 突變是胰臟腫瘤發生的決定性驅動因子。

links.context: KRAS-driven Autophagy has a dual role in PDA: it supports tumor metabolism, survival, and chemoresistance, and high basal Autophagy appears to be a prerequisite for tumorigenic growth (Yang et al. 2011b). This is why autophagy inhibitors such as hydroxychloroquine are being investigated as adjuncts to chemotherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 PDA 中，KRAS 驅動的 Autophagy 具有雙重角色：它支持腫瘤代謝、存活與化療抗藥性，且高基礎 Autophagy 似乎是腫瘤生成的先決條件（Yang 等，2011b）。這也是為何 hydroxychloroquine 等自噬抑制劑正被研究作為化療的輔助療法。

links.context: Ketogenesis is induced whenever glucose availability falls, as under Caloric Restriction, Intermittent Fasting or a Ketogenic Diet. During fasting the inhibition of mTORC1 (rising AMP/ATP) promotes Ketogenesis while inhibiting glycolysis and glutaminolysis in tumor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 只要葡萄糖可得性下降就會誘導 Ketogenesis，例如在 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 或 Ketogenic Diet 之下。禁食期間 mTORC1 的抑制（AMP/ATP 上升）會促進 Ketogenesis，同時在腫瘤細胞中抑制糖解與麩醯胺分解。

links.context: Kinesin is a family of microtubule-based motor proteins that transport cargo including mitochondria along axons. The outer mitochondrial membrane protein Miro, together with the adaptor Milton, forms a complex bridging MFN2 to kinesin motors, enabling processive mitochondrial movement to distal neuronal compartments. This Miro/Milton/kinesin axis ensures local ATP delivery and axonal mitochondrial integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: Kinesin 是一類以微管為軌道、沿軸突運送貨物的馬達蛋白，可運送包括粒線體在內的物質。粒線體外膜蛋白 Miro 與轉接蛋白 Milton 形成的複合體將 MFN2 與 kinesin 馬達相連，使粒線體能持續運送至神經元遠端區室。此 Miro/Milton/kinesin 軸確保局部 ATP 供應與軸突粒線體完整性。

links.context: Klotho is a transmembrane protein with a shed, hormone-like extracellular domain that acts as an anti-aging factor: loss-of-function accelerates aging, while elevated Klotho extends lifespan in mice. It regulates mTOR/insulin-IGF signalling and phosphate and vitamin D metabolism, placing it on a shared axis with mTORC1 control and stem-cell homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: Klotho 是一種跨膜蛋白，具有可被剪切釋放、具有荷爾蒙樣特性的胞外結構域，作為抗衰老因子發揮作用：功能喪失會加速衰老，而 Klotho 水平升高則可延長小鼠壽命。它調節 mTOR／胰島素-IGF 訊號以及磷與維生素 D 代謝，因而位於與 mTORC1 調控和幹細胞恆定共享的同一條軸上。

links.context: Knockout of PTP1B in mice enhances insulin sensitivity, improves glucose tolerance and confers resistance to diet-induced obesity, whereas PTP1B overexpression or hyperactivity contributes to systemic insulin resistance. Small-molecule PTP1B inhibitors have therefore been pursued for type 2 diabetes and obesity.
links.context_zh_TW: PTP1B 剔除的小鼠胰島素敏感度提升、葡萄糖耐受性改善並對飲食誘導的肥胖具有抗性；相反地，PTP1B 過度表現或活性過高會促成全身性胰島素阻抗。因此 PTP1B 小分子抑制劑一直被用於第二型糖尿病與肥胖的研究。

links.context: Kynurenic acid is functionally opposed by quinolinic acid, an NMDA receptor agonist and neurotoxin produced in the same kynurenine pathway. The KynA/quinolinic acid ratio is therefore a critical determinant of neuronal health: a high ratio favours neuroprotection, whereas a low ratio permits excitotoxicity and neurodegeneration. Reduced KynA contributes to excitotoxicity in Alzheimer's disease and Huntington's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Kynurenic acid 在功能上與 quinolinic acid 相對抗；後者是同一條 kynurenine 路徑產生的 NMDA 受體致效劑與神經毒素。因此 KynA／quinolinic acid 比值是決定神經元健康的關鍵因子：比值高有利於神經保護，比值低則容許興奮毒性與神經退化發生。KynA 降低會促成阿茲海默症與亨丁頓舞蹈症中的興奮毒性。

links.context: Kynurenine and its derivatives activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), which promotes regulatory T cell (Treg) differentiation while suppressing effector T and NK cells. This is a central effector arm of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression: IDO1 in antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells depletes local tryptophan and produces kynurenine, creating an immunosuppressive microenvironment that favors immune tolerance. This pathway underlies IDO1's physiological roles in maternal-fetal tolerance, regulation of inflammation and autoimmunity, antimicrobial defense, and tumor immune escape, where IDO1 is often upregulated in cancers and the tumor microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）及其衍生物會活化芳香烴受體（aryl hydrocarbon receptor，AhR），進而促進調節性T細胞（Treg）分化，同時抑制效應T細胞與NK細胞。這是IDO1介導之免疫抑制的核心效應臂：樹突細胞等抗原呈現細胞中的IDO1會耗竭局部色胺酸並產生犬尿胺酸，營造有利於免疫耐受的免疫抑制微環境。此途徑是IDO1在母胎耐受、發炎與自體免疫調節、抗菌防禦及腫瘤免疫逃逸中生理角色的基礎；在癌症與腫瘤微環境中IDO1常被上調。

links.context: L-Carnitine is synthesized endogenously, mainly in the liver and kidneys, from the amino acids lysine and methionine, a process that requires vitamin C and iron-dependent hydroxylases. Because the biosynthetic enzymes are not expressed in mature mitochondria, the organelle depends on this supply, and body carnitine pools concentrate in skeletal and cardiac muscle where oxidative demand is highest.
links.context_zh_TW: L-Carnitine 主要在肝臟與腎臟由胺基酸 lysine 與 methionine 內生合成，此過程需要維生素 C 與鐵依賴性羥化酶參與。由於生合成酵素並不在成熟粒線體中表現，粒線體須依賴此供應；而全身肉鹼儲存池集中於氧化需求最高的骨骼肌與心肌。

links.context: L-lactate is the physiological enantiomer of lactate and is produced predominantly by glycolysis and anaerobic metabolism. Once dismissed as a mere waste product, it is now recognized as a signaling metabolite, an energy substrate shuttled between cells via the Cori cycle and monocarboxylate transporters, and an epigenetic modulator through histone lactylation.
links.context_zh_TW: L-lactate 是 lactate 的生理性對映異構體，主要由 glycolysis 與無氧代謝產生。它過去被視為單純的廢物，如今則被認為是訊號代謝物、經由 Cori cycle 與單羧酸運輸蛋白在細胞間運送的能量底物，以及透過組蛋白 lactylation 作用的表觀遺傳調節者。

links.context: LAMP-2A (lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A) is the lysosomal receptor that makes Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy possible: the Hsc70-bound substrate docks on LAMP-2A, which translocates the protein into the lysosome for degradation. Without LAMP-2A the substrate never crosses the membrane.
links.context_zh_TW: LAMP-2A（lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A）是使 Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 得以進行的 lysosome 受體：由 Hsc70 結合的受質停靠在 LAMP-2A 上，後者將蛋白質轉位進 lysosome 進行分解。缺乏 LAMP-2A 時受質無法跨越膜。

links.context: LAMP1 is the most abundant protein on the lysosomal membrane and serves as the standard marker for Lysosome and Autolysosome. Heavily glycosylated, it protects the membrane from luminal hydrolases and maintains lysosomal stability and integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: LAMP1 是 lysosome 膜上最豐富的蛋白質，也是 Lysosome 與 Autolysosome 的標準標記。高度醣基化的 LAMP1 保護膜免受腔內水解酶作用，並維持 lysosome 的穩定性與完整性。

links.context: LATS1 and LATS2 phosphorylation excludes and degrades YAP.
links.context_zh_TW: LATS1 與 LATS2 磷酸化排除並降解 YAP。

links.context: LC3 (Atg8) is lipidated to LC3-II and incorporated into the autophagosomal membrane, serving as the standard marker for autophagosomes; SIRT1 promotes autophagy of cancer cells by reducing acetylation of LC3.
links.context_zh_TW: LC3（Atg8）經脂化形成 LC3-II 並納入自噬體膜，是自噬體的標準標記；SIRT1 藉由降低 LC3 的乙醯化來促進癌細胞的自噬。

links.context: LC3 is the mammalian Atg8 homolog and serves as the key autophagosome marker; p62 acts as a cargo receptor that binds LC3 and ubiquitinated targets, bridging selective cargo to the Atg-driven autophagosome.
links.context_zh_TW: LC3 是哺乳類的 Atg8 同源蛋白，並作為自噬體的關鍵標記；p62 則是貨物受體，結合 LC3 與泛素化的標的，將選擇性貨物橋接到 Atg 驅動的自噬體上。

links.context: LDL oxidation is characterized by lipid peroxidation of polyunsaturated fatty acids plus alteration of the apoB protein moiety, and can be induced by copper ions, gamma-radiolysis-generated free radicals, or endothelial cells. Oxidized LDL is present in atherosclerotic lesions and correlates with coronary atherosclerosis severity; macrophages take up oxidized LDL, accumulating cholesterol and forming foam cells, the hallmark of early atherogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: LDL 氧化的特徵是多不飽和脂肪酸的脂質過氧化，以及 apoB 蛋白部分的改變，可由銅離子、γ 輻解產生的自由基或內皮細胞誘發。氧化型 LDL 存在於動脈粥狀硬化病灶中，並與冠狀動脈粥狀硬化的嚴重程度相關；巨噬細胞攝取氧化型 LDL 後累積膽固醇形成泡沫細胞，這是早期動脈粥樣硬化的特徵。

links.context: LDL that has undergone oxidative modification becomes Oxidized LDL. Reactive Oxygen Species and Myeloperoxidase are the principal agents of this modification, which produces conjugated dienes and alters apoB, converting LDL from a benign cargo particle into a pro-inflammatory atherogenic species.
links.context_zh_TW: 經歷氧化修飾的 LDL 即成為 Oxidized LDL。Reactive Oxygen Species 與 Myeloperoxidase 是此修飾的主要作用者，會產生共軛雙烯並改變 apoB，將 LDL 由無害的載脂顆粒轉化為促發炎、致動脈粥樣硬化的分子。

links.context: LGG-2 is one of the C. elegans orthologues of the yeast Atg8 and mammalian LC3/GABARAP proteins. As the Atg8 family ortholog of GABARAP, LGG-2 performs the membrane-tethering role that mammalian GABARAP plays in autophagosome formation.
links.context_zh_TW: LGG-2 是酵母 Atg8 與哺乳類 LC3/GABARAP 在 C. elegans 中的直系同源物之一。作為 GABARAP 的 Atg8 家族直系同源物，LGG-2 執行哺乳類 GABARAP 在 autophagosome 形成中所扮演的膜繫留角色。

links.context: LHRH agonists such as leuprolide provide the reversible, clinically tolerable pharmacological route to sex steroid ablation: they desensitize LHRH receptors, lower LH/FSH, and hence reduce testosterone and estrogen.
links.context_zh_TW: LHRH 促效劑（如 leuprolide）提供可逆且臨床耐受性良好的藥理途徑來進行性類固醇去除：它們使 LHRH 受體去敏感化、降低 LH/FSH，進而減少 testosterone 與 estrogen。

links.context: LINE-1 (L1) is a common retrotransposable element whose derepression is a hallmark of the senescent epigenome. Loss of RB1-driven heterochromatin and of SIRT6 from L1 loci, together with DNA hypomethylation, decompacts the loci; the resulting LINE-1 cDNA in the cytoplasm acts as a cytosolic DNA ligand for cGAS-STING, activating NF-κB SASP genes. Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs) suppress this axis.
links.context_zh_TW: LINE-1（L1）是常見的retrotransposable element（反轉錄轉位元件），其去抑制是衰老表觀基因組的特徵。RB1 驅動的異染色質與 SIRT6 從 L1 基因座位上的流失，加上 DNA 低甲基化，使這些基因座位解壓縮；所產生的細胞質 LINE-1 cDNA 作為細胞質 DNA 配體活化 cGAS-STING，啟動 NF-κB 相關的 SASP 基因。核苷反轉錄酶抑制劑（NRTIs）可抑制此軸。

links.context: LINE-1 activity leads to elevated cytoplasmic LINE-1 cDNA levels via LINE-1 reverse transcriptase during aging and senescence. This cytosolic DNA is sensed by cGAS, triggering a type I Interferon response that promotes inflammaging in various tissues in a manner similar to SASP. Inhibiting LINE-1 reverse transcriptase with nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors alleviates this interferon-mediated inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在老化與衰老期間，LINE-1 活性透過 LINE-1 反轉錄酶導致細胞質 LINE-1 cDNA 濃度上升。這些細胞質 DNA 被 cGAS 感知，觸發 type I Interferon 反應，以類似 SASP 的方式促進各種組織的 inflammaging。以 nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor 抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄酶可減輕此 interferon 媒介的發炎。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: LINE-1 derepression underlies inflammaging: reactivation of LINE-1 (and HERV) generates cytoplasmic cDNA that triggers cGAS-STING-NF-κB signalling and the SASP, converting a chromatin-level change into a chronic inflammatory output. De-repression of LINE-1 is also observed during normal aging, contributing to genomic instability and inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: LINE-1 去抑制是 inflammaging（發炎性老化）的根源：LINE-1（與 HERV）的再活化會產生細胞質 cDNA，觸發 cGAS-STING-NF-κB 訊號與 SASP，將染色質層級的變化轉化為慢性發炎輸出。正常老化過程中也可觀察到 LINE-1 去抑制，促成基因體不穩定與發炎。

links.context: LKB1, through AMPK activation, feeds back on SIRT1 via NAD+-dependent coupling (AMPK raises NAD+), but is also listed as a negative pathway regulator in Table 3: under certain conditions AMPK/LKB1 signaling opposes SIRT1-promoted anabolic programs, reflecting context-dependent cross-talk of the energy-sensing network.
links.context_zh_TW: LKB1 透過 AMPK 活化，透過 NAD+ 依賴性耦合對 SIRT1 進行回饋（AMPK 提高 NAD+），但也被列為通路的負向調節因子：在某些條件下，AMPK/LKB1 信號拮抗 SIRT1 促進的合成代謝程序，反映了能量感知網絡的環境依賴性交叉對話。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: LRRK2 directly phosphorylates DRP1 to drive excess mitochondrial fission; since impaired mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin) is a PD mechanism, LRRK2-driven fission couples mitochondrial dynamics to Parkinson's pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: LRRK2 直接磷酸化 DRP1 以驅動過度的粒線體分裂；由於受損的 mitophagy（PINK1/Parkin）是帕金森氏症機制，LRRK2 驅動的分裂把粒線體動態學與帕金森氏症病理耦合。

links.context: LYN tyrosine-phosphorylates and suppresses initiator caspase-8.
links.context_zh_TW: LYN 酪胺酸磷酸化並抑制起始 caspase-8。

links.context: Lactate-derived K352 lactylation of malic enzyme 2 enhances its enzymatic activity, boosting NADPH production and mitochondrial respiration in tumor cells; disrupting this mark (K352R) elevates ROS, raises the NADP+/NADPH ratio and suppresses colorectal tumor growth.
links.context_zh_TW: 乳酸衍生的 ME2 K352 乳醯化會增強其酵素活性，提升腫瘤細胞的 NADPH 生成與粒線體呼吸；破壞此標記（K352R）會提高 ROS、升高 NADP⁺/NADPH 比值並抑制結直腸癌生長。

links.context: Lamin A, together with lamin C and the B-type lamins, forms the nuclear lamina meshwork underlying the inner nuclear membrane. By anchoring the Nuclear Pore Complex it provides mechanical support to the nucleus and helps organize Chromatin into lamina-associated domains.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamin A 與 lamin C 及 B 型 lamin 共同構成內核膜下的核纖層網狀結構。它藉由錨定 Nuclear Pore Complex 為細胞核提供機械支撐，並將 Chromatin 組織成核纖層相關結構域（LADs）。

links.context: Lamin B1 is a type B intermediate-filament protein of the nuclear lamina that polymerizes with Lamin A to form the scaffold anchoring nuclear pores and peripheral Chromatin as lamina-associated domains. Senescence represses LMNB1 (partly via p53 and Retinoblastoma Protein) without commensurate loss of Lamin A.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamin B1 是核纖層的 B 型中間絲蛋白，與 Lamin A 聚合形成錨定核孔與周邊 Chromatin（核纖層相關結構域）的支架。衰老會抑制 LMNB1 表達（部分經由 p53 與 Retinoblastoma Protein），而 Lamin A 並未同步流失。

links.context: Lamivudine (3TC) is a cytidine nucleoside analogue that, after phosphorylation to its triphosphate form, competes with dCTP and terminates cDNA chain elongation. The same inhibitory principle applies to the endogenous reverse transcriptase encoded by autonomous LINE-1 retroelements, which is why lamivudine acts as a senomorphic agent.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamivudine（3TC）是胞苷核苷類似物，磷酸化為三磷酸型後與 dCTP 競爭並終止 cDNA 鏈延長。相同的抑制原理也適用於自主性 LINE-1 反轉錄子所編碼的內源性反轉錄酶，因此 lamivudine 可作為 senomorphic 藥物。

links.context: Lamivudine is a representative nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor drug. Classification anchors the member.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamivudine 是代表性的核苷逆轉錄酶抑制藥物。歸類錨定成員。

links.context: Late-life fisetin intervention extends healthspan in aged mice. Extension records the geroprotective outcome with no existing Fisetin-Healthspan edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 晚年 fisetin 介入延長老年小鼠健康壽命。延長記錄老年保護結果，既無 Fisetin-Healthspan 邊。

links.context: Latent TGFβ is activated extracellularly by integrins (alpha-v-beta-6/8), proteases and thrombospondin-1, then binds the TGFBR2/TGFBR1 (ALK5) receptor complex, which phosphorylates receptor-regulated SMAD2 and SMAD3. These complex with SMAD4 and translocate to the nucleus to regulate transcription, including pro-fibrotic and SASP genes.
links.context_zh_TW: 潛伏型 TGFβ 經由 integrin（alpha-v-beta-6/8）、蛋白酶與 thrombospondin-1 在胞外被活化，接著結合 TGFBR2/TGFBR1（ALK5）受體複合體，使其磷酸化受體調控型 SMAD2 與 SMAD3。這些 SMAD 與 SMAD4 複合成體後轉位入核，調控包含促纖維化與 SASP 基因在內的轉錄。

links.context: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy, the thickening or enlargement of the left ventricular wall in response to pressure overload, is accompanied by increased expression of the fission protein DRP1 and reduced levels of the fusion protein MFN2, so mitochondrial dynamics themselves are a biomarker of cardiac remodelling.
links.context_zh_TW: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy 是壓力超負荷引起的左心室壁增厚或擴大，常伴隨分裂蛋白 DRP1 上升與融合蛋白 MFN2 下降，因此粒線體動態本身即為心臟重塑的生物標誌。

links.context: Lens Crystallins serve as a readout of Aging in long-lived proteins: with no meaningful turnover they integrate every modification over a lifetime, so failure of chaperone function and their precipitation into cataract report on cumulative protein damage. Oxidative Stress is a co-driver of that damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Lens Crystallins（水晶蛋白）可作為長壽蛋白層次的 Aging（老化）讀值：由於沒有實質周轉，它們整合了一生中所有的修飾，因此伴護蛋白（chaperone）功能喪失及其凝聚形成白內障，即反映累積的蛋白損傷。Oxidative Stress（氧化壓力）是該損傷的共同驅動因素。

links.context: Leptin is the principal adipocyte-derived signal communicating energy stores to the hypothalamus. Circulating leptin rises with fat mass and falls during energy deficit, reducing appetite and stimulating energy expenditure; in obesity, elevated leptin is accompanied by central leptin resistance that blunts these catabolic actions.
links.context_zh_TW: Leptin 是脂肪細胞分泌、將能量儲存傳訊給下視丘的主要訊號。循環中的 leptin 隨脂肪量上升、在能量不足時下降，進而抑制食慾並刺激 energy expenditure；在肥胖時，leptin 升高卻伴隨中樞 leptin 阻抗，使其促分解代謝作用減弱。

links.context: Leptomycin B causes nuclear accumulation of the transcription factors TFEB, TFE3 and FOXO, which in turn enhances Autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis. Because CRM1 export is a key control layer over the autophagic transcriptional program, its blockade is a mechanistic probe of TFEB activation.
links.context_zh_TW: Leptomycin B 造成轉錄因子 TFEB、TFE3 與 FOXO 在細胞核內累積，進而增強 Autophagy 與溶酶體生成。由於 CRM1 依賴的核輸出是自噬轉錄程序的關鍵調控層，阻斷 CRM1 是探討 TFEB 活化機制的工具。

links.context: Leucine is one of the three Branched-Chain Amino Acids, alongside isoleucine and valine. It is the most potent amino-acid activator of mTORC1, and dietary leucine restriction alone recapitulates many hallmarks of protein restriction such as suppressed mTORC1 signalling, reduced hepatic steatosis and improved metabolic health.
links.context_zh_TW: Leucine 是三大 Branched-Chain Amino Acids 之一，與 isoleucine、valine 並列。它是 mTORC1 最強的胺基酸活化劑；單獨限制飲食中的 leucine 即可重現蛋白限制的許多特徵，例如 mTORC1 訊號被抑制、肝臟脂肪變性減少以及代謝健康改善。

links.context: Leucine, a branched-chain amino acid, activates GDH, promoting oxidative deamination and amino-acid-stimulated metabolism. This activation is part of the enzyme's sensing of amino acid supply and underlies the ability of glutamine/leucine to act as insulin secretagogues in pancreatic beta-cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 支鏈胺基酸亮胺酸會活化 GDH，促進氧化脫氨和胺基酸刺激的代謝。此活化是酶感應胺基酸供應的一部分，也是穀氨醯胺/亮胺酸能在胰腺 β 細胞中作為胰島素促泌劑的基礎。

links.context: Leuco-adrenochrome is the reduced member of a redox cycle centered on adrenochrome. It is highly unstable in the presence of oxygen, acting as a reductant that readily donates electrons to cycle back into adrenochrome or other oxidative products, and it autoxidizes more easily than epinephrine at physiological pH. This redox cycling contributes to superoxide anion generation and oxygen uptake in biological systems, and in systems involving hemoglobin-derived ROS it can amplify oxidative stress in erythrocytes. Redox cycling also makes leuco-adrenochrome difficult to isolate and study without controlled laboratory environments, which is why it is typically stored under inert atmosphere and at sub-zero temperatures.
links.context_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome 是 centered on adrenochrome 的 redox cycle 的 reduced member。它在 oxygen presence 下 highly unstable，acting as a reductant that readily donates electrons to cycle back into adrenochrome or other oxidative products，且 autoxidizes more easily than epinephrine at physiological pH。此 redox cycling contributes to superoxide anion generation and oxygen uptake in biological systems，且在 systems involving hemoglobin-derived ROS 中它 can amplify oxidative stress in erythrocytes。Redox cycling also makes leuco-adrenochrome difficult to isolate and study without controlled laboratory environments，這就是為什麼它 typically stored under inert atmosphere and at sub-zero temperatures。

links.context: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies. HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability, since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments. Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe, and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically.
links.context_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies。HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability，since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments。Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe，and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically。

links.context: LeucoMB donates the electrons it took from complex I to Complex IV, regenerating Methylene blue and bypassing complex III inefficiencies. This shuttling outcompetes oxygen for electrons and limits ROS, enhancing electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: LeucoMB 將它自複合體 I 取得的電子捐給 Complex IV，再生 Methylene blue，並繞過複合體 III 的效率損失。此電子穿梭與氧競爭電子，限制 ROS 生成，增強電子傳遞與 Oxidative Phosphorylation。

links.context: Leukemia is treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy and, in selected cases, targeted agents; ivermectin's activity remains preclinical.
links.context_zh_TW: Leukemia 接受細胞毒性化療，在某些情況下使用標靶藥物；伊維菌素的活性仍處於臨牀前階段。

links.context: Leukemic clones derive from transformed hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 白血病克隆源自於轉化的造血幹細胞或祖細胞。

links.context: Levodopa is the standard dopamine-replacement therapy for Parkinson disease. Treatment is the clinical indication.
links.context_zh_TW: Levodopa 是帕金森病的標準多巴胺替代治療。治療是臨床適應症。

links.context: Lidocaine, an amide-type local anesthetic and Class IB antiarrhythmic that blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, is a recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, particularly with high-dose infusion, topical mucosal application, or use in infants. The pathogenesis is metabolic: lidocaine and its aromatic amine metabolites oxidize ferroheme (Fe2+) of hemoglobin to ferriheme (Fe3+), shifting the oxygen-dissociation curve leftward and producing cyanosis refractory to oxygen.
links.context_zh_TW: Lidocaine 是一種阻斷電壓門控鈉離子通道的醯胺類局部麻醉藥與 IB 類抗心律不整藥，被認為是後天性 methemoglobinemia 的已知病因，尤其見於高劑量輸注、黏膜局部使用或嬰兒族群。其致病機轉為代謝性：lidocaine 及其芳香胺代謝物將血基質由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+），使氧解離曲線左移，產生對氧氣無反應的發紺。

links.context: Ligand engagement clusters EPHA2 and induces autophosphorylation of activation-loop tyrosines, which then signal downstream through PI3K-AKT, Src-FAK and MAPK to regulate adhesion, motility and survival. Because SASP-derived exosomes can supply these cues without cell contact, AKT-pathway activation in tumor cells is no longer restricted to ephrin-A1 engagement.
links.context_zh_TW: 配體結合使 EPHA2 聚集並引起活化環酪胺酸的自體磷酸化，隨後經由 PI3K-AKT、Src-FAK 與 MAPK 傳遞訊號以調控黏附、移行與存活。由於 SASP 來源的外泌體可在無細胞接觸下提供這些訊號，腫瘤細胞的 AKT 路徑活化不再侷限於 ephrin-A1 的結合。

links.context: Like Adrenochrome, Dopaminochrome participates in Redox Cycling, generating further Superoxide anion and contributing to neuronal damage. Because its lower reduction potential limits electron transfer to molecular oxygen, Dopaminochrome yields less Superoxide anion per redox cycle than Adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: 與 Adrenochrome 相同，Dopaminochrome 會參與 Redox Cycling，產生更多 Superoxide anion 並促成神經元損傷。由於其還原電位較低、限制了向分子氧的電子轉移，Dopaminochrome 每次氧化還原循環所產生的 Superoxide anion 比 Adrenochrome 少。

links.context: Like Methylene blue, Toluidine Blue O increased Complex IV expression and activity at low nanomolar concentrations, alongside higher oxygen consumption rate and lower extracellular acidification rate. It is not a classical chain-breaking antioxidant — it gave no protection against direct extracellular H₂O₂ from glucose oxidase — but acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow.
links.context_zh_TW: 與 Methylene blue 相同，Toluidine Blue O 在低奈莫濃度下提高 Complex IV 的表現與活性，並伴隨耗氧率上升與細胞外酸化率下降。它並非典型的鏈斷式抗氧化物——對 glucose oxidase 產生的細胞外 H₂O₂ 完全無保護作用——而是作用於粒線體電子流的上游。

links.context: Like eukaryotic sirtuins, CobB couples the hydrolysis of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl and related acyl groups from lysine residues on protein substrates. Because NAD+ availability is a universal metabolic currency, CobB links nutrient state to the post-translational regulation of bacterial enzymes, particularly in carbon and cofactor metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: 與真核 sirtuin 一樣，CobB 將 NAD+ 的水解與蛋白受質上離胺酸殘基之乙醯基（及相關醯基）的移除相偶聯。由於 NAD+ 可用性是通用的代謝貨幣，CobB 把營養狀態與細菌酵素的轉譯後調節連結起來，於碳與輔因子代謝中尤其明顯。

links.context: Like other Catecholamines, Dopamine can undergo spontaneous or enzymatic Oxidation to form reactive intermediates. Dopaminochrome is the aminochrome formed when the catechol ring is oxidized to an o-quinone followed by cyclization; high ROS levels promote this oxidation, bypassing normal degradation by COMT and MAO, and excess dopamine oxidation to dopaminochrome is linked to neuronal stress in Parkinson's Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 與其他 Catecholamines 相同，Dopamine 可經由自發性或酵素性 Oxidation 形成反應性中間產物。Dopaminochrome 是在兒茶酚環被氧化成 o-quinone 後再環化所形成的 aminochrome；高濃度 ROS 會促進此氧化、繞過 COMT 與 MAO 的正常降解，而 dopamine 過量氧化成 dopaminochrome 與 Parkinson's Disease 中的神經元壓力相關。

links.context: Like other benzimidazoles, albendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, blocking polymerization into microtubules.
links.context_zh_TW: 與其他苯並咪唑一樣，Albendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的秋水仙鹼位點，阻斷其聚合成 Microtubule。

links.context: Lin28 recruits the TUTase ZCCHC11 to uridylate pre-let-7 for degradation. Recruitment executes the let-7 suppression mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: Lin28 招募 TUTase ZCCHC11 使 pre-let-7 尿苷化以降解。招募執行 let-7 抑制機制。

links.context: LipA is the mouse lysosomal acid lipase, the functional orthologue of human LAL and of C. elegans LIPL-1 and LIPL-3. It hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides inside the lysosome, and its fasting-induced transcription in liver is linked to TFEB activity.
links.context_zh_TW: LipA 是小鼠的溶酶體酸性脂肪酶，為人體 LAL 與 C. elegans LIPL-1、LIPL-3 的功能同源物。它在溶酶體內水解膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯，且其在小鼠肝臟中禁食誘發的轉錄與 TFEB 活性相關。

links.context: Lipid droplets are delivered to lysosomes for degradation via lipophagy, mirroring selective autophagy of peroxisomes. Targeting is the cargo direction.
links.context_zh_TW: 脂滴經由脂噬遞送到溶酶體降解，呼應過氧化物酶體的選擇性自噬。標定是貨物方向。

links.context: Lipid metabolism is a major output of SIRT1 deacetylase activity, which modulates transcription factors such as PGC-1alpha, LXR, FOXO, and CREB to govern lipid handling. SIRT1 deficiency is linked to metabolic and lipid disorders.
links.context_zh_TW: 脂質代謝是 SIRT1 去乙醯化酶活性的主要輸出，SIRT1 調控 PGC-1α、LXR、FOXO 與 CREB 等轉錄因子以掌握脂質處理。SIRT1 缺乏與代謝及脂質疾病相關。

links.context: Lipid peroxyl radical hydrogen abstraction from polyunsaturated fatty acids yields lipid hydroperoxide plus a new lipid radical; the rate-determining propagation step. Abstraction sustains the peroxidation chain.
links.context_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基從多元不飽和脂肪酸提取氫，產生脂質氫過氧化物加新脂質自由基；是速率決定傳播步驟。提取維持過氧化鏈。

links.context: Liposomes are self-assembled phospholipid-bilayer vesicles that encapsulate hydrophobic cargo in the bilayer and hydrophilic cargo in the aqueous core, improving solubility and shielding labile molecules. Fisetin liposomes raised AUC 47-fold after intraperitoneal dosing, and nanocochleate and spherulite formats improved it further (141-fold for nanocochleates).
links.context_zh_TW: Liposomes 是自組裝的磷脂雙層囊泡，可將疏水性藥物包埋於雙層、親水性藥物包埋於水相核心，從而提升溶解度並保護易降解分子。Fisetin liposome 腹腔投藥後使 AUC 提升 47 倍，nanocochleate 與 spherulite 形式提升更多（nanocochleate 達 141 倍）。

links.context: Lipoteichoic acid (LTA) is a major constituent of the Gram-positive bacterial cell wall and functions as a canonical PAMP detected by the innate immune system. It is a polymer of glycerolphosphate or ribitolphosphate subunits linked by phosphodiester bonds, anchored to the bacterial membrane by a glycolipid moiety, with D-alanine and N-acetylglucosamine substitutions that modulate its immunogenicity. It is the Gram-positive counterpart of LPS.
links.context_zh_TW: Lipoteichoic acid (LTA) 是革蘭氏陽性菌 cell wall 的主要成分，作為典型 PAMP 被 innate immune system 辨識。它是由 glycerolphosphate 或 ribitolphosphate 次單元以 phosphodiester 鍵連接的聚合物，藉 glycolipid 部分錨定於細菌膜上，其 D-alanine 與 N-acetylglucosamine 取代程度會調節免疫原性。它是 LPS 的革蘭氏陽性菌對應物。

links.context: Lipotoxicity is cellular and tissue injury arising when lipid intermediates accumulate ectopically in non-adipose tissues. Excess fatty-acid delivery or incomplete oxidation produces diacylglycerol, ceramides and long-chain acyl-CoAs that activate protein kinase C and mTOR and inhibit insulin signalling, making lipotoxicity a key mechanism linking obesity and ectopic fat to insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Lipotoxicity 是脂質中間產物在非脂肪組織異位累積所造成的細胞與組織損傷。過量脂肪酸輸送或氧化不完全會產生 diacylglycerol、ceramides 與長鏈 acyl-CoA，活化 protein kinase C 與 mTOR 並抑制胰島素訊號，因此 lipotoxicity 是連結肥胖、異位脂肪與胰島素阻抗及第二型糖尿病的關鍵機制。

links.context: Liproxstatin-1 is a spiroquinoxalinamine small molecule that inhibits ferroptosis by suppressing lipid peroxidation as a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant. It has demonstrated in vivo efficacy in mouse models of ferroptosis-driven pathologies.
links.context_zh_TW: Liproxstatin-1 是螺喹噁啉胺小分子，作為親脂自由基捕捉抗氧化劑抑制脂質過氧化來阻斷 ferroptosis。它在ferroptosis 驅動病理的小鼠模型中展現體內療效。

links.context: Liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) is the biophysical process by which proteins and nucleic acids coalesce into dense membraneless condensates through multivalent low-affinity interactions mediated by intrinsically disordered regions. Human cGAS carries an N-terminal Intrinsically Disordered Region that drives LLPS with DNA and enables nuclear cGAS to scaffold condensates recruiting RNA-Binding Proteins, the Spliceosome and the SWI-SNF Complex — a STING-independent role.
links.context_zh_TW: 液-液相分離（LLPS）是由多價低親和力交互作用（多由 intrinsically disordered regions 媒介）使蛋白質與核酸凝聚成緻密、無膜凝聚體的生體物理過程。人類 cGAS 帶有 N 端 Intrinsically Disordered Region，可促進與 DNA 的 LLPS，並使核內 cGAS 能支架化凝聚體、招募 RNA-Binding Proteins、Spliceosome 與 SWI-SNF Complex——此為不依賴 STING 的功能。

links.context: Liraglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist used for type 2 diabetes and obesity. Beyond glucose-dependent insulin secretion, it promotes Mitophagy, selectively clearing damaged mitochondria, which reduces the mitochondrial ROS that drives fibrosis and maintains mitochondrial quality in cardiomyocytes under stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Liraglutide 是用於第二型糖尿病與肥胖的 GLP-1 受體致效劑。除了促進葡萄糖依賴性的胰島素分泌外，它還促進 Mitophagy，選擇性清除受損粒線體，因而降低驅動纖維化的粒線體 ROS，並在壓力下維持心肌細胞的粒線體品質。

links.context: Liver X Receptor is a master regulator of cholesterol efflux: LXR transcriptionally activates ABCA1 and ABCG1, the key cholesterol efflux transporters. Resveratrol induces LXR-alpha expression in human monocyte-derived macrophages, which upregulates ABCA1 and ABCG1 and links resveratrol's anti-atherogenic effects to cholesterol homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: Liver X Receptor 是膽固醇外排的主控者：LXR 以轉錄方式活化 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 這兩個關鍵的膽固醇外排運輸蛋白。Resveratrol 在人類單核細胞衍生巨噬細胞中誘導 LXR-alpha 表現，進而上調 ABCA1 與 ABCG1，將 resveratrol 的抗動脈粥樣硬化效果與膽固醇恆定連結起來。

links.context: Liver X receptors (LXRα/NR1H3 and LXRβ/NR1H2) are nuclear receptors that regulate cholesterol, fatty acid and lipid homeostasis. SIRT1 modulates over 40 known substrates including LXR, deacetylating and regulating its activity, thereby coupling sirtuin activity to cholesterol and lipid metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Liver X Receptor（LXRα/NR1H3 與 LXRβ/NR1H2）是調節膽固醇、脂肪酸與脂質恆定的核受體。SIRT1 可調節超過 40 種已知受質（包含 LXR），藉由去乙醯化並調節其活性，將 sirtuin 活性與膽固醇及脂質代謝連結起來。

links.context: Loading the senolytic flavonoid Fisetin into Human Serum Albumin nanoparticles (220 ± 8 nm, ~84% encapsulation, ~75% released over 72 h) overcomes the flavonoid's poor solubility and rapid clearance, and produced greater cytotoxicity against MCF-7 Breast Cancer cells than free Fisetin. Albumin encapsulation is thus a general strategy for delivering poorly bioavailable compounds.
links.context_zh_TW: 將衰老細胞毒殺類黃酮 Fisetin 裝載於 Human Serum Albumin 奈米粒子中（220 ± 8 nm、封裝率約 84%、72 小時釋放約 75%），可克服該類黃酮溶解度差與清除快的限制，對 MCF-7 Breast Cancer 細胞的毒性高於游離 Fisetin。因此白蛋白包封是提升難溶性化合物 Bioavailability 的一般策略。

links.context: Locked nucleic acid (LNA) is a synthetic RNA analog that can be incorporated into antisense oligonucleotides and siRNAs to hybridize to target messenger RNA. Hybridizing an LNA raises melting temperature and protects against nucleases for potent silencing.
links.context_zh_TW: 鎖核酸（LNA）是合成 RNA 類似物，可整合入反義寡核苷酸與 siRNA 以雜交至目標信使 RNA。雜交 LNA 可提高熔解溫度並抵抗核酸酶，實現強效靜默。

links.context: Long-term consumption of dietary advanced glycation end products (AGEs) in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. Chronic dietary AGE excess reproduces in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet to the kidney.
links.context_zh_TW: 大鼠長期攝取膳食 advanced glycation end products（AGEs）會造成劑量依賴性的 proteinuria 增加，長期下來可能誘發腎臟損傷。慢性膳食 AGE 過量在動物身上重現了 aging 與 diabetes 中部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食對腎臟的毒性。

links.context: Long-term nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation modulates gut microbiota composition in humans, increasing the abundance of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii. In a twin study, NR at 250-1000 mg/day for 5 months raised F. prausnitzii abundance, and association analysis suggested this bacterium contributes to regulation of NAD+, inflammation, amino acid, and lipid metabolism. Faecalibacterium prausnitzii is a butyrate-producing commensal that promotes metabolic health and anti-inflammatory responses, and its decline characterizes dysbiosis in inflammatory bowel disease. NR's ability to enrich this beneficial organism supports its role in improving gut and systemic health through microbiota modulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）調節人類腸道菌叢組成，增加 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 的豐度。在一項雙生子研究中，每天 250-1000 mg NR 持續 5 個月提升了 F. prausnitzii 豐度，且關聯分析顯示此細菌有助於調節 NAD+、發炎、胺基酸與脂質代謝。Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 是一種產丁酸的共生菌，促進代謝健康與抗發炎反應，其減少是發炎性腸道疾病中菌叢失調的特徵。NR 富集此有益生物的能力支持其透過菌叢調節改善腸道與全身健康的角色。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Loss of ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux is the core pathophysiological defect of Tangier disease, blocking transfer of cellular cholesterol to apolipoprotein A-I for HDL particle formation. The resulting disruption of reverse cholesterol transport links the disorder to lipid metabolism, foam cell formation, and atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: ABCA1 所介導的 cholesterol efflux 喪失是 Tangier disease 的核心病理缺陷，阻斷了細胞內 cholesterol 轉移給 apolipoprotein A-I 以形成 HDL 顆粒的過程。由此造成的 reverse cholesterol transport 失調，將此疾病與脂質代謝、foam cells 形成及 atherosclerosis 連結起來。

links.context: Loss of ATRX causes telomere decondensation, replication stress and DNA damage at telomeric repeat sequences, yet paradoxically extends telomeres in tumors by activating the alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) pathway, a recombination-based maintenance mechanism seen in 10-15% of cancers. ALT is template-directed rather than telomerase-mediated and is associated with more aggressive tumor behavior, making ATRX loss a diagnostic marker (about 30% of adult diffuse IDH-mutant gliomas) and a therapeutic vulnerability.
links.context_zh_TW: ATRX 缺失會造成端粒去凝縮、複製壓力與端粒重複序列處的 DNA 損傷，卻又在腫瘤中反常地透過活化替代性端粒延長（ALT）路徑延長端粒；ALT 是一種以重組為基礎的維持機制，見於 10-15% 的癌症。ALT 是模板導向而非端粒酶介導的，並與更侵襲性的腫瘤行為相關，因此 ATRX 缺失既是診斷標記（約 30% 成人瀰漫性 IDH 突變膠質瘤），也是治療弱點。

links.context: Loss of CDH5 expression is a hallmark of Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition: CDH5 is downregulated 45% during CXCL12-driven EndoMT, marking loss of endothelial identity and junctional integrity, while ACTA2 rises inversely. This transdifferentiation program is driven by TGFβ signaling, and PECAM1 is co-downregulated as a second endothelial marker.
links.context_zh_TW: CDH5 表現喪失是 Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition 的標誌：在 CXCL12 驅動的 EndoMT 中 CDH5 下調 45%，標記內皮身分與接合完整性的喪失，而 ACTA2 則反向升高。此轉分化程式由 TGFβ 訊號驅動，另有 PECAM1 作為第二個內皮標記一同下調。

links.context: Loss of G3BP1 attenuates cGAS-STING signaling and the attendant interferon and chemokine secretion, while stress-granule assembly itself can concentrate and protect senescence-associated transcripts. G3BP1 therefore bridges nuclear dysfunction and CCF release to innate immune signaling, a core upstream trigger of the SASP in oncogene- and therapy-induced senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: G3BP1 的缺失會減弱 cGAS-STING 訊號及其伴隨的干擾素與趨化因子分泌，而 stress granule 的組裝本身則可濃縮並保護衰老相關轉錄本。因此 G3BP1 將核功能異常與 CCF 釋放橋接到先天免疫訊號，是在 oncogene 誘導與治療誘導衰老中觸發 SASP 的核心上游事件。

links.context: Loss of H3K9me2/3 around the major SASP genes IL-6 and IL-8 correlates with their induction, and diminished SUV39H1 lowers H3K9 methylation at these loci, so SUV39H1 restrains SASP transcription. Loss of H3K9 methylation also permits enhancer–promoter contacts and 3D-genome reorganization that drive SASP, making restoration of SUV39H1 a candidate senomorphic strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: 主要 SASP 基因 IL-6 與 IL-8 周圍 H3K9me2/3 的流失與其誘導相關，而 SUV39H1 減少會降低這些位點的 H3K9 甲基化，因此 SUV39H1 抑制 SASP 的轉錄。H3K9 甲基化的流失還允許促進子–增強子接觸與驅動 SASP 的 3D 基因組重組，使恢復 SUV39H1 成為候選的 senomorphic 策略。

links.context: Loss of Lamin B1 detaches lamina-associated domains from the nuclear periphery, permitting a global shuffling of the genome that facilitates both Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci formation and the leaky transcription characteristic of senescence. Lamin B1 loss is upstream of these large-scale chromatin rearrangements.
links.context_zh_TW: Lamin B1 流失使核纖層相關結構域脫離核周邊，讓基因體發生全面性的重新洗牌，既促成 Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci 的形成，也造成衰老時特有的「滲漏式」轉錄。Lamin B1 流失位於這些大規模染色質重排的上游。

links.context: Loss of Metabolic Flexibility — metabolic inflexibility — is a hallmark of metabolic disease: in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus tissues cannot switch from fatty acid to glucose oxidation in the fed state, and in Obesity impaired fatty acid oxidation causes ectopic lipid accumulation. Chronic inflexibility of this kind also underlies Metabolic Syndrome and insulin resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Metabolic Flexibility 的喪失——也就是代謝僵化——是代謝疾病的特徵：在 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 中，組織在進食狀態下無法由脂肪酸氧化切換至葡萄糖氧化；而在 Obesity 中，受損的脂肪酸氧化則造成異位脂肪堆積。這類長期僵化同時也是 Metabolic Syndrome 與胰島素阻抗的基礎。

links.context: Loss of PALB2 makes tumors synthetically lethal with olaparib: because PALB2 loss removes homologous-recombination competence, the DNA breaks created by trapped PARP cannot be repaired and the cells die. BRCA1/2 and ATM loss act the same way, and this synthetic lethality between PARP trapping and repair deficiency is what lets olaparib treat BRCA-mutated breast, ovarian, pancreatic, and prostate cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: PALB2 的缺失使腫瘤與 olaparib 形成合成致命關係：因為 PALB2 缺失移除了同源重組能力，被困住的 PARP 所造成的 DNA 斷端無法修復，細胞因而死亡。BRCA1/2 與 ATM 缺失具有相同作用，而正是這種 PARP 困陷與修復缺陷之間的合成致命性，讓 olaparib 能治療 BRCA 突變的乳癌、卵巢癌、胰臟癌與攝護腺癌。

links.context: Loss of PECAM1 expression is a hallmark of Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition (EndoMT): PECAM1 is downregulated 55% during CXCL12-driven EndoMT, the most pronounced loss among endothelial identity markers alongside CDH5. Because loss of PECAM1 contributes to vascular barrier breakdown and age-related vascular dysfunction, EndoMT directly erodes endothelial function.
links.context_zh_TW: PECAM1 表現喪失是 Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition（EndoMT）的標誌之一：在 CXCL12 驅動的 EndoMT 中，PECAM1 下調 55%，是內皮身分標記中降幅最大者之一（與 CDH5 並列）。由於 PECAM1 喪失會促成血管屏障崩解與老化相關的血管功能障礙，EndoMT 會直接侵蝕內皮功能。

links.context: Loss of SLC25A51 lowers mitochondrial but not whole-cell NAD+, depresses oxygen consumption, collapses complex I activity and reduces TCA-cycle flux — a compartment-specific lesion compensated partly by a glycolytic shift. Matrix NAD+ imported by SLC25A51 feeds complex I, matrix dehydrogenases such as IDH2, glutamate dehydrogenase and the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, and NAD+-consuming enzymes including SIRT3, SIRT5 and mitochondrial PARP1.
links.context_zh_TW: SLC25A51 缺失會降低粒線體（而非全細胞）的 NAD+、抑制氧消耗、使複合體 I 活性崩解並減少 TCA 循環流量——這是區室特異性的損傷，部分由糖解轉移補償。由 SLC25A51 輸入的基質 NAD+ 供應複合體 I、IDH2、麩胺酸去氫酶與丙酮酸去氫酶複合體等基質去氫酶，以及 SIRT3、SIRT5 與粒線體 PARP1 等 NAD+ 消耗酵素。

links.context: Loss of SMAD4 (DPC4), a key mediator of TGFβ signaling, occurs in roughly 55% of advanced PDA and is associated with poor prognosis and metastatic propensity. Because SMAD4 is the canonical tumor suppressor lost in pancreatic cancer, its absence distinguishes PDA from other KRAS-driven malignancies.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFβ 訊號的關鍵介導因子 SMAD4（DPC4）之缺失發生於約 55% 的晚期 PDA，並與不良預後及轉移傾向相關。由於 SMAD4 是胰臟癌中典型流失的腫瘤抑制因子，其缺乏使 PDA 與其他 KRAS 驅動的惡性腫瘤有所區別。

links.context: Loss of TSC1 or TSC2 removes the GAP that restrains Rheb, causing constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation that drives benign hamartomas (Tuberous Sclerosis, renal angiomyolipoma, epilepsy, autism). Here benign growth is itself the disease, contrasting with the protective OIS-type benign lesion.
links.context_zh_TW: TSC1 或 TSC2 缺失移除抑制 Rheb 的 GAP，造成組成性 mTORC1 過度活化，驅動良性錯構瘤（結節性硬化症、腎血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇、自閉症）。此處良性生長本身就是疾病，與保護性 OIS 型良性病灶形成對比。

links.context: Loss of USP30 in knockout mice prevents behavioural deficits, increases mitophagy, and reduces both phosphorylated S129 alpha-synuclein and dopaminergic neuron loss; the brain-penetrant inhibitor MTX115325 shows similar efficacy in Parkinson's Disease models. USP30 knockdown also cuts lipid ROS by about 40% and reduces ferroptotic neuronal death.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 knockout mouse 中移除 USP30 可預防行為缺陷、增加 mitophagy，並降低磷酸化 S129 的 alpha-synuclein 與 dopaminergic neuron 喪失；可穿過血腦障礙的抑制劑 MTX115325 在 Parkinson's Disease 模型中展現類似效力。USP30 knockdown 還可減少約 40% 的脂質 ROS 並降低 ferroptosis 性的神經元死亡。

links.context: Loss of YME1L shifts OPA1 toward long forms and disrupts fusion, compromising mitochondrial integrity and linking protease activity directly to optic neuropathies such as Dominant Optic Atrophy. Because inner-membrane fusion requires the S-OPA1/L-OPA1 cooperative pair, YME1L is a proteolytic gatekeeper of the mitochondrial fusion balance.
links.context_zh_TW: YME1L 喪失會使 OPA1 偏向長型並破壞融合，危及 mitochondrial integrity，並將蛋白酶活性直接與 Dominant Optic Atrophy 等視神經病變相連結。由於粒線體內膜融合需要 S-OPA1 與 L-OPA1 的協同配對，YME1L 是粒線體融合平衡的蛋白水解守門者。

links.context: Loss of junctional integrity defines EMT execution. Disruption is the structural hallmark of transition.
links.context_zh_TW: 連接完整性喪失定義 EMT 執行。破壞是轉換的結構標誌。

links.context: Loss of orexin-producing neurons causes narcolepsy, the clearest demonstration that Orexin is required to stabilize wakefulness rather than merely promote it. Because OX2R is the primary receptor for wakefulness, narcolepsy is the clinical mirror image of the OX2R upregulation that mediates the ~11% lifespan extension in the SIRT1-overexpressing BRASTO mouse.
links.context_zh_TW: 產生 orexin 的神經元流失會造成嗜睡症（narcolepsy），這是最清楚的證據，顯示 Orexin 是「穩定」而非僅僅「促進」清醒所必需。由於 OX2R 是維持清醒的主要受體，嗜睡症正是 OX2R 上調之臨床鏡像，而後者正是 SIRT1 過量表現的 BRASTO 小鼠中位壽命延長約 11% 的中介機制。

links.context: Loss-of-function MC1R variants that produce red hair and fair skin also raise Melanoma risk. The melanoma-PD association is tied to MC1R and to melanocyte and neuromelanin biology. MC1R thus exemplifies how a pigment gene can influence both cancer and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 產生紅髮和淺膚色的功能缺失 MC1R 變異也會提高 Melanoma 風險。黑色素瘤-PD 的關聯與 MC1R 以及 melanocyte 和 neuromelanin 生物學相關。因此 MC1R 說明了色素基因如何同時影響癌症和神經退化。

links.context: Loss-of-function and activating mutations in the GLUD1 gene cause hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia (hyperinsulinism/hyperammonemia syndrome), illustrating the clinical impact of deregulated GDH. This underscores the importance of the SIRT4-GDH regulatory axis in whole-body glucose handling.
links.context_zh_TW: GLUD1 基因的功能喪失性和活化性突變會導致高胰島素性低血糖（高胰島素血症/高氨血症症候群），顯示 GDH 調節異常的臨床影響。這凸顯了 SIRT4–GDH 調節軸在全身葡萄糖處理中的重要性。

links.context: Loss-of-function mutations in SLC6A8 cause creatine transporter deficiency (CTD, OMIM #300352), an X-linked recessive disorder accounting for about 2% of intellectual disability in males. Features include global developmental delay, epilepsy, speech/language delay, autistic-like behaviors and movement disorders; diagnosis rests on elevated urinary creatine:creatinine ratio and reduced brain creatine on MRS. Unlike AGAT/GAMT deficiencies, oral creatine supplementation is less effective because the transporter defect blocks cellular uptake.
links.context_zh_TW: SLC6A8 的失功能突變會造成肌酸轉運蛋白缺乏症（CTD，OMIM #300352），一種 X 聯隱性遺傳疾病，約占男性智障的 2%。其特徵包括整體發育遲緩、癲癇、語言發育遲緩類自閉症狀與運動障礙；診斷依據為尿中肌酸／肌酸酐比值升高及 MRS 上腦肌酸降低。與 AGAT／GAMT 缺乏不同，口服肌酸補充效果較差，因為轉運蛋白缺陷阻斷了細胞攝取。

links.context: Low levels of reactive oxygen species generated during mild mitochondrial stress function as second messengers in stress-adaptation signaling rather than purely as toxic byproducts. In Caenorhabditis elegans this ROS signal engages the UPRmt and the SKN-1/Nrf2 axis to upregulate chaperones, proteases and detoxification enzymes, the mechanistic core of mitohormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 輕度粒線體壓力期間產生的低量 Reactive Oxygen Species，在壓力適應訊號中作為第二訊使，而非純粹的有毒副產物。在 Caenorhabditis elegans 中，此 ROS 訊號啟動 UPRmt 與 SKN-1/Nrf2 軸，上調伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與解毒酵素，這正是 mitohormesis 的機轉核心。

links.context: Low, transient Mitochondrial ROS act as signalling molecules that stabilize HIF-1α, activate NRF2 and AMPK, and induce PGC-1α and the UPRmt — the adaptive strengthening of respiratory capacity that defines Mitohormesis and supports longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: 低濃度、短暫的 Mitochondrial ROS 會作為訊號分子穩定 HIF-1α、活化 NRF2 與 AMPK，並誘導 PGC-1α 與 UPRmt；這種呼吸能力的適應性強化即定義了 Mitohormesis，並支持長壽。

links.context: Low-density lipoprotein is the principal cholesterol-transporting lipoprotein, carrying ApoB-100 with a core of cholesteryl esters and triglycerides. The unmodified particle is relatively inert; pathogenicity emerges once LDL is retained in the arterial intima and chemically modified by oxidation or glycation, after which scavenger-receptor uptake by macrophages seeds foam cells and fatty streaks. Small, dense LDL subspecies are especially prone to both modifications, so particle number and quality matter beyond total cholesterol.
links.context_zh_TW: Low-Density Lipoprotein 是運送膽固醇的主要脂蛋白，攜帶 ApoB-100 及膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯核心。未經修飾的顆粒相對惰性；致病性出現在 LDL 滯留於動脈內膜並受到氧化或醣化修飾之後，此時經由清道夫受體被巨噬細胞攝取，形成泡沫細胞與脂肪斑塊。體積小而密的 LDL 次族群特別容易被這兩種修飾，因此顆粒數量與品質比總膽固醇更關鍵。

links.context: Lox-1 is a key driver of atherosclerosis initiation and progression: beyond lipid scavenging it mediates endothelial dysfunction, reduces nitric oxide bioavailability, promotes monocyte adhesion, and drives macrophage conversion into foam cells. Lox-1 expression is upregulated in human atherosclerotic lesions, acute coronary syndromes, metabolic syndrome, and diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Lox-1 是動脈粥狀硬化起始與進展的關鍵驅動因子：除了脂質清除外，它還介導內皮功能障礙、降低一氧化氮可用性、促進單核細胞黏附，並驅動巨噬細胞轉化為 Foam Cells。Lox-1 的表現在人類動脈粥狀硬化病灶、急性冠狀症候群、metabolic syndrome 與糖尿病中皆上調。

links.context: Lox-1 is a type II transmembrane scavenger receptor whose C-terminal C-type lectin-like domain recognizes and internalizes oxidized LDL. oxLDL-induced Lox-1 expression forms a positive feedback loop that amplifies further oxLDL uptake, accelerating plaque formation, and Lox-1 signalling engages NF-κB, MAPK, and PI3K/Akt to raise ROS and adhesion molecules.
links.context_zh_TW: Lox-1 是第二型跨膜清道夫受體，其 C 端 C-type lectin-like 結構域負責辨識並內吞氧化 LDL。由 oxLDL 誘導的 Lox-1 表現形成正回饋迴路，進一步放大 oxLDL 的攝取並加速斑塊形成；Lox-1 訊號亦啟動 NF-κB、MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt，提升 ROS 與黏附分子表現。

links.context: Luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation and are a clinically tolerable alternative to surgical castration. Agents such as Lupron (leuprolide) act on the pituitary gland, desensitizing LHRH receptors and thereby decreasing luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone, leading to reduced estrogen and testosterone production. Human studies with LHRH analogues have resulted in increased thymic weight and reversal of age-related thymic structural defects.
links.context_zh_TW: 黃體生成激素釋放激素（LHRH）類似物可達成藥理性性類固醇消融，是外科去勢的臨床上可耐受之替代方案。諸如 Lupron（leuprolide）等藥物作用於腦下垂體，使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，從而減少黃體生成激素與濾泡刺激激素，導致雌激素與睪固酮生成減少。使用 LHRH 類似物的人類研究已導致胸腺重量增加及年齡相關胸腺結構缺陷的逆轉。

links.context: Luteolin exerts anti-inflammatory effects primarily through inhibition of pro-inflammatory signaling cascades, including NF-kB activation, MAPK phosphorylation, and the NLRP3 inflammasome. This broad suppression of inflammatory signaling underlies its benefits in atopic diseases and neuroinflammation. It is a key mechanism distinct from its COMT interactions.
links.context_zh_TW: Luteolin 主要透過抑制促發炎訊號級聯（包括 NF-kB 活化、MAPK 磷酸化和 NLRP3 發炎小體）來發揮抗發炎作用。這種對發炎訊號的廣泛抑制是其對異位性疾病和神經發炎益處的基礎。這是與其 COMT 交互作用不同的關鍵機制。

links.context: Luteolin is lipophilic enough to cross the blood-brain barrier, which underlies its central nervous system interest. This property allows it to reach brain parenchyma and modulate catecholamine metabolism and neuroinflammation. It is investigated as a nutraceutical for cognitive health.
links.context_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有足夠的親脂性，可穿越 blood-brain barrier，這正是它在中樞神經系統受到關注的基礎。此特性使其能到達腦實質並調節兒茶酚胺代謝和神經發炎。它作為認知健康營養補充劑受到研究。

links.context: Luteolin scavenges reactive oxygen species and upregulates endogenous antioxidant defenses, countering oxidative stress.
