links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) preserves cardiac function in heart failure models by stabilizing NAD+ levels. In a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy, NR at 450 mg/kg body weight for 45 days stabilized myocardial NAD+ levels, increased glycolysis, and citrate and acetyl-coenzyme A metabolism, attenuating the development of heart failure. NR also elevates myocardium NAD+ content in diabetic mice, promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion through the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway, which suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. These cardiac benefits, combined with its reduction of inflammation and vascular protection, establish NR as a cardioprotective NAD+ precursor.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過穩定 NAD+ 水平在心力衰竭模型中維持心臟功能。在擴張型心肌病的小鼠模型中，以 450 mg/kg 體重 NR 給藥 45 天穩定了心肌 NAD+ 水平，增加糖解作用以及檸檬酸與乙醯輔酶 A 代謝，減緩心衰竭的發展。NR 也提升糖尿病小鼠心肌 NAD+ 含量，透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，從而抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。這些心臟益處，加上其減少發炎與血管保護作用，確立了 NR 作為具心臟保護作用的 NAD+ 前驅物。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) prevents and improves metabolic disorders such as high-fat diet-induced obesity. NR supplementation promoted metabolic flexibility by enhancing energy expenditure, significantly attenuating high-fat diet-induced body weight gain and decreasing fat mass, particularly in the liver where triglyceride levels dropped by 40%. NR also protected against hyperinsulinemia and elevated total and LDL cholesterol caused by a high-fat diet, while having no effect on body weight when given with a normal chow diet. Additionally, NR-conditioned gut microbiota conferred protection against high-fat diet weight gain through fecal transfer, linking the gut microbiome to its anti-obesity effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可預防並改善代謝紊亂，例如高脂飲食誘發的肥胖。NR補充透過增強能量消耗來促進代謝靈活性，顯著減緩高脂飲食誘發的體重增加並降低脂肪量，尤其是在肝臟中，三酸甘油酯水平下降了40%。NR也保護免受高脂飲食引起的胰島素過高血症以及總膽固醇與LDL膽固醇升高，而在正常飼料飲食下給予時對體重無影響。此外，經NR調理的腸道微生物群透過糞便移植賦予對高脂飲食體重增加的保護力，將腸道微生物組與其抗肥胖效應連結起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and its metabolic sequelae by increasing NAD+ and stimulating sirtuins. NR supplementation increased hepatic beta-oxidation and mitochondrial content, reversing glucose intolerance, insulin resistance, liver lipid accumulation, and hepatic fibrosis in mouse models. In high-fat diet studies, NR reduced liver fat mass and decreased hepatic triglyceride levels by 40%. These benefits arise from NR elevating NAD+ in liver and muscle, which stimulates SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity to enhance oxidative metabolism and mitochondrial function, counteracting the fatty liver and metabolic inflexibility driven by overnutrition.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過提升 NAD+ 並刺激 sirtuins，保護免受非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）及其代謝後遺症之害。NR 補充增加了肝臟 β-氧化與粒線體含量，在小鼠模型中逆轉了葡萄糖耐受不良、胰島素抗性、肝臟脂質堆積與肝纖維化。在高脂飲食研究中，NR 減少了肝臟脂肪量，並使肝臟三酸甘油酯水平降低了 40%。這些益處源於 NR 提升肝臟與肌肉中的 NAD+，進而刺激 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 活性以增強氧化代謝與粒線體功能，抵銷由過度營養所驅動的脂肪肝與代謝不靈活。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces beta-amyloid levels and protects cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease models. In Tg2576 mice, NR treatment lowered beta-amyloid and increased the chance of recognizing a novel object by 20%, indicating improved recognition memory. NR also significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage, while increasing neurogenesis by almost 20%. These cognitive and synaptic protective effects are attributed to NR's ability to elevate NAD+ and upregulate proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha-regulated beta-secretase 1 degradation and mitochondrial gene expression, linking NAD+ precursor supplementation to preservation of learning, memory, and motor function.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）可降低 beta-amyloid 水平，並在阿茲海默症模型中保護認知功能。在 Tg2576 小鼠中，NR 處理降低了 beta-amyloid，並使辨識新物體的機率提高 20%，顯示辨識記憶改善。NR 也顯著減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 與 DNA 損傷，同時使神經生成增加近 20%。這些認知與突觸保護作用歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 並上調由 proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha 調控的 beta-secretase 1 降解與粒線體基因表現的能力，將 NAD+ 前驅物補充與學習、記憶及運動功能的維持相連結。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease models and in alcohol-induced depression models. In AD models, NR significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage while increasing neurogenesis. In mice with alcohol-induced depression, dietary NR for 10 weeks reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels and inhibited microglial activation, with the protective effect attributed to NR upregulating brain-derived neurotrophic factor by altering gut microbiota composition. These findings connect NR's NAD+-boosting action to suppression of neuroinflammation, microglial reactivity, and preservation of cognitive and emotional function.
links.context_zh_TW: 煙醯胺核糖（NR）可降低Alzheimer's disease模型與酒精誘發憂鬱模型中的神經發炎。在AD模型中，NR顯著降低神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化Tau與DNA損傷，同時增加神經生成。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠中，飲食補充NR達10週降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素濃度，並抑制小膠質細胞活化，其保護作用歸因於NR透過改變gut microbiota組成而上調brain-derived neurotrophic factor。這些發現將NR提升NAD+的作用與抑制神經發炎、小膠質細胞反應性，以及維持認知與情緒功能相連結。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reversed the progressive wasting syndrome in skeletal muscle in mice lacking Nampt while restoring endurance in as little as 1 week of treatment. Decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression were also observed in Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD), a condition histologically and transcriptionally similar to progressive wasting syndrome and characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration. NR was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of DMD and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. These findings support NR as an effective approach to managing muscular dystrophy and degeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）逆轉了缺乏 Nampt 小鼠骨骼肌中的漸進性消耗症候群，同時在僅 1 週的治療內恢復耐力。在 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）中也觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低，此疾病在組織學與轉錄組學上類似於漸進性消耗症候群，並以 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化為特徵。NR 被發現能改善 DMD 的 mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。這些發現支持 NR 作為管理肌肉營養不良與退化的有效方法。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation exhibits protective effects in adverse cardiac remodeling and prevents the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure. NR normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio, and long-term supplementation increases nucleocytoplasmic protein acetylation by stimulating citrate and acetyl-CoA metabolism and antioxidant gene expression. NAD+ precursor supplementation also protects against adverse cardiac remodeling by activating sirtuins and maintaining Ca2+ homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充在不良心臟重塑中展現保護作用，並在導致心衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中預防心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。NR 使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，而長期補充透過刺激檸檬酸與 acetyl-CoA 代謝以及抗氧化基因表現，增加核質蛋白乙醯化。NAD+ 前驅物補充亦透過活化 sirtuins 與維持 Ca2+ 恆定，保護免受不良心臟重塑。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) treatment decreases IL-6 along with other inflammatory markers including NLRP3, CASP1, IL-1, and TNF-alpha in the whole brain of high-fat-diet-fed mice, contributing to reduced neuroinflammation and improved cognitive function. NR can similarly decrease IL-2, IL-5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in human studies, and a 21-day supplementation of NR decreased numerous circulating inflammatory cytokines. Targeting IL-6 has been proposed as a promising treatment to block the inflammatory storm, especially in severe COVID-19 patients, supporting the potential of NR as an anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory agent in infection and age-related inflammatory conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）治療降低了高脂飲食小鼠全腦中的 IL-6 以及其他發炎標記，包括 NLRP3、CASP1、IL-1 與 TNF-alpha，有助於減少神經發炎並改善認知功能。NR 在人體研究中同樣能降低 IL-2、IL-5、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha，且 21 天的 NR 補充降低了眾多循環中的發炎性細胞激素。針對 IL-6 已被提議為阻斷發炎風暴（尤其是重症 COVID-19 患者）的有前景療法，這支持了 NR 在感染與年齡相關發炎狀態中作為抗發炎與免疫調節劑的潛力。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
links.context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nicotinamide riboside supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function. In mouse models this reduction was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis, and it complements established antihypertensive therapies.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotinamide riboside 補充可降低 systolic blood pressure 與主動脈僵硬，這兩者是心血管功能的重要臨床風險指標。在小鼠模型中，此降低效果與 NAD+ 恆定的改善同時出現，並可作為既有降血壓治療的補充。

links.context: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day, and several preclinical studies have confirmed that both NA and nicotinamide (NAM) can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NA shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels and is used to treat dyslipidemia, but this flushing side effect limits its tolerability. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR) elevates NAD+ levels without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, and was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects.
links.context_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關，且數項臨床前研究已確認 NA 與 nicotinamide（NAM）皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。NA 展現降低血脂水平的效果並被用於治療血脂異常，但此潮紅副作用限制了其耐受性。相對地，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）提升 NAD+ 水平而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），並在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
links.context_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
links.context_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Nitrative stress produces 3-nitrotyrosine (3-NT), the most characteristic and biomedically relevant protein modification of this pathway. 3-NT forms when peroxynitrite-derived radicals (NO2 and carbonate radical) oxidize tyrosine phenolate groups and couple with NO2. Because 3-NT is a stable, unrepairable post-translational modification, it serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of tissue injury in many diseases.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 產生 3-nitrotyrosine（3-NT），這是此途徑最具特徵性且與生物醫學最相關的蛋白質修飾。當 peroxynitrite 衍生的自由基（NO2 和 carbonate radical）氧化酪氨酸酚基並與 NO2 偶聯時，會形成 3-NT。由於 3-NT 是穩定且不可修復的轉譯後修飾，它在許多疾病中既是生物標記也是組織損傷的介導者。

links.context: Nitrite oxidation of Hemoglobin yields Methemoglobin, a heme species unable to carry oxygen; it also shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve leftward, impairing tissue oxygen release even in the presence of adequate oxygenation. Methemoglobin therefore compounds hypoxia by both reducing oxygen carriage and hindering its unloading.
links.context_zh_TW: 亞硝酸鹽氧化 Hemoglobin 會生成 Methemoglobin，一種無法攜帶氧氣的血基質形式；它同時使氧解離曲線左移，妨礙組織釋放氧氣，即使氧合量充足亦然。因此 Methemoglobin 透過降低氧的攜帶與妨礙氧的釋放雙重機制加重缺氧。

links.context: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

links.context: Nitrotyrosine, most commonly the 3-nitro form, is the nitrated derivative of the amino acid tyrosine and the stable, accumulated footprint of tyrosine nitration.
links.context_zh_TW: Nitrotyrosine（最常見為 3-硝基型）是胺基酸 [[Tyrosine]] 的硝化衍生物，也是 tyrosine nitration 穩定累積的終產物痕跡。

links.context: Nociceptor cell bodies reside largely in the Dorsal Root Ganglion (and trigeminal ganglion), with peripheral and central axon projections; beyond pain transduction they act as innate immune signalling participants through the cGAS-STING axis.
links.context_zh_TW: Nociceptor 的細胞本體主要位於 Dorsal Root Ganglion（三叉神經節亦然），並具有周邊與中樞軸突投射；除痛覺傳遞外，它們還透過 cGAS-STING 軸參與先天免疫訊號。

links.context: Noggin binds and sequesters BMP2/4/7 extracellularly to block signaling. This antagonism patterns embryonic and skeletal development.
links.context_zh_TW: Noggin 在胞外結合並隔離 BMP2/4/7 以阻斷訊號。此拮抗塑造胚胎與骨骼發育。

links.context: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is widely considered a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome as it is found to be associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, and sirtuins are downregulated in NAFLD patients, a state characterized by liver steatosis. Raising NAD+ through nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation can restore sirtuin-driven fatty acid oxidation, inhibit lipogenesis, and reduce cholesterol levels, thereby improving liver health and reducing fat accumulation through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
links.context_zh_TW: 非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）被廣泛視為代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因為它被發現與第二型糖尿病、肥胖與胰島素抗性相關，且 sirtuins 在 NAFLD 患者中被下調，此狀態以肝臟脂肪變性為特徵。透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充提升 NAD+ 能恢復 sirtuin 驅動的脂肪酸氧化、抑制脂肪生成並降低膽固醇水平，從而透過誘發粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應改善肝臟健康並減少脂肪堆積。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Non-coding RNAs, once dismissed as junk, are now recognized as powerful regulators of the Epigenome: many lncRNAs recruit histone methyltransferases or histone deacetylases to specific genomic loci, and Xist drives large-scale epigenetic silencing.
links.context_zh_TW: Non-coding RNA 過去被視為「廢料」，如今被認為是 Epigenome 的強大調節者：許多 lncRNA 會將組蛋白甲基轉移酶或組蛋白去乙醯化酶招募至特定基因組位點，而 Xist 則驅動大規模表觀遺傳沉默。

links.context: Non-enzymatic cross-links between structural proteins such as collagen and elastin reduce tissue elasticity, stiffening the extracellular matrix. This matrix stiffening is a leading mechanism behind arterial stiffness, cardiac hypertrophy, and senile cataract, and AGE cross-linking of vessel-wall matrix together with glycation of LDL promotes atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: collagen 與彈性纖維等結構蛋白之間的非酵素性交聯降低組織彈性、使細胞外基質僵硬。這種基質僵硬是 Arterial Stiffness、Cardiac Hypertrophy 與老年性 Cataract 背後的主要機制，而血管壁基質的 AGE cross-linking 連同 LDL 的 glycation 會促進 Atherosclerosis。

links.context: Non-enzymatic, radical-mediated Lipid Peroxidation of Arachidonic acid yields a mixture of regioisomeric HETEs - 5-, 8-, 9-, 11-, 12- and 15-HETE - in non-stereoselective, largely racemic ratios. The loss of stereospecificity is the diagnostic feature separating free-radical peroxidation from enzymatic synthesis, and it is why GPX4 matters here: by reducing the phospholipid hydroperoxides that would otherwise fragment into HETEs, GPX4 controls how much of the HETE pool is oxidative rather than signaling in origin.
links.context_zh_TW: 非酵素性、由自由基媒介的 Arachidonic acid 過氧化會產生多種位置異構的 HETE 混合物——5-、8-、9-、11-、12- 與 15-HETE——比例不具立體專一性且大致為外消旋。立體專一性的喪失正是區別自由基過氧化與酵素性合成的診斷特徵；GPX4 在此之所以重要，正是因為它還原了原本會碎裂成 HETE 的磷脂過氧化氫物，因而控制了 HETE 池中有多少屬氧化來源而非訊號來源。

links.context: Non-muscle myosin II generates the contractile forces needed for Cell Migration: it drives protrusion retraction, rear-end detachment, and adhesion turnover at the trailing edge, all on Cytoskeleton-resident Actin tracks.
links.context_zh_TW: 非肌肉型 myosin II 產生 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）所需的收縮力：驅動前緣的伸縮、尾端分離，以及後緣的黏附周轉—all 皆在 Cytoskeleton（細胞骨架）中的 Actin 軌道上進行。

links.context: Non-synonymous mutations in SLC6A8 cause creatine transporter deficiency, a form of cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome accounting for roughly 2% of intellectual disability in boys. Reduced uptake lowers brain creatine and phosphocreatine, causing developmental delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and speech deficits, and oral creatine is less effective because the uptake step itself is blocked.
links.context_zh_TW: SLC6A8 的非同義突變造成 creatine transporter deficiency，屬於腦型 creatine 缺乏症候群，約占男性智能障礙的 2%。攝取下降使腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 減少，造成發育遲緩、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵與語言缺陷；由於攝取步驟本身受阻，口服 creatine 的效果較差。

links.context: Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) is progressive fatty liver disease in which deficient Autophagy and impaired Fatty acid oxidation combine with Inflammation to drive the steatosis-to-fibrosis transition.
links.context_zh_TW: Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) 是一種進展性脂肪肝疾病，Autophagy 不足與 Fatty acid oxidation 受損會與 Inflammation 共同作用，推動脂肪變性向纖維化的轉變。

links.context: Noncanonical inflammasome-mediated IL-1alpha cleavage is a critical upstream trigger for the SASP in senescent cells, providing the active IL-1alpha that sustains NF-kB signaling and secretome production. Caspase-5/11 thus license the secretome rather than merely respond to it, operating independently of the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 pathway. The relationship establishes the noncanonical pathway as a core SASP initiator and is supported by cleavage-deficiency and inhibitor studies. This makes it a distinct therapeutic target for senescence inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 非典型發炎體介導的 IL-1alpha 切割是衰老細胞中 SASP 的關鍵上游觸發因子，提供維持 NF-kB 訊號與分泌組產生的活性 IL-1alpha。因此 caspase-5/11 許可分泌組而非僅回應它，獨立於典型 caspase-1 路徑運作。此上游角色將非典型發炎體置於 SASP 誘發的因果鏈中，解釋為何阻斷其可減弱分泌組。它是 IL-1alpha 中心發炎迴圈的核心組成。

links.context: Noncanonical nuclear cGAS recruits the spliceosome through its intrinsically disordered region, which mediates liquid-liquid phase separation with chromatin and RNA-processing machinery. Because cGAS binds spliceosome components directly, phase-separated cGAS condensates concentrate splicing factors and can influence alternative splicing decisions independently of canonical cGAS-STING Pathway interferon output.
links.context_zh_TW: 非典型核內 cGAS 透過其 intrinsically disordered region 招募 spliceosome，該區域藉由與染色質及 RNA 加工機器的 liquid-liquid phase separation 達成此作用。由於 cGAS 直接結合 spliceosome 組分，相分離形成的 cGAS 凝聚體可濃縮剪接因子並影響 alternative splicing 決定，且獨立於典型 cGAS-STING Pathway 的干擾素輸出。

links.context: Norepinephrine is synthesized in the brain primarily by neurons of the Locus Coeruleus, where it mediates arousal, attention, and the stress response, and also affects heart rate and blood pressure as a hormone.
links.context_zh_TW: 腦中的 Norepinephrine 主要由 Locus Coeruleus 的神經元合成，參與覺醒、注意力與壓力反應，並作為荷爾蒙影響心率與血壓。

links.context: Norepinephrine, an α1-adrenergic agonist raising vascular tone with modest β1-mediated inotropy, is the prototypical first-line vasopressor for Septic Shock and most distributive shocks. Dopamine is now reserved for selected cases because of arrhythmogenic risk; Epinephrine is preferred in refractory hypotension and anaphylactic shock; Angiotensin II acts via the renin–angiotensin system as a rescue agent.
links.context_zh_TW: Norepinephrine 為 α1-adrenergic agonist，兼具提升血管張力與溫和的 β1 正性肌力作用，是 Septic Shock 與多數 distributive shock 的典型第一線 Vasopressor。Dopamine 因心律不整風險現僅保留於特定情境；Epinephrine 則用於 refractory hypotension 與過敏性休克；Angiotensin II 經 renin–angiotensin system 作用，作為救援藥物。

links.context: Notch acts as a temporal gatekeeper of the SASP: repression of C/EBPβ transcriptional activity by Notch signalling restrains the late, highly inflammatory IL-6/IL-8-dominated secretome and times the transition from an early TGFβ-dominated phase.
links.context_zh_TW: Notch 是 SASP 的時間性守門者：Notch 訊號對 C/EBPβ 轉錄活性的抑制，限制了晚期以 IL-6/IL-8 為主的強烈發炎分泌型，並決定由早期 TGFβ 主導階段的轉換時機。

links.context: Nrf2 drives SIRT6 transcription via ARE in its promoter. SIRT6 co-activates Nrf2, creating a feed-forward amplification loop for antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: Nrf2 透過其啟動子中的 ARE 驅動 SIRT6 轉錄。SIRT6 共活化 Nrf2，形成抗氧化防禦的前饋放大迴路。

links.context: Nrf2 is the transcription factor that, upon release from Keap1, translocates to the nucleus and upregulates antioxidant response element (ARE) genes encoding detoxifying and antioxidant enzymes. In the senomorphic hypothesis, aminochrome-mediated Keap1 modification activates this Nrf2/ARE program. Because active Nrf2 signaling mutually antagonizes NF-κB and directly represses pro-inflammatory cytokine transcription, Nrf2 activation is proposed to enforce a quiescent, non-secretory phenotype in senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Nrf2是從Keap1釋放後轉位至細胞核並上調編碼解毒和抗氧化酶的抗氧化反應元件（ARE）基因的轉錄因子。在衰老模仿假說中，氨基色素介導的Keap1修改激活此Nrf2/ARE程序。由於活性Nrf2信號相互拮抗NF-κB並直接抑制促炎細胞因子轉錄，Nrf2激活被提出在衰老細胞中強制執行靜止、非分泌表型。

links.context: Nrf2, the master antioxidant transcription factor, induces SIRT6-responsive antioxidant and DNA-repair programs; SIRT6 binds the Nrf2 promoter and cooperates with Nrf2 to maintain glutathione and redox balance, and Nrf2 deacetylation is itself regulated by SIRT6 (Pan et al., 2016, Cell Res).
links.context_zh_TW: Nrf2 是主要的抗氧化轉錄因子，可誘導 SIRT6 相關的抗氧化及 DNA 修復程序；SIRT6 結合 Nrf2 啟動子並與 Nrf2 協同維持穀胱甘肽和氧化還原平衡，而 Nrf2 的去乙醯化本身也受 SIRT6 調節（Pan et al., 2016, Cell Res）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Nrk2 is a muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme whose expression dynamically tracks skeletal muscle mass across wasting and hypertrophy: it is downregulated in cachexia and by inactivity, and upregulated by resistance training, making it an early responsive marker of muscle mass change.
links.context_zh_TW: Nrk2 是肌肉專一的 NAD+ 生合成酵素，其表現量會動態追蹤骨骼肌量在消耗與肥大間的變化：在 cachexia 與不活動時被下調，阻力訓練則會上調，因此它是肌肉量變化的早期反應性標記。

links.context: Nuclear export of TFEB suppresses Autophagy: nutrient-rich conditions activate mTORC1 at the lysosome and ERK2, which phosphorylate TFEB at S142 (priming S138), creating a nuclear export signal that recruits CRM1 and traps TFEB in 14-3-3-bound cytosolic complexes. Under starvation, mTORC1 inhibition dephosphorylates TFEB, allowing nuclear accumulation and activation of CLEAR-network genes.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 的核輸出會抑制 Autophagy：營養充足時，溶酶體上的 mTORC1 與 ERK2 被活化，磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），產生可招募 CRM1 的核輸出訊號，將 TFEB 困在與 14-3-3 結合的細胞質複合體中。禁食時 mTORC1 抑制使 TFEB 去磷酸化，因而在核內累積並活化 CLEAR network 基因。

links.context: Nuclear-translocated Apoptosis-Inducing Factor recruits MIF (PAAN nuclease), which executes large-scale (~50-kbp) chromatinolysis independently of caspases.
links.context_zh_TW: 轉位入核的 Apoptosis-Inducing Factor 招募 MIF（PAAN 核酸酶），以後者執行 caspase 非依賴的大尺度（~50-kbp）染色質降解。

links.context: Nucleoside Reverse Transcriptase Inhibitor (NRTI) compounds such as zidovudine, lamivudine, emtricitabine and tenofovir are chain-terminating nucleoside analogs that block the reverse transcription of LINE-1 cDNA. Because LINE-1 derepression in aged cells generates cytoplasmic cDNA that triggers cGAS-STING signalling, NRTIs act upstream of that sensor and dampen the resulting interferon inflammation and SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: 核苷類反轉錄酶抑制劑（Nucleoside Reverse Transcriptase Inhibitor, NRTI），如 zidovudine、lamivudine、emtricitabine 與 tenofovir，是可終止鏈的核苷類似物，可阻斷 LINE-1 cDNA 的反轉錄。由於老化細胞中 LINE-1 去抑制會產生細胞質 cDNA 並觸發 cGAS-STING 訊號傳遞，NRTIs 作用於該感測器的上游，因而抑制隨後的干擾素發炎反應與 SASP。

links.context: Nucleosome is the fundamental structural unit of Chromatin, consisting of about 147 base pairs of DNA wrapped around a core octamer of histone proteins (two each of H2A, H2B, H3 and H4). Successive nucleosomes, linked by linker DNA, fold into the higher-order chromatin fibre whose density and positioning determine genome accessibility and transcriptional output.
links.context_zh_TW: 核小體（Nucleosome）是染色質（Chromatin）的基本結構單位，由約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 纏繞在組蛋白核心八聚體（H2A、H2B、H3、H4 各兩個）上構成。相連的核小體以連接 DNA 串聯，再折疊成高階染色質纖維；其密度與定位決定基因體的可及性與轉錄輸出。

links.context: Nucleus Accumbens is the ventral striatal region that forms the heart of the brain's reward circuitry, and it is subdivided into a core and a shell with distinct inputs and outputs. As a limbic–motor interface it integrates motivational, emotional and cognitive signals to direct goal-directed and habitual behaviour, making it a key target for reward, addiction and affective disease research.
links.context_zh_TW: 伏隔核（Nucleus Accumbens）是腹側紋狀體（Striatum）的區域，構成腦部獎賞迴路的核心，並可分為核心部與殼部，各自具有不同的輸入與輸出。作為邊緣—運動的介面，它整合動機、情緒與認知訊號以引導目標導向與習慣性行為，因此是研究獎賞、成癮與情感疾病的重要標的。

links.context: Nudix Hydrolases (NUDT family, e.g. NUDT5/NUDT9-type ADPR pyrophosphatases) cleave the phosphodiester bond of free ADP-ribose, producing AMP and ribose-5-phosphate (R5P). In Parthanatos they sit downstream of PARG and ARH3, converting the PAR-catabolism product ADP-ribose into both a metabolic signal (AMP) and salvage substrates (R5P).
links.context_zh_TW: Nudix 水解酶（Nudix Hydrolases，NUDT 家族，例如 NUDT5/NUDT9 型 ADPR 焦磷酸酶）切割游離 ADP-ribose 的磷酸二酯鍵，產生 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸（R5P）。在 parthanatos 中，它們位於 PARG 與 ARH3 下游，將 PAR 分解產物 ADP-ribose 同時轉成代謝訊號（AMP）與補救合成受質（R5P）。

links.context: Nutlin 3a suppresses the pro-inflammatory SASP by inhibiting MDM2, the E3 ligase that marks p53 for degradation, thereby stabilizing the tumor suppressor; stabilized p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven expression of SASP cytokines and chemokines. This mechanism exploits the natural tumor-suppressive rheostat of p53 rather than broadly blocking inflammation, and it is consistent with the observation that loss of p53 dramatically amplifies secretome output. The compound is primarily a research tool with limited clinical development, which constrains its translational confidence, but mechanistically its SASP-suppressive action is well grounded in p53's restraint of the inflammatory secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2（標記 p53 降解的 E3 連接酶）而穩定腫瘤抑制因子，從而抑制促發炎性 SASP；穩定的 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子表現。此機制利用 p53 天然的腫瘤抑制變阻器，而非廣泛阻斷發炎，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組輸出的觀察一致。此化合物主要是研究工具、臨床開發有限，限制了其轉譯信度，但在機制上其 SASP 抑制作用是立基於 p53 對發炎分泌組的抑制。

links.context: Nutrient abundance activates mTORC1 at the lysosome, and mTORC1 together with ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at S142 (and primes S138), which licenses CRM1-dependent export of TFEB. This phosphorylation-dependent nuclear export is a key control layer atop the mTORC1/TFEB axis gating autophagic transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: 營養充足會活化溶酶體上的 mTORC1，mTORC1 與 ERK2 共同磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），使 TFEB 可被 CRM1 依賴性輸出。這種磷酸化依賴的核輸出是 mTORC1/TFEB 軸之上調控自噬轉錄的關鍵層。

links.context: O-GlcNAcylation of DRP1 increases its fission activity: O-GlcNAc transferase drives DRP1 translocation from the Cytosol to the mitochondria, enhancing Mitochondrial Fission in parallel with the stimulatory effect of S-nitrosylation on the same GTPase. Because excessive fission is associated with aging and mitochondrial dysfunction, DRP1 O-GlcNAcylation links dietary glucose load to mitochondrial fragmentation.
links.context_zh_TW: DRP1 的 O-GlcNA 醣基化（O-GlcNAcylation）會提高其分裂活性：O-GlcNAc 轉移酶驅動 DRP1 由細胞質（Cytosol）轉位至粒線體，增強粒線體分裂（Mitochondrial Fission），與 S-硝基化對同一 GTPase 的刺激作用平行。因過度分裂與老化及粒線體功能障礙相關，DRP1 的 O-GlcNAcylation 將飲食葡萄糖負荷與粒線體碎裂連結起來。

links.context: OIS bypass requires loss of p53, p16INK4A, or PTEN, prerequisites for progression from arrested pre-malignancy to malignancy. Inactivation of these tumor suppressors releases the senescence brake, permitting proliferation of oncogene-stressed cells and enabling malignant transformation. The relationship underscores senescence as a barrier that must be overcome for cancer and is supported by co-mutation and knockout studies. Telomerase activation can also contribute to escape from arrest, further highlighting the multi-step nature of tumor progression.
links.context_zh_TW: OIS 迴避需要 p53、p16INK4A 或 PTEN 的缺失，這些是從停滯的癌前狀態進展到惡性所需的先決條件。這些腫瘤抑制因子的失活釋放衰老煞車，允許致癌壓力細胞增殖並啟動惡性轉化。此關係凸顯衰老作為失效安全屏障，且其崩潰是癌症進展的必要步驟。它是連結 OIS 到腫瘤抑制與其失效的核心機制。

links.context: OIS cells are susceptible to senolytic drugs like navitoclax (a BCL-2/BCL-XL inhibitor), which disable SCAPs and induce apoptosis in the arrested cells. This vulnerability reflects the SCAP dependence of senescent cells generally and provides a pharmacological route to eliminate OIS cells. The relationship supports the therapeutic concept of clearing oncogene-induced senescent cells to limit SASP-driven pathology, though removing premalignant senescent cells may paradoxically compromise tumor suppression. It is supported by senolytic efficacy studies in OIS models.
links.context_zh_TW: OIS 細胞對 navitoclax（一種 BCL-2/BCL-XL 抑制劑）等 senolytic 藥物敏感，其失能 SCAPs 並在停滯細胞中誘發凋亡。此脆弱性反映衰老細胞普遍對 SCAP 的依賴，並提供藥理清除致癌基因誘發衰老細胞的手段。透過標靶抗凋亡依賴，senolytics 可選擇性消除停滯的癌前細胞，支持以衰老清除作為癌症預防策略。它是 senotherapeutic 介入的關鍵機制。

links.context: OMA1 is constitutively present but normally restrained; its activity is sharply upregulated in response to mitochondrial stress signals, particularly loss of Mitochondrial Membrane Potential (ΔΨm), perturbed protein import, or accumulation of unfolded proteins. Excess or prolonged OMA1 activation collapses cristae, sensitizes cells to apoptosis and cooperates with the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy machinery.
links.context_zh_TW: OMA1 平時持續存在但受到抑制；其活性會在粒線體壓力訊號出現時顯著上升，尤其是粒線體膜電位（Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, ΔΨm）喪失、蛋白輸入受擾或未折疊蛋白堆積時。過度或持續的 OMA1 活化會使嵴崩解、使細胞對凋亡敏感，並與 PINK1/Parkin 的 mitophagy 機制協同作用。

links.context: OPA1 is a dynamin-related GTPase that regulates cristae morphology and inner membrane fusion, with OPA1 oligomers maintaining cristae junction tightness. Disruption of cristae architecture impairs ATP production in cardiomyocytes and neurons, contributing to cardiac dysfunction and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: OPA1 是 dynamin 相關的 GTPase，調節 cristae 形態與內膜融合，OPA1 寡聚體維持 cristae junction 的緊密性。Cristae 結構遭破壞會損害心肌細胞與神經元中的 ATP 生成，促成心臟功能失調與神經退化。

links.context: OPA1 is synthesized in the cytosol and imported into the Mitochondrial Matrix, where its N-terminal mitochondrial targeting sequence is removed by the matrix processing protease, yielding the mature isoforms that later regulate fusion.
links.context_zh_TW: OPA1 在細胞質合成後被輸入 Mitochondrial Matrix，其 N 端 targeting sequence 在此由基質處理蛋白酶切除，產生之後調控融合的成熟異構型。

links.context: OPA1 mutations impair Inner Mitochondrial Membrane fusion, causing mitochondrial dysfunction that disrupts cristae architecture and energy production in neurons with high bioenergetic demand. A severe 'DOA plus' phenotype adds deafness and ataxia, and OPA1 overlaps with Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A, reflecting shared mitochondrial dynamics pathways; OPA1 processing also depends on YME1L.
links.context_zh_TW: OPA1 突變會損害 Inner Mitochondrial Membrane 的融合，造成粒線體功能障礙，破壞高生物能需求神經元中的 cristae 結構與能量產生。嚴重的「DOA plus」表型另加上耳聾與共濟失調；OPA1 也與 Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A 重疊，反映共享的粒線體動態路徑，且 OPA1 的加工另依賴 YME1L。

links.context: OPTN is recruited to ubiquitin-coated mitochondria after Parkin ubiquitinates outer-membrane proteins, and through its LIR Motif it binds LC3 proteins on the phagophore, bridging cargo and autophagosomal membrane. Together with NDP52, OPTN is one of the two primary autophagy receptors in the PINK1/Parkin pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Parkin 泛素化粒線體外膜蛋白之後，OPTN 會被招募到帶有泛素的粒線體表面，並透過其 LIR Motif 與吞噬膜上的 LC3 結合，將受質與自噬體膜橋接起來。OPTN 與 NDP52 一起是 PINK1/Parkin 路徑中兩個主要的自噬受體。

links.context: OPTN mutations have been identified as pathogenic in ALS, and because mitophagy critically depends on OPTN and its kinase TBK1, loss of OPTN function impairs both mitochondrial clearance and axonal transport. Loss of function in this pathway therefore couples defective selective autophagy to motor neuron degeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: OPTN 突變已被確認在 ALS（肌萎縮性側索硬化症）中具有致病性；由於 mitophagy 高度依賴 OPTN 及其激酶 TBK1，OPTN 功能喪失會同時損害粒線體清除與軸突運輸。因此此路徑的功能喪失會把選擇性自噬缺陷與運動神經元退化連結起來。

links.context: OX2R (orexin receptor type 2, encoded by HCRTR2) is a G-protein-coupled receptor that mediates signalling of the hypothalamic neuropeptides orexin A and B. OX2R is enriched in the tuberomammillary nucleus and dorsomedial hypothalamus and is the primary receptor for wakefulness, so it links orexin release to arousal, feeding behaviour and energy homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: OX2R（orexin 受體第二型，由 HCRTR2 編碼）是 G 蛋白偶聯受體，負責介導下視丘神經胜肽 orexin A 與 orexin B 的訊號傳遞。OX2R 在乳頭核與背內側下視丘高度表現，是維持清醒的主要受體，因此將 orexin 的釋放連結到覺醒、攝食行為與能量恆定。

links.context: Obesity increases deoxycholic acid levels both directly, by raising bile acid secretion under high-fat diets, and indirectly, by altering gut microbial ecology in favour of DCA-producing bacteria. Because DCA is then reabsorbed in the ileum and returned to the liver by enterohepatic circulation, obesity sets both production and delivery of the senescence-inducing metabolite.
links.context_zh_TW: Obesity 會提高 deoxycholic acid 的濃度：直接原因是高脂飲食下 bile acid 分泌增加，間接原因是 gut microbial ecology 改變而有利於產生 DCA 的細菌。由於 DCA 之後在 ileum 被再吸收並經 enterohepatic circulation 回到肝臟，Obesity 同時決定了這個誘發 senescence 代謝物的生成與運送。

links.context: Obesity, a chronic disease of excessive adipose accumulation affecting over 603.7 million adults, is associated with chronic inflammation and increased risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Cardiovascular Disease, Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and certain cancers. Epidemiological evidence links rising Obesity to declining physical activity and reduced resting metabolic rate, so reduced Energy Expenditure is a key driver of the obesity epidemic.
links.context_zh_TW: 肥胖（Obesity）是一種脂肪組織過度累積的慢性疾病，全球有超過 6.037 億成年人受累，並與慢性發炎以及第二型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus）、心血管疾病（Cardiovascular Disease）、非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease）與某些癌症的風險上升相關。流行病學證據將肥胖增加與身體活動下降及 resting metabolic rate 降低連結，因此能量消耗（Energy Expenditure）減少是肥胖流行的重要驅動因素。

links.context: Oct4 and Sox2 bind the Nanog enhancer in a feed-forward pluripotency loop. Circuitry interconnects the core factors.
links.context_zh_TW: Oct4 與 Sox2 在前饋多能性迴圈結合 Nanog 增強子。線路互連核心因子。

links.context: Oct4 is a core pluripotency transcription factor governing the ESC state. Regulation places Oct4 upstream of ESC identity.
links.context_zh_TW: Oct4 是掌管 ESC 狀態的核心多能性轉錄因子。調節將 Oct4 置於 ESC 身份上游。

links.context: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 1 (OCA1), about 40% of OCA worldwide, is caused by mutations in the Tyrosinase gene (TYR, 11q14.3). Tyrosinase catalyzes the rate-limiting hydroxylation of L-Tyrosine to L-DOPA and the subsequent oxidation to dopaquinone. OCA1A is the most severe form, with complete absence of tyrosinase activity.
links.context_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 1 型（OCA1）約佔全球 OCA 的 40%，由 Tyrosinase 基因（TYR，11q14.3）的突變引起。Tyrosinase 催化 L-Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA 的限速反應，以及隨後氧化為 dopaquinone。OCA1A 是最嚴重的形式，tyrosinase 活性完全缺失。

links.context: Odanacatib is the selective cathepsin K inhibitor reaching Phase III for osteoporosis. Inhibition is the pharmacological edge.
links.context_zh_TW: Odanacatib 是進入骨質疏鬆 III 期選擇性組織蛋白酶 K 抑制劑。抑制是藥理邊。

links.context: Of more than 600 described carotenoids, only three - alpha-carotene, beta-carotene and beta-cryptoxanthin - carry provitamin A activity, because only they can be cleaved asymmetrically to retinal. Central (BCO1) cleavage of beta-carotene yields two retinal molecules, which are reduced to retinol and esterified to retinyl palmitate; eccentric (BCO2) cleavage instead yields apocarotenoids such as beta-apo-8'-lycopene that act as retinoid-like nuclear receptor ligands. Alpha-carotene and beta-cryptoxanthin yield one retinal each. Conversion is feedback-regulated, which is why provitamin A carotenoids have no upper level.
links.context_zh_TW: 在已描述的 600 多種類胡蘿蔔素中，只有三種——α-carotene、β-carotene 與 β-cryptoxanthin——具有 provitamin A 活性，因為只有它們能被不對稱地切割生成 retinal。β-carotene 的中央（BCO1）切割產生兩個 retinal 分子，之後被還原為 retinol 並酯化成 retinyl palmitate；偏心（BCO2）切割則產生 apocarotenoids（如 beta-apo-8'-lycopene），作為類維生素 A 樣的核受體配體。α-carotene 與 β-cryptoxanthin 各產生一個 retinal。此轉換受回饋調控，因此 provitamin A 類胡蘿蔔素沒有上限。

links.context: Olaparib, a PARP inhibitor, is approved as maintenance therapy for patients with germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations who have not progressed on platinum-based chemotherapy, based on the POLO trial. This makes germline BRCA2 a predictive biomarker for PARP-inhibitor sensitivity in PDA.
links.context_zh_TW: Olaparib（PARP 抑制劑）依 POLO 試驗結果，獲核准作為帶有胚系 BRCA1 或 BRCA2 突變、且在鉑類化療後未進展患者的維持治療。這使胚系 BRCA2 成為 PDA 中對 PARP 抑制劑敏感性的預測性生物標記。

links.context: Oleacein competes with endogenous catechols such as dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine for the COMT active site. At sufficient intake this competitive inhibition can slow the methylation and clearance of these catecholamines. This places oleacein in the same COMT-modulating class as other polyphenols like luteolin and rutin.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 與 dopamine、epinephrine 和 norepinephrine 等內源性兒茶酚競爭 COMT 活性位點。在足夠攝入量下，這種競爭性抑制可減緩這些兒茶酚胺的甲基化和清除。這使 oleacein 與 luteolin 和 rutin 等其他多酚屬於同一 COMT 調節類別。

links.context: Oleacein scavenges free radicals and upregulates antioxidant defenses via the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, reducing oxidative stress. It inhibits pro-inflammatory enzymes (COX, LOX) and cytokine production, contributing to vascular and neuroprotective effects. These properties support cardiovascular and cognitive health.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 清除自由基並透過 Nrf2/HO-1 途徑上調抗氧化防禦，減少 oxidative stress。它抑制促發炎酶（COX、LOX）和細胞因子產生，有助於血管和神經保護作用。這些特性支持心血管和認知健康。

links.context: Oligomycin at 1 µg/ml suppresses ATP-synthase-linked respiration and produces the characteristic OCR drop used as a coupling-efficiency readout in Seahorse XF assays. Even under Oligomycin, Methylene blue, Toluidine Blue O and Neutral Red significantly increased Oxygen Consumption Rate and reduced extracellular acidification rate, showing these compounds sustain electron transport and suppress anaerobic glycolysis independently of ATP synthase.
links.context_zh_TW: Oligomycin 以 1 µg/ml 抑制 ATP 合成酶連結的呼吸，產生 Seahorse XF 試驗中作為耦合效率讀值的典型性耗氧量（OCR）下降。即使在 Oligomycin 存在下，Methylene blue、Toluidine Blue O 與 Neutral Red 仍顯著提高耗氧量並降低細胞外酸化率，顯示這些化合物可獨立於 ATP 合成酶維持電子傳遞並抑制無氧糖解。

links.context: Once absorbed into the circulation, urolithin A undergoes further metabolism through multiple metabolic pathways, with the liver playing a central role. Metabolic enzymes present in the liver convert urolithin A into its mercaptan and sulfate forms. Hepatic enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and carbamazepine can increase the activity of these metabolic enzymes, accelerating urolithin A metabolism and reducing its half-life in the body, whereas enzyme inhibitors such as clarithromycin slow its metabolism and clearance and can lead to accumulation of urolithin A.
links.context_zh_TW: 一旦吸收進入循環系統，urolithin A 會經由多條代謝途徑進一步代謝，其中肝臟扮演核心角色。肝臟中的代謝酶將 urolithin A 轉化為其硫醇（mercaptan）與硫酸鹽（sulfate）形式。肝臟酶誘導劑如 rifampicin 與 carbamazepine 可提升這些代謝酶的活性，加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期；而酶抑制劑如 clarithromycin 則減緩其代謝與清除，可能導致 urolithin A 蓄積。
links.source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

links.context: Once absorbed, fisetin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) and sulfotransferases in the intestinal epithelium and liver, producing fisetin glucuronide and fisetin sulfate metabolites that circulate in the plasma. Because these conjugates have reduced biological activity and are rapidly excreted via bile and urine, the parent aglycone fisetin reaches only low concentrations in tissues. The extent of this phase II metabolism is a primary cause of fisetin's poor oral bioavailability and short plasma half-life, and it is one reason most preclinical efficacy studies have used intraperitoneal injection rather than oral dosing.
links.context_zh_TW: 一旦被吸收，fisetin會被腸道上皮與肝臟中的UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶（UGT）與磺基轉移酶廣泛接合，產生在血漿中循環的fisetin葡萄糖醛酸與fisetin硫酸代謝物。由於這些接合物生物活性降低，且會經由膽汁與尿液迅速排泄，母體苷元fisetin在組織中僅達到低濃度。此第二相反應的程度是fisetin口服生體可用率差與血漿半衰期短的主要原因，也是多數臨床前療效研究採用腹腔注射而非口服給藥的原因之一。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

links.context: Once activated, Parkin polyubiquitinates outer mitochondrial membrane proteins such as MFN1/2, Miro and VDAC1. Ubiquitination of MFN2 marks the damaged mitochondrion for mitophagy and blocks its re-fusion with the healthy network, while excessive Parkin-mediated MFN2 ubiquitination drives excessive fragmentation in Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Parkin 活化後會多泛素化粒線體外膜蛋白，例如 MFN1/2、Miro 與 VDAC1。MFN2 的泛素化標記受損粒線體使其被 mitophagy 清除，並阻止其與健康網絡再融合；而 Parkin 介導的 MFN2 過度泛素化則在 Parkinson's Disease 中造成過度裂解。

links.context: Once active, Protein Kinase D phosphorylates and activates the IKK complex — phosphorylating IKKβ and the regulatory machinery — which stimulates IκBα degradation and nuclear NF-κB translocation. PKD also modulates NF-κB at the chromatin level (e.g., phosphorylation of histone H3 at Ser10) and influences AP-1 and CREB transcriptional programs.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Kinase D 一旦活化便磷酸化並活化 IKK complex——磷酸化 IKKbeta 與其調節機制——從而促進 IκBα 降解與 NF-κB 的核內轉位。PKD 也在染色質層級調節 NF-κB（例如磷酸化組蛋白 H3 的 Ser10），並影響 AP-1 與 CREB 轉錄程式。

links.context: Once anchored at promoters by ELK4, SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of Histone H3, removing the H3K18ac mark and repressing tumor suppressor genes. Because ELK4 inhibition would antagonize this SIRT7-driven repression, the ELK4–SIRT7 axis is a candidate therapeutic node for counteracting sirtuin-mediated tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 一旦由 ELK4 錨定於啟動子，SIRT7 便將 Histone H3 的離胺酸 18 去乙醯化，移除 H3K18ac 標記並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。由於抑制 ELK4 可拮抗這種 SIRT7 驅動的抑制，ELK4–SIRT7 軸因此是對抗 sirtuin 介導致瘤的候選治療節點。

links.context: Once formed, Amadori products undergo further irreversible dehydration, rearrangement and oxidation, proceeding to advanced glycation end products such as glucosepane and pentosidine crosslinks that accumulate on long-lived proteins.
links.context_zh_TW: Amadori products 一旦形成，即進一步進行不可逆的脫水、重排與氧化，生成 Advanced Glycation End Products，例如在長壽命蛋白上累積的 Glucosepane 與 Pentosidine 交聯。

links.context: Once formed, adrenaline-quinone is extremely unstable and rapidly cyclizes: the primary amine side chain attacks the electron-deficient C6 position of the quinone ring in a 1,4-Michael addition, forming the colorless reduced intermediate Leuco-adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: Adrenaline-quinone 一旦生成即極不穩定並迅速環化：主胺側鏈以 1,4-Michael addition 進攻 quinone 環上缺電子的 C6 位置，形成無色還原態中間體 Leuco-adrenochrome。

links.context: Once imported into mitochondria by MPC, pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (PDH), feeding the TCA cycle and the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis. This mitochondrial pyruvate oxidation also promotes necroptosis, because RIPK3 activates the PDC to raise aerobic respiration and mitochondrial ROS that feed back on the necrosome.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyruvate 一旦由 MPC 運入粒線體，便由丙酮酸去氫酶複合體 (PDH) 轉換為 Acetyl-CoA，供應 TCA cycle 與粒線體檸檬酸－Acetyl-CoA 軸。這條粒線體丙酮酸氧化途徑也會促進 necroptosis，因 RIPK3 活化 PDC 提高有氧呼吸與粒線體 ROS，進而回饋於 necrosome。

links.context: Once inserted into the peroxisomal membrane by PEX19 and PEX3, PEX13 recruits PEX14 to build the core docking complex and the oligomeric translocation pore.
links.context_zh_TW: PEX13 在被 PEX19 與 PEX3 插入過氧化體膜後，會募集 PEX14 以組建核心對接複合體與寡聚化轉位孔道。

links.context: Once unblocked by depolarization, the NMDA receptor is highly permeable to Ca2+, and the resulting calcium influx drives both synaptic plasticity and, when excessive, excitotoxicity. This dual coupling to Ca2+ signaling is why the receptor sits at the intersection of learning and memory on one hand and stroke, traumatic brain injury and epilepsy pathology on the other.
links.context_zh_TW: 在去極化解除封阻後，NMDA receptor 對 Ca2+ 具有高度通透性，而由此產生的鈣離子內流既驅動突觸可塑性，過量時也造成 excitotoxicity。這種與 Ca2+ 訊號的雙重耦合，正是該受體一方面位於學習記憶核心、另一方面位於 stroke、traumatic brain injury 與 epilepsy 病理交會點的原因。

links.context: Onchocerca volvulus is transmitted by blackflies of the genus Simulium, which breed in fast-flowing rivers — hence the name river blindness and the endemic clustering around riverine communities. Within the fly, microfilariae penetrate the gut wall and migrate to thoracic flight muscles, developing to the infective L3 stage over 10–14 days before being deposited on human skin at a subsequent blood meal.
links.context_zh_TW: Onchocerca volvulus 由 Simulium 屬的黑蠅傳播，後者在湍急河流中繁殖——這正是 river blindness 名称由來，也是疾病沿河岸社區聚集流行的原因。在黑蠅體內，微絲蟲穿過腸壁並遷移至胸部飛行肌肉，於 10–14 天內發育為具感染力的 L3 期幼蟲，之後在再次吸血時被沉積到人體皮膚上。

links.context: Onchocerciasis is a core disease in the TDR portfolio, addressed through operational research on how to deliver Ivermectin mass drug administration effectively, monitor drug resistance and measure progress toward elimination targets, together with mapping of Simulium vector distributions.
links.context_zh_TW: Onchocerciasis 是 TDR 疾病組合中的核心項目，其工作包含研究如何有效執行 Ivermectin 大規模藥物投予、監測抗藥性與衡量朝向根除目標的進度，以及 Simulium 病媒分布的製圖。

links.context: Oncogene Activation is the process by which a proto-oncogene is converted into an oncogene with the ability to promote Cancer, via point mutations, gene amplification, chromosomal translocation, insertional mutagenesis or epigenetic derepression. Once activated, Oncogene Activation leads to constitutive Cell Proliferation, resistance to Apoptosis, metabolic reprogramming and Angiogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 致癌基因活化（Oncogene Activation）是指原致癌基因（proto-oncogene）被轉換成能促進癌症（Cancer）的致癌基因的過程，可經由點突變、基因擴增、染色體轉位、插入性突變或表觀遺傳去抑制達成。一旦活化，Oncogene Activation 會導致持續的細胞增殖（Cell Proliferation）、對凋亡（Apoptosis）的抵抗、代謝重編程與血管新生（Angiogenesis）。

links.context: Oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) is the permanent cell-cycle arrest triggered in cells carrying BRAF/RAS/MYC mutations. The benign melanocytic nevus (mole) is the in-vivo embodiment of OIS and prevents melanoma; bypass of OIS via p53/PTEN loss or TERT activation is required for malignancy. Capped, arrested growth is therefore tumor-suppressive.
links.context_zh_TW: 致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS）是在帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 突變的細胞中觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯。良性黑色素細胞痣（痣）是 OIS 的體內體現，並防止黑色素瘤；經由 p53/PTEN 缺失或 TERT 活化繞過 OIS 是惡性化所必需的。受封頂、停滯的生長因此是腫瘤抑制性的。

links.context: Oncogene-induced senescence depends on both the p53/p21 and p16/Rb pathways maintaining Rb in its active hypophosphorylated state, and Rb's role in maintaining this arrest is through inhibition of E2F target gene expression. Loss of Rb function cooperates with loss of p53 in malignant transformation, and RB1 was the first tumour suppressor gene identified.
links.context_zh_TW: Oncogene-induced senescence 同時依賴 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 兩條路徑把 Rb 維持在活性的低磷酸化狀態，而 Rb 維持此停滯的作用是透過抑制 E2F 標的基因表現。Rb 功能喪失與 p53 喪失協同作用以促進惡性轉化，且 RB1 是第一個被辨識出的腫瘤抑制基因。

links.context: Oncogenic MYC overdrives proliferative and E2F programs that trigger OIS, as excessive mitogenic signaling exhausts replicative capacity and engages senescence checkpoints. MYC-induced senescence is a recognized tumor-suppressive response in multiple tissues, arising from hyper-replication and DNA damage. The relationship positions MYC among canonical OIS inducers alongside RAS and BRAF and is supported by transgenic and overexpression models. It highlights that even growth-promoting oncogenes can activate the senescence barrier.
links.context_zh_TW: 致癌基因 MYC 過度驅動增殖與 E2F 程序，觸發 OIS，因過度的促有絲分裂訊號耗盡複製能力並啟動衰老檢查點。MYC 誘發的衰老是多種組織中公認的腫瘤抑制反應，將致癌壓力轉化為生長停止。此誘發凸顯 OIS 如何由不同致癌基因透過共享的複製壓力機制觸發。它是細胞防禦惡性轉化的關鍵機制。

links.context: Oncosis is the primary mechanism of cell death in many forms of ischemic injury, including myocardial infarction and stroke, as well as organ failure due to shock. It is driven by ATP depletion rather than caspase activation, distinguishing it from apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Oncosis 是多種缺血性損傷（ischemic injury）的主要細胞死亡機制，包括 Myocardial infarction、Stroke 以及休克造成的器官衰竭。其驅動力是 ATP 耗竭而非 caspase 活化，這正是它與 Apoptosis 的區別所在。

links.context: One defining feature of Aging is the progressive loss of epigenetic information. Repressive heterochromatic regions open up, activating genes that should stay silenced, and gene expression patterns become more erratic and less coordinated within a tissue, a phenomenon described as transcriptional drift.
links.context_zh_TW: Aging 的定義性特徵之一是表觀遺傳資訊的逐步流失。壓抑性的 heterochromatin 區域逐漸開放，啟動本應保持沉默的基因；組織內的基因表現型態變得更不規律、更缺乏協調，此現象稱為 transcriptional drift。

links.context: One of the most important sensors involved in the regulation of mTORC1 activity is the TSC complex, a heterodimer comprising TSC1 (hamartin) and TSC2 (tuberin). Rapamycin and its analogue everolimus are FDA-approved for TSC-associated seizures (EXIST-3), making the TSC-mTOR axis a validated bridge from mTOR biology to the clinic.
links.context_zh_TW: 參與調控 mTORC1 活性的最重要感測器之一是 TSC 複合體，它是由 TSC1 (hamartin) 與 TSC2 (tuberin) 組成的異二聚體。Rapamycin 及其類似物 everolimus 已獲 FDA 核准用於 TSC 相關的癲癇發作 (EXIST-3)，使 TSC-mTOR 軸成為 mTOR 生物学與臨床之間經過驗證的橋樑。

links.context: One-Carbon Metabolism is a hallmark of cancer metabolic reprogramming: enzymes such as SHMT2, MTHFD2, MTHFD1L and cytosolic MTHFD1/MTHFD2 are frequently upregulated in tumours, where they fuel de novo purine synthesis, thymidylate synthesis, Methionine regeneration and NADPH. Because this network is reprogrammed in Cancer, it is a prime chemotherapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: 一碳代謝（One-Carbon Metabolism）是癌症代謝重編程的特徵之一：SHMT2、MTHFD2、MTHFD1L 及細胞質 MTHFD1/MTHFD2 等酵素在腫瘤中經常上調，為新生嘌呤合成、胸腺嘧啶核苷酸合成、蛋胺酸（Methionine）再生成與 NADPH 提供燃料。由於此代謝網在癌症中被重編程，它成為化學治療的首要標的。

links.context: Only a small fraction of doxorubicin-treated breast cancer cells escape apoptosis, and those survivors are senescent, which makes therapy-induced senescence by construction a cell-death evasion state. Senescent tumor cells can re-enter the cell cycle through p16/p21 loss, Cdk1 upregulation, autophagy and polyploidy, and they are cross-resistant to many drugs while in that state.
links.context_zh_TW: 接受 doxorubicin 處理的乳癌細胞中，只有極少部分逃過凋亡，而倖存者皆為衰老細胞，因此治療誘導的衰老在建構上就是一種細胞死亡逃避狀態。衰老腫瘤細胞可藉由 p16/p21 喪失、Cdk1 上調、自噬與多倍體化而重新進入細胞週期，並在該狀態下對多種藥物產生交叉抗藥性。

links.context: Only when mutant Heteroplasmy rises past a biochemical threshold — often ~60–80% depending on mutation and tissue — does Oxidative Phosphorylation fail enough to produce clinical disease. Proof-of-concept work in patient cybrids and mouse models carrying the m.8993 T>C and m.3243A>G MELAS mutations shows that shifting heteroplasmy back toward wild-type restores respiratory function.
links.context_zh_TW: 只有當突變型 Heteroplasmy 超過生化閾值（依突變與組織不同常約 60–80%）時，Oxidative Phosphorylation 才會嚴重受損並產生臨床疾病。在帶有 m.8993 T>C 與 m.3243A>G 等 MELAS 突變的患者 cybrid 與小鼠模型中，把 heteroplasmy 往野生型方向推移即可恢復呼吸功能。

links.context: Oocyte SCNT reprograms somatic nuclei back to the blastocyst epigenome. Reset restores totipotency-grade plasticity.
links.context_zh_TW: 卵母細胞 SCNT 將體細胞核重編程回囊胚表觀基因組。重置恢復全能性級可塑性。

links.context: Oocyte activation or nuclear transfer reaches the blastocyst stage. Generation covers the developmental route.
links.context_zh_TW: 卵母細胞活化或核轉移到達囊胚期。產生涵蓋發育路徑。

links.context: Oocyte factors reset the donor genome to a totipotent and pluripotent state.
links.context_zh_TW: 卵母細胞因子將供體基因組重置為全能與多能狀態。

links.context: Oral SCC belongs to the anatomical head-and-neck cancer parent class.
links.context_zh_TW: 口腔鱗癌屬於解剖學頭頸癌母類。

links.context: Oral aminoguanidine potently inhibits gut Diamine Oxidase, the enzyme that degrades dietary histamine, which can cause severe acute Histamine Intolerance with headache, flushing, hives, and tachycardia after histamine-rich foods. Intravenous delivery bypasses gut DAO but still affects systemic DAO. It also inhibits SSAO/VAP-1, reducing endothelial hydrogen peroxide production.
links.context_zh_TW: 口服 aminoguanidine 會強效抑制腸道 Diamine Oxidase（分解膳食組織胺的酵素），可能在攝取高組織胺食物後造成嚴重的急性 Histamine Intolerance，症狀包括頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹與心搏過速。靜脈給藥可繞過腸道 DAO，但仍影響全身性 DAO。它也抑制 SSAO／VAP-1，降低內皮的過氧化氫生成。

links.context: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
links.context_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

links.context: Oral supplementation with nicotinamide riboside (NR) is associated with improved mitochondrial function, and increasing NAD+ content with NR can stimulate energy production and improve mitochondrial abundance and function in two different mitochondrial myopathies, even though supplementation could not correct the underlying genetic defects. In mice, NR also confers increased endurance and improved cold tolerance in high-fat-diet-fed mice, while a nonsignificant trend toward increased endurance was seen in regular chow-fed mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 口服 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充與改善的粒線體功能相關，且以 NR 提升 NAD+ 含量能刺激能量產生並改善兩種不同粒線體肌病中的粒線體數量與功能，儘管補充無法矯正潛在的遺傳缺陷。在小鼠中，NR 亦賦予高脂飲食小鼠增強的耐力與改善的耐寒能力，而在一般飼料餵食的小鼠中則觀察到耐力增加的未達顯著趨勢。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Orexin (hypocretin) is produced by a small cluster of neurons in the lateral and perifornical Hypothalamus, where prepro-orexin is cleaved into orexin-A and orexin-B and the neurons project widely to cortex, brainstem and limbic system. These glucose-sensing neurons promote arousal-associated energy expenditure and physical activity, linking sleep–wake regulation to metabolic health.
links.context_zh_TW: Orexin（hypocretin）由外側與圍室核下視丘（Hypothalamus）的一小群神經元產生，這些神經元將前驅 orexin 切割成 orexin-A 與 orexin-B，並廣泛投射至皮質、腦幹與邊緣系統。這些具葡萄糖感測能力的神經元促進覺醒相關的能量消耗與身體活動，把睡眠—清醒調節與代謝健康連結起來。

links.context: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
links.context_zh_TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

links.context: Ornithine Aminotransferase (OAT) Deficiency causes progressive gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina, with circular atrophic lesions appearing in the peripheral retina from childhood. Because the underlying defect is ornithine catabolism failure, visual fields progressively constrict and night vision is lost, often leading to legal blindness by age 40–50.
links.context_zh_TW: 鳥胺酸轉氨酶缺乏症（Ornithine Aminotransferase (OAT) Deficiency）會造成脈絡膜與視網膜的進展性牛狀萎縮（Gyrate Atrophy），自兒童期起在周邊視網膜出現環狀萎縮病灶。由於其根本缺陷是鳥胺酸分解代謝受阻，視野會逐步縮小並喪失夜視力，常在 40–50 歲前達到法定失明。

links.context: Ornithine aminotransferase deficiency raises plasma ornithine 10- to 20-fold; the elevated ornithine inhibits AGAT, reducing endogenous creatine synthesis. The secondary creatine depletion drives muscle atrophy and weakness, which respond to creatine monohydrate supplementation, while arginine restriction lowers ornithine.
links.context_zh_TW: Ornithine aminotransferase 缺乏使血漿 ornithine 上升 10 至 20 倍，升高的 ornithine 抑制 AGAT，減少內源性 creatine 合成。此繼發性 creatine 耗損造成 muscle atrophy 與 weakness，可由 creatine monohydrate 補充改善，而 arginine 限制則可降低 ornithine。

links.context: Ornithine transcarbamylase is the only urea-cycle enzyme located in the mitochondrion, where it condenses carbamoyl phosphate with ornithine to form citrulline; its deficiency is the most common inborn error of the urea cycle, causing hyperammonemia.
links.context_zh_TW: [[Ornithine transcarbamylase]] 是唯一位於 [[Mitochondria]] 的尿素循環酵素，在此將 carbamoyl phosphate 與 ornithine 縮合生成 citrulline；其缺乏是尿素循環最常見的先天性錯誤，導致高血氨。

links.context: Over-expression of Acid ceramidase in senescent WI-38 fibroblasts drove a pro-ferroptotic profile with increased sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids, whereas Acid ceramidase knockdown decreased these PL-PUFAs and protected against RSL3-induced Ferroptosis. This effect was independent of GPX4/glutathione and iron, indicating that ceramide-derived free fatty acids raise PUFA-PL content upstream of the canonical ferroptosis regulators.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent WI-38 fibroblasts 中過量表現 Acid ceramidase 會帶出促鐵死亡（pro-ferroptotic）的型態，sn-2 含 PUFA 的磷脂增加；而 Acid ceramidase 敲低則降低這些 PL-PUFAs，並保護免於 RSL3 引發的 Ferroptosis。此效應獨立於 GPX4/glutathione 與 iron，顯示 ceramide 衍生的游離脂肪酸能在典型鐵死亡調控因子之上游提高 PUFA-PL 含量。

links.context: Oxidation in biological systems — both enzymatic and non-enzymatic — is a major source of Reactive Oxygen Species. Non-enzymatic autoxidation of catechols reduces molecular oxygen to Superoxide, which dismutates to Hydrogen Peroxide and perpetuates oxidative chain reactions, coupling oxidation chemistry directly to oxidative damage.
links.context_zh_TW: 生物體內的氧化（酵素性與非酵素性皆是）都是 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要來源。非酵素性兒茶酚自氧化會將分子氧還原為 Superoxide，後者歧化為 Hydrogen Peroxide 並延續氧化鏈反應，將氧化化學直接連結至氧化傷害。

links.context: Oxidative Stress impairs Cholesterol Efflux by reducing the expression of ABCA1, the LXR nuclear receptor and PPAR, which together govern the macrophage cholesterol export machinery. The resulting deficit in efflux leaves excess cholesterol trapped in Macrophages and drives foam cell formation characteristic of Atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 會降低 ABCA1、LXR 核受體與 PPAR 的表現，因而損害 Cholesterol Efflux。這些因子共同調控巨噬細胞的膽固醇輸出機制；外流不足會使過量膽固醇滯留於 Macrophages，促成 Atherosclerosis 特有的泡沫細胞形成。

links.context: Oxidative Stress is one of the most common acute inducers of Stress-Induced Senescence, alongside genotoxic agents such as radiation and chemotherapy. Because the resulting arrest is driven by the p53-p21 and p16-RB tumour suppressor pathways, oxidant exposure can impose senescence on cells well before they have exhausted their replicative potential.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 是 Stress-Induced Senescence 最常見的急性誘發因子之一，與輻射、化學治療等 genotoxic agent 並列。由於所產生的停滯由 p53-p21 與 p16-RB 腫瘤抑制路徑驅動，氧化壓力可在細胞耗盡複製潛能之前很久就使其陷入 senescence。

links.context: Oxidative Stress potently activates kinases that hyperphosphorylate Tau Protein, promoting its dissociation from Microtubule and self-aggregation into paired helical filaments. GSK3 (GSK-3β) is the principal tau kinase, and its activity is enhanced by ROS-mediated inhibition of Akt survival signaling; CDK5, activated by p25 from Ca²⁺-driven calpain cleavage of p35, also contributes, as do p38 MAPK and JNK.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 會強效活化使 Tau Protein 過度磷酸化的激酶，促進其從 Microtubule 解離並自我聚集形成成對螺旋絲 (PHF)。GSK3 (GSK-3β) 是主要的 tau 激酶，其活性因 ROS 介導的 Akt 存活訊號抑制而增強；由 Ca²⁺ 驅動的 calpain 切割 p35 產生的 p25 所活化的 CDK5 也有貢獻，p38 MAPK 與 JNK 亦然。

links.context: Oxidative stress activates the canonical IKK-NF-kB pathway, driving inflammatory gene expression and the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP).
links.context_zh_TW: 氧化壓力活化典型的 IKK–NF-kB 路徑，驅動發炎基因表現與衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

links.context: Oxidative stress impairs HDL function: Fe/ascorbate stress and Cu-induced oxidation of HDL3 decrease its capacity to mediate cholesterol efflux from macrophages, alter phospholipid fluidity, modify apoprotein structure, and lower PON1 activity. Resveratrol protects HDL3 from copper oxidation and preserves efflux capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 會損害 HDL 功能：Fe/ascorbate 壓力與 Cu 誘發的 HDL3 氧化降低其從 macrophages 介導 cholesterol efflux 的能力，改變磷脂流動性、變形 apoprotein 結構並降低 PON1 活性。Resveratrol 可保護 HDL3 免於銅氧化並維持 efflux 能力。

links.context: Oxidative stress is heavily implicated in ALS, particularly through mutations in the SOD1 gene encoding superoxide dismutase, which lead to mitochondrial impairment and motor neuron death. Loss of SOD1 function leaves superoxide radicals unremoved, linking the disease directly to the free-radical theory of neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: ALS 與氧化壓力高度相關，尤其是編碼 superoxide dismutase 的 SOD1 基因突變，會導致粒線體受損與運動神經元死亡。SOD1 功能喪失使超氧自由基無法被清除，使此疾病直接與神經退行的自由基理論相連結。

links.context: Oxidative stress is the major driver of endothelial dysfunction: peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, causing BH4 deficiency; in the absence of sufficient BH4 eNOS uncouples and its oxygenase domain reduces oxygen to superoxide instead of producing NO. The superoxide reacts with remaining NO (~6.7 x 10^9 M-1 s-1) to form peroxynitrite, which further oxidizes BH4 — a feed-forward loop converting eNOS from protective to pro-oxidant.
links.context_zh_TW: 氧化壓力是內皮功能失調的主要驅動因子：過氧亞硝酸鹽將四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）氧化為 BH2，造成 BH4 缺乏；缺乏足夠 BH4 時 eNOS 發生「解偶聯」，其加氧酶結構域將氧還原為超氧陰離子而非產生 NO。該超氧陰離子會與殘餘 NO（約 6.7 x 10^9 M-1 s-1）反應形成過氧亞硝酸鹽，進一步氧化 BH4——形成將 eNOS 由保護性酵素轉為促氧化劑的正向迴路。

links.context: Oxidative stress plays a central role in the mechanism by which advanced glycation end products form and accumulate. The glycation reaction is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, and oxidative stress is fueled by reactive oxygen species generated from glucose autoxidation and from the non-enzymatic covalent attachment of glucose to proteins. ROS drive and accelerate the protein glycation reaction, which is why the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is attributed to exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Oxidative stress is implicated in diabetes, Alzheimer's disease, and aging progression.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 在 advanced glycation end products 形成與堆積的機制中扮演核心角色。Glycation reaction 在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，而 oxidative stress 由 glucose autoxidation 以及 glucose 非酵素共價附著於蛋白質所產生的 reactive oxygen species 所助長。ROS 驅動並加速蛋白質 glycation reaction，這就是為何 regular exercise 對 AGE formation 的抑制歸因於 exercise-associated antioxidant activity。Oxidative stress 涉及 diabetes、Alzheimer's disease 與 aging progression。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Oxidatively modified GAPDH translocates to the nucleus, where it binds and activates the apoptosis-inducing factor AIF, triggering caspase-independent apoptosis; nuclear GAPDH accumulation is implicated in neurodegeneration and ischemia-reperfusion injury.
links.context_zh_TW: 經氧化修飾的 GAPDH 會轉位至細胞核，在核內結合並活化 apoptosis-inducing factor（AIF），觸發 caspase 依賴性之外的 apoptosis；GAPDH 的核內累積與神經退化及缺血再灌流傷害有關。

links.context: Oxidized LDL and lipid peroxides inhibit prostacyclin synthase, lowering endothelial PGI2 output and shifting the PGI2/TXA2 balance toward thrombosis. This is a direct mechanistic link between Lipid Peroxidation and thrombotic risk, and it explains why reduced PGI2 accompanies plaque progression in Atherosclerosis: the oxidative lesion and the prothrombotic shift are two faces of the same chemistry.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidized LDL 與脂質過氧化物會抑制 prostacyclin synthase，降低內皮的 PGI2 產量，並把 PGI2/TXA2 平衡推向血栓。這是 Lipid Peroxidation 與血栓風險之間直接的機制連結，也解釋了為何 PGI2 降低會伴隨 Atherosclerosis 中的斑塊進展：氧化病灶與促血栓轉向是同一套化學的兩面。

links.context: Oxidized LDL drives plaque formation and foam-cell generation. Contribution is the lipid-etiology edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 氧化 LDL 驅動斑塊形成與泡沫細胞生成。貢獻是脂質病因邊。

links.context: Oxidized LDL is a key driver of Atherosclerosis: macrophages take up the modified particle through scavenger receptors, accumulating cholesterol as Foam Cells that define the fatty streak. It also impairs Cholesterol Efflux and reduces Nitric Oxide bioavailability, worsening Endothelial Dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidized LDL 是 Atherosclerosis 的關鍵驅動因子：巨噬細胞透過清除受體攝取此修飾顆粒，累積膽固醇形成 Foam Cells，构成脂紋的核心。它同時抑制 Cholesterol Efflux 並降低 Nitric Oxide 的生體可用性，加重 Endothelial Dysfunction。

links.context: Oxygen Consumption Rate is measured in real time with a Seahorse XF Analyzer, whose transient micro-chamber clamps track O2 flux while titrating oligomycin, FCCP and rotenone/antimycin A to resolve basal, ATP-linked, proton-leak and spare respiratory capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxygen Consumption Rate 以 [[Seahorse XF Analyzer]] 即時測定；儀器利用瞬間微腔夾制追蹤 O₂ 通量，並以 [[Oligomycin]]、[[FCCP]] 與 rotenone/antimycin A 滴定，解析基礎呼吸、ATP 連結呼吸、質子漏與呼吸剩餘容量。

links.context: Oxygen-driven autoxidation of epinephrine terminates in adrenochrome (and, downstream, melanins). Because the catechol ring of the catecholamine is exceptionally susceptible to hydrogen-atom abstraction, yielding semiquinone radical intermediates that accelerate propagation, adrenochrome accumulation is a direct and unavoidable consequence of catecholamine exposure to oxygen.
links.context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 受氧驅動的 autoxidation 最終生成 Adrenochrome（下游則生成 Melanins）。由於兒茶酚胺的 catechol 環極易發生氫原子抽離、產生能加速鏈傳播的半醌自由基中間物，Catecholamine 接觸氧氣所導致的 Adrenochrome 累積，是直接且無可避免的結果。

links.context: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin, a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-). These radicals, along with hydrogen peroxide, can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production. Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen. This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin，a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-)。These radicals，along with hydrogen peroxide，can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome，a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production。Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state，and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen。This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions。

links.context: Oxyhemoglobin is in constant redox equilibrium with methemoglobin: spontaneous autoxidation lets bound O2 abstract an electron from Fe2+, yielding ferric heme and releasing superoxide anion at a slow rate (~0.5-3% of Hb per day), normally kept low by cytochrome b5 reductase and NADPH diaphorase.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin 與 methemoglobin 處於持續的氧化還原平衡：自發自氧化使結合的 O₂ 從 Fe²⁺ 奪走電子，生成三價血基質並釋放 [[Superoxide anion]]，速率緩慢（每日約 0.5–3% Hb），通常由 cytochrome b5 reductase 與 NADPH diaphorase 維持在低值。

links.context: P66shc knockout mice live about 30% longer than wild-type controls and show enhanced resistance to oxidative stress and age-related pathologies, indicating P66shc is a negative regulator of longevity. Directionally, loss of P66shc extends lifespan. This makes P66shc an attractive node, with SIRT1 as an upstream suppressor, for longevity interventions.
links.context_zh_TW: P66shc 基因敲除小鼠比野生型對照多活約 30%，並表現出對氧化壓力和年齡相關病變的增強抵抗力，表明 P66shc 是壽命的負向調節因子。方向性上 P66shc 的缺失延長壽命。這使 P66shc 成為一個有吸引力的節點，以 SIRT1 作為上游抑制因子，用於長壽介入措施。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: PAANIB-1 blocks the terminal DNA-fragmentation step of parthanatos, preventing neurodegeneration in models of Parkinson's disease (alpha-synuclein preformed fibrils, MPTP) while sparing upstream PAR formation and AIF-MIF binding. This supports MIF/PAAN as the DNA-fragmenting executioner downstream of AIF and as a druggable node.
links.context_zh_TW: PAANIB-1 阻斷 parthanatos 最終的 DNA 片段化步驟，在 Parkinson's disease 模型（α-突觸核蛋白預成型纖維、MPTP）中防止神經退化，同時保留上游的 PAR 形成與 AIF-MIF 結合。這支持 MIF/PAAN 為 AIF 下游的 DNA 片段化執行者，也是可成藥的節點。

links.context: PAANIB-1 is a brain-penetrant, selective inhibitor of the PD-D/E(X)K nuclease activity of MIF (PAAN, parthanatos-associated AIF nuclease). It spares MIF's tautomerase and cytokine functions and does not broadly inhibit other nucleases such as APE1, separating the parthanatotic nuclease arm from MIF's inflammatory roles.
links.context_zh_TW: PAANIB-1 是可穿透腦部、具選擇性的抑制劑，針對 MIF（PAAN，parthanatos 相關 AIF 核酸酶）的 PD-D/E(X)K 核酸酶活性。它保留 MIF 的互變異構酶與細胞激素功能，也不廣泛抑制 APE1 等其他核酸酶，將 parthanatotic 核酸酶臂與 MIF 的發炎功能區分開來。

links.context: PAD4 is a calcium-dependent peptidylarginine deiminase that converts protein arginine residues to citrulline, the defining reaction of Protein Citrullination. Applied to histones, this modification strips the positive charge that condenses chromatin and is the proximate cause of nuclear decondensation during NETosis.
links.context_zh_TW: PAD4 是鈣離子相依的肽基精胺酸去亞胺酶，將蛋白質上的精胺酸殘基轉為瓜胺酸，即 Protein Citrullination 的定義性反應。作用於組蛋白時，此修飾去除使染色質凝聚的正電荷，是 NETosis 期間核去凝結的直接原因。

links.context: PAD4 needs millimolar-range Ca2+ for full catalytic activity, so an obligate calcium signal couples calcium signaling to epigenetic-scale chromatin remodeling. The requirement also explains why PAD4 activation follows rather than precedes the ROS-induced calcium flux that initiates NETosis.
links.context_zh_TW: PAD4 需要毫莫耳濃度範圍的 Ca2+ 才能達到完整催化活性，因此不可或缺的鈣離子訊號將 Calcium Signaling 與表觀遺傳層級的染色質重塑耦合。此需求也解釋了為何 PAD4 的活化是在引發 NETosis 的 ROS 誘導鈣流之後而非之前。

links.context: PAI-1 is one of the most robust secreted components of the SASP and promotes senescence in an autocrine and paracrine loop via plasmin suppression and integrin signalling. Proteomic meta-analyses of aging cohorts identified circulating PAI-1, with GDF15, RAGE, VEGF, and CCL18, as part of a five-protein senescence signature associated with all-cause mortality.
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 SASP 中最穩健的分泌成分之一，透過 plasmin 抑制與 integrin 訊號在自分泌與旁分泌迴圈中促進 Senescence。老化世代的蛋白質體後分析將循環中的 PAI-1 與 GDF15、RAGE、VEGF、CCL18 一同列為與全因死亡相關的五蛋白 Senescence 簽章。

links.context: PAI-1 is the primary physiological inhibitor of tissue plasminogen activator, rapidly inactivating free tPA in plasma and thereby limiting systemic fibrinolysis. PAI-1 is itself a key SASP factor, so senescence-associated protease inhibitor elevation links cellular senescence to a prothrombotic, fibrinolysis-suppressed state.
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 tissue plasminogen activator 的主要生理抑制劑，能在血漿中迅速失活游離 tPA，因而限制全身性 fibrinolysis。PAI-1 本身也是關鍵的 SASP 因子，因此細胞衰老相關的蛋白酶抑制劑上升，將細胞衰老與促血栓、纖維蛋白溶解受抑制的狀態連結起來。

links.context: PAI-1 is the principal physiological inhibitor of the plasminogen activators uPA and tissue-type plasminogen activator, blocking plasmin generation and therefore fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix remodelling. By suppressing plasmin it also modulates integrin and latent-growth-factor activation, feeding fibrotic and proliferative loops.
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 uPA 與組織型纖維蛋白溶解酶原活化素的主要生理抑制劑，阻斷 plasmin 生成，因而抑制纖維蛋白溶解與細胞外基質重塑。透過抑制 plasmin，它也調節 integrin 與潛在生長因子的活化，feeding 纖維化與增殖性回饋迴圈。

links.context: PAI-1 is transcriptionally repressed by SIRT6 through H3K9 deacetylation at its promoter (SIRT6 binding is a hallmark of PAI-1 downregulation), so PAI-1 elevation with age opposes SIRT6's anti-senescence and metabolic programs; Table 3 lists PAI-1 among negative regulators of SIRT6 (Van Meter et al., 2014).
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 的轉錄受 SIRT6 透過其啟動子 H3K9 去乙醯化所抑制（SIRT6 結合是 PAI-1 下調的標誌），因此 PAI-1 隨年齡升高會對抗 SIRT6 的抗衰老和代謝程序；表 3 將 PAI-1 列為 SIRT6 的負向調節因子（Van Meter et al., 2014）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: PAI-1 transcription is induced by TGFβ, by p53, and by inflammatory cues, and its expression rises sharply in senescence as part of the SASP program. This places PAI-1 downstream of both TGFβ-driven fibrosis and the senescence program, explaining why it accumulates with age and in fibrotic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 的轉錄受 TGFβ、p53 與發炎訊號誘導，並在 Senescence 中作為 SASP 程式的一部分而急遽上升。這使 PAI-1 同時位於 TGFβ 驅動的纖維化與 Senescence 程式之下游，解釋了它為何隨老化及纖維化疾病而累積。

links.context: PAI-1, a senescence-associated secreted factor (SASP), suppresses SIRT1 expression, and SIRT1 reciprocally binds the PAI-1 promoter to deacetylate H4K16 and repress its transcription; elevation of PAI-1 with age thus contributes to SIRT1 decline and the senescence phenotype (Kortlever et al., 2006, Nat Cell Biol; Wan et al., 2014, Aging Cell, PMID 24649892).
links.context_zh_TW: PAI-1 是一種衰老相關的分泌因子（SASP），抑制 SIRT1 表達，而 SIRT1 相互結合 PAI-1 啟動子去乙醯化 H4K16 並抑制其轉錄；因此 PAI-1 隨年齡的升高促成 SIRT1 的下降和衰老表型（Kortlever et al., 2006, Nat Cell Biol; Wan et al., 2014, Aging Cell, PMID 24649892）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: PAK2 binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at Ser30, Thr173 and Ser239, suppressing it at two layers: Ser30 phosphorylation in the prodomain obstructs interaction with Caspase-9 and prevents activation, while Ser239 phosphorylation near the active site sterically hinders substrate binding. PAK2 overexpression in invasive ductal carcinoma makes this axis a driver of chemotherapy resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK2 結合並在 Ser30、Thr173 與 Ser239 磷酸化 Caspase-7，於兩個層次抑制它：前驅物區的 Ser30 磷酸化阻擋與 Caspase-9 的交互作用而阻止活化，活性位點附近的 Ser239 磷酸化則以立體障礙妨礙受質結合。侵襲性導管癌中的 PAK2 過度表現使此軸成為化療抵抗的驅動因素。

links.context: PAK2 is a serine/threonine kinase of the PAK family held in an autoinhibited state by its CRIB domain. Binding of active Rac1 (or Cdc42) relieves autoinhibition by engaging the N-terminal regulatory domain, a mechanism that couples PAK2 to cytoskeletal dynamics and migration signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK2 是 PAK 家族的絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶，其 CRIB 區域使酵素處於自我抑制狀態。活化的 Rac1（或 Cdc42）結合並接合 N 端調節區域以解除自我抑制，此機制將 PAK2 與細胞骨架動態及遷移訊號相連。

links.context: PAK2 is frequently overexpressed in invasive ductal carcinoma of the Breast Cancer, and the PAK2-Caspase-7 axis is a major driver of resistance to DNA-damaging chemotherapeutics such as doxorubicin and staurosporine. PAK2 inhibitors are therefore being developed as chemosensitizers, and PAK2 also promotes Metastasis via LIMK and filamin phosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: PAK2 在 Breast Cancer 的浸潤性導管癌中經常過度表現，PAK2–Caspase-7 軸是對 doxorubicin 與 staurosporine 等 DNA 損傷性化療藥物抗性的主要驅動因素。因此 PAK2 抑制劑正被開發為化療增敏劑，而 PAK2 亦透過磷酸化 LIMK 與 filamin 促進 Metastasis。

links.context: PAR binds the PAR-binding motif on Apoptosis-Inducing Factor (AIF) domain D3 at Arg588/Lys589/Arg592, triggering AIF release from mitochondria and its nuclear translocation. This binding is the mitochondrial death hit that converts a metabolic lesion into executed parthanatos.
links.context_zh_TW: PAR 會結合 Apoptosis-Inducing Factor（AIF）D3 區域的 PAR 結合基序（Arg588/Lys589/Arg592），觸發 AIF 自粒線體釋放並向細胞核轉位。此結合是粒線體層面的死亡攻擊，將代謝層面的損傷轉化為已執行的 parthanatos。

links.context: PARG dosage bidirectionally sets infarct outcome: PARG transgenic mice show a 62% reduction in hemisphere infarct after 120-minute MCAO, whereas heterozygotes show 56% larger infarcts after 90-minute MCAO and their neurons make roughly twice the PAR with about 20% excess death. PARG therefore is a dosage-sensitive determinant of ischemic injury.
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 的劑量會雙向決定梗死結果：PARG 轉基因鼠在 120 分鐘 MCAO 後半球梗死減少 62%，而異型合子鼠在 90 分鐘 MCAO 後梗死增加 56%，其神經元製造的 PAR 約為兩倍並伴隨約 20% 的額外死亡。因此 PARG 是缺血性損傷的劑量敏感性決定因子。

links.context: PARG dosage sets parthanatos bidirectionally: cytosolic PARG overexpression lowers cytosolic PAR, halves NMDA/MNNG death, and reduces infarct volume by 62% in transgenics, while PARG knockdown prolongs PAR and adds roughly 30% MNNG death. A 2026 preprint adds the twist that complete PARG inhibition prevents parthanatos, so both polymer formation and hydrolysis are required.
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 的劑量會雙向決定 parthanatos：細胞質 PARG 過量表現會降低細胞質 PAR，將 NMDA/MNNG 誘導的死亡減半，並在轉基因鼠中使梗死體積減少 62%；相反地，PARG 敲低會延長 PAR 存在並增加約 30% 的 MNNG 死亡。2026 年 preprint 補充了完全抑制 PARG 反而阻止 parthanatos 的轉折，顯示聚合物的生成與水解皆為必需。

links.context: PARG hydrolyzes PAR chains, releasing free ADP-ribose monomers. This free ADP-ribose is the ligand that gates TRPM2 and the substrate for Nudix degradation, making PARG activity a determinant of the downstream Ca2+ and AMP arms of parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 水解 PAR 鏈釋出游離 ADP-ribose 單體。此游離 ADP-ribose 是開啟 TRPM2 的配體及 Nudix 降解的受質，使 PARG 活性成為 parthanatos 下游 Ca2+ 與 AMP 分支的決定因素（Moura et al. 2024）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md

links.context: PARK7 (DJ-1) functions primarily as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase, stereospecifically detoxifying free glyoxal to glycolic acid and methylglyoxal to L-lactate, which prevents these dicarbonyls from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine and arginine residues.
links.context_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）主要作為穀胱甘肽非依賴性 glyoxalase 作用，立體專一地將游離的 [[Glyoxal]] 解毒為 [[Glycolic acid]]、將 [[Methylglyoxal]] 解毒為 [[L-lactate]]，避免這些二碳醣基化合物在 [[Cysteine]]、[[Lysine]] 與 [[Arginine]] 殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。

links.context: PARK7 (DJ-1), a peroxiredoxin-like protein, stereospecifically converts the glycating dicarbonyl methylglyoxal into L-lactate in a glutathione-independent manner. By detoxifying methylglyoxal without consuming the principal antioxidant buffer, this route complements the glutathione-dependent glyoxalase system and the fructosyl-amino acid oxidase/PARK7 family of anti-glycation defenses.
