Because low progerin levels are detected even in normal aging, progerin may represent a shared mechanism between progeroid syndromes and normal biological aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Progerin 是 LMNA 突變所產生的異常 lamin A 產物，是 Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome 早衰的驅動因子。Progerin 也會誘導 LINE-1 去抑制，產生細胞質 cDNA，觸發 cGAS-STING 依賴性的 SASP。由於正常老化細胞中亦可檢出低量 progerin，progerin 可能代表早衰症候群與正常生物老化之間的共同機制。

links.context: Progression through G1 is driven by cyclin-dependent kinase complexes, principally cyclin D-CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2. Mitogenic signals activate these complexes, which phosphorylate the RB1 tumor suppressor to release E2F and induce S-phase genes.
links.context_zh_TW: 通過 G1 期的進程由週期蛋白依賴性激酶複合體驅動，主要是 cyclin D-CDK4/6 和 cyclin E-CDK2。促有絲分裂訊號活化這些複合體，磷酸化 RB1 腫瘤抑制因子以釋放 E2F 並誘導 S 期基因。

links.context: Progressive telomere attrition with cell division (the end-replication problem) causes loss of the protective TRF2-occupied shelterin cap, activating persistent DDR signaling that triggers Replicative Senescence. Deletion or dysfunction of TRF2 leads to telomere end-to-end fusions and genomic instability, counteracting Telomere Attrition-driven aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 隨細胞分裂而逐步發生的端粒耗損（末端複製問題）會造成具保護作用的 TRF2-占据 shelterin 帽流失，啟動持續的 DNA 損傷反應訊號，進而觸發 Replicative Senescence。TRF2 的缺失或功能失常會導致端粒端對端融合與基因體不穩定，對抗 Telomere Attrition 驅動的老化。

links.context: Proline is the major nitrogen donor for polyamine synthesis, including spermidine, which is itself implicated in autophagy induction and longevity. Proline's cyclic structure additionally constrains protein backbone conformation and stabilizes collagen.
links.context_zh_TW: Proline 是多胺（包括 spermidine）合成的主要氮供應者，而 spermidine 本身即與自噬誘導及長壽相關。Proline 的環狀結構另外可限制蛋白主鏈構形並穩定 collagen。

links.context: Prolonged Exercise training raises Citrate Synthase and cytochrome-c oxidase activity in tissues linked to the training, such as Skeletal Muscle and heart. The elevated oxidative-enzyme activity indicates higher metabolic rate per unit tissue mass, supporting training-induced gains in Resting Metabolic Rate beyond what lean-mass accretion alone predicts.
links.context_zh_TW: 長時間的 Exercise 訓練會提升 Skeletal Muscle 與心臟等受訓組織中的 Citrate Synthase 與 cytochrome-c oxidase 活性。氧化酵素活性升高代表單位組織量的代謝率提高，支持訓練所帶來的 Resting Metabolic Rate 增益超出單純瘦體組織增加的預期。

links.context: Promoter CpG hypermethylation silences tumor suppressor genes in cancer. Silencing is the epigenetic inactivation route.
links.context_zh_TW: 啟動子 CpG 高甲基化在癌症沉默腫瘤抑制基因。沉默是表觀遺傳失活路徑。

links.context: Propidium Iodide reports membrane rupture: its negativity is the live-cell signature of early Apoptosis, whereas positivity in uncleared apoptotic cells marks late secondary necrosis, making PI status the workhorse discriminator between lytic and non-lytic death programs.
links.context_zh_TW: Propidium Iodide 反映細胞膜破裂：其陰性是早期 Apoptosis 的活細胞特徵，而未被清除的凋亡細胞呈陽性則標記晚期次級壞死，使 PI 狀態成為區分裂解型與非裂解型死亡程序的主要工具。

links.context: Propionate is produced by the Gut Microbiome through fermentation of dietary fiber and resistant starch, making it a key node connecting diet, microbial metabolism and host metabolism. Low SCFA exposure is associated with obesity and type 2 diabetes, whereas higher propionate availability tracks with favorable metabolic and longevity phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: Propionate 由 Gut Microbiome 發酵膳食纖維與抗性澱粉而產生，使其成為連結飲食、微生物代謝與宿主代謝的關鍵節點。SCFA 曝露量低與肥胖及第二型糖尿病相關，而較高的 propionate 可利用度則與有利的代謝與長壽表型相呼應。

links.context: Propolis inhibits NF-κB, with its caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE) acting as a potent inhibitor of NF-κB and of COX-2. This transcription-factor suppression is the shared mechanistic basis for both the anti-inflammatory and the anti-cancer activity attributed to propolis extracts.
links.context_zh_TW: Propolis 抑制 NF-κB，其中咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）是 NF-κB 與 COX-2 的強效抑制劑。這種轉錄因子抑制，是 propolis 萃取物同時具有抗發炎與抗癌活性的共同機轉基礎。

links.context: Prostaglandin E2 is one of the inflammatory mediators that sensitize nociceptor terminals at sites of tissue injury, together with bradykinin and cytokines. Sensitized nociceptors fire spontaneously and respond to normally innocuous stimuli, producing spontaneous pain, hyperalgesia and allodynia that together define inflammatory pain.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin E2 是使 nociceptor 末梢在組織損傷處敏感化的發炎介質之一，與 bradykinin 及細胞激素共同作用。敏感化的 nociceptor 會自發性放電並對原本無害的刺激產生反應，造成自發性疼痛、痛覺過敏與異痛症，三者共同構成 inflammatory pain。

links.context: Prostaglandin H₂ is converted by prostacyclin synthase to prostacyclin (PGI₂), a vasodilator and inhibitor of platelet aggregation produced preferentially by endothelial cells. Because platelets are enucleate and cannot resynthesize cyclooxygenase, irreversible Ser530 acetylation by aspirin in platelets suppresses PGH₂-derived thromboxane for ~10 days while largely preserving recoverable endothelial prostacyclin.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin H₂ 經 prostacyclin synthase 轉為 prostacyclin（PGI₂），為血管擴張與抑制血小板聚集的分子，主要由內皮細胞製造。由於血小板無核且無法重新合成環氧化酶，aspirin 對其 Ser530 的不可逆乙醯化可抑制 PGH₂ 衍生的 thromboxane 約十天，而幾乎保留可恢復的內皮 prostacyclin。

links.context: Prostaglandin H₂ is the common precursor of all terminal prostanoids. Platelets preferentially make Thromboxane A₂ (vasoconstriction, platelet aggregation) while endothelium preferentially makes prostacyclin, and this TXA₂/PGI₂ balance — both drawn from the same PGH₂ pool — is the central determinant of vascular thrombotic tendency.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin H₂ 是所有末端前列腺素類的共同前驅物。血小板偏好製造 Thromboxane A₂（血管收縮、血小板聚集），內皮則偏好製造 prostacyclin；此源自同一 PGH₂ 池的 TXA₂/PGI₂ 平衡是血管血栓傾向的核心決定因素。

links.context: Protein Restriction recapitulates many of the benefits of Caloric Restriction — improved metabolic health and extended lifespan across yeast, flies and rodents — without requiring a reduction in overall energy intake, and is far easier to sustain than calorie restriction itself.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Restriction 在不需減少總能量攝取的情況下，重現 Caloric Restriction 的許多效益——在酵母、果蠅與囓齒類中改善代謝健康並延長壽命——且比熱量限制本身更容易長期維持。

links.context: Protein Restriction robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of its metabolic effects — increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure and extended lifespan. FGF21 acts in part through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue and mediates effects on senescence and inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Restriction 在小鼠、大鼠與人類中穩定提升 FGF21，而 FGF21 是其多數代謝效應所必需——增加攝食、降低體重、增加能量消耗並延長壽命。FGF21 部分透過 UCP1 依賴的白色脂肪組織米色化產熱作用，並中介對衰老與發炎的影響。

links.context: Protein Turnover is the dynamic steady state between protein synthesis and degradation that maintains Proteostasis across the body. Because each peptide bond consumes ATP equivalents, the aggregate rate of whole-body protein turnover is a meaningful component of resting energy metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Turnover 是蛋白合成與分解之間的動態平衡，維持全身的 Proteostasis。由於每個肽鍵都消耗 ATP 當量，全體蛋白周轉的總速率是靜止能量代謝中一個有意義的組成部分。

links.context: Protein citrullination is definitionally arginine deimination to citrulline residues. Substrate identity anchors the modification.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化定義上即精胺酸脫亞胺為瓜氨酸殘基。底物身份錨定修飾。

links.context: Protein kinases and sirtuins both contain an adenosine/ATP-binding site, and this structural overlap allowed known kinase inhibitors to be screened against sirtuins, identifying bisindolylmaleimide and indolinone scaffolds such as Ro31-8220 and GW5074 as SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitors active in the low micromolar range. Sirtuin cross-reactivity is therefore a relevant off-target consideration for kinase inhibitor therapeutics.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 sirtuin 都含有腺苷/ATP 結合位點，這種結構重疊讓研究者得以將已知激酶抑制劑篩選於 sirtuin，進而確認 Ro31-8220 與 GW5074 等雙吲哚基馬來醯亞胺與吲哚啉酮骨架在低微莫耳濃度下即為 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制劑。因此，sirtuin 的交叉反應性是激酶抑制劑治療時須考量到的離靶效應。

links.context: Proteinopathy describes a family of neurodegenerative diseases driven by the misfolding, accumulation and aggregation of specific proteins — Aβ and tau in Alzheimer's disease, α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease, mutant TDP-43 in ALS/FTD, mutant huntingtin in Huntington's disease, and mutant SOD1. Although the offending proteins differ, many proteinopathies generate cytosolic dsDNA that activates cGAS.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteinopathy 描述一族由特定蛋白錯誤摺疊、累積與聚集所驅動的 neurodegenerative disease——Alzheimer’s disease 的 Aβ 與 tau、Parkinson’s disease 的 α-synuclein、ALS/FTD 的突變型 TDP-43、Huntington’s disease 的突變型 huntingtin，以及突變型 SOD1。雖致病蛋白不同，許多 proteinopathy 會產生可活化 cGAS 的細胞質雙股 DNA。

links.context: Proteobacteria is one of the largest and most physiologically diverse phyla of Gram-Negative Bacteria, spanning Alpha-, Beta-, Gamma-, Delta- and Epsilonproteobacteria and including familiar genera such as Escherichia, Salmonella, Pseudomonas, Helicobacter and Campylobacter, plus a substantial fraction of known pathogens.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteobacteria 是 Gram-Negative Bacteria 中最大且生理多樣性最高的菌門之一，涵蓋 Alpha-、Beta-、Gamma-、Delta- 與 Epsilonproteobacteria，並包含 Escherichia、Salmonella、Pseudomonas、Helicobacter、Campylobacter 等常見菌屬，以及相當比例的已知病原體。

links.context: Proteolytic degradation of elastin releases bioactive elastin-derived peptides (elastokines), including the hexapeptide VGVAPG. They bind the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor and upregulate MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12, creating a feed-forward loop — elastin fragmentation, elastokine generation, EBP signalling, MMP upregulation, further elastin degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: 彈性蛋白的蛋白水解降解會釋出具生物活性的彈性蛋白衍生胜肽（elastokines），其中包括六胜肽 VGVAPG。它們結合彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12，形成正向前饋迴路：彈性蛋白碎裂、elastokine 生成、EBP 訊號、MMP 上調、更多彈性蛋白降解。

links.context: Proteostasis is the ensemble of folding chaperones, the ubiquitin–proteasome system, and autophagy/lysosomal degradation that maintains the correct composition, conformation and clearance of cellular proteins. With age proteostatic capacity declines, permitting accumulation of damaged and aggregated proteins that drive age-related disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteostasis 是由摺疊伴護蛋白、ubiquitin–proteasome 系統，以及 autophagy／溶小體降解所組成的集合體，負責維持細胞蛋白質的正確組成、構形與清除。隨年齡增長，蛋白恆定能力下降，使受損與聚集蛋白得以累積並驅動年齡相關疾病。

links.context: Proto-lysosomal tubules are dynamic membrane extensions arising from endolysosomes during lysosome reformation. They represent an intermediate stage in recycling lysosomal membrane and content, ultimately giving rise to new proto-lysosomes that mature into functional lysosomes.
links.context_zh_TW: 原溶酶體小管（proto-lysosomal tubules）是溶酶體再形成期間由內吞溶酶體產生的動態膜延伸。它們是回收溶酶體膜與內容物的中間階段，最終產生成熟為功能性溶酶體的新原溶酶體。

links.context: Protor-1 (PRR5) is a component of mTORC2 that binds mSIN1 and stabilizes the complex, and it interacts with Rictor. Within mTORC2, Protor-1 regulates substrate specificity toward SGK1 and PKC, though its precise physiological function remains to be fully elucidated.
links.context_zh_TW: Protor-1（PRR5）是 mTORC2 的組成成分，會結合 mSIN1 並穩定該複合體，且與 Rictor 互作。在 mTORC2 中，Protor-1 調控其對 SGK1 與 PKC 的受質專一性，但其確切生理功能尚未完全釐清。

links.context: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 signaling is required for autophagic lysosome reformation. Regulation is the lipid-to-scission coupling.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 訊號為自噬性溶酶體重組所需。調節是脂質到分裂的耦合。

links.context: PtdIns3P is generated by Vps34, the sole class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, in two distinct complexes: complex I with Atg14L at the phagophore and complex II with UVRAG at endosomes. Its spatial confinement is enforced by myotubularin phosphatases and by PIKfyve, which converts it to PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns3P 由 Vps34（唯一的第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶）合成，存在於兩種不同複合體中：含 Atg14L 的 complex I 位於 phagophore，含 UUVRAG 的 complex II 位於內體。其空間分布由 myotubularin 磷酸酶以及將其轉為內溶體膜上 PtdIns(3,5)P2 的 PIKfyve 加以限制。

links.context: PtdIns3P is the defining lipid landmark of the autophagy initiation machinery: on the phagophore it serves as a docking platform for PX/FYVE-domain effectors, most notably the WIPI family and Atg18, which recruit downstream ATG proteins required for phagophore expansion and autophagosome growth.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns3P 是自噬起始機器的定義性脂質標記：在 phagophore 上，它作為 PX/FYVE 結構域效應蛋白的停靠平台，尤其是 WIPI 家族與 Atg18，它們會招募 phagophore 擴張與 autophagosome 生長所需的下游 ATG 蛋白。

links.context: PtdIns3P is the defining lipid landmark of the autophagy initiation machinery: on the phagophore it serves as a docking platform for PX/FYVE-domain effectors, notably the WIPI family, which bind and localize Atg16L1 to drive LC3 lipidation and autophagosome expansion.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns3P 是自噬起始機器的定義性脂質標記：在 phagophore 上，它作為 PX/FYVE 結構域效應蛋白（尤其是 WIPI 家族）的停靠平台，這些效應蛋白結合並定位 Atg16L1，以驅動 LC3 脂質化與 autophagosome 擴張。

links.context: Pterostilbene is a calorie-restriction mimetic that directly activates SIRT1 and upstream energy sensors such as AMPK. It recapitulates the molecular signature of nutrient scarcity, enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: 紫檀芪是熱量限制模擬劑，直接活化 SIRT1 與 AMPK 等上游能量感應器。它重現營養稀缺的分子特徵，增強脂肪酸氧化與抗氧化防禦。

links.context: Pterostilbene is a natural stilbenoid polyphenol, structurally the 3,5-dimethoxy analogue of resveratrol. Its improved bioavailability and metabolic stability allow meaningful tissue concentrations at physiological doses, recapitulating resveratrol's calorie-restriction-mimetic effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 紫檀芪（pterostilbene）是天然芪類多酚，結構上是 resveratrol 的 3,5-二甲氧基類似物。其改善的生物可用性與代謝穩定性允許在生理劑量下達到有意義的組織濃度，重現 resveratrol 的熱量限制模擬效應。

links.context: Pulmonary arterial hypertension involves excessive mitochondrial fission mediated by DRP1, contributing to pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation and vascular remodeling. DRP1-mediated fission has been implicated in PAH pathogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 肺動脈高壓涉及由 DRP1 介導的過度粒線體分裂，促成肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖與血管重塑。DRP1 介導的分裂被認為與 PAH 致病機轉有關。

links.context: Pulse oximetry non-invasively estimates oxygen saturation, but methemoglobin (and methylene blue) artifactually lowers the reading. In methemoglobinemia, arterial blood gas with co-oximetry should be used instead to resolve the methemoglobin fraction.
links.context_zh_TW: 脈搏血氧儀非侵入性估算血氧飽和度，但變性血紅素（及 methylene blue）會人為地降低讀數。在變性血紅素血症中，應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry 以解析變性血紅素比例。

links.context: Pulse wave velocity, specifically carotid-femoral PWV, is the gold standard measurement of arterial stiffness, calculated as the distance between two arterial sites divided by pulse transit time; higher PWV indicates stiffer arteries. Other methods include the augmentation index from pulse wave analysis, the ambulatory arterial stiffness index, and ultrasound echo-tracking of arterial distensibility.
links.context_zh_TW: Pulse wave velocity（尤其是 carotid-femoral PWV）是動脈僵硬的金標準測量方式，計算方式為兩動脈部位間距離除以脈搏傳導時間，PWV 越高代表動脈越僵硬。其他方法包括由脈搏波分析得出的 augmentation index、 ambulatory arterial stiffness index，以及以超音波 echo-tracking 測量動脈擴張性。

links.context: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Pyroptosis is a form of regulated (programmed) cell death induced by inflammasomes, distinct from apoptosis. It is characterized by cell swelling and rupturing, leading to the release of proinflammatory cytokines. Pyroptosis is therefore a distinct modality within regulated cell death.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyroptosis 是由發炎小體誘導的一種受調控（程式性）細胞死亡形式，與細胞凋亡不同。其特徵是細胞腫脹與破裂，導致促發炎細胞因子的釋放。因此 Pyroptosis 是受調控細胞死亡中的一種獨特形式。

links.context: Pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ) is a small redox-active compound that acts as a potent promoter of mitochondrial biogenesis and stimulant of mitochondrial function. It modulates cellular redox state and activates PGC-1alpha-associated pathways that increase mitochondrial number.
links.context_zh_TW: 吡咯喹啉醌（PQQ）是小型氧化還原活性化合物，是粒線體生合成的強效促進劑與粒線體功能刺激劑。它調控細胞氧化還原狀態並活化增加粒線體數量的 PGC-1α 相關途徑。

links.context: Pyruvate Kinase M2 catalyzes the final glycolytic step, PEP to pyruvate.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyruvate Kinase M2 催化最後糖解步驟，PEP 至 Pyruvate。

links.context: Q-VD-OPh is a cell-permeant, irreversible pan-caspase inhibitor used to test caspase dependence in vivo. By blocking caspase-3 and caspase-8 it blocks the caspase-dependent apoptosis program, and in murine ischemia models it protects females only - consistent with the XX preference for caspase-dependent apoptosis over the caspase-independent parthanatos program. It also rescues PARP-1-deficient female cells shunted into cytochrome-c/caspase death.
links.context_zh_TW: Q-VD-OPh 是一種可穿透細胞、不可逆的泛 caspase 抑制劑，用於在體內檢驗 caspase 依賴性。藉由阻斷 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-8，它阻斷 caspase 依賴性的 Apoptosis 程式；在小鼠缺血模型中它僅保護雌性，與 XX 染色體較偏好 caspase 依賴性 Apoptosis 而非 caspase 非依賴性 parthanatos 的現象一致。它也能挽救被轉入細胞色素 c／caspase 死亡途徑的 PARP-1 缺失雌性細胞。

links.context: QPRT operates at the terminal step of the kynurenine pathway, converting the intermediate quinolinic acid into NaMN, after which NMNAT converts NaMN to NaAD and then NAD+. Tryptophan is degraded through N-formylkynurenine and kynurenine to 3-hydroxykynurenine and quinolinic acid, so QPRT is what links tryptophan catabolism to NAD+ supply. NMNAT also channels NaMN generated from niacin in the Preiss-Handler route.
links.context_zh_TW: QPRT 作用於 kynurenine pathway 的末端步驟，將中間產物 quinolinic acid 轉為 NaMN，之後由 NMNAT 將 NaMN 轉為 NaAD 再轉為 NAD+。Tryptophan 經 N-formylkynurenine、kynurenine、3-hydroxykynurenine 分解至 quinolinic acid，因此 QPRT 正是把色胺酸分解與 NAD+ 供應連結起來的酵素。NMNAT 同時也處理由 niacin 經 Preiss-Handler 途徑產生的 NaMN。

links.context: QueE-like enzymes are radical S-adenosylmethionine proteins discovered by metagenomic screening that cleave glucosepane, the exceptionally stable lysine-arginine imidazolium AGE crosslink; they can grow on synthetic glucosepane as sole nutrient and degrade it in vitro.
links.context_zh_TW: QueE-like 酵素是經由 metagenomic 篩選發現的 radical S-adenosylmethionine 蛋白，可切割 [[Glucosepane]]——一種極穩定的離胺酸-精胺酸 imidazolium AGE 交聯；它們能以合成 glucosepane 為唯一營養源生長，並在體外降解之。

links.context: Queen Palm (Syagrus romanzoffiana, jeriva) fruit carries beta-carotene and alpha-carotene as the dominant pigments of the orange pericarp, both provitamin A species that quench Singlet Oxygen, plus lutein and zeaxanthin as membrane-integrated photoprotectants. Pulp oil extracts reach about 1,200 ug/g total carotenoids, a load comparable to jelly palm and acai and below Tier-1 record-holders such as buriti at 5-10 times the carotenoid load. The combination of carotenoids and a lipid vehicle in one fruit is what makes it a useful food-source test case for structural protection against Lipid Peroxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: Queen Palm（Syagrus romanzoffiana，jerivá）果實以 beta-carotene 與 alpha-carotene 為橙色果皮中的主要色素，兩者皆為 provitamin A 物種且能 quench Singlet Oxygen，並含 lutein 與 zeaxanthin 作為整合於膜的光保護物。果肉油萃取物可達約 1,200 ug/g 的總類胡蘿蔔素，其量級與 jelly palm、acai 相當，則低於 Tier-1 紀錄保持者 buriti（其類胡蘿蔔素量為 5-10 倍）。同一果實中同時具備類胡蘿蔔素與脂質載體，使其成為結構性防禦 Lipid Peroxidation 的食物來源測試案例。

links.context: Queen Palm mature fruit yields about 590-1,100 mg GAE/100 g of extractable polyphenols, dominated by hydroxycinnamic acids (ferulic and caffeic conjugates) and flavonols including Quercetin and Kaempferol glycosides, with high DPPH, ABTS and ORAC radical-scavenging activity. Vitamin C is low, so the fruit's antioxidant capacity runs through polyphenols and carotenoids rather than ascorbate. This makes it a clean example of the non-enzymatic, lipophilic dietary arm of antioxidant defence, sitting in the same radical-trapping paradigm that positions GPX4 and vitamin E as terminal defences against iron-driven lipid peroxide accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: Queen Palm 成熟果實可萃出約 590-1,100 mg GAE/100 g 的多酚，以 hydroxycinnamic acids（ferulic 與 caffeic 結合型）及包括 Quercetin 與 Kaempferol 配糖體在內的 flavonols 為主，並具高 DPPH、ABTS 與 ORAC 自由基清除活性。Vitamin C 含量低，因此該果實的抗氧能力主要來自多酚與類胡蘿蔔素而非 ascorbate。這使它成為抗氧防禦中非酵素性、親脂性膳食分支的清楚範例，與將 GPX4 與 vitamin E 定位為對抗鐵驅動脂質過氧化物累積之終端防禦的同一自由基捕捉範式相符。

links.context: Queen Palm pulp oil carries more than 320 mg/kg of alpha-tocopherol, making the fruit a concentrated natural tocopherol carrier that is synergistic with its carotenoids. The Vitamin E pool rides on the same triglycerides that feed membrane pools: pulp oil is unsaturated (oleic C18:1, linoleic C18:2) while kernel oil is medium-chain saturated (lauric C12:0 at 30-40%). Because tocopherols terminate LOO. chains within bilayers, the co-occurrence of tocopherol, carotenoid and lipid vehicle in the same tissue is the feature that matters for peroxidation defense.
links.context_zh_TW: Queen Palm 果肉油含有超過 320 mg/kg 的 alpha-tocopherol，使該果實成為與其類胡蘿蔔素協同作用的濃縮天然 tocopherol 載體。Vitamin E 儲備與供應膜池的同一批三酸甘油酯同行：果肉油為不飽和（oleic C18:1、linoleic C18:2），核油則為中鏈飽和（lauric C12:0 佔 30-40%）。由於 tocopherols 能在雙層膜內終止 LOO. 鏈，tocopherol、類胡蘿蔔素與脂質載體在同一組織中共存，才是過氧化防禦上真正要點。

links.context: Quercetin is a flavonoid classified as a senolytic that inhibits BCL-2 family anti-apoptotic proteins and PI3K/Akt signaling, and is a core component of the D+Q combination with dasatinib. It shows broad senolytic activity and synergizes with dasatinib, and its additional antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties complement its clearance action. The classification is supported by the foundational Zhu et al. (2015) study and subsequent clinical pilots. Quercetin exemplifies a naturally occurring compound with a validated senolytic role.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是一種歸類為 senolytic 的類黃酮，抑制 BCL-2 家族抗凋亡蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 訊號，並是與 dasatinib 的 D+Q 組合核心成分。它展現廣泛 senolytic 活性並與 dasatinib 協同，且其額外抗氧化與抗發炎特性補充其清除作用。此分類獲基礎 Zhu 等人（2015）研究及後續臨床試驗支持。Quercetin 例示具有已驗證 senolytic 角色的天然存在化合物。

links.context: Quercetin is a member of the flavonoid fraction of Propolis alongside Chrysin, Galangin, Pinocembrin and Apigenin. Flavonoids are the major bioactive class in propolis, and quercetin in particular is independently studied as a Senolytic.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 與 Chrysin、Galangin、Pinocembrin 及 Apigenin 同屬 Propolis 的黃酮類成分。Flavonoids 是蜂膠中主要的活性化合物類別，而 quercetin 本身也被獨立研究為 Senolytic。

links.context: Quercetin is a plant flavonoid found in many fruits, vegetables and grains, commonly used as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant supplement. It is also one of the natural polyphenol STACs discussed in sirtuin biology, where it is used to augment resveratrol activity in red wine.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是存在於多種水果、蔬菜與穀物中的植物性 Flavonoid，常作為抗發炎與抗氧化補充劑使用。它也是 sirtuin 生物學中常提及的天然多酚 STAC 之一，在紅酒中被用來增強 resveratrol 的活性。

links.context: Quercetin is the best-studied flavonol and the comparator arm of the dasatinib plus quercetin (D+Q) senolytic combination, used alongside fisetin in flavonoid senolytic panels.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是研究最深入的 flavonol，也是 dasatinib 加 quercetin（D+Q）senolytic 組合中的對照臂，並在 flavonoid senolytic 篩選中與 fisetin 並列。

links.context: Quercetin's catechol structure means it is metabolized by the COMT enzyme, and because it competes for the same enzyme, high doses of quercetin act as a COMT inhibitor. This slows the breakdown of neurotransmitters such as dopamine and norepinephrine, and it may enhance the bioavailability of EGCG by inhibiting COMT. Individuals with slow COMT variants may experience irritability or anxiety at high doses because COMT activity is reduced further.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 的兒茶酚結構使其由 COMT 酵素代謝；由於它競爭同一酵素，高劑量的 quercetin 會作為 COMT 抑制劑作用。這會減慢 dopamine 與 norepinephrine 等神經傳遞物質的分解，並可能藉由抑制 COMT 提升 EGCG 的生體可用性。帶有慢型 COMT 變異的人族群在高劑量下可能出現易怒或焦慮，因 COMT 活性被進一步降低。

links.context: Quiescence is the default homeostatic state of the muscle stem pool. Maintenance preserves long-term regenerative capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 靜止是肌肉幹細胞池預設的恆定狀態。維持保存長期再生能力。

links.context: Quinolinic acid is a biosynthetic precursor of NAD+: it is converted to nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) by QPRT, entering the Preiss-Handler pathway for NAD+ synthesis. This makes QA the metabolic node where kynurenine catabolism feeds de novo NAD+ production, opposite to its excitotoxic role as an NMDA agonist.
links.context_zh_TW: Quinolinic acid 是 NAD+ 的生合成前驅物：它由 QPRT 轉為 nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN)，進入 Preiss-Handler 途徑進行 NAD+ 合成。這使 QA 成為 kynurenine 分解供應從頭 NAD+ 生成的中樞節點，與其作為 NMDA 致效劑的興奮毒性角色相對。

links.context: Quinolinic acid is an endogenous NMDA receptor agonist with roughly 100-fold greater potency than glutamate. It promotes calcium influx, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis in neurons, so accumulation of QA is excitotoxic; its neuroprotective counterbalance is kynurenic acid.
links.context_zh_TW: Quinolinic acid 是內生性 NMDA receptor 致效劑，效力約為 glutamate 的 100 倍。它促進鈣離子流入、氧化壓力、粒線體功能失調與神經元凋亡，因此 QA 累積具有興奮毒性；其神經保護性的對抗角色則由 kynurenic acid 扮演。

links.context: Quinolinic acid is the direct substrate of QPRT, which converts it to nicotinic acid mononucleotide using phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate. QPRT activity therefore depends on quinolinic acid supply from the kynurenine pathway; inflammatory signalling upregulates IDO and increases quinolinic acid production, linking immune activation to de novo NAD+ flux and, when unchecked, to neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Quinolinic acid 是 QPRT 的直接受質，QPRT 以磷醯核糖焦磷酸將其轉為 nicotinic acid mononucleotide。因此 QPRT 活性取決於 kynurenine pathway 供應的 quinolinic acid；發炎訊號會上调 IDO 並增加 quinolinic acid 生成，將免疫活化與從頭 NAD+ 流量連結，若未受控制也與神經退化連結。

links.context: Quinones are organic compounds with a conjugated cyclic dione structure. The formation of a quinone moiety is the first step in the oxidation of catecholamines to aminochromes, where catechol hydroxyls are oxidized to carbonyl groups.
links.context_zh_TW: 醌（quinone）是具有共軛環狀二酮結構的有機化合物。醌部分的形成是兒茶酚胺氧化為 aminochrome 的第一步，其中兒茶酚羥基被氧化為羰基。

links.context: RAD51 is loaded onto resected DNA ends by BRCA2, with BRCA1 acting upstream in the homologous recombination pathway and RAD51 paralogs (RAD51B/C/D, XMCC3) acting as accessory factors. This loading step is the gateway to RAD51 filament formation and therefore to error-free double-strand break repair.
links.context_zh_TW: RAD51 由 BRCA2 載送到切除處理的 DNA 末端，BRCA1 則在同源重組途徑中位於其上游，而 RAD51 paralogs (RAD51B/C/D、XMCC3) 作為輔助因子作用。這個載送步驟是 RAD51 絲狀體形成的入口，進而決定無誤差的雙股斷裂修復。

links.context: RAD51 overexpression in cancer contributes to chemoresistance to DNA-damaging agents. RAD51-mediated repair of cisplatin adducts confers resistance to platinum-based drugs, and HR proficiency signalled by RAD51 confers resistance to PARP inhibitors. RAD51 inhibition is therefore explored as a strategy to sensitize HR-proficient cancers to DNA-damaging chemotherapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 癌症中的 RAD51 过表达會促成對 DNA 損傷性藥物的化學抗藥性。RAD51 介導對 cisplatin 加成物的修復賦予對鉑類藥物的抗藥性，而由 RAD51 訊號代表的同源重組能力則賦予對 PARP inhibitors 的抗藥性。因此 RAD51 抑制被研究作為使同源重組能力完整的癌症對 DNA 損傷性化療更敏感的策略。

links.context: RAF kinases phosphorylate MEK1/2 once recruited to the membrane by RAS-GTP, and MEK in turn activates ERK1/2. RAF/MEK is also the axis behind RAS-RAF-MEK-dependent oxidative cell death described by Yagoda et al. involving VDAC, the iron-dependent death that preceded the formal naming of ferroptosis, and Raf/MEK is a ferroptosis-modulating route in hepatocellular carcinoma.
links.context_zh_TW: RAF 激酶在被 RAS-GTP 招募至膜上後磷酸化 MEK1/2，MEK 再活化 ERK1/2。RAF/MEK 也是 Yagoda 等人所描述的 RAS-RAF-MEK 依賴性氧化細胞死亡（涉及 VDAC）的軸線，那種鐵依賴性死亡早於 ferroptosis 的正式命名；而在肝細胞癌中，Raf/MEK 是調節 ferroptosis 的路徑。

links.context: RAGE binds HMGB1 (amphoterin), as well as members of the S100 protein family, amyloid beta oligomers, and other ligands, making it a multi-ligand pattern-recognition receptor. This broad ligand repertoire positions RAGE as a sensor for damage-associated molecular patterns in sterile inflammation. Each ligand class activates overlapping but distinct downstream signaling profiles.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 結合 HMGB1（amphoterin），以及 S100 protein family 成員、amyloid beta 寡聚體和其他配體，使其成為多配體模式識別受體。這種廣泛的配體庫使 RAGE 成為無菌性發炎中損傷相關分子模式的感測器。每一類配體都活化重疊但截然不同的下游訊號輪廓。

links.context: RAGE is the receptor for advanced glycation end products that regulates cell processes including inflammation, apoptosis, ROS signaling, proliferation, autophagy, and aging. Activation of RAGE by AGEs leads to ROS generation and downstream inflammatory signaling, providing a receptor-mediated route by which glycated proteins damage cells. This ROS generation contributes to oxidative stress in diabetes, renal failure, and aging. The AGE-RAGE axis is therefore a key molecular link between glycation and oxidative damage, and blocking RAGE signaling is a potential therapeutic strategy against AGE-mediated pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 是 advanced glycation end products 的 receptor，調節包括 inflammation、apoptosis、ROS signaling、proliferation、autophagy 與 aging 在內的 cell processes。AGEs 活化 RAGE 會導致 ROS generation 與 downstream inflammatory signaling，提供一條 receptor-mediated route，使 glycated proteins 損傷細胞。此 ROS generation 促成 diabetes、renal failure 與 aging 中的 oxidative stress。因此，AGE-RAGE axis 是 glycation 與 oxidative damage 之間的關鍵分子連結，而 blocking RAGE signaling 是對抗 AGE-mediated pathology 的潛在治療策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: RAGE, the receptor for advanced glycation end products, transmits the signal from AGE binding by activating mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) and phosphatidylinositol-3 kinase (PI3K) pathways, ultimately leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB. Once activated, NF-kB translocates to the nucleus and drives transcription of genes for cytokines, growth factors, and adhesion molecules, including tumor necrosis factor alpha, interleukin 6, and VCAM1, which are potent promoters of inflammation. RAGE activation thereby converts persistent glycation stress into sustained inflammatory gene expression in vascular and other tissues, a key step in AGE-driven pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE（receptor for advanced glycation end products）透過activating mitogen-activated protein kinase（MAPK）與phosphatidylinositol-3 kinase（PI3K）pathways，transmits the signal from AGE binding，ultimately leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB。Once activated，NF-kB translocates to the nucleus並drives transcription of genes for cytokines、growth factors與adhesion molecules，包括tumor necrosis factor alpha、interleukin 6與VCAM1，它們都是potent promoters of inflammation。RAGE activation thereby converts persistent glycation stress into sustained inflammatory gene expression in vascular與other tissues，是AGE-driven pathology中的key step。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is the cell-surface receptor whose ligand is RANKL. Ligand engagement of RANK recruits NF-kB and MAPK signalling machinery, driving osteoclast differentiation from monocyte/macrophage precursors and, downstream, MAPK-dependent phosphorylation and activation of TFE3 (Hershey & Fisher 2004).
links.context_zh_TW: RANK (TNFRSF11A) 是細胞表面受體，其配體為 RANKL。RANKL 結合 RANK 後招募 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊息傳遞機制，驅動單核／巨噬細胞前驅細胞分化為 Osteoclast，並在下游經由 MAPK 依賴性的磷酸化活化 TFE3（Hershey & Fisher 2004）。

links.context: RANK signalling drives osteoclast differentiation via NF-kB and MAPK, with downstream TFE3 activation. Because TFE3 activation downstream of M-CSF and RANK requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation, RANK is a mechanistic link between growth-factor signalling and the lysosomal-biogenesis/adaptation program in osteoclasts.
links.context_zh_TW: RANK 訊息傳遞經由 NF-κB 與 MAPK 驅動 Osteoclast 分化，並在下游活化 TFE3。由於 M-CSF 與 RANK 下游的 TFE3 活化需要 MAPK 依賴性的 TFE3 磷酸化，RANK 因而成為生長因子訊息與 osteoclast 中溶小體生成／調適程式之間的機制性連結。

links.context: RANKL (TNFSF11) is the ligand for RANK, and RANKL-RANK engagement is the defining interaction that initiates osteoclastogenesis. RANKL is a TNF-family cytokine expressed by osteoblasts, osteocytes and immune cells; altered RANKL expression is associated with cancer and with bone loss conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: RANKL (TNFSF11) 是 RANK 的配體，而 RANKL–RANK 的結合是啟動 osteoclast 生成的基本交互作用。RANKL 是由成骨細胞、骨細胞與免疫細胞表現的 TNF 家族細胞激素；RANKL 表現異常與癌症及骨流失疾病相關。

links.context: RANKL drives osteoclast differentiation via NF-kB signalling once it engages its receptor RANK. RANKL is therefore both a developmental and therapeutic target, and it serves as a biomarker in multiple clinical contexts involving excessive bone resorption.
links.context_zh_TW: RANKL 一旦結合其受體 RANK，便經由 NF-κB 訊息傳遞驅動 Osteoclast 分化。因此 RANKL 同時是發育與治療標的，也是骨吸收過多相關臨床情境中的生物標記。

links.context: RAS is the upstream activator that relieves BRAF inhibition and engages the RAF-MEK-ERK cascade; BRAF inhibitors such as Vemurafenib and Dabrafenib are approved for BRAF-mutant melanoma and are combined with MEK inhibitors to improve response and reduce resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: RAS 是上游活化因子，可解除對 BRAF 的抑制並啟動 RAF-MEK-ERK 串聯；如 Vemurafenib 與 Dabrafenib 等 BRAF 抑制劑已獲准用於 BRAF 突變型 Melanoma，並常與 MEK 抑制劑合併以提升反應率並降低抗藥性。

links.context: RAW264.7 is an immortalized mouse macrophage cell line derived from an ascitic tumor induced by Abelson murine leukemia virus in a male BALB/c mouse, established in 1978. It carries v-Abl transformant sequences and retains many primary macrophage functions, including Fc receptor-mediated phagocytosis, cytokine secretion and nitric oxide production upon LPS/IFN-gamma stimulation, and can be polarized toward M1 or M2 phenotypes.
links.context_zh_TW: RAW264.7 是源自雄性 BALB/c 小鼠中 Abelson 鼠白血病病毒誘發的腹水腫瘤之永生化小鼠巨噬細胞株，建立於 1978 年。它帶有 v-Abl 轉位序列，並保留許多原代巨噬細胞功能，包括 Fc 受體媒介的吞噬作用、細胞激素分泌，以及在 LPS／IFN-γ 刺激下的一氧化氮生成，且可被極化為 M1 或 M2 表型。

links.context: RCC is treated with VEGF-pathway inhibitors (e.g., sunitinib) and mTOR inhibitors; chemotherapy is largely ineffective.
links.context_zh_TW: RCC 使用 VEGF 途徑抑制劑（例如 sunitinib）和 mTOR 抑制劑治療；化療基本上無效。

links.context: RGD peptide inhibits Angiogenesis when mimetics competitively block integrin engagement: alpha-v-beta-3 and alpha-v-beta-5 are markedly upregulated on tumor vasculature, and blocking their adhesion disrupts focal adhesions, reduces neovascularization and reduces Metastasis in preclinical models. Cilengitide carried this concept into glioblastoma trials.
links.context_zh_TW: 當模擬物以競爭性方式阻斷 integrin 結合時，RGD peptide 會抑制 Angiogenesis：αvβ3 與 αvβ5 在腫瘤血管上顯著上調，封鎖其黏附可破壞焦點黏著、減少新生血管形成並在臨床前模型中降低 Metastasis。Cilengitide 已將此概念帶入 glioblastoma 臨床試驗。

links.context: RHEB-1 is the C. elegans orthologue of the small GTPase Rheb and a key activator of mTOR (CeTOR) in response to nutrient signals. RHEB-1 activates Autophagy under dietary restriction and regulates dauer formation, and is required for the lifespan extension seen in certain intermittent fasting models.
links.context_zh_TW: RHEB-1 是小 GTP 酶 Rheb 在 C. elegans 中的同源物，也是營養訊號下 mTOR（CeTOR）的關鍵活化因子。RHEB-1 在飲食限制下活化 Autophagy 並調控 dauer 形成，且為某些間歇性禁食模型中壽命延展所必需。

links.context: RHIM signaling from RIPK1 to RIPK3 to MLKL drives lytic death when caspase-8 is compromised. Promotion is the necrosome relay.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK1 經 RHIM 到 RIPK3 到 MLKL 在 caspase-8 受損時驅動裂解死亡。促進是 necrosome 接力。

links.context: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.
links.context_zh_TW: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.

links.context: RHIM-mediated partnership activates RIPK3 to phosphorylate MLKL. Activation is the kinase relay.
links.context_zh_TW: RHIM 介導的夥伴關係活化 RIPK3 以磷酸化 MLKL。活化是激酶接力。

links.context: RIG-I is a member of the RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) subset of pattern recognition receptors and, alongside cGAS, is one of the principal cytosolic nucleic-acid sensors - RIG-I sensing RNA, cGAS sensing DNA. Its expression is itself interferon-inducible, which gives the receptor its 'retinoic acid-inducible' name and its place in positive-feedback antiviral amplification.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I 屬於模式辨識受體中的 RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) 子集合，與 cGAS 同為主要的細胞質核酸感測器：RIG-I 感測 RNA，cGAS 感測 DNA。其表現本身受干擾素誘導，這賦予該受體「retinoic acid-inducible」之名，也使其位於抗病毒正向放大反饋之中。

links.context: RIG-I is an RNA-sensing input to senescence-associated inflammation: cytosolic RNA species in senescent and damaged cells engage RIG-I to drive interferon and cytokine output feeding the secretome. Sources of such RNA include retroelement-derived transcripts de-repressed during senescence and deep senescence, and mitochondrial double-stranded RNA released when mitochondrial dynamics or autophagy are perturbed. In the Birch and Gil scheme RIG-I sits on the RNA-sensing arm of SASP induction, parallel to the cGAS-STING DNA-sensing arm and the inflammasome.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I 是衰老相關發炎的 RNA 感測輸入：衰老與受損細胞中的細胞質 RNA 結合 RIG-I，驅動干擾素與細胞激素輸出以餵給分泌體。此類 RNA 來源包括衰老與深層衰老期間去抑制的轉位元件衍生轉錄本，以及粒線體動態或自噬受擾時釋出的粒線體雙股 RNA。在 Birch 與 Gil 的架構中，RIG-I 位於 SASP 誘導的 RNA 感測支臂，與 cGAS–STING 的 DNA 感測支臂及 inflammasome 平行。

links.context: RIG-I, together with MDA5, is a cytosolic pattern recognition receptor that detects PAMP in the form of viral RNA, contributing to type I interferon induction; by contrast, cGAS senses cytosolic DNA of microbial origin.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I 與 MDA5 一起作為胞質內的模式辨識受體，偵測以病毒 RNA 形式存在的 PAMP，參與第一型干擾素的誘導；相對地，cGAS 則偵測微生物來源的胞質 DNA。

links.context: RIPK1 directly phosphorylates MLKL under specific conditions, particularly in mouse inflammation models.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK1在特定條件下（特別是小鼠細胞）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎模型。

links.context: RIPK3 phosphorylates and activates CaMKII, triggering necroptosis or neuroprotection in cardiac and neurological injury.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3磷酸化並活化CaMKII，觸發necroptosis或抑制興奮性毒性以發揮神經保護作用，見於心肌缺血再灌注損傷、心衰竭與神經損傷。

links.context: RIPK3, together with RIPK1, FADD, and Caspase-8, forms the shared death-receptor core of the PANoptosome. RIPK3 phosphorylation of MLKL is the necroptotic execution arm, while the same RIPK3-centered platform is what allows necroptosis, apoptosis, and pyroptosis to be co-activated in a single cell.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 與 RIPK1、FADD、Caspase-8 共同構成 PANoptosome 的共享死亡受體核心。RIPK3 對 MLKL 的磷酸化是壞死凋亡執行臂，而正是這個以 RIPK3 為中心的平台，使同一細胞中的壞死凋亡、凋亡與發炎性裂解凋亡得以共同活化。

links.context: RIPK3-deficient mice are protected from ischemia-reperfusion injury across models and Nec-1 adds nothing on top of the deficiency; glomerular endothelial cells (unlike tubular cells, mesangial cells, or podocytes) express the highest RIPK3, correlating with necroptosis propensity.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 缺失小鼠在多個缺血–再灌注模型中受保護，且在此基礎上 Nec-1 不再增加效果；腎小球內皮細胞（與腎小管細胞、系膜細胞或足細胞不同）表現最高之 RIPK3，與 necroptosis 傾向相關。

links.context: RNA interference is a conserved post-transcriptional gene-silencing pathway in which double-stranded RNA is processed into siRNAs or microRNAs that guide RISC to repress complementary target mRNAs. MicroRNAs are a key effector class of this pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA 干擾是保守的轉錄後基因靜默途徑，雙股 RNA 被加工為 siRNA 或 microRNA，引導 RISC 抑制互補的目標 mRNA。MicroRNA 是此途徑的關鍵效應類別。

links.context: RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) are recurrently enriched among the interaction partners of cGAS. Nuclear cGAS scaffolds RBPs via its intrinsically disordered region, leveraging phase separation to maintain nuclear homeostasis; G3BP1, a core stress granule component, binds the cGAS IDR and primes cGAS for DNA binding, while PQBP1 acts as an adaptor linking monomeric tau to cGAS activation. This positions cGAS as a conformational hub organizing RNA-processing proteins in phase-separated nuclear assemblies.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA-binding proteins (RBP) 反覆出現在 cGAS 的交互作用夥伴之中。細胞核內的 cGAS 透過其內在無序區 (IDR) 支架化 RBP，利用相分離以維持核內恆定；壓力顆粒核心成分 G3BP1 結合 cGAS 的 IDR 並使 cGAS 預備好結合 DNA，而 PQBP1 則作為轉接因子將單體 tau 與 cGAS 活化連結起來。這使 cGAS 成為在相分離的核內組裝體中組織 RNA 處理蛋白的構形樞紐。

links.context: RNA-seq detects alternative splicing because splice junctions in the reads reveal isoform usage across a sample, and long-read protocols (Iso-Seq) extend this to full-length isoform detection. The same library data also identify novel transcripts and RNA editing events, which is why RNA-seq is the primary tool of transcriptomics.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA-seq 能偵測 alternative splicing，因為讀段中的剪接接合點可揭示樣本中的 isoform 使用情況，而長讀段 (Iso-Seq) 方案更可延伸到全长 isoform 的偵測。相同的文庫資料也能鑑定新穎轉錄本與 RNA editing 事件，因此 RNA-seq 是 transcriptomics 的主要工具。

links.context: RNA-seq libraries are built by reverse transcription of RNA into complementary DNA (cDNA) before adapter ligation and PCR amplification. cDNA synthesis is therefore the required intermediate that converts RNA abundance into a sequenceable, amplifiable library for high-throughput sequencing.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA-seq 文庫是先把 RNA 逆轉錄為互補 DNA (cDNA)，再進行接頭連接與 PCR 擴增而建立。因此 cDNA 合成是必要的中間步驟，將 RNA 豐度轉為可定序、可擴增的文庫，以供高通量定序。

links.context: RNF185 is a mitochondrial ubiquitin E3 ligase that forms part of the non-Parkin E3 ligase network providing backup mitophagy capacity. Together with parallel ligases such as MUL1 and Ambra-1/HUWE1, it maintains mitochondrial quality control when the primary PINK1/Parkin pathway is impaired, so cells can still clear damaged mitochondria when the canonical pathway is compromised.
links.context_zh_TW: RNF185 是粒線體泛素 E3 連接酶，屬於提供備援 mitophagy 能力的非 Parkin E3 連接酶網路。它與 MUL1 及 Ambra-1/HUWE1 等平行連接酶一起，在主要 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時維持粒線體品質管制，使細胞在典型途徑失效時仍能清除受損粒線體。

links.context: RNF185 ubiquitinates its substrate BNIP1 with K63-linked ubiquitin chains, and these chains serve as the recognition signal for p62/SQSTM1. p62 then recruits the autophagy machinery to clear the targeted mitochondria, so RNF185's E3 activity is what couples substrate ubiquitination to autophagosome delivery in this non-Parkin mitophagy route.
links.context_zh_TW: RNF185 以 K63 連結的泛素鏈泛素化其受質 BNIP1，而這些鏈就是 p62/SQSTM1 的辨識訊號。p62 隨後招募自噬機制以清除被標記的粒線體，因此 RNF185 的 E3 活性正是把受質泛素化與自噬體運送連結起來的關鍵，構成這條非 Parkin mitophagy 路徑。

links.context: ROS promote necroptosis by inducing RIPK1 autophosphorylation in septic cardiomyopathy and viral myocarditis.
links.context_zh_TW: ROS透過誘導RIPK1自身磷酸化來促進necroptosis，見於敗血性心肌病變與病毒性心肌炎。

links.context: RPA-coated single-stranded DNA at stalled forks activates the ATR-CHK1 checkpoint. This is the canonical replication-stress sensor.
links.context_zh_TW: 停滯叉上 RPA 包被的單股 DNA 活化 ATR-CHK1 檢查點。這是典型的複製壓力感受器。

links.context: RRM1 is overexpressed in many solid tumors, including non-small-cell lung, pancreatic, and bladder cancers. High RRM1 is associated with reduced gemcitabine benefit and poor prognosis, and RRM1 levels are evaluated as a predictive biomarker.
links.context_zh_TW: RRM1 在許多實體腫瘤（包括非小細胞肺癌、胰臟癌與膀胱癌）中被過度表現。高 RRM1 與 Gemcitabine 療效降低及不良預後相關，RRM1 濃度被評估為預測性生物標記。

links.context: RRM2 expression is transcriptionally gated to S phase by the E2F transcription factor, and the protein is degraded when cells exit S phase or enter quiescence. This makes RRM2 the cell-cycle-controlled switch for de novo dNTP synthesis and a direct index of proliferation.
links.context_zh_TW: RRM2 的表現由 E2F 轉錄因子在轉錄層面局限於 S 期，當細胞離開 S 期或進入靜止期時蛋白質會被降解。這使 RRM2 成為 de novo dNTP 合成的細胞週期控制開關，以及增殖的直接指標。

links.context: RSK3 acts upstream of RIPK3 phosphorylation, promoting necroptosis in ischemic retinal injury.
links.context_zh_TW: RSK3作為RIPK3磷酸化的上游調控因子，促進necroptosis活化，見於缺血性視網膜損傷。

links.context: RSL3 (with ML162 and FINO2) covalently modifies GPX4's catalytic selenocysteine, directly inhibiting the enzyme and thereby bypassing the glutathione supply route used by erastin. GPX4 can also be inactivated by peroxynitrite-mediated tyrosine nitration.
links.context_zh_TW: RSL3（與 ML162、FINO2 一起）以共價方式修飾 GPX4 的催化性硒半胱胺酸，直接抑制該酵素，因而繞過 erastin 所採用的 glutathione 供應途徑。GPX4 亦可因 peroxynitrite 介導的酪胺酸硝化而失活。

links.context: RSL3 is a GPX4 inhibitor whose ferroptotic effect J147 antagonizes; co-treatment with J147 rescued RSL3-killed senescent cells, confirming that the elevated lipid peroxidation of senescent cells is genuinely ferroptotic.
links.context_zh_TW: RSL3 是 GPX4 抑制劑，其造成 ferroptosis 的作用被 J147 拮抗；J147 共同處理可救回被 RSL3 殺死的衰老細胞，確認衰老細胞升高的脂質過氧化確實屬於 ferroptosis。

links.context: RTAs protect against ferroptosis by preventing peroxidation chains from propagating to lethal levels. Endogenous RTAs include ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), vitamin K hydroquinone and vitamin E, while synthetic RTAs such as ferrostatin-1 and liproxstatin-1 rescue cells from ferroptosis and are used as experimental inhibitors. The FSP1-CoQ10-NAD(P)H axis works precisely by maintaining ubiquinol as a membrane RTA; loss of the RTA, for example via mevalonate-pathway depletion of ubiquinone, removes this protection.
links.context_zh_TW: RTA 藉由防止過氧化鏈傳播到致死程度來保護對抗 ferroptosis。內源性 RTA 包括 ubiquinol (CoQ10H2)、vitamin K hydroquinone 與 vitamin E；合成 RTA 如 ferrostatin-1 與 liproxstatin-1 則可挽救細胞免於 ferroptosis，並作為實驗性抑制劑使用。FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸正是藉由維持 ubiquinol 作為膜上 RTA 發揮作用；RTA 喪失（例如經甲羥戊酸途徑耗竭 ubiquinone）就會撤除這種保護。

links.context: Rab5 promotes homotypic early endosome fusion and recruits the class III PI3K Vps34 to generate PtdIns3P on endosomal membranes, a lipid also essential for phagophore formation. In its GTP-bound state Rab5 engages EEA1, the HOPS tethering complex and motor adaptors; Rabex-5 activates it while RabGAPs such as TBC1D2 inactivate it.
links.context_zh_TW: Rab5 促進早期內體的同型融合，並招募第三類 PI3K Vps34 在內體膜上產生 PtdIns3P，而此脂質對 phagophore 形成同樣必需。在 GTP 結合狀態下，Rab5 與 EEA1、HOPS 拴繫複合體及馬達銜接蛋白作用；Rabex-5 活化它，而如 TBC1D2 的 RabGAP 使其失活。

links.context: Rab8 is required for retrograde transport of mitochondria-containing autophagosomes along microtubules to the cell body. Delivering autophagosomes to lysosomes is the terminal step of mitophagic flux, so Rab8-mediated transport connects the autophagosome pool to lysosomal degradation of damaged mitochondria.
links.context_zh_TW: Rab8 是含粒線體自噬體沿微管向細胞體逆行運輸所必需的。將自噬體運送至溶小體是 mitophagic flux 的末端步驟，因此 Rab8 媒介的運輸把自噬體池與受損粒線體的溶小體降解連結起來。

links.context: Rad53p is a required mediator of mitohormetic longevity in yeast. Mild mitochondrial dysfunction (deletion of clk-1 or cco-1) elevates mitochondrial ROS, activating Tel1p/Rad53p and driving reduced H3K4me3 and increased H4K16ac; deletion of RAD53 or TEL1 abolishes both these epigenetic changes and the resulting lifespan extension.
links.context_zh_TW: Rad53p 是酵母菌中線粒體 hormesis 性延壽的必要媒介。輕度粒線體功能障礙（clk-1 或 cco-1 缺失）升高粒線體活性氧，啟動 Tel1p/Rad53p 並造成 H3K4me3 下降與 H4K16ac 上升；刪除 RAD53 或 TEL1 會同時消除這些表觀遺傳變化與隨後的壽命延長。

links.context: Rad53p is a serine/threonine protein kinase of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and the functional homolog of human CHK2. It is the central checkpoint kinase of the DNA damage response, coordinating cell cycle arrest, transcriptional induction of repair genes, and replication fork stabilization upon genotoxic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Rad53p 是 *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* 的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，為人類 CHK2 的功能性同源物。它是 DNA 損傷反應的中樞檢查點激酶，在基因毒性壓力下協調細胞週期停滯、修復基因的轉錄誘導以及複製叉穩定化。

links.context: Rag proteins are required for the mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment because amino-acid starvation inactivates the Rags, disperses mTORC1 from the lysosome and de-represses autophagy. The Ragulator-Rag axis therefore converts lysosomal amino-acid detection into mTORC1 spatial activation, the core mechanism of nutrient signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Rag 蛋白對 mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment 而言是必需的，因為胺基酸飢餓會使 Rag 失活、讓 mTORC1 從溶酶體分散並解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Ragulator–Rag 軸把溶酶體的胺基酸偵測轉換為 mTORC1 的空間性活化，構成營養訊號的核心機制。

links.context: Ragulator is required for the mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment: loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. That double consequence makes Ragulator the lynchpin of lysosomal nutrient coupling, since it is needed both to switch mTORC1 off at the membrane and to prevent constitutive autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: Ragulator 對 mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment 而言是必需的：Ragulator 缺失會破壞營養依賴性的 mTORC1 訊號並解除對自噬的抑制。這種雙重後果使 Ragulator 成為溶酶體營養耦合的關鍵，因為它既是關閉膜上 mTORC1 所必需，也是防止自噬持續活化所必需。

links.context: Rapalogs are allosteric inhibitors of mTOR that act preferentially on mTORC1 and thereby induce Autophagy. Highly mTORC1-selective rapalogs are desired in the clinic to avoid the adverse effects on glucose tolerance that arise from mTORC2 inhibition, which is why rapalogs are widely used in Cancer therapy and as immunosuppressive agents in organ transplantation.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 mTOR 的異構性抑制劑，主要作用於 mTORC1，進而誘導自噬。臨床上希望有高度 mTORC1 選擇性的 Rapalog，以避免因抑制 mTORC2 而造成的葡萄糖耐受不良；因此 Rapalog 廣泛用於癌症治療與器官移植的免疫抑制。

links.context: Rapalogs are analogs of rapamycin that inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. They share rapamycin's core pharmacology, including mTORC1 inhibition, autophagy induction, and lifespan effects.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 rapamycin 的類似物，透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面抑制 mTORC1。它們共享 rapamycin 的核心藥理學，包括 mTORC1 抑制、自噬誘導與壽命效應。

links.context: Rapalogs share the mTORC1-dependent class effect of Rapamycin, so mucosal ulceration of the oral and digestive tract is a dose-limiting adverse event across the class, not unique to rapamycin.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapalogs 與 Rapamycin 共享 mTORC1 依賴的類別效應，因此口腔與消化道黏膜潰瘍是整個類別的劑量限制性不良事件，並非 rapamycin 特有。

links.context: Rapamycin acts as a senomorphic: as an mTOR inhibitor it suppresses IL-1α translation, reduces NF-κB activity and attenuates SASP expression and SASP-induced inflammation without fully reversing senescence arrest. This makes mTOR inhibitors useful for dampening the harmful secretome while preserving the beneficial tumor-suppressive functions of acute senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 作為 senomorphic 作用：作為 mTOR 抑制劑，它抑制 IL-1α 轉譯、降低 NF-κB 活性並減弱 SASP 表現與 SASP 誘發的發炎，卻不完全逆轉衰老停滯。這使 mTOR 抑制劑適合在抑制有害分泌組的同時，保留急性衰老的腫瘤抑制功能。

links.context: Rapamycin and its analogs are metabolized by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP3A4 and are therefore sensitive to pharmacokinetic drug interactions. Cannabidiol (CBD) is a potent CYP3A inhibitor that increases circulating levels of mTOR inhibitors, raising the risk of toxicity - a clinically relevant interaction given the widespread use of CBD and other cannabis products. This has been documented in patients with tuberous sclerosis complex (cannabidiol elevates mechanistic target of rapamycin inhibitor levels) and in a phase 1 healthy volunteer trial of coadministered everolimus and CBD.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin及其類似物通過細胞色素P450酶CYP3A4代謝，因此對藥物動力學相互作用敏感。大麻二酚（CBD）是一種強效CYP3A抑製劑，可增加mTOR抑製劑的循環水平，從而增加毒性風險——考慮到CBD和其他大麻產品的廣泛使用，這是一個臨床相關的相互作用。這在結節性硬化症患者（大麻二酚升高rapamycin抑製劑水平）和everolimus與CBD共同給藥的1期健康誌願者試驗中已有記錄。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: Rapamycin extends murine lifespan roughly 10 to 25 percent even with late-life start from the landmark Harrison 2009 study. Extension is the geroprotective outcome.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 即使晚年開始仍延長小鼠壽命約 10 至 25%，源自里程碑 Harrison 2009。延長是老年保護結果。

links.context: Rapamycin inhibits Target of rapamycin, a central regulator of cell growth and metabolism whose pathway governs muscle protein synthesis and cell growth. Inhibition of this axis can extend lifespan through mechanisms that include adaptive mitochondrial ROS signaling, making it a major pharmacological target for longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 抑制 Target of rapamycin，一個調控細胞生長與代謝的中樞調節因子，其路徑掌控肌肉蛋白合成與細胞生長。抑制此軸可透過包括適應性粒線體 ROS 訊號在內的機制延長壽命，因此它是長壽研究的重要藥理標的。

links.context: Rapamycin-induced mTORC2 inhibition has been shown to induce insulin resistance, highlighting a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. While rapamycin's canonical target is mTORC1, chronic exposure also suppresses mTORC2, and this unintended suppression - rather than mTORC1 inhibition alone - mediates the glucose intolerance and insulin resistance observed in mice and humans. Lamming et al. demonstrated that rapamycin-induced insulin resistance is mediated by mTORC2 loss and is uncoupled from longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin誘導的mTORC2抑制已被證明會誘發胰島素阻抗，突顯了代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。雖然rapamycin的典型靶點是mTORC1，但長期暴露也會抑制mTORC2，這種意外抑制——而非僅僅mTORC1抑制——介導了在小鼠和人類中觀察到的葡萄糖不耐症和胰島素阻抗。Lamming等人證明rapamycin誘導的胰島素阻抗是由mTORC2缺失介導的，並且與壽命解偶聯。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: Raptor is the substrate-binding scaffold of mTORC1, docking canonical substrates such as S6K1 and 4E-BP1 through their TOS motifs. This short linear motif engagement is what allows mTORC1 to phosphorylate these effectors and thereby control translation initiation and growth.
links.context_zh_TW: Raptor 是 mTORC1 的受體結合支架，透過 TOS 序列停靠 S6K1 與 4E-BP1 等典型受體。正是這種短線性序列的結合，使 mTORC1 能磷酸化這些效應蛋白，進而控制轉譯起始與生長。

links.context: Rasburicase, a recombinant PEGylated urate oxidase, is a recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia. Catalysis of uric acid to allantoin generates hydrogen peroxide as a byproduct; in erythrocytes that peroxide oxidizes Hemoglobin's ferrous (Fe²⁺) heme iron to ferric (Fe³⁺) Methemoglobin, impairing oxygen carriage.
links.context_zh_TW: Rasburicase 是重組 PEG 化尿酸氧化酶，是後天性 Methemoglobinemia 的公認病因。其催化尿酸生成 allantoin 的過程會產生過氧化氫副產物；在紅血球中，該過氧化物將 Hemoglobin 的二價（Fe²⁺）血基質鐵氧化為三價（Fe³⁺）Methemoglobin，損害氧的運送。

links.context: Rather than being purely toxic, low-dose 2-deoxy-D-glucose forces cells toward mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and a mild, transient burst of reactive oxygen species. This low-level oxidative signal is the hallmark of mitohormesis, inducing adaptive antioxidant and stress-defense responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 低劑量的 2-deoxy-D-glucose 並非純粹具毒性，而是迫使細胞轉向粒線體 Oxidative Phosphorylation，產生輕微而短暫的 Reactive Oxygen Species 脈衝。這種低度氧化訊號正是 Mitohormesis 的特徵，可誘發適應性的抗氧化與壓力防禦反應。

links.context: Rb is inactivated by phosphorylation: CDK4/CDK6-cyclin D mono-phosphorylates it as the initial step, and CDK2-cyclin E/A hyperphosphorylates it, releasing E2F and allowing cell cycle progression. p16 inhibits CDK4/6 while p21 restrains CDK2, so both pathways converge on keeping Rb hypophosphorylated and enforcing cell cycle arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: Rb 會因磷酸化而失活：CDK4/CDK6–cyclin D 先做單一磷酸化，隨後 CDK2–cyclin E/A 進行過磷酸化，釋放 E2F 並允許細胞週期進行。p16 抑制 CDK4/6，而 p21 約束 CDK2，因此兩條路徑都匯聚於維持 Rb 低磷酸化並執行細胞週期停滯。

links.context: Rb plays a pivotal role in enforcing the irreversible nature of senescence. Hypophosphorylated Rb keeps E2F repressed and recruits chromatin remodeling complexes to E2F target promoters, so loss of Rb function can allow cells to bypass senescence and re-enter the cell cycle. In oncogene-induced senescence Rb is held hypophosphorylated by both p16 and p21 pathways simultaneously, and Rb-mediated senescence contributes to age-related tissue degeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Rb 在維持衰老的不可逆性上扮演樞紐角色。低磷酸化 Rb 保持 E2F 受抑制，並將染色質重塑複合體招募到 E2F 標的啟動子，因此 Rb 功能喪失可能讓細胞繞過衰老而重新進入細胞週期。在 oncogene-induced senescence 中，Rb 由 p16 與 p21 兩條路徑同時維持低磷酸化，而 Rb 介導的衰老也促成與年齡相關的組織退化。

links.context: Reactions using COMT include magnesium as a cofactor, so it is important to get plenty of magnesium in the diet or through a mineral supplement to support COMT function. Magnesium stabilizes the SAMe-substrate complex for efficient methyl transfer. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
links.context_zh_TW: 使用 COMT 的反應包含鎂作為輔因子，因此在飲食中攝取足量鎂或透過礦物質補充劑來支持 COMT 功能很重要。鎂穩定 SAMe-受質複合物以實現有效的甲基轉移。這使鎂成為維持健康 COMT activity 的實用營養槓桿。
links.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

links.context: Reactive Astrocytes and Microglia engage in bidirectional paracrine signaling, propagating Type I Interferon and pro-inflammatory cytokine responses that reshape the glial landscape and sustain chronic inflammation and synaptic dysfunction in Alzheimer's Disease and Parkinson's Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 反應性的 Astrocytes 與 Microglia 進行雙向的旁分泌訊號傳遞，傳播 Type I Interferon 與促發炎細胞激素反應，重塑神經膠細胞環境，並在 Alzheimer's Disease 與 Parkinson's Disease 中維持慢性發炎與突觸功能失調。

links.context: Reactive Oxygen Species in mitochondria convert the fission GTPase from a housekeeping enzyme into a stress-driven cutter by oxidizing the redox-sensitive Cys644 of DRP1. Sulfenylated DRP1 has higher GTPase activity and fragments the network, and the resulting ROS feed forward to oxidize more DRP1, a self-reinforcing loop that MitoTEMPO and mito-catalase interrupt.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體中的 Reactive Oxygen Species 藉由氧化 DRP1 上對氧化還原敏感的 Cys644，把這個分裂 GTPase 由家務性酵素轉為壓力驅動的切割者。被 sulfenyl 化的 DRP1 GTPase 活性升高並使網絡碎裂，而產生的 ROS 又回饋氧化更多 DRP1，形成自我強化的迴路，可由 MitoTEMPO 與 mito-catalase 打断。

links.context: Rearranged TFE3 transcription factor defines Xp11 translocation RCC.
links.context_zh_TW: 重排的 TFE3 轉錄因子定義 Xp11 易位 RCC。

links.context: Receptor kinases phosphorylate R-SMADs to propagate signaling. Phosphorylation is the transduction step.
links.context_zh_TW: 受體激酶磷酸化 R-SMAD 以傳播訊號。磷酸化是傳導步驟。

links.context: Receptor-SMADs are phosphorylated by the receptor complex upon ligand binding. Activation direction mirrors the receptor-side edge.
links.context_zh_TW: 受體 SMAD 在配體結合後被受體複合體磷酸化。活化方向呼應受體側的邊。

links.context: Recommended pharmacotherapy for gnathostomiasis is ivermectin (200 μg/kg/day for 2 days) combined with albendazole (400 mg twice daily for 21 days), which shows synergistic efficacy against migrating Gnathostoma larvae. Surgical excision of accessible lesions is additionally curative and provides diagnostic confirmation.
links.context_zh_TW: Gnathostomiasis 的建議藥物治療為 ivermectin（200 μg/kg/day、連續 2 天）與 albendazole（400 mg、每日兩次、連續 21 天）併用，對移行中的 Gnathostoma 幼蟲具有協同療效。對於可接觸的病灶，手術切除同時具有治療與確診價值。

links.context: Recruitment of eEFSec depends on SECISBP2, which binds the SECIS element in the 3' UTR of selenoprotein mRNAs and contacts eEFSec, tethering the Sec delivery complex to the translating ribosome. eL30 additionally anchors the SECIS ribonucleoprotein complex to the large ribosomal subunit.
links.context_zh_TW: eEFSec 的招募依賴 SECISBP2；SECISBP2 結合硒蛋白 mRNA 3' UTR 上的 SECIS 元素並與 eEFSec 接觸，將 Sec 遞送複合體繫於正在轉譯的核糖體上。eL30 進一步將 SECIS 核糖核蛋白複合體錨定在大次單元上。

links.context: Red palm oil supplies 18-25 ppm of Coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinones), a modest but real dietary source of the radical-trap substrate for the GPX4-independent FSP1 ferroptosis axis. Ubiquinol also regenerates tocopheroxyl radicals, so CoQ10 in the same oil acts synergistically with the tocotrienol fraction rather than as an isolated additive. The same oil additionally carries squalene (14-15 ppm) and phytosterols (235-365 ppm) that stabilize bilayer packing.
links.context_zh_TW: Red palm oil 提供 18-25 ppm 的 Coenzyme Q10（ubiquinones），是 GPX9 非依賴型 FSP1 ferroptosis 軸之自由基捕捉受體的適量但真實的膳食來源。Ubiquinol 亦可再生 tocopheroxyl 自由基，因此油中的 CoQ10 與 tocotrienol 組分是協同作用，而非孤立的添加物。同一油品還含有 squalene（14-15 ppm）與 phytosterols（235-365 ppm），有助於穩定雙層膜的堆積。

links.context: Reduced BDNF levels are implicated in depression and anxiety disorders, where SIRT1 activation and BDNF induction may underlie antidepressant effects. BDNF loss is also a feature of neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and Huntington's disease, and SIRT1-mediated BDNF induction is neuroprotective.
links.context_zh_TW: BDNF 水平降低與憂鬱症和焦慮症有關，其中 SIRT1 活化和 BDNF 誘導可能是抗憂鬱效應的基礎。BDNF 缺失也是阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症和亨丁頓舞蹈症神經退化的特徵，SIRT1 介導的 BDNF 誘導具有神經保護作用。

links.context: Reduced expression of the fusion protein MFN2 in Left Ventricular Hypertrophy skews the balance toward excessive fission, which disrupts Mitochondrial Integrity and contributes to cardiac dysfunction and pathological remodelling.
links.context_zh_TW: 融合蛋白 MFN2 在 Left Ventricular Hypertrophy 中表現下降，使動態平衡偏向過度分裂，進而破壞 Mitochondrial Integrity 並促成心臟功能異常與病理性重塑。

links.context: Reduced insulin/IGF-1 signaling through dietary restriction, intermittent fasting, or genetic reduction of DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor, derepresses autophagy and doubles lifespan via DAF-16/FOXO, making it one of the most robust lifespan-extending interventions.
links.context_zh_TW: 透過飲食限制、間歇性禁食，或在 C. elegans 中遺傳性降低胰島素/IGF-1 受體 DAF-2 來減少胰島素訊息傳遞，可解除對自噬的抑制並經由 DAF-16/FOXO 使壽命加倍，是最穩健的延壽介入之一。

links.context: Reduced perfusion from constriction directly causes ischemia. Causation is the flow to injury step.
links.context_zh_TW: 收縮減少灌流直接導致缺血。因果是血流到損傷步驟。

links.context: Reduced thioredoxin-1 regenerates ribonucleotide reductase each turnover for dNTP synthesis. This textbook electron flow links redox tone to DNA synthesis capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 還原型 thioredoxin-1 在每次周轉再生 ribonucleotide reductase 以合成 dNTP。此教科書電子流將氧化還原張力連結到 DNA 合成能力。

links.context: Reformation rebuilds a fresh pool of functional lysosomes. Generation is the recycling output.
links.context_zh_TW: 重組重建新鮮功能性溶酶體池。產生是回收輸出。

links.context: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Regulatory T cells counter chronic Inflammation and autoimmunity by restraining immune activation; because their number and function are modulated by mTORC1 inhibition, Treg expansion is a key lever for restoring immune balance in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Regulatory T cells 藉由抑制免疫活化來對抗慢性 Inflammation 與自體免疫；由於其數量與功能受 mTORC1 抑制調節，Treg 的擴增是恢復老化個體免疫平衡的關鍵槓桿。

links.context: Removing sex steroids surgically or via LHRH analogues restores early thymic progenitor numbers and thymic architecture, re-establishing the stromal microenvironment on which Thymopoiesis depends. IL-7, keratinocyte growth factor, IL-22, growth hormone via IGF-1, and ghrelin act through complementary routes to the same end.
links.context_zh_TW: 以外科手術或 LHRH 類似物剝除性類固醇，可恢復早期胸腺前驅細胞數量與胸腺結構，重新建立 Thymopoiesis 所依賴的基質微環境。IL-7、keratinocyte growth factor、IL-22、經由 IGF-1 作用的生長激素以及 ghrelin 則透過互補途徑達到相同目的。

links.context: Reperfusion of ischemic tissue adds a second injury wave — ROS burst, damage-associated molecular pattern release and inflammasome priming — which recruits regulated death programs including necroptosis (RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL), ferroptosis, parthanatos and pyroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 缺血組織的再灌流加上第二波傷害——活性氧爆發、損傷相關分子模式釋放與發炎小體啟動——招募受調控的死亡程式，包括 necroptosis（RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL）、ferroptosis、parthanatos 與 pyroptosis。

links.context: Replication stress produced by gemcitabine activates the DNA damage response through ATR and ATM pathway kinases. This leads to cell cycle arrest and can resolve into either apoptosis or stress-induced premature senescence depending on stress severity.
links.context_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 產生的複製壓力透過 ATR 和 ATM 途徑激酶活化 DNA 損傷反應。這導致細胞週期停滯，並可依壓力嚴重程度演化為凋亡或壓力誘導的早發性衰老。

links.context: Reprogramming encompasses Partial Reprogramming as its in vivo, cyclic, non-pluripotent regime: short pulses of OSKM factor expression erase epigenetic age marks without full loss of cell identity, avoiding teratoma risk and targeting rejuvenation of aged tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Reprogramming 涵蓋 Partial Reprogramming 此一體內、間歇性、不進入多能性的重編程模式：短暫的 OSKM 因子表現脈衝能在不完全喪失細胞身份的情況下清除表觀年齡標記，避免畸胎瘤風險，並以年老組織的年輕化為目標。

links.context: Reprogramming ranges from complete nuclear reprogramming via somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT), where an oocyte erases somatic identity to restore totipotency, to factor-driven pluripotent reprogramming and partial reprogramming. SCNT remains the gold standard for developmental reprogramming studies.
links.context_zh_TW: Reprogramming 的範圍從透過體細胞核轉移（SCNT）的完全核重編程（卵母細胞抹除體細胞身分以恢復全能性），到因子驅動的多能性重編程和部分重編程。SCNT 仍是發育重編程研究的黃金標準。

links.context: Resistance to Doxorubicin is a common clinical problem, often mediated by overexpression of anti-apoptotic proteins like Bcl-2. Silencing Bmi-1 in MCF breast cancer cells downregulates pAkt and Bcl-2 and renders the cells more sensitive to Doxorubicin, with a corresponding increase in apoptotic cells in vitro.
links.context_zh_TW: 對 Doxorubicin 的抗藥性是常見的臨床問題，常由 Bcl-2 等抗凋亡蛋白的過量表現所介導。在 MCF 乳癌細胞中沉默 Bmi-1 會下調 pAkt 與 Bcl-2，使細胞對 Doxorubicin 更加敏感，並在 in vitro 下增加凋亡細胞數。

links.context: Resolvins are specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators derived from the omega-3 PUFAs eicosapentaenoic acid and Docosahexaenoic acid. Because the same PUFAs are the substrate for non-enzymatic Lipid Peroxidation, omega-3 status raises the potential for both outcomes at once: the outcome depends on oxidative context, with adequate Vitamin E, GPX4 and Glutathione channeling oxygenation through lipoxygenase into resolvins, and with failed defenses producing 4-Hydroxynonenal, Acrolein and F2-Isoprostanes instead.
links.context_zh_TW: Resolvins 是源自 omega-3 PUFA（eicosapentaenoic acid 與 Docosahexaenoic acid）的 specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators。由於同一批 PUFA 也是非酵素性 Lipid Peroxidation 的受質，omega-3 狀態會同時提升兩種結果的可能性：實際結果取決於氧化情境——當 Vitamin E、GPX4 與 Glutathione 充足時，氧化被導向經 lipoxygenase 生成 resolvins；當防禦失效時，則產生 4-Hydroxynonenal、Acrolein 與 F2-Isoprostanes。

links.context: Respiratory Complex I regenerates NAD+ from NADH, coupling OXPHOS to TCA flux.
links.context_zh_TW: 呼吸複合體 I 從 NADH 再生 NAD+，將 OXPHOS 耦合到 TCA 通量。
links.source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

links.context: Resveratrol (trans-3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene) is the most extensively studied stilbene, obtained from grape skin and red wine and recognized for antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and sirtuin-activating properties; pterostilbene, piceatannol and pinosylvin are other notable members.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol（trans-3,4',5-三羥基 stilbene）是最廣為研究的 stilbene，來自葡萄皮與紅酒，以抗氧化、抗發炎與 sirtuin 活化性質聞名；pterostilbene、piceatannol 與 pinosylvin 也是其他重要成員。

links.context: Resveratrol activates SIRT1 directly or indirectly, prolonging life span in model organisms, and this effect is lost in yeast, worms and flies lacking Sir2. Resveratrol and caloric restriction also induce autophagy in a Sir2-dependent fashion, so Resveratrol sits upstream of the autophagy machinery rather than acting on it directly.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 直接或間接活化 SIRT1，在模式生物中延長壽命，而此效應會在缺乏 Sir2 的酵母、線蟲與果蠅中消失。Resveratrol 與熱量限制同樣以 Sir2 依賴的方式誘導自噬，因此 Resveratrol 位於自噬機組的上游，而非直接作用於它。

links.context: Resveratrol enhances Cholesterol Efflux in a dose-dependent manner by upregulating ABCA1 expression, which increases apoA-1-mediated cholesterol transfer to lipid-poor Apolipoprotein A1. Under Oxidative Stress, which otherwise reduces ABCA1, LXR and PPAR expression and impairs efflux, Resveratrol restores efflux capacity and HDL functionality.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過上調 ABCA1 表現，以劑量依賴方式增強 Cholesterol Efflux，提升對脂蛋白缺乏型 Apolipoprotein A1 的介導型膽固醇轉移。在 Oxidative Stress 下，ABCA1、LXR 與 PPAR 表現下降而使外流受損，此時 Resveratrol 可恢復外流能力與 HDL 功能。

links.context: Resveratrol enhances Reverse Cholesterol Transport by inducing LXR-α expression, upregulating ABCA1 and boosting apoA-1-mediated cholesterol efflux from macrophages; it also reduces cholesterol influx and restores HDL3-mediated efflux under oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 藉由誘導 LXR-α 表現、上調 ABCA1 並增強巨噬細胞中由 apoA-1 介導的 cholesterol efflux，來提升 Reverse Cholesterol Transport；它也降低膽固醇流入，並在氧化壓力下恢復 HDL3 介導的 efflux。

links.context: Resveratrol enhances apoA-1-mediated cholesterol efflux from macrophages in a dose-dependent manner by upregulating the ABCA1 transporter, and it also induces LXR-α expression, which is the master transcriptional regulator of ABCA1 and ABCG1.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 以劑量相關的方式藉由上調 ABCA1 轉運蛋白，增強巨噬細胞中由 apoA-1 介導的 cholesterol efflux；它同時誘導 LXR-α 表現，而後者是 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的主要轉錄調節因子。

links.context: Resveratrol exhibits chemopreventive activity against leukemia, DMBA-induced mammary tumors, skin cancer, and other malignancies, in part through SIRT1-dependent and -independent pathways (reviewed in the sirtuin literature; Baur 2006 PMID 17086191).
links.context_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇對白血病、DMBA 誘導的乳腺腫瘤、皮膚癌和其他惡性腫瘤表現出化學預防活性，部分透過 SIRT1 依賴性和非依賴性通路（參見 sirtuin 文獻綜述；Baur 2006 PMID 17086191）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: Resveratrol protects LDL against oxidation by chelating free copper ions and scavenging free radicals: at 0-1 micromolar it inhibits LDL oxidation by extending the lag phase and reducing the maximum rate of conjugated diene formation, and it preserves the vitamin E content of LDL during oxidative stress while protecting apoB integrity from radical-induced alteration. These effects underpin its proposed atheroprotective action.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過螯合游離銅離子與清除自由基來保護 LDL 免於氧化：在 0–1 微莫耳濃度下，它藉由延長延遲期並降低共軛雙烯生成的最高速率來抑制 LDL 氧化，並在氧化壓力下維持 LDL 中的維生素 E 含量，同時保護 apoB 完整性免受自由基誘發的改變。這些效應構成其被提出作為動脈粥狀硬化保護作用的基礎。

links.context: Resveratrol protects LDL against oxidation in a concentration-dependent manner, inhibiting the conjugated-diene formation produced by copper or gamma-radiolysis-driven LDL oxidation (Berrougui et al., Atherosclerosis 2009). By limiting LDL oxidation, Resveratrol reduces the generation of Oxidized LDL and hence atherogenic foam-cell drive.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 以濃度依賴的方式保護 LDL 不被氧化，抑制銅或 γ 輻解引發的 LDL 氧化所產生的共軛雙烯形成（Berrougui 等，Atherosclerosis 2009）。藉由限制 LDL 氧化，Resveratrol 減少 Oxidized LDL 的生成，因而降低致粥樣硬化的泡沫細胞驅動力。

links.context: Resveratrol significantly reduced DPPH free radical content in a concentration-dependent manner over 0-50 uM (r2 = 0.96, p = 0.0032), with over half the total activity occurring in the first 30 minutes. At identical concentrations resveratrol and vitamin E showed equivalent DPPH scavenging activity, with rapid kinetics for both.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在 0–50 µM 範圍內以濃度依賴方式顯著降低 DPPH 自由基含量（r² = 0.96，p = 0.0032），且超過一半的活性在前 30 分鐘內出現。在相同濃度下，resveratrol 與 vitamin E 展現相等的 DPPH 清除活性，兩者的動力學皆十分快速。

links.context: Resveratrol significantly reduces Cholesterol Influx into J774 macrophages in a dose-dependent manner (r² = 0.89, p = 0.015), and also lowers cholesterol uptake by endothelial cells. It additionally represses the lipid uptake genes LPL and SR-AII through LXR-α, shifting cellular cholesterol balance toward efflux.
links.context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 以劑量依賴方式顯著降低 J774 巨噬細胞的 Cholesterol Influx（r² = 0.89, p = 0.015），並減少內皮細胞的膽固醇攝取。它同時透過 LXR-α 抑制脂質攝取基因 LPL 與 SR-AII，使細胞膽固醇平衡轉向外流。

links.context: Resveratrol — a SIRT1 activator — attenuated cell death caused by the topoisomerase poisons etoposide and camptothecin in HeLa cells, while the SIRT1 inhibitor Selisistat (EX-527) did the opposite. SIRT1 activity in these experiments was tracked by acetyl-p53 (Lys379) levels, a canonical SIRT1 substrate readout. Functionally this anchors the anti-apoptotic role of SIRT1 in the DDR: raising its activity protects against genotoxic death, and the protection is lost when TRIM28 can no longer be restrained.
links.context_zh_TW: 作為 SIRT1 活化劑的 Resveratrol 能減輕拓撲異構酶毒物 etoposide 與 camptothecin 在 HeLa 細胞中造成的細胞死亡，而 SIRT1 抑制劑 Selisistat（EX-527）則相反。實驗中以 acetyl-p53（Lys379）水平作為 SIRT1 活性指標。這在功能上確立了 SIRT1 在 DDR 中的抗凋亡角色：提高其活性可抵抗基因毒性死亡，而當 TRIM28 無法被抑制時保護作用便會消失。
links.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

links.context: Retinal pigment epithelium dysfunction and loss is the pathophysiologic center.
links.context_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮功能障礙與缺失是病理生理中心。

links.context: Retinoblastoma Protein inhibits proliferation by binding to and inactivating E2F1, a key transcriptional activator of cell cycle and cell division genes. E2F1 itself plays a dual role, acting as a master regulator of cell cycle progression at the G1/S transition and as a potent driver of apoptosis in response to severe DNA damage or oncogenic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoblastoma Protein 藉由結合並使 E2F1 失活來抑制增殖；E2F1 是 cell cycle 與細胞分裂基因的關鍵轉錄活化因子。E2F1 本身具有雙重角色：既是 G1/S transition 的 cell cycle 進展主導調節因子，也是嚴重 DNA 損傷或致癌壓力下的強效凋亡驅動者。

links.context: Retinoic Acid induces differentiation in monolayer cultures of embryonic stem cells cultured without Leukemia inhibitory factor, providing a standard in vitro model for testing lineage commitment and self-renewal silencing.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 在未添加 Leukemia inhibitory factor 的胚胎幹細胞單層培養中誘導 Differentiation，提供了測試譜系命定與自我更新沉默的標準體外模型。

links.context: Retinoic Acid silences Pluripotency by driving differentiation of embryonic stem cells; however DGCR8-deficient ES cells treated with retinoic acid still failed to shut down pluripotency markers (Oct4, Rex1, Sox2, Nanog), showing that microRNA biogenesis is required for the differentiation response.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 藉由驅動胚胎幹細胞分化來沉默 Pluripotency；然而 DGCR8 缺陷的 ES 細胞即使接受 retinoic acid 處理，仍無法關閉多能性標記（Oct4、Rex1、Sox2、Nanog），顯示 microRNA 生合成是此分化反應所必需的。

links.context: Retinoic acid signaling raises FSP1 transcription alongside GPX4, adding a GPX4-independent radical-trapping brake to the same anti-ferroptotic program. FSP1 acts at the outer leaflet of the plasma membrane using NAD(P)H-dependent reduction of Coenzyme Q10 to ubiquinol, so induction of FSP1 by retinoic acid extends the transcriptional defense to a different membrane compartment than the enzymatic GPX4 axis. This is why coQ10, tocopherols and retinoids sit at adjacent rungs of the same dietary defense tier.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoic acid 訊號在提升 GPX4 的同時也提高 FSP1 的轉錄，為同一套抗 ferroptosis 程式補上一個 GPX9 非依賴型的自由基捕捉煞車。FSP1 作用於細胞膜外葉，藉由 NAD(P)H 依賴方式將 Coenzyme Q10 還原為 ubiquinol，因此 retinoic acid 誘導的 FSP1 會把轉錄性防禦延伸至與 GPX4 酵素軸不同的膜區室。這也是為何 coQ10、tocopherols 與 retinoids 會位於同一膳食防禦層級的相鄰階梯。

links.context: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors (RLRs) detect unique RNA structures generated during viral infection and then activate MAVS on the outer mitochondrial membrane. MAVS acts as the signaling platform that converts that detection event into prion-like aggregate formation and downstream interferon production, making the organelle an internal sensor of external danger.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors（RLRs）偵測病毒感染過程中產生的特殊 RNA 結構，隨後在粒線體外膜上活化 MAVS。MAVS 作為訊號平台，將此偵測事件轉換為類普里昂聚集體形成與下游 interferon 生成，使胞器成為對外來危險的內部感測器。

links.context: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a key effector of the mammalian Retrograde Response. Mitochondrial stress — electron transport chain impairment, Mitochondrial ROS accumulation, loss of membrane potential — converges on RXRα via calcium-dependent calcineurin, which dephosphorylates and activates the receptor, promoting nuclear translocation and transcription of metabolic adaptation, antioxidant defense, Mitochondrial Biogenesis, and Mitochondrial Dynamics genes.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinoid X receptor α（RXRA、NR2B1）是哺乳類 Retrograde Response 的關鍵效應者。粒線體壓力——電子傳遞鏈受損、Mitochondrial ROS 累積、膜電位喪失——經由鈣離子依賴的 calcineurin 匯聚於 RXRα；calcineurin 使其去磷酸化並活化，促進核轉位與代謝適應、抗氧化防禦、Mitochondrial Biogenesis 與 Mitochondrial Dynamics 等基因的轉錄。

links.context: Retinol, retinal and all-trans retinoic acid are direct suppressors of Ferroptosis through two distinct arms: non-genomic lipid-radical trapping and transcriptional induction of the GPX4/FSP1 defense modules. In erastin and RSL3 models, retinol (EC50 0.4-4.8 uM) and all-trans retinal (0.7-1.1 uM) inhibited ferroptosis more potently than alpha-tocopherol (7.4-36.1 uM), placing vitamin A metabolites above tocopherols in the dietary radical-trapping tier. The nutritional arm therefore acts as defense while pharmacologic retinoid dosing, where the pro-oxidant arm dominates, acts as stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Retinol、retinal 與 all-trans retinoic acid 透過兩條不同途徑直接抑制 Ferroptosis：非基因體的脂質自由基捕捉，以及 GPX4/FSP1 防禦模組的轉錄誘導。在 erastin 與 RSL3 模型中，retinol（EC50 0.4-4.8 uM）與 all-trans retinal（0.7-1.1 uM）抑制 ferroptosis 的效力高於 α-tocopherol（7.4-36.1 uM），使 vitamin A 代謝物在膳食自由基捕捉層級中排在 tocopherols 之上。因此營養劑量的途徑是防禦，而藥理劑量（pro-oxidant 途徑主導）則是壓力。

links.context: Retrograde signaling is a key mediator of Mitohormesis, the phenomenon whereby mild mitochondrial stress extends lifespan and enhances stress resistance. Interventions that activate mitochondrial stress responses in a controlled manner — mild respiratory chain inhibition, NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside and Nicotinamide Mononucleotide, or Metformin, Rapamycin, and Urolithin A — all engage retrograde and UPRmt components, with benefit requiring an optimal activation window between insufficient and excessive activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 逆行訊號傳遞是 Mitohormesis 的關鍵媒介，即輕度粒線體壓力可延長壽命並提升抗壓能力。以受控方式活化粒線體壓力反應的介入手段——輕度呼吸鏈抑制、NAD+ 前驅物如 Nicotinamide Riboside 與 Nicotinamide Mononucleotide，或 Metformin、Rapamycin、Urolithin A——皆會徵用逆行與 UPRmt 的組成元件，其效益需要介於活化不足與過度活化之間的最佳活化窗。

links.context: Retrotransposons are mobile genetic elements normally kept transcriptionally silent by repressive chromatin maintained by chromatin modifiers including SIRT6. In the RCM hypothesis, repeated recruitment of SIRT6 to DNA repair sites can de-repress retrotransposons, contributing to genomic instability and inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 反轉錄轉座子是正常由包括 SIRT6 在內之染色質修飾因子維持的抑制性染色質靜默的移動遺傳元件。在 RCM 假說中，SIRT6 被反覆招募至 DNA 修復位點可解除對反轉錄轉座子的抑制，促成基因體不穩定與發炎。

links.context: Reverse Cholesterol Transport is the primary anti-atherogenic function of HDL; when it is impaired — for example by oxidative stress damaging HDL function and reducing ABCA1 expression — foam cells form and Atherosclerosis develops.
links.context_zh_TW: Reverse Cholesterol Transport 是 HDL 的主要抗動脈粥樣硬化功能；當它受損 —— 例如 Oxidative Stress 破壞 HDL 功能並降低 ABCA1 表現 —— 就會形成泡沫細胞並進展為 Atherosclerosis。

links.context: Reverse electron transport is one of the largest single sources of mitochondrial ROS, and when electrons accumulate they leak to oxygen generating superoxide. This makes RET a key contributor to low-level oxidative stress that can initiate mitohormesis or drive pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: 反向電子傳遞是粒線體 ROS 最大的單一來源之一，當電子累積時會洩漏至氧氣產生超氧化物。這使 RET 成為可啟動毒物興奮或驅動病理的低度氧化壓力關鍵貢獻者。

links.context: Reverse electron transport is the process by which electrons flow backward through the electron transport chain from reduced ubiquinol toward NADH. It occurs when the mitochondrial membrane is highly polarized and ubiquinol is abundant, producing a major source of mitochondrial ROS.
