links.context: SIRT2 activates G6PD via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 G6PD（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 activates c-Myc via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 c-Myc（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 activates phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (PEPCK) via deacetylation, a regulatory axis that also involves FOXO transcription factors, c-Myc and glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase. Increased gluconeogenic capacity is thereby coupled to pentose-phosphate-pathway flux and NADPH/redox balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化磷酸烯醇丙酮酸羧激酶（PEPCK）；此調控軸同時涉及 FOXO 轉錄因子、c-Myc 與葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶。藉此，糖質新生能力提升並與磷酸戊糖途徑通量及 NADPH／氧化還原平衡相連結。

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates FOXO1 and FOXO3a, promoting their nuclear accumulation and target-gene activation (e.g., stress resistance, gluconeogenesis, and cell survival) in a manner analogous to SIRT1-FOXO coupling, making FOXOs downstream effectors and listed positive regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 FOXO1 和 FOXO3a，促進它們的核積累和靶基因活化（例如抗壓、糖質新生和細胞存活），類似於 SIRT1-FOXO 的耦合方式，使 FOXOs 成為 SIRT2 通路的下游效應因子和被列出的正向調節因子（Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates G6PD in the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP) at Lys403, activating it to promote NADPH production and antioxidant defense; the PPP thus serves as a downstream effector of SIRT2 and is listed among its positive pathway regulators (Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在磷酸戊糖途徑（PPP）中去乙醯化 G6PD 的 Lys403，活化它以促進 NADPH 產生和抗氧化防禦；因此 PPP 作為 SIRT2 的下游效應因子被列為其正向通路調節因子（Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates H3K56ac, contributing to mitotic chromatin organization and genome stability.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，有助於有絲分裂染色質組織和基因組穩定性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates NFATc2, attenuating agonist-induced cardiac hypertrophy. Loss of SIRT2 reduces AMPK, promoting aging-related and angiotensin II-induced hypertrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 NFATc2，減輕促效劑誘導的心臟肥大。SIRT2 缺失降低 AMPK，促成老化相關與血管緊張素 II 誘導的肥大。

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates histone H4 Lys16 during the G2/M transition, promoting mitotic chromatin condensation (Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期間去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 Lys16，促進有絲分裂染色質凝縮（Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 deacetylates transcription factors including NF-kB/p65, p53, FOXO1, and FOXO3a, generally restraining their pro-inflammatory/apoptotic output while shaping metabolic and stress programs; this cytoplasmic transcription-factor control complements SIRT2's tubulin and mitotic functions.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化包括 NF-kB/p65、p53、FOXO1 和 FOXO3a 在內的轉錄因子，通常抑制其促發炎/凋亡輸出，同時塑造代謝和壓力反應程序；這種細胞質轉錄因子的控制補充了 SIRT2 的 tubulin 和有絲分裂功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 extends lifespan in BubR1 progeroid mice, as reported in the longevity/aging literature, supporting a role in cell-cycle and proteostatic regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 BubR1 早衰小鼠中延長壽命，這在長壽/衰老文獻中已有報導，支持其在細胞週期和蛋白質恆定調節中的角色。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 has an anti-inflammatory role in myeloid and joint cells by deacetylating NF-kB/p65, reducing cytokines and ameliorating arthritis, though it promotes Th2 responses in allergic asthma; this context-dependence reflects SIRT2's diverse substrates and its differential expression across immune cell types.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在髓系和關節細胞中具有抗發炎作用，透過去乙醯化 NF-kB/p65 減少細胞因子並改善關節炎，但在過敏性氣喘中促進 Th2 反應；這種環境依賴性反映了 SIRT2 多樣化的底物及其在不同免疫細胞類型中的差異表達。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 inhibits FOXO1 by deacetylation (e.g., NF-κB, p53, FOXO1), generally restraining their transcriptional/apoptotic output.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化抑制 FOXO1（例如 NF-κB、p53、FOXO1），通常抑制其轉錄/凋亡輸出。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 inhibits p53 by deacetylation (e.g., NF-κB, p53, FOXO1), generally restraining their transcriptional/apoptotic output.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化抑制 p53（例如 NF-κB、p53、FOXO1），通常抑制其轉錄/凋亡輸出。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 is a Tubulin deacetylase that restrains cell-cycle mitotic regulators; disruption of SIRT2 raises Aurora-A and Aurora-B levels, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death, and SIRT2-deficient mice consequently develop gender-specific tumorigenesis including Hepatocellular Carcinoma in males.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 是調節細胞週期有絲分裂因子的 Tubulin 去乙醯化酶；SIRT2 遭破壞會使 Aurora-A 與 Aurora-B 濃度上升，導致非整倍體與有絲分裂性細胞死亡，而 SIRT2 缺失小鼠因此出現性別特異性的腫瘤發生，包含雄鼠的 Hepatocellular Carcinoma。

links.context: SIRT2 is a cytoplasmic/mitotic deacetylase that regulates cytokinesis and the G2/M transition, supporting genomic stability and mitotic fidelity; age-related SIRT2 decline impairs these cell-cycle checkpoints (source review; North & Verdin review of SIRT2 mitotic roles).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種細胞質/有絲分裂去乙醯酶，調節細胞質分裂和 G2/M 轉換，支持基因組穩定性和有絲分裂忠實度；與年齡相關的 SIRT2 下降損害這些細胞週期檢查點（文獻綜述；North & Verdin 關於 SIRT2 有絲分裂角色的綜述）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 is downregulated in breast cancer tissue and increased expression is associated with longer survival, indicating a predominantly tumor-suppressive role. It acts as a tumor suppressor by promoting BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimerization and homologous recombination DNA repair. However, SIRT2 also has a promoter role in basal-like breast cancer, where it deacetylates and stabilizes Slug to drive tumorigenesis and invasion, giving it a binary role.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在乳癌組織中下調，且表現增加與較長存活相關，顯示主要為腫瘤抑制角色。它透過促進 BRCA1-BARD1 異二聚體化與同源重組 DNA 修復，作為腫瘤抑制因子。然而，SIRT2 在基底樣乳癌中亦有促進角色，去乙醯化並穩定 Slug 以驅動腫瘤發生與侵犯，呈現二元角色。

links.context: SIRT2 is the first identified tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule stability and dynamics; this underlies SIRT2's mitotic roles and explains why SIRT2 inhibitors, by preserving tubulin acetylation, protect neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's disease models.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 是第一個被發現的 tubulin 去乙醯酶，它移除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基團以調節微管穩定性和動態性；這構成了 SIRT2 有絲分裂功能的基礎，也解釋了為什麼 SIRT2 抑制劑透過保留 tubulin 乙醯化，在帕金森氏症和亨廷頓氏症模型中保護神經元。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 levels rise in senescent cells regardless of trigger (stress, oncogene, replicative exhaustion) but not in quiescent or apoptotic cells, and SIRT2 is not required to induce senescence. Directionally, senescence causes elevated SIRT2 rather than vice versa. This makes SIRT2 a useful biomarker of the senescent state.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 水平在衰老細胞中無論觸發因素為何（壓力、癌基因、複製耗竭）都會升高，但在靜止或凋亡細胞中不會，且 SIRT3 不是誘導衰老所必需的。方向性上衰老導致 SIRT2 升高而非相反。這使 SIRT2 成為衰老狀態的有用生物標記。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: SIRT2 overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, as excessive deacetylation may compromise microtubule stability and proteostasis. Consequently SIRT2 inhibitors, rather than activators, are pursued for Parkinson's and Huntington's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 過度活性與神經退化情境中的神經毒性相關，因為過度去乙醯化可能損害微管穩定性與蛋白質恆定。因此對帕金森氏症與亨廷頓病追求 SIRT2 抑制劑而非活化劑。

links.context: SIRT2 peaks at the G2/M transition and deacetylates H4K16, alpha-tubulin, and mitotic regulators, promoting chromatin condensation and mitotic fidelity; its loss raises Aurora-A/B and causes aneuploidy, linking SIRT2 to cell-cycle control and genomic stability.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，並去乙醯化 H4K16、α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子，促進染色質凝縮和有絲分裂忠實度；其缺失會增加 Aurora-A/B 水平並導致非整倍體，將 SIRT2 與細胞週期控制和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 prevents hepatic steatosis by deacetylating HNF4alpha, a master regulator of hepatic lipid genes, and suppresses adipocyte differentiation via FoxO1 deacetylation that restrains PPAR-gamma; reduced SIRT2 in obese adipose progenitors is linked to visceral fat expansion.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝臟脂質基因的主調控因子 HNF4α 來預防肝脂肪變性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化抑制脂肪細胞分化（FoxO1 去乙醯化可抑制 PPAR-γ）；肥胖脂肪前體細胞中 SIRT2 的減少與內臟脂肪擴增相關。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 promotes antioxidant defense in part through induction/stabilization of MnSOD (SOD2) targets, reducing mitochondrial superoxide; MnSOD is therefore listed among the positive regulators/effectors of the SIRT2 pathway in the source review's Table 3.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過誘導/穩定 MnSOD（SOD2）靶點部分促進抗氧化防禦，減少粒線體超氧化物；因此 MnSOD 被列為文獻綜述表 3 中 SIRT2 通路的正向調節因子/效應因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT2 promotes glucose-dependent hepatic glucose uptake by deacetylating GKRP at K126. GKRP is an inhibitory binding partner of glucokinase, and its acetylation state modulates the threshold for hepatic glucose phosphorylation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過在 K126 去乙醯化 GKRP 來促進葡萄糖依賴的肝臟葡萄糖攝取。GKRP 是葡萄糖激酶的抑制性結合夥伴，其乙醯化狀態調控肝臟葡萄糖磷酸化的門檻。

links.context: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 G477T and other SNPs are associated with human longevity/healthy aging; the G477T variant (V208I/V184I alleles) improves SIRT3 function or expression and is enriched in centenarian populations in some cohorts (source review; Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 reports).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 G477T 和其他 SNP 與人類長壽/健康衰老相關；G477T 變異（V208I/V184I 等位基因）改善 SIRT3 功能或表達，在某些族群中在百歲老人中富集（文獻綜述；Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 報導）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 activates AMPK/Parkin-mediated mitophagy (for example via the FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin route in retinal pigment epithelial cells under high glucose), and simultaneously suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation by lowering mitochondrial ROS in human macrophages. In myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, abnormalities in the SIRT1-SIRT3 axis silence PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, raising ROS and activating ferroptosis — making the SIRT1/SIRT3 pair a joint upstream gate for mitophagy and, through it, for multiple death modalities.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 會活化 AMPK/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬（例如高糖環境下視網膜色素上皮細胞中的 FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin 路徑），並在人類巨噬細胞中藉由降低粒線體 ROS 抑制 NLRP3 發炎體的活化。在心肌缺血再灌注損傷中，SIRT1-SIRT3 軸線的異常會沉默 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬，升高 ROS 並活化鐵死亡——使 SIRT1/SIRT3 這一對成為粒線體自噬（進而及於多種死亡模式）的共同上游閘門。

links.context: SIRT3 activates GDH to support gluconeogenesis from amino acids via deacetylation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 GDH 以支持氨基酸的糖質新生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 activates Ku70 via deacetylation, enhancing mitochondrial oxidative metabolism, ROS management, and ATP production (Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 Ku70，增強粒線體氧化代謝、ROS 管理和 ATP 產生（Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 activates MnSOD (SOD2) by deacetylation at Lys68/Lys122 (Qiu 2010 PMID 21566644), a key mitochondrial antioxidant node. MnSOD functions as a downstream effector of SIRT3: the two cooperate in neutralizing mitochondrial ROS, and MnSOD is therefore listed among positive regulators/effectors of the SIRT3 pathway. Enhanced MnSOD activity lowers mitochondrial superoxide, protecting tissues from oxidative injury and contributing to SIRT3's longevity and stress-resistance phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 Lys68/Lys122 處去乙醯化活化 MnSOD（SOD2）（Qiu 2010 PMID 21566644），這是一個關鍵的粒線體抗氧化節點。MnSOD 作為 SIRT3 的下游效應因子：兩者在中和粒線體 ROS 方面協同作用，因此 MnSOD 被列為 SIRT3 通路的正向調節因子/效應因子。增強的 MnSOD 活性降低粒線體超氧化物，保護組織免受氧化損傷，並有助於 SIRT3 的長壽和抗壓表型。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 acts as an oncogene in Colorectal Cancer by deacetylating SHMT2 at Lys95, activating Serine metabolism. The SIRT3–SHMT2 axis increases serine consumption and NADPH levels, fuelling nucleotide biosynthesis and tumour cell proliferation, a mechanism distinct from SIRT3's protective antioxidant role elsewhere.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 Colorectal Cancer 中作為致癌基因，透過在 Lys95 去乙醯化 SHMT2 而活化 Serine 代謝。SIRT3–SHMT2 軸增加 serine 消耗與 NADPH 濃度，為核苷酸生合成與腫瘤細胞增殖提供燃料，此機制與 SIRT3 在其他情境下的保護性抗氧化作用不同。

links.context: SIRT3 alleviates mitochondrial oxidative damage and apoptosis in intestinal ischemia-reperfusion injury via deacetylation of Peroxiredoxin 3. This couples SIRT3 activity to the mitochondrial peroxiredoxin antioxidant system.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化 Peroxiredoxin 3，減輕腸道缺血再灌注損傷中的粒線體氧化損傷與細胞凋亡。這將 SIRT3 活性與粒線體過氧化還原酶抗氧化系統相耦合。

links.context: SIRT3 and SIRT5 are both critical for the health of retinal photoreceptors, and SIRT3 activity is sensitive to the reduction of NAD+ content detected in multiple disorders with retinal degeneration, including age-associated dysfunction, diabetic retinopathy, and light-induced degeneration in mice. SIRT3 is a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase that supports ATP homeostasis, ROS detoxification, and neuroprotection, and increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 is one proposed mechanism of nicotinamide riboside's neuroprotective effects. This suggests a potential therapeutic treatment with NR for a variety of disorders that include photoreceptor degeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT5 對視網膜感光細胞的健康均至關重要，且 SIRT3 活性對多種伴隨視網膜退化的疾病中所偵測到的 NAD+ 含量降低相當敏感，包括年齡相關功能障礙、diabetic retinopathy（糖尿病視網膜病變）與小鼠中的光誘發退化。SIRT3 是一種粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，支持 ATP 恆定、ROS（活性氧）解毒與神經保護，而提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3 是 nicotinamide riboside 神經保護效應的其中一種被提出的機制。這暗示了以 NR 治療包含感光細胞退化在內的各種疾病的潛在療法。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: SIRT3 and SIRT6 are downregulated in HBV-positive patients, yet both restrain HBV replication by deacetylating H3K9 on the viral cccDNA minichromosome, which destabilizes the episome that sustains chronic infection. SIRT7 similarly restricts HBV transcription via H3 desuccinylation of cccDNA, making sirtuin-mediated chromatin silencing of the viral minichromosome a promising epigenetic axis for functional HBV cure.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT6 在 HBV 陽性患者中表現下降，但兩者都能藉由對病毒 cccDNA 小染色體上的 H3K9 進行去乙醯化而抑制 HBV 複製，使支撐慢性感染的 episome 不穩定。SIRT7 同樣透過 cccDNA 的 H3 去琥珀醯化限制 HBV 轉錄，因此以 sirtuin 介導的染色質沉默來對抗病毒小染色體，是實現功能性治愈 HBV 的有前景表觀遺傳軸。

links.context: SIRT3 binds and deacetylates SLC25A22 at K83, which suppresses the transporter's ubiquitination, prevents its 26S-proteasomal degradation and extends its half-life. Targeting SIRT3 increases SLC25A22 acetylation, then ubiquitination and degradation, sensitizing lung adenocarcinoma cells to RSL3-induced ferroptosis in vivo and in vitro. This is a non-enzymatic substrate mode of SIRT3 action: deacetylation does not change transporter kinetics but governs protein turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 結合 SLC25A22 並在 K83 去乙醯化，抑制該轉運蛋白的泛素化、阻止其 26S 蛋白酶體降解並延長半衰期。針對 SIRT3 會增加 SLC25A22 乙醯化，接著泛素化與降解，使肺腺癌細胞在體內與體外都對 RSL3 誘發的鐵死亡更加敏感。這是 SIRT3 作用的非酵素性受質模式：去乙醯化不改變轉運蛋白動力學，而是管控蛋白質周轉。

links.context: SIRT3 buffers mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating MnSOD and IDH2, letting SIRT3-rich tumor-associated macrophages tolerate the oxidative metabolism that supports their M2 program. This ties mitochondrial sirtuin redox control directly to immune polarization and to the redox homeostasis of the Tumor Microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由去乙醯化 MnSOD 與 IDH2 緩衝粒線體 ROS，使 SIRT3 豐富的 Tumor-Associated Macrophage 能耐受支持其 M2 程序的氧化代謝。這將粒線體 sirtuin 的氧化還原調控直接連結到免疫極化，以及 Tumor Microenvironment 的 Redox Homeostasis。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylase activity is the numerator of the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio, a readout of the mitochondrial sirtuin balance that sets the adaptive-vs-toxic threshold of the hormetic window.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯酶活性是 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例的分子，反映粒線體 sirtuin 平衡，決定激素性窗口中適應與毒性之間的閾值。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates DLD, the flavoprotein E3 component shared by the mitochondrial α-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes. By supporting complex activity, SIRT3-dependent DLD deacetylation enhances flux through pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenases, coupling mitochondrial NAD+ availability to oxidative decarboxylation and ATP production.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 將 DLD 去乙醯化；DLD 是粒線體 α-酮酸去氫酶複合體共用的黃素蛋白（E3）成分。藉由支撐複合體活性，SIRT3 依賴性的 DLD 去乙醯化可提升丙酮酸去氫酶與 α-酮戊二酸去氫酶的通量，把粒線體 NAD+ 可用性與氧化脫羧及 ATP 生成相偶聯。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates H3K56ac, a mark of newly synthesized/histone turnover.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，這是新合成/組蛋白週轉的標記。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates H3K9ac, a minor histone target linking SIRT3 to chromatin regulation in mitochondria-associated nuclei.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 H3K9ac，這是一個次要的組蛋白靶點，將 SIRT3 與粒線體相關細胞核的染色質調控聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates H4K14ac, part of its mitochondrial/cytonuclear deacetylase program.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 H4K14ac，這是其粒線體/核質去乙醯酶程序的一部分。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates H4K16ac among its histone substrates, contributing to chromatin compaction.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化其組蛋白底物中的 H4K16ac，有助於染色質凝縮。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates GDH, promoting amino-acid-derived anaplerosis and gluconeogenesis (contrast SIRT4, which ADP-ribosylates and inhibits GDH).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 GDH（穀氨酸脫氫酶），促進氨基酸衍生的回補反應和糖質新生（與 SIRT4 形成對比，後者透過 ADP-核糖基化抑制 GDH）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates MTHFD2, boosting mitochondrial NADPH and sustaining cellular redox balance. High SIRT3 activity therefore keeps MTHFD2 active and redox-protective, while SIRT3 inhibition deactivates MTHFD2, depleting NADPH and sensitising cells to oxidative and chemotherapeutic stress. MTHFD2 is thus a downstream effector of SIRT3's redox-shaping activity, alongside IDH2, MnSOD and SLC25A22.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 MTHFD2，提升粒線體 NADPH 並維持細胞的氧化還原平衡。因此 SIRT3 活性高會使 MTHFD2 保持活化與氧化還原保護作用，而 SIRT3 受抑制則使 MTHFD2 去活化、耗竭 NADPH，並使細胞對氧化與化學治療壓力更敏感。MTHFD2 因此是 SIRT3 氧化還原調節活性的下游效應者，與 IDH2、MnSOD、SLC25A22 並列。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates SOD2 (MnSOD) at Lys68/Lys122 and supports glutathione-dependent antioxidant pathways, reducing mitochondrial ROS; aging-associated SIRT3 decline increases oxidative stress, and SIRT3 knockout mice show accelerated aging phenotypes (source review; Qiu et al., 2010).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 Lys68/Lys122 處去乙醯化並活化 SOD2（MnSOD），支持穀胱甘肽依賴性的抗氧化通路，減少粒線體 ROS；衰老相關的 SIRT3 下降增加氧化壓力，SIRT3 敲除小鼠顯示加速的衰老表型（文獻綜述；Qiu et al., 2010）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates mitochondrial MnSOD (SOD2) at lysine 122 (K122), the site written on the MnSOD pathway used as a SIRT3 target-engagement endpoint. Deacetylation at this residue activates MnSOD, while SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation opposes the same axis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 會去乙醯化粒線體 MnSOD（SOD2）的第 122 號離胺酸（K122），此殘基的乙醯化亦被用作 SIRT3 標的結合率的檢測終點。該位置的去乙醯化可活化 MnSOD，而 SIRT4 的單 ADP 核糖基化則在同一軸線上與之拮抗。

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylates subunits of respiratory-chain complexes I and III, maintaining basal ATP levels and electron-transport efficiency (Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 的次單元，維持基礎 ATP 水平和電子傳輸效率（Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 deacetylation of SHMT2 at Lys95 activates serine-to-glycine conversion, increasing one-carbon flux and NADPH production and thereby promoting colorectal carcinogenesis. This SIRT3-SHMT2 axis is a direct route by which NAD+ status is converted into one-carbon metabolic output, tying sirtuin activity to the tumour metabolic phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 將 SHMT2 在 Lys95 位點去乙醯化，可活化絲胺酸到甘胺酸的轉換，提高一碳通量與 NADPH 生成，進而促進大腸直腸癌發生。此 SIRT3-SHMT2 軸是把 NAD+ 狀態轉換為一碳代謝輸出的直接途徑，將 sirtuin 活性與腫瘤代謝表型相連。

links.context: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

links.context: SIRT3 expression is lower in HCC tissue than in adjacent tissue. Modulating SIRT3 enhances sorafenib therapy, and SIRT3 downregulates GST-pi1 to enhance chemo- and sorafenib-induced apoptosis. Its loss therefore correlates with tumor aggressiveness and reduced treatment efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 HCC 組織中的表現低於鄰近組織。調節 SIRT3 可增強 sorafenib 治療，且 SIRT3 下調 GST-pi1 以增強化療與 sorafenib 誘發的凋亡。因此，其缺失與肝細胞癌中的腫瘤侵襲性與治療效能降低相關。

links.context: SIRT3 has a central protective role in acute kidney injury: deficiency exacerbates sepsis-induced tubular damage and apoptosis with increased Bax and caspase-3 and decreased Bcl-2, and aggravates fatty acid oxidation dysfunction. Honokiol activation increases ATP and reduces ROS and lipid peroxidation, while overexpression attenuates ischemia-reperfusion mitochondrial damage in the kidney.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在急性腎損傷中具有核心保護角色：缺失加劇敗血症誘發的管狀損傷與凋亡，伴隨 Bax 與 caspase-3 增加、Bcl-2 減少，並加劇脂肪酸氧化功能障礙。Honokiol 活化增加 ATP 並減少 ROS 與脂質過氧化，而過度表現減弱腎臟中的缺血—再灌流粒線體損傷。

links.context: SIRT3 indirectly destabilizes HIF1α and subsequently inhibits glycolysis and glucose oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 間接不穩定化 HIF1α，隨後抑制糖酵解和葡萄糖氧化。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 inhibits ROS (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制 ROS（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 inhibits lipogenesis (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制脂肪生成（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 inhibits p53 (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制 p53（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 is a prosurvival factor protecting against excitotoxic injury and is protective in ischemic stroke via HIF-1α/VEGF signalling in astrocytes. It is downregulated in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury, so enhancing SIRT3 alongside Wnt/β-catenin activation are proposed therapeutic targets for reducing infarct damage.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 是對抗 excitotoxic injury 的促存活因子，並透過星狀膠細胞中的 HIF-1α/VEGF 訊息在 ischemic stroke 中具保護作用。它在腦部缺血再灌注損傷中被下調，因此提升 SIRT3 搭配 Wnt/β-catenin 活化被提出作為減少梗塞損傷的治療標的。

links.context: SIRT3 is associated with Human aging (longevity); mitochondrial sirtuin activity and SIRT3 variants are linked to human longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 與人類衰老（長壽）相關；粒線體 sirtuin 活性和 SIRT3 變異與人類長壽相關。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 is described as tumor suppressor (decreased in breast/ovarian cancers); it is a tumor suppressor frequently downregulated in breast/ovarian cancers (Massudi et al., 2012).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在乳腺癌/卵巢癌中降低）；它是在乳腺癌/卵巢癌中經常下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Massudi et al., 2012）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 is downregulated in patients with kidney stones and is protective via the Nrf2/heme oxygenase-1 pathway. SIRT3-dependent antioxidant defense protects tubular epithelium from crystal-induced injury.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在腎結石患者中表現降低，並經由 Nrf2/血基質加氧酶-1 途徑具有保護作用。SIRT3 依賴的抗氧化防禦保護腎小管上皮免受晶體誘導的損傷。

links.context: SIRT3 is protective in diabetes mellitus: knockout impairs insulin-stimulated muscle glucose uptake leading to insulin resistance. In diabetic cardiomyopathy SIRT3 regulates fibrosis, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress, attenuating damage via reduced p53 acetylation and PFKFB3 upregulation. Deficiency aggravates hyperglycemic mitochondrial damage, ROS, necroptosis, and NLRP3 activation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有保護性：基因敲除損害胰島素刺激的肌肉葡萄糖攝取，導致胰島素抗性。在糖尿病性心肌病中，SIRT3 調節纖維化、發炎、凋亡與氧化壓力，經由降低 p53 乙醯化與 PFKFB3 上調來減弱損傷。缺失加劇高血糖粒線體損傷、ROS、壞死性凋亡與 NLRP3 活化。

links.context: SIRT3 is protective in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout of Takeda G protein-coupled receptor 5 suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. The protective SIRT1/SIRT3 axis is a targetable balance for organ protection.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 對肝臟缺血再灌注損傷具有保護作用：敲除 Takeda G 蛋白偶聯受體 5 會抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞並加重損傷。保護性的 SIRT1/SIRT3 軸是器官保護的可靶向平衡。

links.context: SIRT3 is the principal mitochondrial deacetylase, regulating the majority of the mitochondrial acetylome to sustain oxidative-phosphorylation enzymes, fatty-acid oxidation, and the TCA/mitochondrial electron transport chain; SIRT3 declines with age, impairing mitochondrial function (source review; Hebert et al., 2013).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，調節粒線體乙醯化組的大部分蛋白質以維持氧化磷酸化酶、脂肪酸氧化和 TCA/粒線體電子傳輸鏈；SIRT3 隨年齡下降，損害粒線體功能（文獻綜述；Hebert et al., 2013）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 is the principal mitochondrial deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from the majority of the mitochondrial acetylome - including respiratory-chain (Complex I/III), TCA-cycle (IDH2, SDH), beta-oxidation (LCAD), and antioxidant (MnSOD) enzymes - to tune bioenergetics; its activity is NAD+-dependent and rises with caloric restriction.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，從粒線體乙醯化組的大部分蛋白質上移除乙醯基團——包括呼吸鏈（複合體 I/III）、TCA 循環（IDH2、SDH）、β-氧化（LCAD）和抗氧化（MnSOD）酶——以調節生物能量學；其活性依賴 NAD+ 並在熱量限制時升高。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 manages mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating MnSOD and IDH2, boosting NADPH/glutathione antioxidant defense; this lowers mitochondrial superoxide and oxidative damage, protecting against cardiovascular, metabolic, and age-related injury.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD 和 IDH2 來管理粒線體 ROS，增強 NADPH/穀胱甘肽抗氧化防禦；這降低了粒線體超氧化物和氧化損傷，保護免受心血管、代謝和年齡相關的損傷。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 prevents cardiac hypertrophy during ageing; its deacetylase activity protects against age-related cardiac hypertrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在衰老過程中預防心臟肥大；其去乙醯酶活性保護免受年齡相關的心臟肥大。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 promotes fatty-acid beta-oxidation by deacetylating LCAD and other beta-oxidation enzymes, supporting energy harvest from fat during fasting; loss of SIRT3 impairs beta-oxidation efficiency and triggers hepatic steatosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化 LCAD 和其他 β-氧化酶來促進脂肪酸 β-氧化，支持禁食期間從脂肪中獲取能量；SIRT3 的缺失損害 β-氧化效率並引發肝脂肪變性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 promotes fatty-acid oxidation by deacetylating metabolic enzymes of β-oxidation and the TCA cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化 β-氧化和 TCA 循環的代謝酶來促進脂肪酸氧化。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 protects against Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury as the primary mitochondrial deacetylase. SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates reperfusion damage, because the enzyme normally sustains oxidative phosphorylation and mitochondrial quality control precisely when the mitochondrion is stressed during reflow.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 作為主要的粒線體去乙醯化酶，保護心臟免受 Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury。SIRT3 功能缺失會加重再灌流傷害，因為此酵素正是在再流動這個粒線體受壓的時刻維持氧化磷酸化與粒線體品質管制。

links.context: SIRT3 protects against kainic acid excitotoxicity via miR-134-5p inhibition in epilepsy. Alongside SIRT1 and SIRT5, SIRT3 constitutes a neuroprotective axis against seizure-related neuronal damage.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在癲癇中透過抑制 miR-134-5p 來保護海人酸（kainic acid）興奮毒性。與 SIRT1 及 SIRT5 並列，SIRT3 構成對抗癲癇相關神經元損傷的神經保護軸。

links.context: SIRT3 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating pyruvate dehydrogenase E1alpha to couple glycolysis to the TCA cycle and by supporting gluconeogenesis from amino acids via GDH; loss of SIRT3 causes PDH hyperacetylation and pyruvate/lactate accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1alpha 將糖酵解與 TCA 循環耦合，並透過 GDH 支持氨基酸糖質新生來調節碳水化合物代謝；SIRT3 的缺失導致 PDH 過度乙醯化和丙酮酸/乳酸積累。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 regulates cell death in a context-dependent manner: it is predominantly anti-apoptotic under stress (via MnSOD activation, Bcl-2 deacetylation, and cyclophilin D modulation) yet pro-apoptotic in some malignancies; it also governs ferroptosis susceptibility through mitochondrial ROS and lipid-peroxidation control.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 以環境依賴的方式調節細胞死亡：在壓力下主要為抗凋亡作用（透過 MnSOD 活化、Bcl-2 去乙醯化和親環素 D 調節），但在某些惡性腫瘤中為促凋亡作用；它還透過粒線體 ROS 和脂質過氧化控制來調節鐵死亡敏感性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 supports ATP production by deacetylating respiratory-chain complexes I and III and OSCP of the ATP synthase, optimizing electron transport and coupling proton flux to ATP synthesis; loss of SIRT3 impairs oxidative phosphorylation and lowers ATP output.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 以及 ATP 合酶的 OSCP 來支持 ATP 產生，優化電子傳輸並將質子流與 ATP 合成耦合；SIRT3 的缺失損害氧化磷酸化並降低 ATP 產量。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 supports insulin sensitivity by maintaining mitochondrial OXPHOS efficiency and reducing oxidative stress in metabolic tissues. Decline of NAMPT and NAD+ with age lowers sirtuin activity and impairs insulin responsiveness, whereas SIRT6 deficiency causes profound insulin resistance and fatty liver in mice.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由維持粒線體 OXPHOS 效率並降低代謝組織中的 Oxidative Stress 來支持 Insulin Sensitivity。NAMPT 與 NAD+ 隨老化下降會降低 sirtuin 活性並損害胰島素反應性，而 SIRT6 缺失則在小鼠中造成嚴重的胰島素阻抗與脂肪肝。

links.context: SIRT3 supports ketogenesis and energy balance during fasting by activating enzymes of fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial metabolism, providing ketone bodies as alternative fuel; SIRT3 is induced by caloric restriction and fasting.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過活化脂肪酸氧化和粒線體代謝的酶來支持禁食期間的生酮作用和能量平衡，提供酮體作為替代燃料；SIRT3 受熱量限制和禁食誘導。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT3 supports lipid metabolism by activating fatty-acid beta-oxidation enzymes (LCAD) while suppressing lipogenesis (ACC1), favoring oxidative disposal of lipids; its actions oppose SIRT4's lipid-conserving brake, and the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance governs hepatic fat handling.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過活化脂肪酸 β-氧化酶（LCAD）同時抑制脂肪生成（ACC1）來支持脂質代謝，促進脂質的氧化分解；其作用與 SIRT4 的脂質保存制動相反，SIRT3/SIRT4 的平衡調控肝臟脂肪處理。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 destabilizes Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α (MTPα, HADHB) in hepatocytes, shifting metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward anabolic lipid conservation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 在肝細胞中使 Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α（MTPα，HADHB）去穩定，使代謝由粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成型脂質保存。

links.context: SIRT4 inhibits fatty-acid oxidation at the mitochondria by suppressing malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (MCD) ADP-ribosylase activity and restraining oxidative fuel use, an adaptive suppression that rises under calorie restriction; during aging its dysregulation perturbs metabolic fuel selection (source review).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制丙二醯輔酶 A 脫羧酶（MCD）ADP-核糖基酶活性並抑制氧化燃料使用來抑制粒線體中的脂肪酸氧化，這種適應性抑制在熱量限制下升高；在衰老過程中，其失調干擾代謝燃料選擇（文獻綜述）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 inhibits glutamine metabolism by suppressing GDH-dependent anaplerosis, acting as a tumor suppressor in colorectal and other cancers that depend on glutamine; this restrains the glutamine addiction of proliferating cells.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 依賴性的回補反應來抑制穀胺酸代謝，在依賴穀胺酸的結直腸癌和其他癌症中作為腫瘤抑制因子；這抑制了增殖細胞對穀胺酸的成癮性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 is a mitochondrial ADP-ribosyl transferase that suppresses glutamine metabolism as its central tumor-suppressive mechanism in breast cancer, HCC, colorectal cancer, and gastric cancer. In breast cancer this represses SIRT1 activity via mitochondrial-nuclear crosstalk, and in colorectal cancer it upregulates E-cadherin while suppressing proliferation, migration, and invasion. SIRT4 also increases sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 是一種粒線體 ADP-ribosyl 轉移酶，在乳癌、HCC、大腸癌與胃癌中，透過抑制麩醯胺代謝作為其中心的腫瘤抑制機制。在乳癌中，這透過粒線體—核交互作用抑制 SIRT1 活性；在大腸癌中，它上調 E-cadherin 同時抑制增生、遷移與侵犯。SIRT4 亦透過抑制細胞週期增加對 5-fluorouracil 的敏感性。

links.context: SIRT4 is described as tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers); it is a tumor suppressor downregulated in multiple cancers (Wu et al., 2022).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在癌症中下調）；它是在多種癌症中下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Wu et al., 2022）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 is expressed at lower levels in HCC tissue and low tumor levels predict decreased survival. It functions as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting glutamine metabolism, and it upregulates p16 and p21 while suppressing CyclinB1, Cdc2, and Cdc25c to induce apoptosis. Low SIRT4 therefore marks an aggressive, therapy-resistant HCC phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 在 HCC 組織中表現較低，且腫瘤低水平預測存活下降。它透過抑制麩醯胺代謝作為腫瘤抑制因子，並上調 p16 與 p21，同時抑制 CyclinB1、Cdc2 與 Cdc25c 以誘發凋亡。因此低 SIRT4 標記出侵襲性、治療抗性的 HCC 表型。

links.context: SIRT4 is the denominator of the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio; its activity tilts the balance toward the toxicity branch of the hormetic window.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 是 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例的分母；其活性使平衡傾向激素性窗口的毒性分支。

links.context: SIRT4 negatively regulates insulin secretion in pancreatic beta cells by repressing glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH) activity, and its overexpression drives dyslipidemia and lipogenesis while deactivating AMPK. It thus opposes SIRT1's protective role in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 藉由抑制 glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH) 活性，負向調控胰臟 beta cell 的 insulin secretion；其過量表現會造成血脂異常與脂肪生成，並使 AMPK 去活化。因此 SIRT4 與 SIRT1 在 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 中的保護角色相反。

links.context: SIRT4 possesses primary mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, using NAD+ to attach a single ADP-ribose moiety to target proteins. Unlike its deacetylase outputs, this reaction is used for targeted inhibition: SIRT4 ribosylates and inhibits Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH) in pancreatic β-cells, suppressing insulin secretion in response to glutamine.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 具有主要的單一 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，利用 NAD+ 將單一 ADP-核糖基團接到底物蛋白上。與其去乙醯化作用不同，這個反應被用來進行針對性抑制：SIRT4 在胰臟 β 細胞中對 Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH) 進行核糖基化並抑制之，藉此在麩醯胺酸反應下壓抑胰島素分泌。

links.context: SIRT4 reduces AMPK signaling by opposing upstream LKB1/energy-sensing inputs, blunting catabolic (fatty-acid-oxidation) signaling in favor of anabolic metabolism; AMPK is reciprocally listed among SIRT4 negative regulators in Table 3 (e.g., via ADP/ATP-driven activation opposing SIRT4's anabolic bias; reviewed in the source review).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過拮抗上游 LKB1/能量感知輸入來降低 AMPK 信號，減弱分解代謝（脂肪酸氧化）信號，有利於合成代謝；AMPK 作為 SIRT4 的負向調節因子列於表 3 中（例如透過 ADP/ATP 驅動的活化拮抗 SIRT4 的合成代謝偏向；參見文獻綜述）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion by mono-ADP-ribosylating and inhibiting glutamate dehydrogenase, limiting anaplerotic ATP generation in beta-cells; caloric restriction downregulates SIRT4 to improve beta-cell metabolic flexibility.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過單 ADP-核糖基化並抑制穀氨酸脫氫酶來抑制氨基酸刺激的胰島素分泌，限制 β 細胞中回補性 ATP 的生成；熱量限制下調 SIRT4 以改善 β 細胞的代謝靈活性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 suppresses apoptosis mainly by inhibiting mitochondrial glutamine metabolism (ADP-ribosylating GDH) and by dampening inducers such as PGC-1α/AMPK, protecting cells from genotoxic stress; SIRT4 loss in contexts like HCC promotes apoptosis, while its decline with stress affects tumor suppression and aging (source review).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 主要透過抑制粒線體穀胺酸代謝（ADP-核糖基化 GDH）並減弱 PGC-1α/AMPK 等誘導因子來抑制凋亡，保護細胞免受基因毒性壓力；SIRT4 在 HCC 等環境中的缺失促進凋亡，而其隨壓力的下降影響腫瘤抑制和衰老（文獻綜述）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid metabolism by inhibiting MTPalpha and repressing PPARalpha, promoting lipid conservation under nutrient-replete conditions; this contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5 and makes SIRT4 a mitochondrial anabolic brake.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 MTPalpha 並抑制 PPARalpha 來抑制脂肪酸代謝，在營養充足條件下促進脂質保存；這與 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，使 SIRT4 成為粒線體合成代謝的制動器。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 suppresses mitochondrial ROS production through its regulatory effects on GDH/PDH and fuel oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過其對 GDH/PDH 和燃料氧化的調節作用抑制粒線體 ROS 的產生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT4 upregulates E-cadherin in colorectal cancer while suppressing proliferation, migration, and invasion via glutamine-metabolism inhibition. SIRT4 also increases sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle, cementing its tumor-suppressive role in CRC.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 在大腸癌中上調 E-cadherin，同時透過抑制麩醯胺代謝抑制增生、遷移與侵犯。SIRT4 亦透過抑制細胞週期增加對 5-fluorouracil 的敏感性，鞏固其在 CRC 中的腫瘤抑制角色。

links.context: SIRT4 uses its mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity to modify and inhibit Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH) in pancreatic β-cells. The resulting suppression of GDH-linked insulin secretion in response to glutamine illustrates how a sirtuin can achieve signal-specific regulation through ADP-ribosylation rather than through deacetylation of the same enzyme.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT4 運用其單一 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，修飾並抑制胰臟 β 細胞中的 Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH)。由此造成的、對麩醯胺酸反應之 GDH 連結胰島素分泌壓抑，說明 sirtuin 如何藉由 ADP-核糖基化而非對同一酵素去乙醯化，達成訊號特異性的調節。

links.context: SIRT5 activates fatty-acid oxidation enzymes (VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA) via desuccinylation, supporting lipid catabolism during fasting; SIRT5 deficiency impairs fatty-acid metabolism and lowers ATP.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化活化脂肪酸氧化酶（VLCAD、LCAD、MCAD、ECHA），支持禁食期間的脂質分解代謝；SIRT5 缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝並降低 ATP。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 deacetylates (and desuccinylates) carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification; SIRT5-KO mice show elevated blood ammonia under fasting (Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 去乙醯化（並去琥珀酰化）氨甲醯磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1）——尿素循環的限速酶——增強氨解毒；SIRT5-KO 小鼠在禁食時顯示血氨升高（Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates GDH to inhibit its activity (opposite to SIRT4, which ADP-ribosylates GDH), so high GDH activity counters SIRT5-dependent restraint of glutamine metabolism; GDH is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT5 pathway in Table 3.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化 GDH 以抑制其活性（與 SIRT4 ADP-核糖基化 GDH 的作用相反），因此高 GDH 活性對抗 SIRT5 依賴性的穀胺酸代謝限制；GDH 被列為表 3 中 SIRT5 通路的負向調節因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates SHMT2 at Lys280, which also promotes SHMT2 activity and cancer cell proliferation (demonstrated in hepatocellular carcinoma). Together with SIRT3-mediated K95 deacetylation and HDAC11-mediated K95 defatty-acylation, this illustrates how the same residue of SHMT2 is targeted by competing modifications in the PTM landscape.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 在 Lys280 去琥珀醯化 SHMT2，同樣促進 SHMT2 活性與癌細胞增殖（於肝細胞癌中證實）。連同 SIRT3 介導的 K95 去乙醯化與 HDAC11 介導的 K95 去脂肪醯化，這說明 SHMT2 的同一殘基可被互相競爭的修飾在轉譯後修飾景觀中調控。

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates CPS1, the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification during fasting; SIRT5-knockout mice show elevated blood ammonia under nitrogen load.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化並活化 CPS1——尿素循環的限速酶——增強禁食期間的氨解毒；SIRT5 敲除小鼠在氮負荷下顯示血氨升高。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates and thereby activates HMGCS2, the rate-limiting mitochondrial enzyme of ketogenesis that converts acetyl-CoA to HMG-CoA. This is a specific instance of SIRT5's broader control of mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism during fasting.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 對 HMGCS2 進行去琥珀醯化並因此將其活化；HMGCS2 是酮體生成的限速粒線體酵素，負責將 acetyl-CoA 轉換為 HMG-CoA。這是 SIRT5 在禁食期間更廣泛調控粒線體醯基輔酶 A 代謝的具體例子。

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates enzymes of the urea cycle and electron-transport chain to sustain mitochondrial function under ammonia and oxidative stress, mitigating accumulation of damaged mitochondria with age; it also supports antioxidant capacity during fasting (source review; Nakagawa et al., 2009).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化尿素循環和電子傳輸鏈的酶以在氨和氧化壓力下維持粒線體功能，減輕受損粒線體隨年齡的積累；它還在禁食期間支持抗氧化能力（文獻綜述；Nakagawa et al., 2009）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 desuccinylates pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) to suppress its activity, favoring glutamine-dependent anaplerosis over glucose oxidation; PDH activity is thus reciprocally regulated and listed among negative regulators/opponents of SIRT5's metabolic program in Table 3 (Park et al., 2013, PMC3769971).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯基化作用抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶（PDH）的活性，使其偏向穀氨醯胺依賴性的回補反應而非葡萄糖氧化；因此 PDH 活性受到反向調節，並被列入表 3 中 SIRT5 代謝程序的負向調節因子或拮抗物（Park et al., 2013, PMC3769971）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 expression in pancreatic cancer directly correlates with favorable prognosis; its loss promotes GOT1 acetylation, driving proliferation via glutamine and glutathione metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 在胰臟癌中的表現與良好預後直接相關；其喪失會促進 GOT1 乙醯化，經由麩醯胺酸與穀胱甘肽代謝驅動增殖。

links.context: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 interacts with and desuccinylates ME2 at K346, increasing ME2 activity and promoting colorectal cancer growth - the mirror-image modification to SIRT3's inhibitory delactylation at the nearby K352.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 與 ME2 互動並在 K346 位點進行去琥珀醯化，提高 ME2 活性並促進結直腸癌生長，與 SIRT3 在鄰近 K352 的抑制性去乳醯化恰為鏡像。

links.context: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 modulates apoptosis by desuccinylating/deacylating death-related and metabolic targets (e.g., LDHB, SOD1) and by supporting cell survival under oxidative and ammonia stress; in cancer it can be pro- or anti-apoptotic depending on context.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化/去酰基化死亡相關和代謝靶點（例如 LDHB、SOD1）以及支持細胞在氧化和氨壓力下的存活來調節凋亡；在癌症中，它可以根據環境發揮促凋亡或抗凋亡作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 regulates fuel oxidation via desuccinylation/deglycylidation of mitochondrial enzymes including CPS1 and components of fatty-acid oxidation, supporting metabolic flexibility under fasting and during aging; its age-related changes affect liver and muscle energetics (source review; Park et al., 2013).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化/去甘氨醯化粒線體酶（包括 CPS1 和脂肪酸氧化的組成成分）來調節燃料氧化，支持禁食和衰老過程中的代謝靈活性；其與年齡相關的變化影響肝臟和肌肉能量學（文獻綜述；Park et al., 2013）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 acts as a lipid-homeostasis brake by suppressing SREBP2, whose derepression in a SIRT6-deficient liver yields steatosis and reduced fatty acid oxidation. The SIRT6–SREBP2 relation is therefore a defined axis, and restoring or mimicking SIRT6 activity is a plausible route to lower hepatic cholesterol synthesis and lipogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 藉由抑制 SREBP2 而成為脂質恆定的煞車；在缺乏 SIRT6 的肝臟中，SREBP2 被解除抑制會導致肝脂肪變性與脂肪酸氧化下降。因此 SIRT6–SREBP2 是一條定義明確的軸，恢復或模擬 SIRT6 活性是降低肝臟膽固醇合成與脂肪生成的可行途徑。

links.context: SIRT6 acts as a negative modulator of IGF-1 signaling: SIRT6 overexpression reduces IGF-1 pathway activity, improving glucose tolerance and reducing fat accumulation. This links sirtuin activity to the somatotropic longevity axis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 是 IGF-1 訊號的負向調控者：SIRT6 過度表現降低 IGF-1 途徑活性，改善葡萄糖耐受並減少脂肪累積。這將 sirtuin 活性與體生長激素長壽軸相連結。

links.context: SIRT6 attenuates NF-kB signaling via histone H3 lysine 9 (H3K9) deacetylation at the chromatin of NF-kB target gene promoters, which are related to apoptosis and cellular senescence. Alongside SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT3, which suppress both NF-kB and NLRP3 inflammasome activity through multiple mechanisms, SIRT6 helps coordinate the intensity of inflammatory responses and prevent cytokine storms. Because sirtuins are NAD+-dependent, NAD+ precursor supplementation that raises NAD+ levels can reinforce this sirtuin-mediated restraint of NF-kB-driven inflammation, linking NAD+ metabolism to control of the pro-inflammatory transcription program during infection and aging.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過在 NF-kB 標的基因啟動子的染色質上進行組蛋白 H3 離胺酸 9（H3K9）去乙醯化，減弱 NF-kB 訊息傳導，這些基因與凋亡和細胞衰老相關。與 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT3 一起——後者透過多種機制抑制 NF-kB 與 NLRP3 發炎體活性——SIRT6 協助協調發炎反應的強度並預防細胞激素風暴。由於去乙醯酶是 NAD+ 依賴性的，提升 NAD+ 水平的 NAD+ 前驅物補充可強化此去乙醯酶介導的 NF-kB 驅動發炎抑制，將 NAD+ 代謝連結到感染與老化期間促發炎轉錄程式的控制。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: SIRT6 blocks IGF-Akt Signaling to forestall maladaptive cardiac hypertrophy. SIRT6 acts upstream of repression by targeting c-Jun, interrupting a pro-hypertrophic survival pathway; this cardioprotective sirtuin mechanism is distinct from the AMPK/PGC-1α metabolic axis used by SIRT3, illustrating how individual sirtuins calibrate distinct downstream programs. Reduced IGF-Akt activity is also associated with longevity in model organisms.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 阻斷 IGF-Akt Signaling 以避免不適應性的心臟肥大。SIRT6 以標的 c-Jun 的方式在抑制的上游發揮作用，切斷促肥大的存活路徑；這種保護心臟的 sirtuin 機制與 SIRT3 所使用的 AMPK/PGC-1α 代謝軸不同，顯示個別 sirtuin 會校準不同的下游程式。IGF-Akt 活性降低也與模式生物的長壽相關。

links.context: SIRT6 co-represses c-Jun to inhibit IGF-AKT hypertrophic signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 共同抑制 c-Jun，以抑制 IGF-AKT 肥大信號。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 cooperates with p53 in the DNA-damage response, maintaining p53 activity under oxidative stress and supporting p53/p21-dependent checkpoints, while SIRT6-dependent genomic stability also favors p53 function. Because p53 is contextually listed as both a positive and a negative regulator of the SIRT6 pathway, the relationship is stress-regulated and context-dependent rather than purely linear.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應中與 p53 協同，在氧化壓力下維持 p53 活性並支持 p53/p21 依賴性的檢查點，同時 SIRT6 依賴性的基因組穩定性也有利於 p53 功能。由於 p53 在不同環境中被列為 SIRT6 通路的正向和負向調節因子，因此這種關係是壓力調節和環境依賴的，而非純粹的線性關係。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 coordinates stress responses by promoting DNA repair (H3K9/H3K56, CtIP, PARP1), maintaining genomic stability, and coactivating Nrf2 antioxidant programs; it protects cells and tissues from oxidative and genotoxic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過促進 DNA 修復（H3K9/H3K56、CtIP、PARP1）、維持基因組穩定性和共同活化 Nrf2 抗氧化程序來協調壓力反應；它保護細胞和組織免受氧化和基因毒性壓力。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates ChREBP (alongside SREBP-1c) to maintain hepatic lipid homeostasis and oppose fatty liver disease. Loss of SIRT6 elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice in part through loss of ChREBP/SREBP-1c control.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 ChREBP（與 SREBP-1c 並行）以維持肝臟脂質恆定並對抗脂肪肝。在 NASH 小鼠中 SIRT6 缺失會部分因失去 ChREBP/SREBP-1c 控制而加重纖維化與氧化壓力。

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates CtIP (RBBP8) as one of its specific protein substrates, alongside H3K9Ac, H3K56Ac, and GCN5. This deacetylation is one route through which SIRT6 maintains genomic stability, metabolic homeostasis, and inflammatory control (Giblin et al. 2014).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 將 CtIP（RBBP8）去乙醯化，與 H3K9Ac、H3K56Ac 及 GCN5 並列為其特定蛋白質受質。此去乙醯化是 SIRT6 維持基因體穩定性、代謝恆定與發炎調控的途徑之一（Giblin et al. 2014）。

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates H2BK12ac, contributing to its chromatin-silencing/heterochromatin program.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H2BK12ac，有助於其染色質沉默/異染色質程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeres and stabilizes WRN helicase, preventing telomere dysfunction-induced senescence; SIRT6-depleted cells undergo accelerated telomere replication problems and senescence (Michishita et al., 2008, Cell; source review).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化端粒處的 H3K9 並穩定 WRN 解旋酶，防止端粒功能障礙引起的衰老；SIRT6 缺失的細胞出現加速的端粒複製問題及衰老現象（Michishita et al., 2008, Cell; 來源文獻）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeric regions in response to DNA damage and stabilizes the WRN helicase at telomeres, tightening telomere structure and preventing dysfunction during replication. Directionally, SIRT6 maintains telomere integrity. Loss of SIRT6 causes H3K9 hyperacetylation and chromatin relaxation at telomeres, tying it to genomic stability in ageing.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應中去乙醯化端粒區域的 H3K9，並在端粒處穩定 WRN 解旋酶，緊密化端粒結構並防止複製過程中的功能障礙。方向性上 SIRT6 維護端粒完整性。SIRT6 的缺失導致端粒處 H3K9 超乙醯化和染色質鬆弛，將其與老化的基因組穩定性聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 on NF-κB (p65) target-gene promoters to repress NF-κB-dependent inflammation, and conversely NF-κB activation opposes SIRT6's anti-inflammatory/genome-stability program in aging; Table 3 lists NF-κB among negative regulators of SIRT6 (Kawahara et al., 2009, Cell).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 NF-κB（p65）靶基因啟動子上的 H3K9，以抑制 NF-κB 依賴的發炎反應；反之，NF-κB 的活化對抗 SIRT6 在老化中的抗發炎及基因組穩定程序；表 3 將 NF-κB 列為 SIRT6 的負向調節因子（Kawahara et al., 2009, Cell）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 on telomeric chromatin and suppresses LINE-1 retrotransposon activity, maintaining genome stability and telomere function; SIRT6-deficient cells show genomic instability, telomere defects, and cellular senescence (Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化端粒染色質上的 H3K9，並抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄轉座子活性，維持基因組穩定性和端粒功能；SIRT6 缺乏的細胞表現出基因組不穩定、端粒缺陷及細胞衰老（Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates Histone H3 at lysine 9 (H3K9ac) on chromatin flanking DNA double-strand breaks, a modification that permits proper 53BP1 recruitment and commitment to NHEJ. SIRT6-deficient cells consequently show impaired 53BP1 focus formation and persistent γ-H2AX signaling, so co-detection of 53BP1 and γ-H2AX foci is the standard readout for SIRT6-dependent genome maintenance in UBCS039 or MDL-800 activation studies.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 雙股斷裂兩側的染色質上將組蛋白 H3 的離胺酸 9 去乙醯化（H3K9ac），此修飾使 53BP1 能正確被招募並投入 NHEJ。因此 SIRT6 缺失的細胞會出現 53BP1 焦點形成受損與持續的 γ-H2AX 訊號，故在 UBCS039 或 MDL-800 的活化研究中，53BP1 與 γ-H2AX 焦點的共同偵測是評估 SIRT6 依賴性基因體維持的標準讀值。

links.context: SIRT6 deacetylates the Werner helicase WRN, supporting DNA repair and telomere maintenance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 Werner 解旋酶 WRN，支持 DNA 修復和端粒維護。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 deficiency accelerates Atherosclerosis through dysregulation of PCSK9 and consequent LDL accumulation, indicating that SIRT6 normally constrains PCSK9-driven plasma LDL elevation and vascular disease. PCSK9 itself is a secreted protease that drives LDL receptor degradation, so SIRT6 acts upstream to limit the atherogenic node.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 缺失會透過 PCSK9 的失調與隨之而來的 LDL 累積而加速 Atherosclerosis，表示 SIRT6 正常情況下會約束 PCSK9 驅動的血漿 LDL 升高與血管疾病。PCSK9 本身是促進 LDL 受體降解的分泌型蛋白酶，因此 SIRT6 在上游作用以限制這個致粥樣硬化節點。

links.context: SIRT6 exhibits mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity alongside deacetylation and deacylation. Under DNA damage it ribosylates proteins such as PARP1, stimulating their double-strand break repair activity, and ribosylates Kap1 to suppress transposable elements — showing that sirtuin ADP-ribosylation serves as a second, non-deacetylase route by which the NAD+-dependent family controls genome maintenance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 除去乙醯化與去醯化之外，也展現單一 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性。在 DNA 損傷下，它會對 PARP1 等蛋白進行核糖基化以促進其雙股斷裂修復活性，並核糖基化 Kap1 以抑制轉位元件，顯示 sirtuin 的 ADP-核糖基化是這個 NAD+ 依賴家族控制基因體維持的第二條非去乙醯化途徑。

links.context: SIRT6 expression blocks the development of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 表達阻斷心臟肥大和心臟衰竭的發展。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 functions in DNA repair; as the nuclear/chromatin sirtuin it guards genome integrity, telomeres, metabolism, and inflammation (Mostoslavsky 2006; Mao 2011 PMID 21680843). It is a core DNA double-strand-break repair factor: recruited to DSBs, it deacetylates H3K9/H3K56 and CtIP and stimulates PARP1 to promote homologous recombination and genomic stability (Kaidi et al., 2010, PMC2943420).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 參與 DNA 修復功能；作為細胞核/染色質 sirtuin，它維護基因組完整性、端粒、代謝和發炎調控（Mostoslavsky 2006; Mao 2011 PMID 21680843）。SIRT6 是 DNA 雙股斷裂修復的核心因子：被招募至 DSB 處後，它去乙醯化 H3K9/H3K56 及 CtIP，並刺激 PARP1 促進同源重組及基因組穩定性（Kaidi et al., 2010, PMC2943420）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 harbors a C-terminal intrinsically disordered region (amino acids 298–355) that encompasses the centenarian mutations N308K and A313S, and vimentin contains N- and C-terminal IDRs; interaction between these IDRs regulates SIRT6 protein stability.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 帶有一個 C 端內在無序區（胺基酸 298–355），其中包含百歲老人突變 N308K 與 A313S；vimentin 則在 N 端與 C 端各有一個 IDR，這些 IDR 之間的交互作用調控 SIRT6 的蛋白質穩定性。

links.context: SIRT6 has a nephron-specific protective role in fibrosis: proximal tubule-specific SIRT6 knockout aggravates UUO-induced fibrosis, whereas the SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates it. Together with SIRT1 and SIRT3 as protective and SIRT2 as context-dependent modulators, the sirtuin network offers multiple anti-fibrotic intervention points in the kidney.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在纖維化中具有腎元特異性的保護作用：近端小管專一性 SIRT6 敲除會加重 UUO 誘發的纖維化，而 SIRT6 活化劑 MDL-800 則可減輕之。連同具保護作用的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3，以及情境依賴性調節因子 SIRT2，sirtuin 網絡在腎臟中提供了多個抗纖維化介入點。

links.context: SIRT6 inhibition shortens vascular smooth muscle cell lifespan and induces senescence via telomeric H3K9 hyperacetylation and 53BP1 binding, while SIRT6 overexpression preserves telomere integrity. SIRT6 deacetylates Pol-beta to confer DNA-damage resistance and prevent progeroid pathologies. SIRT6 is therefore a genome-stability guardian whose loss drives senescence and whose gain extends cellular lifespan.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制透過端粒 H3K9 過乙醯化與 53BP1 結合縮短血管平滑肌細胞壽命並誘發衰老，而 SIRT6 過度表現維持端粒完整性。SIRT6 去乙醯化 Pol-beta 以賦予 DNA 損傷抗性並防止早老病理。SIRT6 因此是基因體穩定性守護者，其缺失驅動衰老，而其增益延長細胞壽命。

links.context: SIRT6 inhibits IGF-1/AKT signaling (e.g., co-repressing c-Jun), protecting against cardiac hypertrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制 IGF-1/AKT 信號（例如共同抑制 c-Jun），保護免受心臟肥大。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 inhibits PGC-1α (e.g., by deacetylation), modulating gluconeogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制 PGC-1α（例如透過去乙醯化），調節糖質新生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 inhibits isoproterenol-induced cardiac hypertrophy through multiple parallel pathways: promoting autophagy via FoxO3 nuclear retention from Akt attenuation, decreasing p300 and NF-kB p65 acetylation, blocking IGF-Akt signaling through c-Jun, and suppressing STAT3. Each of these inputs converges on dampening the pathological growth response, making SIRT6 a consistently protective factor in cardiac hypertrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過多條平行路徑抑制 isoproterenol 誘發的心臟肥大：經由 Akt 減弱導致 FoxO3 核保留而促進自噬、降低 p300 與 NF-kB p65 乙醯化、透過 c-Jun 阻斷 IGF-Akt 訊號，以及抑制 STAT3。這些輸入皆匯聚於減弱病理性生長反應，使 SIRT6 在心臟肥大中始終為保護因子。

links.context: SIRT6 is a principal repressor of LINE-1 and other transposable elements. Age-related loss of SIRT6, together with heterochromatin erosion and reduced Piwi/KRAB-ZNF control, allows transposable element derepression, so SIRT6 activity links epigenetic silencing to genome stability and exceptional longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 是 LINE-1 等 transposable elements 的主要抑制者。隨 Aging 伴隨的 SIRT6 下降、heterochromatin 侵蝕以及 Piwi/KRAB-ZNF 控制減弱，使 transposable elements 去抑制，因此 SIRT6 活性把表觀遺傳沉默與基因體穩定性及非凡長壽連結起來。

links.context: SIRT6 is a prominent cardioprotective sirtuin, as loss of SIRT6 in mice resulted in the development of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure, while cardiac-specific SIRT6 overexpression protects the heart from hypertrophic stimuli by blocking activation of Akt signaling at the level of chromatin. Alongside SIRT1 and SIRT2, SIRT6 has emerged as a key mediator of the benefits of NAD+ precursor supplementation in the cardiovascular system. SIRT6 is a nuclear, chromatin-associated NAD+-dependent deacetylase involved in telomerase protection, genome stability, cholesterol homeostasis, and glucose metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 是一個顯著的心臟保護型 sirtuin，因為小鼠中 SIRT6 的缺失會導致心臟肥大與心衰竭的發生，而心臟特異性 SIRT6 過表現則透過在染色質層次阻斷 Akt 訊號的活化，保護心臟免於肥大刺激。與 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 並列，SIRT6 已成為 NAD+ 前驅物補充在心血管系統中益處的關鍵介導者。SIRT6 是一種位於細胞核、與染色質相關的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，參與端粒酶保護、基因組穩定性、膽固醇恆定與葡萄糖代謝。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: SIRT6 is decreased in chronic heart failure, but its overexpression increases survival of TAC-induced heart failure mice via telomerase upregulation (TERT, TRF1). Together with SIRT1, this makes SIRT6 a cardioprotective sirtuin whose loss accompanies disease progression.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性心衰竭中下降，但過量表現可透過端粒酶（TERT、TRF1）上調提高 TAC 誘發心衰竭小鼠的存活率。與 SIRT1 共同顯示 SIRT6 是具有心臟保護作用的 sirtuin，其喪失伴隨疾病進展。

links.context: SIRT6 is described as tumor suppressor protein (TSP); it is a tumor-suppressor protein whose deficiency causes genomic instability and premature aging.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 被描述為腫瘤抑制蛋白（TSP）；它是一種腫瘤抑制蛋白，其缺乏導致基因組不穩定和早衰。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 is downregulated in gastric cancer where low expression negatively correlates with tumor size and pathological grade and predicts poor prognosis. It inhibits the JAK2/STAT3 pathway to suppress growth, and SIRT6 silencing overcomes sorafenib resistance by promoting ferroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在胃癌中下調，其中低表現與腫瘤大小與病理分級負相關，並預測不良預後。它抑制 JAK2/STAT3 路徑以抑制生長，且 SIRT6 靜默透過促進鐵蛋白死亡克服 sorafenib 抗性。

links.context: SIRT6 is downregulated in lipid metabolism-related diseases including Metabolic Syndrome, and SIRT6 overexpression improves hypercholesterolemia by recruiting FOXO3 to the SREBP2 promoter, where it deacetylates H3K9 and H3K56. Enhancing SIRT6 activity is therefore proposed to improve the dyslipidemia component of metabolic syndrome.
links.context_zh_TW: 在包含 Metabolic Syndrome 在內的脂質代謝相關疾病中，SIRT6 會下調；而 SIRT6 的過量表現可藉由招募 FOXO3 至 SREBP2 啟動子、並對 H3K9 與 H3K56 去乙醯化來改善高膽固醇血症。因此提升 SIRT6 活性被提出可改善代謝症候群的血脂異常組成。

links.context: SIRT6 is markedly downregulated in chronic kidney disease and vascular calcification patients, and it suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells. Preservation of SIRT6 inhibits vascular calcification.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性腎病與血管鈣化患者中顯著下調，並抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化。保存 SIRT6 可抑制血管鈣化。

links.context: SIRT6 is one of the chromatin modifiers known to relocalize from its native genomic loci to Double-Strand Break sites during DNA repair. Repeated activation of this damage-response program disrupts youthful gene-expression patterns and can de-repress retrotransposons.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 是已知會在 DNA 修復過程中由原本的基因組位點轉位至 Double-Strand Break 處的染色質修飾蛋白之一。此損傷反應程式的反覆活化會破壞年輕時的基因表現模式，並可能去抑制 retrotransposon。

links.context: SIRT6 is the clearest anti-Warburg sirtuin: it corepresses HIF-1alpha and suppresses transcription of glycolytic enzymes (glucose transporters, Hexokinase 2) and deacetylates histone H3 at ERK1/2 promoters. Loss of SIRT6 permits Warburg-like aerobic glycolysis; its restoration suppresses glycolysis in HCC/glioma and enhances radiosensitivity in lung cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 是最明確的抗 Warburg sirtuin：它共抑制 HIF-1alpha 並抑制糖解酵素（葡萄糖轉運蛋白、Hexokinase 2）的轉錄，並在 ERK1/2 啟動子去乙醯化 histones H3。SIRT6 缺失容許 Warburg 樣有氧糖解；其恢復抑制 HCC／神經膠質瘤中的糖解並增強肺癌中的放射敏感性。

links.context: SIRT6 maintains metabolic homeostasis by repressing HIF-1alpha and c-MYC to limit glycolysis, deacetylating H3K9 at glycolytic promoters, and restraining lipogenesis (SREBP-1c/2) and insulin/IGF-1 signaling while promoting lipolysis via FoxO1-ATGL; it protects against diet-induced obesity and diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過抑制 HIF-1α 和 c-MYC 來限制糖酵解，去乙醯化糖酵解啟動子上的 H3K9，並抑制脂肪生成（SREBP-1c/2）和胰島素/IGF-1 信號同時透過 FoxO1-ATGL 促進脂解，從而維持代謝恆定；它保護免受飲食誘導的肥胖和糖尿病。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 maintains telomere function by deacetylating H3K9 at telomeric chromatin and stabilizing WRN helicase, preventing telomere dysfunction-induced senescence; it also preserves the telomere position effect, linking SIRT6 to genome stability.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化端粒染色質中的 H3K9 並穩定 WRN 解旋酶來維持端粒功能，防止端粒功能障礙引發的衰老；它還維持端粒位置效應，將 SIRT6 與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 overexpression extends lifespan in male mice and is required for healthy aging, acting through DNA repair, metabolic regulation, and inflammation control; as with SIRT1, SIRT6 activity is NAD+-dependent and declines with age (Kanfi et al., 2012, Nature; source review).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表現可延長雄性小鼠的壽命，且是健康老化的必要條件，其作用機制涉及 DNA 修復、代謝調節和發炎控制；與 SIRT1 相似，SIRT6 的活性依賴 NAD+ 並隨年齡增長而下降（Kanfi et al., 2012, Nature; 來源文獻）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 overexpression extends lifespan in male mice with a median gain around 14%, and the mechanism runs through lowered serum IGF-1, raised IGFBP1 and reduced p-AKT/p-FOXO to female levels. Female mice show no significant lifespan effect in the original study, and the human Finnish longevity association at rs117385980 is also male-specific, making SIRT6 a male-leaning growth and longevity node.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表達可延長雄性小鼠壽命，中位數增益約 14%，其機制是降低血清 IGF-1、升高 IGFBP1，並把 p-AKT／p-FOXO 降到雌性水準。在原始研究中雌性小鼠的壽命效果不顯著，人類芬蘭族 rs117385980 的長壽關聯也同樣是雄性特異的，因此 SIRT6 是偏雄性的生長與長壽節點。

links.context: SIRT6 overexpression protects mice from diet-induced obesity, with increased glucose tolerance and reduced fat accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 過表達保護小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，具有增加的葡萄糖耐受性和減少的脂肪積累。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 preserves Rspo1 expression to confer intestinal epithelium injury resistance in inflammatory bowel disease. Rspo1 potentiates canonical Wnt signaling by stabilizing the LGR5 receptor complex, maintaining intestinal stem-cell function.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 保存 Rspo1 表現，以賦予發炎性腸病中腸道上皮的損傷抵抗力。Rspo1 透過穩定 LGR5 受體複合體增強典型 Wnt 訊號，維持腸道幹細胞功能。

links.context: SIRT6 promotes DNA-PKcs mobilization/stability at DSBs, enhancing repair (McCord 2009 PMID 20157594).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 促進 DNA-PKcs 在雙股斷裂處的動員/穩定性，增強修復（McCord 2009 PMID 20157594）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 promotes double-strand break repair by deacetylating histone H3 at lysines 9 and 56, facilitating 53BP1 and BRCA1 recruitment and stabilizing repair complexes; SIRT6-deficient cells accumulate persistent γ-H2AX foci, while pharmacological SIRT6 activation with UBCS039 or MDL-800 accelerates γ-H2AX focus clearance, making it the standard readout of SIRT6-dependent genome maintenance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 藉由對組蛋白 H3 的離胺酸 9 與 56 去乙醯化來促進雙股斷裂修復，促進 53BP1 與 BRCA1 的招募並穩定修復複合體；SIRT6 缺失細胞會累積持續的 γ-H2AX foci，而以 UBCS039 或 MDL-800 藥理活化 SIRT6 則加速 γ-H2AX foci 的清除，使其成為評估 SIRT6 依賴性基因體維護的標準讀值。

links.context: SIRT6 promotes double-strand break repair by deacetylating histone H3 at lysines 9 and 56, which facilitates 53BP1 and BRCA1 recruitment and stabilizes repair complexes. Gamma-H2AX focus clearance is therefore the standard functional readout of SIRT6-dependent genome maintenance: SIRT6-deficient cells accumulate persistent foci, while activators such as UBCS039 and MDL-800 accelerate clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 藉由去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 9 與第 56 離胺酸促進雙股斷裂修復，促進 53BP1 與 BRCA1 的招募並穩定修復複合體。因此 γ-H2AX 焦點的清除速度是評估 SIRT6 依賴性基因體維持功能的标准讀值：SIRT6 缺失的細胞會累積持續性焦點，而 UBCS039、MDL-800 等活化劑則加速清除。

links.context: SIRT6 regulates FOXO transcription factors as part of its metabolic/chromatin program.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 作為其代謝/染色質程序的一部分來調節 FOXO 轉錄因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 regulates macrophage polarization to alleviate sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome through both autophagy-dependent and autophagy-independent mechanisms. This positions SIRT6 as a modulator of the M1/M2 inflammatory balance.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過自噬依賴與非依賴機制調控巨噬細胞極化，以減輕敗血症誘導的急性呼吸窘迫症候群。這使 SIRT6 成為 M1/M2 發炎平衡的調控者。

links.context: SIRT6 represses Nkx3.2 transcription by deacetylating histone H3 at lysine 9 (H3K9ac) within the Nkx3.2 promoter region. The resulting chromatin compaction prevents Nkx3.2 expression, thereby relieving its repression of target genes such as GATA5 and protecting endothelium from injury.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 藉由在 Nkx3.2 啟動子區去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的離胺酸 9（H3K9ac）來抑制 Nkx3.2 轉錄。染色質凝縮使 Nkx3.2 無法表現，因而解除其對 GATA5 等標的基因的抑制，保護血管內皮免於損傷。

links.context: SIRT6 represses RELA (p65) transcriptional activity via chromatin deacetylation. By deacetylating histones at NF-κB target loci (and/or the RELA protein itself), SIRT6 reduces recruitment and transactivation of pro-inflammatory genes, a key mechanism restraining chronic inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過染色質去乙醯化抑制 RELA（p65）的轉錄活性。藉由在 NF-κB 標的位點（或 RELA 蛋白本身）去乙醯化組蛋白，SIRT6 降低發炎基因的招募與轉活化，是抑制慢性發炎的關鍵機制。

links.context: SIRT6 represses RELA/p65 transcriptional activity via chromatin deacetylation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過染色質去乙醯化抑制 RELA/p65 的轉錄活性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 represses glycolysis by inhibiting HIF-1α and thereby promotes oxidative metabolism, preserving Metabolic Flexibility. Together with SIRT1 and SIRT3 it acts as a flexibility-preserving sirtuin, whereas SIRT4 (which inhibits fatty acid oxidation) and possibly SIRT7 push in the opposite direction.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 藉由抑制 HIF-1α 來壓抑糖解作用，進而促進氧化代謝，維持 Metabolic Flexibility。它與 SIRT1、SIRT3 一同屬於維持靈活性的 sirtuin，而 SIRT4（抑制脂肪酸氧化）以及可能的 SIRT7 則朝相反方向作用。

links.context: SIRT6 restrains c-Myc transcriptional output in certain cancer contexts.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在某些癌症環境中抑制 c-Myc 的轉錄輸出。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 safeguards genomic stability by deacetylating H3K9 at telomeres and repetitive elements, suppressing LINE-1 retrotransposons, and supporting double-strand-break repair via CtIP and PARP1; SIRT6 deficiency causes genomic instability and premature aging.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化端粒和重複元件上的 H3K9、抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄轉座子，以及透過 CtIP 和 PARP1 支持雙股斷裂修復來保障基因組穩定性；SIRT6 缺乏導致基因組不穩定和早衰。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 suppresses TNF-α signaling downstream of NF-κB chromatin deacetylation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 NF-κB 染色質去乙醯化的下游抑制 TNF-α 信號。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT6 suppresses inflammation by deacetylating H3K9 at NF-kB target-gene promoters and promoting p65 degradation, restraining pro-inflammatory transcription; loss of SIRT6 elevates inflammatory output and contributes to age-related inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化 NF-kB 靶基因啟動子上的 H3K9 並促進 p65 降解來抑制發炎反應，抑制促發炎轉錄；SIRT6 的缺失增加發炎輸出並促成年齡相關的發炎。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I transcription of ribosomal DNA and is required for pre-rRNA cleavage, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity; this nucleolar function supports growth and, in cancer, tumor proliferation.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 對核糖體 DNA 的轉錄，並為前 rRNA 切割所需，驅動核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力；這種核仁功能支持生長，在癌症中支持腫瘤增殖。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 concentrates in the nucleolus where it deacetylates H3K18.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 集中於核仁，在該處去乙醯化 H3K18。

links.context: SIRT7 cooperates with FOXO3: SIRT7 deacetylates FOXO3 (alongside SIRT1), preventing pro-apoptotic Ser574 phosphorylation and activating FOXO3-dependent stress-resistance transcription; Table 3 lists FOXO3 as a positive regulator of the SIRT7 pathway (mutual activation).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 與 FOXO3 協同：SIRT7 去乙醯化 FOXO3（與 SIRT1 一起），防止促凋亡的 Ser574 磷酸化並活化 FOXO3 依賴性的抗壓轉錄；表 3 將 FOXO3 列為 SIRT7 通路的正向調節因子（相互活化）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates GABPβ1, the DNA-binding beta subunit of the GABP ETS transcription factor complex, facilitating GABP complex formation and transcriptional activation of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes; SIRT7 deficiency causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction with lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 會去乙醯化 GABPβ1——即 GABP 這個 ETS 轉錄因子複合體的 DNA 結合 beta 次單元，促進 GABP 複合體形成並活化核編碼粒線體基因的轉錄；SIRT7 缺失會造成全身性粒線體功能障礙，伴隨乳酸累積與心臟異常。

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates H3K18 on promoters (Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849) and associates with chromatin remodelers (including PAF1 complex) to regulate rDNA transcription, ribosomal biogenesis, and global gene expression; age-related SIRT7 decline perturbs these epigenetic landscapes (source review; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18（Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849），並與染色質重塑因子（包括 PAF1 複合物）結合，以調節 rDNA 轉錄、核糖體生成和整體基因表現；與年齡相關的 SIRT7 下降會擾亂這些表觀遺傳景觀（來源文獻; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates and regulates RNA Polymerase I transcription at rDNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis (Ford et al., 2006).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化並調節 RNA 聚合酶 I 在 rDNA 上的轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成（Ford et al., 2006）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2A, contributing to its nucleolar/chromatin regulatory program.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2A，有助於其核仁/染色質調控程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2B as part of its chromatin modification repertoire.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2B，作為其染色質修飾 repertoire 的一部分。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deacetylates p53 to repress p53-driven apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma, and p53 activation reciprocally opposes SIRT7 functions (e.g., under genotoxic stress p53 promotes apoptosis despite SIRT7), so p53 is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT7 pathway (source review; oncogene review s41388-024-02976-8).
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化 p53 以抑制肝細胞癌中 p53 驅動的凋亡，而 p53 的活化反之對抗 SIRT7 的功能（例如在基因毒性壓力下，p53 促進凋亡而不管 SIRT7 的存在），因此 p53 被列為 SIRT7 途徑的負向調節因子（來源文獻; oncogene review s41388-024-02976-8）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

links.context: SIRT7 deletion leads to heart hypertrophy, fibrosis, lipofuscin accumulation, and inflammatory cardiomyopathy that worsens with age.
