links.context: Smoking, including cigarettes, cigars, and wood smoke, is a major exogenous source of Oxidative Stress. Tobacco smoke carries roughly 10^17 free radical molecules per puff, and smoking additionally depletes antioxidant defenses such as vitamin C and Glutathione, leaving Reactive Oxygen Species unneutralized. Wood and campfire smoke, rich in particulates and reactive compounds, induces systemic Inflammation with the same biochemical consequences.
links.context_zh_TW: Smoking（包含香菸、雪茄與木柴煙）是 Oxidative Stress 的主要外源性來源。菸霧每 puff 約含 10^17 個自由基分子，吸菸並會耗竭維生素 C 與 Glutathione 等抗氧化防禦，使 Reactive Oxygen Species 無法被中和。木柴與營火煙富含微粒與反應性化合物，會誘發全身性 Inflammation，造成相同的生化後果。

links.context: Snail repression of E-cadherin is the defining EMT molecular event; proposed once here, CDH1 side marked covered. Repression executes transition.
links.context_zh_TW: Snail 對 E-cadherin 的抑制是定義性的 EMT 分子事件；僅在此提案一次，CDH1 側標記已涵蓋。抑制執行轉換。

links.context: Sodium Persulfate serves as a convenient laboratory oxidant for the synthesis of Adrenochrome from Epinephrine; the resulting pink aminochrome is monitored spectrophotometrically at its 480 nm absorbance maximum. This assay is widely used to model oxidative stress and to measure catecholamine oxidation kinetics under controlled conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: Sodium Persulfate 是由 Epinephrine 合成 Adrenochrome 的便利實驗室氧化劑；所生成的粉紅色 aminochrome 可藉由其 480 nm 吸收極大值以分光光度法定量。此檢測常用於模擬 Oxidative Stress 並在受控條件下測量兒茶酚胺氧化動力學。

links.context: Sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO3) serves as the preferred buffer during the oxidation of Epinephrine, maintaining the reaction medium within the pH 4-8 range required for adrenochrome formation. It is one of several buffer options (sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, sodium acetate) in industrial adrenochrome processes.
links.context_zh_TW: Sodium hydrogencarbonate（NaHCO3）在 Epinephrine 的 Oxidation 過程中作為首選緩衝液，將反應介質維持在形成 Adrenochrome 所需的 pH 4–8 範圍內。它是工業 Adrenochrome 製程中數種緩衝選項之一（磷酸二氫鈉、磷酸氫二鈉、醋酸鉀、醋酸鈉）。

links.context: Sodium metabisulfite is a reducing agent commonly added to pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions as a sacrificial antioxidant. Because epinephrine slowly oxidizes in the presence of air, the sulfite compound donates electrons to any quinone intermediate that forms, converting it back to stable epinephrine and preventing the pink-red adrenochrome discoloration that indicates oxidation. This is why many injectable epinephrine formulations used in emergency devices such as autoinjectors contain sodium metabisulfite: it extends the shelf life of the catecholamine by intercepting the very first oxidation step of the adrenochrome pathway. The practice illustrates how chemical formulation, not just biology, exploits the catechol-quinone redox equilibrium to suppress adrenochrome formation and preserve drug potency.
links.context_zh_TW: Sodium metabisulfite 是一種還原劑，常被加入腎上腺素（epinephrine）藥劑中作為犧牲性抗氧化劑。因為腎上腺素在空氣中會緩慢氧化，sulfite 化合物會向形成的任何醌類中間體提供電子，將其轉回穩定的腎上腺素，並防止呈粉紅紅色的 adrenochrome 變色，這是氧化的指標。因此，許多用於自動注射器等緊急裝置的注射型腎上腺素製劑都含有 sodium metabisulfite：它透過攔截 adrenochrome 途徑的第一個氧化步驟，延長了兒茶酚胺的保存期限。此做法說明了化學配方（而不僅是生物學）如何利用兒茶酚-醌氧化還原平衡來抑制 adrenochrome 的形成並保持藥效。

links.context: Solid lipid nanoparticles (a lipophilic matrix solid at body temperature) can encapsulate Fisetin, giving controlled/sustained release, protection of the labile active and improved bioavailability without organic solvents; fisetin co-loaded with the photosensitizer IR-780 into SLNs reduced LoVo colon adenocarcinoma viability by ~50% at 24 h.
links.context_zh_TW: Solid lipid nanoparticles（由在體溫下呈固態的親脂性基質構成）可將 Fisetin 包埋，提供受控／持續釋放、對易分解活性成分的保護，以及無需有機溶劑的生體可用度提升；將 fisetin 與光敏劑 IR-780 共載於 SLN 中，可使 LoVo 結腸腺癌細胞在 24 小時的存活率降低約 50%。

links.context: Soluble guanylyl cyclase, when activated by nitric oxide produced downstream of inducible nitric oxide synthase, generates cyclic GMP, which mediates smooth-muscle relaxation, vasodilation and platelet inhibition. Methylene blue blocks the pathway at soluble guanylyl cyclase while aminoguanidine blocks it upstream at inducible nitric oxide synthase.
links.context_zh_TW: Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase 在受到 inducible nitric oxide synthase 下游產生的 Nitric Oxide 活化後，生成 Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate，後者介導平滑肌舒張、Vasodilation 與 Platelet 抑制。Methylene blue 在 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase 層級阻斷此路徑，而 Aminoguanidine 則在上游的 inducible nitric oxide synthase 層級阻斷。

links.context: Soluplus is an amphiphilic graft copolymer used to formulate polymeric micelles that encapsulate poorly soluble drugs. Fenbendazole-loaded Soluplus micelles showed lower total clearance and volume of distribution, supporting improved delivery.
links.context_zh_TW: Soluplus 是兩親性接枝共聚物，用於配製包封難溶性藥物的聚合物微胞。裝載 fenbendazole 的 Soluplus 微胞表現較低的總清除率與分布體積，支持改善的遞送。

links.context: Sorafenib's ferroptotic component in HCC runs through GPX4 inactivation; loss of retinoblastoma protein sensitizes HCC cells to it, while GPX4 inhibitors or iron donors are being explored to push the mechanism further.
links.context_zh_TW: Sorafenib 在 HCC 中的 ferroptosis 成分是經由 GPX4 失活而來；視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白的流失會使 HCC 細胞對其更敏感，而研究也正探索以 GPX4 抑制劑或鐵供應劑進一步強化此機制。

links.context: Sox2 is a core circuitry factor required for the pluripotent state. Requirement places it with Oct4/Nanog.
links.context_zh_TW: Sox2 是多能性狀態所需的核心線路因子。必要性將它與 Oct4/Nanog 並列。

links.context: Specialized DNA Polymerases carry out repair synthesis: Pol β fills single-strand breaks, while Pol γ replicates mitochondrial DNA and dedicated polymerases perform translesion synthesis across damaged bases. Mismatch repair such as MLH1 removes the errors polymerases leave behind.
links.context_zh_TW: 專一的 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）負責修復合成：Pol β 填補單股斷裂，Pol γ 複製粒線體 DNA，另有專門聚合酶在受損鹼基上進行跨損傷合成（translesion synthesis）。而像 MLH1 這類的錯配修復則移除聚合酶留下的錯誤。

links.context: Spermidine acts as an autophagy inducer by inhibiting histone acetyltransferases, particularly EP300/p300, which produces global de-acetylation of Histone H3. This de-acetylation alters chromatin accessibility at the promoters of autophagy genes — a mechanism independent of mTOR inhibition, distinguishing spermidine from rapamycin-class inducers.
links.context_zh_TW: Spermidine 透過抑制組蛋白乙醯轉移酶（尤其是 EP300/p300）而誘導 Autophagy，結果造成 Histone H3 的全面去乙醯化。這種去乙醯化改變了自噬基因啟動子的染色質可及性；其機制獨立於 mTOR 抑制，這正是 spermidine 與 rapamycin 類誘導劑的差異所在。

links.context: Spermidine supplementation normalized aortic PWV to young levels in old mice in the seminal study by LaRocca et al. (2013). Supplementation at 3 mM in drinking water for 4 weeks reduced aortic PWV in 27-29-month-old mice, accompanied by reductions in aortic AGE accumulation and collagen I expression, consistent with reversal of vascular aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 LaRocca 等人 2013 年的代表性研究中，精胺酸補充將老化小鼠的主動脈 PWV 回復至年輕水準。以 3 mM 加入飲水中補充 4 週，可降低 27–29 月齡小鼠的主動脈 PWV，並伴隨主動脈 AGE 累積與第一型膠原蛋白表現下降，與血管老化逆轉一致。

links.context: Spermidine supplementation reverses age-associated arterial stiffening in old mice: it normalises aortic pulse wave velocity to young levels, reduces AGE accumulation and aortic collagen I expression, restores NO-mediated endothelial function, and enhances autophagy in the arterial wall. The mechanism involves spermidine-induced de-acetylation of histone H3, activating transcription of autophagy-related genes and improving vascular protein quality control.
links.context_zh_TW: Spermidine 補充可逆轉老年小鼠的與年齡相關動脈僵硬：將主動脈脈搏波速度恢復至年輕水平、減少主動脈壁 AGE 累積與 collagen I 表現、恢復 NO 媒介的內皮功能，並增強動脈壁的自噬。其機制涉及 spermidine 誘導 histone H3 去乙醯化，活化自噬相關基因的轉錄，改善血管蛋白質的品質管制。

links.context: Sphingolipid metabolism acts upstream of ferroptosis: the ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P rheostat sets cell fate, and free fatty acids released by acid ceramidase feed phospholipid PUFA enrichment (Lands cycle), creating a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile.
links.context_zh_TW: Sphingolipid metabolism 作用於 ferroptosis 的上游：ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P 的調節平衡決定細胞命運，而 acid ceramidase 釋出的游離脂肪酸會餵入 phospholipid 的 PUFA  enrich（Lands cycle），形成促 ferroptosis 的脂質組型。

links.context: Sphingomyelin is a phosphosphingolipid composed of ceramide linked to phosphocholine and serves as a reservoir for ceramide generation. It is a major structural lipid of the plasma membrane and myelin, and sphingomyelinases convert it back to ceramide.
links.context_zh_TW: 神經鞘磷脂是由 ceramide 連接磷酸膽鹼組成的磷酸鞘脂，並作為 ceramide 生成的儲庫。它是質膜與髓鞘的主要結構脂質，神經鞘磷脂酶將其轉化回 ceramide。

links.context: Sphingomyelin is one of the major lipids of CNS Myelin, sitting alongside cholesterol in the compacted sheath. Sphingolipid content is what sets the sheath's low dielectric environment, and a defect in sphingolipid breakdown — sphingomyelinase activity — is a recognized mechanism of myelin destruction in leukodystrophies.
links.context_zh_TW: Sphingomyelin 是中樞 Myelin 的主要脂質之一，與 cholesterol 一同存在於壓實的髓鞘中。鞘磷脂的含量決定了髓鞘低介電的環境；而鞘磷脂分解的缺陷——即 sphingomyelinase 活性——是 leukodystrophies 中髓鞘遭破壞的公認機制。

links.context: Sphingosine is the long-chain amino alcohol that forms the structural backbone of all sphingolipids. Every ceramide, sphingomyelin and sphingosine-1-phosphate species is built on this single scaffold, which is why changes in the Sphingosine pool propagate through the whole Sphingolipid Metabolism network.
links.context_zh_TW: Sphingosine 是構成所有 sphingolipid 結構骨架的長鏈胺基醇。每一種 ceramide、sphingomyelin 與 sphingosine-1-phosphate 都以這個單一骨架建造，因此 Sphingosine 池的變化會沿整個 Sphingolipid Metabolism 網絡傳播。

links.context: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy is allelic with Farber disease: both arise from mutations in ASAH1. The severity difference is set by residual enzyme activity — ~5–30% in Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy versus <5% in Farber disease — which explains the milder neurodegenerative rather than widespread lipogranulomatosis phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy 與 Farber disease 為同一基因（ASAH1）的等位基因疾病。兩者嚴重程度由殘餘酵素活性決定：Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy 約 5–30%，Farber disease 則 <5%，這解釋了前者較輕微的神經退行性表型，而非廣泛脂肪肉芽腫表型。
links.source_file: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy.md

links.context: Squalene synthase condenses farnesyl diphosphate to squalene, the precursor to lanosterol and ultimately Cholesterol, and is required for downstream steroid and hormone biosynthesis. It is also the target of cholesterol-lowering squalene synthase inhibitors such as lapaquistat, developed for dyslipidemia.
links.context_zh_TW: Squalene synthase 將 farnesyl diphosphate 縮合為 squalene，而 squalene 是 lanosterol 乃至最終 Cholesterol 的前驅物；它也是下游類固醇與激素生合成所必需。此酵素同時是 lapaquistat 等降膽固醇 squalene synthase 抑制劑的標的，該類藥物為高膽固醇血症而開發。

links.context: Src activates the RAS/ERK2 and PI3K/Akt proliferative and survival pathways to drive growth. It also phosphorylates FAK and paxillin to promote focal adhesion turnover and cell motility. In its inactive conformation Src is autoinhibited by an SH2-domain interaction with the C-terminal phosphotyrosine Tyr527; activation requires dephosphorylation of Tyr527 or SH3 domain displacement.
links.context_zh_TW: Src 啟動 RAS/ERK2 與 PI3K/Akt 的增殖與存活路徑以驅動生長，並磷酸化 FAK 與 paxillin 以促進焦點黏附周轉與細胞運動。在不活化構形中，Src 由 SH2 區域與 C 端磷酸化酪胺酸 Tyr527 的分子內交互作用維持自體抑制；活化需 Tyr527 去磷酸化或 SH3 區域位移。

links.context: Stabilized spindles trigger SAC arrest and caspase-dependent apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 穩定的紡錘體觸發 SAC 停滯與 caspase 依賴凋亡。

links.context: Stalled and collapsed forks are a major source of genomic instability. Fork failure converts transient stress into heritable lesions.
links.context_zh_TW: 停滯與崩塌的複製叉是基因組不穩定的主要來源。複製叉失敗將短暫壓力轉化為可遺傳損傷。

links.context: Standard therapy is maximal resection, radiotherapy and temozolomide; prognosis remains poor (median <15 months).
links.context_zh_TW: 標準治療是最大切除、放療和 temozolomide；預後仍然不良（中位數 <15 個月）。

links.context: Statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme of the mevalonate pathway, which reduces mevalonate flux and lowers ubiquinone (CoQ10) availability. Because ubiquinone is the direct substrate of FSP1, CoQ10 depletion collapses FSP1's NAD(P)H-driven radical-trapping arm and sensitizes cells to ferroptosis — paralleling the drop in GPX4 caused by impaired selenocysteine-tRNA maturation.
links.context_zh_TW: Statins 抑制 mevalonate 途徑的限速酵素 HMG-CoA reductase，使 mevalonate 通量下降並降低 ubiquinone（CoQ10）的可供量。由於 ubiquinone 是 FSP1 的直接受質，CoQ10 耗竭會瓦解 FSP1 由 NAD(P)H 驅動的自由基捕捉能力，使細胞對 ferroptosis 更加敏感——這與 selenocysteine-tRNA 成熟受阻造成的 GPX4 下降效果平行。

links.context: Statins upregulate eNOS expression and activity directly, by prolonging eNOS mRNA half-life, thereby improving NO bioavailability. Combined with reduced LDL oxidation and oxLDL levels, this endothelial protection contributes to clinical benefit beyond cholesterol reduction alone.
links.context_zh_TW: Statins 藉由延長 eNOS mRNA 半衰期直接上調 eNOS 的表現與活性，進而改善 NO 的生物可利用性。搭配減少 LDL 氧化與 oxLDL 濃度，這種內皮保護作用使臨床效益超越單純的膽固醇降低。

links.context: Stilbenes are a class of polyphenolic organic compounds built on a 1,2-diphenylethylene core (a central ethene bridge connecting two aromatic rings) and existing as cis and trans isomers, with the trans configuration being the more biologically active form.
links.context_zh_TW: Stilbene 是一類以 1,2-二苯乙烯骨架（連接兩個芳香環的中心烯橋）為基礎的多酚類有機化合物，存在順式與反式異構物，其中反式為生物活性較高的形式。

links.context: Stilbenoids are a subclass of polyphenolic phytoalexins characterized by a stilbene backbone (1,2-diarylethylene core); methoxylation, as in pterostilbene, improves metabolic stability and oral bioavailability relative to the parent stilbene.
links.context_zh_TW: Stilbenoid 是一類以 stilbene 骨架（1,2-二芳基乙烯核心）為特徵的多酚類植物抗毒素（phytoalexin）子類；如 pterostilbene 的甲氧基化可相較於母體 stilbene 改善代謝穩定性與口服生體可用率。

links.context: Stilbenoids are direct sirtuin activators: resveratrol and its analogues bind SIRT1 and promote deacetylation, with resveratrol-driven PGC-1α deacetylation promoting mitochondrial biogenesis (PMID 18505964).
links.context_zh_TW: Stilbenoid 是直接的 sirtuin 活化劑：resveratrol 及其類似物結合 SIRT1 並促進去乙醯化，其中 resveratrol 促使 PGC-1α 去乙醯化而促進粒線體生成（PMID 18505964）。

links.context: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning depends on dopamine signaling within the Striatum, where dorsolateral and dorsomedial striatal circuits integrate cortical and dopaminergic input at medium spiny neurons and enable corticostriatal long-term potentiation. Because striatal dopamine tone is shaped locally by COMT given sparse dopamine transporter expression, COMT activity modulates how readily S-R associations are acquired: elevated COMT accelerates dopamine clearance and slows S-R learning, whereas slower COMT preserves dopamine and facilitates habit formation.
links.context_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 依賴 Striatum 內的多巴胺訊號傳遞，背外側與背內側紋狀體迴路在 medium spiny neurons 處整合皮質與多巴胺輸入，並促成皮質-紋狀體長期增益。由於紋狀體多巴胺張力在多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏的情況下由 COMT 局部塑造，COMT 活性會調節 S-R 關聯習得的難易：COMT 升高會加速多巴胺清除並減緩 S-R 學習，而 COMT 較慢則保留多巴胺並促進習慣形成。

links.context: Stimulus-response learning underlies both adaptive expertise and maladaptive habits, including addiction and compulsive behaviors. Its COMT dependence links genetic dopamine regulation to individual differences in habit formation. Understanding S-R mechanisms informs therapeutic approaches to compulsive and addictive disorders.
links.context_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 既構成適應性專長，也構成適應不良習慣，包括成癮和強迫行為。其對 COMT 的依賴將遺傳性多巴胺調節與習慣形成的個體差異連結起來。了解 S-R 機制有助於治療強迫性和成癮性疾病的介入方法。

links.context: Stomatitis (oral mucositis) is the oral manifestation of Mucositis, the broader inflammation and ulceration of mucous membranes lining the gastrointestinal tract including the oral cavity.
links.context_zh_TW: Stomatitis（口腔黏膜炎）是 Mucositis 的口腔表現，後者指覆蓋胃腸道（含口腔）黏膜的發炎與潰瘍這個更廣泛的病況。

links.context: Stress Granules are membraneless ribonucleoprotein condensates assembled by liquid-liquid phase separation and commonly marked by G3BP1. They transiently concentrate and immobilize RNA-Binding Proteins to halt translation and protect the transcriptome during oxidative stress, heat shock or viral infection, then dissolve once the stress resolves.
links.context_zh_TW: Stress Granules 是由 liquid-liquid phase separation 組裝的無膜核糖核蛋白凝聚體，通常以 G3BP1 為標記。它們在 oxidative stress、熱休克或病毒感染期間暫時性濃縮並固定 RNA-Binding Proteins，以停止轉譯並保護轉錄組，待壓力解除後即溶解。

links.context: Stressors that trigger the integrated stress response include ER stress, amino acid starvation, heme deficiency, viral infection and mitochondrial dysfunction, making the ISR a common retrograde signaling pathway linking organelle stress to nuclear adaptation.
links.context_zh_TW: 能觸發整合性壓力反應的壓力源包括內質網壓力、胺基酸缺乏、血紅素不足、病毒感染與粒線體功能障礙，使 ISR 成為連結胞器壓力與細胞核適應的共同逆行訊息傳遞途徑。

links.context: Stroke is a medical emergency caused by interruption of blood supply to the brain, with ~87% of cases ischemic from thrombus or embolus. Its pathophysiology runs through the Ischemia-reperfusion Injury cascade, in which Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, Excitotoxicity and Apoptosis act together to produce tissue damage and neurological deficits.
links.context_zh_TW: Stroke 是腦部血流中斷所造成的醫療急症，約 87% 屬血栓或栓塞造成的 ischemic stroke。其病理生理經由 Ischemia-reperfusion Injury 級聯反應，過程中 Oxidative Stress、Inflammation、Excitotoxicity 與 Apoptosis 共同作用，造成組織損傷與神經功能缺損。

links.context: Subcytotoxic hydrogen peroxide is the canonical SIPS inducer in fibroblast models. Acute oxidative insult bypasses telomere counting entirely.
links.context_zh_TW: 亞細胞毒性過氧化氫是纖維母細胞模型中典型的 SIPS 誘發因子。急性氧化傷害完全繞過端粒計數。

links.context: Sublethal MOMP, in which only a minority of mitochondria are permeabilized, keeps the cell viable while released mtDNA and other DAMPs signal through the cGAS-STING Pathway, driving the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 次致命 MOMP（僅少數粒線體被通透化）使細胞維持存活，同時釋出的 mtDNA 與其他 DAMP 經由 cGAS-STING Pathway 傳遞訊號，驅動衰老相關分泌表型。

links.context: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta contains a high density of dopaminergic neurons whose axons travel via the Nigrostriatal System to the striatum. Progressive loss of these neurons is the hallmark of Parkinson's Disease, with tremor and Bradykinesia emerging only once a significant fraction of the population has degenerated.
links.context_zh_TW: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 含有高密度的 dopaminergic neuron，其軸突經由 Nigrostriatal System 投射至 striatum。這些神經元的漸進性喪失是 Parkinson's Disease 的標誌病變，且 tremor 與 Bradykinesia 要在相當比例的族群已退化後才會出現。

links.context: Succinate dehydrogenase (complex II) couples the TCA cycle to the electron transport chain. The review identifies SDH as a critical acetylation node in the mitochondrial matrix regulated by SIRT3, mediating crosstalk between metabolic flux control and mitochondrial energy transduction, fine-tuning substrate utilization and electron transfer synchronization.
links.context_zh_TW: 琥珀酸脫氫酶（複合物 II）將 TCA 循環偶聯至電子傳遞鏈。該綜述將 SDH 確認為粒線體基質中受 SIRT3 調節的關鍵乙醯化節點，介導代謝通量控制和粒線體能量傳導之間的串擾，微調受質利用和電子轉移同步化。

links.context: Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) is a repair enzyme that reverses the over-oxidation of typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxins such as Peroxiredoxin 3. Its expression is induced by oxidative stress through Nrf2, forming a feed-forward repair loop that reinforces antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白（Sulfiredoxin/SRXN1）是逆轉典型 2-Cys 過氧化還原酶（如 Peroxiredoxin 3）過度氧化的修復酶。其表現由氧化壓力經由 Nrf2 誘導，形成強化抗氧化防禦的前饋修復迴路。

links.context: Sulfiredoxin (Srx/SRXN1) is the ATP-dependent enzyme that rescues hyperoxidized (sulfinylated) peroxiredoxin back to the active state, directly Nrf2-induced as feed-forward. Together with glutaredoxin it constitutes the reversible-repair machinery that turns moderate ROS into hormetic adaptation (memory) rather than irreversible collapse.
links.context_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin（Srx/SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴性酵素，可將過度氧化（亞磺醯化）的過氧化還原酶救回活性態，本身受 Nrf2 誘導而具前饋作用。它與 glutaredoxin 共同構成可逆修復機械，使中等量 ROS 轉為荷爾蒙適應（記憶）而非不可逆崩潰。

links.context: Sulforaphane from broccoli sprouts is a mild electrophilic toxin that activates NRF2 at subtoxic doses, upregulating endogenous antioxidant enzymes 10-100x more effectively than dietary antioxidants — the xenohormesis principle that phytochemicals work by mild stress, not scavenging. For the hormesis goal itself, xenohormetins such as Sulforaphane, Curcumin and Resveratrol are preferred over antioxidant dosing, because they are mild electrophilic stressors that induce NRF2 rather than scavenge reactive species. Vitamin E is framed as situational membrane insurance rather than a longevity signal under this strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: 來自青花菜苗的 Sulforaphane 是溫和親電子毒素，在亞毒性劑量活化 NRF2，使內生性抗氧化酵素提升幅度比膳食抗氧化劑有效 10–100 倍——即植物化學物質藉溫和壓力而非清除作用發揮功效的 xenohormesis 原則。 就 hormesis 目標本身而言，Sulforaphane、Curcumin 與 Resveratrol 等 xenohormetin 優於抗氧化劑補充，因為它們是誘導 NRF2 的溫和親電壓力源，而非清除活性物質。在這個策略下，Vitamin E 被定位為情境性的膜保障，而非長壽訊號。

links.context: Sulforaphane suppresses NF-κB activation by inhibiting IKKβ phosphorylation and p65 nuclear translocation, so it dampens inflammatory signalling alongside its NRF2-mediated antioxidant effects. It is additionally a weak HDAC inhibitor that raises histone acetylation and tumour suppressor gene expression, and it activates AMPK to promote mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: Sulforaphane 藉由抑制 IKKβ 磷酸化與 p65 核轉位來抑制 NF-κB 活化，因此在其 NRF2 介導的抗氧化作用之外還能減弱發炎訊息傳遞。它同時是弱效 HDAC 抑制劑，可提升 histone acetylation 與腫瘤抑制基因表現，並活化 AMPK 以促進 mitochondrial biogenesis 與 autophagy。

links.context: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) is an antioxidant enzyme that catalyzes the dismutation of superoxide anion into hydrogen peroxide and oxygen. In experiments with neutrophil homogenates, superoxide dismutase inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome, confirming that the reaction is driven by superoxide radicals. By removing superoxide, SOD blocks the radical-mediated catechol oxidation that initiates adrenochrome formation, interrupting both the initial oxidation and the regenerative redox cycle. This makes SOD a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway under inflammatory conditions, and its age-related decline is thought to permit greater adrenaline oxidation in older organisms.
links.context_zh_TW: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）是一種催化超氧陰離子歧化為過氧化氫與氧的抗氧化酶。在中性球勻漿的實驗中，superoxide dismutase 抑制 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，證實此反應由超氧自由基驅動。透過移除超氧，SOD 阻斷啟動 adrenochrome 形成的自由基介導兒茶酚氧化，中斷初始氧化與再生性氧化還原循環。這使 SOD 成為發炎條件下 adrenochrome 途徑的天然煞車，且其與年齡相關的下降被認為會容許年老個體中更多的 adrenaline 氧化。

links.context: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) is an antioxidant enzyme that destroys superoxide anion (O2-), the reactive oxygen species produced when molecular oxygen gains an extra electron, before it can oxidize epinephrine. By removing superoxide, SOD blocks a key route by which oxidative stress drives the conversion of the catecholamine into the o-quinone intermediate and thence into adrenochrome. SOD therefore functions as part of the biological anti-adrenochrome defense system, working alongside glutathione, which reduces oxidized epinephrine back to its stable state, and the MAO and COMT cleanup enzymes. The coordinated action of these systems keeps adrenochrome levels effectively zero in healthy blood, meaning that adrenochrome forms in vivo only when oxidative stress, such as that produced by infiltrating neutrophils, overwhelms this enzymatic protection.
links.context_zh_TW: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）是一種抗氧化酶，能在超氧陰離子（O2-）氧化腎上腺素之前將其破壞，超氧陰離子是分子氧獲得額外電子時產生的活性氧物種。通過去除超氧化物，SOD 阻斷了氧化應激將兒茶酚胺轉化為鄰醌中間體，進而形成腎上腺素紅的關鍵途徑。因此，SOD 作為生物抗腎上腺素紅防禦系統的一部分發揮作用，與谷胱甘肽協同工作，谷胱甘肽將氧化的腎上腺素還原回其穩定狀態，以及 MAO 和 COMT 清潔酶。這些系統的協調作用使健康血液中的腎上腺素紅水平實際上保持為零，這意味著只有當氧化應激（例如浸潤性中性粒細胞產生的氧化應激）超過這種酶促保護時，體內才會形成腎上腺素紅。

links.context: Superoxide dismutates to hydrogen peroxide with defined stoichiometry and kinetics. Conversion links the MPO substrate supply to HOCl production.
links.context_zh_TW: 超氧陰離子以確定化學計量與動力學歧化為過氧化氫。轉換將 MPO 受質供應連結到 HOCl 產生。

links.context: Superoxide generated by NADPH oxidase activation in response to AGE-RAGE interaction is a major contributor to intracellular oxidative stress. The sudden increase in oxidative stress produced by NAD(P)H oxidase upregulation in response to AGE binding can itself activate NF-kB, coupling oxidant production with inflammatory signaling. Superoxide and its derivatives damage proteins, lipids, and DNA, and their accumulation is a hallmark of glycoxidative stress. This reactive oxygen species links the receptor-mediated effects of AGEs to the oxidative stress that characterizes aging tissues and drives chronic disease pathology in diabetes and atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 因應AGE-RAGE interaction而由NADPH oxidase activation所generated的superoxide，是intracellular oxidative stress的major contributor。NAD(P)H oxidase因應AGE binding而上調所produced的oxidative stress sudden increase，本身即可activate NF-kB，coupling oxidant production with inflammatory signaling。Superoxide及其derivatives damage proteins、lipids與DNA，其accumulation是glycoxidative stress的hallmark。此reactive oxygen species links AGEs的receptor-mediated effects to the oxidative stress that characterizes aging tissues，並drives diabetes與atherosclerosis中的chronic disease pathology。
links.source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

links.context: Superoxide reacts with nitric oxide at diffusion-limited rates near 1e10 to yield peroxynitrite. Reaction couples oxidative stress to endothelial dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: 超氧陰離子以近 1e10 的擴散極限速率與一氧化氮反應產生過氧亞硝酸鹽。反應將氧化壓力耦合到內皮功能障礙。

links.context: Suppressed mTOR relieves inhibition of autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis via TFEB, promoting cellular cleanup. mTOR inhibition is thus a canonical inducer of autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: 抑制的 mTOR 解除對自噬與溶酶體生合成的抑制（經由 TFEB），促進細胞清理。因此 mTOR 抑制是自噬的典型誘導者。

links.context: Suramin is a potent multi-target sirtuin inhibitor: its highly charged sulfonic acid groups bind the basic sirtuin channels and competitively interfere with binding of both the NAD+ co-substrate and the peptide substrate, locking the enzyme inactive. Potency is SIRT1 IC50 = 297 nM, SIRT2 IC50 = 1150 nM and SIRT5 IC50 = 22 µM, giving broad antiviral and cytostatic anticancer activity against sirtuin-supported tumour cell survival.
links.context_zh_TW: Suramin 是效價強的多標靶 sirtuin 抑制劑：其帶多個電荷的 sulfonic acid 群與 sirtuin 的鹼性通道結合，並競爭性干擾 NAD+ 輔基受質與胜肽受質的結合，將酵素鎖定於不活化狀態。效價為 SIRT1 IC50 = 297 nM、SIRT2 IC50 = 1150 nM、SIRT5 IC50 = 22 µM，對仰賴 sirtuin 存活的腫瘤細胞具有廣效抗病毒與細胞靜止抗腫瘤活性。

links.context: Suramin was standard-of-care for trypanosomiasis and river blindness (Onchocerciasis) and, in 1975, one of only two available drugs alongside Diethylcarbamazine — both used highly satisfactorily. It was superseded by Ivermectin, but its history marks the pre-ivermectin era of antiparasitic therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Suramin 曾是 trypanosomiasis 與 river blindness（Onchocerciasis）的標準治療，並且在 1975 年是僅有的兩種可用藥物之一，另一種為 Diethylcarbamazine——兩者使用滿意度都很低。它後來被 Ivermectin 取代，但其歷史標記了驅蟲治療在 ivermectin 之前的時代。

links.context: Surface-bound IL-1α on senescent cells engages IL-1R1 on neighboring macrophages in a juxtacrine, contact-dependent manner: IL-1R1 recruits IL-1RAcP, activates MyD88 then IRAK1/4 and TRAF6, and drives NF-κB and MAPK signaling that induces TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IL-12, chemokines, COX-2 and iNOS. Macrophages may not respond to soluble IL-1α/IL-1β, making the membrane-bound form the primary activator.
links.context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞表面的 IL-1α 以 juxtacrine（接觸依賴）方式與鄰近 macrophages 的 IL-1R1 結合：IL-1R1 招募 IL-1RAcP，活化 MyD88 再到 IRAK1/4 與 TRAF6，並驅動 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號，誘導 TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-12、趨化因子、COX-2 與 iNOS。巨噬細胞可能不對可溶性 IL-1α/IL-1β 反應，使膜結合型成為主要活化形式。

links.context: Sustained cGAS-STING Pathway activation downstream of proteotoxic and mitochondrial stress drives Astrocyte Senescence, a stable growth-arrested, pro-inflammatory state with a SASP secretome that amplifies Neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 在蛋白毒性與粒線體壓力之下持續活化的 cGAS-STING Pathway 會驅動 Astrocyte Senescence——一種穩定停滯生長、促發炎且具有 SASP 分泌表型的狀態，進而放大 Neuroinflammation 與神經退化。

links.context: Sustained pyrimidine starvation produced by Cyclopentenyl cytosine activates a p53-dependent DNA damage checkpoint and drives a stable senescent phenotype characterized by enlarged flattened morphology and SA-beta-galactosidase activity. p53-null cells resist both the cell cycle arrest and the senescent phenotype, identifying the p53-p21 axis as the primary effector of CPEC-induced senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 造成的持續嘧啶缺乏會活化 p53 依賴的 DNA 損傷檢查點，並驅動穩定的衰老表型，特徵是細胞形態增大扁平並出現 SA-β-galactosidase 活性。p53 缺失細胞會抵抗細胞週期停滯和衰老表型，顯示 p53-p21 軸是 CPEC 誘導衰老的主要效應器。

links.context: Sustained, dysregulated Neuroinflammation harms neuronal homeostasis and accelerates progression of Neurodegenerative Disease, and chronic neuroinflammation intersects with Inflammaging and Senescence, adding age-related vulnerability.
links.context_zh_TW: 持續且失調的 Neuroinflammation 會危害神經元恆定性並加速 Neurodegenerative Disease 的進展；慢性神經發炎亦與 Inflammaging 及 Senescence 交疊，進一步增加與年齡相關的易感性。

links.context: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
links.context_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

links.context: Sympathetic nerve endings store and release norepinephrine as their primary neurotransmitter from bead-like varicosities along the terminal axon. Norepinephrine is released en passant along the length of the fiber, allowing a single sympathetic fiber to influence a broad field of target cells. Its effects depend on the postsynaptic receptor subtype expressed by the target tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 將 norepinephrine 作為其主要神經傳遞物質，從終末軸突上的念珠狀膨體（varicosities）儲存與釋放。Norepinephrine 沿著纖維長度邊走邊釋放，使單一交感纖維能影響廣闊的靶細胞區域。其效應取決於靶組織表現的突觸後受體亞型。

links.context: Synaptophysin (SYP) is a 38 kDa transmembrane glycoprotein of synaptic vesicles and among the most abundant proteins of the presynaptic terminal. It forms a channel-like complex with other vesicular proteins and participates in synaptic vesicle biogenesis, trafficking, exocytosis and membrane fusion during neurotransmitter release, making it a structural component of Synapse.
links.context_zh_TW: Synaptophysin（SYP）是突觸小泡的 38 kDa 跨膜醣蛋白，也是突觸前末端最豐富的蛋白質之一。它與其他囊泡蛋白形成通道狀複合體，參與突觸小泡生成、運輸、exocytosis 與神經傳遞物質釋放時的膜融合，因此是 Synapse 的結構組分。

links.context: Synaptophysin is expressed in neuronal presynaptic terminals and is used as a pan-neuronal presynaptic immunohistochemical marker of synaptic density and connectivity, colocalising with MAP2 dendritic markers. Because reduced Synaptophysin indicates synaptic loss, it serves as a synaptic-integrity endpoint for comparing neurotoxicity against synaptic protection in ageing and neurodegenerative disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Synaptophysin 表現於神經元突觸前末端，被用作突觸密度與連結性的泛神經元突觸前免疫組織化學標記，並與 MAP2 樹突標記共定位。由於 Synaptophysin 下降代表突觸喪失，它可作為比較神經毒性與突觸保護的突觸完整性終點指標，用於 ageing 與 neurodegenerative disease。

links.context: System Xc- (SLC7A11) supplies cystine, one of the two precursors required for Glutathione synthesis in Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Because ccRCC depends so heavily on Glutathione/GPX4 defence, blocking System Xc- collapses cystine availability and tips the tumour cells into iron-dependent Ferroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11）供應 cystine，而 cystine 是 Clear cell renal cell carcinoma 合成 Glutathione 所需的兩種前驅物之一。由於 ccRCC 高度依賴 Glutathione/GPX4 防禦，阻斷 System Xc- 會使 cystine 可用性崩潰，迫使腫瘤細胞進入鐵依賴性的 Ferroptosis。

links.context: System Xc- imports extracellular cystine at a 1:1 exchange ratio with glutamate; the imported cystine is reduced to cysteine in the cytosol and condensed with glutamate and glycine to build the Glutathione pool. Without cystine import, intracellular GSH falls and the cell loses its frontline antioxidant defense.
links.context_zh_TW: System Xc- 以 1:1 的比例將胞外胱胺酸換入、麩胺酸換出；進入的胱胺酸在細胞質被還原為半胱胺酸，再與麩胺酸、甘胺酸縮合生成 Glutathione。若缺乏胱胺酸輸入，胞內 GSH 會下降，細胞便失去前線抗氧化防禦。

links.context: System Xc- is a heterodimeric plasma-membrane cystine/glutamate antiporter whose light chain is SLC7A11 (xCT), which confers substrate specificity and catalyzes the transport reaction. SLC3A2 supplies the heavy chain that traffics and stabilizes the complex at the cell surface, so the two subunits are functionally linked rather than interchangeable.
links.context_zh_TW: System Xc- 是質膜上的胱胺酸／麩胺酸反向運輸蛋白，其輕鏈為 SLC7A11（xCT），決定受質專一性並催化運輸反應。SLC3A2 提供重鏈，負責將複合體運送並穩定於細胞表面，因此兩個次單元是功能上相互依存的。

links.context: Systemic NAD+ levels decline with aging as a result of both lowered rates of biosynthesis and increased consumption of NAD+. The decreased expression of the NAMPT enzyme is one of the major causes of this age-related NAD+ decline, and NAD+-consuming enzymes, including sirtuins, PARPs, and CD38, are induced by stress factors such as DNA damage, oxidative stress, and inflammation. The content of the primary mammalian NADase CD38 also increases with age, further lowering NAD+ availability. NAD+ depletion contributes to age-associated pathophysiology and is considered a major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, supporting the use of NAD+ precursor supplementation to counter age-related decline.
links.context_zh_TW: 全身性 NAD+ 濃度會隨老化而下降，這是由於生物合成速率降低以及 NAD+ 消耗增加所致。NAMPT 酵素的表現下降是這種與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降的主要原因之一，而 NAD+ 消耗酵素（包括 sirtuins、PARPs 與 CD38）會受到 DNA 損傷、氧化壓力與發炎等壓力因子所誘發。主要哺乳動物 NADase CD38 的含量也會隨年齡增加而上升，進一步降低 NAD+ 的可用性。NAD+ 耗竭會促進與年齡相關的病理生理變化，並被視為阿茲海默症的主要風險因子，這支持了使用 NAD+ 前驅物補充來對抗與年齡相關的衰退。
links.source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

links.context: Systemic overexpression of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is among the few antioxidant interventions that prolong the lifespan of mice, chiefly by improving oxidative-stress resistance and reducing oxidative damage during the earlier portion of life. The benefit is best characterized as a healthspan gain rather than an extension of maximum lifespan, and chronic sustained overexpression can increase tumor burden in old age.
links.context_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的全身性過度表現是少數能延長小鼠壽命的抗氧化介入之一，主要透過改善氧化壓力抵抗並降低生命早期階段的氧化損傷。此效益最好被描述為健康壽命（healthspan）的提升，而非最大壽命的延長，且長期持續的過度表現可能在老年時增加腫瘤負擔。

links.context: Systemic spillover of gut-derived Lipopolysaccharide (metabolic endotoxemia) links the Gut Microbiome to low-grade inflammation, insulin resistance and mitochondrial dysfunction. Chronic low-dose exposure is a driver of Inflammaging, and it blunts Sirtuins-dependent antioxidant defenses.
links.context_zh_TW: 腸道來源 Lipopolysaccharide 的全身溢出（代謝性內毒素血症）將 Gut Microbiome 與低度發炎、胰島素阻抗及粒線體功能障礙連結起來。慢性低劑量曝露是 Inflammaging 的驅動因子，並會削弱 Sirtuins 相關的抗氧化防禦。

links.context: T lymphocytes arise in the thymus from bone-marrow lymphoid progenitors that seed the corticomedullary junction, then pass through cortical beta-chain rearrangement, positive selection by cortical thymic epithelial cells, and medullary negative selection before export as naive single-positive cells.
links.context_zh_TW: T 淋巴球源自骨髓的淋巴系前驅細胞，它們在皮質髓質交界處進入 thymus，隨後經歷皮質中的 β 鏈重組、皮質胸腺上皮細胞的正向選擇，以及髓質的負向選擇，最後以初始單陽性細胞的形式輸出。

links.context: T-bet suppresses the Th2 fate defined by GATA3, antagonizing the IL-4/STAT6 axis that would otherwise drive type-2 immunity. T-bet is therefore a determinant of whether a CD4+ T cell mounts a type-1 interferon-gamma response or a type-2 allergic/eosinophilic program, and its dysregulation skews this balance.
links.context_zh_TW: T-bet 抑制由 GATA3 定義的 Th2 命運，與本會驅動第二型免疫的 IL-4/STAT6 軸相拮抗。因此 T-bet 決定了 CD4+ T 細胞會啟動第一型 interferon-gamma 反應，還是第二型過敏/嗜酸性反應程式；其失調會使此平衡偏移。

links.context: TADs constrain enhancer-promoter communication, and super-enhancers reside within TADs where they loop to target promoters. In senescence, TAD-scale rewiring reshapes enhancer-promoter looping to drive SASP expression.
links.context_zh_TW: TAD 約束增強子-啟動子溝通，超級增強子位於 TAD 內並環化至目標啟動子。在衰老中，TAD 尺度重組重塑增強子-啟動子環化以驅動 SASP 表現。

links.context: TAK1 phosphorylates the IKK complex, triggering IkappaBalpha degradation and consequent NF-κB nuclear translocation. This branch is what makes TAK1 kinase activity essential for cytokine-induced NF-κB and AP-1 activation in innate and stress responses.
links.context_zh_TW: TAK1 磷酸化 IKK complex，導致 IkappaBalpha 降解並使 NF-κB 核轉位。正是這個分支讓 TAK1 的激酶活性成為細胞激素誘發 NF-κB 與 AP-1 活化所必需，並連結先天與壓力反應。

links.context: TALE repeat arrays are the programmable DNA-binding module of mitoTALENs. Because each 34-residue repeat reads one base pair, a mitoTALEN can be engineered to discriminate a single mutant nucleotide in mitochondrial DNA, and a mitochondrial targeting sequence imports the TALE-FokI fusion into the matrix for selective cleavage.
links.context_zh_TW: TALE 重复阵列是 mitoTALENs 的可程式化 DNA 結合模組。由於每個 34 殘基重複單元辨識一個鹼基對，mitoTALEN 可被設計成在 mitochondrial DNA 上辨識單一突變核苷酸，再由 mitochondrial targeting sequence 將 TALE–FokI 融合蛋白輸入粒線體基質進行選擇性切割。

links.context: TASCC assembly is required for the robust chronic SASP because it supplies both the amino-acid substrate and the mTORC1 directive for cap-dependent translation of secretory mRNAs such as IL-1alpha. Blocking mTORC1 with rapamycin or blocking early autophagy diminishes SASP output without eliminating senescence itself.
links.context_zh_TW: TASCC 的組裝是穩健而慢性的 SASP 所必需，因為它同時提供胺基酸原料與 mTORC1 指令，使 IL-1alpha 等分泌性 mRNA 能進行帽依賴性轉譯。以 rapamycin 阻斷 mTORC1 或阻斷早期自噬可削弱 SASP 輸出，卻不會消除衰老狀態本身。

links.context: TBK1 phosphorylates the autophagy receptor NDP52, which significantly enhances NDP52's affinity for ubiquitin chains on damaged mitochondria. This phosphorylation-dependent boost creates a positive feedback loop that accelerates mitochondrial engulfment by the phagophore, and the same kinase also phosphorylates the partner receptor OPTN.
links.context_zh_TW: TBK1 會磷酸化自噬受體 NDP52，显著提升 NDP52 對受損粒線體上泛素鏈的親和力。這種依賴磷酸化增強的機制形成正向回饋迴圈，加速 phagophore 對粒線體的吞噬；同一激酶也會磷酸化搭檔受體 OPTN。

links.context: TBK1 promotes apoptosis indirectly by degrading XIAP: once XIAP is removed, Caspase-3, Caspase-7 and Caspase-9 are released from inhibition and the cell is sensitized to apoptosis. This is notable because TBK1 is generally a survival kinase in other contexts.
links.context_zh_TW: TBK1 藉由降解 XIAP 間接促進 apoptosis：XIAP 被清除後，Caspase-3、Caspase-7 與 Caspase-9 解除抑制，細胞便被敏化而走向凋。這點值得注意，因為在其他情境下 TBK1 主要是存活促進型激酶。

links.context: TDO (TDO2) is the hepatic heme enzyme that catalyzes the same first, rate-limiting step of the kynurenine pathway as IDO1, converting tryptophan to N-formylkynurenine. Unlike IDO1 it is selective for L-tryptophan, primarily hepatic, induced by substrate and glucocorticoids rather than interferon-gamma - so in tumors TDO provides a compensatory tryptophan-catabolic route when IDO1 is blocked.
links.context_zh_TW: TDO（TDO2）是催化 kynurenine Pathway 同一個首要且速率限制步驟的肝臟血紅素酵素，與 IDO1 皆將 tryptophan 轉為 N-Formylkynurenine。與 IDO1 不同，TDO 對 L-tryptophan 具專一性、主要位於肝臟，並受受質與糖皮質素誘導而非 interferon-gamma；因此在腫瘤中 IDO1 被阻斷時，TDO 提供代償性的 tryptophan 分解途徑。

links.context: TDO also produces N-Formylkynurenine, but in a tissue-restricted way: hepatic tryptophan dioxygenase runs the same oxidative deamination. Having IDO1 and TDO generate the identical intermediate means tryptophan catabolism can be targeted at either entry point, and that N-Formylkynurenine is not a marker of one specific enzyme's activity.
links.context_zh_TW: TDO 也會產生 N-Formylkynurenine，但侷限於特定組織：肝臟的 tryptophan dioxygenase 執行相同的氧化脫胺反應。由於 IDO1 與 TDO 生成相同的中間產物，表示 tryptophan 分解可在任一入口被標定，也表示 N-Formylkynurenine 並非某一特定酵素活性的專一標記。

links.context: TDP-43 is the canonical example of a mislocalized RNA-binding protein. Under stress it redistributes out of the nucleus into cytoplasmic aggregates and stress granules, losing nuclear function and gaining toxicity in ALS and frontotemporal dementia; more generally, RBP mislocalization or aggregation, including sequestration by tau or polyQ condensates, drives neurodegeneration by disrupting RNA metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: TDP-43 是錯定位 RNA-binding protein 的典型例子。在壓力下它從細胞核重新分布到細胞質聚集体與壓力顆粒，失去核內功能並在 ALS 與額顳葉失智症中獲得毒性；更一般地說，RBP 的錯定位或聚集（包括被 tau 或 polyQ 凝聚體隔離）會破壞 RNA 代謝而驅動神經退化。

links.context: TDP-43 pathology in ALS is not only a loss-of-function aggregation disease: TDP-43-mediated mtDNA release and consequent cGAS-STING activation contribute to motor neuron degeneration. Blocking the mPTP or VDAC1 mitigates neurodegeneration and STING inhibition rescues TDP-43-treated iPSC motor neurons, positioning pore blockade as therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: ALS 中的 TDP-43 病態不僅是聚集造成的功能喪失：TDP-43 媒介的 mtDNA 釋放與隨後的 cGAS-STING 活化也促成運動神經元退化。阻斷 mPTP 或 VDAC1 可減輕神經退化，抑制 STING 則挽救 TDP-43 處理的 iPSC 運動神經元，使孔道阻斷成為治療策略。

links.context: TDR is a component_of the World Health Organization system: it was established in 1975 and is co-sponsored by WHO together with UNICEF, UNDP, the World Bank and formerly the Rockefeller Foundation, with the mandate of building an evidence base for control, elimination and eradication of neglected tropical diseases.
links.context_zh_TW: TDR 是 World Health Organization 體系的一環：它成立於 1975 年，由 WHO 與 UNICEF、UNDP、世界銀行及（前）洛克菲勒基金會共同資助，使命是為熱帶疾病的控制、消除與根除建立證據基礎。

links.context: TFAM is a nuclear-encoded, mitochondria-targeted DNA-binding protein that binds and packages mitochondrial DNA, regulating its replication and transcription. Because of that role TFAM is a key determinant of mitochondrial biogenesis and respiratory-chain capacity, and one of the major effectors by which mTOR inhibition rebuilds mitochondrial networks.
links.context_zh_TW: TFAM 是核基因編碼、定位於粒線體的 DNA 結合蛋白，會結合並包裝 mitochondrial DNA，調控其複製與轉錄。有鑒於此角色，TFAM 是 mitochondrial biogenesis 與呼吸鏈容量的關鍵決定因子，也是 mTOR 抑制重建粒線體網絡的主要效應因子之一。

links.context: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

links.context: TFEB is normally retained in the cytoplasm by mTOR-dependent phosphorylation, and Torin1 releases that repression to drive TFEB into the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of the Ser122 and Ser211 sites is required for this translocation, as shown by phosphomimetic S122D mutation of TFEB, which largely blocks the Torin1 effect on TFEB nuclear localization.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 原本因 mTOR 依賴性的磷酸化而被留在細胞質中，Torin1 解除此抑制後促使 TFEB 進入細胞核。TFEB 的 Ser122 與 Ser211 位點去磷酸化是此轉位所必需；TFEB 的 S122D 磷酸擬似突變可大幅阻斷 Torin1 對 TFEB 核定位的效應，即為證據。

links.context: TFEB is required for osteoclast function in vivo, as its depletion results in decreased expression of lysosomal genes, reduced lysosome number, and defective bone matrix resorption. RANK treatment promotes TFEB phosphorylation via PKCbeta kinase, leading to TFEB nuclear translocation and induction of lysosomal biogenesis. Nuclear TFEB facilitates secretion of lysosomal hydrolases at the site of bone resorption. This establishes TFEB as essential for skeletal homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 在活體中為破骨細胞功能所必需，因為其缺失導致溶酶體基因表現下降、溶酶體數量減少和骨基質吸收缺陷。RANK 處理經由 PKCbeta 激酶促進 TFEB 磷酸化，導致 TFEB 核轉位和溶酶體生物發生誘導。核 TFEB 促進溶酶體水解酶在骨吸收部位分泌。這確立了 TFEB 對骨骼恆定性的必要性。
links.source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

links.context: TFEB is retained in the cytosol when it is phosphorylated at cytoplasmic-retention sites. Phosphorylation of S211 by mTORC1 or p38 MAPK, of S142 by mTORC1 or ERK2, of S122 by mTORC1, of S467 by Akt, and of S3 by MAP4K3 all promote cytoplasmic retention of TFEB, keeping the transcription factor away from its nuclear target genes. This phosphorylation-dependent cytosolic sequestration is the primary mechanism by which nutrient-rich and growth-factor-rich conditions suppress the lysosomal and autophagic transcriptional program. Dephosphorylation of these sites by calcineurin or PP2A relieves the retention and permits TFEB to translocate to the nucleus.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 在胞質保留位點被磷酸化時被保留在細胞質中。mTORC1 或 p38 MAPK 對 S211 的磷酸化、mTORC1 或 ERK2 對 S142 的磷酸化、mTORC1 對 S122 的磷酸化、Akt 對 S467 的磷酸化，以及 MAP4K3 對 S3 的磷酸化，均促進 TFEB 的胞質保留，使轉錄因子遠離其核靶基因。這種依賴磷酸化的胞質隔離是營養豐富和生長因子豐富條件抑制溶酶體和自噬轉錄程序的主要機制。鈣調磷酸酶或 PP2A 對這些位點的去磷酸化解除保留，允許 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

links.context: TFEB is the central node of the transcriptional regulation of the autophagic-lysosomal network, driving expression of lysosomal genes, V-ATPase subunits, lysosomal transmembrane proteins and hydrolases. It also self-regulates, and its transcription is modulated by PGC-1α and by XBP1 through the unfolded protein response element, so its output is set at several levels at once.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 是自噬－溶酶體網絡 transcriptional regulation 的核心節點，驅動溶酶體基因、V-ATPase 次單元、溶酶體跨膜蛋白與水解酶的表現。它亦具自我調控，其轉錄受 PGC-1α 與透過 unfolded protein response element 作用的 XBP1 調節，因此其輸出同時受數個層級設定。

links.context: TFEB is the master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy gene programs via the CLEAR network. Its activation links nutrient stress to autophagic flux across fasting, exercise and drug interventions.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 是經由 CLEAR 網絡調控溶酶體生成與自噬基因程序的主轉錄因子。其活化將營養壓力連結到禁食、運動與藥物介入中的自噬流。

links.context: TFEB translocates to the nucleus in response to dephosphorylation of its cytoplasmic-retention sites. Dephosphorylation of S211 and S142 by calcineurin, and of S122 and S109/S114 by PP2A, promotes nuclear translocation, while phosphorylation of S401 by p38 MAPK also drives the transcription factor into the nucleus. Acetylation at K91/K103/K430 and PARsylation by TNKS1 likewise promote nuclear translocation, and O-GlcNAc glucosylation of S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 promotes nuclear entry while S138 glucosylation blocks nuclear export. Once in the nucleus, TFEB activates transcription of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes, making nuclear localization the key regulatory decision point.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 通過其胞質保留位點的去磷酸化響應而轉位至細胞核。鈣調磷酸酶對 S211 和 S142 的去磷酸化，以及 PP2A 對 S122 和 S109/S114 的去磷酸化，促進核轉位；p38 MAPK 對 S401 的磷酸化也驅動轉錄因子進入細胞核。K91/K103/K430 的乙醯化以及 TNKS1 的 PARylation 同樣促進核轉位，S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 的 O-GlcNAc 糖基化促進核輸入，而 S138 的糖基化則阻斷核輸出。一旦進入細胞核，TFEB 啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因的轉錄，使核定位成為關鍵的調節決定點。

links.context: TFEB, a member of the microphthalmia (MiT/TFEB) family of leucine-zipper transcription factors, is known as the master regulator of transcription of genes participating in lysosome biogenesis and autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 microphthalmia（MiT/TFEB）家族的亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，被認為是參與溶小體生成與自噬之基因轉錄的主調控因子。

links.context: TFEB-mediated autophagy protects Dopamine Neuron from Alpha-synuclein toxicity. Dopamine neurons of the Substantia Nigra pars compacta are selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease, and deleting TFEB (or Atg7) in mice triggers their degeneration together with protein aggregation.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 TFEB 介導的自噬可保護 Dopamine Neuron 免受 Alpha-synuclein 毒性傷害。Substantia Nigra pars compacta 的多巴胺神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中具有選擇易感性，在小鼠中剔除 TFEB（或 Atg7）會誘發其退化與蛋白聚集。

links.context: TGF-beta is both a key SASP factor and the dominant upstream activator of the mesenchymal program, engaging Snail and Zeb1 to suppress E-cadherin and junctions. The TGF-beta signaling pathway is also the main roadblock to reprogramming, which is why it is inhibited with compounds such as SB431542 to improve efficiency.
links.context_zh_TW: TGF-beta 既是關鍵的 SASP 因子，也是間質程式最主要的活化途徑，透過 Snail 與 Zeb1 抑制 E-cadherin 與細胞連接。TGF-beta signaling pathway 同時也是細胞重編程的主要障礙，因此會使用 SB431542 等化合物抑制它以提升效率。

links.context: TGF-beta1 signals through downstream SMAD2/3/4 effectors. Ligand-to-SMAD coupling is the pathway core.
links.context_zh_TW: TGF-beta1 經由下游 SMAD2/3/4 效應器訊號。配體到 SMAD 的耦合是路徑核心。

links.context: TGF-beta3 is a ligand isoform of the TGF-beta superfamily.
links.context_zh_TW: TGF-β3 是 TGF-β 超家族的配體亞型。

links.context: TGF-β signaling proceeds through SMAD2/3 phosphorylation by the TβRI receptor kinase, complex formation with SMAD4, and nuclear translocation for target gene regulation. SMAD3 is therefore the transducer of the pathway, and its phosphorylation state sets the output of the entire cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: TGF-β 訊號經由 TβRI 受體激酶磷酸化 SMAD2/3、與 SMAD4 形成複合體，以及核轉位以調控標的基因。SMAD3 因而是此路徑的傳遞者，其磷酸化狀態決定了整個級聯的輸出。

links.context: TGF-β signalling through SMAD2/3 drives fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation and extracellular matrix deposition. Activated myofibroblasts are contractile, α-smooth-muscle-actin-positive cells that close wounds but, when persistently activated, drive fibrosis — which is why fibroblast-targeted therapies such as TGF-β or lysyl oxidase inhibition aim to limit pathological scarring.
links.context_zh_TW: TGF-β 經由 SMAD2/3 的訊號傳遞驅動 fibroblast 向 myofibroblast 分化與 extracellular matrix 沉積。被活化的 myofibroblast 是具收縮性、α-smooth-muscle-actin 陽性的細胞，可閉合傷口，但持續活化時會驅動 fibrosis——因此針對 fibroblast 的治療（如抑制 TGF-β 或 lysyl oxidase）旨在限制病理性瘢痕。

links.context: TGFb is a SASP factor strongly associated with pro-fibrotic phenotypes and pulmonary fibrosis, activating fibroblasts and myofibroblasts to deposit extracellular matrix. Through SMAD and non-SMAD signaling it shifts tissue toward scar formation, and its induction of EMT in neighboring epithelial cells further contributes to fibrosis and tissue remodeling. This makes TGFb a central mediator of senescence-associated fibrosis in the lung, liver, and kidney. Its pro-fibrotic action is a major pathological consequence of chronic SASP and a target for anti-fibrotic therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFb 是一種與促纖維化表型和肺纖維化強相關的 SASP 因子，活化纖維母細胞與肌纖維母細胞沉積細胞外基質。透過 SMAD 與非 SMAD 訊號，它將組織推向疤痕形成，且其對鄰近上皮細胞 EMT 的誘發進一步貢獻纖維化與組織重塑。這使 TGFb 成為肺、肝與腎中衰老相關纖維化的中心介導者。其促纖維化作用是慢性 SASP 的主要病理後果，也是抗纖維化療法的標靶。

links.context: TGFb is a SASP factor that mediates paracrine senescence by activating SMAD signaling and, in some contexts, suppressing PI3K/Akt signaling in recipient cells, promoting growth arrest. It transcriptionally induces CDKN2B/p15INK4b and p21CIP1 to enforce the arrest, and it contributes to the fibrotic and arrest-inducing arms of the secretome. TGFb cooperates with IL-6 to drive TH17 differentiation and with other factors to spread senescence. Its mediation of paracrine arrest is well documented in multiple models.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFb 是一種介導旁分泌衰老的 SASP 因子，透過活化 SMAD 訊號並在某些脈絡中抑制受體細胞的 PI3K/Akt 訊號，促進生長停滯。它轉錄誘發 CDKN2B/p15INK4b 與 p21CIP1 以執行停滯，並貢獻分泌組的纖維化與停滯誘發臂。TGFb 與 IL-6 協作驅動 TH17 分化，並與其他因子共同擴散衰老。其對旁分泌停滯的介導在多種模型中已有良好記載。

links.context: TGFb is a SASP factor that promotes paracrine senescence by activating SMAD signaling and, in some contexts, suppressing PI3K/Akt signaling in recipient cells, reinforcing growth arrest. It transcriptionally induces CDKN2B/p15INK4b and p21CIP1 to enforce the arrest, and it contributes to the fibrotic and arrest-inducing arms of the secretome. TGFb cooperates with IL-6 to drive TH17 differentiation and with other factors to spread senescence. Its mediation of paracrine arrest is well documented in multiple models.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFb 是一種促進旁分泌衰老的 SASP 因子，透過活化 SMAD 訊號並在某些脈絡中抑制受體細胞的 PI3K/Akt 訊號，強化生長停滯。它轉錄誘發 CDKN2B/p15INK4b 與 p21CIP1 以執行停滯，並貢獻分泌組的纖維化與停滯誘發臂。TGFb 與 IL-6 協作驅動 TH17 分化，並與其他因子共同擴散衰老。其對旁分泌停滯的介導在多種模型中已有良好記載。

links.context: TGFβ drives epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition together with fibroblast activation, which is why it is a central driver of fibrosis and scar biology. This is also why TGFβ has a dual role in cancer - tumor suppressor early, tumor promoter later - and why context-specific targeting (ALK5/SMAD inhibitors, integrin alpha-v-beta-6 blockers) is essential.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFβ 會促成 epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition 與纖維母細胞活化，因此是纖維化與疤痕生物學的核心驅動因子。這也是 TGFβ 在癌症中具有雙重角色的原因——早期為腫瘤抑制、晚期為腫瘤促進——並使情境專一性標定（ALK5/SMAD 抑制劑、integrin alpha-v-beta-6 阻斷劑）不可或缺。

links.context: TGFβ family ligands play a major role in paracrine senescence by regulating p15^INK4b and p21^CIP1 expression; TGF-βR1 (TGFBR1) inhibitors prevented SMAD2/3 phosphorylation and blunted the arrest. In a mouse PanIN model driven by Kras G12D, conditional deletion of TGF-βR1 in the pancreas attenuated oncogene-induced senescence and sharply shortened cancer-free latency, showing TGF-β signalling is essential for OIS-mediated tumour suppression in vivo.
links.context_zh_TW: TGFβ 家族配體藉由調控 p15^INK4b 與 p21^CIP1 表現在 paracrine senescence 中扮演主要角色；TGF-βR1（TGFBR1）抑制劑阻止 SMAD2/3 磷酸化並削弱停滯。在 Kras G12D 驅動的 PanIN 小鼠模型中，於胰臟條件性剔除 TGF-βR1 會減弱致癌基因誘發衰老並大幅縮短無癌存活期，顯示 TGF-β 訊號在體內對 OIS 媒介的腫瘤抑制至關重要。

links.context: TIMP1 is a transcriptional target of the TGF-beta1/SMAD3 pathway: TGF-beta1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1 and ACTA2 alongside TIMP1. By restraining MMP-mediated proteolysis TIMP1 thereby acts as a central effector of tissue fibrosis and net ECM accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: TIMP1 是 TGF-beta1/SMAD3 途徑的轉錄標的：TGF-beta1 啟動 SMAD3 依賴的促纖維化基因轉錄，包含 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 與 TIMP1。由於 TIMP1 抑制 MMP 媒介的蛋白水解，它因此成為組織纖維化與淨 ECM 累積的核心效應因子。

links.context: TIMP1 is the principal endogenous inhibitor of MMP-9 (gelatinase B) and also of MMP-12 (macrophage metalloelastase). Its N-terminal inhibitory domain binds the catalytic site of the target MMP in a 1:1 stoichiometric complex, blocking substrate access, so the MMP-9/TIMP1 balance sets net gelatinolytic activity in tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: TIMP1 是 MMP-9（gelatinase B）的主要內生抑制劑，也抑制 MMP-12（macrophage metalloelastase）。其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 化學計量複合體結合目標 MMP 的催化位，阻斷受質接近，因此 MMP-9／TIMP1 的平衡決定組織中淨明膠酶活性。

links.context: TIMP2 binds the catalytic site of MMP-2 (gelatinase A) in a 1:1 complex to inhibit it, but at low concentrations it also acts as a facilitator rather than an inhibitor: TIMP2 bridges MT1-MMP and pro-MMP-2 on the cell surface into a ternary complex, letting adjacent uninhibited MT1-MMP cleave the pro-peptide and generate active 62 kDa MMP-2. This makes TIMP2 a concentration-dependent molecular switch.
links.context_zh_TW: TIMP2 以 1:1 複合體結合 MMP-2（gelatinase A）的催化位而抑制它；但在低濃度下它反而是促進因子：TIMP2 在細胞表面把 MT1-MMP 與 pro-MMP-2 架橋成三元複合體，使鄰近且未被抑制的 MT1-MMP 剪除前驅物胜肽，生成具活性的 62 kDa MMP-2。這使 TIMP2 成為濃度依賴的分子開關。

links.context: TIMP3 is an endogenous ~24 kDa secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases; its N-terminal inhibitory domain inserts into the catalytic cleft of targets such as MMP-9 and MMP-2 in a 1:1 complex, and unlike TIMP1/2/4 it stays tethered to the extracellular matrix via heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
links.context_zh_TW: TIMP3 是內生性約 24 kDa 的分泌型基質金屬蛋白酶抑制劑；其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 複合體插入 MMP-9、MMP-2 等標的酵素的催化裂縫，且與 TIMP1/2/4 不同，它透過硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣固定在細胞外基質上。

links.context: TLR2 is induced during senescence and is essential for the immunity-regulating arm of the SASP: engagement recruits MyD88 and TRIF, nucleates a MyD88-IRAK-TRAF6 complex, and activates IKK complex, NF-kB and p38 MAPK. Via NF-kB and IRF signaling TLR2 lets senescent cells communicate with macrophages, NK cells and T cells - underpinning tumor immunosurveillance when acute, maladaptive inflammation when chronic.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR2 在衰老期間被誘導，且對 SASP 的免疫調節分支不可或缺：配體結合會招募 MyD88 與 TRIF，形成 MyD88–IRAK–TRAF6 複合體並活化 IKK complex、NF-kB 與 p38 MAPK。經由 NF-kB 與 IRF 訊號，TLR2 讓衰老細胞得以與巨噬細胞、NK 細胞與 T 細胞溝通——急性時支撐腫瘤免疫監控，慢性時則導致失調的發炎。

links.context: TLR2 is not a functional receptor on its own: it heterodimerizes with TLR1 or TLR6 to recognize lipopeptides, and the partner sets specificity. The TLR2/TLR6 complex senses diacylated lipopeptides such as MALP-2 and lipoteichoic acid, whereas TLR2/TLR1 senses triacylated lipopeptides - one scaffold, two classes of bacterial lipoprotein.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR2 單獨並非功能性受體：它必須與 TLR1 或 TLR6 二聚化以辨識脂胜肽，而夥伴受體決定了專一性。TLR2/TLR6 複合體感測二醯化脂胜肽（如 MALP-2）與 lipoteichoic acid，而 TLR2/TLR1 則感測三醯化脂胜肽——同一骨架涵蓋兩類細菌脂蛋白。

links.context: TLR2 is the primary pattern recognition receptor for lipoteichoic acid, functioning as a complex with TLR6 and the co-receptor CD36. Binding of LTA to the TLR2/TLR6/CD36 complex activates MyD88-dependent NF-κB and MAPK signalling, inducing TNF-α, IL-6, IL-8 and IL-1β production.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR2 是 lipoteichoic acid 的主要模式辨識受體，與 TLR6 及共同受體 CD36 形成複合體。LTA 與 TLR2/TLR6/CD36 複合體結合後，會活化 MyD88 相關的 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號，誘導 TNF-α、IL-6、IL-8 與 IL-1β 的產生。

links.context: TLR3 (and TLR4 endosomal TLR4/TRIF arm) signals through the TIR-domain adapter TRIF, which carries a RHIM and activates RIPK3 to form a RIPK1-independent necrosome.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR3（及 TLR4 的 TRIF 臂）經由含 TIR 結構域的接合蛋白 TRIF 傳訊；TRIF 帶 RHIM，可活化 RIPK3 形成不依賴 RIPK1 的 necrosome。

links.context: TLR3 is the receptor whose signaling is mediated solely by the TRIF adaptor; dsRNA (poly(I:C)) engagement under caspase inhibition can then drive a TRIF/RIPK3 necrosome (Niu et al. 2026).
links.context_zh_TW: TLR3 是唯一完全經由 TRIF 接頭傳遞訊號的受體；在 caspase 受抑制時，dsRNA（poly(I:C)）接合可驅動 TRIF/RIPK3 necrosome（Niu et al. 2026）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Regulatory complexity and therapeutic targeting of the necroptosis network.md

links.context: TLR6 signals exclusively through MyD88, never TRIF: diacylated lipopeptide or lipoteichoic acid binding induces TLR2/TLR6 heterodimerization, the TIR domains recruit MAL/TIRAP which bridges to MyD88 then IRAK4/IRAK1 then TRAF6, and TRAF6 activates TAK1, the IKK complex and NF-kB plus MAPK cascades. Because the TRIF-IRF3 axis is not engaged, output is pro-inflammatory cytokines with little type I interferon.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR6 僅透過 MyD88 傳訊，絕不走 TRIF：二醯化脂胜肽或 lipoteichoic acid 結合誘發 TLR2/TLR6 二聚化，TIR 結構域招募 MAL/TIRAP，再橋接至 MyD88、IRAK4/IRAK1 與 TRAF6，TRAF6 進而活化 TAK1、IKK complex、NF-kB 與 MAPK 级联。由於 TRIF–IRF3 軸未被啟動，輸出為促發炎細胞激素而第一型干擾素極少。

links.context: TLR9 activation triggers NF-κB and interferon regulatory factor signaling, linking endosomal DNA detection to Inflammation and type I IFN responses. Because TLR9 signals through NF-κB, its activity modulates the magnitude of inflammatory output downstream of endolysosomal CpG sensing.
links.context_zh_TW: TLR9 的活化會啟動 NF-κB 與干擾素調節因子訊號，將內體 DNA 偵測連結到 Inflammation 與第一型 IFN 反應。由於 TLR9 經由 NF-κB 傳遞訊號，其活性可調節內溶體 CpG 感知下游的發炎反應強度。

links.context: TLS arises from loss or inactivation of tumor suppressors such as PTEN, RB1, and p16INK4A rather than from excess proliferative signaling. Each removal of a growth brake generates replication stress or DNA damage that stabilizes the arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: TLS 源於 PTEN、RB1 和 p16INK4A 等腫瘤抑制因子的喪失或失活，而非過度的增殖訊號。每次移除生長制動器都會產生複製壓力或 DNA 損傷，使停滯狀態穩定化。

links.context: TMG (trimethylglycine/betaine) is a methyl donor that, via betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase, converts homocysteine to methionine. By supporting remethylation it helps maintain a high SAM:SAH ratio, reducing SAH accumulation and preserving methylation capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: TMG（三甲基甘氨酸/betaine）是甲基供體，經由甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶將同型半胱氨酸轉化為甲硫氨酸。透過支持再甲基化，它有助於維持高 SAM:SAH 比例，減少 SAH 累積並保存甲基化能力。

links.context: TNF death-receptor engagement drives extrinsic apoptosis via caspase-8. Induction covers the death-arm outcome.
links.context_zh_TW: TNF 死亡受體接合經由 caspase-8 驅動外源凋亡。誘發涵蓋死亡分支結果。

links.context: TNF signaling is the pathway activated by TNF family cytokines through TNFR1/2, converging on NF-kB, MAPK, and apoptosis pathways. Apigenin downregulates TNF signaling and NF-kB signaling to suppress the SASP in senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: TNF 訊號是 TNF 家族細胞激素經由 TNFR1/2 活化的途徑，匯聚於 NF-κB、MAPK 與細胞凋亡途徑。Apigenin 下調 TNF 訊號與 NF-κB 訊號以壓制衰老細胞中的 SASP。

links.context: TNFR1 is the death-domain-containing member of the TNF receptor family and the canonical necroptosis entry point; other TNFR-superfamily members lack the same direct necrosome coupling.
links.context_zh_TW: TNFR1 為 TNF 受體家族中具死亡結構域的成員，是 necroptosis 的經典入口；其他 TNFR 超家族成員無相同的直接 necrosome 偶聯。

links.context: TNKS2 (tankyrase 2, PARP5B) is one of two tankyrase isozymes that catalyze poly-ADP-ribosylation of substrate proteins. Its ankyrin repeat domain binds substrates such as axin, TRF1 and TFEB, and PARsylation of TFEB promotes its destabilisation and restricts its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes.
links.context_zh_TW: TNKS2（tankyrase 2，PARP5B）是兩種 tankyrase 異構酶之一，催化受體蛋白的 poly-ADP-核糖基化。其 ankyrin repeat 結構域結合 axin、TRF1 與 TFEB 等受體，而 TFEB 的 PARsylation 會促進其去穩定化並限制其溶酶體與自噬基因的轉錄程序。

links.context: TOM1 acts as a negative regulator of innate immune signaling. TOM1 recruitment to ubiquitinated Toll-like Receptor 4 and IL-1 receptor complexes accelerates their clearance, damping pro-inflammatory NF-κB and cytokine output; TOM1 knockdown enhances TLR- and IL-1β-driven inflammation. By routing ubiquitinated receptors to lysosomes, TOM1 limits receptor half-life and keeps inflammatory signaling balanced.
links.context_zh_TW: TOM1 作為先天免疫訊號的負向調節因子。TOM1 被招募至泛素化的 Toll-like Receptor 4 與 IL-1 受體複合體後加速其清除，抑制促發炎的 NF-κB 與細胞激素輸出；TOM1 敲低會增強 TLR 與 IL-1β 驅動的發炎反應。藉由將泛素化受體運送至 lysosome，TOM1 限制受體半衰期，使發炎訊號維持平衡。

links.context: TOP1 (Topoisomerase 1) relieves DNA supercoiling by creating transient single-strand breaks. Its trapped cleavage complexes (TOP1cc) assist cGAS recognition of and binding to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCFs), which is essential for downstream SASP regulation: TOP1 on these fragments licenses cGAS binding by exposing appropriate DNA topology and co-localizing with the sensor, cooperating with G3BP1.
links.context_zh_TW: TOP1 (Topoisomerase 1) 藉由製造暫時性單股斷裂來解除 DNA 超螺旋。其被捕捉的裂解複合體 (TOP1cc) 協助 cGAS 辨識並結合細胞質染色質片段 (CCFs)，這對下游 SASP 的調控至关重要：TOP1 藉由呈現適當的 DNA 拓撲並與感測器共定位，使 cGAS 得以結合，並與 G3BP1 協同作用。

links.context: TOP1cc are essential for cGAS-STING activation in senescence: they link DNA damage/topo stress to SASP regulation through the cytosolic DNA axis, positioning DNA topology and replication stress as upstream triggers of the SASP. Pharmacologic TOP1 trapping (e.g., low-dose irinotecan) can exacerbate senescence-associated interferon signaling, whereas TOP1 modulation attenuates it.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Senescence 中，TOP1cc 對 cGAS-STING 的活化不可或缺：它們經由細胞質 DNA 軸將 DNA 損傷／拓撲壓力連結到 SASP 的調控，使 DNA 拓撲與複製壓力成為 SASP 的上游觸發因子。藥理性的 TOP1 捕捉（例如低劑量 irinotecan）會加劇與 Senescence 相關的干擾素訊號，而 TOP1 的調節則可減輕之。

links.context: TRAF2 (TNF receptor-associated factor 2) is a versatile adaptor protein recruited by the MAVS complex to activate an innate immune response following viral infection. As part of the MAVS signaling platform on mitochondria, TRAF2 relays antiviral signals downstream to effectors such as NF-κB.
links.context_zh_TW: TRAF2 (TNF receptor-associated factor 2) 是一種多功能的轉接蛋白，由 MAVS 複合體招募，以在病毒感染後啟動先天免疫反應。作為粒線體上 MAVS 訊號平台的一部分，TRAF2 將抗病毒訊號向下游傳遞給 NF-κB 等效應器。

links.context: TRAF2 is a key component of the signaling complex recruited by TNFR1, where it helps activate the NF-κB pathway to promote cell survival. In TNFR1 complex I, TRAF2 recruits cIAPs to ubiquitinate RIPK1 (survival mode), and is itself a CYLD deubiquitination substrate at the complex I → complex II handoff. Because of this survival signaling, TRAF2 overactivity can contribute to tumor growth and resistance to apoptosis-inducing therapies.
links.context_zh_TW: TRAF2 是 TNFR1 所招募訊號複合體的關鍵成分，在其中協助活化 NF-κB 途徑以促進細胞存活。在 TNFR1 complex I 中，TRAF2 招募 cIAPs 對 RIPK1 進行泛素化（存活模式），其本身在 complex I → complex II 的交接處是 CYLD 去泛素化的受質。由於此存活訊號作用，TRAF2 的過度活化可能促成腫瘤生長與對誘導凋亡療法的抗性。

links.context: TRAIL binding induces DR4 trimerization and DISC recruitment, initiating extrinsic apoptosis with tumor selectivity.
links.context_zh_TW: TRAIL 結合誘發 DR4 三聚化與 DISC 招募，啟動具腫瘤選擇性的外源性凋亡。

links.context: TREM2 signaling activity — independent of disease-associated variants — can itself induce Interferon-Stimulated Genes and upregulate cGAS expression, doing so separately from the canonical Disease-Associated Microglia program. TREM2 activity independently drives cGAS/ISG programs, suggesting that TREM2 functions as a rheostat for cGAS-STING engagement in glial cells.
links.context_zh_TW: TREM2 的訊號活性——獨立於疾病相關變異之外——本身即可誘導 Interferon-Stimulated Genes 並上调 cGAS 的表現，且此作用獨立於典型的 Disease-Associated Microglia 程式。TREM2 活性可獨立驅動 cGAS/ISG 程式，顯示 TREM2 在膠細胞中是 cGAS-STING 參與程度的調節開關。

links.context: TREM2 tone bidirectionally shapes both microglial and astrocytic responses: TREM2 haploinsufficiency intensifies Astrocyte Senescence, indicating that loss of TREM2 function accelerates glial senescence. Because TREM2 both gates inflammatory signaling and supports microglial homeostasis, it is a prime target for immunomodulatory strategies that dampen maladaptive IFN-I programs without abolishing protective microglial functions.
links.context_zh_TW: TREM2 的作用量能雙向塑造微膠細胞與星狀膠細胞的反應：TREM2 單倍體功能不足會加劇 Astrocyte Senescence，顯示 TREM2 功能喪失會加速膠細胞的 Senescence。由於 TREM2 既能閘控發炎訊號又能支持微膠細胞恆定，它是免疫調節策略的绝佳標的，可在不犧牲保護性微膠細胞功能的前提下抑制失適應性的 IFN-I 程式。

links.context: TREX1's C-terminal transmembrane domain anchors it to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane, where it co-localizes with cGAS and STING. The ER-targeting C-terminal domain is essential for TREX1 function in vivo, as forced cytoplasmic mislocalization impairs its ability to prevent innate immune activation. TREX1 forms homodimers via a hydrophobic interface, with back-to-back active sites enabling processive degradation of cytosolic DNA.
links.context_zh_TW: TREX1 的 C 端穿膜結構域將其錨定在內質網（ER）膜上，並在該處與 cGAS 及 STING 共定位。ER 定位的 C 端結構域對 TREX1 的體內功能至關重要，因為強迫其錯位至細胞質會損害其抑制先天免疫活化的能力。TREX1 透過疏水介面形成同源二聚體，其背靠背的活性位點可進行細胞質 DNA 的持續性降解。

links.context: TRIF binds the RHIM domain of RIPK3, directly activating downstream necroptosis in infection, inflammation, and tumors.
links.context_zh_TW: TRIF結合RIPK3的RHIM結構域，直接活化下游necroptosis，見於感染、發炎損傷與腫瘤。

links.context: TRIF carries a RHIM domain that directly recruits and activates RIPK3 downstream of TLR3/TLR4, enabling RIPK1-bypassing necroptosis under caspase inhibition (poly(I:C) or LPS); this pathway is implicated in acute pancreatitis and immune dysregulation (Niu et al. 2026).
links.context_zh_TW: TRIF 具 RHIM 結構域，可在 TLR3/TLR4 下游直接招募並活化 RIPK3，於 caspase 受抑制時（poly(I:C) 或 LPS）促成繞過 RIPK1 的 necroptosis；此路徑與急性胰臟炎及免疫失調相關（Niu et al. 2026）。
links.source_file: _document_ - Regulatory complexity and therapeutic targeting of the necroptosis network.md

links.context: TRIF recruits TRAF3-TBK1/IKKε to phosphorylate IRF3, driving type I interferon (IFN-β) transcription downstream of TLR3 and TLR4.
links.context_zh_TW: TRIF recruits TRAF3-TBK1/IKKε to phosphorylate IRF3, driving type I interferon (IFN-β) transcription downstream of TLR3 and TLR4.

links.context: TRIM2 inhibits Apoptosis by eliminating Bim, a potent initiator of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization. Because the removal of Bim blunts chemotherapy-induced death, aberrant TRIM2 expression can confer resistance to apoptosis-inducing Chemotherapy and to targeted agents that rely on Bim upregulation.
links.context_zh_TW: TRIM2 藉由清除 Bim 這個線粒體外膜通透化作用的強效啟動者而抑制 Apoptosis。由於 Bim 被清除會削弱化療引發的死亡，TRIM2 的異常表現可使細胞對誘發凋亡的 Chemotherapy 以及依賴 Bim 上調的標靶藥物產生抗藥性。

links.context: TRIM2 is opposed by the related TRIM E3 ligase Trim17, which has the opposite substrate preference: instead of degrading pro-apoptotic Bim, Trim17 degrades the anti-apoptotic Mcl-1 to promote death. The TRIM2-Bim and Trim17-Mcl-1 axes therefore push the apoptotic threshold in opposite directions.
links.context_zh_TW: TRIM2 受到相關 TRIM E3 泛素連接酵素 Trim17 的對抗；Trim17 的受質偏好正好相反：它不是降解促凋亡的 Bim，而是降解抗凋亡的 Mcl-1 以促進死亡。因此 TRIM2–Bim 與 Trim17–Mcl-1 兩條軸把凋亡閾值推向相反方向。

links.context: TRIM21 directly interacts with RIPK1 and ubiquitinates it through its RING domain, regulating antiviral immunity and autoimmunity.
links.context_zh_TW: TRIM21直接與RIPK1交互作用，並透過其RING結構域泛素化RIPK1，調控抗病毒免疫與自體免疫。

links.context: TRP-2/DCT is a type I membrane glycoprotein of the melanosome, closely related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1. It requires copper at its active site and is regulated transcriptionally by MITF and post-translationally within melanosomes. The enzyme is part of the shared tyrosinase-family melanogenic toolkit.
links.context_zh_TW: TRP-2/DCT 是 melanosome 的 I 型膜醣蛋白，與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 密切相關。它的活性位點需要 copper，並在轉錄上受 MITF 調控，且在 melanosomes 內受到轉譯後調控。該酶是共享的 tyrosinase 家族黑色素生成工具包的一部分。

links.context: TRPM2 is directly gated by OAADPr (2′-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose): its C-terminal NUDT9-H homology domain lacks catalytic activity but binds this sirtuin deacetylation by-product, so sirtuin activity rises, local OAADPr accumulates, and the channel opens to permit Na+ and Ca2+ influx.
links.context_zh_TW: TRPM2 直接由 OAADPr（2′-O-乙醯-ADP-核糖）開啟閘門：其 C 端 NUDT9-H 同源域雖無催化活性但會結合這個 sirtuin 去乙醯化副產物，因此 sirtuin 活性上升、局部 OAADPr 累積，通道開啟使 Na+ 與 Ca2+ 流入。

links.context: TSC1 (hamartin) forms a complex with TSC2 (tuberin) that acts as a GAP for Rheb, inhibiting mTORC1. One of the most important sensors involved in regulation of mTORC1 activity, the TSC heterodimer is also recruited to lysosomes by RagA/B GDP–RagC/D GTP heterodimers in starvation conditions, where it is an essential brake on nutrient-deprivation signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: TSC1（hamartin）與 TSC2（tuberin）形成複合體，該複合體作為 Rheb 的 GAP 而抑制 mTORC1。作為調控 mTORC1 活性最重要的感測器之一，TSC 異二聚體在飢餓條件下也會被 RagA/B GDP–RagC/D GTP 異二聚體招募至溶酶體，在那裡它是營養缺乏訊號不可或缺的煞車。

links.context: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
links.context_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

links.context: Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy is the prototypical presentation of catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy, with apical or diffuse hypokinesis and preserved basal function mimicking myocardial infarction; the two terms are often used synonymously in the literature.
links.context_zh_TW: Takotsubo（壓力性）心肌病變是 catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 的原型表現，典型為心尖或瀰漫性運動低下而基部功能保留，模擬心肌梗塞；文獻中兩者常被視為同義。

links.context: Takotsubo is the prototypical form of catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy; the two terms are often used synonymously within the stress-cardiomyopathy spectrum. Physical triggers include critical illness, surgery, high-dose exogenous catecholamines, and Pheochromocytoma, while emotional triggers activate the Sympathetic Nervous System.
links.context_zh_TW: Takotsubo 是 catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 的原型；在壓力性心肌病變範疇中，兩個名詞常被當作同義詞使用。生理性誘因包括危重症、手術、高劑量外源性兒茶酚胺與 Pheochromocytoma；情緒性誘因則活化 Sympathetic Nervous System。

links.context: Tangier disease is characterized by extremely low HDL resulting from blocked cholesterol efflux. Incomplete versus complete loss of ABCA1 function yields a spectrum of severity: heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
links.context_zh_TW: Tangier disease 的特徵是因 cholesterol efflux 阻斷所致的 HDL 極低。ABCA1 功能的完全喪失與部分喪失形成嚴重程度的光譜：異型合子呈現中等程度的 HDL 下降，顯示 Tangier disease 與 familial HDL deficiency 之間的基因劑量效應。

links.context: Tanikolide, a pentadecanolide-type natural product, is grouped with aristoforin and amurensin G among the natural products that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, forming one of several chemical classes catalogued as sirtuin inhibitors.
links.context_zh_TW: Tanikolide（一種十五烷醇內酯型天然產物）與 aristoforin、amurensin G 一併被歸類於在微莫耳濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物，構成 sirtuin 抑制劑數個化學類別之一。

links.context: Targeting the tumour microenvironment is a major focus of modern oncology: checkpoint inhibitors such as anti-PD-1 and anti-CTLA-4 antibodies release the brakes on the immune system so it can attack cancer cells, anti-angiogenics targeting VEGF starve the tumor of blood supply, and stromal strategies aim at CAFs or reprogram them to a less supportive phenotype.
links.context_zh_TW: 以腫瘤微環境為標的，是現代 Oncology 的主要重心：抗 PD-1 與抗 CTLA-4 等免疫檢查點抑制劑解除免疫系統的煞車，使其得以攻擊癌細胞；抑制 VEGF 的抗血管生成藥物使腫瘤失去血液供應；基質策略則針對 CAFs 或將其重新編程為較不助癌的表型。

links.context: Tau hyperphosphorylation and aggregation into neurofibrillary tangles is a pathological hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, and Braak staging I–VI of Tau pathology correlates with cognitive decline, with propagation following a predictable anatomical progression from transentorhinal cortex to neocortex. The MAPT H1 haplotype is also associated with increased Alzheimer's disease risk, while H2 is protective.
links.context_zh_TW: Tau 過度磷酸化並聚集形成神經纖維纏結，是 Alzheimer's disease 的病理標誌；Tau 病變的 Braak 分期 I–VI 與認知衰退相關，且其傳播沿著從內嗅皮質到新皮層的可預測解剖路徑進展。MAPT H1 單倍型也與 Alzheimer's disease 風險升高相關，而 H2 則具有保護作用。

links.context: Tau pathology and Mitochondria dysfunction engage in a mutually reinforcing cycle. In Alzheimer's Disease, pathological tau accumulates within mitochondria, binds VDAC, and impairs the Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore, increasing ROS leakage and reducing ATP production; conversely, mitochondrial ROS activate the kinases that hyperphosphorylate tau. Tau knockout mice are resistant to mitochondrial toxin-induced neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: tau 病變與 Mitochondria 功能失調 形成互相強化的循環。在 Alzheimer's Disease 中，病理性 tau 累積於粒線體內，結合 VDAC 並損害 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore，增加 ROS 漏出並降低 ATP 產生；反之，粒線體 ROS 會活化使 tau 過度磷酸化的激酶。tau 基因敲除小鼠對粒線體毒物誘發的神經退化具有抵抗力。

links.context: Tau pathology — abnormal post-translational modification, misfolding and progressive accumulation of the microtubule-associated protein tau within neurons — is a defining feature of Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies such as progressive supranuclear palsy and frontotemporal dementia. Pathologic tau transitions from physiological microtubule binding into hyperphosphorylated fibrillar species that form Neurofibrillary tangles, impairing axonal transport and synaptic function.
links.context_zh_TW: Tau 病理——神經元內微管相關蛋白 tau 的異常轉譯後修飾、錯誤摺疊與逐步累積——是阿茲海默症與相關 tau 病（如進行性核上性麻痺與額顳葉失智症）的定義性特徵。病理性 tau 由生理性的微管結合轉為過度磷酸化的纖維狀物種，形成神經纖維糾結，損害軸突運輸與突觸功能。

links.context: Tauopathy refers to a class of neurodegenerative diseases defined by the pathological aggregation of the microtubule-associated protein Tau into insoluble fibrils and Neurofibrillary tangles. The spectrum includes Alzheimer's disease and Frontotemporal Dementia, and the progressive spread of pathological tau is a central driver of cognitive decline.
links.context_zh_TW: Tauopathy 指的是一類以微管相關蛋白 Tau 病理性聚集形成不溶性纖維與 Neurofibrillary tangles 為定義特徵的神經退化疾病。其範疇包括 Alzheimer's disease 與 Frontotemporal Dementia，而病理性 Tau 的漸進性擴散是認知衰退的核心驅動力。

links.context: Taurine conjugates to the wobble uridine of mitochondrial tRNAs (taurine-modified tRNAs for leucine and lysine codons), stabilizing codon–anticodon interactions; taurine deficiency therefore impairs efficient synthesis of respiratory-chain subunits.
links.context_zh_TW: Taurine 與粒線體 tRNA 的擺動位 uridine 結合（leucine 與 lysine 密碼子的 taurine 修飾 tRNA），穩定密碼子—反密碼子交互作用；因此 taurine 缺乏會妨礙呼吸鏈次單元的有效合成。

links.context: Taurine is incorporated into the wobble position of certain mitochondrial tRNAs as 5-taurinomethyluridine (τm5U). This modification is required for accurate mitochondrial translation of codon families, supporting Oxidative Phosphorylation and mtDNA-encoded complex assembly; its absence underlies the tRNA-modification defects in MELAS (m.3243A>G), which impair mitochondrial translation.
links.context_zh_TW: Taurine 會以 5-taurinomethyluridine (τm5U) 的形式被納入某些粒線體 tRNA 的擺動位置。此修飾是準確進行粒線體密碼子家族轉譯所必需，可支持 Oxidative Phosphorylation 與 mtDNA 編碼的複合體組裝；其缺失正是 MELAS (m.3243A>G) 中 tRNA 修飾缺陷的成因，並會損害粒線體轉譯。

links.context: Tel1p is required for mitohormetic lifespan extension: in yeast, mild mitochondrial dysfunction (for example deletion of clk-1 or cco-1) elevates mitochondrial superoxide and hydrogen peroxide, which activate a Tel1p-Rad53p module. Deletion of TEL1 or RAD53 abolishes both the epigenetic changes and the longevity benefit, making Tel1p the required redox sensor of this adaptive pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: Tel1p 是 mitohormetic 壽命延長所必需：在酵母中，輕度的粒線體功能障礙（例如 clk-1 或 cco-1 缺失）會提升粒線體超氧陰離子與過氧化氫，進而活化 Tel1p–Rad53p 模組。TEL1 或 RAD53 的缺失會完全消除表觀遺傳變化與延壽效益，使 Tel1p 成為此適應性路徑不可或缺的氧化還原感知者。

links.context: Tel1p maintains telomere length homeostasis by accumulating preferentially at short telomeres, through physical interaction with the MRX complex and the Ku heterodimer, and recruiting Telomerase to elongate critically shortened chromosome ends. This length-dependent recruitment preserves genome stability across successive cell divisions.
links.context_zh_TW: Tel1p 藉由與 MRX 複合體及 Ku 異二聚體的物理交互作用，優先累積於短端粒上並招募 Telomerase，以延長已嚴重縮短的染色體末端，藉此維持端粒長度恆定並在連續細胞分裂中保存基因體穩定性。

links.context: Tel1p, the yeast ortholog of human ATM, is the upstream kinase that phosphorylates and activates Rad53p. Tel1p responds to DNA double-strand breaks and telomere dysfunction in the canonical checkpoint pathway, and in a non-canonical context it senses mitochondrial reactive oxygen species and relays the signal to Rad53p, so the same Tel1p/Rad53p module serves both DNA damage control and mitohormetic adaptation.
links.context_zh_TW: Tel1p（人類 ATM 的酵母直系同源物）是磷酸化並活化 Rad53p 的上游激酶。Tel1p 在典型檢查點路徑中回應 DNA 雙股斷裂與端粒功能異常；在非典型情境中它感知粒線體活性氧並將訊號傳給 Rad53p，因此同一 Tel1p/Rad53p 模組同時服務於 DNA 損傷防禦與線粒體 hormesis 適應。

links.context: Telomeres cap chromosome ends and shorten with each cell division until they reach a critical length that triggers replicative senescence or apoptosis. Telomere attrition is thus a direct trigger of cellular senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 端粒封蓋染色體末端，並隨每次細胞分裂縮短，直到達到觸發複製性衰老或細胞凋亡的關鍵長度。因此端粒磨損是細胞衰老的直接觸發因素。

links.context: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
links.context_zh_TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

links.context: Tenovin-1 and tenovin-6 belong to the sirtuin inhibitor class and, like the tenovins generally, illustrate the therapeutic dichotomy in which sirtuin inhibitors are explored as cancer therapeutics — especially in p53-competent tumors — while sirtuin activators are pursued for longevity and metabolic health.
links.context_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 與 tenovin-6 屬於 sirtuin 抑制劑類別；與 tenovins 整體一樣，它們體現了治療上的二分——sirtuin 抑制劑被探索作為癌症治療藥物（尤其針對 p53 具功能的腫瘤），而 sirtuin 活化劑則用於延壽與代謝健康。

links.context: Tenovins (tenovin-1 and tenovin-6) are one of the chemical classes of sirtuin inhibitors, engaging SIRT1, SIRT2 and p53; the class also spans nicotinamide/NAD+ mimics, β-naphthol derivatives, indoles such as EX-527, suramin analogues and kinase-inhibitor scaffolds.
links.context_zh_TW: Tenovins（tenovin-1 與 tenovin-6）是 sirtuin 抑制劑的化學類別之一，作用於 SIRT1、SIRT2 與 p53；該類別還包括菸鹼醯胺/NAD+ 模擬物、β-萘酚衍生物、EX-527 等吲哚類、suramin 類似物與激酶抑制劑骨架。

links.context: Terminal high molecular weight brown pigments of cooked foods are Maillard melanoidins. Polymerization ends the browning cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: 熟食的終末高分子量棕色色素即 Maillard melanoidins。聚合終止褐變級聯。

links.context: Terminal identity opposes the undifferentiated pluripotent ground state. Opposition separates endpoints from origins.
links.context_zh_TW: 終末身份對立未分化的多能性基態。對立將終點與起源分開。

links.context: Testosterone acts mainly through the Androgen Receptor as the anabolic and immune drive node of male biology. Testosterone binding to AR activates PI3K/Akt/mTOR signalling for muscle anabolism and suppresses NF-kB-driven T-cell and macrophage inflammation, but the relationship is bidirectional because inflammaging via IL-6 and GDF-15 lowers testosterone rather than testosterone simply protecting, and AR signalling is pro-cancer in prostate, liver and melanoma.
links.context_zh_TW: Testosterone 主要透過 Androgen Receptor 作用，是男性生理中的合成代謝與免疫驅動節點。Testosterone 與 AR 結合後啟動 PI3K／Akt／mTOR 訊息以促進肌肉合成代謝，並抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 T 細胞與巨噬細胞發炎；但此關係是雙向的，因為經由 IL-6 與 GDF-15 的 inflammaging 會降低 testosterone，而非單純由 testosterone 提供保護，且 AR 訊息在前列腺癌、肝癌與黑色素瘤中是促癌的。

links.context: Th1 cells produce TNFα, which contributes to macrophage activation, endothelial upregulation of adhesion molecules, and granuloma formation. Together with interferon-gamma, TNFα walls off persistent intracellular pathogens that cannot be fully eliminated, driving granulomatous pathology such as the tuberculin-type delayed-type hypersensitivity reaction.
