This makes NF-kB a prime senomorphic node whose blockade tempers the entire inflammatory arm of the secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: Senomorphics 標靶 NF-κB，即 SASP 的主要轉錄調節者，作為抑制發炎分泌組的關鍵機制。NF-κB 抑制劑（如糖皮質類固醇、某些天然化合物）減弱大部分 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子的表現，且 NF-κB 在衰老細胞中被 p38 MAPK、GATA4、cGAS-STING 與 IL-1R/MyD88 訊號活化。由於 NF-κB 位於 SASP 控制的頂端並與 C/EBPb 在 SASP 增強子上協作，其抑制廣泛有效。這使 NF-κB 成為主要的 senomorphic 節點，其阻斷可減緩分泌組整個發炎臂。

links.context: The JAK-STAT3 signaling axis promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR and by transducing cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory and tumor-promoting facets of the secretome. JAK1/2 inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib) reduce SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8, validating the axis as a senomorphic target. The pathway is especially important for the feed-forward, self-reinforcing inflammation characteristic of chronic senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號軸透過與 p38 MAPK 和 mTOR 交互作用，以及轉導來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化促成年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向。JAK1/2 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8，證實此軸作為 senomorphic 標靶。該路徑對慢性衰老特有的正向、自我強化發炎尤為重要。

links.context: VEGF is a SASP growth factor that stimulates angiogenesis in the cancer and wound-healing microenvironment by binding endothelial VEGFR2 and promoting new vessel formation. Its inclusion in the secretome links senescence to blood-vessel formation and to the tumor-promoting angiogenic switch, and it contributes to paracrine reprogramming of neighboring stroma. Alongside VEGF-C, it exemplifies the growth-factor arm of the SASP beyond pure inflammation. The pro-angiogenic direction is beneficial in repair but can support tumor vascularization in chronic senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: VEGF 是一種在癌症與傷口癒合微環境中結合內皮 VEGFR2 並促進新血管形成的 SASP 生長因子。其納入分泌組將衰老連結到血管形成與促腫瘤的血管生成開關，並貢獻鄰近基質的旁分泌重編程。與 VEGF-C 一起，它例示超越純發炎的 SASP 生長因子臂。此促血管生成方向在修復中有益，但在慢性衰老中可支持腫瘤血管化。

links.context: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) is a SASP growth factor that stimulates angiogenesis in the cancer and wound-healing microenvironment by acting on endothelial VEGFR2 to promote new vessel formation. Its inclusion in the secretome links senescence to blood-vessel formation and to the tumor-promoting angiogenic switch, and it contributes to paracrine reprogramming of neighboring stroma. The growth-factor arm of the SASP that VEGF exemplifies extends beyond pure inflammation, mobilizing vascular and tissue-remodeling responses. Together with VEGF-C, MMPs, and chemokines, it illustrates how the secretome coordinates a broad tissue-level response.
links.context_zh_TW: 血管內皮生長因子（VEGF）是一種 SASP 生長因子，透過作用於內皮 VEGFR2 促進血管生成，在癌症與傷口癒合微環境中促進新血管形成。其納入分泌組將衰老連結到血管形成與腫瘤促進的血管生成開關，並貢獻鄰近基質的旁分泌重編程。VEGF 所例示的 SASP 生長因子臂超越純發炎，動員血管與組織重塑反應。它與 VEGF-C、MMPs 及趨化因子一起，說明分泌組如何協調廣泛的組織層級反應。

links.context: mtDNA released by minority MOMP activates cGAS-STING, driving type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP without causing full cell death. The cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern recognized by cGAS, linking mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD) directly to innate immune activation. This activation is a pivotal bridge between metabolism and senescence inflammation and also enhances immune surveillance of the arrested cell. It is a well-validated mechanism in multiple senescence models.
links.context_zh_TW: 少數 MOMP 釋放的 mtDNA 活化 cGAS-STING，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 而不引起完全細胞死亡。胞質 mtDNA 作為 cGAS 辨識的損傷相關分子模式，將粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）直接連結到先天免疫活化。此活化是代謝與衰老發炎間的關鍵橋樑，也增強對停滯細胞的免疫監視。它在多種衰老模型中為良好驗證的機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - JCI -Expanding roles of cGAS-STING signaling in neuroinflammation.md

links.context: mtDNA released into the cytosol activates the cGAS-STING pathway, driving type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP expression. As a damage-associated molecular pattern, cytosolic mtDNA is a potent innate immune ligand that links mitochondrial dysfunction to senescence-associated inflammation. The activation is central to both SASP induction and enhanced immune surveillance of senescent cells, and it is well-validated across multiple senescence models. Leakage can occur through minority MOMP, mitochondrial permeability transition, or reduced mitophagic clearance, making mtDNA a convergence point for mitochondrial stress signaling in aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 釋放至胞質的 mtDNA 活化 cGAS-STING 路徑，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 表現。作為損傷相關分子模式，胞質 mtDNA 是將粒線體功能障礙連結到衰老相關發炎的強效先天免疫配體。此活化對 SASP 誘發與對衰老細胞增強的免疫監視皆至為核心，並在多種衰老模型確立良好。滲漏可經少數 MOMP、粒線體通透性轉變或減少的 mitophagic 清除發生，使 mtDNA 成為老化中粒線體壓力訊號的匯聚點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md

links.context: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) is the brain's principal cholesterol-clearance oxysterol and an endogenous ligand of the liver X receptors, driving reverse-cholesterol-transport genes such as ABCA1, ABCG1 and ApoE across the blood–brain barrier.
links.context_zh_TW: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) 是腦部主要的膽固醇清除 oxysterol，也是肝 X 受體的內源性配體，可誘發 ABCA1、ABCG1 與 ApoE 等逆向膽固醇運輸基因，作用可跨越血腦障壁。

links.context: 3-Hydroxykynurenine is highly redox-active and generates Reactive Oxygen Species by autooxidation, contributing to Oxidative Stress wherever the Kynurenine Pathway is overactivated, notably in brain and tumour microenvironment.
links.context_zh_TW: 3-Hydroxykynurenine 具有高度氧化還原活性，會經由自氧化產生 Reactive Oxygen Species，因此在 Kynurenine Pathway 過度活化的狀況（尤其在腦部與腫瘤微環境）促成 Oxidative Stress。

links.context: A Chromosome is a single long DNA molecule wrapped around histones into Chromatin and then condensed for segregation. Humans carry 46 chromosomes in somatic cells, so Chromatin is the packaging material from which every chromosome is built.
links.context_zh_TW: Chromosome 是單一長 DNA 分子纏繞於 histone 而形成 Chromatin，再經凝縮以利分離的結構。人類體細胞具有 46 條染色體，因此 Chromatin 正是構成每一條染色體的包裝材質。

links.context: A number of different studies with diabetic rats indicate that aminoguanidine-administered rats have significantly superior survival rates than untreated animals. Aminoguanidine prolongs survival in azotemic-induced diabetic rats, and it prevents age-related arterial stiffening and cardiac hypertrophy in animals. Human trials indicate aminoguanidine has very low toxicity and appears safe to use at normal dosages, with side effects limited to nausea and headache, although there is still relatively little human data and clinical trials, and broad anti-aging claims rest largely on animal and early human data rather than definitive clinical outcomes.
links.context_zh_TW: 多項針對糖尿病大鼠的研究表明，給予氨基胍的鼠，與未經處理的動物相比，存活率顯著優異。氨基胍延長了在氮質性糖尿病大鼠中的存活時間，並能預防在動物中出現與年齡相關的動脈僵硬和心肌肥大。人類臨床試驗表明，氨基胍毒性極低，在正常劑量下使用時似乎安全，副作用主要為噁心和頭痛，儘管人類數據和臨床試驗仍然相對有限，而且廣泛的抗衰老聲稱主要依賴動物和早期人類數據，而非明確的臨床結果。
links.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

links.context: A prospective, randomized exploratory study by Chung et al. (2019) provided the first evidence that topical application of rapamycin can reduce cellular markers of aging in human skin. It showed a reduction in the senescent cell marker p16INK4A protein and improvement in the structural and functional parameters of skin by increasing collagen VII levels, with improvement in clinical and histological appearance. Additionally, rapamycin limits the translation of pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype factors such as IL-1, NF-kappaB, and STAT3, reducing the risk of cancer development in late life.
links.context_zh_TW: Chung等人（2019）的一項前瞻性、隨機探索性研究首次提供了局部應用rapamycin可以減少人類皮膚中細胞老化標誌物的證據。它顯示衰老細胞標誌物p16INK4A蛋白的減少，並通過增加膠原蛋白VII水平改善皮膚的結構和功能參數，從而改善臨床和組織學外觀。此外，rapamycin限制促炎性衰老相關分泌表型因子（如IL-1、NF-κB和STAT3）的翻譯，從而降低晚年癌症發生的風險。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

links.context: ACKR3 (formerly CXCR7) is an atypical scavenger/decoy receptor for CXCL12 that, unlike classical GPCRs, signals mainly through β-arrestin-dependent pathways. By sequestering CXCL12 it shapes chemokine gradients and modulates CXCR4-mediated signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: ACKR3（舊稱 CXCR7）是 CXCL12 的非典型清除型/誘餌受體，與典型 GPCR 不同，主要透過 β-arrestin 依賴的途徑傳訊。藉由隔離 CXCL12，它塑造趨化激素梯度並調節 CXCR4 媒介的訊號。

links.context: ACLY is upregulated across irradiation-induced, replicative and doxorubicin-induced senescence models, and silencing it lowers both H3K27ac and SASP gene expression. ACLY-derived cytosolic acetyl-CoA therefore gates the epigenetic activation of the senescence-associated secretory programme.
links.context_zh_TW: ACLY 在輻射誘導、複製性與 doxorubicin 誘導的衰老模型中皆上调；將其靜音會同時降低 H3K27ac 與 SASP 基因表現。因此 ACLY 產生的細胞質 acetyl-CoA 是衰老相關分泌程式的表觀遺傳活化關卡。

links.context: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB at serines 467, 466, and 469, and these phosphorylation events enhance TFEB's transcriptional activity (PMID 33734022). This is consistent with AMPK's role as an energy-stress sensor that promotes catabolic programs: when cellular energy is low, AMPK activates TFEB to drive lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. The S467 site is notable because Akt phosphorylates the same residue with the opposite effect (cytoplasmic retention), demonstrating that distinct upstream signals can use a single phosphorylation site to either activate or repress TFEB depending on context. AMPK phosphorylation thus couples cellular energy status to the autophagy-lysosome gene expression program.
links.context_zh_TW: AMPK 在絲氨酸 467、466 和 469 上磷酸化 TFEB，這些磷酸化事件增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性（PMID 33734022）。這與 AMPK 作為能量壓力感知器促進分解代謝程序的角色一致：當細胞能量不足時，AMPK 活化 TFEB 以驅動溶酶體生物發生和自噬。S467 位點值得注意，因為 Akt 磷酸化同一殘基產生相反效應（胞質保留），表明不同的上游信號可以利用單一磷酸化位點根據語境啟動或抑制 TFEB。因此，AMPK 磷酸化將細胞能量狀態與自噬-溶酶體基因表達程序耦合。

links.context: AP-1 acts as a pioneer transcription factor that binds nucleosomal DNA at otherwise inaccessible enhancer regions and initiates chromatin opening at super-enhancers flanking SASP genes. This pioneering activity recruits BRD4, CEBPα and P300 to H3K27ac-marked super-enhancers, so AP-1 is required for both the senescence growth arrest and the pro-inflammatory secretome. Depletion of AP-1 reduces NF-κB-regulated SASP gene expression, including IL-6, IL-8, TNFα, CXCL1, CXCL5 and MMP-3.
links.context_zh_TW: AP-1 扮演先驅轉錄因子的角色，與原本不可及的增強子區域核小體 DNA 結合並啟動染色質開放，作用於 SASP 基因兩側的超级增强子。此先驅活性會招募 BRD4、CEBPα 與 P300 到帶有 H3K27ac 標記的超级增强子，因此 AP-1 同時是衰老生長停滯與促炎分泌組所必需。耗竭 AP-1 會降低 NF-κB 調控的 SASP 基因表現，包括 IL-6、IL-8、TNFα、CXCL1、CXCL5 與 MMP-3。

links.context: ARN14974 (Compound 17a) is a potent benzoxazolone carboxamide inhibitor of intracellular Acid ceramidase with an IC50 of 79 nM against recombinant human ACase, developed by Pizzirani et al. (2015) as a systemically active, brain-penetrant tool. It is active by both i.p. and i.v. routes, reduces ACase activity in brain, liver, heart, lungs and kidney, and shows Cmax 1768 ng/mL with t1/2 458 min at 10 mg/kg i.p. in mice. Carmofur is a clinically approved ACase inhibitor with BBB penetration.
links.context_zh_TW: ARN14974（Compound 17a）是細胞內 Acid ceramidase 的強效苯并噁唑啉酮甲醯胺類抑制劑，對重組人類 ACase 的 IC50 為 79 nM，由 Pizzirani 等人於 2015 年開發為可全身給藥、可穿透血腦障壁的工具化合物。它可經 i.p. 與 i.v. 途徑給藥，在腦、肝、心、肺與腎降低 ACase 活性，小鼠 10 mg/kg i.p. 時 Cmax 為 1768 ng/mL、半衰期 458 分鐘。Carmofur 則是另一個可穿透血腦障壁的已核准 ACase 抑制劑。

links.context: ATF4 emerged as a common and critical downstream mediator of the metabolic reprogramming that occurs following diverse mitochondrial stressors in mammalian cells. Strategies including doxycycline inhibition of mitochondrial translation, actinonin-mediated destabilization of OXPHOS proteins, FCCP reduction of mitochondrial membrane potential, and MitoBloCK-6 impairment of protein import all converge on ATF4 induction through a conserved amino acid response element (AARE) in the promoters of metabolic response genes. Other mediators such as ATF5, p53, and c-Myc also participate in the broader mitochondrial stress transcriptional response.
links.context_zh_TW: ATF4 作為哺乳動物細胞中多種粒線體壓力源後發生的代謝重編程的共同且關鍵的下游介體而脫穎而出。包括 doxycycline 抑制粒線體翻譯、actinonin 介導的 OXPHOS 蛋白不穩定化、FCCP 降低粒線體膜電位以及 MitoBloCK-6 損害蛋白輸入等策略，都透過代謝反應基因啟動子中保守的胺基酸反應元件（AARE）匯聚到 ATF4 誘導。其他介體如 ATF5、p53 和 c-Myc 也參與更廣泛的粒線體壓力轉錄反應。

links.context: ATR is one of the earliest checkpoint kinases activated during the DNA Damage Response in Replicative Senescence, alongside ATM, and persistent ATR/CHK1 signaling maintains the DDR signal that sustains cell cycle arrest. Oncogene activation causes DNA hyper-replication and stalled forks that generate the ssDNA activating ATR, and chemotherapeutic agents that cause replication stress do the same. ATR signals through CHK1 to p53 to p21 and through CDC25 degradation to CDK inhibition and Rb hypophosphorylation, contributing to SAHF formation.
links.context_zh_TW: ATR 是 Replicative Senescence 中 DNA Damage Response 期間最早被活化的檢查點激酶之一（與 ATM 並列），而持續的 ATR/CHK1 訊號維持使細胞週期停滯得以持久的 DDR 訊號。致癌基因活化造成 DNA 過度複製與複製叉停滯，產生活化 ATR 的 ssDNA；造成複製壓力的化療藥物亦然。ATR 經 CHK1 傳訊至 p53 再到 p21，並經 CDC25 降解導致 CDK 抑制與 Rb 去磷酸化，促成 SAHF 形成。

links.context: AUF1 (AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1, hnRNP D) is a post-transcriptional brake on the SASP. Its four isoforms (p37, p40, p42, p45) each carry two RNA-recognition motifs that bind AUUUA-type AU-rich elements in the 3' UTR; once bound, AUF1 recruits the exonuclease XRN1 and the deadenylase PARN and collaborates with the exosome to drive rapid transcript decay, including decay of transcripts for pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines such as IL-6 and IL-8.
links.context_zh_TW: AUF1（AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1，hnRNP D）是 SASP 的轉錄後煞車。其四個異型（p37、p40、p42、p45）各帶兩個 RNA 辨識基序，結合 3' UTR 中 AUUUA 型的 AU-rich element；結合後 AUF1 招募外切核酸酶 XRN1 與去腺苷化酶 PARN，並與 exosome 協同驅動快速的轉錄本降解，包含 IL-6、IL-8 等促發炎細胞激素與趨化因子轉錄本的降解。

links.context: Acetyl-L-Carnitine (ALC) is the acetylated form of L-Carnitine, the naturally occurring L-enantiomer. It facilitates the transport of long-chain fatty acids into Mitochondria for beta-oxidation and supplies an acetyl group for energy metabolism and acetylcholine synthesis, so it inherits the mitochondrial transport function of its parent compound. It is also grouped with Carnosine and Aminoguanidine as a compound shown to help prevent Cross-linking associated with aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Acetyl-L-Carnitine（ALC）是天然存在的 L-映型 L-Carnitine 的乙醯化形式。它促進長鏈脂肪酸進入 Mitochondria 以進行 β-氧化，並供應乙醯基供能量代謝與乙醯膽鹼合成，因此承襲其母體化合物的粒線體運輸功能。它也與 Carnosine、Aminoguanidine 並列，被列為有助於預防老化相關 Cross-linking 的化合物。

links.context: Acid ceramidase (ACase) inhibition protects against ferroptosis independently of iron regulation, despite iron being a classic ferroptosis driver via the Fenton reaction. ACase knockdown increased ferritin heavy chain 1 (FTH1), a buffer of ferrous iron, yet the labile iron pool (LIP, reactive Fe2+) was actually increased in senescent cells after ACase knockdown despite the anti-ferroptotic effect. This demonstrates that ACase inhibition acts upstream of both the GPX4/GSH axis and iron/Fe2+ regulation, protecting cells by reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool rather than by modulating iron handling.
links.context_zh_TW: 酸性膽鹼酯酶 (ACase) 抑制保護免受鐵滅細胞的影響，與鐵的調節無關，儘管鐵是通過 Fenton 反應的經典鐵滅細胞驅動劑。在 ACase 下調後，增加了 ferritin heavy chain 1 (FTH1)，一種 ferrous iron 的緩衝劑，但衰老細胞中 labile iron pool (LIP, 活性 Fe2+) 實際上在 ACase 下調後仍然增加，儘管具有抗鐵滅細胞效果。這證明 ACase 抑制作用在 GPX4/GSH 軸和鐵/Fe2+ 調節之前，通過減少脂質過氧化底物池來保護細胞，而不是通過調節鐵的處理。

links.context: Activated STING recruits TBK1, which autophosphorylates and then phosphorylates downstream substrates to initiate interferon and inflammatory transcription. In the SASP-induction scheme this is the step linking cGAMP generation to cytokine output, and it is a therapeutically attractive node because STING inhibitors act upstream of both the IRF3 and NF-kB arms. The recruitment is part of the canonical STING trafficking itinerary: after cGAMP binding, STING moves from the endoplasmic reticulum through the ERGIC, where TBK1 engagement and downstream signalling occur.
links.context_zh_TW: 活化的 STING 招募 TBK1，後者自體磷酸化並磷酸化下游受質，啟動干擾素與發炎轉錄。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，這是連結 cGAMP 生成與細胞激素輸出的步驟，也是具治療吸引力的節點，因為 STING 抑制劑作用於 IRF3 與 NF-kB 兩臂的上游。此招募是典型 STING 運輸路徑的一部分：結合 cGAMP 後，STING 由內質網經 ERGIC 移動，TBK1 的接合與下游訊號即在該處發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: Active caspase-8 cleaves RIPK1/RIPK3 to suppress necroptosis; its inhibition flips TNF signaling to necroptosis. Inhibition is the fate-switch mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 活化 caspase-8 切割 RIPK1/RIPK3 以抑制程序性壞死；其抑制將 TNF 訊號翻轉為壞死。抑制是命運開關機制。

links.context: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

links.context: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
links.context_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

links.context: Activin A was identified as a TGF-beta family ligand acutely upregulated during oncogene-induced senescence (Acosta et al., 2013), where it contributes to the paracrine arrest program. Its early, inducible expression marks OIS as a state with active TGFbeta-family signaling deployed against neighboring cells. The upregulation situates Activin A among the earliest SASP components produced in response to oncogenic stress, complementing IL-1alpha-dependent cytokines and chemokines. This is a well-supported, citation-backed relationship that links oncogene activation directly to the secretion of arrest-inducing paracrine factors.
links.context_zh_TW: Activin A 被確認為致癌基因誘發衰老期間急性上調的 TGF-beta 家族配體（Acosta 等人，2013），其貢獻旁分泌停滯程序。其早期、可誘發的表現標記 OIS 為一種對鄰近細胞部署主動 TGFbeta 家族訊號的狀態。此上調將 Activin A 置於對致癌壓力反應最早產生的 SASP 成分中，補充 IL-1alpha 依賴的細胞激素與趨化因子。這是連結致癌基因活化直接到停滯誘發旁分泌因子分泌的、良好支持且具文獻引用的關係。

links.context: Aerobic metabolism generates roughly 1e5 oxidative lesions per cell per day, making ROS the dominant endogenous source of DNA damage via 8-oxo-dG and strand breaks. This causation grounds the oxidative-stress arm of genotoxic stress.
links.context_zh_TW: 有氧代謝每天每細胞產生約十萬個氧化損傷，使 ROS 經由 8-oxo-dG 與股斷裂成為 DNA 損傷的主要內源來源。此因果奠定基因毒性壓力的氧化分支。

links.context: Aging impairs senescence surveillance by degrading NK-cell and T-cell function and altering macrophage responses, reducing the capacity to clear senescent cells. This creates a feed-forward loop in which senescence accumulates and the SASP rises while immune elimination wanes, and the same decline fosters immunosenescence. The impairment is a key mechanism by which senescent burden escalates with age across tissues. Restoring immune competence, such as through exercise or pharmacological rejuvenation, can partly re-establish surveillance.
links.context_zh_TW: 老化透過退化 NK 細胞與 T 細胞功能並改變巨噬細胞反應損害衰老監視，降低清除衰老細胞的能力。這創造一種正向迴圈，其中衰老累積、SASP 上升而免疫排除衰退，且同一衰退助長免疫衰老。此損害是衰老負擔隨年齡在組織中升級的關鍵機制。恢復免疫能力（如透過運動或藥理復育）可部分重建監視。

links.context: Aldose reductase catalyzes the first rate-limiting glucose to sorbitol step opening the pathway. Initiation gates all downstream flux.
links.context_zh_TW: Aldose reductase 催化首個速率限制的葡萄糖到山梨醇步驟，開啟路徑。啟動守衛所有下游通量。

links.context: All five major Parkinson genes act on mitochondria and toxins inhibit the electron transport chain. Involvement records the bioenergetic axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 五個主要帕金森基因皆作用於粒線體，毒素抑制電子傳遞鏈。涉及記錄生物能量軸。

links.context: Alongside caspase-3, the executioner caspase-7 is a downstream target of the SIRT1-FOXO4 survival axis. FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 shifts FOXO output away from apoptosis (caspase-3/7 activation) toward stress resistance and repair gene expression. RNAi silencing of SIRT1 in p53-wildtype colorectal cancer cells produced caspase-3 and caspase-7 cleavage products and massive apoptosis, rescued by FOXO4 co-silencing — establishing caspase-7 as a co-executioner of the SIRT1-regulated death pathway.
links.context_zh_TW: 與 Caspase-3 並列，執行者半胱天冬酶-7 是 SIRT1-FOXO4 存活軸的下游目標。SIRT1 對 FOXO4 的去乙醯化會將 FOXO 的輸出由細胞凋亡（Caspase-3/7 活化）轉向壓力抗性與修復基因表達。在 p53 母源型大腸直腸癌細胞中以 RNAi 沉默 SIRT1 會產生 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 的切割片段並引發大量凋亡，而共同沉默 FOXO4 可 rescue——確立 Caspase-7 為 SIRT1 調控死亡路徑的共同執行者。
links.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine is a formal guanidine family member carrying the guanidinium pharmacophore. Membership records the structural class.
links.context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是攜帶胍基藥效團的正式 guanidine 家族成員。成員關係記錄結構類別。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the intestinal enzyme that breaks down histamine. By blocking gut DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods) may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This histamine-sensitivity risk is a major safety consideration for oral use of aminoguanidine.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二氨基酸氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，這是分解組織胺的腸道酶。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可以顯著增加對膳食組織胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組織胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組織胺的食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這種組織胺敏感的風險是口服氨基胍使用的主要安全考量。

links.context: Aminoguanidine is able to join up with substances that cause links and stop cross-links from developing, and therefore it may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis, skin wrinkles and many other signs of aging. One animal study showed that aminoguanidine prevented age-related cardiac enlargement, reduced the membrane surface area of the rats by 30%, and increased the collagen content of their arterial walls by 24-30%, improving overall heart and arterial condition by decreasing AGE-induced cross-linking of the extracellular matrix.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍能夠與引起連接的物質結合，並阻止交叉連接的形成，因此可能幫助緩解或預防白內障、動脈硬化、腎衰竭、骨質流失、骨關節炎、皮膚皺紋等許多衰老跡象。 一項動物研究表明，氨基胍可防止與年齡相關的心臟擴大，將大鼠的膜表面面積降低 30%，並將其動脈壁的膠原蛋白含量增加 24-30%，從而改善整體的心臟和動脈狀況，藉由降低基底體AGE誘導的細胞外基質交叉連接。
links.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine prevents the formation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs), which are implicated in diabetic complications such as damage to blood vessels and kidneys. Under the developmental name Pimagedine, it was evaluated in phase III clinical trials for diabetic nephropathy but was ultimately not approved for widespread clinical use due to safety concerns, including a risk of autoimmune reactions and vitamin B6 depletion. Today it remains primarily an experimental tool, and its AGE-inhibiting activity underlies its study for long-term, chronic conditions in diabetics.
links.context_zh_TW: 胺胍可阻止晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）的形成；AGEs與糖尿病併發症有關，例如血管與腎臟損傷。在開發階段名為Pimagedine時，它曾被用於糖尿病腎病變的第三期臨床試驗評估，但因安全性疑慮——包括自體免疫反應風險與維生素B6耗竭——最終未獲核准用於廣泛臨床使用。如今它主要仍是實驗工具，而其抑制AGE形成的活性，正是其被研究用於糖尿病患者長期慢性狀況的基礎。

links.context: Apigenin consistently induces the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor p21/Waf1/Cip1 across cancer models, which mediates its cell-cycle-arrest and pro-apoptotic effects. In prostate LNCaP cells p21 is induced in a p53-dependent manner alongside p27/Kip1, whereas in p53-mutant colon and osteosarcoma cells apigenin still elevated p21/Waf1 in a dose- and time-dependent manner via a p53-independent pathway. Apigenin also functions as an HDAC inhibitor that increases global histone acetylation and hyperacetylates histone H3 specifically at the p21/Waf1 promoter, directly driving p21 transcription in triple-negative breast cancer cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 芹菜素在多種癌症模型中一致地誘導細胞週期依賴性激酶抑制劑p21/Waf1/Cip1，此作用介導其細胞週期停滯與促凋亡效果。在前列腺LNCaP細胞中，p21以p53依賴性方式與p27/Kip1一同被誘導；而在p53突變的結腸癌與骨肉瘤細胞中，芹菜素仍能經由p53非依賴性途徑，以劑量與時間依賴方式提高p21/Waf1。芹菜素同時也是HDAC抑制劑，可增加整體組蛋白乙醯化，並特別在p21/Waf1啟動子處高度乙醯化組蛋白H3，在三陰性乳癌細胞中直接驅動p21轉錄。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: Apigenin decreases hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1alpha) protein but not the HIF-1beta subunit, acting at the HIF-1alpha binding site to suppress transcriptional activation of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and downstream angiogenesis. In lung cancer A549 cells and xenografts, apigenin at 15 uM reduced tumor volume partly by inhibiting the HIF-1alpha-VEGF pathway, and it also blocked AKT and p70S6K1 activation that mediates VEGF transcription. The same HIF-1alpha/VEGF suppression was observed in pancreatic and ovarian cancer cells under both hypoxic and normoxic conditions, establishing anti-angiogenesis as a core anticancer mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 芹菜素會降低缺氧誘導因子1-alpha（HIF-1alpha）蛋白，但不會影響HIF-1beta次單元；它作用於HIF-1alpha結合位點，抑制血管內皮生長因子（VEGF）的轉錄活化及其下游的血管新生。在肺癌A549細胞與異種移植腫瘤中，15 µM的芹菜素部分透過抑制HIF-1alpha-VEGF途徑而縮小腫瘤體積，同時也阻斷了調控VEGF轉錄的AKT與p70S6K1活化。在缺氧與常氧條件下，胰臟癌與卵巢癌細胞中亦觀察到相同的HIF-1alpha/VEGF抑制，確立抗血管新生為其核心抗癌機制之一。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: Apigenin is a potent inhibitor of casein kinase 2 (CK2), a serine/threonine kinase that is elevated in many cancers. In prostate cancer, apigenin inhibited CK2 activity in both hormone-responsive LNCaP and hormone-refractory PC-3 cells, though apoptosis was induced only in LNCaP. In colon cancer cells, apigenin together with DRB inhibited CK2 expression and synergistically sensitized cells to TNF-alpha-mediated apoptosis. In cervical cancer stem-like cells, apigenin suppressed self-renewal by downregulating CK2-alpha, and in pancreatic cancer it stabilized the transcription factor Ikaros by downregulating CK2 to restore T-cell homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧是一種強效的酪蛋白激酶2 (CK2) 抑制劑，是一種絲胺類/酪蛋白激酶，在許多癌症中表現升高。在攝護腺癌中，阿皮ゲ寧抑制了 LNCaP 和 PC-3 細胞中的 CK2 活性（包括激素反應型和激素抵抗型細胞），儘管僅在 LNCaP 細胞中誘導了凋亡。在結直腸癌細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧與 DRB 結合，抑制了 CK2 的表達，並與 TNF-α 介導的細胞凋亡產生了協同作用。在子宮頸癌幹細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧通過下調 CK2-α 來抑制自我更新，而在胰腺癌中，它通過下調 CK2 來穩定轉錄因子 Ikaros，以恢復 T 細胞穩態。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: Apigenin suppresses cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), the enzyme that converts arachidonic acid into prostaglandins and whose overexpression drives carcinogenesis. It inhibits UVB-induced increases in COX-2 protein and mRNA in mouse and human keratinocytes, reduces COX-2 expression in colon and gastric cancer models, and downregulates inducible COX-2 in HCEC colon cells more potently than quercetin or tricin. In non-melanoma skin cancer models, COX-2 inhibition by apigenin prevents tumor development, and apigenin also suppresses UVB-induced cutaneous angiogenesis by maintaining endogenous TSP1 levels.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制環氧合酶-2 (COX-2)，該酶將 arachidonic 酸轉化為前列腺素，且其過表達促進癌變。它抑制了在小鼠和人類表皮細胞中 UVB 誘導的 COX-2 蛋白和 mRNA 升高，在結直腸癌和胃癌模型中降低 COX-2 表現，並且比槲皮苷或槲青素更強效地 downregulation  inducible COX-2 在 HCEC 結直腸細胞中，在非黑色素瘤皮膚癌模型中，阿皮ゲ寧通過抑制 COX-2 預防腫瘤發育，阿皮ゲ寧還通過維持內源性 TSP1 水平抑制 UVB 誘導的表皮血管生成。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk specifically in individuals carrying the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, a pharmacogenetic interaction identified in prospective studies. The mechanism is thought to involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter aspirin's effects on vascular homeostasis. This contrasts sharply with slow COMT individuals, in whom aspirin is protective, underscoring the importance of COMT genotyping in cardiovascular prevention strategies.
links.context_zh_TW: Aspirin 可能會增加心血管疾病的風險，特別是在攜帶快速 COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型的個體中，這是前瞻性研究中發現的一種藥物遺傳學交互作用。此機制被認為涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，從而改變阿斯匹靈對血管穩態的影響。這與緩慢的 COMT 個體形成鮮明對比，阿斯匹靈對這些個體具有保護作用，並強調了 COMT 基因分型在心血管預防策略中的重要性。

links.context: Aspirin prevents cardiovascular disease specifically in the slow COMT (Met/Met, A/A) genotype, where the enzyme's reduced activity is associated with a favorable response to aspirin prophylaxis. Clinical and epidemiological evidence indicates that the cardiovascular benefit of aspirin is concentrated in this subgroup rather than the population at large, with fast COMT individuals showing no benefit or increased risk. The mechanism is thought to involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's effects on vascular homeostasis. This supports using COMT Val158Met status to guide aspirin-based prevention.
links.context_zh_TW: Aspirin 可預防心血管疾病，特別是在緩慢的 COMT (Met/Met，A/A) 基因型中，該酶的活性降低與阿斯匹靈預防的良好反應有關。臨床和流行病學證據表明，阿斯匹靈的心血管益處集中在這一亞組而不是整個人群中，快速 COMT 個體沒有表現出任何益處或風險增加。該機制被認為涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血管穩態的影響。這支持使用 COMT Val158Met 狀態來指導基於阿斯匹靈的預防。

links.context: Aspirin suppresses thromboxane A2 synthesis in platelets, which cannot resynthesize COX, shifting hemostasis toward reduced clot formation at low doses. TXA2 suppression is the antiplatelet mechanism behind its cardiovascular prophylaxis.
links.context_zh_TW: Aspirin 抑制血小板中血栓素 A2 合成，血小板無法重新合成 COX，低劑量使止血傾向減少凝塊形成。TXA2 抑制是其心血管預防背後的抗血小板機制。

links.context: Assembloids are built by fusing two or more region-specific organoids.
links.context_zh_TW: Assembloid 由融合兩個以上區域特異類器官建成。

links.context: BCL-2 family members are key anti-apoptotic proteins upregulated as part of SCAPs, buffering senescent cells against the intrinsic death pathway. By sequestering pro-apoptotic BAX/BAK activators, they maintain mitochondrial integrity and prevent lethal mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, and they also restrain minority MOMP to allow sublethal mtDNA leakage. Their inhibition (e.g., by navitoclax or quercetin) is a direct senolytic mechanism that pushes cells into apoptosis. BCL-2 exemplifies the pro-survival dependence that defines senescent-cell resilience.
links.context_zh_TW: BCL-2 家族成員是作為 SCAPs 一部分上調的關鍵抗凋亡蛋白，緩衝衰老細胞對內在死亡路徑的抵抗。透過隔離促凋亡的 BAX/BAK 活化因子，它們維持粒線體完整性並防止致死的粒線體外膜透化，且也抑制少數 MOMP 以允許次致死的 mtDNA 滲漏。其抑制（如透過 navitoclax 或 quercetin）是將細胞推入凋亡的直接 senolytic 機制。BCL-2 例示定義衰老細胞復原力的促存活依賴。

links.context: BMAL1 and CLOCK form the heterodimer at the centre of the Circadian Rhythm transcriptional-translational feedback loop. The pair drives clock-controlled genes including NAMPT, and their acetylation state set by SIRT1 links the ~24-hour oscillator to cellular energy state.
links.context_zh_TW: BMAL1 與 CLOCK 組成異二聚體，位於 Circadian Rhythm 轉錄—轉譯回饋迴路的核心。該二聚體驅動包括 NAMPT 在內的時鐘受控基因，而其由 SIRT1 設定的乙醯化狀態則將約 24 小時的振盪器與細胞能量狀態相連結。

links.context: Beta-TrCP ubiquitinates IkappaBalpha, whose destruction activates NF-kB.
links.context_zh_TW: Beta-TrCP 泛素化 IkappaBalpha，其破壞活化 NF-κB。

links.context: Broad alpha-4 integrin inhibition with natalizumab is associated with progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML), a potentially fatal demyelinating disease caused by JC virus reactivation. Risk is highest with prolonged use, prior immunosuppression and JC virus seropositivity, which limits therapy to patients managed under strict risk-stratification protocols.
links.context_zh_TW: 使用 natalizumab 廣泛阻斷 alpha-4 integrin 與 progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy（PML，一種由 JC virus 再活化引起、可致命的脫髓鞘疾病）相關。風險在長期使用、既往免疫抑制與 JC virus 血清陽性時最高，因此治療僅限於在嚴格風險分層規範下管理的病人。

links.context: By keeping methionine synthase functional, MTRR ensures a steady supply of methionine and, downstream, SAMe, the universal methyl donor. SAMe is consumed by COMT to O-methylate dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. MTRR activity therefore indirectly governs methyl-group availability that sets the pace of catecholamine clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: 透過維持 methionine synthase 的功能，MTRR 確保蛋氨酸以及下游的通用 methyl donor SAMe 穩定供應。COMT 消耗 SAMe 來 O-甲基化 dopamine、epinephrine 和 norepinephrine。因此 MTRR 活性間接調控設定兒茶酚胺清除速率的甲基可用性。

links.context: By remethylating homocysteine to methionine, MethylB12 supports the production of methionine, the precursor of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. MethylB12 therefore indirectly influences the rate of COMT-mediated methylation of catecholamines. Its status is coupled to overall methyl-group supply.
links.context_zh_TW: 透過將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，MethylB12 支持蛋氨酸的產生，蛋氨酸是 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor SAMe 的前驅物。因此 MethylB12 間接影響 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺甲基化速率。其狀態與整體甲基供應相關。

links.context: By remodeling nucleosomes at promoters and enhancers, SWI/SNF acts as a gatekeeper of transcriptional access and thereby regulates gene expression, differentiation, and DNA repair. Its mutants — including SMARCB1 in rhabdoid tumors and ARID1A in ovarian clear-cell carcinoma, in roughly 20% of cancers overall, plus Coffin-Siris neurodevelopmental syndrome — make it a major cancer and developmental gene.
links.context_zh_TW: SWI/SNF 藉由在 promoter 與 enhancer 上重塑核小體，扮演轉錄可及性的守門人，進而調節基因表現、分化與 DNA 修復。它的突變——包括 rhabdoid 腫瘤中的 SMARCB1 與卵巢透明細胞癌中的 ARID1A（整體約見於 20% 的癌症），以及 Coffin-Siris 神經發育症候群——使它成為主要的癌症與發育相關基因。

links.context: C/EBPbeta is one of the two principal transcription factors driving the inflammatory SASP, cooperating with NF-kB to activate CXCR2-ligand genes including IL-8. Loss of C/EBPbeta together with NF-kB reduces IL-8 and other chemokine receptor ligands and also impairs the growth arrest that defines oncogene-induced senescence, indicating that this transcription factor sits at the intersection of the arrest and secretory programmes. In the SASP-induction scheme C/EBPbeta occupies the transcription-factor tier alongside NF-kB, STAT and GATA4, and it is the target through which Notch modulates the late SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: C/EBPbeta 是驅動發炎型 SASP 的兩大主要轉錄因子之一，與 NF-kB 協同活化包括 IL-8 在內的 CXCR2 配體基因。C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB 同時缺失會降低 IL-8 及其他趨化激素受體配體，並損害定義癌基因誘導衰老的生長停滯，顯示此轉錄因子位於停滯與分泌程序的交會處。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB、STAT、GATA4 同處轉錄因子層，也是 Notch 調節晚期 SASP 的作用靶點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
links.context_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

links.context: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
links.context_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

links.context: CD38 becomes hyperactive with age and hydrolyzes NAD+ into ADPR, contributing to age-related NAD+ depletion, calcium imbalance, mitochondrial fragmentation, and oxidative stress. Alongside PARP1 and SARM1, CD38 is a major NAD+-consuming enzyme driving the decline in NAD+ availability during aging. Because reduced NAD+ compromises SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity and triggers mitochondrial dysfunction-associated senescence (MiDAS) via AMPK-p53 signaling, CD38 hyperactivity is a key mechanistic contributor to the metabolic bottleneck that links declining NAD+ to stem cell exhaustion and impaired resilience. CD38 is therefore considered a target for NAD+-boosting strategies.
links.context_zh_TW: CD38會隨年齡增長而過度活化，將NAD+水解為ADPR，促成與年齡相關的NAD+耗竭、鈣離子失衡、粒線體斷裂與氧化壓力。與PARP1和SARM1並列，CD38是衰老過程中驅動NAD+可用性下降的主要NAD+消耗酵素。由於NAD+減少會損害SIRT1與SIRT3的活性，並經由AMPK-p53訊息傳導觸發粒線體功能障礙相關衰老（MiDAS），CD38過度活化是連結NAD+下降與幹細胞耗竭及韌性受損之代謝瓶頸的關鍵機制貢獻者。因此，CD38被視為提升NAD+策略的標靶。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md

links.context: CDC20 is the mitotic co-activator switching on the APC-C ligase.
links.context_zh_TW: CDC20 是開啟 APC-C 連接酶的有絲分裂共活化因子。

links.context: CDKN2B is a direct transcriptional target of TGFbeta signaling: SMAD3/SMAD4 complexes bind SMAD-binding elements at the CDKN2B promoter to induce p15INK4b. This couples TGFbeta-family ligands, including Activin A and TGF-beta1, to CDK inhibition and growth arrest. The induction is a principal mechanism by which TGFbeta drives paracrine senescence and is essential for transmissible arrest in receiving cells. It is a well-established SMAD-dependent transcriptional event, validated by TGFBR1 inhibitor and knockout studies.
links.context_zh_TW: CDKN2B 是 TGFbeta 訊號的直接轉錄標的：SMAD3/SMAD4 複合體結合 CDKN2B 啟動子的 SMAD 結合元件以誘發 p15INK4b。這將包括 Activin A 與 TGF-beta1 在內的 TGFbeta 家族配體耦合到 CDK 抑制與生長停滯。此誘發是 TGFbeta 驅動旁分泌衰老的主要機制，對受體細胞中的可傳播停滯必要。它是確立的 SMAD 依賴轉錄事件，獲 TGFBR1 抑制劑與剔除研究驗證。

links.context: CDKN2B is frequently silenced by promoter methylation in leukaemias, lymphomas, and gliomas, abolishing p15INK4b expression and removing a brake on CDK4/6. This epigenetic inactivation contributes to uncontrolled proliferation in cancer and is often assessed as a prognostic marker in myeloid malignancies. The silencing contrasts with its inducible activation during senescence, highlighting the context-dependent regulation of the locus. Demethylating agents such as decitabine and 5-azacytidine can re-express silenced CDKN2B and restore growth arrest, supporting the locus as a therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: CDKN2B 在白血病、淋巴瘤與神經膠質瘤中常被啟動子甲基化靜默，廢除 p15INK4b 表現並移除對 CDK4/6 的煞車。此表觀遺傳失活貢獻癌症中不受控的增殖，且常作為骨髓性惡性腫瘤的預後標記評估。此靜默不同於其在衰老期間可誘發的活化，凸顯此基因座依脈絡的調節。去甲基化藥劑如 decitabine 與 5-azacytidine 可重新表現靜默的 CDKN2B 並恢復生長停滯，支持此基因座作為治療標靶。

links.context: CISD1, also known as mitoNEET, is a mitochondrial outer-membrane protein carrying a CDGSH-type [2Fe-2S] cluster. By sequestering and regulating mitochondrial labile iron it reduces the Fe2+ available to drive the Fenton reaction, limiting ROS-driven lipid peroxidation and thereby acting as a negative regulator of ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma and other liver cancers.
links.context_zh_TW: CISD1 又稱 mitoNEET，是帶有 CDGSH 型 [2Fe-2S] 簇的粒線體外膜蛋白。藉由封存與調節粒線體內的活性鐵，它減少可供 Fenton 反應使用的 Fe2+，抑制 ROS 驅動的脂質過氧化，因此在肝細胞癌等肝癌中作為鐵死亡（ferroptosis）的負向調節因子。

links.context: CISD2 (NAF-1) is a CDGSH-domain [2Fe-2S] protein localized to the mitochondrial outer membrane and ER that acts as a conserved mitochondrial ferroptosis brake. Intact CISD2 limits mitochondrial Fe2+ availability for the Fenton reaction; inhibiting the CISD2 gene in head and neck cancer cells increases mitochondrial iron and lipid ROS, promoting ferroptotic death.
links.context_zh_TW: CISD2 (NAF-1) 是含 CDGSH domain 的 [2Fe-2S] 蛋白，位於粒線體外膜與內質網，作為保守的粒線體鐵死亡煞車。完整的 CISD2 限制可供 Fenton 反應使用的粒線體 Fe2+；在頭頸癌細胞中抑制 CISD2 基因會提高粒線體鐵與脂質 ROS，促進鐵死亡。

links.context: COMT genotype determines the cardiovascular response to aspirin: slow (Met/Met) individuals gain protection against cardiovascular disease, whereas fast (Val/Val) individuals may see increased risk or no benefit. This pharmacogenetic effect arises from genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's actions on platelets, vascular endothelium, and redox balance. Stratifying aspirin therapy by COMT status could improve risk-benefit profiling in primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. The finding exemplifies how a common polymorphism can gate a widely used drug's efficacy.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT genotype 決定了阿斯匹靈的心血管反應：慢速 (Met/Met) 個體獲得預防心血管疾病的保護，而快速 (Val/Val) 個體可能會看到風險增加或沒有益處。這種藥物基因效應源自於兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血小板、血管內皮和氧化還原平衡的作用。以 COMT 狀態對阿斯匹靈治療進行分層可以改善第一級和第二級心血管預防的風險效益分析。這項發現例證了常見的多態性如何控制廣泛使用的藥物的功效。

links.context: COMT immunoreactivity has been detected in the cell bodies and dendritic spines of medium spiny neurons in the human striatum. Because the striatum is relatively poor in dopamine transporter, extracellular dopamine is cleared substantially by local enzymatic methylation by COMT. MSN-associated COMT shapes the temporal and spatial profile of dopaminergic signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 已在中型多棘神經元的細胞體和樹突棘中檢測到 COMT 免疫反應性。由於 striatum 的多巴胺轉運蛋白相對缺乏，細胞外多巴胺主要透過 COMT 的局部酶促甲基化清除。與 MSN 相關的 COMT 塑造了多巴胺能訊號傳導的時間和空間特徵。

links.context: COMT inhibition increases epinephrine (adrenaline) levels because O-methylation to metanephrine is blocked, prolonging epinephrine signaling and allowing accumulation of the parent catecholamine. Clinically, COMT inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone used as adjuncts to levodopa in Parkinson's disease raise circulating catecholamines, which is therapeutically useful for motor symptoms but can cause adrenergic side effects. The directionality is straightforward: less enzymatic inactivation yields higher epinephrine. This relationship also connects COMT blockade to downstream oxidative products such as adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 抑制會增加腎上腺素（腎上腺素）水平，因為 O-甲基化為變腎上腺素被阻斷，從而延長腎上腺素信號傳導並允許母體兒茶酚胺積累。臨床上，COMT 抑制劑（例如恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋）用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，可提高循環 catecholamines，這對運動症狀有治療作用，但可能引起腎上腺素能副作用。方向性很簡單：較少的酵素失活會產生較高的腎上腺素。這種關係也將 COMT 阻斷與下游氧化產物（例如腎上腺素紅）聯繫起來。

links.context: COMT is expressed in medium spiny neurons of the striatum, with immunoreactivity detected in both cell bodies and dendritic spines, where it participates in local dopamine clearance. Because medium spiny neurons are the principal targets of nigrostriatal dopamine projections and comprise about 95% of striatal neurons, perisynaptic COMT shapes the dopamine signal they receive even where the dopamine transporter dominates. This expression underpins COMT's role in modulating striatal motor, habit, and reward circuits. It shows that COMT contributes to dopamine regulation in the striatum as well as the cortex.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 在紋狀體的中型多棘神經元中表達，在細胞體和樹突棘中檢測到免疫反應性，參與局部多巴胺清除。由於中型多棘神經元是黑質紋狀體多巴胺投射的主要目標，並且包含約 95% of striatal neurons，因此即使在多巴胺轉運蛋白占主導地位的情況下，突觸周圍 COMT 也會塑造它們接收的多巴胺訊號。此表現支持 COMT 在調節紋狀體運動、習慣和 reward 迴路中的作用。它表明 COMT 有助於紋狀體和皮質中的多巴胺調節。

links.context: COMT is expressed in the hippocampus, where its protein and enzymatic activity contribute to the local regulation of catecholamine signaling involved in memory, plasticity, and emotional processing. Hippocampal COMT helps terminate dopamine and norepinephrine signaling that modulate synaptic plasticity, long-term potentiation, and stress responses. Variation in COMT activity can therefore influence hippocampal-dependent learning, memory consolidation, and vulnerability to mood disorders. Its presence in this region extends COMT's functional reach beyond the prefrontal cortex into circuits central to memory and affect.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 在海馬體中表達，其蛋白質和酵素活性有助於參與記憶、可塑性和情緒處理的兒茶酚胺訊號傳導的局部調節。海馬 COMT 有助於終止調節 synaptic plasticity、長時程增強和壓力反應的多巴胺和 norepinephrine 訊號傳導。因此，COMT activity 的變異會影響海馬依賴性學習、memory consolidation 以及情緒障礙的脆弱性。它在該區域的存在將 COMT 的功能範圍擴展到前額葉皮質之外，進入記憶和情感的中心電路。

links.context: COMT overexpression impairs stimulus-response (S-R) learning, as demonstrated in COMT-OE mouse models where excess enzyme accelerates dopamine clearance in striatal circuits that mediate habit learning. Excessive catecholamine inactivation reduces the dopamine signaling needed for efficient S-R acquisition, slowing task learning and producing perseveration. This phenotype mirrors aspects of fast-human COMT cognition, linking the animal model to human genetic findings. The specificity of the deficit supports a circuit-level rather than generalized effect of COMT excess.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現會損害刺激反應 (S-R) 學習，如 COMT-OE mouse models 所示，過量的酵素會加速介導習慣學習的紋狀體迴路中的多巴胺清除。兒茶酚胺過度失活會減少有效獲取 S-R 所需的多巴胺訊號，從而減慢任務學習並產生毅力。這種表型反映了快速人類 COMT 認知的各個方面，將動物模型與人類遺傳發現聯繫起來。赤字的特殊性支持電路級而非 COMT 過剩的普遍影響。

links.context: COMT overexpression increases striatal dopamine release capacity, observed in COMT-OE mice as enhanced phasic dopamine signaling in the striatum. The mechanism is thought to involve homeostatic upregulation of dopamine synthesis and release in response to chronically low extracellular dopamine tone produced by excess clearance. This contrasts with the cognitive deficits also seen in these mice, illustrating region-specific effects of COMT activity on striatal versus prefrontal dopamine systems. The finding helps dissociate the motor and cognitive consequences of COMT excess.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現增加了 striatal dopamine release 的能力，在 COMT-OE 小鼠中觀察到，紋狀體中的階段性多巴胺訊號傳導增強。該機制被認為涉及多巴胺合成和釋放的穩態上調，以響應因過度清除而產生的長期較低的細胞外多巴胺張力。這與這些小鼠中也觀察到的認知缺陷形成鮮明對比，說明 COMT activity 對紋狀體多巴胺系統與前額葉多巴胺系統的區域特異性影響。這項發現有助於區分 COMT 過量對運動和認知的影響。

links.context: COMT-OE mice show increased compulsive behavior, reflected in more perseverative responses, indicating that excess COMT activity shifts the impulsive-compulsive balance toward perseveration. This suggests COMT tone influences the tuning of habit and repetitive-behavior circuits, particularly in the striatum and prefrontal cortex. The observation extends the behavioral phenotyping of COMT overexpression beyond cognition and impulsivity. It is relevant to disorders characterized by compulsivity and rigid behavioral patterns.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased compulsive behavior，反映在更堅持不懈的反應中，顯示過量的 COMT activity 會使衝動-強迫平衡轉向堅持。這表明 COMT 音調影響習慣和重複行為迴路的調節，特別是在紋狀體和前額葉皮質。此觀察結果將 COMT 過度表現的行為表型擴展到認知和 impulsivity 之外。它與以強迫性和僵化行為模式為特徵的疾病有關。

links.context: COMT-OE mice show increased impulsive behavior, quantified as more premature responses in timed operant tasks, consistent with catecholaminergic perturbation of inhibitory control circuits in prefrontal and striatal regions. This mirrors impulsivity-related traits linked to fast COMT in humans, such as risk-taking and rapid decision-making under time pressure. The phenotype is reversible by manipulations that restore dopamine signaling, supporting causality rather than confounded effects. It extends the COMT-OE behavioral profile beyond cognition into impulse control.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased impulsive behavior，量化為定時操作任務中更多的過早反應，與前額葉和紋狀體區域抑制控制迴路的兒茶酚胺能擾動一致。這反映了與快速 COMT in humans 相關的 impulsivity 相關特徵，例如在時間壓力下承擔風險和快速決策。透過恢復多巴胺訊號傳導的操作，表型是可逆的，支持因果關係而不是混雜效應。它將 COMT-OE 行為特徵從認知擴展到衝動控制。

links.context: COMT-OE mice show specific cognitive deficits, particularly in stimulus-response learning and working memory, attributable to excess catecholamine clearance that reduces dopamine availability in prefrontal and striatal circuits. These deficits model the cognitive endophenotype associated with fast human COMT genotypes, providing a causal link between enzyme activity and cognition. The specificity, rather than global impairment, supports a circuit-level rather than generalized effect of COMT overexpression. Such models are central to translating COMT genetics into mechanistic understanding.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 specific cognitive deficits，特別是 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶，這是由於兒茶酚胺清除過多，減少了前額葉和紋狀體迴路中多巴胺的可用性。這些缺陷模擬了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的認知內表型，提供了酶活性和認知之間的因果關係。 COMT 過度表現的特異性（而不是全局損傷）支持電路水平而非普遍效應。這些模型對於將 COMT 遺傳學轉化為機械理解至關重要。

links.context: CPT2 is expressed at high levels in tissues with robust oxidative capacity - skeletal muscle, heart (cardiomyocytes), liver and kidney. Because the outer-membrane enzyme CPT1 is allosterically inhibited by malonyl-CoA while CPT2 is not, the CPT2 step of the carnitine shuttle is the rate-limiting entry point for long-chain fatty acid oxidation, supplying the matrix with acyl-CoA for beta-oxidation.
links.context_zh_TW: CPT2 在氧化能力強的組織中高度表現，包括骨骼肌、心臟（心肌細胞）、肝臟與腎臟。由於外膜酵素 CPT1 會被 malonyl-CoA 別構抑制，而 CPT2 不受此調控，肉鹼穿梭的第二步 CPT2 便是長鏈脂肪酸氧化的限速入口，負責在基質中提供 acyl-CoA 供 β-氧化使用。

links.context: CXCL14 (BRAK) is a constitutively expressed C-X-C chemokine that, unlike most CXC ligands, lacks the ELR motif and does not signal through classical CXCR1/2/3 receptors. Its expression is supported by the p53 tumor suppressor and the p21-Rb axis, placing it in the early p53/p21/Rb-dependent SASP program rather than the later NF-kB-driven inflammatory wave; it is thus often lost in p53-mutant cancers, removing an immune-surveillance cue.
links.context_zh_TW: CXCL14 (BRAK) 是持續表現的 C-X-C 趨化因子，與多數 CXC 配體不同，它缺少 ELR motif，也不經由典型的 CXCR1/2/3 受體傳遞訊號。其表現由腫瘤抑制蛋白 p53 與 p21–Rb 軸支撐，因此屬於早期 p53/p21/Rb 相依的 SASP 程式，而非後續 NF-κB 驅動的發炎波；它也常在 p53 突變的癌症中缺失，使免疫監視訊號消失。

links.context: CXCR2 is the dominant receptor for the ELR+ C-X-C chemokines (CXCL1-3, CXCL5, IL-8) and is the node through which the neutrophil-directed arm of the SASP acts. Senescent cells secrete IL-8/CXCL1-3 that signal back through CXCR2 in an autocrine/paracrine manner, sustaining senescent growth arrest and amplifying the SASP — a feed-forward loop — and factors from one senescent cell engaging CXCR2 on neighbours drive bystander senescence. Chronic CXCR2 signaling sustains inflammaging, and antagonists such as navarixin and AZD5069 are in trials.
links.context_zh_TW: CXCR2 是 ELR+ C-X-C 趨化因子（CXCL1-3、CXCL5、IL-8）的主要受體，也是 SASP 中嗜中性球導向分支的作用節點。衰老細胞分泌 IL-8/CXCL1-3，經由 CXCR2 以自分泌／旁分泌方式回饋，維持衰老的生長阻滯並放大 SASP，形成前饋迴路；而某個衰老細胞釋出的因子作用在鄰近細胞的 CXCR2 上，則驅動旁觀者衰老。慢性 CXCR2 訊號會維持 inflammaging，navarixin 與 AZD5069 等拮抗劑已進入臨床試驗。

links.context: CZ-48 (sulfo-ara-F-NMN) is a cell-permeant NMN analog that acts as an NMN mimetic binding the SARM1 ARM domain, relieving autoinhibition and driving NADase activation. Activated SARM1 produces cyclic ADP-ribose, depletes NAD+ and ATP, and induces non-apoptotic cell death. CZ-48 is the only known molecule with opposite effects on the two principal NAD+ glycohydrolases: it activates SARM1 while inhibiting CD38, pharmacologically separating two enzymes that share substrate and products.
links.context_zh_TW: CZ-48（sulfo-ara-F-NMN）是可穿透細胞膜的 NMN 類似物，作為 NMN 擬態結合 SARM1 的 ARM 結構域，解除其自體抑制並驅動 NADase 活化。活化的 SARM1 會產生環腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR），耗竭 NAD+ 與 ATP，並誘發非凋亡性細胞死亡。CZ-48 是已知唯一對兩種主要 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶作用相反的分子：它活化 SARM1 卻抑制 CD38， pharmacological 上將這兩個共享底物與產物的酵素區分開來。

links.context: Caloric restriction is the most robust healthspan-extending intervention across model organisms. Extension is the geroscience consensus.
links.context_zh_TW: 熱量限制是跨模式生物最強健的健康壽命延長介入。延長是老年科學共識。

links.context: Canakinumab (Ilaris) is a human monoclonal antibody that binds free IL-1β with high affinity and prevents it from engaging the IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP complex, without affecting IL-1α or other IL-1 family members — making it more selective than anakinra, which blocks both ligands. By neutralizing extracellular IL-1β it inhibits MyD88-dependent signaling, reducing NF-κB activation and transcription of IL-6, TNFα and COX-2. The long-acting antibody (half-life ~26 days) is dosed subcutaneously and is degraded proteolytically without CYP-mediated metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Canakinumab（Ilaris）是一種人類單株抗體，以高親和力結合游離 IL-1β，阻止其與 IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP 受體複合體接合，且不影響 IL-1α 或其他 IL-1 家族成員——因此比同時阻斷兩者的 anakinra 更具選擇性。藉由中和胞外 IL-1β，它抑制 MyD88 依賴的訊號，減少 NF-κB 活化以及 IL-6、TNFα、COX-2 的轉錄。此長效抗體（半衰期約 26 天）以皮下注射給藥，經蛋白水解分解代謝，不經 CYP 代謝。

links.context: Cancer is suppressed by senescence surveillance, which clears oncogene-induced and otherwise damaged senescent cells in benign lesions before they can progress to malignancy. By eliminating arrested pre-malignant cells through natural killer cell, macrophage, and T-cell mechanisms, surveillance acts as a fail-safe tumor-suppression barrier that removes cells carrying oncogenic mutations. Loss of surveillance permits senescent-cell accumulation, sustained SASP output, and tumor promotion, converting an intrinsic barrier into a tumor-permissive microenvironment. This positions immune clearance of senescent cells as a key anticancer defense.
links.context_zh_TW: 癌症被衰老監視抑制，衰老監視在癌前細胞進展為惡性前清除良性病灶中致癌基因誘發與其他受損的衰老細胞。透過 NK 細胞、巨噬細胞與 T 細胞機制消除停滯的癌前細胞，監視作為失效安全的腫瘤抑制屏障，移除帶有致癌突變的細胞。監視喪失允許衰老細胞累積、持續 SASP 輸出與腫瘤促進，將內在屏障轉化為允許腫瘤的微環境。這將衰老細胞的免疫清除定位為關鍵抗癌防禦。

links.context: Canonical inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-18 into its mature secreted form alongside IL-1β. This provides a second IL-1-family cytokine output linking DAMP sensing to senescence inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 典型發炎體活化的 caspase-1 將 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟分泌形式，與 IL-1β 並列。這提供第二種 IL-1 家族細胞激素輸出，將 DAMP 感知連結到衰老發炎。

links.context: Cardiolipin is an obligate cofactor for inner-membrane fusion: L-OPA1 binds cardiolipin on liposomes and GTP hydrolysis by OPA1 drives fusion, and removing cardiolipin abolishes fusion even when L-OPA1 is present on both membranes. Cardiolipin also interacts with DRP1 to stimulate its oligomerization and GTPase activity, promoting fission, so the same lipid bidirectionally regulates mitochondrial dynamics. It is additionally required for mitophagy receptor recruitment.
links.context_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 是內膜融合的必需輔因子：L-OPA1 在脂質體上結合 cardiolipin，OPA1 的 GTP 水解驅動融合；即使兩側膜上都有 L-OPA1，只要移除 cardiolipin 融合即被廢除。Cardiolipin 也與 DRP1 互動以促進其寡聚化與 GTPase 活性而促進分裂，因此同一種脂質對粒線體動態學具有雙向調控作用。它同時也是 mitophagy 受體招募所必需。

links.context: Caspase-1 processes pro-IL-1beta into mature IL-1beta for secretion, providing a major inflammatory cytokine output of inflammasome activation. In senescent contexts, this contributes to the IL-1 family arm of the SASP, particularly in macrophages recruited to senescent tissue. The processing is essential for extracellular IL-1beta bioactivity and links sterile damage signals in senescence to classical inflammatory cytokine release. NLRP3 priming and activation precede the cleavage, ensuring that mature IL-1beta is only produced upon coordinated signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 發炎體經由活化的 caspase-1 處理 pro-IL-1beta，產生成熟 IL-1beta 以供分泌，強化發炎性 SASP。此處理使衰老細胞能釋放強效促發炎細胞激素，且與 IL-1alpha 的頂層放大器角色協調放大分泌組。透過提供成熟 IL-1beta，發炎體將 DAMP 感知（如 mtDNA）連結到旁分泌衰老與免疫招募。此過程是衰老細胞釋放功能性 IL-1beta 的確立機制。

links.context: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (GSDME), releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain and converting apoptosis into pyroptosis. The outcome is dictated by GSDME expression level: in GSDME-high cancer cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 drives pyroptotic lysis; in GSDME-low settings, GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3, reinforcing classical apoptosis. This caspase-3/GSDME switch is the clearest demonstration that the caspase substrate — not the caspase itself — determines the death modality.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 會切割 gasdermin E（GSDME），釋出其成孔的 N 端片段，使細胞凋亡轉為焦亡。結果由 GSDME 的表達量決定：在 GSDME 高表達的癌細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 驅動焦亡裂解；在 GSDME 低表達的情境下，GSDME 反而作為 Caspase-3 的上游活化因子，強化典型細胞凋亡。Caspase-3/GSDME 開關最清楚地表現出：決定死亡型態的是 caspase 的受質，而非 caspase 本身。

links.context: Checkpoint inhibitors prototypically block the PD-1 receptor to release T-cell brakes.
links.context_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑典型阻斷 PD-1 受體以釋放 T 細胞煞車。

links.context: Cholesterol Influx is the receptor-mediated movement of Cholesterol from the extracellular environment into Macrophages, mainly via scavenger receptors taking up Oxidized LDL. When influx exceeds the opposing Cholesterol Efflux, macrophages accumulate lipid and become Foam Cells, the hallmark lesion of Atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Influx 是 Cholesterol 由細胞外環境經受體介導而進入 Macrophages 的過程，主要透過清除受體攝取 Oxidized LDL 達成。當 influx 超過相反的 Cholesterol Efflux 時，巨噬細胞累積脂質而成為 Foam Cells，即 Atherosclerosis 的標誌性病灶。

links.context: Chronic SASP promotes fibrosis through TGFb-mediated pro-fibrotic signaling and through matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) that remodel the extracellular matrix, activating resident fibroblasts and myofibroblasts that deposit collagen. This contributes to idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, liver fibrosis, and renal fibrosis in aging and after tissue injury, where persistent senescence shifts tissue toward scar formation rather than regeneration. The fibrotic arm of the secretome is one of its clearest pathological sequelae and is a principal rationale for senolytic and senomorphic trials in fibrotic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 TGFb 介導的促纖維化訊號，以及透過重塑細胞外基質的基質金屬蛋白酶（MMPs），促進纖維化，活化駐留纖維母細胞與肌纖維母細胞沉積膠原。這導致老化與組織損傷後的特發性肺纖維化、肝纖維化與腎纖維化，其中持續性衰老將組織推向疤痕形成而非再生。分泌組的纖維化臂是其最清楚的致病後遺症之一，也是纖維化疾病中 senolytic 與 senomorphic 試驗的主要依據。

links.context: Chronic exposure to methylene blue (MB) increases both the expression and the activity of mitochondrial complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase). In HT-22 cells, MB treatment at 10 and 100 nM for 3 days increased Cox1 (subunit I) protein expression as measured by Western blot, and blue-native gel activity staining confirmed increased complex IV activity at 100 nM MB. The close structural analog 2-chlorophenothiazine had no effect on Cox1 expression or complex IV activity, indicating this is a distinctive MB-specific adaptive response rather than a general phenothiazine effect.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性暴露於亞甲基藍 (MB) 增加線粒體複合體 IV（細胞色素 c 氧化酶）的表達和活性。在 HT-22 細胞中，MB 以 10 和 100 nM 處理 3 天，通過 Western blot 測量增加了 Cox1（亞基 I）蛋白表達，且藍色原生凝膠活性染色證實在 100 nM MB 時複合體 IV 活性增加。close structural analog 2-氯吩噻嗪對 Cox1 表達或複合體 IV 活性沒有影響，表明這是一種獨特的 MB 特異性 adaptive response，而非一般的吩噻嗪效應。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Chronic rapamycin or everolimus use is associated with elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels (hyperlipidemia), alongside mucosal ulcers, impaired wound healing, delayed tissue repair, and increased infection risk. These metabolic disturbances were common in the EXIST-3 trial and other cohorts, along with stomatitis, infections, and cytopenias. The mechanisms are attributed to both mTORC1 inhibition and unintended mTORC2 suppression, which induces insulin resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin或everolimus使用與膽固醇和甘油三酯水平升高（高脂血症）相關，並伴有黏膜潰瘍、傷口癒合受損、組織修復延遲和感染風險增加。這些代謝紊亂在EXIST-3試驗和其他隊列中很常見，並伴有口腔炎、感染和血細胞減少症。機制歸因於mTORC1抑制和意外mTORC2抑制，後者誘發胰島素阻抗。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: Chronic rapamycin treatment is associated with metabolic disturbances including glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia in both mice and humans administered rapamycin for prevention of immunosenescence. Mechanistically these effects are attributed not only to mTORC1 inhibition but also to unintended suppression of mTORC2, which induces insulin resistance - a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. Houde et al. showed chronic rapamycin causes glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia by upregulating hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairing lipid deposition in adipose tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin治療與代謝紊亂相關，包括在rapamycin給藥以預防免疫老化的兩者小鼠和人類中的葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。從機制上講，這些效應不僅歸因於mTORC1抑制，還歸因於意外抑制mTORC2，這會誘發胰島素阻抗——這是代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。Houde等人顯示慢性rapamycin透過上調肝臟糖質新生和損害脂肪組織中的脂質沉積來引起葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

links.context: Cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 protein interaction, diminishing SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of the NF-κB subunit RelA. With RelA left more acetylated and transcriptionally active, inflammatory mediator expression rises in airway and other smoke-exposed cells — a direct mechanistic bridge between smoking, impaired sirtuin function and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Cigarette-smoke extract 會破壞 SIRT1 與 RelA/p65 的蛋白質交互作用，使 SIRT1 對 NF-κB 次單元 RelA 的去乙醯化減少。RelA 因此維持較高乙醯化與轉錄活化狀態，導致氣道及其他煙霧暴露細胞的發炎介質表現上升——這在吸菸、sirtuin 功能受損與慢性發炎性肺病之間提供了直接機制橋樑。

links.context: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma is a subtype of Renal Cell Carcinoma whose reprogrammed redox metabolism makes it exquisitely dependent on Glutathione and the GPX4 antioxidant axis to prevent Lipid Peroxidation and death. Inhibiting Glutathione synthesis collapses this defence and induces Ferroptosis with tumour growth suppression.
links.context_zh_TW: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma 是 Renal Cell Carcinoma 的一個亞型，其重編程的氧化還原代謝使它極度依賴 Glutathione 與 GPX4 抗氧化軸來防止 Lipid Peroxidation 與細胞死亡。抑制 Glutamine 合成會瓦解此防禦並誘發 Ferroptosis，同時抑制腫瘤生長。

links.context: Clostridium sporogenes is an anaerobic, spore-forming gut commensal and the best-characterized producer of Indole-3-propionic acid, reducing Tryptophan through indole-pyruvate to indole-3-lactate and then IPA. IPA is a circulating radical-scavenging metabolite acting on host Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Pregnane X Receptor signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: Clostridium sporogenes 是厭氧、能形成芽孢的腸道共生菌，也是 Indole-3-propionic acid 最具表征的產生菌，經由 indole-pyruvate 將 Tryptophan 還原為 indole-3-lactate 再生成 IPA。IPA 是循環中的自由基清除代謝物，作用於宿主 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 與 Pregnane X Receptor 的訊息傳遞。

links.context: Colon Cancer is driven by Wnt Signaling. Constitutive Wnt/β-catenin signaling—initiated by APC loss—is the initiating driver in the majority of sporadic colon cancers, leading to dysplastic aberrant crypt foci and progression along the adenoma-carcinoma sequence.
links.context_zh_TW: 大腸癌（Colon Cancer）由 Wnt 訊息傳遞（Wnt Signaling）所驅動。由 APC 缺失所啟動的持續 Wnt/β-catenin 訊息傳遞是多數散發性大腸癌的起始驅動因子，導致發育不良的異常隱窩病灶，並沿腺瘤-癌序列進展。

links.context: Constitutive oncogenic RAS signaling pushes cells into hyper-replication, where DNA replication forks are initiated at excessive frequency and become stalled or collapsed. This generates single-stranded DNA gaps and replication stress that activate checkpoint kinases ATR and ATM, converging on p53 stabilization. The relationship is a central mechanism linking oncogene activation to senescence-inducing damage and is well established in OIS biology. It explains how proliferative overload is converted into a senescence signal.
links.context_zh_TW: 組成型致癌 RAS 訊號將細胞推入過度複製，其中 DNA 複製叉以過高頻率起始並停滯或崩塌。這產生單股 DNA 缺口與複製壓力，活化檢查點激酶（ATR/ATM）與 DDR。在 OIS 中，此複製壓力是衰老誘發的核心上游事件，將癌基因活化連結到遺傳不穩定與停滯。它是 RAS 驅動衰老的關鍵機制前因。
links.source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

links.context: Creatine provides the immediate phosphate group needed to recycle ADP back into ATP, the cellular energy currency, keeping cellular energy pools saturated and reducing metabolic stress, which protects HRV from plunging during hard training. It is recommended daily at 3-5 grams, ideally post-workout or with the largest carbohydrate meal, because creatine uptake is enhanced by insulin. Pairing creatine with carbohydrates and protein helps drive it into muscle and brain cells more efficiently, with consistency mattering more than exact timing.
links.context_zh_TW: 肌酸提供將 ADP 回收為 ATP（細胞的能量貨幣）所需的即時磷酸基團，使細胞能量池保持飽和並降低代謝壓力，從而保護 HRV 在艱苦訓練期間不致驟降。建議每日攝取 3–5 公克，理想上在訓練後或搭配最大的一餐碳水化合物，因為胰島素可增強肌酸攝取。將肌酸與碳水化合物和蛋白質搭配，有助於更有效地將其送入肌肉與腦細胞，而持續性比精確的時機更重要。

links.context: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
links.context_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。
links.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

links.context: CsA binds cyclophilin D with high affinity; the CsA-CypD complex is the mechanistic basis of its MPT blockade, independent of its calcineurin-dependent immunosuppression.
links.context_zh_TW: CsA 以高親和力結合 Cyclophilin D；CsA-CypD 複合體為其 MPT 阻斷的機制基礎，與其以 calcineurin 依賴的免疫抑制無關。

links.context: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

links.context: DAMP release plus direct RIPK3-dependent inflammasome activation (caspase-8- and NLRP3-mediated arms) make necroptosis intrinsically pro-inflammatory; uncontrolled necroptosis converts host defense into chronic necroinflammatory disease.
links.context_zh_TW: DAMP 釋放加上 RIPK3 直接驅動的炎症小體活化（caspase-8 與 NLRP3 兩臂）使 necroptosis 本質上促發炎；失控的 necroptosis 將宿主防禦轉為慢性壞死性發炎疾病。

links.context: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
links.context_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

links.context: DVE-1 is a C. elegans homeobox transcription factor that acts as a downstream effector of the Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response. It is recruited to target promoters together with the small acidic protein UBL-5, and the DVE-1-UBL-5 complex binds chromatin at UPRmt-responsive genes to drive expression of mitochondrial chaperones (e.g. hsp-60) and proteases. Loss of either gene blunts the UPRmt program and the longevity and stress-resistance phenotypes that normally follow respiratory-chain perturbation.
links.context_zh_TW: DVE-1 是 *C. elegans* 的 homeobox 轉錄因子，作為 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的下游效應因子。它與小型酸性蛋白 UBL-5 一起被招募至標的啟動子，DVE-1-UBL-5 複合體在 UPRmt 反應基因的染色體上結合，促進粒線體伴護蛋白（如 hsp-60）與蛋白酶的表現。任一基因缺失都會削弱 UPRmt 程式，以及原本隨呼吸鏈受 Perturbation 而出現的長壽與抗逆境狀型。

links.context: Dapsone is one of the most common causes of drug-induced methemoglobinemia, particularly with chronic dosing, because its hydroxylamine metabolite oxidizes hemoglobin iron to methemoglobin. It also drives oxidative hemolysis, markedly worse in Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase deficiency; severe cases are treated with Methylene blue, which restores NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase-dependent reduction.
links.context_zh_TW: Dapsone 是藥物誘發性 methemoglobinemia 最常見的原因之一，尤其在長期給藥時，因為其羥胺代謝物會將 hemoglobin 的鐵氧化為 methemoglobin。它也會造成氧化性溶血，在 Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase 缺乏時更為嚴重；嚴重病例以 Methylene blue 治療，恢復 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 途徑的還原能力。

links.context: Dasatinib, a multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor, is a component of the foundational D+Q (dasatinib plus quercetin) senolytic combination. It is proposed to act by inhibiting pro-survival kinases in senescent cells, lowering their apoptotic threshold, and it has established clinical use in chronic myeloid leukemia that aids repurposing. Its senolytic activity is well demonstrated in vitro and in vivo, and it synergizes with quercetin to clear senescent cells across multiple tissues including adipose and endothelium. Though tissue selectivity varies, the D+Q regimen has become the most clinically studied senolytic, tested in IPF, diabetic kidney disease, and osteoarthritis pilots.
links.context_zh_TW: Dasatinib 是一種多標靶酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，是基礎 D+Q（dasatinib 合併 quercetin）senolytic 組合的成分。其被認為透過抑制衰老細胞中的促存活激酶、降低其凋亡閾值而作用，且其在慢性骨髓性白血病中既有的臨床用途有助重新定位。其 senolytic 活性在體外與體內皆獲充分證實，並與 quercetin 協同清除包括脂肪與內皮在內多種組織的衰老細胞。儘管組織選擇性有差異，D+Q 方案已成為臨床研究最深入的 senolytic，已在 IPF、糖尿病腎病與骨關節炎試驗中測試。

links.context: Diaphorase (NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase) is the FAD-containing flavoenzyme that accounts for roughly 95-99% of physiological methemoglobin reduction. It oxidizes NADH and passes electrons via cytochrome b5 to the ferric iron of methemoglobin, returning it to the ferrous state that can bind oxygen. Because only 1-2% of hemoglobin spontaneously autoxidizes daily, the enzyme is continuously required to restore functional Hemoglobin.
links.context_zh_TW: Diaphorase（NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase，又稱 cytochrome b5 reductase）是含 FAD 的黃素酶，約負責 95–99% 的生理性 methemoglobin 還原。它氧化 NADH 並經 cytochrome b5 將電子傳給 methemoglobin 的三價鐵，使其回到可結合氧氣的二價態。由於每日僅約 1–2% 的 hemoglobin 會自發性氧化，此酶持續作用以恢復具功能的 Hemoglobin。

links.context: Dietary Hormesis is the everyday, lowest-risk form of Hormesis, where cumulative adaptive responses come from complex arrays of hormetins eaten within whole foods rather than from a single isolated compound.
links.context_zh_TW: Dietary Hormesis 是 Hormesis 最日常、風險最低的形式，其累積適應反應來自以全食物攝取的複合 Hormetin 陣列，而非單一分離化合物。

links.context: Dopachrome is the unstable indole-quinone intermediate formed when Dopaquinone undergoes intramolecular cyclization and decarboxylative rearrangement. It sits at the branch point of melanogenesis: enzymatic tautomerization by dopachrome tautomerase yields 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid, while spontaneous decay yields 5,6-Dihydroxyindole; both indoles are then oxidized and polymerized into eumelanin, the predominant form of Melanins.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopachrome 是 Dopaquinone 經分子內環化與去羧重排所形成的不穩定 indole-quinone 中間產物。它位於黑色素生成的分岔點：由 dopachrome tautomerase 酵素催化互變異構化產生 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid，而自發分解則產生 5,6-Dihydroxyindole；兩種 indole 隨後被氧化並聚合成為黑色素中主要的 eumelanin。

links.context: During prophase I of Meiosis, homologous chromosomes pair in synapsis and undergo crossing over, i.e. Homologous Recombination, at chiasmata. This exchange of DNA segments between maternal and paternal homologs is a principal source of genetic diversity in gametes, and defects in the recombination machinery produce aneuploid gametes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Meiosis 的前期 I，同源染色體配對形成聯會，並在交叉點發生互換，也就是 Homologous Recombination。母系與父系同源染色體之間的 DNA 片段交換是配子遺傳變異的主要來源之一，而重組機制的缺陷會產生非整倍體配子。

links.context: E-cadherin is the primary epithelial transmembrane protein of adherens junctions. Containment records the junction composition.
links.context_zh_TW: E-cadherin 是黏附連接的主要上皮跨膜蛋白。包含記錄連接組成。

links.context: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

links.context: Elevated levels of acid ceramidase make senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis, a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway driven by toxic accumulation of lipid peroxides. The enzyme promotes ferroptosis by breaking down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition toward a pro-ferroptotic profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids, the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Removing acid ceramidase from cells protected both young and old cells from induced ferroptosis. This represents a novel, GPX4/GSH-independent axis that modulates lipid metabolism rather than iron or glutathione levels, and makes acid ceramidase a promising senolytic target. Acid ceramidase (ACase) upregulation in replicatively senescent cells drives increased sensitivity to ferroptosis, an iron-dependent regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation. Over-expression of ACase amplifies ceramide lipolysis, releasing free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that are exchanged into sn-2 polyunsaturated fatty acid phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation - creating a pro-ferroptotic membrane lipid profile. Conversely, knockdown or chemical inhibition of ACase protects both proliferative and senescent cells against RSL3-induced ferroptosis by decreasing the PL-PUFA substrate pool.
links.context_zh_TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶（acid ceramidase）濃度升高使衰老細胞更容易發生鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）——一種由脂質過氧化物毒性累積所驅動的受調控、鐵依賴性細胞死亡途徑。該酶透過將神經醯胺分解為鞘氨醇（sphingosine）與游離脂肪酸來促進鐵依賴性細胞死亡，重塑膜脂質組成，使其轉向富含多元不飽和脂肪酸（脂質過氧化之偏好受質）的促鐵依賴性細胞死亡特徵。從細胞中移除酸性神經醯胺酶可保護年輕與衰老細胞免受誘導性鐵依賴性細胞死亡。這代表一條新穎、獨立於GPX4/GSH的調控軸，其作用在於調節脂質代謝而非鐵或穀胱甘肽濃度，也使酸性神經醯胺酶成為具潛力的衰老細胞清除（senolytic）標靶。 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase) 在複製衰老細胞中誘導升高，導致對鐵死亡 (ferroptosis) 的敏感度增加，鐵依賴的調節性細胞凋亡是由脂質過氧化引起的。ACase 過表達會放大甘油酯水解，釋放飽和和單不飽和脂肪酸，這些脂肪酸被轉化為 sn-2 不飽和脂肪酸磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 脂質過氧化物的底物，從而產生促進鐵死亡的膜脂質型態。相反地，針對 ACase 的敲低或化學抑制可以通過降低 PL-PUFAs 底物池來保護增生性和衰老細胞免受 RSL3 誘導的鐵死亡。
links.source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

links.context: Endothelial dysfunction is the initiating lesion step of atherosclerosis. Involvement records the onset mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 內皮功能障礙是動脈粥狀硬化的起始病灶步驟。涉及記錄起始機制。

links.context: Estrogen metabolites, such as 2-hydroxyestrone and 4-hydroxyestrone, are catechols because they retain a catechol ring formed during hydroxylation, making them substrates for COMT. COMT O-methylates these metabolites into less genotoxic methoxyestrogens, a protective detoxification step that reduces exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones. Slow COMT can therefore slow the clearance of catecholestrogens, with implications for hormone-related cancer risk. This connection links COMT genotype to estrogen metabolism and cancer susceptibility hypotheses.
links.context_zh_TW: Estrogen metabolites，如 2-羥基雌酮和 4-羥基雌酮，是兒茶酚，因為它們保留了羥基化過程中形成的兒茶酚環，使其成為 COMT 的底物。 COMT 將這些代謝物 O-甲基化成遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素，這是一種保護性解毒步驟，可減少活性兒茶酚醌的暴露。因此，緩慢的 COMT 可以減緩兒茶酚雌激素的清除，進而影響荷爾蒙相關的癌症風險。這種關聯將 COMT genotype 與雌激素代謝和癌症易感性假設聯繫起來。

links.context: Exercise Hormesis is the canonical whole-organism hormetic stressor: transient exercise ROS, calcium, AMP/ATP and lactate pulses act as the stress input that elicits the adaptive response.
links.context_zh_TW: Exercise Hormesis 是全身層級典型的 hormetic 壓力源：運動期間短暫的 ROS、鈣離子、AMP/ATP 與乳酸脈衝即為誘發適應反應的壓力輸入。

links.context: Extracellular disulfide-HMGB1 signals through TLR4 on antigen-presenting cells to drive inflammatory and antitumor immune responses.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞外二硫鍵-HMGB1 通過抗原呈遞細胞上的 TLR4 發出信號，驅動炎症和抗腫瘤免疫反應。

links.context: FBW7 recognizes the GSK3-primed S155/S159 phosphodegron on Mcl-1.
links.context_zh_TW: FBW7 辨識 Mcl-1 上經 GSK3 啟動的 S155/S159 磷酸降解子。

links.context: FLIP (FLICE/caspase-8 inhibitory protein) is a catalytically inactive homolog that heterodimerizes with and restrains procaspase-8 activation; the FLIP-L/Caspase-8 heterodimer retains partial cleavage of RIPK1/RIPK3 that suppresses necroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: FLIP（FLICE/caspase-8 抑制蛋白）為催化失活的同源物，與 pro-caspase-8 異二聚化並抑制其活化；FLIP-L/Caspase-8 異二聚體保留部分切割 RIPK1/RIPK3 的能力以抑制 necroptosis。

links.context: FOXO3a activity is inhibited by the Akt pathway, which phosphorylates FOXO3a and promotes its sequestration in the cytoplasm. Akt-dependent phosphorylation thus keeps the FOXO transcription factor inactive and blocks its autophagic and stress-resistance transcriptional output; mTORC2 depletion relieves this brake by reducing Akt signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: FOXO3a 的活性受 Akt 途徑抑制：Akt 磷酸化 FOXO3a 並促使其在細胞質中隔離。Akt 相依的磷酸化因此使 FOXO 轉錄因子維持不活性，阻斷其自噬與抗逆境轉錄輸出；mTORC2 耗損時 Akt 訊號下降，便解除此煞車。

links.context: FOXO4 is directly targeted by sirtuin-mediated deacetylation in response to oxidative stress. Hydrogen peroxide treatment induces FOXO4 acetylation, which inhibits its transactivation potential; SIRT1 physically interacts with FOXO4 and deacetylates it, reversing that inhibition and restoring FOXO4 transactivation so that antioxidant defence genes are induced.
links.context_zh_TW: 在氧化壓力反應下，FOXO4 是 sirtuin 介導去乙醯化的直接標的。過氧化氫處理會誘導 FOXO4 乙醯化，抑制其轉錄活化潛能；SIRT1 與 FOXO4 物理互動並將其去乙醯化，逆轉此抑制作用並恢復 FOXO4 的轉錄活化，使抗氧化防禦基因得以被誘導。

links.context: FYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase alongside SRC and LYN.
links.context_zh_TW: FYN 是與 SRC 和 LYN 並列的 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

links.context: Failing lysosomes cannot clear α-synuclein oligomers, so aggregates accumulate into Lewy bodies — the hallmark of Parkinson's disease dopaminergic neurons. Lysosomal failure co-acts with Complex I defects, and dying neurons then release neuromelanin and aggregates as DAMPs that prime microglia. Because the lysosome is the terminal station of autophagy and mitophagy, its dysfunction converts otherwise-manageable protein load into lethal aggregation, and lipofuscin accumulation further buffers lysosomal pH upward.
links.context_zh_TW: 失能的溶酶體無法清除 α-synuclein 寡聚體，使聚集物累積成路易氏體——帕金森氏症多巴胺神經元的標誌。溶酶體失能與 Complex I 缺陷協同作用，垂死神經元隨後釋出神經黑色素與聚集物作為 DAMP 致敏小膠細胞。由於溶酶體是自噬與粒線體自噬的終點站，其失能會使原本可處理的蛋白負荷轉為致命聚集，而脂褐素的累積更進一步推高溶酶體的 pH。

links.context: Fasting — voluntary abstinence from food and caloric beverages for a defined period — induces a metabolic switch from glucose-based to ketone-based energy and stimulates autophagy and cellular repair processes. The mechanism is reduced IGF1/mTORC1 signalling together with increased AMPK and SIRT1 activity, which releases the brake on autophagic flux and promotes mitochondrial biogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Fasting——在一段定義時間內自願禁食與禁含熱量飲品——會誘發由葡萄糖型轉向酮體型的代謝轉換，並刺激 autophagy 與細胞修復過程。其機制為 IGF1/mTORC1 訊號下降、AMPK 與 SIRT1 活性上升，解除對自噬通量的煞車並促進粒線體生成。

links.context: Fisetin is a natural flavonoid that inhibits catechol-O-methyltransferase with moderate potency (IC50 2.6-5.8 uM, mixed kinetics) and also acts as a COMT substrate. It is roughly 10-50x weaker than clinical COMT inhibitors (entacapone ~0.23 uM, tolcapone ~0.048 uM, quercetin 0.9-1.5 uM, EGCG 0.04-0.07 uM), yet nutraceutical dosing can reach effective levels.
links.context_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種天然類黃酮，可中等到效抑制 catechol-O-methyltransferase（IC50 2.6–5.8 µM，混合型動力學），同時也是 COMT 的受質。它的效力約比臨床 COMT 抑制劑弱 10–50 倍（entacapone 約 0.23 µM、tolcapone 約 0.048 µM、quercetin 0.9–1.5 µM、EGCG 0.04–0.07 µM），但營養補充劑劑量仍可達到有效濃度。

links.context: Fisetin is a potent antioxidant that scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species and stimulates endogenous antioxidant defenses including Nrf2-dependent expression of heme oxygenase-1, catalase, and superoxide dismutase. Its multiple hydroxyl groups allow it to donate electrons to quench free radicals and chelate metal ions that catalyze oxidative damage. The anti-oxidative action of fisetin underpins its protective effects in neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, and renal models of oxidative stress, and is considered a core mechanism shared with other polyphenols in its protective pharmacology.
links.context_zh_TW: Fisetin是一種強效抗氧化劑，可清除活性氧物種（ROS）與活性氮物種，並刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，包括Nrf2依賴性的血基質氧化酶-1（heme oxygenase-1）、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶表現。其多個羥基使其能捐贈電子以淬滅自由基，並螯合催化氧化損傷的金屬離子。fisetin的抗氧化作用是其於神經、心臟、肝臟與腎臟氧化壓力模型中保護效應的基礎，並被認為是其保護性藥理學中與其他多酚類共有的核心機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

links.context: Fisetin suppresses inflammation through multiple converging mechanisms. It inhibits the NF-kB pathway, reducing the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, and it inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and inducible nitric oxide synthase, decreasing prostaglandin and nitric oxide levels. It also blocks the STAT1 and STAT3 signaling cascades that amplify inflammatory gene expression.
