These anti-inflammatory actions contribute to fisetin's protective effects in arthritis, colitis, acute lung injury, and neuroinflammation models, and the anti-inflammatory activity is preserved in some nanoformulations of the compound.
links.context_zh_TW: Fisetin透過多種匯聚機制抑制發炎。它抑制NF-kB途徑，減少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta與IL-6等促發炎細胞激素的產生，並抑制環氧合酶-2（COX-2）與誘導型一氧化氮合酶，降低前列腺素與一氧化氮水平。它也阻斷放大發炎基因表現的STAT1與STAT3訊號級聯。這些抗發炎作用促成fisetin在關節炎、結腸炎、急性肺損傷與神經發炎模型中的保護效應，且此抗發炎活性在該化合物的一些奈米配方中得以保留。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

links.context: Flavonoids with a catechol structure can inhibit COMT at high, supplemental doses by competing for the enzyme's active site and for SAMe, reducing O-methylation of endogenous catecholamines and catechol drugs. At dietary concentrations this inhibition is usually negligible, but concentrated extracts may perturb catechol metabolism and mood. The effect is structure-dependent: only catechol-bearing flavonoids, such as quercetin, luteolin, and EGCG, inhibit, whereas flavanones like hesperidin do not. This structure-activity relationship is key to evaluating supplement interactions with COMT.
links.context_zh_TW: 具有兒茶酚結構的 Flavonoids 可以透過競爭酵素的活性位點和 SAMe 來抑制高補充劑量的 COMT，從而減少內源性 catecholamines 和兒茶酚藥物的 O-甲基化。在飲食濃度下，這種抑制通常可以忽略不計，但濃縮萃取物可能會擾亂兒茶酚代謝和情緒。此作用具有結構依賴性：只有含兒茶酚的類黃酮（例如槲皮素、木犀草素和 EGCG）具有抑製作用，而橙皮苷等黃烷酮則不會。這種結構-活性關係是評估補充劑與 COMT 相互作用的關鍵。

links.context: Formation of 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate at the glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase step is strictly NAD+-dependent. Senescent cells lose NAD+ surplus as the NAD+/NADH ratio falls, so the availability of this co-substrate limits 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate and downstream ATP generation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在甘油醛-3-磷酸脫氫酶步驟中，1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 的形成嚴格依賴 NAD+。衰老細胞隨著 NAD+/NADH 比值下降而流失 NAD+ 儲備，因此此輔底物的可用性限制了 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 及其下游的 ATP 生成。

links.context: Formulating fisetin as SNEDDS raises its oral bioavailability: dissolution increased 11.0-fold in water, 3.6-fold at pH 1.2 and 7.9-fold at pH 6.8, with 3.79-fold higher intestinal permeation. In rats at 20 mg/kg, Cmax rose 3.7-fold and AUC about 1.5-fold, while cell viability improved to 89% versus 10% for free fisetin because of reduced direct cell interaction.
links.context_zh_TW: 將 fisetin 製成 SNEDDS 可提高其口服生體可用性：溶出度在水、pH 1.2 與 pH 6.8 緩衝液中分別提升 11.0 倍、3.6 倍與 7.9 倍，腸道通透性提高 3.79 倍。大鼠以 20 mg/kg 給藥時，Cmax 提升 3.7 倍、AUC 約增加 1.5 倍；由於與細胞直接作用減少，細胞存活率由游離 fisetin 的 10% 提升至 89%。

links.context: G1 is the principal interphase gap before DNA synthesis. Once the cell passes the restriction point late in G1, it becomes irreversibly committed to replicating its genome in S phase.
links.context_zh_TW: G1 是 DNA 合成前的主要分裂間期。一旦細胞通過 G1 後期的限制點，就不可逆地決定在 S 期複製其基因組。

links.context: GATOR2 suppresses GATOR1 GAP activity when amino acids are abundant. Inhibition is the sufficiency release.
links.context_zh_TW: GATOR2 在胺基酸充足時抑制 GATOR1 GAP 活性。抑制是充足釋放。

links.context: GDF15, a member of the transforming growth factor beta superfamily, was identified as a mammalian mitokine using mice with skeletal muscle-specific deficiency of Crif1, a mitoribosomal subunit protein, and confirmed through muscle-specific expression of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1). In both cases mitochondrial perturbation in skeletal muscle raised circulating GDF15, which triggered metabolic alterations in distal tissues including regulation of body fat mass and reversal of hepatic steatosis. GDF15 secretion is downstream of the ISR, and metformin-induced weight loss in patients is dependent on a several-fold rise in serum GDF15.
links.context_zh_TW: GDF15 是轉化生長因子 beta 超家族的成員，透過使用具有骨骼肌特異性 Crif1（粒線體核糖體亞基蛋白）缺陷的小鼠，被確認為哺乳動物粒線體因子，並透過肌肉特異性 uncoupling protein 1（UCP1）的表達得到證實。在這兩種情況下，骨骼肌中的粒線體擾動都提高了循環 GDF15，觸發遠端組織的代謝改變，包括調節體脂量和逆轉肝脂肪變性。GDF15 分泌在 ISR 的下游，而 metformin 誘導的患者體重減輕依賴於血清 GDF15 的數倍升高。

links.context: GLO1 (glyoxalase 1, lactoylglutathione lyase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the cellular Glyoxalase System. It catalyzes conversion of hemithioacetals, which form spontaneously between the reactive dicarbonyl Methylglyoxal and Glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione, committing the dicarbonyl to detoxification rather than further reaction.
links.context_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase 1，lactoylglutathione lyase）是細胞 Glyoxalase System 的限速酵素。它催化將反應性二碳醣基 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 自發形成的 hemithioacetal 轉為 S-D-lactoylglutathione，使該二碳醣基被導向去毒途徑而非進一步反應。

links.context: GLO1 (glyoxalase 1, lactoylglutathione lyase) is the rate-limiting, zinc-dependent metalloenzyme of the Glyoxalase System. It catalyzes the isomerization of the hemithioacetal that forms spontaneously between Methylglyoxal and Glutathione into S-D-lactoylglutathione, proceeding through a cis-enediolate intermediate in which the active-site Zn²⁺ coordinates the substrate. Human GLO1 is a homodimer of 184-residue (~21 kDa) subunits with allosteric regulation by Glutathione and S-D-lactoylglutathione.
links.context_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase 1，lactoylglutathione lyase）是 Glyoxalase System 的限速酵素，為鋅依賴型的金屬酵素。它催化 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 自發形成的硫代半縮醛異構化為 S-D-lactoylglutathione，經由 cis-enediolate 中間體進行，過程中活性中心的 Zn²⁺ 配位受質。人類 GLO1 為 184 個胺基酸（約 21 kDa）次單體的同源二聚體，並受 Glutathione 與 S-D-lactoylglutathione 的變構調節。

links.context: GPX4 uses glutathione (reduced GSH) to convert phospholipid hydroperoxides to harmless alcohols — the canonical ferroptosis brake. System Xc- (SLC7A11) imports cystine for GSH synthesis, so cystine starvation or RSL3-style GPX4 inhibition collapses this shield and unleashes ferroptosis. The GPX4 repair tier stalls whenever glutathione supply fails, because two glutathione equivalents are consumed per hydroperoxide reduced. Erastin blocks system xc- and collapses cystine uptake so that glutathione synthesis halts and GPX4's substrate vanishes, while RSL3 bypasses glutathione entirely by covalently modifying the selenocysteine. Glutathione depletion converts an aldehyde clearance pathway into a liability.
links.context_zh_TW: GPX4 使用 glutathione（還原態 GSH）把磷脂氫過氧化物轉成無害醇類——這是鐵死亡的典型煞車。System Xc-（SLC7A11）輸入胱氨酸以合成 GSH，因此胱氨酸飢餓或 RSL3 式 GPX4 抑制會使此護盾崩潰並釋放鐵死亡。 只要 glutathione 供應中斷，GPX4 修復層就會停滯，因為每還原一個過氧化物就消耗兩個 glutathione 當量。Erastin 阻斷 system xc- 讓胱胺酸攝入崩潰，glutathione 合成因而停止、GPX4 的基質消失；而 RSL3 則繞過 glutathione，直接共價修飾 selenocysteine。Glutathione 耗竭會把原本的醛清除路徑轉為危害來源。

links.context: Glyoxal is a highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediate generated during cellular metabolism, Glycolysis and Lipid Peroxidation. It is a potent inducer of dicarbonyl stress, reacting non-enzymatically with cellular macromolecules to form Advanced Glycation End Products. It is detoxified by enzymatic defense networks including the Glyoxalase System and PARK7 (DJ-1), which catalyzes its glutathione-independent conversion to Glycolic acid and thereby protects cellular proteins from covalent modification.
links.context_zh_TW: Glyoxal 是在細胞代謝、Glycolysis 與 Lipid Peroxidation 過程中產生的高反應性 dicarbonyl 中間體。它是 dicarbonyl stress 的強效誘發因子，會與細胞大分子進行非酵素性反應形成 Advanced Glycation End Products。它可被包括 Glyoxalase System 與 PARK7（DJ-1）在內的酵素防禦網絡解毒；PARK7 催化其不依賴 glutathione 的轉化為 Glycolic acid，藉此保護細胞蛋白免於共價修飾。

links.context: HFF1 is a neonatal foreskin fibroblast line.
links.context_zh_TW: HFF1 是新生兒包皮纖維母細胞系。

links.context: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory receptor NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer expressed on NK cells and CD8+ T cells. This binding delivers a cognate inhibitory signal upon engagement, dampening the cytotoxic activity of the receptor-bearing lymphocyte. The interaction is a canonical innate immune checkpoint, analogous to PD-1/PD-L1 but restricted to the NKG2A-CD94 axis. In senescence, HLA-E-NKG2A engagement becomes a route by which arrested cells dampen their own immune clearance, contributing to their persistence.
links.context_zh_TW: HLA-E 是表達於 NK 細胞與 CD8+ T 細胞的抑制性受體 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體。此結合在參與時傳遞同源抑制訊號，減弱攜帶受體的淋巴球的細胞毒性活性。此交互作用是典型的先天免疫檢查點，類似 PD-1/PD-L1 但限於 NKG2A-CD94 軸。在衰老中，HLA-E-NKG2A 參與成為停滯細胞減弱其自身免疫清除的途徑，貢獻其持續。

links.context: HP1alpha reads the H3K9me3 heterochromatin mark and, when recruited by KAP1 after SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation, packages LINE-1 retrotransposons into repressive heterochromatin. In senescence, declining SIRT6 and RB1 weaken this complex, decompacting LINE-1 loci and permitting retrotransposon transcription that feeds cGAS–STING-driven SASP and inflammaging.
links.context_zh_TW: HP1alpha 讀取 H3K9me3 異染色質標記，並在 KAP1 經 SIRT6 單 ADP-核糖基化後被招募時，將 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉位子包裝進抑制性異染色質。在細胞衰老時，SIRT6 與 RB1 減少削弱此複合體，使 LINE-1 位點去壓縮並容許轉位子轉錄，進而透過 cGAS–STING 驅動 SASP 與發炎性老化。

links.context: HRV is highly individual and a universal normal range does not exist; factors such as age, sex, health conditions, and activity levels all shape an individual's baseline. General adult ranges only serve as rough guidelines, and HRV declines with age. More important than any single raw number is an individual's personal baseline trend: a sustained drop of 20 percent or more in average HRV is a far more insightful signal than a specific value on a standardized chart, making trends over 3 to 7 days the practical unit of analysis.
links.context_zh_TW: HRV 高度因人而異，並不存在通用的正常範圍；年齡、性別、健康狀況與活動量等因素都會塑造個人的基線。一般成人的參考區間僅供粗略參考，且 HRV 會隨年齡增長而下降。比任何單一數值更重要的是個人基線趨勢：平均 HRV 持續下降 20% 以上，遠比標準圖表上的特定數值更具洞察力，因此 3 至 7 天的趨勢才是實際的分析單位。

links.context: HSP27 (HSPB1) is a small heat-shock protein that buffers stress and inhibits apoptosis, contributing to chemoresistance.
links.context_zh_TW: HSP27（HSPB1）是一種小熱休克蛋白，緩衝壓力並抑制凋亡，導致化療抗性。

links.context: HSPA8 (HSC70) is the constitutive HSP70-family chaperone that delivers KFERQ-motif client proteins to LAMP-2A at the lysosome in chaperone-mediated autophagy. Because deficient CMA degradation compromises proteostasis and activates signaling that culminates in cellular senescence, HSPA8 is central to both proteostasis and senescence control.
links.context_zh_TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是恆定表現的 HSP70 家族伴護蛋白，負責在伴護素媒介自噬中將帶有 KFERQ 序列的受質蛋白運送至溶酶體的 LAMP-2A。由於 CMA 降解不足會破壞蛋白恆定性並啟動最終導致細胞衰老的訊號傳遞，HSPA8 同時是蛋白恆定與衰老調控的核心。

links.context: HUWE1 is a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase.
links.context_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 HECT 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶。

links.context: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is a rare congenital form of Methemoglobinemia caused by autosomal dominant mutations in the globin genes (α, β or γ chains). These mutations stabilize the iron in the ferric Fe³⁺ state within Hemoglobin, so the affected heme groups cannot bind oxygen, producing lifelong Cyanosis; patients are otherwise typically asymptomatic or only mildly affected.
links.context_zh_TW: Hemoglobin M（HbM）疾病是 Methemoglobinemia 的一種罕見先天型態，由 globin 基因（α、β 或 γ 鏈）的體染色體顯性突變造成。這些突變使 Hemoglobin 中的鐵穩定於 ferric Fe³⁺ 態，使受影響的 heme 無法結合氧氣，造成終身 Cyanosis；患者通常無其他症狀或僅有輕微表現。

links.context: Hexokinase 2 catalyzes the first rate-limiting glycolytic step, glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.
links.context_zh_TW: Hexokinase 2 催化第一個速率限制糖解步驟，葡萄糖至葡萄糖-6-磷酸。

links.context: High-dose, long-term creatine supplementation is a nutritional strategy for creatine synthesis deficiencies caused by mutations in AGAT, GAMT, or the creatine transporter (SLC6A8), which reduce endogenous creatine synthesis or cellular uptake and result in low brain creatine and phosphocreatine. Supplementation at 0.3-0.8 g/kg/day increases brain creatine and PCr levels and improves or stabilizes clinical symptoms including intellectual disability, epilepsy, and movement disorders. Patients with GAMT or AGAT deficiency treated early (e.g., starting at four months of age) can experience normal psychomotor development, and such therapy is well tolerated and may also benefit ornithine aminotransferase deficiency causing gyrate atrophy.
links.context_zh_TW: 高劑量、長期的肌酸補充是針對 AGAT、GAMT 或肌酸轉運蛋白（SLC6A8）突變所致肌酸合成缺乏症的營養策略，這些突變會降低內源性肌酸合成或細胞攝取，導致腦部肌酸與磷酸肌酸偏低。以每日 0.3–0.8 公克/公斤補充可提高腦部肌酸與 PCr 濃度，並改善或穩定臨床症狀，包括智能障礙、癲癇與動作障礙。早期治療（例如從四個月大開始）的 GAMT 或 AGAT 缺乏症患者可獲得正常的心理動作發展，此療法耐受性良好，且可能對導致迴旋狀萎縮的鳥胺酸胺基轉移酶缺乏症也有益。

links.context: Honeybee venom and its major component melittin suppress activation of EGFR and HER2 by interfering with receptor phosphorylation in the plasma membrane of breast carcinoma cells. Immunoblotting showed downregulation of p-EGFR (Tyr1068), p-HER2 (Tyr1248), p-p44/42 MAPK, p-Akt, p-JNK and p-p38 MAPK within 5-20 minutes, and BRET data indicate melittin sits within 10 nm of the receptor without occupying the EGF-binding site.
links.context_zh_TW: 蜂蜜蜂毒及其主要成分 melittin 藉干擾乳癌細胞細胞膜上的受體磷酸化，抑制 EGFR 與 HER2 的活化。免疫 blot 顯示在 5 至 20 分鐘內 p-EGFR（Tyr1068）、p-HER2（Tyr1248）、p-p44/42 MAPK、p-Akt、p-JNK 與 p-p38 MAPK 均被下調；BRET 數據則顯示 melittin 位於受體 10 nm 範圍內，但未占據 EGF 結合位。
links.source_file: _document_ - Honeybee venom and melittin suppress growth factor receptor activation in HER2-enriched and triple-negative breast cancer - npj Precision Oncology.md

links.context: Honokiol protects the brain against ischemia-reperfusion injury. Intravenous honokiol given 15 minutes before or 60 minutes after middle cerebral artery occlusion dose-dependently reduced infarct volume by 20-70% without significant hemodynamic changes. Protective mechanisms include inhibition of neutrophil infiltration and ROS production, suppression of post-ischemic glucose intolerance, disruption of the PSD95-nNOS interaction at the NMDA receptor complex (preventing calcium-dependent neurotoxic nitric oxide production), and suppression of glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可保護大腦免受缺血再灌注損傷。在大腦中動脈阻塞前 15 分鐘或阻塞後 60 分鐘靜脈給予厚朴酚，可依劑量將梗塞體積減少 20-70%，且無顯著的血流動力學變化。保護機制包括抑制中性球浸潤與 ROS 產生、抑制缺血後葡萄糖不耐受、破壞 NMDA 受體複合物處的 PSD95-nNOS 交互作用（防止鈣依賴的神經毒性一氧化氮產生），以及抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與細胞激素產生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol reduces cerebral infarction in rodent stroke models, including both pre-ischemic and post-ischemic administration paradigms. In MCA occlusion models, intravenous honokiol significantly reduced total infarct volume without creating significant hemodynamic changes. The neuroprotection is multifactorial, involving inhibition of neutrophil infiltration and reactive oxygen species production, suppression of post-ischemic glucose intolerance, disruption of PSD95-nNOS coupling to prevent neurotoxic nitric oxide generation, and inhibition of glial NF-kappaB activation and inflammatory cytokine production during ischemia-reperfusion.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可減少囓齒類中風模型中的腦梗塞，涵蓋缺血前與缺血後兩種投藥模式。在大腦中動脈阻塞模型中，靜脈給予厚朴酚顯著減少總梗塞體積，且不造成顯著的血流動力學變化。其神經保護作用是多因素的，涉及抑制中性球浸潤與活性氧物質產生、抑制缺血後葡萄糖不耐受、破壞 PSD95-nNOS 耦聯以防止神經毒性一氧化氮生成，以及在缺血再灌注期間抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與發炎性細胞激素產生。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Honokiol suppresses NF-kappaB activation in multiple cell types, a key node in its anti-inflammatory activity. In LPS-stimulated macrophages honokiol inhibited NF-kappaB activation along with PKC-alpha membrane translocation and MAPK signaling, reducing TNF-alpha and nitric oxide production. It likewise suppressed glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production during cerebral ischemia-reperfusion and inhibited COX-2 expression in RAW264.7 macrophage-like cells. These convergent actions on the NF-kappaB pathway underlie honokiol's neuroprotective and analgesic anti-inflammatory effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚在多種細胞類型中抑制 NF-kappaB 活化，此為其抗發炎活性的關鍵節點。在 LPS 刺激的巨噬細胞中，厚朴酚抑制 NF-kappaB 活化，同時抑制 PKC-alpha 膜轉位與 MAPK 訊息傳導，降低 TNF-alpha 及一氧化氮的產生。它在腦缺血再灌注期間同樣抑制膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化與細胞激素產生，並在 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞樣細胞中抑制 COX-2 表現。這些對 NF-kappaB 路徑的收斂性作用，構成了厚朴酚神經保護與鎮痛抗發炎效果的基礎。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Human caspase-4 is a cytosolic-LPS sensor and noncanonical effector alongside caspase-5, paralleling murine caspase-11. It cleaves gasdermin D and IL-1α to drive SASP and pyroptotic signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 人類 caspase-4 是胞質 LPS 感受器與非典型效應因子，與 caspase-5 並列，對應小鼠 caspase-11。它切割 gasdermin D 與 IL-1α 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptotic 訊號。

links.context: Humanin improves glucose tolerance and delays the onset of diabetes in NOD mice, a model of type 1 diabetes involving progressive accumulation of lymphocytes within the pancreatic islets of Langerhans. In NOD mouse pancreata, humanin treatment dramatically suppressed inflammation and lymphocyte infiltration. Furthermore, humanin decreases serum starvation- and cytokine-induced apoptosis in the pancreatic beta-cell line NIT-1, protecting against the IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma released by T cells and activated macrophages, in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner, suggesting it may be a therapeutic target for type 1 diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: Humanin 改善 NOD 小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性並延遲糖尿病的發生；NOD 小鼠是第 1 型糖尿病模型，其特徵為淋巴球在胰臟蘭氏小島內逐漸累積。在 NOD 小鼠胰臟中，humanin 治療顯著抑制發炎與淋巴球浸潤。此外，humanin 降低胰臟 beta 細胞株 NIT-1 中血清剝奪與細胞激素誘導的細胞凋亡，以 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式保護細胞免受 T 細胞與活化巨噬細胞釋放的 IL-1beta、TNF-alpha 與 IFN-gamma 傷害，顯示它可能是第 1 型糖尿病的治療標靶。
links.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

links.context: Hydroxyurea is a first-line therapy for managing erythrocytosis in polycythemia vera. By inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase in erythroid progenitors it reduces total red blood cell mass and prevents thrombotic complications.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 是控制真性紅血球增多症紅血球增多症的一線治療。透過抑制紅血球前驅細胞中的 ribonucleotide reductase，它減少總紅血球質量並預防血栓併發症。

links.context: Hydroxyurea is used to improve the clinical course of sickle cell disease by raising HbF levels. It reduces the frequency of vaso-occlusive crises and is a standard disease-modifying therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 藉由提高 HbF 水平改善鐮刀型細胞疾病的臨床病程。它可減少血管阻塞性危象的發生頻率，是標準的疾病調整治療。

links.context: IDO1 is a major target in immuno-oncology due to its role in tumor evasion: it is often upregulated in cancers and the tumor microenvironment, where its tryptophan depletion and kynurenine accumulation create an immunosuppressive niche that suppresses effector T cells and promotes regulatory T cells. Inhibitors such as epacadostat, navoximod and linrodostat (BMS-986205) have been tested in clinical trials, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors (PD-1/PD-L1), though results have been mixed.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 因其在腫瘤逃逸中的角色而成為免疫腫瘤學的主要標靶：它在癌症與腫瘤微環境中常被上調，其色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸累積創造出免疫抑制微環境，抑制效應 T 細胞並促進調節性 T 細胞。諸如 epacadostat、navoximod 與 linrodostat（BMS-986205）等抑制劑已在臨床試驗中接受測試，通常與檢查點抑制劑（PD-1/PD-L1）合併使用，儘管結果好壞參半。

links.context: IL-1a is a primary SASP factor that induces paracrine senescence in neighboring cells by engaging IL-1R and activating MyD88-NF-kB signaling, which drives growth arrest in recipients. As an apical amplifier, it both sustains the SASP in the sender and converts neighbors into senescent cells, and its cleavage is required for full activity. This makes IL-1a a key transmissible effector of senescence spread, with MyD88 and IRAK1 as required downstream nodes. IL-1R blockade can therefore restrain the paracrine propagation of senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是誘發鄰近細胞旁分泌衰老的主要 SASP 因子，透過接合 IL-1R 並活化 MyD88-NF-κB 訊號，驅動受體生長停滯。作為頂層放大器，它既在傳送者維持 SASP，又將鄰近轉化為衰老細胞，且其切割對完整活性必要。這使 IL-1α 成為衰老擴散的關鍵可傳播效應器，MyD88 與 IRAK1 為必要下游節點。因此 IL-1R 阻斷可抑制衰老的旁分泌傳播。

links.context: IL-1a is a primary SASP factor that mediates paracrine senescence by engaging IL-1R on neighboring cells, activating MyD88-dependent NF-kB signaling that induces arrest. As an apical amplifier, IL-1a both sustains the SASP in the sender and converts recipients into senescent cells, and its cleavage by caspase-5 or calpain is required for full activity. This makes IL-1a a key transmissible effector of senescence spreading, with MyD88 and IRAK1 as required downstream nodes. Its centrality explains why IL-1R blockade can restrain paracrine arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是介導旁分泌衰老的主要 SASP 因子，透過接合鄰近細胞的 IL-1R、活化 MyD88 依賴的 NF-κB 訊號以誘發停滯。作為頂層放大器，IL-1α 既在傳送者中維持 SASP，又將受體轉化為衰老細胞，且其經 caspase-5 或 calpain 的切割對完整活性必要。這使 IL-1α 成為衰老擴散的關鍵可傳播效應器，MyD88 與 IRAK1 為必要的下游節點。其中心性解釋為何 IL-1R 阻斷可抑制旁分泌停滯。

links.context: IL-1α is directly cleaved at a conserved site by Caspase-5 in human cells (Caspase-11 in mice), enzymes of the noncanonical inflammasome. Senescent human fibroblasts show increased CASP5 expression, cell surface IL-1α and cleaved IL-1α in conditioned media, and CASP5 knockdown significantly reduced surface IL-1α and downstream IL-6, IL-8 and CCL2 while maintaining senescence arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 在人類細胞中由 Caspase-5（小鼠為 Caspase-11）在保守位點直接切割，這些酵素屬非典型 inflammasome。衰老的人類纖維母細胞顯示 CASP5 表現增加、細胞表面 IL-1α 與條件培養液中的切割 IL-1α 增加；CASP5 敲低顯著減少表面 IL-1α 與下游 IL-6、IL-8、CCL2，同時維持衰老停滯。

links.context: IL-4 is the primary polarizing cytokine for Th2 differentiation: it activates STAT6, which induces GATA3 expression, and early IL-4 sources include basophils, mast cells, and NKT cells. IL-4 also drives IgE class switching in B cells, autocrine STAT6/GATA3 Th2 self-amplification, M2 macrophage polarization, and eotaxin production.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-4 是 Th2 分化的主要極化細胞激素：它活化 STAT6，後者誘導 GATA3 的表現；IL-4 的早期來源包括嗜鹼性球、肥大細胞與 NKT 細胞。IL-4 同時驅動 B 細胞的 IgE 類別轉換、經由自分泌 STAT6/GATA3 的 Th2 自我放大、M2 巨噬細胞極化以及 eotaxin 的產生。

links.context: IL-6 engages the IL-6R/gp130 co-receptor to activate JAK-STAT3, sustaining stemness factors OCT4, NANOG and SOX2. This canonical axis underlies SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming and cancer stemness.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 接合 IL-6R/gp130 共受體以活化 JAK-STAT3，維持幹性因子 OCT4、NANOG 與 SOX2。此典型軸構成 SASP 驅動的旁分泌重編程與癌症幹性的基礎。

links.context: IL-6 to JAK to STAT3 forms the autocrine amplification loop of SASP signaling. Activation sustains chronic inflammatory transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 到 JAK 到 STAT3 形成 SASP 訊號的自分泌放大迴圈。活化維持慢性發炎轉錄。

links.context: IL-6R activates JAK-STAT signalling after assembling with gp130: receptor-associated JAK kinases phosphorylate gp130 tyrosines, recruiting and activating STAT3 (and STAT1), which dimerise and translocate to the nucleus. In senescence, JAK-STAT activation downstream of IL-6R promotes SASP gene expression, and JAK inhibition with ruxolitinib suppresses the secretome without clearing senescent cells, establishing this arm as a validated senomorphic target. The scheme draws IL-6R feeding JAK and STAT, with STAT reaching the nuclear transcription-factor tier.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6R 與 gp130 組裝後活化 JAK-STAT 訊號：與受體結合的 JAK 激酶磷酸化 gp130 酪胺酸，招募並活化 STAT3（及 STAT1），使其二聚化並入核。在衰老中，IL-6R 下游的 JAK-STAT 活化促進 SASP 基因表現，而 ruxolitinib 抑制 JAK 可壓制 secretome 而不清除衰老細胞，確立此臂為經驗證的 senomorphic 靶點。圖中顯示 IL-6R 供應 JAK 與 STAT，STAT 並到達細胞核轉錄因子層。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: IL-8 (CXCL8) signals through CXCR1/CXCR2 to expand cancer stem-cell pools and promote tumoursphere formation. CXCR2 blockade abrogates this stemness effect, establishing the receptor axis of SASP-driven reprogramming.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-8（CXCL8）經 CXCR1/CXCR2 訊號擴張癌症幹細胞池並促進腫瘤球形成。阻斷 CXCR2 消除此幹性效應，確立 SASP 驅動重編程的受體軸。

links.context: IL-8 is the primary neutrophil chemoattractant acting through CXCR1/2. Recruitment is its defining immune function.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-8 是經由 CXCR1/2 作用的主要嗜中性球趨化因子。招募是其定義性免疫功能。

links.context: Immunosenescence impairs T-cell immunity, featuring perturbed memory responses, thymic involution, reduced naive T-cell generation, and accumulation of differentiated, often dysfunctional memory and effector subsets such as EMRA CD8+ T cells. This limits responses to infection and vaccination in the elderly and weakens T-cell-mediated immune surveillance, including the clearance of senescent and premalignant cells. The impairment is a hallmark of adaptive immune aging. It directly contributes to the decline in senescence surveillance with age.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫衰老損害 T 細胞免疫，特徵為記憶反應紊亂、胸腺退化、初始 T 細胞生成減少，以及分化、常功能障礙的記憶與效應子集（如 EMRA CD8+ T 細胞）累積。這限制老年人對感染與疫苗的回應，並削弱 T 細胞介導的免疫監視，包括清除衰老與癌前細胞。此損害是適應性免疫老化的特徵，直接促成隨年齡的衰老監視下降。

links.context: Immunosenescence is accompanied by inflammaging -- a chronic state of innate immune activation and elevated inflammatory cytokines -- forming a reciprocal loop. As immune competence declines, residual innate activation and senescent-cell SASP sustain low-grade inflammation, and the inflammation in turn further impairs immune function. The two processes are tightly coupled: immunosenescence permits inflammaging, and inflammaging accelerates immune aging. Their association is a central feature of the aging immune landscape.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫衰老伴隨 inflammaging——一種先天免疫慢性活化與發炎細胞激素升高的狀態——形成互補迴圈。隨免疫能力衰退，殘餘先天活化與衰老細胞 SASP 維持低程度發炎，且此發炎反過來又進一步損害免疫功能。兩過程緊密耦合：免疫衰老允許 inflammaging，而 inflammaging 加速免疫老化。此關聯是老化免疫景觀的核心特徵。

links.context: In a preclinical NOD-SCID xenograft model combining PC3 prostate cancer cells with senescent PSC27 stroma, co-administration of apigenin with the chemotherapy agent mitoxantrone (MIT) produced additional tumor reduction beyond MIT alone: MIT alone shrank tumors 57.8%, and the combination achieved an additional 51.1% reduction, for a total 74.9% decrease versus placebo. Apigenin reversed circulating SASP factors (amphiregulin/AREG, epiregulin/EREG) and enhanced DNA damage (γH2AX) and cleaved-caspase-3 apoptosis in tumors.
links.context_zh_TW: 在一個結合PC3前列腺癌細胞與衰老PSC27基質的臨床前NOD-SCID異種移植模型中，芹菜素與化療藥物米托蒽醌（mitoxantrone，MIT）合併投予，產生了超越單用MIT的額外腫瘤縮小效果：單用MIT使腫瘤縮小57.8%，合併療法再達成額外51.1%的縮小，總計較安慰劑組減少74.9%。芹菜素逆轉了循環中的SASP因子（雙調蛋白/AREG、上皮調節素/EREG），並增強腫瘤中的DNA損傷（γH2AX）與cleaved-caspase-3細胞凋亡。

links.context: In acquired Methemoglobinemia, NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase reduces Methylene blue to leucomethylene blue, which then nonenzymatically reduces ferric heme. Methylene blue therefore acts as an electron carrier that recruits the reductase system to accelerate methemoglobin clearance, rather than acting directly itself.
links.context_zh_TW: 在後天性 Methemoglobinemia 中，NADPH 依賴性的 methemoglobin reductase 會將 Methylene blue 還原為 leucomethylene blue，後者再以非酵素方式還原三價鐵血基質。因此 Methylene blue 是扮演電子載體的角色，藉由招募還原酶系統加速 methemoglobin 的清除，本身並非直接作用。

links.context: In colitis models, NMN increased tight-junction protein expression and improved mucus secretion, attenuating intestinal mucosal permeability. Long-term treatment raised goblet cell numbers and mucus thickness, maintaining epithelial integrity. NAD+-precursor-activated sirtuins additionally protect intestinal endothelial cells against oxidative injury, collectively reinforcing the barrier.
links.context_zh_TW: 在結腸炎模型中，NMN 增加緊密連接蛋白表現並改善黏液分泌，減輕腸黏膜通透性。長期處理提高杯狀細胞數量與黏液厚度，維持上皮完整性。由 NAD+ 前驅物活化的 sirtuins 另可保護腸道 Endothelial Cells 免受氧化損傷，整體上強化屏障。

links.context: In senescence, mitochondrial pyruvate entry via MPC feeds a citrate-acetyl-CoA export axis: the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 exports citrate to the cytoplasm where ACLY generates Acetyl-CoA, and that pool is used to place H3K27ac at SASP loci. Inhibiting SLC25A1 or MPC with CTPI2 collapses this pool, removes H3K27ac from SASP enhancers and selectively suppresses SASP expression while leaving viability and mtDNA-driven signalling intact; exogenous acetate bypasses the block via ACSS2. CTPI2-treated mice showed reduced Frailty and improved healthspan.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老中，經 MPC 進入的粒線體丙酮酸驅動檸檬酸-Acetyl-CoA 輸出軸：粒線體檸檬酸運輸蛋白 SLC25A1 將檸檬酸輸出至細胞質，由 ACLY 生成 Acetyl-CoA，而該乙醯基群池用於在 SASP 位點標記 H3K27ac。以 CTPI2 抑制 SLC25A1 或 MPC 會使此群池崩解、從 SASP 增強子移除 H3K27ac，並選擇性抑制 SASP 表現，同時保留細胞存活與 mtDNA 驅動的訊號；外源性 acetate 可經 ACSS2 繞過此阻斷。接受 CTPI2 處理的小鼠 Frailty 下降且健康壽命改善。

links.context: In the periphery, IL-7 regulates T cell survival and function. IL-7 binds the IL-7 receptor expressed on many immune cells, including lymphoid precursors, double-positive thymocytes, and single-positive CD4 or CD8 T cells, promoting survival and differentiation of immature triple-negative and mature single-positive thymocytes. The IL-7 receptor is a target for therapeutic intervention, particularly for restoring T cells in subjects undergoing T cell-depleting regimens.
links.context_zh_TW: 在周邊，IL-7 調節 T 細胞的存活與功能。IL-7 結合表現於許多免疫細胞上的 IL-7 受體，包括淋巴前驅細胞、雙陽性胸腺細胞與單陽性 CD4 或 CD8 T 細胞，促進未成熟三陰性與成熟單陽性胸腺細胞的存活與分化。IL-7 受體是治療介入的標靶，特別是恢復正接受 T 細胞耗竭療程之個體的 T 細胞。

links.context: Individuals with Down Syndrome (trisomy 21) carry an extra copy of the APP gene on chromosome 21q21.3, producing roughly 1.5-fold APP overexpression. This dosage effect leads to Aβ accumulation beginning in the third decade of life, and virtually all individuals with Down Syndrome develop AD neuropathology by age 40, which supports the amyloid cascade hypothesis that APP-derived Aβ accumulation is the initiating event in Alzheimer's Disease pathogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（三染色體 21）個體在 21q21.3 上多帶有一份 APP 基因，導致約 1.5 倍的 APP 過量表現。這種劑量效應使 Aβ 從二十多歲起開始累積，且幾乎所有 Down Syndrome 個體在 40 歲前都會出現 AD 神經病理，支持類澱粉樣級聯假說：由 APP 衍生的 Aβ 累積是 Alzheimer's Disease 致病過程的起始事件。

links.context: Inflammaging is reduced by senolytics, which clear the senescent cells that produce the chronic SASP, thereby lowering circulating inflammatory mediators. In aged animals and human pilot studies, senolytic treatment decreases inflammatory markers and improves physical function, consistent with source reduction of the secretome. The directionality is source-directed: remove the secretors and the inflammation falls, which also weakens the feed-forward loop by which the SASP activates immune cells. This makes senolysis a primary strategy against age-related inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Inflammaging 被 senolytics 減少，senolytics 清除產生慢性 SASP 的衰老細胞，從而降低循環發炎介質。在老化動物與人類試驗性研究中，senolytic 治療降低發炎標記並改善身體功能，與分泌組的來源減少一致。其方向性為來源導向：移除分泌者則發炎下降，這也減弱 SASP 活化免疫細胞的正向迴圈。這使 senolysis 成為對抗年齡相關發炎的主要策略。

links.context: Inflammasomes are cytosolic supramolecular multiprotein scaffolds that assemble in response to pathogens or sterile danger signals and activate inflammatory caspases such as Caspase-1. These caspases cleave pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 and drive pyroptosis, an inflammatory form of cell death; NLRP3-containing inflammasomes are the archetypal example.
links.context_zh_TW: Inflammasome 是細胞質內的超分子多蛋白支架，會在遇到病原體或無害的危險訊號時組裝並活化發炎性 caspase（如 Caspase-1）。這些 caspase 切割 pro-IL-1β 與 pro-IL-18，並驅動 pyroptosis（發炎性細胞死亡）；含 NLRP3 的 inflammasome 是典型例子。

links.context: Insulin signaling through the Akt–mTORC1 axis activates SREBP-1c transcription and promotes its proteolytic processing, with S6K1-dependent signaling driving SREBP-1c-dependent lipid synthesis. This nutrient-sensing route is the main reason fed-state lipogenesis rises, and it is the same axis mTOR inhibition suppresses.
links.context_zh_TW: 經由 Akt–mTORC1 軸的 insulin 訊息傳遞會活化 SREBP-1c 的轉錄並促進其蛋白酶水解加工，其中由 S6K1 依賴的訊息傳遞驅動 SREBP-1c 依賴性的脂質合成。這條營養感知途徑是進食狀態下脂肪生成上升的主要原因，也是抑制 mTOR 所能阻斷的同一條軸。

links.context: Integrin alphaVbeta5 has been identified as the high-affinity receptor for the myokine irisin (Perakakis et al. 2018, Cell). A 2023 cryo-EM study revealed a two-step activation in which extracellular Hsp90alpha primes alphaVbeta5 for high-affinity irisin binding, establishing an Hsp90alpha/alphaVbeta5/irisin ternary complex.
links.context_zh_TW: Integrin alphaVbeta5 已被鑑定為肌動素 irisin 的高親和力受體（Perakakis 等人 2018，Cell）。2023 年的冷凍電鏡研究揭示了兩步活化機制：細胞外 Hsp90alpha 先使 alphaVbeta5 準備好進行高親和力的 irisin 結合，形成 Hsp90alpha/alphaVbeta5/irisin 三元複合體。

links.context: Interleukin 1β is a potent pyrogenic, pro-inflammatory cytokine of the IL-1 family. Unlike most secreted proteins, mature IL-1β is not released by conventional signal-peptide cleavage: the inactive precursor pro-IL-1β is first transcribed in response to inflammatory cues such as TLR/NOD ligands, then proteolytically matured by active Caspase-1 following assembly of the NLRP3 Inflammasome. Once mature, IL-1β amplifies Inflammation by inducing COX-2, adhesion molecules and other cytokines.
links.context_zh_TW: Interleukin 1β 是 IL-1 家族中強效的致熱性促發炎細胞激素。與多數分泌蛋白不同，成熟的 IL-1β 並非經由一般訊號胜肽切割釋放：其不活化前驅物 pro-IL-1β 先在 TLR/NOD 配體等發炎訊號刺激下轉錄，接著在 NLRP3 Inflammasome 組裝後由活化的 Caspase-1 蛋白水解成熟。成熟後的 IL-1β 藉由誘導 COX-2、黏附分子與其他細胞激素放大 Inflammation。

links.context: Interleukin 22, an IL-10 gene family member produced by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets, signals through the IL-22 receptor on the surface of thymic epithelial cells and promotes the proliferation and survival of thymocytes. Dudakov et al. showed that IL-22 administration to wild-type mice after total body irradiation significantly increases thymic cellularity, including both developing thymocytes and TEC subsets, and that immune recovery in irradiated IL-22-deficient mice is impaired.
links.context_zh_TW: 介白素 22（Interleukin 22）是 IL-10 基因家族成員，由 T 輔助 17 細胞與先天淋巴樣細胞亞群產生，透過胸腺上皮細胞表面的 IL-22 受體傳遞訊號，促進胸腺細胞的增生與存活。Dudakov 等人顯示，在全身照射後對野生型小鼠施用 IL-22 可顯著增加胸腺細胞數量，包括發育中的胸腺細胞與 TEC 亞群，而 IL-22 缺陷小鼠在照射後的免疫恢復則受損。

links.context: Ivermectin became the drug of choice for onchocerciasis because of its potent microfilaricidal effect, absence of severe side effects and excellent safety; a single annual oral dose of 150 μg/kg reduces skin microfilariae to zero and, by interfering with worm embryogenesis, delays the build-up of new microfilariae for up to two years. It is the sole tool in onchocerciasis elimination campaigns.
links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 因具強效的殺微絲蟲作用、缺乏嚴重副作用且安全性優異，而成為 Onchocerciasis 的首選藥物；每年單次口服 150 μg/kg 即可將皮膚微絲蟲降至零，並藉干擾蟲體胚胎發生延緩新微絲蟲累積長達兩年。它是河盲症根除計畫中唯一的防治工具。
links.source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

links.context: JAK (Janus kinase) phosphorylates latent cytoplasmic STAT transcription factors on tyrosine residues, triggering their dimerization and nuclear translocation.
links.context_zh_TW: JAK（Janus 激酶）對潛伏於胞質的 STAT 轉錄因子進行酪胺酸磷酸化，促使其二聚化並轉位入核。

links.context: Keratinocyte growth factor (KGF, FGF7) signaling through FGFR2IIIb is critical for fetal thymus organogenesis and linked to proliferation and differentiation of fetal and postnatal thymic epithelial cells. KGF administration is well-documented to increase thymus size, TEC differentiation, and thymocyte production in aged animals. Min and colleagues showed that a single course of KGF treatment increases thymic cellularity in aged mice, maintained for two months, with restoration of cortical and medullary compartments, increased naive CD4 T cell output, and increased humoral responses to a T-dependent antigen.
links.context_zh_TW: 角質細胞生長因子（KGF，FGF7）透過 FGFR2IIIb 的訊息傳導對胎兒胸腺器官發生至關重要，並與胎兒及出生後胸腺上皮細胞的增生與分化有關。有充分文獻記載 KGF 施用可增加年老動物的胸腺大小、TEC 分化與胸腺細胞生成。Min 及其同事顯示，單一療程的 KGF 治療可增加老年小鼠的胸腺細胞數量，並維持兩個月，同時恢復皮質與髓質區室、增加初始 CD4 T 細胞輸出，並增加對 T 依賴性抗原的體液免疫反應。

links.context: Kidney fibrosis — pathological extracellular matrix accumulation in the renal tubulointerstitium and glomeruli with myofibroblast activation driven by TGF-beta, oxidative stress and metabolic dysfunction — is the final common pathway of nearly all progressive kidney diseases and the key determinant of progression to end-stage kidney disease. Fibrosis replaces functional nephrons with scar tissue, progressively losing filtration.
links.context_zh_TW: 腎臟纖維化——腎小管間質與腎小球中細胞外基質的病理性累積，伴隨由 TGF-beta、氧化壓力與代謝失調所驅動的肌成纖維細胞活化——是幾乎所有進展性腎病的最終共同途徑，也是進展至末期腎病的關鍵決定因子。纖維化以疤痕組織取代具功能的腎元，使濾過功能逐步喪失。

links.context: Kynurenic acid is synthesized from kynurenine by kynurenine aminotransferase (KAT) enzymes (KAT I, II, III), one of three branch points at which kynurenine is metabolized. The other branches run through kynurenine 3-monooxygenase to 3-hydroxykynurenine and quinolinic acid, or through kynureninase to anthranilic acid, so the KynA/quinolinic acid ratio reflects branch flux.
links.context_zh_TW: Kynurenic acid 由 kynurenine aminotransferase（KAT，包含 KAT I、II、III）以 kynurenine 為受質合成，是 kynurenine 三條分支代謝路徑之一。其餘分支分別經 kynurenine 3-monooxygenase 生成 3-hydroxykynurenine 再生成 quinolinic acid，或經 kynureninase 生成 anthranilic acid，因此 KynA／quinolinic acid 比值可反映分支通量。

links.context: Kynurenine and its derivatives activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), promoting regulatory T cell (Treg) differentiation and suppressing effector T/NK cells. This metabolite-driven AhR signaling is the second major mechanism of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression alongside local tryptophan depletion, and together they create an immunosuppressive microenvironment in tissues such as tumors, placenta and inflamed sites. The context-dependent nature of this pathway is notable: it is protective via tolerance induction in autoimmunity but potentially detrimental when overactive in metabolic inflammation, where elevated KP activity links to insulin resistance and chronic low-grade inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸及其衍生物活化芳香烴受體（AhR），促進調節性 T 細胞（Treg）分化並抑制效應 T/NK 細胞。此代謝物驅動的 AhR 訊息傳導是 IDO1 媒介免疫抑制的第二個主要機制，與局部色胺酸耗竭並行，兩者共同在腫瘤、胎盤與發炎部位等組織中創造免疫抑制微環境。此路徑的情境依賴性值得注意：它在自體免疫中經由耐受誘導具有保護作用，但在代謝性發炎中過度活化則可能有害，此時升高的 KP 活性與胰島素抗性及慢性低度發炎相關。

links.context: Kynurenine is formed by deformylation of N-formylkynurenine, itself the product of IDO1 or TDO activity on tryptophan. Because its level reflects flux through the rate-limiting IDO1/TDO step, the kynurenine-to-tryptophan (Kyn/Trp) ratio is used clinically as a surrogate for IDO1 activity and is elevated in chronic inflammation, cancer and insulin resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Kynurenine 由 N-formylkynurenine 去醯胺化（deformylation）生成，而 N-formylkynurenine 則是 IDO1 或 TDO 作用於色胺酸的產物。由於其濃度反映通過 IDO1/TDO 限速步驟的通量，kynurenine 與色胺酸比值（Kyn/Trp ratio）被臨床用作 IDO1 活性的替代指標，並在慢性發炎、癌症與胰島素阻抗性中升高。

links.context: LHRH (GnRH) is a decapeptide produced by hypothalamic neurons that stimulates luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone release from anterior pituitary gonadotrophs, driving testosterone and estrogen production. Physiological pulsatile release is required for normal gonadotropin secretion. LHRH agonists such as leuprolide desensitize LHRH receptors, lowering LH/FSH and thereby reducing testosterone and estrogen without surgical castration.
links.context_zh_TW: LHRH（GnRH）是由下視丘神經元產生的十肽，刺激腦下垂體前葉促性腺細胞釋放黃體生成素與濾泡刺激素，進而驅動睪固酮與雌激素的產生。生理上的脈衝式釋放是正常促性腺激素分泌所必需。LHRH 致效劑如 leuprolide 會使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，降低 LH／FSH，因而在不進行手術去勢的情況下降低睪固酮與雌激素。

links.context: LIT-927 is a CXCL12 neutraligand that rescues endothelial function, restoring NO production and suppressing senescence markers in human aortic endothelial cells. Blocking CXCL12 with LIT-927 also reversed the senescence-induced increase in p21/Cdkn1a and p16INK4a/Cdkn2a and reduced mitochondrial superoxide, making CXCL12 neutralization a candidate senomorphic strategy against cardiovascular aging.
links.context_zh_TW: LIT-927 是 CXCL12 的中和配體，可挽救內皮功能，在人類主動脈內皮細胞中回復 NO 產生並抑制衰老標記。以 LIT-927 阻斷 CXCL12 也能逆轉衰老所造成的 p21/Cdkn1a 與 p16INK4a/Cdkn2a 上升並降低粒線體超氧陰離子，使 CXCL12 中和成為對抗心血管老化的候選 senomorphic 策略。

links.context: LPCAT3 is a positive regulator and substrate gatekeeper of ferroptosis: together with ACSL4 it determines how much oxidizable PUFA-phosphatidylethanolamine is present, setting the ferroptosis threshold independently of GSH/GPX4 levels. It operates upstream of the GPX4-controlled execution step, and its implication across cancer, neurodegeneration and ischemia-reperfusion injury makes it a candidate sensitizer, though systemic inhibition would perturb essential lipid homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: LPCAT3 是 ferroptosis 的正向調節因子與受質守門者：它與 ACSL4 共同決定可被氧化的 PUFA-磷脂醯乙醇胺的數量，獨立於 GSH／GPX4 濃度而設定 ferroptosis 的閾值。它作用於 GPX4 控制的執行步驟之上游；其在癌症、神經退化與缺血再灌流傷害中的重要性使其成為候選增敏劑，但全身性抑制會擾動必要的脂質恆定。

links.context: LPS activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, which processes pro-IL-1beta into its mature form via caspase-1 cleavage, adding a second layer of innate immune activation critical to the hyperinflammatory state of sepsis. Together with MyD88-dependent and TRIF-dependent TLR4 signalling to NF-κB and IRF3, this drives release of TNFα, IL-1beta, IL-6 and inducible COX-2 and iNOS.
links.context_zh_TW: LPS 會活化 NLRP3 inflammasome，透過 caspase-1 切割將 pro-IL-1β 加工為成熟形式，提供了對敗血症高發炎狀態至關重要的第二層先天免疫活化。此作用與經 MyD88 依賴性及 TRIF 依賴性 TLR4 訊號傳至 NF-κB 與 IRF3 共同驅動 TNFα、IL-1β、IL-6 以及誘導型 COX-2 與 iNOS 的釋放。

links.context: LRRK2 regulates mitophagy as well as lysosomal tubulation and vesicle sorting. Pathogenic LRRK2 activity impairs mitophagy, so inhibiting LRRK2 with GSK3357679A restores mitophagy in LRRK2 G2019S mice — the first demonstration that LRRK2 targeting can rescue mitophagy damage in vivo, linking LRRK2 dysfunction in Parkinson's disease to mitochondrial quality control failure.
links.context_zh_TW: LRRK2 調節 mitophagy 以及溶小體管狀化與囊泡分選。致病型 LRRK2 活性會損害 mitophagy，因此以 GSK3357679A 抑制 LRRK2 可在 LRRK2 G2019S 小鼠中恢復 mitophagy——這是首次證明針對 LRRK2 的標靶可在體內救援 mitophagy 損傷，將 Parkinson's disease 中的 LRRK2 失能與粒線體品質控管失效連結起來。

links.context: LYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase.
links.context_zh_TW: LYN 是 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

links.context: Laminin concentrates in the basement-membrane layer of basal lamina. Part-whole nesting of the component.
links.context_zh_TW: Laminin 集中於基底膜的基底膜層。成分的部分—整體嵌套。

links.context: Laminin is a major structural and signaling component of basal lamina. Containment records the sheet composition.
links.context_zh_TW: Laminin 是基底膜的主要結構與訊號成分。包含記錄片狀組成。

links.context: Leucine is a potent activator of the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 and stimulates skeletal muscle anabolism. Leucine signals to mTORC1 in specific neurons by binding to and activating a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1). In humans, leucine supplementation increases muscle protein synthesis but does not improve muscle function, and its effects on fat mass are mixed. Leucine's cardiovascular effects are divergent: some studies show supplementation accelerates atherosclerotic plaque progression in an mTORC1-dependent manner and its metabolite isovaleric acid accelerates atrial fibrillation, while others report improved vascular function. Notably, leucine supplementation does not extend mouse lifespan, suggesting changes in leucine are unlikely to be responsible for protein restriction benefits.
links.context_zh_TW: 白胺酸是主要營養感測器 mTORC1 的強效活化劑，並刺激骨骼肌合成代謝。白胺酸在特定神經元中透過結合並活化電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向 mTORC1 傳遞訊號。在人體中，白胺酸補充增加肌肉蛋白質合成，但不會改善肌肉功能，其對脂肪量的影響則好壞參半。白胺酸的心血管效應存在分歧：一些研究顯示補充會以 mTORC1 依賴方式加速動脈粥狀硬化斑塊進展，其代謝物異戊酸會加速心房顫動，而其他研究則報導血管功能改善。值得注意的是，白胺酸補充不會延長小鼠壽命，顯示白胺酸的改變不太可能是蛋白質限制益處的原因。

links.context: Loss of nigral dopamine in Parkinson's Disease disrupts the direct/indirect balance of medium spiny neuron pathways, producing the classic motor phenotype. The D1-MSN direct pathway facilitates movement while the D2-MSN indirect pathway suppresses it. This imbalance underlies the motor symptoms of Parkinson's Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，黑質多巴胺的喪失破壞了中型多棘神經元直接/間接途徑的平衡，產生典型的運動表型。D1-MSN 直接途徑促進運動，而 D2-MSN 間接途徑抑制運動。這種失衡是帕金森氏症運動症狀的基礎。

links.context: Luteolin can inhibit COMT at high supplemental doses because its catechol (flavone) ring competes for the enzyme's active site and for SAMe, slowing O-methylation of endogenous catechols. At dietary levels inhibition is minimal, but concentrated extracts may affect catechol metabolism and clearance. As a catechol flavonoid, luteolin is itself a COMT substrate, creating dose-dependent competition between its own metabolism and that of endogenous catecholamines. This dual role must be considered when using luteolin in slow COMT individuals.
links.context_zh_TW: Luteolin 在高補充劑量下可以抑制 COMT，因為其兒茶酚（黃酮）環競爭酶的活性位點和 SAMe，從而減緩內源兒茶酚的 O-甲基化。在飲食層面上，抑製作用很小，但濃縮萃取物可能會影響兒茶酚代謝和清除。作為 catechol flavonoid，木犀草素本身就是 COMT 底物，在其自身代謝與內源性 catecholamines 代謝之間產生劑量依賴性競爭。在緩慢的 COMT 個體中使用木犀草素時，必須考慮這種雙重作用。

links.context: Lymphopenia, an abnormally low circulating lymphocyte count, is a characteristic feature of severe SARS-CoV-2 infection. During the adaptive immune response, CD4+ and CD8+ T cell numbers decline dramatically while exaggerated pro-inflammatory cytokine production drives a pulmonary cytokine storm, making lymphopenia part of a maladaptive immune response rather than an isolated finding.
links.context_zh_TW: Lymphopenia（循環淋巴細胞數異常偏低）是嚴重 SARS-CoV-2 感染的特徵性表現。在適應性免疫反應期間，CD4+ 與 CD8+ T Cell 數量大幅下降，而過度產生的促發炎細胞激素驅動肺部細胞激素風暴，使 lymphopenia 成為適應不良免疫反應的一部分而非孤立現象。

links.context: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
links.context_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

links.context: Lysosomal lipolysis is primarily executed by lysosomal acid lipase. Requirement is the enzyme dependency.
links.context_zh_TW: 溶酶體脂解主要由溶酶體酸性脂肪酶執行。必要性是酶依賴。

links.context: MAPKAPK2 stabilises SASP transcripts, prolonging the half-life of cytokines, chemokines and matrix remodellers after transcription has been initiated. This post-transcriptional activity is what allows the secretome to persist in senescent cells: p38 to MK2 signalling keeps decay factors inactive so that ARE-containing SASP mRNAs accumulate. Inhibiting p38 or MK2, or silencing MK2, sharply reduces SASP factor secretion without reversing the DNA-damage-induced cell-cycle arrest, which is the pharmacological signature of a senomorphic rather than a senolytic intervention.
links.context_zh_TW: MAPKAPK2 穩定 SASP 轉錄本，在轉錄起始後延長細胞激素、趨化激素與基質重塑因子的半衰期。此轉錄後活性使 secretome 得以在衰老細胞中持續：p38 至 MK2 訊號使衰變因子維持不活化，含 ARE 的 SASP mRNA 因而累積。抑制 p38 或 MK2、或靜默 MK2，可大幅降低 SASP 因子分泌而不逆轉 DNA 損傷誘發的細胞週期停滯，這是 senomorphic 而非 senolytic 干預的藥理特徵。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: MEK1/2 dual-specificity kinases phosphorylate the ERK Thr+Tyr activation loop, refining the existing is_activated_by edge.
links.context_zh_TW: MEK1/2 雙特異性激酶磷酸化 ERK Thr+Tyr 活化環，細化既有的 is_activated_by 邊。

links.context: MET is a classic proto-oncogene aberrantly activated in cancer through gene amplification, activating mutations, overexpression, and autocrine/paracrine HGF loops. MET amplification also mediates acquired resistance to EGFR and ALK inhibitors in lung adenocarcinoma, and MET is targeted by approved tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
links.context_zh_TW: MET 是典型的原致癌基因，可透過基因擴增、活化突變、過度表現和自分泌/旁分泌 HGF 迴圈在癌症中異常活化。MET 擴增也在肺腺癌中介導對 EGFR 和 ALK 抑制劑的後天抗藥性，且 MET 已成為獲核准酪胺酸激酶抑制劑的靶點。

links.context: MFN2 mutations cause Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A by impairing the Miro/Milton/kinesin linkage that drives axonal mitochondrial transport, resulting in axonal mitochondrial depletion. The disease exemplifies how failure of the MFN2 transport axis compromises local ATP delivery and axonal mitochondrial integrity in peripheral neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: MFN2 突變可誘發 2A 型 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 疾病，機制是損害驅動軸突粒線體運輸的 Miro/Milton/kinesin 連結，導致軸突粒線體耗竭。此疾病凸顯 MFN2 運輸軸失效如何損害周邊神經元中的局部 ATP 供應與軸突粒線體完整性。

links.context: MLKL-driven plasma membrane rupture releases damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), which immune cells recognize to eliminate harmful cells and initiate repair. When the inflammatory response remains uncontrolled, this same mechanism drives pathology: cancer, Alzheimer's, parkinsonism, multiple sclerosis, pulmonary, liver, enteric, and cardiac diseases. MLKL-mediated DAMP release is therefore the mechanistic bridge between necroptosis as a host-defense program and necroinflammatory chronic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: MLKL 驅動的細胞膜破裂會釋出損傷相關分子模式（DAMP），免疫細胞藉此辨識並清除有害細胞、啟動修復。當發炎反應失控時，同一機制便成為病理推手：癌症、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、多發性硬化症、肺、肝、腸道與心臟疾病。MLKL 介導的 DAMP 釋放因此是「程序性壞死作為宿主防禦程序」與「壞死性發炎慢性疾病」之間的機制橋樑。

links.context: MTRR maintains the Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) cofactor of methionine synthase in its active reduced state, preventing the futile cycling that would halt methyl transfer. Every catalytic cycle of MTR carries a risk of oxidative inactivation of the B12 cofactor. MTRR preserves methylation flux by reducing the cobalt center.
links.context_zh_TW: MTRR 將 methionine synthase 的 Vitamin B12（鈷胺素）輔因子維持在活性的還原狀態，防止會停止甲基轉移的無效循環。MTR 的每個催化循環都有 B12 輔因子氧化失活的風險。MTRR 透過還原鈷中心來維持甲基化通量。

links.context: MTRR supports SAMe production indirectly by keeping methionine synthase active, thereby enabling homocysteine remethylation to methionine, the precursor of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. Adequate MTRR function thus preserves the methyl donor pool that COMT uses for catechol O-methylation. Its supportive role links B12 status and methylation cycle integrity to catecholamine metabolism. Variants in MTRR can constrain methylation capacity and indirectly slow COMT-dependent clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: MTRR 透過維持蛋氨酸合成酶活性來間接支持 SAMe 的生產，從而使同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，蛋氨酸是 SAMe 的前體，SAMe 是 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor。因此，足夠的 MTRR 功能保留了 COMT 用於兒茶酚 O-甲基化的 methyl donor 庫。其支持作用將 B12 狀態和 methylation cycle 完整性與兒茶酚胺代謝聯繫起來。 MTRR 的變體可以限制甲基化能力並間接減慢 COMT 依賴性清除。

links.context: Magnolol is the structural analog of honokiol, both being lipid-soluble polyphenolic lignans from Magnolia species. The two compounds show broadly overlapping pharmacology - both are positive allosteric modulators of GABA-A receptors, inhibit NMDA receptor signaling and NF-kappaB activation, protect neurons against beta-amyloid toxicity, and reduce inflammatory pain - but magnolol is generally slightly less potent or less selective, particularly for NMDA-driven responses where honokiol shows greater selectivity. The structural homology with the anesthetic propofol likely explains some shared pharmacologic actions.
links.context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚（magnolol）是和厚朴酚（honokiol）的結構類似物，兩者皆為來自木蘭屬（Magnolia）物種的脂溶性多酚木脂素。這兩種化合物展現大致重疊的藥理作用——兩者皆為 GABA-A 受體的正向異位調節劑、抑制 NMDA 受體訊息傳導與 NF-kappaB 活化、保護神經元免受 beta-類澱粉毒性，並減輕發炎性疼痛——但厚朴酚通常效力稍低或選擇性較差，尤其對於和厚朴酚展現較高選擇性的 NMDA 驅動反應。與麻醉劑異丙酚（propofol）的結構同源性可能解釋某些共享的藥理作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md

links.context: Metabotypes are reproducible, data-driven subgroups of individuals sharing a characteristic metabolic phenotype, identified by clustering high-throughput Metabolome profiling (LC-MS, NMR) with covariates such as genetics, microbiota, and lifestyle. The resulting strata reflect differences in enzyme activity, nutrient sensing, mitochondrial capacity, and substrate preference, and they shift dynamically with intervention, aging, or disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Metabotypes 是依據高通量 Metabolome 描繪（LC-MS、NMR）並結合基因遺傳、菌群與生活型態等協變數所叢集分析，得到的可重現資料驅動個體亞群，各群共享特定代謝表型。由此得到的分層反映酵素活性、營養感測、粒線體能力與受質偏好的差異，且會隨介入、衰老或疾病而動態改變。

links.context: MethylB12 feeds the production of SAMe, which COMT consumes as its methyl donor for catechol O-methylation. Individuals homozygous for slow COMT variants (Val158Met Met/Met) are unusually sensitive to high-dose methyl-donor supplementation. A sudden surge in methyl groups can over-drive catecholamine methylation, manifesting as anxiety or irritability.
links.context_zh_TW: MethylB12 供應 SAMe 的產生，COMT 消耗 SAMe 作為其兒茶酚 O-甲基化的 methyl donor。緩慢 COMT 變異（Val158Met Met/Met）純合子的個體對高劑量甲基供體補充劑異常敏感。甲基群的突然激增可能過度驅動兒茶酚胺甲基化，表現為焦慮或煩躁。

links.context: Methylene blue has several well-established off-label applications, including intraoperative staining to enhance visualization of structures such as the ureters, parathyroid glands, and sentinel lymph nodes during surgery, including sentinel lymph node mapping in breast cancer and other malignancies. For intraoperative lymph node mapping, 1 to 5 mL of 1 percent methylene blue is injected peritumorally, subareolarly, or pericervically depending on tumor type and anatomical site, and the dye migrates through lymphatic channels to allow visual identification of sentinel lymph nodes to guide surgical staging and resection.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue有幾個well-established的非標籤應用，包括術中染色以增強手術期間結構的可視化，如輸尿管、甲狀旁腺和前哨淋巴結，包括乳腺癌和其他惡性腫瘤中的前哨淋巴結定位。對於術中淋巴結定位，根據腫瘤類型和解剖部位，將1至5毫升1%的methylene blue注入瘤周、乳暈下或宮頸周圍，染料通過淋巴通道遷移，以實現前哨淋巴結的視覺識別，從而指導手術分期和切除。

links.context: Methylene blue is a potent inhibitor of monoamine oxidase, specifically MAO-A. This MAO-A inhibition means that combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications - such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), or certain pain relievers - can cause a life-threatening accumulation of serotonin (serotonin syndrome). This drug-interaction risk is a critical safety consideration when methylene blue is used clinically, particularly in the perioperative or critical-care setting.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue是單胺氧化酶的強效抑制劑，特別是MAO-A。這種MAO-A抑制意味著將methylene blue與血清素能藥物——如選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRIs）、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑（SNRIs）或某些止痛藥——結合使用可能導致危及生命的血清素積累（血清素症候群）。當methylene blue在臨床上使用時，這種藥物相互作用風險是關鍵的安全考慮因素，特別是在圍手术期或重症護理環境中。

links.context: Methylene blue is an investigational neuroprotective agent in neurologic conditions such as Alzheimer disease, Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, and ischemic stroke, based on preclinical and early clinical data. The mechanistic basis is its ability to bypass dysfunctional components of the mitochondrial electron transport chain by shuttling electrons from NADH in the presence of Complex I and donating them directly to cytochrome c, which enhances mitochondrial respiration, increases oxygen consumption, reduces mitochondrial superoxide production, and mitigates oxidative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍是一種研究中的神經保護劑，用於神經系統疾病如阿爾茨海默病、帕金森病、創傷性腦缺血和缺血性中風，基於臨床前和早期臨床數據。其機制基礎是它能通過穿梭電子從 NADH 在複合體 I 存在下繞過功能障礙的線粒體電子傳遞鏈組分，並直接捐贈給細胞色素 c，從而增強線粒體呼吸、增加氧氣消耗、減少線粒體超氧化物產生並緩解氧化應激。

links.context: Methylene blue is widely used off-label for the treatment of ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, the neurotoxicity associated with ifosfamide administration. For this indication, methylene blue is typically administered intravenously at a dosage of 50 mg every 4 hours until symptom resolution. This regimen is supported by case series and institutional experience, though dosing is individualized based on clinical response, with symptom resolution often occurring within 10 minutes to 24 hours.
links.context_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療異環磷醯胺誘導的腦病變，即與異環磷醯胺給藥相關的神經毒性。對於此適應症，亞甲基藍通常以 50 mg 劑量靜脈注射，每 4 小時一次，直至症狀緩解。此方案由案例系列和機構經驗支持，但劑量根據臨床反應個體化，症狀緩解通常在 10 分鐘至 24 小時內發生。

links.context: Methylfolate supplies the methyl-group pool that generates SAMe, which COMT consumes to inactivate catecholamines. High-dose methylfolate in slow COMT individuals can flood the cycle with methyl groups, accelerating catecholamine turnover and producing overmethylation symptoms. This is most pronounced when methylfolate is combined with MethylB12.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylfolate 供應產生 SAMe 的甲基群池，COMT 消耗 SAMe 來滅活兒茶酚胺。在緩慢的 COMT 個體中，高劑量 methylfolate 會使循環充滿甲基，加速兒茶酚胺代謝並產生過度甲基化症狀。當 methylfolate 與 MethylB12 合併使用時，這種情況最為明顯。

links.context: MicroRNAs bind Messenger RNA to control its stability, localization, and translation, together with other RNA-binding proteins and non-coding RNAs. Locked Nucleic Acid–based inhibitors exploit the same axis to repress mRNA translation or promote its degradation, which is why nucleic-acid senolytic and antisense strategies treat mRNA as their substrate.
links.context_zh_TW: MicroRNA 會與 Messenger RNA 結合，控制其穩定性、定位與轉譯，並與其他 RNA 結合蛋白及非編碼 RNA 協同作用。以 Locked Nucleic Acid 為基礎的抑制劑利用同一條軸線來抑制 mRNA 轉譯或促進其降解，因此核酸類 senolytic 與反義策略都把 mRNA 當作作用受質。

links.context: Mild, pulsed mitochondrial stress from brief caloric restriction, intense exercise, temperature extremes, or certain phytochemicals triggers a robust adaptive response that enhances cellular resilience, longevity, and metabolic efficiency. This occurs through upregulation of endogenous antioxidants and improved mitochondrial quality control. The acute stressor activates AMPK and PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis, leading to creation of new mitochondria while mitophagy clears old or dysfunctional ones, ultimately producing a highly efficient, resilient metabolic engine.
links.context_zh_TW: 來自短暫熱量限制、劇烈運動、溫度極端或某些植物化學物質的輕度、脈衝式粒線體壓力，觸發強大的適應性反應，增強細胞彈性、壽命和代謝效率。這透過內源性抗氧化劑的上調和改善的粒線體品質控制發生。急性壓力源活化 AMPK 和 PGC-1alpha（粒線體生物合成的主調節因子），導致新粒線體的產生，同時粒線體自噬清除老舊或功能失調的粒線體，最終產生高效、具彈性的代謝引擎。

links.context: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues. mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability, reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output. Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues。mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability，reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output。Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity。

links.context: Mitomycin C is a prototypical intra- plus interstrand crosslinker. Classification defines the drug.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitomycin C 是原型的鏈內加鏈間交聯劑。歸類定義藥物。

links.context: Modafinil is more effective in Val/Val (fast COMT) individuals because their constitutively lower prefrontal dopamine leaves greater room for improvement when modafinil raises dopamine by DAT inhibition, whereas slow COMT individuals already have high dopamine and benefit less or may be over-stimulated. This gene-drug interaction has been reported in both cognitive and clinical contexts, including effects on working memory and attention. It illustrates how COMT genotype predicts stimulant responsiveness. It is a leading example of COMT-guided psychopharmacology.
links.context_zh_TW: Modafinil 對 Val/Val（快 COMT）個體更有效，因為當莫達非尼透過 DAT 抑制提高多巴胺時，其組成型 lower prefrontal dopamine 留下了更大的改進空間，而慢 COMT 個體已經具有高多巴胺，受益較少或可能被過度刺激。這種基因-藥物交互作用已在認知和臨床環境中得到報告，包括對工作記憶和注意力的影響。它說明了 COMT genotype 如何預測興奮反應。它是 COMT 引導的精神藥理學的領先範例。

links.context: MyD88 is the central TIR-domain adaptor for all Toll-like receptors except TLR3, linking receptor engagement to IRAK4/IRAK1 and TRAF6. In senescence this couples DAMP sensing to NF-kB and SASP transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: MyD88 是除 TLR3 外所有 Toll-like 受體的核心 TIR 域銜接蛋白，將受體結合連結到 IRAK4/IRAK1 與 TRAF6。在衰老中，此將 DAMP 感知耦合到 NF-κB 與 SASP 轉錄。

links.context: NAD+ availability is the rate-limiting co-substrate for sirtuin activity and therefore determines how much Metabolic Flexibility a cell can sustain; reduced NAD+ availability impairs sirtuin function across all compartments. This is why NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside and Nicotinamide Mononucleotide, and caloric restriction that raises NAD+, are used to improve metabolic flexibility.
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+ 的可用性是 sirtuin 活性的速率限制性輔底物，因此決定了細胞能維持多少 Metabolic Flexibility；NAD+ 可用性下降會在所有胞器區隔中損害 sirtuin 功能。這也是為何會使用 Nicotinamide Riboside、Nicotinamide Mononucleotide 等 NAD+ 前驅物，以及能提升 NAD+ 的熱量限制來改善代謝靈活性。

links.context: NAD+ is the essential coenzyme that sirtuins use to repair DNA damage and stimulate mitochondrial biogenesis. NAD+ levels naturally follow a circadian rhythm, peaking in the morning, so NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR are recommended for morning intake within one hour of waking. Taking them in the evening can cause alertness or sleep disruption in some individuals, which would directly depress overnight HRV. Morning intake therefore aligns with the circadian rise of NAD+ and supports natural daytime energy cycles. The progressive decline in NAD+ levels during aging is a central metabolic bottleneck compromising sirtuin-dependent resilience. Reduced NAD+ availability compromises SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity, which regulate PGC-1α, FOXO, and NRF1 transcriptional programs governing antioxidant defenses, mitochondrial biogenesis and stress adaptation. NAD+ decline arises from both reduced biosynthetic capacity and increased degradation via CD38, PARP1 and SARM1. Restoration of NAD+ enhances UPRmt activity, and PARP inhibition can promote mitonuclear communication and UPRmt activation.
links.context_zh_TW: NAD+是sirtuins修復DNA損傷和刺激粒線體生物合成所必需的輔酶。NAD+水平自然遵循晝夜節律，早晨達到峰值，因此建議在醒來一小時內的早晨攝入NAD+前體如NMN和NR。在晚上攝入可能導致某些個體警覺性或睡眠中斷，這會直接降低夜間心率變異性（HRV）。因此早晨攝入與NAD+的晝夜上升一致，支持自然的白天能量週期。 衰老過程中NAD+水平的進行性下降是損害sirtuin依賴性恢復力的 central 代謝瓶頸。NAD+可用性降低損害SIRT1和SIRT3活性，它們調節PGC-1α、FOXO和NRF1轉錄程序， govern 抗氧化防禦、粒線體生物合成和壓力適應。NAD+下降源於生物合成能力降低以及透過CD38、PARP1和SARM1的降解增加。恢復NAD+增強UPRmt活性，而PARP抑制可促進粒線核通訊和UPRmt激活。

links.context: NET can be inhibited by drugs such as atomoxetine and methylphenidate, which raise both norepinephrine and dopamine in the prefrontal cortex. These NET inhibitors enhance attention and executive function, relevant to ADHD and the cognitive effects of Modafinil. Amphetamine-like compounds reverse NET transport, causing catecholamine efflux.
links.context_zh_TW: NET 可被 atomoxetine 和 methylphenidate 等藥物抑制，這些藥物會升高前額葉皮質中的 norepinephrine 和 dopamine。這些 NET 抑制劑增強注意力和 executive function，與 ADHD 和 Modafinil 的認知效應相關。安非他命類化合物會逆轉 NET 運輸，導致兒茶酚胺外流。

links.context: NF-kB is activated by p38 MAPK, which was the first kinase shown to drive NF-kB-mediated SASP independently of the DNA damage response. p38 MAPK integrates oxidative and stress signals and phosphorylates upstream kinases such as TAK1, which liberates NF-kB from its inhibitory complex and allows nuclear translocation. This provides a DDR-independent route to SASP activation, complementing the classical genotoxic pathway. The p38-NF-kB axis is a conserved, druggable SASP regulatory module, with p38 inhibitors shown to suppress the SASP from aged fibroblasts.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 被 p38 MAPK 活化，p38 MAPK 是首個被證實可驅動 NF-κB 介導 SASP 而獨立於 DNA 損傷反應的激酶。p38 MAPK 整合氧化與壓力訊號並磷酸化 TAK1 等上游激酶，將 NF-κB 從其抑制複合體釋放並允許核轉位。這提供一條獨立於 DDR 的 SASP 活化途徑，補充典型基因毒性路徑。p38-NF-κB 軸是保守、可藥物化的 SASP 調節模組，p38 抑制劑已顯示抑制年長纖維母細胞的 SASP。

links.context: NF-κB is the master transcription factor that activates the acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) and sustains the SASP in senescent cells. Upon senescence, IκBα is degraded in the cytoplasm and NF-κB subunits p65 and p50 translocate to the nucleus, driving expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines. Apigenin and the HSPA8 inhibitor VER155008 reverse this IκBα degradation and nuclear translocation, and GSEA confirms apigenin suppresses the NF-κB signature alongside the SASP signature. NF-κB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, and its estrogen-driven suppression gives premenopausal females a lower SASP burden. The sex-dependent SASP burden and its role in the post-menopausal 'estrogen cliff' connect the NF-κB and SASP sex-difference frameworks.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB是啟動急性壓力相關表型（ASAP）並維持衰老細胞SASP的主轉錄因子。衰老時，IκBα在細胞質中被降解，NF-κB亞基p65和p50易位至細胞核，驅動促炎細胞因子和趨化因子的表達。芹菜素和HSPA8抑制劑VER155008逆轉這種IκBα降解和核易位，GSEA證實芹菜素抑制NF-κB特徵以及SASP特徵。 NF-κB 是 SASP 的主要轉錄調控因子，其受雌激素驅動的壓抑使停經前女性具有較低的 SASP 負擔。性別依賴的 SASP 負擔及其在停經後「雌激素懸崖」中的角色，將 NF-κB 與 SASP 的性別差異架構相連結。

links.context: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin inflammasomes recruit pro-Caspase-1 via ASC for proximity-induced dimerization and activation — the scaffolded platform that determines pyroptotic versus inflammatory outcomes; Caspase-1 then cleaves pro-IL-1beta and IL-18 to their active cytokines.
links.context_zh_TW: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin 發炎體經 ASC 招募 pro-Caspase-1，進行鄰近誘導二聚化與活化——這是決定細胞焦亡或發炎結果的平台支架；Caspase-1 隨後把 pro-IL-1beta 與 IL-18 切割成熟為活性細胞激素。

links.context: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
links.context_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

links.context: Natural killer (NK) cells directly kill senescent cells through NKG2D recognition of stress-induced ligands MICA, MICB, and ULBP2 upregulated on the senescent surface. This antigen-independent cytotoxicity is a core component of senescence surveillance, and NK activity is enhanced by type-I interferons from cGAS-STING in the target cell. HLA-E upregulation can engage the inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 receptor to blunt this killing, illustrating immune evasion. The efficiency of NK-mediated killing declines with age, permitting senescent-cell accumulation.
links.context_zh_TW: 自然殺手（NK）細胞透過 NKG2D 辨識衰老表面上升的壓力誘發配體 MICA、MICB 與 ULBP2，直接殺死衰老細胞。此非抗原依賴的細胞毒性是衰老監視的核心組成，且 NK 活性被目標細胞中 cGAS-STING 產生的第一型干擾素增強。HLA-E 上升可接合抑制性 NKG2A/CD94 受體以減弱此殺死，說明免疫逃脫。NK 介導殺死的效率隨年齡下降，允許衰老細胞累積。

links.context: Navitoclax (ABT-263) is a potent BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W inhibitor classified as a senolytic with strong activity against senescent cells. Its mechanism directly targets the BCL-2 family SCAP dependence of arrested cells, inducing apoptosis by displacing pro-apoptotic BAX/BAK. Clinical use is limited by on-target thrombocytopenia due to platelet dependence on BCL-XL, which has driven the development of BCL-XL-sparing analogues. The classification is well established preclinically and in early translational studies.
links.context_zh_TW: Navitoclax（ABT-263）是一種強效 BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W 抑制劑，歸類為具強大抗衰老細胞活性的 senolytic。其機制直接標靶停滯細胞的 BCL-2 家族 SCAP 依賴，透過移位促凋亡 BAX/BAK 誘發凋亡。臨床使用受限於血小板依賴 BCL-XL 的標靶性血小板減少症，這促使保留 BCL-XL 的類似物開發。此分類在臨床前與早期轉譯研究中確立牢固。

links.context: Navitoclax (ABT-263) is a potent BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W inhibitor with strong senolytic activity, effectively inducing apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling their BCL-2-family SCAP dependence. It is limited clinically by on-target thrombocytopenia resulting from platelet dependence on BCL-XL, which has spurred development of more selective BCL-XL-sparing derivatives. Its senolytic efficacy is well established in multiple preclinical models, including oncogene-induced senescence and hematopoietic and lung contexts. The toxicity caveat shapes its use toward intermittent or tissue-targeted regimens, and it exemplifies both the power and the challenge of targeting the BCL-2 family for senolysis.
links.context_zh_TW: Navitoclax（ABT-263）是一種強效 BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W 抑制劑，具強大 senolytic 活性，透過失能其 BCL-2 家族 SCAP 依賴有效誘發衰老細胞凋亡。其臨床使用受限於血小板依賴 BCL-XL 所致的標靶性血小板減少症，這促使更具選擇性、保留 BCL-XL 的衍生物開發。其 senolytic 功效在多種臨床前模型（包括致癌基因誘發衰老與造血、肺脈絡）中確立。此毒性注意事項使其使用傾向間歇或組織標靶方案，並例示標靶 BCL-2 家族用於 senolysis 的威力與挑戰。

links.context: Navitoclax inhibits BCL-XL (along with BCL-2 and BCL-W), displacing pro-apoptotic BAK and permitting mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in senescent cells, thereby inducing apoptosis. This BCL-XL inhibition is also the cause of its dose-limiting thrombocytopenia, since platelets depend on BCL-XL for survival, and it makes navitoclax a potent senolytic against cells reliant on BCL-XL. The targeted inhibition exemplifies the SCAP-disabling senolytic principle. Selectivity tuning, such as BCL-XL-sparing analogues, is an active development area to retain efficacy while improving safety.
links.context_zh_TW: Navitoclax 抑制 BCL-XL（連同 BCL-2 與 BCL-W），移位促凋亡 BAK 並允許衰老細胞中粒線體外膜透化，從而誘發凋亡。此 BCL-XL 抑制也是其劑量限制性血小板減少症的原因，因血小板依賴 BCL-XL 存活，且使其成為對依賴 BCL-XL 細胞的強效 senolytic。此標靶抑制例示 SCAP 失能的 senolytic 原理。選擇性調整（如保留 BCL-XL 的類似物）是保留功效同時改善安全性的活躍開發領域。

links.context: Necroptosis is a NCCD-standard regulated death modality distinct from apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Necroptosis 是與凋亡不同的 NCCD 標準受調控死亡形式。

links.context: Nuclear p53 transcriptionally activates PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis), a BH3-only protein that binds and inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL. Because PUMA can act both as a direct activator of BAX/BAK and as a sensitizer that displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members, p53-PUMA signaling lowers the mitochondrial threshold for cytochrome c release. Cytoplasmic p53 additionally retains the ability to activate BAX and BAK directly.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞核內的 p53 會轉錄活化 PUMA（p53 上調凋亡調控因子），一種可結合並抑制抗凋亡 BCL-xL 的 BH3-only 蛋白。由於 PUMA 既能直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能作為置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員的敏化因子，p53-PUMA 訊號降低了粒線體釋出 cytochrome c 的門檻。此外，細胞質型的 p53 仍可直接活化 BAX 與 BAK。

links.context: OIS cells transmit senescence to neighbouring normal cells via secreted SASP factors (Acosta et al., 2013), triggering paracrine senescence that amplifies the arrested field. This spread reinforces the tumor-suppressive barrier but can also promote pathology if chronic, and it was demonstrated in vivo in mouse liver and human sessile serrated adenomas. The relationship establishes OIS as a source of transmissible arrest and is a landmark, citation-backed finding in senescence biology. TGF-beta family ligands are the major paracrine mediators.
links.context_zh_TW: OIS 細胞透過分泌 SASP 因子（Acosta 等人，2013）將衰老傳遞至鄰近正常細胞，觸發旁分泌衰老以放大停滯場域。此擴散強化腫瘤抑制屏障，但在慢性脈絡中也可促進病理。透過將停滯擴展到周圍，OIS 將局部癌前病灶轉化為廣泛的生長抑制區，增強其作為癌症防禦的有效性。它是衰老可傳播性的關鍵例證。

links.context: Oleacein carries a catechol (ortho-dihydroxyphenyl) moiety, making it a classic substrate for COMT O-methylation. It is itself O-methylated by the enzyme, consuming SAMe and methyl groups. This makes oleacein a catechol-bearing phenol that engages COMT as a substrate.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 帶有兒茶酚（鄰二羥苯基）部分，使其成為 COMT O-甲基化的典型受質。它本身會被酶 O-甲基化，消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。這使 oleacein 成為以受質身分接合 COMT 的含兒茶酚酚類。

links.context: Oleacein has anti-inflammatory properties, suppressing pro-inflammatory mediators and oxidative pathways, consistent with the bioactivity of olive-derived phenolic secoiridoids. These effects contribute to the cardioprotective and neuroprotective reputation of extra virgin olive oil and the Mediterranean diet. Oleacein's actions are independent of COMT inhibition, yet it nonetheless interacts with the enzyme as both substrate and inhibitor. Its anti-inflammatory profile is a focus of olive oil health research.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，可抑制促發炎介質和氧化途徑，與橄欖衍生酚類環烯醚萜的生物活性一致。這些作用增強了 extra virgin olive oil 和地中海飲食的心臟保護和神經保護聲譽。 Oleacein 的作用獨立於 COMT 抑制，但它仍作為底物和抑制劑與酵素相互作用。其抗發炎作用是橄欖油健康研究的重點。

links.context: Oleacein has antioxidant properties, scavenging reactive oxygen species and upregulating endogenous antioxidant defenses such as Nrf2-target genes, typical of olive phenolic compounds. This activity supports vascular and neuronal protection and underlies part of the Mediterranean diet's health benefits. Its catechol-like structure also makes it a COMT-interacting compound, serving as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is among the most abundant phenolic secoiridoids in extra virgin olive oil.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 具有 antioxidant properties，清除活性氧並上調內源性抗氧化防禦，例如 Nrf2 目標基因（典型的橄欖酚類化合物）。這種活性支持血管和神經元保護，是地中海飲食健康益處的一部分。其茶酚樣結構也使其成為 COMT 相互作用化合物，既可作為底物又可作為競爭性抑制劑。它是 extra virgin olive oil 中最豐富的酚類環環烯醚萜化合物之一。

links.context: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT, simultaneously competing with endogenous catechols for the active site. At sufficient intake, oleacein can slow the methylation and clearance of catecholamines such as dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. In slow-COMT individuals this competitive inhibition may further elevate synaptic catechol tone.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 COMT 的雙重受質-抑制劑，同時與內源性兒茶酚競爭活性位點。在足夠攝入量下，oleacein 可減緩 dopamine、epinephrine 和 norepinephrine 等兒茶酚胺的甲基化和清除。在緩慢-COMT 個體中，這種競爭性抑制可能進一步升高突觸兒茶酚張力。

links.context: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT: its phenolic structure is O-methylated by COMT as a substrate while simultaneously competing for the active site and for SAMe as an inhibitor, reducing clearance of other catechols. This bifunctional interaction means oleacein both feeds and partially blocks the COMT pathway, with the net effect depending on dose and on the individual's COMT genotype. It is a notable example of dietary polyphenols modulating catechol metabolism. Its olive oil source links diet to COMT-related biochemistry.
links.context_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT：其酚類結構被 COMT 作為底物 O-甲基化，同時競爭活性位點和 SAMe 作為抑制劑，減少其他兒茶酚的清除。這種雙功能交互作用意味著油酸素既供給又部分阻斷 COMT 途徑，淨效應取決於劑量和個體的 COMT genotype。這是膳食多酚調節兒茶酚代謝的一個顯著例子。其橄欖油來源將飲食與 COMT 相關的生物化學聯繫起來。

links.context: Oncosis is an accidental, energy-independent form of cell death within the broader category of necrosis, distinguished by a specific morphological sequence: ATP depletion from ischemia and hypoxia causes ion pump failure, sodium and water influx, oncotic cell swelling, increased membrane permeability from cytoskeletal and plasma membrane damage, and eventual lysis with inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: Oncosis 是廣義 Necrosis 類別中的一種非程序性、能量無關的細胞死亡形式，其特徵是特定形態學序列：Ischemia 與缺氧造成 ATP 耗竭，導致離子幫浦失效、鈉與水內流、細胞腫脹（oncotic swelling）、細胞骨架與細胞膜受損造成膜通透性上升，最終裂解並引起發炎。

links.context: Outside-in integrin signaling recruits focal adhesion kinase (FAK), paxillin, talin and kindlin, which organize actin stress fibers and activate RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT pathways. This pathway transduction governs cell migration, proliferation, and survival.
links.context_zh_TW: 由外而內的 integrin 訊號招募黏著斑激酶（FAK）、paxillin、talin 和 kindlin，組織肌動蛋白應力纖維並活化 RAS-MAPK 和 PI3K-AKT 途徑。這種途徑傳導調控細胞遷移、增殖和存活。

links.context: Oxidative Stress is the selective pressure that limits Metastatic colonization: micrometastases in distant niches experience high oxidative burden, so only cells with a sufficient antioxidant shield succeed. This constraint is why melanoma cells upregulate Selenocysteine biosynthesis and selenoprotein production in the metastatic niche.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 是限制 Metastatic colonization 的選汰壓力：遠端微環境中的微轉移灶承受高度氧化負擔，因此只有具備足夠抗氧化防護的細胞才能成功。這項限制正是黑色素瘤細胞在轉移微環境中上調 Selenocysteine 生合成與 selenoprotein 產量的原因。

links.context: PARG, together with ARH3, hydrolyzes PAR chains to free ADP-ribose. In parthanatos, PARG-dependent free-ADP-ribose generation is required for TRPM2 gating, whereas endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ release was PARG-independent.
links.context_zh_TW: PARG 與 ARH3 一起將 PAR 鏈水解成游離 ADP-ribose。在 parthanatos 中，TRPM2 的開啟需要 PARG 依賴的游離 ADPR 生成，而內質網的 Ca2+ 釋放則不依賴 PARG。

links.context: PUMA neutralizes the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL, freeing BAX and BAK to permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. Notably, PUMA is dual-function: it can act as a direct BAX/BAK activator (like Bid and Bim) or as a sensitizer (like Bad, Noxa, and Bik) that displaces Bcl-2-family restraint. This places p53-PUMA signaling at the point where transcriptional death decisions become mitochondrial permeabilization.
links.context_zh_TW: PUMA 會中和抗凋亡的 BCL-xL，釋放 BAX 與 BAK 以通透化粒線體外膜。值得注意的是 PUMA 具雙重功能：它既能像 Bid 與 Bim 一樣直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能像 Bad、Noxa 與 Bik 一樣作為敏化因子置換 Bcl-2 家族的抑制。這使 p53-PUMA 訊號正好位於轉錄層面的死亡決定轉換為粒線體通透化的節點。

links.context: Parthanatos is caspase-independent: z-VAD-fmk fails to block purified-PAR killing in neurons and HeLa or MNNG/NMDA death, and PAR does not directly activate caspases; it shows shrunken condensed nuclei with PI positivity rather than apoptotic bodies (Andrabi 2006; Andrabi 2008).
links.context_zh_TW: Parthanatos 为 caspase 非依赖：z-VAD 不能阻断纯化 PAR、MNNG/NMDA 杀伤，PAR 亦不直接激活 caspase；形态为皱缩浓缩核伴 PI 阳性而非凋亡小体。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

links.context: Patients with takotsubo present with chest pain, dyspnea, and ST-segment elevation or deep T-wave inversion on ECG — indistinguishable from ST-elevation Myocardial infarction. Modestly elevated Troponin is often discordant with the degree of wall-motion abnormality, and coronary angiography shows normal or non-obstructive coronaries, with characteristic apical ballooning on ventriculography or echocardiography.
links.context_zh_TW: Takotsubo 患者會出現胸痛、呼吸困難，以及 ECG 上的 ST 段上升或深 T 波倒置——與 ST 上升型 Myocardial infarction 難以區分。輕度升高的 Troponin 常與室壁運動異常的程度不一致，且冠狀動脈攝影顯示正常或非阻塞性冠狀動脈，心室造影或超音波則可見典型的頂端氣球狀（apical ballooning）變化。

links.context: Protein restriction activates GCN2, an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase triggered by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, suppressing global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key activator of stress response and autophagy genes. Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, and deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, while overexpression extends lifespan. During PR, GCN2 is initially required for FGF21 induction and also activates hepatic gluconeogenesis in response to decreased amino acid availability.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制活化GCN2，這是一個 evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase，由胺基酸限制透過未充電的tRNAs以及核糖體停滯和碰撞觸發。活化的GCN2磷酸化eIF2alpha，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性促進ATF4的翻譯，ATF4是壓力反應和自噬基因的關鍵活化因子。缺乏Gcn2的黑腹果蠅在胺基酸限制時死亡，酵母中Gcn2的缺失阻斷飲食限制壽命延長，而過表達則延長壽命。在PR期間，GCN2最初對FGF21誘導是必需的，並在胺基酸可用性降低時激活肝臟糖質新生。

links.context: Quercetin enhances EGCG bioavailability by inhibiting the metabolism and efflux of EGCG, increasing the proportion of the parent catechin available in its bioactive form. As a catechol flavonoid itself, quercetin may also compete for COMT, further slowing EGCG O-methylation and extending its exposure. The quercetin-EGCG combination is therefore studied for synergistic polyphenol effects on metabolism and oxidative stress. This interaction illustrates how co-ingested flavonoids modulate each other's pharmacokinetics.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 透過抑制 EGCG 的代謝和流出來增強 EGCG bioavailability，從而增加母體兒茶素以其生物活性形式提供的比例。作為 catechol flavonoid 本身，槲皮素也可能與 COMT 競爭，進一步減緩 EGCG O-甲基化並延長其暴露時間。因此，研究了槲皮素-EGCG 組合對代謝和氧化壓力的協同多酚效應。這種相互作用說明了共同攝取的黃酮類化合物如何調節彼此的藥物動力學。
links.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

links.context: Quercetin is a flavonoid senolytic that inhibits BCL-2 family anti-apoptotic proteins and PI3K/Akt survival signaling, and is combined with dasatinib in the D+Q regimen. It shows broad senolytic activity across cell types and synergizes with dasatinib, and its additional antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties complement its clearance action. Its inclusion in D+Q is supported by the landmark Zhu et al. (Nat Med 2015) study and subsequent clinical pilots. Quercetin exemplifies how a naturally occurring compound with multiple bioactivities became a cornerstone of senolytic therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是一種抑制 BCL-2 家族抗凋亡蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 存活訊號的類黃酮 senolytic，並與 dasatinib 合併於 D+Q 方案中。它展現跨細胞類型的廣泛 senolytic 活性並與 dasatinib 協同，且其額外抗氧化與抗發炎特性補充其清除作用。其納入 D+Q 獲 Zhu 等人（Nat Med 2015）里程碑研究及後續臨床試驗支持。Quercetin 例示一種具多種生物活性、天然存在且成為 senolytic 療法基石的化合物。

links.context: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for DLBCL.
links.context_zh_TW: R-CHOP 是 DLBCL 標準一線方案。

links.context: RSK is the canonical ERK effector kinase transducing MAPK output to survival and death substrates.
links.context_zh_TW: RSK 是典型的 ERK 效應激酶，將 MAPK 輸出傳遞至存活與死亡受質。

links.context: Rapamycin has emerged as a leading caloric restriction mimetic because its effects converge on the same nutrient-sensing pathways engaged by reduced nutrient intake. Caloric restriction has extended lifespans across yeast, flies and rodents, with significant results in primates, though evidence in humans is unclear. Suppression of mTORC1 by rapamycin reproduces the biochemistry of nutrient scarcity, and is theorized to shift cells from anabolic processes toward maintenance and repair, promoting autophagy and improved proteostasis - mechanisms associated with lifespan extension.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin已成為領先的熱量限制模擬物，因為其效果匯聚於與營養攝入減少相同的營養感知途徑。熱量限制已延長酵母、果蠅和囓齒動物的壽命，在靈長類動物中也有顯著結果，儘管在人類中的證據尚不清楚。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制再現了營養稀缺的生物化學，理論上將細胞從合成代謝過程轉向維護和修復，促進自噬和改善蛋白質恆定性——這些機制與壽命延長相關。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
