The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The directionality runs from MAPK toward Cancer, so MAPK is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由MAPK 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。方向性從 MAPK 朝向 Cancer，因此 MAPK 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by NFκB. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The directionality runs from NFκB toward Cancer, so NFκB is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 NFκB 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。方向性從 NFκB 朝向 Cancer，因此 NFκB 是活性劑，而 Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by PI3K. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Phosphoinositide 3-kinase generates PIP3 at the membrane to recruit and activate Akt, a central node of growth and survival signaling. The directionality runs from PI3K toward Cancer, so PI3K is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由PI3K 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。磷酸肌醇 3-激酶在膜上產生 PIP3，以募集並活化 Akt（生長和生存訊號傳導的中心節點）。方向性從 PI3K 朝向 Cancer，因此 PI3K 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by STAT3. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. STAT3 is a latent transcription factor activated by JAKs that drives proliferation, survival, and the inflammatory program of many tumors. The directionality runs from STAT3 toward Cancer, so STAT3 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 STAT3 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 STAT3 是一種由 JAK 活化的潛在轉錄因子，可驅動許多腫瘤的增殖、存活和發炎程序。方向性從 STAT3 朝向 Cancer，因此 STAT3 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by Wnt. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Wnt signaling is a conserved pathway controlling cell fate and stemness whose beta-catenin arm is aberrantly activated in many cancers. The directionality runs from Wnt toward Cancer, so Wnt is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由Wnt 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。訊號傳導是控制細胞命運和乾性的保守途徑，其β-連環蛋白臂在許多癌症中被異常活化。方向性從 Wnt 朝向 Cancer，因此 Wnt 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by YAP1. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. The directionality runs from YAP1 toward Cancer, so YAP1 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由YAP1 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 YAP1 朝向 Cancer，因此 YAP1 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is driven by mTOR. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. mTOR is a nutrient- and growth-factor-sensitive kinase that integrates PI3K/Akt inputs to control protein synthesis and cell growth. The directionality runs from mTOR toward Cancer, so mTOR is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由mTOR 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 mTOR 是一種營養和生長因子敏感激酶，可整合 PI3K/Akt 輸入來控制蛋白質合成和細胞生長。方向性從 mTOR 朝向 Cancer，因此 mTOR 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is linked to Oxidative Stress. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Oxidative stress arises from an imbalance of reactive oxygen species and inflicts DNA, protein, and lipid damage that can initiate and promote malignancy. The directionality runs from Oxidative Stress toward Cancer, so Oxidative Stress is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 連結到Oxidative Stress。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Oxidative Stress 由活性氧失衡引起，會造成 DNA、蛋白質和脂質損傷，進而引發和促進惡性腫瘤。方向性從 Oxidative Stress 朝向 Cancer，因此 Oxidative Stress 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer is suppressed by BRCA. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. The directionality runs from BRCA toward Cancer, so BRCA is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 被 BRCA 抑制。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。方向性從 BRCA 朝向 Cancer，因此 BRCA 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: Cancer is suppressed by p53. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward Cancer, so p53 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 被p53 抑制。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 向 Cancer，因此 p53 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: Cancer is suppressed by senescence, which halts the proliferation of damaged and oncogene-stressed cells and acts as an intrinsic barrier to malignant transformation. This tumor-suppressive role is evident in benign neoplasms such as melanocytic nevi and after cytotoxic therapy, where arrest removes cells from the replicative pool. By inducing durable cell-cycle exit and recruiting immune clearance through the SASP, senescence constrains clonal expansion of pre-malignant cells. The protective directionality holds acutely, although chronic senescence with persistent SASP can become tumor-promoting, illustrating the context-dependent duality of the senescence program.
links.context_zh_TW: 癌症被衰老抑制，衰老停止受損與致癌基因受壓細胞的增殖，作為對惡性轉化的內在屏障。此腫瘤抑制角色在如黑色素細胞痣等良性腫瘤與細胞毒性治療後明顯，其中停滯將細胞移出複製池。透過誘發持久細胞週期退出並經 SASP 招募免疫清除，衰老限制癌前細胞的克隆擴張。保護性方向性在急性期成立，儘管伴隨持續 SASP 的慢性衰老可轉為促腫瘤，說明衰老程序依脈絡的雙重性。

links.context: Cancer is treated by BET inhibitors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. The directionality runs from BET inhibitors toward Cancer, so BET inhibitors is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 BET inhibitors 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。方向性從 BET inhibitors 朝向 Cancer，因此 BET inhibitors 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer is treated by BH3 mimetics. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Cancer, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由BH3 mimetics 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從BH3 mimetics 向Cancer 延伸，因此BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer is treated by Cisplatin. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Cisplatin is a platinum compound that forms intra- and inter-strand DNA crosslinks, triggering damage responses that can culminate in senescence or death. The directionality runs from Cisplatin toward Cancer, so Cisplatin is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Cisplatin 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Cisplatin 是一種鉑化合物，可形成鏈內和鏈間 DNA 交聯，引發損傷反應，最終導致老化或死亡。方向性從 Cisplatin 朝向 Cancer，因此 Cisplatin 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer is treated by docetaxel. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Docetaxel is a taxane that stabilizes microtubules, arresting mitosis and inducing cell death in a range of carcinomas. The directionality runs from docetaxel toward Cancer, so docetaxel is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 docetaxel 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。多西紫杉醇是一種紫杉烷，可穩定微管、阻止有絲分裂並誘導多種癌症的細胞死亡。方向性從 docetaxel 朝向 Cancer，因此 docetaxel 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer is treated by trastuzumab. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward Cancer, so trastuzumab is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 由 trastuzumab 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 Cancer，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Cancer shares epigenetic features with Aging. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Aging is the foremost non-modifiable risk factor for cancer, reflecting accumulated mutations, epigenetic drift, and a senescence-shaped microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Aging rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer 與 Aging 具有相同的表觀遺傳特徵。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Aging是癌症最重要的不可改變的危險因素，反映了累積的突變、表觀遺傳漂變和老化形成的微環境。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Aging 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling stabilizes β-catenin: Wnt ligand binding Frizzled/LRP receptors inhibits the β-catenin destruction complex, allowing β-catenin to accumulate and translocate to the nucleus, where TCF/LEF transcription factors turn it into a transcriptional activator. This stabilization sustains stemness, proliferation, and fate decisions in the responding cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 典型 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號可穩定 β-catenin：Wnt 配體結合 Frizzled/LRP 受體後抑制 β-catenin 破壞複合體，使 β-catenin 得以累積並轉位進入細胞核，由 TCF/LEF 轉錄因子將其轉化為轉錄活化因子。這種穩定化維持了受應細胞的幹性、增殖與命運決定。

links.context: Capsaicin from chili peppers induces a stimulatory hormetic response by activating transient receptor potential (TRP) channels. Downstream effects include increased thermogenesis, improved mitochondrial function and insulin sensitivity, and reduced risk of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 來自辣椒的 Capsaicin 透過活化 transient receptor potential (TRP) channels 引發興奮性 hormesis 反應。下游效應包括產熱增加、粒線體功能與胰島素敏感性改善，以及肥胖、第二型糖尿病與心血管疾病風險降低。

links.context: Carbazochrome is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone ('is_derivative_of', conf 0.95), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to make a relatively chemically inactive derivative — resolving the Round-2 amplifier-conflict ticket as an evidence-based null for carbazochrome redox-cycling at Complex I.
links.context_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（「is_derivative_of」，conf 0.95），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成的一種相對化學惰性衍生物——把第二輪放大器衝突票裁定為 carbazochrome 在 Complex I 氧化還原循環的以證據為基礎的空結果。

links.context: Carbonylated proteins are degraded by the 20S proteasome, which recognizes their unfolded, oxidized structure and degrades them independently of ubiquitin. This removes damaged proteins before they aggregate or lose function. The directionality is oxidized protein to proteasomal clearance. A caveat is that severe oxidation can form cross-links that resist degradation and instead promote aggregates, especially in aging and neurodegeneration. Because 20S degradation is ATP- and ubiquitin-independent, it provides a rapid, energy-sparing route for clearing mildly oxidized proteins.
links.context_zh_TW: Carbonylated proteins 被 20S proteasome 降解，20S proteasome 識別其未折疊的氧化結構並獨立於泛素進行降解。這可以在損壞的 proteins 聚集或失去功能之前將其刪除。方向性是氧化蛋白到蛋白酶體清除。需要注意的是，嚴重氧化會形成 cross 連接，從而抵抗降解並促進聚集，特別是在 aging 和 neurodegeneration 中。由於 20S 降解不依賴 ATP 和泛素，因此它提供了一個快速、節能的途徑來清除輕度氧化的 proteins。

links.context: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

links.context: Carotenoids quench singlet oxygen by physical energy transfer from the triplet state of the sensitizer, a capacity that requires at least nine conjugated double bonds - which excludes phytoene and phytofluene. This is a non-radical antioxidant route distinct from radical trapping: carotenoids do not donate hydrogen to lipid peroxyl radicals the way tocopherols do, they physically deactivate an excited sensitizer. Within membrane lipid domains, beta-carotene, alpha-carotene and lycopene in the orange pericarp of Queen Palm and the mesocarp of Red Palm Oil act as direct singlet-oxygen quenchers.
links.context_zh_TW: Carotenoids 透過從敏化劑三重態進行物理能量轉移來 quench Singlet Oxygen，此能力需要至少九個共軛雙鍵，因此 phytoene 與 phytofluene 不具此能力。這是一條與自由基捕捉不同的非自由基抗氧路徑：類胡蘿蔔素不像 tocopherols 那樣把氫原子 donate 給脂質過氧自由基，而是物理性地去活化一個受激的敏化劑。在膜脂質區域中，Queen Palm 的橙色果皮與 Red Palm Oil 的中果皮所含的 beta-carotene、alpha-carotene 與 lycopene 都是直接的 singlet-oxygen quenchers。

links.context: Caspase-1 is the effector protease of the inflammasome pathway: when activated by the NLRP3 inflammasome (or by the AIM2 inflammasome via ASC specks), it proteolytically cleaves Interleukin 1β from its inactive precursor into its mature, secreted, active form.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-1 是發炎小體路徑的效應蛋白酶：當它被 NLRP3 Inflammasome（或經由 ASC 斑塊的 AIM2 Inflammasome）活化時，會將 Interleukin 1β 由不活性前驅物蛋白水解切割成成熟、可分泌的活性形式。

links.context: Caspase-10 activates Caspase-3. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-10 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-10 啟動 Caspase-3。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-10 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-10 activates Caspase-7. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspase-7 is an executioner caspase closely related to caspase-3 that contributes to the proteolytic demolition of the cell. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-10 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-7 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-10 啟動 Caspase-7。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。 Caspase-7 是一種與 caspase-3 密切相關的劊子手 caspase，有助於細胞的蛋白水解破壞。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-10 充當 Caspase-7 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

links.context: Caspase-10 is activated at DISC. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The directionality runs from DISC toward Caspase-10, so DISC is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-10 在 DISC 啟動。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。方向性從 DISC 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 DISC 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-12 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-12, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-12 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

links.context: Caspase-12 is activated by Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. links.context: Caspase-3 (with caspase-7) cleaves full-length 116-kDa PARP1 at Asp214/Gly215, separating the DNA-binding from the catalytic domain and releasing the 89-kDa C-terminal p89 fragment. links.context: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. links.context: Caspase-3 is inhibited by XIAP. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. links.context: Caspase-4 is a human inflammatory (non-canonical) caspase that senses cytosolic Gram-negative bacterial LPS through its CARD, inducing oligomerization and auto-cleavage. links.context: Caspase-5 is a human inflammatory caspase that oligomerizes and auto-cleaves in response to cytosolic danger signals such as microbial products. links.context: Caspase-7 (CMH-1, ICE-LAP3) is an executioner (effector) protease, synthesized as an inactive procaspase-7 with p20 and p10 catalytic subunits. links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-7（CMH-1、ICE-LAP3）是執行者（效應）蛋白酶，以含 p20 與 p10 催化次單元的不活化 procaspase-7 形式合成。它與 Caspase-3 功能冗餘，但具有不同的受質偏好與上游調控，並在內質網壓力與特定組織情境中扮演不可替代的角色。

links.context: Caspase-8 activates Caspase-3: as the initiator caspase of the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, DISC-assembled caspase-8 (with caspase-10) directly cleaves the executioner Caspase-3 in type I cells, while in type II cells it cleaves Bid to route through mitochondria. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Caspase-8, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-8 被 SRC kinase 抑制。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。 SRC 是一種非受體酪胺酸激酶，可促進存活，尤其是磷酸化 caspase-8 和 Bik 並使其失去活性。方向性從 SRC kinase 朝向 Caspase-8，因此 SRC kinase 是活性劑，Caspase-8 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: Caspase-8 is restored by SHP1. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. SHP1 is a protein tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and reactivates caspase-8, restoring death-receptor-induced apoptosis. The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Caspase-8, so SHP1 is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-8 由 SHP1 恢復。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。 SHP1 是一種蛋白質酪胺酸磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並重新活化 caspase-8，恢復死亡受體誘導的細胞凋亡。方向性從 SHP1 朝向 Caspase-8，因此 SHP1 是主動主體，Caspase-8 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-9 activates Caspase-3. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-9 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 啟動 Caspase-3。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-9 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-9 is activated at Apoptosome. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The directionality runs from Apoptosome toward Caspase-9, so Apoptosome is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 在 Apoptosome 啟動。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。方向性從 Apoptosome 向 Caspase-9，因此 Apoptosome 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Caspase-9 is inhibited by Akt. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward Caspase-9, so Akt is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 Akt 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 Caspase-9，因此 Akt 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: Caspase-9 is inhibited by XIAP. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Caspase-9, so XIAP is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 XIAP 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 XIAP 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: Caspase-9, the intrinsic-pathway initiator, cleaves procaspase-7 at specific Asp residues to release the active (p20)2(p10)2 heterotetramer, after which Caspase-7 dismantles the cell by cleaving substrates such as ICAD, PARP and lamin B1. Caspase-8 provides the extrinsic-pathway route to the same activation step.
links.context_zh_TW: 內在性路徑的起始 caspase Caspase-9 會在特定 Asp 殘基切割 procaspase-7，釋出活性的 (p20)2(p10)2 異四聚體，隨後 Caspase-7 藉由切割 ICAD、PARP 與 lamin B1 等受質拆解細胞。Caspase-8 則提供通往同一活化步驟的外在性路徑。

links.context: Catalase deficiency causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), a rare autosomal recessive disorder in which near-absent catalase activity leads to oral mucosal ulcers and periodontal destruction from accumulated H2O2. The pathology arises because bacterial metabolism in the mouth produces H2O2 that cannot be degraded, fostering gangrene-prone infections. The directionality is enzyme loss to local oxidative injury. A caveat is that many acatalasemic individuals are surprisingly asymptomatic, indicating redundancy from other peroxide-removing systems.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase deficiency 會導致 acatalasemia（高原氏症），這是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，幾乎不存在 catalase 活性，導致口腔黏膜潰瘍和累積的 H2O2 造成牙周破壞。這種病理現象的產生是因為口腔中的細菌代謝產生無法降解的 H2O2，促進壞疽感染。方向性是酵素損失導致局部氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多 acatalasemic 個體出乎意料地沒有症狀，這表明其他過氧化物去除系統存在冗餘。
links.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

links.context: Catalase downregulation contributes to cancer because reduced H2O2 clearance permits sustained oxidative stress that can drive DNA damage, genomic instability, and altered redox signaling favoring proliferation. Catalase is frequently downregulated in breast, prostate, and hepatocellular carcinomas relative to normal tissue. The directionality is loss-of-defense promoting tumorigenic oxidative damage. A caveat is that many tumors also exploit moderate ROS for survival signaling, so catalase levels represent a context-dependent balance rather than a simple tumor suppressor.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase downregulation 有助於 cancer，因為減少的 H2O2 清除允許持續的 oxidative stress，從而驅動 DNA damage、基因組不穩定性和有利於增殖的氧化還原訊號傳導改變。相對於正常組織，Catalase 在乳癌、prostate 和肝細胞癌中經常下調。方向性是防禦喪失促進致瘤性氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多腫瘤也利用適度的 ROS 來發出生存訊號，因此 catalase 水平代表了情境依賴性平衡，而不是簡單的腫瘤抑制因子。
links.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

links.context: Catalase is localized predominantly in peroxisomes, organelles that host numerous H2O2-generating oxidases involved in lipid beta-oxidation and purine catabolism. Concentrating catalase here minimizes leakage of peroxide into the cytosol and nucleus. The directionality reflects compartmentalization of both source and sink of H2O2. A caveat is that a minority of catalase activity also exists in cytosol and mitochondria in some tissues, providing additional but lesser protection. This compartmentalization is functionally important: peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids generates substantial H2O2, and catalase prevents that peroxide from spilling into the cytosol.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase 主要位於 peroxisomes 細胞器中，該細胞器含有大量參與脂質 β 氧化和嘌呤分解代謝的產生 H2O2 的氧化酶。在此濃縮 catalase 可最大程度地減少過氧化物洩漏到細胞質和細胞核。方向性反映了 H2O2 源和彙的劃分。需要注意的是，少數 catalase 活性也存在於某些組織的細胞質和 mitochondria 中，提供額外但較少的保護。這種區室化在功能上很重要：極長鏈脂肪酸的過氧化物酶體 β 氧化會產生大量 H2O2，而 catalase 可以防止過氧化物溢出到細胞質中。

links.context: Catalase is presented as an endogenous antioxidant defense that detoxifies hydrogen peroxide generated after ischemic events. Its activity falls during OGD and is restored by Brosimine B in parallel with reduced ROS and improved viability. The paper cites dose-dependent catalase protection in HT-1080 oxygen-deprivation cultures as precedent.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase 被視為解毒缺血事件後生成之過氧化氫的內源性抗氧化防禦。其活性在 OGD 期間下降，並隨 Brosimine B 處理而恢復，同時伴隨 ROS 下降與存活率改善。本文引用 HT-1080 缺氧培養中 catalase 劑量依賴性保護作為先例。

links.context: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
links.context_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

links.context: Cataract is the opacification of the eye's crystalline lens, and its formation is driven by cumulative oxidative damage: thiol oxidation, protein carbonylation, and AGE-mediated glycation unfold and cross-link Lens Crystallins, which then aggregate and scatter light. Because the lens has minimal protein turnover, the damage accumulates irreversibly.
links.context_zh_TW: Cataract（白內障）是眼睛晶狀體的混濁，其形成由累積的氧化性傷害驅動：硫醇氧化、protein carbonylation（蛋白質羰基化）與 AGE 介導的糖化使 Lens Crystallins（晶狀體晶 crystallin 蛋白）展開並交聯，隨後聚集並散射光線。由於晶狀體的蛋白質周轉率極低，傷害會不可逆地累積。

links.context: Catechin is a flavan-3-ol member of the Flavonoids, abundant in green tea, cocoa, and fruits, with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. It is also a monomeric building block of the polymeric proanthocyanidins and belongs to the natural-polyphenol STAC family that activates SIRT1.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechin 是 Flavonoids（黃酮類）中 flavan-3-ol 家族的成員，富含於綠茶、可可與水果，具有抗氧化與抗發炎活性。它也是聚合 proanthocyanidins 的單體構成單元，並屬於可活化 SIRT1 的天然多酚 STAC 家族。

links.context: Catechol (1,2-dihydroxybenzene) is the parent ortho-diphenol scaffold of the Catecholamines class, which includes dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine; the same ring oxidation chemistry that converts catechol to o-benzoquinones also governs epinephrine oxidation to adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechol（兒茶酚，1,2-二羥基苯）是 Catecholamines（兒茶酚胺）類的母體鄰二酚骨架，該類包含 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine；將 catechol 氧化為 o-benzoquinone 的同一環氧化化學，也主導 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome。

links.context: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) is a primary enzyme in catecholamine metabolism that methylates one of the catechol hydroxyl groups of epinephrine, converting it to metanephrine using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor. COMT-mediated methylation is one of the two dominant routes for terminating adrenaline signaling and preparing it for excretion, alongside MAO-mediated oxidative deamination. Because COMT clears adrenaline rapidly, the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome remains a minor side pathway under normal conditions. Inhibiting COMT raises catecholamine levels and can shift a greater proportion of epinephrine toward oxidative conversion to adrenochrome.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）是兒茶酚胺代謝中的主要酶，它甲基化 epinephrine 的其中一個兒茶酚羥基，使用 S-adenosylmethionine 作為甲基供體將其轉化為 metanephrine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 訊號並為其排泄做準備的兩大主要途徑之一，與 MAO 介導的氧化脫胺並行。由於 COMT 迅速清除 adrenaline，epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome 在正常條件下仍是次要的旁路。抑制 COMT 會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可使更大比例的 epinephrine 轉向氧化轉化為 adrenochrome。

links.context: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) methylates the catechol ring of catecholamines using S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) as the methyl donor. In this reaction SAM transfers a methyl group to one of the adjacent hydroxyl groups of epinephrine, producing metanephrine and S-adenosylhomocysteine. COMT-mediated methylation is one of the dominant routes for terminating adrenaline and dopamine signaling. COMT inhibition can raise SAM levels while MAO inhibition may lower them, and the balance of these effects depends on the specific inhibitors used. This methylation pathway keeps adrenochrome formation a minor route under normal metabolic conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）使用 S-adenosylmethionine（SAM）作為甲基供體，甲基化兒茶酚胺的兒茶酚環。在此反應中，SAM 將一個甲基轉移至 epinephrine 的相鄰羥基之一，產生 metanephrine 與 S-adenosylhomocysteine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 與多巴胺訊號的主要途徑之一。COMT 抑制可升高 SAM 濃度，而 MAO 抑制可能降低之，這些效應的平衡取決於所使用的特定抑制劑。此甲基化途徑在正常代謝條件下使 adrenochrome 形成維持為次要路線。

links.context: Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy is acute or subacute myocardial injury and systolic dysfunction driven by sustained supraphysiologic excess of Catecholamines, particularly norepinephrine. It presents classically as stress (Takotsubo) cardiomyopathy or as pheochromocytoma-associated cardiomyopathy, and histologically shows contraction-band necrosis without dominant coronary occlusion.
links.context_zh_TW: Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy（兒茶酚胺誘發性心肌病變）是由持續過高的 Catecholamines（尤其是 norepinephrine）所驅動的急性或亞急性心肌損傷與收縮功能障礙。典型表現為壓力性（Takotsubo）心肌病變或 pheochromocytoma 相關心肌病變，組織學上呈現收縮帶壞死而無主要冠狀動脈阻塞。

links.context: Catecholamines and Dopamine are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Catecholamines and Dopamine may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Catecholamines 和 Dopamine 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Catecholamines 和 Dopamine 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, one of the most overlooked molecules in modern medicine, is not a spectator.md

links.context: Catechols are the primary substrates for COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase), which transfers a methyl group from SAMe to one hydroxyl of the catechol ring to yield a less reactive, more excretable O-methylated metabolite. This O-methylation is a major inactivation and detoxification route in the liver and brain for endogenous catecholamines and exogenous catechol compounds. Because COMT activity is genetically variable via the Val158Met polymorphism, the rate of catechol clearance differs across individuals.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechols 是 COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）的主要受質，該酶將甲基從 SAMe 轉移至兒茶酚環上的一個羥基，產生反應性較低、更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。此 O-甲基化是肝臟和 brain 中內源性兒茶酚胺和外源性兒茶酚化合物代謝與解毒的主要途徑。由於 COMT activity 會因 Val158Met 多態性而具有遺傳變異，因此不同個體間兒茶酚清除速率有所差異。

links.context: Catechols include the catecholamine neurotransmitters dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine, which are the body's principal sympathoadrenergic messengers. Each of these is in part terminated by COMT-mediated O-methylation to metanephrines and normetanephrines. This makes the catechol class central to both endogenous signaling and xenobiotic metabolism.
links.context_zh_TW: Catechols 包含兒茶酚胺神經傳導物質多巴胺、腎上腺素和去甲腎上腺素，它們是人體主要的交感腎上腺能訊息傳遞者。每一種都部分透過 COMT 介導的 O-甲基化終止為間甲腎上腺素和去甲變腎上腺素。這使得兒茶酚類在內源性訊號傳導和異生物質代謝中都至關重要。

links.context: Cathepsin L1 (CTSL), a lysosomal cysteine protease, cleaves the N-terminal tail of the replication-independent histone variant H3.3 during chromatin remodeling and DNA-damage responses. This tail clipping erases post-translational modifications that control cell-cycle regulators, altering the chromatin landscape at senescence loci.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsin L1（CTSL）為溶酶體半胱胺酸蛋白酶，會在染色質重塑與 DNA 傷害反應期間切割複製非依賴型組蛋白變異體 H3.3 的 N 端尾部。此尾部切割會抹除調控細胞週期相關因子的轉譯後修飾，改變衰老基因座周圍的染色質景觀。

links.context: Cathepsins are a family of cysteine, aspartic and serine proteases primarily localized to lysosomes, where they mediate bulk protein degradation and amino acid recycling. They are optimally active at the acidic pH (4.5-5.5) of the lysosomal lumen and are synthesized as inactive zymogens whose propeptide is removed on arrival in the compartment.
links.context_zh_TW: Cathepsins 是一群主要定位於 Lysosome 的半胱胺酸、天門冬胺酸與絲胺酸蛋白酶，在其中執行大規模蛋白降解與胺基酸回收。它們在溶小體腔的酸性 pH（4.5–5.5）下活性最佳，並以無活性的 zymogen 形式合成，其 propeptide 在到達該區室時被切除。

links.context: Caudate Nucleus and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Caudate Nucleus and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Caudate Nucleus 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Caudate Nucleus 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
links.context_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

links.context: Cell Division, in which a parent cell yields two or more daughter cells, is tightly governed by the Cell Cycle, with checkpoints ensuring accuracy of DNA replication and chromosome segregation. Key regulators include cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb/E2F, p53, and checkpoint kinases; dysregulated division is a hallmark of cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Cell Division（細胞分裂，親代細胞產生兩個或更多子細胞）受到 Cell Cycle 的嚴密調控，並由檢查點確保 DNA 複製與染色體分離的正確性。主要調控因子包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb/E2F、p53 與檢查點激酶；失調的細胞分裂是 cancer 的特徵之一。

links.context: Cellular reprogramming erases somatic DNA methylation and other epigenetic marks to reset the cell to a pluripotent state. During iPSC generation, the Yamanaka factors promote active and passive demethylation of pluripotency gene promoters while somatic gene methylation is lost, and this global epigenetic reset is required for establishing the pluripotency gene network. The erasure of DNA methylation is a defining feature of the stochastic and deterministic phases of reprogramming. This epigenetic reset is what enables a differentiated cell to regain full developmental potential.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞重編程會消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化和其他表觀遺傳標記，從而將細胞重置為多能狀態。在 iPSC 生成過程中，山中因子促進多能性基因啟動子主動和被動去甲基化，同時體細胞基因甲基化丟失，這種全局表觀遺傳重置是建立多能性基因網絡所必需的。 DNA 甲基化的消除是重編程隨機階段和確定性階段的決定性特徵。這種表觀遺傳重置使分化細胞能夠重新獲得全部發育潛力。

links.context: Cellular reprogramming is fundamentally an epigenetic remodeling process that erases somatic memory and installs a new cellular identity. Reprogramming requires global erasure of somatic DNA methylation, reconfiguration of histone marks, and resetting of the chromatin landscape at pluripotency loci, driven by pioneer factors and chromatin remodelers. The process proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, and culminates in the establishment of a stable pluripotent state in induced pluripotent stem cells.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞重編程從根本上來說是一種表觀遺傳重塑過程，它會消除體細胞記憶並安裝新的細胞身份。重編程需要在先鋒因子和染色質重塑因子的驅動下，全面消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化、重新配置組蛋白標記以及重置多能性位點的染色質景觀。這個過程經歷確定的階段，包括間質到上皮的轉變，並最終在誘導多能幹細胞中建立穩定的多能狀態。

links.context: Cellular senescence is characterized by the SASP, the secretion of a complex mixture of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, and proteases. Together with irreversible cell cycle arrest and the formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci, the SASP defines the senescent phenotype and mediates its effects on the tissue environment. The SASP is a double-edged sword, promoting tumor surveillance and wound healing when acute but driving inflammation and tissue dysfunction when senescent cells accumulate.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞老化的特徵是 SASP，即促發炎細胞因子、趨化因子、生長因子和蛋白酶的複雜混合物的分泌。與不可逆的細胞週期停滯和衰老相關異染色質灶的形成一起，SASP 定義了衰老表型並介導其對組織環境的影響。 SASP 是一把雙面刃，在急性時促進腫瘤監測和傷口癒合，但在老化細胞累積時引發發炎和組織功能障礙。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: Centenarian SIRT6 variants ameliorate multiple aging phenotypes in progerin-expressing hMSCs, including higher Ki67, reduced SA-β-gal, decreased p16/p21, reduced IL-6, and increased Lamin B1. Directionally, CentSIRT6 sits upstream of progerin-stress resistance. This shows the variant buffers premature-aging pathology and ties SIRT6 to laminopathy resilience. By maintaining proliferation, reducing senescence markers, and lowering inflammatory output in progerin-stressed cells, the variants counteract key features of Hutchinson-Gilford progeria. These findings support SIRT6-boosting strategies for laminopathy and related premature-aging conditions.
links.context_zh_TW: 百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體改善了表達 progerin 的 hMSC 的多種衰老表型，包括較高的 Ki67、較低的 SA-β-gal、減少的 p16/p21、降低的 IL-6 和增加的 Lamin B1。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 位於抗 progerin 壓力的上游。這表明變異體緩衝早衰病理並將 SIRT6 與核纖層蛋白病抗性聯繫起來。透過在 progerin 壓力下的細胞中維護增殖、減少衰老標誌物和降低發炎輸出，變異體對抗了 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症的關鍵特徵。這些發現支持提升 SIRT6 的策略用於核纖層蛋白病和相關早衰疾病。

links.context: Centenarian-associated SIRT6 variants (N308K/A313S) elevate endogenous SIRT6 protein through a weakened interaction with vimentin, independent of mRNA changes. Directionally, the variant reduces vimentin binding, which raises SIRT6. This suggests protein stability, not expression, drives the longevity phenotype, and it links a human genetic finding to SIRT6 abundance. By escaping vimentin-mediated degradation, variant SIRT6 accumulates to higher levels in cells. This mechanism explains how a subtle coding change can increase SIRT6 output and is consistent with the variants' association with exceptional longevity.
links.context_zh_TW: 與百歲人瑞相關的 SIRT6 變異體（N308K/A313S）透過與 vimentin 的弱化相互作用（獨立於 mRNA 變化）提高內源性 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，變異體減少 vimentin 結合，從而提高 SIRT6。這表明蛋白穩定性（而非表達）驅動長壽表型，並將人類遺傳學發現與 SIRT6 豐度聯繫起來。透過逃避 vimentin 介導的降解，變異體 SIRT6 在細胞中積累到更高水平。此機制解釋了微妙的編碼變化如何能增加 SIRT6 產出，與該變異體和非凡長壽的關聯一致。

links.context: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) is one of the three canonical types of Autophagy (alongside Macroautophagy and Microautophagy). Unlike the other routes it does not require vesicle formation: cytosolic proteins carrying a KFERQ-like motif are delivered directly into the lysosome for enzymatic degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) 是 Autophagy 的三種典型類型之一（與 Macroautophagy、Microautophagy 並列）。與其他途徑不同，它不需要囊泡形成：帶有 KFERQ 類基序的細胞質蛋白質直接被運送進 lysosome 進行酵素分解。

links.context: Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective form of lysosomal degradation in which individual soluble cytosolic proteins bearing a pentapeptide KFERQ-like targeting motif are recognized by the cytosolic chaperone HSC70. The substrate-chaperone complex is then delivered to the lysosomal membrane, where the receptor LAMP-2A monomers translocate the unfolded substrate across the membrane into the lumen for degradation. Unlike macro- and microautophagy, CMA degrades one protein at a time and does not require membrane engulfment or autophagosome formation. CMA activity declines with age and is implicated in neurodegeneration and cancer, and it is subject to regulation by mTORC2 and other signaling nodes.
links.context_zh_TW: 伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）是一種選擇性的溶酶體降解形式，其中帶有五肽KFERQ樣標靶基序的個別可溶性細胞質蛋白被細胞質伴護蛋白HSC70辨識。隨後受質—伴護蛋白複合體被遞送至溶酶體膜，由受體LAMP-2A單體將未折疊的受質跨膜轉運至腔內進行降解。不同於巨自噬和微自噬，CMA一次降解一個蛋白質，且不需要膜吞噬或自噬體形成。CMA活性隨年齡下降，並與神經退化和癌症有關，且受mTORC2和其他訊號節點的調控。

links.context: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A (CMT2A), the most common axonal form of CMT, is caused by heterozygous missense mutations in MFN2 (e.g. T105M, R94W). These mutations impair axonal mitochondrial transport by disrupting the Miro/Milton/kinesin transport complex, causing mitochondrial depletion in distal axons and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A（CMT2A）是 CMT 最常見的軸突型，由 MFN2 的異型合子錯義突變（如 T105M、R94W）致病。這些突變藉由破壞 Miro／Milton／kinesin 運輸複合體而損害軸突的粒線體運輸，導致遠端軸突粒線體耗竭與神經退化。

links.context: Checkpoint Inhibitors are the core modality of Immunotherapy: they release CTLA-4 and PD-1/PD-L1 brake signaling that suppresses antitumor T-cell activity, converting a chronically inflamed but immune-excluded tumor into one the immune system can clear.
links.context_zh_TW: Checkpoint Inhibitor（檢查點抑制劑）是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）的核心手段：它們解除抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞活性的 CTLA-4 與 PD-1/PD-L1 煞車訊號，使長期發炎但免疫排斥的腫瘤轉為免疫系統可清除的腫瘤。

links.context: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: Chloroquine raises lysosomal pH and blocks autophagosome-lysosome fusion, arresting autophagic flux at the degradation step; it is the standard late-stage autophagy inhibitor.
links.context_zh_TW: Chloroquine 提高溶酶體 pH 並阻斷自噬體-溶酶體融合，在降解步驟中止自噬流；是標準的晚期自噬抑制劑。

links.context: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: cells, especially Macrophages, export excess free Cholesterol to extracellular lipid acceptors such as Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL. Because the process is the rate-limiting gateway of the whole reverse transport cascade, its impairment promotes foam cell formation and Atherosclerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步且為速率限制步驟：細胞（尤其是 Macrophages）將過量的游離 Cholesterol 輸出至細胞外脂質受體，例如 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL。由於此步驟是整個逆向運輸級聯反應的速率限制關口，其功能受損會促進泡沫細胞形成與 Atherosclerosis。

links.context: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: free cholesterol and phospholipids move from peripheral tissue cells — especially arterial Macrophages — to lipid-poor apoA-1 and HDL3 via ABCA1, ABCG1 and SR-BI, beginning the journey to the liver.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步也是限速步驟：游離膽固醇與磷脂經由 ABCA1、ABCG1 與 SR-BI 從周邊組織細胞（尤其是動脈 Macrophages）轉移至缺乏脂質的 apoA-1 與 HDL3，展開前往肝臟的旅程。

links.context: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
links.context_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

links.context: Cholesterol-biosynthesis-derived mevalonate activates IGF1R and downstream PI3K-mTOR, promoting histone modifications at inflammatory loci. Statins prevent trained immunity induction, whereas mevalonate kinase deficiency yields a constitutively trained state. oxLDL engages this mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop via HIF-1alpha.
links.context_zh_TW: 源自 cholesterol-biosynthesis 的 Mevalonate 活化 IGF1R 及下游 PI3K-mTOR，促進發炎基因座的 histone modifications。Statins 可阻止 trained immunity 的誘導，而 mevalonate kinase deficiency 則產生組成型 trained state。Oxidized LDL 經由 HIF-1alpha 接合此 mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop。

links.context: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome. This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants. Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome。This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants。Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues。

links.context: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
links.context_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
links.context_zh_TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。
links.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

links.context: Chronic exposure to large doses of Silver leads to Argyria: absorbed silver is carried in the circulation as protein-bound silver sulfide, is reduced in tissue to elemental metal or precipitated as silver sulfide granules, and irreversibly accumulates in the dermis, around sweat glands, and in basement membranes to produce the characteristic slate-blue skin, scleral, and nail-bed pigmentation.
links.context_zh_TW: 长期大剂量接觸 Silver 會導致 Argyria：被吸收的 silver 經血液循環以蛋白結合態的 silver sulfide 運送，在組織中被還原為金屬態或沉澱成 silver sulfide 顆粒，並不可逆地累積於真皮、汗腺周圍與基底膜，形成典型的青藍色皮膚、鞏膜與甲床色素沉著。

links.context: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 is also consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, where its deficiency correlates with insulin resistance, and in skeletal muscle its deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中也持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗相關，在骨骼肌中其缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重第 2 型糖尿病的周邊胰島素阻抗。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 overexpression mitigates neuronal injury by inhibiting the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, thereby reducing mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) formation and protecting neurons from metabolic stress-induced apoptosis in diabetic encephalopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 的過量表現透過抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物減輕神經元損傷，從而減少粒線體相關內質網膜（MAM）形成，保護神經元免受代謝壓力誘導的凋亡，在糖尿病腦病變中發揮保護作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
links.context_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

links.context: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

links.context: Cigarette, cigar, and wood smoke contain enormous amounts of free radicals and oxidants (cigarette smoke alone carries on the order of 10^17 oxidant molecules per puff). These external oxidants directly increase reactive oxygen species, deplete antioxidants such as vitamin C and glutathione, and cause systemic oxidative stress. Smoke also activates sympathetic nervous system responses and inflammation, further raising endogenous ROS production. This oxidative environment promotes the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome and supports the redox cycle by which adrenochrome generates more superoxide, linking smoking to increased catecholamine oxidation and oxidative damage.
links.context_zh_TW: 香菸、雪茄與木柴煙霧含有大量自由基與氧化劑（單是香菸煙霧每口就帶有約 10^17 個氧化劑分子）。這些外部氧化劑直接增加活性氧物種、耗竭維生素 C 與麩胱甘肽等抗氧化劑，並造成全身性氧化壓力。煙霧也活化交感神經系統反應與發炎，進一步升高內源性 ROS 生成。此氧化環境促進 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，並支持 adrenochrome 藉以產生更多超氧陰離子的氧化還原循環，將吸菸與增加的兒茶酚胺氧化及氧化損傷連結起來。

links.context: Cisplatin downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 93 percent with high significance.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 高顯著下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 93%。

links.context: Cisplatin induces premature senescence via DNA intrastrand cross-links. Mechanism involves p53-p21 pathway activation and ROS-dependent signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 透過 DNA 鏈內交聯誘發早衰。其機制涉及 p53-p21 路徑活化與 ROS 依賴的訊號傳遞。

links.context: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
links.context_zh_TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

links.context: Citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3) is the PAD4-generated immunodetection signature of NETosis, marking neutrophil extracellular trap formation. Together with extracellular DNA (Sytox Green) and MPO-DNA complexes it forms the diagnostic triad that distinguishes NETs from generic necrotic DNA release.
links.context_zh_TW: 瓜胺酸化組蛋白 H3（cit-H3）是 NETosis 的 PAD4 生成式免疫檢測標記，用以標示中性球細胞外捕捉網（NET）的形成。它與細胞外 DNA（Sytox Green）以及 MPO–DNA 複合體共同構成診斷三聯體，用以區分 NET 與一般壞死造成的 DNA 釋放。

links.context: Clofarabine received FDA accelerated approval in December 2004 for pediatric patients (ages 1-21) with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia after at least two prior regimens. It was the first new drug approved for pediatric leukemia in over a decade.
links.context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 於 2004 年 12 月獲得 FDA 加速核准，用於至少接受過兩種先前療程後復發或難治型急性淋巴性白血病的兒童患者（1-21 歲）。它是十多年來第一個獲核准用於兒童白血病的藥物。

links.context: Clofarabine's diphosphate inhibits ribonucleotide reductase (IC50 about 65 nM), depleting dNTP pools and further starving DNA synthesis. This direct RNR inhibition is complemented by DNA polymerase inhibition and chain termination by the incorporated triphosphate.
links.context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 的二磷酸形式抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶（IC50 約 65 nM），耗竭 dNTP 池並進一步使 DNA 合成匱乏。此直接的 RNR 抑制與嵌入的三磷酸所造成的 DNA 聚合酶抑制及鏈終止相互補。

links.context: Co-crystallization of suramin with human SIRT5 revealed that suramin binds by occupying the nicotinamide ribose pocket (B-pocket), the nicotinamide pocket (C-pocket), and part of the substrate-binding site. This structural insight explains suramin's broad, high-affinity inhibition of multiple sirtuins and informed the design of more selective derivatives such as NF675. Directionally, suramin is the ligand and the SIRT5 catalytic cleft the receptor. The structure also illustrates general principles governing small-molecule engagement of the sirtuin NAD+/substrate channel.
links.context_zh_TW: Suramin 與人類 SIRT5 的共晶體結構揭示 Suramin 透過占据尼可醯胺核糖口袋（B 口袋）、尼可醯胺口袋（C 口袋）和部分受質結合位點進行結合。此結構見解解釋了 Suramin 對多種 sirtuin 的廣泛高親和力抑制作用，並為設計更具選擇性的衍生物如 NF675 提供了依據。方向性上 Suramin 是配體，SIRT5 催化溝槽是受體。此結構也闡明了小分子與 sirtuin NAD+/受質通道結合的一般原則。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

links.context: Co-oximetry is the gold-standard diagnostic test for methemoglobinemia: it enables accurate diagnosis and dosing of therapy such as methylene blue. It also distinguishes concurrent exposures that produce overlapping clinical cyanosis, for example carbon monoxide poisoning (carboxyhemoglobin) versus nitrite- or anaesthetic-induced methemoglobinemia.
links.context_zh_TW: Co-oximetry 是 Methemoglobinemia 的黃金標準診斷檢查：它使診斷與 Methylene blue 等治療的給藥得以精確進行。它也能區分造成臨床發紺重疊的同時暴露，例如一氧化碳中毒（carboxyhemoglobin）與亞硝酸鹽或麻醉藥所致的 Methemoglobinemia。

links.context: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.
links.context_zh_TW: 耳蝸毛細胞是機械感測受體，一旦喪失無法再生。在熱量限制下，SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2 活化促進粒線體 NADPH 和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性——這種保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中完全喪失。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 protects against lipid peroxidation because ubiquinol reduces lipid peroxyl radicals in the bilayer, terminating chain reactions similarly to vitamin E. Its high concentration in membranes makes it a front-line chain breaker. The directionality is reduced CoQ10 to peroxyl radical termination. A caveat is that ubiquinol is rapidly consumed and must be regenerated enzymatically, so its protective capacity depends on the redox state of the CoQ pool. CoQ10 levels decline with age and in some pathologies, and supplementation is often used to restore membrane redox protection.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 可防止 lipid peroxidation，因為泛醇可減少雙層中的脂質過氧自由基，從而終止與 vitamin E 類似的鍊式反應。它在膜中的高濃度使其成為一線的鏈條破壞者。方向性是 CoQ10 還原為過氧自由基終止。需要注意的是，泛醇會迅速消耗，必須透過酵素再生，因此其保護能力取決於 CoQ 池的氧化還原狀態。 CoQ10 水平隨著年齡的增長和某些疾病而下降，補充通常用於恢復膜的氧化還原保護。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 reduces heart-failure morbidity and mortality, as suggested by the Q-SYMBIO trial showing a substantial reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events with supplementation in chronic heart failure. Its benefit is attributed to improved mitochondrial bioenergetics and reduced oxidative stress. The directionality is supplementation to improved cardiac outcomes. A caveat is that trial results are mixed and effect sizes vary, so CoQ10 is adjunctive rather than replacement therapy. Improved mitochondrial ATP production and endothelial function are also invoked to explain the cardiac benefit, though larger confirmatory trials are still needed.
links.context_zh_TW: Q-SYMBIO 試驗表明，Coenzyme Q10 可以降低心臟衰竭的發病率和死亡率，該試驗顯示，補充慢性 heart failure 後，主要不良反應 cardiovascular events 大幅減少。其益處歸因於改進的mitochondria1生物能學和減少的oxidative stress。方向性是改善心臟結果的補充。需要注意的是，試驗結果參差不齊，效果大小也各不相同，因此 CoQ10 是輔助療法，而不是替代療法。儘管仍需要更大規模的驗證性試驗，但改善的mitochondria1 ATP產生和內皮功能也被用來解釋心臟益處。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 regenerates vitamin E by reducing the alpha-tocopheroxyl radical back to alpha-tocopherol, extending the chain-breaking lifetime of vitamin E in membranes. This places CoQ10 upstream of vitamin E in the antioxidant network. The directionality is ubiquinol to tocopherol recycling. A caveat is that this regeneration competes with CoQ10's own peroxyl-radical scavenging, and the net effect depends on local ratios. The recycling interaction places CoQ10 and vitamin E as partners in a lipid-phase antioxidant network that also involves vitamin C at the membrane interface.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 透過將 α-生育酚自由基還原回 α-生育醇來再生 vitamin E，從而延長了 vitamin E 在膜中的斷鏈壽命。這使得 CoQ10 在抗氧化網路中位於 vitamin E 的上游。方向性是泛醇到生育醇的回收。需要注意的是，這種再生與 CoQ10 自身的過氧自由基清除作用相競爭，淨效應取決於局部比率。這種回收相互作用將 CoQ10 和 vitamin E 作為脂相抗氧化網絡中的合作夥伴，該網絡還涉及膜界面上的維生素 C。

links.context: Coenzyme Q10 transfers electrons between mitochondrial Complex I (or II) and Complex III as a mobile lipophilic carrier in the inner membrane, shuttling single electrons and buffering the pool. In its reduced form (ubiquinol) it also acts as an antioxidant. The directionality is electron transport coupled to redox buffering. A caveat is that CoQ10's electron-transfer role is distinct from its antioxidant role, and statin-mediated depletion can affect both. CoQ10 is synthesized endogenously via the mevalonate pathway and is also a potent lipophilic antioxidant in both its ubiquinol and ubiquinone forms.
links.context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 作為內膜中的移動親脂載體在 mitochondrial Complex I（或 II）和複合物 III 之間轉移電子，穿梭單一電子並緩衝池。其還原形式（泛醇）也可作為抗氧化劑。方向性是與氧化還原緩衝耦合的電子傳遞。需要注意的是，CoQ10 的電子轉移作用與其抗氧化作用不同，而他汀類藥物介導的耗竭會影響這兩者。 CoQ10 透過甲羥戊酸途徑內源合成，其泛醇和泛醌形式也是一種有效的親脂性抗氧化劑。

links.context: Cold exposure induces SIRT3 in brown adipose tissue, where it promotes expression of mitochondrial genes and supports thermogenic programs. The induction enhances oxidative metabolism and uncoupled respiration needed for heat production, with SIRT3 acting upstream of UCP1-dependent thermogenesis. Directionally, a cold stimulus triggers SIRT3 upregulation, which in turn drives thermogenic mitochondrial biogenesis. This ties SIRT3 to adaptive thermogenesis and the metabolic benefits of cold exposure, and conversely SIRT3 is reduced in brown adipose tissue of obese mice, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity and blunted cold-induced mitochondrial function.
links.context_zh_TW: 冷暴露在棕色脂肪組織中誘導 SIRT3，促進粒線體基因表達並支持產熱程序。這種誘導增強了產生熱量所需的氧化代謝和解偶聯呼吸，SIRT3 在 UCP1 依賴性產熱的上游作用。在方向性上，冷刺激觸發 SIRT3 上調，進而驅動產熱性粒線體生物合成。這將 SIRT3 與適應性產熱和冷暴露的代謝益處聯繫起來，相反，肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪組織中 SIRT3 減少，將肥胖與受損的產熱能力和遲鈍的冷誘導粒線體功能聯繫起來。

links.context: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
links.context_zh_TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

links.context: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
links.context_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

links.context: Complex I and Mitochondrial Dysfunction are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Complex I and Mitochondrial Dysfunction may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Complex I 和 Mitochondrial Dysfunction 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Complex I 和 Mitochondrial Dysfunction 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: Complex V synthesizes ATP using the proton motive force at roughly 32 to 34 ATP per glucose. Synthesis is the oxidative-phosphorylation output.
links.context_zh_TW: 複合體 V 利用質子動力以每葡萄糖約 32 至 34 ATP 合成 ATP。合成是氧化磷酸化輸出。

links.context: Compound C (Dorsomorphin, BML-275) is a potent, selective and cell-permeable reversible ATP-competitive inhibitor of AMPK (Ki ≈ 109 nM), binding the kinase domain of the catalytic α subunit and preventing phosphorylation of targets such as ACC and TSC2. It is the most widely used pharmacological tool for establishing whether a phenotype requires AMPK activity.
links.context_zh_TW: Compound C（Dorsomorphin、BML-275）是強效、具選擇性且可穿透細胞的可逆性 AMPK ATP 競爭性抑制劑（Ki ≈ 109 nM），結合催化 α 次單元的激酶區並阻止 ACC 與 TSC2 等標的的磷酸化。它是判定某一表型是否需要 AMPK 活性時最廣泛使用的藥理工具。

links.context: Concentrations above 10 uM (25, 50, and 100 uM) drastically reduced retinal cell viability, demonstrating the descending toxic limb of the hormetic curve. This toxicity threshold mirrors related Moraceae compounds such as moracin P and mulberrofuran Q. It establishes a narrow therapeutic window for Brosimine B.
links.context_zh_TW: 高於 10 uM 的濃度（25、50、100 uM）大幅降低視網膜細胞存活率，呈現 hormetic 曲線的下降毒性支。此毒性閾值與 Moraceae 家族相關化合物如 moracin P 和 mulberrofuran Q 相似。這確立了 Brosimine B 狹窄的治療窗。

links.context: Conditional deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD in intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis and IBD-like pathology, but crossing these mice onto a RIPK3-deficient background completely prevents the disease, demonstrating that the epithelial cell death underlying the phenotype is RIPK3-dependent.
links.context_zh_TW: 在腸道上皮中條件性刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引發自發性壞死性凋亡與類 IBD 的病理，但將這些小鼠交配到缺乏 RIPK3 的背景上可完全阻止該病徵，證明其上皮細胞死亡依賴 RIPK3。

links.context: Conjugated dienes are the early products of lipid peroxidation: they form when polyunsaturated fatty acids in lipoproteins such as LDL and HDL are oxidized by copper or free radicals. Their appearance at 234 nm absorbance (extinction coefficient 27,000 M-1/cm) is the standard way to quantify the extent of lipoprotein oxidation, with a kinetic profile of lag phase, propagation phase, and decomposition phase.
links.context_zh_TW: Conjugated Dienes 是 Lipid Peroxidation 的早期產物：當 LDL、HDL 等脂蛋白中的多不飽和脂肪酸被銅或自由基氧化時便會形成。以 234 nm 吸光度（消光係數 27,000 M-1/cm）測量是量化脂蛋白氧化程度的標準方法，其動力學曲線包含 lag phase、propagation phase 與 decomposition phase。

links.context: Constitutional aneuploidy arises from errors in chromosome segregation during meiosis, chiefly nondisjunction of homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids in meiosis I or II, producing gametes with an extra or missing chromosome. Advanced maternal age is the single greatest risk factor, via deterioration of cohesin complexes, spindle defects and aberrant chiasma formation. Aneuploidy is the leading genetic cause of miscarriage and intellectual disability.
links.context_zh_TW: 體染色體非整倍體源自減數分裂期間的染色體分離錯誤，主要是減數分裂第一次或第二次分裂中同源染色體或姊妹染色單體的不分離，產生多一條或少一條染色體的配子。孕婦高齡是最大的單一風險因子，機制包括黏連蛋白複合體劣化、紡錘體缺陷與異常交叉互換。染色體非整倍體是流產與智能障礙最主要的遺傳原因。

links.context: Contrary to intuition, hypoxia shifts the mitochondrial electron transport system toward a reduced state, increasing electron availability and favoring superoxide formation. This hypoxic oxidant burst provides the redox signal that activates defenses before the larger reoxygenation insult.
links.context_zh_TW: 與直覺相反，Hypoxia 使粒線體電子傳遞系統偏向還原態，增加電子可利用性並促進超氧物生成。這波缺氧期間的氧化物爆發提供了氧化還原訊號，在更大的再氧合損傷之前活化防禦機制。

links.context: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate.
