links.context: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

links.context: Hypochlorous acid is generated by myeloperoxidase, which uses H2O2 and chloride to produce HOCl in activated neutrophils and monocytes. This reaction concentrates a potent oxidant at infection and inflammatory sites. The directionality is MPO catalysis to HOCl formation. A caveat is that MPO can also use bromide and other halides, so related hypohalous acids are produced alongside HOCl. Because HOCl is produced only in proximity to MPO, the appearance of its chlorinated products such as 3-chlorotyrosine is a highly specific footprint of MPO activity in vivo.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 由 myeloperoxidase 生成，myeloperoxidase 使用 H2O2 和氯化物在活化的嗜中性球和單核球產生 HOCl。此反應在感染和發炎部位濃縮了強效氧化劑。方向性是 MPO 催化 HOCl 的形成。要注意的是，MPO 還可以使用溴化物和其他鹵化物，因此相關的次鹵酸會與 HOCl 一起產生。由於 HOCl 僅在 MPO 附近產生，因此其氯化產物（例如 3-chlorotyrosine）的出現是 MPO 體內活性的高度特異性足跡。

links.context: Hypochlorous acid is the primary microbicidal oxidant of the innate immune system, killing pathogens through widespread oxidation of thiols, amines, and proteins in microbes. Its potency makes it central to neutrophil host defense. The directionality is HOCl to microbial killing. A caveat is that HOCl is non-selective and, when extrapolated beyond the phagolysosome, damages host tissues and proteins, contributing to inflammatory injury. Defects in MPO impair HOCl production and, although compensated in most patients, illustrate the enzyme's central role in oxidant-mediated killing.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 是 innate immune system 的主要殺菌氧化劑，透過微生物中硫醇、胺和 proteins 的廣泛氧化來殺死病原體。它的效力使其成為中性粒細胞宿主防禦的核心。方向性是次氯酸對微生物的殺滅作用。需要注意的是，HOCl 是非選擇性的，當外推到吞噬溶小體之外時，會損害宿主組織和 proteins，導致發炎損傷。 MPO 的缺陷會損害 HOCl 的產生，儘管在大多數患者中得到補償，但說明了該酶在氧化劑介導的殺傷中的核心作用。

links.context: Hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors in G1. This suppression withholds S-phase genes until CDK phosphorylation releases them.
links.context_zh_TW: 低磷酸化 RB1 在 G1 結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子。此抑制扣留 S 期基因，直到 CDK 磷酸化釋放它們。

links.context: Hypoxia and related states such as estivation transiently upregulate endogenous antioxidant enzymes including Superoxide Dismutase, Catalase, Glutathione S-Transferase, and Glutathione Peroxidase. These activities rise by tens of percent during low-oxygen exposure and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypoxia 及相關狀態（如夏眠）會短暫上調內源性 Antioxidant Enzymes，包括 Superoxide Dismutase、Catalase、Glutathione S-Transferase 和 Glutathione Peroxidase。這些酵素活性在低氧暴露期間上升數十個百分點，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線。

links.context: Hypoxia-reoxygenation produces a ROS burst in rheumatoid arthritis synovium analogous to ischemia-reperfusion, as restored oxygen fuels mitochondrial and enzymatic ROS after hypoxic epochs. This oxidant surge perpetuates synovial inflammation and joint damage. The directionality is reoxygenation to ROS burst in joint tissue. A caveat is that RA synovium is also hypoxic because of high metabolic and infiltrating-cell demand, so the cycle is sustained rather than episodic. This mechanism may explain the vulnerability of the inflamed joint to intermittent blood flow and oxidative injury.
links.context_zh_TW: Hypoxia-reoxygenation 在類風濕性關節炎滑膜中產生 ROS 爆發，類似於缺血再灌注，因為缺氧時期後恢復的氧氣為 mitochondria1 和酶促 ROS 提供燃料。這種氧化劑激增會導致滑膜發炎和關節損傷持續存在。方向性是關節組織中ROS爆發的再氧合。需要注意的是，由於高代謝和浸潤細胞的需求，RA 滑膜也會缺氧，因此循環是持續的而不是間歇性的。這種機制可以解釋發炎關節對間歇性血流和氧化損傷的脆弱性。

links.context: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
links.context_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

links.context: ICF syndrome (Immunodeficiency, Centromere instability, and Facial anomalies) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the DNMT3B gene. Loss of DNMT3b activity leads to hypomethylation of pericentromeric satellite repeats and juxtacentromeric regions, resulting in centromeric decondensation, chromosome instability, and characteristic chromosomal abnormalities in stimulated lymphocytes. The disease manifests as combined immunodeficiency with reduced immunoglobulin levels, facial dysmorphism, and developmental delay.
links.context_zh_TW: ICF 症候群（免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和臉部異常）是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 DNMT3B 基因突變引起。 DNMT3b 活性的喪失會導致著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列和近著絲粒區域的低甲基化，從而導致著絲粒脫縮、染色體不穩定以及受刺激的淋巴細胞中的特徵性染色體異常。此疾病表現為聯合免疫缺陷，伴隨免疫球蛋白水平降低、臉部畸形和發育遲緩。

links.context: IDH2 (mitochondrial isocitrate dehydrogenase 2) catalyzes the oxidative decarboxylation of isocitrate to α-ketoglutarate in the mitochondrial matrix, generating NADPH. That NADPH pool feeds Glutathione regeneration and other antioxidant systems, making IDH2 a key controller of mitochondrial Reactive Oxygen Species balance. SIRT3 deacetylates and activates IDH2, and during Dietary Restriction the SIRT3→IDH2→NADPH→glutathione relay lowers ROS alongside the SIRT3→SOD2 arm.
links.context_zh_TW: IDH2（粒線體 isocitrate dehydrogenase 2）在粒線體基質中催化 isocitrate 氧化脫羧生成 α-ketoglutarate，並產生 NADPH。該 NADPH 供應 Glutathione 再生與其他抗氧化系統，使 IDH2 成為粒線體 Reactive Oxygen Species 平衡的關鍵調控者。SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 IDH2；在 Dietary Restriction 期間，SIRT3→IDH2→NADPH→glutathione 這條中繼可與 SIRT3→SOD2 分支共同降低 ROS。

links.context: IDO1 (or TDO) catalyses the rate-limiting step of the Kynurenine Pathway, converting tryptophan to N-formylkynurenine. IDO1-mediated tryptophan depletion in the Tumor Microenvironment is a well-established mechanism of local immune suppression, linking tryptophan catabolism to tumor immune evasion.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1（或 TDO）催化 Kynurenine Pathway 的速率限制步驟，將 Tryptophan 轉為 N-Formylkynurenine。Tumor Microenvironment 中 IDO1 介導的 Tryptophan 耗竭是局部免疫抑制的確立機制，將 tryptophan 分解與腫瘤免疫逃逸連結起來。

links.context: IDO1 catalyzes the first, rate-limiting step in tryptophan catabolism, inserting both oxygen atoms of O2 into the indole ring to yield N-formylkynurenine and thereby initiating the Kynurenine Pathway. Downstream metabolism produces Quinolinic Acid and ultimately NAD+, so IDO1 activity links tryptophan availability to the cellular NAD+ pool as well as to T-cell immunity and tumor immune tolerance.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 催化色胺酸分解代謝的第一步也是限速步驟，將 O2 的兩個氧原子插入 indole 環以生成 N-formylkynurenine，據此啟動 Kynurenine Pathway。下游代謝產生 Quinolinic Acid 並最終生成 NAD+，因此 IDO1 活性同時連結色胺酸可得性與細胞 NAD+ 池，以及 T 細胞免疫與腫瘤免疫耐受。

links.context: IDO1 is a heme-containing enzyme that catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step of the Kynurenine Pathway, oxidizing L-Tryptophan to N-Formylkynurenine in an O2-dependent reaction after reduction of its ferric heme to the ferrous form. N-Formylkynurenine is then rapidly deformylated to Kynurenine, committing substrate to the kynurenine pathway; Tryptophan depletion at the IDO1 step activates the GCN2 stress kinase in effector T cells.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 是含血基質的酵素，催化 Kynurenine Pathway 的第一個也是限速步驟，將 L-Tryptophan 在需氧反應中氧化為 N-Formylkynurenine，前提是血基質由三價鐵還原為二價鐵。N-Formylkynurenine 隨即被迅速去甲醯化為 Kynurenine，使底物正式進入犬尿胺酸途徑；IDO1 這一步造成的 Tryptophan 匱乏會活化效應 T 細胞中的 GCN2 壓力激酶。

links.context: IDO1 is the rate-limiting enzyme of the Kynurenine Pathway and generates Kynurenine from Tryptophan; Kynurenine then signals through the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor to promote Regulatory T cells and suppress Th17 responses, creating a feed-forward immunosuppressive loop when dendritic cells express IDO1.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 是 Kynurenine Pathway 的限速酵素，由 Tryptophan 生成 Kynurenine；Kynurenine 接著透過 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 訊號促進 Regulatory T cells 並抑制 Th17 反應，當樹突細胞表現 IDO1 時便形成前饋式的免疫抑制迴路。

links.context: IDO1 transcription is strongly induced by the pro-inflammatory cytokine Interferon-gamma through the JAK/STAT1 pathway, with TNF-α, IL-1β, LPS and glucocorticoids able to synergize in certain cellular contexts. Because IFNγ is a hallmark of the antitumor immune response, IFNγ-driven IDO1 induction in tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes helps suppress antitumor immunity.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 的轉錄會被發炎性細胞激素 Interferon-gamma 透過 JAK/STAT1 路徑強烈誘導，在某些細胞情境下 TNF-α、IL-1β、LPS 與類固醇可協同作用。由於 IFNγ 是抗腫瘤免疫反應的標誌，腫瘤與腫瘤引流淋巴結中由 IFNγ 驅動的 IDO1 誘導有助於壓抑抗腫瘤免疫。

links.context: IGF1 is a potent inhibitor of Autophagy. It binds IGF1R, activating the PI3K/Akt axis, which stimulates mTORC1 and inhibits FoxO1 transcription factors — both of which normally suppress autophagic activity. Consistent with this, low IGF1 during Caloric Restriction or Intermittent Fasting is associated with increased Longevity and induction of beneficial autophagy, while reduced IGF1 signaling extends lifespan across species.
links.context_zh_TW: IGF1 是 Autophagy 的強效抑制因子。它與 IGF1R 結合後活化 PI3K/Akt 軸，進而刺激 mTORC1 並抑制 FoxO1 轉錄因子——兩者平時都會壓抑自噬活性。與此一致，Caloric Restriction 或 Intermittent Fasting 期間的低 IGF1 與 Longevity 增加及有益自噬的誘導相關，而 IGF1 訊號降低可在多種物種中延長壽命。

links.context: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: IKK is activated in Cancer. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward IKK, so Cancer is the active agent and IKK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: IKK 在 Cancer 中活化。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 IKK，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，IKK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: IKKbeta is the kinase that activates NF-κB by phosphorylating its inhibitory IκB proteins, licensing their degradation and nuclear translocation. Inhibiting IKKbeta therefore blocks pro-inflammatory cytokine production in arthritis, IBD, and psoriasis, making it a therapeutic target in Inflammatory Diseases.
links.context_zh_TW: IKKbeta 是透過磷酸化 NF-κB 的抑制性 IκB 蛋白（使其降解並可轉位入核）來活化 NF-κB 的激酶。因此抑制 IKKbeta 可阻斷類風濕性關節炎、IBD 與 psoriasis 中的促發炎細胞激素生成，使其成為 Inflammatory Diseases（發炎性疾病）的治療標的。

links.context: IKKepsilon, together with TBK1, phosphorylates XIAP at Ser430 within its RING finger domain, triggering Lys48-linked autoubiquitination at Lys322 and Lys328 and rapid proteasomal degradation. This functional link between innate immune activation (e.g., viral infection) and apoptotic sensitization means cells that have recently fought viral infection upregulate IKKε and lower their apoptotic threshold as a safeguard against viral persistence.
links.context_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與 TBK1 一起在 XIAP 的 RING finger 區域磷酸化 Ser430，觸發 Lys322 與 Lys328 位置的 Lys48 連結自泛素化與快速的蛋白酶體降解。這條連結先天免疫活化（如病毒感染）與凋亡致敏的功能路徑意味著：剛經歷過抗病毒戰鬥的細胞會上調 IKKε、降低凋亡門檻，作為防止病毒持續存在的防線。

links.context: IL-12 is the primary cytokine driving Th1 differentiation: it activates STAT4 in naive CD4+ T cells, induces the master Th1 transcription factor T-bet, and simultaneously suppresses Th2 and Th17 polarization.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-12 是驅動 Th1 分化最主要的細胞激素：它在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中活化 STAT4、誘導 Th1 譜系的主轉錄因子 T-bet，並同時抑制 Th2 與 Th17 極化。

links.context: IL-12 signals through IL-12Rβ1/IL-12Rβ2 to activate the JAK2/TYK2 kinase complex, phosphorylating STAT4 and thereby driving IFN-gamma production in T cells and natural killer cells. This IFN-gamma output is the defining effector function of the IL-12 axis.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-12 透過 IL-12Rβ1/IL-12Rβ2 訊號活化 JAK2/TYK2 激酶複合體，使 STAT4 磷酸化，進而驅動 T 細胞與自然殺手細胞產生 IFN-gamma。此 IFN-gamma 輸出是 IL-12 軸的代表性效應功能。

links.context: IL-13 binds the IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 receptor complex, activating JAK1 and TYK2, which phosphorylate STAT6. Dimerized STAT6 translocates to the nucleus and drives transcription of mucus, tissue-remodeling and alternatively-activated macrophage genes. IL-13 shares both the IL-4Rα subunit and STAT6 signaling with IL-4.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-13 與 IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 受體複合體結合後活化 JAK1 與 TYK2，進而使 STAT6 磷酸化。二聚化的 STAT6 轉位至細胞核，驅動黏液、組織重塑以及 alternative 活化巨噬細胞相關基因的轉錄。IL-13 與 IL-4 共用 IL-4Rα 次單元與 STAT6 訊號傳遞。

links.context: IL-18 is synthesized as an inactive pro-IL-18 precursor and matures only when caspase-1, recruited by the NLRP3 inflammasome, cleaves it in macrophages and other innate immune cells.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-18 先以無活性的 pro-IL-18 前驅物形式合成，必須由 NLRP3 發炎小體招募的 caspase-1 在巨噬細胞及其他先天免疫細胞中切割後才成熟。

links.context: IL-1a is an apical SASP amplifier that sits at the top of the inflammatory cascade, and its cleavage by caspase-5 or calpain is essential for full SASP regulatory function. Cell-surface and secreted IL-1a engage IL-1R, activating MyD88-NF-kB signaling that sustains the SASP and induces paracrine senescence, and it also induces downstream factors such as CCL20 and Activin A. It is thus a master initiator rather than merely a component of the secretome. Its centrality makes IL-1a a key mechanistic and therapeutic node in senescence-associated inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是位於發炎級聯頂端的頂層 SASP 放大器，其經 caspase-5 或 calpain 的切割對完整 SASP 調節功能必要。細胞表面與分泌的 IL-1α 接合 IL-1R，活化 MyD88-NF-κB 訊號，維持 SASP 並誘發旁分泌衰老，且也誘發 CCL20 與 Activin A 等下游因子。因此它視為主要啟動者而非僅分泌組成分。其中心性使 IL-1α 成為衰老相關發炎的關鍵機制與治療節點。

links.context: IL-1a is an apical SASP amplifier that sits at the top of the inflammatory cascade, and its proteolytic cleavage (by caspase-5 or calpain) is essential for full SASP regulatory function. Cell-surface and secreted IL-1a engage IL-1R on neighboring cells, activating MyD88-dependent NF-kB signaling that both sustains the SASP in the sender and induces paracrine senescence in recipients. As a master initiator rather than a passive component, IL-1a integrates with the noncanonical inflammasome, whose caspase-5 cleavage licenses the secretome. Its centrality makes IL-1a a key mechanistic and therapeutic node.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是位於發炎級聯頂端的頂層 SASP 放大器，其蛋白水解切割（由 caspase-5 或 calpain）對完整 SASP 調節功能不可或缺。細胞表面與分泌的 IL-1α 接合鄰近細胞的 IL-1R，活化 MyD88 依賴的 NF-κB 訊號，既維持傳送者的 SASP 又誘發受體者的旁分泌衰老。作為主要啟動者而非被動組成，IL-1α 與非典型發炎體整合，後者的 caspase-5 切割許可分泌組。其中心性使 IL-1α 成為關鍵的機制與治療節點。

links.context: IL-1beta activates NF-kappaB via MyD88-dependent signaling upon binding its receptor IL-1R1, amplifying expression of inflammatory genes. This places IL-1beta upstream of a central inflammatory transcription factor. The directionality is cytokine to NF-kappaB activation. A caveat is that IL-1beta itself is an NF-kappaB target, so the loop is reinforcing rather than linear, and IL-1ra can dampen it. The resulting amplification loop is a target of anti-inflammatory biologics and explains the broad effects of IL-1 blockade in chronic disease.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1beta 在結合其受體 IL-1R1 後，透過 MyD88 依賴性訊號傳導活化 NF-kappaB，從而放大發炎基因的表達。這將 IL-1beta 置於中央發炎轉錄因子的上游。方向性是細胞激素對 NF-κB 活化的影響。需要注意的是，IL-1beta 本身是 NF-kappaB 靶標，因此環是增強的而不是線性的，而 IL-1ra 可以抑制它。由此產生的放大環是抗發炎生物製劑的目標，並解釋了 IL-1 阻斷在慢性疾病中的廣泛影響。

links.context: IL-1beta inhibition with canakinumab reduces cardiovascular events, as the CANTOS trial showed fewer recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death independent of lipid lowering. This validated inflammation (not just LDL) as a treatment target. The directionality is IL-1beta blockade to lower CVD events. A caveat is that the trial also showed increased infection risk and that not all patients benefited, indicating a selected responder population. The results of CANTOS established the inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis and opened the door to targeted immunomodulation for CVD.
links.context_zh_TW: 卡那奴單抗抑制 IL-1beta 會降低 cardiovascular events，因為 CANTOS 試驗顯示，與降血脂無關的複發性心肌梗塞、中風和心血管死亡較少。這驗證了發炎（不僅僅是低密度脂蛋白）作為治療目標。方向性是IL-1beta封鎖以降低CVD事件。需要注意的是，該試驗還顯示感染風險增加，並且並非所有患者都受益，這表明特定的反應族群。 CANTOS的結果建立了atherosclerosis的發炎假說，為CVD的標靶免疫調節打開了大門。

links.context: IL-1β requires two signals: NF-κB priming induces pro-IL-1β and NLRP3, then a danger signal activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, which recruits ASC and caspase-1 to cleave pro-IL-1β into the mature 17-kDa secreted form.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-1β 需要兩道訊號：先由 NF-κB priming 誘導 pro-IL-1β 與 NLRP3，接著危險訊號活化 NLRP3 發炎小體，招募 ASC 與 caspase-1，將 pro-IL-1β 切割成成熟的 17 kDa 分泌型。

links.context: IL-22 signals through IL-22R on thymic epithelial cells to drive their proliferation and survival, raising thymic cellularity after total body irradiation (Dudakov et al., 2012). IL-22-deficient mice show impaired immune recovery, and loss of CD4/CD8 double-positive thymocytes triggers IL-23-driven ILC production of IL-22 that feeds back into thymic regeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-22 透過胸腺上皮細胞上的 IL-22R 訊號促進其增殖與存活，在全身輻射後提高胸腺細胞數（Dudakov et al., 2012）。IL-22 缺乏小鼠的免疫恢復受損；CD4/CD8 雙陽性胸腺細胞的流失會觸發 IL-23 驅動的 ILC 產生 IL-22，再回頭促進胸腺再生。

links.context: IL-4 binding to IL-4Rα activates JAK1 and JAK3, which phosphorylate STAT6; STAT6 then drives GATA3, CCL17, CCL22 and MUC5AC transcription, defining the type 2 immune program. IL-13 uses the same IL-4Rα subunit and STAT6 axis.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-4 與 IL-4Rα 結合後活化 JAK1 與 JAK3，進而使 STAT6 磷酸化；STAT6 隨後驅動 GATA3、CCL17、CCL22 與 MUC5AC 的轉錄，定義第二型免疫程式。IL-13 使用相同的 IL-4Rα 次單元與 STAT6 軸。

links.context: IL-4 is indispensable for IgE class switching in B cells; IL-4-deficient mice fail to produce IgE and have impaired anti-helminth immunity. This is why dupilumab, an anti-IL-4Rα antibody blocking both IL-4 and IL-13, is approved for type 2 inflammatory disease.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-4 對 B 細胞的 IgE 類別轉換不可或缺；IL-4 缺乏小鼠無法產生 IgE，且抗蠕蟲免疫受損。這也是為何阻斷 IL-4 與 IL-13 的抗 IL-4Rα 抗體 dupilumab 獲准用於第二型發炎性疾病。

links.context: IL-6 signals through the interleukin-6 receptor, the ligand-binding subunit that must associate with gp130 to transduce a signal. In the SASP this is the entry point of the autocrine amplification loop: secreted IL-6 acts on IL-6R in the same or neighbouring cells, which is one reason IL-6 is described as both an output and a driver of the senescent secretory programme. Soluble IL-6R generated by shedding or alternative splicing extends the loop to cells that lack membrane IL-6R, broadening the set of cells that can respond.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6 經介白素-6 受體訊號，該受體為配體結合次單元，必須與 gp130 結合才能傳遞訊號。在 SASP 中，這是自泌放大環路的進入點：分泌的 IL-6 作用於同一或鄰近細胞的 IL-6R，這也是 IL-6 同時被描述為衰老分泌程序的輸出與驅動者的原因之一。由切割或替代剪接產生的可溶性 IL-6R 可將此環路延伸至缺乏膜性 IL-6R 的細胞，擴大可回應的細胞範圍。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: IL-6R (CD126) is the ligand-binding subunit of the IL-6 receptor complex and has no intrinsic enzymatic activity. IL-6 binds IL-6R at site I, the binary complex then recruits gp130 at site II to form a 2:2:2 hexamer, and gp130 dimerization brings JAK1, JAK2 and TYK2 together to phosphorylate STAT3.
links.context_zh_TW: IL-6R（CD126）是 IL-6 受體複合體的配體結合次單元，本身不具酵素活性。IL-6 先在 site I 與 IL-6R 結合，該二元複合體再於 site II 招募 gp130 形成 2:2:2 六聚體，gp130 二聚化使 JAK1、JAK2 與 TYK2 聚集並使 STAT3 磷酸化。

links.context: IL-8 (CXCL8) is a prototypical SASP chemokine secreted by senescent cells, essential for neutrophil recruitment and, in tumors, cancer stemness via CXCR2 signaling. It is co-induced with IL-6 downstream of NF-kB and IL-1a and is frequently measured alongside IL-6 as a SASP readout. IL-8's roles in both inflammation and tumor promotion underscore the dual nature of the secretome, supporting wound-healing neutrophil influx acutely while contributing to chronic inflammation and therapy resistance. It is a canonical component of the senescent secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: 介白素-8（IL-8）與 IL-6 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。IL-8 由衰老細胞分泌，重塑局部組織微環境並對鄰近細胞發揮旁分泌效應。在本研究中，重組 IL-8（以 1:2 比例與 IL-6 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現，此現象可由衰老細胞共培養重現，導致脂質過氧化升高並使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

links.context: IL6 is a representative SASP gene whose expression is suppressed upon mitochondrial clearance, with coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation at its locus and mRNA expression. Acetate supplementation induces expression of IL6 alongside IL8, IL1B and CCL2, while MPC1 deletion or SLC25A1 inhibition reduces these factors. In aged mice, CTPI2 treatment reduces expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines including Il6 and Il1b in skeletal muscle, and their expression negatively correlates with muscle strength, indicating that mitochondrial acetyl-CoA-dependent histone acetylation gates the secretion of IL-6 as part of the senescent inflammatory programme.
links.context_zh_TW: IL6 是具代表性的 SASP 基因，其表現會隨粒線體清除而受到抑制，其基因座上的染色質乙醯化與 mRNA 表現同步下降。乙酸補充會誘導 IL6 與 IL8、IL1B 及 CCL2 一同表現，而 MPC1 缺失或 SLC25A1 抑制則會降低這些因子。在老年小鼠中，CTPI2 治療降低骨骼肌中包括 Il6 與 Il1b 在內的促發炎細胞激素表現，且其表現與肌肉力量呈負相關，顯示粒線體乙醯-CoA 依賴的組蛋白乙醯化調控著 IL-6 作為衰老發炎程式一部分的分泌。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: IPF is a paradigm of senescence-driven pathology. Aged lung fibroblasts accumulate senescence markers and secrete a pro-fibrotic SASP including IL-11, leukotrienes and TGFβ, which recruits immune cells and sustains a fibrogenic loop that resists normal repair. SIRT1 downregulation in IPF de-represses IL-11 transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: IPF 是衰老驅動病理的典範。老化的肺纖維母細胞累積衰老標記並分泌促纖維化的 SASP（包含 IL-11、白三烯與 TGFβ），招募免疫細胞並維持抗拒正常修復的纖維生成迴路。IPF 中 SIRT1 的下调使 IL-11 轉錄去抑制。

links.context: IRE1 senses ER stress and splices XBP1 mRNA to produce the active transcription factor XBP1s. The IRE1-XBP1 arm then activates the autophagy genes Beclin1 and BAG3 as part of the UPR-autophagy intersection.
links.context_zh_TW: IRE1 感知 ER 壓力並剪接 XBP1 mRNA，產生具活性的轉錄因子 XBP1s；IRE1-XBP1 分支隨後活化自噬基因 Beclin1 與 BAG3，構成 UPR 與自噬的交會點。

links.context: IRE1 uses its RNase domain to splice XBP1 mRNA, producing the XBP1s transcription factor that expands ER folding capacity. It is one of three proximal UPR sensors, alongside PERK and ATF6.
links.context_zh_TW: IRE1 利用其 RNase 結構域剪接 XBP1 mRNA，產生可擴大內質網摺疊能力的 XBP1s 轉錄因子。它是三個近端 UPR 感測器之一，與 PERK 及 ATF6 並列。

links.context: ITPR2 is the gene encoding inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 2 (IP3R2), an isoform of the IP3 receptor family that mediates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytosol.
links.context_zh_TW: ITPR2 是編碼肌醇 1,4,5-三磷酸受體第 2 型（IP3R2）的基因，屬於 IP3 受體家族的異構型，負責將鈣離子由內質網釋放至細胞質。

links.context: If ER stress is unresolved, the Unfolded Protein Response switches from pro-survival to pro-apoptotic: ATF4 drives the pro-apoptotic transcription factor CHOP, which downregulates Bcl-2, upregulates BIM and induces ERO1α, causing ER hyper-oxidation, calcium release and mitochondrial sensitisation to cytochrome c release. CHOP acts in parallel with IRE1-JNK signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 若 ER 壓力無法緩解，Unfolded Protein Response 會由促存活轉為促凋亡：ATF4 驅動促凋亡轉錄因子 CHOP，下調 Bcl-2、上調 BIM 並誘導 ERO1α，造成 ER 過氧化、鈣離子釋放，使粒線體對 cytochrome c 釋放敏感。CHOP 與 IRE1-JNK 訊號平行作用。

links.context: Ifosfamide is a bifunctional nitrogen-mustard alkylating antineoplastic agent structurally related to cyclophosphamide, given as a prodrug. Hepatic CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 convert it to ifosfamide mustard, which forms DNA interstrand crosslinks, and to the neuro- and nephrotoxic chloroacetaldehyde.
links.context_zh_TW: Ifosfamide 是結構上與 cyclophosphamide 相關的雙功能氮芥類烷化抗腫瘤藥物，以前藥形式給藥。肝臟的 CYP3A4 與 CYP2B6 將其轉為形成 DNA 鏈間交聯的 ifosfamide mustard，以及具神經毒性与腎毒性的 chloroacetaldehyde。

links.context: Imatinib is the prototype tyrosine-kinase inhibitor targeting BCR-ABL, c-KIT and PDGFR. Its inhibition of c-KIT is the basis of its activity in KIT-mutant gastrointestinal stromal tumors, and it is the classic single-target KIT inhibitor against which multi-targeted agents such as pazopanib are contrasted.
links.context_zh_TW: Imatinib 是標靶 BCR-ABL、c-KIT 與 PDGFR 的原型酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。其對 c-KIT 的抑制是它在 KIT 突變型胃腸道間質腫瘤中的活性基礎，也是與 pazopanib 等多標的藥物對照時的典型單一標的 KIT 抑制劑。

links.context: Immune Checkpoint includes PD-L1. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with Immune Checkpoint acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
links.context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 包括PD-L1。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，Immune Checkpoint 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

links.context: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: Immune Checkpoint is targeted by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Immune checkpoint inhibitors are antibodies that release the brakes on T cells by blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4 interactions. The directionality runs from Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors toward Immune Checkpoint, so Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 是 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 的目標。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是透過阻斷 PD-1/PD-L1 或 CTLA-4 交互作用來釋放 T 細胞煞車作用的抗體。方向性從 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 向 Immune Checkpoint 延伸，因此 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

links.context: Immune surveillance is the continuous monitoring of tissues by the immune system to detect and eliminate pathogens, malignant cells and senescent cells. Senescent cells are normally cleared by natural killer cells and macrophages recognizing surface ligands such as NKG2D ligands and SASP components.
links.context_zh_TW: 免疫監視是指免疫系統持續監控組織，以偵測並清除病原體、惡性細胞與衰老細胞。衰老細胞正常情況下會被辨識到細胞表面配體（如 NKG2D 配體與 SASP 成分）的自然殺手細胞與巨噬細胞清除。

links.context: Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: Immunotherapy treats Cancer by activating anti-tumor immunity rather than by directly killing tumor cells. Its modalities include checkpoint blockade (CTLA-4, PD-1/PD-L1), CAR-T and TIL cell therapies, bispecific engagers, and therapeutic vaccines.
links.context_zh_TW: Immunotherapy（免疫療法）藉由活化抗腫瘤免疫而非直接殺傷腫瘤細胞來治療 Cancer（癌症）。其手段包含檢查點阻斷（CTLA-4、PD-1/PD-L1）、CAR-T 與 TIL 細胞療法、雙特異性接合分子，以及治療性疫苗。

links.context: Impaired mitophagy is a common feature of several neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and Huntington's disease. In these disorders, the accumulation of damaged mitochondria exacerbates oxidative stress, metabolic disruption, and neuronal death. Defects can arise from mutations in PINK1 or Parkin, from tau or amyloid-beta pathology, or from disrupted transport of autophagosomes. Restoring mitophagy is therefore a major therapeutic goal for neuroprotection.
links.context_zh_TW: Mitophagy 受損是多種神經退化性疾病的常見特徵，包括阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、ALS 和亨丁頓氏症。在這些疾病中，受損粒線體的累積加劇氧化壓力、代謝紊亂和神經元死亡。缺陷可源於 PINK1 或 Parkin 突變、tau 或 amyloid-beta 病理，或自噬體運輸受擾。因此恢復 mitophagy 是神經保護的主要治療目標。

links.context: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy. In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1. Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
links.context_zh_TW: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy。In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1。Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
links.context_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

links.context: In 1972 Denham Harman refined his free radical theory into the mitochondrial free radical theory of aging, specifically implicating mitochondria as the primary source and the primary target of reactive oxygen species. This localisation sharpened the earlier theory by assigning both origin and damage site to one organelle.
links.context_zh_TW: 1972 年，Denham Harman 將其 free radical theory 精煉為 mitochondrial free radical theory of aging，明確指出 mitochondria 是 reactive oxygen species 的主要來源與主要標的。此項定位為較早的理論增加了精確度，把起源與損傷部位同時指派給同一胞器。

links.context: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
links.context_zh_TW: 2003 年，Sinclair 展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，後來在高等生物中展示了類似效應，將其發現為第一個 STAC。在方向性上，此發現位於 STAC 概念的上游。這催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，至今仍是老年科學的開創性發現。透過鑑定一種活化 sirtuin 的天然化合物，Sinclair 為藥理學地介入長壽途徑提供了原型。STAC 概念自那以後推動了尋找更強效和更具選擇性的 sirtuin 活化劑用於治療。

links.context: In Alzheimer's disease, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial bioenergetics disrupted by amyloid-beta toxicity, partially through deacetylation of mitochondrial p53 at Lys320, a modification crucial for maintaining energy homeostasis and neuronal survival. SIRT3 mRNA expression declines progressively in AD clinical specimens and rodent models, and SIRT3 levels inversely associate with tau protein deposition, supporting SIRT3 as a mitochondrial checkpoint and candidate biomarker in AD.
links.context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症中，SIRT3 增強被澱粉樣蛋白-beta 毒性破壞的粒線體生物能學，部分透過在 Lys320 處去乙醯化粒線體 p53，此修飾對於維持能量恆定和神經元存活至關重要。SIRT3 mRNA 表現在 AD 臨床標本和囓齒動物模型中進行性下降，且 SIRT3 水平與 tau 蛋白沉積呈負相關，支持 SIRT3 作為 AD 中的粒線體檢查點和候選生物標記。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In BRASTO mice, hypothalamic SIRT1 deacetylates the transcription factor NKX2-1, which drives expression of the orexin type 2 receptor (OX2R); increased OX2R in DMH/LH raises neural activity, physical activity, and energy expenditure, underpinning the approximately 11% lifespan extension. This positions the SIRT1-to-NKX2-1-to-OX2R pathway as a hypothalamic longevity axis that mimics calorie restriction. By increasing physical activity and energy expenditure through orexin signaling, SIRT1 promotes a CR-like metabolic state. This brain-centered mechanism demonstrates that sirtuin effects on lifespan can be mediated through neural control of energy balance.
links.context_zh_TW: 在BRASTO小鼠中，下丘腦SIRT1去乙醯化轉錄因子NKX2-1，後者驅動食慾素第2型受體（OX2R）的表達；DMH/LH中OX2R的增加提升了神經活動、身體活動和能量消耗，支撐了約11%的壽命延長。這將SIRT1-NKX2-1-OX2R通路定位為一種模擬熱量限制的下丘腦長壽軸。透過食慾素訊號增加身體活動和能量消耗，SIRT1促進了類CR的代謝狀態。這種以大腦為中心的機制表明，sirtuin對壽命的影響可以透過神經控制能量平衡來介導。

links.context: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
links.context_zh_TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

links.context: In C. elegans, glucose restriction normally raises mitochondrial respiration and ROS, inducing catalase and extending lifespan; NAC pre-treatment completely abolished both the ROS rise and the longevity benefit. NAC is the strongest direct evidence that scavenging the ROS signal blocks mitohormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，葡萄糖限制通常升高粒線體呼吸與 ROS，誘發 catalase 並延長壽命；NAC 預處理完全廢除 ROS 升高與長壽益處。NAC 是最強的直接證據，顯示清除 ROS 訊號會阻斷粒線體促效應。

links.context: In C. elegans, proteotoxic stress blocks import of the transcription factor ATFS-1; the protein is excluded from mitochondria, traffics to the nucleus and, with DVE-1 and UBL-5, induces chaperones (HSP-6/mtHSP70) and proteases such as LONP. The same nuclear output in mammals is driven by the ATF4/ATF5/CHOP integrated stress response axis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，蛋白毒性壓力阻斷轉錄因子 ATFS-1 的輸入；該蛋白被排除於粒線體之外而運送至細胞核，並與 DVE-1、UBL-5 共同誘導 chaperone（HSP-6/mtHSP70）與 LONP 等蛋白酶。在哺乳類中，相同的核內輸出由 ATF4/ATF5/CHOP 的 integrated stress response 軸驅動。

links.context: In C. elegans, the MAX-like transcription factor MXL-3 represses transcription of lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) when food is abundant, limiting lipid mobilization. This repression maintains lipid storage under fed conditions and is relieved during fasting, allowing lipolysis. MXL-3 thus acts as a nutritional gatekeeper of lysosomal lipid catabolism, analogous to MYC's repression of lysosomal programs in mammals. Its activity positions lipid degradation within the broader nutrient-responsive regulatory network.
links.context_zh_TW: 在線蟲 C. elegans 中，MAX 樣轉錄因子 MXL-3 在食物充裕時抑制溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的轉錄，限制脂質動員。此抑制在進食條件下維持脂質儲存，並在禁食期間解除，允許脂解作用。因此 MXL-3 作為溶酶體脂質分解代謝的營養閘門，類似於 MYC 在哺乳動物中對溶酶體程序的抑制。其活性將脂質降解定位於更廣泛的營養反應性調節網絡中。

links.context: In Huntington's disease, SIRT3 maintains mitochondrial dynamics by suppressing fission regulators such as Fis1 and Drp1, preserving mitochondrial morphology and promoting efficient axonal transport. In Drosophila HD models, transgenic expression of the SIRT3 ortholog dSirt2 significantly attenuates neuropil degeneration and prolongs organismal longevity, reinforcing conserved neuroprotective functions of SIRT3 across species.
links.context_zh_TW: 在亨丁頓氏症中，SIRT3 透過抑制分裂調節因子如 Fis1 和 Drp1 維護粒線體動態，保持粒線體形態並促進有效的軸突運輸。在果蠅 HD 模型中，SIRT3 直系同源物 dSirt2 的轉基因表達顯著減輕神經 neuropil 退化並延長生物體壽命，增強了 SIRT3 跨物種的保守性神經保護功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In K-RAS mutated cancers hyperactive ERK1/2 phosphorylates and inactivates PTPN5 (Ser221), locking BAK in its inactive phosphorylated state and conferring profound resistance to apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 K-RAS 突變癌症中，過度活化的 ERK1/2 會磷酸化並使 PTPN5（Ser221）失活，將 BAK 鎖定於失活且帶磷酸的狀態，造成嚴重的凋亡抵抗。

links.context: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

links.context: In Parkinson's disease, SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1), a mitochondrial fission protein implicated in pathological fragmentation, restores mitochondrial dynamics, protects against dopaminergic neuronal loss, and ameliorates motor deficits in murine models. SIRT3 concurrently scavenges ROS, preserves electron transport chain integrity, and promotes mitochondrial autophagy, attenuating neurodegeneration in midbrain dopaminergic populations.
links.context_zh_TW: 在巴金森氏症中，SIRT3 介導的 dynamin 相關蛋白 1（DRP1）去乙醯化（一種與病理性碎片化相關的粒線體分裂蛋白）恢復粒線體動態、保護多巴胺ergic 神經元免於喪失，並改善囓齒動物模型中的運動缺陷。SIRT3 同時清除活性氧、維護電子傳遞鏈完整性並促進粒線體自噬，減輕中腦多巴胺ergic 群體的神經退化。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In Parkinson's disease, toxic α-synuclein (α-Syn) binds to the TOM20 receptor on the outer mitochondrial membrane. This binding blocks protein import into Mitochondria by 50%–60%, triggering ROS production and the accumulation of damaged mitochondria, thereby contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired Mitophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，有毒的 α-synuclein (α-Syn) 會結合外層粒線體膜上的 TOM20 受體。此結合使進入 Mitochondria 的蛋白質輸入被阻斷 50%–60%，觸發 ROS 產生與受損粒線體累積，進而促成粒線體功能失調與受損的 Mitophagy。

links.context: In Parthanatos, free PAR chains bind Hexokinase-1 through its PAR-binding motif and inhibit catalysis, driving VDAC dissociation and cytosolic translocation with loss of activity. Purified PAR directly inhibits hexokinase in neuronal and glioblastoma lysates whereas PARG-predigested PAR does not, and PBM-mutant HK1 resists PAR inhibition — decisive evidence for a direct binding model.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 Parthanatos 中，游離的 PAR 鏈透過 PAR 結合基序與 Hexokinase-1 結合並抑制其催化活性，導致 VDAC 解離、轉位至細胞質並伴隨活性喪失。純化的 PAR 可直接抑制神經元與膠質母細胞瘤裂解液中的己糖激酶，而經 PARG 預消解的 PAR 則無此效果；帶有 PBM 突變的 HK1 能抵抗 PAR 抑制——這是直接結合模型最具決定性的證據。

links.context: In a head-to-head screen of ten flavonoid polyphenols on senescent Ercc1-/- murine embryonic fibroblasts and etoposide-senescent IMR90 human fibroblasts, Fisetin at 5 uM was the most effective at reducing the SA-beta-gal-positive fraction, whereas Quercetin at the same dose was ineffective. This positioned Fisetin as the top senotherapeutic candidate for in vivo testing.
links.context_zh_TW: 在針對十種類黃酮多酚的頭對頭篩選中，於衰老的 Ercc1-/- 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞與 etoposide 誘導衰老的 IMR90 人類纖維母細胞中，5 uM 的 Fisetin 是降低 SA-beta-gal 陽性細胞比例最有效的化合物，而同劑量的 Quercetin 則無效果。這使 Fisetin 成為體內試驗的首選 senotherapeutic 候選藥物。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan.md

links.context: In a mouse liver cancer model, increased SIRT6 expression reduces survivin expression by deacetylating H3K9Ac at the survivin promoter, and this induces apoptosis during cancer initiation. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of survivin suppression and prevention of tumor initiation. By silencing survivin, an anti-apoptotic factor, SIRT6 removes a key block to programmed cell death in early tumor cells. This allows damaged or transformed cells to undergo apoptosis rather than expand into tumors. The finding links SIRT6's epigenetic control of a critical survival gene to its tumor-suppressive activity in the liver.
links.context_zh_TW: 在小鼠肝癌模型中，增加的SIRT6表達透過去乙醯化存活素啟動子上的H3K9Ac來減少存活素表達，這在癌症起始期間誘導凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於存活素抑制和腫瘤起始預防的上游。透過沉默存活素（一種抗凋亡因子），SIRT6移除了早期腫瘤細胞中程式性細胞死亡的關鍵阻礙。這使得受損或轉化細胞能夠經歷凋亡而非擴展為腫瘤。此發現將SIRT6對關鍵存活基因的表觀遺傳控制與其在肝臟中的腫瘤抑制活性聯繫起來。

links.context: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。
links.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

links.context: In atherosclerosis, SIRT3 promotes AMPK activation and modulates the activity of uncoupling protein-1 (UCP1), thereby suppressing oxidized-LDL-induced foam cell formation. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced macrophage lipid loading. Gut microbiota-derived metabolites further influence the SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a axis that antagonizes lipogenic programming governed by the SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 cascade, indicating functional linkage between SIRT3 activity and host-microbiome interactions in vascular disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在動脈粥狀硬化中，SIRT3 促進 AMPK 活化並調節解偶聯蛋白 1 (UCP1) 的活性，從而抑制氧化 LDL 誘導的泡沫細胞形成。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於巨噬細胞脂質負荷減少的上游。腸道微生物群衍生的代謝物進一步影響 SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a 軸，該軸拮抗由 SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 級聯控制的脂肪生成程序，顯示血管疾病中 SIRT3 活性與宿主微生物組相互作用之間的功能連結。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In basal-like breast cancer, SIRT2 maintains the protein stability of Slug, an epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) transcription factor, through deacetylation. Stabilized Slug contributes to the robust tumorigenic activity of basal-like breast cancer, along with its enhanced invasive and metastatic capabilities. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Slug-dependent EMT and tumor progression. By protecting Slug from degradation, SIRT2 sustains the mesenchymal program that drives invasion and metastasis in this aggressive breast cancer subtype.
links.context_zh_TW: 在基底樣乳腺癌中，SIRT2透過去乙醯化維持Slug（一種上皮-間質轉化EMT轉錄因子）的蛋白穩定性。穩定化的Slug與其增強的侵襲和轉移能力一起，促進了基底樣乳腺癌的強大致瘤活性。方向上，SIRT2位於Slug依賴性EMT和腫瘤進展的上游。透過保護Slug免受降解，SIRT2維持了驅動此侵襲性乳腺癌亞型侵襲和轉移的間質程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

links.context: In beta-glucan-trained monocytes, glutaminolysis drives fumarate accumulation, which inhibits KDM5 demethylases and preserves activating histone methylation. Exogenous fumarate alone can imprint a trained phenotype, while blocking glutaminolysis impairs training. It directly couples TCA-cycle remodeling to chromatin memory.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 beta-glucan 訓練的單核球中，glutaminolysis 驅動 Fumarate 累積，進而抑制 KDM5 Histone Demethylases 並保留活化型組蛋白甲基化。單獨給予外源性 Fumarate 即可印記 trained phenotype，而阻斷 glutaminolysis 則損害訓練。它直接將 TCA-cycle remodeling 與 chromatin memory 耦合。

links.context: In cardiomyocytes, SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis by inhibiting the FOS/AP-1 and STAT3/NFATc2 signaling pathways, complementing its GSK3beta Lys15 deacetylation that blocks Smad3 complexes. Together these transcriptional suppressions reduce ECM gene expression and pathological cardiac remodeling, establishing SIRT3 as a master anti-fibrotic node acting on multiple pro-fibrotic pathways simultaneously.
links.context_zh_TW: 在心肌細胞中，SIRT3 透過抑制 FOS/AP-1 和 STAT3/NFATc2 訊號途徑減輕纖維化，與其阻斷 Smad3 複合物的 GSK3beta Lys15 去乙醯化互補。這些轉錄抑制共同減少 ECM 基因表達和病理性心臟重塑，確立 SIRT3 作為同時作用於多個促纖維化途徑的主要抗纖維化節點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance via ROS buffering. This tumor-supportive role contrasts with SIRT3's tumor-suppressive actions in other contexts (Warburg suppression via HIF-1alpha destabilization, OGG1-mediated DNA repair, H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity), exemplifying the dualistic, context-dependent behavior of SIRT3 in cancer biology.
links.context_zh_TW: 在慢性淋巴性白血病中，SIRT3 實現代謝適應，透過活性氧緩衝賦予化療抗性。此腫瘤支持角色與 SIRT3 在其他情境中的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比（透過 HIF-1alpha 不穩定化抑制 Warburg 效應、OGG1 介導的 DNA 修復、H3K56 去乙醯化維持 NHEJ 精準度），體現了 SIRT3 在癌症生物學中的雙重性、情境依賴行為。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: In colorectal malignancies, SIRT3 optimizes serine metabolism via serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2) deacetylation at Lys95, enhancing tumor aggressiveness. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated SHMT2 activation sits upstream of intensified one-carbon metabolism supporting colorectal cancer cell proliferation and survival.
links.context_zh_TW: 在結直腸惡性腫瘤中，SIRT3 透過絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2 (SHMT2) 在 Lys95 處去乙醯化來優化絲胺酸代謝，從而增強腫瘤侵襲性。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 SHMT2 活化位於強化一碳代謝的上游，支持大腸直腸癌細胞增殖和存活。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In contrast to its S211 effect, p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 401 in a manner that promotes nuclear translocation in specific cell types such as monocytes. This site-specific divergence illustrates that p38 can either retain or activate TFEB depending on cell context and the constellation of concurrent modifications. Such opposing outcomes highlight the combinatorial code by which multiple phosphorylations determine TFEB localization. The monocyte-specific response implicates TFEB in immune cell activation and inflammatory programs.
links.context_zh_TW: 相對於其 S211 效應，p38 MAPK 以促進核轉運的方式於 serine 401 磷酸化 TFEB，此作用發生在特定細胞類型如單核細胞中。這種位點特異性分歧說明 p38 可根據細胞背景和同時存在的修飾組合，保留或活化 TFEB。這種相反結果凸顯了多種磷酸化決定 TFEB 定位的組合密碼。單核細胞特異性反應將 TFEB 牽涉進免疫細胞活化和發炎程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

links.context: In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress primarily through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway, uncoupling excessive glucose levels from electron transport chain dysfunction. SIRT3 downregulation leads to breakdown of this axis, resulting in impaired ETC activity and accelerated DCM progression.
links.context_zh_TW: 在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化主要透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並抑制氧化壓力，將過高的血糖水平與電子傳遞鏈功能障礙解偶聯。SIRT3 的下調導致此軸線的崩解，造成 ETC 活性受損和 DCM 進展加速。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects that are strictly dependent on SIRT3: lentivirus-mediated SIRT3 silencing abolishes irisin's osteoprotective efficacy against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction. SIRT3 is therefore the obligatory signaling node for irisin-mediated redox homeostasis and bone preservation in the diabetic periodontium.
links.context_zh_TW: 在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用嚴格依賴 SIRT3：慢病毒介導的 SIRT3 沉默消除 Irisin 對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的骨保護效果。因此 SIRT3 是 Irisin 介導的氧化還原恆定和糖尿病牙周組織骨保護的必要訊號節點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In dose-response comparisons across low, moderate, and high exercise intensities, all intensities improved cognition and motor outcomes, but high-intensity exercise produced the greatest BDNF upregulation alongside the strongest behavioral gains. This intensity-dependent neurotrophic response supports prescribing higher-intensity modalities such as HIIT when tolerated to maximize BDNF-TrkB signaling in neurodegenerative models.
links.context_zh_TW: 在低、中、高運動強度的劑量反應比較中，所有強度均改善認知與運動結果，但 High-Intensity Exercise 產生最大的 BDNF 上調並伴隨最強的行為改善。此強度依賴的神經營養反應支持在可耐受時優先採用 HIIT 等高強度模式，以最大化神經退化模型中的 BDNF-TrkB 訊號。

links.context: In eukaryotes and archaea selenocysteine is synthesized on its tRNA; PSTK acts immediately upstream of the selenium-incorporation step performed by SepSecS, so PSTK is essential for Sec biosynthesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在真核生物與古菌中，selenocysteine 是在其 tRNA 上合成的；PSTK 作用於 SepSecS 執行硒導入步驟的緊上游，因此 PSTK 對 Sec 生合成至關重要。

links.context: In glioblastoma models, SIRT3 promotes nucleotide biosynthesis by deacetylating glycine decarboxylase (GLDC) at Lys514. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated GLDC activation sits upstream of expanded nucleotide pools fueling glioblastoma proliferation. Together with PYCR1 and SHMT2 regulation, this underscores how SIRT3's control of amino-acid metabolism can be co-opted to support aggressive tumor growth in specific contexts.
links.context_zh_TW: 在膠質母細胞瘤模型中，SIRT3 透過在 Lys514 處去乙醯甘氨酸脫羧酶 (GLDC) 來促進核苷酸生物合成。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的 GLDC 活化位於擴大的核苷酸庫的上游，促進膠質母細胞瘤增殖。與 PYCR1 和 SHMT2 調節一起，這強調了 SIRT3 對氨基酸代謝的控制如何能夠在特定情況下支持侵襲性腫瘤生長。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In heart-specific Sirt1 transgenic mice, low (2.5-fold) to moderate (7.5-fold) overexpression retarded age-dependent cardiac hypertrophy, apoptosis, fibrosis, dysfunction, and senescence-marker expression. In contrast, high (12.5-fold) expression increased apoptosis and hypertrophy, leading to cardiomyopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在心臟特異性 Sirt1 轉基因小鼠中，低（2.5 倍）至中（7.5 倍）表達可延緩年齡相關的心臟肥大、凋亡、纖維化、功能障礙和衰老標記表達。相反，高（12.5 倍）表達會增加凋亡和肥大，導致心肌病。
links.source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md

links.context: In hepatic fibrosis models, SIRT3 has been implicated in mediating the anti-fibrotic effects of withaferin A, an effect that is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice. This finding reinforces SIRT3's role as an indispensable molecular effector of pharmacological anti-fibrotic agents, consistent with its central suppressive function across hepatic, pulmonary, cardiac, and renal fibrosis models.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝纖維化模型中，SIRT3 被認為參與介導 withaferin A 的抗纖維化作用，此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除。此發現增強了 SIRT3 作為藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器的角色，與其在肝、肺、心和腎纖維化模型中的核心抑制功能一致。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

links.context: In hepatocellular carcinoma, a major mechanism of sorafenib's anti-tumor activity is induction of ferroptosis: it depletes glutathione and inactivates GPX4, causing lipid peroxidation and iron-dependent death that is rescued by ferrostatin-1 and liproxstatin-1.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 hepatocellular carcinoma 中，sorafenib 抗腫瘤活性的主要機制之一是誘發 ferroptosis：它耗盡 glutathione 並使 GPX4 失活，造成脂質過氧化與鐵依賴性死亡，而此現象可被 ferrostatin-1 與 liproxstatin-1 搶救。

links.context: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

links.context: In hepatocytes, SIRT6 restrains gluconeogenesis by activating the acetyltransferase GCN5. Once active, GCN5 increases acetylation of the transcriptional coactivator PGC-1alpha, which inhibits its activity and thereby limits glucose output from the liver. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of GCN5-mediated PGC-1alpha inhibition. This mode of control is functionally distinct from SIRT6's direct deacetylation of GCN5 in other contexts, illustrating the context-dependence of sirtuin-acetyltransferase interplay.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT6透過活化乙醯轉移酶GCN5來抑制糖質新生。GCN5活化後增加轉錄共活化因子PGC-1alpha的乙醯化，抑制其活性，從而限制肝臟的葡萄糖輸出。方向上，SIRT6位於GCN5介導的PGC-1alpha抑制的上游。這種控制模式在功能上與SIRT6在其他環境中對GCN5的直接去乙醯化不同，說明了sirtuin-乙醯轉移酶相互作用的環境依賴性。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

links.context: In human colorectal cancer, SIRT2-dependent deacetylation of the metabolic enzyme IDH1 represses cancer cell migration and invasion both in vitro and in vivo. This regulation of IDH1 influences cellular metabolism and inhibits the formation of liver metastases. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of IDH1 sits upstream of suppressed colorectal cancer metastasis. By modulating IDH1 and the metabolic state of the tumor cell, SIRT2 limits the invasive capacity that drives metastatic spread. This positions SIRT2 as a suppressor of colorectal cancer progression and indicates that preserving SIRT2 activity, or mimicking its effects, could restrain metastasis in this malignancy.
links.context_zh_TW: 在人類大腸直腸癌中，SIRT2依賴性的代謝酶IDH1去乙醯化在體外和體內抑制癌細胞遷移和侵襲。此IDH1的調節影響細胞代謝並抑制肝臟轉移瘤的形成。方向上，SIRT2對IDH1的酵素修飾位於大腸直腸癌轉移抑制的上游。透過調節IDH1和腫瘤細胞的代謝狀態，SIRT2限制了驅動轉移性擴散的侵襲能力。這將SIRT2定位為大腸直腸癌進展的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT2活性或模擬其效果可能限制此惡性腫瘤的轉移。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

links.context: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
links.context_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: In humans, SIRT6 is necessary to maintain the telomere position effect. SIRT6 was discovered as the first enzyme that modifies histones to regulate the telomere position effect in human cells, a novel role for SIRT6 in the regulation of age-related genome silencing. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of telomeric chromatin silencing, providing a new approach for telomere chromatin silencing and linking SIRT6 to telomere biology and genome stability.
links.context_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT6對於維持端粒位置效應是必要的。SIRT6被發現為第一個修飾組蛋白以調節人類細胞中端粒位置效應的酶，這是SIRT6在調節與年齡相關的基因組沉默方面的新角色。方向上，SIRT6位於端粒染色質沉默的上游，為端粒染色質沉默提供了新的方法，並將SIRT6與端粒生物學和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: In humans, SIRT7 takes part in the genesis of colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and luminal breast cancer. SIRT7 is overexpressed in multiple cancer tissues, promoting the survival of cancer cells and the maintenance of a transformed state. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of tumorigenesis in these cancer types, and its overexpression supports the transformed phenotype across a broad range of tumours.
links.context_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT7參與大腸直腸癌、胃癌和管腔型乳腺癌的發生。SIRT7在多種癌症組織中過表達，促進癌細胞的存活和轉化狀態的維持。方向上，SIRT7位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤發生的上游，其過表達在廣泛的腫瘤中支持轉化表型。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

links.context: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: In mammary carcinoma, SIRT3 inhibits Src kinase oxidation to suppress metastatic dissemination. Directionally, SIRT3-controlled redox state sits upstream of restrained Src-driven migratory signaling. This illustrates a tumor-suppressive facet of SIRT3's ROS management, whereby maintenance of mitochondrial redox homeostasis prevents oxidative activation of pro-metastatic kinases.
links.context_zh_TW: 在乳癌中，SIRT3 抑制 Src 激酶氧化以抑制轉移擴散。從方向上看，SIRT3 控制的氧化還原狀態位於受抑制的 Src 驅動的遷移訊號的上游。這說明了 SIRT3 ROS 管理的腫瘤抑制方面，即維持粒線體氧化還原穩態可防止促轉移激酶的氧化活化。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
links.context_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

links.context: In mice on a high-calorie diet, resveratrol increases mitochondrial number and function, an effect accompanied by elevated SIRT1 and PGC-1α activity. This shift counters diet-induced metabolic dysfunction by improving oxidative capacity, increasing endurance, and protecting against the metabolic consequences of overnutrition. Directionally, resveratrol activates SIRT1/PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis. The finding, from Baur and Sinclair's 2006 study in Cell, helped popularize resveratrol as a caloric-restriction mimetic against diet-induced obesity and demonstrated that a small molecule could reproduce key metabolic benefits of dietary restriction in mammals.
links.context_zh_TW: 在高熱量飲食小鼠中，白藜蘆醇增加粒線體數量和功能，這種效應伴隨著 SIRT1 和 PGC-1α 活性的升高。這種轉變通過提高氧化能力、增加耐力和保護對抗過度營養的代謝後果來對抗飲食誘導的代謝功能障礙。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇活化 SIRT1/PGC-1α 以驅動粒線體生物合成。這一發現來自 Baur 和 Sinclair 2006 年在 Cell 上的研究，幫助推廣白藜蘆醇作為熱量限制模擬物對抗飲食誘導的肥胖，並證明小分子可以在哺乳動物中重現飲食限制的關鍵代謝益處。

links.context: In mitochondria SHMT2 converts Serine to glycine plus a one-carbon unit; this is the dominant entry point of one-carbon metabolism in proliferating and cancer cells, supplying nucleotides, NADPH and methylation capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: 在線粒體中 SHMT2 將 Serine 轉換為 glycine 與一個一碳單位；這是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳代謝的主要入口，供應核苷酸、NADPH 與甲基化能力。

links.context: In mitohormesis, elevated ROS activates the Keap1/NRF2/ARE pathway, driving transcription of cytoprotective vitagenes. This increases antioxidant enzymes, Hsp70, heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), neurotrophic factors, plus sirtuin and glutathione redox systems. The resulting adaptive stress response has longer-lasting protection than conventional antioxidants, especially in neurons.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 mitohormesis 中，升高的 ROS 會活化 Keap1/NRF2/ARE Pathway，驅動細胞保護性 Vitagenes 的轉錄。此過程增加抗氧化酶、Hsp70、heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)、神經營養因子，以及 sirtuin 與穀胱甘肽氧化還原系統。所產生的適應性壓力反應比傳統抗氧化劑具有更持久的保護作用，尤其在神經元中。

links.context: In most cancer contexts, excessive mitochondrial fission plays a causal role in promoting cancer cell transformation, proliferation, migration, invasion, metastasis and drug resistance. Many tumors exhibit fragmented mitochondria with upregulated DRP1 and decreased MFN1 and MFN2 across ovarian cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, lung, colon and breast cancer, neuroblastoma and glioblastoma. Increased DRP1 or DRP1-Ser616 phosphorylation prevents apoptosis, alters metabolism, induces immune escape and sustains cell cycle progression, so DRP1 inhibition with agents such as Mdivi-1 may decrease tumor proliferation and invasion, though fusion can also support tumor survival in some contexts.
links.context_zh_TW: 在大多數癌症情境中，過度的粒線體分裂在促進癌細胞轉化、增殖、遷移、侵襲、轉移和抗藥性方面扮演因果角色。許多腫瘤在卵巢癌、肝細胞癌、肺癌、結腸癌和乳癌、神經母細胞瘤和膠質母細胞瘤中，呈現粒線體碎片化，並伴隨 DRP1 上調以及 MFN1 和 MFN2 下調。DRP1 或 DRP1-Ser616 磷酸化增加可阻止細胞凋亡、改變代謝、誘導免疫逃逸並維持細胞週期進程，因此使用 Mdivi-1 等藥物抑制 DRP1 可能降低腫瘤增殖和侵襲，但融合在某些情境中也可能支持腫瘤存活。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: In mouse embryonic fibroblasts, SIRT1 rescues cells from PML-mediated premature senescence by deacetylating and inhibiting p53, relieving the senescence program. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of senescence rescue. This requires the PML-p53-SIRT1 nuclear-body axis, and it shows SIRT1 can oppose proliferative arrest when appropriately engaged. By deacetylating p53 within PML nuclear bodies, SIRT1 dampens the p53-dependent senescence checkpoint. This dual role—promoting survival in normal cells but potentially enabling cancer-cell proliferation—illustrates the context-dependence of SIRT1's functions.
links.context_zh_TW: 在小鼠胚胎成纖維細胞中，SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 p53 從 PML 誘導的過早衰老中拯救細胞，解除衰老程式。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於拯救衰老的上游。這需要 PML-p53-SIRT1 核體軸線，並表明 SIRT1 在適當啟動時可以對抗增殖停滯。透過在 PML 核體中去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 削弱 p53 依賴性的衰老檢查點。這種雙重角色——在正常細胞中促進存活但可能使癌細胞增殖——說明了 SIRT1 功能的情境依賴性。

links.context: In mouse models engineered to develop Alzheimer's-like pathology, caloric restriction prevents accumulation of β-amyloid neuropathology, an effect consistent with SIRT1-driven reductions in neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. CR also preserves cognitive function and synaptic integrity in these models. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of reduced amyloid burden. This supports the hypothesis that CR protects the brain through sirtuin-mediated resilience, and is consistent with SIRT1's promotion of the non-amyloidogenic α-secretase ADAM10. Human translation remains uncertain, but the findings motivate lifestyle interventions and NAD+-boosting strategies in neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: 在被設計發展出阿茲海默症樣病變的小鼠模型中，熱量限制防止 β-amyloid 神經病理學的累積，這種效應與 SIRT1 驅動的神經發炎和氧化壓力減少一致。CR 還在這些模型中保留認知功能和突觸完整性。在方向性上，熱量限制位於減少澱粉樣蛋白負擔的上游。這支持了 CR 通過 sirtuin 介導的韌性保護大腦的假說，與 SIRT1 促進非澱粉樣生成的 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 一致。人類轉化仍然不確定，但這些發現為神經退行性疾病中的生活方式干預和 NAD+ 提升策略提供了動力。

links.context: In oral squamous cell carcinomas, SIRT3 is overexpressed, and its downregulation has antiproliferative activity and sensitizes carcinoma cells to radiation and to cisplatin. This contrasts with SIRT3's broader tumor-suppressive role in mouse models, showing that sirtuin function is context-dependent. Directionally, elevated SIRT3 supports tumor growth and therapy resistance in this cancer type, while SIRT3 loss restores sensitivity. The finding highlights that a single sirtuin can be either protective or oncogenic depending on tumor type and molecular background.
links.context_zh_TW: 在口腔鱗狀細胞癌中，SIRT3 過量表現，其下調具有抗增殖活性並使癌細胞對放射治療和 Cisplatin 敏感。這與 SIRT3 在小鼠模型中更廣泛的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比，顯示 sirtuin 功能具有情境依賴性。方向性上，SIRT3 升高在此癌種中支持腫瘤生長和治療抗性，而 SIRT3 缺失恢復敏感性。此發現凸顯了單一 sirtuin 根據腫瘤類型和分子背景可能具有保護性或致癌性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

links.context: In osteoarthritis, SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial integrity by deacetylating cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4 isoform 2, and its deletion correlates with OA exacerbation in animal and human models. SIRT3 promotes mitophagy via the PINK1/Parkin axis, maintains mitochondrial health by regulating FOXO3a hyperacetylation, inhibits chondrocyte apoptosis through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, facilitates mitochondrial fusion for mtDNA complementation, and enhances cartilage resilience.
links.context_zh_TW: 在骨關節炎中，SIRT3 透過去乙醯化細胞色素 c 氧化酶亞基 4 異型 2 維護粒線體完整性，其缺失與動物和人類模型中的 OA 加劇相關。SIRT3 透過 PINK1/Parkin 軸線促進粒線體自噬，透過調節 FOXO3a 超乙醯化維護粒線體健康，透過 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 訊號抑制軟骨細胞凋亡，促進粒線體融合以進行 mtDNA 補償，並增強軟骨韌性。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: In pancreatic beta-cells, GDH activity is a central regulator of amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, providing an amino-acid-sensing branch independent of glucose. Its inhibition by SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation suppresses this insulin output, linking mitochondrial sirtuin signaling to glucose handling.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰腺 β 細胞中，GDH 活性是胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌的核心調節者，提供獨立於葡萄糖的胺基酸感應分支。SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基化對其的抑制會抑制此胰島素輸出，將粒線體 sirtuin 信號與葡萄糖處理聯繫起來。

links.context: In pancreatic beta-cells, SIRT6 preserves glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) and cell survival by repressing expression of TXNIP, a pro-oxidant and pro-apoptotic protein. This repression is achieved through histone deacetylation, with SIRT6 removing acetylation marks at H3K9 and H3K56 in the TXNIP regulatory region. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TXNIP suppression via chromatin modification. By keeping TXNIP low, SIRT6 protects beta-cells from glucotoxic damage and maintains their capacity to secrete insulin in response to glucose. This links SIRT6's epigenetic function directly to pancreatic beta-cell health and the preservation of glucose homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰島β細胞中，SIRT6透過抑制TXNIP的表達來維持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）和細胞存活，TXNIP是一種促氧化和促凋亡蛋白。此抑制透過組蛋白去乙醯化實現，SIRT6在TXNIP調控區域移除H3K9和H3K56的乙醯化標記。方向上，SIRT6透過染色質修飾位於TXNIP抑制的上游。透過保持TXNIP低水平，SIRT6保護β細胞免受葡萄糖毒性的損傷，並維持其對葡萄糖反應分泌胰島素的能力。這將SIRT6的表觀遺傳功能直接與胰島β細胞健康和葡萄糖恆定的維持聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md

links.context: In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDA), TFEB remains constitutively nuclear-localized and active independent of nutrient status, supporting the tumor's high demand for lysosomal degradation and metabolic flexibility. This aberrant activation promotes expression of glutaminase and other catabolic genes that fuel PDA growth under the harsh tumor microenvironment. The nutrient-independent nuclear TFEB state distinguishes PDA from normal epithelial regulation and contributes to therapy resistance. Targeting TFEB or its effectors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy in this lethal cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: 在胰腺導管腺癌（PDA）中，TFEB 持續性地核定位並維持活化，獨立於營養狀態，支持腫瘤對溶酶體降解和代謝靈活性的高需求。此異常活化促進了 glutaminase 和其他分解代謝基因的表現，在嚴苛的腫瘤微環境中供給 PDA 生長。此不依賴營養的核 TFEB 狀態將 PDA 與正常上皮調節區分開來，並促成治療抗性或耐藥。標靶 TFEB 或其效應物正被探索作為此致命癌症的治療策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

links.context: In pancreatic islets of calorically restricted mice, SIRT4 expression is reduced, shifting the mitochondrial sirtuin balance toward the protective, oxidative-phosphorylation-promoting actions of SIRT3. Because SIRT4 normally restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion and mitochondrial fat oxidation, its downregulation supports improved β-cell metabolic flexibility. The directionality is that CR suppresses SIRT4 transcription, altering the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio. Aging shows the opposite pattern—rising SIRT4 and falling SIRT3—so CR counters the age-related drift in this ratio.
links.context_zh_TW: 在熱量限制小鼠的胰腺胰島中，SIRT4 表達降低，使粒線體 sirtuin 平衡向 SIRT3 的保護性、促進氧化磷酸化的作用傾斜。由於 SIRT4 通常抑制胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌和粒線體脂肪氧化，其下調支持改善的 β 細胞代謝靈活性。其方向性為 CR 抑制 SIRT4 轉錄，改變 SIRT3/SIRT4 比值。衰老呈現相反的模式——SIRT4 上升而 SIRT3 下降——因此 CR 抵消了這種比值的年齡相關漂移。

links.context: In response to DNA breaks, SIRT1 relocalizes from gene promoters and repetitive DNA to sites of DNA damage to facilitate repair. At damage sites, it deacetylates histones and DNA repair factors, promoting chromatin remodeling that allows access for the repair machinery. This relocalization is central to SIRT1's genome-stabilizing function, and its age-related decline or mislocalization is associated with impaired DNA repair and accelerated aging, paralleling the behavior of SIRT6 during the DNA damage response.
links.context_zh_TW: 為了回應 DNA 斷裂，SIRT1 從基因啟動子和重複 DNA 重新定位到 DNA 損傷位點以促進修復。在損傷部位，它使組蛋白和 DNA 修復因子去乙醯化，促進染色質重塑，從而允許修復機制進入。這種重新定位是 SIRT1 基因組穩定功能的核心，其與年齡相關的衰退或錯誤定位與 DNA 修復受損和加速老化有關，與 SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應期間的行為相似。

links.context: In response to DNA damage signaling, SIRT6 moves away from gene promoters and repetitive loci to sites of DNA breaks, where it recruits DNA repair factors and modifies local chromatin. At damage sites, SIRT6 promotes the deacetylation of H3K56 and other substrates, facilitating efficient double-strand break repair. This mobilization from LINE-1 loci to damage sites simultaneously couples the DNA damage response to derepression of retrotransposons during aging, linking genomic stress to innate immune activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 為了回應 DNA 損傷訊號，SIRT6 從基因啟動子和重複基因座移至 DNA 斷裂位點，在那裡招募 DNA 修復因子並修飾局部染色質。在損傷部位，SIRT6 促進 H3K56 和其他底物的去乙醯化，促進有效的雙股斷裂修復。這種從 LINE-1 位點到損傷位點的動員同時將 DNA 損傷反應與老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子的去抑制結合起來，將基因組壓力與先天免疫活化聯繫起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: In response to survival cytokines such as GM-CSF, ERK2 phosphorylates BAX at Thr167, creating a pThr-Pro motif that Pin1 recognizes. Pin1 isomerizes the peptide bond and locks Bax in an inactive conformation, preventing its translocation to mitochondria and oligomerization, so Pin1 acts as the switch that decides pro-survival versus pro-death outcomes.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 GM-CSF 等存活細胞激素作用下，ERK2 磷酸化 BAX 的 Thr167，形成 Pin1 所辨識的 pThr-Pro motif。Pin1 催化胜肽鍵的順反異構化，將 Bax 鎖定於不活化構形，阻止其轉位至粒線體與寡聚化，因此 Pin1 是決定存活或死亡結果的關鍵開關。

links.context: In rodents, caloric restriction raises SIRT1 levels in multiple tissues, and this elevation is linked to reduced inflammatory and oxidative responses. Higher SIRT1 expression translates into enhanced deacetylation of targets such as NF-κB, FOXO, and PGC-1α, promoting stress resistance and metabolic health. The directionality is that CR is the upstream stimulus and increased SIRT1 abundance/activity the downstream mediator. This adaptation is considered a key explanation for the anti-aging and disease-protective effects of CR in mammals.
links.context_zh_TW: 在齧齒動物中，熱量限制在多個組織中提高 SIRT1 水平，這種升高與減少的發炎和氧化反應相關。更高的 SIRT1 表達轉化為對 NF-κB、FOXO 和 PGC-1α 等靶標的增強去乙醯化，促進壓力抗性和代謝健康。其方向性為 CR 是上游刺激，SIRT1 表達量/活性增加是下游介導因子。這種適應被認為是 CR 在哺乳動物中抗衰老和疾病保護效應的關鍵解釋。

links.context: In senescence, JMJD3 overexpression specifically reduces H3K27me3 levels at the IL-6 and IL-8 promoters, elevating their expression along with other SASP factors; because NF-κB can recruit H3K27 demethylases to inflammatory loci, JMJD3 cooperates with NF-κB signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老過程中，JMJD3 的過量表現會專一性地降低 IL-6 與 IL-8 啟動子上的 H3K27me3 濃度，升高其表現及其他 SASP 因子；由於 NF-κB 可招募 H3K27 去甲基化酶至發炎位點，JMJD3 與 NF-κB 訊息相互協作。

links.context: In senescent cells only fragmented mitochondria are BAX6A7-positive and release TFAM-bound mtDNA; DRP1-driven fission licenses this minority MOMP event, while hyperfusion protects by homogenizing Bcl-2 across the network.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，只有片段化的粒線體呈 BAX6A7 陽性並釋放 TFAM 結合的 mtDNA；DRP1 驅動的分裂促使這種 minority MOMP，而高度融合則透過均質化 Bcl-2 來保護。

links.context: In senescent cells, DNASE2 is transcriptionally downregulated together with the cytosolic exonuclease TREX1. Persistent DNA damage therefore no longer resolves, the resulting cytosolic DNA activates cGAS-STING, and a type-I interferon plus NF-kB response emerges that is a major engine of the SASP - making DNASE2 loss a senescence-intrinsic mechanism rather than an extrinsic trigger.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 senescent cells 中，DNASE2 與細胞質外切核酸酶 TREX1 一同被轉錄性下調。因此持續存在的 DNA 損傷不再被解決，產生的細胞質 DNA 活化 cGAS-STING，並引發 type-I interferon 與 NF-κB 反應，成為 SASP 的主要動力來源；這使 DNASE2 的喪失成為一種 senescent 內在機制而非外在觸發因素。

links.context: In senescent cells, the histone variant H3.3 accumulates and progressively replaces the canonical histones H3.1 and H3.2. Both H3.3 and its N-terminally cleaved product H3.3cs1, generated by the lysosomal protease cathepsin L1, trigger senescence when ectopically expressed. Because H3.3 is deposited in a replication-independent manner, it accumulates in post-mitotic and senescent cells, and its long half-life makes it vulnerable to cumulative damage that contributes to epigenetic dysregulation during aging.
links.context_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，組蛋白變體 H3.3 累積並逐漸取代經典組蛋白 H3.1 和 H3.2。 H3.3 及其 N 端裂解產物 H3.3cs1（由溶小體蛋白酶組織蛋白酶 L1 產生）在異位表達時都會引發老化。由於 H3.3 以不依賴複製的方式沉積，因此它會在有絲分裂後和衰老細胞中積累，並且其較長的半衰期使其容易受到累積損傷，從而導致衰老過程中的表觀遺傳失調。

links.context: In tauopathy, monomeric tau binds PQBP1, forming a tau-PQBP1 complex that engages cGAS; PQBP1 thus serves as a noncanonical adaptor converting a proteinopathy signal into innate immune activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 tau 病變中，單體 tau 會結合 PQBP1，形成的 tau–PQBP1 複合體再與 cGAS 作用；因此 PQBP1 扮演非典型轉接蛋白，把蛋白病變訊號轉換為先天免疫活化。

links.context: In the AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway, energy stress raises AMPK activity, AMPK phosphorylates PGC-1α, and the coactivator partners with transcription factors such as NRFs and ERRα to induce nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, elevating mitochondrial number, capacity, ATP output and stress resistance.
links.context_zh_TW: 在 AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway 中，能量壓力提升 AMPK 活性，AMPK 磷酸化 PGC-1α，後者再與 NRF、ERRα 等轉錄因子合作誘導核編碼的粒線體基因，提升粒線體數量、容量、ATP 產出與抗逆境能力。
