links.context: Peroxynitrite (ONOO-) is the most powerful oxidant driving tyrosine nitration, converting a tyrosine residue to 3-nitrotyrosine either directly or via intermediate radicals (tyrosyl radical plus nitrogen dioxide). Peroxynitrite itself forms where nitric oxide and superoxide coincide, so nitration marks sites of combined nitric oxide and superoxide generation.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite（ONOO-）是推動 Tyrosine Nitration 最強的氧化劑，可直接或經由中間自由基（tyrosyl radical 加 nitrogen dioxide）將酪胺酸殘基轉換為 3-nitrotyrosine。Peroxynitrite 本身在一氧化氮與超氧陰離子交會處形成，因此硝化標記出的是一氧化氮與超氧陰離子共同生成的位點。

links.context: Peroxynitrite causes nitrative stress by oxidizing and nitrating biomolecules, most characteristically forming 3-nitrotyrosine on proteins, an irreversible modification that can inactivate enzymes. It also nitrates nucleic acids and lipids, broadening its toxic footprint. The directionality is hybrid oxidant to nitrative modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can also arise from other nitrating species such as myeloperoxidase-derived species, so it is not exclusively peroxynitrite-specific.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過氧化和硝化生物分子產生 nitrative stress，最典型的是在 proteins 上形成 3-nitrotyrosine，這是一種可以使酵素失去活性的不可逆修飾。它還會硝酸化 nucleic acids 和脂質，從而擴大其毒性足跡。方向性是混合氧化劑與硝化改質。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 也可以由其他硝化物質產生，例如 myeloperoxidase 衍生物質，因此它並不完全是 peroxynitrite 特有的。

links.context: Peroxynitrite depletes nitric oxide by reacting with it to form peroxynitrite, thereby lowering bioavailable NO and impairing vasodilation and endothelial function. This converts a vasoprotective signal into oxidative and nitrative damage. The directionality is NO consumption to endothelial dysfunction. A caveat is that peroxynitrite also nitrates prostacyclin synthase and other vasoregulators, so NO loss is one of several endothelial insults. The loss of NO also removes its anti-inflammatory and antithrombotic actions, compounding the injury beyond simple loss of vasodilation.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過與 nitric oxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite 來耗盡 nitric oxide，從而降低生物可利用的 NO 並損害 vasodilation 和內皮功能。這將血管保護訊號轉化為氧化和硝化損傷。方向性是對endothelial dysfunction無消費。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 也硝酸化 prostacyclin 合成酶和其他血管調節劑，因此 NO 損失是幾種內皮損傷之一。 NO 的缺失也會消除其抗發炎和抗血栓作用，使損傷比單純的 vasodilation 缺失更嚴重。

links.context: Peroxynitrite forms from the diffusion-limited combination of Nitric Oxide with superoxide anion. Because the product is a potent nitrating and oxidizing species, peroxynitrite couples the nitric oxide and superoxide arms of oxidative stress into protein tyrosine nitration and other nitrosative lesions.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 由 Nitric Oxide 與 Superoxide anion 受擴散限制的結合而形成。由於產物兼具強效硝化與氧化能力，peroxynitrite 將氧化壓力中的一氧化氮臂與超氧陰離子臂偶聯成蛋白質酪胺酸硝化及其他亞硝基化損傷。

links.context: Peroxynitrite inactivates MnSOD by nitrating Tyr34 in the mitochondrial matrix enzyme, impairing its ability to dismutate superoxide. This creates a vicious cycle in which peroxynitrite both consumes NO and disables a key superoxide-scavenging enzyme. The directionality is nitration to loss of antioxidant defense. A caveat is that the magnitude of MnSOD inactivation depends on local peroxynitrite concentration and the availability of peroxynitrite scavengers such as uric acid. Because MnSOD is a first-line mitochondrial defense, its inactivation amplifies superoxide levels and further feeds peroxynitrite production in a self-sustaining loop.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過硝化 mitochondria1 基質酶中的 Tyr34 來滅活 MnSOD，削弱其歧化超氧化物的能力。這就形成了一個惡性循環，其中 peroxynitrite 既消耗 NO，又使一種關鍵的超氧化物清除酶失效。方向性是硝化到抗氧化防禦喪失。需要注意的是，MnSOD 失活的程度取決於當地 peroxynitrite 濃度和 peroxynitrite 清除劑（例如 uric acid）的可用性。因為MnSOD是一線mitochondria1防禦，所以它的失活會放大超氧化物水平並進一步在自我維持循環中促進peroxynitrite的產生。

links.context: Peroxynitrite inactivates aconitase by disrupting its [4Fe-4S] cluster, impairing the TCA-cycle enzyme and diverting citrate metabolism. This links nitrative stress to mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction. The directionality is cluster destruction to enzyme inactivation. A caveat is that aconitase is also sensitive to superoxide and other oxidants, so its inhibition is not uniquely peroxynitrite-driven. Because aconitase also acts as iron regulatory protein 1 when its cluster is lost, oxidative inactivation links metabolic and iron-regulatory responses.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過破壞 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇、損害 TCA 循環酶並轉移檸檬酸代謝來滅活 aconitase。這將 nitrative stress 與 mitochondria1 代謝功能障礙聯繫起來。方向性是簇破壞到酵素失活。需要注意的是，aconitase 也對超氧化物和其他氧化劑敏感，因此它的抑製作用並不是 peroxynitrite 獨有的。由於 aconitase 在其簇丟失時也充當 iron 調節蛋白 1，因此氧化失活將代謝和 iron 調節反應聯繫起來。

links.context: Peroxynitrite is formed by nitric oxide reacting with superoxide at a rate (k approximately 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1) that often outcompetes superoxide dismutase, making NO availability a key determinant of peroxynitrite formation. This places iNOS induction as a major driver of peroxynitrite in inflammation. The directionality is NO to hybrid oxidant. A caveat is that peroxynitrite formation requires co-localized NO and superoxide, so spatial compartmentalization strongly modulates its production. This coupling means that inflammatory conditions that simultaneously induce iNOS and NOX drive high peroxynitrite flux and subsequent tissue nitration.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 是由 nitric oxide 與超氧化物以通常超過 superoxide dismutase 的速率（k 約為 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1）反應形成的，使得 NO 可用性成為 peroxynitrite 形成的關鍵決定因素。這使得 iNOS 感應成為 peroxynitrite 發炎的主要驅動因素。混合氧化劑的方向性為NO。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 的形成需要共定位的 NO 和超氧化物，因此空間分隔強烈調節其產生。這種耦合意味著同時誘導 iNOS 和 NOX 的發炎條件驅動高 peroxynitrite 通量和隨後的組織硝化。

links.context: Peroxynitrite is formed by superoxide radicals through their near-instantaneous reaction with nitric oxide, yielding the potent oxidant and nitrating species ONOO-. This couples two radical species into one hybrid effector. The directionality is radical-radical combination. A caveat is that the reaction competes with SOD for superoxide, so the relative activities of NOX, NOS, and SOD determine peroxynitrite yield. The reaction effectively couples two signaling systems, converting a protective vasodilator into a cytotoxic oxidant, and its rate constant (about 10^10 M-1 s-1) is diffusion-limited, so peroxynitrite forms whenever the two radicals meet.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 是由 superoxide radicals 透過與 nitric oxide 近乎瞬時的反應形成的，產生有效的氧化劑和硝化物質 ONOO-。這將兩種自由基物種耦合成一個混合效應器。方向性是激進-激進的結合。需要注意的是，該反應與 SOD 競爭超氧化物，因此 NOX、NOS 和 SOD 的相對活性決定了 peroxynitrite 的產量。此反應有效地耦合兩個訊號系統，將保護性血管舒張劑轉化為細胞毒性氧化劑，其速率常數（約 10^10 M-1 s-1）是擴散限制的，因此每當兩個自由基相遇時就會形成 peroxynitrite。

links.context: Peroxynitrite is the key mediator of nitrative stress, formed at diffusion-limited rates from the reaction of nitric oxide with superoxide and responsible for the majority of tyrosine nitration observed in disease. Its centrality distinguishes it from other, less abundant RNS. The directionality is hybrid oxidant to the dominant nitrative lesion. A caveat is that other oxidants (e.g., myeloperoxidase-derived) also contribute to nitration, so peroxynitrite is the major but not sole mediator. Its role is supported by the colocalization of nitrotyrosine with peroxynitrite-generating cells in inflamed and degenerating tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 是 nitrative stress 的關鍵介體，由 nitric oxide 與超氧化物反應以擴散限制速率形成，並負責疾病中觀察到的大部分 tyrosine 硝化。它的中心地位使其有別於其他數量較少的 RNS。方向性是主要硝化損傷的混合氧化劑。需要注意的是，其他氧化劑（例如 myeloperoxidase 衍生的）也有助於硝化，因此 peroxynitrite 是主要但不是唯一的介體。發炎和退化組織中硝基rosine 與peroxynitrite 生成細胞的共定位支持了其作用。

links.context: Peroxynitrite nitrates alpha-synuclein, and nitrated alpha-synuclein is more prone to aggregation and fibrillation, hallmarks of Parkinson's disease pathology. Nitration at tyrosine residues stabilizes protofibrils and may seed Lewy-body formation. The directionality is nitrative modification to misfolding propensity. A caveat is that aggregation is also driven by many non-oxidative factors, so nitration accelerates rather than solely causes the process. Elevated nitrated alpha-synuclein is found in Lewy bodies and in the CSF of Parkinson's patients, supporting a pathogenic role for nitration.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 硝酸鹽 alpha-synuclein，硝化 alpha-synuclein 更容易發生聚集和纖維化，這是 Parkinson's disease 病理學的標誌。 tyrosine 殘基上的硝化可穩定原纖維並可能引發路易氏體形成。方向性是對錯誤摺疊傾向的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，聚集也是由許多非氧化因素驅動的，因此硝化會加速而不是僅僅導致該過程。在路易氏體和巴金森氏症患者的腦脊髓液中發現硝化 alpha-synuclein 升高，支持硝化的致病作用。

links.context: Peroxynitrite nitrates tau protein at tyrosine residues, impairing tau-microtubule interaction and enhancing formation of paired helical filaments. Nitration adds to the spectrum of oxidative modifications that destabilize tau. The directionality is nitrative modification to tau dysfunction. A caveat is that tau is targeted by many oxidative and kinase modifications, so nitration is one of several converging insults. Elevated nitrotyrosine is detected on tau in neurofibrillary tangles, supporting nitration as a contributor to tau pathology in vivo.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在 tyrosine 殘基處硝酸鹽 tau protein，損害 tau-微管相互作用並增強成對螺旋絲的形成。硝化增加了氧化修飾的範圍，從而破壞了 tau 的穩定性。方向性是tau功能障礙的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，tau 是許多氧化和激酶修飾的目標，因此硝化是幾種聚合損傷之一。在神經纖維纏結中的 tau 上檢測到升高的硝基rosine，支持硝化是體內 tau 病理學的貢獻者。

links.context: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
links.context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

links.context: Pexophagy is the selective form of Autophagy that targets Peroxisomes for lysosomal degradation. It is the principal mechanism by which cells adjust peroxisome number and eliminate damaged or superfluous peroxisomes, safeguarding organelle quality control and redox balance; impaired pexophagy allows dysfunctional ROS-generating peroxisomes to accumulate, contributing to oxidative stress and neurodegeneration.
links.context_zh_TW: Pexophagy 是 Autophagy 中選擇性地將 Peroxisomes 送往 lysosome 降解的形式。它是細胞調整過氧化體數量並清除受損或過剩過氧化體的主要機制，守護胞器品質管制與氧化還原平衡；當 pexophagy 受损時，會產生活性氧的失能過氧化體累積，促成 oxidative stress 與 neurodegeneration。

links.context: Phagocytes use the respiratory burst to produce high concentrations of ROS and RNS via NOX2 and inducible NOS, creating an antimicrobial environment in the phagosome and extracellular space. This oxidant surge kills engulfed pathogens but also risks collateral tissue damage. The directionality is immune activation to oxidant deployment. A caveat is that the burst is tightly compartmentalized and regulated; failure (CGD) causes infection, while excess causes inflammatory injury. The burst is also coordinated with phagosome maturation, degranulation, and acidification, ensuring oxidants act where pathogens are contained.
links.context_zh_TW: Phagocytes 使用 respiratory burst 透過 NOX2 和誘導型 NOS 產生高濃度的 ROS 和 RNS，在吞噬體和細胞外空間中創建抗菌環境 ironment。這種氧化激增會殺死被吞噬的病原體，但也有可能造成組織損傷。方向性是對氧化劑部署的免疫活化。需要注意的是，爆發是嚴格劃分和監管的。失敗（CGD）會導致感染，而過量則會導致發炎損傷。這種爆發也與吞噬體的成熟、脫粒和酸化相協調，確保氧化劑在病原體所在的地方發揮作用。

links.context: Pharmacologic BAX inhibitors BAI1 and eltrombopag block BAX translocation and oligomerization, reducing cytosolic mtDNA/mtRNA and SASP secretion in senescent fibroblasts; in aged mice BAI1 lowers circulating SASP factors and improves bone strength and frailty without altering p16/p21 arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: 藥理學 BAX 抑制劑 BAI1 與 eltrombopag 阻斷 BAX 轉位與寡聚，減少衰老纖維母細胞的胞質 mtDNA/mtRNA 與 SASP 分泌；在老齡小鼠中 BAI1 降低循環 SASP 因子並改善骨強度與衰弱，且不改變 p16/p21 停滯。

links.context: Pharmacological AMPK activation using metformin promotes SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3, enhancing its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, which in turn reduces tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress in AKI models. The AMPK/SENP1/SIRT3 axis also governs mitochondrial apoptosis via SOD2 deacetylation, mitigating oxidative stress-induced apoptosis across renal and other tissues.
links.context_zh_TW: 利用 Metformin 進行藥理學 AMPK 活化促進 SENP1 介導的 SIRT3 去 SUMO 化，增強其粒線體定位和功能活性，進而在 AKI 模型中減少代謝壓力下的腎小管細胞凋亡。AMPK/SENP1/SIRT3 軸線還透過 SOD2 去乙醯化掌控粒線體凋亡，減輕氧化壓力誘導的凋亡，影響腎臟及其他組織。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: Pharmacological potentiation of SIRT3 by nicotinamide (NAM) preserves neuronal ultrastructural integrity and viability in ALS models, and SIRT3 overexpression in mutant SOD1 (G93A) ALS models ameliorates disease phenotypes. Loss of SIRT3 activity promotes aberrant mitochondrial protein hyperacetylation, compromising OXPHOS complex stoichiometry and electron transport chain capacity in ALS pathogenesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 利用尼可醯胺（NAM）進行 SIRT3 的藥理學增強在 ALS 模型中維護神經元超微結構完整性和存活率，而在突變 SOD1（G93A）ALS 模型中過量表現 SIRT3 可改善疾病表型。SIRT3 活性的缺失促進異常的粒線體蛋白超乙醯化，在 ALS 發病機制中有損氧化磷酸化複合物化學計量和電子傳遞鏈能力。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: Pharmacological targeting or RNAi-mediated knockdown of SIRT1 inhibits cell growth and sensitizes acute myeloid leukemia cells to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of enhanced drug sensitivity in AML. By restraining SIRT1-driven survival, AML cells become more responsive to tyrosine kinase inhibitors, suggesting that combining SIRT1 inhibition with TKI therapy could improve leukemia treatment outcomes.
links.context_zh_TW: SIRT1的藥理學靶向或RNAi介導的沉默抑制細胞生長並使急性骨髓性白血病細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於AML中藥物敏感性增強的上游。透過抑制SIRT1驅動的存活，AML細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑變得更加敏感，表明將SIRT1抑制與TKI治療結合可能改善白血病治療結果。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

links.context: Pheochromocytoma is a rare neuroendocrine tumor of the adrenal medulla, arising from chromaffin cells, that secretes excess catecholamines — primarily Epinephrine and Norepinephrine — autonomously or in response to physiological stimuli. Catecholamine excess drives episodic hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias and catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy.
links.context_zh_TW: Pheochromocytoma 是源自腎上腺髓質嗜鉻細胞的罕見神經內分泌腫瘤，會自主或因應生理刺激分泌過量 Catecholamines，主要為 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine。Catecholamine 過量會造成陣發性高血壓、心律不整與 Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy。

links.context: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase catalyzes the committed step of gluconeogenesis, converting oxaloacetate to phosphoenolpyruvate. It is a key control point for hepatic glucose output during fasting and for glyceroneogenesis in adipose tissue.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸烯醇丙酮酸羧激酶催化糖質新生的關鍵步驟，將草醯乙酸轉為磷酸烯醇丙酮酸。它是禁食時肝臟葡萄糖輸出與脂肪組織甘油新生（glyceroneogenesis）的核心調控點。

links.context: Phosphorylated EIF2A inhibits global protein synthesis while selectively increasing translation of specific mRNAs such as ATF4, producing the adaptive transcriptional output of the integrated stress response.
links.context_zh_TW: 被磷酸化的 EIF2A 抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性增加 ATF4 等特定 mRNA 的轉譯，產生整合性壓力反應的適應性轉錄輸出。

links.context: Phosphorylation is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
links.context_zh_TW: 磷酸化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

links.context: Phosphorylation of eIF2α at Ser51 attenuates global cap-dependent translation while paradoxically promoting translation of selected stress-responsive mRNAs such as ATF4. Phosphorylated eIF2α sequesters the guanine nucleotide exchange factor eIF2B, preventing eIF2 complex recycling; ATF4 then drives transcription of adaptive genes.
links.context_zh_TW: eIF2α 在 Ser51 的磷酸化會抑制整體帽依賴性轉譯，卻反而促進 ATF4 等選擇性壓力反應 mRNA 的轉譯。磷酸化的 eIF2α 隔離鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子 eIF2B，阻斷 eIF2 複合體的再循環；ATF4 隨後驅動適應性基因的轉錄。

links.context: Pin1 binding to phosphorylated BAX (Thr167) catalyzes a conformational change that locks Bax in an inactive state, preventing mitochondrial translocation and MOMP.
links.context_zh_TW: Pin1 與磷酸化的 BAX（Thr167）結合，催化構形變化，將 Bax 鎖定於不活化狀態，阻止粒線體轉位與 MOMP。

links.context: Piperine raises the Bioavailability of co-administered compounds by inhibiting intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein, and phase-II conjugation by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The classic demonstration is a roughly 20-fold increase in Curcumin bioavailability, with similar enhancement explored for Fisetin and other poorly absorbed polyphenols.
links.context_zh_TW: Piperine 藉由抑制腸道與肝臟的 CYP3A4 及其他 cytochrome P450 酵素、外排轉運蛋白 P-glycoprotein，以及 UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 的第二期結合反應，提高併用化合物的 Bioavailability。經典例子是使 Curcumin 的生體可用度提升約 20 倍；類似的增強效果也在 Fisetin 與其他吸收不良的 polyphenols 上被研究。

links.context: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.
links.context_zh_TW: 植物多酚中較為突出的成分，包括紫檀芪（piceatannol）、丁香酚（butein）和異甘草素（ILQ），已被證實能夠活化重組 SIRT1，並被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs）。從作用方向而言，這些天然多酚位於增強 SIRT1 酶活性的上游。與白藜蘆醇一起，這些植物來源的化合物代表了天然 STACs，而合成 STACs 如 SRT1720 活化 SIRT1 的效力則顯著更強。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

links.context: Plasminogen is the inactive zymogen precursor of Plasmin: a 92 kDa single-chain glycoprotein synthesised in the liver and secreted into plasma at about 2 µM, containing five kringle domains with lysine-binding sites plus a catalytic serine protease domain. Plasminogen is converted to active two-chain Plasmin by cleavage at Arg561-Val562 by tPA or uPA.
links.context_zh_TW: Plasminogen 是 Plasmin 的不活化 zymogen 前驅物：由肝臟合成、以約 2 µM 濃度分泌入血漿的 92 kDa 單鏈醣蛋白，含五個帶有離胺酸結合位點的 kringle 結構域與一個催化性 serine protease 結構域。Plasminogen 經 tPA 或 uPA 在 Arg561–Val562 處切割，轉為活化的雙鏈 Plasmin。

links.context: Polo kinase 3 phosphorylates the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL at Ser49 during cell cycle progression and at checkpoint states, altering Bcl-xL's capacity to restrain Apoptosis and tipping damaged cells toward mitochondrial death. The site is distinct from the Ser62 targeted by PLK1, marking Plk3 as a stress-coupled rather than mitotic-execution kinase.
links.context_zh_TW: Polo kinase 3 在細胞週期推進與檢查點狀態下於 Ser49 磷酸化抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-xL，改變 Bcl-xL 抑制 Apoptosis 的能力，使受損細胞倒向線粒體死亡。此位點與 PLK1 所標的的 Ser62 不同，標示出 Plk3 是與壓力偶聯的激酶，而非執行有絲分裂者。

links.context: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases (PARPs) are NAD+-consuming enzymes that transfer ADP-ribose units onto proteins and nucleic acids, playing critical roles in DNA repair and antiviral immunity. During aging, accumulated DNA damage activates PARPs, which depletes NAD+ and reduces SIRT1 activity. In SARS-CoV-2 infection, PARPs inhibit viral transcript translation through ADP-ribosylation, but viral macrodomain proteins hydrolyze these ADPR units, and the compensatory hyperactivation of PARPs consumes NAD+; restoring NAD+ may therefore support the antiviral functions of PARPs. PARPs also consume NAD+ during diabetes-associated DNA repair, contributing to the NAD+/NADH redox imbalance that drives diabetic complications.
links.context_zh_TW: 聚(ADP-核糖)聚合酶（PARPs）是消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，可將 ADP-ribose 單元轉移至蛋白質與核酸上，在 DNA 修復與抗病毒免疫中扮演關鍵角色。老化過程中，累積的 DNA 損傷會活化 PARPs，進而耗竭 NAD+ 並降低 SIRT1 活性。在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中，PARPs 透過 ADP-ribosylation 抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，但病毒的 macrodomain 蛋白會水解這些 ADPR 單元，而 PARPs 的代償性過度活化會消耗 NAD+；因此補充 NAD+ 可能有助於支持 PARPs 的抗病毒功能。PARPs 在糖尿病相關的 DNA 修復過程中也會消耗 NAD+，促成驅動糖尿病併發症的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原失衡。
links.source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

links.context: Polyphenols activate NRF2 by modifying KEAP1 cysteine residues, releasing NRF2 to induce more than 200 cytoprotective and antioxidant genes. This harnesses the cell's own defense program rather than only direct scavenging. The directionality is electrophilic polyphenol to NRF2-dependent transcription. A caveat is that the specific cysteines and magnitude of activation differ among polyphenol structures and depend on metabolism. Examples include resveratrol, curcumin, and EGCG, whose electrophilic moieties and metabolites trigger NRF2 stabilization.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸殘基活化 NRF2，釋放 NRF2 誘導 200 多個細胞保護和抗氧化基因。這利用了細胞自身的防禦程序，而不僅僅是直接清除。方向性是親電子多酚到NRF2依賴的轉錄。需要注意的是，多酚結構之間的特定半胱氨酸和活化程度不同，並且取決於代謝。例子包括白藜蘆醇、薑黃素和 EGCG，其親電子部分和代謝物可觸發 NRF2 穩定。

links.context: Polyphenols are metabolized by the gut microbiome, with the majority of dietary polyphenols reaching the colon intact for bacterial transformation into absorbable metabolites. Microbial catabolism both activates and inactivates these compounds, shaping their systemic bioavailability. The directionality is host diet to microbial biotransformation. A caveat is that the resulting metabolites, not the parent compounds, often mediate the in vivo antioxidant and signaling effects. Inter-individual differences in microbial polyphenol metabolism explain much of the variability in the health effects of these compounds.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 由 gut microbiome 代謝，大部分飲食 polyphenols 完整地到達結腸，被細菌轉化為可吸收的代謝物。微生物分解代謝既可以活化也可以使這些化合物失活，從而影響它們的全身生物利用度。方向性是宿主飲食對微生物生物轉化的影響。需要注意的是，產生的代謝物，而不是母體化合物，通常介導體體內抗氧化和訊號傳導作用。微生物多酚代謝的個體間差異解釋了這些化合物對健康影響的大部分差異。

links.context: Polyphenols exhibit hormesis, showing beneficial low-dose antioxidant and signaling effects but pro-oxidant or toxic high-dose effects. This biphasic response is typical of many redox-active phytochemicals. The directionality is dose-dependent switch from protection to harm. A caveat is that the hormetic window varies widely by compound, tissue, and individual microbiome, so blanket dosing claims are unreliable. This hormetic principle underlies the common advice that polyphenols are best consumed as part of whole foods rather than as high-dose supplements.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 表現出 hormesis，顯示出有益的低劑量抗氧化和訊號傳導作用，但顯示出促氧化或有毒的高劑量作用。這種雙相反應是許多氧化還原活性植物化學物質的典型特徵。方向性是從保護到傷害的劑量依賴性轉換。需要注意的是，毒物興奮效應窗口因化合物、組織和個體微生物組的不同而有很大差異，因此總體劑量聲明並不可靠。這種興奮效應原理是常見建議的基礎，即 polyphenols 最好是作為天然食品的一部分而不是作為高劑量補充劑。

links.context: Polyphenols inhibit NADPH oxidase by blocking p47phox translocation to the membrane, lowering superoxide production in endothelial and inflammatory cells. This reduces a major enzymatic ROS source and complements their NRF2 activation. The directionality is polyphenol to NOX assembly inhibition. A caveat is that effects are isoform- and cell-type specific, and in vivo concentrations after metabolism may be low. This is one route by which dietary polyphenols lower vascular oxidative burden beyond their direct radical-scavenging capacity.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyphenols 透過阻斷 p47phox 易位至膜來抑制 NADPH oxidase，從而降低內皮細胞和發炎細胞中超氧化物的產生。這減少了主要的酶 ROS 來源並補充了它們的 NRF2 活化。方向性是多酚對 NOX 組裝的抑制。需要注意的是，影響是異構體和細胞類型特異性的，代謝後的體內濃度可能較低。這是飲食 polyphenols 降低血管氧化負擔超出其直接自由基清除能力的途徑之一。

links.context: Polyunsaturated fatty acids are susceptible to oxidative stress because their bis-allylic methylene groups have relatively weak C-H bonds that are easily abstracted by radicals, seeding lipid peroxidation. The more double bonds, the higher the peroxidation index. The directionality is PUFA structure to peroxidation propensity. A caveat is that some PUFAs (e.g., omega-3) are beneficial despite higher oxidizability, as their oxidation products can be anti-inflammatory, so susceptibility is not uniformly harmful.
links.context_zh_TW: Polyunsaturated fatty acids 很容易受到 oxidative stress 的影響，因為它們的雙烯丙基亞甲基具有相對較弱的 C-H 鍵，很容易被自由基奪去，形成 lipid peroxidation。雙鍵越多，過氧化指數越高。方向性是PUFA結構對過氧化傾向的影響。需要注意的是，一些多元不飽和脂肪酸（例如 omega-3）儘管氧化性較高，但仍然有益，因為它們的氧化產物具有抗發炎作用，因此易感性並不都是有害的。

links.context: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II) is a lysosomal storage disease caused by deficiency of acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA), leading to massive glycogen accumulation in lysosomes, particularly in cardiac and skeletal muscle.
links.context_zh_TW: 龐貝氏症（第二型肝醣儲積症）屬於溶小體儲積症，由酸性 α-葡萄糖苷酶（GAA）缺乏所致，造成溶小體（尤其在心肌與骨骼肌）大量肝醣累積。

links.context: Pons and Locus Coeruleus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Pons and Locus Coeruleus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Pons 和 Locus Coeruleus 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Pons 和 Locus Coeruleus 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: Poria cocos-derived poricoic acid A upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, effectively attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro. The compound thereby exemplifies phytochemical engagement of the SIRT3-beta-catenin axis as a disease-modifying strategy for tubulointerstitial fibrosis in chronic kidney disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 來自茯苓的 poricoic acid A 上調 SIRT3 並促進 β-catenin K49 去乙醯化，有效減輕腎臟纖維母細胞活化和腎間質纖維化（體內和體外）。該化合物因此體現了植物化學物質參與 SIRT3-β-catenin 軸線作為慢性腎臟病腎小管間質纖維化的疾病修飾策略。
links.source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

links.context: Poricoic acid A is a lanostane triterpenoid from Poria cocos. It upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro, a candidate disease-modifying agent for tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Poricoic acid A 是來自茯苓的羊毛甾烷三萜類化合物。它上調 SIRT3 並促進 β-catenin K49 去乙醯化，減輕腎臟纖維母細胞活化和腎間質纖維化（體內和體外），是腎小管間質纖維化的候選疾病修飾劑。

links.context: Preconditioning and postconditioning are described as clinical manifestations of hormesis, where a low-dose homologous or heterologous stimulus builds a biological protective barrier. Ischemic preconditioning reduces myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, and cerebral preconditioning or transient ischemic attacks induce tolerance that lessens subsequent stroke severity. Postconditioning applies a low-dose stimulus after a high-dose insult within a time window.
links.context_zh_TW: Preconditioning 與 postconditioning 被描述為 Hormesis 的臨床表現形式，即以低劑量同源或異源刺激建立生物保護屏障。Ischemic Preconditioning 可減輕心肌缺血再灌流損傷，而腦部 preconditioning 或短暫性腦缺血發作可誘發耐受性並減輕後續中風嚴重度。Postconditioning 則是在高劑量損傷後的時間窗內施加低劑量刺激。

links.context: Progerin is a toxic, truncated isoform of Lamin A produced when a silent point mutation in the LMNA gene (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site. Because it retains a permanently farnesylated C-terminus it cannot be de-farnesylated, and it accumulates at the nuclear membrane.
links.context_zh_TW: Progerin 是 Lamin A 的毒性截短型異構物，由 LMNA gene 上的一個沉默點突變（c.1824C>T）活化隱藏剪接位點而產生。由於其保留永久性的法尼基化 C 端而無法被去法尼基化，它會在核膜處累積。

links.context: Programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) suppresses TFEB translation by binding eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibiting the RNA helicase activity required for ribosome scanning of the TFEB mRNA. This translational blockade limits TFEB protein synthesis independently of its transcriptional or degradative regulation. PDCD4 thereby acts as a brake on the autophagy-lysosomal program at the level of protein synthesis. Its own downregulation in cancer may contribute to the elevated TFEB activity observed in some malignancies.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞程序性死亡蛋白 4（PDCD4）透過結合真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）並抑制 TFEB mRNA 核糖體掃描所需的 RNA 解旋酶活性，抑制 TFEB 轉錄。此轉錄阻斷獨立於其轉錄或降解調節而限制 TFEB 蛋白合成。PDCD4 因此在蛋白質合成層次上充當自噬—溶酶體程序的制動。其在癌症中的自身下調可能促成某些惡性腫瘤中觀察到的 TFEB 活性升高。

links.context: Progressive telomere shortening to critical length triggers replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. The end-replication problem is the causal mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: 漸進性端粒縮短至關鍵長度在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。末端複製問題是因果機制。

links.context: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
links.context_zh_TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

links.context: Propidium Iodide is paired with Annexin V in the standard viability panel: PI is a membrane-impermeant intercalating dye excluded by intact membranes, so Annexin V+/PI− defines early apoptosis while Annexin V+/PI+ marks lytic programs (parthanatos, necrosis, necroptosis, pyroptosis) and late secondary necrosis of uncleared apoptotic bodies.
links.context_zh_TW: Propidium Iodide 在標準細胞存活面板中與 Annexin V 搭配使用：PI 為膜不通透的嵌入型染劑，完整細胞膜會將其排除，因此 Annexin V+/PI− 定義早期 apoptosis，而 Annexin V+/PI+ 則標記裂解型程序（parthanatos、necrosis、necroptosis、pyroptosis）以及未被清除凋亡小體的晚期次級壞死。

links.context: Propionate is the three-carbon (C3) member of the Short-chain Fatty Acids, generated when gut bacteria ferment dietary fiber and resistant starch. Unlike acetate and butyrate it is produced largely by Bacteroidetes via succinate and acrylate pathways, and is absorbed into the portal vein for extensive first-pass hepatic extraction.
links.context_zh_TW: Propionate 是 Short-chain Fatty Acids 中三碳（C3）的成員，由腸道細菌發酵膳食纖維與抗性澱粉產生。與 acetate 和 butyrate 不同，它主要由 Bacteroidetes 經 succinate 與 acrylate 路徑產生，並被吸收入門脈靜脈，經肝臟大量首過萃取。

links.context: Propolis is produced by the Honeybee (Apis mellifera) by mixing plant exudates with beeswax and salivary enzymes, and is used inside the hive as a sealant and antimicrobial barrier. Its composition varies with geographic and plant source, yielding distinct types such as Brazilian green and European poplar propolis.
links.context_zh_TW: Propolis 由 Honeybee（Apis mellifera）將植物分泌物與蜂蠟、唾液酵素混合製成，在蜂巢內作為封閉劑與抗菌屏障使用。其成分隨地理與植物來源而異，形成巴西綠蜂膠與歐洲楊樹蜂膠等不同類型。

links.context: Prostacyclin (PGI2) is the prostaglandin produced from Prostaglandin H2 by prostacyclin synthase, a cytochrome P450-type enzyme that isomerizes the endoperoxide bridge to an enol ether bridge. It is chemically unstable and hydrolyzes to 6-keto-PGF1alpha within minutes at physiological pH, the stable metabolite measured in clinical samples. Its synthesis is concentrated in endothelial cells lining the vascular wall, where prostacyclin synthase is physically coupled to COX-2.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostacyclin（PGI2）是由 prostacyclin synthase 從 Prostaglandin H2 生成的 prostaglandin；該酵素為 cytochrome P450 型，會將 endoperoxide 鍵異構化為 enol ether 鍵。它在化學上不穩定，在生理 pH 下數分鐘內即水解為 6-keto-PGF1alpha，也就是臨床樣本中測量的穩定代謝物。其合成集中於襯覆血管壁的內皮細胞，prostacyclin synthase 在該處與 COX-2 物理偶聯。

links.context: Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2 are made from the same Prostaglandin H2 pool and act on opposing receptors - IP (Gs-coupled, raising cAMP, inhibiting platelet activation and relaxing smooth muscle) versus TP (promoting aggregation and vasoconstriction). The PGI2/TXA2 ratio at the vessel wall is therefore the key determinant of thrombotic tendency. In pulmonary arterial hypertension prostacyclin deficiency is central to pathogenesis, which is why prostacyclin analogues are mainstay therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2 由同一個 Prostaglandin H2 池生成，卻作用於相反的受體——IP（Gs 偶聯、升高 cAMP、抑制血小板活化並放鬆平滑肌）對上 TP（促進聚集與血管收縮）。因此血管壁的 PGI2/TXA2 比值是血栓傾向的關鍵決定因素。在肺動脈高壓中，prostacyclin 缺乏是致病機制的核心，因此 prostacyclin 類似物為主線治療。

links.context: Prostaglandin G₂ (PGG₂) is the 15-hydroperoxy endoperoxide produced by the bis-dioxygenation of arachidonic acid at the cyclooxygenase site of COX-1/COX-2 — two O₂ additions forming the bicyclic endoperoxide — making it the first committed intermediate of the prostanoid pathway and the site of aspirin's irreversible Ser530 acetylation.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin G₂（PGG₂）是在 COX-1/COX-2 的環氧化酶位點由花生四烯酸雙加氧而產生的 15-過氧基內過氧化物——兩次 O₂ 加成形成雙環內過氧化物——使其成為前列腺素路徑的第一個承諾中間產物，也是 aspirin 不可逆乙醯化 Ser530 的作用位點。

links.context: Prostaglandin H₂ (PGH₂) is produced when the peroxidase site of the same cyclooxygenase reduces the C15 hydroperoxide of PGG₂ to a C15 hydroxyl, converting the hydroperoxide intermediate into the common precursor of all prostanoids — prostaglandins, thromboxane A₂ and prostacyclin.
links.context_zh_TW: 當同一環氧化酶的過氧化酶位點將 PGG₂ 的 C15 過氧基還原為 C15 羥基時，產生 Prostaglandin H₂（PGH₂），使此過氧化中間產物轉為所有前列腺素類——前列腺素、thromboxane A₂ 與 prostacyclin——的共同前驅物。

links.context: Prostaglandin H₂ is derived from PGG₂ by the peroxidase activity of Cyclooxygenase, which requires a reducing co-substrate (phenol or other hydroperoxide activators serve this role in vivo). PGH₂ keeps the bicyclic endoperoxide bridge but bears a C15 alcohol, is unstable with a half-life of minutes, and is never measured directly in clinical samples.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandin H₂ 由 Cyclooxygenase 的過氧化酶活性自 PGG₂ 衍生，此反應需要還原性共底物（體內由酚類或其他過氧化氫活化劑擔任）。PGH₂ 保留雙環內過氧化物橋但帶有 C15 醇基，化學不穩定（半衰期僅數分鐘），因此臨床樣本中從不直接測定。

links.context: Prostaglandins are 20-carbon lipid autacoids derived from Arachidonic acid released from membrane phospholipids by cytosolic phospholipase A2, then oxidized in two steps by COX-1 or COX-2 to Prostaglandin G2 and the reduced endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2. PGH2 is the common precursor converted by terminal synthases into PGE2, PGD2, PGF2alpha, Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2, giving the family its roles in pain, fever, vascular tone, gastric protection and platelet function.
links.context_zh_TW: Prostaglandins 是 20 碳脂質 autacoids，源自由 cytosolic phospholipase A2 從膜磷脂釋出的 Arachidonic acid，再由 COX-1 或 COX-2 兩步氧化成 Prostaglandin G2 與還原後的 endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2。PGH2 是共同前驅物，經末端合成酶轉為 PGE2、PGD2、PGF2alpha、Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2，使這一族在疼痛、發燒、血管張力、胃黏膜保護與血小板功能中扮演角色。

links.context: Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md

links.context: Protein Kinase A phosphorylates the fission GTPase DRP1 at Ser637, a cAMP-dependent serine/threonine modification that retains DRP1 in the cytosol and prevents its recruitment to the outer mitochondrial membrane. PKA therefore negatively regulates mitochondrial fission, in contrast to pro-fission kinases such as ERK (Ser616) and CDK1 (Ser585).
links.context_zh_TW: Protein Kinase A 會在 Ser637 磷酸化裂解 GTP 酶 DRP1；這個 cAMP 依賴的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸修飾使 DRP1 留在 cytosol，阻止其被招募至 outer mitochondrial membrane。因此 PKA 負向調控粒線體分裂，與 ERK（Ser616）、CDK1（Ser585）等促分裂激酶相反。

links.context: Protein carbonylation is an irreversible modification of proteins introduced by metal-catalyzed oxidation or by adduction of lipid-peroxidation products to susceptible residues. It marks severe, often non-repairable oxidative damage and is used as a biomarker. The directionality is oxidative insult to stable carbonyl formation. A caveat is that carbonylation can also arise from glycation and other non-ROS processes, so it is not exclusively an oxidative-stress marker. Carbonyls can be measured in plasma, tissues, and cell lysates, and their accumulation is a hallmark of aging and age-related disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein carbonylation 是 proteins 的不可逆修飾，透過金屬催化氧化或透過脂質過氧化產物與敏感殘基的加合引入。它標誌著嚴重的、通常不可修復的氧化損傷，並被用作生物標記。方向性是對穩定羰基形成的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，羰基化也可能由糖化和其他非 ROS 過程引起，因此它不僅僅是氧化壓力標記。可以在血漿、組織和細胞裂解物中測量羰基，它們的累積是 aging 和年齡相關疾病的標誌。

links.context: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

links.context: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

links.context: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。
links.source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

links.context: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。
links.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

links.context: Protein restriction inhibits the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 in the liver, heart, muscle, adipose tissue, and brain, and this inhibition is required for PR's benefits - without it, the benefits are lost. mTORC1 inhibition suppresses protein synthesis by reducing phosphorylation of S6K1 (whose genetic ablation extends lifespan) and of 4E-BP1, blocking eIF4E from initiating translation, while simultaneously promoting autophagy via ULK1 initiation of autophagosome formation. Normal aging is characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation in many tissues, whereas pharmacological or genetic inhibition of mTORC1 extends lifespan in many species. Amino acid scarcity is sensed in part through leucine signaling to mTORC1 in specific neurons via a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1).
links.context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制抑制肝臟、心臟、肌肉、脂肪組織和腦中的主營養感知器mTORC1，這種抑制是PR益處所必需的——沒有它，益處就會喪失。mTORC1抑制透過減少S6K1（其基因缺失延長壽命）和4E-BP1的磷酸化來抑制蛋白質合成，阻斷eIF4E啟動翻譯，同時透過ULK1啟動自噬體形成促進自噬。正常老化以許多組織中組成型mTORC1活化為特徵，而mTORC1的藥理學或基因抑制在許多物種中延長壽命。胺基酸稀缺部分透過亮氨酸透過電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向特定神經元中的mTORC1訊號傳導來感知。

links.context: Protein tyrosine phosphatases are inactivated by hydrogen peroxide because their catalytic cysteines (e.g., PTP1B Cys-215) are oxidized to sulfenic acid, blocking substrate dephosphorylation. This shifts the phosphorylation balance toward active kinase signaling, notably in insulin and growth-factor pathways. The directionality is H2O2 to reversible PTP inhibition to enhanced phosphorylation. A caveat is that sustained oxidation can progress to irreversible inactivation and that some phosphatases are less redox-sensitive, adding specificity.
links.context_zh_TW: Protein tyrosine phosphatases 被 hydrogen peroxide 滅活，因為它們的催化半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B Cys-215）被氧化為次磺酸，從而阻止底物去磷酸化。這將磷酸化平衡轉向活性激酶訊號傳導，特別是在胰島素和生長因子途徑中。方向性是 H2O2 到可逆 PTP 抑製到增強磷酸化。需要注意的是，持續氧化可能會發展為不可逆的失活，某些磷酸酶對氧化還原較不敏感，從而增加了特異性。

links.context: Proteins are major targets of oxidative stress, sustaining side-chain oxidation, backbone fragmentation, and cross-linking that alter enzyme activity, signaling, and turnover. Because proteins are abundant and long-lived, they integrate oxidative exposure over time. The directionality is oxidant to protein modification. A caveat is that some oxidative modifications are reversible (e.g., methionine sulfoxide) and can serve signaling roles rather than purely damage. Protein oxidation markers such as carbonylation and 3-nitrotyrosine are therefore widely used to estimate the severity of oxidative burden in disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Proteins 是 oxidative stress 的主要靶標，維持側鏈氧化、主鏈斷裂和 cross 連接，從而改變酶活性、訊號傳導和周轉。由於 proteins 含量豐富且壽命長，因此它們會隨著時間的推移而整合氧化暴露。方向性是蛋白質修飾的氧化劑。需要注意的是，一些氧化修飾是可逆的（例如甲硫氨酸亞砜），並且可以發揮信號作用而不是純粹的損傷。因此，蛋白質氧化標記物（例如羰基化和 3-nitrotyrosine）被廣泛用於估計疾病中氧化負擔的嚴重程度。

links.context: Psoriasis is driven by the IL-23/Th17 axis: activated dendritic cells secrete IL-23, expanding TH17 cells that release IL-17 and IL-6; together with TNF-alpha this drives keratinocyte hyperproliferation, shortened epidermal transit time, acanthosis and parakeratosis, producing the characteristic scaly plaques.
links.context_zh_TW: Psoriasis 由 IL-23/Th17 軸驅動：活化的樹突細胞分泌 IL-23，擴增 TH17 細胞並使其釋放 IL-17 與 IL-6；這些因子連同 TNF-alpha 驅動角質形成細胞過度增殖、表皮通過時間縮短、棘層增厚與角化不全，形成典型的鱗屑斑塊。

links.context: PtdIns(3,5)P2 directly binds and activates the TRPML1 calcium channel. Activation couples phosphoinositide to calcium release.
links.context_zh_TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2 直接結合並活化 TRPML1 鈣通道。活化將磷酸肌醇耦合到鈣釋放。

links.context: Pulse wave velocity (PWV) is the speed at which the pressure wave generated by left ventricular ejection travels along the arterial tree, and is the gold standard clinical measure of arterial stiffness. It is computed as arterial distance between two recording sites divided by pulse transit time (D/Δt), with carotid-femoral PWV (cfPWV) the most validated variant. Because pressure waves travel faster through rigid vessels than compliant ones, higher PWV values indicate stiffer arteries.
links.context_zh_TW: 脈搏波傳導速度 (PWV) 是左心室射血所產生的壓力波沿動脈樹傳播的速度，被視為衡量動脈僵硬度（arterial stiffness）的黃金標準臨床指標。它以兩個量測部位間的動脈距離除以脈搏傳導時間計算（D/Δt），其中頸動脈－股動脈 PWV (cfPWV) 為驗證最充分、應用最廣的版本。由於壓力波在僵硬血管中傳播比在彈性血管中快，PWV 值越高代表動脈越僵硬。

links.context: Purified PAR polymer delivered into cortical neurons kills ~50% at 80 nM (mean 40-mer) and ~80% as ≥60-mer fractions, with toxicity from 20 nM; PARG or phosphodiesterase 1 predigestion abolishes killing while poly(A) charge control is nontoxic, proving the polymer itself is the parthanatos death signal (Andrabi et al. 2006 PNAS).
links.context_zh_TW: 純化 PAR 聚合物导入皮质神经元在 80 nM 杀死约50%，≥60-mer 组分约80%致死，20 nM 起即有毒性；PARG 或磷酸二酯酶1预消化消除毒性，poly(A) 对照无毒，证明聚合物本身即 parthanatos 死亡信号。
links.source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

links.context: Purkinje cells are the principal output neurons of the cerebellar cortex integrating sensory-motor input to deep nuclei. Containment records the defining cellular composition of the cerebellum.
links.context_zh_TW: Purkinje 細胞是小腦皮質的主要輸出神經元，整合感覺運動輸入至深部核。包含記錄小腦的定義性細胞組成。

links.context: Putamen and Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Putamen and Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Putamen 和 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Putamen 和 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: Pycnogenol is a standardized extract of French maritime pine (Pinus pinaster) bark whose defined composition is ~65-75% proanthocyanidins, predominantly A-type oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), with smaller amounts of monomeric catechin/epicatechin, caffeic and ferulic phenolic acids, and taxifolin. It is among the most clinically studied proanthocyanidin-rich supplements, and its activity tracks with this constituent class.
links.context_zh_TW: Pycnogenol 是法國 maritime pine（*Pinus pinaster*）樹皮的標準化萃取物，其成分約 65–75% 為 Proanthocyanidins，以 A 型寡聚前花青素（OPC）為主，另含少量單體 catechin/epicatechin、咖啡酸與阿魏酸等酚酸，以及 taxifolin。它是臨床研究最多的前花青素類補充劑之一，其活性與此主要成分類高度相關。

links.context: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: Pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α (PDH E1α) becomes hyperacetylated at Lys385 in tubular epithelial cells after TGF-β1 stimulation and is deacetylated by SIRT3, modulating pyruvate entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates PDH. This links mitochondrial metabolism to TGF-β1-driven kidney injury, and loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and pyruvate/lactate accumulation. It shows SIRT3 buffering metabolic dysfunction during fibrosis, and connects the metabolic phenotype of injured kidneys to sirtuin-dependent control of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
links.context_zh_TW: 丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1α（PDH E1α）在 TGF-β1 刺激後在腎小管上皮細胞中 Lys385 處被超乙醯化，並被 SIRT3 去乙醯化，調節丙酮酸進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 PDH。這將粒線體代謝與 TGF-β1 驅動的腎損傷聯繫起來，SIRT3 的缺失導致 PDH 超乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少和丙酮酸/乳酸累積。它表明 SIRT3 在纖維化期間緩衝代謝功能障礙，並將受損腎臟的代謝表型與丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體的 sirtuin 依賴性控制聯繫起來。

links.context: Pyruvate is converted to Acetyl-CoA by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase in the rate-limiting, committed step that links glycolysis to aerobic respiration. Because acetyl-CoA is what fuels the TCA cycle, blocking this step removes the reducing equivalents whose downstream leak produces the mitochondrial ROS that RIPK3 needs in order to reinforce necrosome assembly.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyruvate 經由 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase 轉變為 Acetyl-CoA，這是連結糖解作用與有氧呼吸的限速且不可逆步驟。由於 acetyl-CoA 是 TCA cycle 的燃料，阻斷此步驟便移除了產生還原力的來源，而其下游滲漏正是形成粒線體 ROS 的途徑——而 RIPK3 需要這些 ROS 才能強化 necrosome 組裝。
links.source_file: _document_ - RIP3 targets pyruvate dehydrogenase complex to increase aerobic respiration in TNF-induced necroptosis.md

links.context: Pyruvate is the three-carbon alpha-keto acid generated as the end product of glycolysis, making it a central metabolic node that links carbohydrate catabolism to TCA cycle oxidation, acetyl-CoA production, and lactate fermentation. Cytosolic pyruvate can be reduced to lactate by lactate dehydrogenase to regenerate NAD+ for glycolysis, or carboxylated to oxaloacetate for anaplerosis.
links.context_zh_TW: Pyruvate 是糖解作用（glycolysis）產生的三碳 α-酮酸，為連結醣類分解與 TCA cycle 氧化、Acetyl-CoA 生成及乳酸發酵的中樞代謝節點。細胞質中的 pyruvate 可由乳酸脫氫酶還原為 lactate 以再生 NAD+ 供糖解使用，或經羧化轉成草醯乙酸進行補充反應。

links.context: QPRT (quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase) is a key enzyme in de novo NAD+ biosynthesis, catalyzing the reaction quinolinic acid + PRPP -> nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) + CO2 + PPi. It requires Mg2+ and PRPP, is highly expressed in liver, kidney and brain, and sits at the junction of tryptophan catabolism and NAD+ production, preventing accumulation of neurotoxic quinolinic acid.
links.context_zh_TW: QPRT（quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase）是從頭 NAD+ 生合成的關鍵酵素，催化 quinolinic acid + PRPP → nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) + CO2 + PPi。它需要 Mg2+ 與 PRPP，在肝、腎與腦高度表現，位於色胺酸分解與 NAD+ 生成交界處，並防止神經毒性的 quinolinic acid 累積。

links.context: Quiescence is a reversible, non-inflammatory form of proliferative arrest, whereas senescence is an irreversible arrest accompanied by a proinflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). While both states involve withdrawal from the cell cycle, they differ mechanistically and functionally: quiescent cells can re-enter proliferation on stimulation, whereas senescent cells are permanently growth-arrested. The distinction is clinically relevant because senescent cells accumulate with age and drive tissue dysfunction, while quiescence protects stem cell pools.
links.context_zh_TW: Quiescence 是一種可逆的、非發炎形式的增殖停滯，而老化是一種不可逆的停滯，伴隨促發炎老化相關的分泌表型 (SASP)。雖然這兩種狀態都涉及退出細胞週期，但它們在機制和功能上有所不同：靜止細胞可以在刺激後重新進入增殖狀態，而衰老細胞則永久生長停滯。這種差異具有臨床相關性，因為老化細胞會隨著年齡的增長而累積並導致組織功能障礙，而靜止則可以保護幹細胞池。

links.context: Quiescence is a state of reversible proliferative arrest in which cells exit the cell cycle but retain the capacity to re-enter upon appropriate stimuli. It is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks S-phase gene expression until mitogenic signals release the block. Unlike senescence, quiescence is reversible and lacks a senescence-associated secretory phenotype, and it is a key protective state for adult stem cells.
links.context_zh_TW: Quiescence 是一種可逆的增殖停滯狀態，其中細胞退出細胞週期，但保留在適當刺激下重新進入細胞週期的能力。它在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期 gene expression，直到有絲分裂信號釋放阻斷。與老化不同，靜止是可逆的，並且缺乏與老化相關的分泌表型，它是成體幹細胞的關鍵保護狀態。

links.context: Quiescence is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks the expression of S-phase genes. Growth factor signals relieve this inhibition through cyclin-dependent kinase phosphorylation of pRb, allowing cells to re-enter the cell cycle and resume proliferation. This reversible brake underlies the ability of quiescent cells to resume division, and it is mechanistically distinct from the irreversible arrest of senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: Quiescence 在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期基因的表達。生長因子訊號透過 pRb 的細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶磷酸化緩解這種抑制，使細胞重新進入細胞週期並恢復增殖。這種可逆制動是靜止細胞恢復分裂能力的基礎，它在機制上與不可逆的衰老停滯不同。

links.context: Quinones and Oxidative Stress are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Quinones and Oxidative Stress may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
links.context_zh_TW: Quinones 和 Oxidative Stress 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Quinones 和 Oxidative Stress 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

links.context: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combining the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, Vincristine and prednisone. It serves as the conventional comparator against which alternative or repurposed approaches are framed.
links.context_zh_TW: R-CHOP 是 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 的標準一線治療方案，將抗 CD20 抗體 rituximab 與 cyclophosphamide、doxorubicin、Vincristine 及 prednisone 合併。它也是評估替代或再定位療法時的常規對照基準。

links.context: RAD51 is the recombinase enzyme essential for homologous recombination repair of double-strand DNA breaks and interstrand crosslinks. It forms helical filaments on single-stranded DNA and catalyzes strand exchange with homologous DNA sequences, enabling accurate repair; foci of RAD51 are used as a marker of active HR repair.
links.context_zh_TW: RAD51 是同源重組 (homologous recombination) 修復 DNA 雙股斷裂與股間交聯所必需的 recombinase 酵素。它在單股 DNA 上形成螺旋絲狀體，催化與同源 DNA 序列的股交換以完成準確修復；RAD51 焦點的形成被用作 HR 修復活性的標記。

links.context: RAF is a family of serine/threonine kinases (ARAF, BRAF, CRAF/RAF1) that transmit signals from RAS to MEK in the canonical RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade. RAF kinases are recruited to the membrane upon RAS-GTP activation, where they phosphorylate MEK1/2, which activates ERK1/2 and drives proliferation and survival; BRAF V600E is a common oncogenic mutation.
links.context_zh_TW: RAF 是一族絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶 (ARAF、BRAF、CRAF/RAF1)，在典型的 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK MAPK 級聯中將訊號由 RAS 傳至 MEK。當 RAS-GTP 活化時，RAF 激酶被招募至膜上並磷酸化 MEK1/2，後者活化 ERK1/2 以驅動增殖與存活；BRAF V600E 是常見的致癌突變。

links.context: RAGE (receptor for advanced glycation end products) is the best-characterized cell surface molecule that recognizes AGEs. The interaction between an AGE and its receptor alters cell and organ functions mainly through inflammatory molecules, leading to aging. RAGE regulates cell processes of crucial importance including inflammation, apoptosis, ROS signaling, proliferation, autophagy, and aging. AGE-RAGE signaling is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging and age-related diseases, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE（receptor for advanced glycation end products）是辨識 AGEs 最具特徵性的 cell surface molecule。AGE 與其 receptor 之間的 interaction 主要透過 inflammatory molecules 改變細胞與器官功能，導致 aging。RAGE 調節包括 inflammation、apoptosis、ROS signaling、proliferation、autophagy 與 aging 在內的重要 cell processes。AGE-RAGE signaling 是 AGEs 促成 aging 與 age-related diseases 的三大主要機制之一，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: RAGE is the best-characterized cell surface receptor for advanced glycation end products. When AGEs bind to RAGE, they activate inflammatory signaling pathways that alter cell and organ functions and contribute to aging. RAGE regulates inflammation, apoptosis, ROS signaling, proliferation, autophagy, and aging, and AGE-RAGE interaction is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues. The RAGE-dependent inflammatory response to dietary AGEs has been shown to drive arterial aging in mice, linking glycated food components to chronic inflammation and vascular dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: RAGE 是 advanced glycation end products 最具特徵性的 cell surface receptor。當 AGEs 與 RAGE 結合時，會活化 inflammatory signaling pathways，改變細胞與器官功能並促成 aging。RAGE 調節 inflammation、apoptosis、ROS signaling、proliferation、autophagy 與 aging，而 AGE-RAGE interaction 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一。對 dietary AGEs 的 RAGE-dependent inflammatory response 已被證實會 drive arterial aging in mice，將 glycated food components 與 chronic inflammation 及 vascular dysfunction 連結起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

links.context: RAIDD activates Caspase-2. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: RAIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: RAIDD forms PIDDosome. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: RAIDD 形式PIDDosome。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

links.context: RAIDD promotes Apoptosis. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: RAIDD 推廣 Apoptosis。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: RB1, the gene encoding the retinoblastoma protein, represses LINE-1 retrotransposons by maintaining repressive chromatin at L1 loci. Active Rb recruits chromatin modifiers, including the histone methyltransferase SUV39H1 and the H3K9me3-binding protein HP1, to deposit and maintain repressive marks that silence LINE-1 elements. Loss of Rb during senescence or tumorigenesis contributes to LINE-1 derepression and the retrotransposon-driven inflammation associated with aging. Thus Rb integrates cell cycle control with genome defense against retrotransposon mobilization.
links.context_zh_TW: RB1 是編碼視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白的基因，透過在 L1 位點維持抑制性染色質來抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座子。活性 Rb 招募染色質修飾劑，包括組蛋白甲基轉移酶 SUV39H1 和 H3K9me3 結合蛋白 HP1，以沉積和維持抑制 LINE-1 元件的抑制標記。老化或腫瘤發生過程中 Rb 的缺失會導致 LINE-1 去抑制以及逆轉錄轉座子驅動的與老化相關的發炎。因此，Rb 將細胞週期控制與針對逆轉錄轉座子動員的基因組防禦結合。

links.context: RB1, the product of the retinoblastoma gene, enforces quiescence by sequestering E2F transcription factors and blocking the expression of S-phase genes. In its active hypophosphorylated form, pRb binds E2F and recruits repressive chromatin machinery to E2F target promoters, maintaining the G1/S restriction point. Cyclin-dependent kinase phosphorylation inactivates this brake and releases E2F, permitting cell cycle re-entry, while loss of RB1 function promotes unscheduled proliferation in cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: RB1 是視網膜母細胞瘤基因的產物，透過隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期基因的表達來強制靜止。在其活性低磷酸化形式中，pRb 結合 E2F 並將抑制性染色質機制募集到 E2F 目標啟動子上，從而維持 G1/S 限制點。細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶磷酸化使這種制動失活並釋放 E2F，允許細胞週期重新進入，而 RB1 功能的喪失會促進癌症中非計劃的增殖。

links.context: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
links.context_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。
links.source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

links.context: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
links.context_zh_TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

links.context: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
links.context_zh_TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

links.context: RIG-I (DDX58) is a cytosolic DExH-box RNA helicase pattern-recognition receptor that detects short double-stranded RNA with a 5'-triphosphate or 5'-diphosphate end. Ligand binding plus K63-linked polyubiquitination releases its N-terminal CARDs, which nucleate filaments that drive MAVS (IPS-1) oligomerisation on the mitochondrial outer membrane, MAMs and peroxisomes, converting RIG-I recognition into downstream signalling.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I (DDX58) 是細胞質的 DExH-box RNA 解旋酶型模式辨識受體，可偵測帶 5′-三磷酸或 5′-二磷酸末端 的短雙股 RNA。配體結合加上 K63 連結的泛素化會釋出其 N 端 CARD，CARD 核化成絲狀體並驅動 MAVS (IPS-1) 在粒線體外膜、MAM 與過氧化體上聚集，將 RIG-I 的辨識轉為下游訊息傳遞。

links.context: RIG-I signalling induces type I interferons and inflammatory cytokines. On the MAVS platform, TRAF3 recruits TBK1 and IKK-epsilon, which phosphorylate and activate IRF3 and IRF7, while TRAF6 and the IKK complex activate NF-kB; the two arms cooperate to induce IFNB1 and interferon-stimulated genes, and secreted interferon acts back through IFNAR-JAK-STAT to amplify RIG-I and other antiviral effectors.
links.context_zh_TW: RIG-I 訊息傳遞會誘導第一型干擾素與發炎性細胞激素。在 MAVS 平台上，TRAF3 招募 TBK1 與 IKK-ε，後者磷酸化並活化 IRF3 與 IRF7；同時 TRAF6 與 IKK 複合體活化 NF-κB。兩條支臂協同誘導 IFNB1 與干擾素刺激基因，分泌出的干擾素再經 IFNAR–JAK–STAT 回饋，放大 RIG-I 與其他抗病毒效應物。

links.context: RIPK1 recruits RIPK3 through RHIM interactions to assemble the necrosome; RIPK1 kinase activity then phosphorylates RIPK3, the obligatory relay of the necroptotic cascade.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK1 經 RHIM 交互作用招募 RIPK3 組裝 necrosome；RIPK1 激酶活性隨後磷酸化 RIPK3，為 necroptosis 級聯的必需接續步驟。

links.context: RIPK3 is the defining molecule of necroptosis — the NCD-2012-aligned definition is 'necrotic cell death dependent on RIPK3', not all necrosis. Deletion of FADD, c-FLIP or Caspase-8 kills mice at ~e10.5 and is fully rescued on a RIPK3-deficient background, and vaccinia virus is lethal in RIPK3-deficient but not wild-type mice.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 是 necroptosis 的定義分子——NCD-2012 對齊的定義是「依賴 RIPK3 的壞死性細胞死亡」，而非所有壞死。FADD、c-FLIP 或 Caspase-8 的缺失會在約 e10.5 殺死小鼠，且在 RIPK3 缺乏背景上完全獲救；牛痘病毒對 RIPK3 缺乏小鼠具致死性，但對野生型小鼠則否。

links.context: RIPK3 is the obligatory kinase of necroptosis. Recruited by RIPK1 via RHIM-domain amyloid-like assembly (or by TRIF/ZBP1 in non-classical necrosomes), it phosphorylates MLKL to drive membrane-pore formation and lytic death; phosphorylation gates necrosome assembly, with Ser204 (Ser199 human) as the key death phospho-site.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 是 necroptosis 不可或缺的激酶。它經由 RHIM 結構域類澱粉樣組裝被 RIPK1 招募（或在非典型壞死小體中由 TRIF／ZBP1 招募），再磷酸化 MLKL 以推動膜成孔與裂解性死亡；磷酸化是壞死小體組裝的閘門，其中 Ser204（人類為 Ser199）是關鍵死亡磷酸化位點。

links.context: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL (human Thr357/Ser358) to license its oligomerization and membrane-pore formation, the terminal executor step of necroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: RIPK3 磷酸化 MLKL（人類 Thr357/Ser358），准許其寡聚化並形成膜孔，為 necroptosis 的末端執行步驟。

links.context: RNA polymerase I transcribes the 18S, 5.8S and 28S rRNA genes in the nucleolus, and each ribosome requires a single 45S precursor rRNA transcript. Pol I output is therefore the rate-limiting step of ribosome biogenesis and sets the ceiling on protein synthesis.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA 聚合酶 I 在核仁中轉錄 18S、5.8S 與 28S rRNA 基因，而每個核糖體都需要一條 45S 前驅 rRNA 轉錄本。因此 Pol I 的產出是核糖體生成的限速步驟，並為蛋白質合成設定上限。

links.context: RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) is a high-throughput sequencing method that profiles the complete set of RNA transcripts in a biological sample and quantifies gene expression. The workflow runs RNA extraction, poly-A selection or ribosomal RNA depletion, reverse transcription to cDNA, adapter ligation and PCR library preparation, sequencing, then bioinformatics read alignment and quantification with tools such as DESeq2 for differential expression.
links.context_zh_TW: RNA-seq（RNA 定序）是一種高通量定序方法，可剖析生物樣本中完整的 RNA 轉錄本集合並量化基因表現。工作流程包含 RNA 萃取、poly-A 篩選或核糖體 RNA 去除、逆转錄成 cDNA、接头連接與 PCR 文庫製備、定序，最後以 DESeq2 等工具進行讀段比對與差異表現量化。

links.context: ROS trigger NLRP3 inflammasome assembly by promoting the conformational changes and ASC speck formation needed for caspase-1 activation. Mitochondrial ROS and oxidized mitochondrial DNA are particularly implicated as upstream signals. The directionality is oxidant to inflammasome activation. A caveat is that NLRP3 is also activated by non-ROS stimuli (ATP, nigericin, crystals), so ROS is a common but not exclusive trigger. ROS derived from both NOX enzymes and mitochondria converge on NLRP3, linking metabolic and inflammatory stress to IL-1beta production.
links.context_zh_TW: ROS 透過促進 caspase-1 活化所需的構象變化和 ASC 斑點形成來觸發 NLRP3 inflammasome assembly。 Mitochondrial ROS 和氧化的 mitochondrial DNA 作為上游訊號尤其受到牽連。方向性是發炎小體活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，NLRP3 也會被非 ROS 刺激（ATP、尼日利亞黴素、晶體）激活，因此 ROS 是一種常見但非排他性的觸發器。源自 NOX 酶的 ROS 和 mitochondria 匯聚於 NLRP3，將代謝和發炎壓力與 IL-1beta 的產生連結起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

links.context: RSK phosphorylates APAF-1 at Ser268, causing inhibition in prostate cancer cells.
links.context_zh_TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 APAF-1，在攝護腺癌細胞中造成抑制。

links.context: RSL3 (Ras-selective lethal 3) is a small-molecule ferroptosis inducer that directly inhibits GPX4. Its chloroacetamide moiety reacts with the selenol group of GPX4's catalytic selenocysteine (Sec46) to form an irreversible covalent adduct, blocking reduction of phospholipid hydroperoxides and causing iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and ferroptotic death. Unlike erastin, which depletes glutathione upstream via system Xc-, RSL3 acts directly on GPX4 and is therefore a more specific probe of GPX4-dependent ferroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: RSL3（Ras-selective lethal 3）是小分子 ferroptosis 誘導劑，可直接抑制 GPX4。它的氯乙醯胺基團與 GPX4 催化性 selenocysteine (Sec46) 的硒醇基反應，形成不可逆的共價加合物，阻斷磷脂過氧化物的還原，造成鐵依賴性的 lipid peroxidation 與 ferroptotic 死亡。與經 system Xc- 上游耗竭 glutathione 的 erastin 不同，RSL3 直接作用於 GPX4，因此是更專一的 GPX4 依賴性 ferroptosis 探針。

links.context: Rab7 is a small Ras-related GTPase that defines late endosomal and lysosomal identity and governs the terminal steps of degradative membrane traffic. In its GTP-bound state on late endosomal membranes Rab7 drives the maturation of endosomes into lysosomes and is indispensable for the fusion of mature autophagosomes with late endosomes and lysosomes to form autolysosomes, thereby enabling autophagic degradation within the lysosomal lumen.
links.context_zh_TW: Rab7 是一個小的 Ras 相關 GTP 酶，定義晚內體與溶酶體的身分，並調控降解性膜運輸的最後步驟。在晚內體膜上處於 GTP 結合狀態時，Rab7 驅動內體成熟為溶酶體，對成熟自噬體與晚內體／溶酶體融合形成自噬溶酶體是不可或缺的，藉此在溶酶體腔內進行自噬降解。

links.context: Rab8 (RAB8A) is a small GTPase that interacts with the mitophagy receptor optineurin (OPTN). This OPTN-Rab8 interaction is required for retrograde, microtubule-based transport of mitochondria-containing autophagosomes toward the cell body where lysosomes are located, so Rab8 supplies the transport step that mitophagic flux requires.
links.context_zh_TW: Rab8 (RAB8A) 是與 mitophagy 受體 optineurin (OPTN) 交互作用的小型 GTPase。此 OPTN–Rab8 交互作用是沿微管將含粒線體的自噬體向細胞體逆行運輸所必需，而細胞體正是溶小體所在處，因此 Rab8 提供了 mitophagic flux 所需的運輸步驟。

links.context: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation, positioning mTORC1 for activation; amino-acid starvation inactivates Rags and disperses mTORC1, de-repressing autophagy. The Rags therefore act as amino-acid sensors that bridge nutrient availability to mTORC1 spatial activation. Their regulation by the Ragulator and GAPs (e.g., GATOR complexes) is central to nutrient signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: Rag GTPases（RagA/B 和 RagC/D）作為異二聚體發揮功能，結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重新定位至活化劑 Rheb 所在的溶酶體表面。胺基酸充足有利於活化的 Rag 構象，將 mTORC1 定位以進行活化；胺基酸飢餓則使 Rags 失活並分散 mTORC1，解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Rags 作為胺基酸感測器，將營養可得性橋接到 mTORC1 的空間活化。它們受 Ragulator 和 GAPs（例如 GATOR 複合物）調節，是營養信號的核心。

links.context: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where its activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation and positions mTORC1 for activation.
links.context_zh_TW: Rag GTP 酶（RagA/B 與 RagC/D）以異二聚體形式結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重定位到溶酶體表面，也就是其活化因子 Rheb 所在之處。胺基酸充足會偏向 Rag 的活化構形，使 mTORC1 就位以接受活化。

links.context: Ragulator is the multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that recruits mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. It interacts with Rag GTPases to tether the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, so that amino-acid sensing converges with Rheb-mediated activation at one defined site.
links.context_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜的多蛋白支架，在胺基酸刺激下把 mTORC1 招募到溶酶體表面。它與 Rag GTP 作用以將 Rag-mTORC1 複合體繫泊於溶酶體，使胺基酸感知與 Rheb 介導的活化在同一定位點收斂。

links.context: Rapalogs are derivatives of Rapamycin (also known as sirolimus) that act as allosteric inhibitors of mTOR. Members of the class include Everolimus (RAD001), Temsirolimus and Ridaforolimus. Because they are rapamycin analogues, rapalogs share the mTOR-binding mechanism of the parent compound while differing in pharmacokinetic properties.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 Rapamycin（又称 sirolimus）的衍生物，作為 mTOR 的異構性抑制劑。該類成員包括 Everolimus（RAD001）、Temsirolimus 與 Ridaforolimus。由於屬於 rapamycin 的類似物，Rapalog 與母體化合物共享 mTOR 結合機制，但在藥代動力學特性上有所不同。

links.context: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes toward a more naïve, less exhausted state and promotes autophagy-mediated quality control within immune cells. In preclinical and clinical studies, transient rapamycin treatment improved immune responses to vaccination in the elderly. These effects illustrate how targeting the mTOR-autophagy axis can functionally rejuvenate the aging immune system.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

links.context: Rapamycin is arguably the most widely reported hormetic drug, an FDA-approved macrolide antibiotic used clinically for immunosuppression in organ-transplant patients and for certain cancers and autoimmune conditions. Many independent studies show a clear inverted U-shaped dose-response curve after long-term rapamycin inhibition (more than 24 hours of treatment) in terms of cell viability, mitochondrial density and Ki-67 expression, with maximum efficiency typically around 1 nM and reduced effects at higher concentrations up to 50 nM. The study proposes that this hormesis arises from the network topology of the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade rather than from side effects or cytotoxicity alone.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin可以說是報告最廣泛的興奮效應藥物，一種FDA批准的巨環類抗生素，臨床上用於器官移植患者的免疫抑制以及某些癌症和自體免疫疾病。許多獨立研究顯示長期rapamycin抑制（超過24小時治療）後，細胞活力、粒線體密度和Ki-67表達呈清晰的倒U型劑量反應曲線，最大效率通常在1 nM左右，在高達50 nM的較高濃度下效果降低。該研究提出這種興奮效應源於mTOR-PI3K訊號級聯的網路拓撲結構，而非僅僅來自副作用或細胞毒性。

links.context: Rapamycin is the most effective known cancer-preventive agent in mice, extending the lifespan of cancer-prone mice, and it prevents lymphoma and some types of cancer in transplant patients. Although it was once feared that rapamycin might increase cancer risk, rapamycin analogs everolimus and temsirolimus are now widely used in cancer therapy. While carcinogens from tobacco cause lung cancer in mice, rapamycin decreases tobacco-induced lung cancer multiplicity by 90%, and rapamycin and everolimus are more effective for preventing cancer than treating it, with no study showing that mTOR inhibitors cause cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin是小鼠中最有效的已知癌症預防劑，可延長易患癌症小鼠的壽命，並預防移植患者的淋巴瘤和某些類型的癌症。盡管曾經擔心rapamycin可能增加癌症風險，但rapamycin類似物everolimus和temsirolimus現在已廣泛用於癌症治療。雖然煙草中的致癌物會導致小鼠肺癌，但rapamycin將煙草誘導的肺癌多發性降低90%，且rapamycin和everolimus在預防癌症方面比治療更有效，沒有研究表明mTOR抑製劑會導致癌症。

links.context: Rapamycin is the prototypical mTORC1 inhibitor suppressing SASP translation and growth signaling. Inhibition is the defining pharmacology.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 是抑制 SASP 轉譯與生長訊號的原型 mTORC1 抑制劑。抑制是定義性藥理。

links.context: Rapamycin-insensitive companion of mTOR (Rictor) is a core component of mTORC2, essential for the structural integrity and kinase activity of the six-protein complex. Rictor scaffolds mTOR, mSIN1, Protor-1 and mLST8, and its rapamycin-insensitivity is what gives mTORC2 its name.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin 不敏感的 mTOR 伴隨蛋白 Rictor 是 mTORC2 的核心成分，對這個六蛋白複合體的結構完整性與激酶活性不可或缺。Rictor 支架化 mTOR、mSIN1、Protor-1 與 mLST8，而其對 rapamycin 的不敏感性正是 mTORC2 命名之由來。

links.context: Raw red grapes contain roughly 0.15-1.3 mg resveratrol per 100 g, mostly in the skins, making dietary intake from fruit modest. Directionally, grape content sits upstream of limited resveratrol exposure. Skin concentration explains why wine, not flesh, carries most of the compound, and it reinforces that supplementation, rather than diet alone, reaches high doses. Even so, grape-derived resveratrol contributes to the polyphenol intake associated with Mediterranean-style diets. Understanding the natural abundance of resveratrol is important for interpreting both dietary and supplement-based research.
links.context_zh_TW: 生紅葡萄每 100 克含有約 0.15-1.3 mg resveratrol，主要在果皮中，使得從水果攝入的飲食量有限。在方向性上，葡萄含量位於 resveratrol 暴露量有限的上游。果皮中的濃度解釋了為何葡萄酒而非果肉攜帶大部分化合物，並強化了需要補充劑而非僅靠飲食才能達到高劑量的觀點。即便如此，葡萄來源的 resveratrol 對地中海飲食相關的多酚攝入量有所貢獻。理解 resveratrol 的天然豐度對於詮釋飲食和補充劑研究都很重要。

links.context: Rb (retinoblastoma protein) acts by binding and sequestering E2F transcription factors, preventing transcription of genes required for S-phase entry such as cyclin A, cyclin E, DNA polymerase and thymidine kinase. In its active hypophosphorylated state Rb also recruits SWI/SNF and histone deacetylase complexes to E2F target promoters, establishing a repressive chromatin state that makes the arrest irreversible even if Rb is later degraded.
links.context_zh_TW: Rb（視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白）的作用方式是結合並隔離 E2F 轉錄因子，阻止 cyclin A、cyclin E、DNA polymerase 與 thymidine kinase 等 S 期進入所需基因的轉錄。在活性態的低磷酸化 Rb 也會將 SWI/SNF 與組蛋白去乙醯酶複合體招募到 E2F 標的啟動子，建立抑制性染色質狀態，使停滯即使在 Rb 隨後被降解後仍不可逆。

links.context: Reactive Oxygen Species are beneficial signaling molecules at low levels, but when their production exceeds the body's antioxidant capacity they cause Oxidative Stress, damaging lipids, proteins and DNA — a process central to Parkinson's Disease and other neurodegenerative disease.
links.context_zh_TW: Reactive Oxygen Species 在低濃度時是有益的訊號分子，但當其生成量超過身體的抗氧化能力時，就會造成 Oxidative Stress，損傷脂質、蛋白質與 DNA —— 此過程是 Parkinson's Disease 及其他神經退化性疾病的核心。

links.context: Reactive nitrogen species are derived from nitric oxide, which combines with superoxide or other radicals to yield peroxynitrite, nitrogen dioxide, and related species. Thus NO is the nitrogenous precursor of the broader RNS family. The directionality is NO to RNS expansion. A caveat is that RNS also include species from myeloperoxidase and other enzymatic pathways, so RNS origin is not exclusively nitric-oxide-derived. Because NO is itself a free radical with signaling functions, RNS can be viewed as both downstream products and, under excess, pathological mediators of nitrative stress.
links.context_zh_TW: Reactive nitrogen species 衍生自 nitric oxide，它與超氧化物或其他自由基結合產生 peroxynitrite、二氧化氮和相關物質。因此，NO 是更廣泛的 RNS 家族的含氮前驅物。 RNS 擴展的方向性是「否」。需要注意的是，RNS 還包括來自 myeloperoxidase 和其他酶途徑的物種，因此 RNS 起源不僅來自一氧化氮​​。由於NO本身是具有訊號傳導功能的自由基，RNS既可以被視為下游產物，也可以被視為nitrative stress過量時的病理介質。
