It is transmitted by mosquito vectors and perpetuates infection through circulating microfilariae in the blood.
links.context_zh_TW: Wuchereria bancrofti 是絲狀的淋巴絲蟲線蟲，為人類 Lymphatic Filariasis（被忽略的熱帶疾病）的主要病因，會造成 massive 的淋巴水腫（大象病）與陰囊積水。經由蚊子病媒傳播，並藉血中循環的微絲蟲持續維持感染。

links.context: XIAP inhibits Caspase-3. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with XIAP acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: XIAP 抑制 Caspase-3。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，XIAP 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: XIAP inhibits Caspase-9. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The relationship is directional, with XIAP acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-9 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: XIAP 抑制 Caspase-9。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。這種關係是有方向的，XIAP 充當 Caspase-9 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: XIAP is antagonized by Smac-DIABLO. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The directionality runs from Smac-DIABLO toward XIAP, so Smac-DIABLO is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: XIAP 被 Smac-DIABLO 拮抗。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。方向性從 Smac-DIABLO 朝向 XIAP，因此 Smac-DIABLO 是活性劑，並且 XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: XIAP is stabilized by Akt. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward XIAP, so Akt is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: XIAP 由 Akt 穩定。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 XIAP，因此 Akt 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: XIST is a long non-coding RNA that is the primary driver of X chromosome inactivation, the process by which one X chromosome is transcriptionally silenced in female cells to ensure appropriate gene dosage. XIST coats the inactive X chromosome and recruits chromatin-modifying enzymes that establish repressive marks, compacting the chromosome into a transcriptionally silent Barr body. This silencing is heritable through cell divisions, making XIST a paradigm for long-range, RNA-mediated epigenetic gene silencing.
links.context_zh_TW: XIST 是一種長非編碼 RNA，是 X 染色體失活的主要驅動因素，在雌性細胞中，一條 X 染色體轉錄沉默，以確保適當的基因劑量。 XIST 覆蓋不活躍的 X 染色體，並招募染色質修飾酶來建立抑制標記，將染色體壓縮成轉錄沉默的巴爾體。這種沉默可透過細胞分裂遺傳，使 XIST 成為長程、RNA 介導的表觀遺傳基因沉默的範例。
links.source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md

links.context: Xanthine oxidase catalyzes the conversion of hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to uric acid, using molecular oxygen as the electron acceptor. This enzyme thus sits at the junction of purine catabolism and ROS production. The directionality is purine oxidation to urate plus superoxide generation. A caveat is that the enzyme exists in an NAD+-dependent dehydrogenase form (XDH) that, when converted to the oxidase form (XO), becomes the prominent ROS-producing variant. The reaction also generates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide when oxygen serves as the electron acceptor, coupling urate production to oxidant release.
links.context_zh_TW: Xanthine oxidase 使用分子氧作為電子受體催化次黃嘌呤轉化為黃嘌呤以及黃嘌呤轉化為 uric acid。因此，此酵素位於嘌呤分解代謝和 ROS 生產的結合點。方向性是嘌呤氧化為尿酸鹽加上超氧化物的生成。需要注意的是，該酶以 NAD+ 依賴性脫氫酶形式 (XDH) 存在，當轉換為氧化酶形式 (XO) 時，它會成為主要的 ROS 生成變體。當氧氣作為電子受體時，此反應也會產生超氧化物和 hydrogen peroxide，從而將尿酸鹽的產生與氧化劑的釋放耦合。

links.context: Xanthine oxidase causes ischemia-reperfusion injury because, upon reperfusion, accumulated hypoxanthine meets newly available oxygen and XO generates a burst of superoxide and H2O2. This oxidant surge, together with neutrophil and mitochondrial ROS, amplifies tissue damage after blood return. The directionality is reperfusion to XO activation to injury. A caveat is that XO is one of several sources in reperfusion, and ischemic priming also contributes independently. Preclinical and some clinical studies show that XO inhibition before reperfusion attenuates infarct size and endothelial damage.
links.context_zh_TW: Xanthine oxidase 導致 ischemia-reperfusion injury，因為再灌注時，累積的次黃嘌呤遇到新可用的氧氣，XO 會產生大量超氧化物和 H2O2。這種氧化劑激增與嗜中性球和 mitochondrial ROS 一起，在血液回流後放大了組織損傷。方向性是再灌注到 XO 活化到損傷。需要注意的是，XO 是再灌注的幾個來源之一，缺血啟動也有獨立的影響。臨床前和一些臨床研究表明，再灌注前抑制 XO 可減輕梗塞面積和內皮損傷。

links.context: Xanthine oxidase produces superoxide radicals because, as it oxidizes hypoxanthine and xanthine, it transfers electrons to molecular oxygen rather than NAD+, yielding O2-*. This makes XO a significant extra-mitochondrial ROS source, especially in endothelium. The directionality is enzyme catalysis to superoxide formation. A caveat is that the oxidase/dehydrogenase ratio is regulated post-translationally, so superoxide output varies with the enzyme's conformation and redox state. XO activity rises during ischemia and inflammation, making it a target for drugs such as allopurinol that suppress both urate and ROS.
links.context_zh_TW: Xanthine oxidase 產生 superoxide radicals，因為當它氧化次黃嘌呤和黃嘌呤時，它將電子轉移到分子氧而不是 NAD+，產生 O2-*。這使得 XO 成為重要的額外 mitochondrial ROS 來源，尤其是在內皮細胞中。方向性是酵素催化超氧化物的形成。需要注意的是，氧化酶/脫氫酶的比例是在翻譯後調節的，因此超氧化物輸出隨酶的構象和氧化還原狀態而變化。 XO 活性在缺血和發炎期間升高，使其成為抑制尿酸鹽和 ROS 等藥物的標靶。

links.context: Xanthine oxidase reduces nitric oxide under hypoxia by functioning as a nitrate reductase that produces NO when nitric oxide synthase is inactive. This provides an alternative, oxygen-independent source of vasodilatory NO during low oxygen. The directionality is XO-driven nitrate reduction to NO formation. A caveat is that under normoxia XO predominantly produces superoxide, so this NO-generating role is context- and oxygen-dependent. The dual roles of XO as NO producer under hypoxia and superoxide source under normoxia make its inhibition context-dependent in vascular biology.
links.context_zh_TW: Xanthine oxidase 在缺氧條件下透過充當硝酸還原酶來還原 nitric oxide，當 nitric oxide synthase 不活躍時，此硝酸還原酶會產生 NO。這提供了低氧期間血管舒張一氧化氮的替代、不依賴氧氣的來源。方向性是 XO 驅動的硝酸鹽還原成 NO 的形成。需要注意的是，在含氧量正常的情況下，XO 主要產生超氧化物，因此這種 NO 生成作用取決於環境和氧氣。 XO 在缺氧條件下作為 NO 產生者和在常氧條件下作為超氧化物源的雙重作用使其抑制在血管生物學中具有背景依賴性。

links.context: Xp11 translocation RCC is a renal cell carcinoma subtype.
links.context_zh_TW: Xp11 易位 RCC 是腎細胞癌亞型。

links.context: Yoshinori Ohsumi was awarded the 2016 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering work using yeast genetics to identify the core autophagy-related (ATG) genes that govern the process. Through systematic mutagenesis screens, he uncovered the molecular machinery responsible for autophagosome formation, including the ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build the phagophore membrane. His discoveries established autophagy as a genetically tractable and evolutionarily conserved degradation pathway, providing the conceptual framework for all subsequent mammalian autophagy research. The recognition underscored the fundamental importance of autophagy in cellular homeostasis, development, and human disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 大隅良典（Yoshinori Ohsumi）因開創性地利用酵母遺傳學鑑定出主導此過程的核心自噬相關（ATG）基因，而獲頒2016年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。透過系統性的突變篩選，他揭示了負責自噬體形成的分子機制，包括建構吞噬泡膜的泛素樣共軛系統。他的發現確立了自噬作為一種可遺傳操作且演化上保守的降解途徑，為後續所有哺乳動物自噬研究提供了概念框架。此項榮譽凸顯了自噬在細胞穩態、發育和人類疾病中的根本重要性。

links.context: Z-VAD-FMK is a pan-caspase inhibitor that blocks caspase-dependent apoptosis; persistence of death under Z-VAD-FMK argues for necroptosis, ferroptosis, or parthanatos instead.
links.context_zh_TW: Z-VAD-FMK 是泛 caspase 抑制劑，可阻斷 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis；在 Z-VAD-FMK 下仍發生的死亡指向 necroptosis、ferroptosis 或 parthanatos。

links.context: ZCCHC11 is terminal uridylyltransferase 4, the Lin28-recruited enzyme.
links.context_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 是末端尿苷醯轉移酶 4，即 Lin28 招募的酶。

links.context: ZKSCAN3 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that represses the expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes, acting in opposition to TFEB/TFE3. Under basal conditions it limits autophagic and lysosomal capacity, and its inhibition or loss enhances cellular clearance. ZKSCAN3 thereby functions as a transcriptional brake on the degradative network, complementary to the post-translational repression by mTORC1. Targeting ZKSCAN3 has been proposed as a strategy to boost autophagy in disease.
links.context_zh_TW: ZKSCAN3 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現，作用與 TFEB/TFE3 相反。在基礎條件下它限制自噬和溶酶體能力，其抑制或缺失則增強細胞清除。因此 ZKSCAN3 作為降解網絡的轉錄性制動，補充了 mTORC1 的轉譯後抑制。標靶 ZKSCAN3 已被提議作為在疾病中提升自噬的策略。

links.context: Zellweger syndrome, the most severe form of the Zellweger spectrum of peroxisome biogenesis disorders, is caused by mutations in PEX genes required for peroxisome assembly and matrix protein import. Affected individuals lack functional peroxisomes, leading to accumulation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid intermediates, and pipecolic acid, with profound neurologic, hepatic, and skeletal abnormalities. The spectrum's severity correlates with the degree of residual peroxisomal function. These disorders highlight the non-redundant essentiality of peroxisomes in human development.
links.context_zh_TW: Zellweger 症候群是 Zellweger 譜系過氧化體生物發生障礙中最嚴重的形式，由組裝過氧化體和基質蛋白輸入所需的 PEX 基因突變所引起。患者缺乏功能性過氧化體，導致極長鏈脂肪酸、膽汁酸中間物和哌可酸（pipecolic acid）累積，伴隨嚴重的神經、肝臟和骨骼異常。此譜系的嚴重程度與殘餘過氧化體功能程度相關。這些障礙凸顯了過氧化體在人類發育中非冗余的必要性。

links.context: aak-2 is the principal catalytic (alpha) subunit of the Caenorhabditis elegans AMP-activated protein kinase complex, the conserved energy sensor that monitors the AMP/ATP ratio. As the catalytic core, aak-2 transduces bioenergetic stress — raised AMP from low glucose, exercise, or mitochondrial dysfunction — into phosphorylation of anabolic and catabolic targets.
links.context_zh_TW: aak-2 是 Caenorhabditis elegans AMP 活化蛋白激酶複合體的主要催化（α）次單元，該複合體是監測 AMP/ATP 比例的保守能量感測器。作為催化核心，aak-2 將低葡萄糖、運動或粒線體功能障礙造成的 AMP 上升等生物能量壓力，轉換為對同化與分解代謝標的的磷酸化。

links.context: c-ABL phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Tyr153, promoting caspase activation and DNA damage-induced apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: c-ABL 在 Tyr153 磷酸化 Caspase-9，促進 caspase 活化與 DNA 損傷誘發的凋亡。

links.context: c-FLIP, structurally related to but catalytically inactive as a homodimer partner, pairs with Caspase-8 to block apoptosis; when Caspase-8 or c-FLIP is lost or its activation interrupted, RIPK1 complexes with RIPK3 to assemble the necrosome — the FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP complex acts as the rheostat that suppresses RIPK3-mediated death.
links.context_zh_TW: c-FLIP 與 Caspase-8 結構相近但具催化惰性，與 Caspase-8 配對以阻斷凋亡；當 Caspase-8 或 c-FLIP 缺失、或其中斷活化時，RIPK1 與 RIPK3 複合組裝成 necrosome——FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP 複合物即為抑制 RIPK3 媒介死亡的調節器。

links.context: c-Jun N-terminal kinase is a MAPK family member activated by the MAP kinase kinases MKK4 and MKK7 in response to cytokines, UV, osmotic shock, and — most relevant here — oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction. Once active, it phosphorylates c-Jun and other substrates on Ser/Thr residues.
links.context_zh_TW: c-Jun N-terminal kinase 是 MAPK 家族的成員，會被 MAP 激酶激酶 MKK4 與 MKK7 活化，以回應細胞激素、UV、滲透壓衝擊，以及——在此最相關的——Oxidative Stress 與粒線體功能障礙。活化後它在絲胺酸／蘇胺酸殘基上磷酸化 c-Jun 及其他標的。

links.context: c-Met is definitionally a receptor tyrosine kinase. Classification is textbook.
links.context_zh_TW: c-Met 定義上是受體酪胺酸激酶。歸類為教科書等級。

links.context: cGAS inhibitors are experimental small molecules — RU.521, TDI, PF-06928215, G150, and SU-cH — that block the nucleotidyltransferase activity of cGAS, preventing synthesis of cGAMP and thereby suppressing downstream STING activation and type I interferon production. By inhibiting the proximal sensor they interrupt the cGAS-STING pathway at its upstream enzymatic step, reducing ISG expression, NF-κB-driven cytokines, and maladaptive glial activation.
links.context_zh_TW: cGAS 抑制劑是一類實驗性小分子——RU.521、TDI、PF-06928215、G150 與 SU-cH——可阻斷 cGAS 的核苷酸轉移酶活性，抑制 cGAMP 的合成，因而抑制下游 STING 活化與第一型干擾素的產生。藉由抑制最上游的感測器，它們在 cGAS-STING pathway 的上游酵素步驟加以截斷，降低 ISG 表現、NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素與不良的膠細胞活化。

links.context: cGAS is tethered at the Nuclear Envelope through Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1), which dynamically outcompetes cGAS for DNA binding and restricts its activity; NPC1 at the envelope further modulates cGAS, so envelope integrity determines whether cGAS stays quiescent or engaged.
links.context_zh_TW: cGAS 透過 Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1) 錨定於 Nuclear Envelope；BAF1 會動態地與 cGAS 競爭 DNA 結合並限制其活性，而位於核膜的 NPC1 進一步調節 cGAS，因此核膜完整性決定 cGAS 是保持靜默或被活化。

links.context: cGAS synthesizes the endogenous cyclic dinucleotide messenger 2'3'-cGAMP from ATP and GTP upon sensing cytosolic DNA. cGAMP then binds STING in the endoplasmic reticulum, triggering STING translocation to the ERGIC and recruitment of TBK1 and IRF3 to drive type I interferon and ISG expression.
links.context_zh_TW: cGAS 在偵測到細胞質 DNA 後，以 ATP 與 GTP 合成內源性 Cyclic Dinucleotide 訊息傳遞者 2'3'-cGAMP。cGAMP 接著在內質網中結合 STING，促使 STING 易位至 ERGIC 並招募 TBK1 與 IRF3，進而驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 的表現。

links.context: cIAPs (cIAP1/BIRC2 and cIAP2/BIRC3) are RING-type E3 Ubiquitin Ligases. Their catalytic triad — BIR, CARD and RING domains — confers ligase activity toward RIPK1, toward other complex-I residents such as TRAF2/5, and toward themselves, so that auto-ubiquitination triggers their own proteasomal self-destruction.
links.context_zh_TW: cIAPs（cIAP1/BIRC2 與 cIAP2/BIRC3）是 RING 型 E3 Ubiquitin Ligase。其由 BIR、CARD 與 RING 結構域構成的催化三要素，賦予其對 RIPK1、對其他 complex I 居民（如 TRAF2/5）以及對自身的連接酶活性，因此自我泛素化會觸發其自身的蛋白酶體自體毀滅。

links.context: cIAPs prevent formation of the Ripoptosome: as E3 ligases they constitutively ubiquitinate compartmentalized RIPK1 and target it for degradation, precluding assembly. Loss of cIAPs through genotoxic stress, Smac mimetics or TLR3 stimulation permits spontaneous formation — proteasome blockade alone suffices.
links.context_zh_TW: cIAPs 阻止 Ripoptosome 的形成：作為 E3 連接酶，它們持續泛素化被區室化的 RIPK1 並將其標記降解，因而排除組裝的可能。當 cIAPs 因基因毒性壓力、Smac mimetics 或 TLR3 刺激而喪失時，Ripoptosome 即可自發形成 —— 單靠蛋白酶體阻斷即已足夠。

links.context: cIAPs suppress Ripoptosome assembly by continuously degrading free cytosolic RIPK1, holding its pool below the assembly threshold. Loss of cIAPs — via Smac mimetics, genotoxic stress or TLR3 stimulation — lets RIPK1 accumulate, expose its death domain, recruit FADD and nucleate the ripoptosome. Critically, proteasome blockade degrades cIAPs yet still permits ripoptosome formation, showing it is control of compartmentalized RIPK1 rather than bulk cIAP levels that gates assembly.
links.context_zh_TW: cIAPs 藉由持續降解游離的細胞質 RIPK1 將其濃度維持在組裝門檻以下，因而抑制 Ripoptosome 的組裝。cIAPs 的喪失——經由 Smac mimetics、基因毒性壓力或 TLR3 刺激——使 RIPK1 累積、暴露其 death domain、招募 FADD 並成核形成 ripoptosome。關鍵在於，蛋白酶體阻斷雖會降解 cIAPs 卻仍容許 ripoptosome 形成，顯示真正把關組裝的是對區室化 RIPK1 的控制，而非 cIAP 的總量。

links.context: cIAPs ubiquitinate RIPK1 inside TNFR1 complex I, attaching K63 and linear M1 chains (the latter via LUBAC) with TRAF2/5. Those chains are both the physical scaffold for IKK/NF-κB and MAPK activation and the substrate that CYLD must erase for the complex to dissolve. Because RIPK1's ubiquitination state is the branch point, cIAP-mediated ubiquitination is what keeps a single cytokine serving as both growth factor and death ligand.
links.context_zh_TW: cIAPs 在 TNFR1 complex I 內泛素化 RIPK1，與 TRAF2/5 一起加上 K63 與線性 M1 鏈（後者經由 LUBAC）。這些鏈既是 IKK/NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化的實體支架，也是 CYLD 必須抹除才能使複合體溶解的受質。由於 RIPK1 的泛素化狀態是分支點，cIAP 媒介的泛素化正是讓單一細胞激素同時扮演生長因子與死亡配體的原因。

links.context: dNTPs are consumed stoichiometrically by DNA polymerases during DNA replication and repair, and their supply is rate-limiting. Balanced dNTP pools are essential for high-fidelity replication; both depletion and imbalance drive replication stress, mutagenesis, and genomic instability.
links.context_zh_TW: dNTP 在 DNA 複製與修復期間被 DNA 聚合酶以化學計量方式消耗，其供應具有速率限制。平衡的 dNTP 池對高保真複製至關重要；耗竭與失衡皆會驅動複製壓力、突變與基因體不穩定性。

links.context: eEFSec (EEFSEC) is the dedicated eukaryotic elongation factor for selenocysteine insertion, the functional analog of bacterial SelB. It forms a ternary complex with GTP and Sec-charged tRNA[Ser]Sec and delivers selenocysteine to the ribosomal A site when the ribosome encounters a recoded UGA codon.
links.context_zh_TW: eEFSec（EEFSEC）是插入硒半胱胺酸（selenocysteine）專屬的真核轉譯延長因子，為細菌 SelB 的功能對應物。它與 GTP 及攜帶 Sec 的 tRNA[Ser]Sec 形成三元複合體，當核糖體遇到再編碼的 UGA 密碼子時，將硒半胱胺酸送入核糖體 A 位。

links.context: eIF2α is a key regulatory hub of the integrated stress response, phosphorylated at Ser51 by four stress-activated kinases. HRI (EIF2AK1) is the mitochondrial stress-responsive kinase, activated by DELE1 and heme deficiency, alongside PERK (ER stress), GCN2 (amino acid starvation), and PKR (double-stranded RNA).
links.context_zh_TW: eIF2α 是整合性壓力反應的關鍵調節樞紐，在 Ser51 上被四種壓力活化激酶磷酸化。HRI（EIF2AK1）是粒線體壓力反應的激酶，由 DELE1 與血基質缺乏活化，其他三者分別為 PERK（ER 壓力）、GCN2（胺基酸缺乏）與 PKR（雙股 RNA）。

links.context: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
links.context_zh_TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

links.context: eNOS (NOS3) is the constitutive isoform of nitric oxide synthase expressed in vascular endothelium, continuously producing low-level nitric oxide for basal vascular tone and opposing vasoconstriction. It dimerizes to catalyze the NADPH-dependent oxidation of L-arginine to citrulline and NO, requiring the cofactors tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), FAD and FMN.
links.context_zh_TW: eNOS（NOS3）是表現於血管內皮的一氧化氮合成酶組成型亞型，持續產生低量一氧化氮以維持基礎血管張力並對抗血管收縮。它以二聚體形式催化 NADPH 依賴的 L-精胺酸氧化生成瓜胺酸與 NO，需輔因子四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）、FAD 與 FMN。

links.context: eNOS (endothelial nitric oxide synthase, NOS3) is the constitutively expressed, calcium/calmodulin-dependent isoform of nitric oxide synthase in the vascular endothelium. It catalyses the conversion of L-arginine to low, pulsatile fluxes of nitric oxide, which diffuse to vascular smooth muscle and raise cGMP via soluble guanylyl cyclase to produce vasodilation.
links.context_zh_TW: eNOS（內皮型一氧化氮合成酶，NOS3）是血管內皮中構成性表現、依賴鈣離子/鈣調蛋白的 nitric oxide synthase 異構型。它催化 L-精胺酸轉化為低量脈動式的 nitric oxide；後者擴散至血管平滑肌，經可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶提高 cGMP，產生血管舒張。

links.context: eNOS produces NO for vasodilation, platelet inhibition, and maintenance of the vascular barrier, making it the principal source of basal endothelium-derived relaxing factor. Its activity is shear-stress regulated and couples blood flow to vessel relaxation. The directionality is endothelial NO to vascular homeostasis. A caveat is that eNOS also promotes angiogenesis and, when uncoupled, becomes a ROS source, so its role is context-dependent. Impairment of eNOS-NO signaling, whether by substrate deficiency, BH4 loss, or NO scavenging by superoxide, underlies most forms of endothelial dysfunction.
links.context_zh_TW: eNOS 產生 NO 用於 vasodilation、血小板抑制和血管屏障的維持，使其成為基底內皮源性舒張因子的主要來源。其活性受剪切應力調節，並將血流與血管鬆弛耦合。方向性是內皮NO對血管穩態的影響。需要注意的是，eNOS 也促進血管生成，並且在解耦時成為 ROS 源，因此其作用取決於上下文。 eNOS-NO 訊號傳導受損，無論是由於底物缺乏、BH4 缺失或超氧化物清除 NO，都是大多數形式的 endothelial dysfunction 的基礎。

links.context: eNOS uncoupling produces superoxide radicals when tetrahydrobiopterin or L-arginine becomes limiting, redirecting electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. The enzyme thereby switches from vasoprotection to oxidative injury. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling still yields some NO, and the transition is graded rather than an on/off switch. This switch contributes to vascular disease progression and explains why restoring BH4 or arginine improves endothelial function in experimental models.
links.context_zh_TW: 當 tetrahydrobiopterin 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，eNOS 解偶聯產生 superoxide radicals，將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。該酶從而從血管保護轉變為氧化損傷。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍然會產生一些 NO，並且過渡是分級的，而不是開/關開關。這種轉變有助於血管疾病的進展，並解釋了為什麼在實驗模型中恢復 BH4 或精氨酸可以改善內皮功能。

links.context: gamma-H2A.X, the phosphorylated form of the histone variant H2A.X at serine 139, serves as a beacon that recruits DNA repair proteins to sites of double-strand DNA breaks. Phosphorylation of H2A.X spreads over large chromatin domains around the break, providing a platform for the assembly of DNA repair complexes and the amplification of damage signaling. Beyond its role in repair, gamma-H2A.X induces p53 expression and activates senescence signaling, and it accumulates with aging as a result of persistent DNA damage.
links.context_zh_TW: γ-H2A.X 是組蛋白變體 H2A.X 在絲氨酸 139 的磷酸化形式，可作為將 DNA 修復蛋白招募到雙股 DNA 斷裂位點的信標。 H2A.X 的磷酸化遍布斷裂周圍的大染色質結構域，為 DNA 修復複合物的組裝和損傷訊號的放大提供了平台。除了修復作用之外，gamma-H2A.X 還誘導 p53 表達並激活衰老信號傳導，並且由於持續的 DNA 損傷，它會隨著衰老而累積。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: iFSP1 is the first reported small-molecule FSP1 inhibitor (IC50 ≈ 103 nM, human-specific via the F360 pocket). It blocks FSP1's NAD(P)H-dependent ubiquinone reductase activity, removing the GPX4-independent radical trap and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis, especially when combined with GPX4 inhibition. iFSP1, the first-in-class FSP1 inhibitor (IC50 ≈ 103 nM), binds human FSP1 at a pocket centered on residue F360 and blocks its NAD(P)H-dependent reduction of ubiquinone to ubiquinol, removing the GPX4-independent radical trap. Alone it is often insufficient in high-GPX4 cells but strongly synergizes with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibition to trigger ferroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: iFSP1 是第一個被報導的 FSP1 小分子抑制劑（IC50 ≈ 103 nM，透過 F360 口袋特異於人類）。它阻斷 FSP1 依賴 NAD(P)H 的泛醌還原酶活性，移除不依賴 GPX4 的自由基陷阱並使細胞對鐵死亡敏感，尤其與 GPX4 抑制合併時。 iFSP1 是第一個 FSP1 抑制劑（IC50 ≈ 103 nM），結合於人類 FSP1 以 F360 殘基為中心的口袋，鎖定並阻斷其依賴 NAD(P)H 將泛醌還原為泛醇的活性，移除不依賴 GPX4 的自由基陷阱。單獨使用在 GPX4 高表現細胞中往往不足，但與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併時強烈協同誘發鐵死亡。

links.context: iNOS (NOS2) is the cytokine-inducible isoform of nitric oxide synthase, expressed in macrophages and many cell types after inflammatory stimulation to generate sustained high-output nitric oxide. Excess iNOS-derived NO drives pathological vasodilation and hypotension in septic and vasoplegic shock.
links.context_zh_TW: iNOS（NOS2）是一氧化氮合成酶的細胞激素誘導型異構酶，在發炎刺激後於巨噬細胞與多種細胞中表現，產生持續高產量的一氧化氮。iNOS 衍生過量的一氧化氮會在敗血症休克與血管麻痺性休克中造成病理性血管擴張與低血壓。

links.context: iNOS drives nitrative stress because its high NO output reacts with concomitant superoxide to form peroxynitrite, especially in inflamed tissues. This makes iNOS a key enzymatic source of nitrating oxidants. The directionality is inducible NO to peroxynitrite-mediated nitration. A caveat is that peroxynitrite also arises from eNOS uncoupling and other sources, so iNOS is a major but not sole driver of nitrative stress. Co-induction of iNOS and NOX in the same cells maximizes peroxynitrite flux, making inflamed tissue a major site of protein nitration.
links.context_zh_TW: iNOS 驅動 nitrative stress，因為其高 NO 輸出與伴隨的超氧化物反應形成 peroxynitrite，特別是在發炎組織中。這使得 iNOS 成為硝化氧化劑的關鍵酶源。方向性是 peroxynitrite 介導的硝化作用的誘導型 NO。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 也源自於 eNOS 解耦和其他來源，因此 iNOS 是 nitrative stress 的主要驅動因素，但不是唯一的驅動因素。同一細胞中 iNOS 和 NOX 的共誘導使 peroxynitrite 通量最大化，使發炎組織成為蛋白質硝化的主要部位。

links.context: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
links.context_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

links.context: iRGD homes to alphav tumor vasculature via its RGD motif as step one.
links.context_zh_TW: iRGD 經 RGD 基序歸巢 αv 腫瘤血管作為第一步。

links.context: iRGD is engineered from the parent RGD motif plus a CendR element.
links.context_zh_TW: iRGD 由母 RGD 基序加 CendR 元件工程化。

links.context: mSIN1 (MAPKAP1) is an essential component of mTORC2, one of six proteins in the complex, and it maintains complex integrity so that mTORC2 can function as a kinase rather than dissociate. mTORC2 also contains mTOR, Rictor, Protor-1, mLST8 and Deptor, several of which are shared with mTORC1.
links.context_zh_TW: mSIN1（MAPKAP1）是 mTORC2 的必需成分，該複合體共含六種蛋白質；它維持複合體完整性，使 mTORC2 得以作為激酶發揮功能而不解離。mTORC2 還包含 mTOR、Rictor、Protor-1、mLST8 與 Deptor，其中數個也與 mTORC1 共用。

links.context: mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) is composed of five core subunits: the catalytic kinase mTOR, the scaffold Raptor (which binds substrates and Rag GTPases), mLST8 (stabilizing the kinase domain), the inhibitory subunit PRAS40, and the negative regulator Deptor. This stoichiometric assembly defines mTORC1's substrate specificity and its sensitivity to upstream inputs such as amino acids and insulin. Raptor is essential for recruitment of mTORC1 to lysosomes and for phosphorylation of canonical substrates like S6K1 and 4E-BP1. The composition distinguishes mTORC1 from mTORC2, which shares mTOR, mLST8, and Deptor but includes Rictor instead of Raptor.
links.context_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 1（mTORC1）由五個核心次單元組成：催化激酶 mTOR、支架蛋白 Raptor（結合受質和 Rag GTPases）、mLST8（穩定激酶結構域）、抑制性次單元 PRAS40，以及負向調節者 Deptor。此化學計量組裝決定了 mTORC1 的受質專一性及其對胺基酸和胰島素等上游輸入的敏感性。Raptor 對於將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體以及磷酸化 S6K1 和 4E-BP1 等典型受質至關重要。此組成將 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 區分開來，後者共享 mTOR、mLST8 和 Deptor，但包含 Rictor 而非 Raptor。

links.context: mTOR complex 2 (mTORC2) comprises six core proteins: mTOR, Rictor (its defining scaffold), mSIN1 (required for mTORC2 integrity and Akt phosphorylation), Protor-1, mLST8, and the negative regulator Deptor. mTORC2 is best known for phosphorylating and activating Akt at Ser473 and for regulating cytoskeletal organization and cell survival. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2 is not acutely rapamycin-sensitive and is not directly recruited to lysosomes by Rag GTPases. Its distinct composition underlies its separate physiological roles in metabolism and actin dynamics.
links.context_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 2（mTORC2）包含六個核心蛋白：mTOR、Rictor（其定義性支架）、mSIN1（mTORC2 完整性與 Akt 磷酸化所需）、Protor-1、mLST8，以及負向調節者 Deptor。mTORC2 最為人所知的是在 Ser473 磷酸化並活化 Akt，以及調節細胞骨架組織和細胞存活。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 不會被雷帕黴素急性抑制，也不會被 Rag GTPases 直接招募至溶酶體。其獨特組成奠定了其在代謝和肌動蛋白動力學中各自獨立的生理角色。

links.context: mTOR is a central regulator of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Rapamycin treatment of senescent cells suppresses SASP production at both the mRNA and protein levels, and mechanistic studies show that mTOR acts in part by promoting the translation of the SASP activator IL-1alpha, which then drives expression of downstream inflammatory cytokines. Because rapamycin reduces the inflammatory secretome while leaving growth arrest intact, mTOR inhibition is considered a senomorphic strategy that attenuates the detrimental effects of senescence without eliminating senescent cells.
links.context_zh_TW: mTOR 是老化相關分泌表型 (SASP) 的中心調節因子。雷帕黴素治療老化細胞可在 mRNA 和蛋白質水平抑制 SASP 的產生，機制研究表明，mTOR 的部分作用是透過促進 SASP 活化劑 IL-1α 的翻譯，然後驅動下游發炎細胞因子的表達。由於雷帕黴素可減少發炎分泌組，同時保持生長停滯完整，因此 mTOR 抑制被認為是一種衰老策略，可減輕衰老的有害影響而不消除衰老細胞。

links.context: mTOR is a primordial negative regulator of Autophagy from yeast to man. It is inhibited under starvation conditions, which contributes to starvation-induced autophagy via activation of its targets Atg13, ULK1 and ULK2, and the same inhibition can be mimicked pharmacologically by rapamycin. Under milder starvation mTOR activity is also reduced while mTORC1 stays lysosome-associated, which clusters lysosomes near the microtubule-organizing center and enhances autophagosome-lysosome fusion.
links.context_zh_TW: mTOR 是從酵母到人類都存在的自噬原始負向調節因子。飢餓時它被抑制，透過活化其目標 Atg13、ULK1 與 ULK2 而促成禁食誘導的自噬，同樣的抑制也可由 rapamycin 以藥理方式模擬。在較輕度的飢餓下 mTOR 活性同樣下降，而 mTORC1 仍與溶酶體相連，使溶酶體聚集於微管組織中心附近並增強自噬體－溶酶體融合。

links.context: mTORC1 integrates signals from amino acids, growth factors, and energy sufficiency to promote the anabolic arm of Metabolism, including protein synthesis, lipid synthesis, and cell growth. When nutrients are scarce mTORC1 is suppressed, allowing catabolic recycling through Autophagy; rapamycin acts by inhibiting mTORC1 and extends lifespan in model organisms.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 整合胺基酸、生長因子與能量充足度的訊號，促進 Metabolism 的合成代謝面向，包括蛋白質合成、脂質合成與細胞生長。當養分匱乏時 mTORC1 受到抑制，使經由 Autophagy 進行的分解回收得以進行；rapamycin 正是藉由抑制 mTORC1 而在模式生物中延長壽命。

links.context: mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosomal surface, where it encounters its activator Rheb and receives upstream amino-acid and growth-factor inputs necessary for full activation. This spatial recruitment, mediated by Rag GTPases and the Ragulator scaffold, converts the lysosome into the signaling platform for mTORC1. Only when docked at the lysosome can mTORC1 efficiently phosphorylate its substrates, including TFEB and ULK1. Thus lysosomal localization is essential for mTORC1 function and for its inhibition of autophagy.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 被招募至溶酶體表面，在此它遇到其活化劑 Rheb，並接收上游胺基酸和生長因子輸入以達到完全活化。這種由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 支架介導的空間招募，將溶酶體轉化為 mTORC1 的信號平台。唯有停靠於溶酶體時，mTORC1 才能有效磷酸化其受質，包括 TFEB 和 ULK1。因此溶酶體定位對 mTORC1 功能及其對自噬的抑制至為關鍵。

links.context: mTORC1 is the central anabolic driver of Muscle Hypertrophy. Mechanical tension and metabolic stress during resistance exercise activate the PI3K/Akt pathway and leucine sensing upstream of mTORC1, which raises translation initiation and boosts myofibrillar protein accretion. Sustained mTORC1 signalling is what makes a muscle grow rather than merely adapt.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的核心合成代謝驅動因子。阻力運動期間的機械張力與代謝壓力會經由 PI3K/Akt 路徑與 leucine 感測在 mTORC1 上游活化它，進而提升轉譯起始並促進肌原纖維蛋白的累積。持續的 mTORC1 訊號正是肌肉生長而非僅止於適應的關鍵。

links.context: mTORC1 is the master nutrient-sensitive repressor of autophagy, integrating signals from growth factors, amino acids, and energy to suppress the pathway when resources are abundant. Active mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 and Atg13, preventing initiation complex assembly, and phosphorylates TFEB/TFE3 to retain them in the cytosol, blocking lysosomal gene expression. Only when mTORC1 is inhibited—by starvation, AMPK, or rapamycin—does autophagy proceed. This inhibitory relationship places mTORC1 at the apex of autophagic control in mammalian cells.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1是mTOR通路中的主激酶，通常透過磷酸化Unc-51樣自噬啟動激酶1（ULK1）複合物的成分來抑制自噬。當雷帕霉素抑制mTORC1時，這種抑制被解除，自噬體形成啟動，激活降解蛋白質聚集物和受損細胞器的細胞回收過程。這種自噬抑制的解除是雷帕霉素提出的geroprotective機制的核心，維持蛋白質穩定並減少有絲分裂後細胞中的「毒性負擔」，但網路上抗衰老背景下從該通路得出的長壽聲稱並非基於正式的geroscience，缺乏精確的生物學...。

links.context: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFE3 at serine 321, an analog of the TFEB S211 site, thereby promoting cytosolic retention and inhibiting TFE3's transcriptional activity under nutrient-replete conditions. This parallel modification ensures that both MiT/TFE family master regulators are coordinately repressed by mTORC1. Upon starvation or mTORC1 inhibition, dephosphorylation permits TFE3 nuclear entry and activation of lysosomal genes. The conserved regulatory logic highlights the unified control of the degradative program.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 321 磷酸化 TFE3，此位點是 TFEB S211 位點的類似物，從而在營養充足條件下促進細胞質保留並抑制 TFE3 的轉錄活性。此平行修飾確保 MiT/TFE 家族的兩個主調節者都被 mTORC1 協調抑制。在飢餓或 mTORC1 抑制時，去磷酸化允許 TFE3 核進入和溶酶體基因的活化。保守的調節邏輯凸顯了對降解程序的統一控制。

links.context: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at both serine 142 and serine 211, two residues whose combined modification enforces 14-3-3 binding and robust cytosolic retention of the transcription factor. These sites act synergistically to prevent TFEB nuclear entry and thus block activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program under nutrient-replete conditions. Dephosphorylation of both marks is required for full TFEB activation during starvation. The dual-site control exemplifies the redundancy mTORC1 employs to firmly suppress degradative transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 142 和 serine 211 兩處磷酸化 TFEB，這兩個殘基的聯合修飾強制了 14-3-3 結合以及該轉錄因子穩健的細胞質保留。這些位點協同作用以防止 TFEB 核進入，從而在營養充足條件下阻斷自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。飢餓期間必須將這兩個標記都去磷酸化，TFEB 才能完全活化。雙位點控制具體體現了 mTORC1 用以牢牢抑制降解轉錄的冗餘機制。

links.context: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 122, an additional N-terminal regulatory site that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor under nutrient-rich conditions. Alongside S142 and S211, S122 forms part of the multi-site phosphorylation code through which mTORC1 enforces TFEB exclusion from the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of these sites by phosphatases such as PP2A is required for nuclear translocation. The multiplicity of mTORC1 sites provides tunable, robust control of lysosomal gene transcription.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 122 磷酸化 TFEB，這是營養豐裕條件下促進該轉錄因子細胞質保留的額外 N 端調節位點。與 S142 和 S211 並列，S122 構成 mTORC1 用以將 TFEB 排除於核外之多位點磷酸化密碼的一部分。這些位點經 PP2A 等磷酸酶去磷酸化，是核轉運所必需的。mTORC1 多重位點的設計提供了對溶酶體基因轉錄可調、穩健的控制。

links.context: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, a residue also modified by GSK3β, and this phosphorylation promotes nuclear export of TFEB, complementing the cytosolic retention imposed at other sites. The accumulation of phosphates across the N-terminal regulatory region collectively suppresses TFEB transcriptional activity. Relief of S138 phosphorylation facilitates nuclear accumulation and activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. This site therefore participates in the coordinated mTORC1 restraint of cellular clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 138 磷酸化 TFEB，此殘基亦受 GSK3β 修飾，此磷酸化促進 TFEB 的核輸出，補足其他位點施加的細胞質保留。N 端調節區磷酸根的增加共同抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。S138 磷酸化的解除有利於自噬—溶酶體程序的核累積與活化。因此此位點參與了 mTORC1 對細胞清除的協調性約束。

links.context: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

links.context: mTORC1 promotes lipid and cholesterol synthesis by activating the sterol regulatory element-binding proteins (SREBP1) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), transcription factors that drive expression of lipogenic and adipogenic enzymes. This anabolic output supports membrane biogenesis and energy storage during growth. The lipid-synthetic program is coordinated with mTORC1's stimulation of protein and nucleotide synthesis to build cellular mass. Its dysregulation contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic syndrome.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過活化固醇調節元件結合蛋白（SREBP1）和過氧化物酶體增殖物活化受體 gamma（PPARγ）——驅動脂肪生成和成脂酵素表現的轉錄因子——來促進脂質和膽固醇合成。此合成代謝輸出在生長期間支持膜生物發生和能量儲存。脂質合成程序與 mTORC1 對蛋白質和核苷酸合成的刺激協調，以建構細胞質量。其失調促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝症候群。

links.context: mTORC1 promotes protein synthesis by phosphorylating 4E-BP1 and S6K1. The phosphorylation of 4E-BP1 prevents its binding to eIF4E, enabling eIF4E to promote cap-dependent translation.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1 藉由磷酸化 4E-BP1 與 S6K1 來促進蛋白質合成。4E-BP1 的磷酸化阻止其結合 eIF4E，使 eIF4E 能促進帽依賴性轉譯。

links.context: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

links.context: mTORC2 regulates actin cytoskeleton organization and cell migration through phosphorylation of PKCα and via effects on paxillin, RhoA, and Rac1 signaling. These outputs control cell polarity, stress-fiber formation, and the ability of cells to remodel their architecture during growth and movement. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2's roles are more closely tied to spatial organization and survival than to bulk nutrient sensing. Dysregulation of mTORC2-dependent cytoskeletal control contributes to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC2 透過磷酸化 PKCα 以及經由對 paxillin、RhoA 和 Rac1 信號的效應，調節肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織和細胞遷移。這些輸出控制了細胞極性、應力纖維形成，以及細胞在生長和移動期間重塑其架構的能力。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 的角色更密切地與空間組織和存活相關，而非大規模的營養感知。mTORC2 依賴的細胞骨架控制失調促成癌細胞侵襲和轉移。

links.context: macroH2A levels increase during aging in mice, baboons, and human senescent fibroblasts, making it a marker of the aged cellular state. As a histone variant with a very long half-life, macroH2A accumulates in post-mitotic cells, where it contributes to repressing proliferation genes and stabilizing senescence-associated heterochromatin foci. Its age-related accumulation is part of the altered chromatin landscape of aging cells and links histone variant dynamics to the senescent state. Thus macroH2A serves as both a marker and a contributor to age-related chromatin remodeling.
links.context_zh_TW: macroH2A 水平在小鼠、狒狒和人類老化成纖維細胞的衰老過程中增加，使其成為衰老細胞狀態的標誌。作為一種半衰期很長的組蛋白變體，macroH2A 在有絲分裂後細胞中積累，有助於抑制增殖基因並穩定衰老相關的異染色質灶。它與年齡相關的累積是老化細胞染色質景觀改變的一部分，並將組蛋白變異動態與老化狀態聯繫起來。因此，macroH2A 既是年齡相關染色質重塑的標記物也是貢獻者。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: macroH2A promotes the SASP by modulating the chromatin state at SASP loci during senescence. Although macroH2A is classically associated with transcriptional silencing and senescence-associated heterochromatin foci, its removal from SASP gene loci during oncogene-induced senescence is required for proper SASP gene induction, and knockout of macroH2A in senescent cells reduces SASP output. This dual role illustrates how dynamic changes in histone variant occupancy fine-tune the expression of the inflammatory secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: macroH2A 透過在老化過程中調節 SASP 基因座的染色質狀態來促進 SASP。儘管 macroH2A 通常與轉錄沉默和衰老相關的異染色質灶相關，但在癌基因誘導的衰老過程中，需要將其從 SASP 基因位點中去除，以實現正確的 SASP 基因誘導，並且在衰老細胞中敲除 macroH2A 會減少 SASP 的輸出。這種雙重作用說明了組蛋白變異佔據的動態變化如何微調發炎分泌組的表達。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md

links.context: miR-217 is a senescence-associated microRNA whose canonical validated target is SIRT1. It binds the SIRT1 3'-UTR and suppresses translation, reducing NAD+-dependent deacetylase activity (Menghini et al., Circulation 2009; PMID 19188522).
links.context_zh_TW: miR-217 是一種與衰老相關的微 RNA，其經實驗驗證的經典靶標是 SIRT1。它結合 SIRT1 的 3'-UTR 並抑制轉譯，降低 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯化酶活性（Menghini 等人，Circulation 2009；PMID 19188522）。

links.context: miR-378 reduces SIRT1 activity and facilitates NF-κB-TNFα inflammatory signaling, in part by targeting the 5'-AMPK subunit gamma-2. Directionally, miR-378 inhibits SIRT1, which activates NF-κB. This links a metabolic microRNA to sirtuin-controlled inflammation, and it illustrates how microRNA networks gate sirtuin protective effects. Because AMPK and SIRT1 reinforce each other, miR-378's targeting of AMPK indirectly weakens SIRT1 as well, amplifying inflammatory signaling. These findings identify microRNAs as upstream regulators of the SIRT1/AMPK axis, with potential relevance to metabolic and inflammatory disease.
links.context_zh_TW: miR-378 降低 SIRT1 活性並促進 NF-κB-TNFα 發炎信號，部分通過靶向 5'-AMPK 亞基 gamma-2。在方向性上，miR-378 抑制 SIRT1，SIRT1 活化 NF-κB。這將一個代謝微小 RNA 與 sirtuin 控制的發炎聯繫起來，說明微小 RNA 網絡如何調控 sirtuin 的保護效應。由於 AMPK 和 SIRT1 相互強化，miR-378 對 AMPK 的靶向也間接削弱 SIRT1，放大發炎信號。這些發現將微小 RNA 鑑定為 SIRT1/AMPK 軸的上游調節因子，對代謝和發炎疾病具有潛在相關性。

links.context: miR-543 represses SIRT1 expression post-transcriptionally, and its downregulation reduces inflammation by strengthening the SIRT1/AMPK/NF-κB signaling pathway. Directionally, miR-543 sits upstream of SIRT1 suppression. This places miR-543 among the microRNAs that calibrate inflammatory tone by controlling sirtuin abundance, alongside miR-217 and miR-378. Modulating such microRNAs, through antagomirs or other strategies, is a potential anti-inflammatory approach, and understanding their regulation in aging and disease could reveal new therapeutic targets for restoring SIRT1-dependent protection against chronic inflammation.
links.context_zh_TW: miR-543 在轉錄後水平抑制 SIRT1 表達，其下調通過加強 SIRT1/AMPK/NF-κB 信號通路來減少發炎。在方向性上，miR-543 位於 SIRT1 抑制的上游。這使 miR-543 列入通過控制 sirtuin 表達量來校準發炎水平的微小 RNA 之中，與 miR-217 和 miR-378 並列。通過反義寡核苷酸或其他策略調節這些微小 RNA 是一種潛在的抗發炎方法，了解它們在衰老和疾病中的調節可能揭示恢復 SIRT1 依賴性保護對抗慢性發炎的新治療靶點。

links.context: mitoTALENs (mitochondria-targeted transcription activator-like effector nucleases) are engineered nucleases that selectively cleave mutant mtDNA inside mitochondria. A TALE repeat array programmed to span the pathogenic mutation discriminates mutant from wild-type mtDNA at the single-nucleotide level, and the obligately dimeric FokI nuclease requires two monomers bound at adjacent half-sites, enhancing specificity.
links.context_zh_TW: mitoTALENs（粒線體定位的轉錄活化因子樣效應器核酸酶）是經工程設計的核酸酶，可在粒線體內選擇性切割突變型 mtDNA。跨越致病突變點設計的 TALE repeat 陣列可在單一核苷酸層級區分突變型與野生型 mtDNA；而二聚化屬絕對必要的 FokI 核酸酶域要求兩個單體結合於相鄰半位點，進一步提升專一性。

links.context: mitoZFNs (mitochondria-targeted zinc finger nucleases) were the first mtDNA-editing platform demonstrated in mammalian cells. Each monomer fuses tandem Cys2-His2 zinc fingers (recognizing 3-6 bp each) with the FokI cleavage domain, giving single-nucleotide discrimination: pathogenic mutations create allele-specific recognition sites so the mutant molecule is preferentially cleaved and degraded while wild-type mtDNA survives and repopulates the organelle.
links.context_zh_TW: mitoZFNs（粒線體定位的鋅指核酸酶）是首個在哺乳類細胞中證明的 mtDNA 編輯平台。每個單體將串聯的 Cys2-His2 鋅指（每個辨識 3–6 bp）與 FokI 切割域融合，達成單一核苷酸的鑑別：致病突變會創造等位專一的辨識位點，使突變分子被偏好切割與降解，而野生型 mtDNA 則存活並重新填充胞器。

links.context: oxLDL-trained monocytes gain H3K4me3 at inflammatory promoters, similar to beta-glucan training, and methyltransferase inhibitors block the trained cytokine output. H3K4me3/H3K27ac enrichment is also seen on the TNF-alpha promoter in monocytes from symptomatic atherosclerosis patients. The mark poises promoters for enhanced transcription upon rechallenge.
links.context_zh_TW: Oxidized LDL 訓練後的單核球在發炎啟動子處獲得 H3K4me3，類似於 beta-glucan 訓練，且 methyltransferase inhibitors 可阻斷訓練後的細胞激素輸出。在 symptomatic atherosclerosis 患者的單核球中，也可在 TNF-alpha 啟動子上看到 H3K4me3/H3K27ac 富集。該標記使啟動子處於 poised 狀態，以便再刺激時增強轉錄。

links.context: p15INK4b specifically binds and inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, preventing cyclin D-CDK complex formation and Rb phosphorylation. This enforces a G1 cell-cycle block that is central to paracrine and oncogene-induced senescence, and its action parallels p16INK4a, providing redundant CDK inhibition. The inhibition is direct and is a canonical mechanism of the INK4 family of CDK inhibitors. By maintaining hypophosphorylated Rb, p15 keeps E2F transcription factors sequestered and silences S-phase genes, ensuring durable arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: p15INK4b 特異結合並抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，防止 cyclin D-CDK 複合體形成與 Rb 磷酸化。這強制對旁分泌與致癌基因誘發衰老至為核心的 G1 細胞週期封鎖，且其作用與 p16INK4a 平行，提供冗餘 CDK 抑制。此抑制直接，且是 INK4 家族 CDK 抑制因子的典型機制。透過維持低磷酸化 Rb，p15 使 E2F 轉錄因子隔離並靜默 S 期基因，確保持久停滯。

links.context: p16 maintains the retinoblastoma protein (Rb) in its hypophosphorylated, growth-suppressive state by inhibiting CDK4/6, thereby keeping Rb bound to and repressing E2F target genes. This sustains the long-term arrest that defines senescent cells and coordinates with SAHF formation, in which Rb recruits HIRA/ASF1a to establish repressive heterochromatin. The p16-Rb axis is the durability engine of senescence, distinct from the more transient p53/p21 arm. Maintaining Rb hypophosphorylation is thus central to permanent growth arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: p16 透過抑制 CDK4/6 維持視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白（Rb）於其低磷酸化、生長抑制狀態，從而保持 Rb 結合並抑制 E2F 標的基因。這維持定義衰老細胞的長期停滯，並與 SAHF 形成協調，其中 Rb 招募 HIRA/ASF1a 建立抑制性異染色質。p16-Rb 軸是衰老的耐久性引擎，不同於較短暫的 p53/p21 臂。維持 Rb 低磷酸化因此對永久生長停滯至為核心。
links.source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

links.context: p16INK4A binds CDK4 and prevents cyclin D association, blocking G1/S progression. This direct binding is the molecular basis of INK4-mediated arrest in senescence and quiescence.
links.context_zh_TW: p16INK4A 結合 CDK4 並阻止 cyclin D 結合，阻斷 G1/S 進展。此直接結合是衰老與靜止中 INK4 介導停滯的分子基礎。

links.context: p21CIP1 (encoded by CDKN1A) is transcriptionally activated by p53 in response to DNA damage and other stresses, making it the principal downstream effector of p53-mediated cell-cycle arrest. p21 then inhibits CDK2-cyclin E and CDK2-cyclin A complexes and enforces arrest at the G1/S checkpoint.
links.context_zh_TW: p21CIP1（由 CDKN1A 編碼）在 DNA 損傷與其他壓力下受 p53 轉錄活化，因此是 p53 媒介之細胞週期停滯的主要下游效應物。p21 接著抑制 CDK2–cyclin E 與 CDK2–cyclin A 複合體，並在 G1/S 檢查點強制停滯。

links.context: p21CIP1 inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) by binding the cyclin E/A-CDK2 complex, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and thereby enforcing G1/S arrest. This is a direct enzymatic inhibition central to p53-driven senescence and quiescence, and by blocking S-phase entry, p21 locks cells out of the cell cycle. Its inhibitory action is a canonical CDK-inhibitor function and operates alongside p16/p15-mediated CDK4/6 inhibition. The cooperation between CIP/KIP and INK4 inhibitors provides redundant, robust arrest enforcement.
links.context_zh_TW: p21CIP1 透過結合 cyclin E/A-CDK2 複合體抑制細胞週期依賴激酶 2（CDK2），防止 Rb 磷酸化從而強制 G1/S 停滯。這是對 p53 驅動衰老與靜止至關的直接酶抑制，且透過阻斷 S 期進入，p21 將細胞鎖出細胞週期。其抑制動作是典型的 CDK 抑制因子功能，並與 p16/p15 介導的 CDK4/6 抑制並行運作。CIP/KIP 與 INK4 抑制因子的合作提供冗餘、強健的停滯執行。
links.source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md

links.context: p22-FLIP is the 22 kDa N-terminal fragment produced when caspase-8 cleaves c-FLIP (FLIP_L or FLIP_S) at Asp198 (Asp196 in some isoforms) in cytosolic, FADD-independent heterodimers. Retaining only DED1-DED2, it is generated off the DISC, unlike Asp376 processing, and its production is human-specific.
links.context_zh_TW: p22-FLIP 是在細胞質中、不依賴 FADD 的異源二聚體裡，caspase-8 切割 c-FLIP（FLIP_L 或 FLIP_S）於 Asp198（部分異構型為 Asp196）時產生的 22 kDa N 端片段。它僅保留 DED1–DED2，於 DISC 之外生成（不同於 Asp376 的加工），且其生成為人類專一。

links.context: p38 MAPK phosphorylates MK2 (MAPKAPK2) at Thr222 in humans, activating the kinase and relieving an intramolecular inhibitory interaction, making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls labile inflammatory mRNA stability.
links.context_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在人類磷酸化 MK2（MAPKAPK2）的 Thr222 位點，活化該激酶並解除其分子內抑制性交互作用，使 MK2 成為 p38 調控不穩定發炎 mRNA 穩定性的主要執行者。

links.context: p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 211, the same residue targeted by mTORC1, thereby promoting cytoplasmic retention under certain stress conditions. This convergence indicates that both growth-factor (mTORC1) and stress (p38) signaling can independently restrain TFEB nuclear entry. The p38-mediated phosphorylation underscores the role of stress-activated MAPK pathways in modulating degradative transcription. Context determines whether p38 signaling suppresses or, at other sites, activates TFEB.
links.context_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 於 serine 211 磷酸化 TFEB，此為 mTORC1 標靶的相同殘基，從而在某些壓力條件下促進細胞質保留。此匯聚顯示生長因子（mTORC1）和壓力（p38）信號都能獨立地約束 TFEB 核進入。p38 介導的磷酸化強調了壓力活化的 MAPK 途徑在調節降解轉錄中的作用。脈絡決定 p38 信號是抑制還是在其他位點活化 TFEB。
links.source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

links.context: p38 MAPK phosphorylates and activates MAPKAPK2 (MK2), making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls the stability of labile inflammatory transcripts. Active MK2 phosphorylates RNA-binding decay factors such as ZFP36L1/TTP, preventing them from recruiting deadenylation machinery to AU-rich elements in SASP mRNAs. The consequence is post-transcriptional prolongation of cytokine and chemokine transcripts, a control layer distinct from transcription-factor-driven expression. In the SASP-induction scheme the p38 to MK2 connection is drawn explicitly, separating transcriptional from post-transcriptional regulation of the secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 磷酸化並活化 MAPKAPK2（MK2），使 MK2 成為 p38 控制不穩定發炎轉錄本穩定性的主要效應者。活化的 MK2 磷酸化 ZFP36L1/TTP 等 RNA 結合衰變因子，阻止其招募去腺苷酸化機制至 SASP mRNA 的 AU-rich 元件。結果是細胞激素與趨化激素轉錄本的轉錄後延長，此調控層不同於轉錄因子驅動的表現。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，p38 至 MK2 的連結被明確畫出，區分了 secretome 的轉錄與轉錄後調控。
links.source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md

links.context: p38 MAPK phosphorylates caspase-3 at Ser150, suppressing its proteolytic activity; this inhibition is reversed by the phosphatase PP2A. Directionally, p38 sits upstream of caspase-3 inhibition. This provides a survival signal that tempers apoptosis under certain stresses, and it shows that stress kinases can directly restrain executioner caspases. By phosphorylating pro-caspase-3, p38 reduces the pool available for proteolytic activation, blunting the death response. This regulatory layer illustrates how the balance between kinases and phosphatases determines the threshold for apoptotic commitment under stress.
links.context_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在 Ser150 位點磷酸化 caspase-3，抑制其蛋白水解活性；此抑制可被磷酸酶 PP2A 逆轉。在方向性上，p38 位於 caspase-3 抑制的上游。這在某些壓力下提供生存訊號以調節凋亡，並表明壓力激酶可以直接抑制效應型 caspase。透過磷酸化前 caspase-3，p38 減少可用於蛋白水解活化的池，削弱死亡反應。這一調控層說明了激酶和磷酸酶之間的平衡如何決定壓力下的凋亡承諾閾值。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

links.context: p43-FLIP is the 43 kDa N-terminal fragment generated when caspase-8 cleaves FLIP_L at Asp376 (Asp377 in mouse) during the first, interdimer processing step at the DISC. It retains both DEDs plus the large pseudo-caspase subunit but lacks any catalytic cysteine, so it cannot cut procaspase-8's DED2-p18 linker - which is why the heterodimer never completes intradimer processing.
links.context_zh_TW: p43-FLIP 是在 DISC 上第一個分子間加工步驟中，caspase-8 切割 FLIP_L 於 Asp376（小鼠為 Asp377）時產生的 43 kDa N 端片段。它保留兩個 DED 加上大型偽 caspase 次單元，但缺乏任何催化性半胱胺酸，因此無法切割 procaspase-8 的 DED2–p18 連接段——這正是該異源二聚體永遠無法完成分子內加工的原因。

links.context: p47phox (NCF1) is the cytosolic organizer of the NOX2 NADPH Oxidase: upon phosphorylation it translocates to the membrane together with p67phox and p40phox to join cytochrome b558 (p22phox/gp91phox), triggering the respiratory burst. Its role is organizational rather than catalytic - p47phox is a scaffold that brings the cytosolic subunits into contact with the membrane catalytic subunit, which is why its loss abolishes oxidase activation and why NCF1 mutations are the commonest autosomal-recessive cause of Chronic Granulomatous Disease.
links.context_zh_TW: p47phox（NCF1）是 NOX2 NADPH Oxidase 的細胞質組織次單元：磷酸化後，它與 p67phox 及 p40phox 一同轉位至膜，與 cytochrome b558（p22phox/gp91phox）結合，觸發呼吸爆發。其角色是組織性而非催化性——p47phox 是將細胞質次單元帶到膜上催化次單元附近的支架，因此其喪失會使氧化酶活化消失，而 NCF1 突變是 Chronic Granulomatous Disease 最常見的體染色體隱性病因。

links.context: p53 acts as a barrier to cellular reprogramming, limiting the efficiency with which somatic cells can be converted into induced pluripotent stem cells. During reprogramming, OSKM transduction and the associated DNA damage and epigenetic stress activate p53, which enforces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis and thereby restricts the emergence of pluripotent cells. Suppressing p53 activity increases reprogramming efficiency, but at the cost of genome instability and tumor risk, illustrating the trade-off between reprogramming yield and genome integrity.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 作為細胞重編程的屏障，限制了體細胞轉化為誘導多能幹細胞的效率。在重編程過程中，OSKM 轉導以及相關的 DNA 損傷和表觀遺傳壓力會活化 p53，從而強制細胞週期停滯和細胞凋亡，從而限制多能細胞的出現。抑制 p53 活性可以提高重編程效率，但代價是基因組不穩定和腫瘤風險，這說明了重編程產量和基因組完整性之間的權衡。

links.context: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。
links.source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

links.context: p53 functions as the archetypal tumor suppressor in cancer, integrating DNA damage and oncogenic stress into arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Its inactivation, most often by missense mutation, removes a central barrier to genomic instability and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional and protective: intact p53 suppresses transformation, whereas its loss permits malignant evolution. Mutant p53 can additionally acquire dominant-negative and gain-of-function oncogenic activities.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 充當癌症中的原型Tumor Suppressor，將DNA Damage 和致癌壓力整合到停滯、老化或凋亡中。它的失活（最常見的是錯義突變）消除了基因組不穩定和治療抗藥性的主要障礙。這種關係是方向性的和保護性的：完整的p53抑制轉化，而它的喪失則允許惡性進化。突變體p53也可以獲得顯性失活和功能性獲得性致癌活性。

links.context: p53 induces Noxa. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Noxa is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein with selective affinity for Mcl-1 and A1, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon Noxa rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 誘發 Noxa。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Noxa 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，對 Mcl-1 和 A1 具有選擇性親和力，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 Noxa 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: p53 induces Puma. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 誘發Puma。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: p53 is activated during cellular reprogramming as a cellular stress response to the ectopic expression of the Yamanaka factors. OSKM transduction generates DNA damage, elevates reactive oxygen species, and activates innate immune signaling, and TP53 expression and phosphorylation increase within the first hours of reprogramming initiation. This p53 activation enforces cell cycle checkpoints and apoptosis, which limits the efficiency of iPSC generation but protects the genome from the destabilizing effects of reprogramming.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 在細胞重編程過程中被激活，作為對山中因子異位表達的細胞壓力反應。 OSKM 轉導會產生 DNA 損傷，升高活性氧，並激活先天免疫信號傳導，並且 TP53 表達和磷酸化在重編程啟動的最初幾個小時內增加。 p53 的活化會強制執行細胞週期檢查點和細胞凋亡，這限制了 iPSC 生成的效率，但保護基因組免受重編程的不穩定影響。

links.context: p53 is inhibited by MDM2. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. The directionality runs from MDM2 toward p53, so MDM2 is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 被 MDM2 抑制。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。方向性從 MDM2 向 p53，因此 MDM2 是活性劑，p53 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

links.context: p53 is mutated in Cancer. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward p53, so Cancer is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 在 Cancer 中發生突變。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 p53，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，p53 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

links.context: p53 is restored by Nutlins. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward p53, so Nutlins is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 由 Nutlins 恢復。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 p53，因此 Nutlins 是主動主體，p53 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: p53 is the canonical sequence-specific transcription factor driving senescence and apoptosis programs. Classification is textbook.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 是驅動衰老與凋亡程序的典型序列特異轉錄因子。歸類為教科書等級。

links.context: p53 is the most significant biological barrier to efficient iPSC induction: damage activates p53, which initiates apoptosis or senescence in transduced cells, sharply reducing reprogramming yield. Fenbendazole's p53 stabilization therefore directly undermines epigenetic rejuvenation strategies requiring reprogramming.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 是高效 iPSC 誘發最重要的生物屏障：損傷活化 p53，後者啟動轉導細胞中的凋亡或衰老，大幅降低重編程產量。Fenbendazole 的 p53 穩定因此直接破壞需要重編程的表觀遺傳回春策略。

links.context: p53 regulates MOMP. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon MOMP rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
links.context_zh_TW: p53 調節 MOMP。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 MOMP 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

links.context: tBid translocates to the mitochondrial outer membrane and directly triggers BAX conformational change and oligomerization, permeabilizing the membrane and releasing cytochrome c. This is how a death-receptor (extrinsic) signal is amplified through the mitochondrial loop into full intrinsic-pathway apoptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: tBid 轉位至粒線體外膜，直接誘發 BAX 構形改變與寡聚化，使膜通透化並釋放 cytochrome c。死亡受體（外在性）訊號正是藉此經由粒線體環路被放大，形成完整的內在性路徑凋亡。

links.context: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a potent oxidant tool compound for stress studies.
links.context_zh_TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是壓力研究的強效氧化劑工具化合物。

links.context: uPAR (CD87) is a GPI-anchored membrane protein with three domains: domain I binds uPA, domain II binds Vitronectin, and domain III carries the GPI anchor. By localizing urokinase plasminogen activator to the cell surface it concentrates proteolysis at sites of cell migration and invasion, driving extracellular matrix remodeling and cancer cell dissemination.
links.context_zh_TW: uPAR（CD87）是 GPI 錨定的膜蛋白，具有三個結構域：domain I 結合 uPA、domain II 結合 Vitronectin、domain III 帶有 GPI 錨定。透過將尿激酶型血漿素原活化素定位到細胞表面，它在細胞遷移與侵犯部位濃縮蛋白水解作用，驅動細胞外基質重塑與癌細胞擴散。

links.context: vFLIPs are DED-tandem viral proteins discovered in 1997 in gammaherpesviruses and poxviruses that block host Apoptosis at the DISC by engaging FADD and Caspase-8, keeping the infected cell alive and transcriptionally productive. KSHV K13 additionally drives constitutive NF-kB activity through NEMO binding.
links.context_zh_TW: vFLIP 是 1997 年在 γ 疱疹病毒與痘病毒中發現的 DED 串聯蛋白，藉由結合 FADD 與 Caspase-8 在 DISC 層級阻斷宿主的 Apoptosis，使受感染細胞存活並維持轉錄活性。KSHV 的 K13 另可透過結合 NEMO 驅動持續性的 NF-κB 活性。

links.context: xCT mediates the electrochemically coupled 1:1 exchange of extracellular cystine for intracellular glutamate. Imported cystine is reduced to cysteine, the limiting substrate for GSH biosynthesis; by sustaining the GSH pool, xCT directly feeds GPX4, the principal eliminator of phospholipid hydroperoxides. When xCT is transcriptionally repressed by p53 or inhibited by erastin/sulfasalazine, cystine import collapses, GSH falls, GPX4 fails and ROS-driven lipid peroxidation executes ferroptosis.
links.context_zh_TW: xCT 以電化學耦聯的 1:1 方式交換胞外胱胺與胞內麩胺酸。輸入的胱胺被還原為半胱胺酸——麩胱甘肽生合成的限量受質；藉由維持 GSH 池，xCT 直接餵養磷脂過氧化氫物的首要清除者 GPX4。當 xCT 被 p53 轉錄抑制或被 erastin／sulfasalazine 藥理抑制時，胱胺輸入崩潰、GSH 下降、GPX4 失效，ROS 驅動的脂質過氧化遂執行鐵死亡。

links.context: γ-H2AX is the Ser139-phosphorylated form of the H2AX histone variant, generated within minutes of double-strand break induction by ATM, ATR and DNA-PK; ATM is the primary responder to double-strand breaks and ionizing radiation, while ATR responds to replication stress.
links.context_zh_TW: γ-H2AX 是組蛋白變異體 H2AX 在 Ser139 磷酸化後的形式，在雙股斷裂誘發後數分鐘內由 ATM、ATR 與 DNA-PK 產生；ATM 是雙股斷裂與游離輻射的主要反應者，而 ATR 則反應複製壓力。

links.context: γ-H2AX is the canonical molecular marker of DNA damage: because a single double-strand break recruits hundreds to thousands of phosphorylated H2AX molecules, the resulting nuclear foci are readily detected by microscopy and flow cytometry, making γ-H2AX an exceptionally sensitive sentinel of lesions and of repair kinetics.
links.context_zh_TW: γ-H2AX 是 DNA 損傷的標準分子標記：由於單一雙股斷裂即可招募數百至數千個磷酸化 H2AX 分子，所形成的核內 foci 可用顯微鏡與流式細胞術輕易偵測，使 γ-H2AX 成為極靈敏的損傷與修復動力學哨兵。

links.context: A central mechanism of apigenin's anticancer activity is the induction of apoptosis in a wide range of human cancer cell lines including breast, colon, gastric, pancreatic, prostate, cervical, hematologic, thyroid, neuroblastoma, bladder, and osteosarcoma cells. Apigenin triggers both the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway, through loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, cytochrome c release, and activation of caspases 3, 7, 8 and 9, and the extrinsic pathway involving death receptors and TRAIL. Apoptosis is typically dose- and time-dependent, and its potency in leukemia cells ranked higher than other flavonoids tested.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿苯扁豆的主要抗癌機制是誘導多種人體癌細胞系（包括乳癌、大腸癌、胃癌、胰臟癌、前列腺癌、子宮頸癌、血液癌、甲狀腺癌、神經母細胞瘤、膀胱癌和骨肉瘤細胞）的細胞凋亡。阿苯扁豆觸發了內顯型 mitochondrial 通路，通過喪失 mitochondrial 膜電位、西妥體 c 釋放以及激活 caspase 3、7、8 和 9，以及涉及死亡受體和 TRAIL 的外顯型通路。細胞凋亡通常與劑量和時間有關，在白血病細胞中的效力高於測試的其他黃酮類化合物。
links.source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md

links.context: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
links.context_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Acetate is converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2 and is not membrane-permeable acetyl-CoA itself. Acetate supplementation increases global nuclear acetylation including H3K27ac and induces expression of pro-inflammatory genes including IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators p16 and p21. In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate increases histone acetylation and partially restores a subset of the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme. However, acetate-induced SASP gene expression is suppressed by the STING inhibitor SN011, showing that chromatin accessibility alone cannot drive SASP transcription without innate immune activation.
links.context_zh_TW: 乙酸（acetate）在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA），其本身並非可通透細胞膜的乙醯輔酶A。補充乙酸可增加整體細胞核乙醯化（包括 H3K27ac），並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因的表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子 p16 與 p21。在缺乏粒線體的衰老細胞中，乙酸可增加組蛋白乙醯化，並部分恢復依賴粒線體的 SASP 程序中的一部分。然而，乙酸誘導的 SASP 基因表現會被 STING 抑制劑 SN011 所壓制，顯示若無先天免疫活化，僅靠染色質可及性無法驅動 SASP 轉錄。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Activated Parkin (PRKN), an E3 ubiquitin ligase recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by PINK1, polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins such as MFN1, MFN2 and VDAC1 for subsequent recognition by mitophagy adaptors including p62/SQSTM1. Ubiquitination of MFN1 and MFN2 leads to mitochondrial fission, fragmentation and subsequent mitophagic degradation via autophagosome formation. Parkin-mediated mitophagy promotes clearance of damaged mitochondria and is protective in cardiovascular recovery, yet its constitutive activation can be detrimental; Parkin mutations cause early-onset Parkinson's disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 活化的Parkin（PRKN）是一種E3泛素連接酶，被PINK1招募至外粒線體膜，對外膜蛋白如MFN1、MFN2和VDAC1進行多聚泛素化，隨後被包括p62/SQSTM1在內的線粒體自噬接頭蛋白識別。MFN1和MFN2的泛素化導致粒線體分裂、碎片化，隨後通過自噬體形成進行線粒體自噬降解。Parkin介導的線粒體自噬促進受損粒線體的清除，並在心血管恢復中具有保護作用，但其組成性活化可能有害；Parkin突變導致早發性帕金森氏症。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
links.context_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

links.context: Aged (19-month-old) C57BL/6 mice gavaged with CTPI2 (50 mg/kg three times weekly for 3 months) exhibited more lustrous fur, reduced alopecia and greying, and delayed onset of frailty as measured by a 31-parameter frailty index. Functional assessment revealed enhanced neuromuscular performance: improved coordination and balance (tightrope test), increased strength (hanging and grip strength tests) and preservation of muscle integrity. CTPI2 reduced SASP gene expression in skeletal muscle, liver and heart without altering p16 or p21, indicating that suppressing the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis improves healthspan through SASP modulation rather than senescent cell clearance.
links.context_zh_TW: 以 CTPI2（50 mg/kg，每週三次，持續 3 個月）管餵的老年（19 個月大）C57BL/6 小鼠，表現出更有光澤的毛皮、脫毛與毛髮灰白減少，且以 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，衰弱症的發生獲得延緩。功能評估顯示神經肌肉表現增強：協調性與平衡感改善（走鋼索測試）、肌力增加（懸掛與握力測試），並保留肌肉完整性。CTPI2 在不改變 p16 或 p21 的情況下，降低了骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中的 SASP 基因表現，顯示抑制粒線體檸檬酸—乙醯輔酶 A 軸，是透過調節 SASP 而非清除衰老細胞來改善健康壽命。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Aminoguanidine prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins by trapping reactive carbonyl species and by binding to sugars, thus preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins. Glucose can react with protein amino groups in a process called glycation to form glucose/protein combinations that eventually cause active cross-links, and this continuous cross-linking may be prevented by glycation inhibitors whose primary use is to stabilize glucose metabolism. Aminoguanidine joins up with substances that cause links and stops cross-links from developing, protecting the proteins that make up the body from aging damage.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍可以通過捕獲反應性羰基物種並與糖結合來防止組織蛋白之間的交叉連接，從而阻止它們與蛋白的精氨酸基團結合。葡萄糖可以通過稱為糖化反應的過程與蛋白氨基反應，形成葡萄糖/蛋白組合，最終導致活躍的交叉連接，而這種持續的交叉連接可能被糖化抑制劑所阻止，其主要用途是穩定葡萄糖代謝。氨基胍與引起鏈接的物質結合，阻止交叉連接的發展，從而保護身體組成的蛋白免受衰老損傷。
links.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

links.context: Apigenin directly binds peroxiredoxin 6 (PRDX6), identified as its bona fide molecular target through two affinity-based approaches: biotin-tagged apigenin pull-down (Bio-APIG) and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS). Binding was confirmed by cellular thermal shift assay, surface plasmon resonance (KD ~ 0.237 uM) and microscale thermophoresis (Kd ~ 916 nM). In silico modelling indicates direct hydrogen bonds with Cys91 and Glu210 of PRDX6; mutating either residue weakens binding ~10-fold and mutating both abolishes it. This is the primary upstream molecular interaction underlying apigenin's senomorphic activity. Among PRDX6's three enzymatic activities (peroxidase, acidic calcium-independent phospholipase A2 / aiPLA2, and lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase), apigenin selectively suppresses the iPLA2 activity. Unlike NAC, a selective peroxidase inhibitor (IC50 = 15.5 µM for H2O2 clearance), apigenin only modestly impairs H2O2 scavenging (IC50 = 49.5 µM), indicating its SASP-dampening effect does not depend on peroxidase function. Instead, blocking the PLA2 arm of PRDX6 curbs production of pro-inflammatory arachidonic acid and downstream signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿皮格寧直接與過氧化物歧化酶 6 (PRDX6) 結合，該酶已透過兩種基於親和力的方法被確認為其真實的分子靶標：標記為生物ட்டின்的阿皮格寧拉下 (Bio-APIG) 和藥物親和力反應性靶標穩定性 (DARTS)。結合已通過細胞熱變變異法、表面等離子共振 (KD ~ 0.237 uM) 和微尺度熱光學法 (Kd ~ 916 nM) 進行確認。計算機模型顯示與 PRDX6 的 Cys91 和 Glu210 之間存在直接的氫鍵；變更其中任何一個殘基會使結合力減弱約 10 倍，而變更兩個殘基則會完全消除它。這是阿皮格寧的促衰作用的主要上游分子相互作用。 在PRDX6的三種酵素活性（過氧化物酶、酸性鈣非依賴性磷脂酶A2 / aiPLA2，以及溶血磷脂醯膽鹼醯基轉移酶）中，芹菜素選擇性地抑制iPLA2活性。不同於選擇性過氧化物酶抑制劑NAC（清除H2O2的IC50 = 15.5 µM），芹菜素僅溫和地削弱H2O2清除能力（IC50 = 49.5 µM），顯示其抑制SASP的效果並不依賴過氧化物酶功能。相反地，阻斷PRDX6的PLA2分支可抑制促發炎花生四烯酸及其下游訊息傳導的產生。

links.context: Atypical dose-response curves where a drug's effect does not follow a monotonic shape are referred to as hormetic or biphasic. This computational study shows that all hormetic networks share a similar core structure: an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of the drug, in which the two interactions emanating from the target have net opposite (direct or indirect) effects over the downstream output. Around 18% of all three-node network topologies contain this motif, and topologies with an incoherent bivalent motif show a roughly five-fold increased probability of exhibiting hormesis compared with all topologies.
links.context_zh_TW: 藥物效應不呈單調形狀的非典型劑量反應曲線稱為荷爾米希（hormetic）或雙相反應。這項計算研究顯示，所有荷爾米希網路共享相似的核心結構：以藥物靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體（incoherent bivalent network motif），其中由靶點發出的兩條交互作用對下游輸出具有淨相反（直接或間接）的效應。約 18% 的三節點網路拓撲含有此模體，而含有不一致雙價模體的拓撲展現荷爾米希反應的機率約為所有拓撲的五倍。

links.context: Autophagy is strongly regulated by the mTORC1 complex, which inhibits autophagy initiation by blocking the ULK1 complex under conditions of nutrient abundance. Rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 cancels this effect by activating autophagy and supporting amino acid recycling and the removal of damaged structures. With age, autophagy activity decreases, leading to accumulation of damaged mitochondria and proteins. In many model organisms from yeast to mammals, mTORC1 inhibition with rapamycin restores autophagic activity and increases lifespan, and long-term administration increases autophagy, reduces lipofuscin accumulation, and improves cardiomyocyte function. Rapamycin's purported geroprotective effects are often attributed to its ability to induce autophagy, the cellular recycling process responsible for degrading protein aggregates and other damage-associated molecular patterns. mTORC1 normally inhibits autophagy by phosphorylating components of the ULK1 (Unc-51-like autophagy-activating kinase 1) complex, and its inhibition by rapamycin removes this suppression and initiates autophagosome formation. However, autophagy is context-dependent in cancer: while it may suppress tumor initiation by clearing damaged components, it can also support the survival and growth of established tumors.
links.context_zh_TW: 自噬受到mTORC1複合物的強烈調控，mTORC1在營養豐富的條件下透過阻斷ULK1複合物抑制自噬啟動。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制透過活化自噬和支持胺基酸回收及損傷結構的移除來抵消此效應。隨著年齡增長，自噬活性降低，導致受損粒線體和蛋白質的累積。在從酵母到哺乳動物的許多模式生物中，rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制恢復自噬活性並延長壽命，長期給藥增加自噬，減少脂褐素累積，並改善心肌細胞功能。 Rapamycin聲稱的抗老化效應通常歸因於其誘導自噬的能力，自噬是負責降解蛋白質聚集和其他損傷相關分子模式的細胞回收過程。mTORC1通常透過磷酸化ULK1（Unc-51-like autophagy-activating kinase 1）複合物的成分來抑制自噬，rapamycin對其的抑制消除了這種抑制並啟動自噬體形成。然而，自噬在癌症中是背景依賴性的：雖然它可能透過清除損傷成分來抑制腫瘤起始，但它也可以支持已建立腫瘤的存活和生長。
links.source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

links.context: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
links.context_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

links.context: COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase) dominates dopamine clearance in the prefrontal cortex because this brain region is sparsely populated with the dopamine transporter (DAT), forcing reliance on extracellular enzymatic degradation rather than rapid reuptake. By methylating dopamine into inactive 3-methoxytyramine using SAMe as cofactor, COMT sets the extracellular dopamine tone that governs prefrontal cognition, working memory, and executive control. The norepinephrine transporter contributes secondarily to this clearance. Because the Val158Met polymorphism changes COMT activity three- to four-fold, genetic variation in COMT has an outsized impact on prefrontal dopamine signaling.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）主導前額葉皮質中的多巴胺清除，因為該 brain 區域稀疏地分佈有多巴胺轉運蛋白（DAT），迫使其依賴細胞外酶促降解而不是快速再攝取。透過使用 SAMe 作為輔因子將多巴胺甲基化為不活躍的 3-methoxytyramine，COMT 設定了控制前額認知、工作記憶和執行控制的細胞外多巴胺基調。 norepinephrine 運輸車對這項清除起到了次要的作用。由於 Val158Met 多態性使 COMT activity 發生三到四倍的變化，COMT 的遺傳變異對前額葉多巴胺訊號傳導產生巨大影響。

links.context: COMT metabolizes dopamine by catalyzing the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to the catechol ring, producing 3-methoxytyramine, which is further oxidized by monoamine oxidase. This O-methylation is the primary route of dopamine inactivation in the prefrontal cortex, where the dopamine transporter is sparse and clearance depends on extracellular enzymes. By controlling the duration and magnitude of extracellular dopamine, COMT activity directly influences dopaminergic tone in cognition, mood, and reward. The Val158Met polymorphism, by altering enzyme activity, modulates the efficiency of this degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT透過催化甲基從S-adenosylmethionine轉移到兒茶酚環代謝多巴胺，產生3-methoxytyramine，3-methoxytyramine被單胺氧化酶進一步氧化。這種 O-甲基化是前額葉皮質中多巴胺失活的主要途徑，其中多巴胺轉運蛋白稀疏，清除依賴細胞外酶。透過控制細胞外多巴胺的持續時間和強度，COMT activity 直接影響認知、情緒和 reward 中的多巴胺能音調。 Val158Met 多態性透過改變酵素活性來調節這種降解的效率。
