links.context: COMT modulates cognitive performance through an inverted-U (or tonic-phasic) relationship in which intermediate dopamine levels in the prefrontal cortex optimize executive function, while both excessively high (slow COMT) and low (fast COMT) activity shift performance away from the optimum. Met-bearing (slow) genotypes favor stability and working memory under calm conditions, whereas Val-bearing (fast) genotypes favor rapid processing under stress. Thus COMT genotype is a major determinant of individual differences in cognition.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 透過倒 U（或強直相位）關係調節 cognitive performance，其中前額葉皮質中的中間多巴胺水平優化 executive function，而過高（慢 COMT）和低（快 COMT）活動會使性能偏離最佳狀態。含有 Met 的（慢速）基因型有利於平靜條件下的穩定性和工作記憶，而含有 Val 的（快速）基因型則有利於在壓力下快速處理。因此，COMT genotype 是認知個體差異的主要決定因素。

links.context: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
links.context_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

links.context: CaMKIIalpha is essential for synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD), by phosphorylating AMPA receptor subunits and structural proteins that consolidate changes in synaptic efficacy. Inhibition or knockout of CaMKIIalpha abolishes LTP at many synapses, confirming its necessity. Its autophosphorylation at threonine 286 generates calcium-independent activity that maintains potentiated transmission over time. It thus serves as a molecular switch converting transient calcium signals into lasting synaptic memory.
links.context_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 synaptic plasticity 至關重要，包括長時程增強 (LTP) 和長時程抑制 (LTD)，透過磷酸化 AMPA 受體亞基和結構蛋白來鞏固突觸功效的變化。抑製或敲除 CaMKIIalpha 可消除許多突觸的 LTP，證實了其必要性。其蘇氨酸 286 處的自磷酸化產生不依賴鈣的活性，可隨著時間的推移維持增強的傳輸。因此，它充當分子開關，將瞬態鈣訊號轉換為持久的突觸記憶。

links.context: Cellular senescence is fundamentally defined as a state of stable, essentially irreversible cell-cycle arrest in which cells remain metabolically active but lose the capacity to proliferate, distinguishing it from quiescence and terminal differentiation. The arrest is actively enforced by tumor-suppressor networks -- the p53/p21 and p16/Rb axes -- that impose a durable G1-phase block and remain engaged even under strong mitogenic stimulation. Because the arrest is permanent, senescent cells can persist for the lifetime of the organism, accumulating in tissues with age. Importantly, senescence is not mere growth arrest but a comprehensive reprogramming entailing chromatin reorganization, metabolic shifts, and a distinctive secretory phenotype (SASP).
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞衰老在根本上被定義為一種穩定、本質上不可逆的細胞週期停滯狀態，細胞在此狀態下仍維持代謝活性，但喪失增殖能力，從而有別於靜止（quiescence）與終末分化。此停滯由腫瘤抑制網絡主動執行——即 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 軸——它們施加持久的 G1 期阻斷，即便在強力促有絲分裂刺激下仍持續作用。由於停滯是永久性的，衰老細胞可在個體終生存留並隨年齡在組織中累積。重要的是，衰老不只是單純的生長停滯，而是一種包含染色質重組、代謝轉變以及獨特分泌表型（SASP）的全面重編程。

links.context: ChIP-seq analysis of histone H3 acetylation at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) showed that loci gaining acetylation during senescence are markedly reduced following mitochondrial clearance, and these regions are enriched for inflammatory and interleukin signalling pathways central to the SASP. A 51-gene SASP signature induced during senescence is suppressed upon mitochondrial removal, with genes such as IL6 and CCL2 showing coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation and mRNA expression. Multiple nodes of the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis converge to control H3K27ac at SASP loci, selectively modulating inflammatory gene expression without affecting the senescence-associated cell cycle arrest.
links.context_zh_TW: 對組蛋白H3在賴氨酸27處的乙酰化（H3K27ac）的ChIP-seq分析表明，在衰老過程中獲得乙酰化的位點在線粒體清除後顯著減少，並且這些區域富含與SASP核心相關的炎症和白細胞介素信號通路。在衰老過程中誘導的51個基因的SASP特徵在線粒體移除後被抑制，IL6和CCL2等基因顯示出染色質乙酰化和mRNA表達的協調減少。線粒體枸櫞酸-乙酰輔酶A軸的多個節點匯聚以控制SASP位點的H3K27ac，選擇性地調節炎症基因表達而不影響衰老相關的細胞週期停滯。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound that is synthesized endogenously in the liver, kidney, and pancreas and is also obtained from dietary sources, particularly red meat and fish. Around 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, approximately one-third of it in the phosphorylated form creatine phosphate. In the muscle it is converted to creatine phosphate, which donates its high-energy phosphate group to regenerate ATP from ADP, supporting short-duration, high-intensity exercise. Because of its role in ATP regeneration, creatine is one of the most widely used sports supplements and is increasingly examined for additional therapeutic effects, including possible anti-cancer properties.
links.context_zh_TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內由肝臟、腎臟與胰臟內源性合成，也可從飲食來源獲得，尤其是紅肉與魚類。人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中約三分之一以磷酸化形式（磷酸肌酸）存在。在肌肉中，肌酸被轉化為磷酸肌酸，後者提供其高能磷酸基團，從 ADP 再生 ATP，以支持短時間、高強度的運動。由於其在 ATP 再生中的角色，肌酸是最廣泛使用的運動補充品之一，並日益被研究是否具有額外的治療效應，包括可能的抗癌特性。

links.context: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
links.context_zh_TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

links.context: Creatine supports COMT function indirectly by supplying phosphocreatine for cellular energy, allowing the methylation cycle to operate efficiently without diverting as many methyl groups toward de novo creatine synthesis. Because endogenous creatine synthesis consumes a large fraction of the body's methyl groups, exogenous creatine supplementation reduces methyl demand and spares SAMe for COMT and other methyltransferases. This nutritional strategy helps maintain catechol methylation capacity and is especially relevant in slow COMT individuals. It represents a methyl-sparing rather than methyl-donating approach to supporting methylation.
links.context_zh_TW: Creatine 透過為細胞能量提供磷酸肌酸來間接支持 COMT 功能，從而使 methylation cycle 能夠有效運行，而無需將盡可能多的 methyl groups 轉向肌酸從頭合成。由於內源性肌酸合成消耗了體內 methyl groups 的很大一部分，因此外源性肌酸補充可減少甲基需求，並為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 SAMe。這種營養策略有助於維持兒茶酚甲基化能力，對於行動緩慢的 COMT 個體尤其重要。它代表了一種支持甲基化的保留甲基而不是提供甲基的方法。

links.context: Creatine supports MTHFR function indirectly by lowering the methyl-group demand of endogenous creatine synthesis, which consumes a substantial share of the body's methyl budget, thereby easing reliance on folate-dependent remethylation. For slow MTHFR variants that generate methylfolate less efficiently, supplemental creatine can reduce the metabolic pressure on an already constrained methylation cycle and help preserve SAMe availability. The benefit is supportive rather than direct enzymatic rescue, but it relieves a major competing methyl sink. This makes creatine a useful adjunct in methylation-support protocols.
links.context_zh_TW: Creatine 透過降低內源性肌酸合成的甲基需求（消耗人體甲基預算的很大一部分）來間接支持 MTHFR function，從而減輕對 folate 依賴性再甲基化的依賴。對於緩慢生成甲基葉酸效率較低的 MTHFR variants，補充肌酸可以降低已經受限的 methylation cycle 的代謝壓力，並有助於維持 SAMe 的可用性。其好處是支持性的，而不是直接的酶救援，但它緩解了主要的競爭性甲基匯。這使得肌酸成為甲基化支持方案中有用的輔助劑。
links.source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md

links.context: Cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM) to initiate fission, where they are anchored by four main adaptor proteins: mitochondrial fission factor (MFF), mitochondrial fission 1 protein (FIS1), and mitochondrial dynamics proteins MID49 and MID51. These adaptors physically interact within a DRP1 complex to coordinate fission, and MFF, MID49 and MID51 are directly associated with mitochondrial division; their absence leads to significant mitochondrial elongation. The endoplasmic reticulum and ER-mitochondria contact sites (MAMs) provide a platform for DRP1 oligomerization and constriction of the OMM.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞質中的 DRP1 單體被招募至粒線體外膜（OMM）以啟動分裂，並由四個主要接合蛋白錨定：粒線體分裂因子（MFF）、粒線體分裂 1 蛋白（FIS1），以及粒線體動力學蛋白 MID49 與 MID51。這些接合蛋白在 DRP1 複合體中物理性交互作用以協調分裂，其中 MFF、MID49 與 MID51 直接與粒線體分裂相關；它們的缺失會導致粒線體顯著延長。內質網與內質網—粒線體接觸位點（MAMs）為 DRP1 寡聚化及 OMM 的收縮提供平台。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 binds and inhibits cyclin-CDK complexes, notably CDK2, enforcing a G1/S arrest. This p53-to-p21 axis is a primary, rapid enforcement mechanism of senescence and quiescence, and the induction is dose-dependent and reversible in the short term but locks the arrest when sustained. It exemplifies tumor-suppressive cell-cycle control and is a core target of the DNA damage response. p21 also supports an early secretory phenotype during stress.
links.context_zh_TW: DNA 損傷穩定 p53，p53 轉錄誘發 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 結合並抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體，特別是 CDK2，強制 G1/S 停滯。此 p53-to-p21 軸是衰老與靜止的主要、快速執行機制，且此誘發在短期內依劑量且可逆，但在持續時鎖定停滯。它例示腫瘤抑制性細胞週期控制，是 DNA 損傷反應的核心標靶。p21 也在壓力期間支持早期分泌表型。
links.source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

links.context: DNA damage, particularly persistent double-strand breaks, is a potent inducer of senescence through activation of the DNA damage response (DDR). The ATM/ATR kinases phosphorylate and stabilize the transcription factor p53, which transcribes p21CIP1 to inhibit cyclin-CDK complexes and enforce arrest. Damage-induced senescence acts as a barrier to malignant transformation by halting proliferation of genomically unstable cells. A caveat is that the same DDR can also drive a pro-inflammatory SASP, so DNA damage both suppresses and, chronically, may promote pathology.
links.context_zh_TW: DNA 損傷，特別是持續性的雙股斷裂，透過活化 DNA 損傷反應（DDR）而成為強效的衰老誘發因子。ATM/ATR 激酶磷酸化並穩定轉錄因子 p53，後者轉錄 p21CIP1 以抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體並強制停滯。損傷誘發的衰老透過阻斷基因組不穩定細胞的增殖，作為惡性轉化的屏障。但需注意，同一 DDR 也能驅動促發炎的 SASP，因此 DNA 損傷一方面抑制、在慢性情況下卻也可能促進病理。

links.context: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
links.context_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
links.context_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

links.context: Glycation is the product of the reaction between a sugar and the free amino group of proteins, referred to as cross-linking, and the accumulation of these glycation byproducts results in large, cross-linked molecules that inhibit the ability of the cell to function normally. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) accumulate with age in tissues, contributing to arterial stiffening and cardiac enlargement. Levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of non-diabetics, and AGEs are believed to play an important role in the development of diabetic complications.
links.context_zh_TW: 糖化（glycation）是糖與蛋白質游離胺基之間反應的產物，又稱交叉連結（cross-linking），而這些糖化副產物的累積會形成大型、交叉連結的分子，抑制細胞正常運作的能力。晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）隨年齡在組織中累積，促成動脈硬化與心臟肥大。糖尿病患者的交叉連結產物水平是非糖尿病患者的兩到三倍，且AGEs被認為在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。
links.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

links.context: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
links.context_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

links.context: IDO1 is a heme-containing, monomeric cytosolic enzyme (~45 kDa) encoded by the IDO1 gene on chromosome 8p11.21 that catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step in the kynurenine pathway (KP) of tryptophan catabolism. It oxidizes L-tryptophan (and other indoleamine substrates such as D-Trp, 5-hydroxy-Trp, tryptamine and serotonin) to N-formylkynurenine in an O2-dependent reaction. The mechanism involves a heme iron center that binds O2, reduction of inactive ferric heme to active ferrous form, and oxidative cleavage of the indole ring at the 2,3-position. The KP accounts for ~95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production. IDO1 exerts immunosuppression through local tryptophan depletion: tryptophan is essential for T cell proliferation, and its depletion activates the GCN2 stress kinase, leading to cell cycle arrest, anergy, or apoptosis in effector T cells. This is one of the two main mechanisms of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression, the other being accumulation of kynurenine and its metabolites, which activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor to promote regulatory T cell differentiation and suppress effector T/NK cells. Together these create an immunosuppressive microenvironment exploited in maternal-fetal tolerance, antimicrobial defense, regulation of inflammation and autoimmunity, and tumor immune escape.
links.context_zh_TW: IDO1 是含血基質的單體胞質酶（約 45 kDa），由位於第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 的 IDO1 基因編碼，催化色胺酸分解代謝中犬尿胺酸途徑（KP）的第一步且為速率限制步驟。它在依賴 O2 的反應中將 L-色胺酸（及其他吲哚胺類受質，如 D-Trp、5-羥基-Trp、色胺與血清素）氧化為 N-甲醯犬尿胺酸。其機制涉及結合 O2 的血基質鐵中心、非活性三價鐵血基質還原為活性二價鐵形式，以及在 2,3 位置對吲哚環進行氧化斷裂。KP 佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解。 IDO1 透過局部色胺酸耗竭發揮免疫抑制：色胺酸對 T 細胞增生至關重要，其耗竭會活化 GCN2 壓力激酶，導致效應 T 細胞細胞週期停滯、無反應性或細胞凋亡。這是 IDO1 媒介免疫抑制的兩個主要機制之一，另一個是犬尿胺酸及其代謝物的累積，後者活化芳香烴受體以促進調節性 T 細胞分化並抑制效應 T/NK 細胞。兩者共同創造免疫抑制微環境，被利用於母胎耐受、抗菌防禦、發炎與自體免疫的調節，以及腫瘤免疫逃逸。

links.context: IL-6 is a prototypical SASP cytokine and one of the most consistently secreted factors in senescent cells, acting as an essential mediator of paracrine senescence and immune modulation. It signals through JAK/STAT3 to promote inflammation and, in some contexts, stemness, and it is widely used as a biomarker of the senescent secretome and of aging. IL-6 also contributes to the feed-forward loop sustaining the SASP and to inflammaging. Its prominence and reliability make it a canonical reference SASP component, frequently measured with IL-8.
links.context_zh_TW: 介白素-6（IL-6）與 IL-8 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。衰老細胞分泌 IL-6，重塑局部組織微環境並發揮旁分泌效應，甚至將衰老表型傳播給健康細胞。在本研究中，重組 IL-6（以 2:1 比例與 IL-8 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現並提高脂質過氧化，使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感，並放大組織功能障礙。

links.context: IRS1 is the upstream insulin receptor substrate in the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade: the IRS receptor upstream of the pathway is activated by binding reversibly to insulin, and active IRS1 promotes the activation of PI3K by phosphorylation. PI3K in turn activates mTORC2 by phosphorylation and activates IRS1 indirectly via AKT, forming a positive feedback loop. Active IRS1 is inactivated by phosphorylation by S6K1/2, closing a negative feedback arm. IRS1 therefore sits at the hub of the incoherent bivalent motif, and the backward reaction from the target toward IRS1 is central to the hormetic response.
links.context_zh_TW: IRS1 是 mTOR-PI3K 訊息傳導級聯中的上游胰島素受體受質：該路徑上游的 IRS 受體透過與胰島素可逆結合而活化，活化的 IRS1 經由磷酸化促進 PI3K 的活化。PI3K 接著經由磷酸化活化 mTORC2，並間接透過 AKT 活化 IRS1，形成正回饋迴路。活化的 IRS1 會被 S6K1/2 磷酸化而失活，封閉負回饋臂。因此 IRS1 位於不一致雙價基序的樞紐，從標靶朝 IRS1 的逆向反應是毒物興奮效應反應的核心。

links.context: In one short-lived mutant strain of mice, the mTOR inhibitor rapamycin (known clinically as sirolimus) extends maximum life span nearly three-fold. Rapamycin also prolongs life in normal mice as well as in yeast, worms and flies, and prevents age-related conditions in rodents, dogs, nonhuman primates and humans. In two dozen studies using different strains of mice, rapamycin extended life span, starting from the thorough study by Harrison and colleagues; rapamycin and its analog everolimus are FDA-approved for human use and have been used safely for decades, and rapamycin extends lifespan even when started late in life. Inhibition of mTOR through rapamycin and its analogs (rapalogs) consistently prolongs life in numerous animal models while improving age-related physiological functions. The breakthrough occurred in 2009 when rapamycin was reported to extend the life of genetically heterogeneous mice, changing the scientific world's perception of aging. Subsequent studies showed rapamycin extends median lifespan by about 10% in UM-HET3 mice and improves glucose tolerance, frailty indicators, gait speed, liver parameters, and weight, while in Drosophila it extends lifespan through increased autophagy and decreased age-related intestinal pathologies. Rapamycin was the only drug among five tested that altered survival.
links.context_zh_TW: 在一個短壽命的小鼠突變品系中，mTOR抑制劑rapamycin（臨床上稱為sirolimus）將最大壽命延長近三倍。Rapamycin也在正常小鼠以及酵母、蠕蟲和果蠅中延長壽命，並預防囓齒動物、狗、非人類靈長類動物和人類的年齡相關疾病。在使用不同小鼠品系的兩 dozen 研究中，rapamycin延長壽命，從Harrison和同事的徹底研究開始；rapamycin及其類似物everolimus已獲FDA批准用於人類，並且已安全使用數十年，即使在生命晚期開始rapamycin也能延長壽命。 透過rapamycin及其類似物（rapalogs）對mTOR的抑制在許多動物模型中一致地延長壽命，同時改善年齡相關的生理功能。突破發生在2009年，當時報告rapamycin延長基因異質性小鼠的壽命，改變了科學界對老化的看法。後續研究顯示rapamycin在UM-HET3小鼠中將中位壽命延長約10%，並改善葡萄糖耐受性、虛弱指標、步態速度、肝臟參數和體重，而在黑腹果蠅中，它透過增加自噬和減少年齡相關的腸道病理來延長壽命。Rapamycin是測試的五種藥物中唯一改變存活率的。

links.context: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) is a prototypical SASP cytokine and one of the most consistently upregulated and secreted factors in senescent cells. It acts as an essential mediator of paracrine senescence and immune modulation and is widely used as a biomarker of the senescent secretome and of organismal aging. IL-6 signals through the JAK/STAT3 pathway to promote inflammation and, in some contexts, stemness and cancer stem-cell traits, and it contributes to the feed-forward loop that sustains the SASP. Its prominence, reliability, and frequent co-measurement with IL-8 make IL-6 a canonical reference factor for defining and quantifying the senescent secretome.
links.context_zh_TW: 介白素-6（IL-6）是典型 SASP 細胞激素，也是衰老細胞中最一致上調與分泌最穩定的因子之一。它是旁分泌衰老與免疫調節的必要介導者，並廣泛用作衰老分泌組與機體老化的生物標記。IL-6 經 JAK/STAT3 路徑訊號促進發炎，且在部分脈絡中促進幹性與癌症幹細胞特徵，並貢獻於維持 SASP 的正向迴圈。其突出、可靠且常與 IL-8 共測，使 IL-6 成為定義與量化衰老分泌組的典型參考因子。

links.context: MFN2 (mitofusin 2), encoded by the MFN2 gene, is an outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase that regulates mitochondrial fusion and is required for outer membrane fusion together with MFN1. Beyond fusion, MFN2 plays roles in mitophagy, mitochondrial movement and lipid transfer, and its tethering action is a vital mediator of mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites that regulate calcium homeostasis and lipid metabolism. MFN2 can be phosphorylated by PINK1, promoting Parkin recruitment and inducing Parkin-dependent mitophagy, and heterozygous MFN2 mutations cause Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A. MFN2 is one of the two mitofusin GTPases that drive outer mitochondrial membrane fusion and, together with MFN1, is essential for tethering and merging adjacent mitochondria. Unlike MFN1, MFN2 additionally localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum, where it participates in tethering mitochondria to the ER and may play a role in lipid exchange. Mutations in MFN2 cause the peripheral neuropathy Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, underscoring its physiological importance. MFN2 expression is regulated by PGC-1alpha and transcriptional co-activators, so changes in MFN2 levels couple mitochondrial fusion capacity to cellular metabolic demand.
links.context_zh_TW: MFN2（mitofusin 2），由 MFN2 基因編碼，是一種外線粒體膜 GTPase，調控 mitochondrial fusion 且與 MFN1 一起 required for outer membrane fusion。除了 fusion，MFN2 在 mitophagy、mitochondrial movement 和 lipid transfer 中扮演角色，且其 tethering action 是 mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites 的 vital mediator，調控 calcium homeostasis 和 lipid metabolism。MFN2 可被 PINK1 磷酸化，促進 Parkin recruitment 並誘導 Parkin-dependent mitophagy，且 heterozygous MFN2 mutations 導致 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A。 MFN2 是兩個驅動粒線體外膜融合的 mitofusin GTP 酶之一，與 MFN1 一起對於栓繫和融合相鄰粒線體至關重要。與 MFN1 不同，MFN2 還定位於內質網，參與將粒線體栓繫到內質網，並可能在脂質交換中扮演角色。MFN2 突變會導致周圍神經病變 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A，突顯其生理重要性。MFN2 表達受 PGC-1alpha 和轉錄共激活因子調節，因此 MFN2 水平的變化將粒線體融合能力與細胞代謝需求相連結。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
links.context_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
links.context_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

links.context: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

links.context: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。
links.source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

links.context: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
links.context_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

links.context: Mitochondrial fusion and mitochondrial fission are opposing, continuously active processes that together maintain the mitochondrial network in a state of dynamic equilibrium known as mitochondrial dynamics. Fusion mixes mitochondrial contents, diluting damaged components, while fission segregates and removes dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments through mitophagy. The fine-tuned balance between the two processes determines mitochondrial morphology, bioenergetic output, and quality control. A shift toward fusion produces elongated, interconnected networks favoring oxidative phosphorylation, whereas a shift toward fission fragments the network and accompanies stress, apoptosis, and pathological remodeling, making the fusion-fission equilibrium central to cellular homeostasis.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體融合和粒線體分裂是相互對立、持續進行的過程，共同維持粒線體網路處於稱為粒線體動力學的動態平衡狀態。融合混合粒線體內容物，稀釋受損成分，而分裂則透過粒線體自噬分離並移除功能失調的粒線體片段。這兩個過程之間的精細平衡決定了粒線體形態、能量代謝產出和品質控制。偏向融合會產生細長、互連的網路，有利於氧化磷酸化，而偏向分裂則會使網路碎片化，伴隨壓力、細胞凋亡和病理性重塑，使融合-分裂平衡成為細胞恆定性的核心。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

links.context: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Multiple caspases redundantly cleave SIRT1 at the C-terminal DEPDVP(704-709) motif under severe DNA damage. Only pan-caspase inhibitors (Q-VD-OPh, Boc-D-FMK, z-VAD) blocked cleavage, while individual knockdown of CASP1-9 failed — the cleavage is distributed across the cascade. The D707A point mutant resists cleavage and the ΔC703 truncation mimics the cleaved fragment. Caspase-mediated SIRT1 cleavage places it in the DDR-cleavage set alongside PARP, DNA-PKcs, and ATM itself — dismantling the repair machinery commits the cell to death.
links.context_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，多種 caspases 會以冗餘方式在 SIRT1 的 C 端 DEPDVP(704-709) 基序進行切割。只有廣效 caspase 抑制劑（Q-VD-OPh、Boc-D-FMK、z-VAD）能阻斷切割，個別沉默 CASP1-9 皆無效——切割分布在整個級聯中。D707A 點突變可抵抗切割，ΔC703 截斷則模擬被切割的片段。caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割使其與 PARP、DNA-PKcs 及 ATM 本身同列於 DDR 切割組——拆解修復機器等同讓細胞走向死亡。
links.source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md

links.context: NF-kB is the master transcription factor regulating SASP gene expression, controlling the bulk of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors in senescent cells. It is activated by p38 MAPK, GATA4, cGAS-STING, and IL-1R/MyD88 signaling and cooperates with C/EBPb at SASP enhancers to coordinate the secretome. Inhibition of NF-kB robustly suppresses the SASP across models, making it a prime senomorphic target. Its regulatory role is central, though it operates with other axes such as mTOR and AP-1 for full secretome output.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是調節 SASP 基因表現的主轉錄因子，控制衰老細胞中大部分促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子與生長因子。它被 p38 MAPK、GATA4、cGAS-STING 與 IL-1R/MyD88 訊號活化，並在 SASP 增強子上與 C/EBPb 協作協調分泌組。抑制 NF-κB 在多種模型中強力抑制 SASP，使其成為主要 senomorphic 標靶。其調節角色為中心，但與 mTOR 與 AP-1 等其他軸共同運作以達完整分泌組輸出。

links.context: NF-κB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, controlling expression of the bulk of pro-inflammatory interleukins, chemokines, and growth factors. It is activated downstream of multiple senescence inputs including p38 MAPK, GATA4 (via TRAF3IP2), and cGAS-STING, and it cooperates with C/EBPbeta at SASP enhancers. Inhibition of NF-κB robustly suppresses the inflammatory arm of the SASP across many models. A caveat is that NF-κB is necessary but not sufficient -- full SASP establishment requires additional axes such as IL-1α/MyD88 and mTOR.
links.context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 SASP 的主要轉錄調節者，控制大部分促發炎介白素、趨化因子與生長因子的表現。它在 p38 MAPK、GATA4（經由 TRAF3IP2）、cGAS-STING 等多種衰老輸入下游被活化，並在 SASP 增強子上與 C/EBPbeta 協作。抑制 NF-κB 在多種模型中強力抑制 SASP 的發炎臂。需注意，NF-κB 是必要的但非充分的——完整的 SASP 建立還需要 IL-1α/MyD88 與 mTOR 等額外軸。

links.context: OPA1 (optic atrophy 1) is the dynamin-related GTPase that mediates inner mitochondrial membrane fusion, needed in only one of two colliding mitochondria for fusing the inner membranes. OPA1 exists as eight isoforms and is proteolytically processed by OMA1, YME1L1, PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease to generate long (L-OPA1) and short (S-OPA1) forms; L-OPA1 promotes fusion while S-OPA1 modulates it by forming complexes with L-OPA1. Decreased OPA1 reduces fusion and contributes to separating dysfunctional mitochondria for mitophagic removal, and OPA1 mutations cause dominant optic atrophy. Inner mitochondrial membrane fusion is mediated by optic atrophy 1 (OPA1), a dynamin-related GTPase that also maintains cristae structure. OPA1 exists in long membrane-bound forms and short soluble forms generated by proteolytic cleavage; the balance of long and short OPA1 isoforms regulates inner membrane fusion and cristae remodeling. Proteolytic processing of OPA1 by the peptidases YME1L and OMA1 links fusion activity to metabolic state and cellular stress, since OMA1 cleaves OPA1 under stress or loss of the mitochondrial membrane potential. Mutations in OPA1 cause dominant optic atrophy, the most common inherited optic neuropathy.
links.context_zh_TW: OPA1（視神經萎縮1）是介導內粒線體膜融合的dynamin相關GTP酶，在兩個碰撞的粒線體中只需一個即可融合內膜。OPA1以八種異構體形式存在，並被OMA1、YME1L1、PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶蛋白水解加工以產生長形式（L-OPA1）和短形式（S-OPA1）；L-OPA1促進融合，而S-OPA1通過與L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。OPA1減少降低融合並有助於分離功能異常的粒線體以進行線粒體自噬清除，OPA1突變導致顯性視神經萎縮。 粒線體內膜融合由視神經萎縮蛋白 1（OPA1）介導，OPA1 是一種 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶，也維持嵴結構。OPA1 以長的膜結合形式和短的可溶形式存在，後者由蛋白水解切割產生；長和短 OPA1 異構體的平衡調節內膜融合和嵴重塑。OPA1 被肽酶 YME1L 和 OMA1 蛋白水解加工，將融合活性與代謝狀態和細胞壓力相連結，因為 OMA1 在壓力或粒線體膜電位喪失時切割 OPA1。OPA1 突變會導致顯性視神經萎縮，這是最常見的遺傳性視神經病變。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Rapamycin binds specifically and reversibly to mTORC1, the rapamycin-sensitive complex formed when mTOR associates with raptor; the downstream readout of the signaling cascade in this study is instead mTORC2. Long-term rapamycin exposure (around 24 hours) traps mTOR in mTORC1 complexes, and this sequestration obstructs the assembly of mTORC2. Because rapamycin acts as an indirect activator of mTORC2 via PI3K and an indirect inhibitor of mTORC2 through this sequestration, the pathway architecture resembles an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target mTORC1.
links.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin特異性和可逆地結合mTORC1，這是mTOR與raptor結合時形成的rapamycin敏感複合物；本研究中信號級聯的下游讀數是mTORC2。長期rapamycin暴露（約24小時）將mTOR困在mTORC1複合物中，這種隔離阻礙了mTORC2的組裝。由於rapamycin透過PI3K作為mTORC2的間接活化劑，並透過這種隔離作為mTORC2的間接抑制劑，該通路架構類似於以目標mTORC1為中心的不連貫二價網路基序。

links.context: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
links.context_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

links.context: Senescent cells are individual cells that have entered the state of cellular senescence -- a stable, essentially irreversible cell-cycle arrest accompanied by the SASP, SAHF (in many human cells), and altered metabolism. They are the cellular instantiation of the senescence process and the units that accumulate in tissues. Distinct from quiescent or differentiated cells, they remain viable yet non-proliferative and pro-secretory. Their persistence and accumulation are what translate the senescence program into organismal-level aging and disease effects.
links.context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞是已進入細胞衰老狀態的個別細胞——一種穩定、本質上不可逆的細胞週期停滯，伴隨 SASP、SAHF（於多數人類細胞）與代謝改變。它們是衰老過程的細胞實例化，也是在組織中累積的單元。不同於靜止或分化細胞，它們仍存活但非增殖且具促分泌性。它們的持續與累積將衰老程序轉化為個體層次的老化與疾病效應。

links.context: Targeting mitochondrial citrate metabolism suppresses inflammation across tissues and improves tissue function and healthspan during ageing without detectable changes in p16 or p21 expression, consistent with SASP modulation rather than senolytic clearance of senescent cells. In aged muscle, senescent-like nuclei defined by the CoreScence gene signature are present at similar abundance and distribution across conditions despite reduced SASP-associated transcription and chromatin accessibility at loci such as Ccl2 and Igfbp4. In the liver, the abundance of p16-positive and/or p21-positive cells remains unchanged while their nuclear histone acetylation is reduced by CTPI2 treatment.
links.context_zh_TW: 靶向線粒體枸櫞酸代謝抑制多個組織中的炎症，並在老化過程中改善組織功能和健康壽命，而p16或p21表達沒有可檢測到的變化，這與SASP調節而非衰老細胞的senolytic清除一致。在老年肌肉中，由CoreScence基因特徵定義的衰老樣細胞核在不同條件下以相似的豐度和分佈存在，儘管SASP相關轉錄和染色質可及性在Ccl2和Igfbp4等位點降低。在肝臟中，p16陽性和/或p21陽性細胞的豐度保持不變，而它們的細胞核組蛋白乙酰化被CTPI2治療降低。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: The D2 receptor is an inhibitory (Gi/o-coupled) dopamine receptor whose activation reduces cAMP and opens GIRK potassium channels, hyperpolarizing neurons in the central nervous system. It is a major mediator of dopamine's modulatory effects on movement, reward, motivation, and cognition, and is highly expressed on striatal medium spiny neurons. Its inhibition of cAMP signaling contrasts with the excitatory D1 receptor, enabling bidirectional dopaminergic tuning of basal ganglia output. It is also the principal target of antipsychotic medications.
links.context_zh_TW: D2 receptor 是一種抑制性（Gi/o 偶聯）多巴胺受體，活化可降低 cAMP 並打開 GIRK 鉀通道，使中樞神經系統中的神經元超極化。它是多巴胺對 movement、reward、動機和認知的調節作用的主要介質，並且在紋狀體中型多棘神經元上高度表達。它對 cAMP 訊號傳導的抑制與興奮性 D1 receptor 形成對比，從而實現 basal ganglia 輸出的雙向多巴胺能調節。這也是antipsychotic medications的主要目標。

links.context: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with better performance on complex working memory tasks, attributed to the elevated prefrontal dopamine tone produced by reduced enzyme activity. Under non-stressful conditions, this higher dopamine level falls near the peak of the inverted-U curve for cognition, favoring stability, accuracy, and maintenance of information. The association is robust at the group level but moderate in effect size and sensitive to task demands, sex, and environmental context such as stress. It is among the most replicated gene-cognition associations in humans.
links.context_zh_TW: Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 與複雜工作記憶任務的較佳表現有關，這歸因於酵素活性降低產生的前額葉多巴胺張力升高。在無壓力的情況下，這種較高的多巴胺水平落在認知倒 U 曲線的峰值附近，有利於訊息的穩定性、準確性和維護。這種關聯在群體層面上很強，但效應大小適中，並且對任務要求、性別和壓力等環境背景敏感。它是人類複製最多的基因認知關聯之一。

links.context: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
links.context_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

links.context: The cerebellum serves as a negative control in COMT-OE studies because CaMKIIalpha-promoter-driven transgene expression is forebrain-restricted, leaving cerebellar structure and function intact. Demonstrating preserved cerebellar-dependent performance, such as motor coordination and balance, confirms that observed cognitive or motor effects arise from forebrain COMT overexpression rather than generalized toxicity. This control strengthens causal interpretation of the model's behavioral outcomes. It exemplifies the value of region-specific promoters in behavioral neuroscience.
links.context_zh_TW: 小腦充當 negative control in COMT-OE studies，因為 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子驅動的轉基因表達受到前腦限制，從而保持小腦結構和功能完整。證明保留的小腦依賴性性能，例如 motor coordination 和平衡，證實觀察到的認知或運動效應是由前腦 COMT 過度表達而不是普遍毒性引起的。這種控制加強了對模型行為結果的因果解釋。它例證了區域特異性啟動子在行為神經科學中的價值。

links.context: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and its expression increases across multiple senescence models including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Pharmacological inhibition of MPC with UK5099 reduces TCA cycle intermediates and increases lactate levels, consistent with impaired mitochondrial pyruvate import, and suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion without affecting cell cycle arrest. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of MPC1 similarly reduces SASP factors such as IL6 and IL8, identifying pyruvate import as the entry node of the mitochondrial metabolic axis controlling the SASP.
links.context_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）將糖酵解產生的丙酮酸連結至三羧酸循環，其表達在多種衰老模型中增加，包括輻射誘導、doxorubicin誘導和複製性衰老。用UK5099對MPC進行藥理學抑制可降低三羧酸循環中間體並增加乳酸水平，符合粒線體丙酮酸輸入受損的特徵，並抑制SASP基因表達和分泌，而不影響細胞週期停滯。CRISPR-Cas9介導的MPC1缺失同樣減少SASP因子如IL6和IL8，確認丙酮酸輸入是控制SASP的粒線體代謝軸的進入節點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: The p16INK4a/Rb pathway enforces the long-term, irreversible phase of senescence independently of p53. p16 inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, keeping Rb hypophosphorylated and bound to E2F, thereby preventing expression of S-phase genes; this locks in a durable growth arrest. Unlike the p53/p21 arm, which can be transient, p16/Rb-mediated arrest is typically sustained for the life of the cell and is the stronger correlate of in vivo senescent burden with age. Its engagement is a key determinant of why senescence is considered irreversible rather than a quiescent state.
links.context_zh_TW: p16INK4a/Rb 路徑獨立於 p53 地執行衰老的長期、不可逆階段。p16 抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，使 Rb 維持低磷酸化並結合 E2F，從而阻止 S 期基因表現；這將持久的生長停滯鎖定。與可能短暫的 p53/p21 臂不同，p16/Rb 介導的停滯通常維持細胞終生，且是體內衰老負擔隨年齡更強的相關因子。其啟動是衰老被視為不可逆而非靜止狀態的關鍵決定因素。

links.context: The p53/p21 axis is a primary enforcement mechanism of senescence, especially in damage- and stress-induced forms. DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 inhibits cyclin E/A-CDK2, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and blocking S-phase entry. This pathway provides a rapid, p53-dose-dependent G1/S arrest that can be engaged acutely after genotoxic insult. A caveat is that the p53 pathway is frequently disabled in cancer, and p53 also restrains the SASP, so its loss reshapes rather than simply abolishes senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: p53/p21 軸是衰老的主要執行機制，尤其在損傷與壓力誘發的形式中。DNA 損傷穩定 p53，後者轉錄誘導 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 抑制 cyclin E/A-CDK2，阻止 Rb 磷酸化並阻斷 S 期進入。此路徑提供快速、依賴 p53 劑量的 G1/S 停滯，可在基因毒性傷害後立即啟動。需注意，p53 路徑在癌症中常被失能，且 p53 也會抑制 SASP，因此其缺失是重塑而非單純廢除衰老。

links.context: The prefrontal cortex has limited dopamine transporter expression compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine persists longer in the extracellular space and is inactivated mainly by diffusion, NET uptake, and COMT O-methylation. This anatomical constraint is the reason COMT genotype exerts its strongest cognitive effects in prefrontal-dependent tasks. It contrasts sharply with the DAT-dominated striatum, where reuptake is fast. This regional difference is foundational to understanding dopamine regulation and COMT's cognitive role.
links.context_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質的多巴胺轉運蛋白表達有限，這意味著多巴胺在細胞外空間中持續時間更長，並且主要透過擴散、NET 攝取和 COMT O-甲基化而失去活性。這種解剖學限制是 COMT genotype 在前額葉依賴性任務中發揮最強認知作用的原因。它與 DAT 主導的紋狀體形成鮮明對比，後者的再攝取速度很快。這種區域差異是理解多巴胺調節和 COMT 認知作用的基礎。

links.context: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
links.context_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

links.context: The thymus exhibits profound age-associated involution, a striking paradoxical feature of this critical lymphoid tissue. Thymic function begins to decrease from the first year of life; the lymphoid component of the thymic epithelial space involutes roughly 3% per year through middle age (35-45 years) and about 1% per year thereafter, while the perivascular space expands with adipocytes and peripheral lymphocytes. By age 70, the TES falls below 10% of total thymus tissue. Although thymic decline is of minimal consequence to healthy individuals, the reduced efficacy of the aging immune system has direct etiological links with opportunistic infections, autoimmunity, and cancer burden.
links.context_zh_TW: 胸腺表現出顯著的年齡相關退化，這是這一關鍵淋巴組織的一個突出矛盾特徵。胸腺功能從生命第一年開始下降；胸腺上皮空間的淋巴成分以每年約 3% 的速度退化至中年（35-45 歲），此後每年約 1%，而血管周圍空間隨脂肪細胞和外周淋巴細胞擴增。到 70 歲時，TES 降至總胸腺組織的 10% 以下。儘管胸腺衰退對健康個體影響極小，但老化免疫系統效力降低與機會性感染、自身免疫和癌症負擔有直接的病因學聯繫。

links.context: Val158Met impacts COMT enzyme activity profoundly: the Met allele encodes a thermolabile protein with roughly three- to four-fold lower activity than the Val allele, making it the principal determinant of fast versus slow catechol clearance. This activity difference cascades into altered dopamine tone, cognition, mood, and drug responses, and underlies the warrior-worrier dichotomy. It is the most functionally consequential COMT variant and among the most studied in psychiatric genetics. Its effect on enzyme kinetics is among the best characterized in human genetics.
links.context_zh_TW: Val158Met 深刻影響 COMT 酶活性：Met 等位基因編碼的不耐熱蛋白的活性比 Val 等位基因低約三到四倍，使其成為快速與慢速兒茶酚清除的主要決定因素。這種活動差異會導致多巴胺音調、認知、情緒和藥物反應的改變，並成為戰士與擔憂者二分法的基礎。它是功能上最重要的 COMT 變體，也是精神遺傳學中研究最多的變體之一。它對酶動力學的影響是人類遺傳學中最具代表性的。

links.context: Val158Met involves a valine-to-methionine amino acid substitution at codon 158 of the COMT enzyme, replacing a hydrophobic residue with a polar one that destabilizes the protein and reduces its catalytic activity in the Met form. This single missense change is the molecular basis of the fast-slow COMT dichotomy and of the three- to four-fold differences in enzyme activity among genotypes. It is the defining feature of the rs4680 polymorphism. The substitution alters protein thermostability rather than substrate binding directly.
links.context_zh_TW: Val158Met 涉及 COMT 酶密碼子 158 處的纈氨酸至甲硫氨酸氨基酸取代，以極性殘基取代疏水性殘基，從而使蛋白質不穩定並降低其 Met 形式的催化活性。這種單一的錯義變化是快慢 COMT 二分法以及基因型之間酵素活性三到四倍差異的分子基礎。這是 rs4680 多態性的定義特性。這種取代改變了蛋白質的熱穩定性，而不是直接改變底物結合。

links.context: Val158Met is a SNP in the COMT gene, specifically a missense variant that alters enzyme function rather than merely regulatory sequence, making it a functional polymorphism. Its location within the COMT coding region directly changes protein thermostability and activity, producing the fast-slow enzyme dichotomy. It is therefore both a marker and a mechanistic driver of COMT-related traits, including cognition, mood, and drug response. It exemplifies how a single coding variant can have broad biological consequences.
links.context_zh_TW: Val158Met 是 COMT 基因中的 SNP，特別是一種錯義變異體，它改變酵素功能而不僅僅是調節序列，使其成為功能性多態性。它在 COMT 編碼區內的位置直接改變蛋白質的熱穩定性和活性，產生快慢酶二分法。因此，它既是 COMT 相關特徵（包括認知、情緒和 drug response）的標記，也是機械驅動因素。它舉例說明了單一編碼變體如何產生廣泛的生物學後果。

links.context: mTOR can bind to raptor to form the complex mTORC1, or to rictor to form mTORC2, and these complexes have distinct functions and sensitivities. Rapamycin binds specifically and reversibly to mTORC1, while the RICTOR subunit of mTORC2 inhibits its interaction with the FKBP12-rapamycin complex, making mTORC2 effectively insensitive to rapamycin. The model of the pathway includes a dynamic equilibrium between free mTOR and mTORC1, and long-term rapamycin treatment sequesters mTOR in mTORC1 complexes, obstructing the assembly of mTORC2.
links.context_zh_TW: mTOR可與raptor結合形成複合物mTORC1，或與rictor結合形成mTORC2，這些複合物具有不同的功能和敏感性。雷帕霉素特異且可逆地結合mTORC1，而mTORC2的RICTOR亞基抑制其與FKBP12-雷帕霉素複合物的相互作用，使mTORC2對雷帕霉素 effectively 不敏感。該通路的模型包括游離mTOR和mTORC1之間的動態平衡，長期雷帕霉素治療將mTOR隔離在mTORC1複合物中，阻碍mTORC2的組裝。

links.context: mTORC1, the complex formed when mTOR binds to raptor, activates the ribosomal protein S6 kinases S6K1/S6K2 (S6K1/2) by phosphorylation. Active S6K1/2 in turn inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylation, forming a negative feedback loop that regulates insulin signaling, and also deactivates mTORC2. In the mass-action model of the mTOR-PI3K pathway, the Michaelis-Menten constant for the activation of S6K1/2 by mTORC1 is significantly smaller on average than other pathway constants, correlating with the low backward-reaction constant that increases the rate of hormesis in rapamycin-treated networks.
links.context_zh_TW: mTORC1是mTOR與raptor結合形成的複合物，透過磷酸化激活核糖體蛋白S6激酶S6K1/S6K2（S6K1/2）。活化的S6K1/2反過來透過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成調節胰島素信號的負反饋環路，並同時使mTORC2失活。在mTOR-PI3K通路的質量作用模型中，mTORC1對S6K1/2的活化的米氏常數顯著小於其他通路常數，與增加雷帕霉素處理網絡中興奮作用速率的低後向反應常數相關。

links.context: mtDNA-cGAS-STING signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation operate as independently regulated pathways: senescent BAX- and BAK-deficient fibroblasts show reduced SASP gene expression from impaired cytosolic mtDNA release yet unchanged H3K27ac at SASP loci, and STING inhibition suppresses SASP without affecting histone acetylation. Despite this independence the pathways functionally cooperate: disruption of either is sufficient to suppress SASP while activation of either alone is not sufficient to fully restore it. Acetyl-CoA enables chromatin accessibility at SASP loci while mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling provides the activation required to engage these regions.
links.context_zh_TW: mtDNA-cGAS-STING訊息傳導與粒線體對組蛋白乙醯化的調控，是作為獨立調控的途徑運作的：衰老的BAX與BAK缺陷纖維母細胞因細胞質mtDNA釋放受損而表現出SASP基因表現降低，但SASP基因座的H3K27ac維持不變；抑制STING可抑制SASP，卻不影響組蛋白乙醯化。儘管彼此獨立，這些途徑在功能上仍相互合作：破壞任何一者都足以抑制SASP，而單獨活化任何一者都不足以完全恢復SASP。乙醯輔酶A（Acetyl-CoA）賦予SASP基因座染色質可及性，而mtDNA驅動的先天免疫訊息傳導則提供參與這些區域所需的活化訊號。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
links.context_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。
links.source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

links.context: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a variation at a single nucleotide position in the genome, the most common type of genetic variation, occurring roughly every few hundred bases. SNPs such as COMT Val158Met (rs4680) can alter protein function, gene expression, or drug response, making them the primary markers used in pharmacogenetic and behavioral genetics studies. Most SNPs are neutral, but functional variants can have substantial biological effects. They are the foundation of modern association studies.
links.context_zh_TW: 單核苷酸多態性 (SNP) 是基因組中單一核苷酸位置的變異，是最常見的遺傳變異類型，大約每幾百個鹼基就會發生一次。 SNPs（例如 COMT Val158Met (rs4680)）可以改變蛋白質功能，gene expression 或 drug response，使它們成為藥物遺傳學和行為遺傳學研究中使用的主要標記。大多數 SNPs 是中性的，但功能變異可以產生顯著的生物效應。它們是現代聯想研究的基礎。

links.context: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
links.context_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

links.context: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
links.context_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Alzheimer disease is the most common dementia and neurodegenerative disorder. Classification nests it in the disease family.
links.context_zh_TW: 阿茲海默病是最常見的失智與神經退化疾病。歸類將它嵌套於疾病家族。

links.context: Aminoguanidine, also developed as pimagedine by Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics, is the first identified inhibitor of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). By trapping reactive carbonyl species, it prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins that is proposed to drive many features of aging. Most anti-aging research has been carried out using a hydrochloride (HCL) derivative, which is more soluble and less irritating than the bicarbonate form, and aminoguanidine has a half-life of only 4 hours, so dosages of 150-300 mg per day are best administered in split doses.
links.context_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Aminoguanidine)，也由 Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics 开发为皮马地宁 (pimagadidine)，是先进糖基化终产物 (AGEs) 的首个抑制剂。通过捕获反应性羰基物种，它能阻止组织蛋白的交联，这被认为是导致衰老许多特征的原因。大部分抗衰老研究都使用盐酸盐 (HCL) 衍生物进行，该衍生物比碳酸氢盐形式更可溶且刺激性更小，而氨基胍丁的半衰期仅为 4 小时，因此，每日 150-300 毫克分剂量给药效果最佳。
links.source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

links.context: Apigenin is a dietary flavone flavonoid identified by screening a 66-compound natural product library against bleomycin-senescent PSC27 human prostate stromal cells. It functions as a senomorphic agent: it suppresses the pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) without killing senescent cells or forcing them back into the cell cycle, in contrast to senolytics such as ABT-263 or procyanidin C1, which preferentially lyse senescent cells. Because it leaves the growth arrest intact, apigenin is classified specifically as a natural senomorphic rather than a senolytic, aligning with the ideal profile for SASP-restraining geroprotective therapy.
links.context_zh_TW: 芹菜素是一種膳食黃酮類化合物（flavone flavonoid），透過以博萊黴素（bleomycin）誘導衰老的人類前列腺基質細胞PSC27篩選含66種化合物的天然產物庫而鑑定出來。它的功能是衰老形態調節劑（senomorphic agent）：在不殺死衰老細胞、也不強迫其重返細胞週期的情況下，抑制促發炎的衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）；這與優先溶解衰老細胞的衰老細胞清除劑（如ABT-263或原花青素C1）形成對比。由於芹菜素保留了生長停滯狀態，它被明確歸類為天然衰老形態調節劑而非衰老細胞清除劑，符合以抑制SASP為目標的老年保護療法之理想特性。

links.context: At Merck, Campbell led the effort to derivatize avermectin B1a into 22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a (ivermectin).
links.context_zh_TW: 在默克，Campbell 領導了將阿維菌素 B1a 衍生化為 22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a（伊維菌素）的工作。

links.context: Avermectin B1a is the natural macrocyclic-lactone precursor of ivermectin (22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a), the semi-synthetic lead derivative developed for human and veterinary medicine.
links.context_zh_TW: Avermectin B1a 是伊維菌素（22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a）的天然大環內酯前體，伊維菌素是為人類和獸醫開發的半合成先導衍生物。

links.context: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
links.context_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

links.context: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
links.context_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

links.context: COMT requires magnesium as a cofactor, because the enzyme's catalytic domain depends on divalent cations, magnesium in particular, to stabilize the SAMe-substrate complex and support efficient methyl transfer to the catechol ring. Magnesium deficiency can therefore impair COMT efficiency and slow catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetic slow variants. Adequate magnesium status is frequently emphasized in protocols supporting slow or balanced COMT function, since the metal is essential for catalysis. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
links.context_zh_TW: COMT 需要鎂作為輔助因子，因為該酶的催化結構域依賴二價陽離子，特別是鎂，以穩定 SAMe-底物複合物並支持有效的甲基轉移到兒茶酚環。因此，Magnesium 缺陷會損害 COMT 效率並減慢兒茶酚胺清除率，從而加劇遺傳慢變異的影響。在支援緩慢或平衡 COMT 功能的方案中經常強調充足的鎂狀態，因為金屬對於催化至關重要。這使得鎂成為維持健康的實用營養槓桿 COMT activity。

links.context: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
links.context_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
links.context_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

links.context: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
links.context_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
links.context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

links.context: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family. Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes. DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts).
links.context_zh_TW: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family。Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes。DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts)。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
links.context_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

links.context: During apoptosis the initiator caspase-9 directly cleaves SIRT1 (Sir2α), the NAD+-dependent deacetylase that normally restrains p53- and FOXO-driven death programs. Cleavage is caspase-dependent: dominant-negative caspase-9 blocks both the lower-molecular-weight SIRT1 band and its nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization in TNF-α-treated HeLa cells. Because caspase-9 sits at the top of the intrinsic cascade, SIRT1 dismantling begins early in the apoptotic process rather than as a late cleanup event. This is the founding observation of the caspase-to-sirtuin feedback direction.
links.context_zh_TW: 在細胞凋亡過程中，起始半胱天冬酶-9（Caspase-9）會直接切割 SIRT1（Sir2α）——這個通常抑制 p53 與 FOXO 死亡程序的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶。切割是 caspase 依賴性的：顯性負向 Caspase-9 同時阻斷了 TNF-α 處理的 HeLa 細胞中較低分子量的 SIRT1 條帶及其由細胞核向細胞質的重新定位。由於 Caspase-9 位於內在級聯的頂端，SIRT1 的瓦解在細胞凋亡早期即已開始，而非晚期的清理事件。這是 caspase 至 sirtuin 回饋方向的奠基性觀察。
links.source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md

links.context: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
links.context_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

links.context: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
links.context_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

links.context: FNDC5 is a 209-amino acid type I transmembrane protein whose fibronectin type III domain is proteolytically cleaved at a site in the linker region (around aa 140/141) and secreted as the myokine irisin. Böström et al. (2012) demonstrated this conversion during exercise, establishing that FNDC5 is the transmembrane precursor of irisin; the responsible sheddase is still not definitively identified, with cathepsin B proposed.
links.context_zh_TW: FNDC5 是一個 209 個胺基酸的 type I 跨膜蛋白，其 fibronectin type III 結構域會在 linker 區域（約 aa 140/141）被蛋白酶切割並以 myokine irisin 的形式分泌。Böström 等人（2012）在運動過程中證實了這個轉換，確立 FNDC5 是 irisin 的跨膜前驅物；負責切割的 sheddase 仍未定案，目前提出 cathepsin B 為候選。

links.context: Fisetin (3,3',4',7-tetrahydroxyflavone) is a natural flavonoid of the flavonol subclass found in strawberries, apples, persimmons, onions, and cucumbers, with strawberries being the richest dietary source. It has the molecular formula C15H10O6 and a molecular weight of 286.24 g/mol. Fisetin is widely studied as a senolytic agent, and its anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective activities are reported in numerous in vitro and in vivo studies. Despite its broad pharmacological potential, fisetin has extremely poor aqueous solubility, which severely limits its oral bioavailability.
links.context_zh_TW: Fisetin（3,3',4',7-四羥基黃酮）是黃酮醇亞類的天然黃酮類化合物，存在於草莓、蘋果、柿子、洋蔥與黃瓜中，其中草莓是最豐富的膳食來源。其分子式為C15H10O6，分子量為286.24 g/mol。Fisetin被廣泛研究作為senolytic藥物，其抗氧化、抗發炎、抗癌、抗糖尿病與神經保護活性在眾多體外與體內研究中均有報告。儘管藥理潛力廣泛，fisetin的水溶性極差，嚴重限制其口服生體可用率。
links.source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

links.context: Following the Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 recommendations, necroptosis is canonically defined as necrotic cell death dependent on RIPK3 — not synonymous with all active necrosis, and mechanistically distinct from other regulated-necrosis programs such as MPT (Linkermann & Green, NEJM 2014).
links.context_zh_TW: 依 Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 之建議，necroptosis 被規範性定義為依賴 RIPK3 的壞死性細胞死亡——不等同於所有活化性壞死，且在機制上與其他 regulated necrosis 程序（如 MPT）截然不同。

links.context: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most malignant primary brain tumor in adults (grade IV astrocytoma).
links.context_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤 (GBM) 是成人中最惡性的原發性腦腫瘤（IV級星形細胞瘤）。

links.context_zh_TW: HER2 富集癌是乳癌的分子亞型。

links.context: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
links.context_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

links.context: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
links.context_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。
links.source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md

links.context: In healthy mitochondria, PINK1 (PTEN-induced putative kinase 1) is continuously imported into the inner membrane, cleaved and degraded by PARL and mitochondrial processing peptidases. When mitochondrial membrane potential becomes abnormal or import is impaired, PINK1 stabilizes and accumulates on the outer mitochondrial membrane, where its kinase domain phosphorylates outer membrane proteins and recruits and activates the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin (PRKN). PINK1 phosphorylation of MFN2 acts as a Parkin receptor that facilitates Parkin recruitment, and activated Parkin polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins, marking damaged mitochondria for autophagic degradation.
links.context_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，PINK1（PTEN-induced putative kinase 1）持續被輸入內膜，並被PARL和粒線體加工肽酶切割和降解。當粒線體膜電位異常或輸入受損時，PINK1會穩定並累積在外膜上，其激酶結構域在此磷酸化外膜蛋白質並招募和活化E3泛素連接酶Parkin（PRKN）。PINK1對MFN2的磷酸化作為Parkin受體，促進Parkin招募，活化的Parkin將外膜蛋白質多聚泛素化，標記受損粒線體以進行自噬降解。
links.source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

links.context: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
links.context_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context: In senescent cells the mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, increasing the availability of acetyl-CoA to support histone acetylation at SASP gene loci. Although acetyl-CoA can be generated from alternative sources such as acetate, fatty acid oxidation and amino acid metabolism, in senescent cells mitochondria constitute a dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification, creating a dependence on mitochondrial acetyl-CoA to sustain epigenetic activation of inflammatory gene programmes. Pathways controlling cytosolic acetyl-CoA production, including mitochondrial citrate export and its conversion by ATP-citrate lyase, are upregulated during senescence.
links.context_zh_TW: In senescent cells，mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis 被 upregulated，增加 acetyl-CoA 可用性以支持 SASP gene loci 的 histone acetylation。雖然 acetyl-CoA 可從 alternative sources 如 acetate、fatty acid oxidation 和 amino acid metabolism 產生，但在 senescent cells 中 mitochondria 構成 dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification，創造對 mitochondrial acetyl-CoA 的依賴以維持 inflammatory gene programmes 的 epigenetic activation。控制 cytosolic acetyl-CoA production 的 pathways，包括 mitochondrial citrate export 和其 conversion by ATP-citrate lyase，在 senescence 期間 upregulated。
links.source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

links.context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是由 William C. Campbell 和默克公司的同事從阿維菌素中開發出來的。
